prompts.text:
Vertical 2:3 poster, typography-first high-end fashion character poster, featuring a design where an image is embedded within giant letters on a black background. The absolute main subject of the visual is the name "RAIDEN," followed by the character. The top row is "RAI" and the bottom row is "DEN," using an extremely bold, narrow, long, and heavy sans-serif font. The letters almost fill the entire width of the frame, with thick vertical strokes, tight counters, and extremely narrow letter spacing, leaving only crisp black slits between the letters. The two rows of letters are tightly arranged, forming a strong, steady geometric visual subject that clearly reads "RAIDEN" at first glance.

Most important structural requirement: A single complete and continuous real-life fashion photograph is embedded inside all the letters. One photograph is precisely cropped by the shapes of the six letters, with the person, architecture, streets, lights, and perspective perfectly aligned across both sides of the letter slits. The black slits only serve as structural divisions for the font, while the photo inside the letters remains naturally continuous. The letters have sufficient width for a large area of the photo to be visible; the character's face falls completely within the wider letter area of the top row, with clear and coherent facial features.

The protagonist of the photo is a real-life Coser of Raiden Shogun from "Genshin Impact," a 24-year-old adult East Asian woman, a Japanese-style cold and elegant high-end fashion model. Small oval face, narrow and slightly upturned violet eyes, straight and sharp eyebrows, a straight bridge of the nose, a tiny tear mole under the right eye, cold white skin tone, and lips in a low-saturation rose bean paste color. Realistic skin with clear fine pores and natural textures, and facial features with slight realistic asymmetry. Expression is calm and majestic, with a gaze directed straight into the lens.

Tall stature, slender neck and shoulders, naturally full chest, slim waistline, superior hip-to-leg ratio, and long, straight legs.

Deep purple long hair braided into a thick and loose braid hanging behind her, keeping the character's signature neat bangs on the forehead, a purple flower-shaped hair ornament on the side of the hair, and the end of the braid and stray hairs gently blown up by the night wind.

The costume is a modern high-fashion version of Raiden Shogun's original design: a black-purple slim-fit long trench coat with sharp shoulder lines, a cinched waist, deep purple satin lapels, and a low-key thunder pattern embroidery on the lining of the hem; paired with a violet square-neck slim-fit top, a wide black belt around the waist, a deep purple high-waisted short skirt, black semi-transparent stockings, and black pointed-toe stiletto boots. Purple-gold details echo Raiden Shogun's signature Electro Mitsu-domoe crest. The overall design retains the nobility, coldness, and majesty of the character's original setting.

Action: She is walking face-forward toward the camera along a city street after rain, her body facing the frame directly, one long leg stepping out, with the boot heel landing on the wet ground. Her left hand is naturally raised, adjusting the black leather glove on her right hand, while her gaze remains fixed on the lens. The long trench coat is blown open to both sides and behind her by the oncoming wind, forming a sharp black-purple hem silhouette. The posture is restrained, the pace is steady, and there is a strong sense of frontal pressure.

Lens: 35mm fashion documentary photography, camera position slightly lower than the waist, slight low-angle shot, the character is fully in the frame from head to toe, her body vertically penetrating both rows of letters. The face is fully presented within the wide strokes of the top row "RAI," the transition between chest and waist is natural, and the legs extend downward through "DEN," with the forward-stepping long leg becoming the visual center of the bottom row of letters.

Environment: A Tokyo-style urban street after rain, a late-night blue-purple atmosphere, a few purple neon lights and red signal lights in the distance, and the wet road reflecting long, thin purple light bands. The silhouettes of background buildings are simple, city details are slightly blurred, and all environmental elements maintain a low presence.

Lighting: Cold blue night ambient light outlines the character's silhouette, a soft purple side light sweeps across the hair and trench coat, and the face is illuminated by natural, even cold light. The satin of the trench coat produces long and restrained purple highlights, realistic photographic texture, low saturation, with deep black and dark purple dominating.

Layout: The area outside the letters is almost pure black and flat. Small monospaced text "CASE FILE / RAIDEN" in the top left corner, vertical "INAZUMA · ELECTRO ARCHON" on the right side, and coordinates, time "23:17," number "No.08," small thunder pattern icons, and extremely thin barcodes arranged at the bottom. All auxiliary text remains at a minimal size, forming a calm archive-style design language.

Overall texture: Realistic documentary fashion photography, fine grain, realistic skin texture, satin and leather materials, with slight printing grain on the edges of the letterforms. The core of the image is the giant "RAI / DEN," the continuous and complete photograph, Raiden Shogun walking toward the camera, the black-purple trench coat spread by the wind, the complete cold and elegant face, and the long legs. The first look is the name, and the second look reveals her standing inside the name.

prompts.text:
竖版 2:3 海报，typography-first 的高端时尚人物海报，黑底巨型字母嵌图设计。画面的绝对主体是名字“RAIDEN”，其次才是人物。上排“RAI”，下排“DEN”，采用极粗、窄长、厚重的无衬线字体，字母几乎撑满画面宽度，竖笔宽厚，字腔紧凑，字距极窄，字母之间仅保留利落的黑色细缝。两行字母排列紧密，形成一块强烈、沉稳的几何视觉主体，第一眼清晰读出“RAIDEN”。

最重要的结构要求：所有字母内部嵌入同一张完整、连续的真人时尚照片。一张照片被六个字母的形状精准裁切，人物、建筑、街道、灯光与透视在字缝两侧完全对齐。黑色细缝仅作为字体结构分割，字母内部的照片保持自然连续。字母拥有充分宽度，照片大面积可见，人物的脸完整落在上排较宽的字面区域内，五官清晰连贯。

照片主角是《原神》雷电将军的真人 Coser，一位24岁的成年东亚女性，日系冷艳的高级时尚模特。小巧的鹅蛋脸，狭长微挑的紫罗兰色眼眸，眉形平直利落，鼻梁挺直，右眼下方一颗细小泪痣，冷白肤色，嘴唇是低饱和玫瑰豆沙色。皮肤真实，细小毛孔与自然纹理清晰，五官略带真实的不对称。表情沉静、威严，目光直接迎向镜头。

身材高挑，肩颈修长，胸部自然饱满，腰线纤细，臀腿比例优越，双腿修长笔直。

深紫色长发编成一条粗而松散的麻花辫，垂在身后，额前保留角色标志性的整齐刘海，发侧佩戴紫色花形发饰，辫尾与碎发被夜风轻轻吹起。

服装是雷电将军原设的现代高定时装化版本：黑紫色修身长风衣，挺括肩线、收腰剪裁、深紫色缎面翻领，衣摆内衬带有低调的雷纹刺绣；内搭紫罗兰色方领修身上衣，腰间束着黑色宽腰带，深紫色高腰短裙，黑色半透明丝袜，黑色尖头细跟长靴。紫金色细节与雷电将军标志性的雷之三重巴纹呼应。整体保留角色原设的尊贵、冷艳与威严感。

动作：她正沿着雨后的城市街道迎面走向镜头，身体正对画面，一条长腿大步迈出，靴跟落在湿润地面。左手自然抬起，正在整理右手的黑色皮质手套，目光始终直视镜头。长风衣被迎面而来的风向两侧与身后掀开，形成锐利的黑紫色衣摆轮廓。姿势克制，步伐稳定，拥有强烈的正面压迫感。

镜头：35mm 时尚纪实摄影，机位略低于腰部，轻微仰拍，人物从头到脚完整入画，身体纵向贯穿上下两行字。面部完整呈现在上排“RAI”的宽大笔画内，胸腰衔接自然，双腿向下延伸穿过“DEN”，前迈的长腿成为下排字母的视觉中心。

环境：雨后的东京风格都市街头，深夜蓝紫色氛围，远处少量紫色霓虹灯与红色信号灯，潮湿路面反射细长的紫色光带。背景建筑轮廓简洁，城市细节被轻微虚化，所有环境元素保持低存在感。

光线：冷蓝色夜间环境光勾勒人物轮廓，一道柔和紫色侧光扫过发丝与风衣，脸部受到自然、均匀的冷光照亮。风衣缎面产生修长而克制的紫色高光，真实摄影质感，低饱和，深黑与暗紫占据主导。

版式：字母以外为近乎纯黑的平面。左上角小号等宽字“CASE FILE / RAIDEN”，右侧竖排“INAZUMA · ELECTRO ARCHON”，底部排列坐标、时间“23:17”、编号“No.08”、细小雷纹图标与极细条形码。所有辅助文字保持极小尺寸，形成冷静的档案式设计语言。

整体质感：真实纪实时尚摄影，细腻颗粒、真实肤质、缎面与皮革材质，字形边缘带轻微印刷颗粒感。画面核心是极巨大的“RAI / DEN”、连续完整的照片、迎面走来的雷电将军、被风展开的黑紫风衣、完整冷艳的面容和修长长腿。第一眼是名字，第二眼才发现她本人站在名字里。

prompts.text: Generate a standalone 3:4 vertical artwork, constructing [Landforms] and presenting [Structures] through the visual language of micro-crystal photography. Direct top-down view, no horizon; from a distance it looks like a complete landform, up close one can identify flaky crystal faces, fine dendrites, crystalline boundaries, and transparent films. The direction of crystal growth must participate in the landform modeling, rather than just applying colored textures to ordinary landscapes. Form a clear viewing path according to [Composition], with crystal details concentrated in about two-thirds of the frame, and the remaining area as continuous, quiet dark film negative space. Use [Color Palette], colors are rich but prioritized, with bright colors appearing along the edges of crystal faces and parts of the film, not unevenly covered in rainbows. Transmission light is primary, with weak diagonal illumination presenting the layers of crystal faces, retaining fine particles, natural cracks, and a few out-of-focus edges; the overall effect is like a precisely photographed microscopic entity, avoiding a plastic feel and over-sharpening. This is an artistic fictional landform, presenting no real maps, place names, scales, or experimental data. Text requirement: [Text Design]. Output only one final work, no original images, top-bottom comparisons, collages, microscope frames, instruments, people, buildings, or watermarks; no coarse gemstone clusters, jewelry cuts, neon light strips, or ordinary aerial landscapes. Example parameters: [Landform] Glacier Fjord [Structure] Pale cyan and ice blue branching crystal flakes like glacier tributaries, flowing from both sides into a deep indigo curved main fjord [Composition] The main fjord curves from the bottom left to the top right, crystal flakes are concentrated in the bottom right and top left, with a wide dark area left in the middle left [Color Palette] Ice cyan, ultramarine, indigo, a small amount of warm gold and violet [Text Design] No text throughout the image.

prompts.text:
生成一张独立3:4竖版艺术作品，以显微晶体摄影的视觉语言构造【地貌】，呈现【结构】。正俯视、无地平线；远看像完整地貌，近看能辨认薄片状晶面、细密枝晶、结晶边界与透明薄膜。晶体生长方向必须参与地貌造型，不能只给普通风景贴彩色纹理。按【构图】形成一条清楚的观看路径，晶体细节集中在约三分之二画面，剩余区域为连续、安静的深色薄膜留白。使用【配色】，色彩浓郁但有主次，亮色沿晶面边缘与薄膜局部出现，不均匀铺满彩虹。透射光为主，微弱斜向照明呈现晶面层次，保留细微颗粒、自然裂隙和少量失焦边缘，整体像被精密拍摄的微观实体，避免塑料感与过度锐化。这是艺术化虚构地貌，不呈现真实地图、地名、比例尺或实验数据。文字要求：【文字设计】。只输出一张最终作品，无原图、上下对照、拼贴、显微镜边框、仪器、人物、建筑、水印；不出现粗大宝石簇、珠宝切割、霓虹光带或普通航拍风景。
示例参数
【地貌】冰川峡湾
【结构】淡青与冰蓝的分枝晶片像冰川支流，从两侧汇入一条深靛蓝弯曲主峡湾
【构图】主峡湾从左下弯向右上，晶片集中在右下和左上，左侧中部留有宽阔暗面
【配色】冰青、群青、靛蓝、少量暖金与紫罗兰
【文字设计】全图无文字

prompts.text: Theme: Dream of the Red Chamber theme Oriental Zen minimalist cover poster. Style branch: Elegant feminine aesthetic. Main content: Xue Baochai standing in front of a simple and elegant courtyard, holding a white flower, with a calm and dignified expression. Mood motifs: Elegant, restrained, steady, gentle. Scene and imagery: Hengwu Court, white flowers, light-colored pillars, simple courtyard, woman. Composition and space: 9:16 vertical composition, character located in the middle-lower part, pillars and negative space forming a stable structure, top part reserved as a complete title area. Color control: Pearl white as a high-brightness base, light rice gold for a small amount of clothing edges, faint green for very few plants, white flowers as the main visual point, character's clothing in light apricot-white or pale gold-white; avoid yellowish overall. Light and texture: Bright natural light, clear image, flat and clean, light New Chinese style cover feel. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Supplementary requirements: The overall look should have Baochai's 'dignified and gentle' vibe, high-end but not dull, do not pile up gold ornaments and complex backgrounds, with suitable text in the white space of the image.

items.title: 日本地铁金发女孩写实人像摄影

prompts.text: Aspect ratio 9:16, photorealistic, lifestyle smartphone photography. A 22-year-old beautiful Japanese girl, long blonde hair down to the waist, slender and tall build, hourglass figure, plump breasts with natural uplift, tiny waist, flat stomach, rounded hips, long slender thighs. She is standing in a crowded Japanese subway car, holding an overhead strap with one hand, and the other hand hanging down naturally. She is wearing a white camisole crop top, made of ultra-light cotton knit fabric, soft, finely woven, naturally draping, with slight elasticity; there is only one small button in the center of the chest connecting the two panels; below, the two panels are completely separated and slightly turned up to the sides, revealing the abdomen. Low-rise light blue jeans, stretch fabric, tight-fitting style hugging the hips and thighs, with part of white underwear straps visible above the waistband. Standing with legs slightly apart, the outlines of two slender thighs are well-defined. Front shooting perspective, the frame is from the head to the mid-thigh, the character occupies most of the screen, eyes naturally looking at the passengers next to her. The passengers are crowded, gray hanging rings and metal handrails, subway lighting is realistic and natural, body proportions are coordinated, details are clear and sharp.

prompts.text:
纵横比 9:16，照片级真实，生活化的智能手机摄影。一位 22 岁的美丽日本女孩，金色长发及腰，纤细高挑的身材，沙漏型身形，丰满的胸部带有自然上翘，小蛮腰，平坦小腹，圆润臀部，修长大腿。她站在拥挤的日本地铁车厢里，一手握住上方吊环，另一手自然垂下。

她穿着白色吊带露脐上衣，由超轻棉质针织面料制成，柔软、编织细腻，自然垂坠，轻微弹性；胸前中央仅有一颗小纽扣连接两片衣襟；下方，两片衣襟完全分开并向两侧微微上翘，露出腹部。低腰浅蓝色牛仔裤，弹性面料，紧身款式贴合臀部和大腿，腰带上方露出一部分白色内裤肩带。双腿略微分开站立，两条纤细大腿轮廓分明。正面拍摄视角，画面从头部至大腿中部，人物占据画面大部分，目光自然看向旁边的乘客。乘客拥挤不堪，灰色吊环和金属扶手，地铁灯光真实自然，身体比例协调，细节清晰锐利。

items.title: 2x2网格黄色吊带背心人像拼贴画

prompts.text:
Create a surreal photo collage containing 4 portraits of the same person in a 2x2 grid layout with an overall aspect ratio of 3:4. Use only the client's reference photos to preserve identity traits, maintaining precise facial features, face shape, eye color, skin tone, as well as natural hair color, length, volume, and texture.

Clothing and Background: A vibrant yellow spaghetti strap camisole, minimalist jewelry, and a solid black background without any decorative elements. Instagram photo dump style, youthful, playful, natural, fashionable, and effortlessly chic.

Camera and Lighting: Captured in the style of a Canon PowerShot G7 X Mark III, using strong direct flash, high contrast, sharp hard-edged shadows, sharp focus, realistic skin texture and visible pores, subtle film grain, and vivid yet natural colors.

Four Unique Expressions and Poses:
1. A gentle smile, with one hand resting lightly on the cheek.
2. A playful wink and a bright smile, with one hand stroking the hair.
3. Eyes closed, tongue slightly sticking out, with both hands playfully lifting the hair.
4. A dreamy and charming gaze, with one hand gently touching the hair.

Composition and Consistency: Each frame must show a unique facial expression, head angle, hand position, and hairstyle arrangement, while preserving the exact same identity, facial structure, and yellow clothing. Maintain consistent lighting, color grading, and photography style across all images. Ensure balanced spacing, neat grid alignment, and clearly separated frames.

Image Quality: Photorealistic, 8K level detail, razor-sharp facial features, realistic skin texture, natural imperfections, lifelike hair strands, vivid expressions, and authentic portable digital camera aesthetics. The final result must look like a real photo taken with a digital compact camera, not an AI-generated image.

Negative Prompt: AI-generated look, plastic skin, excessive skin smoothing, altered identity, inconsistent facial features, deformed hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, unnatural anatomy, repetitive facial features, blurred face, over-sharpening, artificial hair, inconsistent clothing, text, watermark, excessively thick grid borders.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
创建一张超现实的照片拼贴画，包含同一个人 4 张肖像，采用 2×2 网格布局，整体宽高比为 3:4。仅使用客户的参考照片来保留身份特征，保持精确的面部特征、脸型、眼睛颜色、肤色以及自然的头发颜色、长度、蓬松度和质感。

服装与背景：一件鲜艳的黄色细肩带吊带背心，极简珠宝，以及纯黑色纯色背景，没有任何装饰元素。Instagram 照片倾倒风格，青春洋溢、俏皮、自然、时尚且毫不费力地时髦。

相机与灯光：采用 Canon PowerShot G7 X Mark III 风格拍摄，使用强烈的直射闪光灯，高对比度、清晰的硬边阴影、锐利对焦、逼真的皮肤纹理和可见毛孔、细微的胶片颗粒，以及生动却自然的色彩。

四个独特表情与姿势：
1. 温柔微笑，一只手轻轻靠在脸颊上。
2. 俏皮眨眼和灿烂微笑，一只手轻抚头发。

items.title: 高端社论艺术海报纸雕拼贴风格

prompts.text:
Create a collection of individual, high-end editorial art posters, producing one separate design for every uploaded photograph. Treat each image as its own creative project, with no image merging, repeated layouts, or borrowed design elements between posters.

CANVAS & STRUCTURE: Use a strict 3:4 vertical format with a precise 50/50 horizontal division. The upper section must retain the original photograph, including the subject’s face, identity, pose, clothing, defining details, original color relationships, and natural lighting. Apply only restrained tonal refinement for a polished magazine finish. Do not reconstruct, reshape, or replace the photographed subject.

PHOTOGRAPHIC UPPER PANEL: Preserve the authentic image as the visual anchor. Simplify distracting surroundings only where necessary, without altering the subject or compromising the photograph’s original character.

LOWER PANEL — PAPER SCULPTURE: Reinterpret the subject’s defining features, silhouette, or visual story as a contemporary handcrafted paper composition. Build the artwork from bold cutouts, abstract contours, overlapping cardstock, and carefully arranged geometric fragments. Reduce unnecessary details while retaining recognizable visual connections to the original photograph. The result should feel like an art director’s handcrafted mixed-media experiment, not a cartoon illustration.

LAYOUT & SPATIAL DESIGN: Create a striking contrast between a spacious, pale upper field and a confidently colored lower section extending edge to edge. Let the subject interact visually with the dividing line, creating a seamless relationship between photography and collage. Introduce an off-center shape, architectural color panel, or restrained graphic accent only when it strengthens the composition. Keep the arrangement intentional, airy, and visually distinctive.

PALETTE & MATERIALS: Derive a small selection of complementary colors from the source image, then translate them into luminous, understated pastel tones. Combine matte paper surfaces, fine fibrous grain, slightly irregular cut edges, and delicate overlapping layers. Establish dimension through the arrangement of paper elements rather than pronounced shadows, gradients, or artificial depth.

EDITORIAL FINISH: Use typography sparingly. If suitable, include a small art-publication title, discreet caption, or minimal typographic detail, positioned with precision. Avoid unnecessary text, decorative labels, and oversized lettering.

ARTISTIC DIRECTION: Contemporary gallery poster meets independent art-journal design. Balance photographic authenticity with tactile paper craftsmanship, bold color blocking, thoughtful asymmetry, and generous breathing room. Every poster should have its own visual character, derived directly from its source photograph.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS: No combined photographs, duplicated designs, distorted anatomy, altered facial identity, full-scene illustration, cartoon rendering, glossy 3D elements, excessive drop shadows, gradients, busy backgrounds, or mass-produced template aesthetics.

FINAL OBJECTIVE: Produce a refined, collectible-quality editorial poster that feels individually art-directed. The original photograph remains authentic in the upper half, while the lower half translates its visual identity into a fresh, tactile, minimalist paper-art interpretation.

prompts.text:
创建一系列独立的高端社论艺术海报，为每张上传的照片生成一个单独的设计。将每张图像视为一个独立的创意项目，海报之间不进行图像合并，不重复布局，也不借用设计元素。

画布与结构：使用严格的 3:4 垂直比例，并具有精确的 50/50 水平分割。上部必须保留原始照片，包括主体的面部、身份、姿势、服装、定义细节、原始色彩关系和自然光线。仅应用克制的色调优化，以获得精致的杂志饰面。请勿重建、重塑或更换被拍摄的主体。

摄影上部面板：保留真实图像作为视觉锚点。仅在必要时简化分散注意力的环境，而不改变主体或损害照片的原始特征。

下部面板 — 纸雕：将主体的定义特征、轮廓或视觉故事重新诠释为当代的纯手工纸质作品。用大胆的剪纸、抽象轮廓、重叠的卡纸和精心安排的几何碎片来构建艺术品。减少不必要的细节，同时保留与原始照片的可辨认视觉联系。结果应该感觉像艺术总监的手工混合媒体实验，而不是卡通插图。

布局与空间设计：在宽敞、浅色的上部区域和充满自信的彩色下部区域（延伸至边缘）之间创造鲜明的对比。让主体与分割线进行视觉互动，在摄影和拼贴之间创造出无缝的关系。仅在能强化构图时引入偏离中心的形状、建筑色彩面板或克制的图形装饰。保持排列具有意图感、透气感和独特的视觉效果。

调色板与材质：从原始图像中提取少量互补色，然后将其转化为明亮、低调的柔和色调。结合哑光纸面、细腻的纤维纹理、略微不规则的裁剪边缘和精致的重叠层。通过纸张元素的排列而不是明显的阴影、渐变或人造深度来建立空间感。

社论饰面：少量使用排版。如果合适，请包含一个小的艺术刊物标题、低调的说明文字或极简的排版细节，并精确放置。避免不必要的文字、装饰性标签和大号字体。

艺术指导：当代画廊海报遇见独立艺术期刊设计。平衡摄影的真实性与触手可及的纸艺感、大胆的色块、深思熟虑的不对称和充足的留白。每张海报都应该有自己的视觉特征，直接源自其原始照片。

严格排除：严禁合并照片、重复设计、扭曲解剖结构、改变面部身份、全场景插图、卡通渲染、光泽 3D 元素、过度的投影、渐变、杂乱的背景或大批量生产的模板美学。

最终目标：制作出一张精致、具有收藏品质的社论海报，让人感觉是经过单独艺术指导的。原始照片在前半部分保持真实，而后半部分则将其视觉身份转化为全新的、触手可及的、极简主义的纸艺诠释。

items.title: 故事书风格复古旅游海报插画

prompts.text:
Create a charming 3:4 vertical vintage travel poster of [COUNTRY / CITY / DESTINATION], illustrated in a colorful, storybook-inspired style.

SCENE:
Show one iconic location with instantly recognizable landmarks, distinctive architecture, beautiful scenery, and authentic local details. Arrange the scene with an elevated viewpoint, layered depth, winding canals or streets, and a few lively elements that capture the destination’s character. Adapt the composition naturally to the location.

ART STYLE:
Clean hand-painted illustration with elegant outlines, simplified architectural details, rich colors, and a polished vintage travel-poster aesthetic. Make the scene whimsical, inviting, and richly detailed without looking photorealistic.

COLORS & LIGHT:
Use a harmonious palette of turquoise, sky blue, warm cream, coral, terracotta, golden yellow, and leafy green, adapted to the destination. Add soft clouds, warm sunlight, and a beautiful atmosphere.

POSTER DESIGN:
Frame the illustration with a subtle cream border. At the bottom, feature the destination’s name in large, elegant brush lettering, followed by the country in small uppercase letters and a short poetic travel-inspired tagline.

Keep the landmark as the focal point, with balanced composition, crisp details, and a collectible vintage postcard finish. Ensure all lettering is correctly spelled and readable.

Avoid photorealism, clutter, excessive decoration, distorted landmarks, illegible text, watermarks, and logos.

FORMAT: 3:4 vertical, full poster composition.

prompts.text:
创建一个迷人的 3:4 垂直比例的 [国家 / 城市 / 目的地] 复古旅游海报，以色彩丰富、受故事书启发的风格进行插画。

场景：
展示一个具有极高辨识度地标、独特建筑、优美风景和地道当地细节的标志性位置。通过高视角、分层深度、蜿蜒的运河或街道，以及一些捕捉目的地特色的生动元素来安排场景。根据位置自然地调整构图。

艺术风格：
简洁的手绘插图，具有优雅的轮廓、简化的建筑细节、丰富的色彩和精致的复古旅游海报美感。让场景充满奇思妙想、诱人且细节丰富，而不显得写实。

颜色与光影：
使用由青绿色、天蓝色、暖奶油色、珊瑚色、赤陶色、金黄色和叶绿色组成的和谐色调，并根据目的地进行调整。加入柔软的云朵、温暖的阳光和优美的氛围。

海报设计：
用微妙的奶油色边框勾勒插图。在底部，以大型优雅的画笔字体显示目的地名称，随后是用大写字母书写的国家名称和一段简短的诗意旅行标语。

保持地标作为焦点，构图平衡，细节清晰，并具有收藏级复古明信片的质感。确保所有字母拼写正确且清晰易读。

避免写实主义、杂乱、过度装饰、扭曲的地标、字迹模糊的文本、水印和徽标。

格式：3:4 垂直，完整海报构图。

items.title: 深夜露台静思东亚女性写实摄影

prompts.text:
An adult East Asian woman in her mid-twenties sits on an open apartment terrace in the quiet stillness of late night. She exhibits naturally feminine proportions, a soft jawline, and subtle, natural cheekbone definition. Her dark brown hair is loosely tied back into a low, unstudied messy bun resting at the nape of her neck, allowing long, wispy side-strands to escape casually and trace along her cheeks, jawline, and collarbones. Her complexion is unpolished and authentic, displaying fine natural skin pores, delicate tone variations, and realistic shadows around her collarbones, completely free from digital smoothing or artificial cosmetic enhancements.

She is styled in a fine white cotton long-sleeved shirt featuring subtle eyelet embroidery along its collar and front plackets. The shirt is worn completely open, slumping generously off both shoulders to pool softly around her elbows, exposing her shoulders and upper torso. Beneath the open shirt, she wears a light-colored semi-sheer lace bralette displaying detailed botanical lace motifs and a plunging neckline. On her lower body, she pairs this with low-rise, dark charcoal denim micro-shorts with frayed hems, studded with silver eyelets and rivets along the waistband that catch subtle metallic glints.

Her body posture is relaxed and grounded in a quiet moment of late-night reflection. Seated comfortably on a low teak lounge chair, her body is turned at an asymmetrical three-quarter angle. Her knees are drawn up slightly toward her chest, creating a natural triangular geometry with her torso. One wrist rests casually over her raised knee while her other hand leans lightly against the weathered wooden armrest. She tilts her head back gently, her gaze drifting upward toward the open night sky with a serene, introspective expression, catching the overhead warmth across her forehead and eyelids.

The scene takes place on a private urban terrace deck enveloped in late-night shadow. Dark weathered wood floor planks run diagonally across the floor, leading toward a chest-high concrete perimeter wall that marks the boundary of the outdoor space. Surrounding the deck are dark architectural framing elements, deep alcoves, and subtle potted leafy greenery that blend into soft shadows. Beyond the terrace edge, distant city skyscrapers rise into the misty atmospheric night, forming a soft geometric backdrop populated by dimly glowing square windows and distant urban haze.

The shot is composed as an asymmetrical, slightly low-angle medium-full environmental portrait using an 85mm prime lens at f/2.0. The camera is positioned slightly below eye level, looking subtly upward across the edge of the teak armrest, which enters the immediate foreground to establish layered spatial depth. The subject is offset slightly to the left of the frame, utilizing natural negative space on the right where the dark deck planks recede toward the city skyline. The focus plane is razor-sharp on the botanical lace weave of her bralette and the fine details of her eyes and cheekbones, while the foreground teak texture and background skyscrapers gradually dissolve into an optically soft, coherent falloff.

Illumination is driven by an overhead wall-mounted practical light fixture fitted with a warm Edison bulb, casting a direct top-down beam that accentuates her hair, forehead, shoulders, and the draped white shirt fabric. Deep, soft directional shadows cast downward beneath her chin, collarbones, and knees. Cool, diffuse ambient moonlight provides a gentle fill along her lower legs, the frayed edges of her charcoal denim micro-shorts, and the damp sheen of the teak wood deck, establishing a natural color temperature contrast between warm light from above and cool ambient darkness surrounding the scene.

Surface textures feel tactile, distinct, and physically authentic across every element of the frame. The heavy twill of the dark charcoal denim exhibits visible thread weave and frayed edge fibers, punctuated by the cold metallic sheen of silver rivets. The fine white cotton shirt displays soft organic creases and delicate cut-out eyelet details, contrasting with the detailed semi-sheer botanical lace of the bralette. Skin highlights reflect natural sebum levels along her nose and shoulders without artificial glare, while the weathered wood of the terrace deck shows subtle grain patterns, matte finishes, and realistic wear.

The visual color palette relies on a balanced contrast between the amber-golden tones of the top-down Edison fixture and the deep indigo-charcoal hues of the night sky and terrace background. Tonal transitions remain gradual and restrained, avoiding harsh digital contrast or saturated color casts. Shadows preserve dark midtone detail without being crushed to absolute black, while bright highlights on the white cotton shirt roll off smoothly. The overall visual mood is quiet, cinematic, and photographic, capturing an authentic late-night moment with natural tonal richness.

Aspect ratio: 3:4
Negative: unwanted decorative text, watermarks, malformed anatomy, extra limbs, visual artifacts, any plastic skin, beauty filters, or artificial smoothing.

她拥有完美的头身比、自然丰满的胸部、完美且曼妙的S型女性身材、沙漏型身材、比例完美的修长美腿以及纤细的腰肢，完美的足部，完美的足部线条。

## [场景 / 背景]

现代高档室内入口，配有高大的暖色木板墙和一扇半开的木门。门口露出昏暗的内部走廊，配有灰色墙板、深色瓷砖地板和一盆长着绿色长叶的装饰盆栽。左侧墙上可见一个小型的壁挂式控制面板，而金属门配件、铰链和深色把手增加了真实的建筑细节。前景是带有细微大理石纹理和反光饰面的抛光石材地板。

## [光影 / 氛围]

正面的相机闪光灯照亮了这位女性，强调了她衬衫上的精细细条纹、超薄连裤袜的亮泽质感，以及珠宝和高跟鞋的反光表面。周围的木板和内部走廊保持相对昏暗，营造出强烈的前景与背景对比。自然的室内阴影、真实的肤色、细微的地板反射和一种自然的夜间氛围。

## [构图 / 视角]

从头到脚的全景构图。正面拍摄，视平线至略低的相机角度，女性位于门口中央位置。捕捉她迈步的瞬间，一条腿微微交叉在另一条腿前，一只手扶着门，另一只手拿着捆好的带子。保留完整的轮廓，包括双脚的高跟鞋、半透明袜裤、修身短裤和层叠的配饰。开着的门框住了主体，而垂直的木板营造出强烈的引导线。保持真实的比例、自然的肢体位置和主体周围充足的环境背景。

## [风格参考]

具有随性街拍风格的高分辨率写实时尚社论摄影。真实的织物纹理、准确的服装结构、自然的解剖结构、细致的配饰、真实的室内材料和栩栩如生的反射。洗练的单色风格，搭配温暖的木质色调和简约的工业现代建筑。避免插画、CGI外观、过度磨皮、人造身材比例、夸张的曲线和过饱和的色彩，不裁剪肢体或截断双脚。

## [质量参数]

超细节、高分辨率摄影、锐利的主体对焦、真实的皮肤纹理、细腻呈现的细条纹、带有细微高光的半透明超薄袜裤、亮泽的黑色皮革高跟鞋、准确的金属反射、自然的深度和透视感、平衡的曝光、真实的闪光灯摄影、详尽的木纹、抛光大理石反射、洁净的解剖结构、全身可见、纵向构图、专业时尚摄影、写实渲染。

items.title: 当代地标建筑艺术社论海报

prompts.text:
Create a premium contemporary editorial poster for [LANDMARK NAME], [CITY], [COUNTRY], using the uploaded photograph of the landmark as the primary visual reference.
FORMAT AND COMPOSITION
Vertical 3:4 portrait poster, divided into two perfectly equal horizontal sections. The upper half occupies exactly 50% of the total height, and the lower half occupies the remaining 50%. Both sections must have equal heights, with a precise horizontal division at the center.
UPPER HALF — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH
Preserve the original landmark photograph as faithfully as possible. Maintain the landmark’s authentic architectural identity, silhouette, proportions, distinctive structures, windows, arches, columns, rooflines, materials, and characteristic colors. Retain the original lighting, natural shadows, surface textures, perspective, and surrounding environment.
Apply subtle art-magazine color grading with refined tonal contrast, sophisticated color balance, and a contemporary fine-art photography aesthetic. If necessary, extend the background naturally to achieve the portrait composition without stretching, distorting, replacing, or altering the landmark. The photograph should feel authentic, timeless, and editorial rather than artificially enhanced.
LOWER HALF — GEOMETRIC ARCHITECTURAL ABSTRACTION
Reinterpret the same landmark as a sophisticated modular geometric illustration. Translate its most recognizable architectural features into bold, simplified geometric structures while maintaining an unmistakable visual connection to the photograph above.
Construct the illustration using large rectangles, squares, rounded squares, circles, triangles, arches, and carefully composed irregular geometric forms. Recreate the landmark’s distinctive silhouette, structural rhythm, architectural proportions, and recognizable details through overlapping blocks, layered planes, simplified facades, and carefully balanced shapes.
Avoid excessive fragmentation, tiny geometric pieces, photorealistic rendering, and generic architectural symbols. Favor fewer, larger, cohesive forms with deliberate spacing and strong compositional structure. Preserve the landmark’s unique identity rather than turning it into an interchangeable building.
COLOR AND MATERIAL LANGUAGE
Develop the illustration’s palette from the original photograph and the visual character of [COUNTRY]. Use a restrained, harmonious combination of architectural neutrals, muted heritage tones, earthy pigments, and carefully selected accent colors.
Introduce subtle paper grain, matte printed surfaces, delicate screen-print textures, and refined color overlays. Maintain a sophisticated balance between flat geometric shapes and tactile printed materials.
EDITORIAL ART DIRECTION
Create the visual quality of a collectible architecture-art exhibition poster designed for a prestigious independent art magazine. Emphasize architectural rhythm, negative space, geometric balance, precise alignment, and visual continuity between the photographic and illustrated halves.
The upper photograph and lower illustration must depict the same landmark from a consistent visual perspective wherever possible. Align major contours, dominant verticals, recognizable towers, rooflines, or other signature features across the central division to strengthen the relationship between the two halves.
The result should feel artistic, architectural, culturally distinctive, contemporary, and suitable for a high-quality art print.
STRICT RESTRICTIONS
No text, typography, letters, words, numbers, captions, slogans, logos, watermarks, signatures, labels, borders, or graphic lettering anywhere in the image. Do not add flags, decorative national symbols, or unrelated landmarks unless they are present in the original photograph. Do not modify the landmark’s authentic identity. Do not merge multiple photographs. Produce one complete, independent poster from the supplied photograph.

prompts.text:
为 [地标名称]、[城市]、[国家] 创作一张高级当代社论海报，使用上传的地标照片作为主要视觉参考。
格式与构图
3:4 纵向肖像海报，分为两个完全相等的水平部分。上半部分占据总高度的 50%，下半部分占据剩余的 50%。两个部分的高度必须相等，中心有精确的水平分割。
上半部分 — 原始照片
尽可能忠实地保留原始地标照片。保持地标真实的建筑身份、轮廓、比例、独特结构、窗户、拱门、柱子、屋顶线、材料和特征颜色。保留原始光影、自然阴影、表面纹理、透视和周围环境。
应用微妙的艺术杂志色调评级，具有精致的色调对比、复杂的色彩平衡和当代美术摄影美学。如有必要，自然延伸背景以实现肖像构图，而无需拉伸、扭曲、替换或改变地标。照片应该感觉真实、永恒且具有社论感，而不是人工增强。
下半部分 — 几何建筑抽象
将同一地标重新诠释为复杂的模块化几何插图。将其最知名的建筑特征转化为大胆、简化的几何结构，同时与上方的照片保持明确的视觉联系。
使用大矩形、正方形、圆角正方形、圆形、三角形、拱门和精心组合的不规则几何形状来构建插图。通过重叠的方块、分层平面、简化的立面和精心平衡的形状，重建地标独特的轮廓、结构节奏、建筑比例和可识别的细节。
避免过度碎片化、微小的几何碎片、光致写实渲染和通用的建筑符号。倾向于更少、更大、有凝聚力的形式，具有深思熟虑的间距和强大的构图结构。保留地标的独特身份，而不是将其变成一个可互换的建筑。
颜色与材料语言
根据原始照片和 [国家] 的视觉特征开发插图的调色板。使用建筑中性色、柔和的遗产色调、大地颜料和精心挑选的点缀色的克制而和谐的组合。
引入微妙的纸张纹理、哑光印刷表面、精致的丝网印刷纹理和精致的色彩叠加。在扁平几何形状和触感印刷材料之间保持复杂的平衡。
社论艺术指导
打造为著名独立艺术杂志设计的收藏级建筑艺术展览海报的视觉品质。强调建筑节奏、负空间、几何平衡、精确对齐以及摄影与插图两部分之间的视觉连续性。
上半部分的摄影和下半部分的插图必须尽可能从一致的视觉透视描绘同一地标。沿中心分割线对齐主要轮廓、主导垂直线、可识别的塔楼、屋顶线或其他标志性特征，以加强两部分之间的关系。
结果应具有艺术感、建筑感、文化特色、现代感，并适合高质量的艺术印刷。
严格限制
图像中的任何地方都不得出现文字、排版、字母、单词、数字、标题、口号、徽标、水印、签名、标签、边框或图形字体。除非原始照片中存在，否则不要添加国旗、装饰性国家符号或无关的地标。不要修改地标的真实身份。不要合并多张照片。根据提供的照片制作一张完整的、独立的海报。

items.title: 垂直平分摄影与极简纸艺拼贴

prompts.text:
Vertical 3:4 canvas split into two strictly equal horizontal halves: top 50% and bottom 50%. The upper half stays photographic; the lower half becomes the continued Second World. Together they must read as one scene.

the

UPPER HALF

Keep the photo faithful. Preserve the subject, pose, spatial relationships, color atmosphere, and natural light. Do not redesign, repaint, replace, or restage it. Only necessary proportional

cropping is allowed.

CONTINUITY (highest priority)

Identify one source structure that naturally reaches the center split: a road, shoreline, water, reflection, branch, beam of light, piece of architecture, or body movement. This structure must cross the boundary and continue into the lower half. The Second World begins from the photograph itself, so the same scene passes through the seam and simply changes its physical rules.

TRANSITION EDGE

The center may use an irregular torn-paper edge, but the tear must follow the source structure, never act as decoration. Source elements may touch, follow, break through, or extend beyond edge. Never force the same tear shape onto every image.

The Second World

LOWER HALF

Ivory paper with subtle fibers and abundant negative space. Continue the chosen structure downward from the exact point where it meets the split, then reinterpret it with restrained photo fragments, cut-paper forms, and minimal black hand-drawn lines. The lower world must stay visibly attached Never isolate it as a separate portal, window, stage, platform, or floating vignette unless it clearly comes from the photo.

SECOND WORLD LOGIC

Ask: if this structure became touchable, usable, enterable, or changeable, what would it naturally become? Create one image-specific interaction. For example, water may stay attached while being pulled, a road may continue as a drawn path, or light may become something held. Do not repeat actions mechanically.

FIGURES

Add 0-3 tiny black line figures only when useful. They must physically interact with the continued structure. If the photo already contains strong human action, add none. Never use figures as decoration.

World

CAPTION

One

short handwritten English caption (2-6 words) based on the action. Natural, light, slightly witty. Spell it correctly. No inspirational quotes and no fixed "Same..., different..." phrasing.

STYLE

Real photography above, warm paper below, minimal black line doodles, subtle handmade collage texture, independent-magazine mood. Bright, airy, restrained. It should feel as if the Second already hidden inside the photo and simply continued downward.

was

NEGATIVE

No detached lower-half illustration, no generic torn-paper template, no isolated portal, no unrelated vignette, no broken continuity, no dense illustration, no random decoration, no crowd, altered photo colors, no redesign of the upper image, no glossy 3D, no scrapbook clutter, no gibberish text, no watermark, no logo, no UI.

prompts.text:
垂直3:4画布被严格平分为上下两个水平部分：顶部50%和底部50%。上半部分保持摄影风格；下半部分成为延续的第二世界。它们必须共同构成一个场景。

上半部分
保持照片的忠实度。保留主体、姿势、空间关系、色彩氛围和自然光线。不要重新设计、重绘、替换或重新布置。仅允许必要的比例裁剪。

连续性（最高优先级）
识别一个自然延伸至中心分割线的源结构：道路、海岸线、水面、倒影、树枝、光束、建筑构件或肢体动作。该结构必须跨越边界并延伸到下半部分。第二世界始于照片本身，因此同一场景穿过接缝并简单地改变其物理规则。

过渡边缘
中心可以使用不规则的撕纸边缘，但撕裂必须遵循源结构，绝不能作为装饰。源元素可以接触、遵循、突破或延伸至边缘之外。绝不要在每张图像上强加相同的撕裂形状。

第二世界
下半部分
带有细微纤维和大量留白的象牙色纸张。从与分割线相遇的精确点开始向下延续所选结构，然后用克制的照片碎片、剪纸形状和极简的黑色手绘线条对其进行重新诠释。下层世界必须保持可见的连接，绝不能将其孤立为一个单独的门户、窗口、舞台、平台或漂浮的插图，除非它明显源自照片。

第二世界逻辑
思考：如果这个结构变得可触碰、可用、可进入或可改变，它会自然变成什么？创建一个特定于图像的互动。例如，水在被拉动时可能保持连接，道路可能延续为一条绘制的小径，或者光可能变成某种被握住的东西。不要机械地重复动作。

人物
仅在有用时添加0-3个微小的黑色线条人物。他们必须与延续的结构产生物理互动。如果照片中已经包含强烈的人类动作，则不添加。绝不要将人物用作装饰。

标题
一个根据动作而定的简短手写英文标题（2-6个单词）。自然、轻盈、略带幽默。拼写正确。不要使用励志名言，也不要使用固定的“Same..., different...”句式。

风格
上方是真实摄影，下方是温暖的纸张，极简的黑色线条涂鸦，细微的手工拼贴纹理，独立杂志氛围。明亮、通透、克制。它应该让人感觉第二世界早已隐藏在照片中，只是向下延续。

负面提示
无脱离的下半部分插图，无通用的撕纸模板，无孤立的门户，无无关的插图，无断裂的连续性，无密集的插图，无随机的装饰，无人群，无改变的照片颜色，无重新设计上半部分图像，无光滑的3D，无剪贴簿堆砌，无乱码文字，无水印，无标志，无UI。

items.title: 旅游记忆立体书海报摄影提示词

prompts.text:
Create a 3:4 vertical travel-memory poster using [LOCATION / DESTINATION / SUBJECT] as the only scene reference.

COMPOSITION:
Divide the image into two equal horizontal halves.

TOP HALF — REAL PHOTOGRAPH:
Preserve the original photograph as faithfully as possible, retaining recognizable architecture, natural proportions, perspective, lighting, shadows, and environmental details. Allow only subtle color correction and necessary cropping. Do not redesign or invent elements.

BOTTOM HALF — POP-UP PAPER WORLD:
Show a real open travel journal against a warm ivory background, with visible page thickness, a defined spine, gently curled corners, and tactile paper texture. Reconstruct the photograph’s most distinctive landmarks and environmental features as a miniature three-dimensional paper-cut scene rising from the pages. Use delicate architectural linework, restrained pastel coloring, layered cutouts, folded paper, realistic occlusion, and natural contact shadows.

TRANSITION:
Connect both halves organically using elements from the actual location, such as a river flowing into the book, a street continuing across the spine, or trees transforming into layered paper shapes. Make the transition feel spatially continuous rather than like a collage.

STYLE:
A sophisticated blend of authentic photography, handcrafted paper engineering, and minimalist travel-journal artistry. Preserve the destination’s identity and create the feeling of collecting a real place inside a book.

Avoid turning the photograph into an illustration, flattening the paper scene, distorting landmarks, adding unrelated objects, excessive decoration, titles, readable text, or watermarks.

FORMAT: 3:4 vertical, exact 50/50 horizontal split.

prompts.text:
创建一个 3:4 竖向旅游记忆海报，以 [地点 / 目的地 / 主体] 作为唯一的场景参考。

构图：
将图像水平平分为相等的上下两半。

上半部分 —— 真实照片：
尽可能忠实地保留原始照片，保留可辨识的建筑、自然比例、透视、光影以及环境细节。仅允许细微的色彩校正和必要的裁剪。请勿重新设计或虚构元素。

下半部分 —— 弹出式纸艺世界：
在温暖的象牙色背景下展示一本真实打开的旅行日记，具有可见的页面厚度、清晰的书脊、轻轻卷曲的页角和触手可及的纸张纹理。将照片中最独特的标志性建筑和环境特征重构为从页面中升起的微型三维剪纸场景。使用细腻的建筑线条、克制的柔和色彩、分层剪贴、折叠纸张、真实的遮挡和自然的接触阴影。

过渡：
使用实际地点的元素有机地连接两部分，例如流入书中的河流、跨越书脊延伸的街道或转化为分层纸张形状的树木。让过渡感觉空间连贯，而不是像拼贴画。

风格：
真实摄影、手工纸艺工程和极简旅行日记艺术的精致融合。保留目的地的身份，营造出将真实地点收藏在书中的感觉。

避免将照片变成插图、扁平化纸张场景、扭曲地标、添加无关物品、过度装饰、标题、可读文本或水印。

格式：3:4 竖向，精确的 50/50 水平分割。

The light of the woven roof and the elegant dress

Adult woman in her 20s. Upper body slightly tilted, chin slightly raised, close-up from chest to waist.

Taupe almond-shaped eyes, soft small chin, slender nose. Glossy peach lips slightly parted, showing a bit of upper teeth. Gaze as if looking down at the camera. Chest-length voluminous brown wavy hairstyle, thin bangs. Fine strands of hair spreading towards the left side of the frame, edges glowing with pale gold light in backlighting. Face and chest are bright cream peach, with a hint of faint red on the cheeks. Distinguished from the golden glow on the hair.

Clothing/Pose:
Deep V-neck and chest ruffles in an ecru tone, translucent long-sleeved dress. The waist is a corset with a slender frame and lace patterns. Floral and transparent waterdrop-shaped earrings, matching series pendant. Arms down, sleeves extending to the bottom of the frame. Hands placed outside the frame, head slightly tilted to the right side of the frame.

Background/Light:
The background is filled with a large woven roof, with blue sky visible through the circular opening directly above it. The distant view below is a blur of light blue and cottages. Strong white sunlight from behind outlines the edges of the hair and shoulders. The face retains soft bright light, without applying an orange filter across the entire face.

Composition/Camera:
From a position slightly lower than the face, a front-diagonal upward view of the chin and the circle of the roof behind. Aspect ratio 1089:1444. Includes the top of the head, cropped below to the corset at the waist. The circle of the roof expands behind the head, not including the person's hands or legs.

Texture/Style:
Photo style with halation. Retains the outlines of the lace and fine hair strands, distinguishing the smooth gradient of the elegant skin and the gold of the background.

20多岁的成年女性。上半身略微倾斜，下巴微微抬起，从胸部到腰部的近景。

灰褐色的杏仁形眼睛，柔和的小下巴，纤细的鼻子。光泽的桃色嘴唇微微张开，露出一点上排牙齿。视线像俯视相机一样。及胸的丰盈棕色波浪发型，薄薄的刘海。纤细的发丝向画面左侧散开，逆光下边缘泛着淡金色光芒。脸部和胸部呈明亮的奶油桃色，脸颊带一丝淡红。与头发上的金色光芒区分开来。

服装・姿势：
深V领和胸部褶边的生成色调，半透明长袖连衣裙。腰部是纤细骨架和蕾丝图案的紧身胸衣。花朵与透明水滴形耳环，同系列的吊坠。双臂向下，袖子延伸至画面下方。双手置于画面外，头部略微向画面右侧倾斜。

背景满布大型编织屋顶，其正上方圆形开口处可见蓝天。下方的远景是淡蓝色和小屋的虚化。后方强烈的白色日光勾勒出头发和肩膀的边缘。脸部保留柔和明亮的光线，不在整个脸上施加橙色滤镜。

带有光晕的照片风格。保留蕾丝和纤细发丝的轮廓，区分出淡雅肌肤的平滑渐变与背景的金色。

{
  "主体": {
    "描述": "一位年轻成年的可爱日本女性坐在一间温馨、以粉色调为主的卧室或游戏室的小圆白桌旁，手持一盘带有淡奶油色蛋糕的小份甜点，贴近脸部。她双肘支在桌上向前倾，双手托住甜点，同时一只眼睛睁开，另一只眼睛俏皮地闭着眨眼，直视摄像机。她的深色头发留着整齐的刘海，戴着两个黑色小猫耳饰品。她在紧身的灰色内层衬衫外穿着一件黑色无袖上衣。这张照片捕捉到了一个俏皮、亲密的日常生活瞬间，融合了可爱的另类造型、随意的甜点姿势以及充满生活气息的私人房间氛围。",

prompts.text:
Vertical 4:5, real street snapshot, CCD point-and-shoot camera body direct flash, late 2000s digital photo texture, slight noise, flash brightens the foreground, background quickly falls into darkness. 
In the frame is a real-life Coser of Hu Tao, clearly an adult, around 24 years old East Asian female, with an agile, playful, and slightly mischievous cute aesthetic: large and spirited eyes, plum-red pupils, lively and cunning gaze, delicate nose bridge, small lips, lip color is low-saturation black tea rose, real skin texture clearly visible, natural oil on the forehead, nose tip, and collarbone under the flash, no skin smoothing. She has mature and soft hourglass curves: rounded and full chest, naturally supporting a smooth highlight arc on the soft fabric, slender waistline, rounded hips, long and well-proportioned legs, the overall temperament is light and vivid, with a bit of a quirky girl-style light-mature feel. 
Deep brown long hair with a slight reddish warm tone, braided into a loose low braid, naturally hanging from the shoulder to the front of the chest, light hair strands, a few strands of stray hair lightly blown up by the dryer's hot air; the top of the head retains Hu Tao's iconic small black hat element, but modernized and simplified into a small black top-hat-style hair accessory, adorned with a red plum blossom, recognizable as Hu Tao at a glance. 
The outfit is a modernized private-wear version of Hu Tao: a deep brownish-red wine-toned silk satin slip short dress, slim-fit bias-cut, the neckline falls softly and naturally, revealing the collarbone and upper chest lines, the fabric fits naturally along the chest, waist, and hips, the hem stops at the mid-thigh; the satin emits a layer of deep reddish-brown flowing reflections under the flash. A black loose knit cardigan is loosely draped outside, sliding from one shoulder to the elbow, revealing the thin straps and shoulder line; on the legs are 15D semi-transparent smoky black stockings, the flash creates a continuous thin bright highlight on the calves and knees; on the feet are a pair of burgundy patent leather Mary Jane high heels. A red string is tied on the wrist, hanging a small plum-shaped charm. 
She sits sideways on the top of the uppermost drum dryer, her back lightly leaning against the tiled wall, one leg naturally hanging down into the foreground, the other leg slightly bent, toes lightly swinging; one hand supports her side, the other hand lightly supports the side of her face or hooks the edge of the hat accessory. She slightly turns her face to look towards the door, as if she suddenly discovered something fun while waiting for the clothes to dry, her expression is agile, playful, with a hint of holding back a laugh: there is light in her eyes, the corners of the mouth are slightly upturned, as if she is about to say a naughty joke in the next second, very consistent with Hu Tao's quirky, cute, and somewhat mischievous feeling. 
Lens: 24mm wide angle, camera position pressed to knee height, shooting upwards from the diagonal front, the hanging stocking-clad long leg occupies the foreground, slightly elongated by perspective; her side profile silhouette falls on the upper third of the frame, the character's posture is natural, with a hint of playful small movements. 
Lighting: Body direct flash is the main light, hard, frontally slightly low, skin and satin highlights are clear, leaving a circle of hard-edged shadows on the wall behind her; ambient light comes from the pale white fluorescent tubes on the ceiling, slightly greenish; the warm yellow inner lights shine through the round glass doors of the row of dryers below her, with rolling towels and clothes blurred into soft blocks of color. 
Environment: A 24-hour self-service laundromat on a street corner at 2 am, the white tile floor slightly reflecting, hand-written operating instructions and faded price lists posted on the wall, an automatic vending machine in the corner emitting blue light, a plastic laundry basket on the bench, and the empty night street and a street lamp outside the glass door. 
Texture: Straight out of a real digital camera, flash edges slightly overexposed, vignetting and grainy noise are obvious, overall cool-toned, with brown-red, green, and warm yellow colors contrasting each other. The wrinkles from sitting on the satin, the shoulder line where the cardigan slides off, the messiness of the stray hairs, and the playful small expressions are all preserved, like a photo a friend took casually in the middle of the night. 
Visual Focus: Deep brown long braid and plum blossom small hat accessory, burgundy-brown satin slip dress, playful side profile sitting on top of the dryer, the stockinged long leg in the foreground, expression with a bit of a cunning smile, the late-night laundromat under direct flash.

画面里是胡桃的真人 Coser，明确成年，24 岁左右的东亚女性，偏灵动、俏皮、带一点坏心眼可爱感的审美：眼睛大而灵，瞳孔偏梅红色，眼神活泼狡黠，鼻梁秀气，嘴唇小巧，唇色是低饱和红茶玫瑰色，真实皮肤纹理清晰可见，闪光下额头、鼻尖和锁骨带一点自然油光，不磨皮。她有成熟柔和的沙漏型曲线：胸部圆润饱满，把柔软布料自然撑起一道顺滑高光弧线，腰线纤细，胯部圆润，双腿修长匀称，整体气质轻盈、生动，带一点古灵精怪的少女式轻熟感。

服装是胡桃的现代私服化：一条深棕红色偏酒红调的真丝缎面吊带短裙，修身斜裁，领口柔和自然下垂，露出锁骨和上胸线条，布料顺着胸、腰、臀自然贴合，裙摆停在大腿中段；缎面在闪光下泛出一层深红棕色的流动反光。外面松松披着一件黑色宽松针织开衫，从一边肩膀滑落到手肘，露出细吊带和肩线；腿上是 15D 半透明烟灰黑丝袜，闪光在小腿与膝盖上打出一条连续细亮高光；脚上一双酒红色漆皮玛丽珍高跟鞋。手腕上系一根红绳，挂着一个小小的梅花形坠饰。
她侧身坐在最上层那台滚筒烘干机的顶上，背轻轻靠着瓷砖墙，一条腿自然垂下来落进前景，另一条腿微微屈起，脚尖轻轻晃着；一只手撑在身侧，另一只手轻轻托着脸侧或者勾着帽饰边缘。她微微侧过脸看向门口，像是在等衣服烘干时突然发现了什么好玩的事，表情灵动、俏皮、带一点忍笑感：眼神有光，嘴角微微翘起，像下一秒就要说点坏坏的玩笑，很贴合胡桃那种古灵精怪、可爱又有点 mischievous 的感觉。
镜头：24mm 广角，机位压到膝盖高度，从斜前方往上拍，垂下来的那条丝袜长腿占据前景，被透视轻微拉长；她的侧颜轮廓落在画面上三分之一处，人物姿态自然，有一点调皮的小动作。
光线：机身直闪是主光，硬、正面略偏下，皮肤和缎面高光清晰，身后墙上留下一圈硬边阴影；环境光来自天花板上惨白的荧光灯管，略偏绿；身下一排烘干机的圆形玻璃门里透出暖黄色内灯，滚动的毛巾和衣物糊成柔软色块。
环境：凌晨两点街角的 24 小时自助洗衣房，白色瓷砖地面微微反光，墙上贴着手写营业须知和褪色价目表，角落里一台自动售货机发着蓝光，长凳上放着塑料洗衣篮，玻璃门外是空荡荡的夜街和一盏路灯。
质感：真实数码相机直出，闪光边缘轻微过曝，暗角和颗粒噪点明显，整体偏冷，棕红、绿、暖黄三种颜色互相衬着。缎面坐出来的褶皱、开衫滑落的肩线、碎发的凌乱感、俏皮的小神情都保留着，像朋友深夜随手拍下的一张照片。
画面重点：深棕长辫与梅花小帽饰、酒红棕缎面吊带裙、坐在烘干机顶上的俏皮侧颜、前景的丝袜长腿、带一点狡黠笑意的表情、直闪下的深夜洗衣房。

items.title: 新中式古诗词细线设色艺术海报

prompts.text:
【Ancient Poetry】{Fill in the poem title, author, and original text}
【Poster Main Title】{Extract 2–4 representative Chinese characters}
【Core Imagery】{Such as flying cranes, weeping willows, sunset in the woods, sparse shadows of plum branches}
【Visual Movement】{Such as diagonal soaring, curved drooping, light and shadow interlacing, branch shadow crossing}
【Visual Scene】{Fill in or extracted by AI based on the poem}
【Main Color Palette】{Choose 2–3 harmonious traditional Oriental colors}
【Aspect Ratio】9:16

Create a new Chinese-style fine-line colored art poster with textbook-level illustration texture based on ancient poetry, transforming the natural scenery, dynamic relationships, and light and shadow artistic conception in the poem into a complete and beautiful Oriental visual work.

【Style and Texture】

Adopting a visual language that combines modern Oriental decorative illustration with traditional Gongbi line drawing. The tree canopy appears as soft, fluffy cloud-like solid color blocks, with fine powder-stippled textures on the edges, interspersed with slender, continuous, and naturally bifurcating ink-black branches.

Main subjects such as flying birds, weeping willows, and plum branches retain their realistic and reasonable forms, using complete flat coloring and a small number of fine long lines to express structure. If buildings appear, use neat blue-green tiles, elegant cornices, and simple walls. The overall colors are saturated and uniform, matte and clean, retaining a slight paper texture.

【Composition and Visual Movement】

Adopting a high-angle overlook, Oriental scattered perspective, and modern graphic composition, flexibly adjusting the perspective according to the poetic meaning.

Focus on extracting the direction, curves, and spatial relationships from the poetry, such as white cranes spreading wings upward, willow branches drooping with the wind, sunset rays entering the forest diagonally, and plum branches slanting horizontally echoing sparse shadows in the water.

Through large color blocks, diagonal guidance, natural curves and warm rice-white negative space, form clear visual focal points. The movement is natural and smooth, the main subject is prominent, and auxiliary scenery is generalized, avoiding element stacking and complex backgrounds.

【Oriental Color Palette and Light/Shadow】

Use traditional Oriental color systems such as mineral blue, mineral green, indigo, cinnabar red, ochre gold, and warm ivory white.

Use one main color to establish visual weight and another contrasting color to highlight the core imagery. Emphasize warm and cold relationships, brightness levels, and complete large color surfaces, while retaining clean negative space.

Sunlight, tree shadows, and reflections in the water are expressed using restrained flat coloring and a small number of fine lines, avoiding photographic volumetric light, complex reflections, strong gradients, and heavy shadows.

【Chinese Poster Layout】

Integrate a large warm ivory white Chinese title in the dark areas at the bottom or side of the image, using heavy, upright, and elegant Oriental art fonts.

Add exquisite small vertical rows of the original poem lines, accurate dynasty and author signatures, and one or two vermilion seals in appropriate negative spaces. The text is clear, orderly in density, and naturally coordinated with the visual movement of the image.

【Final Quality】

Maintain a visual hierarchy of distinct large shapes, smooth long lines, complete colors, detailed partial descriptions, and background negative space.

Avoid realistic photography, 3D, anime, oil painting impasto, thick ink wash, dense independent leaves, complex feathers, messy textures, excessive grain, and artificial aging.

Finally present a new Chinese-style ancient poetry art poster with a unified style, tense composition, high-end colors, and clear poetic meaning. It has strong visual recognition from a distance and exquisite fine Gongbi lines and Oriental decorative beauty up close.

prompts.text:
【古诗词】{填写诗词标题、作者及原文}
【海报主标题】{提取2–4个代表性汉字}
【核心意象】{如飞鹤、垂柳、林间夕照、梅枝疏影}
【视觉动势】{如斜向飞升、曲线垂坠、光影穿插、枝影交错}
【画面场景】{填写或由AI根据诗词提取}
【主色调】{选择2–3种协调的东方传统色}
【画幅比例】9:16

根据古诗词创作一张具有教科书级插画质感的新中式细线设色艺术海报，将诗中的自然景物、动态关系与光影意境转化为完整、优美的东方视觉作品。

【画风与质感】

采用现代东方装饰插画与传统工笔线描相结合的绘画语言。树冠呈柔软蓬松的云团状完整色块，边缘具有细腻的粉末点染质感，内部穿插纤细、连续、自然分叉的墨黑枝条。

飞鸟、垂柳、梅枝等主体保留各自真实合理的形态，使用完整的平面设色与少量精细长线表现结构。建筑如有出现，采用规整青绿瓦片、优雅飞檐与简洁墙面。整体色彩饱满均匀、哑光干净，保留轻微纸本质感。

【构图与视觉动势】

采用高位俯瞰、东方散点透视与现代平面构成，根据诗意灵活调整视角。

重点提取诗词中的方向、曲线与空间关系，例如白鹤展翅向上、柳枝随风垂落、夕照斜入密林、梅枝横斜与水中疏影呼应。

通过大面积色块、斜向引导、自然曲线和暖米白留白形成明确的视觉焦点。动势自然流畅，主体突出，辅助景物概括，避免元素堆砌和复杂背景。

【东方配色与光影】

使用石青、石绿、黛青、朱砂红、赭金、暖象牙白等东方传统色系。

以一种主色建立视觉重量，另一种对比色突出核心意象。强调冷暖关系、明度层次与完整的大色面，保留干净的留白。

阳光、树影与水中倒影使用克制的平面设色和少量细线表达，避免摄影式体积光、复杂反射、强烈渐变和厚重阴影。

【中文海报排版】

在画面下方或侧边深色区域融入大幅暖象牙白中文标题，采用厚重、端正、优雅的东方艺术字体。

在适当留白处加入精致的小型纵排原诗句、准确的朝代与作者署名，以及一至两枚朱红印章。文字清晰，疏密有序，与画面动势自然协调。

【最终质量】

保持大形鲜明、长线流畅、色彩完整、局部精描与背景留白的视觉层级。

避免写实摄影、3D、动漫、油画厚涂、浓重水墨、密集独立叶片、复杂羽毛、杂乱纹理、过度颗粒与人工做旧。

最终呈现一张画风统一、构图有张力、色彩高级、诗意鲜明的新中式古诗词艺术海报。远看具有强烈的视觉识别度，近看拥有精致细腻的工笔线条与东方装饰美感。

items.title: 新中式古诗词细线设色艺术海报

prompts.text:
【Ancient Poetry】{Fill in poem title, author, and original text}
【Poster Main Title】{Extract 2–4 representative Chinese characters}
【Core Imagery】{Such as hanging wisteria, blue-green flying eaves, crabapple after rain, round fan and fireflies}
【Visual Scene】{Such as Jiangnan courtyard, lakeside village, classical garden}
【Visual Relationship】{Such as flower vines hanging down, red and green contrasting, flowers and trees surrounding buildings}
【Main Color Tone】{Choose 2–3 harmonious traditional Oriental colors}
【Aspect Ratio】9:16

Create a New Chinese-style fine-line colored art poster based on ancient poetry with textbook-level illustration texture, transforming the flowers, trees, architecture, figures, and emotions in the poem into a complete, exquisite Oriental poetic scene.

【Painting Style and Texture】
Adopt a painting language that combines modern Oriental decorative illustration with traditional Gongbi line drawing. Tree canopies are complete color blocks in soft, fluffy cloud shapes, with edges featuring a delicate powder-stippled texture, and interior interspersed with slender, continuous, naturally bifurcating ink-black branches.

Flowers and trees are artistically generalized based on real growth forms; wisteria maintains natural hanging, crabapple flower clusters are orderly in density, and branch and leaf lines are elegant and smooth. Use complete color planes to express the overall form of plants, without depicting dense petals and leaves one by one.

Traditional architecture uses fine and regular blue-green tiles, elegant flying eaves, warm white walls, and a small amount of cinnabar red wooden structures. The overall style is flattened, with full and even coloring, possessing a clean, matte, delicate paper decorative texture.

【Composition and Space】
Adopt a high-angle bird's-eye view, Oriental scattered perspective, and modern flat composition.

Organize the screen through flower and tree enclosures, branch interspersing, architectural blocking, natural curves, and large areas of warm rice-white negative space to form a clear visual focus and spatial layers.

Flexibly adjust the composition based on the poem, highlighting the most representative scenery and action relationships. Detailed architecture, generalized plants, concise figures, and negative space background.

Avoid repeated use of fixed courtyard layouts, and do not forcibly add irrelevant pavilions, figures, or decorations. Ground and water surfaces remain simple, using only a small amount of fine lines and irregular ink shadows to express space.

【Oriental Color Palette】
Adopt traditional Oriental color systems such as azurite blue, mineral green, dark cyan, cinnabar red, wisteria purple, pink ochre, and warm ivory white.

以一种主色形成视觉重量，通过另一种对比色突出花木、建筑或人物主体，搭配墨色细线与暖白留白。
Use one main color to form visual weight, and highlight the main body of flowers, trees, architecture, or figures through another contrasting color, paired with ink-black fine lines and warm white negative space.

Emphasize complete large color planes, harmonious warm and cold relationships, and clear brightness levels. Colors are rich yet restrained, even, matte, and non-fading, avoiding messy colors, complex gradients, heavy textures, and excessive aging.

【Chinese Art Poster Layout】
Integrate large warm ivory white Chinese titles in the dark tree canopy area at the bottom or side of the image, using heavy, upright, and elegant Oriental art fonts, naturally overlapping with flower and tree color blocks.

Add exquisite small vertical original poem lines, accurate author signatures, and one or two cinnabar red seals in appropriate negative spaces.

The text is clear with distinct hierarchies, naturally merging with the landscape, without adding fictional exhibition information, serial numbers, or meaningless decorations.

【Final Quality】
Maintain complete large color block compositions, soft cloud-like tree canopies, slender continuous ink lines, exquisite blue-green architecture, and beautiful negative space. The subject and auxiliary scenery have clear detail hierarchies, and the poetic imagery conforms to natural laws.

Avoid realistic photography, 3D, anime, oil painting impasto, heavy ink wash, dense independent flowers and leaves, complex buildings, complicated ground, excessive grain, and artificial aging.

Finally present a New Chinese-style ancient poetry art poster with a unified painting style, high-end color palette, distinct poetic flavor, and mature Oriental decorative aesthetics.

prompts.text:
【古诗词】{填写诗词标题、作者及原文}
【海报主标题】{提取2–4个代表性汉字}
【核心意象】{如紫藤垂花、青绿飞檐、雨后海棠、罗扇流萤}
【画面场景】{如江南庭院、临水村落、古典园林}
【视觉关系】{如花蔓垂落、红绿映衬、花木包围建筑}
【主色调】{选择2–3种协调的东方传统色}
【画幅比例】9:16

根据古诗词创作一张具有教科书级插画质感的新中式细线设色艺术海报，将诗中的花木、建筑、人物与情绪转化为完整、精致的东方诗意场景。

【画风与质感】

采用现代东方装饰插画与传统工笔线描结合的绘画语言。树冠呈柔软蓬松的云团状完整色块，边缘具有细腻的粉末点染质感，内部穿插纤细、连续、自然分叉的墨黑枝条。

花木根据真实生长形态进行艺术化概括，紫藤保持自然垂挂，海棠花簇疏密有序，枝叶线条优雅流畅。以完整色面表现植物整体形态，不逐片描绘密集花瓣与树叶。

传统建筑采用精细规整的青绿色瓦片、优雅飞檐、暖白墙面与少量朱红木结构。整体平面化、设色饱满均匀，具有干净、哑光、细腻的纸本装饰质感。

【构图与空间】

采用高位俯瞰、东方散点透视与现代平面构成。

通过花木包围、枝条穿插、建筑遮挡、自然曲线与大面积暖米白留白组织画面，形成清晰的视觉重心和空间层次。

根据诗词灵活调整构图，突出最有代表性的景物与动作关系。建筑精描、植物概括、人物简练、背景留白。

避免反复使用固定的庭院布局，不强行添加无关的亭台、人物或装饰。地面和水面保持简洁，只用少量细线及不规则墨色阴影表现空间。

【东方配色】

采用石青、石绿、黛青、朱砂红、藤紫、粉赭、暖象牙白等东方传统色系。

以一种主色形成视觉重量，通过另一种对比色突出花木、建筑或人物主体，搭配墨色细线与暖白留白。

强调完整的大色面、协调的冷暖关系与清晰的明度层次。色彩浓郁而克制，均匀、哑光、不褪色，避免颜色杂乱、复杂渐变、厚重纹理与过度做旧。

【中文艺术海报排版】

在画面下方或侧边的深色树冠区域，融入大幅暖象牙白中文标题，采用厚重、端正、优雅的东方艺术字体，与花木色块形成自然叠压。

在适当留白处加入精致的小型纵排原诗句、准确的作者署名，以及一至两枚朱红印章。

文字清晰，层级分明，与景观自然融合，不添加虚构展览信息、编号或无意义装饰。

【最终质量】

保持完整的大色块构成、柔软云团树冠、纤细连续墨线、精致青绿建筑与优美留白。主体与辅助景物具有明确的细节层级，诗词意象符合自然规律。

避免写实摄影、3D、动漫、油画厚涂、浓重水墨、密集独立花叶、繁杂建筑、复杂地面、过度颗粒与人工做旧。

最终呈现一张画风统一、配色高级、诗意鲜明、具有成熟东方装饰美学的新中式古诗词艺术海报。

prompts.text:

prompts.text:
Create a charming Japanese-style bakery poster combining photorealistic food photography, playful hand-drawn illustrations, and nostalgic editorial typography.

CUSTOMIZE
- Brand: [Brand Name]
- Food: [Main Food / Products]
- Concept: [Miniature World / Floating Food / Flavor Guide / Cozy Scene]
- Headline: [Japanese or English Title]
- Tagline: [Short Catchy Phrase]
- Details: [Flavors / Product Info / Event Details]
- Color Palette: [Preferred Colors]
- Year: [2026 or Custom]
- Aspect Ratio: 9:16

VISUAL STYLE

Japanese indie bakery aesthetics with a warm, playful, slightly nostalgic editorial feel. Combine realistic food photography with delicate, imperfect pen-and-ink illustrations.

Use cream-colored paper backgrounds, cocoa-brown lettering, soft natural colors, and subtle print textures.

FOOD & STORYTELLING

Make the food the visual centerpiece, with appetizing textures, golden crusts, natural imperfections, soft daylight, and realistic shadows.

Add a few tiny 2D hand-drawn characters interacting with the food—walking across pastries, exploring oversized treats, or enjoying a cozy café moment.

Create a charming miniature story through simple, meaningful interactions.

COMPOSITION & TYPOGRAPHY

Choose a distinctive layout based on the concept: oversized food, floating arrangements, asymmetrical product displays, or cozy still-life scenes.

Maintain a strong focal point, balanced visual hierarchy, and approximately 35–40% clean negative space.

Use expressive Japanese-style handwritten headlines, elegant retro serif fonts, and small playful annotations.

Keep all text accurate, readable, and naturally integrated into the design.

FINAL ART DIRECTION

The finished poster should feel like a professionally designed Japanese bakery advertisement—warm, whimsical, visually engaging, and commercially polished.

Keep illustrations minimal and purposeful. Let the food, typography, and storytelling create the visual impact.

Avoid excessive doodles, cluttered layouts, CGI-looking food, 3D cartoon characters, random text, heavy distressing, decorative sparkles, numbering, and watermarks.

Generate one complete, standalone vertical poster, not a collage or mockup.

食物与叙事

确保所有文本准确、易读，并自然地融入设计中。

最终艺术指导

完成的海报应该感觉像是一份专业设计的日式面包店广告——温暖、奇思妙想、视觉吸引力强且具有商业品质。

prompts.text:
A refined adult East Asian woman in her early twenties is depicted with a serene, contemplative presence in a weathered stone pool. Her face features a softly elongated oval structure with gentle cheekbones, a slender jawline, and delicately arched eyebrows framing large, dark almond-shaped eyes. Her skin exhibits a natural, healthy tone with soft human warmth and authentic micro-texture. Long, thick raven-black hair is slicked back neatly from her forehead, glistening with moisture as individual strands trace the contour of her neck. A single, pristine white camellia flower with a soft yellow center is tucked delicately behind her left ear, serving as an elegant visual focal point against her dark hair.

She is styled in an exquisite ivory silk halter wrap dress that drapes gracefully over her shoulders and chest. The lightweight, semi-translucent fabric is saturated with clear water, clinging gently to her upper body in fine, natural folds while submerged beneath the surface. The subtle texture of the woven silk shifts between soft matte highlights where sunlight strikes and translucent tones beneath the water level. The styling maintains a high-fashion, Vogue-editorial sophistication, seamlessly blending luxury resort couture with the serene ambiance of an ancient bathing ritual.

Positioned in the lower-left third of the frame, her body is captured in a subtle contrapposto stance with a dropped hip and a relaxed shoulder. Her head is turned slightly toward the right, her eyes focused softly on the open air beyond the water's edge with a quiet, undisturbed micro-expression. One slender arm rests weightlessly along the submerged stone ledge while her other hand floats just beneath the surface of the pool, creating delicate concentric ripples that radiate outward across the clear water. Her posture feels unposed and candid, captured mid-moment during a quiet pause in the sanctuary pool.

She is immersed within a weathered stone sanctuary pool constructed from ancient, moss-draped masonry and hand-carved stone tiles showing subtle signs of age and mineral staining. In the immediate lower foreground, a large lotus blossom with vibrant pink petals floats on the surface, its lower half partially submerged to guide the viewer's eye along a strong diagonal line toward the subject. The surrounding environment opens into an ancient secluded courtyard enclosed by dense tropical foliage, with broad palm fronds and hanging vines framing the upper border. The upper-right portion of the composition features expansive negative space, where filtered morning light diffuses across the open air and sky.

The shot is framed with an off-center vertical composition formatted for a vertical perspective. A ten-degree Dutch tilt introduces subtle visual tension and dynamic energy while preserving a polished editorial aesthetic. The image is captured on an ARRI Alexa 35 cinema camera paired with a 35mm prime lens set at a wide aperture of f/1.8. This configuration establishes a distinct foreground-to-background depth hierarchy, producing a shallow depth of field where the foreground lotus blossom is crisp, the subject remains in sharp focus, and the distant jungle foliage melts into creamy, soft-focused background bokeh.

Dappled, filtered sunlight penetrates the dense overhead canopy, casting dynamic patterns of luminous warmth across the scene. Golden specular highlights glisten across the surface of the turquoise mineral pool, reflecting light upward onto the weathered stone walls. Deep velvet shadows define the contours of the masonry and foliage, creating rich tonal contrast without obscuring detail. Light refracting through the moving water forms caustics that dance across her skin and the pool's stone floor, illuminating the subsurface clarity of the water.

The rendering emphasizes lifelike material textures throughout the frame. Her skin features a liquid-glass finish, glistening with delicate micro-droplets of water along her collarbones and cheeks, complemented by realistic pores and subtle subsurface scattering beneath the skin's surface. The wet raven-black hair displays individual glistening strands, while the petals of the camellia and lotus possess a velvety, soft-touch texture. The ancient stone surfaces exhibit rough, pitted textures alongside smooth, water-polished edges, creating an authentic contrast between organic flesh, fluid water, and solid stone.

The image undergoes a cinematic color treatment modeled after Kodak Vision3 500T motion picture film stock. Rich turquoise and deep teal tones dominate the water, balancing against the emerald greens of the foliage and the warm, golden hues of the filtered sunlight. Skin tones remain natural and balanced under the cinematic color science, supported by expansive dynamic range that preserves detail in both bright highlights and deep shadows. Fine, organic film grain is evenly distributed across the image, enhancing the authentic photographic character and editorial quality of the visual prompt.
Aspect ratio: 9:16
Avoid: watermarks, signature, text overlay, overexposed highlights, lens flare, extra limbs, misaligned perspective, unrealistic reflections.

prompts.text:
一位二十岁出头的精致成年东亚女性，在饱经风霜的石池中展现出宁静、沉思的神态。她的脸型呈柔和的细长椭圆结构，拥有温柔的颧骨、纤细的下颌线，以及衬托着深色大杏仁眼的精致拱形眉毛。她的皮肤呈现出自然健康的色调，带有柔和的人类温润感和真实的微纹理。长而浓密的乌黑头发整齐地从额头向后梳理，闪烁着水分的光泽，每一缕发丝都勾勒出她颈部的轮廓。一朵洁白纯净、中心呈淡黄色的山茶花巧妙地戴在她的左耳后，在深色头发的映衬下成为优雅的视觉焦点。

她穿着一件精致的象牙色丝绸挂脖裹身裙，优雅地披在肩膀和胸前。轻盈、半透明的面料被清澈的水浸透，在水面下紧贴着她的上半身，形成细腻、自然的褶皱。编织丝绸的微妙质感在阳光照射的柔和哑光高光与水面下的透明色调之间切换。造型保持了《Vogue》社论式的高级时尚精致感，将奢华的度假屋高级定制服装与古代沐浴仪式的宁静氛围无缝融合。

她的身体位于画面左下三分之一处，呈现出微妙的对立式构图姿态，胯部下沉，肩膀放松。她的头略微向右转，眼睛柔和地聚焦在水边之外的开阔空间，带着平静、从容的微表情。一条纤细的手臂轻盈地搭在淹没的石阶上，而另一只手则漂浮在水面之下，在清澈的水面上形成向外扩散的精致同心涟漪。她的姿势感觉未经摆拍且自然，是在避难所水池中安静停顿时捕捉到的瞬间。

她沉浸在一个由古老、布满苔藓的砖石和手工雕刻的石砖构成的饱经风霜的避难所水池中，石砖显示出细微的年代痕迹和矿物染色。在紧邻的下方前景中，一朵有着鲜艳粉红色花瓣的大莲花漂浮在水面上，其下半部分局部淹没，引导观众的目光沿着一条强烈的对角线移向主体。周围环境通向一个被茂密的原始热带植物包围的古老隐秘庭院，宽大的棕榈叶和悬挂的藤蔓构成了上边缘。构图的右上部分拥有广阔的留白空间，过滤后的晨光散布在开阔的空气和天空中。

镜头采用专为垂直透视设计的偏心垂直构图。十度的荷兰式倾斜引入了微妙的视觉紧张感和动态能量，同时保留了精致的社论审美。该图像使用 ARRI Alexa 35 电影摄影机拍摄，搭配 35mm 定焦镜头，光圈设置为 f/1.8 的大光圈。这种配置建立了清晰的前景到背景深度层次，产生浅景深效果，其中前景莲花清晰，主体保持锐利焦距，而远处的丛林植被融化成乳白色、柔焦的背景虚化效果。

斑驳的过滤阳光穿透头顶茂密的树冠，在场景中投射出动态的亮丽暖色图案。金色的镜面高光在绿松石矿物池的表面闪烁，将光线向上反射到饱经风霜的石墙上。深沉的绒面阴影定义了砖石和植物的轮廓，在不遮盖细节的情况下创造出丰富的色调对比。光线穿过流动的湖水发生折射，形成在她的皮肤和水池石地板上跳动的焦散线，照亮了水下的清澈度。

渲染强调了整个画面中逼真的材料纹理。她的皮肤呈现出液态玻璃般的质感，在锁骨和脸颊上闪烁着细腻的微小水珠，辅以真实的毛孔和皮肤表层下的微妙次表面散射。湿润的乌黑头发显示出单根闪亮的发丝，而山茶花和莲花的花瓣则具有天鹅绒般的柔软触感。古老的石头表面呈现出粗糙、坑洼的纹理以及光滑的水磨边角，在有机的血肉、流动的清水和坚固的石头之间形成了真实的对比。

图像经过了模仿柯达 Vision3 500T 电影胶片的电影级色彩处理。浓郁的绿松石色和深青色调主导了水面，与植物的翡翠绿和过滤阳光的温暖金黄色调相平衡。在电影色彩科学的作用下，肤色保持自然平衡，并得到广阔动态范围的支持，保留了明亮高光和深邃阴影中的细节。细腻、有机的胶片颗粒均匀分布在图像上，增强了视觉提示词真实的摄影特质和社论品质。
纵横比：9:16
避免：水印、签名、文本覆盖、曝光过度的高光、镜头光晕、额外的肢体、未对准的透视、不真实的反射。

Behind her, the pit garages and paddock area contain team personnel wearing red-and-black uniforms, equipment, barriers, and metal railings. On the left, the asphalt pit lane extends into the distance, with painted markings, additional trackside structures, spectators, and softly visible green hills beyond the circuit. The white umbrella spans the upper portion of the frame, providing shade and partially covering the sky.

## \(Lighting / Atmosphere\)

Soft, diffused natural daylight under an overcast or lightly cloudy sky. The umbrella reduces harsh direct sunlight on the subject, creating gentle facial shadows, balanced skin tones, and subdued reflections on the glossy red race car and high heels. The overall atmosphere is bright, slightly hazy, and nostalgic, capturing the authentic ambience of a historic motorsport paddock.

## \(Composition / View\)

full-body framing from the umbrella to the woman's shoes. Eye-level camera angle with a nearly frontal view. The woman stands slightly left of center, forming the primary focal point, while the red formula race car fills much of the lower-right and right side of the frame. The large foreground tire provides strong visual depth and scale. The pit lane and garage structures recede into the background, creating natural perspective. Keep the subject's entire body visible, with realistic proportions and clearly defined hands, legs, footwear, and umbrella shaft. Moderate depth of field preserves the subject's sharpness while retaining recognizable background details.

## \(Style Reference\)

Authentic 1990s Japanese motorsport promotional photography, vintage racing paddock editorial, candid event-documentary aesthetic, realistic fashion photography, natural posing, period-appropriate race car and team uniforms, understated film-like colors, slightly faded highlights, subtle analog-film character, and lifelike textures. Avoid contemporary cinematic grading, excessive retouching, artificial skin smoothing, exaggerated body proportions, or overly dramatic lighting.

## \(Quality Parameters\)

High-resolution photorealism, realistic skin texture, anatomically correct body proportions, natural facial expression, accurate hand placement, detailed hair strands, realistic fabric seams and color blocking, legible motorsport branding, glossy red automotive paint, textured racing slick tires, physically plausible umbrella structure, natural perspective, consistent lighting, subtle film grain, balanced exposure, and fine environmental details. Preserve the full-body composition and the visual relationship between the woman, umbrella, and race car. No extra limbs, distorted fingers, duplicated objects, malformed footwear, excessive blur, oversaturated colors, or artificial CGI appearance,No cropped limbs or truncated feet.

prompts.text:
## (主体描述)

一张写实的全身赛车宣传照，主角是一位拥有白皙皮肤、丰满胸部、长腿和精致五官的成年东亚女性。她留着深棕色齐肩发，造型为自然蓬松的柔软乱发波波头，几缕碎发修饰脸部。她化着淡妆，眉毛柔和，正对着镜头露出温暖而自信的微笑。

她穿着一件红、黑、白三色的贴身高领无袖赛车宣传连体衣。设计包含大胆的垂直色块、窄白色条纹、黑色侧板和高衩轮廓。胸前印有醒目的白色“TAi-Beauty”字样，上方有较小的“RACING TEAM”文字。她穿着红色亮面尖头高跟鞋。

她直立在一辆红色开轮式赛车旁，双手握住头顶巨大的白色雨伞的中央黑色伞柄。她的双手在腰部左右位置汇合，双臂自然弯曲。肩膀放松，双腿以自然站姿伸展，双脚靠近，一只脚稍微靠前。她的神情和姿态传达了一位专业赛车队宣传模特的亲和力与精致感。

## (场景 / 背景)

赛车活动期间的户外赛车场维修站通道。一辆复古风格的红色开轮方程式赛车占据了右侧前景，具有暴露的悬挂部件、巨大的黑色赛车光头胎、低风阻车身以及可见的“TAi-Beauty”车队品牌和赛车编号图形。最靠近的前轮在女性腿部旁边尤为突出。

在她身后，维修站车库和围场区域包含穿着红黑制服的车队人员、设备、路障和金属护栏。左侧，柏油马路维修站通道延伸至远方，带有地面标线、其他赛道建筑、观众以及赛场外隐约可见的绿色山丘。白色雨伞横跨画面上方，遮挡阳光并部分遮住了天空。

## (光影 / 氛围)

阴天或薄云下的柔和弥散自然日光。雨伞减少了直射在主体上的刺眼阳光，营造出柔和的面部阴影、平衡的肤色，并减弱了亮面红色赛车和高跟鞋上的反射。整体氛围明亮、略带朦胧感和怀旧感，捕捉到了历史性赛车围场的真实氛围。

## (构图 / 视角)

从雨伞到女性鞋子的全身取景。与眼睛齐平的相机视角，近乎正面的视野。女性站位略偏中心左侧，成为主要焦点，而红色方程式赛车占据了画面右下方和右侧的大部分。巨大的前景轮胎提供了强烈的视觉深度和比例感。维修站通道和车库建筑向背景延伸，形成自然的透视感。保持主体全身可见，比例真实，手部、腿部、鞋履和伞柄定义清晰。适度的景深保持了主体的清晰度，同时保留了可辨认的背景细节。

## (风格参考)

真实的1990年代日本赛车宣传摄影、复古赛车围场社论、随性的活动纪录美学、写实时尚摄影、自然摆拍、符合时代的赛车和车队制服、低调的类胶片色彩、轻微褪色的高光、微妙的模拟胶片特征以及逼真的纹理。避免当代电影感调色、过度修图、人造皮肤磨皮、夸张的身体比例或过于戏剧性的光效。

## (质量参数)

高分辨率照片写实主义、真实的皮肤纹理、符合解剖学的身体比例、自然的表情、准确的手部位置、细致的头发丝、真实的织物接缝和色块、清晰可读的赛车品牌、亮面红色汽车漆、有质感的赛车光头胎、物理上合理的雨伞结构、自然透视、一致的光照、微妙的胶片颗粒、平衡的曝光和细腻的环境细节。保留全身构图以及女性、雨伞和赛车之间的视觉关系。没有多余的肢体、扭曲的手指、重复的物体、畸形的鞋子、过度的模糊、过饱和的颜色或人造CGI感。没有裁剪的肢体或截断的双脚。

Output: Generate a high-resolution fashion editorial poster with a vertical 2:3 aspect ratio. Do not include comparison images, divided images, or the production process.

Character/Background: Maintain the face, hair, body type, clothing, shoes, pose, and direction of the reference image as faithfully as possible without redesigning the pose or clothing. The full body must not be cropped. The background is a solid studio space ranging from white to light gray. Add only natural grounding shadows.

Main Title: Fixed as two lines, placed large in the upper left of the screen. Line 1 shows MAIN TITLE LINE 1, and Line 2 shows MAIN TITLE LINE 2. Use a black high-end fashion magazine style serif font. Beautiful contrast between thin and thick strokes, with letter spacing and line spacing that are not too tight, ensuring appropriate white space. Leave ample room at the top to create a dignified title block without a sense of pressure.

Subtitle: Based on the meaning, tone, and worldview of the input main title, the AI automatically conceives a short and refined Japanese subtitle. Place it vertically in the white space on the left in a black thin Mincho font. Do not place it immediately below the main title; shift the starting position down to the height corresponding to the character's shoulder to waist. The text should not be too dense and should harmonize with the white space. Horizontal arrangement is prohibited.

Achieve visual balance with the upper left title and do not overlap with the person or hair. Do not add decorative text, numbers, or logos.

Barcode: Place a small, dignified magazine-style barcode in the lower right. Do not add prices, issue numbers, or explanatory text around it.

Overall Design: Top left 2-line title, left middle vertical subtitle, center to right reference character, top right extremely thin vertical line, bottom right barcode. Prioritize the character while adjusting for beautiful white space and asymmetrical balance. Do not fill white space with unnecessary graphics; create a quiet and refined layout for a high-end fashion magazine.

Prohibitions: Pose changes, clothing changes, adding people, full body cropping, single-lining the title or placing it on the right, horizontal subtitle arrangement, overly dense text arrangement, unnecessary titles, copy, dates, prices, logos, watermarks, excessive decoration, or generating multiple options.

【主标题】
固定为2段，大尺寸放置在画面左上方。第1行显示 MAIN TITLE LINE 1，第2行显示 MAIN TITLE LINE 2。采用黑色的高级时尚杂志风格衬线字体。细粗对比优美，字间距・行间距不过于紧凑，确保适度空白。上端也留有余裕，形成无压迫感的端庄标题块。

【副标题】

在右上方的空白处放置一条黑色至深灰色的极细纵向实线。从右端约6〜8%、上端约5〜7%、长度为画面高度的8〜12%、粗细约0.5〜1pt。与左上标题取得视觉平衡，不与人物或头发重叠。不添加装饰文字・数字・标志。

左上方2段标题、左侧中段纵向副标题、中央至右侧参考人物、右上方极细纵线、右下方的条形码。以人物为优先，同时调整优美的空白和不对称平衡。不用不必要的图形填充空白，形成高级时尚杂志安静而精炼的版面。

袖子宽大而飘逸，采用半透明的浅粉色雪纺材质，袖口带有多层轻盈的荷叶边。薄纱袖子自然垂落在手臂两侧，具有柔软、轻盈的垂坠感。

裙摆由多层浅粉色薄纱、乳白色蕾丝和柔软缎面组成，具有丰富的层次与自然的褶皱。裙边装饰精细的花朵刺绣、蕾丝花边、小巧蝴蝶结和柔软的装饰飘带。

裙摆宽大蓬松，随着坐姿自然铺散在石阶表面，形成优雅的扇形轮廓。不同材质之间具有明显区别，缎面呈现柔和光泽，蕾丝纹理细腻，薄纱轻盈半透明。

【三、连裤袜设计】

人物穿着一条浅薰衣草紫色的精致连裤袜，采用一体式 pantyhose 设计，从腰部连续包裹臀部、双腿并延伸至脚尖，而不是独立的长筒袜或过膝袜。

连裤袜采用柔和的淡紫色半透明纱质面料，透明度自然，能够隐约呈现真实的腿部轮廓，同时保留细腻均匀的织物质感。

袜面装饰精致的白色小花朵、蝴蝶结和细腻的交织线条图案。装饰图案自然地沿着双腿延伸，分布协调、连续，不出现明显的断层、错位或不对称。

连裤袜整体颜色均匀柔和，与浅粉色裙装、乳白色蕾丝和粉色鞋子形成协调的 pastel 配色。

连裤袜从腰部连续延伸至脚尖，具有完整的一体式结构。大腿处没有独立袜口，没有长筒袜边缘，没有吊带，也没有裸露的腿部与袜口分界。

人物脚穿浅粉色玛丽珍鞋，鞋面带有纤细的搭扣带、小巧蝴蝶结和精致装饰。连裤袜自然包裹双脚，脚尖位于鞋内，袜子与鞋子的结构真实合理。

连裤袜需要具有真实的薄纱织物质感，图案细腻清晰，贴合腿部自然轮廓，不出现不合理的褶皱、材质融化或图案漂浮。

【四、人物姿势与动作】

人物自然地坐在传统中式建筑的宽阔石阶上，整体姿势优雅、放松，带有轻微的慵懒感。

她的臀部坐在石阶上，上半身微微向前倾，头部轻轻向一侧倾斜，脸部朝向镜头，双眼自然注视镜头，带着温柔甜美的微笑。

一只手撑在身体侧后方的石阶上，手掌自然接触石面，手指轻轻舒展，以支撑身体重量。

另一只手抬至脸颊附近，轻轻拿着一朵粉白色莲花。花朵靠近脸部，但不遮挡眼睛和主要面部特征。

双腿沿画面右下方自然伸展，略微交错，形成优雅的对角线构图。膝盖、脚踝和双脚的角度符合真实人体结构，腿部线条自然流畅。

两只脚自然放置在石阶上，两只浅粉色玛丽珍鞋均清晰可见。浅薰衣草紫色连裤袜沿双腿连续延伸至脚部，与鞋子自然衔接。

宽大的多层裙摆自然铺散在人物周围及石阶表面，薄纱、蕾丝和飘带顺着坐姿形成自然的褶皱。

确保人物具有正确的身体比例、自然的肩颈结构、准确的手部形态和完整连贯的双腿。手指数量正确，肢体不重复，不出现多余手臂或不自然的关节。

【五、莲花道具】

人物手中拿着一朵精致的粉白色莲花。

莲花呈半开放状态，由多层自然舒展的花瓣构成。花瓣中心为乳白色，向边缘逐渐过渡为柔和的浅粉色，花心带有淡淡的暖黄色细节。

花瓣层次清晰，边缘柔和自然，具有真实植物的细腻质感。莲花大小适中，形态优雅，与人物面部形成自然的视觉呼应。

莲花必须具有清晰完整的花瓣结构，不出现重复花瓣、融化的形状或不合理的连接。

【六、环境与背景】

场景是一处具有历史感的中国传统木建筑入口或古典廊下。

人物身后是一扇深棕色的传统木门，门板具有清晰的天然木纹、古典矩形装饰框和真实的木质表面纹理。

建筑两侧分布着深色粗壮木柱，柱脚由浅灰色雕刻石质柱础支撑。背景墙面采用米灰色石材，具有自然的石块拼接结构。

人物坐在宽阔的浅灰色石阶上。石阶沿斜向延伸，表面具有真实的天然石材纹理、细微磨损痕迹和自然的明暗变化。

深棕色木门与浅灰色石阶形成温暖而沉静的色彩对比，突出人物浅粉色的服装，同时保留传统建筑的古朴氛围。

背景简洁真实，不添加现代家具、霓虹灯、夸张装饰或不符合传统建筑环境的物品。

【七、摄影构图】

采用真实数码相机人像摄影风格，竖版 2:3 构图。

摄影机位于人物前方略高的位置，采用轻微俯拍视角，呈现自然的空间透视关系。

人物位于画面中央偏左的位置，头部处于画面上半部分，身体、裙摆和双腿沿对角线向画面右下方展开。

采用接近 35mm 至 50mm 镜头的自然透视效果，避免过度广角造成的面部和四肢变形。

人物从头部到双脚完整地呈现在画面中，莲花、裙摆、连裤袜和两只鞋子均清晰可见，不要意外裁切脚部。

画面保留足够的木门、木柱和石阶作为环境背景。人物是主要视觉焦点，建筑提供真实的空间纵深感。

人物面部和服装细节清晰，背景具有适度的景深，但木门、石柱与石阶仍然能够辨认出真实纹理。

【八、光线与色彩】

采用柔和的自然环境光，光线从建筑入口一侧进入，均匀照亮人物的面部、头发和粉色服装。

人物面部具有自然的高光与细腻阴影，眼睛保留真实的光线反射。黑色头发具有清晰的发丝层次，白色蕾丝能够保留丰富纹理，不出现过曝发白。

浅薰衣草紫色连裤袜在光线下呈现柔和、均匀的淡紫色，白色装饰图案清晰可辨，同时保留自然的织物透明感与细腻纹理。

整体色彩以浅粉色、乳白色、薰衣草紫、米灰色和深棕色为主。画面温暖柔和，色彩协调，保持准确的白平衡和自然的肤色。

使用真实摄影中的自然曝光和柔和反差，不添加过强的橙黄色滤镜、夸张梦幻光晕或过度 HDR 效果。

【九、最终画面质量】

超写实真人摄影，高质量日系 Cosplay 写真，自然真实的成年东亚女性面部，清透日系妆容，黑色长发与粉色花朵发饰，粉白色古典 Lolita 长裙，精细蕾丝与半透明雪纺，浅薰衣草紫色花纹连裤袜，粉色玛丽珍鞋，手持粉白色莲花，自然坐在传统中式建筑的石阶上。

重点突出真实皮肤质感、自然人体比例、精致服装工艺、真实布料物理效果、准确的手部结构、自然环境光和真实石材纹理。

连裤袜必须是一体式设计，从腰部连续延伸至脚尖，具有一致的淡紫色调和连续的白色装饰图案，不得生成独立长筒袜、过膝袜、吊带袜或裸露的大腿袜口。

避免动漫风、插画风、3D 渲染感、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、夸张大眼、浓重滤镜、僵硬姿势、错误手指、额外肢体、腿部结构错误、重复鞋子、服装纹理融化、连裤袜断层、袜面图案错位、背景结构扭曲、严重噪点、过度锐化和不自然的 HDR 效果。
