prompts.text:
【主题定位】少女户外公园写真，高级日系青春人像摄影，清新自然的春夏季节氛围，融合日本时尚杂志Editorial、日系胶片写真、轻奢生活方式广告与电影级人像摄影的视觉语言。画面呈现一种轻盈、柔软、自由而富有呼吸感的青春气息，不刻意摆拍，不追求过度精致的商业修饰，而是在自然光线、微风、草地与人物情绪之间捕捉真实动人的瞬间，仿佛空气中弥漫着淡淡的青草香、花香与阳光晒过衣裙的温柔气息。整体色彩以粉黛粉、淡青色、柔和草绿、奶油白为主，低饱和度的清透撞色设计，色彩丰富但不艳俗，背景简洁开阔，人物突出，画面具有高级摄影作品的质感与故事性。

【场景环境】现代城市公园中的开阔草坪，大片粉黛乱子草如轻柔的粉色云雾般铺展在草地之间，粉色花穗在微风中轻轻摇曳，呈现自然松弛的层次感。草坪以清新柔和的绿色为基底，局部点缀淡粉色花丛与自然生长的观赏植物，形成粉绿相间的清透视觉效果。公园采用现代极简景观设计，宽阔草坪占据主要画面，健身设施与现代休闲设施零星穿插在远处，避免密集排列与杂乱的视觉干扰。场景内仅有极少量中型乔木，树冠轻盈疏朗，枝叶形成自然的透光层次，不遮挡天空与主体人物。减少园林步道的存在感，仅保留几段简洁的浅灰色步行小径，自然延伸至远景。草坪边缘三三两两摆放几张现代铁木组合长椅，黑灰色纤细金属支架搭配温润的原木坐板，设计简约克制，间隔疏朗，成为画面中的轻微几何点缀。远处偶尔出现模糊的散步行人，人物数量极少，虚化处理，不干扰主体。环境通透、安静、整洁，保留真实城市公园的生活气息，同时具备高端户外时尚广告的审美质感。

【人物形象】一位20岁左右的年轻成年东方少女，气质可爱甜美，带有自然清新的邻家少女感，面容柔和精致，脸颊微微带一点自然婴儿肥，面部线条圆润流畅，下颌小巧柔和，五官协调自然，不刻意追求夸张的网红审美。眼睛清澈明亮，眼神灵动，眼尾自然舒展，瞳孔具有细腻真实的光泽，鼻梁小巧自然，唇形柔软饱满，唇色为低饱和度的蜜桃粉或淡玫瑰色。表情自然放松，笑起来带有轻微的羞涩与俏皮感，安静时则呈现出温柔、清冷而略带忧郁的情绪。肌肤呈现真实自然的健康白皙质感，保留细微的皮肤纹理、自然的毛孔与柔和的面部光影，面颊带有阳光照射后的淡淡红润，不使用过度磨皮、塑料皮肤或瓷娃娃式的处理。整体呈现清透、细腻、具有真实呼吸感的高级人像质感。

【妆容设计】户外淡妆与日系盐系妆容相结合，强调自然、清透、低存在感的精致美。底妆轻薄通透，保留真实皮肤纹理，额头、鼻梁与颧骨处具有自然的柔和光泽。眉毛采用自然原生眉形，颜色与发色协调，眉峰不刻意强调。眼妆以浅米棕、淡杏粉与低饱和玫瑰棕为主，细腻晕染眼窝，眼线纤细自然，睫毛根根分明，不使用夸张的浓密假睫毛。眼下保留极淡的自然卧蚕与轻微粉嫩气色，腮红采用低饱和蜜桃粉，从面颊中央向外自然晕染。唇妆为半透明水润的淡粉色，呈现柔软自然的唇部纹理。整体妆容仿佛只是经过精心整理的原生好气色，在阳光下清新、干净、灵动。

【发型设计】采用自然蓬松的高位丸子头，发髻松弛而不刻意规整，具有轻盈的空气感与自然的发丝层次。额前保留少量轻薄碎刘海与自然散落的鬓角碎发，修饰脸型与面部轮廓。耳侧、后颈与发髻边缘有少量细软青丝，在微风吹拂下轻轻飘动，部分发丝被逆光勾勒出纤细的金色轮廓。头发颜色为自然黑棕色，避免过度染色的塑料光泽。发型不佩戴复杂发饰，仅允许极简的同色系发圈隐藏在发髻中。整体呈现刚刚走出家门、在户外自然活动时被风吹乱的真实感，轻盈、松弛、自然且富有青春气息。

【服装造型】少女身穿一条淡青色轻盈长裙，颜色介于浅薄荷青、雾感青绿与淡青瓷色之间，低饱和度、柔和清透，与粉黛乱子草形成精致的粉青撞色。裙装采用简洁优雅的现代设计，整体线条流畅，腰部自然收束，裙摆宽松舒展，长度延伸至小腿下方或脚踝附近。面料采用轻薄柔软的高品质雪纺与细腻哑光缎面混合质感，具有适度垂坠感、自然褶皱与轻盈透光性，但不透明暴露。上身为简洁的无袖或细肩带设计，领口自然呈现柔和的抹胸式轮廓，淡青色外裙与内搭之间仅在领口、肩带边缘若隐若现地形成精致层次，整体端庄清新，不刻意强调身体曲线。裙摆在风中微微扬起，形成自然的弧线与柔软的动态褶皱。搭配极简的米白色平底凉鞋或干净的浅色帆布鞋，根据拍摄动作灵活选择。全身不佩戴夸张珠宝，不使用繁杂腰带、腿环或装饰性挂件，不手持多余道具。服装干净、轻盈、舒适，像一件为春夏公园写真精心挑选的高级设计师日常裙装。
【光线与摄影质感】采用温暖的自然漫反射阳光，模拟晴朗天气下上午九点至十点半或下午四点至五点之间的柔和日光。光线经过天空、草地与粉色花穗的反射，在人物面部形成均匀、柔和、具有空间层次的照明。主光从人物侧前方约45度的位置进入，面部保留细腻的明暗过渡，鼻翼、下颌与颈部形成淡淡的自然阴影，避免平光造成的面部扁平感。人物发丝、肩线与裙摆边缘带有微弱的逆光轮廓，粉黛花穗在阳光下呈现细腻的透光效果。整体曝光明亮但不过曝，高光柔和，暗部保留细节，肤色清透自然，绿色与粉色不出现荧光感。空气中具有轻微的柔光氛围，但不使用明显的雾化滤镜。采用真实光学镜头的浅景深效果，背景虚化自然，焦外光斑柔和，主体清晰锐利，画面具有高端日系胶片摄影与现代商业人像广告相结合的质感。

【色彩与画面风格】整体采用淡青、粉黛粉、奶油白与柔和草绿的低饱和配色，画面清透、温暖、轻盈，具有高级日系写真特有的留白感与呼吸感。淡青色裙装作为人物的主要视觉色块，与大面积粉色花海形成柔和而醒目的色彩对比。肤色保持自然白皙与轻微暖调，不偏黄、不发灰。绿色背景呈现细腻的层次变化，粉色花穗带有柔和的灰粉色调，避免过度鲜艳。后期采用轻微的日系胶片色彩曲线，适度降低高饱和颜色，保留丰富的中间调与自然的肤色过渡，颗粒感极轻微，整体干净细腻。避免过度锐化、强烈HDR、浓重橙黄色调、过度复古滤镜与不自然的磨皮效果。

items.title: 诊室里的绝美东亚护士问诊人像

prompts.text:
Subject:
Leaning forward for consultation in the consultation room

Main Body:
Vertical shot, a beautiful 23-year-old East Asian beauty leaning slightly forward in the consultation room, occupying about 70% of the frame. The right hand is touching stray hair near the ear, and the left hand is resting on the right knee. On the left is a stainless steel medicine cart, and on the right is a hospital bed.
Beautiful 23-year-old East Asian beauty, fashion lifestyle photography, commercial portrait texture.

Character and Expression:
Beautiful 23-year-old East Asian beauty, fashionable, confident, and gentle temperament; well-proportioned and plump figure, breasts are obviously and naturally plump, visual about D to E cup, with a natural sense of weight and soft rounded contours, obvious chest-to-waist difference.
Brown long hair in a low ponytail, with bangs and stray hair on the sides of the cheeks. Roundish face shape, soft eyebrows and eyes, thin nose bridge, light lip color, a hint of a smile at the corners of the mouth. Light makeup, looking at the camera. Healthy skin tone, natural highlights on shoulders and neck. Round hips, slender lower limbs.

Clothing and Props:
White short-sleeved nurse uniform, pink piping, front piece with a deep curved collar, a thin zipper in the center reaching below the waist, the skirt hem stops at the upper thigh. Wearing a white nurse hat with a pink cross on the front. A pink stethoscope is hung around the neck, with the chest piece hanging in front of the chest. White over-the-knee socks on the legs, flat sock openings. Do not change to a regular dress or trousers.

Background and Light:
Consultation room, the stainless steel medicine cart on the left has bottles, jars, and trays, the hospital bed on the right is covered with light blue sheets, there are curtains and a door in the distance. The main light comes from the indoor lights above, uniform, with a neutral color temperature.

Composition and Lens:
From head to knees, natural front camera position, focus is on the face, nurse hat, and front zipper. Medium depth of field, the clothes in the foreground are clear, and the bed in the distance is slightly soft. Do not change to outdoors.

Texture and Style:
Commercial fashion lifestyle photography, pink edges, zippers, and stethoscopes must be clear, real space, 8K clear, on-site in the consultation room, no illustration feel.

Negative Prompts:
Deformed fingers, extra limbs, facial collapse, child appearance, text watermark, logo, change to a regular dress, remove nurse hat or stethoscope, change to a long skirt, change to outdoors or studio.

绝美23岁东亚美女，时尚生活摄影，商业写真质感。

items.title: 废土奇幻冷酷女战士全身像

prompts.text:
A gritty, cinematic post apocalyptic fantasy portrait with a hyper detailed concept art finish, a full length shot of a fierce female warrior in a ragged black hooded costume standing in a wide, confident stance in a dusty wasteland, a spiked iron club resting across her shoulder, one hand on her hip, staring at the camera with a cold, menacing, regal expression.

Hair: Long, pale, almost white blonde hair with ashen grey tones, falling from beneath the hood in thin, loose strands and several twisted braids and dreadlock like sections down past the chest, threaded with small chains, beads and rusty metal charms. Warm amber firelight rims the strands in a soft glow.

Face and skin: A pale, dust streaked face with sharp cheekbones, strong dark brows and dramatic black war paint around the eyes in heavy, smudged, winged shapes, with a small dark mark painted at the center of the forehead. Lips are painted a deep, matte black with a slightly serious, composed expression. Skin appears pale with fine natural texture, a faint sweaty sheen, small smudges of grime and warm orange highlights from the fire.

Outfit: A tattered, black cloth hood with frayed, ragged edges and a pointed peak, worn over a cropped, shredded black jacket with long, fitted sleeves covered in studs and worn, scuffed fabric, with armored cuffs at the wrists. Layers of chains, dark beads and chain harnesses wrap across the chest, shoulders and midriff, over a thick studded choker collar. A wide, battered leather belt with heavy metal buckles holds a ragged, tattered asymmetrical skirt with long, torn, trailing strips of black cloth hanging to the ground at both sides, with hanging chains and spikes. Black ripped fishnet tights with large, torn holes, and tall, black, glossy leather high heeled boots with buckles, studs and small spikes. Several chunky rings and spiked bracelets cover her fingers and wrists.

Props: A heavy iron club or spiked baton with a studded head resting on her right shoulder, with a chain hanging from it. Behind her, a battered black armored truck with a rusted hood, mounted cannons and a bleached horned skull strapped to the front grille with hanging chains.

Background: A vast, dusty, cracked desert wasteland under heavy, dark brown clouds with a smoky orange glow, with tall black banners with faint gold emblems on tall poles flying at the upper left and right, hanging chains strung across the sky, and a huge fire and thick black and orange smoke rising from a ruined camp at the right. Distant silhouettes of other figures and armored vehicles stand in the dust haze.

Lighting: Dramatic, low angled, warm amber firelight from the right combined with a hazy, overcast glow from the sky, creating strong rim lights on the hair and hood, small sharp highlights on the chains, boots and studs, deep, smoky shadows across the clothing and the ground and a thick dust atmosphere.

Color palette: Jet black, burnt orange, ember red, dusty brown, rusty bronze, pale ash blonde, warm tan dirt and pale skin tones.

Camera and look: Shot as a highly detailed cinematic digital artwork with the realism of a full frame camera at 35mm from a slightly low angle, sharp focus on the subject, soft atmospheric depth in the haze, rich texture on the cloth and metal, fine grain and a dark, desaturated, high contrast grade with a warm, smoky tone.

Composition: Vertical full length framing, the subject centered in a wide, powerful stance with her face in the upper third, the club angled across her shoulder, the ragged skirt flaring outward at both sides, the armored truck on the left, the burning camp on the right and the cracked dusty ground leading the eye up to her.

Mood: Menacing, fierce, epic and apocalyptic, a ruthless queen of the wasteland in front of a burning world.

No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no plastic skin, no merged chains and mesh, no cluttered random shapes, no stiff pose, no smeared face paint, no extra fingers, no distorted legs or anatomy.

prompts.text:
一幅充满质感、电影感的废土奇幻人像，具有超精细的概念艺术修饰，一张全身照，一名凶悍的女战士穿着破旧的黑色兜帽服饰，以宽大、自信的姿态站在尘土飞扬的荒原上，肩上扛着一根带刺的铁棍，一只手叉腰，以冷酷、威胁、尊贵的表情盯着镜头。

头发：长而苍白的、近乎白金色的头发，带有灰烬灰色调，从兜帽下垂落，呈薄薄的散发，以及几根扭曲的发辫和类似脏辫的部分，向下垂过胸部，穿插着细链、珠子和生锈的金属饰品。温暖的琥珀色火光在发丝边缘勾勒出柔和的光晕。

面部和皮肤：苍白、布满尘土痕迹的脸，颧骨高耸，浓黑的眉毛，眼睛周围涂着夸张的黑色战争油彩，呈厚重、涂抹过的翼状，额头中心绘有一个黑色的小标记。嘴唇涂成深哑光黑色，表情略显严肃、沉着。皮肤看起来苍白，具有细腻的自然质感，淡淡的汗水光泽，细小的污渍，以及来自火焰的温暖橙色高光。

服饰：一件破烂的黑色布质兜帽，边缘磨损参差，带有尖顶，套在短款、破碎的黑色夹克外，长长的修身袖子上布满铆钉和磨损、擦伤的织物，手腕处有装甲袖口。多层链条、深色珠子和链条背带横跨在胸部、肩膀和腹部，戴着厚重的铆钉颈圈。宽阔、破旧的皮革皮带配有沉重的金属扣，固定着一条破旧、不规则的裙子，两侧垂着长长的、撕裂的、拖地的黑色布条，并挂有链条和尖刺。黑色破洞鱼网袜，以及带有搭扣、铆钉和细小尖刺的高筒黑色亮面皮革高跟靴。手指和手腕上戴着几枚厚重的戒指和带刺的手镯。

道具：一根沉重的铁棍或带刺的警棍，带有铆钉头，靠在右肩上，上面挂着一根链条。在她身后，有一辆破旧的黑色装甲卡车，引擎盖生锈，安装有大炮，一个漂白的有角头骨用挂链绑在前进气格栅上。

背景：广阔、多尘、开裂的沙漠荒原，浓厚、深褐色的云层下散发着烟雾般的橙色光芒，左上方和右上方的高杆上飘扬着带有微弱金色徽记的黑色长旗，天空中拉着挂链，右侧的一处废墟营地升起巨大的火焰和浓厚的黑橙色烟雾。远处的尘霾中站立着其他人物和装甲车辆的剪影。

光照：戏剧性的低角度、来自右侧的温暖琥珀色火光，结合来自天空的朦胧、阴沉光泽，在头发和兜帽上产生强烈的轮廓光，在链条、靴子和铆钉上产生微小锐利的高光，在服装和地面上产生深沉、烟雾缭绕的阴影，以及浓厚的尘埃氛围。

调色板：漆黑色、焦橙色、余烬红、灰褐色、锈青铜色、浅灰金色、温暖的棕褐色泥土和苍白的肤色。

相机与外观：拍摄为精细的电影数字艺术作品，具有全画幅相机 35mm 镜头的真实感，从略低的角度拍摄，主体对焦清晰，雾霾中带有柔和的大气深度，布料和金属上具有丰富的纹理，细腻的颗粒感，以及深色、去饱和、高对比度的分级，带有温暖、烟雾缭绕的色调。

prompts.text:
Create a premium FULL-FRAME 4:5 vertical photo-to-illustration travel poster for [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT].

TEXT-TO-IMAGE ONLY — generate everything from the written subject alone. No reference image required.

CORE CONCEPT:
Create a charming vintage travel-journal poster with a precise horizontal split: the upper 50% features a realistic photographic scene, while the lower 50% transforms the SAME scene into a beautiful hand-painted travel illustration.

COMPOSITION:
Keep the main subject consistent across both halves. The upper section features natural lighting, authentic textures, and realistic details. The lower section reimagines the scene using simplified shapes, soft watercolor and gouache, and a warm cream paper background.

STYLE:
Retro travel postcards, hand-painted architecture, delicate botanical details, playful handwritten lettering, tiny stars and hearts, and subtle paper texture. Add a short, creative English headline and a small destination label inspired by the scene.

COLORS:
Warm ivory, sky blue, muted teal, sunny yellow, coral, sage green, and terracotta. Use cheerful, harmonious colors with a nostalgic afternoon atmosphere.

FINAL AESTHETIC:
Real photography × illustrated travel memory × vintage editorial design × playful handwritten typography.

AVOID:
Combining unrelated scenes, changing the main subject between halves, clutter, excessive text, glossy digital art, 3D, logos, watermarks, and mockups.

FORMAT:
Exact 4:5 vertical ratio, full-bleed artwork, complete canvas coverage, clean 50/50 horizontal split, high resolution.

prompts.text:
为 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主体] 创建一张优质的全画幅 4:5 垂直比例的摄影转插画旅行海报。

仅限文本生成图像 — 完全根据书写的主体生成一切。不需要参考图像。

核心概念：
创作一张迷人的复古旅行日志海报，采用精确的水平分割：上半部分 50% 为写实的摄影场景，下半部分 50% 将同一场景转化为精美的手绘旅行插画。

构图：
保持主体在上下两半部分一致。上半部分采用自然光、真实的纹理和写实的细节。下半部分使用简化的形状、柔和的水彩和水粉以及温暖的奶油色纸张背景重新构思该场景。

风格：
复古旅行明信片、手绘建筑、精致的植物细节、俏皮的手写文字、小星星和爱心，以及微妙的纸张纹理。添加一个简短、有创意的英文标题和一个受场景启发的小目的地标签。

颜色：
暖象牙色、天蓝色、柔和的蓝绿色、阳光黄、珊瑚色、鼠尾草绿和赤陶色。使用欢快、和谐的色彩，营造出怀旧的下午氛围。

最终美学：
真实摄影 × 插画旅行记忆 × 复古社论设计 × 俏皮的手写排版。

避免：
组合无关场景、在两半部分之间更改主体、杂乱、过多的文字、光滑的数字艺术、3D、徽标、水印和样机。

格式：
精确的 4:5 垂直比例、全出血艺术作品、完整的画布覆盖、干净的 50/50 水平分割、高分辨率。

场景环境： 夏日午后，安静茂密的天然绿色森林，人物站在一条被树木包围的狭窄林间小路上。背景有高大的深褐色树干、茂盛的绿色阔叶植物、浓密的灌木丛和层层叠叠的深绿色树叶。阳光从高处密集的树冠缝隙穿透下来，在人物身上和森林地面形成斑驳的明亮光斑。地面由浅灰色泥土、碎石、干枯树叶和不规则树影组成，背景小路向画面右后方自然延伸。周围植被颜色偏深，具有真实森林环境的空间纵深感。

光线与色彩： 强烈的夏日阳光从人物左后上方透过树冠照射下来，照亮头顶、额头、鼻梁、脸颊、肩膀和白色裙摆。头发边缘形成明显的浅金棕色轮廓光，大量细碎发丝被阳光点亮，具有自然的逆光发丝光晕。人物脸部由森林反射的自然柔光照亮，冷白肌肤呈现干净的乳白色高光，面部阴影柔和。裙摆局部在阳光下轻微过曝，呈现明亮柔软的白色光感。森林背景整体保持深绿色和深灰色调，阳光斑点呈暖白色，人物与背景形成鲜明的明暗对比。整体色彩以冷白、深绿、深棕和浅金色为主，层次自然，避免鲜艳的商业滤镜。

画质风格： 复古 CCD 数码相机质感与自然光人像摄影相结合，日系透明感少女写真，轻微梦核氛围，真实生活抓拍，柔和光学成像，低强度数字颗粒，细腻的高光溢出，轻度光晕，轻微色散，真实的发丝边缘散射。人物面部清晰但不过度锐化，皮肤保留自然微小纹理，背景暗部带细微数字噪点。整体曝光略微偏亮，色彩低饱和但森林绿色层次丰富，白色裙子保持轻盈柔亮的质感，呈现自然高级而非商业精修的真实照片效果。

items.title: 东方文博实验字体艺术海报

prompts.text:
【Cultural Theme】: Fill in, such as Tang Sancai, blue and white porcelain, Jun kiln, Jian ware
【Core Artifact】: Fill in name, vessel shape, and material characteristics
【Chinese Main Title】: Fill in
【English Main Title】: Fill in
【Cultural Phrase】: Fill in
【Series Name】: 器色有形 / COLORS OF HERITAGE
【Main and Auxiliary Colors】: Fill in
【Visual Mode】: Dark Minerals / High-Saturation Contrasting Colors / Gradient Raster
【Aspect Ratio】: 9:16

Create a high-completion Oriental museum experimental typography art poster, integrating traditional Chinese aesthetics, museum exhibition visuals, vintage editorial design, and modern experimental Typography.

I. Artifact and Composition

Use a real artifact with authentic cultural characteristics as the core main visual, displayed in a large proportion, with accurate vessel shape, exquisite material texture, natural glaze or surface texture, and lighting layers like museum collection photography.

Allow partial enlargement of the artifact, with edges going out of frame, creating front-and-back overlapping with the text. Add a partially cropped or semi-transparent auxiliary artifact, using differences in size, virtual/real, direction, and form to establish spatial layers.

II. Typography and Layout

The Chinese main title uses huge and powerful brush calligraphy, with natural brushstrokes, flying white (feibai), and thickness variations, becoming an important visual graphic of the picture.

The English main title uses high-quality uppercase vintage serif fonts, interacting with the Chinese calligraphy and artifacts through enlargement, line breaks, dislocation, and overlapping. A small amount of elegant English cursive can be added as an auxiliary.

The layout must have a complete editorial information hierarchy, including series name, artifact name, cultural category, craftsmanship description, Chinese and English phrases, and a small amount of exquisite annotation lines. Information density is medium-high, but maintains a clear primary-secondary relationship.

III. Color and Background

Design according to the selected visual mode:

- Dark Minerals: Ink black, deep blue, copper gold, etc., integrating mineral textures, local metallic color details, semi-transparent calligraphy backgrounds, presenting a deep and heavy cultural temperament.
- High-Saturation Contrast: Use two distinct main colors for large-area partitioning, paired with organic curves, artifacts dislocated out of frame, huge fonts, and low-contrast cultural patterns, forming a vintage editorial design sense.
- Gradient Raster: Use gradient color fields such as cyan-blue and indigo-purple with spatial depth, superimposed with continuous and dense vertical rasters. Lines bend slightly at the edges of artifacts, with variations in density and front-back overlapping, forming a modern optical art effect where artifacts appear indistinctly.

The background integrates traditional calligraphy, decorative patterns, glaze flow, or historical cultural textures related to the theme, with low transparency, enriching the picture without interfering with the main information.

IV. Visual Hierarchy and Completion

Build three main visual anchors with huge Chinese calligraphy, core artifacts, and large English titles.

Form rich spatial layers and reading rhythms through partial out-of-frame artifacts, text overlapping, color contrast, background shadows, and fine lines.

From a distance, it has strong visual impact and a clear large shape; from close up, one can discover exquisite materials, calligraphy textures, cultural information, and graphic details.

The entire poster should have the completion of professional museum exhibitions, art publishing, and cultural brand design, becoming a complete work with independent thematic expression, rather than a common artifact display template.

Ensure accurate artifact modeling, clear text, precise layout, and mature colors. Avoid garbled characters, fictional exhibition news, meaningless English, cheap 3D, excessive tech special effects, random numbering, four-pointed stars, and watermarks.

Final output is a 9:16 vertical high-definition art poster.

prompts.text:
【文化主题】：填写，如唐三彩、青花瓷、钧窑、建盏
【核心器物】：填写名称、器型及材质特征
【中文主标题】：填写
【英文主标题】：填写
【文化短句】：填写
【系列名称】：器色有形 / COLORS OF HERITAGE
【主色与辅助色】：填写
【视觉模式】：深色矿物 / 高饱和撞色 / 渐变光栅
【画幅比例】：9:16

创作一张高完成度的东方文博实验字体艺术海报，融合中国传统美学、博物馆展览视觉、复古编辑设计与现代实验 Typography。

一、器物与构图

以一件具有真实文化特征的器物作为核心主视觉，大比例展示，具备准确的器型、精致的材质纹理、自然釉面或表面质感，以及博物馆藏品摄影般的光影层次。

允许器物局部放大、边缘出框，与文字产生前后遮挡。加入一件局部裁切或半透明的辅助器物，利用大小、虚实、方向与形态差异建立空间层次。

二、字体与排版

中文主标题使用巨大而富有力量的毛笔书法，具有自然的笔锋、飞白与粗细变化，成为画面的重要视觉图形。

英文主标题采用高品质大写复古衬线字体，通过放大、分行、错位与叠压，与中文书法及器物产生互动。可加入少量优雅的英文连笔字作为辅助。

画面必须具有完整的编辑式信息层级，包括系列名称、器物名称、文化分类、工艺说明、中英文短句及少量精致标注线。信息密度中高，但保持明确的主次关系。

三、色彩与背景

根据选择的视觉模式设计：

- 深色矿物： 墨黑、深蓝、铜金等色彩，融合矿物纹理、局部金属色细节、半透明书法底纹，呈现深邃厚重的文化气质。
- 高饱和撞色： 使用两种鲜明的主色进行大面积分区，搭配有机曲线、器物错位出框、巨大字体与低对比文化纹样，形成复古编辑设计感。
- 渐变光栅： 使用具有空间深度的青蓝、靛紫等渐变色场，叠加连续细密的纵向光栅。线条在器物边缘产生轻微弯曲、疏密变化和前后遮挡，形成器物若隐若现的现代光学艺术效果。

背景融入与主题相关的传统书法、装饰纹样、釉色流动或历史文化肌理，透明度较低，丰富画面但不干扰主要信息。

四、视觉层级与完成度

以巨大中文书法、核心器物和英文大标题构建三个主要视觉锚点。

通过器物局部出框、文字叠压、色彩对比、背景虚影和精细线条，形成丰富的空间层次与阅读节奏。

远看具有强烈的视觉冲击和清晰的大形，近看能发现精致的材质、书法肌理、文化信息与图形细节。

整张海报应具有专业文博展览、艺术出版和文化品牌设计的完成度，成为一件具有独立主题表达的完整作品，而不是普通的器物展示模板。

确保器物造型准确、文字清晰、排版精密、色彩成熟。避免乱码、虚构展讯、无意义英文、廉价3D、过度科技特效、随机编号、四角星芒及水印。

最终输出一张9:16竖版高清艺术海报。

prompts.text:
A young adult East Asian woman sits in an intimate, quiet moment. She has a softly elongated oval facial structure marked by subtle high cheekbones, lean gently filled cheeks, a slim tapered jaw, and a small, delicately rounded chin. Medium almond-shaped dark eyes curve slightly upward at their outer corners framed by natural, softly defined eyebrows. A slender straight nose with a subtle rounded tip rests above medium lips that show a slightly fuller lower curve. Her dense, straight black hair is cut into a sleek dark bob framing her forehead and cheekbones, while her slender silhouette follows an hourglass-to-subtle-pear proportion with a naturally defined waist.

She is styled in a minimalist black Calvin Klein bra and matching lower-waist underwear. The garments are crafted from fine matte satin that clings softly to her form, contrasted sharply by a clean, crisp white elastic waistband bearing subtle brand lettering. The smooth fabric creates soft tension folds across her torso and hip. Sitting beside her on the worn counter surface is a small, off-white ceramic coffee mug with a visibly chipped rim, adding a grounded, lived-in touch to the intimate styling.

Her posture is naturally asymmetrical and relaxed as she perches atop the narrow kitchen counter. One knee is drawn tightly toward her chest, held gently by her arm, while her opposite leg dangles casually down the front of the cabinetry. Her torso twists delicately toward the side window, creating a subtle spiral curve through her waist and neck. A lit cigarette is balanced lightly between her lips, its glowing red ash sending thin, meandering threads of pale smoke spiraling softly upward toward the ceiling.

The scene is set inside a cramped, retro domestic kitchen filled with lived-in detail. Behind her, a faded tiled backsplash exhibits subtle discoloration and aged grout lines. A vintage metal stove sits adjacent to stacked stainless steel pans, worn wooden cutting boards, and cooking utensils leaning against the wall. To one side, a small sink holds a worn dish brush and damp sponge, while a frosted glass window panel forms the primary backdrop behind her upper torso, its surface speckled with morning condensation and light water droplets.

The shot is composed from a dynamic waist-level perspective with a slight fifteen-degree Dutch angle tilt, establishing a strong diagonal spatial flow across the vertical frame. Framing is off-center, positioning her twisted silhouette along the left vertical third while the dangling leg and counter edge form a lead-in vector. The camera utilizes a 50mm anamorphic cinema lens set at f/1.8 on a full-frame sensor, creating a deep spatial separation between the tack-sharp subject plane and the surrounding environment. Foreground framing catches the soft, out-of-focus edge of a wooden cutting board, while the background kitchen clutter melts into smooth, painterly oval bokeh.

A cool, moody teal-green backlight streams through the frosted window pane, serving as a strong key light that casts a delicate rim glow along the contours of her dark bob, shoulders, and waist. Ambient morning daylight fills the room with soft, cool shadows, producing gentle tonal gradations across her skin. Secondary warm highlights catch the glowing orange tip of the cigarette, the white elastic band of her underwear, and the fine wisps of rising smoke, creating a crisp contrast against the cool background tones.

Surface details reflect real-world material fidelity and physical texture. Her skin exhibits natural pores, fine peach fuzz catching the backlight, and subtle subsurface scattering along her cheekbones and chest. The matte satin underwear shows realistic fabric grain and subtle sheen where light hits the taut folds. The ceramic mug displays a matte glaze with micro-scratches and a chipped edge, while individual strands and flyaways of her black hair catch the teal rim light independently.

The color palette features a cinematic contrast between cool teal shadows and warm amber midtones. Deep desaturated greens and cyans dominate the atmospheric background and window glass, while her skin tones maintain a warm, natural golden-amber glow. High-contrast pop is achieved through the bright white elastic waistband and the vivid fiery point of the cigarette ember, producing a cohesive, atmospheric filmic color grade reminiscent of 35mm motion picture film.

她的造型是一件极简主义的黑色 Calvin Klein 内衣和配套的低腰内裤。这些服装由精细的哑光缎面制成，柔软地贴合她的身形，与带有微妙品牌字母的洁净、挺括的白色弹性腰带形成鲜明对比。平滑的面料在她的躯干和臀部形成了柔软的拉伸褶皱。坐在她身旁磨损的台面上的是一个米白色陶瓷咖啡杯，杯缘有明显的缺口，为这种亲密的造型增添了一抹接地气的生活气息。

当她坐在狭窄的厨房柜台上时，她的姿势自然不对称且放松。一只膝盖紧贴胸部，被手臂轻轻抱着，而另一条腿则随意地悬挂在橱柜前。她的躯干向侧窗微妙地扭转，在腰部和颈部形成了一个微妙的螺旋曲线。一根点燃的香烟轻轻地夹在她的唇间，其燃烧的红色烟灰散发出细长、蜿蜒的淡色烟雾，向天花板柔和地螺旋上升。

场景设定在一个拥挤、复古的住宅厨房里，充满了生活细节。在她身后，褪色的瓷砖背景墙显示出微妙的变色和老化的勾缝线。一个老式金属炉灶紧邻着堆叠的不锈钢锅、磨损的木质砧板和靠墙放置的烹饪用具。在一侧，一个小水槽放着磨损的洗碗刷和潮湿的海绵，而磨砂玻璃窗板构成了她上身后的主要背景，其表面布满了清晨的冷凝水和细小的水滴。

镜头采用动态的腰部高度视角拍摄，带有轻微的 15 度荷兰角倾斜，在垂直画框中建立起强烈的对角线空间流动感。构图偏离中心，将她扭转的剪影定位在左侧垂直三分之一处，而悬挂的腿和柜台边缘形成了引导向量。相机使用了 50mm 变形电影镜头，全画幅传感器上光圈设定为 f/1.8，在极为清晰的主体平面与周围环境之间创造了深邃的空间分隔。前景构图捕捉到了木质砧板柔软、模糊的边缘，而背景中杂乱的厨房则融化成平滑、如画般的椭圆形焦外成像。

冷调、忧郁的蓝绿色背光流过磨砂窗玻璃，作为强力主光，沿着她深色波波头、肩膀和腰部的轮廓投射出微妙的边缘光。清晨的自然光散布在房间里，带有柔和的冷色阴影，在她皮肤上产生柔和的色调渐变。次要的暖色高光捕捉到了香烟发光的橙色尖端、内裤的白色弹性腰带以及缓缓升起的细微烟雾，与冷色的背景色调形成了鲜明的对比。

表面细节反映了真实世界的材质逼真度和物理质感。她的皮肤展现出自然的毛孔，细小的汗毛捕捉着背光，颧骨和胸部有微妙的次表面散射。哑光缎面内衣在光线照射到紧绷褶皱处显示出逼真的织物纹理和微妙的光泽。陶瓷杯显示出带有微划痕和缺口边缘的哑光釉面，而她黑发的每一根发丝和碎发都独立地捕捉着蓝绿色的边缘光。

Primary request: 严格制作一张竖版上下对比图。上半部完整保留输入照片的真实摄影质感、主体身份、数量、姿态、动作方向、观察角度、构图和关键环境关系，不重新编造照片。下半部把同一照片转绘成“WATERCOLOR DOUBLE EXPOSURE TRAVEL｜暖白水彩双重曝光旅行海报风”：以暖白、米白纸张为大面积底色，保留一个从原照片提炼出的主体轮廓或核心形体，并把同一场景中的环境、建筑、地貌、植物、天空或其他真实元素以双重曝光方式嵌入主体内部或从主体边缘延展出来，形成有语义的叠景关系；主体与叠入景物必须来自输入照片，不得套用固定旅游模板。边缘使用自然的湿水彩晕开、干刷擦痕、稀薄墨点飞溅和纸纤维吸色，局部允许轻微留白断裂，但不能变成普通滤镜或平涂插画。主动改变下半部的主体尺度、裁切、信息密度和空间组织：可将主体缩小置于大面积留白中，让叠景成为视觉回声；不得把原照片按相同取景等比例重画。加入极少量与照片事实有关的手写/细线题签、材料字段或一句极短观察，文字像印在纸上，避免假字、长段落、品牌、二维码和网址。
Composition/framing: 画布为干净竖版海报；上下各约一半，水平分界清晰；下半部留白充足，叠影集中且有主次，不能塞满画面；不得左右并排、九宫格、多图拼贴或额外照片框。
Materials/textures: 暖白粗纹纸、纸纤维、透明水彩叠色、湿边晕染、干刷、稀墨飞溅、轻微手工印刷不均；不要塑料质感、3D渲染、厚重油画或纯数字渐变。
Color palette: 从输入照片提取并压缩颜色，以暖白和低饱和环境色为底，保留主体中最有辨识度的少量色彩；不要固定橙蓝配色。
Constraints: 保持照片事实、主体身份/数量/姿态、主要建筑或地形关系；下半部必须明显是同一场景的双重曝光水彩重组；禁止新增无关人物、地标、动物或交通工具；禁止“原图”“AI图”角标、品牌标志、水印。
Avoid: 仅调色、仅加颗粒、普通滤镜、完整等比例临摹、纯水彩风景替换、过度复杂拼贴、满版无留白、模糊主体、错误文字。

prompts.text:
Generate a hyper-realistic real-person Cosplay photography work, 9:16 vertical composition. The overall presentation is a natural Japanese-style Cosplay selfie style, blending dreamlike fantasy girl aesthetics with real smartphone photography texture.

[I. Character Setting]

A clearly adult young East Asian female Cosplayer, visual age about early 20s, with a pure, sweet, and gentle temperament.

Small face, soft and natural facial contours, smooth jawline, exquisite and coordinated facial features, preserving real adult female facial structure and natural human body proportions. Eyes are bright and full of spirit, presenting a clear violet color, the iris has rich purple layers, delicate textures, and natural light reflections.

Eyes can be slightly larger than real eyes, presenting a slight 2D aesthetic, but still conform to real human facial structure. Avoid exaggerated anime eyes, excessively dilated pupils, and unnatural eye proportions.

Skin is fair and delicate, with a natural pink blush. Light and elegant Japanese-style makeup, long and natural eyelashes, soft eyeliner, pink and tender lips, lips slightly parted, showing a gentle and cute expression.

Preserve real skin texture, fine pores, natural facial light and shadow changes, and slight asymmetry. The character is exquisite and beautiful, but must not look like a plastic doll, do not over-smooth the skin, and do not generate cookie-cutter AI influencer faces.

[II. Hairstyle and Hair Accessories]

Silver-white ultra-long hair, with a soft creamy white tone, hair strands are light, fluffy, and delicate, with a natural sense of layering and real hair strand texture.

Uses an exquisite double-sided partial hair-tie style, rather than traditional high twin-tails.

The hair on the top of the head is naturally fluffy, the hair parting is slightly off-center, and the forehead is covered with thick and soft white straight bangs. Bangs naturally spread to both sides, with some fine hair strands gently falling above the eyes and on both sides of the cheeks, creating a natural shielding effect. 

The hair on the left and right sides of the head is separately treated with partial hair-ties, fixed with mint-green ribbons and exquisite silver crystal hair accessories. Most of the rest of the long hair remains naturally loose, falling along both sides of the shoulders to near the waist.

The overall long hair is smooth and soft, the ends show natural large-arc curls, and some ends have a very faint mint-green gradient.

The sides of the head are decorated with mint-green ribbons, transparent crystal flower ornaments, silver metal accessories, and long, thin cyan-green ribbons. Crystal ornaments have real transparency and delicate reflections, ribbons are light and flowing, hair accessories are exquisite and gorgeous but not excessively stacked.

Special emphasis: The overall hairstyle is dominated by loose ultra-long hair, with only partial hair-ties on both sides; do not split all hair into two bundles, do not generate traditional high twin-tails, and do not generate short hair or neat low ponytails.

[III. Clothing Design]

The character wears an exquisite white fantasy princess dress, blending Japanese Lolita, light wedding dress, and fairy tale styles.

Overall dominated by pearl white and pure white, paired with a small amount of mint-green ribbons, creating a fresh, pure, and dreamlike visual effect.

The upper body adopts an elegant off-the-shoulder design, the chest is made of soft white fabric, paired with multiple layers of naturally stacked 3D ruffles. The fabric has delicate folds and a gentle drape.

A white decorative collar is worn around the neck, paired with a mint-green ribbon. The cyan-green ribbon is naturally tied into an exquisite small bow in front of the neck, with long ribbon ends hanging down along the chest.

Shoulders and arms are covered with translucent white organza, sleeves feature a light and fluffy design, and cuffs are decorated with multiple layers of white ruffles. Transparent gauze can vaguely show arm contours while maintaining real material transparency.

The chest uses soft white pleated fabric and layered ruffle decorations, forming an exquisite princess dress structure.

The lower body is a large and fluffy white princess skirt, the skirt body falls naturally, forming elegant 3D folds. The hem uses light satin, tulle, and organza, with rich layers, presenting a flowing feel like a light wedding dress.

The satin part of the clothing has soft silk reflections, the tulle is light and semi-transparent, and the organza is slightly stiff, capable of supporting the fluffy shape of the sleeves and skirt.

Mint green is only used for the neck ribbon, hair accessories on both sides, and a few details; do not let the entire outfit become blue-green.

The clothing structure is clear, material differences are distinct, folds are natural, avoid fabric blending with skin, avoid unreasonable decorations and blurred clothing edges.

[IV. Character Action and Expression]

The character faces the camera, the upper body leans slightly forward, and the head tilts gently to one side, presenting a natural and intimate selfie posture.

One hand is raised near the eyes, the index and middle fingers are naturally spread, forming a playful V-sign gesture. The palm is slightly tilted, and the fingers are naturally extended, with clear knuckle structures.

The raised hand is close to the camera, forming a slight close-up wide-angle perspective effect, but the finger length, quantity, and joint proportions must conform to real human body structure.

The other hand hangs naturally at the side of the body, in a relaxed posture.

The character looks directly at the camera with both eyes, the gaze is clear and gentle, lips are slightly parted, with a natural, gentle smile.

Overall expression is sweet, pure, and playful; do not blink, do not do a single-eye wink, no exaggerated smiles, and no stiff posed postures.

[V. Photography Angle and Composition]

9:16 vertical composition.

Uses a position slightly higher than the character's eyes for close-range shooting, forming a slight high-angle perspective.

The character's face is located in the upper center of the frame, with the head, shoulders, upper body, and wide skirt extending sequentially towards the bottom of the frame.

The character occupies about 85% of the frame area, highlighting facial expressions, silver-white long hair, exquisite hair accessories, and white dress.

The hand close to the camera forms a natural foreground layer, producing a slight sense of spatial depth.

Long hair falls naturally along both sides of the shoulders, allowing clear visibility of hair strands, cyan-green ribbons, and the layers of the skirt.

Uses the visual effect of a real smartphone close-range shot, with a slight wide-angle perspective, but no obvious facial distortion and no overstretching of body proportions.

The image has the natural feel of a casual selfie, rather than a deliberately designed commercial advertisement or standard studio portrait.

[VI. Indoor Background]

Ordinary indoor environment, behind the character is a dark brown wooden door, wooden walls, and a small amount of dark furniture.

The background remains simple and natural, requiring no complex decorations. The dark wooden background forms a sharp light-dark contrast with the bright white dress.

The background is slightly blurred but the contours of a real indoor environment are still recognizable.

Overall environment has the reality of daily life, as if the Cosplayer just finished changing into the outfit indoors and took a casual photo with a phone.

[VII. Lighting and Image Texture]

Soft indoor fill light illuminates the character's face, and the eyes have natural light reflections.

The face is bright and clear, preserving the natural light and shadow transitions of the nose bridge, cheeks, and jaw.

Silver-white hair has clear hair strand textures, with different light and dark layers on the top of the head, bangs, and hair ends, avoiding the entire hair block being overexposed into pure white.

The white dress preserves clear folds, material textures, and 3D structure. Tulle shows a natural semi-transparent effect, and satin has soft reflections, avoiding loss of detail in white clothing.

Overall tone is clean and bright, dominated by white, silver-white, and mint-green, with purple eyes forming an exquisite visual accent.

The photo is clear and natural, with rich details on the subject and a slightly blurred background. Avoid manually adding noise, thick fog, excessive soft focus, or strong sharpening effects.

[VIII. Final Image Requirements]

The final effect is a high-quality Japanese-style selfie photo of a real adult female Cosplayer.

The character has a slight 2D aesthetic, but the overall result is still real-person photography, not anime illustration, 3D rendering, or plastic dolls.

Emphasis is on presenting silver-white ultra-long loose hair, double-sided partial hair-ties, violet eyes, mint-green crystal hair accessories, white tulle princess dress, and a natural close-up V-sign gesture.

Skin is real and natural, hair strands are clear, clothing materials are accurate, hand structure is correct, light and shadow are soft, and character proportions are natural.

Avoid plastic skin, over-smoothing, stiff AI expressions, exaggerated anime faces, overexposed white areas, blurred hair strands, incorrect finger counts, deformed hands, extra limbs, unreasonable clothing structures, and an obvious 3D rendering feel.

prompts.text:
生成一张超写实真人 Cosplay 摄影作品，9:16 竖版构图。整体呈现自然的日系 Cosplay 自拍风格，融合梦幻幻想系少女美学与真实智能手机摄影质感。

【一、人物设定】

一名明确成年的年轻东亚女性 Cosplayer，视觉年龄约20岁出头，具有清纯、甜美、温柔的气质。

脸型小巧，面部轮廓柔和自然，下颌线流畅，五官精致协调，保留真实成年女性的面部结构与自然的人体比例。眼睛明亮而富有神采，呈现清透的紫罗兰色，虹膜具有丰富的紫色层次、细腻的纹理和自然的光线反射。

眼睛可以比现实中的眼睛略大一些，呈现轻微的二次元美感，但仍然符合真人的面部结构。避免夸张的动漫眼睛、过度放大的瞳孔和不自然的眼部比例。

皮肤白皙细腻，带有自然的粉色红晕。淡雅的日系妆容，纤长自然的睫毛，柔和的眼线，粉嫩的嘴唇，嘴唇微微张开，呈现轻柔可爱的表情。

保留真实的皮肤纹理、细微毛孔、自然的面部明暗变化和轻微的不对称。人物精致漂亮，但不能像塑料娃娃，不要过度磨皮，不要生成千篇一律的 AI 网红脸。

【二、发型与发饰】

银白色超长发，带有柔和的奶油白色调，发丝轻盈、蓬松、细腻，具有自然的层次感和真实的发丝纹理。

采用精致的双侧局部束发造型，而非传统的高位双马尾。

头顶发丝自然蓬松，发缝略微偏中分，额前覆盖浓密柔软的白色齐刘海。刘海自然地向两侧散开，部分细碎发丝轻柔地垂落在眼睛上方和脸颊两侧，形成自然的遮挡效果。

头部左右两侧的头发分别进行局部束发处理，以薄荷青色缎带和精致的银色水晶发饰固定。其余大部分长发保持自然披散状态，沿着肩膀两侧垂落至腰部附近。

长发整体顺滑柔软，发尾呈现自然的大弧度卷曲，部分末端带有极淡的薄荷青色渐变。

头部两侧装饰薄荷青色缎带、透明水晶花饰、银色金属配件和细长的青绿色丝带。水晶饰品具有真实的透明度与细腻反光，丝带轻盈飘逸，发饰精致华丽但不过度堆叠。

特别强调：整体发型以披散的超长发为主体，双侧仅进行局部束发，不要将全部头发分成两束，不要生成传统高位双马尾，不要生成短发或整齐的低马尾。

【三、服装设计】

人物穿着一套精致的白色幻想系公主礼服，融合日系 Lolita、轻婚纱与童话风格。

整体以珍珠白和纯白色为主，搭配少量薄荷青色缎带，营造清新、纯净、梦幻的视觉效果。

上半身采用优雅的露肩设计，胸口由柔软的白色布料构成，搭配多层自然堆叠的立体荷叶边。布料具有细腻的褶皱和轻柔的垂坠感。

颈部佩戴白色装饰领，搭配薄荷青色缎带。青绿色缎带在颈前自然系成精致的小蝴蝶结，细长的带尾沿着胸前向下垂落。

肩部与手臂覆盖半透明白色欧根纱，袖子采用轻盈蓬松的设计，袖口装饰多层白色荷叶边。透明薄纱能够隐约呈现手臂轮廓，同时保留真实的材质透明度。

胸口采用柔软的白色褶皱布料与层叠荷叶边装饰，形成精致的公主礼服结构。

下半身是一条宽大蓬松的白色公主裙，裙身自然垂落，形成优雅的立体褶皱。裙摆使用轻盈的缎面、薄纱与欧根纱，层次丰富，呈现轻婚纱般的飘逸感。

服装的缎面部分具有柔和的丝绸反光，薄纱轻盈半透明，欧根纱略微挺括，能够支撑袖子与裙摆的蓬松形状。

薄荷青色仅用于颈部缎带、两侧发饰和少量细节，不要让整套服装变成蓝绿色。

服装结构清晰，材质区别明确，褶皱自然，避免布料与皮肤融合，避免不合理的装饰和模糊的服装边缘。

【四、人物动作与表情】

人物面对镜头，上半身略微向前倾，头部轻轻向一侧倾斜，呈现自然、亲近的自拍姿态。

一只手抬到眼睛附近，食指与中指自然张开，形成俏皮的 V 字手势。手掌略微倾斜，手指自然伸展，指节结构清晰。

抬起的手靠近镜头，形成轻微的近距离广角透视效果，但手指长度、数量和关节比例必须符合真实人体结构。

另一只手自然垂落在身体一侧，姿态放松。

人物双眼直视镜头，眼神清澈温柔，嘴唇微微张开，带有自然、轻柔的微笑。

整体表情甜美、清纯、俏皮，不要眨眼，不要单眼 wink，不要夸张的笑容，不要僵硬的摆拍姿势。

【五、摄影角度与构图】

9:16 竖版构图。

采用略高于人物眼睛的位置进行近距离拍摄，形成轻微俯拍的视角。

人物面部位于画面上方中央，头部、肩膀、上半身和宽大的裙摆依次向画面下方延伸。

人物占据画面约85%的面积，突出面部表情、银白色长发、精致发饰和白色礼服。

靠近镜头的手形成自然的前景层次，产生轻微的空间纵深感。

长发沿着肩膀两侧自然垂落，能够清晰地看到发丝、青绿色缎带和裙身的层次。

采用真实智能手机近距离拍摄的视觉效果，具有轻微的广角透视，但不要明显的面部畸变，不要过度拉伸身体比例。

画面具有随手自拍的自然感，而不是刻意设计的商业广告或标准影棚写真。

【六、室内背景】

普通室内环境，人物身后是深棕色木门、木质墙面和少量深色家具。

背景保持简洁自然，不需要复杂的装饰。深色木质背景与明亮的白色礼服形成鲜明的明暗对比。

背景轻微虚化，但仍然能够辨认出真实室内环境的轮廓。

整体环境具有日常生活的真实感，仿佛 Cosplayer 在室内换好服装后，随手使用手机拍摄了一张照片。

【七、光线与画面质感】

柔和的室内补光照亮人物面部，眼睛具有自然的光线反射。

面部明亮清晰，保留鼻梁、脸颊和下颌自然的光影过渡。

银白色头发具有清晰的发丝纹理，头顶、刘海和发尾呈现不同的明暗层次，避免整块头发过曝成纯白色。

白色礼服保留清晰的褶皱、材质纹理与立体结构。薄纱呈现自然的半透明效果，缎面具有柔和的反光，避免白色服装细节丢失。

使用书面概念作为创意方向。将所有三个目的地融入一个具有凝聚力的艺术构图中，而不是创建单独的面板或拼贴画。

大师风格：
优质水彩旅行插图，优雅的建筑墨线勾勒，精致的金箔点缀，复古手工象牙纸质感，精致的编辑设计，艺术水彩飞溅，细微的油漆滴落，考究的排版，电影级光效，错综复杂的细节，豪华画廊品质的海报。

日本京都：
包括一条传统的日本街道，拥有美丽的木制町屋、深色瓷砖屋顶、悬挂的灯笼、精致的粉红色樱花、远处的传统宝塔、薄雾缭绕的山脉和散落的樱花瓣。使用柔和的尘粉色、柔和的绿色、木炭色和温暖的米色水彩调。

英国伦敦：
以标志性的伊丽莎白塔（大本钟）、优雅的哥特式建筑细节以及塔后微妙的金色太阳为特色。使用精致的金箔和象牙色线条描绘地标，带有深邃的午夜蓝背景点缀和微小的金色星星。保持精致、永恒的外观。

阿联酋迪拜：
展示雄伟的哈利法塔耸立在奢华的现代天际线之上，独特的未来博物馆，宁静的水滨，优雅的传统船只，棕榈树和温暖的阿拉伯沙漠景观。使用金色落日光、沙米色、土耳其蓝、琥珀色和柔和的天蓝色水彩晕染。

构图：
将三个目的地自然地融合成一件视觉平衡的艺术品。在上方两侧放置樱花和传统的日本屋顶，将大本钟优雅地放置在上方中间区域，并使哈利法塔成为核心建筑景观。将迪拜的水滨和沙漠灵感景观融入底部。使用流动的多色水彩丝带、精致的金色波浪线、艺术飞溅和细微的油漆滴落来连接这三座城市。

背景：
带有微妙天然纤维的温暖象牙色手工纸，柔和的水彩污渍，优雅的负空间，精致的复古旅行印章细节，以及考究的博物馆品质印刷美学。

排版：
在顶部写上：
“CITIES OF THE WORLD”

在主标题下方写上：
“KYOTO • LONDON • DUBAI”

在底部写上：
“TRADITION • HISTORY • FUTURE”

排版应优雅、考究、拼写完美，并完美融合到构图中。使用精致的衬线字体，精心排列的大写字母和微妙的手写装饰。

光效与品质：
柔和的黄金时刻照明，大气深度，逼真的建筑比例，细腻的水彩纹理，错综复杂的细线细节，平衡的对比度，优质的艺术指导，超精细的 8K 品质外观。

输出：
4:5 垂直构图，高分辨率旅行编辑海报，具有凝聚力的水彩插图，优质收藏级艺术印刷品，优雅的国际旅游杂志美学。

负面提示词：
无单独的图像面板，无分屏构图，无摄影拼贴，无杂乱的布局，无过大的文字，无拼写错误的单词，无随机字母，无扭曲的建筑，无重复的地标，无不切实际的建筑比例，无过多的油漆飞溅，无过饱和的颜色，无标志，无水印，无模糊的细节。

最终结果：
一张考究、视觉效果惊人的世界城市水彩海报，将日本传统、伦敦的历史优雅和迪拜的未来奢华完美融合为一件统一的艺术作品。

prompts.text:
Character Reference: Strictly refer to the female appearance and female body proportions in Figure 1. There are diverse dynamic bangs and hairstyle states that conform to physical effects (cannot be identical to the hair and bangs state in original Figure 1). 

Suggested Aspect Ratio: 9:16 

Full Prompt: 
- Character and Clothing: She wears a loose, soft, light gray-blue thin cotton short-sleeved top and creamy white loungewear shorts; the state of the clothes is as reasonable as a Western woman not wearing a bra. The originally baggy clothes turn significantly darker and heavier after being completely soaked by water. Part of the wet fabric clings to the shoulders, neck, chest, rib cage, waist, abdomen, and hips, while another part is still lifted by the jet of water and forms messy wrinkles. 
- Action and Pose: She is half-squatting in front of an open sink cabinet, her body hurriedly dodging backward. One hand uses a towel to press firmly on the loose pipe joint; but high-pressure water continuously sprays out from between her fingers and both sides of her wrist, rushing directly toward her upper body and face. The other hand is raised in front of her face, trying to block the water flow. She instinctively shrugs her shoulders, tightens her arms, and twists her face to one side, with one leg firmly supported and the knee on the other side naturally lowering due to loss of balance, the body forming a realistic and tense reverse twist. 
- Water Flow and Wet State: Water sprays continuously from the broken joint inside the cabinet along a diagonal upward path, splitting into several columns of water and a large amount of splashing droplets, one of which grazes her chin and cheek. Her hair, top, and shorts are all soaked; the hem of the shirt sags irregularly and clings to the waist and abdomen due to water absorption, and the chest fabric forms clear radial wrinkles under water pressure, gravity, and body twisting, clearly outlining her body lines; the shorts show wet clinging and variations in shade along the hips and thighs. Accumulated water on the floor spreads, with splashes scattering around her knees and arms. 
- Fabric Physics: The thin cotton top becomes significantly heavier after fully absorbing water, and its originally loose silhouette shrinks significantly and naturally conforms to the curves of the body; the chest area is affected by water flow, gravity, and twisting, forming radial wet folds extending from the direction of the pressing arm. The hem clings heavily to the waist and flanks, with water dripping continuously from the edges. After being soaked, the shorts cling to the hips and thighs; the leg openings, drawstrings, and side seam structures remain clear, and dense stretch wrinkles appear in the deep squatting posture. 
- Expression and Gaze: She closes one eye that was sprayed by water, while the other eye barely stays open; her eyebrows are furrowed helplessly, droplets hang from the tip of her nose and eyelashes, and her lips are pursed and then slightly parted, as if sighing. She turns her face to the side to avoid the water, her expression looking distressed, helpless, yet slightly amused, completely ignoring the camera. 
- Hairstyle State: Maintain the basic identification of the character reference. The hair is completely soaked, and its volume is noticeably gathered due to water absorption. The bangs and hair on the sides of the face are divided into wet thin strands, clinging to the forehead, temples, cheeks, neck, and shoulders; a few hair ends swing to the side and back with the head twist, throwing off small water droplets. 
- Camera and Composition: The camera is located slightly high in front of the sink, shooting downward at an approximately 35mm perspective. The foreground is the hand pressing the joint, the water deflecting from the fingers, and the other hand raised to block the face; the mid-ground is the completely soaked top, the twisted waist, and the deep-squatting legs; the wet face dodging to the side is located at the top of the frame. 9:16 close-up upper-body composition, shooting from the complete top of the head to the mid-thigh, slightly tilted, capturing the moment the fine water just hits her face. 
- Scene and Lighting: A standard modern kitchen, where the open light-colored sink cabinet, metal pipe components, scattered towels, and large areas of water on the floor are clearly visible. The warm white top light illuminates the soaked face and clothing, while cold blue night light enters from the side and rear, creating dense and fine highlights on the skin's water marks, wet hair, skin-tight cotton material, and airborne water droplets. 
- Photography Texture: A combination of realistic mobile phone life snapshot and high-speed shutter photography. The face, both hands, and the main water flow are clear, with small droplets frozen in the air. The focus is on expressing the weight and clinging sensation after being thoroughly soaked, the continuous dripping state, and the coherent action of one hand plugging the leak, one hand blocking the face, and the head twisting to avoid water; the overall vibe is distressed, wet, vivid, and full of strong visual tension.

prompts.text: Create a vertical 3:4 comparison conversion page between a real photo and a horizontal contour specimen diagram. The top part preserves the real photography information of the pet, animal, or object in the input photo, accurately maintaining the subject's identity, pose, quantity, composition, and key accessories; the bottom or adjacent area performs a minimalist form translation on warm rice-white paper, retaining large areas of continuous white space. Extract the subject's outer contour, as well as the eyes, nose/mouth, ears, joints, contour transitions, or object structures, and deconstruct them into 3–8 groups of spaced horizontal parallel lines and a small number of horizontal arcs. The lines curve slightly according to the form, with staggered lengths, partial breaks, or misalignments, forming a recognizable head, torso, limbs, and key accessories; the rice-white background must be visible between the lines, and they cannot be filled as solid color blocks. Use one dark main line and a maximum of two low-saturation auxiliary color lines extracted from the original photo, colors are not fixed. Line ends can have slight hand-drawn unevenness, paper ink absorption, and pen pressure variations, but the overall style maintains the restraint of a flat design research manuscript. The photo area and the conversion area can establish a layout through wide white space, short specimen numbers, or accurate subject names. No large colored blocks, ordinary two-color posters, automatic tracing, complex cartoons, uniform horizontal lines across the page, logos, watermarks, fake Chinese, or corner marks.

prompts.text:
Create a vertical minimalist mosaic art poster inspired by the reference images. Combine a realistic photograph in the top half with a creative pixel-mosaic artwork in the bottom half, using the same main subject and matching colors.

Top section: A cozy vintage coffee shop interior with a rustic wooden counter, dark textured walls, warm ambient lighting, shelves filled with ceramic mugs and collectibles, retro coffee posters, a glowing cursive neon “Coffee” sign, and a turquoise inspirational sign above it. Create a nostalgic café atmosphere with rich brown tones, teal accents, warm highlights, realistic textures, cinematic lighting and shallow depth of field.

Bottom section: On a clean, warm ivory textured paper background, recreate the main café scene as an artistic mosaic made of hundreds of tiny square tiles. Arrange the tiles to form the recognizable coffee sign, turquoise quote board, retro posters, mugs and dark wooden wall. Use varying shades of brown, cream, teal, orange and muted blue. Let a few small square tiles float outward around the mosaic, creating a dissolving pixel effect. Leave generous negative space around the artwork. Add a small elegant caption on the left: “Coffee is a quiet kind of magic.” Keep the design refined, balanced and modern.

Alternative subject: Apply the same technique to a bright red takeaway cup with the words “Hello Sweet Summer,” held against a sunny beach background with turquoise ocean waves, sparkling water and a pale blue sky. In the lower half, reconstruct the cup and beach colors using tiny square mosaic tiles, with scattered red, blue, beige and white pixels. Add delicate handwritten text on the side: “Same Sun, New Stories.”

Style: premium contemporary editorial poster, photorealistic top section, intricate square-tile mosaic below, minimalist cream background, sophisticated color harmony, realistic textures, clean composition, vertical 4:5 ratio, sharp details, no watermark.

根据参考图创作一张竖直的极简主义马赛克艺术海报。在上半部分结合一张写实照片，下半部分结合一种创造性的像素马赛克艺术作品，使用相同的主体和匹配的颜色。

顶部部分：一个舒适的复古咖啡馆内部，配有质朴的木制柜台、深色纹理墙壁、温暖的环境照明、摆满陶瓷杯和收藏品的架子、复古咖啡海报、发光的草书霓虹灯“Coffee”标志，以及上方的一个绿松石色励志标志。营造一种怀旧的咖啡馆氛围，具有浓郁的棕色调、青绿色调、温暖的高光、写实的纹理、电影感的光效和浅景深。

底部部分：在干净、温暖的象牙色纹理纸背景上，将主要的咖啡馆场景重现为由数百个微小方块瓷砖组成的艺术马赛克。排列瓷砖以形成可辨认的咖啡标志、绿松石色引言板、复古海报、杯子和深色木墙。使用不同深浅的棕色、奶油色、青绿色、橙色 and 柔和的蓝色。让一些小方块瓷砖在马赛克周围向外漂浮，创造出一种消解的像素效果。在作品周围留出大量的负空间。左侧添加一段简短优雅的字幕：“Coffee is a quiet kind of magic.” 保持设计精致、平衡且现代。

替代主体：将相同的技术应用于一个印有“Hello Sweet Summer”字样的亮红色外带杯，背景是阳光明媚的海滩，带有绿松石色的海浪、闪闪发光的水面和淡蓝色的天空。在下半部分，使用微小的正方形马赛克瓷砖重构杯子和海滩的颜色，带有散落的红色、蓝色、米色和白色像素。侧面添加精致的手写文本：“Same Sun, New Stories.”

风格：高端当代社论海报，上半部分为写实摄影，下方为复杂的正方形瓷砖马赛克，极简主义奶油色背景，精致的色彩和谐，写实的纹理，干净的构图，竖向4:5比例，锐利的细节，无水印。

items.title: 午后泳池回眸的粉衣女性

prompts.text:
Theme:
A glance back in the pool in the afternoon

Main Subject:
An adult woman in her 20s. Kneeling on a light beige bench, body turned to the right and leaning forward. Showing the back and close-up waist to the camera, looking back with only the face from behind the right shoulder.

Person · Expression:
Short and pointed chin, small oval face, large brown eyes, slender and light-colored eyebrows, small nose. Rose pink lips slightly parted, gazing at the camera. Bright brown long hair flowing backward in waves, retaining thin bangs and fine hair strands around the face. Bright peach-pink skin. Retaining a faint blush on the cheeks, as well as soft reflections on the shoulders and back, with calm light and shadow contrast on the face.

Clothing · Pose:
Light pink-beige fine floral pattern camisole cropped top. Deep slit in the back, tied with a thin string at the nape. Long strings under the armpits pull out pleats, forming a high slit. Both arms extended forward and downward to the right, both palms supporting the cushion. Both knees kneeling on the seat surface, lower legs folded toward the back left, toes partially cropped at the edge.

Background · Lighting:
The foreground is a beige thick cushion. On the left are stone edges of different heights and a blue pool, behind are wooden pillars, stone walls, and green potted plants. On the wooden table in the back right, a white towel and a glass are rolled up. Sunlight from the back left brightens the hairline and back, with soft reflected light on the face. Distinguish warm highlights from light pink skin.

Composition · Camera:
Photographed from a close rear-diagonal side, from a perspective slightly looking down at the seat. The waist and knees are close and large, with the head at the top rear. Vertical 3:4 ratio. Leave a little space at the top of the head, with the body occupying most of the space. Hands are near the right edge, and the folded legs are partially cropped at the bottom and left edges. The pool appears as a strip on the left.

Texture · Style:
Soft and warm photo style. Retain the fine patterns and pleats of the clothes, the smooth layering of the skin, and the tiny light spots on the water surface.

prompts.text:
主题：
午后泳池中的回眸

主体：
20多岁的成年女性。跪在浅米色的长椅上，身体向右转并向前倾斜。面向相机展示背部和靠近的腰部，仅将脸从右肩后方回望。

人物・表情：
短小而尖细的下巴，呈小卵形脸庞，大而棕色的眼睛，细长而浅色的眉毛，小巧的鼻子。玫瑰粉色的嘴唇微微张开，注视着相机。明亮的茶色长发呈波浪状向后流淌，保留薄薄的刘海和脸部周围的细发束。明亮的桃粉色肌肤。保留脸颊上淡淡的红晕，以及肩部和背部的柔和反光，脸部呈现平静的明暗对比。

服装・姿势：
浅粉米色的细花纹样式的吊带短款罩衫。背部深开叉，后颈处以细绳系结。腋下长绳拉出褶皱，形成高开叉。双臂向前下方右侧伸展，两只手掌支撑着靠垫。双膝跪在座面上，小腿向左下方后方折叠，脚尖在边缘处部分被裁切。

背景・光线：
前景是米色的厚靠垫。左侧是高度不同的石沿和蓝色泳池，后方是木柱、石墙和绿色的盆栽。右后方的木桌上卷起白色毛巾和玻璃杯。左后方的阳光使发际和背部明亮起来，脸部带有柔和的反射光。将暖色高光与浅粉色肌肤区分开来。

构图・相机：
从靠近的后方斜侧面拍摄，从略微俯视座面的视角。腰部和膝盖靠近且较大，头部在上方后方。纵向3:4比例。头顶稍留空白，身体占据大部分空间。双手靠近右边缘，折叠的腿在下边缘和左边缘部分被裁切。泳池作为左侧的带状呈现。

质感・风格：
柔和温暖的照片风格。保留衣服细小的纹样和褶皱，肌肤平滑的层次感，以及水面上的微小光点。

items.title: 超写实户外花园长发绿裙侧坐东亚女性

prompts.text:
Ultra-realistic outdoor garden portrait photography, vertical aspect ratio approximately 9:16. A clearly adult East Asian female, 25+, sitting sideways on a thick horizontal log / tree trunk on the courtyard grass, body leaning slightly back, legs together and extending diagonally toward the bottom right of the frame. Camera position is directly in front of the subject, slightly to the left, approximately 35–50mm lens medium-distance shot, completely preserving the subject, legs, log, grass, and the calf on the right.

The subject has a slender and long build, a cinched waist, and well-proportioned thighs. Long jet-black ultra-long straight hair, length reaching near the waist, center-parted, hair strands naturally draped over the chest and back. Fair skin tone, light makeup, gaze directed toward the left side of the frame, with a quiet expression.

The upper body wears a bright fluorescent green short slim-fit top, layered with a light and thin wide-sleeve blouse of the same color; the lower body wears a bright green short printed / paisley mini skirt.

The legs wear very striking grey-green snake-pattern / diamond-textured ultra-thin transparent pantyhose, with patterns extending from the thighs all the way to the toes, skin-tight, slightly silky. No shoes on the feet, the pantyhose completely cover both feet.

Pose highlights: The subject's left hand is propped on the thick tree trunk behind her, upper body leaning slightly back; legs completely together extending toward the right side of the frame, knees basically straight, toes naturally extended, forming a long-legged diagonal line.

The scene is a real private garden / courtyard, with a large area of fresh green lawn, background with tall pine trees, shrubs, bamboo forests, outdoor tables, chairs, and recliners. To the right of the subject is a black and white patterned calf / young cow bowing its head to graze on the grass. The foreground and the area under the subject retain rough tree trunks, stumps, and a few stones.

Overcast natural light, high saturation in the green environment, overall style like a casual snapshot from a mobile phone or digital camera, background remains relatively clear.

Key points: Adult East Asian female, ultra-long black straight hair, fluorescent green top, green printed short skirt, grey-green snake-pattern transparent tights, barefoot, sitting sideways on a thick log, legs together and diagonally extended, calf, green courtyard.

Avoid: High heels, sneakers, black tights, solid color tights, long pants, standing posture, bent legs, indoor background, anime face, CG feel, extra limbs, watermark.

阴天自然光，绿色环境饱和度较高，整体像手机或数码相机随手拍，背景保持较清楚。

prompts.text:
A realistic vertical nighttime indoor direct-flash portrait, approximately 9:16. An adult woman, 25 or older, preserving the reference facial contours, feature proportions, and expression. Long, very dark brown hair with a loose side part falls down her back, with a few strands over her shoulder. Refined evening makeup: brown eyeshadow, winged eyeliner, full lashes, soft pink blush, and glossy nude-pink lips. Her head is slightly tilted, her lips gently parted, and she looks directly into the lens with a calm, confident, slightly reserved expression.

She wears a champagne-pink crushed velvet halter mini dress with narrow straps, a deep V neckline, exposed shoulders and collarbones, a fitted waist, side ruching, and thin hanging ties. The velvet catches the flash in irregular silvery-pink patches, retaining natural creases around the waist and skirt. Nude-pink pointed-toe stiletto pumps.

She kneels on a dark wooden floor, both knees grounded, lower legs folded backward, hips close to her heels. Her body faces a three-quarter side angle, torso leaning slightly forward, while her face turns toward the camera. Both hands rest naturally on her thighs near her knees, fingers relaxed and extended. Light skin with a neutral-to-warm pink undertone, subtle skin texture, natural joint color variation, and believable shading.

Place her in the lower middle of the composition, including her head, knees, and shoes, with generous curtain-filled space above. Heavy taupe-gray floor-length curtains frame a narrow, almost-black window gap with a few faint distant lights. Partial black furniture appears at the far right edge. Two warm pillar candles stand on the floor at the lower right, producing small reflections on the polished wood.

Photograph from slightly above the kneeling subject's face with a mild downward angle and an approximately 28–35mm equivalent lens feel. Near-camera frontal flash illuminates her face, shoulders, arms, and legs, making her distinctly brighter than the background. Keep soft dark shading along her sides; the candles contribute only faint low warm light. Moderate depth of field, clear subject, readable curtain folds, subtle shadow noise, natural flyaway hairs, and the believable texture of a casual evening photograph captured during a brief pause beside the window.

prompts.text: 一张写实的垂直夜间室内直闪人像，比例约为 9:16。一位 25 岁或以上的成年女性，保留参考的面部轮廓、五官比例和表情。蓬松侧分的深棕色长发垂在背后，几缕发丝落在肩上。精致的晚宴妆容：棕色眼影、翼状眼线、浓密的睫毛、柔和的粉色腮红和有光泽的裸粉色嘴唇。她的头微微倾斜，嘴唇微启，以冷静、自信且略显矜持的表情直视镜头。她穿着一件香槟粉色碎褶天鹅绒挂脖迷你连衣裙，配有细肩带、深 V 领、裸露的双肩和锁骨、收腰设计、侧边褶皱和细长的垂带。天鹅绒捕捉到闪光灯，呈现出不规则的银粉色光斑，保留了腰部和裙摆周围的自然褶皱。裸粉色尖头细高跟鞋。她跪在深色木地板上，双膝着地，小腿向后弯曲，臀部靠近脚跟。她的身体呈四分之三侧角，躯干略微前倾，脸转向相机。双手自然地放在膝盖附近的大腿上，手指放松并伸展。皮肤白皙，带有中性至暖粉色的底色，细腻的皮肤纹理，自然的关节颜色变化和真实的光影。将她置于构图的中下方，包括她的头部、膝盖和鞋子，上方留有充裕的窗帘空间。厚重的灰褐色落地窗帘勾勒出一个狭窄的、近乎黑色的窗户缝隙，远处有几点微弱的灯光。画面最右侧边缘出现了部分黑色家具。两根温暖的柱状蜡烛立在右下角的地板上，在抛光的木头上产生微小的反射。从略高于跪姿主体脸部的位置拍摄，带有轻微的俯角，具有约 28–35mm 等效镜头的质感。靠近相机的正面闪光灯照亮了她的脸部、肩膀、手臂和腿部，使她明显比背景更亮。身体两侧保持柔和的暗部阴影；蜡烛仅贡献微弱的低暖光。适中的景深，主体清晰，窗帘褶皱可见，细微的阴影噪点，自然的碎发，以及在窗边短暂休息时拍摄的随性晚间照片的真实质感。

items.title: 第二世界超现实写实摄影拼贴

prompts.text:
Create a premium 3:4 vertical “SECOND WORLD” conceptual surreal photo-collage artwork for [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT].

TEXT-TO-IMAGE ONLY.
Generate the entire composition creatively from the written subject alone. Do not request, upload, use, or depend on any reference image or existing photograph. Automatically invent an original scene with authentic photographic realism and a surprising visual concept.

CORE CONCEPT:
Create one imaginative “Second World” in which a realistic photographic scene naturally transforms into a delicate, surreal paper-collage world. Discover one unexpected, poetic visual idea inspired by the subject. Make every composition original rather than following a fixed template.

COMPOSITION:
Divide the vertical canvas into two connected visual zones.

UPPER 50% — PHOTOGRAPHIC REALITY:
Create a believable, high-quality photographic scene inspired by [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT]. Preserve realistic lighting, natural colors, authentic textures, accurate perspective, and atmospheric depth. The scene should feel like a genuine photograph, not a digital painting.

LOWER 50% — THE SECOND WORLD:
Continue the upper scene onto soft ivory paper. Allow one identifiable element from the photographic scene to cross the center boundary and transform into something unexpected, playful, and visually poetic. The transition must feel physically connected, as though the second world is growing directly out of reality.

CREATIVE TRANSFORMATION:
Invent ONE distinctive surreal transformation that makes sense within the scene. Explore imaginative relationships between objects, nature, architecture, materials, scale, and physical space. Let the subject determine the concept naturally.

Avoid predictable fantasy structures, repetitive compositions, elaborate architecture, and unnecessary decorative elements. Favor one clever visual idea over multiple competing concepts.

HUMAN & BLACK CAT:
Include ONE tiny, clearly recognizable black cat and ONE small, delicately illustrated human figure within the lower world. Give them a meaningful interaction, expressive gesture, or subtle narrative connection to the main transformation. Their poses and relationship should emerge naturally from the scene.

Keep both characters small, charming, and secondary to the central concept. Use thin black-ink outlines with simple, elegant details.

ART DIRECTION:
Contemporary surreal editorial collage, authentic photographic realism, handmade paper textures, delicate ink illustration

仅根据所写的主体创造性地生成整个构图。不要请求、上传、使用或依赖任何参考图像或现有照片。自动发明一个具有真实摄影现实感和令人惊喜的视觉概念的原创场景。

核心概念：
创造一个富有想象力的“第二世界”，其中真实的摄影场景自然地转化为一个精致、超现实的纸质拼贴世界。从主体中发现一个出人意料的、富有诗意的视觉创意。让每个构图都是原创的，而不是遵循固定的模板。

构图：
将垂直画布分为两个相连的视觉区域。

上半部分 50% — 摄影现实：
创作一个受[国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主体]启发的、可信的高质量摄影场景。保留真实的照明、自然的色彩、真实的纹理、准确的透视和大气深度。场景应该感觉像是一张真实的摄影照片，而不是数字绘画。

下半部分 50% — 第二世界：
在柔软的象牙色纸上延续上半部分的场景。允许摄影场景中一个可识别的元素跨越中心边界，并转化为意想不到的、有趣的且具有视觉诗意的东西。这种过渡必须在物理上感到连接，仿佛第二世界是直接从现实中生长出来的。

创意转化：
发明一种在场景中具有意义的独特超现实转化。探索物体、自然、建筑、材料、比例和物理空间之间富有想象力的关系。让主体自然地决定概念。

避免可预测的幻想结构、重复的构图、复杂的建筑和不必要的装饰元素。宁要一个聪明的视觉创意，也不要多个竞争的概念。

人物与黑猫：
在下层世界中加入一只微小、清晰可辨的黑猫和一个精细描绘的小人物形象。赋予他们有意义的互动、表现性的手势或与主要转化的微妙叙事联系。他们的姿势和关系应自然地从场景中显现。

保持两个角色微小、迷人，并次于核心概念。使用细黑色墨水轮廓和简单、优雅的细节。

艺术指导：

prompts.text:
Create a premium 4:5 vertical autumn travel-journal artwork for [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT].

TEXT-TO-IMAGE ONLY — generate every element from the written destination or subject alone. Do not request, upload, use, or depend on any reference image, existing photograph, or source image.

MASTER STYLE LOCK:
Hand-painted autumn watercolor on warm ivory paper, minimalist travel-editorial illustration, transparent watercolor washes mixed with soft gouache, delicate imperfect ink outlines, visible paper grain, natural pigment blooms, soft edges, muted autumn colors, generous negative space, warm nostalgic atmosphere, premium handcrafted art-book aesthetic.

COMPOSITION:
Divide the vertical canvas into two equal halves using a precise 50/50 left-right split.

LEFT HALF — REALISTIC DESTINATION:
Generate an original, natural-looking photograph-style scene of [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT]. Automatically determine its recognizable architecture, scenery, atmosphere, and natural lighting. Preserve realistic textures, authentic colors, and believable perspective. Keep this entire half clean, with no text, labels, illustrations, borders, or decorative elements.

RIGHT HALF — AUTUMN WATERCOLOR JOURNAL:
Reimagine the same destination as a delicate, handmade autumn watercolor illustration. Use simplified rounded architecture, warm glowing windows, a small tree with dusty rose, apricot, and amber foliage, a few drifting leaves, and subtle watercolor clouds. Include only a few meaningful local details, keeping the composition airy and uncluttered.

COLOR PALETTE:
Caramel brown, dusty rose, apricot orange, creamy yellow, muted maple red, warm ivory, and faint lavender-grey shadows. Use soft, low-saturation afternoon light. No neon colors or harsh black.

HANDMADE DETAILS:
Add one or two narrow kraft-brown or dusty-pink washi tape strips, a small pressed autumn leaf, and a few delicate hand-drawn stars or arrows. Integrate these details naturally without overcrowding the illustration.

DESTINATION LABEL:
Place a small cream-colored paper label near the upper-left corner of the RIGHT HALF.

Main title: [LOCATION NAME]
Subtitle: [ENGLISH LOCATION NAME]

Use rounded, handwritten Japanese-inspired lettering for the main title and smaller, widely spaced handwritten English lettering for the subtitle. Keep spelling accurate and typography legible.

SIGNATURE LABEL:
Near the bottom-right corner of the RIGHT HALF, add a small kraft-paper label with exactly this text:

RYOBIYORI
No. [NUMBER] / [YEAR]

Use subtle, fine dark-brown lettering.

STRICT LAYOUT RULES:
All text, labels, washi tape, and decorative elements must remain entirely within the right half. The left half must contain only the original generated realistic destination scene. Never reproduce or modify an existing photograph.

PAPER & FINISH:
Warm ivory watercolor-paper texture, delicate fibers, subtle grain, organic pigment edges, and a carefully assembled travel-journal feeling.

FINAL AESTHETIC:
Realistic destination imagery × autumn watercolor illustration × handmade travel journal × nostalgic seasonal palette × premium editorial design.

AVOID:
Reference-image requests, image-editing instructions, existing-photo preservation, unequal panel widths, text crossing the center divider, excessive decoration, oversaturated colors, glossy digital painting, 3D rendering, misspelled text, extra logos, watermarks, and interface elements.

OUTPUT:
4:5 vertical portrait, exact 50/50 left-right composition, realistic generated destination scene on the left, watercolor travel-journal illustration on the right, ultra-high definition.

prompts.text:
为 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主题] 创作一个优质的 4:5 垂直秋季旅行手帐艺术品。

仅限文本转图像 —— 仅根据书面的目的地或主题生成每个元素。不要请求、上传、使用或依赖任何参考图像、现有照片或来源图像。

大师风格锁定：
暖象牙色纸上的手绘秋季水彩，极简旅行社论插画，透明水彩洗涤色调混合柔和的水粉，精致不完美的墨水轮廓，可见的纸张纹理，自然颜料晕染，柔和边缘，柔和的秋色，大量的留白，温暖怀旧的氛围，优质手工艺术书美学。

构图：
使用精确的 50/50 左右分割将垂直画布分成相等的两半。

左半部分 —— 真实的目的地：
生成一张 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主题] 的原创、自然的摄影风格场景。自动确定其具有辨识度的建筑、风景、氛围和自然光线。保持真实的纹理、真实的色彩和可信的透视。保持整个这一半简洁，没有文字、标签、插图、边框或装饰元素。

右半部分 —— 秋季水彩手帐：
将同一目的地重新构思为精致、手工制作的秋季水彩插画。使用简化的圆形建筑、温暖的发光窗户、一棵带着灰粉色、杏色和琥珀色叶子的小树、几片漂浮的落叶以及微妙的水彩云。仅包含几个有意义的当地细节，保持构图轻盈且不凌乱。

调色板：
焦糖棕、灰粉色、杏橘色、奶油黄、柔和的枫叶红、暖象牙色以及浅淡的薰衣草灰阴影。使用柔和、低饱和度的午后光线。不要霓虹色或刺眼的黑色。

手工细节：
添加一两张窄窄的牛皮棕色或灰粉色和纸胶带条、一片小小的压制秋叶以及几颗精致的手绘星星或箭头。自然地融入这些细节，不要让插画显得过于拥挤。

目的地标签：

主标题：[地点名称]
副标题：[英文地点名称]

签名标签：
在右半部分的右下角附近，添加一个小的牛皮纸标签，上面确切写着以下文本：

RYOBIYORI
No. [数字] / [年份]

使用微妙、精细的深褐色字体。

严格的布局规则：
所有文本、标签、和纸胶带和装饰元素必须完全保留在右半部分。左半部分必须仅包含原始生成的真实目的地场景。切勿复制或修改现有的照片。

纸张与饰面：
暖象牙色水彩纸纹理，精细纤维，微妙颗粒，有机颜料边缘，以及精心组装的旅行手帐感。

最终美学：
真实的地点图像 × 秋季水彩插画 × 手工旅行手帐 × 怀旧季节性色调 × 优质社论设计。

避免：
参考图像请求、图像编辑指令、保留现有照片、面板宽度不相等、文字跨越中心分隔线、过度装饰、过度饱和的颜色、油亮的数字绘画、3D 渲染、拼写错误的文本、额外的标志、水印和界面元素。

输出：
4:5 垂直人像，精确的 50/50 左右构图，左侧为生成的真实目的地场景，右侧为水彩旅行手帐插画，超高清。

The overall body maintains a doll-like slender proportion: head slightly large, narrow shoulders, short neck, slender torso, thin and long limbs. Clothing is autonomously designed by the model as animal or fantasy beast-themed plush mascot fashion. Ears, tails, graphics on the chest, sleeve covers, gloves, round-toe shoes, local facial graphics, and material splicing vary freely. Materials are mainly plush, lamb wool, fleece, knit, and soft foam, with simple silhouettes and fluffy touch. The subject consists of 2–4 main color blocks, with high-saturation accent colors added locally.

Actions and expressions are randomly designed, can be expanded from directions such as leaning forward, leaning in, tilting head, looking back, twisting, tiptoeing, raising hands, opening arms, reaching out, stepping, half-squatting, bending over, lifting one foot, or jumping slightly, and creating new action combinations. Actions have clear tension, retaining a doll-like stiffness, imbalance, and uncoordinated sense of humor. Expressions vary between innocent, cold, dazed, slight surprise, dullness, and clumsy seriousness.

Camera lens and composition are autonomously designed by the model based on actions. Shot sizes can be full body, medium-close shot, or close-up full body; camera positions can be eye-level, slight low angle, close-up slight wide-angle, or natural studio shooting perspective. Character position, body orientation, perspective, cropping, and negative space change with actions, with action directions and frame space echoing each other, clearly presenting slender proportions and clothing silhouettes.

Backgrounds use pure white, light gray, low-saturation solid colors, or simple studio color fields. Lighting is clean and soft, emphasizing plush materials, character outlines, and poses. The overall look combines visual characteristics of character setting sheets and performative fashion photography.

When generating in batches, autonomously vary the animal theme, clothing structure, color matching, actions, expressions, body orientation, shot size, camera position, and composition for each image, while maintaining consistent body proportions and visual tone.

【主体】，成年人真人化，怪萌吉祥物时装 × 毛绒潮玩角色 × 暗黑童趣 editorial 摄影。

主体为成年真人模特，脸部保持清楚的人类结构，带轻微吉祥物化处理。整体保持玩偶式瘦长比例：头部略大、肩窄、脖子短、躯干细长、四肢纤细修长。不同动作中始终保留木讷、僵直、笨拙的人形玩偶感。

服装由模型自主设计为动物或幻想小兽主题的毛绒 mascot fashion。耳朵、尾巴、胸前图形、袖套、手套、圆头鞋、局部脸部图形与材质拼接自由变化。材质以毛绒、羊羔绒、抓绒、针织、软泡棉为主，轮廓简洁，触感蓬松。主体由 2–4 个主色色块构成，局部加入高饱和跳色。

动作与表情随机设计，可从前倾、探身、歪头、回头、扭转、踮脚、抬手、张开双臂、伸手、迈步、半蹲、俯身、单脚抬起或轻微跳起等方向展开，并创造新的动作组合。动作具有明确张力，保留玩偶式僵硬、失衡与不协调的幽默感。表情在无辜、冷淡、发愣、轻微惊讶、呆滞、笨拙认真之间变化。

镜头与构图由模型根据动作自主设计，景别可为全身、近中景或近距离全身；机位可为平视、轻微低机位、近距离轻广角或自然棚拍视角。人物位置、身体朝向、透视、裁切与留白随动作变化，动作方向与画面空间相互呼应，清楚呈现细长比例和服装轮廓。

背景采用纯白、浅灰、低饱和纯色或简洁棚拍色场。光线干净柔和，强调毛绒材质、人物轮廓与姿态。整体兼具角色设定图与表演性时装摄影的视觉特点。

批量生成时，每张自主变化动物主题、服装结构、配色、动作、表情、身体朝向、景别、机位与构图，保持统一的身体比例与视觉基调。

items.title: 秋日银杏林宋代贵族女子电影感肖像

prompts.text:
A vertical 2:3 cinematic style portrait depicting a young noblewoman in an autumn ginkgo forest with falling leaves, blending traditional Chinese painting style with fashion editorial photography.

Scene:
She stands in an ancient ginkgo grove, golden leaves falling around her. The trees form a natural cathedral—trunks fading into mist, canopies filtering soft light. The ground is carpeted with golden and amber fallen leaves. She wears layered Song Dynasty style robes in soft ivory silk, one hand reaching up, attempting to catch a falling leaf.

Lighting:
Late afternoon sunlight filters down through the golden canopy from the top left, casting dappled Rembrandt lighting—one cheek glows in the amber light, while the other is shrouded in soft shadow. A cool blue-grey mist fills the background, creating a warm-cool temperature contrast. Soft volumetric light penetrates the trees. No harsh highlights, no neon, no glowing effects.

Palette (3 colors):
- Warm Golden (ginkgo leaves, sunlight, metal accessories)
- Soft Ivory (silk robes, mist)
- Cool Blue-Grey (background mist, distant trees)
Only use desaturated mineral pigment tones, as if viewed through aged silk gauze.

Clothing and Accessories:
Layered Song Dynasty style robes in soft ivory silk, decorated with exquisite ginkgo leaf embroidery. A thin silk sash hangs from her shoulders. At her waist: a jade pendant with silk tassels and an embroidered sachet.

Hairstyle and Accessories:
Hair is in a Song Dynasty double-ring bun, secured with the following ornaments:
- A gold hairpin shaped like a ginkgo leaf with hanging pearl strands
- A flower comb decorated with golden and ivory chrysanthemum patterns
- A forehead ornament (huadian)—a gold-leaf ginkgo shape between the eyebrows

Hands:
A thin gold bracelet on one wrist, catching the dappled light. A simple jade ring on the right hand. Expression is calm and aloof, gazing up at the falling leaf.

Composition:
The figure occupies 50% (waist up to head), while the environment dominates through layers of depth. Foreground: falling leaves slightly out of focus. Midground: her figure and the nearest trees. Background: receding trunks fading into mist. Generous white space (tian-tou) at the top, following a scroll format.

Atmosphere:
Serene, contemplative, peaceful solitude. A noblewoman pausing in nature's golden hour, allowing for a moment of stillness. Tranquil, not melancholic.

Style:
Traditional Chinese painting × Cinematic Rembrandt lighting × Fashion photography editorial style × Song Dynasty minimalism × Film grain (35mm). Not anime, not chibi, not fantasy RPG, not surrealism.

Smoothness Control:
The overall image must be clean, smooth, and unified. No jagged edges. Emphasize large-block color storytelling and overall silhouettes. No subtle noise, no high-frequency textures, no dirty grain, no dense small decorations. Edges should be clean and sharp, surfaces pure and flawless, with strong visual breathing space. The composition must be clearly legible at a glance.

prompts.text:
一幅竖幅2:3电影风格肖像，描绘一位年轻贵族女子身处秋日银杏林中，落叶飘零，以传统中国画风融合时尚摄影编辑风格。

场景：
她站在古老的银杏树林中，金黄的树叶在她周围飘落。树木形成一座天然的大教堂——树干隐没于薄雾之中，树冠过滤着柔和的光线。地面铺满金色与琥珀色的落叶。她身穿层层叠叠的宋代风格长袍，采用柔和的象牙色丝绸，一只手向上伸展，试图捕捉一片飘落的叶子。

光线：
午后晚些时候的阳光从左上方透过金黄的树冠洒下，投射出斑驳的伦勃朗式光影——一侧脸颊在琥珀色光芒中熠熠生辉，另一侧则笼罩在柔和的阴影中。凉爽的蓝灰色薄雾充盈背景，营造出暖凉色温对比。柔和的体积光线穿透树木。没有刺眼的亮点，没有霓虹，没有发光效果。

调色板（3种颜色）：
- 暖金色（银杏叶、阳光、金属饰品）
- 柔和象牙色（丝绸长袍、薄雾）
- 冷蓝灰色（背景薄雾、远方树木）
仅使用脱饱和度的矿物颜料色调，仿佛透过陈旧的丝纱观看。

服饰与配饰：
层层叠叠的宋代风格长袍，采用柔和的象牙色丝绸，饰以精致的银杏叶刺绣。细丝披帛从肩部垂下。腰间佩戴：丝穗玉佩，以及绣花香囊。

发型与饰品：
发髻为宋代双环髻，用以下饰物固定：
- 金簪，形似银杏叶，垂挂珍珠珠串
- 花梳，饰以金色与象牙色的菊花图案
- 额饰花钿——眉间金箔银杏叶形状

双手：
一侧手腕佩戴细金镯，捕捉斑驳光影。右手戴一枚简约玉戒。表情平静而疏离，抬头凝视飘落的叶子。

构图：
人物占据50%（腰部以上至头部），环境通过层层深度占据主导。前景：飘落的叶子略微失焦。中景：她的身影与最近的树木。背景：渐远的树干隐没于薄雾中。顶部留有宽裕的空白（天头），采用卷轴格式。

氛围：
宁静、沉思、平和的独处。贵族女子在自然的黄金时段中驻足，允许一刻的静止。宁和，而非忧郁。

风格：
传统中国画 × 电影化的伦勃朗光影 × 时尚摄影编辑风格 × 宋代极简主义 × 胶片颗粒（35mm）。非动漫，非Q版，非奇幻RPG，非超现实主义。

平滑度控制：
整体图像必须干净、平滑且统一。严禁锯齿边缘。强调大色块叙事与整体轮廓。无细微噪点，无高频纹理，无脏污颗粒，无密集小装饰。边缘应干净锐利，表面纯净无瑕，具有强烈的视觉呼吸空间。构图必须一眼即可清晰易读。

prompts.text:
Pink Cardigan & White Cargo Pants
Create an ultra-realistic, high-resolution, professional female character reference sheet inspired by the provided reference image. Use the same young adult woman with a delicate heart-shaped face, fair smooth skin, large expressive dark brown eyes, naturally rosy cheeks, soft pink lips, and long dark brown hair styled in a messy high bun with wispy bangs and loose face-framing strands. Preserve her facial identity, hairstyle, slim body proportions, and gentle, cheerful personality consistently across every panel.
Outfit Design: Dress the woman in a beautiful oversized pastel pink knitted cardigan with long, loose sleeves and visible knitted texture. Underneath, she wears a simple white camisole top with a delicate lace neckline. Pair it with loose-fitting white cargo pants featuring side pockets and a relaxed, comfortable fit. Add clean white sneakers and a delicate silver necklace with a small pendant. Keep the outfit modest, fashionable, soft, and coordinated.
1. Character Profile: Create a large portrait of the woman wearing the pink cardigan and white top, smiling gently with her chin resting on one hand. Include character details, personality, hairstyle, facial features, and a coordinated pastel color palette.
2. Full-Body Turnaround: Show the same woman in four full-body views: front view, three-quarter view, side view, and back view. Keep her face, hairstyle, cardigan, white cargo pants, sneakers, and body proportions consistent in every view.
3. Face and Identity Details: Include three close-up portraits showing her face from the front, side profile, and three-quarter angle. Maintain consistent facial features, natural makeup, expressive eyes, and soft pink lips.
4. Expression Sheet: Create ten facial expressions: neutral, happy, smiling, playful, sad, surprised, thoughtful, confident, worried, and calm. Keep the same face and hairstyle in every portrait.
5. Pose and Body Language: Show six full-body poses: standing naturally, walking, sitting casually on a cube, relaxed standing, arms crossed, and looking back over her shoulder. Preserve the complete outfit and consistent character proportions.
6. Costume Details: Include close-up reference images of the cardigan neckline, knitted sleeves, cargo-pant waistband and pockets, cardigan stitching, necklace, earrings, and white sneakers.
7. Color and Material Palette: Display coordinated pastel pink, blush pink, ivory, cream, white, and muted mauve color swatches. Add realistic fabric samples showing knitted wool, cotton, lace, stitching, and sneaker material.
Overall Style: Professional fashion-design character sheet, clean white background, thin gray panel borders, organized editorial grid, realistic studio photography, soft natural lighting, sharp details, consistent character identity, and high-quality fashion catalog presentation. Keep all seven sections arranged neatly on one large vertical poster.

prompts.text:
3:4 vertical orientation, realistic mobile phone close-up photography, a candid photo taken during the painting process of a garage kit model. The main subject is an adult female proportion resin figure model, only capturing the area from below the waist and hips to the feet, with the upper body completely outside the frame. 

The model's clothing is changed to a lower-body version of Bayonetta's classic look. The waist and hips connect to the lower part of the classic black tight-fitting battle suit, featuring an extremely tight-fitting integrated black jumpsuit structure with smooth and sharp contours, closely fitting the waist, hips, and upper thighs, clearly presenting the character's signature cold, powerful, and supermodel-like long leg proportions. The clothing surface is a high-end black elastic glossy material with subtle and restrained reflections, partially embellished with exquisite silver decorative lines and small metallic structures, forming elegant and complex contour changes on both sides of the hips, with overall high recognition of the classic Bayonetta look. 

The legs wear a black tight-fitting leg structure that connects seamlessly with the main battle suit, showing a fine garage kit spray-painting effect. The legs appear extremely long visually, forming a smooth and complete black silhouette from the thigh to the calf, with a smooth and delicate surface material featuring a premium texture that combines slightly shiny black leather and elastic fabric. The lines of the knees, calves, and ankles are clear and distinct, with sharp yet smooth light and shadow on the legs, fully displaying the visual tension of Bayonetta's signature long legs. 

The feet wear Bayonetta's classic signature black high-heeled gun shoes. The shoe shape is slender and exaggerated, primarily made of high-end black glossy material with exquisite and complex gold-carved structures and small areas of red detail accents, and the silhouette is highly decorative and mechanical. The high heels are clearly slender and long, and the shoe body structure carries a firearm-style design language, combining a sense of fashion and weaponry, serving as a crucial visual identification point for the character. The shoe upper, heel, and toe structures are complete, with sharp and distinct highlight reflections on the surface. 

The pose strictly follows the garage kit display posture: the left leg extends naturally downward, forming the main vertical line through the frame; the other leg slants out to the lower left from the thigh, with the knee clearly bent about ninety degrees, the calf folding horizontally backward to the right side of the frame, and the right high-heeled gun shoe suspended facing right, creating a clear crossing relationship between the legs near the knees. The black tight-fitting battle suit and the exaggerated, exquisite high-heeled gun shoes together reinforce Bayonetta's signature strong sense of female power and ultra-long leg proportions. 

A real adult's left hand enters from the bottom left corner of the frame, with the palm occupying about one-third of the bottom left, the thumb and index finger naturally pinching the lower section of the straight leg's calf to stabilize the model being painted. The hand size is significantly larger than the figure's leg, creating a realistic miniature scale contrast. The skin texture, fingernails, and joint wrinkles of the hand are clear and natural. 

The camera distance is very close, shot with a mobile phone's main camera at close range, a slight high-angle view, with the lens center aimed at the leg crossing and knee area. The model's legs, black tight-fitting battle suit details, silver decorative lines, high-heeled gun shoes, and the palm are clear and sharp, with a natural shallow depth of field in the background. 

The background is a real garage kit model painting workbench with a light gray fine-grained texture desktop. Several large translucent plastic model supply bottles are placed vertically on the left side of the frame, with white bottle bodies and yellow and blue industrial labels; a transparent square pointed-nozzle dispensing bottle is placed in the center-right position with the long white conical nozzle pointing up; a translucent round bottle containing dark gray paint is placed in the bottom right area, with a white screw cap that has a small amount of black pigment traces on top, and parts of other white model supply containers are also visible nearby. All bottles and jars are in a state of actual use, placed naturally and casually. 

Indoor cool white overhead light combined with mobile phone close-up fill light, the hand skin tone is slightly warm, the figure is overall dominated by deep black, with clear layers formed through glossy reflections, silver decorations, and gold shoe structures. The light is even and direct, creating realistic desktop reflections, plastic bottle highlights, strong bright spots on the shoes, smooth shadows on the legs, and sharp highlights on parts of the clothing. 

Overall presentation has the feel of a casual record by a real iPhone, with slight wide-angle perspective, real macro proportions, clear details, shallow depth of field, real resin figure material, fine character clothing spray-painting, classic Bayonetta style lower body design, the black tight-fitting battle suit and signature high-heeled gun shoes forming extremely strong character identification, an everyday model studio environment, and a natural snapshot quality without commercial lighting.

3:4 竖版，真实手机近距离摄影，一张手办涂装过程中的随手实拍照片。画面主体是一款成年女性比例树脂手办模型，只拍摄腰臀以下至双脚区域，人物上半身完全位于画面之外。

模型服装改为 Bayonetta 经典造型的下半身版本。腰臀位置连接经典黑色紧身战斗装下半部分，整体为极贴身的一体化黑色连体结构，轮廓流畅利落，紧密贴合腰胯与大腿根部，清晰呈现角色标志性的冷艳、强势与超模般长腿比例。服装表面为高级黑色弹性亮面材质，带有细腻而克制的反光，局部点缀精致的银色装饰纹线与小型金属感结构，在胯部两侧形成优雅复杂的轮廓变化，整体极具经典 Bayonetta 造型辨识度。
