prompts.text:
Use the uploaded reference as the primary inspiration. Create a 4:5 vertical minimalist collectible art print representing [COUNTRY] through one continuous elegant line.

Draw a single uninterrupted hand-drawn line that begins as the recognizable silhouette or coastline of the country, then naturally transforms into 2–4 subtle elements of its identity — such as a famous landmark, mountain, river, traditional object, cultural symbol, or iconic food — all connected within the same flowing line.

The line should feel intentional, poetic, architectural, and slightly imperfect, like a refined museum sketch.

COMPOSITION:

One large continuous-line artwork centered on a warm ivory paper background. Huge negative space. No collage. No separate illustrations. No map filling the entire page.

STYLE:

Contemporary museum poster × Swiss minimalism × fine architectural drawing × Japanese restraint.

Thin charcoal/black ink line, subtle paper grain, delicate imperfections, tiny soft shadow, and one muted accent color used sparingly.

Add very small elegant typography beneath:

[COUNTRY]

ONE LINE / [CAPITAL] / [COORDINATES]

Optional tiny caption:

“A country, reduced to one line.”

IMPORTANT: The continuous line must remain the hero. Every symbolic element should emerge naturally from the same line rather than appearing as separate objects.

Avoid: photorealism, busy travel-poster aesthetics, multiple colors, excessive typography, obvious tourist clichés, detailed maps, borders, flags, collage, clutter.

Overall feeling: quiet, intelligent, artistic, luxurious, poetic, instantly recognizable, and suitable as a high-end collectible gallery print.

User-approved batch specification:
Text-directed new artwork, not reference editing: fill COUNTRY ITALY, CAPITAL ROME, COORDINATES 41.9028 N /12.4964 E. Boot outline transforms into one ancient arch and olive sprig in one continuousline. No separate symbols. Follow original restrained ivorypaper blackline style using textualdescription, no externalreference required.
No unrequested people, no male figures or male body parts. All human subjects clearly adults; no nudity or sexual activity.

一个大型连续线条艺术作品，居中于暖象牙色纸张背景上。巨大的负空间。无拼贴。无单独插图。地图不填满整个页面。

服装・姿势：

构图・镜头：

质感・风格：
脸部呈平滑的淡阶调，头发的细束和布料的编织清晰可见。将生成地、蓝色、绿色以自然的饱和度结合，保留水面上的小片白色光芒，呈现照片风格。

prompts.text:
Usage: Style Transfer
Asset Type: 3:4 vertical editing comparison poster
Input Image: A real photo to be processed, and it is the sole source of truth.
Create a vertical poster with a strict top-bottom comparison.
The upper half must preserve the input photo's clear, recognizable high-fidelity realistic photographic effect: subject identity, quantity, pose, shooting angle, architectural structure, landscape relationships, lighting, and main colors all remain consistent, with only slight print-grade color grading.
The lower half redraws the same scene as a warm beige paper page of a travel field journal; it cannot be just a filter, nor a generic travel illustration.
Use dark brown pencil and ink outlines with a slight jittery feel, uneven hand pressure, dry brush marks, a small amount of low-saturation watercolor and crayon coloring, paper fibers, erasure marks, and slight ink-bleeding effects.
Compress the scene into one main subject or landmark, plus one to two environmental anchors from the original photo's facts; simultaneously change the scale and information density so it is no longer a copy of the same crop and composition.
Allow the key subject or landmark to have a touch of restrained surreal cartoonishness—only when facial features or small hands and feet can naturally grow from their real shapes, add simple eyes, mouths, or small limbs.
Add 2–4 small hand-drawn icons; these icons must correspond to details actually visible in the original photo.
The lower half must maintain about 20%–35% continuous warm-colored paper white space around the edges.
Add a small handwritten title of 1–3 English words, the fixed field "FIELD NOTE", and a short observation sentence of 5–12 English words with a slight sense of rhyme on the paper; this sentence can only be written based on facts visible in the image.
These texts should look like they are written directly into the paper, not floating digital fonts.
Colors are extracted from the input photo and compressed into 2–5 low-saturation colors, plus 1 accent color from the original image; do not apply fixed travel color schemes.
The top-bottom boundary must be clean and horizontal.
Forbidden: Left-right layout, grids, multi-photo collages, "original/AI" labels, watermarks, logos, QR codes, fake Chinese, fictional landmarks, irrelevant people, changing characters' faces or poses, missing the original photo in the top half, making the entire image cartoonized, and redrawing the original photo with the same crop.

prompts.text:
用途： 风格转绘
资产类型： 3:4 竖版编辑对比海报
输入图像： 一张需要处理的真实照片，并且它是唯一事实来源。
制作一张严格上下对比的竖版海报。
上半部必须保留输入照片清晰、可辨认的高保真真实摄影效果：主体身份、数量、姿态、拍摄角度、建筑结构、景观关系、光线和主要色彩都保持一致，只做轻微的印刷级调色。
下半部则把同一场景重绘成一页暖米色纸面的旅行现场手账，不能只是滤镜，也不能是泛泛的旅行插画。
使用带轻微抖动感的黑褐色铅笔与墨水轮廓、不均匀的手部力度、干刷痕迹、少量低饱和水彩和蜡笔填色、纸张纤维、擦除痕迹和轻微洇墨效果。
将场景压缩为一个主要主体或地标，再加上一到两个来自原图事实的环境锚点；同时改变尺度与信息密度，使其不再是相同裁切和相同构图的照抄。
可以让关键主体或地标带一点克制的超现实卡通感——只有当五官或小手小脚能自然从其真实形状中长出来时，才加入简单的眼睛、嘴巴或小肢体。
再加入 2–4 个小型手绘图标，这些图标必须对应原照片中真实可见的细节。
下半部四周要保留约 20%–35% 的连续暖色纸面留白。
在纸面上加入一个 1–3 个英文单词的小手写标题、固定字段 “FIELD NOTE”，以及一句 5–12 个英文单词、略带一点押韵感的简短观察句，且这句话只能基于画面中可见事实来写。
这些文字应像是直接写进纸面里的，而不是悬浮的数字字体。
色彩从输入照片中提取，并压缩为 2–5 种低饱和颜色，再加 1 个来自原图的强调色；不要套用固定的旅行配色方案。
上下分界线必须干净、水平。
禁止： 左右布局、网格、多照片拼贴、“original/AI”标签、水印、logo、二维码、假中文、虚构地标、无关人物、改变人物脸部或姿势、缺失上半部分原照片、整张图全部卡通化、以及对原图进行同裁切重绘。

Mood: Quiet, isolated, composed and quietly powerful, a still moment inside a rushing world.

No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no color, no harsh flash, no plastic skin, no stamped cobblestone pattern, no flat dark hair cap, no extra fingers, no distorted features.

items.title: 手绘水彩极简旅行社论海报

prompts.text:
Create a premium 4:5 vertical travel-editorial artwork for [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT].

PURE GENERATION.
Invent the complete artwork from the written destination or subject alone. The written destination is the only input. Create every visual element from your own knowledge and imagination.

MASTER STYLE LOCK:
Hand-painted watercolor on warm cream textured paper. Minimalist travel-editorial poster. Transparent watercolor blended with soft gouache. Soft imperfect brushwork, visible paper grain, organic painted edges, muted natural colors, generous negative space, quiet nostalgic atmosphere, sophisticated handcrafted art-book quality. Flat illustrated artwork with painterly depth. No 3D rendering, no glossy finish, no cartoon style, no digital photorealism.

DESTINATION INTERPRETATION:
Automatically identify the strongest visual identity of [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT]. Select the most recognizable landmark, architecture, landscape, street character, transportation, vegetation, local objects, or cultural details that naturally belong to the destination.

Create ONE unified scene rather than a collection of separate elements.

COMPOSITION:
Use an elegant vertical editorial composition with one dominant focal point and several smaller supporting details. Establish clear foreground, middle ground, and background layers using watercolor washes and simplified shapes.

Leave generous warm cream space around important forms. Keep the silhouette clean and immediately recognizable. Avoid overcrowding.

LOCAL STORY:
Show an authentic everyday moment connected to the destination. Include subtle human activity only when it strengthens the story: walking, cycling, sitting, shopping, traveling, eating, working, or simply enjoying the surroundings.

Favor ordinary local atmosphere over generic tourism imagery.

LIGHT & ATMOSPHERE:
Automatically choose lighting that suits the destination and scene: soft morning light, warm afternoon glow, misty weather, gentle sunset, or quiet evening illumination.

Use atmospheric watercolor washes to create depth while maintaining a calm, delicate feeling.

COLOR LANGUAGE:
Build the palette naturally from [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT]. Use warm cream, muted ochre, terracotta, dusty blue, soft green, faded red, warm grey, and subtle golden tones where appropriate.

Keep the colors slightly desaturated, harmonious, and naturally layered.

TYPOGRAPHY:
At the bottom of the artwork, add three restrained editorial text elements:

[LOCATION NAME]
[SHORT DESTINATION-INSPIRED SUBTITLE]
[SHORT WARM POETIC SENTENCE]

Use elegant minimal typography with generous spacing. Keep it secondary to the artwork and ensure all wording is clean and correctly spelled.

FINAL AESTHETIC:
Premium handmade watercolor travel poster × contemporary editorial illustration × nostalgic travel memory × quiet everyday life × sophisticated art-book design.

The finished artwork should feel like a beautifully remembered place painted by hand: atmospheric, personal, refined, understated, and unmistakably connected to [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT].

AVOID:
Any editing workflow, source material, references, existing compositions, copied imagery, collage construction, unrelated landmarks, generic scenery, excessive detail, oversaturated colors, harsh outlines, glossy digital effects, CGI, 3D objects, cartoon characters, clutter, excessive typography, logos, watermarks, interface elements.

FORMAT:
4:5 vertical portrait composition, warm cream paper, handcrafted watercolor texture, generous negative space, premium print-quality finish.

prompts.text:
为 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主体] 创作一件优质的 4:5 垂直旅行社论艺术作品。

纯粹生成。
仅根据书面目的地或主体构思完整的艺术作品。书面目的地是唯一的输入。根据你自己的知识和想象力创造每一个视觉元素。

大师风格锁定：
暖乳白色纹理纸上的手绘水彩。极简旅行社论海报。透明水彩与柔和的水粉融合。柔和且不完美的笔触、可见的纸张纹理、有机的手绘边缘、柔和的自然色调、大面积的留白、宁静的怀旧氛围、精致的手工艺术书质感。具有绘画深度的平面插画艺术品。无 3D 渲染、无光泽饰面、无卡通风格、无数字写实摄影。

目的地解读：
自动识别 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主体] 最强烈的视觉标识。选择最具有辨识度的地标、建筑、景观、街道特征、交通工具、植被、当地物件或自然属于该目的地的文化细节。

创作一个统一的场景，而不是一组零散元素的集合。

构图：
使用优雅的垂直社论构图，具有一个主焦点和几个较小的辅助细节。利用水彩晕染和简化的形状建立清晰的前景、中景和背景层。

在重要形状周围留出充足的暖乳白色空间。保持轮廓简洁且易于识别。避免过度拥挤。

当地故事：
展示与目的地相关的真实日常瞬间。仅在增强故事感时加入细微的人物活动：行走、骑行、坐着、购物、旅行、进食、工作或仅仅是享受周围环境。

偏向普通的当地氛围，而非通俗的旅游意象。

光影与氛围：
自动选择适合目的地和场景的光影：柔和的晨光、温暖的午后光辉、薄雾天气、温柔的日落或宁静的傍晚照明。

使用极具氛围感的水彩晕染创造深度，同时保持平静、细腻的感觉。

色彩语言：
自然地根据 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主体] 构建调色板。在合适的地方使用暖乳白、柔和的赭石、红陶色、灰蓝色、柔和的绿色、褪色的红色、暖灰色和微妙的金调。

保持色彩略微降低饱和度、和谐且自然分层。

排版：
在艺术作品底部，添加三个克制的社论文本元素：

[地点名称]
[简短的目的地灵感副标题]
[简短的温暖诗意句子]

使用优雅的极简排版和宽裕的间距。使其仅次于艺术作品，并确保所有措辞简洁且拼写正确。

最终美学：
优质手工水彩旅行海报 × 当代社论插画 × 怀旧旅行记忆 × 宁静的日常生活 × 精致的艺术书设计。

最终的艺术作品应该感觉像是一个被亲手绘制的美丽记忆之地：富有氛围感、个性化、精致、低调，且与 [国家 / 城市 / 地点 / 主体] 有着明确的联系。

避免：
任何编辑工作流、素材来源、参考资料、现有构图、复制的图像、拼贴构造、不相关的地标、通用的风景、过多的细节、过度饱和的颜色、生硬的轮廓、光泽的数字效果、CGI、3D 物体、卡通人物、杂乱、过多的排版、徽标、水印、界面元素。

格式：
4:5 垂直肖像构图，暖乳白色纸张，手工水彩纹理，大面积留白，优质印刷级质量效果。

items.title: 午夜奶油复古电影海报全新构图版

prompts.text:
["Midnight Crème" | C2 Theme Poster | New Composition Version]

[Creation Goal]
Generate a 2:3 vertical vintage movie theme poster. The image must first look like a frame from a 35mm film still truly captured by a cinema camera, then add the typography of a movie promotional poster. Reject AI beauty fashion photoshoot feel, excessive retouching, uniform full-body lighting, and digital HDR.

[Character]
26-year-old East Asian adult female, realistic movie actor facial bone structure, normal eye proportions, natural slight facial asymmetry, skin with realistic regional differences, pores, under-eye texture, lip lines, and natural stray hairs. Naturally balanced body, hourglass shape but believable proportions. Expression focuses on real emotions, avoiding exaggerated sexy performances.

[Costume Master]
Strictly inherit the complete outfit actually generated in "Midnight Crème" C1: cream-white silk satin draped neckline short dress, pearl-decorated shoulder straps, black velvet waist cincher, vintage gold decorative fasteners, cream-colored draped bow at the side waist, irregular black lace hem, black translucent lace shawl, black lace short gloves, pearl earrings, black hard evening bag, black thin-strap pointed high heels. Retain realistic satin thickness, natural folds, and the translucent structure of the black lace. Do not redesign the neckline, waist, or hemline.

[New Scene]
A vintage luxury hotel ballroom after midnight, guests have departed. A huge vintage gold crystal chandelier hangs in the center of the hall, with realistic light reflections on the dark polished wooden floor, scattered with a few round banquet tables, empty wine glasses, folded cream napkins, and several chairs not fully returned to their positions. In the distance, a glass door leading to a terrace is half-open, with the night breeze gently blowing the sheer curtains.

The scene must look like an actually built and lit movie set, not an infinitely grand CG palace. Tables, chairs, lamps, and architectural perspective are realistic and believable.

[Cinematic Event and Action]
The character has just walked through the ballroom alone when the sound of a glass breaking suddenly comes from behind her. Her walking motion stops instantly; one foot still takes a half-step in the original direction, the other foot bears weight stably, and the body leans slightly forward due to inertia; the pelvis still points in the original direction of travel, but the shoulders and head have naturally turned toward the source of the sound, forming a realistic and restrained counter-rotation.

One hand naturally holds the evening bag, the other hand is slightly raised due to surprise but without exaggeratedly splayed fingers. The shawl and hemline retain a bit of inertia from walking. The character's gaze is directed toward the source of the sound outside the frame, not looking directly at the camera. The expression shifts from calm to alert, lips naturally closed, eyes slightly tightening.

The action should be like an actor caught unexpectedly by the camera, rather than deliberately showing off body curves.

[New Photographic Composition]
The camera is located on the second-floor gallery of the ballroom, shooting at a downward angle of about 35 degrees, using a 35mm spherical cinema lens. The character is located in the lower-middle-right part of the frame, occupying about 55% to 65% of the frame height, not a full-frame headshot.

Part of the giant chandelier forms a soft out-of-focus foreground at the top of the frame; the geometric lines of the floor, the staggered arrangement of round tables and chairs constitute strong spatial depth. The character's cream-white dress emerges from the dark floor and surrounding shadows, forming a clear visual focus.

Do not use elevator door frames, hallway vanishing points, low-angle leg perspective, holding the door while stepping, or leaning forward in front of curtains compositions. Do not place the character in the center of the frame for a standard poster pose.

[Realistic Cinematic Lighting]
The primary light sources are parts of the remaining turned-on chandeliers in the ballroom, small table lamps, and faint cool-toned night light from outside the terrace. The character is unevenly lit, with one side of the face bright and the other naturally falling into shadow. The cream-white satin has only local highlights, while the black waist and shawl retain dense shadows. Floor reflections should match the actual light source positions.

Do not use unreasonable full-body rim lighting, don't make every piece of jewelry glow, and don't make the skin look like it's been coated with highlighter oil.

[35mm Film Cinematic Texture]
Real 35mm color negative film, moderate organic grain, soft highlight halation, natural tungsten lamp color shift, deep black shadows, limited dynamic range, slight exposure errors, real lens depth of field, and a small amount of natural motion blur.

The character's eyes and face are clearly discernible within the actual focal plane but without digital beauty sharpening. The film texture comes from real exposure and optical performance, rather than overlaying a large number of scratches, light leaks, and dirty borders.

[Movie Poster Typography]
Large Chinese theme "午夜奶油" (Midnight Crème) placed in the dark space of the ballroom at the top left of the frame, English "Midnight Crème" arranged naturally along the top or side, Japanese "真夜中のクリーム" as a small auxiliary title, the MapleJ.AI logo placed in the top right corner. Supplemented with a small amount of movie-style promotional fine print.

Text must not cover the character's face, main actions, chandelier structure, or key clothing details. Do not display internal numbers like C2.

[Strict De-duplication]
Completely different from the generated C2 elevator version: Prohibit brass elevators, hotel corridors, holding the door, stepping, looking towards the corridor sideways, and left door frame compositions.
Completely different from the C3 stairs triptych: Prohibit holding stair railings, tidying the shawl at the dressing table, or bending over to pick up an envelope.
Completely different from the C4 quad: Prohibit entering guest rooms, putting down the evening bag, reading a letter, and looking back at the door.
Completely different from 01 HERO: Prohibit grabbing curtains, leaning forward toward the mirror, or close-up strong staring compositions.

[Final Acceptance]
Single 2:3 vertical screen. The first look sees the dramatic spatial relationship between the empty ballroom and the character; the second look feels the suspense of the character's sudden stop; the third look sees the clear clothing identity of cream-white and black. It must look like a real 35mm film still, not an AI fashion poster.

严格继承「午夜奶油」C1实际生成的完整穿搭：奶油白真丝缎面垂坠领口短礼服、珍珠装饰肩带、黑色天鹅绒束腰、旧金装饰扣件、侧腰奶油色垂坠蝴蝶结、不规则黑色蕾丝裙缘、黑色半透明蕾丝披肩、黑色蕾丝短手套、珍珠耳饰、黑色硬质晚宴包、黑色细带尖头高跟鞋。保留真实缎面厚度、自然褶皱和黑色蕾丝的半透明结构。不得重新设计领口、束腰或裙摆。

【全新场景】
午夜过后的复古豪华酒店宴会厅，宾客已经离去。巨大的旧金水晶吊灯悬挂在大厅中央，深色抛光木地板上有真实灯光反射，四周散布少量圆形宴会桌、空酒杯、折叠的奶油色餐巾和几把没有完全归位的椅子。远处一扇通往露台的玻璃门半开，夜风轻轻吹动薄纱窗帘。

场景必须像实际搭建并照明的电影布景，而不是无限宏伟的CG宫殿。桌椅、灯具和建筑透视真实可信。

【电影事件与动作】
人物刚独自穿过宴会厅，身后突然传来一只玻璃杯摔碎的声音。她的行走动作瞬间停止，一只脚仍朝原方向迈出半步，另一只脚稳定承重，身体因为惯性略微前倾；骨盆仍指向原行进方向，肩部与头部却已自然转向声音来源，形成真实、克制的反向旋转。

一只手自然握着晚宴包，另一只手因惊讶略微抬起但没有夸张张开五指。披肩和裙摆保留行走后的一点惯性。人物视线投向画面外的声音来源，不直视摄影机。表情从平静转为警觉，嘴唇自然闭合，眼神微微收紧。

动作应当像演员被摄影机意外捕捉，而不是刻意展示身体曲线。

【全新摄影构图】
摄影机位于宴会厅二层回廊，向下约35度斜俯拍，采用35mm球面电影镜头。人物位于画面中下部偏右，约占画面高度55%至65%，不是满画面大头人像。

巨型吊灯的一部分在画面上方形成柔和失焦前景；地板几何线、圆桌与椅子的错位排列构成强烈空间纵深。人物的奶油白礼服从深色地板与周围暗部中显现，形成明确的视觉焦点。

不要使用电梯门框、走廊消失点、低机位腿部透视、扶门跨步或窗帘前倾构图。不要把人物放到画面正中央做标准海报站姿。

【真实电影布光】
主要光源为宴会厅残留开启的部分吊灯、桌面小灯与露台外微弱冷色夜光。人物受光不均匀，脸部一侧明亮、另一侧自然落入阴影。奶油白缎面只有局部高光，黑色束腰和披肩保留浓密暗部。地面反射应符合实际光源位置。

不使用不合理的全身轮廓光，不要每件饰品都发光，不要皮肤像打了高光油。

【35mm胶片电影质感】
真实35mm电影彩色负片，适度有机颗粒、柔和高光卤光、自然钨丝灯色偏、深黑阴影、有限动态范围、轻微曝光误差、真实镜头景深与少量自然运动模糊。

人物眼睛与面部在实际焦平面内清楚可辨，但不进行数字美容锐化。胶片质感来自真实曝光与光学表现，而不是叠加大量划痕、漏光和脏污边框。

【电影海报排版】
大型中文主题「午夜奶油」置于画面左上方宴会厅暗色空间，英文 Midnight Crème 沿画面上部或侧边自然排列，日文 真夜中のクリーム 作为小型辅助标题，
http://
MapleJ.AI 标识置于右上角。辅以少量电影宣传式小字。

文字不能覆盖人物面部、主要动作、吊灯结构和关键服装细节。不显示C2等内部编号。

【严格去重】
与已生成C2电梯版本彻底不同：禁止黄铜电梯、酒店走廊、扶门、跨步、侧身望向走廊与左侧门框构图。
与C3楼梯三联不同：禁止扶楼梯栏杆、梳妆台整理披肩、弯腰拾取信封。
与C4四联不同：禁止进入客房、放下晚宴包、读信和回望房门。
与01 HERO不同：禁止抓窗帘、迎镜前倾、近距离强凝视构图。

【最终验收】
单张2:3竖屏。第一眼看到空宴会厅与人物之间的戏剧性空间关系；第二眼感受到人物突然停步的悬念；第三眼看清奶油白与黑色的服装辨识度。必须像真实35mm电影剧照，而不是AI时尚海报。

prompts.text:
Medium full shot, eye-level dynamic freeze-frame portrait of a lively early-20s East Asian young woman dancing inside a modern apartment hallway. Razor-sharp focus throughout with completely zero motion blur, capturing a crisp, frozen moment of movement: her body sways playfully mid-dance, and both hands are raised open-palmed beside her waist in a cute choreography pause. She smiles warmly at the camera with an open, cheerful smile showing neat upper teeth.

Her face is clear and radiantly detailed: a delicate V-line jaw, porcelain skin texture, bright dark-brown almond eyes with natural aegyo-sal and soft eyeliner, and glossy coral-pink lips parted in an energetic grin. Her warm chestnut-brown hair has light, airy see-through fringe bangs across the forehead, with loose, wavy side locks flowing down over her shoulders and framed by a soft half-tied style at the crown.

She is dressed in a classic Japanese anime-style sailor uniform (JK seifuku): a fitted cream-white short-sleeve sailor blouse featuring a deep navy-blue flap collar with two crisp white parallel border stripes, accented at the chest by a tied crimson-red ribbon scarf with cascading ends. Below, she wears a matching high-waisted navy-blue pleated flared mini skirt with sharp folds, paired with sheer black thigh-high stockings featuring defined bands on the upper thighs. A thin gold chain bracelet shines on her right wrist.

The setting is a clean, contemporary residential corridor: smooth light-beige walls, interior doorframes on both sides creating architectural vanishing lines, and a warm ceiling recessed downlight casting a soft overhead glow.

Illuminated by warm, even hallway ambient light, calibrated with high-speed shutter mechanics for total edge clarity and zero blur. Shot on a 50mm f/2.2 prime lens at an ultra-fast 1/1000s shutter speed, ISO 200, resolving pin-sharp eyelash definition, crisp fabric stitching, crisp pleated skirt edges, and lifelike skin pores.

prompts.text:
中景全身镜头，视线平齐的动态定格肖像，捕捉了一位活泼的二十出头东亚年轻女性在现代公寓走廊内跳舞的画面。全程呈现极其锐利的焦点，完全没有运动模糊，捕捉到了一个清晰、冻结的动作瞬间：她的身体在舞动中俏皮地摇摆，双手掌心张开举在腰部两侧，处于一个可爱的舞蹈停顿动作。她对着镜头温暖地微笑，灿烂开朗的笑容露出了整齐的上排牙齿。

她的脸部清晰且细节明亮：精致的V型下巴，瓷器般的皮肤纹理，明亮的深褐色杏仁眼，带有自然的卧蚕和柔和的眼线，亮泽的珊瑚粉色嘴唇在充满活力的笑容中微微张开。她温暖的栗色头发在额头上有着轻盈透气的空气刘海，蓬松波浪状的侧发垂在肩膀上，头顶则是柔和的半扎发造型。

她穿着经典的日系动漫风格水手服（JK制服）：一件合身的乳白色短袖水手衬衫，带有深海军蓝色的翻领，领子上有两条清晰的白色平行边纹，胸前点缀着一条系好的深红色丝带围巾，末端自然垂下。下半身她穿着配套的高腰海军蓝色百褶扩摆超短裙，褶皱锐利，搭配透视黑色过膝长筒袜，大腿上方有明显的束带。右手腕上闪耀着一条细金链手链。

环境是一个整洁、现代的住宅走廊：平滑的浅米色墙壁，两侧的室内门框构成了建筑透视线，暖色的天花板内嵌式射灯投射出柔和的头顶光芒。

由温暖、均匀的走廊环境光照射，通过高速快门机制进行校准，以实现完全的边缘清晰度和零模糊。使用50mm f/2.2定焦镜头拍摄，快门速度极快，达到1/1000秒，ISO 200，解析出清晰如针尖的睫毛细节、清脆的面料缝线、锐利的百褶裙边缘以及栩栩如生的皮肤毛孔。

prompts.text: Generate 6 independent vertical photos at once, each as a separate image, no collages, no grids, no storyboards. [Reference Image Division] Reference Image 1 (Original): The sole source of the background. Directly use the real background from this photo, including the cyan gradient sky, white cumulus clouds, distant snow mountain outlines, nearby plateau meadows and gravel, several black birds in the sky, as well as the direction of sunlight, color temperature, and overall color grading on-site. The styles of the clothing and straw hat should also follow this image. Reference Image 2 (Face): Look only at this for the face. Priority: Face only from Image 2; background, lighting, and clothing only from Image 1. The face of the person in Image 1 is not to be adopted at all, and the watermark text at the bottom of the original image should not be retained. The face must only come from Reference Image 2; it is not allowed to redesign facial features due to lighting, styling, or stylization; do not enlarge eyes, do not sharpen the chin. [Background Requirements] The background should maintain the real photographic texture and grain of Reference Image 1, do not redraw it into a CG sky or illustration style, do not add or change mountains, clouds, and terrain. The 6 photos are in the same location, with only random positions and angles creating normal perspective changes. [6 Poses, each different] 1. Holding the straw hat in front of the waist with both hands, looking up at the sky. 2. Raising both hands to press the straw hat on the head, wind blowing messy bangs. 3. Back to the camera, one hand steadying the hat, looking back at the camera. 4. Straw hat tucked under the arm, looking up from a side profile. 5. One hand touching the brim of the hat, face slightly tilted, hair strands blown onto the face by the wind. 6. Low-angle full body, skirt hem blown up by the wind, one hand hanging down holding the straw hat. [Character and Clothing] Black long hair in a low bun, stray hairs blown up by the wind. Black Victorian-style long dress, stand-up collar, a row of small black buttons on the front placket, white lace at the neckline and cuffs, high-waisted pleats, long skirt hem. Beige straw-woven flat-top wide-brimmed hat, with a creamy white ribbon. Silver diamond-shaped gemstone earrings. [Lighting Consistency] The character must naturally receive the sunlight and the cyan ambient light reflected from the sky from the scene in Reference Image 1. Hair edges, lace, and the straw hat must all be affected by the same light; there should be no "cut-out" feel where the character looks like studio lighting and the background is outdoor light. [Lens] Low-angle shot, equivalent 85mm, medium shot to full body, natural head-to-body ratio, no wide-angle distortion. [Prohibited] Collages, grids, text, watermarks, logos, AI plastic faces, excessive skin smoothing, CG sky, illustration style, cut-out white edges, incorrect fingers, redundant limbs.

prompts.text: 一次性生成 6 张独立的竖版照片，每张单独成图，不要拼图、不要宫格、不要分镜。 【参考图分工】 参考图1（原图）：背景的唯一来源。直接沿用这张照片里的真实背景，包括青绿色渐变天空、白色积云、远处雪山轮廓、近处高原草甸与碎石、天空中的几只黑色飞鸟，以及现场阳光的方向、色温和整体调色。服装和草帽的款式也以这张为准。 参考图2（人脸）：脸只看这张。 优先级：脸只看图2；背景、光线、服装只看图1。图1里人物的脸一律不采纳，原图底部的水印文字不要保留。 脸只能来自参考图2，不允许因为光线、造型或风格化重新设计五官，不要放大眼睛，不要削尖下巴。 【背景要求】 背景保持参考图1的真实摄影质感和颗粒，不要重绘成CG天空或插画风，不要新增或改动山、云和地形。6张是同一个地点，只随机位和角度产生正常的透视变化。 【6张的姿势，每张不同】 1. 双手把草帽捧在腰前，仰头望天 2. 双手举起压住头上的草帽，风吹乱刘海 3. 背对镜头，一手扶帽，回头看镜头 4. 草帽夹在臂弯里，侧身仰望 5. 一手扶帽檐，脸微侧，发丝被风吹到脸上 6. 低机位全身，裙摆被风吹起，单手垂落拿着草帽 【人物与服装】 黑色长发低盘，碎发被风吹起。黑色维多利亚风长裙，立领，前襟一排小黑扣，领口和袖口有白色蕾丝，高腰收褶，长裙摆。米色草编平顶宽檐帽，配奶白色丝带。银色菱形宝石耳坠。 【光线一致性】 人物必须自然接受参考图1现场的阳光和天空反射的青色环境光。发丝边缘、蕾丝、草帽都要受同样的光影响，不能出现人物是棚拍光、背景是户外光的抠图感。 【镜头】 低机位仰拍，等效85mm，中景到全身，头身比自然，不要广角畸变。 【禁止】 拼图、宫格、文字、水印、logo、AI塑料脸、过度磨皮、CG天空、插画感、抠图白边、错误手指、多余肢体。

items.title: 第二世界超现实摄影插画海报

prompts.text: Please create an independent 3:4 vertical "Second World" conceptual surrealist photography illustration poster based on each photograph I upload, outputting each one individually without collaging. The overall top and bottom are strictly 1:1. The upper half is the original realistic photograph, and the lower half is another layer of space growing out from within the photograph; the two are not a top-and-bottom splice, but a continuous existence of the same moment in different narrative layers. The upper half should preserve the original photograph as faithfully as possible, without changing the subject, action, spatial relationships, lighting, color, and realistic texture, making only necessary proportional cropping and slight high-end tonal refinement to give it a clean, restrained, independent publication-like photographic quality. The creative focus is not on the "subject matter," but on the re-understanding of the visual structure. First observe the most decisive structural clues in this photograph, such as boundaries, slopes, water surfaces, reflections, shadows, cracks, roads, branches, clouds, outlines, gaps, flow directions, repetitive rhythms, spatial transitions, or character poses; find the part most suitable for "crossing the boundary" from among them. Then let it break through the photograph's boundary, enter the lower half, and undergo a translation of use, scale, semantics, or narrative role after entering. It is not a simple extension, but letting something in reality become another kind of existence in the second layer of space that can be used, entered, measured, salvaged, repaired, organized, borrowed, unfolded, or collected. The lower half is a warm, quiet, warm-off-white space with fine paper texture, retaining ample white space. It is not an illustration background or a decorative area, but a place that carries the "new logic after crossing the boundary." The top-bottom relationship should conform to: Reality → Crossing → Translation. The visual interest comes from a clever and accurate cross-layer narrative, rather than cute decoration. Minimalist black hand-drawn line-art characters can be added, but they should be few and precise, 0–3 is sufficient. Characters are not decorations, but users of the Second World; they must have real interaction with the translated structure. Lines should be light, simple, natural, with a slight handcrafted feel, not cute, not complex, and not overshadowing the main subject. Actions should be specific, restrained, and clever, as if seriously handling a small matter that originally existed in this world. A short English handwritten narration can be added, but it must be generated on-site based on the real "Second World event" occurring in this image. The tone is like a discovery or a soft narration written in passing, with a bit of humor and aftertaste, not written as an inspirational sentence, not explaining the meaning, and not following a template. The overall style should present a comprehensive texture of: Mixed-Media Photo Illustration, Surreal Photomontage, Frame-Breaking Illusion, Trompe-l'œil, Visual Metaphor, and Conceptual Editorial Illustration. That is: with cross-media collage as the form, frame-breaking as the mechanism, visual metaphor as the core, and gentle, slight, clever micro-surrealism as the emotional tone. Do not make it into a template image of "small people and sentences added below a photo"; do not have only extension without translation; do not have only form without metaphor; do not force lyricism; do not have a commercial advertising feel, complex illustration feel, repetitive actions, baseless decoration, mechanical collage, hard connections, or cheap healing style. Final goal: Let the viewer first see a valid real photograph, then suddenly discover an element within it crossing over into another layer of space and obtaining an unexpected yet extremely natural new meaning there. It is not adding creativity to the photograph, but revealing the second reality originally latent within the photograph.

prompts.text:
请基于我上传的每一张摄影作品，分别创作一张独立的 3:4 竖版「第二世界」概念性超现实摄影插画海报，每张单独输出，不拼图。整体上下 严格 1:1。上半部分是原始现实照片，下半部分是从照片内部生长出来的另一层空间；二者不是上下拼接，而是同一个瞬间在不同叙事层中的连续存在。
上半部分尽可能忠实保留原照片，不改变主体、动作、空间关系、光线、色彩与真实质感，只做必要的等比裁切与轻微高级调性整理，使其具有干净、克制、独立出版物般的摄影品质。
创作重点不在“题材”，而在视觉结构的再理解。先观察这张照片中最具决定性的结构线索，例如边界、坡度、水面、倒影、阴影、裂缝、道路、枝条、云层、轮廓、空隙、流向、重复节奏、空间转折或人物姿态；从中找到最适合被“越界”的那个部分。然后让它突破照片边界，进入下半部分，并在进入后发生用途、尺度、语义或叙事角色的转译。不是简单延长，而是让现实中的某种东西，在第二层空间里变成另一种可以被使用、进入、测量、打捞、修补、整理、借用、展开或收藏的存在。
下半部分是温暖、安静、带细微纸张肌理的暖米白空间，保留充足留白。它不是插画背景，也不是装饰区，而是承接“越界之后的新逻辑”的地方。上下关系应符合：现实 → 越界 → 转译。画面的趣味来自一个聪明而准确的跨层叙事，而不是可爱装饰。
可加入极简黑色手绘线稿人物，但应少而准，0–3 个即可。人物不是摆设，而是第二世界的使用者；他们必须与被转译出的结构发生真实互动。线条轻、简、自然，略带手工感，不卖萌，不复杂，不喧宾夺主。动作应具体、克制、聪明，像是在认真处理一件本来就存在于这个世界里的小事。
可加入一句简短英文手写旁白，但必须根据这张图里真实发生的“第二世界事件”现场生成。语气像顺手写下的发现或轻声旁白，带一点幽默和余味，不写成励志句，不解释寓意，不套模板。
整体风格应呈现：Mixed-Media Photo Illustration、Surreal Photomontage、Frame-Breaking Illusion、Trompe-l'œil、Visual Metaphor、Conceptual Editorial Illustration 的综合质感。也就是：以跨媒介拼贴为形式，以画面越界为机制，以视觉隐喻为核心，以温柔、轻微、聪明的微型超现实主义为情绪基调。
不要做成“照片下方加小人和句子”的模板图；不要只有延伸没有转译；不要只有形式没有隐喻；不要强行抒情；不要商业广告感、复杂插画感、重复动作、无依据装饰、机械拼贴、硬连接或廉价治愈风。
最终目标：
让观者先看到一张成立的真实照片，再忽然发现其中某个元素越界进入了另一层空间，并在那里获得了一个意想不到却极其自然的新意义。
不是给照片加创意，而是把照片里原本潜伏的第二种现实显现出来。

prompts.text: A high-end fashion magazine quality lavender-toned young girl artistic portrait, vertical 3:4 composition, overall using low-saturation lavender purple, haze purple, cream white, and soft skin tones to build a unified visual system, the image presents a clear, dreamy, gentle, retro, romantic atmosphere with the temperament of high-end fashion photography. The main subject is a young East Asian female, with exquisite and soft features, a small and natural face shape, with a slight temperament of a classical Oriental beauty, clear and agile eyes, slender and natural eyebrows, soft nose bridge lines, full but not overly exaggerated lip shape, light pink nude lip makeup, the face retains real and natural skin texture and delicate light and shadow transitions, overall makeup is light and transparent, with a slight pink-purple tone blush, avoiding heavy makeup. The model has deep brown long hair, naturally tied into a slightly loose retro low bun, retaining fluffy hair roots, fine bangs, naturally falling sideburns, and a small amount of messy hair strands, hair details are rich and real, wearing lavender fabric flower hair accessories on the hair, petals are soft and three-dimensional, partially decorated with small purple bows, creating a romantic and exquisite girlhood atmosphere. The model is wearing a light lavender purple loose knit cardigan, the knit fabric has clear and delicate weaving textures, soft drape, and natural folds, paired inside with a white lace camisole or exquisite lace top, lace patterns are dense and fine, presenting a light and transparent layered feel, the bottom is paired with a dark grey-black pleated short skirt, the skirt hem falls naturally, revealing a small amount of white lace decoration at the edge, wearing light purple retro Mary Jane flats on the feet, the shoe surface adopts a soft matte leather texture, paired with narrow buckles and a simple shoe shape, the overall clothing color scheme is coordinated and unified, highlighting the romantic fashion aesthetics of the lavender color system. The person adopts a low-posture curled sitting composition, the body is located in the lower-middle to the right position of the frame, legs are naturally bent and gathered to the front of the chest, shoulders are slightly retracted, the upper body leans forward gently, the head is tilted to one side and leans lightly near the knees, the face is turned towards the camera, the gaze is quiet, soft, slightly lazy and innocent, lips are naturally slightly parted, the expression is relaxed and has emotional tension. Both hands are naturally overlapped and gently holding a mature deep red pomegranate, finger postures are natural, skin details are real, avoiding stiff hand movements. Three pomegranates with a maturity of about 80% to 90% are placed in the lower-left corner of the frame, two of which are placed on the ground, and the other is held lightly by the model's hands, the pomegranates show a gradient of deep red, wine red, and subtle dark purple, the peel has real and delicate granules, natural irregular color changes, and slight moist reflections, retaining the natural fruit crown structure, paired with a small amount of dark green pomegranate leaves, leaves are scattered randomly on the ground, forming a simple and artistic still life combination, the number of pomegranates is restrained, avoiding prop accumulation. The background uses seamless studio background paper, the overall is a soft gradient between extremely light lavender purple and matte grey-purple, the background is clean and pure, without complex textures, without obvious boundary lines, the ground and background naturally connect, forming a continuous monochromatic space. A large area of pure negative space is reserved at the top and upper left of the frame, the figure is concentrated in the lower right area, the pomegranates are located in the lower left corner, the overall composition follows asymmetrical balance and high-end fashion magazine minimalist layout logic, forming a natural visual echo between the figure and props. A small-sized English title "LAVENDER DAYS" is placed in the upper-left corner of the frame, using a slender and elegant high-contrast serif font, all letters are uppercase, letter spacing is appropriately widened, the color is low-saturation grey-purple; below the title is the Chinese subtitle "紫色絮语", using an exquisite fine Song font or a Chinese serif font with classical charm, the font size is smaller, left-aligned with the English title, text color is consistent with the English, the layout is restrained, light, and exquisite, not seizing the visual focus from the main figure. The overall setup uses a large softbox combined with soft diffused light from the front-left, supplemented by weak fill light on the right, forming delicate and uniform facial lighting, soft nose shadows, and jaw shadows, knit clothing, lace, hair strands, and pomegranate surfaces all show rich and natural material details; there are slight real soft shadows where the figure contacts the ground, avoiding a floating sensation of the figure. Adopting the visual language of an 85mm portrait lens, a camera position slightly above the ground, a shooting distance close to full-body environmental portrait photography, the character's face and clothing textures are clear, the background is moderately softened but the overall space remains clean, the image has professional commercial photography exposure control and detail layers. The overall color is dominated by low-saturation light purple, contrast is moderately reduced, naturally red pomegranates are reserved as visual embellishments, white areas appear as soft cream white rather than piercing pure white, details are retained in dark parts, skin shows a natural light warm pink tone, the image has a slight soft focus and delicate film grain, but the character's features and material details remain clear, presenting a visual effect that merges high-end magazine spreads, Japanese retro girl portraits, French romantic still life photography, and modern minimalist aesthetics. Hyper-realistic photography, real human body proportions, natural skin texture, fine hair strands, real knit texture, high-definition details, professional studio lighting, soft airy feel, elegant white space, exquisite color matching, high-end commercial portrait photography, avoiding excessive skin smoothing, plastic skin, over-sharpening, heavy filters, overexposed backgrounds, complex backgrounds, too many props, overly large titles, incorrect text, extra people, deformed fingers, repeated limbs, pomegranate deformation, cartoon feel, illustration feel, 3D rendering feel.

prompts.text: 一张高端时尚杂志质感的淡紫色系少女艺术写真，竖版3:4构图，整体采用低饱和薰衣草紫、雾霾紫、奶油白与柔和肤色构建统一的视觉体系，画面呈现清透、梦幻、温柔、复古、浪漫且具有高级时装摄影气质的氛围。画面主体是一位年轻的东亚女性，五官精致柔和，脸型小巧自然，略带古典东方美人的气质，清澈灵动的眼睛，细长自然的眉毛，柔和的鼻梁线条，饱满但不过分夸张的唇形，淡粉裸色唇妆，面部保留真实自然的肌肤纹理与细腻的光影过渡，整体妆容清淡通透，带有轻微的粉紫色调腮红，避免浓艳妆感。模特拥有深棕色长发，头发自然盘成略显松散的复古低发髻，保留蓬松发根、细碎刘海、自然垂落的鬓发和少量凌乱的发丝，发丝细节丰富真实，头发上佩戴淡紫色布艺花朵发饰，花瓣柔软立体，局部点缀小型紫色蝴蝶结，营造浪漫而精致的少女气息。模特身穿淡薰衣草紫色宽松针织开衫，针织面料具有清晰细腻的编织纹理、柔软的垂坠感和自然的褶皱，内搭白色蕾丝吊带或精致蕾丝上衣，蕾丝花纹细密，呈现轻盈通透的层次感，下身搭配深灰黑色百褶短裙，裙摆自然散落，边缘露出少量白色蕾丝装饰，脚穿浅紫色复古玛丽珍平底鞋，鞋面采用柔和的哑光皮革质感，搭配细窄搭扣与简洁鞋型，整体服装配色协调统一，突出淡紫色系的浪漫时装美学。人物采用低姿态蜷坐构图，身体位于画面中下部偏右的位置，双腿自然弯曲并收拢至胸前，肩膀微微内收，上半身轻柔地向前倾斜，头部侧向一边并轻轻倚靠在膝盖附近，脸部转向镜头，眼神安静、柔和、略带慵懒与无辜感，嘴唇自然微张，神态松弛而具有情绪张力。双手自然交叠并轻轻捧住一颗成熟的深红色石榴，手指姿态自然，皮肤细节真实，避免僵硬的手部动作。画面左下角摆放三颗成熟度约八至九成的石榴，其中两颗完整石榴放置于地面，另一颗由模特双手轻握，石榴呈现深红、酒红与微妙的暗紫色渐变，果皮具有真实细腻的颗粒、自然不规则的色泽变化与轻微的柔润反光，保留自然的果冠结构，搭配少量深绿色石榴叶，叶片随意散落在地面，形成简洁而富有艺术感的静物组合，石榴数量克制，避免道具堆积。背景采用无缝摄影棚背景纸，整体为极浅薰衣草紫与雾面灰紫色之间的柔和渐变，背景干净纯粹，没有复杂纹理，没有明显分界线，地面与背景自然衔接，形成连续的单色空间。画面上方与左上方保留大面积纯净的负空间，人物集中于右下区域，石榴位于左下角，整体构图遵循不对称平衡与高端时尚杂志的极简排版逻辑，人物与道具之间形成自然的视觉呼应。画面左上角放置小尺寸英文标题“LAVENDER DAYS”，采用纤细优雅的高对比衬线字体，字母全部大写，字间距适当拉开，颜色为低饱和灰紫色；标题下方放置中文副标题“紫色絮语”，使用精致的细宋体或具有古典韵味的中文衬线字体，字号更小，与英文标题左对齐，文字颜色与英文一致，排版克制、轻盈、精致，不抢夺人物主体的视觉焦点。整体采用大型柔光箱结合正面偏左的柔和漫射光，辅以右侧微弱补光，形成细腻均匀的面部照明、柔和的鼻影与下颌阴影，针织衣物、蕾丝、发丝、石榴表面均呈现丰富而自然的材质细节；人物与地面接触处具有轻微真实的柔和投影，避免人物悬浮感。采用85mm人像镜头的视觉语言，略高于地面的机位，接近全身环境人像摄影的拍摄距离，人物面部与服装纹理清晰，背景适度柔化但整体空间保持干净，画面具有专业商业摄影的曝光控制与细节层次。整体色彩以低饱和淡紫色为主，适度降低对比度，保留自然的红色石榴作为视觉点缀，白色区域呈现柔和奶油白而非刺眼纯白，暗部保留细节，肌肤呈现自然的浅暖粉色，画面带有轻微柔焦与细腻胶片颗粒感，但人物五官和材质细节依然清晰，呈现高级杂志大片、日系复古少女写真、法式浪漫静物摄影与现代极简美学相融合的视觉效果。超写实摄影，真实人体比例，自然皮肤质感，精细发丝，真实针织纹理，高清细节，专业影棚布光，柔和空气感，优雅留白，精致配色，高级商业人像摄影，避免过度磨皮、塑料皮肤、过度锐化、浓重滤镜、过曝背景、复杂背景、过多道具、过大标题、错误文字、额外人物、畸形手指、重复肢体、石榴变形、卡通感、插画感、3D渲染感。

items.title: 商业服饰隐形人台三视图设计指令

prompts.text:
{
  "system_role": "You are a professional clothing designer, clothing stylist, clothing structure analyst, and high-end commercial apparel product photography expert. You are good at extracting real outfits from character reference photos, and are also able to independently design complete clothing styles and generate professional front, side, and back three-view reference drawings based on clothing categories, style names, design tables, or natural language descriptions provided by users.",
  "objective": "Generate a high-quality, realistic photographic style three-view reference image of a complete outfit. The image displays a set of clothing in a natural wearing state, including tops, pants, skirts, jumpsuits, and applicable accessories. The clothing features the three-dimensional volume, natural silhouette, gravity wrinkles, and reasonable garment structure of real human wearing, but the image must absolutely not contain human bodies, human parts, mannequins, models, or any visible support models. Use real 3D Invisible Ghost Mannequin visual technology to keep the clothing itself upright, full, natural, and in a credible wearing form.",
  "input_modes": {
    "mode_A_reference_image_extraction": {
      "trigger": "The user uploaded character photos, clothing photos, or clothing reference drawings containing target apparel and requested to extract, replicate, convert, or produce three-view drawings.",
      "priority": "When the user explicitly requests to extract clothing from a reference drawing, the reference drawing shall be the primary design basis, and it must not be replaced by other styles from textual imagination without authorization.",
      "instructions": [
        "Identify the clothing actually existing in the reference image, including tops, bottoms, jumpsuits, coats, and identifiable accessories.",
        "Extract the style, color, pattern, length, material, texture, pattern, cut, structural lines, and wearing method of the clothing.",
        "Retain the original matching relationship, wearing order, occlusion relationship, and proportion between the top and the pants or skirt.",
        "Remove the person themselves, but retain the three-dimensional outline originally formed by the human body wearing the clothing.",
        "For areas occluded by human posture, hair, arms, or shooting angles, perform restrained completion based on visible clues and reasonable clothing structures.",
        "For details that cannot be confirmed in the reference image, do not add complex designs out of thin air or change the core characteristics of the clothing.",
        "If multiple sets of identifiable clothing exist in the reference image, identify and process them set by set; unless the user explicitly requests re-styling, do not randomly mix clothing from different characters."
      ]
    },
    "mode_B_text_driven_design": {
      "trigger": "The user did not provide a reference image for the clothing to be extracted, or explicitly requested to generate clothing based on text, tables, style categories, clothing names, or design descriptions.",
      "primary_rule": "Directly use the text provided by the user as the design basis, and do not require the user to upload a reference image. Users can input full descriptions, simple keywords, style names, classification tables, clothing lists, or clothing design parameters.",
      "instructions": [
        "Identify the style category, season, usage occasion, gender adaptation, top structure, bottom structure, color, and accessories in the user's description.",
        "Treat each row in the table as an independent candidate clothing style, unless the user explicitly specifies to only generate one of them.",
        "When the user inputs multiple styles, generate complete outfits one by one, each of which must have front, side, and back views.",
        "Combine tops and bottoms into a complete styling in a real wearing state, and do not break them down into independent product display images.",
        "Reasonably determine the neckline, sleeve type, shoulder, waistline, garment length, pant type, skirt pleats, fabric thickness, wrinkles, and overall proportions based on the clothing category.",
        "When the user only provides a style name, use representative classic structures of that category for the design; when the user provides detailed features, strictly follow the user's specific description.",
        "When the user provides a color range, prioritize the classic matching specified by the user; when the user does not specify colors, reasonably choose coordinated colors based on the clothing category, season, and overall styling.",
        "When certain design details are not specified, reasonable professional design completion can be carried out, but completion details must not override requirements clearly put forward by the user.",
        "If the user explicitly requests custom modifications, modern transformations, original designs, or mix-and-match, adjust according to those requirements instead of mechanically copying traditional styles."
      ]
    },
    "input_priority": [
      "Specific requirements explicitly put forward by the user in the current task",
      "Reference image extraction requirements explicitly specified by the user",
      "Clothing text descriptions and style parameters provided by the user",
      "Clothing category tables and classic style characteristics provided by the user",
      "Reasonable professional design conventions for corresponding clothing categories"
    ],
    "conflict_resolution": "If the user explicitly requests to extract original clothing from a reference image, the actual design that can be confirmed in the reference image takes priority over general style conventions. If the user explicitly requests a redesign based on text, the text requirements shall prevail. Conflicting design bases must not be mixed without reason in the same task."
  },
  "text_input_schema": {
    "accepted_fields": [
      "Style Name",
      "Style Category",
      "Season and Occasion",
      "Gender or Fit Adaptation",
      "Top Type and Core Features",
      "Bottom Type and Core Features",
      "Primary and Secondary Colors",
      "Fabric and Texture",
      "Looseness and Fit",
      "Accessories",
      "Style Reference",
      "Extra Design Requirements"
    ],
    "partial_input": "The user does not have to fill in all fields. Even if only one style name is entered, generate a reasonable and complete clothing scheme directly as much as possible.",
    "table_processing": "Able to identify clothing information in Markdown tables, plain text tables, bulleted lists, and natural language. For tables containing multiple rows of clothing categories, default to identifying them row by row as multiple candidate styles.",
    "multi_style_rule": "When the user inputs a multi-style list, each style is independently designed as a complete wearing styling. Tops, bottoms, and colors from different rows must not be randomly combined into unrelated new styles. Cross-category free mixing is only allowed when the user explicitly requests a combination.",
    "output_strategy": "When the number of styles is small, each complete outfit can be arranged separately on the same reference board. When there are many styles, generate multiple images in batches to ensure that the three views of each outfit are clear enough. Do not shrink clothing, crop key parts, or omit views to accommodate all styles in a single image."
  },
  "invisible_garment_support": {
    "core_principle": "Only remove the human body, do not remove the three-dimensional structure of the clothing formed by human wearing. The clothing must present a complete, stable, and reasonable wearing state as if naturally supported by a completely invisible body.",
    "absolutely_no_human": [
      "No real people or digital people appear.",
      "No human skin, heads, faces, necks, hands, arms, legs, feet, or other body parts appear.",
      "No transparent human bodies, translucent human bodies, ghost human bodies, or human silhouettes appear.",
      "No human skeletons, anatomical structures, muscles, body meshes, or humanoid outlines appear.",
      "No real-life models, virtual models, 3D human models, plastic mannequins, tailor mannequins, or any visible human models appear.",
      "No hangers, hanging hooks, support rods, display bases, or other visible support devices appear."
    ],
    "garment_volume": [
      "The shoulders, chest, waist, and body of the top maintain natural three-dimensional volume.",
      "The collar, neckline, shoulder line, and sleeves maintain their spatial form as in real wearing.",
      "Short sleeves, long sleeves, and loose sleeve types should all maintain a naturally supported form and must not collapse into a plane.",
      "The waistband, hips, crotch, thighs, calves, and leg openings of the pants maintain a reasonable three-dimensional outline.",
      "The waist, hips, skirt pleats, and hem of the skirt maintain the volume and gravitational drape of natural wearing.",
      "The top and the bottom form reasonable contact, coverage, constriction, or tucking relationships at the waist.",
      "A natural space and structure are reserved between the two pant legs to avoid sticking into a single piece of fabric.",
      "Clothing wrinkles should follow gravity, fabric softness, and clothing stress relationships, rather than random accumulation.",
      "The entire set of clothing should maintain a stable and complete wearing silhouette without local collapse, distortion, or unreasonable suspension."
    ],
    "support_method": "Use purely visual invisible mannequin photography and three-dimensional clothing reconstruction effects to maintain the natural form of the clothing when worn. The source of support can only be reflected through the volume, tailoring, wrinkles, shadows, and spatial structure of the clothing itself, and must never present any actual support objects or human forms.",
    "neckline_and_openings": "Necklines, cuffs, waistbands, and other open areas can show reasonable internal shadows and natural cavities, but skin, human outlines, or mannequin materials must not appear inside. Do not design clothing to be completely collapsed or abnormally hollow just to prove the interior is empty.",
    "forbidden_flatness": "Flat laying, folding, spreading, hanging, scattering, stacking, or representing clothing as a flat silhouette lacking wearing volume is prohibited."
  },
  "complete_outfit_integrity": {
    "unified_ensemble": "Present the entire set of clothing as a unified wearing styling, rather than displaying each item separately as an independent commodity.",
    "upper_and_lower_relationship": "Tops and pants, skirts, or other bottoms always maintain a natural wearing relationship. Retain the waistline position, hem coverage relationship, tucking methods, waist constriction, front and back occlusion, and reasonable contact and compression wrinkles between garments.",
    "original_styling": "In reference image mode, strictly retain original outfit combinations and styling. In text mode, form a complete outfit according to the top, bottom, and accessories specified by the user.",
    "accessories": "Only retain accessories that can be confirmed in the reference image, or add accessories explicitly requested by the user's text. Accessories should be naturally worn or attached to the clothing, and no independent floating commodity displays should appear.",
    "one_outfit_three_views": "The front, side, and back views of the same outfit must be the same top, the same pants or same skirt, and the same accessories from different observation directions."
  },
  "three_view_layout": {
    "canvas": "Default to using a 16:9 horizontal canvas, with a seamless photography background in solid white or very light neutral gray.",
    "arrangement": [
      {
        "view": "Front View",
        "position": "Left side",
        "requirement": "Completely display the front wearing state of the entire set of clothing, clearly showing the top, waist matching relationship, bottoms, and all key details."
      },
      {
        "view": "Side View",
        "position": "Center",
        "requirement": "Display the entire set of clothing from a strict 90-degree side view, clearly presenting the depth of the front and back, the silhouette of the chest, waist, and hips, and the side form of the pant legs or skirt hem."
      },
      {
        "view": "Back View",
        "position": "Right side",
        "requirement": "Completely display the real back structure of the entire set of clothing, including the back of the top, the back of the waist, and the back and back hem of the pants or skirt."
      }
    ],
    "alignment": "The overall height, visual scale, ground baseline, and photographic perspective of the clothing in the three views should be as consistent as possible. Keep the clothing complete and do not crop necklines, cuffs, leg openings, skirt hems, or other key parts.",
    "orientation": "The three views use clear front, strict side, and back directions, and must not be replaced by three diagonal views that are close to the front.",
    "spacing": "Maintain appropriate blank space between views to avoid overlapping of sleeves, pant legs, and skirt hems. Each view must be independently identifiable while constituting a unified clothing reference board.",
    "labels": "By default, no text, dimensions, arrows, brand logos, watermarks, borders, or redundant decorations are added. Add labels only when explicitly requested by the user."
  },
  "photographic_style": {
    "style_keywords": [
      "High-end commercial lookbook photography",
      "Premium apparel product photography",
      "3D invisible ghost mannequin effect",
      "Realistic three-dimensional garment presentation",
      "Professional studio lighting",
      "Photorealistic fabric texture"
    ],
    "rendering": "Real commercial photography texture. Accurately represent fabric textures, stitching, cloth thickness, natural wrinkles, seams, and three-dimensional silhouettes.",
    "lighting": "Soft, uniform, and clean professional photography lighting that shapes clothing volume through natural light and shadow, without relying on visible human bodies or models to form silhouettes.",
    "camera": "Adopt a natural perspective suitable for clothing product reference drawings, avoiding exaggerated wide angles, obvious perspective distortion, and inconsistent lens effects between different views.",
    "background": "Clean, seamless, non-distracting light-colored photography background.",
    "realism": "The clothing must look like a finished product obtained from professional invisible mannequin photography or high-quality three-dimensional clothing reconstruction of real fabrics, rather than an illustration, graphic design draft, or ordinary three-dimensional human rendering."
  },
  "negative_constraints": [
    "No human, no person, no human body, no human body parts.",
    "No mannequin, no dress form, no 3D human model, no virtual avatar.",
    "No visible skin, no face, no neck, no hands, no arms, no legs, no feet.",
    "No transparent human silhouette, no ghost body, no anatomical mesh.",
    "No hanger, no support rod, no visible stand, no display base.",
    "No flat lay, no folded clothes, no hanging garments, no collapsed garments.",
    "No isolated tops, no isolated trousers, no separate clothing product cutouts.",
    "No disassembled outfit, no separated upper and lower garments.",
    "No visible human anatomy inside the neckline, sleeves, waistband, or trouser openings.",
    "No unnatural floating fabric, no rigid inflated clothing, no random wrinkles.",
    "No missing garment components, no inconsistent outfits between views.",
    "No incorrect side view, no mirrored back view, no cropped garment parts.",
    "No invented logos, random text, watermarks, decorative props, or unrelated objects."
  ],
  "quality_control": {
    "before_generation": [
      "Determine whether the current task belongs to the reference image extraction mode or the text design mode.",
      "Identify all clothing styles and design details specified by the user that must be retained.",
      "Clarify the complete wearing relationship between the top and the bottom.",
      "Determine the front, side, and back display scheme for each set of clothing.",
      "Ensure that invisible support is only used to shape clothing volume and that no humans or mannequins appear."
    ],
    "after_generation": [
      "Check whether human bodies, human parts, mannequins, or other visible models appear in the image.",
      "Check whether the clothing maintains a complete, natural, and full three-dimensional wearing form.",
      "Check whether the clothing and pants or skirt still constitute a set of complete outfit.",
      "Check whether the clothing appears flat, collapsed, hanging, or in an unnatural hollow shell effect.",
      "Check whether the front, side, and back belong to the same set of clothing.",
      "Check whether the clothing color, structure, proportion, waistline, wrinkles, and accessories remain consistent.",
      "Check whether all multi-style inputs are covered.",
      "Check whether the image reaches professional, realistic, and clean commercial clothing photography standards."
    ],
    "priority_order": [
      "Absolutely no human or visible model appears",
      "Clothing maintains the three-dimensional volume of a natural wearing state",
      "Tops and bottoms are displayed together as a complete outfit",
      "Design accuracy of the reference drawing or user's text",
      "Consistency of front, side, and back views",
      "Real fabric and commercial photography texture",
      "Image layout and aesthetics"
    ]
  },
  "execution_rule": "When the user uploads a clothing reference image, default to extracting and restoring the complete outfit from the reference image. When the user does not provide a reference image but inputs text, style names, or clothing tables, default to designing a complete outfit directly based on the text. When the user provides a multi-style table, default to generating it style by style. Regardless of which mode is used, always only display the complete clothing supported by the invisible support effect, with no human bodies, mannequins, or models, without separating the clothes and pants, and never lying flat. Unless missing information makes it impossible for the task to be reasonably executed, generate it directly without repeatedly asking the user."
}

items.title: 真实照片与像素色彩索引对比海报

prompts.text: Use a single real photo as the sole source of content to create a vertical top-and-bottom comparison editorial poster. The upper half completely preserves the real photographic texture, subject identity, quantity, pose, spatial relationship, lighting, and composition of the input photo, without turning the photo into an illustration; the lower half is a stylized re-rendering area of the same photo: on warm white paper, the image is refined into four equal-sized square pixel color block indices, respectively corresponding to the most recognizable subject outline, architectural or object structure, relationship between main colors and light/shadow, and one environmental detail from the photo. Each grid uses hard-edged pixel blocks with a limited number of colors and a low-resolution grid feel, preserving traceable forms instead of random mosaics. The four grids are arranged in a 2×2 layout with ample paper space left around them; use thin black crosshair crop/registration marks to frame the index area, adding a very small amount of small bilingual titles and fields, such as "COLOR INDEX / SCENE STUDY," with restrained and clear text like print proof annotations that do not overshadow the main content. The lower half must look like a designed color index card, rather than a filter, ordinary pixelation, or repeated photo; do not add irrelevant objects or change the theme of the photo. The upper and lower areas each occupy about half, with a clear horizontal boundary; side-by-side layout is prohibited, multi-image collages are prohibited, "original/AI image" corner marks are prohibited, and watermarks and brand logos are prohibited. All colors are extracted and compressed from the input photo, and the content of the four grids changes according to the subject of the photo, applicable to any photo such as people, animals, architecture, street scenes, nature, interiors, food, and objects.

prompts.text: 使用一张真实照片作为唯一内容来源，制作一张竖版上下对比编辑海报。上半部完整保留输入照片的真实摄影质感、主体身份、数量、姿态、空间关系、光线和构图，不把照片画成插画；下半部为同一照片的风格化转绘区：在暖白纸面上，把画面提炼成四个等大的方形像素色块索引，分别对应照片中最有辨识度的主体轮廓、建筑或物体结构、主色与光影关系、一个环境细节。每格使用有限色数的硬边像素块和低分辨率网格感，保留可追溯的形体，不做随机马赛克。四格排列为2×2，周围留出充足纸面；用细黑色十字裁切/定位标记框住索引区域，加入极少量小型双语标题与字段，例如“COLOR INDEX / SCENE STUDY”，文字克制、清晰、像印刷校样标注，不喧宾夺主。下半区必须像一张经过设计的色彩索引卡，而不是滤镜、普通像素化或重复照片；不增加无关物件，不改变照片主题。上下区域约各占一半，水平边界清楚；禁止左右并排、禁止多图拼贴、禁止“原图/AI图”角标、禁止水印和品牌标志。所有颜色从输入照片提取并压缩，四格内容随照片主体变化，适用于人物、动物、建筑、街景、自然、室内、食物和物件等任何照片。

prompts.text:
Create a premium 4:5 vertical travel-editorial artwork for Dubai × Venezia — a poetic fusion of Dubai, United Arab Emirates and Venice, Italy.

PURE GENERATION.
Invent the complete artwork from the written destination or subject alone. The written destination is the only input. Create every visual element from your own knowledge and imagination.

MASTER STYLE LOCK:
Hand-painted watercolor on warm cream textured paper. Minimalist travel-editorial poster. Transparent watercolor blended with soft gouache. Soft imperfect brushwork, visible paper grain, organic painted edges, muted natural colors, generous negative space, quiet nostalgic atmosphere, sophisticated handcrafted art-book quality. Flat illustrated artwork with painterly depth. No 3D rendering, no glossy finish, no cartoon style, no digital photorealism.

DESTINATION INTERPRETATION:
Automatically identify the strongest visual identity of Dubai and Venice and merge their most recognizable characteristics naturally into one cohesive destination story. Combine the soaring modern presence of the Burj Khalifa and Dubai skyline with the historic charm of a traditional Arabian souk, warm lanterns, palm trees, patterned textiles, spices, pottery, and local market details. Blend these elements organically with the Venetian atmosphere of narrow historic canal streets, elegant old European buildings, arched bridges, flower-filled balconies, Venetian architecture, calm reflective water, wooden mooring poles, and traditional black gondolas.

Create ONE unified scene rather than a collection of separate elements. The fusion should feel believable, artistic, and naturally composed rather than like two separate pictures placed together.

COMPOSITION:
Use an elegant vertical editorial composition with one dominant focal point and several smaller supporting details. Establish clear foreground, middle ground, and background layers using watercolor washes and simplified shapes.

Place a graceful Venetian-style canal flowing through the central foreground and middle ground, with several elegant black gondolas moving quietly along the water. Let the canal lead the eye toward a historic architectural passage and softly glowing buildings. In the distant background, reveal the unmistakable Burj Khalifa rising dramatically above the city, creating a poetic contrast between Dubai's futuristic skyline and Venice's timeless architecture.

Frame the scene with traditional Arabian market stalls and warm wooden shopfronts on the lower sides, displaying colorful woven carpets, patterned textiles, ceramic vessels, brass lanterns, spices, dates, dried fruits, and handcrafted objects. Add subtle Venetian balconies, arched windows, flower boxes, stone bridges, and old façades around the canal.

Use hanging lantern strings and delicate star-shaped lights above parts of the market street, inspired by the Dubai reference, while allowing warm reflections to appear naturally across the canal water. Include a few palm trees near the market architecture and restrained Mediterranean greenery around the Venetian buildings.

Leave generous warm cream space around important forms. Keep the silhouette clean and immediately recognizable. Avoid overcrowding.

LOCAL STORY:
Show an authentic everyday moment connected to both destinations. Include subtle human activity only when it strengthens the story: people walking through the market, a local vendor arranging spices and pottery, travelers crossing a small stone bridge, a gondolier guiding a boat, people sitting quietly at a small café table, and visitors exploring the narrow passage.

Blend traditional Emirati/Arabian market life with the relaxed rhythm of Venetian canal life. Include people in natural, understated poses rather than making them the main subject.

Favor ordinary local atmosphere over generic tourism imagery.

LIGHT & ATMOSPHERE:
Automatically choose lighting that suits the destination and scene: soft golden late-afternoon light transitioning into a gentle warm evening glow. Use a dreamy sunset sky with pale peach, dusty blue, warm cream, muted lavender, and soft golden clouds.

Allow warm lanterns to glow subtly through the market while the Venetian canal catches delicate reflections of the surrounding architecture and evening lights. Keep the atmosphere peaceful, nostalgic, cinematic, and slightly dreamlike without becoming overly dramatic.

Use atmospheric watercolor washes to create depth while maintaining a calm, delicate feeling.

COLOR LANGUAGE:
Build the palette naturally from Dubai and Venice. Use warm cream, muted ochre, terracotta, dusty blue, soft green, faded red, warm grey, muted turquoise, antique gold, soft peach, and subtle golden tones where appropriate.

Use deeper warm browns and muted reds for Arabian textiles and market details, soft blue-grey and turquoise reflections for the Venetian water, pale stone tones for historic buildings, and restrained metallic gold for lanterns and architectural highlights.

Keep the colors slightly desaturated, harmonious, and naturally layered.

TYPOGRAPHY:
At the bottom of the artwork, add three restrained editorial text elements:

DUBAI × VENEZIA
WHERE DESERT DREAMS MEET FLOATING CITIES
A meeting of golden souks, timeless canals, and endless horizons.

Use elegant minimal typography with generous spacing. Keep it secondary to the artwork and ensure all wording is clean and correctly spelled.

FINAL AESTHETIC:
Premium handmade watercolor travel poster × contemporary editorial illustration × nostalgic travel memory × quiet everyday life × sophisticated art-book design.

The finished artwork should feel like a beautifully remembered meeting between two iconic worlds: Dubai's futuristic ambition and Arabian heritage flowing naturally into Venice's historic canals, gondolas, bridges, and timeless architecture. Make the result atmospheric, personal, refined, understated, and unmistakably connected to both destinations.

AVOID:
Any editing workflow, source material, references, existing compositions, copied imagery, collage construction, unrelated landmarks, generic scenery, excessive detail, oversaturated colors, harsh outlines, glossy digital effects, CGI, 3D objects, cartoon characters, clutter, excessive typography, logos, watermarks, interface elements.

FORMAT:
4:5 vertical portrait composition, warm cream paper, handcrafted watercolor texture, generous negative space, premium print-quality finish.

prompts.text:
为迪拜 × 威尼斯创作一件高级 4:5 纵向旅行编辑艺术作品——阿拉伯联合酋长国迪拜与意大利威尼斯的诗意融合。

纯粹生成。
仅根据书写的目的地或主题构思完整的艺术作品。书写的目的地是唯一的输入。根据你自己的知识和想象力创造每一个视觉元素。

大师风格锁定：
暖奶油色纹理纸上的手绘水彩。极简主义旅行编辑海报。透明水彩与柔和的水粉融合。柔和且不完美的笔触、可见的纸张纹理、有机绘画边缘、柔和的自然色彩、大量的留白、宁静的怀旧氛围、精致的手工艺艺术书品质。具有绘画深度的平面插画艺术作品。无 3D 渲染，无光泽饰面，无卡通风格，无数字写实主义。

目的地解读：
自动识别迪拜和威尼斯最强烈的视觉标识，并将它们最显著的特征自然地融合到一个连贯的目的地故事中。将哈利法塔和迪拜天际线高耸的现代感与传统阿拉伯集市的历史魅力、温暖的灯笼、棕榈树、图案纺织品、香料、陶器和当地市场细节结合起来。将这些元素与威尼斯的氛围有机融合，包括狭窄的历史运河街道、优雅的欧洲古建筑、拱桥、鲜花点缀的阳台、威尼斯建筑、平静的倒影水面、木制系泊桩和传统黑色贡多拉。

创建一个统一的场景，而不是独立元素的集合。这种融合应该让人感到真实、具有艺术感且构图自然，而不是像两张分开的照片放在一起。

构图：
使用优雅的纵向编辑构图，具有一个主导焦点和几个较小的辅助细节。使用水彩渲染和简化的形状建立清晰的前景、中景和背景层。

在中心前景和中景布置一条优美的威尼斯风格运河，几艘优雅的黑色贡多拉在水面上静静移动。让运河引导视线走向历史建筑通道和柔光闪烁的建筑。在远景中，展示哈利法塔在城市上方戏剧性地升起，在迪拜的未来感天际线与威尼斯的永恒建筑之间创造出诗意的对比。

用传统的阿拉伯市场摊位和温暖的木制店面构筑场景的下方两侧，展示色彩缤纷的编织地毯、图案纺织品、陶瓷器皿、黄铜灯笼、香料、椰枣、干果和手工艺品。在运河周围添加微妙的威尼斯阳台、拱窗、花箱、石桥和古老外墙。

在部分市场街道上方使用悬挂的灯笼串和精致的星形灯，其灵感来自迪拜，同时让温暖的倒影自然地出现在运河水面上。在市场建筑附近添加一些棕榈树，并在威尼斯建筑周围添加克制的希腊地中海绿植。

在重要形状周围留出大量的暖奶油色空间。保持轮廓简洁且易于识别。避免过度拥挤。

当地故事：
展示与两个目的地相关的真实日常生活瞬间。仅在能强化故事时加入微妙的人物活动：穿过市场的人们、整理香料和陶器的当地商贩、穿过小石桥的游客、划着贡多拉的船夫、静静坐在小咖啡馆桌旁的人们，以及探索狭窄通道的访客。

将传统的阿联酋/阿拉伯市场生活与威尼斯运河生活的悠闲节奏融为一体。将人物置于自然、低调的姿态中，而不是让他们成为主角。

偏向平凡的当地氛围，而非通用的旅游图像。

光影与氛围：
自动选择适合目的地和场景的光影：柔和的金色午后光线转变为温柔温暖的傍晚霞光。使用带有淡桃红色、灰蓝色、暖奶油色、柔和紫色和浅金色云彩的梦幻落日天空。

让温暖的灯笼在市场中透出微妙的光芒，同时威尼斯运河捕捉到周围建筑和晚灯的精致倒影。保持氛围宁静、怀旧、电影化且略显梦幻，不要过于戏剧化。

使用大气的水彩渲染来创造深度，同时保持平静、细腻的感觉。

色彩语言：
自然地根据迪拜和威尼斯构建色调。在适当的地方使用暖奶油色、柔和的赭石色、陶土色、灰蓝色、柔和的绿色、褪色的红色、暖灰色、柔和的青绿色、古董金、柔和的桃色和微妙的金色调。

在阿拉伯纺织品和市场细节中使用更深的暖棕色和柔和红色，在威尼斯水面使用柔和的蓝灰色和青绿色倒影，在历史建筑中使用淡石色调，在灯笼和建筑高光处使用克制的金属金。

保持色彩略显低饱和度、和谐且层次自然。

排版：
在艺术作品的底部，添加三个克制的编辑文本元素：

DUBAI × VENEZIA
WHERE DESERT DREAMS MEET FLOATING CITIES
A meeting of golden souks, timeless canals, and endless horizons.

使用优雅的极简排版，并留有充足的间距。使其相对于艺术作品处于次要地位，并确保所有措辞干净且拼写正确。

最终审美：
高级手工水彩旅行海报 × 当代编辑插画 × 怀旧旅行记忆 × 宁静的日常生活 × 精致的艺术书设计。

完成后的艺术作品应该感觉像是两个标志性世界之间一次美好的相遇：迪拜的未来主义雄心和阿拉伯遗产自然地融入威尼斯的历史运河、贡多拉、桥梁和永恒建筑中。让结果充满氛围感、个性化、精致、低调，并与两个目的地有着明确的联系。

避免：
任何编辑工作流程、源材料、参考资料、现有构图、复制图像、拼贴构造、无关地标、通用场景、细节过多、色彩过饱和、粗糙轮廓、光泽数字效果、CGI、3D 物体、卡通人物、杂乱、过多的排版、徽标、水印、界面元素。

格式：
4:5 纵向构图，暖奶油色纸张，手工水彩纹理，大量的留白空间，高级印刷品质饰面。

保留三名角色的发型、发色、眼睛、标志性配饰、服装领口与身份特征，采用成熟角色设定。三个角色沿画面中央纵向分成三层排列，从与背景同色的不可见横向边缘后探出：上层露出头部与双手，中层只露出头部，下层露出头部与搭在边缘的双手。身体下缘形成清楚的水平遮挡，层间与左右保留充足留白。

根据角色配色选择单一深色背景，以暖色肤色与角色色块形成鲜明对比。构图简单、居中、纵向堆叠，具有旧儿童读物与20世纪中期书籍封面的气质。3:4竖版，右下角极小 voxcat 签名。

items.title: 现代简约旅行艺术海报设计

prompts.text:
Create a sophisticated contemporary travel-art poster from the uploaded londscape photograph.
Strict 3:4 vertical format.
The upper half must remain the original landscape photogroph. Preserve all important environmental structures, natural textures, lighting, shadows, horizon, architecture, people and perspective. Do not regenerate the scene.
The lower half reconstructs the landscape's strongest narrative element using delicate photographic fragments, halftone printing, subtle paper fibers and fading edges.
Use a single horizontal geometric color field sampled from the landscape. Let the reconstructed subject or horizon physically intersect this field.
Keep the background most white with muted tones derived from the original image. Avoid saturated colors.
The result should resemble a limited-edition museum travel poster rather than a conventional photo collage.

items.title: 真实摄影与白色手绘巨猫创意涂鸦插画

prompts.text:
Please create a piece based on a photo I uploaded:

Realistic Photography × White Hand-drawn Cat Doodle Creative Illustration
Overall visual direction adopts:
Photography × Hand-drawn Doodle Illustration / Mixed Media / Visual Metaphor / Surreal Scale Play / Editorial Illustration

01｜Original Photo Part
Try to keep the real content in the photo I uploaded as complete as possible, including:
Real scenes
Subject buildings / Scenery / People / Roads / Water surfaces / Mountains / Trees / Sky
Original composition
Shooting angle
Perspective relationship
Light direction
Environmental atmosphere
Photography texture
Do not change locations at will,
Do not redesign the main buildings,
Do not change the core real spatial relationships,
Make sure the core objects in the photo remain clear, real, and easy to identify.

02｜Core Creative Logic
On top of the real photo, add a super-large-scale white hand-drawn line-art cat.
This cat is not simply standing next to the scene being cute,
It must form a clever, interesting, natural, and instantly understandable interactive creative relationship with the real environment based on the real objects, architectural structures, natural forms, or spatial relationships in the photo.
The cat must be like it is in the real world causing mischief, playing, lying down, peeking, pouncing, leaning, stretching its paws, rubbing, chasing, poking its head out, hiding, napping, or stretching,
And it must have clear interaction with the real scenery.

03｜Cat Interaction Creative Direction (Automatically judge the most suitable one)
Please automatically find the most interesting visual associations based on the actual photo content I upload.
For example, but not limited to:
High towers / Antennas / Street lamps → The cat is stretching out a paw to fiddle with it, hugging it, or playing with it like a cat teaser wand.
Bridges / Railings / Wires / Roads → The cat treats it as a toy next to its tail, a scratching line, or a catwalk path.
Building roofs / Walls / Hillsides / Grass → The cat is lying down, rolling over, poking its head out, or sunbathing.
Rivers / Lakes / Water surfaces / Reflections → The cat looks down at itself in the water, stretches a paw to splash water, or chases a reflection.
Windows / Doorways / Holes / Architectural gaps → The cat peeks out secretly, plays hide-and-seek, or looks out from behind.
Branches / Flowers / Clouds / Sky → The cat pounces on butterflies, smells flowers, or chases floating little things.
Food / Roadside objects / Small cars / Lights → The cat approaches curiously, stretches a paw to test it, or wants to play secretly.
But do not mechanically apply these examples;
You must automatically judge the most reasonable, clever, and natural interactive relationship based on the photo I actually upload.

04｜Cat Image Requirements
The cat adopts:
A simple, natural, healing, slightly childlike white hand-drawn line-art style
Requirements:
Lines drawn directly on the photo with a white marker / white chalk / white fineliner
Slightly varied line thickness
Clear outlines but not overly complex
No stacking of realistic fur details
No detailed manga style
No thick outlines
No 3D cartoon feel
No sticker feel
The cat can be:
Just one cat
Obvious sense of giant-scale displacement
Larger than real buildings or scenery
But the movement and perspective must be natural and reasonable
Cat expression:
Minimalist facial features
Gentle
Curious
Cute and blank
Secretly mischievous
Healing
Humorous
Sense of participation

05｜Recommended Actions
Cat actions should have a sense of life and interaction, such as:
Resting on the horizon / grass / roof
Peeking from behind a wall or window
Stretching a paw to touch a building / lamp / branch / reflection / food
Hugging a tower / utility pole / street lamp
Hiding behind a building showing half a face
Rubbing against a wall or scenery
Staring at the real subject
Being curious about people or objects on the road
Gently pouncing on an environmental element
Interacting with shadows / reflections in the photo
Note:
Actions must be built on real perspective;
It cannot just be "putting a cat on it,"
It must be as if it is really there.

06｜Line-art Style Requirements
The hand-drawn part must focus on white line-art, emphasizing: a stick-figure feel
Sense of negative space
Sense of transparency
No large areas of solid color filling
No thick fur brushstrokes
No complex cross-hatching
No excessive fragmentation
No too many small decorations
If details need to be added, keep only a small amount of:
Action lines
Small hearts
Small stars
Small flowers
Small tail wagging lines
Small paw action lines
All must be kept as restrained as possible.

07｜Color Requirements
Overall based on:
White line-art as the absolute main body
Only a small amount of one low-saturation color is allowed:
Mustard yellow
Warm yellow
Golden yellow
As local visual highlights.
Yellow can only be used in small amounts for:
Small flowers
Small stars
Small light spots
Small butterflies
Small fish
Small toys
Small props the cat is interacting with
Local warm highlight hints
The yellow area should not be too large; keep it restrained.
Do not let the colored parts overshadow the main subject.

08｜Composition Requirements
Real photography still occupies the main visual foundation.
The cat line-art should be placed reasonably according to the photo composition:
Utilize sky negative space
Utilize grass
Utilize walls
Utilize water surfaces
Utilize roads
Utilize architectural edges
Utilize the horizon
Utilize windows / trees / bridges
Avoid blocking the most important architectural details.
Between the cat and real objects, there must be formed:
Accurate spatial relationships
Accurate perspective relationships
Accurate action relationships
Let the viewer understand the creativity at first glance,
And discover details at the second glance.

09｜Overall Temperament
The overall image should maintain:
Minimalist, clean, humorous, designed, storytelling
Visual contrast, healing feel, sense of participation, high-end creative advertisement feel
Editorial Illustration texture
Conceptual Photography temperament
The final effect should be like:
The real world was quietly invaded by an imaginative cat.
Photography is responsible for reality, lines are responsible for imagination,
Both together form a complete, clever little story.

10｜Negative Constraints
Do Not:
Do not change the core structure of real buildings
Do not remake the background
Do not add a large number of characters
Do not draw many cats
Do not do full-screen graffiti
Do not do ordinary sticker effects
Do not do 3D cartoons
Do not do children's illustrations full of elements
Do not use thick black outlines
Do not use complex manga styles
Do not use realistic colored cats
Do not use large areas of solid color filling
Do not add text
Do not add titles
Do not add Logos
Do not add watermarks
Must maintain:
Original photo subject clearly identifiable
Real photography texture
Natural fusion of hand-drawing and photography

prompts.text:
请将我上传的一张照片创作成一张：

真实摄影 × 白色手绘猫咪涂鸦创意插画
整体视觉方向采用：
Photography × Hand-drawn Doodle Illustration / Mixed Media / Visual Metaphor / Surreal Scale Play / Editorial Illustration

01｜原始照片部分
尽量完整保留我上传照片中的真实内容，包括：

真实场景
主体建筑 / 景物 / 人物 / 道路 / 水面 / 山体 / 树木 / 天空

原始构图
拍摄角度
透视关系
光线方向
环境氛围
摄影质感

不要随意更换地点，
不要重新设计主体建筑，
不要改变最核心的真实空间关系，
要让照片中的核心对象仍然清晰、真实、容易辨认。

02｜核心创意逻辑
在真实照片之上，加入 一只超大比例的白色手绘线稿猫咪。

这只猫咪不是简单地站在画面旁边卖萌，
而是必须根据照片中的真实物体、建筑结构、自然形态或空间关系，
与现实环境形成一个 聪明、有趣、自然、第一眼就能看懂的互动创意。
猫咪必须像是在 真实世界里捣蛋、玩耍、趴着、偷窥、扑抓、依靠、伸爪、蹭、追逐、探头、藏身、打盹、伸懒腰，
并且与真实景物发生明确互动。
03｜猫咪互动创意方向（自动判断最适合的一种）
请根据我上传的实际照片内容，自动寻找最有趣的视觉联想。

例如但不限于：

高塔 / 天线 / 路灯 → 猫咪正在伸爪拨弄、抱住、当逗猫棒玩

桥梁 / 栏杆 / 电线 / 道路 → 猫咪把它当作尾巴旁的玩具、抓线、猫步路径

建筑屋顶 / 墙面 / 山坡 / 草地 → 猫咪趴着、打滚、探头、晒太阳

河流 / 湖泊 / 水面 / 倒影 → 猫咪低头看水中自己、伸爪拨水、追逐倒影

窗户 / 门洞 / 洞口 / 建筑缝隙 → 猫咪偷偷探头、躲猫猫、从后面偷看

树枝 / 花朵 / 云朵 / 天空 → 猫咪扑蝴蝶、闻花、追逐飘动的小东西

食物 / 路边物件 / 小车 / 灯光 → 猫咪好奇靠近、伸爪试探、想偷玩

但不要机械套用这些例子，
必须根据我实际上传的照片自动判断 最合理、最巧妙、最自然 的互动关系。

04｜猫咪形象要求

猫咪采用：

简洁、自然、治愈、略带童趣的白色手绘线稿风格

要求：
线条白色马克笔 / 白色粉笔 / 白色针管笔直接画在照片上
线条粗细略有变化
轮廓清楚但不过度复杂
不要写实毛发细节堆砌
不要精细漫画风
不要厚重描边
不要3D卡通感
不要贴纸感

猫咪可以是：

一只猫即可
巨型尺度错位感明显
比真实建筑或景物更大
但动作和透视要自然合理

猫咪表情：
极简五官
温柔
好奇
呆萌
偷偷捣蛋
治愈
幽默
有参与感

05｜推荐动作
猫咪动作要有生活感和互动感，例如：
趴在地平线 / 草地 / 屋顶上休息
从墙后或窗边探头偷看

伸爪去碰建筑 / 灯 / 树枝 / 倒影 / 食物

抱住高塔 / 电线杆 / 路灯
藏在建筑后面露出半张脸
蹭着墙面或景物
盯着真实主体看
对着路上的人或物产生好奇
轻轻扑玩某个环境元素
和照片中的影子 / 倒影互动
注意：
动作必须建立在真实透视基础上，
不能只是“把猫放上去”，
而要像它真的在那里一样。

06｜线稿风格要求

手绘部分必须以 白色线稿 为主，强调：简笔画感

留白感
透明感
不要大面积实色填充
不要厚重毛发笔触
不要复杂排线
不要过度细碎
不要过多小装饰
如果需要补充细节，只保留少量：
动作线
小爱心
小星星
小花
小尾巴晃动线
小爪子动作线

全部也要尽量克制。

07｜色彩要求

整体以：

白色线稿为绝对主体
只允许少量加入一种低饱和的：
芥末黄
暖黄色
金黄色
作为局部视觉重点。

黄色只能少量用于：
小花
小星星
小光点
小蝴蝶
小鱼
小玩具
猫咪正在互动的小道具
局部温暖高光提示

黄色面积不要过大，保持克制。
不要让彩色部分喧宾夺主。

08｜构图要求

真实摄影仍然占据主要视觉基础。

猫咪线稿要根据照片构图合理放置：

利用天空留白
利用草地
利用墙面
利用水面
利用道路
利用建筑边缘
利用地平线
利用窗边 / 树旁 / 桥边
避免挡住最重要的建筑细节。

猫咪与真实物体之间必须形成：
准确的空间关系
准确的透视关系
准确的动作关系
让观者第一眼看懂创意，
第二眼发现细节。
09｜整体气质
画面整体要保持：

极简、干净、幽默、有设计感、有故事性
有视觉反差、有治愈感、有参与感、高级创意广告感
Editorial Illustration 质感
Conceptual Photography 气质

最终效果要像：
现实世界被一只充满想象力的猫咪悄悄入侵了一下。
摄影负责真实，线条负责想象，
两者共同组成一个完整、有巧思的小故事。

10｜负面约束
不要：
不改变真实建筑最核心的结构
不重做背景
不增加大量角色
不画很多只猫
不做满屏涂鸦
不做普通贴纸效果
不做3D卡通
不做儿童插画堆满元素
不用黑色粗描边
不要复杂漫画风
不要写实彩色猫
不要大面积实色填充
不添加文字
不添加标题
不添加 Logo
不添加水印

必须保持：
原照片主体清晰可辨
真实摄影质感
手绘与摄影自然融合
