prompts.text:
Theme:
Ivory dress and soft lighting

Subject:
Adult female in her 20s. Sitting on the rug to the right side of a classical sofa, torso slightly facing the front, legs folded towards the right side of the frame. The head is tilted down to the left side.

Character/Expression:
A slender oval face and a small chin, a thin nose bridge. Brown eyes half-closed, coral-colored lips slightly parted. Not looking directly at the camera. Brown hair tied in a low loose bun at the back of the head, with thin bangs and long hair strands hanging down along the cheeks. Bright warm peach skin, with a soft glow on the cheeks and nose.

Clothing/Pose:
An ivory-colored spaghetti strap long wrap dress. Overlapping fabric at the chest and a large knot at the right waist, with overlapping thin skirt hems. Flower and long pearl drop earrings, a slender moon-shaped pendant. The left elbow on the left side of the frame rests on the sofa cushion, the forearm is raised, and fingertips are near the eyes. The right arm is lowered towards the right side, with fingertips cutting out of the frame. Legs are folded horizontally, and part of the lower leg is exposed from the front skirt, extending towards the bottom right.

Background/Lighting:
On the left is a beige sofa with gold trim, and below is a rug with an elegant pattern. Warm table lamps, pale pink flowers, and candles are placed on low furniture in the back right. The entire room is enveloped in soft warm light, gently outlining the shadows of the face and fabric.

Composition/Lens:
From a slightly elevated angle in front, looking down at the sitting posture. Aspect ratio 362:483. Little headroom, capturing from the face to the spread skirt and part of the leg at the bottom right. The sofa on the left slightly overlaps with the figure on the right.

Texture/Style:
A warm photograph in cream and gold. Smooth skin gradients, delicate folds of the thin dress, and the woven texture details of the sofa are preserved.

prompts.text:
主题：
象牙色连衣裙与柔和灯光

主体：
20多岁的成年女性。坐在古典沙发右侧的地毯上，身躯略微面向正面，双腿折叠向画面右侧。头部向左侧倾斜低垂。

人物・表情：
细长的卵形脸和小巧的下巴，纤细的鼻梁。棕色的眼睛半闭，珊瑚色的嘴唇微微张开。不直视镜头。棕色的头发在脑后低松挽成髻，薄薄的刘海和沿脸颊的长发束垂下。明亮温暖的桃色肌肤，脸颊和鼻子上带有柔和的光泽。

服装・姿势：
象牙色的细肩带长款裹身连衣裙。胸前交叉的布料和右腰部的大结扣，薄薄的裙摆重叠。花朵和长珍珠耳坠，细长的月形吊坠。画面左侧的肘部倚靠在沙发垫子上，前臂抬起，指尖靠近眼部。右臂低垂向右侧，手尖向外切出。双腿横向折叠，前方裙摆露出一部分小腿向右下方伸出。

背景・光线：
左侧是金边的米色沙发，下方是淡雅花纹的地毯。右后方的矮家具上摆放温暖的台灯、淡粉色的花朵和蜡烛。整个房间被柔和的暖色光线笼罩，温和地勾勒出脸部和布料的阴影。

构图・镜头：
从正面略微斜上方的角度，低头俯视坐姿。纵横比362:483。头部上方留白较少，从脸部到展开的裙摆以及右下方腿部的一部分纳入画面。左侧的沙发与右侧的人物略有重叠。

质感・风格：
奶油色与金色的温暖照片。肌肤平滑的色阶，薄款连衣裙的细腻褶皱，沙发的织纹细节得以保留。

Deconstruct the main subject in the photo into a small number of flat geometric planes, black outlines of varying thickness, and limited 2–4 color blocks; retain the identity, quantity, action direction, and most critical structure of the subject. Use arrows, dotted lines, numbered dots, partial enlargement boxes, short labels, and concise structural lines to explain visible features, forming an instructional relationship like "how to observe/how to identify." Style/medium: 纸张说明卡、旅行观察页、克制的几何拼贴与手工印刷图解。把照片中的主体拆成少量平面几何面、粗细不一的黑色轮廓线和有限的 2–4 色块；保留主体身份、数量、动作方向和最关键的结构。用箭头、虚线、编号圆点、局部放大框、短标签和简洁结构线解释可见特征，形成像“如何观察/如何识别”一样的说明关系。标注必须指向真实可见的主体部件或空间关系，不添加照片中不存在的对象。
Scene/backdrop: 下半部使用温暖的米白纸张底，轻微纸纤维、印刷不齐和低对比颗粒；颜色从输入照片提取并压缩，不固定蓝海或狗的模板。主体与说明框之间留出呼吸空间。
Text: 只加入 1 个简短英文标题、1 个材料/观察字段和 1 句极短说明；文字像印在纸卡上的标签，避免长段落、假中文、网址、二维码、品牌和水印。若照片主题不同，标题和字段必须根据照片事实替换。
Constraints: 保持真实照片中的主体身份、数量、姿态、动作方向、关键结构、光照方向和主要空间关系；上半部不能画成插画、不能替换主体、不能模糊或重构照片。下半部必须仍能一眼对应上半部同一主体，并明确体现几何分解、箭头标注和说明页机制。不要出现“原图/AI图”角标。
Avoid: 仅调色、仅加颗粒、普通卡通滤镜、写实照片占满下半区、无意义装饰贴纸、固定狗/海滩元素、过度复杂的工程制图、密集难读的小字、额外人物和无关地标。

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 high-end multi-character editorial poster about [THEME].

Include 4–7 clearly different characters with distinct ages, roles, personalities, poses, and relationships. Build a believable story around why they belong in the same poster.

Use [VISUAL STRUCTURE: oversized typography / layered bands / geometric cuts / circular composition / freeform collage / irregular portrait grid] as the main graphic system.

Mix large, medium, and small figures using full-body, half-body, close-up, side-profile, and partial crops. Avoid equal-sized people and evenly spaced layouts.

Integrate people directly with typography and graphic shapes through overlap, masking, negative space, cropping, and foreground/background relationships.

Use [COLOR PALETTE] with bold editorial typography. Main title: “[TITLE]”. All visible text in English.

Keep the composition rich, bold, story-driven, and highly designed, with strong thumbnail impact and meaningful information density.

Style: contemporary cultural poster, film ensemble poster, independent magazine, Korean editorial design, European graphic design, realistic editorial photography.

Avoid generic group photos, repeated faces, same-age characters, rigid cards, simple text-image blocks, regular grids, meaningless filler text, corporate poster styling, 3D type, watermarks, numbering, and sparkle symbols.

prompts.text:
创建一张关于[主题]的 9:16 高级多角色社论海报。

包括 4–7 个明显不同的角色，具有截然不同的年龄、角色、个性、姿势和关系。围绕他们为何出现在同一张海报中构建一个可信的故事。

使用 [视觉结构：超大版式 / 分层带状 / 几何切割 / 圆形构图 / 自由形式拼贴 / 不规则人像网格] 作为主要的图形系统。

混合使用全身、半身、特写、侧面和局部裁剪的大、中、小人物。避免大小相同的人物和均匀间隔的布局。

通过重叠、遮罩、负空间、裁剪以及前景/背景关系，将人物直接与排版和图形形状结合。

使用 [调色板] 和大胆的社论排版。主标题：“[标题]”。所有可见文本均为英文。

保持构图丰富、大胆、故事驱动且高度设计感，具有强烈的缩略图冲击力和有意义的信息密度。

prompts.text:
Create a premium 3:4 vertical editorial poster using the uploaded photo as the sole reference.

OVERALL FORMAT

The image must use a strict 3:4 vertical composition divided horizontally into two equal regions with an exact 1:1 height ratio. Each region occupies exactly 50% of the total image height.

UPPER REGION: ORIGINAL PHOTO

Use the original uploaded photo directly as the upper 50% of the composition.

Preserve the subject's exact identity, facial features, body structure, proportions, posture, perspective, clothing, materials, lighting, and original color atmosphere.

Do not regenerate, reshape, distort, stretch, beautify, or alter the subject.

Only apply subtle high-end color grading, image purification, refined tonal balance, and gentle detail enhancement, giving the image the refined texture of an art magazine or exhibition photograph.

The background may be moderately expanded to fit the 3:4 composition, but the subject must remain completely unchanged in structure, posture, proportions, and core composition.

LOWER REGION: MINIMALIST INK WASH RECONSTRUCTION

Reconstruct the same subject and scene as a minimalist contemporary ink wash artwork.

First identify and preserve the most recognizable elements of the original image, including silhouette, outline, structure, perspective, movement, visual rhythm, spatial relationship, and overall atmosphere.

Do not directly copy photographic details. Do not create a realistic reproduction. Instead, translate the original scene into an artistic ink wash interpretation that preserves its recognizable essence and visual relationship with the upper photograph.

Use a milky white, warm white, or natural paper-white base with delicate paper fibers and subtle organic texture.

Build the artwork using expressive ink wash techniques including dry and wet brushwork, flying white, ink seepage, ink accumulation, soft diffusion, broken edges, layered washes, and intentional white space.

Remove secondary details. Keep only the most distinctive contours, structural transitions, spatial layers, movement, and atmosphere.

The lower artwork should feel summarized, refined, poetic, and intentionally incomplete rather than realistically detailed.

INK AND COLOR

Use black, charcoal gray, soft gray, and diluted ink tones as the dominant palette.

Create clear tonal layering with varied ink density, pressure, rhythm, and transparency.

Extract only a few emotionally important colors from the original image and reinterpret them as small areas of artistic staining or pigment.

Colors may transform naturally into blue-gray, distant blue, soft gold, warm yellow, vermilion red, light cyan, or similar restrained tones.

Do not mechanically reproduce the original color values.

Ink and negative space must remain dominant.

Avoid muddy brown, dull vintage tones, heavy coloring, excessive decoration, or vulgar color combinations.

COMPOSITION AND NEGATIVE SPACE

The main reconstructed subject should occupy approximately 30% to 45% of the lower half.

Reserve the remaining area for generous negative space.

The artwork may be asymmetrically positioned, partially framed, suspended, slightly cropped, or offset.

Maintain strong asymmetrical balance and a sophisticated editorial composition.

The edges of the ink artwork should gradually loosen, fragment, fade, scatter, and disappear into the paper, creating a natural sense of breathing space.

Negative space must function as an intentional visual element, not as empty unused space.

Reduce information rather than filling the entire lower region.

The final lower section should resemble a refined ink seal, contemporary Eastern material study, or museum-quality oriental artwork displayed on a clean editorial page.

TEXT

Use very little text.

Do not add preset titles, numbers, labels, or template typography.

If appropriate, extract only a few meaningful words or a very short phrase related to the subject, location, time, action, emotion, or metaphor.

Place the text quietly within the negative space or near the edge of the artwork.

Typography must remain subtle, sparse, elegant, and secondary to the visual composition.

OVERALL AESTHETIC

Contemporary Eastern aesthetics.

Minimalist ink wash reconstruction.

Premium art magazine presentation.

Exhibition photography quality.

Large-scale intentional negative space.

Subtle editorial typography.

Small-scale seal-like visual focus.

Quiet, restrained, poetic atmosphere.

Elegant asymmetrical composition.

Refined paper texture.

Museum-quality visual finish.

Avoid complex backgrounds, excessive photographic details, realistic duplication, decorative clutter, excessive text, rigid template layouts, filled compositions, heavy colors, old-fashioned brown tones, and unnecessary visual elements.

prompts.text:
使用上传的照片作为唯一参考，创建一张高级 3:4 竖向编辑海报。

整体格式

图像必须采用严格的 3:4 竖向构图，水平分为两个高度比例精确为 1:1 的相等区域。每个区域正好占据图像总高度的 50%。

上半区域：原始照片

直接将原始上传的照片用作构图的上半部 50%。

保留主体的准确身份、面部特征、身体结构、比例、姿势、透视、服装、材质、光影和原始色彩氛围。

不要重新生成、重塑、扭曲、拉伸、美化或改变主体。

仅应用细微的高端调色、图像净化、精细的色调平衡和柔和的细节增强，使图像具有艺术杂志或展览照片的精致质感。

背景可以适度扩展以适应 3:4 的构图，但主体的结构、姿势、比例和核心构图必须保持完全不变。

下半区域：极简水墨重构

将相同的主体和场景重构为极简主义的当代水墨艺术品。

首先识别并保留原始图像中最具辨识度的元素，包括轮廓、外形、结构、透视、动作、视觉节奏、空间关系和整体氛围。

不要直接复制摄影细节。不要进行写实再现。相反，将原始场景转化为一种艺术化的水墨演绎，保留其可辨识的本质以及与上方照片的视觉关系。

使用乳白色、暖白色或天然纸白色底色，带有细腻的纸张纤维和微妙的有机纹理。

使用表现力丰富的水墨技法构建作品，包括干湿笔触、飞白、沁墨、积墨、柔和扩散、断边、分层渲染和有意的留白。

移除次要细节。仅保留最独特的轮廓、结构过渡、空间层次、动作和氛围。

下方的艺术作品应该是高度概括、精炼、富有诗意且有意不完整的，而不是写实细节的。

墨色与色彩

使用黑色、木炭灰、柔和的灰色和稀释的墨色调作为主导色调。

通过不同的墨浓度、压力、节奏和透明度创造清晰的色调层次。

仅从原始图像中提取少量情感重要的颜色，并将其重新演绎为小面积的艺术晕染或颜料。

颜色可以自然地转化为蓝灰色、远山蓝、柔金、暖黄、朱红、淡青或类似的克制色调。

不要机械地复制原始颜色的数值。

水墨和留白必须保持主导地位。

避免浑浊的褐色、沉闷的复古色调、重彩、过度装饰或庸俗的色彩组合。

构图与留白

重构的主要主体应占据下半部分的约 30% 到 45%。

剩余区域留出大量的负空间（留白）。

艺术作品可以非对称定位、部分构图、悬浮、略微剪裁或偏移。

保持强烈的非对称平衡和精致的编辑式构图。

水墨作品的边缘应逐渐松散、破碎、褪色、消散并消失在纸张中，创造一种自然的呼吸感。

负空间必须作为一种有意的视觉元素而存在，而不是未使用的空白。

通过减少信息而非填满整个下方区域来构图。

最终的下方部分应像精美的水墨印章、当代东方材质研究或展示在干净编辑页面上的博物馆级东方艺术品。

文字

使用极少的文字。

不要添加预设标题、数字、标签或模板排版。

如果合适，仅提取少量与主体、地点、时间、动作、情感或隐喻相关的有意义词汇或极短的短语。

将文字安静地放置在负空间内或艺术作品边缘附近。

排版必须保持微妙、稀疏、优雅，并服从于视觉构图。

整体美学

当代东方美学。

极简水墨重构。

高级艺术杂志呈现。

展览摄影品质。

大面积有意的留白。

微妙的编辑排版。

印章式的视觉焦点。

安静、克制、富有诗意的氛围。

优雅的非对称构图。

精细的纸张纹理。

博物馆级的视觉效果。

避免复杂的背景、过多的摄影细节、写实复制、装饰堆砌、过多的文字、僵化的模板布局、填满的构图、沉重的色彩、过时的褐色调以及不必要的视觉元素。

items.title: 电影感高级时尚九宫格叙事摄影

prompts.text:
Use the attached image as the sole reference for the same character and the same photography series.

The character's facial features, hairstyle, body type, clothing, skin texture, lighting texture, color tone, film feel, atmospheric feel, and the worldview as a photograph are all faithfully inherited from the attached image.

However, it is not to reproduce the attached image itself.

The composition, pose, camera position, angle, shooting distance, cropping, and frame composition of the attached image are not to be copied at all.

Reconstruct this character and the world as if they exist within a feature film.

Not merely a fashion photo variation,

but as a 

"photography series established as nine moments captured from a movie."

Let each photo have different visual drama and narrativity.

Moments of the character waiting for something, staring at something, in motion, at rest, existing in the distance, etc., allowing one to feel clear situational differences.

But do not fixedly specify specific locations, small props, or events; instead, let them unfold naturally within the range of the interpretable worldview of the attached image.

Lighting is not handled as simple, beautiful, and uniform illumination, but as cinematic lighting.

Boldly incorporate strong light and deep shadows, partial backlighting, silhouettes, moments where light captures only a part of the character, characters emerging from the shadows, light streaming in from a distance, light that allows one to feel the change in time of day, etc.

Through light and shadow, create tension, tranquility, lingering resonance, loneliness, anticipation, anxiety, a sense of liberation, and other emotional shifts that do not rely on words in the photos.

Overall,

create an extremely sophisticated cinematic photography story that sits between high-fashion editorial photos and a scene from a movie.

The nine photos are each independent as complete works, while at the same time, when placed side-by-side, give the feeling of watching fragments of a single film.

【Composition of the Nine Photos】

Arrange the nine photos in a 3×3 grid.

In all nine, significantly change the shooting distance, the character's occupancy in the frame, camera height, angle of view, body cropping method, and relationship with the space.

Consciously mix the following visual scales.

・Partial extreme close-ups of eyes, face, hands, fingers, feet, legs, etc.

・Photos cropping only a certain part of the body

・Photos centered on the back or the figure from behind

・Mid-range portraits of the character

・Full-body photos capturing the whole body

・Photos placing the character small at the edge or corner of the frame

・Long shots of the character as a tiny presence in a vast space

・Photos where the scale of space or landscape is felt more strongly than the character

・Cinematic wide-angle shots where the character exists in only a very small part of the frame

Clearly contrast photos where the character fills the frame with photos where the character occupies only a tiny part of the frame.

The camera angle also changes significantly.

Not limited to eye level, but also combining low angles, high angles, distant perspectives, perspectives shot from behind the character, perspectives capturing the character through space, etc.

Do not lean toward the front; actively use side profiles, back views, compositions showing only the body, compositions where the face is out of the frame, compositions where only a part of the character enters the frame, etc.

All nine use different compositions.

Do not repeat similar facial close-ups.

Do not repeat the same pose.

Do not repeat the same shooting distance.

Do not repeat the same camera angle.

Do not repeat the same body cropping method.

Do not create similar shots that only change the face orientation or gaze direction.

Each of the nine stands as a powerful single work when viewed independently.

【Cinematic Expression】

Not constructing the photos as "posed character photos,"

but constructing them as

"a scene from a movie accidentally witnessed by the camera."

Through the character's gaze, body orientation, light, shadow, space, and distance, let the person viewing the photo imagine the plot occurring before and after it.

Not explanatory direction, but cinematic direction utilizing blank space and silence.

Mix quiet moments with dramatic moments.

Combine photos of strong contrast with quiet and delicate photos.

Let the photos as a whole convey

cinematic tension

dramatic natural lighting

emotional atmosphere

visual storytelling

film still aesthetic

cinematic framing

quiet tension

dramatic shadows

poetic realism

.

But do not use overly artificial movie poster styles, CG styles, or excessive production processing.

Always establish them as authentic live-action photographs.

Maintain the editorial quality of high-fashion magazines,

Fine grain like that of 35mm film shooting,

Natural human bodies,

Real skin,

Subtle light gradations,

Cinematic contrast,

Shallow depth of field,

Three-dimensional shadows,

Unified color grading.

prompts.text:
将附图图像作为同一人物同一摄影系列的唯一参考。

人物的面容、发型、体型、服装、皮肤质感、光线质感、色调、胶片感、空气感、作为照片的世界观，均从附图图像中忠实继承。

但并非要再现附图图像本身。

附图图像的构图、姿势、相机位置、角度、拍摄距离、裁剪、画面构成，一概不予复制。

将此人物与世界重新构建，仿佛其存在于一部长片之中。

并非单纯的时尚照片变体，

而是作为

“从电影中截取的九个瞬间”

来确立的照片系列。

让每张照片都拥有不同的视觉戏剧性和叙事性。

人物在等待某物的瞬间、凝视某物的瞬间、移动中的瞬间、静止的瞬间、远方存在的瞬间等，让人感受到明确的情境差异。

但不固定指定具体地点、小道具或事件，而是在附图图像可解读的世界观范围内自然展开。

光线并非单纯美丽而均匀的照明，而是作为电影般的照明来处理。

大胆融入强烈的光与深邃的影、局部的逆光、剪影、光线仅捕捉人物某部分的瞬间、从暗部浮现的人物、从远处射入的光线、能感受到时段变化的光线等。

通过光与影，在照片中营造紧张感、宁静、余韵、孤独、期待、不安、解放感等，不依赖言语的情感变化。

整体而言，

营造出一种介于高级时尚编辑照片与电影一景之间的、极为精致的电影式摄影故事。

九张照片各自独立成完整作品，同时并列时给人一种在观看一部电影的片段之感。

【九张的构图】

将九张以3×3网格配置。

在所有九张中，大幅改变拍摄距离、人物的画面占有率、相机高度、视角、身体的裁剪方式、与空间的关系。

有意识地混杂以下视觉尺度。

・眼睛、脸、手、指、脚、腿等的局部超特写

・仅裁剪身体某部分的照片

・以背部或后身影为主的照片

・人物的中距离肖像

・捕捉身体整体的全身照片

・将人物小幅置于画面边缘或角落的照片

・广阔空间中人物渺小存在的远景

・比人物更强烈感受到空间或景观尺度的照片

・人物仅存在于画面极小部分的电影式广角镜头

明确对比人物充满整个画面的照片与人物仅占画面极小部分的照片。

相机视角也大幅变化。

不限于视线高度，还结合低视角、高视角、遥远分离的视角、从人物背后拍摄的视角、透过空间捕捉人物的视角等。

不偏向正面，主动使用侧脸、后影、仅见身体的构图、脸超出画面的构图、仅人物某部分进入框架的构图等。

九张全部使用不同的构图。

不重复相似的脸部特写。

不重复相同的姿势。

不重复相同的拍摄距离。

不重复相同的相机角度。

不重复相同的身体裁剪方式。

不制作仅改变脸部朝向或视线方向的相似镜头。

每张九张均作为独立观看时也成立的强大单张作品。

【电影式的表达】

并非将照片构成为“摆姿势的人物照片”，

而是构成为

“相机偶然目击的那个瞬间的电影一景”。

通过人物的视线、身体朝向、光、影、空间、距离，让观看照片的人能想象其前后发生的剧情。

并非说明性的演出，而是活用空白与沉默的电影式演出。

混杂安静的瞬间与戏剧性的瞬间。

结合强烈对比的照片与安静而细腻的照片。

让照片整体传达出

cinematic tension

dramatic natural lighting

emotional atmosphere

visual storytelling

film still aesthetic

cinematic framing

quiet tension

dramatic shadows

poetic realism

。

但不做过度人工化的电影海报风、CG风、过剩演出的处理。

始终作为照片真实的实拍照片来确立。

维持高级时尚杂志的编辑品质，

如同35mm胶片拍摄般的细腻颗粒，

自然的人体，

真实的皮肤，

微细的光线阶调，

电影式的对比度，

浅景深，

立体的阴影，

统一的色彩分级。

prompts.text:
Subject:
Silk Knot Morning Light

Main Body:
Vertical 9:16, in a high-brightness off-white beauty studio, she stands next to a light wood high stool, having just tied the bow on the front placket of her top, looking down to check if the ribbons on both sides are symmetrical; her right fingertips lightly pinch the end of the right bow, and her left hand naturally rests on the edge of the stool surface. The character is located slightly to the right of the center of the frame, the shot is from the top of the head to the middle of the thighs, and the high stool forms a foreground pivot in the lower left, with soft white space reserved on the right.

Character/Expression:
Exquisitely beautiful 23-year-old East Asian woman, with a fashionable, confident, and gentle temperament; well-proportioned and full figure, chest is noticeably and naturally full, visually about D to E cup, with a natural sense of weight and soft rounded contours, distinct chest-waist difference but not exaggerated or looking like implants; slender waist, forming a clear but natural proportional contrast with the full chest; ivory-white skin with a light pink flush, retaining fine pores and natural shimmer on the collarbone and shoulders. Bright milk tea grey-brown medium-long hair falls over the shoulders, thin air bangs lightly cover the forehead, layers around the face softly wrap the jawline, hair ends naturally curl inward, with a small amount of fine stray hairs scattered by the ears. Light rose blush, champagne-beige and pink-brown eye shadow, slender eyelashes, natural tear bags, and translucent pink-beige lips; chin slightly tucked, corners of the mouth with a faint smile, gaze accurately falling on the end of the bow in her hand.

Clothing/Pose:
Wearing an ivory-white fine-ribbed tight-fitting crop top, a soft square neckline outlines the shoulders and neck, the front placket is tied into a full bow with two wide ribbons of the same fabric, the center of the knot is located in the center below the chest, and the ends of the ribbons naturally fall above the exposed waist and abdomen; paired with cream-white low-waist ultra-short tight-fitting shorts, flat-covered by elastic fine-knit fabric, the leg openings fit the base of the thighs but do not produce exaggerated marks. The body carries weight on the right leg, the left knee is slightly bent forward half a step, and the hips produce a restrained natural shift accordingly; the right thumb and index finger lightly pinch one side of the ribbon end without pulling the knot, the left arm extends backward and downward, the edge of the palm firmly touches the stool surface, the waistline naturally constricts with breathing, and the fabric only forms small real folds at the side waist and waistband.

Background/Light:
The foreground is a light wood high stool cut by the left edge of the frame, the middle ground keeps the character and the bow clear, the background is clean light beige seamless paper, with only a blurred light grey 3D panel placed in the back right to establish layers. A large area softbox in the upper left serves as the only main light, illuminating the face, bow texture, and waist/abdomen uniformly with neutral warm light; shadows of the nose wings and jawline transition softly to the lower right; the white floor provides extremely weak natural bounce fill, making the outline of the shorts clear without overexposure.

Composition/Camera:
Equivalent 50mm lens, eye-level shot at chest height, the focal plane covers the eyes and the front bow, shallow depth of field softens the rear 3D panel but retains a sense of space. The character occupies about 70% of the frame, the head and the white space on the right form a diagonal balance, the edge of the high stool enters from the lower left, and the legs are naturally cut at the middle of the thighs to avoid joint truncation; hair strands, bow ribbon ends, and the center of gravity of the body together form smooth vertical lines.

Texture/Style:
Japanese high-brightness beauty magazine photography, low contrast, restrained saturation, cream white and milk tea grey-brown tones, with slight soft film grain. Focus on presenting the fine texture of the ribbed top, the soft thickness of the bow, the matte fit of the elastic shorts, and un-plasticized real skin texture.

Negative:
Underage or mature middle-aged feel, character facial feature drift, messy bow structure or extra straps, fingers not touching ribbon ends or clipping, ultra-shorts turning into long pants or skirts, limb proportion distortion, plastic-looking skin, background text or watermarks

prompts.text:
【Title】[TITLE]  
【Subtitle】[SUBTITLE]  
【Landscape】[canyon / river / cloud mountains / glacier / desert / coast]  
【Main Palette】[PRIMARY COLORS]  
【Scale Anchor】[tiny traveler / canoe / boat / small building]  
【Visual Destination】[moon / distant light / horizon / mountain pass]  
【Aspect Ratio】9:16

Create a refined vertical art poster that transforms a natural landscape into a flowing topographic world.

Build the terrain from hundreds of long, smooth, continuous contour lines that follow the shape, depth, and movement of the land. The lines should feel like a fusion of topographic maps, silk threads, and abstract Chinese landscape painting — directional, elegant, and highly organized rather than random decorative waves.

Use one strong visual path, such as a river, valley, ridge, cloud road, or negative-space corridor, to guide the eye from foreground to distance.

Keep the natural environment monumental and place only one or two extremely small human figures, boats, or architectural elements as scale anchors.

Use clear spatial hierarchy:
dense flowing lines in the main terrain,
calmer negative space around the visual path,
simpler and softer details in the distance.

Control the palette with 2–4 dominant colors rather than evenly distributed rainbow tones. Use large, clean color fields and let color changes reinforce depth and movement.

Add minimal editorial typography:
[TITLE]
[SUBTITLE]
[SHORT POETIC LINE]

Typography should feel like a contemporary exhibition poster or art-book cover — elegant, widely spaced, restrained, and secondary to the landscape.

The final image should feel poetic, monumental, calm, and highly designed, combining Eastern landscape aesthetics, contour-line abstraction, negative space, and modern editorial composition.

Avoid realistic landscape photography, random waves, chaotic line patterns, excessive texture, generic fantasy CGI, plastic 3D surfaces, watermarks, logos, copyright text, or copied reference typography.

使用一条强有力的视觉路径，例如河流、山谷、山脊、云道或负空间廊道，引导视线从前景移动到远方。

主要地形中密集的流动线条，

远方更简单、更柔和的细节。

垂直3:4。中广角镜头。相机位置略高于毯子平面，主要聚焦于女性，同时展示湖畔风景。主体占据画面的约75%。

姿势
舒适地侧卧在野餐毯上，由左前臂支撑。双腿自然弯曲，一个膝盖轻轻重叠在另一个膝盖上。眼神直视镜头，表情放松。右手轻轻放在胸口附近的一本翻开的平装书上。随性、舒适、真实的阅读休息姿势。

表情
柔和放松的眼神，温柔的闭口微笑，自然的红润脸颊，平静祥和的度假心情。

服饰
柔软的灰白细格子夏季家居服套装。上装：精致的褶皱胸衣，带有极细的细肩带，微妙的中心抽绳设计，轻质棉质感，修身剪裁，具有写实的织物张力和自然垂坠感。下装：配套的轻质褶皱超短家居短裤，配有抽褶弹性腰带和微妙的荷叶边装饰。极低腰腰带自然且牢固地贴合在髋骨最低处，在身体周围均匀分布，露出下腹部、髋骨、腰线和微妙的V线，不露出内衣。

配饰
银色手表，简约的银色手镯，小巧的银色戒指。无太阳镜。无帽子。

头发
柔和的暖栗棕色，长及胸部下方的中长韩国层次感长发。自然的蓬松感，柔和的修饰脸型的层次，被微风吹过的轻微乱发。

光影
带有云层过滤阳光的柔和自然日光，自然智能手机HDR，皮肤和栗色头发上的柔和高光，来自周围森林的浓郁绿色反射。

相机
现代智能手机后置摄像头，等效26mm镜头，手持真实摄影，轻微的自然透视畸变，真实的智能手机渲染。

风格/质量
超写实的高级韩国ulzzang生活方式摄影。自然的皮肤纹理和可见的毛孔，真实的棉质织物，真实的身体比例，自然的光影，高端智能手机度假审美。

负面
塑料感皮肤，不真实的解剖结构，夸张的曲线，过大的头部，扭曲的四肢，重复的身体部位，CGI，演播室灯光，过度锐化，模糊的脸部，无法辨认的文字，徽标，水印，色彩过饱和，人工姿势。

items.title: 独立第二世界海报视觉设计提示词

prompts.text:
Create one independent “Second World” poster per upload.Never combine photos.Format:Vertical 3:4 canvas split into two strictly equal horizontal halves,top 50% and bottom 50%.Upper half stays photographic;lower half becomes the continued Second World.They must read as one scene. Upper Half:Keep the photo faithful.Preserve subject,pose,spatial relationships,color atmosphere,and natural light. Do not redesign,repaint,replace,or restage it.Only allow necessary proportional cropping. Continuity:The top-to-bottom connection is the highest priority.Identify one source structure that naturally reaches the center split,such as a road,shoreline,water,reflection,branch,light,architecture,or body movement.This structure must cross the boundary and continue into the lower half.The Second World must begin from the photograph itself,so the same scene passes through the seam and changes physical rules. Transition Edge:The center may use an irregular torn-paper edge,but the tear must follow the source structure,not act as decoration.Allow source elements to touch,follow,break through,or extend beyond it.Never force the same tear shape onto every image. Lower Half:Use ivory paper with subtle fibers and abundant negative space.Continue the chosen structure downward from the exact point where it meets the split,then reinterpret it with restrained photo fragments,cut-paper forms,and minimal black hand-drawn lines.The lower world must remain visibly attached.Never isolate it as a separate portal,window,stage,platform,or floating vignette unless clearly derived from the photo. Second World Logic:Ask:if this structure became touchable,usable,enterable,or changeable,what would it naturally become?Create one image-specific interaction.For example,water may stay attached while being pulled,a road may continue as a drawn path,or light may become something held.
Do not mechanically repeat actions. Figures:Add 0–3 tiny black line figures only when useful.They must physically interact with the continued structure.If the source already contains strong human action,add none.Never use figures as decoration. Caption:Add one short handwritten English caption based on the action.Keep it natural,light,and slightly witty.
No inspirational quote and no fixed “Same...,different...” phrasing. Style:Real photography above,warm paper below,minimal black line doodle,subtle handmade collage texture,independent-magazine mood,bright,airy,and restrained.The result should feel as if the second world was already hidden inside the photo and simply continued downward. Negative:No detached lower-half illustration,no generic torn-paper template,no isolated portal,no unrelated vignette,no broken continuity,no dense illustration,no random decoration,no crowd,no altered photo colors,no redesign of the upper image,no glossy 3D,no scrapbook clutter,no gibberish text,no watermark,no logo,no UI.

prompts.text: 每次上传仅创建一张独立的“第二世界”海报。切勿合并照片。格式：垂直 3:4 画布，严格分为上下相等的两半，顶部 50% 和底部 50%。上半部分保持摄影风格；下半部分成为延续的第二世界。它们必须被视为同一个场景。上半部分：保持照片的忠实度。保留主体、姿势、空间关系、色彩氛围和自然光。不要重新设计、重画、更换或重新布置它。仅允许必要的比例裁剪。连贯性：上下连接是最高优先级。识别出一个自然到达中心分界线的源结构，例如道路、海岸线、水、反射、树枝、光线、建筑或肢体动作。该结构必须越过边界并延续到下半部分。第二世界必须从照片本身开始，这样同一个场景穿过接缝并改变物理规则。过渡边缘：中心可以使用不规则的撕纸边缘，但撕裂必须遵循源结构，而不是作为装饰。允许源元素触碰、跟随、突破或延伸到其之外。切勿在每张图像上强加相同的撕裂形状。下半部分：使用带有细微纤维和大量负空间的象牙色纸张。从与分界线相遇的确切点向下延续所选结构，然后用克制的照片碎片、剪纸形状和极简的黑色手绘线条对其进行重新阐释。下层世界必须保持可见的连接。除非明确源自照片，否则切勿将其孤立为单独的入口、窗口、舞台、平台或漂浮的小插图。第二世界逻辑：问：如果这个结构变得可触摸、可用、可进入或可改变，它会自然变成什么？创建一个特定于图像的互动。例如，水在被拉动时可能保持连接，道路可能延续为一条绘制的路径，或者光线可能变成某种被握住的东西。不要机械地重复动作。人物：仅在有用时添加 0–3 个微小的黑色线条人物。他们必须与延续的结构产生物理互动。如果源照片已经包含强烈的人类动作，则不添加任何人物。切勿将人物用作装饰。标题：根据动作添加一段简短的手写英文标题。保持自然、轻盈且略带风趣。不要使用励志名言，也不要使用固定的“Same..., different...”短语。风格：上方是真实摄影，下方是温暖的纸张，极简的黑色线条涂鸦，细微的手工拼贴纹理，独立杂志氛围，明亮、轻盈且克制。结果应该感觉像是第二世界已经隐藏在照片内部，只是简单地向下延续。负面提示：没有脱离的下半部分插图，没有通用的撕纸模板，没有孤立的入口，没有不相关的小插图，没有断裂的连贯性，没有密集的插图，没有随机的装饰，没有人群，没有改变的照片颜色，没有对上方图像的重新设计，没有光滑的 3D，没有剪贴簿杂乱，没有乱码文本，没有水印，没有标志，没有 UI。

items.title: 真实摄影与白色手绘线稿创意插画

prompts.text:
Create a creative illustration of Real Photography × Hand-drawn Doodle based on a photo I upload.
Original photo part:
Retain the real scene, main building, natural landscape, composition, shooting angle, perspective relationship, light and environment in the uploaded photo as completely as possible. Do not change locations at will, and do not redesign the main building, so that the core objects in the photo remain clear, real, and easy to recognize.
Add one or more oversized white hand-drawn line art characters / animals / cartoon characters on top of the real photo, using the visual language of:
Photography × Hand-drawn Doodle Illustration / Mixed Media / Visual Metaphor / Surreal Scale Play / Editorial Illustration.
Core creativity:
Based on the architectural structure, natural forms, roads, bridges, mountains, water surfaces, towers, roofs, windows, trees, vehicles or other main features in the original photo, automatically find the most interesting visual associations and reinterpret real objects as something else.
Don't just have characters standing next to buildings or simply posing; let the hand-drawn characters truly interact with objects in reality.
For example, one could automatically associate:
Building → Food / Musical Instrument / Toy / Gift / Clothing / Daily Necessities
High Tower → Microphone / Straw / Pencil / Candle / Knitting Needle
Circular Building → Plate / Button / Wheel / Balloon / Bead
Bridge → Strings / Clothesline / Jump Rope
City Wall / Road → Yarn / Scarf / Zipper / Ribbon
Mountain Peak → Pillow / Cake / Hat
Lake / River → Water in a cup / Mirror / Bathtub
Roof → Hat / Gift Wrapping / Quilt
But do not mechanically apply the above examples; the most suitable creative relationship must be automatically determined based on the actual photo I upload.
Hand-drawn character style:
Characters use simple, natural white hand-drawn lines with slightly varying thickness, as if drawn directly on the photo with a white marker or chalk.
Character proportions can be much larger than the real building, creating an interesting sense of giant-scale dislocation.
Facial features are minimalist, expressions are natural, gentle, and humorous. Actions can include:
Smiling, focusing, being surprised, working seriously, playing secretly, hugging, knitting, repairing, moving, blowing, packaging, watering, etc.
The line art should not be overly complex, not a fine manga style, and no heavy black outlines.
Color:
The hand-drawn part is dominated by white line art.
Only a small amount of a low-saturation mustard yellow / warm yellow / golden yellow is allowed as a visual focus.
Yellow can be used for:
Scarves, yarn, balloons, food, ribbons, music symbols, small flowers, lights, stars, cups, partial clothing or interactive props.
The yellow area should not be too large; keep it restrained.
Composition:
Real photography still occupies the main visual basis of the image.
An accurate spatial relationship, perspective relationship, and movement relationship must be formed between the hand-drawn character and the real object. Hands, feet, and props should be integrated as naturally as possible with the building or scenery.
Utilize negative space, sky, water surfaces, or walls in the original photo to place character line art, avoiding covering the most important architectural details.
The image maintains:
Minimalist, clean, humorous, clever, sense of design, storytelling, visual contrast, with a touch of healing.
Understand the creativity at first glance, and discover the details at the second glance.
Do not stack too many elements for the sake of creativity; keep only one core visual creativity per image.
Image requirements:
The subject of the original photo must be clearly identifiable
Do not change the core structure of the real building
Do not add complex backgrounds
Do not add a large number of characters
Do not use thick black outlines
Do not make ordinary cartoon sticker effects
Do not make 3D cartoon characters
Do not make full-screen graffiti
Do not add text, titles, logos, watermarks
Maintain real photography texture
Natural integration of hand-drawn and photography
Creativity must be ingenious, not just simple cuteness
The overall feel has the high-end quality of International Creative Advertising / Editorial Illustration / Conceptual Photography
Final Effect:
Like the real world suddenly being reinterpreted by an imaginative person—photography is responsible for reality, lines are responsible for imagination, and the two together form a complete small story.
Ultra-high definition.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
将我上传的一张照片创作成一张 真实摄影 × 手绘涂鸦创意插画。
原始照片部分：
尽量完整保留我上传照片中的真实场景、主体建筑、自然景观、构图、拍摄角度、透视关系、光线与环境，不随意更换地点，不重新设计主体建筑，使照片中的核心对象仍然清晰、真实、容易辨认。
在真实照片之上加入一个或多个 超大比例的白色手绘线稿人物 / 动物 / 卡通角色，整体采用：
Photography × Hand-drawn Doodle Illustration / Mixed Media / Visual Metaphor / Surreal Scale Play / Editorial Illustration
的视觉语言。
核心创意
根据原照片中的 建筑结构、自然形态、道路、桥梁、山体、水面、塔楼、屋顶、窗户、树木、车辆或其他主体特征，自动寻找最有趣的视觉联想，把真实物体重新解释成另一种东西。
不要只是让人物站在建筑旁边或简单摆姿势，而要让 手绘角色真正与现实中的物体发生互动。
例如可以自动联想到：
建筑 → 食物 / 乐器 / 玩具 / 礼物 / 衣服 / 日用品
高塔 → 麦克风 / 吸管 / 铅笔 / 蜡烛 / 毛衣针
圆形建筑 → 盘子 / 纽扣 / 轮子 / 气球 / 珠子
桥梁 → 琴弦 / 晾衣绳 / 跳绳
城墙 / 道路 → 毛线 / 围巾 / 拉链 / 彩带
山峰 → 枕头 / 蛋糕 / 帽子
湖泊 / 河流 → 杯子中的水 / 镜子 / 浴缸
屋顶 → 帽子 / 礼物包装 / 被子
但不要机械套用以上例子，必须根据我实际上传的照片自动判断最适合的创意关系。
手绘角色风格
人物采用简洁、自然、有一点童趣的 粗细略有变化的白色手绘线条，像直接用白色马克笔或粉笔画在照片上一样。
人物比例可以远大于现实建筑，形成有趣的 巨人尺度错位感。
五官极简，表情自然、温柔、幽默，可以出现：
微笑、专注、惊讶、认真工作、偷偷玩耍、拥抱、编织、修理、搬动、吹奏、包装、浇水等动作。
线稿不要过度复杂，不要精细漫画风，不要厚重黑色描边。
色彩
手绘部分以 白色线稿为绝对主体。
只允许少量加入一种 低饱和芥末黄 / 暖黄色 / 金黄色 作为视觉重点。
黄色可以用于：
围巾、毛线、气球、食物、丝带、音乐符号、小花、灯光、星星、杯子、局部服饰或互动道具。
黄色面积不要过大，保持克制。
构图
真实摄影仍然占据画面的主要视觉基础。
手绘角色与真实物体之间必须形成 准确的空间关系、透视关系和动作关系，手、脚、道具要尽量自然地与建筑或景物衔接。
利用原照片中的留白、天空、水面或墙面放置人物线稿，避免挡住最重要的建筑细节。
画面保持：
极简、干净、幽默、聪明、有设计感、有故事性、有视觉反差，同时带一点治愈感。
第一眼能看懂创意，第二眼能发现细节。
不要为了创意堆砌太多元素，一张图只保留 一个最核心的视觉创意。
画面要求
原照片主体必须清晰可辨
不改变真实建筑最核心的结构
不增加复杂背景
不增加大量人物
不使用黑色粗描边
不做普通卡通贴纸效果
不做3D卡通人物
不做满屏涂鸦
不添加文字、标题、Logo、水印
保持真实摄影质感
手绘与摄影自然融合
创意要有巧思，而不是单纯可爱
整体具有 国际创意广告 / Editorial Illustration / Conceptual Photography 的高级感
最终效果：
像现实世界突然被一个充满想象力的人重新解释了一遍——摄影负责真实，线条负责想象，两者共同组成一个完整的小故事
超高清

items.title: 真实摄影与治愈水彩食物拟人对比海报

prompts.text: Use one input real photo to generate a vertical 3:4 top-bottom contrast editing journal poster. The upper half strictly preserves the real photography of the input photo: the subject identity, quantity, pose/placement, key outlines, original lighting, perspective, and background relationships must be accurate; the photo only undergoes slight publication-style color grading and cannot be turned into an illustration. The lower half must be a "healing watercolor food personification journal" redraw of the same photo content: extract the subject and main supporting elements from the original photo and reorganize them into a transparent watercolor illustration on a cream-white paper page; preserve recognizable shapes, colors, and spatial clues, but allow for shrinking, cropping, white space, and changes in information density. The subject can be personified as a gentle and cute character on paper, using minimalist small eyes, a smile or sleepy expression, light blush, short hands and feet or a peeking body; personification can only occur in the lower redraw area and cannot change the identity, quantity, and action relationships of the original subject. Add fine pencil/fineliner outlines, translucent watercolor blooming, wet-and-dry overlapping pigment edges, paper fibers, slight water stains, and hand-painted unevenness. Around the subject, only add a small amount of journal elements extended from the photo facts, such as leaves/branches, fruits, tableware, small desktop items, hearts, star points, arrows, observation circles, and material fields; do not crowd with stickers, do not use fixed travel templates. A very tall white street light pole stands in the center of the frame, extending from near the ground to the top of the frame, the round street light at the top is extremely bright and clearly overexposed, forming a strong white halo. 人物为成熟丰满、腰臀曲线明显的沙漏型体态：胸部丰满，腰部明显收束，髋胯圆润，大腿丰润，小腿匀称。不要纸片身材，也不要夸张肥胖或健美肌肉感。

人物留深棕黑色中长直发 / 微卷长发，长度到胸下，额前为轻薄齐刘海，头顶佩戴一对非常醒目的高耸红色兔耳发箍，兔耳细长、向上伸展，其中一只略微向外倾斜。脸部为侧面 / 3/4侧面，头微微抬起，视线望向画面右侧，不看镜头，神情平静冷淡。

上身穿亮红色漆皮兔女郎式连体衣 / corset bodysuit，材质为高光泽红色漆皮或PVC，紧贴胸腰臀。胸口为低胸无肩带结构，领口沿线装饰一圈银色水钻流苏 / 珠链坠饰，在灯光下产生细小反光；腰侧带少量绑带 / 金属扣细节。

颈部佩戴红色蝴蝶结领结，手腕佩戴黑色宽腕套 / cuff。下身不穿裙子和裤子，保持红色连体衣完整轮廓。

双腿穿黑色细密菱形网袜 / fishnet tights，网格清晰、均匀覆盖大腿、小腿和脚踝，必须明显看出网纹，不要生成普通透明丝袜。

脚穿黑色亮面超高跟厚底鞋 / platform stiletto pumps，前掌带明显厚底，细跟较高，鞋面带少量红色闪点 / 水钻反光。两只鞋完整保留。

姿势严格锁定：人物侧身靠在画面左侧的浅蓝色金属栏杆旁，左手向后扶住栏杆；一条腿保持直立承重，另一条腿向后屈膝抬起，脚尖 / 鞋底贴近后方栏杆或立柱，形成明显的单腿支撑姿势。上半身略微后仰，胸口朝画面右侧，腰胯形成自然S形曲线。

场景为真实夜间旧式城市天桥 / 公寓楼公共连廊。四周是浅青蓝 / 淡蓝绿色金属栏杆，油漆有明显老化、锈迹、污渍和脱落；栏杆下半部局部为深蓝色金属板。右侧栏杆角落放着一个透明塑料杯和吸管，保留生活化杂物感。

画面中央竖立一根非常高的白色路灯杆，从地面附近一直延伸到画面顶部，顶部圆形路灯极亮并明显过曝，形成强烈白色光晕。路灯几乎位于画面中央，是除人物之外最重要的构图元素。

背景是一整栋深灰黑色老式公寓 / 住宅楼外立面，多个阳台、窗户和突出平台在黑暗中若隐若现，只有零星窗户灯光。建筑整体保持非常暗，不要霓虹灯、广告牌或繁华商业街。

地面为深灰色粗糙水泥 / 沥青，带排水沟、污迹、锈斑和少量杂草。画面整体空间空旷、冷清，有明显城市夜晚孤独感。

光线主要来自头顶强烈冷白路灯，人物被路灯从上方和侧上方照亮，红色漆皮服装、水钻和高跟鞋产生明显高光，肤色保持自然偏冷；背景住宅楼大面积压暗。不要专业棚拍补光，不要把人物脸照得过亮。

摄影风格为真实夜间街头时尚抓拍＋轻微数码相机感：高反差、有限动态范围、路灯局部严重过曝、背景暗部轻微噪点，人物清晰但不是商业棚拍。整体色调以黑灰、浅青蓝、冷白与高饱和红色为主。

重点锁定：明确成年东亚女性＋红色高耸兔耳＋亮红漆皮无肩带兔女郎连体衣＋胸口银色水钻流苏＋红色领结＋黑色鱼网连裤袜＋黑色厚底超高细跟鞋＋侧身靠栏杆＋单腿承重＋另一腿向后屈膝抬起＋人物位于画面左下且占比较小＋中央超高白色路灯＋顶部强烈过曝光球＋浅青蓝老旧金属栏杆＋深色住宅楼背景＋大量夜间负空间。

items.title: 凌晨海岸观测记录海报视觉风格

prompts.text:
First establish a visual event recognizable at a glance: a large area of low light, a nearly static deep cold-colored environment occupying the main space, with a very small but bright and warm circular focal point suspended in the empty field, suppressing the whole scene with extreme scale contrast and warm-cold contrast; the lower part forms a second event with a darker horizontal base and a suddenly raised high-energy texture with a sense of grain and spray, allowing the quiet distance and the violent movement nearby to exist simultaneously. The image adopts a photographic documentary texture rather than a refined commercial texture, with dark cyan, ink blue, and blackish brown forming a narrow color gamut, the highlights being a restrained old gold, and local highlights tending towards grayish white; retain slight out-of-focus, low clarity, darkened shadows, simulated high-sensitivity noise, weak color shifts, and uneven exposure, without adding gorgeous halos, smooth gradients, or over-sharpening. The spatial organization centers on a large white space at the top and dense information at the bottom, with the horizontal horizon-style boundary pressed low, and movement textures allowed to be cropped out of bounds; all text is attached to the lower dark areas and texture boundaries, like magazine inner pages and private diaries overprinted on photos. The main title uses a heavy, compact, low-center-of-gravity sans-serif construction, with glyphs composed of thick, nearly equal-width strokes, short flat-cut endpoints, solid connections, small internal cavities, and tight letter spacing, which can be divided into two lines of staggered stacking and partially overlap with the surging texture; no matter what writing system the target text uses, it maintains its orthographic recognizability, original reading direction, and natural marking positions, achieving the same sense of oppression through literal area, stroke weight, and rhythm, without imitating a specific source alphabet. Auxiliary information uses lighter but still slightly rough sans-serif characters, with small font sizes forming two groups on the left and right: one group is a hierarchy of short notes and signatures, and the other consists of date-like numbers, short tags, thin horizontal lines, and compact body text; numbers can be significantly enlarged as navigation anchors, and the body text maintains short lines, loose line spacing, and the slight irregularity of manual typesetting. The copy content must serve the current theme and not copy any source wording, brands, or signatures; the white characters are not purely bright, but have slight grayness, edge softening, and print bleeding, making the text, noise, and photographic grain share the same old media surface. The overall temperament is restrained, lonely, with a sense of nighttime recording, letting the tension between the tiny bright spots, huge negative space, bottom movement, and editorial-style text become an irreplaceable design touch.

——————

Make it into a Late Night Coast Observation Record Poster: use deep ink green as the large-area low-light environment, gray-cyan for the lower wave foam support, and dark amber yellow for the only warm point, maintaining a narrow color gamut, low saturation, old media grain, and a color grammar of cold and dark surrounding warm and bright. A tiny lighthouse is suspended towards the upper right, the line of sight falls along the diagonal wave ridge into the bottom-left dense area, and a huge empty field is reserved in the upper left; the main title is staggered and stacked in two oversized lines on the bottom left, and the date anchor is independently placed on the bottom right, forming a strong primary-secondary relationship. The copy revolves around night sailing and tide observation, and the aspect ratio is vertical 3:4.

prompts.text:
先建立一眼可辨的视觉事件：大面积低照度、近乎静止的深冷色环境占据主体空间，一个尺寸极小却明亮温暖的圆形焦点悬置在空场中，以极端尺度反差和冷暖反差压住全局；下部由更暗的水平基底与突然抬起、带颗粒和飞沫感的高能纹理形成第二重事件，让安静的远处与近处的猛烈运动同时存在。画面采用摄影纪实质感而非精修商业质感，暗青、墨蓝、黑褐构成窄色域，亮点呈克制的旧金色，局部高光偏灰白；保留轻微失焦、低清晰度、压暗阴影、模拟高感光噪点、微弱色偏和不均匀曝光，不添加华丽光晕、顺滑渐变或过度锐化。空间组织以上部巨大留白、下部密集信息为核心，地平式横向分界压低，运动纹理允许裁切出界；所有文字贴附于下方暗部和纹理交界，像杂志内页与私人日记叠印在照片上。主标题使用粗重、紧凑、低重心的无衬线构造，字形由宽厚近等粗笔画、短促平切端点、结实连接、较小内腔和紧密字距组成，可分成两行错位堆叠，并与翻涌纹理局部交叠；无论目标文字采用何种书写系统，都保持其正字法可识别性、原阅读方向与自然标记位置，以字面面积、笔画重量和节奏实现同等压迫感，不模仿某一种来源字母。辅助信息使用较轻但仍略粗糙的无衬线字，小字号形成左右两组：一组是短注与署名式层级，另一组由日期感数字、短标签、细横线和紧凑正文组成；数字可明显放大作为导航锚点，正文保持短行、松弛行距和轻微手工排版的不齐。文案内容必须服务当前主题，不复制任何来源措辞、品牌或署名；白色字并非纯净发亮，而是带轻微灰度、边缘柔化和印刷渗化，使文字、噪点与摄影颗粒共享同一种旧媒介表面。整体气质克制、孤独、带夜间记录感，让微小亮点、巨大负空间、底部运动与编辑式文字之间的张力成为不可替代的设计手感。

——————
做成凌晨海岸观测记录海报：以深墨绿为大面积低照度环境，灰青作下部浪沫支撑，唯一暖点用暗琥珀黄，保持窄色域、低饱和、旧媒介颗粒与冷暗包围暖亮的颜色语法。微小灯塔偏右上悬置，视线沿斜向浪脊跌入左下密集区，左上保留巨大空场；主标题在底部左侧以超大两行错位堆叠，日期锚点独立置于右下，形成强烈主次。文案围绕夜航与潮汐观测，画幅为竖版 3:4。

prompts.text:
Create a premium 3:4 vertical cinematic travel poster for [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT].

TEXT-TO-IMAGE ONLY — generate the entire artwork creatively from [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT] alone. No reference image required.

CORE CONCEPT
Create an elegant, photorealistic travel editorial inspired by luxury tourism campaigns, high-end fashion magazines, cinematic photography, and premium airline advertising. Use a warm ivory-to-soft-white background with generous negative space, refined composition, and a quiet sophisticated atmosphere.

CHARACTER & POSE
Feature one contemporary traveler as the main subject, positioned slightly off-center and captured full-body in a natural three-quarter side profile. The traveler is casually walking through the destination, creating an effortless candid travel moment rather than a posed portrait.

Give the traveler a small vintage camera held naturally in one hand, with the other hand carrying a compact leather travel bag or resting casually near the shoulder. The posture should feel relaxed, authentic, and elegant.

Automatically style the traveler according to the destination: refined contemporary travel clothing, appropriate seasonal layers, tasteful neutral tones, practical footwear, and subtle accessories inspired by the local environment without becoming stereotypical.

DESTINATION STORY
Build the background around the visual identity of [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT]. Automatically select the most recognizable landmark, architecture, streetscape, landscape, cultural details, and environmental elements that genuinely belong to the destination.

Keep the environment realistic and photographically believable. Add subtle local details that make the destination immediately recognizable while maintaining a clean editorial composition.

LIGHTING & ATMOSPHERE
Soft warm autumn or late-afternoon sunlight, delicate golden rim light, gentle atmospheric haze, realistic skin and fabric textures, subtle shadows, restrained contrast, and cinematic natural illumination.

STYLE
Luxury travel editorial × cinematic destination photography × high-end airline campaign × contemporary fashion magazine × fine-art photography.

Use realistic photographic detail, natural proportions, sophisticated depth of field, subtle film grain, restrained saturation, and a calm premium visual language.

COLOR PALETTE
Warm ivory, cream, soft beige, muted earth tones, charcoal, and destination-specific accent colors. Keep saturation low to medium and maintain a refined monochromatic harmony.

FINAL AESTHETIC
Quiet luxury travel photography, sophisticated autumn atmosphere, authentic human presence, premium editorial storytelling, timeless composition, and a polished collectible travel-poster feeling.

Avoid crowded scenes, exaggerated poses, stereotypes, fantasy architecture, excessive colors, heavy HDR, oversaturated grading, artificial skin, distorted anatomy, duplicate people, logos, watermarks, UI elements, and excessive typography.

3:4 vertical, full-body character, cinematic composition, generous negative space, photorealistic detail, premium editorial quality, single cohesive image.

核心理念
创作一个优雅、写实的旅游专题，灵感来自奢华旅游宣传活动、高端时尚杂志、电影摄影和高级航空公司广告。使用暖象牙色至柔白色的背景，带有大量的留白、精致的构图和宁静考究的氛围。

items.title: 温暖生活油画棒绘本插画

prompts.text:
Redraw the uploaded image as a warm, charming everyday-life picture-book illustration, using coarse oil-pastel and wax-crayon marks with colored-pencil accents. The uploaded image is the sole source of people, objects, actions, and scenery. Transform the shapes, contours, color masses, and mark-making into a coherent illustration; simply adding paper texture or grain to the photograph is insufficient.

OVERALL STYLE
Make the image look drawn directly on warm ivory paper. Combine soft, substantial color shapes, rough dark outlines, and clearly visible crayon strokes. Aim for an affectionate, unpolished handmade quality, with slightly imperfect drawing and the feeling of an ordinary moment recorded in a family picture book.

LINEWORK AND MATERIAL
Outline people and major objects with grainy charcoal-black or dark-brown strokes. Let contours wobble slightly, vary naturally in thickness, and show broken edges, rough deposits, and small gaps of exposed paper. Keep interior lines lighter and fewer.
Build color through short strokes, diagonal scribbles, back-and-forth rubbing, and uneven overlapping layers. Paper grain should remain visible through both outlines and filled areas. Even dark masses should contain tiny lighter gaps. Texture must follow the drawing strokes rather than appear as uniform digital noise. Allow occasional slight overshoot and incompletely filled edges while keeping the main shapes clear.

CHARACTER DESIGN
Clearly cartoonize the people: moderately enlarged heads, rounded faces, full cheeks, simplified chins, and soft, compact body and limb shapes. Preserve the rounded proportions of young children while keeping adults visibly distinct in age and body structure.
Retain each person's visible hairstyle silhouette, hair color, approximate face shape, eyewear, distinctive accessories, and general build. Do not give everyone the same face.
Draw eyes as small solid-black dots or short ovals. Use simple short strokes for eyebrows, a tiny dot or minimal mark for the nose, and a small curve or uncomplicated open shape for the mouth, preserving the source expression. Add soft peach-pink blush to the cheeks where appropriate. Avoid realistic eyeballs, irises, eyelashes, large sparkling eyes, and detailed facial anatomy.
Consolidate hair into substantial overall shapes with rough color coverage and a few directional strokes, without rendering individual strands. Simplify hands and feet into rounded forms while maintaining clear grasping, contact, and support relationships.

COLOR AND LIGHT
Establish a warm base of cream, ivory, peach skin tones, and soft browns while retaining the source image's main object colors. Use natural crayon yellows, greens, blues, and reds rather than fluorescent colors or a uniform faded filter.
Express most volume through color shapes, contours, and overlap. Suggest shadows sparingly with darker strokes from the same color family or muted gray-brown patches. Replace photographic shading, glossy reflections, and complex gradients with simple drawn color relationships. Preserve the visual weight of dark hair, dark clothing, and strong outlines.

CLOTHING, OBJECTS, AND ENVIRONMENT
Preserve clothing categories, main colors, recognizable patterns, accessories, and important props from the source. Translate folds, patterns, and object structures into a limited number of drawn lines and color patches rather than intricate material detail.
Redraw the entire background in the same handmade visual language. Preserve the positions, major shapes, and spatial relationships of furniture, buildings, trees, roads, and other scene elements. Simplify detail while retaining enough everyday information for the original setting to remain recognizable.
Keep facial features extremely simple, clothing and props selectively descriptive, and environmental marks richer but still broadly drawn. The background must not retain photographic texture or automatically become blank white or a solid color.

COMPOSITION AND CONTENT
Preserve the source aspect ratio, viewpoint, shot size, main subject placement, number of people, actions, gaze directions, and overlap relationships. Apply the same illustration style to every person in a group photograph.
Allow local proportion changes for cartoon design while preserving the meaning of the scene. Do not expand the canvas or invent body parts and objects outside the original frame.
The style controls how the source is drawn. Do not introduce babies, food, phones, festive decorations, or any other content absent from the uploaded image. Simplify existing text and signage according to their visual importance. Add no new text, watermark, or signature.

AVOID
Photo tracing; a photograph with a texture overlay; realistic portraiture; smooth vector art; mechanically uniform outlines; transparent watercolor washes; detailed graphite drawing; large anime eyes; sparkling eyes; plastic surfaces; 3D rendering; complex photographic lighting; finely rendered hair or skin; random grime; excessive blur; and inconsistent styles between characters and backgrounds.

Output exactly one finished illustration, with no collage, comparison panel, or explanatory text.

prompts.text:
将上传的图片重绘为一幅温暖、迷人的日常生活绘本插画，使用粗糙的油画棒和蜡笔痕迹，并辅以彩色铅笔的点缀。上传的图片是人物、物体、动作和风景的唯一来源。将形状、轮廓、色块和笔触转化为连贯的插画；仅在照片上添加纸张纹理或颗粒感是不够的。

整体风格
让图像看起来像是直接画在温暖的象牙色纸上的。结合柔和、厚实的色彩形状、粗糙的深色轮廓和清晰可见的蜡笔笔触。追求一种亲切、未经修饰的手工质感，带有略显不完美的绘画感，以及家庭绘本中记录平凡时刻的感觉。

线条与材料
用颗粒状的炭黑色或深褐色笔触勾勒人物和主要物体。让轮廓略微抖动，厚度自然变化，并展现出断裂的边缘、粗糙的堆积和露出纸张的小间隙。保持内部线条更轻、更少。
通过短笔触、对角线涂鸦、来回摩擦和不均匀的重叠层来构建颜色。纸张颗粒应在轮廓和填充区域中都保持可见。即使是深色色块也应包含微小的浅色缝隙。纹理必须遵循绘画笔触，而不是呈现为均匀的数字噪点。允许偶尔出现轻微的越界和未完全填充的边缘，同时保持主要形状清晰。

角色设计
将人物进行明显的卡通化：适度放大的头部、圆润的面部、丰满的双颊、简化的下巴，以及柔软、紧凑的身体和肢体形状。保留幼儿圆润的比例，同时让成年人在年龄和身体结构上保持明显的区别。
保留每个人的可见发型轮廓、发色、大致脸型、眼镜、独特的配饰和一般体型。不要给每个人都画同一张脸。
将眼睛画成黑色的小实心点或短椭圆形。用简单的短笔触表示眉毛，用极小的点或极少的痕迹表示鼻子，用小曲线或不复杂的开口形状表示嘴巴，保留原有的表情。在适当的地方为脸颊添加柔和的桃粉色腮红。避免写实的眼球、虹膜、睫毛、闪亮的大眼睛和详细的面部解剖。
将头发合并为厚实的整体形状，具有粗糙的色彩覆盖和少许方向性笔触，不渲染单根发丝。将手脚简化为圆润的形状，同时保持清晰的抓握、接触和支撑关系。

颜色与光影
建立以奶油色、象牙色、桃色肤色和柔和褐色为基础的温暖色调，同时保留原图中主要物体的颜色。使用自然的蜡笔黄、绿、蓝、红，而不是荧光色或统一的褪色滤镜。
主要通过色彩形状、轮廓和重叠来表现体积。用同色系的深色笔触或暗灰褐色斑块克制地暗示阴影。用简单的绘画色彩关系取代照片的光影、高光反射和复杂的渐变。保留深色头发、深色衣物和强力轮廓的视觉重量。

服装、物体与环境
保留原图中的服装类别、主要颜色、可识别的图案、配饰和重要道具。将褶皱、图案和物体结构转化为有限数量的线条和色块，而不是复杂的材质细节。
以同样的手工视觉语言重绘整个背景。保留家具、建筑、树木、道路和其他场景元素的方位、主要形状和空间关系。简化细节，同时保留足够的日常信息，以便识别原始环境。
保持面部特征极其简单，服装和道具选择性描述，环境痕迹更丰富但仍保持粗放的绘画感。背景不得保留照片纹理，也不得自动变为空白白色或纯色。

构图与内容
保留原图的宽高比、视角、镜头大小、主体位置、人数、动作、视线方向和重叠关系。将同样的插画风格应用于集体照中的每个人。
在符合卡通设计的前提下，允许局部比例变化，同时保留场景的含义。不要扩大画布，也不要发明原始画框之外的身体部位和物体。
风格控制源图片的绘制方式。不要引入婴儿、食物、手机、节日装饰或上传图片中不存在的任何其他内容。根据视觉重要性简化现有的文字和标识。不添加新文字、水印或签名。

避免
照片描摹；带有纹理叠加的照片；写实人像；平滑的矢量艺术；机械统一的轮廓；透明水彩渲染；精细的铅笔画；动漫大眼睛；闪亮的眼睛；塑料质感；3D渲染；复杂的摄影照明；精细渲染的头发或皮肤；随机的污垢；过度的模糊；以及人物与背景之间的风格不一致。

仅输出一张完成的插画，不包含拼图、对比面板或解释性文字。

items.title: 保龄球馆抱球回眸的东亚美女摄影

prompts.text:
Theme:
Holding a ball and looking back in a bowling alley

Subject:
Vertical orientation, a stunningly beautiful 23-year-old East Asian woman standing slightly to the left at the start of the lane, occupying about 70% of the frame, looking back from a side profile, feet apart standing on a polished wooden floor. Both hands are holding a bowling ball at her side, with her upper body slightly turned toward the camera. To the left is a black and gray horizontal striped pillar, to the right foreground is a corner of a metal ball return machine, and the bowling lanes stretch out in perspective behind her.
Stunningly beautiful 23-year-old East Asian woman, fashion lifestyle photography, commercial portrait quality.

Character and Expression:
Stunningly beautiful 23-year-old East Asian woman, with a fashionable, confident, and gentle temperament; a well-proportioned and voluptuous figure, breasts are naturally and noticeably full, visually about D to E cup, with a natural sense of weight and soft, rounded contours, and a distinct waist-to-hip ratio.
The face shape is slightly round, eyes and brows are soft, the corners of the eyes are slightly upturned, the bridge of the nose is thin, lip color is light, and the corners of the mouth have a slight smile. Long brown hair is half-tied with a creamy white small flower clip at the back of the head, and the rest of the hair ends have natural curls draped over her back. Light makeup, her gaze looks toward the camera from behind her left shoulder. Healthy skin tone, with indoor overhead lights leaving natural highlights on her shoulders, neck, and face. Rounded hips and long lower limbs.

Clothing and Props:
The top is a beige ribbed short-sleeved shirt, cotton, slim-fit, with the hem ending at the waist, showing a thin black camisole strap at the shoulder. The bottom is a grayish-blue denim short pleated skirt with a metal button at the waistband, multiple layers of fine pleats, and a frayed hem ending below the hips, with a hip-hugging fit. Wearing white, brown, and black tricolor bowling shoes with a dark circular logo on the heel, no specific text. Both hands hold a dark purple gradient bowling ball with finger holes facing inward.

Background and Lighting:
Indoor bowling alley, multiple polished wooden lanes side-by-side, gutters are black, with white bowling pins standing at the end of the lanes. The backboard features a cosmic planet pattern with blue, orange, and purple color blocks, without copying any text on it. The ceiling has uniform recessed overhead lights, the main light comes from above with a warm white color temperature, and the wooden floor has long reflections. Black and gray horizontal stripes on the left pillar, and only a corner of the metal ball return machine is visible on the right.

Composition and Camera:
Full body down to the shoes, natural standing camera angle, slightly from the side and rear, focus is on the overall silhouette of the figure and the action of holding the ball. Medium depth of field, the floor in the foreground is clear, while the distant pins and backboard are slightly soft. Do not change to a front-facing pose or outdoor setting.

Texture and Style:
Commercial fashion lifestyle photography, ribbed textures, denim pleats, and wooden floor reflections are clear, realistic space, 8K clarity, natural and everyday, no illustration style.

Negative Prompt:
Deformed fingers, extra limbs, distorted face, child-like appearance, text watermarks, logos, wearing different clothes, changing to long skirts or wide-leg pants, changing to outdoor or studio settings.

prompts.text:
主题：
保龄球馆抱球回头

主体：
竖幅，绝美23岁东亚美女站在球道起点偏左，约占画面七成，侧身后视，双脚分开站在抛光木地板上。双手在身侧抱住一颗保龄球，上身微转向镜头。左侧是黑灰横条纹立柱，右侧前景是金属回球机一角，后方球道拉出透视。
绝美23岁东亚美女，时尚生活摄影，商业写真质感。

人物与表情：
绝美23岁东亚美女，气质时尚、自信、温柔；身材匀称丰满，胸部明显自然丰满，视觉约 D 至 E 杯，具有自然重量感与柔和圆润轮廓，胸腰差明显。
脸型偏圆，眉眼柔和，眼尾微翘，鼻梁细，唇色淡，嘴角带一点笑。棕色长发半扎，脑后一朵米白小花发夹，其余发尾自然卷，披在后背。妆容淡，视线从左肩后看向镜头。健康肤色，室内顶灯在肩颈和面部留下自然高光。髋部圆，下肢修长。

服装与道具：
上装为米色罗纹短袖上衣，棉质，修身，下摆收到腰上，肩带处露出一条细黑吊带。下装为灰蓝牛仔短款百褶裙，腰头有一颗金属扣，裙摆多层细褶，须边停在髋下，版型贴髋。脚穿白、棕、黑拼色保龄球鞋，鞋跟有深色圆形标，不写具体字。双手抱一颗深紫渐变保龄球，指孔朝内。

背景与光线：
室内保龄球馆，多条抛光木球道并列，沟槽为黑色，球道尽头立着白色球瓶。挡板是宇宙星球图案，蓝、橙、紫色块，不抄上面的字。天花板有均匀嵌入式顶灯，主光来自上方，色温偏暖白，木地板有长条反光。左侧立柱黑灰横条，右侧金属回球机只露一角。

构图与镜头：
全身到鞋，自然站立机位，略微侧后，焦点在人物整体轮廓和抱球动作。中等景深，近处地板清楚，远处球瓶和挡板略柔。不要改成正面摆拍或户外。

质感与风格：
商业时尚生活摄影，罗纹纹理、牛仔褶和木地板反光清楚，空间真实，8K 清晰，自然日常，不要插画感。

负面提示：
畸形手指、多余肢体、面部崩坏、儿童外观、文字水印、logo、穿成另一套衣服、换成长裙或阔腿裤、换成户外或影棚

items.title: 未来主义低保真粗粝拼贴视觉

prompts.text: First generate a main visual based on a future theme that can be strongly cropped and a set of theme text, the first glance must be a black and white coarse-grained subject pressed onto a large area of high-saturation warm-colored information blocks, like image proofs and low-fidelity design drafts being directly collaged onto the same print; the upper subject is treated with high-contrast black and white, the dark parts become solid black blocks, and the bright parts are manifested by dense dot halftones and a small amount of white edge lines, the outline does not seek completeness, relying on edge cropping, partial occlusion, and diagonal arcs to create a sense of movement; the lower information area uses flat and intense color blocks for weight, the text adopts a monospaced typewriter construction, the character spacing is loose, and underlines and line breaks become the rhythm, the main title is horizontally lowered close to the upper edge of the color block, and auxiliary information can be arranged vertically along the edge or in narrow columns, forming an engineering label-like image reading path; add a slightly rotated light-colored small piece of paper or grid label in the picture, covering the vicinity of the junction between the color block and the subject, using the white of different materials, thin line grids, and tilted angles to break the hard division; the overall look retains the grittiness of scanning noise, dot clogging, slight dirt, and printing misalignment, do not include glass texture, refined gradients, soft shadows, commercial poster-style centered beautification, or arrange text into neat templates.

prompts.text: 由未来主题先生成一个可被强烈剪裁的主视觉和一组主题文字，第一眼必须是黑白粗颗粒主体压在大面积高饱和暖色信息块之上，像影像样张与低保真设计稿被直接拼贴到同一张印刷品里；上方主体用高反差黑白处理，暗部成整片黑块，亮部由密集圆点网屏和少量白色边缘线显形，轮廓不求完整，靠贴边裁切、局部遮挡和斜向弧线制造运动感；下方信息区使用平整浓烈色块承重，文字采用等宽打字机式构造，字距偏松、下划线与断行成为节奏，主标题横向压低贴近色块上缘，辅助信息可沿边缘竖排或窄列排布，形成工程标签般的读图路径；画面中加入一个轻微旋转的浅色小纸片或网格标签，覆盖在色块与主体交界附近，用异材质的白、细线网格和倾斜角度打破硬分割；整体保留扫描噪点、网点堵塞、轻微脏污和印刷不准的粗粝，不要玻璃质感、精修渐变、柔和阴影、商业海报式居中美化或把文字排成整齐模板。

items.title: ZARA勃艮第红托特包新品发布海报

prompts.text:
ZARA — TOTE BAG MERCH DROP
“THE EVERYDAY ICON”
Act as a Senior Brand Art Director, Editorial Fashion Photographer, Art Director, Set Designer, Typography Designer and Behance-level campaign designer.
Create ONE horizontal 16:9 editorial campaign poster announcing a ZARA tote-bag merch drop.
REFERENCE PRODUCT:
Use the uploaded reference image as the EXACT product reference.
The tote must remain visually faithful to the reference:
— deep burgundy / oxblood leather appearance
— structured rounded tote silhouette
— wide curved upper body
— distinctive double-handle construction
— long shoulder straps
— short top handles
— visible stitched construction
— minimal metal detailing
— understated luxury finish
— same proportions, silhouette, handle architecture and material character
DO NOT redesign the bag.
DO NOT change the silhouette.
DO NOT add pockets, logos, hardware or decorative elements that do not exist on the reference.
The product must remain the recognizable hero SKU throughout the composition.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CONCEPT — MERCH DROP
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is NOT a conventional Zara product photoshoot.
It should feel like a highly art-directed ZARA merchandise DROP campaign created for Instagram, fashion media and a Behance editorial case study.
The tote is treated as a CULT OBJECT — photographed with the visual confidence of a fashion campaign rather than a standard ecommerce product image.
Visual language:
fashion editorial × contemporary retail × art-directed street photography × premium merchandise launch.
The campaign should immediately communicate:
NEW DROP.
LIMITED MOMENT.
DESIRABLE OBJECT.
ZARA ENERGY.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
LAYOUT ARCHITECTURE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
16:9 horizontal editorial poster.
Create a dramatic split composition:
LEFT 45%:
Bold graphic field with a strong ZARA-inspired editorial treatment.
RIGHT 55%:
Full-bleed cinematic fashion photograph featuring a realistic fashion model carrying the exact reference tote.
Hard vertical compositional division.
The graphic and photographic zones must feel designed together rather than like two separate images.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
BACKGROUND
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Use a bold, unexpected fashion-editorial background rather than plain white.
Deep oxblood / burgundy, warm off-white and charcoal-black visual relationships inspired by the reference tote.
The background should feel expensive, architectural and contemporary.
Possible visual environment:
minimalist brutalist architecture,
large geometric walls,
oversized stone surfaces,
architectural shadows,
fashion-store exterior,
urban European street,
or sculptural concrete environment.
No generic studio backdrop.
The environment should feel like an actual ZARA fashion campaign location.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
HERO PHOTOGRAPHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
A realistic adult fashion model, completely fictional and non-identifiable.
The model wears contemporary ZARA-style fashion:
minimal tailored oversized coat,
structured trousers,
refined footwear,
restrained accessories.
The burgundy tote is the visual hero.
The model holds the bag naturally at their side while walking through the architectural environment.
Pose:
confident,
editorial,
slightly candid,
non-confrontational,
fashion-week street-style energy.
The model should NOT look like a celebrity or recognizable public figure.
Natural human anatomy.
Natural skin texture.
Realistic hands.
Realistic grip on the handles.
The tote must remain clearly visible and unobstructed.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CAMERA / PHOTOGRAPHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
High-end professional fashion editorial photography.
Full-frame / medium-format fashion photography aesthetic.
50mm editorial lens.
Camera positioned slightly below eye level.
Subtle perspective compression.
Shallow but controlled depth of field.
The tote must remain tack-sharp.
Natural environmental depth behind the model.
Professional fashion campaign lighting:
hard directional sunlight mixed with controlled architectural shadow,
subtle reflected fill,
natural specular highlights on the leather,
deep but detailed shadows.
No artificial CGI lighting.
No beauty-filter appearance.
No plastic skin.
No AI-generated fashion look.
The image should feel photographed by an elite fashion photographer.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
TYPOGRAPHIC SYSTEM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Typography is a PRIMARY DESIGN ELEMENT.
Use a refined contemporary fashion-editorial sans-serif character:
high contrast,
clean geometry,
precise spacing,
strong vertical presence,
minimal,
luxury retail aesthetic.
Do NOT imitate or distort the official ZARA wordmark.
Use only legitimate ZARA branding where appropriate.
HEADLINE:
NEW
DROP
Two enormous lines.
“NEW” positioned across the graphic zone.
“DROP” dramatically oversized and extending across the vertical split into the photograph.
The typography should partially overlap the model and tote while remaining completely legible.
Very large scale.
Tight leading.
Slightly compressed editorial proportions.
Flat typography.
No glow.
No bevel.
No 3D.
No shadows.
No gradient.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
TYPOGRAPHIC BRIDGE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CRITICAL:
The word “DROP” must physically cross the boundary between the graphic field and photograph.
Approximately 40–50% of the word sits over the left graphic field.
The remaining letters continue over the photographic environment.
The type must visually interact with the model and architecture.
The tote may partially intersect with the typography, creating a sophisticated editorial layering effect.
This is the key Behance-level composition device.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MICRO TYPOGRAPHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Use restrained fashion-editorial information blocks.
Small uppercase tracking.
Example layout:
ZARA
WOMAN
NEW SEASON
LEATHER TOTE
DROP 01
2026
ONLINE + SELECTED STORES
SHOP NOW →
Keep the micro-copy secondary.
Do not fill the poster with unnecessary text.
Generous negative space.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PRODUCT CALLOUT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Add one small editorial product annotation near the tote:
ZARA
LEATHER TOTE
BURGUNDY
Use thin directional typography / subtle technical annotation lines pointing toward the bag.
The annotation should feel like a fashion editorial product study rather than ecommerce UI.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CORNER SYSTEM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Top-left:
small ZARA brand identifier.
Bottom-left:
NEW SEASON / DROP 01
Top-right:
2026 / EDITORIAL RELEASE
Bottom-right:
SHOP THE DROP →
All information must remain extremely clean.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
COLOR SYSTEM
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Primary visual color:
deep burgundy / oxblood derived directly from the reference tote.
Secondary:
warm editorial ivory.
Supporting:
near-black charcoal.
Optional restrained metallic highlight from the bag's hardware.
No rainbow palette.
No unnecessary colors.
The burgundy tote must remain the strongest color anchor in the entire composition.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
ART DIRECTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
The final image should feel like:
ZARA fashion campaign
+
premium merch drop
+
Behance editorial case study
+
high-fashion street photography
+
contemporary graphic design.
Not:
generic product advertisement,
Amazon-style product listing,
ecommerce banner,
basic Instagram ad,
ordinary studio photoshoot,
AI fashion collage.
The image should look intentionally designed by a senior European fashion-art-direction team.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
VISUAL HIERARCHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. MASSIVE “DROP” typography
2. Burgundy ZARA tote
3. Fashion model
4. Architectural environment
5. “NEW” headline
6. Product annotation
7. Micro-information
8. Brand identifier
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
FINAL TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
16:9 horizontal.
Ultra-high-resolution editorial campaign artwork.
Photorealistic fashion photography.
Premium commercial-grade image quality.
Extremely sharp product construction.
Accurate leather texture.
Accurate stitching.
Accurate handles.
Natural model anatomy.
Crisp typography.
Precise alignment.
Strong negative space.
Sophisticated editorial color grading.
No visible AI artifacts.
No distorted hands.
No duplicated objects.
No malformed bag.
No altered product silhouette.
No random logos.
No fake brand marks.
No excessive text.
No generic stock-photo aesthetic.
FINAL RESULT:
A visually arresting ZARA tote-bag MERCH DROP poster that could plausibly function as a premium fashion campaign hero image, editorial spread, outdoor fashion billboard or Behance featured project.

prompts.text:
ZARA — 托特包新品发布
“日常偶像”
担任高级品牌艺术总监、时尚社论摄影师、艺术总监、布景设计师、字体设计师和 Behance 级别的活动设计师。
创建一张 16:9 的横向社论活动海报，宣布 ZARA 托特包新品发布。
参考产品：
将上传的参考图像作为准确的产品参考。
托特包必须在视觉上忠于参考图：
— 深勃艮第红/牛血色皮革外观
— 结构化的圆润托特包轮廓
— 宽阔的弧形上半身
— 独特的双提手结构
— 长肩带
— 短手提柄
— 可见的缝线结构
— 极简金属细节
— 低调奢华质感
— 相同的比例、轮廓、手提结构和材料特性
请勿重新设计包袋。
请勿改变轮廓。
请勿添加参考图中不存在的口袋、标志、硬件或装饰元素。
在整个构图中，产品必须始终作为可识别的核心单品（hero SKU）。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
概念 — 新品发布
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
这不是传统的 ZARA 产品拍摄。
它应该感觉像是为 Instagram、时尚媒体和 Behance 社论案例研究创作的高度艺术化设计的 ZARA 新品发布活动。
托特包被视为“崇拜物（CULT OBJECT）”——拍摄时具有时尚活动而非标准电商产品图的视觉自信。
视觉语言：
时尚社论 × 当代零售 × 艺术化设计的街头摄影 × 高端商品发布。
该活动应立即传达出：
全新发布。
限定时刻。
令人向往的物件。
ZARA 能量。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
布局架构
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
16:9 横向社论海报。
创建一个戏剧性的分割构图：
左侧 45%：
大胆的图形领域，具有强烈的 ZARA 风格社论处理。
右侧 55%：
全出血电影感时尚照片，展示一位真实的时尚模特携带准确的参考托特包。
硬性的垂直构图划分。
图形区域和摄影区域必须感觉是共同设计的，而不是两张独立的图像。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
背景
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
使用大胆、出人意料的时尚社论背景，而不是纯白色。
受参考托特包启发，深牛血色/勃艮第红、暖米白色和炭黑色之间的视觉关系。
背景应感觉昂贵、具有建筑感和当代感。
可能的视觉环境：
极简主义粗野主义建筑、
大型几何墙面、
巨大的石材表面、
建筑阴影、
时尚店铺外观、
欧洲城市街道、
或雕塑感的混凝土环境。
没有通用的影棚背景。
环境应感觉像是真实的 ZARA 时尚活动拍摄地点。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
核心摄影
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
一位真实的成年时尚模特，完全虚构且不可识别。
模特穿着当代 ZARA 风格的时尚：
极简剪裁的廓形大衣、
结构感长裤、
精致鞋履、
克制的配饰。
勃艮第红托特包是视觉核心。
模特在穿过建筑环境时自然地将包提在身侧。
姿势：
自信、
社论风格、
略带抓拍感、
非对抗性、
时装周街拍能量。
模特不应看起来像名人或公认的公众人物。
自然的人体解剖结构。
自然的皮肤纹理。
真实的手。
真实对提手的抓握。
托特包必须保持清晰可见且无遮挡。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
相机 / 摄影
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
高端专业时尚社论摄影。
全画幅/中画幅时尚摄影美学。
50mm 社论镜头。
相机位置略低于眼睛水平。
微妙的透视压缩。
浅但受控的景深。
托特包必须极其清晰。
模特背后有自然的场景深度。
专业时尚活动照明：
强烈的定向阳光与受控的建筑阴影相结合、
微妙的反射补光、
皮革上的自然镜面高光、
深邃但细节丰富的阴影。
没有人工 CGI 照明。
没有美颜滤镜效果。
没有塑料皮肤。
没有 AI 生成的时尚感。
图像应感觉是由顶级时尚摄影师拍摄的。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
字体系统
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
字体是主要的涉及元素。
使用精致的当代时尚社论无衬线字体：
高对比度、
简洁的几何形状、
精确的间距、
强烈的垂直感、
极简、
奢华零售美学。
请勿模仿或扭曲官方 ZARA 字标。
仅在适当位置使用合法的 ZARA 品牌标识。
大标题：
NEW
DROP
两大行。
“NEW”位于图形区域。
“DROP”戏剧性地超大，并跨越垂直分割线延伸到照片中。
字体应部分遮盖模特和托特包，同时保持完全清晰可辨。
非常大的比例。
紧凑的行距。
略微压缩的社论比例。
扁平化字体。
无发光。
无斜切。
无 3D。
无阴影。
无渐变。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
字体衔接
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
关键点：
单词“DROP”必须物理性地跨越图形场和照片之间的边界。
单词约 40–50% 位于左侧图形场上方。
其余字母继续延伸到摄影环境上方。
字体必须与模特和建筑产生视觉互动。
托特包可能与字体部分交叉，产生精致的社论层叠效果。
这是关键的 Behance 级别构图手法。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
微观字体
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
使用克制的时尚社论信息块。
小的全大写字间距。
布局示例：
ZARA
WOMAN
NEW SEASON
LEATHER TOTE
DROP 01
2026
ONLINE + SELECTED STORES
SHOP NOW →
保持微观文案为次要地位。
不要在海报中填充不必要的文字。
大量的负空间。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
产品标注
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
在托特包附近添加一个小型的社论产品注释：
ZARA
LEATHER TOTE
BURGUNDY
使用细的定向字体/微妙的技术注释线指向包袋。
注释应感觉像是时尚社论产品研究，而不是电商 UI。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
角落系统
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
左上角：
小的 ZARA 品牌标识。
左下角：
NEW SEASON / DROP 01
右上角：
2026 / EDITORIAL RELEASE
右下角：
SHOP THE DROP →
所有信息必须保持极其整洁。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
色彩系统
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
主要视觉颜色：
直接源自参考托特包的深勃艮第红/牛血色。
次要颜色：
暖社论象牙白。
辅助颜色：
接近黑色的炭黑色。
可选的来自包袋硬件的克制金属高光。
没有彩虹色调。
没有不必要的颜色。
勃艮第红托特包必须保持整个构图中最强的色彩锚点。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
艺术指导
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
最终图像应感觉像是：
ZARA 时尚活动
+
高端新品发布
+
Behance 社论案例研究
+
高级时装街拍
+
当代图形设计。
而不是：
普通的产品广告、
亚马逊风格的产品列表、
电商横幅、
基础的 Instagram 广告、
普通的影棚拍摄、
AI 时尚拼贴。
图像应看起来是由资深的欧洲时尚艺术指导团队精心设计的。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
视觉层级
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. 巨大的“DROP”字体
2. 勃艮第红 ZARA 托特包
3. 时尚模特
4. 建筑环境
5. “NEW”标题
6. 产品注释
7. 微观信息
8. 品牌标识
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
最终技术规范
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
16:9 横向。
超高分辨率社论活动艺术作品。
写实时尚摄影。
高端商用级图像质量。
极其清晰的产品构造。
准确的皮革纹理。
准确的缝线。
准确的提手。
自然的人体解剖结构。
清脆的字体。
精确的对齐。
强烈的负空间。
精致的社论调色。
无可见的 AI 瑕疵。
无畸形的手。
无重复物体。
无变形的包袋。
无改变的产品轮廓。
无随机标志。
无虚假品牌标记。
无过多文字。
无通用的库存照片美学。
最终结果：
一张极具视觉冲击力的 ZARA 托特包新品发布海报，完全可以作为高端时尚活动核心图、社论插页、户外时尚广告牌或 Behance 精选项目使用。

items.title: 温暖治愈系生活流电影群像海报

prompts.text:
【Character / Work】, warm healing ensemble movie poster, slice-of-life realistic photography, East Asian contemporary urban daily atmosphere, with a gentle, light, approachable, healing, realistic yet slightly idealistic independent film promotional photo feel.

If [Character] is filled in, construct a group of warm characters around that character that matches their worldview and relationships; if [Work] is filled in, select 4–6 of the most representative core characters from the work to form an ensemble, with all characters retaining clear and stable identity recognition: hairstyle outline, hair color, face shape, eye shape and the relationship between eyes and eyebrows, character primary colors, iconic clothing structures, key accessories, and identity symbols. The entire thing is translated into a live-action / real-world movie character texture, while retaining the core identifiability of the work and characters.

The image is a vertical movie poster composition. The ensemble of characters is concentrated in the lower middle part of the frame, while the upper part retains a large area of clean negative space, forming a very clear poster-like sense of breathing and visual hierarchy. The overall composition is stable, clear, and friendly, like a highly finished healing movie official poster, but it is a pure image version, containing no text elements such as titles, actor names, release information, slogans, or production credits.

The scene is set in a warm and real indoor public space, which can be understood as a children's activity room, a small community classroom, a rehabilitation center, a childcare space, a handicraft activity room, a community rest area, or a daily indoor environment with slight traces of life. The background uses beige, light peach, cream, and pale wood colors as the main tones, with clean and soft walls and slight daily decorations. Small, low-saturation, soft, and friendly daily objects and environmental details can naturally appear in the frame, such as handmade hanging decorations, knitwear, small storage racks, children's graffiti, foam puzzle mats, paper decorations, transparent bottles and jars, small toys, simple tabletops, soft fabrics, and daily props, but the overall look remains neat, orderly, and not overly crowded.

The relationship between characters is presented as a warm collective group photo feel, but not a stiff line. Characters naturally approach each other, sit down or half-squat, are slightly staggered front and back, and their bodies are connected to each other, forming an intimate and relaxed relationship atmosphere. There can be 4–6 main characters, or the number can be automatically adjusted according to [Character / Work]. It is allowed to include a child, a mascot, a small-sized character from the work, a cute pet, or a symbolic companion as an emotional anchor and source of life-like feeling.

Character expressions are mainly natural smiles, relaxed expressions, gentle gazes, easy greetings, making hand gestures, smiling at the camera, and slight interactions, emphasizing a sense of closeness, group belonging, and gentle moments in real life. The overall look is more like a frame captured by a photographer in an ordinary daily life, rather than a dramatized posed shot. All characters are treated as adults; if the original work involves underage characters, they are maintained with an appropriate real-world age structure and natural ensemble relationships during translation.

Clothing is automatically translated according to [Character / Work], but uniformly incorporated into a soft, realistic, and credible clothing system such as 'daily light uniforms / simple workwear / daily casual clothes / community staff feel / light medical feel / simple home casual wear'. Clothing colors are mainly low-saturation soft colors such as light blue, light grayish blue, off-white, khaki, light camel, cream yellow, pale pink, and grayish green, so that the group of characters has a unified realistic movie styling logic in the same frame, while still retaining each character's identity through local colors and accessories.

The lighting uses soft natural indoor diffused daylight, like soft light entering the room from the window during the day, overall high-key, low contrast, light airiness, soft shadows, clean and translucent skin, and the overall color temperature is warm. The image has slight bloom, gentle haze, soft highlight roll-off, and subtle filmic softness, giving the entire image a very gentle 'phenomenal healing film' vibe, while still maintaining clear and realistic photographic details.

The color system is dominated by warm beige, peach beige, cream, pale blue, and soft pastel accents, overall bright, soft, clean, and restrained. The image avoids strong pure blacks and overly deep shadows, placing the visual focus on the characters' emotions, relationships, and the warmth in the space. The background and clothing form a unified soft color field, the characters' skin tones are natural, and the overall look is like a 'pure image version of a realism healing movie poster currently in warm release'.

Composition emphasizes:
bottom-weighted ensemble composition,
large upper negative space,
gentle centered grouping,
soft domestic interior,
human relationship-driven storytelling,
healing slice-of-life cinema poster.

Imaging texture is highly finished modern film promotional photography:
contemporary cinematic portrait photography,
soft natural daylight,
clean skin texture,
gentle tonal transitions,
subtle filmic atmosphere,
high-resolution but not oversharpened,
clear facial readability,
natural group interaction.

The final effect should be like a brand new and clean healing ensemble movie poster without any copy: warm, approachable, credible, soft, with a realistic daily sense and collective emotional power. No text appears except for a tiny 'voxcat' signature in the bottom right corner.

prompts.text:
【角色 / 作品】，温暖疗愈系群像电影海报，生活流写实摄影，东亚当代都市日常气质，具有温柔、轻盈、亲近、治愈、现实主义又带一点理想化的独立电影宣传照感觉。

如果填写的是【角色】，则围绕该角色构建一组与其世界观和关系匹配的温暖群像；如果填写的是【作品】，则从作品中选择 4–6 位最有代表性的核心人物组成群像，所有人物都保留清晰稳定的身份识别：发型轮廓、发色、脸型、眼型与眉眼关系、角色主色、标志性服装结构、关键配饰与身份符号。整体全部转译为真人版 / 现实世界电影角色质感，但保留作品与角色的核心辨识度。

画面为纵向电影海报构图。人物群像集中在画面下半部偏中间位置，上半部保留大面积干净留白，形成非常明确的海报式呼吸感与视觉层级。整体构图稳定、清晰、亲和，像一张完成度很高的治愈系电影正式海报，但为纯画面版本，不包含标题、演员名、上映信息、标语、制作名单等任何文字元素。

场景设定为温暖真实的室内公共空间，可理解为儿童活动室、社区小教室、康复中心、托育空间、手工活动室、社区休息区或带有轻微生活痕迹的日常室内环境。背景使用米杏色、浅桃色、奶油色、淡木色为主，墙面干净柔和，带有轻微生活装饰。画面中可自然出现一些低饱和、柔软、亲切的小型生活物件与环境细节，例如手工挂饰、编织物、小收纳架、儿童涂鸦、泡沫拼图垫、纸质装饰、透明瓶罐、小玩具、简洁桌面、柔和布料与生活道具，但整体仍保持整洁、有秩序、不过度拥挤。

人物关系呈现为温暖的集体合影感，但不能僵硬站排。角色之间自然靠近、坐下或半蹲、轻微前后错落、身体彼此联结，形成亲密而轻松的关系氛围。可以有 4–6 位主要人物，也可根据【角色 / 作品】自动调整人数。允许其中搭配一名孩童、吉祥物、作品中的小体型角色、萌宠或象征性陪伴对象，作为情绪锚点与生活感来源。

人物表情以自然笑容、放松神情、温和注视、轻松打招呼、比手势、微笑看镜头、轻微互动为主，强调亲近感、群体归属感与现实生活中的温柔瞬间。整体更像在某个平凡日常中被摄影师捕捉到的一帧，而不是戏剧化摆拍。所有人物保持成年化处理；若原作涉及未成年角色，则转译时维持合适的真实世界年龄结构与自然群像关系。

创建一个垂直的舒适家居剪贴簿海报，灵感来自参考图像。将上半部分的精美写实室内照片与下半部分的手绘插图记忆日志相结合。

顶部区域：一个温暖、明亮且极简的舒适家居室内，配有天然奶油色墙壁、浅色木质家具、摆满微型陶瓷房子、可爱收藏人偶、微型动物、书籍、带框艺术品和手工装饰的开放式木质架子。包括一张木桌或餐桌、复古收音机、小台灯、花卉、篮子、陶瓷和精心排列的小物件。柔和的阳光从窗户射入，温暖的自然阴影，宁静的北欧/日式小屋审美，整洁且诱人，写实室内摄影，高度详细。

底部区域：将相同的房间和物体转换为纹理温暖的奶油色纸上的迷人手绘剪贴簿插图。将插图排列在整齐的 3×3 网格中，每个小面板显示一个舒适的细节：微型房屋、可爱的人物形象、复古收音机、平板电脑/屏幕、台灯、微型动物收藏、花瓶、陶瓷收藏、篮子、书籍和其他小装饰品。使用细腻的水彩和彩色铅笔质感，柔和的棕色墨水轮廓，柔和的粉彩色调，略显不完美的手工笔触。

在顶部添加手写标题：“My Little World”或“My Cozy Home”，并带有小星星、爱心和简单的涂鸦。在每张插图下方添加简短的手写说明，例如“little things, big happiness”、“cozy corner”、“my little collection”、“warm light”、“home sweet home”、“small moments, big joy”。

风格：舒适生活方式杂志 + 手工旅行日志，怀旧剪贴簿，水彩和彩色铅笔插图，有纹理的纸张，温暖的米褐色和天然木色调，柔和的阳光，可爱的微型细节，优雅的极简构图，高度详细，垂直 4:5 海报，从写实摄影到插图的无缝过渡，无水印。
