items.title: 先锋时尚杂志极简商业大片封面

prompts.text:
Avant-garde fashion magazine cover and luxury brand concept planning poster, minimalist commercial blockbuster style, real high-definition human portrait photography, 9:16 standard vertical format, panoramic standing full-body portrait. The image features a fashion woman with extreme supermodel proportions as the sole subject, the composition is centered slightly to the right, with a restrained and pure sense of breathing white space. The background is a minimalist off-white monochromatic seamless studio, with low information density, a strong sense of order, and gallery collection quality.

The model exhibits a strong sense of avant-garde lens presence: ten-head body proportion, long lower limbs, tight and slender waist, sharp waist-hip angle; wearing a haute couture cinched-waist silhouette short trench coat jacket, with a leather glossy ultra-short hip-hugging skirt underneath, wearing ultra-thin dark red slightly translucent tights and deep burgundy patent leather ultra-thin high heels on the lower body. The leather reflection is stiff, and the stockings show delicate muscle translucency and highlight gradients.

The posture is full of tension: the model stands with her back turned, her torso rotating and twisting elegantly to a large degree, the axis of the hips and legs extending straight vertically, legs close together in a neat inward-pointing toe posture; one hand is raised to the top of the head slightly bent and open, the other arm hangs naturally at the side of the waist, both hands are empty, standing upright and tight on ultra-thin heels; voluminous blonde hair is put up in a pretty double bun hairstyle, wearing thin black-rimmed glasses, looking back with a side profile of three-dimensional bone structure, with a cold and composed expression, possessing both aggressiveness and a dangerous elegant aura.

Light and shadow adopt top-tier commercial sculptural lighting: softbox diffusion combined with sharp rim lighting, accurately carving the trench coat silhouette, skin shimmer, leather mirror surface, and stocking sub-surface texture, with colors unified in a restrained system of low-saturation off-white and rich dark red.

The layout is a minimalist modern vertical system: micro restrained sans-serif letter titles and ultra-fine lines are arranged vertically in the white space, with wide letter spacing, including a planning number, and a low-profile exclusive signature engraved in the white space at the edge of the image: voxcat.

prompts.text:
先锋时尚杂志封面与奢侈品牌概念企划海报，极简主义商业大片风格，真实真人超高清人像摄影，9:16标准竖版画幅，全景立姿全身像。画面以极端超模比例的时尚女性为唯一主体，构图居中微偏右，留有克制纯净的呼吸感留白，背景为极简米白单色无缝影棚，信息密度低，极具秩序感与画廊收藏质感。

模特展现强烈的先锋镜头感：十头身比例，下肢修长，腰部紧致纤细，腰臀折角鲜明；身着高定收腰廓形短风衣外套，内搭皮革亮面超短包臀裙，下身着极薄暗红微透光连裤袜与深酒红漆皮极细高跟鞋，皮革反光硬挺，丝袜呈现细腻肌肉透光与高光渐变。

姿态极具张力：模特背身站立，躯干大幅度优雅回旋拧转，臀腿轴线沿竖向笔直延伸，双腿并拢呈利落内扣足尖姿态；单手举至头顶微曲张开，另一臂自然垂落于腰侧，双手皆空，踩极细鞋跟紧绷直立；蓬松金发盘起俏丽双丸子发髻，佩戴细黑框眼镜，回眸侧颜骨相立体，神情冷峻从容，兼具侵略性与危险优雅气场。

光影采用顶级商业雕塑式布光：柔光箱漫射结合锐利轮廓光，精准切分风衣轮廓、皮肤微光、皮革镜面与丝袜次表面质感，色彩统一在低饱和米白与醇厚暗红的克制体系中。

版式为极简现代垂直系统：留白处纵向排布微缩克制的无衬线字母标题与极细线条，字距疏朗，带有企划编号，画面边缘留白处低调印刻专属签名：voxcat。

items.title: 旧物修补材料品牌视觉风格板

prompts.text:
Generate a brand visual style board around any theme object, establishing a strong brightness partition between the upper and lower parts overall: the upper part is a clean high-brightness blank field, placing real objects or material samples related to the theme, using an overhead display and a slightly staggered diagonal intersection relationship, letting long strips, round heads, tips, or curved silhouettes form extractable symbolic clues; objects retain manual traces, worn edges, polished dark parts, partial cracks or coating peeling, shadows are soft and ground-hugging, the blank area is larger than the physical object occupation, making coarse materials appear quiet and scrutinized. The lower part transitions into a low-brightness matte black information field, the top only puts a small amount of explanatory text with extremely small letter spacing, the left and right corners form a slight symmetry, the central axis puts a short Chinese name and a small English transcription, maintaining white space to suppress information density. The main logo is extracted from the contours of the objects in the upper part, not directly copying the objects, but transforming the long handles, round ends, notches, missing corners, and joints of the theme into loose handwritten letters and primitive graphics, the letter sizes are uneven, the baseline jumps, the spacing is loose, and local glyphs are replaced by object-shaped silhouettes, like hand-cut paper pieces or thick paint stickers on a black background. Color matching is theme-adaptive: high-brightness background colors and low-brightness background colors undertake large-area structures, the logo uses a small amount of low-saturation theme colors and warm white to form brightness skip points, and the colored version and the light version maintain the same glyph skeleton when juxtaposed. Avoid exquisite vectors, commercial gloss, and neat grids; must retain the relationship of crudeness, hand-making, material wear, and the mutual deformation of graphics and text.

——————
Establish a visual style board for an old object repair material brand: the upper high-brightness empty field displays patch cloth, needles and thread, tape, and worn corners, using a gathering composition close to a circle, leaving a piece of quiet white space in the middle; using brick red as the only low-saturation accent color, warm white, matte black, and grayish-brown undertake the main body, the material remains coarse and lusterless. The logo is placed on the central axis of the lower black field, the title is in a narrow and long vertical arrangement, the English transcription is split into two segments close to the glyph outline, and the information hierarchy shrinks step by step from the title to tiny annotations; the aspect ratio is vertical 3:4.

prompts.text:
围绕任意主题对象生成品牌视觉风格板，整体先建立上下强明度分区：上部是干净高明度空白场，放置主题相关的真实物件或材质样本，采用俯视陈列和轻微错位的斜向交叉关系，让长条、圆头、尖端或弯曲轮廓形成可被提炼的符号线索；物件保留手工痕迹、磨损边、暗部擦亮、局部裂纹或涂层剥落，阴影柔软贴地，空白面积大于实物占用，使粗粝材质显得安静而被审视。下部转入低明度哑黑信息场，顶部只放少量极小字距的说明文字，左右边角形成轻微对称，中轴放简短中文名与小号英文转写，保持留白压住信息密度。主要标志从上部物件的轮廓中提炼，不直接复制物件，而把主题的长柄、圆端、凹口、缺角、连接处转化为松散手写字母和幼拙图形，字母大小不齐、基线跳动、间距松散，局部字形被器物状剪影替代，像手剪纸片或厚涂颜料贴在黑底上。配色按主题自适应：高明度底色与低明度底色承担大面积结构，标志使用少量低饱和主题色与暖白色形成明暗跳点，彩色版和浅色版并置时保持同一字形骨架。避免精致矢量、商业光泽和整齐网格，必须保留朴拙、手作、材料磨耗、图形与文字互相变形的关系。

——————
为旧物修补材料品牌建立视觉风格板：上部高明度空场陈列补丁布、针线、胶带和磨损边角，采用近似圆环的聚拢构图，中间留出一块安静空白；以砖红作为唯一低饱和强调色，暖白、哑黑与灰褐承担主体，材质依旧粗粝而无光泽。标志置于下部黑场中轴，标题做窄长竖向排列，英文转写拆成两段贴近字形轮廓，信息层级从标题到微小注释逐级收缩；画幅为竖版 3:4。

items.title: 超写实和室茶室女性人像摄影

prompts.text:
Hyper-realistic Japanese washitsu life portrait photography, vertical ratio approximately 3:4. A clearly adult East Asian female, 25+, sitting in a minimalist Japanese tea room / washitsu with light beige tatami, the body is located center-right of the frame, next to a dark low wooden table. The camera position is located slightly to the left in front of the character, slightly higher than the leg position, using a 35–50mm lens for medium-distance shooting, completely preserving the head, upper body, sitting legs and feet, while also preserving the floor-to-ceiling gauze curtains on the left, the low table, the vase, the paper lantern and a large area of negative space in the room.

The character has a slender, long, naturally curved adult female body type: narrow shoulders, naturally moderate chest, distinctively cinched waist, soft hips, long thighs, and slender calves. The overall temperament is gentle, restrained, and elegant; no fitness muscularity, and no exaggerated fullness.

The character has very long, straight, dark brown-black hair, the length reaching below the chest near the waist, with a smooth and natural hair quality. No thick bangs on the forehead, the hair on the top and sides is gently gathered back into a half-tied / low half-bun hairstyle, and the rest of the long hair hangs naturally in front of the chest and behind the back. The face shape is a small oval, the skin tone is fair and natural, and the facial features are delicate and mature. Makeup is very light: natural eyebrow shape, thin eyeliner, soft eyelashes, light pink blush, and nude pink-rose lip makeup. She looks directly at the camera, her expression is calm and gentle, with almost no obvious smile at the corners of her mouth, and her demeanor is quiet and composed.

On the upper body, she wears a light cream / off-white camisole slim-fit long dress or one-piece dress, the neckline is low but natural, the fabric is soft and smooth, fitting the upper body and waistline. Over it is a matching ivory-white lightweight long-style smock / Japanese-style cardigan, the sleeves are very loose with a soft drape, and there are small amounts of hollow-out embroidery, plant patterns, or lace details on the cuffs and hem; the overall look is light and airy but not Xianxia clothing.

The lower hem of the dress is naturally spread on the tatami, and the part above the knees is slightly gathered upwards due to the sitting posture. The legs wear smoke-gray-black ultra-thin transparent pantyhose, approximately 8–12D, which must clearly reveal the real skin tone, overall appearing in a soft smoke-gray, the material fits the skin smoothly, forming delicate and slight silk luster on the thighs, knees, calves, and instep. No thick black stockings, no fishnet stockings.

The feet do not wear shoes, and the stockings extend completely to cover the toes and soles. The foreground feet can see the real contours of the soles, toes, and arches, but do not do extreme close-ups.

The sitting posture is strictly restored: the character sits center-right of the tatami, the body close to the low table, and the torso remains naturally straight. The legs extend diagonally to the left front from the hips, the two legs naturally cross and stack near the knees, one leg pressed on top of the other, with knees slightly bent. The calves continue to extend towards the bottom left and directly below the frame, the two feet are staggered front and back, with the foot closer to the camera located center-left at the bottom of the frame, and the other foot slightly behind. No cross-legged sitting, no kneeling, and no high-positioned leg-crossing.

The character's hands gently hold a small white / off-white ceramic teacup in front of the chest and abdomen, one hand supporting the cup body, and the fingers of the other hand lightly resting on the rim or lid position, the movement is very gentle. Wearing a small amount of exquisite jewelry: small earrings, thin chain necklace, overall restrained.

The scene is a modern minimalist Japanese washitsu / tea room. The floor is covered with a large area of light beige-yellow tatami, the tatami texture is clear, and the edges have natural wooden platforms. The left side of the frame is a full row of ivory-white linen gauze curtains falling from the ceiling to the floor, the fabric is translucent with obvious vertical folds, strong natural sunlight enters the room through the curtains, forming clear strip light and shadow on the tatami and wooden floor.

To the right of the character is a dark brown vintage Japanese low table / coffee table, the tabletop is long and narrow with obvious wood grain, and the four corners have a traditional curved leg structure. A gray-green / sage-green long table runner is spread on the tabletop, hanging towards the front from the middle of the table.

A tall pink ceramic vase is placed center-right of the tabletop, the vase body is slender with a smooth glaze, containing several bright pink-purple peonies / herbaceous peonies, with two or three slender green leaves extending upwards. The flower color is the only obviously high-saturation point in the entire frame.

A small deep green / dark green tea tin or incense box is also placed on the back side of the tabletop, next to which there can be a small amount of simple tea sets, but do not pile up items.

A circular straw-woven futon / rattan-woven cushion is placed on the ground to the left-rear of the character, the color is light brown with clear weaving texture.

The background wall is low-saturation gray-green / sage-gray-green, the surface is very clean without complex decorations. On the right side of the frame, a dark wooden frame sliding door / window frame and a layer of thin white gauze curtain can be seen.

A very large white Japanese washi spherical pendant light / paper lantern hangs on the top right of the frame, the spherical lampshade has clear horizontal skeleton textures, and part of it is cropped by the top of the frame. Parts of the ceiling are low-saturation dark red / brick red, forming a restrained Japanese color scheme with the gray-green wall.

Lighting is the most critical part of the frame: using strong natural daylight from the large window on the left. The sunlight shines diagonally from left to right, the character's left face, shoulders, clothes, and legs are illuminated by bright daylight, and clear strip shadows are formed on the tatami; the character's right side and the background remain in soft shadows. The overall dynamic range is natural, with local highlights slightly bright but not overexposed.

Photography style is high-quality natural light Japanese lifestyle photography + modern washitsu tea ceremony portrait: natural skin texture, real pores, delicate hair strands, clear clothing and stocking textures, the background maintains high details, no strong blurring, no studio lighting. The overall tone is mainly cream white, light wood color, sage green, dark brown, and pink-purple flowers, quiet, transparent, and warm.

Focus locking: Clearly adult East Asian female + super long dark brown straight hair half-tied + cream white camisole long dress + ivory white wide-sleeve lightweight smock + smoke-gray-black ultra-thin transparent pantyhose + no shoes + sitting on tatami + legs naturally crossed and extended towards the front left + hands holding white teacup + large area of linen gauze curtains on the left + strong natural window light + Japanese low table + sage green table runner + pink vase + pink-purple peony / herbaceous peony + straw-woven futon + huge white washi spherical pendant light + gray-green wall + modern minimalist Japanese washitsu.

Avoid: short hair, thick bangs, heavy makeup, exaggerated voluptuous body, black clothing, bright complex kimono, pants, bare legs, thick black stockings, fishnet stockings, high heels, sneakers, standing posture, cross-legged sitting, kneeling posture, luxurious Chinese-style tea room, complex ancient-style furniture, studio lighting, night scenes, strong direct flash, strong background blur, cinematic heavy color grading, anime face, CG feeling, plastic skin, extra fingers, extra legs, foot deformities, watermarks and garbled text.

prompts.text:
超写实日式和室生活人像摄影，竖版约 3:4。一名明确成年的东亚女性，25+，坐在铺有浅米色榻榻米的极简日式茶室 / 和室中，身体位于画面中央偏右，旁边是一张深色低矮木桌。摄影机位位于人物正前方略偏左、稍高于腿部的位置，使用约 35–50mm 镜头中距离拍摄，完整保留头部、上半身、坐姿双腿和脚部，同时保留左侧落地纱帘、低桌、花瓶、纸灯笼和房间大面积留白。

人物为纤细修长、曲线自然的成年女性体型：肩部偏窄，胸部自然适中，腰部明显收束，髋部柔和，大腿修长，小腿纤细。整体气质温柔、克制、清雅，不要健身肌肉感，也不要夸张丰满。

人物留深棕黑色超长直发，长度到胸下接近腰部，发质顺滑自然。前额没有厚重刘海，头顶与两侧头发向后轻轻收拢成半扎发 / 低位半束发型，其余长发自然垂在胸前和背后。脸型偏小巧鹅蛋形，肤色白皙自然，五官清秀成熟。妆容非常淡：自然眉形、细眼线、柔和睫毛、浅粉腮红、裸粉玫瑰色唇妆。她正视镜头，表情平静温柔，嘴角几乎没有明显笑意，神情安静、从容。

上身内穿一件浅奶油色 / 米白色吊带修身长裙或连衣裙，领口较低但自然，面料柔软顺滑，贴合上半身和腰线。外搭一件同色系的象牙白轻薄长款罩衫 / 和风开衫，袖子非常宽松，带柔软垂坠感，袖口和下摆有少量镂空刺绣、植物纹样或蕾丝细节，整体轻盈飘逸但不是仙侠服饰。

下身裙摆自然铺在榻榻米上，膝盖以上部分因坐姿轻微向上收起。双腿穿烟灰黑色超薄透明连裤丝袜，约8–12D，必须明显透出真实肤色，整体呈柔和烟灰色，材质贴肤平整，在大腿、膝盖、小腿和脚背形成细腻轻微丝光。不要厚黑丝袜，不要网袜。

双脚不穿鞋，丝袜完整延伸覆盖脚趾与脚底。前景脚部能够看到真实的脚掌、脚趾和足弓轮廓，但不要做极端特写。

坐姿严格还原：人物坐在榻榻米中央偏右位置，身体靠近低桌，躯干保持自然挺直。双腿从髋部向画面左前方斜伸，两条腿在膝盖附近自然交叉叠放，一条腿压在另一条腿上方，双膝轻微弯曲。小腿继续向画面左下和正下方延伸，两只脚前后错开，靠近镜头的一只脚位于画面下方中央偏左，另一只脚稍靠后。不要盘腿，不要跪坐，也不要高位翘腿。

人物双手在胸腹前轻轻捧着一只小型白色 / 米白色陶瓷茶杯，一只手托住杯身，另一只手指轻搭杯沿或杯盖位置，动作非常轻柔。佩戴少量精致首饰：小型耳环、细链项链，整体克制。

场景为现代极简日式和室 / 茶室。地面铺大面积浅米黄色榻榻米，榻榻米纹理清晰，边缘带自然木质平台。画面左侧是一整排从天花板垂落到地面的象牙白亚麻纱帘，布料半透明、纵向褶皱明显，强烈自然阳光透过窗帘进入室内，在榻榻米和木地板上形成清晰条状光影。

人物右侧是一张深棕色复古日式矮桌 / 茶几，桌面狭长，木纹明显，四角为传统弯腿结构。桌面铺一条灰绿色 / 鼠尾草绿色长条桌旗，从桌面中间垂向前侧。

摄影风格为高质量自然光日系生活写真＋现代和室茶席人像：自然肤质、真实毛孔、细腻发丝、衣料和丝袜纹理清楚，背景保持较高细节，不要强烈虚化，不要影棚打光。整体色调以奶油白、浅木色、鼠尾草绿、深棕和粉紫花朵为主，安静、通透、温暖。

An early‑twenties East Asian woman stands at the threshold of a sun‑lit courtyard, her profile captured through an open doorway that frames the scene like a living portrait. A subtle blush kisses her cheekbones, while her straight, slim nose and modest cupid’s bow rest in a relaxed, slightly serious expression that balances allure with restraint.

She wears a soft ivory boho ensemble that feels as if it were woven from morning mist. A white halter top hugs her defined waist, its delicate straps drawing attention to her slender shoulders and the graceful line of her neck. Over the top drapes a layered lace shawl, its intricate pattern catching the light and casting faint shadows across her shoulders. Flowing tassels spill from the shawl’s hem, swaying gently with her slightest movement, while delicate body chains trace the curve of her torso, catching glints of sunrise as they trace the contours of her figure. The fabrics are light and airy, their knitted textures adding a tactile sense of femininity without overwhelming her silhouette.

She is seated on a low, weathered wooden bench placed just inside the doorway, one leg crossed over the other in a relaxed, twisted torso pose that accentuates her slender hips and elongated limbs. Her right hand rests lightly on the chain that circles her waist, fingers trailing over the metal links as if feeling an invisible rhythm. The left arm rests on the bench, elbow bent, forearm supporting her chin in a day‑dreaming gesture, eyes unfocused and gazing past the camera toward an unseen horizon. This pose creates a subtle contrapposto, the weight shifted onto her left hip, the right hip slightly lifted, giving her a poised yet languid presence.

The composition places her in the left third of the frame, leaving a broad expanse of negative space that stretches through the courtyard beyond the doorway, suggesting depth and the promise of an open world beyond. The doorway itself forms a natural frame‑within‑frame, its wooden lintel and stone threshold providing architectural lines that echo the delicate lace of her shawl. The viewer’s eye is drawn along the diagonal created by the bench, the crossing leg, and the flow of tassels, guiding attention toward her face and the subtle shimmer of the body chains.

Warm sunrise light pours through the doorway from the right, casting a soft side‑light that outlines the edges of her hair and the folds of the shawl with a gentle rim. The light is diffused by a sheer curtain that filters the glow, creating a delicate interplay of warm amber and cool early‑morning blues across the scene. Shadows fall lightly on the bench and the stone floor, adding dimensionality without hard contrast, while the subtle bounce from the courtyard walls adds a faint luminous fill to the left side of her face, emphasizing the quiet allure of her expression.

Every element, from the ivory palette and airy fabrics to the relaxed yet intentional pose, framed doorway, and sunrise side‑light, converges to evoke an ethereal, feminine charm that feels both intimate and expansive. The image captures a moment of serene allure, where the subject’s gentle confidence and the softness of her boho attire create a timeless reverie that invites the viewer to linger in the quiet beauty of the early day.

她穿着一套柔软的象牙色波西米亚套装，感觉像是用清晨的薄雾织就的。一件白色挂脖上衣紧贴着她轮廓分明的腰部，精致的肩带将注意力吸引到她纤细的双肩和优雅的颈部线条上。上衣外披着一件叠层蕾丝披肩，其复杂的图案捕捉着光线，在她的肩膀上投射出淡淡的阴影。流动的流苏从披肩边缘垂下，随着她最轻微的动作轻轻摆动，而精致的身体链勾勒出她躯干的曲线，在勾勒她身材轮廓时捕捉着日出的闪光。织物轻盈飘逸，针织纹理在不掩盖她轮廓的前提下增添了触觉上的女性气质。

她坐在一张放置在门内侧的低矮饱经风霜的木凳上，一条腿叠在另一条腿上，呈现出放松的扭转躯干姿势，突出了她纤细的臀部和修长的四肢。她的右手轻轻搭在环绕腰部的链条上，手指滑过金属链环，仿佛在感受一种无形的节奏。左臂搁在长凳上，手肘弯曲，前臂支撑着下巴，做出白日梦的手势，眼神涣散，越过相机望向看不见的远方地平线。这个姿势创造了一种微妙的对立式平衡，重心移到左臀部，右臀部略微抬起，赋予她一种优雅而慵懒的存在感。

构图将她置于画面的左侧三分之一处，留下一片广阔的负空间，延伸到门外的庭院，暗示着深度和门外开放世界的承诺。门扉本身形成了一个自然的框中框，其木制过梁和石质门槛提供的建筑线条与她披肩的精致蕾丝相呼应。观众的视线顺着由长凳、交叉的双腿和流动的流苏创造的对角线移动，引导注意力转向她的脸部和身体链的微妙闪烁。

温暖的日出光线从右侧穿过门扉洒入，投射出柔和的侧光，勾勒出她头发的边缘和披肩的褶皱，带有一层温柔的轮廓光。光线被一层透明的窗帘过滤，在整个场景中创造出温暖琥珀色与清凉清晨蓝色之间精致的相互作用。阴影轻轻落在长凳和石地板上，增加了维度感而没有强烈的对比，而来自庭院墙壁的微妙反光为她脸部的左侧添加了微弱的发光填充，强调了她表情中宁静的吸引力。

从象牙色调和飘逸的织物到放松而刻意的姿势、构图门框和日出侧光，每一个元素都汇聚在一起，唤起一种空灵、女性化的魅力，既亲密又广阔。影像捕捉了一个宁静诱惑的时刻，主体的温柔自信和波西米亚服装的柔软创造了一个永恒的遐想，邀请观众流连于清晨宁静的美丽中。

items.title: 窄长字嵌影视觉切片高原输电巡检海报

prompts.text: Let the future theme first be compressed into a set of recognizable main images, then fully embed the images into large, narrow, bold characters occupying the core of the screen: what is seen at first glance is not independent photos and titles, but a huge visual slice formed by text outlines, internal scenes, and black whitespace. The glyphs bear the main composition, vertical strokes are densely arranged, horizontal space is compressed, and hard, almost mechanical black gaps are maintained between characters; the internal images are continuously misplaced across different character cavities but still share the same depth of field, horizon, or action path, allowing reading, viewing, and thematic narrative to occur simultaneously. The thematic content should be reconstructed as a documentary scene with foreground and background layers, clear subject scales, and local actions; figures or objects serve only as scale anchors in the image and do not individually snatch the title hierarchy. The background uses an almost pure black plane, external whitespace is restrained, and a small amount of equal-width, highly technical explanatory text, location information, or symbolic markings are quietly arranged at the bottom, forming a sense of a data archive beneath the main visual. The color palette is skeletal with a black base and low-saturation cool-colored imagery, allowing the theme itself to provide a small amount of natural color, but overall remaining grayish, cool, and low-decoration; light is like outdoor documentary photography, with brightness and darkness determined by real scenery, without adding commercial gradients. There should be slight cropping, compression, and a sense of print translation between the intra-character images and the glyph edges; local details can be rough but not messy, maintaining clear recognizability, hard edges, and slightly uneven alignment between image and text. The font is not a designated library: use a transferable narrow-tall structure, heavy straight strokes, tight tracking, shallow narrow inner cavities, simple terminals, and a few sharp turns; let different writing systems reorganize strokes, cavities, connections, and reading rhythms according to their own glyph topology to ensure the target text remains naturally recognizable. Avoid shrinking photos into ordinary backgrounds, floating titles on top of pictures, over-beautification, roundness and cuteness, rich decoration, soft focus, neon, gradient backgrounds, or sterile digital typography. —————— Implement the theme as a plateau power transmission line inspection poster: use rock ochre-brown as the primary color, overlaid with lead gray, low-saturation cyan-green, and faint safety yellow, with low-angle side light strengthening the realistic terrain; giant narrow characters are horizontally divided into two groups, with internal images misaligned and connected along the path of diagonal power towers-ridges-inspection personnel, the main subject concentrated in the bottom left and expanding to the top right, with black whitespace suppressing the density around the edges; the title adopts a three-level hierarchy with small text guidance in the top left, giant central characters for weight-bearing, and technical data secondary arrangement at the bottom, with a vertical 3:4 aspect ratio.

prompts.text:
让未来主题先被压缩成一组可辨识的主体影像，再把影像完整嵌入占据画面核心的大型窄长粗体字中：第一眼看到的不是独立照片与标题，而是文字轮廓、内部景象和黑色留白共同形成的巨大视觉切片。字形承担主要构图，竖向笔画密集排列，横向空间被压缩，字与字之间保留硬朗、近乎机械的黑色间隙；内部图像在不同字腔中连续错位，但仍共享同一条景深、地平线或动作路径，使阅读、观看和主题叙事同时发生。主题内容应重建为具有远近层次、明确主体尺度和局部动作的纪实场景，人物或物件只作为影像中的尺度锚点，不单独抢夺标题层级。背景使用近乎纯黑的平面，外围留白克制，底部安静排列少量等宽、技术感强的说明文字、地点信息或符号标记，形成主视觉下方的资料档案感。色彩以黑底和低饱和冷色影像为骨架，允许主题自身提供少量自然色，但整体保持偏灰、偏冷、低装饰；光线像户外纪实摄影，明暗由真实景物决定，不添加商业渐变。字内图像与字形边缘应有轻微裁切、压缩和印刷转译感，局部细节可粗糙但不能脏乱，保留清晰识别度、硬边和不完全均匀的图文贴合。字体不是指定字库：使用可迁移的窄体高字面结构、厚重直线笔画、紧凑字距、浅窄内腔、简洁端点与少量锐利转折；让不同文字系统根据自身字形拓扑重新组织笔画、字腔、连接和阅读节奏，确保目标文字仍能自然辨认。避免把照片缩成普通背景、让标题浮在图片上、过度美化、圆润可爱、丰富装饰、柔焦、霓虹、渐变背景或整齐无菌的数字排版。

最高优先级：16格身体结构严格对应01至16，不能仅通过镜头角度、人物朝向、表情或裁切制造差异；差异必须来自身体结构，每格使用不同的身体支撑、腿部或躯干结构。

一、主体一致性
16格保持同一主体的身份、外貌、体型、发型、发色、服装、配饰与核心视觉特征一致；头发、衣摆、褶皱可随动作自然变化。主体始终为第一视觉主体。主体身份、服装与视觉特征不得因姿势变化而漂移。

二、16种姿势
01后方跪坐式
双膝着地，臀部向后靠近脚跟，身体背向镜头，上身保持直立，形成明确的后方人物轮廓。

02侧展腿跪坐式
双膝着地，一条腿向身体侧方展开，另一条腿保持弯曲，上身直立，形成明显的侧向腿部线条。

03四足斜向跪姿式
双手与双膝着地，形成明确四点支撑，身体呈明显斜向结构，一侧腿向侧前方展开。

04俯卧单腿抬起式
身体完整俯卧，上身由前臂支撑，一条腿向后上方弯曲抬起，另一条腿保持伸展。

05纯侧卧伸腿式
身体完整侧卧，一侧手臂支撑上身，双腿沿身体方向伸展，形成清晰的纯侧面轮廓。

06侧坐后撑伸腿式
坐姿，一条腿向前伸展，另一条腿弯曲收拢，身体向后倾，一只手在身后撑地承担重量。

07正面展开跪坐式
双膝着地，身体正对镜头，双腿向左右两侧大幅展开，双手自然放置。

08单臂抬手坐姿式
坐姿，一条腿弯曲收拢，另一条腿自然展开，一只手向上延伸，另一只手支撑或保持身体平衡。

09俯卧前伸式
身体完整俯卧，双腿向后伸展，双臂向身体前方充分伸直，形成明显的纵深方向。

10后方侧跪伸腿式
身体背向或侧背向镜头，双膝着地，一条腿向身体侧后方充分伸展，上身保持直立。

11仰卧屈膝式
身体完整仰卧，背部贴地，双膝向上弯曲，双脚靠近地面，头部与肩部保持贴地。

12极低位后方四足式
双手与双脚着地，臀部明显抬高，身体形成紧凑的倒V形结构，呈高臀低身的四足结构，从后方低机位观察。

13坐姿环抱腿式
坐姿，双腿向身体前方收拢并交叠，双臂环抱双腿，上身略微向前收缩。

14侧卧托头屈腿式
身体完整侧卧，一只手托住头部，双腿同时弯曲并向身体方向收拢。

15仰卧抬腿式
身体完整仰卧，双腿明显抬离地面并向上弯曲，形成突出的纵向腿部结构。

16后撑侧坐收腿式
坐姿，双腿完全收拢并向身体一侧折叠，身体明显后倾，一只手在身后撑地，另一只手自然放置，形成紧凑的侧向轮廓。

16个姿势必须有明确身体结构差异，严格按01至16执行，不交换、不重复、不遗漏。

三、宫格构成
严格排列：
01 02 03 04
05 06 07 08
09 10 11 12
13 14 15 16

每格仅呈现一个完整主体和对应姿势。统一Editorial人像摄影语言、人物尺度、服装系统与背景逻辑。人物完整入镜，身体结构、手脚膝肘及支撑关系清晰。格间边界清晰，不重叠、不串格、不交换姿势、不遗漏、不重复。

四、背景系统
根据主体服装、发色、代表色与视觉身份提取主色及邻近色，最多两种核心色相，生成低饱和、低对比度极简渐变背景。
仅使用大面积纯净色彩与缓慢渐变，不添加环境、道具、纹理、复杂光影或装饰元素。
16格共享同一渐变逻辑，保持统一、干净、连续，并保留大面积负空间。背景不得形成具体场景。

五、16宫格隐藏视觉
将16个背景视为连续的大型渐变平面。
固定隐藏视觉：主体本身的低对比度45度侧脸轮廓。
根据主体脸部特征、发型与核心视觉特征生成轮廓，以极弱明暗变化融入背景，并连续拆分为16个片段，按4×4自然衔接。
隐藏轮廓仅使用当前主体特征，不引入其他人物；保持低对比、低饱和、弱可见，仅存在于背景负空间。
仅表现抽象连续的明暗形态，不呈现眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴等具体五官。
单格只能看到局部明暗形态，完整观看4×4时才能辨认完整侧脸。
不得覆盖主体、干扰姿势、添加额外人物、形成第二主体或产生水印效果；隐藏轮廓不得成为独立人脸。

六、视觉层级
第一层：主体与16种姿势。
第二层：极简低饱和渐变背景。
第三层：16格连续隐藏视觉。
主体清晰度优先于背景连续性，背景连续性优先于隐藏视觉。

七、最终输出
只生成1张9:16竖版完整图片，内部为4×4共16个独立人物画面。
严格执行01至16，不遗漏、不重复。
不添加标题、说明文字、Logo、杂志排版文字或其他版式文字。
单格为完整、清晰的Editorial人像姿势画面；整体形成统一的16宫格，并在背景中隐藏由16格共同组成的主体45度侧脸轮廓。

prompts.text:
超写实中国普通写字楼开放办公区手机纪实抓拍，竖版约 3:4。明确成年的 23 岁绝美东亚女性，气质时尚、自信、温柔，独自坐在隔断工位外侧，低头看屏幕。摄影者站在过道稍前方偏左，约 35–50mm，拍到头部、轻薄白衬衫里的低领胸型、细腰和交叉的大腿，桌沿不准挡住胸口；同时留下邻座局部、隔断名牌和格栅灯。

身材匀称丰满，胸部明显自然丰满，有自然重量感和柔和圆润轮廓，胸腰差明显；腰细，髋腿有真实柔软体积。不要过瘦，不要扁平，不要健美。

她坐在黑色网布办公椅上微微前倾，双腿膝上交叉，一条小腿斜伸到过道。右手握鼠标，左手搭在文件边。头低着看表格，不看镜头。前倾把白衬衫领口拉开，薄料下胸型压出圆润重量，腰从扎进裙腰的衬衫里收出来。神情安静。

乌黑长发松松低马尾，碎发贴脸。鹅蛋脸，白皙，淡妆：细眉、自然眼线、薄腮红、水润豆沙唇。不笑。

上身是一件极轻薄的白色雪纺衬衫，面料半透带微光，袖口挽到小臂。最上面四颗扣子解开，领口开到乳沟上缘。里面是浅肤色真丝吊带，细肩带，窄蕾丝边，被白衬衫衬得更薄。衬衫下摆只松松掖进裙腰一侧，另一侧滑出来，腰侧细褶把胸腰差勒清楚。西装脱在椅背上，不穿在身上。

下身是浅卡其高腰迷你包臀裙，薄斜纹带一点光泽，一侧短开衩，长度到大腿中上。坐下被髋部顶高，交叉腿把腿侧弧度顶出来。裸腿。

脚上是裸色尖头细跟高跟鞋，约 7cm，脚趾豆沙色甲油。细金项链贴锁骨，小金耳环，细手链。

桌上是亮着的显示器、键鼠、开口文件袋和白马克杯。椅腿边靠着迷你编织包。右后方露出蓝衬衫男同事半边肩。隔断上贴着「行政部 / Administration」和卷边的「周五 3点 周会」。冷白格栅灯加左侧窗光，打在半透白衬衫上。手机纪实，中等景深，背景清楚，不要棚拍。

重点锁定

23岁绝美东亚女性＋时尚自信温柔＋D至E杯自然重量＋胸腰差＋极轻薄半透白衬衫解开四颗扣＋浅肤色真丝吊带窄蕾丝＋西装挂椅背＋浅卡其迷你包臀裙短开衩＋裸腿＋裸色尖头细跟＋交叉腿前倾看电脑＋胸口腰线入画＋低马尾＋行政部隔断＋邻座蓝衬衫＋中国写字楼纪实抓拍

items.title: 东方文化艺术海报强主体巨型野字动势

prompts.text:
Make a 9:16 vertical Oriental culture and art poster, the core method is "strong subject + giant wild characters + clear momentum".

Use clean and warm ivory white art paper for the background, retaining slight paper texture. No complex backgrounds, no dirty aging, no templated layouts, let large areas of white space become part of the image.

Use two oversized black brush characters as the main visual skeleton in the image. The calligraphy should be thick, wild, and free, with obvious lifting and pressing, flying white, and realistic ink edges. The two characters should not be arranged too neatly; they can be misplaced, overlapped, echoing up and down, with some strokes directly going out of the frame.

Place a strong subject object in the center of the screen; the subject must be large enough, with a clear enough silhouette, and have real volume, material, and structure. The subject can be a paper kite, a large drum, a folding fan, a long blade, or other highly recognizable Oriental objects.

Most importantly, let the subject and the wild characters have a dynamic relationship that can be understood at a glance. Don't just place the object in front of the characters, but let the subject truly change the text: it can break the frame, impact, radiate, slant cut, pull open, intersperse, push, or let the strokes change with the direction and force of the subject.

The overall composition should have a very clear line of momentum. It can be a diagonal frame break, radial expansion, frontal impact, or a strong cutting axis. Let the audience feel the screen is "moving" at a glance, rather than a static display.

Adopt asymmetric editorial design for the layout. The central area is responsible for "strong subject + giant wild characters + momentum relationship", and small-sized exhibition information, dates, locations, and material descriptions are added to the left and right edges, giving the image both visual impact and a sense of publication for cultural exhibition posters.

Add a small amount of natural handwritten English titles, like notes added later by a designer. The English should not be too large, mainly playing a role in rhythm adjustment. A very small amount of vermilion seals can be added as embellishments, but do not pile up too many decorative elements.

The overall color scheme is controlled to warm ivory white, deep ink black, plus a main color of the subject itself. For example, the paper kite can have a small amount of cinnabar red, the big drum can use a deep red drum body, the folding fan can use off-white plus red brush marks, and the long blade is mainly cold silver gray. Colors should not be too cluttered.

The final effect should be like a high-completion Oriental exhibition poster: the subject is strong enough, the characters are wild enough, the direction is clear enough, and the visual tension is directly maximized. Suitable for poster references such as traditional crafts, Oriental culture, and exhibition visuals.

Avoid characters, ordinary product advertisements, e-commerce staged photos, Guochao illustrations, red and gold festive feelings, neon tech feelings, cheap CGI, and meaningless accumulations of ink dots.

prompts.text:
做一张 9:16 竖版东方文化艺术海报，核心方法是“强主体 + 巨型野字 + 明确动势”。

背景使用干净温暖的象牙白艺术纸，保留轻微纸张纹理。不要复杂背景，不要脏污做旧，不要模板化排版，让大面积留白成为画面的一部分。

画面里使用两个超大的黑色毛笔字作为主要视觉骨架。书法要粗重、野性、自由，带明显提按、飞白和真实墨迹边缘。两个字不要排得太工整，可以错位、压叠、上下呼应，部分笔画直接出画。

在画面中央放置一个强主体器物，主体必须足够大、轮廓足够清楚，并且有真实体积、材质和结构。主体可以是纸鸢、大鼓、折扇、长刃，或其他具有强识别度的东方器物。

最重要的是，让主体和野字发生一个一眼就能看懂的动态关系。不要只是把器物摆在字前面，而是让主体真正改变文字：可以破框、冲击、放射、斜切、拉开、穿插、推动，或者让笔画随着主体的方向和力量发生变化。

整体构图要有一条非常明确的动势线。可以是斜向破框、放射展开、正面冲击，或一条强烈的切割轴。让观众一眼就感到画面在“动”，而不是静态陈列。

版式上采用非对称编辑设计。中央区域负责“强主体 + 巨型野字 + 动势关系”，左右边缘再加入小尺寸展览信息、日期、地点和材质说明，让画面既有视觉冲击，也有文化展览海报的出版感。

加入少量自然手写英文标题，像设计师后来补上的注释。英文不要太大，主要起到节奏调节作用。可以再加入极少量朱红印章作为点缀，但不要堆太多装饰元素。

整体配色控制为暖象牙白、深墨黑，再加一个主体本身的主色。比如纸鸢可带少量朱砂红，大鼓可用深红鼓身，折扇可用米白加红刷痕，长刃则以冷银灰为主。颜色不要太杂。

最终效果要像高完成度的东方展览海报：主体够强，字够野，方向够明确，画面张力直接拉满。适合传统工艺、东方文化和展览视觉这类海报参考。

避免人物、普通产品广告、电商摆拍、国潮插画、红金节庆感、霓虹科技感、廉价 CGI，以及无意义的墨点堆积。

items.title: 日系独立店铺品牌标志设计探索方案

prompts.text:
[Brand Name]: {BRAND NAME}  
[Descriptor]: {BUSINESS TYPE / TAGLINE}  
[Brand Type]: {e.g. bakery, hair studio, ceramic studio, bicycle workshop}  
[Brand Keywords]: {3–5 keywords}  
[Core Visual Ideas]: {people, objects, symbols, or concepts related to the brand}  
[Primary Colors]: {2–4 restrained colors}  
[Header Color]: {main header color}  
[Final Ratio]: 9:16

Create a professionally art-directed Brand to Logo exploration sheet for this brand, inspired by refined Japanese independent-shop identities, boutique branding, handcrafted print graphics, editorial typography, screen printing, block printing, and thoughtful local-business design. The result should feel designed, distinctive, and concept-driven rather than generated from generic AI logo templates.

LAYOUT

Use a strict 9:16 vertical composition. The upper brand-input section must occupy exactly 30% of the total image height, while the lower logo exploration section occupies exactly 70%. Keep the dividing line fixed at 30% from the top regardless of the length of the brand name. If the name is long, reduce the font size instead of increasing the header height.

Divide the lower 70% into four equal 2×2 quadrants using only very subtle thin dashed separators. Keep all four cells equal in size, with no outer border and no A/B/C/D numbering.

TOP SECTION

Use [Header Color] as the main background, with subtle paper grain, handmade print texture, and extremely low-contrast graphic traces inspired by the brand’s visual world. These background elements should remain atmospheric and should never become a full illustration.

Show only BRAND TO LOGO, [Brand Name], and [Descriptor]. Use clean, neutral typography for this original brand input and do not turn it into a finished logo yet. Do not add slogans, paragraphs, fake addresses, dates, decorative badges, unnecessary icons, or excessive microcopy.

LOGO DIRECTION 1 — CHARACTER / PICTORIAL

Create one memorable, concrete brand image using a person, animal, product, object, or recognizable activity directly related to the business. Simplify the subject into a compact logo composition with a strong silhouette, limited detail, restrained color, and subtle handmade print texture.

The image should feel like a genuine brand character or pictorial mark rather than a complete illustration. Avoid anime styling, exaggerated cute mascots, generic stock characters, or overly detailed scenes. Integrate the image naturally with the brand name so the pictorial element and wordmark feel like one identity.

LOGO DIRECTION 2 — EMBLEM / SYMBOL

Create a compact graphic symbol by combining two or three important ideas from [Core Visual Ideas]. Use negative space, shared geometry, overlap, transformation, visual metaphor, or double meaning so the elements become one unified mark rather than several icons placed next to each other.

The design should reward a second look while remaining simple enough to work at very small sizes. Prioritize a strong silhouette, clever graphic relationships, and clear conceptual relevance to the brand.

LOGO DIRECTION 3 — CUSTOM WORDMARK

Turn the brand name itself into the primary logo. Do not place a separate generic icon beside ordinary typography. Instead, identify a few letters with strong visual potential and modify them through cuts, shared strokes, altered counters, extended curves, negative space, structural substitutions, or subtle references to the brand’s core concept.

Only modify the letters that genuinely benefit from the concept. Keep the name highly readable and avoid decorating every character. The final result should feel like a custom-drawn wordmark designed specifically for this brand, with a clear visual idea embedded directly into the typography.

LOGO DIRECTION 4 — BRAND MARK

Create a secondary identity mark appropriate to the business, such as a maker’s mark, workshop tag, studio label, shop stamp, service mark, packaging mark, mirror label, ticket, or another format that naturally belongs to the brand’s real-world context.

Keep the structure restrained, open, and highly usable. Allow subtle handmade irregularity, broken edges, missing ink, incomplete borders, or asymmetry where appropriate, but maintain generous negative space and a clear hierarchy. Avoid rigid generic circular badges, overcrowded vintage emblems, fake heritage details, and unnecessary decorative information.

STYLE & DESIGN CONTROL

Use only 1–3 colors per logo, selected from [Primary Colors]. The four directions should share the same brand world, color logic, and general print character, but they must be visibly different in design methodology. At least one of the four concepts must contain a clear pictorial or character-based image; do not make all four logos abstract, typographic, or monogram-based.

Prioritize strong silhouettes, meaningful visual relationships, custom typography, negative space, restrained color, generous breathing room, subtle print grain, controlled irregularity, and authentic small-business character. The handmade quality should feel intentional and refined rather than distressed for decoration.

Avoid generic leaves, random botanical decoration, luxury serif clichés, fake founding dates, meaningless monograms, stock-vector icons, glossy effects, gradients, metallic foil, chrome, 3D rendering, photorealistic mockups, storefront scenes, packaging mockups, and unrelated decorative elements.

The finished image should resemble a sophisticated logo exploration page from an independent branding studio, showing four genuinely different but visually related directions for the same brand.

prompts.text:
[品牌名称]：{BRAND NAME}
[描述符]：{业务类型 / 口号}
[品牌类型]：{例如：面包店、美发工作室、陶瓷工作室、自行车工坊}
[品牌关键词]：{3–5 个关键词}
[核心视觉理念]：{与品牌相关的人物、物体、符号或概念}
[主要颜色]：{2–4 种克制的颜色}
[页眉颜色]：{主页眉颜色}
[最终比例]：9:16

为此品牌创建一个专业的艺术指导类“品牌到标志”探索表，灵感源自精致的日本独立店铺标识、精品品牌、手工印刷图形、编辑排版、丝网印刷、木版印刷和周到的本地业务设计。结果应具有设计感、独特性和概念驱动，而不是由通用的 AI 标志模板生成。

布局

使用严格的 9:16 垂直构图。上方的品牌输入部分必须恰好占据图像总高度的 30%，而下方的标志探索部分恰好占据 70%。无论品牌名称的长短，分界线都固定在距离顶部 30% 的位置。如果名称较长，请缩小字体大小而不是增加页眉高度。

将下方的 70% 分为四个相等的 2×2 象限，仅使用非常细微的薄虚线分隔符。保持所有四个单元格大小相等，没有外边框，也没有 A/B/C/D 编号。

顶部区域

使用 [页眉颜色] 作为主背景，带有细微的纸张纹理、手工印刷质感，以及受品牌视觉世界启发且对比度极低的图形痕迹。这些背景元素应保持氛围感，绝不能变成完整的插图。

仅显示 BRAND TO LOGO、[品牌名称] 和 [描述符]。为原始品牌输入使用干净、中性的排版，尚未将其转化为成品标志。不要添加标语、段落、虚假地址、日期、装饰性徽章、不必要的图标或过多的微缩文本。

标志方向 1 — 角色 / 图形

使用与业务直接相关的人物、动物、产品、物体或可识别的活动创建一个令人难忘的、具体的品牌形象。将主体简化为紧凑的标志构图，具有强烈的剪影、有限的细节、克制的色彩和细微的手工印刷纹理。

图像应感觉像是真正的品牌角色或图形标记，而不是完整的插图。避免动漫风格、夸张的可爱吉祥物、通用的素材角色或过度详细的场景。将图像与品牌名称自然结合，使图形元素和文字标记感觉像是一个整体。

标志方向 2 — 徽记 / 符号

通过结合 [核心视觉理念] 中的两个或三个重要想法来创建一个紧凑的图形符号。使用负空间、共有几何形状、重叠、变换、视觉隐喻或双重含义，使元素成为一个统一的标记，而不是并排放置的几个图标。

设计应经得起推敲，同时保持足够简单以便在极小尺寸下也能发挥作用。优先考虑强烈的剪影、巧妙的图形关系以及与品牌清晰的概念相关性。

标志方向 3 — 定制文字标记

将品牌名称本身作为主要标志。不要在普通排版旁边放置单独的通用图标。相反，识别出几个具有强烈视觉潜力的字母，并通过切割、共有笔画、改变字肚、延伸曲线、负空间、结构替换或对品牌核心概念的微妙引用来对其进行修改。

只修改那些真正能从概念中获益的字母。保持名称的高度可读性，避免装饰每个字符。最终结果应感觉像是专门为该品牌设计的定制手绘文字标记，排版中直接嵌入了清晰的视觉构思。

标志方向 4 — 品牌标记

创建一个适合该业务的次级身份标记，例如制作者标记、工坊标签、工作室标签、商店印章、服务标记、包装标记、镜面标签、门票或另一种自然属于品牌现实世界环境的格式。

保持结构克制、开放且高度可用。在适当的地方允许细微的手工不规则、破损边缘、缺墨、不完整的边框或不对称，但保持慷慨的负空间和清晰的层次结构。避免刻板通用的圆形徽章、拥挤的复古纹章、虚假的传统细节和不必要的装饰信息。

风格与设计控制

每个标志仅使用从 [主要颜色] 中选择的 1–3 种颜色。四个方向应共享相同的品牌世界、色彩逻辑和通用印刷特征，但在设计方法论上必须有明显区别。四个概念中至少有一个必须包含清晰的图形或基于角色的图像；不要让所有四个标志都变成抽象的、排版的或基于字母组合的设计。

优先考虑强烈的剪影、有意义的视觉关系、定制排版、负空间、克制的色彩、充裕的呼吸空间、细微的印刷纹理、受控的不规则性以及真实的真实小店特色。手工质感应感觉是刻意且精致的，而不是为了装饰而进行的磨损处理。

避免通用的叶子、随机的植物装饰、奢侈品衬线体陈词滥调、虚假的成立日期、毫无意义的字母组合、素材矢量图标、光泽效果、渐变、金属箔、铬、3D 渲染、写实样机、店面场景、包装样机和不相关的装饰元素。

成品图像应类似于独立品牌工作室制作的精美标志探索页面，展示同一品牌的四个真正不同但视觉相关的方向。

items.title: 实体纸张物理折痕摄影装置效果

prompts.text: Applicable to any input photo. The upper part of the frame retains the original photo as a clear and complete factual reference; the lower part prints the same photo completely on a piece of matte paper with a real sense of weight and thickness, and naturally forms 1–2 large-scale, stretching folds or curved undulations according to the movement, posture, or main spatial direction of the subject in the picture. The paper must present realistic physical bending: partial lifting, pressing down, rolling, or slight suspension, creating accurate contact shadows and spatial occlusion. The characters, buildings, scenery, textures, and perspective relationships in the original photo continuously cross the creases, undergoing spatial changes along with the actual bending of the paper surface, without being fragmented, redrawn into another painting, or adding unrelated objects that do not exist in the original image. The focus is on using the folded surfaces to reorganize the scale, hierarchy, and spatial relationship of the original image, giving the flat photographic image a three-dimensional tension similar to a sculpture or paper art installation. The edges of the paper can reveal subtle paper core thickness, indentations, and slight natural wear, but the overall look remains restrained and realistic. The background uses a large area of warm white or off-white empty space, with soft and natural lighting, highlighting the volume, fold lines, and shadows of the paper itself. A line of minimalist and restrained handwritten observation text can be added to the blank area, like a photographic note or exhibition annotation. The overall effect should be like a "real photo printed onto a physical surface that can be bent," rather than adding a water ripple filter to the photo. Avoid: liquid water ripple effects, digital distortion filters, regular sine waves, cheap 3D deformation, fragmented origami, excessive creases, multi-image collages, duplicate subjects, extra decorations, over-artistic redrawing.

prompts.text:
适用于任意输入照片。画面上方保留原始照片，作为清晰、完整的事实对照；下方将同一照片完整印制在一张具有真实重量感与厚度的哑光纸面上，并根据画面主体的走势、姿态或空间主方向，自然形成 1–2 道大尺度、舒展的折面或卷曲起伏。

纸张必须呈现真实的物理弯折：局部抬起、下压、翻卷或轻微悬空，并产生准确的接触阴影与空间遮挡。原照片中的人物、建筑、景物、纹理与透视关系连续跨越折痕，随纸面真实弯曲发生空间变化，不割裂、不重绘成另一幅画，也不添加原图不存在的无关物件。

重点利用折面重新组织原图的尺度、层次与空间关系，让平面的摄影图像获得类似雕塑或纸艺装置的立体张力。纸张边缘可露出细微纸芯厚度、压痕和轻度自然磨损，但整体保持克制、真实。

背景使用大面积暖白或米白空场，光线柔和自然，突出纸张本身的体积、折线与投影。可在空白区域加入一行极简、克制的手写观察文字，像摄影手记或展览注释。

整体应像“真实照片被打印成一张可以弯折的实体表面”，而不是给照片添加水波滤镜。

避免：液体水波特效、数字扭曲滤镜、规则正弦波、廉价 3D 变形、碎片化折纸、过多折痕、多图拼贴、重复主体、额外装饰物、过度艺术化重绘。

items.title: 俏皮眨眼斜向半身人像摄影

prompts.text: Close-up half-body portrait, near-front slightly high camera angle perspective. The camera is located directly in front of the character from the face to the upper chest, slightly higher than the character's eyes, with the lens tilting slightly downwards, but the pitch angle is very small, keeping both the face and the chest as the main visual surfaces. The character's body is not standing vertically, but instead leaning diagonally towards one side of the frame and slightly backwards, with the shoulder line and waistline forming a clear diagonal, the chest facing the camera, and the pelvis slightly shifted to the other side, forming a continuous S-shaped twist. The character's head is located in the center of the upper half of the frame, with the head slightly tilted and moving closer to the camera, chin slightly tucked. Both arms are raised around the head, one upper arm entering significantly from the upper left of the frame, the elbow located outside or near the edge of the frame, and the forearm crossing the top of the head; the other arm enters from the upper right of the frame, with the palm resting near the head and horn-shaped accessories. The arms form an inverted triangular frame surrounding the face. The lens distance is close, using a compact half-body crop from the chest to the top of the head, with only a small amount of the waist retained, and the elbows allowed to be cut off by the edge of the frame. The character's body unfolds along the diagonal of the frame, rather than being straight and centered. Slight close-up perspective makes the face, chest, and front shoulder slightly closer to the camera, but without using exaggerated ultra-wide angles; visually similar to a close-up portrait with a 50–70mm equivalent focal length. The focus of the frame is the three-layered structure of "face located between arms + chest unfolding toward the camera + body diagonal to the frame." Expression matches the pose: head slightly tilted, one eye winking, the other eye toward the camera, mouth slightly open, tip of the tongue slightly sticking out, creating a playful, provocative, and relaxed sense of close-range interaction.

prompts.text:
Theme: Quietness of looking back in front of a black sofa. 

Subject: 4:5 vertical composition, subject centered-right, occupying about 70% of the frame. Kneeling on the light brown wooden floor of a modern living room, body located directly in front of a black leather sofa; the photographer is at about 30–45° on the left rear of the subject, at knee-height low angle. Hips and pelvis facing the bottom left of the frame, upper body twisted toward the camera, fully capturing the head, shoulders and back, waist and hips, folded legs, and two high-heeled shoes. 

Character and Expression: East Asian female over twenty-five years old, well-proportioned and full figure, naturally full chest (visual effect of about D to E cup), slender waist, coordinated hip-to-leg ratio, soft and natural curves clearly visible, overall forming a beautiful hourglass shape without being exaggerated to the point of dissonance. Skin retains natural texture and faint blood color, not excessively unified or beautified; restrained highlights on cheeks, nose tip, and collarbone. Small oval face, natural eyebrow shape, slender black eyeliner, soft eyelashes, light pink blush, nude pink-leaning-red lips. Jet-black medium-length hair gathered into a low bun at the back of the head, wearing a large matte black bow with a few small decorative dots at the back; thick but light straight bangs on the forehead, with longer curved stray hairs on both sides close to the cheeks. Body side-back to the camera, head turned looking back, about three-quarters side view of the face, expression calm and slightly cold. Pupils capture small highlights from indoor cool white lights. 

Clothing and Pose: Pure black short-sleeved slim-fit ultra-short knit dress, round neck, soft stretch fabric completely fitting the shoulders, back, waist, and hips, no prints or logos; when kneeling, the hem stops near the root of the thighs, fully covering, with ribbing and stretch wrinkles distributed along the sides of the waist and hip line. Smoke-black 8–12D ultra-thin pantyhose tights covering from thighs to toes, revealing real skin tone, lighter at the thighs and slightly darker at the knees and ankles, the surface of the tights is smooth with delicate silk luster. Black glossy patent leather ultra-high-heeled shoes, almond pointed toe, hidden thick platform at the forefoot, stiletto heel about 11–13cm, strong highlights on the shoe surface. Center of gravity distributed between both knees and the low-sitting hips/pelvis; hips sitting low but not completely pressed on the heels; both thighs folded forward and downward, calves all bent backward, one calf close to the camera slanted toward the bottom left of the frame, the other shoe still fully visible behind the hips. Upper body upright and turned backward, forming an S-shape of side-back plus looking back. Right hand raised to the chin, fingertips lightly touching the lower lip; left forearm near the edge of the sofa cushion, fingers relaxed. 

Background and Light: Foreground is light warm brown longitudinal wood grain floor and two patent leather shoes, mid-ground is the black leather two-seater sofa behind the subject, backrest with regular square stitching and slight leather reflection, warm brown wooden frame and four wooden legs; a pure black square throw pillow on the left side of the sofa is slightly tilted. Background is light gray-white wall, partial white faux-brick relief, narrow black metal side table on the far left of the frame, black retro three-arm candelabra on the light wood tabletop. Main light is soft indoor cool white ambient light, slight fill light from the front, lighting up skin, dress, and stockings; patent leather shoe surfaces and sofa leather surfaces form mirror highlights, wood floor reflects warm yellow scattered light. Shadows fall softly along the left side of the body and under the sofa, no dramatic warm yellow lighting. 

Composition and Lens: Equivalent 35–50mm, knee-height low angle, shot from the left rear side. Focus locked on the turned-back profile and waist-hip curves, background sofa and wall maintain high detail with only slight blurring. Hips/pelvis in the foreground, upper body looking back, legs folded on the floor constitute visual guidance; fully captured from head to toe, heels not cut off. 

Texture and Style: Realistic indoor digital camera photo, with a slight sense of life candid snapshot. Emphasis on expressing skin texture, matte knit, ultra-thin stocking luster, patent leather highlights, sofa leather stitching, and wood floor texture. Cool white indoor color tone, black as the main body, slight sharpening, avoiding skin smoothing and cinematic color grading. 

Negative Prompts: Standing, sitting on chair, cross-legged, skirt too long, bare legs, thick black stockings, fishnets, flats, block heels; changes to the bow or looking-back kneeling pose; too thin or exaggerated body shape; underage appearance; extra or missing fingers; plastic-feeling skin; text watermarks.

prompts.text:
主题：
黑色沙发前，回头看一眼的安静

主体：
4:5竖构图，人物居中偏右，占画面约70%。现代客厅浅棕木地板上双膝跪坐，身体位于黑色皮质沙发正前方；摄影者在人物左后侧约30–45°，膝盖高度低机位。臀胯朝向画面左下方，上身向镜头扭转，完整收入头部、肩背、腰臀、折叠双腿与两只高跟鞋。

人物与表情：
二十五岁以上东亚女性，身材匀称丰满，胸部自然丰满（约D至E杯视觉效果），腰部纤细，臀腿比例协调，曲线柔和自然且明显，整体呈漂亮的沙漏型，不夸张到违和。皮肤保留自然肌理与淡淡血色，不过度均匀化、不过度美颜；脸颊、鼻尖与锁骨有克制高光。小鹅蛋脸，自然眉形，细长黑色眼线，柔和睫毛，浅粉腮红，裸粉偏红唇。乌黑中长发在脑后收成低位发髻，后脑佩戴宽大哑光黑色蝴蝶结，带少量细小装饰点；额前偏厚的轻薄齐刘海，两侧较长弧形碎发贴近脸颊。身体侧背向镜头，转头回望，脸部约四分之三侧面，神情平静、略带冷淡。瞳孔捕捉室内冷白灯的细小高光。

服装与姿势：
纯黑色短袖修身超短针织裙，圆领，柔软弹力面料完全贴合肩背、腰部与臀胯，无印花无Logo；跪姿时裙摆停在大腿根部附近，完整覆盖，罗纹与拉伸褶皱沿腰侧与臀线分布。烟黑色8–12D超薄连裤丝袜从大腿覆盖至脚尖，透出真实肤色，大腿处偏浅、膝与脚踝略深，袜面平整带细腻丝光。黑色亮面漆皮超高跟鞋，杏仁尖头，前掌隐藏厚底，细跟约11–13cm，鞋面高光强烈。重心分散于双膝与低坐的臀胯，臀部坐低但未完全压在脚跟上；两条大腿向前下方折叠，小腿全部向身后弯曲，靠近镜头的一条小腿斜向画面左下方，另一只鞋在臀后仍完整可见。上身挺直并向后回转，形成侧背加回头的S形。右手抬至下巴，指尖轻轻触碰下唇；左手前臂靠近沙发坐垫边缘，手指放松。

背景与光线：
近景是浅暖棕色纵向木纹地板与两只漆皮鞋，中景是人物身后的黑色皮革双人沙发，靠背带规则方形压线与轻微皮革反光，暖棕木框与四条木腿；沙发左侧一只纯黑方形抱枕略微倾斜。远景为浅灰白墙面，局部白色仿砖浮雕，画面最左侧窄型黑色金属边几，浅木桌面放黑色复古三臂烛台。主光为柔和室内冷白环境灯，正面轻微补光，打亮皮肤、裙装与丝袜；漆皮鞋面与沙发皮面形成镜面高光，木地板反射暖黄散射光。阴影沿身体左侧与沙发下方软落，不做戏剧性暖黄布光。

构图与镜头：
等效35–50mm，膝盖高度低机位，从左后侧拍摄。焦点锁在回头的侧脸与腰臀曲线，背景沙发与墙面保持较高细节、仅轻微虚化。臀胯在前景、上身回头、双腿折叠在地板上构成视线引导；头顶到鞋尖完整收入，鞋跟不被裁掉。

质感与风格：
真实室内数码相机写真，带轻微生活抓拍感。重点表现皮肤肌理、哑光针织、超薄丝袜丝光、漆皮高光、沙发皮革压线与木地板纹理。冷白室内色调，黑色为主体，轻微锐化，避免磨皮与电影调色。

负面提示：
站姿、坐椅、盘腿、裙摆过长、裸腿、厚黑丝、网袜、平底鞋、粗跟；蝴蝶结与回头跪姿改变；过瘦或过夸张体型；未成年外观；多余或缺失手指；塑料感皮肤；文字水印。

prompts.text:
Use the uploaded photo as the only content source. Create a vertical 3:4 "real photo + minimal illustration" memory card based entirely on that image. Preserve the main subjects, subject count, pose, viewpoint, spatial relationships, and overall scene logic. Do not redesign the source or add unrelated content.

Layout:Split the card into two horizontal sections, about 50% top and 50% bottom. The top half keeps the uploaded photo with photographic texture. Crop naturally to fit, but do not stretch,mirror, rearrange, or alter the main subjects. Keep natural lighting, real materials, and the original color mood, with subtle editorial grading. The lower half uses a warm ivory handmade-paper background and shows a centered horizontal illustration of the same scene. The illustration occupies about 63-67% of the lower width, with generous blank space around it.

Scene translation:In the lower illustration, preserve the most recognizable subjects, major structures, important objects, viewpoint, depth, relative scale, and key positions from the source. Remove tiny clutter, fine photographic texture, reflections, and complex shadows.Simplify the scene into slightly awkward geometric color blocks and thin hand-drawn lines. People and animals, when present, remain identifiable through silhouette, pose,hair or fur shape,clothing color, and placement, but facial detail may be reduced. Outlines may wobble, break, shift, or misalign slightly while the scene stays recognizable.

Illustration style: Use restrained naive editorial drawing with soft geometric simplification and handmade quality. Combine thin sketchy linework with flat shapes. The lower scene should feel calm, clean, slightly imperfect, and visually reduced rather than technically precise. Avoid realistic rendering.

Color:Extract 4-6 representative colors from the uploaded photo and reinterpret them as a soft low-saturation palette. Use muted tones derived from the source, with flat fills and enough contrast to separate major subjects and scene layers. No complex gradients,glossy highlights, or heavy 3D modeling.

Texture:Blend crayon, pastel,screen-print, and old-book illustration qualities. Keep paper show-through, fine grain, slight pigment unevenness, worn edges, and subtle off-register shifts. The result should feel like an independent editorial illustration printed on aged

paper:warm, quiet, nostalgic, and collectible.

Typography:Below the illustration, you may include exactly two short English lines related to the scene.mood,place.or moment. Use a small vintage serif font, left-aligned. If clean readable text cannot be rendered, leave the area blank. No other readable text.

Cleanup:Remove phone UI,subtitles, screenshot traces, and interface elements when present. Do not invent missing scenery or decorative props.

Negative:No major layout change, no added or missing primary subjects, no photoreal painting, no polished watercolor,no anime,no manga, no vector clip-art, no oil paint, no impasto, no 3D, no logo,no watermark, no black border,no UI,no unrelated decoration.

使用上传的照片作为唯一的内容来源。完全基于该图像创建一个纵向 3:4 的“真实照片 + 极简插画”记忆卡。保留主要主体、主体数量、姿势、视角、空间关系和整体场景逻辑。不要重新设计来源或添加无关内容。

场景转换：在下方的插画中，保留来源中最具辨识度的主体、主要结构、重要物体、视角、深度、相对比例和关键位置。去除细小的杂物、精细的摄影纹理、反射和复杂的阴影。将场景简化为略显笨拙的几何色块和细致的手绘线条。当出现人或动物时，通过剪影、姿势、头发或皮毛形状、服装颜色和位置保持可辨识性，但面部细节可以减少。轮廓可能会出现晃动、断裂、偏移或轻微错位，同时保持场景可辨识。

Pale rose blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, slender eyelashes, natural tear bags, and translucent pink-beige lips; expression is composed and soft, corners of the lips slightly raised, eyes looking directly at the camera, with small catchlights in the pupils.

Clothing/Pose:
Wearing an ivory-white ribbed sleeveless tight crop top with a rounded square neckline, a restrained longitudinal hollow structure set in the center of the chest and abdomen of the top, fixed with narrow connecting straps, the edges of the hollow fit smoothly and do not expose anything; paired with a light taupe high-waisted tight mini skirt, the fine-knit fabric naturally tightens along the waist and hips, the hem of the skirt forms slight horizontal folds above the thighs in a sitting position. A small amount of blurred grass and leaves at the lower edge of the foreground, the midground is a wooden bench with clear texture and a light-colored stone walkway, the background consists of softened tree trunks, shrubs, and distant silhouettes of people walking, no readable logos appear. Equivalent 50mm lens, eye-level shot at chest height, maintaining a strictly frontal sitting posture and natural perspective; focus falls on the eyes, while also taking into account the relationship between the edges of the central hollow of the top and the hands contacting the bench surface. The character occupies about 70% of the frame, centered slightly to the left, the horizontal line of the bench stabilizes the frame, leaving a small amount of environmental white space on the right; medium-shallow depth of field makes the character, clothing, and contact points on the bench clear, with the background softly blurred.

Japanese beauty magazine and summer park fashion editorial photography, low contrast, restrained saturation, soft film colors with fine grain; focus on expressing real skin texture, ribbed knit, fine knit texture of the skirt, and the warm texture of the old wooden bench surface.

Underage or mature middle-aged feel, drifting facial features, non-frontal sitting posture, failed hand-to-bench contact, finger or joint errors, chaotic or accidental exposure of the top's hollow structure, mini skirt clipping, broken bench perspective, plastic skin, readable gibberish text or watermarks

items.title: 品牌Logo概念探索设计稿生成

prompts.text:
【Brand Name】: {e.g., Tail & Day}  
【English Name】: {e.g., TAIL & DAY PET CLUB}  
【Brand Type】: {e.g., Pet lifestyle brand / Flower shop / Catering / Bookstore}  
【Brand Keywords】: {e.g., Warm, natural, friendly, handmade feel}  
【Core Visual Imagery】: {e.g., Tail, sun, pet companionship}  
【Main Color Suggestions】: {e.g., Cream yellow, dark brown, brick red, sage green}  
【Top Background Color】: {Fill in according to brand temperament}  
【Aspect Ratio】: 9:16

Please generate a complete "Brand to Logo" brand logo concept exploration design draft for the above brand. The core is not simply generating four similar logos, but proposing four truly different visual design routes around the same brand name, industry attributes, and core concepts.

The final image is fixed at a 9:16 vertical version. The top brand input area strictly occupies 30% of the entire image height, and the bottom logo display area strictly occupies 70%. This ratio cannot be changed regardless of the length of the brand name; when the name is long, reduce the font size instead of expanding the top area. The bottom 70% is then strictly divided into 2×2 four equal-sized areas, using only very light and thin dashed lines for separation, without drawing peripheral borders.

【Top Branding Area】

The top is only an introductory area for the original brand information, not a main visual poster. Use [Top Background Color], and add extremely slight paper, washi, wrapping paper, screen printing grain, or low-contrast dark patterns related to the brand to only increase texture without forming complex illustrations.

The top only retains three layers of information:

BRAND TO LOGO

【Brand Name】

【English Name】

The brand name should use a normal, clear, modern printed font, without being pre-logoized, handwritten, or graphically deformed. Do not add slogans, brand descriptions, large amounts of small English text, serial numbers, stamps, auxiliary icons, or complex light and shadow, so that the visual focus naturally falls on the four logo schemes below.

【Bottom Logo Display Area】

The bottom uniformly uses a Warm Ivory warm off-white paper background, retaining only slight natural paper grain. All four logos need to be developed around the [Brand Type], [Brand Keywords], and [Core Visual Imagery], keeping the brand core consistent, but the design methods must be significantly different.

Each logo should be a complete set of brand identity that can be realistically used for stores, packaging, labels, social avatars, business cards, or peripheral products, rather than a full illustration, poster, or decorative image.

Control each scheme within 1–3 primary colors, prioritizing the [Main Color Suggestions]. Avoid high-saturation variegated colors, complex gradients, 3D, metal relief, glass texture, and commercial mockups.

【Mascot | Mascot Type】

Design a highly generalized character or anthropomorphic subject from the brand name, industry, or core imagery. The character needs to have a clear large outline and strong memory points, but do not make it into a complex anime character or a full scene illustration.

Let the character itself relate to the brand concept, for example, holding a product, hiding behind an object, or merging with core plants or animals. Pair it with the complete [Brand Name] wordmark and a smaller [English Name], making it overall friendly, story-oriented, and suitable for social media dissemination.

【Emblem | Imagery Emblem Type】

Do not rely on a full character; instead, extract the 2–3 most important elements from the [Core Visual Imagery] and combine them into a concentrated, balanced brand emblem that is easy to recognize when scaled down.

Prioritize using negative space, surrounding, vertical stacking, partial enclosure, or graphic isomorphism to let different elements truly fuse into one logo rather than simply placing several small icons side by side. Pair it with the brand wordmark to form a complete and stable logo system.

【Type-led | Creative Typography Type】

Take the [Brand Name] itself as the core design object. Analyze the strokes, structures, radicals, negative spaces, and letter outlines with the most visual potential in Chinese characters or English letters, and let the core imagery of the brand grow naturally from within the text.

Omissions, shared strokes, extensions, cutting, partial replacement, negative space reconstruction, or glyph fusion can be performed, but basic legibility must be maintained.

Do not simply stick an extra icon next to a regular font. The focus is to make "the text itself the logo," forming a more modern, clever, and professional graphic design scheme.

【Stamp | Open Handmade Mark Type】

Design a logo with the temperament of a hand-carved, printmaking, shop stamp, or packaging mark, but do not use a regular complete square box, and do not stuff all content into a closed ellipse.

Use incomplete boundaries, open arcs, natural strokes, brand core graphics, or text to jointly form a loose visual scope. Elements can be slightly misaligned, and the edges allow for a small amount of natural ink deficiency and uneven hand-printing to give the overall design a sense of breath.

The Stamp must maintain clear primary-secondary relationships and sufficient white space. Do not become stiff, dense, or difficult to use practically in pursuit of a "stamp feel."

The four types must share the same brand worldview, core imagery, and basic color palette, but they cannot simply be the same logo in four drawing styles or four layouts.

Do not add serial numbers such as A/B/C/D. Do not add slogans, explanatory sentences, or extra information at the bottom. Do not generate packaging mockups, real store scenes, or full illustrations.

The final image should look like a mature, clean, professionally differentiated logo exploration sheet with real brand design value.

【底部 Logo 展示区】

底部统一使用 Warm Ivory 暖米白纸张背景，只保留轻微天然纸纹。四个 Logo 都需要围绕【品牌类型】【品牌关键词】【核心视觉意象】展开，保持品牌核心一致，但设计方法必须明显不同。

每个 Logo 都应该是一套完整、可以真实用于门店、包装、标签、社交头像、名片或周边商品的品牌标识，而不是完整插画、海报或装饰图。

每个方案控制在 1–3 个主要颜色以内，优先使用【主色建议】。避免高饱和杂色、复杂渐变、3D、金属浮雕、玻璃质感和商业 mockup。

【Mascot｜吉祥物型】

从品牌名称、行业或核心意象中设计一个高度概括的角色或拟人化主体。角色需要拥有清楚的大轮廓和强记忆点，但不要做成复杂动漫人物或完整场景插画。

让角色本身与品牌概念发生关系，例如抱着产品、隐藏在物体后面、与核心植物或动物融合。搭配完整的【品牌名称】字标和较小的【英文名称】，整体亲和、有故事感、适合社交传播。

【Emblem｜意象徽章型】

不依赖完整人物，而是从【核心视觉意象】中提炼 2–3 个最重要的元素，组合成一个集中、平衡、容易缩小识别的品牌徽章。

优先使用负空间、环绕、上下叠合、局部包围或图形共形，让不同元素真正融合成一个标志，而不是简单把几个小图标并排放在一起。搭配品牌字标，形成完整稳定的 Logo 系统。

【Type-led｜字形创意型】

以【品牌名称】本身作为核心设计对象。分析中文字或英文字母中最有视觉潜力的笔画、结构、偏旁、负空间和字母轮廓，让品牌的核心意象从文字内部自然生长出来。

可以进行省笔、共享笔画、延长、切割、局部替换、负空间重构或字形融合，但必须保留基本识别度。

不要在普通字体旁边额外贴一个图标。重点是让“文字本身就是 Logo”，形成更现代、更聪明、更具有专业平面设计感的方案。

【Stamp｜开放式手作印记型】

设计一款具有手刻、版画、店章或包装印记气质的 Logo，但不要使用规整完整的方框，也不要把所有内容塞进封闭椭圆。

使用不完整边界、开放弧线、自然笔触、品牌核心图形或文字共同形成松散的视觉范围。元素可以轻微错位，边缘允许少量自然缺墨和手工印刷不均，让整体具有呼吸感。

Stamp 必须保持清楚的主次关系和充分留白。不要因为追求“印章感”而变得死板、密集或难以实际使用。

四款必须共享同一个品牌世界观、核心意象和基础配色，但不能只是同一个 Logo 换四种画风或四种排版。

不要加入 A/B/C/D 等编号。底部不要添加口号、解释句或多余信息。不要生成包装 mockup、真实门店场景或完整插画。

最终画面要像一张成熟、干净、有方法差异、有真实品牌设计价值的专业 Logo Exploration Sheet。

items.title: 姓名转签名设计稿四款风格展示图

prompts.text:
[Name]: {e.g. Amelia Rose}  
[Top Background Color]: {e.g. dusty blue, muted rose, forest green, deep burgundy, warm ochre}  
[Final Ratio]: 9:16

Create a vertical 9:16 "Name to Signature" design sheet that transforms one plain English name into four clearly different handwritten signature concepts.

Use two sections. The top 40% shows the original typed name, and the bottom 60% shows four signature designs.

For the top section, use the selected muted background color with subtle paper or fabric texture and a soft natural shadow. Add small widely spaced text at the top:

NAME TO SIGNATURE

Display the original name in the center using a large, clean neutral sans-serif font such as Helvetica, Arial, Inter, or a similar modern typeface. This must look like normal typed text, not handwriting. Keep the layout minimal and do not add extra slogans or decorative copy.

For the bottom section, use a warm ivory paper background with very subtle grain. Divide it into a clean 2×2 grid using faint thin dashed lines, with no outer border.

Create four large black handwritten signatures for the same name. They must be noticeably different in silhouette, rhythm, stroke direction, abstraction, and personality. Do not simply generate four similar cursive versions.

Use realistic gel pen or fountain pen handwriting with natural pressure variation, lighter entry strokes, stronger main strokes, tapered endings, and slight ink irregularity. Letters may merge, stretch, overlap, simplify, share strokes, or become partially abstract. The goal is signature design, not perfect letter-by-letter readability.

FLOW: Create a graceful, fluid signature with smooth connected strokes and one or two long sweeping tails. Keep it elegant, natural, and believable as a real personal signature.

EDGE: Create a sharper, more directional signature using stronger slant, tall vertical accents, pointed turns, crossings, and decisive endings. Make it modern, confident, and fashion-forward.

LOOP: Build the signature around a large expressive looping gesture. Compress parts of the name inside or across the loop, and allow one stroke to extend outward as a strong finishing motion. Keep the loop organic and handwritten rather than geometrically perfect.

MARK: Create the most minimal and abstract version. Reduce the name to approximately 4–6 important strokes, often using the initials or strongest letter shapes as the foundation. The result may resemble a personal monogram or creator mark more than fully readable handwriting.

For softer or more romantic names, MARK may be replaced with CHARM: a refined usable signature with one subtle personal detail, such as a tiny heart-like terminal or a minimal floral gesture. Keep it tasteful and mature.

The four designs must feel clearly different at first glance. FLOW should feel fluid, EDGE sharp, LOOP expressive, and MARK minimal.

Keep each signature large enough to dominate its quadrant. Do not add extra descriptions under the style labels.

Do not add watermarks, numbering, decorative borders, stars, crowns, excessive hearts, unrelated icons, or unnecessary graphic elements.

prompts.text:
[姓名]: {例如：Amelia Rose}
[顶部背景颜色]: {例如：灰蓝色、柔雾粉、森林绿、深酒红、暖赭色}
[最终比例]: 9:16

创建一个垂直 9:16 的“姓名转签名”设计图，将一个普通的英文姓名转换为四个明显不同的手写签名概念。

分为两个部分。顶部占 40%，展示原始打印姓名；底部占 60%，展示四款签名设计。

对于顶部区域，使用选定的柔和背景色，带有微妙的纸张或织物纹理以及柔和的自然阴影。在顶部添加间距较宽的小字：

NAME TO SIGNATURE

使用大型、简洁的中性无衬线字体（如 Helvetica、Arial、Inter 或类似的现代字体）在中心显示原始姓名。这必须看起来像普通的打印文本，而不是手写体。保持布局极简，不要添加额外的口号或装饰性文案。

对于底部区域，使用带有极细微颗粒感的暖象牙色纸张背景。使用纤细的虚线将其划分为整洁的 2×2 网格，不设外边框。

为同一个名字创作四个大型黑色手写签名。它们在轮廓、节奏、笔画方向、抽象度和个性上必须有明显的区别。不要简单地生成四个类似的草写版本。

使用真实的凝胶笔或钢笔手写效果，具有自然的压力变化、较轻的入笔、较重的主笔画、逐渐变细的收笔以及轻微的墨水不规则感。字母可以融合、拉长、重叠、简化、共用笔画，或者变得部分抽象。目标是签名设计，而不是完美的逐字可读性。

FLOW：创建一个优雅、流畅的签名，具有平滑的连接笔画和一个或两个长长的扫尾。保持其优雅、自然，且作为真实的个人签名具有可信度。

EDGE：使用更强的倾斜度、高大的垂直重音、尖锐的转折、交叉和果断的结尾，创建一个更具锋芒感和方向性的签名。使其具有现代感、自信且富有时尚感。

LOOP：围绕一个具有表现力的大环形动作构建签名。将姓名的一部分压缩在环形内部或穿过环形，并允许一个笔画向外延伸，作为强有力的结束动作。保持环形是有机的和手写的，而不是几何完美的。

MARK：创建最简约和抽象的版本。将名字简化为大约 4–6 个重要的笔画，通常使用首字母或最强的字母形状作为基础。结果可能更像个人花押或创作者标记，而不是完全可读的手写体。

对于更柔和或更浪漫的名字，MARK 可以替换为 CHARM：一种精致实用的签名，带有一个微妙的个人细节，例如微小的类心形结尾或极简的花卉姿态。保持其高雅且成熟。

这四种设计在第一眼看上去必须明显不同。FLOW 应感觉流畅，EDGE 锋利，LOOP 具有表现力，MARK 极简。

让每个签名都足够大，足以占据其象限。不要在样式标签下添加额外的描述。

不要添加水印、编号、装饰性边框、星星、皇冠、过多的心形、无关的图标或不必要的图形元素。

items.title: 纪念碑式建筑排版概念海报设计

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 vertical conceptual poster built around monumental architectural typography.

WORD: [WIND / TIDE / GROW / LIGHT / your word]
PHYSICAL EFFECT: [wind / water / plants / sunlight / other]
MATERIAL: [stone / concrete / plaster / metal]
ENVIRONMENT: [coast / salt flat / forest / mountains / open landscape]
ACCENT COLOR: [optional]

Turn the chosen word into a massive three-dimensional architectural structure, tens of meters tall, using bold modern sans-serif letterforms with realistic depth, inner walls, side surfaces, shadows, and physical scale.

The key idea is that the meaning of the word must physically affect the scene.

Do not simply place a landscape inside the letters. Create a real interaction between typography and environment:

• WIND: fabric or dust moves through the letters  
• TIDE: ocean water breaks through the type  
• GROW: trees and plants emerge through the letterforms  
• LIGHT: sunlight passes through the openings and casts long shadows  

The physical element should move naturally through, around, behind, and in front of the typography with clear spatial relationships, realistic occlusion, believable lighting, shadows, reflections, and material interaction.

Use a cinematic architectural-photography composition with strong depth and scale. Add one very small human figure for scale, integrated naturally into the scene.

Keep the environment minimal and spacious so the typography remains the main visual anchor.

Use realistic natural light, physically believable materials, restrained high-end color grading, and a surreal but photorealistic art direction.

Add a minimal editorial information system with:
• a small title block
• one short concept sentence
• one vertical metadata line
• one short signature phrase

Keep all typography sparse and secondary to the main visual.

No numbering, no Vol., no logo, no watermark, no decorative UI, no star symbols, no excessive text.

The final image should feel like a finished contemporary art-direction poster, where the word itself changes the physics of the world.

prompts.text:
创建一个以纪念碑式的建筑排版为核心的 9:16 垂直概念海报。

单词：[WIND / TIDE / GROW / LIGHT / 你的单词]
物理效果：[风 / 水 / 植物 / 阳光 / 其他]
材质：[石头 / 混凝土 / 石膏 / 金属]
环境：[海岸 / 盐沼 / 森林 / 山脉 / 开阔景观]
强调色：[可选]

将所选单词转化为一个巨大的三维建筑结构，高数十米，使用具有真实深度、内壁、侧面、阴影和物理比例的大胆现代无衬线字体。

核心理念是单词的含义必须在物理上影响场景。

不要只是简单地在字母内部放置景观。创造排版与环境之间的真实互动：

• WIND（风）：织物或灰尘穿过字母移动
• TIDE（潮汐）：海水冲破字体
• GROW（生长）：树木和植物从字形中生长出来
• LIGHT（光）：阳光穿过开口并投射出长长的阴影

物理元素应自然地穿过、环绕、在排版之后和之前移动，具有清晰的空间关系、真实的遮挡、可信的光照、阴影、反射和材质互动。

使用具有强烈深度和比例感的电影级建筑摄影构图。添加一个非常小的人影作为比例参考，自然地融入场景中。

保持环境极简且宽敞，使排版保持为主要的视觉锚点。

使用真实的自然光、物理上可信的材质、克制的高端调色，以及超现实但写实的艺术指导。

添加一个极简的编辑信息系统，包含：
• 一个小的标题块
• 一个简短的概念句子
• 一条垂直的元数据行
• 一个简短的签名短语

保持所有排版稀疏，且次于主要视觉效果。

不要编号，不要 Vol.，不要 logo，不要水印，不要装饰性 UI，不要星形符号，不要过多的文字。

最终图像应该感觉像是一张完整的当代艺术指导海报，单词本身改变了世界的物理规律。

prompts.text:
[Subject]: ____  
[Chinese Title]: ____  
[English Title]: ____  
[Central Hard Axis]: ____  
[Left and Right Visual Power]: ____ / ____  
[Repeating or Radiating Elements]: ____  
[Movement Mode]: Radiating / Diagonal / Repetitive Rhythm / Ripple / Tension / Other____  
[Primary Color Tone]: ____  
[Secondary Colors]: ____  
[Research Node]: ____  
[Aspect Ratio]: 9:16  

Generate a "Center Axis Framing" cultural poster with strong momentum and a mature Editorial Design temperament.

First, establish a clear, stable central hard axis, which can be a ship hull, bamboo spine, arrow, vessel structure, or other longitudinal main body; then let the repeating elements, arcs, diagonal lines, or ripples on the left and right sides together press the visual power toward the center.

The left and right elements are not just decorations, but must truly participate in the sense of direction and rhythm. Use oar arrays, skeletons, bow bodies, sound waves, wings, rods, etc., to form a continuous visual sequence, creating momentum through repetition, radiation, inclination, and scale changes.

The image must have a very clear first visual big shape: the central hard axis + the directional structures on both sides. The visual weight on the left and right should remain balanced, but do not make it a mechanical mirror image; allow for changes in angles, scales, materials, and rhythms.

Typography is redesigned according to the direction of the main body, it can span structures, stay close to the hard axis, align along the big shape, or be partially offset; do not fixedly use four-character vertical arrangement, giant single character centered, or the same title template.

A very small structural research module can be added, such as action stages, forces, ripples, skeletons, or path diagrams, with the area controlled at 5%–7%, adding a "sense of design research," but do not make it into a PPT or instructional diagram.

Control colors to 3–5 main colors, using clear large color gamuts and strong main body contrast.

The first eye sees the big shape and momentum, the second eye sees the central axis and title, and the third eye discovers how the elements on both sides together create direction and tension.

Avoid: mechanical symmetry, complete duplication of repeating elements, the main subject being too small, confused directions, multiple visual centers, complex technical parameters, PPT info boxes, random decorative lines, excessive aging, mottled noise, and a low-completion AI poster feel.

生成一张具有强动势和成熟 Editorial Design 气质的「中轴夹景」文化海报。

先建立一条明确、稳定的中央硬轴，可以是船身、竹脊、箭矢、器物结构或其他纵向主体；再让左右两侧的重复元素、弧线、斜线或波纹共同把视觉力量压向中央。

左右元素不只是装饰，而要真正参与方向感和节奏。可以使用桨阵、骨架、弓身、声波、羽翼、杆件等形成连续视觉序列，通过重复、放射、倾斜和尺度变化制造动势。

画面要有一个非常清楚的第一视觉大形：中央硬轴 + 两侧方向性结构。左右视觉重量保持平衡，但不要机械镜像，允许角度、尺度、材质和节奏存在变化。

Typography 根据主体方向重新设计，可以横跨结构、贴近硬轴、沿大形排布或局部错位，不要固定使用四字纵排、巨大单字居中或同一种标题模板。

可加入一个很小的结构研究模块，例如动作阶段、受力、波纹、骨架或路径示意，面积控制在 5%–7%，增加“设计研究感”，但不要做成 PPT 或教学图。

色彩控制在 3–5 个主要颜色，使用明确的大色域和强主体反差。

第一眼看到大形和动势，第二眼看到中轴和标题，第三眼发现两侧元素如何共同制造方向与张力。

避免：机械对称、重复元素完全复制、主体过小、方向混乱、多个视觉中心、复杂技术参数、PPT 信息框、随机装饰线、过度做旧、斑驳噪点和低完成度 AI 海报感。

items.title: 世界切片系列高端自然社论海报

prompts.text:
Theme: [Desert / Ocean / Forest / Ice / Other]
Surface world: [What appears above the surface]
Hidden world: [What is revealed underneath]
Key natural structure: [Aquifer / Blue hole / Root network / Ice mass / Other]
Main palette: [Warm sand + cyan / Deep blue / Forest green + umber / Ice blue + white]
Title: [Main English title]
Subtitle: [Short concept line]

Create a premium 9:16 editorial poster from the WORLD SLICE series.

Show a realistic natural landscape as if a section of the world has been physically cut open, revealing a much larger hidden structure beneath the visible surface.

Keep the surface relatively simple and easy to read, while the hidden section becomes the main visual surprise. Use strong scale contrast, clear geological or ecological layers, realistic materials, believable depth, atmospheric perspective and cinematic natural light.

The cutaway should not look like a glass box or aquarium. Treat it as a real piece of land, ocean, forest or ice physically sliced from the planet.

Let parts of nature break beyond the geometric cutaway boundary: roots, rock formations, ice, water or terrain may extend outside the original shape to create stronger visual impact.

Keep the central object around 55–70% of the poster width and preserve generous negative space. Avoid making the 3D cutaway too large.

Integrate typography into the composition instead of adding many tiny labels. Use one bold main title, one short supporting line and only a few minimal editorial details. Allow natural elements to overlap, pass behind or partially cover the typography.

Use a refined mix of modern serif and condensed sans-serif typography. The poster should feel like premium nature editorial design, contemporary art direction and photorealistic environmental visualization.

Prioritize:
strong thumbnail readability, one clear visual surprise, large recognizable forms, realistic natural textures, clean hierarchy, high-end editorial composition, and a strong contrast between the visible world and the hidden world.

No logo, no watermark, no numbering, no excessive micro text, no HUD interface, no four-point sparkle symbols, no cheap CGI, no glass-container look.

Make the final image feel like a complete finished poster, not a template.

副标题：[简短的概念说明]

创作一张来自 WORLD SLICE 系列的高端 9:16 社论海报。

展示一个真实的自然景观，仿佛世界的一角被物理切开，揭示出可见地表下大得多的隐藏结构。

保持地表相对简单且易于解读，而隐藏部分则成为主要的视觉惊喜。使用强烈的比例对比、清晰的地质或生态分层、真实的材质、可信的深度、大气透视和电影般的自然光。

剖面不应看起来像玻璃箱或水族馆。将其视为从地球上物理切割下来的真实土地、海洋、森林或冰块。

让自然的一部分突破几何切口的边界：树根、岩层、冰、水或地形可以延伸到原始形状之外，以创造更强的视觉冲击力。

保持中心物体占据海报宽度的 55–70% 左右，并保留充足的负空间。避免将 3D 剖面做得太大。

将排版融入构图中，而不是添加许多微小的标签。使用一个粗体主标题、一行简短的辅助文字和极少数极简的社论细节。允许自然元素重叠、穿过排版背面或部分遮盖排版。

混合使用精致的现代衬线体和紧凑的无衬线体。海报应具有高端自然社论设计、当代艺术指导和写实环境视觉化的质感。

优先级：
强烈的缩略图可读性、一个清晰的视觉惊喜、大型可辨认的形状、真实的自然纹理、清晰的层级、高端社论构图，以及可见世界与隐藏世界之间的强烈对比。

无徽标、无水印、无编号、无过多的微型文本、无 HUD 界面、无四角星闪烁符号、无廉价 CGI 感、无玻璃容器外观。

使最终图像感觉像是一张完整成品海报，而不是模板。

interpretation:

"If the INTRUDER is an abstract concept or invisible thing, transform it into a concrete visual image recognizable at a glance, or only show the visible consequences it causes"

"The accident must be unique to the INTRUDER: if you replace the INTRUDER with something else, the accident would not make sense"

prompts.text:
INTRUDER = 「 一只大白鹅 」     
scene:     
"最终图像是一张2×2田字格四宫格图，这是最优先的构图规则"     
"四格大小完全相同，用细白边隔开，四格照片铺满整个画面，整张图比例为3:4，每一格也是3:4"     
"每一格都是一张真实的证件照：上传参考图中的人物，正对镜头，保持标准证件照姿势"     
"四格讲述一个连续的故事，阅读顺序为：左上 → 右上 → 左下 → 右下"     
"在这个故事中，INTRUDER闯进证件照拍摄现场，对人物造成越来越严重的物理混乱"     
"人物拼命维持证件照的标准表情和姿势，只流露出极细微的破防信号"     
"反差核心：绝对规范、严肃的证件照格式，与画面中逐步失控的离谱事故"     
panels:     
"左上格：完美的标准证件照，画面中没有INTRUDER，一切正常"     
"右上格：INTRUDER刚从画面边缘出现，只露出一部分，人物眼神微微瞥向它"     
"左下格：INTRUDER开始直接接触人物，人物强忍，表情几乎不变"     
"右下格：事故完全失控，场面最混乱，人物身上留下明显痕迹，但人物仍坚持标准姿势，只多了一个破防信号"     
"混乱程度从左上到右下逐格递增，不要把最混乱的画面放在其他格"     
"四格使用同一机位、同一背景、同一人物、同一服装"     
"四格中人物的脸必须是同一个人，身份一致"     
preprocess:     
"最优先保持参考人物的面部身份：脸型、眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、眉毛、下巴、个人特征与左右差异"     
"保持发型、发色、发质，以及参考图中可确认的服装领口与配饰"     
"将参考图中的人物转换为标准正面角度，校正参考图的透视与镜头畸变"     
"不要重新设计成另一个人，不要美颜、平均化、网红化"     
id_photo_format:     
"纯色证件照背景，默认证件蓝，均匀无渐变"     
"人物正面朝向镜头，头部居中，双肩平齐对称"     
"取景从头顶上方少量留白到胸口"     
"证件照闪光灯平光，脸部均匀照亮，背景上几乎没有人物投影"     
"整体像真实照相馆拍出的照片，高清、真实，带有证件照特有的平淡感"     
subject:     
expression:     
"基础表情是标准证件照中性表情：嘴巴闭合，目视镜头，面部放松"     
"破防信号只允许极细微的一种：眼神瞥向INTRUDER、嘴角憋笑、眉头轻微抽动、额头一滴汗、鼻孔微张"     
"人物努力不动，不大笑、不尖叫、不逃跑"     
intruder:    
interpretation:    
    
"INTRUDER可以是任何东西：动物、物体、食物、自然现象、交通工具、角色、抽象概念或一个短语，按大众最熟悉的样子理解它"    
    
"如果INTRUDER带有数量、状态或形容词，严格执行：写的是很多，就真的铺满画面"    
    
"如果INTRUDER是抽象概念或看不见的东西，把它转化为大众一眼能认出的具体视觉形象，或者只表现它造成的可见后果"    
    
"如果INTRUDER是角色，以真实摄影质感的实体版本出现，保留其标志性外形；它不替换人物，也不影响人物的脸"    
    
"如果INTRUDER远大于人物，只让它的一部分伸进格子；如果远小于人物，就靠数量造成混乱"    
    
"如果INTRUDER带有危险性，保持无害的喜剧效果，不出现受伤、流血或恐怖感"    

intruder:    
behavior:    
    
"先找出INTRUDER最有辨识度的特性：它最出名的习性、功能、用途、物理性质或大众熟知的梗"    
    
"事故必须由这个特性直接引起"    
    
"事故必须是INTRUDER专属的：如果把INTRUDER换成别的东西，这个事故就不成立"    
    
"不采用任何同类事物都会做的通用行为，优先选择只有INTRUDER才会做的事"    
    
"先在内部构思几个可能的事故，选择最出人意料、同时观众一眼就能看懂的那一个"    

intruder:    
escalation:    
    
"四格是同一件事故逐步升级，而不是四件不同的事"    
    
"右上格：INTRUDER以它特有的方式从格子边缘登场"    
    
"左下格：它的特性开始作用在人物身上，产生第一处可见后果"    
    
"右下格：同一特性被放大到极限，后果遍布人物和画面，人物仍保持证件照姿势"    

intruder:    
readability:    
    
"INTRUDER以真实摄影质感出现，与人物处在同一空间、同一光线下"    
    
"每一格不看任何文字也能一眼看懂发生了什么"    
    
"INTRUDER和它造成的后果是画面的主要看点之一，但始终不遮挡人物的眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴"    
critical:     
must:     
"2×2田字格，四格等大，整图3:4"     
"剧情按左上 → 右上 → 左下 → 右下的顺序逐格升级"     
"左上格完全正常，右下格最混乱"     
"标准证件照格式：正面、纯色背景、平光、胸口以上"     
"INTRUDER与人物有直接的物理互动和可见后果"     
"人物保持冷静姿势，只有细微破防"     
"四格面部身份一致，并与参考图一致"     
critical:     
avoid:     
"竖排照片条" "单列或单行排列" "格子大小不一致" "超过或少于四格"     
"剧情顺序错乱" "最混乱的画面不在右下格" "左上格就出现INTRUDER"     
"人物大笑、尖叫、逃离画面" "侧脸或低头" "INTRUDER离人物很远没有互动"     
"卡通化的INTRUDER" "杂乱的实景背景" "背景有明显渐变或阴影"     
"四格中人物长相不一致" "五官被完全遮挡" "美颜网红脸"     
"多余肢体" "多余手指" "文字" "水印" "logo"
