Shot with a 24–28mm wide-angle lens at close range, the foreground character is closest to the lens, forming a distinct large-near-small-far perspective, while the other two are distributed in the middle ground and right rear.

All three have naturally plump hourglass-shaped bodies, moderate shoulders, full breasts, cinched waists, rounded hips, and well-proportioned thighs; no paper-thin bodies, and no exaggerated athletic feel.

The foreground woman is on the left side of the frame, leaning forward toward the camera with a bright smile, handing a slender champagne glass filled with golden sparkling wine toward the lens; the glass is significantly enlarged due to being closest. She has dark brown medium-length hair, loosely pinned up with thin wispy bangs.

The middle-ground woman stands in the center of the aisle, body slightly bent forward, holding a silver round tray with both hands containing grapes, strawberries, olives, and exquisite small desserts, looking at the camera with a smile.

The third woman in the right rear stands by the beverage cabinet with her back to the camera, body slightly turned, taking or pouring champagne, showing only her profile and back contour.

All three wear unified deep navy blue + white piping flight attendant-themed bikini sets: triangle tops, low-waist bottoms, with small gold wing badges on the chest; blue and white striped silk scarves around the neck, and small navy blue flight attendant hats with gold wing patterns on the side. The overall theme is clearly fashion cosplay / party, not real airline uniforms.

The scene is the interior of a luxury private business jet: cream-white leather seats, polished dark brown wood veneer tabletops, black high-gloss cabinets, metal decorative strips, with continuous oval portholes on the left showing high-altitude blue sky and clouds. There are warm white hidden LED strips on the ceiling, and the cabin depth is distinct.

The overall texture is a combination of high-quality commercial photography and slight lifestyle snapshots, with a clear, transparent, luxurious yet realistic image.

items.title: 手工立体层叠纸艺绘本风格转换

prompts.text:
Use the single uploaded photograph as the sole content source. Transform it into one finished handcrafted layered-paper storybook scene. Output only the transformed image—do not include the original photograph, a before-and-after comparison, split layout, collage, caption, explanation, border, or mockup. Preserve the source image’s aspect ratio and general framing.

Faithfully preserve the main subject’s identity cues, age category, gender presentation, skin tone, hairstyle, facial hair, glasses, expression, gaze direction, pose, body orientation, clothing categories, garment colors, accessories, and interaction with important objects. Keep the exact number of principal people and preserve their spatial relationships. Retain all objects necessary to understand the action. Do not add, remove, duplicate, or replace important subjects, limbs, tools, garments, or props.

Redesign the person as a charming contemporary paper-cut storybook character with a slightly enlarged head, softly simplified facial anatomy, compact proportions, expressive dark eyes, clean eyebrows, a small nose and mouth, subtle rosy cheeks, and a warm natural expression matching the source. Preserve distinguishing facial structure, hair silhouette, facial hair, eyewear, and clothing so the subject remains recognizable. Adults must retain an adult appearance; avoid infant proportions, extreme chibi anatomy, oversized sparkling eyes, or a generic identical doll face.

Construct the entire image as a dimensional handmade paper diorama using layered cut cardstock, fibrous handmade paper, lightly embossed paper, and occasional soft felt-like paper surfaces. Every person, object, plant, architectural element, and landscape feature must visibly consist of overlapping cut-paper pieces. Show tactile paper grain, slightly irregular hand-cut edges, folded planes, stacked layers, shallow relief, clean silhouettes, and soft contact shadows between layers. Avoid photorealistic materials, plastic toys, clay, crochet, glossy CGI, flat vector graphics, or smooth digital painting.

Identify the photograph’s dominant everyday action and its most meaningful object, then turn that relationship into a gentle visual metaphor. The metaphor must grow directly from the source rather than introduce an unrelated fantasy. For example, fabric may become folded mountains, food may expand into an orchard, water may form a miniature garden landscape, or the contents of a bag may become a tiny symbolic world. Use this principle adaptively—do not copy these examples when they do not match the uploaded photograph. Preserve the original action exactly while allowing the key object or surrounding surface to unfold into a coherent miniature paper world that expresses the action’s emotional theme.

Keep the main character large and dominant in the foreground. Surround the character’s silhouette with a narrow warm-ivory paper edge, like a raised die-cut storybook figure. Integrate this figure naturally into the layered scene rather than making it look pasted onto an unrelated background. Preserve the source setting’s recognizable structure—such as a room, balcony, kitchen, garden, doorway, table, or landscape—but simplify it into broad paper shapes. Remove incidental clutter, unreadable labels, duplicate objects, and distracting background details. Expand only the central storytelling element into an imaginative environment.

Use strong foreground, middle-ground, and background separation. Place small paper elements at different depths to create a theatrical miniature-set effect: foreground foliage or props, the main subject and action in the middle ground, and simplified architecture, hills, trees, clouds, or distant scenery behind them. Use overlapping shapes rather than realistic perspective detail. Keep the composition balanced and readable, with the principal action remaining the clearest focal point.

Use a warm, muted, nature-inspired palette derived from the source photograph: sage and olive greens, mustard, terracotta, dusty blue, cream, warm brown, charcoal, and restrained pastel accents. Preserve signature clothing and object colors. Use broad matte color fields with subtle variations from paper fibers, avoiding neon colors and photographic gradients. Light the scene with warm diffused daylight from the same general direction as the source, producing soft shadows beneath raised paper layers and a cozy handcrafted atmosphere.

Render plants, trees, clouds, mountains, waves, furniture, textiles, and small decorative objects as simplified cut-paper forms with enough detail to remain identifiable. Use repeated leaf shapes, scalloped clouds, angular folded mountains, layered waves, tiny buildings, and miniature props only when relevant to the source story. Keep hands complete and naturally connected to objects. Preserve occlusion and contact accurately so tools, containers, clothing, and environmental elements remain physically understandable.

The finished image should feel like a premium children’s picture-book illustration, stop-motion paper theater, and collectible dimensional papercraft artwork: imaginative but grounded in the uploaded moment, tactile, warm, polished, emotionally gentle, and rich in small narrative details. Avoid photorealism, anime rendering, plastic 3D characters, smooth vector art, watercolor, yarn embroidery, malformed hands, duplicated limbs, changed actions, missing props, unrelated fantasy objects, excessive clutter, text, logos, signatures, watermarks, and visible comparison layouts. Output only the completed transformed paper-diorama image.

prompts.text:
以上传的单张照片为唯一内容来源。将其转换成一个完成的手工叠层纸艺绘本场景。仅输出转换后的图像——不要包含原始照片、前后对比图、分屏布局、拼贴画、标题、解释、边框或模型图。保留源图像的长宽比和大致构图。

忠实保留主角的身份线索、年龄类别、性别呈现、肤色、发型、面部毛发、眼镜、表情、注视方向、姿势、身体取向、服装类别、服装颜色、配饰以及与重要物品的互动。保持主要人物的确切数量并保留其空间关系。保留理解动作所需的所有物品。不要添加、删除、重复或替换重要的主体、肢体、工具、服装或道具。

将人物重新设计为迷人的当代剪纸绘本角色，头部略微放大，面部解剖结构柔和简化，比例紧凑，拥有富有表现力的深色眼睛、整洁的眉毛、小鼻子和小嘴巴、微妙的红润脸颊，以及与来源匹配的温暖自然表情。保留独特的面部结构、发型轮廓、面部毛发、眼镜和服装，使主体保持可辨识性。成年人必须保持成年外观；避免婴儿比例、极端的二头身解剖结构、过大的闪烁眼睛或通用的相同娃娃脸。

将整个图像构建为一个维度的手工纸艺透视模型，使用层叠的卡纸、纤维手工纸、轻微压花的纸张以及偶尔出现的柔软毡状纸面。每个人、物体、植物、建筑元素和景观特征都必须明显由重叠的剪纸片组成。展示触觉纸纹、略微不规则的手切割边缘、折叠平面、堆叠层、浅浮雕、清晰的轮廓以及层与层之间的柔和接触阴影。避免写实材料、塑料玩具、粘土、钩针、光泽的CGI、扁平矢量图形或平滑的数字绘画。

识别照片中占主导地位的日常动作及其最有意义的物体，然后将这种关系转化为柔和的视觉隐喻。隐喻必须直接源于素材，而不是引入无关的幻想。例如，织物可能变成褶皱的山脉，食物可能扩展成一间果园，水可能形成微型花园景观，或者包里的内容物可能变成一个微小的象征世界。自适应地使用这一原则——当这些例子与上传的照片不匹配时，不要复制它们。准确保留原始动作，同时允许关键物体或周围表面展开成一个连贯的微型纸艺世界，以表达动作的情感主题。

保持主角在前景中高大且占主导地位。在人物轮廓周围包围一圈窄窄的暖象牙色纸边，就像一个凸起的模切绘本人物。将此形象自然地融入层叠场景中，而不是使其看起来像是粘贴在无关背景上的。保留源场景的可辨识结构——如房间、阳台、厨房、花园、门口、桌子或风景——但将其简化为宽阔的纸张形状。移除偶然的杂乱、无法辨认的标签、重复的物体和分散注意力的背景细节。仅将核心叙事元素扩展为富有想象力的环境。

使用强烈的背景、中景和背景分离。将小的纸张元素放置在不同的深度，以创造剧场式的微型布景效果：前景的植物或道具，中景的主角和动作，以及他们身后简化的建筑、小山、树木、云朵或远景。使用重叠的形状而不是写实的透视细节。保持构图平衡且易读，主要动作保持为最清晰的焦点。

使用源于原始照片的温暖、柔和、受自然启发的色调：鼠尾草绿和橄榄绿、芥末黄、陶土色、灰蓝色、奶油色、暖褐色、木炭色和内敛的粉彩色调。保留标志性的服装和物体颜色。使用具有来自纸张纤维细微变化的宽阔哑光色块，避免霓虹色和摄影渐变。用来自与光源大致相同方向的温暖漫射日光照射场景，在升起的纸层下方产生柔和的阴影，营造出舒适的手工氛围。

将植物、树木、云朵、山脉、波浪、家具、纺织品和小型装饰物渲染为简化的剪纸形式，并带有足以保持可辨识性的细节。仅在与源故事相关时使用重复的叶子形状、扇形云朵、棱角分明的折叠山脉、层叠的波浪、微型建筑和微型道具。保持双手完整并与物体自然连接。准确保留遮挡和接触，使工具、容器、服装和环境元素保持物理上的可理解性。

成品图像应该感觉像是一幅高级儿童图画书插图、定格纸艺剧场和具有收藏价值的立体纸艺作品：充满想象力但植根于上传的时刻，具有触感，温暖，精致，情感温柔，且富有微小的叙事细节。避免写实主义、动漫渲染、塑料3D角色、平滑的矢量艺术、水彩、毛线绣、变形的手、重复的肢体、改变的动作、缺失的道具、无关的幻想物品、过度的杂乱、文本、徽标、签名、水印和可见的对比布局。仅输出完成的转换后的纸艺透视图。

Use an asymmetric split layout: around 25% clean white editorial space on the left and 75% full-color fashion portrait on the right. Use a close-up young adult fashion portrait with distinctive styling, realistic skin texture, natural hair, statement eyewear and metallic accessories.

Keep the left column moderately filled with short headlines, keywords and compact editorial copy. Build hierarchy through typography scale and spacing. Do not use black horizontal divider lines, long vertical rules or heavy frames.

Place [MAIN WORD] vertically along the boundary between the white column and the portrait, using oversized stacked letters that run through most of the poster height.

The most important rule: the image inside the letters must be the exact same continuous photograph as the portrait on the right.

Do not treat each letter as a separate photo. Hair, glasses, facial features, clothing, accessories and background must align seamlessly across the inside and outside of every letter. The typography should look as if the letters were directly cut from the original photograph in place.

Where the letters extend into the white column, the photographic fill becomes clearly visible. Where they overlap the portrait area, the image inside the letters should naturally merge back into the original photograph.

Define the letters with very thin white outlines. Keep around 85% of the edges clean and intact, and apply [EDGE EFFECT] only to selected local areas.

Echo Outline: add 2–4 short parallel contour echoes beside selected edges.

Speed Slice: use thin horizontal slices with short lateral displacement.

Wave Displacement: create brief sections where the edge gently shifts left and right before returning to normal.

Fragment Edge: break selected sections into short clean fragments, small gaps and slightly displaced pieces.

Keep all distortions precise and restrained. Do not distort the full portrait and do not turn the entire word into glitch typography.

Add a large ultra-thin [TOP RIGHT] headline in the upper-right area. Near the lower-right, use [BOTTOM RIGHT] with a bold first word and a large ultra-thin secondary word.

Maintain strong macro and micro typography contrast, a clean editorial grid and a limited palette based on [BACKGROUND COLOR], white, black, natural skin tones and metallic accents.

The final image should feel like a contemporary independent fashion magazine cover with experimental typography, strong youth styling and polished editorial art direction.

Avoid ordinary hollow text, flat-color giant letters, separate photo fills inside each letter, misaligned image fragments, duplicated faces, excessive copy, black divider lines, full-screen glitch, RGB separation, cyberpunk UI, plastic skin, CGI texture, numbered issue labels, starbursts or sparkle symbols.

保持所有变形精确且克制。不要扭曲整个肖像，也不要将整个单词变成故障排版。

在右上方区域添加一个大型超细的 [右上角] 标题。在右下方附近，使用 [右下角]，第一个单词加粗，第二个单词为大型超细字体。

prompts.text:
Hyper-realistic Chinese hospital waiting area smartphone snapshot photography, vertical aspect ratio approximately 3:4. A clearly adult East Asian female, about 30–40 years old, sitting alone on a metal waiting chair outside a hospital internal medicine clinic, looking down and organizing a brown handbag in her hands. The photographer is located slightly to the left directly in front of the subject, using an approximately 35–50mm equivalent lens for a medium-distance shot, fully capturing the head, upper body, crossed legs, and sandals, while retaining the nearby waiting patients, hospital signage, and corridor environment.

The subject has a naturally full, slightly hourglass figure: moderate shoulders, full chest, natural waist and abdomen, realistic soft volume in hips and thighs, and proportionate calves. Do not make her overly thin, and do not have an athletic muscular feel.

Sitting posture focus: body leaning slightly forward, legs crossed at the knees, one leg naturally extending diagonally toward the bottom left of the frame, the other leg placed vertically on the ground. Left arm close to the body, hands opening or organizing a handbag placed by her leg; head lowered, gaze looking inside the bag, not looking at the camera, quiet and focused expression.

The subject has jet-black medium-long hair, casually tied in a slightly messy low bun/updo at the back, with naturally fluffy stray hairs on top and a few thin strands near the cheeks. Oval face shape, naturally fair skin tone, light makeup: thin eyebrows, natural eyeliner, light pink blush, nude pink lip makeup.

Top wears a black slim-fit camisole/tank top with a simple curved low neckline, no obvious pattern; loosely draped over it is a thin brown and black leopard print cardigan/shawl, material is light and soft, sleeves are loose, leopard print consists of irregular dark brown and black spots.

Bottom wears a black slim-fit midi skirt, length reaching near the knees, fabric is soft and fits naturally, forming small folds when sitting. Legs are bare, no stockings.

Feet wear light beige woven-texture high-heeled mule sandals, open-toe front, wide strap with beige fabric or woven texture, heel is approximately 5–7cm transparent or silver slim square heel. Toes have dark nail polish.

Subject wears a thin gold necklace + small gold pendant, a slender gold bracelet on the wrist, jewelry is simple and everyday.

Beside her is a classic brown monogram handbag, brown canvas base covered with light brown repeating patterns, with caramel brown leather trim, handles, and long shoulder strap, gold metal hardware, the bag body is located at the bottom left of the frame near the thigh.

The scene is a waiting area of a regular Chinese public hospital outpatient clinic. The subject sits on a grey metal row chair, immediately to her right is another middle-aged to elderly female patient, showing only a white T-shirt, khaki pants, and part of the body. The background wall consists of off-white/light grey tiles, with the lower half being a light beige wainscot.

Directly behind and above the subject's head is a clear hospital department sign, white background with dark green or blue-green font, writing “内科 / Internal medicine”. Beside it on the wall are also green and red hospital notice boards, such as “Please respect patient privacy,” “Warm reminder,” and other Chinese medical notices, with simple nurse cartoon patterns and hospital logos. The text does not need to be perfectly accurate, but the overall feel must be a real Chinese hospital bulletin board.

The left side of the frame is an open corridor/doorway, where green-toned natural light, metal window bars, light-colored tile floors, and a small red plastic stool can be seen. The floor consists of large light beige tiles with obvious seams and daily wear, and there is a green floor guide line under the subject's feet.

Lighting uses hospital cold white ceiling lights + natural sunlight from the window on the left, soft light on the subject's face and legs, overall tending towards a realistic light green/beige hospital color tone. Do not use studio lighting.

The overall quality is a real Chinese hospital waiting area casual snapshot/smartphone documentary photography texture: natural exposure, medium depth of field, clear background, slight smartphone sharpening, real skin texture, everyday clutter, not a commercial fashion blockbuster effect.

Key focus: Adult East Asian female + Hospital internal medicine waiting area + Metal row chairs + Looking down organizing brown monogram handbag + Black camisole + Brown black leopard print shawl + Black midi skirt + Bare legs + Beige open-toe high-heel mule sandals + Crossed legs + Messy bun + Other patients nearby + “内科 / Internal medicine” sign + Chinese hospital warm reminder boards + Red plastic stool + Chinese public hospital real snapshot.

Avoid: Young girlish feel, long straight hair completely loose, heavy makeup, stockings, sneakers, luxury private hospital, empty waiting area, studio background, strong blurring, anime face, CG feel, plastic skin, extra limbs, watermarks and irrelevant text.

prompts.text:

她手边是一只经典棕色老花纹手提包，棕色帆布底布覆盖浅棕色重复花纹，配焦糖棕皮革包边、手柄和长肩带，金色金属扣件，包体位于画面左下靠近大腿位置。

场景为中国普通公立医院门诊候诊区。人物坐在灰色金属联排椅上，右侧紧邻另一名中老年女性患者，只显示白色T恤、卡其裤和部分身体。背景墙为米白 / 浅灰瓷砖，下半部浅米色护墙。

人物头顶正后方有明显的医院科室指示牌，白底深绿色或蓝绿色字体，写有“内科 / Internal medicine”。旁边墙面还张贴绿色和红色医院提示牌，如“请注意保护患者隐私”“温馨提示”等中文医疗告示，并带简单护士卡通图案和医院标识。文字不必完全准确，但整体必须有真实中国医院公告栏感。

画面左侧是开放式走廊 / 门口，能看到绿色调自然光、金属窗栏、浅色瓷砖地面和一个红色塑料小凳子。地面为浅米色大块瓷砖，带明显拼缝和日常磨损，人物脚下还有绿色地面引导线。

光线采用医院冷白顶灯＋左侧窗户自然日光，人物脸部和腿部受光柔和，整体偏真实浅绿色 / 米黄色医院色调。不要摄影棚布光。

整体呈 真实中国医院候诊随手抓拍 / 手机纪实摄影质感：自然曝光、中等景深、背景清楚、轻微手机锐化、真实皮肤纹理、日常杂乱感，不要商业时尚大片效果。

重点锁定：成年东亚女性＋医院内科候诊区＋金属联排椅＋低头整理棕色老花手提包＋黑色吊带背心＋棕黑豹纹披肩＋黑色中长裙＋裸腿＋米色露趾高跟凉拖＋双腿交叉＋凌乱盘发＋旁边其他患者＋“内科 / Internal medicine”标识＋医院中文温馨提示牌＋红色塑料凳＋中国公立医院真实抓拍。

避免：年轻少女感、长直发完全披散、厚重浓妆、丝袜、运动鞋、豪华私立医院、空无一人的候诊区、摄影棚背景、强烈虚化、动漫脸、CG感、塑料皮肤、多余肢体、水印和无关文字。

prompts.text:
Use the uploaded image as the primary reference. Preserve the original scene, composition, subjects, poses, proportions, colors, and important details accurately. Do not replace or rearrange the main elements.

Create a vertical 3:4 editorial poster with a refined photograph-to-hand-drawn-illustration transformation.

TOP SECTION — ORIGINAL PHOTO
•Keep the uploaded photograph essentially unchanged.
•Preserve the exact environment, people/animals, objects, architecture, lighting, colors, and composition.
•Make it look natural, sharp, and photographic.
•The photo should occupy approximately the upper 50% of the poster.

BOTTOM SECTION — ILLUSTRATED VERSION
•Recreate the same scene from the photograph as a delicate hand-drawn illustration.
•Keep the same subjects, positions, poses, perspective, and recognizable details.
•Use a soft watercolor + colored pencil + ink sketch aesthetic.
•Fine expressive outlines, subtle pencil texture, gentle watercolor washes, slightly imperfect hand-drawn edges.

prompts.text:
Create a premium 4:5 vertical Perler Bead editorial artwork for [COUNTRY / LOCATION / SUBJECT].

VISUAL GENERATION
Build the entire composition creatively from [COUNTRY / LOCATION / SUBJECT]. Automatically identify the most recognizable subject, landmark, character, animal, architecture, landscape, or cultural element associated with it.

PERLER BEAD ART
Transform the main subject into a miniature Perler Bead artwork made from precisely arranged rounded plastic beads. Every bead should have a clearly visible central hole, authentic matte plastic texture, subtle dimensionality, and realistic heat-fused construction.

Preserve the subject's most recognizable silhouette, proportions, pose, and signature colors while simplifying unnecessary details. Build highlights, shadows, and depth entirely through neighboring solid-color beads. No gradients, watercolor effects, soft brushwork, or painterly transitions.

Add a clean white Perler Bead outline around the entire artwork, following the subject with a naturally stepped pixel-like edge.

COMPOSITION
Place the finished Perler Bead artwork small and refined in the upper-center of the frame, surrounded by generous negative space. Divide the composition into two balanced horizontal zones, creating a clean 50/50 editorial structure.

Use a soft, low-saturation background palette inspired by [COUNTRY / LOCATION / SUBJECT], with subtle paper grain and tactile printed texture. Add only a very soft natural shadow beneath the bead artwork so it feels physically placed on the surface.

TYPOGRAPHY
Keep typography minimal and restrained. If text is used, include only a short elegant English title related to [COUNTRY / LOCATION / SUBJECT]. No excessive labels, captions, logos, or decorative text.

FINAL AESTHETIC
Perler Bead craftsmanship × minimalist travel editorial × lifestyle photography book × tactile paper texture × refined negative space. The result should feel like a premium physical art piece photographed from above, combining playful bead craftsmanship with sophisticated editorial design.

Avoid photorealistic subjects, CGI plastic, smooth gradients, watercolor, painterly effects, oversized bead art, clutter, excessive text, logos, watermarks, or distorted bead patterns.

FORMAT: 4:5 vertical, 50/50 balanced composition, small centered Perler Bead artwork, generous negative space.

在车站站台上向左看的虚构成年女性。以灰色西装和白色衬衫、肩上挎着的包为中心，描绘通勤途中的自然姿态。

地点・时间・背景:
金属屋顶和柱子连绵的车站站台。右后方可见带有蓝色条纹的车厢，以及背对着的西装打扮的通勤乘客。通过屋顶的横梁和柱子营造纵深感，背景细节比人物更柔和地模糊。

服装・配饰:
灰色的修身夹克和同色下装，白色前扣衬衫。搭配细项链和小耳饰，添加黑色肩挎包。

姿势・手部・接触:
身体微微斜向一边，一只手握住肩上的包带。另一只手臂自然下垂，保持肩膀略微后收的姿势。

表情・视线:
脸部和双眼朝向左侧的站台，嘴唇微微张开。眼角保留一丝轻微的紧张，营造出自然确认周遭的表情。

脸部・妆容:
浅棕色眉毛，深色瞳孔，玫瑰色的嘴唇。柔和连接脸颊的温暖色调和下巴的阴影，保留自然的肌理。

头发:
棕色及肩头发自然下垂，一侧向耳朵靠近。长刘海斜向流动，在颈部周围放置弯曲的发束。

光源:
从屋顶缝隙中洒下的柔和日光照亮脸部和白色衬衫。夹克上投下轻微阴影，金属柱子上放置细长的反光。

颜色・明暗:
以西装的炭灰色、衬衫的白色、肌肤的暖色为主。列车蓝色作为低调的点缀色，结合灰色金属和柔和日光。白色衣物上也保留布料的细微明暗。

材质・细微质感:
夹克的细密织纹、衬衫纽扣周围的褶皱、包的平滑肩带、列车的金属质感，各自分开描绘。

构图・镜头:
纵向9:16的近距离上半身构图。胸口中心置于横向58%，脸部中心置于横向32%附近。脸部的左端和握包的手端延伸至画面外。保持肩膀的斜向流动，以及右后方列车和通勤乘客的位置。

图像处理・完成:
作为自然的车站快照，将背景人群柔和模糊。眼睛和西装保留细节，白色衬衫的明暗调和柔和处理。

崩坏回避・禁止:
维持成年女性的服装和姿势、握包的手。不要添加多余的手脚、虚构的车站名称、标志、体型变更、暴露追加、水印。

She has very long, thick, dark brown hair, parted loosely near the center and falling in flowing, softly tousled waves down her back to her waist, with a few fine strands framing her face.

Her body is turned mostly away from the camera in a full-length rear three-quarter pose. Her legs are long and close together, with one knee subtly bent and her weight shifted naturally to create an elegant fashion-model stance.

She wears a fitted black mini dress exactly as shown: a sleek, body-hugging design with short sleeves, a high simple neckline, a closely tailored waist and hips, and a very short hem ending high on the upper thighs. The fabric has a smooth, slightly satin-like finish that catches gentle highlights while remaining predominantly matte black. She wears glossy black patent-leather pointed-toe stiletto pumps with extremely high thin heels, with no additional visible accessories.

The apartment features polished gray marble flooring with soft reflections, a contemporary beige-gray upholstered sofa and cushions on the right, dark floor-length curtains, and a warm rectangular floor lamp. Beyond the expansive glass windows, tall modern towers recede into atmospheric haze. prompts.text:
Theme:
Tying hair with a checkered apron

Subject:
In the center of the frame, a young woman lifting her arms to tie her hair in a bright kitchen. A black and white small checkered pattern halter apron, a large knot at the front waist, with vegetables in the foreground as the secondary subjects.

Character·Expression:
A small oval face, slim chin, large dark brown eyes, thin eyebrows, a neat nose, and slightly parted glossy peach-colored lips. The face is turned slightly to the right, eyes fixed on the front camera, with a calm expression. Dark brown hair with thin bangs and side strands remaining, using both hands to make a low ponytail at the back of the head.

Clothing·Pose:
Black and white extremely small checkered pattern, thick white halter straps, a pleated apron dress wrapping straight across the chest, with a large bow of the same fabric at the front waist. Small gold stud earrings and a thin necklace. Standing, elbows bent significantly upwards to the left and right, hands gathering the hair at the back of the head.

Background·Light:
On the wooden cooking counter in the foreground are leafy greens in a metal bowl, red tomatoes, a kitchen knife, and a pepper shaker. To the left of the background are a refrigerator and wooden shelves, in the center is a sink, and on the right side of the frame are a large window and greenery. Hard morning light enters from the window at the top right, shining on the face, arms, and chest, and casting bright shadows on the cooking counter.

Composition·Camera:
3:4 vertical composition, shot from a front camera at chest height across the cooking counter, an upper body portrait from the top of the head to below the waist. The person is presented largely in the center, with raised arms surrounding the upper part, and vegetables placed at the bottom edge. Elbows are cropped at the left and right edges, focus on the pupils and face, with the depths of the kitchen slightly blurred.

Texture·Style:
Photorealistic realistic photo. Highly exquisite representation of natural skin, small checkered fabric, hair, metal bowl, vegetables, and wooden counter, adding warm tones of morning light into white, black, and wood colors.

Negative Prompt:
Changes in arms and hair tying; omitting the checkered apron or vegetables

prompts.text:
Based on the attached character image, create an "AI Beauty Character Consistency Sheet" as a single image.

Purpose:
Create a visual reference sheet so that this person can be stably reproduced as the same person in the future, even if clothing, background, pose, expression, and camera angle change.

【Most Important】
Maintain the features related to identification, such as the person's face, facial proportions, eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, contour, skin tone, hair color, hair texture, body type, and body balance in the reference image as consistently as possible.
Avoid excessive beautification, becoming someone else, anime style, or CG style.
Unify everything as the same adult female.

【Sheet Composition】

■ Basic Settings
Organize the following content in text on the left.
・Name
・Age (Adult)
・Personality
・Facial contour
・Eye shape
・Eyebrow shape
・Nose characteristics
・Mouth/lip characteristics
・Hair color
・Hair length
・Bangs
・Hair texture
・Skin tone
・Skin texture
・Height sense
・Body type
・Basic clothing

For items such as personality and name that cannot be determined from the reference image, do not conclude arbitrarily; leave them as "Setting Column."

■ Full Body Angles
In the same simple clothing and same hairstyle,
・Front
・Side
・Back
・Diagonal front
・Diagonal back

Display 5 directions arranged horizontally.
Body proportions such as height, shoulder width, torso, waist, and leg length are all unified.

■ Facial Angles
・Front
・Diagonal 45 degrees
・Profile
・Diagonal upward
・Diagonal downward

Do not change facial bone structure or part placement; all as the same person.

■ Expressions
・Neutral
・Natural smile
・Serious
・Surprised
・Troubled expression

Only change expressions, do not change the person's face itself.

■ Hair Details
・Front
・Side
・Back

Make the hairline, parting, bangs, length, volume, and texture clearly visible.

■ Facial Parts
Close-up display of,
・Eyes
・Eyebrows
・Nose
・Mouth
・Ears
.

■ Skin
・Face skin close-up
・Body skin close-up

Maintain natural skin textures like pores and subtle color variations.
Plastic-like skin processing is prohibited.

■ Body Details
・Shoulders
・Abdomen
・Back
・Legs
・Hands

for display.
Hands or fingers adopt natural anatomical structures.

■ Common Clothing/Scenes
Place several reference examples of daily life scenes using this character at the bottom.
Example:
・Loungewear
・Casual wear
・Cafe
・Work/School outfit
・Travel

【Design】
High-quality professional character reference sheet.
Clean background with white to light beige as the base tone.
Organize items in a grid-like manner.
Attach short Japanese labels for each item.
The amount of information is large, but the layout should let readers understand at a glance where to look for what content.

【Photo Representation】
Photorealistic.
Texture as if taking a real adult woman with natural light.
Natural skin, natural hair, realistic body proportions.
Avoid excessive retouching, advertising-photo-like processing, and CG feel.

Top priority:
Rather than "making everything beautiful,"
prioritize "making all images in the sheet look like the same person."

items.title: 极简社论风旅行艺术海报设计

prompts.text:
Create a sophisticated minimalist editorial travel-art poster based on the provided reference photograph of [LANDMARK / COUNTRY ].

TOP SECTION — REAL PHOTOGRAPH:
Preserve the original photograph as faithfully as possible. Keep the exact subject, recognizable architecture or facial features, proportions, pose, clothing, surroundings, perspective, lighting, and important environmental details. Enhance it with a cinematic yet natural color grade, atmospheric depth, subtle film grain, and beautiful soft lighting. The photograph should feel authentic, premium, calm, and emotionally evocative.

BOTTOM SECTION — HAND-PAINTED MEMORY:
Recreate the same subject and scene as a delicate handcrafted watercolor and ink illustration. Preserve the recognizable silhouette, composition, proportions, and defining details, but simplify them into elegant artistic brushwork. Use loose watercolor washes, fine ink outlines, subtle paper texture, soft bleeding pigments, imperfect hand-painted edges, and minimal architectural/environmental details.

The illustrated version should feel like a beautiful travel sketch painted from memory, not a completely different scene. Keep the main subject immediately recognizable.

COMPOSITION:
Use a clean vertical 4:5 poster format with the realistic photograph occupying the upper portion and the watercolor interpretation occupying the lower portion. Separate the two sections with a subtle clean transition and generous warm ivory/off-white negative space.

BACKGROUND:
Warm textured handmade paper, subtle natural grain, minimal and uncluttered. Use a restrained color palette derived from the original photograph and the location.

TYPOGRAPHY:
Add small elegant handwritten/editorial typography beneath the illustration:

[SHORT PHRASE / POETIC LINE]
[CITY / COUNTRY / PERSON / PLACE]
[YEAR / COORDINATES / SHORT DESCRIPTION]

Typography should be tiny, refined, widely spaced, understated, and slightly imperfect like handwritten travel-journal lettering.

AESTHETIC: Recreate the landmark as a delicate architectural watercolor sketch, preserving its exact silhouette, proportions, distinctive structural details, surrounding landscape, and recognizable character.

prompts.text:
基于提供的 [地标 / 国家] 参考照片，创建一个精致的极简社论旅行艺术海报。

顶部区域 — 真实照片：
尽可能忠实地保留原始照片。保持完全相同的主体、可辨认的建筑或面部特征、比例、姿势、服装、环境、视角、光影和重要的环境细节。使用电影感且自然的调色、大气深度、细微的胶片颗粒和优美的柔光进行增强。照片应具有真实感、高级感、宁静感并能唤起情感。

底部区域 — 手绘记忆：
将相同的主体和场景重现为精致的手工水彩和墨水插画。保留可辨认的剪影、构图、比例和标志性细节，但将其简化为优雅的艺术笔触。使用松散的水彩晕染、细腻的墨水轮廓、细微的纸张纹理、柔和的颜料渗色、不完美的手绘边缘以及极简的建筑/环境细节。

插画版本应该感觉像是凭记忆画出的美丽旅行写生，而不是一个完全不同的场景。保持主体立即被辨认。

构图：
使用简洁的 4:5 垂直海报格式，真实照片占据上部，水彩诠释占据下部。用细微简洁的过渡和大量的暖象牙色/米白色留白将两个部分分开。

背景：
温暖的有纹理手工纸，细微的自然纹理，极简且整洁。使用源自原始照片和地点的克制色调。

排版：
在插图下方添加细小的优雅手写/社论排版：

[短语 / 诗句]
[城市 / 国家 / 人物 / 地点]
[年份 / 坐标 / 简短描述]

排版应细小、精致、间距宽阔、低调，并带有略微不完美的手写旅行日记字迹。

审美：将地标重现为精致的建筑水彩素描，保留其精确的轮廓、比例、独特的结构细节、周围景观和可辨认的特征。

人物留乌黑色超长直发，长度到腰部附近，中分偏自然，头发从肩膀两侧垂落。脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，肤色白皙，淡眼妆、自然睫毛、裸粉唇色，视线专注手机屏幕，表情安静冷淡。

身材为自然纤细偏轻沙漏型，肩部窄、腰部收束、髋部自然，大腿柔软匀称。人物坐姿是关键：臀部坐在浴缸边缘，双膝高高屈起贴近胸前，两条腿靠拢并略微前后交叠，形成蜷缩坐姿；上半身略前倾。

上身穿宽松黑色长袖针织开衫 / 毛衣，衣摆自然覆盖腰腹和臀部上缘，袖子偏长，手腕处有堆叠褶皱。下身穿黑色简洁贴身短裤 / 内搭短裤。

双腿穿烟黑色超薄透明连裤丝袜，约8–12D，明显透出自然肤色，腿部有轻微丝光，材质贴肤均匀，不要厚黑袜。

脚穿一双黑色漆皮细带尖头 / 露趾细高跟鞋，红色鞋底，鞋跟约9–11cm。一只鞋已经穿在脚上，另一只脚自然伸向前方；人物左手垂下，手里拎着另一只高跟鞋的细带 / 鞋跟，鞋子悬在画面左下位置，红色鞋底明显可见。

右手举一部黑色手机挡住部分脸部，通过镜子自拍。

场景为现代高档浴室：整体采用暖米色大理石 / 石纹瓷砖墙面和地面，人物身后是一只白色嵌入式浴缸，墙面安装极简银灰色金属毛巾架。空间干净，没有杂物，镜框仅在画面边缘隐约可见。

光线采用浴室暖白顶灯＋柔和环境光，肤色自然暖白，黑色针织物、透明丝袜与红底高跟鞋材质细节清楚。整体呈真实手机镜面自拍质感，轻微手机锐化和自然噪点，不要商业棚拍。

重点锁定：成年东亚女性＋超长黑直发＋浴缸边缘蜷缩坐姿＋双膝高收贴近胸前＋黑色宽松针织上衣＋黑色短裤＋烟黑超薄透明连裤丝袜＋黑色细高跟鞋＋红色鞋底＋一手举黑色手机自拍＋另一手拎一只高跟鞋＋暖米色大理石浴室。

避免：厚黑丝袜、裸腿、白袜、运动鞋、粗跟鞋、站姿、双腿伸直、短发、复杂浴室杂物、强闪光、过度磨皮、动漫脸、CG感、塑料皮肤、多余肢体、畸形鞋子、水印和乱码文字。

prompts.text:
Morning White Washroom | Kiss Face After Bath and Soft Morning Light

【Theme/Style】
Depicts an intimate moment of an adult woman drying her hair in her white washroom after a morning bath, noticing her lover in front of her and stopping to lean in slightly for a kiss face. Combines realistic lifestyle photography with an elegant photobook style, focusing on a natural sense of distance without over-acting. Integrates the freshness of the washroom, wet hair, soft expressions, and exquisite lingerie into an atmospheric feel. The exposure itself is not the protagonist; instead, it is like a candid daily photo capturing the morning tranquility and the intimacy between lovers.

【Location/Background/Worldview】
A bright and fresh private washroom dominated by white and light beige tones. In the background, there is a half-open bathroom door with faint lingering steam from the bath. The wall mirror is not fully fogged up, only slightly blurred at the edges due to moisture. The washstand is simply placed with a white soap dish, small skincare products, and folded towels, retaining a sense of daily life. Although the background is tidy, it is not sterile like a hotel, but allows one to feel the soft, homey atmosphere of actual residence.

【Season/Time/Weather】
A gentle morning like spring to early summer. The time is around 7:00 AM, and it is clear outside. Soft natural light through frosted glass fills the entire interior without strong direct sunlight. Because it is just after a bath, the room has a little moisture, and the air is slightly warm. The cool morning light from the window blends with the warm humidity from the bathroom side, creating an atmosphere where freshness and intimacy coexist.

【Character Setting】
Clearly a 24-year-old adult Japanese woman. A soft and dignified adult female face, slightly large black pupils, natural eyebrows, a refined nose bridge, and soft, rosy lips. The skin tone is a bright light apricot, with a faint post-bath flush remaining on the cheeks and ears. Dark brown shoulder-length hair is wet and falls naturally to one side. Slender shoulders and limbs, a thin waist, and a naturally plump physique harmonious with female curves. The chest is clearly large and full, but expressed with soft roundness following the posture and gravity, maintaining balance with the overall figure.

【Clothing/Accessories】
The outfit is an elegant Wacoal-style ivory bra and panties lingerie set. The chest is decorated with small flower embroidery in light apricot tones, and the edges are treated with delicate scalloped lace. The fabric is not too sheer and is a soft material with a refined luster. The bra naturally wraps the full chest in a realistic size and structure, with the cups and straps not stretching or tightening unnaturally. No accessories are worn, prioritizing the simplicity and freshness of being after a bath.

【Pose/Action/Gaze】
A natural standing posture with the body slightly diagonal to the camera and shoulders relaxed. Originally stopping the motion of wrapping the ends of the wet hair falling to one side with a small towel, that hand and towel are moved to the outside of the shoulder, not blocking the face or chest. The upper body leans slightly towards the lover, and the neck is tilted a bit. No extreme bending or leaning back poses are used. The gaze is fixed directly on the eyes of the lover slightly behind the camera, naturally expressing the moment of about to approach.

【Expression/Emotion】
The lips are small and softly pursed, with a shy and natural kiss face. Not just emphasizing the mouth, the corners of the eyes have a soft relaxation as if slightly holding back a smile. The eyebrows are relaxed, and the cheeks are slightly lifted. Not an actively seductive expression, but an intimate gesture suddenly shown in the close daily life of lovers. Even if slightly shy, a feeling of joy is naturally conveyed from the gaze and the color in the cheeks.

【Composition/Lens】
A 4:5 vertical composition suitable for X posts. A half-body composition focusing from the chest to the top of the head, with a little negative space at the top. Shot at close range, ensuring the face, mouth, wet hair, and embroidery on the upper part of the lingerie are clearly discernible. The camera position is almost at the same height as the woman's eye level. A natural perspective using a standard to medium telephoto lens is used, without exaggerating the face or chest with a wide angle. The background is only slightly blurred, retaining enough depth of field to identify the washstand, mirror, and bathroom door.

【Light/Color/Texture/Atmosphere】
The main light source is morning diffused light coming through a frosted glass window diagonally in front. The opposite white wall and washstand reflect soft light, naturally lifting the shadows on the face and neck. Extremely faint warm indoor light remains on the bathroom side, forming a subtle color temperature difference with the morning natural light. The skin retains pores, fine shadows, and natural blood color, with tiny water droplets after the bath glowing slightly on the neck and collarbone. The wet hair expresses a sense of clumps and fine stray hairs, and the embroidery and lace of the lingerie naturally depict the three-dimensional feel of the threads. Dominated by white, ivory, and light apricot, creating a fresh and soft morning color tone.

【Quality/Exclusion Elements】
High-resolution realistic photo. Focus on human body, light, material, depth of field, and perspective as if shot with a real camera. Avoid underage-looking characters, overly juvenile faces, unnatural human bodies, extra limbs or fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, unnatural joints or gestures, damaged clothing, body merging with clothing, accidental exposure, extreme wide-angle distortion, or excessive skin smoothing treatments. The chest maintains a full and natural volume, without unnatural enlargement, hard ball shapes, abnormal pushing up, or shapes defying gravity. No text, logos, watermarks, or UI displays are added within the image.

prompts.text:
早晨的白色洗面室｜浴后的吻脸与柔和晨光

【主题・画风】
描绘早晨洗浴后，在自家白色洗面室擦拭头发的成年女性注意到眼前的恋人，停下手来微微靠近脸庞的亲密瞬间。将写实的生活照片与优雅的摄影集风格相结合，注重不过度演出的自然距离感。

将洗面室的清爽感、湿润的头发、柔和的表情、精致的内衣融合成一种氛围感。不以暴露本身为主角，而是像偶然捕捉到早晨的宁静与恋人间的日常照片。

【地点・背景・世界观】
以白色和浅米色为主调的自家明亮清爽的洗面室。画面深处有半开的浴室门，其周围残留着洗浴后的淡淡水汽。墙面的镜子没有全面起雾，只有边缘部分因湿气而微微模糊。

洗面台上简约地放置着白色皂盒、小型护肤用品和折叠的毛巾，保留日常的生活气息。背景虽整洁，但不似酒店般无机质，而是让人感受到实际居住的家居柔和氛围。

【季节・时间・天气】
季节是春至初夏般的温和早晨。时间约为上午7点左右，室外晴朗。透过磨砂玻璃的柔和自然光洒满室内整体，没有强烈的直射阳光。

因刚洗浴完，室内带有少许湿气，空气略显温暖。窗户透入的清凉晨光与浴室一侧的温润湿度交融，营造出清新与亲密并存的氛围。

【人物设定】
明确为24岁的成年日本女性。柔和端庄的成年女性脸庞，略大的黑瞳、自然的眉毛、上品鼻梁、富有血色的柔软嘴唇。肤色为明亮的淡杏色，脸颊和耳边残留着洗浴后的淡淡红晕。

深棕色的及肩头发湿润着，自然地向一侧垂落。纤细的肩膀和四肢、细腰与女性曲线和谐的自然丰满体型。胸部明确较大且丰盈，但以顺应姿态和重力的柔和圆润表现，保持与整体身材的平衡。

【服装・配饰】
服装是优雅的Wacoal风格象牙色胸罩和内裤内衣套装。胸部饰以淡杏桃色调的小花刺绣，边缘施以细致的扇形蕾丝。面料不过于薄透，带有精致光泽的柔软材质。

胸罩以现实尺寸和结构自然包裹丰满胸部，罩杯和肩带不会不自然拉伸或勒紧。不佩戴配饰，优先体现浴后的朴素与清爽感。

【姿势・动作・视线】
身体面向镜头略微斜向，肩膀放松的自然站姿。本来用小毛巾包裹着向一侧垂落的湿发发梢时停下手，那只手和毛巾移向肩外侧，不遮挡脸部或胸部。

上半身微微向恋人方向靠近，脖子略微倾斜。不使用极端的俯身或后仰姿势。视线直直对准镜头稍深处恋人的眼睛，自然表现正要靠近的瞬间。

【表情・情感】
嘴唇小巧柔软地抿起，带有羞涩的自然吻脸。不只强调嘴部，眼角带有微微忍住笑意的柔和松弛。眉毛放松，脸颊也微微上扬。

不是主动诱惑的表情，而是恋人近距离日常中忽然展现的亲昵姿态。即使略带羞涩，也从视线和脸颊的血色中自然传达出喜悦的心情。

【构图・镜头】
X帖子适用的4:5竖长构图。以胸部至头顶为主的半身构图，头顶处留有少许余白。近距离拍摄，确保脸部、嘴部、湿发、内衣上部的刺绣清晰可辨。

镜头位置与女性视线高度几乎相同。使用标准至中长焦的自然视角，不以广角夸张脸部或胸部。背景仅轻微虚化，保留可辨识洗面台、镜子和浴室门的景深。

【光线・色彩・质感・氛围】
主光源为画面斜前方磨砂玻璃窗透入的晨间漫射光。对侧的白墙和洗面台反射出柔和光线，自然提升脸部和颈部的阴影。浴室一侧残留极淡的暖色室内光，与晨间自然光形成微妙的色温差异。

肌肤保留毛孔、细微阴影和自然血色，颈部和锁骨处带有洗浴后的细小水珠微微发光。湿发表现束感和细碎后发，内衣的刺绣和蕾丝自然描绘出线材的立体感。以白、象牙色、淡杏为主调，营造清爽柔和的晨间色调。

【品质・排除要素】
高分辨率的写实照片。注重如同真实相机拍摄的人体、光线、材质、景深和远近感。

避免看起来未成年的人物、过于幼嫩的脸庞、不自然的人体、多余的手脚或手指、缺失手指、融合手指、不自然的关节或手势、服装破损、身体与服装融合、意外暴露、极端广角扭曲、过度美肌处理。胸部维持丰满自然的体积，不做不自然的巨大化、硬球状、异常上推、违背重力的形状。图像内不添加文字、标志、水印、UI显示。

items.title: 鹿鼎记群芳夜宴清代工笔人物群像

prompts.text:
"The Deer and the Cauldron: Banquet of Beauties" × "The Last Supper" 8-person classic group composition × Only borrowing the horizontal group structure × Approximately 1.9:1 wide aspect ratio × 3 people on the left of the screen: Su Quan, Shuang'er, A Ke × Center: Wei Xiaobao × 4 people on the right of the screen: Princess Jianning, Fang Yi, Mu Jianping, Zeng Rou × Horizontal long table banquet × Qing Dynasty imperial court Gongbi figure painting

Explanation:
"The Last Supper" classic group composition only borrows the composition relationship of the central figure, left and right grouping, horizontal long table, and figures unfolding around the table.
The screen strictly maintains 3 people on the left + 1 person in the center + 4 people on the right, total 8 people.
Wei Xiaobao is located in the exact center of the screen, serving as the visual and narrative core of the entire painting.
The left side in order: Su Quan, Shuang'er, A Ke; the right side in order: Princess Jianning, Fang Yi, Mu Jianping, Zeng Rou.
All 8 people are clearly visible, with no addition or reduction of figures, no disruption of left-right order, and no scattering of figures to other areas.
All figures form a complete, continuous horizontal group portrait along the sides of the long table, with natural interaction and expression exchange between each other, presenting a lively yet subtle character relationship.
Only the horizontal group structure of "The Last Supper" is borrowed; no Western religious figures, religious symbols, or religious scene elements appear.
The story, characters, clothing, utensils, space, and painting language all adopt the Chinese classical context of "The Deer and the Cauldron".
The overall scene is set as a magnificent Qing Dynasty night banquet: Chinese wine vessels, porcelain plates, snacks, fruits, and banquet dishes are placed on the long table. The background can be a prince's mansion inner hall or a gorgeous classical hall, accompanied by elements such as screens, palace lanterns, brocade curtains, and carved wood structures.
Character costumes are in the style of Qing Dynasty nobles and ladies, taking into account the different temperaments of the seven wives:
Su Quan: Mature, elegant, calm aura
Shuang'er: Gentle, loyal, delicate and considerate
A Ke: Cold and glamorous, outstanding, stunning appearance
Princess Jianning: Arrogant and willful, lively, vivid expression
Fang Yi: Beautiful, intelligent, slightly reserved
Mu Jianping: Fragile, innocent, a bit shy
Zeng Rou: Quiet, gentle, elegant and subtle
The painting style adopts Qing Dynasty imperial court Gongbi figure painting, with delicate line drawing, elegant and rich coloring, beautiful and clear facial features, exquisite clothing patterns, and an overall sense of order and banquet atmosphere like a Chinese classical group portrait handscroll.

prompts.text:

说明：
“《最后的晚餐》经典群像构图”仅借用其中央人物、左右分组、横向长桌、人物围桌展开的构图关系。
画面严格保持左侧3人＋中央1人＋右侧4人，共8人。
 韦小宝位于画面正中央，作为全画视觉与叙事核心。
左侧依次为：苏荃、双儿、阿珂；右侧依次为：建宁公主、方怡、沐剑屏、曾柔。
8人全部清晰可见，不增减人物，不打乱左右顺序，不将人物分散到其他区域。
所有人物沿长桌两侧形成完整、连贯的横向群像，彼此之间有自然互动与表情交流，呈现热闹而微妙的人物关系。
仅借用《最后的晚餐》的横向群像结构，不出现任何西方宗教人物、宗教符号或宗教场景元素。
故事、人物、服饰、器物、空间与绘画语言均采用《鹿鼎记》的中国古典语境。
整体场景设定为清代华丽夜宴：长桌上摆放中式酒器、瓷盘、点心、果品与宴席菜肴，背景可为王府内厅或华美古典厅堂，配以屏风、宫灯、锦帐、雕花木构等元素。
人物服饰为清代贵族与闺阁风格，兼顾七位夫人各自不同气质：
苏荃：成熟、端丽、气场沉稳
双儿：温柔、忠顺、清秀体贴
阿珂：冷艳、出众、姿容绝美
建宁公主：娇蛮、灵动、神情鲜活
方怡：秀丽、聪慧、略带矜持

沐剑屏：柔弱、纯真、带些羞怯
曾柔：娴静、温婉、清雅含蓄
画风采用清代宫廷工笔人物画，线描细腻，设色雅致而富丽，人物面容秀美清晰，服饰纹样精致，整体具有中国古典群像长卷般的秩序感与宴饮氛围。

A young adult Oriental woman wearing soft white and light cyan long robes stands at a distance by the stream, her silhouette clear but not overly sharp. Her long hair and thin sleeves are lifted by the extremely soft morning breeze, the edges dyed into a faint milky white halo by backlighting.

Sunlight penetrates multiple layers of mist from the distance of the valley, forming extremely soft pale gold volumetric light. Colors naturally blend with milky white, light cyan-green, soft peach pink, light indigo-green, and extremely pale warm gold; do not use a uniform pink filter, do not use high-saturation hard color blocks, not dark, not heavy.

items.title: 新野蛮主义风格双拼重构插画

prompts.text:
Create a complete vertical split-style illustration, with the vertical canvas clearly divided into top and bottom sections, each occupying 1:1. The overall piece presents a split-screen work of "Uploaded Original Subject + Neo-Brutalism Flat Reconstruction," where the top and bottom sections must maintain a strong correlation with the same subject.

Upper section:
Use the uploaded original image as the sole source of subject reference, automatically identifying people, cats, dogs, or other common pets. Focus on extracting the subject itself, without treating buildings or complex environments as the main expressive objects. Retain the person's face shape, features, hairstyle, clothing, sense of age, and accessories, or the pet's fur color, patterns, ears, face shape, body type, and other identifying information. The background is simplified, the subject is complete and clear, and the composition is stable.

Lower section:
Transform the same subject into a complete illustration in the "Neo Brutalism" visual language. Core style features: Accurately extract the most typical lines, colors, composition, and material language of this style, maintaining unity without mixing with other styles. General principles: Adopt clear geometric structures, flat color blocks, and ordered compositions, controlling hierarchy and negative space. The composition uses a single clear subject or one clear scene, the visual center is stable, the subject is complete and not cropped, and the background is moderately simplified while retaining a sense of breathing room; lines, color blocks, light and shadow, materials, and paper textures must serve the same style, without mixing in unrelated art styles. The lower section should reflect the common high-saturation solid colors, strong outlines, hard edges, simplified and direct graphic language of Neo Brutalism, along with a bit of the conflict and humor of digital-age graphic design, allowing the subject to be redefined within the Neo-Brutalism system. The image should be natural, have a handmade feel, and recognizable style characteristics, avoiding the excessive smoothness, meaningless accumulation of details, and random decorations common in AI.

Overall requirements:
The top and bottom sections must maintain the consistency of the same subject; the bottom section is a Neo-Brutalism design version of the subject in the top section. Unless clearly required by the theme, do not generate text, logos, watermarks, borders, UIs, and do not perform multi-image stitching.

上半部分：
以上传原图作为唯一主体参考来源，自动识别人物、猫、狗或其他常见宠物，重点提取主体本身，不把建筑和复杂环境作为主要表现对象。保留人物的脸型、五官、发型、服饰、年龄感和配饰，或宠物的毛色、花纹、耳朵、脸型、体型等识别信息。背景简化处理，主体完整清晰，构图稳定。
下半部分：
将同一个主体转化为「Neo Brutalism 新野蛮主义」视觉语言的完整插画。核心风格特征：准确提取该风格最典型的线条、色彩、构成与材质语言，保持统一，不与其他风格混杂。整体原则：采用清晰的几何结构、平面块面与秩序化构图，控制层级和留白。构图采用单一明确主体或一个清晰场景，视觉中心稳定，主体完整不被裁断，背景适度简化并保留呼吸感；线条、色块、明暗、材质和纸面纹理必须服务于同一风格，不混入无关画风。下半部分应体现 Neo Brutalism 常见的高饱和纯色、强轮廓、硬朗边界、简化而直接的图形语言，以及带一点数字时代平面设计感的冲突与幽默，让主体在新野蛮主义体系中被重新定义。画面自然、有手作感和可识别的风格特征，避免 AI 常见的过度光滑、无意义细节堆砌和随机装饰。
整体要求：
上下两部分必须保持同一主体的一致性，下半部分是上半部分主体的新野蛮主义设计化版本。除非主题明确要求，否则不生成文字、Logo、水印、边框、UI，不做多图拼接。

items.title: 怀旧日系微缩故事书剪贴簿拼图

prompts.text:
Use the uploaded photo as the exact visual reference and transform it into a nostalgic editorial scrapbook-style artwork. Preserve the subjects, composition, clothing, poses, objects, and overall scene from the original photo.

Create a vertical 3:4 composition with a refined, minimalist Japanese-inspired photo-to-illustration aesthetic.

The final design should be divided into two equal horizontal sections:

TOP HALF — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH
•Place the uploaded original photograph in the upper 50% of the canvas.
•Keep it photorealistic and completely unchanged.
•Preserve the exact facial features, body proportions, clothing, hairstyle, pose, lighting, environment, furniture, food, blanket, window, and all other recognizable details.
•Do not crop important subjects.
•Use the original image naturally, with clean edges and no artificial frame.

BOTTOM HALF — MINIATURE STORYBOOK VERSION
•Recreate the exact same scene from the photograph as a small, delicate hand-painted illustration positioned around the center of the lower half.
•Keep the same subjects, poses, clothing, objects, perspective, and recognizable composition, but make the entire scene appear like a tiny nostalgic illustration placed on paper.
•Use a soft watercolor + colored-pencil + subtle gouache aesthetic.
•Delicate imperfect brushwork, lightly textured edges, soft shadows, muted natural colors, slightly faded vintage appearance.
•The miniature scene should occupy only about 25–35% of the lower section, leaving generous negative space around it.
•Make it feel like a tiny memory captured on paper rather than a conventional full-frame illustration.
•Add a very subtle hand-drawn shadow underneath the miniature scene to make it feel naturally placed on the paper.

BACKGROUND
•Cover the entire bottom half with warm off-white / ivory handmade paper.
•Visible fine paper fibers and subtle grain.
•Slightly uneven organic texture, similar to premium watercolor paper.
•Minimal, warm, calm and elegant.
•No borders, no decorative patterns, no unnecessary elements.

TEXT
•Beneath the miniature illustration, add a very small handwritten phrase:
“sunny days”
•Use thin, delicate, lowercase handwritten script.
•Light gray/taupe ink.
•Keep the text subtle and understated, centered beneath the artwork.

LIGHTING & COLOR
•Warm natural daylight.
•Soft cream, beige, pale blue, muted denim blue and warm brown tones.
•Gentle highlights and soft shadows.
•Slightly nostalgic film-inspired color grading.
•Avoid oversaturation.
•Overall mood: quiet, cozy, sentimental, peaceful family memory.

IMPORTANT
•Maintain the identity and visual characteristics of the people from the reference photo.
•Do not invent additional people or objects.
•Do not change clothing or poses.
•Do not distort anatomy.
•The miniature illustration must clearly depict the same exact moment and scene as the original photograph.
•Clean premium editorial composition.
•High detail, sophisticated art direction, realistic paper texture, subtle handcrafted imperfections.
•No extra text, no frame, no logo, no watermark.

prompts.text:

最终设计应分为两个相等的水平部分：

上半部分 —— 原始照片

下半部分 —— 微缩故事书版本

背景

•可见的细微纸张纤维和微妙的纹理。

文字

光影与色彩

prompts.text:
Hyper-realistic office low-angle portrait photography, vertical aspect ratio approximately 2:3. A clearly adult East Asian female, 25+, professional style outfit, sitting on a modern office black rolling chair, the camera is almost touching the wooden floor, using a 20–24mm ultra-wide-angle lens to shoot from a very low angle directly in front, creating a very strong near-large far-small perspective. The face shape is oval-ish, skin tone is naturally fair, makeup is clean and restrained: thin eyeliner, natural eyelashes, light pink blush, nude pink lip color. Pose focus: The character sits on the front edge of the office chair, legs crossed, one leg extending significantly towards the camera from in front of the other leg, knees and calves forming a strong perspective; the foot near the lens is significantly enlarged by the wide angle, but maintains realistic human structure. The other foot rests on the floor further back, creating a front-to-back layering.

Top wears a white long-sleeved shirt + dark navy blue slim-fit suit vest. The white shirt has a standard lapel, sleeves fit well; a light blue satin large bow tie / bow tie is tied at the neckline, with a slight silk luster. The outer dark blue vest has a formal business uniform feel, with narrow vertical stripes or subtle patterns, double-breasted or multiple dark buttons, obvious waist narrowing.

Legs are bare or in extremely thin natural skin-toned stockings, overall almost no obvious stocking color visible, only retaining a slight silky texture and uniform skin tone.

Feet wear black leather pointed-toe stiletto high heels, the upper is slightly matte / semi-bright leather, narrow and long toe, about 7–9cm thin heel. The toe and forefoot of the shoe closest to the lens occupy the lower part of the frame in a huge close-up, the sole slightly facing the camera, forming an obvious exaggerated perspective; the other high heel appears fully on the wooden floor behind.

The character's left hand is near the desktop or the side of the body, the right hand naturally holds the chair / desk edge, the posture looks like a low-angle snapshot taken when sitting down casually in the office.

The floor is light brown wood grain flooring, with a small amount of realistic wear, stains, and tiny debris. Background walls and office furniture are mainly white and light gray.

The white office ceiling and long cold white fluorescent lamps / LED light panels are visible at the top, forming a clear low-angle sense of space.

Lighting uses office cold white ceiling lights + natural ambient light, the character's face and white shirt are bright, the dark blue uniform retains details, and the high heels produce soft reflections. No studio lighting overall.

Overall presents a high-quality mobile phone / mirrorless camera low-angle snapshot texture: slight wide-angle distortion, natural sharpness, medium depth of field, realistic skin texture, low-saturation business color tones.

prompts.text:

prompts.text:

prompts.text:
Portrait reference: [upload one portrait]
Main palette: [butter yellow / custom]
Accent color: [deep cocoa brown / custom]

Use the uploaded portrait to create four separate fashion-editorial portrait posters from the same visual system. Keep the same person, facial identity, hairstyle, outfit direction, photographic realism, color palette, typography family, and overall art direction across all four images.

Use a bright, low-saturation editorial palette: soft butter yellow as the dominant background, warm ivory and cream as supporting tones, and deep cocoa brown for oversized typography. Keep the image luminous, soft, refined, and visually striking rather than highly saturated.

Create these four layout variations:

1. MIRROR
   Show the same portrait twice, with one normal portrait and one enlarged 180° flipped portrait entering from the opposite side. Add oversized horizontal typography with a subtle outline echo. Let the portraits and letters overlap naturally.

2. TRACE
   Use a large warm-toned close-up portrait on one side and a smaller full-color portrait on the other. Place oversized condensed typography vertically between them as a strong visual spine, with letters moving in front of and behind the subject.

3. GLOW
   Use huge condensed typography as the dominant composition. Place the portrait behind the letters so the eyes, lips, hair, and shoulders appear through and between the letterforms. The subject should feel integrated into the type rather than simply covered by it.

4. DRIFT
   Slice the portrait into several clean horizontal photographic sections and slightly shift them left and right. Keep the face recognizable and attractive while allowing the hair and facial features to create a soft drifting motion. Avoid digital glitch effects.

Maintain realistic skin texture, natural hair strands, believable fabric folds, soft fashion photography lighting, and a refined magazine-editorial finish.

Use oversized condensed sans-serif typography, meaningful small editorial copy, thin rules, small geometric blocks, and controlled negative space. Keep the hierarchy clear: portrait and oversized typography first, supporting text second.

All four posters should feel visually related but clearly use different composition systems.

Full-bleed design only. Do not add an outer border, poster frame, white margin, NO., VOL., numbering, barcode, sparkle symbols, random placeholder text, complex UI elements, RGB glitches, or decorative clutter.

Generate the four posters as separate standalone 9:16 images, not combined into one collage.

prompts.text:
Create a photorealistic contemporary fashion photograph of a clearly adult East Asian woman crossing a quiet, sunlit room with dark wooden floorboards. Capture the instant she turns toward the window after feeling the morning light reach her face, one foot still in motion and her attention directed outside the frame. Her expression is calm and momentarily absorbed, with relaxed lips and slightly narrowed eyes responding naturally to the brightness.

She has a softly elongated oval face, gentle full cheeks, a smooth tapered jawline, a small rounded chin, and fair light neutral-warm skin with visible pores and subtle natural asymmetry. Her medium almond-shaped dark eyes have subtly raised outer corners beneath straight, moderately thick dark eyebrows. She has a slender straight nose with a delicate rounded tip and medium-small natural lips with a slightly fuller lower lip. Her physique is distinctly slender, narrow, and elongated, with a long slender neck, narrow ribcage and torso, defined natural waist, gently wider hips, and long lean limbs. Her dark hair falls loosely around her shoulders with a few naturally displaced strands.

She wears a white spaghetti-strap lace cotton mini dress with delicate lace trim and a short hem. Preserve the dress exactly as specified, showing the tactile woven cotton, fine lace pattern, narrow straps, natural folds, and subtle movement produced by her turning step. She is barefoot and wears no jewelry or additional accessories.

Photograph her from a pronounced high oblique angle, with the camera positioned near one upper corner of the room and aimed diagonally across the floor rather than directly overhead. Use a 35mm lens at moderate distance for a full-body composition that preserves believable proportions while allowing the diagonal floorboards, elongated window shadows, and direction of her movement to create a strong visual path. Place her below center with open space extending toward the window side of the frame; keep her face clearly readable despite the elevated viewpoint.

Hard but clean morning sunlight enters from outside the frame, forming an angular band of light across her face, shoulders, white dress, and the dark floor. Maintain controlled highlight detail in the fabric, soft reflected fill in the shadows, realistic skin texture, and moderately deep focus. Natural photographic color, restrained contrast, subtle fine grain, believable anatomy, real fabric physics, and no artificial skin smoothing. No additional people, fantasy elements, wings, supernatural effects, typography, captions, slogans, decorative text, or watermarks.
Aspect ratio: 4:5

prompts.text:
Hyper-realistic indoor flash portrait photography, vertical orientation approximately 9:16. An explicitly adult East Asian female, 20+, sitting sideways on a minimalist gray fabric sofa, the photographer is positioned directly in front of the subject and slightly elevated, using an approximately 28–35mm lens + on-camera direct flash, capturing the full head, body, legs, and high heels. The subject is located in the center-left of the frame, with legs extended horizontally, occupying the middle and lower parts of the image.

The subject has a naturally plump, hourglass-leaning figure: moderate shoulders, full bust, significantly cinched waist, rounded hips, soft and full upper thighs, and long, well-proportioned legs. Not overly thin, and no athletic muscularity.

The subject is sitting diagonally on the left side of the sofa, the upper body leaning slightly back, the left leg bent at the knee and placed horizontally on the sofa cushion, the right leg extended significantly from under the body toward the right side of the frame, with the legs forming a cross-over structure. The right foot extends to the bottom right corner of the frame, and the left foot is near the body. The left hand is lightly resting on the sofa armrest/side, and the right hand is placed near the bent leg, in a relaxed and natural posture.

The subject has jet-black ultra-long wavy hair, reaching near the waist, with thick hair volume and a slightly fluffy top; the forehead has a center-parted curtain fringe and fine stray hairs, with hair on both sides naturally falling over the chest. The face shape is small and oval-leaning, with fair skin and exquisite makeup: thin black eyeliner, natural long eyelashes, pale pink blush, and rosy nude lip makeup. Both eyes look directly at the camera, corners of the mouth slightly upturned, with a calm and soft expression.

The upper body wears a black lace corset top with a clear cup structure, translucent lace paneling, vertical boning lines, and a waist-cinching design, with thin shoulder straps and a waist that fits tightly to the body. The lower body wears black high-cut tight-fitting shorts / ultra-short leather or satin bottoms, unified with the top in an all-black look, maintaining complete normal coverage.

The legs are wearing high-gloss smoky black ultra-thin sheer pantyhose, approximately 8–12D, clearly showing the real skin tone, the surface of the stockings is smooth and skin-tight, forming very obvious silver-white longitudinal reflective highlights on the thighs, knees, calves, and insteps after the flash, which is an important feature of the image. No thick black stockings, matte stockings, or fishnets.

Wearing black glossy pointed-toe stiletto high heels, patent leather material, long and narrow toe, stiletto heel about 9–11cm; the right high heel extends to the bottom right of the frame, with a slight red / dark red sole edge, the left shoe is near the leg overlap.

The scene is a minimalist modern interior: a medium gray fabric two-seater sofa against a light grayish-white micro-cement wall, the wall has very slight cracks and rough textures; the floor is dark brown old wooden flooring, retaining wear, scratches, and wood grain. Part of a black large pendant lamp shade is visible in the upper left corner, forming a distinct black geometric foreground.

The lighting uses a front on-camera flash + weak indoor ambient light. The subject's skin, stockings, and black patent leather shoes are significantly brightened by the direct flash, with light shadows appearing on the wall behind; the background is overall dark gray, with clear silhouettes of the subject. Retain the high contrast, slight overexposure, and local reflections of real flash photography.

The overall texture is like 2000s digital camera / nighttime indoor direct flash portraits: natural skin texture, real pores, slight grain, limited dynamic range, low saturation cool gray tones, no commercial studio feel.

Key locks: Adult East Asian female + ultra-long black wavy hair + black lace corset top + black high-cut short bottoms + high-gloss smoky black ultra-thin sheer stockings + black pointed-toe stiletto heels + gray fabric sofa sitting diagonally + one leg bent and placed horizontally, one leg extended significantly to the right + on-camera direct flash + stockings with obvious silver-white highlights + light gray wall + dark old wooden floor.

Avoid: Thick black stockings, fishnets, bare legs, long pants, long skirts, sneakers, chunky heels, standing posture, legs together, short hair, colored clothing, luxurious interior, soft light studio shooting, strong background blur, anime face, CG feel, plastic skin, extra limbs, deformed feet, watermarks and garbled text.

prompts.text:
Theme:
Purple Mist Gramophone

Subject:
Vertical 3:4, an evening Japanese-style apartment living room, a woman sits sideways in front of a low walnut record cabinet by the window, body facing the left side of the frame, using her right hand to gently lower the vinyl needle onto the spinning record, left hand supporting the cabinet edge, her gaze fixed on the point where the needle and record are about to touch. The subject is located in the center slightly to the right, with the framing extending from the top of the head to the mid-thigh; the lower left corner of the frame is obscured by a blurred record sleeve forming a foreground, and the record player and hand movements constitute a clear narrative center.

Character · Expression:
Stunningly beautiful 23-year-old East Asian beauty, stylish, confident, and gentle temperament;
Well-proportioned and voluptuous figure, breasts are naturally and visibly full, visually about D to E cup, with a natural sense of weight and soft rounded contours, a clear but not exaggerated waist-to-chest difference, no prosthetic feel; slender waist, forming a clear but natural proportional contrast with the full chest;
Exquisite and natural oval face with soft bone structure, ivory white skin with a faint pink flush, retaining subtle pores and real soft light on the tip of the nose and cheekbones. Bright milk tea grey-brown medium-length hair falls over the shoulders, thin air bangs lightly cover the forehead, layers around the face and inner-curling hair ends scatter naturally, with a few fine stray hairs illuminated by the window light. Champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long thin eyelashes, natural tear bags and small clear eye lights, light rose blush, translucent pink-beige lips. Her chin is slightly tucked, corners of her mouth relaxed, expression quiet and focused, gaze clearly falling on the tip of the stylus.

Clothing · Pose:
Upper body wears a loose sheer top in a color between low-saturation lavender purple and grey-purple, the deep V-neck drapes naturally, and the shoulder lines on both sides slide down loosely to form a restrained off-shoulder style; semi-transparent light chiffon sleeves reach near the elbows, forming soft and irregular natural folds at the neck, upper arms, and elbow bends, the sheer fabric transmits light but maintains real textile layers. Lower body wears a dark grey-black slim-fit mini skirt, the waistline fits the slender waist, and the sitting posture creates slight horizontal tension and small wrinkles on the skirt surface at the hips. Legs are naturally pressed together diagonally toward the bottom left of the frame, staggered one in front of the other, wearing smoky black 10–15D ultra-thin semi-transparent tights, high transparency clearly reveals natural skin tone, the surface is even and delicate, showing only a very faint smoky grey luster at the knees and thighs where light hits. She rests her center of gravity on her right hip, her right arm extends toward the record player, her right thumb and index finger lightly pinch the front of the tonearm and control the moment the needle is about to touch the record, wrist relaxed; left palm lightly rests on the cabinet edge to stabilize the body.

Background · Light:
The foreground is a corner of an out-of-focus off-white record sleeve, the middle ground retains the walnut record cabinet, black record player, and a small stack of vertically placed records, the background consists only of a rice-grey wall and softly blurred linen curtains on the right, objects are restrained with traces of life. The evening natural light from the window at the top right acts as the sole main light, the neutral soft light first falls on the side of the face, bare shoulder line, collarbone, and right hand, then passes through the purple-grey sheer gauze to show chiffon layers; shadows extend softly toward the bottom left. The light-colored wall provides extremely weak neutral fill, so that the dark grey-black short skirt and smoky black tights still retain layers without becoming dead black.

Composition · Camera:
Equivalent 50mm lens, eye level at chest height slightly downward, the focal plane covers the subject's near-side pupil, right finger tips, and the contact point of the stylus, the background is softened with a shallow depth of field but the record player's silhouette is discernible. The character occupies about 68% of the frame, the right shoulder and arm form a diagonal line with the tonearm extending to the bottom left, leaving space on the left for her gaze and actions; a small amount of breathing room is kept at the top of the head, the bottom edge of the frame naturally cuts at the mid-thigh, and the foreground sleeve in the lower left enhances the candid feel and depth.

Texture · Style:
Japanese beauty magazine-style indoor lifestyle photography, low contrast, low saturation lavender grey, smoky black, and walnut tones, with subtle soft film grain. Emphasis on expressing the semi-transparent layers of chiffon, real skin texture of the neck and shoulders, the natural skin tone looming under ultra-thin tights, and the subtle reflections on wood grain and vinyl surfaces.

Negative:
Underage or mature middle-aged feel, drifting facial features, wrong or floating contact between needle and record, finger clipping and joint errors, sheer gauze turning into opaque thick cloth, tights too black/not transparent or producing a latex texture, skirt exposure, plastic skin, readable gibberish text or watermarks.

prompts.text:
一位25岁的成年东亚女性，容貌极为出众。成熟冷艳，兼具东方美人的精致与持剑角色的英气。小巧流畅的鹅蛋脸，下颌线清晰柔和，修长的眉毛，明亮深邃的眼睛，眼尾略微上挑，鼻梁秀挺，唇形饱满精致。淡淡的冷调妆容，神情自信而专注，目光凌厉，不刻意微笑。皮肤白皙细腻，保留自然的皮肤纹理，避免塑料感和过度磨皮。乌黑长发扎成利落的高马尾，发尾自然垂落，额面与脸颊留少量碎发丝，露出清晰的眉眼、颈部与肩部线条。身材高挑修长，肩颈舒展，腰部纤细，胸腰臀比例鲜明，胸部与臀部曲线自然饱满，双腿修长匀称，具有轻微的肌肉线条。整体优美、健康、有力量感，不夸张放大身体部位。身穿墨黑色修身高开衩旗袍，无袖剪裁，精致的小立领，传统斜襟与盘扣，领缘及斜襟使用极细的暗金色滚边。面料带低对比度的精细暗花，近看可见纹样，远看保持简约。采用有真实厚度与柔和光泽的丝缎面料，不透明，不呈现乳胶或塑料般的反光。旗袍裾裾胸、腰、胯的自然轮廓立体裁剪；胸部合体，腰线明显内收，腰腹贴合但不过分紧绷，胯部顺着身体自然线展开，清晰勾勒纤细腰身与流畅的腰胯过渡。衣料随抬臂与迈腿动作产生合理的牵拉和细小褶皱，不像直接涂在皮肤上。裙身为长款，下摆延伸至小腿下段。在画面右侧、向前迈出的这条腿对应的位置设置圆开衩，开衩从大腿中上段向下延伸至裙摆。随着迈腿向画面右侧迈出，两侧裙片自然分开，露出这条腿的大腿、膝盖及小腿线条；布料沿裙部两侧垂落，形成深色旗袍与白皙腿部的鲜明对比。开衩位于侧面，不在正面中央，前后裙片保持完整，侧裙腿适当被裙身遮挡，保留清楚的前后层次。双手佩戴黑色贴身半指手套，柔软皮革与弹力布拼接，包裹手掌、手背和手指根部，五根手指的前半截及指尖露出。指根开口清晰，腕部有窄款固定绑带。握剑时能够看见真实的指节弯曲、手指用力的皮肉褶皱，不变成长款全指手套。脚穿简洁的黑色系带短靴，不增加繁杂装饰。动作沿用前面修正后的持剑姿势：正面朝向，躯干作为整体倾斜，胯部相对胸廓向画面左侧偏移，不扭转、不折腰。身材曲线通过自然人体轮廓与旗袍的收腰剪裁体现，不依靠夸张扭胯或反弓姿势。电影级真人写实风格，自然的人体比例，真实的五官、皮肤、发丝与服装材质，人物清晰，光影富有层次。
【整体姿势与镜头】
竖幅构图。人物呈扭身架剑、准备挥击的蓄力姿态。镜头位于人物前上方，以近距离广角视角向下俯拍，形成明显的近大远小透视。高举的握剑手和剑柄最靠近镜头，位于画面上半部；头部、胸腹和双腿依次向画面下方及纵深延伸。不是平视，也不是从下往上的仰拍。
【前景握剑手与手指】
高举的手位于头部左上方，向镜头前伸，透视明显放大，尺寸接近或略大于头部，明显大于下方另一只手。手掌牢牢包住剑柄，虎口贴住柄体。食指、中指、无名指、小指依次弯曲环握，四指蜷曲的轮廓在握柄上清晰可见；拇指从另一侧扣住剑柄，与四指形成闭合握持。手指关节有明确弯折，不能张开手掌，也不能只用指尖捏住武器。手腕略微转折，与斜向上伸来的前臂衔接。
【高举的手臂与手肘】
这条手臂从画面右侧肩膀抬起。上臂由肩膀斜向右上方伸展，肘部向画面右侧外撑，明显高于肩膀，大致处于额头高度。手肘保持明显弯曲，肘尖朝外、不伸直。前臂从右侧肘部斜向左上方折回，同时向镜头前方伸出，连接头部左上方的巨大握剑手。整条手臂在头部上方形成宽大的折角拱形，脸部从手臂下方完整露出，不被遮挡。
【另一只手、手臂与颈部】
另一条手臂位于画面左侧，上臂从肩膀斜向左下方伸出，略微离开躯干。肘部弯曲，肘尖朝下，前臂再向左侧略向上回折。手停在人物左侧下胸至上腹部高度，手指弯曲，扶握住一把武器更下方的位置。按参考图，这只手处于剑身中段附近，而不是与上方的手挤在一起握住短剑柄。上下两只手之间保持明显距离，下方手的透视尺寸较小。
【脑袋、面部与颈部】
头部轻微向画面左侧倾斜，低头、下巴内收，头顶朝向前上方镜头。脸部稍向画面左侧转动，眼睛从低头姿态中抬起，看向镜头方向，形成专注、凌厉的目光。颈部随身自然扭转，不仰头，不把下巴向前伸，也不是端正笔直的证件照姿态。
【肩膀、身体、腰部与骨盆】
肩膀、胸腔、腰部和骨盆保持一致的正面朝向，整个躯干像一整块向侧面倾斜，没有胸腔与骨盆之间的相对扭转，也没有腰部弯折或明显的S形曲线。胯部相对胸腔向画面左侧偏移，因此躯干从胯部到肩膀呈现由画面左下方斜向右上方的整体倾斜。胸口到腹部的中线近似保持一条斜直线。腰部只是顺着躯干连接胸腔与骨盆，不单独扭转、不折腰、不反弓。整体效果是正面歪着站，而不是扭身蓄力。画面右侧肩膀随高举的手臂略微抬高，画面左侧肩膀相对较低，保留举臂带来的肩线高低差，但不因此改变胸腔、腹部和骨盆的正面朝向。不出现胸口朝前、腰部转向侧面的姿态。其余动作保持不变：前上方俯拍，前景握剑手透视放大，高举手臂向外撑肘后折回，头部微低，双腿一前一后错开。

items.title: 高端未来感超跑时尚商业海报

prompts.text:
Create a premium futuristic automotive editorial poster featuring a high-performance sports car, designed in the same visual language as a luxury car campaign and modern streetwear graphic poster.
FORMAT:
Vertical 4:5 portrait composition, ultra-high resolution, highly polished commercial artwork. Use a dramatic rotated composition where the car and environment create strong diagonal movement. The image should feel intentionally designed like a premium automotive poster, not like a normal photograph.
CAR:
A sleek exotic supercar viewed from a dramatic high-angle top-down perspective, with the entire vehicle clearly visible. Aggressive aerodynamic bodywork, sharp LED headlights, sculpted panels, detailed wheels, low stance, realistic tires, glossy paint, precise reflections and realistic materials. The car should be the main focal point.
VISUAL STYLE:
Blend photorealistic automotive design with sophisticated digital illustration. Extremely clean edges, simplified geometric surfaces, subtle cel-shading, controlled gradients, crisp highlights, realistic reflections, detailed mechanical elements, and slightly stylized architectural forms. Premium fashion-editorial poster aesthetic.
ENVIRONMENT:
Dark futuristic city architecture viewed from above, black asphalt, geometric buildings, glass surfaces, road markings, cables, windows, structural lines and subtle reflections. Keep the environment mostly black and charcoal so the vehicle stands out strongly.
COLOR PALETTE:
Use a strict two-tone palette: deep black and charcoal as the base, with one strong accent color such as electric orange, neon yellow, hot pink, cyan, or red. The accent color should appear on the car, road markings, architectural details and selected graphic elements.
GRAPHIC DESIGN:
Add huge bold condensed typography integrated into the environment behind the car. The typography should be partially hidden by the vehicle, creating depth. Use oversized white or light-gray letters with clean geometric forms. Add thin technical lines, subtle grids, minimal racing-inspired markings and abstract graphic shapes.
LIGHTING:
Dramatic directional lighting, strong rim lighting around the car, subtle neon reflections, deep shadows, controlled highlights and cinematic contrast. No excessive glow.
COMPOSITION:
Keep the car large and dominant in the frame. Use negative space around it, strong diagonal lines and architectural perspective. Make the composition feel like a professionally designed automotive campaign poster.
QUALITY:
Extremely detailed, sharp, clean, premium, sophisticated, realistic materials, polished surfaces, precise geometry, high-end automotive advertising, editorial art direction, 8K quality.
IMPORTANT:
No people, no random objects, no clutter, no excessive text, no distorted car proportions, no extra wheels, no malformed geometry, no blurry details, no cheap cartoon appearance. Keep the vehicle recognizable and physically believable.

prompts.text:

垂直 4:5 纵向构图，超高分辨率，高度抛光的商业艺术作品。使用极具张力的旋转构图，其中汽车和环境营造出强烈的对角线运动感。图像感觉应像是有意设计的顶级汽车海报，而不是普通照片。
汽车：
一辆流线型异国超级跑车，从极具张力的高角度俯视视角拍摄，整辆车清晰可见。侵略性的空气动力学车身、锐利的 LED 大灯、雕塑般的面板、细节丰富的轮毂、低趴姿态、逼真的轮胎、光泽漆面、精准的反射和真实的材质。汽车应是主要的焦点。
视觉风格：
将写实的汽车设计与精致的数字插画相结合。极简干净的边缘、简化的几何表面、微妙的赛璐璐阴影、受控的渐变、清晰的高光、逼真的反射、详细的机械元素和略微风格化的建筑形式。高端时尚编辑海报美学。
环境：
俯瞰的黑暗未来主义城市建筑，黑色沥青，几何形状的建筑物，玻璃表面，道路标记，电缆，窗户，结构线和微妙的反射。环境保持以黑色和炭灰色为主，以便车辆强烈突出。
调色板：
使用严格的双色调色板：深黑色和炭灰色作为基底，配以一种强烈的强调色，如电光橙、霓虹黄、亮粉色、青色或红色。强调色应出现在汽车、道路标记、建筑细节和选定的图形元素上。
平面设计：
在汽车后面的环境中融入巨大的粗体压缩版式。排版应被车辆部分遮挡，营造出深度。使用带有干净几何形状的超大白色或浅灰色字母。添加细微的技术线、精致的网格、极简的赛车灵感标记和抽象的图形形状。
灯光：
戏剧性的定向照明，汽车周围强烈的轮廓光，微妙的霓虹反射，深邃的阴影，受控的高光和电影般的对比。没有过度的辉光。
构图：
保持汽车在画面中的巨大和主导地位。在其周围使用负空间、强烈的对角线和建筑透视。让构图感觉像是一张专业设计的汽车宣传海报。
质量：
极尽细节、锐利、干净、高端、精致、真实的材质、抛光表面、精确的几何形状、高端汽车广告、编辑艺术指导、8K 质量。
重要提示：
没有人物，没有随机物体，没有杂乱，没有多余文字，没有扭曲的汽车比例，没有多余的车轮，没有畸形的几何形状，没有模糊的细节，没有廉价的卡通外观。保持车辆可辨识且符合物理常理。

From a distance, the composition method is seen first; up close, it is discovered to be related to the actual craft or material in the [Poster Theme].

The large color gamut has obvious natural paper fibers, pulp particles, watercolor or mineral pigment deposition, natural deckle edges, and matte textures. The [Main Tone] is used throughout; colors are low-saturation but complete and concentrated, without being dirty/old, faded, randomly mottled, heavily noisy, or having digital gradients.

Add a very small [Miniature Cultural Scene] near the large color gamut, where figures are realistically completing the [Core Action]. Figures, tools, and [Cultural Artifacts] overall account for only about 3%–5%, with no product display.

Figures uniformly adopt a 2D paper light-color illustration style: minimalist facial features, light volume, complete flat color blocks, and a few continuous clothing fold lines; no photographic skin, 3D miniature model feel, CGI lighting/shadows, strong projections, or real depth of field.

Add a "scale connection" from a real source between the micro scene and the huge main visual, such as fiber, rotation trajectories, thin foil edges, imprints, positioning lines, or the material itself, allowing the material being handled by the small figure to visually extend into a huge color gamut structure. The connection must have clear starting and ending points, not floating or mechanically repeating the same curve.

The main title [Main Title] uses small-scale modern Songti or Mingti type, placed in the white space area; English categories, dates, locations, and [Activity Information] use even smaller font sizes for restrained typography. All text must have real meaning.

The overall reading order is:

White space and large color gamut → Large shape structure → Material texture → Miniature cultural scene → Craft action → Title and activity information.

The final presentation is a modern Oriental editorial poster with clear large shapes from a distance, rich paper fibers up close, and cultural narrative and material details.

Avoid huge titles, ordinary Chinese-style illustrations, realistic figures, 3D miniature models, photographic backgrounds, PPT grids, commercial advertising feel, dirty/old paper, random noise, CGI, glass or mirror materials, Logos, watermarks, numbering, and starburst decorations.

prompts.text:

设计一张现代东方文化活动海报，以「纸纤维 + 大色域结构 + 主动留白 + 微型文化场景」为核心。

背景使用暖象牙白手工纸，保留约 45%–60% 留白。使用【核心大色域】建立第一视觉主体，并根据【大色域结构】形成纤维束、螺旋、薄片、正负形、穿插、嵌套或其他清晰的大形关系。远看先看到构图方法，近看才发现它与【海报主题】中的真实工艺或材料相关。

大色域具有明显天然纸纤维、纸浆颗粒、水彩或矿物颜料沉积、自然毛边和哑光质感。整体使用【主色调】，颜色低饱和但完整、有浓度，不做脏旧、褪色、随机斑驳、强噪点和数字渐变。

在大色域附近加入非常小的【微型文化场景】，人物正在真实完成【核心动作】，人物、工具和【文化器物】整体只占约 3%–5%，不做商品陈列。

人物统一采用二维纸本淡彩插画画法：五官极简、轻体积、完整平面色块、少量连续衣褶线，不出现摄影皮肤、3D 微缩模型感、CGI 光影、强投影或真实景深。

微场景与巨大主视觉之间加入一处真实来源的“尺度连接”，例如纤维、旋转轨迹、薄箔边缘、印迹、定位线或材料本身，让小人物正在处理的材料视觉上延展成巨大色域结构。连接必须有明确起点和终点，不漂浮、不机械重复同一种曲线。

主标题【主标题】使用小尺度现代宋体或明朝体，放在留白区域；英文类别、日期、地点和【活动信息】使用更小字号克制排版。所有文字必须具有真实意义。

整体阅读顺序为：

留白与大色域 → 大形结构 → 材料质感 → 微型文化场景 → 工艺动作 → 标题与活动信息。

最终呈现远看大形清楚、近看纸纤维丰富、有文化叙事和材料细节的现代东方编辑海报。

避免巨大标题、普通国风插画、写实人物、3D 微缩模型、摄影背景、PPT 网格、商业广告感、脏旧纸张、随机噪点、CGI、玻璃或镜面材质、Logo、水印、编号和星芒装饰。
