prompts.text:
Use the uploaded photo as the exact visual reference and transform it into a nostalgic editorial scrapbook-style artwork. Preserve the subjects, composition, clothing, poses, objects, and overall scene from the original photo.

Create a vertical 3:4 composition with a refined, minimalist Japanese-inspired photo-to-illustration aesthetic.

The final design should be divided into two equal horizontal sections:

TOP HALF — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH
•Place the uploaded original photograph in the upper 50% of the canvas.
•Keep it photorealistic and completely unchanged.
•Preserve the exact facial features, body proportions, clothing, hairstyle, pose, lighting, environment, furniture, food, blanket, window, and all other recognizable details.
•Do not crop important subjects.
•Use the original image naturally, with clean edges and no artificial frame.

BOTTOM HALF — MINIATURE STORYBOOK VERSION
•Recreate the exact same scene from the photograph as a small, delicate hand-painted illustration positioned around the center of the lower half.
•Keep the same subjects, poses, clothing, objects, perspective, and recognizable composition, but make the entire scene appear like a tiny nostalgic illustration placed on paper.
•Use a soft watercolor + colored-pencil + subtle gouache aesthetic.
•Delicate imperfect brushwork, lightly textured edges, soft shadows, muted natural colors, slightly faded vintage appearance.
•The miniature scene should occupy only about 25–35% of the lower section, leaving generous negative space around it.
•Make it feel like a tiny memory captured on paper rather than a conventional full-frame illustration.
•Add a very subtle hand-drawn shadow underneath the miniature scene to make it feel naturally placed on the paper.

BACKGROUND
•Cover the entire bottom half with warm off-white / ivory handmade paper.
•Visible fine paper fibers and subtle grain.
•Slightly uneven organic texture, similar to premium watercolor paper.
•Minimal, warm, calm and elegant.
•No borders, no decorative patterns, no unnecessary elements.

TEXT
•Beneath the miniature illustration, add a very small handwritten phrase:
“sunny days”
•Use thin, delicate, lowercase handwritten script.
•Light gray/taupe ink.
•Keep the text subtle and understated, centered beneath the artwork.

LIGHTING & COLOR
•Warm natural daylight.
•Soft cream, beige, pale blue, muted denim blue and warm brown tones.
•Gentle highlights and soft shadows.
•Slightly nostalgic film-inspired color grading.
•Avoid oversaturation.
•Overall mood: quiet, cozy, sentimental, peaceful family memory.

IMPORTANT
•Maintain the identity and visual characteristics of the people from the reference photo.
•Do not invent additional people or objects.
•Do not change clothing or poses.
•Do not distort anatomy.
•The miniature illustration must clearly depict the same exact moment and scene as the original photograph.
•Clean premium editorial composition.
•High detail, sophisticated art direction, realistic paper texture, subtle handcrafted imperfections.
•No extra text, no frame, no logo, no watermark.

prompts.text:

• 将照片中的完全相同的场景重新创作为位于下半部分中心周围的小型、精致的手绘插画。

prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
【海报主题】
【主标题】
【核心大色域】
【主色调】
【微型文化场景】
【核心动作】
【文化器物】
【活动信息】
【画幅比例】9:16 竖版

设计一张具有现代东方编辑美学的文化活动海报，以「纸纤维 + 大色域 + 主动留白 + 微型文化场景」作为核心视觉方法。

背景使用温润、干净的暖象牙白手工纸，保留极轻天然纤维和细腻纸浆纹理。画面主动保留约 45%–60% 的大面积留白，让空白本身成为构图的一部分，不使用大量山水、植物、建筑或装饰元素填满背景。

使用【核心大色域】作为画面的第一视觉主体。大色域占据约 25%–40% 的画面，根据【海报主题】可以表现为幕布、嵌套层、长轴、薄纸、纸浆、器物结构或其他抽象大形，但不要直接做成普通写实物体。

大色域必须拥有真实而高级的手工纸材料感，包括天然长短纤维、纸浆颗粒、水彩或矿物颜料沉积、大尺度自然色差、轻微压痕、自然毛边与哑光表面。材质丰富但保持干净、完整，不做脏旧、黄斑、严重破损、随机斑驳、强噪点或廉价复古效果。

整体主色使用【主色调】，颜色数量保持克制。低饱和但色面必须完整、有浓度，不要把“东方感”理解成褪色、灰蒙或陈旧。可以设置一枚极小朱砂红印记或一个极小暖色节点作为点睛，总面积控制在画面 1%–2%。

在大色域附近加入一个尺度非常小但叙事完整的【微型文化场景】。人物、桌面、工具和器物整体只占画面约 3%–5%，让观者远看先看到大形和留白，靠近后才发现人物正在完成【核心动作】。

所有人物必须采用二维纸本淡彩插画语言，与整张海报使用同一种纸、同一套颜料和同一个画师般的视觉语言。人物面部只用少量克制线点概括五官，不刻画真实皮肤纹理、毛孔、眼球高光或摄影式面部阴影。

人物身体只使用轻微二维明暗表达基础体积，服装主要使用完整、低饱和、哑光的平面色块，仅加入少量连续自然的线性衣褶。人物脚下只保留非常淡的贴纸接触阴影。

禁止摄影真人感、3D 微缩模型感、CGI 体积感、塑料皮肤、电影光影、强轮廓光、摄影景深和强投影。人物必须像直接画在纸上的东方编辑插画。

根据主题加入少量【文化器物】，器物真正参与人物动作，不做整齐商品陈列，不堆满工作台。器物、人物与场景均保持纸本淡彩和轻工笔质感。

在微型场景和巨大主视觉之间建立一个清楚但克制的“尺度连接”。可以根据主题使用一根琴弦、操偶杆、纤维、漆线、纸边、工具轨迹或其他真实来源的细线，将微型手工行为视觉上连接到巨大色域。

连接元素必须有真实起点、完整走势和明确终点，不得漂浮、断裂或作为无意义装饰。

主标题【主标题】放在大面积留白区域，使用纤细、端正、具有现代东方文化机构气质的中文宋体或明朝体。标题保持中小尺度，不使用巨大 Typography，让文字成为第二视觉层级。

标题上方可加入极小英文活动类别，标题下方加入一行简短中文副题。日期、地点与活动信息使用更小字号集中排布在边缘留白区，形成真实文化海报的信息层级。

整体风格融合手工纸拼贴、水彩或矿物颜料肌理、二维纸本淡彩插画、微型文化叙事与现代东方编辑设计。

A close-up selfie of a young woman's face and chest, taken with an outstretched arm on a warm bedroom bed in the center of the frame. Large transparent pink-framed glasses, a white small floral camisole, and a white fluffy shawl are the main protagonists.

Photorealistic realistic photo. High-definition presentation of transparent resin glasses, eyelashes, and natural skin, small floral patterns, lace, woolen white fabric, and soft night light in peach, white, and amber.

Omit transparent round glasses; change close-up angle and small floral top

prompts.text:
[Poster Theme]
[Main Title]
[Core Large Color Gamut]
[Structural Method]
[Main Color Tone]
[Miniature Cultural Scene]
[Character Action]
[Cultural Artifacts]
[Event Information]
[Aspect Ratio]

Design a modern Oriental culture event poster, with "paper fiber + large color gamut + active negative space + miniature cultural scene" as the core.

The background uses warm ivory white handmade paper, retaining about 45%–60% large area white space. Use [Core Large Color Gamut] to establish the primary visual, forming a clear and methodical large-scale relationship according to [Structural Method]. The theme can be expressed through fiber radiation, paper cutouts, crack connections, positive-negative shape transformation, or rubbing marks, but do not directly create ordinary realistic objects.

The large color gamut has obvious natural paper fibers, pulp particles, watercolor or mineral pigment deposits, natural rough edges, and a matte texture. The overall style uses [Main Color Tone], colors are low-saturation but complete and dense; from a distance, the large shapes and color relationships are seen first, and material details are only discovered upon close inspection.

Add a very small scale [Miniature Cultural Scene] near the large color gamut, where characters are genuinely performing [Character Action]. Characters, tools, and [Cultural Artifacts] overall occupy only about 3%–5%, no staged poses or product displays.

Characters uniformly adopt a two-dimensional paper-based light color illustration style: simple facial features, light volume, complete flat color blocks, a few continuous clothing fold lines, belonging to the same visual world as the paper and color gamut. Avoid photographic realism, 3D miniature models, CGI lighting and shadow, strong projections, and real depth of field.

Establish a real scale connection between the miniature scene and the huge main visual, such as fibers, paper scraps, cracks, mending staples, ink marks, tool trajectories, or the material itself, allowing "small manual actions" to naturally extend into a "large color gamut structure."

The main title [Main Title] uses small-scale modern Songti or Mingti fonts, placed in the white space area; date, location, and [Event Information] use smaller font sizes for restrained layout. The text does not compete with the main visual, and no meaningless placeholder words are added.

The overall reading order is:

Negative space and large color gamut → structural relationship → paper fiber texture → miniature cultural scene → craftsmanship actions → title and event information.

The final presentation is an Oriental editorial poster that is eye-catching from afar, with a paper feel, details, and cultural stories upon close inspection.

Avoid giant titles, ordinary Chinese style illustrations, realistic characters, 3D miniature models, photographic backgrounds, PPT grids, commercial advertising feel, dirty old paper, random noise, CGI, glass or mirror materials, Logos, watermarks, numbering, and starburst decorations.

在大色域附近加入尺度很小的【微型文化场景】，人物正在真实完成【人物动作】，人物、工具和【文化器物】整体只占约 3%–5%，不做摆拍或商品陈列。

The bottom half maintains 60%–80% continuous warm white negative space, with only very light fibers and matte grains on the paper. The edges of the main shape can have slight halftones, dry brush grains, or uneven ink density, but the overall style must be restrained, flat, and clean, not smudging into ink wash, nor becoming fine line art. Figures and animals can be compressed into overall silhouettes without faces or clothing textures; architecture, plants, food, and vessels retain only the minimum structure to identify the shape relationship, without restoring photo details. At most, use one or two extremely fine auxiliary lines to suggest direction; no second abstract object may be added.

The abstract shape is mainly charcoal black, ink black, or dark graphite, with at most one spot of extremely low-saturation color extracted from the original image; the color changes with the photo and does not use fixed blue, green, or city palettes. A row of very small, accurate English editorial notes can be added at the bottom to describe the semantics, such as ONE GESTURE / OPEN SPACE, ARC / STILLNESS, or SINGLE FORM; do not add large titles, long paragraphs, or fictional location information.

The overall design should let the top half bear the photographic facts and the bottom half bear the single concept, form judgment, and rhythm of negative space. Prohibit full-page scene redrawing, multiple floating objects, continuous route nodes, complete city skyline templates, photo windows, full-page ink wash, colored geometric posters, heavy paper art, 3D rendering, automatic outlining, logos, watermarks, fake Chinese, AI badges, and original image badges.

prompts.text:
制作一张竖向 3:4 的上下对比转绘图，风格命名为【CONCEPTUAL SILHOUETTE VOID｜概念留白剪影风】。适用于人物、动物、植物、建筑、城市、交通工具、食物、器物、室内、自然和旅行照片，不限定“旅途”或任何单一场景。
上半部约 42%–48% 保留输入照片本身：准确保持主要主体、数量、姿态、视角、空间关系、光线、材质和可识别色彩，只做自然的出版级调色，不插画化、不换地点、不增删关键主体。上下之间留出干净的暖白接缝，不加粗边框、照片标签或原图/AI角标。
下半部不要复制整幅照片，也不要画完整插画。先从原照片提炼一个最有意义的语义关系、动作、轮廓或材质节奏：例如人物的站姿、动物的尾巴弧线、花的开放、树枝的伸展、道路的弯折、建筑的拱线、车辆的速度方向、碗碟的圆形关系、窗户的重复节奏、山脊的起伏或水面的波纹。只选择一个主载体，把它重构成一枚炭黑、墨黑或深石墨色的抽象平面剪影、带状轮廓、块面符号或单一线性手势。该形状必须能回溯到上半部的真实主体，但允许拉长、缩小、偏置、旋转、切断或跨越留白。
下半部保持 60%–80% 的连续暖白留白，纸面只有极淡纤维和哑光颗粒。主形状边缘可以有轻微网点、干刷颗粒或不均匀墨密度，但整体必须克制、平面、干净，不能晕成水墨，也不能变成精细线稿。人物和动物可压缩为无脸、无服装纹理的整体剪影；建筑、植物、食物和器物只保留能识别形状关系的最少结构，不恢复照片细节。最多使用一条或两条极细辅助线提示方向，不得添加第二个抽象物。
抽象形状以炭黑、墨黑或深石墨为主，最多从原图提取一处极低饱和点色，颜色随照片变化，不套固定蓝色、绿色或城市色板。底部可加入一行很小、准确的英文编辑注释，描述该语义，例如 ONE GESTURE / OPEN SPACE、ARC / STILLNESS 或 SINGLE FORM；不要加入大标题、长段落或虚构地点信息。
整体应让上半部承担摄影事实，下半部承担单一概念、形体判断和留白节奏。禁止满版场景重绘、多个漂浮物、连续路线节点、完整城市天际线模板、照片窗、整页水墨、彩色几何海报、厚重纸艺、3D渲染、自动描边、Logo、水印、假中文、AI角标和原图角标。

prompts.text:
Ultra-realistic Japanese-style indoor fashion portrait photography, vertical 3:4. A clearly adult East Asian female, 20+, standing in the corner and by the window of a minimalist cream-white room. The photographer is located directly in front of the subject slightly to the left, using an approximately 50–70mm equivalent lens, capturing the head, body, legs, and shoes in full, while retaining a large area of blank wall and window environment.

The subject has a naturally slender, slightly light hourglass figure: narrow shoulders, a clearly snatched waist, naturally rounded hips, and well-proportioned long legs. The body is standing basically facing forward, the back lightly leaning against the wall, center of gravity naturally falling on one leg, with legs close together. The head is turned to the right side of the frame looking out the window, not looking directly at the camera, with a quiet and slightly alienated expression. The left hand hangs naturally at the side of the body, and the right hand lightly lifts the right side of the skirt hem / ruffles, with a relaxed wrist.

The subject has deep brown medium-long wavy hair, extending below the chest, thick volume, with natural large curls at the ends; light air bangs on the forehead and stray hairs at the sides of the face. Makeup is light and exquisite: thin eyeliner, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, natural eyelashes, light pink blush, nude pink lips.

The clothing is a set of cream-white / ivory-white romantic knit mini dress-style outfit. The top is a slim-fit square neck / shallow U-neck knit garment, with a slender white ribbon bow at the chest, and the waist and abdomen area uses obvious corset-style stitching and multiple sets of thin ribbon ties to emphasize the slender waistline; sleeves are made of translucent thin knit material, fitting the upper arm and then gradually flaring out downwards to form wide bell sleeves / ruffle sleeves, with fine lace edges at the cuffs. The hem flares out from the waist into multiple layers of soft ruffles, overall like a short doll dress, but with same-colored safety shorts / romper structure underneath to maintain full normal coverage.

The legs wear cream-white thigh-high socks, the top of the socks located above the knees, made of soft translucent or fine knit material; each outer side of the calves has a set of white thin ribbon bow decorations, with long ribbons hanging down naturally. The feet wear ivory-white pointed-toe low-heels / mid-low heel Mary Janes or thin-strap heels, the toes are narrow and pointed, the upper is simple, with thin straps and small bows near the ankle, overall unified with the clothing.

The scene is a minimalist cream-white interior: light off-white walls, white baseboards, and on the right is a high window covered with white translucent lace gauze curtains; under the window is a white built-in windowsill / wainscoting with simple rectangular line-frame decoration. The floor is dark, near-black wood flooring, creating a clear contrast with the all-white clothing. No extra furniture or decorations in the room.

Lighting uses natural daylight from the right-side window plus soft indoor ambient light, slightly bright near the window, the subject's face and white clothes are illuminated by soft side light, skin tone is naturally warm white, the clothing fabric still retains fine knit textures and layers; shadows are very soft, no strong flash used.

The overall quality is high-quality Japanese portrait / Korean-style minimalist indoor fashion photography texture: low-saturation cream tones, natural skin texture, slight soft focus, medium depth of field, clear subject, background kept clean and soft.

Key focus: Adult East Asian female + deep brown long curly hair with air bangs + head turned looking out window + cream-white slim-fit corset knit mini dress-style set + multiple sets of white ribbons at chest and waist + translucent wide bell sleeves + multi-layered ruffle hem + white thigh-high socks + calf ribbon bows + ivory pointed-toe shoes + cream-white wall corner + lace curtains + natural window light from the right + minimalist soft portrait.

Avoid: long skirts, black stockings, bare legs, sneakers, platform shoes, tight bodycon skirts, pure white wedding dresses, exaggerated Lolita decorations, complex backgrounds, strong flash, excessive airbrushing, anime faces, CG feel, plastic skin, extra limbs, watermarks and garbled text.

items.title: 晨间卧室日本女性柔光微笑写实摄影

prompts.text:
Morning Bedroom | Soft light and a "Good morning" smile

【Theme · Style】
Capture the natural and intimate moment of lovers waking up in a morning bedroom, presented in a realistic photo style. Depict a clearly adult Japanese woman lying on the bed, noticing her lover entering the bedroom and gently waving. Give it a photo-collection-like aesthetic, but without excessive retouching, conveying a sense of daily life and intimacy between lovers, presented in a soft photo expression form.
The core charm is the morning tranquility, natural expressions upon waking, and the combination of peach-pink clothing with white bedding. Incorporate a slightly heart-pounding sense of intimacy within the elegant cuteness.

【Location · Background · Worldview】
A clean and tidy home bedroom with pale beige and white as the main tones. White sheets, fluffy pillows, ecru-colored quilts, or soft knitted blankets are naturally placed on the bed. Thin white curtains hang on the windows, with morning light pouring through.
A small side table with bright wood grain is placed by the bed, with a few items like a vase or alarm clock to create a sense of morning life. The background is tidy but not cold like a hotel, retaining the warm atmosphere where two people actually live.

【Season · Time · Weather】
Evokes a mild late spring to early summer morning. The time is around 7:00 AM; it's sunny outside but not with strong direct sunlight, but rather soft morning light diffused through thin curtains spreading into the room.
Almost no wind, with curtains only slightly swaying. The tranquility of the beginning of the day remains, with the indoor atmosphere feeling both the slightly cool morning air and the warmth of the bedding.

【Character Setting】
A clearly adult Japanese woman about 27 years old. Has a soft adult face, slightly large black pupils, natural eyebrows, an elegant nose bridge, and full, soft lips with good color. Deep brown natural wavy long hair reaching slightly past the shoulders, with some messiness at the ends and around the face upon waking.
Skin tone is a bright oak tone, processed evenly but not over-retouched, retaining natural flush on the cheeks and subtle shadows. Slender shoulders, limbs, and a thin waist, contrasting with feminine rounded hips and clearly plump breasts, forming a natural curvaceous body type. The breasts are given a soft sense of weight and three-dimensionality, naturally blending into the sleeping posture and clothing.

【Clothing · Accessories】
Wearing a peach-pink strapless babydoll and matching shorts. The babydoll is mainly made of thin, soft see-through material, with small floral embroidered lace accents at the chest. The chest and shorts are lined with the same color, ensuring an elegant design that appropriately covers necessary parts.
Even for plump breasts, the fabric does not overstretch or dig in, fitting with a natural sense of size like actual clothing. The waist fabric has a slight transparency and soft drape, naturally creating folds or slackness based on the sleeping posture. No accessories are worn, prioritizing the simplicity of the morning.

【Pose · Action · Gaze】
The woman is lying on her back on the bed, her head naturally resting in the center of the pillow. Her body is slightly diagonal to the camera, her legs leisurely stretched, with no excessive force applied to the knees and ankles. Only one toe is slightly turned outward, expressing a natural sense of relaxation upon waking.
Noticing the lover entering the bedroom, she only slightly turns her face toward them. One hand is naturally placed on the bedding, the other hand is slightly raised to shoulder height, fingers softly spread, gently waving. The gaze does not look directly into the lover's eyes, but rather a gentle eye contact level.

【Expression · Emotion】
Eyes naturally open, capturing the moment she sees the lover entering the bedroom with an expression mixed with peace of mind and joy. Eyebrows and cheeks are relaxed, the eye area slightly softened. A small but natural smile appears on the corners of the mouth, with lips slightly parted as if just about to say "Good morning."
Not a calculated smile, but retaining a slightly defenseless atmosphere of waking up. Not an exaggerated performance of joy, but an intimate sense of a natural smile like "Ah, you're here," and the soft expression unique to the morning.

【Composition · Lens】
Suitable for X posts with a 4:5 vertical composition. A full-body composition that comfortably includes from head to toe. Place the figure slightly diagonally in the longitudinal frame, naturally showing the width of the bed and part of the bedroom. The head, hands, and toes are not cropped, maintaining a distance where the full-body posture and small wave are visible at a glance. The camera shoots diagonally downward from a slightly higher position at the bedside. The focal length is in the standard range leaning towards medium-telephoto, without exaggerating the face, chest, or limbs. The background is only slightly blurred, retaining enough depth of field to convey the depth of the bedroom.

【Lighting · Color · Texture · Atmosphere】
The main light source is soft natural morning light coming through the window on the left side of the frame. Diffused light through white curtains highlights the cheeks, chest, hair, and lace, while the opposite side has light reflection from the bedding wrapping around. Shadows are not heavy, only naturally expressing the facial contours and the three-dimensionality of the clothing.
A gentle color palette mainly consisting of peach pink, ivory white, pale beige, and bright wood grain. Skin retains pores, subtle shadows, and natural flush; hair depicts fine strands of flow and messiness; lace shows the exquisite texture of embroidery and thin cloth. Overall conveys a quiet and sweet, warm air of lovers starting the day together.

【Quality · Exclusion Elements】
In the form of a high-resolution realistic photo, truly expressing the human body, clothing, light, bedding, and sense of distance. Depict the woman as a clear adult, avoiding a face or physique that appears underage or too young.
Avoid extra limbs or fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, unnatural joints or body distortions, confusion between left and right hands, blending of clothing and body, damaged clothing, or accidental exposure. Breasts maintain a plump natural volume but do not appear as hard spheres, extreme push-ups, or shapes ignoring gravity. Do not use extreme wide-angle distortion, excessive skin-smoothing treatments, unnatural backgrounds, text, logos, watermarks, or UI displays.

prompts.text:
晨间卧室｜柔和的光线与“早上好”的微笑

【主题・画风】
捕捉早晨卧室中恋人醒来时那自然而亲密的瞬间，以写实照片风格呈现。描绘一位明确成年的日本女性躺在床上，注意到走进卧室的恋人并轻轻挥手的场景。赋予照片集般的美感，但不过度修饰，传达出生活气息和恋人间的亲近距离感，以柔和的照片表现形式呈现。
以早晨的宁静、醒来时的自然表情、桃粉色服装与白色寝具的搭配为核心魅力。在优雅的可爱中，稍稍融入让人心跳加速的亲密感。

【地点・背景・世界观】
以淡米色和白色为主调的干净整洁的家中卧室。床上自然放置白色床单、蓬松的枕头、生成色被子或柔软的编织毯。窗户上挂着薄薄的白色窗帘，晨光从中洒入。
床边放置一张明亮木纹的小边桌，上面少量摆放花瓶或闹钟等，营造出早晨的生活感。背景整洁但不似酒店般冷冰冰，保留两人实际居住的温暖氛围。

【季节・时间・天气】
唤起温和春末至初夏的早晨。时间约为上午7时前后，外头晴朗但非强烈直射阳光，而是透过薄窗帘的柔和晨光扩散至室内。
几乎无风，窗帘仅微微摇曳。仍残留着一天伊始的宁静，室内同时感受到略带凉意的晨空气息与被窝的温暖氛围。

【人物设定】
明确成年的约27岁日本女性。拥有柔和成人的脸庞，略大的黑瞳、自然的眉毛、优雅的鼻梁、富有血色的柔软嘴唇。深棕色自然波浪长发及肩稍长，醒来时发梢和脸周留有少许散乱。
肤色为明亮的橡木调，均匀处理但不过度修饰，保留脸颊的自然血色和细微阴影。纤细的肩膀、手脚、细腰，对比女性化的圆润臀部，以及明确丰满的胸部，形成自然的丰腴体型。胸部赋予柔软的重量感和立体感，自然融入睡姿与服装中。

【服装・配饰】
身着桃粉色无肩带式婴儿装及同色短裤。婴儿装以薄而柔软的透视材质为主，胸口点缀小花纹刺绣蕾丝。胸部和短裤处附以同色内衬，确保必要部位妥善覆盖的上品设计。
即使面对丰满胸部，布料也不会过度拉伸或嵌入，以实际衣物般的自然尺寸感贴合。腰部布料带有轻微透视感和柔和垂坠感，根据睡姿自然产生褶皱或松弛。不配戴饰品，优先早晨的朴素感。

【姿势・动作・视线】
女性仰躺在床上，头部自然枕在中央枕头上。身体对镜头略微斜向，双腿悠然伸展，膝盖和脚踝不施加过多力量。只将一侧脚尖稍稍向外，表现醒来时的自然放松感。
注意到走进卧室的恋人，仅将脸稍稍转向那边。一手自然置于寝具上，另一手轻抬至肩旁，手指柔和张开，轻轻挥手。视线不直视恋人眼睛，而是温柔地对视程度。

【表情・情感】
眼睛自然睁开，捕捉到走进卧室的恋人那一瞬，混杂安心与喜悦的表情。眉毛和脸颊放松，眼周稍稍柔和。嘴角浮现不大却自然的微笑，嘴唇像是刚要说“早上好”般微微张开。
非刻意笑容，而是保留醒来时的些许无防备氛围。不夸张演绎喜悦，而是像“啊，你来了”般自然一笑的亲密感，以及早晨特有的柔和表情。

【构图・镜头】
适合X帖子4:5竖长构图。从头顶至脚尖宽裕纳入全身的全身构图。将人物略微斜置于画面纵向，自然展现床铺的宽阔与卧室一部分。头部、手部、脚尖不裁切，保持一眼可见全身姿势和小幅挥手的距离。
镜头从床侧稍高位置斜向下拍摄。焦距为标准域稍偏中长焦，不夸张脸部、胸部或手脚。背景仅轻微虚化，保留足以传达卧室深度的景深。

【光线・色彩・质感・氛围】
主光源为画面左侧窗户透入的柔和晨自然光。透过白色窗帘的漫射光斜照脸颊、胸部、头发、蕾丝，反侧则有寝具的淡反射光回绕。阴影不浓重，仅自然表现脸部轮廓与服装立体感。
以桃粉色、象牙白、淡米色、明亮木纹为主的温柔色调。肌肤保留毛孔、细微阴影、自然血色；头发描绘细致发丝流动与散乱；蕾丝展现刺绣与薄布的精致质感。整体传达宁静甜蜜、恋人共度一天开端的温暖空气。

【品质・排除要素】
以高分辨率写实照片形式，真实表现人体、服装、光线、寝具、远近感。将女性描绘为明确成人，避免显得未成年或过于幼小的脸庞与体格。
避免多余手脚或手指、缺失手指、融合手指、不自然关节或身体扭曲、左右手混淆、服装与身体融合、服装破损、意外暴露。胸部保持丰满自然体积，但不呈硬球状、极端上推、无视重力的形状。不使用极端广角畸变、过度美肌处理、不自然背景、文字、标志、水印、UI显示。

items.title: 东方武侠浮世绘金庸人物志

prompts.text:
[Character] Fill in a Jin Yong character
[Core Move] Fill in a representative martial arts move or action
[Visual Anchor] Fill in weapons, divine beasts, palm gestures, long hair, giant waves, etc.
[Environment] Fill in cliffs, bamboo forests, waves, wilderness, etc.
[Main Color Palette] Fill in 3–5 main colors
[Inscribed Label] Fill in character name and move name

Create a 9:16 vertical Oriental martial arts Ukiyo-e character painting. Redesign the scene around [Character] and [Core Move], without referring to any film/television actor's face or specific film/television styles.

The character must be in a moment of intense action, letting the [Core Move] directly participate in the composition. Use [Visual Anchor], body twists, weapons, palm gestures, robes, hair, or environmental dynamics to form clear large diagonals, C-shaped or S-shaped curves, and strong perspective relationships. The character occupies the main area of the frame, allowing parts to naturally extend out of the frame, ensuring the character and move are quickly identifiable even in a thumbnail.

The overall style adopts the strong language of traditional Ukiyo-e Mushae and multi-color woodblock printing: powerful black carved outlines, exaggerated human perspective, large flat color planes, compact character composition, and a distinct handmade woodcut feel. Maintain a rough style with a sense of paper and ink, and a sense of printing; do not process it into overly smooth modern digital illustrations.

Use [Main Color Palette] for colors; large color planes should remain complete and full, but allow for slight natural uneven inking and a handmade feel in the color registration. Textures must follow material changes: skin is expressed with complete skin-tone color planes and a small amount of structural lines; robes are expressed with large color blocks and long folds; hair, feathers, wave patterns, and clouds use directional continuous line bundles; rocks can retain more obvious rough woodcut textures. Avoid covering skin, clothes, weapons, and the background entirely with the same uniform dotted, flocculent, or short-stroke textures.

The background uses [Environment], maintaining a lower information density than the character, with large areas of warm ivory paper preserved, making the character, moves, and visual anchors the subject. The paper retains only slight natural fibers and ancient printing textures, without using heavy yellow spots, damage, or global aging filters.

Add traditional vertical labels, small annotations, and 1–2 vermilion seals at the edges of the frame. Labels use [Inscribed Label], naturally integrating into the borders of the ancient painting; do not use modern large titles, numbering, or UI decorations.

The final effect should be like a Mushae from the same set of "Jin Yong's World Character Collection": clear character identity, moves becoming the core of the composition, strong dynamics, strong shapes, and high recognizability, while retaining the unique woodcut lines, color blocks, and paper-ink texture of traditional Ukiyo-e.

Avoid: film/television actor faces, specific film/television costumes, idol-style beautiful faces, xianxia mobile game illustrations, anime feel, 3D rendering, photographic texture, neon light effects, magic circles, excessive CG special effects, standard standing poses, modern typography, uniform dot noise, full-screen short-stroke patterns, global grain coverage, random cracks, overly smooth digital flat painting, watermarks, numbering.

prompts.text:
【人物】填写金庸人物
【核心招式】填写代表性武功或动作
【视觉锚点】填写武器、神兽、掌势、长发、巨浪等
【环境】填写山崖、竹林、海浪、荒原等
【主色调】填写 3–5 个主色
【题签】填写人物名与招式名

创作一幅 9:16 竖幅东方武侠浮世绘人物画。围绕【人物】与【核心招式】重新设计画面，不参考任何影视演员脸或具体影视造型。

人物必须处于强烈动作瞬间，让【核心招式】直接参与构图。利用【视觉锚点】、身体扭转、兵器、掌势、衣袍、头发或环境动态形成清楚的大斜线、C 型或 S 型曲线和强透视关系。人物占据画面主要面积，局部允许自然出框，缩略图下仍能快速识别人物和招式。

整体采用强烈的传统浮世绘武者绘与多色木版套色语言：有力量的黑色雕版轮廓、夸张人体透视、大块平面设色、紧凑人物构图和明显手工木刻气息。保持画风粗粝、有纸墨感、有印刷感，不要处理成过于光滑的现代数字插画。

色彩使用【主色调】，大色面保持完整、饱满，但允许轻微天然上墨不均和套色手工感。纹理必须跟随材质变化：皮肤以完整肤色色面和少量结构线表现；衣袍以大色块和长衣褶表现；头发、羽毛、浪纹、云气使用有方向的连续线束；山石可保留更明显的粗粝木刻纹理。避免让皮肤、衣服、武器和背景全部覆盖相同的均匀点状、絮状或短划纹理。

背景使用【环境】，保持低于人物的信息密度，大面积保留暖象牙色纸面，使人物、招式和视觉锚点成为主体。纸张只保留轻微天然纤维与古版印刷质感，不使用严重黄斑、破损和全局做旧滤镜。

items.title: 原创角色IP品牌设计提案四页全案

prompts.text:
Create a complete 4-page IP design proposal for an original character brand.

[IP Name]:
[Core Character]:
[Character Personality]:
[World / Brand Concept]:
[Primary Colors]:
[Secondary Accent Colors]:
[Material Direction]:
[Visual Tone]: quirky, collectible, editorial, premium, design-forward
[Language]: English
[Aspect Ratio]: 9:16 vertical

Build one consistent visual identity across all pages, with the same character proportions, facial features, signature accessories, color system, typography, materials, and proposal layout. Use a premium editorial case-study style with a small brand lockup, irregular dark chapter tab, slim vertical navigation, asymmetric footer, controlled whitespace, fine annotations, and subtle cut / fold geometry. Keep the layout rich in detail but clean and professionally art-directed.

Page 1 — Character Identity
Present one large hero character, 3–4 key identity anchors, silhouette tests, shape-language studies, and front / side / back turnaround views. Clearly establish what makes the character recognizable. Include only meaningful design notes, no fake parameters or generic character-profile data.

Page 2 — Design Development
Show the character-design process through rough shape exploration, 2D sketches, clay model, 3D wireframe, partial scan-style construction view, proportion studies, seam or structural logic, exploded anatomy, rejected silhouette alternatives, and material close-ups. Make the page feel like a real character-design development board rather than a futuristic HUD.

Page 3 — World & Story
Place the character inside a fully designed environment derived from the same visual language. Include one strong hero scene, one smaller interaction scene, a concise form-evolution study, and a few material or spatial details. The environment should feel like a natural extension of the character rather than an unrelated backdrop.

Page 4 — Extensions & Packaging
Create several clearly different character variations based on specific tasks, tools, outfits, or use cases while keeping the core identity unchanged. Add one premium collectible packaging or product application and a small extension-logic diagram showing how the character can scale into a commercial IP system.

Across all pages, vary the internal composition instead of repeating the same grid. Use large, medium, small, and micro visual scales to create rhythm. Let sketches, 3D renders, annotations, close-ups, materials, and product applications work together as design evidence.

The final result should feel like a real creative-agency IP proposal: distinctive character identity, visible design process, coherent worldbuilding, storytelling potential, and believable commercial extension.

Avoid generic PPT layouts, rigid card grids, childish scrapbook styling, meaningless English, fake technical data, excessive handwriting, decorative stickers, sparkles, page numbers, watermarks, inconsistent character features, or changing the character into different species across pages.

The explorer must be isolated with an exceptionally clean professional cutout when required for the collage.
Preserve:
hair detail
fabric edges
hands
boots
backpack straps
equipment
natural movement
No artificial cutout halo.
No white outline.
No excessive sharpening.
PHASE 2 — COLOR FOUNDATION
PRIMARY QUECHUA OUTDOOR BLUE
Use a strong outdoor-inspired Quechua blue as the principal graphic accent.
SUPPORTING COLORS:
Off-white
Warm stone grey
Deep forest green
The palette should feel connected to:
mountain sky
rock
forest
trail
technical outdoor equipment
Keep the graphic system controlled.
Avoid excessive colors.
PRIMARY PAINT FORM
Create ONE enormous irregular outdoor-blue paint form.
Occupy approximately:
45–55% of the composition.
The shape should function as the visual foundation of the collage.
Appearance:
hand-painted
thick brush texture
organic edges
dry-brush imperfections
visible bristle marks
slight transparency variations
screen-print character
paper interaction
The paint should feel physically applied to recycled expedition paper.
Not a smooth digital blob.
Not a generic vector shape.
The explorer should overlap the paint form.
The product must remain completely visible.
PHASE 3 — COLLAGE SYSTEM
Introduce exactly five major handcrafted graphic elements.
Select from:
TOPOGRAPHIC CONTOUR LINES
TRAIL ROUTE LINES
HAND-DRAWN CIRCLES
COMPASS SYMBOLS
ALTITUDE MARKERS
MOUNTAIN SILHOUETTES
GPS COORDINATE MARKINGS
ELEVATION GRAPHICS
HAND-DRAWN ARROWS
WEATHER SYMBOLS
TERRAIN MAP FRAGMENTS
HALFTONE DOTS
FIELD-NOTE MARKINGS
Each element must have a visual purpose.
Do not scatter graphics randomly.
Graphics should reinforce:
direction
altitude
location
distance
terrain
exploration
Use asymmetric placement.
Create a strong diagonal rhythm.
Some elements may pass behind the explorer.
Some may partially disappear beneath typography.
One or two graphic elements may overlap the subject subtly to create physical depth.
MATERIAL LANGUAGE
Build the collage as though physically assembled from an explorer’s field notebook.
Include subtle:
torn-paper edges
folded map fragments
screen-print texture
photocopy artifacts
ink bleed
dry-brush marks
recycled paper fibers
topographic printing
handwritten route markings
subtle registration offsets
analog grain
The artwork should feel tactile.
It should resemble:
A MOUNTAIN MAP
AN OUTDOOR MAGAZINE
A HANDMADE ADVENTURE POSTER.
Do not overdo the texture.
PHASE 4 — TYPOGRAPHY
PRIMARY HEADLINE:
PLAY OUTSIDE.
Make this the second-largest visual element after the explorer.
Large bold uppercase geometric sans-serif.
Extremely strong weight.
Tight leading.
Compact composition.
Minimal tracking.
Allow a slight 2–4° rotation.
The typography should feel physically printed onto the artwork.
Not floating.
Not glossy.
Not 3D.
Not futuristic.
Typography should interact with the collage.
Allow:
partial cropping
layer overlap
masking
paint interruption
map-line interruption
edge cropping
PRIMARY COPY:
PLAY OUTSIDE.
SUPPORTING COPY:
Built for whatever the trail brings.
Keep supporting copy small and highly readable.
TYPOGRAPHIC HIERARCHY
01
QUECHUA BRANDING
02
PLAY OUTSIDE.
03
Built for whatever the trail brings.
04
TRAIL / ALTITUDE / ADVENTURE INFORMATION
05
DISCOVER MORE
The headline must remain instantly readable even at Instagram thumbnail size.
PHASE 5 — QUECHUA BRANDING
Place the official QUECHUA branding in the upper-left.
Preserve:
correct proportions
clear space
accurate wordmark
brand integrity
Do not distort.
Do not stretch.
Do not place the logo inside unnecessary effects.
Small supporting line:
OUTDOOR EQUIPMENT
The branding should remain visible but should not compete with:
PLAY OUTSIDE.
PHASE 6 — BACKGROUND
BACKGROUND COLOR:
Warm Light Stone Grey
The background should resemble premium recycled expedition paper.
Add extremely subtle:
paper grain
recycled fiber
analogue noise
soft printing imperfections
faint topographic texture
Texture opacity:
Below 15%.
The background must remain visually quiet.
The energy comes from:
THE EXPLORER
THE TERRAIN
THE PAINT FORM
THE TOPOGRAPHIC GRAPHICS.
PHASE 7 — COMPOSITION
MODEL POSITION:
Off-center.
Never dead center.
Place the explorer slightly toward the visual intersection of the composition.
NEGATIVE SPACE:
Approximately 18%.
Allow breathing room around the major elements.
LAYER ORDER:
01 BACKGROUND
02 PAPER TEXTURE
03 TOPOGRAPHIC MAP FRAGMENTS
04 PAINT FORM
05 HANDMADE GRAPHIC ELEMENTS
06 EXPLORER PHOTOGRAPH
07 PRODUCT
08 TYPOGRAPHY
09 MICRO INFORMATION
10 BRANDING
11 FOOTER
The explorer should appear to physically exist inside the collage.
MOVEMENT DIRECTION
TOP LEFT
↓
MOUNTAIN RIDGE
↓
EXPLORER
↓
BOTTOM RIGHT
The entire composition should feel as if it is moving toward an unseen destination.
The eye should travel naturally:
BRANDING
↓
HEADLINE
↓
FACE
↓
PRODUCT
↓
TRAIL
↓
CTA
PHASE 8 — VISUAL DEPTH
Create three distinct depth planes.
BACKGROUND:
Recycled paper, faint mountain forms and subtle map texture.
MIDGROUND:
Paint forms, contour lines, trail maps, compass graphics and altitude information.
FOREGROUND:
Explorer, product and typography.
Some contour lines should disappear behind the explorer.
Some typography should overlap the paint.
One small map element should overlap the subject subtly.
This creates the feeling of a physically assembled outdoor editorial collage rather than a flat AI composition.
PHASE 9 — BRAND DNA
The artwork must communicate Quechua’s core outdoor identity:
ACCESSIBLE ADVENTURE
EVERYDAY EXPLORATION
HIKING
OUTDOOR DISCOVERY
PRACTICAL INNOVATION
WEATHER READINESS
COMFORT
COMMUNITY
NATURE
MOVEMENT
The explorer should never look like an untouchable professional expedition athlete.
The campaign should make the viewer think:
“I could go there.”
That feeling is more important than displaying extreme athletic performance.
PHASE 10 — INFORMATION DESIGN
Introduce a small editorial information block.
Example:
01 / MOUNTAIN TRAIL
ALT. 2,480 M
HIKING / TREKKING
ALL-WEATHER EQUIPMENT
DISTANCE / 08.4 KM
Use tiny but perfectly legible typography.
Create visual hierarchy through:
scale
weight
spacing
alignment
Not through excessive colors.
PHASE 11 — SECONDARY COLLAGE FRAME
Introduce ONE small secondary photographic frame.
Place it asymmetrically.
Inside:
A secondary outdoor adventure moment.
For example:
a small group of hikers crossing a mountain trail.
Frame it with a thin outdoor-blue border.
Add:
02 / 04
MOUNTAIN COLLECTION
The secondary image must feel like part of a printed outdoor field journal.
It should support the campaign narrative without competing with the hero explorer.
PHASE 12 — FOOTER
Create a minimal bottom strip.
Include:
QUECHUA
DISCOVER MORE →

http://
DECATHLON.COM
OUTDOOR EQUIPMENT
Use very small clean typography.
Keep the footer extremely restrained.
No sale banner.
No clutter.
PHASE 13 — GRAPHIC IMPERFECTION
Introduce controlled imperfections characteristic of high-end physical outdoor collage:
slightly uneven paint edges
tiny ink inconsistencies
subtle map displacement
minor registration shift
hand-drawn contour variation
faint photocopy noise
slight paper edge wear
These details should make the artwork feel human-made.
The composition must still feel extremely polished.
Think:
ART-DIRECTED IMPERFECTION.
Not RANDOM IMPERFECTION.
PHASE 14 — LIGHTING & IMAGE QUALITY
The original outdoor photograph must retain premium commercial photography quality.
Natural mountain sunlight.
Strong directional light.
Realistic atmospheric depth.
Crisp highlights.
Controlled shadows.
Natural skin exposure.
Detailed technical fabric.
Realistic rock and vegetation texture.
Sharp hero product.
Natural environmental reflections.
No artificial HDR.
No plastic skin.
No beauty retouching.
No excessive clarity.
No fake cinematic glow.
No neon.
No fantasy lighting. over-saturated landscape.
PHASE 15 — FINAL ART DIRECTION
The final visual should look like a real campaign artwork created by:
A SENIOR SOCIAL MEDIA ART DIRECTOR
A PROFESSIONAL OUTDOOR PHOTOGRAPHER
A DIGITAL COLLAGE ARTIST
A TYPOGRAPHER
A MAP / EDITORIAL DESIGNER
Every element should appear intentional.
Every layer should have a purpose.
The explorer should provide realism.
The Quechua product should provide commercial relevance.
The typography should provide communication.
The mountain environment should provide emotion.
The map graphics should provide exploration.
The paint form should provide brand energy.
The paper texture should provide physicality.
The composition should provide movement.
FINAL FEEL
If:
QUECHUA
×
A CONTEMPORARY OUTDOOR MAGAZINE
×
A HAND-PAINTED MOUNTAIN POSTER
×
A TOPOGRAPHIC FIELD JOURNAL
×
A MODERN GRAPHIC DESIGN STUDIO
created one campaign together.
The final result should feel:
RAW.
HUMAN.
OUTDOOR.
TACTILE.
ADVENTUROUS.
ACCESSIBLE.
YOUTHFUL.
EXPLORATIVE.
REAL.
Not a catalogue.
Not a generic hiking advertisement.
Not a luxury outdoor campaign.
Not a travel-influencer post.
Not a corporate retail graphic.
Not an AI-generated mountain collage.
A genuine Quechua campaign where:
PHOTOGRAPHY + TERRAIN + PRODUCT + TYPOGRAPHY + TOPOGRAPHIC GRAPHICS + HANDCRAFTED COLLAGE
become one visual system.
FINAL GENERATION SPECIFICATION
Vertical 4:5
8K UHD
Hyper-realistic outdoor photography
Sony A1 II
85mm
f/2.8
Authentic human anatomy
Natural skin texture
Detailed technical outdoor apparel
Accurate Quechua product construction
Clean professional cutout
Outdoor blue / off-white / stone grey / forest green
Controlled graphic palette
Hand-painted collage elements
Topographic map graphics
Recycled paper texture
Editorial typography
Asymmetrical composition
Strong diagonal movement
18% negative space
Premium commercial photography
Contemporary digital collage
Behance front-page art direction
Instagram hero creative
Print-ready finish
High visual hierarchy
High brand recognition
ZERO AI SLOP

prompts.text:
QUECHUA —— “去户外玩。”
BEHANCE 级别数字拼贴活动
格式
超高端 QUECHUA 户外活动主视觉
垂直 4:5 Instagram 主打创意
Behance 首页质量
全球户外与徒步活动
资深社交媒体艺术指导
当代户外摄影 × 手工数字拼贴 × 编辑类平面设计
8K 超高清
超写实户外摄影
高端编辑类艺术指导
印刷级图形执行
高端商业探险活动
强视觉叙事
触感混合媒体美学
零 AI 废料
零通用的徒步广告
零图库照片感
零网红旅行美学
零公司目录布局
零豪华探险模仿
零随机图形装饰
最终作品必须感觉是由资深艺术总监精心设计，并由专业数字拼贴艺术家组装而成 —— 而不是作为一堆无关元素的集合生成的。
创意概念
活动：
“去户外玩。”
核心信息：
户外属于每一个人。
该活动庆祝离开平凡生活的本能。
下班后的一条小径。
周末的一座山。
一个寒冷早晨的远足。
天气的突然变化。
与朋友的一次长散步。
一个你从未探索过的地方。
Quechua 成为让日常探索成为可能的装备。
视觉应传达：
探索
自由
发现
冒险
运动
韧性
社区
户外生活
活动感觉应是：
真实的
冒险的
年轻的
原始的
乐观的
人性化的
充满活力的
易于亲近的
艺术指导
思考：
QUECHUA × 户外编辑 × 登山杂志 × 手工海报 × 地形图 × 当代数字拼贴
作品应将高度写实的户外摄影与显而易见的手工图形干预相结合。
对比至关重要：
真实的人
+
真实的户外环境
+
真实的 QUECHUA 产品
+
手工图形
+
地形信息
+
编辑类排版
不要让环境看起来像人造的奇幻景观。
山脉必须感觉物理上是真实的。
天气必须感觉真实。
服装必须看起来真正具有功能性。
人必须看起来像一个真正徒步的人。
引入受控的不完美感：
粗糙的纸张边缘
手绘标记
等高线
略微套印不准的油墨
丝网印刷纹理
剪纸形状
野外笔记标记
可见的纸张纤维
模拟颗粒
细微的复印纹理
这些不完美应感觉是经过精心艺术指导的。
绝不凌乱。
绝不业余。
第一阶段 —— 主角摄影
主体：
一名充满活力的日常户外探险者。
年龄：
20–30岁。
性别：
根据最强的视觉构图自动选择。
选角：
当代全球化且多样化。
此人必须看起来像真正的 Quechua 客户，而不是时装模特。
自然的面部结构。
自然的皮肤纹理。
真实的身体比例。
实用的户外形象。
无网红美学。
无豪华旅行美学。
无远征超人造型。
表情：
专注。
好奇。
自信。
自然。
微妙真实的微笑或专注的表情。
情感应传达：
“我想看看下一个拐角处是什么。”
动作
捕捉主角在户外运动的绝对巅峰时刻。
首选动作：
向山上徒步
越野跑
穿越岩石脊线
爬陡峭的小径
穿过森林
跳过小溪
下山路
在微雨中徒步
选择一个具有最强剪影的动作。
动作必须创造出强大的对角线。
身体应自然地从：
左上角
向
右下角 移动。
地形应强化运动方向。
捕捉真实的体力消耗。
靴子应与岩石、土壤或小径表面自然互动。
服装应随风和运动做出自然反应。
无不可能的身体姿势。
无悬空的脚。
无奇幻攀爬。
核心产品
仅限一个清晰可见的 QUECHUA 产品。
选择最能支持所选探险活动的产品。
例如：
QUECHUA 徒步夹克
QUECHUA 背包
QUECHUA 徒步靴
QUECHUA 抓绒衣
QUECHUA 雨衣
QUECHUA 登山裤
QUECHUA 帐篷
产品必须清晰辨认。
产品放置应感觉自然地融入探险中。
无漂浮的产品。
无重复的产品。
无产品阵容。
核心产品在探险者之后获得次要视觉重点。
保持准确的产品结构：
面料
缝线
拉链
搭扣
背带
口袋
防水细节
鞋底构造
技术材料
品牌标识
摄影风格
高端编辑类户外活动摄影。
真实自然的光线。
纪实探险能量。
真实的山地氛围。
自然的皮肤。
高分辨率的面料细节。
真实的地形。
相机：
SONY A1 II
镜头：
85mm
光圈：
f/2.8
相机位置：
略微低角度的主角透视。
剪裁：
根据动作进行 3/4 全身或全身剪裁。
在拼贴需要时，探险者必须通过极其干净的专业扣图进行孤立。
保留：
发丝细节
织物边缘
手部
靴子
背包带
装备
自然运动
无人工抠图光晕。
无白色轮廓。
无过度锐化。
第二阶段 —— 色彩基础
主要的 QUECHUA 户外蓝
使用强烈的户外启发式 Quechua 蓝作为主要图形点缀。
辅助色彩：
灰白色
暖石灰色
深森林绿
色调应与以下内容相连：
山间天空
岩石
森林
小径
技术户外装备
保持图形系统的受控。
避免过多的颜色。
主要油漆形态
创建一个巨大的不规则户外蓝油漆形态。
占据大约：
构图的 45–55%。
该形状应作为拼贴的视觉基础。
外观：
手绘感
厚重的笔触纹理
有机边缘
干画笔的不完美感
可见的刷毛痕迹
细微的透明度变化
丝网印刷特征
纸张互动
油漆应感觉是物理应用在回收的探险纸上。
不是平滑的数字色块。
不是通用的矢量形状。
探险者应与油漆形态重叠。
产品必须保持完全可见。
第三阶段 —— 拼贴系统
引入恰好五个主要的手工图形元素。
从中选择：
地形等高线
路径路线图
手绘圆圈
指南针符号
高度标记
山脉剪影
GPS 坐标标记
海拔图表
手绘箭头
天气符号
地形图碎片
半色调网点
野外笔记标记
每个元素必须有视觉目的。
不要随机散射图形。
图形应强化：
方向
高度
位置
距离
地形
探索
使用非对称放置。
创造强烈的对角线节奏。
一些元素可能穿过探险者后方。
一些可能部分消失在排版下方。
一到两个图形元素可以微妙地重叠在主体上以创造物理深度。
材料语言
像从探险者的野外笔记本中物理组装一样构建拼贴。
包括细微的：
撕裂的纸张边缘
折叠的地图碎片
丝网印刷纹理
复印痕迹
墨水晕染
干画笔痕迹
回收纸张纤维
地形印刷
手写的路线标记
细微的套准偏移
模拟颗粒
作品应具有触感。
它应该像：
一张登山地图
一本户外杂志
一张手工制作的探险海报。
不要过度使用纹理。
第四阶段 —— 排版
主要标题：
PLAY OUTSIDE.
使其成为仅次于探险者的第二大视觉元素。
大号加粗大写几何无衬线体。
极强的字重。
紧凑的行距。
紧凑的构图。
最小的字间距。
允许轻微 2–4° 的旋转。
排版应感觉是物理印刷在作品上的。
不漂浮。
不光滑。
不是 3D 的。
不具未来感。
排版应与拼贴互动。
允许：
部分剪裁
层级重叠
遮罩
油漆遮断
地图线遮断
边缘剪裁
主要文案：
PLAY OUTSIDE.
辅助文案：
Built for whatever the trail brings.
保持辅助文案小巧且高度可读。
排版层级
01
QUECHUA 品牌
02
PLAY OUTSIDE.
03
Built for whatever the trail brings.
04
路线 / 高度 / 探险信息
05
探索更多
标题即使在 Instagram 缩略图尺寸下也必须保持瞬间可读。
第五阶段 —— QUECHUA 品牌
将官方 QUECHUA 品牌标识放置在左上角。
保留：
正确的比例
安全距离
准确的文字商标
品牌完整性
不要变形。
不要拉伸。
不要将徽标放置在不必要的特效中。
小型辅助行：
OUTDOOR EQUIPMENT
品牌应保持可见，但不应与以下内容竞争：
PLAY OUTSIDE.
第六阶段 —— 背景
背景颜色：
温暖的浅石灰色
背景应类似于高端回收探险纸。
添加极其细微的：
纸张颗粒
回收纤维
模拟噪声
柔和的印刷不完美感
隐约的地形纹理
纹理透明度：
低于 15%。
背景必须保持视觉上的安静。
能量来自：
探险者
地形
油漆形态
地形图形。
第七阶段 —— 构图
模特位置：
偏离中心。
绝不在正中心。
将探险者放置在构图的视觉交叉点附近。
留白：
大约 18%。
在主要元素周围留出呼吸空间。
图层顺序：
01 背景
02 纸张纹理
03 地形图碎片
04 油漆形态
05 手工图形元素
06 探险者照片
07 产品
08 排版
09 微观信息
10 品牌
11 页脚
探险者应看起来物理上存在于拼贴内部。
运动方向
左上角
↓
山脊
↓
探险者
↓
右下角
整个构图应感觉像是在向一个看不见的目的地移动。
视线应自然流动：
品牌
↓
标题
↓
脸部
↓
产品
↓
小径
↓
行动呼吁 (CTA)
第八阶段 —— 视觉深度
创建三个明显的深度平面。
背景：
回收纸、隐约的山形和细微的地图纹理。
中景：
油漆形态、等高线、路线图、指南针图形和高度信息。
前景：
探险者、产品和排版。
一些等高线应消失在探险者身后。
一些排版应与油漆重叠。
一个小的地图元素应微妙地重叠在主体上。
这创造了物理组装的户外编辑拼贴感，而不是平淡的 AI 构图。
第九阶段 —— 品牌基因
作品必须传达 Quechua 的核心户外身份：
易于亲近的探险
日常探索
徒步
户外发现
实用创新
全天候准备
舒适
社区
自然
运动
探险者绝不应看起来像遥不可及的专业远征运动员。
该活动应让观众心想：
“我也能去那里。”

prompts.text:
Generate a vertical 9:16, 3x3 nine-grid photo collection, all 9 photos featuring the same adult female, maintaining highly consistent facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, and body proportions.

Overall theme: Records of a KPOP girl group member's daily work and private life, but not professionally edited promotional photos, but a set of 'failed but unexpectedly atmospheric' mobile phone snaps. Realistic, relaxed, slightly messy, like unpublished life fragments in a phone album.

The 9 frames respectively show different states:
Slumped on the floor resting in a dance studio, suddenly looking back halfway through backstage makeup, too sleepy to open eyes in the back of a van, dazing out while working late in front of an office computer, buying things late at night in a convenience store, curled up on the sofa scrolling through a phone after returning home, just finished washing hair in loose loungewear in front of the bathroom mirror, tidying clothes by the bedroom bed, sitting by the bed drinking water just after waking up in the early morning.

Incorporate slightly intimate but natural shooting angles: door crack perspective, low tabletop camera angle, bedside perspective, mirror reflection, over-the-shoulder candid feel, tilted composition from a phone held casually. Focus on the sense of distance in life, no intentional sexy poses.

The photos intentionally preserve a 'sense of failure': slight hand-shake, motion blur, focus shift, person slightly cropped out, moments of closed eyes, failed expression management, messy hair, tilted composition, occasional overexposure, foreground obstruction, mobile phone night scene noise.

Contrast between KPOP idol aura and ordinary girl life: exquisite on stage, but sleepy, tired, dazing out, no-makeup look, wearing loose hoodies and loungewear in private. A mix of cool white indoor lights, warm yellow bedroom lights, and city night lights, iPhone original camera texture, real skin texture, no skin smoothing, no over-beautification, no studio feel.

Each grid of the nine-grid is a different time, different action, different camera angle, and different expression, like random photos flipped out of a phone album over several consecutive days. No text, no watermarks, no logos.

items.title: 梦幻宁静水下东亚女性写实肖像

prompts.text:
Create a dreamy, tranquil live-action underwater portrait of a clearly adult East Asian woman in her early twenties floating weightlessly within a deep aquatic sanctuary. The atmosphere conveys quiet wonder, serenity, and complete surrender to the surrounding water, as though time has slowed almost to stillness. Keep the ethereal quality grounded in real underwater phenomena: filtered surface light, suspended particles, gentle buoyancy, natural haze, subtle refraction, drifting jellyfish, and physically believable optical distortion rather than overt fantasy effects.

She has a softly elongated oval face, gentle full cheeks, a smooth tapered jawline, a small rounded chin, and fair light neutral-warm skin. Her medium almond-shaped dark eyes have subtly raised outer corners beneath straight, moderately thick dark eyebrows. She has a slender straight nose with a delicate rounded tip and medium-small natural lips with a slightly fuller lower lip. Preserve visible skin texture, fine tonal variation, and subtle natural asymmetry. Her physique is distinctly slender, narrow, and elongated, with a light feminine frame, relatively narrow shoulders, a long slender neck, narrow ribcage and torso, defined natural waist, gently wider hips, and long lean limbs.

Her dark brown hair is medium-long and loose, spreading freely through the water in separated buoyant strands around her head and shoulders. Her eyes remain open underwater, gazing quietly toward the illuminated surface, while her lips rest slightly parted. She wears a minimal pale light-blue slip dress with thin spaghetti straps and a deep V-neckline. The lightweight fabric follows her slender silhouette while floating naturally away from the body at the hem and folds, responding convincingly to the surrounding water without becoming stiff or sculptural.

Photograph her in a vertical medium portrait as she drifts diagonally through the frame, her upper body gently arched backward and her face angled toward the light above. The camera is positioned slightly below and to one side rather than directly frontal, looking upward across her floating figure toward the brighter water surface. One arm hangs loosely beneath her while the other drifts outward with relaxed fingers, giving the pose an unforced sense of suspension. Her hair, dress, and limbs should all respond to the same slow underwater current.

Several translucent white and pale-blue jellyfish drift at different distances around her. Place one softly out of focus in the near foreground, several around the midground without obscuring her face, and smaller silhouettes deeper in the surrounding blue water. Their bells and trailing tentacles remain naturally translucent and illuminated by the same ambient light, with no artificial glow. Fine suspended particles and occasional tiny air bubbles catch the light at different depths, strengthening the sense of physical space.

Use premium live-action feature-film underwater cinematography with natural photographic realism, believable human anatomy, tactile fabric, physically coherent buoyancy, and authentic underwater optics. Soft shafts of cool daylight descend from the distant surface, creating delicate moving caustic patterns and gradual cyan-to-deep-blue tonal falloff. Use a moderate wide-normal underwater perspective around 35mm equivalent, close enough for emotional intimacy while retaining surrounding depth. Keep contrast gentle, highlights diffused, and depth of field naturally shallow toward the foreground jellyfish while her face remains clearly resolved. The final image should resemble footage captured during a carefully controlled professional underwater production, not anime, illustration, CGI, or stylized 3D rendering. No additional people, no decorative text, and no overt magical effects.
Aspect Ratio: 4:5

prompts.text:
创建一张梦幻、宁静的真人实拍水下肖像，画面中是一位二十多岁、明显成年的东亚女性，在深邃的水下避难所中无重力地漂浮。氛围传达出宁静的惊叹、安详以及对周围水分的完全屈服，仿佛时间已经减慢到近乎静止。保持空灵的特质，并立足于真实的水下现象：过滤后的表面光线、悬浮颗粒、轻柔的浮力、自然的薄雾、细微的折射、漂浮的水母以及物理上可信的光学畸变，而非明显的幻想效果。

她有一张柔和拉长的椭圆脸，圆润柔和的双颊，平滑收窄的下颚线，小巧圆润的下巴，以及白皙、浅色且中性偏暖的皮肤。她中等大小的杏仁状深色眼睛在笔直且厚度适中的深色眉毛下，外眼角略微上扬。她有一个纤细挺拔的鼻子，带有一个精致圆润的鼻尖，以及中等偏小的自然嘴唇，下唇略微丰满。保留可见的皮肤纹理、细腻的色调变化和细微的自然不对称感。她的体型明显纤细、狭窄且修长，带有轻盈的女性骨架，肩膀相对较窄，颈部细长，胸腔和躯干狭窄，腰线自然清晰，臀部略宽，四肢修长纤瘦。

她的深褐色头发中长且蓬乱，在她的头部和肩膀周围呈分离的漂浮发丝自由地散开。她的眼睛在水下保持睁开，静静地注视着被照亮的表面，而她的嘴唇微张。她穿着一件极简的淡浅蓝色吊带裙，带有细长的细肩带和深V领口。轻盈的面料顺着她纤细的轮廓，在裙摆和褶皱处自然地漂离身体，对周围的水做出令人信服的反应，而不会变得僵硬或具有雕塑感。

以垂直的中景肖像拍摄她，她斜向漂浮在画面中，上身轻轻后仰，脸部朝向上方的光线。摄像机位于侧下方，而不是正前方，向上穿过她漂浮的身躯望向更亮的水面。一只手臂松散地垂在身下，另一只手臂向外漂浮，手指放松，使姿势有一种不费力的悬浮感。她的头发、裙子和四肢都应该对同一股缓慢的水下水流做出反应。

几只半透明的白色和淡蓝色水母在她的周围以不同的距离漂浮。将一只轻轻地放在近景的焦外，几只放在中景但不遮挡她的脸，在周围深蓝色的水中放置更小的剪影。它们的水母体和拖曳的触须保持自然的半透明，并被相同的环境光照亮，没有人工光效。细腻的悬浮颗粒和偶尔的小气泡在不同深度捕捉光线，增强了物理空间感。

使用高级真人剧情长片水下摄影技术，具有自然的摄影写实主义、可信的人体解剖结构、触感真实的织物、物理连贯的浮力和真实的水下光学效果。冷色的日光光束从遥远的水面落下，产生细腻的动态焦散图案和渐变的青色到深蓝色的色调衰减。使用约35mm等效的中等广角到标准的水下视角，近到足以产生情感亲密度，同时保留周围的深度。保持对比度柔和，高光扩散，景深自然浅向前景水母，同时她的脸部保持清晰。最终图像应类似于在精心控制的专业水下制作中捕获的镜头，而不是动画、插图、CGI或风格化的3D渲染。没有额外的人，没有装饰性文字，也没有明显的魔法效果。

items.title: 复古中世纪风格旅行海报地标插画

prompts.text:
Create a 3:4 vertical retro travel poster featuring [Country / City Name] and its representative landmark [Building / Natural Landscape Name].

The overall style adopts Mid-century Vintage Travel Poster / Vintage Lithograph / Retro Tourism Poster, referencing the visual language of classic mid-20th-century aviation, railway, and national tourism promotional posters.

Main Subject:
Use [Landmark Name] as the absolute visual center; the building or landscape must have real, accurate, and clearly identifiable iconic silhouettes and structural features. Naturally include auxiliary elements such as [trees / mountains / rivers / lakes / streets / city skyline / clouds / vegetation] based on the actual local environment, but do not let them overshadow the main subject. The composition is simple, stable, possessing a monumental visual sense and a collectible travel poster feel.

Poster Layout:
Retain a wide warm ivory / beige old paper border on all sides, with the main image placed inside a thin-line rectangular frame.
At the top of the poster, use an extra-large, bold, geometric sans-serif English title:

[CITY / COUNTRY]

The letter spacing is slightly wide, with a deep dark green or deep blue-green ink effect. A minimalist thin horizontal line and a small geometric decorative symbol related to the local culture can be added above the title, but remain restrained and do not add redundant information.

Printing Texture:
Simulate real vintage Lithograph / Screen Printing / old magazine printing effects, adding fine halftone dots, paper fibers, ink particles, slight ink leakage, mild fading, faint overprint displacement, natural wear, small areas of white noise, and aged grain.
Maintain a clear sense of physical printing; do not use smooth digital illustration effects or modern 3D rendering feels.

Color Palette:
Use a limited color palette and low-saturation retro colors, dominated by grey-cyan-blue sky, deep dark green, warm beige, ochre, terracotta orange, faded red, and warm golden sunlight.
Highlights lean towards cream yellow and warm orange, while shadows lean towards deep cyan-green and blue-grey. The overall color is rich but not gaudy, possessing the synthesized tones of an old poster oxidized over time.

Lighting:
Soft morning or afternoon slanted sunlight, creating warm golden highlights on buildings and natural landscapes, forming a classic warm-cold contrast with the cyan-blue sky. Clouds are thick and soft, with an old printed magazine texture.

Overall Temperament:
nostalgic, timeless, elegant, cinematic, collectible, editorial, refined, poetic, sophisticated, archival travel poster aesthetic

Image Requirements:
Sophisticated composition, clear subject, natural negative space, rich details without clutter, ultra-high definition, possessing the high-end retro travel poster texture that is truly printable and collectible.

Avoid:
Modern commercial advertising feel, neon colors, high-saturation candy colors, smooth CG, plastic texture, AI over-sharpening, complex layout, large amounts of small text, random English, garbled characters, modern UI elements, excessive realistic photography feel, cartoonish feel, distortion of the main building.

prompts.text:
将【国家 / 城市名称】与其代表性地标【建筑 / 自然景观名称】创作成一张 3:4 竖版复古旅行海报。

items.title: 现代感创意食物文字交互海报提示词

prompts.text:
Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Food: [FOOD / PRODUCT]
Headline: [1 SHORT WORD]
Physical Interaction: [ROLL / TORCH / FOLD / GRATE / other physical action]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Product Name: [PRODUCT NAME]
Price: [PRICE]
Aspect Ratio: 9:16

Create a premium editorial food poster where real food physically interacts with and reshapes oversized typography, using a warm cream or ivory background, bold black Heavy Grotesk typography, photorealistic food materials, generous negative space, and a broken editorial grid inspired by contemporary European food branding and high-end magazine design.

The food and typography must exist inside the same physical world, the food should not simply overlap, decorate, or sit beside the letters, instead the selected physical action must visibly alter the typography through believable material behavior, geometry, heat, pressure, bending, abrasion, or surface transformation.

Examples: ROLL, a continuous food surface rolls into a spiral while the typography printed on that same surface bends, compresses, stretches, foreshortens, and wraps with it; TORCH, heat transforms a real sugar coating on the letters from dry crystals to molten sugar and then amber caramel glass while the black type underneath stays rigid; FOLD, typography printed directly onto a thin food surface follows the same crease, perspective compression, rotation, and occlusion as the food is physically folded; GRATE, a real grater removes material directly from the letters, revealing edible material inside while the removed type becomes realistic shavings and particles.

Use only one main physical mechanism per poster, keep the cause and effect visually clear, untouched areas of the typography should remain hard, clean, geometric, and readable, all deformation should happen only where the food, tool, heat, or physical force actually makes contact.

Use a broken editorial grid with strong scale contrast, asymmetric placement, edge information, small meaningful annotations, and large areas of negative space, add details such as [INGREDIENTS], [OPENING HOURS], [ADDRESS], and [PRODUCT NOTES], but avoid traditional menu rows, long horizontal divider lines, rigid bottom information bars, boxed prices, and template-like layouts.

Use bold Grotesk Sans Serif for the main headline, high-contrast Editorial Serif or Italic Serif for product names, quotes, and prices, keep the palette minimal with a cream background, black typography, natural food colors, and one accent color.

The final poster should feel clever, physical, premium, contemporary, and instantly readable at thumbnail size, the first glance should reveal the food and headline, the second glance should reveal the physical mechanism that has transformed the typography.

创建一个高级感编辑风格的食物海报，真实的食物与超大号的排版进行物理互动并重塑排版，使用温暖的奶油色或象牙色背景、加粗的黑色 Heavy Grotesk 排版、照片级的真实食物材质、大量的负空间，以及灵感源自当代欧洲食物品牌和高端杂志设计的破碎编辑网格。

食物与排版必须存在于同一个物理世界中，食物不应仅仅是重叠、装饰或坐在字母旁边，相反，所选的物理动作必须通过可信的材质行为、几何形状、热量、压力、弯曲、磨损或表面转变，肉眼可见地改变排版。

示例：ROLL（卷），连续的食物表面卷成螺旋状，而印在该表面上的排版随之弯曲、压缩、拉伸、缩短并包裹；TORCH（火喷），热量将字母上真实的糖涂层从干燥结晶转化为融化的糖，然后转化为琥珀色的焦糖玻璃，而下方的黑色字体保持刚性；FOLD（折叠），直接印在薄食物表面上的排版随着食物的物理折叠而遵循相同的褶皱、透视压缩、旋转和遮挡；GRATE（磨碎），真实的磨碎器直接从字母上移除材质，露出内部的可食用材质，而移除的字体变成真实的刨花和微粒。

每张海报仅使用一种主要的物理机制，保持因果关系在视觉上清晰，排版中未触及的区域应保持坚硬、干净、几何化且易读，所有变形应仅发生在食物、工具、热量或物理力量实际接触的地方。

使用带有强烈比例对比、非对称布局、边缘信息、小型有意义的注释以及大面积负空间的破碎编辑网格，添加诸如 [INGREDIENTS]（成分）、[OPENING HOURS]（营业时间）、[ADDRESS]（地址）和 [PRODUCT NOTES]（产品备注）等细节，但要避免传统的菜单行、长水平分割线、僵硬的底部信息栏、框起来的价格以及模版化的布局。

主标题使用加粗的 Grotesk Sans Serif，产品名称、引用语和价格使用高对比度的 Editorial Serif 或 Italic Serif，保持调色板极简，包含奶油色背景、黑色排版、天然食物颜色和一种强调色。

最终的海报应给人以巧妙、物理感、高级、当代且在缩略图尺寸下可立即阅读的感觉，第一眼应揭示食物和标题，第二眼应揭示改变了排版的物理机制。

items.title: 竖版双拼世纪中期现代风格插画

prompts.text:
Create a vertical split-style full illustration, with the vertical canvas divided 1:1 between top and bottom, overall resembling a retro and restrained design work. The upper half presents a refined version of the main subject from the uploaded original image, and the lower half presents a Mid-century Modern style reconstruction of the same subject.

Upper Half:
Use the uploaded original image as the sole subject reference source, automatically identify people, cats, dogs, or other common pets in the image, focusing on extracting the subject, and do not use architecture or complex environments as core content. Try to preserve the person's face shape, features, hairstyle, clothing, sense of age, temperament, and accessories, or the pet's fur color, pattern, face shape, ears, and body type. Simplify the background appropriately, the subject should be clear and complete, the composition stable, clean, and natural.

Lower Half:
Transform the same subject into a full illustration in the "Mid-century Modern" visual language. Core style features: 1950s to 60s simplified figures, Atomic Age geometry, warm retro colors, and paper grain. General principles: use clear geometric structures, flat color blocks, and ordered composition, controlling hierarchy and white space. The composition uses a single clear subject or a clear scene, the visual center is stable, the subject is complete and not cropped, the background is moderately simplified and retains breathing space; lines, color blocks, light and shadow, materials, and paper textures must serve the same style, without mixing in unrelated art styles. Simplify and organize the subject image using Mid-century Modern design language, emphasizing retro warm colors, Atomic Age geometric symbols, paper texture, and concise flattened human/pet shapes, giving the image a clear 50s-60s design poster and illustration temperament. The image should be natural, have a handmade feel and recognizable style characteristics, avoiding AI's common over-smoothness, meaningless accumulation of details, and random decorations.

Overall Requirements:
The upper and lower subjects must maintain obvious consistency; the lower half should be immediately recognizable as the Mid-century Modern version of the same subject in the upper half. Unless the theme explicitly requires it, do not generate text, logos, watermarks, borders, UIs, and no multi-image stitching.

将同一个主体转化为「Mid-century Modern 世纪中期现代」视觉语言的完整插画。核心风格特征：50 至 60 年代简化人物、原子时代几何、暖复古色和纸张颗粒。整体原则：采用清晰的几何结构、平面块面与秩序化构图，控制层级和留白。构图采用单一明确主体或一个清晰场景，视觉中心稳定，主体完整不被裁断，背景适度简化并保留呼吸感；线条、色块、明暗、材质和纸面纹理必须服务于同一风格，不混入无关画风。将主体形象以世纪中期现代设计语言进行简化和整理，强调复古暖色、原子时代几何符号、纸张质感和简练平面化人物/宠物造型，使画面呈现明显的 50–60 年代设计海报与插画气质。画面自然、有手作感和可识别的风格特征，避免 AI 常见的过度光滑、无意义细节堆砌和随机装饰。
整体要求：
上下主体必须保持明显一致性，下半部分能一眼看出是上半部分同一主体的世纪中期现代版。除非主题明确要求，否则不生成文字、Logo、水印、边框、UI，不做多图拼接。

items.title: 富士织物拼接风格旅行转绘海报

prompts.text: Create a vertical 3:4 top-bottom comparison travel conversion poster, in the style of 'FUJI TEXTILE TRAVEL | Fuji Textile Patchwork Travel Style'. The top half fully preserves the input real Japan travel photo: maintain the original location's main subject, quantity, composition, perspective, viewing angle, spatial relationships, and natural colors, applying only slight publication-style color grading; the photo must be clearly recognizable and cannot become an illustration or a small thumbnail. In the middle, use a restrained thin white divider line. The bottom half reconstructs the same scene as a handmade textile collage with real thickness, not a photo filter nor a flat vector illustration. Use off-white coarse woven fabric as the base, strictly mapping element by element from the original photo: mountains, lake water, torii gates, temples, streets, buildings, vehicles, people, trees, or the sky are converted respectively into layered fabric pieces, felt, suede fibers, embroidery threads, chain stitches, and a small amount of bead decorations; do not add elements that do not exist in the photo out of thin air. Water surfaces and roads use continuous curved or parallel stitches to express direction, while mountains and buildings use visible thick overlapping fabric edges to express volume; window panes, eaves, torii beams, and human silhouettes use fine stitches to maintain recognizability. The materials should have handmade sewing undulations, pinholes, fiber fraying, layered shadows, and local protrusions, forming a touchable three-dimensional fabric model. The bottom half retains the main outlines, subject count, and spatial relationships of the original photo, but allows for the subjects to be split, shrunk, displaced, and recombined with negative space, and cannot be a completely isomorphic or same-density replica of the top half. Colors are refined from the photo into a limited 4 to 7 colors, each varying with the original photo, not fixed to a Mount Fuji blue-red color scheme. Retain enough off-white coarse woven fabric empty space to give the fabric components and background a sense of breathing. Must not add text, location names, logos, watermarks, AI markers, or original photo markers; must not include plastic, metal, glass, 3D game assets, pure flat cartoons, photo collages, uniform mosaic filters, irrelevant landmarks, fake Chinese, or garbled characters.

prompts.text:
Create four independent portrait poster variations from the uploaded photo, all belonging to the same visual system.

Portrait: [use uploaded portrait]
Main color: [mint green / red / blue / yellow / custom]
Typography theme: [SIGNAL / MOTION / ECHO / MINT, or custom words]
Aspect ratio: 9:16

Keep the same person, facial identity, hairstyle, outfit, photographic realism, color palette, typography family, and editorial art direction across all four posters.

The four posters must feel like one cohesive fashion editorial series, but each must use a clearly different layout concept:

1. Vertical Type Layering
   Use oversized condensed typography as a strong vertical spine. Let letters move in front of and behind the portrait, creating clear depth and layered interaction.

2. Sliced Portrait
   Split the portrait into several clean horizontal sections and slightly offset each slice. Keep the face recognizable and beautiful. Avoid RGB glitch, noise, or digital distortion.

3. Echo Portrait
   Show the same subject twice using contrasting scale or orientation, such as one normal portrait and one enlarged flipped portrait. Use repeated typography or outline type to create a visual “echo.”

4. Portrait Inside Oversized Type
   Use huge bold typography as the main composition. Let parts of the face, eyes, lips, hair, or shoulders appear through and between the letterforms, so the portrait becomes integrated into the typography.

Use a modern fashion-editorial aesthetic with oversized condensed sans-serif type, strong portrait photography, clean geometric structure, generous negative space, fine rules, small meaningful editorial text, and subtle graphic blocks.

Keep the information hierarchy clear: large typography first, portrait second, small editorial text third.

Use meaningful supporting copy related to the visual concept rather than random placeholder text.

Keep skin realistic with natural texture, realistic hair strands, natural fabric folds, and photographic lighting. Avoid plastic skin, CGI appearance, excessive retouching, random symbols, meaningless text, heavy UI graphics, sparkles, numbering, NO., VOL., and decorative clutter.

Generate all four as separate standalone 9:16 posters, not combined into a single collage.

The figure has a naturally plump, slightly hourglass figure: moderate shoulders, full and natural chest, significantly narrowed waist, rounded hips, and thick, soft roots of the thighs. No paper-thin body, narrow hips and thin legs, or athletic muscles.

The upper body leans forward slightly, and the head is clearly tilted towards the figure's right side, near the back of the chair. The character has jet-black medium-length hair, loosely tied up at the back of the head, fixed with a conspicuous white/creamy white large ruffled scrunchie; natural side-parted wispy hair on the forehead, with a slender lock of bangs hanging down on each side to frame the cheeks. The legs wear smoky black ultra-thin semi-transparent pantyhose, about 10–15D, high transparency, clearly showing natural skin tone; the thighs, knees, and calves have soft silk light reflections, the surface of the stockings is delicate and even. Feet wear black shiny pointed-toe stiletto high heels, patent leather material, heels about 9–11cm, both the pointed toes and thin heels have obvious highlights, the shoe shape is elegant and slender.

The chair is an important element of the frame: a European classical Rococo style single armchair, dark brown carved solid wood frame, curved armrests and acanthus carvings, seat cushion and backrest covered with olive gold/dark green vintage floral damask, with golden brown patterns and old-style textile texture.

The lighting uses bright indoor soft light + natural light from the window, the figure's face, shoulders, neck, thighs, and stockings are uniformly bright, and the skin tone is a natural creamy white; the high heels and stockings have clear but not overexposed reflections. The overall color tone is lavender purple, olive gold, dark brown, smoky black, soft and retro.

Focus lock: Adult East Asian female + sitting curled in a classical armchair + knees tucked high and crossed + close-up perspective of plump thighs + gray-purple off-shoulder sheer top + dark short skirt + smoky black ultra-thin pantyhose + black pointed-toe patent leather stiletto high heels + loose updo + large white scrunchie + head tilted looking directly at the camera + green gold-patterned classical chair + retro European interior.

姿势重点：人物整个身体蜷缩在扶手椅中，双腿高高屈膝收向胸前，一条腿从另一条腿前方交叉叠放，大腿距离镜头最近，被广角自然放大；两只脚向画面右下方伸出。上半身略向前倾，头部明显向人物右侧歪斜，靠近椅背。双手在膝盖上方轻轻交叠、手指靠拢，动作安静、自然。

人物留乌黑色中长发，后脑松散挽起，用一个明显的白色 / 奶油白色大号褶皱发圈固定；额前为自然侧分碎发，两侧各垂下一缕细长刘海修饰脸颊。脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，肤色白皙，眼妆为细长黑色眼线、柔和玫瑰棕眼影和清晰睫毛，腮红淡粉，嘴唇为水润珊瑚红。双眼直视镜头，神情安静、柔和，嘴唇微张。

上身穿一件低饱和薰衣草紫 / 灰紫色薄纱上衣，宽松柔软，深 V 领，肩部自然滑落形成露肩穿法，袖子为半透明轻薄雪纺，长度约到手肘附近，布料在肩颈和手臂处形成自然褶皱。下身穿深灰黑色修身超短裙 / 短款下装，大部分被蜷起的双腿遮挡，只在腰胯位置露出少量布料。

双腿穿烟黑色超薄半透明连裤丝袜，约 10–15D，透明度高，明显透出自然肤色；大腿、膝盖和小腿带柔和丝光反射，袜面细腻均匀。脚穿黑色亮面尖头细高跟鞋，漆皮材质，高跟约 9–11cm，尖鞋头和细跟都有明显高光，鞋型优雅修长。

椅子是画面重要元素：欧洲古典洛可可风单人扶手椅，深棕色雕花实木框架，弧形扶手和卷草雕刻，坐垫与靠背覆盖橄榄金 / 墨绿色复古花卉锦缎，带金棕色花纹和旧式织物质感。

背景为精致复古房间：下半墙是白色竖向护墙板，上半墙为低饱和灰绿色暗纹壁纸；左上有窗户，配奶油白纱帘和橄榄金色厚窗帘；右上角露出一部分雕花复古镜框。地面为深灰木纹地板。

避免：纤细纸片身材、裸腿、厚黑丝袜、网袜、粗跟鞋、运动鞋、站姿、普通坐姿、双腿伸直、长发完全披散、现代极简家具、强直闪、过度背景虚化、动漫脸、CG感、塑料皮肤、多余肢体、水印和乱码文字。

prompts.text: Create a vertical 2:3 indie travel newspaper collage poster with the theme [[CITY], [COUNTRY]]. Use [CITY] as the sole city main title, and generate content based on the city's real landmarks, neighborhoods, transportation, food, architecture, nature, and lifestyle. Do not make it a single photo; it should be like an indie travel newspaper pieced together from real printed fragments. The entire canvas uses a warm beige old newspaper base, with pulp fibers, creases, worn edges, slight stains, old ink bleeding, and uneven printing. Use modular editorial collage: split into multiple photo sections of varying sizes but clear order, receipt fragments, postmarks, map segments, coordinates, color palettes, thin lines, numbers, and small description columns. There are slight misalignments, overlaps, crops, and offset print edges between photo sections, as if real paper had been cut out and rearranged. Place a huge English city title "[CITY]" at the top or top left, cropped by the edges of the frame, using heavy vintage serif or condensed newspaper fonts. Include short and accurate editorial information around it: "TRAVEL FILE", "CITY NOTES", "NO. 07", "[CITY] · [COUNTRY]", "PEOPLE · PLACES · CULTURE · EVERYDAY LIFE". All text must be clear and correctly spelled; do not generate fake Chinese or gibberish. The photo and image content should include at least 6 types of real travel elements from [CITY]: representative landmarks or skyline, neighborhoods or markets, local transportation, night or lighting scenes, food or daily life details, nature or distant view elements. Add a simplified city map and a fragment of a receipt, ticket, or postmark. Each section serves the city narrative, avoiding repeating the same perspective. Overall use old paper warm beige, carbon black, faded brick red, deep indigo, grayish green, and a small amount of ochre yellow. Photos are primarily black and white, warm gray, or low-saturation duotone, with a few sections retaining the city's representative colors. Add halftone dots, photocopy grain, screen printing textures, overprint shifts, faded edges, paper fold lines, and slight ink wear, while keeping the main photo subjects and landmarks recognizable. The composition should have a clear editorial hierarchy: one giant title, 2–3 main photo sections, several auxiliary small sections, receipts, maps, color palettes, and paper gaps. Prohibit modern UI, clean digital grids, full-page single photos, random irrelevant objects, futuristic sci-fi elements, brand logos, watermarks, AI badges, and original image badges. Optional variables: [CITY]: TOKYO, PARIS, SHANGHAI, LISBON, etc. [COUNTRY]: English name of the country or region. [LANDMARKS]: Specify 2–4 real landmarks, neighborhoods, or transportation.

prompts.text:
制作一张竖版 2:3 的独立旅行报纸拼贴海报，主题为【[CITY]，[COUNTRY]】。将 [CITY] 作为唯一城市主标题，并根据该城市真实的地标、街区、交通、食物、建筑、自然和生活方式生成内容。不要做成单张照片，应像一张由真实印刷碎片拼成的独立旅行报纸。
整张画布使用暖米色旧报纸底，带纸浆纤维、折痕、边角磨损、轻微污渍、旧墨渗透和不均匀印刷。使用模块化编辑拼贴：拆分成多个尺寸不一但秩序清楚的照片版块、票据碎片、邮戳、地图局部、坐标、色卡、细线、编号和小型说明栏。照片版块之间有轻微错位、重叠、裁切和胶印边缘，像真实纸张被剪下后重新排版。
顶部或左上放置巨大、被画面边缘裁切的英文城市标题“[CITY]”，使用粗重的复古衬线或窄体报刊字体。周围加入简短准确的编辑信息：“TRAVEL FILE”、“CITY NOTES”、“NO. 07”、“[CITY] · [COUNTRY]”、“PEOPLE · PLACES · CULTURE · EVERYDAY LIFE”。所有文字必须清晰、拼写正确，不生成假中文或乱码。
照片与图像内容至少包含 6 类 [CITY] 真实旅行元素：代表性地标或天际线、街区或市场、本地交通工具、夜间或灯光场景、食物或日常生活细节、自然或远景元素。再加入一块简化城市地图和一张票据、车票或邮戳碎片。每个版块都服务于城市叙事，避免重复相同角度。
整体使用旧纸暖米色、炭黑、褪砖红、深靛蓝、灰绿和少量赭黄。照片以黑白、暖灰或低饱和双色为主，少量版块保留城市代表色。加入半调网点、复印颗粒、丝网印刷纹理、套印偏移、褪色边缘、纸张折线和轻微墨迹磨损，但保持照片主体和地标可辨认。
构图要有清晰编辑层级：一个巨型标题、2–3 个主要照片版块、若干辅助小版块、票据、地图、色卡和纸张间隙。禁止现代 UI、干净数字网格、全页单张照片、随机无关物件、未来科幻元素、品牌 Logo、水印、AI 角标和原图角标。
可选变量：
[CITY]：TOKYO、PARIS、SHANGHAI、LISBON 等
[COUNTRY]：国家或地区英文名
[LANDMARKS]：指定 2–4 个真实地标、街区或交通工具

items.title: 写实摄影与几何扁平插画对比海报

prompts.text:
Using the uploaded photo, create a vertical 3:4 “before-and-after” comparison poster. If multiple photos are uploaded, create one separate poster for each photo; do not mix different photos on the same page. The upper and lower sections should each occupy exactly half of the total height, with a seamless transition between them. Do not add borders, arrows, or “Before” / “After” labels.

【TOP SECTION: ORIGINAL PHOTO】  
The top section should use the uploaded original photo, filling the full width of the canvas. Preserve the original subject, pose/action, scene, natural lighting, and dominant color palette. Only allow subtle overall color adjustments; do not change the atmosphere or add any filter effects. Maintain the photo’s original aspect ratio and do not stretch the subject. To fit the top section, you may crop unimportant edges; if cropping would remove the main subject, prioritize adding a small amount of background instead, but never invent or alter the subject or key elements of the scene.

【BOTTOM SECTION: GEOMETRIC ABSTRACT】  
Using the same photo from the top section as the only reference, recreate the core subject and a few key environmental elements as a hard-edged, geometric, flat-style illustration. Do not add any people, animals, objects, or actions that were not present in the original photo. Preserve the core subject’s left/right position, pose, direction, interactions, and major occlusion relationships from the photo so that the top and bottom sections appear visually aligned at first glance; however, there is no need to reproduce the image pixel-for-pixel.

Remove secondary background elements and insignificant details. The subject may be scaled down slightly to create generous negative space around it. Construct objects using a limited number of polygons of varying sizes, simplified curves, and solid color blocks. Preserve enough of the subject’s silhouette, movement, and defining characteristics so that it remains recognizable as the specific subject from the original photo; do not reduce it to a generic icon.

Use adjacent color blocks of different shapes and brightness levels to define structure. Do not use gradients, outlines, 3D shadows, or realistic textures. Extract approximately 5–6 representative colors from the original photo and organize them into a cohesive palette with slightly reduced saturation. Use a warm off-white/beige tone as the background color for the lower section. Reserve the darkest tones for a few visual focal points, and retain one accent color that echoes the original photograph. Do not arbitrarily change the most recognizable colors of the core subject.

Keep all geometric edges crisp and sharp. Add only an extremely subtle printed grain texture within the color blocks, with slight registration misalignment allowed on a few edges. Do not render the entire image with a rough paper texture or glitch-art effect.

【TEXT】  
Add a small amount of archival-style typography to the lower section: automatically generate a short English title based on the content of the photo, accompanied by the small number “NO. 023”. Place the title in an area of negative space where it does not obstruct the subject, and position the number diagonally opposite the title to create visual balance.

Do not fabricate real locations, dates, identities, or events, and do not add overly dense explanatory text. The overall composition should resemble a page from a contemporary art book: a rich, realistic photograph on top paired with a bold, highly simplified, orderly geometric interpretation beneath it.

Keep the overall work restrained, gentle, and distinctive. Avoid cartoon-like faces, 3D effects, plastic-like materials, clashing neon colors, or random doodles.

prompts.text:
使用上传的照片，创建一个垂直 3:4 的“前后”对比海报。如果上传了多张照片，为每张照片分别创建一个海报；不要在同一页中混合不同的照片。上下部分应各占总高度的恰好一半，两者之间无缝衔接。不要添加边框、箭头或“Before” / “After”标签。

【顶部区域：原始照片】  
顶部区域应使用上传的原始照片，填满画布的整个宽度。保留原始主体、姿势/动作、场景、自然光影和主导色调。仅允许细微的整体色彩调整；不要改变氛围或添加任何滤镜效果。保持照片的原始宽高比，不要拉伸主体。为了适应顶部区域，您可以裁剪不重要的边缘；如果裁剪会移除主要主体，请优先添加少量背景，但切勿虚构或更改场景的主体或关键元素。

【底部区域：几何抽象】  
仅以顶部区域的同一张照片为参考，将核心主体和几个关键环境元素重新创作为硬边、几何、扁平风格的插画。不要添加原始照片中不存在的人物、动物、物体或动作。保留照片中核心主体的左右位置、姿势、方向、交互和主要的遮挡关系，使上下两部分在视觉上乍看之下是对齐的；但是，不需要像素级地还原图像。

移除次要的背景元素和无关紧要的细节。主体可以略微缩小，以在其周围创造充足的负空间。使用有限数量的各种大小的多边形、简化的曲线和纯色块来构建物体。保留足够的主体轮廓、动作和定义特征，使其依然可以被识别为原始照片中的特定主体；不要将其还原为通用的图标。

使用不同形状和亮度的相邻色块来定义结构。不要使用渐变、轮廓、3D 阴影或写实纹理。从原始照片中提取大约 5–6 种代表性颜色，并将它们组织成一个饱和度略微降低的协调色盘。使用温暖的米白色/米色作为下半部分的背景色。将最深的色调保留给少数视觉焦点，并保留一种与原始照片呼应的强调色。不要随意更改核心主体最具辨识度的颜色。

保持所有几何边缘清晰锐利。仅在色块内添加极细微的印刷颗粒纹理，允许在少数边缘出现轻微的对齐偏移。不要用粗糙的纸张纹理或故障艺术效果渲染整个图像。

【文本】  
在底部区域添加少量的档案风格排版：根据照片内容自动生成一个简短的英文标题，并配以小数字“NO. 023”。将标题放置在不阻碍主体的负空间区域，并将数字放置在标题的对角线位置以创造视觉平衡。

不要虚构真实的地点、日期、身份或事件，也不要添加过于密集的说明性文字。整体构图应类似于当代艺术书籍的一页：顶部是丰富、写实的照片，下方是与其配对的大胆、高度简化、有序的几何诠释。

保持整体作品克制、柔和且独特。避免卡通式的面孔、3D 效果、塑料感的材质、冲突的霓虹色或随意的涂鸦。

prompts.text:
