Create a premium editorial food poster where real food physically interacts with and reshapes oversized typography, using a warm cream or ivory background, bold black Heavy Grotesk typography, photorealistic food materials, generous negative space, and a broken editorial grid inspired by high-end European food branding and contemporary magazine design.

The food must not simply overlap or sit beside the letters, treat the food and typography as objects inside the same physical world, the selected interaction should visibly alter the structure, surface, or material behavior of the letterforms through clear and believable physics.

Examples: TWIST, long food elements wrap around, pass in front of and behind, tighten around, and subtly pull selected letter strokes; SNAP, the food fractures along a clear force line and the typography breaks along the same continuous axis with small structural offsets; DRIP, a real liquid or glaze flows over the letters, gradually covering and replacing parts of the geometric type with edible material; PEEL, the surface of a letter is physically removed to reveal a different edible material underneath, with the peeled layer remaining visibly connected and curling away.

Keep the interaction focused on one main physical mechanism, localized deformations should follow real contact, weight, tension, gravity, viscosity, fracture, or material separation, untouched areas of the typography should remain clean, hard, geometric, and readable, avoid random liquify effects, decorative overlap, generic 3D lettering, floating food pieces, or digital-looking distortion.

Use a broken editorial grid with strong scale contrast, asymmetric placement, edge information, large negative space, and small meaningful annotations such as [INGREDIENTS], [OPENING HOURS], and [ADDRESS], avoid traditional menu rows, long horizontal divider lines, boxed prices, rigid bottom information bars, and template-like layouts.

Use bold Grotesk Sans Serif for the main typography, high-contrast Editorial Serif or Italic Serif for product names, quotes, and prices, keep the palette minimal with a cream background, black typography, natural food colors, and one accent color.

The final image should feel clever, physical, premium, contemporary, and immediately understandable at thumbnail size, the first glance should reveal the food and headline, the second glance should reveal how the food has physically changed the typography.

示例：TWIST（扭曲），长条状食品元素缠绕、穿过字母的前后、收紧并微妙地拉动选定的字母笔画；SNAP（断裂），食品沿清晰的受力线断裂，且排版沿相同的连续轴线断裂，带有小的结构偏移；DRIP（滴落），真实的液体或釉料流过字母，逐渐覆盖并用可食用材料替换部分几何文字；PEEL（剥离），字母表面被物理移除，露出下面不同的可食用材料，剥离层保持可见的连接并卷曲。

将交互集中在一种主要的物理机制上，局部变形应遵循真实的接触、重量、张力、重力、粘度、断裂或材料分离，排版中未触及的区域应保持干净、坚硬、几何化且易读，避免随机的液化效果、装饰性重叠、通用的 3D 文字、漂浮的食物碎片或具有数码感的扭曲。

主排版使用粗体 Grotesk 无衬线体，产品名称、引语和价格使用高对比度的社论衬线体（Editorial Serif）或斜体衬线体，保持配色极简，采用奶油色背景、黑色排版、自然的食品颜色和一种强调色。

prompts.text:
## [Subject Description]

A photorealistic full-body sports portrait of a young adult East Asian woman with a Hourglass figure, naturally proportioned athletic physique and fair skin. She has a softly oval face, delicate facial features, dark almond-shaped eyes, straight natural eyebrows, a small nose, and soft pink lips. She is smiling brightly with a lively, cheerful expression, looking slightly to her right.

Her short-to-medium dark black hair is straight with full blunt bangs, slightly curved inward at the ends, framing her face and reaching around the jawline to neck. Small colorful hair accessories are visible near both sides of her hair.

She is performing an exaggerated high-leg pitching pose on a baseball field: one leg is firmly planted on the ground while the other leg is raised extremely high diagonally upward, creating a strong dynamic split-like pitching silhouette. Her raised leg is extended straight with the foot pointed upward. She leans forward slightly while both hands hold a colorful baseball glove low in front of her body.

She wears a fitted professional baseball-style uniform consisting of a white short-sleeve top with blue trim, a blue collar, dark navy/black body panels, and visible sports/team-style markings and number graphics. She wears a dark short skirt or shorts integrated into the uniform, opaque black full-length tights, and black-and-white athletic baseball shoes with vivid pink shoelaces. She wore a baseball glove featuring a mix of blue, yellow, white, and brown on her left hand, while her right hand rested upon the glove.

## [Scene/Background]

An outdoor professional baseball field during a game or practice session. The foreground and lower background contain vivid green natural grass, with a reddish-brown clay infield/pitching area behind and around the subject. A narrow white pitching-line or base marking is visible beneath her planted foot. The background is clean and softly blurred, with no distracting spectators or unnecessary objects.

## [Lighting/Atmosphere]

Bright natural daylight with clear, even illumination. Soft directional sunlight produces realistic highlights on the hair, face, uniform, tights, shoes, and glove while retaining natural shadow detail. Fresh, energetic, sporty atmosphere with vivid but realistic field colors. High clarity and crisp subject separation.

## [Composition/Viewpoint]

Vertical full-body composition, portrait orientation. The entire figure is visible from the raised shoe at the upper-left area to the planted shoe at the bottom. Camera positioned approximately at eye-to-waist height with a slightly low perspective that emphasizes the dramatic height and extension of the raised leg. Three-quarter frontal view.

The subject is centered slightly right of frame, with the raised leg extending diagonally toward the upper-left corner to create a strong dynamic leading line. The planted leg forms a stable vertical anchor. Both the face and the unusual pitching posture remain clearly visible. Moderate background depth of field keeps the woman and sports equipment sharply detailed while softly blurring the baseball field.

She possesses the best head-to-body ratio, a perfect, curvaceous, S-shaped female figure,Hourglass figure,long legs with perfect leg lines, and a slender waist, perfect foots,perfect foot lines

## [Style Reference]

High-end photorealistic sports photography, professional baseball promotional photography, realistic human anatomy and proportions, authentic athletic posture, natural skin texture, realistic fabric and material rendering, crisp facial details, dynamic action composition, realistic outdoor sports environment, subtle telephoto compression, documentary-style realism. Avoid artificial glamour retouching, exaggerated body proportions, plastic skin, cartoon/anime styling, or studio aesthetics.

## [Quality Parameters]

Ultra-detailed photorealism, high-resolution image, sharp focus on the entire subject, realistic skin pores and hair strands, precise anatomy, natural hands and fingers, accurate footwear and baseball glove construction, detailed uniform fabric and stitching, realistic opaque tights with subtle fabric texture, clean edges, natural depth of field, balanced exposure, realistic color reproduction, fine micro-details, minimal motion blur, professional sports-camera image quality, 4K–8K quality.

**Key constraints:** preserve the complete high-leg pitching pose, raised leg fully extended diagonally upward, planted supporting leg, black opaque tights, black-and-white shoes with vivid pink laces, professional baseball uniform, green grass and reddish-brown clay field, vertical full-body framing, and photorealistic natural anatomy,No cropped limbs or truncated feet.

prompts.text:
## [主体描述]

一位年轻东亚成年女性的写实全身运动肖像，拥有沙漏型身材、自然比例的运动体魄和白皙皮肤。她有着柔和的椭圆形脸庞，精致的面部特征，深色的杏仁形眼睛，笔直的自然眉毛，小巧的鼻子和柔和的粉红色嘴唇。她灿烂地微笑着，表情活泼开朗，稍微向右看。

她在棒球场上做一个夸张的高抬腿投球姿势：一条腿稳稳地踩在地上，另一条腿向斜上方极高地抬起，创造出一种强烈的动态劈叉式投球剪影。她抬起的腿笔直伸展，脚尖向上。她身体微微前倾，双手在身前低处握着一个彩色的棒球手套。

她穿着一套贴身的专业棒球风格制服，包括一件带有蓝色边饰的白色短袖上衣、蓝色领子、深海军蓝/黑色身体拼接，以及可见的运动/球队风格标记和数字图形。她穿着与制服融为一体的深色短裙或短裤，黑色不透明全长连裤袜，以及带有鲜艳粉红色鞋带的黑白运动棒球鞋。她的左手戴着一只结合了蓝色、黄色、白色和褐色的棒球手套，右手搭在手套上。

## [场景/背景]

比赛或练习期间的室外专业棒球场。前景和中后景包含鲜艳的绿色天然草地，主体身后和周围是红褐色的粘土内场/投手区。在她的支撑脚下可以看到一条窄窄的白色投球线或垒位标记。背景干净且轻微模糊，没有干扰性的观众或不必要的物体。

## [光照/氛围]

明亮的自然日光，照明清晰均匀。柔和的有向阳光在头发、面部、制服、连裤袜、鞋子和手套上产生逼真的高光，同时保留自然的阴影细节。清新、充满活力、具有运动气息的氛围，带有生动但写实的球场色彩。高清晰度和鲜明的主体分离。

## [构图/视角]

垂直全身构图，人像方向。从左上方抬起的鞋子到下方的支撑鞋，整个身体清晰可见。相机位置大约在眼睛到腰部的高度，视角略低，强调了抬起腿的戏剧性高度和延伸感。三分之二正面视角。

主体位于画面中心偏右位置，抬起的腿向左上角对角线延伸，形成强烈的动态引导线。支撑腿形成稳定的垂直锚点。面部和不寻常的投球姿势都清晰可见。中等的背景景深使女性和运动器材细节锐利，同时柔化棒球场。

她拥有最佳的头身比例，完美、玲珑、S型的女性身材，沙漏型身材，拥有完美腿部线条的长腿，以及纤细的腰部，完美的双脚，完美的足部线条。

## [风格参考]

高端写实运动摄影，专业棒球宣传摄影，真实的人体解剖结构和比例，真实的运动姿势，自然的皮肤纹理，逼真的织物和材料渲染，清晰的面部细节，动态的动作构图，真实的户外运动环境，细微的长焦压缩，纪录片式的现实主义。避免人工的磨皮美颜、夸张的身体比例、塑料感的皮肤、卡通/动漫风格或摄影棚美学。

## [质量参数]

超细节写实主义，高分辨率图像，整个主体的锐利聚焦，逼真的皮肤毛孔和发丝，精确的解剖结构，自然的手部和手指，准确的鞋履和棒球手套构造，详细的制服面料和缝线，带有细微面料纹理的逼真不透明连裤袜，干净的边缘，自然的景深，平衡的曝光，逼真的色彩还原，微小的细节，极少的运动模糊，专业运动相机画质，4K–8K画质。

**关键约束：** 保留完整的高抬腿投球姿势，抬起的腿向斜上方完全伸展，支撑腿踩地，黑色不透明连裤袜，带有鲜艳粉红色鞋带的黑白鞋子，专业棒球服，绿草和红褐色粘土球场，垂直全身取景，以及逼真的自然解剖结构，无肢体裁剪或残缺的双脚。

The cold light of the screen slightly illuminates the foreground wrist and the hair edges near the character's face, forming a natural light interaction with the dark parts of the environment. Strong perspective relationship: the foreground wrist and Apple Watch are significantly enlarged due to being close to the lens, the middle-ground watch is extremely close, and the background live-action body is relatively small. The overall goal is a balance between realistic photography and surreal visual illusions: like a conceptual fashion blockbuster shot on a real movie set, rather than CG, illustration or 2D rendering. Keep a very thin horizontal line in the upper right corner, add a small scribbled handwritten signature playforge on the line, about 80% transparency, low-profile, not competing with the main subject.

prompts.text:
超写实真人 COS 摄影，电影级时装人像质感，真实皮肤纹理、毛孔、细微汗湿高光与自然肤色层次，真实织物、金属、玻璃与电子屏幕材质。浅景深，柔和 bloom，低照度暗调摄影，克制的高光与浓郁阴影，电影级明暗层次，轻微胶片颗粒，细腻柔焦，低饱和冷色调，神秘、梦幻、压抑而高级的电影氛围。

角色：【角色名】成年真人 COS 版。由拥有电影演员质感与偶像级颜值的专业成年 Coser 演绎。自动保留原角色最核心的发型、发色、瞳色、代表性服装结构、标志性饰品、武器或符号，服装轻度融合日系制服与现代高级时装设计，在保持真人化材质与真实穿着逻辑的同时，不改变角色辨识度。

第一人称近距离 POV。画面前景伸入一只真实手臂，手腕佩戴 Apple Watch，并将手腕抬至镜头正前方。Apple Watch 极度靠近镜头，占据画面视觉中心，同时精准遮挡后方真人角色的整个面部。

这是整张照片最重要的视觉设计：

Apple Watch 的屏幕必须正好位于真人角色原本面部的位置，完整覆盖其真实面孔；屏幕中显示该角色对应的真人面部影像。屏幕中的脸与后方真人身体保持完全一致的演员身份、发型、发色、肤色、光线方向和表情状态。

尤其强调空间错觉与精准拼合感：屏幕中的面部大小、头部角度、透视关系、下巴位置、颈部连接位置必须与后方真人身体严格对应，让 Apple Watch 屏幕中的脸像真正长在后方身体上一样。手表边框切断真实头部，但屏幕内部的人脸继续完成被遮挡的面部信息，使屏幕成为角色真正的第二张脸。

从第一眼看去，应产生一种超现实但摄影上可信的视觉错觉：Apple Watch 屏幕中的人脸＋手表后方露出的头发轮廓、耳侧发丝、颈部、肩膀和身体共同组成一个完整人物。避免出现屏幕头像悬浮、比例过小、脸与身体错位、双重面孔、后方真实脸从手表边缘露出等情况。

Apple Watch 使用真实现代工业设计与黑色或深色金属表壳，真实玻璃反射、OLED 屏幕亮度、细微指纹与边缘高光。去除电子宠物机、钥匙圈、吊坠、按钮及所有宠物机相关配饰。

屏幕中的真人面部清晰可辨，同时保留轻微电子媒介质感：极细微数字噪点、扫描纹理、屏幕刷新痕迹与偶发轻微 glitch，但不要做成低像素头像。整体仍然是一张真实真人面孔，只是像情绪被电子设备读取并重新显示出来。

屏幕中的表情与后方人物身体语言同步，但更加克制、焦虑、疏离，像隐藏情绪被机器读取：眼神压抑、轻微迟疑、隐秘期待、脆弱、幻想感与无法言说的情绪。

后方角色接近全身入镜，身体轻微内收，双手自然抓住衣领、袖口或胸前布料，姿态带有克制、焦虑、隐秘期待、幻想、脆弱与纯真，非情色。动作自然，避免刻意摆拍。

背景改为暗调电影空间：深灰蓝、黑灰、低饱和暗红、暗冷粉或墨绿色环境随机变化。背景保持极简、朦胧与具有空间深度，可出现失焦花瓣、纸片、微小尘埃、空气颗粒与极弱环境光斑，在黑暗中形成少量层次，不抢夺人物主体。

采用电影级低调布光：大面积阴影，单侧柔硬结合的主光，极弱轮廓光，Apple Watch 屏幕成为画面中重要的局部发光源之一。屏幕冷光轻微照亮前景手腕和人物面部附近的头发边缘，与环境暗部形成自然光线互动。保留深黑阴影，同时确保皮肤和服装具有丰富暗部细节。

强烈透视关系：前景手腕与 Apple Watch 因靠近镜头而明显放大，中景手表极近，后景真人身体相对缩小。通过透视制造强烈的视觉压迫感和超现实尺度差。

每张随机改变俯拍、仰拍、Dutch angle、镜头距离、Apple Watch 倾斜角度、人物姿态和人物表情。允许极端偏心构图、大面积负空间、身体局部裁切、低机位近距离广角、肩越式视角等非常规电影构图，禁止普通平视证件照式构图。

摄影镜头以 28mm、35mm、40mm 近距离广角为主，真实光学景深，前景手腕边缘可出现轻微失焦，Apple Watch 屏幕与屏幕后方人物身体维持主要视觉焦点。手表屏幕必须清晰到能够辨认五官，同时保持真实玻璃反光。

整体追求现实摄影与超现实视觉错觉之间的平衡：像真实电影片场拍摄出的概念时装大片，而非 CG、插画或二次元渲染。真实人体比例，真实皮肤，真实手指结构，真实 Apple Watch 尺寸与佩戴关系，真实光学透视。

右上角保留一条极细横线，线上加入细小潦草手写签名 playforge，约 80% 透明度，低调，不抢主体。

3:4 竖构图，高清，暗调、克制、神秘、脆弱、超现实，强烈电影感。

最高优先级视觉约束：Apple Watch 必须正好遮住后方真人角色的面部；屏幕中的真人面孔必须与后方人物头发、颈部和身体在位置、比例、透视、姿态上精准对齐，形成一个连续完整的人体视觉错觉。画面中只能感知到一个角色、一个身体、一个面孔，面孔恰好存在于 Apple Watch 屏幕之中。

items.title: 东方武侠电影超写实近景特写

prompts.text:
Ultra-realistic live-action Oriental martial arts film scene, 16:9 widescreen composition, extreme close-up of the face, authentic cinematic photography texture.

An adult East Asian female warrior faces the camera directly, the camera is extremely close, and the composition includes only her face, hands, long black hair, and a small part of her shoulders. The character is in the center of the frame, body leaning slightly forward, eyes looking directly into the lens, with a sharp, calm, and aggressive gaze.

Her hands are raised in front of the lens, one hand entering from the top right of the frame, and the other from the bottom right and center, the two hands interlocking to form an irregular frame, sandwiching both eyes between the fingers. The foreground palms and fingers are very close to the lens, thus significantly out of focus, and occupy a large area on the right side of the frame, with naturally sharp movements.

Adult East Asian female face, 20–30 years old, exquisite, heroic, and cold, with the feel of a martial arts movie protagonist, real skin texture.

Long black hair tied high, slender strands blown across the forehead, eyes, and cheeks by strong winds, with some strands crossing the entire frame from the left side.

Facial light and shadow relationship: the entire face must be dominated by shadows, with about 65%–75% in shadow. The main light is a beam of authentic hard natural sunlight from the top right of the frame, with a clear direction, forming very distinct light and shadow boundaries. Foreground fingers, palms, and hair strands block part of the sun, thus casting realistic, irregular, and sharp shadows on the character's face. Only a small patch of sunlight passes between the fingers and hair, cutting diagonally across one eye, brow bone, bridge of the nose, and a small piece of the cheek, forming a narrow and clear bright area. The other eye is mostly in shadow, but the pupil is still visible. Lips, chin, jaw, and neck maintain significant darkness, with no frontal fill light.

Minimalist background, only a low-saturation pale blue sky. The eyes are located near the center of the frame and are the clearest area; foreground palms are heavily out of focus, a large amount of long black hair enters the frame from the left, and the right side is occupied by foreground fingers, creating a strong sense of enclosure.

ARRI Alexa 35 / Alexa Mini LF cinematic look, 65mm lens, T2.0, ISO 800, 1/1000s, focus on the eyes, hard natural sunlight, face slightly underexposed, strong chiaroscuro lighting, deep facial shadows, subtle film grain.

一名成年东亚女侠正面对镜头，摄影机距离极近，构图只包含她的脸、双手、黑色长发和少量肩部。人物位于画面中央，身体微微前倾，眼睛直视镜头，目光凌厉、冷静、具有攻击性。

她的双手抬到镜头前方，一只手从画面右上伸入，另一只手从画面右下与中央伸入，两只手交错形成不规则框架，把双眼夹在手指之间。前景手掌和手指距离镜头非常近，因此明显失焦，并占据画面右侧较大面积，动作自然锋利。

成年东亚女性面孔，20–30岁，精致、英气、冷峻，有武侠电影女主角感，真实皮肤纹理。

黑色长发高束，细长发丝被强风吹过额头、双眼和脸颊，部分发丝从左侧横穿整个画面。

脸部明暗关系：整张脸必须以暗部为主，约65%–75%处于阴影中。主光是一束来自画面右上方的真实硬质自然阳光，方向明确，形成非常清晰的明暗边界。前景手指、手掌和发丝挡住部分太阳，因此在人物脸上投下真实、不规则、锋利的阴影。只有一小块阳光从手指和发丝之间穿过，斜切过一只眼睛、眉骨、鼻梁和小块脸颊，形成窄而明确的亮区。另一只眼睛大部分在阴影中，但瞳孔仍可见。嘴唇、下巴、下颌和颈部保持明显暗度，不要正面补光。

背景极简，只有低饱和淡蓝天空。双眼位于画面中央附近，眼睛是最清晰区域，前景手掌严重失焦，左侧大量黑色长发进入画面，右侧由前景手指占据，形成强烈包围感。

items.title: 建筑师风格旅游实地考察笔记海报

prompts.text: Create one individual “Travel Field Notes” poster for each uploaded photo, never combining multiple photos into a collage. Use a 3:4 portrait composition with the original photograph occupying roughly 58% of the frame and a warm, slightly aged paper field filling the remaining 42%, blending naturally without a visible dividing line. Keep the photograph highly realistic and faithful to the source, preserving the subject, architecture, landscape, vegetation, people, proportions, perspective, lighting, shadows, textures, and original atmosphere, with only subtle editorial color correction and fine film grain; never redraw, replace, distort, or reposition important elements. On the paper side, leave generous empty space and create a compact location-specific rubber stamp inspired only by the most recognizable visual features of the photograph, such as a landmark silhouette, roofline, skyline, mountain contour, shoreline, road direction, trees, or other defining forms. Simplify the scene rather than reproducing everything, removing crowds, cars, repetitive buildings, tiny windows, clutter, and insignificant details. Keep the stamp relatively small, around 30–38% of the paper section’s height, and place it toward the lower-middle area with plenty of breathing room. Build the stamp from 2–4 muted spot colors naturally sampled from the original scene, such as charcoal, forest green, faded brick, ochre, slate blue, or earthy brown, using authentic carved-rubber printing characteristics including rough engraved marks, irregular edges, uneven pressure, broken ink coverage, paper show-through, granular pigment, tiny imperfections, ghosting, and subtle layer misregistration. The result should feel physically stamped onto real fibrous paper rather than digitally illustrated. Add restrained typewriter-style field-note typography near the stamp containing the location’s English name, a small numbered entry, exactly three concise English keywords describing the place, and the current Gregorian year, with accurate spelling and no slogans or unnecessary decoration. The final aesthetic should resemble a quiet archival travel record made by an architect, explorer, or observant traveler: tactile, understated, authentic, collectible, and strongly connected to the actual location. Avoid obvious panel borders, hard dividing lines, circular seals, postage perforations, wax seals, souvenir-card layouts, generic icons, polished vector graphics, cartoon styling, 3D effects, glossy gradients, excessive saturation, dense illustration, decorative clutter, or any alteration of the original photograph.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text: 为每张上传的照片创建一张单独的“旅游实地笔记”海报，绝不将多张照片组合成拼贴画。使用 3:4 的纵向构图，原始照片占据画面的约 58%，温暖且略显陈旧的纸张区域填充剩余的 42%，自然融合且没有明显的分割线。保持照片的高度写实并忠于来源，保留主体、建筑、景观、植被、人物、比例、透视、光效、阴影、纹理和原始氛围，仅进行细微的编辑色彩校正和细腻的胶片颗粒感；绝不重画、替换、扭曲或重新定位重要元素。在纸张一侧，留出宽敞的空白区域，并创建一个紧凑的特定地点的橡胶印章，其灵感仅来自照片中最具辨识度的视觉特征，例如地标剪影、屋顶线、天际线、山脉轮廓、海岸线、道路方向、树木或其他定义形状。简化场景而不是复制所有内容，移除人群、汽车、重复的建筑物、微小的窗户、杂物和微不足道的细节。保持印章相对较小，大约占纸张部分高度的 30–38%，并将其放置在具有充足呼吸空间的下部中间区域。使用 2–4 种从原始场景中自然采样的柔和专色来构建印章，例如炭黑色、森林绿、褪色砖红、赭石色、石板蓝或大地棕，使用真实的刻制橡胶印刷特性，包括粗糙的雕刻痕迹、不规则的边缘、压力不均、油墨覆盖断裂、纸张透出、颗粒状颜料、微小瑕疵、重影和细微的图层对齐偏差。结果应该感觉像是物理加盖在真实的纤维纸上，而不是数字插画。在印章附近添加克制的打字机风格实地笔记排版，包含地点的英文名称、一个小编号的条目、准确的三个描述该地点的简明英文关键词以及当前的公历年份，拼写准确，且没有标语或不必要的装饰。最终的美学应类似于由建筑师、探险家或细心的旅行者制作的安静的档案旅行记录：触感真实、朴素、正宗、具有收藏价值，并且与实际地点紧密联系。避免明显的面板边界、硬分割线、圆形印章、邮票穿孔、蜡封、纪念卡布局、通用图标、抛光的矢量图形、卡通风格、 3D 效果、光泽渐变、过度饱和、密集的插画、装饰性杂物或对原始照片的任何改动。

items.title: 韩系风格楼梯间手机闪光灯时尚写真

prompts.text:
Create a full-body 9:16 realistic fashion editorial featuring an adult young East Asian woman with a refined K-pop-inspired look, expressive eyes, a slim silhouette, and long balanced legs.

Place her inside a narrow, slightly worn concrete stairwell with rough gray steps, chipped edges, scratches, patch repairs, concrete pores, uneven walls, and ordinary metal railings. The space should feel real, functional, and slightly raw — never like a luxury brutalist interior or studio set.

Use a stair-pause pose: one leg supports the body on a lower step while the other bends onto a higher step. Let the hips and torso rotate naturally so part of the front body remains visible. She turns toward the camera with clear eye contact and an expressive mood — confident, playful, cool, sensual, or slightly distant.

Shoot from a slightly low full-body angle, emphasizing elegant leg lines while keeping realistic anatomy and controlled perspective.

Style her in a fashion-forward mini dress or bodysuit with one clear design feature, such as an off-shoulder neckline, bandeau, deep V, asymmetric shoulder, bustier, halter, or clean cutout. Vary the outfit color, hairstyle, and mood while keeping the series cohesive.

Pair the outfit with refined hosiery such as sheer tights, satin sheer, subtle jacquard, fine diamond texture, micro-rib, or tonal woven patterns. Keep the hosiery clean and elegant, with realistic transparency, yarn texture, stretch, and tension. Avoid dense florals, heavy fishnet, messy patterns, or gradient colors.

Use cool blue ambient stairwell light combined with smartphone direct flash. The flash should brightly illuminate the model while the background remains darker and cooler, creating fast flash falloff, small hard-edged shadows, and realistic highlights on the eyes, skin, hosiery, and shoes.

Skin must remain genuinely photographic under flash: visible pores, tiny imperfections, subtle tonal variation, natural redness, and believable highlights. Avoid poreless AI-beauty skin, waxy gloss, plastic smoothness, or excessive retouching.

Hair should show natural volume, individual strands, loose flyaways, and slight irregularity.

The key visual contrast is:

rough concrete × cool blue ambient light × smartphone direct flash × sharp feminine styling × refined hosiery.

Real-location Fashion Editorial × Hosiery Campaign × Smartphone Flash Photography.

prompts.text:
创建一个全身 9:16 的写实时尚社论，主角是一位成年的年轻东亚女性，拥有精致的 K-pop 灵感外观、富有表现力的眼睛、苗条的轮廓和修长的双腿。

将她置于一个狭窄、略显破旧的混凝土楼梯间内，这里有粗糙的灰色台阶、崩边的边缘、划痕、补丁修复、混凝土孔隙、凹凸不平的墙壁和普通的金属栏杆。这个空间应该感觉真实、具有功能性且略显粗犷——绝不要像奢华的粗犷主义室内设计或摄影棚布景。

使用楼梯停顿姿势：一条腿在较低的台阶上支撑身体，而另一条腿弯曲在较高的台阶上。让臀部和躯干自然旋转，使部分身体正面保持可见。她转身面向镜头，眼神交流清晰，表情丰富——自信、俏皮、酷飒、感性或略带疏离感。

从略低的全身角度拍摄，强调优雅的腿部线条，同时保持真实的解剖结构和受控的透视。

为她搭配一件前卫的迷你裙或连体衣，具有一个明显的设计特征，如露肩领口、抹胸、深 V、不对称肩膀、紧身胸衣、挂脖或整洁的剪裁。改变服装颜色、发型和情绪，同时保持系列的统一性。

将服装与精致的丝袜搭配，如透明连裤袜、缎面透明袜、微妙的提花、精细的钻石纹理、微细罗纹或同色系编织图案。保持丝袜整洁优雅，具有真实的透明度、纱线纹理、弹性和张力。避免密集的碎花、厚重的渔网袜、杂乱的图案或渐变色。

使用冷蓝色的楼梯间环境光结合手机直射闪光灯。闪光灯应明亮地照亮模特，而背景保持较暗且较冷，创造出快速的闪光衰减、微小的硬边阴影，以及眼睛、皮肤、丝袜和鞋子上的真实高光。

皮肤必须在闪光灯下保持真实的摄影质感：可见的孔隙、微小的瑕疵、微妙的色调变化、自然的发红和可信的高光。避免无孔的 AI 美颜皮肤、蜡质光泽、塑料般的平滑或过度的修饰。

头发应表现出自然的发量、根根分明的发丝、散乱的碎发和轻微的不规则感。

核心视觉对比是：

粗糙混凝土 × 冷蓝色环境光 × 手机直射闪光灯 × 利落的女性造型 × 精致丝袜。

实地时尚社论 × 丝袜广告活动 × 手机闪光灯摄影。

items.title: 竖版上下双拼孟菲斯风格重构插画

prompts.text: Create a vertical split-style complete illustration, where the screen is strictly divided into two equal-height areas. The upper part is a refinement of the subject from the original image, and the lower part is a Memphis style reconstruction, with an overall distinct sense of design and visual interest. Upper part: Use the uploaded original image as the sole subject reference source, automatically identify main characters, cats, dogs, or other common pets, focusing on retaining the subject while not taking buildings or the environment as the main content. Retain the character's face shape, features, hairstyle, clothing, sense of age, and temperament, or the pet's breed, fur color, patterns, ears, body shape, and other identifying characteristics. The background is simplified, the subject is clear and complete, and the visual center is explicit. Lower part: Transform the same subject into a complete illustration in the 'Memphis' visual language. prompts.text:
Use the attached image as the sole source for the scene, people, objects, clothing, pose, and overall visual context.

Transform it into a realistic smartphone photograph in which the original scene remains visible as a real photographic background, while a hand-held illustrated card is placed prominently in the foreground and partially covers the scene.

The background must remain photorealistic and recognizable as the same location and situation as the source image, but use a strong shallow depth of field: soft natural blur, realistic bokeh, subdued background details, and gentle optical defocus. Keep the broad composition, lighting direction, color atmosphere, and major subject arrangement from the source photo. Do not replace the background with a completely different environment.

In the foreground, show a single physical illustration card held close to the camera by a realistic human hand. The hand should enter naturally from the lower edge of the frame, with visible fingers gripping the card. Preserve believable skin texture, fingernail shape, contact shadows, perspective, and natural hand anatomy.

The card should have a slightly imperfect rounded-rectangle shape, softly rounded corners, a warm off-white paper border, subtle thickness, and a handmade physical appearance. It should be positioned in front of the camera and partially obscure the real background, as if someone is holding up a printed art card for comparison with the scene behind it.

Inside the card, redraw the main people, objects, and spatial relationships from the source image as a charming hand-drawn colored cartoon illustration. The illustration should depict the same subject matter and recognizable actions as the source, but in a simplified, playful, editorial picture-book style. Preserve important hairstyles, clothing categories, facial expressions, body language, distinctive accessories, props, and basic interactions when visible.

Use expressive dark ink outlines, slightly uneven organic linework, colored-pencil and crayon-like texture, visible paper grain, lightly rough hand-colored fills, simplified shapes, warm natural colors, and a deliberately handmade illustrated quality. The card artwork should feel like a personal travel sketch, memory card, or small printed comic illustration rather than a polished digital cartoon.

The illustrated version should correspond clearly to the real scene behind it, creating a visual contrast between photorealistic background and hand-drawn foreground card. The card artwork may simplify anatomy, facial details, background structures, and surface textures, but it must remain readable and semantically faithful to the source image.

Composition: portrait-oriented smartphone photography, close-up framing, the card occupying roughly the central foreground area, slightly below the center, with the real environment visible around it. Focus sharply on the card and the gripping hand; keep the background noticeably out of focus. Use natural perspective, realistic depth, subtle lens softness, and believable contact shadows around the card.

The result must look like one authentic photograph taken in the real world, not a flat collage or a graphic design mockup.

Avoid: a fully illustrated background, replacing the original location, a floating card, a perfectly digital rectangle, a glossy commercial poster, a clean vector illustration, photorealistic artwork printed on the card, excessive text, logos, watermarks, extra hands, malformed fingers, duplicated people, unrelated props, inconsistent perspective, harsh cutout edges, artificial drop shadows, extreme fisheye distortion, or an entirely blurred card.

prompts.text:
使用附带的图像作为场景、人物、物体、服装、姿势和整体视觉背景的唯一来源。

将其转换为一张逼真的智能手机照片，其中原始场景作为真实的摄影背景保持可见，而一张手持的插画卡片被显著地放置在前景中并部分遮挡场景。

背景必须保持写实，且可识别为与源图像相同的地点和情境，但要使用强烈的浅景深：柔和的自然模糊、真实的虚化、淡化的背景细节和轻微的镜头失焦。保持源照片的大致构图、光照方向、色彩氛围和主要主体安排。不要用完全不同的环境替换背景。

在前景中，展示一张由真实的人手握住并靠近摄像机的实体插画卡片。手应该从画面的下边缘自然进入，并带有可见的抓握卡片的手指。保留可信的皮肤纹理、指甲形状、接触阴影、透视和自然的手部解剖结构。

卡片应具有略显不完美的圆角矩形形状、柔和的圆角、温暖的米白色纸张边框、微妙的厚度和手工制作的实体外观。它应该位于摄像机前方，并部分遮挡真实的背景，就好像有人拿着一张印刷艺术卡片与背后的场景进行对比。

在卡片内部，将源图像中的主要人物、物体和空间关系重新绘制为迷人的手绘彩色卡通插图。插图应描绘与源图像相同的主题和可识别的动作，但采用简化、俏皮、社论绘本风格。保留重要的发型、服装类别、面部表情、身体语言、独特的配饰、道具和可见的基本互动。

使用富有表现力的深色墨水轮廓、略微不均匀的有机线条、彩色铅笔和蜡笔般的纹理、可见的纸张颗粒、轻微粗糙的手绘填充、简化的形状、温暖的自然色彩以及刻意为之的手工插画质感。卡片作品应该感觉像是个人旅行写生、记忆卡或小型印刷漫画插图，而不是精致的数字卡通。

插画版本应与背后的真实场景清晰对应，在写实背景和手绘前景卡片之间创造视觉对比。卡片艺术作品可以简化解剖结构、面部细节、背景结构和表面纹理，但它必须保持可读性，并且在语义上忠实于源图像。

构图：纵向智能手机摄影，近景取景，卡片占据大约中央前景区域，略低于中心，周围可见真实环境。清晰对焦于卡片和抓握的手；保持背景明显失焦。使用自然的透视、真实的深度、微妙的镜头柔化以及卡片周围可信的接触阴影。

结果必须看起来像是在现实世界中拍摄的一张真实照片，而不是扁平的拼贴画或图形设计模型。

避免：完全插画化的背景、替换原始位置、漂浮的卡片、完美的数字矩形、光滑的商业海报、干净的矢量插图、印在卡片上的写实艺术作品、过多的文字、标志、水印、多余的手、畸形的手指、重复的人物、无关的道具、不一致的透视、生硬的剪裁边缘、人造投影、极端的鱼眼失真或完全模糊的卡片。

items.title: 顶级社刊食品文字物理交互海报

prompts.text:
Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Food: [FOOD / DRINK]
Headline: [1 SHORT WORD]
Physical Interaction: [PRESS / SCOOP / SMEAR / LAYER / other physical action]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Product Name: [PRODUCT NAME]
Price: [PRICE]
Aspect Ratio: 9:16

Create a premium editorial food poster where real food physically interacts with and reshapes oversized typography, using a warm cream or ivory background, bold black Heavy Grotesk typography, photorealistic food materials, generous negative space, and a broken editorial grid inspired by high-end European café branding and contemporary magazine design.

The food must not simply overlap or sit beside the letters, treat the typography and food as objects inside the same physical world, the selected interaction must visibly change the structure of the letters through believable physics.

Examples: PRESS, food weight compresses and locally deforms the typography; SCOOP, a real scoop removes material directly from a letter, leaving a matching cavity and revealing edible material inside; SMEAR, a knife drags food across the type, causing localized lateral stretching and shear only along the contact zone; LAYER, the typography contains real food layers, and one structural layer is physically pulled out and offset.

Keep the interaction localized, clear, and physically believable, untouched parts of the typography should remain hard, clean, geometric, and readable, use only one main physical mechanism per poster, avoid random liquify effects, decorative overlap, generic 3D lettering, or digital-looking distortion.

Add small editorial information such as [INGREDIENTS], [OPENING HOURS], and [ADDRESS], use strong scale contrast rather than traditional menu rows, avoid long horizontal divider lines, boxed prices, rigid bottom information bars, or template-like layouts.

Use bold Grotesk Sans Serif for the main typography, high-contrast Editorial Serif or Italic Serif for product names, quotes, or prices, keep the color system minimal with a cream background, black typography, natural food colors, and one accent color.

The final poster should feel clever, physical, premium, and instantly understandable at thumbnail size, the key idea is simple: food does not decorate the typography, food physically changes it.

prompts.text:

强调色：[COLOR]
产品名称：[PRODUCT NAME]
价格：[PRICE]
宽高比：9:16

创建一张高级社刊风格食品海报，其中真实的食物与超大尺寸的版式产生物理互动并重塑其形状。使用温暖的乳白色或象牙色背景，粗体黑色 Heavy Grotesk 字体，光影写实的食物材质，大量的留白，以及受高端欧洲咖啡馆品牌和当代杂志设计启发的打破常规的编辑网格。

食物不得简单地重叠或靠在字母旁边，应将排版和食物视为同一物理世界中的物体，所选的交互作用必须通过可信的物理效应明显地改变字母的结构。

示例：PRESS（按压），食物的重量压缩并使局部排版变形；SCOOP（舀取），真实的勺子直接从字母中移除材料，留下匹配的空腔并露出内部的可食用材质；SMEAR（涂抹），一把刀将食物拖过字体，仅在接触区引起局部的横向拉伸和剪切；LAYER（分层），排版包含真实的食物层，其中一个结构层被物理地拉出并偏移。

保持交互的局部性、清晰性和物理上的真实感，排版中未被触及的部分应保持坚硬、干净、几何化且易读，每张海报仅使用一种主要的物理机制，避免随机的液化效果、装饰性重叠、通用的3D字体或看起来像数字生成的扭曲。

添加小型编辑信息，如 [INGREDIENTS]、[OPENING HOURS] 和 [ADDRESS]，使用强烈的比例对比，而非传统的菜单行，避免长水平分割线、方框标价、僵硬的底部信息栏或模板化的布局。

主体排版使用粗体 Grotesk Sans Serif，产品名称、引言或价格使用高对比度的 Editorial Serif 或斜体 Serif，保持极简的配色方案，包括乳白色背景、黑色字体、天然食物颜色和一种强调色。

最终的海报应该感觉巧妙、具有物理感、高端，并且在缩略图尺寸下也能立即理解。核心理念很简单：食物不是装饰排版，食物在物理上改变排版。

3:4 vertical composition, a front shot from nearly the same height as the seated figure, capturing a knee-up portrait from the top of the head to below the crossed knees. Photorealistic realistic photo. High-definition expression of the deep gloss of satin, velvet, marble, glass, and the natural glow of skin, a cinematic night scene unified in burgundy and amber tones.

Change of dress color and crossed-leg pose; omitting wine glass or bar lighting.

让真实立体物局部遮挡二维色块或摄影窗口，形成明显的前后层次：

艺术纸背景 → 平面色块 → 自然摄影窗口 → 真实立体实物。

右侧占据画面约 42%，使用温暖的米白色陈年纸张作为背景。纸张具有细微的纤维、自然纹理、轻微的使用痕迹和哑光质感，同时保留大面积未打印的纸张留白，使空白成为布局的重要组成部分。

分析原始照片并提取最具地域特色的主体轮廓、建筑结构、地形轮廓、植物形态、道路、海岸线或其他关键视觉关系，将它们压缩成一个小型的多色橡皮章图像。

不要逐项复制照片中的每一个元素。仅保留即时识别原始位置、主体和场景关系所必需的最低限度信息。移除人群、车辆、密集的窗户、重复的建筑物、破碎的植被、装饰元素和无关背景。

印章位于右侧纸张区域的中下方，仅占据右侧区域高度的约 30%–38%，周围保留充足的留白。印章必须不得放大成标准的插图、完整的风景画或品牌标志。

根据原始照片的构图决定印章的组织方式：

- 标志性建筑：保留最独特的轮廓、屋顶、圆顶、拱门、塔楼或主体结构。
- 山地聚落：将建筑物压缩成沿地形排列的几个阶梯状色块。
- 海滨景色：保留山脉轮廓、聚落层次、海岸线和稀疏断续的水面波纹。
- 城市全景：保留主要天际线、一座标志性建筑和一两层远山。
- 自然景观：保留主要山形、树木、海岸线或道路导向。
- 前景遮挡：如果原始照片中具有叙事重要性，则保留作为前景印章轮廓。

从原始照片中提取 2–4 种专色油墨。优先选择去饱和的颜色，如碳黑、深绿、砖红、赭黄、板岩蓝或灰褐色，但不强求固定色板。保留原始照片中最独特的色彩特征，仅允许小面积色彩用于视觉强调。

将每种颜色渲染为单独的手工盖印效果：

真实的橡皮章刻制纹理、手工雕刻痕迹、线条粗细不均、轮廓缺口、破碎边缘、干墨短缺、透纸感、颗粒状油墨、压力不均、局部重影以及约 1–2 mm 的细微套印不准。

允许颜色层之间自然错位；边缘不得经过数字平滑处理。印刷品应看起来像压在陈年纸张上的真实雕刻印章，而不是滤镜照片、平滑的矢量插图或线条艺术标志。

根据照片的地点、主题和视觉意象生成文本：

地点英文名称  
No. 数字  
三个简短的英文关键词  
公历年份  

将文本放置在印章下方或相邻的留白处，使用小型、克制、略带机械缺陷的打字机字体。排版应唤起旅行者实地记录的感觉，而不是广告标题。确保所有文本拼写准确，不添加无关的口号、品牌或装饰性文字。

整体氛围就像建筑师、旅行作家或自然观察者记录的实地笔记：安静、克制、触感真实、具有地域针对性，带有手工制作的瑕疵感和收藏感。照片负责现场记录；印章捕捉最易辨识的记忆片段。

避免：明显的中心分割线、圆形印章、中国红章、邮票齿孔、火漆印章、贴纸拼贴、旅游纪念品模板、平滑的矢量标志、通用的城市图标、完整复制所有建筑、密集的细节、孩子气的拙劣感、卡通风格、3D 渲染、塑料质感、光滑的数字渐变、过度饱和、过多的文本、装饰性杂乱以及重绘或更改左侧原始照片。

items.title: 竖版双拼原图与构成主义重构

prompts.text:
Create a full vertical split-style illustration, with the canvas strictly in a vertical composition, divided equally top and bottom at a 1:1 ratio, forming a clear visual contrast: the top is a refinement of the original image subject, and the bottom is a Constructivist style reconstruction.

Upper part:
Use the uploaded original image as the sole subject reference source, automatically identify and extract the subject such as people, cats, dogs, or other pets, without taking buildings or the environment as the main content. Try to preserve the core identifying features of the subject, including the person's face shape, features, hairstyle, clothing, and sense of age, or the pet's fur color, patterns, face shape, ears, and body shape. The background can be simplified; the subject should be clear, the composition stable, and not subject to meaningless cropping.

Lower part:
Transform the same subject into a full illustration in the visual language of "Constructivism." Core style features: red, black, cream-white, diagonal composition, geometric cutting, and strong propaganda poster rhythm. Overall principles: adopt clear geometric structures, flat planes, and ordered composition, controlling hierarchy and white space. The composition uses a single clear subject or a clear scene, the visual center is stable, the subject is complete and not cut off, and the background is moderately simplified while retaining a sense of breathing; lines, color blocks, light and shadow, materials, and paper texture must serve the same style, without mixing in irrelevant art styles. Integrate the subject's posture, gaze, or movement into a strong diagonal composition, using geometric cutting, diagonal power, propaganda-style tension, and a limited color system to reconstruct the image, giving it a clear Constructivist visual rhythm. The image should be natural, have a handmade feel and recognizable style features, avoiding common AI issues like excessive smoothness, meaningless piles of detail, and random decoration.

Overall requirements:
The top and bottom parts are the visual transformation of the same subject before and after; the bottom part should have a distinct sense of Constructivist power and a propaganda poster atmosphere, but do not generate text, logos, watermarks, borders, or UI, and do not create multi-image collages.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
创作一张竖版上下双拼风格的完整插画，画布严格竖向构图，上下对半分割，各占 1:1，形成清晰的视觉对照：上方为原图主体提炼，下方为构成主义风格重构。
上半部分：
以上传原图作为唯一主体参考来源，自动识别并提取人物、猫、狗或其他宠物主体，不以建筑或环境为主要表现内容。尽量保留主体的核心识别特征，包括人物的脸型、五官、发型、服饰与年龄感，或宠物的毛色、花纹、脸型、耳朵、体型等。背景可做简化处理，主体清晰，构图稳定，不被无意义裁切。
下半部分：
将同一个主体转化为「Constructivism 构成主义」视觉语言的完整插画。核心风格特征：红黑米白、斜向构图、几何切割和强烈宣传画节奏。整体原则：采用清晰的几何结构、平面块面与秩序化构图，控制层级和留白。构图采用单一明确主体或一个清晰场景，视觉中心稳定，主体完整不被裁断，背景适度简化并保留呼吸感；线条、色块、明暗、材质和纸面纹理必须服务于同一风格，不混入无关画风。将主体姿态、视线或动作融入强烈的斜向构图之中，用几何切割、对角力量、宣传画式张力和有限色彩系统来重建画面，使其具有明确的构成主义视觉节奏。画面自然、有手作感和可识别的风格特征，避免 AI 常见的过度光滑、无意义细节堆砌和随机装饰。
整体要求：
上下两部分是同一主体的前后视觉转化，下半部分应具有鲜明的构成主义力量感和宣传画气息，但不生成文字、Logo、水印、边框、UI，不做多图拼接。

prompts.text:
Theme:
Blue and white floral ribbon by the water

Subject:
In the center of the frame, a young woman sits with her back to the stone edge of an outdoor pool. The main subjects are her wide, wet back, the thin swimsuit straps removed from her arms, the white bottom with light blue small floral patterns, and the blue water surface.

Character・Expression:
Round small profile, lowered eyes, long eyelashes, thin eyebrows, delicate bridge of the nose, light peach-colored closed lips. Her face is turned toward the lower left, and her gaze also falls on her hands, showing a quiet expression. Dark brown hair is tied in a small bun on the back of the head, with thin bangs and wet back hair strands falling along her cheeks and neck.

Clothing・Pose:
A high-cut swimsuit bottom with a white base scattered with light blue small floral patterns and aqua blue piping. The thin floral straps of the top are removed from the shoulders; her elbows are extended horizontally, and she holds the straps under her armpits with both hands. She sits upright on the pool edge with her back and waist facing directly forward. On the lower right are white cloth, a straw hat, and sunglasses.

Background・Lighting:
The background is entirely the blue water surface of an outdoor pool, with a gray stone edge at the top and a light-colored seating surface at the bottom. Harsh direct sunlight from the upper right of the frame shines on the shoulders, spine, and waist, creating shadows of the arms and body, as well as subtle shimmering reflections on the water surface.

Composition・Camera:
4:5 vertical composition, captured from a back-view medium shot slightly above the waist, from the top of the head to below the buttocks, forming a back portrait. The spine is centered and enlarged, with the left and right arms symmetrically spread out, and the blue water surface filling the entire background. prompts.text:
High-key minimalist studio fashion photography of two young adult women against a seamless pure white to pale gray-white background, arranged in a strongly layered vertical composition. Her long straight dark brown-black hair falls over her chest, with heavy blunt bangs partly obscuring her eyes. She wears a structured fitted black single-breasted blazer, a wide white collar or scarf-like detail marked with tiny black printed or embroidered motifs, a short black regularly pleated skirt, and black over-the-knee boots or stockings. One hand hangs naturally while the other is raised, holding a thin black leash or cord extending downward.

In the lower-right, the second woman kneels close to the standing woman's legs, with her back toward the camera and her face shown partly in profile. Her long black hair falls naturally over her back and shoulder, and she looks upward toward the standing woman. She wears an ivory long-sleeved blouse and a voluminous black pleated mid-length skirt spreading outward around her, with black pointed high heels. One hand touches near the standing woman's lower leg or skirt while the other reaches upward. Their poses remain still, restrained, and ritual-like, with the height difference and mutual gaze creating a cool, mysterious, slightly absurd theatrical fashion narrative.

Use large soft high-key light from the front or front-left, evenly illuminating the figures. Keep the white background bright with extremely subtle gray tonal variation, and add soft contact shadows beneath the shoes and skirts. Use a normal to moderately wide perspective around an equivalent 35–50mm lens, approximately a 4:5 vertical frame, full-body coverage from head to shoes and floor contact areas, with the figures slightly left of center and generous negative space above and to the right. Preserve naturally falling hair, garment wrinkles, slight asymmetry in the poses, subtle black fabric texture, faint grain, and the realism of a softly lit studio photograph. Do not add a third person, complex props, colored lighting, harsh shadows, casual sportswear, revealing clothing, or distorted hands, leash, pleats, or footwear.

items.title: AETHRA奢侈生活品牌网页视觉设计

prompts.text:
Create a premium editorial web-design campaign board for a fictional lifestyle brand called AETHRA, presented as one single tall composition containing four stacked full-screen website hero slides, each built from the same elegant interface system but reinterpreted through a different season. The entire image must feel like a luxury creative-direction presentation: minimalist, airy, high-end, and curatorially precise. Preserve a consistent layout across all four slides: a small square brand mark at the upper left, a thin refined navigation row across the upper right, a large human portrait on the left half rendered as a soft double-exposure silhouette, and a clean seasonal title block on the right half over a spacious white or near-white field. The “product” is the design system itself, and it must remain the dominant visual focus.

Overall composition: four horizontal website hero banners stacked vertically in one clean presentation board, separated by thin dark dividers or slim frame gaps. Each slide follows the same structure but carries its own seasonal mood, palette, portrait direction, and embedded landscape. The board should read like a polished design showcase for a premium homepage slider concept. Typography, grid, whitespace, navigation rhythm, and button placement must stay consistent from slide to slide. The left portrait and right title area should always form the primary balance. Everything must feel deliberate, spacious, and highly art-directed.

Slide 1, SUMMER: an adult woman in side profile or three-quarter profile facing right, with softly windblown hair and a graceful elongated silhouette. Inside her silhouette, blend a luminous alpine summer landscape: teal lake water, sunlit ochre grass, pale rocky mountains, soft cloud haze, and warm summer air. Main title on the right reads exactly: "SUMMER". Small script line above reads exactly: "Seasonal Chapter". Supporting line below reads exactly: "Warm air, open light, slow horizons." Small button text reads exactly: "DISCOVER".

Slide 2, WINTER: an adult bearded man in left-facing side profile, calm and introspective. Inside the silhouette, blend a muted winter forest landscape with bare trees, cool fog, pale frost, bluish-grey shadows, and soft white atmospheric layering. Main title reads exactly: "WINTER". Small script line above reads exactly: "Seasonal Chapter". Supporting line below reads exactly: "Quiet depth, cold breath, held silence." Small button text reads exactly: "DISCOVER".

Slide 3, SPRING: an adult man in a softly bent or turning pose, looking slightly downward, elegant and reflective. Inside the silhouette, blend a light spring woodland scene with soft evergreen layers, misty white light, pale moss, wet bark, and fresh emerging growth. Main title reads exactly: "SPRING". Small script line above reads exactly: "Seasonal Chapter". Supporting line below reads exactly: "Soft renewal, green pulse, waking air." Small button text reads exactly: "DISCOVER".

Slide 4, AUTUMN: an adult woman or androgynous adult figure shown from the back or slight rear three-quarter view, head centered, silhouette broad and calm. Inside the silhouette, blend an autumn river-valley landscape with muted golden grasses, cool mountain shadow, forest edge, silver water flow, and pale amber dusk light. Main title reads exactly: "AUTUMN". Small script line above reads exactly: "Seasonal Chapter". Supporting line below reads exactly: "Earth tone, long water, fading warmth." Small button text reads exactly: "DISCOVER".

Brand and interface system: the small top-left mark on every slide reads exactly: "AETHRA". The top-right navigation on every slide reads exactly: "HOME", "EDITIONS", "SEASONS", "WORK", "JOURNAL", "ABOUT", "CONTACT". Keep the UI elegant, understated, and believable as a real luxury website, but reduce clutter so it still feels like a gallery-grade image rather than a literal web screenshot. Include tiny left and right arrow cues near the side edges of each slide to imply a fullscreen slider. Typography should be thin, premium, editorial, and spatially balanced, with the main seasonal titles in large refined uppercase serif or elegant display text, the smaller interface elements in light modern sans-serif, and the script line above each title delicate and controlled.

Double-exposure treatment: the portrait silhouettes must be photoreal and anatomically elegant, with clean profiles, believable shoulders and necks, natural skin and hair detail where visible, and very soft edge transitions where the landscapes merge into the faces and bodies. The landscapes should align with the contour logic of each portrait so the horizon lines, tree masses, grass layers, and fog fields feel embedded inside the figures rather than pasted on top. Keep the integration subtle and premium, with no harsh collage cutouts, no muddy overlaps, and no chaotic texture stacking.

Lighting and palette: overall board palette must remain restrained, premium, and seasonally differentiated while unified by the clean white interface field. Use a 60/30/10 logic within each slide, but maintain a coherent full-board look. Summer: warm white, teal water, sunlit ochre. Winter: cool whites, fog grey, blue-green forest shadow. Spring: pale mist, fresh green, soft bark brown. Autumn: warm stone, muted amber, deep conifer shadow. Keep contrast soft but deliberate, with enough tonal separation to preserve facial silhouettes and text readability. The board must feel calm, expensive, and editorial, never loud or saturated.

Materials and finish: hyper-real portrait photography fused with fine-art landscape exposure and luxury UI design. Show realistic hair wisps, skin softness, lake texture, tree silhouette detail, mist depth, mountain atmosphere, and crisp rendered typography. The final image should feel like a Cannes-level digital-art-direction board: modern, collectible, emotionally intelligent, and brand-system driven.

Output and constraints: one complete four-slide seasonal campaign board, no copied source text, no real brand names, no extra people, no cluttered interface, no heavy decorative noise, no cheap stock-template feeling. Keep all portraits adult, elegant, and anatomically correct. Keep typography crisp and readable, white fields spacious, blends clean, and seasonal differences clear but controlled. Avoid broken facial structure, muddy double exposure, random texture spill, unreadable UI, over-sharpened forests, oversaturated palettes, pasted collage edges, gibberish text, or drift away from high-end editorial realism.

为一个名为 AETHRA 的虚构生活方式品牌创建一个高级编辑网页设计活动展示板，呈现为一个单一的长构图，包含四个垂直堆叠的全屏网站英雄幻灯片，每个幻灯片都基于相同的优雅界面系统构建，但通过不同的季节进行了重新诠释。整个图像必须感觉像是一个奢侈品创意指导演示：极简主义、轻盈、高端且具有策展式的精确感。在所有四个幻灯片中保持一致的布局：左上角是一个小的方形品牌标志，右上角是一行细致精炼的导航栏，左半部分是一个渲染为柔和双重曝光剪影的大型人物肖像，右半部分是一个干净的季节性标题块，位于宽敞的白色或近白色区域之上。“产品”是设计系统本身，它必须保持主导的视觉焦点。

整体构图：四个水平的网站英雄横幅垂直堆叠在一个干净的展示板中，由细小的深色分隔线或狭窄的框架间隙分开。每个幻灯片遵循相同的结构，但带有各自的季节情绪、调色板、肖像方向和嵌入的景观。该展示板读起来应该像是一个针对高级主页滑动条概念的精致设计展示。字体、网格、空白、导航节奏和按钮位置必须在各个幻灯片之间保持一致。左侧的肖像和右侧的标题区域应始终构成主要的平衡。一切都必须感觉是经过深思熟虑的、宽敞的，并具有高度的艺术指导性。

幻灯片 1，夏季：一名成年女性，侧面或四分之三侧面朝右，头发被微风轻轻吹动，剪影优雅而修长。在她的剪影内部，融合一片明亮的高山夏季景观：青蓝色的湖水、阳光照射下的赭石色草地、苍白的岩石山脉、柔软的云雾和温暖的夏日空气。右侧的主标题内容完全为：“SUMMER”。上方的小字手写体内容完全为：“Seasonal Chapter”。下方的辅助行内容完全为：“Warm air, open light, slow horizons.”。小按钮文字内容完全为：“DISCOVER”。

幻灯片 2，冬季：一名留着胡须的成年男性，左侧脸，平静且内省。在剪影内部，融合一片柔和的冬季森林景观，带有枯树、凉爽的雾气、苍白的霜冻、蓝灰色的阴影和柔和的白色大气层。主标题内容完全为：“WINTER”。上方的小字手写体内容完全为：“Seasonal Chapter”。下方的辅助行内容完全为：“Quiet depth, cold breath, held silence.”。小按钮文字内容完全为：“DISCOVER”。

幻灯片 3，春季：一名姿势轻微弯曲或转身的成年男性，略微向下看，优雅且深思。在剪影内部，融合一片明亮的春季林地场景，带有柔软的常绿层、薄雾般的白光、苍白的苔藓、湿润的树皮和新鲜萌发的生长物。主标题内容完全为：“SPRING”。上方的小字手写体内容完全为：“Seasonal Chapter”。下方的辅助行内容完全为：“Soft renewal, green pulse, waking air.”。小按钮文字内容完全为：“DISCOVER”。

幻灯片 4，秋季：一名成年女性或中性成年人物，从背面或略微后侧四分之三视角显示，头部居中，剪影宽阔而沉稳。在剪影内部，融合一片秋季河谷景观，带有柔和的金黄色草丛、凉爽的山影、森林边缘、银色的流水和苍白的琥珀色黄昏光线。主标题内容完全为：“AUTUMN”。上方的小字手写体内容完全为：“Seasonal Chapter”。下方的辅助行内容完全为：“Earth tone, long water, fading warmth.”。小按钮文字内容完全为：“DISCOVER”。

品牌和界面系统：每个幻灯片左上角的小标志内容完全为：“AETHRA”。每个幻灯片右上角的导航内容完全为：“HOME”、“EDITIONS”、“SEASONS”、“WORK”、“JOURNAL”、“ABOUT”、“CONTACT”。保持 UI 优雅、低调，并像真实的奢侈品网站一样可信，但要减少杂乱，使其感觉更像是一张画廊级别的图像，而不是文字意义上的网页截图。在每个幻灯片的侧边附近包含微小的左右箭头提示，以暗示全屏滑动条。字体应细长、高级、具有编辑感且空间平衡，主季节标题采用大型精致的大写衬线体或优雅的展示字体，较小的界面元素采用轻盈的现代无衬线体，每个标题上方的手写体行应精致且克制。

双重曝光处理：人物剪影必须是写实的且解剖结构优雅，具有干净的轮廓、可信的肩膀和颈部，在可见处具有自然的皮肤和头发细节，并且在景观融入面部和身体的地方具有非常柔和的边缘过渡。景观应与每个肖像的轮廓逻辑保持一致，使水平线、树丛、草层和雾场感觉嵌入在人物内部，而不是粘贴在上面。保持融合微妙且高级，没有粗糙的剪贴效果、没有浑浊的重叠，也没有混乱的纹理堆叠。

光影和调色板：整体板块的调色板必须保持克制、高级且具有季节差异，同时通过干净的白色界面区域进行统一。在每个幻灯片中使用 60/30/10 逻辑，但保持一致的整体板块外观。夏季：暖白色、青蓝色水面、阳光下的赭石色。冬季：冷白色、雾灰色、蓝绿色森林阴影。春季：苍白的薄雾、新鲜的绿色、柔软的树皮棕色。秋季：温暖的石色、柔和的琥珀色、深色的针叶树阴影。保持对比度柔和但刻意，具有足够的色调分离以保留面部轮廓和文字的可读性。展示板必须感觉平静、昂贵且具有编辑感，绝不吵闹或过度饱和。

材质和修饰：超写实的人物摄影与艺术性的景观曝光以及奢侈品 UI 设计相结合。显示真实的头发丝、皮肤的柔和感、湖泊纹理、树木剪影细节、雾的深度、山脉氛围和清晰渲染的排版。最终图像应感觉像是戛纳级别的数字艺术指导板块：现代、具有收藏价值、情感智能且由品牌系统驱动。

输出和约束：一个完整的四幻灯片季节性活动展示板，没有复制的源文本，没有真实的品牌名称，没有额外的人，没有杂乱的界面，没有沉重的装饰性噪音，没有廉价的库存模板感。保持所有肖像为成年人、优雅且解剖结构正确。保持排版清晰易读，白色区域宽敞，融合干净，季节差异清晰但受控。避免破碎的面部结构、浑浊的双重曝光、随机的纹理溢出、无法阅读的 UI、过度锐化的森林、过度饱和的调色板、粘贴的拼贴边缘、乱码文本或偏离高端编辑现实主义。

prompts.text:
## [Subject Description]

A photorealistic large group portrait of **many distinct young adult  women(20-28y)** arranged across a grand double staircase and the marble floor of an elegant mansion. Each woman has individually varied facial features, hairstyles, body proportions, expressions, and poses; preserve clear visual individuality rather than homogenizing their appearances.

They wear a wide variety of **two-piece bikinis in different colors, patterns, and designs**, including white, black, red, pink, blue, green, orange, and floral prints. Hairstyles vary naturally, including long straight hair, long wavy hair, medium-length hair, and bangs. Expressions are generally relaxed and friendly, with many women looking directly toward the camera.

The women are arranged in multiple vertical and horizontal tiers: standing along both staircases and upper balcony areas, standing and kneeling on the lower floor, and several seated or kneeling in the foreground. Poses remain natural and clearly readable, with complete bodies and limbs visible wherever possible.

They possess the best head-to-body ratio, a perfect, curvaceous, S-shaped female figure,Hourglass figure,long legs with perfect leg lines, and a slender waist, perfect foots,perfect foot lines

## [Scene / Background]

An opulent **European-style luxury mansion foyer** with a dramatic symmetrical double staircase. The interior features cream and ivory architectural walls, elaborate classical molding, tall decorative columns, ornate black wrought-iron railings with intricate gold detailing, polished white marble flooring, and large arched windows.

A large crystal chandelier hangs centrally above the staircase. Additional chandeliers and warm interior lighting are visible deeper in the mansion. The staircase curves upward symmetrically from both sides toward a central upper landing, creating a grand architectural frame around the group.

The background includes decorative balconies, classical wall panels, ornamental gold accents, elegant furniture, lamps, and a distant doorway/window visible beneath the central staircase.

## [Lighting / Ambience]

Warm, luxurious indoor illumination with soft golden ambient light. Crystal chandeliers produce subtle highlights and reflections across the polished marble floor and metal railings. Balanced exposure across the entire large group, with gentle soft shadows and natural skin tones.

The atmosphere is elegant, formal, glamorous, and celebratory while retaining the realism of a professionally photographed group event.

## [Composition / View]

**Very wide horizontal group portrait**, straight-on eye-level perspective, centered and highly symmetrical composition.

Use the architectural symmetry of the double staircase as the primary framing element. The central staircase landing and chandelier form the visual axis, while the women create layered rows following the curves and levels of the architecture.

Include the entire width of the staircase and foyer, with the foreground group extending across the marble floor. Maintain clear separation between individuals and avoid excessive overlapping of faces, torsos, hands, or legs.

Show the women at different elevations and depths to create strong visual layering while keeping faces recognizable and bodies naturally proportioned. Full-body framing for foreground subjects, with no unnecessary cropping of heads or major limbs.

Ultra-wide perspective appropriate for a very large group photograph, while keeping architectural lines natural and avoiding extreme fisheye distortion.

## [Style Reference]

**Photorealistic high-end professional group photography**, realistic East Asian adult women, natural facial diversity, realistic anatomy and body proportions, authentic skin texture, physically plausible hair and fabric, detailed bikini materials and patterns.

Luxury editorial photography combined with an upscale formal group portrait aesthetic. Natural photographic depth, realistic perspective, subtle lens rendering, refined warm color grading, crisp architectural detail, and convincing spatial depth.

No illustration, no anime, no CGI appearance, no duplicated faces, no cloned bodies, no homogenized facial features.

## [Image Quality Parameters]

Ultra-high-resolution, highly detailed, sharp focus across the large group, realistic skin pores and fine hair strands, accurate hands and fingers, natural body anatomy, detailed fabric and metallic textures, clean facial rendering, realistic marble reflections, precise architectural details, balanced exposure, high dynamic range, subtle professional lens characteristics, natural depth of field appropriate for a large group, minimal distortion, clean image structure, professional full-frame camera quality, **wide horizontal aspect ratio**.

prompts.text:
## [主体描述]

一张极其写实的大型群体肖像，由许多各具特色的年轻成年女性（20-28岁）组成，她们排列在一座宏伟豪宅的豪华双向阶梯和大理石地板上。每位女性都拥有各异的面部特征、发型、身材比例、表情和姿势；保持清晰的视觉个性，而不是使她们的外貌同质化。

她们穿着各式各样的两件式比基尼，有不同的颜色、图案和设计，包括白色、黑色、红色、粉色、蓝色、绿色、橙色和碎花印花。发型自然多样，包括长直发、长波浪发、中长发和刘海。表情通常放松且友好，许多女性直接注视着镜头。

女性们排列在多个垂直和水平层级中：沿着两侧楼梯和上方阳台区域站立，在底层地板上站立和跪着，还有几位在前景中坐着或跪着。姿势保持自然且清晰可读，在可能的情况下，全身和肢体均清晰可见。

她们拥有最佳的头身比，完美的曲线玲珑的S型女性身材，沙漏型身材，拥有完美腿部线条的长腿，以及纤细的腰部，完美的双脚，完美的足部线条。

## [场景 / 背景]

一个华丽的欧式豪华豪宅门厅，带有戏剧性的对称双向阶梯。室内以奶油色和象牙色的建筑墙壁、精致的古典线条、高大的装饰柱、带有复杂金色细节的华丽黑色锻铁扶手、抛光白色大理石地板和大型拱形窗户为特色。

一盏大型水晶吊灯悬挂在楼梯正上方的中央。在豪宅深处还可以看到额外的吊灯和温暖的室内照明。楼梯从两侧对称地向上弯曲，通向中央的上方平台，在群体周围形成了一个宏伟的建筑框架。

背景包括装饰性阳台、古典墙板、装饰性金色点缀、优雅的家具、灯具以及中央楼梯下方可见的远处的门口/窗户。

## [光影 / 氛围]

温暖、奢华的室内照明，带有柔和的金黄色环境光。水晶吊灯在抛光大理石地板和金属栏杆上产生微妙的高光和反射。整个大型群体的曝光平衡，带有柔和的阴影和自然的肤色。

氛围优雅、正式、迷人且具庆典感，同时保留了专业拍摄的群体活动的写实感。

## [构图 / 视角]

prompts.text:
Create a vertical illustration with a "top-bottom split composition," where the vertical layout of the canvas is divided into top and bottom areas with a strict 1:1 ratio. It should be a single complete work, not a collage of two independent images.

Top Half:
Use the user-uploaded original image as the primary source, automatically identifying the main characters, cats, dogs, or other common pets in the original image and presenting them as the sole core subject. Focus on extracting identifiable information of the subject itself, including the person's face shape, facial features, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone, age, clothing, accessories, posture, and temperament, or the pet's fur color, patterns, body shape, ear shape, eye characteristics, and expression. The top half should center on "original subject display," maintaining a visual state that is as realistic, natural, and clear as possible. Appropriate cropping and composition optimization can be done according to the needs of the split screen, but do not change the identity of the subject. If the original image contains buildings, indoor spaces, street scenes, or other complex environmental elements, these contents should only be treated as auxiliary background weakening and not as key extraction objects; there is no need to specifically preserve the architectural style. The overall requirement for the top half is that the subject is clear, complete, and not cut off, the image is clean, the visual center is stable, and the main task is to clearly show "who the original subject uploaded by the user is."

Bottom Half:
Perform a stylized translation of the same subject from the top half in the bottom half. It must still be the same person or animal, maintaining core recognizability and not becoming an unrelated new character. Create a complete illustration in the visual language of "Raw Art / Art Brut." Core stylistic features: unrefined academic lines, rough forms, direct symbols, and irregular color blocks. General principle: allow for exaggeration, distortion, and irregular brushstrokes, creating visual impact with strong lines, ink marks, and emotional tension. The composition uses a single clear subject or a clear scene, the visual center is stable, the subject is complete and not cut off, and the background is moderately simplified while retaining a sense of breathability; lines, color blocks, light and shadow, materials, and paper texture must serve the same style and not mix in unrelated painting styles. The image should be natural, have a handmade feel and recognizable stylistic features, avoiding common AI issues like excessive smoothness, meaningless piles of detail, and random decoration. Unless the theme specifically requires it, do not generate text, logos, watermarks, borders, or UI, and do not make multi-image collages.

Overall Supplementary Requirements:
The top and bottom parts must clearly correspond to the same subject, forming a top-bottom contrast relationship of "original subject / stylized subject." The bottom half should reflect a raw, direct, and unrefined sense of crude art, but must not lose the recognizability of the subject. Maintain a handmade, simple, primitive, and impactful visual language overall, and do not make it into a polished commercial illustration. Do not generate additional explanatory text, titles, logos, watermarks, UI, or borders.

prompts.text:
Use the uploaded real street style photo as the source.

Bottom 50%: AI-filtered editorial fashion illustration

Do not simply apply a cartoon effect or trace the photograph.

The outfit is the priority. Carefully preserve important fashion details such as:

clothing shape and layering, shoulder line, waistline, skirt or trouser length, pockets, collars, cuffs, footwear, bags, glasses, jewelry, and other recognizable accessories.

Simplify the facial features into a tasteful fashion illustration style while keeping the original expression and personality. Avoid oversized anime eyes, chibi proportions, doll-like faces, or overly cute expressions.

Transform the surrounding environment into the same illustration language instead of removing it. Keep the most important architecture, storefronts, windows, streets, trees, shadows, and environmental color blocks so the filtered image still feels like the same place and the same moment.

Simplify unnecessary background details while preserving the original composition, camera angle, lighting direction, and spatial relationships.

Use clean continuous outlines, soft matte colors, subtle paper texture, restrained hand-painted details, and a modern Japanese editorial fashion illustration feel.

The result should feel stylish, natural, contemporary, and collectible, like an illustrated OOTD page from a fashion or lifestyle magazine.

Avoid photorealistic rendering, glossy 3D, heavy watercolor bleeding, thick oil-paint texture, excessive linework, generic cartoon styling, or changing the outfit into a different design.

Keep the top and bottom images closely matched in crop, subject scale, pose, and composition.

prompts.text:
Hyper-realistic Japanese-style washitsu double portrait, vertical aspect ratio approximately 3:4, two clearly adult East Asian women, 20+, sitting side-by-side on traditional tatami room floor, camera placed extremely low directly in front of their feet, using a 20–24mm ultra-wide-angle lens for a close-up low-angle upward shot. The feet of the two people are closest to the lens, and the soles of the feet wrapped in thin black stockings are significantly enlarged, occupying the lower half of the frame; the faces are located in the upper-middle part of the frame, forming a strong near-large far-small perspective.

Both individuals have small-to-medium frames, slender waists, naturally full thighs, and realistic body proportions. They are sitting naturally against a Japanese-style wall with their legs extended toward the camera and knees bent: the legs of the person on the left are basically parallel and pointing forward, with both soles directly facing the camera; the legs of the person on the right are crossed, with one sole in the foreground center and the other slightly raised to the right. The soles are completely covered by stockings, and the outlines of toes, ball of the foot, arch, and heel can be clearly identified through the thin stockings; the stockings become more transparent after being stretched on the soles, with fine fabric texture visible at the tips.

Appearance details: the person on the left has long straight jet-black hair combed back to reveal ears and forehead, wearing small gold earrings. The person on the right has hair in a simple low bun with a few stray strands on the sides of the face. Both look directly at the camera with quiet, cold expressions and exquisite yet natural makeup: slender eyeliner, light brown eyeshadow, and low-saturation bean paste lip color.

Clothing consists of two different colored modern slim-fit cheongsams / modified Chinese-style sleeveless dresses.

On the left: a warm ginger / amber yellow cheongsam with a stand collar, sleeveless, tight-fitting cut, fabric with red-orange floral and small traditional patterns, a small teardrop opening at the center of the neckline, and the skirt hem naturally split on the side, revealing thighs in a sitting position.

On the right: a grey-blue / slate grey floral cheongsam, also high-collared and sleeveless, covered with pink, dark red, and cream-white flowers and green leaf patterns; the fabric is matte and soft, fitting the waist and hips, with the skirt naturally spread out with the sitting posture.

Both wear smoke-black ultra-thin translucent pantyhose / sheer pantyhose, about 10–15D, in tones of black-grey or dark coffee-grey, which clearly reveal natural skin tone. The stockings completely cover from the thighs to the toes, with a delicate silken luster on the surface that produces faint highlights under the flash. No fishnets, thick black socks, or bare feet.

Hand placement is natural: the person on the left has hands near the chest/abdomen or between the knees; the person on the right has one hand lightly on the chest and the other propped on the side of the body, maintaining a casual group photo state.

Setting is a traditional Japanese tatami washitsu. The floor is laid with light beige straw-woven tatami with dark green woven edges. Background includes white lime walls, dark brown wooden beams, wooden lattice sliding doors, and translucent washi paper windows. On the upper left wall hangs a white wood-framed calligraphy piece with black ink characters.

In the foreground on the upper right, there is a thick low dark brown wooden table, the corner of which is very close to the lens, creating obvious perspective enlargement. On the table is a transparent glass teapot filled with light golden-yellow tea, next to a white teacup. The wooden table partially blocks the upper right of the frame, increasing the sense of real space.

Lighting uses front-facing portable digital camera hard flash combined with dim indoor warm light. The flash directly illuminates the faces, cheongsams, and stockinged soles; skin tones are warm white; the soles are very clear and bright due to being closest to the flash, with obvious stocking textures, toe outlines, and arch layers. The background wooden structures and deep parts of the room remain dark.

Overall texture is 2000s–2010s Asian photo / CCD digital camera indoor direct flash style: strong ultra-wide-angle perspective, slight vignetting, small amount of grain, slightly soft edges, limited dynamic range, realistic skin texture, no modern HDR or commercial studio photography.

Key Focus: Two adult East Asian women + Japanese tatami room + ultra-low camera position close-up low-angle shot + two people sitting on the ground with legs extended + multiple thin black stockinged soles directly facing the camera and significantly enlarged by wide angle + clear toe and arch outlines + ginger yellow floral cheongsam + grey-blue floral cheongsam + smoke-black sheer pantyhose + glass teapot + dark low wooden table + wooden beams and calligraphy + front direct flash + CCD photo texture.

服装采用两套不同颜色的现代修身旗袍 / 改良中式无袖连衣裙。

两人都穿烟黑色超薄半透明连裤丝袜 / sheer pantyhose，约 10–15D，色调为黑灰或深咖灰，能明显透出自然肤色。丝袜从大腿一直完整覆盖到脚趾，表面有细腻丝光，在闪光灯下产生微弱高光。不要网袜、厚黑袜或裸脚。

人物手部自然：左侧双手靠近胸腹或膝盖之间，右侧一手轻放在胸前，另一只手撑在身体侧边，保持随意合影状态。

场景为传统日式榻榻米和室。地面铺浅米黄色草编榻榻米，边缘带深绿色织纹包边。背景为白色石灰墙、深棕木梁、木质格栅拉门和半透明和纸窗。左上墙面挂一幅带黑色书法的白底木框字画。

画面右上前景放置一张深棕色厚实低矮木桌，桌角距离镜头很近，产生明显透视放大。桌上放一只透明玻璃茶壶，里面装淡金黄色茶水，旁边有白色茶杯。木桌部分遮挡右上画面，增加真实空间感。

光线采用正面便携数码相机硬闪＋昏暗室内暖光。闪光直接照亮两人的脸部、旗袍和丝袜脚掌，人物肤色偏暖白；脚底因距离闪光最近而非常清晰明亮，丝袜纹理、脚趾轮廓和足弓层次明显。背景木结构和房间深处保持较暗。

整体呈 2000s–2010s 亚洲写真 / CCD 数码相机室内直闪质感：强烈超广角透视、轻微暗角、少量颗粒、边缘略软、有限动态范围、真实皮肤纹理，不要现代 HDR 或商业棚拍。

重点锁定：两名成年东亚女性＋日式榻榻米房间＋超低机位近距离仰拍＋两人坐地伸腿＋多只黑色薄丝袜脚掌正对镜头并被广角明显放大＋脚趾与足弓轮廓清楚＋姜黄色花卉旗袍＋青灰色花卉旗袍＋烟黑超薄连裤丝袜＋玻璃茶壶＋深色矮木桌＋木梁和书法字画＋正面直闪＋CCD 写真质感。

避免：未成年人、裸脚、白袜、网袜、厚黑丝袜、高跟鞋、站姿、跪姿、正常平视机位、现代西式卧室、人物过远、脚掌太小、鞋子遮挡脚部、动漫脸、CG 感、塑料皮肤、多余脚趾、多余腿脚、水印和乱码文字。

prompts.text:
Create one independent editorial-style poster for each uploaded photo. Do not make a collage. Process and output each photo separately.

Use a strict 3:4 vertical composition, divided horizontally into two exactly equal sections, each occupying 50% of the canvas.

TOP HALF — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH
Preserve the original photo. Keep the main subject unchanged while retaining its realistic texture, natural lighting, and original color atmosphere. Apply only subtle editorial-grade color correction to create the refined feel of an art magazine, independent publication, or exhibition photography.

To fit the composition, you may gently extend the sky, ground, or surrounding environmental background, but do not stretch, distort, or alter the main subject.

BOTTOM HALF — LAYERED PAPER CUT / PAPER ART REINTERPRETATION
Reinterpret the most recognizable subject, silhouette, pose, and spatial relationships from the photo as a minimalist layered paper-cut / paper-art composition.

Use one primary subject as the visual anchor. Do not mechanically reproduce every detail. Instead, reconstruct the key silhouette, proportions, and structure through folding, cutting, layering, and overlapping.

Transform only a few supporting environmental elements into foreground, midground, and background paper layers. Use scale contrast, negative space, clean alignment, and front-to-back layering to make the subject immediately recognizable while maintaining a restrained editorial composition.

COLOR & MATERIAL
Extract the most distinctive and recognizable colors from the original photo, then reduce them into a limited and harmonious paper-art palette.

Use warm ivory or light-colored paper as the base, supported by a small amount of stronger accent colors, darker structural tones, soft transitional layer colors, and very limited highlights.

The material should resemble high-quality matte cardstock, with subtle visible paper fibers, clean cut edges, and soft contact shadows under natural diffused lighting. Emphasize the tactile quality of real handcrafted paper art.

Avoid glossy plastic-like 3D effects, cheap craft-paper aesthetics, neon colors, and overly saturated or complex gradients.

EDITORIAL TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM
Add a refined editorial typography system. Based on the identity, location, action, material, emotion, or symbolic meaning of the subject, create one short main title.

Add 2–4 groups of smaller supporting text. These may include object names, location information, numbers, sequence markers, coordinate-like numbers, direction words, status words, material descriptions, classification labels, or a very short poetic phrase.

Do not use any year or date.

The main title should convey emotion and identity, while the smaller text should add rhythm, structure, and refinement.

TYPOGRAPHY INTEGRATION
Integrate the typography naturally into the composition so that it interacts with the paper-cut forms. Arrange text along paper-layer edges, subject contours, geometric axes, or areas of negative space.

Use horizontal or vertical typesetting, rotated text, generous letter spacing, edge alignment, corner placement, cross-section layouts, embedded typography, or partially overlapped text.

The main title may have a subtle paper-cut or folded-paper quality, while the supporting text should remain thin, modern, restrained, and precise.

The final result should feel elegant, tactile, balanced, art-directed, and distinctly editorial.

为了适应构图，你可以轻轻延伸天空、地面或周围的环境背景，但不要拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分 — 分层剪纸 / 纸艺重新诠释
将照片中最具辨识度的主体、轮廓、姿势和空间关系重新诠释为极简的分层剪纸 / 纸艺构图。

使用一个主要主体作为视觉锚点。不要机械地复制每一个细节。相反，通过折叠、裁剪、分层和重叠来重构关键的轮廓、比例和结构。

仅将少数辅助环境元素转化为前景、中景和背景纸层。利用比例对比、负空间、整洁的对齐和前后分层，使主体立即辨识，同时保持克制的社论构图。

色彩与材质
从原始照片中提取最具特色和辨识度的色彩，然后将其简化为有限且和谐的纸艺调色板。

使用暖象牙色或浅色纸张作为基底，辅以少量较强的强调色、较深的结构色调、柔和的过渡层颜色以及极其有限的高光。

材质应类似于高质量的磨砂卡纸，具有细微可见的纸张纤维、整洁的切割边缘，以及在自然漫反射光线下的柔和接触阴影。强调真实手工纸艺的触感质量。

避免产生像塑料一样的光泽 3D 效果、廉价的工艺纸美感、霓虹色以及过度饱和或复杂的渐变。

社论排版系统
添加精致的社论排版系统。根据主体的身份、位置、动作、材质、情感或象征意义，创建一个简短的主标题。

添加 2–4 组较小的辅助文字。这些可能包括物体名称、位置信息、数字、序列标记、类似坐标的数字、方向词、状态词、材质描述、分类标签或非常短的诗意短语。

不要使用任何年份或日期。

主标题应传达情感和身份，而较小的文字应增加节奏感、结构感和精致度。

排版整合
将排版自然地融入构图，使其与剪纸形式互动。沿着纸层边缘、主体轮廓、几何轴线或负空间区域排列文字。

使用水平或垂直排版、旋转文字、宽松的字间距、边缘对齐、角落放置、横截面布局、嵌入式排版或部分重叠的文字。

主标题可能带有细微的剪纸或折纸质感，而辅助文字应保持纤细、现代、克制且精确。

最终结果应感觉优雅、具有触感、平衡、经过艺术指导且具有鲜明的社论风格。

items.title: 现代简约社论风格美食海报设计

prompts.text:
Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Food / Drink: [PRODUCT]
Headline: [2–4 WORD HEADLINE]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Visual Interaction: [food replaces a letter / passes through type / refracts letters / becomes a divider / reveals hidden text]
Supporting Info: [PRICE / HOURS / INGREDIENTS / ADDRESS]
Aspect Ratio: 9:16

Create a premium editorial food poster for a modern café, bakery, or restaurant brand.

Use a warm cream or ivory background, generous negative space, oversized typography, photorealistic food photography, and a clean European editorial layout.

The key idea is that the food must actively interact with the typography rather than simply sit beside it.

Use the selected visual interaction to create one clear visual hook. For example, a coffee cup can replace a letter, a croissant can overlap the headline, transparent glass can physically refract letters behind it, melted cheese can become part of the layout, or a missing food slice can reveal hidden text underneath.

Keep the main headline large and instantly readable at thumbnail size. Combine a bold Grotesk Sans Serif with a refined Editorial Serif, using no more than 2–3 type styles.

Build clear hierarchy with: large headline, medium product name, small brand information, price, ingredients, opening hours, or address.

Use only cream, black, natural food colors, and one accent color.

Food should look highly realistic with natural texture, believable shadows, accurate materials, and appetizing detail. Avoid CGI, plastic surfaces, excessive gloss, fake textures, or over-stylized commercial food photography.

Keep the composition clean, asymmetric, refined, and brand-ready. Every text element should feel intentional and meaningful, with no Lorem Ipsum or random filler copy.

The final result should feel like a real independent café campaign designed by a strong editorial design studio, with one instantly understandable food-and-typography interaction as the visual hook.

prompts.text:
Ultra-realistic night party group photography, horizontal aspect ratio 3:2, seven clearly adult East Asian women, age 20+, wearing uniform purple sequin bunny girl stage costumes, huddled tightly together for a group photo in a high-rise hotel lounge / night view restaurant. The photographer is very close, using approximately 28–35mm equivalent lens + direct front flash, figures almost fill the entire frame, crowded composition, strong sense of authentic party snapshot.

All seven people wearing deep purple sequin bunny girl bodysuits, fabric covered in tiny sequins, producing purple-blue highlights under the flash; paired with black fine fishnet tights, white stand collars, black bowties, white cuffs, purple sequin bunny ear headbands, and white fluffy bunny tails on the lower back. Costumes are uniform but with slight variations in detail for each person, maintaining full normal coverage.

Figures are all naturally slim to slight hourglass shapes, narrow shoulders, cinched waists, rounded hips, thighs with realistic soft volume, no athletic muscles or exaggerated proportions. Hairstyles are mainly black, dark brown, light brown, and golden brown medium-long hair, including let-down hair, low ponytails, light curls, and wispy bangs. Makeup is Japanese-style nightclub party style: distinct eyeliner, eyelashes, light brown eyeshadow, nude pink or mauve lips.

Composition focus is seven people layered and squeezed together: On the left, one person is sideways with her back to the camera, looking back at the lens, white bunny tail clearly visible; next to her, one person is front-facing but slightly turned, holding a champagne glass; in the center-back, two or three people are very close, one person with a hand touching bunny ears or hair; in the front-center of the frame, one person is clearly leaning forward, body facing forward, head looking back at the lens, becoming the foreground core; on the right, two people are semi-sideways near the table, the rightmost person has light brown-blonde hair holding a slender champagne glass. Everyone is looking directly or semi-directly at the camera, expressions are cool, smiling, or slightly party-vibe, not uniform expressions.

Champagne glasses, transparent glass cups, wine bottles, ice buckets, and warm candle light reflections are visible on the table and in front of the figures. Background is a dark brown wood high-rise lounge, outside the floor-to-ceiling windows is a sea of city night lights and skyscraper lights, windows reflect indoor warm light, overall background is relatively dark.

Lighting uses strong camera direct flash + dim warm ambient light: faces, shoulders, sequin costumes, and fishnet tights are directly illuminated by the flash, skin tones are warm white; purple sequins generate many fine highlights; background darkens rapidly, city night view forms scattered bokeh. Allow for small amount of high ISO noise, slight motion blur, and edge softening.

Overall presents a 2000s–2010s Japanese nightclub / high-rise lounge party CCD digital camera snapshot texture: high contrast, direct flash, high saturation purple, deep shadows, slight grain, limited dynamic range, realistic skin texture, no commercial studio feel.

Key Focus: Seven adult East Asian women + purple sequin bunny girl suits + purple bunny ears + white bunny tails + black fine fishnet stockings + white collars and cuffs + multiple people tightly huddled + central figure leaning forward looking back + multiple people holding champagne glasses + high-rise night view lounge + floor-to-ceiling window city lights + direct front flash + 2000s digital party snapshot.

Avoid: Fewer than seven people, single person overly prominent, white or black bunny girl suits, ordinary dresses, messy sock/shoe colors, daytime, outdoors, photography studio, figures standing dispersed in a row, over-smoothed skin, anime faces, CG feel, extra figures, extra limbs, watermarks and garbled text.

prompts.text:
超写实夜间派对群像摄影，横版约 3:2，七名明确成年的东亚女性，20+，穿统一的紫色兔女郎舞台服装，在高层酒店酒廊 / 夜景餐厅里围成紧密一团合影。摄影者距离很近，使用约 28–35mm 等效镜头＋正面直闪，人物几乎填满整个画面，构图拥挤、有强烈真实聚会抓拍感。

七人全部穿深紫色亮片兔女郎连体衣，面料布满细小闪片，在闪光灯下出现紫蓝色高光；搭配黑色细网眼丝袜 / fishnet tights、白色立领、黑色蝴蝶结、白色腕口、紫色亮片兔耳发箍、腰后白色毛绒兔尾巴。服装统一但每个人细节略有差异，保持完整正常覆盖。

人物全部为自然纤细到轻微沙漏型身材，肩部偏窄，腰部收束，髋部圆润，大腿有真实柔软体积，不要健美肌肉或夸张比例。发型以黑色、深棕、浅棕和金棕色中长发为主，有披发、低马尾、轻卷发和碎刘海，妆容偏日系夜店派对风：明显眼线、睫毛、浅棕眼影、裸粉或豆沙色嘴唇。

构图重点是七个人前后错落挤在一起：
左侧一人侧身背对镜头后回头看镜头，腰后白色兔尾巴清楚；旁边一人正面偏侧，手持香槟杯；中后方两三人靠得很近，有人一手扶兔耳或头发；画面正中央前方一人明显俯身前倾、身体朝前、头部回看镜头，成为前景核心；右侧两人半侧身靠近桌边，其中最右人物为浅棕金发，手里拿细长香槟杯。所有人都直视或半直视镜头，神情冷淡、微笑或略带派对感，不要统一表情。

桌面与人物前方可见香槟酒杯、透明玻璃杯、酒瓶、冰桶和暖色烛光反射。背景为深棕色木质高层酒廊，落地窗外是夜晚城市灯海和高楼灯光，窗户反射室内暖光，整体背景较暗。

光线采用强烈相机直闪＋昏暗暖色环境灯：人物脸部、肩部、亮片服装和丝袜被闪光直接照亮，肤色偏暖白；紫色亮片产生大量细碎高光；背景迅速压暗，城市夜景形成零散散景。允许少量高 ISO 噪点、轻微运动模糊和边缘柔化。
