prompts.text:
创作一张竖版上下双拼视觉作品。

上半部分呈现用户上传的真实人物、宠物、动物或主体照片；下半部分以同一个主体为核心，重构成中国印压浮雕 / 纸雕凹凸质感的东方极简艺术画面。

上下两部分形成非常克制而高级的“真实影像 × 东方纸张雕塑”对照。

上半部分｜用户上传原图

上方完整保留原始摄影照片。

优先保持人物、宠物、动物、多人互动或人与宠物互动主体。

人物需要保留脸型、五官、发型、肤色、服饰、饰品、姿态与互动关系。

宠物或动物需要保留品种特征、脸型、耳朵、毛色、花纹、身体比例、尾巴、姿势与动作。

不将上方照片变成白色浮雕或插画。

允许适应竖版构图进行合理裁切，但不得改变主体身份。

建筑与环境仅作为照片背景存在，除非其轮廓与人物动作存在明确关系，否则不作为下半部分主要重构内容。

下半部分｜东方金色压印浮雕转译

从上半部分照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为中国印压浮雕 / 纸雕凹凸质感的极简艺术海报。

整体像压印在厚重乳白色纸张上，以浅浮雕、细腻阴影、极简线刻和克制层次重新概括主体。

不机械复刻照片全部细节，而是保留最核心的结构特征与空间关系，使人一眼能够识别下方与上方原图为同一个人物、同一只动物或同一组主体。

人物脸部不需要做成写实雕像，但脸型、发型轮廓、服装结构、身体姿势与动作必须能够和上方建立对应。

宠物需要重点保留耳朵、脸部比例、毛色分区所形成的结构、身体姿态和尾巴等识别信息，并通过浮雕层级和线刻重新表现。

根据主体类型，可将其转化为正视、微俯视、局部俯瞰或轴线延展的浅浮雕构图。

适度保留与主体真正相关的少量环境轮廓或道具，例如椅子、一本书、一束花、宠物玩具等，使画面具有清晰主次、纵深秩序与博物馆展陈般的宁静感。

不要把上方完整建筑背景机械雕刻进下方。

整体以大面积乳白、暖白或浅纸色留白为基底。

主体及相关元素统一以同色系浅浮雕呈现，通过压印高低差、边缘投影和细微明暗建立层次。

浮雕必须呈现真实厚纸压印质感：纸张纤维细腻、边缘干净、浅浅压痕、柔和自然阴影，不要做成石膏雕塑、陶瓷或电脑3D模型。

可仅在主体最关键的局部结构或视觉焦点处加入少量哑金色细节与柔和暖白光感，用来强化核心识别点。

金色使用必须非常克制。

例如人物的一处发饰、衣服线条、手中道具、宠物项圈、眼神方向中的极小结构、轮廓节点或动作关系可以采用哑金压印。

不要把整个主体都涂成金色。

避免颜色杂乱、过度装饰和堆砌场景。

文字需转化为画面结构的一部分，而不是普通标题说明。

从照片的主体身份、主题气质、动作状态、情绪或象征意义中提炼简短文字。

可使用标题 + 关键词 + 少量编号、微型注释或哲理短句。

如果没有明确地点，不强行加入虚构地点。

文字采用克制的金色或深灰色衬线 / 高级编辑字体，可置于中央轴线、主体下方、留白边缘或与浮雕结构对齐，使其与压印主体共同形成秩序感与展览海报气质，而非后期贴上的信息层。

整体风格追求高级、宁静、极简、克制、东方美学、博物馆海报感与纸张雕塑感。

下半部分应具有非常明显的收藏级纸张艺术作品气质。

上下组合后，观看者能够先看到真实人物或动物，再在下方看到其最核心的轮廓、姿态和情绪被提炼成安静的东方压印浮雕。

避免文字乱码、低清晰度、主体畸形、颜色杂乱、构图拥挤、廉价三维感和模板感。

禁止将人物做成完全陌生的雕像脸。

禁止改变宠物的关键轮廓和动作。

禁止复杂建筑抢夺下方主体。

prompts.text:
A cinematic vintage-camcorder snapshot photograph captured on location — an intimate medium-full hero composition of an East Asian woman reclining on a plush resort bed in a moody nighttime suite, the camera positioned at a low bed level in a horizontal framing capturing her relaxed, sleepy gaze and luminous silk texture in an M1 cinematic narrative register.

The woman has long, glossy chestnut-tinted dark brown hair falling softly over her shoulders and pillows, with natural loose strands gently swept back by her right hand resting near her temple. Her fair skin displays a soft, velvety natural texture with fine pores, delicate collarbones, and subtle subsurface scattering under warm indoor illumination. Her dark almond eyes gaze languidly toward the lens with an intimate, unhurried, late-night vulnerability, paired with soft natural pink lips relaxed in a gentle, neutral expression. She wears a luxurious dusty-rose pink silk satin loungewear robe with flowing sleeves draped loosely over a matching lustrous satin cowl-neck camisole, embellished with a sparkling silver crystal rhinestone strap detail resting along her collarbone. She is reclining comfortably on her side across clean white cotton sheets, her left arm extending forward onto the mattress in an effortless, candid posture.

prompts.text:
Vertical composition, aspect ratio 9:16. 

A young East Asian woman stands alone by the edge of a giant lotus pond that seems forgotten by time. She wears an extremely gorgeous but not ostentatious classical long dress, with layers of ivory white and faded cyan-green overlapping. Soft silk falls from her shoulders all the way to the ground, trailing a very, very long hem. The fabric is covered with dense yet restrained floral embroidery and dark gold patterns, like something left behind from a vanished era. 

She stands sideways, not looking at the camera. 

One hand is lightly raised, fingertips pausing in mid-air, as if wanting to touch something, yet finally deciding not to. 

Long black hair hangs to her waist, with only a few exquisite old-gold hairpins and long tassels in her bun. She is very young, very beautiful, but she does not smile. There is no sadness in the true sense on that face, only an indescribable fatigue and quietness—as if the person she is waiting for never promised to return, yet she has waited for a long time anyway. 

All around grow giant and almost surreal white lotuses, blooming in layers, with massive dark green lotus leaves covering the distant sky. The water surface is calm, reflecting the flowers, trees, and her dress trailing on the ground. A few withered petals are scattered at her feet, mixed with several dark red fading flowers. 

The flowers bloom so well. 

So well that it makes one feel that this day should not have been sad. 

The image adopts slight Rembrandt-style lighting: a warm and soft golden light passes through the branches, leaves, and mist from the upper left, illuminating only the woman's cheeks, shoulders, fingers, and part of the ivory white fabric; the rest of the space gradually sinks into deep brown, dark green, and grey-blue shadows. The transition between light and dark is soft, no stage light effect, no over-dramatization, making the light more like something accidentally left behind in the last few minutes of the evening. 

The giant lotuses behind her are still bright, while further away it has begun to darken. 

Maybe the sky is not going to get dark. 
It’s just that for some stories, after reaching this point, there is no need for the light to be that bright anymore. 

The overall visual merges Chinese classical Gongbi aesthetic, the white space and atmosphere of Song Dynasty bird-and-flower painting, European classical oil painting, Rembrandt chiaroscuro, modern European art film cinematography, and 35mm film texture. At first glance, it looks like a real movie still; at second glance, you realize it doesn't belong to reality; after staring for a long time, the brushstrokes and sense of time of a classical oil painting slowly emerge. 

Low color saturation, mainly ivory white, old gold, grey-cyan, dark green, and faded blue-green, with a small amount of dark red as very weak visual stinging points. Realistic silk texture, realistic embroidery, realistic skin texture, fine hair, extremely light mist and dust in the air, soft high dynamic range, rich details preserved in shadows, highlights not overexposed, no plastic skin, no excessive skin smoothing, no modern objects, no text, no watermark. 

Emotional keywords: slow, quiet, beautiful, alienated, nostalgic, hesitating to speak, nothing happening yet inexplicably sad. 

9:16, cinematic composition, full-body shot of the character, deep space, extensive environmental storytelling, classical painting texture, extremely high detail.

prompts.text:
竖幅构图，比例 9:16。

一个年轻的东亚女子，独自站在一座仿佛已经被时间遗忘的巨大荷花池畔。她穿着极其华美却并不张扬的古典长裙，象牙白与褪色青绿色层层交叠，柔软的丝绸从肩头一直垂落到地面，拖曳出很长很长的裙摆，衣料上布满细密而克制的花卉刺绣与暗金纹饰，像某个已经消失的时代留下来的东西。

她侧身站着，没有看镜头。

一只手轻轻抬起，指尖停在半空，像是想触碰什么，又像最后还是决定算了。

乌黑的长发垂到腰际，发髻上只有少量精致的旧金色簪饰与细长流苏。她很年轻，很漂亮，却没有笑。那张脸上没有真正意义上的悲伤，只是一种说不清楚的疲倦与安静——仿佛她等的人其实从来没有答应过要回来，而她偏偏还是等了很久。

四周生长着巨大而近乎不真实的白色荷花，层层盛开，硕大的墨绿色荷叶遮住远处的天空。水面平静，倒映着花、树与她拖在地上的衣裙。少量已经凋谢的花瓣散落在脚边，其中夹杂几朵暗红色残花。

花开得太好了。

好到让人觉得，这一天本来不应该难过。

画面采用轻微的伦勃朗式光影：一道温暖而柔和的金色光线从左上方穿过枝叶与薄雾，只照亮女子的脸颊、肩膀、手指以及部分象牙白衣料；其余空间逐渐沉入深褐、墨绿与灰蓝色阴影。明暗交界柔和，不要舞台灯效果，不要过度戏剧化，让光更像傍晚最后几分钟偶然留下来的东西。

她身后那些巨大的荷花仍然明亮，而更远的地方已经开始暗下去。

也许天并没有要黑。
只是有些故事，走到这里以后，光就没有必要再那么亮了。

整体视觉融合 中国古典工笔审美、宋代花鸟画的留白与气息、欧洲古典油画、伦勃朗式明暗法、现代欧洲艺术电影摄影、35mm胶片质感。第一眼像一张真实的电影剧照，第二眼才意识到它并不属于现实，凝视久了，又慢慢浮现出古典油画般的笔触与时间感。

色彩低饱和，象牙白、旧金、灰青、墨绿、褪色蓝绿色为主，少量暗红作为极弱的视觉刺点。真实丝绸纹理，真实刺绣，真实皮肤质感，细腻毛发，空气中极轻的薄雾与尘埃，柔和高动态范围，暗部保留丰富细节，高光不过曝，无塑料皮肤，无过度磨皮，无现代物件，无文字，无水印。

情绪关键词：慢、静、漂亮、疏离、怀旧、欲言又止、没有发生任何事情却莫名令人难过。

9:16，电影级构图，人物全身，纵深空间，大量环境叙事，古典绘画质感，极高细节。

prompts.text:
Turn this structure photo into a single high-end halftone architectural travel-collage poster. Output one poster per uploaded photo — never merge multiple structures or photos into one frame.

FORMAT

3:4 vertical canvas. Split into two roughly equal zones — real architectural photo on top, printed reconstruction below — divided by one clean, sharp horizontal line.

Do not stretch, warp, tilt, or unnaturally reposition the structure to force the proportions.

TOP HALF — THE REAL SHOT

Preserve the original structure faithfully: same architecture, proportions, perspective, distinctive details, surrounding elements, natural light and shadow, and original color mood.

Keep recognizable features such as:

* façade
* windows and arches
* towers or domes
* doors and structural details
* roofline
* surrounding landscape or street elements

Add only a subtle high-end color grade and the faintest film grain. Do not redesign or reinterpret the architecture.

BOTTOM HALF — THE PRINTED RECONSTRUCTION

Rebuild the same structure as an experimental printed architectural collage using:

torn photographic fragments + fixed-width ASCII character fields + photocopy halftone dots + architectural linework.

The structure must remain immediately recognizable.

* Torn-edge photographic fragments preserve the most important architectural details.
* Brick, stone, glass, metal, shadows, windows, and surrounding textures gradually dissolve outward into ASCII characters, black halftone dots, fragmented print grain, and fine architectural drafting lines.
* Use thin technical construction lines to subtly trace the structure’s geometry.
* Let selected areas break apart into paper fibers and halftone fragments, creating the feeling that the building is emerging from an archival print.
* Keep the main silhouette strong and readable.
* Texture: rough white paper-fiber edges, subtle photocopy imperfections, slight print misregistration, faded ink, old-paper stains, a few restrained crop marks, and one small red calibration bar.
* Color: warm gray old-paper background + black ink + the structure’s original muted colors + a single restrained red accent.
* Never fully desaturate the structure.

The structure should occupy roughly 60–88% of the frame width, scaled according to what reads best for the architecture.

Leave 22–38% of the paper visibly untouched and empty, creating generous negative space so the poster feels like an archival architectural specimen rather than a packed digital screen.

TYPOGRAPHY

Add one clean, readable fixed-width architectural title based on the structure:

[STRUCTURE NAME]

Below it include:

[CITY, COUNTRY]
REC. STUDY 01

Add one short observational caption related to the architecture, such as:

“A monumental study in geometry, time, and place.”

Typography should feel like an old architectural archive mixed with an underground experimental design journal.

A few loose ASCII glyphs may trace the outer silhouette or architectural edges as texture only — never use ASCII to invent windows, doors, structural details, or technical specifications.

MOOD

Early digital systems × analog photocopy × architectural archive × underground zine × modern travel editorial.

The structure should feel like it is surfacing from an old printed document — half photograph, half architectural drawing, half experimental print.

Sophisticated, minimal, tactile, intellectual, slightly mysterious, and highly collectible.

AVOID

Solid black terminal backgrounds, dense walls of code, cyberpunk neon, excessive ASCII, distorted architecture, impossible geometry, invented architectural details, fake technical specifications, random symbols with no meaning, garbled text, excessive colors, brand logos, QR codes, watermarks, author credits, or tourist-poster clichés.

Priority: Preserve the structure’s identity and architectural accuracy first. The experimental halftone/ASCII treatment should enhance the architecture, not hide it.

prompts.text:
将这张建筑照片转变为一张高端半色调建筑旅行拼贴海报。每张上传的照片输出一张海报——切勿将多个建筑或多张照片合并到一个画幅中。

格式

3:4 垂直画布。分为两个大致相等的区域——上方为真实的建筑照片，下方为打印的重建效果——由一条干净、清晰的水平线分隔。

不要为了强行适应比例而拉伸、扭曲、倾斜或不自然地重新定位建筑。

上半部分——真实拍摄

忠实地保留原始建筑：相同的建筑、比例、透视、独特的细节、周围元素、自然光影和原始色彩氛围。

保留可辨识的特征，例如：

* 立面
* 窗户和拱门
* 塔楼或穹顶
* 门和结构细节
* 屋顶线
* 周围景观或街道元素

仅添加细微的高端调色和极淡的电影颗粒感。不要重新设计或重新诠释建筑。

下半部分——打印重建

使用以下元素将相同的建筑重建为实验性的打印建筑拼贴：

撕裂的摄影碎片 + 等宽 ASCII 字符场 + 复印半色调网点 + 建筑线条。

建筑必须保持立即可辨识。

* 撕裂边缘的摄影碎片保留了最重要的建筑细节。
* 砖块、石头、玻璃、金属、阴影、窗户和周围的纹理逐渐向外溶解为 ASCII 字符、黑色半色调网点、破碎的打印纹理和精细的建筑制图线条。
* 使用细的工程施工线巧妙地勾勒建筑的几何形状。
* 让特定区域分解为纸张纤维和半色调碎片，营造出建筑正从档案印刷品中浮现的感觉。
* 保持主轮廓强有力且清晰易读。
* 纹理：粗糙的白色纸张纤维边缘、细微的复印缺陷、轻微的印刷套印不准、褪色的墨水、旧纸张污渍、少量克制的裁切标记以及一个小红色的校准条。
* 颜色：暖灰色旧纸张背景 + 黑色墨水 + 建筑原始的柔和色彩 + 单一且克制的红色点缀。
* 永远不要让建筑完全去色。

建筑应占据画幅宽度的约 60–88%，根据最适合该建筑的比例进行缩放。

留出 22–38% 的纸张明显留白，营造出宽裕的负空间，使海报感觉像是一件档案建筑标本，而不是拥挤的数字屏幕。

排版

添加一个基于该建筑的干净、易读的等宽建筑标题：

[建筑名称]

在其下方包括：

[城市, 国家]
REC. STUDY 01

添加一段与建筑相关的简短观察说明，例如：

“一场关于几何、时间和地点的丰碑式研究。”

排版应具有旧建筑档案与地下实验设计杂志相结合的感觉。

少量松散的 ASCII 字符可以仅作为纹理勾勒外部轮廓或建筑边缘——切勿使用 ASCII 来伪造窗户、门、结构细节或技术规范。

氛围

早期数字系统 × 模拟复印 × 建筑档案 × 地下杂志 × 现代旅行社论。

建筑应感觉像是从一份旧的印刷文件中浮现——一半照片，一半建筑图纸，一半实验性印刷。

精致、极简、有质感、充满理智、略带神秘且极具收藏价值。

避免

纯黑终端背景、密集的代码墙、赛博朋克霓虹灯、过多的 ASCII、扭曲的建筑、不可能的几何形状、虚构的建筑细节、虚假的技术规范、毫无意义的随机符号、乱码、过多的色彩、品牌徽标、二维码、水印、作者署名或旅游海报的陈词滥调。

优先级：首先保留建筑的身份和建筑准确性。实验性的半色调/ASCII 处理应增强建筑感，而不是掩盖它。

prompts.text:
Create a vertical split-screen visual work. The upper part is a real photo uploaded by the user, and the lower part re-translates the figures, pets, animals, or subject relationships from the upper photo into an editorial illustration composed of real natural materials.

The upper and lower images must maintain a clear correspondence in subject identity, outline, posture, and relationship.

Upper Part | User-uploaded original photo
Keep the real photo in the upper part.
Prioritize identifying people, pets, animals, human-animal combinations, and multi-person relationships.
Completely maintain the subject's original identity characteristics, including facial shape, hairstyle, clothing, posture, and movements for people; fur color, patterns, ears, facial shape, body proportions, tail, and movements for pets or animals.
Do not transform the upper part into leaves, petals, or illustrations beforehand.
Allow reasonable cropping according to the vertical layout, but keep the core subject complete and recognizable.
Buildings and complex environments are only kept as the photographic background of the upper part; the lower part does not use buildings as the main translation object.

Lower Part | Natural material collage editorial illustration translation
Extract the most recognizable subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship from the upper photo, and reconstruct it into an editorial illustration composed of real natural materials.
Use clearly identifiable leaves, petals, branches, fruits, seeds, grass stems, bark, or dry leaves, directly utilizing their original shapes, textures, color differences, and irregular edges to assemble the subject.
Do not cut the plants into overly precise geometric shapes, nor use a complete illustration outline to enclose the plants.
Make the viewer recognize that the bottom represents the same person, animal, or group of interacting subjects as the top photo, while also clearly seeing that it is ingeniously composed of real natural elements.
Natural materials are not decorations outside the person's photo, but truly undertake the subject's body structure.
For example:
A person's hair can be formed by naturally curling or layered leaves, grass stems, or petals;
Clothing can utilize leaves of different sizes and comprehensive color differences to form the main area;
Arms and legs can be represented using branches, grass stems, or elongated leaves according to the original posture;
Pet ears can choose naturally pointed leaves;
Tails can use curved branches or slender plant materials;
Face and body should try to utilize the natural materials' own outlines rather than relying on extensive drawing.

The composition establishes order with a simple rectangular color field or paper area, but do not deliberately draw a complete border.
The subject maintains a natural internal and external relationship with the rectangle, with most of it falling within the color field and a few most directional parts naturally extending beyond the boundary.
A person's extended hand, a pet's tail, ears, branches, or movement directions can naturally exceed the color field, giving the image a relaxed sense of "crossing boundaries"; like plants just happening to grow out of the layout, rather than striking a pose for the sake of "breaking the frame."
Maintain a large amount of white space, a clear center of gravity, and incomplete symmetry, allowing the randomness of natural materials to coexist with the order of editorial design.

Black lines appear only as a minimal auxiliary language and do not serve as the overall outline for the subject.
Can be used for eyes, mouths, minimalist expressions, small movement hints, local connections, short lines, handwriting marks, or slight visual rhythms in the layout.
The lines are thin, relaxed, and slightly hand-drawn, letting the plants themselves undertake the subject's form and outline.
In particular, it is forbidden to use black lines to completely outline a person's body or a pet's outer contour and then fill it with plants.

The color scheme extracts the most vital and recognizable color temperament from the original image in the upper part, and then re-translates it through the colors of natural plants themselves.
For example, if the person above wears green, orange, or blue clothing, the bottom can look for real materials like leaves, petals, or fruits with similar comprehensive colors for correspondence.
A pet's orange, gray, black and white patterns, etc., can also be cleverly reproduced using the comprehensive color differences of natural materials, but the plants cannot be artificially dyed into completely uniform color blocks to match the colors.
Retain the real comprehensive color differences of leaves, petals, fruits, and dead branches, without excessive uniform dyeing.
The background uses light or soft comprehensive colors coordinated with the original image, making the natural materials the visual center of the image, overall fresh, restrained, vital, and not cluttered.

prompts.text:
创作一张竖版上下双拼视觉作品，上半部分为用户上传的真实照片，下半部分将上方照片中的人物、宠物、动物或主体关系重新转译成由真实自然材料拼合而成的编辑插画。

上下画面必须保持主体身份、轮廓、姿态以及关系上的明显对应。

上半部分｜用户上传原图

上半部分保留真实照片。

优先识别人物、宠物、动物、人与动物组合以及多人关系。

完整保持主体原本的身份特征，包括人物脸型、发型、服饰、姿势和动作；宠物或动物的毛色、花纹、耳朵、脸型、身体比例、尾巴与动作。

不得把上半部分提前转化成树叶、花瓣或插画。

允许按照上下版式进行合理裁切，但保持核心主体完整可辨认。

建筑和复杂环境只保留为上半部分摄影背景，下半部分不以建筑作为主要转译对象。

下半部分｜自然材料拼贴编辑插画转译

从上半部分照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为由真实自然材料拼合而成的编辑插画。

使用清晰可辨的叶片、花瓣、枝条、果实、种子、草茎、树皮或枯叶，直接利用它们原本的形状、纹理、色差和不规则边缘组合主体。

不要把植物切割成过于精准的几何形，也不要用完整插画轮廓包住植物。

让观看者既能认出下方表现的是上方照片中的同一个人物、同一只动物或同一组互动主体，也能清楚看见它是由真实自然元素巧妙拼合而成。

自然材料不是装饰在人物照片外面，而是真正承担主体身体结构。

例如：

人物头发可以由自然卷曲或层叠的叶片、草茎、花瓣形成；

服装可以利用不同尺寸和综合色差的叶片形成主要面积；

手臂和腿部可以根据原姿态利用枝条、草茎或狭长叶片表现；

宠物耳朵可以选择天然尖形叶片；

尾巴可以使用弯曲枝条或细长植物材料；

脸部与身体应尽量利用天然材料自身轮廓形成，而不是依赖大量绘制。

构图以一个简洁的矩形色域或纸面区域建立秩序，但不要刻意画出完整边框。

主体与矩形保持自然的内外关系，大部分落在色域之中，少量最具方向感的部分自然伸出边界。

人物伸出的手、宠物尾巴、耳朵、枝条或动作方向可以自然超出色域，使画面产生轻松的越界感；像植物恰好从版面中生长出来，而不是为了“突破边框”刻意摆造型。

保持大面积留白、明确重心和不完全对称，让自然材料的偶然性与编辑设计的秩序并存。

黑色线条只作为极少量辅助语言出现，不为主体整体描边。

可用于眼睛、嘴巴、极简表情、细小动作暗示、局部连接、短线、手写痕迹或版式中的轻微视觉节奏。

线条纤细、松弛、略带手绘感，让植物本身承担主体的形体与轮廓。

尤其禁止用黑线完整勾勒人物身体或宠物外轮廓，再在里面填植物。

配色从上半部分原图中提取最有生命力和辨识度的色彩气质，再通过天然植物自身的颜色重新转译。

例如上方人物穿绿色、橙色、蓝色服装时，下方可以寻找具有相近综合色彩的真实叶片、花瓣、果实等材料对应。

宠物的橘色、灰色、黑白花纹等也可以利用天然材料综合色差巧妙重现，但不能为了匹配颜色而把全部植物人工染成完全统一的色块。

保留叶片、花瓣、果实和枯枝真实的综合色差异，不过度统一染色。

背景使用与原图协调的浅色或柔和综合色，使天然材质成为画面的视觉中心，整体清新、克制、有生命力而不杂乱。

文字保持极少，并作为编辑设计中的轻量元素。

从照片的情绪、动作、关系或隐喻中提炼一个简短英文标题和少量微型注释，可贴近矩形色域边缘、悬置于留白中，或与一根枝条、叶片方向形成巧妙对齐。

不要抢主体，也不要做成常规海报标题。

如果照片情绪非常明确，可以让文字表现其隐藏关系；如果没有必要，可以进一步减少文字。

整体呈现真实自然材料 × 轻微黑色手绘痕迹 × 几何色域 × 自然越界的视觉关系，保持手工、聪明、松弛、诗意和高级编辑感。

下方不是普通“树叶贴人像”，而应该像艺术指导精心挑选不同自然材料，用天然轮廓巧妙重新构建了上方照片中的人物或宠物。

避免完整黑色描边、植物被切成规则色块、儿童树叶贴画、刻意越界、卡通拼贴和模板化构图。

禁止重新创造与上方身份无关的人物或动物。

禁止复杂建筑成为自然材料拼贴的主要对象。

Two adult Japanese women, approximately 25–27 years old, are sitting on a beach towel spread over the sand, resting and chatting together. Both have naturally Japanese facial features, but their appearances are clearly distinct from one another.

Main woman: approximately 25 years old, with a small oval face, soft Japanese facial features, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, naturally fair skin, and long black hair reaching her chest, loosely tied into a low ponytail. A few fine strands of hair around her cheeks are gently moved by the sea breeze.

She wears a cobalt-blue two-piece bikini with a minimalist sporty design, featuring a square-neck top and mid-rise bottoms, made from realistic matte-textured swimwear fabric. Beside her lies a loose white linen shirt that she has just taken off and placed on the towel.

She sits in a relaxed position, one leg comfortably extended across the sand while the other is slightly bent. One hand supports her from behind, and her torso naturally turns toward her friend as they talk. She does not adjust her body for the camera and is not posing in any way.

Second woman: approximately 27 years old, with a slightly smaller round face, dark brown eyes, and shoulder-length chestnut-brown hair with gentle waves and Japanese-style wispy bangs.

She wears an ivory-cream one-piece swimsuit with a simple square neckline, paired with a pale blue sarong loosely tied around her hips. She sits angled toward her friend, with both legs resting naturally to one side. One hand holds a cold bottle of water while the other rests on the towel for support. She is listening to her friend and smiling softly.

The two women are simply chatting and relaxing, like an ordinary everyday moment someone might casually notice while walking along the beach. Neither woman looks toward the camera.

The camera is tightly zoomed in on the subjects: the photographer is actually standing approximately 10–15 meters away but uses a 135–200mm telephoto lens with tight zoom, making both women appear large in the image. Together, they occupy approximately 75–80% of the frame height. The composition focuses primarily on them, showing them from head to near their feet so that their faces, swimwear, and natural body proportions remain clearly visible.

The camera uses a slightly frontal three-quarter angle, positioned approximately at seated torso height. Telephoto compression visually pulls the background closer, creating the impression of distant observation even though the subjects appear very large within the frame.

Along the extreme left edge and lower corner, only a small portion of another beachgoer’s shoulder and the edge of a beach bag appear heavily out of focus, creating the impression that the photographer is zooming through a crowd. The foreground blur should not obscure too much of either subject.

Behind them are bright sand, blue ocean water, several beach umbrellas, and other adult beachgoers relaxing in the distance, all naturally softened by shallow depth of field. Summer sunlight reflected from the sand creates soft illumination across their skin, while a gentle breeze moves only a few loose strands of hair.

prompts.text:
一张在夏日日本海滩拍摄的写实抓拍照片，垂直 9:16 构图。

两位成年日本女性，大约 25–27 岁，正坐在铺在沙滩上的沙滩毛巾上，一起休息聊天。两人都有自然的日本面部特征，但她们的外貌截然不同。

主角女性：大约 25 岁，小鹅蛋脸，柔和的日本面部特征，杏仁状深褐色眼睛，天然白皙的皮肤，长长的黑发垂至胸前，松松地扎成低马尾。几缕脸颊旁的细发被海风轻轻吹动。

她穿着一件钴蓝色的两件式比基尼，采用简约运动设计，由方形领口上衣和中腰裤组成，材质为写实的哑光质感泳装面料。在她身边放着一件她刚刚脱下放在毛巾上的宽松白色亚麻衬衫。

她以放松的姿势坐着，一条腿舒服地伸展在沙滩上，另一条腿略微弯曲。一只手从后方支撑着身体，在聊天时，她的躯干自然地转向她的朋友。她没有为了镜头调整身体，也没有在摆任何姿势。

第二位女性：大约 27 岁，圆脸稍小，深褐色眼睛，栗褐色及肩发，带有柔和的波浪和日式薄刘海。

她穿着一件象牙白色的连体泳衣，带有简单的方领，搭配一件松松地系在腰间的浅蓝色围裙。她侧身对着朋友坐着，双腿自然地垂向一侧。一只手拿着一瓶冷水，另一只手支撑在毛巾上。她正在听朋友说话并温柔地微笑着。

这两位女性只是在聊天和放松，就像有人在海滩散步时可能会随手注意到的普通日常瞬间。两位女性都没有看向相机。

相机紧紧聚焦在主体上：摄影师实际上站在大约 10–15 米外，但使用了 135–200mm 的远摄镜头进行特写变焦，使两位女性在图像中显得很大。她们共同占据了画面高度的大约 75–80%。构图主要聚焦于她们，显示从头部到脚部附近的位置，以便她们的面部、泳装和自然的身体比例清晰可见。

相机使用了略微正面的四分之三角度，位置大约在坐姿躯干的高度。远摄压缩感在视觉上拉近了背景，营造出一种远距离观察的印象，尽管主体在画面中显得非常大。

沿着极左边缘和下角，只有另一位去海滩的人的肩膀和沙滩包边缘的一小部分出现，且严重失焦，营造出摄影师正从人群中变焦拍摄的印象。前景模糊不应遮挡过多主体。

她们身后是明亮的沙滩、蓝色的海水、几把遮阳伞和远处放松的其他成年游客，这些都被浅景深自然地弱化。从沙滩反射出来的夏日阳光在她们的皮肤上形成了柔和的照明，而微风只吹动了几缕散发。

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-photorealistic vertical romantic photo-booth contact-sheet collage, 2 columns × 5 rows, showing ONE continuous visual story involving the exact same young adult couple throughout.

CORE VISUAL IDEA:
The two columns are not ten unrelated photos. They represent two separate adjacent photo-booth spaces. The young woman begins entirely inside the LEFT column and the young man begins entirely inside the RIGHT column. As the rows move downward, the man gradually leaves his own frame and physically moves into the woman’s frame. His original RIGHT frame therefore becomes progressively emptier. This visual migration is the central concept and MUST remain logically consistent.

CHARACTERS:
A very cute young adult East Asian couple, approximately 20–23 years old, both clearly adults.

GIRL:
Naturally adorable Korean-looking young woman, soft youthful facial features, expressive dark-brown eyes, realistic fair skin with visible pores and subtle natural texture, slightly rosy cheeks, dark-brown hair in a loose messy bun with wispy strands around her face. Oversized black knitted sweater. Minimal natural makeup. Sweet, shy, playful personality.

BOY:
Cute Korean-looking young man, youthful but clearly adult, soft masculine facial features, warm dark eyes, naturally messy fluffy dark hair, realistic skin texture. Light-grey oversized hoodie over a simple white T-shirt. Gentle, slightly shy personality.

STRICT IDENTITY LOCK:
The SAME woman and SAME man must appear in every row. Identical faces, hairstyle, clothing, skin tone and proportions throughout. No face drift, no hairstyle changes, no outfit changes.

STORYBOARD:

ROW 1 — TWO STRANGERS
LEFT: girl alone, chest-up portrait, casually looking toward the right edge as though she has noticed someone.
RIGHT: boy completely visible and centered in his own frame, facing camera naturally.
They are physically separated by the vertical black divider.
Small handwritten text:
LEFT: “just a girl… ♡”
RIGHT: “just a guy…”

ROW 2 — THEY NOTICE EACH OTHER
LEFT: girl turns her eyes and face toward him with a tiny restrained smile.
RIGHT: boy turns toward the girl, leaning slightly toward the LEFT boundary for the first time.
He is still mostly inside his own frame.
Text:
LEFT: “who noticed something”
RIGHT: “…and looked twice ♡”

ROW 3 — CROSSING THE LINE
This is the important transition.
The boy has moved substantially LEFT and is now entering the girl’s frame across the central divider. The couple are close together, looking directly at each other and smiling naturally.
His RIGHT frame must now contain noticeably more empty background because he has physically moved away from it.
Do NOT duplicate him.
Text:
LEFT: “then we smiled ♡”
RIGHT empty area: “and suddenly it made sense”

ROW 4 — HE HAS LEFT HIS FRAME
The boy is now almost COMPLETELY inside the LEFT frame with the girl.
They share one soft, natural kiss, photographed candidly rather than dramatically.
Only a tiny portion of his shoulder/body may intersect the central border.
The RIGHT frame is approximately 85–90% EMPTY — just clean studio background.
This empty frame is intentional and visually important.
Text:
LEFT: “same weird thoughts ♡”
RIGHT empty frame: “different chaos ♡”

ROW 5 — FINAL PAYOFF
The boy has now COMPLETELY abandoned his original right-hand frame.
Both characters are entirely together inside the LEFT frame.
Instead of another kiss, create an irresistibly cute candid moment: he hugs her tightly from behind while giving her a small forehead/temple kiss; she scrunches her cheeks slightly, closes her eyes and smiles naturally.
Their body language should feel spontaneous, warm and genuinely affectionate.
RIGHT frame must be COMPLETELY EMPTY except for:
“more stories ♡”

Text in left:
“same people…”

IMPORTANT:
Never place a second copy of either character in the right frame after the man moves left.
Never repeat the kissing image across both columns.
The empty space tells the story.

DESIGN:
Minimal premium analog contact-sheet aesthetic inspired by an old 35mm film proof sheet, but make the composition completely original.

Warm off-white / soft beige seamless studio background.
Deep black film borders.
Thin slightly imperfect frame separators.
Tiny amber film-number markings and subtle sprocket details along outer edges.
Very subtle authentic analog grain, dust and microscopic scratches.
Small pieces of aged masking tape.
A few torn-paper notes.
Tiny hand-drawn hearts.
Small dried flowers near one bottom corner.
Only a handful of decorations — never clutter the photographs.

Margin notes:
“Good people, good times ♡”
“You + Me Always ♡”
“Collect moments, not things ♡”

BOTTOM HERO MESSAGE:
Place a torn warm-ivory paper strip across the lower border with handwritten text:

“you + me = a better kind of chaos ♡”

PHOTOGRAPHY:
100% believable real-human photography.
Premium editorial photo-booth portraits shot on a full-frame camera with approximately 50–85mm portrait-lens character.
Soft warm studio key light, subtle fill, realistic shadow falloff.
Natural skin pores, peach fuzz, individual hair strands, realistic knitted fabric and hoodie texture.
Slightly imperfect candid expressions.
Warm cinematic color grade with creamy highlights, rich blacks and subtle analog grain.
Faces remain sharp while retaining natural photographic softness.

The first row should feel slightly awkward and separated.
Every subsequent row becomes visually warmer and physically closer.
The final row should provide the strongest emotional payoff.

NO CGI.
NO illustration.
NO anime.
NO plastic skin.
NO excessive beauty retouching.
NO duplicated people.
NO extra fingers or limbs.
NO random additional characters.
NO identity changes.
NO duplicated poses.
NO repeated kiss.
NO decorative overload.
NO characters appearing inside intentionally empty right-side frames.

FINAL FEEL:
A photograph someone would instantly stop scrolling to understand — first they notice two separate people, then realize the man is literally disappearing from his own frames because he is moving into hers. Cute, clever, romantic, nostalgic, highly polished and visually understandable even before reading the handwritten text.

prompts.text:
创建一个超写实的垂直浪漫大头贴联系表拼贴画，2列×5行，展示一个涉及完全相同的年轻成年情侣的连续视觉故事。

核心视觉创意：
这两列不是十张无关的照片。它们代表两个独立的相邻大头贴空间。年轻女性最初完全在左栏，年轻男性最初完全在右栏。随着行数向下移动，男性逐渐离开他自己的框架并物理上进入女性的框架。因此他原本的右侧框架会逐渐变得空旷。这种视觉迁移是核心概念，并且必须保持逻辑一致性。

角色：
一对非常可爱的年轻成年东亚情侣，约20–23岁，两人显然都是成年人。

女孩：
自然可爱的韩国长相年轻女性，柔和的青春面部特征，富有表现力的深褐色眼睛，具有可见毛孔和微妙自然纹理的真实白皙皮肤，微微红润的双颊，深褐色头发扎成松散凌乱的丸子头，脸部周围有碎发。大号黑色针织毛衣。极简自然妆容。甜美、害羞、俏皮的个性。

男孩：
可爱的韩国长相年轻男性，年轻但显然是成年人，柔和的男性面部特征，温暖的深色眼睛，自然凌乱的蓬松深色头发，真实的皮肤纹理。浅灰色大号连帽衫内搭简单白色T恤。温柔、略显害羞的性格。

严格身份锁定：
每一行必须出现相同的女性和相同的男性。全程保持相同的面部、发型、服装、肤色和比例。没有脸部偏移，没有发型变化，没有服装更换。

分镜脚本：

第1行 —— 两个陌生人
左：女孩独自一人，胸部以上的肖像，随意地看向右边缘，仿佛她注意到了某人。
右：男孩完全可见并位于他自己的框架中心，自然地面对相机。
他们被垂直的黑色分隔线物理隔开。
手写小字：
左：“只是一个女孩…… ♡”
右：“只是一个男生……”

第2行 —— 他们注意到彼此
左：女孩转过眼睛和脸看向他，带着微小克制的微笑。
右：男孩转向女孩，第一次稍微向左侧边界倾斜。
他大部分仍在自己的框架内。
文字：
左：“注意到了一些事”
右：“……并回头看了两次 ♡”

第3行 —— 越线
这是重要的过渡。
男孩已经大幅向左移动，现在正穿过中央分隔线进入女孩的框架。这对情侣靠在一起，直接看着对方并自然地微笑。
他的右侧框架现在必须包含明显更多的空白背景，因为他已经物理上离开了它。
不要重复生成他。
文字：
左：“然后我们笑了 ♡”
右侧空白区域：“突然间一切都有了意义”

第4行 —— 他离开了他的框架
男孩现在几乎完全在左侧框架内与女孩在一起。
他们分享一个柔和、自然的吻，以抓拍而非戏剧化的方式拍摄。
只有一小部分他的肩膀/身体可能与中央边界交叉。
右侧框架大约 85–90% 是空的 —— 只是干净的摄影棚背景。
这个空框架是刻意的且在视觉上很重要。
文字：
左：“同样的古怪想法 ♡”
右侧空框架：“不同的混乱 ♡”

第5行 —— 最终回报
男孩现在已经完全放弃了他原本的右侧框架。
两个角色都完全一起在左侧框架内。
不要再画一个吻，而是创造一个极度可爱的抓拍瞬间：他从后面紧紧抱住她，同时亲吻她的额头/太阳穴；她轻微挤压双颊，闭上眼睛自然地微笑。
他们的肢体语言应该感到自发、温暖且真诚地充满爱意。
右侧框架必须完全空白，除了：
“更多故事 ♡”

左侧文字：
“同样的人们……”

重要提示：
当男性向左移动后，切勿在右侧框架放置第二个该角色的副本。
切勿在两个列中重复亲吻图像。
空白空间在讲述故事。

设计：
极简的高级模拟联系表美学，灵感来自旧的35mm胶片样片，但使构图完全原创。

温暖的米白色 / 柔和米色无缝摄影棚背景。
深黑色胶片边框。
纤细且略有瑕疵的框架分隔线。
外边缘有微小的琥珀色胶片编号标记和微妙的齿孔细节。
非常微妙真实的模拟颗粒、灰尘和微小的划痕。
小块陈旧的遮盖胶带。
几张撕碎的纸条。
手绘小爱心。
底部一个角落附近有小干花。
只有少量的装饰 —— 绝不使照片杂乱。

边栏注释：
“好的人，好的时光 ♡”
“你 + 我 永远 ♡”
“收集瞬间，而不是东西 ♡”

底部核心信息：
在下边缘放置一条撕碎的暖象牙色纸条，带有手写文字：

“你 + 我 = 一种更好的混乱 ♡”

摄影：
100% 可信的真实人类摄影。
高级社论大头贴肖像，由全画幅相机拍摄，具有约50–85mm肖像镜头的特性。
柔和温暖的摄影棚主灯，微妙的补光，真实的阴影衰减。
自然皮肤毛孔、汗毛、单根发丝，真实的针织面料和连帽衫纹理。
略有瑕疵的抓拍表情。
温暖的电影色彩分级，具有乳白色高光、浓郁的黑色和微妙的模拟颗粒。
面部保持锐利，同时保留自然的摄影柔和感。

第一行应该感到稍微尴尬和分离。
每一后续行在视觉上变得更温暖，物理上更接近。
最后一行应该提供最强的情感回报。

无CGI。
无插图。
无动漫。
无塑料皮肤。
无过度美容修图。
无重复的人。
无多余的手指或肢体。
无随机添加的角色。
无身份变化。
无重复的姿势。
无重复的接吻。
无装饰过载。
无角色出现在刻意留空的右侧框架内。

最终感觉：
一张让人会立即停止滚动去理解的照片 —— 首先他们注意到两个分开的人，然后意识到男人正在从他自己的框架中消失，因为他正在进入她的框架。可爱、聪明、浪漫、怀旧、高度精致，甚至在阅读手写文字之前就能在视觉上被理解。

prompts.text:
3:4 vertical ratio, realistic urban night fashion portrait of an adult East Asian female, visual state of 20 to 30 years old, tall and slender, fair and natural skin tone, natural East Asian bone structure, stunning but recognizable features, no influencer template faces, plastic surgery look, or AI fake faces. The subject is located on a high-altitude city terrace or elevated platform, using a medium-close-up to half-body composition, with the body turned away from the camera, shoulders and back as the main foreground subject, the head turned significantly back looking towards the camera, one shoulder slightly raised, body maintaining a direction away from the lens while the face looks back in reverse, forming a core tension of "body leaving, gaze returning."

The character wears a minimalist black thin-strap or off-the-shoulder long dress, upper body matte, low reflection, without complex decorations, black clothing naturally blending with the dark night scene, highlighting the fair shoulders, back, face, and arms. Deep dark long hair has realistic weight and a large amount of stray hairs, with night wind blowing continuously from the side, multiple strands of hair sweeping horizontally across the forehead, eyes, bridge of the nose, lips, and cheeks, partially obscuring the face but keeping at least one eye clearly legible; the hair ends spread toward the side of the frame, with individual fine strands showing very slight motion blur, rejecting neat commercial hairstyles and static wig-like sensations.

One arm of the character extends naturally toward the right side of the frame, with the wrist or forearm resting lightly near a metal railing, fingers relaxed and drooping; the shoulder line is diagonal, with the neck and back forming a natural twist. The head is slightly lowered, the chin is slightly tucked, and the eyes look back naturally at the camera from a sideways angle, maintaining a slight off-axis look, eyelids relaxed, brows stretched, lips slightly parted, with an emotion that is alert, quiet, detached, and restrained, capturing the instantaneous feeling of looking back after being suddenly called. No sweet smiles, no provocative expressions, no ID-style frontal stares.

The background is a real high-density modern city night scene, with distant building bodies, window lights, road lights, and vehicles forming a large area of softened bokeh, though architectural outlines remain vaguely discernible, not a pure light-spot background. The background main body uses deep cyan-blue, ink-blue, and blue-green low-frequency color fields, with large areas of the sky or city shadows maintaining cool tones; a small amount of warm orange, amber, and warm white light points are scattered on the roads and distant buildings to form depth. High-saturation neon, cyberpunk, nightclubs, and rainy night streets are prohibited.

The core lighting adopts a strong but restrained "Warm Face Cold City": a beam of warm orange or amber side-front light falls on the character's forehead, eyes, bridge of the nose, cheeks, lips, shoulders, and a few hair strands, making the character's face the only concentrated warm color area in the frame; the background continues to maintain deep cyan-blue low-light illumination. The warm light must not contaminate the entire scene and is only allowed to concentrate on the character and a few distant light points. Black hair and black dress form large areas of deep color weight with the city's dark parts, allowing the skin tone to jump out naturally against the cold background.

The imaging maintains a sense of real low-light night photography, with the character's face and visible eye being relatively the clearest, while wind-blown hair strands are partly sharp and partly slightly motion-blurred, and the background has a clear shallow depth-of-field blur; it retains slight high-ISO grain, shadow noise, natural uneven exposure, slight city light bleed, and soft edges. The skin retains pores, subtle skin tone variations, real under-eye shadows, lip lines, and local highlights, with no plastic skin smoothing, HDR, fake 8K sharpening, or commercial beauty retouching.

The composition keeps the character located in the lower-left to center-left area, with the right side leaving space for the arm extension and night scene negative space; the character occupies about 45% to 55% of the frame, and the city still has enough volume. The warm facial colors, black hair crossing the face, bare shoulders and back, right-side extended arm, and background bokeh together form a path of attention. The overall image emphasizes the relationship of: Back View Looking Back + Horizontal Wind-blown Hair + Warm Orange Face + Deep Cyan-Blue City + Black Clothing + Night Bokeh.

Soran three-layer natural branding: The first layer is accurately and clearly engraved with "Soran" on a small metal tag of an earring near the face or a micro metal nameplate on the black shoulder strap, in silver-gray, recognizable under normal viewing but not distracting from the face; the second layer hides Soran by merging it into the paint peeling, oxidation, scratches, and old wear of the foreground metal railing; the third layer forms a microscopic Soran through the stitching of the shoulder straps, the arrangement of earring chain links, or subtle scratches on the metal railing. All must belong to real in-frame materials and structures, prohibiting external watermarks, corner icons, subtitles, floating text, random logos, garbled text, and misspellings.

Negative words: Frontal standing, stiff turn of the head, static hair, face completely unobstructed, hair completely covering both eyes, sweet smile, exaggerated sexy expressions, cheap night scene photography, influencer face, plastic surgery face, AI fake face, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, HDR, over-sharpening, high-saturation neon, cyberpunk, nightclub, rainy night city, blue-purple light pollution, large area orange filters, complex clothing, sequined dresses, leather highlights, background pure bokeh without city structure, harsh studio rim lighting, random text, external watermarks.

prompts.text:
3:4竖幅，真人写实都市夜景时尚人像，成年东亚女性，20到30岁视觉状态，高挑修长，白皙自然肤色，东亚自然骨相，五官惊艳但有辨识度，不要网红模板脸、整容感、AI假脸。人物位于城市高处露台或高架平台，采用中近景到半身构图，身体背向镜头，肩背成为前景主体，头部大幅向后回转看向摄影机，一侧肩膀略高，身体保持离开镜头的方向，脸却反向回望，形成“身体离开、视线回来”的核心张力。

人物穿极简黑色细肩带或露肩长裙，上身哑光、低反射、无复杂装饰，黑色服装与深色夜景自然融合，突出白皙肩背、脸部与手臂。深色长发具有真实重量和大量碎发，夜风从侧面持续吹过，多束发丝横向掠过额头、眼睛、鼻梁、嘴唇和脸颊，局部遮脸但至少保留一只眼睛清楚可读；发尾向画面侧方展开，个别细发丝出现极轻运动模糊，拒绝整齐商业发型和静止假发感。

人物一只手臂向画面右侧自然延伸，手腕或前臂轻搭在金属栏杆附近，手指松弛下垂；肩线斜向，颈部与背部形成自然扭转。头部略低，下巴轻收，眼睛从侧向角度自然回看镜头，保持轻微偏轴，眼睑放松，眉间舒展，嘴唇微微张开，情绪警觉、安静、疏离、克制，带有被突然叫住后回头的一瞬间感。不要甜笑，不要挑逗式表情，不要证件照正面凝视。

背景为真实高密度现代城市夜景，远处楼体、窗灯、道路灯光和车辆形成大面积柔化散景，建筑轮廓仍隐约可辨，不做纯光斑背景。背景主体使用深青蓝、墨青、蓝绿色低频色场，大面积天空或城市暗部保持冷色；少量暖橙、琥珀、暖白灯点散落于道路和远处建筑，形成纵深。禁止高饱和霓虹、赛博朋克、夜店、雨夜街头。

光线核心采用强烈但克制的 暖脸冷城：一束暖橙色或琥珀色侧前光落在人物额头、眼睛、鼻梁、脸颊、嘴唇、肩膀和少量发丝上，使人物面部成为画面唯一集中的暖色区域；背景继续维持深青蓝低照度。暖光不能污染整个场景，只允许集中于人物和少量远处灯点。黑发、黑裙与城市暗部形成大面积深色重量，肤色在冷背景前自然跳出。

成像保持真实低照度夜间摄影感，人物脸和可见眼睛相对最清晰，风吹发丝部分清晰、部分轻微运动模糊，背景明显浅景深虚化；保留轻微高感颗粒、暗部噪声、自然曝光不均、城市灯光轻微溢散和柔和边缘。皮肤保留毛孔、细微肤色变化、真实眼下阴影、唇纹和局部高光，不做塑料磨皮、HDR、假8K锐化、商业美容精修。

构图保持人物位于左下至中央偏左区域，右侧留出手臂延伸和夜景负空间，人物占画面约45%到55%，城市仍有足够体量。脸部暖色、横穿脸部的黑色发丝、裸露肩背、右侧延展手臂和背景散景共同形成注意力路径。画面整体强调 背身回望 + 横向风发 + 暖橙脸部 + 深青蓝城市 + 黑色服装 + 夜间散景 的关系。

Soran三层自然标识：第一层在靠近脸部的耳饰小型金属吊牌或黑色肩带微型金属铭牌上准确清晰刻写“Soran”，银灰色，正常观看可辨认但不抢脸；第二层将隐藏Soran融入前方金属栏杆的掉漆、氧化、擦痕与旧磨损中；第三层通过肩带针脚、耳饰链节排列或金属栏杆细微划痕形成微观Soran。全部必须属于真实画内材质与结构，禁止外贴水印、角标、字幕、漂浮文字、随机Logo、乱码和错误拼写。

负面词： 正面站立，僵硬回头，头发静止，脸完全无遮挡，发丝完全遮住双眼，甜美微笑，夸张性感表情，廉价夜景写真，网红脸，整容脸，AI假脸，塑料皮肤，过度磨皮，HDR，过度锐化，高饱和霓虹，赛博朋克，夜店，雨夜城市，蓝紫灯污染，大面积橙色滤镜，复杂服装，亮片礼服，皮革高光，背景纯散景无城市结构，强硬棚拍轮廓光，随机文字，外贴水印。

Preserve the original age category and expression. Do not turn adults into children or make every face identical. Recreate clothing with layered felt pieces and fine stitched outlines, preserving only the patterns and seams necessary for recognition. Render long thin props as firmly rolled or embroidered yarn. Avoid text, captions, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders, additional scenery, invented props, malformed anatomy, duplicated limbs, missing subjects, incorrect animal counts, generic clothing, excessive facial detail, harsh shadows, oversaturated colors, and smooth synthetic surfaces. 使用受限的色调：灰蓝色、暗淡的海绿色、温暖的沙色、奶油象牙色、柔和的石灰色，以及少量的褪色赤陶色点缀。保留原始场景的重要颜色和特征，同时赋予它们精致的复古旅行海报处理效果。

将底部艺术作品放置在温暖的象牙色手工纸上，留出宽敞的呼吸空间和细微的触感纤维。保持建筑清晰可辨，并维持原始的视觉平衡。加入柔和的午后光线和宁静的海岸怀旧感。

在底部面板的较低部分附近，添加优雅且低调的受打字机启发的版式：

“harbour light”

在其下方，字体更小：

“afternoon lingers in the curve, where sea and steps remember.”

在两个面板之间添加一条非常细微的细分割线。让整个图像看起来像是一本优质独立旅行艺术杂志中精心拍摄的前后对比页面。

重要提示：顶部必须保持未经改动的原始照片。底部必须是该确切照片的艺术重新诠释。两个面板必须从相同的视角显示相同的场景。底部不要进行写实重建，不要有重大的构图改变，不要有新的建筑，不要有过度细节，不要有光泽的数字效果，不要有过度饱和的颜色。

prompts.text:
【Theme】
【Main visual information】
【Concept】
【Accent color】
【Key visual phenomenon】

Create a 9:16 vertical experimental editorial architecture poster based on the theme above.

Transform the central concept into a monumental surreal architectural space rather than simply placing text on a building. Typography, architecture, light, human figures and the key visual phenomenon should belong to the same physical world.

Design one immediately recognizable visual hook using the main visual information. Large numbers or words should be physically integrated into walls, slabs, frames, platforms or other architectural surfaces, affected naturally by scale, cropping, perspective, depth and occlusion. Avoid flat poster text placed over the image.

Create an impossible but visually coherent architectural composition with strong depth, oversized geometric structures, generous negative space and clear hierarchy. Do not rely on conventional skyscrapers or repetitive building blocks. Let the architectural language respond directly to the theme. Cinema may become frames and projection space, weather may become fins, clouds and rain, memory may become rooms or archives, and absence may become empty display structures and shadows.

Include approximately 6 to 12 tiny adult human figures throughout the scene. Keep them realistic in scale and understated in pose. Use them to communicate monumentality, distance, loneliness and human presence rather than making them the main subject.

Use one distinctive physical or atmospheric event as the secondary hook, such as a wide projection beam, suspended rain curtain, impossible cast shadow, floating architectural page, cloud layer, unusual reflection or dramatic geometric sunlight. This phenomenon should interact with the architecture rather than appear as a decorative effect.

Keep the palette highly restrained: warm ivory white, pale concrete gray, graphite black and soft desaturated sky tones, plus only one muted accent color occupying a small percentage of the image. Avoid colorful commercial architecture.

Use refined high contrast serif typography with a limited amount of thin sans serif technical text. Add a small set of meaningful words, data or short phrases related to the theme, but keep many architectural surfaces completely blank. The image should feel designed, not filled.

Use matte stone, concrete, paper like grain, subtle graphite texture and delicate scan noise. Avoid glossy CGI rendering. The final surface should resemble a sophisticated architecture publication, cultural poster, museum editorial or experimental printed artwork.

Use believable natural light, strong spatial shadows and atmospheric depth. Maintain a clear relationship between foreground, middle ground and distant structures.

The final image should feel monumental, intelligent, surreal, quiet and visually striking even at small social media thumbnail size. Prioritize one strong visual idea over excessive complexity.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
【主题】
【主要视觉信息】
【概念】
【强调色】
【关键视觉现象】

根据以上主题，创作一张 9:16 垂直比例的实验性编辑建筑海报。

将中心概念转化为一个纪念碑式的超现实建筑空间，而不是简单地在建筑物上放置文字。排版、建筑、光影、人物和关键视觉现象应属于同一个物理世界。

利用主要视觉信息设计一个极具辨识度的视觉钩子。巨大的数字或单词应物理地集成到墙壁、楼板、框架、平台或其他建筑表面，并受到比例、裁剪、透视、深度和遮挡的自然影响。避免在图像上放置扁平的海报文字。

创建一个不可能但视觉上连贯的建筑构图，具有强烈的深度感、超大几何结构、大量的负空间和清晰的层级。不要依赖传统的摩天大楼或重复的积木式建筑。让建筑语言直接呼应主题。电影可能变成框架和投影空间，天气可能变成翼板、云和雨，记忆可能变成房间或档案，而缺失可能变成空的展示结构和阴影。

在整个场景中包含大约 6 到 12 个微小的成年人形象。保持他们的比例写实，姿态含蓄。利用他们来传达纪念碑感、距离感、孤独感和人类的存在，而不是让他们成为主要主体。

使用一种独特的物理或大气事件作为次要钩子，例如宽大的投影光束、悬浮的雨帘、不可能的投影阴影、漂浮的建筑页面、云层、不寻常的反射或戏剧性的几何阳光。这种现象应该与建筑互动，而不是作为一种装饰效果出现。

保持调色板高度克制：暖象牙白、浅混凝土灰、石墨黑和柔和的低饱和天空色调，再加上仅一种占图像比例很小的柔和强调色。避免丰富多彩的商业建筑。

使用精细的高对比度衬线字体，搭配少量的细无衬线技术文本。添加一小组与主题相关的有意义的单词、数据或短语，但保持许多建筑表面完全空白。图像应该感觉是经过设计的，而不是被填满的。

使用哑光石材、混凝土、纸质纹理、微妙的石墨纹理和精致的扫描噪点。避免光泽的 CGI 渲染。最终表面应类似于精致的建筑出版物、文化海报、博物馆社论或实验性的印刷艺术品。

使用真实的自然光、强烈的空间阴影和大气深度。保持前景、中景和远处结构之间清晰的关系。

最终图像应具有纪念碑感、智慧感、超现实感、安静感，且即使在社交媒体缩略图大小下也具有强烈的视觉冲击力。优先考虑一个强有力的视觉创意，而不是过度的复杂性。

items.title: 雨中街头抱衣侧笑的成年女性

prompts.text:
Subject:
A single fictional adult female smiling sideways while holding a black jacket on a street in the rain. White shirt and calm-toned bottoms, wet bangs falling onto the forehead. Taking a daily moment of sudden rain as the theme, naturally capturing the face, hands, and the surrounding moist air.

Location, Time, Background:
A quiet alley lined with low block walls and plantings, slender fences, building windows, and utility poles. The depths of the rain-drenched road are dotted with warm light. The background includes the grey-blue tones of a dim twilight, with visible yellow from windows and green leaves. Do not add elements of specific city names or shop names.

Clothing and Accessories:
A white front-opening shirt with a collar and small buttons, sleeves rolled up. A light beige bag strap hangs over the shoulder, with dark pinkish fabric and ties visible at the waist. The black jacket held in front forms heavy folds, without emphasizing a see-through effect of wet clothes.

Pose, Fingers, Contact:
Upper body leaning slightly forward, face turned towards the right side of the frame. One arm holds the black jacket, with the hand placed on top of the fabric and lightly gripped. The heights of the shoulders differ slightly, and the bag strap moves accordingly. Clearly define the contact of the wrists and fingers to avoid the jacket appearing as if floating in the air.

Expression and Gaze:
A soft smile with teeth revealed toward an object on the side. Eyes following that object, eyebrows not raised excessively, retaining a hint of surprise at the rain and a slightly troubled friendliness. Coordinate the upward movement of the cheeks linked with the sideways gaze and the corners of the mouth. Do not use exaggerated crying faces or dramatic expressions.

Face and Makeup:
Naturally rounded cheeks and a thin chin, light eyebrows, small highlights on a moist face. Lips are an understated rose color, and the lines around the eyes are slender. Place irregular water glisten on the cheeks or nose, do not make the overall skin glow uniformly like oil. Retain the natural separation of the corners of the eyes and teeth when smiling.

Hair:
Black-brown hair loosely tied at the back of the head, wet bangs sticking to the forehead and cheeks in thin strands. Reduce dry fluffiness, with a few long bangs falling by the side of the neck. Distinguish the luster of the wet hair strands from the darkness of the roots, avoiding it looking like regular thick ropes.

Light Source:
Cloudy cyan-grey ambient light mixed with warm tones from windows or street lamps. The face and the upper surface of the shirt are moderately bright, while the grooves of the walls and the black jacket carry deep shadows. Add small highlights on the water droplets on the cheeks, with soft reflections continuing on the rainy street. Do not use strong studio flashes.

Colors and Tones:
A color scheme centered on the white shirt, wet black hair and jacket, grey walls, dark green, and the yellow of windows. The skin does not sink excessively into grey, while balancing the twilight air with warm blood color. Avoid strong cyan-green filters or thick orange, maintaining a moist low-saturation tone.

Material and Subtle Textures:
Depict wet hair strands on the forehead, subtle water glisten on the cheeks, wet folds of the shirt, the matte black of the jacket, and the roughness of the block walls. Place pressure shadows where fingers press into the fabric. Water surface reflections are intermittent according to the road surface irregularities, not made into a mirror-like flat plane.

Composition and Lens:
Vertical 9:16 close-up street corner portrait. The visual center of the chest is at horizontal 50%, and the center of the face is near horizontal 39% and vertical 25%. Leave a little blank space for the face turned to the right, placing the held black fabric and hand below. Utilize background fences and utility poles as vertical lines, avoiding excessive wide-angle distortion.

Image Processing and Finishing:
Natural snapshot quality of a dim rainy day. Keep the hair strands and face clear enough to be recognizable, with the background moderately softened. Retain subtle grain in the dark areas and subtle color variations in the skin, without excessively increasing brightness to turn it into a sunny daytime photo. No strong skin-beautifying filters needed.

Crash Avoidance and Prohibitions:
Maintain the posture of the adult female holding the black jacket and the sideways gaze. Do not increase clothing transparency or exposure, and do not add sexy poses. Do not produce merged fingers, extra hands, melted teeth, unnatural rain lines across the face, recognizable added text, logos, or watermarks.

prompts.text:
被写体：
雨中的街路上抱着黑色上衣、侧脸笑着的虚构成年女性一人。白色衬衫和沉稳色调的下装，湿漉漉的前发垂落到额头。将突然降雨的日常瞬间作为主题，自然捕捉脸部、手部以及周围潮湿的空气。

地点・时间・背景：
低矮的块状围墙和植栽、细长的栅栏、建筑物窗户、电线杆排列的安静小巷。雨水打湿的道路深处点缀着温暖的光芒。背景包含昏暗黄昏的灰青色调，可见窗户的黄色和绿叶。不添加特定城市名称或店铺名称的元素。

服装・小物：
白色前开襟衬衫带有领子和小型纽扣，袖子卷起。肩上挂着浅米色的包带，腰间可见暗粉色系的布料和系带。抱在身前的黑色上衣形成有重量的褶皱，不新强调湿衣服的透视效果。

姿势・手指・接触：
上身微微前倾，脸朝画面右侧转去。一只手臂抱着黑色上衣，手置于布料上方轻轻握住。双肩高度略有差异，包带随之移动。明确手腕和手指的接触，避免上衣浮在空中。

表情・视线：
朝侧方对象露出的带齿柔和笑容。眼睛追随那个对象，眉毛不过度上扬，保留一丝对雨的惊讶和略带困扰的亲切感。将侧向视线与嘴角连动的脸颊上扬方式协调一致。不使用夸张的哭脸或戏剧化表情。

脸部・妆容：
自然圆润的脸颊和细下巴、淡眉、湿润脸庞上的小亮点。嘴唇为低调的玫瑰色，眼周线条纤细。在脸颊或鼻子上放置不规则的水光泽，不将整体肌肤像油一样均匀发光。保留笑时眼尾和牙齿的自然分离。

头发：
黑褐色头发在脑后松散扎起，湿润的前发以细束贴在额头和脸颊。减少干燥的蓬松感，在颈侧落下几缕长刘海。将湿润发束的光泽与发根的暗度区分开来，避免看起来像规则的粗绳。

光源：
阴天的青灰色环境光中混入窗户或路灯的暖色调。脸部和衬衫上表面适度明亮，围墙的凹槽和黑色上衣带有深邃阴影。在脸颊水滴上加入小亮点，雨中街路延续柔和的反光。不使用强烈的摄影棚闪光。

颜色・色调：
以白色衬衫、湿润的黑发和上衣、灰色围墙、暗绿、窗户的黄色作为配色主轴。肌肤不过度沉入灰色，同时兼顾黄昏空气与温暖血色。避免强烈的青绿色滤镜或浓橙色，保持湿润的低饱和度色调。

材质・细微质感：
描绘额头湿润的发束、脸颊细微的水光泽、衬衫湿润的褶皱、上衣的哑光黑、块状围墙的粗糙感。手指处放置按压布料的压力阴影。水面反射依路面凹凸断续，不做成镜面般的平面。

构图・镜头：
纵向9:16的近景街角肖像。胸口视觉中心位于横向50%，脸部中心位于横向39%・纵向25%附近。为右侧转去的脸部留出少许空白，将抱着的黑色布料和手置于下方。利用背景栅栏和电线杆作为纵向线条，避免过度广角失真。

图像处理・完成：
昏暗雨天的自然抓拍摄质。将头发细束和脸部保持可辨识程度的清晰，背景适度柔和。保留暗部的细微颗粒感和肌肤的微妙色差，不过度提高亮度使其变成晴天日间照片。不需要强烈的美肌滤镜。

崩溃回避・禁止：
维持成年女性抱着黑色上衣的姿态和侧向视线。不增加衣物透视或暴露，不添加性感姿势。不产生融合的手指、多余的手、融化的牙齿、横跨脸部的非自然雨线、可辨识的新增文字、标志、水印。

## [风格参考]

具有真实智能手机摄影美学的写实当代时尚快照。哥特洛丽塔街头时尚社论感，真实的人体解剖和身体比例，自然的五官，细腻的蕾丝和面料纹理，可信的发丝，真实的皮肤纹理，准确的镜面反射，以及不刻意的抓拍氛围。避免过度美颜修图、人工魅力感、夸张的解剖结构或类似摄影棚的外观。

## [质量参数]

高细节写实，真实的皮肤纹理，精细解析的蕾丝刺绣和服装材质，锐利的发丝，准确的面料层叠，符合物理规律的光影和阴影，干净的镜面反射，真实的零售店纹理，自然的景深，平衡的曝光，细微的摄影颗粒，高分辨率图像，清晰的主体细节，真实的色彩还原，无畸变的解剖结构，无多余的肢体或手指，无重复的配饰，无扭曲的反射，无文字伪影，无裁剪的肢体或被截断的脚。

Create a refined vertical editorial poster using tactile handmade paper, large color fields, generous negative space, and a tiny micro scene.

Keep the composition minimal, but do not make it empty or simplistic. Build the entire poster around one clear visual idea or physical paper interaction. The concept should be immediately readable from a distance, while smaller material and spatial details become visible only when viewed closely.

Use only one or two dominant handmade paper forms. Let them interact through one deliberate spatial mechanism such as passing through a slot, being pulled under tension, forming one sweeping curve, creating a deep perspective, lifting from the surface, or defining a large negative space.

The paper must feel physical and handmade. Show visible natural fibers, pulp texture, subtle pigment absorption, small embedded flecks, soft pressure marks, slightly irregular edges, and a matte dry surface. Keep the material clean, refined, and contemporary.

Use perspective, overlap, scale, paper thickness, soft natural shadows, subtle curvature, or suspension only when they help explain the physical construction. Avoid decorative effects that do not have a structural purpose.

Add one very small micro scene related to the main concept. Include two or three adult figures naturally interacting with the paper structure, such as holding, measuring, pulling, aligning, inspecting, lifting, or assembling it. The figures and tools should occupy only about 2% to 4% of the composition.

Keep the figures modern, understated, and secondary. Add only a few necessary tools or objects that help explain how the paper structure works.

Use generous warm ivory negative space so the poster feels calm and editorial. Large empty areas should be intentional and balanced against the main paper form.

Typography should remain restrained. Use a refined editorial serif for the title and small uppercase sans serif for supporting information. Keep the title relatively small and place it in a quiet area of negative space.

The visual reading order should be:

large paper form first, spatial interaction second, material texture third, micro scene fourth, title and event details last.

The final image should feel minimal, tactile, intelligent, spatial, refined, and carefully constructed.

From a distance, it should read as a simple arrangement of large paper forms.

Up close, it should reveal fibers, depth, tension, overlap, shadows, tiny figures, tools, and the physical logic behind the composition.

保持构图极简，但不要使其显得空洞或过于简单。围绕一个清晰的视觉构思或物理纸张互动来构建整个海报。这个概念应该在远处就能立即辨认，而较小的材质和空间细节仅在近距离观察时才变得可见。

仅使用一个或两个主要的手工纸张形状。让它们通过一个精心设计的空间机制进行互动，例如穿过一个槽口、在张力下被拉动、形成一个大幅度的曲线、创造深远的透视感、从表面抬起，或定义一个巨大的负空间。

纸张必须具有物理感和手工感。展示可见的天然纤维、纸浆纹理、细微的颜料吸收、嵌入的小斑点、柔和的压力痕迹、略微不规则的边缘以及哑光干燥的表面。保持材质干净、精致且具有现代感。

仅在有助于解释物理结构时使用透视、重叠、比例、纸张厚度、柔和的自然阴影、细微的曲率或悬浮。避免没有结构目的的装饰效果。

添加一个与主要概念相关的非常小的微缩场景。包括两到三个成年人，他们自然地与纸张结构互动，例如握住、测量、拉动、对齐、检查、抬起或组装它。人物和工具应仅占构图的 2% 到 4% 左右。

保持人物现代、低调且居于次要地位。仅添加少量必要的工具或物体，以帮助解释纸张结构的工作方式。

使用充裕的暖象牙色留白，使海报感觉平静且具有社论感。大面积的空白区域应该是刻意留出的，并与主要的纸张形状保持平衡。

排版应保持克制。标题使用精致的社论衬线体，辅助信息使用小号大写无衬线体。标题保持相对较小，并将其放置在留白的安静区域。

视觉阅读顺序应为：

首先是大面积纸张形状，其次是空间互动，第三是材质纹理，第四是微缩场景，最后是标题和活动详情。

最终图像应给人以极简、触感、智能、空间感、精致且精心构建的感觉。

从远处看，它应该被解读为大面积纸张形状的简单排列。

近距离看，它应展示出纤维、深度、张力、重叠、阴影、微小的人物、工具以及构图背后的物理逻辑。

VISUAL STYLE

Create an ultra realistic nighttime fashion snapshot of an adult East Asian woman sitting on a rumpled ivory hotel bed. Keep the same visual setup across variations: deep burgundy velvet curtain, dark warm gray wall, strong on camera direct flash, hard natural shadow behind the subject, close 35 to 50mm perspective, and a slightly imperfect candid composition.

She has a slim waist, long legs, natural feminine proportions, realistic skin texture and subtle flash sheen. Long black hair should feel full, soft and slightly messy, with a few strands crossing the face. Hair must remain continuous from root to tip, forming several coherent flowing locks instead of broken or randomly fragmented strands.

Her pose is relaxed and asymmetrical: one hand touching her hair, the other supporting her body on the bed, one leg extending toward the camera while the other bends naturally to the side. Keep the pose elegant and spontaneous rather than looking like a commercial model pose.

The satin top should show realistic drape, folds and flash reflections while preserving its chosen color in the shadows. The skirt should stay matte and structured. The tights must remain very sheer with visible natural skin underneath, and the chosen hosiery detail should follow the three dimensional shape of the legs naturally.

For back seam tights, place one thin continuous seam along the true back center of the leg from heel upward. For micro dot tights, use tiny sparse dots that are only noticeable up close. For fine pinstripe tights, use very thin low contrast vertical lines with generous spacing. For smoke gray tights, keep them completely clean and pattern free.

items.title: 纪念碑式超现实建筑空间海报设计

prompts.text:
【Theme】
【Title】
【Main typography】
【Spatial metaphor】
【Signature structure】
【Accent color】
【Human activity】

Create a 9:16 vertical experimental editorial architecture poster that transforms the selected abstract concept into a monumental surreal spatial environment.

Do not simply design a building and place typography over it. The architecture itself must be generated from the logic of the concept.

Translate the theme into one clear spatial metaphor. Transit can become disconnected suspended platforms and passages. Time can become arcs, sunlight, long shadows and observation structures. Sound can become acoustic ribs, suspended panels and reverberation spaces. Memory can become fragmented rooms, doors, corridors and traces of human presence. For other themes, invent an equally direct architectural metaphor rather than reusing these examples mechanically.

Choose one dominant architectural gesture and build the entire composition around it. Avoid combining too many structural ideas. The image should have one immediately recognizable spatial identity even at small thumbnail size.

Integrate the main typography physically into the architecture. Large words, numbers or data should exist on different walls, platforms, curved surfaces, rooms or structural elements, following real perspective, scale, cropping, depth and occlusion. Typography may stretch across multiple spatial planes or only become readable from the chosen camera viewpoint. Never treat the main text as a flat graphic overlay.

Use the main typography as the visual hook. It should be simple enough to read quickly but surprising enough to make the viewer notice how it interacts with the space.

Add only a limited amount of secondary editorial information related to the theme, such as functional labels, measurements, timestamps, room information, observation data or short conceptual phrases. Keep many large surfaces completely blank so the design does not become a wall of text.

Populate the architecture with approximately 7 to 12 tiny adult human figures. Their poses should be natural and connected to the theme: waiting, walking, observing, listening, sitting, arriving or leaving. Keep people visually small so they establish scale, distance and emotional atmosphere rather than becoming portrait subjects.

Use large differences in architectural scale. Combine one or two monumental foreground structures with medium depth elements and several extremely small distant forms. Preserve clear foreground, middle ground and background separation.

Create strong but believable light and shadow. Let light participate in the concept whenever relevant: long shadows for time, isolated warm rooms for memory, controlled pools of light for sound, or directional daylight for transit. Avoid decorative cinematic effects that do not serve the spatial idea.

Use a restrained palette of ivory white, pale concrete gray, graphite black and soft desaturated atmospheric tones. Introduce only one muted accent color on a small percentage of the architecture so each variation develops its own identity while remaining part of the same series.

Use matte concrete, stone, glass or paper like architectural surfaces with subtle grain, graphite texture and delicate scan noise. Keep the final image closer to a sophisticated architecture publication, cultural poster or experimental editorial print than a glossy CGI render.

Maintain strong asymmetry, deliberate negative space and controlled information density. Avoid conventional presentation boards, regular grids and perfectly balanced layouts. The composition should feel carefully designed but never mechanically templated.

The final result should feel monumental, intelligent, surreal, quiet and slightly melancholic, with typography, architecture, tiny humans, light and spatial depth operating as one coherent visual system.

prompts.text:
【主题】
【标题】
【主要排版】
【空间隐喻】
【签名结构】
【强调色】
【人类活动】

创建一个 9:16 的垂直实验性编辑建筑海报，将所选的抽象概念转化为具有纪念碑意义的超现实空间环境。

不要只是设计一栋建筑并在其上放置排版。建筑本身必须根据概念的逻辑生成。

将主题转化为一个清晰的空间隐喻。交通可以变成断开的悬浮平台和通道。时间可以变成圆弧、阳光、长阴影和观察结构。声音可以变成声学肋骨、悬浮面板和回响空间。记忆可以变成支离破碎的房间、门、走廊和人类存在的痕迹。对于其他主题，发明一个同样直接的建筑隐喻，而不是机械地重复这些例子。

选择一种主导的建筑姿态，并围绕它构建整个构图。避免组合过多的结构想法。即使在缩略图大小下，图像也应该具有一个一眼就能识别的空间身份。

将主要排版物理地融入建筑中。大单词、数字或数据应该存在于不同的墙壁、平台、曲面、房间或结构元素上，遵循真实的透视、比例、裁剪、深度和遮挡。排版可能会跨越多个空间平面，或者仅从选定的相机视角变得可读。绝不要将主体文本视为扁平的图形叠加。

使用主要排版作为视觉钩子。它应该足够简单以便快速阅读，但又足够令人惊讶，让观众注意到它与空间的互动方式。

仅添加少量与主题相关的次要编辑信息，如功能标签、测量值、时间戳、房间信息、观测数据或简短的概念短语。保持许多大面积表面完全空白，这样设计就不会变成一堵文字墙。

在建筑中填充约 7 到 12 个微小的成年人形象。他们的姿势应该是自然的并与主题相关：等待、行走、观察、聆听、坐着、到达或离开。让人保持视觉上的微小，以便他们建立比例、距离和情感氛围，而不是成为人像主体。

在建筑比例上使用巨大的差异。将一个或两个巨大的前景结构与中等深度的元素以及几个极其微小的远处形式结合起来。保持清晰的前景、中景和远景分离。

创造强烈但可信的光影。只要相关，就让光参与到概念中：时间的漫长阴影，记忆的孤立温暖房间，声音的受控光池，或交通的定向日光。避免使用不服务于空间构思的装饰性电影效果。

使用象牙白、浅混凝土灰、石墨黑和柔和的低饱和度大气色调组成的受限色调。仅在一小部分建筑上引入一种柔和的强调色，使每个变体在保持作为同一系列的一部分的同时，发展出自己的身份。

使用哑光混凝土、石头、玻璃或纸张般的建筑表面，带有微妙的纹理、石墨纹理和精致的扫描噪点。保持最终图像更接近精致的建筑出版物、文化海报或实验性编辑印刷品，而不是光泽的 CGI 渲染。

保持强烈的不对称、刻意的负空间和受控的信息密度。避免传统的展示板、规则的网格和完美平衡的布局。构图应该感觉经过精心设计，但绝不是机械模板化的。

最终结果应该是具有纪念碑意义的、智能的、超现实的、安静的且略带忧郁的，排版、建筑、微型人类、光线和空间深度作为一个连贯的视觉系统运作。

items.title: 高端半色调建筑旅行拼贴海报

prompts.text:
Turn this structure photo into a single high-end halftone architectural travel-collage poster. Output one poster per uploaded photo — never merge multiple structures or photos into one frame.

FORMAT

3:4 vertical canvas. Split into two roughly equal zones — real architectural photo on top, printed reconstruction below — divided by one clean, sharp horizontal line.

Do not stretch, warp, tilt, or unnaturally reposition the structure to force the proportions.

TOP HALF — THE REAL SHOT

Preserve the original structure faithfully: same architecture, proportions, perspective, distinctive details, surrounding elements, natural light and shadow, and original color mood.

Keep recognizable features such as:

* façade
* windows and arches
* towers or domes
* doors and structural details
* roofline
* surrounding landscape or street elements

Add only a subtle high-end color grade and the faintest film grain. Do not redesign or reinterpret the architecture.

BOTTOM HALF — THE PRINTED RECONSTRUCTION

Rebuild the same structure as an experimental printed architectural collage using:

torn photographic fragments + fixed-width ASCII character fields + photocopy halftone dots + architectural linework.

The structure must remain immediately recognizable.

* Torn-edge photographic fragments preserve the most important architectural details.
* Brick, stone, glass, metal, shadows, windows, and surrounding textures gradually dissolve outward into ASCII characters, black halftone dots, fragmented print grain, and fine architectural drafting lines.
* Use thin technical construction lines to subtly trace the structure’s geometry.
* Let selected areas break apart into paper fibers and halftone fragments, creating the feeling that the building is emerging from an archival print.
* Keep the main silhouette strong and readable.
* Texture: rough white paper-fiber edges, subtle photocopy imperfections, slight print misregistration, faded ink, old-paper stains, a few restrained crop marks, and one small red calibration bar.
* Color: warm gray old-paper background + black ink + the structure’s original muted colors + a single restrained red accent.
* Never fully desaturate the structure.

The structure should occupy roughly 60–88% of the frame width, scaled according to what reads best for the architecture.

Leave 22–38% of the paper visibly untouched and empty, creating generous negative space so the poster feels like an archival architectural specimen rather than a packed digital screen.

TYPOGRAPHY

Add one clean, readable fixed-width architectural title based on the structure:

[STRUCTURE NAME]

Below it include:

[CITY, COUNTRY]
REC. STUDY 01

Add one short observational caption related to the architecture, such as:

“A monumental study in geometry, time, and place.”

Typography should feel like an old architectural archive mixed with an underground experimental design journal.

A few loose ASCII glyphs may trace the outer silhouette or architectural edges as texture only — never use ASCII to invent windows, doors, structural details, or technical specifications.

MOOD

Early digital systems × analog photocopy × architectural archive × underground zine × modern travel editorial.

The structure should feel like it is surfacing from an old printed document — half photograph, half architectural drawing, half experimental print.

Sophisticated, minimal, tactile, intellectual, slightly mysterious, and highly collectible.

AVOID

Solid black terminal backgrounds, dense walls of code, cyberpunk neon, excessive ASCII, distorted architecture, impossible geometry, invented architectural details, fake technical specifications, random symbols with no meaning, garbled text, excessive colors, brand logos, QR codes, watermarks, author credits, or tourist-poster clichés.

Priority: Preserve the structure’s identity and architectural accuracy first. The experimental halftone/ASCII treatment should enhance the architecture, not hide it.

prompts.text:
将此建筑照片转换为一张高端半色调建筑旅行拼贴海报。每张上传的照片输出一张海报——切勿将多个建筑或照片合并到一帧中。

格式

3:4 垂直画布。分为两个大致相等的区域——上方是真实的建筑照片，下方是印刷的重建图——由一条干净、锐利的水平线分隔。

不要拉伸、扭曲、倾斜或不自然地重新定位建筑以强行适应比例。

上半部分——真实拍摄

忠实保留原始建筑：相同的建筑、比例、透视、独特的细节、周围元素、自然光影和原始色彩基调。

保留可识别的特征，例如：

* 外立面
* 窗户和拱门
* 塔楼或圆顶
* 门和结构细节
* 屋顶线
* 周围的景观或街道元素

仅添加细微的高端调色和极微弱的电影颗粒感。不要重新设计或重新诠释建筑。

下半部分——印刷重建

使用以下元素将同一建筑重建为实验性的印刷建筑拼贴：

撕碎的摄影碎片 + 固定宽度的 ASCII 字符场 + 复印机半色调点 + 建筑线稿。

建筑必须保持立即可辨认。

* 撕裂边缘的摄影碎片保留了最重要的建筑细节。
* 砖块、石头、玻璃、金属、阴影、窗户和周围的纹理逐渐向外溶解为 ASCII 字符、黑色半色调点、碎片化的印刷颗粒和精细的建筑制图线。
* 使用细长的技术施工线微妙地追踪建筑的几何形状。
* 让选定区域分解为纸张纤维和半色调碎片，营造出建筑物正从档案印刷品中浮现的感觉。
* 保持主轮廓强有力且清晰易读。
* 纹理：粗糙的白色纸张纤维边缘、细微的复印缺陷、轻微的印刷对位不准、褪色的墨水、旧纸渍、少量克制的裁剪标记和一个小的红色校准条。
* 颜色：暖灰色旧纸背景 + 黑色墨水 + 建筑原始的柔和色彩 + 单一克制的红色点缀。
* 永远不要让建筑完全去色。

建筑应占据约 60–88% 的框架宽度，根据建筑的最佳视觉效果进行缩放。

留出 22–38% 的纸张明显留白，营造出慷慨的负空间，使海报感觉像是一个档案建筑样本，而不是拥挤的数字屏幕。

排版

添加一个基于建筑的简洁、易读的固定宽度建筑标题：

[建筑名称]

其下方包括：

[城市，国家]
REC. STUDY 01

添加一段与建筑相关的简短观察说明，例如：

“几何、时间和空间的纪念性研究。”

排版应感觉像是旧建筑档案与地下实验设计杂志的结合。

少量松散的 ASCII 字符可以追踪外部轮廓或建筑边缘作为纹理——切勿使用 ASCII 来发明窗户、门、结构细节或技术规格。

氛围

早期数字系统 × 模拟复印 × 建筑档案 × 地下杂志 × 现代旅行社论。

建筑应感觉像是从一份旧的印刷文档中浮现出来的——一半是照片，一半是建筑图纸，一半是实验性印刷品。

精致、极简、具有触感、理智、略带神秘感且极具收藏价值。

避免

纯黑终端背景、密集的代码墙、赛博朋克霓虹灯、过度的 ASCII、扭曲的建筑、不可能的几何形状、虚构的建筑细节、虚假的技术规格、无意义的随机符号、乱码文本、过多的颜色、品牌 Logo、二维码、水印、作者署名或旅游海报陈词滥调。

优先级：首先保留建筑的身份和建筑准确性。实验性的半色调/ASCII 处理应增强建筑，而不是掩盖它。

items.title: 银月羽裳清冷仙姬中式人像

prompts.text: An adult East Asian ancient-style woman with a cold and ethereal temperament, a narrow long oval face, cold white translucent skin, exquisite features, moist red lips, and soft, slightly cold eyes. Her black long hair is styled in a gorgeous Chinese hairstyle combining a high bun and half-down hair, with natural wisps of hair at the forehead and sides of the face. She wears a golden Chinese hair crown, white flower ornaments, pearl tassel hairpins, pearl earrings, and a small red floral mark on her forehead. The character is dressed in a white and pearl-white Chinese-style ethereal fairy gown, with soft silk and tulle stitching at the chest and an elegant low neckline. The shoulders and cuffs are decorated with white feathers, covered by light semi-transparent gauze sleeves. The waist and chest are adorned with multiple layers of pearl chains and exquisite metal details, and the overall garment is light, dreamy, and shimmering with fine pearl luster. The character is positioned in front of a deep blue night background, with a huge bright full moon behind her, creating clear rim lighting. The top of the frame is decorated with small osmanthus branches and leaves, with faint starlight and floating dust in the background. prompts.text:
Hyper-realistic nighttime park duo candid photography, vertical ratio about 3:4, two clearly adult East Asian women, 20+, sitting side-by-side on a park bench / low seat, the photographer is located very close directly in front of the two, using an approximately 24–28mm equivalent mobile phone wide-angle lens, camera position slightly below the chest, upper bodies of the figures occupy the main part of the frame, showing an obvious close-up nighttime mobile phone selfie / candid shot texture.

Both have natural plump hourglass figures, medium-narrow shoulders, clearly full breasts, slim waists, and naturally rounded hips. No paper-thin bodies, narrow hips with thin legs, or athletic muscles.

The person on the left has raven-black ultra-long straight hair, hair naturally draped over the right shoulder and chest, body leaning slightly towards the person on the right. The left arm is bent high behind the head, palm holding the back of the head or hair, right hand naturally resting near the waist and hips. Head turned to the right, looking at the person next to her, lips slightly parted, as if speaking. Wearing a silver rhinestone / metal choker necklace around the neck.

The person on the right has raven-black ultra-long straight hair, center-parted, hair hanging down near the waist from both sides, upper body leaning back slightly, body tilting towards the person on the left, head slightly lowered and turned towards the camera, expression calm and slightly lazy.

Both are wearing bright magenta / fuchsia lingerie-style tops, color high-saturated and cool-toned pink. The left one is an underwire deep V push-up bra-style top, cup surface has a fine matte or slight lace texture; the right one is also a bright magenta bra-style top, cups are rounder, with a small connecting structure in the center. Only a small amount of the same color low-waist innerwear edge is visible on the lower body, paired with grey sweatpants / casual pants hanging loosely at the waist and hips, waistband clearly shifted down, creating a natural state of casually draped coat or just having taken off a layer of clothing, but maintaining normal full coverage.

The person on the left is wearing a light grey loose hooded sweatshirt / cardigan on the outside, the garment sliding off the shoulders, only hanging on the arms and sides of the body; the shoulders and arms of the person on the right are mostly bare, with grey clothing naturally piled up at the side of the waist.

The scene is a night city park: the background has a large area of dark green tree canopies, lawns, benches, walkways, and distant buildings. There is a very bright warm white street light at the top left, the strong light illuminating nearby leaves and forming local overexposure; a few small park lights are scattered further away. Most of the trees and grass are caught in deep shadows, the overall environment is quiet and low-light.

Lighting is mainly park street lights + mobile phone night mode / slight automatic brightening, do not use strong direct flash. The faces, chests, shoulders, and skin of the figures are under dim warm-cold mixed light, the person on the left is slightly brighter, the person on the right falls more into the shadows. The image allows slight motion blur, dark area noise, and high ISO grain, the edges of the figures should not be too sharp.

The overall presentation is a real iPhone night shot / 2000s–2010s digital camera nighttime candid shot texture: low light, obvious noise in dark areas, incomplete and uneven exposure, leaves and background slightly blurred, natural warm skin tones, bright pink clothing becomes the main color focus of the image.

Key focus: Two adult East Asian women + nighttime park + close-up duo composition + ultra-long black straight hair + natural plump hourglass figure + bright magenta bra-style tops + grey loose clothing sliding off shoulders, arms, and waist + left person one hand raised behind the head + two people close to each other + trees and lawn + strong street light + low-light mobile phone night shot + slight noise and blur.

Avoid: Daytime, indoor bedroom, studio, strong flash, exquisite commercial lighting, short hair, high ponytail, sportswear fully covering, black underwear, red dress, exaggerated athletic figure, extreme giant buttocks, heavily blurred background, excessive HDR, plastic skin, anime face, CG feel, watermarks, and garbled text.

If I were to modify it according to the color logic of Western oil painting, the core is to perform subtraction: cold fluorescent blue as the main tone, oxidized matte gold as the supplement, and cinnabar red as the only high-saturation accent, with the background shifting to a deep void that is almost pure black. Black background + a single high-saturation color (cinnabar red) + a cold main tone is the classic color matching logic for high-end ads like Dior and Cartier; Western aesthetics are more receptive to "restraint" than "complexity."

prompts.text:
Turn this structure photo into a single high-end halftone architectural travel-collage poster. Output one poster per uploaded photo — never merge multiple structures or photos into one frame.

FORMAT

3:4 vertical canvas. Split into two roughly equal zones — real architectural photo on top, printed reconstruction below — divided by one clean, sharp horizontal line.

Do not stretch, warp, tilt, or unnaturally reposition the structure to force the proportions.

TOP HALF — THE REAL SHOT

Preserve the original structure faithfully: same architecture, proportions, perspective, distinctive details, surrounding elements, natural light and shadow, and original color mood.

Keep recognizable features such as:

* façade
* windows and arches
* towers or domes
* doors and structural details
* roofline
* surrounding landscape or street elements

Add only a subtle high-end color grade and the faintest film grain. Do not redesign or reinterpret the architecture.

BOTTOM HALF — THE PRINTED RECONSTRUCTION

Rebuild the same structure as an experimental printed architectural collage using:

torn photographic fragments + fixed-width ASCII character fields + photocopy halftone dots + architectural linework.

The structure must remain immediately recognizable.

* Torn-edge photographic fragments preserve the most important architectural details.
* Brick, stone, glass, metal, shadows, windows, and surrounding textures gradually dissolve outward into ASCII characters, black halftone dots, fragmented print grain, and fine architectural drafting lines.
* Use thin technical construction lines to subtly trace the structure’s geometry.
* Let selected areas break apart into paper fibers and halftone fragments, creating the feeling that the building is emerging from an archival print.
* Keep the main silhouette strong and readable.
* Texture: rough white paper-fiber edges, subtle photocopy imperfections, slight print misregistration, faded ink, old-paper stains, a few restrained crop marks, and one small red calibration bar.
* Color: warm gray old-paper background + black ink + the structure’s original muted colors + a single restrained red accent.
* Never fully desaturate the structure.

The structure should occupy roughly 60–88% of the frame width, scaled according to what reads best for the architecture.

Leave 22–38% of the paper visibly untouched and empty, creating generous negative space so the poster feels like an archival architectural specimen rather than a packed digital screen.

TYPOGRAPHY

Add one clean, readable fixed-width architectural title based on the structure:

[STRUCTURE NAME]

Below it include:

[CITY, COUNTRY]
REC. STUDY 01

Add one short observational caption related to the architecture, such as:

“A monumental study in geometry, time, and place.”

Typography should feel like an old architectural archive mixed with an underground experimental design journal.

A few loose ASCII glyphs may trace the outer silhouette or architectural edges as texture only — never use ASCII to invent windows, doors, structural details, or technical specifications.

MOOD

Early digital systems × analog photocopy × architectural archive × underground zine × modern travel editorial.

The structure should feel like it is surfacing from an old printed document — half photograph, half architectural drawing, half experimental print.

Sophisticated, minimal, tactile, intellectual, slightly mysterious, and highly collectible.

AVOID

Solid black terminal backgrounds, dense walls of code, cyberpunk neon, excessive ASCII, distorted architecture, impossible geometry, invented architectural details, fake technical specifications, random symbols with no meaning, garbled text, excessive colors, brand logos, QR codes, watermarks, author credits, or tourist-poster clichés.

Priority: Preserve the structure’s identity and architectural accuracy first. The experimental halftone/ASCII treatment should enhance the architecture, not hide it.

格式

不要为了强行适应比例而拉伸、扭曲、倾斜或不自然地重新定位建筑。

上半部分 —— 实拍

忠实保留原始建筑：相同的建筑风格、比例、透视、独特细节、周围元素、自然光影和原始色彩基调。

使用以下元素将同一建筑重建为实验性的印刷建筑拼贴：

撕裂的摄影碎片 + 固定宽度的 ASCII 字符字段 + 复印机半色调点 + 建筑线条。

* 颜色：暖灰色旧纸背景 + 黑色墨水 + 建筑原始的柔和色彩 + 单一克制的红色点缀。
* 切勿让建筑完全去色。

建筑应占据框架宽度的约 60–88%，根据最适合建筑的比例进行缩放。

保留 22–38% 的纸张明显留白，营造出宽敞的负空间，使海报感觉像是一份档案建筑标本，而非拥挤的数字屏幕。

氛围

早期数字系统 × 模拟复印 × 建筑档案 × 地下杂志 × 现代旅行社论。

建筑应感觉像是从旧印刷文件中浮现——一半照片，一半建筑草图，一半实验性印刷品。

精致、简约、触感、理性、略显神秘且极具收藏价值。

避免

优先级：首先保留建筑的身份和建筑准确性。实验性的半色调/ASCII 处理应增强建筑感，而非掩盖它。
