items.title: 室内清冷美女神颜废片九宫格

prompts.text:
9:16 vertical composition, 3×3 nine-grid collage. Pure generated portrait photography. Theme: a collection of amateur “almost-god-shot” failed photos.
The image is made of 9 different photos assembled into one 3×3 contact sheet / nine-grid. Overall mood: casual phone snaps / friend-took-it-for-you / lightly private outtake collection. Every frame looks like it was one small mistake away from being a god-tier shot. The point is the contrast of “pretty girl + naturally great body + the exact moment it went wrong” — not making her look ugly, but making it obvious she was extremely photogenic.
Subject: clearly adult young East Asian woman, 22–27, long black hair, cool-toned pale skin, refined cold-pretty features, small face, faint freckles. Quiet, private, beautiful presence with a slightly feline coolness. Body proportions realistic and natural, but the lines are excellent: beautiful shoulders and neck, visible collarbones, natural bust line, very slim waist, clear hip/butt curve, long legs. Easy-to-photograph, feminine, well-proportioned real body — not exaggerated anime proportions.
Outfit: creamy-white tight halter knit top, soft and body-hugging, clearly outlining the upper body, exposing shoulders and collarbones; light-gray low-rise bodycon mini skirt that shows waist-to-hip ratio and leg lines; white mid-calf socks and pale thin-strap heels. Stylish, simple, the kind of everyday look that should produce great casual photos.
Setting: clean indoor white wall / doorway / hallway corner / apartment mirror area, with a lived-in home feel. Lighting: soft direct flash + cool-white, low-saturation palette. Slight CCD / iPhone casual-snap quality, light soft focus, light haze, strong private atmosphere. All nine frames must be the same person, same outfit, same scene family, but each pose, crop, and failure reason is different.
The nine frames:

Slight motion blur
She is standing in a 3/4 pose, body lines excellent, waist-hip curve and leg proportions beautiful, just about to look at the camera — almost a god shot — but she moved at the shutter. Face and body edges have a slight smear. Pretty, but soft/blurred.
Eyes closed
Leaning against the wall, one hand naturally in her hair. Shoulders, collarbones, and upper-body lines are great, pose is beautiful — but she blinked at the exact flash moment. Extremely close, extremely wasted.
Cropped-head outtake
Composition fail. Upper body was extremely flattering — bust line, collarbones, shoulders, slim waist — but forehead and part of the hair are cut off. Frame keeps only lips, chin, neck/shoulders, top, and waist. Intimate and close, but cropped too hard.
Flash overexposure
Selfie angle, facing the camera. Face and upper body were originally very pretty, but the flash is too strong. Face, chest, and shoulders blow out to white, detail gone. That “she was beautiful and the photo still died” feeling.
Completely out of focus
Standing facing the camera, one leg slightly forward, waist very slim, bodycon skirt clearly showing the curve. Pose is perfect for a god shot — but focus missed her face. The figure is soft overall; the background is sharper.
Crooked camera / tilted frame
Full body. Stance is good, one hand on the wall, the other hanging naturally. Proportions and leg lines are excellent — but the photographer’s hand was tilted. The whole frame leans. Almost a fashion street-style hero shot, but shot crooked.
Death angle from below
Close low-angle upward shot. Captures chin, underside of the nose, neck, and upper body. Unflattering angle, but she herself is still beautiful and the body outline is still clear. That “she’s gorgeous, her friend just can’t shoot” realism.
Too far, too much empty space
Full-body distant shot. Standing by the white wall, slightly turned, waist-hip-leg proportions all good, pose actually nice — but the photographer stood too far. She occupies only a small part of the frame; too much blank space; the subject is lost.
Hand blocking the lens
She notices she’s still being photographed and reaches to block the camera. Foreground is a large, out-of-focus palm; only part of the face is visible; body leans slightly forward; waist line and upper-body silhouette still readable. Slight motion blur and flash feel — the last outtake grabbed just before she stopped it.
Image requirements
All nine frames must be clearly different; failure reasons cannot repeat
Every frame must still read as “she herself is very beautiful and her body photographs extremely well”
Clearly show shoulders/neck, collarbones, bust line, slim waist, hip curve, long legs — keep it real and natural
Not a meme, not an ugly joke photo, not exaggerated posing
The feeling of “this should have been an easy god shot, and it still failed”
Real photography texture: slight grain, soft focus, flash feel, mistake feel
No text, no watermarks, no UI elements

prompts.text:
9:16 垂直构图，3×3 九宫格拼图。纯生成的摄影人像。主题：业余“差点成神”的废片合集。
图像由 9 张不同的照片组合成一个 3×3 的印相页/九宫格。整体氛围：随意的手机快照 / 朋友帮你拍的 / 略带私密的幕后花絮合集。每一帧看起来都像是差一点点就能成为神级大片。重点在于“漂亮女孩 + 自然的好身材 + 恰好出错的瞬间”之间的反差——不是要把她拍丑，而是要明显地表现出她非常上镜。
主体：明显的成年东亚年轻女性，22–27 岁，黑色长发，冷色调白皙皮肤，精致的冷感美女五官，小脸，淡淡的雀斑。安静、私密、美丽的姿态，带着一丝猫系的清冷感。身体比例写实自然，但线条极其优越：漂亮的肩膀和颈部，清晰可见的锁骨，自然的胸部线条，极细的腰部，清晰的臀胯曲线，大长腿。易于拍摄、充满女性化气质、比例协调的真实身材——不是夸张的动漫比例。
着装：奶白色紧身挂脖针织背心，柔软贴身，清晰地勾勒出上半身轮廓，露出肩膀和锁骨；浅灰色低腰包臀超短裙，展示腰胯比和腿部线条；白色中筒袜和淡色细带高跟鞋。时尚、简约，是那种本该拍出精彩生活照的日常装扮。
场景：干净的室内白墙 / 门口 / 走廊角落 / 公寓镜子区域，带有生活气息的居家感。光线：柔和的直闪光 + 冷白色、低饱和度色调。轻微的 CCD / iPhone 随手拍质感，轻微柔焦，轻微薄雾，强烈的私密氛围。所有九帧必须是同一个人、同一套衣服、同一系列场景，但每张的动作、构图和失败原因各不相同。
九帧画面：
1. 轻微运动模糊：她以 3/4 侧身站立，身体线条优越，腰臀曲线和腿部比例极美，正准备看向镜头——几乎是神级大片——但在按下快门时她动了。脸部和身体边缘有轻微的重影。漂亮，但模糊了。
2. 闭眼：靠在墙上，一只手自然地拨弄头发。肩膀、锁骨和上半身线条极佳，姿势很美——但在闪光灯亮起的瞬间她眨眼了。极近的距离，极大的浪费。
3. 裁掉头的废片：构图失败。上半身极其迷人——胸部线条、锁骨、肩膀、细腰——但额头和部分头发被切掉了。画面只保留了嘴唇、下巴、颈部/肩膀、上衣和腰部。亲密且靠近，但裁剪得太狠。
4. 闪光灯过曝：自拍角度，面对镜头。脸部和上半身原本非常漂亮，但闪光灯太强了。脸部、胸部和肩膀处过曝变白，细节消失。那种“她很美但照片还是毁了”的感觉。
5. 完全失焦：面对镜头站立，一只脚稍稍前迈，腰部非常纤细，包臀裙清晰地展示了曲线。动作完美契合神片标准——但焦点没对准她的脸。整个人物是虚的，背景反而更清晰。
6. 相机歪了 / 倾斜的构图：全身照。姿态很好，一只手扶墙，另一只手自然垂下。比例和腿部线条极佳——但摄影师的手抖歪了。整个画面倾斜。几乎是时尚街拍大片，但拍歪了。
7. 死亡底角仰拍：近距离低角度向上拍摄。拍到了下巴、鼻孔下方、颈部和上半身。角度不好看，但她本人依然很美，身体轮廓依然清晰。那种“她本人很正，只是朋友不会拍”的真实感。
8. 太远了，留白太多：全身远景照。站在白墙边，身体微侧，腰臀腿比例都很好，姿势其实很漂亮——但摄影师站得太远了。她在画面中只占很小一部分，留白过多，主体感丧失。
9. 手遮镜头：她发现还在被拍，伸手去挡镜头。前景是一个巨大的、失焦的手掌；只能看到脸部的一部分；身体略微前倾；腰部线条和上半身轮廓依然可辨。轻微的运动模糊和闪光感——在被制止前抓拍的最后一张废片。
图像要求：
- 九帧画面必须明显不同；失败原因不能重复
- 每一帧必须依然能看出“她本人非常漂亮且身材极其上镜”
- 清晰地展示肩膀/颈部、锁骨、胸部线条、细腰、臀部曲线、长腿——保持真实自然
- 不是表情包，不是丑照，不是夸张的摆拍
- “这本该是一张轻松成神的大片，但还是失败了”的感觉
- 真实的摄影质感：轻微颗粒，柔焦，闪光灯感，错误感
- 无文字，无水印，无 UI 元素

prompts.text:
ULTRA-REALISTIC NATURAL SMARTPHONE SELFIE, vertical 3:4, a candid indoor mirror-style selfie of a young East Asian woman in a cozy upscale restaurant or hotel lounge.
She has long, naturally wavy dark-brown hair falling over her shoulders and chest, soft wispy strands around her face, delicate youthful features, clear natural skin, subtle makeup, and a gentle closed-mouth smile while looking at her phone screen.

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 vertical editorial poster series in English, combining brutalist architecture, oversized perspective typography, realistic young adult figures, and strong three-dimensional spatial relationships.

Keep the visual system consistent across the series: dramatic low-angle photography, deep cobalt-blue sky, warm raw-concrete gray, warm ivory typography, charcoal clothing, and safety orange as the only strong accent. Architecture should feel monumental and simple, with large geometric surfaces rather than complex structures.

Typography must actively participate in the space. Let letters follow architectural perspective, change scale with depth, wrap around surfaces, cast real shadows, become partially hidden by people or concrete, and interact naturally with foreground and background elements. Avoid flat text placed over a photograph.

Keep the people realistic and naturally posed, with authentic skin texture, natural hair, believable clothing folds, and clear physical interaction with the surrounding architecture.

Poster 1: CAST TYPE
Create monumental three-dimensional letters spelling “TYPE” mounted above a brutalist concrete structure. Use warm-ivory front faces and safety-orange side depth. Strong sunlight casts huge readable letter shadows across the concrete wall below. Place a realistic young woman walking through the transition between sunlight and the projected shadow. Add “CAST” as giant perspective typography in the sky. Supporting text may include “LIGHT MAKES FORM”, “READ THE SHADOW”, and “SOLID / PROJECTION”.

Poster 2: SKY APERTURE
Create a monumental circular brutalist atrium viewed from below, with a large round opening revealing vivid blue sky. Integrate “SKY APERTURE” into the curved concrete structure using true circular perspective rather than flat curved text. Add a realistic young man on the lower walkway and a restrained vermilion curved graphic accent. Supporting text may include “OPEN ABOVE”, “CIRCULAR FIELD”, and “LIGHT ENTERS HERE”.

Poster 3: OPEN CORNER
Create a massive 90-degree brutalist concrete corner viewed from a dramatic low angle. Place a realistic young woman naturally interacting with the corner and an orange three-dimensional L-shaped spatial form. Make “OPEN CORNER” wrap across the two architectural planes so the typography visibly changes direction at the corner. Supporting text may include “TWO SIDES”, “TURN THE GRID”, and “BETWEEN SURFACES”.

Poster 4: FLOAT LEVEL
Create two offset concrete slabs with a realistic young man walking along the upper level. Introduce two separated translucent planes at different depths, one smoky blue-gray behind him and one orange plane in front, creating a fragmented spatial volume. Place “FLOAT LEVEL” across multiple depths so the words appear at different distances. Supporting text may include “BETWEEN PLANES”, “NO FIXED GROUND”, and “OFFSET HEIGHT”.

Use meaningful editorial microcopy, small labels, thin rules, and compact annotations to create rich but controlled information density. Keep clear hierarchy and generous negative space around the main architectural forms.

The final series should feel like professionally art-directed architecture and youth-culture editorial posters, with strong thumbnail impact and sophisticated spatial detail up close.

海报 3：开放角落（OPEN CORNER）。创建一个从戏剧性低角度观察的巨大的 90 度粗野主义混凝土角落。放置一名真实的年轻女性，与角落以及一个橙色的三维 L 形空间形式进行自然互动。让“OPEN CORNER”包裹在两个建筑平面上，使排版在角落处明显改变方向。辅助文字可能包括“TWO SIDES”、“TURN THE GRID”以及“BETWEEN SURFACES”。

prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
请将我上传的照片制作成一张 3:4 竖版「上方原始摄影 / 下方线稿转译」对照海报**。

**【主体保持真实】**

照片中的人物始终保持完整的照片级写实效果。脸部特征、肤色、发型、发色、神态、动作、服装、饰品以及身体比例全部沿用原图，不重新绘制，不换衣，不改变动作，不增减人物，也不要出现肢体缺失。

画面继续使用原照片的取景方式、裁切范围、镜头角度、人物尺寸与所在位置，不镜像，不重新居中，不随意缩放，也不要为人物创造新的动作。人物始终停留在原本的位置，作为画面的真实视觉主体。人物正在拿着或使用的重要物件可以继续保留照片质感。

**【环境转成手绘世界】**

下半部分中，人物周围的环境全部脱离摄影质感，转换到柔和的暖白纸张背景上。

建筑、树木、山体、墙面、门窗、窗帘、家具、书籍、植物、灯具、地毯、相框以及其他背景物件，都根据原照片的位置与比例进行简化，用松散、概括的单色线条重新画出。

不需要复制所有真实细节，只保留能识别场景的主要轮廓、大小关系和空间位置。去除背景原有的颜色、真实阴影、摄影纹理和材质表现。

**【单色线条规则】**

整个下半部分的环境只允许使用 **一种饱和单色墨线**。

优先从原照片中提取一个明显的非中性色，再将它调整为清晰、明亮的中等饱和色。若原图整体偏灰、偏白或没有明显主色，则自动选择与画面协调的强调色，例如钴蓝、砖红、珊瑚红、森林绿、深青、紫色、酒红、赭橙等。

一张图只能有一种线稿颜色，不允许混用第二种颜色。

线条质感不要像精细钢笔画，也不要像铅笔素描，更接近 **中粗号记号笔与圆珠笔之间的随手画感**：线条可以轻微抖动，粗细和压力略有变化，转折不必完全精准，连接处可以稍微错位，线尾允许轻微越界，整体有一次画成的自然感。

轮廓不要太工整，要保留一点笨拙、不完美和随性。

物体尽量用简单图形概括：

书本用简单矩形表示；

植物用几组松散叶片表示；

灯具用简单圆顶和支杆表示；

窗户只保留基本框架；

布料只画少量稀疏褶皱。

不追求画满，保留大量暖白留白，让画面轻松、透气、有一点未完成的手稿感。

**【地面与空间处理】**

地面、道路、桌面、墙脚、台面等只保留最基本的外轮廓以及少量结构缝线。

不使用灰色底，不画真实投影，不大面积填色，不制造立体明暗。所有环境元素始终使用同一种墨色，让照片级真实人物自然叠加在单色手绘环境之上。

**【整体视觉方向】**

最终效果应呈现明显的 **「真实主体 × 粗粝单色手绘环境」** 反差。

整体气质偏向：

**编辑拼贴、独立杂志生活插画、素朴环境涂鸦、干净暖白纸张、极简、有趣、松弛。**

下半部分不是精致插画，而是经过概括的、带有人手痕迹的单色背景手稿。

**【禁止出现】**

不要把真实人物画成插画或卡通；

不改变人物身份、脸、服装和姿势；

不额外增加人物；

不出现缺手缺脚或肢体错误；

不凭空增加原图不存在的重要物件；

不使用多色线稿；

不保留写实摄影背景；

不做渐变、水彩、3D、动漫、漫画或精致矢量插画；

不添加文字、Logo、水印、界面元素或任何 UI。

prompts.text:
Aspect ratio 9:16. A cinematic, full-length fine-art portrait of a captivating 24-year-old east asian woman. Her expressive features are enhanced by minimal, dewy editorial makeup. Her expression captures a raw mix of playful thrill and fleeting mystery. The visual style is deeply anchored in the candid, emotionally raw fashion photography of Harley Weir, combined with the poetic, intimate gaze of Petra Collins.

Captured in an ultra-sharp high-speed time slice with a 1/2000s shutter speed  to freeze the kinetic energy. She is frozen mid-stride while running along a rustic cobblestone path. Her hands delicately lift the hem of her dress to free her movement as she turns her torso sideways, casting a fleeting glance back over her shoulder. Her face is beautifully obscured by windblown hair, with wispy strands drifting across her forehead, evoking the accidental, snapshot-aesthetic of classic 90s street photography.

Her body angles sharply away from the camera, emphasizing a dynamic, diagonal line of motion. She wears a flowing, bias-cut silk slip dress in a soft champagne hue that clings and ripples against her movement. The lightweight material billows outward, creating rich fluid textures, accessorized subtly by a delicate, glinting silver anklet that catches a sharp specular highlight near the heel.

An extreme low-angle, worm’s-eye view positioned directly at ground level, almost touching the path. One bare foot steps forcefully toward and past the lens, the detailed texture of the sole dominating the immediate foreground with dramatic foreshortening. Shot on a vintage 24mm anamorphic lens, creating a wide cinematic field of view with characteristic subtle edge distortion. The composition utilizes a strong upward perspective and shallow depth of field (f/2.8), keeping the foreground foot razor-sharp while layering the mid-ground silhouette and a soft bokeh canopy of overhanging trees.

Shot on 35mm Fujifilm Superia film stock. The scene is bathed in warm, low-slung golden hour light filtering from the front-left, casting long, dramatic shadows and creating a bright rim-light along her silhouette. The color grade boasts a warm, nostalgic palette with muted earth tones and rich, organic contrast. Features subtle chromatic aberration at the frame edges and an authentic, fine tactile film grain, giving the image a tangible, analog gallery-photograph texture.

prompts.text:
Turn this structure photo into a single high-end halftone architectural travel-collage poster. Output one poster per uploaded photo — never merge multiple structures or photos into one frame.

FORMAT

3:4 vertical canvas. Split into two roughly equal zones — real architectural photo on top, printed reconstruction below — divided by one clean, sharp horizontal line.

Do not stretch, warp, tilt, or unnaturally reposition the structure to force the proportions.

TOP HALF — THE REAL SHOT

Preserve the original structure faithfully: same architecture, proportions, perspective, distinctive details, surrounding elements, natural light and shadow, and original color mood.

Keep recognizable features such as:

* façade
* windows and arches
* towers or domes
* doors and structural details
* roofline
* surrounding landscape or street elements

Add only a subtle high-end color grade and the faintest film grain. Do not redesign or reinterpret the architecture.

BOTTOM HALF — THE PRINTED RECONSTRUCTION

Rebuild the same structure as an experimental printed architectural collage using:

torn photographic fragments + fixed-width ASCII character fields + photocopy halftone dots + architectural linework.

The structure must remain immediately recognizable.

* Torn-edge photographic fragments preserve the most important architectural details.
* Brick, stone, glass, metal, shadows, windows, and surrounding textures gradually dissolve outward into ASCII characters, black halftone dots, fragmented print grain, and fine architectural drafting lines.
* Use thin technical construction lines to subtly trace the structure’s geometry.
* Let selected areas break apart into paper fibers and halftone fragments, creating the feeling that the building is emerging from an archival print.
* Keep the main silhouette strong and readable.
* Texture: rough white paper-fiber edges, subtle photocopy imperfections, slight print misregistration, faded ink, old-paper stains, a few restrained crop marks, and one small red calibration bar.
* Color: warm gray old-paper background + black ink + the structure’s original muted colors + a single restrained red accent.
* Never fully desaturate the structure.

The structure should occupy roughly 60–88% of the frame width, scaled according to what reads best for the architecture.

Leave 22–38% of the paper visibly untouched and empty, creating generous negative space so the poster feels like an archival architectural specimen rather than a packed digital screen.

TYPOGRAPHY

Add one clean, readable fixed-width architectural title based on the structure:

[STRUCTURE NAME]

Below it include:

[CITY, COUNTRY]
REC. STUDY 01

Add one short observational caption related to the architecture, such as:

“A monumental study in geometry, time, and place.”

Typography should feel like an old architectural archive mixed with an underground experimental design journal.

A few loose ASCII glyphs may trace the outer silhouette or architectural edges as texture only — never use ASCII to invent windows, doors, structural details, or technical specifications.

MOOD

Early digital systems × analog photocopy × architectural archive × underground zine × modern travel editorial.

The structure should feel like it is surfacing from an old printed document — half photograph, half architectural drawing, half experimental print.

Sophisticated, minimal, tactile, intellectual, slightly mysterious, and highly collectible.

AVOID

Solid black terminal backgrounds, dense walls of code, cyberpunk neon, excessive ASCII, distorted architecture, impossible geometry, invented architectural details, fake technical specifications, random symbols with no meaning, garbled text, excessive colors, brand logos, QR codes, watermarks, author credits, or tourist-poster clichés.

Priority: Preserve the structure’s identity and architectural accuracy first. The experimental halftone/ASCII treatment should enhance the architecture, not hide it.

prompts.text:
将此建筑照片转换为一张高端半色调建筑旅行拼贴海报。每张上传的照片输出一张海报——切勿将多个建筑或照片合并到一个画面中。

格式

3:4 垂直画布。分为两个大致相等的区域——上方是真实的建筑实拍，下方是印刷的重建图——由一条干净、锐利的水平线分隔。

不要拉伸、扭曲、倾斜或不自然地重新放置建筑以强行适应比例。

上半部分 —— 实拍

忠实地保留原始建筑：同样的建筑、比例、透视、独特的细节、周围元素、自然光影以及原始色彩基调。

保留可识别的特征，例如：

* 立面
* 窗户和拱门
* 塔楼或圆顶
* 门和结构细节
* 屋顶线
* 周围的景观或街道元素

仅添加微妙的高端调色和极细微的胶片颗粒。不要重新设计或重新诠释建筑。

下半部分 —— 印刷重建

使用以下元素将相同的建筑重建为实验性的印刷建筑拼贴：

撕裂的照片碎片 + 固定宽度的 ASCII 字符字段 + 复印半色调网点 + 建筑线条。

建筑必须保持立即可以被识别。

* 撕裂边缘的照片碎片保留了最重要的建筑细节。
* 砖块、石头、玻璃、金属、阴影、窗户和周围的纹理逐渐向外溶解成 ASCII 字符、黑色半色调网点、破碎的印刷颗粒和精细的建筑绘图线条。
* 使用细的技术施工线微妙地追踪建筑的几何形状。
* 让选定的区域破碎成纸张纤维和半色调碎片，营造成建筑正从档案印刷品中浮现出来的感觉。
* 保持主轮廓强有力且清晰易读。
* 纹理：粗糙的白色纸张纤维边缘、微妙的复印瑕疵、轻微的印刷对位不准、褪色的墨水、旧纸张污渍、少量克制的裁切标记以及一个小红色的校准条。
* 颜色：暖灰色旧纸张背景 + 黑色墨水 + 建筑原始的柔和色彩 + 单一且克制的红色点缀。
* 永远不要让建筑完全去色。

建筑应占据约 60–88% 的画面宽度，根据最适合建筑的阅读效果进行缩放。

留出 22–38% 的纸张明显留白且不作处理，创造充裕的负空间，使海报感觉像是一件档案建筑标本，而不是拥挤的数字屏幕。

排版

添加一个基于建筑的干净、清晰、固定宽度的建筑标题：

[建筑名称]

下方包括：

[城市，国家]
REC. STUDY 01

添加一段与建筑相关的简短观察性说明，例如：

“几何、时间与场所的丰碑式研究。”

排版应感觉像旧建筑档案馆与地下实验设计杂志的结合。

少量松散的 ASCII 字符可以作为纹理追踪外部轮廓或建筑边缘——切勿使用 ASCII 来虚构窗户、门、结构细节或技术规格。

氛围

早期数字系统 × 模拟复印 × 建筑档案 × 地下杂志 × 现代旅行社论。

建筑应感觉像是从旧的印刷文件中浮现出来——一半是照片，一半是建筑图纸，一半是实验性印刷品。

精致、极简、触感、理性、略显神秘且极具收藏价值。

避免

纯黑终端背景、密集的代码墙、赛博朋克霓虹、过度的 ASCII、扭曲的建筑、不可能的几何形状、虚构的建筑细节、虚假的技术规格、无意义的随机符号、错乱的文字、过多的色彩、品牌徽标、二维码、水印、作者署名或旅游海报陈词滥调。

优先级：首先保留建筑的身份和建筑准确性。实验性的半色调/ASCII 处理应该增强建筑，而不是掩盖它。

空气感的稀疏透视刘海和修饰脸型的纤细发丝。
几根精细的乱发在逆光中闪烁。
白皙真实的皮肤，带有细腻的自然纹理，自然的棕色眼睛，浅粉米色妆容，柔和的红润脸颊和哑光柔滑的粉红色嘴唇。
温柔、略带甜美的闭口微笑，并与镜头直接眼神交流。

服装：
白色 / 象牙色无袖蕾丝下摆上衣，带有精致的花卉蕾丝、合身的腰部和轻微展开的下摆。
浅色水洗宽松阔腿牛仔裤。
象牙色结构化小手提包。

姿势：
她沿着公园小径向前走了几步，被捕捉到回过头看向镜头的瞬间。
她的躯干大部分仍背对着，而上半身自然地转向镜头。
她身体微微前倾，呈现出一种微妙可爱、俏皮的轮廓。
双手放在后腰处，共同拿着那个象牙色小手提包。
头发随转身动作轻轻摆动。
自然的放松姿势，具有解剖学上正确的肩膀、手臂、手腕、手和手指。

构图：
近距离四分之三后视图时尚快照。
相机位置略低于头部且高于腰部，强调回眸一瞥。
24–28mm 广角透视，不是自拍。
取景范围约为头部至膝盖以下 / 小腿上方，女性占据图像的约 85–90%。
保留足够的公园步道可见，以清晰地确立户外环境。

背景 / 光影：
水边优雅的林荫公园步道，黑色栏杆，木凳，灌木丛和经典的黑色灯柱。
明亮温暖的初秋午后阳光透过绿色树叶。
她的棕色头发周围有强烈的自然轮廓光，肩膀上有柔和的高光，人行道上有细微的斑驳阴影。
背景柔和模糊，具有真实的真实光学焦外成像。

照片质量：
超写实真人摄影，iPhone 17 Pro，Apple Smart HDR，真实的皮肤毛孔，单根发丝，详细的蕾丝和牛仔布纹理，自然的景深，真实的阳光，自然的日本时尚杂志快照。

禁止动漫、插画、CGI、过度磨皮、夸张的身材比例、扭曲的解剖结构、多余的手指、畸形的手、重复的肢体、不自然的扭曲、文字或水印。

prompts.text:
PROMPT — 7UP “MAKE IT EXTRA REFRESHING”
FORMAT
Ultra-Premium 7UP SMM Promotional Poster
Vertical 4:5 Instagram Hero Creative
Global Soft Drink Campaign
Contemporary Beverage Advertising
Surrealist Commercial Photography × Freshness × Pop Design × Graphic Art Direction
Agency-Level Art Direction
Behance Front Page Quality
8K UHD
Hyper-Realistic Surrealism × Product Photography × Contemporary Advertising
High-Impact Visual Communication
Zero AI Slop
Zero Generic Beverage Advertising
Zero Catalogue Aesthetic
Zero Basic Soda Advertisement
Zero Luxury-Copycat Aesthetic
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CORE STRATEGY
This is not simply a 7UP product advertisement.
This is 7UP turning refreshment into a physical force.
The campaign should communicate:
ONE SIP. TOTAL RESET.
7UP should feel:
fresh + playful + optimistic + energetic + youthful + spontaneous + crisp + uncomplicated
The visual language should combine:
7UP advertising × surrealist photography × contemporary pop design × premium beverage photography × summer culture × editorial graphic design
The surrealism should be built around one simple idea:
FRESHNESS CHANGES THE WORLD AROUND YOU.
The world becomes brighter, lighter and more refreshing the instant 7UP enters the scene.
No random fantasy.
No excessive CGI.
No psychedelic dream world.
The impossible elements should feel tactile, refreshing and commercially believable.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CAMPAIGN IDEA
“MAKE IT EXTRA REFRESHING”
Imagine an ordinary city afternoon.
Hot pavement.
Harsh sunlight.
Busy streets.
People looking exhausted.
Then someone opens an ice-cold 7UP.
Suddenly:
the entire environment transforms into a giant refreshing wave.
The pavement becomes sparkling translucent water.
Buildings bend like sheets of fresh mint.
Trees explode into oversized citrus leaves.
Ice cubes float through the air.
Lime slices become enormous graphic discs.
A giant stream of sparkling 7UP travels through the city.
The hero remains completely calm at the center.
The message:
WHEN LIFE GETS HEAVY, MAKE IT EXTRA REFRESHING.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MASTER VISUAL
Create a surreal contemporary city plaza during an intensely bright summer afternoon.
The environment begins as a realistic hot urban setting.
Concrete.
Glass.
Sunlight.
Pedestrians.
Cafés.
Traffic.
Then an enormous wave of crystal-clear sparkling 7UP cuts through the city.
The wave bends around buildings.
Passes underneath cars.
Travels across walls.
Splashes upward.
Turns into translucent architectural structures.
Inside the wave:
ice cubes + lime slices + carbonation bubbles + mint leaves
are suspended in mid-air.
At the exact center stands the hero subject holding an ice-cold 7UP bottle.
Everything around them has been transformed by freshness.
The scene should feel like:
a real commercial production that somehow captured a physical wave of refreshment.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
HERO PRODUCT
Chilled 7UP bottle or can.
Classic green packaging.
Bright yellow-green citrus accents.
Heavy realistic condensation.
Individual water droplets.
Visible carbonation.
Clear fizzy beverage.
Realistic transparent liquid.
Authentic label treatment.
Clean 7UP branding.
No distorted logo.
No melted typography.
No impossible packaging.
The product should look commercially manufactured and professionally photographed.
Place the hero product prominently in the foreground.
The bottle should be one of the sharpest elements in the composition.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
HERO SUBJECT
Young adult.
Contemporary global appearance.
Natural skin texture.
Realistic anatomy.
Fresh, energetic expression.
Relaxed confidence.
Subtle smile.
No exaggerated influencer expression.
No beauty-commercial posing.
The person should feel like they were genuinely caught enjoying an unexpectedly refreshing moment.
One hand holds the 7UP.
The other hand relaxed naturally.
Body slightly turned toward camera.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WARDROBE
Contemporary summer streetwear.
Oversized white shirt.
Loose light denim trousers.
Clean white sneakers.
Small green accessory.
Subtle citrus-yellow detail.
Minimal jewelry.
Natural styling.
No excessive logos.
No luxury fashion.
No futuristic clothing.
The wardrobe should feel:
fresh + youthful + effortless + wearable.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SURREALISM SYSTEM
The surrealism follows one central rule:
REFRESHMENT FLOWS THROUGH EVERYTHING.
The 7UP wave should transform:
* pavement into sparkling water
* concrete walls into translucent citrus surfaces
* street signs into lime-shaped forms
* architecture into flowing curves
* sunlight into sparkling particles
* fountains into giant carbonation streams
* trees into oversized mint-and-lime structures
* shadows into liquid reflections
Add:
* floating ice
* lime slices
* carbonation bubbles
* condensation droplets
* crystal-clear splashes
* translucent green surfaces
Every surreal element must reinforce:
freshness + citrus + fizz + cooling relief.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SIGNATURE SURREAL DEVICE
Create one enormous 7UP FRESHNESS WAVE.
The wave emerges from behind the hero bottle.
It begins as a small sparkling splash.
Then grows into a monumental transparent green-tinted wave.
It curves upward behind the subject.
It passes between buildings.
It forms a giant circular arc around the composition.
Within the wave:
ice cubes + lime slices + bubbles
are suspended with realistic fluid physics.
At the top of the wave:
07
At the bottom:
FRESHNESS / UNLIMITED
This becomes the campaign’s visual signature.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
COMPOSITION
VISUAL HIERARCHY
7UP BRAND
↓
HERO PRODUCT
↓
FRESHNESS WAVE
↓
HERO SUBJECT
↓
CITRUS ENVIRONMENT
↓
CAMPAIGN MESSAGE
↓
CTA
Product:
15–20%
Hero subject:
15–20%
Surreal environment:
55–60%
Typography / promotional information:
10–15%
The composition should feel energetic without becoming visually chaotic.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
7UP COLOR SYSTEM
7UP GREEN
Primary campaign color.
Use saturated fresh green across:
Product packaging
Graphic blocks
Liquid wave
Environmental accents
CITRUS LIME
Bright yellow-green.
Use for:
Lime slices
Highlights
Small graphic elements
Freshness particles
WHITE
Used for:
Typography
Negative space
Foam
Highlights
DARK GREEN
Used for:
Shadows
Typography
Supporting graphic elements
The palette should feel cold, crisp and refreshing.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
COLOR RATIO
40% white / bright architectural neutrals
30% fresh green
15% lime-yellow
10% deep green
5% natural skin / environmental tones
The green should immediately trigger the idea of freshness without turning the entire image into a flat green advertisement.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
BACKGROUND
Create a contemporary urban summer plaza.
White concrete architecture.
Glass façades.
Outdoor café seating.
Open pedestrian space.
Modern geometric buildings.
Small trees.
Bright sunlight.
No recognizable city.
No famous landmarks.
No nightclub.
No beach resort.
No generic tropical island.
No cyberpunk environment.
The location should feel like a global modern city experiencing an impossible freshness event.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CITRUS WORLD
Introduce large but carefully controlled citrus details.
One oversized lime slice partially embedded into a concrete wall.
Small lime slices suspended inside the freshness wave.
Mint leaves travelling through the liquid.
Tiny bubbles catching sunlight.
Ice cubes refracting the environment.
A subtle citrus mist surrounding the hero.
Everything should remain photorealistic.
Do not turn the image into a fruit collage.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
GRAPHIC DESIGN SYSTEM
Create a bold contemporary 7UP editorial grid.
Use:
oversized typography
green graphic blocks
lime-yellow accents
thin rules
circular citrus graphics
large numerals
micro typography
directional arrows
temperature indicators
refreshment codes
cropped typography
vertical labels
Subtle campaign information:
07 / FRESH
ICE COLD
CITRUS / FIZZ / RESET
REFRESH MODE
The graphic system should feel like a premium global beverage campaign, not an infographic.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM
PRIMARY HEADLINE
Large bold contemporary sans-serif.
Rounded but confident.
Heavy weight.
Clean geometry.
High readability.
Use slightly oversized typography with playful cropping.
The typography should feel:
fresh + energetic + contemporary.
Avoid:
luxury serif typography.
traditional soda typography.
generic sports fonts.
overly futuristic type.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
TOP LEFT
7UP logo.
Small.
Clean.
Official-style treatment.
Generous clear space.
Underneath:
LEMON-LIME REFRESHMENT
Small uppercase typography.
No logo distortion.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
GIANT CENTER TYPOGRAPHY
Massive:
FRESH
Then:
HITS DIFFERENT.
The word FRESH should occupy a major portion of the composition.
Allow the freshness wave to pass behind and through the typography.
Some letters should appear partially submerged inside the transparent liquid.
Typography remains crisp and readable.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CAMPAIGN TITLE
Lower-left:
MAKE IT
Then substantially larger:
EXTRA FRESH.
Add a lime-yellow underline.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SUPPORTING COPY
ONE SIP. TOTAL RESET.
Secondary:
COOL DOWN. BRIGHTEN UP.
Short.
Playful.
No unnecessary marketing paragraph.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PRODUCT INFORMATION
Small structured block:
7UP
LEMON-LIME
ICE COLD
330 ML
Use precise micro typography.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PROMOTIONAL STRIP
Create a thin bright-green horizontal block.
Inside:
OPEN / SIP / REFRESH / REPEAT
White uppercase typography.
Integrated into the overall grid.
Not a discount banner.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CTA
Bottom-right:
GET REFRESHED →
Dark-green rectangular button.
White typography.
Underneath:
Discover 7UP
Compact.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PRICE
Optional India-market version:
FROM ₹40
Small.
Secondary.
Do not make the poster feel retail-focused.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
BOTTOM FEATURE STRIP
Thin dark-green rule.
Then:
LEMON-LIME / ICE COLD / FIZZ / FRESHNESS / MOMENTS
Centered beneath.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
VERTICAL EDGE TEXT
Right edge:
7UP / FRESH / CITRUS / 2026
Rotated vertically.
Small.
Precise.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
Premium global beverage campaign photography.
Hyper-realistic.
Bright.
Crisp.
Refreshing.
Real human skin.
Real fabric.
Real glass.
Real liquid.
Real ice.
Real lime texture.
Real carbonation.
The image should feel like an extremely expensive commercial production photographed at the exact moment a surreal freshness wave hits the city.
No illustration.
No cartoon.
No obvious CGI.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
LIQUID / ICE PHYSICS
The 7UP liquid must behave realistically.
Transparent carbonated beverage.
Tiny bubbles.
Natural splash arcs.
Realistic surface tension.
Individual droplets.
Clear ice.
Natural refraction.
Condensation beads.
Correct glass reflections.
The giant wave may be surreal in scale, but its fluid physics must remain believable.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
LIGHTING
Bright summer sunlight.
Large directional source from upper-left.
Strong crisp shadows.
High-key environment.
Bright reflections on glass.
Green liquid catching sunlight.
Lime slices glowing naturally through backlight.
Ice producing realistic caustic reflections.
Natural skin exposure.
No neon.
No colored fog.
No excessive bloom.
No dreamy luxury haze.
The image should feel cold despite being photographed under hot sunlight.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CAMERA
ARRI Alexa Mini LF
35mm premium commercial lens
Slightly low camera position.
Hero product foreground.
Subject centered.
Large environmental perspective.
Moderate depth of field.
High dynamic range.
Extremely detailed product.
Natural optical characteristics.
Premium global beverage advertising photography.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
POST-PRODUCTION
Contemporary global 7UP campaign grading.
Clean whites.
Fresh saturated green.
Controlled citrus yellow.
Deep green shadows.
Natural skin.
High micro-contrast.
Crystal-clear liquid.
Detailed ice.
Sharp condensation.
Crisp graphic edges.
Subtle film grain.
Controlled highlights.
No plastic skin.
No artificial HDR.
No teal-orange grade.
No excessive saturation.
No fake CGI glow.
No excessive grain.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
BRAND SAFETY / CONSISTENCY
The final visual must immediately communicate 7UP without relying solely on the logo.
Brand recognition should come from:
fresh green
lemon-lime identity
crisp carbonation
refreshment
playfulness
optimism
summer energy
clean visual language
bold graphic design
ice-cold product photography
Do not make it resemble:
Sprite’s green citrus advertising.
Mountain Dew’s extreme-sports aesthetic.
Coca-Cola’s red emotional storytelling.
Pepsi’s electric-blue cultural energy.
Fanta’s colorful playful world.
Generic lemon-lime soda advertising.
Generic summer beverage advertising.
Random AI surrealism.
The visual identity must remain unmistakably 7UP.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
FINAL FEEL
If:
7UP × a surrealist artist × a world-class beverage photographer × a contemporary graphic design studio × a global advertising agency
created one campaign together—
the result should feel like:
MAKE IT EXTRA FRESH.
Not a bottle floating in a green background.
Not a generic summer advertisement.
Not a fruit collage.
Not a basic soda poster.
Not random surrealism.
Not an AI fantasy image.
A high-impact 7UP campaign where one sip sends an impossible wave of freshness through an overheated world.
Vertical 4:5 — 8K UHD — hyper-realistic — surreal urban summer environment — giant transparent freshness wave — lemon-lime visual language — fresh green/lime/white palette — hero chilled 7UP product — realistic condensation — carbonation and liquid physics — oversized contemporary typography — precise editorial grid — natural human anatomy — authentic summer styling — detailed glass and ice — physically believable surrealism — accurate 7UP branding treatment — crisp readable typography — premium commercial photography — agency-level art direction — Instagram hero creative — Behance front-page quality — print-ready.

prompts.text:
提示词 — 七喜“让它额外清爽”
格式
超级高端七喜社交媒体促销海报
垂直 4:5 Instagram 英雄创意
全球软饮料宣传活动
当代饮料广告
超现实主义商业摄影 × 清爽感 × 流行设计 × 平面艺术指导
机构级艺术指导
Behance 首页质量
8K 超高清
超写实超现实主义 × 产品摄影 × 当代广告
高冲击力视觉传达
零 AI 废料
零平庸饮料广告
零画册美学
零基础苏打广告
零奢侈品模仿美学
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
核心策略
这不仅仅是一个七喜产品广告。
这是七喜将清爽转化为一种物理力量。
该宣传活动应传达：
啜饮一口。全面重启。
七喜应该感觉：
清新 + 俏皮 + 乐观 + 活力 + 年轻 + 自发 + 脆爽 + 简约
视觉语言应结合：
七喜广告 × 超现实主义摄影 × 当代流行设计 × 高端饮料摄影 × 夏季文化 × 编辑平面设计
超现实主义应围绕一个简单的想法建立：
清爽改变你周围的世界。
在七喜进入画面的瞬间，世界变得更明亮、更轻盈、更清爽。
没有随机的幻想。
没有过度的 CGI。
没有迷幻梦境世界。
不可能的元素应该是触手可及的、清爽的且在商业上可信的。
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
活动构思
“让它额外清爽”
想象一个平凡的城市下午。
滚烫的人行道。
强烈的阳光。

The person should be clearly visible within the frame and photographed realistically, wearing a simple dark shirt or jacket. He holds a large white drawing pad beside him, facing the camera.

The paper features an exaggerated French street caricature of the same person, drawn in the classic old-school style of a Montmartre tourist artist. The caricature should appear hand-drawn using black ink or pen lines on white paper. It should be dramatically exaggerated and humorous while remaining clearly recognizable as the same person.

Push the facial features theatrically: an oversized or unusually shaped nose, an exaggerated jawline, enlarged ears, expressive eyebrows, distorted facial proportions, a broad mischievous smile, a strongly emphasized beard shape, and a playful, over-the-top expression. Keep the caricature charming, funny, and artistic rather than grotesque.

Important: clearly show both versions within a single image:

The real, photorealistic person
The caricature drawing of the same person on the paper

Use realistic lighting, a clean composition, high detail, natural skin texture, believable hands holding the paper, a calm background, and a playful vintage Parisian tourist-souvenir atmosphere.

prompts.text:
9:16 vertical, ultra-realistic portrait photography, 90s Japanese magazine lifestyle snapshot / Korean Instagram candid everyday style, POV from inside a supermarket freezer case, light vintage Leica 35mm film look.
The camera is placed inside a supermarket freezer cabinet, shooting outward from between frozen-food packages and plastic bags, creating a clear subjective POV. The foreground is dominated by naturally defocused frozen-food packaging, plastic-bag edges, white freezer shelves, light frost, and condensation, building a real sense of looking out from inside the freezer. At the frame edges, the freezer door frame and glass reflections are visible, reinforcing spatial realism.
A clearly adult young East Asian woman, about 23–27, with cool-toned fair skin that keeps real texture, fine pores, and slight natural unevenness. Her features have strong classical East Asian recognizability: a small, flowing face shape, a full forehead, soft brow bones, a slender straight nose, slightly elongated almond eyes with naturally extending outer corners (not exaggeratedly upturned), dark pupils, and a cool, quiet gaze; clear lip shape with a natural cupid’s bow and soft mouth corners. The overall presence is not “sweet-girl”; it is slightly cool, restrained, classically beautiful.
Makeup has a light contemporary Chinese-style (guofeng) feel, but stays restrained and natural, as if guofeng elements are only faintly folded into everyday makeup: thin, translucent base that keeps real skin texture; slender brows with a soft classical willow-leaf curve; eye makeup in low-saturation dusty rose and light taupe-gray, with a slight smudge and elongation at the outer corners and a reserved Eastern mood; faint wash and subtle highlight on the lower lids; a very light misty blush swept from under the eyes onto the cheekbones; lips in soft peach-bean-paste or camellia red, no glassy over-gloss. Mid-length black hair falls naturally, smooth with slight volume and flyaways, as if she just went out for the day.
Her figure has a naturally clear pear-shaped proportion: slender shoulders and neck, a defined waist, soft natural hip and leg curves, nothing over-exaggerated. She wears a simple white slim tank top under a loose light-gray or milky-white thin knit cardigan, with a gray fitted long skirt, gray slim midi skirt, or other low-saturation casual bottoms. The outfit is simple and natural, like real 90s Japanese-magazine everyday wear — not deliberately sexy, but atmospheric.
She stands in the frozen-food aisle of a large warehouse/membership supermarket. After opening the freezer door, she leans slightly forward and bends down to look at the products. One hand rests on the freezer door; the other reaches toward the camera, about to pick up or already holding a box of frozen food that caught her interest. Her face is close to the freezer opening, softly lit by the cold white light inside, so her skin looks translucent, cool-pale, and natural. Her gaze is lowered toward the product in her hand or into the freezer; she is not posing into the lens, so it feels accidentally recorded.
Optional extra beat: as she reaches for the item, her eyes briefly graze the camera direction, as if she just noticed a camera inside the freezer. A slight puzzled, curious, or unconsciously cute expression — not exaggerated, not deliberately cute.
Mixed lighting from the freezer interior and supermarket overhead fluorescents. Overall palette: cool white, low saturation, low contrast. Highlights have slight bloom / halation; glass edges and plastic packaging give soft reflections. Add light film grain, slight soft focus, slight highlight blowout, and a cyan-gray cool 90s Japanese-magazine grade. Avoid a heavy modern digital look. It should feel like a Heisei-era magazine lifestyle spread, not an e-commerce ad or studio poster.
Composition emphasis:

camera inside the freezer
foreground = defocused products and frost
subject leaning in from outside the case
freezer door frame and glass reflections visible
voyeuristic / everyday / accidental feeling
subject not perfectly centered; keep a slightly crooked, casually cropped snapshot feel

Overall mood: a beautiful adult East Asian woman with a faint contemporary guofeng air, seriously choosing frozen food in an ordinary supermarket, unexpectedly recorded from inside the freezer. Real, restrained, lived-in, with a touch of 90s Japanese magazine and Korean influencer candid vibe.
Do not: over-posed shots, heavy skin smoothing, HDR, strong commercial lighting, exaggerated expressions, exaggerated sexy poses, text stickers, watermarks, obvious AI look.

prompts.text: 9:16 竖屏，超写实人像摄影，90 年代日式杂志生活快照 / 韩国 Instagram 抓拍日常风格，从超市冷冻柜内部拍摄的视角，轻微复古徕卡 35mm 胶片感。相机放置在超市冷冻柜内，从冷冻食品包装和塑料袋之间向外拍摄，营造出清晰的主观视角。前景由自然虚化的冷冻食品包装、塑料袋边缘、白色冷冻架、轻微的霜和冷凝水占据，营造出一种真实地从冰箱内部向外看的感觉。在画面的边缘，可以看到冷冻柜门框和玻璃反射，增强了空间的真实感。一位显而易见的成年年轻东亚女性，约 23–27 岁，拥有冷色调的白皙皮肤，保留了真实的质感、细微的毛孔和轻微的自然不均。她的五官具有极强的经典东亚辨识度：小巧流动的脸型，饱满的额头，柔和的眉骨，纤细挺直的鼻子，略微拉长的杏仁眼，眼角自然延伸（不过分上扬），深色的瞳孔，以及冷峻、安静的目光；清晰的唇形，带有自然的唇峰和柔软的嘴角。整体气质不是“甜美女孩”；而是略带冷感、克制、古典的美。妆容带有淡淡的现代中式（国风）感，但保持克制和自然，仿佛国风元素只是淡淡地折叠进日常妆容中：轻薄、半透明的底妆，保留真实的皮肤纹理；细长的眉毛，带有柔和的经典柳叶弧度；眼妆采用低饱和度的枯玫瑰色和浅灰褐色，眼角有轻微的晕染和拉长，带有含蓄的东方神韵；下眼睑有淡淡的色彩和细微的高光；眼下扫至颧骨处有极淡的雾面腮红；嘴唇为柔和的蜜桃豆沙色或山茶红，没有镜面感的过分光泽。中长的黑发自然垂下，顺滑但带有轻微的蓬松感和碎发，仿佛她刚出门。她的身材具有自然清晰的梨形比例：纤细的肩膀和脖子，清晰的腰线，柔和自然的臀腿曲线，没有任何夸张之处。她在宽松的浅灰色或奶白色薄针织开衫内穿着简单的白色修身背心，搭配灰色修身长裙、灰色修身中裙或其他低饱和度的休闲下装。穿着简单自然，就像真实的 90 年代日式杂志日常服装——不刻意性感，但很有氛围感。她站在大型仓库式/会员制超市的冷冻食品区。打开冷冻柜门后，她身体略微前倾并弯腰查看商品。一只手搭在冷冻柜门上；另一只手伸向镜头，正准备拿取或已经拿着一盒引起她兴趣的冷冻食品。她的脸靠近冷冻柜开口，被内部冷白的灯光柔和地照亮，使她的皮肤看起来通透、冷白且自然。她的目光向下投向手中的产品或冷冻柜内部；她没有对着镜头摆姿势，因此感觉像是被意外记录下来的。可选额外细节：当她伸手拿东西时，她的眼睛短暂地扫过镜头方向，仿佛她刚注意到冷冻柜里的相机。一个轻微的困惑、好奇或不自觉的可爱表情——不夸张，不刻意卖萌。冷冻柜内部和超市头顶荧光灯的混合照明。整体色调：冷白、低饱和度、低对比度。高光有轻微的弥散 / 光晕效果；玻璃边缘和塑料包装产生柔和的反射。添加轻微的胶片颗粒、轻微的柔焦、轻微的高光溢出，以及青灰色调的冷感 90 年代日式杂志色调。避免沉重的现代数字感。它应该感觉像平成时代的杂志生活版面，而不是电子商务广告或工作室海报。构图重点：相机在冷冻柜内；前景 = 虚化的产品和霜；主体从柜外探身进来；冷冻柜门框和玻璃反射可见；窥视感 / 日常 / 偶然感；主体不完全居中，保持一种略显歪斜、随意的裁剪快照感。整体氛围：一位美丽的成年东亚女性，带着淡淡的现代国风气息，在平凡的超市里认真挑选冷冻食品，被从冷冻柜内部意外记录下来。真实、克制、生活化，带有一点 90 年代日式杂志和韩国博主抓拍的氛围。不要：过度摆拍、重度磨皮、HDR、强烈的商业照明、夸张的表情、夸张的性感姿势、文字贴纸、水印、明显的 AI 感。

prompts.text:
Hyper-realistic backstage makeup room portrait, vertical ratio approximately 3:4, a clearly adult East Asian female, 20+, sitting on a gray low-back swivel office chair, body slightly leaning to the left of the frame, legs crossed significantly in front, overall with a realistic studio snapshot feel. Using an approximately 28–35mm equivalent lens, the photographer is located directly in front of the subject slightly to the right, camera position near waist height and slightly tilted down, the subject is captured completely from the top of the head to the high heels, background dressing table and windows remain clear, do not have strong depth-of-field blurring.

The subject has a small to medium frame, naturally slender hourglass figure, slightly narrow shoulders, cinched waist, long thighs with realistic soft volume, and slender calves. Do not have athletic muscles, extreme wide hips, or exaggerated body proportions.

The subject's sitting posture is key: hips resting against the middle and back of the chair, one leg crossed high over the other forming a tight cross, the raised thigh angling toward the center of the frame, occupying a significant foreground; the lower supporting leg extends toward the bottom right of the frame. The upper body leans back slightly, shoulders relaxed. The left hand hangs naturally at the side of the chair, and the right hand holds a large black makeup brush near the cheek, as if touching up makeup or just having stopped the motion. The head is tilted back slightly and turned toward the lens, eyes looking at the photographer, lips slightly parted, expression cold and calm.

The subject has deep brownish-black medium-long straight hair, length near the chest, center-parted slightly to the side, hair strands straight and natural, with a small amount of stray hair near the ears. Makeup is exquisite but realistic studio makeup: skin tone fair and leaning neutral, slender eyeliner, clear eyelashes, light pink blush, lips a low-saturation bean paste red / nude pink. Wearing a very thin gold necklace + a small black four-leaf clover/round pendant around the neck.

Wearing a pure black slim-fit tank top / tight dress inner layer, layered with a black loose-fitting suit jacket, the suit shoulder line is natural, sleeves are long, overall matte black. The clothes have no obvious logos or complex decorations, style is professional, minimalist, and sharp.

The legs are wearing very crucial smoky black / deep gray-brown ultra-thin translucent pantyhose, approximately 10–15D, which can clearly reveal the natural skin tone. The surface of the stockings has a soft silk luster and carries a light gray-white thin vertical seam line, extending longitudinally along the leg from the thigh, forming a very obvious vintage seamed stocking effect. Do not have thick black stockings, fishnets, or bare legs.

Feet wearing black pointed-toe slingback pumps, the upper material is black leather or slightly glossy, the toe has a prominent silver metal pointed toe cap, the heel is a stiletto heel, approximately 7–9cm. Both the heel and the toe are completely visible.

The scene is a real commercial photography / makeup backstage workroom. To the back right of the subject is a large black work table, with a large amount of makeup supplies placed very messily on it: brush holders, foundation, eyeshadow palettes, lipsticks, tissues, storage boxes, black makeup bags, silver makeup cases, and disposable coffee cups. Behind is a professional makeup mirror with round bulbs, white bulbs on the left and right sides lit up, partial reflections of the person and the room can be seen in the mirror.

A computer monitor is placed on the left side of the table, the screen displaying a dark software interface and blue windows, with a keyboard, mouse, and wires below. On the left side of the background, photography equipment, black bags, and a small amount of clutter can also be seen; the whole is an in-use workspace, not a tidy studio.

Above the background is a full wall of oversized floor-to-ceiling windows, outside the windows high-rise residential buildings, trees, and a gray-white sky can be seen, daytime natural light enters from the window. The left wall has white wall cabinets, curtains are gray pleated fabric. The floor is covered with deep gray office carpet.

Lighting uses large-area overcast window light + makeup mirror bulb fill light, details of the person's face, legs, and black clothing are clear, skin naturally leaning cool white; stockings have a soft reflection but are not overexposed. Overall color temperature is neutral leaning cool, the background is realistic and not deliberately beautified.

The overall quality is that of a high-quality phone / wide-angle camera backstage snapshot: natural sharpness, slight wide-angle perspective, real skin texture, light HDR, rich background details, the frame has a slight sense of work-site clutter, do not have the excessive cleanliness of a commercial studio shoot.

Key lock-in: Adult East Asian female + gray swivel chair sitting posture + high-positioned crossed legs + black suit + black slim inner wear + smoky black ultra-thin pantyhose + light-colored longitudinal seam line + black silver-tipped slingback stiletto heels + right hand holding makeup brush near face + large makeup mirror bulbs + messy professional makeup table + computer monitor + large floor-to-ceiling window + backstage studio snapshot feel.

Avoid: Long curly hair, high ponytail, white clothing, short skirts pleated skirts, thick black stockings, fishnets, over-the-knee socks, sneakers, chunky heels, legs side-by-side, standing posture, extreme background blur, pure white studio, luxury hotel, strong flash, plastic skin, anime face, CG feel, watermarks and garbled text.

prompts.text:
Create a vertical split-style image. The entire canvas is strictly vertically arranged, with the top and bottom halves precisely 1:1 in height, forming a clear and complete vertical visual contrast relationship.

Top half:
Directly present the original image uploaded by the user, treating the original image as the sole primary reference source. Focus on preserving the core subjects such as people, pets, or animals from the original image, prioritizing the extraction of the subject's facial features, hairstyle or fur characteristics, facial features, expressions, postures, clothing, accessories, body contours, and overall temperament.
If buildings, indoor environments, street scenes, furniture, landscapes, etc., appear in the original image, these are not the primary objects of expression and only exist as weakened auxiliary backgrounds.
The top half as a whole maintains a sense of real photography, natural lighting, and original shooting atmosphere, making it obvious at a glance that this is the original reference image itself; do not make the top half into an illustration or a stylized redraw.

Bottom half:
Reconstruct the same person/same pet/same animal subject from the top half into a black and white ink line drawing.
Highlight the most recognizable features of the subject, not mechanically copying photo details, but preserving the most identifiable face shape, silhouette, posture, expression, action relationship, and identity temperament.
The overall style adopts the 2D animation aesthetics of the 1970s, emphasizing bold and rhythmic high-contrast outlines, sharp and clear line art, minimalist but hierarchically varied line width control, and the graphic language of old animation clean-up drawings.
The image uses a high-key composition and adds a pure white backing around the subject or in local areas to make the subject emerge more clearly from the background.
Only black and white are allowed; do not add shadows, colors, grayscale, or midtones; do not do sketch-like light and shadow modeling, and do not add color accents.
The bottom half does not pursue complex environmental depiction but instead forms a black and white visual effect with a sense of era, graphics, and animation through the weight, density, and generalization of outlines.
If the original subject is a person, highlight the expression, hairstyle, movement, and clothing silhouette; if it is a pet or animal, highlight the ears, fur edges, eyes, posture, and rhythm of movement.
The overall effect should make people clearly feel: the top is the real original image, and the bottom is the same subject translated into a 1970s black and white animation ink line image.

Overall requirements:
There must be a clear correspondence between the top and bottom parts, ensuring the bottom part is instantly recognizable as a stylized translation of the subject in the top part.
The image should be clean, restrained, and designed, without generating redundant text, logos, or watermarks; no irrelevant subjects should appear, and buildings or background elements should not seize the visual center.

上半部分：
直接呈现用户上传的原图，将原图视为唯一主体参考来源。重点保留原图中的人物、宠物、动物等核心主体，优先提取主体的脸部特征、发型或毛发特征、五官、神态、动作、服装、配饰、体型轮廓与整体气质。

上半部分整体保持真实照片感、自然光感和原始拍摄氛围，让人一眼看出这是原始参考图本身，不要将上半部分也做成插画或风格化重绘。

下半部分：
将上半部分中的同一人物 / 同一宠物 / 同一动物主体重构为一张黑白墨线画。
突出主体最具辨识度的特征，不机械照搬照片细节，而是保留最有识别性的脸型、轮廓、姿态、表情、动作关系和身份气质。
整体采用二十世纪七十年代二维动画美学，强调粗犷而富有节奏感的高对比轮廓、锐利清晰的线稿、极简但有层级变化的线宽控制，以及老动画清稿式的图形语言。
画面采用高调构图，并在主体周围或局部区域加入纯白衬底，使主体从背景中更清晰地浮现出来。
只允许使用黑白两色，不得添加阴影、颜色、灰度或中间调，不要做素描式明暗塑造，也不要加入彩色点缀。
下半部分不追求复杂环境刻画，而是通过线条的轻重、疏密和轮廓的概括，形成具有年代感、图形感和动画感的黑白视觉效果。

整体效果要让人明显感受到：上方是真实原图，下方是同一主体被转译成七十年代黑白动画墨线形象。

整体要求：
上下两部分之间必须存在明确呼应关系，保证下半部分一眼就能识别出是上半部分主体的风格化转译。

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 vertical poster series in English with a high-end editorial visual style, combining brutalist architecture, monumental perspective typography, realistic young adult figures, and strong three-dimensional spatial design. The series should feel bold, clean, architectural, and visually sophisticated, with a deep cobalt-blue sky, warm raw-concrete gray, warm ivory typography, charcoal styling for the figures, and safety orange as the only strong accent color.

Use dramatic low-angle perspectives so the architecture, typography, human figure, and spatial structures all belong to the same perspective system. Keep the buildings monumental, simple, and geometric. Typography should be oversized, tall, condensed, and integrated into the composition rather than floating as flat overlay text. Human figures should look realistic, naturally posed, and scaled against the architecture. Add clean editorial microcopy, secondary headlines, and small annotations with strong hierarchy and controlled information density.

Poster 1: TYPE VOID
Create a monumental concrete wall with the word “VOID” carved completely through the structure as real architectural openings. The inner surfaces of the carved letters should be safety orange, revealing strong physical depth. A realistic young man stands or steps naturally within the D-shaped opening. Place the word “TYPE” in giant warm-ivory perspective typography across the sky. Add secondary text such as “WORDS BECOME OPENINGS”, “STEP THROUGH”, and “POSITIVE / NEGATIVE”. The image should feel architectural, clear, and conceptually striking.

Poster 2: SHIFT FRAME
Create a dramatic low-angle view of offset brutalist concrete platforms with a realistic young woman seated near the edge. Surround and intersect her with a rotated semi-transparent orange spatial frame that has visible depth and thin ivory structural edges. Place the main title “SHIFT FRAME” across the sky in huge perspective typography. Add secondary text such as “OFF AXIS”, “MOVE THE GRID”, and “BETWEEN PLANES”. The image should feel bold, layered, and spatially dynamic.

Poster 3: TYPE DEPTH
Create a brutalist concrete setting where the word “TYPE” becomes giant three-dimensional extruded letterforms with warm-ivory faces and orange side depth. A realistic young woman moves naturally through or between the letters, making the typography feel inhabitable. Place the word “DEPTH” farther back in perspective in the sky. Add secondary text such as “WORDS HAVE WEIGHT”, “STEP INSIDE”, and “TYPE IN SPACE”. The image should clearly show typography turning into physical space.

Poster 4: FLOAT LEVEL
Create two large offset concrete slabs with a realistic young man walking along the upper level. Add two separated translucent spatial planes, one larger and smoky behind him and one smaller orange plane in front, as if a box has been pulled apart into layers. Place the main title “FLOAT LEVEL” in huge perspective typography across the sky. Add secondary text such as “BETWEEN PLANES”, “NO FIXED GROUND”, and “OFFSET HEIGHT”. The image should feel open, suspended, and layered.

All four posters should belong to the same visual family while each one explores a different relationship between architecture, typography, human scale, and three-dimensional spatial intervention.

她穿着一件淡粉蓝色的丝绸缎面女仆风格时尚连衣裙，配有合身的褶皱紧身胸衣、柔和曲线的领口、宽大的褶皱肩带和精致的淡蓝色滚边。领口中心装饰着一个小巧的粉色缎面蝴蝶结。短裙有多个轻盈的层叠：一件粉蓝色的缎面外裙、白色欧根纱衬裙和柔和的褶皱边。正面覆盖着一块配套的蓝色围裙板，上面装饰着淡粉色的刺绣心形徽章和细微的装饰缝线。这套服装给人一种精致、奇幻且具有时尚社论感的印象，拥有高级缎面的光泽和真实的层叠结构。

她的右臂举在额头旁，手肘向外弯曲。她张开的掌心面对相机，松散地框住脸部的上半部分，五根手指自然分开，留着长长的杏仁状裸粉色指甲。另一只手放在腰部附近，拿着一个插在白色短棒上的半透明绿色心形棒棒糖。一条精细的金链手镯环绕在她抬起的手腕上。她的双腿并拢，膝盖放松，赤脚自然地踩在地毯上，脚趾甲涂成了深色。

她站在一块醒目的奶油色与黑色相间的地毯上，地毯上布满了扫过的不规则同心线，在俯拍构图中形成了图形化的背景。在她身后是一个模糊的现代感卧室，有一个高大的圆形全身镜、一个窄窄的深色展示架、一个亮黑色的圆形边几和一盏温暖的奶油色灯罩台灯。深色家具和温暖的环境光与浅蓝色的服装和白皙的皮肤形成了对比。

来自床头灯的温暖钨丝灯光与来自相机上方的柔和正面美容光混合在一起。光线产生了细腻的肤色、柔和的面部阴影、缎面褶皱上的亮泽高光，以及向房间角落自然衰减的温暖电影感暗角。背景保持昏暗且柔和虚化，而她的眼睛、脸部、抬起的手、辫子和连衣裙依然清晰可辨。

使用全画幅相机和 24mm 广角镜头从陡峭的俯视角度拍摄，相机距离近，广角畸变受控，眼睛焦点清晰，背景景深浅，边缘轻微柔和，高光微弱晕染，以及一种梦幻的室内色调。

超写实摄影。真实的人类皮肤纹理，可见毛孔、细微绒毛、细微色调变化、自然的眼下细节、轻微的真实瑕疵，以及脸颊、鼻子、耳朵、肩膀、手和脚上的柔和次表面散射。眼睛带有真实的水分、立体虹膜图案和柔和的高光。头发根根分明，有写实的碎发、婴儿毛、单根高光和自然的辫子纹理。缎面和欧根纱渲染出真实的织物纹理、层叠的半透明感、缝线、垂坠感、折痕和克制的高光反射。解剖结构准确的手和脚，有自然的关节，每只手五根手指，每只脚五个脚趾，写实的指甲和可信的透视。细腻的模拟胶片颗粒感，柔和的镜头暗角，温暖的阴影，柔和的高光，触手可及的织物细节，奇幻的优雅感，以及令人信服的摄影写实主义。

items.title: 现代东方编辑美学文化活动海报

prompts.text:
【Theme / Event Name】
【Main Color Gamut】
【Micro Scene】
【Cultural Elements】
【Title Text】
【Auxiliary Information】
【Aspect Ratio】

Design a cultural event poster with modern Oriental editorial aesthetics. The core visual adopts a composition of "Large Color Gamut + Micro Scene" and incorporates obvious but restrained paper collage and watercolor material language.

The image uses large areas of low-saturation color blocks as the primary visual subject, using 【Main Color Gamut】 to establish a strong and complete large-scale relationship. Color blocks can constitute abstract spaces such as mountain ranges, waterfronts, courtyards, workshops, kites, or dyed cloth through tearing paper, layering, blocking, enclosing, interleaving, hanging, diagonal extension, or white negative space, but do not draw them directly as ordinary realistic scenes. From a distance, a clear large-color-gamut composition is seen first, and it still has obvious recognition in thumbnail status.

All color blocks have rich and realistic textures of handmade paper, watercolor pulp, and mineral pigments, with visible natural paper fibers, pigment deposition, slight indentations, rubbings, natural shade variations, and irregular torn paper edges. The material is delicate and rich but remains clean and complete, without being dirty, old, having yellow spots, severe damage, strong grain, or cheap retro filters. The overall presentation is matte, natural, and has a breathable paper-like tactile feel.

Between the large areas of color gamut, add a 【Micro Scene】 that is very small in scale but complete in content. Characters and props overall account for only about 2%–5% of the screen. Characters are truly doing something, rather than posing for a photo. Tell a small story through actions, objects, and spatial relationships, such as flying, playing the qin, drinking tea, rubbing, drying books, dyeing cloth, or making pottery. Character clothing is natural and restrained, unified with the overall cultural theme, and does not grab the primary vision of the large color gamut.

The micro scene can include a small amount of 【Cultural Elements】, but control the quantity and information density. Props are naturally scattered or participate in character actions, not product displays, and do not crowd the screen. A very small area of warm-colored nodes, vermillion marks, lights, the moon, or object colors can be set as the finishing touch, usually controlled at 1%–3% of the screen.

The typography adopts restrained Oriental editorial design language. The main title 【Title Text】 uses exquisite Chinese Songti, Mingti, or modern fonts with a sense of publication. The font size should not be too large, maintaining sufficient white space, making the text the second visual level rather than overpowering the screen with huge Typography. Auxiliary English, dates, locations, and event information use smaller font sizes to form a clear information hierarchy. All text must have real meaning, do not use meaningless placeholders such as RANDOM, DESIGN, ART, STUDIO, etc.

The composition avoids mechanical centering and regular PPT grids, prioritizing asymmetrical layouts, large areas of white space, color block misalignment, front-and-back blocking, and density contrast. Let the image form a reading experience of "simple from a distance with large shapes; material, scenes, and stories upon close inspection".

The overall style should present a visual effect of merging modern Oriental cultural posters, paper collage, watercolor textures, editorial design, and micro-narratives, which is high-end, natural, restrained, and has a cultural temperament, while possessing the completeness of a real professional poster.

Avoid: book cover déjà vu, huge titles, traditional ink painting, ordinary national style illustrations, realistic photography backgrounds, PPT-style layout, commercial advertising feel, stacking of elements, over-decoration, dirty and old paper, random noise, plastic feel, 3D CGI, glass materials, neon colors, logos, watermarks, numbering, starlight decorations.

prompts.text:
【主题 / 活动名称】
【主色域】
【微场景】
【文化元素】
【标题文字】
【辅助信息】
【画幅比例】

设计一张具有现代东方编辑美学的文化活动海报，核心视觉采用「大色域 + 微场景」的构成方式，并加入明显但克制的纸本拼贴与水彩材质语言。

画面以大面积低饱和色块作为第一视觉主体，使用【主色域】建立强烈、完整的大形关系。色块可以通过撕纸、叠层、遮挡、围合、穿插、悬挂、斜向延伸或留白负空间构成山势、水岸、庭院、工坊、纸鸢、染布等抽象空间，但不要直接画成普通写实场景。远看首先看到清晰的大色域构图，缩略图状态下仍具有明显识别度。

所有色块具有丰富真实的手工纸、水彩纸浆和矿物颜料质感，可见天然纸纤维、颜料沉积、轻微压痕、擦印、自然浓淡变化与不规则撕纸边缘。材质细腻丰富但保持干净完整，不做脏旧、黄斑、严重破损、强颗粒或廉价复古滤镜。整体呈现哑光、自然、有呼吸感的纸本触觉。

在大片色域之间加入一个尺度非常小但内容完整的【微场景】。人物与道具整体只占画面约 2%–5%，人物正在真实地做一件事情，而不是站立摆拍。通过动作、器物和空间关系讲清一个小故事，例如放飞、弹琴、饮茶、拓印、晒书、染布、制陶等。人物服装自然克制，与整体文化主题统一，不抢夺大色域的第一视觉。

微场景可以加入少量【文化元素】，但控制数量和信息密度。道具自然散落或参与人物动作，不做商品陈列，不堆满画面。可以设置一个面积很小的暖色节点、朱红印记、灯火、月亮或器物色彩作为点睛，通常控制在画面 1%–3%。

排版采用克制的东方编辑设计语言。主标题【标题文字】使用精致的中文宋体、明朝体或具有出版感的现代字体，字号不要过大，保持充足留白，让文字成为第二视觉层级，而不是用巨大 Typography 压住画面。辅助英文、日期、地点和活动信息采用更小字号，形成清楚的信息层级。所有文字必须有真实意义，不使用 RANDOM、DESIGN、ART、STUDIO 等无意义占位词。

构图避免机械居中和规则 PPT 网格，优先使用不对称布局、大面积留白、色块错位、前后遮挡和疏密反差。让画面形成“远看简洁、有大形；近看有材质、有场景、有故事”的阅读体验。

整体风格应呈现现代东方文化海报、纸本拼贴、水彩材质、编辑设计与微型叙事融合的视觉效果，高级、自然、克制、有文化气质，同时具备真实专业海报的完成度。

避免：书籍封面既视感、巨大标题、传统水墨画、普通国风插画、写实摄影背景、PPT式排版、商业广告感、元素堆砌、过度装饰、脏旧纸张、随机噪点、塑料感、3D CGI、玻璃材质、霓虹色、Logo、水印、编号、星芒装饰。

items.title: 竖版双拼原图转三维厚涂微景观插画

prompts.text:
Create a vertical split-style image. The entire canvas is strictly vertically arranged, with the top half and bottom half heights accurately at 1:1, forming a clear split structure of "original photo × style translation."

Top half:
Directly display the original photo uploaded by the user and treat it as the unique source of subject reference.
The top half focuses on preserving core subjects such as people, pets, or animals from the original photo, retaining their most recognizable facial features, fur or hair color, posture, actions, clothing, accessories, expressions, and overall temperament.
Architecture, street scenes, interior structures, furniture, background decorations, etc., should not be the main subjects but exist only as auxiliary environments and can be appropriately weakened.
Maintain an overall realistic photo texture, natural lighting, and original shooting atmosphere, clearly showing that this is the original reference photo before style translation.

Bottom half:
Extract the most recognizable subjects, outlines, postures, and narrative relationships from the top photo, and reconstruct them into a 3D impasto oil painting style micro-landscape illustration poster.
Do not mechanically replicate the photo, but transform the subject into an exquisite, three-dimensional, touchable miniature landscape, reshaped with thick brushstrokes, color layering, and a sculpture-like sense of volume; preserve the core identity and key characteristics of the subject while moderately optimizing angles, proportions, and details to make it more suitable for a micro-landscape presentation.
The priority for the subject is the person, pet, or animal itself, not based on architectural style, and do not make buildings, furniture, or environments the main visual center.

The composition uses large areas of negative space + a centered or slightly off-center diagonal main axis. On a bright white textured paper surface, a touch of clear impasto color band related to the theme of the original photo supports the subject. This color band can be transformed into water, ground, paths, light bands, or abstract landscape slices; the subject interacts naturally with the color band, and reflections, ripples, light spots, or extended brushstrokes are added according to the content. The background retains only a small amount of impasto clouds, sun, mist, or natural imagery related to the subject's mood, forming a light and poetic spatial layer.

The painting language emphasizes impasto oil painting × miniature entity × clear light sense. Preserve obvious pigment accumulation, palette knife marks, undulating edges, paper texture, and a semi-manual sculpting feel; impasto is concentrated on water surfaces, clouds, color bands, and local highlights, making the subject both exquisite and three-dimensional, while having the material feel of real oil paint.

The color scheme extracts the brightest, most vivid, and most vital colors from the uploaded original photo for modulation, rather than average color sampling. Overall increase brightness and color purity, using clear sky blue, lake cyan, tender green, warm yellow, coral orange, peach pink, and other bright hues naturally derived from the original photo, forming a healing sense through refreshing warm and cold relationships. Use a large amount of pure warm white as breathing space, the main colors are distinct but not dazzling, and local warm orange, golden yellow, or pink can serve as sun-like highlight colors, giving the picture a sunny, vivid, warm, light, and vital color spirit. Avoid grayish, old, low-spirited Morandi-fication, dark brown filters, fluorescent colors, and cheap candy feel.

Minimal text intervention. A short title can be refined from the identity, emotion, or symbolic meaning of the subject in the photo, paired with a very small amount of subtext, numbers, or miniature notes. The text remains detailed, restrained, with ample white space, and can be cleverly arranged along the diagonal main axis, the edge of the subject, or large areas of blank space, like exquisite annotations in an art publication.

The overall presentation features a bright white background, vivid impasto, clear colors, miniature subjects, large areas of white space, and warm light, collectively forming a high-end healing temperament. Whether the subject in the top half is a person, pet, or animal, the bottom half should maintain a clear identity and vivid colors, avoiding grayish, dull, cartoon toy-like, plastic computer rendering feel, e-commerce feel, and template feel.

Overall requirements:
The bottom half must allow someone to recognize at a glance that it is a stylized reconstruction of the same subject in the top half.
Do not make scene architecture the protagonist, do not generate irrelevant second subjects, do not let the style relationship between the top and bottom parts break, and do not include unnecessary watermarks, logos, or long explanatory texts.

prompts.text:
创作一张竖版上下双拼风格图像，整张画布严格纵向排版，上半部分与下半部分高度精准 1:1，形成“原始照片 × 风格转译”的清晰双拼结构。

上半部分：
直接展示用户上传的原图，并将其视为唯一主体参考来源。
上半部分重点保留原图中的人物、宠物、动物等核心主体，保留其最具识别性的脸部特征、毛色或发色、姿态、动作、服装、配饰、神态和整体气质。
建筑、街景、室内结构、家具、背景装饰等内容不要作为主要主体，只作为辅助环境存在，且可以适度弱化。
整体保持真实照片质感、自然光线与原始拍摄氛围，明确让人看出这是风格转译前的原始参考图。

下半部分：
从上半部分照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为一张 三维厚涂油画风格的微景观插画海报。
不要机械复刻照片，而是将主体转化为精致、立体、可触摸的微缩景观，以厚涂笔触、色彩堆叠和雕塑般的体积感重新塑造；保留主体核心身份和关键特征，同时适度优化角度、比例与细节，使其更适合微景观式呈现。
主体优先是人物、宠物或动物本身，不以建筑风格为主，不把建筑、家具或环境做成主视觉中心。

构图采用大面积留白 + 居中或轻微偏心的斜向主轴。在明亮白色纹理纸面上，以一抹与原图主题相关的清透厚涂色带承托主体，这条色带可以转化为水面、地面、路径、光带或抽象风景切片；主体与色带自然交互，并根据内容加入倒影、波纹、光斑或延展笔触。背景仅保留少量厚涂云层、太阳、雾气或与主体情绪相关的自然意象，形成轻盈而富有诗意的空间层次。

绘画语言强调厚涂油画 × 微缩实体 × 清透光感。保留明显的颜料堆积、刮刀痕迹、起伏边缘、纸张纹理和半手工塑形感；厚涂集中在水面、云层、色带与局部高光，让主体既精致立体，又具有真实油彩的物质感。

配色从上传原图中提取最明亮、最鲜活、最有生命力的颜色重新调制，而不是平均取色。整体提高明度与色彩纯净度，采用清澈天空蓝、湖水青、嫩绿、暖黄、珊瑚橙、桃粉等由原图自然推导出的明快色相，通过清爽冷暖关系形成治愈感。以大量纯净暖白作为呼吸空间，主色鲜明但不刺眼，局部暖橙、金黄或粉红可作为阳光般的点睛色，使画面具有晴朗、鲜活、温暖、轻快、有生命力的色彩精神。避免灰脏、发旧、低沉莫兰迪化、暗褐滤镜、荧光色和廉价糖果感。

文字少量介入。可从照片中主体的身份、情绪或象征意义中提炼一个简短标题，并搭配极少量副文、编号或微型注释。文字保持细致、克制、留白充足，可沿斜向主轴、主体边缘或大面积空白巧妙排布，像艺术出版物中的精致标注。

整体呈现 明亮白底、鲜活厚涂、清透色彩、微缩主体、大面积留白与温暖光感 共同构成的高级治愈气质。
无论上半部分主体是人物、宠物还是动物，下半部分都应保持清晰身份与鲜活色彩，避免灰脏、沉闷、卡通玩具感、塑料感电脑渲染感、电商感和模板感。

整体要求：
下半部分必须让人一眼认出是上半部分同一主体的风格化重构。
不要把场景建筑做成主角，不要生成无关第二主体，不要让上下两部分风格关系断裂，不要多余水印、Logo 或解释性大段文字。

items.title: 夜景阳台黑色蕾丝羽毛女性

prompts.text:
Theme:
Black feathers in night view

Subject:
On a night balcony facing tall buildings, an adult woman wearing black lace clothing and a feather robe, back to the camera, portrait photo. The character is positioned based on the center of the frame.

Character·Expression:
Dark brown hair tied high in a casual bun, thin front bangs and stray hairs. Slender oval contour, elongated brown eyes, natural eyebrows, small nose, glossy peach lips. Looking directly at the camera from behind the shoulder. Face turned toward the camera from behind the shoulder. Calm expression.

Clothing·Pose:
Black see-through lace bra and thin straps, black thin-strap lace bottom. Long black feather robe slipped down to the elbows, hanging on both arms. Back to the camera in front of the railing, waist slightly twisted. Black swimwear.

Background·Lighting:
Black metal railing, road lights below feet, dense high-rise buildings and dim night sky. Frontal flash illuminates the character and black feathers, city lights show fine pearly bokeh. The main light source for the background is hard light shining directly from the front of the camera.

Composition·Camera:
4:5 portrait composition, camera shooting from a close-up rear diagonally above for a photo above the legs. Place the character in the right center, night view expanding towards the top left, largely featuring the open back and feather robe. Focus on the face and black lace. The character occupies most of the frame, focus concentrated on the protagonist, background slightly blurred.

Texture·Style:
Photorealistic night flash photo. Capturing black lace, thin straps, light-absorbing feathers, skin gloss, and distant streetlights with high contrast.

Negative Prompt:
Must not omit the black lace on the back and the feather robe on both arms

prompts.text:
主题：
夜景的黑羽毛

主体：
面向高楼的夜间阳台上，成年女性身着黑色蕾丝服装和羽毛长袍，背对镜头，纵向照片。人物以画面中央为基准配置。

人物·表情：
浓茶色的头发高高盘成随意丸子头，薄薄的前刘海和后逸发丝。细长的卵形轮廓，横长的褐色眼睛，自然的眉毛，小巧的鼻子，富有光泽的桃色嘴唇。从肩后直视镜头。脸从肩后转向镜头。平静的表情。

黑色透视蕾丝胸罩和细细的背带，黑色细带蕾丝下装。黑色长羽毛长袍滑落到肘部，挂在双臂上。在栏杆前背对镜头，腰部微微扭转。黑色泳装。

prompts.text:

The figure has a small-to-medium frame, natural voluptuous hourglass figure, narrow shoulders, significantly full chest, very slender waist, rounded hips, and soft realistic volume in the thighs. The overall focus is on the full upper body + distinctly thin waist + natural hip and waist curves; no body-building muscles, wide shoulders/thick back, extreme giant hips, or paper-thin proportions.

The figure's pose involves a slight hip tilt, with one leg as the supporting leg and the other naturally relaxed forward. The upper body tilts slightly towards the right side of the frame, the head tilts gently to one side, chin slightly tucked, eyes looking directly at the camera, with a quiet, soft, and slightly cool expression. The left hand hangs naturally near the skirt hem and gently lifts one side of the skirt; the other hand hangs naturally behind the side of the body.

The figure has dark brown-black medium-length hair, loosely tied at the back of the head into a low bun / low ponytail, with thin wispy bangs on the forehead and many natural stray hairs against the cheeks and neck; the hairstyle is slightly loose and messy. The face shape is small and somewhat oval, skin tone is fair and slightly pinkish, eye makeup is soft, eyelashes are clear, the bridge of the nose is small, and the lips are low-saturation pink. Wearing a very thin silver necklace with a small cross / slender pendant in the center.

The figure wears a pure white off-shoulder tight asymmetric lace dress. The upper part is a low-cut sweetheart bodice structure + semi-off-shoulder short sleeves, shoulders and collarbones fully exposed, with small white lace ruffles at the cuffs. The chest features an obvious white criss-cross lace-up / corset design, extending downward from the center of the chest, forming a fine X-shaped lacing structure.

The dress body fits very tightly from under the chest to the waist, with slight corset-style boning and longitudinal stitching, clearly outlining the slender waistline. The hem is an asymmetric high-low hem; the left thigh position of the figure is significantly shorter, while the right skirt panel extends down to near the calf, forming soft draped layers.

The left side of the skirt has a very high side slit / panel opening, revealing a layer of white semi-transparent floral lace mesh underneath; the lace has fine flower and vine textures, allowing some thigh skin tone to show through. The outer white skirt edge is soft and thin, with a few natural folds and lace details. The overall fabric is mainly matte stretch cloth + tulle lace; no shiny satin or heavy wedding dress materials.

The background is very simple: light gray-white walls, light gray-brown wood floors, with only a small part of white bedding / corner of a quilt showing in the bottom left corner of the frame, and a dark vertical mirror frame or door frame may appear on the right edge. No complex furniture or decorations.

The lighting uses large areas of soft natural window light + slight overexposure effect. The figure's face, neck, shoulders, chest, and white dress are wrapped in soft light, the skin tone is creamy white, and shadows are very shallow. The overall image is high-key, low-contrast, and slightly atomized; the white walls and parts of the dress are near overexposure but still retain lace and fold details.

The overall style is Japanese-style soft-light portrait / slight old digital camera soft-focus texture: slightly hazy, low sharpness, soft highlights, pale pink skin tone, a bit of airiness; no strong HDR, no sharp commercial studio feel.

Key focus: Adult East Asian female + loose low bun + wispy bangs + voluptuous hourglass figure + pure white off-shoulder low-cut sweetheart dress + white criss-cross lacing on chest + extremely thin waist + asymmetric high-low hem + high slit on one side + white semi-transparent floral lace paneling + one hand gently lifting the skirt + light gray-white wall + soft overexposed window light + hazy Japanese portrait feel.

Avoid: Black dress, colored dress, long sleeves, ordinary camisole dress, no chest lacing, symmetrical hem, no lace slit, long straight loose hair, high ponytail, body-builder physique, wide shoulders, thick waist, extreme giant hips, luxurious interior, strong flash, harsh cinematic lighting, over-sharpening, plastic skin, anime face, CG feel, watermarks, and garbled text.

items.title: 文化质感与自然秩序的信息视觉艺术

prompts.text:
Create an informational visual work with a high degree of editing consciousness, cultural texture, and visual insight. Do not rush to explain; do not directly translate information into icons, flowcharts, cards, or standard charts. Instead, first understand the time, scale, hierarchy, relationship, density, difference, evolution, contrast, gathering and scattering, and rhythm that truly exist within the content, and let visual forms naturally generate from these relationships.

The entire image should possess a quiet and open order. There are clear connections between elements, yet they retain their independent states of life; some are close, some distant, some towering, some low-lying, some heavy, some light. Do not aim for tidiness for the sake of tidiness, nor deliberately create change for the sake of change. Let scale, position, material, posture, spacing, direction, light and dark, whitespace, and visual weight interact with each other, making the order seem naturally formed rather than forcibly arranged by a template.

Information can be transformed into characters, artifacts, structures, natural forms, architecture, spaces, materials, symbols, text, scenes, abstract shapes, or visual existences that are difficult to categorize simply. What specific form is adopted should be determined by the content itself, without presetting a fixed visual dictionary. Avoid the mechanical logic of "one type of information corresponds to one fixed icon," and avoid repeatedly copying the same shape. Allow different expressions to appear within the same system, as long as they hold true to each other in visual relationships and spiritual temperament.

Let data and information be perceived rather than crudely labeled. Quantity can be manifested through scale, time through extension, importance through visual weight, and relationships through distance, direction, overlap, resonance, or spatial structure. Necessary text, numbers, markers, and guide lines should exist quietly as part of the editorial system, rather than dominating the image.

Maintain a large amount of effective whitespace, letting the blank space become part of the structure. The image should have pauses, transitions, breathing, and space that is not fully explained. Parts can be precise, parts can be relaxed; some information can be seen immediately, while some relationships are allowed to emerge gradually after viewing. Do not say everything at once.

The visual language lies between high-end publications, museum displays, cultural research maps, contemporary information design, still life photography, art direction, and data storytelling, but do not obviously mimic any existing style. Materials, light, fonts, composition, and space should jointly serve the content itself, remaining restrained, accurate, and mature, while possessing a subtle sense of strangeness and discovery.

Do not use rigid grids to dominate everything, do not apply common commercial infographic templates, and do not pursue superficial "sense of technology," "sense of high-end," or decorative complexity. Avoid averageness, symmetry, homogenization, over-regularity, and meaningless visual filling. Allow for contingency, but contingency must be built within the overall judgment; allow for freedom, but freedom always exists within an internal order.

The final work should first attract the viewer with the overall relationship and atmosphere, and then gradually enter the information; from a distance, it forms a complete and distinct visual structure, and upon closer inspection, layers of detail and content logic can be discovered. It is not about decorating information more beautifully, but about letting the content find a form that originally belongs to it.

prompts.text:
创作一幅具有高度编辑意识、文化质感与视觉洞察力的信息视觉作品。不要急于解释，不要把信息直接翻译成图标、流程框、卡片或标准图表，而是先理解内容内部真正存在的时间、尺度、层级、关系、密度、差异、演变、对照、聚散与节奏，让视觉形式从这些关系之中自然生成。

整个画面应拥有一种安静而开放的秩序。元素之间既存在明确联系，又保留各自独立的生命状态；有些靠近，有些疏离，有些高耸，有些低伏，有些厚重，有些轻盈。不要为了整齐而整齐，也不要为了变化而刻意制造变化。让尺度、位置、材质、姿态、间距、方向、明暗、空白以及视觉重量彼此作用，使秩序像自然形成，而不是被模板强行排列。

信息可以转化为人物、器物、结构、自然形态、建筑、空间、材料、符号、文字、场景、抽象形体或难以被简单归类的视觉存在。具体采用什么形式，应由内容自身决定，不预设固定视觉词典。避免“一类信息对应一种固定图标”的机械逻辑，也避免重复复制同一种造型。允许同一体系中出现不同表达方式，只要它们在视觉关系和精神气质上彼此成立。

让数据和信息被感知，而不是被粗暴标注。数量可以通过尺度体现，时间可以通过延展体现，重要性可以通过视觉重量体现，关系可以通过距离、方向、重叠、呼应或空间结构体现。必要的文字、数字、标记与引导线应像编辑系统的一部分安静存在，而不是凌驾于画面之上。

保持大量有效留白，让空白成为结构的一部分。画面要有停顿、转折、呼吸和未被完全解释的空间。局部可以精密，局部可以松弛；某些信息可以立即被看见，某些关系允许观看之后才逐渐浮现。不要把所有意义一次说尽。

视觉语言介于高级出版物、博物馆陈列、文化研究图谱、当代信息设计、静物摄影、艺术指导与数据叙事之间，但不要明显模仿任何一种现成风格。材质、光线、字体、构图和空间应共同服务于内容本身，保持克制、准确、成熟，同时具有细微的陌生感与发现感。

不使用僵硬网格支配一切，不套用常见商业信息图模板，不追求表面上的“科技感”“高级感”或装饰性复杂度。避免平均、对称、同质化、过度规整以及毫无意义的视觉填充。允许偶然性，但偶然必须建立在整体判断之中；允许自由，但自由始终存在内在秩序。

最终作品应让观看者先被整体关系和气息吸引，再逐步进入信息；远看形成完整而鲜明的视觉结构，近看能够发现层层细节与内容逻辑。它不是把信息装饰得更漂亮，而是让内容找到一种原本就属于它自己的形态。
