items.title: 公园树影下持红枫叶的日本女性

prompts.text:
Subject: In a park with dappled tree shadows, a fictional adult Japanese female holds a red maple leaf close to her cheek. Wearing a soft knit sweater, sitting with knees bent to the side, a natural snapshot at a close distance to the camera. Do not make the maple leaf the sole protagonist; depict the woman's expression and the small leaf as the center of the same scene.

Location/Time/Background: A bright daytime picnic on a lawn covered with a cloth. Behind her are slanting tree trunks and a continuous green slope, with fine sunlight filtering through the leaves. Create a sense of space by pulling the checkered cloth in the foreground away from the distant grass and trees, avoiding flattening the background green into a monochromatic wall.

Clothing/Small Items: A cream-colored thick ribbed knit sweater with a wide neckline and long sleeves, paired with a brown and gray plaid skirt. Gently pinch a small reddish-brown maple leaf with fingertips. Depict the knit texture of the cuffs and neckline, the plaid of the skirt, and the hem with different levels of delicacy.

Pose/Fingers/Contact: Upper body leaning slightly forward, with bent knees extending toward the lower right of the frame. The hand on the right side of the frame gently holds the leaf's stem up to the cheek, while the other arm extends toward the lower left. Maintain the contact point between fingers and the leaf, expressing the weight of the knit sleeve naturally falling to the wrist.

Expression/Gaze: Head tilted slightly looking at the camera, a demure smile with closed lips. Combine the upward curve of the corners of the mouth with gentle eye corners to express the soft friendliness of the moment before taking the photo. Do not raise eyebrows excessively or turn it into an intentional big laugh.

Face/Makeup: Soft contours, brown pupils, natural eyebrows, and light brown eye makeup. Cheeks with a light pink tint, lips with soft pink. Maintain small shadows on the bridge of the nose and cheeks; do not paint the face uniformly white. The catchlights in the eyes should be consistent with the direction of the sunlight.

Hair: Dark brown hair reaching the chest. Thin bangs hanging over the forehead, with fine strands flowing to both sides of the face. Only the strands exposed to sunlight slightly show a golden-brown tint, while the inner parts at the neck and knit sweater form heavy shadows.

Light Source: Sunlight through trees and soft light reflected from the lawn. Facial shadows are gentle, with fine sunlight highlights on the hair and shoulders. Unify the projected shadows of the hand, leaf, and cheek in the same light direction, avoiding hard shadows from strong studio flashes.

Colors/Tones: Cream clothing, reddish-brown leaf, dark green background, and brown-gray plaid as the main color scheme. Keep skin at a warm mid-tone; do not over-saturate the red of the leaf. Even in the highlights of the white knit, preserve the bumpy texture of the knitting.

Materials/Fine Textures: Distinguish the fine fuzz of the vertical rib yarn, the weave of the skirt, the veins of the dry leaf, and the small fingernails on the fingertips. Cheeks have demure skin texture, and hair maintains gaps between strands and gloss. The grass in the background is softly blurred with a grainy feel based on distance.

Composition/Lens: A 9:16 vertical composition looking down slightly from a close distance. The center of the face is placed at approximately 35% horizontal and 20% vertical, with the visual center of the chest at approximately 50% horizontal. Place the leaf on the right side of the face and the knees at the lower right, creating depth with the tilt of the head and the diagonal line of the shoulders. Focus on the subject, with the background grass gently blurred.

Image Processing/Finish: Natural photo exposure and moderate local contrast. Selectively sharpen the eyes, edges of the leaf, and knit texture, while keeping background details restrained. Slightly preserve skin spots, avoiding excessive beauty treatment or strong HDR outlines.

Distortion Avoidance/Prohibitions: Maintain one adult female, holding a leaf, sitting in knitwear and a plaid skirt. Do not add extra people, extra fingers, fusion of leaf and hair, distorted knees, text, logos, watermarks, or split screens. Do not replace facial features or clothing colors with different outfits from others.

prompts.text:
被摄主体：
在树影斑驳的公园里，一位虚构的成年日本女性将红色的枫叶贴近脸颊。穿着柔软的针织衫，膝盖向侧弯曲的坐姿，与镜头保持亲近距离的自然一帧照片。不要只把红叶作为主角，而是将女性的表情和小小的叶子描绘成同一场景的中心。

地点・时间・背景：
在铺有布的草坪上度过明亮的白天野餐。背后是倾斜的树干和绿色的斜坡延续，树叶间洒落下细碎的阳光。将前景的格子布向远处的草地和树木拉开距离的空间感，避免将背景的绿色扁平化为单色的墙壁。

服装・小物件：
奶油色的粗肋针织衫拥有宽大的领口和长袖，搭配茶色与灰色的格子裙。用指尖轻轻捏住赤褐色的小枫叶。将袖口、领口的针织纹理、裙子的格子与翻边分别以不同细腻度描绘。

姿势・手指・接触：
上半身微微前倾，弯曲的膝盖向画面右下方延伸而坐。画面右侧的手轻轻握住叶子的叶柄举到脸颊旁，另一只手臂向左下方伸展。保持手指与叶子的接触点，表现出针织袖子自然垂落到手腕的重量感。

表情・视线：
头部微微倾斜看着镜头，嘴唇闭合的矜持微笑。将嘴角上扬的方式与温和的眼角结合，表现出拍照前一刻的柔和亲切感。不要过度抬起眉毛，也不要变成刻意的大笑。

脸部・妆容：
柔和的轮廓，棕色的瞳孔，自然的眉毛和薄棕色的眼部妆容。脸颊带淡粉色，嘴唇留柔和的粉红。保持鼻梁和脸颊的小阴影，不要将脸部均匀涂白，眼中的光点与阳光方向一致。

头发：
垂至胸口的深棕色头发。将薄薄的前发垂在额头，向脸部两侧流淌细束。只有受阳光照射的发束微微透出金棕色，颈部和针织衫处的内侧则形成浓重的阴影。

光源：
透过树木的阳光和草坪反射的柔和光线。脸部的阴影温和，头发和肩膀上有细碎的阳光亮部。将手、叶子、脸颊的投影统一到相同光向，避免添加强烈的摄影棚闪光灯硬影。

颜色・色调：
以奶油色的服装、赤褐色的叶子、深绿的背景、茶灰色的格子作为主要配色。皮肤保持温暖的中调，不要过度鲜艳化叶子的红色。即使是白色针织的亮部，也保留针织的凹凸纹理。

材质・细微质感：
区分竖肋纱线的细小毛羽、裙子的织纹、干燥叶子的叶脉、指尖的小指甲。脸颊有矜持的肌理，头发保留发束间的空隙和光泽。背景的草坪根据距离柔和地模糊颗粒感。

构图・镜头：
近距离稍从上方俯视的竖9:16构图。脸部中心置于横约35%、竖约20%，胸口视觉中心置于横约50%。叶子置于脸部右侧，膝盖置于右下方，用头部倾斜和肩膀的斜线创造纵深感。将焦点对准人物，后方的草坪温和地虚化。

图像处理・完成：
自然的照片曝光和适度局部对比。选择性地锐化眼睛、叶子的边缘、针织纹理，背景细节则保持克制。略微保留皮肤的色斑，避免过度美肌处理或强烈的HDR轮廓。

崩坏回避・禁止：
维持一位成年女性、手持叶子、针织与格子裙的坐姿。不要添加额外人物、多余手指、叶子与头发的融合、扭曲的膝盖、文字、标志、水印、分屏。不要将脸部特征或服装颜色替换为其他人的不同服饰。

items.title: 雪域银凰仙姬东亚女性仙侠电影人像

prompts.text:
Ultra-realistic Oriental Xianxia movie portrait, a clear adult East Asian female over 25 years old, transformed into the Snow Field Silver Phoenix Immortal Maiden, standing on the summit of high-altitude snow-capped mountains and sea of clouds, a fusion of Oriental mythological aesthetics, haute couture fashion, and Xianxia movie conceptual photography.

The character is an exquisite and cold-type Oriental beauty, natural narrow oval face, slender and soft jawline, dark almond eyes, eye tails slightly upturned, slender natural eyebrows, exquisite straight nose bridge, pale coral pink plump lips slightly parted. The expression is quiet, detached, cold and elegant, with the oppression and divinity of a high-status goddess.

Makeup is very light and thin, using a small amount of warm orange-red and light coral eyeshadow around the eyes, with the eye tails slightly deepened, forming a cold-warm contrast with the icy blue snow mountains; real and natural skin, retaining pores, fine vellus hair, and facial natural light and shadow, do not over-smooth the skin.

The character is facing the camera at a two-thirds angle, head slightly tilted back, gaze directly through the lens or slightly above the lens, forming a calm, noble, non-accommodating goddess temperament.

Hairstyle and Silver Phoenix Crown
Thick jet-black ultra-long hair, classical high semi-updo combined with a large amount of loose long hair.
Strong mountain winds blow the hair violently, a large number of black strands flying towards the left, right, and top of the frame, several strands of stray hair crossing the forehead, eyes, nose bridge, and cheeks.
Hair strands cannot be neat, must have random directions, thickness variations, and physical inertia under real wind force.
Top of the head wears a large icy silver phoenix-wing hair crown, wings spreading to the left and right top, merging phoenix feathers, ice crystals, silver branches, and Oriental metal carving.
Several sets of silver thin chains, crystal bead chains, and tassels hang from both sides of the crown, fluttering outward in the strong wind.
A small silver-white teardrop/ice crystal forehead ornament is worn in the center of the forehead.
Slender silver chain pearl earrings are worn on the ears.

Clothing
Wearing a set of extremely high-end moon white + ice silver + ivory white + pearl iridescent Xianxia haute couture gown.
Inner layer is an ivory white silk bandeau/tube dress with soft natural 3D folds at the chest.
Shoulders and arms are covered with a translucent ice-silver organza outer robe.
The surface of the outer robe has a large amount of fine 3D embroidery of silver-white peonies, ice crystal flowers, phoenix feathers, and silver branches.
Petals are not ordinary fabric, but a fusion of metal wire, pearl film, transparent organza, and iridescent materials, reflecting faint light blue, silver white, champagne gold, and pearl pink in the sunlight.
Large transparent sleeves and several ultra-long silk ribbons are swept up by the strong wind, passing through the frame around the person's body.
One hand is naturally raised near the collarbone, slender fingers lightly touching the clothing on the chest, the other arm hidden between the flying ribbons and wide sleeves.

Scene
The character is located on a grand summit of a snow mountain.
Background consists of layered grey-blue snow peaks, glacier ridges, white sea of clouds, and clean icy blue sky.
The snow mountains are far from the character, using shallow depth of field to create soft blurring, keeping only the grand snow mountain silhouettes.
Overall no buildings, palaces, or modern elements, only sky, snow mountains, clouds, and wind.

The most critical 'Foreground'
A large number of wind-blown transparent silk ribbons, iridescent gauze, and silver-white feather-like decorations exist between the lens and the character.
A large piece of ivory white translucent ribbon passes by very close to the lens from the left side of the frame, severely out of focus, forming a huge creamy white foreground.
Another layer of transparent gauze passes horizontally from the top right of the frame.
Below are many warm golden bokeh circles and translucent highlights.
Foreground is allowed to block about 20–35% of the character's body, but cannot cover the eyes and main facial features.
Forming a feeling of the photographer capturing the goddess in an instant through the flying immortal gauze, rather than a common clean studio shoot.

Light
Golden Hour snow mountain sunset light.
The sun is located low behind the character on the left, forming a strong warm golden side backlight.
Cold blue sky + warm golden sunlight forms an obvious cold-warm color temperature contrast.
Sunlight penetrates the transparent ribbons producing creamy golden Bloom, soft Lens Flare, and large-area circular bokeh.
Face exposure is slightly soft and bright, but must retain the real three-dimensional structure of the nose bridge, eye sockets, jaw, and collarbone.
Black hair strands show silver-golden rim light on the edges.
The silver phoenix crown shows sharp but restrained metallic highlights.
Iridescent organza produces weak spectral refraction of pearl white, light blue, light pink, and champagne gold.
The overall frame has a feeling that there is light in the air.

prompts.text:
超写实东方仙侠电影人像，一名明确25岁以上成年东亚女性，化身雪域银凰仙姬，站在高海拔雪山云海之巅，东方神话美学、高级定制时装、仙侠电影概念摄影融合。

人物为精致清冷型东方美人，自然窄鹅蛋脸，纤细柔和下颌线，深色杏仁眼，眼尾微微上扬，细长自然眉，精致挺直鼻梁，淡珊瑚粉色丰润嘴唇微微张开。表情安静、疏离、冷艳，带有高位神女般的压迫感与神性。

妆容非常轻薄，眼周使用少量暖橘红、浅珊瑚色眼影，眼尾略微加深，与冰蓝色雪山形成冷暖对比；真实自然皮肤，保留毛孔、细小绒毛和面部自然明暗，不要过度磨皮。

人物正面偏三分之二角度面对镜头，头部轻微向后抬起，视线直接穿过镜头或略微看向镜头上方，形成冷静、高贵、不迎合镜头的神女气质。

发型与银凰冠

浓密乌黑超长发，古典高位半盘发结合大量披散长发。

高山强风猛烈吹动头发，大量黑色发丝向画面左右以及上方飞舞，几缕碎发横穿额头、眼睛、鼻梁和脸颊。

发丝不能整齐，必须具有真实风力作用下的随机方向、粗细变化和物理惯性。

头顶佩戴大型冰银色凤凰展翼发冠，凤凰双翼向左右上方展开，融合凤凰羽毛、冰晶、银色枝杈与东方金属雕刻。

发冠两侧垂落多组银色细链、水晶珠链与流苏，在强风中向外飘动。

额心佩戴一枚小型银白水滴形/冰晶形额饰。

耳部佩戴细长银链珍珠耳坠。

服装

身穿一套极其高级的月白＋冰银＋象牙白＋珍珠虹彩仙侠高定礼服。

内层为象牙白真丝抹胸式/裹胸式仙裙，胸口采用柔软自然的立体褶皱。

肩部与手臂覆盖半透明冰银色欧根纱外袍。

外袍表面具有大量精细的银白牡丹、冰晶花卉、凤凰羽毛、银色枝叶立体刺绣。

花瓣并非普通布料，而是融合金属丝、珍珠薄膜、透明欧根纱与虹彩材质，在阳光下出现极淡蓝、银白、香槟金和珍珠粉反射。

宽大透明衣袖和数条超长披帛被狂风卷起，从人物身体周围穿过画面。

一只手自然抬到锁骨附近，纤细手指轻轻触碰胸前衣料，另一条手臂隐藏于飞舞披帛和宽大衣袖之间。

场景

人物位于宏大的雪山之巅。

背景是层叠的灰蓝色雪峰、冰川山脊、白色云海和干净冰蓝天空。

雪山距离人物很远，使用浅景深产生柔和虚化，只保留宏大雪山轮廓。

整体没有建筑、宫殿或现代元素，只有天空、雪山、云层和风。

这张最关键的「前景」

镜头与人物之间存在大量被风卷起的透明披帛、虹彩薄纱、银白羽毛状装饰。

一大片象牙白半透明披帛从画面左侧非常靠近镜头的位置掠过，严重失焦，形成巨大奶油白色前景。

另一层透明薄纱从画面右上方横向穿过。

下方存在大量暖金色圆形散景和半透明高光。

前景允许遮挡人物身体约20–35%，但不能遮住双眼和主要五官。

形成一种摄影师隔着飞舞仙纱瞬间抓拍神女的感觉，而不是普通干净棚拍。

光线

Golden Hour雪山日落光。

太阳位于人物左后方偏低位置，形成强烈暖金色侧逆光。

冷蓝色天空＋暖金阳光形成明显冷暖色温反差。

阳光穿透透明披帛产生奶油金色Bloom、柔和Lens Flare和大面积圆形散景。

人物面部曝光稍微柔和偏亮，但必须保留鼻梁、眼窝、下颌与锁骨的真实立体结构。

黑色发丝边缘出现银金色轮廓光。

银凰冠出现锐利但克制的金属高光。

虹彩欧根纱产生珍珠白、淡蓝、淡粉、香槟金微弱光谱折射。

整体画面具有一种空气里都是光的感觉。

items.title: 复古居家走廊全身镜穿搭自拍

prompts.text:
Hyper-realistic home mirror selfie photography, vertical aspect ratio about 3:4, a young adult female, explicitly adult, standing in front of a full-length mirror in a narrow residential corridor taking a selfie. The character is captured in full from the top of the head to the feet, located in the center of the frame, with plenty of the corridor environment preserved around. Using an approximately 28–35mm equivalent mobile phone lens, camera position near chest-to-abdomen height, natural perspective, like an ordinary daily outfit photo taken casually with a mobile phone.

No strong flash, no cinematic lighting.

items.title: 现代东亚展览海报包围式构图设计

prompts.text:
[Theme]
[Main Visual Subject]
[Core Chinese Character]
[Chinese Title]
[English Title]
[Enclosure Method] Character Surround / Three-Sided Huge Text / Physical Border / Nested Frame / Other
[Accent Color]
[Aspect Ratio] 9:16

Generate a modern exhibition poster with the temperament of East Asian Modernist Exhibition Poster, Japanese Contemporary Graphic Design, and Editorial Design. The core adopts an "Enclosure Composition": do not simply add a border around the subject, but let characters, huge text, real object edges, geometric frames, or photographic crops apply visual pressure from the periphery toward the center, naturally enclosing a clear visual focal point or negative space in the middle. The enclosure relationship should have direction and weight, avoiding four sides being completely equal in width, quantity, or symmetry; unbalanced structures like "heavy on the left, light on the right; dense on the top, sparse on the bottom" or "enclosed on three sides, open on one" can be adopted to maintain tension in the image.

First, select the most suitable enclosure mechanism according to the [Theme]. For character themes, multiple cropped portraits can gather toward the center from all sides; for a single sculpture or product, oversized edge Typography and white space can form a three-sided enclosure; for real-space themes, physical structures such as curtains, door frames, or architectural edges can be used to enclose the central area; for graphic themes, center-ward contraction can be achieved through multi-layered staggered geometric frames, repeating text, or nested boundaries. Do not cram all these methods into one image; choose only one that best fits the current theme as the main framework, then add a slight "break-frame," such as a character's shoulder entering the center, the subject pressing over the text, an object passing through the boundary, or a frame line being interrupted by a real object.

Typography must become part of the composition, not just a regular title. Use a striking [Core Chinese Character], which can be close to the edge of the frame, partially cropped, rotated, cross-regional, or create front-to-back occlusion with the subject; for the English title, use modern Grotesk, Condensed Sans, or restrained Serif, allowing ultra-wide tracking, 90° rotation, Outline fonts, and edge cropping. Use a maximum of 2–3 font personalities overall, forming a clear hierarchy where "large characters handle structure, medium characters handle the theme, and small characters handle information." Information density is generated through font size, direction, cropping, and spatial relationships, not by relying on a large number of explanatory modules to create a "sense of design."

Keep the image modern, sharp, and restrained as much as possible. For the background, prioritize neutral colors such as cool white, light gray, and charcoal black, adding only one [Accent Color] as a visual node; the total area of the accent color should be controlled at about 5%–10%, which can be used for small color blocks, short lines, dates, or local graphics. The central area should be noticeably quieter than the periphery, retaining about 25%–40% of effective negative space, making "outer density × inner sparsity" the most core visual rhythm. The subject itself should remain single, clear, and with a strong silhouette, without simultaneously adding landscapes, seals, traditional patterns, complex industrial diagrams, material cards, and large amounts of decoration.

The final reading order should be: first sight catches the strong outer shapes and central focus, second sight understands how the periphery encloses the center, third sight discovers the cropping, interleaving, or frame-breaking relationships, and finally, reading the title, date, and small amount of information. The entire work should look like a real contemporary exhibition poster, an international graphic design yearbook entry, or the visual of an independent culture magazine, rather than a traditional culture promotion page, PPT layout, or museum archive information board.

Avoid: equal four-sided borders, mechanical symmetry, full-page explanatory text, traditional national style decorations, landscape backgrounds, stacked red seals, templated small text, tech HUDs, meaningless English, Design Study, Vol., serial numbers, Logos, QR codes, and copyright marks.

prompts.text:
【主题】
【主视觉主体】
【中文核心字】
【中文标题】
【英文标题】
【包围方式】人物环绕 / 三边巨字 / 实体边界 / 嵌套框 / 其他
【强调色】
【画面比例】9:16

生成一张具有 **East Asian Modernist Exhibition Poster、Japanese Contemporary Graphic Design、Editorial Design** 气质的现代展览海报。核心采用“包围式构图”：不要简单在主体四周加边框，而是让人物、巨大文字、真实物体边缘、几何框架或摄影裁切从画面外围向中心施加视觉压力，在中央自然围出一个明确的视觉焦点或负空间。包围关系应当有方向、有轻重，避免四边完全等宽、等量、对称；可以采用“左重右轻、上密下疏”“三边收拢、一边开放”等非均衡结构，让画面保持张力。

先根据【主题】选择一种最适合的包围机制。人物题材可以让多个裁切肖像从四周朝中心聚拢；单一雕塑或产品可以用超大边缘 Typography 与留白形成三边包围；真实空间可以利用幕布、门框、建筑边缘等实体结构围出中央区域；平面题材可以通过多层错位几何框、重复文字或嵌套边界逐层向中心收缩。不要把这些方法全部塞进一张图，只选择最适合当前主题的一种作为主骨架，再加入一处轻微“破框”，例如人物肩部进入中心、主体压住文字、物件穿过边界或某一框线被真实对象打断。

Typography 必须成为构图的一部分，而不是普通标题。使用一个醒目的【中文核心字】，可以贴近画幅边缘、局部裁切、旋转、跨区或与主体产生前后遮挡；英文标题使用现代 Grotesk、Condensed Sans 或克制 Serif，允许超宽字距、90° 旋转、Outline 字体和边缘裁切。整体最多使用 2–3 种字体性格，形成“大字负责结构、中字负责主题、小字负责信息”的清楚层级。信息密度主要通过字号、方向、裁切和空间关系产生，不要依靠大量说明模块堆出“设计感”。

画面尽量保持现代、锋利、克制。背景优先使用冷白、浅灰、炭黑等中性色，只加入一个【强调色】作为视觉节点；强调色总面积控制在约 5%–10%，可以用于小色块、短线、日期或局部图形。中心区域应当明显比外围更安静，保留约 25%–40% 的有效负空间，让“外密 × 内疏”成为最核心的视觉节奏。主体本身保持单一、清楚、有强轮廓，不要同时加入山水、印章、传统纹样、复杂工艺图、材料卡和大量装饰。

最终阅读顺序应为：第一眼先看到外围强大形与中央焦点，第二眼理解外围如何围出中心，第三眼发现裁切、穿插或破框关系，最后才阅读标题、日期和少量信息。整张作品要像真实的当代展览海报、国际平面设计年鉴作品或独立文化杂志视觉，而不是传统文化宣传页、PPT 排版或博物馆档案说明板。

避免：平均四边框、机械对称、满版说明文字、传统国风装饰、山水背景、朱印堆叠、模板化小字、科技 HUD、无意义英文、Design Study、Vol.、编号、Logo、二维码和版权标识。

items.title: 竹影试茶秋日午后中式人像

prompts.text:
Subject:
Bamboo shadows tea tasting

Main Subject:
3:4 vertical aspect ratio, a waterside Chinese-style tea room on an early autumn afternoon, a woman sits sideways in front of an open wooden lattice window, her right hand lifting the lid of a white porcelain gaiwan, looking down at the slowly dispersing tea steam; the gaiwan is placed in the center of a low tea table in front of her, the bottom edge of the frame features a blurred celadon teacup as the foreground, the subject is located slightly to the right of the center, framing from the top of the head to the mid-thigh.

Character・Expression:
A stunningly beautiful 23-year-old East Asian woman, fashionable, confident, and gentle in temperament; well-proportioned and full figure, breast part is noticeably and naturally full, visual size approximately D to E cup, with a natural sense of weight and soft rounded contours, distinct but not exaggerated waist-to-chest ratio, no prosthetic feel; slender waist forming a clear but natural proportional contrast with the full chest; oval face with naturally soft bone structure, ivory white skin showing a faint pinkish flush, retaining pores and subtle highlights on the tip of the nose and cheekbones. Bright milk-tea grey-brown long hair loosely tied in a low bun, thin air bangs and side strands of hair gently moved by the window breeze. Champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, slender eyelashes, natural aegyosal, pale rose blush, and translucent pink-beige lips; corners of the mouth quietly and slightly upturned, gaze accurately falling on the tea steam rising from the gaiwan.

Clothing・Pose:
Wearing a moon-white improved national style short jacket (ru), light and semi-transparent silk gauze layered over a matching opaque lining, the deep cross-collar naturally forms a restrained low V-neck, cinched at the side waist with a thin ribbon; paired with misty cyan high-waisted form-fitting mini-skirt-shorts, length reaching the upper thigh, soft satin fabric with extremely faint dark bamboo patterns and natural sitting creases. Body angled towards the tea table, waist and back stretched out, left leg slightly forward, knees naturally together; right thumb and middle finger lightly pinching the lid knob, tilting the lid open by one finger's width, left fingertips steadily supporting the edge of the bowl saucer, sleeves falling naturally along the forearms.

Background・Light:
Foreground celadon cup and a corner of Xuan paper slightly blurred, middle ground retains only the tea table, white porcelain gaiwan, and a small sprig of osmanthus, background is a dark brown wooden lattice window, hazy bamboo leaves, and water surface. Warm natural window light from the top right passes through the bamboo leaves, falling on the cheeks, collarbones, silk gauze, and legs, forming soft, unevenly dense bamboo shadows, with shadows fading toward the bottom left; the water surface provides a weak cold cyan reflection, brightening the jawline and the dark parts of the skirt-shorts, the edges of the tea steam are outlined with a fine white silhouette by the window light.

Composition・Camera:
Equivalent 50mm lens, eye-level at chest height looking slightly downward, focus locked on the near pupil, the fingers pinching the lid knob, and the contact point with the gaiwan, shallow depth of field softening the bamboo leaves outside the window. The character occupies about 68% of the frame, the vertical lines of the wooden lattice window and the horizontal lines of the tea table form a stable frame, retaining a sense of breathing room in the upper left along the line of sight, the bottom edge of the frame is irregularly cropped by the teacup and the table edge.

Texture・Style:
A fusion of contemporary national style and Japanese beauty magazine photography, low contrast, restrained cyan-white and warm wood tones, soft film grain; emphasis on the light layers of silk gauze, dark bamboo patterns on soft satin, real skin texture, porcelain glaze shimmer, and the faint, flickering tea steam.

Negative:
Underage or mature middle-aged feel, drifting facial features, floating lid or gaiwan, fingers not touching the lid knob or clipping, disorganized cross-collar structure, short skirt-shorts turning into long bottoms, plastic-textured skin, broken window lattice perspective or watermarks

prompts.text:
主题：
竹影试茶

主体：
竖3:4画幅，初秋午后临水中式茶室，一位女子侧坐在敞开的木格窗前，右手提起白瓷盖碗的碗盖，低头观察缓缓散开的茶汽；盖碗置于身前矮茶案中央，画面下缘以虚化的青瓷茶杯形成前景，人物位于中央略偏右，取景从头顶至大腿中段。

人物・表情：
绝美23岁东亚美女，气质时尚、自信、温柔；
身材匀称丰满，胸部明显自然丰满，视觉约 D 至 E 杯，具有自然重量感与柔和圆润轮廓，胸腰差明显，但不夸张、不假体感；纤细腰部，与丰满胸部形成清晰但自然的比例对比；
鹅蛋脸与自然柔和的软骨相，象牙白肌肤透出淡粉血色，保留毛孔、鼻尖与颧骨的细微高光。明亮奶茶灰棕长发松挽成低髻，薄空气刘海与脸侧碎发被窗风轻轻拨动。香槟米色与粉棕眼影、细长睫毛、自然泪袋、淡玫瑰腮红和透感粉米色唇；唇角安静微扬，视线准确落在盖碗中升起的茶汽上。

服装・姿势：
身着月白色改良国风短襦，轻薄半透真丝绡叠覆同色不透内衬，深交领自然形成克制的低V领，侧腰以细带收束；搭配雾青色高腰贴身短裙裤，长度至大腿上段，软缎面带极淡暗竹纹与自然坐褶。身体斜向茶案，腰背舒展，左腿微向前、双膝自然并拢；右手拇指与中指轻捏盖钮，将碗盖斜启一指宽，左手指腹稳扶碗托边缘，衣袖沿前臂自然垂落。

背景・光：
前景青瓷杯与一角宣纸轻微虚化，中景仅保留茶案、白瓷盖碗和一小枝桂花，背景是深棕木格窗、朦胧竹叶与水面。右上方偏暖自然窗光穿过竹叶落在脸颊、锁骨、真丝绡与腿部，形成疏密不均的柔软竹影，阴影向左下方渐淡；水面提供微弱冷青反射，为下颌和裙裤暗部提亮，茶汽边缘被窗光勾出细白轮廓。

构图・相机：
等效50毫米镜头，胸口高度平视略向下，焦点锁定近侧瞳孔、捏住盖钮的手指与盖碗接触处，浅景深柔化窗外竹叶。人物占画面约68%，木格窗竖线与茶案横线形成稳定框架，左上方沿视线方向保留呼吸感，画面下缘以茶杯和桌沿不规则裁切。

质感・风格：
当代国风与日系美容杂志写真融合，低对比、克制青白与暖木色、柔和胶片颗粒；重点表现真丝绡轻薄层次、软缎暗竹纹、真实皮肤纹理、瓷釉微光和若隐若现的茶汽。

负面：
未成年或成熟中年感、人物面部特征漂移、碗盖或盖碗悬浮、手指未接触盖钮或穿模、交领结构错乱、短裙裤变成长下装、塑料感皮肤、窗格透视崩坏或水印

items.title: 浴室日常写实东亚女性生活化广角人像

prompts.text:
3:4 vertical aspect ratio, realistic daily bathroom portrait of a person, adult East Asian female, standing between a warm white marble wall and a white radiator, close-up half-body composition. The person's body is clearly oriented towards the left side of the frame, with the torso and hips kept sideways, and the head then naturally turns back to look at the camera, forming a clear "body turned away, face looking back" relationship.

One arm is actively extended towards the front of the lens, the forearm extending almost along the lens axis, with the palm and fingers close to the lens, thus producing significant close-up wide-angle perspective magnification. The size of the foreground hand and forearm is significantly larger than the face and shoulders behind, but must maintain real human anatomy, wrist direction, knuckle length, and perspective relationship. The other arm is naturally tucked toward the back of the body, reducing the complexity of limbs in the frame.

The person's head is slightly turned back, eyes naturally looking at the lens, with a bit of calm, cold, slight sense of observation, no staring, and no aggressive gaze. The upper eyelids are naturally open, the area between the eyebrows is relaxed, the lips are closed or slightly parted, and the jaw is slightly tucked. Short deep brownish-black hair reaching near the neck, with natural layers and a slight sense of messiness; bangs on the forehead and stray hairs on the side of the face are randomly distributed, with hair ends slightly flipped outward, no exquisite styling.

The person wears a white or light gray-white form-fitting sleeveless top, the fabric is light and thin with natural stretch and folds, paired with black shorts, forming a clear light top + dark bottom structure. The clothing is simple and lifelike, without adding large jewelry or complex accessories. A few minimalist small tattoos or small graphic marks can be kept on the arms, but the area is very small and does not become a visual focus.

The background is an ordinary real bathroom space, with a white or warm white towel hanging on the left, a set of white vertical radiators on the right, and light beige marble wall tiles in the middle and back, with low-contrast gray natural textures. The background remains recognizable but low weight; it is not a luxury hotel bathroom, and no bathtubs, mirror light strips, gold hardware, or complex decorations are added.

The light is soft warm white indoor ambient light, evenly illuminating the person's face, neck, shoulders, arms, and top from above and the front side. The overall brightness is natural, without dramatic strong shadows or commercial studio soft light. The skin remains a real warm neutral, retaining natural texture, slight skin tone differences, fine highlights, and real arm joint structures, without plastic skin smoothing.

The color relationship is controlled as: approximately 30% warm gray beige-white bathroom walls and towels, 19% deep black-blue hair and black shorts, 18% natural warm skin tone, 15% soft white top and radiator highlights, 10% warm gray marble texture and floor, 8% warm brown-gray hair strands and facial shadow transitions. The overall remains low saturation, lifelike, and clean, without adding vivid high-saturation color blocks.

The imaging maintains a modern real digital photography feel; the person's face, foreground arms, torso, towels, and radiators all maintain recognizable structures. The foreground palm may have slight edge softening due to being extremely close to the lens, but cannot be completely out of focus. The background does not have extreme creamy bokeh, retaining a real sense of bathroom space. The overall is like a casual fashion photo taken near a person in an ordinary living space, not a commercial blockbuster.

Soran Three-layer Natural Watermark

First layer readable watermark: The precise text "Soran" is clearly readable once, naturally woven into the white top near the side waist hem, shoulder strap edge, or small fabric label position with light gray-silver or light blue-gray silk thread, like a real high-quality basic clothing brand logo; the position is obvious but does not grab the face, naturally changing with fabric stretching, body turning, folds, and indoor light.

Second layer hidden watermark: The hidden "Soran" is integrated into the marble fine veins, white towel fibers, and black short textures.

Third layer microscopic watermark: The miniature "Soran" is naturally formed by top stitches, towel fibers, fine radiator paint textures, hair strand intersections, and fabric fibers.

All "Soran" must belong to a part of the real clothing and environmental materials; the first layer is clearly readable, and the remaining two layers are naturally hidden, with no floating text appearing.

Negative Prompts:
Completely standing frontally, person not turned sideways, face not turned back, foreground arm too far from the lens, hand and face close in size, telephoto compression perspective, finger deformity, extra fingers, stuck fingers, wrong wrist, floating arm, stiff posing, aggressive gaze, standard studio portrait, luxury bathroom, complex background, bathtub, gold hardware, neon lights, strong dramatic lighting, extreme background blur, plastic skin, porcelain white skin smoothing, AI beauty face, anime face, perfectly symmetrical features, commercial beauty retouching, HDR, over-sharpening, 8K fake details, extra people, extra readable text, extra brand names, external watermark, sticker-like logo, detached letters, captions, subtitles, floating text, oversized branding, flat pasted logo

prompts.text:
3:4 竖幅，真人写实日常浴室人像，成年东亚女性，站在暖白色大理石墙面与白色暖气片之间，近距离大半身构图。人物身体明显侧向画面左侧，躯干与髋部保持侧身，头部再自然回转看向镜头，形成清楚的“身体侧开，脸回看”关系。

一只手臂主动向镜头前方伸出，前臂几乎沿镜头轴方向延伸，手掌和手指靠近镜头，因此产生明显近距离广角透视放大。前景手和前臂尺寸明显大于后方脸部与肩部，但必须保持真实人体结构、手腕方向、指节长度和透视关系。另一只手臂向身体后侧自然收拢，降低画面肢体复杂度。

人物头部轻微回转，眼神自然看向镜头，带一点平静、冷淡、轻微观察感，不瞪眼，不做攻击性凝视。上眼睑自然打开，眉间放松，嘴唇闭合或轻微分开，下颌略收。深棕黑短发到颈部附近，带自然碎层和轻微凌乱感，额前刘海与脸侧碎发随机分布，发尾轻微外翘，不做精致造型。

人物穿白色或浅灰白贴身无袖上衣，布料轻薄、有自然拉伸和褶皱，搭配黑色短裤，形成清楚的浅上衣 + 深下装结构。服装简洁、生活化，不加入大型首饰和复杂配件。手臂上可保留少量极简小纹身或小图形标记，但面积很小，不成为视觉重点。

背景为普通真实浴室空间，左侧挂一条白色或暖白色毛巾，右侧是一组白色竖向暖气片，中间与后方为浅米白大理石墙砖，带低对比灰色天然纹理。背景保持可辨识但低权重，不做豪华酒店浴室，不加入浴缸、镜面灯带、金色五金和复杂装饰。

光线为柔和暖白室内环境光，从上方和前侧均匀照亮人物脸部、肩颈、手臂和上衣。整体亮度自然，不做戏剧性强阴影，也不做商业影楼柔光。皮肤保持真实暖中性，保留自然纹理、轻微肤色差异、细小高光和真实手臂关节结构，不做塑料磨皮。

色彩关系控制为：约30%暖灰米白浴室墙面与毛巾，19%深黑蓝头发与黑色短裤，18%自然暖肤色，15%柔白上衣与暖气片高光，10%暖灰大理石纹理与地面，8%暖棕灰发丝与面部阴影过渡。整体保持低饱和、生活化、干净，不加入鲜艳高饱和色块。

成像保持现代真实数码摄影感，人物脸部、前景手臂、躯干、毛巾和暖气片都保持可辨识结构。前景手掌可因距离镜头极近出现轻微边缘柔化，但不能完全失焦。背景不做极端奶油虚化，保留真实浴室空间感。整体像普通生活空间里靠近人物拍下的一张随手时尚照片，不做商业大片。

Soran 三层自然水印

第一层可读水印：精确文字 “Soran” 清晰可读一次，以浅灰银或淡蓝灰丝线自然织入白色上衣靠近侧腰下摆、肩带边缘或小型布料织标位置，像真实高品质基础款服装品牌标识，位置明显但不抢脸，随布料拉伸、身体侧转、褶皱和室内光线自然变化。

第二层隐藏水印：隐藏的 “Soran” 融入大理石细纹、白色毛巾纤维和黑色短裤织纹中。

第三层微观水印：微型 “Soran” 由上衣针脚、毛巾纤维、暖气片细微漆面纹理、发丝交叉和布料纤维自然形成。

所有 Soran 都必须属于真实服装和环境材质的一部分，第一层明显可读，其余两层自然隐藏，不出现悬浮文字。

负向词

完全正面站立，人物不侧身，脸不回转，前景手臂距离镜头太远，手和脸尺寸接近，长焦压缩透视，手指畸形，多余手指，粘连手指，错误手腕，手臂悬浮，僵硬摆拍，攻击性凝视，标准影楼写真，豪华浴室，复杂背景，浴缸，金色五金，霓虹灯，强戏剧性布光，背景极端虚化，塑料皮肤，瓷白磨皮，AI 美女脸，动漫脸，完美对称五官，商业美容精修，HDR，过度锐化，8K 假细节，额外人物，额外可读文字，额外品牌名，external watermark, sticker-like logo, detached letters, captions, subtitles, floating text, oversized branding, flat pasted logo

items.title: 晨光中的黑缎子睡裙女性照片

prompts.text:
Subject:
Black satin in the morning light

Main Subject:
A vertical photo of an adult woman wearing a black satin mini slip nightgown, sitting on a white bed drenched in morning sunlight with her back to the camera. The character is positioned based on the center of the frame.

Character/Expression:
Shoulder-length dark brown loose wavy hair and thin bangs. Slender oval-shaped facial outline, elongated brown eyes, natural eyebrows, a small nose, and glossy peach lips. A serene expression looking towards the camera from behind the shoulder. The face is turned from behind the shoulder toward the camera.

Clothing/Pose:
A black glossy satin mini slip dress with thin spaghetti straps. The back is wide open to near the waist, with multiple slender lace-up ties and small bows on both sides. Sitting with legs folded to the side, with one hand placed on the bed. Black mini skirt.

Background/Lighting:
White bedsheets and pillows, light-colored walls, large windows. Strong morning light creates slender white reflections on the black satin, warmly illuminating the back and hair. The main light source in the background of the image is soft light from the window side.

Composition/Shot:
A 4:5 vertical composition, with the camera shooting an above-the-knee photo from diagonally behind the foot of the bed. The character is placed in the center and presented prominently, with the open back and the woven ties on both sides as the protagonists. The focus is concentrated on the face looking back and the satin. The character is included largely, with the focus on the protagonist and the background slightly blurred.

Texture/Style:
Photorealistic natural light photography. The specular gloss of the black satin, the slender woven ties, white bedding, and the morning light on the hair and skin are finely captured.

Negative Prompt:
Do not omit the deep open back and the woven ties on both sides

prompts.text:
主题：

主体：

prompts.text:
Transform the provided real photograph into a charming hand-drawn travel-journal illustration while preserving the original scene, composition, perspective, architecture, landmarks, people, objects, and overall layout. Keep the main subject and recognizable details in exactly the same positions as the reference image, but reinterpret everything as a warm, playful illustrated artwork.

Use a Japanese illustrated travel diary / modern picture-book aesthetic with clean expressive black ink outlines, slightly imperfect hand-drawn strokes, simplified shapes, soft watercolor-and-gouache textures, subtle paper grain, and vibrant but natural colors. Add gentle artistic exaggeration while keeping the location clearly recognizable.

Create a bright sky-blue atmosphere, lush simplified greenery, expressive trees, stylized buildings, charming small details, and simplified human figures with minimal facial features. Use warm orange/red architectural elements and natural greens where appropriate. Maintain realistic depth and perspective, but simplify fine photographic details into appealing illustrated forms.

Add small hand-written doodle elements and travel-journal typography naturally around empty areas of the composition, such as a short location title, mood phrase, tiny hearts, clouds, sun, flowers, stars, or simple decorative marks. The lettering should feel casually handwritten with a white paint-marker/brush effect and should never cover important subjects.

The final image should feel like a personal travel memory redrawn by an artist, nostalgic, cheerful, wholesome, youthful and spontaneous — not a generic cartoon and not a digital 3D render.

Preserve: original framing, camera angle, landmark proportions, major objects, people placement, road/building layout, lighting direction and recognizable environmental details.

Style: Japanese travel sketchbook, hand-painted illustration, ink outline, watercolor + gouache, children’s picture-book charm, editorial travel illustration, textured paper, imperfect brushwork, vibrant blue sky, warm natural lighting, cinematic composition, highly detailed but artistically simplified.

Avoid: photorealism, 3D CGI, anime character styling, overly smooth digital artwork, excessive saturation, distorted architecture, changing the landmark, adding major objects, unrealistic perspective, plastic textures, overly detailed faces, or losing the original photograph’s composition.

prompts.text:
Create a vertical "upper-lower split" style poster, overall like a disassembled picture book page: the upper part is a real photo, and the lower part is a fairytale print-style image translation of the same subject. The composition is simple, clear, narrative, with the temperament of a picture book and an art publication.

Upper Part:
Display the original photo uploaded by the user. Retain the main characters, pets, animals, or the most important interaction between characters and animals in the photo. The subject must be clearly identifiable, trying to preserve its identity, movement, posture, expression, clothing features, fur color, outer contour, and emotional state. The upper part maintains a sense of real photography and does not undergo painterly processing. Environments and buildings exist only as auxiliary spatial clues and do not occupy the main position.

Lower Part:
Extract the most recognizable subjects, outlines, postures, and narrative relationships from the upper photo, and reconstruct them into fairytale print-style hand-drawn images. Do not mechanically trace details, but instead compress the subject into one or two clear large blocks, using blunt silhouettes, slightly exaggerated proportions, and a few key edges to retain the original object's identity, action, function, and emotion. The image refines a large area of low-brightness or high-contrast structural field from the original content, serving as a container, path, frame, or density layer to wrap the subject; the background grows out of the original space and meaning like a shell where the story takes place, forming a structural narrative of blocking, cropping, swallowing, and partial exposure. The overall style adopts flat narrative perspective and picture book page-style hierarchy, utilizing overhead compression, lateral movement, front framing, path guidance, scale jumping, or edge cropping to organize reading.

Color:
Extracted from the uploaded original image, maintaining a clear three-layer relationship: large areas of dark structural colors are responsible for weight and boundaries, appropriate amounts of light colors or negative space are responsible for breathing, and small areas of high-saturation emotional colors are responsible for the image reading path and story signals. The most important information is concentrated only in a few bright color blocks on the face, posture, path, utensil function points, environment markers, or narrative focus, and is always suppressed by dark structures or light negative shapes, making the image vivid but not balanced. The hue can be adjusted according to the theme's mood, but the area ratio and brightness order remain stable.

Lines:
Appear only at functions, paths, boundaries, textures, and identification points, maintaining sparse, hand-drawn, slightly inaccurate thin lines. All color blocks maintain flat processing, while retaining dry brush, grain, white space (feibai), paper texture, spray dots, and slight overprint misalignment, presenting a handcrafted texture completed by screen printing and pastels, avoiding realistic lighting and shadow, complex volumes, smooth vector edges, 3D rendering, and plastic textures.

Overall:
The composition is simple, low-detail, high-recognition, with a dark field wrapping bright signals, combining cute narrative with a heavy print feel. If the image contains text, the text can be treated as small logos, object panels, or edge annotations, with a streamlined quantity that subordinates to the graphic structure; the font is round and blunt, with slightly uneven thickness and low density, carrying a natural handwritten feel, making it look like a part of the image rather than an explanation pasted on later.

Overall Presentation:
A visual relationship of "upper part real original image + lower part fairytale picture book, handcrafted print, editorial illustration, and art publication temperament combination," forming a very clear "before and after translation of the same subject" effect, with unified, vivid, and transferable visuals.

prompts.text:
创作一张竖版“上下双拼”风格海报，整体像一本被拆开的绘本页：上方是真实照片，下方是同一主体的童话版画式图像转译。构图简洁、清楚、带叙事性，具有绘本和艺术出版物气质。

上半部分：
展示用户上传的原始照片。保留照片中的主要人物、宠物、动物，或人物与动物之间最重要的互动关系。主体必须清晰可辨，尽量保留其身份、动作、姿态、表情、服装特征、毛色、外轮廓与情绪状态。上半部分保留真实摄影感，不进行绘画化处理。环境和建筑只作为辅助空间线索存在，不占据主体地位。

下半部分：
从上半部分照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为童话版画式手绘图像。不要机械描摹细节，而是将主体压缩为一两个清楚的大体块，以钝拙剪影、略微夸张的比例和少量关键边缘，保留原始对象的身份、动作、功能与情绪。画面从原图内容中提炼出一个大面积低明度或高反差的结构场，作为包裹主体的容器、路径、框架或密度层；背景像故事发生的外壳一样从原图空间与意义中生长出来，形成遮挡、裁切、吞没与局部露出的结构叙事。整体采用平面叙事透视和绘本页面式层级，可使用俯视压缩、侧向移动、正面框架、路径引导、尺度跳跃或边缘裁切组织阅读。

配色从上传的原图提取，并保持明确的三层关系：大面积暗结构色负责重量与边界，适量浅色或留白负责呼吸，小面积高饱和情绪色负责读图路线与故事信号。最重要的信息仅以少量鲜明色块集中在面部、姿态、路径、器物功能点、环境标识或叙事焦点上，并始终被深色结构或浅色负形压住，让画面鲜艳但不平均。色相可随主题情绪调整，但面积比例与明度秩序保持稳定。

线条只在功能、路径、边界、纹理和识别处出现，保持稀疏、手绘、略不准的细线。所有色块保持平面化处理，同时保留干刷、颗粒、飞白、纸纹、喷点和轻微套印错位，呈现丝网印刷与粉蜡笔共同完成的手工质感，避免写实光影、复杂体积、光滑矢量边缘、三维渲染和塑料质感。

整体构图简洁、低细节、高识别，暗场包裹亮色信号，兼具可爱叙事与厚重版画感。若画面包含文字，可将文字处理为小标识、物体面板或边缘注释，数量精简，服从图形结构；字形圆钝，粗细略不均，密度低，带有自然手写感，使其像画面的一部分而不是后期贴上去的说明。

整体呈现“上半部分真实原图 + 下半部分童话绘本、手工版画、编辑插画与艺术出版物气质结合”的视觉关系，形成非常明确的“同一主体前后转译”效果，视觉统一、鲜明、可迁移。

prompts.text:

Subject:

Clothing and Accessories:
Soft beige tailored jacket and short skirt, white ribbed inner layer. Depict the strap of the single-shoulder black bag and the black high heels. Retain the jacket collar, sleeve creases, and overlapping skirt hem.

Pose, Fingers, Contact:
One knee bent, leg extended forward, head bowed, hand resting on the heel. Shoulders slightly tilted, bearing the weight of the bag. The boundary between fingers and shoe, the upper and lower connection of the leg, and the orientation of the supporting foot must be natural.

Expression and Gaze:
Gentle side-eye, focusing towards the upper right direction of the screen. Mouth slightly closed, with a hint of tension. Do not adopt a pose smiling at the camera; prioritize the action of adjusting shoes mid-journey.

Brown eyes and natural eyebrows, light pink lips. Shadows on cheeks and chin are soft, with subtle light and dark areas preserved through the bangs on the forehead. Maintain understated makeup suitable for commuting clothes, avoiding excessive modification of facial contours.

Hair:
Brown hair tied back at the head, retaining light bangs and scattered strands near the ears. Hair at the neck is expressed in thin bundles to avoid merging into the same silhouette as the black bag strap.

Light Source:
Station ceiling lighting and diffused light from spacious corridors. Face is bright, with thin shadows on jacket folds and below the knees. Place elegant reflections on the glossy floor, but do not make strong mirror-like character reflections.

Colors and Tones:
Dominantly beige, off-white, and gray station hall, with the black bag and high heels as accent colors. Retain the warmth of the skin, separated from the cool gray of the background. Retain tonal layers in bright areas of clothing and floor.

Materials and Fine Textures:
Fine weave of the jacket, ribbing of the inner layer, matte sheen of the leather bag strap, and smooth surface of the high heels should be depicted separately. Retain natural skin texture and creases on hands and knees; seams on stone floors should not be overly sharp.

Composition and Lens:

Use the diagonal line of the jacket as the main line of the protagonist's action, retaining station pillars as vertical background lines.

Image Processing and Finishing:
Natural exposure and soft details like a daily snapshot. The character's eyes, collar, and bag strap should be clear, with distant people and signs blurred according to distance. Do not apply strong HDR or excessive skin correction.

prompts.text:

棕色眼睛和自然眉毛，淡粉色嘴唇。脸颊和下巴的阴影柔和，前额透过刘海保留细微明暗。保持适合通勤服的低调妆容，避免过度修饰脸部轮廓。

夹克的细密织纹、内搭的罗纹、皮革包带的哑光泽、高跟鞋的光滑表面要分别描绘。手部和膝盖保留自然的皮肤纹理和褶皱，石地板的接缝不宜过度锐利。

像日常快照般自然的曝光和柔和细节。人物的眼部、领子、包带要清晰，远处的人和指示牌根据距离模糊化。不施加强HDR或过度肌肤修正。

prompts.text:
Create a vertical "top-bottom split" style poster, the canvas is strictly divided into upper and lower areas, overall maintaining sufficient white space, quietness, and a sense of high-end children's book editing.

Upper part:
Display the original photo uploaded by the user. The subject is limited to people, pets, animals, or the interaction relationship between people and pets, retaining the true photographic state of the subject, including shape, fur color or skin tone, hairstyle, clothing, posture, movement, expression, and overall temperament. The upper part is not redrawn in illustration style; it should be like a clean, real, and clear reference photo. The background can be moderately simplified and cropped, but do not let buildings and the environment become the main character; the focus is always the human or animal subject.

Lower part:
Extract the same subject from the photo in the upper part and reconstruct it as a minimalist thick black dry medium silhouette illustration. Do not mechanically trace photo details; instead, compress the subject into a rounded, thick, slightly naive generalized form. The head, face, ears, hand movements, tail, body outline, or the most memorable parts can be moderately enlarged, making the original object recognizable at a glance even under minimal information. If the photo contains multiple subjects, retain the most important interaction relationship and treat them as a single visual unit rather than an average dispersion of focus.

The image uses only a near-pure white paper base + thick black crayon, charcoal, or dry rub marks, no color, and no grayscale gradients. The black form is not a smooth solid vector block but is formed by repeated application of short, powerful crayon strokes, retaining paper grain, broken strokes, indentations, rough edges, uneven thickness, and local white gaps. The outline is slightly shaky, incomplete, and imprecise, keeping the image with a true handmade feel.

The most critical identification features of the subject can be strengthened through "white characteristic areas suddenly cut out of the black silhouette," such as human facial contours, around the eyes, hairline, mouth shape, pet face, nose and mouth area, chest patterns, the core structure of objects, or the most recognizable parts; then use minimal black dots, short lines, or symbols to complete expressions and details. Do not pursue realistic facial features and precise structures, but let a direct, interesting, and strong recognition relationship form between black and white.

The composition maintains large areas of pure white space + one main visual relationship. The subject can be suspended in the center, or slightly offset, partially cropped, or near the bottom of the screen, using only a rough ground friction line, a few short lines, or minimal environment symbols to suggest space. Grass, wind, tabletop, ground, smoke, roads, shadows, or other environmental information should be compressed into minimal crayon marks, keeping the background quiet and empty. The overall goal is not to pursue complex scenes, but to let a posture, movement, distance, or relationship bear the main narrative.

The text retains a small text system where a high-end sense of editing and a children's book feel coexist. Don't just write location or object names, but extract a short English title from the emotion, movement, relationship, time, or small story in the photo, and then match it with a number, a suitable golden quote, a chapter number, or a very short, subtle small copy. The text can be restrained small printed text, or a very small amount of clumsy handwriting, crayon characters, or not completely regular font shapes can be added, making it look as if it originally belonged to this illustration.

The text needs to have a clever relationship with the graphics: it can be arranged along the ground line, extend along the direction of the subject's movement, hide in large areas of white space, produce slight occlusion with the outline, be stuck in the negative space between two subjects, or use a thin line to connect the number with the subject. Maintaining "one short title + 1–2 groups of minimal auxiliary text" is enough, letting the text become part of the compositional rhythm rather than a common poster title.

The overall presentation features the visual characteristics of "upper part real original image + lower part black needs to be thick, white needs to be clean, shape needs to be simple, texture needs to be rough," maintaining a subtle balance between childishness, softness, quietness, humor, and loneliness, like an old black-and-white children's book re-edited by a high-end design studio. Avoid smooth digital outlines, precise line art, realistic light and shadow, thick painting, three-dimensional effects, color, large areas of gray rendering, cartoon sticker feel, and templated commercial illustrations.

prompts.text:
创作一张竖版“上下双拼”风格海报，画布严格分为上下两个区域，整体保持留白充分、安静、有高级童书编辑感。

上半部分：
展示用户上传的原始照片。主体限定为人物、宠物、动物或人物与宠物之间的互动关系，保留主体的真实摄影状态，包括外形、毛色或肤色、发型、服装、姿态、动作、表情与整体气质。上半部分不进行插画风重绘，应像一张干净、真实、明确的参考照片。背景可适度简化与裁切，但不要让建筑和环境成为主角，重点始终是人物或动物主体。

下半部分：
将上半部分照片中的同一主体提取出来，重构为极简粗黑干媒介剪影插画。不要机械描摹照片细节，而是将主体压缩成圆润、敦厚、略带稚拙感的概括形体，可适度放大头部、脸部、耳朵、手部动作、尾巴、身体轮廓或最有记忆点的局部，使其在极少信息下仍能一眼识别原物。若照片包含多个主体，则保留最重要的互动关系，将它们视为一个整体视觉单元，而不是平均分散焦点。

画面只使用近乎纯白的纸面底 + 浓黑蜡笔、炭笔或干擦痕迹，不使用彩色，不使用灰阶渐变。黑色形体不是光滑实心矢量块，而是由短促、有力度的蜡笔反复涂抹形成，保留纸张颗粒、断笔、压痕、边缘毛糙、浓淡不均和局部露白。轮廓略微摇晃、不完整、不精确，让画面保持真实手作感。

主体最关键的识别特征可通过“黑色剪影中突然切出的白色特征区”强化，例如人物的脸部轮廓、眼睛周围、发际线、嘴型、宠物面部、鼻口区域、胸前花纹、物件核心结构或最具有辨识度的局部；再以极少黑点、短线或符号完成表情与细节。不要追求写实五官和精密结构，而是让黑、白之间形成直接、有趣而强烈的辨识关系。

构图保持大面积纯净留白 + 一个主要视觉关系。主体可居中悬浮，也可轻微偏置、局部裁切或靠近画面下方，仅用一条粗糙地面摩擦线、几根短线或极少环境符号提示空间。草叶、风、桌面、地面、烟气、道路、影子或其他环境信息都应被压缩成极少的蜡笔记号，让背景保持安静空旷。整体不追求复杂场景，而让一个姿态、动作、距离或关系承担主要叙事。

文字保留少量高级编辑感与童书感并存的小字系统。不要只写地点或物体名称，而从照片中的情绪、动作、关系、时间或微小故事提炼一个简短英文标题，再搭配编号、适配的金句、章节号或一句极短的含蓄小文案。文字可以是克制的印刷小字，也可以加入极少量笨拙手写、蜡笔字或不完全规整的字形，使其像原本就属于这幅插画。

文字需要与图形发生巧妙关系：可以贴着地面线排列、沿主体动作方向延伸、躲在大片留白中、与轮廓产生轻微遮挡、卡在两个主体之间的负形里，或用一条细线把编号与主体连接起来。保持“一个短标题 + 1–2 组极小辅助文字”即可，让文字成为构图节奏的一部分，而不是普通海报标题。

整体呈现“上半部分真实原图 + 下半部分黑要粗、白要净、形要简、质要糙”的视觉特征，在童稚、温软、安静、幽默与孤独之间保持微妙平衡，像一本由高级设计工作室重新编辑的旧黑白童书。避免光滑数字描边、精密线稿、写实光影、厚涂、三维效果、彩色、大面积灰色渲染、卡通贴纸感和模板化商业插画。

A beautiful Japanese woman, about 25 years old. Porcelain-white, delicate skin; natural grey-blue eyes; extremely exquisite features; precise high-fashion makeup with a soft glow. A quiet Tokyo street at noon. Richly textured white walls or building facades. Urban yet restrained—no chaotic crowds, no tourist landmarks. The city exists only through architecture and cut light.

Vertical composition, three-quarter or medium shot. Large format/8x10 feel. Slow, painterly composition. Emphasize the face, collarbone, waist, and folds of the fabric.
4. Lighting & Style
Noon light cut by buildings into soft side lighting and shadow stripes. No harsh overhead sunlight on the face. Ethereal, almost divine sensuality. In the high-fashion editorial style of Paolo Roversi's spirit: slow, still, glossy skin, air in the clothes. Surreal skin and fabric textures. Sophisticated, not vulgar.
5. Restrictions
No wardrobe malfunctions, no transparency, no visible nipples, no explicit nudity. Fabric must be thin but completely opaque. Breasts presented only with natural weight and folds. Maintain an innocent-sensual, high-fashion, and restrained mood. No cheap "sexy poses," no direct provocative gaze, no low-angle crotch compositions. Natural tones, no heavy retouching marks.

items.title: 东方文化展海报视觉指南

prompts.text:
[Theme]:
[Chinese Title]:
[English Title]:
[Core Subject]:
[Left-Right Relationship]: Giant object dominating / Image narrow band × Wide text field / Subject × Archive / Image crossing boundaries / Dense × White space / Other
[Left Content]:
[Right Content]:
[Crossover Elements]: Object silhouette / Branches and leaves / Large characters / Line drawings / Patterns / Other
[Main Color Tone]:
[Accent Color]:
[Date / Venue]:
[Aspect Ratio]: 9:16

Generate a high-aesthetic, high-information-density Oriental culture exhibition poster using a "Left-Right Composition / Asymmetrical Dual-Zone Composition."

Do not split the left and right 50/50 equally. Use ratios like 35/65, 40/60, 45/55 flexibly based on the volume of the subject, text density, and white space relationships. The focus is not equal area on both sides, but achieving visual balance among image weight, typography, and information density.

Flexibly choose different methods based on the theme:

Giant Object Dominating: Enlarge a scale object, cultural relic, or art object on one side, allowing bold cropping to occupy the primary visual weight; establish reading hierarchy on the other side through titles, English text, small print, structural line drawings, and exhibition info.

Image Narrow Band × Wide Text Field: Use a slender ancient painting, photography, or pattern slice on one side, while keeping a larger area of paper and typography on the other. Branches, birds, clouds, or subject silhouettes in the image can actively cross out of the core area into the text zone.

Subject × Archive: Maintain a single strong subject on one side, while combining object line drawings, material macros, rubbings, pattern studies, dimensions, era, and a small amount of explanatory text on the other to create an art catalog feel.

Dense × White Space: Form a high-density visual on one side through images, archive fragments, and research content, while maintaining a large area of controlled white space on the other, using only a few large characters and key exhibition info. White space must not just be "no content"; it must be precisely designed through kerning, fine lines, position, and proportion.

Left and right boundaries should not be too mechanical. Allow object edges, large characters, flower branches, patterns, or research lines to cross the boundary by about 3%–10% to reconnect the two sides, while avoiding random collage.

Typography must be redesigned based on the subject of each image. Use oversized single characters, two-character offsets, full horizontal titles, medium-scale titles, multi-column text, or partial color inversion. Adhere to the scale contrast of "large characters are very large, small characters are very small," reducing meaningless medium-sized fonts. Do not fixate on four-character vertical arrangements, and do not repeat templates like "two-character horizontal + two-character vertical."

Information density should refer to mature museum posters, Japanese Editorial Design, and Art Catalogues. Include English subtitles, eras, materials, techniques, venues, dates, curatorial phrases, and 1–3 research nodes directly related to the theme, such as object line drawings, glaze macros, ancient painting materials, pattern rubbings, stone texture studies, or partial enlargements.

These auxiliary pieces of information must serve the theme; do not pile up random small text just to "look professional."

Control colors within 3–5 main colors. Prioritize restrained colors such as bone white, ink black, celadon green, mineral blue/green, deep gray, and ochre, then add a clear but very small area of cinnabar red or another accent color. Paper surface should remain clean without using dirty yellow antique filters.

First glance should see the large subject and the left-right weight relationship; second glance sees the title and main color blocks; third glance discovers how objects, ancient paintings, or branches break through the left-right boundaries; finally, read the materials, structures, eras, and exhibition archives.

Core principle: One side is responsible for anchoring the vision, the other for carrying the reading; white space is weight, and information density is also weight; left and right are not equal, but the whole must be balanced.

Overall requirements: 9:16, high-definition, clear, clean paper surface, realistic subject texture, sharp typography, fine lines and small text as clear as possible, rich information but not messy, with the completion level of mature museum posters and art publications.

Avoid: Mechanical 50/50 split, simple left-image-right-text, placing a similar subject on both sides, subjects being too small, information areas looking like manuals, fixed title templates, PPT info boxes, complex UI, random English, heavy aging, mottled noise, image numbering, copyright logos, four-pointed stars, sparkles, and low-completion AI poster vibes.

prompts.text:
【主题】：
【中文标题】：
【英文标题】：
【核心主体】：
【左右关系】：巨物压场 / 图像窄带 × 宽文字场 / 主体 × 档案 / 图像越界 / 密集 × 留白 / 其他
【左侧内容】：
【右侧内容】：
【跨界元素】：器物轮廓 / 枝叶 / 大字 / 线稿 / 纹样 / 其他
【主色调】：
【强调色】：
【日期 / 场馆】：
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张高审美、高信息密度的东方文化展览海报，采用「左右构图 / 非对称双区构图」。

左右不要 50 / 50 平均切开，根据主体体量、文字密度和留白关系灵活使用 35 / 65、40 / 60、45 / 55 等比例。重点不是两侧面积相等，而是让图像重量、Typography 和信息密度达到视觉平衡。

根据主题灵活选择不同方式：

巨物压场：一侧放大尺度器物、文物或艺术对象，允许大胆裁切，占据主要视觉重量；另一侧通过标题、英文、小字、结构线稿和展讯建立阅读层级。

图像窄带 × 宽文字场：一侧使用修长古画、摄影或纹样切片，另一侧保留更大的纸面与 Typography。图像中的枝叶、飞鸟、云气或主体轮廓可主动越出画芯进入文字区。

主体 × 档案：一侧保持单一强主体，另一侧组合器型线稿、材质微距、拓片、纹样研究、尺寸、年代和少量说明文字，形成艺术图录感。

密集 × 留白：一侧通过图像、档案碎片和研究内容形成高密度视觉，另一侧保持大面积控制过的留白，只使用少量大字和关键展讯。留白不能只是“没有内容”，要通过字距、细线、位置和比例被精确设计。

左右边界不要过于机械。可以让器物边缘、大字、花枝、纹样或研究线条跨过分界约 3%–10%，把两侧重新连接起来，但避免随意拼贴。

Typography 必须根据每张画面的主体重新设计。可以使用超大单字、两字错位、完整横排标题、中等尺度标题、跨栏文字或局部反色。坚持“大字很大、小字很小”的尺度反差，减少无意义的中号字。不要固定使用四字纵排，也不要重复“两字横排 + 两字竖排”的模板。

信息密度参考成熟博物馆海报、Japanese Editorial Design 和 Art Catalogue。可加入英文副标题、年代、材质、工艺、场馆、日期、策展短句，以及 1–3 个与主题直接相关的研究节点，例如器型线稿、釉面微距、古画材料、纹样拓片、石纹研究或局部放大。

这些辅助信息必须服务主题，不要为了“显得专业”而堆随机小字。

色彩控制在 3–5 个主要颜色。优先使用骨白、墨黑、青瓷绿、石青石绿、深灰、赭色等克制色彩，再加入一个明确但面积很小的朱砂红或其他强调色。纸面保持干净，不使用脏黄仿古滤镜。

第一眼看到大型主体与左右重量关系；第二眼看到标题和主要色块；第三眼发现器物、古画或枝叶如何突破左右边界；最后再阅读材质、结构、年代与展览档案。

核心原则：一边负责压住视觉，一边负责承接阅读；留白也是重量，信息密度也是重量；左右不相等，但整体必须平衡。

整体要求：9:16，高清、清晰、纸面干净、主体质感真实、Typography 锐利、细线与小字尽可能清楚，信息丰富但不乱，具有成熟博物馆海报和艺术出版物完成度。

避免：机械五五分、简单左图右字、左右各放一个相似主体、主体过小、信息区像说明书、固定标题模板、PPT 信息框、复杂 UI、随机英文、严重做旧、斑驳噪点、画面编号、版权标识、四角星芒、sparkle 和低完成度 AI 海报感。

The background in the mirror is a large area of pure low-saturation sky blue sky, retaining a small amount of very light cloud traces, overall refreshing, bright, clean and transparent.

The figure is located to the right of the center in the mirror, doing a natural casual selfie action, holding a light pinkish-white or creamy-pink mobile phone with one hand to block the center of the face, the phone completely covers the eyes and most of the facial features, only retaining the chin, neck and part of the hairline, forming a clear face-covering selfie relationship. The hairstyle is deep brown-black medium-long hair, with a large volume of hair, part of the hair falls naturally near the shoulders and chest, and the other part is blown by the wind towards the upper right or upper side, forming a clear dynamic of hair strands lifting up, breaking the static composition of the circular mirror. The clothing is a white or warm white short puff-sleeved top, V-neck or shallow V-neck, with a knotted, twisted or cross-cutout structure in the middle, revealing a small amount of waist and abdomen lines, the fabric is light and soft, retaining natural folds. The bottom is light blue high-waisted jeans, the denim is slightly stiff, and the waistband and pocket structure are clearly identifiable.

The composition must retain the circular mirror as the main frame, the blue sky in the mirror occupies a large area of negative space, the character is not standing dead center, the phone covers the face, the hair has a sense of wind, and the middle knot of the top and the high-waisted tangent of the jeans clearly exist. The mirror surface is clean and clear, allowing only very slight natural reflection softening, without adding heavy grain, dirty mirror surfaces, strong glare and complex reflections.

The lighting uses bright and soft natural sunlight, the character's skin, white top, phone shell and denim are all evenly illuminated, without strong hard shadows. The overall color relationship is controlled as: about 34% low-saturation azure sky, 24% warm white top and white fluffy edges, 13% natural warm skin tone, 11% deep brown-black hair and local shadows, 10% light blue jeans, 8% light warm gray mirror frame and phone reflection transitions. The blue sky controls the main color field, the white top and fluff control the refreshing and bright feeling, and the denim blue and warm skin tone undertake the summer relaxed temperament, and it should not be made into a heavy filter or high-saturation internet celebrity color tone.

The overall imaging is a modern realistic digital photography feel, the picture is clear, soft, and clean, the clothing fabric, denim, mirror frame, hands and hair strands should all be identifiable. The edges of the hair strands can have a slight wind-blown loose feel, but cannot be blurred into low definition. The overall looks like a designed life-like summer mirror selfie photo.

Soran three-layer natural watermark

The second layer of hidden watermark: The hidden “Soran” is integrated into the direction of the white fluffy fibers, the fold texture of the top and the twill weave of the denim.

The third layer of microscopic watermark: The miniature “Soran” is naturally formed by denim stitching, pocket topstitching, fluffy fibers, phone edge details and hair strand intersections.

All Soran must be integrated with the clothing and environmental materials, obvious but natural, without floating lettering.

4:5 竖幅，真人写实夏日镜面自拍人像，成年东亚女性，主体出现在一面大圆形镜子中，镜子几乎占满画面，镜外一圈是白色蓬松绒毛或长纤维软质边缘，形成柔软外框。镜中背景为大面积纯净的低饱和天青蓝天空，保留少量极淡云痕，整体清爽明亮、干净通透。

人物位于镜中偏右位置，做自然随手自拍动作，一只手举着浅粉白或奶油粉色手机挡住脸部中央，手机完整遮住眼睛和大部分五官，只保留下巴、颈部和部分发际线，形成明确的遮脸自拍关系。另一只手自然插在高腰牛仔裤口袋里，肩膀放松，上身轻微后仰，腰腹自然展开。视线不直接可见，情绪由姿态、发丝和整体氛围承担，呈现轻松、自我记录、夏日感、略带时尚摆拍的状态。

发型为深棕黑色中长发，发量较多，一部分头发自然垂落在肩胸附近，另一部分被风吹向右上方或侧上方，形成明显的发丝扬起动态，打破圆镜静态构图。服装为白色或暖白色短款泡袖上衣，V 领或浅 V 领，中部有打结、扭结或交叉镂空结构，露出少量腰腹线条，布料轻薄柔软，保留自然褶皱。下装为浅蓝色高腰牛仔裤，牛仔布略硬挺，裤腰和口袋结构清楚可辨。

构图必须保留圆镜作为主画框，镜中蓝天占据大面积留白，人物不居中死站，手机遮脸，发丝有风感，上衣的中部扭结和牛仔裤的高腰切线清楚存在。镜面干净清晰，仅允许极轻微自然反射柔化，不加入重颗粒、脏污镜面、强炫光和复杂倒影。

光线采用明亮柔和的自然日光，人物皮肤、白色上衣、手机外壳和牛仔布都受到均匀照亮，没有强烈硬阴影。整体色彩关系控制为：约34%低饱和天青蓝天空，24%暖白上衣与白色绒毛边缘，13%自然暖肤色，11%深棕黑发丝与局部阴影，10%浅蓝牛仔裤，8%浅暖灰镜框与手机反光过渡。蓝天控制主色场，白色上衣和绒毛控制清爽明亮感，牛仔蓝和暖肤色承担夏日轻松气质，不能做成重滤镜或高饱和网红色调。

整体成像为现代真实数码摄影感，画面清晰、柔和、干净，衣料、牛仔布、镜框、手部和发丝都应可辨识。发丝边缘可有轻微风动松散感，但不能糊成低清。整体像一张有设计感的生活化夏日镜面自拍照片。

Soran 三层自然水印

第一层可读水印：精确文字 “Soran” 清晰可读一次，以浅灰蓝、暖灰或米白细字自然出现在白色上衣下摆的小型品牌织标位置，或浅蓝牛仔裤前口袋边缘的小型品牌标签位置，像真实服装品牌标识，位置明显、肉眼可辨，并随布料褶皱、镜面反射和日光自然变化。

第二层隐藏水印：隐藏的 “Soran” 融入白色绒毛纤维走向、上衣褶皱纹理和牛仔布斜纹织理中。

第三层微观水印：微型 “Soran” 由牛仔缝线、口袋压线、绒毛纤维、手机边缘细节和发丝交叉自然形成。

所有 Soran 都必须与服装和环境材质融合，明显但自然，不做悬浮字样。

负向词

人物完整露脸，眼睛清楚可见，强烈直视镜头，表情夸张，僵硬摆拍，镜子太小，圆镜不明显，镜外没有白色绒毛边框，镜中背景出现复杂建筑树木室内天花板，手机离脸太远，手机不遮脸，头发完全静止，风感消失，上衣没有中部扭结或镂空结构，牛仔裤不是高腰，过强滤镜，高饱和蓝色，网红磨皮，塑料皮肤，商业影楼感，重颗粒，脏污镜面，强烈鬼影，HDR，过度锐化，8K 假细节，动漫脸，AI 美女脸，多余手指，错误手部结构，额外人物，额外可读文字，额外品牌名，external watermark, sticker-like logo, detached letters, captions, subtitles, floating text, oversized branding, flat pasted logo

prompts.text: Subject: A fictional adult Japanese female, leaning over and approaching a bright supermarket frozen food cabinet, comparing products. This character image is centered on the daily concentration of selecting frozen foods and natural moments of judgment during shopping, constructed as a realistic scene for advertisements extendable to food supermarkets, frozen foods, saving, menus, and consumer behavior. Maintaining an adult-like skeleton and natural body proportions, providing a readable presence for expression, chest, and main actions sequentially in a vertical frame. A transparent freezer and packaged goods are placed at the bottom left, a black and beige shopping basket is placed at the bottom right, and shelves and small signs are placed in the background with a blur. The overlapping of foreground, mid-ground, and background strengthens the daily concentration of selecting frozen foods and natural moments of judgment during shopping, with information density and contrast gently weakening as distance from the person increases. Background objects remain clear within the scope of explaining advertising purposes for food supermarkets, frozen foods, saving, menus, and consumer behavior, creating a sense of depth that does not interfere with the protagonist's silhouette and line of sight. Clothing · Small items: Blue-gray ribbed tank top, thin white underwear straps, a thin white shirt hanging from the shoulders, light beige bottom. Solid-colored everyday shopping clothes. In the scene of daily concentration on selecting frozen foods and natural moments of judgment during shopping, the thickness of the fabric, seams, wrinkles, and boundaries with the skin are expressed according to gravity, organized into a neat outfit. Assuming advertising purposes for food supermarkets, frozen foods, saving, menus, and consumer behavior, small items maintain a size that explains the character's actions, with colors and reflections naturally connecting to the main color of the clothing. Pose · Fingers · Contact: Leaning significantly forward from the waist, neck extending toward the freezer. The left index finger descends near the edge of the cabinet, the right arm flows toward the back, and the chest and shoulders form a diagonal axis. Communicating the daily concentration of selecting frozen foods and natural moments of judgment during shopping, evoking a sense of movement before and after the static image by linking the directions of the neck, shoulders, elbows, wrists, and pelvis into one motion. Looking natural even in advertisements for food supermarkets, frozen foods, saving, menus, and consumer behavior, with fingers having clearly visible numbers and joints, transmitting pressure to the contacted fabric or props. Expression · Line of Sight: Eyes concentrated on the products at the bottom left, lips slightly pursed. The horizontal expression naturally conveys the seriousness of comparing options and daily small hesitations. The movements of eyebrows, eyelids, cheeks, and corners of the mouth are unified in the same emotion, conveying the daily concentration of selecting frozen foods and natural moments of judgment during shopping without words. Maintaining the sense of trust required for food supermarket, frozen food, saving, menu, and consumer behavior advertisements, the direction of gaze is consistent with the pose and target object, prioritizing the reaction of that moment over a deliberate smile. Face · Makeup: A small oval face visible from the side, straight eyebrows, large deep brown pupils, a short nose tip, low-saturation rose-colored lips. Soft reflections from store lighting remain on the cheeks and nose. To support the expression of daily concentration in selecting frozen foods and natural moments of judgment during shopping, small light and dark differences are created on the left and right cheeks, bridge of the nose, chin, and lips according to the light source, retaining an adult-like three-dimensionality. Adapted for food supermarket, frozen food, saving, menu, and consumer behavior advertisements, makeup is organized with beige-brown eyes, thin peach cheeks, and a moisturizing low-saturation lip gloss. Hair: Shoulder-length black hair loosely tied in the back, thin bangs and short strands in front of the ears hanging along the face. Let the hair ends flow toward the neck and shoulders according to the movement. Matching the atmosphere of daily concentration in selecting frozen foods and natural moments of judgment during shopping, changing the thickness of hair strands from root to tip, making the overlap of bangs, back hair, and shoulders conform to the pose. Even in small displays of food supermarket, frozen food, saving, menu, and consumer behavior advertisements, the face will not sink; bright parts have delicate luster, and the inner layers are deep colors. Light Source: White lighting from the ceiling serves as a uniform main light, creating bright surfaces on the face, chest, arms, and basket. A faint auxiliary light reflects from inside the freezer, slightly blurring the background lighting. Ensuring the protagonist is readable in food supermarket, frozen food, saving, menu, and consumer behavior advertisements, placing small reflections suitable for the material on the pupils, lips, hair, fabric, and main small items, and smoothly decreasing exposure from the face toward the background. The color temperature difference between the main light and ambient light is organized within a range that maintains the sense of time for daily concentration in selecting frozen foods and natural moments of judgment during shopping. Color · Tone: Dominated by white, blue-gray, beige, and black, with pastel colors of packaged products remaining as subtle background accents. Keeping skin neutral warm tones. To support the daily concentration of selecting frozen foods and natural moments of judgment during shopping with color, connecting mid-tones from the brightest skin and fabric to deep background shadows, with main colors not becoming muddy. Even when scaled down, the sequence of expression, chest, and action will not collapse, creating brightness differences and leaving a quiet background surface usable for text layout in food supermarket, frozen food, saving, menu, and consumer behavior advertisements. Material · Fine Texture: The vertical ribbing of the tank top, the light transparency of the thin shirt, shoulder straps, hair strands, fingers and nails, the hard resin of the basket, the metal and glass of the cabinet, and reflections on packaging are depicted separately. In the scene of daily concentration on selecting frozen foods and natural moments of judgment during shopping, concentrating precision on close-up parts and gently weakening outlines as distance increases. Considering the final size for food supermarket, frozen food, saving, menu, and consumer behavior advertisements, skin retains pores and fine blood color, expressing the touch of fabric, hair, and hard objects with different textures. Composition · Camera: A 9:16 vertical shopping action portrait. The actual visual center of the chest is near 50% of the screen width, the center of the face is near 24%, both eyes are at about 25% from the top, and the shopping basket is at about 28% from the bottom. Allowing slight cropping of the face edges, using a close-up wide-angle to emphasize the tilted upper body and cabinet. To convey daily concentration in selecting frozen foods and natural moments of judgment during shopping in the shortest time, placing the face, chest, and main hands or props within the same finished frame, reducing avoidable unilateral blank space. Ensuring the protagonist is not blurred in food supermarket, frozen food, saving, menu, and consumer behavior advertisements, the focal plane centers on the character's eyes and chest, and the background is adjusted to a depth of field where the scene is recognizable. Image Processing · Finish: Vivid digital development like a life snapshot. Neutralizing the store's white, separating skin from bluish-gray clothing, and suppressing local contrast of products inside the cabinet. Moderately adding sharpness to hair, pupils, fingers, and basket edges. Within the range of not destroying the daily concentration of selecting frozen foods and natural moments of judgment during shopping, adjusting white balance, black levels, local contrast, noise reduction, and sharpness to achieve a balance between skin and clothing details. Achieving a clean photographic expression that does not show artificial outlines even in food supermarket, frozen food, saving, menu, and consumer behavior advertisements. Collapse Avoidance · Prohibitions: Fixed to the same woman, the posture of leaning toward the freezer, fingertips, bluish-gray top, shopping basket in front. Do not add extra fingers, distorted shoulders, merged baskets, readable brand names, text, logos, watermarks, shelf repetition collapses, or excessive wide-angle distortion. Do not add invisible limbs or furniture based on speculation; physically organize the connection of the human body, clothing, small items, and background. Protecting authenticity and the daily concentration of selecting frozen foods and natural moments of judgment during shopping, not performing mechanical proximity or replacement with other scenes solely for exposure purposes.

被摄主体：
一位虚构的成年日本女性，弯腰凑近明亮的超市冷冻食品柜，比较商品。这一人物形象以选择冷冻食品的日常专注和购物中自然的判断瞬间为核心，构建为可扩展至食品超市、冷冻食品、节约、菜单、消费者行为的广告的现实主义一幕。保持成人般的骨架和自然的体型比例，在纵向画面中赋予表情、胸口、主要动作依次可读的存在感。

地点・时间・背景：
食品超市，白色的天花板灯并排排列。左下方放置透明冷冻柜和包装商品，右下方放置黑与米色的购物篮，后方模糊放置货架和小指示牌。前景、中景、背景的重叠强化选择冷冻食品的日常专注和购物中自然的判断瞬间，从人物渐远处，信息量和对比度温和减弱。背景物体在说明食品超市、冷冻食品、节约、菜单、消费者行为广告用途的范围内保持清晰，营造不干扰主角轮廓和视线的纵深感。

服装・小物：
蓝灰色的罗纹背心、细白的内衣肩带、从肩部垂下的薄白衬衫、浅米色的下装。纯色日常购物服。在选择冷冻食品的日常专注和购物中自然的判断瞬间的画面中，顺着重力表现布料厚度、接缝、褶皱、与皮肤的边界，整理成整洁的装束。假设食品超市、冷冻食品、节约、菜单、消费者行为的广告用途，小物保持解释人物行动的大小，颜色和反射自然连接至服装主色。

姿势・手指・接触：
从腰部大幅前倾，脖子向冷冻柜方向伸展。左手食指降至柜缘附近，右臂向后方流动，胸部和肩膀形成斜轴。传递选择冷冻食品的日常专注和购物中自然的判断瞬间，通过将脖子、肩膀、肘部、手腕、骨盆的方向联动成一个运动，唤起静止画前后动态的感觉。即便在食品超市、冷冻食品、节约、菜单、消费者行为的广告中也显得自然，手指明确可见的数量和关节，向接触的布料或道具传递压力。

表情・视线：
双眼集中于左下方的商品，嘴唇轻轻抿起。横向表情自然传达比较选项的认真和日常小犹豫。眉毛、眼睑、脸颊、嘴角的动作统一于同一情感，无需言语传递选择冷冻食品的日常专注和购物中自然的判断瞬间。保持食品超市、冷冻食品、节约、菜单、消费者行为广告所需的信赖感，视线方向与姿势和目标物体一致，优先于刻意笑容，转而强调那一瞬间的反应。

脸部・妆容：
从侧面可见的小卵形脸、直眉、大而深棕色的瞳孔、短鼻尖、低饱和度的玫瑰色嘴唇。在脸颊和鼻子上残留店内照明柔和的反光。为支撑选择冷冻食品的日常专注和购物中自然的判断瞬间的表情，在左右脸颊、鼻梁、下巴、嘴唇上根据光源制造小的明暗差，保留成人般的立体感。适应食品超市、冷冻食品、节约、菜单、消费者行为广告，妆容以米棕色眼部、薄桃色脸颊、保湿感的低饱和度唇彩整理。

头发：
及肩下的黑发在后方松散扎起，薄刘海和耳前短发束沿脸部垂落。顺着动作让发梢流向脖子和肩膀。配合选择冷冻食品的日常专注和购物中自然的判断瞬间的氛围，从发根到发梢改变发束粗细，将刘海、后发、与肩膀的重叠顺应姿势。即便在食品超市、冷冻食品、节约、菜单、消费者行为广告的小显示中脸部也不会沉没，明亮部分细腻光泽，内侧分层深色。

光源：
天花板的白色照明作为均匀主光，在脸部、胸口、手臂、篮子上制造明亮面。从冷冻柜内部反射微弱辅助光，将背景照明小幅模糊。确保食品超市、冷冻食品、节约、菜单、消费者行为广告中主角可读，在瞳孔、嘴唇、头发、布料、主要小物上放置适合材质的小反射，从脸部向背景平滑降低曝光。主光与环境光的色温差在保持选择冷冻食品的日常专注和购物中自然的判断瞬间的时间感范围内整理。

颜色・色调：
以白、蓝灰、米色、黑为主调，将包装商品的淡彩色作为背景细微点缀残留。保持皮肤中性暖色。为以颜色支撑选择冷冻食品的日常专注和购物中自然的判断瞬间，从最亮的皮肤和布料到背景深影连接中间调，主色之间不混浊。即便缩小时，表情、胸口、动作的顺序也不会崩坏，制造明度差，残留食品超市、冷冻食品、节约、菜单、消费者行为广告的文字布局可用的静谧背景面。

材质・细微质感：
背心的纵向罗纹、薄衬衫的透光、肩带、发束、手指与指甲、篮子的硬质树脂、柜子的金属与玻璃、包装的反光分别描绘。在选择冷冻食品的日常专注和购物中自然的判断瞬间的画面中，向特写部分集中精细度，距离渐远处温和弱化轮廓。考虑食品超市、冷冻食品、节约、菜单、消费者行为广告的完成尺寸，皮肤残留毛孔和细微血色，以不同质感表现布料、头发、硬质物的触感。

构图・相机：
纵向9:16的购物动作肖像。实际胸部视觉中心在画面宽度的50%附近，脸部中心在24%附近，双目在上端约25%，购物篮在下端约28%。允许脸端轻微裁剪，以近距离广角强调斜向上身和柜子。为最短时间内传递选择冷冻食品的日常专注和购物中自然的判断瞬间，将脸部、胸口、主要手部或道具收纳于同一完成画面，削减可回避的单侧空白。确保食品超市、冷冻食品、节约、菜单、消费者行为广告中主角不模糊，焦点面以人物眼睛和胸口为中心，背景调整至可辨识场景的景深。

图像处理・完成：
生活快照般的鲜明数字显像。将店内白色中性化，分离皮肤与青灰色服装，抑制柜内商品的局部对比。适度添加头发、瞳孔、手指、篮子边缘的锐度。在不破坏选择冷冻食品的日常专注和购物中自然的判断瞬间的范围内，调整白平衡、黑电平、局部对比、噪点降低、锐度，实现皮肤与服装细节的兼顾。完成食品超市、冷冻食品、节约、菜单、消费者行为广告中也不会出现人工轮廓的、干净的照片表现。

崩溃回避・禁止：

prompts.text:
Hyper-realistic outdoor terrace portrait photography, vertical aspect ratio approximately 3:4, a young adult East Asian female, clearly adult, sitting sideways on a gray woven leisure chair, with a deep green forest, a calm lake, and warm brown wooden railings in the background. The photographer is located directly in front of the subject slightly to the left about 1.5–2 meters away, using a 28–35mm equivalent lens, with the camera position close to the seat height tilted slightly upward, capturing the subject from the top of the head down to the high heels, the subject occupying about 80% of the frame, with a slight mobile phone wide-angle perspective.

The person has a small to medium frame, narrow shoulders, a slender waist, natural and soft volume in the hips and thighs, long slender legs, with an overall compact and natural light hourglass proportion. Do not include a bodybuilder physique, extreme wide hips, or excessively thin paper-like proportions.

The person is sitting diagonally on the right side of the chair, with the body angled about 30° toward the front-left of the frame, the upper body leaning back slightly, the right hand propped on the right side of the chair surface with the arm basically straight; there is a set of black-gray line text/pattern tattoos on the outer side of the right forearm. The head is tilted slightly to the left, the face turned toward the camera, the expression is calm and cold, and the lips are naturally closed.

The leg posture is the focus: one leg is raised with the knee high, the knee close to chest and abdomen height, and the lower leg pointing diagonally down to the left; the other leg is folded horizontally in front of the chair seat, the two legs forming a clear staggered layer, a lazy but stable posture.

The person has short raven-black Bob hair, length to the chin, the top of the head is rounded and smooth, and the ends of the hair are slightly curled inward; in front of the forehead are thick and neat long shattered straight bangs, close to the upper edge of the eyes, with short hair on both sides tucked against the face. The skin tone is fair and cool-toned, the face shape is a small oval, dark almond eyes, light pink eye makeup, and nude pink lip color, an overall Japanese-style cool-toned makeup.

The upper body wears a pure black strapless short mini dress, the chest is a horizontal tube structure with small ruffles at the top, and the fabric is soft thin cotton or slightly wrinkled cloth. The dress body is loose but the waist still has a natural constriction, hanging from the chest to the upper thighs, and the hem has multiple layers of irregular fine pleats and slight ruffles. No tight bodycon skirts, no shiny leather.

The legs wear black semi-transparent thigh-high stockings + garter belt structure. The raised leg wears approximately 15–20D smoky black transparent stockings, which can clearly show the skin tone, and the stocking top is located near the base of the thigh with a narrow black edge. The upper thigh of the other leg has a prominent wide black floral lace garter band, the lace having semi-transparent patterns and a slight shimmering silk effect; several thin black garter straps connect diagonally from under the skirt hem to the stocking tops, forming a clear but not complex garter structure. The stockings continue to cover the calves and feet. No thick black socks, fishnets, or pantyhose.

Wearing black patent leather open-toe stiletto high-heeled sandals, the upper is composed of several thin black straps, with a buckle strap at the ankle and small silver metal decorations, the stiletto heels are about 9–11cm. The heel of the raised leg is near the edge of the chair, and the other shoe is partially blocked by the leg.

The chair is a gray metal frame + gray-black woven backrest + gray cushion. Behind the person is a circle of warm brown-red wooden terrace railings, with horizontal wooden beams running through the frame; outside the railings is a dense deep green mountain forest and a quiet, narrow lake/river channel, the water surface is dark green, with layers of trees in the distance. The sky is overcast and white, slightly overexposed, with no obvious sun.

The lighting uses overcast natural light + front weak flash / portable digital camera fill light, the person's face, neck, and exposed thighs are significantly brightened, and the skin tone is cool white; the forest and lake are slightly darker, creating a separation between the subject and the background. The overall texture is a 2000s Japanese-style digital camera / CCD outdoor portrait: slight soft focus, direct flash feel, a small amount of grain, limited dynamic range, natural skin texture, no modern HDR or commercial-grade over-sharpening.

Key locks: short black Bob + thick bangs + black strapless ruffled mini dress + sitting sideways on a gray chair + one leg raised with knee high + the other leg folded horizontally + semi-transparent black thigh-high stockings + wide floral lace garter band + thin garter straps + black open-toe stiletto heels + right forearm tattoo + wooden terrace railing + forest lake + overcast + old digital camera weak flash texture.

Avoid: long hair, high ponytail, standing posture, straight legs, regular black pantyhose, white socks, no garter straps, thick cotton socks, long dresses, tight leather skirts, sneakers, block heels, indoor backgrounds, city streets, beaches, strong sunlight, cinematic color grading, heavy background blur, anime faces, CG feel, plastic skin, extra limbs, watermarks and garbled text.
