prompts.text:
1:2 vertical aspect ratio, realistic minimalist environmental portrait, close-up bust shot of an adult East Asian woman, the figure is positioned in the center-right of the frame, body leaning gently against a light gray-white wall, head tilted slightly toward the wall side, eyes closed, brow relaxed, lips naturally closed or very slightly parted, expression quiet, immersive, restrained, like a momentary pause when hit by sunlight. The figure wears a black or deep ink-colored soft V-neck top, the fabric forming a large area of dark shadows, creating a strong contrast of light and dark with the lit neck and collarbone.

The left side of the frame is a large area of pure black or near-black negative space, and the right side is a clean light gray-white wall; the two constitute a minimalist black and white background partition. The figure's face, neck, collarbone, and upper chest are obliquely illuminated by a beam of warm white to golden natural sunlight, forming a very clear high-light band, with brightness concentrated but not diffusing into a whole-frame yellow mist. The face retains soft natural lighting, and the high-light section of the neck and chest is the first visual anchor. The hair is long deep brown-black hair, part of it hanging down the shoulders, the other part blown to the left by a light breeze, with edges lit by backlighting, forming warm golden-brown hair strand highlights and a slight sense of floating. A small section of low-weight rainbow-colored lens flare is reserved at the bottom of the frame as a foreground optical layer, positioned at the bottom edge, weakened, not competing with the main subject.

The overall texture is clean, restrained, modern realistic photography style, with the focus on the closed-eye still posture, strong neck and chest light bands, large black clothing dark blocks, backlit hair strands, and minimalist background relationship. The figure's skin maintains a true warm neutral tone, retaining natural facial structure, slight light and dark fluctuations, real lip texture, and hair strand obstruction, no commercial skin smoothing, no AI beauty faces, no over-sharpening. The focus falls on the face, the main body of hair strands, and the neckline area; the hair ends and a few backlit flyaway strands can be slightly soft. The overall look is like a quiet portrait caught by a real photographer in a window-side or semi-indoor natural light environment, simple, high-end, and natural.

Color relationship control: approximately 31% near-black shadow background and black clothing, 21% light gray-white wall, 14% warm white to golden high-light band, 12% soft warm white skin tone, 10% warm brown backlit edges of hair strands, 12% a very small amount of low-saturation blue-green iridescent flare at the bottom. The black and white partition must be clean, warm light only concentrated on the figure's neck, chest, and partial face, and iridescence only appearing in small amounts at the bottom, strictly not diffusing into a full-frame filter.

Soran three-layer natural watermark

Layer one readable watermark: The precise text "Soran" is clearly readable once, naturally embroidered with low-contrast mercerized gray-silver thread on the hem of the black V-neck near the collarbone, like a real high-end clothing brand embroidery, the position is obvious but does not overwhelm the face, changing naturally according to the neckline curve, fabric folds, perspective, and lighting.

Layer two hidden watermark: The hidden "Soran" is integrated into the backlit hair highlight arrangement and the very subtle surface texture of the light gray-white wall on the right.

Layer three microscopic watermark: The miniature "Soran" is jointly formed by the neckline stitches, fabric fibers, hair strand crossings, and tiny chromatic dispersion textures at the bottom rainbow edges.

If referencing the original image, remove any external stickers or platform logos from the original, only keeping the naturally embedded "Soran".

Negative words

Eyes open, looking directly at the camera, exaggerated expressions, stiff posing, even lighting, full face and body evenly lit, photo studio style, commercial skin smoothing, plastic skin, porcelain white skin, AI beauty face, anime face, perfectly symmetrical features, over-sharpening, HDR, 8K fake details, complex indoor backgrounds, background ornaments, curtains and furniture stealing the spotlight, large area of rainbow flare, full-frame warm yellow filter, full-frame color filter, hair completely still, hair too neat, dirty white wall, black background turning gray, extra figures, extra hands, extra text, photography signature, platform logos, external watermark, sticker-like logo, detached letters, captions, subtitles, floating text, oversized branding, flat pasted logo.

prompts.text:

画面左侧为大面积纯黑或近黑负空间，右侧为干净浅灰白墙面，两者构成极简黑白背景分区。人物面部、颈部、锁骨和上胸被一束暖白偏金色的自然阳光斜切照亮，形成非常清晰的高亮光带，亮度集中但不扩散成整张黄雾。脸部保留柔和自然受光，颈部和胸口的高亮切面是第一视觉锚点。头发为深棕黑色长发，一部分顺肩垂下，另一部分被轻风吹向左侧，边缘被逆光点亮，形成暖金棕色发丝高光和轻微漂浮感。画面下方保留一小段低权重彩虹色镜头炫光，作为前景光学层，位置在底部边缘，弱化处理，不抢主体。

整体质感是干净、克制、现代写实摄影感，重点在闭眼静止姿态、强烈颈胸光带、黑衣大暗块、逆光发丝和极简背景关系。人物皮肤保持真实暖中性，保留自然面部结构、轻微明暗起伏、真实嘴唇质感和发丝遮挡，不做商业磨皮，不做 AI 美女脸，不做过度锐化。对焦落在面部、发丝主体和领口区域，发尾和少量逆光飞丝可略柔。整体像真实摄影师在靠窗或半室内自然光环境中抓到的一张安静人像，简洁、高级、自然。

色彩关系控制为：约 31% 近黑暗部背景与黑色服装，21% 浅灰白墙面，14% 暖白偏金高亮光带，12% 柔和暖白肤色，10% 发丝暖棕逆光边，12% 底部极少量低饱和蓝绿虹彩炫光。黑白分区必须干净，暖光只集中在人物颈胸和局部面部，虹彩只在底部少量出现，绝不能扩散成全画面滤镜。

Soran 三层自然水印

第一层可读水印：精确文字 “Soran” 清晰可读一次，以低对比丝光灰银线自然绣在黑色 V 领靠近锁骨的领口缝边，像真实高端服装品牌刺绣，位置明显但不压脸，顺着领口弧度、布料褶皱、透视和受光自然变化。

第二层隐藏水印：隐藏 “Soran” 融入被逆光照亮的发丝高光排列，以及右侧浅灰白墙面非常细微的表面肌理中。

第三层微观水印：微型 “Soran” 由领口针脚、衣料纤维、发丝交叉和底部虹彩边缘细小色散纹理共同形成。

如果参考原图，需去掉原图里任何外贴式角标或平台标识，只保留自然嵌入的 Soran。

负向词

睁眼，直视镜头，夸张表情，僵硬摆拍，均匀布光，全脸全身平均受光，影楼风，商业磨皮，塑料皮肤，瓷白皮肤，AI 美女脸，动漫脸，完美对称五官，过度锐化，HDR，8K 假细节，复杂室内背景，背景摆件，窗帘家具抢镜，大面积彩虹炫光，全图暖黄滤镜，全图彩色滤镜，头发完全不动，头发过于整齐，白墙脏乱，黑背景发灰，额外人物，额外手部，额外文字，摄影签名，平台角标，external watermark, sticker-like logo, detached letters, captions, subtitles, floating text, oversized branding, flat pasted logo

prompts.text:

Preserve a cold desaturated lavender-magenta cast, deep crushed blacks, low saturation, and a moody nocturnal gothic atmosphere. Skin should look pale and realistic with subtle pores, faint texture, slight imperfections, and minimal retouching. Add subtle high-ISO noise, fine grain, faint compression artifacts, slight bloom on highlights, and a raw late-night flash-photo feeling. Background should remain nearly black and indistinct. 50–85mm look, close distance, f/2.0–f/2.8, shallow depth of field.

items.title: 喷泉边的白色缎面裙女子深夜时尚人像

prompts.text:
Ultra-realistic nighttime fashion portrait of a young adult woman sitting on the curved stone edge of an ornate garden fountain, photographed with strong direct flash against a dark outdoor background. The mood should feel glamorous, feminine, slightly theatrical, and romantic—like a late-night party photo at a private villa or European estate.

She has very long straight dark brunette hair with a smooth glossy finish, parted near the center and falling over both shoulders. Makeup is polished and soft: defined brows, subtle winged eyeliner, long lashes, warm blush, luminous skin, and glossy nude-pink lips. Her expression is calm and slightly sultry, head tilted gently to one side while looking toward the camera.

Outfit: a structured white corset-inspired mini dress with a sweetheart neckline and sculpted bust, fitted closely through the waist with visible boning seams. The center front features black ribbon lacing running vertically through small loops, finished with a neat black satin bow near the neckline. The lower half transitions into a very short layered white satin skirt with multiple soft ruffled tiers, creating a playful romantic silhouette.

The dress should feel polished and fashion-forward rather than costume-like, with crisp white satin, subtle sheen, and clean tailoring.

Accessories: minimal delicate jewelry, tiny stud earrings or small hoops, subtle rings, pale manicure. No necklace to keep the neckline clean.

Pose: seated sideways on the wide stone rim of the fountain with the torso leaning slightly backward. One hand is placed behind her on the stone ledge to support her body, while the other arm rests naturally along her side or thigh. One leg bends forward while the other extends diagonally toward the foreground, creating a relaxed asymmetrical pose. Shoulders open, chin slightly raised.

Environment: elegant outdoor garden at night with a large classical tiered stone fountain directly behind her, water streams visibly falling from the upper bowls. Surrounding the fountain are dense dark-green hedges, leafy shrubs, and subtle garden landscaping. Small warm landscape lights glow softly in the distant background, while most of the garden remains deep and shadowy.

Lighting: strong on-camera flash illuminating the woman, white dress, and pale stone fountain sharply against the dark garden. Bright specular highlights on satin and skin, deep black shadows in the foliage, subtle reflective sparkle in the falling water, slight red-eye-era digital-camera feel without actual red eye.

Photography: early-2000s compact digital camera aesthetic, direct flash, mild grain, slight overexposure on the white fabric, realistic skin texture, minimal retouching, strong contrast, subtle low-light noise, glamorous candid party-photo energy, photorealistic, high resolution.

Composition: vertical 3:4 frame, subject centered slightly right, fountain architecture rising behind her, dark foliage filling the left and upper background, seated pose framed from thighs upward or nearly full body, slightly imperfect handheld crop.

Negative prompt: daytime garden, bridal gown, wedding styling, ballroom, neon nightclub, heavy jewelry, black dress, long skirt, extreme bokeh, soft studio lighting, plastic skin, distorted hands, extra fingers, malformed fountain, duplicated ribbons, warped anatomy, cartoon, anime, illustration, CGI.

prompts.text:
一名成年女性坐在华丽花园喷泉弧形石边上的超写实深夜时尚人像，采用强烈的直闪光灯拍摄，背景为黑暗的户外。氛围应具有魅力、女性化、略带戏剧感且浪漫——就像私人别墅或欧洲庄园深夜派对上的照片。

她留着极长的深褐色直发，表面平滑亮丽，近乎中分，垂在双肩。妆容精致柔和：轮廓分明的眉毛、细微的猫眼眼线、长睫毛、暖色调腮红、发光的皮肤和亮泽的裸粉色嘴唇。她的表情平静且略带妩媚，头微微向一侧倾斜，同时望向镜头。

服装：一件结构化的白色胸衣式迷你连衣裙，带有甜心领口和雕塑感的胸部设计，腰部紧身且有明显的鱼骨缝线。中心正前方有黑色丝带垂直穿过小孔，并在领口附近打了一个整洁的黑色缎面蝴蝶结。下半身过渡为极短的多层白色缎面裙，带有多个柔软的褶皱层级，营造出俏皮浪漫的轮廓。

连衣裙应感觉精致且走在时尚前沿，而非像演出服，采用挺括的白色缎面，带有微妙的光泽和简洁的剪裁。

配饰：极简精致的珠宝，微小的耳钉或小耳环，细微的戒指，浅色美甲。不戴项链以保持领口洁净。

姿势：侧身坐在喷泉宽阔的石缘上，躯干微微向后倾斜。一只手放在身后的石台上以支撑身体，另一只手臂自然垂在侧面或大腿上。一条腿向前弯曲，另一条腿向斜前方延伸，营造出轻松的不对称姿势。双肩打开，下巴微抬。

环境：夜晚优雅的户外花园，身后紧挨着一座大型古典分层石质喷泉，可见水流从上层水碗落下。喷泉周围是茂密的深绿色树篱、多叶灌木和细致的花园景观。远处背景中微弱的暖色景观灯发出柔和的光，而花园的大部分区域仍处于深邃且阴暗的状态。

光线：强烈的机载闪光灯照亮了女性、白色连衣裙和苍白的石质喷泉，与黑暗的花园形成鲜明对比。缎面和皮肤上有明亮的镜面高光，树叶中有深黑色的阴影，落水中带有细微的反射闪烁，具有轻微的红眼时代数码相机感，但没有实际的红眼。

摄影：2000年代初期紧凑型数码相机的美学，直闪，轻微颗粒感，白色织物略微曝光过度，真实的皮肤纹理，极简修饰，强对比度，细微的弱光噪点，充满魅力的随性派对照片能量，照片级真实感，高分辨率。

构图：垂直 3:4 画幅，主体略微偏右居中，喷泉建筑在身后升起，深色叶群填满左侧和上方背景，坐姿取景范围从大腿向上或近乎全身，略微不完美的手持裁剪。

负向提示词：白天花园，婚纱，婚礼造型，宴会厅，霓虹夜总会，厚重珠宝，黑色连衣裙，长裙，极端虚化，柔和的影棚灯光，塑料感皮肤，畸形的手，多出的手指，畸形的喷泉，重复的丝带，扭曲的解剖结构，卡通，动漫，插画，CGI。

items.title: 晨曦微光中慵懒的卧室私密自拍

prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
超写实近距离卧室床上自拍摄影，竖版约 4:5，一名年轻成年东亚女性，明确成年，半躺半侧卧在凌乱床铺上，从身体斜上方用手机近距离自拍。采用约 24–30mm 等效前置/手机广角镜头，摄影距离非常近，约 35–60cm，镜头位于人物脸部右上方并向下俯拍，画面带明显近大远小透视：脸部、肩颈、胸口和靠近镜头的上半身占据大面积前景，下半身只保留部分腰胯和大腿。不要全身，不要拉远。

人物为年轻成年东亚女性，中小骨架，肩部偏窄，胸廓相对窄，上半身明显丰满，胸部体积自然偏大，腰腹较纤细，胯部和大腿有柔软真实体积。身材必须呈自然丰满沙漏比例，不要生成高挑纸片人、窄胯细腿，也不要健美肌肉型。近距离广角会让胸肩略微放大，但人体结构必须真实，不要夸张成不自然球形。

人物身体斜躺在床上，头部位于画面右上，骨盆和大腿延伸向画面左下。上半身微微朝镜头抬起，右肩更靠近镜头，左肩略低。躯干有轻微侧转，形成自然胸腰曲线。下半身侧躺，左侧大腿从画面左下进入，另一条腿被身体和床铺部分遮挡。

人物一只手臂从画面右下向前伸出，像正在举手机自拍，手臂只保留部分前臂和上臂，不需要手机进入画面。另一只手自然放在下腹/裙摆附近，手指轻轻抓住或压住睡裙布料，姿态随意，不做比心、剪刀手等动作。

人物留乌黑色中长直发，长度到胸口以下，发量自然偏多。头发因为侧躺而向人物右侧和床面散开，部分发丝贴在脸颊、颈部、锁骨和胸口。额前是长碎刘海/偏分刘海，多束细发垂过额头和眼睛附近，略显凌乱、潮湿，不要整齐齐刘海，不要高马尾或大卷发。

脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，下颌柔和，肤色白皙偏冷粉。人物双眼略微半睁，眼神看向镜头，眼皮有轻微疲倦感，表情慵懒、发热、像刚睡醒。嘴巴自然微张，露出少量上牙，不笑。嘴唇为浅粉、珊瑚粉色，表面明显湿润有光泽。

眼妆偏自然但有清楚睫毛，眼线细，眼尾轻微上扬；眼周有淡淡粉红色。鼻梁小巧，鼻尖和鼻梁有明显高光。不要浓重欧美妆，不要过度修容。

人物皮肤呈非常明显的潮湿 / 出汗 / 刚洗完澡后的湿润质感：额头、鼻梁、鼻尖、双颊、下巴、颈部、锁骨、肩膀和上胸均有细密水光和汗珠反射。不是油腻塑料皮肤，而是真实水膜、细小汗珠和自然皮肤高光。锁骨到胸口区域有数条细小湿润反光，肩膀和脸颊也能看到不规则水光。头发局部因潮湿贴住皮肤。

人物穿一件浅薰衣草粉 / 淡紫粉色缎面细肩带睡裙 / 吊带家居裙。面料为非常柔软的真丝/仿真丝缎面，带明显细腻高光和自然褶皱，颜色介于淡紫、灰粉和珠光粉之间。

睡裙采用超细肩带＋低圆领/浅 U 领结构，肩带很细，一侧肩带因人物侧躺略微向肩外滑落，但仍保持穿着状态。领口低而宽，贴合胸部下缘，布料受身体张力产生自然弧形褶皱，不要生成硬质胸衣、运动内衣或蕾丝胸罩。

睡裙上半身贴合但不完全紧身，胸口下方和腰腹处出现大量柔软横向褶皱。裙摆长度较短，到大腿上部附近，人物侧躺后裙摆自然向上堆叠并露出部分大腿，但保持正常完整服装覆盖。不要生成透明材质，不要生成内裤外露。

场景为普通私人卧室。人物躺在浅灰白 / 冷灰米色床单与被子上，床品略乱，有大量自然褶皱。人物头部右侧靠着一只浅灰或淡粉灰枕头，另一只米白枕头位于头后方。

背景左上可见一扇带白色横向百叶窗的窗户，窗外光线很亮。百叶窗投进来的自然日光在墙面和床头区域形成柔和浅色光斑。墙面为冷灰绿色/浅灰米色。

人物头后方靠墙位置有一个小型白色床头柜，上面放着一只透明塑料矿泉水瓶、水杯或小型日用品，细节保持真实但不要抢主体。

光线采用左上方窗户自然日光＋室内环境反射光。日光偏冷白并略带暖金色边缘，从左上斜射进入，人物右侧脸颊、鼻梁、嘴唇、肩膀和胸前水光产生明显高亮反射。阴影仍然柔和，没有强硬闪光灯效果。

人物脸部和上半身曝光略高，背景略暗，动态范围保持手机自拍感。床单高光局部接近纯白，但不完全过曝。肤色保持冷白、微粉，湿润区域反光更强。

整体呈真实高质量手机自拍视频截图/自拍照片质感：轻微手机广角、轻度数码锐化、自然高光、少量 JPEG 压缩、局部柔焦，皮肤保留毛孔和微小色差。不要商业棚拍，不要 8K 过度锐化，不要塑料磨皮。

整体色调以冷灰卧室＋浅紫粉缎面睡裙＋白皙粉冷肤色＋黑色湿发＋柔和窗边日光为主，氛围安静、慵懒、私密、刚睡醒或洗澡后的真实生活自拍感。

重点锁定：年轻成年东亚女性＋卧室床上半躺侧卧自拍＋超近距离高机位俯拍＋24–30mm 手机广角＋脸部位于右上＋身体斜向左下＋黑色中长湿发＋碎发贴脸＋半睁眼＋嘴巴微张＋全脸与肩颈胸口明显湿润水光＋自然丰满上半身＋纤细腰腹＋淡紫粉色真丝缎面细肩带短睡裙＋一侧肩带轻微滑落＋浅灰白凌乱床铺＋左上百叶窗＋床头矿泉水瓶＋自然窗光＋真实手机随手自拍。

避免：全身远景、站姿、正面平视、人物离镜头太远、纤细纸片身材、胸部明显缩小、健美肌肉型、极端夸张身材、干燥哑光皮肤、完全整齐头发、浓妆、闭嘴微笑、露齿大笑、黑色睡裙、红色睡裙

items.title: 简约背景下黑色长袖上衣少女写真

prompts.text:
Frame her from approximately the waist or lower torso upward, centered slightly below the vertical midpoint, leaving a large area of minimalist architectural background above her. Behind her are smooth pale gray wall panels with thin seams, reflective metallic elevator surfaces, and softly blurred structural details. Use warm indoor overhead lighting with gentle highlights on her skin and hair, realistic smartphone-camera depth of field, subtle background motion blur or softness, a natural 35–50mm equivalent perspective, restrained contrast, warm neutral cinematic color grading, fine skin texture, realistic fabric detail, and no excessive retouching. Aspect ratio 9:16
.

She wears exactly a fitted black ribbed long-sleeve top with an extremely deep plunging scoop neckline. The neckline is edged with delicate black lace and exposes substantial cleavage. A narrow horizontal black strap crosses the upper chest near the collarbone, while small decorative gold-toned chain details sit near the upper sides of the neckline. The sleeves are long and fitted, extending over part of her hands. A black face mask is pulled down beneath her chin rather than covering her mouth or nose. No additional outer garment should be added
.

Her hair is long, straight, glossy black to very dark brown, parted near the center and falling smoothly over both shoulders. The strands have natural shine and soft volume, framing her face without elaborate styling. She raises both hands beside her face, elbows bent, making symmetrical V-shaped peace signs with her index and middle fingers. Her fingers are slightly angled toward the camera, with long manicured nails in a warm coral-pink tone. A small yellow ring is visible on one hand
.

A photorealistic cinematic vertical portrait of a young woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, standing indoors in front of a large mirror in a modern elevator lobby or sleek contemporary interior. Her ethnicity is left unspecified because race or ethnicity cannot be reliably determined from appearance alone. She has smooth light skin with a softly luminous complexion, a petite oval face, gently tapered jawline, subtle rounded cheeks, a small straight nose, naturally shaped dark eyebrows, and dark brown almond-shaped eyes lowered toward the floor rather than looking directly at the camera. Her makeup is polished and feminine, with soft peach-pink eyeshadow, delicate eyeliner, defined lashes, subtle rosy blush, and muted coral-red lipstick. Her expression is shy, relaxed, and playful, with a faint closed-mouth smile.

prompts.text:
从腰部或下半身向上构图，中心略低于垂直中点，上方留出大面积极简主义建筑背景。她身后是带有细缝的平滑浅灰色墙面板、反光金属电梯表面以及轻微模糊的结构细节。使用温暖的室内顶灯照明，在她的皮肤和头发上投射柔和的高光，呈现真实的智能手机相机景深，细微的背景运动模糊或柔和感，自然的35–50mm等效透视，克制的对比度，温暖中性的电影级色调，细腻的皮肤纹理，真实的织物细节，且无过度修饰。长宽比 9:16。

第一眼看到强主视觉与巨大中文；第二眼发现跨区的物理关系；第三眼理解结构、材料或过程；第四眼阅读作品标题与档案信息。

同系列统一纸张、字体体系、信息层级和编辑气质，但每张根据不同【物理关系】重新设计构图，不做模板换皮。

prompts.text:
In a softly lit bedroom that feels lived‑in rather than opulent, a Korean woman stands at the edge of a low wooden nightstand. The room’s palette is restrained: muted earth tones of the wooden floor and nightstand, soft cream walls, and the amber glow of the lamp. A thin veil of night‑time shadows drapes the far corner where a folded blanket lies partially hidden, adding depth without drawing attention away from the subject. The mirror reflects a faint, hazy silhouette of the woman, reinforcing the feeling of private preparation.

The composition balances foreground intimacy such as the nightstand and her hands, with the midground of her torso and the subtle background of the room, all rendered in a photographic style that feels both real and poetically still. The image conveys a grounded, seductive moment of a Korean woman calmly getting ready for bed, captured with a calm, contemplative atmosphere and a tactile sense of the textures around her, presented in a 2:3 vertical composition.

The camera position is at the height of the person's chest to eye level, naturally shooting from the diagonal front. The focal length is about 50-70mm standard to medium telephoto. 【Hairstyle】
Thick jet-black long hair, tied into a large Oriental classical high bun, natural fluffy volume on top of the head, the bun at the back of the head is rounded and full, the structure is complex but real. Middle part in front of the forehead, a small amount of natural broken hair reserved on both sides, slender strands of hair by the ears falling naturally, several strands of black broken hair illuminated by backlight. Real black hair texture, single strands of hair are clearly visible, no plastic wigs.

【Headwear】
A large champagne gold hollow classical hair crown is worn at the top center of the bun. A large oval deep red gemstone is inlaid in the center of the crown, with symmetrical golden flowers, leaves, scrolling grass patterns, and phoenix feather structures extending around it. Several three-dimensional gilded flower hairpins are inserted on the right side of the bun, with small rubies inlaid in the flower cores. A long golden Buyao hangs on the right side, composed of fine gold chains, rubies, white pearls, and teardrop pearls, falling naturally near the neck. Metal ornaments are illuminated by the sunset, producing delicate golden highlights.

【Earrings】
Long champagne gold earrings, fine metal patterns, inlaid with rubies, connected to small teardrop pearls below.

【Clothing - Core】
The character wears an extremely gorgeous Oriental fantasy court gown. Main colors: ivory white, pearl white, champagne gold, very light teal. The clothing adopts a large-area backless design. The entire upper back is basically bare, extending from the shoulders to the waist, forming an elegant and clean back curve. The main body of the garment wraps along the sides of the body, and the chest and waist are fixed by exquisite three-dimensional gilded metal relief structures. The side chest area is covered with large champagne gold three-dimensional flower-leaf or phoenix-feather metal decorations with real metal thickness. Metal patterns include: phoenix feathers, scrolling grass patterns, petal patterns, cloud patterns, and Oriental court hollow patterns. Several deep red gemstones are inlaid in the center. No flat embroidery, the focus is on 3D gilded relief with jewelry-grade texture.

【Arm Accessories】
A large champagne gold arm ring is worn on the upper arm near the camera side. The arm ring is in the shape of Oriental scrolling grass and petals, with an oval deep red ruby inlaid in the center and golden branch structures extending around it. The metal fits the upper arm, with real weight and three-dimensional thickness.

【Back Bead Chains】
Multiple layers of extremely fine golden bead chains hang from behind the neck over the bare back. Several fine gold chains fall naturally along the spine, some forming soft arcs. The ends of the chains are connected to small teardrop gold ornaments and red gemstones. The bead chains are illuminated by warm golden backlight, producing shimmering highlights.

【Pibo - Silk Wrap】
A large area of translucent champagne gold Pibo (silk wrap) surrounds the arms and waist. The Pibo is very light and thin, a mixed material similar to transparent silk, organza, and tulle. It features: pearlescent luster, fine gold threads, slight glitter, translucent folds, and real fabric refraction. The Pibo falls naturally from the arms, forming soft flowing curves near the waist and hips of the character. No heavy ordinary Hanfu sleeves.

【Posture - Strictly Locked】
The character is standing. The body is facing away from the camera at about 60-70 degrees, showing the complete shoulder and back lines. The upper body is slightly twisted toward the camera. The head is further turned back, forming a classic Oriental beauty looking back posture. Both eyes look directly at the camera. The chin is slightly lowered. The shoulder near the camera is slightly raised, and the other shoulder extends backward. Arms fall naturally, no exaggerated movements. The overall posture is elegant, restrained, and has a sense of Oriental court nobility.

【Scene】
Traditional Chinese high-end indoor space. The character stands next to a large wooden carved window or screen. On the right side of the frame, there is a dark rosewood window frame with traditional Chinese geometric hollow patterns. Blurred green bamboo leaves can be seen outside the window. The overall background is: dark ink green, black, and dark rosewood. The indoor light is dim, and outside the window is the evening golden sunlight. The background remains simple and high-end, no modern furniture.

【Lighting - Most Critical】
Evening sunset shines into the room through the Chinese window from the back right of the character. Strong but soft warm golden backlight. The sunlight specifically outlines: top of the head, hair bun, broken hair, ear edges, neck, shoulders, shoulder blades, spine, upper arms, and Pibo edges. Forming a beautiful golden rim light. The center of the character's bare back remains in soft shadow, and both sides of the shoulders are outlined by golden contour light. Part of the sunset passes through the window panes, forming slight light and shadow spots on the character's shoulders and back. The face is illuminated by very soft warm white fill light from the front, ensuring the eyes, nose bridge, and lips are clear. Metal ornaments show real golden specular reflections, and rubies produce deep red translucency. Cinematic golden hour, warm backlight, golden rim light, soft frontal fill light, volumetric sunlight, cinematic chiaroscuro, soft highlight roll-off.

【Atmospheric Particles】
A small amount of golden glowing particles float in the air on the left side of the character. The particles are very small and the quantity is restrained. Some particles form softly dispersed golden light spots, like dust in the sunset. No magic explosions, no large amount of special effects.

【Lens】
85mm full-frame portrait lens, f/1.8-f/2.2, ISO 100-200. The camera is basically level with the character's shoulders. Medium-close-up composition, shooting from the top of the head to near the waist and hips. The character is located slightly to the left of the center of the frame. Focus specifically on the eyes and face, while maintaining high-definition details on the shoulder-back, metal arm ornaments, and parts of the Pibo. Background Chinese window panes and bamboo leaves are naturally blurred. Real optical shallow depth of field, soft creamy bokeh.

【Material Enhancement】
Real adult female skin, real shoulder and back skin micro-texture, single black hair strands, champagne gold metal, natural pearls, deep red garnet/ruby, transparent silk, translucent organza, real metal carving, real jewelry refraction, real sunset light.

【Overall Style】
Oriental mythological noble consort, gilded court beauty, magnificent, mysterious, cold and elegant, charming but restrained, possessing the temperament of a high-end Oriental movie heroine. Not an ordinary ancient costume photo, not studio Hanfu, but a court heroine costume still from a high-budget Oriental fantasy movie.

prompts.text:
9:16竖版，超写实真人摄影，高预算东方古装奇幻电影剧照，中国古典宫廷美学，奢华鎏金东方幻想风格，一位明确成年的年轻东亚女性站在古典中式室内窗边，背身面向镜头，身体呈优雅三分之二侧背姿态，头部转向镜头回眸。

【人物】

23-27岁成年东亚女性，
纤细修长、比例自然的成年女性体态，
精致自然鹅蛋脸，
小巧流畅下颌线，
白皙象牙色肌肤，
真实细腻皮肤纹理，
肩颈线条修长，
自然清晰的锁骨与肩胛骨，
背部线条纤细优雅。

深棕黑色杏仁眼，
自然双眼皮，
眼尾轻微上挑，
纤长睫毛，
暖棕红色眼影，
眼尾略微加深，
眼神清冷、安静、略带神秘感。

鼻梁纤细挺直，
鼻尖精致，
嘴唇自然饱满，
低饱和朱砂红、珊瑚红水润唇色。

额头中央点缀一枚非常小的红色古典花钿，
由红色宝石/朱砂点构成，
精致克制。

【发型】

浓密乌黑长发，
盘成大型东方古典高髻，
头顶具有自然蓬松体积，
后脑发髻圆润饱满，
结构复杂但真实。

额前中分，
两侧保留少量自然碎发，
耳侧细长发丝自然垂落，
几缕黑色碎发被逆光照亮。

真实黑发质感，
单根发丝清晰可见，
不要塑料假发。

【头饰】

发髻顶部中央佩戴一件大型香槟金镂空古典发冠。

发冠中央镶嵌一颗大型椭圆形深红色宝石，
周围延伸出对称的金色花叶、卷草纹、凤凰羽毛状结构。

发髻右侧插入数枚立体鎏金花簪，
花芯镶嵌小型红宝石。

右侧垂落长款金色步摇，
由细金链、红宝石、白珍珠、水滴珍珠组成，
自然垂落至颈部附近。

金属饰品被夕阳照射，
产生细腻金色高光。

【耳饰】

长款香槟金耳坠，
细密金属花纹，
镶嵌红宝石，
下方连接小型水滴珍珠。

【服装——核心】

人物穿一件极其华丽的东方幻想宫廷礼服。

主色：
象牙白
珍珠白
香槟金
极浅青绿色。

服装采用大面积露背设计。

整个上背部基本裸露，
从肩膀一直延伸至腰部，
形成优雅、干净的背部曲线。

服装主体沿身体侧面包裹，
胸前与腰部由精致的立体鎏金金属浮雕结构固定。

侧胸区域覆盖大型香槟金立体花叶/凤凰羽毛纹金属装饰，
具有真实金属厚度。

金属纹样呈：
凤凰羽毛
卷草纹
花瓣纹
云纹
东方宫廷镂空纹。

中央镶嵌数颗深红色宝石。

不要平面刺绣，
重点是具有珠宝级质感的3D鎏金浮雕。

【手臂饰品】

靠近镜头一侧上臂佩戴大型香槟金臂环。

臂环呈东方卷草与花瓣造型，
中央镶嵌椭圆形深红宝石，
周围延伸金色枝蔓结构。

金属贴合上臂，
具有真实重量和立体厚度。

【背部珠链】

裸背上方从颈后垂落多层极细金色珠链。

数条细金链顺着脊柱自然下垂，
部分形成柔和弧线。

链条末端连接小型水滴金饰与红色宝石。

珠链受到暖金逆光照射，
产生闪烁高光。

【披帛】

双臂与腰部环绕大面积半透明香槟金披帛。

披帛非常轻薄，
类似透明真丝、欧根纱与薄纱混合材质。

具有：
珍珠光泽
细密金丝
轻微闪粉
半透明褶皱
真实织物折射。

披帛从手臂自然滑落，
在人物腰臀附近形成柔和流动曲线。

不要厚重普通汉服袖子。

【姿态——严格锁定】

人物站立。

身体背对摄影机约60-70度，
展示完整肩背线条。

上半身轻微向镜头方向扭转。

头部进一步回转，
形成经典东方美人回眸姿态。

双眼直接看向摄影机。

下巴略微压低。

靠近镜头的肩膀略微抬起，
另一侧肩膀向后延伸。

手臂自然垂落，
不要夸张动作。

整体姿态优雅、克制、具有东方宫廷贵族感。

【场景】

传统中式高级室内空间。

人物站在大型木质雕花窗/屏风旁。

画面右侧存在深色红木窗框，
窗框具有传统中式几何镂空纹样。

窗外能够看到虚化的绿色竹叶。

背景整体为：
深墨绿
黑色
深红木色。

室内光线较暗，
窗外为傍晚金色阳光。

背景保持简洁高级，
不要现代家具。

【光线——最关键】

傍晚夕阳从人物右后方穿过中式窗户照入室内。

强烈但柔和的暖金色逆光。

阳光重点勾勒：

头顶
发髻
碎发
耳朵边缘
颈部
肩膀
肩胛骨
脊柱
上臂
披帛边缘。

形成漂亮的金色rim light。

人物裸背中央保持柔和阴影，
两侧肩部被金色轮廓光勾勒。

部分夕阳透过窗格，
在人物肩背形成轻微明暗光斑。

脸部由前方非常柔和的暖白色补光照亮，
确保眼睛、鼻梁和嘴唇清晰。

金属饰品出现真实金色镜面反射，
红宝石产生深红透光。

cinematic golden hour,
warm backlight,
golden rim light,
soft frontal fill light,
volumetric sunlight,
cinematic chiaroscuro,
soft highlight roll-off.

【氛围粒子】

人物左侧空气中漂浮少量金色发光微粒。

粒子非常细小，
数量克制。

部分粒子形成柔和散开的金色光点，
仿佛夕阳中的尘埃。

不要魔法爆炸，
不要大量特效。

【镜头】

85mm全画幅人像镜头，
f/1.8-f/2.2，
ISO 100-200，

摄影机与人物肩部基本平齐。

中近景构图，
从头顶拍摄至腰臀附近。

人物位于画面中央偏左。

重点对焦眼睛与面部，
同时保持肩背、金属臂饰和部分披帛具有高清细节。

背景中式窗格与竹叶自然虚化。

真实光学浅景深，
柔和奶油散景。

【材质强化】

真实成年女性皮肤，
真实肩背肌肤微纹理，
单根黑色发丝，
香槟金金属，
天然珍珠，
深红石榴石/红宝石，
透明真丝，
半透明欧根纱，
真实金属雕刻，
真实珠宝折射，
真实夕阳光线。

【整体风格】

东方神话贵妃，
鎏金宫廷美人，
华贵，
神秘，
清冷，
妩媚但克制，
具有高级东方电影女主角气质。

不是普通古装写真，
不是影楼汉服，
而是高预算东方奇幻电影中的宫廷女主角定妆剧照。

items.title: 1920年代复古旅游海报纸雕浮雕风格

prompts.text:
Create a premium vintage travel poster for [LOCATION], inspired by the 1920s–1930s, with a refined layered paper-relief and embossed illustration style. Use warm parchment, muted terracotta, olive, dusty blue and sepia tones, combined with subtle paper grain, soft dimensional shadows and elegant handcrafted detailing.

Design a vertical 4:5 composition with a clear visual hierarchy. An ornate scalloped architectural arch frames the scene, while a culturally iconic landmark becomes the main focal point in the middle distance. Surround it with a distinctive local landscape that creates natural depth and atmosphere.

Place a period-appropriate person viewed from behind in the foreground for scale, keeping them secondary to the landmark and occupying approximately 10–15% of the poster height. Add authentic 1920s–30s transportation, local vegetation and restrained decorative motifs to strengthen the sense of place without overcrowding the composition.

Create cinematic depth from foreground → figure and objects → architecture → landscape → sky, with a muted sun, stylized clouds and a few distant birds. Ensure the architecture, clothing, vegetation, vehicles and decorative elements are culturally authentic to [LOCATION] and historically appropriate to the era.

At the bottom, feature a large embossed “[LOCATION]” in elegant classical serif lettering on a substantial vintage cartouche, with “1920s – 1930s” beneath it and a small centered floral ornament.

Maintain generous negative space, balanced symmetry, sophisticated proportions, tactile paper layering and a cohesive luxury heritage travel-poster aesthetic. Avoid modern objects, contemporary typography, neon colors, photorealism, clutter and modern tourism graphics.

prompts.text:
为 [LOCATION] 创作一张高端复古旅游海报，灵感源自 20 世纪 20 年代至 30 年代，采用精致的分层纸雕和浮雕插画风格。使用暖色羊皮纸、柔和的赤陶色、橄榄绿、灰蓝色和深褐色调，结合细微的纸张纹理、柔和的立体阴影和优雅的手工细节。

设计一个具有清晰视觉层次的垂直 4:5 构图。一个装饰华丽的扇形建筑拱门构成了场景框架，而一个具有文化代表性的地标则成为中景的主要焦点。在其周围环绕独特的当地景观，营造出自然的深度和氛围。

在前景放置一个从背后观察的符合时代特征的人物以示比例，使其仅作为地标的辅助，约占海报高度的 10–15%。添加真实的 20 世纪 20–30 年代的交通工具、当地植被和克制的装饰图案，在不使构图过于拥挤的情况下加强地域感。

创造从前景 → 人物和物体 → 建筑 → 景观 → 天空的电影感深度，配以柔和的太阳、风格化的云朵和几只远处的鸟。确保建筑、服装、植被、车辆和装饰元素在文化上符合 [LOCATION] 且在历史上符合那个时代。

在底部，在显眼的复古装饰框内，以优雅的古典衬线字体呈现大型浮雕文字 “[LOCATION]”，下方标注 “1920s – 1930s”，并带有一个小的居中花卉装饰。

保持充裕的留白、平衡的对称、考究的比例、触感十足的纸张层叠以及统一的奢华遗产旅游海报美学。避免现代物体、当代排版、霓虹色彩、写实主义、杂乱和现代旅游图形。

items.title: 场景中拍立得旅行记忆

prompts.text:
Turn the uploaded travel photo into a 3:4 vertical 'Polaroid in a scene' travel memory image.

The entire image must be a continuous, complete, and real travel scene, with no horizontal partitioning between the top and bottom halves, no top-bottom original image comparison, and no stitching lines. Maintain the location, subject, architecture or natural environment, people, perspective, lighting, and main colors from the original photo; do not replace the location, and do not add landmarks that do not exist in the original image.

Within this continuous real scene, embed a large physical Polaroid photo card. The Polaroid can be naturally held by a hand extending from the bottom edge of the frame, or naturally suspended in front of the scene. The card is slightly tilted, and the continuous real environment must be visible around it, making it look as though it was indeed brought to the original travel location, rather than a common flat overlay.

The Polaroid has real stiff photo paper, subtle paper texture, visible paper thickness, and soft contact shadows; the top and side borders are narrow, and the bottom border is significantly wider. The outer frame uses a single color extracted from representative colors of the original photo. The inside of the card uses a clear photographic image of the same original photo, echoing the external scene in location, composition, and light direction, but it must retain clear edges of the photo paper.

Add only two lines of text on the widened bottom edge of the Polaroid:

"[Location or memory title in 1—3 English words]"
"[A short, specific English observation related to the scene]"

The main title uses a slightly larger vintage sans-serif font, and the observation sentence is smaller but clearly legible. Do not add any other text besides this.

The overall effect should look like a physical commemorative photo paper appearing in real travel photography: the world remains continuous, while the Polaroid is responsible for framing a moment worth taking away.

Avoid: top-bottom comparison posters, horizontal partitioning, common rectangular overlays, scrapbooks, torn paper collages, tickets/cards, tape, stamp perforations, illustration backgrounds, transparent windows, picture frames filling the screen, author names, brands, logos, URLs, watermarks, gibberish, and extra text.

prompts.text:
将上传的旅行照片制作成一张 3:4 竖版“场景中的拍立得”旅行记忆图。

整张画面必须是一张连续完整的真实旅行场景，没有上半部分与下半部分的水平分区，没有上下原图对比，没有拼接线。保持原照片中的地点、主体、建筑或自然环境、人物、透视、光线和主要色彩，不替换地点，不添加原图中不存在的地标。

在这张连续的真实场景中，嵌入一张大号实体拍立得相片卡。拍立得可以由画面下沿伸入的一只手自然拿着，也可以自然悬置在现场前方。卡片略微倾斜，四周必须露出连续的真实环境，使它看起来确实被带到原来的旅行地点，而不是普通的平面叠图。

拍立得具有真实硬挺相纸、细微纸纹、可见纸张厚度和柔和接触投影；上边和左右边较窄，下边明显更宽。外框使用从原照片代表性色彩中提取的单一颜色。卡片内部使用同一张原始照片的清晰摄影画面，与外部场景在地点、构图和光线方向上呼应，但必须保留明确的相纸边缘。

只在拍立得加宽的下边加入两行文字：

“[1—3 个英文单词的地点或记忆标题]”
“[一句简短、具体、与现场景物有关的英文观察]”

主标题使用稍大的复古无衬线字体，观察句较小但清晰可读。除此之外不要添加任何文字。

整体效果应像真实旅行摄影中出现了一件实体纪念相纸：世界保持连续，拍立得负责框住一个值得带走的瞬间。

避免：上下对比海报、水平切分、普通矩形叠图、手账本、撕纸拼贴、票卡、胶带、邮票齿孔、插画背景、透明窗、相框铺满画面、作者名、品牌、Logo、网址、水印、乱码和额外文字。

items.title: 隐秘海湾冲澡的东亚女性时尚写实摄影

prompts.text:
Create a 2:3 vertical photorealistic analog fashion-lifestyle photograph of a fictional 24-year-old East Asian woman on a secluded pale-sand cove during a bright but hazy late morning, photographed moments after she has emerged from swimming and crossed toward a weathered wooden beach shower near the edge of the dunes. The mood is alluring, sun-warmed, physical, and candid rather than polished resort advertising. She has a softly elongated oval face, gentle full cheeks tapering into a smooth narrow jawline and small rounded chin, fair light neutral-warm skin, medium almond-shaped dark eyes with subtly raised outer corners, straight moderately thick dark eyebrows, a slender straight nose with a delicate rounded tip, and natural medium-small lips with a slightly fuller lower lip. Preserve refined proportions with subtle natural asymmetry, visible pores, faint under-eye detail, realistic sunlit skin texture, and small tonal irregularities. Her body remains distinctly slender and elongated with a light narrow frame, long slender neck, relatively narrow shoulders, narrow ribcage, defined waist, gently wider hips, long lean arms and legs, and restrained natural feminine curves.

Her long dark-brown hair is saturated with seawater and swept predominantly over one shoulder, breaking into irregular wet strands down her collarbone and back. Dress her in a simple ivory triangle bikini made from lightly textured matte swim fabric, with narrow straps and clean minimal construction, paired with a loosely tied semi-sheer white cotton sarong sitting low around her hips. The sarong has become partially damp from contact with her swimsuit and thighs, producing localized translucency, darker wet patches, uneven wrinkles, and a heavier drape without becoming artificially transparent. Keep jewelry minimal: tiny gold stud earrings and one fine chain at her ankle.

Catch her beneath the outdoor shower at the instant she reaches both hands behind her head to rinse salt from her hair. Her elbows rise naturally and unevenly, lengthening the torso while creating a relaxed open body line; one knee bends slightly and her hips shift away from the stronger supporting leg. Water streams irregularly through her hair and across her shoulders, collarbones, arms, abdomen, and legs before darkening the sand beneath her feet. She has turned her face sideways toward the nearby beach rather than squarely addressing the camera, eyes narrowed slightly against the brightness with a quiet, self-possessed expression. The allure comes from the stretched silhouette, wet materials, exposed waist and shoulders, and seemingly unguarded gesture rather than overt posing.

Place the camera several meters away at approximately chest height using restrained telephoto compression, as though the photographer noticed the moment while approaching from farther down the beach. Frame through a small amount of softly blurred dune grass in one foreground corner, creating observational depth without obscuring her body. The weathered shower post forms a simple vertical counterpoint beside her while the shoreline curves away behind her. In the middle distance, pale turquoise seawater breaks into irregular white foam; farther out, the sea fades toward a slightly hazy horizon. Leave the beach sparsely occupied enough that no background person competes with the subject.

Use hard coastal daylight softened by humid marine haze. Let sunlight create crisp but believable highlights on moving water droplets and wet skin while broad sky illumination prevents the shadows from becoming studio-black. Preserve subtle squinting, stray wet hairs, tiny droplets, sand adhering to damp ankles, footprints around the shower, water-darkened timber, disturbed sand, irregular wave patterns, and slight atmospheric desaturation toward the horizon.

Shoot with the visual character of CineStill 50D in daylight: very fine grain, clean daylight color, nuanced skin rendering, crisp coastal detail and a subtle highlight glow without night-film halation. Maintain enough depth of field for the shower structure and immediate shoreline to remain legible while allowing the distant sea to soften naturally. Keep the palette physically derived from ivory fabric, sunlit skin, bleached timber, pale sand, subdued coastal blue and dune vegetation. Avoid luxury-resort styling, excessive tropical saturation, artificial glamour lighting, exaggerated body proportions, plastic skin, perfectly arranged wet hair, staged pin-up posture, impossible water behavior, gratuitous accessories, typography, captions, logos, or decorative text.

prompts.text:
创建一张2:3垂直比例的写实模拟时尚生活摄影照片，展现一名虚构的24岁东亚女性，身处一处偏僻的淡色沙滩海湾，在明亮但有雾气的上午时分，捕捉她游泳后上岸、走向沙丘边缘一处风化的木质海滩淋浴器后的瞬间。氛围诱人、充满阳光的温暖感、极具肉体美感且自然真实，而非那种经过修饰的度假村广告风格。她拥有一张柔和拉长的鹅蛋脸，温和饱满的双颊收窄为平滑纤细的下颌线和圆润的小下巴，肤色白皙，呈中性偏暖色调，中等大小的杏仁状深色眼睛，眼角微微上扬，直而中等粗细的深色眉毛，细长的直鼻，鼻尖精致圆润，自然的偏小嘴唇，下唇略显丰满。保持精致的比例，带有细微的自然不对称感，清晰可见的毛孔，浅浅的眼下细节，真实的阳光照射下的皮肤纹理，以及微小的色调不均。她的身体保持着明显的纤细修长，骨架轻盈狭窄，脖子细长，肩膀相对较窄，胸腔狭窄，腰线清晰，臀部略宽，四肢修长紧致，展现出克制的自然女性曲线。

她深褐色的长发被海水打湿，主要披在一侧肩膀上，凌乱湿润的发丝垂在锁骨和后背上。让她穿着一套简单的象牙色三角比基尼，由略带纹理的哑光泳装面料制成，配有细肩带，设计极简，腰间低低地系着一条松散的半透明白色棉质纱笼。纱笼因接触泳衣和下肢而局部变湿，产生局部透光感、深色的湿斑、不均匀的褶皱和更沉重的垂坠感，但不会呈现出虚假的透明。首饰保持极简：细小的金耳钉和脚踝上的一条细链。

捕捉她在户外淋浴器下，双手伸向脑后清洗头发上盐分的瞬间。她的手肘自然且不对称地抬起，拉长了躯干，同时营造出一种放松舒展的身体线条；一条腿膝盖微屈，重心从支撑腿移开。水流不规则地穿过她的头发，流过肩膀、锁骨、手臂、腹部和腿部，最后染湿她脚下的沙滩。她的脸侧向旁边的海滩，而不是正对着相机，眼睛因光线强烈而微微眯起，表情宁静从容。这种诱惑力源自拉长的剪影、湿润的材质、裸露的腰部和肩膀，以及看似不经意的动作，而非刻意的摆拍。

相机架设在几米外，高度约在胸部位置，使用克制的远摄压缩感，仿佛摄影师从海滩远处走近时捕捉到了这一幕。在前景的一角通过少量柔和模糊的沙丘草进行构图，创造出观察的深度，同时不遮挡她的身体。风化的淋浴柱在她身边形成一个简单的垂直对比，而海岸线在她身后延伸。在中景，淡青色的海水破碎成不规则的白色泡沫；在远处，大海逐渐消失在略显朦胧的地平线上。保持海滩空旷，确保背景中没有人干扰主体。

使用被潮湿的海雾柔化后的强烈海岸日光。让阳光在流动的水滴和湿润的皮肤上产生清晰但真实的亮部，同时广阔的天空照明防止阴影变得像影棚那样漆黑。保留细微的眯眼、散乱的湿发、细小的水珠、粘在湿润脚踝上的沙子、淋浴器周围的脚印、被水打湿变暗的木材、被翻动过的沙子、不规则的波浪纹理，以及向地平线延伸的轻微大气色偏。

prompts.text: Hyper-realistic indoor stairwell low-angle fashion snapshot photography, vertical aspect ratio approximately 3:4, one young adult East Asian female, clearly adult, standing on the steps of a minimalist grey-white stairwell, body leaning against the right white wall, the photographer is located below the stairs, shooting upwards from a clear low angle diagonally in front of the subject. The overall presentation is a Japanese uniform style fashion photo + a casual snapshot in an ordinary architectural stairwell + a close-up mobile phone wide-angle feel, no studio shooting, no luxury scenes. Using an approximately 28–35mm equivalent lens, the photographer is about 1.5–2 meters away from the subject, the camera position is lower than the subject's knees, and the lens is clearly tilted upwards. The subject is located in the center-right of the frame, captured completely from the top of the head to both feet; the grey stairs rise from the bottom left towards behind the subject, and the white wall on the right occupies a large area of the background, forming a strong diagonal perspective. Because the low angle is closer, the subject's legs are visually more prominent than the upper body, but no fisheye distortion. The subject is a young adult East Asian female, medium frame, moderate to narrow shoulders, short and naturally tightened waist, naturally wider hips, thighs clearly plump and thick, knees and calves gradually tapering. The overall proportion is a compact and natural light pear/hourglass: narrow shoulders + short waist + naturally wide hips + plump thighs. No tall paper-thin figures, no extreme giant butts, no bodybuilding muscular legs. The subject's body stands in a two-thirds back-side pose, the back and right shoulder lightly leaning against the white wall, the upper body slightly turning back toward the lens toward the subject's left. The shoulders are slightly raised, forming a slight shrugging posture. The head turns to the left, eyes looking at the lens from above, the chin is slightly raised, the expression is calm, cold, slightly impatient or aloof, no smile. The right hand hangs naturally on the outside of the subject's right thigh, the palm near the lower edge of the skirt hem, five fingers naturally relaxed; the other hand is partially blocked by the body and the wall, no complex movements. The leg movements must be strictly locked: one leg acts as the supporting leg stepping on a lower step, basically straight; the other leg is significantly bent backwards from the knee and raised, the calf folded back towards the upper rear, the foot sole facing the lens. The raised foot is closer to the lens, forming a clear perspective of 'near large and far small', and the outline of the foot sole is clear. The subject wears pure white over-knee long socks/thigh-high socks, the sock opening is located in the upper-middle part of the thigh, not far from the lower edge of the skirt hem. The socks are relatively thin but basically opaque white nylon/fine knit material, the surface is very smooth, with only extremely fine fiber texture, not thick cotton sports socks, nor clearly ribbed socks. The white sock of the supporting leg fully extends to the foot; the sock of the raised leg also completely wraps the sole and toes, the foot sole area appears light beige-white because it is close to the lens, and the slight texture of the sock surface flattened by the tension of the sole and the outline of the toes can be seen. The feet are paired with a pair of black shiny low-heel loafers / student-style leather shoes. The supporting foot wears one of the black loafers; the other shoe has been taken off and placed on the stair step near the subject's foot. The raised foot only wears a white long sock, no shoe, with the foot sole completely facing the lens. Another empty shoe among the two black shoes can be seen on the steps, with the shoe opening facing up, the black patent leather has slight reflections. Do not generate shoes on both feet. The upper body wears a cream white/ivory white short-sleeved sailor collar uniform-style top, clearly adult fashion/uniform-inspired outfit. The body is slim-fit, length to near the natural waist, with a light grey-blue sailor collar and fine line decorations on the front chest. The cuffs have grey-blue double-layer thin stripe piping, and the short sleeves slightly tighten around the upper arms. The top fabric is soft uniform cloth or dense knit, not transparent. The neckline structure is a shallow V/sailor collar, there may be a light grey-blue neckerchief/thin strap on the chest, but no exaggerated bow. The garment body forms slight natural wrinkles at the chest and waist, the overall color is warm white rather than pure cold white. The lower body wears a medium grey short pleated mini skirt, the skirt waistline is at the natural waist, the pleats are of medium width and clearly arranged, the fabric is grey uniform wool. Due to the subject's body against the wall and leg movements, the skirt hem is slightly raised and turned outward on the subject's right side, forming a natural asymmetrical layer; the left skirt hem is relatively flat. Maintain normal complete clothing coverage, do not generate transparent skirts or exaggerated exposure. The subject has deep black ultra-long wavy hair, length near the waist, thick hair volume. There are thick long fragmented straight bangs in front of the forehead, length close to the upper edge of the eyes, partially covering the eyebrows. The hair on both sides falls along the shoulders and chest, and the long hair in the back is against the white wall and naturally forms large wavy curls. No short hair, high horse-tails, or buns. The face shape is small and somewhat oval, the jawline is soft, and the skin tone is naturally warm white. The eyes are deep brown almond eyes, eye makeup is slightly obvious, eyeliner is long and slightly upturned, there is light brownish-red smudging around the eyes; eyebrows are naturally thin. The nose bridge is small, and the lips are low-saturation nude brown-red/bean paste color, lips naturally closed. The makeup has a bit of retro Japanese fashion feel, but no heavy Western-style makeup. The scene is a minimalist indoor fire exit / industrial stairwell. The right side is a full wall of slightly rough warm white cement/plaster wall, where very small coating textures, local repair marks, and uneven reflections can be seen. The left side and behind the subject are dark grey metal or painted concrete stairs, the step color is cold grey, graphite grey, with small anti-slip grooves and slight wear on the edges. The stairs extend from the bottom left to the upper left of the frame, creating strong depth. A grey metal handrail is fixed to the right wall, extending diagonally from the bottom right to behind the subject; there is another section of handrail above behind the subject extending to the upper floor of the stairs. The handrail is matte grey metal with a square or rectangular cross-section, simple structure. A small section of grey metal railing/glass railing frame may appear on the left edge of the frame, but should not distract from the main subject. The light is cold white LED/fluorescent light from the top of the stairwell + a small amount of ambient diffused light. The subject's face, white uniform, and white socks are evenly illuminated, and the grey skirt and stairs form low-saturation medium grey layers. The wall is overall warm white, with soft but clear shadows. Do not use a strong flash. There are natural shadows on the right side of the subject's body and below the skirt hem, and the raised white-socked foot sole is slightly brighter due to being close to the lens. The overall exposure is natural, like a mobile phone shot directly in a stairwell. The overall texture is a high-quality mobile phone/mirrorless camera casual fashion snapshot: natural digital sharpness, slight JPEG compression, real skin texture, the background basically remains clear, without strong depth of field blur. The color tone is dominated by warm white walls + cold grey stairs + ivory white sailor top + medium grey pleated skirt + pure white over-knee socks + black loafers + deep black long hair, concise, calm, with a bit of an underground fashion magazine feel.

prompts.text:
超写实室内楼梯间低机位时尚抓拍摄影，竖版约 3:4，一名年轻成年东亚女性，明确成年，站在极简灰白色楼梯间的台阶上，身体背靠右侧白墙，摄影者位于楼梯下方，从人物斜前下方以明显低机位仰拍。整体呈现 日系制服风时尚写真＋普通建筑楼梯间随手拍＋近距离手机广角感，不要棚拍，不要豪华场景。

采用约 28–35mm 等效镜头，摄影者距离人物约 1.5–2 米，机位低于人物膝盖，镜头明显向上倾斜。人物位于画面中央偏右，从头顶完整拍到双脚；灰色楼梯从左下向人物身后上升，右侧白墙占据大面积背景，形成强烈斜线透视。人物腿部因为低机位距离更近，视觉上比上半身更突出，但不要鱼眼畸变。

人物为年轻成年东亚女性，中等骨架，肩部适中偏窄，腰部短而自然收紧，髋部自然偏宽，大腿明显丰满厚实，膝盖和小腿逐渐收细。整体是紧凑自然的轻梨形/沙漏比例：窄肩＋短腰＋自然宽髋＋丰满大腿。不要高挑纸片人，不要极端巨臀，不要健美肌肉腿。

人物身体以三分之二背侧姿势站立，背部和右肩轻轻靠在白色墙面上，上半身向人物左侧微微转回镜头。肩膀略微抬起，形成轻微缩肩姿态。头部向左转，双眼从上方看向镜头，下巴稍微抬起，表情平静、冷淡、略带一点不耐烦或疏离感，不微笑。

右手自然垂在人物右侧大腿外侧，手掌靠近裙摆下缘，五指自然放松；另一只手被身体和墙面部分遮挡，不做复杂动作。

双腿动作必须严格锁定：一条腿作为支撑腿踩在较低一级台阶上，基本伸直；另一条腿从膝盖处大幅向后弯曲并抬起，小腿向后上方折回，脚掌朝向镜头。抬起的脚距离镜头更近，形成明显近大远小透视，脚底轮廓清楚。

人物穿纯白色过膝长袜/大腿袜，袜口位于大腿中上部，距离裙摆下缘不远。袜子为偏薄但基本不透明的白色尼龙/细针织材质，表面非常光滑，只有极细纤维纹理，不是厚棉运动袜，也不是明显罗纹袜。支撑腿的白袜完整延伸到脚部；抬起腿的袜子同样完整包裹脚掌和脚趾，脚底区域因为贴近镜头呈浅米白色，能看到袜面被脚底张力拉平后的轻微纹理和脚趾轮廓。

脚上配一双黑色亮面低跟乐福鞋 / 学生风皮鞋。支撑脚穿着其中一只黑色乐福鞋；另一只鞋已经脱下，放在楼梯台阶上靠近人物脚边的位置。抬起的脚只穿白色长袜，不穿鞋，鞋底完整朝向镜头。台阶上能看到两只黑色鞋中的另一只空鞋，鞋口朝上，黑色漆皮带轻微反光。不要生成两只脚都穿鞋。

上身穿一件奶油白/象牙白色短袖水手领制服风上衣，明显为成年人时尚/制服灵感穿搭。衣身修身，长度到自然腰附近，前胸有浅灰蓝色水手领和细线装饰。袖口有灰蓝色双层细条纹滚边，短袖略微收住上臂。上衣面料为柔软制服布或细密针织，不要透明。

领口结构为浅 V/水手领，胸前可有浅灰蓝色领巾/细带，但不要夸张蝴蝶结。衣身在胸腰位置形成轻微自然褶皱，整体颜色偏暖白而不是纯冷白。

下身穿中灰色短款百褶迷你裙，裙子腰线位于自然腰，褶皱宽度中等、排列清楚，面料为灰色制服呢料。由于人物身体贴墙和腿部动作，裙摆在人物右侧略微抬起和外翻，形成自然不对称层次；左侧裙摆相对平整。保持正常完整服装覆盖，不要生成透明裙或夸张走光。

人物留深黑色超长波浪发，长度到腰部附近，发量浓密。额前是较厚的长碎齐刘海，长度接近眼睛上缘，部分遮住眉毛。两侧头发沿肩膀和胸前垂落，后方长发贴着白墙并自然形成大波浪卷曲。不要短发、高马尾或盘发。

脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，下颌柔和，肤色自然偏暖白。眼睛为深棕色杏仁眼，眼妆略明显，眼线细长并稍微上扬，眼周有轻微棕红色晕染；眉毛自然偏细。鼻梁小巧，嘴唇为低饱和裸棕红/豆沙色，嘴唇自然闭合。妆容带一点复古日系时装感，但不要浓艳欧美妆。

场景为极简室内消防楼梯 / 工业楼梯间。右侧是一整面轻微粗糙的暖白色水泥/灰泥墙，能看到非常细小的涂层纹理、局部修补痕迹和不均匀反光。

左侧与人物身后是深灰色金属或涂漆混凝土楼梯，台阶颜色为冷灰、石墨灰，边缘有细小防滑槽和轻微磨损。楼梯从画面左下向左上方延伸，制造很强的纵深。

右侧墙面固定一条灰色金属扶手，从画面右下斜向人物背后延伸；人物身后上方还有另一段扶手向楼梯上层延伸。扶手为方形或矩形截面的哑光灰金属，结构简单。

画面左边缘可出现一小段灰色金属栏杆/玻璃栏杆框架，但不要抢主体。

光线为楼梯间顶部冷白 LED/荧光灯＋少量环境漫射光。人物脸部、白色制服和白袜被均匀照亮，灰裙和楼梯形成低饱和中灰层次。墙面整体偏暖白，阴影柔和但清楚。

不要使用强烈闪光灯。人物身体右侧和裙摆下方有自然阴影，抬起白袜脚底因为距离镜头近而略微更亮。整体曝光自然，像手机在楼梯间直接拍摄。

整体呈高质量手机/无反相机随手时装抓拍质感：自然数码锐度、轻微 JPEG 压缩、真实皮肤纹理、背景基本保持清晰，不做强烈景深虚化。色调以暖白墙面＋冷灰楼梯＋象牙白水手上衣＋中灰百褶裙＋纯白过膝袜＋黑色乐福鞋＋深黑长发为主，简洁、冷静、带一点地下时尚杂志感。

items.title: 高级编辑感水粉拼贴旅行海报

prompts.text:
Please turn the travel portrait photo I uploaded into a single high-end editorial poster, do not stitch multiple photos. Use a 3:4 vertical composition, with the top and bottom areas strictly 1:1.

The upper part retains the original photo, keeping the person's identity, face shape, expression, hairstyle, posture, main clothing colors, and identifiable small objects, without changing the relationship between the person and the original image. Only perform slight high-end photographic color grading, preserving the texture of a real photo.

The lower part extracts the person from the photo into a pastel gouache travel portrait. Use matte opaque gouache, pastel dry brushing, and thick outlines with a slight charcoal feel, preserving the person's movement, clothing structure, hairstyle direction, and emotion, but removing most environmental details. The person can be moderately enlarged or recropped to make the lower part look more like an independent travel portrait.

The background of the lower part must be a single solid color block extracted from the original image's colors, continuously filling from the edges of the frame, without windows, plants, streets, tables, chairs, buildings, gradients, decorative color blocks, or any scene information. Reserve about 18%–30% of continuous negative space for text; gouache brushstrokes only exist inside the person and near the outlines.

The colors are extracted from the original image into 5–7 soft colors, reducing noise and saturation while maintaining the warm-cool relationship of the original photo. The image features paper grain, dry brush gaps, slight color bleeding over lines, and a hand-edited feel.

Add only a small amount of clearly readable English editorial text:
【Fill in a short title based on the scene】
【GOUACHE NOTE 01/02/03/04】
Plus one very short travel observation. Use hand-drawn narrow font with slight dry brush gaps for the text, without covering the person's facial features.

No author names, logos, watermarks, fake Chinese, garbled characters, plastic 3D feel, cartoon template feel, or complete replication of the original scene.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的旅行人物照片制作成一张独立的高级编辑海报，不拼接多张照片。采用 3:4 竖版构图，上下两个区域严格 1:1。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持人物身份、脸型、表情、发型、姿态、服装主色和可识别的小物件，不改变人物与原图的关系。仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，保留真实照片质感。

下半部分将照片中的人物提炼为粉彩水粉旅拍小像。使用哑光不透明水粉、粉彩干刷和略带炭笔感的粗轮廓，保留人物的动作、服装结构、发型方向和情绪，但删去大部分环境细节。人物可以适度放大或重裁，让下半部分更像一张独立的旅途肖像。

下半部分背景必须是从原图颜色中提取的一整块纯色，从画面边缘连续铺满，不出现窗户、植物、街道、桌椅、建筑、渐变、装饰色块或任何场景信息。保留约 18%–30% 的连续留白用于文字，水粉笔触只存在于人物内部和轮廓附近。

颜色从原图提炼为 5–7 种柔和色，降低杂色和饱和度，保留原照片的冷暖关系。画面具有纸张颗粒、干刷缺口、轻微越线和手工编辑感。

只添加少量清晰可读的英文编辑文字：
【根据画面填写一个简短标题】
【GOUACHE NOTE 01/02/03/04】
再加一句很短的旅行观察。文字使用略带干刷缺口的手绘窄体字，不覆盖人物五官。

不要作者名、Logo、水印、假中文、乱码、塑料 3D 感、卡通模板感或完整复刻原场景。

items.title: 宋玉穿衣全过程宋式闺房古风摄影

prompts.text:
【Song Yu Dressing Full Process | Song Style Boudoir】

Professional high-end ancient style fashion photography; 9:16 vertical full canvas, internal strict 3 columns × 3 rows nine-square grid, each grid is proportional, consistent in size, with narrow and neat spacing; characters in each grid are mainly full-body or near full-body compositions to ensure a complete presentation of clothing changes.

Using the same adult Oriental female from the input reference image as the sole character subject, maintaining the same face, hairstyle, body proportions, makeup, and character temperament; using the complete clothing in the reference image as the basis for the final look, strictly maintaining the visual characteristics of light cyan-white ancient style clothing system, embroidery patterns, semi-transparent tulle, waist seals, skirts, hair ornaments, jewelry, and footwear, without designing another set of clothing by oneself.

The nine grids represent the entire continuous process of the same adult woman completing her dressing in an elegant Song-style boudoir, from basic undergarments layered up to the complete look in the reference image. Grid 1: Wearing only exquisite and simple light-colored basic undergarments, standing next to a clothes rack, preparing to dress; Grid 2: Putting on the light cyan embroidered inner top from the reference image; Grid 3: Putting on the corresponding skirt, tidying the waistband and hem; Grid 4: Starting to put on the semi-transparent light cyan outer robe, putting arms through the sleeves; Grid 5: Tying the wide waist seal from the reference image, forming a complete waist layer; Grid 6: Completing the outer robe dressing, tidying the lapel, long sleeves, and tulle layers in front of a bronze mirror; Grid 7: Tidying the complete lower garment and skirt layers, ensuring the leg clothing state is consistent with the reference image; Grid 8: Sitting by the couch putting on the shoes from the reference image, while wearing the necklace, earrings, and other existing accessories; Grid 9: All clothing, shoes, jewelry, and hair ornaments are completed, standing naturally in front of a bronze mirror, presenting the complete final look from the reference image.

Each grid must strictly inherit all clothing already worn in the previous grid, only adding or completing one clear step; the clothing state accumulates grid by grid according to chronological order, and must not disappear, be replaced, change color, change style, or suddenly add clothing that does not exist in the reference image; the same character, the same set of clothing, the same boudoir, and the same era atmosphere run through all nine grids. Actions must have clear evidence of dressing behavior, such as taking clothes, putting on clothes, putting through sleeves, tidying lapels, tying waist seals, tidying in the mirror, tidying the skirt hem, putting on shoes, and wearing jewelry, so that the nine grids form a real and continuous Getting Dressed visual narrative.

The background is an elegant Song-style boudoir, with wooden lattice windows, light-colored gauze curtains, wooden clothes racks, simple ancient makeup tables and bronze mirrors, clothing boxes, low couches, simple and elegant screens, a few book scrolls, and flower branches; the space is elegant, lived-in, with a sense of real residence, avoiding excessive stacking of antiques; cream-white, light wood, cyan-gray, and pale cyan tones, naturally echoing the reference clothing. Natural window light enters the room, soft light and shadow, real ancient style portrait photography, high-end magazine editorial feel, real natural skin texture, exquisite makeup, smooth and shiny hair; embroidery, stitching, folds, metal accessories, semi-transparent fabrics, and clothing layers are clear and natural.

The nine-square grid must have clear temporal continuity: Grid 1 is the initial state, Grid 9 is the final state, and each grid in between is a non-skippable transition state; maintain high consistency in character face, hairstyle, clothing color, clothing style, spatial structure, light direction, and overall photographic quality; character poses can change naturally according to real dressing behaviors, such as standing, sitting, bending over, tidying clothes, etc., but must not change character identity and clothing state.

Must not appear: different characters, different clothing, modern furniture, modern clothing, modern items, sudden scene changes, changes in photography style, clothing suddenly disappearing, clothing suddenly increasing, repeated steps, extra characters, text, numbers, titles, watermarks, or brand logos.

prompts.text:
【宋玉穿衣全过程｜宋式闺房】

专业高级古风时尚摄影；9:16竖版完整画布，内部严格3列×3行九宫格，每格等比例、尺寸一致、间距细窄整齐；每格人物均以全身或接近全身构图为主，确保完整呈现服装穿着变化。

以输入参考图中的同一位成年东方女性为唯一人物主体，保持相同面容、发型、体型比例、妆容与人物气质；以参考图中的完整服装作为最终造型依据，严格保持浅青白色古风服饰体系、刺绣纹样、半透明薄纱、腰封、裙装、发饰、首饰与鞋履的视觉特征，不自行设计另一套服装。

九格表现同一位成年女子在清雅宋式闺房中连续完成穿衣的全过程，从基础贴身衣物逐层穿到参考图中的完整造型。第1格：仅穿精致简约的浅色基础贴身衣物，站在衣架旁，准备穿衣；第2格：穿上参考图中的浅青色刺绣内搭上衣；第3格：穿上对应裙装，整理裙腰与裙摆；第4格：开始穿入半透明浅青色外衫，将双臂穿入衣袖；第5格：系上参考图中的宽腰封，形成完整腰部层次；第6格：完成外衫穿着，在铜镜前整理衣襟、长袖与薄纱层次；第7格：整理完整下装与裙摆层次，确保腿部服饰状态与参考图一致；第8格：坐在榻边穿好参考图中的鞋履，同时佩戴项链、耳饰及其他已有配饰；第9格：所有服饰、鞋履、首饰与发饰全部完成，在铜镜前自然站立，呈现参考图中的完整最终造型。

每一格必须严格继承上一格已经穿好的全部衣物，只新增或完成一个明确步骤；服装状态按照时间顺序逐格累积，不得消失、替换、变色、改变款式或突然增加参考图中不存在的服装；同一人物、同一套服装、同一闺房、同一时代氛围贯穿九格。动作必须具有明确的穿衣行为证据，例如取衣、套衣、穿袖、整理衣襟、系腰封、照镜整理、整理裙摆、穿鞋、佩戴首饰，让九格形成真实连续的Getting Dressed视觉叙事。

背景为清雅宋式闺房，木质格窗、浅色纱帘、木质衣架、古朴妆台与铜镜、衣箱、低矮榻、简雅屏风、少量书卷与花枝；空间雅致、生活化、有真实居住感，避免过度堆砌古董；米白、浅木、青灰、淡青色调，与参考服装自然呼应。自然窗光进入室内，柔和光影，真实古风人像摄影，高级杂志编辑感，真实自然肤质，精致妆容，柔顺有光泽的头发；刺绣、缝线、褶皱、金属配件、半透明面料与服装层次清晰自然。

九宫格必须具有明确的时间连续性：第1格是最初状态，第9格是最终状态，中间每格都是不可跳跃的过渡状态；保持人物面容、发型、服装颜色、服装款式、空间结构、光线方向和整体摄影质感高度一致；人物姿势可以根据真实穿衣行为自然变化，站立、坐姿、弯腰、整理衣物等动作均可出现，但不得改变人物身份与服装状态。

prompts.text:
## [Subject Description]

A photorealistic full-body portrait of a young adult woman with a curvaceous, graceful, feminine physique, long legs, fair warm-toned skin, and natural body proportions. She has a softly oval face, delicate facial features, large dark almond-shaped eyes, straight dark eyebrows, a small straight nose, and naturally pink lips. Her expression is calm, poised, and subtly confident, with a gentle closed-mouth smile, looking directly toward the camera.

Her medium-length chestnut-brown hair is styled in a neat low ponytail, with straight wispy bangs framing her forehead and softly framing the sides of her face. Natural-looking makeup, smooth realistic skin texture, subtle blush, and understated lip color.

She wears a fitted turquoise-blue floral lace one-piece bodysuit with intricate white floral patterns. The garment has a high neckline, sleeveless construction, and distinctive symmetrical teardrop/keyhole cutouts at the upper chest and sides of the torso, exposing portions of the midriff and waist while remaining an elegant fashion-oriented design. She wears transparent high-heeled sandals with clear straps.

Her pose is an elegant overhead stretch: both arms are raised above her head with the hands gently overlapping/curving together, elbows slightly bent. Her torso is elongated and subtly turned, one hip slightly shifted, with one leg extended diagonally forward and the other supporting her weight. Relaxed posture, graceful lines, natural anatomy.

She possesses the best head-to-body ratio, a perfect, curvaceous, S-shaped female figure, long legs with perfect leg lines, and a slender waist, perfect foots,perfect foot lines

## [Scene / Background]

A bright, tasteful contemporary apartment living room with a minimalist warm interior. Light beige walls, pale wood flooring, and a large neutral-colored upholstered sofa positioned on the right side. Several tall green indoor plants in woven natural-fiber baskets occupy the background. Two small sculptural hourglass-shaped stools/tables, one white and one black, sit on the left. A minimalist wall-mounted exposed-bulb lamp is visible on the left wall. A large muted beige, gray, and blue patterned area rug covers the foreground floor.

Clean residential interior, uncluttered composition, understated modern decor, warm neutral palette with natural greenery.

## [Lighting / Atmosphere]

Soft diffused indoor lighting with warm-neutral white balance. Gentle ambient illumination throughout the room, subtle natural-looking shadows, smooth highlights on the skin and hair, balanced exposure, realistic skin tones. Calm, elegant, intimate lifestyle-photography atmosphere. No harsh shadows, no dramatic colored lighting,No cropped limbs or truncated feet.

## [Composition / Viewpoint]

Vertical full-body composition, camera positioned approximately at eye-to-chest height with a natural slightly frontal perspective. The entire figure is visible from the top of her raised hands to her feet, with sufficient space around the body. Subject positioned slightly right of center, standing prominently against the interior background.

Full-body fashion/lifestyle portrait, natural perspective, moderate depth of field, background recognizable but gently softened. The raised arms create a strong vertical/arched silhouette, while the diagonal leg placement adds dynamic balance. Camera approximately 50mm-equivalent perspective, minimal distortion. Keep anatomy, hands, fingers, feet, and facial proportions natural and accurate.

## [Style Reference]

High-end photorealistic lifestyle and fashion photography, realistic human anatomy, natural skin pores and subtle skin texture, detailed hair strands, realistic lace and fabric texture, physically accurate materials, refined editorial aesthetic, elegant and sophisticated rather than provocative. Authentic photographic rendering, natural proportions, subtle optical depth, realistic indoor environment.

## [Image Quality Parameters]

Ultra-detailed photorealism, high resolution, sharp subject detail, realistic skin texture, accurate facial features, detailed eyes, individually defined hair strands, highly detailed floral lace, realistic transparent footwear, clean edges, natural shadows, physically plausible lighting, balanced exposure, subtle depth of field, realistic color rendition, professional DSLR photography, crisp focus on the subject, no excessive HDR, no oversharpening, no plastic skin.

## [主体描述]

一个逼真的、全身的年轻成年女性肖像，拥有丰满、优雅、女性化的体态，长腿，白皙的暖色调皮肤，以及自然的身体比例。她有着柔和的鹅蛋脸，精致的面部特征，大的深色杏眼，平直的深色眉毛，小巧挺直的鼻子，以及自然的粉红色嘴唇。她的表情平静、端庄且略显自信，带着温柔的闭嘴微笑，直接看向摄像机。

她的中等长度栗褐色头发梳成整洁的低马尾，笔直轻盈的刘海遮住额头，并柔和地勾勒出她的脸庞。看起来很自然的妆容，平滑逼真的皮肤纹理，微妙的腮红，以及含蓄的唇色。

她穿着一套合身的绿松石蓝色花卉蕾丝连体紧身衣，带有复杂的白色花卉图案。这件服装采用高领、无袖设计，并在上胸部和躯干侧面有独特的对称泪滴形/钥匙孔形镂空，露出部分腹部和腰部，同时保持优雅的时尚导向设计。她穿着带有透明带子的透明高跟凉鞋。

她的姿势是优雅的过顶伸展：双臂高举过头顶，双手轻轻重叠/弯曲在一起，手肘微弯。她的躯干被拉长并微妙地扭转，一边臀部轻微偏移，一条腿斜向前方延伸，另一条腿支撑重心。放松的姿态，优雅的线条，自然的解剖结构。

她拥有最佳的头身比，完美的、曲线玲珑的S型女性身材，长腿，拥有完美的腿部线条，纤细的腰部，完美的双脚，完美的足部线条。

## [场景 / 背景]

一个明亮、有品位的当代公寓客厅，具有极简主义的温暖室内装修。浅米色墙壁，浅色木地板，右侧放置着一个大的中性色调布艺沙发。几个编织天然纤维篮子里的高大绿色室内植物占据了背景。左侧放着两个小型的雕塑般的沙漏型凳子/桌子，一白一黑。左侧墙壁上可以看到一盏极简主义的壁挂式裸露灯泡灯。一块巨大的柔和米色、灰色和蓝色图案的地毯覆盖了前景地板。

整洁的住宅内部，清爽的构图，含蓄的现代装饰，温暖的中性色调与自然绿植。

## [光影 / 氛围]

柔和的漫射室内光线，带有暖中性的白平衡。整个房间内温柔的环境照明，微妙的自然阴影，皮肤和头发上的平滑高光，均衡的曝光，真实的肤色。冷静、优雅、亲密的居家生活摄影氛围。没有生硬的阴影，没有戏剧性的彩色灯光，没有裁剪掉的肢体或残缺的双脚。

## [构图 / 视角]

纵向全身构图，摄像机位置大约在眼睛到胸部的高度，具有自然的略微正面透视。从高举的双手的顶端到她的脚部，整个身材都可见，身体周围留有足够的空间。主体位于中心略微偏右的位置，在室内背景的衬托下显得十分突出。

全身时尚/生活方式肖像，自然透视，适中的景深，背景可辨认但被轻轻软化。抬起的双臂营造出强烈的垂直/拱形剪影，而倾斜的腿部放置增加了动态平衡。大约50mm等效焦距的视角，最小的畸变。保持解剖结构、双手、手指、脚部和面部比例自然准确。

## [风格参考]

高端逼真的生活方式和时尚摄影，真实的解剖结构，自然的皮肤毛孔和微妙的皮肤纹理，细致的发丝，逼真的蕾丝和面料纹理，物理精确的材质，精致的社论美学，优雅大方而非挑逗。真实的摄影渲染，比例自然，微妙的光学深度，真实的室内环境。

## [图像质量参数]

极高细节的逼真感，高分辨率，锐利的主体细节，逼真的皮肤纹理，准确的面部特征，细致的眼睛，清晰定义的单根发丝，高度详细的花卉蕾丝，逼真的透明鞋履，整齐的边缘，自然的阴影，物理上合理的照明，均衡的曝光，微妙的景深，真实的色彩呈现，专业单反摄影，主体对焦清晰，无过度HDR，无过度锐化，无塑料感皮肤。

prompts.text:
A polished vertical beauty portrait of a petite Spanish woman seated beside a mint-green indoor pool. Preserve the exact delicate, soft, doll-like facial proportions described below. The character occupies approximately 80 percent of the frame, photographed from slightly above eye level, with the composition extending from the top of her hair to her covered lap.

She has a very small heart-shaped face with a narrow lower face, a softly tapered jawline, a short delicate chin, smooth understated cheekbones, a compact midface, and refined symmetrical features. Her eyes are exceptionally large, luminous, and slightly wide-set, with a rounded almond shape, pale gray-green irises, dark defined upper lash lines, softly extended outer eyeliner, fine lower lashes, and bright glassy catchlights. Her eyebrows are slim, softly arched, and light ash brown. She has a small straight nose with a narrow bridge and petite rounded tip. Her lips are small, softly full, and rose-pink, with a subtle relaxed closed-mouth smile.

Her complexion is pale warm ivory with a perfectly even, softly luminous beauty finish, delicate pink blush concentrated on the upper cheeks, and a smooth porcelain appearance. Her expression is gentle, dreamy, composed, and slightly playful. The facial proportions remain petite and delicate rather than angular or strongly sculpted.

Her hair is a shoulder-length platinum-blonde layered lob. The longest strands stop precisely at the collarbones. It has a deep side part, high soft volume at the crown, a broad swept section flowing across the forehead, champagne-blonde highlights on the upper layers, and cool smoky ash-gray undertones through the lower layers and feathered ends. One side rests over her shoulder while the opposite side fans outward through her raised hand. Silky straight texture, lightweight separated strands, softly curved ends, and gentle natural movement.

She has a slim, narrow-framed physique with a long graceful neck, gently sloping shoulders, slender arms, a compact torso, a narrow waist, and balanced feminine proportions.

She wears a vivid raspberry-red cropped camisole with a soft lightweight silhouette. The camisole has thin shoulder straps tied into neat ribbon bows, a low curved neckline edged with delicate lace, subtle floral lace across the center of the bust, a semi-transparent fine-mesh lower bodice, gentle ruching at the center, and several long raspberry drawstrings hanging vertically from a small front bow. The garment appears softly fitted and flexible rather than rigidly structured.

A high-waisted deep peacock-blue satin maxi skirt begins at her waist. The fabric has rich teal-blue highlights, smooth reflective folds, and a fluid drape. The long skirt flows continuously across her lap and completely covers her crossed legs.

She wears long ornate gold dangling earrings, a translucent pale-gray jade bangle, a dark red bead bracelet, a thin black elastic bracelet, and delicate metallic rings. A tiny metallic navel piercing is visible between the cropped top and the high-waisted skirt.

Recreate the pose precisely: she sits upright on the pale stone pool ledge with her torso facing almost directly toward the camera. Her shoulders remain relaxed. Her head tilts noticeably toward camera-left while her eyes look directly into the lens. The arm on camera-left crosses diagonally downward over her torso and rests softly across her covered lap. The arm on camera-right bends upward beside her shoulder; the wrist is relaxed and the fingertips lightly hold the ends of her outward-flowing hair. Her fingers are slender and naturally curved.

A clean modern indoor pool café forms the background. Mint-green illuminated water fills most of the middle background. A simple pale natural-wood counter spans the upper portion of the frame, with only a few softly blurred metallic drink containers, white vessels, stacked cups, and minimal dark café equipment. Plain warm-beige wall, uncluttered surfaces, no visible signage, no decorative writing, and no prominent background people. The background remains quiet, softly blurred, and secondary to the woman.

Soft frontal beauty lighting with gentle warm indoor illumination and a faint mint-green reflection from the pool. Bright, evenly exposed face, very soft shadow transitions, luminous eyes, delicate highlights along the pale hair, and restrained reflections on the satin skirt. Clean smartphone beauty-camera aesthetic with a subtle smoothing effect, gentle pastel color rendering, low contrast, and softly glowing skin.

Vertical 9:16 social-media portrait, slight high-angle viewpoint, medium portrait framing, natural 50mm-equivalent perspective, face positioned near the upper center, raised hand fully visible on camera-right, covered lap visible in the lower frame, moderate background separation, sharpest focus on the eyes and face.

High-fidelity photographic beauty portrait. Smooth luminous skin with extremely fine natural texture, subtle peach fuzz, gentle subsurface light on the cheeks and nose, and an even porcelain finish. Hair rendered as fine individual platinum and ash-gray strands with realistic transparency and soft movement. Fine mesh, lace, ribbons, jewelry, and satin rendered with accurate material detail. Realistic eyes with moist reflections and clear gray-green iris patterns. Accurate petite facial anatomy, slender hands, natural fingers, slim body proportions, soft fine grain, neutral-warm highlights, lightly cooled shadows, lifelike photography with the refined softness of a high-quality beauty-filtered social-media portrait.

一张精致的竖向美颜人像，一位身材娇小的西班牙女性坐在薄荷绿的室内泳池旁。保留下文描述的精确、柔和、像玩偶般的面部比例。人物占据画面的约80%，从略高于视线的高度拍摄，构图从头发顶部延伸到盖住的大腿。

她有一张非常小的桃心脸，下半部分脸较窄，下颌线柔和收窄，下巴短而精致，颧骨平滑不显眼，中面部紧凑，五官对称精细。她的眼睛异常大而明亮，眼距略宽，呈圆润的杏仁状，有浅灰绿色的虹膜、清晰的黑色上睫毛线、柔和延长的外眼线、细密的下睫毛以及明亮的玻璃质感高光。她的眉毛纤细，微微弯曲，呈浅灰褐色。她有一个挺直的小鼻子，鼻梁窄，鼻尖圆润小巧。她的嘴唇小而柔和丰满，呈玫瑰粉色，带着淡淡的放松的闭口微笑。

她的头发是齐肩长的白金色层次感波波头（lob）。最长的发丝恰好落在锁骨处。深侧分，发顶蓬松柔软，一抹宽阔的头发拂过额头，上层有香槟色挑染，下层和羽毛般的发梢带有冷色调的烟灰色底色。一侧垂在肩膀上，另一侧则由她举起的手拨开。丝滑顺直的质感，轻盈的分明发丝，柔和弯曲的发尾，以及自然的律动感。

她身材苗条，骨架窄，脖子修长优雅，肩膀略微倾斜，手臂纤细，躯干紧凑，腰部纤细，具有平衡的女性比例。

她佩戴着长款华丽的金吊坠耳环、一只半透明的浅灰色玉镯、一串深红色珠子手链、一条黑色细皮筋手链以及精致的金属戒指。在短款上衣和高腰裙之间可以看到一个小小的金属脐钉。

精确重现姿势：她挺直地坐在浅色石质池边平台上，躯干几乎直接面对镜头。肩膀保持放松。她的头明显向镜头左侧倾斜，而眼睛直视镜头。镜头左侧的手臂斜向下跨过躯干，轻柔地搭在盖住的大腿上。镜头右侧的手臂在肩膀旁向上弯曲；手腕放松，指尖轻轻捏住向外飘动的发梢。她的手指纤细且自然弯曲。

背景是一个干净现代的室内泳池咖啡馆。薄荷绿色的灯光水池占据了中景的大部分。一个简单的浅色天然木台面横跨画面上方，只有少量模糊的金属饮料容器、白色器皿、叠放的杯子和极简的深色咖啡设备。平整的暖色调米色墙壁，整洁的表面，没有可见的标志，没有装饰性文字，背景中没有明显的行人。背景保持安静、柔和模糊，并次于女性人物。

items.title: 照片转绘滑稽鬼脸蜡笔涂鸦对比海报

prompts.text:
Please turn every photo I upload into an individual 3:4 vertical transformation comparison poster, no multi-image stitching, output each photo separately. The screen adopts a clear top-and-bottom dual-link structure: the upper half retains the complete original photo, and the lower half transforms the same subject into a rough, funny, slightly grimace-like crayon scribble.

The upper part maintains the identity, quantity, posture, movement, clothing, animal fur color, architectural structure, environmental relationship, observation angle, and real lighting of the subject in the photo, with only slight photographic color grading. Do not add or delete people or animals, do not change the location, and do not turn the photographic part into an illustration.

The lower part retains the most recognizable outline, posture, and relationship of the subject in the original photo, but do not perform realistic copying. Refine and appropriately enlarge the faces of people or animals, deliberately exaggerating eyes, eyebrows, nose, teeth, tongue, corners of the mouth, and facial proportions to form a skewed, asymmetrical, and slightly clumsy funny grimace. Expressions can be more absurd and dramatic than the original photo, but must still be recognizable as the original subject; do not turn into horror images, and do not apply fixed cartoon characters.

Use thick black crayons, oil pastels, and oil pencils to repeatedly search for outlines. Lines should be shaky, broken, overlapping, uneven in thickness, and retain traces of erasing, back-strokes, coloring outside the boundaries, and untrimmed marks. Extract colors from the original photo and compress them into a limited color palette, representing bodies, clothes, or hair with rough friction, local white space, and uneven overlapping colors. Do not use smooth outlines, clean color blocks, or exquisite digital coloring.

The background only retains a few clues sufficient to identify the location or action relationship, such as building outlines, seats, railings, roads, trees, or travel landmarks, and summarizes them with more scribbly, low-density strokes. The subject should be more concentrated and impactful than the original photo, with a part of warm paper white reserved around it; do not redraw all the photographic details fully.

Add a set of short English handwritten text in the blank space of the lower half:

- Refine a 1–3 word main title based on the image;
- Add the field "SCRIBBLE STUDY 01";
- Add a short observation describing the real action or expression in the image.

The text uses skewed, dry, slightly broken pencil or crayon handwriting, like a painter's casual notes on the edge of the paper, clearly legible but not overly regular. No author names, brands, URLs, logos, watermarks, fake quotes, garbled code, or redundant text should appear.

Overall presentation is a deliberate non-pretty manual graffiti feel: rough, funny, absurd, with a bit of a grimace quality, while retaining the real character relationships, animal characteristics, and travel memories in the original photos.

Avoid: exquisite cartoons, cute style, Japanese anime style, smooth vectors, realistic sketches, horror and gore, uniform template faces, complete background copying, excessive decoration, changing the number of subjects, changing character postures, fictional landmarks, and turning the photographic part into an illustration.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的 3:4 竖版转绘对比海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。画面采用清晰的上下双联结构：上半部分保留完整真实原图，下半部分将同一主体转绘为粗糙、滑稽、略带鬼脸感的蜡笔涂鸦。

上半部分保持照片中主体的身份、数量、姿态、动作、服装、动物毛色、建筑结构、环境关系、观察角度和真实光影，仅进行轻微摄影调色。不得增删人物或动物，不得改变地点，不得将摄影部分插画化。

下半部分保留原图主体最具辨识度的轮廓、姿态和关系，但不要进行写实临摹。将人物或动物的脸部提炼并适度放大，故意夸张眼睛、眉毛、鼻子、牙齿、舌头、嘴角和面部比例，形成歪斜、不对称、稍显笨拙的滑稽鬼脸。表情可以比原图更荒诞、更有戏剧性，但仍须能够辨认出原来的主体；不要变成恐怖形象，也不要套用固定卡通角色。

使用粗黑蜡笔、油画棒和油性铅笔反复寻找轮廓。线条应抖动、断裂、重叠、粗细不均，保留擦除、回笔、涂出边界和未经修整的痕迹。色彩从原图提取并压缩为有限色盘，以粗糙摩擦、局部留白和不均匀叠色表现身体、衣服或毛发。不要使用平滑描边、干净色块和精致数字上色。

背景只保留足以辨认地点或动作关系的少量线索，例如建筑轮廓、座椅、栏杆、道路、树木或旅行地标，并用更加潦草、低密度的笔触概括。主体应比原图更集中、更有冲击力，周围保留一部分温暖纸白，不要把所有摄影细节重新画满。

在下半部分留白处加入一组简短英文手写文字：

- 根据画面提炼一个 1–3 词主标题；
- 加入字段“SCRIBBLE STUDY 01”；
- 加入一句描述画面真实动作或表情的简短观察。

文字使用歪斜、干涩、略有断裂的铅笔或蜡笔手写体，像画画的人随手记在纸边，清楚可读但不要过分规整。不得出现作者名、品牌、网址、Logo、水印、假引用、乱码或多余文字。

整体呈现一种故意不画漂亮的手工涂鸦感：粗糙、滑稽、荒诞、有一点鬼脸气质，同时保留原照片中真实的人物关系、动物特征和旅行记忆。

避免：精致卡通、可爱萌系、日漫风、光滑矢量、写实素描、恐怖血腥、统一模板脸、完整背景临摹、过多装饰、改变主体数量、改变人物姿态、虚构地标和摄影部分插画化。

items.title: 苹果折叠屏手机概念产品信息图

prompts.text:
Create a premium photorealistic Apple foldable-phone concept infographic, inspired by the clean visual language of official Apple product presentations. Use a pure white background with a subtle glossy white floor and extremely minimal editorial composition.

At the top, place a large bold black headline:
“The iPhone Duo isn’t just ‘an iPhone that folds.’”

Directly underneath, add a smaller elegant teal-blue statement:
“It changes what an iPhone actually is.”

Main product arrangement: Show two versions of the same foldable iPhone concept side by side.

Left device: a slim silver/white foldable iPhone shown partially open, with one half displaying the edge-to-edge inner screen and the other half showing the premium glass rear panel. Use flat polished metallic edges, extremely thin bezels, rounded corners, a subtle central hinge, and a compact dual-camera module on the rear.

Right device: a dark graphite/black version opened much wider, almost like a miniature tablet, displaying a beautiful dark mountain landscape wallpaper. In front of it, place the same phone folded/closed vertically, showing its dark glass back, centered Apple logo, and horizontally arranged dual-camera system.

Make the hardware consistent across every view: identical proportions, camera placement, buttons, hinge design, materials and dimensions. The foldable mechanism should look physically believable and engineered rather than futuristic or exaggerated.

Around the phones, add thin gray leader lines ending in minimalist circular technical icons, creating an Apple-style product breakdown:

• NO FACE ID — small Face ID-style icon
• 100+ HINGE PARTS — precision gear icon
• 2 BATTERIES — battery icon
• NO SIM TRAY — SIM-card icon
• APPLE PENCIL — minimal stylus icon
• AI LIMITS — minimalist neural/AI icon

Place each label carefully around the devices with generous white space. Use black modern sans-serif typography, small gray icons, thin gray connector lines and one restrained teal accent color.

At the bottom, add:

Innovation isn't cheap 
the new premium foldable starts at a staggering $1,999.

Visual style: ultra-realistic premium product photography + minimalist Apple-style technical infographic, sophisticated industrial design, realistic titanium/aluminum edges, glossy glass, precise reflections, believable hinge construction, soft studio lighting, subtle shadows, immaculate white space, perfectly balanced typography and composition.

Composition: vertical 4:5, high-end technology editorial, centered products, crisp details, no clutter, no unnecessary futuristic effects, no cyberpunk aesthetic, no excessive glowing elements, no generic Android foldable styling. Make the entire image feel like a real leaked Apple product presentation/concept poster, while clearly remaining a fictional concept.

自然双眼皮，

眼尾微微上挑，

纤长自然睫毛，

眼神清冷、安静、略带神秘感。

眉毛纤细自然，

真实眉毛毛流。

暖棕色与浅红棕色眼妆，

眼尾轻微加深，

下眼睑带极淡红色晕染，

自然卧蚕。

嘴唇饱满柔软，

低饱和朱砂红、珊瑚红渐变唇妆，

具有轻微水润感。

额头正中央绘制一枚极小、精致、对称的朱砂红古典花钿，

由数个微小红点组成，

不要大型额饰。

【发型】

浓密乌黑长发，

大型东方古典高髻，

头顶具有圆润蓬松体积，

左右发髻结构对称但不过度僵硬。

中分偏自然分缝，

额前和太阳穴保留少量自然黑色碎发，

耳侧几缕细长发丝自然垂落。

发丝根根分明，

具有真实黑发光泽，

不要塑料假发。

暖色轮廓光穿过发髻边缘，

产生细腻金色发丝光。

【头饰】

头顶中央佩戴大型镂空香槟金古典花冠。

核心为一颗椭圆形深红色宝石，

宝石呈石榴红/红玛瑙质感，

周围环绕对称金色镂空花叶、卷草纹和花瓣结构。

发髻左右插入数枚较小的金色花簪，

花芯镶嵌红色宝石。

两侧各垂下长款古典步摇，

结构包括：

细金链

小型红宝石

白色珍珠

水滴形珍珠

金色花朵。

步摇长度达到耳朵以下，

左右基本对称，

自然垂坠。

【耳饰】

左右佩戴大型金色花形耳坠，

中央镶嵌红宝石，

下方连接白色水滴珍珠。

耳饰精细、纤细，

具有真实金属高光。

【项链】

颈部佩戴多层香槟金珠链与珍珠链。

胸口中央悬挂大型东方镂空金色吊坠，

吊坠中央镶嵌大型椭圆深红宝石。

下方垂落数枚大小不同的红色水滴宝石，

形成华丽宫廷珠宝效果。

【服装——最重要】

人物穿深墨绿色、孔雀绿、黑绿色丝绒质感抹胸式东方幻想礼服。

肩部完全露出，

锁骨完整清晰，

服装上缘为柔和心形抹胸结构。

胸口中央覆盖一件极其精致的大型立体鎏金凤凰胸甲装饰。

凤凰纹样左右展开，

呈高度对称结构。

凤凰双翼从中央向左右上方展开，

羽毛由大量细密的香槟金金属羽片组成。

金属纹样具有：

凤凰羽毛

火焰纹

卷草纹

花叶纹

云纹

东方宫廷镂空纹样。

凤凰胸饰中央镶嵌一颗大型椭圆形深红宝石，

周围存在数颗微小红宝石。

金属不是平面印花，

必须具有明显3D浮雕厚度，

像真正由黄金锻造而成的高级宫廷首饰。

胸饰表面产生柔和暖金色高光，

边缘存在真实金属反射。

【披帛】

人物双臂外侧披着大面积半透明墨绿/青绿色轻纱披帛。

披帛中混合非常淡的香槟金透明纱层。

薄纱具有：

半透明

丝绸光泽

微弱金粉

细密金线纹理。

披帛自然从肩部滑落至手臂，

露出完整肩膀和锁骨。

不要现代袖子，

不要普通汉服大袖。

【动作——严格锁定】

人物正面坐在深色桌案后。

身体基本正对摄影机，

肩膀自然展开，

姿态端庄。

左前臂横放在桌面上，

手掌自然放松。

另一只手抬起。

食指竖直，

指尖非常轻地触碰下唇中央。

其他手指自然微微弯曲，

不要刻意张开。

动作具有一种安静、神秘、若有所思的感觉。

双眼直视摄影机。

表情平静，

不笑，

略带距离感和神秘东方贵族气质。

【背景——关键】

幽暗的中国古典宫廷室内。

整体背景为极深墨绿色、黑绿色。

人物左右两侧出现巨大的对称鎏金中国龙浮雕。

左上方一条金色东方龙，

右上方另一条金色东方龙。

龙具有：

细长蛇形身体

金色鳞片

中国传统龙头

龙角

胡须

锋利爪部。

两条龙沿画面左右边缘盘旋，

形成天然视觉框架。

不要西方翼龙，

不要恐龙。

背景深处存在极轻微古典云纹、宫廷纹样，

保持暗调虚化。

【前景】

画面左下角存在一根燃烧中的象牙白蜡烛，

古铜色烛台。

蜡烛火焰呈温暖橙黄色，

轻微虚焦。

人物面前深色桌面上散落少量华丽金色古典首饰：

金簪

红宝石发饰

金属步摇

粉白色玉石小饰品。

右下角存在一个小型古铜色镂空香炉/首饰盒。

所有前景元素保持适度虚化，

不能抢人物主体。

【灯光】

电影级低调布光。

整体环境非常暗，

背景接近深墨绿色黑色。

主光从人物右前上方约45度照射，

暖白偏金色柔光。

重点照亮：

面部

双眼

鼻梁

嘴唇

肩膀

锁骨

金属凤凰胸饰。

人物右侧头发存在明显但柔和的金色轮廓光。

肩膀表面具有细腻高光，

但保持真实皮肤质感。

金属凤凰胸饰受到光线照射后产生漂亮的香槟金反射，

红宝石出现深红色透光。

左下方蜡烛提供非常轻微的暖橙色环境补光。

高光不过曝，

阴影保留丰富细节
