items.title: 高端摄影与简约水彩手绘拼贴海报

prompts.text:
Create a refined, high-end PHOTO + MINIMAL WATERCOLOR VIGNETTE artwork based entirely on the uploaded photograph. Use the photograph as the only visual reference and preserve the exact subject, composition, environment, clothing, objects, lighting, colors, and mood.

FORMAT: Vertical 3:4 editorial composition.

TOP SECTION — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH:
Place the original photograph in the upper 55–60% of the canvas. Keep it photorealistic and naturally detailed. Do not alter the identity, pose, proportions, objects, architecture, scenery, or important visual details. Give it a subtle premium editorial photography finish with natural cinematic light and gentle tonal balance.

BOTTOM SECTION — HAND-PAINTED INTERPRETATION:
Transform the same exact scene into a delicate minimal watercolor and fine-ink illustration. Recreate the main subject, pose, perspective, key objects, and recognizable background elements from the photograph. Use loose watercolor washes, subtle pencil/ink outlines, imperfect hand-painted edges, soft paper texture, and restrained pastel tones. Keep the illustration airy, elegant, and slightly imperfect rather than digitally polished.

The illustration should feel like a fashion/lifestyle magazine sketchbook page, with plenty of clean negative space and a warm off-white textured paper background. Do not introduce new subjects or details.

TYPOGRAPHY:
Add a short elegant handwritten brush-script phrase underneath or integrated naturally into the illustrated section, similar to a premium lifestyle editorial poster. Underneath it, add a tiny minimalist lowercase serif/sans-serif subtitle. Typography should be subtle, sophisticated, thin, and balanced with the artwork.

AESTHETIC:
Scandinavian editorial design, quiet luxury, nostalgic travel journal, soft watercolor, delicate ink drawing, handmade paper texture, muted natural palette, sophisticated minimalism, emotional storytelling, premium art-book layout.

IMPORTANT: The photograph and illustration must clearly represent the same exact moment and scene. No collage of unrelated images, no dramatic redesign, no excessive watercolor, no cartoon appearance, no heavy outlines, no saturated colors, no clutter.

Output: photorealistic upper section + matching delicate watercolor illustration below, seamless premium editorial composition, vertical 3:4, high detail.

For different photos, just change the text phrase

Examples:
•Good Days — a kinder me
•Better Together — same window, same silence
•Little Moments — worth remembering
•Slow Days — nothing to rush
•Somewhere Quiet — just for a while
•Golden Hours — softly remembered

prompts.text:
完全基于上传的照片，创作一件精致、高端的“照片 + 简约水彩装饰画”艺术作品。使用该照片作为唯一的视觉参考，并保留确切的主体、构图、环境、服装、物体、光线、颜色和氛围。

格式：垂直 3:4 编辑组合。

顶部部分 — 原始照片：
将原始照片置于画布的上部 55–60%。保持其光线真实且细节自然。不要更改身份、姿势、比例、物体、建筑、风景或重要的视觉细节。赋予其微妙的高级编辑摄影修饰，具有自然的电影光效和温和的色调平衡。

底部部分 — 手绘诠释：
将完全相同的场景转化为精致的简约水彩和细墨插画。重新创作照片中的主要主体、姿势、透视、关键物体和可识别的背景元素。使用松散的水彩晕染、微妙的铅笔/墨水轮廓、不完美的手绘边缘、柔软的纸张纹理和克制的柔和色调。保持插画的轻盈、优雅和略带不完美感，而不是数字化的精致感。

插画应该感觉像时尚/生活方式杂志的写生页，拥有大量干净的负空间和温暖的米白色纹理纸背景。不要引入新的主体或细节。

排版：
在插图部分下方或自然融入其中添加一段简短优雅的手写毛笔书法短语，类似于高端生活方式编辑海报。在其下方，添加一个极小且简约的小写衬线/无衬线副标题。排版应微妙、精致、纤细，并与艺术品平衡。

审美：
斯堪的纳维亚编辑设计、静奢风、怀旧旅行日记、柔和水彩、细腻墨线画、手工纸纹理、柔和自然色调、精致极简主义、情感叙事、高端艺术书布局。

重要提示：照片和插画必须清晰地表现完全相同的时刻和场景。不要出现无关图像的拼贴、不要剧烈重新设计、不要过度的水彩、不要卡通外观、不要粗重的轮廓、不要饱和的色彩、不要杂乱。

输出：写实的上部区域 + 下方匹配的细腻水彩插画，无缝的高级编辑构图，垂直 3:4，高细节。

对于不同的照片，只需更改文本短语

示例：
•Good Days — a kinder me
•Better Together — same window, same silence
•Little Moments — worth remembering
•Slow Days — nothing to rush
•Somewhere Quiet — just for a while
•Golden Hours — softly remembered

items.title: 高级时尚社论纵向狭缝扫描人像

prompts.text:
TITLE: [your title]
SUBJECT: [person + pose]
DISTORTION: [echo / scan / motion delay / type refraction]
PALETTE: [neutral base + one accent]
FORMAT: 9:16

Create a premium fashion editorial portrait using controlled vertical slit-scan distortion.

Begin with a strong realistic portrait and keep at least one clear identity anchor such as the eyes, profile or facial outline. Break selected areas into vertical slices with varied widths, compression and horizontal displacement, creating a gradual transition from clear photography to optical fragmentation.

Keep some areas completely sharp rather than distorting the whole image. Preserve realistic skin, hair and fabric texture inside every slice.

Use a restrained palette, strong silhouette and generous negative space. Keep typography clean and editorial: one title, one short phrase and minimal supporting copy.

The result should feel like an optical photography experiment and high-fashion magazine poster, not a digital glitch effect.

Avoid RGB splitting, VHS noise, horizontal scanlines, uniform slices, neon cyberpunk graphics, excessive text, plastic skin, logos, numbering and watermarks.

畸变：[回声 / 扫描 / 动作延迟 / 类型折射]
色调：[中性基调 + 一种强调色]
比例：9:16

使用受控的纵向狭缝扫描畸变效果创作一张高级时尚社论人像。

从一张具有强烈写实感的人像开始，并保留至少一个清晰的身份锚点，例如眼睛、侧脸或面部轮廓。将选定区域分解为宽度、压缩度和水平位移各异的垂直切片，创造出从清晰摄影到光学碎片化的渐进过渡。

保持部分区域完全清晰，而不是扭曲整个图像。在每个切片内保留真实的皮肤、头发和织物纹理。

使用克制的色调、强烈的轮廓和大量的负空间。保持排版整洁且具社论感：一个标题，一个短句和极简的辅助文案。

结果应该感觉像是一次光学摄影实验和高级时尚杂志海报，而不是数字故障艺术效果。

避免 RGB 分离、VHS 噪点、水平扫描线、均匀的切片、霓虹赛博朋克图形、过多的文字、塑料感的皮肤、标志、编号和水印。

items.title: 夜游古城墙的东亚女子人像

prompts.text:
A realistic candid travel photo of a young East Asian woman standing on an old stone walkway beside a historic city wall at night. Behind her is a beautiful traditional Chinese-style building glowing with warm golden lights and deep red accents, with layered roofs, curved upturned eaves, detailed wooden architecture, and softly illuminated windows. Tall red lanterns hang from an ornate black lamp post nearby, adding a warm glow to the scene.
She has long, straight dark brown hair falling naturally over her shoulders and back, with a few loose strands around her face. She has soft youthful features and a gentle, genuine smile as she looks naturally toward the camera. She is wearing an oversized dark charcoal-gray leather jacket with a relaxed, slightly loose fit, paired with wide-leg light-gray jeans. A small black shoulder bag hangs at her side with a cute little white plush charm attached to it.
She is casually leaning against the black metal railing, resting one arm comfortably on it while her body is turned slightly toward the camera. The pose should feel spontaneous and relaxed, like a friend captured the moment while she was enjoying an evening walk. The old dark brick wall stretches behind her, with warm lights highlighting parts of the stonework, while the paved walkway continues into the distance with a few people and subtle city lights.
The sky is a deep gray-blue with soft clouds, contrasting naturally with the warm golden architecture and glowing red lanterns. Keep everything believable and lived-in, with realistic skin texture, natural facial proportions, individual hair strands, authentic leather and denim textures, soft evening shadows, subtle reflections from the lights, and realistic depth of field. Shot with a modern smartphone camera, slightly imperfect and natural rather than overly polished, with soft cinematic tones and a subtle dreamy atmosphere. Wide horizontal 16:9 composition.

prompts.text: 一张写实的、抓拍风格的旅行照片，镜头中一位年轻的东亚女性站在夜晚的历史古城墙旁的旧石板路上。她身后是一座美丽的传统中式建筑，散发着温暖的金光，带有深红色的点缀，拥有层叠的屋顶、弯曲的飞檐、精细的木制结构和柔光映照的窗户。附近华丽的黑色灯柱上挂着高大的红灯笼，为场景增添了温暖的光辉。她留着长长的深褐色直发，自然地披在肩膀和背上，脸庞周围有几缕散发。她有着柔和年轻的面容，正自然地看向镜头，带着温柔真诚的微笑。她穿着一件宽松的深炭灰色大码皮夹克，版型休闲，搭配浅灰色阔腿牛仔裤。她身侧背着一个小黑挎包，上面挂着一个可爱的白色小毛绒挂件。她正随意地倚靠在黑色金属栏杆上，一只手臂舒服地搁在上面，身体略微转向镜头。姿势应显得随性放松，就像朋友在她享受晚间散步时捕捉到的瞬间。古老深色的砖墙在她身后延伸，暖光勾勒出石制结构的部分细节，铺就的步道延伸向远方，点缀着几个行人和隐约的城市灯光。天空呈深灰蓝色，飘着柔和的云朵，与温暖的金黄色建筑和发光的红灯笼形成自然对比。保持一切真实且充满生活感，具有写实的皮肤纹理、自然的五官比例、根根分明的发丝、真实的皮革和牛仔材质感、柔和的晚间阴影、细微的光影反射以及真实的景深。使用现代智能手机拍摄，略带瑕疵感和自然感，而非过度修饰，具有柔和的电影色调和微妙的梦幻氛围。宽屏横向16:9构图。

items.title: 极简手绘涂鸦摄影拼贴高级海报设计

prompts.text:
Please turn each photo I upload into an individual high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, output each photo separately. The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout, with the top and bottom sections strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the screen.

The upper half preserves the original photo, maintaining the subject's identity, structure, posture, realistic texture, natural light and shadow, and the original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end color grading to give it an art magazine and exhibition image texture. To fit the frame, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The lower half extracts only the most recognizable subject, outline, structure, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, reconstructing it as a Hand-drawn Doodle Photo Collage. Do not copy the photo completely, do not keep all objects and backgrounds, but instead remove irrelevant details and select only a few photo fragments that best represent the theme and visual memory points of the original image. Re-express through cropping, scaling, reorganizing, and white space, so people can recognize the correspondence between it and the photo above at a glance.

The lower half requires new artistic judgment. Even if the original composition is poor, the background is messy, or the subject is small, actively save it into a valid work through deletion, reorganization, cropping, scale changes, and white space, truly giving the model the power to re-direct the scene.

The composition uses a method of small-scale collage groups + large empty spaces. The lower half only keeps a group of smaller photo collage units, like a cluster of visual notes placed on white paper, which can be off-center, edge-aligned, suspended, or partially cropped; the whole is not filled and does not replicate large scenes. White space is not an empty background but a part of the frame, working with photo fragments, hand-drawn lines, symbols, and text to create a sense of breath, space, pause, and asymmetrical balance. Better to have less than to have too much.

The visual language uses a mixed media approach of photo collage + hand-drawn doodles + graphic layout design. Photo fragments can be organized in irregular grids, staggered modules, or loose arrangements; edges can have rough, hand-drawn black borders. A small amount of freehand-drawn suns, stars, smiley faces, brackets, arrows, cups, lines, symbols, or graffiti-style notes can be added to enhance the personal recording and magazine feel of a scrapbook / zine / editorial collage, but must be restrained and not overshadow the main subject.

The background remains a clean white or extremely light warm white base with large areas of blank space, like a sketchbook, scrapbook, or independent magazine page. The overall vibe is relaxed, everyday, clever, and loose, but the layout must be exquisite, balanced, and durable to look at.

The color scheme extracts 2–4 of the most recognizable and emotionally valuable colors from the top photo to be used for the photo fragments, hand-drawn elements, and a few embellishments in the lower half, making the overall color unified, soft, and natural, without being cluttered, dirty, or gray.

Text is only a very small amount of editorial intervention, with no language restrictions. A few words or short phrases can be generated based on the subject, location, action, emotion, or metaphor, distributed lightly in the white space areas like casual notes in a journal, independent magazine, or zine, forming an exquisite relationship between images and text together with photo fragments and doodles.

The overall presentation features high-end visual effects composed of large empty spaces on a white background, small-scale photo collages, black hand-drawn doodle lines, a magazine-style layout, and a personal recording atmosphere. Avoid complete replication of the original image, excessive background preservation, filled screens, complex scenes, heavy decorations, a commercial template feel, a cheap journal feel, and excessive flashiness.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用 3:4 竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格 1:1，各占画面 50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级调色，使其具有艺术杂志与展览图像质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分只提取照片中最具识别性的主体、轮廓、结构、姿态与叙事关系，重构为 手绘涂鸦式摄影拼贴 / Hand-drawn Doodle Photo Collage。不要完整复制照片，不要保留全部对象和背景，而是删去无关细节，只选取最能代表原图主题与视觉记忆点的少量照片碎片，通过裁切、缩放、重组与留白重新表达，使人一眼识别它与上方照片之间的对应关系。

下半部分需重新做美术判断。哪怕原图构图差、背景乱、主体小，也要主动通过删减、重组、裁切、尺度变化和留白把它救成一张成立的作品，真正赋予模型重新导演画面的权力。

构图采用小尺度拼贴群组 + 大片空场的方法。下半部分只保留一组较小的照片拼贴单元，像被安放在白纸上的一簇视觉笔记，可偏心、贴边、悬置或局部裁切；整体不铺满，不做大场景复刻。留白不是空背景，而是画面的一部分，要与照片碎片、手绘线条、符号和文字共同形成呼吸感、空间感、停顿感与非对称平衡。宁可少，也不要满。

画面语言采用摄影拼贴 + 手绘涂鸦 + 平面版式设计的混合媒介方式。照片碎片可按不规则网格、错位模块或松散编排组织；边缘可带有粗糙、随手画出的黑色手绘边框。可加入少量自由手绘的太阳、星星、笑脸、括号、箭头、杯子、线条、符号或涂鸦式注记，增强 scrapbook / zine / editorial collage 的私人记录感与杂志感，但必须克制，不可喧宾夺主。

背景保持干净白底或极浅暖白底，大面积空白，像速写本、剪贴簿或独立杂志页面。整体气质轻松、日常、聪明、松弛，但版式要精致、平衡、耐看。

配色从上方照片中提取 2–4 种最具辨识度、最有情绪价值的颜色，用于下半部分照片碎片、手绘元素和少量点缀，使整体色彩统一、柔和、自然，不杂乱、不脏灰。

文字只作极少量编辑性介入，不限制语种。可根据主体、地点、动作、情绪或隐喻生成少量字词或短句，像手帐、独立杂志或 zine 中的随手注记一样，轻巧地分布在留白区域，与照片碎片和涂鸦共同形成精致图文关系。

整体呈现白底大片空场、小尺度摄影拼贴、黑色手绘涂鸦线条、杂志感版式与私人记录气质共同构成的高级视觉效果。避免完整复刻原图、背景保留过多、画面填满、复杂场景、厚重装饰、商业模板感、廉价手帐感和过度花哨。

prompts.text:
direction: A daily moment of a 26-year-old fictional adult Japanese female, riding a small community bus traveling through a Japanese residential area. Depicted like a casual SNS snapshot left by a real smartphone. Vehicle refers to the Hino Poncho long 1-door suburban layout widely adopted by Japanese community buses, realistically reproducing the internal dimensions, seat configuration, aisle width, handrails, and stop buttons of a small step-free route bus. Do not modify the interior layout to accommodate figure photography.
mood: A hot day, an ordinary time moving on a community bus. A slightly relaxed expression, and the contingency brought by a small accident of almost dropping the smartphone. Not a fashion shoot, but a photo in the middle of life.
model: A 26-year-old fictional adult Japanese female. Do not imitate real people, entertainers, or influencers. Natural adult female face and realistic body proportions.
face: Light everyday makeup. Looking reflexively at the falling smartphone instead of looking directly at the camera. Extremely subtle confusion in the eyes and corners of the mouth, not a deliberate posed smile.
hair: Natural black hair slightly longer than shoulder length. Because the body is leaning forward, a few strands of back hair are scattered on the cheeks and shoulders. Not perfectly organized like a salon shoot.
body: Natural physique as a 26-year-old adult female. A sense of volume in the upper body, but without magnifying specific parts, maintaining the realistic full-body balance of a wide-angle smartphone perspective. The shape of the abdomen, waist, and thighs changes naturally when sitting.
skin: Summer outfit results in extensive exposure of shoulders, collarbones, upper arms, upper back, around the abdomen and waist, and legs. Skin retains fine pores, light spots, and natural color differences around elbows and knees. No excessive skin beautification treatment.
outfit: Top is a black thin ribbed material cropped camisole. Extremely thin shoulder straps, a natural square neckline that is not too deep, largely open shoulders and back, short design, clearly showing the abdomen and waist. The soft thin ribbed fabric fits the body lightly, creating small fabric folds and vertical rib expansion differences at the chest, armpits, and abdomen when sitting. The light and dark contrast between the black fabric and the skin makes the skin exposure visually distinct. Bottoms are white low-rise shorts. Worn low near the hip bone, an extremely short summer design that makes the legs look long, but maintains necessary coverage as opaque clothing that can be worn in public. Natural horizontal folds and creases occur at the waist and leg openings when sitting.
accessories: Small silver hoop earrings, a thin chain necklace, a simple watch, a small black shoulder bag. The phone case is transparent or plain color.
bus_layout: Refers to the Hino Poncho long 1-door suburban type Japanese small step-free bus. The person is sitting normally in a forward-facing seat along the window on the side of the car body. The seat back is behind the person, and the person's knees and toes are facing forward. The adjacent seat is also forward-facing. There is an aisle extending front and back in the center, and there is also a row of seats on the opposite side. A realistic vehicle structure that rises step by step toward the rear floor. Do not place the person in a rear-facing seat or an unnatural face-to-face seat.
seat: Route bus seats in blue or blue-green moquette fabric. The backrest is slightly lower than an adult's shoulder, with utilitarian, not thick cushioning. Gray resin backrest, small armrests or handholds, extremely slight fuzzing from years of use. The person is sitting in a window seat, leaving the aisle-side seat empty.
scene_objects: Beside the person are large side windows of the bus, window frames, orange or yellow-orange vertical handrails, handrails extending upwards, stop buttons, hanging rings, and small interior advertisements for regional activities or hospital guidance. The central aisle floor is deep gray non-slip material. In the distance ahead, the passage leading to the driver's seat and the area around the fare machine can be seen. Free space for wheelchairs and strollers exists naturally as an interior structure.
pose: Sitting normally in a forward-facing window seat. The smartphone is slipping from the hand, almost falling to the junction of the seat and the aisle, so the upper body is leaning slightly forward and tilting toward the aisle side. One shoulder is lowered, one hand is reaching toward the falling phone, and the other hand remains near the seat. Legs are naturally facing the direction of travel, with differences in left and right knee positions. Do not do shooting-style leg crosses or fixed poses.
camera_position: A low perspective as if the camera was accidentally activated when the smartphone tilted and fell to a low position on the seat side. However, do not use an extreme upward angle looking up at the body from the floor. Aimed diagonally upward from a height slightly lower than the seat surface, the person, seat configuration, central aisle, windows, and interior facilities can be understood in one photo.
lighting: Daytime. Bluish-white natural light enters from the large bus window on the person's side, and the milky-white LED lighting of the interior ceiling is faintly mixed in. The shoulder, arm, and leg near the window are slightly brighter, with soft shadows remaining on the aisle side. The black camisole absorbs light, creating a natural contrast with the exposed skin. Part of the view outside the window is slightly blown out while driving.
effect: General smartphone photo. Slight JPEG compression, fine noise in dark areas, extremely weak motion blur of about 1 frame brought by the falling movement, slight white clipping of window highlights. Do not use excessive HDR or cinematic color grading.
camera: Equivalent to a 24-26mm smartphone wide-angle lens, vertical 9:16. Regular shooting instead of portrait mode. The person as well as the front and back seats, aisle, handrails, etc., relatively maintain focus. Retain the extremely weak distortion at the screen edges characteristic of smartphone wide-angle.
imperfections: Horizontal tilt of about 2-4 degrees. The person is not completely centered, slightly biased toward the window side. Part of the shoe tip or bag is subtly cropped at the edge of the frame. Stray hair strands, slightly different positions of the left and right straps of the camisole, differences in the stretching of the ribbed fabric, sitting folds in the shorts, wear on the seat moquette, small scratches on the floor, thin fingerprints or wipe marks on the window glass are retained.
background: A community bus traveling through a Japanese residential area. Low-rise houses, utility poles, guardrails, and small shops are seen flowing past through the side window. There are a few elderly passengers or ordinary passengers returning from shopping deep in the interior, but their faces are too small to identify individuals. The interior is not a brand-new display car, but in a clean but slightly used condition from daily operation.
atmosphere: A summer outfit with a large area of skin exposure brought by a black thin camisole and white shorts, coexisting with the sense of life of a real Japanese small route bus. Not a model shoot, gravure shoot, or commercial photo, but a moment of an ordinary adult female riding a community bus on a hot day.
composition: Do not fill the frame with only the person; include at least the seat back behind the person, the adjacent forward-facing seat, the central aisle, the opposite seats or handrails, and a part of the side window. Through these, understand the seat direction at a glance. Skin exposure is scattered across shoulders, collarbones, back, abdomen, arms, and legs, without placing specific body parts at the center of the composition.
negative: Rearward passenger seats, unnatural face-to-face seats, interior like a train with only long transverse benches, luxury seats of large tour buses, airplane-like seat configurations, non-existent aisles, inconsistency between the person and seat direction, voyeuristic sexy compositions, compositions aiming only at body parts, underwear exposure, clothing exposure, extreme floor upward angles, unrealistic body proportions, excessive skin retouching, doll-like faces, excessive background blur, faces similar to real people or celebrities
watermark_direction: Incorporate '@Live_life_style' naturally as an environmental element that originally existed on the community bus window glass, rather than as a post-superimposed logo.
integration_method: Combine with thin mist, wipe marks, fingerprints, and external light reflections on the side window away from the person, forming a shape where '@Live_life_style' can be read if looked at closely.
subtle_visibility: The photo looks like a normal window reflection at first glance, and the string is only discovered when paying attention.
placement: Window glass at the top or upper right side of the screen. Do not superimpose on the person's face or body.
material_behavior: Translucent texture identical to wipe marks on the glass surface, with character lines retaining density and discontinuity.
lighting_interaction: Only the part reflecting the sunlight entering the window is faintly bright, and the text part overlapping with the white-out part outside the window disappears.
perspective: Naturally give the text perspective distortion along the bus window plane angle and smartphone tilt.
avoid: Uniform white text pasted on the screen, thick logos, glowing, outlining, placing directly on the person

prompts.text:
请将上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的高级 3:4 竖版旅行手账作品，不要把多张照片拼在同一张图中。

画面采用清晰的上下结构：

上半部分约占画面 50%，完整保留输入的真实照片。保持主体身份、人物数量与姿态、建筑结构、道路方向、空间关系、真实材质、自然光影和原有色彩，不得更换地点、增删人物、重塑建筑、改变透视或把照片画成插画。只允许进行轻微的旅行杂志级调色与克制的胶片质感。

下半部分约占画面 50%，呈现一本真实摊开的旅行手账。手账放在低饱和深色桌面上，清楚表现左右页面、中央书脊、纸页厚度、轻微翻页弧度、自然投影和细腻纸张纹理。书本两侧可以使用黑色长尾夹固定。

左页使用一块从照片色彩中提取的低饱和纸张作为底页，在上面粘贴一张同一旅行照片的撕边印刷照片。照片必须保持原场景可辨认，但可以重新裁切以突出最重要的主体。撕边应具有真实纸纤维、轻微翘边和自然厚度，并使用两到三小段半透明米色胶带固定。

右页保留大面积连续的暖白色纸张，不要塞满内容。根据输入照片中真实可见或能够可靠确认的信息，选择二到四件值得纪念的小元素，例如：

- 建筑局部、窗户、拱门、屋顶、路灯或瓷砖纹样；
- 车辆号码牌、街道路牌、车票或交通线路片段；
- 水面、植物、船只、桥梁、雕塑或当地材料纹理；
- 一张很小的撕边照片、一块方格纸或一段简短铅笔速写。

纪念元素必须来自输入照片或已确认的地点信息，不得加入其他城市的地标、通用旅游贴纸或虚构纪念品。所有小元素都必须明显小于左页主照片，并围绕文字松散分布，保持右页安静、克制和有呼吸感。

右页只加入以下三层英文文字：

1. 一个根据照片主体或地点提炼的 1–3 个英文单词标题；
2. 一个简短字段，格式为“PLACE / FIELD NOTE”；如果无法可靠确定地点，使用“TRAVEL / FIELD NOTE”；
3. 一句 5–12 个英文单词的观察句，只描述照片中真实可见的颜色、光线、建筑、道路、自然景物或空间感受。

文字必须简短、准确、清楚可读，使用深棕色铅笔、钢笔或自然手写质感。不要生成长段落，不要添加作者名、日期、坐标、品牌、网址、二维码、Logo、乱码、假中文或其他文字。

整体风格像一本真实旅行结束后整理出来的私人纪念手账：安静、温暖、克制、具有真实纸张、胶带、撕边照片和收藏物的触感。上方是真实世界，下方是从同一地点留下来的纸面记忆。

必须保持：

- 一张输入照片对应一张独立成品；
- 3:4 竖版；
- 上下区域接近 1:1；
- 上方照片清楚、完整且高度保真；
- 下方必须是真实摊开的手账，不是平面双栏海报；
- 左页承担主要照片；
- 右页保留大面积留白；
- 纪念元素必须来自同一地点；
- 所有图片内容都能追溯到输入照片。

避免：multiple-photo collage, grid layout, altered architecture, invented landmark, replaced subject, distorted perspective, mirrored extension, blurred-photo background, dense scrapbook, excessive stickers, generic travel icons, unrelated souvenirs, full-page decoration, glossy digital template, flat vector layout, plastic 3D, illegible text, excessive typography, fake logo, watermark, signature.

prompts.text:
[LOCATION] =

Create a premium, scroll-stopping Instagram travel campaign for [LOCATION] in a 4:5 vertical portrait format.

A large modern smartphone stands vertically near the upper center, acting as the main visual anchor. A single elegant map-navigation notification card overlaps the upper-middle of the phone, integrated naturally with realistic depth, soft shadows, and subtle reflections.

The notification should feature a warm-white, lightly frosted rounded rectangle with a refined mobile UI aesthetic and perfectly legible typography:

[map icon] MAPS — now
You keep searching.
Come visit [LOCATION] instead.

Keep the notification within the upper 25–40% of the composition. It should feel physically connected to the phone and must not cover the miniature destination scene.

Below the smartphone, a folded papercraft map labeled “[LOCATION]” unfolds into a handcrafted miniature world. Include only 4–6 highly recognizable elements that naturally represent the destination—such as iconic architecture, landscapes, nature, food, culture, or atmosphere.

Visual Materials

- Phone & distant background: realistic photography
- Buildings & landmarks: handcrafted painted 3D clay
- Map, terrain, roads & water: layered hand-cut paper
- Vegetation & small details: miniature clay and paper

Make the physical materials clearly visible through paper fibers, cut edges, layered surfaces, subtle clay texture, tiny imperfections, and soft dimensional shadows.

Add one large location pin and a tiny backpacked traveler standing on the map, looking toward the miniature world. Keep the traveler small and secondary, like a hidden discovery detail.

Use only 2–3 subtle travel doodles, such as a paper airplane with a dotted path, a tiny heart, and a simple hand-drawn route arrow. Keep them thin, imperfect, and journal-like.

Visual Hierarchy

1. Notification
2. Miniature [LOCATION] world
3. Location pin
4. Tiny traveler
5. Folded map

Maintain generous negative space and avoid clutter, excessive landmarks, unnecessary text, icons, props, or competing focal points.

Use a refined 3–5 color palette inspired by [LOCATION], warm cinematic or golden-hour lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic miniature photography, tactile materials, and sophisticated editorial advertising composition.

The final image should feel like a world-class handcrafted travel campaign-instantly recognizable, destination-specific, clean, emotionally inviting, and rich with subtle details worth discovering.

items.title: 东方文化竖三栏展览海报设计

prompts.text:
[Theme]:
[Chinese Title]:
[English Title]:
[Core Subject]:
[Three-Column Relationship]: Character Crossing / Same Subject Three-Column Variation / Middle Column Main Scene / Artifact Crossing / Other
[Left Column Content]:
[Middle Column Content]:
[Right Column Content]:
[Main Color Palette]:
[Date / Venue]:
[Aspect Ratio]: 9:16

Generate a high-aesthetic, high-information-density Oriental culture exhibition poster, using a "vertical three-column / left-middle-right composition."

Do not split the three columns equally, and do not make them into three independent information boxes. Flexibly adjust the width according to the theme, letting each column assume different visual responsibilities, then actively cross column lines through subjects, text, lines, or materials to reconnect the three areas into a complete image.

Choose different methods based on the content:

Character Crossing: The character is mainly located in the middle column, with sleeves, skirt hems, or ornaments entering the left and right columns, letting the left side be responsible for patterns and textures, and the right side be responsible for structure and archival information.

Same Subject Three-Column Variation: Let a continuous subject pass through all three columns simultaneously, presenting different materials, stages, or states in different columns, but the outline must be continuous and cannot become three independent objects.

Middle Column Main Scene: Place the strongest key visual in the center column, such as a mountain, building, or large image, while the left and right columns handle the title, date, materials, and research information, allowing parts of the subject or clouds/mist to cross columns.

Artifact Crossing: Large artifacts enter other columns diagonally or horizontally from one side, using the subject itself to break the vertical grid, making the three columns merely a layout order rather than physical boundaries.

Typography is redesigned according to the structure of each image, using oversized single characters, full horizontal titles, cross-column titles, medium-scale titles, or small information spines. Do not use a fixed four-character vertical layout, and do not repeat the "two horizontal characters + two vertical characters" template.

Information density should be close to mature museum posters, art catalogs, and Editorial Design: include English subtitles, materials, structures, dates, venues, curatorial short sentences, and a small number of research drawings, but concentrate them in 2–3 areas, do not spread them evenly across the whole screen.

Small structural line drawings, material research, production processes, sections, or pattern research can be added, but keep the area restrained, serving only as second-layer reading content.

Use 3–5 main colors, forming clear column relationships with large areas of pure color fields. Combinations such as black, bone white, vermilion, cobalt blue, deep cyan, and ochre are allowed, but avoid dirty gray, heavy aging, and complex gradients.

Overall requirements: High definition, clear, clean, information-rich but orderly, accurate subject proportions, sharp text and fine lines, with the completion level of a mature cultural exhibition poster.

Avoid: Mechanical three-way splitting, three independent cards, PPT information boxes, fixed title templates, subjects being too small, columns being completely fragmented, random small text, meaningless decorative lines, excessive aging, mottled noise, and low-completion AI poster feel.

prompts.text:
【主题】：
【中文标题】：
【英文标题】：
【核心主体】：
【三栏关系】：人物跨栏 / 同一主体三栏变化 / 中栏主景 / 器物跨栏 / 其他
【左栏内容】：
【中栏内容】：
【右栏内容】：
【主色调】：
【日期 / 场馆】：
【画面比例】：9:16

生成一张高审美、高信息密度的东方文化展览海报，采用「竖三栏 / 左中右构图」。

三栏不要平均分割，也不要做成三个独立信息框。根据主题灵活调整宽度，让每一栏承担不同视觉职责，再通过主体、文字、线条或材质主动跨越栏线，把三个区域重新连接成一个完整画面。

可根据内容选择不同方式：

人物跨栏：人物主要位于中栏，衣袖、裙摆或饰物进入左右栏，让左侧负责纹样与材质，右侧负责结构与档案信息。

同一主体三栏变化：让一件连续主体同时穿过三栏，在不同栏位呈现不同材质、阶段或状态，但轮廓必须连续，不能变成三个独立物体。

中栏主景：中央栏放置最强主视觉，例如山体、建筑或大型图像，左右栏承担标题、日期、材质、研究信息，并允许部分主体或云雾越栏。

器物跨栏：大型器物从一侧斜向或横向进入其他栏位，用主体本身打破竖向网格，让三栏只是排版秩序，而不是物理边界。

Typography 根据每张画面的结构重新设计，可使用超大单字、完整横排标题、跨栏标题、中等尺度标题或小型信息脊柱。不要固定使用四字纵排，也不要重复“两字横排 + 两字竖排”的模板。

信息密度要接近成熟博物馆海报、艺术图录和 Editorial Design：加入英文副标题、材质、结构、日期、场馆、策展短句和少量研究图，但集中在 2–3 个区域，不要平均铺满全画面。

可以加入小型结构线稿、材质研究、制作流程、剖面或纹样研究，但面积保持克制，只作为第二层阅读内容。

色彩使用 3–5 个主要颜色，以大面积纯净色域形成明显栏位关系。允许黑、骨白、朱红、钴蓝、深青、赭色等组合，但避免脏灰、严重做旧和复杂渐变。

整体要求：高清、清晰、干净、信息丰富但有秩序，主体比例准确，文字与细线锐利，具有成熟文化展览海报完成度。

避免：机械三等分、三个独立卡片、PPT 信息框、固定标题模板、主体过小、栏位完全割裂、随机小字、无意义装饰线、过度做旧、斑驳噪点和低完成度 AI 海报感。

prompts.text: Create a premium editorial art poster for every uploaded photograph, treating each image as its own independent composition and never merging multiple photos together. Use a strict 3:4 vertical format with the canvas split into two perfectly equal horizontal halves: the upper half should remain a faithful, photorealistic presentation of the original image, preserving the subject’s exact identity, facial features, proportions, pose, clothing, objects, composition, lighting, shadows, mood, and natural colors, enhanced only with sophisticated editorial color grading and seamless environmental extension where necessary; the lower half should transform the visual story into an entirely different artistic interpretation—a tiny, carefully composed handmade mixed-media artwork centered within expansive warm ivory negative space, occupying no more than 10–20% of the lower section, using expressive ink sketching, layered gouache-like color fields, subtle collage textures, torn-paper edges, imperfect brushwork, visible fibers, soft pigment variations, and charming human imperfections while retaining the most recognizable silhouette, gesture, objects, and emotional narrative from the original photo. Extract up to four dominant harmonious colors from each photograph and reinterpret them in a muted, sophisticated palette. Add only occasional understated editorial typography when it genuinely enhances the composition, such as a poetic title, place, date, or single word. The overall result should feel like a collectible contemporary art publication cover—minimal, poetic, tactile, elegant, emotionally quiet, visually distinctive, and unmistakably connected to its original photograph.

prompts.text: 为每张上传的照片创建一个高级编辑艺术海报，将每张图像视为独立的构图，且绝不将多张照片合并在一起。使用严格的 3:4 垂直比例，画布被完美地等分为上下两个水平部分：上半部分应保持对原始图像的忠实、写实呈现，保留主体的确切身份、面部特征、比例、姿势、服装、物体、构图、光影、阴影、情绪和自然色彩，仅在必要时辅以高级编辑色彩分级和无缝的环境扩展；下半部分应将视觉故事转化为完全不同的艺术解读——一个微小的、精心构图的手工混合媒介艺术品，居中放置在广阔的暖象牙色留白空间内，占据下半部分不超过 10–20% 的空间，使用表现力强的水墨素描、分层的水粉感色域、细腻的拼贴纹理、撕裂的纸张边缘、不完美的笔触、可见的纤维、柔和的颜料变化以及迷人的人工瑕疵，同时保留原始照片中最具辨识度的轮廓、姿势、物体和情感叙事。从每张照片中提取最多四种主导的和谐色彩，并以柔和、高级的调色板重新对其进行诠释。仅在确实能增强构图时，添加偶尔且低调的编辑排版，例如富有诗意的标题、地点、日期或单个单词。整体效果应像一本具有收藏价值的当代艺术刊物封面——极简、富有诗意、有触感、优雅、情绪安静、视觉独特，且与原始照片有着明确的联系。

prompts.text:
超写实日系卧室镜前自拍摄影，竖版约 2:3，一名年轻成年东亚女性，明确成年，坐在狭小卧室里的低矮软凳/坐垫上，用一台亮粉色便携数码相机对着落地镜自拍。摄影者实际为人物自己，画面通过镜面形成正面构图，采用约 35–50mm 等效便携数码相机镜头，机位接近人物胸腹高度并基本平视。人物位于画面中央，占画面高度约 82–88%，从头顶完整拍到鞋尖；左右两侧保留床铺、被褥、抱枕和墙面挂布，整体像 2000s–2010s 日本少女房间里的生活自拍，不是商业棚拍。

人物为年轻成年东亚女性，中小骨架，肩部偏窄，上半身自然纤细，腰部较短，骨盆与髋部自然适中，大腿自然柔软匀称，小腿修长。整体是小骨架、紧凑、自然轻盈的成年女性比例，不要生成高挑欧美模特、健美肌肉型、夸张宽胯或过度丰满身材。

人物坐在一只蓝色方形软垫/矮凳上，软垫表面印有卡通月亮、星星和睡眠主题图案，底部放在铺着花纹地毯的地面上。骨盆位于画面中央偏下，上半身略微向前倾。

双腿是画面的重要结构：两条腿都屈膝抬起并向镜头前方靠近，膝盖靠得很近，几乎并拢，形成自然的内收坐姿。大腿从髋部向前上方折起，小腿再向下垂，双脚落在画面最下方，鞋尖略微向外分开。不要盘腿，不要翘二郎腿，也不要双腿完全伸直。

人物右手举一台亮玫红/洋红色小型便携数码相机，相机尺寸较小，机身为高饱和粉色，正面有一个明显的大型黑色圆形镜头，周围带少量银色或黑色细节。相机位于胸前略偏人物右侧，手指自然握住机身，像正在按快门。

人物另一只手抬到脸侧，手掌托住左侧脸颊/下巴，手肘自然靠近胸前或膝盖附近。头部轻轻向托脸一侧倾斜，动作安静、柔软。

人物视线略微向下看向相机或镜面，表情平静、略带一点慵懒和害羞感，不露齿笑。嘴唇自然闭合，颜色为低饱和粉红色。

人物留乌黑色短 Bob/短狼尾感发型，长度到下巴和后颈附近，整体蓬松但不夸张。额前为较厚的长碎齐刘海，长度接近眼睛上缘，中央几束刘海自然垂下并遮住部分眉毛。右侧脸附近的头发更长，轻轻贴着脸颊。发尾略微内扣和外翘混合，带一点自然凌乱感。不要长直发、高马尾、大卷发。

脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，下颌柔和，肤色白皙偏冷。深棕色杏仁眼，双眼皮自然，睫毛较长但不夸张，眼线细；眉毛自然偏细。鼻梁小巧，嘴唇浅粉。妆容轻薄、偏日系自然妆，双颊有轻微粉色腮红，整体保持真实皮肤纹理，不要过度磨皮。

上身穿一件纯白色短袖修身 T 恤/短款家居上衣，领口为宽圆领或浅 U 领，面料柔软、略有弹性，贴合身体但不过分紧身。袖口短而简单，没有图案、Logo 或复杂装饰。

下身穿白色短裤/白色超短家居裤，大部分被抬起的大腿和构图遮挡，只在髋部和腿根附近露出少量白色布料。整体是很简洁的全白家居搭配，不要生成裙子、牛仔裤或彩色下装。

双腿穿纯白色过膝袜/长筒棉袜，袜筒到膝盖上方附近，颜色干净偏奶白，材质为柔软细密针织，表面略有轻微纵向纹理。袜口平整，没有彩色条纹或大 Logo。袜子整体不透明，不要生成半透明丝袜或黑丝袜。

脚穿一双银灰色＋白色复古运动鞋/厚实低帮跑鞋，鞋型偏 2000s 复古运动鞋，鞋头圆润、鞋底较厚但不过分夸张。鞋面由银灰、浅灰、白色拼接，带明显白色鞋带和深灰色弧形装饰线条。两只鞋完整出现在画面底部，鞋尖微微朝外。

背景是一个非常拥挤、可爱、日系卡通感浓厚的小卧室。人物身后墙面不是纯白，而是被大量红白格纹和卡通布艺装饰覆盖。

画面左上墙面挂有一块红白色卡通挂布/海报，主体是一个大型蓝白猫型卡通角色的红白化图案，周围有棋盘格、圆形和小图标装饰。不要要求生成准确版权角色文字或 Logo，只保留“蓝白机器猫风格卡通挂布”的视觉感觉。

人物背后正中央有一块大型红白格纹窗帘/布帘，外圈为红白 gingham 小格纹，中央区域印有大量彩色街道、商店、小汽车、房屋、圣诞树或童话城市图案，视觉信息非常丰富。中央偏右有一棵深绿色圣诞树图案，上面点缀彩色小球和灯饰，是背景的重要视觉元素。

窗帘上方还有一条横向大型卡通布饰，颜色以奶油白、红、浅蓝和粉色为主，带食物、动物或童趣插画，但文字保持模糊不可读。

画面左侧是一张窄床，床头靠墙，铺着浅黄色/奶油黄色条纹或格纹被褥。床上放着一个大型蓝白色卡通圆脸抱枕/毛绒玩偶，只有部分进入画面。床架为深棕木色。

画面右侧同样有另一张床或软垫家具，铺着白色、橙色和浅蓝色卡通床品。右边缘可见一个浅蓝色毛绒毯/毛巾从床边自然垂下。后方枕头上有黄色卡通人物图案和橙色边缘。

人物身后下方还能看到一只深棕色小桌/矮柜，周围有少量电线、充电线或杂物，增强真实私人卧室感。

地面铺着一块颜色略旧的花纹地毯，以灰白、淡粉、酒红和浅蓝色为主，图案不规则，带一点长期使用后的轻微磨损。

光线采用室内顶灯/环境灯＋便携数码相机弱直闪。人物脸部、白色上衣、大腿、白袜和鞋面被明显提亮，背景仍保持清楚但稍暗。肤色呈偏冷白和淡粉色，银灰运动鞋产生柔和反光。

prompts.text:
A candid, photorealistic 9:16 image capturing an everyday moment between an adult Japanese woman around 22 years old and her boyfriend in a private bedroom at night, with an intimate, joyful, and natural feeling, like a long-term couple who are deeply comfortable and in love with each other.

She has a delicate oval-shaped face, naturally large almond-shaped eyes, soft eyebrows, a refined nose bridge, and natural-looking lips. Her long black hair is slightly wavy and falls naturally around her, with a subtly tousled appearance and a few fine baby hairs falling loosely around her face. Her makeup is very light, while her skin retains realistic texture, including visible pores and small natural imperfections.

She is wearing a light cream-colored spaghetti-strap nightgown made of soft fabric, with a feminine yet comfortable silhouette, natural draping, and realistic small fabric folds. The outfit is appropriate for a bedroom setting, clearly visible but not overly elaborate.

She is interacting naturally with her boyfriend, with a cheerful, playful expression and a slightly affectionate, playful demeanor. She is not posing for the camera; her actions should feel like a spontaneous moment that happens naturally while the two of them are playfully teasing and joking around.

The viewpoint is entirely from the boyfriend's perspective, as if the viewer were standing or sitting directly in front of her. The camera is positioned close, approximately 50–80 cm away, prioritizing a clear view of her face, eyes, hair, and upper body. The angle may shift slightly depending on her pose, but it should always maintain a natural boyfriend-POV feeling. No phone, camera, or hand holding a camera should appear in the frame.

She looks toward her boyfriend or reacts to him depending on the action in each shot; her gaze and facial expression should feel as though she is genuinely interacting with someone directly in front of her, rather than looking at the camera.

The bedroom contains a bed, slightly rumpled pillows and blankets, a bedside table, and a warm bedside lamp. There are subtle signs of everyday life throughout the room, keeping the environment lived-in rather than perfectly arranged. The nighttime lighting is soft and warm, creating gentle depth across her face and hair.

Photorealistic candid photography, authentic couple moment, natural smartphone perspective, realistic skin texture, visible fine hair strands, realistic fabric folds, subtle smartphone grain, natural depth of field, imperfect spontaneous composition, warm ambient bedroom lighting, intimate but wholesome everyday atmosphere, no studio lighting, no beauty filter, no plastic skin, no excessive retouching, no posed fashion photography.

prompts.text:
Subject:
A single fictional adult Japanese woman close to the camera in a bright living room, sticking out her tongue. A portrait depicting an intimate and playful expression.

Location · Time · Background:
Afternoon living room with sunlight coming in through large windows. White curtains, light-colored sofa, round mirror on a wooden shelf, dried flowers, green leaves placed in the foreground.

Clothing · Accessories:
Beige thick ribbed sleeveless top, a brown cardigan knit jacket slipping off the shoulders, combined with a thin necklace.

Pose · Fingers · Contact:
Leaning the upper body forward from the sofa, one index finger against the cheek, the other finger lightly touching the chin. Wrist and fingers connect naturally.

Expression · Gaze:
Both eyes staring straight at the lens, tongue naturally sticking out, showing a mischievous expression. Eyebrows and cheeks remain soft.

Face · Makeup:
Round oval outline, large dark brown pupils, thin eyebrows, thin coral-colored eye makeup, glossy rose-beige lip gloss.

Hair:
Chin-length dark brown blunt bob. Retaining thin bangs and fine hair strands by the cheeks, using window light to illuminate the edges.

Light Source:
Warm direct light entering from the right window, creating bright highlights on the face, shoulders, and fingers. White interior reflections soften shadows.

Color · Tone:
Mainly beige, brown, ivory, and leaf green, warm-toned, maintaining skin transparency and pupil contrast.

Material · Fine Texture:
Thick ribbing of the top, fine mesh of the cardigan, natural moisture of the lips and tongue, skin texture, hair strands, detailed depiction of curtains and leaf veins.

Composition · Camera:
Vertical 9:16 ultra-close-up composition. The visual center of the chest is placed near 50% of the frame width, and the center of the face is placed near 69%, using the right window and leaves as bright edge decoration.

Image Processing · Completion:
Retaining a wide-angle smartphone-like close-up feel, sharp resolution of eyes and fingers, shallow depth-of-field background blur, giving a warm micro-grain feel.

Collapse Avoidance · Prohibited:
Only one adult female, looking straight at the lens, tongue, chin fingers, fixed same clothing. Avoid extra fingers, deformed teeth or tongue, overexposure, logos, readable text, watermarks.

人物穿着雾紫色修身吊带家居短裙，柔软贴身针织或棉质面料，裙身自然贴合身体，胸部饱满自然，胸前轮廓清晰但不过度夸张，胸腰比例协调，腰线自然清晰，腰胯转折柔和，臀腿线条圆润流畅，整体身形为丰腴自然曲线型，比例健康真实，不低俗，不刻意情色化。发型为黑色长发随意挽成松散丸子头，脸侧保留少量自然碎发，居家松弛感明显。

人物站在木质书架前，一只手正在抽出一本书，另一只手自然扶着书架边缘，身体轻微前倾并自然偏向镜头，前倾动作生活化且稳定，形成上半身、腰线和臀腿的连续自然轮廓。人物神情安静柔和，像在夜晚找书时短暂停顿，被随手拍到的一瞬间。

场景为真实有人居住的温暖公寓客厅，右侧是高书架，书架上摆满书籍，局部有垂落绿植；旁边有暖黄色落地灯，背景可见米色沙发、靠枕、茶几、烛光、小花束、地毯、墙上装饰画，以及窗外模糊可见的城市夜景灯光，整体空间温暖、文艺、安静、有故事感。光线采用真实夜晚室内暖灯照明，以落地灯和客厅环境灯为主，局部有柔和高光，暗部保留自然层次，营造温暖私密的夜读氛围。

整体画面要求真实自然，高质量写实摄影感，像在家中拍到的一张生活照片，不要摄影棚布光，不要夸张 HDR，不要 CG 感，不要 3D 渲染感，不要过度磨皮，不要过度锐化，不要低俗性感摆拍。重点保证人物肢体完整自然，双手清晰，手指数量正确，前倾姿态稳定，比例协调，受力真实。

A photorealistic full-body portrait of a young adult woman with an elegant, feminine appearance and naturally curvy, well-proportioned figure. items.title: 超写实复古工业风红丝袜女性街拍

prompts.text:
Ultra-realistic retro fashion street photography, vertical format approx 3:4, a young adult East Asian female sitting on a gray metal bench in a semi-outdoor industrial building corridor, behind her is a large area of off-white old brick wall, exposed concrete beams and columns, and gray drainage pipes. The overall look presents 90s–2000s Japanese magazine fashion editorial + modern minimalist industrial space + snapshot feel, quiet, restrained, with a bit of retro urban temperament.

The photographer is located directly in front of the subject, slightly to the left, about 2–2.5 meters away, using an equivalent 35–50mm lens, with the camera position slightly lower than the subject's chest and tilted slightly upwards. The subject is located in the center-right of the frame, occupying about 75–80% of the frame height, captured completely from the top of the head to the feet; a large amount of empty corridor, columns, and floor is preserved on the left, while the bench and personal belongings are preserved on the right. Do not crop tightly, do not over-blur the background, let the industrial environment be clearly established.

The subject is a young adult East Asian female, small-boned, with narrow shoulders, a slender and natural upper body, a short and clearly cinched waist, naturally wide pelvis and hips, and long thighs with soft, realistic volume, with calves gradually tapering. The overall look is a naturally elegant, light hourglass proportion; do not generate an exaggeratedly voluptuous figure, athletic muscular legs, or paper-thin proportions.

The subject is sitting sideways on the bench, her body facing about 30–40° to the front-left of the frame, hips sitting on the right side of the bench, and her upper body tilting significantly toward the front-left, with one shoulder higher than the other, forming a soft diagonal line. The head also tilts toward the subject's left following the body, the face turns toward the camera, eyes looking directly at the photographer, expression quiet, slightly lazy and detached, lips naturally slightly parted, no toothy smile.

The left hand reaches down from the left side of the body, fingers pinching a folded English newspaper/financial newspaper, the newspaper naturally hanging toward the ground, the layout showing black and white text, gray images, and bold headlines, but the text remains blurred and unreadable. The wrist wears a string of dark red small bead bracelets.

The right hand hangs naturally on the right side of the body, holding a red translucent/glossy low-heeled shoe, grasping the heel or back, letting the shoe hang in front of the bench. The right wrist wears a vintage watch with a gold case + green rectangular dial, and the fingers wear a few silver/gold rings.

The legs are the core of the image: the subject is wearing semi-transparent berry red / wine red-pinkish stockings, the stockings completely covering from the thighs to the toes, the color is very obvious, but natural skin tone can still be seen through them. The material is thin nylon/stocking texture, about 15–25D, the surface is smooth with a slight sheen, not a thick cotton sock feel.

One leg is extended significantly from the bench toward the bottom-left of the frame, the knee is slightly bent, and the stocking-wrapped toe is stretched forward and slightly pressed down, the foot being closest to the lens, forming a natural perspective enlargement; the other leg is bent and close to the bottom of the bench, the sole of the foot on the ground or hanging slightly above the floor. Both feet are not wearing shoes, only red stockings.

On the ground at the bottom of the frame is a pair of berry red/rose red low-heeled ballet shoes / kitten heel pumps that match the one in the hand. The shoe style is round toe or slightly square-round toe, the upper is semi-transparent or gauze material, with thin red piping and a small bow, the heel is very low and small, about 3–4cm. The subject's right hand holds the other shoe of the same style, forming a clear "one on the ground, one in hand" relationship.

The upper body wears a cream white / ivory white slim-fit long-sleeved knit top, the fabric is thin and soft, slightly sheer but maintaining normal complete coverage. The neckline is a wide shallow U-neck/boat neck, revealing the collarbone and shoulder-neck lines. The body of the garment fits tightly to the waist, forming natural folds.

The sleeves are long and slightly sheer, with small white ruffles/lace edges near the wrist, carrying a bit of retro feminine detail. Do not generate a regular white T-shirt or thick sweater.

The lower body wears a high-saturation bright red / dark red knit mini skirt, the skirt style is simple and fits the hips, the length is about below the root of the thigh, the fabric has dense longitudinal knit texture or slight ribbing. The skirt waist is near the natural waistline, no pleats, no plaid, no leather.

The subject wears a short white pearl necklace, the pearls are medium-small in size, close to the base of the neck, adding a sense of retro elegance. Overall jewelry is few but refined, do not add exaggerated earrings or large necklaces.

The subject has long dark black-brown wavy hair, length near the waist, with natural thick volume. The top of the head is slightly side-parted, there are no thick straight bangs on the forehead, and long stray hairs on both sides modify the face shape. The hair hangs down from both sides of the shoulders, forming obvious large S-shaped curls in front of the chest and on the left side, the ends of the hair are soft with a natural fluffy feel. No short hair, high ponytail, or excessive perming.

The face shape is small and somewhat oval, with a soft jawline, and the skin tone is fair and slightly warm. Eyebrows are naturally thin, dark brown almond eyes, slight double eyelids, extremely fine eyeliner; the bridge of the nose is small and straight, and the lips are low-saturation rose bean paste color. The makeup is clean, with a Japanese retro magazine feel, preserving real skin texture, no internet-celebrity style skin smoothing.

The scene is a semi-outdoor industrial building corridor / parking garage / gallery back hall passage. The background on the right is a whole wall of gray-rice white painted brick wall, the brick outlines, mortar joints, wear, and uneven coating are clearly visible, and the wall surface has slight aging particles.

Exposed concrete ceiling beams, rectangular structural beams, gray drainage pipes, and connecting elbows are visible on the upper left. Toward the back left, there is a huge light gray circular load-bearing column extending from the ground to the top. There can be a small electrical box/sensor on the wall, but no prominent text should appear.

The subject is sitting on a minimalist gray metal bench, the seat surface composed of multiple horizontal metal strips, supported by thin gray metal legs, the overall style leaning toward industrial design. On the right side of the bench is a high-gloss red small square bag / vanity bag, the material is shiny patent leather or PVC.

Above the red small bag is a pale yellow / cream yellow soft beret or plush hat, slightly collapsed in shape, with a soft color. Next to it is an open newspaper/magazine naturally spread on the bench surface.

The ground is gray coarse-grained concrete / cement floor, with small stones, wear, and a few light-colored water stains/damp spots. The subject's extended red stocking foot forms a strong color contrast with the gray ground.

The light is soft natural daylight entering from the open space on the left, overall leaning toward an overcast day or large window-side diffused light. The subject's left face, chest, white top, and front leg are softly illuminated; the subject's right body, brick wall, and bench enter deeper gray shadows, forming natural light and dark levels.

No strong flash, no studio softbox. The white brick wall is overall warm gray or ivory gray, not pure white; the red skirt, stockings, shoes, and handbag are the main color focuses of the entire image.

prompts.text:
超写实复古时装街拍摄影，竖版约 3:4，一名年轻成年东亚女性坐在半室外工业建筑走廊的一张灰色金属长椅上，背后是大面积米灰白色旧砖墙、裸露混凝土梁柱和灰色排水管。整体呈现 90s–2000s 日系杂志时装大片＋现代极简工业空间＋随手抓拍感，安静、克制、带一点复古都市气质。

摄影者位于人物正前方略偏左约 2–2.5 米，采用约 35–50mm 等效镜头，机位略低于人物胸口并轻微向上。人物位于画面中央偏右，占画面高度约 75–80%，从头顶完整拍到双脚；左侧保留大量空旷走廊、立柱和地面，右侧保留长椅与随身物品。不要紧裁，不要背景虚化过度，要让工业环境清楚成立。

人物为年轻成年东亚女性，中小骨架，肩部偏窄，上半身纤细自然，腰部短而明显收束，骨盆和髋部自然偏宽，大腿修长但有柔和真实体积，小腿逐渐收细。整体是自然优雅、轻沙漏型比例，不要生成夸张丰满身材、健美肌肉腿或纸片人比例。

人物侧坐在长椅上，身体朝画面左前方约 30–40°，臀部坐在长椅右侧，上半身明显向左前方倾斜，肩膀一高一低，形成柔和斜线。头部也跟随身体向人物左侧倾斜，脸转向镜头，双眼直视摄影者，神情安静、略带慵懒和疏离感，嘴唇自然微张，不露齿笑。

左手从身体左侧向下伸，手指捏着一份折叠的英文报纸/财经报纸，报纸自然垂向地面，版面是黑白文字、灰色图片和粗体标题，但文字保持模糊不可读。手腕佩戴一串深红色小珠手链。

右手自然垂在身体右侧，手里拎着一只红色半透明/亮面低跟鞋，抓住鞋跟或后帮，让鞋子垂在长椅前方。右手佩戴一块金色表壳＋绿色矩形表盘的复古腕表，手指戴少量银色/金色戒指。

双腿是画面核心：人物穿着半透明莓红色 / 酒红偏粉色丝袜，丝袜从大腿一直完整覆盖到脚趾，颜色非常明显，但仍能透出自然肤色。材质为轻薄尼龙/丝袜质感，约 15–25D，表面顺滑、轻微丝光，不要厚棉袜感。

一条腿从长椅向画面左下方大幅伸出，膝盖轻微弯曲，丝袜包裹的脚尖向前伸直并略微下压，脚部离镜头最近，形成自然透视放大；另一条腿弯曲并靠近长椅下方，脚掌落地或轻轻悬在地面上。两只脚都没有穿鞋，只穿红色丝袜。

画面下方地面上放着一只与手中成对的莓红/玫红色低跟芭蕾鞋 / kitten heel pump。鞋型为圆头或微方圆头，鞋面半透明或薄纱材质，带细红色滚边和小蝴蝶结，鞋跟很低、细小，约 3–4cm。人物右手拎着另一只同款鞋，形成“一只在地上、一只拿在手里”的明确关系。

上身穿一件奶油白 / 象牙白色修身长袖针织上衣，面料薄而柔软，轻微透肤但保持正常完整覆盖。领口为宽大的浅 U 领/船领，露出锁骨和肩颈线条。衣身紧贴腰部，形成自然褶皱。

袖子很长并略带薄透感，袖口靠近手腕位置有细小白色荷叶边/蕾丝边，带一点复古女性化细节。不要生成普通白 T 恤或厚毛衣。

下身穿一条高饱和正红 / 深红色超短针织迷你裙，裙型简洁贴合髋部，长度约到大腿根下方，面料有细密纵向针织纹理或轻微罗纹。裙腰位于自然腰线附近，不要百褶，不要格纹，不要皮革。

人物佩戴一条短款白色珍珠项链，珍珠大小中等偏小，贴近颈根，增加复古优雅感。整体首饰少而精，不要加入夸张耳饰或大项链。

人物留深黑棕色超长波浪发，长度到腰部附近，发量自然浓密。头顶轻微侧分，额前没有厚齐刘海，两侧有长碎发修饰脸型。头发从肩膀两侧垂下，在胸前和左侧形成明显的大 S 型卷曲，发尾柔软、带自然蓬松感。不要短发、高马尾或过度卷烫。

脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，下颌柔和，肤色白皙偏暖。眉毛自然偏细，深棕色杏仁眼，双眼皮轻微，眼线极细；鼻梁小巧顺直，嘴唇为低饱和玫瑰豆沙色。妆容干净、偏日系复古杂志感，保留真实皮肤纹理，不要网红磨皮。

场景为半室外工业建筑走廊 / 停车楼 / 美术馆后场通道。背景右侧是一整面灰米白色刷漆砖墙，砖块轮廓、砂浆缝、磨损和不均匀涂层清楚可见，墙面带轻微旧化颗粒。

左上方可见裸露的混凝土天花梁、矩形结构梁、灰色排水管和连接弯头。靠左后方有一根巨大浅灰色圆形承重柱，从地面延伸到顶部。墙上可有一个小型电气盒/传感器，但不要出现醒目文字。

人物坐在一张极简灰色金属长椅上，椅面由多根横向金属条组成，细灰色金属脚支撑，整体偏工业设计。长椅右侧摆着一只高光泽红色小方包 / 化妆包，材质为亮面漆皮或 PVC。

红色小包上方放着一顶淡黄色 / 奶油黄色柔软贝雷帽或毛绒帽，形状略塌，颜色柔和。旁边还有一张打开的报纸/杂志自然摊在椅面上。

地面为灰色粗颗粒混凝土 / 水泥地面，带细小石子、磨损和几块浅色水渍/潮湿斑。人物延伸出来的红色丝袜脚与灰色地面形成强烈色彩对比。

光线为左侧开放空间进入的柔和自然日光，整体偏阴天或大型窗边漫射光。人物左脸、胸口、白色上衣和前腿受到柔和照亮；人物右侧身体、砖墙和长椅进入更深的灰色阴影，形成自然明暗层次。

不要强闪光，不要棚拍柔光箱。白色砖墙整体呈暖灰、象牙灰，不是纯白；红色裙子、丝袜、鞋和手袋是全画面的主要色彩焦点。

The character is a young adult East Asian female, small frame, narrow shoulders, naturally slender upper body, small oval-shaped face, soft jawline, fair skin with a neutral warm tone. Do not exaggerate Western features, do not over-retouch, do not generate plastic skin.

The character's body is slightly turned to the left of the frame, the upper body is slightly retracted, shoulders are naturally shrugged a bit, forming a posture with a sense of shyness and restraint. The surface of the yukata is distributed with a large number of deep pink, rose red, and dark red flower prints, the flowers are medium-sized, with a small amount of dark green leaves and stems. The sleeves are wide and loose, after the character's arms are raised, the cuffs and fabric form natural folds around the shoulders and arms. The overall color of the yukata is slightly dark and warm in the night scene, do not generate bright pure white or high-saturation red.

An obvious pink bow/kimono belt knot structure is visible behind the character on the left, the bow is large in size, the color is berry pink, rose pink, or old pink, partially blocked by the character's body and the night, only showing two corners of the fabric. Do not turn it into a hair accessory.

The background is a large-scale fireworks festival at night. The sky accounts for about 55–60% of the upper part of the frame, the overall color is deep blue-black, ink purple-black, and the exposure is dark.

There is a largest and brightest firework in the top right of the frame: a huge blue-white circular firework, with a warm gold/orange-gold radial fireline in the center, and the outer periphery is composed of a large number of white-blue bright spots forming a complete ring, the edges of the firework are slightly blurred with an obvious bloom halo.

There is a slightly smaller pink-white spherical firework in the upper left-middle position, showing a dense spherical shape, with colors mainly pink, light white, and light orange, accompanied by pink smoke around it.

Several golden-yellow and orange-yellow firework bursts also appear simultaneously directly behind and to the right behind the character's head, some of which have already begun to disperse, forming a large number of circular bright spots and short light trails. Different fireworks overlap each other, creating the layers of a real festive night sky.

The fireworks produce a large amount of pink, purple-red, and grey-blue smoke, especially in the sky above the character's head and on the right side, there are large areas of glowing smoke, which appear hazy pink-purple after being illuminated by the fireworks. The smoke must be obvious, do not have only clean firework patterns.

The background ground area is very dark, only silhouettes of distant crowds, outlines of trees, railings, or festival site lights can be vaguely seen. Occasionally there are very small warm orange light spots, blue light spots, and blurred figures on both sides and behind the character, do not generate clear streets or buildings.

背景是夜晚大型烟火大会。天空占画面上半部约 55–60%，整体是深蓝黑、墨紫黑色，曝光较暗。

画面右上方有一枚最大、最亮的烟花：巨大的蓝白色圆形烟花，中心带暖金/橙金色放射状火线，外围由大量白蓝色亮点组成完整圆环，烟花边缘略微虚化并带明显 bloom 光晕。

画面左上偏中位置有一枚稍小的粉白色球形烟花，呈密集圆球状，颜色以粉红、浅白、淡橙为主，周围伴随粉红烟雾。

人物头顶正后方和右后方还同时出现数枚金黄色、橙黄色烟花爆点，其中部分已经开始散开，形成大量圆形亮点和短光轨。不同烟花互相重叠，制造真实节庆夜空的层次。

烟花产生大量粉红、紫红、灰蓝色烟雾，尤其人物头顶上方和右侧天空有大片发光烟雾，被烟花照亮后呈朦胧粉紫色。烟雾必须明显，不要只有干净的烟花图案。

背景地面区域非常暗，只能隐约看到远处人群剪影、树木轮廓、栏杆或祭典场地灯光。人物两侧和身后偶尔有非常小的暖橙色光点、蓝色光点和模糊人影，不要生成清晰街道或建筑。

光线必须保持极低照度。人物不是被闪光灯完全照亮，而主要受到烟花、远处祭典灯光和非常微弱手机自动曝光提亮。脸部和浴衣曝光偏暗，肤色略带红棕/暖灰色，人物轮廓部分融入黑暗背景。

烟花区域明显过曝，亮点周围出现强烈光晕和色彩溢出。人物脸部则轻微欠曝，形成原图那种“背景烟花很亮、人物很暗”的反差。

整体影像必须带明显的2000s 旧手机 / CCD / 早期数码相机夜间拍摄质感：较高 ISO 噪点、轻微失焦、低动态范围、明显 JPEG 压缩、暗部发红发紫、边缘柔软、烟花高光大面积 bloom、轻微手抖模糊和自然色偏。不要现代旗舰手机的干净 HDR，不要 8K 锐利，不要商业烟火大片。

色调以深蓝黑夜空＋粉紫烟雾＋蓝白烟花＋金黄烟花＋暗红粉花浴衣＋暖棕肤色为主，整体朦胧、怀旧、安静，像夏日烟火大会结束前朋友用旧相机随手拍到的一瞬间。

重点锁定：年轻成年东亚女性＋夜晚烟火大会＋人物位于画面下方、烟花占据大部分上方空间＋短黑发＋长碎刘海遮住部分眼睛＋双手靠在脸侧＋羞涩安静表情＋奶油白底玫红花卉浴衣＋背后粉色腰带蝴蝶结＋右上巨大蓝白圆形烟花＋左侧粉白球形烟花＋中部多枚金黄色烟花＋大片粉紫烟雾＋人物明显欠曝＋烟花明显过曝＋高 ISO 噪点＋低清柔焦＋旧 CCD/手机夜拍质感。

避免：白天、夕阳、人物占满画面、高清商业人像、人物被强闪光照亮、背景完全虚化、烟花数量太少、烟花颜色单一、干净无烟雾夜空、人物笑得很夸张、剪刀手、比心、高马尾、长卷发、现代洋装、JK 制服、红色纯色和服、商业棚拍光、强 HDR、锐利 8K、塑料皮肤、CG 感、动漫风、水印和乱码文字。

items.title: 极简墨线风景小笺对比海报

prompts.text:
Please create each of my uploaded travel photos into an independent 'Minimalist Ink Line Landscape Note' comparison poster, without stitching multiple images, outputting each photo separately.

Adopt a 3:4 vertical composition overall, clearly maintaining the visual contrast of 'original photo above, stylized re-drawing below'. The proportions of the upper and lower areas can be naturally adjusted based on the content of the original image, rather than being mechanically divided equally, but the two parts must have clear boundaries and a clear reading relationship, jointly constituting a complete editorial design work.

The upper part preserves the original photo with high fidelity: maintain the location, main subject, architectural structure, character posture, natural light and shadow, spatial layers, and original color atmosphere; do not replace scenes, change key objects, stretch subjects, or fabricate landmarks that do not exist in the original image. Perform only slight and restrained magazine photography color grading; if needed to fit the frame, naturally extend the sky, water surface, ground, or environmental background.

The lower part uses warm rice white or natural paper white as the complete base, refining the photo into a small, minimized minimalist ink line landscape sketch. Do not fully copy the original image, and do not draw the entire frame with line work; actively filter the most recognizable and poetic few pieces of information from the frame, such as: an architectural or topographical structural anchor point, a ridge or shoreline, a plant with a certain posture, a small figure or a travel object, and one or two weather and spatial clues.

Delete irrelevant crowds, cluttered vegetation, repetitive buildings, and trivial backgrounds. The re-drawn subject should occupy only about 38%–62% of the width of the lower area, retaining about 55%–72% of continuous, complete, and perceptible paper white.

Lines should use black or deep grey-black fine steel pen, dry ink, and slight brush 'flying white' texture: allow for thickness variations, pauses, intermittence, paper grain, ink leakage, and unclosed outlines, making it look like a quick but accurate observation sketch made during travel.

Architecture relies on a few structural lines to show proportion; peaks and distant views retain only sparse outlines; water surfaces, fog, sky, and distance are mainly completed through white space; plants do not depict leaves one by one but represent posture through branch direction and very few ink dots. Avoid large areas of grey ink wash, and avoid drawing them as complete traditional landscape paintings or precise architectural drawings.

The color scheme is primarily black ink, allowing for a maximum of two small areas of accent colors extracted from the original photo, such as cinnabar red, autumn leaf ochre, lotus pale pink, moss grey-green, or fishing net warm yellow. The total area of accent colors should not exceed 8% of the lower frame, falling only on one most memorable part, without watercolor full-spread, colored outlines, or high-saturation decoration.

Text should be like headers and captions of small travel publications, few in number but clear and readable. Generate a short English title based on the photo content, paired with a numbering field 'INK NOTE 01' and a very short English observation sentence.

The title can use restrained serif, typewriter, or slightly irregular manual printing fonts; text is placed in the main white space areas, maintaining a breathing distance from the illustration, not pressing against the main subject, not using ornate calligraphy, and not generating Chinese seals, author signatures, brand names, or watermarks. Different images only change the title, number, and observation sentence, keeping the overall layout and font temperament consistent.

The final image should present a clear contrast between real travel photography and a light ink line observation sketch; quiet, restrained, and airy, like a page taken from an independent travel journal, an architectural observation book, or a private sketchbook. The focus is not on showing off techniques, but on letting a location, a type of weather, or a brief movement from the original photo be seen again through subtraction, stopping the pen, and paper white.

Avoid: direct line-art filtering of the entire photo, complete repetition of upper and lower content, filling the lower frame entirely, continuous grey washes, traditional Chinese painting full compositions, complex leaves, precise cross-hatching, comic-style architecture, cartoon characters, watercolor filling, high-saturation color clashing, pseudo-Chinese characters, copying signage text from photos, author names, watermarks, e-commerce template feel, and cheap vintage filters.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的「极简墨线风景小笺」对比海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。

整体采用3:4竖版构图，明确保留“上方原始照片、下方风格转绘”的视觉对照。上下区域可根据原图内容自然调整比例，不必机械均分，但两部分必须边界清楚、阅读关系明确，并共同构成一张完整的编辑设计作品。

上半部分高保真保留原始照片：保持地点、主体、建筑结构、人物姿态、自然光影、空间层次和原有色彩氛围，不得替换场景、改变关键物体、拉伸主体或虚构原图中不存在的地标。仅进行轻微而克制的杂志摄影调色；如需适配画幅，可自然延展天空、水面、地面或环境背景。

下半部分使用温润的米白色或自然纸白作为完整底面，将照片提炼为一幅缩小的极简墨线风景小稿。不要完整照搬原图，也不要把整个画面平均线描；应主动筛选画面中最有识别度和诗意的少数信息，例如：一个建筑或地貌结构锚点、一条山脊或水岸线、一株具有姿态的植物、一名小人物或一件旅行物件，以及一至两条天气与空间线索。

删除无关人群、杂乱植被、重复建筑和琐碎背景。转绘主体仅占下半区域宽度约38%–62%，保留约55%–72%连续、完整、可感知的纸白。

线条使用黑色或深灰黑色的细钢笔、干墨与轻微毛笔飞白质感：允许粗细变化、停顿、断续、纸齿、漏墨和未闭合轮廓，使其像旅行途中迅速但准确留下的观察小稿。

建筑依靠少量结构线表现比例，山峰与远景只保留稀疏轮廓，水面、雾气、天空与距离主要通过留白完成；植物不逐片描绘叶子，而以枝干方向和极少墨点表现姿态。避免灰墨大面积铺染，避免画成完整传统山水画或精密建筑制图。

配色以黑墨为主，只允许从原照片中提取最多两种小面积强调色，例如朱砂红、秋叶赭黄、荷花淡粉、苔藓灰绿或渔网暖黄。强调色总面积不超过下半画面的8%，仅落在一个最有记忆点的局部，不做水彩满铺、彩色轮廓或高饱和装饰。

文字应像小型旅行出版物的页眉与图注，数量少但清楚可读。根据照片内容生成一个简短英文标题，搭配编号字段“INK NOTE 01”和一句极短英文观察句。

标题可使用克制的衬线体、打字机体或略带手工不齐的印刷体；文字放在主要留白区域，与插画保持呼吸距离，不压住主体，不使用华丽书法，不生成中文印章、作者签名、品牌名或水印。不同图片只更换标题、编号和观察句，整体版式与字体气质保持统一。

最终画面应呈现真实旅行摄影与轻盈墨线观察稿之间的明确对照；安静、克制、疏朗，像一页从独立旅行刊物、建筑观察册或私人速写本中取出的纸本小笺。重点不是炫技，而是通过删减、停笔与纸白，让原照片中的一个地点、一种天气或一个短暂动作被重新看见。

避免：整张照片直接线稿滤镜化、上下内容完全重复、下半铺满画面、连续灰色晕染、传统国画满构图、复杂树叶、精密交叉排线、漫画化建筑、卡通人物、水彩填色、高饱和撞色、伪中文、复制照片中的招牌文字、作者姓名、水印、电商模板感和廉价复古滤镜。

prompts.text:
Create a highly realistic 4:5 editorial fashion photograph featuring a young woman on the right beside a child-sized hand-drawn illustrated girl on the left, designed as her miniature visual counterpart.

The woman has long, naturally wavy dark black-brown hair, a gentle smile, and looks toward the illustrated girl. She wears a cobalt-blue utility jacket with realistic seams, buttons and pockets, both hands inside the pockets; a cream sweater with dark navy horizontal stripes; a long ivory pleated ankle-length skirt; mustard/caramel oval crossbody bag; white ankle socks; and dark burgundy leather loafers.

The illustrated girl matches the woman’s outfit, colors, hairstyle, pose and mood exactly. She remains clearly hand-drawn with delicate pencil/ink outlines, soft watercolor coloring, subtle blush, expressive eyes and a gentle smile.

Set them against a minimalist weathered light-gray concrete wall and rough gray pavement, with no background clutter. Both are fully visible from head to shoes, slightly facing each other, with generous negative space.

Use soft overcast natural daylight, subtle shadows, realistic skin and fabric texture, 50mm full-frame camera, eye-level perspective, f/4, natural proportions and high resolution. Premium minimalist Japanese/Korean street-fashion editorial aesthetic blended with whimsical children's illustration.

Negative: no mismatched outfits, altered identity, distorted faces/hands, extra limbs or people, photorealistic cartoon, anime woman, cropped feet/head, wide-angle distortion, clutter, text, watermark or logo.

Use the same beautiful adult East Asian woman across the set, with direct eye contact, realistic skin texture, soft natural hair, and a sensual but natural presence. She wears a simple backless summer kitchen dress in ivory or soft cream, with a light apron and a delicate headscarf. The setting is a refined retro Shaker-style kitchen with mushroom-gray cabinets, dark walnut counters, warm gray stone surfaces, subtle brass hardware, and clean summer daylight.

This batch should focus more on body language, eye contact, and pose geometry than on big action scenes. The woman must remain the clear visual focus in every frame.

This style is suitable both for individual animals with clear outlines and poses, and for objects with clear individual outlines encountered during travel, such as suitcases, cameras, hats, shoes, coffee cups, pottery, bicycles, roadside seats, or small souvenirs.

Accurately maintain the identity, quantity, pose, direction, outer contour, key structure, light and shadow, and real environment of the animal or travel object, with only slight photographic color grading. Do not change the subject or stylize the photo area into an illustration.

The lower part uses extreme reduction and extraction.

If the subject is an animal, only retain the most important ear shape, head-to-body ratio, tail direction, standing/sitting pose, and expression.

If the subject is a travel object, only retain the outer contour, handle, wheels, lens, cup rim, folds, straps, or wear characteristics that define its identity.

Use hesitant, broken, slightly paused black crayon outlines, and one to two light crayon smears extracted from the original photo. Allow line crossing, paper grain, unfilled areas, repetitive lines, and partial pauses.

prompts.text:

Character's attention is focused on the matter in front of them, not looking at the camera; actions are naturally triggered by sudden situations, allowing for clumsiness, imbalance, being too late to react, or momentarily frozen, do not deliberately pose.

【Scene Pool】
① Shaken soda suddenly sprays out: Just opened the bottle cap, foam suddenly gushes out, the character subconsciously reaches out to block the bottle mouth or dodge.
② Instant noodle soup spills out: Holding the cup noodles and about to sit down, the bowl suddenly tilts, the character hurriedly reaches out to support it, soup has already spilled onto the table.
③ Shopping bag suddenly breaks: Just entered the door when the bottom of the bag splits, fruits and drinks roll out, the character quickly squats down to grab the scattered items.
④ Bed sheet wraps the person in: While tidying the bed sheet, the body is entangled by the sheet, showing only the head, hands, and feet, struggling to break free.
⑤ Takeout bag stuck on the door handle: The character is already walking into the room, the bag behind them is suddenly caught by the door handle, pulling the body to look back.
⑥ Balloon suddenly slips away: While tying a knot for the balloon, the balloon suddenly flies away, the character instinctively looks up and reaches out to chase it.
⑦ Sweeping robot hits the side of the foot: The character is squatting and tidying things, the robot suddenly bumps over, the character looks back and reaches out to block it.
⑧ Drying rack blown over by wind: The balcony clothes rack suddenly tilts, the character hurriedly reaches out to support it, clothes slide off with it.
⑨ Headphone cable tangled with bag strap: Preparing to go out and finds the headphone cable tangled with the bag strap, the character lowers their head to untangle it, the body is pulled to one side by the cable.
⑩ Garbage bag suddenly ruptures: Carrying a garbage bag through the hallway, the bottom of the bag suddenly splits, things scatter all over the ground, the character is dazed for a moment before preparing to squat down and pick them up.

【Imaging】
Imaging of iPhone handheld casual shots; natural exposure, white balance, and ambient light; allow natural slight motion blur or focus deviation; retain real life traces and appropriate negative space.

写实，高度详细，写实的色彩还原，对比度自然，白平衡准确，主体细节清晰，织物和花朵纹理真实，边缘清晰，微妙的摄影颗粒，均衡的动态范围，自然的环境阴影，高分辨率图像，清晰的面部和服装细节，真实的深度和透视，专业级质量。

items.title: 刺绣旅行布贴海报设计

prompts.text:
Please turn each travel photo I upload into a separate "Embroidered Travel Patch" high-end editorial poster, not a multi-image collage, with each photo output individually.

The overall layout uses a 3:4 vertical original-photo-comparison composition. The upper half retains a clear original photo with substantial area, and the lower half presents a single embroidered travel subject extracted from the same photo. The top and bottom usually occupy about 50% each, which can be slightly adjusted according to the photo ratio, but the original photo comparison must not be cancelled.

The upper half preserves the subject identity, quantity, posture, structure, observation angle, environmental relationship, real texture, natural light and shadow, and original colors in the photo with high fidelity, only performing slight travel magazine and art publication color grading. The upper part must continue to be a real photographic work, and must not be illustrated, have scenes replaced, have subjects added or deleted, or have the structure of buildings and transportation vehicles changed.

When the original photo ratio is not suitable for the horizontal area, it should be centered to retain its own ratio, and supplemented with the solid color sidebars of the lower half's fabric background, without stretching, mirroring, or using blurred photo edge-filling.

The lower half should not embroider the entire photo completely. Only select one core subject with the most recognition and clearest outline from the photo, such as a tram, a boat, a bicycle, a hot air balloon, an animal, a person with clear movements, or a travel object.

Retain the outer contour, orientation, posture, key structure, and iconic color blocks that determine the subject's identity, and delete building complexes, streets, sky, water surfaces, mountains, trees, and other complex backgrounds.

The subject uses a reduced extraction or single-item display composition, occupying about 28%—52% of the width and about 30%—50% of the height of the lower area, usually placed in the center or lower middle. Retain about 45%—65% of continuous, complete fabric open space without fragmented decorations around it.

2—5 short stitches can be added to imply tracks, water waves, wind direction, ground, or movement direction, but they must not develop into a complete background, and a second visual subject must not appear.

The background of the lower half is a whole piece of clearly visible twill, old canvas, coarse cotton, or linen. The fabric base color must be extracted from the original photo and adaptively changed according to each photo, such as grayish blue, terracotta pink, turquoise, smoky blue-gray, warm beige, or other low-saturation colors; do not use the same off-white cloth fixedly for all photos.

Use real satin stitch, split stitch, chain stitch, backstitch, and a small amount of loose thread to constitute the subject. The stitch direction must change according to the subject's blocks, structure, and movements: metal, wood, clothes, animal fur, wheels, hulls, balloons, or plants need to be expressed using embroidery threads of different directions, lengths, and pile heights.

Localized thread piling, slightly uneven stitches, edge misalignment, exposed backing, loose threads, thread ends, and fabric wrinkling are allowed, making it look like real handmade embroidery sewn on a fabric surface, rather than a printed illustration or digital filter.

Each work extracts 4—8 embroidery thread colors from the original photo, retaining the subject's most recognizable color relationships, and then appropriately summarizes and softens them. Fixed rainbow threads, neon gradients, or high-saturation color clashing unrelated to the photo must not be used.

Text is concentrated below the embroidered subject, using lower pile height chain stitches, small woven labels, or fabric embroidered characters. By default, it includes a title of 1—3 English words, a field like "PATCH NO. 01", and a short observation sentence of 5—10 English words.

The text content is extracted based on the real visible subject, action, or state in the photo, and must be clearly readable, restrained in quantity, not block the subject, and not generate fake place names, author names, brands, logos, URLs, or gibberish.

Overall presentation is a quiet, warm travel patch visual with handmade temperature and a sense of collectability. The real photo is responsible for preserving the complete scene, and the embroidery area only leaves the one subject most worth remembering, like taking a mark from the journey that can be sewn on clothes, bags, or luggage.

Avoid embroidering the entire landscape, full background embroidery, same-composition-different-material of the photo, printed stickers, flat vector mascots, thick felt collages, photos pasted on cloth, knitted toys, embroidery hoop mockups, extra people or animals, fashion brand logos, author signatures, watermarks, and a sense of cheap templates.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的“刺绣旅行布贴”高级编辑海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。

整体采用3:4竖版原图对比构图。上半部分保留清楚、具有实质面积的原始照片，下半部分呈现从同一张照片中提取出的单个刺绣旅行主体。上下通常各占约50%，可以根据照片比例轻微调整，但不得取消原图对比。

上半部分高保真保留照片中的主体身份、数量、姿态、结构、观察角度、环境关系、真实材质、自然光影和原有色彩，仅进行轻微的旅行杂志与艺术出版物调色。上半必须继续是一张真实摄影作品，不得插画化、替换场景、增删主体或改变建筑与交通工具结构。

原图比例不适合横向区域时，应居中保留自身比例，并使用下半织物底色的纯色侧栏补齐，不拉伸、不镜像、不使用模糊照片填边。

下半部分不要把整张照片完整刺绣出来。只选择照片中最有识别度、轮廓最清楚的一个核心主体，例如一辆电车、一只船、一辆自行车、一个热气球、一只动物、一名动作明确的人物或一个旅行物件。

保留决定主体身份的外轮廓、朝向、姿态、关键结构和标志性色块，删除建筑群、街道、天空、水面、山体、树木和其他复杂背景。

主体采用缩小提炼或单体陈列构图，占下半区域宽度约28%—52%、高度约30%—50%，通常放在中部或中下部。周围保留约45%—65%连续、完整、没有碎片装饰的织物空场。

可以加入2—5条短小针脚，暗示轨道、水波、风向、地面或动作方向，但不得发展成完整背景，也不得出现第二视觉主体。

下半背景是一整块真实可见的斜纹布、旧帆布、粗棉或亚麻。织物底色必须从原照片提取并根据每张照片自适应变化，例如灰蓝、赤陶粉、青绿、烟蓝灰、暖米色或其他低饱和颜色，不要为所有照片固定使用同一种米白布。

使用真实的缎面绣、劈针、锁链针、回针和少量松线构成主体。针脚方向必须跟随主体体块、结构和动作发生变化：金属、木材、衣服、动物毛色、车轮、船身、球囊或植物，需要使用不同方向、长度和绒高的绣线表现。

局部允许绣线堆高、针脚轻微不齐、边缘错位、露底、松线、线头和布面起皱，使它像真正缝在布面上的手工刺绣，而不是印刷插画或数字滤镜。

每张作品从原照片提取4—8种绣线颜色，保留主体最有辨识度的色彩关系，再适度归纳和柔化。不得使用与照片无关的固定彩虹线、霓虹渐变或高饱和撞色。

文字集中在刺绣主体下方，使用较低绒高的链式针脚、小型织标或布面刺绣字。默认包含一个1—3个英文单词的标题、一个“PATCH NO. 01”式字段和一句5—10个英文单词的简短观察句。

文字内容根据照片中真实可见的主体、动作或状态提炼，必须清楚可读、数量克制，不遮挡主体，不生成假地名、作者名、品牌、Logo、网址或乱码。

整体呈现安静、温暖、具有手工温度和收藏感的旅行布贴视觉。真实照片负责保存完整场景，刺绣区域只留下最值得记住的一个主体，像从旅途中取下一枚可以缝在衣服、布袋或行李上的记号。

避免整幅风景全部刺绣、完整背景刺绣、照片同构图换材质、印刷贴纸、平面矢量吉祥物、厚毛毡拼贴、照片粘贴在布上、针织玩具、刺绣圈Mockup、额外人物或动物、时尚品牌标志、作者签名、水印和廉价模板感。
