The upper part preserves the original photo with high fidelity. Maintain the architectural identity, main structure, real materials, perspective relationship, natural lighting, environmental scale, and original color atmosphere, only performing slight high-end photographic color grading to give it the texture of architectural magazines, independent publications, and exhibition photography. To adapt to the frame, the sky, ground, or environmental background can be naturally extended, but the main architectural body must not be stretched, distorted, replaced, or changed at will.

The lower part extracts the most recognizable outlines, structures, and spatial relationships of the building from the original photo, reconfiguring them into a monochrome copperplate etching or classical architectural print. Do not directly replace the entire photo with a line drawing, nor mechanically copy the composition of the upper part; the scale, cropping, and position should be reselected according to the architectural features. Arches, spires, domes, colonnades, or gables can be enlarged, or a continuous facade can be compressed into a horizontal rhythm, making the lower part an edited and refined independent plate, while still being able to recognize the original building at a glance.

Use extremely fine etching lines, parallel hatching, cross-hatching, stippling, broken lines, and a small amount of drypoint scratches to shape stone, brick walls, carvings, window panes, metal roofs, and spatial shadows. Foreground structures are clear, and dark areas are established through line density rather than large blocks of pure black; background, air, sky, and screen edges gradually reduce lines and stippling, naturally dissipating into the paper, avoiding hard rectangular borders and complete photo outlines.

The lower part uses warm ivory white, natural cream, or slightly aged paper backgrounds, retaining about 35%—55% continuous paper white. The subject is prioritized in the middle and lower parts, leaving breathable empty space around it. The paper has restrained and realistic fibers, tiny indentations, and plate pressure, but do not make it look like dirty old kraft paper or use excessive retro filters.

Only one ink color and its lightness variations are allowed for each work. The ink color is adaptively selected according to the temperament of the original image from deep indigo, Prussian blue, blue-gray, charcoal ink, or warm dark sepia, but multiple color inks must not be mixed in the same work. Establish volume, distance, and light through variations in the thickness, density, overlap, and ink starvation of lines of the same color.

Refine a 1—3 word English title based on the location, architectural type, morphology, or travel feelings in the photo, and add a plate number in the form of "PLATE NO. 01" and a 5—10 word English observation sentence.

The text uses narrow uppercase serif fonts or old topographical movable type in the same color as the print, clearly readable with slight ink starvation and paper tooth; placed in the continuous white space, forming a sparse and restrained publication layout with the main building. Do not have garbled characters, meaningless long text, or large areas of text that grab the subject.

Overall reference classical copperplate etching, European urban topography, museum architectural plates, old architectural survey books, and contemporary high-end editorial design, presenting a precise, quiet, rational visual temperament with a sense of collectability and real printing touch.

Avoid simple black and white filters, pencil sketches, watercolors, gouache, comic ink lines, CAD blueprints, pure vector line art, screen-tone dots, multi-color printing, hard photo outlines, full-page coverage without white space, hard rectangular illustration frames, 3D rendering, plastic feel, e-commerce feel, and template feel.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张欧洲建筑旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的高级单色建筑蚀刻版画对比海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。

整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下形成清晰但自然的原图与转绘对照。两个区域通常各占约50%，可根据原图主体比例进行少量调整，但不得取消原图对比关系。

上半部分高保真保留原始照片。保持建筑身份、主体结构、真实材质、透视关系、自然光影、环境尺度和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微的高级摄影调色，使其具有建筑杂志、独立出版物和展览摄影质感。为适配画幅，可以自然扩展天空、地面或环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲、替换或随意改变建筑主体。

下半部分从原图中提取建筑最具识别性的轮廓、结构和空间关系，重新构成为单色铜版蚀刻或古典建筑版画。不要把整张照片直接换成线稿，也不要机械复制上半部分构图；应根据建筑特征重新选择尺度、裁切与位置。可以放大拱券、尖塔、穹顶、柱廊或山墙，也可以将连续立面压缩成横向节奏，使下方成为经过编辑和提炼的独立图版，同时仍能一眼认出原建筑。

使用极细蚀刻线、平行排线、交叉排线、点描、断续线和少量干刻划痕，塑造石材、砖墙、雕刻、窗格、金属屋面和空间阴影。近景结构清楚，暗部通过线条密度而不是大块纯黑建立；远景、空气、天空与画面边缘逐渐减少线条和点描，自然消散进纸张，避免硬矩形边框和完整照片轮廓。

下半部分使用温暖象牙白、自然米白或轻微旧化的纸张背景，保留约35%—55%的连续纸白。主体优先集中于中下部，四周留出可以呼吸的空场。纸张具有克制真实的纤维、细小压痕和印版压力，但不要做成脏旧牛皮纸或过度复古滤镜。

每张作品只允许使用一种墨色及其明度变化。墨色根据原图气质自适应选择深靛蓝、普鲁士蓝、蓝灰、炭墨或暖深褐，但同一张作品中不得混用多种彩色油墨。通过同色线条的粗细、疏密、交叠和缺墨变化建立体积、距离与光线。

根据照片中的地点、建筑类型、形态或旅行感受，提炼一个1—3个英文单词的标题，并加入“PLATE NO. 01”形式的图版编号和一句5—10个英文单词的观察短句。

文字使用与版画同色的窄体大写衬线字或旧地志铅字，清晰可读，带轻微缺墨与纸齿；放置在连续留白中，与建筑主体形成疏朗、克制的出版物版式。不要出现乱码、无意义长文或抢夺主体的大面积文字。

整体参考古典铜版蚀刻、欧洲城市地志、博物馆建筑图版、旧建筑测绘册和当代高级编辑设计，呈现精确、安静、理性、具有收藏感和真实印刷触感的视觉气质。

避免简单黑白滤镜、铅笔素描、水彩、水粉、漫画墨线、CAD蓝图、纯矢量线稿、丝网网点、多色印刷、照片硬描边、满版无留白、硬矩形插画框、3D渲染、塑料感、电商感和模板感。

items.title: 亲密视角复古厨房写实人像系列

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 photorealistic vintage kitchen portrait series with an intimate POV feeling.

A beautiful adult East Asian woman is the clear visual focus in every frame. She wears a simple backless summer kitchen dress in ivory or soft cream, with a light apron and a delicate headscarf. The setting is a refined retro Shaker-style kitchen with mushroom-gray cabinets, dark walnut counters, warm gray stone surfaces, subtle brass hardware, and soft summer daylight.

The series should feel like the viewer is inside the scene with her. Use direct eye contact, playful body language, and varied camera placement to create a strong POV experience. Each frame should feel like a captured moment rather than a stiff pose.

Include dynamic, visually engaging kitchen moments such as:

* almost losing balance while reaching from a stool
* looking into the camera from inside an open fridge
* sitting on a stool with a cheeky, playful expression
* turning back while pulling something fresh from the oven

Keep the woman’s face angles varied across the series: avoid repeating the same three-quarter face in every image. Use a mix of front-facing gaze, side glance, upward gaze, downward gaze, and profile-based eye contact so the series feels alive and natural.

Use posture, emotion, long legs, shoulders, waistline, and eye contact as the main source of visual interest. Props should stay secondary. If props appear, keep them small and supportive, such as strawberries, a cake slice, a wooden spoon, a whisk, a tray, or a small glass jar. Do not let oversized opaque objects block the body or steal attention from the model.

Lighting should be clean, soft, and summery. Keep the color balance neutral to slightly warm. The retro feeling must come from the kitchen style, wardrobe, textures, and atmosphere — not from a heavy yellow or orange vintage filter. Skin should look natural, white clothing should stay ivory-white, and gray cabinets should remain gray.

The final result should feel sensual, playful, feminine, intimate, and editorial, with realistic anatomy, realistic skin texture, soft natural hair, and a believable lived-in kitchen environment.

Avoid repetitive face angles, oversized props, stiff posing, yellow color cast, orange skin, distorted hands, exaggerated wide-angle body distortion, cluttered backgrounds, complex strap designs, and obvious AI artifacts.

prompts.text:
创建一个 9:16 的写实复古厨房人像系列，具有亲密的 POV 视角感。

一位美丽的成年东亚女性是每一帧中清晰的视觉焦点。她穿着一件简单的象牙色或柔和奶油色的露背夏季厨房连衣裙，搭配轻便的围裙和精致的头巾。场景是一个精致的复古 Shaker 风格厨房，配有蘑菇灰色的橱柜、深色胡桃木台面、温暖的灰色石材表面、细微的黄铜五金件和柔和的夏季日光。

该系列应该让观众感觉仿佛置身于场景之中。使用直接的眼神交流、俏皮的肢体语言和多变的相机位置来创造强烈的 POV 体验。每一帧都应该感觉像是一个捕捉到的瞬间，而不是僵硬的姿势。

包括动态且极具视觉吸引力的厨房时刻，例如：

* 从凳子上伸手拿东西时几乎失去平衡
* 从打开的冰箱内部看向镜头
* 坐在凳子上，带着厚脸皮、俏皮的表情
* 从烤箱中取出新鲜食物时回头看

在整个系列中保持女性的面部角度多样化：避免在每张图像中重复相同的三分之二脸。混合使用正面注视、侧视、仰视、俯视和侧脸眼神交流，使系列感觉生动自然。

将姿势、情感、长腿、肩膀、腰线和眼神交流作为主要的视觉趣味来源。道具应保持次要地位。如果出现道具，请保持它们小巧且起到辅助作用，例如草莓、一角蛋糕、木勺、打蛋器、托盘或小玻璃罐。不要让巨大的不透明物体遮挡身体或从模特身上转移注意力。

光线应该是干净、柔和且充满夏日气息的。保持色彩平衡为中性至略微偏暖。复古感必须来自厨房风格、服装、质感和氛围——而不是来自厚重的黄色或橙色复古滤镜。皮肤应该看起来很自然，白色的衣服应该保持象牙白，灰色的橱柜应该保持灰色。

最终结果应该感觉感性、俏皮、女性化、亲密且具有社论风格，具有真实的解剖结构、真实的皮肤纹理、柔软自然的头发和可信的生活化厨房环境。

避免重复的面部角度、过大的道具、僵硬的姿势、黄色色偏、橙色皮肤、扭曲的手部、夸张的广角身体畸变、杂乱的背景、复杂的肩带设计以及明显的 AI 瑕疵。

prompts.text:
Hyper-realistic seaside summer girlhood portrait photography, vertical version about 3:4, a young adult East Asian female sitting on a dark gray stone low wall at the edge of a seaside promenade/pier, background is light blue-green seawater, white sand beach, a light green sea-crossing bridge across the frame, distant port cranes and extremely clear blue sky. Using about 35–50mm equivalent lens, medium-close distance shot, photographer about 1.5–2 meters from the subject, camera position close to the subject's waist and abdomen height and basically at eye level. Subject located in the center-right of the frame, occupying about 75–82% of the frame height, composition from the top of the head to below the knees, keeping a light straw-yellow straw hat in the lower-left foreground. Realistic travel snapshot perspective, no fisheye, no obvious background blurring.

Subject is a young adult East Asian female, small-boned, shoulders moderate to narrow, upper body slender and natural, waist short and slightly tapered, pelvis and hip width moderate, thighs natural and symmetrical, overall belongs to a small-boned, light and slender, natural youthful proportion. Do not generate voluptuous hourglass, exaggerated wide hips, thick thighs, athletic muscularity or tall European and American model proportions.

Subject sitting on the edge of the low wall, body slightly turned to subject's left, upper body leaning forward slightly, shoulders naturally relaxed. Right hand extended to the right-rear of the body and propped on the stone wall surface, palm against the wall top as support; left hand naturally hanging on the left side of the body, fingers near the skirt hem and stone wall edge. Double legs naturally overlapped at the bottom of the frame, one leg bent and raised closer to the lens, the other leg partially blocked by the front leg and skirt hem, pose relaxed, not deliberately posed.

Subject's head slightly lowered and slightly tilted to subject's left, gaze falling toward the lower-left of the frame, not looking directly at the camera. Expression quiet, soft, lips naturally slightly parted, with a bit of a thoughtful feeling, no toothy smile.

Subject has jet-black extra-long straight hair, length near the waist, hair volume naturally thick. Top of head near middle part, front of forehead is thick but light straight fragmented bangs, length close to eyebrows and upper edge of eyes; long hair on both sides naturally falls along shoulders, chest and arms, a few strands of hair blown outward by the sea breeze, hair ends slightly messy. No high ponytails, large curls, short bobs or no-bangs styles.

Face shape small and oval-shaped, jaw soft, skin tone fair with neutral-warm tone. Dark brown almond eyes, natural double eyelids, black thin eyeliner slightly extended, eyelashes clear; eyebrows naturally thin. Nose bridge small and straight, lips naturally full, color low-saturation nude pink/light bean paste. Makeup light, clean, biased towards Japanese life photo feel, no heavy contouring and internet celebrity makeup.

Upper body wearing an ivory white/creamy white short-sleeved sailor collar shirt. Fabric is light matte cotton, overall loose but not baggy. Neckline is a classic sailor collar structure, collar edge has dark navy/black-blue thin double-line piping; short sleeve cuffs also have a circle of dark thin piping. Front of neckline is a shallow V-shaped opening, no tie or only minimalist details inside. Do not generate ordinary white T-shirts or formal shirts.

Outside wearing a dark navy blue/near-black sleeveless strap dress/pinafore dress. Shoulder straps are medium to wide, connecting vertically down from the shoulders to the front chest, front chest is a lower square/round-square neckline, white sailor shirt inside is clearly visible. Dress slightly tapers at the waist and abdomen, naturally spreads down from the hips, material is matte cotton or uniform fabric.

Skirt hem length about mid-to-lower thigh/above the knee, naturally spreading around the stone wall and legs after sitting. Overall color close to dark navy blue, blue-black or ink blue, no checks, pleats or complex decorations added. Do not generate black sexy tight skirts, miniskirts or Lolita skirts.

Subject's lower body bare legs, skin tone naturally fair. Calf position wearing white mid-tube ribbed cotton socks, sock tube to the lower-middle section of the calf, material soft, slightly thick, surface has fine vertical ribs. Shoes mostly out of frame or cropped, not emphasizing shoe style.

Lower-left foreground place a light rice-yellow wide-brimmed straw hat, hat body is natural woven straw material, hat crown medium height, brim wide and with slight raw edges/irregular fibers, a dark brown or black thin ribbon around the hat body. Straw hat very close to the lens, therefore size is large, details clear, it is an important foreground element.

Scene is a sunny daytime seaside promenade. Behind the subject is a stretch of very shallow transparent blue-green seawater, near the shore area color transitions from light mint green, cyan-green to slightly deeper blue-green, water surface has small ripples.

Right-rear and behind the subject is a large area of bright white/light beige sand beach, sand surface flat, only a few footprints or slight shadows. Near the coast a blue float/safety buoy line is visible, extending horizontally.

Upper-middle of the frame spans a light gray-green/cyan-gray-green concrete sea-crossing bridge, bridge deck basically horizontal, extending from the left all the way to the right. Under the bridge there are thick piers falling into the seawater, above the bridge deck slender lampposts and low railings are arranged. Do not generate modern glass bridges, suspension bridges or large arch bridges.

Behind the bridge in the distance a few industrial port cranes/construction cranes are visible, among them the top-right background has a higher red and white tower crane/port machine, next to it there is also a tilted green boom. They are small in volume, only serving as realistic port area background details.

Sky occupies a large area of the upper half of the frame, high saturation but realistic clear azure blue, basically cloudless, only a small cluster of thin white clouds in the upper-right. Air transparent, high visibility, showing a typical island/Okinawa-style midsummer sunny day temperament.

Light is very strong natural sunlight from noon to early afternoon, coming from the top-left of the frame. Subject's top of hair, left shoulder, cheeks and bare legs show obvious white highlights; subject's right side of body enters deeper shadow, forming realistic hard daylight contrast. No soft overcast light.

Although the subject's face is in partial shadow, eye, nose bridge and lip details are still preserved through mobile phone HDR/auto-exposure. Black hair shows cool blue highlights and fine hair strand reflections under sunlight. White sailor shirt partially slightly bright, but do not completely overexpose.

Overall shows high-quality mobile phone/portable camera summer travel snapshot texture: natural mobile phone HDR, slight digital sharpening, small amount of fine grain, both subject and bridge maintain basic clarity, distant sea surface and industrial facilities slightly soft but no obvious portrait mode blurring. Colors mainly high-saturation blue sky + cyan-green seawater + light color sand + black-blue dress + creamy white sailor shirt + light straw-yellow straw hat, bright, refreshing, with a slight Japanese-style youthful feeling.

prompts.text:
超写实海边夏日少女感人像摄影，竖版约 3:4，一名年轻成年东亚女性坐在海滨步道/码头边缘的深灰石质矮墙上，背景是浅蓝绿色海水、白色沙滩、横跨画面的浅绿色跨海桥、远处港口吊机和极通透的蓝天。采用约 35–50mm 等效镜头，中近距离拍摄，摄影者距离人物约 1.5–2 米，机位接近人物腰腹高度并基本平视。人物位于画面中央偏右，占画面高度约 75–82%，构图从头顶拍到膝盖以下，左下前景保留一顶浅草黄色草帽。真实旅行抓拍透视，不使用鱼眼，不做明显背景虚化。

人物为年轻成年东亚女性，骨架偏小，肩部适中偏窄，上半身纤细自然，腰部短而轻微收束，骨盆和髋部宽度适中，大腿自然匀称，整体属于小骨架、轻盈纤细、自然少女感比例。不要生成丰满沙漏型、夸张宽胯、粗壮大腿、健美肌肉感或高挑欧美模特比例。

人物坐在矮墙边缘，身体略微向人物左侧转，上半身轻轻前倾，肩膀自然放松。右手向身体右后方伸出并撑在石质墙面上，手掌贴住墙顶作为支撑；左手自然垂落在身体左侧，手指靠近裙摆和石墙边缘。双腿在画面下方自然交叠，一条腿屈膝抬起更靠近镜头，另一条腿被前腿与裙摆部分遮挡，姿态松弛、不刻意摆拍。

外面套一件深海军蓝/近黑色无袖吊带连衣裙/背心裙。肩带中等偏宽，从肩部垂直向下连接胸前，前胸为较低方形/圆方形领口，内搭白色水手衫清楚可见。裙身在腰腹位置略微收束，从髋部开始自然向下展开，材质为哑光棉质或制服布料。

裙摆长度约到大腿中下部/膝盖上方，坐姿后自然铺在石墙与腿部周围。整体颜色接近深海军蓝、蓝黑或墨蓝，不加入格纹、百褶或复杂装饰。不要生成黑色性感紧身裙、超短裙或洛丽塔裙。

左下前景放一顶浅米黄色宽檐草帽，帽体为天然编织草材质，帽冠中等高度，帽檐较宽并带轻微毛边/不规则纤维，帽身绕一圈深棕或黑色细带。草帽距离镜头很近，因此尺寸偏大、细节清楚，是重要前景元素。

场景为晴朗白天的海滨步道。人物背后是一片非常浅的透明蓝绿色海水，靠岸区域颜色从浅薄荷绿、青绿色过渡到稍深的蓝绿色，水面有少量细小波纹。

右后方和人物后方是大片明亮白色/浅米色沙滩，沙面平整，只有少量脚印或轻微阴影。靠近海岸可见一条蓝色浮筒/安全浮标线，横向延伸。

画面中上部横跨一座浅灰绿/青灰绿色混凝土跨海桥，桥面基本水平，从左侧一直延伸到右侧。桥下有粗大的桥墩落入海水中，桥面上方排列细长路灯杆和低矮护栏。不要生成现代玻璃桥、悬索桥或大型拱桥。

远处桥后方可见少量工业港口吊机/施工起重机，其中右上背景有一台较高的红白色塔吊/港机，旁边还有一支倾斜绿色吊臂。它们体积较小，只作为真实港区背景细节。

天空占画面上半部较大区域，为高饱和但真实的晴朗蔚蓝色，基本无云，仅右上方有一小团细薄白云。空气通透、能见度高，呈典型海岛/冲绳式盛夏晴天气质。

光线是非常强烈的正午至下午早段自然阳光，来自画面左上方。人物头发顶部、左侧肩膀、脸颊和裸露腿部出现明显白色高光；人物右侧身体进入较深阴影，形成真实硬朗日照对比。不要柔和阴天光。

人物面部虽然处于部分阴影中，但通过手机 HDR/自动曝光仍保留眼睛、鼻梁和嘴唇细节。黑发在日光下出现冷蓝色高光和细碎发丝反射。白色水手衫局部略亮，但不要完全过曝。

整体呈高质量手机/便携相机夏日旅行随手拍质感：自然手机 HDR、轻微数码锐化、少量细颗粒，人物与桥梁都保持基本清晰，远处海面和工业设施略柔但不做明显人像模式虚化。色彩以高饱和蓝天＋青绿海水＋浅色沙滩＋黑蓝裙装＋奶油白水手衫＋浅草黄色草帽为主，明亮、清爽、带轻微日系青春感。

items.title: 20岁虚构日本女性吃炸鸡便当奇迹快照

prompts.text:
direction: An inexplicable yet strangely deeply memorable miracle snapshot photo accidentally left on a friend's phone. A moment of a 20-year-old fictional Japanese adult female being jokingly photographed by a friend while in the middle of eating a Hotto Motto fried chicken bento. Not a high-finish beauty shot, the composition is a bit of a failure, but the expression and timing are miraculously perfect. The most important condition is to keep the facial bone structure and contours as realistic and natural Japanese female shapes.

mood: Cute, friendly, defenseless, slightly funny, everyday feel. A natural moment without any preparation before shooting. Absolutely no horror, eerie, or deformed impressions.

model: A 20-year-old fictional Japanese adult female. Does not imitate real people or artists. Has a young and friendly atmosphere, while carrying a slightly calm sense of maturity.

face: A natural oval to slightly rounded Japanese female face shape. The proportions of the forehead, cheekbones, chin, and jaw are realistic, and the skull shape is never changed. The chin is not extremely thin, the cheeks do not bulge, and the forehead is not oversized. Not perfectly symmetrical left and right, but with natural left-right differences as an everyday photo. Eyes follow normal human proportions, avoiding huge anime eyes or eyeball enlargement caused by fish-eye. The nose and mouth are also not extremely elongated or shortened due to perspective.

expression: In the middle of bringing fried chicken to the mouth, the moment of suddenly noticing a phone nearby. Just shifting the gaze slightly upward. No surprised expression, no significant raising of eyebrows. The corners of the mouth are moving slightly due to eating, with a natural expression of wanting to laugh.

hair: Natural short straight hair from black to deep brown. The contour is not rounded. A few strands of bangs hang down on the forehead, slightly messy due to the eating motion. Do not make the head look too large.

body: Natural body proportions as an adult female. The chest has a natural fullness but does not exaggerate any part of the body. The size relationship between the head, shoulders, ribcage, arms, and torso remains realistic. Only use natural perspective brought by a forward-leaning posture.

skin: Natural texture, fine pores, very faint blush on the cheeks, moderate sebum reflection on the forehead or nose. No excessive skin beautification, retaining fine irregularities like human skin.

outfit: Natural attire for eating lunch indoors on a hot day, a simple camisole with thin spaghetti straps. The length is short, naturally revealing the navel. Paired with casual bottoms. Small wrinkles and natural shifting caused by the sitting posture are kept on the fabric. Not an outfit for showing off the body, but daily wear for a hot day.

scene_objects: A half-eaten Hotto Motto fried chicken bento, black bento box, white rice, several pieces of fried chicken, side dishes, disposable chopsticks, transparent bento lid, a half-drunk plastic bottle drink, tissues, a smartphone placed on the table, etc. In the middle of a meal, so the arrangement is a bit messy.

pose: Sitting normally on a chair, in the middle of the action of picking up fried chicken with chopsticks to put in the mouth. The torso is slightly leaning forward, but without forcing the neck to bend. One shoulder is slightly raised, a natural asymmetrical posture. Not a pose meant for the camera.

camera_viewpoint: Use only the idea of 'like a viewpoint of a mosquito perched on the forehead'. Do not show the mosquito itself. The camera line of sight starts slightly above the female's forehead, slightly angled down along the surface of the face. But no macro photography or fish-eye photography. Not approaching the face from the front by a few centimeters, but a perspective naturally connecting from above the forehead to the face, shoulders, hands, and bento. What's strange is the shooting position, not the shape of the face.

perspective_control: Most important. Keep the facial contours as correct human structures. The forehead does not protrude, eyes are not oversized, the nose is not elongated, and the chin does not become extremely small. The head does not swell into a sphere. The difference in size between the near and far sides of the camera is controlled within a mild range. Strong distortion unique to ultra-wide-angle is prohibited, limited only to the perspective of a normal smartphone wide-angle camera.

camera: The impression of being taken with a normal smartphone main camera. Equivalent to a natural wide angle of 24-28mm. Do not use fish-eye lenses or 0.5x ultra-wide angle. Portrait 9:16. Smartphone-style depth of field with background somewhat in focus. Auto exposure, auto white balance.

composition: Only the camera position is unusually close and high, a somewhat failed vertical composition. The horizon line is only tilted by 2-3 degrees. The top of the head or part of the hair can be slightly cropped at the edge of the frame, but the overall facial contour must be recognizable. Do not fill the frame with the face, while including the shoulders, chopsticks, fried chicken, and bento. The subject is slightly offset from the center.

lighting: Life-like light mixed with natural light from a window during the day and ordinary indoor lighting. Small highlights on the cheeks or forehead. Does not illuminate the whole face evenly, there are subtle differences in light and shadow between left and right. Studio lighting is prohibited.

motion: Because the shutter was accidentally pressed during the eating motion, only the tips of the chopsticks, the fried chicken, and a few strands of hair have very slight motion blur. The eyes, nose, mouth, and facial contours are clear and recognizable enough.

imperfections: Due to suddenly holding up the phone to shoot, slightly tilted composition, fine camera shake, slight noise in dark areas, small white highlights blown out, background daily necessities, clothing wrinkles, messy bangs on the forehead. Do not create a sense of failure by deforming the face itself.

background: Around the dining area of a friend's house or a normal rental apartment. Chairs, shelves, tissues, charging cables, drinks, daily necessities, etc., naturally enter the frame. Not a tidy shooting set, but not extremely cluttered either. The background also retains some focus.

atmosphere: The feeling of a friend suddenly bringing a phone close as a joke during a meal and the shutter being pressed at that moment. An atmosphere where the two of them are likely to laugh together after taking the photo. Not a carefully crafted portrait, but an everyday photo that truly remains in a smartphone photo album.

memory_hook: What's strange is the situation, not the face. This inexplicable shooting position near the forehead, the fried chicken going towards the mouth, the slightly tilted frame, the gaze noticing the camera midway, the daily necessities at the edge of the frame accidentally fitting together, creating a photo that is 'clumsy in technique but somehow very good' and makes one 'can't help but zoom in repeatedly to check'.

negative: Fish-eye face, facial deformation, skull deformation, huge forehead, huge eyes, extreme small chin, extreme thin chin, bulging cheeks, overly long nose, excessive difference in size between left and right eyes, deformed human body, unnatural neck, excessive perspective, strong distortion of 0.5x ultra-wide angle, doll face, plastic skin, excessive skin beautification treatment, advertising photo, studio shooting, horror, eerie expression, overly sexy pose, imitating faces of real people or celebrities.

watermark_direction: Integrate '@Live_life_style' not as a post-added logo, but as a part of daily necessities existing from the time of shooting, naturally merging into the frame.

integration_method: Integrate as text thinly printed on the transparent lid of the fried chicken bento, or as readable text reflected through transparent plastic.

subtle_visibility: Not conspicuous in the entire photo, to a degree that can only be read by zooming in slightly.

placement: Near the bento lid at the bottom of the frame. Do not overlay on the character's face or body.

material_behavior: Add subtle distortion and shading to the text through the curvature, scratches, and reflections of the transparent plastic.

lighting_interaction: Indoor light and window light reflections make part of the text slightly fade.

avoid: Digital text directly overlaid on the frame, large logos, glowing text, placement on human skin.

items.title: 轴测微缩场景艺术海报设计

prompts.text:
Please turn each photo I upload into an individual high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, output each photo separately. Use a 3:4 vertical composition overall, with the top and bottom regions strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the frame. 

The top half retains the original photo, maintaining the identity of the subject, structure, posture, realistic texture, natural lighting, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end color grading to give it the texture of an art magazine or exhibition image. To adapt to the frame, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The bottom half extracts only the most recognizable subject, outline, structure, posture, and narrative relationship of the photo; do not copy the photo completely, do not keep all objects, and do not redraw every object; actively delete most irrelevant backgrounds and details, keeping only the core information that best represents the original theme, and make a new artistic judgment. Even if the original composition is poor, the background is messy, or the subject is small, it must be re-directed into a valid work through deletion, reorganization, cropping, scale changes, and white space.

The aesthetic logic of the bottom half is reconstructed as Stylized Isometric 3D Architectural Diorama / Orthographic Axonometric 3D Render. Use an orthographic camera + three-quarter top-down axonometric perspective, approximately 30°–40° top-down and about 45° horizontal rotation, seeing the front, side, and top simultaneously, presenting a sense of space like a model, sand table, or miniature world. Do not make it a realistic photographic perspective, nor a pure map or elevation.

Reconstruct the subject into a stylized 3D miniature scene: with the subject as the core, retain only a few necessary environmental clues, such as terrain, roads, water, platforms, plants, buildings, or objects, to form a complete but highly summarized small world. The overall style is stylized 3D, not low-poly, and not realistic CG; emphasize regular geometry, moderate rounded corners, simplified materials, toy-like proportions, clean blocks, delicate layers, and soft lighting; it can have exquisite details, but cannot be complex or crowded.

The composition maintains a small-scale subject + massive amount of intentional white space. The miniature scene does not have to be centered and can be freely arranged according to the subject's direction, proportion, and visual center of gravity, and can be eccentric, edge-aligned, or partially cropped. White space is not an empty background but a part of the image, working with the subject to create a sense of breathing, space, and high-end order. Better to have less than too much.

The color scheme extracts 2–4 of the most vital and memorable colors from the top photo and reformulates them, moderately brightening, purifying, and removing gray to form a more bright, clean, and healing comprehensive color relationship. The overall tone remains fresh but not eye-piercing, warm but not cloying, and can naturally transform into refreshing color systems such as sky blue, lake cyan, vegetation green, cream yellow, apricot orange, coral pink, etc.; avoid gray-dirty, dark, old, fluorescent colors, and cheap plastic feel.

Text is used only as minimal editorial intervention, with no language restrictions. According to the subject, location, action, emotion, or metaphor, freely generate a small number of titles, short sentences, or notes, quietly landing on the white space area to form an exquisite graphic relationship with the image.

The overall presentation is a stylized axonometric 3D miniature scene, clear spatial relationships, exquisite model feel, vivid colors, massive amount of artistic white space, and editorial layout which together constitute a high-end visual effect. Avoid complete copying of the original image, complex stacking, realistic perspective, low-quality low-poly, cheap game feel, plastic feel, filling up the screen, and templated effects.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用 3:4 竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格 1:1，各占画面 50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级调色，使其具有艺术杂志与展览图像质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分只提取照片中最具识别性的**主体、轮廓、结构、姿态与叙事关系**，不要完整复制照片，不要保留所有对象，不要逐物转绘；主动删去大部分无关背景与细节，只保留最能代表原始主题的核心信息，并重新做美术判断。哪怕原图构图差、背景乱、主体小，也要通过删减、重组、裁切、尺度变化和留白，把它重新导演成一张成立的作品。

下半部分的美学逻辑重构为 **Stylized Isometric 3D Architectural Diorama / Orthographic Axonometric 3D Render**。采用**正交相机 + 四分之三俯视轴测视角**，大约 30°–40° 俯视、45° 左右水平旋转，同时看到正面、侧面和顶部，呈现模型、沙盘、微缩世界般的空间感。不要做成真实摄影透视，也不要做成纯地图或立面图。

将主体重构为一个**风格化 3D 微缩场景**：以主体为核心，只保留少量必要的环境线索，如地形、道路、水体、平台、植物、建筑或器物，使其组成一个完整但高度概括的小世界。整体是 **stylized 3D**，不是 low-poly，也不是写实 CG；强调规整几何、适度圆角、简化材质、玩具化比例、干净体块、细腻层次与柔和光照，可有精致细节，但不能复杂拥挤。

构图保持**小尺度主体 + 超大量有意识的留白**。微缩场景不必居中，可根据主体方向、比例和视觉重心自由安排，可偏心、贴边或局部裁切。留白不是空背景，而是画面的一部分，要与主体共同形成呼吸感、空间感和高级秩序。宁可少，不要满。

配色从上方照片中提取 **2–4 种最有生命力、最有记忆点的颜色**重新调制，适度提亮、提纯、去灰，形成更明快、干净、治愈的综合色关系。整体保持鲜活但不刺眼，温暖但不甜腻，可自然转化为天空蓝、湖水青、草木绿、奶油黄、杏橙、珊瑚粉等清爽色系；避免灰脏、暗沉、陈旧、荧光色和廉价塑料感。

文字只作极少量编辑性介入，不限制语种。可根据主体、地点、动作、情绪或隐喻，自由生成少量标题、短句或注记，安静地落在留白区域，与画面形成精致的图文关系。

整体呈现**风格化轴测 3D 微缩场景、清晰空间关系、精致模型感、鲜活配色、超大量艺术留白与编辑式排版**共同构成的高级视觉效果。避免完整复制原图、复杂堆积、写实透视、低质 low-poly、廉价游戏感、塑料感、画面填满和模板化效果。

prompts.text:

FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a high-impact perspective typography poster where oversized type is physically integrated into architecture and uses the structure of the space to create movement, depth and direction.

Build the architecture and perspective system first, then make the typography strictly follow its surfaces, curves, openings, height changes and vanishing directions.

The main word should dominate the composition while remaining readable. Let the letterforms change naturally according to the selected spatial mechanism:

For vertical spaces, make the type expand, compress or fall through different levels.

For passages and repeating openings, let the letters appear, disappear behind structural elements and re-emerge deeper in the scene.

For curved paths, bend and rotate the typography along the changing direction of the architecture.

For opposing directions, use two typographic flows moving against each other within the same spatial system.

Typography should feel painted, printed or embedded into real architectural surfaces, with accurate perspective, scale, occlusion and surface contact. Avoid simply placing flat text over the image.

Use a restrained architectural palette with one or two strong accent colors against concrete, black, white or neutral materials. Keep the letterforms bold, geometric and visually dominant.

If a person is included, keep them relatively small and use them as a scale anchor. Their movement or position should reinforce the direction of the typography rather than compete with it.

Add only a small amount of editorial information such as project name, location, date and one short thematic line.

Overall style: perspective typography, architectural poster, spatial graphic design, editorial composition, strong depth, clear hierarchy and bold visual impact.

创作一张具有高冲击力的透视排版海报，将超大号文字物理地融入建筑中，并利用空间的结构来创造运动感、深度和方向感。

先构建建筑和透视系统，然后让文字严格遵循其表面、曲线、开口、高度变化和消失方向。

主词应在构图中占据主导地位，同时保持可读性。让字母形状根据所选的空间机制自然变化：

对于垂直空间，让文字在不同楼层间扩张、压缩或坠落。

对于通道和重复的开口，让字母在结构元素后面出现、消失并重新出现在场景深处。

对于弯曲路径，让排版沿着建筑不断变化的方向弯曲和旋转。

对于相反方向，在同一个空间系统中使用两股相互背向移动的文字流。

如果包含人物，请保持其相对较小，并将其作为比例锚点。他们的动作或位置应加强文字的方向，而不是与之竞争。

items.title: 高端实验文字排版艺术海报

prompts.text:
TITLE: [poster title]
CONCEPT WORDS: [3–4 related words]
BACKGROUND COLOR: [color]
PRIMARY COLOR: [color]
ACCENT COLOR: [color]
GRAPHIC SYSTEMS: [dots / wave lines / concentric arcs / offset contours / radiating lines]
EVENT TYPE: [sound art / exhibition / live performance / cultural program]
EVENT INFO: [date / time / venue]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a high-end experimental typography poster where oversized English words become the main visual system.

Use 3–4 layered words with clear conceptual relationships. Do not simply place normal bold text and apply textures inside it. Rebuild the letterforms directly from precise geometric systems such as dot matrices, parallel wave lines, concentric or eccentric arcs, stepped contours, offset registrations, radiating segments, and frequency-like line bundles.

Give different text layers different graphic behaviors, then connect them through controlled transitions: dots may stretch into lines, arcs may open into waves, waves may shift or drift, and line systems may gradually realign. The poster should feel like one evolving typographic field rather than several separate effects.

Use overlap, compression, partial cropping, displacement, and negative space to create dense multi-layer typography. Maintain strong density contrast: some areas highly compressed and bright, some medium-density, and some deliberately open.

Keep all dots and lines exceptionally clean, sharp, continuous, and intentional. Smooth curves, consistent spacing, clear endpoints, stable dot shapes, no accidental broken lines, fuzzy edges, random noise, messy moiré, glitch artifacts, or low-quality AI textures.

Use a restrained, high-contrast color palette with one dominant background, one main typography color, and only small accent areas.

Reserve the lower 25%–30% for a refined editorial information section with the poster title, one short concept sentence, 2–3 program items, date, time, venue, and program name. Use clean modern sans-serif typography, multiple hierarchy levels, thin divider lines, and an asymmetric cultural-poster grid.

The final image should work at three distances: a strong abstract composition at thumbnail size, readable layered typography at medium distance, and rich geometric detail up close.

赋予不同的文本层不同的图形行为，然后通过受控的过渡连接它们：点可能会拉伸成线，圆弧可能会展开成波浪，波浪可能会移动或漂移，线条系统可能会逐渐重新对齐。海报应该感觉像是一个不断演变的排版场，而不是几个独立的效果。

使用重叠、压缩、局部裁剪、位移和负空间来创建密集的多层排版。保持强烈的密度对比：一些区域高度压缩且明亮，一些区域中等密度，一些区域刻意开放。

最终图像应在三个距离下都能发挥作用：缩略图大小具有强烈的抽象构图，中等距离具有可读的层叠排版，近处具有丰富的几何细节。

prompts.text:
Please make each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, output each photo individually. The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout, with the upper and lower regions strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the screen. 

The upper part keeps the original photo, maintaining the subject's identity, structure, posture, realistic texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end color grading to give it the texture of an art magazine, independent publication, or exhibition image. To adapt to the aspect ratio, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed. 

The lower part involves a new independent artistic judgment and visual direction. Do not copy the original photo's composition, nor translate every object; first understand the themes, structural trends, subject relationships, and visual memory points truly worth preserving from the original image, then recompose through deletion, reorganization, cropping, scale changes, position adjustments, and white space. Even if the original subject is small, the background is cluttered, or the composition is ordinary, actively correct it so the lower part itself becomes a complete, valid work with aesthetic judgment. 

Reconstruct the preserved key subjects, local structures, or related objects into a theme-combined illustration in a hand-drawn pencil sketch style. Use graphite pencil outlines, natural hatching, small amounts of cross-hatching, and light gray tones, with shapes slightly loose, naive, and having an illustrative sketch feel, not pursuing academic realism or complex perspective. Only draw the most meaningful parts, allowing people to immediately feel its correspondence with the photo above, but not as a pencil copy of the photo. 

The composition emphasizes a large amount of conscious white space. White space is not a background, but a constituent element as important as the subject; arrange freely according to the subject's direction, proportion, and visual center of gravity, which can be eccentric, edge-aligned, suspended, enlarged, shrunk, or partially cropped, establishing a sense of breath, space, and editorial order through positive and negative shapes, density, dispersion, and asymmetrical balance. Better to delete information than to fill the screen. 

The overall tone is mainly black and white or natural graphite grayscale, with a very small amount of 1–2 identifying colors extracted from the original image for local emphasis. Text is only for a small amount of editorial intervention, with no restrictions on language or fixed format, freely generating a few words or short phrases based on the subject, location, mood, or metaphor, quietly blending into the white space to form the layout with the illustration. 

The overall presentation is a re-directed image, hand-drawn pencil, theme combination, active deletion, large amount of artistic white space, and high-end editorial layout. Avoid photo replication, traditional academic sketches, complex backgrounds, filled screens, overly dense details, mechanical typesetting, and a template feel.

画面整体布满细密的雨丝，黑暗夜路上的蓝色反射，画面右侧背景放置白色与橙色的街灯光晕。球体内部描绘正午的蓝天、蔚蓝大海、盛开的栏杆扶手，以及面向大海的身着白色连衣裙的女性，作为鲜明的小型缩景。球体柔和的暖色光芒作为主光源，照亮双手和胸口，画面左侧后方的冷色街灯勾勒出湿润的发丝边缘。

构图・镜头：
3:4的纵向构图。镜头从略高于坐姿人物的视角，以近距离捕捉，从头顶至双腿中段在画面边缘裁切。脸部置于左上方，球体置于中央偏右，双手置于其下方，使人物占据画面左侧的大部分空间。对脸部和球体内部聚焦，夜路以浅景深强烈虚化。

质感・风格：
以写实摄影为基础的高精细电影式奇幻图像。精密描绘雨水浸湿的肌肤、头发、薄衫、路面反射以及透明球体的折射效果，对比冷峻的蓝色雨夜与球体内部鲜艳的夏日色彩。

负面提示：
不要将球体内部的海滩缩景抽象化为光影；不要让双手与球体的接触出现破绽

prompts.text:
{
"direction": "朋友手机里偶然留下的、难以解释却莫名其妙地深刻记忆中的『奇怪的奇迹一拍』。23岁的虚构日本女性。拍摄者没有时间摆好姿势，在对话或移动途中反射性地按下了快门。优先选择不是为了美观拍摄，而是偶然的时机・过近的距离・构图的失败最终转化为魅力的照片。",
"mood": "日常中突然诞生的滑稽瞬间。本人完全没有意识到自己正在被拍，不是刻意做出的表情。不带恐怖、不安、灵异照片的氛围，而是那种『为什么就这一瞬间莫名其妙地这么好呢』，让人事后想反复回看的氛围。",
"model": "23岁的虚构日本成年女性。健康自然的体型，拥有丰满的胸部线条，但不把身体的特定部位作为照片的主角。不模仿真实存在的艺人、网红、配信者或个人。",

"body": "重心偏向一侧腿，左右肩高度略有不同。身体没有固定姿势，而是转身、蹲下、捡东西、站起来、转头回话等动作途中。丰满的体型通过衣服的自然垂感表现，不使用夸张的身体比例或强调胸部的构图。",
"skin": "自然成年女性的肌肤。保留细小的毛孔、轻微的色差、脸颊或鼻子周围的普通质感。没有过度的美肌处理。室内光或窗光导致部分轻微过曝也可以。",
"outfit": "每次根据地点和事件理由改为有来头的cosplay服装。露出肌肤面积稍多也可以，但作为事件或拍摄会中自然成立的非露骨成人向服装，避免泳装・内衣本身的展示方式或挑逗性的脱衣。例：夏祭则是轻幻想服装，游戏活动则是短夹克＋高腰服装，万圣节则是运动风魔法使服装等。衣服上保留动作造成的褶皱、肩部或袖子的轻微偏移。",

"scene_objects": "放入制造拍摄理由的生活物品。地板上的包、打开的纸袋、喝到一半的瓶子、朋友的外套、椅子、简易桌子、活动会场的指示牌等。在背景中留下当时实际有人存在的痕迹。",
"pose": "禁止摆定姿势。被朋友叫住突然转头的瞬间、试图捡起差点掉落的小物件的瞬间、笑着后退一步的瞬间、边把头发别到耳后边回话的瞬间等。手脚某处正在动，指尖或头发微微模糊。",
"lighting": "只用现场原本存在的光。窗户的自然光与天花板照明混合、活动会场的白色照明与入口的日光混合等，色温不完全统一。不均匀照亮整个脸，一侧稍亮。允许局部的过曝和普通的阴影。",
"effect": "手机JPEG特有的轻微压缩感、细小噪点、头发或手上微弱的运动模糊、边缘的轻微镜头畸变。不使用强烈的胶片加工或电影式色彩分级，像是直接留在朋友相机胶卷里的质感。",
"camera": "朋友单手拿着的一般智能手机广角偏主摄。被摄体距离异常近约45～70cm。相当于24～28mm。竖持4:5或9:16。脸或肩部离画面上端稍近。相机水平倾斜约2～6度。快门速度不足，运动部分微微模糊。景深较深，背景也能大致辨认。没有过度的肖像模式虚化。",
"imperfections": "构图稍显拥挤、头顶余白不均、一侧背景过多、手臂或包在中途进入画面边缘、水平线微微倾斜、一缕头发挂在脸上、衣服上有普通的褶皱。放入多个失败元素，但不同时夸张全部，只到『手法笨拙但结果意外好』的程度。",
"background": "普通的日本日常空间或活动会場。不是完美收拾的工作室，能看到人来人往、指示标志、地板的小刮痕、随意放置的行李、生活用品等。偏向泛焦，背景也能大致辨认。",

"composition": "不完美地将被摄体置于中央，稍偏向画面外侧。因为太近，透视稍强，照片局部信息密度奇高。先引导视线到脸部，然后想放大查看衣服褶皱、手部动作、背景小物件等细节的构图。优先发现的多样性和记忆残留感而非美观。",
"capture_reason": "朋友说『等一下』叫住后，被摄体试图回应而转头的瞬间，误按了快门。拍摄后没确认，直接留在相机胶卷里的自然理由。",
"negative": "过度的美肌修正、极端的修图、人偶般的脸、塑料状肌肤、非现实骨骼、过度身体强调、广告照片照明、完美的左右对称、过强的背景虚化、摆定姿势、恐怖表现、灵异表现、模仿真实人物或名人的脸"
}{
"watermark_direction": "水印『
@Live_life_style
』不以后期添加文字形式显示，而是作为从拍摄时起就自然融入现场生活元素的一部分。",
"integration_method": "在背景半透明的活动指示牌或亚克力板上的弱反射中，让『
@Live_life_style
』字符串偶然可读。文字不完全正面显示，通过反射和远近微微变形。",
"subtle_visibility": "初看像是背景图案或反射，放大图像时才注意到是『
@Live_life_style
』的程度。不比主角显眼。",
"placement": "不放在人物身体上，而是画面边缘偏向的背景、地板反射、透明板、纸袋、小物件等生活元素上。",
"material_behavior": "不是印刷的数字文字，而是透明材质的反射、弱雾气、光线条纹、纸材质的印刷模糊等，顺应材质本身的质感。",
"lighting_interaction": "接受与周围相同的光源，明亮部分稍淡，暗部稍易读。不让文字独立成白色或发光状态。",
"perspective": "沿背景面的角度和智能手机广角镜头透视微微倾斜，不做完全水平的字符串。",
"avoid": "直接放在人物皮肤上、巨大的logo、中央配置、发光文字、UI风叠加、像照片上后期加的字幕那样显示"

prompts.text:
Please turn each travel photo I upload into an independent "Scenery Memo Postcard" high-end editorial poster, no multi-photo collage, each photo output separately.

The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout. The original photo serves as a clear, realistic, and recognizable full-frame background covering the entire canvas, faithfully preserving the location, subject, architecture, people, terrain, perspective, natural light and shadow, and authentic photography texture from the original photo. Apply only a slight high-end travel photography color grading and moderately reduce the contrast in the area behind the postcards to allow the physical cards to emerge naturally. Do not blur, redraw, replace, or randomly change the background photo.

Place two independent physical horizontal postcards in the center of the image, arranged vertically along the same central axis:

- Top: Postcard front;
- Bottom: Postcard back;
- Both cards must have the same width, same height, and use the same standard horizontal postcard ratio;
- Left and right edges strictly aligned, kept horizontal, no rotation, no tilting;
- Card width accounts for approximately 72%—82% of the overall image;
- Maintain a breathing space of about 5%—10% of the card height between the two cards;
- No overlapping, misalignment, side-by-side, or scattered arrangements.

The front of the top postcard uses a representative horizontal crop of the same original photo, highlighting the most recognizable subject, landmark, human action, or natural landscape in the photo. It must maintain an authentic photography texture and not be converted into an illustration. A short English main title and a real, accurate location name can be added.

The back of the bottom postcard uses warm white or off-white thick paper, preserving slight paper grain, edge wear, creases, and traces of collection. The back features a thin-line divider, four restrained address lines, a stamp in the top right corner, and a slight postmark.

The stamp design must be extracted from the same original photo, using silhouettes of landmarks, buildings, plants, vehicles, mountains, or figures from the photo; no second location or irrelevant patterns. The postmark is only an abstract mark, with no fabricated dates, zip codes, addresses, or fake postal information.

In the blank area of the back, add an original travel observation of no more than two sentences. The text should describe based on the location, light, weather, movement, and environmental imagery truly visible in the photo, being quiet, natural, and restrained, like a private note jotted down during a journey. Do not use famous quotes; do not fabricate stories that do not exist in the photo.

Before generation, please clearly write out and accurately present the following text:

Main Title:
"[Short English title extracted based on the photo]"

Location:
"[Real location, country]"

Back Subtitle:
"[Short travel observation title]"

Back Body:
"[A short English text of no more than two sentences created based on the actual scene]"

The font uses elegant and restrained editorial serif and simple postal sans-serif. Text colors are extracted from the original photo, such as dark gray, dark green, grayish blue, brown, etc., with low saturation, using one representative color from the photo as a minor accent. The text must be clearly legible, with no garbled characters or extra text.

The two cards use warm white thick paper material, with clear paper edges, slight wear, and natural short drop shadows, making them look like real collection postcards quietly placed on top of the original scenery.

The overall presentation merges the temperament of authentic photography, old postcards, travel publications, private correspondence, and collection archives: quiet, poetic, restrained, warm, with traces of time, while maintaining a high-end editorial design sense.

Avoid ordinary "original image on top, redrawn on bottom" diptych poster structures; avoid side-by-side arrangements, tilted cards, scattered collages, a third card, complex decorations, fictional place names, fake postal info, handwritten gibberish, excessive vintage filters, cartoonish feel, plastic 3D feel, e-commerce template feel, brand logos, and watermarks.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的「风景余笺明信片」高级编辑海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。

整体采用3:4竖版构图。原始照片作为清晰、真实、可辨认的全幅背景铺满整张画面，忠实保留原照片中的地点、主体、建筑、人物、地形、透视关系、自然光影与真实摄影质感。仅进行轻微的高级旅行摄影调色，并适度降低明信片后方区域的对比度，使实体卡片自然浮现。不得模糊、重绘、替换或随意改变背景照片。

画面中央放置两张独立的实体横向明信片，沿同一条竖向中轴上下排列：

- 上方为明信片正面；
- 下方为明信片背面；
- 两张卡片必须同宽、同高、采用相同的标准横向明信片比例；
- 左右边缘严格对齐，保持水平，不旋转、不倾斜；
- 卡片宽度约占整体画面的72%—82%；
- 两张卡片之间保留约为卡片高度5%—10%的呼吸间距；
- 不得重叠、错位、并排或散落排列。

上方明信片正面使用同一张原始照片的代表性横向裁切，突出照片中最具识别度的主体、地标、人物动作或自然景观。必须保持真实摄影质感，不转绘成插画。可加入一个简短英文主标题，以及真实、准确的地点名称。

下方明信片背面使用暖白色或米白色厚纸，保留轻微纸张颗粒、边缘磨损、折痕与收藏痕迹。背面设置细线分隔区、四条克制的地址横线、一枚位于右上角的邮票，以及一处轻微邮戳。

邮票图案必须从同一张原照片中提取，可使用照片中的地标轮廓、建筑、植物、车辆、山体或人物剪影，不得加入第二个地点或无关图案。邮戳仅作为抽象印迹，不编造日期、邮编、地址或虚假邮政资料。

在背面的留白区域加入一段不超过两句的原创旅行观察。文字应根据照片中真实可见的地点、光线、天气、动作与环境意象进行描写，安静、自然、克制，像旅途中随手写下的一则私人注记。不得使用名人名言，不虚构照片中不存在的故事。

生成前请明确写定并准确呈现以下文字：

主标题：
“[根据照片提炼的简短英文标题]”

地点：
“[真实地点，国家]”

背面小标题：
“[简短的旅行观察标题]”

背面正文：
“[根据真实画面创作的不超过两句英文短文]”

字体采用优雅克制的编辑衬线体与简洁邮政无衬线体。文字颜色从原照片中提取，可使用深灰、墨绿、灰蓝、褐色等低饱和色，并以一种照片中的代表性色作为少量强调。文字必须清晰可读，不得生成乱码或额外文字。

两张卡片使用暖白厚纸材质，拥有清晰纸边、轻微磨损和自然短投影，让它们像真实存在的收藏明信片，被安静地放置在原本的风景之上。

整体呈现真实摄影、旧明信片、旅行出版物、私人通信与收藏档案相融合的气质：安静、诗意、克制、温暖、有时间痕迹，同时保持高级编辑设计感。

避免普通的“上方原图、下方转绘”双联海报结构；避免左右并排、倾斜卡片、散乱拼贴、第三张卡片、复杂装饰、虚构地名、虚假邮政信息、手写乱码、过度复古滤镜、卡通感、塑料3D感、电商模板感、品牌标志和水印。

items.title: 超写实傍晚樱花公园售货机前亲吻的青年

prompts.text:
Hyper-realistic evening cherry blossom park street snapshot, vertical aspect ratio approximately 3:4, two young adult East Asians sitting on the ground kissing in front of two white beverage vending machines, the image has a very obvious old phone/portable digital camera low-light snapshot texture. Using approximately 35–50mm equivalent lens, photographer about 3–4 meters from the subjects, camera position near standing chest height and slightly downward, subjects located in the lower center-left of the frame, occupying only about 25–30% of the entire image; two glowing vending machines occupy the main left-middle area, the upper half of the frame retains a large amount of cherry blossom branches and a gray-blue twilight sky. No commercial portrait composition, no obvious background bokeh.

The scene is a cherry blossom season evening on the edge of a Japanese neighborhood/park. The time is near after sunset, before it gets completely dark, the sky is a low-saturation gray-blue and light gray-purple, the overall environment is very dark. Multiple tall cherry trees grow densely in the background, with thick black trunks and branches crisscrossing, the canopy is covered with a large amount of light pink-white cherry blossoms that have already bloomed; due to lack of light, the flowers are generally grayish-white, do not generate bright pink.

Two large white beverage vending machines are placed side-by-side in the left-middle of the frame, the one on the left is slightly larger and further forward, the one on the right is slightly narrower and staggered backward. The cold white fluorescent lights inside the machines are very bright, becoming the main light source in the dim environment.

Each vending machine has multiple layers of transparent beverage display windows in front, where a large number of bottles and cans of different colors can be seen: transparent water bottles, green tea drinks, light yellow drinks, red canned drinks, etc. Below each row is a column of dense circular selection buttons. The machine frames are white and light blue-gray, with many faded stickers, Japanese advertisements, small payment logos, and blurry labels on the sides, but all text remains realistic yet unreadable, do not generate prominent clear gibberish.

Cold white light from the vending machines leaks out, forming slight cyan/cold gray reflections on the characters' hair, white clothes, and nearby road surface. The lower half and sides of the machine bodies enter obvious shadows, the overall exposure is uneven, consistent with a real nighttime mobile phone photo.

Two young adults sit on the asphalt/cement ground near the bottom of the vending machines on the left, their bodies close together. The characters are not a dominant large close-up of the frame, but a small life moment in the environment.

The person on the left has short and naturally messy deep black hair, wears a loose white long-sleeved shirt, black or dark gray trousers for the bottom, and black low-top casual shoes/canvas shoes with slightly bright white sole edges. Sitting sideways on the ground, back near the side of the vending machine, one leg bent in front of the body, the other leg slightly extended toward the bottom of the frame.

The person on the right has long straight deep black-brown hair, hair hanging below the chest and covering part of the side face. Wearing a white or light gray-white top, paired with a dark academic-style bottom, which can be a dark gray-black short skirt or a simple dark dress; legs naturally extended together toward the lower right of the frame, wearing white mid-calf cotton socks and black round-toe loafers. Overall a simple black and white outfit for ordinary young people, no sexualized design.

The two sit very close, sides facing each other, shoulders and knees slightly touching. The person on the left leans their upper body to the right, the person on the right leans slightly to the left, their faces are close together at the bottom center of the frame, performing a very natural, brief, restrained kiss. One hand can be gently placed on the other's cheek or side of the neck, the other hand naturally placed near the knee. No exaggerated hugging, no dramatic body movements, the focus is like a private moment recorded by a friend from a distance.

The characters' faces basically cannot have clear features due to the distance, dim light, and being close to each other, retaining only realistic side profiles and hair shapes. Do not generate the characters' faces into high-definition exquisite commercial portraits.

To the right of the characters, the ground is a gray-black asphalt walkway/road slightly curving toward the right rear, leading deep into the woods. The right edge of the road has a patch of dark green grass and low bushes, almost entering black shadows in the evening. No large crowds, cars, or bustling city buildings in the background.

There can be a small amount of weeds, messy plants, and ground stains at the bottom left and around the vending machines to strengthen the realistic outdoor environment. There are obvious dark shadows at the bottom of the machine bodies and around the characters.

The exposure relationship of the entire frame must be strictly maintained: vending machine display windows are the brightest, characters are the second brightest, woods and roads are the darkest, and the sky is a gray-blue mid-tone. Do not brighten the characters separately into a studio effect.

The overall image quality is a real old phone/early digital camera evening low-light photo: slightly out of focus, obvious high ISO noise, JPEG compression, grayish-green shadows, blurred edge details, limited dynamic range, some vending machine lights slightly overexposed, character faces and clothing details not completely sharp. No 8K commercial sharpness, no modern phone extreme HDR.

The colors are dominated by gray-blue twilight + deep gray-black woods + cold white/cyan vending machine lights + white clothes + low-saturation cherry blossom gray-pink, the overall vibe is quiet, moist, with a slight youth movie screenshot feel, but it must remain a real-life photo rather than movie lighting.

Key locks: Evening cherry blossom woods + two side-by-side white glowing beverage vending machines + machines occupy left-middle of frame + many cold white beverage display lights + two young adults sitting on the ground at the bottom of the machines kissing + subjects very small in volume + white shirt black pants on the left + long black hair, white top, dark skirt on the right + white socks black shoes + legs extended toward the lower right + gray-black walkway extending toward the right rear + large area of dark cherry blossom woods + low-resolution, noisy, gray-blue real old phone nighttime snapshot texture.

Avoid: Characters filling the frame, high-definition face close-ups, formal couple photography, wedding photos, strong hugging, sexy clothing, separate lighting for characters, high noon daylight, bright pink cherry blossoms, neon city streetscapes, only one vending machine, vending machine lights disappearing, woods disappearing, heavy background bokeh, cinematic accent colors, commercial sharpening, excessive HDR, anime style, CG feel, clear readable gibberish text, watermarks.

prompts.text:
超写实傍晚樱花公园街头随手拍摄影，竖版约 3:4，两名年轻成年东亚人坐在两台白色饮料自动售货机前的地面上亲吻，画面带非常明显的旧手机/便携数码相机低照度抓拍质感。采用约 35–50mm 等效镜头，摄影者距离人物约 3–4 米，机位接近站立胸口高度并轻微向下，人物位于画面下方中央偏左，只占整个画面的约 25–30%；两台发光自动售货机占据左中部主要区域，上半画面保留大量樱花树枝和灰蓝色暮色天空。不要商业人像构图，不做明显背景虚化。

场景为日本街区/公园边缘的樱花季傍晚。时间接近日落后、天还没有完全黑，天空呈低饱和灰蓝和淡灰紫色，环境整体很暗。背景密集生长着多棵高大的樱花树，粗黑树干和枝杈纵横交错，树冠上布满大量已经开放的浅粉白色樱花，由于光线不足，花朵整体偏灰白，不要生成鲜艳粉色。

画面左中部并排摆放两台大型白色饮料自动售货机，靠左一台略大、略靠前，右边一台稍窄并向后错开。机器内部冷白荧光灯非常明亮，在昏暗环境中成为最主要光源。

每台自动售货机前面都有多层透明饮料展示窗，能看到大量不同颜色瓶装和罐装饮料：透明水瓶、绿色茶饮、浅黄色饮料、红色罐装饮品等。每排下面有一列密集圆形选择按钮。机器边框为白色和浅蓝灰色，侧面贴有大量褪色贴纸、日文广告、小型付款标识和模糊标签，但所有文字保持真实而不可读，不要生成醒目的清晰乱码。

自动售货机冷白光向外泄出，在人物头发、白色衣服和附近路面形成轻微青绿色/冷灰反射。机身下半部和侧面则进入明显阴影，整体曝光不均匀，符合真实夜间手机拍照。

两名年轻成年人坐在自动售货机左下方靠近机身底部的柏油/水泥地面，身体紧靠在一起。人物不是画面主导的大特写，而是环境中的一个小型生活瞬间。

左侧人物留短而自然凌乱的深黑色头发，穿一件宽松白色长袖衬衫，下身为黑色或深灰色长裤，脚穿黑色低帮休闲鞋/帆布鞋，白色鞋底边缘略亮。身体侧坐在地面，背部靠近自动售货机侧面，一条腿弯曲收在身体前方，另一条腿向画面下方略微伸出。

右侧人物留深黑棕色长直发，头发垂到胸口以下并遮住部分侧脸。穿白色或浅灰白色上衣，外面搭配深色学院风下装，可为深灰黑色短裙或简洁深色裙装；腿部自然向画面右下方并拢伸出，穿白色中筒棉袜和黑色圆头便鞋/乐福鞋。整体是普通年轻人的简洁黑白穿搭，不要做性感化设计。

两人坐得非常近，身体侧面对向彼此，肩膀和膝盖轻微相碰。左侧人物上半身向右倾斜，右侧人物略向左靠近，两人的脸在画面中央下方贴近，正在进行一个非常自然、短暂、克制的亲吻。其中一只手可轻轻放在对方脸颊或颈侧，另一只手自然放在膝盖附近。不要夸张拥抱、不要戏剧性肢体动作，重点是像朋友在远处随手记录下来的私人瞬间。

人物脸部因为距离较远、光线昏暗和彼此靠得很近而基本看不清五官，只保留真实侧脸轮廓和头发形状。不要把人物脸生成高清精致商业肖像。

人物右侧地面是一条略微向右后方弯曲的灰黑色柏油步道/道路，通向树林深处。道路右边缘有一片暗绿色草地和低矮灌木，傍晚几乎进入黑色阴影。背景不要出现大量路人、汽车或繁华城市建筑。

自动售货机左下和周围可有少量野草、杂乱植物和地面污渍，强化真实户外环境。机身底部与人物周围存在明显深色阴影。

整个画面的曝光关系必须严格保持：自动售货机展示窗最亮，人物次亮，树林与道路最暗，天空为灰蓝中间调。不要把人物单独提亮成棚拍效果。

整体影像质量为真实旧手机/早期数码相机傍晚低照度照片：轻微失焦、明显高 ISO 噪点、JPEG 压缩、暗部发灰发绿、边缘细节模糊、动态范围有限、部分自动售货机灯光轻微过曝，人物脸部和衣服细节不完全锐利。不要 8K 商业锐度，不要现代手机极致 HDR。

色彩以灰蓝暮色＋深灰黑树林＋冷白偏青的自动售货机灯光＋白色衣服＋低饱和樱花灰粉色为主，整体安静、潮湿、略带青春电影截图感，但必须保持真实生活照片而不是电影布光。

重点锁定：傍晚樱花树林＋两台并排白色发光饮料自动售货机＋机器占画面左中部＋大量冷白饮料展示灯＋两名年轻成年人坐在机器底部地面亲吻＋人物体积很小＋左侧白衬衫黑长裤＋右侧长黑发、白色上衣、深色裙装＋白袜黑鞋＋两腿向右下伸出＋灰黑步道向右后方延伸＋大片暗色樱花树林＋低清、噪点、偏灰蓝的真实旧手机夜间抓拍质感。

避免：人物占满画面、高清脸部特写、正式情侣写真、婚纱照、强烈拥抱、性感服装、人物单独打光、白天正午、鲜艳粉红樱花、霓虹城市街景、只有一台售货机、售货机灯光消失、树林消失、背景严重虚化、电影级强调色、商业锐化、过度 HDR、动漫风、CG 感、清晰可读乱码文字、水印。

prompts.text:
TITLE: [your main word]
PROJECT NAME: [brand / exhibition / campaign]
ARCHITECTURAL STRUCTURE: [vertical fins / separated buildings / staggered platforms / folded planes / other]
TYPE MECHANISM: [slice / span / offset / fold / custom]
SUBJECT: [small human figure / none]
ACCENT COLOR: [one strong solid color]
SUPPORTING TEXT: [location / date / short tagline]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a high-impact perspective typography poster where oversized type is physically integrated into architecture and only becomes visually complete from one intentional camera viewpoint.

Build the architectural structure first, then let the typography strictly follow its real depth, surfaces, angles, gaps, folds and occlusion.

Depending on the selected mechanism, the word can be sliced across multiple vertical planes, span a physical gap between structures, break across staggered platforms, or continue over folded architectural surfaces.

The main word should occupy roughly 35–55% of the composition. Individual fragments may look abstract or incomplete on separate surfaces, but from the intended viewpoint they should visually align into one clear, readable word.

Use bold geometric sans-serif typography with one strong solid accent color against restrained architectural materials such as concrete, black, white or neutral stone.

If a person is included, keep them small and use them mainly as a scale reference. Let architecture naturally hide or overlap part of the figure so they feel physically inside the typographic space.

Add only a small amount of editorial information such as project name, location, date and one short thematic line.

Overall style: perspective typography, spatial graphic design, contemporary architecture, editorial poster, anamorphic installation, strong depth and clean hierarchy.

Avoid floating text, random distortion, weak alignment, decorative 3D extrusion, neon sci-fi effects, excessive filler copy, cluttered backgrounds, watermarks and numbering.

prompts.text:
Please make each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, each photo output individually. The overall layout uses a 3:4 vertical composition, with the top and bottom areas strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the screen.

The upper part retains the original photo, maintaining the subject's identity, structure, posture, real texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end color grading to give it the texture of an art magazine, independent publication, or exhibition image. To adapt to the frame, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The lower part first understands the core theme, subject relationship, structural trend, emotion, and visual metaphor of the original photo most worth remembering, and then reconstructs it into a pastel crayon graffiti illustration with vintage paper texture. Do not copy the photo item by item, nor completely redraw all content; only retain the contours, postures, directions, and visual memory points that best represent the original object. Through deletion, generalization, slight exaggeration, and recombination, make people feel the correspondence between it and the photo above at a glance.

The subject uses thick-grained chalk / crayon-style hand-drawn outlines: the lines are slightly thick, loose, dry, with powder particles, intermittent color fading, slight shaking, and incompletely closed edges, with naturally blunt and rounded ends. Only a very small amount of pastel color blocks, simple grids, stripes, dots, or casual smears are added inside the subject, using minimal information to suggest structure, without realistic volume or complete details.

Surrounding small elements use the same line language as the subject, but are further compressed into graffiti symbols identifiable in one or a few strokes. Stars, flowers, plants, objects, environmental clues, or abstract symbols should all be simple, naive, open, and incompletely closed, mainly single-line outlines with very little filling. Do not draw them as exquisite icons, stickers, or independent small illustrations.

Composition maintains the relationship between small-scale stamps and large areas of white space, freely arranging positions according to the subject's own direction, proportion, and visual center of gravity, which can be eccentric, edge-aligned, suspended, or partially cropped. The subject and a very small number of graffiti symbols form a loose but clear visual community, with the remaining space actively left blank. White space itself is the main compositional element, forming a sense of breathing, distance, and pause through the relationship between empty and solid, gathered and scattered, size contrast, and asymmetry; would rather draw less than fill it up.

The background must use an extremely light, bright, and clean paper base color, such as cream white, ivory white, light beige white, pale apricot white, extremely light grey-white, or a near-white paper color intelligently matched according to the overall color temperature of the original image. The paper only retains very slight fibers and particles, and must not be brownish, yellowish, grayish, or appear old. The background brightness must be significantly higher than the subject lines and color blocks to ensure all crayon outlines, small symbols, and text are clearly visible and do not blur with the background.

The color scheme extracts 2–4 of the most vivid, friendly, and representative colors from the photo above to be reformulated into bright and soft pastel crayon colors. This can naturally form lightweight colors like peach pink, apricot orange, cream yellow, mint green, sky blue, light purple, etc.; the subject lines prioritize using coral pink, soft blue, cyan-green, warm orange, light purple, or deep cream tones that are clearer than the background, and small elements only sporadically repeat these colors to form an echo. The overall maintain the contrast relationship of light background + clear colored lines + a small amount of soft color blocks, being bright, healing, relaxed, and having a sense of life. Avoid dark, dirty brown, dull Morandi-style, low contrast, fluorescent colors, and cheap candy feel.

Text intervenes in small amounts, with no language restriction. Short sentences or text fragments can be freely extracted from the subject, action, emotion, memory, or metaphor, using thin, sparse typewriter fonts with slight irregular character spacing and old mechanical printing errors, with colors using clear but not eye-catching grey-brown, soft black, deep blue-grey, or dark colors that echo the subject, ensuring sufficient readability on the light paper surface. The text naturally scatters in the white space area, forming a mixed text-image layout with the subject and graffiti, without fixed title templates.

The overall presentation is a high-end healing visual composed of an extremely light paper surface, thick-grained crayon outlines, a small amount of pastel filling, minimalist graffiti symbols, a small-scale subject, and a large amount of artistic white space. The focus is to let the subject and small elements float clearly on the light-colored paper surface, while maintaining a loose, naive, gentle, and mature editorial composition sense. Avoid dark kraft paper, dark brown backgrounds, low-contrast lines, backgrounds and subjects blurring together, fine strokes, realistic redrawing, complex small icons, filled backgrounds, smooth vectors, 3D feels, and commercial template feels.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览图像质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分先理解原照片最值得被记住的**核心主题、主体关系、结构走势、情绪与视觉隐喻**，再重构为**复古纸张肌理的粉彩蜡笔涂鸦插画**。不要逐物复制照片，也不要把所有内容完整转绘，只保留最能代表原物的轮廓、姿态、方向和视觉记忆点，通过删减、概括、轻微夸张和重新组合，使人一眼感受到它与上方照片之间的对应关系。

主体使用**粗颗粒粉笔 / 蜡笔式手绘轮廓**：线条略粗、松弛、干涩，带有粉末颗粒、断续掉色、轻微抖动和不完全闭合的边缘，笔端自然钝圆。主体内部只加入极少量粉彩色块、简单网格、条纹、圆点或随手涂抹，用最少信息提示结构，不做写实体积和完整细节。

周围小元素与主体使用**同一种线条语言**，但进一步压缩为一笔或几笔即可识别的涂鸦符号。星星、花朵、植物、器物、环境线索或抽象符号都应简单、稚拙、开放、不完全闭合，以单线轮廓为主，极少填色。不要画成精致图标、贴纸或独立小插画。

构图保持**小尺度章印与大面积留白**的关系，根据主体自身的方向、比例和视觉重心自由安排位置，可偏心、贴边、悬置或局部裁切。主体与极少量涂鸦符号形成松散但明确的视觉群落，其余空间主动留空。**留白本身就是主要构图元素**，通过空与实、聚与散、大小反差和不对称关系形成呼吸感、距离感与停顿感；宁可少画，也不要填满。

背景必须使用**极浅、明亮、干净的纸张底色**，例如奶油白、象牙白、浅米白、淡杏白、极浅灰白或根据原图综合色温智能匹配的近白纸色。纸张只保留非常轻微的纤维与颗粒，不能偏棕、偏黄、偏灰或显得陈旧。**背景明度必须明显高于主体线条与色块，确保所有蜡笔轮廓、小符号和文字清楚可见，不得与背景糊在一起。**

配色从上方照片中提取 **2–4 种最鲜活、最有亲和力、最能代表画面精神的颜色**重新调制，转化为明亮柔和的粉彩蜡笔色。可自然形成蜜桃粉、杏橙、奶油黄、薄荷青、天空蓝、淡紫等轻盈色彩；主体线条优先使用比背景更清晰的珊瑚粉、柔蓝、青绿、暖橙、淡紫或奶油深色调，小元素只零星重复这些颜色形成呼应。整体保持**浅背景 + 清晰彩线 + 少量柔和色块**的对比关系，明快、治愈、轻松、有生活感。避免灰暗、脏褐、沉闷莫兰迪化、低对比、荧光色和廉价糖果感。

文字少量介入，不限制语种。可从主体、动作、情绪、记忆或隐喻中自由提炼短句或文字片段，使用**轻薄、疏朗、带轻微字距不齐与旧式机械印字误差的打字排版字体**，颜色使用清晰但不刺眼的灰褐、柔黑、深蓝灰或与主体呼应的深色，确保在浅色纸面上有足够可读性。文字自然散落在留白区域，与主体和涂鸦形成图文混排，不做固定标题模板。

整体呈现**极浅纸面、粗颗粒蜡笔轮廓、少量粉彩填色、极简涂鸦符号、小尺度主体与大量艺术留白**共同构成的高级治愈视觉。重点是让主体与小元素清楚浮现在浅色纸面上，同时保持松弛、天真、温柔和成熟的编辑构图意识。避免深色牛皮纸、暗棕背景、低对比线条、背景与主体糊成一团、精细描边、写实转绘、复杂小图标、背景填满、光滑矢量、3D感和商业模板感。

Young adult East Asian woman, approximately 22-25 years old.

Exquisite and natural small oval face, the face shape is short and soft, facial contours are smooth, lower jaw is slender but not sharp, cheeks retain a slight softness.

Cold white delicate skin, real skin texture, skin texture is clean and transparent but not plastic skin smoothing.

Exquisite features:
Large and clear almond eyes,
dark brown iris,
obvious pupil highlights,
eyes looking directly at the camera,
gaze is quiet, cold, and slightly mysterious.

Natural straight eyebrows,
nose bridge is slender and straight,
nose tip is small,
naturally full soft mist bean-paste nude pink lips,
lips gently closed,
expression is restrained, no smile.

Eye makeup focus:
long and curled eyelashes,
upper and lower eyelashes are distinct,
thin black inner eyeliner,
eye corners slightly elongated,
lower eyelid has a faint pink-brown smudge,
teardrop bag position has slight highlights,
eye corners have a small amount of pearlescence,
the overall look is like exquisite Gothic girl makeup, but maintains real photography texture.

A very faint cold pink blush added to the cheeks.

【Hairstyle】

Deep black-brown long hair,
middle-parted hairstyle,
hair naturally gathered on both sides,
forming a soft and fluffy low-position curly hair structure at the back.

A large amount of very natural fine hair strands retained on the forehead,
a few long wisps of hair fall in the center of the forehead,
some hair strands gently pass near the eyebrows and eyes.

Natural wisps of hair at the temples,
emphasizing real hair strands,
no wig-cap feel.

An ivory white vintage lace headscarf/lace veil worn on the top and back of the head.

The headscarf covers the top and back hair,
the edges have very fine hollow lace patterns,
with a slight mixed temperament of vintage Victorian maid and nun headscarf.

White lace forms a very strong black and white contrast with the black background.

【Clothing】

Black and white Victorian Gothic long-sleeved clothing.

The main body is a black long-sleeved dress,
sleeves are completely black,
fabric is matte,
cuffs extend to cover the wrists and even part of the palms,
forming slender black arm lines.

An ivory white high-collared pleated shirt structure on the chest.

The high collar uses fine vertical pleats,
the neckline is a small ruffled stand-up collar,
having a 19th-century European vintage clothing feel.

Several pearl buttons arranged on the chest,
the white bodice and black clothes form a clear geometric division.

A small pearl necklace worn at the neckline,
the pearl chain falls naturally to the chest.

An exquisite black-gold Gothic cross pendant hangs in the center of the necklace,
the cross is inlaid with small jewels,
having an antique jewelry texture.

Overall styling:
Victorian Gothic
dark romantic
gothic nun inspired
vintage European portrait
but not a real religious ritual scene.

【Hand Action】

The character's left hand holds a vintage brass candlestick in the lower-left of the frame.

A thick ivory white candle is inserted in the candlestick.

The candle has been burning for a while,
the top edge is irregular,
real melted wax and slight wax drippings can be seen.

The orange-yellow flame burns steadily,
the flame has:
a bright white-yellow core
an orange-gold outer flame
a very slight warm-colored halo.

The character's other hand is raised near the right cheek.

The palm does not block the face,
five fingers naturally slightly curved,
fingertips gently close to the cheek.

Fingers are slender and long.

【Nail Art】

Long almond/pointed oval nail art,
transparent nude pink gradient nail surface,
some nails have silver rhinestones, pearls, transparent crystals, and three-dimensional bow/jewelry decorations.

The nail art is very exquisite,
with real transparent resin and diamond reflection effects,
but not over-exaggerated.

【Composition】

9:16 vertical screen.

Ultra-close-up front portrait photography.

The character's face is in the center of the frame,
the lace headscarf is close to the top edge.

The frame captures from the top of the head to near the chest,
belonging to a head-shoulder-chest close-up.

The character's eyes are at the most important visual center of the frame.

A huge candle on the lower left enters the foreground,
the candle is slightly out of focus,
but the flame is still clearly discernible.

The raised hand on the right is next to the cheek,
forming a second visual layer.

Face remains absolutely clear,
eyes precisely focused.

The composition is nearly symmetrical,
but the complete symmetry is broken by the candle on the left and the hand on the right.

【Background】

Completely dark indoor environment.

The background is nearly pure black,
no obvious furniture,
no modern items,
no complex decorations.

The black clothes of the character partially blend into the dark background,
distinguished only by rim light and candlelight.

Creates:
midnight
quiet
mysterious
dark romantic
vintage oil painting-like atmosphere.

【Lighting】

This is the key to the image.

Low-key dark light photography Low-key lighting.

The real candle in the lower left serves as the warm-colored actual light source in the frame,
forming very soft orange-gold candlelight on the character's left cheek, jaw, nose wing, and hand.

At the same time, there is very soft, very restrained cold white fill light in front of the character,
ensuring the eyes, eyelashes, nose bridge, and lips are still clear.

warm candlelight + cold white front fill light
cinematic-grade cold and warm mixed lighting.

【人物】

年轻成年东亚女性，约22-25岁。

精致自然的小鹅蛋脸，脸型偏短而柔和，面部轮廓流畅，下颌纤细但不尖锐，脸颊保留轻微柔软感。

冷白色细腻肌肤，真实皮肤纹理，肤质干净通透但不是塑料磨皮。

五官精致：
大而清澈的杏仁眼，
深棕色虹膜，
明显瞳孔高光，
双眼完全直视摄影机，
眼神安静、冷淡、略带神秘感。

自然平直眉毛，
鼻梁纤细挺直，
鼻尖小巧，
自然饱满的柔雾豆沙裸粉色嘴唇，
嘴唇轻轻闭合，
表情克制，不笑。

眼妆重点突出：
纤长卷翘睫毛，
上下睫毛根根分明，
细黑色内眼线，
眼尾略微拉长，
下眼睑淡淡粉棕色晕染，
卧蚕位置具有轻微高光，
眼角带少量珠光，
整体像精致的哥特少女妆，但保持真人摄影质感。

面颊加入极淡的冷粉色腮红。

【发型】

深黑偏棕色长发，
中分发型，
头发在两侧自然收起，
后侧形成柔软蓬松的低位卷发结构。

额前保留大量非常自然的细碎发丝，
几根长碎发垂落在额头中央，
部分发丝轻轻经过眉毛和眼睛附近。

鬓角有自然碎发，
强调真实发丝，
禁止假发套感。

头顶及后脑佩戴一块象牙白色复古蕾丝头巾/蕾丝头纱。

头巾覆盖头顶和后侧头发，
边缘具有非常精细的镂空蕾丝花纹，
略带复古维多利亚女仆与修女头巾的混合气质。

白色蕾丝与黑色背景形成非常强烈的黑白对比。

【服装】

黑白配色的维多利亚哥特式长袖服装。

主体为黑色长袖连衣裙，
袖子完全黑色，
布料哑光，
袖口延伸覆盖至手腕甚至部分手掌，
形成修长纤细的黑色手臂线条。

胸前为象牙白色高领褶皱衬衫结构。

高领采用细密竖向褶皱，
领口为小型荷叶边立领，
具有19世纪欧洲复古服饰感觉。

胸前排列数颗珍珠纽扣，
白色胸襟与黑色衣服形成清晰几何分区。

领口佩戴一条细小珍珠项链，
珍珠链自然垂落至胸前。

项链中央悬挂一个精致的黑金色哥特十字架吊坠，
十字架镶嵌细小珠宝，
具有古董首饰质感。

整体造型：
Victorian Gothic
dark romantic
gothic nun inspired
vintage European portrait
但不要真正宗教仪式场景。

【手部动作】

人物左手在画面左下方握住一个复古黄铜烛台。

烛台中插着一根较粗的象牙白色蜡烛。

蜡烛已经燃烧一段时间，
顶部边缘不规则，
能够看到真实融化蜡液和轻微滴蜡。

橙黄色火焰稳定燃烧，
火焰具有：
明亮白黄色核心
橙金色外焰
非常轻微的暖色光晕。

人物另一只手抬至右侧脸颊附近。

手掌不遮挡脸，
五根手指自然微微弯曲，
指尖轻轻靠近脸颊。

手指纤细修长。

【美甲】

长款杏仁形/尖椭圆形美甲，
透明裸粉色渐变甲面，
部分指甲具有银色水钻、珍珠、透明晶石以及立体蝴蝶结/珠宝装饰。

美甲非常精致，
具有真实透明树脂与钻石反射效果，
但不要过度夸张。

【构图】

9:16竖屏。

极近距离正面人像摄影。

人物脸部位于画面中央，
头顶蕾丝头巾接近画面上边缘。

画面从头顶一直拍摄到胸部附近，
属于头肩胸部近景。

人物双眼处于画面最重要视觉中心。

左下方巨大蜡烛进入前景，
蜡烛略微失焦，
但火焰仍然清晰可辨。

右侧人物抬起的手位于脸颊旁边，
形成第二视觉层次。

脸部保持绝对清晰，
眼睛精准对焦。

构图近乎对称，
但通过左侧蜡烛和右侧手部打破完全对称。

【背景】

完全黑暗的室内环境。

背景接近纯黑色，
不出现明显家具，
不出现现代物品，
不出现复杂装饰。

人物黑色衣服部分融入暗色背景，
只通过轮廓光和烛光区分。

营造：
午夜
安静
神秘
暗黑浪漫
复古油画般氛围。

【光线】

这是画面的关键。

低调暗光摄影 Low-key lighting。

左下方真实蜡烛作为画面中的暖色实际光源，
在人物左侧脸颊、下颌、鼻翼以及手部形成非常柔和的橙金色烛光。

与此同时，人物正前方存在非常柔和、非常克制的冷白色补光，
保证双眼、睫毛、鼻梁和嘴唇仍然清晰。

形成：
暖色烛光 + 冷白正面补光
的电影级冷暖混合光线。

眼睛具有非常漂亮的小型catchlight。

鼻梁中央出现细腻高光，
嘴唇保留水润反射，
皮肤保持柔软细腻的明暗层次。

背景完全压暗。

蜡烛火焰周围出现极轻微暖色辉光，
禁止大面积过曝。

【摄影参数与质感】

真实全画幅相机摄影，
85mm portrait lens，
F1.4-F2.0，
超浅景深，
眼睛精准对焦，
脸部高清，
背景纯黑柔化。

cinematic gothic portrait，
Victorian gothic fashion editorial，
candlelight portrait photography，
dark romantic photography，
realistic East Asian woman，
real human skin texture，
individual eyelashes，
individual hair strands，
real lace texture，
real pearl reflections，
real candle flame，
subtle film grain，
high dynamic range，
4K，
ultra detailed，
photorealistic。

黑色

Subject:
Night view and white satin back

Main Subject:
On the center right of a night hotel room scene, a vertical photo of an adult female wearing a white satin mini dress, hands resting on a glass table, showing her profile from the back.

Person · Expression:
The body is in a two-thirds back pose facing the right side of the frame, with a quiet profile face turned to the right. Short brown bob haircut, thin bangs, smooth cheek lines, natural eyebrows, elongated eyes, thin straight nose bridge, and subtle glossy lips.

Clothing · Pose:
A white spaghetti strap satin mini dress with a deep slit at the back, decorated with fine lace under the armpits, and diagonal ruffles from the waist to the hem. Silver stiletto-heeled sandals. The waist is slightly pulled back, leaning forward with both hands on the glass table.

A bed is on the left side of the frame, a champagne bottle and wine glasses are placed on the center glass table, and city lights at night are outside the large window in the background. Soft warm indoor light from the upper right of the frame and weak blue light from the window side outline the satin and back, with the night view in circular bokeh.

Composition · Lens:
9:16 vertical composition, the camera is positioned slightly lower than the waist, a full-body photo taken from a diagonal angle from behind. The person is placed on the center right and enlarged, including everything from the top of the head to the silver high heels, with the table and bottle on the left and the window behind. Focused on the back and the dress.

Texture · Style:
Photorealistic realistic photo. High-definition capture of the gloss of white satin, underarm lace, reflections on glass and bottles, and the contrast between warm and cold in the night view.
