prompts.text:
A photorealistic cinematic full-body portrait of a young adult woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, standing beside a large bright window in a softly illuminated minimalist interior. She has fair, smooth skin with natural texture, a softly oval face, dark almond-shaped eyes, straight brows, a small refined nose, and softly defined peach-pink lips. Her expression is calm and subtly confident, with a gentle closed-mouth smile while looking directly toward the camera. She has sleek, straight jet-black hair cut into a chin-to-shoulder-length bob, with full wispy bangs resting evenly across her forehead and slightly curved ends framing her jawline.

Her pose is relaxed and elegant: she stands at a slight three-quarter angle near the window ledge, her torso gently turned toward the camera. One hand is raised delicately to her chin, fingertips resting near her jaw and lower lip, while her other arm bends naturally downward with her hand relaxed near her waist and upper thigh. Her legs are slightly separated, creating a natural asymmetrical stance.

She wears a short white sleeveless mini dress exactly as shown, made from lightweight softly textured fabric. The dress has extremely thin spaghetti straps, a fitted ruched bodice, a very deep plunging front opening with separated bust panels, a wide fitted waistband, and a loose flowing short skirt ending high on the thighs. The skirt features overlapping fabric and a high side opening that reveals much of one upper thigh. No additional outerwear or accessories are present.

The environment is airy and predominantly white, with sheer curtains and pale architectural framing around a large floor-to-ceiling window. Outside the glass, distant greenery and buildings dissolve into creamy bokeh. A translucent acrylic chair is partially visible in the lower-left foreground. Soft diffused daylight wraps around her body, producing luminous skin tones, gentle highlights, subtle shadows, and an ethereal high-key atmosphere. Shot with a professional full-frame camera and an 85mm portrait lens at approximately f/2, shallow depth of field, softly compressed perspective, fine realistic skin detail, delicate film grain, pastel whites, muted greens, slightly warm skin tones, dreamy editorial color grading, sophisticated fashion photography, ultra-realistic cinematic finish, 9:16.

prompts.text:
Use the uploaded image as the exact composition and subject reference. Transform the original nighttime photograph into a delicate hand-painted watercolor art print, while preserving the recognizable scene and all major elements.

Recreate the Starbucks café centered in the foreground, with its dark low-profile building, clearly visible STARBUCKS sign, glowing warm interior lights, outdoor seating/windows, surrounding evergreen trees, minimalist street lamps, and the majestic snow-covered Mount Fuji rising directly behind the café. Preserve the original perspective, proportions, placement, and atmospheric depth.

Style: traditional Japanese-inspired watercolor illustration on warm ivory textured paper, elegant and minimal, with soft translucent washes, subtle pigment bleeding, visible paper grain, loose hand-painted brushwork, and naturally imperfect watercolor edges.

Use a restrained winter palette of deep cobalt blue, icy blue, soft cyan, muted navy, pale gray, and warm golden yellow from the café windows and signage. Paint Mount Fuji with delicate blue-gray snow shadows and atmospheric mist around its lower slopes. Keep the sky beautifully simplified into smooth watercolor gradients rather than photographic detail.

Create a premium minimalist stationery / gallery art-print composition with the illustration relatively small and centered, surrounded by generous blank cream-colored paper.

Under the illustration, add neat handwritten-style typography reading exactly:

“coffee · mist · mountain”
“a quiet moment”

Then below it:

“2024”

Typography should be small, understated, dark blue-gray ink, with authentic hand-lettered imperfections.

Important: Keep the Starbucks branding and sign clearly recognizable, preserve Mount Fuji’s distinctive shape, do not add people, cars, extra buildings, or unnecessary objects. No photorealism, no digital 3D look, no heavy outlines, no oversaturated colors. The final result should feel like a quiet, sophisticated Japanese watercolor travel print made by hand.

A fictional adult Japanese woman stopping on a forest path, tucking hair behind her ear while smiling at the camera. Centered on elegant early autumn outing attire and a friendly sense of close proximity.

A grey paved road for passage in a quiet park during the afternoon. The left side is filled with dense low shrubs and thick tree trunks; the right side features a gently curving path with overlapping trees in the depth, creating a natural sense of depth as if walking.

Clothing and Accessories:
An ivory top with delicate vertical ribs inside, layered with an open-front charcoal grey long-sleeved shirt. Paired with a matte sage green glossy long skirt, a dark brown shoulder bag, and a small round pendant.

Pose, Fingers, Contact:
Body slightly angled towards the path, using a fingertip of one hand to gently touch a strand of hair by the ear. Shoulders relaxed, the other arm and the bag strap hanging naturally along the body's curves.

Expression and Gaze:
Eyes looking directly into the camera, corners of closed lips softly upturned. The gaze carries the composure and slight shyness of noticing an acquaintance while on the way.

Face and Makeup:
Smooth oval contour, natural parallel eyebrows, dark brown pupils, neat bridge of the nose, pale coral pink lips. Applying a thin layer of blood color on the cheeks, balancing facial dimensionality with a bare-skin texture.

Hair:
Shoulder-length dark brown hair parted from the center-side, retaining soft outward-flipping waves at the ends. Meticulous flyaway strands tucked behind the ear, carefully expressing every strand of hair that catches the light.

Light Source:
Afternoon natural light through the canopy spills from the upper right, dotting the forehead, cheeks, chest, and skirt with fine dappled tree shadows. Diffused light reflected from the surrounding greenery makes facial shadows soft and light.

Colors and Tones:
A low-saturation early autumn palette centered on dark green leaves, charcoal grey, ivory, sage green, and dark brown. Retaining the yellow tones of the skin and tree shadows as restrained warm accents.

Materials and Fine Textures:
The vertical ribs of the top, the fine wrinkles of the shirt after washing, the smooth reflection of the satin-toned long skirt, the leather texture of the bag, the moisture of the leaves, and the graininess of the paved road are each depicted with recognizable textures.

Composition and Lens:
A 9:16 vertical close-up eye-level portrait. The chest is placed near 50% of the image width as the visual center, and the midpoint between the eyes is placed near 53% horizontally. Using the hands touching the hair and the path extending to the right as diagonal leading lines.

Image Processing and Finish:
Smoothly refining the skin with natural commercial photography resolution while retaining soft local contrast in the pupils, hair strands, clothing textures, and leaves. Balancing the tonal layers of tree shadows in bright areas and plants in dark areas.

Deformation Avoidance and Prohibitions:
Fixed to one adult woman, hands touching hair, multi-layered clothing, tree shadows on the path. Do not add extra fingers or hands, fused bags, discontinuous clothing, excessive skin retouching, text, logos, watermarks, or extra people.

items.title: 当代透视排版空间装置海报

prompts.text:
TITLE: [TENSION / DRIFT / FOCUS / REFRACT / your own word]
PROJECT: [brand / exhibition / campaign name]
ENVIRONMENT: [fabric canopy / terrain / mirror installation / water / other]
TYPE MECHANISM: [surface distortion / terrain warp / reflection / refraction]
SUBJECT: [small human figure / none]
MAIN COLOR: [accent color]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a contemporary perspective typography poster where oversized type is physically transformed by the material or environment around it.

The main word should occupy roughly 35–55% of the composition and become part of the scene itself. Let the letterforms stretch, bend, split, compress or realign according to the chosen surface or optical medium.

For fabric, let the type follow tension, curvature and suspended folds.
For terrain, let it wrap across slopes, ridges and valleys.
For mirrors, distort the source typography so the reflection resolves into a readable word.
For water, use depth and refraction to shift and reconnect the letterforms.

Keep the spatial logic physically believable, with correct perspective, occlusion, reflections, refraction and surface contact.

Use one strong accent color against a restrained architectural or natural palette. Keep the typography bold, clean and highly legible from the intended viewpoint.

If a person is included, keep them small and use them mainly as a scale reference or observer within the typographic space.

Add only a small amount of secondary editorial information such as project name, date, location and one short thematic line.

Overall style: perspective typography, spatial graphic design, contemporary installation art, editorial poster, strong depth, clean hierarchy and high visual impact.

Slightly harsh warm key light streams in from the upper left window, forming slender window-frame shadows and bright highlights on the face, chest, and sleeves, while leaving soft shadows on the right.

2:3 vertical composition. The face is placed in the upper center, the right hand touching the face in the upper right, and the window at the left end, making the person appear large in the center. Photorealistic high-definition live-action photograph. Accurately capturing natural skin texture and glow, every strand of hair, fine rib texture, lace, translucent sleeves, and the weave of the denim, harmonized with warm low-saturation tones of ecru and light wood colors.

prompts.text: Scene ID S1, location: a compact modern apartment kitchen breakfast counter. She wears a loose cream textured knit top with casual light shorts. Capture the candid instant while she cracks an egg over a breakfast bowl beside tomatoes and vegetables, her body still oriented toward the counter while her head has just turned toward the camera. Camera height 104 cm, 35mm lens, photographer approximately 1.5 m away. Her figure occupies about 76% of frame height, cropped around mid thigh. A towel hanging from the near sink edge enters the lower foreground and softly obscures about 14% of the frame. Morning sunlight enters from frame right at roughly 2 o'clock, descending about 18 degrees, moderately hard with defined highlights across her cheek, hands and sweater. Main colors are warm cream 38%, soft white 24%, natural wood 18%, muted green 10%, stainless gray 10%. Unique scene fingerprints include an egg carton beside sliced tomatoes, a frying pan containing a sunny side egg, and small condiment bottles clustered beneath hanging utensils. Keep the foreground towel noticeably defocused, the woman's nearer eye and face critically sharp, and the refrigerator and distant dining opening gently softened. items.title: 蜡笔旅行小记对比海报摄影插画

prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的“蜡笔旅行小记”对比海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。

整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度接近1:1，以清晰、平直的水平边界分隔。不得在中间使用渐变、羽化或相互渗透效果。

上半部分忠实保留原始照片，准确保持原照片中的人物、动物、建筑、车辆、船只、自然景观、动作方向、观察角度、空间关系、真实材质、自然光影和原有色彩氛围。仅进行轻微的旅行杂志摄影调色，并加入极薄的胶片颗粒。不得重新绘制、移动、替换或扭曲原照片中的主体。

下半部分是一张具有明显纤维和轻微纸齿的温暖米白色画纸，保留大面积干净、连续的纸张留白。

在下半部分中央嵌入一张独立的横向绘画纸片。纸片占下半区域宽度约70%—80%、高度约40%—50%，边缘带有柔软、自然、轻微不规则的手撕毛边和纸纤维，不使用光滑规则的数码相框。

横向纸片中的蜡笔插画必须来自上方同一张照片。不要只提取一个孤立人物或物件，而是保留原照片最主要的叙事构图和空间关系：

- 保留一个最具识别度的主体；
- 保留主体原本的姿态、方向和位置关系；
- 保留一至三项能够说明地点或环境的线索；
- 让插画中的主体、道路、建筑、山、水、天空或其他关键元素能够与上方照片清楚对应；
- 删除杂乱背景、远处细节、摄影噪声、微小文字和无关装饰。

下方不是将整张照片机械描摹一遍，而是把完整确的场景压缩成一幅简短、稚拙、带有记忆感的横向蜡笔小画。适当改变裁切、细节密度和色彩数量，但不得改变主体身份、数量、动作方向和关键场景关系。

使用圆头粗蜡笔、油画棒和少少少量量铅笔完成插画。以断断续续、略带迟疑的深灰或黑色粗蜡笔轮廓作为主要结构，表现软硬不均的手部压力、停笔、重描、越线填色、纸纹透底、轻微擦脏、颜色没有完全填满以及不规则的笔触断口。

造型简洁、圆润、略显笨拙，带有私人旅行画本和旧绘本的亲切感。可以不描绘写实五官，也不追求准确透视，但必须通过主体轮廓、姿态和标志性物件保持一眼可辨。画面应稚拙但不幼稚，轻松但不潦草。

从上方照片中提取两至四种柔和颜色，配合黑色或深灰色轮廓。保留照片最具有记忆点的特征色，例如建筑的蓝色、车辆的橙色、湖水的灰蓝、草地的绿色或花朵的粉色。降低颜色数量和饱和度，不使用固定海蓝色、彩虹色盘或与原照片无关的颜色。

在横向画芯上方和下方分别加入一句自然的英文手写配文：

- 上方文字描述照片中真实可见的地点、天气、主体或画面关系；
- 下方文字记录这一刻带来的轻微情绪或观察；
- 两句话应简短、自然、有人味，像旅行途中随手写下的句子；
- 不使用编号、年份、档案字段、广告口号或标准化海报标题。

文字采用松动、略微摇晃的石墨铅笔或蜡笔手写体，保留纸齿、断笔和自然书写误差。字号必须能在聊天预览中清楚阅读，文字像真正写在纸面上，而不是后期添加的光滑数码排版。

整体呈现真实旅行摄影与私人蜡笔画本之间的温柔对照。上方记录当时真正发生的场景，下方留下经过记忆删减后的形状、颜色和一句轻轻的注解。

避免孤立人物图标、贴纸式主体、完整背景写实重画、儿童卡通、表情包、彩虹配色、光滑矢量线条、自动照片描边、数字滤镜、满版插画、规则相框、密集装饰、乱码、假中文、作者名字、签名、品牌标志、二维码和水印。

prompts.text:
Please turn each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, each photo output individually. Overall use a 3:4 vertical composition, the top and bottom areas are strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the screen.

The upper half retains the original photo, maintaining the subject's identity, structure, posture, real texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end color grading to give it the texture of art magazines and exhibition images. To adapt to the frame size, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The lower half performs new artistic judgment, only extracting the most recognizable subject, outline, structure, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, reconstructed as Hand-drawn Doodle Lifestyle Illustration / Naïve Illustration / Marker Drawing. Do not retain all objects, do not copy the original scene; actively delete the vast majority of backgrounds and irrelevant information, re-direct the scene through deletion, reorganization, cropping, and scale changes, so that even if the original image has an ordinary composition, it can be transformed into a valid piece of work.

Modeling is simplified, symbolic, relaxed, and personalized, using slightly jittery, intermittent, and not completely regular hand-drawn lines, as well as natural coloring like markers, crayons, and oil pastels. Allow slight line crossing, white space, and manual errors, without pursuing realistic proportions, complete perspective, or fine depiction.

The lower half must take a huge amount of conscious whitespace as its core, with solid graphics occupying only a small proportion, and the rest of the space actively left blank. Subjects can be eccentric, edge-aligned, suspended, or partially cropped, with positions determined by posture direction and visual center of gravity. Whitespace and the subject together form positive and negative shapes, distance, pauses, and a sense of breathing; rather paint less than fill the screen.

Graphics and text must be re-typeset as a whole, rather than "a sentence on top, a character below." Establish an invisible grid, visual axis, and reading path first, then decide on text placement; text can be close to the subject's outline, follow the direction of movement, align with the head or shoulder line, fall in large negative spaces, or form staggered, interspersed, and asymmetrical echoes with the graphics. Avoid mechanical centering, top-to-bottom stacking, and fixed templates; let graphics handle emotion and text handle rhythm, with both completing the composition together.

Text has no language restriction, retaining only a very small amount of truly meaningful words or short phrases. Use light, natural handwritten fonts with slight variations in character width and pen pressure, keeping a bit of a casual writing feel, but letter spacing, line spacing, and overall placement must be controlled through editorial design. One slightly obvious short phrase can be used with tiny auxiliary text to form a hierarchy, but no menu-style titles, long copy, or full-page text.

Color adopts a soft, bright, and healing limited palette, re-modulating the most vital colors extracted from the original image to form refreshing colors such as cream yellow, peach pink, coral red, sky blue, lake cyan, tender green, and lavender purple; vivid but not glaring, soft but not dirty-grey, with warm white or extremely light composite colors as large areas of breathing space.

Overall pursuit of naive drawing, mature composition, smart text-graphic relationships, and a massive amount of whitespace, like high-end independent magazines, lifestyle editorial illustrations, or art publications, rather than children's scrapbooks. Avoid fixed structures of centered subject + centered copy, random small icons scattered around, complex backgrounds, information accumulation, filling the screen, cheap cartoonishness, and templated layout.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用 3:4 竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格 1:1，各占画面 50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级调色，使其具有艺术杂志与展览图像质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分重新做美术判断，**只提取照片中最具识别性的主体、轮廓、结构、姿态与叙事关系**，重构为 Hand-drawn Doodle Lifestyle Illustration / Naïve Illustration / Marker Drawing。不要保留所有对象，不要复制原场景；主动删除绝大多数背景和无关信息，通过删减、重组、裁切、尺度变化重新导演画面，使原图即使构图普通，也能转化成一张成立的作品。

造型简化、符号化、松弛而有个性，使用轻微抖动、断续、不完全规整的手绘线条，以及马克笔、蜡笔、油画棒般的自然涂色。允许轻微越线、露白和手工误差，不追求写实比例、完整透视和精细描绘。

下半部分必须以**超大量有意识的留白**为核心，实体图形只占较小比例，其余空间主动留空。主体可偏心、贴边、悬置或局部裁切，根据姿态方向和视觉重心决定位置。留白与主体共同形成正负形、距离、停顿和呼吸感，宁可少画，也绝不填满画面。

**图形与文字必须作为一个整体重新排版，而不是“上面一句话、下面一个人物”。** 先建立隐形网格、视觉轴线和阅读路径，再决定文字位置；文字可贴近主体轮廓、顺着动作方向、与头部或肩线对齐、落在大块负空间中，或与图形形成错位、穿插和不对称呼应。避免机械居中、上下堆叠和固定模板，让图形负责情绪，文字负责节奏，两者共同完成构图。

文字不限制语种，只保留极少量真正有意义的字词或短句。使用**轻巧、自然、略带字宽差异与笔压变化的手写字体**，保留一点随手书写感，但字距、行距和整体落点必须经过编辑设计控制。可用一个稍明显的短句配合极小辅助文字形成层级，但不要菜单式标题、长段文案或满版文字。

配色采用柔和、明快、治愈的限定色系，从原图中提取最有生命力的颜色重新调制，可形成奶油黄、蜜桃粉、珊瑚红、天空蓝、湖水青、嫩绿、薰衣草紫等清爽色彩；鲜活但不刺眼，柔和但不灰脏，以暖白或极浅综合色作为大面积呼吸空间。

整体追求**稚拙的画、成熟的构图、聪明的图文关系、超大量留白**，像高级独立杂志、生活方式 editorial illustration 或艺术出版物，而不是儿童手帐。避免主体居中 + 文案居中的固定结构、随机小图标撒满四周、复杂背景、信息堆积、画面填满、廉价卡通感和模板化排版

prompts.text:
创作一张真实、自然的室内窗边人像，对象是一位明确为25岁以上的成年女性，她坐在温暖的棕色木地板上，倚靠着窗帘和一个长圆柱形长枕，长枕为奶油色背景，印有柔和的绿色、黄色和棕色植物花卉图案。

她留着自然的黑色长发，随意地从中分。大部分头发垂在肩膀上并倾向画面右侧，发根略微蓬松，脸部附近有几丝碎发，在头发靠在窗帘的地方有细微的挤压和凌乱感。保持头发平滑但具有真实感，而不是完美的丝般质感。

她穿着一件简约的白色细肩带短款棉质吊心，完全遮盖胸部，长度到上腹部左右，露出锁骨、肩膀、手臂、腰部、腹部和肚脐。她还穿着奶油色或淡米色的低腰棉质比基尼内裤，上面点缀着细小的柔和蓝绿色、棕黄色和灰粉色花卉图案，完全覆盖盆骨中心区域。保持苗条但真实的成年身体，具有真实的软组织重量和重力感。不要夸大胸部、臀部或腰部。她的腹部自然放松，仅有由于坐姿扭转引起的微妙轮廓变化。

姿势松弛且不对称。她的上半身向后靠，身体在竖幅画面中形成一条对角线。画面右侧的腿弯曲并抬起，非常靠近相机，产生大腿的自然透视放大效果。另一条腿横跨木地板折向左下方。一只手臂向画面左侧延伸，手里拿着一把已经打开的传统折扇，扇骨为浅色竹制或木制，扇面为白色薄面；扇骨形成强烈的放射状图案。另一只手抬向右上方区域，随意地抚摸着后脑勺和头发。不要水平镜像构图。

她的头微微后仰并转向左上方。她没有注视相机；她的目光飘向明亮的窗户。她的双唇轻启。表情安静、心不在焉且带有淡淡的自省感，既没有微笑，也没有刻意诱惑。

使用柔和的东亚美容社论妆容风格，但不暗示种族或改变她的身份：洁净的半哑光肤色，具有真实的皮肤纹理，较直的深色眉毛，紧贴睫毛膏的精致黑色上眼线并带有微妙的外延，自然清晰的睫毛，极柔和的灰褐色眼影，极少的腮红，以及带有淡淡滋润光泽的柔和灰玫瑰色嘴唇。保留原始的面部比例、下颌线、眼间距和自然的面部不对称。不要把她变成一张明星脸或过度完美的网红脸。

她裸露的皮肤包括面部、颈部、锁骨和上胸部、肩膀、手臂、腋下附近区域、完整的腹部和肚脐、臀部外缘、大腿、膝盖、小腿、脚踝和脚部。使用浅中性的象牙肤色。在最强的窗光下，它会变得像牛奶般柔和，而阴影区域则转向极其微妙的暖灰色和米粉色。皮肤看起来应该感觉温暖、柔软、光滑且带有淡淡的绒面感，保留微小的毛孔、轻微的色调变化、关节周围的自然暗沉以及真实的软组织压缩感。避免塑料感、蜡质感或瓷感皮肤。

主要的物理光源是身后及画面左侧的一扇巨大的明亮窗户。自然日光穿过半透明的白色薄纱窗帘，使整个窗户变成一个巨大的柔和扩散光源。宽阔而柔和的高光洒在面向窗户的脸颊、肩膀、锁骨、手臂和腿部，过渡非常自然。另一侧仅接收来自淡色墙壁、米色窗帘和木地板的被动反光。不要使用明显的正面闪光灯或人造摄影棚轮廓光。允许薄纱窗帘和最靠近窗户的高光部分出现轻微的白色溢出，并带有微妙的自然晕染。

在画面右侧，加入一个较厚的米灰色窗帘，带有低调的金棕色植物刺绣或花卉细节。将整个房间的色调控制在柔和的白色、淡米色、暖灰色和天然木材色系内。室外景观应完全被发光的薄纱窗帘遮挡。

像真实的、全画幅无反或单反相机拍摄的照片一样，使用大约35-50mm的定焦镜头，最好是40mm左右的全画幅视角，光圈约f/2.8-f/4，ISO 200-500，快门约1/125秒。将相机放置在坐姿时腰部到膝盖的高度，略低于胸部水平，从画面左侧稍微偏移一点的角度拍摄。这应该会产生轻微的向上透视，并对抬起的近景大腿产生真实的近大远小效果。

使用3:4的竖幅构图。让主体几乎填满画面。不要让身体完全居中或对称。允许肢体靠近画面边缘，保留轻微的看起来像偶然的裁剪和不均匀的视觉重量感。画面左侧打开的折扇与画面右侧硕大的近景大腿形成平衡。

使用适度的浅景深，而不是极端的背景虚化。保持面部、躯干和腿部的主要区域清晰可见且富有细节，而窗帘和花卉长枕仅轻微柔化，仍保留可见的纹理。保留微妙的数字颗粒、克制的锐度、少量的阴影噪点和轻微的高光溢出。避免HDR、过度的清晰度处理和完美无瑕的商业修图。

她已经在窗边坐了一会儿了。午后的阳光一直透过薄纱窗帘洒进来。现在她正抬头望向窗外，打开的折扇仍停留在她手中；过一会儿，她可能会再次开始扇动它。最终的图像应该传达出低能量、温暖、静谧以及某种未尽之言的余味——仿佛摄影师就坐在同一块地板的附近，碰巧捕捉到了这一瞬间，而不是导演了一个完美受控的摄影棚姿势。

items.title: 肖像海报与拼豆挂件实拍设计

prompts.text:
Please turn each portrait photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, outputting each photo separately without stitching multiple images together.

The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout, setting clear upper and lower contrast areas. The top and bottom proportions are roughly balanced, with a clear and clean horizontal boundary in the middle, but the original photo must not be stretched or distorted.

The upper part faithfully preserves the original portrait, accurately maintaining the person's identity, facial features, expressions, hairstyle, clothing, posture, gestures, personal items, environment, lighting, and original color relationships, only adding slight editorial photographic color grading and very fine film grain. The person must not be redrawn or their identity changed.

The lower part summarizes the person's most recognizable hairstyle, main clothing colors, posture, and two to four key objects from the photo into a single-outline physical Perler bead travel keychain.

The Perler bead work must be composed cell-by-cell from a large number of cylindrical plastic beads with central holes. Clearly represent the hole in each bead, the highlight on the plastic surface, thermal melting connections, slightly fused edges, black or dark bead outlines, and the thickness of the real object. It must look like a truly completed handmade Perler bead physical object, rather than digital pixel art, a printed pattern, or a flat sticker.

Retain the person's instantly recognizable hairstyle, face direction, clothing color blocks, posture, and representative objects, but compress details so that the person and objects form a complete, clean, die-cuttable keychain outline. Use a limited palette of 7–12 bead colors extracted from the original photo.

The Perler bead keychain occupies about 52%–72% of the width of the lower part, held, gripped, or lightly pinched by a real natural hand, presenting a believable hand-held scale. The background is a real environment with shallow depth of field, retaining at least 30% continuous low-information negative space. Only one Perler bead work can appear in each image; do not make it into a multi-piece set or display rack.

Text must not be printed inside the Perler bead keychain. Generate a short English title based on the photo, paired with “BEAD EDITION 01” and a short observation text, placed in the quiet peripheral background. The font uses clear small pixel fonts or restrained print fonts and must be completely readable.

Overall, it has the texture of a combination of handmade souvenirs, physical collectible photography, and modern editorial design, being compact, vivid, real, and touchable, while retaining the character of the original person.

Avoid digital pixel illustrations, flat stickers, brand logos, crochet textures, squares without holes, fake hands, multiple keychains, gibberish, author names, QR codes, and watermarks.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张肖像照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，每张照片单独输出，不得多图拼接。

整体采用3:4竖版构图，设置清晰的上下对比区域。上下比例大致均衡，中间保留明确、整洁的水平分界，但不得拉伸或扭曲原照片。

上半部分忠实保留原始肖像，准确保持人物身份、面部五官、表情、发型、服装、姿态、手势、随身物件、环境、光线和原始色彩关系，仅加入轻微编辑摄影调色与极细胶片颗粒。不得重绘人物或改变人物身份。

下半部分将照片中最具辨识度的人物发型、服装主色、姿态和两至四件关键物件，概括为一件单一轮廓的实体拼豆旅行挂件。

拼豆作品必须由大量具有中央孔洞的圆柱形塑料拼豆逐格构成。清楚表现每颗珠子的孔洞、塑料表面高光、热熔连接、轻微熔合边缘、黑色或深色珠子外轮廓以及真实物件厚度。它必须看起来是一件真正制作完成的手工拼豆实物，而不是数字像素画、印刷图案或平面贴纸。

保留人物一眼可辨的发型、脸部方向、衣服色块、姿态和代表性物件，但压缩细节，使人物与物件形成一个完整、干净、可模切的挂件轮廓。使用从原照片中提取的7—12种有限珠色。

拼豆挂件占下半部分宽度约52%—72%，由一只真实自然的手掌托住、夹持或轻轻捏住，呈现可信的手持尺度。背景为浅景深的真实环境，并保留至少30%的连续低信息留白。每张画面只能出现一件拼豆作品，不得做成多件套或展示架。

文字不得印在拼豆挂件内部。根据照片生成一个简短英文标题，并搭配“BEAD EDITION 01”和一句简短观察文字，放置在外围安静背景中。字体采用清晰的小型像素字体或克制印刷字体，必须完整可读。

整体具有手工纪念品、实体收藏摄影与现代编辑设计结合的质感，小巧、鲜明、真实、可触摸，同时保留原人物的性格。

避免数字像素插画、平面贴纸、品牌标志、钩织质感、没有孔洞的方块、虚假手掌、多件挂件、乱码、作者名、二维码和水印。

items.title: 高级清吧黑皮衣兔女郎全身照

prompts.text:
[Subject Description]

A photorealistic full-body portrait of a young adult East Asian woman with a tall, slim, feminine figure and long legs. She has warm fair skin, a softly oval face, a delicate jawline, dark almond-shaped eyes, straight dark eyebrows, a small straight nose, naturally rosy-red lips, and a gentle, confident, slightly playful smile. She is looking directly toward the camera with a subtle head tilt.

Her hair is long, straight-to-slightly-wavy black hair, parted near the center, with loose strands naturally framing both sides of her face and falling over her shoulders.

She wears a black bunny-inspired cocktail costume: a glossy black leather-like strapless bodysuit with a sweetheart neckline and high-cut leg openings, paired with a crisp white detachable collar, a small black bow tie, and oversized white cuffs. A pair of tall, upright black satin bunny ears is worn on her head. She wears sheer black fishnet stockings and elegant black pointed-toe high heels.

She is holding a dark champagne/wine bottle with a decorative label horizontally in front of her torso with both hands, presenting it toward the camera. Her posture is poised and feminine, with her weight shifted onto one leg and the other leg slightly crossed forward.

She possesses the best head-to-body ratio, a perfect, curvaceous, S-shaped female figure, long legs with perfect leg lines, and a slender waist, perfect foots,perfect foot lines

[Scene / Background]

An upscale, dimly lit cocktail bar / lounge interior with a sophisticated dark atmosphere. Behind the woman is a long bar counter with a large collection of liquor bottles and numerous champagne bottles arranged across illuminated shelves. Dark metal window or railing structures, textured glass, wooden architectural elements, and subtle trailing green plants appear in the upper background.

The bar counter features a warm copper/bronze metallic front panel with naturally visible scratches, stains, reflections, and patina. A dark wooden floor occupies the lower foreground.

The environment should feel like a real premium nightlife venue rather than a studio set. Background bottles and architectural details remain recognizable but slightly softened by depth of field.

[Lighting / Atmosphere]

Strong direct on-camera flash photography illuminates the woman, producing crisp highlights on her skin, glossy costume, champagne bottle, and hair. The foreground subject is significantly brighter than the surrounding environment.

Warm amber/orange practical lighting glows from beneath and around the bar counter, creating rich copper reflections and a luxurious nighttime atmosphere. The background remains predominantly dark with deep shadows and restrained highlights.

Realistic specular reflections on the glossy black outfit and bottle; natural skin texture without excessive smoothing. High contrast between the flash-lit subject and the dark bar interior. Subtle ambient falloff, realistic shadowing, and authentic nightlife color balance.

[Composition / Viewpoint]

The entire woman is visible from the top of her bunny ears to the tips of her high heels, with a small amount of breathing room around her.

The woman is centered slightly right of frame, standing directly in front of the bar. Eye-level to slightly low camera perspective, with mild wide-angle perspective that emphasizes her long legs while maintaining natural body proportions.

Camera faces the subject almost directly. Her body is slightly angled while her face remains oriented toward the camera. The champagne bottle is clearly visible near the center of the frame.

[Style Reference]

High-end photorealistic nightlife photography, authentic professional camera capture, realistic East Asian facial features, natural human anatomy and proportions, sophisticated cocktail-lounge aesthetic, elegant and playful bunny-inspired fashion styling.

Realistic photographic skin, individual hair strands, fabric and leather texture, metallic reflections, glass reflections, bottle-label detail, environmental imperfections, and natural optical rendering.

Avoid illustration, anime, CGI, plastic skin, excessive beauty retouching, artificial glamour lighting, exaggerated anatomy, or fantasy-like rendering,no cropped feet, 

[Image Quality Parameters]

Photorealistic, ultra-detailed, high-resolution DSLR/mirrorless photography, full-body sharp focus, realistic skin pores and fine texture, detailed hair strands, accurate fabric and material rendering, physically plausible reflections, natural depth of field, realistic lens characteristics, subtle optical falloff, high dynamic range, crisp flash illumination, rich shadow detail, warm cinematic tonal range, authentic indoor exposure, natural perspective, professional color grading.

prompts.text:
[主体描述]

一位年轻成年东亚女性的写实全身肖像，身材高挑、苗条、充满女性魅力且双腿修长。她拥有温暖的白皙皮肤，柔和的椭圆形脸庞，精致的下颚线，深邃的杏眼，笔直的深色眉毛，小巧挺拔的鼻子，自然红润的双唇，以及温柔、自信且略带俏皮的微笑。她正略微倾斜头部直接注视着镜头。

她的头发是长而直且略带波浪的黑发，近乎中分，蓬松的发丝自然地修饰着脸庞两侧并垂在肩上。

她穿着一套黑色兔子灵感的鸡尾酒装扮：一件富有光泽的黑色类皮革抹胸连体衣，带有心形领口和高叉剪裁，搭配洁白的活动衣领、一个小黑领结和特大的白色袖口。头上戴着一对高耸、直立的黑色缎面兔耳朵。她穿着透明的黑色鱼网袜和优雅的黑色尖头高跟鞋。

她双手水平地在躯干前拿着一个带有装饰性标签的深色香槟/酒瓶，将其展示给镜头。她的姿态沉稳且富有女性美感，重心移动到一条腿上，另一条腿稍稍向前交叉。

她拥有最佳的头身比，完美、曼妙的S形女性曲线，拥有完美腿部线条的长腿，纤细的腰部，完美的足部，完美的足部线条。

[场景 / 背景]

一个高档、光线昏暗的鸡尾酒酒吧/酒廊内部，具有精致的暗调氛围。女人身后是一个长长的酒吧柜台，照明架上排列着大量的烈酒瓶和众多的香槟瓶。背景上方出现了深色金属窗户或栏杆结构、纹理玻璃、木质建筑元素和细微的垂坠绿植。

吧台采用温暖的铜/青铜金属前面板，带有自然可见的划痕、污渍、反射和岁月的痕迹。深色木地板占据了前景的较低位置。

环境感觉应该像是一个真实的优质夜生活场所，而不是演播室布景。背景中的酒瓶和建筑细节保持可辨识性，但由于景深而略微柔化。

[光影 / 氛围]

强烈的直接机顶闪光摄影照亮了这位女性，在她的皮肤、有光泽的服装、香槟瓶和头发上产生清晰的高光。前景主体明显比周围环境明亮。

温暖的琥珀色/橙色环境光从吧台下方和周围发光，营造出丰富的铜质反射和奢华的夜生活氛围。背景主要保持黑暗，带有深沉的阴影和克制的高光。

黑色亮面套装和瓶子上真实的镜面反射；自然的皮肤纹理，没有过度的平滑。闪光灯照射的主体与黑暗的酒吧内部之间的高对比度。微妙的环境衰减，真实的阴影和真实的夜生活色彩平衡。

[构图 / 视角]

从兔耳朵顶端到高跟鞋尖端，整个人都清晰可见，身体周围留有一定的呼吸空间。

女人位于画面中心略微偏右，直接站在吧台前。视平线到略低的相机视角，带有轻微的广角透视，在保持自然身体比例的同时强调她的长腿。

相机几乎直接面对主体。她的身体略微侧向，而脸部保持正对镜头。香槟瓶在画面中心附近清晰可见。

prompts.text: Direction: A midnight snapshot accidentally left on a friend's phone that makes one inexplicably unable to look away. A 23-year-old fictional Japanese adult woman, still wearing a near-future fallen angel character costume after a cosplay event, in the process of organizing her luggage in the passage behind the venue. The photographer is right beside her, and the shutter was accidentally triggered at the moment she turned her head. Not a beautifully finished cosplay photo, but one that pursues a 'badly shot but exceptionally brilliant photo' where the distance is too close, the frame is tilted, the costume is messy, and the expression mid-movement coincidentally aligns. Mood: A sense of exhaustion mixed with excitement right after the event. She is not posing, but laughing and looking back during a conversation with a friend. The contrast brought by the bold costume makes one feel its charm, yet the photo itself remains a casual, accidental mobile phone snapshot. Not scary or eerie, but the characteristic floating sensation of the journey home from a nighttime event. Model: A 23-year-old fictional Japanese adult woman. Healthy and natural physical proportions, an adult woman with a full bust. Does not imitate real people, artists, or influencers. Face: A friendly and approachable fictional adult woman's face. Natural makeup, with sweat or slight makeup breakdown remaining after long hours of activity. The mouth is slightly open, about to respond, a blurred expression just before a smile forms. Not looking directly at the lens, but as if looking at the photographer's face, with the gaze slightly shifted to one side of the lens. Hair: Long hair from black to dark brown. Tips are slightly messy due to multiple movements during the event, with a few strands sticking to the cheeks or neck. The momentum of looking back gives the hair ends a slight motion blur. Body: In the middle of taking something out of a bag on the floor and standing up. The body is only turned halfway toward the photographer's side, an unbalanced posture with weight on one leg. The shoulders and waist are not fully aligned, forming a natural twist that is not a posed shot. The full figure is revealed naturally only through the fit of the clothing and close-range perspective, without exaggeration. Skin: Natural skin like that of an adult woman. Parts exposed by the clothing such as the collarbone, shoulders, arms, and legs retain fine texture and color variations. Slight redness after long exposure to event lighting, and a moderate glow from sweat. No excessive skin beautification or uniform porcelain skin. Outfit: A bold but not explicit adult-oriented cosplay inspired by a near-future fallen angel. A high-cut bodysuit-style garment dominated by black and gunmetal gray, plus an extremely short asymmetrical jacket, a decorative belt at a high waist position, thigh-high boots, and partial combinations of translucent and mesh materials. Boldly cut designs around the shoulders, back, waist, and legs, but necessary parts of the chest and lower body are firmly covered. The clothing is not a perfectly fitting CG suit, but retains small wrinkles, seams, upturned edges, and slight shifts after activity as real fabric. Costume details: Small black feather parts installed on the back, with one side slightly tilted. A thin metal collar-style costume part on the neck. Asymmetrical arm sleeves on the arms. Decorative straps for cosplay attached to the legs, but not used to emphasize specific parts. High-completion costume, yet parts are slightly shifted due to the end of the event, which adds a sense of reality. Accessories: Event wristband, smartphone, transparent drink bottle, small backpack, one glove removed. Holding some costume accessories in hand, conveying the state of being in the middle of packing up. Scene objects: White wall behind the venue, folding chairs, paper bags on the floor, costume cases, charging cables, event booklets, a half-drunk plastic bottle. Contrast created through the gap between the flashy cosplay costume and the cluttered packing space. Pose: The moment of looking back after a friend calls her name while standing up from a bag on the floor, with the body preceding the face. Holding a phone in one hand, while the other hand naturally begins to tidy the hem of the jacket. Leg width and shoulder positions are asymmetrical. No arching of the back, thrusting of the chest, or intentional leg-showing poses used for photos are allowed. Lighting: A mix of cool white LED from behind the venue and slightly warm streetlights seeping in from the distant automatic doors. One side of the face is white lighting, with parts of the hair and shoulders reflecting warmth. Black clothing partially sinks into shadows, with only metallic materials catching light in small areas. Phone auto-exposure, with slight overexposure on skin parts. Effect: Ordinary phone JPEG. Slight ISO noise, fine compression artifacts, slight noise in the dark parts of the black clothing, with only slight motion blur on the hair and fingertips when looking back. No high-end retouching or cinematic color grading. Camera: An ordinary smartphone held by a friend with one hand. Equivalent to a 24-26mm wide-angle main camera. The shooting distance is too close at about 40-60cm, causing a slight wide-angle perspective on the face, shoulders, and front of the costume. Vertical 4:5. No time to adjust the composition, the frame is tilted by 2-5 degrees. Shutter speed is slightly slow, ISO auto. Not portrait mode, but a regular shot, so the background is also relatively clear. Imperfections: Almost no headroom at the top, hair parts are close to the top edge of the frame. One boot is slightly cropped at the edge of the frame. Black feathers on one side are halfway out of the frame. The hem of the jacket is slightly flipped up, revealing garment seams and wrinkles. One side of the hair hangs over the face. Localized overexposure and shadow noise characteristic of mobile phones. Not everything is beautified or organized. Background: Not a flashy photography booth, but a utilitarian passage behind the event hall. Floor has traces of protective tape, and by the wall, there are folding chairs, someone's paper bag, costume cases, a charging phone, etc. Other participants pass by blurred in the distance, background not organized for photography. Atmosphere: The point in time when the event's brilliance has ended and everyone returns to being ordinary friends. A cosplay appearance remaining only at that boundary. The temperature difference of the bold costume while the person is only thinking about the bag and phone brings an unintentional charm. Composition: Not just aiming at the chest or legs, but an extreme close-up vertical composition where the face, clothing, hands, and floor luggage all enter the frame. The person is slightly off-center, with a large margin on one side of the frame. The close-range wide-angle makes for a rich amount of information in the frame; first look at the face, then zoom in to confirm clothing texture, feather shift, hands, event ID on the floor, etc. Capture reason: A friend was about to leave and called out 'You didn't forget that, did you?', she looked back while standing up from the bag, and the photographer's finger accidentally pressed the shutter while about to put the phone down. Negative: Nudity, direct exposure of nipples or underwear, explicit sexual poses, close-ups targeting specific parts, extreme body proportions, excessive chest emphasis, excessive skin correction, doll-like face, plastic-like skin, perfect bilateral symmetry, commercial shoot lighting, excessive background blur, horror, spiritual expressions, faces imitating real people or celebrities. Watermark direction: Not a post-processed '@Live_life_style' watermark, but like text information that originally existed at the event venue, naturally integrated into the photo. Integration method: Integrated into a translucent event ID box placed on the floor, or into the weak gloss printing of a black paper bag, embedding '@Live_life_style' while following the perspective and material wrinkles of the phone photo with slight distortion. Subtle visibility: Usually appears like brand printing, the character string can only be recognized by enlarging the image. Do not make it more conspicuous than the person. Placement: Placement on the paper bag, event ID, or transparent box surface at the bottom of the frame or on the background side. Do not place on the person's skin. Material behavior: If it is a paper bag, there is slight blurring of the printing ink; if it is a transparent box, it is accompanied by reflection and transmission. Do not make the text unnaturally sharp. Lighting interaction: Let the white LED and street light reflections of the venue act on the text in the same way, some parts can be faint or missing due to reflection. Perspective: Follow the angle, wrinkles, and wide-angle lens perspective of the small items to naturally deform the character string. Avoid: Avoid huge central logos, direct placement on the person's body, glowing text, subtitle-style overlays, or perfectly horizontal text that looks like it's pasted onto the photo.

items.title: 写实照片与简约水墨装饰画拼贴艺术

prompts.text:
Create ONE refined PHOTO + MINIMAL INK VIGNETTE artwork based ONLY on the uploaded photograph.

FORMAT: Vertical 3:4.

### TOP — ORIGINAL PHOTO
Use approximately the upper 48–50% for the original photograph.

Preserve the photo faithfully and photorealistically. Do not redraw, beautify, replace, remove, duplicate, or invent important elements.

Preserve:
- people, animals, faces, clothing, poses and gestures
- food and objects
- buildings and environment
- perspective, lighting, colors and atmosphere

Only crop or scale proportionally when necessary.

### BOTTOM — MINIMAL INK VIGNETTE
Use a warm ivory / natural off-white paper background.

Study THIS photograph independently and identify the ONE main visual subject or small group that best represents the moment.

Illustrate only what matters. Remove roughly 70–90% of unnecessary background detail.

Recognition should come mainly from:
silhouette + shape + color + pose + 1–3 distinctive details.

Keep the illustration relatively small with generous negative space.

### STYLE
Vintage editorial / classic printed vignette.

Use:
- thin controlled dark-ink outlines
- slightly imperfect hand-drawn contours
- simple geometric forms
- restrained flat colors
- subtle tonal variation
- minimal texture
- soft grounding shadow
- clean shape separation

Keep it charming, graphic, tidy, nostalgic and understated.

Use fewer strokes than a detailed sketch.

Avoid:
photorealistic illustration, watercolor, painterly brushwork, dense sketching, cross-hatching, excessive outlines, comic-book style, anime/chibi, 3D rendering, vector-perfect geometry, or unnecessary tiny details.

### TITLE + CAPTION
Above the illustration, create:

ONE short editorial title: approximately 2–4 words, inspired specifically by the photograph.

ONE micro-caption: approximately 3–8 words, natural and understated.

Never use generic titles such as “Beautiful Moment,” “Sweet Memories,” or “Wonderful Day.”

If a recognizable place, landmark, food, brand, event, or subject is clearly visible, its real name may be used. Never guess.

### INDEX
Add a tiny bottom-right label based on the main subject:

- Food/drink → PLATE NO. 01
- Animal → PORTRAIT NO. 01
- Person/group → MOMENT NO. 01
- Place/architecture/landscape → VIEW NO. 01
- Object/miscellaneous → STUDY NO. 01

For a person + pet, normally use MOMENT NO. 01.

### FINAL FEEL
A beautifully curated personal visual archive:

REAL PHOTOGRAPH ABOVE  
+ SIMPLIFIED MEMORY BELOW  
+ SHORT EDITORIAL TITLE  
+ TINY HUMAN CAPTION  
+ ADAPTIVE INDEX

Quiet, minimal, collectible, elegant, and consistent.

IMPORTANT: Analyze every uploaded photograph independently. Never carry over subjects, objects, locations, colors, captions, or details from previous images.

prompts.text:
仅根据上传的照片创建一件精美的“照片 + 简约水墨装饰画”艺术作品。

格式：纵向 3:4。

### 顶部 —— 原始照片
使用大约上方 48–50% 的区域放置原始照片。

忠实且写实地保留照片。不要重绘、美化、替换、删除、复制或捏造重要元素。

保留：
- 人物、动物、面部、服装、姿势和手势
- 食物和物品
- 建筑和环境
- 透视、光线、颜色和氛围

仅在必要时进行裁剪或等比例缩放。

### 底部 —— 简约水墨装饰画
使用温暖的象牙色/自然的米白色纸张背景。

独立研究这张照片，并确定最能代表那一刻的一个主要视觉主体或一小群主体。

仅描绘重要的部分。移除大约 70–90% 不必要的背景细节。

识别度应主要源于：
轮廓 + 形状 + 颜色 + 姿势 + 1–3 个独特细节。

保持插图相对较小，留有大量的留白。

### 风格
复古编辑风格 / 经典的印刷装饰画。

使用：
- 纤细受控的深色墨水轮廓
- 略显不完美的轻微手绘轮廓
- 简单的几何形状
- 克制的平面色彩
- 微妙的色调变化
- 极简的纹理
- 柔和的落地阴影
- 清晰的形状分离

保持其迷人、图形化、整洁、怀旧且内敛。

使用比详细素描更少的笔触。

避免：
写实插画、水彩、绘画般的笔触、密集的素描、交叉排线、过多的轮廓、漫画风格、动漫/Q版、3D 渲染、完美的矢量几何或不必要的微小细节。

### 标题 + 说明
在插图上方，创建：

一个简短的编辑标题：大约 2–4 个单词，灵感特别源自照片。

一个微型说明：大约 3–8 个单词，自然且内敛。

绝不使用通用标题，如 “Beautiful Moment”、“Sweet Memories” 或 “Wonderful Day”。

如果清晰可见可辨认的地点、地标、食物、品牌、事件或主体，可以使用其真实名称。绝不猜测。

### 索引
根据主要主体在右下角添加一个微小的标签：

- 食物/饮料 → PLATE NO. 01
- 动物 → PORTRAIT NO. 01
- 人物/群体 → MOMENT NO. 01
- 地点/建筑/景观 → VIEW NO. 01
- 物品/杂项 → STUDY NO. 01

对于人物 + 宠物，通常使用 MOMENT NO. 01。

### 最终感觉
一个精美策展的个人视觉档案：

上方是真实照片  
+ 下方是简化记忆  
+ 简短的编辑标题  
+ 微型的人文说明  
+ 自适应索引

安静、极简、具收藏价值、优雅且一致。

重要提示：独立分析每一张上传的照片。绝不沿用之前图像中的主体、物体、地点、颜色、说明或细节。

items.title: 高级纸本墨像旅行编辑海报

prompts.text:
Please turn every travel photo I upload into an individual high-end paper ink editorial poster, not a multi-image collage, with each photo outputted separately. The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical diptych layout, with the top half retaining the clearly visible real original photo and the bottom half transforming the same character into a "silk-like serpentine travel ink image"; the boundary between the upper and lower areas is horizontal, clear, and quiet, without using fogging transitions.

The upper part occupies about 45%–50% of the screen, faithfully retaining the original photo. Accurately maintain character identity, number, face shape, gaze, smile or expression, hairline, wind-blown hair strands, body posture, gestures, mobile phones or personal belongings, and the real relationship between characters and the travel environment. Perform only slight artistic publication color grading and extremely thin film grain processing, which must still be real photography. To adapt to the frame, the sky, water surface, or quiet background can be naturally extended, but do not redraw the face, change the posture, add or remove characters, stretch, mirror, or distort the main subject.

The bottom part should not fully replicate the photo scene, but rather reorganize the characters using a combination of reduced refinement and partial enlargement. The head or upper body occupies about 55%–78% of the width of the lower area, retaining the face shape, gaze, smile, hairline, and body direction that best confirm identity; mobile phones, hands, scarves, or travel objects leave only necessary clues. Delete complex backgrounds and organize the character together with two or three directions of wind, hair strands, clothing straps, smoke, or water flow from the original image into a paper ink image that is not "fully spoken."

Use fast brushwork, dry ink, flying white (feibai), broken ink, and extremely fine silk-like line drawing. Large areas of the face retain the warm white paper color, using only a few accurate ink lines to suggest features and outlines; black ink is mainly concentrated on the hair, collar, and a few weight-bearing structures. Extract two to three long and elastic serpentine or wind-shaped silk lines from the character's real hair strands, scarf, or environmental streamlines, letting the lines hover, pass through, or suddenly stop on the paper surface.

The "serpentine" here only refers to the rhythmic curves of calligraphy, and no real snakes, Medusa, horror narratives, mythical characters, or tattoo patterns appear.

The lower area retains at least 40% continuous warm white paper surface, and the ink lines can extend outward but must not fill the surroundings. Colors are dominated by black ink and paper white, and an extremely light warm gray, skin tone, or environmental color can be extracted from the original photo for washing, with very minimal usage, maintaining the paper fiber, ink density, bleeding edges, and the breathing of flying white.

Add a set of light and clear text in the paper white area. Extract 1–3 English word titles based on the real visible actions, wind, light, or character status in the photo, with the main title using a small brush inscription style; fields and observation sentences use fine pencil or light ink side notes. Add the field "INK NOTE 01" and an observation sentence of 5–12 English words.

If the location cannot be confirmed, use the title "WIND TRACE" and the observation sentence "Loose lines remember how the air once moved." The text does not impersonate the author's signature, and does not add names, fake seals, accounts, logos, QR codes, long paragraphs of text, or garbled code.

Overall, it should have the temperament of contemporary ink character research, travel sketches, and high-end editorial publications: restrained, light, with a sense of wind, where the characters are recognizable but not overwhelmed by details.

Avoid dense backgrounds, manga halftones, colorful decorations, realistic snakes, horror feelings, tattoo designs, pseudo-calligraphy signatures, fake seals, cheap national style templates, and full-screen ink filters.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张人物旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的高级纸本墨像编辑海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版双联构图，上方保留清楚可见的真实原图，下方将同一人物转绘为“游丝蛇形旅行墨像”；上下区域边界水平、清晰、安静，不使用雾化过渡。

上半部分约占画面45%–50%，忠实保留原始照片。准确保持人物身份、数量、脸型、目光、笑容或表情、发际、迎风发丝、身体姿态、手势、手机或随身物件，以及人物与旅行环境的真实关系。只进行轻微的艺术出版物调色和极薄胶片颗粒处理，仍必须是真实摄影。为适配画幅，可自然延展天空、水面或安静背景，但不得重画脸部、改变姿态、增删人物、拉伸、镜像或扭曲主体。

下半部分不要完整复刻照片场景，而采用缩小提炼与局部放大结合的方式重新组织人物。头像或半身占下区宽度约55%–78%，保留最能确认身份的脸型、目光、笑容、发际和身体方向；手机、手、围巾或旅行物件只留下必要线索。删除复杂背景，将人物与两三条来自原图的风、发丝、衣带、烟雾或水流方向共同组织成一幅未被说满的纸本墨像。

使用快速毛笔、干墨、飞白、断墨和极细游丝描表现。脸部大面积保留暖白纸色，只用少数准确墨线提示五官与轮廓；黑墨主要集中在头发、衣领和少量受力结构。从人物真实发丝、围巾或环境流线中提炼两至三条长而有弹性的蛇形或风形游丝，让线条在纸面上盘旋、穿行或突然停笔。

这里的“蛇形”只指书写性的曲线节奏，不出现真实蛇、美杜莎、恐怖叙事、神话角色或纹身图案。

下区至少保留40%连续暖白纸面，墨线可以向外延伸，但不得把四周填满。色彩以黑墨与纸白为主，可从原照片提取一处极淡暖灰、肤色或环境色洗染，用量极少，保持纸张纤维、墨色浓淡、渗化边缘与飞白呼吸。

在纸白处加入一组轻巧而清楚的文字。根据照片中真实可见的动作、风、光线或人物状态提炼1–3个英文单词标题，主标题使用小型毛笔题签；字段与观察句使用细铅笔或淡墨边注。加入字段“INK NOTE 01”与一行5–12个英文单词的观察句。

若无法确认地点，可使用标题“WIND TRACE”，观察句使用“Loose lines remember how the air once moved.”。文字不冒充作者落款，不加姓名、假印章、账号、Logo、二维码、长段文字或乱码。

整体应具有当代水墨人物研究、旅行速写与高级编辑出版物的气质：克制、轻盈、带风感，人物可辨却不被细节压满。

避免密集背景、漫画网点、多彩装饰、写实蛇、恐怖感、纹身设计、伪书法签名、假印章、廉价国风模板和全画面水墨滤镜。

items.title: 中轴夹景高级文化展览海报设计

prompts.text:
[Theme]: ____
[Chinese Main Title]: ____
[English Title]: ____
[Left Main Subject]: ____
[Right Main Subject]: ____
[Central Axis Content]: Title / Character / Plant / Negative Space / Others ____
[Clamping Method]: Circular Arc Negative Shape / Spatial Perspective / Flexible Material / Dual Object Weighting / Others ____
[Background Main Color]: ____
[Subject Material and Style]: ____
[Date / Venue]: ____
[Image Ratio]: 9:16

Generate a "central axis clamped" poster with strong visual impact and a high-end cultural exhibition temperament.

First, establish a clear and stable vertical central axis, then let the [Left Main Subject] and [Right Main Subject] jointly create visual weight from both sides of the frame, pushing the main title, characters, plants, or negative space areas towards the center.

The left and right subjects must be large enough, close to the edges of the frame, and allow for natural cropping, jointly bearing the primary visual weight. The two sides can differ in silhouette, size, color, material, and detail, but the overall visual weight must be balanced, avoiding simple duplication and mechanical mirroring.

Choose different clamping methods based on the theme:

Circular or arched subjects can use silhouettes to jointly clamp a central negative shape;
Architectural or screen spatial subjects can form depth in the central axis through perspective;
Flexible materials like fabrics or plants can form flexible clamping through natural bending;
Objects, characters, or cultural relics can strengthen the central title through left and right weighting.

The central axis must become the most important reading area of the frame. The Chinese main title uses a bold large font size, which can adopt vertical layout, mixed horizontal and vertical layout, scale changes, partial occlusion, or slight intersection with the subjects, letting Typography truly participate in the composition rather than being simply placed at the top.

Allow the central axis to include a low-weight visual node, such as a tiny character, flower branch, pattern rubbing, structural line drawing, or research diagram, giving the center both a focus and layering, but do not form a third subject of the same level.

Information density can be rich, but concentrated in 2–3 areas: the central axis core information, left and right sidebars, and bottom exhibition info. Form a clear font size contrast through oversized titles and tiny text; do not scatter small text evenly across the entire frame.

Use one clear large-area main color to establish recognition, such as cinnabar red, cobalt blue, lemon yellow, grass green, cyan blue, dark brown, or persimmon orange. Control the overall palette to 3–5 main colors, creating contrast through subject materials, Typography, and a very small amount of accent colors.

Core principle: It's not simple "bilateral symmetry," but using visual weight on both sides to jointly shape the center. The left and right are responsible for applying pressure, while the central axis is responsible for focusing; the structure is stable, but details allow for differences.

Overall requirements: Strong central axis, strong subjects, strong color gamut, clear sense of design, rich information but not chaotic, clear edges, distinct text, realistic materials, with the completion level of a mature cultural exhibition poster and Editorial Design.

先建立一条明确、稳定的垂直中轴，再让【左侧主体】与【右侧主体】从画面两侧共同形成视觉重量，把主标题、人物、植物或留白区域推向中央。

左右主体必须足够大，靠近画面边缘并允许自然裁切，共同承担主要视觉重量。两侧可以在轮廓、大小、颜色、材质和细节上不同，但整体视觉重量必须平衡，避免简单复制和机械镜像。

根据主题选择不同的夹景方式：

圆形、弧形主体可利用轮廓共同夹出中央负形；
建筑、屏风等空间主体可通过透视形成纵深中轴；
织物、植物等柔性材料可通过自然弯曲形成柔性夹景；
器物、人物或文物可通过左右配重强化中央标题。

中轴必须成为画面最重要的阅读区域。中文主标题使用大胆的大字号，可采用纵排、横竖混排、尺度变化、局部遮挡或与主体轻微穿插，让 Typography 真正参与构图，而不是普通放在顶部。

允许中轴加入一个低权重视觉节点，例如极小人物、花枝、纹样拓片、结构线稿或研究图，让中央既有焦点又有层次，但不要形成第三个同等级主体。

信息密度可以丰富，但集中在 2–3 个区域：中轴核心信息、左右边栏、底部展讯。通过超大标题与极小文字形成明显字号反差，不要把小字平均撒满整个画面。

使用一个明确的大面积主色建立识别度，例如朱红、钴蓝、柠檬黄、草绿、青蓝、深棕或柿子橙。整体控制在 3–5 个主要颜色，通过主体材质、Typography 和极少量点缀色形成对比。

核心原则：不是简单“左右对称”，而是利用两侧视觉重量共同塑造中心。左右负责施压，中轴负责聚焦；结构稳定，但细节允许不同。

整体要求：强中轴、强主体、强色域，设计感明确，信息丰富但不乱，边缘清晰，文字清楚，材质真实，具有成熟文化展览海报与 Editorial Design 的完成度。

prompts.text: Oriental Zen minimalist cover poster, bright female aesthetic, New Chinese style morning high-value cover. 9:16 vertical composition, the overall image is light, clear, clean, and bright, with a modern Oriental female aesthetic and Xiaohongshu cover feel. The main subject is a young adult Oriental ancient-style woman standing next to a huge circular lattice window. The figure is located in the lower right area of the frame, slightly turned, with a relaxed, quiet, and soft posture, carrying the ease of just waking up in the morning and a reserved temperament. The woman has delicate and refined features, Oriental aesthetic, a simple and elegant hair bun with a few small white flower ornaments and light drooping hair ribbons. The clothing is a light ancient-style long dress transitioning through pale white, pale apricot pink, and extremely light mint green; the fabric is soft and translucent, not overly gorgeous, without complex embroidery or heavy headpieces. The left hand naturally and lightly rests on the edge of the circular window, while the right hand hangs naturally holding a small branch of white flowers; hand structures are natural, proportions are accurate, without deformity or reversed hands. The scene is a minimalist white-walled interior space, with cream-white walls as the high-brightness main base; a large area of complete blank space is reserved on the left side of the frame, suitable for title layout. The circular lattice window is located from the top right to the middle of the frame, serving as the primary visual memory point. Outside the window, layers of mint green and light cyan-green plants, a soft morning mist air layer, extremely faint outlines of a distant courtyard or mountains, and an apricot-orange circular morning sun can be seen; the morning sun is located in the distance outside the window and is not stuck to the wall. Twigs outside the window may carry a few small white or extremely pale pink-white flowers, creating a gentle morning atmosphere. There are slight tree shadows projected on the wall and floor, enhancing the morning light atmosphere. The composition emphasizes large blank spaces and a stable cover feel: the circular window serves as the main visual in the upper part, the figure is in the lower right, and a complete title area is left on the left. Color control: cream white is used for the walls and overall base, mint green and light cyan-green are used for the plants and air layer outside the window, apricot orange is used only for the morning light and a very small amount of warm reflections, and the figure's clothing remains light white and pale apricot, avoiding a full-image teal-and-orange filter, and avoiding the image becoming gray, dirty, or old. The light is bright and soft natural morning light, with clear edges and a clean texture, just a slight paper feel is enough; no heavy ink wash feel, no gray fog, no old paper grain, no darkening. The overall temperament requires gentleness, relaxation, lightness, clarity, brightness, and cleanliness, with a female-oriented cover feel and Oriental lifestyle Zen. prompts.text:
Create a loose urban-sketch watercolour of a busy street crossing in {CITY}, vertical 3:4, on pure bright-white cold-press paper with visible texture. No cream, beige, sepia, or vintage tint.

TITLE: Paint only “{CITY}” across the empty upper sky in large expressive hand-lettering. Use translucent warm-grey watercolour with varied brush weight, darker pooling, dry-brush gaps, an irregular baseline, and slight tonal fade. It must look hand-painted with the same brush as the artwork, never printed or pasted. Add a subtle pale blue/apricot wash behind it, fading before the edges.

SCENE: Low-angle pavement view of a wide multi-lane crossing. Make {HERO} the dominant middle-distance landmark, with distinct {LEFT}, {RIGHT}, and smaller {FAR} buildings. Include {VEHICLE}, a few sedans, and one small {PUNCH} vehicle. Keep buildings clearly different in height, material, and colour.

LINEWORK: Rough black fineliner drawn first: loose, wobbly, broken freehand strokes, imperfect perspective, occasional overshoots, and minimal single-direction hatching. No perfectly ruled lines.

DEPTH: Strong density gradient. Foreground is about 60% resolved and colourful; mid-ground about 30% with softened edges; distance about 10%, mostly pale outlines and washes. Leave some distant buildings unpainted. The outer 20% of every edge and all four corners must remain untouched white paper. Never create an even wash or vignette.

ARCHITECTURE: Avoid complete window grids. {HERO} gets only a few broken mullion lines with large areas of wash-only glass. Its glass reflects broad sky-blue and white-paper sweeps, warm apricot sunlight, and only two soft warped building reflections.

PEOPLE: 10–12 figures scattered across near, middle, and far distances. Vary size, spacing, overlap, poses, and activities. Use tiny loose ink marks for distant figures; minimal facial detail; soft grey contact shadows; let some outlines dissolve into the washes.

GROUND: Darker visual weight in the bottom fifth: near kerb, sparse pavement joints, grit, and a cast shadow toward the viewer. Paint only portions of the crosswalk, leaving large areas of white paper.

COLOUR & LIGHT: Loose off-register watercolour over ink with wet-in-wet blooms, backruns, hard edges, and dry-brush skips. Use {WARM} for sunlit architecture/pavement, muted sage for trees, and cerulean for sky/glass. At least four distinct hues; no hue dominates. {PUNCH} is a tiny accent under 3%. White paper is the brightest value. Keep only 4–5 small deepest-value accents.

SKY & TREES: Mostly white sky with sparse broken blue strokes. Trees appear in separated clusters with wide white gaps; vary their size and treatment, including one large cropped foreground tree.

SIGNAGE: All signs are abstract and illegible. No readable text besides {CITY}.

AVOID: photorealism, digital/vector style, glossy 3D, uniform detail, full background washes, solid-black lettering, complete window grids, straight ruled geometry, continuous tree rows, detailed distant buildings, fully painted crosswalk, cream/sepia paper, borders, frames, signatures, logos, or watermarks.

prompts.text:
在纯亮白、有可见纹理的冷压纸上，创作一张{CITY}繁忙十字路口的松散城市速写水彩画，纵横比3:4。不要奶油色、米色、乌贼墨色或复古色调。

标题：仅在空旷的上部天空用大型且富有表现力的手写字体画出“{CITY}”。使用半透明的暖灰色水彩，笔触粗细多变，有较深的积水、干笔留白、不规则的基准线以及轻微的色调退色。它必须看起来是用与作品相同的画笔手绘的，绝不是印刷或粘贴的。在其背后添加微妙的淡蓝色/杏色晕染，并在边缘前淡出。

场景：宽阔多车道交叉口的人行道低角度视图。让{HERO}成为中景的主导地标，伴有明显的{LEFT}、{RIGHT}和较小的{FAR}建筑。包含{VEHICLE}、几辆轿车和一辆小型{PUNCH}车辆。保持建筑在高度、材质和颜色上明显不同。

线条：先用粗糙的黑色针管笔勾勒：松散、摇晃、断裂的徒手笔触，不完美的透视，偶尔的留白，以及极少的单向排线。不要完美的尺子线条。

深度：强烈的密度梯度。前景约60%的清晰度和色彩；中景约30%且边缘软化；远景约10%，主要是浅色轮廓和晕染。让一些远处建筑物不着色。每个边缘的外部20%和所有四个角必须保持空白的白纸。切勿创建均匀的晕染或暗角。

建筑：避免完整的窗格网格。{HERO}只得到几条断裂的窗棂线，大面积仅是晕染的玻璃。其玻璃反射出宽阔的天蓝色和白纸扫尾、温暖的杏色阳光，以及仅有的两个柔软扭曲的建筑物反射。

人物：10–12个形象分散在近、中、远距离。改变大小、间距、重叠、姿势和活动。对远处的人物使用微小的松散墨迹；极简的面部细节；软灰色接触阴影；让一些轮廓溶解在晕染中。

地面：底部五分之一处视觉重量较重：近处的路缘、稀疏的铺路接缝、砂砾以及朝向观察者的投射阴影。仅绘制部分斑马线，留出大面积白纸。

色彩与光影：墨线上方是松散错位的水彩，带有湿接湿的晕染、回流、硬边缘和干笔跳跃。对受光的建筑/路面使用{WARM}，对树木使用柔和的鼠尾草绿，对天空/玻璃使用天蓝色。至少四种截然不同的色调；没有主导色调。{PUNCH}是低于3%的微小点缀。白纸是最亮的明度。仅保留4–5个小的最深明度重点。

天空与树木：主要是白色天空，带有稀疏断裂的蓝色笔触。树木以分开的集群形式出现，有宽阔的白色缝隙；改变它们的大小和处理方式，包括一棵大型裁剪后的前景树。

标识：所有指示牌都是抽象且不可辨认的。除了{CITY}外没有可读文字。

避免：写实主义、数字/矢量风格、光泽3D、均匀的细节、完整的背景晕染、实色黑色字体、完整的窗格网格、直线尺规几何、连续的树排、详细的远景建筑、完全绘制的斑马线、奶油/乌贼墨色纸张、边框、框架、签名、徽标或水印。

prompts.text:
Please turn each travel photo I upload into an individual premium travel record visual archive poster, no multi-image stitching, output each photo separately.

Overall 3:4 vertical composition, forming a clearly visible contrast between the original image and the visual translation of the record. The upper part accounts for about 45%–50% of the frame, the lower part about 50%–55%, the two parts use a clear, horizontal, and restrained boundary, no fogging, no feathering, no mutual penetration. Only output the front of the poster, do not generate desktop, wall, handheld displays or other mockup environments.

The upper part faithfully retains the original photo. Accurately maintain the identity and number of subjects, the posture of people or vehicles, the structure of buildings and terrain, the observation angle, spatial relationships, real textures, natural light and shadow, and the original color atmosphere. Only perform slight premium photography color grading and extremely thin film grain processing, giving the photo the quality of travel magazines, independent music publications, and photography exhibitions.

To adapt to the frame, the sky, ground, water surface, or surrounding environment can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, mirrored, moved, replaced, or redrawn. The upper part must still be a clearly identifiable real photography work, not becoming an illustration, record cover, or blurred background.

The lower part translates the same travel photo into a sophisticated record collection visual system on a warm white or light ivory uncoated paper surface.

Fixedly adopt a 2×2 staggered display composed of four items:

Top left: front cover;
Top right: Side A colored vinyl record;
Bottom left: Side B colored vinyl record;
Bottom right: back cover.

The four items should have clear size relationships and a stable editorial grid, but should not be arranged like a stiff product catalog. The sizes of the front and back covers are close, and the size, color, transparency, and groove structure of the two records remain consistent, showing Side A and Side B of the same record respectively. Do not add a third record, nor merge the front and back covers into the same item.

The front cover must directly use the most recognizable real local crop from the original photo. Retain the core buildings, figures, vehicles, terrain, plants, sky, water surface, or other main subjects in the photo, so that it can be matched with the original image above at a glance.

The back cover uses another effective crop of the same original photo, or re-selects a visual focus for the same scene. It can echo the front cover in terms of distance, whole and part, or subject and environment, but must not redraw the photo, replace the location, stitch in similar landscapes, or invent content that does not exist in the original image.

Secondary information is allowed to be removed through cropping, scale changes, and whitespace, but the identity, number, direction of subjects, building structures, terrain relationships, and iconic colors in the cover must be faithful to the original image. The cover cannot use generic record illustrations or abstract patterns unrelated to the photo to replace real travel imagery.

The front and back covers adopt a design combining photos and editorial whitespace. The photo can be cropped and placed on one side of the cover, keeping about 25%–40% of the light-colored paper surface on the other side for titles, numbers, and short sentences. The covers should have realistic paper thickness, cut edges, uncoated paper fibers, slight wear, tiny printing deviations, and natural short shadows.

The two records use the same representative color extracted from the original photo as the base color, which can present a slight translucent, smoky, frosted, or soft pearlescent effect. Express realistic and fine record grooves, center holes, center labels, and edge thickness, but avoid plastic CGI and excessive highlights.

The center labels of Side A and Side B must use the same typography system, title, and numbering, only writing the side designation as 'SIDE A' and 'SIDE B' respectively. The two records must obviously belong to the same set of records, and there should be no inconsistency in color, size, or design language.

The overall color scheme is entirely extracted from the original photo. Select one color from the photo that is most representative and best reflects the temperament of the location as the main color of the record, and then complete the cover design with shades of the same color, analogous colors, and one small area of emphasis color. Summarize, purify, and soften complex colors into a limited color palette, maintaining the warm and cold relationship of the original scene, without applying fixed vinyl record color templates.

Add a small amount of clearly readable English text on the cover and record center label. Based on the real and confirmable location, subject, weather, action, or atmosphere in the photo, extract a main title of 1–3 English words, and add the following text structure:

Main Title: determined word by word based on the photo content;
Serial Number: 'TRAVEL RECORD 01', numbered sequentially for multiple photos;
Side Designation: 'SIDE A' and 'SIDE B';
Observation Sentence: one line of 5–12 English words, describing the light, color, action, or spatial relationship actually visible in the photo.

Text must be determined word by word before generation. When the location cannot be confirmed, use the scene or emotional theme, do not fabricate cities, building names, dates, coordinates, artists, or release information.

The font uses a delicate narrow serif paired with restrained small sans-serif. The main title should be clearly readable in a normal chat preview, the number and observation sentence can be smaller, but cannot be shrunk into decorative gray lines. The text should look like it is truly printed on the cover paper and record center label, allowing for slight ink bleeding, paper ink absorption, and printing registration deviations.

The four items in the lower part account for about 62%–78% of the area, with a continuous and complete warm white paper surface reserved on the periphery. There should be sufficient distance between the four items, and they must not obscure key photos, record center labels, or text. Whitespace needs to participate in the composition, giving the entire set of records a sense of being carefully displayed and collected.

The overall style refers to premium record covers, independent music publications, travel photography archives, and collectible editorial design. Let the colors, rhythms, and scenes in the photo be translated into a set of travel records that can be viewed repeatedly, rather than simply pasting the photo onto a record template.

Avoid: missing the original photo at the top, original image shrunk into a decorative thumbnail, using different locations for top and bottom, cover redrawn as illustration, fictional landscapes, changing buildings, a third record, inconsistency between Side A and Side B, records obscuring covers, black fixed record templates, perspective desktops, e-commerce product mockups, handheld displays, glossy plastic 3D, fictional artists, fictional record labels, brand logos, URLs, QR codes, unreadable tracklists, garbled text, author names, account handles, and watermarks.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的高级旅行唱片视觉档案海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。

整体采用3:4竖版构图，形成清楚可见的原图与唱片视觉转译对比。上半部分约占画面45%–50%，下半部分约占50%–55%，两部分使用清晰、水平、克制的边界，不雾化、不羽化、不互相渗透。只输出海报正面，不生成桌面、墙面、手持展示或其他Mockup环境。

上半部分忠实保留原始照片。准确保持主体身份与数量、人物或交通工具姿态、建筑与地形结构、观察角度、空间关系、真实材质、自然光影和原有色彩氛围。仅进行轻微高级摄影调色与极薄胶片颗粒处理，使照片具有旅行杂志、独立音乐出版物和摄影展览质感。

为适配画幅，可自然延展天空、地面、水面或周边环境，但不得拉伸、扭曲、镜像、移动、替换或重画主体。上半部分必须仍然是一张清楚可辨的真实摄影作品，不能变成插画、唱片封面或模糊背景。

下半部分在暖白或浅象牙色的无涂布纸面上，把同一张旅行照片转译为一套精致的唱片收藏视觉系统。

固定采用四件物组成的2×2错落陈列：

左上：唱片正面封套；
右上：Side A彩色黑胶唱片；
左下：Side B彩色黑胶唱片；
右下：唱片背面封套。

四件物应具有清楚的大小关系和稳定的编辑网格，但不能排列得像僵硬的商品目录。正面封套与背面封套尺寸接近，两张唱片尺寸、颜色、透明度和沟槽结构保持一致，分别展示同一张唱片的A面与B面。不得增加第三张唱片，也不得把正反封套合并成同一件物品。

正面封套必须直接使用原照片中最具识别度的真实局部裁切。保留照片中的核心建筑、人物、交通工具、地形、植物、天空、水面或其他主要主体，使其一眼能够与上方原图对应。

背面封套使用同一张原照片的另一处有效裁切，或者对同一场景重新选择视觉重点。它可以与正面封套形成远近、整体与局部、主体与环境之间的呼应，但不得重绘照片、替换地点、拼入相似景观或发明原图不存在的内容。

允许通过裁切、比例变化与留白删去次要信息，但封套中的主体身份、数量、方向、建筑结构、地形关系和标志性色彩必须忠实于原图。封套不能使用通用唱片插画或与照片无关的抽象图案替代真实旅行影像。

正反封套采用照片与编辑留白结合的设计。可将照片裁切放置在封套的一侧，在另一侧保留约25%–40%的浅色纸面，用于标题、编号和短句。封套应具有真实纸张厚度、裁切边缘、无涂布纸纤维、轻微磨损、细小印刷偏差和自然短投影。

两张唱片使用从原照片中提取的同一种代表性色彩作为基色，可以呈现轻微半透明、烟熏、磨砂或柔和珠光效果。表现真实而细密的唱片沟槽、中心孔、中心纸标与边缘厚度，但避免塑料CGI和过度高光。

Side A与Side B的中心标必须使用相同的排版系统、标题和编号，只将面别分别写为“SIDE A”与“SIDE B”。两张唱片必须明显属于同一套唱片，不能出现颜色、尺寸或设计语言不一致的问题。

整体配色完全从原始照片中提取。选择照片里最有代表性、最能体现地点气质的一种颜色作为唱片主色，再以同色深浅、邻近色和一处小面积强调色完成封套设计。将复杂色彩归纳、提纯和柔化为有限色盘，保持原场景的冷暖关系，不套用固定的黑胶唱片配色模板。

在封套和唱片中心标上加入少量清楚可读的英文文字。根据照片中真实可确认的地点、主体、天气、动作或氛围，提炼一个1–3个英文单词的主标题，并加入以下文字结构：

主标题：根据照片内容逐字确定；
编号：“TRAVEL RECORD 01”，多张照片依次编号；
唱片面别：“SIDE A”与“SIDE B”；
观察句：一行5–12个英文单词，描述照片中真实可见的光线、颜色、动作或空间关系。

文字必须在生成前逐字确定。无法确认地点时，使用场景或情绪主题，不得编造城市、建筑名称、日期、坐标、艺人或发行信息。

字体采用细腻的窄体衬线搭配克制的小号无衬线。主标题应在正常聊天预览中清楚可读，编号和观察句可以较小，但不能缩成装饰性灰线。文字应像真正印在封套纸张和唱片中心标上，允许轻微油墨渗化、纸张吸墨和印刷套色偏差。

prompts.text: Generate a visual poster with an Oriental aesthetic based on specific thematic content. The core image uses a large area of clean white space as the main stage. The thematic subject is refined into a slender, restrained, handcrafted line-drawn main shape, placed to one side within the white space area. The lines have rhythmic density, resembling both natural forms and informational symbols. The exterior of the white space is surrounded by a field of continuous undulating bas-relief textures. The textures are like layers of surging material surfaces, forming a soft enclosure from the edges toward the center, partially obscuring and holding up the thematic space, making the void appear opened rather than empty. Add a few tiny figures in postures of labor, walking, or operating as scale points and narrative points within the scene. The contrast between light and dark is clear, scattered among the undulating textures, creating a quiet tension between macro-textures and micro-actions. A strong title and secondary information layers are set at the top. The title has a thick font weight and expands horizontally. Subtitles and explanatory text use small letter spacing to create a sense of order, retaining only necessary information so that the text does not take away from the central white space. Colors are extracted from the material, season, and cultural mood of the theme itself, mapped into large areas of high-brightness clean base colors, low-saturation structural textures, clear but sparse informational colors, and small areas of dark scale points, maintaining a bright, clear, gentle, and ritualistic mood. The texture has paper embossing and fine-line engraved qualities, but the light is airy and the color levels are clean, avoiding muddy aging effects. The overall emphasis is on labor within stillness, order within emptiness, and the combination of graphics and text to form a restrained yet memorable modern Oriental information visual.

MAIN COLORS: [deep indigo + crimson / jade teal + ivory / dusky violet + lavender]
OUTFIT: [hanfu colors and fabric]
MOOD: [serene / elegant / dreamy / restrained]
ASPECT RATIO: 1:3 ultra-vertical

Create a highly detailed Chinese-inspired portrait in an elegant 1:3 ultra-vertical format, with the visual feeling of a long illustrated bookmark rather than a standard poster.

Keep the character as the clear focal point, occupying around 75–80% of the image height. The hairstyle, hands, flowing sleeves and main skirt should remain fully visible inside the frame. The figure should feel prominent but still leave enough breathing room for flowers and background.

Build the composition vertically: floral branches or hanging blossoms frame the upper and side areas, the face becomes the main focal point in the upper-middle section, and the long sleeves, draped fabric and skirt continue the visual flow downward.

Use flowers as part of the composition rather than simple decoration. Create clear foreground, middle-ground and background layers, with a few branches or petals crossing naturally in front of the figure without covering the face.

Dress the character in layered flowing hanfu with elegant long sleeves and refined fabric textures. Use fine, continuous gold linework to trace key garment edges, major folds, sleeve curves and the downward flow of the skirt. The gold lines should follow the natural structure of the fabric, never becoming thick borders or dense all-over decoration.

Combine refined gongbi-inspired figure rendering with rich mineral-pigment color fields, rock-painting texture, subtle palette-knife impasto and restrained scattered gold dust. Keep the face, hands, hair and clothing cleaner and more delicate, while allowing the background to carry stronger texture.

Use deep, saturated background colors to make the lighter figure stand out. Add only small amounts of muted gold leaf, luminous particles and fine gold accents to connect the flowers, accessories and clothing.

The final image should feel elegant, painterly, luxurious and handcrafted, with strong vertical rhythm and enough detail to work as a standalone artwork, illustrated bookmark, editorial visual or cultural-brand image.

No text, no title, no logo, no numbering, no border, no product mockup, no visible bookmark hole or tassel, no modern poster layout, no CGI look, no dirty distressed texture.

prompts.text:
Create a close handheld smartphone selfie of a clearly adult young woman, 18+, standing on the open rooftop of an older urban building near sunset. Use a vertical frame of roughly 9:16, cropped from the top of her head to around the waist. Hold the phone slightly below eye level, approximately around shoulder or upper-chest height, looking gently upward from very close distance. One arm extends prominently from the lower-left foreground toward the phone and becomes noticeably larger because of the wide-angle perspective. Preserve this imperfect close-range selfie foreshortening.

She has a highly recognizable messy black chin-to-neck-length bob, with loose volume at the crown and irregular ends that flip both inward and outward. Long broken bangs are being pushed around by rooftop wind, falling directly across her eyes, nose bridge and cheeks. Some strands obscure parts of the eyes. Do not clean those strands away. Preserve the frizz, uneven separation and tiny flyaways, because the wind-disrupted hair is essential to the identity of the photograph. Backlighting should turn the thinnest hair edges partially translucent with muted warm-brown and pale-gold highlights.

Keep the facial proportions soft and natural: a gently oval face, realistic jawline, small nose and subtle facial asymmetry. She looks toward the smartphone through gaps in her bangs with a quiet, restrained, faintly detached gaze. Her lips remain naturally closed, with only the smallest lift at the corners—almost a smile, but not a deliberate posed smile.

Use extremely subtle everyday makeup inspired by casual East Asian urban selfie aesthetics with understated Japanese/Korean natural-makeup cues: sheer realistic complexion, faint natural blush, almost invisible eyeliner, natural lashes, softly shaped brows and muted nude-pink or natural rose lips. Avoid glamorous contouring, dramatic eyeliner, smoky eyes or saturated red lipstick.

She wears a muted gray-green, sage-gray, gray-olive or gray-khaki ribbed spaghetti-strap fitted top, possibly the upper portion of a fitted knit dress. The straps are very thin, the neckline is a low rounded scoop, and the fabric has dense vertical ribbing. Let the knit naturally follow the torso, causing the ribs to curve and stretch subtly across the body with tiny authentic folds and tension. It should look like soft ribbed cotton knit, never latex, plastic or rigid synthetic material.

Visible skin includes the face, neck, both shoulders, collarbones, upper chest and neckline area, both arms, a small amount near the underarm and part of the waist/upper abdomen. Maintain natural anatomy without deliberately exaggerating body proportions. Skin is fair and warm-neutral, with faint peach and pale golden warmth from the sunset. It should visually feel soft, warm, smooth and slightly elastic to the touch, while still showing believable skin thickness, slight tone variation, tiny pores and subtle imperfections. Avoid waxy, porcelain or completely poreless AI skin.

The most important photographic element is the very low golden-hour sun positioned directly behind her left shoulder. It is already near the roofline and almost touches the outline of her shoulder and neck. Physically this creates strong backlight and side-backlight: the left shoulder, jaw edge, neck and hair receive warm golden edge illumination, while areas closest to the sun can naturally lift toward pale overexposure. Introduce a small amount of real lens flare and reduced contrast around the sun.

The front of her face should not be artificially lit. Instead, the bright open sky acts like a giant natural softbox, gently filling the frontal facial planes so the features remain visible despite the strong backlight. Avoid ring lights, flash, studio fill and engineered cinematic rim lighting.

Keep the background as a rough industrial urban rooftop. Place a large cylindrical stainless-steel rooftop water/storage tank behind her on the right, along with weathered pale concrete walls, aged metal pipes, visible utility cables crossing the frame, rust marks, rooftop equipment and worn dusty flooring. The sky should approach bright white because of backlit exposure, while the industrial structures remain flatter and more gray. Do not clean up the wires, pipes or weathering. Do not transform the location into a luxury rooftop, minimalist terrace, pool deck or fashion set.

Render it as an authentic front-camera smartphone image with roughly a 24–28mm full-frame-equivalent wide-angle feel. Use medium-to-deep smartphone depth of field: the subject remains clear while the rooftop tank, wall and pipes are still recognizable rather than dissolved into creamy portrait blur. Allow mild digital noise in darker areas, slight bloom around backlit hair, localized lens flare, clipped highlights around the sun and imperfect dynamic range. Do not use aggressive HDR or strong computational portrait-mode background separation.

The photograph should feel like a moment that had already happened at the end of the day: she had just stepped onto the rooftop as the sun was sinking behind the buildings. The wind kept pushing her short hair across her eyes, and she did not bother fixing it. She simply extended the phone and looked briefly toward the lens; at that exact moment the sunlight slipped through behind her shoulder. The image preserves the wind, the rooftop heat and the last warmth of the disappearing sun rather than a perfected pose.

Overall aesthetic: urban rooftop, messy black bob, muted gray-green clothing, golden-hour backlight, subtle early-2000s Asian internet-photo sensibility blended with contemporary casual social-media selfie realism. Quiet, slightly cool and relaxed, with just enough warm sunset light to soften the mood.

Negative prompt: long hair, perfectly groomed bob, clean bangs, hair removed from eyes, heavy makeup, dramatic eyeliner, red lipstick, sharp jawline, extreme face slimming, exaggerated anatomy, exaggerated chest, plastic skin, poreless skin, luxury rooftop, clean minimal background, missing wires, missing industrial tank, midday lighting, blue hour, night scene, ring light, studio lighting, artificial rim light, aggressive HDR, strong portrait blur, perfect symmetry, CGI, 3D render.
