prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览图像质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分先理解原照片最值得被记住的**主体、基本构图、透视关系、结构走势、视觉记忆点与整体气氛**，再重构为具有材料拼贴感的极简像素景观。不要完整复制照片，而是删去无关细节，只保留最能代表原物的结构、走势和视觉记忆点，通过规则方块的秩序与天然材料质感重新概括，使人能够一眼识别它与上方照片之间的对应关系。

像素模块不是标准数字色块，而像由**粗粝贝壳、贝壳薄片或天然矿物壳层切割而成的小型方形与近方形碎片**。保持明确的几何网格秩序，但边缘可略有崩缺、不完全规整，表面带天然层理、粉质颗粒、轻微凹凸、磨损与不均匀色泽，以哑光、自然、温和的材料感为主。主体核心区域由相对密集的模块聚合成形，边缘逐步减少、缺失、断开和漂浮，让形态从清晰向留白中自然逸散。严格控制模块总量，整体不超过200块，单个模块大小统一或接近统一，避免细碎噪点、标准马赛克和游戏像素感。

构图保持**小尺度章印与大面积留白**的关系，根据主体自身的方向、比例和视觉重心自由安排位置，可偏心、贴边、悬置或局部裁切。主体约占下半部分30%–45%，其余空间主动留空。留白不是空背景，而是与主体、模块密度和消隐边界同等重要的构成元素，通过正负形、疏密、聚散和不对称平衡建立呼吸感、空间感与停顿感。宁可删减信息，也不要填满画面，让主体像一枚被精心安放在大片纸面上的材料章印。

配色从上方照片中提取**最明亮、最鲜活、最有生命力的颜色重新调制**，而不是平均取色或忠实复制原始色值。整体适度提高明度、纯净度与通透感，根据原图自然推导出清澈天空蓝、湖水青、嫩绿、暖黄、珊瑚橙、桃粉等明快综合色，通过清爽冷暖关系形成温暖而治愈的色彩节奏。以大量纯净暖白或与原图综合色温协调的极浅近白色作为呼吸空间，主色明亮、有精神但不刺眼，局部暖橙、金黄、珊瑚红或柔粉可作为阳光般的点睛色。保留贝壳材料自身轻微天然色差与层理，但避免因此变灰、变旧或变脏。避免灰脏、发旧、低沉莫兰迪化、暗褐滤镜、阴郁大地色、荧光色和廉价糖果感。

文字只作极少量编辑性介入，不限制语种，也不预设固定标题或编号。可从照片的主体、地点、动作、情绪或隐喻中自由提炼少量字词或短句，安静地置于留白或主体边缘，与材料模块形成精致的图文关系，不喧宾夺主。

整体呈现**天然材料拼贴、贝壳质感像素、规则几何秩序、渐进消隐、小尺度章印、大面积艺术留白与现代编辑排版**共同构成的高级视觉效果，更像当代材料艺术与设计工作室的重构海报，而不是普通数字像素画。避免完整复制照片、复杂背景、真实细节、标准纯色色块、光滑矢量、塑料马赛克、强珠光、游戏UI感、画面填满、过多文字和模板化效果。

items.title: 高端时尚社论海报排版设计

prompts.text:
TITLE: [VOLUME / ANGLE / FOLD / CUT / your own title]
MODEL: [model appearance, hairstyle, attitude]
GARMENT: [sculptural couture / architectural tailoring / oversized outerwear / flowing fashion]
TYPE INTERACTION: [overlap / cut through / frame / conceal / pass through / wrap around]
PALETTE: [neutral base + black + one strong accent color]
FORMAT: 9:16 vertical poster

Create a premium high-fashion editorial poster where the model, garment, typography and negative space are designed as one composition.

Start with a strong fashion silhouette rather than a conventional standing pose. Give the model a confident, detached editorial attitude and a clear body gesture such as a long stride, torso twist, asymmetric stance or controlled mid-motion pose. The clothing should have a distinctive sculptural shape through oversized volume, architectural shoulders, exaggerated draping, sharp tailoring or large folded fabric planes. Prioritize silhouette and garment structure over simple facial beauty.

Keep the studio environment minimal and refined, using a clean ivory, stone grey or muted neutral background. Build the palette around strong black-and-white contrast with only one controlled accent color such as cobalt blue, scarlet red or muted coral. Keep skin tones natural and realistic, with visible fabric texture, believable folds and polished fashion lighting.

Typography must actively participate in the image rather than sit beside the photograph. Use one dominant oversized word or letterform with extreme scale, paired with very small editorial copy. Let the type overlap the body, disappear behind clothing, reappear through negative space, cross between the model’s limbs, become a frame, or function like an architectural structure the model moves through. Partial cropping and controlled obstruction are encouraged as long as the main word remains recognizable.

Mix one strong display typeface with restrained supporting typography: high-contrast serif, bold grotesk sans serif, small clean sans serif or a subtle italic serif. Keep secondary copy sparse and purposeful. Avoid filling every empty area with text.

Maintain generous negative space, asymmetric balance, strong silhouette readability and a clear visual hierarchy. The first impression should come from one memorable visual event: a giant letter containing the model, typography slicing across a black silhouette, sculptural fabric interrupting a word, or oversized type interacting with a moving body.

The finished image should feel like sophisticated contemporary fashion art direction — bold, elegant, graphic, expensive and editorial, with the polish of a premium magazine cover or fashion campaign.

prompts.text:
标题：[音量 / 角度 / 褶皱 / 切割 / 你的自定义标题]
模型：[模特外观、发型、态度]
服装：[雕塑般的时装 / 建筑风格裁剪 / 超大外套 / 流动的时尚]
文字交互：[重叠 / 切穿 / 框架 / 隐藏 / 穿过 / 缠绕]
色调：[中性底色 + 黑色 + 一种强烈的强调色]
格式：9:16 垂直海报

创作一张高端时尚社论海报，将模特、服装、排版和负空间设计成一个统一的构图。

以强烈的时尚廓形开始，而不是常规的站姿。赋予模特自信、冷淡的社论态度和清晰的身体姿势，例如长跨步、躯干扭转、不对称姿态或受控的中期动作姿势。服装应通过超大体积、建筑感肩部、夸张的垂坠感、锋利的裁剪或巨大的折叠面料平面呈现出独特的雕塑形状。优先考虑轮廓和服装结构，而非简单的面部美感。

保持工作室环境极简且精致，使用洁净的象牙色、石灰色或柔和的中性背景。围绕强烈的黑白对比构建色调，仅使用一种受控的强调色，如钴蓝色、猩红色或柔和的珊瑚色。保持肤色自然真实，具有可见的面料纹理、可信的褶皱和精致的时尚照明。

排版必须积极地参与到图像中，而不是坐在照片旁边。使用一个具有极端比例的主导超大单词或字母形状，并搭配非常小的社论副本。让文字重叠在身体上、消失在服装后面、通过负空间重新出现、在模特的肢体之间穿插、成为框架，或像模特穿行的建筑结构一样发挥作用。只要主词保持可识别，鼓励部分裁剪和受控的遮挡。

将一种强烈的展示型字体与克制的辅助排版混合：高对比度的衬线体、粗体无衬线体、小的干净无衬线体或微妙的斜体衬线体。保持次要副本稀疏且有目的。避免在每个空白区域都填满文字。

保持充裕的负空间、不对称平衡、强烈的轮廓可读性和清晰的视觉层次。第一印象应该来自一个令人难忘的视觉事件：包含模特的巨型字母、切开黑色轮廓的排版、干扰单词的雕塑感织物，或与移动身体互动的超大文字。

最终图像应具有精致的当代时尚艺术指导感——大胆、优雅、图形化、昂贵且具有社论感，并具有高端杂志封面或时尚活动的精致度。

items.title: 摄影几何解构模块化艺术海报设计

prompts.text:
Please turn each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-photo stitching, each photo output separately. Use a 3:4 vertical composition overall, with the top and bottom areas strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the screen.

The top half retains the original photo, maintaining the subject's identity, structure, posture, realistic texture, natural lighting, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end color grading to give it the quality of art magazines, independent publications, and exhibition images. To fit the frame, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The bottom half extracts the most recognizable subject, outline, structure, posture, and narrative relationship of the photo, and reconstructs them into blocky, modular geometric deconstruction illustrations. Do not fully copy the photo, nor paint realistically; instead, remove irrelevant details and only keep the visual memory points that best represent the original object's identity and temperament. Re-establish the image through geometric generalization, shape overlapping, and collage-style reorganization, so that people can recognize the correspondence between it and the photo above at a glance.

The overall styling emphasizes a sense of blocks, modules, geometric segmentation, and complete large facets. Geometric splitting should not be too fragmented; do not cut into a large number of scattered small pieces, but organize the subject with fewer, larger, and more complete rectangles, squares, rounded corners, ellipses, triangles, and irregular blocks. People can be expressed with square faces, clear jawlines, and blocky facial features; buildings can be transformed into square volumes, facade partitions, window rhythms, and structural turns; animals, plants, objects, and landscapes should also be refined into geometric forms with blocky order and modular relationships. Moderate exaggeration and deformation are allowed, but the overall result must be mature, restrained, and concise, avoiding trivialization, infantilization, and being too scattered.

The overall styling adopts flat color blocks + collage-style composition + modernist geometric language. Color blocks are re-stitched like pieces of paper, forming a vivid but orderly collage feel; complex backgrounds are actively deleted, leaving only a few necessary shapes or auxiliary blocks, without forming a second visual center.

The composition maintains a relationship of small-scale subjects / large areas of white space, freely arranging positions according to the subject's own direction, proportion, visual focus, and structural trend. It can be off-center, edge-aligned, or partially cropped, but always maintain clear primary and secondary roles, rhythmic density, and editorial balance. The overall image emphasizes positive and negative shapes, block weight, breathing white space, and layout order, giving the bottom half both a sense of art and the temperament of high-end publications.

The material presents gentle paper grain and a slight printmaking feel: retain fine paper texture, soft noise, and a slight printing texture on top of the geometric color blocks, making the image closer to paper collage or art print works. Avoid smooth vectors, 3D rendering, photo filters, and over-refinement.

The color scheme extracts 2–4 of the most recognizable, pleasing colors that best embody the subject's temperament from the photo above and reorganizes them into a more high-end color system. The overall palette can be moderately brightened, purified, and desaturated, transformed into lighter, modern, and durable color block relationships such as creamy white, apricot, peach pink, coral orange, misty blue, gray-green, sage green, warm brown, and soft purple. The main colors are vivid but not harsh, the auxiliary colors are gentle and layered, and the overall temperament is clean, warm, fashionable, and approachable, avoiding earthy yellow, dirty gray, dark brown, fluorescent colors, cheap candy feelings, and cluttered color schemes.

A small amount of text intervenes, with no language restrictions. Short titles, small annotations, numbers, or explanatory fragments can be freely refined based on the subject's identity, location, mood, temperament, or symbolic meaning. The text should be small, light, and restrained, naturally falling in white space or layout corners, forming an exquisite graphic-text relationship with the graphics, without stacking commercial titles.

The overall presentation features geometric deconstruction of complete large blocks, restrained collage, soft high-end color schemes, paper grain, large areas of white space, and editorial layout forming a visual effect together. Whether the subject is a person, building, animal, plant, object, or natural landscape, it should maintain a clear identity, modular geometric order, and a unified artistic language. Avoid realistic depiction, over-fragmented cutting, naive collage, complex perspective, overly dense details, cartoonish feel, 3D feel, templated poster feel, and cheap cultural and creative feel.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览图像质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的**主体、轮廓、结构、姿态与叙事关系**，重构为**方块化、模块化的几何解构插画**。不要完整复制照片，也不要写实描摹，而是删去无关细节，只保留最能代表原物身份与气质的视觉记忆点，通过几何概括、形状叠压与拼贴式重组重新建立形象，使人能够一眼识别它与上方照片之间的对应关系。

整体造型强调**方块感、模块感、几何切分与完整大块面**。几何拆分不要过碎，不要切成大量零散小块，而应以更少、更大、更完整的矩形、方形、圆角方块、椭圆、三角形和不规则块面组织主体。人物可表现为方形面部、清晰下颌线与块面五官；建筑可转化为方整体量、立面分区、窗洞节奏与结构转折；动物、植物、器物和景观也应提炼为具有方块秩序与模块关系的几何形体。允许适度夸张与变形，但整体必须成熟、克制、简洁，避免琐碎化、幼稚化和拼得太散。

整体造型采用**扁平色块 + 拼贴感构成 + 现代主义几何语言**。色块像纸片一样被重新拼接，形成鲜明但有秩序的剪贴感；复杂背景主动删除，只保留少量必要形状或辅助块面，不形成第二视觉中心。

构图保持**小尺度主体 / 大面积留白**的关系，根据主体自身的方向、比例、视觉重心与结构走势自由安排位置，可偏心、贴边或局部裁切，但始终保持清晰主次、疏密节奏与编辑式平衡。画面整体重视正负形、块面轻重、留白呼吸与版式秩序，让下半部分既有艺术感，也有高级出版物气质。

材质呈现**温和纸张颗粒与轻微版画印刷感**：在几何色块之上保留细腻纸感、柔和噪点与轻微印刷质感，使画面更接近纸本拼贴或艺术印刷作品。避免光滑矢量、3D渲染、照片滤镜和过度精修。

配色从上方照片中提取 **2–4 种最有辨识度、最讨喜、最能体现主体气质的颜色** 重新整理为更高级的配色系统。整体可适度提亮、提纯、去灰，转化为**奶油白、杏色、蜜桃粉、珊瑚橙、雾蓝、灰绿、鼠尾草绿、暖棕、柔紫**等更轻盈、现代、耐看的色块关系。主色鲜明但不刺眼，辅助色温柔而有层次，整体气质干净、温暖、时髦、亲和，避免土黄、脏灰、暗褐、荧光色、廉价糖果感和杂乱配色。

文字少量介入，不限制语种。可根据主体身份、地点、情绪、气质或象征意义，自由提炼简短标题、小字注释、编号或说明片段。文字应小、轻、克制，自然落在留白区域或版面边角，与图形共同形成精致的图文关系，不做商业标题堆砌。

整体呈现**完整大块面的几何解构、克制拼贴、柔和高级配色、纸本颗粒、大面积留白与编辑式排版**共同构成的视觉效果。无论主体是人物、建筑、动物、植物、器物或自然景观，都应保持清晰身份、模块化几何秩序与统一的艺术语言。避免写实描摹、过碎切割、幼稚拼贴、复杂透视、过密细节、卡通感、3D感、模板化海报感和廉价文创感

items.title: 高对比度黑白墨绘时尚女性插画

prompts.text:
Create a high-contrast black-and-white fashion illustration of a young woman in a sophisticated hand-drawn ink-art style.

COMPOSITION:
Close-up portrait from the chest and shoulders upward. The woman is turned slightly toward the right in a confident three-quarter profile, with her head tilted subtly upward. Her face occupies the center-right of the frame.

HAIR:
Long dark hair pulled into a high ponytail, with thick flowing strands extending behind her. Use bold black ink shapes mixed with many thin, expressive white highlight strokes to define individual hair strands. Add a few loose strands around the face.

FACE:
Elegant feminine facial features with clean, sharp ink contours. Clearly defined eyebrows, nose, lips, cheekbones and jawline. Use minimal light-gray/black cross-hatching for subtle facial shadows while keeping most of the face clean white.

SUNGLASSES:
Large oversized black rectangular sunglasses with thick frames and dark lenses. Strong white reflective highlights on the lenses and frame edges.

CLOTHING:
A black oversized hoodie with a large hood around the neck and visible white drawstrings. Deep black fabric areas with thin white ink highlights showing folds and texture.

ART STYLE:
Pure monochrome editorial fashion illustration, bold black ink, crisp linework, dramatic black-and-white contrast, graphic novel aesthetic, elegant fashion-sketch artwork, hand-drawn brush strokes, selective gray shading, clean white negative space.

DETAIL:
Use varied line weights — thick solid black areas for hair, sunglasses and hoodie, extremely fine lines for hair strands and facial details. Add subtle gray shadow shapes under the sunglasses, nose, lips and jaw.

BACKGROUND:
Completely clean white background with no scenery or objects.

QUALITY:
Highly detailed professional ink illustration, polished composition, sharp contours, sophisticated editorial artwork, balanced negative space.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
color, colored clothing, photorealistic photo, 3D render, anime, cartoon, watercolor, messy background, text, logo, watermark, extra people, distorted face, deformed hands, excessive shading, blurry lines.

items.title: 旅行照片青绿山水绢本设计海报

prompts.text:
Please turn each travel photo I upload into a separate high-end design poster, outputting each photo individually without multi-image collage.

The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout with warm ivory natural silk as the background. The final image must simultaneously retain the clearly visible original photo and a blue-green landscape (Shanshui) re-rendering of the same scene, forming a contrast between real travel imagery and classical handscroll painting.

The upper part occupies about 40%—45%, faithfully retaining the peaks, rivers, terraced fields, villages, forests, roads, and their relative positions from the original photo. Only apply slight artistic publication color grading and extremely thin grain processing; do not redraw the original image, and do not add buildings, boats, figures, or peaks that do not exist in the photo.

The lower part occupies about 55%—60%, setting a wide and low horizontal painting area within a large area of ivory empty silk, making it look like a section captured from a blue-green landscape handscroll. Do not generate complete physical scrolls; do not show wooden poles, rolled edges, tassels, or product displays.

Re-analyze the spatial route of the photo and organize the real landscape into a "roaming view" order unfolding from left to right. Distant mountains, river surfaces, peak forests, terraced fields, shorelines, villages, or woodlands can be arranged in sequence, but they must follow the actual topography and positional relationships in the photo, without creating traditional buildings or ancient figures out of thin air.

Use fine line drawing, "cun" (brushstroke) textures, and restrained mineral pigment expression. Colors are mainly azurite, malachite green, gray-blue, ochre, and light ink, allowing a very small amount of cinnabar as visual emphasis. The pigments should be calm, delicate, and have a silk grain feel; do not use high-saturation emerald green or magnificent golden decorative effects.

Keep obvious empty silk within the painting core. Water surfaces, sky, clouds/mist, and valleys can be directly represented by uncolored areas, letting the blank space become a pause in the horizontal route. The upper and lower boundaries of the painting core should be clear, with wide silk surfaces maintained outside the painting core, avoiding stuffing the lower half into a full-bleed landscape.

Add a small amount of accurate English typography in the blank space outside the painting core: a 2—4 word title extracted from the location or landscape, a number, and a short observation sentence. Use restrained serif fonts or small caps with loose letter spacing; the text should be clearly readable and echo the horizontal rhythm of the handscroll.

The overall style refers to blue-green landscape, silk handscrolls, mineral pigments, and modern museum publication design. The image is calm, distant, clear, has a sense of horizontal roaming, while retaining the real regional identity of the travel photo.

Avoid: fake Chinese, calligraphy, seals, ancient poetry, author names, complete scroll products, wooden poles, tassels, picture frames, wall mockups, fictional temples, ancient people, cranes, extra boats, randomly added peaks, golden decorations, neon blue-green, full-bleed coloring, photo-realism in the lower half, and simple filtering.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，每张照片单独输出，不进行多图拼贴。

整体采用3:4竖版构图，以温暖的象牙色天然绢纸作为背景。最终画面必须同时保留清楚可见的原始照片和同场景的青绿山水转绘，形成真实旅行影像与古典手卷绘画之间的对照。

上方约占40%—45%，忠实保留原始照片中的山峰、河流、梯田、村落、树林、道路及其相对位置。仅进行轻微艺术出版物调色和极薄颗粒处理，不重新绘制原图，不增加照片中不存在的建筑、舟船、人物或山峰。

下方约占55%—60%，在大面积象牙色空绢中设置一条宽而低的横向绘画区域，使其像从一幅青绿山水手卷中截取出来的一段画面。不要生成完整实体卷轴，不出现木杆、卷边、流苏或商品展示。

重新分析照片的空间路线，将真实景观组织成从左到右逐步展开的游观顺序。可以依次安排远山、江面、峰林、梯田、岸线、村落或林地，但必须遵循照片中的真实地形和位置关系，不得凭空制造传统建筑或古代人物。

使用精细勾线、皴擦纹理和克制的矿物颜料表现，色彩以石青、石绿、灰蓝、赭石、淡墨为主，允许极少量朱砂作为视觉强调。颜料沉静、细腻、有绢本颗粒感，不使用高饱和翡翠绿或金碧辉煌的装饰效果。

画芯内部保留明显的空绢。水面、天空、云雾和山谷可以由未着色区域直接表示，让空白成为横向路线中的停顿。画芯上下边界应清楚，画芯外继续保留宽阔绢面，避免将下半部分塞成完整满幅风景。

在画芯外的留白中加入少量准确英文排版：一个由地点或景观提炼的2—4词标题、编号与一句简短观察句。使用字距宽松、克制的衬线字体或小型大写字，文字应清楚可读，并与手卷的横向节奏呼应。

整体参考青绿山水、绢本手卷、矿物颜料与现代博物馆出版设计。画面沉静、悠远、清晰、有横向游观感，同时保留旅行照片的真实地域身份。

避免：假中文、书法、印章、古诗、作者名字、完整卷轴产品、木杆、流苏、画框、墙面样机、虚构寺庙、古人、仙鹤、额外舟船、随意增加山峰、金碧装饰、霓虹青绿、满幅填色、下半部分摄影写实和简单滤镜化。

prompts.text:
Create a striking high-contrast black-and-white typographic fashion portrait of the same woman, designed as an intricate editorial text-mosaic artwork.

COMPOSITION:

Vertical 9:16 portrait composition.

Show the woman from approximately the waist/chest upward in a graceful three-quarter view. Her head is slightly turned toward the right with a confident, thoughtful expression.

The woman occupies the central portion of the frame.

Her entire silhouette, hair, face, neck, shoulders, and clothing are constructed from thousands of carefully arranged words, letters, newspaper fragments, typography and micro-text.

The typography should follow the natural contours of her anatomy so the words themselves create the shape of her face, hair and clothing.

FACE & TYPOGRAPHY:

Her facial features must remain clearly recognizable despite being constructed from typography.

Use extremely small black and dark-gray micro-text across the forehead, cheeks, nose, chin and neck.

Use larger typography strategically around the facial contours to define shadows and structure.

The eyes should remain highly detailed and expressive, with fine typography and delicate linework defining the eyelids, lashes, eyebrows and eye sockets.

Keep the nose and lips clearly readable through carefully controlled typography.

The lips should be a subtle vivid red accent, while everything else remains monochrome.

HAIR:

Create flowing dark hair made almost entirely from dense black typography, newspaper fragments, bold letters and fine handwritten marks.

Hair edges should gradually dissolve into scattered individual letters, punctuation marks, ink particles and fragmented typography.

Use different font sizes and orientations to create realistic depth and texture.

TYPOGRAPHY:

Integrate prominent words throughout the portrait, including:

“SUCCESS”
“ENERGY”
“BILLS”
“MONEY”
“SCHOOL”
“FOCUS”
“DISCIPLINE”
“AMBITION”
“GOALS”
“FAITH”
“HOPE”
“STRENGTH”
“COURAGE”
“PATIENCE”
“PURPOSE”
“PASSION”
“DEDICATION”
“CONSISTENCY”
“PERSISTENCE”
“RESILIENCE”
“HUSTLE”
“GRIND”
“DREAMS”
“BELIEF”
“FUTURE”
“POSITIVE”
“LIFE”

Make several key words much larger and visually dominant.

“SUCCESS” should be one of the strongest and largest typographic elements, positioned prominently across the lower-center torso area.

“ENERGY”, “BILLS”, and “MONEY” should appear prominently around the upper-left hair/head region.

“FOCUS”, “DISCIPLINE”, “AMBITION”, “GOALS”, and “DEDICATION” should appear around the torso.

Mix bold serif headlines, condensed sans-serif typography, elegant serif fonts, handwritten script, newspaper-style microprint and tiny fragmented letters.

Typography must wrap naturally around the contours of the woman instead of appearing as random text pasted over her.

CLOTHING:

The woman wears an elegant dark blazer/jacket over a clean white collared shirt.

The clothing is also constructed from typography.

Use dense dark typography to form the blazer while keeping the white shirt primarily light with fine black micro-text.

Large bold words should follow the folds and structure of the blazer.

BACKGROUND:

Pure white editorial background.

Add extremely subtle faded newspaper columns, vintage handwritten notes, barely visible horizontal writing lines and old printed-paper textures in the background.

Keep the background significantly lighter than the subject.

Allow scattered individual letters, punctuation marks, numbers and tiny typographic fragments to float around the silhouette.

ARTISTIC EFFECT:

The outer edges of the hair, shoulders and clothing should gradually dissolve into chaotic typography, ink splatters and fragmented letters.

Add controlled black ink splashes, dry-brush marks, scattered dots and grunge particles around the silhouette.

The effect should feel like the woman is physically emerging from words and gradually breaking apart into typography.

Do not make the splatters overpower the face.

STYLE:

Premium editorial graphic design.
High-fashion magazine artwork.
Black-and-white typographic portrait.
Experimental typography.
Mixed-media newspaper collage.
Fine-art ink illustration.
High contrast.
Sharp typography.
Detailed micro-text.
Sophisticated monochrome aesthetic.
Organic text-mosaic construction.
Professional poster design.

LIGHTING & TONALITY:

Strong monochrome contrast with deep black typography and clean white negative space.

Use subtle gray halftones and delicate shading to create depth around the facial features.

The face should remain readable and dimensional despite the typography.

Add a very subtle red accent only to the lips.

QUALITY:

Extremely detailed.
Crisp typography.
Sharp micro-text.
Clean edges.
Professional graphic-design quality.
Natural facial proportions.
Highly recognizable face.
Balanced composition.
No blurry typography.
No random unreadable blocks dominating the image.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:

colorful background,
multiple colors,
different person,
similar-looking person,
identity drift,
altered facial structure,
different eyes,
different nose,
different lips,
different jawline,
generic face,
face distortion,
face morphing,
over-beautified face,
cartoon,
anime,
3D render,
photorealistic photograph,
messy composition,
excessive typography covering the eyes,
illegible giant text everywhere,
extra people,
extra limbs,
deformed anatomy,
watermark,
logo,
unwanted text,
low resolution.

FINAL RULE:

The uploaded image determines WHO the woman is.

The creative prompt determines the ART STYLE, TYPOGRAPHY, HAIRSTYLE, CLOTHING, POSE, COMPOSITION and ENVIRONMENT.

Keep the facial identity consistent while transforming the person into the described typographic artwork.

DESTINATION IDENTITY
Santorini 🇬🇷 — Aegean Dream
Whitewashed Cycladic buildings cascading dramatically down a sunlit cliffside, iconic blue-domed churches, narrow stone pathways, elegant terraces, colorful bougainvillea, small boats floating across the deep-blue Aegean Sea, distant volcanic cliffs, and a spectacular golden sunset. Capture the romantic island atmosphere with warm sunlight reflecting across the water and soft glowing lanterns illuminating the pathways.
Amalfi Coast 🇮🇹 — Mediterranean Elegance
Luxury cliffside villas and sophisticated Mediterranean architecture overlooking the sparkling coastline, terraced gardens, elegant infinity pools, glowing windows, winding stone stairways, lush greenery, bougainvillea, coastal boats and yachts, dramatic rocky cliffs, and a refined evening atmosphere. Add subtle warm architectural lighting to create an exclusive five-star resort feeling.
Paris 🇫🇷 — Timeless Romance
Elegant Parisian architecture, the Eiffel Tower rising beautifully in the background, classic European buildings, romantic bridges crossing the Seine, charming riverside cafés, vintage street lamps, flower-filled balconies, bicycles, small boats on the river, cobblestone pathways and subtle Parisian decorative details. Blend the cityscape naturally into the overall artwork without making it look like a separate scene.
COMPOSITION
Create one seamless luxury travel journey, not three separate sections and not a simple collage.
The composition should visually flow from the bright Mediterranean atmosphere of Santorini into the dramatic cliffside elegance of the Amalfi Coast, gradually transitioning toward the timeless architectural beauty of Paris. The three destinations should feel connected through a sophisticated artistic perspective, atmospheric depth, elegant lighting and carefully blended architectural elements.
Place the main visual focus toward the center while maintaining generous negative space in the upper portion for premium typography. Create a cinematic elevated perspective with strong foreground, middle-ground and background depth.
Include recognizable but naturally integrated elements such as blue-domed Santorini churches, white cliffside houses, Mediterranean villas, infinity pools, coastal boats, the Eiffel Tower, Parisian rooftops, historic bridges, cafés, elegant street lamps, flower arrangements and winding stone pathways.
Keep every architectural element refined, realistic and proportionally believable. Avoid making the scene overcrowded. Each destination should contribute its own character while remaining part of the same unified world.
Add subtle decorative elements inspired by vintage European travel posters: thin ornamental borders, elegant corner flourishes, delicate divider lines, small decorative symbols and refined vintage accents. These details should remain understated and luxurious rather than dominating the scenery.
TYPOGRAPHY
Use elegant luxury editorial typography with generous negative space.
MEDITERRANEAN & PARIS ESCAPES
SANTORINI 🇬🇷 • AMALFI COAST 🇮🇹 • PARIS 🇫🇷
“Three Icons. One Unforgettable Journey.”
Typography should be sophisticated, minimal, spacious and magazine-inspired, using a refined high-fashion serif style combined with subtle elegant script for the smaller tagline.
Keep all typography extremely clean, properly aligned and highly readable. Make the main title large and premium without covering important architectural landmarks.
ART DIRECTION
Premium European luxury travel campaign, high-end editorial travel poster, sophisticated vintage-meets-modern aesthetic, cinematic travel photography, elegant architectural visualization, refined Mediterranean atmosphere, timeless Parisian romance, luxury boutique travel magazine design.
Create a subtle premium 3D miniature architectural diorama feeling while keeping the scenery highly realistic and photographic. Buildings should have exquisite architectural details, realistic stone and plaster textures, natural reflections, believable windows and doors, delicate landscaping and sophisticated depth.
Use cinematic atmospheric perspective, realistic environmental lighting, soft volumetric glow, natural shadows, subtle reflections on water, realistic glass surfaces, detailed rooftops and finely crafted architectural elements.
The final artwork should feel like an exclusive luxury travel campaign poster displayed in a five-star hotel, private lounge or premium fashion magazine.
LIGHTING & ATMOSPHERE
Blend warm Mediterranean golden-hour sunlight with sophisticated Parisian evening illumination.
Use soft golden sunlight touching the Santorini buildings, warm sunset reflections across the sea, subtle amber illumination from Amalfi villas and pools, and elegant golden street lamps and café lighting around the Paris section.
Create a beautiful transition from sunset gold → warm Mediterranean twilight → elegant Parisian evening glow.
Add delicate atmospheric haze, soft clouds, subtle lens depth, realistic highlights and gentle cinematic bloom while keeping the image crisp and highly detailed.
COLOR SYSTEM
Use a sophisticated harmonious palette of:
warm ivory, creamy white, Mediterranean blue, Santorini cobalt blue, sea turquoise, soft sunset gold, muted terracotta, elegant beige, warm charcoal, deep navy and subtle champagne-gold accents.
Keep the colors refined and slightly cinematic. Avoid overly saturated artificial colors. The overall palette should feel expensive, sophisticated, warm and cohesive.
DETAILS & FINISHING
Add realistic small-scale details throughout the scene: flower-filled balconies, bougainvillea, elegant outdoor seating, café tables, decorative lanterns, stone walls, narrow stairways, boats and yachts, subtle water reflections, distant coastal lights, Parisian balconies, vintage bicycles and delicate greenery.
Maintain excellent depth separation between foreground, middle ground and background.
Use realistic textures for stone, marble, stucco, wood, glass, water, metal and architectural surfaces.
The image should look like a professionally photographed luxury destination artwork rather than an ordinary AI-generated collage.
Ultra-realistic details, cinematic composition, premium editorial photography, sophisticated travel-poster design, HDR, realistic reflections, controlled highlights, natural shadows, atmospheric depth, crisp architectural details, high-end magazine quality, visually balanced composition, masterpiece-level finish.
MOOD
Romantic, luxurious, elegant, dreamy, sophisticated, warm, timeless and aspirational — combining the Aegean charm of Santorini, Mediterranean luxury of the Amalfi Coast and timeless romance of Paris into one unforgettable premium travel experience.
The final image should communicate the feeling of luxury, romance, discovery and effortless European elegance.
NEGATIVE PROMPT
No split screen.
No three separate posters.
No obvious collage.
No disconnected scenes.
No hard visual divisions between destinations.
No duplicated landmarks.
No distorted Eiffel Tower.
No malformed buildings.
No incorrect architecture.
No unrealistic proportions.
No excessive boats.
No overcrowded composition.
No excessive text.
No misspelled destination names.
No incorrect flags.
No random landmarks.
No floating buildings.
No warped roads or stairways.
No distorted windows or doors.
No artificial plastic textures.
No harsh oversaturation.
No extreme contrast.
No excessive lens flare.
No watercolor.
No painterly brushwork.
No cartoon appearance.
No low-resolution details.
No visual clutter.
No copied layout from the references.
No repetitive architecture.
No cheap tourist-poster appearance.

prompts.text:
灵感来自圣托里尼、阿马尔菲海岸和巴黎的顶级精致奢华旅行海报系列，融合成一个统一的、令人惊叹的编辑构图，3:4 垂直格式。
创作一个原创的、奢华的旅行艺术构图，无缝结合所有三张参考图像的视觉特征、建筑、风景、氛围、色彩和优雅的海报美学。参考图像应启发场景、排版、建筑细节、装饰框架、光线和整体高级旅行杂志感，但最终作品必须看起来像一个全新的、专业设计的构图，而不是简单地将三张图像放在一起。
目的地标识
圣托里尼 🇬🇷 — 爱琴海之梦
白色基克拉迪建筑如瀑布般从阳光普照的悬崖边倾泻而下，标志性的蓝顶教堂，狭窄的石路，优雅的露台，色彩缤纷的九重葛，漂浮在深蓝色爱琴海上的小船，远处的火山悬崖，以及壮观的金黄色夕阳。捕捉浪漫的岛屿氛围，温暖的阳光倒映在水面上，柔和发光的灯笼照亮了小径。
阿马尔菲海岸 🇮🇹 — 地中海优雅
俯瞰波光粼粼海岸线的奢华悬崖别墅和精致的地中海建筑，梯田花园，优雅的无边泳池，发光的窗户，蜿蜒的石梯，郁郁葱葱的绿植，九重葛，沿海船只和游艇，壮观的岩石悬崖，以及精致的傍晚氛围。添加细微温暖的建筑照明，营造出专属五星级度假村的感觉。
巴黎 🇫🇷 — 永恒浪漫
优雅的巴黎建筑，埃菲尔铁塔在背景中优美地升起，经典的欧洲建筑，横跨塞纳河的浪漫桥梁，迷人的河畔咖啡馆，复古路灯，鲜花盛开的阳台，自行车，河上的小船，鹅卵石小径和细微的巴黎装饰细节。将城市景观自然地融入整体艺术作品中，而不会使其看起来像一个独立的场景。
构图
创造一段无缝的奢华旅行旅程，而不是三个独立的部分，也不是简单的拼贴。
构图应从圣托里尼明亮的地中海氛围视觉流向阿马尔菲海岸壮丽的悬崖优雅，逐渐向巴黎永恒的建筑美感过渡。这三个目的地应通过精致的艺术视角、氛围深度、优雅的光线和精心融合的建筑元素联结在一起。
将主要视觉焦点放在中心，同时在上方保留大量留白以用于高级排版。通过强大的前景、中景和背景深度创造一种电影感的高空视角。
包括可识别但自然整合的元素，如蓝顶圣托里尼教堂、白色悬崖房屋、地中海别墅、无边泳池、沿海船只、埃菲尔铁塔、巴黎屋顶、历史桥梁、咖啡馆、优雅的路灯、花卉布置和蜿蜒的石径。
保持每个建筑元素精炼、写实且比例可信。避免使场景过于拥挤。每个目的地都应贡献自己的特色，同时保持作为同一个统一世界的一部分。
添加灵感来自复古欧洲旅行海报的细微装饰元素：细装饰边框、优雅的角落花纹、精致的分隔线、小的装饰符号和精炼的复古点缀。这些细节应保持低调和奢华，而不是主导场景。
排版
使用优雅的奢华编辑排版，带有大量的留白。
地中海与巴黎逃逸之旅
圣托里尼 🇬🇷 • 阿马尔菲海岸 🇮🇹 • 巴黎 🇫🇷
“三个偶像。一段难忘的旅程。”
排版应精致、极简、宽敞且受杂志启发，使用精炼的高级时尚衬线体，并结合细微优雅的手写体作为较小的标语。
保持所有排版极其干净、排列整齐且高度清晰。使主标题大而高档，且不遮挡重要的建筑地标。
艺术指导
顶级欧洲奢华旅行活动，高端编辑旅行海报，精致的复古遇上现代美学，电影感旅行摄影，优雅的建筑可视化，精炼的地中海氛围，永恒的巴黎浪漫，奢华精品旅行杂志设计。
营造一种细微的高级 3D 微缩建筑模型感觉，同时保持风景高度写实和摄影化。建筑应具有精致的建筑细节，写实的石头和灰泥纹理，自然反射，可信的门窗，精致的景观和精致的深度。
使用电影感大气透视，写实环境照明，柔和的体积光晕，自然阴影，水面上的细微反射，写实玻璃表面，精细的屋顶和制作精良的建筑元素。
最终的作品应感觉像展示在五星级酒店、私人酒廊或高端时尚杂志上的专属奢华旅行活动海报。
光影与氛围
将温暖的地中海黄金时刻阳光与精致的巴黎傍晚照明相融合。
使用触及圣托里尼建筑的柔和金色阳光，横跨海面的温暖夕阳反射，阿马尔菲别墅和泳池散发出的细微琥珀色照明，以及巴黎区域周围优雅的金黄色路灯和咖啡馆照明。
创造一个美丽的转变：夕阳金 → 温暖的地中海黄昏 → 优雅的巴黎夜景。
添加微妙的大气薄雾，柔和的云朵，细微的镜头深度，写实的高光和柔和的电影感光晕，同时保持图像清晰且细节丰富。
色彩系统
使用精致和谐的调色板：
温暖的象牙色，乳白色，地中海蓝，圣托里尼钴蓝，海洋青色，柔和的夕阳金，柔和的陶土色，优雅的米色，温暖的炭灰色，深海军蓝和细微的香槟金点缀。
保持色彩精炼且带有一点电影感。避免过度饱和的人造色彩。整体色调应感觉昂贵、精致、温暖且连贯。
细节与修饰
在整个场景中添加写实的小规模细节：鲜花盛开的阳台，九重葛，优雅的户外座椅，咖啡桌，装饰灯笼，石墙，狭窄的楼梯，船只和游艇，细微的水面反射，远处的海岸灯光，巴黎阳台，复古自行车和精致的绿植。
在前景、中景和背景之间保持出色的深度分离。
对石头、大理石、灰泥、木材、玻璃、水、金属和建筑表面使用写实的纹理。
图像看起来应像专业拍摄的奢华目的地艺术品，而不是普通的 AI 生成的拼贴画。
超写实细节，电影感构图，高级编辑摄影，精致的旅行海报设计，HDR，写实反射，受控的高光，自然阴影，大气深度，清晰的建筑细节，高端杂志品质，视觉平衡的构图，大师级的修饰。
情绪
浪漫、奢华、优雅、梦幻、精致、温暖、永恒且令人向往——将圣托里尼的爱琴海魅力、阿马尔菲海岸的地中海奢华和巴黎的永恒浪漫融合为一段难忘的顶级旅行体验。
最终图像应传达奢华、浪漫、探索和毫不费力的欧洲优雅感。
负面提示
无分屏。
没有三个独立的海报。
没有明显的拼贴。
没有断连的场景。
目的地之间没有生硬的视觉划分。
没有重复的地标。
没有变形的埃菲尔铁塔。
没有畸形的建筑。
没有不正确的建筑。
没有不真实的比例。
没有过多的船只。
没有过度拥挤的构图。
没有过多的文字。
没有拼错的目的地名称。
没有不正确的国旗。
没有随机的地标。
没有悬浮的建筑。
没有扭曲的道路或阶梯。
没有变形的门窗。
没有写实感差的塑料纹理。
没有刺眼的过度饱和。
没有极端对比。
没有过度的镜头光晕。
没有水彩画。
没有绘画笔触。
没有卡通外观。
没有低分辨率细节。
没有视觉杂乱。
没有复制参考图的布局。
没有重复的建筑。
没有廉价的旅游海报外观。

prompts.text:
Transform the uploaded real photo into a minimalist low-poly editorial illustration.

Use the original photo as the visual source.

Faithfully preserve:
- the main subject
- pose and gesture
- body direction
- clothing
- important accessories
- key objects
- perspective
- recognizable scene relationships

Do not redesign the scene.
Do not invent a new composition.
Do not add unrelated elements.

STYLE

Convert the photo into a clean 2D low-poly illustration.

Use:
- medium-to-large geometric polygonal planes
- broad angular shapes
- simplified faceted light and shadow
- clean edges
- restrained details
- muted natural colors

Avoid excessive tiny triangles.

The result should feel:
minimal,
quiet,
refined,
editorial,
graphic,
elegant.

Less is more.

COMPOSITION

Create a compact illustrated scene floating in the exact center of a large empty canvas.

Place the entire scene precisely in the center, both horizontally and vertically.

The illustrated scene should occupy only about 35–50% of the total canvas height.

Leave a very large amount of empty space evenly around all four sides.

Do not fill the frame.
Do not crop tightly around the subject.
Do not shift the scene upward, downward, left, or right.

The scene should feel like a small visual specimen displayed in the center of a large editorial page.

BACKGROUND

Use one completely solid background color:

#F4EBDD

The background must remain clean, flat, uniform, and empty.

No texture.
No paper grain.
No gradient.
No vignette.
No decorative elements.
No background shadows.

ASPECT RATIO

Match the canvas aspect ratio to the uploaded photo as closely as possible.

Preserve the original image orientation and overall width-to-height relationship.

Horizontal photo → horizontal output.
Vertical photo → vertical output.
Square or near-square photo → square or near-square output.

Do not force the source photo into a predefined aspect ratio.

SCENE SIMPLIFICATION

Keep only the visual information necessary to recognize the original photo.

Simplify secondary details.

Group:
- buildings
- trees
- plants
- water
- furniture
- architecture
- landscape
- clothing folds
- reflections

into larger geometric masses.

Do not reproduce every small detail.

The outer edge of the illustrated scene should end naturally with an irregular silhouette.

Do not preserve the original rectangular photo boundary inside the canvas.

COLOR

Preserve the original photo’s overall color identity.

Reduce it into a controlled, slightly desaturated palette.

Keep colors natural, muted, warm, and sophisticated.

LIGHT

Preserve the original light direction and overall mood.

Translate realistic lighting into simplified geometric color planes.

FINAL LOOK

Minimalist low-poly editorial illustration.
Large negative space.
Small centered scene.
Solid #F4EBDD background.
Controlled geometric facets.
Natural irregular scene boundary.
Clear subject recognition.
Elegant visual simplification.
Less is more.

AVOID

full-frame illustration,
busy background,
photorealism,
3D rendering,
CGI,
cartoon style,
anime,
children’s illustration,
thick outlines,
tiny triangle overload,
overly fragmented polygons,
complex textures,
paper texture,
grain,
background gradients,
dramatic lighting,
neon colors,
oversaturated colors,
decorative graphics,
text,
typography,
borders,
frames.

prompts.text:
将上传的真实照片转换为极简低多边形社论插画。

使用原始照片作为视觉来源。

忠实保留：
- 主体
- 姿势与动作
- 身体方向
- 服装
- 重要配饰
- 关键物体
- 透视
- 可识别的场景关系

不要重新设计场景。
不要发明新的构图。
不要添加无关元素。

风格

将照片转换为干净的二维低多边形插画。

使用：
- 中到大型的几何多边形平面
- 宽阔的有棱角的形状
- 简化的切面光影
- 干净的边缘
- 克制的细节
- 柔和的自然色彩

避免过多微小的三角形。

结果应呈现：
极简、
安静、
精致、
社论感、
图形化、
优雅。

少即是多。

构图

在一个巨大的空白画布正中心创建一个悬浮的紧凑插画场景。

将整个场景精准地放置在水平和垂直中心。

插画场景应仅占画布总高度的约 35–50%。

在四周均匀留出极大量的空白。

不要填满画面。
不要紧贴主体裁剪。
不要向上、向下、向左或向右偏移场景。

场景应感觉像展示在大篇幅社论页面中心的一个小型视觉标本。

背景

使用一种完全纯色的背景色：

#F4EBDD

背景必须保持干净、平坦、统一且空白。

无纹理。
无纸张颗粒。
无渐变。
无暗角。
无装饰元素。
无背景阴影。

纵横比

尽可能贴合上传照片的画布纵横比。

保留原始图像的方向和整体宽高关系。

横向照片 → 横向输出。
纵向照片 → 纵向输出。
正方形或接近正方形的照片 → 正方形或接近正方形的输出。

不要强制将源照片放入预定义的纵横比中。

场景简化

仅保留识别原始照片所必需的视觉信息。

简化次要细节。

将以下内容组合：
- 建筑物
- 树木
- 植物
- 水
- 家具
- 建筑
- 景观
- 衣服褶皱
- 反射
为更大的几何块。

不要再现每一个微小细节。

插画场景的外边缘应以不规则的轮廓自然结束。

不要在画布内保留原始的长方形照片边界。

颜色

保留原始照片的整体色彩特征。

将其缩减为受控的、略微去饱和的调色板。

保持颜色自然、柔和、温暖且高级。

光线

保留原始光线方向和整体氛围。

将写实的光影转化为简化的几何色块。

最终效果

极简低多边形社论插画。
大面积负空间。
小型居中场景。
纯色 #F4EBDD 背景。
受控的几何切面。
自然的场景不规则边界。
清晰的主体识别。
优雅的视觉简化。
少即是多。

避免

全画幅插画、
杂乱背景、
写实主义、
3D 渲染、
CGI、
卡通风格、
动漫、
儿童插画、
粗轮廓、
过多的微小三角形、
过度破碎的多边形、
复杂纹理、
纸张纹理、
颗粒、
背景渐变、
戏剧性光影、
霓虹色、
过饱和颜色、
装饰图形、
文字、
排版、
边框、

prompts.text:
Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product / Campaign: [PRODUCT OR CAMPAIGN]
Main Word: [SHORT ACTION WORD]
Subject: [ATHLETE / DANCER / OTHER]
Action: [DUNK / PUNCH / CUT / JUMP / OTHER]
Foreground Object: [SHOE / GLOVE / BALL / PRODUCT / OTHER]
Main Color: [COLOR]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Campaign Details: [SLOGAN / SPECS / DATE]
Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Create a bold commercial campaign poster built around **extreme forced perspective, dynamic human motion, and oversized typography**.

Use a low-angle or close-perspective camera so one important object enters the foreground much larger than normal, while the athlete remains clearly readable in the mid-ground. The foreground object should feel dramatic but must not block the face or destroy the body proportions.

Capture the subject at a clear peak-action moment with believable anatomy, balance, weight, and direction. Hair, clothing, limbs, and equipment should follow the same movement naturally.

Make the main word extremely large and integrate it into the scene rather than placing it flat behind the subject. Use controlled depth, perspective, cropping, and foreground/background overlap so parts of the typography sit behind the athlete while selected sections move into the foreground.

Let the typography reinforce the action: it can rise, compress, slice, drop, or shift according to the subject’s movement, while remaining clearly readable.

Use a strong high-saturation color system with one dominant background color, one contrasting accent color, warm white or black typography, and only a few supporting colors.

Add 2–3 compact information areas with meaningful campaign details such as product weight, cushioning, grip, material, performance features, or slogan, plus a clean footer.

Prioritize:
**dynamic subject → strong foreground perspective → clear product → oversized type interaction → supporting information.**

Keep people, hands, equipment, shoes, balls, and body mechanics realistic and structurally correct.

The final image should feel like a finished high-energy sports campaign key visual — bold, colorful, dimensional, dynamic, and instantly readable in a social feed.

A young adult East Asian woman stands upright at a floor-mounted microphone, facing slightly toward the camera while looking forward with a composed, confident, elegant expression. She has fair skin, delicate facial features, dark brown eyes, and dark brown hair styled with a center part and a long, thick braided ponytail extending down past her waist, secured with a pale ribbon or fabric accent.

She wears a tailored black formal suit with a structured single-breasted blazer, notched lapels, long sleeves, and fitted shoulders, paired with a crisp white pointed-collar shirt and a narrow black necktie. The blazer extends below the hips toward mid-thigh and has visible flap pockets. She wears sheer black thigh-high stockings or semi-transparent black hosiery and black glitter-accented pointed-toe high heels.

She holds a rectangular dark award trophy with both hands at chest-to-waist level. The trophy has a distinctive vertical gold/brass-colored textured face mounted on a dark rectangular base. A slim standing microphone is positioned directly in front of her, with the microphone head around chest level and a visible cable descending to the stage floor.

Her posture is poised and formal, with one leg subtly positioned forward and her body naturally balanced behind the microphone. The overall appearance is sophisticated, youthful, professional, and ceremonial.

She possesses the best head-to-body ratio, a perfect, curvaceous, S-shaped female figure, long legs with perfect leg lines, and a slender waist, perfect foots,perfect foot lines

## Key Details

* Full-body composition, entire figure visible from head to shoes.
* Young adult East Asian woman, natural realistic proportions.
* Long dark braided ponytail extending to below the waist.
* Center-parted dark brown hair with soft face-framing strands.
* Black tailored blazer, white dress shirt, narrow black tie.
* Sheer black hosiery.
* Black pointed-toe high heels with subtle glitter/texture.

* 全身构图，从头到鞋的整个形象清晰可见。
* 东亚成年女性，自然的真实比例。
* 长长的深色编织辫子延伸至腰部以下。

## 约束条件

items.title: 纸窗海岸记忆高级对比旅行海报

prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的
“PAPER WINDOW COASTAL MEMORY｜纸窗海岸记忆”
高级对比海报。每张照片单独输出，不得多图拼贴。

整体采用3:4竖版构图。上方原始照片约占画面48%–50%，
下方纸窗记忆区约占50%–52%。两个区域之间使用清楚、
平直、克制的水平边界，不得渐变、羽化或互相覆盖。

上半部分必须使用原始照片本身，准确保持主体身份、数量、
人物或动物姿态、船只方向、建筑轮廓、山体与海岸线、
空间关系、观察角度、自然材质、真实光影和原有色彩氛围。

仅进行轻微的旅行艺术出版物级调色与极薄胶片颗粒。
为适配竖版，可以合理裁切或自然扩展天空、水面、地面与
无主体环境，但不得拉伸、扭曲、移动、替换或重新绘制主体，
不得使用AI重建的相似照片冒充原图。

下半部分使用大面积温暖米白色粗纹水彩纸作为完整背景，
保留清楚可见的棉纸纤维、纸齿与轻微自然色差。

下半部分的大面积空白是构图的主要组成，不要使用地图、
邮票、贝壳、胶带或装饰性手账素材填满纸面。

在下半部分偏左或略偏中心的位置，放置一张小型、竖向或
接近竖向的自然撕边手绘纸稿。

小纸稿通常只占下半部分宽度约38%–45%、高度约45%–58%，
四周必须保留至少45%–60%连续、安静、未经绘制的粗纸留白。

撕边具有真实棉纸纤维和轻微物理厚度，只使用柔和、克制的
接触阴影。不得将它做成厚纸板、立体相框、拍立得照片或
悬浮卡片。

小纸稿内部只提取照片中最值得记住的一个核心旅行锚点，
例如一艘船、一座风车、一组穹顶、一个灯塔、一段码头、
一座海边建筑或一位行人。

搭配两至四条必要的环境线索，例如一小段岸线、一条水面、
几根桅杆、一道山脊、少量屋顶或植物。主动删除人群、
重复船只、密集建筑、招牌、窗格、杂物和摄影噪声。

不要把整张照片缩小后完整画进纸窗，也不要沿用原图的完整
裁切、主体比例和信息密度。

重新调整主体尺度、次要元素位置与纸白比例，使核心物件像
一次被单独保存的观察，而不是照片的彩铅复制品。小稿内部
同样保留明显未上色区域，笔触在接近撕边前自然停止。

绘画媒介以迟疑、纤细、略带手工误差的石墨铅笔线为主，
结合干涩彩铅、浅淡水彩铅、局部纸面擦痕与断裂笔触。

配色完全从原始照片提取并归纳为有限色盘，例如海水与天空
的灰蓝、青绿，建筑与土地的暖石色、赭色，植物的灰绿色，
以及一处很小的原图特征色。

颜色保持柔和、褪淡、略带旧旅行速写感，不能使用高饱和
颜色铺满整张纸稿。

在小纸稿边缘加入一根极细、略褪色的红色或暖色铅笔竖线，
以及一小块从照片色彩中提取的灰蓝、青绿或暖灰色纸片。

这些元素只用于建立纸本编辑节奏，不得变成固定品牌标识，
也不得遮挡主体。

下半部分默认加入一组少量、准确且清晰可读的英文文字，
放置在小纸稿右侧或附近的连续留白中。文字包括：

1. 一个由1–3个英文单词构成的场景或意象标题；
2. 一个类似“COASTAL NOTE 01”或“TRAVEL NOTE 01”的字段；
3. 一句5–12个英文单词的简短观察句，描述照片中真实存在的
   天气、动作、建筑、船只、海水或空间关系。

文字使用克制的打字机衬线体、旧铅字或细瘦书卷感字体，
字距与行距稍宽，边缘允许轻微缺墨和不均匀压力，像直接
印在粗纸上。

主标题在正常聊天预览尺寸下必须清楚辨认，不能缩成灰色
装饰线。不得自行编造城市、日期、坐标、引用或历史信息。

整体气质安静、温和，具有真实纸张触感和旅行后的回望感。
上半部分保留旅途正在发生时的光线与声音；下半部分则像从
记忆里挑出一个物件，重新画在一张被夹进书中的小纸片上。

避免：
下半部分完整复画原景；
相同裁切、相同尺度的材质替换；
整面水彩背景；
巨大手绘稿；
多个撕纸卡片；
密集手账拼贴；
光滑矢量线稿；
儿童卡通；
商业旅游图标；
地图、邮票、贝壳和胶带堆积；
厚重投影；
塑料3D；
假中文、乱码；
作者名、签名、Logo、二维码、网址和水印。

prompts.text:
Create a vertical 2:3 premium city landmark architectural art poster, themed London, UK, with core landmarks being Big Ben / Elizabeth Tower + Palace of Westminster + River Thames.

Continue the unified ICONIC LANDMARK SERIES visual system:

Upper half real city photography + lower half minimalist 2D vector architectural deconstruction illustration.

The upper and lower parts must represent the same set of London landmarks and have a clear visual correspondence.

⸻

Upper Half | London Real Photography

The upper half accounts for about 45% of the entire frame.

Looking towards the Palace of Westminster from near the South Bank of the River Thames.

Big Ben / Elizabeth Tower is located slightly to the right of the visual center of the frame, the full tower body is clearly visible, extending from the bottom to the top spire, no cropping.

Strictly maintain the real architectural proportions of Elizabeth Tower.

Clearly represent the iconic:

Golden clock face, Gothic Revival spire, detailed stone facade, vertical window panes, top spire.

The Palace of Westminster expands horizontally next to Big Ben, forming a typical London skyline.

The building uses real warm beige stone, with parts hit by the setting sun creating soft golden highlights.

The foreground is the wide River Thames, occupying about 20–25% of the photography area.

The river water is low-saturation blue-gray, with natural fine ripples, and the building produces a slight reflection.

A very small London tour boat can appear as a scale reference, but it must not steal the spotlight.

Modern London city buildings can appear slightly in the distance but must be weakened.

The time is set at evening during London's Golden Hour entering Blue Hour.

The sky forms a natural gradient of:

Pale grey-blue → soft misty purple → light peach pink → slightly warm gold.

The sky has a small amount of Britain-specific stratiform clouds and soft cumulus clouds, with a slight overcast feeling, but not gloomy.

Sunlight passes through the clouds from the side and back, creating a delicate golden rim light for the edges of Big Ben.

50–85mm architectural photography, medium-telephoto visual compression, building vertical lines remain straight, no fisheye, no exaggerated wide-angle distortion.

Real London travel photography, premium architectural photography, cinematic golden hour, real stone texture, natural HDR, high dynamic range, 4K.

⸻

Lower Half | London Architectural Vector Deconstruction

The lower half accounts for about 55%.

The background transitions to warm ivory white, cream white premium art paper.

Large area of clean negative space.

Redesign the real London buildings in the upper half into minimalist 2D architectural vector illustrations.

Big Ben is still located slightly to the right of the visual center, maintaining a similar visual axis with the real photography above.

Must strictly retain Big Ben's most core identifying elements:

Tall rectangular tower body
Four large clock faces
Golden clock face decorations
Gothic window panes
Top spire structure
Slender tower tip

Simplify complex Gothic architectural structures into:

Rectangles + slender vertical lines + triangles + pointed arches + extremely fine geometric lines.

The clock face is represented using a very restrained light golden circle.

The main body of Big Ben uses:

Light sandstone color, warm beige, taupe, low-saturation gold, deep grey-blue.

No thick black outlines.

⸻

The simplified Palace of Westminster extends horizontally to the left of Big Ben.

Highly geometrize the complex Gothic facade of the Houses of Parliament, retaining only:

Continuous spires, rectangular main body, towers, pointed arch windows, horizontal architectural base.

Use low-saturation:

Beige-grey, sand color, light brown, grey-blue, pale gold.

The building height must be significantly lower than Big Ben.

Add a giant translucent geometric circular sun to the rear left of Big Ben.

Use very soft:

British misty pink / Dusty Rose / Pale Peach

The circular part is obscured by Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament.

Do not use real sun textures.

⸻

River Thames Abstract Design

Use an extremely fine dark grey-blue horizontal line at the base of the building to establish a baseline.

Below, add 5–7 extremely fine horizontal lines of different lengths.

Lines use:

Misty blue, grey-blue, light navy blue.

Abstractly represent the Thames water surface.

A very small, minimalist red London double-decker bus silhouette can be added as a hidden Easter egg, but the area must not exceed 1% of the frame.

Maintain an overall architectural design archival feel, do not turn it into a travel cartoon illustration.

⸻

Typography | Architectural Archive Layout

Lower left uses uppercase English:

LONDON

Second line:

BIG BEN

Use premium modernist sans-serif font, thin weight, significantly increase letter spacing.

The main title uses Deep Navy Blue / Charcoal Navy.

An extremely fine short horizontal line below.

Small font size:

LONDON, UNITED KINGDOM

Top left corner uses extremely small font size:

ICONIC
LANDMARK
SERIES

—

No.001

Top right corner:

EST.
1859

Bottom right corner:

51.5007° N

0.1246° W

Bottom-most extremely small font size:

PALACE OF WESTMINSTER

All fonts follow architectural firm archives, museum exhibition catalog-style layout.

⸻

Final Style

Swiss International Style + British modernism + Bauhaus + Mid-century travel poster + architectural editorial illustration + museum exhibition graphic design + Japanese minimalism + Scandinavian graphic design

Warm ivory white paper, large areas of white space, precise grid system, ultra-fine lines, low-saturation Morandi color palette, accurate architectural proportions.

Upper real photography, lower 2D vector deconstruction, strict correspondence between upper and lower landmarks.

prompts.text:
Please turn each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-photo stitching, output each photo individually. The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical format, with the top and bottom areas strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the frame.

The upper half retains the original photo, maintaining the subject's identity, structure, posture, realistic texture, natural lighting, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end color grading to give it the quality of an art magazine, independent publication, or exhibition image. To adapt to the frame, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The lower half extracts the most recognizable subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, reconstructing it into a flat illustration in the style of new folk art paper-cut collage. Do not completely copy the photo; instead, remove irrelevant details, retaining only the structures, trends, and visual memory points that best represent the original. Re-summarize through silhouettes, color blocks, cut lines, positive/negative shapes, and a small amount of layering, so people can recognize the correspondence between it and the photo above at a glance. Subjects, plants, buildings, animals, artifacts, or environmental elements should be recombined like pieces of independent colored paper; shapes can be moderately naive, symbolic, or geometric, not pursuing realistic perspective and complex details, but emphasizing a sense of culture, craftsmanship, and contemporary design.

The composition maintains the relationship of small-scale subject / seal-like main visual + large area of white space, freely arranging positions according to the subject's own direction, proportion, and visual center of gravity, which can be eccentric, edge-aligned, or partially cropped, but always maintains clear primary and secondary order, density rhythm, and editorial balance. The subject can be concentrated on one side or at the bottom to form a visual focal point, with only a very small amount of auxiliary elements around it, avoiding the formation of multiple equal focuses.

The material presents a paper-cut collage + printmaking feel: the edges of color blocks can have a slight manual cutting feel, slight registration deviations, ink loss, and gentle grain, retaining the texture of paper fibers and art paper bases, avoiding smooth vectors, 3D rendering, photo filters, and over-refinement. The background is mainly off-white, warm white, or light paper color, retaining quiet and sufficient white space.

The color scheme extracts 2–4 most recognizable colors from the photo above, transforming them into a vivid but restrained, bright but not glaring flat color block system; it can be moderately purified, brightened, and organized to form a clear hierarchy of main colors, auxiliary colors, and a few finishing touches, which both retains the emotion and identity of the original image and has the contemporary high-end feel of folk art collage, avoiding gray/dirty, dull, cheap candy-like, and messy color schemes.

A small amount of text is involved, with no language restrictions. Based on the subject, location, emotion, cultural imagery, or symbolic meaning of the photo, freely refine short titles, small notes, numbers, color value markings, or explanatory fragments. The text should be small, light, and restrained, naturally falling in the white space or layout corners, forming an exquisite graphic-text relationship with the graphics, without stacking commercial titles.

The overall presentation features New Folk Art, paper-cut collage, symbolic shapes, printmaking texture, large white space, and editorial layout to form a high-end visual effect, referencing contemporary folk-art illustration with paper-cut collage aesthetics, symbolic geometric forms, screen-print texture and editorial layout. Avoid realistic illustration, complex perspective, overly dense details, cartoonishness, 3D feel, templated poster feel, and cheap cultural-creative product feel.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览图像质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的**主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系**，重构为**新民艺剪纸拼贴风的扁平化插画**。不要完整复制照片，而是删去无关细节，只保留最能代表原物的结构、走势与视觉记忆点，通过剪影、色块、刻线、正负形和少量层叠重新概括，使人能够一眼识别它与上方照片之间的对应关系。主体、植物、建筑、动物、器物或环境元素都应像一块块独立彩纸被重新组合，造型可适度稚拙、符号化、几何化，不追求写实透视和复杂细节，而强调文化感、手工感与当代设计感。

构图保持**小尺度主体 / 章印感主视觉 + 大面积留白**的关系，根据主体自身的方向、比例和视觉重心自由安排位置，可偏心、贴边或局部裁切，但始终保持清晰主次、疏密节奏和编辑式平衡。主体可集中于一侧或下方形成视觉落点，周围只保留极少量辅助元素，不形成多个同等焦点。

材质呈现**剪纸拼贴 + 版画印刷感**：色块边缘可略带手工剪切感、轻微套印偏差、掉墨感和温和颗粒，保留纸张纤维与艺术纸底的质感，避免光滑矢量、3D渲染、照片滤镜和过度精修。背景以米白、暖白或浅纸色为主，保留安静、充足的留白空间。

配色从上方照片中提取 **2–4 种最具辨识度** 的颜色，转化为**鲜明但克制、明快但不刺眼**的扁平色块系统；可适度提纯、提亮与整理，形成主色、辅助色和少量点睛色的清晰层级，既保留原图的情绪与身份，又具有民艺拼贴的当代高级感，避免灰脏、沉闷、廉价糖果感和杂乱配色。

文字少量介入，不限制语种。可根据照片的主体、地点、情绪、文化意象或象征意义，自由提炼简短标题、小字注释、编号、色值标注或说明片段。文字应小、轻、克制，自然落在留白区域或版面边角，与图形共同形成精致的图文关系，不做商业标题堆砌。

整体呈现**新民艺、剪纸拼贴、符号化造型、版画肌理、大面积留白与编辑式排版**共同构成的高级视觉效果，参考 contemporary folk-art illustration with paper-cut collage aesthetics, symbolic geometric forms, screen-print texture and editorial layout。避免写实插画、复杂透视、过密细节、卡通感、3D感、模板化海报感和廉价文创感。

items.title: 职场女性居家脱鞋写真超写实摄影

prompts.text:
9:16 vertical, full-body composition, hyper-realistic real-life photography × high-end professional fashion Editorial × lazy home atmosphere × warm cinematic feel. A 20–22-year-old, clearly adult beautiful East Asian female, height approximately 1.75 meters, with tall and slender fashion model proportions, a small head and face, relaxed neck and shoulders, slender and firm waist, and straight long legs. Visual chest size is approximately a natural E-cup, full but not overly exaggerated, naturally coordinated with the tall and slender overall figure.

The subject must present a real East Asian female face, small head, small face, exquisite and smooth oval face shape, clear jawline and slightly pointed chin, with a three-dimensional and natural bone structure. Long black hair tied into a clean and sharp high ponytail, with a small amount of stray hairs naturally falling on the sides of the ears. Makeup is exquisite and restrained, focused on natural foundation, slender eyeliner, light smoky eye shadow, and low-saturation moist lip color.

Skin is very fair, delicate, and transparent, presenting a clean and high-end cold white porcelain skin tone. The skin color of the face, neck, shoulders, collarbone, chest, arms, and legs is naturally unified, retaining real pores, fine fuzz, and a faint natural blood color, avoiding plastic skin smoothing.

The person is wearing a black high-end slim-fit professional suit; the blazer features a sharp waist-nipping cut, paired with a short slim-fit hip-hugging skirt, the fabric is high-end and crisp, with real stitching, folds, and delicate fabric textures.

The inner layer is changed to a white silk lace shirt, featuring an obvious large deep V low collar design, the V-shaped neckline naturally extends downwards, revealing more of the shoulder, neck, collarbone, and upper chest lines, naturally presenting the full curves of an E-cup vision. The white silk has a soft pearly luster, and the neckline is decorated with exquisite lace trim, forming a high-end black and white contrast with the black professional suit.

Legs are wearing thin light black stockings, the stockings have a natural translucent texture and delicate soft light, the leg contours are clear, maintaining real fabric textures.

The person is located in a high-end home bedroom, one hand naturally supporting the back of the sofa to maintain balance, the body slightly leaning forward or turning sideways, the waist naturally slightly twisted. The other hand is taking off a black patent leather pointed high-heeled shoe: one foot has already taken off the shoe, wearing only stockings and naturally stepping on the soft carpet; the other foot is still wearing the black pointed high-heeled shoe; the other shoe that has already been taken off is naturally placed near the floor. The entire movement is like a moment accidentally recorded when just returning to the bedroom and preparing to change shoes, the posture is relaxed, natural, and elegant, not deliberately posed.

The scene is a real high-end bedroom, visible cream-colored or warm gray high-end sofa, wooden side cabinet, soft carpet, bed and warm-toned bedding, adding a small amount of desk lamps, curtains, and simple daily necessities. The space is tidy but retains a real sense of living, avoiding a studio set feel.

Adopt a 9:16 full-body environmental portrait composition, from the complete top of the head, high ponytail, real face, deep V silk shirt, black professional suit, full legs, all the way to the feet that are taking off shoes, all in the frame. The subject occupies about 75%–85% of the frame height, retaining appropriate safety space at the top of the head and the bottom of the feet; the shoes and the action of taking off shoes must be completely visible, no cut-off feet.

The camera uses a natural perspective close to eye level and slightly low, approximately a 50–70mm full-frame portrait focal length, naturally strengthening the 1.75-meter tall proportion and long legs, while avoiding severe wide-angle distortion.

Soft warm-toned indoor ambient light illuminates the subject from the front-side, keeping the face and cold white skin bright and transparent; warm light forms delicate highlights of different materials on the surface of the black suit, white silk, lace trim, light black stockings, and patent leather high heels. Shadows are soft and retain rich details.

Overall style adopts 8K ultra-high-definition real-life photography texture, with the subject's eyes, real skin, hair strands, silk luster, lace texture, suit fabric, stocking fibers, patent leather shoe surface, and carpet details clearly visible. Natural shallow depth of field, the background is moderately softened but still maintains the recognizability of the bedroom environment, presenting a mature, elegant, restrained, and life-oriented high-end professional female portrait.

Core Keywords: 20–22-year-old adult East Asian female, 1.75 meters, tall and slender, small head and face, cold white porcelain skin, natural E-cup vision, black slim-fit professional suit, white silk lace large deep V shirt, high ponytail, light black stockings, black patent leather pointed high-heeled shoes, one hand supporting sofa, one hand taking off high-heeled shoe, one foot already took off shoe and stepping on ground, one foot still wearing shoe, full body, high-end bedroom, warm-toned soft light, 8K real-life photography.

Negative Keywords: Half-body photo, close-up crop, feet out of frame, shoe removal action not visible, both shoes worn, both feet barefoot, shoes floating, shoe structure error, sneakers, trousers, neckline too high, V-neck too shallow, chest overly exaggerated, big head, big face, short legs, 50/50 body proportions, imbalanced body proportions, severe wide-angle distortion, clothing clipping, damaged stockings or abnormal structure, deformed hands and feet, extra limbs, multiple hands and feet, too many or too few fingers, plastic skin, excessive skin smoothing, yellowish skin tone, severe overexposure, severe out of focus, anime face, CG face, AI artifacts, text, Logo, watermark.

prompts.text:
9:16 竖版，完整全身构图，超写实真人摄影 × 高级职业时尚 Editorial × 慵懒居家氛围 × 暖调电影感。一位 20–22 岁、明确成年的漂亮东亚女性，身高约 1.75 米，拥有高挑纤细的时装模特比例，头部偏小、脸型小巧，肩颈舒展，腰身纤细紧致，双腿笔直修长。胸部视觉约为自然 E 罩杯，丰满但不过度夸张，与高挑纤细的整体身材自然协调。

人物必须呈现真实东亚女性真人脸，小头、小脸，精致流畅的鹅蛋脸，清晰下颌线与微尖下巴，骨相立体自然。乌黑长发扎成干净利落的高马尾，少量碎发自然垂落在耳侧。妆容精致克制，以自然底妆、纤细眼线、淡淡烟熏眼影与低饱和水润唇色为主。

肌肤非常白皙、细腻、通透，呈干净高级的冷白瓷肌色调。脸部、颈部、肩部、锁骨、胸前、手臂与双腿肤色自然统一，保留真实毛孔、细小绒毛与淡淡自然血色，避免塑料磨皮。

人物身穿黑色高档修身职业套裙，西装外套采用利落收腰剪裁，搭配短款修身包臀裙，面料高级挺括，具有真实缝线、褶皱与细腻织物纹理。

内搭改为白色真丝蕾丝衬衫，采用明显的大深 V 低领设计，V 型领口自然向下延伸，露出较多肩颈、锁骨与上胸线条，自然呈现 E 罩杯视觉的丰满曲线。白色真丝具有柔和珍珠光泽，领口点缀精致蕾丝花边，与黑色职业套装形成高级黑白对比。

腿部穿着轻薄浅黑色丝袜，丝袜具有自然半透明质感与细腻柔光，腿部轮廓清晰，保持真实织物纹理。

人物位于高级居家卧室，一只手自然扶住沙发靠背保持平衡，身体轻微前倾或侧转，腰部自然微扭。另一只手正在脱下一只黑色漆皮尖头高跟鞋：一只脚已经脱鞋，仅穿丝袜自然踩在柔软地毯上；另一只脚仍穿着黑色尖头高跟鞋；另一只已经脱下的鞋自然摆放在地面附近。整个动作像刚回到卧室准备换鞋时被偶然记录的一瞬间，姿态松弛、自然、优雅，不刻意摆拍。

场景为真实高级卧室，可见奶油色或暖灰色高档沙发、木质边柜、柔软地毯、床铺与暖色床品，加入少量台灯、窗帘和简洁生活用品。空间整洁但保留真实居住感，避免影棚布景感。

采用 9:16 完整全身环境人像构图，从完整头顶、高马尾、真人面容、深 V 真丝衬衫、黑色职业套裙、完整双腿一直到正在脱鞋的双脚全部入镜。人物占画面高度约 75%–85%，头顶与脚底保留适量安全空间，鞋履和脱鞋动作必须完整可见，不裁脚。

摄影机采用接近平视、略微偏低的自然视角，约 50–70mm 全画幅人像焦段，自然强化 1.75 米高挑比例与修长腿部，同时避免严重广角畸变。

柔和暖调室内环境光从侧前方照亮人物，脸部与冷白肌肤保持明亮通透；暖光在黑色西装、白色真丝、蕾丝花边、浅黑丝袜与漆皮高跟鞋表面形成不同材质的细腻高光。阴影柔和并保留丰富细节。

整体采用8K 超高清真人摄影质感，人物眼睛、真人皮肤、发丝、真丝光泽、蕾丝纹理、西装织物、丝袜纤维、漆皮鞋面与地毯细节清晰可见。自然浅景深，背景适度柔化但仍保持卧室环境辨识度，呈现成熟、优雅、克制、生活化的高级职业女性写真。

核心关键词： 20–22 岁成年东亚女性，1.75 米，高挑纤细，小头小脸，冷白瓷肌，自然 E 罩杯视觉，黑色修身职业套裙，白色真丝蕾丝大深 V 衬衫，高马尾，浅黑丝袜，黑色漆皮尖头高跟鞋，一手扶沙发、一手脱高跟鞋，一脚已经脱鞋踩地、一脚仍穿鞋，完整全身，高级卧室，暖调柔光，8K 真人摄影。

负面提示词： 半身照，近景裁切，双脚出画，脱鞋动作不可见，两只鞋都穿着，两只脚都赤脚，鞋子悬浮，鞋子结构错误，运动鞋，长裤，领口过高，V 领过浅，胸部过度夸张，大头，大脸，短腿，五五分身材，身体比例失衡，严重广角畸变，衣物穿模，丝袜破损或结构异常，手脚畸形，多余肢体，多手多脚，多指少指，塑料皮肤，过度磨皮，肤色偏黄，严重过曝，严重失焦，动漫脸，CG脸，AI 伪影，文字，Logo，水印。

prompts.text:
## Scene / Background

Photorealistic full-body urban fashion photograph of a young adult woman seated on the edge of a large dark charcoal-gray stone or granite ledge in a modern downtown business district. Tall contemporary office buildings form a dense urban canyon on both sides, with glass façades, dark architectural columns, concrete surfaces, and distant high-rise structures. A broad pale-gray stone-paved pedestrian plaza extends into the background. Several casually dressed pedestrians and businesspeople walk through the scene, softly blurred by shallow depth of field. Large planters with greenery are visible in the distance. Bright natural daytime light, soft overcast-to-neutral illumination, realistic urban textures, subtle atmospheric depth, and a sophisticated editorial street-fashion aesthetic.

## Main Description

A young adult woman with long, dark brown hair sits sideways on the stone ledge, facing the camera with a calm, confident expression. Her hair is parted near the center and falls naturally over her shoulders and down her back. She wears a fitted short-sleeved teal/turquoise dress with a high neckline and an ornate cream, gold, and warm-brown baroque-inspired decorative pattern featuring intricate chain-like and ornamental motifs. The dress is closely fitted through the torso and hips and ends above the knees.

She sits with one leg crossed over the other, creating an elegant elongated pose. Her upper body is slightly angled toward the camera. One elbow rests against her knee while her raised hand gently touches beneath her chin. Her gaze is directed naturally toward the camera. Her posture is poised and relaxed rather than exaggerated.

She wears several prominent turquoise gemstone rings with metallic settings on the raised hand, along with delicate jewelry details. Her footwear consists of minimalist nude/beige strappy high-heeled sandals with thin stiletto heels and a delicate gold anklet. Her toenails are neatly manicured in a pale neutral shade.

She possesses the best head-to-body ratio, a perfect, curvaceous, S-shaped female figure, long legs with perfect leg lines, and a slender waist, perfect foots,perfect foot lines

## Key Details

* Photorealistic fashion photography
* Young adult woman, natural realistic facial features
* Long dark-brown hair, center part, naturally flowing
* Calm, composed, confident facial expression
* Direct eye contact with the camera
* Fitted teal/turquoise short-sleeved dress
* High neckline
* Intricate cream, gold, and brown ornamental/baroque pattern
* Elegant seated pose on a dark granite/stone ledge
* Legs crossed naturally and fully visible
* One hand raised beneath the chin
* Multiple turquoise gemstone rings
* Minimal nude/beige strappy stiletto sandals
* Thin gold anklet
* Pale neutral manicure/pedicure
* Modern downtown office architecture
* Pale-gray paved plaza
* Dark architectural columns and glass façades
* Background pedestrians naturally present but out of focus
* Subtle greenery in distant planters
* Natural daylight
* Realistic skin texture and fabric texture
* Shallow depth of field with clear subject separation
* Mild background bokeh
* Eye-level fashion-photography perspective with enough distance to include the entire body and footwear
* Vertical portrait composition
* Subject centered slightly right of frame
* High detail, realistic proportions, natural anatomy
* Sophisticated luxury street-fashion/editorial photography

## Constraints

* Preserve the complete full-body composition, including both feet and high heels.
* Preserve the seated sideways posture and crossed-leg arrangement.
* Preserve the raised hand beneath the chin and direct gaze toward the camera.
* Keep the dress predominantly teal/turquoise with cream, gold, and brown ornamental detailing.
* Keep the footwear nude/beige and minimalist with thin stiletto heels.
* Keep the turquoise gemstone rings visually prominent.
* Background architecture must remain recognizable as a modern downtown business district while staying softer and less detailed than the subject.
* Pedestrians should remain secondary, naturally positioned, and softly out of focus.
* Maintain realistic human anatomy, natural hands and fingers, correct limb proportions, and physically plausible posture.
* No extra limbs, fingers, hands, feet, jewelry, clothing elements, or duplicated objects.
* No distorted facial features, plastic-looking skin, excessive retouching, cartoon styling, illustration, or CGI appearance.
* No dramatic studio lighting; retain natural outdoor daylight.
* No excessive lens distortion or extreme wide-angle perspective.
* Maintain realistic photographic depth, texture, shadows, and color relationships.

prompts.text:
## 场景 / 背景

一张位于现代市中心商业区，一名年轻成年女性坐在巨大的深炭灰色石头或花岗岩窗台边缘的写实全身都市时尚照片。高耸的当代办公楼在两侧形成了密集的都市峡谷，拥有玻璃幕墙、深色建筑柱、混凝土表面和远处的摩天大楼。广阔的浅灰色石板铺就的行人广场延伸至背景。几名穿着休闲的行人和商务人士走过场景，被浅景深轻轻虚化。远处可见带有绿植的大型花坛。明亮的自然白光，柔和的阴天至中性照明，真实的都市纹理，微妙的大气深度，以及精致的社论街头时尚美学。

## 主要描写

一名留着深棕色长发的年轻成年女性侧身坐在石台上，表情冷静自信地面对镜头。她的头发近乎中分，自然地垂在肩膀和背部。她穿着一件合身的短袖鸭蛋青/绿松石色连衣裙，高领口，带有华丽的米色、金色和暖棕色巴洛克风格装饰图案，具有复杂的链条状和装饰性图案。连衣裙在躯干和臀部处紧身合体，长度在膝盖以上。

她坐着，一条腿叠在另一条腿上，营造出优雅修长的姿态。她的上半身略微倾向镜头。一只手肘抵在膝盖上，抬起的手轻轻触碰下巴下方。她的目光自然地直视镜头。她的姿势沉稳放松，而非夸张。

她在抬起的手上戴着几枚带有金属镶嵌的显眼绿松石宝石戒指，以及精致的珠宝细节。她的鞋子由简约的裸色/米色细带高跟凉鞋组成，配有细跟和精致的金脚链。她的脚趾甲修剪整齐，涂有浅中性色调。

她拥有最佳的头身比，完美的曲线型S形女性身材，拥有完美腿部线条的长腿，以及纤细的腰部，完美的脚部，完美的脚部线条。

## 关键细节

* 写实时尚摄影
* 年轻成年女性，自然写实的五官
* 深棕色长发，中分，自然飘逸
* 冷静、沉着、自信的面部表情
* 与镜头直接眼神接触
* 合身的鸭蛋青/绿松石色短袖连衣裙
* 高领口
* 复杂的米色、金色和棕色装饰/巴洛克图案
* 在深色花岗岩/石台上优雅的坐姿
* 双腿自然交叉并完全可见
* 一只手举在下巴下方
* 多枚绿松石宝石戒指
* 简约裸色/米色细带细高跟凉鞋
* 细金脚链
* 浅色中性美甲/美足
* 现代市中心办公建筑
* 浅灰色铺路广场
* 深色建筑柱和玻璃幕墙
* 背景行人自然存在但焦外模糊
* 远处花坛中的微妙绿植
* 自然日光
* 真实的皮肤纹理和织物纹理
* 具有清晰主体分离感的浅景深

* 眼平高度时尚摄影视角，距离足以包含全身和鞋履

* 高细节，写实比例，自然解剖结构

## 约束条件

* 保留完整的全身构图，包括双脚和高跟鞋。
* 保留侧坐姿势和交叉腿安排。
* 保留抬手托下巴和直视镜头的目光。

* 保持绿松石宝石戒指视觉突出。
* 背景建筑必须保持可辨认为现代市中心商业区，同时比主体更柔和、细节更少。

* 保持真实的解剖结构，自然的手和手指，正确的肢体比例，以及物理上合理的姿势。
* 不得出现额外的肢体、手指、手、脚、珠宝、服装元素或重复物体。

prompts.text:
Create one independent high-end editorial poster for each uploaded photo. Do not combine multiple photos into a collage. Each photo must be processed and output as a separate poster.

OVERALL FORMAT

Strict 3:4 vertical composition.

Divide the canvas horizontally into two exactly equal sections, with a precise 1:1 height ratio.

The top half occupies exactly 50% of the canvas.

The bottom half occupies exactly 50% of the canvas.

The two sections should feel visually connected as one refined art publication cover.

TOP HALF — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH

Preserve the original photograph as faithfully as possible.

Keep the main composition, subjects, identity, facial features, body proportions, poses, expressions, clothing, objects, and spatial relationships unchanged.

Preserve the realistic photographic texture, natural lighting, shadows, atmosphere, and original color mood.

Apply only subtle, sophisticated editorial color grading, creating the feeling of a premium magazine photograph, contemporary art book, or high-end independent publication.

The image should remain photorealistic and authentic, never overly retouched or artificially stylized.

If necessary to fit the 3:4 composition naturally, extend the sky, ground, walls, or surrounding environmental background.

Background extension must feel seamless and photographic.

Never stretch, distort, reshape, replace, or alter the main subject.

BOTTOM HALF — MINIMAL HAND-DRAWN PAPER ILLUSTRATION

Extract the most recognizable visual elements from the original photograph and reinterpret them as a minimalist hand-drawn paper-cover illustration.

Preserve:

The most recognizable subject

Essential silhouette and proportions

Key pose or gesture

Important objects

The core narrative relationship between people and objects

Highly simplify the image. Remove unnecessary details and retain only the visual information needed for immediate recognition.

Use:

Delicate, slightly imperfect hand-drawn lines

A small number of bold, clearly defined acrylic-style flat color shapes

Rough paper texture

Visible handmade brush marks

Slightly irregular, organic edges

Subtle imperfections that make it feel genuinely handmade

The main illustrated subject should be small, centered, and carefully composed, occupying approximately 10–20% of the bottom half.

Leave a large amount of negative space around the illustration.

The background should primarily resemble:

Rough white paper

Warm off-white paper

Pale natural paper

Minimal editorial book-cover stock

Use only a few lines or small color shapes to suggest the surrounding environment.

COLOR PALETTE

Extract the dominant colors directly from the original photograph.

Compress the palette into no more than 4 main colors.

Keep the colors restrained, sophisticated, and harmonious.

Use bold but controlled flat color blocks.

Avoid excessive color variation.

Preserve subtle paper grain and handmade brush texture.

The illustration should visually feel like a simplified color interpretation of the photograph.

TYPOGRAPHY

A small amount of simple typography may be included when appropriate.

Possible elements:

A short title

Keyword

Object name

Location

Year

Number

Short phrase

Text should be minimal, understated, and editorial.

Typography should naturally interact with the large areas of negative space and the small illustration, evoking:

Art book covers

Independent publishing

Contemporary editorial design

Thoughtful children's picture books

Do not force text into the composition if it does not naturally fit the photograph.

VISUAL LANGUAGE

The final poster should feel:

Quiet · Poetic · Refined · Minimal · Innocent · Relaxed · Artistic · Thoughtful · High-recognition · Premium

The visual concept should be:

“A small subject surrounded by a large amount of empty space.”

The result should resemble a carefully designed independent art publication cover, rather than a commercial advertisement.

AVOID

Do not use:

Colored-pencil aesthetics

Crayon textures

Bleeding watercolor

Pure line-art illustration

Complex realistic illustration

Heavy oil-painting effects

Smooth polished digital illustration

3D rendering

Glossy 3D textures

Commercial cartoon aesthetics

Cute commercial character design

E-commerce advertising aesthetics

Generic poster templates

Excessive decorative elements

Busy compositions

Excessive typography

FINAL ART DIRECTION

The top half should feel like a beautiful, authentic editorial photograph.

The bottom half should feel like a small, handmade visual poem derived from that photograph.

The two halves should clearly belong to the same visual story, while maintaining a strong contrast between photographic realism above and minimal handmade illustration below.

Prioritize recognition, restraint, negative space, material texture, subtle imperfection, editorial sophistication, and artistic storytelling over decorative complexity.

prompts.text:
为每张上传的照片创建一张独立的高端编辑海报。不要将多张照片合并为拼贴画。每张照片必须作为独立的海报进行处理和输出。

整体格式

严格的 3:4 纵向构图。

将画布水平分为两个完全相等的部分，高度比例精确为 1:1。

上半部分正好占据画布的 50%。

下半部分正好占据画布的 50%。

这两个部分在视觉上应感觉像是一个精致的艺术出版物封面。

上半部分 — 原始照片

尽可能忠实地保留原始照片。

保持主要构图、主体、身份、面部特征、身体比例、姿势、表情、服装、物体和空间关系不变。

保留真实的照片质感、自然光线、阴影、氛围和原始色彩基调。

仅应用微妙、高级的编辑色彩分级，营造出优质杂志照片、当代艺术书籍或高端独立出版物的感觉。

图像应保持写实和真实，切勿过度修饰或人工风格化。

如果为了自然适应 3:4 构图而有必要，请延伸天空、地面、墙壁或周围的环境背景。

背景延伸必须感觉无缝且具有照片感。

绝不拉伸、扭曲、重塑、替换或改变主体。

下半部分 — 极简手绘纸张插画

从原始照片中提取最具辨识度的视觉元素，并将其重新诠释为极简手绘纸质封面插画。

保留：

最具辨识度的主体

基本的轮廓和比例

关键姿势或手势

重要物体

人物与物体之间的核心叙事关系

高度简化图像。去除不必要的细节，仅保留即时识别所需的视觉信息。

使用：

细腻、略带瑕疵的手绘线条

少量大胆、定义明确的丙烯风格平涂形状

粗糙的纸张质感

可见的手工刷痕

略微不规则的有机边缘

使其感觉真实手工制作的细微瑕疵

插画主体应小巧、居中并精心构图，占据下半部分约 10–20% 的空间。

在插画周围留出大量负空间。

背景应主要类似于：

粗糙的白纸

温暖的米白色纸

淡雅的天然纸张

极简编辑书封纸张

仅使用几根线条或小的色块来暗示周围环境。

调色板

直接从原始照片中提取主导颜色。

将调色板压缩为不超过 4 种主色。

保持色彩克制、高级且和谐。

使用大胆但受控的平涂色块。

避免过度的色彩变化。

保留细微的纸张颗粒和手工笔触质感。

插画在视觉上应感觉像是照片的简化色彩诠释。

排版

在合适时可以包含少量简单的排版。

可能的元素：

短标题

关键词

物品名称

地点

年份

数字

短语

文字应极简、低调且具编辑感。

排版应自然地与大面积的负空间和小插图互动，让人联想到：

艺术书封面

独立出版

当代编辑设计

深刻的儿童绘本

如果文字与照片不自然契合，请勿强行加入构图。

视觉语言

最终海报应感觉：

宁静 · 诗意 · 精致 · 极简 · 纯真 · 放松 · 艺术感 · 深刻 · 高辨识度 · 优质

视觉概念应为：

“大面积留白围绕的小主体”

结果应类似于精心设计的独立艺术出版物封面，而非商业广告。

避免

不要使用：

彩色铅笔美学

蜡笔纹理

晕染水彩

纯线条画插图

复杂的写实插图

沉重的油画效果

光滑打磨的数字插图

3D 渲染

光亮的 3D 纹理

商业卡通美学

可爱的商业角色设计

电子商务广告美学

通用海报模板

过多的装饰元素

繁忙的构图

过多的排版

最终艺术指导

prompts.text:

[COUNTRY]

低饱和度调色，略显冷色调和灰色，不带浓重的蓝色。微妙的智能手机颗粒感，轻微的数字锐化，细小的压缩痕迹，普通的阴天微对比度。没有过度的 HDR。相当深的类手机景深：女性清晰对焦；海水、山脉、远处的建筑物、帆船保持可辨认，主要因距离和大气遮蔽而软化，而非人工大光圈虚化。
