items.title: 东方诗意留白艺术海报提示词

prompts.text:
[Original Poetry Sentence]: Fill in a line of ancient poetry with subtle emotions and imagery
[Two-Character Theme]: Extract 2 core characters from the poem
[Core Emotion]:
[Small Subject]:
[Main Color System]:
[Shallow Embossing]:
[Location and Date]:

Generate a 9:16 vertical Oriental poetic white space art poster, transforming the [Core Emotion] from the [Original Poetry Sentence] into a visible emotional state.

Use pure white or slightly cool-toned high-end handmade art paper as the background, preserving real paper fibers, pulp particles, and natural indentations. Maintain approximately 65%–75% effective white space; the main subject should not be too large, the [Small Subject] is suggested to occupy only about 8%–20% of the frame, letting the white space itself participate in expressing distance, waiting, memory, and a sense of incompleteness.

Do not directly replicate the complete scene from the poem, but instead choose a small and clear object as an emotional anchor, then express the emotional state through color changes, disappearance, accumulation, afterimages, or movement paths.

Add a low-contrast bas-relief [Shallow Embossing] related to the theme in the background. The embossing must not be just decorative, but must represent traces that once existed, are changing, or have not yet arrived, such as gradually rising old water levels, repeated misaligned butterfly wings, fading flower shadows, wing marks after flying, or wind lines extending into the distance. Keep it clean from afar, and only discover hidden information when looking closely.

Use [Main Color System] for colors, which can be vivid, beautiful, and emotional; do not use only black, white, and gray just because the theme is sad. Colors should naturally produce shade, fading, transparency, or dissipation relationships with distance, time, or state.

All water lines, silk threads, wind lines, rain marks, and movement trajectories must be continuous, soft, and natural, avoiding a large number of break points, fragmented lines, and messy AI textures.

Extremely small figures can be added, but they don't have to appear in every image. Figures are only used to establish scale and emotion; they do not cry or perform dramatic actions. Figures can also be completely removed, letting small subjects like flowers, rain, butterflies, or birds independently carry the narrative.

Use the [Two-Character Theme] for the main Chinese title, using modern Songti, Mingti, or editorial-style Chinese serif fonts. Design sense can be added through character spacing, slight misalignment, thin lines, or partial extensions, but the Chinese characters must be complete, accurate, and clear.

At the same time, add small font poetry lines, location, date, and a short English title.

The overall effect should be like a combination of classical poetry emotion, paper material experimentation, bas-relief art, and modern Editorial Design: concise with white space at first glance, seeing the subject at the second glance, and only discovering those "unfinished" traces when looking closely.

prompts.text:

【小主体】：

【浅压纹】：

生成一张 9:16 竖版东方诗意留白艺术海报，将【诗词原句】中的【核心情绪】转化为一种可以被看见的情绪状态。

使用纯白或轻微冷调的高级手工艺术纸作为背景，保留真实纸纤维、纸浆颗粒和自然压痕。保持约 65%–75% 的有效留白，主体不要过大，【小主体】建议只占画面约 8%–20%，让空白本身参与表达距离、等待、记忆与未完成感。

不要直接复刻诗句中的完整场景，而是选择一个小而明确的物件作为情绪锚点，再通过颜色变化、消失、堆积、残影或运动路径表现情绪状态。

背景加入与主题有关的低对比浅浮雕【浅压纹】。压纹不能只是装饰，而要表现曾经存在、正在变化或尚未抵达的痕迹，例如逐渐上涨的旧水位、重复错位的蝶翼、褪色花影、飞过后的翼痕或延向远方的风线。远看保持干净，近看才发现隐藏的信息。

色彩使用【主色体系】，可以鲜明、漂亮、有情绪，不要因为主题忧伤就全部使用黑白灰。颜色应随着距离、时间或状态自然产生浓淡、褪色、透明或消散关系。

所有水线、丝线、风线、雨痕和运动轨迹必须连续、柔和、自然，避免大量断点、碎线和杂乱 AI 纹理。

可加入极小人物，但不是每张都必须出现。人物只用于建立尺度与情绪，不哭泣、不做戏剧化动作。也可以完全取消人物，让花、雨、蝶、鸟等小主体独立承担叙事。

中文主标题使用【两字主题】，采用现代宋体、明朝体或具有编辑感的中文衬线字体，可通过字距、轻微错位、细线或局部延伸增加设计感，但必须保证汉字完整、准确、清晰。

同时加入小字号诗句、地点、日期和简短英文标题。

整体效果应像古典诗词情绪、纸张材料实验、浅浮雕艺术与现代 Editorial Design 的结合：第一眼简洁、有留白，第二眼看到主体，近看才发现那些“没有说完”的痕迹。

prompts.text:
Please create a high-end design poster of the same scene from the uploaded photo in the current layer, not a multi-photo collage, output each photo individually. 'Not a multi-photo collage' here means: do not mix different uploaded photos into the same finished product; each uploaded photo must independently generate a complete four-layer style poster.

【Overall Aspect Ratio and Four-Layer Structure】
The overall layout uses a 3:4 vertical composition. The image is strictly divided into four equal horizontal areas from top to bottom, and the height of each area must precisely account for 25% of the overall image height. The ratio of the four layers is strictly 1:1:1:1, and no ratio deviation is allowed. The four layers are seamlessly connected, with no dividing lines, no white gaps, and no borders.

Since each layer is actually an extremely flat banner of approximately 3:1, the subject needs to be horizontally adapted within each layer: maintain the stability of the subject's main position and visual focus, prioritize horizontal expansion, and avoid the subject being vertically stretched, squashed, pushed to the edge, or having key parts cropped. The sky, walls, ground, water surface, paper, or environmental whitespace consistent with the original image can be extended to the left and right, but blurred background duplication must not be used for filling.

【Consistency Across Four Layers】
The four layers must come from the same uploaded photo and the same moment. Strictly maintain the consistency of the subject's identity, number of subjects, the facial features of people or animals, posture, movement direction, gaze, core features of hairstyle and clothing, architectural structure, landmark identity, main object relationships, observation angle, perspective direction, left-right positioning, front-back hierarchy, and narrative relationship. 
The style layers are allowed to delete secondary backgrounds, reduce textures, and change materials and detail density according to their respective media, but the subject cannot be replaced with another person, another building, another car, another animal, or another scene.

【Layer 1 | Original Photography】
The first layer faithfully preserves the real photographic texture of the uploaded photo. Retain the subject's identity, quantity, compositional relationship, posture, movement, real materials, natural lighting and shadows, comprehensive color temperature, and scene atmosphere. Only restrained high-end photography-grade color grading, exposure and contrast fine-tuning, and extremely slight delicate grain optimization are allowed. 
To adapt to the current approximately 3:1 banner, natural cropping or extending the environmental edges consistent with the original scene can be performed, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, mirrored, copied, key objects moved, architectural structure changed, or characters redesigned. 
The first layer does not add extra text, brand logos, borders, watermarks, or decorative elements.

【Layer 2 | 1970s Animation Style Black and White Ink Drawing | Current Layer Adaptation Rules】
This layer only accounts for 25% of the height of the entire 3:4 four-split poster, which is actually an extremely flat horizontal area of approximately 3:1. The following style instructions are all executed "within the current layer". 
Any expressions appearing in the source prompt such as independent poster, entire image, vertical ratio, separate output, etc., must not change the overall four-split structure; the current layer's approximately 3:1 flat horizontal ratio is the highest priority. 
Do not generate an original image comparison area, a second photo, top-bottom split screens, or extra multi-grids within the current layer. If there are recomposition requirements in the source prompt, only refinement of background information, materials, whitespace, and secondary elements is allowed; the subject's identity, quantity, key posture, movement direction, observation perspective, main perspective, left-right position, and core spatial relationship must not be changed. 
If text is an important component of the source style, it is retained, but it must be reduced to the minimum necessary number that can be clearly read in the current layer; if the source prompt explicitly requires no text, maintain no text.

【Source Style Complete Translation Description】
Create a black and white ink drawing of the [subject]. Emphasize expressive features, using 1970s 2D animation aesthetics, rough high-contrast outlines, sharp and clear line art, minimalist yet hierarchical line widths, and animation clean-up style. The image uses a high-key composition and a pure white background, using only black and white colors, without adding shadows, colors, or grayscale.

【Layer 3 | Coarse Grain Limited Color Travel Relief Print | Current Layer Adaptation Rules】
This layer only accounts for 25% of the height of the entire 3:4 four-split poster, which is actually an extremely flat horizontal area of approximately 3:1. The following style instructions are all executed "within the current layer".

If text is an important component of the source style, it is retained, but it must be reduced to the minimum necessary number that can be clearly read in the current layer; if the source prompt explicitly requires no text, maintain no text.

【Source Style Complete Translation Description】
Please use the currently uploaded photo as the only reference and make it into a high-end limited color travel relief print poster in the current layer. Use an approximately 3:1 flat horizontal composition for the current layer; the current layer only presents this style translation and does not set an additional original photo comparison area.

Travel Relief Print

The image uses a warm cream or ivory natural printmaking paper background.
The paper should have: visible paper grain, subtle paper fibers, a slightly rough matte surface, warm archival paper, natural pigment absorption.

Select the most recognizable subject from the original uploaded photo, or a scene as a whole that can represent the meaning of the photo, and remake it into an independent "travel print mark" floating on the paper.

Retain what determines the recognizability of the original photo:
- Subject's outer contour
- Posture or direction of movement
- Main light and dark divisions
- Perspective direction
- Key structures
- Material texture rhythm
- Signature colors
- Most important spatial relationships

Actively delete:
- Complex backgrounds
- Repetitive architectural structures
- Large numbers of windows
- Dense crowds
- Irrelevant vehicles
- Tiny signs
- Clutter
- Fine textures
- Secondary objects
- Text that cannot be accurately generated

The current layer is not about reducing the saturation of the entire photo, adding grain, or applying a print filter. It must first understand the most important visual information in the photo, then re-plate, compress, color-set, and print it.

IV. Printmaking Media and Texture
Use the following mixed printmaking language: Travel relief print, limited color palette screen printing, coarse lithography, woodcut texture, linocut texture, stencil printing, compressed photographic texture, handmade printmaking, worn pigment, broken halftones, irregular ink coverage, rough dry brush edges, paper showing through, slight color registration offset, grainy shadows, handmade masking boundaries, natural ink deficiency. 
The print should have the texture of coarse grain, handmade overprinting, and old travel prints. Pigments are opaque, matte printing inks, not transparent watercolors.

Allowed:
- Uneven ink coverage
- Local ink deficiency
- Broken halftones
- Rough dry brush edges
- Paper showing through
- Slight color registration offset
- Granular shadows
- Irregular boundaries of manual masking
- Partial wear
- A small amount of original photo texture after compression

Different color layers should look like they were overprinted on the paper separately, rather than smoothly blended through digital gradients. Do not use precise vector strokes. Do not let the subject become a corporate brand logo, clean icon, or common flat illustration.

V. Current Layer Composition
The print subject is placed in the center or slightly upper part of the image. The subject accounts for about 38%–52% of the height of the current layer, naturally adjusted according to the photo content. The print subject cannot fill the entire frame; a large amount of warm ivory paper whitespace must be reserved around it. The edges of the subject cannot form a complete rectangular photo frame. Use the following methods to make the edges disappear naturally: Irregular brush printing, torn-like ink edges, broken halftones, ink-deficient areas, gradually decreasing grain, paper naturally showing through, partial structural interruptions. The overall feel is like "a travel memory being imprinted on paper". 
Landscape photos can retain a small amount of terrain, skyline, water surface, or architectural rhythm, but cannot completely reconstruct all backgrounds. Photos of people or vehicles should prioritize highlighting the subject's contour, posture, and direction of movement. Architectural photos should retain the most recognizable volumes, roofs, window-to-wall ratios, or structural rhythms.

VI. Limited Color Palette
Extract 3–5 main colors from the original uploaded photo and compress them into a high-contrast, matte, limited ink color palette. Usually includes: One darkest contour ink color, one warm paper base color, one to two subject colors, one small area highlight or signature color. 
Warm-toned photos can use: ochre orange, brick red, burnt yellow, olive green, charcoal gray, warm beige. 
Cool-toned photos can use: gray-blue, sea blue-green, dark green, graphite gray, mist gray, and warm ivory. 
Night scenes can use: dark dark green, charcoal black, faded blue, dark red, and a small amount of warm yellow light. 
Keep one bright color from the original photo that is most recognizable as a visual memory point, but do not use many bright colors simultaneously. All colors must look like layers of physical ink overprinted. Smooth digital gradients, neon glows, high-saturation commercial color matching, and transparent watercolor smudging are prohibited.

VII. Text System
Place a minimal amount of text below the print subject. The main title uses the following exact text: "[English Main Title]". The main title is limited to 1–3 English words, using a restrained typewriter font, monospaced serif, or old archive font, horizontally centered. Below the main title, place the following accurate travel keywords: "[Keyword 1 / Keyword 2 / Keyword 3]". Keywords use 3–5 short English words, separated by slashes, smaller than the main title, with natural letter spacing, like typed descriptions on the back of old travel photos. All text must be verbatim accurate; no modification, addition, deletion, misspelling, or extra characters generated. Except for the above two lines, do not add numbers, years, brands, brand logos, QR codes, URLs, slogans, long paragraphs, or meaningless text. If no text is provided, maintain a no-text design and do not fabricate titles.

VIII. Overall Temperament
The overall should look like a small limited-edition print made from travel photography: direct, simple, nostalgic, warm, quiet, coarse, with a slight sense of adventure and personal travel memory. High-end quality comes from: accurate limited color palette, subject information compression, coarse grain printing texture, incomplete print edges, paper whitespace, restrained text, and visual correspondence with the original photo in terms of subject, color, and narrative. It is not traditional realistic painting, nor is it an ordinary photo filter. It is a mark of travel memory remade from the original photo.

IX. Mandatory Avoidance
Avoid: multi-photo collages, grid layouts, poster display mockups, photo frames, wall scenes, hand-held posters, illustrationizing the original photo area, redrawing photos, changing subject identity, changing facial features, changing posture, changing architectural structure, copying objects, mirroring expansion, stretching photos, blurred photo side filling, applying a print filter to the entire poster, clean vector strokes, smooth digital gradients, smooth flat illustrations, generic brand logo silhouettes, complete rectangular photo crops, detailed background reconstruction, watercolor smudging, transparent watercolor, sticker collage, travel icons, airplane icons, passport graphics, map pins, architectural blueprint lines, random circles, decorative grids, smooth 3D effects, anime, cartoons, neon colors, full-frame filling, hard rectangular photo frames, excessive typography, fictional brands, garbled text, watermarks, cheap souvenir templates.

Most important rule: The print must accurately correspond to the most important subject or scene in the current original photo. The image must remake the most important subject or scene in the original photo into a limited-color, coarse-grained, incomplete-edged travel print mark floating in a large area of ivory paper whitespace. The entire poster must be completed in one generation; do not generate materials separately, do not use code for splicing, and do not output multiple images.

【Layer 4 | Landmark Geometric Engraving Composition Poster | Current Layer Adaptation Rules】
This layer only accounts for 25% of the height of the entire 3:4 four-split poster, which is actually an extremely flat horizontal area of approximately 3:1. The following style instructions are all executed "within the current layer".

【Source Style Complete Translation Description】
Please translate each travel photo I upload into an independent high-end landmark art poster. Default to using the current layer's approximately 3:1 flat horizontal composition; do not keep top-bottom split screens, and do not show the original photo area, photo frames, walls, or hand-held display mockups.

First, understand the visual structure that truly determines the recognition of the location, and select a set of the most important subject relationships from buildings, monuments, bridges, towers, stations, ships, peaks, islands, coastlines, or city skylines.

Accurately retain in the original photo:
- Landmark identity and number of subjects
- Observation angle and spatial direction

- Roof rhythm, tower ratio, bridge spans, arch openings, or main openings
- Ridges, shorelines, water baselines and key negative shapes

Actively delete: tourists, vehicles, dense vegetation, advertisements, window panes, tiny text, decorative components, and photographic noise. Do not add buildings, vehicles, cultural symbols, or a second landmark that do not exist in the photo to enhance the "sense of locality".

Remake the subject as a coarse black architectural engraving. Integrate woodcut, drypoint, copperplate etching, and old-fashioned screen printing languages, expressing form through dense but uneven hatching, cross-hatching, broken ink surfaces, score marks, dry brush gaps, local ink leakage, rough edges, and paper showing through.

The subject cannot be a smooth black silhouette, nor can it be like automatic photo outlining. White architectural walls, snow, sky openings, and water highlights can be directly expressed using paper negative shapes, letting the whitespace truly participate in the subject structure.

Place 2 to 3 large modernist geometric blocks behind the subject. All geometric shapes must be extracted from the structure, contour, or negative shapes of the current photo itself, for example:
- Extract circles, semicircles, or low ellipses from the sun, dome, mountain, or visual center;
- Extract vertical arches and curved surfaces from archways, doorways, tower bodies, sails, valleys, or curved roofs;
- Extract tilted or angular blocks from triangular roofs, hillsides, bridge spans, and architectural polylines;
- Extract narrow crescents, black slices, or upright structures from the side of the subject, structural thickness, distant mountains, and spatial shadows.

Different photos must produce different geometric combinations based on their respective subjects. Do not mechanically add the same circle, archway, or sun to all works. Geometric blocks are responsible for organizing space and rhythm and must not become brand logos, badges, or pure decorative patterns.

Geometric color plates need to have a real plate-making texture, including slight overprinting deviations, worn edges, uneven ink color, grain, scratches, nicks, and local paper showing through. Avoid clean vector graphics, digital gradients, and smooth software edges.

The entire image uses warm ivory, old book page beige, or light taupe printmaking paper. The paper has fine fibers, slight indentations, ink stains, and natural wear, but the aging must be restrained; do not have burnt edges, treasure map effects, or full-page stains.

Compress the subject and geometric color plates into a compact visual island, accounting for about 32% to 52% of the image, placed in the lower center, bottom left, or bottom right according to the original photo's center of gravity. Above, at least about 30% to 40% of continuous whitespace is reserved, and sufficient breathing room should also be maintained on the left and right.

Do not fill the canvas with the landscape according to the original photo. The sky, air, distance, and complex background in the photo can be represented directly by the blank paper.

- One matte spot color extracted and summarized from the original photo

The spot color can be brick red, ochre yellow, dark orange, gray-blue, moss green, olive, or other most representative colors according to the photo, but each work uses only one main spot color. When necessary, a very light version of the same spot color is allowed; do not use colorful collages.

Default to not generating any text. Only when explicitly requested by the user, add a small title of 1 to 3 English words or a number on the edge of the whitespace away from the subject. Prohibit author names, photographer names, signatures, seals, pseudo-calligraphy, accounts, brand logos, and watermarks.

The overall should have the temperament of modernist editorial design, architectural printmaking, coarse screen printing, and collection-level independent publications: restrained, quiet, rough, clearly structured, with a real handmade plate-making feel and large areas of whitespace.

Avoid: Full background coverage, precise tracing of photos, fictional second landmarks, generic landmark templates, fixed arch compositions, random circles, brand logo style compositions, clean vector geometry, smooth digital gradients, flat black silhouettes, photo filters, watercolors, smooth 3D effects, complete landscape reconstruction, crowded collages, multi-color palettes, neon colors, burnt parchment edges, treasure map-style aging, pseudo-calligraphy, author names, signatures, seals, brand logos, watermarks.

【Final Unified Check】
1. The height of the four layers must strictly account for 25% each, and the order must not be changed.
2. No borders, dividing lines, whitespace gaps, or card-style spacing should appear between the four layers.
3. The first layer maintains real photography; layers 2 to 4 strictly execute their respective source styles and do not mix media.
4. Subject identity, quantity, posture, movement direction, perspective, key perspective, left-right positioning, and core spatial relationships must be continuous and consistent.
5. Do not mix different uploaded photos into the same poster.
6. Do not add subjects, landmarks, people, vehicles, or key narrative objects that do not exist in the photo due to stylization.
7. Unless a source style clearly requires text, do not add extra text; all text must be spelled correctly, clearly legible, and no garbled characters, pseudo-text, brand logos, QR codes, or watermarks are allowed.
8. Each layer must be able to independently read its media characteristics, but after combining the four layers, it still looks like the same scene gradually translated from reality into different artistic media.

prompts.text:
请在当前层将上传照片中的同一场景制作成高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。
这里的“不多图拼接”是指：不要把不同上传照片混在同一张成品里；每一张上传照片都必须单独生成一张完整的四层风格海报。

【整体画幅与四层结构】
整体采用3:4竖版构图。画面从上到下严格四等分为四个横向区域，每个区域的高度必须精确占整体画面高度的25%，四层比例严格为1:1:1:1，不允许出现比例偏差。四层之间无缝衔接，不设置分隔线，不留白色缝隙，不使用边框。

由于每层实际约为3:1的极扁横幅，主体需要在每层内部进行横向适配：保持主体主要位置与视觉重心稳定，优先横向展开，避免主体被纵向拉伸、压扁、贴边或裁掉关键部位。可在左右延展与原图一致的天空、墙面、地面、水面、纸张或环境留白，但不得使用模糊复制背景填充。

【四层共同一致性】
四层必须来自同一张上传照片、同一个瞬间。严格保持主体身份、主体数量、人物或动物面貌、姿态、动作方向、视线、发型、服装核心特征、建筑结构、地标身份、主要物体关系、观察角度、透视方向、左右位置、前后层级及叙事关系一致。
风格层允许根据各自媒介删除次要背景、减少纹理、改变材质和细节密度，但不能把主体替换成另一个人物、另一座建筑、另一辆车、另一只动物或另一个场景。

【第一层｜原始摄影】
第一层忠实保留上传照片的真实摄影质感。保留主体身份、数量、构图关系、姿态、动作、真实材质、自然光影、综合色温和场景氛围。只允许进行克制的高级摄影级调色、曝光与对比微调以及极轻微的细腻颗粒优化。
为适配当前约3:1横幅，可进行自然裁切或延展与原场景一致的环境边缘，但不得拉伸、扭曲、镜像、复制主体、移动关键物体、改变建筑结构或重新设计人物。
第一层不添加额外文字、品牌标志、边框、水印或装饰元素。

【第2层｜七十年代动画感黑白墨线画｜当前层适配规则】
本层只占整张3:4四拼海报高度的25%，实际为约3:1的极扁横向区域。以下风格说明全部在“当前层内部”执行。
任何源提示词中出现的独立海报、整张画面、竖版比例、单独输出等表述，均不得改变四拼总结构；当前层约3:1扁横幅比例为最高优先级。
不得在当前层内部再次生成原图对照区、第二张照片、上下分屏或额外多宫格。源提示词中若存在重新构图要求，只允许对背景信息、材质、留白和次要元素做提炼，不得改变主体身份、数量、关键姿态、动作方向、观察视角、主要透视、左右位置及核心空间关系。
文字若为该源风格的重要组成部分则保留，但必须缩减到当前层能够清楚阅读的最低必要数量；若源提示词明确要求无文字，则保持无文字。

【源风格完整转译说明】
创作一幅[主体]的黑白墨线画。突出富有表现力的特征，采用二十世纪七十年代二维动画美学、粗犷高对比轮廓、锐利清晰的线稿、极简而有层级的线宽，以及动画清稿风格。画面采用高调构图和纯白背景，只使用黑白两色，不添加阴影、颜色或灰度。

【第3层｜粗颗粒限色旅行浮雕版画｜当前层适配规则】
本层只占整张3:4四拼海报高度的25%，实际为约3:1的极扁横向区域。以下风格说明全部在“当前层内部”执行。
任何源提示词中出现的独立海报、整张画面、竖版比例、单独输出等表述，均不得改变四拼总结构；当前层约3:1扁横幅比例为最高优先级。
不得在当前层内部再次生成原图对照区、第二张照片、上下分屏或额外多宫格。源提示词中若存在重新构图要求，只允许对背景信息、材质、留白和次要元素做提炼，不得改变主体身份、数量、关键姿态、动作方向、观察视角、主要透视、左右位置及核心空间关系。
文字若为该源风格的重要组成部分则保留，但必须缩减到当前层能够清楚阅读的最低必要数量；若源提示词明确要求无文字，则保持无文字。

【源风格完整转译说明】
请以当前上传的一张照片为唯一参考，在当前层将其制作成高级限色旅行浮雕版画海报。采用当前层约3:1扁横幅构图，当前层只呈现该风格转译，不设置额外原始照片对照区。

旅行浮雕版画

画面使用温暖的奶油色或象牙色天然版画纸背景。

纸张应具有：

可见纸纹,
细微纸纤维,
略粗糙哑光表面,
温暖档案纸,
自然颜料吸收.

从上传的原始照片中选择一个最具识别度的主体，或者一个能够代表照片含义的场景整体，将其重新制作成一枚独立悬浮在纸面上的“旅行版画印记”。

保留决定原照片识别度的：

- 主体外轮廓
- 姿态或行进方向
- 主要明暗分区
- 透视方向
- 关键结构
- 材质纹理节奏
- 标志性色彩
- 最重要的空间关系

主动删除：

- 复杂背景
- 重复建筑结构
- 大量窗户
- 密集人群
- 无关车辆
- 微小招牌
- 杂物
- 细碎纹理
- 次要物体
- 无法准确生成的文字

当前层不是将整张照片降低饱和度、增加颗粒或套用版画滤镜。

必须先理解照片中最重要的视觉信息，再将其重新制版、压缩、套色和印刷。

四、版画媒介与质感

使用以下混合版画语言：

旅行浮雕版画,
限色色盘丝网印刷,
粗粝石版画,
木刻质感,
油毡版画质感,
模板印刷,
摄影纹理压缩,
手工版画制作,
磨损颜料,
断裂网点,
不规则油墨覆盖,
粗糙干刷边缘,
纸张透底,
轻微套色偏移,
颗粒阴影,
手工遮罩边界,
自然缺墨.

版画应具有粗颗粒、手工套印和旧旅行印刷品的质感。

颜料为不透明、哑光的印刷油墨，不是透明水彩。

允许出现：

- 油墨覆盖不均
- 局部缺墨
- 断裂网点
- 粗糙干刷边缘
- 纸张透底
- 轻微套色偏移
- 颗粒化阴影
- 手工遮罩的不规则边界
- 局部磨损
- 少量原照片纹理被压缩后的印刷痕迹

不同色层应像分别套印在纸张上，而不是通过数字渐变平滑融合。

不要使用精确矢量描边。

不要让主体变成企业品牌标志、干净图标或普通扁平插画。

五、当前层构图

版画主体放置于画面中央或略微偏上。

主体占当前层高度约38%–52%，根据照片内容自然调整。

版画主体不能铺满整个画面，周围必须保留大量温暖象牙色纸张留白。

主体边缘不能形成完整的矩形照片框。

使用以下方式让边缘自然消失：

- 不规则刷印
- 撕裂般的油墨边缘
- 断裂网点
- 缺墨区域
- 颗粒逐渐减少
- 纸张自然透出
- 局部结构突然中断

整体具有“一枚旅行记忆被压印在纸张上”的感觉。

风景照片可以保留少量地形、天际线、水面或建筑节奏，但不能完整重建所有背景。

人物或交通工具照片应优先突出主体轮廓、姿态和运动方向。

建筑照片应保留最有识别度的体块、屋顶、窗洞比例或结构节奏。

六、限色色盘

从上传的原始照片中提取3–5种主要颜色，压缩成高对比、哑光的有限油墨色盘。

通常包括：

- 一种最深的轮廓墨色
- 一种温暖纸张底色
- 一至两种主体颜色
- 一个小面积高光色或标志性色

暖色照片可以使用：

赭橙、砖红、焦黄、橄榄绿、炭灰、暖米色。

冷色照片可以使用：

灰蓝、海水蓝绿、墨绿、石墨灰、雾灰和暖象牙色。

夜景可以使用：

深墨绿、炭黑、褪色蓝、暗红和少量暖黄色灯光。

保留原照片中最具有识别度的一处亮色作为视觉记忆点，但不要同时使用大量鲜艳颜色。

所有颜色必须像层层套印的实体油墨。

禁止平滑数字渐变、霓虹发光、高饱和商业配色和透明水彩晕染。

七、文字系统

在版画主体下方放置极少量文字。

主标题使用以下准确文字：

“[英文主标题]”

主标题控制在1–3个英文单词，使用克制的打字机体、等宽衬线体或旧档案字体，水平居中。

主标题下方放置以下准确旅行关键词：

“[关键词1 / 关键词2 / 关键词3]”

关键词使用3–5个简短英文单词，以斜杠分隔，小于主标题，字距自然，像旧旅行照片背面的打字说明。

所有文字必须逐字准确，不得修改、增删、拼错或生成额外字符。

除以上两行外，不要添加编号、年份、品牌、品牌标志、二维码、网址、宣传语、长段落或无意义文字。

如果没有提供文字，则保持无文字设计，不得自行编造标题。

八、整体气质

整体应像一张由旅行摄影制作而成的小型限量版画：

直接、朴素、怀旧、温暖、安静、粗粝、略带探险感与私人旅行记忆。

高级感来自：

- 准确的限色色盘
- 主体信息压缩
- 粗颗粒印刷纹理
- 不完整的版画边缘
- 纸张留白
- 克制的文字
- 与原始照片在主体、色彩和叙事上的视觉呼应

它不是传统写实绘画，也不是普通照片滤镜。

它是一枚由原照片重新制版而成的旅行记忆印记。

九、强制避免

避免：

多照片拼贴,
网格版式,
海报展示样机,
相框,
墙面场景,
手持海报,
原照片区域插画化,
重绘照片,
改变主体身份,
改变面貌,
改变姿态,
改变建筑结构,
复制物体,
镜像扩展,
拉伸照片,
模糊照片侧边填充,
整张海报套用版画滤镜,
干净矢量描边,
平滑数字渐变,
光滑扁平插画,
通用品牌标志剪影,
完整矩形照片裁切,
细密背景重建,
水彩晕染,
透明水彩,
贴纸拼贴,
旅行图标,
飞机图标,
护照图形,
地图图钉,
建筑蓝图线,
随机圆形,
装饰网格,
光滑三维效果,
动漫,
卡通,
霓虹色,
画面满铺,
硬质矩形相框,
过量排版,
虚构品牌,
乱码文字,
水印,
廉价纪念品模板.

最重要的规则：

版画必须准确对应当前原始照片中最重要的主体或场景。

画面必须将原照片中最重要的主体或场景，重新制成一枚限色、粗颗粒、边缘不完整、悬浮在大面积象牙纸留白中的旅行版画印记。

整张海报必须在一次生成中完成，不要分别生成素材，不要使用代码拼接，不要输出多张图片。

【第4层｜地标几何版刻拼构海报｜当前层适配规则】
本层只占整张3:4四拼海报高度的25%，实际为约3:1的极扁横向区域。以下风格说明全部在“当前层内部”执行。
任何源提示词中出现的独立海报、整张画面、竖版比例、单独输出等表述，均不得改变四拼总结构；当前层约3:1扁横幅比例为最高优先级。
不得在当前层内部再次生成原图对照区、第二张照片、上下分屏或额外多宫格。源提示词中若存在重新构图要求，只允许对背景信息、材质、留白和次要元素做提炼，不得改变主体身份、数量、关键姿态、动作方向、观察视角、主要透视、左右位置及核心空间关系。
文字若为该源风格的重要组成部分则保留，但必须缩减到当前层能够清楚阅读的最低必要数量；若源提示词明确要求无文字，则保持无文字。

【源风格完整转译说明】
请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别转绘成一张独立的高级地标艺术海报。默认采用当前层约3:1扁横幅构图，不保留上下分屏，也不要出现原始照片区域、相框、墙面或手持展示样机。

首先理解照片中真正决定地点识别度的视觉结构，从建筑、古迹、桥梁、塔楼、车站、船只、山峰、岛屿、海岸或城市天际线中，选择一组最重要的主体关系。

准确保留原照片中的：

- 地标身份与主体数量
- 观察角度与空间方向
- 建筑外轮廓与层级关系
- 屋顶节奏、塔身比例、桥跨、拱洞或主要开口
- 山脊、岸线、水面基线和关键负形
- 能够让人一眼认出原地点的标志性结构

主动删除游客、车辆、密集植被、广告、窗格、微小文字、装饰构件和摄影噪声。不要为了增强“地域感”而添加照片中不存在的建筑、交通工具、文化符号或第二座地标。

将主体重新制作为粗粝的黑色建筑版刻。融合木刻、干刻、铜版蚀刻和旧式丝网印刷语言，通过密集但不均匀的排线、交叉线、断裂墨面、刻痕、干刷缺口、局部漏墨、粗糙边缘和纸张透底表现形体。

主体不能成为平滑黑色剪影，也不能像照片自动描边。建筑白墙、积雪、天空开口和水面高光可直接使用纸张负形表现，让留白真正参与主体结构。

在主体后方放置2至3个大型现代主义几何版块。所有几何形状必须从当前照片自身的结构、轮廓或负形中提炼，例如：

- 从太阳、穹顶、山体或视觉中心提炼圆形、半圆或低椭圆；
- 从拱洞、门洞、塔身、船帆、山谷或弯曲屋顶提炼竖向拱形和弧面；
- 从屋顶三角、山坡、桥跨和建筑折线提炼倾斜或角形版块；
- 从主体侧面、结构厚度、远山和空间阴影提炼窄月牙、黑色切片或直立结构。

不同照片必须根据各自主体产生不同的几何组合。不要给所有作品机械添加相同的圆、拱门或太阳。几何版块负责组织空间和节奏，不得变成品牌标志、徽章或纯装饰图案。

几何色版需要具有真实的制版质感，包括轻微套印偏差、磨损边缘、不均匀墨色、颗粒、擦痕、缺口和局部纸张透出。避免干净矢量图形、数字渐变和光滑软件边缘。

整张画面使用温暖的象牙色、旧书页米色或浅灰褐色版画纸。纸张带有细小纤维、轻微压痕、墨迹和自然磨损，但老化必须克制，不要出现烧焦边缘、藏宝图效果或满页污渍。

将主体与几何色版压缩成一个紧凑的视觉岛，占画面约32%至52%，根据原照片重心放在中央偏下、左下或右下位置。上方至少保留约30%至40%的连续空白，左右也应保持充足呼吸空间。

不要按照原始照片把风景铺满画布。照片中的天空、空气、距离和复杂背景可以直接由空白纸张代表。

主体底部只使用少量断续的黑色和专色横向笔触，暗示水面、道路、台地、地平线、倒影或岸线。笔触应向两侧和下方逐渐断裂、磨损并消失进纸张，不形成完整背景、规则底座或封闭风景。

整体色彩仅使用：

- 温暖纸张底色
- 碳黑色版刻墨
- 一种从原照片中提取并归纳的哑光专色

专色可以根据照片选择砖红、赭黄、暗橙、灰蓝、苔绿、橄榄色或其他最具代表性的颜色，但每张作品只使用一种主要专色。必要时允许加入该专色非常浅的同色阶，不使用多彩拼贴。

默认不生成任何文字。只有用户明确要求时，才在远离主体的留白边缘加入1至3个英文单词的小型标题或一个编号。禁止作者姓名、摄影者姓名、签名、印章、伪书法、账号、品牌标志和水印。

整体应具有现代主义编辑设计、建筑版画、粗粝丝网印刷与收藏级独立出版物的气质：克制、安静、粗糙、结构清晰、具有真实手工制版感和大片留白。

避免： 完整覆盖背景, 精确描摹照片, 虚构第二地标, 通用地标模板, 固定拱形构图, 随意圆形, 品牌标志式构图, 干净矢量几何, 平滑数字渐变, 扁平黑色剪影, 照片滤镜, 水彩, 光滑三维效果, 完整景观重建, 拥挤拼贴, 多色色盘, 霓虹色, 烧焦羊皮纸边缘, 藏宝图式老化, 伪书法, 作者姓名, 签名, 印章, 品牌标志, 水印.

【最终统一检查】
1. 四层高度必须严格各占25%，顺序不得改变。
2. 四层之间不得出现边框、分割线、留白缝隙或卡片式间距。
3. 第一层保持真实摄影；第二至第四层分别严格执行各自源风格，不互相混合媒介。
4. 主体身份、数量、姿态、动作方向、视角、关键透视、左右位置和核心空间关系必须连续一致。
5. 不得把不同上传照片混在同一张海报中。
6. 不得因为风格化而新增照片中不存在的主体、地标、人物、交通工具或关键叙事物件。
7. 除非某一源风格明确需要文字，否则不要额外添加文字；所有文字必须拼写正确、清楚可读，禁止乱码、伪文字、品牌标志、二维码和水印。
8. 每一层都必须能独立读出其媒介特征，但四层组合后仍像同一场景从现实逐步转译为不同艺术媒介。

She wears a fitted ivory-cream vintage-inspired halter-neck one-piece leotard with delicate textured fabric, fine openwork or crochet-like detailing, narrow ruffled edging around the neckline and arm openings, and scattered small pastel floral motifs in muted blue, pink, yellow, and red. A narrow beige belt with a small metallic buckle defines the waist. She wears pale blush-beige satin ballet pointe shoes with crossed ankle ribbons.

She possesses the best head-to-body ratio, a perfect, curvaceous, S-shaped female figure, long legs with perfect leg lines, and a slender waist, perfect foots,perfect foot lines

## [Scene / Background]

A minimalist vintage studio interior with a large weathered plaster wall in warm off-white and light beige tones. The wall has subtle cracks, stains, peeling texture, and aged patina, creating a rustic yet sophisticated editorial backdrop. The floor is similarly pale, worn, and textured.

The woman sits on an ornate classical cream-colored stone pedestal resembling a small neoclassical column, featuring carved floral ornamentation, fluted vertical details, a decorative capital, and a square base. The environment remains sparse, with generous negative space surrounding the subject.

## [Lighting / Atmosphere]

Soft natural diffused daylight entering from the upper-left/front, producing gentle illumination across the face, skin, clothing, pedestal, and textured wall. Subtle directional shadows provide depth without becoming harsh. Warm neutral color temperature, low contrast, delicate highlights, soft shadow transitions, serene and romantic atmosphere, refined vintage fashion-editorial mood.

## [Composition / Viewpoint]

. Full figure completely visible from head to pointe shoes. Three-quarter frontal view, camera positioned approximately at seated torso height with a slight downward perspective. The subject occupies the central-left portion of the frame, while the upper-right area contains substantial clean negative space formed by the aged plaster wall.

Dynamic diagonal composition created by the flowing hair, angled torso, crossed extended legs, and pointed feet. The long hair sweeps horizontally toward the left edge, emphasizing movement. The pedestal anchors the lower-left composition. Maintain natural body proportions, elegant anatomy, realistic hands and feet, accurate ballet posture, and balanced visual geometry.

## [Style Reference]

High-end fine-art fashion photography combined with vintage ballet editorial aesthetics. Photorealistic, sophisticated, understated, feminine, graceful, nostalgic European studio atmosphere. Natural skin texture, realistic fabric fibers, authentic plaster and stone textures, subtle filmic rendering, restrained neutral palette with delicate pastel floral accents, shallow yet controlled depth of field, premium fashion-magazine aesthetic.

## [Quality Parameters]

Ultra-high-resolution photorealistic rendering, exceptional facial detail, realistic anatomy and proportions, natural skin texture, individually defined strands of flowing hair, highly detailed textile weave and floral embroidery, realistic satin ballet shoes and ribbons, physically plausible lighting and shadows, fine tonal gradation, subtle film grain, crisp subject separation, accurate perspective, clean edges, professional editorial photography quality.

**Constraints:** full body visible; preserve the elegant seated ballet pose; legs remain extended and crossed; one foot clearly pointed en pointe; long black hair visibly flowing to the left; ivory-cream floral halter leotard with ruffled trim and waist belt; pale blush-beige ballet pointe shoes with ankle ribbons; ornate cream classical pedestal; weathered off-white plaster wall; warm neutral vintage palette; no text, watermark, logo, extra people, extra limbs, distorted hands, malformed feet, exaggerated anatomy, or unnecessary background objects,No cropped limbs or truncated feet.

她拥有最佳的头身比，完美、曼妙的S形女性身材，拥有完美线条的长腿，以及纤细的腰部，完美的双脚，完美的足部线条。

## [场景 / 背景]

一个极简的复古工作室室内，有一面巨大的风化灰泥墙，呈现出温暖的乳白色和浅米色调。墙壁上有细微的裂缝、污点、剥落的纹理和陈旧的岁痕，营造出一种质朴而考究的社论背景。地板同样色调浅淡、磨损且富有纹理感。

这位女性坐在一个华丽的古典奶油色石质底座上，底座类似于一个小型的艺术古典柱，带有雕刻的花卉装饰、凹槽垂直细节、装饰性的柱头和方形底座。环境保持简洁，主体周围留有大量的负空间。

## [光影 / 氛围]

柔和的自然漫射日光从左上方/前方射入，在面部、皮肤、服装、底座和纹理墙面上产生柔和的照明。细微的方向性阴影提供了深度而不会显得突兀。温暖的中性色温，低对比度，细腻的高光，柔和的阴影过渡，宁静而浪漫的氛围，精致的复古时尚社论情调。

全身像，从头到足尖鞋完全可见。四分之三正面视角，相机位置大约处于坐姿躯干高度，带有轻微的俯视透视。主体占据画面的中左部分，而右上角由陈旧的灰泥墙形成大量的干净负空间。

由飘动的头发、倾斜的躯干、交叉延伸的双腿和紧绷的脚尖构成的动态对角线构图。长发水平向左边缘扫过，强调了动感。底座锚定了左下角的构图。保持自然的身体比例，优雅的解剖结构，写实的手部和足部，准确的芭蕾姿势，以及平衡的视觉几何感。

高端美术时尚摄影，结合了复古芭蕾社论美学。写实、考究、含蓄、阴柔、优美，带有怀旧的欧洲工作室氛围。自然的皮肤纹理，真实的织物纤维，真实的灰泥和石头纹理，细微的电影感渲染，受限的中性色调配以细腻的浅色花卉点缀，浅而受控的景深，高级时尚杂志美学。

## [质量参数]

超高分辨率写实渲染，卓越的面部细节，真实的解剖结构和比例，自然的皮肤纹理，清晰定义的飘动发丝，高度详实的纺织品织纹和花卉刺绣，写实的缎面芭蕾舞鞋和缎带，符合物理规律的光照和阴影，细腻的色调渐变，细微的胶片颗粒，锐利的主体分离，准确的透视，干净的边缘，专业编辑级摄影质量。

prompts.text:
Hyper-realistic night indoor mirror selfie photography, vertical format about 4:5, a young adult East Asian female sitting on a light-colored raw wood square stool in front of a large full-length mirror, taking a selfie with the phone's flash turned on. The camera shoots through the mirror, using an equivalent mobile phone lens of about 35–50mm, the person is about 0.8–1.2 meters away from the mirror, the camera position is close to the chest and abdomen height and slightly angled downwards. The composition captures fully from the top of the head to the lower-middle part of the thighs and part of the over-the-knee socks, the character accounts for about 88–92% of the frame height, the body is located center-left, and the right leg extends to the edge of the frame. Maintain realistic mobile phone mirror selfie perspective, do not use fisheye, and do not do obvious background blur.

The character is a young adult East Asian female, with a medium-to-small skeleton, medium-to-narrow shoulders, a very full upper body but the rib cage itself has normal width, a significantly slender and constricted waist, a naturally flat abdomen, a wide pelvis and hips, and the base of the thighs is obviously full and thick. The overall proportion is a compact full hourglass: very full upper body + obvious thin waist + naturally wide hips + full buttocks and legs + thick thighs. In the sitting posture, the hips and thighs are supported by the wooden stool, producing realistic soft tissue compression and lateral expansion, the visual volume of the thighs is significant, but do not generate athletic muscular legs, giant buttocks with thin legs, narrow-hipped paper-thin figures, or abnormal wasp waists.

The person sits diagonally on the front edge of the wooden stool, the pelvis is slightly rotated towards the person's right, the upper body leans towards the person's left rear, forming a clear but natural S-curve. The person's right shoulder is slightly lower, and the waist is tightened inward. The left arm extends towards the lower rear of the body and is supported on the stool surface or behind the body, most of the arm is obscured along the left side of the body; the right hand holds a dark gray/titanium-colored triple-camera smartphone in front of the chest, the phone is located between the face and the chest, blocking part of the central area of the body.

The legs extend towards the bottom right of the frame. One thigh closer to the camera horizontally occupies a large area in the lower half of the frame, with the knee bent, and the other leg is located behind it and partially obscured. The person's sitting posture is overall relaxed rather than sitting upright, the legs should not be completely closed, nor should they be crossed. Maintain realistic joint structures between the knees and thighs.

The person's head is slightly lowered and turned towards the person's right, the gaze looks at the phone screen instead of the lens. The expression is quiet, cold, slightly lazy, with lips naturally closed or slightly parted, no toothy smile.

The person has very long dark black-brown slightly wavy long hair, reaching the waist or even lower, with thick hair volume. The top of the head is naturally slightly middle-parted, there are no straight bangs on the forehead, only long face-framing stray hairs. Most of the hair falls from the person's left shoulder and back, forming a large area of dark smooth hair strands; there is also a small amount of long hair falling along the front of the chest on the right side. The hair ends have a slight natural large curve, rather than regular curls.

The face shape is small and oval-leaning, the jawline is soft, and the skin tone is fair and warm. Deep brown almond eyes, natural double eyelids, slender eyeliner, clear eyelashes; eyebrows are naturally thin. The bridge of the nose is small and straight, the tip of the nose has clear highlights under the flash; the lips are naturally full, nude pink leaning towards peach, with a slight glass lip gloss. The skin retains fine pores, skin tone transitions, and realistic highlights under the flash, do not over-smooth the skin.

Wearing a very fine silver chain necklace around the neck, close to the collarbone, without any obvious large pendants.

The upper body wears a pure white/ivory white strapless tight short tube top or bandeau top. The neckline wraps horizontally around the chest, there are no shoulder straps, no sleeves, and the shoulders and collarbones are all exposed. The fabric is soft stretch cotton/thin knit, close-fitting and has realistic horizontal stretch and a small amount of wrinkles. The overall length of the top reaches below the ribs to above the waist, exposing a full segment of the waist and abdomen. The color is warm white, no lace, ruffles, logos, or complex decorations.

The top must maintain a horizontal strapless wrapped structure, rather than thin-strap camisoles, corsets, bikinis, or ordinary T-shirts. The clothing material stretches naturally with the curves of the body, forming slight wrinkles under the chest and at the side waist.

The lower body wears pure white high-waisted/mid-high-waisted ultra-short close-fitting loungewear shorts. The waistband is located below the navel to near the natural waistline, the waistband is flat, the fabric is similar to the top, soft stretch cotton. The shorts fit tightly to the pelvis and full hips, the pant legs are very short, only covering the base of the thighs. In the sitting position, the shorts produce realistic fabric tension and slight horizontal wrinkles near the hips, base of the thighs, and groin. No denim material, sports shorts, skirts, or complex straps.

The legs wear pure white over-the-knee socks/thigh-high socks, the sock openings are located at the lower-middle part of the thigh to the area above the knee. The material is soft fine-knit or semi-thick elastic cloth, the color is consistent with the clothing. The sock openings are simple wide edges, no lace, no bows, no stripes. The thigh-high sock on the right side closer to the mirror is clearly visible and occupies a large area in the lower right of the frame, the other sock only shows a part. Do not generate transparent stockings, fishnets, or short socks.

The person is sitting on a small square wooden stool in light honey/light oak color. The stool surface is a rectangular thick wooden board with clear wood grain and slightly rounded edges; simple right-angled wooden legs and horizontal supports are visible below. The stool size is not large, and the person's hips almost take up the entire stool surface. Do not turn it into a bed, sofa, bar chair, or metal chair.

The scene is a very dark modern residential/apartment interior at night. Behind the person is almost a full large dark black-blue glass window or floor-to-ceiling glass door, it is completely dark outside the window, only a few blurred reflections and faint light points can be seen. The mirror and the glass area create a deep blue-black background, making the person stand out from the darkness.

Narrow black metal mirror frames/window frames are visible on the left and right edges of the frame, of which there is a more obvious black vertical frame on the left, and a small amount of light-colored wall is revealed on the outermost side. The overall background is minimalist, do not add beds, sofas, TVs, decorative paintings, or complex furniture.

The core light of the photography is the mobile phone mirror direct flash. The person holds the phone in the right hand, the flash at the top of the phone faces the mirror directly, forming a very bright white bursting light spot above the phone camera, locally severely overexposed, and producing slight flare/bloom on the edge of the phone and in front of the person's chest. The flash is the brightest highlight of the whole picture.

The person's face, chest, shoulders, waist, abdomen, and thighs are illuminated by the front cold white flash, the skin tone is bright and delicate, with obvious but soft specular highlights; the sides of the person's body quickly enter the shadow, and the background is almost completely black. The hair shows dark brown highlights under the flash, and the white clothing remains bright but cannot be completely overexposed.

The phone is a dark gray/titanium-colored triple-camera flagship phone, with a transparent or smoky gray protective case, the back is facing the mirror, and the camera module is clear. The flash must be located in the area above the phone and form a strong direct reflection. The phone is close to the center of the person's body, so it appears slightly enlarged in the mirror.

人物头部微微低下并向人物右侧转动，视线看向手机屏幕而不是镜头。神态安静、冷淡、略带慵懒感，嘴唇自然闭合或轻微分开，不露齿笑。

prompts.text:
Theme: [poster theme / event]
Headline: [one bold word, 4–8 letters]
Subject: [adult person + styling]
Foreground object: [basketball / camera / skateboard / racket / bike wheel / other object]
Event info: [date / venue / time / category / website]
Base colors: [background + main color]
Accent color: [one restrained accent]
Aspect ratio: 9:16

Create a bold editorial poster built around forced perspective, oversized typography, and a realistic human subject.

Place the subject near the center or slightly off-center, photographed from a dramatic low angle. Push the [foreground object] extremely close to the camera so it becomes oversized and creates a strong near-to-far depth relationship leading back toward the subject.

Use the [headline] as enormous condensed bold sans-serif typography across the upper and middle background. Let the person and foreground object naturally overlap and partially obscure the letters so the typography feels integrated into the physical space rather than placed behind the image.

Build three clear information scales:
1. Oversized headline
2. Medium event details
3. Small editorial information

Arrange the smaller information along the left, right, and bottom edges using a clean editorial grid. All text should feel relevant to the actual theme rather than random placeholder words.

Use a lightly textured off-white paper background with subtle print grain. Add very faint oversized secondary typography or minimal perspective lines in the background for depth, but keep them low contrast.

Keep the palette restrained: mostly [base colors] with only small amounts of [accent color]. Let the visual impact come from scale, perspective, typography, and overlap rather than excessive decoration.

The subject should look photographic and natural, with realistic skin, hair, clothing folds, and believable anatomy. Keep the foreground object structurally accurate and visually dominant.

Overall feel: contemporary editorial design, street culture, fashion campaign, sports culture, and independent event poster aesthetics.

The final result should feel like a finished poster artwork, not a design mockup or template.

Clothing·Pose: A deep red bikini top with thin shoulder straps and three-dimensional cups, a narrow connection in the center, paired with matching low-waist bottoms. A thin silver necklace with a small pendant, and a bracelet on one wrist. The hand in the lower left of the frame is placed on a low metal railing, while the hand on the right side of the frame is placed on a high railing, with the waist twisted and leaning forward.

Background·Lighting: The cabin is on the left, the sea is on the right, with mountains in the background, and a hard direct main light projected from above. On the left is the white and dark blue hull of a large yacht, an open cabin, and a white sofa; on the right is the sparkling blue sea, distant green mountains, and bright cumulus clouds. Strong midday direct light creates sharp reflections on the wet skin and the boat hull.

Composition·Lens: The focus is on the person, with the head to the thighs cropped at the edges of the frame and a natural background blur. The person is centered and enlarged. A 3:4 vertical composition, a close-up medium shot from the head to the upper thighs. The person is centered and enlarged, with the curves of the yacht extending toward the upper left and the railings stretching toward the lower right. A slightly wide-angle close-up shot, enlarging the chest and upper body while maintaining the depth of the sea in the background.

Texture·Style: Photorealistic realistic photography. Clear and refreshing on-board location photography. Highly exquisite depiction of wet skin and hair, red swimwear, white boat hull, metal railings, and reflections on the sea surface.

Negative Prompts: Do not turn the wet short bob into long hair; do not change the color of the deep red swimwear.

prompts.text:
主题：  
船上的深红比基尼

主体：  
人物置于画面中央，占据较大空间。在晴朗海面上的白色大型游艇中，身穿深红比基尼的女性双手扶住两侧栏杆，上身前倾的纵向照片。将湿漉漉的人物置于中央，船舱置于左侧，右侧为蓝色大海和山峦。

人物·表情：  
脸庞几乎正面对着镜头凝视相机，涂有光泽的嘴唇微微张开。圆润的卵形轮廓和小巧的下巴，横长的杏仁形浅褐色眼睛，细长的自然眉毛，小巧的鼻尖，丰满的淡粉色嘴唇。湿润明亮的肌肤带着一丝低调的桃色。下巴处的黑色波波头侧分，湿漉漉的细发束垂落在额头和脸颊。

服装·姿势：  
深红色的比基尼上装带有细肩带和立体杯罩，中央有细窄的连接处，搭配同色低腰下装。细银项链和小吊坠，一只手腕上的手链。画面左下方的手置于低矮的金属栏杆，画面右侧的手置于高栏杆，腰部扭转并前倾。

背景·光线：  
画面左侧为船舱，右侧为大海，背景置入山峦，从上方投射硬朗的直射主光。左侧为白色与深蓝的大型游艇船体、敞开的船舱和白色沙发，右侧为波光粼粼的蓝色大海、远处的绿色山脉，以及明亮的积云。强烈的正午直射光在湿润的肌肤和船体上制造出锐利的反射。

构图·镜头：  
镜头焦点置于人物，头部至大腿在画面边缘裁切，背景自然虚化。将人物置于中央并放大显示。3:4 的纵向构图，近距离中景从头部至大腿上方。将人物置于中央并放大，游艇的曲线向左上方延伸，栏杆向右下方伸展。略带广角的近距离拍摄，放大胸部和上身，同时保留背景中大海的纵深感。

质感·风格：  
照片级真实写实摄影。清晰而清爽的船上实景摄影。高精致描绘湿润的肌肤和头发、红色泳装、白色船体、金属栏杆以及海面的反射。

负面提示：  
不要将湿漉漉的短波波头变成长发；不要改变深红泳装的颜色

prompts.text: direction: Shortly after completing a running workout on an outdoor athletic track, a companion took a realistic SNS snapshot using a smartphone in just a few seconds. The reference image is for reference only regarding the red all-weather track, black running outfit, messy hair after exercise, and the quiet moment with downcast eyes. Do not reproduce the person's face or inherent characteristics, or the exact same pose as the original image; instead, reconstruct it as a fictional adult woman. It should have a more fashionable and quite bold silhouette than ordinary sports photos, yet always be established as functional running wear that could actually be used for sports. mood: A moment where the heat from just finishing the run still remains in the body, and the breathing is only slightly hurried. The person is not striking a pose for the camera, but rather pausing briefly while checking the ground at their feet. Healthy, urban, cool. Not an advertisement model shoot, but the sense of distance of a photo left accidentally on a friend's phone. model: A fictional adult woman, approximately 25 years old. A healthy physique from daily running and light strength training. Not overly thin, with exercise habits naturally visible in the shoulders, arms, abdomen, and legs. Does not mimic real people, entertainers, or influencers. face: A natural face like that of a non-specific adult woman. Light makeup, eyebrows not perfectly symmetrical, cheeks slightly flushed after exercise. Eyes are not directed at the camera, but diagonally downward. Lips are not pursed, but in an expression during normal breathing. Not a perfect model face, but the natural degree of attractiveness seen in actual smartphone photos. hair: Deep brown hair close to black, tied up casually in a high position. A messy tie-up like something between a bun and a ponytail. Thin strands of hair from the bangs and sideburns fall near the cheeks due to sweat and wind, with some sticking to the neck. Shows no signs of hair being styled before the shoot. body: A healthy and realistic adult female body type. The upper body is quite full, with lateral thickness and presence naturally visible even from the front. However, the chest is not exaggerated like an independent part, but is established as a continuous human body from the shoulder width, ribcage, torso, and waist to the legs. The contrast with the slim waist is clearly visible, but no unrealistic waist-snatching is done. A natural silhouette that allows one to feel gravity and the support of the sportswear. skin: Natural skin without over-processing. The skin tone of the arms, shoulders, abdomen, and legs is not completely uniform. There are very thin sweat reflections after exercise around the forehead, neck, and collarbone. Retain pores, fine texture, and some redness. Do not make the skin overly smooth like a beauty advertisement. outfit: Minimalist running wear unified in a single black color. The top is a high-support sports vest with wide straps and a sturdy inner support band. It realistically supports the very full volume of the upper body, with actual tension, seams, and slight wrinkles visible on the fabric. The bottom is low-rise running shorts with an extreme low-rise design. The waist position is significantly lower than typical running shorts, leaving a large area of the abdomen between the top and bottom. Maintains the coverage and mobility required for sports while having a bold and highly fashionable silhouette. No large brand logos are used. low_rise_geometry: Low-rise expression is treated as the most important condition. The upper edge of the shorts is located quite low below the navel, leaving a clear vertical distance from the navel to the waistband. The waistband does not follow the narrowest part of the natural waist, but passes through a low position from the upper part of the pelvis to near the hip bone. The center front is also not raised high; the entire circumference is a low-rise design. Absolutely do not change to high-rise, mid-rise, or running leggings that cover the abdomen. shorts_design: The shorts themselves are made of a thin and light black running material. The front is simple, with short side slits on the left and right hems to facilitate leg movement during running, presenting a practical shape. The waistband is relatively thin, not digging into the abdomen but fitting naturally at the low-rise position. The fabric is not perfectly symmetrical, with one side of the hem or waist shifted by a few millimeters due to post-exercise movement. outfit_physics: The fabric of the sports vest and shorts is not treated like CG fitting the body, but allows one to feel the seams, thickness, stretch, and fabric tension. The sports vest has moderate tension in the shoulder straps and inner support band due to supporting weight. The shorts naturally stay at the low-rise position, with wrinkles and left-right differences generated in the fabric due to body movement. accessories: Black sports watch, thin metal necklace, small pendant. Holding a half-full transparent sports water bottle in one hand. An earphone case or thin towel is placed near the bag in the background. Do not pile up too many accessories. scene_objects: A used red-brown all-weather track, slightly worn white lane lines, green grass on the inner side, metal fence, old-style bench, black running bag, transparent spare water bottle, small towel. In the background, only a few users who have finished practicing are walking. pose: Just stopped after finishing the run. The body is almost facing forward, but the direction of the pelvis and shoulders are not perfectly aligned, with the weight naturally leaning on one leg. The head is slightly low, casually checking the condition of the feet or clothing. One hand holds a sports water bottle, and the other hand hangs naturally by the side of the body or lightly brushes away hair falling in front of the forehead. No movements such as pulling at the shorts or intentionally emphasizing body lines. The sense of boldness comes from the natural physique and design rather than the pose. shooting_reason: Returning to hydrate after completing interval runs. A moment caught when a companion casually held up a smartphone to shoot with a 'you ran a lot today' feeling. The subject noticed the shooting started, but not to the extent of consciously posing. lighting: Natural diagonal light through thin clouds shortly before sunset. No strong light directly hitting the face, with brightness only slightly left on the shoulders and hair outline. The warm tones reflected from the red track return very weakly to the legs and lower body. No studio lighting or artificial rim light is used. effect: Realistic colors like a standard smartphone camera. The red track has a slight warm tone, and the black clothing is not flat black but retains fabric texture. Highlights are only slightly blown out, and there is slight noise in the shadows. No excessive cinematic processing, beauty filters, or strong teal & orange. camera: A rear camera of a recent common smartphone. Vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. 2x camera or approximately 50mm equivalent. Subject distance is about 3m. Handheld shot from a few centimeters above eye level. The background is not completely blurred, allowing the track and grass to be identified. The shutter only stops the subject, but the hair ends and background figures have minimal motion blur. Local HDR processing and a slight sense of JPEG compression characteristic of smartphones. imperfections: Messy hair, slight flushing of the cheeks, fine fabric wrinkles on the sports vest, slightly different heights of the low-rise shorts on the left and right, one side of the hem only slightly folded up, asymmetrical shoulder height, weight leaning on one leg, composition not perfectly horizontal, background runners slightly blurred, stains on the track surface, small shadow noise. background: Not a professional arena, but a realistic outdoor athletic track that is also available for general use. The white lines have small abrasions, the track surface has color differences, and the grass also has uneven parts. Bags or towels are not placed perfectly, but are left naturally as traces of someone having practiced. atmosphere: An evening sports field where heat still remains in the body. Damp air and a weak breeze. A sense of tranquility like the sound of spikes or soles hitting the track from a distance. Not the feeling of 'someone who came to the track for a photo shoot,' but 'someone who really ran being captured accidentally.' composition: A 4:5 vertical composition of the figure from the head to the mid-thigh. Little margin above the head. The figure is slightly off-center, shifted a bit to the right or left. The waist position of the low-rise shorts, the distance from the navel, and the abdomen remaining between the sports vest are visible at a glance, but without a local close-up of the waist or any part of the body. With the horizontal line of the red track as the background, presenting a slightly casual framing like a photo taken by a friend on SNS. realism_priority: Priority given to the body itself over charm, gravity, fabric tension, the sense of weight of the human body, post-exercise posture, and smartphone shooting distance. Clearly expresses the full volume of the body and the extreme low-rise, but without departing from the fashion and sports context. negative: High-rise, mid-rise, shorts covering the navel, waistband extending to the abdomen, long bike shorts, composition focusing on a specific part of the body, unrealistic body proportions, floating clothes, silhouettes ignoring gravity, plastic-like skin, excessive beauty processing, doll-like faces, faces looking like real people or celebrities, characters looking like minors, perfect lighting like advertisement photos, excessive background blur. watermark_direction: Not adding the text @Live_life_style afterwards using image editing, but integrating it as a small design that has existed in the landscape since the time of shooting. watermark_text: @Live_life_style integration_method: Integrate @Live_life_style on the reflective print of a black running bag placed casually on the side of the track behind the person. Does not appear like a watermark for SNS, but as if a small brand logo was originally printed on the bag. subtle_visibility: Identifiable as a small white-ish print at normal size, with @Live_life_style readable upon slightly enlarging the image. Not completely hidden, with weaker identifiability than the figure. placement: On the black running bag in the background at the bottom of the screen, slightly away from the person's outline. material_behavior: The string of characters is also very subtly curved and deformed according to the folds, wrinkles, and sense of perspective of the soft bag fabric. The text part blends into the subtle differences in light and shadow caused by the fabric folds. lighting_interaction: As a thin reflective print material, it weakly catches the evening natural light. The white is not pure white, but slightly grayish text influenced by the surrounding color temperature and the bag's shadows. avoid: Digital subtitles directly overlaid on the image, text placed on the person's body, huge signatures, glowing logos, text that is unusually sharp compared to the background, perfectly flat typography without distortion.

"avoid": "直接叠加于画面的数字字幕、置于人物身体上的文字、巨大签名、发光标志、比背景异常鲜明的文字、完全平面无扭曲的排版"

prompts.text: Realistic portrait photography, night on-camera direct flash snapshot texture, close to cool white high-exposure beauty effect: face and skin specifically brightened by flash, cooler and whiter than the environment, skin micro-contrast reduced, highlights soft and diffused, but eyebrows, eyes, lip shapes, and bone structure remain clear; vertical 3:4 aspect ratio, above-the-knee mid-shot composition, lower edge of the skirt cut off by the bottom of the frame, chest-high camera position direct shot, close-up small sensor deep depth of field, almost uniform clarity across the frame, subject slightly to the left of the center, occupying about 90% of the height, 10% negative space at the top, the right third of the frame given to a brick wall. The subject is an adult young woman (early twenties), single person, oval face, soft jawline, long straight black hair with eyebrow-length airy fringe, the main hair bundle falls along the right side of the frame from the shoulder to the waist, a thin strand rests on the outer edge of the left cheek; natural skin tone is light warm ivory, large area of pink blush on cheeks, tip of the nose, and under eyes, watery red-toned lip glaze. She is looking almost directly at the camera, iris roughly centered in the eye slit but slightly toward the left of the frame, showing slightly more white on the right side, upper eyelids slightly pressed not wide open, prominent "aegyo sal" (undereye bags), long drooping eyelashes, plain eyebrow shape; lips slightly parted, no teeth showing, narrow lip gap, strong moist highlights on both upper and lower lips, expression lazy and calm. She stands leaning her back lightly against the wall, weight on the leg on the right side of the frame, hips pushed out toward the right, upper body tilting toward the left, shoulder line forming a diagonal from low left to high right, head tilted slightly to the right; the hand on the left side is raised to chest height, thumb and index finger pinching the end of a blue plaid tie and pulling it outward to the left, remaining three fingers curled inward, the tie thus stretched into a diagonal straight line extending to the middle left, nails are silver-gray mirror-finish glitter manicured; the other arm hangs down along the body, the hand falling outside the bottom edge. Clothing is a slim-fit white short-sleeved shirt, a vertical ruching in the center front tightens the fabric over the chest and abdomen to fit the torso, collar unbuttoned two or three times, collar leaves naturally folded out, sleeves rolled up above the elbow, hem tied into a small knot at the waist, exposing the entire abdomen and navel; lower body is a low-rise blue-white-gray-yellow plaid pleated mini skirt, waistband resting on the hip bones, leaving a bare strip about a palm wide between the knotted shirt; shirt is thin matte plain weave fabric, skirt pleats are pressed knife pleats, under the direct flash each pleat's lit surface is bright and the backlit surface turns deep blue, a tiny light-colored embroidered mark on the chest but unreadable. The background is an outdoor corridor wall scene: the right third is a warm yellow red brick wall, clear white grout, with stains and color variations, two sets of white plastic switch panels side-by-side in the center-right; the left and top are dark metal doors and frames, a small area of deep red foreign language signs and a small blue text sign above the door, only for environmental detail; the leftmost edge reveals a corner of a warm brown circular object; background information is low, almost no depth. The sole light source is a hard flash from the front of the camera, no modeling light, the subject casts a sharp-edged dark shadow on the door panel on the left, a bright spot appears on the brick wall spreading to the upper right and decaying quickly, the top left corner is pushed to near total black. In terms of color, warm yellow brick wall is the main background color, saturated royal blue plaid is the only high-saturation control color, white shirt is the brightening color, black hair and dark door are dark anchor points, pink blush and lip color are accents, cool white skin contrasts with the warm yellow environment. In terms of texture, the facial features, tie plaid, and nails are the sharpest, followed by the shirt and skirt pleats, the brick wall texture maintains medium detail, only the dark parts in the upper left are underexposed losing detail with slight color noise and compression artifacts, retaining some real skin pore texture, no global soft focus, no shallow depth-of-field blurring. Avoid studio soft light and commercial-grade skin smoothing, avoid global high-key lighting up the background, avoid losing the action of the fingers pinching and pulling the tie to the left and the tension of the tie, avoid big smiles showing teeth or eyes looking away, avoid the bare strip between the waist knot and the low-rise skirt being misdrawn as a bodysuit or tucked in, avoid becoming an illustration or anime style. prompts.text: Create a realistic vertical 9:16 photographed portrait. Subject and action: A single woman leaning forward close to a low camera, lifting her chin into the overhead light and looking above and to frame left. Composition: strict vertical close portrait cropped from the upper thighs to just above the top of her outfit, with the face large in the upper-middle of frame and the right upper arm dominating the lower-right foreground. Pose: leaning forward from the waist toward the camera, torso angled slightly toward frame left, both arms extending downward out of frame; right shoulder raised closer to the lens and left shoulder set farther back; lips closed and relaxed with a slight natural upward set; eyes gently narrowed against the bright sun. Wardrobe: Oversized natural beige woven straw sunhat with a wide floppy brim and open perforated weave; sleeveless off-white lightweight cotton top with a softly scooped neckline, narrow scalloped trim, visible wrinkles and gravity folds, and a small navy ribbon bow centered at the neckline. Setting: minimal outdoor location against a plain pale blue-white sunlit wall, with a faint soft diagonal shadow entering from the lower left and no visible props. Lighting: strong direct midday sun from high camera-left; crisp bright highlights, gentle open-shadow fill, and dense small patterned light spots and curved shadow lines across the face and upper body. Finish: clean bright editorial daylight photograph with a subtle warm sun cast, cool cyan-white background, moderate-low contrast outside the crisp patterned shadows, restrained saturation, fine natural digital grain, soft highlight roll-off with a few near-clipped wall highlights, and light sharpening without phone-HDR halos. Skin and material texture: unretouched photographed skin with visible pores, vellus hair, under-eye/lip texture, tonal variation, and faint grain on face, neck, ears, and hands, including flash, monochrome, and low light; global grain or noise alone does not satisfy this constraint. Rendering constraints: keep the exact crop, body-to-camera relationship, hand task, gaze direction, light direction, foreground obstruction, and background placement; preserve believable anatomy and natural hands; avoid beauty-filter skin, studio-clean restaging, generic fashion posing, text, logos, borders, and watermarks.

items.title: 夏日海边薰衣草上衣日本女性人像

prompts.text:
Subject:
A fictional adult Japanese female smiling brightly at the camera on a seaside deck with her back to a vivid blue sea. Long dark brown hair, a lavender-colored top, and a white shoulder bag are clearly visible in the summer light. Include the face, shoulders, chest, upper waist, and the main part of the bag in a vertical frame to create an open persona inviting the other person to a trip to the seaside. The body is slightly towards the front, with one shoulder pulled back slightly, retaining the feel of wind and walking.

Location, Time, Background:
A bright seaside deck reminiscent of the tropics on a summer noon. Behind her, the water surface with a gradient from turquoise to ultramarine, a light blue sky, a straight horizon, white railings, and greenery in the distance are arranged. The sea spreads out widely behind the figure, with waves and reflections softly blurred as subtle light. No signs showing specific facility names or regions are placed, creating a sense of place that can be used for various purposes such as hotels, travel, resorts, and tourism. The air is clear, and the wind gently brushes the hair and bag.

Clothing, Accessories:
A lavender-colored sleeveless top with thin vertical ribs. The neckline is rounded, naturally showing the contours of the collarbone and chest, and the fabric fits the body without being overly tight. A soft white shoulder bag hangs on the shoulder, with a wide strap extending from the shoulder to the armpit, and the bag body slightly bulging at the outer waist. Accessories are kept simple, with the vivid combination of the purple of the clothes, the white of the bag, and the blue of the sea as the main features.

Pose, Fingers, Contact:
The body faces almost directly toward the camera, with one shoulder slightly pulled back, creating a slight twist in the ribcage. One hand lightly touches the shoulder strap of the bag, to the extent of gently pinching or supporting it with fingers. The other arm hangs naturally at the side of the body, with the elbow not stiff. The lines of the shoulders, collarbone, chest, and waist are continuous and smooth, creating a light center of gravity of the moment of stopping in the wind. Ensure space so the bag handle and arm do not overlap and merge.

Expression, Gaze:
Brown eyes look straight at the camera with a bright smile showing teeth. The cheeks are raised high, and the corners of the eyes naturally blend into the smile. The eyebrows are relaxed, expressing the joy of discovering a favorite scenery during a trip and a sense of friendliness inviting the other person. Do not open the mouth wide, maintaining an elegant cuteness. Avoid excessive squinting due to strong sunlight, prioritizing clear visibility of the light in the eyes and pupils.

Face, Makeup:
A small oval face, natural brown eyebrows, bright brown pupils, a neat nose, and coral pink lips. Thin brown eyeliner on the upper eyelids, long eyelashes, and a healthy light pink on the cheeks. Give the forehead, bridge of the nose, cheekbones, and lower lip a delicate summer light sheen, with the bluish-white reflection of the sea weakly fed back to the chin and the shadowed side of the cheeks. The skin retains the texture of fine details and expression muscles, turning into a bright natural makeup suitable for resort advertisements.

Hair:
Dark brown long hair reaching below the chest. The top of the head is rounded and trimmed, with thin bangs on the forehead and small hair bundles left by the cheeks. The sea breeze moves large strands of hair to flow outside the shoulders, with a few fine hairs floating in the blue of the background. The sun-drenched surface has brown and slight golden lusters, while the shadowed side remains deep dark brown. The hair ends flow towards the outside of the bag and chest, clearly defining the boundary with the clothing ribs or shoulder strap.

Light Source:
The strong summer sun at the top of the frame is the main light source, placing vivid highlights on the top of the hair, forehead, cheeks, nose, collarbone, chest, arms, and bag. Cool-toned fill light reflected from the blue sea surface and white deck is fed back to the shadow side, lifting the dark parts of the face and clothing. A thin rim light is created on the outer edge of the hair, separating the silhouette from the background sea. Do not let the white bag overexpose, retain the stitching, and ensure clear exposure of the eyes, nose, and mouth even in summer light.

Color, Light-Dark:
Centered on lavender, white, cyan, ultramarine, peach of the skin, and dark brown of the hair. The sky is pale and elegant, the water is deep, creating a cyan light-dark difference above and below the horizon. The lavender of the clothing does not sink into blue, retaining a bit of rosiness, serving as an intermediate color between the skin and the sea. The white bag is the brightest accent color, but retains fabric thickness and shadows. Saturation is refreshed and increased, while unified into a natural summer tone where the skin does not lean orange.

Material, Fine Texture:
The thin vertical ribs of the top and the thickness of the neckline, the soft skin of the white bag, the stitching, and the woven texture of the shoulder strap are depicted and distinguished one by one. The hair has thick flows and fine stray hairs, the skin has natural pores and a thin sheen, and the lips have a transparent moist feeling. The sea surface is given small reflections according to distance, the white railing has a smooth paint finish, and the deck is given thin horizontal lines. Eyelashes, eyebrows, nails, and the tips of the fingers touching the bag are also organized photographically, not unifying all lusters to the same intensity.

Composition, Lens:
A waist-up portrait in 9:16 vertical orientation. The visual center of the chest is placed at 50% horizontally, the center of the face at 51% horizontally, and the eyes at approximately 24% from the top. The top of the head retains about 5% of the frame height, and the white bag is naturally shown from the bottom to the side. The horizon passes stably through the upper half of the background, at a height that does not overlap excessively with the figure's shoulders. The lens captures from a slightly higher position than the chest with a standard focal length, with the face and chest as the first focus and the bag as the second focus. Retain a wide background sea, while the left and right white spaces do not push the figure to one side.

Image Processing, Finish:
Organized into a vivid commercial photo usable for resort travel, hotels, sightseeing, summer vacation, seaside holidays, and summer fashion. Finely depict pupils, smiles, clothing ribs, bags, and the wind direction of the hair, with the sea and sky unified into a smooth cyan blur. Retain the brightness of summer light while maintaining the light and dark of the skin, and contours do not have an excessive HDR feel. Add natural graininess and lens depth of field, resulting in a finish that conveys the smile and lavender color first even on a smartphone display.

Distortion Avoidance, Prohibitions:
Fixed to the finished image of the same adult woman, a slightly front-facing smile, a lavender ribbed top, a white bag, the blue sea, and a white deck. Do not generate extra fingers, hands merging with shoulder straps, distorted bags, double arms, misaligned eyeballs, other people, children, text, logos, watermarks, signatures, or SNS UIs. Do not speculatively depict unseen lower body parts or facility information, naturally including both face and chest, and do not expand for the purpose of exposure.

prompts.text:
被摄体：
背对鲜艳的蓝色大海，在海边甲板上对着镜头晴朗微笑的虚构成年日本女性一人。长长的黑褐色头发，薰衣草色的上衣，白色肩背包在夏日的光芒中清晰可见。将脸部、肩膀、胸口、腰部上方、包的主要部分纳入纵向画面，营造出邀请对方一起去旅行海边的开放人物形象。身体略微朝正面，一侧肩膀稍稍后拉，保留风与步行的气息。

地点・时间・背景：
夏日中午，令人联想到南国的明亮海边甲板。背后配置从青绿色渐变至群青色的水面、淡蓝天空、直直的地平线、白色栏杆、远处的绿色。大海在人物身后广阔展开，波浪与反射作为细微的光芒柔和地虚化。不放置显示特定设施名或地区的标牌，营造出可转用于酒店、旅行、度假、观光等多种用途的场所感。空气清澈，风轻轻拂过头发与包。

服装・小物：
薰衣草色的无袖上衣，带有细长的纵向罗纹。领口圆润，自然展现锁骨与胸口的轮廓，布料贴合身体却不过分紧绷。肩上挂着柔软的白色肩背包，宽阔的肩带从肩膀延伸至腋下，包身部分在腰外侧微微鼓起。饰品保持简约，以服装的紫色、包的白色、海的蓝色这三种颜色的鲜明组合为主角。

姿势・手指・接触：
身体几乎正面朝向镜头，一侧肩膀稍稍后拉，在胸廓处制造轻微的扭转。一只手轻触包的肩带，用手指轻轻捏住或支撑的程度。另一只手臂自然垂于身体侧面，肘部不僵硬。肩部、锁骨、胸部、腰部的线条连贯流畅，营造出迎风驻足瞬间的轻盈重心。确保包的提手与手臂不重叠融合的空间。

表情・视线：
棕色的双眼直视镜头，露出牙齿的明亮笑容。高高扬起脸颊，眼角自然融入笑意。眉毛放松，表达出在旅行中发现心仪景色的喜悦，以及邀请对方的亲切感。不张大嘴巴，保持优雅的可爱。避免因强烈日光过度眯眼，优先确保双眼与瞳孔的光芒清晰可辨。

脸部・妆容：
小巧的卵形脸，自然的茶色眉毛，明亮的茶色瞳孔，整齐的鼻子，珊瑚粉色的嘴唇。上眼睑细细的棕色眼线，长长的睫毛，脸颊上健康的浅粉色。在额头、鼻梁、颧骨、下唇赋予夏光细腻的光泽，将海的青白色反射弱弱地回馈至下巴与阴影侧的脸颊。肌肤保留细腻与表情肌的质感，化作适合度假村广告的明亮自然妆容。

头发：
及至胸下的黑褐色长发。头顶圆润修整，前额薄薄的刘海，脸颊旁保留短小的发束。海风带动大股发丝向肩外流动，几缕细发浮于背景的蓝色。阳光照射的表面带有茶色与些许金色的光泽，阴影侧保持深黑褐色。发梢向包与胸口外侧流动，清晰划分与服装罗纹或肩带的边界。

光源：
以画面上方强烈的夏日太阳为主光源，在头发的顶面、额头、脸颊、鼻子、锁骨、胸口、手臂、包上置入鲜明的高光。从蓝色海面与白色甲板反射的冷调辅助光回馈至阴影侧，提升脸部与服装的暗部。头发外缘制造细细的轮廓光，从背景大海中分离轮廓。不让白色包过度飞白，保留缝线，确保眼鼻口在夏光中也清晰的曝光。

颜色・明暗：
以薰衣草色、白色、青色、群青色、肌肤的桃色、头发的黑褐色为中心。天空淡雅，水面深邃，在地平线上下制造青色的明暗差。服装的薰衣草色不沉入蓝色，保留些许红润，作为肌肤与海的中间色发挥作用。白色包是最亮的点缀色，但保留布料厚度和阴影。饱和度爽快地提升，同时统一为肌肤不偏橙色的自然夏日色调。

材质・细微质感：
上衣的细长纵向罗纹与领口厚度、白色包的柔软表皮、缝线、肩带的编织纹理一一描绘区分。头发有粗壮的流动与细碎的飞发，肌肤有自然的毛孔与薄薄光泽，嘴唇带有透明的润泽感。海面根据距离赋予细小的反射，白色栏杆有光滑的涂装，甲板赋予细细的水平线。睫毛、眉毛、指甲、触碰包的手指尖也摄影般整理，不将所有光泽统一为相同强度。

构图・镜头：
纵向9:16的腰上肖像。胸部的视觉中心置于横向50%、脸部中心置于横向51%、双眼置于上端约24%。头顶保留画面高度约5%，白色包从下部向侧面自然展现。水平线稳定通过上半部的背景，不与人物肩膀过度重叠的高度。镜头从胸部稍高位置以标准焦段拍摄，脸部与胸口为第一焦点，包为第二焦点。保留广阔的背景大海，同时左右空白不将人物推向一侧的构图。

图像处理・完成：
整理成可用于度假旅行、酒店、观光、暑假、海边假期、夏季时尚的鲜明商用照片。精细描绘瞳孔、笑容、服装罗纹、包、头发的风向，海与天空统一为柔滑的青色虚化。保留夏光的明亮同时保持肌肤的明暗，轮廓不带过度HDR感。添加自然的颗粒感和镜头的景深，即使在智能手机显示中也能先传达笑容与薰衣草色的完成。 

崩坏回避・禁止：
固定为同一成年女性、略微正面的笑容、薰衣草罗纹上衣、白色包、蓝色大海、白色甲板这一完成形象。不生成多余的手指、手与肩带融合、扭曲的包、双重的臂、眼球偏移、其他人、儿童、文字、标志、水印、签名、SNS UI。不推测描绘看不见的下半身或设施信息，自然同时包含脸部与胸口，不以暴露量为目的而扩大。
