items.title: 泳池水面下自然光影抓拍

prompts.text:
Direction: Realistic underwater fashion snapshot. A photo of a fictional adult Japanese woman in her early 20s taken at close range with an underwater camera just below the surface of an outdoor swimming pool. It is not a portrait showcasing the subject's beauty, but rather an abstract interplay where water, light, skin, and blue tiles merge as the protagonist. The entire frame is dominated by intense underwater caustics and heavily distorted water surface reflections above. Not a meticulously staged advertisement or gravure shoot, but a natural photo accidentally captured by truly bringing a camera into the pool.

Mood: Strong midsummer sunlight breaking on the water surface, where the coolness of blue water and the warm golden light falling on the skin coexist. Not refreshing, but slightly hard-textured, like a raw underwater snapshot taken with a waterproof card camera from the late 2000s to early 2010s. Not a static model shoot, but a moment when the body slowly floats in the water and light and waves move continuously.

Model: A fictional adult Japanese woman in her early 20s. A generalized face that does not evoke a real person or celebrity. Slim to standard build, with the body naturally elongated by the buoyancy of the water. Natural upper body fullness equivalent to an I-cup, but not emphasizing body parts, instead presented naturally as part of the overall silhouette and underwater light.

Face: The face is not the protagonist of the photo. The head is located near the upper edge of the frame, partially obscured and difficult to see due to water surface reflections, hair, arms, and angle. Not looking directly at the camera, but naturally turning the gaze towards the water surface or outside the frame. Not a forced smile, but an unconscious, calm expression while adjusting breathing and posture in the water.

Hair: Natural black to dark brown hair. Wet clumped sections mixed with fine strands lightly floating and spreading in the water. A few strands flow towards the upper left of the frame, completely unstyled following the current. Slender water surface light also runs irregularly over the hair.

Body: A natural human body slightly elongated or distorted due to underwater refraction. Not perfectly symmetrical, with one shoulder slightly raised and the waist drifting slightly to the opposite side. Light patterns projected from the water surface continuously cast on the abdomen, flanks, ribcage, waist, and thighs, leaving a mesh-like impression of light more than the body silhouette itself.

Skin: Fair to medium natural Japanese skin tone. Picking up a thin blue tint from the water, while the caustic parts derived from direct sunlight glow strongly in white, pale yellow, and thin orange. Texture is not completely erased, retaining fine texture, slight color variations, and natural shadows near joints. There is a slight softening characteristic of underwater photography.

Outfit: A white to icy blue crochet-style bikini. The top is a halter-neck type based on a triangle, showing dense knit stitches, slightly thick yarn, small bumps at the edges, and thin straps. Not pure white, but an off-white that picks up the blue of the water. The bottom is a matching low-rise side-tie design. The small knot and short strings on the left waist float naturally. The fabric after absorbing water appears slightly soft, not having an unnatural texture that fits the body perfectly.

Accessories: No conspicuous accessories. No jewelry or fashion items like sunglasses, composed only of water, light, swimwear, and pool facilities.

Scene Objects: A stainless steel pool ladder or handrail is on the left side of the frame. Part of the thick vertical pipe and horizontal steps enter, reflecting the blue in the water. Slender white highlights run over the metal surface. On the right is a blue to turquoise pool wall. Small square to horizontally long tiles and deep grout lines are visible, with straight lines slightly swaying due to water refraction.

Pose: In the middle of slowly stretching the body near the water surface. At least one arm is extended upwards, and the other is slightly bent. The area from shoulder to ribcage is stretched vertically, and the torso is not facing forward but slightly twisted. The waist is slightly tilted to one side, with the figure's centerline flowing from the upper left through the center to the lower right, forming a relaxed S-shape. The legs or thighs continue towards the bottom of the frame but are not required to be fully contained, naturally escaping the frame.

Water Surface: The water surface is located near the upper 15-20% of the frame. Not a neat horizontal line, but swaying significantly with waves. The water surface reflects the figure, white swimwear, blue water, and surrounding shapes like a mirror, which are horizontally stretched, meandering, and partially doubled. Irregular reflections mixing skin tone, white, blue, and deep blue. Not a quiet mirror, but a state where small waves continuously pass through.

Lighting: Most important. Intense natural light from nearly directly above passes through the water surface, creating dramatic underwater caustics. Large amounts of irregular mesh-like, wave-like, fine meandering lines, and light spots with broken outlines are projected onto the abdomen, waist, ribcage, flanks, thighs, blue tiles on the right, and the metal ladder on the left. Caustics are not a weak decoration but strongly dominate the image, with parts nearly blown out in white. Colors are not just pure white but change from white to pale yellow and thin orange. Shadows remain deep blue to blue-black in the hair, back of the metal, body shadows, and tile joints.

Effect: Water refraction, local outline swaying, fine floating particles, very thin underwater mist, and strong geometric distortion near the water surface. Parts of the figure's upper body appear duplicated or elongated due to water surface reflection. The frame's color contrast is vivid blue-cyan and warm beige to gold. Not a cinematic teal-and-orange processing, but the actual color difference produced naturally by water and sunlight.

Camera: Shot with a small waterproof camera or a point-and-shoot camera with a waterproof housing fully immersed in water. A close distance of about 0.6-1.0m from the person. Equivalent to a 24-30mm wide-angle lens. No extreme fisheye. ISO around 200-400, about 1/500 second, stopping the movement of water to some extent while leaving very slight bleeding. Aperture equivalent to f/5.6-f/8, so not only the person but also the tiles and ladder are relatively clear. No large background blur. Not an over-high-definition RAW style, but a slightly hard color rendering close to old waterproof card cameras.

Imperfections: Slight contrast reduction caused underwater, blue cast, local chromatic aberration, blown-out light edges, light noise in shadows, subtle outline bleeding, messy hair, asymmetrical poses, natural swaying of bikini strings, and irregular deformation of the water surface are all preserved. No over-smoothing of skin, no over-sharpening of the overall image.

Background: About 30-35% on the right is occupied by a blue to turquoise tiled wall. Grout is slightly dark, and extremely strong caustics also run across the tiles. The left side is the ladder and deep blue water. No tropical resort-style decorations, palm trees, sun loungers, or flashy backgrounds; limited to facilities actually visible in the water.

Atmosphere: An abstract unity of light, waves, body, and tiles. Not a meticulously crafted portrait for admiring a person, but a photo of a midsummer pool where a waterproof camera was pointed underwater, and impressionistic light happened to overlap. Slightly grainy, slightly blue, slightly hard. But the sun coming in from the water surface alone is extremely intense.

Composition: 1:1 square. Person slightly to the left of the center. The body occupies most of the frame height, the head is near the top edge, and the legs are naturally cut off at the bottom. From below the chest to the waist and thighs are relatively large due to the close distance, but no specific parts are cropped. The person's axis is not perfectly vertical but tilts slightly from top left to bottom right. The upper 15-20% is the distorted water surface, the right 30-35% is the tile wall, and the left end is the metal ladder. Almost no empty space, filling the frame with the body, water, and facilities.

Color Palette: Deep water approx. #0C5F88, bright water approx. #1493B6, tiles and water surface approx. #62B0C3, strong blue light approx. #B0D1CF, skin mid-tones approx. #C8B38E, skin shadows approx. #868473, darkest parts approx. #162D39. Cyan remains vivid, skin retains a slight yellowish tone.

Capture Reason: A natural capture reason from a moment of stretching the body near the water surface after sinking a waterproof camera while playing in the pool with friends. The subject is not posing for the camera but is in the process of floating back to the surface, so the gaze also avoids the camera.

Negative: Excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, doll-like face, extreme body proportions, compositions emphasizing body parts, gravure-style frozen poses, looking directly at camera, perfect lighting like advertising photography, tropical resort ads, large background blur, 85mm-style portraits, static mirror-like water, weak caustics, excessive HDR, excessive cinematic grading, fisheye distortion, abnormally high-definition skin texture, faces resembling real people or celebrities, UI, generative AI icons, black rounded corners, text, logos.

Watermark Direction: The string "@Live_life_style" is not text pasted onto the image afterwards, but an optical phenomenon naturally embedded in the light present in the pool from the start.

Integration Method: A part of the water surface caustics falling on the blue tile wall towards the bottom right of the frame, accidentally forming a slender light sequence that can be read as "@Live_life_style". The text outlines do not use a complete digital font, slightly collapsing due to wave refraction, with parts becoming thinner or intermittent.

Subtle Visibility: At first glance, it appears as ordinary water surface reflection light, only readable as a string with a little attention. Not more conspicuous than the protagonist or strong caustics.

Placement: On the blue tile surface from the bottom right to the right center. Not directly superimposed on the character's body. Configured slightly diagonally across the joints, not too straight due to water swaying.

Material Behavior: Treated as refracted light projected onto the tile surface, the text parts are darkly cut off at the joints, and other parts stretch slightly horizontally due to water surface swaying.

Lighting Interaction: Maintains the same brightness, color temperature, and blur as the surrounding white to pale yellow caustics. The watermark does not have fixed luminance and is uneven in brightness according to the water surface waves.

Avoid: Sticker style, digital subtitle style, perfectly neat fonts, pure white logos, directly placed on character skin, black outlines, glowing logos, text floating in front of the frame.

"hair": "黑色到深棕色的自然头发。湿润后成束的部分与水中轻微浮起散开细发束混在其中。几缕头发向画面左上方流动，顺着水流完全未整理。头发上也不规则地跑过细长的水面光。",
"body": "水中折射导致微微拉长或扭曲的自然人体。不完全左右对称，一侧肩膀稍抬，腰部向对侧微微流动。腹部、侧腹、胸廓、腰、 thigh 上从水面投射的光纹连续投影，比身体轮廓本身更留下光的网状印象。",
"skin": "偏亮到中等的自然日本人肤色。一边薄薄拾取水中的青色，直射阳光衍生的 caustics 部分仅显白、淡黄、薄橙强烈发光。肌理不完全抹除，保留细微质感、轻微色差、关节附近的自然阴影。有水下拍摄特有的轻微柔化。",
"outfit": "白色到偏冰蓝的钩针式比基尼。上装以三角形为基础的挂脖型，能看到细密编织眼、稍厚实的纱线、边缘小凹凸、细肩带。不是纯白，而是拾取水中青色的 off-white。下装同色系低腰侧绑设计。左腰小结和短绳自然浮起。吸水后的布料稍显柔软，不做完全贴合身体的不自然质感。",
"accessories": "不戴显眼配饰。不加珠宝或太阳镜等时尚小物，仅用水、光、泳装、泳池设施构成。",
"scene_objects": "画面左侧有不锈钢泳池梯子或扶手。粗竖管和横踏步的一部分进入，反射水中的蓝色。金属表面跑过白色细长高光。右侧是青到绿松石色的泳池墙。可见方形到横长的细小瓷砖和较深接缝，直线因水折射微微摇曳。",
"pose": "水面附近身体缓缓伸展的途中。至少一臂向上伸展，另一臂轻微弯曲。肩到胸廓纵向拉伸，躯干不是正面对，而是稍稍扭转。腰部微微偏向一侧，人物中心线从左上经中央流向右下，形成松弛的S形。腿或大腿向画面下方延续，但不求完整收纳全身，自然地从框架逸出。",
"water_surface": "水面位于画面上部15~20%附近。不做水平线整齐，而是因波浪上下起伏大幅摇晃。水面如镜反射人物、白色泳装、蓝色水、周遭形状，这些被横向拉伸、蛇行、部分双重化。混杂肤色、白、青、浓蓝的不规则倒影。不是静谧镜面，而是小波不断通过的状态。",
"lighting": "最重要。近直上方的强烈自然光通过水面，制造剧烈的 underwater caustics。在腹部、腰、胸廓、侧腹、大腿、右侧青瓷砖、左侧金属梯子上，大量投射不规则网状、波状、细蛇行线、轮廓断裂的光斑。caustics 不是弱装饰，而是强势主宰图像，部分近白飞。颜色不只纯白，还从白变淡黄、薄橙。暗部在头发、金属背侧、身体阴影、瓷砖接缝处留深青到青黑。",
"effect": "水折射、局部轮廓摇曳、细微浮游物、极薄水下雾气、水面附近强烈几何扭曲。人物上半身部分因水面反射显复制、伸长。画面色对比是鲜艳青蓝与温暖米色到金色。不是电影式蒂尔&橙加工，而是实际水和阳光自然生出的色差。",
"camera": "完全浸入水中的小型防水相机或带防水壳的卡片机拍摄。与人物距离约0.6~1.0m的近距离。相当于24~30mm的轻广角。不用极端鱼眼。ISO 200~400左右，约1/500秒，某种程度止住水运动，同时留极微渗出。光圈相当于f/5.6~f/8，不仅人物，瓷砖和梯子也相对清晰。不用大背景虚化。不是RAW调的过度高精，而是接近旧防水卡片机的稍硬发色。",
"imperfections": "水中产生的轻微对比降低、青被、局部色差、光的白飞边缘、暗部的轻噪、轮廓微妙渗出、头发凌乱、左右不对称姿势、比基尼绳自然的摇曳、水面不规则变形，全都保留。不过度均肤化，不过度锐化图像整体。",
"background": "右侧约30~35%被青到绿松石瓷砖墙占据。接缝稍浓，瓷砖上也有极强 caustics 纵横跑动。左侧是梯子和深蓝水。不见南国度假村式装饰、棕榈树、躺椅、华丽背景，仅限水中实际可见的设施。",
"atmosphere": "光、波、身体、瓷砖一体化的抽象性。不是为欣赏人物而精心肖像，而是盛夏泳池把防水相机对准水中，偶然重叠印象性光线的照片。稍粗糙、稍青、稍硬。但唯独从水面射入的太阳极为强烈。",
"composition": "1:1正方形。人物稍偏左于中央。身体占画面高度大部分，头部在上端附近，腿在下端自然截断。胸下到腰、大腿因近距相对较大，但不裁剪特定部位。人物轴不是完全垂直，而是从左上到右下微微倾斜。画面上部15~20%扭曲水面，右30~35%瓷砖墙，左端金属梯子。几乎不留空白，用身体、水、设施填满画面。",
"color_palette": "深水约#0C5F88，亮水约#1493B6，瓷砖和水面约#62B0C3，强青光约#B0D1CF，肤色中调约#C8B38E，肤影约#868473，最暗部约#162D39。青色保持鲜艳，肤色留微黄味。",
"capture_reason": "和朋友来泳池玩时，把防水相机沉入水中，在水面附近伸展身体的瞬间，从近距只拍了一张的自然拍摄缘由。被摄者不是对镜头摆姿势，而是正要浮回水面的途中，所以视线也避开相机。",
"negative": "过度美肌修补、塑料般肌肤、人偶般脸庞、极端身体比例、强调身体局部的构图、写真式定格姿势、直视镜头、广告摄影般的完美照明、南国度假村广告、大背景虚化、85mm风肖像、静止镜面水、过弱 caustics、HDR过多、过度电影分级、鱼眼扭曲、异常高精肤质、似真实人物或名人的脸、UI、生成AI图标、黑色圆角、文字、logo"
}

prompts.text:
Create a premium commercial poster for an original instant tomato soup brand named "VELORA SIPS". Use an ultra-realistic food advertising style with a warm cinematic kitchen-still-life mood. Preserve the exact structural logic: a tall vertical poster, a softly blurred dark kitchen background, one large red enamel pot floating in the upper center filled with rich tomato soup, one single upright squeeze-soup sachet positioned directly below the pot like a narrow central connector, and one branded ceramic mug in the lower center receiving the soup stream. The entire composition must create the striking illusion that a full pot of homemade soup is being transformed through one elegant pack into an instantly drinkable serving below. The product must remain the absolute visual hero and the image must feel like a Cannes-level FMCG campaign: clever, clean, appetizing, iconic, and instantly memorable.

Style lock:
Premium food advertising, ultra-real product photography, warm kitchen atmosphere, product-first composition, clever visual metaphor, refined tabletop styling, high-end retail poster finish, minimal clutter, strong symbolic readability.

Core composition:
Place one red enamel soup pot in the upper-middle, front-facing, with both handles visible and a smooth front lip where the soup gently pours downward. Directly beneath the pot, align one narrow squeeze-soup pack vertically in the center so it visually bridges the gap between the pot and the mug. The pack must feel perfectly centered, sharp, and deliberate, like the compressed essence of the full recipe. Below it, place one ceramic mug on a wooden tabletop, centered and slightly enlarged, filled with warm tomato soup. The stream of soup must connect the pot, the pack, and the mug in one continuous vertical axis. Surround the lower scene with a controlled ring of fresh tomatoes and a few basil leaves, neatly arranged and clearly secondary.

Port super-symbol logic:
Turn the pot-pack-mug vertical chain into the brand’s unmistakable super-symbol. The viewer should instantly recognize the identity through one upper source vessel, one slim central squeeze pack, and one comforting serving cup below. The image must read as a complete flavor-convenience ritual condensed into one iconic stacked form. This vertical conversion line should feel ownable, memorable, and readable even at thumbnail scale.

Orbit motion logic:
Create a clear circular reading path around the central vertical chain. The eye should begin at the pot rim, follow the soup stream downward into the sachet, continue into the mug surface, sweep outward through the front tomatoes and basil leaves, then rise back upward along the steam curls and soft side highlights toward the pot again. Use steam direction, tomato placement, basil arcs, soup flow, and pot curvature to build one elegant loop that repeatedly draws attention back to the center product transformation.

Product design:
Design one original squeeze-soup pack for "VELORA SIPS" with readable English packaging text such as "Tomato & Basil". The packaging should feel premium, shelf-ready, sharply printed, and globally marketable. Design one matching ceramic mug with the same brand identity in a bold but elegant food-brand style. The mug and sachet must clearly belong to the same product family.

Lighting:
Use soft warm studio lighting from upper-left with gentle frontal fill. Add appetizing highlights on the soup surface, soft reflections on the enamel pot, subtle printed-package sheen, and a warm glow on the ceramic mug. Let the background remain darker and diffused so the product stack projects forward. Shadows must be soft, rich, and clean.

Materials and realism:
Render the soup with rich tomato-red density, subtle surface gloss, realistic viscosity, and a smooth continuous pour. Render the red enamel pot with clean glazed finish, soft edge highlights, realistic curvature, and premium kitchenware realism. Render the sachet with crisp flexible packaging material, believable folds, accurate hanging tension, and sharp print detail. Render the ceramic mug with glossy glaze, thick rim, realistic handle, and faint rising steam. Render the tomatoes with natural skin sheen, stem detail, and believable freshness. Render basil leaves with soft vein detail and fresh green elasticity. Render the wooden table as matte, warm, and slightly rustic but refined.

Color strategy:
Dominant palette: tomato red, warm terracotta, deep kitchen brown, soft cream white. Secondary tones: fresh basil green, muted wood brown, soft amber highlights. Keep the mood warm, comforting, hearty, and premium, with the red soup system as the strongest color anchor.

Concept atmosphere:
The image should communicate warmth, flavor concentration, crafted comfort, and smart simplicity. The upper pot represents abundance, the central sachet represents modern convenience, and the lower mug represents immediate enjoyment. The full poster must feel like one elegant ritual frozen into a single commercial symbol.

Typography and layout:
Do not add any extra poster headline outside the product packaging and mug branding. Only the pack and mug may contain original readable English branding and product text. Keep the overall image text-minimal beyond the product itself.

Quality target:
Hyper-detailed, high-resolution commercial finish, appetizing soup realism, pristine packshot sharpness, clean steam rendering, elegant tabletop depth, strong symbolic readability, no clutter, no muddy shadows, no cheap grocery flyer look.

Negative prompt:
copied branding, copied slogan, extra headline text, weak product hierarchy, unrealistic soup flow, blurry packaging, warped mug shape, cheap kitchen styling, muddy tomatoes, fake steam, low-resolution print, greasy clutter, black blotches, unreadable label, distorted pot perspective

prompts.text:
为名为“VELORA SIPS”的原创新鲜番茄汤品牌制作一张高端商业海报。采用超写实食品广告风格，营造温暖电影感的厨房静物氛围。保持精确的结构逻辑：一张高窄竖版海报，柔焦的暗调厨房背景，一个大型红色搪瓷锅漂浮在上方中心，里面装满了浓郁的番茄汤，一个直立的单条装挤压式汤料包直接位于锅下方，就像一个狭窄的中央连接器，下方中心是一个品牌陶瓷马克杯，承接着流下的汤液。整个构图必须创造出一种引人注目的错觉，即一整锅自制汤正通过一个优雅的包装转化为下方即刻饮用的份量。产品必须保持绝对的视觉主角地位，图像必须感觉像是戛纳级别的快速消费品广告：巧妙、干净、令人垂涎、标志性且过目不忘。

风格锁定：
高端食品广告，超写实产品摄影，温馨厨房氛围，产品优先构图，巧妙的视觉隐喻，精致的台面造型，高端零售海报饰面，极简杂乱，极强的符号可读性。

核心构图：
在上方中间放置一个红色搪瓷汤锅，面向前方，两个手柄可见，平滑的前边缘处汤汁轻轻向下倾倒。在锅正下方，在中心垂直对齐一个窄小的挤压汤包，使其在视觉上桥接锅和马克杯之间的间隙。包装必须感觉完美居中、清晰且刻意，就像完整配方的压缩精华。在其下方，在木质桌面上放置一个陶瓷马克杯，居中并略微放大，盛满温暖的番茄汤。汤流必须在一条连续的垂直轴上连接锅、包装和马克杯。用一圈受控的新鲜番茄和几片罗勒叶环绕下层场景，排列整齐且明显处于次要地位。

超级符号逻辑：
将锅-包-杯垂直链条转化为品牌独一无二的超级符号。观众应通过上方的源头容器、中间的纤细挤压包和下方的舒适饮用杯立即识别出其身份。图像必须读起来像是一个压缩成一个标志性叠加形式的完整风味便利仪式。这条垂直转化线应该是可拥有的、令人难忘的，即使在缩略图比例下也清晰可见。

轨道运动逻辑：
围绕中央垂直链条创建一个清晰的圆形阅读路径。视线应从锅边开始，顺着汤流向下进入包装袋，继续进入马克杯表面，通过前方的番茄和罗勒叶向外扫动，然后沿着蒸汽卷和柔和的侧面高光再次向上回到锅部。利用蒸汽方向、番茄位置、罗勒弧线、汤流和锅的曲率构建一个优雅的循环，反复将注意力吸引回中心的产品转化。

产品设计：
为“VELORA SIPS”设计一个原创的挤压汤包，带有可读的英文包装文本，如“Tomato & Basil”。包装应感觉高端、上架即用、印刷清晰且具有全球市场吸引力。设计一个匹配的陶瓷马克杯，采用相同品牌标识，呈现大胆而优雅的食品品牌风格。马克杯和包装袋必须明显属于同一产品系列。

灯光：
使用来自左上方的柔和暖色影棚灯光，带有柔和的前部补光。在汤表面添加令人垂涎的高光，在搪瓷锅上添加柔和的反光，在印刷包装上添加微妙的光泽，并在陶瓷马克杯上添加温暖的光芒。让背景保持较暗且模糊，使产品堆叠结构向前突出。阴影必须柔和、丰富且干净。

材质与写实度：
渲染具有浓郁番茄红密度、微妙表面光泽、真实粘度和顺滑连续倾倒感的汤。渲染具有干净釉面效果、柔和边缘高光、真实曲率和高端厨具写实感的红色搪瓷锅。渲染具有脆亮柔性包装材料、可信褶皱、准确悬挂张力和清晰印刷细节的包装袋。渲染具有光滑釉面、厚边缘、真实手柄和微弱上升蒸汽的陶瓷马克杯。渲染具有自然表皮光泽、蒂部细节和可信新鲜度的番茄。渲染具有细微叶脉细节和新鲜绿色弹性的罗勒叶。将木桌渲染为哑光、温暖且略显乡村但精致。

色彩策略：
主色调：番茄红、温暖的赤陶色、深色厨房棕色、柔和的奶油白。次要色调：新鲜罗勒绿、柔和的木棕色、柔和的琥珀色高光。保持心情温暖、舒适、丰盛且高端，以红色汤系统作为最强的色彩锚点。

概念氛围：
图像应传达温暖、风味浓缩、精心打造的舒适感和巧妙的简约。上方的锅代表丰饶，中央的包装袋代表现代便利，下方的马克杯代表即刻享受。整张海报必须感觉像是一个冻结在单一商业符号中的优雅仪式。

排版与布局：
不要在产品包装和马克杯品牌之外添加任何额外的海报标题。只有包装袋和马克杯可以包含原创的可读英文品牌和产品文本。保持整体图像除了产品本身之外文字极简。

质量目标：
极高细节，高分辨率商业饰面，诱人的汤汁写实感，原始的包装清晰度，干净的蒸汽渲染，优雅的台面深度，极强的符号可读性，无杂乱，无模糊阴影，无廉价杂货传单感。

负面提示词：
抄袭的品牌，抄袭的标语，额外的标题文本，虚弱的产品层级，不真实的汤流，模糊的包装，扭曲的马克杯形状，廉价的厨房造型，浑浊的番茄，虚假的蒸汽，低分辨率打印，油腻的杂乱，黑色斑点，不可读的标签，扭曲的锅透视

items.title: 工业海滨落日余晖女性三连帧摄影

prompts.text: Create a realistic vertical 9:16 photographed portrait. Subject and action: One woman repeated across all three panels at the waterfront: calm upright side profile, distant leftward gaze, neutral closed mouth, and restrained body movement. prompts.text: Create an authentic vertical 9:16 close-range smartphone portrait of an explicitly adult young woman, combining restrained classical East-Asian-inspired styling with the intimacy of a modern phone selfie. She is seated beside a window in a quiet private interior, leaning noticeably forward toward the lens. Place the camera extremely close, around slightly below face level or upper-chest height, using a mild upward angle. Reproduce the perspective of a 24–28mm full-frame-equivalent smartphone front camera: keep the face relatively natural while allowing the broad sleeve extending toward the camera to become visibly enlarged in the lower-right foreground.  Preserve a small, softly shaped natural face, slight real-world facial asymmetry, a clean but not artificially sharp jawline, and normally proportioned eyes. Her head tilts gently toward image-right, with the chin very slightly raised. She looks directly into the lens with relaxed eyelids and clear window catchlights in her dark irises. Her lips remain naturally closed, without an obvious smile. The expression should feel as though she has just leaned closer to glance at the phone and has not deliberately arranged her face for the photograph; the quiet feeling from the previous second still remains.  Use thin, low-saturation East-Asian costume-drama-inspired makeup: soft gray-brown brows, extremely fine brown-black inner eyeliner, light taupe mixed with muted dusty-rose eyeshadow, naturally elongated but not overly dense eyelashes, almost no visible nose contour, a trace of cool-pink cheek color, and softly blurred muted rose-pink lips. Avoid heavy contouring and obvious powder highlighter.  Her hair is long, mostly straight, and nearly black with a deep brown undertone, lightly tied or half-pinned behind the head. Leave irregular wispy long bangs across the forehead and several long strands beside the cheeks. Do not make the hair commercially perfect. Retain many tiny flyaway hairs around the crown, temples, ears, and silhouette. Strong real backlight from the upper-left turns these flyaways into thin silver-white lines, as if a mild draft disturbed the hair a moment earlier and it has not completely settled yet.  Add delicate small floral hair ornaments on both sides. On image-left, use pale petals with a few pastel blue and soft pink beads. On image-right, use a fine gold-toned structure with pearls and several small teardrop-shaped dangling beads. Keep them lightweight and refined. Do not add a visible necklace or large modern statement jewelry.  The adult figure is naturally slender. Visible skin includes the full face, neck, both shoulders, collarbones, the upper-chest area down to the garment edge, and only a small amount of upper-arm skin. The skin is fair with a neutral-to-slightly-warm undertone, while blue-gray environmental reflections introduce a subtle cyan-gray cast into the shadow side. The skin should visually and tactilely suggest fine, soft, mildly warm human skin: smooth but not waxy, with extremely subtle pores, tiny facial hairs, local tone variation, and natural softness rather than aggressive beauty filtering.  Dress her in a loose ivory or creamy off-white overlapping classical robe or lightweight Han-inspired garment, with broad sleeves and a naturally draped deep V-shaped neckline. The fabric is soft, lightweight, faintly translucent, and lightly wrinkled. Gravity and the forward-leaning posture cause the neckline to slip naturally off the shoulders, revealing the collarbones and upper chest. Keep the amount of exposed skin exactly within the reference range; do not increase the neckline or create exaggerated chest compression. At the waist, only a small portion of a desaturated pale blue-gray or mint-gray fabric sash is visible. The broad sleeve in the lower-right sits extremely close to the lens, becomes oversized from wide-angle perspective, and catches a bright patch of real sunlight.  Treat the illumination as physical light rather than vague “atmospheric lighting.” The only strong key light is genuine daylight from a real window located upper-left or upper-left-rear of the subject. Slightly cool-white direct sunlight strikes the hair, ear area, left shoulder, collarbones, and part of the foreground sleeve. Allow mild highlight clipping, especially across the left shoulder. Retain soft but clearly physical shadows beneath the chin and along the neck. The cool blue-gray walls act only as weak natural bounce, introducing a faint cyan-gray fill into shadow areas rather than eliminating the shadows. Do not introduce studio three-point lighting, artificial fill lamps, or fake rim lights.  The background is an ordinary quiet private interior rather than a designed set. Use low-saturation cool blue-gray walls and a simple wall-to-ceiling transition, with only a narrow dark edge of a cabinet, doorframe, or furniture piece along image-right. Keep decoration minimal. The background should sit approximately one to two stops darker than the subject and fall gently out of focus while still retaining believable room geometry.  The final photograph should feel like a casual window-side image taken in the morning or earlier part of the day: cool, quiet, soft, restrained, slightly half-awake. The visual tension comes from classical hair ornaments and clothing appearing inside a very modern close smartphone perspective. Preserve accidents and imperfections: flyaway hair, uneven shoulder height, slightly displaced neckline, mild highlight clipping, subtle phone sharpening, tiny digital noise, mild compression texture, slight framing drift, natural facial asymmetry, and foreground wide-angle distortion. She had already leaned into the light; she is looking into the lens now; in the next second she may look away or sit upright again. prompts.text:
Create a bold editorial campaign poster where oversized typography behaves like a physical material instead of remaining flat and static.

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product / Campaign: [PRODUCT OR CAMPAIGN]
Main Word: [SHORT WORD]
Subject: [PERSON / PRODUCT / BOTH]
Material Behavior: [FOLD / PEEL / SPLIT / REFLECT / OTHER]
Main Color: [COLOR]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Campaign Details: [SLOGAN / SPECS / DATE]
Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Use realistic commercial photography, oversized typography, strong high-contrast colors, and contemporary editorial design.

Make the main word extremely large, filling roughly 50–75% of the composition. Let the typography physically react according to the selected material behavior:

 FOLD: create clean creases and folded planes that follow the product or subject’s structural direction.
 PEEL: build several clean color layers and let the top layer lift away to reveal what is underneath.
 SPLIT: divide the typography into several large strips and shift them in alternating directions while keeping the subject visually intact.
 REFLECT: turn the letterforms into flat mirrored surfaces that realistically reflect the subject, product, and surrounding colors.

Create strong foreground–subject–background interaction so the person or product feels physically connected to the typography.

Use one dominant color with black, white, and one contrasting accent color. Add only a few meaningful campaign details such as the brand name, product name, slogan, specifications, or small editorial labels.

Keep people, products, materials, lighting, and reflections realistic and polished.

The final image should feel like a finished campaign key visual — bold, colorful, layered, and conceptually clear.

Avoid generic subject + big text layouts, random deformation, heavy 3D lettering, meaningless filler text, excessive UI graphics, clutter, and disconnected visual effects.

Dark brown curtains, white tile floor, black furniture on the right edge of the frame. Soft front lighting illuminates the face and chest, while the background is dim and quiet.

Composition・Lens:
The focus of the lens is placed on the face and the hand in the foreground, cropping the visible range to the edges of the frame and naturally blurring the background. Place the face in the center and zoom in. 3:4 vertical composition, extreme top-down wide-angle close-up photo. Place the face in the center of the upper half, with the chest and knees arranged downwards, and the thick forearm and hand greatly enlarged as the largest foreground object. Partially include blurred black clothing at the bottom edge.

Texture・Style:
Photorealistic realistic photo. High-definition realism with a sense of flash. Vividly presenting the glow of the skin, long eyelashes, rib fabric, the skin in the foreground, and emphasizing the peach color.

Negative Prompt:
Do not shrink the foreground hand and forearm; do not make the top-down angle shallower.

主题：
仰望的桃色

主体：
将人物的脸部置于画面中央并放大。从近正上方俯视室内地板上坐着的女性，前方伸出一只大手包裹住下巴和脸颊，采用纵向构图的照片。特殊近距离构图，将女性的脸置于中央，前臂从左下方斜向中央大幅纳入。

人物・表情：
抬起脸直视镜头，略微张开光泽的嘴唇。小巧的卵形轮廓和纤细的下巴、宽大的横长眼睛和上下长睫毛、细致的柔和眉毛、细直的鼻梁和小巧的鼻尖、丰满的粉色嘴唇。脸颊上带有浓郁的桃色腮红。长而明亮的茶色头发，有偏向中央的分线和薄薄的刘海，向肩部和地板方向散开。

服装・姿势：
浅粉色的罗纹编织上衣，深V领、前排纽扣和胸下小蝴蝶结，搭配白色短裙。双膝并拢坐姿，另一人物的手从画面左下方伸出支撑下巴下方和双颊。女性自己的手臂位于画面外。

背景・光线：
深棕色的窗帘、白色瓷砖地板、画面右端的黑色家具。正面柔和的光线照亮脸部和胸口，背景则昏暗而宁静。

构图・镜头：
镜头的焦点置于脸部和前景的手上，将可见范围裁剪至画面边缘，自然模糊背景。将脸部置于中央并放大。3:4纵向构图，极端俯瞰的广角近接照片。将脸部置于上半部分中央，胸口和膝盖向下排列，将粗壮的前臂和手作为最大的前景物体大幅放大。在下端模糊纳入黑色衣物的一部分。

质感・风格：
照片级真实写实照片。带有闪光感的高精细写实。鲜明呈现肌肤的光泽、长睫毛、罗纹面料、前景的肌肤，并强调桃色。

负面提示：
不要将前景的手和前臂缩小；不要将俯瞰角度变浅

prompts.text:
Hyper-realistic indoor bedroom close-up portrait photography, vertical version approximately 4:5, a young adult East Asian female sitting on the front edge of a messy light beige bed, photographed in a posture of sitting slightly sideways with the body leaning gently forward toward the lens. The lens is located directly in front of the character slightly to the right, using an approximately 35–50mm equivalent mobile phone/portable camera lens, distance approximately 1–1.4 meters, camera position near the character's chest and abdomen height, slight eye-level view. The composition captures completely from the top of the head to the middle of the thighs, the character is located in the center of the frame, occupying about 85–90% of the frame height, the face, neck/shoulders, and upper body are the main visual centers, the lower part retains one bent thigh and a white sock cuff. The background is basically clear, no fisheye used, no obvious creamy bokeh.

The character has a naturally plump adult female figure, a medium-to-small skeleton, moderate to narrow shoulders, a plump upper body, the waist is distinct but naturally tapered, the pelvis and hips are wide, and the thighs are plump and soft. The overall proportion is a compact natural hourglass, not a tall and thin model. The torso length is medium-short, the distance from under the chest to the pelvis should not be stretched too long; the shoulder-waist-hip ratio is natural, the thighs and hips have realistic soft tissue compression in the sitting posture, no athletic muscular type, no extreme bee waist, no giant buttocks with thin legs.

The character sits on the edge of the bed, the pelvis is slightly offset to the character's right, and the upper body is slightly tilted to the character's left, forming a soft asymmetrical curve. The character's left leg is bent at the knee and raised toward the lower-left foreground of the frame, the thigh horizontally occupies a large area of the lower half of the frame; the other leg is located under the body or blocked by the edge of the bed. Both arms naturally extend downwards from the body, hands falling near the legs or the bed surface, mostly out of the frame. Shoulders are relaxed, no exaggerated posing.

Head slightly tilted to the character's right, chin slightly raised, eyes looking directly at the camera, expression quiet and slightly cold. Lips naturally closed or slightly parted, no toothy smile.

The character has jet-black medium-short layered hair, length reaching near the shoulders, overall straight but the hair ends have slight outward flips and natural messy layers. The top of the head is near a middle part leaning slightly to a side part, the front of the forehead has thin air bangs, length near the eyebrows, slightly sparse in the center, with longer stray hairs on both sides naturally clinging near the cheeks and jaw. No extra-long hair, thick blunt bangs, or large curls.

The face shape is small and slightly oval, the jawline is soft, and the skin tone is fair leaning warm. Deep brown almond eyes, natural double eyelids, eyeliner is thin and long slightly upturned, eyelashes are clear; eyebrows are naturally thin, nose bridge is small and straight, lips are naturally plump, nude pink bean paste color. Cheeks have a slight pink blush, skin retains real texture and natural soft light, no plastic skin smoothing.

The character wears a pair of black thick-framed large square-round glasses, the frame is black acetate material, the contour leans rectangular but the four corners are rounded, the size is slightly large, completely surrounding both eyes. The lenses are transparent, carrying only very slight indoor reflections, must not cover the eyes. The glasses are one of the styling focuses, do not generate thin metal frames, rimless, or cat-eye frames.

The upper body wears an extremely thin, soft, semi-transparent ivory white long-sleeved cardigan/knit top. The material is thin fine knit or transparent rib fabric, capable of seeing very fine fabric textures and natural light transmission. The neckline is extremely wide, in an asymmetric off-shoulder/wide V-neck structure, the left shoulder is obviously slipped down, completely exposing the shoulder head and collarbone, the right shoulder is also quite open.

The front placket of the cardigan is only fastened by a few small buttons near the upper-middle part of the chest, forming an obvious semi-open placket structure: the upper part of the chest is covered by the clothing material, the middle and lower parts of the front placket naturally open, exposing a vertical opening and a large area of the waist and abdomen. The hem of the garment is short, ending near the waistline. Do not generate the top as a normal fully buttoned cardigan, T-shirt, or sweater.

The long sleeves are very slim-fit but slightly soft, sleeve length exceeds the wrists, forming natural folds near the wrists and the back of the hands, the cuffs have very slight wavy/lettuce edges. The overall clothing color is warm white, cream white, ivory white, no pure cold white.

The lower body wears cream white/ivory white ultra-short loungewear shorts, material is soft thin cotton, satin, or thin knit, the waistband is elastic and carries a thin white drawstring, the drawstring hangs down naturally in the front. The pant legs are very short, the edges have slight ruffles/wavy pleats, the left and right pant legs produce soft folds in the sitting posture. No denim shorts, sweatpants, or skirts.

On the character's left bent thigh, a cuff of a pure white or milky white over-the-knee sock/thigh-high sock is visible, the cuff position is from the lower thigh to above the knee, only showing a section of white ribbed edge and a small amount of the sock surface. No black stockings, fishnets, or complex lace stockings.

The scene is a warm, minimalist bedroom. Behind the character is a large light beige bed, covered with cream white, ivory white, light beige sheets and quilts, the bedding is obviously messy, with a large number of naturally accumulated soft folds on both sides of the character. The bed cannot be too neat, there must be realistic ups and downs, indentations, and folds.

The background wall is warm beige-gray/light khaki gray, overall very clean. The right side of the frame is a full width of light beige-gray thick curtains, hanging from the top to behind the bed, forming obvious vertical soft folds. The right edge of the curtain has a strip of warm yellow light or warm light from outside the window, forming a very thin golden vertical bright edge, adding a slight warm atmosphere to the whole frame.

The left background is mainly the light beige wall and the bed, no complex furniture, TVs, decorative paintings, or clutter added. The overall space remains quiet, simple, and lifelike.

The light is soft warm white bedroom ambient light + slight natural window light. The character's face, neck/shoulders, and white clothes are brightly and softly exposed, but not overexposed. The warm light on the edge of the right curtain adds very slight warm-colored silhouettes to the hair, shoulders, and the right side of the body. Shadows are soft, overall low contrast, low saturation, leaning towards a creamy tone.

The image presents a realistic high-quality mobile phone/portable camera bedroom snapshot texture: natural sharpening, slight mobile phone HDR, a small amount of high ISO fine grain, realistic skin tone. Focus on expressing black layered short hair, black-framed glasses, ivory white semi-transparent cardigan, wide-collar off-shoulder structure, semi-open front placket, soft white shorts, bent plump thighs, white sock cuffs, messy cream-colored bedding, and beige-gray curtains.

Key locks: Black medium-short layered hair + air bangs + large black thick-framed glasses + close-up sitting on the edge of the bed + body leaning slightly forward + one thigh bent into the foreground + ivory white ultra-thin semi-transparent long-sleeved cardigan + wide collar slipping off to expose the shoulder + front placket with only a few buttons fastened, lower part naturally open + short style exposing the waist + cream white ultra-short drawstring loungewear shorts + white thigh-high sock cuff + warm beige-gray bedroom + large amount of messy cream-white bedding + light gray curtains on the right + soft warm white snapshot lighting.

Avoid: Long hair, Bob cut too short, thick blunt bangs, thin metal glasses, no glasses.

prompts.text:
超写实室内卧室近距离人像摄影，竖版约 4:5，一名年轻成年东亚女性坐在凌乱的浅米白床铺前沿，以略微侧坐、身体轻轻向镜头前倾的姿态拍摄。镜头位于人物正前方略偏右，采用约 35–50mm 等效手机/便携相机镜头，距离约 1–1.4 米，机位接近人物胸腹高度，轻微平视。构图从头顶完整拍到大腿中部，人物位于画面中央，占画面高度约 85–90%，脸部、肩颈和上半身是主要视觉中心，下半部保留一条屈起的大腿和白色袜口。背景基本清晰，不使用鱼眼，不做明显奶油虚化。

人物为自然丰满的成年女性身材，骨架中等偏小，肩膀适中偏窄，上半身丰满，腰部明显但自然收束，骨盆和髋部较宽，大腿丰满柔软。整体是紧凑型自然沙漏比例，不是高挑纤瘦模特。躯干长度中等偏短，胸下到骨盆之间距离不要拉得过长；肩腰胯比例自然，坐姿下大腿和髋部具有真实软组织压缩，不要健美肌肉型，不要极端蜂腰，不要巨臀细腿。

人物坐在床沿，骨盆略向人物右侧偏移，上半身轻微向人物左侧倾斜，形成柔和不对称曲线。人物左腿屈膝向画面左下前景抬起，大腿横向占据画面下半部较大区域；另一条腿位于身体下方或被床沿遮挡。双臂自然向身体下方延伸，双手落在腿边或床面附近，大部分离开画面。肩膀放松，不做夸张摆拍。

头部轻微向人物右侧倾斜，下巴略抬，双眼直接看向镜头，表情安静、轻微冷淡。嘴唇自然闭合或轻微分开，不露齿笑。

人物留乌黑色中短层次发，长度到肩膀附近，整体顺直但发尾有轻微外翻和自然凌乱层次。头顶接近中分偏轻微侧分，额前是轻薄空气刘海，长度接近眉毛，中央略稀疏，两侧有较长碎发自然贴在脸颊和下颌附近。不要超长发、厚齐刘海、大卷发。

脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，下颌线柔和，肤色白皙偏暖。深棕色杏仁眼，双眼皮自然，眼线细长轻微上扬，睫毛清晰；眉毛自然偏细，鼻梁小巧顺直，嘴唇自然丰满，裸粉豆沙色。双颊带轻微粉红腮红，皮肤保留真实纹理与自然柔光，不要塑料磨皮。

人物佩戴一副黑色粗框大号方圆形眼镜，镜框为黑色醋酸板材，轮廓偏矩形但四角圆润，尺寸略大，完整包围双眼。镜片透明，只带极轻微室内反光，不能遮住眼睛。眼镜是造型重点之一，不要生成细金属框、无框或猫眼框。

上身穿一件极薄、柔软、半透感的象牙白色长袖开衫/针织上衣。材质为轻薄细针织或透明感罗纹面料，能够看到非常细的织物纹理和自然透光。领口极宽，呈不对称斜肩/宽 V 领结构，左侧肩膀明显滑落，完整露出肩头和锁骨，右侧肩部也较开放。

开衫前襟只有靠近胸口中上部的少量小纽扣扣住，形成明显的半开襟结构：胸前上部由衣料部分覆盖，中下部前襟自然敞开，露出一条纵向开口和大片腰腹区域。衣服下摆较短，结束在腰线附近。不要把上衣生成普通完整扣好的开衫、T 恤或毛衣。

长袖非常修身但略微松软，袖长超过手腕，在手腕和手背附近形成自然堆褶，袖口带极轻微波浪边/卷边。衣服整体为暖白、奶油白、象牙白，不要纯冷白。

下身穿奶油白/象牙白色超短居家短裤，材质为柔软薄棉、绸缎或轻薄针织，腰头为松紧带并带一根细白色抽绳，抽绳在正前方自然垂下。裤腿非常短，边缘带轻微荷叶边/波浪褶边，坐姿下左右裤脚产生柔软皱褶。不要牛仔短裤、运动裤或裙子。

人物左侧屈起的大腿上可见一只纯白色或奶白色过膝长袜/大腿袜的袜口，袜口位置在大腿下部至膝盖上方，只露出一段白色罗纹边缘和少量袜面。不要黑丝袜、网袜或复杂蕾丝袜。

场景为温暖、极简的卧室。人物身后是一张浅米白色大床，铺着奶油白、象牙白、浅米色的床单和被子，床品明显凌乱，人物左右两侧都有大量自然堆积的柔软褶皱。床铺不能过于整洁，要有真实起伏、压痕和折叠。

背景墙为暖米灰/浅卡其灰色，整体非常干净。画面右侧是一整幅浅米灰色厚窗帘，从顶部垂落到床后，形成明显纵向柔软褶皱。窗帘右侧边缘有一条暖黄色灯光或窗外暖光，形成很细的金色竖向亮边，为整个画面增加轻微暖色氛围。

左侧背景主要是浅米墙面和床铺，不加入复杂家具、电视、装饰画或杂物。整体空间保持安静、简洁、生活化。

光线为柔和暖白卧室环境光＋轻微自然窗光。人物脸部、肩颈和白色衣服曝光明亮柔和，但不过曝。右侧窗帘边缘的暖光给头发、肩膀和身体右侧增加非常轻微的暖色轮廓。阴影柔和，整体低对比、低饱和、偏奶油色。

画面呈真实高质量手机/便携相机卧室随手拍质感：自然锐化、轻微手机 HDR、少量高 ISO 细腻颗粒，肤色真实。重点表现黑色层次短发、黑框眼镜、象牙白半透明开衫、宽领露肩结构、前襟半开、柔软白色短裤、屈起丰满大腿、白色袜口、凌乱奶油色床品和米灰窗帘。

重点锁定：黑色中短层次发＋空气刘海＋大号黑色粗框眼镜＋近距离床沿坐姿＋身体略前倾＋一条大腿屈起进入前景＋象牙白超薄半透长袖开衫＋宽领滑落露肩＋前襟仅少量纽扣扣住、下部自然敞开＋短款露腰＋奶油白超短抽绳居家短裤＋白色大腿袜袜口＋暖米灰卧室＋大量凌乱奶油白床品＋右侧浅灰窗帘＋柔和暖白生活照光线。

避免：长发、短 Bob 过短、厚齐刘海、细金属眼镜、无眼镜

items.title: 高级布艺拼贴旅行记忆海报

prompts.text: Please turn each travel photo I upload into an independent high-end fabric collage memory poster, outputting each photo separately without stitching multiple images together. The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout, and the final product must simultaneously feature clearly identifiable original photography and a fabric re-rendering of the same scene. The top part retains about 46%–52% of the original photo, faithfully maintaining the identity, quantity, and posture of subjects, architectural structures, layers of mountains and waters, horizons, roads, water surfaces, real textures, natural light and shadow, and original colors, with only slight color grading for travel magazines and art publications. Do not stretch, mirror, change the subject, or turn the photo into an illustration. The bottom part uses warm natural linen, old cotton, or faded fabrics as the base. First understand the ridges, clouds, buildings, clusters of trees, water surfaces, roads, people, animals, or vehicles that truly determine the recognizability in the photo, and then compress the complex scene into 4–8 major fabric layers. Reorganize the same scene using faded cotton, coarse linen, denim, plaid fabric, corduroy, old shirt fabric, gauze, and a very small amount of wool yarn; each piece of fabric must correspond to the real spatial relationship in the photo, without adding irrelevant decorations. The fabric layers retain real warp and weft textures, washed fading, raw edges, frayed threads, creases, patch overlays, and slight thickness. Use uneven hand-sewn lines, overlock stitches, backstitches, and a small amount of embroidery thread to emphasize subject outlines, ridges, reflections, or directions of movement. The stitches can be hesitant, loose, and inconsistent in density, but do not make it like a refined craft sample. People and animals are summarized using only small pieces of fabric and stitch marks, maintaining quantity, posture, and direction without depicting facial features. The bottom part adopts a physical structured secondary composition: the main fabric collage occupies about 58%–76% of the re-rendering area, which can be shrunk into an independent setting or formed with a strong outline using a small number of large fabric layers, do not follow the complete framing of the photo in equal proportions. Retain at least 25%–40% of continuously visible linen or old cotton empty space around the collage. Colors are extracted entirely from the original photo and softened, prioritizing the retention of the most recognizable color of the location, while the rest are unified into low to medium saturation old fabric colors. Do not fixedly apply country floral patterns or orange-blue palettes. In the bottom white space, add a 1–3 English word title, a woven-label-style number, and a line of a 5–10 English word observation sentence. The title looks like slightly uneven hand-embroidered letters, and the fields and observation sentences look like old woven labels or fine-stitch text sewn onto the base fabric, clearly readable at normal preview size. The text must come from the actual visible location, action, weather, or color in the photo; use the scene theme when the location cannot be confirmed, do not fabricate place names and dates. The overall temperament is warm, quiet, handmade, with a sense of vintage items, possessing preserved travel memories. Mandatory avoidance: paper collage, torn paper edges, pure felt painting, tufted carpets, crochet dolls, refined embroidery samples, lace buttons, journal ephemera, printed photo patches, smooth vector color blocks, plastic synthetic fabrics, children's crafts, bottom part completely covered, fixed sunset color schemes, author names, signatures, logos, QR codes, watermarks, gibberish.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的高级布艺拼贴记忆海报，每张照片单独输出，不多图拼接。整体采用3:4竖版构图，成品中必须同时出现清楚可辨的原始摄影与同场景布艺转绘。

上方保留原始照片约46%–52%，忠实保持主体身份、数量、姿态、建筑结构、山水层次、地平线、道路、水面、真实材质、自然光影和原有色彩，只进行轻微旅行杂志与艺术出版物调色。不得拉伸、镜像、改变主体或把照片画成插画。

下方使用温暖的天然亚麻、旧棉布或褪色织物作为基底。先理解照片中真正决定识别度的山脊、云层、建筑、树群、水面、道路、人物、动物或车辆，再将复杂场景压缩成4–8个主要布层。使用褪色棉布、粗亚麻、牛仔、格纹布、灯芯绒、旧衬衫布、纱布和极少量毛线重新组织同一场景；每块布都必须对应照片中的真实空间关系，不添加无关装饰。

布层保留真实经纬纹、洗旧褪色、毛边、抽丝、折痕、补丁叠压与轻微厚度。使用不均匀手缝线、锁边、回针和少量刺绣线强调主体轮廓、山脊、倒影或运动方向。针脚可以迟疑、松动、疏密不一，但不要做成精致工艺品样板。人物和动物只用小块布与线迹概括，保持数量、姿态和方向，不描绘五官。

下方采用实体结构化的二次构图：主体布艺拼贴占转绘区约58%–76%，可以缩小成一块独立布景或以少量大布层形成强轮廓，不要沿用照片的完整取景等比例重做。拼贴周围至少保留25%–40%连续可见的亚麻或旧棉布空场。

颜色完全从原照片提取并柔化，优先保留地点最有识别度的一处颜色，其余统一为低至中等饱和的旧织物色。不要固定套用乡村碎花或橙蓝色盘。

在下方留白中加入一个1–3个英文单词标题、一个织标式编号和一行5–10个英文单词观察句。标题像略微不齐的手绣字，字段与观察句像缝在底布上的旧织标或细针脚文字，正常预览尺寸下清楚可读。文字必须来自照片真实可见的地点、动作、天气或色彩；无法确认地点时使用场景主题，不虚构地名和日期。

整体气质温暖、安静、手工、旧物感，具有被保存下来的旅行记忆。

强制避免：纸拼贴、撕纸边、纯毛毡画、簇绒地毯、钩针玩偶、精致刺绣样板、蕾丝纽扣、手账杂物、印刷照片补丁、光滑矢量色块、塑料合成布、儿童手工、下半完全铺满、固定日落配色、作者名、签名、Logo、二维码、水印、乱码。

items.title: 夜晚卧室粉蓝蕾丝吊带自拍女性

prompts.text:
Subject: A fictional adult Japanese female leaning back and raised up on a bed at night, stretching out her arm for a selfie. Place the chest and light blue camisole in the center of the vertical frame and zoom in significantly, with the face moved toward the upper right, letting only the right profile slightly extend outside the frame. Eyes, nose, lips, and the gaze directed here should be clearly preserved, capturing the moment of quietly staring back at a close distance before sleep. Include the arm extending downward from the shoulder on the left, and include the waist area, light-colored shorts, and part of the bent legs at the bottom. The character occupies most of the vertical frame, and the gaze from the face and the central chest form two strong focus points, naturally connected by the lines of the neck and collarbone.

Location, Time, Background: A small bedroom before lights out. Behind the character is summarized with a nearly black-brown headboard and dark walls, with the shadow of a pillow thinly superimposed from the top left to the center depth. A tapestry in raw silk color is placed at the bottom of the screen, and brown-toned bedding with a circular bulge is placed at the bottom right, expressing the soft bed feeling only with subtle wrinkles. The background in the upper left is almost kept as a textureless dark surface, serving as a quiet negative space leading to the character's bright skin. The background is composed of deep dark parts with little information, while the character's skin and blue clothing are separated as bright parts illuminated by close-range light, creating an intimate atmosphere in a private room at night.

Clothing and Accessories: A slightly grayish powder blue camisole with thin straps. The left and right straps are slender, the chest is edged with lace of the same color forming a deep curve, and the main part has fine vertical ribbing and soft seams under the chest. The fabric is naturally tight along the roundness of the chest, and the central lace forms a nearly symmetrical arc. The main part is slightly loose toward the waist, with soft horizontal folds superimposed near the hem. The lower body is paired with ivory to light beige short indoor wear, only slightly revealed at the bottom left and bottom right. Does not emphasize jewelry or indoor items, placing the three major textures of blue fabric, skin, and bedding at the core of the frame.

Pose, Fingers, Contact: The upper body leans against the bed while being slightly raised forward, with the left and right shoulder heights offset. The arm holding the camera extends from the right shoulder toward the lens, with only part of the upper arm and armpit remaining on the right edge, while the forearm and hand extend out of the frame. The other arm extends downward from the left shoulder along the left edge of the frame, sending the part below the elbow to the outside of the lower edge. The left and right shoulders are slightly retracted inward, making the chest face forward to form a natural balance point. Tilt the face toward the right shoulder side, forming a diagonal connection from the neck through the collarbone to the chest. The waist stays oriented toward the front, with one knee bent and legs and thighs overlapping with the bedding at the bottom.

Expression and Gaze: Direct the large, deep brown pupils straight at the lens, with small white reflections placed in the left and right eyes. The upper eyelids have a soft arc, and the lower eyelids are expressed with slightly moist lines, not showing sleepiness but creating a quiet gaze waiting for the other party's response. Eyebrows are relaxed and naturally raised, and the corners of the mouth are superimposed with pink lips slightly parted. Does not intentionally create a big smile, taking the gentleness conveyed at close range and a hint of heart-pounding defenselessness as the core of the expression.

Face and Makeup: Smooth oval face, finely trimmed dark brown eyebrows, large round brown pupils, short brown eyeliner flowing at the outer corners of the eyes, and distinguishable upper eyelashes one by one. The bridge of the nose is slender, the tip of the nose has a small highlight, and a light peach-pink flush is added to the cheekbones and under the eyes. The lips are applied with a thin rose-pink gloss, slightly brighter only in the center. Even at close range, the natural skin texture without completely eliminated pores is preserved, with continuous weak gloss natural makeup applied to the forehead, nose, cheeks, and chin.

Hair: Dark brown long hair loosely tied low at the back of the head, with most of the hair bundles blending into the dark background at the top left. Thin see-through bangs fall irregularly on the forehead, with a few strands extending near the right eyebrow and eye. Fine stray hairs hang down from the temples through the cheeks, in front of the ears, neck, and collarbone, creating a state where the hair tied before sleep has slightly come loose. The roots are darker, with only the fine hair around the face picking up warm light.

Light Source: A small warm light from the front-left, close to a smartphone, is the main light, smoothly illuminating the face, neck, collarbone, chest, and left arm. Wrap weak light to the right side of the face and right shoulder, maintaining readable brightness for the eyes and lips near the right edge. Place soft shadows showing roundness below the neck, in the center of the chest, and inside the straps. Let the background and deep parts of the hair fall into deep darkness, leaving only small reflections on the pupils, tip of the nose, lower lip, and lace edges.

Color, Light and Dark: Composed of the warm beige of the skin, the grayish blue of the camisole, the ivory of the shorts and tapestry, and the dark brown and charcoal of the background. The bright parts of the character are natural warm colors with suppressed red tones, while the blue fabric is juxtaposed as a cool color with reduced saturation. Although the dark parts are close to the depth of black, weakly discernible light and dark levels are preserved at the boundary between the headboard at the top left and the bedding at the bottom. The skin brightness from the face to the chest is the most prominent part.

Materials and Fine Textures: The vertical ribbing of the camisole is thin and continuous from the chest to the hem, the lace depicts small ripples and see-through threads, and the straps outline edge stitching. Subtle tension is applied to the parts of the fabric in contact with the body, forming loose folds from under the chest to the waist. Extremely fine texture and soft halo are added to the skin, collarbone and shoulders are expressed with thin shadows, and the hair preserves glowing stray hairs one by one. Simultaneously shows the moist reflection of the pupils, the gloss of the lower lip, the folds and fuzz of the bedding, and the small grains of low-light shooting, supporting the close-range realism of smartphone photography.

Composition and Camera: A close-up selfie from a high angle looking down in vertical 9:16. Place the visual center of the chest at about 49% of the frame width, the center of the face at about 76% horizontally, and the face height at about 24% from the top edge. The face contour is slightly cut out of the frame on the right side, while preserving both eyes, nose, and mouth; the chest is placed significantly in the center with readable width of the left and right lace and straps. Place the left shoulder and arm on the left vertical line, the neck and collarbone on a descending diagonal line from the top right to the center, and the torso and bent legs as the volume at the bottom. Superimpose shorts and bedding at the very bottom of the screen as a bright base for the close-up upper body. With a smartphone distance like an arm's length and a gentle wide-angle feel, naturally guide the gaze from the dark negative space at the top left to the face at the top right, the central chest, and the lower waist to form the composition.

Image Processing and Finishing: Adjusted to a natural live-action style suitable for nighttime indoor wear, self-care, bedtime beauty, and smartphone communication. Preserves the bold vertical composition with the right edge of the face cut out and the chest centered, with soft skin and locally sharp pupils and lace. Finely brighten the ribbing of the blue fabric from the dark parts, with remaining grain and weak light attenuation in the background. Soften the boundary between the character and the bedding. Rather than strong lighting, emphasize the intimacy like a photo taken on a bed, slightly incomplete framing, and quiet night air as the personality of the completion.

Collapse Avoidance and Prohibitions: Fixed as one and the same adult female, a direct gaze biased toward the top right, a slight cutout of the right face contour, central chest, powder blue lace camisole, dark bedding, and an outstretched selfie arm. Do not add other people, young-looking characters, extra faces/eyes/arms/fingers, smartphones inside the frame, accessories, strong sunlight, text, logos, signatures, watermarks. Do not break the positions of eyes, nose, and mouth, the connection from the neck to the shoulders and armpits, the left and right shapes of the chest, the lace and straps, the joints of arms and legs, avoiding plastic-like beautiful skin, excessive contour emphasis, horizontal flipping, or face center reconstruction.

prompts.text:
被摄体：
夜晚床上身体斜靠着抬起，伸出手臂自拍的虚构成年日本女性一人。将胸口和淡蓝色的吊带背心置于纵向画面中心并大幅放大，脸部向右上方靠拢，仅让右侧轮廓轻微延伸至画面外。双眼、鼻子、嘴唇、以及投向这边的视线要清晰保留，捕捉睡前近距离静静凝视回望的瞬间。左侧纳入从肩部向下延伸的手臂，下部纳入腰部周围、淡色短裤、以及弯曲的双腿一部分。人物占据纵向画面的大部分，脸部的视线与中央的胸口形成两个强烈的注视焦点，其间由脖颈和锁骨的线条自然连接。

场所・时间・背景：
熄灯前的小型卧室。人物背后以接近黑色的棕色床头板和暗色墙壁概括，左侧上方至中央深处薄薄叠加枕头的阴影。画面下方放置生成里色的挂毯，右下方放置圆形隆起的棕色系寝具，仅以细微的褶皱表现柔软的床铺感。左上方的背景几乎保留为无纹理的暗面，作为通向人物明亮肌肤的静谧留白。背景以信息量少的深暗部构成，人物的肌肤和蓝色衣物则作为近距离光线照射的明部分离，营造夜晚私室中的亲密氛围。

服装・小物：
略带灰度的粉蓝色细肩带吊带背心。左右肩带纤细，胸口以同色蕾丝饰边形成较深的曲线，主体部分加入细纵向罗纹和胸下柔和的接缝。布料沿胸部圆润自然绷紧，中央蕾丝形成近乎左右对称的弧形。主体部分向腰部略微松弛，衣摆附近叠加柔软的横向褶皱。下半身搭配象牙白至浅米色的短款室内服，仅在左下和右下稍作显露。不强调珠宝或室内小物，将蓝色布料、肌肤、寝具的三大质感置于画面的核心。

姿势・手指・接触：
上半身斜靠床铺的同时稍向前抬起，左右肩部高度错开。持相机一侧的手臂从右肩伸向镜头，仅在上臂和腋部一部分留在右端，前臂和手则延伸至画面外。另一侧手臂从左肩沿画面左端向下伸展，将肘部以下送至下端外侧。左右肩部微微向内收拢，使胸口朝向前方形成自然的平衡点。将脸部向右肩侧倾斜，由脖颈经锁骨至胸口形成斜向连接。腰部保持偏向前方，一侧膝盖弯曲的双腿和大腿与下部的寝具重叠。

表情・视线：
将大而深棕色的瞳孔直直对准镜头，在左右眼中置入细小的白色反光。上眼睑呈柔和的弧形，下眼睑以微微湿润的线条表现，不显困倦，而是营造等待对方回应的静谧视线。眉毛放松自然上扬，嘴角以粉色嘴唇微微张开状叠加。不刻意营造大笑容，以近距离传达的温和与一丝令人心跳的无防备感作为表情的核心。

脸部・妆容：
光滑的卵形脸庞，修整细致的深棕色眉毛，圆大而棕色的瞳孔，眼尾短促流淌的棕色眼线，一根根可辨的上睫毛。鼻梁纤细，鼻尖带小亮点，在颧骨和眼下加入淡桃粉色的血色。嘴唇涂抹玫瑰粉色的薄薄光泽，仅中央稍亮。即使近距离，也保留未完全消除毛孔的自然肌理，在额头、鼻子、脸颊、下巴施以连续的弱光泽自然妆容。

头发：
浓棕色的长发在后脑部低位松散扎起，大部分发束融入左上方的暗色背景。薄薄的透视刘海不规则垂落额头，几缕延伸至右侧眉毛和眼睛附近。从太阳穴经脸颊、耳前、脖颈、锁骨垂下细碎的后发，营造睡前扎起的头发稍稍散开的状态。发根处偏暗，仅脸周细发拾取暖色光线。

光源：
以接近智能手机的正面偏左小暖色光为主光，从近距离平滑照射脸部、脖颈、锁骨、胸口、左臂。将弱光回绕至脸部右侧和右肩，保持右端偏靠的双眼和嘴唇的可读亮度。在脖颈下方、胸部中央、肩带内侧置入显示圆润的柔和阴影。将背景和头发深处落入深暗，仅在瞳孔、鼻尖、下唇、蕾丝边缘残留细小反光。

颜色・明暗：
以肌肤的温暖米色、吊带背心的灰蓝、短裤和挂毯的象牙白、背景的焦茶与炭灰构成。人物的明部为抑制红调的自然暖色，蓝色布料则为降低饱和度的冷色并置。暗部虽接近黑色深度，却在左上方床头板与下部寝具的边界处保留微弱可辨的明暗层次。将从脸部至胸口的肌肤亮度作为最突出的部分。

材质・细微质感：
吊带背心的纵向罗纹从胸部至衣摆细长连续，蕾丝描绘小波纹与透视纱线，肩带勾勒边缘缝线。布料接触身体的部分施以细微张力，从胸下至腰部形成松弛褶皱。肌肤加入极细的纹理与柔和光晕，锁骨和肩部以薄阴影表现，头发保留一根根发光的碎发。同时展现瞳孔的湿润反光、下唇的光泽、寝具的褶皱与起毛、低照度拍摄的细小颗粒，支持智能手机拍摄的近距离真实感。

构图・相机：
纵向9:16从高位俯视的近距离自拍。将胸部视觉中心置于画面宽度的约49%，脸部中心置于横向约76%，脸部高度从上端起约24%。脸部轮廓在右侧轻微切出画面外，同时保留双眼、鼻子、嘴巴，胸口以左右蕾丝和肩带的可读宽度大幅置于中央。将左肩和手臂置于左端纵线，脖颈和锁骨置于从右上方至中央的下行斜线，躯干和弯曲双腿置于下部的体积感。画面最下方叠加短裤和寝具，作为上半身近距离的明亮基底。以手臂长度般的智能手机距离和温和广角感，从左上方的暗色留白自然引导视线流向右上方的脸部、中央胸口、下部腰部，形成构图。

图像处理・完成：
调整为适用于夜晚室内服、自理护理、睡前美容、智能手机沟通的自然实拍风格。保留脸部右端切出与胸部中心的大胆纵构图，肌肤柔和，瞳孔和蕾丝局部锐利。从暗部细致提亮蓝色布料的罗纹，背景残留颗粒与微弱光衰减。将人物与寝具的边界柔化。比起强烈布光，强调床上拍摄的一张照片般的亲近感、略带不完整的取景、静谧夜气作为完成的个性。

崩溃回避・禁止：
固定为同一成年女性一人、右上方偏靠的直接视线、右侧脸部轮廓的轻微切出、中央胸口、粉蓝蕾丝吊带背心、暗色床铺、伸展的自拍手臂。不添加他人、显幼人物、多余的脸・眼・臂・手指、画面内的智能手机、配饰、强烈日光、文字、标志、签名、水印。不崩坏眼睛与鼻口位置、从脖颈至肩部和腋下的连接、胸部的左右形状、蕾丝与肩带、手臂与腿部的关节，避免塑料般的美肌、过度轮廓强调、左右翻转、脸部中心重构。

prompts.text:
Use the provided reference image as the strict identity reference. Create a single 12-image collage featuring the exact same girl in every image. Her facial identity must remain perfectly consistent across all 12 variations. Do not create a different person or reinterpret her appearance.

Arrange the result as a clean 4×3 professional studio portrait collage, with one hairstyle per panel. Keep the same framing, camera angle, pose, expression, clothing, makeup, accessories, background, and lighting in every panel. The only difference between the 12 images should be the hairstyle.

Hairstyle variations

1. High ponytail — Sleek high ponytail with a smooth crown and long flowing length.

2. French bob — Jaw-length bob with a soft blunt micro-fringe across the forehead.

3. Long straight middle-part hair — Very long, sleek, pin-straight brown hair falling well below the shoulders, parted in the middle.

4. Shaggy wolf cut — Medium-length heavy layers, choppy fringe, textured volume, and a slightly wild finish.

5. Elegant updo — Polished high chignon with soft face-framing tendrils.

6. Short curly crop — Short, voluminous natural curls with tapered sides and a textured top.

7. Side-swept Hollywood waves — Long glamorous hair with a deep side part and sculpted vintage waves cascading over one shoulder.

8. Sleek low bun — Smooth center-parted hair gathered into a clean, polished low bun at the nape.

9. Long layered waves — Long brown hair with soft cascading layers and natural, loose waves.

10. Shoulder-length blunt cut — Straight, sleek shoulder-length hair with clean blunt ends and a middle part.

11. Curtain bangs — Long natural brown hair with soft curtain bangs framing the face and subtle movement through the lengths.

12. Textured pixie cut — Short modern pixie with textured volume on top, softly tapered sides, and a natural finish.

Identity and consistency rules

Hair color: Keep exactly the same natural brown hair color as the reference image.

Only change: hair length, hair shape, hair texture, and hair styling.

Never change: facial structure, face, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, age, makeup, clothing, accessories, pose, expression, or overall identity.

The girl must look unmistakably like the same person in all 12 panels. Maintain identical facial proportions and recognizable features throughout the entire collage.

Photography and rendering

Professional studio portrait photography, Canon EOS R5, 85mm f/1.4 lens, soft key light with subtle fill, sharp focus on the face, natural shallow depth of field, realistic skin pores, individual hair strands, realistic hair texture.

Photorealistic, hyperrealistic, extremely high detail, 8K quality, natural skin texture, realistic lighting, no CGI appearance, no plastic skin, no painterly effect.

Create a clean, evenly spaced 4×3 collage, with each hairstyle clearly visible and distinctly different while maintaining perfect character consistency across all 12 images.

Subject:
On a sunny urban terrace, leaning forward from a bench, one fictional adult Japanese woman smiling brightly at the camera. The upper body is a sleeveless knit top close to beige, with a deep V-shaped front slit, fine longitudinal textures, and a long self-fabric ribbon tied at the waist side. The edge of thin black underwear is visible inside the chest, forming a sharp contrast with the white-toned top. The heights of the left and right shoulders are slightly different, and a sense of flow with gradually relaxing power extends from the forward-leaning ribcage to the elbows and wrists. The fingertips gathered between the knees should not be excessively superimposed, each one naturally curved. The weight rests on the seat surface and legs, and even if the sense of closeness is strong, it is established as a natural movement of peeking out for conversation rather than a posture of deliberately puffing out the chest.

Looking directly at the camera with dark brown eyes, the corners of the eyes slightly upturned, forming a friendly gaze. Lips are slightly parted, revealing neat upper teeth, blooming a bright smile, creating a soft roundness on the cheeks. The chin is slightly tucked, and the face is gently tilted, possessing both a cute conversational feel for the person nearby and a confident yet gentle sexy charm. Thin see-through bangs are dispersed on the forehead, fine strands of hair are left in front of the ears and on the sides of the cheeks, and the right hair ends hang down along the chest. The left hair is lightly tucked behind the ear, revealing the earring, and a rounded natural fluffiness and thin light lines are created on the top of the head. The wind is weak, with only a few strands of back hair floating slightly in the sunlight.

Soft shadows are retained under the bench and where clothing overlaps to convey the directionality of the midday light. Taking the strong midday light slightly to the left above the frame as the main light source, clear glows are placed on the top of the hair, forehead, cheeks, shoulders, arms, and the knit top on the chest. The bluish-white light reflected from the glass wall and railing on the right supplements the shadow side of the face and hair, and creates small catchlights in the eyes. Harder tree shadows fall around the plantings and bench, but the facial shadows should not be flattened, but processed smoothly. Gentle light is applied to the bag and skirt, forming a lighting balance that gathers the gaze on the upper body.

Color, Tone:
Centered on cream, pale water blue, peach of the skin, and dark brown of the hair, combined with the blue-green of the background and the blue of the glass. The water blue skirt shows smooth weave patterns and small folds around the waist, the bag is matte synthetic leather with metal fittings, and the wooden bench has a dry wood grain. Hair is not depicted strand by strand, but balances the flow of bundles with fine flyaway hairs, and the skin retains faint textures rising under the sun. 在晴朗的城市露台上，从长椅探出身子，对着镜头明亮微笑的虚构成年日本女性一人。捕捉凉爽的办公区午休时，向亲近的对象靠近一步的瞬间。将头部连接到淡蓝色的裙子和膝盖以上的部分，形成纵向画面，同时将脸庞的可爱与奶油色上衣的胸口作为主角来表现。一边呈现健康且充满清新感的都市人物形象，一边保留近距离特有的微微心跳的亲密感。

地点・时间・背景：
人物的左侧后方，逐步叠加蓝色窗面和金属框架，向右侧深处延伸的平台线条与街路树的绿色，营造出从工作场所通往户外的开阔感。
这是接近盛夏的强烈日照倾泻而下的、带有玻璃扶手的现代建筑街区露台。背后叠加着略带青色的办公楼窗面、纤细的街路树、扶手越过的绿色、木制长椅，以及右侧深处的玻璃墙。白天的蓝天位于画面外，但通过高色温的反射光和短促的阴影，传达出晴朗的氛围。背景的建筑以直线条形式端正地模糊处理，左侧的建筑与植栽营造出纵深感，突出人物的肌肤和柔软衣物的质感。

服装・小物：
腰部右侧的结扣制作得小巧而立体，将丝带的末端沿裙子的纵向延伸。包的短手柄和金屬配件，也以从木质座面分离可见的形式呈现。
上半身是接近米色的无袖针织衫，带有深V字前开衩、细密的纵向纹理，以及在腰侧系住的长共布丝带。胸口的内侧可见黑色细薄内衣的边缘，与白色系上衣形成鲜明对比。下装是高腰的淡水蓝色裙子，从腰部到大腿展现出平滑的布面质感。颈部佩戴一颗小巧的单颗吊坠，耳朵上戴着低调的耳环，右侧下方的长椅上放置着米色的方形手提包。

姿势・手指・接触：
左右肩的高度略有差异，从前倾的胸廓延伸到肘部、手腕，形成一种力量逐渐放松的流动感。汇聚在膝盖间的指尖不宜过度叠加，一根根自然弯曲。
保持浅浅坐在长椅上，将上身向前倾斜，双肩斜向，将脸庞和胸口靠近镜头。双臂自然垂放在身体前方，肘部松弛伸展，将双手并拢置于膝盖之间，从而从肩部到手腕形成一条长曲线。左侧腰部的丝带顺着姿势垂落，右侧手臂后方可见包包。体重倚靠在座面和双腿上，即使接近感强烈，也不会显得刻意挺胸的姿势，而是作为为了交谈而探头窥视的自然动作来确立。

表情・视线：
将深棕色的双眼直视镜头，眼尾微微上扬，形成亲切的视线。嘴唇微微张开，露出整齐的上排牙齿，绽放明亮的笑容，在脸颊上营造出柔和的圆润感。下巴略微收回，脸庞轻轻倾斜，既有对近处对象的可爱交谈感，又兼具自信而温和的性感魅力。不是惊讶或勉强挤出的笑容，而是表达享受午间阳光的放松情感。

脸庞・妆容：
轮廓是光滑的卵形，拥有修剪细致的棕色眉毛、大大的杏仁形眼眸、利落的鼻梁，以及圆润的嘴唇。上眼睑施以细致的棕色眼线和长长的睫毛，脸颊上淡淡的玫瑰粉，嘴唇上施以光泽的珊瑚粉。额头、鼻尖、颧骨处带有直射阳光的细腻高光，下巴下方落有薄薄的自然阴影。肌肤明亮均匀，但保留微细的毛孔和细绒的质感，避免过度瓷器般的肌肤。

头发：
发色在光线下呈现出略带红调的深棕色，直发偏向的半长发，直达胸部上方。将薄薄的透视刘海分散在额头，前耳和脸颊侧留有细束发丝，右侧发梢沿胸口垂落。左侧发丝轻轻搭在耳上，露出耳环，头顶营造出圆润自然的蓬松感和细长的光线条。风势微弱，仅有几缕后发在阳光中微微飘浮。

光源：
头发上端和右肩处置以细白的轮廓光，鼻梁和颧骨处置以小反射光。在长椅下方和衣物重叠处保留柔和的阴影，以传达午间的光向性。
以画面上方略偏左侧的强烈午间光为主光源，在头发的顶部、额头、脸颊、肩部、手臂、胸口的针织衫上置以清晰的辉光。右侧的玻璃墙和扶手反射出的青白色光线补充脸庞的阴影侧和头发，并在眼中制造小小的捕捉光。植栽和长椅周边落有较硬的树影，但脸部阴影不宜压扁，而是平滑处理。包包和裙子上施以较为温和的光线，形成视线汇聚在上半身的照明平衡。

颜色・色调：
以奶油色、淡水蓝色、肌肤的桃色、头发的焦茶色为中心，结合背景的青绿色和玻璃的青色。传达出阳光清爽感的明亮高调倾向，但黑色内衣、眼眸、头发的深部保留足够的深沉感。肌肤的红润控制在自然范围内，确保白色系衣物的编织纹理不至于过曝的色调层次。清新的企业街区色调中，脸颊和嘴唇的暖色作为小小的情感点缀。

材质・细微质感：
吊坠上置以一点金色反射，黑色内衣边缘带有薄布的厚度，包包的角部添加缝合线。背景的玻璃仅保留天空色的淡淡反射。
将针织上衣的细纹、前身部分的接缝、侧腰系住的丝带厚度描绘得可辨识。水蓝色裙子展现平滑的织纹和腰部周围的小褶皱，包包是哑光合成皮革与金具，木制长椅带有干燥的木纹。头发不是一根根描绘，而是兼顾束流的流动与细碎的飞发，肌肤保留阳光下浮起的微弱纹理。玻璃扶手施以低调的反射，植栽带有小叶子的颗粒感，远景建筑赋予重复窗户的节奏感。

构图・镜头：
纵向9:16的近距离生活方式肖像，将实际可见的胸部视觉中心置于画面宽度的约51%，脸庞中心置于横向约72%。头顶距上端约3%，视线距上端约20%，胸口的V字距上端约48%，下端残留向前伸展的手臂和水蓝色裙子。将脸庞偏向右上方，左侧置以模糊的办公楼和绿色，削减右侧不利于胸部中央化的空白空间。镜头从坐姿人物略高的位置靠近，以标准焦段的自然远近感，从脸庞到胸部、手部、包包形成斜向的视线引导。

图像处理・完成：
在采用页面或办公室休闲文章中使用时，调整局部对比度，使笑容和服装配色即使在小尺寸显示中也能优先传达，同时保留肌肤的自然色幅。
完成成适合都市午餐时间、办公室休闲、招聘宣传、夏季时尚、美容文章的高分辨率实拍照片。一边保留明亮阳光的透明感，一边仔细调整脸庞和针织衫的局部对比度，将背景轮廓连接到平滑的虚化。自然强调肌肤的立体感和头发的光泽，将包包或建筑的细节比人物低一档。即使在智能手机屏幕上观看，也能瞬间读懂笑容、视线、胸口服装设计的清爽而优雅的广告品质。

崩坏回避・禁止：
保持这位成年女性单人、前倾的坐姿、奶油色的深V针织衫、黑色内衣的细线、水蓝色裙子、米色包包、晴天的城市露台这一组合。不产生五官中途断裂、轮廓不连续、左右瞳孔不同、牙齿融化、多余的手臂或手指、手腕扭曲等问题。不在画面边缘突兀地缺失胸部轮廓或衣物的V字，不融合丝带与手臂、头发与肩部、包包与长椅。不添加可读文字、品牌标志、水印、其他人物、过度美肌滤镜、仅强调暴露的不自然倾斜。

items.title: 高端LUNAVERA植物奶双版商业海报

prompts.text:
Create a premium dual-panel commercial campaign poster for an original plant-milk brand named "LUNAVERA". Use an ultra-realistic top-down food photography style with a clean, high-end editorial advertising layout. Preserve the exact structural logic: two equal vertical panels placed side by side in one horizontal campaign board, each built on a rustic weathered wood tabletop, each with one large flowing white hand-lettered headline across the upper area, one oversized circular split-food composition in the middle, one short curved supporting line near the lower middle, one identical product carton packshot at the lower-right corner, and one minimal nutritional claim near the bottom. The whole campaign must feel like a Cannes-level FMCG visual system: fresh, versatile, elegant, and instantly memorable.

Style lock:
Premium plant-based food campaign, ultra-real still-life photography, rustic tabletop styling, clean product-first hierarchy, modern organic branding, soft daylight realism, polished supermarket flagship finish.

Core composition:
Use a strict two-panel layout with equal panel width, equal visual weight, equal top margin, equal packshot size, and identical camera angle. The two main bowls or glasses must be exactly matched in diameter, height, crop size, perspective, and visual weight. The campaign should read as one unified system rather than two separate ads.

Port super-symbol logic:
Turn the idea of one identical plant-milk carton paired with two perfectly matched circular food applications into the brand’s unmistakable super-symbol. The same product must clearly bridge both worlds: savory comfort and fresh breakfast energy. The repeated circle shape and repeated carton placement should become the visual identity code of the brand. Even at thumbnail scale, the viewer should immediately recognize the system through one product, two equal circles, two lifestyles.

Orbit motion logic:
Create a strong left-to-right and back-again reading loop across the two panels. The eye should begin at the left upper headline, move into the left circular savory dish, descend through the curved supporting line into the left carton, jump across to the right carton, rise into the right circular breakfast composition, then return upward through the right headline and back across the pair as a complete visual loop. Use the curved rims of the containers, arc-shaped copy, ingredient placement, and matched carton positions to create one elegant campaign-wide orbit.

Left panel:
Create a savory meal application scene. Use one large round bowl composition cropped identically to the right panel. One half should show a creamy golden vegetable curry with visible green beans, tofu cubes, and red chili slices; the other half should show a pale creamy mash or grain puree. The textures must feel warm, smooth, rich, and comforting. Keep the product carton at the lower-right corner, identical in size and angle to the right panel.

Right panel:
Create a breakfast application scene using the same exact container scale and perspective. One half should show a soft pink berry smoothie or yogurt-like blend in a round vessel, while the other half shows a breakfast bowl with granola, sliced peach, blueberries, oats, and seeds. The textures must feel cool, fresh, and naturally wholesome. Place the same product carton again at the lower-right corner with identical size and alignment.

Product design:
Design one original almond-coconut plant milk carton for "LUNAVERA Almond Coconut Blend" with elegant cream, soft green, and coconut-almond illustration details. The carton must feel premium, shelf-ready, realistic, and globally marketable. Both packshots must be perfectly consistent.

Lighting:
Use soft diffused daylight from upper-left with gentle ambient fill. Keep food surfaces bright, clean, and appetizing, with subtle shadow falloff and natural texture detail. Maintain fully consistent lighting logic across both panels so they feel part of one premium campaign system.

Materials and realism:
Render the curry with creamy viscosity, soft oil shimmer, realistic vegetables, tofu porosity, and appetizing sauce depth. Render the mash or grain puree with smooth whipped texture and subtle surface ridges. Render the smoothie with blended foam softness and fruit density. Render the breakfast bowl with crisp oats, juicy fruit texture, seed detail, and natural freshness. Render the cartons with crisp folds, matte-coated paperboard, and clean printed detail. Render the wooden tabletops with realistic grain, scratches, and subtle aging.

Color strategy:
Use a natural plant-based palette: muted driftwood gray, warm cream, almond beige, coconut white, leaf green, berry pink, peach gold, and golden curry yellow. Keep the campaign bright, wholesome, and premium. Let the left panel feel warmer and the right panel feel fresher while preserving overall harmony.

Typography and layout:
Use only original English text. Suggested upper headline direction across both panels:
"One Blend, Every Table"
Use short curved supporting lines such as:
"made for savory comfort"
and
"made for bright mornings"
Use one minimal bottom claim such as:
"30% lighter than dairy milk"
Do not copy any existing brand name, slogan, or wording from any source image.

Quality target:
Hyper-detailed, high-resolution commercial print finish, pristine food realism, accurate equal-container scale, sharp packshot clarity, clean rustic background, strong symbolic readability, no clutter, no muddy colors, no cheap grocery-flyer look.

Negative prompt:
copied branding, copied slogan, mismatched bowl size, mismatched glass size, inconsistent perspective, unequal visual weight, low-detail food texture, blurry carton, cluttered tabletop, muddy wood texture, oversaturated colors, unreadable typography, weak product hierarchy, random props, black blotches, cheap supermarket leaflet aesthetic

prompts.text:
为名为“LUNAVERA”的原生植物奶品牌创建一张高端双版商业活动海报。使用超写实俯拍美食摄影风格，搭配整洁、高端的社论广告布局。保持精确的结构逻辑：在同一个水平活动板上并排放置两个相等的垂直面板，每个面板都建立在质朴的饱经风霜的木制桌面上，每个面板上方都有一行巨大的流动白色手写标题，中间有一个超大的圆形分割食物构图，中下方有一条简短的弧形支撑线条，右下角有一个相同的产品纸盒包装图，底部有一个极简的营养声明。整个活动必须感觉像戛纳级别的快消品视觉系统：新鲜、多变、优雅且过目难忘。

风格锁定：
高端植物基食品活动，超写实静物摄影，质朴桌面造型，整洁的产品优先层级，现代有机品牌推广，柔和的日光写实感，精细的超市旗舰店质感。

核心构图：
使用严格的双面板布局，面板宽度相等，视觉权重相等，顶部间距相等，包装图大小相同，且相机角度一致。两个主要的碗或玻璃杯在直径、高度、裁剪大小、透视和视觉权重上必须完全匹配。该活动应被视为一个统一的系统，而不是两个独立的广告。

端口超级符号逻辑：
将一个相同的植物奶纸盒与两个完美匹配的圆形食物应用相结合的理念转化为品牌独特且不容错过的超级符号。同一产品必须清晰地连接两个世界：咸味的舒适感和清新的早餐活力。重复的圆形形状和重复的纸盒放置应成为品牌的视觉识别代码。即使在缩略图比例下，观看者也应能通过一个产品、两个相等的圆圈、两种生活方式立即识别出该系统。

轨道运动逻辑：
在两个面板之间创建一个强大的从左到右并返回的阅读循环。视线应从左侧上方标题开始，移动到左侧圆形咸味菜肴，通过弧形支撑线下降到左侧纸盒，跳跃到右侧纸盒，上升到右侧圆形早餐构图，然后向上穿过右侧标题并穿过这对组合回到起点，形成一个完整的视觉回路。利用容器的弧形边缘、圆弧状的文案、食材的摆放以及匹配的纸盒位置来创建一个优雅的整个活动范围内的轨道。

左侧面板：
创建一个咸餐应用场景。使用一个与右侧面板裁剪方式完全相同的圆形大碗构图。一半应显示带有可见绿豆、豆腐块和红辣椒片的奶油色金黄蔬菜咖喱；另一半应显示淡奶油色的泥状物或谷物泥。质地必须感觉温暖、光滑、丰富且舒适。将产品纸盒保留在右下角，大小和角度与右侧面板完全一致。

右侧面板：
使用完全相同的容器比例和透视创建一个早餐应用场景。一半应在圆形容器中显示淡粉色的浆果奶昔或类似酸奶的混合物，而另一半则显示装有麦片、桃子切片、蓝莓、燕麦和种子的早餐碗。质地必须感觉凉爽、新鲜且天然健康。再次将相同的产品纸盒放置在右下角，尺寸和对齐方式完全相同。

产品设计：
为“LUNAVERA Almond Coconut Blend”设计一个原创的杏仁椰子植物奶纸盒，带有优雅的奶油色、柔和的绿色和椰子杏仁插画细节。纸盒必须感觉高端、可上架、写实且具有全球市场竞争力。两个包装图必须完全一致。

光照：
使用来自左上方的柔和漫射日光，并带有柔和的环境填充。保持食物表面明亮、整洁且令人垂涎，具有细微的阴影衰减和自然的纹理细节。在两个面板上保持完全一致的光照逻辑，使它们感觉像是一个高端活动系统的一部分。

材质与写实感：
将咖喱渲染出奶油般的粘稠度、柔和的油脂光泽、写实的蔬菜、豆腐的孔隙和诱人的酱汁深度。将泥状物或谷物泥渲染出平滑的打发质感和细微的表面纹理。将奶昔渲染出混合泡沫的柔软感和水果密度。将早餐碗渲染出清脆的燕麦、多汁的水果质感、种子细节和天然新鲜感。将纸盒渲染出清晰的折痕、亚光涂层纸板和整洁的印刷细节。将木制桌面渲染出真实的木纹、划痕和细微的老化感。

色彩策略：
使用自然的植物基色调：柔和的漂流木灰色、暖奶油色、杏仁米色、椰子白、叶绿色、浆果粉、桃金色和金黄色咖喱色。保持整个活动明亮、健康且高端。让左侧面板感觉更温暖，右侧面板感觉更清新，同时保持整体和谐。

排版与布局：
仅使用原创英文文本。建议跨两个面板的上方标题方向为：
“One Blend, Every Table”
使用简短的弧形支撑线，例如：
“made for savory comfort”
和
“made for bright mornings”
使用一条极简的底部声明，例如：
“30% lighter than dairy milk”
不要从任何源图像中复制任何现有的品牌名称、口号或措辞。

质量目标：
超细节、高分辨率商业印刷效果，纯净的美食写实感，准确的等大容器比例，清晰的包装图，整洁的质朴背景，强大的符号可读性，不杂乱，没有浑浊的颜色，没有廉价的超市传单感。

prompts.text: 2x2 gri,d 16:9, do this for 4 famous scientists: L₁  NAME‑AS‑STRUCTURE (master)   the subject's NAME is a constitutive structural element — it becomes the hair /       the box lid / the hat / the body — warped and custom‑drawn to fill that region; legible AND load‑bearing.       ¬L₁ = name as a caption below / name pasted beside a portrait / stock font unshaped. L₂  TRIPLE‑READING FUSION   one mark reads three ways at once: the WORD (name legible) ∧ the PORTRAIT (iconic,       recognizable) ∧ the IDEA (the signature concept). All three cohere in a single figure‑ground system.       ¬L₂ = just a portrait with text / just a word / the idea absent. L₃  NEGATIVE‑SPACE FACE   the face/object is implied by negative space + a few iconic signifiers (glasses, brows,       mustache; box + cat halves); minimal marks, maximal recognition.   ¬L₃ = fully rendered portrait / mark clutter. L₄  SIGNATURE‑IDEA EMBEDDING   the subject's defining idea/equation/paradox is a FUNCTIONAL part of the portrait       (equation in the lenses; superposition in the box), instantly recognizable, ¬decorative.   ¬L₄ = generic symbol. L₅  LOGO GRAMMAR + PALETTE   flat vector, clean edges, high contrast, scalable; palette = black + off‑white/cream       + at most ONE accent used semantically (amber eye = alive); bold lettering shaped to the form (arch/perspective).       ¬L₅ = gradient / texture / photoreal / extra colors / thin illegible type. η   HONEST LOGO   letterforms custom‑warped to the silhouette (the arch of the mane, the perspective of the lid);       the two‑tone split is deliberate meaning (superposition), not decoration. FORBIDDEN = name‑as‑caption · fully‑drawn face · gradient · photoreal · extra colors · generic symbol ·             illegible word · stock‑font paste · mark clutter
