items.title: 悬挂纸卡地形旅行记忆海报

prompts.text:
Please turn each travel photo I upload into an individual high-end design poster, with one photo corresponding to one finished product, and no collaging of multiple photos in the same frame.

The overall layout uses a 3:4 vertical composition. The image consists of a clearly separated photography area and a paper art conversion area, with a straight, clear, and restrained horizontal boundary between the two areas, without blurred blending, tearing, infiltration, or material overlap.

The upper photography area accounts for about 45%—50% of the entire image. Faithfully retain the identity, number, posture, direction, architectural structure, terrain relationship, observation angle, real material, natural light, and original color atmosphere of the subject in the original photo. Only perform slight travel magazine, independent publication, or photography exhibition-level color grading, and add very thin film grain. The upper part must remain a clearly identifiable real photograph and must not be changed into an illustration, and the subject must not be moved, replaced, mirrored, stretched, or redesigned.

The lower part accounts for about 50%—55%, reconstructing the same scene as "SUSPENDED PAPER CARD TERRAIN".

On warm off-white matte paper, suspend a small, open handmade paper card or terrain slice. The paper card occupies about 35%—50% of the lower area, located in the center, lower middle, or slightly offset according to the direction of the subject; about 40%—60% continuous blank paper surface is reserved around it.

Use an extremely thin vertical suspension line, paper pin, or almost invisible suspension point to connect the paper card. The suspension line can only exist in the lower paper art area and must not enter the upper photo.

The paper card is not a flat card printed with scenery. The core subject, roads, tracks, waterfronts, ridges, bridges, or steps in the photo should grow from the card's own slots, folded paper surfaces, and bas-relief layers.

From the original photo, only extract:

- One most recognizable subject or landmark;
- One spatial clue that determines the scene's narrative;
- Two to three layers of necessary terrain;
- A small amount of plant, wave, vehicle, or human fragments as scale prompts.

Actively delete, merge, and shrink complex environments, and do not replicate the entire photo in proportion. Express the structure through two or three layers of thin paper, continuous narrow cuts, shallow indentations, natural paper fibers, slight curls, open paper edges, and restrained short shadows.

The paper art subject must retain the most critical outlines, directions, relative positions, and signature colors from the original photo, so that the viewer can still identify the original location at a glance. Extract 4-7 colors from the photo and soften them, with off-white paper occupying the main area, keeping only one most recognizable accent color.

In the continuous white space outside the paper card, add:

- An accurate title of 1—3 English words;
- A "CARD NO. 01" style number;
- A short observation sentence of 5—10 English words.

The text must be determined word for word in advance. Use shallow debossing, letterpress, narrow serif, or restrained sans-serif fonts, as if crafted on a collection page with the paper card. The main title must be clearly readable at chat preview size; the auxiliary text can be smaller, but cannot be compressed into a blurry gray line.

Overall temperament is light, quiet, poetic, and restrained, like a travel memory collected on paper by a thin line. Poeticism comes from scale, white space, paper, and a soft sense of gravity, rather than fairy tale characters or complex decorations.

Avoid: small round planets, fairy tale asteroids, generic floating islands, complete realistic sandboxes, thick foam boards, plastic toys, smooth 3D, heavy shadows, dense paper-cut plants, busy scrapbook collages, redrawing the entire photo with different materials, proportional conversion of the same composition, missing original photos, photos shrunk into decorative thumbnails, blurry boundaries, suspension lines passing through photos, author names, book titles, quotes, logos, brands, URLs, watermarks, gibberish, and extra text.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，一张照片对应一张成品，不得将多张照片拼贴在同一画面中。

整体采用3:4竖版构图。画面由清楚分离的摄影区域与纸艺转绘区域组成，两个区域之间使用平直、清晰、克制的水平边界，不做模糊渐融、撕裂渗透或材质重叠。

上方摄影区域约占整张画面的45%—50%。忠实保留原始照片中的主体身份、数量、姿态、方向、建筑结构、地形关系、观察角度、真实材质、自然光线与原有色彩氛围。只进行轻微的旅行杂志、独立出版物或摄影展级调色，并加入极薄的胶片颗粒。上方必须仍然是一张清楚可辨的真实照片，不得改成插画，不得移动、替换、镜像、拉伸或重新设计主体。

下方约占50%—55%，将同一场景重新构建为“SUSPENDED PAPER CARD TERRAIN｜悬挂纸卡微缩地形”。

在温暖的米白色哑光纸面上，悬挂一枚小型、开放式的手工纸卡或地形切片。纸卡占下方区域约35%—50%，位于中央、中下部或根据主体方向轻微偏置；四周保留约40%—60%的连续空白纸面。

使用一根极细的垂直悬线、纸钉或几乎不可见的悬挂点连接纸卡。悬线只能存在于下方纸艺区域，不得进入上方照片。

纸卡不是印有风景的平面卡片。照片中的核心主体、道路、轨道、水岸、山脊、桥梁或台阶，应从卡片自身的切槽、折起纸面和浅浮雕层叠中生长出来。

从原照片中只提取：

- 一个最具识别度的主体或地标；
- 一条决定场景叙事的空间线索；
- 两至三层必要地形；
- 少量植物、浪花、车辆或人物碎片作为尺度提示。

将复杂环境主动删除、合并和缩小，不要等比例复制整张照片。通过两三层轻薄纸片、连续窄切口、浅压痕、天然纸纤维、轻微翘角、开放纸边和克制的短投影表现结构。

纸艺主体必须保留原照片中最关键的轮廓、方向、相对位置和标志性色彩，使观者仍能一眼识别原地点。颜色从照片中提取4—7种并进行柔化，米白纸承担主要面积，只保留一处最具辨识度的强调色。

在纸卡之外的连续留白中加入：

- 一个1—3个英文单词的准确标题；
- “CARD NO. 01”式编号；
- 一行5—10个英文单词的简短观察句。

文字必须提前逐字确定。使用浅凹压印、铅字、窄体衬线或克制无衬线字体，像与纸卡一起制作在收藏页上。主标题在聊天预览尺寸下必须清楚可读，辅助文字可以较小，但不能缩成模糊灰线。

整体气质轻盈、安静、诗意、克制，像被细线收藏在纸面上的旅行记忆。诗意来自尺度、留白、纸张和轻柔重力感，而不是童话角色或复杂装饰。

避免：圆形小星球、童话小行星、通用悬浮岛、完整写实沙盘、厚泡沫板、塑料玩具、光滑3D、重阴影、密集纸雕植物、繁忙手账拼贴、整张照片换材质重画、相同取景等比例转绘、原照片缺失、照片缩成装饰性缩略图、模糊分界、悬线穿过照片、作者名字、书名、引用、Logo、品牌、网址、水印、乱码和额外文字。

items.title: 四层进阶叙事高阶设计海报生成指令

prompts.text:
Please turn each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, rather than a multi-photo collage; each photo should be output individually.

The overall layout uses a 3:4 vertical composition. The frame is strictly divided from top to bottom into four equal horizontal zones. Each zone's height must precisely occupy 25% of the overall frame, and the ratio of the four layers must be strictly 1:1:1:1, with no ratio deviation allowed. The zones transition seamlessly with no dividing lines or blank gaps. Here, "no blank gaps" refers only to the seams between layers, which must not have space; the interior of each layer can still maintain negative space, paper surfaces, or solid color backgrounds according to the corresponding style.

All four layers are based solely on the same uploaded photo, presenting the same subject, the same moment, and the same spatial relationship. Strictly maintain the subject's identity, quantity, key structures, proportions, posture, direction of action, line of sight, observation perspective, perspective, occlusion, left-right positioning, front-back relationship, and core narrative consistency. The four layers are not four unrelated new compositions but a continuous stylistic translation of the same image. Since each layer is a very flat banner of approximately 3:1, the subject should be organized horizontally, and an appropriate amount of breathing space should be reserved on the left and right; natural horizontal extension of the background or slight cropping is allowed, but the subject must not be vertically stretched, key parts must not be cropped, character relationships must not be changed, and scenes unrelated to the original image must not be created.

The visual center of gravity, subject proportion, and contour placement of the four layers should be aligned vertically as much as possible, forming a coherent evolution from real photography transitioning gradually to the target style. Each layer must completely fill its own 25% area. Do not add layer numbers, dividing lines, borders, collage seams, watermarks, or logos. Do not generate extra text unless a layer's style description explicitly requires a small amount of editorial text, receipt marks, or handwritten notes; even if text is needed, it must be small in quantity, restrained, not block the subject, and avoid garbled characters as much as possible.

Layer 1 | Original Photography

Directly preserve the real photographic state of the uploaded photo as the visual baseline for the subsequent three layers of stylistic translation. Maintain the original person or subject's identity, quantity, facial features, hairstyle, clothing, structure, proportions, posture, actions, line of sight, interactive relationships, observation perspective, perspective, occlusion, environmental direction, natural light and shadow, and core colors, without performing illustration, materialization, geometrization, or 3D reconstruction.

To adapt to the approximately 3:1 flat banner, only natural extension of the left and right sides of the background consistent with the logic of the original scene is allowed, or slight cropping that does not damage the subject; the proportion of the subject must not be changed, characters or buildings must not be stretched, and heads, hands, feet, key objects, or important narrative relationships must not be cropped. The image should remain natural, realistic, and clear, avoiding excessive skin smoothing, exaggerated color grading, fictional scenery, and decorations unrelated to the original image.

Layer 2 | Humanistic Geometric Abstraction

In this approximately 3:1 flat banner area, translate the real subject from the first layer into a "Humanistic Geometric Abstraction" style. Maintain the same subject identity, quantity, key structure, posture, left-right position, perspective, spatial relationship, and core narrative as the first layer, then fully execute the following visual requirements:

The entire frame uses a clean ivory background, extracting the most recognizable subject, contours, posture, and narrative relationships from the photo, and converting them into a minimalist abstract visual according to the logic of "deconstruction—screening—refining—reconstruction." Focus on retaining the most unique volume proportions, axes, curves, interweaving, stacking, occlusion, negative space, and asymmetric relationships, reorganizing them with a few geometric forms; do not replicate details completely, but the correspondence with the uploaded original must be immediately felt. The composition emphasizes visual center of gravity, scale difference, primary and secondary hierarchy, positive and negative shapes, and the rhythm of white space, avoiding iconization, average arrangement, and fragmented accumulation.

Color schemes are all extracted from the uploaded original photo and simplified into 1 main color, 1 dark structural color, and 1 light/neutral color, with at most a small amount of key emphasis color added. Prioritize retaining the most recognizable and spirited colors from the original photo, establishing layers through area proportions, depth relationships, and local contrast, maintaining a clean, restrained, yet vital appearance, and avoiding overall graying or average use of color.

Text establishes a complete high-end editorial micro-typography system: extract a 2–5 word poetic English main title from the light, shadow, space, action, material, or emotion of the photo, while pairing it with 2–4 sets of extremely small auxiliary text, which can be freely combined from short sentences, state words, location or object information, numbers, chapter marks, serial numbers, scale-style numbers, direction words, material words, archival labels, or miniature explanations; do not use years. The main title is responsible for emotion, and the small text is responsible for order and detail, making the text like editorial notes in art books, architectural journals, or exhibition catalogs rather than ordinary titles.

Text must be composed together with abstract graphics, and can be arranged along geometric axes, edges, contours, or negative space, or arranged vertically, rotated, in columns, with expanded letter-spacing, against edges, at corners, crossing color blocks, embedded between forms, or forming interweaving and alignment with the subject; allow one set of text to be extremely small and another slightly larger, establishing a reading path through font size contrast, letter-spacing, direction, and position. Overall, use a restrained combination of serif fonts and thin editorial fonts, letting abstract forms be responsible for visual memory and text for structure, rhythm, and a sense of high-end quality.

The overall presentation reflects a visual temperament of original imagery × abstract memory × editorial typography, being modern, quiet, restrained, exquisite, artistic, and collectible, avoiding complex collage, cheap decoration, commercial template feel, and meaningless abstraction.

Layer 3 | Integrated Logo Reconstruction

In this approximately 3:1 flat banner area, translate the real subject from the first layer into an "Integrated Logo Reconstruction" style. Maintain the same subject identity, quantity, key structure, posture, left-right position, perspective, spatial relationship, and core narrative as the first layer, then fully execute the following visual requirements:

Extract the most recognizable subject, contours, posture, and narrative relationships from the photo, and reconstruct them into a concise, professional, brand-identifiable custom wordmark/logo graphic. Do not place the subject graphic alone next to the text; instead, cleverly integrate its most key contours, structures, or features into the letters themselves or the overall logo structure, so that graphics and text become a unified, complete, and recognizable visual symbol. Whether the subject is a person, animal, plant, building, object, vehicle, or natural landscape, its most core visual features should be refined and converted into a concise, geometric, and graphic logo language, maintaining a sense of identity recognizable at a glance within minimal information.

Text is refined into a short English main text from the subject's name, theme attributes, location clues, action status, or symbolic meaning of the photo; if the original image itself has a clear proper noun, it can be directly converted into the main logo name; if there is no clear name, refine a highly summarized, easy-to-recognize English word or phrase suitable as a brand wordmark. It can be paired with a very small amount of auxiliary text, such as category, region, state words, or short slogans, but must be highly restrained, serving only as a supplement to the identification hierarchy. Text and graphics need to together constitute the logo, rather than a conventional collage of "icon + title."

The overall style remains minimalist, modern, geometric, striking, elegant, with sufficient white space and balanced composition. The background uses a light solid color or a very light neutral color to maintain cleanliness and simplicity; the logo is presented in black and white or a very small amount of color, which can be a small translation of the one with the most spiritual temperament extracted from the uploaded original photo, but overall, restraint, professionalism, and branding take priority. The logo maintains a comfortable medium visual size in the entire frame, neither too large nor too small, with the completion level of a mature brand identity, cultural visual system, or high-end design studio work.

The overall emphasis is on the integration of graphics and text, subject recognizability, geometric order, exquisite letter-spacing, professional layout, and high-end white space, presenting a visual temperament that combines modern logo design with art posters. Avoid a travel poster feel, simple icons plus text, cartoonization, decorative stacking, e-commerce feel, cheap graphics, and template feel.

Layer 4 | Brand Packaging System Mockup

In this approximately 3:1 flat banner area, translate the real subject from the first layer into a "Brand Packaging System Mockup" style. Maintain the same subject identity, quantity, key structure, posture, left-right position, perspective, spatial relationship, and core narrative as the first layer, then fully execute the following visual requirements:

Extract the most recognizable subject, contours, posture, and narrative relationships from the photo and convert them into a complete brand packaging and material visual system. Do not simply copy the photo, but refine the subject's characteristics into reusable core graphics, illustration symbols, patterns, color blocks, or identification elements, then apply them respectively to packaging carriers of different sizes and purposes, making all materials belong to the same visual family at a glance.

Automatically select the 5–8 most suitable carriers based on the theme of the original image, such as paper bags, packaging boxes, sets, labels, tags, tickets, cards, stickers, sleeves, cup packaging, key pendants, wrapping paper, or other related materials, without forcing the use of fixed categories. Use 1–2 main packages as the visual focus, with the remaining materials forming modular combinations according to size, horizontal/vertical ratios, and function; use a clear grid, edge alignment, scale contrast, spacing rhythm, and large areas of white space to organize the frame, like a professional brand design studio's packaging visual identity proposal board, rather than a product display or messy mockup presentation collage.

The color palette remains soft, transparent, and slightly desaturated high-end color systems, mainly light pinkish-blue, misty blue, sky blue, and airy cool-toned blue, paired with ivory white, cream white, light beige, soft gray-green, and architectural neutrals, using only a small amount of gray-toned rose pink or low-saturation blush pink as visual focal points. Different packaging can change the color area and combination method, but must maintain the same color system to form a rich yet unified sense of series.

Materials emphasize realistic and exquisite paper and packaging processes, showing matte paper, fine-grained paper, thick cardstock, translucent paper, embossing, die-cutting, folding, stickers, partial printing, and slight layering relationships; light is soft and natural, used only to show paper thickness, creases, and material differences, avoiding plastic feel, strong reflections, exaggerated 3D, and cheap product rendering.

Text is also designed as a unified part of the entire packaging system. Refine a short English main title from the original image's subject name, theme, mood, function, or symbolic meaning, and extend it with a very small amount of sub-titles, short sentences, serial numbers, category names, or miniature explanations. Text can change naturally according to different carriers: arranged vertically on tags, extending along packaging edges, surrounding circular labels, crossing box surfaces, hidden between graphics, or becoming part of the packaging seal structure, making fonts, graphics, and materials together form a complete brand language, rather than repeating the same title on every item.

The overall presentation is a high-end brand packaging system / visual identity proposal board: rich but not crowded, lively but orderly, showing both a complete series and the design logic between graphics, text, materials, and different carriers. Whether the original image is a person, animal, plant, building, object, food, vehicle, or natural landscape, a unique packaging language should be established from the original image itself, avoiding fixed product combinations, repetitive templates, e-commerce display feel, and ordinary brand mockup templates.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。

整体采用 3:4竖版构图。画面从上到下严格四等分为四个横向区域，每个区域高度必须精确占整体画面的25%，四层比例严格为1:1:1:1，不允许出现比例偏差。区域之间无缝衔接，无分隔线、无留白间隙。这里的“无留白间隙”仅指层与层的接缝不能出现空隙；每层内部仍可按照对应风格保留负空间、纸面或纯色背景。

四层全部以同一张上传照片为唯一依据，呈现同一主体、同一瞬间和同一空间关系。严格保持主体身份、数量、关键结构、比例、姿态、动作方向、视线、观察视角、透视、遮挡、左右位置、前后关系与核心叙事一致。四层不是四张互不相关的新构图，而是同一画面的连续风格转译。由于每层均为约3:1的极扁横幅，主体应横向组织，并保留适量左右呼吸空间；允许对背景进行自然横向延展或轻微裁切，但不得纵向拉伸主体、裁掉关键部位、改变人物关系，或另造与原图无关的场景。

四层的视觉重心、主体占比和轮廓落点尽量上下对齐，形成从真实摄影逐步过渡到目标风格的连贯演化。每层都必须完整填满自身25%的区域。不要添加层号、分隔线、边框、拼贴缝隙、水印或Logo。除非某层风格说明明确要求少量编辑文字、票据标记或手写注释，否则不要额外生成文字；即使需要文字，也必须少量、克制、不遮挡主体，并尽量避免乱码。

第一层｜原始摄影

直接保留上传照片的真实摄影状态，作为后三层风格转译的视觉基准。保持原始人物或主体的身份、数量、面部特征、发型、服装、结构、比例、姿态、动作、视线、互动关系、观察视角、透视、遮挡、环境方向、自然光影与核心色彩，不进行插画化、材质化、几何化或三维重建。

为了适配约3:1的极扁横幅，只允许对背景左右两侧进行符合原场景逻辑的自然延展，或进行不损伤主体的轻微裁切；不得改变主体比例，不得拉伸人物或建筑，不得裁掉头部、手脚、关键物件或重要叙事关系。画面保持自然、真实、清晰，避免过度磨皮、夸张调色、虚构景物和与原图无关的装饰。

第二层｜人文几何抽象

在本层约3:1的扁横幅区域中，将第一层的真实主体转译为“人文几何抽象”风格。保持与第一层一致的主体身份、数量、关键结构、姿态、左右位置、视角、空间关系与核心叙事，再完整执行以下视觉要求：

整张画面采用干净的象牙色背景，从照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，按照“解构—筛选—提炼—重构”的逻辑转化为极简抽象视觉。重点保留最独特的体量比例、轴线、曲线、穿插、层叠、遮挡、负空间与非对称关系，用少量几何形体重新组织；不完整复刻细节，但必须一眼感受到与上传原图的对应。构图强调视觉重心、尺度差、主次层级、正负形和留白节奏，避免图标化、平均排列和零碎堆积。

配色全部从上传的原图中提取并精简为1个主色、1个深色结构色、1个浅/中性色，最多加入少量关键强调色。优先保留原图中最有辨识度、最有精气神的颜色，通过面积比例、深浅关系和局部对比建立层次，保持干净、克制而有生命力，避免整体灰化与平均用色。

文字建立完整的高级编辑式微排版系统：从照片的光影、空间、动作、材质或情绪中提炼一个2–5词的诗意英文主标题，同时搭配2–4组极小辅助文字，可由短句、状态词、地点或对象信息、编号、章节标记、序列号、尺度式数字、方向词、材质词、档案式标签或微型说明自由组合，不使用年份。主标题负责情绪，小字负责秩序与细节，使文字像艺术书、建筑期刊或展览图录中的编辑注释，而不是普通标题。

文字必须与抽象图形共同构图，可沿几何轴线、边缘、轮廓或负空间排列，也可纵排、旋转、分栏、拉开字距、贴边、压角、跨越色块、嵌入形体之间或与主体形成穿插和对齐；允许一组文字极小、一组稍大，通过字号反差、字距、方向和位置建立阅读路径。整体使用克制的衬线字体与细瘦编辑字体组合，让抽象形体负责视觉记忆，文字负责结构、节奏与高级感。

整体呈现原始影像 × 抽象记忆 × 编辑排版的视觉气质，现代、安静、克制、精致、艺术化且具有收藏感，避免复杂拼贴、廉价装饰、商业模板感和无意义抽象。

第三层｜图形文字一体化 Logo 重构

在本层约3:1的扁横幅区域中，将第一层的真实主体转译为“图形文字一体化 Logo 重构”风格。保持与第一层一致的主体身份、数量、关键结构、姿态、左右位置、视角、空间关系与核心叙事，再完整执行以下视觉要求：

从照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为一个简洁、专业、具有品牌识别性的定制字标 / 标志（Logo） 图形。不要把主体图形单独放在文字旁边，而是将其最关键的轮廓、结构或特征巧妙融入字母本身或整体标志结构中，使图形与文字成为一个统一、完整、可识别的视觉符号。无论主体是人物、动物、植物、建筑、器物、交通工具或自然景观，都应提炼其最核心的视觉特征，并转化为简洁、几何化、图形化的标志语言，在极少信息中保持一眼可辨的身份感。

文字从照片的主体名称、主题属性、地点线索、动作状态或象征意义中提炼为一个简短英文主文本；如原图本身具有明确专名，可直接转化为主标识名称；如没有明确名称，则提炼一个高度概括、易识别、适合作为品牌字标的英文词或短语。可搭配极少量辅助小字，如类别、地区、状态词或简短标语，但必须高度克制，只作为识别层级的补充。文字与图形需共同构成标志，而不是“图标 + 标题”的常规拼贴。

整体风格保持极简、现代、几何、醒目、优雅、留白充足、构图平衡。背景采用浅色纯色或极浅中性色，保持清洁简约；标志以黑白或极少量色彩呈现，颜色可从上传的原图中提取最具精神气质的一种进行少量转译，但整体仍以克制、专业、品牌化为优先。标志在整张画面中保持舒适的中等视觉尺寸，不过大也不过小，具有成熟品牌标识、文化视觉系统或高级设计工作室作品的完成度。

整体强调图形与文字一体化、主体识别度、几何秩序、精致字距、专业布局与高级留白，呈现现代标志设计与艺术海报结合的视觉气质。避免旅游海报感、简单图标加文字、卡通化、装饰堆砌、电商感、廉价图形和模板感。

第四层｜品牌包装系统 Mockup

在本层约3:1的扁横幅区域中，将第一层的真实主体转译为“品牌包装系统 Mockup”风格。保持与第一层一致的主体身份、数量、关键结构、姿态、左右位置、视角、空间关系与核心叙事，再完整执行以下视觉要求：

从照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，将其转化为一套完整的品牌包装与物料视觉系统。不要简单复制照片，而是把主体特征提炼成可重复使用的核心图形、插画符号、纹样、色块或识别元素，再分别应用到不同尺寸和用途的包装载体中，使所有物料一眼属于同一个视觉家族。

根据原图主题自动选择最合适的 5–8 种载体，例如纸袋、包装盒、套盒、标签、吊牌、票券、卡片、贴纸、封套、杯具包装、钥匙挂件、包装纸或其他相关物料，不强行使用固定品类。以 1–2 个主包装作为视觉重心，其余物料按大小、横竖比例和功能形成模块化组合；使用清晰网格、边缘对齐、尺度反差、间距节奏和大面积留白组织画面，像专业品牌设计工作室的包装视觉识别提案板，而不是商品陈列或杂乱样机展示拼贴。

配色保持柔和、通透、略微去饱和的高级色系，以浅粉蓝、雾蓝、天空蓝、空气感冷调蓝为主，搭配象牙白、奶油白、浅米色、柔和灰绿和建筑中性色，仅用少量灰调玫瑰粉或低饱和腮红粉作为视觉跳点。不同包装可以改变颜色面积和组合方式，但必须保持同一套色彩系统，形成丰富而统一的系列感。

材质强调真实而精致的纸张与包装工艺，可表现哑光纸、细纹纸、厚卡、半透明纸、压纹、模切、折叠、贴纸、局部印刷与轻微层叠关系；光线柔和自然，只用于表现纸张厚度、折痕和材质差异，避免塑料感、强反光、夸张三维和廉价商品渲染。

文字也作为整个包装系统的一部分统一设计。从原图的主体名称、主题、情绪、功能或象征意义中提炼一个简短英文主标题，并延展出极少量副标题、短句、编号、品类名称或微型说明。文字可以根据不同载体自然变化：竖排于吊牌、沿包装边缘延伸、环绕圆形标签、跨越盒面、隐藏在图形之间或成为包装封口结构的一部分，使字体、图形和材质共同形成完整品牌语言，而不是每件物料重复贴上同一个标题。

整体呈现为一张高级品牌包装系统 / 视觉识别提案板：丰富但不拥挤，活泼但有秩序，既展示完整系列，也能看到图形、文字、材质与不同载体之间的设计逻辑。无论原图是人物、动物、植物、建筑、器物、食物、交通工具或自然景观，都应从原图本身建立独特的包装语言，避免固定产品组合、重复模板、电商展示感和普通品牌样机展示套版。

items.title: 深蓝牛仔Y2K风格女性室内试衣间时尚抓拍

prompts.text:
Direction: 9:16 vertical smartphone photo. A fictional adult Japanese female in her mid-20s, captured candidly by a friend in an indoor fitting and shooting space. Not a posed photo, but a moment accidentally captured right before she finishes adjusting her deep blue jeans and turns to the next movement. The camera is quite close to the subject, shot slightly upwards at about 5 to 12 degrees from a position slightly lower than the waist. The person occupies about 90% of the frame width; through the smartphone's wide-angle lens, the front waist and torso appear slightly larger than the face. It's not a finished advertisement photo, but a fashion snapshot taken by a friend to be sent directly to SNS.

Mood: Has a cool Y2K denim fashion vibe, but without being a deliberately designed model shoot. The person is unaware of the photographer and doesn't pose, focusing slightly elsewhere while adjusting her clothes. A quiet neutral expression and a sense of the moment just before the next action begins.

Model: A fictional adult Japanese female in her mid-20s. Does not imitate real people or celebrities. Mature, steady face and physique. Has a full bust line equivalent to an I-cup, but without making the body the main focus, achieving a natural balance within the denim fashion and close-up wide-angle perspective.

Face: Slightly elongated oval face, sharp jawline, natural roundness of the cheeks, thin straight nose bridge, slightly full rose-beige lips. Not perfectly symmetrical, with subtle differences in the eyebrows or corners of the mouth. Not smiling, a neutral expression with slightly relaxed corners of the mouth.

Gaze: Does not look directly at the camera. As if momentarily shifting her gaze to a mirror or clothes next to the photographer, the face is only 5 to 15 degrees away from the front, and the gaze naturally flows out of the frame. Not a gaze for being photographed, but a gaze during the next action of adjusting clothes.

Hair: Dark brown long straight hair close to black. Extends below the chest, with a slightly middle-parted seam. One side is lightly tucked behind the ear, the other hangs vertically from the shoulder to the outside of the torso. Not perfectly arranged, with a few small stray hairs at the temples or ends.

Body: Natural skeleton of an adult female. The contrast between the full upper body and the waist is naturally expressed through clothing structure and wide-angle perspective. No excessive hourglass shape or unrealistic thin waist. Shoulders at slightly different heights, waist center of gravity, and arm bending are slightly asymmetrical.

Skin: Bright warm beige skin. Avoids excessive skin smoothing, leaving subtle textures and natural color variations around the cheeks, collarbones, and abdomen. Highlights attach softly under front light, with slight noise characteristic of smartphone photos in dark areas.

Outfit: A Y2K coordination unified in deep indigo denim. The top is a strapless structured denim vest. Features golden-brown contrast stitching and vertical panel lines, short in length to significantly expose the abdomen, but the clothing stably covers the body. Below the vest is a matching wide denim waist component, with a central flap, metal buttons, small rivets, and thin denim cords hanging asymmetrically. The bottom is deep blue low-waist jeans. The waist is low, naturally revealing the area above the hip bones slightly. The front is slightly open as if just about to be buttoned, showing just a tiny bit of the inner light denim side. The sense of exposure is maximized through the cropped top, shoulders, arms, abdomen, and the skin area around the hip bones, while the lower body remains in a natural state of coverage as fashion.

Accessories: 2 to 3 thin silver-tone necklaces layered, with a small pendant. One ear wears a thin hoop earring. Several silver rings of different sizes on fingers, a thin gold-tone bracelet and a light-colored bead bracelet on one wrist. Small point reflections of indoor lighting on the metal.

Scene Objects: On the back left, small studio lights in red, creamy white, and pale cyan-white are arranged horizontally; below them is an abstract pink neon light with unrecognizable text. On the right are a white wall, a vertical panel, and thin metal parts. At the edges, part of a garment rack, folded clothes, and a small bag enter the frame halfway, creating the cluttered feel of an actual fitting space.

Pose: Not a finished pose. Weight shifted to one leg, pelvis shifted laterally by a few centimeters. One hand lightly pinches the waistband of the low-waist jeans, the other hand is reaching towards the opposite waist. Not wide-open hands for display, but the action of 'the moment just before buttoning or adjusting the position.' Shoulders are at slightly different heights, and the torso is not completely front-facing, twisted only a few degrees.

Action Reason: The reason is a moment when the person is looking towards the mirror to adjust the waist of the jeans while checking the outfit with a friend, and the friend holds up a smartphone to take a photo. It is not a moment for the camera, but rather the attention is turning to the next action, so the gaze and hands are not completely still.

Lighting: Soft neutral light from ceiling lights or nearby is in front of the person, naturally illuminating without creating large shadows from the face to the abdomen. RGB lights on the back left bring very weak red and blue tints to the hair or silhouette. The white wall on the right has weak reflected light. Natural indoor mixed lighting, not perfect three-point lighting like an ad shoot. There is some small white clipping on the forehead or part of the shoulder, and slight loss of detail in the dark areas of the deep blue denim.

Effect: Smartphone auto HDR works only weakly. Skin correction is restrained. Only the background lights have small halos. No strong cinematic processing, extreme teal and orange, or excessive film look.

Camera: Smartphone main wide-angle lens, equivalent to 24-26mm. Vertical 9:16. Ultra-close range of about 60-90cm from the subject. Camera height is slightly lower than the waist, 5 to 12 degrees upward. The face is further from the camera than the waist and torso, creating a perspective relationship. The top of the head is close to the upper edge, parts of the elbows are outside the left and right frame, and the bottom is naturally cut off above the thighs. A smartphone-style deep depth of field with focus from face to waist. No heavy background blur. Slight lens distortion, weak peripheral stretching, and weak JPEG compression feel.

Imperfections: The composition is not perfectly level, tilted only 1-2 degrees. One hand's movement has very slight motion blur. Subtle messy hair, natural denim wrinkles, differences between the left and right of the waistband, and shifts in overlapping necklaces are preserved. The background white wall has very thin scratches, the metal panel has weak fingerprint-like reflections, and a sense of life is added around the floor or shelves. Skin is not made porcelain-like, maintaining the subtle texture of a smartphone photo.

Background: The left half is a dark shooting space with black to charcoal gray and RGB lights, and the right half is a bright white wall, forming clear left-right asymmetry. The background is not arranged too neatly, roughly between a photo studio, store backroom, and fitting space. The background also retains a recognizable level of focus.

Atmosphere: Indoors at night or with weak window light. RGB lights are on but it is not a club, rather a simple shooting space for checking clothes. Has a slightly cluttered sense of being on-site and a relaxed feeling of friends taking a few casual shots.

Composition: 9:16. The person is placed near the center but not completely symmetrical. The top of the head takes up a few percent of the top, the face is in the upper quarter, the chest to waist occupies most of the center, and the low-waist jeans and hands take up the bottom third. The person's width is 85-95% of the frame. Preserves the neon light in the left background and the white wall on the right, not letting the subject fill the frame completely. An incomplete crop that cuts off outside the frame while continuing below the waist.

Color Palette: Primarily deep indigo, black, warm light beige, and white, with only small amounts of red, light blue, and pink neon as accents. The jeans are not light blue, but a deep indigo close to navy blue.

Negative: Faces similar to real people or celebrities, images that look underage, excessive body proportions, extreme thin waist, doll-like face, plastic skin, excessive skin correction, finished photographic poses, excessive low angles, close-ups emphasizing a part of the body, too strong background blur, high-end commercial studio style, light blue denim, curly hair, deliberate smiles, looking directly at the camera, text, UI, app icons, logos, existing watermarks.

{  
"direction": "9:16的纵长智能手机照片。20多岁中段的虚构成年日本女性，被朋友在室内的试衣兼拍摄空间里随意抓拍的一瞬间。不是完成姿势的照片，而是把她整理深蓝色牛仔裤、即将转向下一个动作的前一刻偶然捕捉下来。相机距离主体相当近，从腰部稍低的位置以5～12度左右轻微向上拍摄。人物占据画面宽度的约90%，通过手机广角，前方的腰部和躯干比脸部看起来稍大。不是完成后的广告照片，而是直接发到SNS的友人拍摄的时尚快照。",  
"mood": "有Y2K牛仔时尚的酷感，但不做刻意设计的模特拍摄。本人没有意识到拍摄者而摆姿势，在整理衣服的同时注意力稍稍转向其他方向。安静的中性表情，以及即将开始下一个动作的瞬间感。",  
"model": "20多岁中段的虚构成年日本女性。不模仿真实人物或艺人。成年人的沉稳面容和体格。拥有相当于I罩杯的丰满胸围线条，但不把身体作为主角，在牛仔时尚和近距离广角透视中实现自然平衡。",  
"face": "稍纵长的卵型脸，利落的颌线，自然的脸颊圆润，细直的鼻梁，稍丰满的玫瑰米色嘴唇。不完全左右对称，在眉毛或嘴角留下细微的左右差异。不做笑容，嘴角微微放松的中性表情。",

"body": "作为成年女性的自然骨架。丰满上半身与腰部的对比通过衣服结构和广角透视自然表现。不做过度沙漏型或不现实的细腰。左右肩高度、腰部重心、手臂弯曲方式稍作不对称。",  
"skin": "偏亮的温暖米色肌肤。避免过度美肌处理，在脸颊、锁骨周围、腹部留下细微的肌理和自然的色差。正面光下高光柔和附着，暗部有手机照片特有的轻微噪点。",  
"outfit": "以深靛蓝靛牛仔统一的Y2K搭配。上身是无肩带的结构型无肩牛仔背心。加入金棕色对比缝线和纵向拼接线，长度较短以大幅露出腹部，但衣服稳定覆盖身体。背心下方配置同材质的宽牛仔腰部部件，添加中央翻盖、金属纽扣、小型铆钉，以及左右不对称垂落的细牛仔绳。下身是深蓝色的低腰牛仔裤。腰位较低，让髋骨上方自然稍露。前面像刚要扣纽扣般微微敞开，露出内侧浅牛仔面仅一点点。暴露感通过短款、肩部、手臂、腹部、髋骨周围的皮肤面积最大化，下半身保持作为时尚的自然覆盖状态。",  
"accessories": "2～3条细银色系项链叠戴，带一个小吊坠。一耳戴细圈形耳环。手指上戴几个尺寸不同的银戒指，一只手腕戴细金色系手链和浅色珠子手链。金属上加入室内灯光的小点反射。",  
"scene_objects": "左后方横向排列着红色、乳白色、浅青白色的小型工作室灯，下侧有无法辨识文字的抽象粉色霓虹灯光。右侧是白墙、纵长面板、细金属部件。边缘有衣架架的一部分、折叠的衣服、小包等半途进入画角，营造出实际试衣空间的杂乱感。",  
"pose": "不完成姿势。体重偏向一侧腿，骨盆横向偏移几厘米。一手轻轻捏住低腰牛仔裤的腰带，另一手正伸向对侧腰部途中。不是双手大开展示，而是『即将扣纽扣或调整位置的前一刻』的动作。左右肩稍变高度，躯干也不完全正面，仅扭转几度。",  
"action_reason": "和朋友确认服装的过程中，本人看着镜子方向正要调整牛仔裤腰位的那一瞬，朋友举起智能手机拍摄的理由。不是服务镜头的瞬间，而是注意力转向下一个动作，因此视线和手部都没有完全静止。",  
"lighting": "人物正面有天花板灯或附近的柔和中性光，从脸到腹部不产生大阴影，自然照亮。左后方的RGB灯带来极弱的红蓝色偏，进入头发或轮廓。右侧白墙有弱反射光。自然的室内混合光，不做广告拍摄般的完美三点照明。额头或肩部一部分有小白飛び，深蓝牛仔暗部保留轻微的阶调丢失。",  
"effect": "手机自动HDR仅弱效工作。肌肤校正克制。只有背景灯有小晕影。不用强烈的电影化加工、极端的蓝绿＆橙色、过剩的胶片外观。",  
"camera": "智能手机的主广角镜头，相当于24～26mm。纵9:16。主体距离约60～90cm的超近距离。相机高度比腰稍低，5～12度向上。脸部比腰和躯干远离镜头，形成远近关系。头顶紧挨上端，肘部一部分在左右画角外，下端在大腿上方自然截断。从脸到腰几乎对焦的手机式较深景深。不大幅虚化背景。有轻微镜头畸变、微弱周边拉伸、弱JPEG压缩感。",  
"imperfections": "构图不完全水平，仅倾斜1～2度。一手动作有极轻微的运动模糊。头发细微凌乱、牛仔裤自然褶皱、腰带左右差异、项链重叠的偏移保留。背景白墙有极薄擦痕，金属面板有弱指纹状反射，地板或架子周围稍加生活感。不把肌肤做成瓷器状，保持手机拍摄的细微质感。",  
"background": "左半分是黑色～炭灰的暗拍摄空间和RGB光，右半分是明亮的白墙，形成明确的左右不对称。背景不做过于整齐的布置，大致介于拍摄工作室、店铺后院、试衣空间之间。背景也保留可辨识程度的焦点。",  
"atmosphere": "夜晚或窗户光线弱的室内。RGB灯亮着但不是俱乐部，而是确认衣服的简易拍摄空间。有稍显杂乱的现场感和，朋友间随意拍几张的轻松感。",  
"composition": "9:16。人物置于中央附近，但不完全左右对称。头顶占上端几％，脸在上1/4，胸到腰占中央大部分，低腰牛仔裤和双手占下1/3。人物宽度为画面的85～95％。保留左背景的霓虹光和右背景的白墙，不让主体完全填满画面。从腰以下还在延续中途的框架外截断的不完整裁切。",  
"color_palette": "以深靛蓝、黑色、温暖浅米色、白色为主色，仅少量使用红色、浅蓝、粉霓虹作为点缀。牛仔裤不是浅蓝色，而是接近海军蓝的深靛蓝。",  
"negative": "类似真实人物或名人的脸、看起来未成年的形象、过度的身体比例、极端的细腰、人偶般的脸、塑料状肌肤、过剩的美肌校正、完成的写真姿势、过度的低角度、强调身体某部分的特写、太强的背景虚化、高级广告工作室风、浅蓝色牛仔、卷发、刻意的笑容、直视镜头、文字、UI、应用图标、logo、现成水印"  
}

prompts.text: 2:3 vertical aspect ratio, a cinematic fine-art environmental photograph of a young adult Chinese woman transforming the simple chore of washing a pink scooter into a spontaneous moment of happiness, captured with the candid intimacy and visual authenticity of a real live-action film still. She has naturally refined Chinese features, realistic human proportions, authentic skin texture, and long dark hair that moves freely as she dances, with loose strands catching the sunlight. She wears an oversized low-cut tank top with relaxed casual styling, the soft fabric falling naturally around her body with believable folds and subtle dampened areas where splashing water has reached the material, and she is barefoot on wet concrete. She holds a garden hose in one hand, sending a lively arc of clear water across the pink scooter, while simultaneously dancing and playing with a cheerful white Maltipoo circling enthusiastically around her feet. Her body is caught in an expressive mid-dance weight shift, one foot slightly lifted or angled playfully, shoulders relaxed, hair moving with her motion, and her face carries a genuine, unguarded smile rather than a posed expression. The Maltipoo adds a second layer of kinetic energy, its fluffy fur catching tiny droplets as it hops and turns toward her. Frame the scene dynamically from a natural three-quarter viewpoint using a 35mm full-frame cinematic perspective, keeping the woman, dog, and scooter visually connected while allowing the surrounding residential environment to establish context. Wet pavement creates subtle reflections beneath them, while suspended water droplets become bright foreground accents. Warm natural daylight illuminates her face, damp skin, flowing hair, white fur, glossy scooter panels, and scattered droplets with soft believable shadows and gentle atmospheric depth. Preserve realistic fabric behavior, individual strands of hair and fur, natural water physics, imperfect wet surfaces, subtle motion, restrained film grain, and organic cinematic color grading, with moderate depth of field and authentic optical falloff. The overall image should feel joyful, spontaneous, tactile, and alive, like an unexpectedly beautiful frame captured during an ordinary summer afternoon, never like a staged commercial or artificial CGI render.

items.title: 超写实等距缩微城市冬季模型海报

prompts.text:
Ultra-detailed photorealistic isometric miniature scale-model diorama of [CITY], presented as a thin flat square tile resting on a pure off-white seamless studio background. The tile is a clean, precisely cut square slab with straight vertical edges revealing a thin band of dark wood/earth material along the sides — like a professionally built architectural model mounted on a display base. The tile is rotated so it reads as a diamond in perspective, viewed from a high isometric angle of roughly 45–50° looking down, with the front corner of the slab pointing toward the lower part of the frame.

The entire top surface is filled edge to edge with a meticulously accurate miniature recreation of [CITY] in winter: the actual street grid and road layout, real residential blocks with authentic local architecture, historic buildings, recognizable landmarks in their true relative positions and realistic scale, plazas, parks, tree-lined boulevards, rivers or coastline if applicable, bridges, major stadiums or arenas, and surrounding urban details.

Create a beautiful realistic winter transformation while preserving the city's authentic identity. Cover rooftops, sidewalks, parks, trees, bridges, streets, and architectural surfaces with natural layers of fresh white snow. Show subtle snow accumulation on building ledges, rooftops, parked vehicles, street lamps, trees, railings, and road edges. Keep roads partially cleared and visibly usable, with realistic tire tracks and patches of exposed asphalt. Water should remain naturally visible where applicable, with subtle winter reflections or thin ice only where geographically appropriate.

Include dense micro-detail: individual parked cars dusted with snow, moving traffic, buses, tiny pedestrians wearing winter clothing, street lamps, awnings, rooftop HVAC units, construction cranes, parking lots with rows of snow-covered cars, boats in water if applicable, realistic snowbanks, footprints, road markings, crosswalks, traffic signals, benches, signs, and tiny urban objects. Every tree is individually modeled with realistic snow-covered branches.

The city's most recognizable landmarks must remain immediately identifiable and geographically accurate. Do not exaggerate landmark size or alter their architecture. Preserve realistic proportions, street relationships, building density, geography, and urban layout.

Rendering style: hyper-realistic tilt-shift miniature photography look — extremely sharp, high resolution, everything in focus across the whole tile, no blur. Bright, soft, even cool winter daylight studio lighting from above with gentle diffuse shadows, no harsh contrast, no dramatic side lighting. Natural winter color palette with clean white snow, subtle blue-grey atmospheric tones, realistic brick, stone, glass, terracotta, dark asphalt, evergreen trees, and naturally colored buildings. Premium architectural model photography.

Layout: the diorama occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame. The upper third is empty off-white negative space containing minimalist editorial typography, centered and small relative to the frame: a small line of wide-tracked small caps reading "WINTER CITY COLLECTION" at the very top, then directly below the city name "[CITY]" in a bold condensed sans-serif display font in dark charcoal grey, large but restrained and not full-bleed, followed by a small wide-tracked small caps subtitle reading "[COUNTRY / REGION]". Generous white space between the typography block and the top edge of the diorama.

Minimalist editorial winter travel poster aesthetic, premium print quality, sophisticated architectural visualization, photorealistic miniature craftsmanship, clean composition, accurate geography, 4:5 vertical aspect ratio.

整个顶部表面从边缘到边缘都填满了对 [CITY] 冬季景观的细致、准确的缩微再现：真实的街道网格和道路布局、具有真实当地建筑风格的实际住宅街区、处于真实相对位置和现实比例的历史建筑、知名地标、广场、公园、林荫大道、河流或海岸线（如果适用）、桥梁、大型体育场或竞技场以及周围的城市细节。

在保留城市真实身份的同时，创造出美丽的写实冬季转变。用自然层层叠叠的新鲜白雪覆盖屋顶、人行道、公园、树木、桥梁、街道和建筑表面。在建筑边缘、屋顶、停放的车辆、路灯、树木、栏杆和路边展示微妙的积雪。保持道路部分清理且明显可用，带有写实的轮胎痕迹和暴露出的沥青块。水域应在适用的地方保持自然可见，仅在地理位置合适的地方带有微妙的冬季倒影或薄冰。

包含密集的微观细节：落满积雪的单辆停放汽车、行驶的交通流、公共汽车、穿着冬装的微小行人、路灯、遮阳篷、屋顶暖通空调机组、施工起重机、停放着成排被雪覆盖的汽车的停车场、水中的船只（如果适用）、写实的雪堆、脚印、路标、人行横道、交通信号灯、长椅、标志和微小的城市物品。每一棵树都是单独建模的，带有写实的落雪树枝。

该城市最知名的地标必须保持立即可辨且地理位置准确。不要夸大地标尺寸或改变其建筑风格。保留现实的比例、街道关系、建筑密度、地理环境和城市布局。

渲染风格：超写实移轴缩微摄影外观——极其锐利、高分辨率，整个瓷砖的所有部分都在焦内，无模糊。来自上方的明亮、柔和、均匀的冷色冬季日光影棚照明，带有柔和的漫反射阴影，无强烈对比，无剧烈的侧面光。自然的冬季色调，带有干净的白雪、微妙的蓝灰色大气色调、写实的砖块、石头、玻璃、赤土陶器、深色沥青、常绿树木和自然色彩的建筑。高级建筑模型摄影。

布局：立体模型占据画面下方的三分之二。上方的三分之一是空白的米白色负空间，包含极简主义的编辑排版，相对于画面居中且较小：最顶部是一行字间距较宽的小型大写字母，写着“WINTER CITY COLLECTION”，紧随其下的是用深炭灰色粗体紧凑型无衬线展示字体书写的城市名称“[CITY]”，字体大但有克制，且非满版，随后是一个字间距较宽的小型大写字母副标题，写着“[COUNTRY / REGION]”。排版板块与立体模型顶部边缘之间保留充裕的留白。

极简主义编辑风冬季旅行海报美学，高级印刷质量，精致的建筑可视化，写实缩微工艺，干净的构图，准确的地理位置，4:5 垂直纵横比。

items.title: 日系夏日少女写真长焦胶片摄影

prompts.text:
Please create a character photography work with a strong Japanese summer portrait vibe, the overall style is transparent, bright, quiet, and light, like an old photo taken by chance during a summer trip.

The subject is a young East Asian girl, with natural black or dark brown long hair, delicate features, natural face shape, fair and transparent skin but without excessive skin smoothing, the temperament is clean, soft, and quiet, with a touch of youthfulness and a faint artistic atmosphere. No internet celebrity face, no heavy makeup, no Westernized contours, no exaggerated expressions, no commercial model feel.

Clothing is mainly white or light-colored, simple and natural, with a sense of life. Can wear a white cotton T-shirt, loose white shirt, light-colored dress, cream-white long skirt, denim shorts, light gray or beige loose trousers. Can be paired with a straw hat, thin-strap sandals, minimalist handbag, glass bottle beverage, and other light life-style accessories. The overall outfit should be clean, light, and natural, without complex designs, and without a strong sense of fashion brands.

The scene is set in a real summer environment, with a fresh and slightly nostalgic atmosphere of life. It can be: by the window of a countryside wooden house, by the wooden window of an old house, by a field, open grassland, under a tree, on white steps, by a balcony railing, in a courtyard, by a quiet outdoor building, at the entrance of an old-style house. Elements such as blue sky, white clouds, tree shadows, distant mountains, fields, wooden window frames, railings, stone steps, and old houses can appear in the background. The environment must be real and natural, not a studio feel.

Character movements are natural and relaxed, no deliberate posing. Can be: sitting on a wooden floor looking into the distance, standing quietly holding a wooden window frame, holding a glass bottle beverage, gently turning the face to look into the distance, walking slowly on white steps, leaning against the window with chin in hand, letting the wind blow hair and skirt. The character may not look at the camera, or may look slightly at the camera, but the expression must be restrained, soft, and quiet, like a moment captured by chance.

Photography style is dreamy cinematic portrait photography. Using the visual effect of a 135mm f/1.8 telephoto lens, the character occupies about 60% to 70% of the frame, shallow depth of field, obvious background compression, strong creamy bokeh, background blur is soft and delicate. The composition is natural, not rigidly symmetrical, not fashion-blockbuster posing, must be like authentic candid photography.

Lighting is bright summer natural light, prioritizing transparent sunlight around noon or bright golden sunlight in the evening. Sunlight shines on the character's face, hair, shoulders, and clothes, creating natural highlights and slight shadows. Highlight areas can have slight overexposure, with soft halation and luminous highlight bloom, making white clothes, skin, and sky appear transparent and bright, but the overall is still soft, not harsh.

Color reference Fuji Pro 400H inspired colors, overall low saturation but bright, leaning towards transparent cool tones. Main colors tend towards: creamy white, light sky blue, soft cyan-green, pale grass green, denim blue, natural skin tone. White is clean and transparent, black hair is rich but not dead black, shadows are soft, the overall picture is light, refreshing, and clean, with a bit of faded feel and old film feel.

Picture texture adds subtle atmospheric haze, fine film grain, soft optical softness, slight nostalgic film rendering. Carries a slight 1990s to early 2000s Japanese photography mood, also a bit of Sony Handycam MiniDV aesthetic nostalgic atmosphere, but do not make it look like rough video, maintain portrait-level transparency and beauty.

The overall atmosphere is not an "exquisite posed beauty photo," but "a memory that truly existed in a certain summer." The picture should make people feel: quiet, gentle, light, bright, youthful, nostalgic, like an old travel photo found many years later.

Avoid:
No internet celebrity AI face, no over-sharpening, no plastic skin, no HDR, no strong orange-teal color grading, no commercial advertising feel, no studio lighting, no complex and gorgeous clothing, no too many accessories, no exaggerated poses, no obvious AI-generated traces.

Final effect: Real East Asian girl portrait + white light-colored outfit + summer transparent sunlight + telephoto shallow depth of field + creamy bokeh + Fuji Pro 400H film colors + soft halation + nostalgic travel photo vibe.

prompts.text:
请创作一张具有强烈日系夏日写真气质的人物摄影作品，整体风格清透、明亮、安静、轻盈，像夏天旅行途中偶然拍下的一张旧照片。

主体是一位年轻东亚女生，黑色或深棕色自然长发，五官清秀，脸型自然，皮肤白皙通透但不过度磨皮，气质干净、柔和、安静，带一点青春感和淡淡文艺气息。不要网红脸，不要浓妆，不要欧美化轮廓，不要夸张表情，不要商业模特感。

服装以白色或浅色系为主，简单自然，具有生活感。可穿白色棉质T恤、宽松白衬衫、浅色连衣裙、米白色长裙、牛仔短裤、浅灰或米色宽松长裤。可搭配草帽、细带凉鞋、简约手提包、玻璃瓶饮料等轻生活感配饰。整体穿搭要干净、轻盈、自然，不要复杂设计，不要强烈时尚品牌感。

场景设定在夏日真实环境中，带有清新而略微怀旧的生活气息。可以是：乡间木屋窗边、老房子的木窗旁、田野边、开阔草地、树下、白色台阶上、阳台栏杆旁、庭院里、安静的户外建筑边、老式房屋门口。背景中可以出现蓝天、白云、树影、远山、田野、木窗框、栏杆、石阶、老房子等元素。环境要真实自然，不要摄影棚感。

人物动作自然松弛，不要刻意摆拍。可以是：坐在木地板上望向远方、扶着木窗框安静站立、握着玻璃瓶饮料、轻轻侧脸看远处、在白色台阶上慢慢走动、托腮倚在窗边、让风吹起头发和裙摆。人物可以不看镜头，也可以轻微看向镜头，但神态必须克制、柔和、安静，像被偶然抓拍到的瞬间。

摄影风格为 dreamy cinematic portrait photography。使用 135mm f/1.8 telephoto lens 的视觉效果，人物占画面约 60% 到 70%，浅景深，明显 background compression，strong creamy bokeh，背景虚化柔软细腻。构图自然，不要僵硬对称，不要时尚大片式摆拍，要像 authentic candid photography。

光线为明亮的夏日自然光，优先表现中午前后的清透阳光或傍晚偏亮的金色日光。阳光照在人物脸部、头发、肩膀和衣服上，产生自然的高光和轻微阴影。高光区域可以有 slight overexposure，带有 soft halation 和 luminous highlight bloom，让白衣、皮肤和天空显得通透发亮，但整体仍然柔和，不要刺眼。

色彩参考 Fuji Pro 400H inspired colors，整体低饱和但明亮，偏清透冷感。主色倾向于：奶油白、浅天空蓝、柔和青绿色、淡草绿色、牛仔蓝、自然肤色。白色干净通透，黑发浓郁但不死黑，阴影柔和，画面整体轻盈、清爽、干净，有一点褪色感和旧胶片感。

画面质感加入 subtle atmospheric haze、fine film grain、soft optical softness、slight nostalgic film rendering。带有轻微的 1990s to early 2000s Japanese photography mood，也有一点 Sony Handycam MiniDV aesthetic 的怀旧氛围，但不要做成粗糙录像感，要保持写真级别的清透与美感。

整体氛围不是“精致摆拍美女图”，而是“某个夏天真实存在过的一段记忆”。画面应该让人感觉：安静、温柔、轻盈、明亮、青春、怀旧，像很多年后翻到的一张旧旅行照片。

避免：
不要网红AI脸，不要过度锐化，不要塑料皮肤，不要HDR，不要浓烈橙青调色，不要商业广告感，不要棚拍布光，不要复杂华丽服装，不要太多配饰，不要夸张姿势，不要明显AI生成痕迹。

最终效果：真实东亚少女写真 + 白色浅色系穿搭 + 夏日清透阳光 + 长焦浅景深 + 奶油虚化 + Fuji Pro 400H 胶片色彩 + 柔和光晕 + 怀旧旅行照片气质。

prompts.text:
Transform the subject in the attached photo into a square miniature painting in a palette-knife impasto oil-painting style.

[Style — Emphasize 3D Texture]

Use bold, thick impasto paint applied with a palette knife, raised approximately 3–5 mm from the surface.

Each paint mass should show clear directional knife marks, including visible grooves and ridges.

Assume lighting from the upper left. Add bright highlights to raised paint and distinct shadows to recessed or overlapping areas, creating strong light-and-shadow contrast like a real oil-paint surface.

Add subtle shadows along paint edges so each color mass appears layered and built up at different depths, rather than flat.

Preserve the subject’s silhouette, colors, and composition from the original photo, but avoid realistic rendering. Simplify the form using thick masses of paint.

Keep the texture controlled and not overly detailed. The subject should remain recognizable through a limited number of bold, dimensional palette-knife strokes.

[Background]

Use a fixed warm ivory/cream watercolor-paper background with a subtle, slightly bumpy texture.

Keep the background flat to contrast with the dimensional subject.

[Text]

Add a black handwritten caption in a corner along the bottom or wherever there is the most empty space.

Automatically determine the caption based on the subject:

Food/drink → menu name (e.g., “Pancake,” “Earl Grey Cake”)

Product → product name or category

Person → a short descriptive phrase or name-like text

Animal → animal name or species

Landscape → place name or a short word describing the scene

The handwriting should look naturally imperfect, slightly uneven, and tactile—not like a clean digital font.

Text color must remain black.

[Composition]

Aspect ratio: 1:1

Place the subject in the center with generous negative space.

Show only the main subject, with no additional props or distracting elements.

prompts.text:
Create a premium FMCG ice cream advertising poster for an original frozen dessert brand named "VELORA". Use ultra-realistic commercial product photography fused with clean Japanese-inspired packaging minimalism and high-end Cannes-level retail poster art direction. Preserve the exact dual-panel vertical diptych structure: left panel in vivid strawberry red, right panel in radiant mango gold. Each panel contains one perfectly centered premium milk-fruit ice cream bar as the absolute visual hero, front-facing, vertically aligned, with a precisely defined diagonal division between a creamy milk upper half and a dense fruit lower half. This diagonal split must become the brand's unmistakable super-symbol, sharp, elegant, iconic, and instantly recognizable across both flavors.

Orbit logic: build a strong visual flow in each panel so the background fruit, annotation callouts, curved lower packaging field, and headline placement all direct the eye back toward the centered bar. On the left, densely packed glossy strawberries subtly arc and compress inward toward the strawberry bar; on the right, luminous mango cubes and sliced mango planes subtly curve and funnel toward the mango bar. Every surrounding element should feel magnetized toward the hero product, creating a clean inward circulation without clutter. The bars remain visually still and dominant while the environment creates controlled movement around them.

Port logic: make the diagonal milk-fruit split the core brand symbol. The creamy top layer should feel sculptural, pale, smooth, thick, and premium, wrapping the fruit layer with a crisp oblique edge. The lower fruit section should feel rich, juicy, saturated, and flavor-intense, clearly contrasting with the soft milk layer above. The left bar is strawberry milk with natural berry pulp and delicate seed-flecked pink-red texture; the right bar is mango milk with velvety golden-yellow fruit density and ripe mango body. The centered wooden stick in each bar must be symmetrical, minimal, and elegant.

Background structure: fill the upper section of each panel with hyper-real macro fruit imagery matching the flavor, left side packed with fresh strawberries showing pores, seeds, gloss, and moisture bloom, right side packed with geometric mango cubes and soft mango flesh planes showing juicy fibers and luminous ripeness. The fruit background should feel abundant and immersive, but always subordinate to the centered bar. Across the lower middle, keep a smooth ivory-white curved packaging field sweeping through both panels, acting as a refined stage for typography and reinforcing the premium product architecture. Add a solid color footer at the bottom of each panel, berry red on the left and warm orange-gold on the right, to lock the composition.

Typography and layout: retain the original logic of one tiny minimalist brand mark near the upper-left of each panel, one vertical side headline per flavor, one oversized elegant handwritten-style English master brand name across the lower center, one smaller flavor subtitle beneath it, and a restrained set of tiny circular annotation callouts with hairline leader rules pointing to the creamy milk layer and fruit layer. All wording must be original, in English only, minimal, refined, premium, and highly legible. Typography should support the product, never overpower it.

Lighting: soft frontal studio lighting with gentle top fill, controlled lateral lift, subtle edge separation on the bars, glossy freshness on the fruit background, creamy matte diffusion on the milk layer, and soft contact shadows beneath each bar. Keep the lighting luminous, premium, clean, and appetizing, with no harsh shadow drama.

Materials and realism: the milk layer must look chilled, velvety, dense, and softly matte; the fruit layer must feel juicy, cold, naturally pulpy, and slightly translucent in brighter areas; the fruit background must show realistic botanical texture, moisture, and fresh-cut detail; the packaging field must feel like smooth matte printed paper with luxury-grade finish; all edges crisp and production-ready. No melting collapse, no plastic texture, no artificial CGI feel.

Color strategy: left panel dominated by strawberry scarlet, berry red, blush pink, and cream white; right panel dominated by mango yellow, ripe gold, honey orange, and cream white. Keep both halves harmonized through the shared ivory curve and identical bar geometry, while clearly separating the two flavor identities.

Art direction goals: product-first hierarchy, strong inward orbit flow, iconic diagonal super-symbol branding, sharp symmetry, premium convenience-store sophistication, immediate shelf recognition, clean flavor storytelling, no unnecessary props, no human figures, no copied Japanese text, no copied branding, no imitation of the original title. Make the result feel like a globally award-worthy premium ice cream launch poster.

Suggested original copy style inside the design: master brand "VELORA", left flavor "Silk Strawberry", right flavor "Golden Mango", with minimal micro-callouts highlighting milk richness and fruit intensity.

Negative prompt: copied brand name, copied Japanese text, copied logo, copied title, messy layout, weak orbit flow, weak product hierarchy, melted ice cream, warped stick, distorted bar proportions, unclear diagonal split, muddy fruit background, plastic-looking cream, low-resolution print, unreadable typography, too many labels, flat lighting, harsh shadows, dirty white area, cluttered annotations, random props, extra products, black blotches, noisy texture, AI artifacts, asymmetrical layout, cheap supermarket flyer look.

prompts.text:
为名为“VELORA”的原创冷冻甜点品牌创作一张高端快消品冰淇淋广告海报。使用超写实商业产品摄影，融合简洁的日式包装极简主义和戛纳级别的顶级零售海报艺术指导。保留精确的双面板垂直二联画结构：左侧面板为鲜艳的草莓红，右侧面板为灿烂的芒果金。每个面板包含一支完美居中的高端乳果冰淇淋棒作为绝对视觉核心，正面朝向，垂直排列，在奶油乳制上半部分和浓郁水果下半部分之间有精确定义的对角线划分。这种对角线切分必须成为品牌独特超级符号，在两种口味中都显得锐利、优雅、具有标志性且一眼就能识别。

轨道逻辑：在每个面板中构建强大的视觉流，使背景水果、标注说明、弯曲的下方包装区域和标题位置都将视线引导回居中的冰淇淋棒。在左侧，密集排列的富有光泽的草莓微妙地向草莓棒呈弧形并向内压缩；在右侧，发光的芒果块和切开的芒果平面微妙地弯曲并汇向芒果棒。周围的每个元素都应该感觉到向核心产品磁化，创造出一种干净的向内循环而无杂乱感。冰淇淋棒保持视觉静止和主导地位，而环境在它们周围创造受控的运动。

接口逻辑：将对角线的乳果切分作为核心品牌符号。奶油顶层应具有雕塑感，苍白、光滑、厚实且高端，以利落的斜边包裹水果层。下方的水果部分应显得丰富、多汁、饱和且口味浓郁，与上方的柔软乳层形成鲜明对比。左侧的冰淇淋棒是草莓牛奶，带有天然浆果果肉和精致的带籽粉红色纹理；右侧的冰淇淋棒是芒果牛奶，具有天鹅绒般的金黄色水果密度和成熟的芒果主体。每根冰淇淋棒中居中的木棒必须对称、极简且优雅。

背景结构：在每个面板的上部填充与口味相匹配的超写实宏观水果图像，左侧堆满显示出气孔、种子、光泽和水汽的鲜艳草莓，右侧堆满显示出多汁纤维和发光成熟度的几何芒果块和柔软芒果肉平面。水果背景应给人以丰富和沉浸感，但始终从属于居中的冰淇淋棒。在下方的中部，保持一个光滑的象牙白弧形包装区域横跨两个面板，作为排版的精致舞台，并强化高端产品的架构。在每个面板的最底部添加一个纯色页脚，左侧为浆果红，右侧为暖橙金，以锁定构图。

排版和布局：保留原始逻辑，即每个面板左上方有一个极简的品牌标志，每种口味有一个垂直的侧边标题，下方中央有一个特大的优雅手写风格英文主品牌名，其下方有一个较小的口味副标题，以及一组克制的、带有细引线的微小圆形标注说明，指向奶油乳层和水果层。所有文字必须是原创的，仅限英文，极简、精炼、高端且高度易读。排版应支持产品，绝不喧宾夺主。

光照：柔和的正面影棚光，带有轻微的顶部补光、受控的侧向提亮、冰淇淋棒上的微妙边缘分离、水果背景上的光泽新鲜感、乳层上的奶油哑光扩散，以及每根冰淇淋棒下方的柔和接触阴影。保持光照明亮、高端、干净且诱人，没有生硬的阴影冲突。

材质与写实度：乳层必须看起来是冰凉的、天鹅绒般的、厚实的且柔和哑光；水果层必须感觉多汁、冰冷、天然带肉感，且在明亮区域略微半透明；水果背景必须显示逼真的植物纹理、水分和新鲜切割的细节；包装区域必须感觉像具有奢侈级饰面的光滑哑光印刷纸；所有边缘清晰且符合制作标准。没有融化崩塌，没有塑料质感，没有人造CGI感。

色彩策略：左侧面板以草莓绯红、浆果红、腮红粉和奶油白为主；右侧面板以芒果黄、熟金、蜂蜜橙和奶油白为主。通过共享的象牙色曲线和相同的冰淇淋棒几何形状使两半保持协调，同时清晰地区分两种口味身份。

艺术指导目标：产品优先的层级结构、强大的向内轨道流、标志性的对角线超级符号品牌化、锐利的对称性、高端便利店的精致感、即时的货架识别度、干净的口味叙事、无不必要的道具、无人物、不复制日语文本、不复制品牌、不模仿原始标题。使结果感觉像是一张具备全球获奖水准的高端冰淇淋发布海报。

建议的设计内原始文案风格：主品牌“VELORA”，左侧口味“Silk Strawberry”，右侧口味“Golden Mango”，带有突显乳质浓郁度和水果浓度的极简微标注。

负面提示词：复制的品牌名称、复制的日语文本、复制的标志、复制的标题、杂乱的布局、微弱的轨道流、微弱的产品层级、融化的冰淇淋、扭曲的木棒、扭曲的棒体比例、不清晰的对角线切分、模糊的水果背景、塑料感的奶油、低分辨率打印、难以阅读的排版、过多的标签、平淡的光照、刺眼的阴影、肮脏的白色区域、杂乱的标注、随机道具、额外的产品、黑色斑点、噪点纹理、AI伪影、不对称布局、廉价超市传单感。

items.title: 雨中撑荷叶的日本女性电影感写实摄影

prompts.text:
2:3 vertical aspect ratio, a cinematic fine-art environmental photograph of an adult Japanese woman standing barefoot in the center of a quiet, rain-soaked wetland, sheltered beneath a single enormous lotus leaf that has already been completely plucked from its plant and is being held overhead like a natural umbrella.

She wears an oversized, low-cut tank top in a muted off-white tone that drapes loosely across her shoulders and falls well past her hips. The fabric is heavy with faint moisture from the surrounding rain and hangs with a soft, lived-in weight. Its wide neckline sits naturally around her shoulders, subtly revealing the line of her collarbone and the gentle curve of her shoulders without appearing posed or deliberately arranged. Her dark hair is damp, with a few loose strands clinging naturally along her neck, cheeks, and temples, mirroring the wetness of the environment.

Her expression is unmistakably joyful, her eyes softly narrowed with genuine laughter and her mouth open in a wide, unguarded smile. She tilts her head slightly upward toward the underside of the lotus leaf, as though welcoming the rain and enjoying the absurdity and beauty of the moment. One hand lifts lightly near her shoulder, fingers relaxed and open, feeling the falling rain, while the other hand grips the thick, fibrous stem of the lotus leaf and holds it upright above her head. Her posture is open and carefree, with loose shoulders and a naturally lifted chest, conveying spontaneous delight rather than tension or posing.

The lotus leaf above her is enormous, broad, deep botanical green, and visibly detached from any living lotus plant. It is not rooted in the pond or connected to the wetland vegetation. Its long, thick stem is entirely free from the ground and is being held in her hand like a makeshift umbrella handle. The lower end of the stem has a natural freshly cut, fibrous appearance, clearly indicating that the leaf has already been harvested or plucked. No part of the stem is buried in mud or attached to the water. The huge leaf arches naturally above her head, with its characteristic radial veins clearly visible beneath the canopy.

The lotus leaf has a waxy, rain-resistant surface covered with countless water droplets. Rainwater gathers across its broad curved surface and travels toward the scalloped edges, where droplets collect and fall in delicate continuous streams around her. The leaf slightly bows under the accumulated weight of the rainwater, creating a believable natural umbrella shape. Some rain slips beyond the leaf's edges, forming a shimmering curtain around her.

Around her, rain falls continuously in soft, slanted veils, filling the air with fine mist that softens every distant edge. Her bare feet press directly into the wet, dark earth, surrounded by shallow puddles and scattered fallen lotus petals. Each raindrop creates concentric ripples across the puddles and shallow water around her feet. The ground feels muddy, tactile, and naturally uneven rather than artificially clean.

The setting is an open wetland at the edge of a lotus pond, with low reeds, scattered lily pads, fallen lotus petals, and partially submerged vegetation in the midground. The distant trees and vegetation fade gradually into a pale gray-green atmospheric background through the rain and mist. The environment feels quiet, spacious, humid, and organically connected to the rainy landscape.

The lighting is overcast and highly diffused, cool silvery daylight filtered through thick clouds and rain, producing soft illumination with no harsh shadows. Subtle highlights catch the wet surface of the lotus leaf, individual raindrops, her damp skin, the moisture-darkened fabric, and the constantly rippling puddles. The restrained palette consists of muted botanical greens, soft gray, pale cream, dark wet earth, faded pink lotus petals, and warm natural skin tones.

Photographed with the observational realism of an authentic live-action film still rather than a posed fashion photograph. Natural human anatomy and proportions, realistic Japanese facial features, authentic skin texture, visible subtle pores and tonal variation, believable wet fabric behavior, physically plausible rain, realistic water droplets, natural hair clumping from moisture, tactile organic materials, atmospheric depth, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, cinematic focus falloff, understated fine-art composition.

Full-body vertical framing from the damp earth beneath her bare feet to the broad canopy of the detached lotus leaf above her. The surrounding rain extends beyond the frame in every direction, enhancing the feeling of immersion. The overall mood is poetic, spontaneous, joyful, intimate, and dreamlike while remaining firmly grounded in photorealistic physical detail.

prompts.text:
2:3 纵横比，一张具有电影感的精细艺术环境摄影照片，画面中一位成年日本女性赤脚站在一片安静、被雨水浸透的湿地中央，遮蔽在一片巨大的荷叶下。这片荷叶已经完全从植株上被采摘下来，被她像天然雨伞一样举在头顶。

她穿着一件米白色调的大廓形低领背心，松松地搭在肩上，长度延伸至臀部以下。面料因周围雨水的轻微湿气而显得沉重，带着一种柔软的、穿过的质感垂落。宽大的领口自然地围绕在她的肩膀上，微妙地显露出她的锁骨线条和肩膀的柔和曲线，没有刻意摆拍或安排的痕迹。她的深色头发是湿的，几缕发丝自然地粘在她的脖子、脸颊和太阳穴上，反映了环境的潮湿。

她的表情是显而易见的喜悦，眼睛因真诚的笑声而微微眯起，嘴巴张开，露出灿烂、毫无防备的笑容。她微微抬头看向荷叶的底面，仿佛在迎接雨水，享受这一刻的荒诞与美丽。一只手在肩膀附近轻轻抬起，手指放松且张开，感受着落下的雨水，而另一只手则抓着荷叶粗大、多纤维的茎，将其垂直举在头顶。她的姿态开放且无忧无虑，双肩放松，胸部自然挺起，传达出一种自发的愉悦，而非紧张或摆拍感。

她头顶的荷叶巨大而宽阔，呈现深植物绿色，且明显与任何活的荷花植株分离。它没有扎根在池塘里，也没有与湿地植被连接。其长而粗的茎完全脱离地面，被她握在手中，就像一个临时凑合的伞柄。茎的底端具有天然的、刚切开的多纤维外观，清楚地表明这片叶子已经被收割或采摘。茎的任何部分都没有埋在泥里或附着在水中。巨大的叶片在她的头顶自然地弯曲，遮篷下清晰可见其特有的放射状脉络。

荷叶具有蜡质、防雨的表面，覆盖着无数水珠。雨水聚集在它宽阔的弧形表面，流向呈扇贝状的边缘，水滴在那里汇聚并形成纤细的连续流束从她周围落下。叶片在积聚的雨水重量下微微弯曲，形成了一个可信的天然伞形。一些雨水滑过叶缘，在她周围形成了一道闪烁的帘幕。

在她周围，雨水持续落在柔软、倾斜的薄幕中，空气中弥漫着细雾，使远处的每一个边缘都变得柔和。她的赤脚直接踩在潮湿、黑暗的土地上，周围是浅浅的水坑和散落的荷花瓣。每一滴雨水都在她脚边的水坑和浅水中产生同心圆涟漪。地面感觉泥泞、有质感且自然不平坦，而不是人工清理过的样子。

环境是荷塘边缘的开阔湿地，中景有低矮的芦苇、散落的睡莲叶、掉落的荷花瓣和部分淹没的植被。远处的树木和植被在雨雾中逐渐消退成淡灰绿色的气象背景。环境感觉安静、宽广、潮湿，并与多雨的景观有机地联系在一起。

利用新体操·地板动作的柔韧性，站立平衡姿势。

prompts.text:
Ultra-detailed photorealistic isometric miniature diorama of the world from [ANIME], presented as a premium collectible-scale landscape sculpture floating above a clean warm off-white studio background with a subtle natural shadow underneath.

(For best accuracy, upload a clear reference image of the official map/world layout.)

WORLD SHAPE & GEOGRAPHY

If [ANIME] features a fictional world, continent, island or region, recreate its canonical map silhouette exactly. The entire landmass should appear physically carved from the earth and lifted upward as one continuous miniature terrain slab, with naturally broken rock sides, exposed soil layers, cliffs and geological textures.

If [ANIME] takes place in a real or semi-real location, use the most important canonical city, region or country as the physical base shape, maintaining its recognizable geographic outline.

The outer boundary must feel like an actual piece of land cut directly from the map — never like a flat printed map or floating board.

CANONICAL WORLD RECONSTRUCTION

Rebuild the world of [ANIME] across the entire miniature surface with maximum lore accuracy.

Every major region, settlement, city, landmark, mountain, river, forest, road, battlefield, castle, shrine, futuristic structure or other recognizable location should appear in its correct relative position.

Preserve the distinctive visual language of the anime:

- canonical architecture
- recognizable environments
- authentic terrain
- faction territories
- signature landmarks
- characteristic colors
- world-specific technology or fantasy elements
- environmental atmosphere

Avoid generic Western architecture or realistic substitutions. The result must immediately feel like [ANIME] transformed into a physical miniature world.

Add tiny but readable location markers for important places, designed like elegant museum-style cartographic labels rather than large text.

MICRO-SCALE STORY DETAILS

Fill the landscape with carefully placed miniature storytelling elements: tiny characters wearing recognizable show-accurate outfits, world-specific creatures, vehicles, ships, trains, flags, faction symbols, market areas, farms, bridges, pathways, trees, vegetation and other details that make the world feel alive.

Characters should remain small environmental elements rather than dominating the composition.

Include subtle activity throughout the terrain so the diorama feels like a living snapshot of the anime universe.

MATERIAL & PHOTOGRAPHY

Hyper-realistic premium miniature photography combined with high-end cinematic environment design.

Extremely crisp micro-details, realistic rock formations, miniature vegetation, tiny architectural textures, believable scale relationships and physically accurate materials.

Everything should remain sharply focused with no artificial background blur.

Use soft warm studio illumination from above with gentle contact shadows and subtle ambient occlusion between buildings, terrain and rock layers.

The miniature should have a sophisticated museum-quality collectible appearance while still preserving the anime's original visual identity.

COLOR & ATMOSPHERE

Use the authentic color language of [ANIME] as the primary visual reference.

Translate the anime's signature palette into realistic miniature materials without losing its recognizable mood, atmosphere or world identity.

Rich but controlled colors, cinematic tonal depth, premium print-like contrast and realistic surface textures.

COMPOSITION

Center the complete shaped diorama in the lower two-thirds of the 4:5 vertical frame.

Leave generous clean negative space around the entire landmass.

The diorama must never touch the frame edges.

The upper third remains almost completely empty and off-white, creating a sophisticated editorial poster composition.

At the very top, place small widely tracked uppercase typography showing the world / region name.

Directly underneath, place:

[ANIME]

in a bold condensed sans-serif typeface, medium charcoal grey, large and dominant.

Below it, add a smaller widely tracked uppercase line containing the studio name and year.

Typography should feel like a luxury museum exhibition poster — restrained, elegant and secondary to the miniature world.

FINAL ART DIRECTION

Premium editorial travel-poster aesthetic + cinematic miniature photography + collectible world-building sculpture + museum-quality cartography.

The final image should look as though the entire world of [ANIME] was physically sculpted from the earth and photographed inside a professional studio.

No generic fantasy map, no flat illustration, no random landmarks, no duplicated buildings, no distorted geography, no excessive text, no modern Western substitutions.

4:5 vertical aspect ratio, ultra-high detail, photorealistic materials, cinematic lighting, premium print quality.

prompts.text:
超精细写实等轴测微缩景观，展示来自 [ANIME] 的世界，呈现为漂浮在干净温暖的米白色影棚背景上的高级收藏级比例景观雕塑，下方带有微妙的自然阴影。

（为了获得最佳准确度，请上传官方地图/世界布局的清晰参考图。）

世界形状与地理

如果 [ANIME] 具有虚构的世界、大陆、岛屿或地区，请准确重建其正统地图轮廓。整个陆块应看起来像是从大地中物理雕刻而成，并作为一个连续的微缩地形板向上抬起，具有自然破碎的岩石侧面、暴露的土壤层、悬崖和地质纹理。

如果 [ANIME] 发生在真实或半真实的位置，请使用最重要的正统城市、地区或国家作为物理底座形状，保持其可识别的地理轮廓。

外部边界必须感觉像是直接从地图上切下的实际土地——绝不能像平面的印刷地图或漂浮的木板。

正统世界重建

在整个微缩表面上重建 [ANIME] 的世界，并保持最大的背景设定准确性。

每个主要地区、定居点、城市、地标、山脉、河流、森林、道路、战场、城堡、神社、未来派结构或其他可识别的位置都应出现在其正确的相对位置。

保留动画独特的视觉语言：

- 正统建筑
- 可识别的环境
- 真实的地形
- 势力范围
- 标志性地标
- 特色色彩
- 特定世界的科技或奇幻元素
- 环境氛围

避免通用的西方建筑或写实的替代品。结果必须立即让人感觉到 [ANIME] 转化为一个物理微缩世界。

为重要地点添加微小但可读的位置标记，设计得像优雅的博物馆式地图标签，而不是大字。

微观尺度故事细节

在景观中填充精心放置的微缩叙事元素：穿着可识别的符合原作服装的微小人物、特定世界的生物、车辆、船只、火车、旗帜、势力符号、市场区域、农场、桥梁、小径、树木、植被以及其他让世界感到充满活力的细节。

角色应保持为微小的环境元素，而不是主导构图。

在整个地形中包含微妙的活动，使微缩景观感觉像是动画宇宙的一个活生生的快照。

材料与摄影

超写实的高级微缩摄影结合高端电影感环境设计。

极其清晰的微观细节、写实的岩石形成、微缩植被、微小的建筑纹理、可信的比例关系和物理准确的材料。

一切都应保持焦点清晰，没有人工背景虚化。

使用来自上方柔和温暖的影棚照明，在建筑、地形和岩层之间带有柔和的接触阴影和微妙的环境光遮蔽。

该微缩模型应具有精致的博物馆级收藏品外观，同时仍保留动画的原始视觉特征。

色彩与氛围

使用 [ANIME] 的真实色彩语言作为主要视觉参考。

将动画的标志性色调转化为写实的微缩材料，而不丢失其可识别的情绪、氛围或世界特征。

丰富但受控的色彩、电影级的色调深度、高级印刷般的对比度和真实的表面纹理。

构图

将完整的定型微缩景观置于 4:5 垂直画面的下三分之二中心。

在整个陆块周围留出大量的干净负空间。

微缩景观绝不能接触画面边缘。

上三分之一几乎完全留白且呈米白色，营造出精致的社论海报构图。

在最顶部，放置间距较宽的小号大写字母，显示世界/地区名称。

紧随其下，放置：

[ANIME]

采用粗体紧凑的无衬线字体，中深灰色，巨大且占据主导地位。

在其下方，添加一行间距较宽的小号大写字母，包含工作室名称和年份。

排版应感觉像奢侈品博物馆展览海报——克制、优雅且次于微缩世界。

最终艺术指导

高级社论旅行海报美学 + 电影级微缩摄影 + 收藏级世界观构建雕塑 + 博物馆级地图学。

最终图像看起来应该像是 [ANIME] 的整个世界被从大地中物理雕刻出来，并在专业摄影棚内拍摄。

无通用奇幻地图，无扁平插画，无随机地标，无重复建筑，无扭曲地理，无过多文字，无现代西方替代。

4:5 垂直纵横比，超高细节，写实材料，电影级灯光，高级打印质量。

prompts.text: Create a realistic vertical 9:16 photographed portrait. Subject and action: one adult woman, Standing extremely close over the camera with legs spread and knees unevenly bent. Hair and styling: Render an adult woman's hair as a collarbone-length layered lob with clear cheek and jaw framing, in black with a faint warm undertone, only within jaw-to-collarbone bob, lob, or compact-tie geometry. Composition: Vertical full-body fashion snapshot from ground level; an extreme low-angle, close wide-lens view makes the nearest foot and lower legs dominate the bottom and right side while the torso and inverted head recede toward the upper-left; the nearest sole is partly cropped, the body. Camera: Camera placed almost on the tiled ground beneath and close to the subject, pointed steeply upward with strong wide-angle perspective distortion, deep focus, and the face kept readable at its naturally smaller scale. Pose: Eyes look directly into the lens from the upside-down head position; eyelids relaxed, lips softly closed to slightly parted, expression neutral and unperformed; Standing extremely close over the camera with legs spread and knees unevenly bent. Wardrobe: A sheer orange fishnet long-sleeve cropped top with visible mesh texture and wrinkles at the elbows, layered with a deep plum fuzzy bandeau across the chest; very baggy dark-indigo wide-leg denim jeans with thick white contrast stitching, bold orange-red side racing stripes bordered in white. Setting: Outdoor paved area beside a low brick-and-concrete building, with a blue grid-tiled ledge across the bottom, a thin roofline and sparse tree branches near the low horizon, and a large blank pale overcast sky filling most of the background. Lighting: Bright diffuse daylight from the overcast sky with flat frontal fill, mild uneven exposure, and the pale sky approaching blown white; no studio light. Finish: Late-1990s consumer fashion-editorial color-negative scan: punchy orange, indigo, plum, and pink saturation; slightly warm skin against a cool off-white sky; moderate contrast with mildly crushed denim shadows, soft highlight roll-off shifting into a near-blown sky, visible fine-to-medium film grain across the frame. Skin and material texture: unretouched photographed skin with visible pores, vellus hair, under-eye/lip texture, tonal variation, and faint grain on face, neck, ears, and hands, including flash, monochrome, and low light; global grain or noise alone does not satisfy this constraint. Rendering constraints: keep the exact crop, body-to-camera relationship, hand task, gaze direction, light direction, foreground obstruction, and background placement; preserve believable anatomy and natural hands; avoid beauty-filter skin, studio-clean restaging, generic fashion posing, text, logos, borders, and watermarks.

prompts.text: 创建一张写实的垂直 9:16 摄影人像。主体与动作：一名成年女性，极近距离地站在摄像机上方，双腿分开，膝盖不均匀地弯曲。发型与造型：将成年女性的发型渲染为锁骨长度的分层长波波头（lob），具有明显的脸颊和下颚轮廓修饰，黑色并带有微弱的暖色底色，仅限于下颚至锁骨的波波头、长波波头或紧凑扎发的几何形状。构图：来自地面高度的垂直全身时尚快照；极低角度、近距离宽透镜视角使得最近的脚和下腿占据底部和右侧，而躯干和倒置的头部则向左上方退去；最近的脚掌被部分裁剪，身体。摄像机：摄像机几乎放置在受试者下方的瓷砖地面上并靠近受试者，陡峭地向上指，具有强烈的广角透视畸变、深焦，并且脸部在其自然的较小比例下保持清晰可辨。姿势：眼睛从倒置的头部位置直视镜头；眼睑放松，嘴唇轻轻闭合或微张，表情中性且无表演痕迹；极近距离地站在摄像机上方，双腿分开，膝盖不均匀地弯曲。服装：一件透明的橙色鱼网长袖短款上衣，具有明显的网眼纹理和肘部褶皱，胸前叠穿深梅紫色的毛绒抹胸；非常宽松的深靛蓝色阔腿牛仔裤，带有粗大的白色对比缝线，以及白边勾勒的大胆橙红色侧边赛车条纹。场景：低矮的砖混结构建筑旁的户外铺装区域，底部有一条蓝色网格瓷砖窗台，低地平线附近有细细的屋顶线和稀疏的树枝，大部分背景由大片空白的浅色阴天占据。光照：来自阴天的明亮漫射日光，具有平坦的前向填充光，轻微的不均匀曝光，浅色天空接近过曝的白色；无影棚灯。后期处理：20 世纪 90 年代后期的消费时尚编辑风格彩色负片扫描：强烈的橙色、靛蓝色、梅紫色和粉色饱和度；偏暖的皮肤对比冷调的灰白色天空；中等对比度，带有轻微压缩的牛仔布阴影，柔软的高光衰减过渡到近乎过曝的天空，整个画面可见细微至中等的胶片颗粒。皮肤和材质纹理：未经修饰的摄影皮肤，具有可见的毛孔、汗毛、眼下/嘴唇纹理、色调变化，以及脸部、颈部、耳朵和手上的微弱颗粒感，包括闪光灯、单色和低光效果；仅靠全局颗粒或噪点无法满足此约束。渲染约束：保持准确的裁剪、身体与相机的关系、手的动作、注视方向、光照方向、前景遮挡和背景布置；保留可信的解剖结构和自然的手部；避免美颜滤镜皮肤、影棚级别的洁净重现、通用的时尚摆拍、文字、标志、边框和水印。

prompts.text:
Turning a simple city name into a complete visual identity 
This prompt is built to make every travel poster feel uniquely its own 
Prompt 
Premium sophisticated editorial travel-poster artwork combining Dubai, UAE  and Vancouver, Canada  into one cohesive luxurious travel composition, 3:4 vertical format.
Create an original premium travel-art composition that naturally blends the visual identity of both destinations into one beautifully connected scene, not two separate images and not a split-screen collage. Dubai's luxury waterfront atmosphere should transition naturally into Vancouver's peaceful Pacific waterfront and mountain landscape.
DESTINATION IDENTITY
Dubai, UAE  — Burj Al Arab, turquoise Arabian Gulf, palm trees, elegant waterfront promenade, luxury yachts, traditional boats, outdoor café seating, glowing lanterns, flowering bougainvillea and warm golden sunset.
Vancouver, Canada  — modern Vancouver skyline, Science World geodesic dome, calm harbor, snow-capped coastal mountains, seawall promenade, sailboats, cherry blossoms, colorful spring flowers, elegant street lamps and peaceful outdoor lifestyle.
COMPOSITION
Create one continuous dreamlike waterfront environment where Dubai and Vancouver visually merge together through a sophisticated artistic transition.
Place the Burj Al Arab elegantly toward one side of the composition, surrounded by turquoise Arabian Gulf water, palm trees, warm lanterns and luxurious outdoor seating.
As the scene naturally extends toward the opposite side, transition into Vancouver's modern skyline, Science World dome and majestic snow-capped mountains rising behind the harbor.
Connect both destinations through one continuous waterfront promenade.
Use beautiful layered depth:
Foreground: luxury outdoor café/lounge, marble table, elegant lanterns, flowers, comfortable seating and subtle lifestyle details.
Middle ground: calm reflective water, yachts, traditional boats and sailboats, waterfront promenade, a few people walking and relaxing.
Background: Dubai's Burj Al Arab gradually transitioning into Vancouver's skyline and snow-covered mountains.
Add palm leaves and warm bougainvillea around the Dubai side, gradually transitioning into cherry-blossom branches and colorful spring flowers toward Vancouver.
The transition must look natural, artistic and intentional — one world, two destinations.
PEOPLE & LIFESTYLE
Include only a few small, naturally integrated figures.
Show elegant travel moments such as:
a woman relaxing at the waterfront café
a couple walking along the promenade
a person photographing the scenery
a cyclist near the Vancouver side
a few distant people enjoying the waterfront
People should remain secondary to the architecture, water and landscape.
TYPOGRAPHY
Use elegant editorial typography with generous negative space.
Include both destinations naturally:
Dubai, UAE 
Vancouver, Canada 
Add one sophisticated central tagline:
“Where Luxury Meets Nature.”
Typography should be refined, spacious, premium and magazine-inspired. Text must remain clean, sharp and readable without dominating the artwork.
ART DIRECTION
Japanese stationery-inspired luxury illustration, premium commercial travel artwork, sophisticated editorial branding, elegant postcard aesthetic, clean delicate outlines, refined architectural details, polished illustration, soft geometric forms, subtle atmospheric depth, elegant travel magazine composition, high-end boutique travel campaign, premium lifestyle magazine aesthetic.
Create a sophisticated visual fusion of:
Dubai luxury + Vancouver nature + waterfront elegance + modern international travel.
COLOR SYSTEM
Use a harmonious palette combining:
soft sky blue, mist blue, turquoise water, warm ivory, cream, elegant beige, muted sage green, architectural gray, subtle golden sunset, soft peach, restrained bougainvillea pink and delicate cherry-blossom pink.
Allow Dubai to have warmer golden tones and Vancouver to have cooler blue-green tones, while keeping the entire artwork visually unified.
MOOD
Luxurious, peaceful, romantic, dreamy, elegant, fresh, sophisticated and contemporary.
The final artwork should feel like a premium international travel campaign, presenting Dubai and Vancouver as two extraordinary destinations connected within one beautiful journey.
NEGATIVE PROMPT
No separate images.
No split screen.
No four-panel layout.
No obvious collage.
No hard dividing line between Dubai and Vancouver.
No messy composition.
No random landmark placement.
No duplicated landmarks.

提示词
结合阿联酋迪拜和加拿大温哥华的高级精致编辑风格旅游海报艺术作品，形成一个统一的奢华旅游构图，3:4 纵向格式。
创作一个原创的高级旅游艺术构图，自然地将两个目的地的视觉特征融合为一个美丽的连接场景，而不是两个独立的图像，也不是分屏拼贴。迪拜的奢华滨水氛围应自然过渡到温哥华宁静的太平洋滨水区和山脉景观。
目的地特征
阿联酋迪拜 —— 帆船酒店（Burj Al Arab）、青绿色的阿拉伯湾、棕榈树、优雅的滨水长廊、豪华游艇、传统船只、户外咖啡馆座位、发光的灯笼、盛开的九重葛和温暖的金黄色夕阳。
加拿大温哥华 —— 现代温哥华天际线、Science World 地理穹顶、平静的港口、白雪皑皑的海岸山脉、海堤步道、帆船、樱花、五彩斑斓的春季花卉、优雅的路灯和宁静的户外生活方式。
构图
创建一个连续的梦幻般的滨水环境，让迪拜和温哥华通过精致的艺术过渡在视觉上融合在一起。
将帆船酒店优雅地放置在构图的一侧，周围环绕着青绿色的阿拉伯湾海水、棕榈树、温暖的灯笼和奢华的户外座椅。
随着场景自然延伸到另一侧，过渡到温哥华的现代天际线、Science World 穹顶和港口后方耸立的雄伟雪山。
通过一条连续的滨水步道连接两个目的地。
使用精美的多层深度：
前景：豪华户外咖啡馆/休息室、大理石桌子、优雅的灯笼、花卉、舒适的座椅和微妙的生活细节。
中景：平静的倒影水面、游艇、传统船只和帆船、滨水步道、少数散步和放松的人。
背景：迪拜的帆船酒店逐渐过渡到温哥华的天际线和雪山。
在迪拜一侧添加棕榈叶和温暖的九重葛，逐渐向温哥华方向过渡为樱花树枝和五彩斑斓的春季花卉。
过渡必须看起来自然、具有艺术感且是有意为之 —— 一个世界，两个目的地。
人物与生活方式
仅包含少数小型、自然融入的人物。
展示优雅的旅行瞬间，例如：
在滨水咖啡馆休息的女性
在步道上散步的情侣
正在拍摄风景的人
温哥华一侧附近的骑行者
少数在远处享受滨水区的人
人物应次于建筑、水体和景观。
排版
使用优雅的编辑排版，带有大量的负空间。
自然地包含两个目的地：
阿联酋迪拜
加拿大温哥华
添加一个精致的中央标语：
“当奢华遇见自然。”
排版应精致、宽敞、高级且受杂志启发。文本必须保持干净、锐利且可读，且不主导艺术作品。
艺术指导
受日本文具启发的奢华插图、高级商业旅游艺术品、精致的编辑品牌、优雅的明信片美学、干净细腻的轮廓、精致的建筑细节、磨砂插画、柔和的几何形状、微妙的气氛深度、优雅的旅游杂志构图、高端精品旅游宣传、高级时尚生活杂志美学。
创建一个精致的视觉融合：
迪拜奢华 + 温哥华自然 + 滨水优雅 + 现代国际旅行。
色彩系统
使用和谐的色调，结合：
淡蓝色、雾蓝色、青绿色水域、温暖的象牙白、奶油色、优雅的米色、柔和的鼠尾草绿、建筑灰色、微妙的金黄色落日、柔和的桃色、内敛的九重葛粉和娇嫩的樱花粉。
让迪拜拥有更温暖的金黄色调，温哥华拥有更凉爽的蓝绿色调，同时保持整个艺术作品在视觉上的统一。
氛围
奢华、宁静、浪漫、梦幻、优雅、清新、精致且当代。
最终的艺术作品应该感觉像是一个高级国际旅行宣传，将迪拜和温哥华呈现为一个美丽旅程中连接在一起的两个非凡目的地。
负面提示词
不要独立图像。
不要分屏。
不要四格布局。
不要明显的拼贴。
迪拜和温哥华之间不要有明显的分割线。
不要混乱的构图。
不要随机的地标放置。
不要重复的地标。
不要扭曲的帆船酒店。
不要扭曲的 Science World 穹顶。
不要不真实的群山。
不要错误的阿联酋国旗。
不要错误的加拿大国旗。
不要拥挤的街道。
不要过大的人物。
不要占据主导地位的主角。
不要过多的文字。
不要平庸的旅游海报公式。
不要重复的构图。
不要水彩画。
不要绘画笔触感。
不要沉重的阴影。
不要戏剧性的电影光效。
不要过度的细节。
不要杂乱。
不要刺眼的颜色。
不要扭曲的船只。
不要重复的人物。
不要扭曲的人体结构。
不要不必要的装饰元素。
