items.title: 大胆排版与物理效果互动的商业活动海报

prompts.text:
Create a bold editorial campaign poster where oversized typography reacts to or becomes a physical force inside the composition.

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product / Campaign: [PRODUCT OR CAMPAIGN]
Main Word: [SHORT WORD]
Subject / Product: [PERSON / PRODUCT / BOTH]
Physical Effect: [SOUND WAVE / REFRACTION / FOLD / TENSION / OTHER]
Main Color: [COLOR]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Campaign Details: [SLOGAN / SPECS / DATE]
Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Use realistic commercial photography, oversized typography, bold high-contrast colors, and contemporary editorial design.

Make the main word extremely large, filling roughly 50–75% of the frame. Let it extend beyond the canvas and interact directly with the subject or product.

The typography should clearly express the chosen physical effect. For example, let it expand like sound waves, bend through glass, fold with a surface, stretch under tension, or react to another believable force.

Keep the effect visually clear and physically consistent. Only the affected parts of the typography should distort; preserve enough of the original letterforms to keep the word recognizable.

Integrate the subject or product into the same space using realistic lighting, reflections, shadows, refraction, perspective, or foreground–background layering.

Use one dominant color system with only a few contrasting colors. Add a small amount of meaningful campaign information such as the brand name, product name, slogan, specifications, labels, or callouts.

The final image should feel like a finished commercial campaign key visual — bold, colorful, concept-driven, and visually complete.

Avoid generic “subject + big text” layouts, random distortion, meaningless filler text, excessive UI graphics, heavy 3D typography, decorative sparkles, clutter, and effects that do not match the chosen physical force.

prompts.text:
创建一个大胆的编辑活动海报，其中超大号的排版会对构图内部的物理力量做出反应，或本身成为物理力量。

品牌：[品牌名称]
产品 / 活动：[产品或活动]
主词：[短词]
主体 / 产品：[人物 / 产品 / 两者皆有]
物理效果：[声波 / 折射 / 折叠 / 张力 / 其他]
主色调：[颜色]
强调色：[颜色]
活动细节：[口号 / 规格 / 日期]
长宽比：[9:16]

使用真实的商业摄影、超大号排版、大胆的高对比度色彩和当代的编辑设计。

使主词变得极其巨大，占据画面的大约 50–75%。让它延伸到画布之外，并与主体或产品直接互动。

排版应清楚地表达所选的物理效果。例如，让它像声波一样扩张，通过玻璃弯曲，随着表面折叠，在张力下伸展，或对另一种可信的力量做出反应。

保持效果视觉清晰且物理上一致。只有受影响的排版部分应该变形；保留足够的原始字母形状以保持单词的可识别性。

将主体或产品整合到同一个空间中，使用真实的照明、反射、阴影、折射、透视或前景–背景分层。

使用一套主色调系统，仅辅以少量对比色。添加少量有意义的活动信息，如品牌名称、产品名称、口号、规格、标签或标注。

最终图像应该感觉像是一个完整的商业活动主视觉——大胆、多彩、概念驱动且视觉上完整。

避免通用的“主体 + 大文字”布局、随机变形、毫无意义的填充文本、过多的 UI 图形、厚重的 3D 排版、装饰性闪光、杂乱以及与所选物理力量不匹配的效果。

prompts.text:
Theme:
Closing eyes to bathe in sunlight

Subject:
The person is placed in the center of the frame, occupying a large space. On a white bed, a woman tilts her face up significantly, closing her eyes to welcome the morning light, vertical close-up photography. The frame is filled with the face, neck, shoulders, and white lace chest area.

Person · Expression:
Lifting the chin high and closing the eyes, with glossy lips slightly parted. Rounded oval contour, smooth jawline, long closed eyelashes, soft eyebrow shape, thin straight bridge of the nose and small nose tip, light pink lips with the upper lip slightly thinner than the lower lip. Bright and smooth skin with light peach-colored cheeks. Long brown hair with sparse bangs and fine hair around the face, flowing towards the back of the head.

Clothing · Pose:
Wearing a white camisole nightgown with thin white shoulder straps and delicate lace edges. The upper body leans back, shoulders open, emphasizing the vertical line from the face to the neck. Wearing a thin gold necklace.

Background · Lighting:
Hard direct light is introduced from the window direction in the upper right of the frame. White plush bedding, a round warm-colored table lamp and elegant flowers are placed on a small table in the back left. From the upper right of the frame, hard morning light shines in, casting bright diagonal light on the face and shoulders, leaving heavy shadows on the walls and bedding.

Composition · Lens:
The lens focus is placed on the face, cropped at the edges of the frame from above the chest to the head, naturally blurring the background. Place the face in the center and enlarge it. 3:4 vertical composition, extreme close-up from above the chest to the top of the head. Place the tilted-up face in the center of the upper part, with the neck and chest extending downwards. Close-range slight high-angle shot, background heavily blurred.

Texture · Style:
Photorealistic realistic photography. High-definition capture of skin luster, lace, flower petals, lips, and hair, a warm-toned realistic beauty photo. Retain the strong light and dark contrast of direct light.

Do not open eyes; do not make the upward tilt angle of the face shallow.

items.title: 阁楼窗边披上白衬衫的日本女性全身抓拍

prompts.text: Direction: 3:4 vertical composition full-body SNS snapshot. By the window of an old-style loft studio, a fictional Japanese adult female around 25 years old, in the moment of putting a white loose shirt back over her shoulders, captured casually by a friend from a distance using a smartphone. Not a posed stance, and no stillness for the shoot. The vertical silhouette of the person, the white shirt spreading like wings to the left and right, and the sunset light diagonally crossing the floor are the three cores of the screen design. Mood: Quiet loft before evening. Slightly warm sunset light, a relaxed sense of distance between friends, a natural moment without being strongly conscious of being photographed. Not a finished shot from a fashion shoot, but an atmosphere where a friend took a single photo because the light was beautiful while changing clothes or moving. Model: Japanese female, clearly an adult, about 24 to 28 years old. Slender and elongated physique, delicate shoulders, simple waistline, long legs. Bust volume equivalent to an H-cup, but not treating any part of the body as the protagonist; instead, expressed naturally as part of the full-body silhouette and clothing drape. Does not exaggerate hourglass figure or unrealistic body proportions. Face: Small face, soft oval contour, natural Japanese female face. Does not imitate real-life artists, influencers, or celebrities. Thin base makeup, natural eyebrows, elegant eye makeup, slightly rosy lips. Not a wide smile, but an intermediate expression with the corners of the mouth slightly relaxed in response to a word from a friend. Gaze: Not looking directly at the camera. The line of sight falls slightly to the side of the photographer, or for a moment on a bag or shirt sleeve on the floor. The gaze is not completely fixed, but the consciousness has already turned to the next action. Hair: Black short bob, length near the chin, thin bangs. The ends are not neatly curled and fixed, but after just moving, one side of the hair bundle is slightly scattered outward. A few thin strands of back hair are translucent in the sunset. Not made into an overly neat hairstyle just finished from a hair studio. Body: Shoulder and waist width are relatively simple, a natural adult female physique with long-looking legs. The abdomen has a daily softness and thin shadows, without excessive abdominal muscle expression. The chest, equivalent to an H-cup, accompanies the natural tension and gravity of the clothes, not perfectly symmetrical, showing realistic differences in the way the fabric pulls. Skin: Healthy and naturally glowing skin. A considerable amount of skin is exposed on the arms, shoulders, collarbone, abdomen, waist, etc., due to the outfit composition. However, it remains fully clothed, with the chest and lower body's private parts reliably covered by clothing. Retain pores, subtle color variations, slight color differences at elbows or knees, and shadows under the diagonal evening light, avoiding porcelain-like skin processing. Outfit: White minimalist bra-style crop top. Thin shoulder straps, a deep but daily-wear-appropriate V-neck, soft matte cotton or knit fabric. The chest is fully covered, and the full bust allows the fabric to stretch naturally. A thin white loose shirt is draped over the top, only the sleeves are worn, the front is completely open, wrapping largely to the back. The bottom is faded light-to-mid blue ultra-low-rise skinny jeans. Worn at a position that naturally reveals the hip bone line, a layering style where only a few centimeters of a white plain inner waistband are visible above the top of the jeans' waist. No brand names, text, or logos added. Shirt Behavior: The white shirt is not just a shawl but acts as the second protagonist of the scene. Because of the moment of putting it back over the shoulders, the arms are slightly spread backward from the sides, and the body and sleeves are spread widely to the left and right. A loose arc is drawn from the left hand through the back to the right hand, and the sleeves, body, and hem on the right side of the screen overlap into a huge white wave. The fabric is thin with drooping caused by gravity, falling cuffs, wrinkles, and partial backlight transmission. Accessories: Accessories are minimized. Only small silver earrings. No flashy necklaces, luxury bags, or sunglasses. On the feet are black slender thin-strap high-heeled sandals, thin heels, open toes, no platforms. Scene Objects: An empty large old wooden frame leans casually against the wall in the lower left. Only a small canvas tote bag or a piece of folded thin cloth is placed at the edge of the floor, implying the person is in the middle of doing something. Do not add too many small items. Pose: Standing roughly facing forward, but without a finished pose for shooting. One foot is only half a step forward, the center of gravity is shifted to the opposite leg, and the waist is shifted horizontally by a few centimeters. There is a slight height difference in the shoulders. The arms are in the process of putting the shirt back on, slightly spread backward from the sides with elbows slightly bent. Wrists or fingers do not make performative stretches, only lightly gripping the fabric. The overall body retains subtle asymmetry. Action Reason: The white shirt once taken off by the window is about to be draped back over the shoulders, at the moment of moving positions. The photographer's friend felt 'the light is good' and raised the smartphone without saying a word, so the person's gaze is not aimed at the camera but turned toward the next action. Lighting: Warm direct sunlight from late afternoon enters through a large window on the right side of the screen. The right side of the person is bright, and the left side is in natural indoor shadow. The face is not evenly illuminated, leaving soft shadows on the cheeks or chin. The abdomen and jeans also receive three-dimensional light from a horizontal diagonal direction. The window frame casts long, thin shadows diagonally across the wooden floor from the top right to the bottom left, forming a large bright trapezoid and multiple diagonal lines. Parts of the white shirt are translucent, but retain some highlights that are almost blown out. Effect: The softness of a natural smartphone photo. Highlights are slightly blown out, and there is subtle sensor noise in the dark areas. There is very slight motion blur on the edges of the shirt and hair tips. Do not apply strong HDR, and do not perfectly balance the light-dark difference between the outside and inside of the window. An extremely light JPEG compression feel like a photo saved once from SNS. Camera: 3:4 vertical, natural field of view close to a smartphone standard lens. Perspective equivalent to 35-45mm. Distance from the person is about 3-4m, camera position is at chest to stomach height, almost horizontal. The person's height occupies about 83% of the frame, fully included from head to shoes. Do not use digital portrait mode; background has identifiable medium to deep depth of field. No excessive wide-angle distortion. Imperfections: Composition is tilted only 1-2 degrees, and the person is not perfectly centered but slightly to the right. A few strands of hair are messy, the shirt has natural wrinkles and cuff offsets, and the jeans have small creases around the knees or crotch caused by wearing. The angles of the left and right shoulders, arms, and legs are not perfectly symmetrical. Skin retains subtle texture. Focus is on the person but not as sharp as an advertisement photo. Background: Old loft-style studio. The left side is a plaster wall from off-white to light beige, with uneven paint, small scratches, and a sense of age. About 35-40% of the right side is occupied by a large vertical industrial-style window extending near the floor, with visible thin metal frames and multiple vertical lines. Outside the window, light blue sky, greenery, distant buildings, or power lines are faintly identifiable. The floor is old wooden boards in warm brown with scratches and color variations. Atmosphere: Centered on white, blue, black, brown, and warm yellow-orange, controlling the number of colors. It is not a high-end hotel or an overly tidy shooting studio, but a rental studio with a lived-in feel and slight signs of use. Established as a fashion photo, while being closer to that one photo left in a friend's phone. Composition: Person is slightly right of center. Head is about 12-14% from the top of the frame, waist about 47%, knees about 70%, and soles about 93%. The body itself forms a thin straight line, only the expanded white shirt extends horizontally to about 75% of the frame width. Simultaneously shows different directionalities: vertical lines of the right window, the vertical line of the person, diagonal sunlight on the floor, and the horizontal span of the shirt. Blank space of the plaster wall is reserved from the top left to the center. prompts.text:
Subject:
In an infinity pool at dusk, a fictional adult Japanese woman with her upper body emerging from the water, arms folded on the edge of the pool, staring into the camera. Highlight her wet face and hair, chest, lavender swimsuit, and water droplets on her arms in a large-sized vertical frame. Connect the close-range gaze with the sunset behind her to express the tranquil exhilaration before the end of a vacation day.

Location, Time, Background:
A rooftop or seaside infinity pool just before sunset. On the left are white building walls and potted plants; from the center to the right is the blue pool water surface, mid-level buildings in the distance, and the horizon dyed orange and light purple. Clouds are large and tower vertically, with the sunset rays shooting through the clouds in long, thin lines. Place the horizon and the pool edge at a low position, preserving the colors of the sky behind the figure.

Clothing, Accessories:
A matte lavender bandeau bikini top. Thin shoulder straps extend upward to the neck, with two lines on the side of the chest, triangular cups, and small knots at the center and shoulders. The fabric is a smooth matte material after absorbing water, with the edges showing a deep wet color. Add an extremely thin silver necklace and a small, vertically elongated pendant below the collarbone.

Pose, Fingers, Contact:
Lean the upper body forward from inside the pool, with both forearms folded horizontally on the stone or tile edge to support the body. Shoulders spread left and right, the neck is elongated, and the face is slightly tilted to the left. Elbows and fingertips naturally extend near the bottom edge; the pressure of the wet arms touching the edge and the sense of center of gravity just after rising from the water surface are conveyed.

Expression, Gaze:
Eyes staring directly into the camera, lips slightly parted, retaining the lingering afterglow of breathing. No smile, presented with a calm and intimate gaze, and an expression that feels the tranquility of the evening. Eyebrows naturally raised, eyelid and pupil directions aligned; maintain the delicacy of the eye area without loss, even with a wet face.

Face, Makeup:
A rounded oval face, well-groomed dark brown eyebrows, dark brown pupils with grey tones, fine brown eyeliner, long eyelashes, a clean bridge of the nose, and glossy pink-beige lips. As waterproof light makeup, apply a faint rose color to the cheeks and add moderate shading to the eye area. Leave tiny water droplets and natural reflections on the cheeks, bridge of the nose, lips, and forehead.

Hair:
Near-black dark brown long hair kept wet and hanging down naturally. Bangs are divided into thin strands clinging to the forehead; hair strands on the left and right extend along the cheeks, neck, shoulders, and chest. The hair on the right side incorporates an orange rim light from the sunset, while the left side maintains a rich, wet black. The ends of the hair form a heavy, drooping bundle-like texture, continuing toward the back and the water surface.

Light Source:
The low sunset at the back right of the frame serves as a backlight, placing warm orange rim light on the hair, ears, shoulders, and right cheek. The front is softly illuminated by the blue reflections of the sky and the pool, lifting the shadows on the face and chest. Add small point light sources on the water droplets, reflect the sky in the pupils, and create shimmering highlights of the evening sky and blue in the pool.

Color, Tone:
Combine lavender, turquoise blue, sunset orange, cloud blue-gray, and wet hair dark brown. The skin uses a neutral tone that is a natural mix of warm sunset colors and cool water surface colors. Although the evening sky in the background is vivid, it does not overpower the person; clearly distinguish the tones of the face and chest, the light purple of the swimsuit, and the gloss of the water droplets.

Material, Subtle Texture:
Depict tiny water droplets and a thin water film on wet skin, the wet matte feel of the bikini fabric, the stitching of the shoulder straps, and the fine metal wire of the necklace. The hair does not have a dry fluffy feel, but rather heavy, tangled wet bundles and clinging messy strands. Distinguish the ripples on the pool surface, the stone texture of the tile edge, and the soft gradations of the distant buildings and clouds.

Composition, Lens:
A vertical 9:16 close-range vacation portrait. Place the visual center of the chest at approximately 51% of the frame width, the center of the face at approximately 48% horizontally, and the top of the head about 5% from the top edge. Position the folded arms about 8% from the bottom edge. Let the face, chest, and arms occupy a large space while preserving the sunset clouds in the upper right and the blue pool in the left middle ground. A low-angle shot level with the water surface, captured with a mid-telephoto perspective, makes the person clear while the background remains soft.

Image Processing, Finish:
A high-quality realistic style suitable for vacation, hotel, spa, summer travel, swimwear, and beauty advertisements. Do not over-glow the wet skin; only let the water droplets shine delicately. Balance the orange of the sunset and the blue of the pool, naturally maintaining the facial colors. Place high resolution in the pupils, lips, chest, and swimsuit edges, creating a cinematic evening scene in the background without over-exaggeration.

Avoidance, Prohibited:
Fixed to the same adult woman, wet long hair, looking directly into the camera, slightly parted lips, lavender bandeau bikini, folded arms, blue pool, sunset clouds. Do not add other people, extra figures, brands, readable building names, text, logos, or watermarks. Do not distort the eyes, wet hair, neck straps, chest, elbows, arms, or water droplets; do not change the swimsuit shape to other designs.

prompts.text:
被摄主体：
黄昏的无边泳池中，从水面露出上半身，将双臂叠放在泳池边缘，凝视镜头的虚构成年日本女性一人。将湿润的脸庞和头发、胸口、淡紫色泳装、手臂上的水滴在大尺寸纵向画面中突出。连接近距离的目光与背后的夕阳，表现度假的一天即将结束前的宁静高扬。

地点・时间・背景：
日落直前的屋顶或海边无边泳池。左侧放置白色建筑墙壁和盆栽，中央向右侧为蓝色的泳池水面，远处的中层建筑群，以及染成橙色与浅紫色的地平线。云朵大而纵向耸立，夕阳从云间细长地射入。将地平线和泳池边缘置于较低位置，在人物背后保留天空的色彩。

服装・小物：
哑光淡紫色的抹胸式比基尼上装。细长的肩带向上延伸至颈部，胸侧有两条线条，三角形罩杯，中央和肩部有小的结扣。面料为吸水后的光滑哑光材质，边缘呈现深湿润色。在锁骨下方添置极细的银色项链和小巧的纵长吊坠。

姿势・手指・接触：
从泳池内将上身向前倾斜，双前臂横向叠放在石质或瓷砖边缘以支撑身体。肩膀左右展开，颈部拉长，脸庞微微向左倾斜。肘部和指尖自然延伸至下端附近，湿润的手臂触及边缘的压力，以及刚从水面升起后的重心感得以传达。

表情・视线：
双眼直视镜头，嘴唇微微张开，保留呼吸的余韵。不带笑容，以平静而亲近的目光，以及感受到傍晚宁静的表情呈现。眉毛自然上扬，眼睑和瞳孔方向对齐，即使是湿润的脸庞，也要保持眼部的细腻感不失。

脸庞・妆容：
圆润的卵形脸，修整整齐的深茶色眉毛，含灰的深棕色瞳孔，细致的棕色眼线，长长的睫毛，干净的鼻梁，光泽的粉米色嘴唇。作为防水薄妆，在脸颊处施以淡玫瑰色，眼部添加适度的阴影。在脸颊、鼻梁、嘴唇、额头留下细小的水滴和自然的反射。

头发：
近黑的深棕色长发保持湿润状态自然垂下。刘海分成细束贴附在额头，左右的发束沿脸颊、颈部、肩膀、胸口延伸。右侧头发加入夕阳的橙色边缘光晕，左侧保持浓郁湿润的黑色。发梢形成沉重下垂的束感，向背部和水面延续。

光源：
画面右后方的低位夕阳作为逆光，在头发、耳朵、肩膀、右脸颊放置温暖的橙色轮廓光。正面由天空和泳池的蓝色反射柔和照亮，提升脸庞和胸口的暗部。水滴上添加小点光源，瞳孔中反射天空，泳池中营造夕空与蓝色的摇曳高光。

颜色・色调：
结合淡紫色、绿松石蓝、夕阳的橙色、云朵的青灰色，以及湿发深棕色。肌肤采用夕阳暖色与水面冷色的自然混合中性色调。背景的夕空虽鲜艳但不覆盖人物，明确区分脸庞和胸口的色调、泳装的浅紫、水滴的光泽。

材质・细微质感：
描绘湿润肌肤上的细小水滴和薄薄水膜、比基尼面料的湿润哑光感、肩带的缝合线、项链的细金属线。头发不采用干燥的蓬松感，而是沉重纠缠的湿润束和贴附的凌乱发丝。泳池水面的涟漪、瓷砖边缘的石质感、远景建筑与云朵的柔和层次也加以区分。

构图・镜头：
纵向9:16的近距离度假肖像。将胸部的视觉中心置于画面宽度的约51%，脸部中心置于横向约48%，头顶距上端约5%，叠放的双臂距下端约8%。让脸庞、胸口、手臂占据大片空间，同时在右上方保留夕阳云朵，左中景保留蓝色泳池。与水面同高的低位镜头、中远摄视角拍摄，使人物清晰而远景柔和。

图像处理・完成：
适用于度假、酒店、水疗、夏日旅行、泳装、美容广告的高品质实写风格。不过度发光湿润肌肤，仅让水滴细腻地闪耀。兼顾夕阳的橙色与泳池的蓝色，自然保持脸部色彩。在瞳孔、嘴唇、胸口、泳装边缘放置解析感，背景营造电影般的夕景但不过度夸张。

崩坏回避・禁止：
固定为同一成年女性、湿润长发、直视镜头、微微张开的嘴唇、淡紫色抹胸比基尼、叠放的双臂、蓝色泳池、夕阳云朵。不添加其他人、额外人物、品牌、可读的建筑名称、文字、标志、水印。不扭曲眼睛、湿发、颈带、胸口、肘部、手臂、水滴，不将泳装形状改为其他设计。

items.title: 撕边墨迹旅行记忆三段式海报

prompts.text:
Please make each travel photo I upload into an independent torn-edge ink memory editing poster, outputting each photo separately, not stitched together. The overall format is 3:4 vertical, using a "Real Photography -> Observational Line Drawing -> Ink Silhouette" three-stage decreasing structure to express the same scene.

The top part occupies about 28%–36% of the screen height, faithfully preserving the most important scene in the original photo. Accurately maintain the identity, number, posture, orientation, spacing of subjects, architectural structures, vehicles, boats, animals, human movements, real textures, spatial directions, natural light and shadow, and iconic colors, only performing slight artistic publication color grading. The photo must be clearly discernible and cannot be transformed into illustrations or decorative thumbnails.

The top photo is connected to the paper surface below using clearly visible hand-torn rough paper edges: the edges have real paper fibers, irregular bumps, and slight thickness, and digital atomization, feathering, or soft light gradients must not be used.

The middle part is warm ivory, unbleached cotton paper, or light beige coarse paper, which is the observation page with the most white space. Redraw the same subject with unstable fountain pen lines, short cross-hatchings, dry ink, and a small amount of gray wash, accurately preserving the quantity, posture, and relative position, but actively deleting irrelevant backgrounds and tiny details. Choose a tree trunk, lighthouse, bridge cable, building edge, ship mast, mountain crack, or vehicle outline from the photo as a vertical memory anchor. The line drawing is concentrated in a narrow horizontal field, does not fill the paper surface, and is not an automatic photo outline.

The bottom part allows the scene to further dissipate into light taupe, smoky gray, blue-gray, or olive black ink blobs, uneven water marks, dry brush particles, slender broken lines, and 1–2 restrained drips. The subject shrinks into a set of small dark silhouettes, still maintaining the correct number and direction, falling on a horizontal brushstroke of an emphasis color extracted from the original photo. Use only one emphasis color, not fixed to orange.

Information density must decrease from top to bottom: the photo is the densest, the line drawing second, and the bottom silhouette the simplest. Continuous and obvious breathing space of the paper surface is reserved in the middle and around the subject; ink blobs flow in incompletely from one side or the lower edge and do not close all four sides.

Add a 1–3 English word title, a MEMORY NO. 01 style field, and a line of 5–10 English word observation sentence in the middle white space. Use readable typewriter bold, monospaced archival fonts, or capitalized lead type with ink gaps for text; auxiliary text is smaller but cannot shrink into gray lines. The text content must come from the subjects, actions, weather, or spatial relationships in the photo, not copying the author's words, and not fabricating research data.

The overall style should be like a page of a travel archive that has been torn open, observed, and gradually faded, restrained, poetic, with real paper fibers, dry ink, and a sense of time.

Mandatory avoidance: rigid vertical/horizontal divisions, ordinary half-photo half-sketch templates, digital softening transitions, irrelevant bottom illustrations, full-page watercolors, traditional ink landscape imitations, cute cartoons, detailed animal or plant field guides, automatic outlines, dense technical infographics, large titles overpowering the image, multiple emphasis colors, author names, signatures, accounts, logos, website addresses, QR codes, watermarks, garbled characters.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的撕边墨迹记忆编辑海报，每张照片单独输出，不多图拼接。整体采用3:4竖版，使用“真实摄影→观察线稿→墨迹剪影”三阶段递减结构表达同一场景。

顶部约占画面高度28%–36%，忠实保留原始照片中最重要的场景。准确保持主体身份、数量、姿态、朝向、间距、建筑结构、车辆、船只、动物、人物动作、真实材质、空间方向、自然光影和标志性色彩，只进行轻微艺术出版物调色。照片必须清楚可辨，不能插画化或变成装饰性缩略图。

顶部照片与下方纸面使用清楚可见的手工撕纸毛边连接：边缘有真实纸纤维、不规则凹凸与轻微厚度，不能使用数字雾化、羽化或柔光渐变。

中部为温暖象牙色、未漂白棉纸或浅米色粗纸，是留白最多的观察页。用不稳定钢笔线、短排线、干墨和少量灰洗重画同一主体，准确保留数量、姿态和相对位置，但主动删除无关背景与微小细节。选择照片中的树干、灯塔、桥索、建筑边缘、船桅、山体裂隙或车辆轮廓作为一条竖向记忆锚点。线稿集中在较窄的水平场域，不铺满纸面，也不做照片自动描边。

底部让场景进一步消散成淡灰褐、烟灰、蓝灰或橄榄黑的墨团、不均匀水痕、干笔颗粒、细长断线和1–2道克制滴落。主体缩成一组小型深色剪影，仍保持正确数量和方向，落在一道从原照片提取的强调色水平笔迹上。只使用一个强调色，不固定为橙色。

信息密度必须自上而下递减：照片最密，线稿次之，底部剪影最简。中部和主体周围保留连续、明显的纸面呼吸空间；墨团从一侧或下缘不完整地涌入，不封闭四边。

在中部留白加入一个1–3个英文单词标题、MEMORY NO. 01式字段和一行5–10个英文单词观察句。文字使用可读的打字机粗体、等宽档案字或带缺墨的大写铅字，辅助文字较小但不能缩成灰线。文字内容必须来自照片中的主体、动作、天气或空间关系，不复制作者文字，不虚构研究数据。

整体应像一页被撕开、观察并逐渐褪去的旅行档案，克制、诗意，具有真实纸纤维、干墨与时间感。

强制避免：硬直上下分界、普通半照片半速写模板、数字柔化过渡、无关下方插画、满页水彩、传统水墨山水模仿、可爱卡通、精细动物或植物图鉴、自动描边、密集技术信息图、大标题压过画面、多种强调色、作者名、签名、账号、Logo、网址、二维码、水印、乱码。

items.title: 真人照片转东方复古木刻版画插画提示词

prompts.text:
Real Person Photos → Oriental Vintage Woodcut Manga | Universal Prompt

Please recreate the entire photo based on the [original photo] I upload into a vintage woodcut print illustration with Eastern aesthetics.

Do not just add a filter to the original photo, but perform a complete artistic redrawing based on the photo.

1. Preserve original photo

Accurately preserve the following from the original photo as much as possible:
Subject identity and recognizability
Poses, actions, and expressions of people or animals
Clothing, hairstyles, accessories
Important props
Positional relationships between subjects
Original photography angle
Dashed composition and visual focus
Most representative scene elements

Backgrounds can be appropriately simplified, but do not change the story originally expressed by the photo.
Characters should not become completely unfamiliar generic cartoon faces.
Animals should retain real characteristics such as breed, fur color, patterns, ears, eyes, and body shape.

2. Core art style

Convert real photos into:
**Traditional Chinese woodcut prints
Vintage folk art illustrations
Old-style New Year print printing
Old book illustrations
Handmade screen printing
A small amount of modern graphic design**
The overall look should have a clear sense of handmade woodblock carving.

Use:
Black carved lines of uneven thickness, dense hatching, woodcut textures, coarse ink marks, dry brush marks, slight ink loss, particles, paper fibers, slight registration misalignment, and natural wear and tear.
Do not draw it as a smooth modern digital illustration.

3. Modeling method

The subject outline is clear, generalized, and powerful.
Details in the real photo are converted into lines and color blocks with a woodcut feel.
Facial features retain recognizability but are moderately illustrated:
Simplified features
Clear outlines
Natural expressions
Do not over-cartoonize
Do not use big anime eyes
Do not use 3D modeling
Hair, clothing texture, leaves, buildings, and props are expressed with handmade carved lines.
Small amounts of fine line work can be retained locally to make the image both coarse and durable.

4. Composition design

The overall composition is like a collection-grade old woodcut poster.
Automatically reorganize the background based on the original photo.
Can naturally include:
Bamboo leaves, branches, flowers and grass, mountains, clouds, birds, traditional building outlines, the moon, the sun, circular halos, and other elements.
But these elements must serve the original photo; do not fill the screen just for decoration.

Can use:
Circular viewfinders / Arched composition / Plant borders / Black silhouette edges
Forming a visual structure similar to an old woodcut cover.
The subject must still be the visual center.

5. Color

Use a low-saturation, vintage, and restrained limited palette.
The main color is automatically selected from the 3–5 most coordinated colors among:
Carbon black
Cream yellow
Old paper color
Dark green
Gray blue
Indigo
Brick red
Ochre
Dark orange
Moss green
Avoid large areas of high-saturation neon colors.
If the original photo has very important bright colors, such as:
Fish lanterns, ethnic costumes, toys, flowers, amusement facilities,
these colors can be appropriately retained as visual highlights but still converted into a vintage color printing effect.

6. Material

The image looks like it's printed on a piece of old paper preserved for decades.
Add real:
Paper fibers
Old paper grains
Uneven ink absorption
Slight fading
Ink spots
Scratches
Wear
Ink loss
Overprint errors
Irregular edges
Handmade printing marks
Texture is natural and restrained; do not make it intentionally too dirty.

7. Atmosphere

The final image should simultaneously have:
Oriental
Vintage
Quiet
Poetic
Simple
Warm
Narrative sense
Handmade feel
Literary sense
Collection sense

Like a page flipped out from an old China travel album, a folk story collection, or a woodcut illustration collection from decades ago.
It has both traditional flavor and modern aesthetics.

8. Text
By default, do not copy from the original photo:
Watermarks, account names, Logos, platform identifiers, dates, or irrelevant text.
If suitable for the image, a very small traditional vertical title tag can be added in the corner,
Automatically generating a 2–4 character Chinese theme name based on the photo content,
Using archaic printing fonts or woodcut fonts.
Text must be minimal and restrained.
If accurate Chinese characters cannot be guaranteed, do not generate text at all.
No garbled characters.

Final Effect

Retain the story and recognizability of the original photo, but make it look like it was re-carved and printed by a traditional woodcut artist.
Not a common manga.
Not a simple filter.
Not photo outlining.
But a completely redesigned:
Oriental vintage woodcut art illustration.
High detail, exquisite carving lines, real old paper texture, limited color overprinting, high-end art print quality, suitable as posters, postcards, book illustrations, and collection-grade artworks.

prompts.text:
真人照片 → 东方复古木刻漫画｜万能提示词

请根据我上传的【原始照片】，将整张照片重新创作为一幅具有东方审美的复古木刻版画插画

不要只是给原照片添加滤镜，而是以照片为基础进行完整的艺术化重绘

1. 保留原照片

尽可能准确保留原照片中的：

主体身份与辨识度
人物或动物的姿势、动作和神态
服装、发型、配饰
重要道具
主体之间的位置关系
原始摄影角度
大致构图与视觉重心
最有代表性的场景元素

可以适当简化复杂背景，但不要改变照片原本表达的故事。

人物不要变成完全陌生的通用卡通脸。

动物要保留品种、毛色、花纹、耳朵、眼睛、体型等真实特征。

2. 核心画风

将真实照片转换为：

**中国传统木刻版画

复古民艺插画

老式年画印刷
旧书插图
手工丝网印刷
少量现代平面设计**
整体具有明显的手工雕版感。

使用：

粗细不均的黑色刻线、密集排线、刀刻纹理、粗粝墨迹、干刷痕迹、轻微掉墨、颗粒、纸纤维、套色轻微错位以及自然磨损。

不要画成光滑的现代数字插画。

3. 造型方式

主体轮廓清晰、概括而有力量。

真实照片中的细节转化为具有木刻感的线条与色块。

面部保留辨识度，但适度插画化：

五官简化

轮廓清楚

表情自然
不过度卡通
不使用动漫大眼
不使用3D造型
毛发、衣服纹理、树叶、建筑和道具采用手工刻线表现。
局部可以保留少量精细线稿，让画面既粗粝又耐看。

4. 构图设计

整体构图像一张收藏级的老版画海报。

根据原照片自动重新组织背景。

可以自然加入：

竹叶、树枝、花草、山峦、云层、飞鸟、传统建筑轮廓、月亮、太阳、圆形光晕等元素。

但这些元素必须服务于原照片，不要为了装饰而堆满画面。

可以使用：

圆形取景框 / 拱形构图 / 植物边框 / 黑色剪影边缘

形成类似旧版画封面的视觉结构。

主体仍然必须是视觉中心。

5. 色彩

采用低饱和、复古、克制的有限色版印刷。

主色自动从以下颜色中选择最协调的 3–5 种：

炭黑

米黄

旧纸色

墨绿

灰蓝
靛青
砖红
赭石
暗橙
苔藓绿
避免大面积高饱和霓虹色。
如果原照片中存在非常重要的鲜艳颜色，例如：
鱼灯、民族服饰、玩具、花朵、游乐设施，
可以适当保留这些颜色作为视觉亮点，但仍然转换成复古套色印刷效果。

6. 材质

画面像印在一张保存了几十年的旧纸上。

纸张纤维
旧纸颗粒
不均匀吸墨
轻微褪色
墨点
划痕
磨损
掉墨
套印误差
边缘不规则
手工印刷痕迹

质感自然、克制，不要故意做得过脏。

7. 氛围

最终画面应该同时具有：

东方
复古
安静
诗意
质朴
温暖
故事感
手工感
文学感
收藏感

像从一本旧中国旅行画册、民俗故事集或几十年前的木刻插画集中翻出来的一页。
既有传统味道，又具有现代审美。
8. 文字
默认不要复制原照片中的：
水印、账号、Logo、平台标识、日期或无关文字。
如果画面适合，可以在边角增加一个非常小的传统竖排题签，
根据照片内容自动生成 2–4 个字的中文主题名称，
使用古朴印刷字体或木刻字体。
文字必须少而克制。
如果无法保证中文字准确，则直接不生成文字。
不要出现乱码。

最终效果

保留原照片的故事和辨识度，但让它看起来像被一位传统木刻版画艺术家重新雕刻并印刷出来。

不是普通漫画。

不是简单滤镜。

不是照片描边。
而是一幅完整重新设计的：
东方复古木刻艺术插画。
高细节，精致刻线，真实旧纸纹理，有限色套印，高级艺术印刷质感，适合作为海报、明信片、书籍插画和收藏级艺术作品

prompts.text:
Create a refined 3:4 vertical premium travel poster for [CITY].
First identify the city, country, architecture, landscape, climate, cultural character, and visual identity. Select ONE iconic and highly recognizable real-world landmark or subject as the HERO. Establish one believable photographic viewpoint and ensure every environmental element logically belongs to that location. Do not create a collage of unrelated landmarks.

COMPOSITION: Divide the poster into two perfectly equal sections: 50% top and 50% bottom. Use a warm beige, ivory, or soft-white background with generous negative space and precise alignment.

TOP — HERO PHOTOGRAPH: Create an ultra-realistic, high-end editorial photograph of the chosen landmark from a believable real-world viewpoint. Preserve accurate architecture, proportions, materials, surrounding environment, natural lighting, shadows, atmosphere, and geographic character. The scene should feel like premium architectural photography or a museum-quality travel photograph, with realistic textures and sophisticated cinematic composition.

BOTTOM — GRAPHIC INTERPRETATION: Reinterpret the same hero landmark as a sophisticated flat graphic design. Extract its most recognizable silhouette, contours, structural details, proportions, and distinctive architectural elements. Simplify them into elegant geometric shapes, flat color blocks, thin lines, restrained divisions, and generous negative space. The landmark must remain instantly recognizable without becoming a realistic illustration, 3D render, cartoon, or game graphic.

COLOR & TYPOGRAPHY: Derive a restrained palette of approximately 4–6 colors from the city's architecture, environment, and hero photograph. Keep the palette sophisticated with slightly muted saturation. Add minimal geometric accents only when they improve the composition.

Use limited, elegant typography such as: [CITY] [COUNTRY] ARCHITECTURAL STUDY 2026

Use Swiss/international graphic design, architectural exhibition posters, luxury editorial design, and museum visual identity as the aesthetic reference. Keep typography subtle, with generous letter spacing and strong visual hierarchy.

FINAL AESTHETIC: Sophisticated, minimal, contemporary, culturally authentic, artistic, and premium. The photographic upper half and graphic lower half should feel like two expressions of the same visual identity. The final result should resemble a world-class gallery poster, collector's travel print, architectural exhibition artwork, or luxury brand campaign.

Avoid landmark collages, inaccurate architecture, invented structures, excessive text, tourist-brochure aesthetics, neon, flashy effects, heavy gradients, glossy 3D rendering, cartoon styling, game UI, clutter, excessive decoration, and generic AI-generated cityscapes.

prompts.text: 为[城市]创作一张精致的3:4垂直高端旅游海报。首先确定城市、国家、建筑、景观、气候、文化特征和视觉身份。选择一个具有代表性且高度可辨识的现实世界地标或主题作为核心主体。确立一个可信的摄影视角，并确保每个环境元素在逻辑上都属于该位置。不要创建不相关地标的拼贴画。构图：将海报完美地分为两个相等的部分：顶部50%和底部50%。使用温暖的米色、象牙色或柔和的白色背景，并留有大量的负空间和精确的对齐。顶部 —— 核心照片：从一个可信的现实世界视角为选定的地标创作一张超写实的高端社论照片。保留准确的建筑、比例、材质、周围环境、自然光照、阴影、氛围和地理特征。场景应感觉像高端建筑摄影或博物馆品质的旅游照片，具有真实的纹理和复杂的电影感构图。底部 —— 图形诠释：将同一个核心地标重新诠释为精致的平面图形设计。提取其最易辨识的轮廓、线条、结构细节、比例和独特的建筑元素。将它们简化为优雅的几何形状、扁平色块、细线、克制的划分和大量的负空间。地标必须保持即刻可辨识，且不能变成写实插画、3D渲染、卡通或游戏图形。颜色与排版：从城市的建筑、环境和核心照片中提取大约4–6种颜色的克制色调。保持色调精致，饱和度略微降低。仅在能改善构图时添加极简的几何点缀。使用有限且优雅的排版，例如：[城市] [国家] 建筑研究 2026。以瑞士/国际平面设计、建筑展览海报、奢侈品社论设计和博物馆视觉身份作为审美参考。保持排版含蓄，具有宽大的字间距和强大的视觉层级。最终审美：精致、极简、当代、文化真实、艺术且高端。摄影的上半部分和图形的下半部分应感觉像是同一视觉身份的两种表达。最终结果应类似于世界级画廊海报、收藏级旅游版画、建筑展览艺术品或奢侈品牌广告。避免地标拼贴、不准确的建筑、虚构的结构、过多的文字、旅游手册审美、霓虹灯、闪亮效果、重度渐变、抛光3D渲染、卡通风格、游戏UI、杂乱、过度的装饰以及平庸的AI生成城市场景。

items.title: 3D等距微缩地理景观建筑模型

prompts.text:
DESTINATION = [DESTINATION] SCOPE = AUTO

Create a premium vertical 3D isometric miniature diorama of [DESTINATION], focused on its most recognizable geographic and cultural core. Select 5–8 authentic iconic elements and use the smallest area that best represents the destination.

Geography

Use the recognizable core as the raised terrain base. Keep the full footprint visible and uncropped. Preserve coastlines, rivers, islands, harbors, mountains, waterfronts, and correct spatial relationships. Simplify geography only for clarity.

Maintain 75% iconic core + 25% supporting context. For large cities, exclude generic suburbs and low-value outskirts.

Landmarks

Include:

1–2 hero landmarks

3–5 secondary landmarks

1 natural feature when relevant

Keep landmarks authentic, recognizable, correctly positioned, and proportionally hierarchical. Use each only once.

Integration

Connect landmarks naturally through streets, bridges, parks, plazas, neighborhoods, waterways, vegetation, and terrain. Preserve real relationships such as waterfront locations, bridge connections, skyline clusters, and mountain positions.

Composition

Create a camera-ready establishing shot with clear depth:

Foreground: water, road, park, shoreline, or terrain edge Midground: hero landmark and main district Background: skyline, historic district, mountain, harbor, or natural boundary

Use one visual axis—river, avenue, coastline, bridge, or valley—to lead toward the hero landmark. Avoid excessive overlap and tiny unstable structures.

Visual Style

High-detail realistic architectural miniature, high-angle three-quarter isometric view, orthographic-like perspective, sculpted terrain, realistic materials, glass, stone, metal, water, foliage, ambient occlusion, and soft contact shadows.

Vertical 2:3 or 3:4. Diorama fills 68–75% of the frame with generous upper negative space, warm off-white studio background, and subtle ground shadow.

Elegant, realistic, architectural, museum-quality. Not cartoonish, chibi, toy-like, flat, or low-poly.

Header

Top center, exactly:

[DESTINATION] [COUNTRY · REGION OR CONTINENT] [ACCURATE NATIONAL FLAG]

Bold condensed uppercase title, smaller tracked subtitle, small accurate flag. No other text, logos, or watermarks.

Final Goal

Make [DESTINATION] instantly recognizable through accurate core geography, landmark hierarchy, cinematic depth, and cohesive premium 3D miniature design.

Avoid inaccurate geography, generic filler, duplicated/invented landmarks, overcrowding, excessive distortion, cropped terrain, incorrect text, or incorrect flags.

prompts.text:
DESTINATION = [目的地] SCOPE = 自动

创建一个 [目的地] 的优质垂直 3D 等距微缩景观模型，重点展示其最知名的地理和文化核心。选择 5–8 个真实的标志性元素，并使用最能代表该目的地的最小区域。

地理

使用可辨识的核心区域作为抬高的地形基底。保持完整的足迹可见且不被裁剪。保留海岸线、河流、岛屿、港口、山脉、水边和正确的空间关系。仅为清晰起见简化地理。

保持 75% 的标志性核心 + 25% 的配套背景。对于大城市，排除普通的郊区和低价值的边缘地带。

地标

包括：

1–2 个核心地标

3–5 个次要地标

1 个自然特征（如果相关）

保持地标真实、可辨识、位置正确且比例层次分明。每个仅使用一次。

整合

通过街道、桥梁、公园、广场、社区、水道、植被和地形自然连接地标。保留真实的关系，如滨水位置、桥梁连接、天际线集群和山脉位置。

构图

创建一个具有清晰深度的摄像机就绪全景镜头：

前景：水、道路、公园、海岸线或地形边缘 中景：核心地标和主要街区 背景：天际线、历史街区、山脉、港口或自然边界

使用一个视觉轴——河流、大街、海岸线、桥梁或山谷——来引导向核心地标。避免过多的重叠和微小不稳定的结构。

视觉风格

高细节真实建筑微缩模型、高角度四分之三等距视图、类正交投影透视、雕刻地形、真实材料、玻璃、石头、金属、水、树叶、环境光遮蔽和柔和的接触阴影。

垂直 2:3 或 3:4。微缩景观占据画面的 68–75%，上方保留大量的负空间，温暖的米白色工作室背景，以及微妙的地面阴影。

优雅、写实、建筑风格、博物馆级品质。非卡通、Q 版、玩具化、扁平化或低多边形。

页眉

正上方中心，确切内容：

[目的地] [国家 · 地区或洲] [准确的国旗]

粗体压缩大写标题，较小的紧凑副标题，小型准确的旗帜。无其他文本、标志或水印。

最终目标

通过准确的核心地理、地标层次、电影深度和凝聚力强的优质 3D 微缩模型设计，让 [目的地] 瞬间可辨识。

避免不准确的地理、通用的填充物、重复/虚构的地标、过度拥挤、过度扭曲、裁剪的地形、错误的文本或错误的旗帜。

Main Subject:
Vertical 3:4, early morning Japanese outdoor courtyard, a circular hinoki wood bath tub filled with hot spring water is placed in the center of wet stone ground, the character sits inside the tub slowly scooping hot water with a wooden ladle to pour onto the left shoulder. The body is located in the center slightly to the right of the frame, framing from the top of the head to the upper edge of the bath tub, forming a clear action chain of the wooden ladle, water flow, and shoulder; the left foreground is lightly obscured by blurred bamboo leaves at the edge of the frame, and the distant garden stones and moss establish a quiet depth.

Character · Expression:
Exquisite 23-year-old East Asian beauty, with a stylish, confident, and gentle temperament;
Well-proportioned and full figure, naturally full breasts (approximate D to E cup visual effect), slender waist, coordinated hip-to-leg ratio, soft and natural curves;
Ivory white skin with a faint pinkish flush after bathing, cheeks, shoulders, and neck retain real pores, tiny water droplets, and moist highlights. Bright milk tea grey-brown medium-length hair loosely tied behind the head, thin air bangs moistened by steam into fine strands, two strands of wet hair hanging by the cheeks. Exquisite and soft oval face, clear dark brown pupils with tiny catchlights, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long slender eyelashes, natural tear troughs, light rose blush, and translucent pink-beige lips. She slightly lowers her eyelids to look at the fine stream of water falling on her left shoulder, with a faint, relaxed smile at the corners of her lips.

Clothing · Pose:
A clean ivory white fine-knit bath towel fits and wraps around the front of the chest within the shot, the upper edge of the towel is flat and stable. The character's back rests lightly against the tub wall, the neck and shoulders are relaxed and turned slightly to the left; the right hand holds the short handle of the hinoki wooden ladle, the palm and four fingers naturally wrap around the handle, the mouth of the ladle is slightly tilted above the left shoulder, and a continuous fine stream of water accurately falls on the outer side of the left shoulder.

Background · Light:
The foreground blurred bamboo leaves have dewdrops on them, the mid-ground shows the copper hoops, wood grain of the hinoki tub and rising white mist, the background only retains the scattered depths of mossy stones, low bamboo fences, and an extinguished stone lantern. The early morning natural light filtered by thin clouds from the upper left is the only main light source, softly illuminating the forehead, bridge of the nose, left shoulder, and the edges of the water mist, with shadows slowly transitioning towards the back right. The surface of the hot spring water provides a layer of weak warm white reflection, lightly supporting the jaw and collarbone, without introducing other colored light sources.

Composition · Camera:
Equivalent 50mm, the camera position is almost level with the upper edge of the bath tub, slightly looking down to simultaneously account for the face, wooden ladle, water flow, and the circular mouth of the tub. The focal plane is locked on the near-side pupil and the position where the water flow contacts the left shoulder, shallow depth of field softens the bamboo leaves and courtyard background; the character occupies about 65% of the frame, with the left side reserved as breathing space for the gaze and water mist, the curve of the tub rim surrounds the character and guides the gaze back to the face.

Texture · Style:
Japanese hot spring ryokan lifestyle photography and beauty magazine texture, low contrast, restrained saturation, warm grey wood and moss green tones, with fine and soft film grain. The focus is on expressing the realistic layers of wet hinoki wood texture, fine-knit bath towel, steam, and continuous water flow.

Negative:
Underage or mature middle-aged feel, drifting facial features, bath towel slipping or exposure, failed grip of wooden ladle and hand, water flow floating or not touching the left shoulder, obvious finger and joint errors, deformed bath tub structure, plastic-looking skin or watermarks

主题：
雾隐木香

主体：
竖3:4，清晨的日式露天庭院，一只注满温泉水的圆形桧木浴桶置于湿润石地中央，人物坐在桶内缓缓用木勺舀起热水淋向左肩。身体位于画面中央略偏右，取景从头顶至浴桶上沿，木勺、水流与肩部形成清晰的动作链；左侧前景以虚化的竹叶轻遮画面边缘，远处庭石与苔藓建立幽静纵深。

绝美23岁东亚美女，气质时尚、自信、温柔；
身材匀称丰满，胸部自然丰满（约D至E杯视觉效果），腰部纤细，臀腿比例协调，曲线柔和自然；

镜头内一条干净的象牙白细织浴巾贴合包裹胸前，浴巾上沿平整稳固。人物背部轻靠桶壁，肩颈放松并微向左转；右手握住桧木勺短柄，掌心与四指自然包覆柄身，勺口在左肩上方略微倾斜，连续细水流准确落在左肩外侧。

前景虚化竹叶沾有露珠，中景可见桧木桶的铜箍、木纹与升腾白雾，背景只保留深浅错落的苔石、矮竹篱和一盏熄灭的石灯笼。左上方被薄云过滤的清晨自然光为唯一主光，柔和照亮额头、鼻梁、左肩及水雾边缘，阴影向右后方缓慢过渡。温泉水面提供一层微弱的暖白反光，轻托下颌与锁骨，不引入其他杂色光源。

等效50mm，机位与浴桶上沿近乎齐平，轻微俯视以同时交代面部、木勺、水流和圆形桶口。焦点平面锁定近侧瞳孔与水流接触左肩的位置，浅景深使竹叶和庭院背景柔化；人物约占画面65%，左侧为视线与水雾保留呼吸空间，桶沿弧线环抱人物并引导视线回到面部。

质感・风格：
日系温泉旅馆生活方式写真与美容杂志质感，低对比、克制饱和、暖灰木色与苔绿调色，带细腻柔和的胶片颗粒。重点表现潮湿桧木纹理、细织浴巾、蒸汽与连续水流的真实层次。

负面：
未成年或成熟中年感、人物面部特征漂移、浴巾滑落或走光、木勺与手部握持失败、水流悬浮或未接触左肩、明显手指与关节错误、浴桶结构变形、塑料感皮肤或水印

prompts.text:
Strictly generate an Oriental fantasy cinematic night scene, the overall worldview is "Oriental Heavenly Palace Ancient City suspended at the edge of the universe," the style must be unified, high-end, aesthetic, cold, dreamy, with a strong sense of epic and spatial depth.

The scene is: [Scene].

The main subject of the picture is a young Oriental woman in ancient costume, with a quiet, cold, gentle, and dignified temperament, possessing classical Oriental beauty, not flamboyant, not modern, not an influencer face. She has extremely long black hair, an exquisite bun, and wears delicate classical hairpins, flower decorations, and tassels. She wears a high-quality Hanfu long skirt, with main colors of moon white, ice blue, fog blue, and light purple blue, with layers of light gauze and silk superimposed, wide robes and large sleeves, the hem naturally trailing on the ground, the fabric is light, soft, translucent, and realistically draping, with extremely delicate embroidery, hidden patterns, and faint pearl luster. The character is presented from the back, two-thirds back, elegant side profile, or quiet side face, not looking directly at the camera, not posing, the character is a poetic subject in the environmental narrative, rather than an ordinary portrait photo.

The overall environment is a high-end Oriental palace aesthetic, the architecture includes dark blue tiles, flying eaves and upturned corners, vermilion corridors and pillars, wooden pavilions, terraces, water pavilions, stone bridges, winding corridors, railings, moon gates, courtyards, and water gardens. In the distance, layers of Oriental palaces stretch out, forming a grand ancient city night scene. Automatically add reasonable elements according to [Scene], such as cherry blossoms, peach blossoms, weeping willows, ancient pines, lotus flowers, lotus leaves, stone lamps, bonsai, strange stones, petals, water surfaces, and bridges, but the overall must be restrained, natural, and exquisite, do not overstack.

A huge near-Earth-like planet must be kept in the sky, not an ordinary moon, but a giant planet spanning a large area of the sky, with obvious atmospheric blue glow, cloud vortices, ocean textures, continental shadows, and nighttime city lights, with a strong sense of oppression, gigantism, dreaminess, and cinematic spectacle, as if the entire Oriental Heavenly Palace is built next to another planet.

The overall lighting and shadow are fixed as the midnight blue hour. The main light source comes from the giant planet and the cold blue night sky, forming a large area of ice blue, silver blue, and moon white ambient light; the buildings, lanterns, and palace lamps only dot a small amount of warm gold, amber gold, and soft warm yellow light sources, forming a high-end and restrained contrast between cold and warm. The whole follows 80% cold colors + 20% warm colors. The edges of the character's hair, the edges of the clothing, the eaves, the railings, and the water surface all have delicate and soft silver-blue rim light. The dark parts must be transparent with details and cannot be dead black; the bright parts must be soft and cannot be overexposed; the whole presents a high dynamic range but restrained cinematic exposure, not a cheap HDR effect.

The main color tone of the picture is midnight blue, deep sea blue, ultramarine, ice blue, silver blue, and blue-black, supplemented by moon white, fog blue, light purple, and gray-blue, with local accents of a small amount of champagne gold, amber gold, and warm yellow lights. Plant colors are biased towards cold green and gray-green, and flower colors are biased towards low-saturation gray-pink and light pink. The overall must be cold, quiet, transparent, aesthetic, restrained, and high-end.

The sky is a deep blue-black cosmic night sky, with fine and real star points, a small amount of Milky Way, star dust, and 1 to 3 meteors can be added, but the special effects must not be flooded, and the vast, silent, and ethereal atmosphere must be maintained.

The composition adopts a 16:9 cinematic horizontal screen, a 20mm to 35mm wide-angle lens feel, and the picture has a clear four-layer space of foreground, mid-ground, background, and extreme background. The foreground can use eaves, red pillars, moon gates, flower branches, window frames, railings, pine branches, rocks, and lanterns as framing; the mid-ground is the character and the main courtyard or corridor; the background is the palace city, bridges, water surfaces, and pavilions; the extreme background is the starry sky and the giant planet. The picture must have clear leading lines, such as stone steps, bridges, railings, long corridors, and waterways, leading the sight from the character to the palace city, the starry sky, and the giant planet. The overall composition is stable, quiet, grand, and poetic.

Materials must be real: real silk, gauze, wood, stone, tiles, plants, water surface, and aerial perspective; the water surface should be as quiet and open as possible, with delicate reflections, which can reflect palace lamps, pavilions, tree shadows, and planet glow. The overall effect is like a combination of high-budget Oriental fantasy movie live-action scenes and top-level movie CG environments, 8K details, cinematic lighting and shadow, strong spatial levels, and a sense of the boundary between dreams and reality.

Negative requirements: no daylight, no dusk, no modern buildings, no modern cities, no technological spaceships, no mechanical armor, no cyberpunk, no western castles, no churches, no steampunk, no neon lights, no anime flat illustrations, no childish 2D, no cheap ancient idol posters, no studio photography, no plastic texture, no excessive skin smoothing, no fluorescent colors, no stacking of special effects, no cluttered pictures, no deformed characters, no strange fingers, no architectural perspective errors, no small moon-style celestial bodies, no watermarks, no logos, no text.

prompts.text:
严格生成一幅东方幻想电影级夜景画面，整体为“悬于宇宙边缘的东方天宫古城”世界观，风格必须统一、高级、唯美、清冷、梦幻、具有强烈史诗感与空间纵深。

场景为：【场景】。

画面主体是一位年轻东方古装女子，气质安静、清冷、温柔、端庄，具有古典东方美感，不妖艳，不现代，不网红脸。她拥有极长的乌黑长发，发髻精致，佩戴细腻古典发簪、花饰、流苏。她身穿高质感汉服长裙，主色为月白、冰蓝、雾蓝、浅紫蓝，层层轻纱与丝绸叠加，宽袍大袖，裙摆自然拖地，面料轻薄、柔软、半透明、真实垂坠，带有极细腻的刺绣、暗纹与微弱珠光。人物以背影、三分之二背影、优雅侧身或安静侧脸呈现，不直视镜头，不摆拍，人物是环境叙事中的诗意主体，而不是普通人像写真。

整体环境为高级东方宫殿美学，建筑包含深色青瓦、飞檐翘角、朱红廊柱、木质楼阁、亭台、水榭、石桥、回廊、栏杆、月洞门、庭院、水庭。远处层层叠叠的东方宫阙延展开来，形成宏大的古城夜景。根据【场景】自动加入合理元素，如樱花、桃花、垂柳、古松、荷花、莲叶、石灯、盆景、奇石、花瓣、水面、桥梁，但整体必须克制、自然、精致，不要过度堆砌。

天空中必须保留一颗极其巨大的近地类地星球，不是普通月亮，而是一颗横跨大面积天空的巨型星球，带有明显的大气层蓝色辉光、云层旋涡、海洋纹理、大陆暗影和夜间城市灯光，具有强烈压迫感、巨物感、梦幻感和电影级奇观感，仿佛整座东方天宫建立在另一颗星球旁边。

整体光影固定为深夜蓝调时刻。主光源来自巨大星球与冷蓝夜空，形成大面积冰蓝、银蓝、月白色环境光；建筑、灯笼、宫灯只点缀少量暖金、琥珀金、柔和暖黄色光源，形成高级克制的冷暖对比。整体遵循 80% 冷色 + 20% 暖色。人物发丝边缘、衣裙边缘、屋檐、栏杆、水面都带有细腻柔和的银蓝色轮廓光。暗部必须通透有细节，不能死黑；亮部必须柔和，不能爆白；整体呈现高动态范围但克制的电影曝光，不要廉价HDR效果。

画面主色调为午夜蓝、深海蓝、群青、冰蓝、银蓝、蓝黑，辅以月白、雾蓝、浅紫、灰蓝，局部点缀少量香槟金、琥珀金、暖黄灯火。植物颜色偏冷绿、灰绿，花朵颜色偏低饱和灰粉、浅粉。整体必须清冷、安静、通透、唯美、克制、高级。

天空为深邃蓝黑色宇宙夜空，带有细密真实星点，可少量加入银河、星尘、1到3颗流星，但不能特效泛滥，必须保持辽阔、寂静、空灵的氛围。

构图采用16:9电影横屏，20mm到35mm广角镜头感，画面具有明确的近景、中景、远景、极远景四层空间。近景可使用屋檐、红柱、月洞门、花枝、窗框、栏杆、松枝、山石、灯笼作为框景；中景为人物与主要庭院或回廊；远景为宫城、桥梁、水面与楼阁；极远景为星空与巨型星球。画面必须有明显引导线，如石阶、桥梁、栏杆、长廊、水道，将视线从人物引向宫城、星空和巨型星球。整体构图稳定、安静、宏大、诗意。

材质必须真实：真实丝绸、薄纱、木材、石材、瓦片、植物、水面与空气透视；水面尽量安静开阔，带有细腻倒影，可映出宫灯、楼阁、树影和星球辉光。整体效果像高预算东方幻想电影实拍场景与顶级电影CG环境融合，8K细节，电影级光影，空间层次极强，梦境与现实交界的感觉。

负面要求：不要白天，不要黄昏，不要现代建筑，不要现代城市，不要科技飞船，不要机械装甲，不要赛博朋克，不要西方城堡，不要教堂，不要蒸汽朋克，不要霓虹灯，不要动漫扁平插画，不要低幼二次元，不要廉价古偶海报，不要影楼写真，不要塑料质感，不要过度磨皮，不要荧光色，不要特效堆砌，不要画面杂乱，不要人物畸形，不要奇怪手指，不要建筑透视错误，不要小月亮式天体，不要水印，不要logo，不要文字。

items.title: 山海经神兽东方史诗电影感提示词

prompts.text:
【Mythical Beast】

Examples: Nine-tailed Fox, Yinglong, Baize, Xiangliu, Bifang, Qiongqi, Luwu, Zhulong, Taotie, Dijiang, Tiangou, Zheng, Zhu Yan, Kui, etc.

Core Optimization Direction

This version focuses not on blindly stacking "weirdness," "ferocity," or "special effects," but on locking down the most touching elements from reference images:

① The mythical beast must be beautiful
② The mythical beast must be massive and shocking
③ The scene must have an Oriental mythical cinematic feel like the reference images
④ Cloud seas, sky light, backlighting, and human scale difference must be strong
⑤ No cheap MMO style, no Western monster style, no horror/ugly style

General Main Prompt
Strictly refer to the overall visual style of the uploaded image to generate a "Classic of Mountains and Seas" Oriental mythical giant creature cinematic scene.
The main subject of the picture is a 【Mythical Beast】 from the "Classic of Mountains and Seas."
It must simultaneously possess:
High aesthetic value, divinity, beauty, sense of gigantism, sense of oppression, ancient feel, and Oriental feel.
【Mythical Beast】 is not an ordinary monster, not a Western magic creature, and not a horror creature intentionally made ugly or fierce;
it should possess, like in the reference images: 

A stunning, solemn, mysterious, gorgeous, and blindingly ancient divinity.

The overall visual effect must be as if:

The mythical beasts in the "Classic of Mountains and Seas" have truly descended between heaven and earth in a cinematic way.

I. The mythical beast must be "beautiful"
This is the most important reinforcement point of this version.

【Mythical Beast】 needs a clear aesthetic upgrade:

The silhouette should be graceful, stretched, and magnificent
The face should have divinity and beauty
The eyes should be deep, ancient, and restrained
Hair / feathers / scales should be exquisite, gorgeous, and realistic
The posture should be elegant and oppressive, but not grotesque or low-grade
The overall "mythical beast feel" should be strong, rather than a "monster feel"

The aesthetic direction of the mythical beast should be:

"Sacred exotic beast" in Oriental mythology
Instead of:

Cheap horror monsters, demons, or ugly magic beasts.

Even for fierce-type beasts, they must be:
Majestic, dangerous, shocking, and gorgeous, rather than messy, ugly, or low-grade horror.

II. The sense of gigantism must be extremely strong
【Mythical Beast】 must reach a true heaven-and-earth-level giant scale.
It's not just a bit bigger, but big enough to:
Press down like a mountain
As if the sky itself has life
As part of storms, cloud seas, and mountains/rivers
So big that the lens cannot fully contain it

The mythical beast occupies about 75%–95% of the frame.

Allowed:

Head approaching the lens
Wings extending out of the frame
Giant tail filling the sky
Dragon body piercing through the cloud sea
Body parts hidden deep in the clouds
Multi-headed beasts peeking out from different spatial layers
Do not shrink the beast just to show the whole body.
People must feel at first glance:
"It's too big."

III. Reference-style composition lock

Use the core composition language of the reference images:

16:9 cinematic widescreen
12–20mm ultra-wide angle
Extremely low camera position
Looking up
Ultra-wide panorama / epic grand panorama
Beast-pressing-down composition

Tiny characters as scale references

Keep one or a very small number of ancient characters, boats, ancient cities, mountain gates, altars, pavilions, army formations, etc., at the bottom of the frame as scale references.

Human height controlled at around 0.5%–2% of the frame.

Ideally, a tiny ancient person with their back to the camera, standing between heaven and earth looking up at the mythical beast.

Forming a strong relationship:

Mortals like dust, beasts like the sky.

IV. Reference-style cloud sea must be locked
In the reference images, the key is not a common background, but:
Giant, thick, churning, dreamlike volumetric cloud seas that engulf heaven and earth.
Cloud layers must have a real sense of volume like mountains and oceans, becoming the second protagonist of the frame.

The cloud sea needs:
Large areas of rolling layers
Localized storm eyes, cloud walls, cloud waves, sky light cracks
Real occlusion relationship with the mythical beast's body
Parts of the mythical beast's body hidden in clouds
Cloud layers clearly disturbed by giant wings, giant tails, dragon bodies, or force fields

Ideal state:

30%–50% of the mythical beast's body hidden in the cloud sea.

Because:

Partially hidden and partially visible has a stronger sense of gigantism and a more high-end temperament than seeing everything clearly.

V. The mythical beast must integrate with the environment

Don't just place the mythical beast alone on a background.

It must truly change the heaven and earth environment like in the reference images.

For example:

Giant wings flapping, pushing clouds to both sides
Dragon body passing through clouds, forming huge flow tracks
Nine tails churning sky cloud waves
Giant beast bowing its head, mountains and rivers covered by shadows
Body passing over, seawater turning up huge waves
Fire-attribute beasts make the sky tinted with red-gold firelight
Lightning-attribute beasts let storms and lightning erupt around cloud walls
Sacred-attribute beasts let cloud layers split and sky light pour down

The mythical beast should have a feeling:

It is not "in the picture," it is part of heaven and earth.

VI. Lighting strictly refers to the image style

The overall lighting must strictly continue the high-end cinematic feel in the reference images:

Low-saturation gray-green / green-black environment + warm gold / red gold backlight + small amount of cold white highlights.

No multi-colored effects.

No fancy colored lights.
No game energy bar feel.

Use:
Large areas of heavy shadows
Local warm gold rim light
Penetrating light in cloud layers
Mythical beast edges lit by backlight
Most of the mythical beast's main body still submerged in shadows and mist

Best lighting structure:

65% shadows
25% mid-tones
10% highlights.

Highlights mainly concentrated on:

Mythical beast eyes
Head silhouette
Hair edges
Wing edges
Scale high points
Cloud layer cracks
Giant sky light / sun wheel / fire ring behind the mythical beast

VII. Colors should be high-end like the reference images
Overall main colors must be restrained and unified.
Main color range:
Ink green, green-gray, gray-blue, ivory white, mist white, black-brown, deep gray.

Attribute colors only as highlights:

Nine-tailed Fox / Baize: milky white, light gold, warm white

Yinglong: gray-white, red-gold, gold-white
Zhulong: dark red, red-gold, deep brown firelight
Xiangliu: iron green, gray-white, cold white

Bifang: gray-blue, molten gold, dark orange firelight

Qiongqi: deep gray, dark red, cold gold
Luwu: gold-brown, gray-gold, dark green background

Core principle:
Overall low saturation, local brilliance.

Do not:
Fluorescent blue
Purple-pink neon
RGB color light
Multi-colored magic effects
Full-screen bright light

VIII. Material must be "gorgeous but real"

The mythical beast must be beautiful, and material is key.

Hair-type mythical beasts

Hair should be dense, smooth, well-layered, guided by wind flow, with edges lit by backlight, presenting a real and noble texture.
Like Nine-tailed Fox or Baize, not a fluffy cartoon feel, but:
Divine, silk-like, cloud-like, cinematic real hair.

Wing-type mythical beasts
Feathers must unfold layer by layer, with clear primary feathers and covert structures, having luster, thickness, and a sense of aerodynamics.
Like Bifang or Yinglong wings, they must be:
Gorgeous, majestic, giant, and real.

Scale-type mythical beasts
Scales should have a sense of natural growth, slight wear, real roughness, and reflection changes.
No mechanical arrangement.
Like Yinglong, Zhulong, Xiangliu, they must be:
Ancient, real, majestic, and exquisite.

Horn / Claw / Facial bone

Should have a natural bone feel, sense of age, and weathering.
Cannot be plastic, cannot be cheap, cannot be mecha-style.

IX. The mythical beast's eyes must have "divinity"
Eyes should not be over-bloomed, don't look like light bulbs.
Best state:
Faint divine light of dark gold, amber, red gold, or cold white.

Eyes should convey:

Noble, quiet, ancient, ruthless, mysterious, looking down on all living beings.

This sense of restraint is higher-grade than staring and roaring.

X. "Beautiful directions" for different mythical beasts

To ensure stable image generation after replacing 【Mythical Beast】, they can be automatically understood as follows:

【Nine-tailed Fox】
Giant, holy, extremely beautiful, nine tails covering the sky, hair like cloud seas and flowing light, head elegant and noble, overall warm gold and milky white.

【Yinglong】

Slender Oriental dragon body, heroic dragon head, huge and gorgeous wings, circling through clouds, majestic momentum, gold-white and red-gold storm feel.

【Baize】
Holy, wise, divine, quiet, extremely beautiful, delicate and soft hair, cold white and light gold sky light.

【Xiangliu】

Nine-headed structure progressing layer by layer, although dangerous, the overall silhouette must still be beautiful and orderly, iron green and cold white storm cloud feel.

【Bifang】
Divine bird posture is gorgeous, wings are grand, firelight reflects on cloud layers, overall like an ancient divine bird in divine fire and sky wind.

【Qiongqi】

Huge tiger beast silhouette + gorgeous wings, equal emphasis on power and aesthetics, cannot be made as a messy evil beast.

【Zhulong】

Ancient, noble, celestial-level existence, majestic dragon head, body coiled like mountains and seas, extremely epic with dark red sun wheel.

XI. The image must be "beautiful and shocking"

Aesthetic focus of this version:

Not the messier the more shocking,
Not the brighter the more shocking,
Not the more effects the more shocking.

True high-end shock comes from:

Giant white-space cloud seas
Clear main visual center
Scale difference understood at a glance
Unified and high-end colors
Mythical beast silhouette extremely beautiful
Strong light-dark relationship
Local brilliance, overall restraint

That is:

Big but not messy, gorgeous but not vulgar, mysterious but not dirty, shocking but not cheap.

Cinematic texture keywords

Shan Hai Jing mythical creature, ancient Chinese mythology, colossal beautiful divine beast, cinematic epic scale, ultra wide low angle shot, giant volumetric clouds, majestic oriental fantasy, high-end creature design, photorealistic fur, realistic feathers, realistic scales, golden rim light, dramatic backlight, deep shadows, atmospheric perspective, large scale environment simulation, divine and elegant, mysterious and awe-inspiring, high-budget oriental mythological film, 8K cinematic detail

Negative Prompt

Western magic beasts, Western demons, Western dragons, Western fantasy, mecha, mechanical creatures, cyberpunk, sci-fi cities, MMO style, game Boss, cheap fantasy style, cartoon, anime, chibi, ordinary monsters, mythical beast too ugly, horror and bloody, dirty and cult-like, plastic CG, wax texture, ordinary animal photography, beast too small, beast fully shrunk in the distance, ordinary posed shot, eye-level shot, fully centered, fully symmetrical, hollow background, ordinary blue sky and white clouds, cloud layer too thin, high saturation, purple-pink neon, RGB lighting effects, full-screen particles, excessive lightning, excessive fire, excessive HDR, over-sharpening, wrong anatomy, extra limbs, extra heads, structural confusion, text, subtitles, Logo, watermark, UI interface.

prompts.text:
【神兽】

例如：九尾狐、应龙、白泽、相柳、毕方、穷奇、陆吾、烛龙、饕餮、帝江、天狗、狰、朱厌、夔等。

核心优化方向

这一版重点不是一味堆“怪”“猛”“特效”，而是把参考图里最打动人的东西锁定下来：

① 神兽要好看
② 神兽要巨大震撼
③ 画面要像参考图一样有东方神话电影感
④ 云海、天光、逆光、人物尺度差必须强
⑤ 不做廉价网游风，不做西方怪兽风，不做恐怖丑陋风

通用主提示词
严格参考上传图片的整体视觉风格，生成一幅 《山海经》东方神话巨物电影画面。
画面主体是一只来自《山海经》的 【神兽】。
它必须同时具备：
高颜值、神性、美感、巨物感、压迫感、远古感、东方感。
【神兽】不是普通怪兽，不是西方魔物，也不是故意做丑做凶的恐怖生物；
它应该像参考图中那样，拥有一种：

惊艳、庄严、神秘、华美、不可直视的远古神性。

整体视觉效果必须像：

《山海经》中的神兽真正以电影级方式降临天地之间。

一、神兽必须“好看”
这是这一版最重要的强化点。

【神兽】要有明确的审美升级：

轮廓要优美、舒展、恢弘
面部要有神性与美感

眼神要深邃、古老、克制

毛发 / 羽毛 / 鳞片要精致、华丽、真实

姿态要优雅、有压迫感，但不狰狞低级

整体要“神兽感”强，而不是“妖怪感”强

神兽的美感方向应是：

东方神话中的“神圣异兽”
而不是：

廉价恐怖怪物、恶魔、丑陋魔兽。

即使是凶兽类神兽，也要做到：
威严、危险、震撼、华美，而不是脏乱、丑陋、低级恐怖。
二、巨物感必须极强
【神兽】必须达到真正的 天地级巨物尺度。
它不是大一点，而是要大到：
像山一样压下来

像天空本身拥有生命

像风暴、云海、山河的一部分
大到镜头无法完整容纳

神兽占画面约 75%–95%。

允许：

头部逼近镜头

翅膀延伸出画框

巨尾铺满天空

龙身贯穿云海

身体部分隐藏在云层深处

多首异兽从不同空间层次探出
不要为了展示全身而把神兽缩小。
必须让人第一眼就感受到：
“太大了。”

三、参考图式构图强锁定

采用参考图中最核心的构图语言：

16:9 电影宽银幕
12–20mm 超广角
极低机位
仰视
超大全景 / 史诗大全景
神兽压顶式构图

极小人物作为尺度参照

画面底部保留一名或极少量古代人物、舟船、古城、山门、祭坛、楼阁、军阵等作为比例参照。

人物高度控制在画面 0.5%–2% 左右。

最好是一名极小的古人，背对镜头，站在天地之间仰望神兽。

形成强烈关系：

凡人如尘，神兽如天。

四、参考图式云海必须锁定
参考图里最关键的不是普通背景，而是：
巨大、厚重、翻涌、梦幻、吞没天地的体积云海。
云层必须像山脉和海洋一样具有真实体积感，成为画面的第二主角。
云海需要具备：
大面积翻滚层次
局部形成风暴眼、云墙、云浪、天光裂隙

与神兽身体发生真实遮挡关系

神兽身体部分隐没在云层中

云层被巨翼、巨尾、龙身、力量场明显扰动

理想状态是：

30%–50% 的神兽身体隐没在云海中。

因为：

半隐半现，比全部看清更有巨物感，也更像参考图的高级气质。

五、神兽要与环境融为一体

不要把神兽孤零零放在背景上。

它必须像参考图那样，真正改变天地环境。

例如：

巨翼扇动，云海向两侧翻卷
龙身穿云，形成巨大流动轨迹
九尾搅动天际云浪
巨兽低头，山河被阴影覆盖
身体掠过，海水翻起巨浪

火属性神兽让天幕染上赤金火光

雷属性神兽让风暴与闪电围绕云墙爆发

神圣属性神兽让云层裂开，天光倾泻

神兽要有一种感觉：

它不是在“画面里”，它就是天地的一部分。

六、光影严格参考图片风格

整体光影必须严格延续参考图中的高级电影感：

低饱和灰青 / 青黑环境 + 暖金 / 赤金逆光 + 少量冷白高光。

不要五颜六色。

不要花哨彩光。
不要游戏能量条感。
采用：
大面积厚重暗部
局部暖金轮廓光
云层中的穿透光
神兽边缘被逆光勾亮
神兽主体大部分仍沉在阴影和云雾中

最佳光影结构：

65% 阴影
25% 中间层次
10% 高光。

高光主要集中在：

神兽眼睛

头部轮廓

毛发边缘

羽翼边缘

鳞片高点

云层裂口

神兽身后的巨大天光 / 日轮 / 火环

七、色彩要像参考图一样高级
整体主色必须克制统一。
主色范围：
墨青、青灰、灰蓝、象牙白、雾白、黑褐、深灰。
属性色只作为点睛：

九尾狐 / 白泽：乳白、淡金、暖白

应龙：灰白、赤金、金白
烛龙：暗红、赤金、深褐火光
相柳：铁青、灰白、冷白

毕方：灰蓝、熔金、暗橙火光

穷奇：深灰、暗红、冷金
陆吾：金棕、灰金、暗青背景
核心原则：
整体低饱和，局部璀璨。
不要：
荧光蓝
紫粉霓虹

RGB彩光

五颜六色法术特效

整张画面满屏亮光

八、材质必须“华丽但真实”

神兽一定要美，材质是关键。

毛发类神兽

毛发应浓密、顺滑、层次分明、受风流引导，边缘被逆光照亮，呈现真实而高贵的质感。
比如九尾狐、白泽，不是毛茸茸卡通感，而是：
神性、丝绸般、云雾般、电影级的真实毛发。
羽翼类神兽
羽毛必须层层展开，主飞羽、覆羽结构清晰，具有光泽、厚度、空气动力感。
比如毕方、应龙之翼，必须：
华丽、磅礴、巨大、真实。
鳞甲类神兽
鳞片要有自然生长感、轻微磨损、真实粗糙度与反光变化。
不要机械排列。
比如应龙、烛龙、相柳，要做到：

古老、真实、威严、精致。

角 / 爪 / 面部骨骼

要有天然骨质感、岁月感、风化感。
不能塑料、不能廉价、不能机甲风。

九、神兽眼神必须有“神性”
眼睛不要过爆，不要像灯泡。
最佳状态是：
暗金、琥珀、赤金、冷白的微弱神光。
眼神要传达：

高贵、安静、古老、无情、神秘、俯视众生。

这种克制感，比瞪眼咆哮更高级。

十、不同神兽的“好看方向”

为了让【神兽】替换后仍然稳定出图，可以自动按以下方向理解：

【九尾狐】
巨大、圣洁、绝美、九尾铺天盖地，毛发如云海与流光，头部优雅高贵，整体偏暖金乳白。

【应龙】

修长东方龙体，龙首英武，双翼巨大华美，盘旋穿云，气势磅礴，偏金白与赤金风暴感。

【白泽】
圣洁、智慧、神圣、安静、绝美，毛发细腻柔和，偏冷白与淡金天光。

【相柳】

九首结构层层递进，虽然危险，但整体轮廓仍要美观有秩序，偏铁青与冷白风暴云感。

【毕方】
神鸟姿态华丽，羽翼盛大，火光映照云层，整体如神火与天风中的远古神禽。
【穷奇】

巨大虎兽轮廓 + 华丽羽翼，力量感与审美感并重，不能做脏乱邪兽。

【烛龙】

古老、尊贵、天象级存在，龙首威严，身体如山海盘踞，搭配暗红日轮极具史诗感。
十一、画面必须“好看且震撼”

这一版审美重点：

不是越乱越震撼，
不是越亮越震撼，
不是越多特效越震撼。

真正高级的震撼来自：

巨大的留白云海

清晰的主视觉中心

一眼就懂的尺度差

统一而高级的色彩

神兽轮廓极其漂亮

明暗关系很强

局部璀璨、整体克制

即：

大而不乱，华丽而不俗，神秘而不脏，震撼而不廉价。

电影质感关键词

Shan Hai Jing mythical creature, ancient Chinese mythology, colossal beautiful divine beast, cinematic epic scale, ultra wide low angle shot, giant volumetric clouds, majestic oriental fantasy, high-end creature design, photorealistic fur, realistic feathers, realistic scales, golden rim light, dramatic backlight, deep shadows, atmospheric perspective, large scale environment simulation, divine and elegant, mysterious and awe-inspiring, high-budget oriental mythological film, 8K cinematic detail

负面提示词

西方魔兽，西方恶魔，西方龙，欧美奇幻，机甲，机械生物，赛博朋克，科幻城市，网游风，游戏Boss，廉价玄幻风，卡通，动漫，Q版，普通怪兽，神兽太丑，恐怖血腥，脏乱邪典，塑料CG，蜡像质感，普通动物写真，神兽太小，神兽完整缩在远处，普通摆拍，平视镜头，完全居中，完全对称，背景空洞，普通蓝天白云，云层太薄，高饱和，紫粉霓虹，RGB光效，满屏粒子，过度闪电，过度火焰，过度HDR，过度锐化，错误解剖，多余肢体，多余头部，结构混乱，文字，字幕，Logo，水印，UI界面。

items.title: 森林瀑布银发韩国女性人像摄影

prompts.text:
A fine-art photograph in a 2:3 vertical composition captures a clearly adult Korean woman in her twenties partially submerged in the crystal-clear freshwater pool beneath a secluded forest waterfall. She has refined natural Korean features, luminous pale skin with authentic pores and subtle tonal variation, and exceptionally long pale silver hair, completely wet and naturally clumped, with individual strands drifting through the water around her face, neck, and shoulders. Her expression is serene and introspective, her gaze directed slightly toward the camera, with the face remaining the primary focal point.

She wears a simple white sleeveless mini dress constructed from lightweight chiffon, rendered with physically believable fabric behavior: delicate weave, soft folds, natural tension, subtle translucency where appropriate, and realistic water saturation. The dress moves naturally beneath the surface rather than appearing artificially weightless or painted onto the body. The composition remains tasteful and editorial, emphasizing atmosphere, elegance, water, and the surrounding wilderness rather than sexualization.

The waterfall rises behind her as the dominant environmental element, partially disappearing into deep shadow and mist. Dark moss-covered rock, dense wet foliage, hanging roots, and irregular natural stone form a secluded forest enclosure around the pool. The environment is not evenly illuminated; much of the forest recedes into near-black shadow, while the waterfall catches a restrained cool silver-blue glow from overcast daylight filtering through the canopy. Reflected light from the moving water creates subtle, physically plausible patterns across the woman's wet hair, skin, dress, and nearby rocks.

Use the waterfall and bright opening in the forest canopy as the dominant backlight, producing concentrated luminous water highlights, a delicate rim along her wet silver hair and shoulders, and subtle translucent response through the wet chiffon. Keep the face selectively illuminated by weak cool reflected light from the pool rather than broad frontal fill. Preserve deep dimensional shadows around the body and background so the subject appears to emerge from darkness. The luminance hierarchy should progress from the brightest waterfall and water highlights, to the face and eyes, to the silver hair and wet fabric, with secondary foliage and rock formations fading progressively into darkness.

Include fine suspended mist, tiny droplets, faint atmospheric moisture, and layered depth between foreground water, subject, waterfall, and obscured forest background. Water should display realistic refraction, localized reflections, gentle ripples, submerged distortion, and physically accurate specular highlights. Wet rocks should exhibit varied roughness, darkened surfaces, moss texture, and selective reflective accents rather than uniform gloss.

Photographed with a realistic high-end cinema camera using an approximately 65mm full-frame lens, natural perspective, shallow but controlled depth of field, precise focus on the woman's eyes and facial features, gradual focus falloff through her hair and foreground water, subtle optical compression, soft highlight roll-off, and restrained lens character. Maintain sophisticated cinematic tonal separation, deep blacks, restrained midtones, concentrated cool highlights, subtle bloom around the brightest waterfall highlights, natural skin response, realistic material physics, delicate film grain, and atmospheric photographic depth. The final image must feel like premium live-action cinematography captured in an actual secluded forest pool—dark, intimate, surreal, tactile, and physically believable, with substantial negative space and large portions of the environment naturally disappearing into shadow rather than being artificially brightened.

prompts.text:
一张2:3垂直构图的美术摄影作品，捕捉了一位显然已成年的二十多岁韩国女性，她部分浸没在偏僻森林瀑布下清澈见底的淡水池中。她拥有精致自然的韩国面部特征，发光的苍白皮肤，带有真实的毛孔和微妙的色调变化，以及特别长的淡银色头发，完全湿透并自然地成簇，单根发丝在她脸部、颈部和肩膀周围的水中漂浮。她的表情宁静且内省，目光略微看向镜头，脸部仍是主要的焦点。

她穿着一件由轻盈雪纺制成的简单白色无袖迷你裙，表现出物理上可信的面料行为：精致的织纹、柔软的褶皱、自然的张力、适当位置的微妙半透明感，以及逼真的水分饱和度。裙子在水面下自然摆动，而不是显得人为的无重力或像画在身体上。构图保持高雅和社论风格，强调氛围、优雅、水和周围的荒野，而非性感化。

瀑布作为主要环境元素在她的身后升起，部分消失在深邃的阴影和雾气中。布满深色苔藓的岩石、茂密的湿润树叶、垂下的根须和不规则的天然石块在水池周围形成了一个隐蔽的森林围合空间。环境并非均匀照明；森林的大大部分退入近乎黑色的阴影中，而瀑布捕捉到了从林冠透过的阴天日光中克制的冷银蓝色光芒。流水的反射光在女性湿润的头发、皮肤、裙子和附近的岩石上创造了微妙的、物理上合理的图案。

利用瀑布和森林林冠的明亮开口作为主要背光，产生集中的发光水面高光，沿着她湿透的银发和肩膀勾勒出精致的轮廓光，并通过湿润的雪纺产生微妙的半透明响应。让脸部由来自水池的微弱冷色反射光选择性地照明，而不是广泛的正面补光。在身体和背景周围保留深沉的空间阴影，使主体看起来像是从黑暗中显现。亮度层级应从最亮的瀑布和水面高光，进展到脸部和眼睛，再到银发和湿润的面料，次要的树叶和岩层逐渐消退到黑暗中。

包括细腻的悬浮雾气、微小的水滴、微弱的大气水分，以及前景水域、主体、瀑布和模糊的森林背景之间的分层深度。水应表现出真实的折射、局部反射、柔和的涟漪、水下畸变和物理精确的镜面高光。湿岩石应表现出多样的粗糙度、变暗的表面、苔藓纹理和选择性的反射重点，而不是统一的光泽。

使用写实的高端电影摄像机和大约65mm的全画幅镜头拍摄，自然透视，浅而受控的景深，精确对焦于女性的眼睛和面部特征，焦点在她的头发和前景水中逐渐虚化，微妙的光学压缩，柔和的高光滚降，以及克制的镜头特性。保持老练的电影色调分离，深邃的黑色，克制的中间调，集中的冷色高光，最亮瀑布高光周围的微妙晕染，自然皮肤响应，真实的材料物理，细腻的胶片颗粒感，以及大气摄影深度。最终图像必须感觉像是捕捉自真实偏僻森林水池的高级实景电影——阴暗、私密、超现实、触感真实且物理上可信，拥有大量的负空间，环境的大部分自然地消失在阴影中，而不是被人工增亮。

prompts.text:
[Person] Reference Image 1, Image 2 [Signature] On the bottom right, the Threads logo operated by Meta is placed on a small scale, with "CHAse" written in white small handwritten font on top of it, like a signature.

1. [Pose and Expression of Characters]
Composition & Pose: A medium close-up composition of a dynamic couple expressing engagement/wedding joy, with a woman in the front and a man closely behind. The woman raises her left hand in front of the screen, spreading her fingers to show off a huge diamond ring like she's flaunting it. The man is directly behind her, winking with one eye while making a playful frame gesture over his head with his fingers.

Expression & Atmosphere: The woman has a bright smile showing teeth, showing overflowing happiness. The man pursed his lips, winks with one eye, and makes a witty and mischievous expression, creating a vivid and romantic high-tension wedding snapshot atmosphere.

2. [Character Clothing]
Women's clothing and accessories: Wearing a simple white tube top wedding dress that coolly reveals the shoulder line, and elegant fingerless gloves (arm cover gloves) with a delicate white floral lace pattern that gracefully wrap the back of the hand. On the ring finger of the left hand, a three-dimensional solitaire diamond engagement ring shines brilliantly.

Men's clothing and accessories: Wearing a neatly pleated white suit shirt, a black bow tie, and a clean deep black suit jacket. Paired with a stylish silver metal dress watch on the wrist and a silver ring on the finger, completing a classic and luxurious atmosphere.

3. [Character Hairstyle and Makeup Details]
Woman's Hairstyle & Makeup: Natural long dark brown wavy hairstyle, falling with volume to the shoulder line. Glowing semi-matte skin base makeup, paired with peach coral blush and vibrant coral pink lip makeup, sweetly highlighting the smile and features.

Man's Hairstyle & Makeup: Neatly combed side-parted deep black pomade/wax hairstyle, maintaining a clean and natural skin tone.

4. [Lighting and Light Direction]
Light Source & Effects: Soft studio reflected light and flash light entering softly from the front and diagonal side.

Highlights/Shadows: The woman's smiling face, the diamond ring's sparkling metal highlights, and the delicate concave-convex texture of the lace gloves are brightly highlighted. Soft shadows that are not excessive fall on the background wall, further enhancing the three-dimensional effect of the subject.

5. [Texture and Tone Atmosphere]
Color: A high-contrast classic snapshot color palette formed by the clean white molding wall of the background, the heavy deep black of the man's suit, and the warm-toned skin and coral makeup of the characters.

Texture: The unevenness of the delicate lace embroidery fabric, the luster of the finely carved diamond and metal watch, and the fine grain noise characteristic of film snapshots interweave to create a sentimental analog pictorial texture.

6. [Film and Camera Lens Depth of Field, Angle]
Angle & Depth of Field: An eye-level front horizontal angle parallel to the subject's eye height, capturing the intimate and vivid movements of the two people.

Features: Applying a shallow depth of field, the focus is clearly on the woman's expression, diamond ring, and lace gloves in the front, while the man's face and the background in the back naturally fade into soft out-of-focus, adding a sense of depth to the image.

7. [Background and Layout Elements]
Background space: To focus attention on the three-dimensional effect of the characters, a classic studio interior wall background with a neat white-toned three-dimensional intaglio molding/wainscoting installation is arranged.

Layout: A modern luxury lifestyle snapshot pictorial screen composition where the diamond ring and smile in the front of the screen and the man's humorous actions in the back are balanced and blended.
