items.title: ROLLSTATE品牌城市时尚滑冰海报

prompts.text:
Create a flagship urban poster for an original roller-skate brand named "ROLLSTATE". Use an ultra-realistic editorial fashion-sports photography style fused with bold typographic poster design. Preserve the exact core structure: a tall vertical poster, a dramatic worm's-eye street-level camera angle, one oversized white quad roller skate exploding toward the lens in the lower foreground, one athletic young woman skating directly above the viewer in a powerful forward-driving pose, tall modern city towers flanking the composition, gigantic condensed English typography integrated behind the subject, and one refined bottom information band with minimal editorial text. The final image must feel like a Cannes-level street-fashion campaign: iconic, kinetic, youthful, architectural, and instantly memorable.

Style lock:
Luxury sports-fashion editorial, ultra-real urban lifestyle photography, premium footwear campaign, clean white poster field, bold typography-led composition, modern city energy, minimalist information design, product-first hierarchy.

Core composition:
Use an extreme low-angle perspective from the road surface. The nearest roller skate must dominate the lower-center foreground with aggressive scale and foreshortening, making the boot, sole, trucks, and wheels the first visual read. The skater must tower above the viewer with one leg thrust forward and one leg supporting balance behind, creating a sharp triangular product-led composition. Frame cool-toned city buildings at the far left and right edges to emphasize vertical lift and speed. Place giant condensed uppercase headline typography behind the skater in two stacked lines, filling most of the poster height without hiding the skate silhouette.

Port super-symbol logic:
Turn the near-lens skate and wheel cluster into the brand’s unmistakable super-symbol. The combination of one oversized white boot, one heavy forward sole, and one enlarged quad-wheel assembly must feel ownable and instantly recognizable even at thumbnail scale. The shoe is not just a product in motion; it is the entire identity mark of the brand. The viewer should remember the campaign by this single visual code: one giant skate crashing into space.

Orbit motion logic:
Build one continuous visual loop. The eye should begin at the giant headline, travel through the skater’s face and hair flow, sweep down the extended arm, dive into the thrust-forward leg, lock onto the oversized skate and wheel hardware, then ride the street perspective and building lines back upward into the typography again. Use hair direction, arm angle, leg thrust, wheel alignment, skyline perspective, and letterform geometry to create a premium circular motion path that keeps pulling attention back to the skate.

Hero product design:
Design one unforgettable white leather quad roller skate with a sculpted high-ankle boot, premium matte leather upper, crisp seam lines, clean white laces, padded collar, polished metal plate, off-white wheels, precise axles and trucks, and a subtle caramel-toned outsole edge. The skate must feel expensive, collectible, and high-performance. The product must read first, before the model.

Model direction:
Use one athletic adult woman with natural anatomy, realistic head-neck-shoulder proportion, slim but strong legs, authentic lower-body volume, smooth hip-to-thigh transitions, subtle natural skin texture, and powerful elegant motion. Straight dark hair moving lightly backward in the wind. Expression calm, confident, and slightly defiant. Hands must be anatomically correct with five natural fingers, clear knuckle logic, no deformation. Outfit: minimal white ribbed sleeveless top, dark structured sport skirt, white ribbed socks. Styling should feel fashion-forward and premium.

Lighting:
Use bright natural daylight with soft urban diffusion and subtle top-front sun direction. Keep the skate brightly modeled with crisp highlights on leather and hardware, soft realistic shadows under the wheels, and clean daylight on the model’s legs and face. Buildings should hold cool reflections and atmospheric depth without stealing focus. Maintain physically coherent outdoor lighting.

Materials and realism:
Render the skate with hyper-real product detail: fine leather grain, lace tension, precise metal hardware reflections, wheel rubber texture, axle engineering, and believable street contact. Render skin with natural pores, soft sheen, and no plastic retouching. Render the city with real glass reflections, concrete texture, and clean architectural depth. The poster field should feel like premium matte print stock with immaculate cleanliness.

Color strategy:
Dominant palette: warm ivory white, cool sky blue, soft concrete gray, glass teal reflections, charcoal black, and natural skin tones. Keep the roller skate the brightest and most visually dominant element. The overall mood should feel crisp, metropolitan, fresh, and charged with movement.

Typography and layout:
Use original English typography only. Create one huge two-line condensed headline behind the skater, such as:
"ROLL
STATE"
or another original equivalent with strong vertical geometry. Add one refined bottom information system with a small left editorial label, one centered year such as "2027", and one short right-side campaign phrase. Include one thin horizontal rule above the bottom text band. All wording must be original, minimal, and globally marketable. Do not copy any existing title, slogan, or layout text.

Quality target:
Hyper-detailed, high-resolution fashion print finish, premium product sharpness, accurate anatomy, realistic city perspective, crisp typography integration, strong symbolic readability, clean negative space, no muddy shadows, no visual noise.

Negative prompt:
copied slogan, copied title, weak skate visibility, distorted roller skate, broken wheel geometry, warped perspective, deformed hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, twisted limbs, unrealistic legs, plastic skin, cheap streetwear styling, cluttered typography, muddy buildings, low-resolution wheels, fake city background, poster dirt, black blotches, overexposed sky, messy composition

prompts.text:
为名为“ROLLSTATE”的原创轮滑鞋品牌创作一张旗舰级城市海报。采用超写实的社论时尚运动摄影风格，并融合大胆的排版海报设计。保留精确的核心结构：一张高比例的垂直海报，戏剧性的街头虫瞻视角，一只巨大的白色四轮滑冰鞋在下层前景中向镜头爆发，一名运动型年轻女性以强有力的向前推进姿态在观察者正上方滑行，高大的现代城市塔楼侧立于构图两旁，巨大的压缩英文排版整合在主体之后，以及一个带有极简社论文本的精细底部信息条。最终图像必须感觉像戛纳级别的街头时尚竞选活动：标志性的、动感的、青春的、建筑化的且瞬间令人难忘。

风格锁定：
奢侈运动时尚社论，超写实城市生活方式摄影，高端鞋履竞选活动，洁白的海报底色，大胆排版主导的构图，现代城市活力，极简信息设计，产品优先的层级。

核心构图：
使用路面的极端低角度透视。最近的旱冰鞋必须以极具攻击性的比例和透视缩短效果占据下中心前景，使靴子、鞋底、支架和轮子成为第一视觉读物。滑冰者必须耸立在观察者上方，一条腿向前冲，另一腿在后支撑平衡，形成一个尖锐的以产品为导向的三角形构图。在远处的左右边缘框住冷色调的城市建筑，以强调垂直升力和速度。在滑冰者后面放置巨大的两行堆叠的压缩大写标题排版，填满海报的大部分高度而不遮挡滑冰鞋的轮廓。

超级符号逻辑：
将靠近镜头的滑冰鞋和轮子集群转化为品牌独一无二的超级符号。一个巨大的白色靴子、一个厚重的前鞋底和一个放大的四轮组件的结合，必须让人感到独特且即便在缩略图比例下也能立即识别。鞋子不仅仅是运动中的产品；它是品牌的整个身份标志。观众应该通过这个单一的视觉代码记住这次活动：一只巨大的滑冰鞋冲入空间。

轨道运动逻辑：
构建一个连续的视觉回路。视线应从巨大的标题开始，穿过滑冰者的脸部和发流，顺着伸展的手臂扫下，俯冲进向前冲的腿，锁定在巨大的滑冰鞋和轮子硬件上，然后顺着街道透视和建筑线条再次向上回到排版中。利用头发方向、手臂角度、腿部推力、轮子对齐、天际线透视和字形几何形状，创造出一条高端的圆形运动路径，不断将注意力拉回到滑冰鞋上。

英雄产品设计：
设计一只令人难忘的白色皮革四轮旱冰鞋，具有雕塑感的高踝靴、优质磨砂皮鞋面、清晰的缝线、干净的白色鞋带、带垫鞋领、抛光金属底板、乳白色轮子、精密的轮轴和支架，以及微妙的焦糖色外底边缘。滑冰鞋必须感觉昂贵、具有收藏价值且高性能。产品必须先于模特被读取。

模特指导：
使用一名运动型成年女性，具有自然的解剖结构，写实的头颈肩比例，修长但强壮的双腿，真实的下半身体量，平滑的臀腿过渡，微妙的自然皮肤纹理，以及有力优雅的动作。深色直发在风中轻轻向后摆动。表情沉着、自信且略带挑衅。手部必须解剖结构正确，有五个自然的手指，清晰的指节逻辑，无变形。服装：极简白色罗纹无袖上衣，深色结构化运动短裙，白色罗纹袜。造型应感觉走在时尚前沿且高端。

光影：
使用带有柔和城市扩散和微妙顶前阳光方向的明亮自然日光。保持滑冰鞋明亮的建模感，皮革和硬件上有清晰的高光，轮子下方有柔和真实的阴影，模特腿部和面部有洁净的日光。建筑物应保持冷色反射和大气深度，而不夺走焦点。保持物理上协调的户外光照。

材质与写实度：
以超写实的产品细节渲染滑冰鞋：细腻的皮革纹理、鞋带张力、精确的金属硬件反射、轮子橡胶质感、轴承工程以及可信的街道接触。渲染皮肤时带有自然毛孔、柔和光泽，且无塑料感修饰。渲染城市时带有真实的玻璃反射、混凝土纹理和洁净的建筑深度。海报底色应感觉像高级哑光印刷纸张，极其干净。

色彩策略：
主导调色板：暖象牙白、冷天蓝色、柔和的混凝土灰色、玻璃青色反射、炭黑色和自然肤色。保持滑冰鞋为最亮且在视觉上最占主导地位的元素。整体色调应感觉清新、都市、新鲜且充满动感。

排版与布局：
仅使用原创英文排版。在滑冰者后面创建一个巨大的两行压缩标题，例如：
“ROLL
STATE”
或另一个具有强垂直几何感的原创等效项。添加一个精细的底部信息系统，带有左侧的小社论标签，一个居中的年份如“2027”，以及一个简短的右侧竞选短语。在底部文本带上方包含一条细水平线。所有措辞必须是原创的、极简的且具有全球市场吸引力。不要复制任何现有的标题、标语或布局文本。

质量目标：
超高细节，高分辨率时尚印刷饰面，高端产品锐度，准确的解剖结构，写实的城市透视，清晰的排版整合，强大的符号可读性，干净的负空间，无模糊阴影，无视觉噪点。

负面提示：
抄袭的标语，抄袭的标题，滑冰鞋可见度低，畸形的旱冰鞋，破碎的轮子几何结构，扭曲的透视，变形的手，多余的手指，缺少手指，融合的手指，扭曲的肢体，不真实的腿，塑料皮肤，廉价的街头服饰造型，凌乱的排版，模糊的建筑，低分辨率的轮子，虚假的城市背景，海报污垢，黑斑，曝光过度的天空，混乱的构图。

items.title: 旅行照片转羊毛毡编织记忆微缩海报

prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的高级旅行转绘海报，每张照片单独输出，不得将多张不同照片拼接在同一画面中。

整体采用3:4竖版构图。上半部分为清楚可见的真实原始照片，下半部分为同一场景的“羊毛毡编织记忆微缩”。两个区域高度接近1:1，使用清晰、水平、克制的边界分隔。

上半部分忠实保留原照片。准确保持主体身份与数量、人物或动物姿态、建筑结构、地形、核心物体、观察角度、相对位置、真实材质、自然光影和原有色彩氛围。仅进行轻微高级旅行杂志和展览摄影调色，并加入极薄胶片颗粒。不得将照片重绘、拉伸、镜像、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分从同一张照片中提取最具识别度的主体、轮廓、动作、地形结构和叙事关系，把场景制作成一件陈列在温暖米白毛毡纸上的立体纤维艺术微缩景观。

它不是平面布贴，也不是给照片覆盖毛线纹理。必须依据真实纤维工艺重新组织场景，结合：

needle-felted wool、wool roving、bouclé yarn、crochet loops、embroidery thread、soft twisted fibers、small woven structures、loose wool fibers。

根据照片内容进行材料转换：

- 云雾使用蓬松、边缘松散的白色羊毛条；
- 山体使用不同密度和方向的针毡羊毛层；
- 植被使用圈圈纱、钩针结、短绒线团和零散线头；
- 水面使用横向铺开的蓝绿纱线、刺绣线和弯曲反光线；
- 建筑使用紧密针毡体块、微型编织墙面和刺绣纹样；
- 道路、岸线与地形边界使用缝线、绳线或较低绒高结构；
- 人物、动物、船只和车辆变成保持原姿态、方向、数量与主色的微型纤维模型。

不得机械复刻照片的全部背景。主动删除重复建筑、密集植被、细小石块和无关杂物，将场景压缩为一个主要微缩景观。改变主体尺度和空间组织，使作品像被安放在纸面上的小型建筑沙盘、纤维标本或收藏级手工记忆模型。

必须清楚表现蓬松羊毛、大小不一的线圈、针毡颗粒、纱线捻度、刺绣针脚、轻微脱线、线头、编织密度变化、真实实体厚度和柔和接触阴影。主体边缘可以松散、有绒毛，但身份轮廓必须一眼可辨。

配色从原始照片中提取并柔化为自然羊毛色。保留原照片最重要的冷暖关系与标志性色彩，降低杂色和高饱和度，通过不同纤维色阶、线圈密度和绒高区分结构。

微缩景观与文字之外至少保留约35%的连续米白毛毡空场。空场必须完整、安静，能够衬托微缩模型的实体感，不能用大量零散毛线、装饰图标或无关工艺物件填满。

在毛毡空场中加入三层准确、可读的英文文字：

1. 根据真实地点、主体或动作提炼一个1–3个英文单词的主标题；
2. 加入“WEAVE NO. 01”形式的小型编号；
3. 加入一行5–12个英文单词的观察句，描述照片中真实可见的颜色、动作、建筑、天气或空间关系。

主标题使用连续毛线摆放或手工刺绣形成，具有真实纱线厚度、针脚和轻微松动感。编号与观察句放在小型织标、粗布标签或刺绣边注上，必须清楚可读。不得叠加光滑数字字体，不得生成作者名、Logo、网址、二维码、虚构年份或乱码。

整体气质温暖、安静、细腻、触觉化、具有收藏感，像把一次旅行认真缝成了一件可以捧在手里的记忆标本。

Avoid: missing source-photo comparison, flat felt appliqué, fabric stickers, flat paper cutout, knitted blanket covering the whole image, plastic toy, clay, resin, glossy CGI, smooth 3D rendering, generic craft template, cartoon proportions, invented landmarks, altered subject count, excessive decoration, tiny unreadable text, floating digital typography, fake logo, watermark.

prompts.text:
[Subject Description]

Adult East Asian woman in an elegant Chinese xianxia-inspired fantasy costume, slender feminine figure, long pale legs, fair porcelain skin, delicate refined facial features, light-colored eyes, and long flowing silver-white hair. Her hair is styled with ornate gold hair ornaments, a small crown-like headpiece, flowing translucent blue-white ribbons, and decorative dangling chains. She wears an elaborate layered white and icy-blue fantasy dress with translucent chiffon-like fabric, flowing sleeves, gold trim, and sculptural translucent blue accents. The outfit has a graceful, ethereal silhouette with long trailing fabric and blue ribbon-like extensions. She wears pale beige high-heeled sandals with multiple thin straps and small metallic studs. She is seated/reclining on the floor, leaning slightly backward while extending both legs toward the camera, one hand raised gracefully as if controlling magical energy, smiling softly and looking toward the camera.

She possesses the best head-to-body ratio, a perfect, curvaceous, S-shaped female figure, long legs with perfect leg lines, and a slender waist, perfect foots,perfect foot lines

[Scene/Background]

Traditional Chinese-style interior with dark wooden architectural elements, large windows, hanging Chinese calligraphy scrolls, monochrome shanshui landscape paintings, and a large ink-wash artwork. A potted yellow orchid stands on the right side. The floor is covered by a muted blue carpet decorated with delicate embroidered lotus flowers and leaves. Loose calligraphy paper and scrolls are scattered near the background. Wispy translucent white smoke or magical mist curls through the room around the woman.

[Lighting/Ambience]

Soft diffused daylight entering through the windows, mixed with subtle cool ambient illumination. Gentle highlights on the woman's pale skin, silver-white hair, translucent costume fabrics, and metallic ornaments. Atmospheric volumetric light, delicate haze, soft shadows, cool blue-white color palette with restrained warm gold accents. Dreamlike, mystical, elegant, serene xianxia atmosphere.

[Composition/Angle]

Low-angle floor-level perspective, dramatic close foreground emphasis on the woman's extended legs and high heels. Dynamic wide-angle perspective with noticeable but controlled foreshortening. Full-body composition, woman positioned near the center, body receding toward the upper-left portion of the frame. The flowing dress, ribbons, smoke, and background scrolls create strong diagonal movement. Moderate depth of field, sharp focus on the woman with naturally softer background details.

[Style Reference]

prompts.text: Create a highly realistic 3:4 vertical direct-flash portrait inside a dim late-night café or bakery. The subject is a clearly adult young woman with a slim, elongated upper-body silhouette, framed in a medium close-up to half-body crop from the head to around the waist. She has extremely long, straight honey-golden brown hair with slightly darker roots, a natural center part, substantial face-framing sections falling along the cheekbones and jaw, and the rest of the hair draping naturally over and behind her shoulders. Keep the hair smooth but unmistakably real, with minor flyaways, irregular strands, subtle messy ends and gentle golden-brown flash reflections rather than wig-like perfection.  Preserve the reference facial structure and proportions closely: face shape, eye spacing and shape, nose proportions, jawline and lip shape. Do not replace the face with a generic influencer template or overly slim the jaw. Use a lifestyle-oriented East Asian pop-idol / K-beauty soft-glam makeup direction: a thin luminous complexion base, softly defined light-brown brows, beige-pink-brown eyeshadow, fine black upper eyeliner extended slightly beyond the outer corners, separated long lashes and minimal lower-eye makeup. Her lips are naturally slightly parted and covered with glossy, wet-looking pink-nude lip color. She looks almost directly into the lens with a calm, soft, slightly detached expression, as though her attention has only just left the music. No smile.  Place oversized metallic silver-gray over-ear headphones on her head, with thick white ear cushions and a pale inner headband. Their large rounded oval earcups and metallic reflections should be visually prominent. This is not a mirror selfie and no phone should appear. Preserve the reference left-right arrangement instead of horizontally flipping it: the raised hand on the left side of the frame rests against the earcup on that same side, while the other hand holds a simple white takeaway coffee cup with a white lid lower in front of the torso.  She wears a fitted light heather-gray spaghetti-strap camisole with very thin straps and a faint silvery edge near the neckline. Over it is a visibly oversized powder-blue / pale cornflower-blue shirt-like lightweight jacket with long sleeves, loose accumulated folds and a small white embroidered letter-style emblem on one sleeve. The blue outer layer has slipped naturally off both shoulders, exposing the camisole straps, shoulders, collarbones and upper chest. Keep the fabric randomly wrinkled, slouchy and asymmetrical rather than perfectly arranged.  Visible skin includes the face, ear area, neck, collarbones, shoulders, upper chest, a small amount of upper-arm skin near the armhole, and both hands. Use a light neutral-warm beige skin tone that becomes slightly brighter beneath the flash while retaining subtle warmth. The skin should appear fine, soft and lightly moisturized—as though it would feel warm, supple and naturally smooth to the touch—while still retaining extremely subtle pores and real micro-texture. Do not use porcelain, waxy or completely airbrushed skin. The lips can appear considerably wetter and smoother than the skin.  Lighting is one of the most important identity features: use a strong, direct frontal flash positioned close to the camera axis, neutral to slightly cool white, fired from short range. Let it produce small specular highlights across the forehead, nose bridge, nose tip, cheeks, chin, collarbones and shoulder peaks, with additional sharp reflections on the metallic headphones and white cup lid. Permit slight highlight clipping in a few bright areas. Create short, physically believable shadows around the neck and shoulder transitions. The café itself should remain several stops darker with only a trace of weak warm ambient illumination. Do not add professional rim lighting, softboxes, side fill, beauty-dish lighting or elegant three-point illumination.  The camera should feel like a compact digital camera, point-and-shoot or casual phone photograph taken with a direct flash rather than a fashion-studio image. Use the perspective of roughly a 28–35mm full-frame-equivalent lens from close range. Keep the viewpoint almost at eye level but very slightly lower than the eyes. Position the subject a little left of center instead of using perfect symmetry, with extra dark environmental space on the right. Leave only a small amount of headroom.  Use moderate depth of field. The face, front hair, headphones, hands and cup should remain clearly readable, while the background becomes softer and much darker but is still recognizable. Do not create extreme creamy bokeh. Preserve genuine digital-camera texture: subtle shadow noise, mild JPEG softness, a touch of flash highlight overexposure, stray hairs, minor compression, uneven background detail, imperfect crop and small compositional offsets. Avoid hyper-sharp commercial retouching.  Behind her is a functioning late-night café, bakery or casual food-and-drink space rather than a photography set. Include a large dark glass window or glass partition with loose white handwritten bakery phrases scribbled across it; the writing only needs to look convincingly handwritten and does not need to be perfectly readable. Add dim, blurred seated patrons farther behind and toward the right, dark furniture, small interior reflections, a pale chair edge near the lower-right area and shadowy ceiling structures above. The environment should feel slightly cluttered, occupied and unstaged.  The finished image should feel as though a friend suddenly raised a camera while she was listening to music and holding a warm drink. She had been absorbed in the headphones a moment ago; right now her fingers are still resting against the earcup as she glances into the unexpected flash, and a second later she seems ready to look away again. Preserve that emotional residue. Aim for a post-Y2K social-media direct-flash snapshot, K-beauty soft glam and casual off-duty styling rather than a polished advertisement. The woman tilts her head to the right side of the screen, looking at the camera with a calm expression and slightly parted lips. Oval face with rounded cheeks, small chin, horizontally long eyes, thin eyebrows, short bridge of the nose, and a rosy lower lip. Dark brown chin-length bob hair with thin forehead bangs and hair strands by the cheeks, with the ends slightly flipped outwards. Fine lines around the eyes, skin is warm and lustrous.

A white thin-strap ribbed camisole top and light gray drawstring shorts. The hem of the shorts is heavily frayed. Her left hand is placed on the sofa seat, her right elbow rests on the backrest, her right hand lightly touches her hair, and she sits with her legs spread wide to the left and right.

Background・Lighting:
On the right side of the foreground are two beer mugs with abundant foam and a green bottle. The background is a large window filled with the neon lights of a night market. At the top of the frame are a black T-shirt, a denim jacket, and striped clothing. A warm light source on the right side of the screen softly illuminates the character, rendering the outside of the window into a cyan and red blurred halo.

Composition・Lens:
2:3 vertical composition, shot from an angle near a low table, capturing from the head to below the knees. The character is centered and occupies a large proportion, while the beer mugs in the lower right foreground are heavily blurred, with focus on the character.

Texture・Style:
A dim interior, worn velvet, bubbles on glass, depicting the neon in a grainy realistic photo style. Brown, black, and cyan-red night colors.

Negative Prompt:
Do not omit the large beer mugs in the foreground; do not bring the legs together.

prompts.text:
Subject:
One fictional adult Japanese female sitting on a rattan chair on a city balcony, upper body and neck slightly tilted, smiling at the camera. Location, Time, Background:

Black metal railings, light beige buildings, mid-rise residences with windows lined up, and part of a blue building placed in the distant view. To the right rear of the woman is a potted plant with thin trunks and small leaves, with dark green leaves densely arranged at the bottom of the frame, showing a living environment where the city and greenery coexist.

Clothing, Small Items:
Light grey-beige sleeveless ribbed knit top. The V-neck is not deep, featuring small same-colored buttons at the front center, vertical fine ribbing, maintaining a simple shape that fits the body. Bottoms are a brown high-waisted style with suppressed red tones, showing a thick belt and buttons. Wearing an ultra-fine gold necklace around the neck, with only small metal studs at the ears.

Pose, Fingers, Contact:
Sitting shallowly on the rattan chair, waist slightly slanted to one side, shoulders gathered forward, upper body close to the camera. Head tilted toward the female's right shoulder, long hair falling naturally to the opposite side. Visible forearms naturally hanging down from the knees toward the table, hands placed near the outside of the frame. The connections of shoulders, elbows, and waist, and the position where weight falls on the chair surface should be natural.

Expression, Gaze:
Looking directly at the camera with brown pupils, corners of the mouth turned up to form a small bright smile. Relaxing tension between eyebrows and cheeks, expressing the friendliness of welcoming someone on a holiday terrace. Depending on the head's tilt, do not force the left and right pupils to stay at the same height, maintaining a natural gaze within the angle of the whole face.

Face, Makeup:
Small oval contour, thin chin, natural brown eyebrows, large brown eyes, thin bridge of the nose, pale coral pink lips. Eyeliner and eyelashes elegantly refined, applying a thin pink flush on the cheeks. Maintaining transparent skin suitable for outdoor light, adding faint highlights on the forehead, nose, and cheekbones. Not exaggerating face shape to appear juvenile.

Hair:
Long straight hair from light brown below the chest deepening to dark brown. Thin bangs naturally parted on the forehead, flowing most hair in the direction of the head tilt. Hair ends overlapping with branches and leaves maintain subtle light and dark to not blur the contour, with a few strands slightly scattered by the wind. Avoid adding uniform curls or strong gloss, maintaining a soft straight hair texture.

Light Source:
Broad natural light from above the front through layers of clouds wraps around, uniformly illuminating the face, shoulders, arms, and knitwear. Using the white sky and light-colored buildings as large reflective surfaces, softening shadows under the eyes and chin. Subtle shadows of branches and leaves remain in the background, but do not let mottled strong shadows fall on the face. Placing a small catchlight reflecting the bright sky in the pupils.

Colors, Tones:
Using grey-beige, brown, and warm skin tones as the gentle base on the figure side, tightened with background green leaves of varying shades, black railings, and light-colored buildings. Maintaining low contrast like a cloudy day, while creating a brightness difference so the face and hair are not buried in the background. Do not over-adjust the green to fluorescent colors, adjust to a natural saturation that blends into the residential area.

Materials, Fine Textures:
Distinguishing the fine vertical lines of the ribbed knit, the edges of the front buttons, the smooth weave of the brown fabric, the fine necklace, the weaving of the rattan chair, the cloth of the cushion, the coating of the metal railings, the thickness of leaves and depiction of fine branches. Retaining hair bundles and single strands, the soft luster of skin, shallow wrinkles generated by clothing fitting the waist, background building windows only to the extent of identifying shapes.

Composition, Lens:
Vertical 9:16 sitting portrait. Placing the center of the face at approximately 50% of the frame width and 25% from the top, aligning the visual center of the figure with approximately 50% horizontally. Blank space above the head is about 7%, accommodating from shoulders to waist within about 70% of the frame height, with the rattan chair back and table edge remaining at the bottom. Shot with a standard focal length from approximately the same height as the gaze, placing the female in the center, greenery at the right rear, and city buildings at the left rear.

Image Processing, Finish:
Bright live-action style suitable for urban life, residences, cafes, and natural fashion advertisements. Placing resolution on the face, hair, knitwear, and necklace, with distant buildings slightly softened. Green leaves retain detail to the extent of conveying the location, avoiding a synthetic feel of only person cutout. Skin-beautifying treatment is moderate, retaining the gentle air of a cloudy day.

Deformity Avoidance, Prohibitions:
Fixed as the same long brown-haired female, beige buttoned ribbed top, brown bottoms, sitting pose with tilted neck, rattan chair, black railings, and potted plants. Do not add other people, minors, multiple figures, added sleeves, other colored clothing, hats, bags, drinks, text, logos, or watermarks. Do not break the sense of perspective of eyes, neck, shoulders, arms, buttons, chairs, branches, leaves, and buildings.

浅浅坐在藤椅上，腰部微微斜向一侧，双肩向前靠拢，上身靠近镜头。头部向女性右肩侧倾斜，长发向对侧自然垂落。可见的前臂从膝盖向桌子方向自然下垂，手置于画面外附近。肩、肘、腰的连接，以及体重落在椅面上的位置要自然。

及胸以下的浅棕色渐深至深棕色的长直发。薄前刘海自然分开在额头，向头部倾斜的方向流动大部分头发。与枝叶重叠的发梢保持细微明暗以不模糊轮廓，用风微微吹散几束发丝。避免添加均匀卷曲或强烈光泽，保持柔和的直发质感。

材质・细微质感：
罗纹针织的细纵纹、前纽扣的边缘、棕色面料的光滑织纹、细项链、藤椅的编织、靠垫的布料、金属扶手的涂装、叶子厚度和细枝的描绘区分。保留头发束和单根发丝、肌肤柔和的光泽、衣服贴合腰部产生的浅皱，背景建筑物的窗户仅辨识形状程度。

prompts.text:
A young Korean woman in her twenties stands half-submerged at the edge of a secluded forest waterfall, her pale silver hair falling in soft, damp strands around her face and shoulders. She wears a white sleeveless mini dress of thin chiffon, the hem floating just above the waterline while the lower layers darken with wetness and billow in translucent folds downstream. Her skin is fair and luminous, lit by a soft, diffused key filtering through the canopy from the upper left, with delicate specular highlights along her damp jawline, collarbones, and shoulders. Her expression is unhurried and inward, with relaxed brows, slightly parted lips, and half-lidded eyes drifting off to the side rather than meeting the viewer.

Her pose is shaped by direct contact with the environment. She leans her back against a moss-covered boulder at the waterfall's edge, her shoulders pressed gently into the stone and her head tilted back so the spray catches along her jaw and throat. One arm rests along the rock beside her, her palm flat on the wet surface and fingertips trailing into the rushing water at the seam where stone meets current. Her other hand lightly gathers a fistful of floating chiffon against the flow, the fabric pulling taut between her fingers and the water. Her legs are slightly apart for balance, knees softly bent, bare feet planted on the slick, pebbled riverbed visible through the clear surface. Ripples spread from her hips outward, and small eddies curl around her calves. The body conforms to the rock and the flow rather than resisting them, giving the pose a surrendered, meditative weight.

The setting is a quiet natural pool beneath a tall, narrow waterfall cascading down a dark, fern-draped cliff face. Lush green moss, hanging vines, and broad tropical leaves frame the edges of the scene, with smooth wet stones and a few scattered fallen petals along the waterline. Mist hangs in the air around the falling water, softening the cliff and distant foliage into layered depth. The composition is a 2:3 vertical frame, with the woman centered in the midground, the waterfall rising behind her as a bright vertical accent, and a foreground of rippling water and stones leading the eye inward toward her.

The palette is restrained and poetic: muted greens of moss and foliage, cool silvers and grays in the water and stone, porcelain skin tones, and the pure, slightly luminous white of the chiffon. The image is rendered as a real photograph with a dreamlike fine-art sensibility, capturing tactile wet fabric, soft spray on skin, the cool dampness of stone, and the still, contemplative hush of a hidden waterfall without crossing into fantasy CGI.

items.title: VELCARA奢华珠宝石榴概念广告海报

prompts.text:
Create a luxury flagship advertising poster for an original fine-jewelry brand named "VELCARA". Preserve the same iconic still-life structure: one whole mature pomegranate centered in the lower-middle as the sculptural hero pedestal, one exquisite yellow-gold charm bracelet draped across the fruit in a graceful horizontal arc, one refined English headline block in the upper center, and one slim premium feature strip along the bottom edge. The background must remain a deep dark garnet-to-black gradient with rich cinematic depth. The final image must feel like a Cannes-level luxury jewelry campaign: minimal, sensual, commanding, symbolic, and instantly memorable, with the bracelet as the absolute commercial focal point.

Style lock:
Ultra-realistic luxury jewelry macro photography, dark editorial still life, premium fashion-house campaign design, refined negative space, high-end print sharpness, rich romantic restraint, iconic product-led hierarchy.

Core composition:
Place one whole pomegranate large and centered in the lower-middle, occupying the visual throne without overwhelming the jewelry. Drape one fine yellow-gold charm bracelet across the upper front curve of the fruit from left to right, following the natural roundness of the pomegranate like a ceremonial coronation line. Suspend six to seven distinct charms along the chain, with one elongated marquise-cut crystal drop hanging lowest at the exact center as the main visual anchor. Keep the upper headline centered with generous negative space above, and the bottom information strip thin, elegant, and fully subordinate to the hero object.

Orbit motion logic:
Build a clear semi-circular eye path. The eye should begin at the upper headline, descend into the fruit crown, travel along the bracelet arc from left charm to central marquise pendant to right charm, then fall softly to the bottom feature strip before returning upward through the round silhouette of the pomegranate. Use chain curvature, charm spacing, highlight rhythm, and the fruit’s circular volume to create one elegant orbit that repeatedly pulls attention back to the center pendant and the gold arc. The motion must feel luxurious, controlled, and inevitable.

Port super-symbol logic:
Turn the single pomegranate wearing a gold charm bracelet into the brand’s unmistakable super-symbol. The fruit must feel like a royal jewel altar or crowned relic rather than a simple prop. The bracelet should read as a coronation band, and the central pendant should feel like the seal of preciousness. Together, the dark crimson fruit and luminous gold arc must form an ownable luxury icon readable instantly even at small scale.

Lighting:
Use soft upper-front-left studio lighting with subtle right-side fill and delicate rim separation. Create smooth highlight rolloff on the pomegranate skin, rich micro-specular glints on the gold links, and crisp premium sparkle on the crystal charms. Shadows must stay feathered, elegant, and clean, with no dead black patches and no muddy transitions.

Materials and realism:
Render the pomegranate with hyper-real botanical texture: taut leathery skin, natural pores, slight dryness, crown detail, organic mottling, deep crimson-to-wine tonal variation, and believable irregular surface sheen. Render the bracelet in polished 18k yellow gold with realistic chain weight, precise link geometry, flawless charm attachment, and refined handcrafted finish. The charms must include varied silhouettes such as pear drops, medallions, celestial forms, and one central marquise-cut crystal, all with physically accurate reflections, gemstone transparency, and premium brilliance.

Color strategy:
Dominant colors: deep garnet, burgundy, blackened wine red, and dark cherry shadow. Secondary tones: rich yellow gold, antique amber, and muted bronze warmth. Accent tones: clear crystal white and soft champagne highlights. Keep the palette dark, regal, warm, and restrained, so the jewelry becomes the brightest visual punctuation.

Typography and layout:
Use an original all-English luxury headline in the upper center, such as "CROWN THE RARE", with a very short refined subline if needed. Place an original premium bottom strip with concise phrases such as "FINE CHARMS  •  18K GOLD  •  HAND-FINISHED". All text must be original, elegant, minimal, and globally marketable. Do not copy any existing brand name, slogan, or campaign wording.

Concept atmosphere:
No extra props, no sliced fruit, no juice, no clutter. The image should evoke abundance, coronation, rarity, and sacred adornment. The pomegranate must feel monumental and symbolic; the bracelet must feel precious, ceremonial, and irresistibly collectible.

Quality target:
Hyper-detailed, high-resolution luxury print finish, macro-grade jewelry clarity, flawless gold rendering, realistic crystal brilliance, unified lighting physics, elegant tonal depth, strong iconic readability, premium editorial polish.

Negative prompt:
copied brand name, copied slogan, copied layout text, weak bracelet visibility, oversized fruit dominance, dull gold, plastic-looking crystals, blurry chain, broken charm spacing, cluttered composition, sliced fruit, juice splash, extra props, muddy background, dead black patches, low-resolution detail, warped charms, inconsistent reflections, unreadable typography, cheap e-commerce styling

prompts.text:
为名为“VELCARA”的原创高级珠宝品牌创作一张奢侈旗舰广告海报。保留相同的标志性静物结构：一个完整的成熟石榴居中位于中下方作为雕塑感的英雄底座，一条精致的黄金吊坠手链呈优美的水平弧线垂挂在水果上，一个精致的英文标题块位于上方中心，以及一条细长的尊贵特性条带沿底部边缘分布。背景必须保持深石榴红到黑色的渐变，具有丰富的电影感深度。最终图像必须感觉像是戛纳级别的奢侈珠宝活动：极简、感性、威严、象征性且令人过目不忘，手链作为绝对的商业焦点。

风格锁定：
超写实奢侈珠宝宏观摄影，暗色调编辑静物，高端时装屋活动设计，精致的负空间，高端印刷清晰度，丰富的浪漫克制，标志性的以产品为核心的层级。

核心构图：
将一个完整的石榴大而居中地放置在中下方，占据视觉宝座而不掩盖珠宝。将一条精美的黄金吊坠手链从左到右垂挂在水果的上前部曲线上，遵循石榴的自然圆润度，如同仪式性的加冕线。沿链条悬挂六到七个独特的吊坠，其中一个拉长的马眼形切割水晶坠饰在正中心挂得最低，作为主要的视觉锚点。保持上方标题居中，上方留有充裕的负空间，底部信息条薄且优雅，并完全从属于英雄主体。

轨道运动逻辑：
构建一个清晰的半圆环视路径。视线应从上方标题开始，下降到水果顶冠，沿着手链弧线从左侧吊坠移动到中央马眼形吊坠再到右侧吊坠，然后轻轻落在底部特性条上，再通过石榴的圆形轮廓向上返回。利用链条的曲率、吊坠的间距、高光的节奏和水果的圆形体积来创建一个优雅的轨道，反复将注意力拉回到中心吊坠和金色弧线上。运动必须感觉奢华、受控且不可避免。

端口超级符号逻辑：
将佩戴着金色吊坠手链的单个石榴变成品牌清晰可辨的超级符号。水果必须感觉像是一个皇家珠宝祭坛或受冕的遗迹，而不是一个简单的道具。手链应被解读为加冕带，中央吊坠应感觉像珍贵的印记。深红色的水果和发光的金色弧线共同构成一个独有的奢侈偶像，即使在小比例下也清晰可辨。

灯光：
使用柔和的左上方工作室灯光，配合细微的右侧补光和精致的轮廓分离。在石榴表皮上创建平滑的高光衰减，在金链环节上产生丰富的微镜面闪烁，在水晶吊坠上产生清脆的高级火彩。阴影必须保持羽化、优雅且干净，没有死黑区域和模糊的过渡。

材质与写实度：
以超真实的植物纹理渲染石榴：紧致的皮革质感表皮、自然的毛孔、轻微的干燥、顶冠细节、有机斑驳、深红到酒红的色调变化以及可信的不规则表面光泽。用抛光的18k黄金渲染手链，具有真实的链条重量、精确的链节几何形状、无瑕的吊坠连接和精致的手工修饰。吊坠必须包括各种轮廓，如梨形坠饰、奖章、天体形状和一个中央马眼形切割水晶，所有这些都具有物理上精确的反射、宝石透明度和高端辉煌感。

色彩策略：
主色调：深石榴红、勃艮第红、变黑的酒红和深樱桃影。次要色调：丰富的黄金色、古董琥珀色和柔和的青铜暖色。点缀色调：清透的水晶白和柔和的香槟高光。保持调色板黑暗、庄严、温暖且克制，使珠宝成为最亮的视觉标点。

排版与布局：
使用一个原创的全英文奢侈标题在上方中心，例如“CROWN THE RARE”，如果需要，可以配上非常短的精致副标题。在底部放置一个原创的高级条带，带有简洁的短语，如“FINE CHARMS • 18K GOLD • HAND-FINISHED”。所有文本必须是原创的、优雅的、极简的且具有全球市场吸引力。不要复制任何现有的品牌名称、口号或活动用语。

概念氛围：
没有额外的道具，没有切开的水果，没有果汁，没有杂乱。图像应唤起丰盈、加冕、稀有和神圣的装饰感。石榴必须感觉宏伟且具有象征意义；手链必须感觉珍贵、具有仪式感且令人难以抗拒地值得收藏。

质量目标：
超细节、高分辨率奢侈印刷饰面、宏观级珠宝清晰度、无瑕的黄金渲染、真实的水晶火彩、统一的灯光物理学、优雅的色调深度、强大的标志性可读性、高端编辑磨光。

负面提示：
复制的品牌名称、复制的口号、复制的布局文本、手链可见度低、水果体积过大、黯淡的黄金、塑料感的水晶、模糊的链条、破碎的吊坠间距、杂乱的构图、切开的水果、果汁飞溅、额外的道具、模糊的背景、死黑补丁、低分辨率细节、扭曲的吊坠、不一致的反射、无法阅读的排版、廉价的电子商务风格

prompts.text:
[Person] Reference Image 1, Image 2 [Signature] At the bottom right, the Threads logo operated by Meta is slightly placed above it, with "CHAse" written in small white handwritten font like a signature.

1. [Person's Pose and Expression]
Composition and overall posture: A cinematic full/medium shot composition of reclining and enjoying to the fullest on a gorgeously carved ancient Roman-style log Japanese-style bed (sofa).

Detailed movements and hand positions:
The upper body leans against the left cushion and is slightly raised, the left hand holds an exquisitely carved heavy golden chalice (Chalice/wine glass), lightly touching the lips and sipping slowly like tasting red wine.

The right hand is relaxed and gracefully holds a bunch of lush deep purple/black grapes placed above the thighs and hips.

One leg is stretched long, and the other is slightly bent and raised, with the smooth leg lines and bare feet sensually revealed between the slits of the skirt.

Expression and atmosphere: Casting a lazy yet charming and arrogant gaze through the wine glass at the camera, creating a grand and decadent atmosphere of a goddess/queen in a sensual and decadent ancient Roman banquet (Bacchanal).

2. [Person's Clothing]
Top/bottom clothing and skirt details: Wearing an elegant pleated (ruffled) voluminous translucent chiffon/silk material ivory ancient Greek/Roman style robe (Chiton) dress.

Details and decorations: The entire part of the deep V-neckline and shoulder strap lines on the chest are surrounded by gorgeous and heavy ancient-style gold embroidery and relief decorations, exquisitely encircling, and the body silhouette is faintly visible through the high slits.

Accessories: Bold golden armlet (Armlet) bracelets with ancient Roman pattern reliefs are worn on both upper arms (upper arms), adding an overwhelming sense of aristocratic splendor.

3. [Person's Hairstyle and Makeup Details]
Hairstyle: Centered on a 5:5 forehead hair, the bangs are neatly braided and fixed backwards at the top of the head, and the rest of the voluminous honey-gold blonde/light brown hair falls softly over the shoulders and back in lush natural waves, creating a classic hairstyle.

Makeup: Wrapped in warm candlelight, based on a warm tan (Warm Tan) skin tone base with a soft glow, deep brown smoky eye makeup and gold pearlescent eyeshadow, and moist shimmering nude terracotta coral lip makeup when touching the wine glass, completing the charming facial features.

4. [Lighting and Light Direction]
Source and expression: Warm and magnificent golden amber main light (Warm Key Light) and soft torch/candlelight illumination projected from the top and sides of the grand ballroom.

Highlights/Shadows: Dazzling golden highlights are formed on the golden wine glass, armlets, gold thread embroidery of the skirt, and the character's collarbones, shoulders, and leg lines, while deep and rich Baroque-style Chiaroscuro (Chiaroscuro) shadows are cast between the sofa folds and the background columns.

5. [Texture and Color Atmosphere]
Colors: A rich and heavy classic warm-tone palette woven from Gold, Amber, Crimson Red, Deep Purple, and the gorgeous oriental/damask patterns of the sofa cushions.

Textures: The rough jacquard fabric texture of the cushions and tapestries, the thin and flowing chiffon fabric texture of the skirt, the smooth luster of the grapes, the cold luster of the carved gold metal, and the fine and heavy film grain (Film Grain) texture unique to large historical movie films are vividly presented.

6. [Film and Camera Lens Depth of Field, Angle]
Angle and Depth of Field: A stable and grand eye-level to low-angle mixed composition matching the height of the person lying on the sofa.

Features: Exquisite application of shallow depth of field, with the protagonist in the front, the golden chalice, the bunch of grapes, and the bed sheets in extreme sharp focus, while the cheering crowd and columns in the back are treated with natural cinematic blurring (Bokeh), maximizing the sense of spatial depth and the protagonist's presence.

7. [Background and Layout Elements]
Background space: A grand marble fluted column (Fluted Columns) and red drapery hanging in an ancient Roman-style gorgeous ballroom interior.

Background characters: Numerous male and female nobles lying on the Japanese-style bed in the background are dressed in gold/red togas, raising their hands high to cheer and enjoy the festival, and the dynamic banquet party scene unfolds richly in the background, completing the narrative sense of scale.

prompts.text:
[人物] 参考图像 1、图像 2 [签名] 右下角有 Meta 运营的 Threads 标志小幅放置在其上方，以白色手写体小字写着像签名一样的“CHAse”。

1. [人物的姿势及表情]
构图及整体姿态：以华丽雕刻的古代罗马式原木日式床（沙发）上慵懒地斜躺着尽情享受的电影式全/中景构图。

详细动作及手部位置：

上身倚靠在左侧靠垫上微微抬起，左手举着一个精致雕琢的沉重金色高脚酒杯（Chalice/酒杯），轻轻触及嘴唇，像品尝红酒般细细啜饮。

右手轻松伸出，优雅地握着放在大腿和臀部上方的一串丰硕的深紫/黑色葡萄。

一条腿长长伸展，另一条腿微微弯曲抬起，裙摆开衩间流畅的腿部线条和赤裸的双足感性地显露出来。

表情及氛围：透过酒杯向镜头投去慵懒却迷人而傲慢的目光，营造出感官而颓废的古代罗马贵族宴会（Bacchanal）中女神/皇后般堂皇而颓废的氛围。

2. [人物服装]
上·下衣及裙子细节：穿着优雅的褶皱（褶边）丰盈的半透明雪纺/丝绸材质的象牙色古代希腊·罗马风长袍（Chiton）连衣裙。

细节及装饰：胸前深V领口和肩带线整个部分环绕着华丽而厚重的古代风格金色刺绣及浮雕装饰，精致环绕，高开衩间身体轮廓隐约可见。

饰品：两侧上臂（上臂）戴着古代罗马图案浮雕的大胆金色臂环（Armlet）手镯，增添压倒性的贵族华丽感。

3. [人物发型及化妆细节]
发型：以 5:5 额发为中心，将刘海整齐地编辫向后固定在头顶，其余丰盈的蜜色蜜金金色/浅棕色头发以丰硕的自然波浪柔和地垂落肩部和背部，营造经典发型。

化妆：以温暖的烛光包裹，流动着柔和光泽的暖棕（Warm Tan）肤色底妆为基础，深邃的棕色烟熏眼妆和金色珠光眼影，以及触及酒杯时湿润闪耀的裸色赤陶珊瑚唇妆，完成迷人的五官。

4. [照明及光线方向]
光源及表现：从华丽的大型宴会厅顶部和侧面投射的温暖而宏伟的金琥珀色主光（Warm Key Light）及柔和的火把/烛光照明。

高光/阴影：金色酒杯、臂环、裙子的金线刺绣，以及人物的锁骨、肩膀、腿部线条上形成耀眼的金色高光，而沙发褶皱和背景柱子之间投下深邃而丰富的巴洛克式明暗对比（Chiaroscuro）阴影。

5. [质感与色调氛围]
色彩：金色（Gold）、琥珀黄（Amber）、深红（Crimson Red）、深葡萄色（Deep Purple），以及沙发靠垫的华丽东方/锦缎图案交织而成的浓郁而沉重的经典暖色调调色板。

纹理：靠垫和挂毯的粗糙提花织物质感、裙子的薄而飘逸的雪纺面料纹理、葡萄粒的光滑光泽、雕琢金金属的冷峻光泽，以及大型历史电影胶片特有的细密而厚重的电影胶片颗粒（Film Grain）纹理生动呈现。

6. [胶片及相机镜头景深、角度]

items.title: 旅行照片转民间墨线设色地标对比海报

prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的「民间墨线设色地标小像」对比海报。每张照片单独输出，不得将多张照片拼接在同一画面中。

## 整体版式

采用3:4竖版构图。

画面上下分为两个高度接近1:1的区域：

- 上半部分：高保真原始照片；
- 下半部分：从同一照片提炼出的民间墨线设色地标小像。

上下区域之间使用笔直、清楚、克制的水平边界。不得渐变、羽化、撕裂或让墨线和色块侵入照片区域。

## 上半部分：真实照片

忠实保留原始照片中的：

- 地标或建筑身份；
- 建筑高宽比例；
- 正立面或侧正面的观察角度；
- 屋顶、穹顶、塔楼与门洞关系；
- 台阶、廊柱、雕塑和入口方向；
- 周围必要的道路、树木、水面或围墙；
- 真实材质、自然光影与原有色彩氛围。

只进行轻微的旅行杂志、独立出版物与艺术展览摄影调色，并加入极薄的胶片颗粒。

上半部分必须仍然是一张真实摄影作品。不得插画化、移动建筑、改变透视、增加装饰、替换天空、拉伸、镜像或复制主体。

## 下半部分：地标小像

不要完整重画照片，也不要给照片添加墨线滤镜。

先识别建筑最具身份的2–4项结构，例如：

- 屋顶或穹顶轮廓；
- 塔楼高低关系；
- 主门洞与拱券；
- 台阶与基座方向；
- 廊柱节奏；
- 雕像位置；
- 桥头、围墙或一小段水岸。

主动删除游客、车辆、广告、标牌、密集植物、重复窗格、砖缝、雕花、复杂檐口、天空纹理与摄影噪声。

下半部分只保留能够让建筑一眼可辨的最少信息。

建筑小像通常只占转绘区域的36%–55%，放置在中部、中下部或顺应原照片重心偏向一侧。四周保留45%–60%的连续温暖白纸。

先删除背景，再缩小主体。不得把完整风景缩小后塞入下半区，也不得铺满整个背景。

## 墨线

在温暖、偏白、带细微纸张纤维的哑光画纸上，使用粗重、略带抖动的黑色毛笔、油性记号笔或粗墨笔重新绘制建筑。

墨线应具有真实手腕压力和纸面阻力：

- 粗细不均；
- 轻微迟疑与回折；
- 局部重描；
- 偶尔断线；
- 小块墨团；
- 毛糙纸齿；
- 少量不闭合轮廓。

先用少量坚定的外轮廓抓住屋顶、塔体、门洞、台阶和基座，再以极少短线、点状墨痕或黑色小块提示内部结构。

线条可以略显笨拙，但必须准确抓住建筑性格。不要画成精细钢笔建筑图、照片自动描边、统一粗细的矢量轮廓或儿童填色稿。

## 设色

只使用2–3种从原始照片中提取的标志性色彩，加上纸白与黑墨构成整套色盘。

优先提取：

- 建筑墙面或屋顶的代表色；
- 天空、植物、水面或地面的一个环境色；
- 必要时加入一个较深的视觉锚点色。

将颜色降低少量饱和度，形成饱满、略微陈旧、哑光的水粉平涂。

色块可以出现：

- 明显刷痕；
- 不均匀覆盖；
- 越过墨线；
- 局部错位；
- 漏白；
- 边缘缺口；
- 纸纹透出。

颜色不必严丝合缝地填在线条内部。它应像画者直接把几块旧色刷在纸上，而不是数字软件中的封闭填色。

颜色只用于主要墙面、屋顶、地面或两三块不规则背板，不得铺满全部背景。

## 留白与构图

建筑小像与文字分别占据两块有间隔的纸白区域。

- 建筑偏左时，文字放置在右侧或右上方；
- 建筑偏右时，文字放置在左侧或左上方；
- 建筑与文字之间保持明显呼吸距离。

除建筑与文字之外，至少保留一块完整、连续、无图无字的纸白区域，让空白代表天空、距离、光线和旅行中的安静感。

不得使用四角全部塞满信息的模板版式。

## 文字

默认加入一组克制但能够正常阅读的英文旅行题签。

文字内容必须在生成前根据照片事实逐字确定，包括：

1. 一个1–3个英文单词的地点或场景标题；
2. 一个简短字段，例如“STUDY NO. 01”或“LANDMARK NOTE”；
3. 一行5–10个英文单词的观察句，描述照片中真实可见的屋顶、门洞、台阶、颜色、岸线或天气。

主标题采用略带迟疑感的粗笔英文大写、油性记号笔字或手工旧铅字。

标题必须在正常聊天预览尺寸下清楚可读，通常占下半区域宽度的20%–32%。允许轻微不齐、断墨、纸齿和手工字距，但不得潦草到无法辨认。

编号和观察句约为标题字高的45%–65%，采用小号旧铅字、手写边注或人文无衬线，同样保持清楚可读。

文字使用黑墨或从建筑色块中提取的一种深色，像直接写、画或印在纸上，不得成为悬浮的光滑数字排版图层。

如果不能可靠确认地点，使用真实场景主题作为标题，不得猜测城市、建筑名称、日期或坐标。

禁止中文题字、假中文、伪书法、作者名、签名、社交账号、Logo、二维码、网址、虚构地点和乱码。

## 强制避免

Avoid:

fixed Chinese temple template, red-wall blue-background formula, invented stone lions, invented flags, fake seals, Chinese calligraphy, copied reference architecture, detailed pen-and-ink architecture drawing, transparent watercolor wash, screenprint halftone, full-page rubber stamp texture, woodcut hatching, automatic photo outlines, vector illustration, clean closed color fills, childish coloring-book style, cartoon landmark icon, complete background rendering, excessive architectural details, edge-to-edge painting, tiny unreadable typography, floating digital text, author signature, logo, watermark.

最重要的规则：

上半部分必须清楚保留真实原始照片。

下半部分用粗重而略带抖动的黑色墨线，抓住同一建筑最有身份的屋顶、塔体、门洞、台阶或雕像；再用两三块稍微越线、带刷痕的旧色平涂压住主要关系。

主动删除细节、缩小建筑、加入可读的旅行题签，并保留大片连续白纸，使结果像旅途中认真画下的一枚民间建筑小像，而不是建筑精描、照片滤镜或通用卡通地标。

Further, naturally include male and female members of the same club in the background to create a sense of sharing the same team's space. Background People Rule: The male and female members in the background do not become the main characters and are naturally positioned in the back or edges of the frame. The number can be from a few to several people, sitting or standing, organizing luggage or talking. They should be slightly smaller than the protagonist, and the focus can be slightly blurred. Lighting: Natural brightness where natural light entering from the club room window mixes with general indoor lighting. The skin or navy clothing does not show unnatural yellow or blue tones, neutral white balance. Mood: An unpretentious natural daily snapshot as if suddenly taken while resting in the club room between practice sessions. Through the presence of men and women from the same club in the background, the actual atmosphere of club activities is strengthened.

{
"direction": "A 3:4 portrait orientation summer daily SNS snapshot taken by a friend at close range with a smartphone wide-angle camera. 1 fictional adult female in her 20s. The core of the photo is not the beauty of the person itself, but the sense of presence brought by the close-range wide-angle, the arms stretched wide to the left and right of the head, the repetition of vivid orange, and the color contrast with the dark building background. It is not an advertising shoot or a fashion editorial, but a photo taken by a friend within seconds during an outing, naturally conveying such a reason for shooting.",
"mood": "Bright and playful atmosphere of a sunny day. The photographer and the subject are very close, showing the natural tension of being slightly silly when photographed. It is not a carefully crafted portrait, but a lighthearted summer snapshot feel that could be sent directly to SNS.",
"model": "A fictional adult female in her early to mid-20s who does not resemble any specific celebrity, influencer, or real person. Slim but not unrealistically exaggerated healthy body type. Maintaining natural shoulder width, waist width, and arm length, only reflecting the slight perspective brought by the smartphone wide angle.",
"face": "Friendly, non-specific face shape. Looking toward the camera with a natural smile showing a bit of teeth. Eyes are relatively wide open, but not a perfect expression like a model shoot; instead, it's a slightly asymmetrical expression from laughing halfway when being photographed by a friend. Retain the differences between the left and right sides of the face and the slight asymmetry of the cheeks caused by the smile.",
"hair": "Chest-length long straight hair. Light brown as the base, showing warm tones of orange-brown in the sun. Natural side part. The action of raising both arms causes a few strands of hair to scatter slightly from the shoulders or near the cheeks, not a perfectly neat hairstyle.",
"body": "Shoulders almost facing the camera but not completely front-facing, with a slight angle. Natural center of gravity shift from the torso to the waist, with the waist slightly offset to the right side of the frame, forming a weak S-curve. Not an intentional waist-emphasizing pose, but a natural standing posture where the weight shifts to one leg as a result of raising both arms.",
"skin": "Healthy, slightly warm-toned skin. As a smartphone photo, it has a slight degree of skin-smoothing treatment, but retains fine skin textures, faint spots, and natural shadows around joints. No plastic-like uniform skin texture. Does not emphasize pores or high-definition beauty photos.",
"outfit": "Navy blue and white fine horizontal striped triangle bandeau bikini. The neck straps and bottom edges of the top use vivid orange thin strings, with orange outlining the structure of the navy and white fabric. The bottom is also unified with the same navy x white stripes, with slightly thicker woven or rope-like vivid orange straps near the hip bone. Natural waist position of a general bikini, no over-the-top way of wearing that emphasizes the body. The fabric retains slight wrinkles and tension differences from actual wear.",
"accessories": "Large round or hoop earring worn on one ear. Mainly navy blue with small orange accents, repeating the bikini's color scheme. Fingernails on both hands are vivid lime green to neon yellow-green, slightly long but of a realistic length.",
"scene_objects": "Holding a small round vivid orange fruit the size of a tangerine or orange in the left hand within the frame. Behind the background glass, multiple bottles or cans are faintly visible lined up on a beverage cooler with glass doors or a small display shelf. No brand logos or readable product names.",
"pose": "Both arms raised wide to the left and right, forming triangular spaces on both sides of the head. The left hand holds an orange fruit while the index and middle fingers extend in a natural V-sign, with the hand positioned slightly behind the head. The right hand also makes a V-sign but does not hold a fruit, extending slightly upward from the side of the head. Not a mirror-like symmetry; heights, elbow angles, and wrist angles vary. Fingers are naturally shaped, and the left hand's V-sign is slightly less perfect than the right hand's due to holding the fruit, making it appear more natural.",
"lighting": "Daylight on a sunny day. Bright natural light near a building entrance where direct sunlight is not strong. Sky scattered light and reflections from surrounding walls make the face and body relatively evenly bright. The charcoal black building in the background is significantly darker than the person, strongly highlighting the orange, navy blue, white, and lime green on the person's side. No golden hour; maintain a neutral to slightly warm color temperature like midday.",
"effect": "Restrained contrast like a smartphone photo, and slightly vivid colors for SNS. Orange is repeated in the hair, fruit, bikini strings, earrings, etc., guiding the eye in a cycle. Dark areas have slight noise originating from a smartphone, and the sky or bright skin areas retain the gradation of slight highlight clipping edges. Not to the extent of JPEG compression, but a slightly lighter texture than a full RAW advertising photo.",
"camera": "Smartphone's standard wide-angle to slightly wide-angle camera. Natural wide-angle perspective equivalent to about 24-28mm in 35mm. The camera is close to the subject, a distance where the head to the upper thighs fill the frame. Almost no background blur, with a relatively deep depth of field where both the person and the black bricks and glass window frames are recognizable. Hands are slightly closer to the camera than the face, so hands are only slightly enlarged in natural wide-angle perspective. No strong artificial blur from portrait mode.",
"imperfections": "The photo as a whole is not perfectly level, with a natural Dutch angle tilted several degrees counter-clockwise for the smartphone. Slight height difference between the left and right arms, and the shoulder line is not perfectly level. Asymmetry in the smile, a few strands of messy hair, small wrinkles in clothes, weak reflections on the background glass, subtle noise in dark areas, and softness from slight hand movement are retained. No over-editing.",
"background": "Near the entrance of a modern shop or a residential-shop combo. Most of the background is an exterior wall made of horizontally stacked charcoal gray slender bricks. On the left side of the frame, there is a large glass door or window with a black metal frame. Behind the glass, warm indoor lighting, wood, small foliage plants, shelves, and bottles/cans are low-key visible. On the right side of the frame are black bricks and a gray concrete surface, with the upper part showing a light blue sky and bright gray building surfaces. No beach, sand, pool, or resort hotel; maintain the unexpected combination of a bikini and achromatic urban architecture.",
"atmosphere": "Against the calm black building surface, only the person stands out with warm high-saturation colors in the dry and bright summer street. The background has information but is not dominant, setting off the person's color scheme. Not an impression of meticulous setup before shooting, but a moment captured when a friend raises their phone while just coming out of a shop or chatting, and the subject raises their hands to play around.",
"composition": "Strict 3:4 portrait composition. The top of the head is about 25% from the top edge, the center of the face is at about 36%, the chest is about 56-62%, the navel is about 78-80%, and the waist is about 88%. The upper thighs are naturally cut off at the bottom edge. The face is slightly to the right of the center. The person is placed large to fill the frame, with both arms extending to the left and right edges. The fruit and V-sign in the left hand, the V-sign in the right hand, and the face create a visual rhythm in the upper half. Uneven negative space, creating a slightly crowded composition like a close-range snapshot.",
"color_design": "Primary colors are orange, navy blue, white, lime green, charcoal black, and light sky blue. Orange is repeated in at least 3 places: hair, fruit, bikini straps, and accessories. Navy blue and white are repeated in the clothing and earrings. The background is centered on low-saturation charcoal gray and gray, highlighting the colors on the person's side.",
"negative": "Faces resembling real people or celebrities, characters that look like minors, exaggerated body proportions, extreme retouching, doll-like faces, plastic-like skin, studio lighting, cinematic strong shadows, extreme background blur, telephoto portraits, perfectly symmetrical poses, beach or pool backgrounds, advertising photo-like perfectly level composition, excessive high-resolution feel, unnatural fingers, extra fingers, readable brand text, UI, app buttons, text information."

The camera is located directly above the character at a high angle of about 45–60°, at a distance of about 60–90cm, using an equivalent 24–28mm mobile phone wide-angle lens, forming a distinct but realistic wide-angle perspective: the face and shoulders/chest are near the upper right area of the frame, the hands are in the foreground at the bottom of the frame, and the hips and thighs extend towards the back left. The character occupies about 85% of the frame, the environment retains only a small amount of floor tiles and wall corners, no fisheye is used, and no background blur is applied.

The character has a naturally plump, distinctly hourglass-shaped adult female figure: moderate shoulders, full upper body, significantly slender waist, wide pelvis and hips, rounded full buttocks, and thick soft thighs. In the kneeling pose, the hips are raised and extended backward, the thighs are naturally compressed due to the bent knees, and the body maintains a realistic sense of soft tissue and gravity; do not use slender model types, narrow hips, thin legs, athletic muscular types, or extreme wasp waists.

The pose is strictly restored: knees apart kneeling on the floor, knees located respectively towards the back on both sides of the body; calves folded back, feet basically leaving the frame. The pelvis is higher than the shoulders, hips are raised towards the character's back left, and the upper body is leaning forward and downward. The upper body wears a very tight-fitting light mint green/ice green ribbed knit long-sleeved cropped top with a very low off-the-shoulder/wide U-neck, largely exposing the shoulders and collarbones. The neckline edge features a circle of fine ivory white lace trim with a translucent mesh and floral embroidery structure. The body of the garment is a soft, dense vertical ribbed fabric, tightly fitting the upper body and forming slight natural wrinkles at the waist and abdomen; the sleeves are slim-fit, extending near the wrist.

The lower body wears a matching light mint green form-fitting ultra-short loungewear shorts/hot pants, low to mid-waist, made of soft ribbed knit or stretch cotton, tightly fitting the wide hips and buttocks; the pant legs are very short but maintain a complete garment structure. The legs wear white translucent over-knee stockings/thigh-high socks, with the tops located at the middle-upper part of the thigh, made of thin nylon or soft stretch yarn, with an obvious skin-showing transparency. The top of the socks uses a slightly wider opaque white elastic band, fitting the thigh tightly but without exaggerated strangulation marks. The scene is a minimalist modern indoor corridor/changing space, with the floor covered in large light beige-gray square tiles, where narrow gray grout lines form a clear grid perspective. Only light gray-white walls, dark baseboards, and one wall corner can be seen in the upper left and upper right of the background, with no furniture, decorations, or complex objects. The overall space is clean and slightly empty.

The lighting is an obvious front direct flash from a mobile phone/portable digital camera; the environment itself is dim, and the flash directly illuminates the character's face, shoulders, neck, chest, arms, and hands from the direction of the lens. items.title: 纪实摄影与纸片速写拼贴海报

prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的高级转绘海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。

整体采用3:4竖版上下对比结构。上半部分约占画面48%～50%，完整保留原始照片；下半部分约占50%～52%，重建同一地点、同一人物和同一时刻。上下之间使用清楚、平直的水平边界，不做渐融、撕纸、多层拼贴或中间装饰带。

上半部分忠实保留原照片中的人物身份、数量、面部特征、姿态、行进方向、手势、服装、随身物件、人物间距、前后遮挡、建筑结构、道路透视、真实材质、自然光影和地点氛围。仅进行轻微的旅行杂志、艺术出版物或展览摄影调色，并加入极薄胶片颗粒。不得改变人物、替换背景、移动建筑、增删行人或把照片插画化。

下半部分重建同一空间，但允许根据人物关系进行更有编辑感的二次构图。选择一段足以证明地点的真实摄影环境，适度收紧裁切、降低背景对比或删除无关边缘人物，使照片中最重要的1～4个人物成为清楚的叙事中心。天空、墙面、街道、水面或地面中保留约20%～32%的连续低信息空场，让画面可以呼吸并容纳文字。

下半部分的建筑、街道、墙壁、树木、车辆、天空、水面和光影继续保持真实摄影质感。不要把整个场景一起画成线稿。只将照片中实际存在、并承担主要叙事作用的人物转化为“暖白纸片＋黑色迟疑线描”的实体剪贴速写角色。

严格保持人物真实数量、位置、大小、姿态、动作方向、彼此距离、手部接触、前后遮挡和互动关系。每个人物由以下部分构成：

- 不透明的暖白或自然白纸片填充，完全遮住原本的人物摄影内容；
- 可见但克制的天然纸张颗粒和轻微纤维；
- 干净却略有手工误差的模切纸边；
- 松动、迟疑、粗细略有变化的炭黑或墨黑轮廓；
- 极少量用于头发、衣领、手臂、手掌、腿部、鞋子、背包或相机的内部速写线；
- 非常浅、方向正确的脚底接触阴影和纸片叠层阴影。

人物必须像真实的薄纸角色站在现场中，脚底与地面、人物间遮挡、透视缩放和现场光向都要可信。不得只在透明摄影人物上叠加白色线稿，也不能做成厚泡棉贴纸、卡通人物、表情包、漫画角色或AR界面。

远处非常小的人物可以根据下半部分裁切主动移出画面；若仍清楚可辨，则应按真实数量以更简洁的白纸剪影处理，不得复制、增加或统一成相同姿势。与人物动作有关的包、帽子、相机、雨伞或自行车可以随人物一起纸片化。

默认加入三层准确、可读的英文文字：

1. 根据照片中的人物动作或场景关系提炼一个1～3个英文单词的标题；
2. 一个类似“SCENE NO. 01”的观察编号；
3. 一行5～10个英文单词的短句，描述照片里真实发生的行走、等待、相遇、拥抱或观看。

主标题必须能在正常聊天预览尺寸下清楚辨认，约占下半区域宽度的25%～38%。文字使用松动黑墨大写、手工铅字或速写本式窄体字，可印在一块暖白色手工纸签上，也可以沿低信息的墙面或地面排列。墨迹允许轻微断裂和纸齿，但不能缩成装饰灰线，不能像后期叠加的光滑数字排版。

不得虚构人物关系、地点、日期、品牌、引用或作者信息。文字不能覆盖人物面部、手部互动和脚底接触位置。

整体具有真实旅行摄影与纸上人物速写同时存在的奇妙感觉：环境仍然属于现实，人物像从记忆、日记或速写本中被剪下，再轻轻放回旅途中。

Avoid: full-poster redraw, illustrated buildings, illustrated street, all-white background replacing the scene, transparent line overlay on photographic people, cartoon people, colored comic characters, kawaii stickers, speech bubbles, AR interface, thick foam stickers, altered person count, invented pedestrians, duplicated figures, changed poses, separated hands, floating figures, missing contact shadows, tiny source-photo comparison, fake text, author name, signature, social handle, logo, watermark.

最重要的规则：上方必须完整保留真实原照片；下方仍然是真实摄影空间，只将照片中真实存在的人物转化为暖白纸片与迟疑黑墨线构成的实体剪贴角色。

items.title: 地铁随拍日系清甜少女超写实摄影

prompts.text:
9:16 vertical, full-body composition, hyper-realistic human photography × Japanese sweet uniform fashion × Subway snapshot Editorial × Light cinematic feel.

Subject and Core Features

A 20–23-year-old, clearly adult beautiful East Asian woman, tall and slender, about 1.70–1.75 meters, with a long head-to-body ratio, a small head, slender and relaxed shoulders and neck, a slim waist, and long straight legs, with natural and coordinated overall body proportions. The character is in frame from the top of the head down to the soles of the shoes, with feet fully visible, without cropping the head, arms, knees, ankles, or shoes.

The character has delicate and sweet East Asian female human features, a small oval face, a smooth and clear jawline with a slightly pointed chin, a delicate and natural bridge of the nose, and large eyes that maintain real human proportions with a soft gaze. The skin is very fair and transparent, with a clean and soft cool white porcelain tone; the skin tone of the face, neck, arms, and legs is naturally unified, retaining real pores, fine fuzz, and slight skin texture, avoiding plastic airbrushing, CG faces, or anime faces.

Dark brown long curly hair, thick volume, styled in low twin tails/side-tied hair, with soft large waves falling naturally to the chest and waist; airy bangs naturally cover the forehead, with a small amount of fine hair on both sides of the cheeks. Hair strands have real bunching, highlights, shadows, and frizz details.

Clothing and Accessories

Wearing a black and white Japanese-style sailor suit modified fashion set. The top is an ivory white short-sleeved slim-fit sailor suit, with a black sailor collar paired with double-layer white piping, a large black polka-dot bow tied at the chest, and the hem decorated with white ruffles; the bottom is a black high-waisted slim skirt with a fine, low-key polka-dot texture, and the hem includes white piping and light-colored wavy ruffles.

The overall clothing fits the body but maintains a real fabric structure, showing natural folds, stitching, edging, and fabric thickness.

A very thin, delicate silver necklace is worn around the neck. A light beige-gray soft shoulder bag hangs naturally from the shoulder. The right hand naturally holds a black smartphone.

Wearing white mid-calf socks + black shiny platform loafers, the shoe surface has real leather reflections, sole thickness, and natural perspective, with both shoes complete and clear, not deformed.

Action and Pose

The character stands by the subway car door, the body naturally forming a slight S-curve, with the upper body leaning slightly toward the car wall/door frame.

The body's center of gravity falls mainly on one leg, while the other leg naturally crosses slightly forward and to the side, with both knees remaining naturally relaxed and toes pointing in slightly different directions, forming a relaxed and casual standing posture.

The right hand is bent near the waist and abdomen, naturally holding the black phone; the left hand hangs naturally and rests lightly near the skirt waist, with fingers relaxed and a clear, natural finger structure.

The head is turned slightly about 20–30° to the right side of the frame, looking toward the front side of the car instead of directly at the camera. The lips are naturally slightly parted, with a quiet, sweet, and slightly thoughtful expression.

Scene and Environment

Interior of a modern Asian city subway/rail transit car, the character is located in the corner area between the train door and the metal handrail.

The background includes silver-gray metal train doors, white-gray interior panels, dark windows, curved stainless steel handrails, vertical metal pillars, door frame structures, and a few real safety warning signs.

In the foreground on the left side of the frame, there is a silver metal handrail very close to the lens, creating natural blurring due to shallow depth of field, producing obvious foreground obstruction and depth levels.

On the right side is the subway door and dark glass window; the environment outside the window is dark, creating light and dark contrast.

The floor is dark gray fine-grained anti-slip flooring, where the real contact relationship between the character's feet and the ground and slight sole shadows can be seen.

The environment remains clean, modern, and quiet, without crowded people, and without adding eye-catching advertisements or messy items.

Time and Atmosphere

Time is set for night or evening commuting hours.

The train interior is brightly lit, while the outside of the window is deep blue-black, thus forming a visual contrast of "bright car × dark outside window."

The overall atmosphere is quiet, private, and slightly lonely, like a frame of a city girl's portrait captured by chance when taking the last subway at night.

Lighting Design

The main light source comes from large areas of cool white LED lights on the ceiling of the subway car.

The main light is a soft diffused top light, medium to high intensity, color temperature about 4300–5000K, falling evenly from about 30–45° in front of the character's head.

The face remains bright and soft, avoiding obvious dark circles and hard shadows; slight natural shadows are retained in the nose, jawline, neck, and collarbone areas to enhance three-dimensionality.

A small amount of cool ambient fill light is generated on the right side of the door, and the metal structure on the left reflects soft highlights.

Skin highlights are soft and not overexposed, and the black clothing still retains shadow textures.

The overall dynamic range is high, highlights are not overexposed, shadows are not crushed, and the skin tone is transparent but real.

Lens Language and Composition

9:16 vertical full-body environmental portrait.

The camera is located directly in front of the character, slightly to the left, about 2.5–3.5 meters away from the character.

Use an equivalent focal length of about 45–55mm on full-frame to avoid ultra-wide angles causing small heads and large feet, leg stretching, and subway structure distortion.

Shoot from a nearly eye-level, slightly low camera position, with the camera height located approximately between the character's waist and chest, producing only a very slight low-angle effect to naturally enhance leg length and the character's tall proportions.

The character occupies about 80–88% of the frame height, with a small amount of safety space left at the top of the head and an appropriate margin left between the soles of the shoes and the bottom of the frame.

The character is located slightly to the right of the center of the frame, using the blurred metal handrail on the left to form a foreground frame, and the subway door on the right to form a vertical structural line.

Negative Constraints

Prohibit anime faces, 2D, CG faces, 3D modeled faces, plastic skin, excessive airbrushing, exaggerated large eyes, deformed features; prohibit overly large heads, abnormal body proportions, waist breaks, twisted legs, uneven leg lengths, extra limbs, extra hands or feet; prohibit finger merging, six fingers, missing fingers, phone merging with palm; prohibit abnormal knees, twisted ankles, reversed left and right feet, deformed or floating shoes.

Must fully display both legs, ankles, socks, and both shoes, no cropping of feet, and do not let the foreground handrail block the character's face or key body structures.

Prohibit excessive wide angle, fisheye, strong perspective stretching, excessive low angle, excessive high angle; prohibit strong background blur leading to the complete disappearance of the subway environment; prohibit overexposed white skin, dead white skin tone, greasy highlights; prohibit incorrect text becoming the visual subject, obvious AI watermarks, logos, subtitles, and borders.

一位 20–23 岁、明确成年的漂亮东亚女性，身材高挑纤细，约 1.70–1.75 米，头身比修长，头部偏小，肩颈纤细舒展，腰身纤细，双腿修长笔直，整体身体比例自然协调。人物从完整头顶一直到鞋底全部入镜，双脚完整可见，不裁切头部、手臂、膝盖、脚踝或鞋子。

人物拥有精致清甜的东亚女性真人五官，小巧鹅蛋脸，流畅清晰的下颌线与微尖下巴，鼻梁精致自然，眼型偏大但保持真实人体比例，眼神柔和。肌肤非常白皙通透，呈干净柔和的冷白瓷肌色调，脸部、颈部、手臂与双腿肤色自然统一，保留真实毛孔、细小绒毛和轻微皮肤纹理，避免塑料磨皮、CG脸、动漫脸。

深棕色长卷发，发量浓密，采用低位双马尾/双侧束发造型，柔软的大波浪卷发自然垂落至胸前和腰侧；空气感刘海自然覆盖额头，脸颊两侧留有少量细碎发丝。发丝具有真实分束、高光、阴影和毛躁细节。

服装与配饰

身穿黑白配色的日系水手服改良时尚套装。上衣为象牙白短袖修身水手服，黑色水手领搭配双层白色滚边，胸前系有宽大的黑色波点蝴蝶结，衣摆带白色荷叶边装饰；下装为黑色高腰修身短裙，表面具有细密低调波点纹理，裙摆加入白色滚边与浅色波浪荷叶边。

整体服装贴合身体但保持真实布料结构，能够看到自然褶皱、缝线、压边和布料厚度。

颈部佩戴一条极细的精致银色项链。肩侧自然垂下一只浅米灰色软质单肩包。右手自然拿着一部黑色智能手机。

脚穿白色中筒短袜 + 黑色亮面厚底乐福鞋，鞋面具有真实皮革反光、鞋底厚度和自然透视，两只鞋完整清晰，不变形。

动作与姿态

人物站在地铁车厢门边，身体自然形成轻微 S 型曲线，上半身略微向车厢墙壁/门框方向倚靠。

身体重心主要落在一条腿上，另一条腿自然向侧前方微微交叉，两膝保持自然放松，脚尖方向略有差异，形成轻松、随意的站姿。

右手弯曲放在腰腹附近，自然握住黑色手机；左手自然下垂并轻轻停留在裙腰附近，五指放松，手指结构清晰自然。

头部轻微转向画面右侧约 20–30°，视线看向车厢侧前方，而不是直视摄影机。嘴唇自然微张，表情安静、清甜、略带若有所思的感觉。

场景环境

现代亚洲城市地铁/轨道交通车厢内部，人物位于列车车门与金属扶手之间的角落区域。

背景包含银灰色金属车门、白灰色车厢内饰板、深色车窗、弧形不锈钢扶手、纵向金属立柱、门框结构以及少量真实安全警示标识。

画面左侧前景有一根距离镜头很近的银色金属扶手，因浅景深形成自然虚化，制造明显的前景遮挡与纵深层次。

右侧为地铁车门和深色玻璃窗，窗外环境较暗，形成明暗对比。

地面为深灰色细颗粒防滑地板，能够看到人物双脚与地面的真实接触关系和轻微鞋底阴影。

环境保持整洁、现代、安静，不出现拥挤人群，不增加抢眼广告或杂乱物品。

时间与氛围

时间设定为夜晚或晚间通勤时段。

列车内部灯光明亮，而车窗外呈深蓝黑色，因此形成“明亮车厢 × 黑暗窗外”的视觉反差。

整体氛围安静、私密、略带孤独感，如同夜晚乘坐末班地铁时偶然捕捉到的一帧城市少女写真。

光影设计

主要光源来自地铁车厢顶部大面积冷白色 LED 灯。

主光为柔和漫射顶光，强度中等偏高，色温约 4300–5000K，从人物头顶前方约 30–45°方向均匀落下。

脸部保持明亮柔和，避免明显黑眼圈与硬阴影；鼻翼、下颌线、颈部和锁骨区域保留轻微自然阴影以增强立体感。

车门右侧产生少量冷色环境补光，左侧金属结构反射出柔和高光。

皮肤高光柔和不过曝，黑色服装仍然保留暗部纹理。

整体动态范围较高，高光不过曝、暗部不死黑、肤色通透但真实。

镜头语言与构图

9:16 竖版全身环境人像。

摄影机位于人物正前方略偏左位置，距离人物约 2.5–3.5 米。

使用约 45–55mm 全画幅等效焦段，避免超广角造成头小脚大、腿部拉伸和车厢结构变形。

采用接近平视、略微低机位拍摄，摄影机高度约位于人物腰腹至胸部之间，仅产生非常轻微的仰拍效果，以自然强化腿长和人物高挑比例。

人物占画面高度约 80–88%，头顶保留少量安全空间，鞋底与画面底部之间保留适当余量。

人物位于画面中央略偏右，左侧利用虚化金属扶手形成前景框架，右侧利用地铁车门形成纵向结构线。

负面约束

禁止动漫脸、二次元、CG脸、3D建模脸、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、夸张大眼、畸形五官；禁止头部过大、身体比例异常、腰部断层、腿部扭曲、长短腿、多余肢体、多手多脚；禁止手指融合、六指、断指、手机与手掌融合；禁止膝盖异常、脚踝扭曲、左右脚颠倒、鞋子变形或悬空。

必须完整显示双腿、脚踝、袜子与两只鞋，不裁脚，不让前景扶手遮挡人物脸部和关键身体结构。

禁止过度广角、鱼眼、强透视拉伸、过度仰拍、过度俯拍；禁止强烈背景虚化导致地铁环境完全消失；禁止过曝白皮、死白肤色、油腻高光；禁止错误文字成为视觉主体、明显 AI 水印、Logo、字幕和边框。

items.title: 书架前阅读瞬间的日本女性人像摄影

prompts.text:
Subject:
A fictional adult Japanese woman, kneeling alone in front of a bookshelf near a large window, reaching for a book on the lower shelf while looking this way. Wearing a cream cardigan paired with light beige clothing for overall coordination, capturing her gaze during a reading break.

Location, Time, Background:
A reading space in a high-rise residence or lounge during the day. Wooden bookshelves and book spines of various colors are placed on the left, and a large floor-to-ceiling window is on the right, with blurred urban buildings and a bright sky outside the window. A grey soft carpet is underfoot.

Clothing, Accessories:
An open-knit cream cardigan, with a light beige top and matching bottoms for a unified style. Wearing a thin necklace on the chest, no other small items are added except for the books.

Pose, Fingers, Contact:
Kneeling on one knee in front of the bookshelf, with the upper body slightly twisted toward the camera. The right hand gently touches near the necklace on the chest, and the left hand reaches toward the lower bookshelf to pick a book.

Expression, Gaze:
Face slightly lowered, but pupils are aligned with the camera, a quiet smile appearing at the corners of the mouth. Combines the calmness of guided reading with the intimate sense of distance from eye contact.

Face, Makeup:
Small oval face, soft eyebrows, dark brown eyes, thin straight bridge of the nose, pale rose-pink lips. Using a matte base makeup suitable for indoor lighting, adding soft shadows at the corners of the eyes and cheeks.

Hair:
Long dark brown hair flowing to one side of the shoulder, forehead bangs lightly parted to reveal the forehead. A faint light penetrates the hair strands on the window side, while the inner side remains dark brown and retains a sense of volume.

Light Source:
Broad daylight is introduced from the large window on the right side of the frame, softly illuminating the face, cheeks, cardigan, arms, and the edges of the bookshelf. The bookshelf on the left retains quiet shadows, and the area under the chin is gently brightened through floor reflection.

Colors, Tones:
Using cream, beige, wood brown, carpet grey, dull multicolored book spines, and pale blue from outside the window. Maintaining a low-saturation intellectual atmosphere, with only the face and hands appearing slightly warm.

Materials, Fine Textures:
Respectively depicting the knitted texture of the cardigan, the smooth fabric of the top, the texture of the skin, the fine metallic luster of the necklace, the paper and spines of the books, the wood grain of the bookshelf, the pile of the carpet, and the reflections of the window glass.

Composition, Lens:
A vertical 9:16 indoor lifestyle photograph. The center of the face is placed at approximately 54% of the frame width and 35% of the top edge, the gaze is at approximately 36% of the top edge, and the center of the figure's upper body is approximately 53% horizontally. About 9% of blank space is left above the head, the reaching hand is placed at approximately 31% of the frame width and 78% of the top edge, the bookshelf is placed at approximately 29% on the left, and the window is at approximately 34% on the right. Filmed diagonally from a slightly high position.

Image Processing, Completion:
Adjusted to a natural indoor photo that utilizes window light, preserving the texture of the face and the knit pattern. Clarity is given to the figure and the books in the foreground, and the city scenery outside the window is treated with bright blurring to avoid distracting the gaze.

Corruption Avoidance, Prohibitions:
Fixed as the same woman, kneeling pose, downward reaching motion, hand on the opposite side of the chest, cream-colored clothing, bookshelf, large window, city landscape. Do not add other people, minors, multiple people, other clothing, glasses, drinks, books with readable text, logos, watermarks, collages. Organize fingers, book arrangement, bookshelf boards, window frames.

prompts.text:
被摄主体：
一个虚构的成年日本女性，独自跪在书架前靠近大窗户的位置，伸手去够下层的书，同时看向这边。穿着奶油色开衫搭配浅米色的服装整体协调，捕捉她在阅读间隙的目光。

地点・时间・背景：
白天的高层住宅或休息室的阅读空间。左侧放置木质书架和颜色各异的书脊，右侧是地板到天花板的大窗户，窗外是模糊的城市建筑和明亮的天空。脚下是灰色的柔软地毯。

服装・小物：
敞开穿着细密编织的奶油色开衫，内搭浅米色的上衣和同色系的下装统一风格。在胸前佩戴一条纤细的项链，除书本外不添加其他小物。

姿势・手指・接触：
在书架前单膝跪地，上身微微扭转面向镜头。右手轻轻触碰胸前的项链附近，左手伸向下方书架挑选一本书。

表情・视线：
脸部微微低下，但瞳孔对准镜头，嘴角浮现宁静的微笑。兼具引导阅读的平静感，以及视线交汇的亲近距离感。

脸部・妆容：
小巧的卵形脸，柔和的眉毛，深棕色的眼睛，细直的鼻梁，淡玫瑰粉色的嘴唇。采用室内光线适配的哑光底妆，在眼尾和脸颊处添加柔和的阴影。

头发：
深棕色的长发流向一侧肩膀，前额刘海轻轻分开露出额头。窗户一侧的发束透入细微的光线，内侧保持深棕色并保留发量感。

光源：
从画面右侧的大窗户引入宽广的日光，柔和地照亮脸部、脸颊、开衫、手臂和书架边缘。左侧的书架保留宁静的阴影，通过地板反射温和地提亮下巴下方。

颜色・色调：
使用奶油色、米色、木头的棕色、地毯的灰色、书脊的暗淡多色，以及窗外淡青色。保持低饱和度的知性氛围，仅让脸部和手部稍显温暖。

材质・细微质感：
分别描绘开衫的编织纹理、上衣的光滑布料、皮肤的纹理、项链的细金属光泽、书的纸张和书脊、书架的木纹、地毯的绒毛，以及窗户玻璃的反射。

构图・镜头：
纵向9:16的室内生活风格照片。将脸部中心置于画面宽度的约54%、上端约35%处，视线在上端约36%、人物上半身中心横向约53%。头部上方留白约9%，伸出的手置于画面宽度的约31%、上端约78%处，书架置于左侧约29%，窗户置于右侧约34%。从稍高的位置斜向拍摄。

图像处理・完成：
调整为活用窗光的自然室内照片，保留脸部和编织纹理的质感。将人物和近景的书赋予清晰度，窗外的城市景物处理为明亮的虚化，避免视线分散。

崩坏回避・禁止：
固定为同一女性、跪姿、向下伸手的动作、胸前相反侧的手、奶油色服装、书架、大窗户、城市景观。不添加其他人、未成年人、多人、其他服装、眼镜、饮料、可阅读文字的书、标志、水印、拼贴。整理手指、书的排列、书架板、窗框。

items.title: 90年代香港夜间浪漫氛围写实快照

prompts.text:
**Photorealistic 1990s Hong Kong nocturnal romantic snapshot aesthetic** — intimate, moody, restless, and slightly decadent.

A **clearly adult young woman** stands in a crowded nightclub, **facing the camera directly and looking straight into the lens**. She has a **cute yet glamorous doll-like face**, **expressive deep-red contact lenses**, healthy fair skin with realistic texture, subtle smoky eye makeup, and **dark wine-red glossy lips**. Her hair is **long, glossy black**, softly framing her face. She has a **naturally fuller bust**, a defined waist, and a balanced, feminine silhouette with realistic anatomy and proportions.

She wears an **ultra-short floral gothic qipao**, fitted and elegant, with a **black faux-fur stole** slipping loosely from her shoulders. She holds a **traditional round embroidered fan** naturally in her hands, making it a clear visual focus. Her glossy black hair, wine-red lips, silver jewelry, and embroidered fan catch fragments of neon and compact-camera flash.

Dense **red, amber, dirty green, and occasional cyan neon** spill across the scene. Mixed practical lighting from lanterns, bar signs, fluorescent tubes, and street-like neon creates imperfect skin tones and unpredictable color contamination.

The nightclub feels **cramped, humid, and slightly surreal** — red lanterns overhead, traditional Chinese calligraphy, talismans, drifting joss paper, pale green ghost lights, cigarette haze, mirrors, dark wood, and moving partygoers dressed as Chinese ghosts, jiangshi, and folklore creatures.

Use **handheld 28–35mm close-range photography** with **slow shutter drag**, **slight subject motion smear**, **subtle camera shake**, **imperfect focus**, **streaked neon highlights**, and an occasional **double-image feeling**. Some frames should feel caught between moments rather than perfectly frozen.

The composition should feel **crowded and spontaneous**: blurred shoulders and hair partially blocking the foreground, faces appearing and disappearing through cigarette smoke, reflections in mirrors and glossy surfaces, and accidental off-center framing.

Her expression should feel **magnetic, intimate, and emotionally distant**, but now with **direct eye contact toward the camera** — a faint knowing smile, dreamy half-lidded gaze, slightly mischievous calm, or a cool, self-possessed expression. She should feel sensual through **presence, eye contact, and atmosphere**, not through nudity.

Mood: **sensual without nudity, melancholic, intimate, feverish, rebellious, lonely-in-a-crowd, romantic, slightly dangerous, and dreamlike**.

Looks like a **late-1990s Hong Kong nightlife memory captured on consumer 35mm film**, not a polished movie still: **coarse grain, faded shadows, mildly blown highlights, warm-magenta contamination, greenish shadows, soft contrast, imperfect scanning, dust, and low-resolution print texture**.

Use **occasional slow-shutter flash photography** so the **face is partly frozen by flash while hair, passing bodies, smoke, and neon lights smear softly through the frame**.

Avoid clean modern cinematography, HDR, perfect sharpness, studio glamour lighting, excessive bokeh, symmetrical framing, fashion-editorial polish, pornographic posing, explicit nudity, or artificial anatomy.

prompts.text:
逼真的1990年代香港夜间浪漫快照美学——亲密、忧郁、焦灼且略显颓废。

一位显而易见的成年年轻女性站在拥挤的夜总会里，直面相机并直视镜头。她有一张可爱而迷人的洋娃娃般的脸庞，戴着富有表现力的深红色隐形眼镜，健康的白皙皮肤带有真实的纹理，微妙的烟熏眼妆，以及深酒红色的亮面嘴唇。她的头发是长而有光泽的黑色，柔和地修饰着她的脸。她有着自然丰满的胸部，明显的腰线，以及比例均衡、富有女性美感的身材，解剖结构和比例真实。

她穿着一件超短的碎花哥特旗袍，合身且优雅，肩上滑落着一件黑色的仿皮草披肩。她手里自然地拿着一把传统的圆形刺绣扇子，使其成为视觉焦点。她光泽的黑发、酒红色的嘴唇、银饰和刺绣扇捕捉到了霓虹灯和紧凑型相机闪光灯的碎片。

浓密的红色、琥珀色、脏绿色和偶尔出现的青色霓虹灯洒满整个场景。来自灯笼、酒吧招牌、荧光灯管和类街道霓虹灯的混合实用照明营造出不完美的肤色和不可预测的色彩污染。

这家夜总会感觉拥挤、潮湿且略显超现实——头顶上方挂着红灯笼，还有中国传统书法、符咒、飘动的冥纸、淡绿色的鬼火、香烟的烟雾、镜子、深色木材，以及穿着中国鬼魂、僵尸和民间生物服装走动的派对参与者。

采用手持28-35mm近距离摄影，配合慢速快门拖尾、轻微的主体运动模糊、微妙的相机抖动、不完美的聚焦、条纹状的霓虹高光，以及偶尔的重影感。一些画面应该感觉像是捕捉在瞬间之间，而不是完美冻结。

构图应该感觉拥挤且自发：模糊的肩膀和头发部分遮挡前景，面孔在香烟烟雾中若隐若现，镜子和光滑表面上的反射，以及偶然的偏心构图。

她的表情应该具有磁性、亲密感且在情感上保持距离，但现在要与相机直接对视——淡淡的会心的微笑、梦幻般的半眯双眼、略带淘气的冷静，或者冷酷、从容的表情。她应该通过存在感、眼神交流和氛围而非裸露来展现感官魅力。

氛围：不露骨的感官刺激、忧郁、亲密、狂热、叛逆、人群中的孤独、浪漫、略显危险且梦幻。

看起来像是用家用35mm胶片捕获的90年代后期香港夜生活记忆，而不是精雕细琢的电影剧照：粗颗粒、褪色的阴影、轻微溢出的高光、暖洋红色污染、偏绿的阴影、柔和的对比度、不完美的扫描、灰尘以及低分辨率的打印质感。

偶尔使用慢速快门闪光灯摄影，使面部被闪光灯部分冻结，而头发、经过的身体、烟雾和霓虹灯则在画面中柔和地涂抹开来。

避免洁净的现代电影摄影、HDR、完美的锐度、摄影棚魅态照明、过度的虚化、对称构图、时尚社论般的润色、色情姿势、露骨的裸体或人造的解剖结构。
