items.title: 一张床上自拍照

prompts.text:
1. Theme:
Intimate morning-after luxury fashion editorial. A private, just-awakened moment of high-fashion sensuality — the quiet temptation of a supermodel sitting up in bed after sleep, treating the body as a living luxury sculpture with extreme waist-to-bust contrast, refined yet boldly erotic.
2. Subject:
A 23-year-old East Asian-European mixed supermodel with an ideal luxury-sculpture physique: extremely slender wasp waist, full heavy H-cup breasts with natural weight and soft volume, long elegant limbs, pale cool-toned skin with a natural morning flush, tall statuesque frame.
3. Character / Expression:
Just-woken, drowsy and naturally sensual expression. Half-lidded striking grey-blue eyes looking toward the camera with sleepy, slightly dazed intensity. Further back on the white storage racks, light-colored plush toys and daily necessities are visible, the space is slightly crowded but real.

Near the subject's arm in the lower left of the frame is a small white desktop fan, the circular protective mesh cover and white fan blades are clearly visible; behind the fan is a red plastic drink bottle. Behind the subject, there are also a black desktop, cardboard boxes, clothes, and a small amount of piled sundries, making the overall appearance 'a real e-sports bedroom used by someone for a long time', do not tidy it into a clean commercial e-sports room.

A section of a black mechanical keyboard is exposed in the foreground at the very bottom of the frame, the edges of the keys have purple-blue RGB lights, occupying only a very small area and cropped by the bottom edge of the frame; a small piece of green RGB light source or mouse/computer equipment light can appear in the lower right corner. The foreground equipment is slightly closer to the lens, with a slight natural blur, but the main subject remains clear.

Soft warm white ceiling light/room ambient light is used as the main light source indoors, no obvious natural window light, and no strong flash. The subject's face, neck, chest, and thighs receive relatively even warm white lighting, with clear but soft highlights forming on the bridge of the nose, collarbone, and micro-sweat areas; background sundries are slightly darker than the subject but still all identifiable. RGB blue-purple light is only used as a small amount of cold color embellishment on the headphones and keyboard, do not dye the entire room in cyberpunk colors.

The overall quality is that of a real high-quality mobile phone/portable camera indoor snapshot, with slight mobile phone HDR, natural digital sharpening, and limited dynamic range. The face, stray hairs, skin texture, white T-shirt cotton wrinkles, gray shorts, headphone plastic material, cable, pink e-sports chair, and background sundries are all clearly identifiable.

prompts.text:
超写实室内电竞房生活方式人像摄影，竖版约 2:3，一名年轻成年东亚女性半躺在粉色电竞椅里，戴着大型黑色游戏耳机和麦克风，面对镜头拍摄近距离坐姿照片。采用约 28–35mm 等效手机镜头，机位位于人物正前方略偏上，距离约 80–120cm，轻微俯拍约 10–15°。画面从头顶完整拍到大腿中部，人物占画面约 80%，脸部位于中央偏上，左右手臂自然延伸到画面两侧，前景底部露出一小段 RGB 机械键盘和桌面设备，保持真实电竞桌前随手拍透视，不使用鱼眼，不做明显背景虚化。

人物为年轻成年东亚女性，身材自然丰满、明显沙漏型：肩部适中，上半身丰满，腰部明显收束，腹部平坦柔和，骨盆和大腿丰满。坐姿下臀胯自然陷入电竞椅，双腿向左右自然打开，形成放松的宽松坐姿；大腿因靠近镜头略微放大，但保持真实人体结构与软组织形态，不要纤细纸片型、健美肌肉型或夸张失真比例。

人物上半身明显向后靠在电竞椅靠背中，肩膀放松，身体微微向人物左侧倾斜，腰腹自然向前形成轻微弧度。左臂向画面左侧自然伸出并搭在黑色桌面/椅子扶手附近，右臂向画面右下方延伸并大部分离开画面，双手都不做刻意手势。整体姿态像长时间打游戏后放松瘫坐在椅子中的随手照片，不要正襟危坐，不要模特式挺胸站姿。

人物留黑色中短发，长度约至下巴和颈部之间，发量适中，整体略微凌乱并带轻微湿润感；额前为稀疏、参差的长空气刘海，多缕发丝贴在额头、眉眼和脸颊两侧。耳机压住头顶和两侧头发，使部分碎发从耳罩边缘露出。不要长卷发、厚齐刘海或过度精致的沙龙造型。

脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，下颌柔和，肤色白皙偏暖。深棕色眼睛直视镜头，眼神略显疲惫、放空，双眼皮自然，轻微棕黑眼线和睫毛；眉毛纤细自然。鼻梁小巧顺直，鼻尖带轻微高光；嘴唇自然丰满，裸粉偏豆沙色，嘴巴微微张开。双颊、鼻梁和额头有轻微粉润和真实皮肤光泽，保留毛孔与细小肤色变化，不要过度磨皮。

人物戴一副大型黑色 over-ear 游戏耳机，厚实圆形/椭圆形耳罩完整包住双耳，外壳为黑色哑光塑料并带少量蓝色 LED 光效。头梁厚实，横跨头顶。耳机右侧伸出一根黑色可弯曲麦克风杆，麦克风末端停在嘴角右侧附近。耳机黑色连接线从耳罩沿胸前垂下，穿过白色上衣和腹部区域后继续延伸至桌面，线材必须完整连续，不要消失或漂浮。

上身穿非常宽松、柔软的纯白色短袖居家 T 恤，领口被自然拉宽并略向下滑，形成较宽的低圆领；面料很薄、略带透气感和真实棉质褶皱，肩膀、胸前和腰腹处形成大量自然堆叠与拉伸纹理。衣摆在腰部右侧形成明显打结/卷起效果，使部分腰腹和肚脐自然露出。不要紧身上衣，不要做成正式 crop top，也不要添加印花、Logo 或文字。

下身穿浅灰色柔软居家运动短裤，低至中腰松紧腰头，腰部带灰色抽绳，面料为柔软毛圈棉或薄卫衣布。裤腿很短并略微宽松，边缘带白色滚边/包边，坐姿下自然向大腿根部上移并产生轻微褶皱。短裤颜色为浅灰偏暖，不要牛仔材质、瑜伽裤或裙子。

皮肤质感是重要特征：脸部、锁骨、胸口、肩颈和腰腹有明显但不过度的细腻湿润高光，像室内较热、刚打完游戏后的轻微出汗状态；锁骨和胸前可见少量纵向光泽，腹部也有柔和反光。不要水珠遍布全身，不要油腻塑料皮肤，只保留真实微汗与皮肤反射。

人物坐在一张大型粉色电竞椅中，靠背为粉色与浅奶油色拼接，侧翼包裹肩背，头枕区域在人物头后形成明显粉色轮廓；椅面和腰部靠垫颜色为浅米白/奶油粉。椅子材质类似 PU 皮革或软质人造革，具有轻微缝线与柔和反光，不要改成普通办公椅。

场景是一间真实、略显凌乱的年轻人卧室/电竞房。人物身后左侧是一组白色开放式桌架和置物架，桌面堆放大量日常用品：透明饮料杯、塑料瓶、小罐子、护肤/化妆瓶、纸巾、盒子、电线和零散杂物。更后方的白色置物架上可见浅色毛绒玩具和生活用品，空间略显拥挤但真实。

画面左下方靠近人物手臂的位置有一台白色小型桌面电风扇，圆形防护网罩和白色扇叶清晰可见；风扇后方有一瓶红色饮料塑料瓶。人物身后还存在黑色桌面、纸箱、衣物和少量堆放杂物，使整体呈“真实有人长期使用的电竞卧室”，不要整理成干净商业电竞房。

画面最下方前景露出一段黑色机械键盘，按键边缘带紫蓝色 RGB 灯光，只占很小面积并被画面底边裁切；右下角可出现一小块绿色 RGB 光源或鼠标/电脑设备灯光。前景设备稍靠近镜头，具有轻微自然虚焦，但主体人物保持清晰。

室内使用柔和暖白色顶灯/房间环境光作为主光源，没有明显窗户自然光，也没有强烈闪光灯。人物脸部、肩颈、胸前和大腿受到较均匀的暖白色照明，鼻梁、锁骨和微汗区域形成明显但柔和的高光；背景杂物比人物稍暗，但仍全部可辨。RGB 蓝紫光仅作为耳机和键盘上的少量冷色点缀，不要把整个房间染成赛博朋克色。

整体呈真实高质量手机/便携相机室内抓拍质感，轻微手机 HDR、自然数码锐化和有限动态范围。脸部、碎发、皮肤纹理、白 T 恤棉料褶皱、灰色短裤、耳机塑料材质、线材、粉色电竞椅和背景杂物均清晰可辨。

prompts.text:
Please make each photo I upload into a separate independent high-end design poster, no multi-photo stitching, each photo output individually.

The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout. The screen is strictly divided from top to bottom into four equal horizontal areas, the height of each area must accurately occupy 25% of the overall screen, the ratio of the four layers is strictly 1:1:1:1, no ratio deviation allowed. The areas transition seamlessly, without dividing lines or white space gaps. "No white space gaps" here only means the seams between layers cannot have gaps; negative space, paper, or solid color backgrounds can still be retained inside each layer according to the corresponding style.

All four layers are based solely on the same uploaded photo as the only basis, presenting the same subject, the same moment, and the same spatial relationship. Strictly maintain the identity of the subject, quantity, key structures, proportions, posture, direction of action, line of sight, observation perspective, perspective, occlusion, left-right position, front-back relationship, and core narrative consistency. The four layers are not four unrelated new compositions, but a continuous style translation of the same image. Since each layer is an extremely flat banner of approximately 3:1, the subject should be organized horizontally, and an appropriate amount of breathing space on the left and right should be reserved; natural horizontal extension or slight cropping of the background is allowed, but the subject must not be vertically stretched, key parts must not be cropped, character relationships must not be changed, or scenes unrelated to the original image must not be created.

The visual center of gravity, subject proportion, and contour landing points of the four layers should be aligned vertically as much as possible, forming a continuous evolution from real photography to the target style. Each layer must completely fill its own 25% area. Do not add layer numbers, dividing lines, borders, collage gaps, watermarks, or logos. Unless a layer style description explicitly requires small amounts of edited text, receipt markings, or handwritten notes, do not generate extra text; even if text is needed, it must be in small quantities, restrained, not obscuring the subject, and avoid garbled characters as much as possible.

Layer 1 | Original Photography

Directly retain the real photographic state of the uploaded photo as the visual benchmark for the style translation of the subsequent three layers. Maintain the identity, quantity, facial features, hairstyle, clothing, structure, proportions, posture, movement, line of sight, interactive relationship, observation perspective, perspective, occlusion, environmental direction, natural light and shadow, and core colors of the original characters or subjects, without performing illustration, materialization, geometrization, or 3D reconstruction.

To adapt to the extremely flat banner of approximately 3:1, only natural extension of the left and right sides of the background consistent with the original scene logic is allowed, or slight cropping that does not damage the subject; the proportion of the subject must not be changed, characters or buildings must not be stretched, and the head, hands, feet, key objects, or important narrative relationships must not be cropped. The image remains natural, real, and clear, avoiding excessive skin smoothing, exaggerated color grading, fictional scenery, and decorations unrelated to the original image.

Layer 2 | Multi-color Rubber Stamp Field Notes

In the approximately 3:1 flat banner area of this layer, translate the real subject of the first layer into "Multi-color Rubber Stamp Field Notes" style. Maintain consistency with the first layer in terms of subject identity, quantity, key structures, posture, left-right position, perspective, spatial relationship, and core narrative, then fully execute the following visual requirements:

Extract the most recognizable subject, contours, posture, spatial relationships, and narrative features from the photo, and reconstruct them into a refined multi-color rubber stamp image. Do not completely copy the photo; instead, remove irrelevant details and retain only the structures, trends, and visual memory points most representative of the original object. Re-summarize through silhouettes, color blocks, carved lines, and a small amount of layering, so that one can recognize the correspondence with the uploaded original image at a glance.

The composition maintains the relationship between small-scale stamp prints and large areas of white space, with positions arranged freely according to the subject's own direction, proportion, and visual center of gravity, which can be eccentric, edge-aligned, or partially cropped, but maintain clear primary and secondary balance and editorial balance. Extract 2–4 of the most recognizable colors from the uploaded original image and convert them into restrained yet spirited spot color inks, establishing layers through overprinting relationships, without using fixed travel color palettes.

The stamp prints retain real hand-carved and stamped textures, including unevenly thick carved lines, broken ink, paper showing through, grainy ink, edge gaps, pressure changes, and slight overprinting misalignment; the background uses warm light-colored paper with subtle fiber textures, avoiding smooth vectors, filter effects, and a sense of children's handicrafts.

The text is like field notes left by a traveler or observer. Refine a short English title from the location, subject, state, or imagery of the photo, and pair it with a No. index, 2–3 keywords, or very short descriptions. Use small typewriter fonts or archival micro-typography, which can be cleverly aligned with the edges, white space, baselines, or partial contours of the stamp print, making the text part of the recording system rather than a commercial title.

The overall presentation is a visual relationship of original imagery × handmade rubber stamp × travel field notes, which is quiet, restrained, simple, exquisite, and collectible. The original image provides the on-site basis, and the stamp print is responsible for leaving the most recognizable parts in the memory, avoiding a souvenir feel, stamp templates, circular seals, sticker collages, cartoon styles, excessive text, and decorative accumulation.

Layer 3 | Gestalt Negative Space Screen Print

In the approximately 3:1 flat banner area of this layer, translate the real subject of the first layer into "Gestalt Negative Space Screen Print" style. Maintain consistency with the first layer in terms of subject identity, quantity, key structures, posture, left-right position, perspective, spatial relationship, and core narrative, then fully execute the following visual requirements:

Extract the most recognizable subject, contours, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, and reconstruct them into a minimalist Gestalt negative space screen print. Retain the most recognizable outer contour of the subject, while extracting an environment, structure, object, or symbolic image most closely related to it from the original image, allowing the two to merge into a complete graphic through contour interlocking, negative space hollowing, shared boundaries, and figure-ground reversal: at a distance, the subject is recognized first, and only upon closer inspection is another layer of scene or imagery discovered hidden within. Do not simply stack two objects; let the edges of one shape naturally become the boundary of the other.

The composition maintains a single visual anchor, clear silhouettes, and large areas of white space, with positions determined by the subject's own posture, orientation, center of gravity, and contour trends, which can use eccentricity, partial cropping, top-bottom nesting, or edge alignment, creating a clever visual transition between the positive and negative shapes. Auxiliary elements must be extremely minimal, letting the visual interest mainly come from the instantaneous switch between "what is seen" and "what is seen again," rather than complex decorations.

The color scheme adopts a healing, soft, and high-end Morandi pastel system, referring to the low-saturation color logic in dream-like architectural spaces: mist pink, soft apricot, grey-green, sage, light terracotta, cream yellow, mist blue, grey-purple, etc., coordinating with each other, using light-colored paper as the base, and selecting the most spirited color relationships from the original photo for softening and reorganization. Control the overall to 2–4 colors, establishing layers through combined color temperature, brightness difference, and area ratio. Colors are clean, soft, and have a sense of air, avoiding dirty grey, heavy aging, fluorescent colors, and high-contrast commercial palettes.

Retain slight paper fibers, screen printing grains, ink coverage, and overprinting deviations to give the graphics a real print texture, but keep edges sharp and color blocks flat, without using gradients, 3D volume, realistic shadows, or smooth computer-rendered textures.

The text also participates in the Gestalt composition. Refine a short English title from the identity, location, action, emotion, state, or symbolic meaning of the photo, and pair it with a very small amount of location, index, status words, or micro-notes. The text can be arranged along the subject's contour, negative space boundaries, horizontal baselines, or white space axes, or partially embedded in the graphic, cut by contours, or occluded by color blocks, making the text like a part of the print structure rather than a title pasted on later. Keep it overall tiny, restrained, clever, and with a high-end editorial feel.

Overall presentation of minimalist geometry, Gestalt optical illusion, soft Morandi color, screen printing and poetic narrative combination of visual temperament. Whether the subject is a character, animal, plant, building, object, vehicle or natural landscape, it should maintain the double reading experience of "recognizing the subject at a glance and discovering the hidden imagery at second glance", avoiding multiple side-by-side focal points, direct collage, complex illustration, cartoon feeling, business promotion feeling and template feeling. Text preference: English

Layer 4 | Black and White Out-of-Bounds Illustration and Single Point Color

In the approximately 3:1 flat banner area of this layer, translate the real subject of the first layer into "Black and White Out-of-Bounds Illustration and Single Point Color" style. Maintain consistency with the first layer in terms of subject identity, quantity, key structures, posture, left-right position, perspective, spatial relationship, and core narrative, then fully execute the following visual requirements:

Extract the most recognizable subject, contours, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, and reconstruct them into a minimalist black and white hand-drawn editorial illustration. Use a horizontal or vertical pure black rectangular color field as the main visual field, so that the subject mostly exists within the rectangle, while selecting the most recognizable head, top outline, branches and leaves, roof, limbs, edge of objects or other key structures to naturally break through the rectangle boundary, forming a clear "out-of-bounds" relationship. The subject is not pasted on the black rectangle, but like popping out, passing through or growing out from the black space, making the rectangle both a background and a part of the composition.

The subject retains only the most necessary outer contours, posture and key structures, expressed with black smooth hand-drawn lines + white negative shapes + a small number of gray color blocks. The lines should be simple, smooth, stable, with natural hand-drawn elasticity and rhythm, allowing for a slight manual feel, but not excessively jittery, repeated strokes, fuzzy noise or deliberate infantileization; the whole is closer to a clean and crisp illustrator line draft, rather than rough and casual graffiti. Internal details remain minimalist, using only a small amount of structural lines, expression lines and local shadows to build identification.

The whole is mainly black, white and gray, but it is allowed to add a core local highlighting color as the finishing touch when necessary. This color can only fall on the most critical, narrative or memory local part, such as a part of the subject, a small object, a key surface, an action focus or an emotional signal. The highlighted color area must be very small, the position is precise, and the role is clear, like the only part lit in the screen, used to enhance the memory point and emotional tension, rather than breaking the overall black and white order. Colors should be extracted from the most representative single highlight color in the original image and appropriately purified.

The composition emphasizes the conflict between the geometric order of the black rectangle and the free contour of the subject. The rectangle undertakes a stable and heavy visual base, and the subject creates vitality with asymmetric positions, partial cropping and crossing boundaries; large areas of white paper negative space surround the black area, making black, white and gray form a strong and restrained area relationship. Auxiliary structures can be transformed into a minimum number of straight lines, slopes, platforms, edges or geometric slices, but shall not form a second subject.

The text establishes a lightweight black and white editorial micro-typography system, extracting a short English title from the action, emotion, state or metaphor of the photo, and matching it with 1-3 groups of tiny notes, numbers, state words or short sentences. The text can be close to the edge of the black rectangle, hidden in the negative space, arranged along the crossing direction, or aligned and staggered with the contour of the subject; use black handwritten characters, thin sans-serif or restrained serif fonts, maintain a small scale, and make the text look like the signature and editorial mark left by the illustrator, rather than a commercial title.

Overall presentation of pure white paper × black geometric color domain × smooth hand-drawn lines × subject crossing boundary × single point color emphasis visual temperament, restrained, smart, light, humorous, modern and artistic publishing sense. Avoid color cartoons, complex scenes, smooth vector strokes, realistic light and shadow, 3D texture, pure black silhouette, rough messy lines and template centralized composition.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。

整体采用 3:4竖版构图。画面从上到下严格四等分为四个横向区域，每个区域高度必须精确占整体画面的25%，四层比例严格为1:1:1:1，不允许出现比例偏差。区域之间无缝衔接，无分隔线、无留白间隙。这里的“无留白间隙”仅指层与层的接缝不能出现空隙；每层内部仍可按照对应风格保留负空间、纸面或纯色背景。

四层全部以同一张上传照片为唯一依据，呈现同一主体、同一瞬间和同一空间关系。严格保持主体身份、数量、关键结构、比例、姿态、动作方向、视线、观察视角、透视、遮挡、左右位置、前后关系与核心叙事一致。四层不是四张互不相关的新构图，而是同一画面的连续风格转译。由于每层均为约3:1的极扁横幅，主体应横向组织，并保留适量左右呼吸空间；允许对背景进行自然横向延展或轻微裁切，但不得纵向拉伸主体、裁掉关键部位、改变人物关系，或另造与原图无关的场景。

四层的视觉重心、主体占比和轮廓落点尽量上下对齐，形成从真实摄影逐步过渡到目标风格的连贯演化。每层都必须完整填满自身25%的区域。不要添加层号、分隔线、边框、拼贴缝隙、水印或Logo。除非某层风格说明明确要求少量编辑文字、票据标记或手写注释，否则不要额外生成文字；即使需要文字，也必须少量、克制、不遮挡主体，并尽量避免乱码。

第一层｜原始摄影

直接保留上传照片的真实摄影状态，作为后三层风格转译的视觉基准。保持原始人物或主体的身份、数量、面部特征、发型、服装、结构、比例、姿态、动作、视线、互动关系、观察视角、透视、遮挡、环境方向、自然光影与核心色彩，不进行插画化、材质化、几何化或三维重建。

为了适配约3:1的极扁横幅，只允许对背景左右两侧进行符合原场景逻辑的自然延展，或进行不损伤主体的轻微裁切；不得改变主体比例，不得拉伸人物或建筑，不得裁掉头部、手脚、关键物件或重要叙事关系。画面保持自然、真实、清晰，避免过度磨皮、夸张调色、虚构景物和与原图无关的装饰。

第二层｜多色橡皮章田野笔记

在本层约3:1的扁横幅区域中，将第一层的真实主体转译为“多色橡皮章田野笔记”风格。保持与第一层一致的主体身份、数量、关键结构、姿态、左右位置、视角、空间关系与核心叙事，再完整执行以下视觉要求：

从照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态、空间关系与叙事特征，重构为一枚精炼的多色橡皮章图像。不要完整复制照片，而是删去无关细节，只保留最能代表原物的结构、走势和视觉记忆点，通过剪影、色块、刻线和少量层叠重新概括，使人能够一眼识别与上传的原图之间的对应关系。

构图保持小尺度章印与大面积留白的关系，根据主体自身的方向、比例和视觉重心自由安排位置，可偏心、贴边或局部裁切，但保持清晰主次与编辑式平衡。配色从上传的原图中提取2–4种最具辨识度的颜色，转化为克制而有精神的专色油墨，通过套色关系建立层次，不使用固定旅行色卡。

章印保留真实手工雕刻与盖印质感，包括粗细不均的刻线、断墨、纸张透底、颗粒油墨、边缘缺口、压力变化和轻微套色错位；背景使用温暖浅色纸张与细微纤维纹理，避免平滑矢量、滤镜效果和儿童手工感。

文字像旅行者或观察者留下的田野注释，从照片的地点、主体、状态或意象中提炼一个简短英文标题，并搭配No.编号、2–3个关键词或极短说明。使用小型打字机字体或档案式微排版，可与章印的边缘、留白、基线或局部轮廓巧妙对齐，使文字成为记录系统的一部分，而不是商业标题。

整体呈现原始影像 × 手工橡皮章 × 旅行田野笔记的视觉关系，安静、克制、质朴、精致而具有收藏感。原图提供现场依据，章印负责留下记忆中最值得辨认的部分，避免旅游纪念品感、邮票模板、圆形印章、贴纸拼贴、卡通风格、过多文字和装饰堆积。

第三层｜格式塔正负形丝网版画

在本层约3:1的扁横幅区域中，将第一层的真实主体转译为“格式塔正负形丝网版画”风格。保持与第一层一致的主体身份、数量、关键结构、姿态、左右位置、视角、空间关系与核心叙事，再完整执行以下视觉要求：

从照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为极简的格式塔正负形丝网版画。保留主体最具有辨识度的外轮廓，同时从原图中提炼一个与其关系最紧密的环境、结构、物件或象征性意象，让二者通过轮廓咬合、负形镂空、边界共用和图底反转融为一个完整图形：远看首先识别主体，近看才发现另一层场景或意象隐藏其中。不要把两个对象简单叠放，而要让一个形状的边缘自然成为另一个形状的边界。

构图保持单一视觉锚点、清晰剪影和大面积留白，根据主体自身姿态、朝向、重心和轮廓走势决定位置，可采用偏心、局部裁切、上下嵌套或边缘对齐，使正形与负形之间形成巧妙视觉转换。辅助元素必须极少，让视觉趣味主要来自“看见什么”与“再次看见什么”的瞬间切换，而不是复杂装饰。

配色采用治愈、柔和而高级的莫兰迪粉彩体系，参考梦境般建筑空间中的低饱和配色逻辑：雾粉、柔杏、灰绿、鼠尾草、淡陶土、奶油黄、雾蓝、灰紫等相互协调，以浅色纸面为底，从原照片中选择最有精神的色彩关系进行柔化与重组。整体控制在2–4种颜色，通过综合色温、明度差和面积比例建立层次，颜色干净、柔和、有空气感，避免脏灰、沉重做旧、荧光色和高反差商业配色。

保留轻微纸张纤维、丝网印刷颗粒、油墨覆盖与套色偏差，使图形具有真实版画触感，但保持边缘清晰、色块平整，不使用渐变、三维体积、写实阴影或光滑电脑渲染质感。

文字同样参与正负形构图。从照片的身份、地点、动作、情绪、状态或象征意义中提炼一个简短英文标题，并搭配极少量地点、编号、状态词或微型注释。文字可沿主体轮廓、负形边界、水平基线或留白轴线排布，也可局部嵌入图形、被轮廓切断或与色块形成遮挡，使文字像版画结构的一部分，而不是后期贴上的标题。整体保持细小、克制、聪明而具有高级编辑感。

整体呈现极简几何、格式塔错视、柔和莫兰迪色、丝网版画与诗意叙事结合的视觉气质。无论主体是人物、动物、植物、建筑、器物、交通工具或自然景观，都应保持“一眼识别主体，第二眼发现隐藏意象”的双重阅读体验，避免多个并列焦点、直接拼贴、复杂插画、卡通感、商业宣传感和模板感。文字偏好：英文

第四层｜黑白越界插画与单点彩色

在本层约3:1的扁横幅区域中，将第一层的真实主体转译为“黑白越界插画与单点彩色”风格。保持与第一层一致的主体身份、数量、关键结构、姿态、左右位置、视角、空间关系与核心叙事，再完整执行以下视觉要求：

从照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为极简黑白手绘编辑插画。以一个横向或纵向的纯黑矩形色域作为主要视觉场，让主体大部分存在于矩形内部，同时选择最具识别度的头部、顶部轮廓、枝叶、屋顶、肢体、器物边缘或其他关键结构自然突破矩形边界，形成明确的“越界”关系。主体不是贴在黑色矩形上，而像从黑色空间中探出、穿过或生长出来，使矩形既是背景，也是构图的一部分。

主体仅保留最必要的外轮廓、姿态和关键结构，以黑色流畅手绘线 + 白色负形 + 少量灰色块面表现。线条应简洁、顺滑、稳定，有自然手绘弹性和节奏感，允许轻微手工感，但不要过度抖动、重复描边、毛躁噪点或刻意稚拙化；整体更接近干净利落的插画师线稿，而不是粗糙随意的涂鸦。内部细节保持极简，只用少量结构线、表情线和局部阴影建立辨识度。

整体以黑、白、灰为主，但允许在必要时加入一个核心局部的强调彩色，作为点睛之笔。这个彩色只能落在最关键、最有叙事性或最有记忆点的局部，例如主体的某个部位、一个小物件、一块关键表面、一个动作焦点或一个情绪信号。强调色面积必须很小、位置精准、作用明确，像画面中唯一被点亮的部分，用来提升记忆点和情绪张力，而不是打破整体黑白秩序。颜色应从原图中提取最有代表性的单一亮点色，并适度提纯。

构图强调黑色矩形的几何秩序与主体自由轮廓之间的冲突。矩形承担稳定、沉重的视觉基座，主体以不对称位置、局部裁切和越界制造活力；大面积白色纸面留白包围黑色区域，使黑、白、灰形成强烈而克制的面积关系。辅助结构可以转化为极少量直线、斜面、平台、边缘或几何切片，但不得形成第二主体。

文字建立轻巧的黑白编辑式微排版系统，从照片的动作、情绪、状态或隐喻中提炼一个简短英文标题，并搭配1–3组极小注释、编号、状态词或短句。文字可贴近黑色矩形边缘、藏在负形中、顺着越界方向排列，或与主体轮廓形成对齐和错位；使用黑色手写字、细瘦无衬线或克制衬线字体，保持小尺度，让文字像插画师留下的签注和编辑标记，而不是商业标题。

整体呈现纯白纸面 × 黑色几何色域 × 流畅手绘线条 × 主体越界 × 单点彩色强调的视觉气质，克制、聪明、轻巧、幽默、现代且具有艺术出版感。避免彩色卡通、复杂场景、光滑矢量描边、写实明暗、三维质感、纯黑剪影、粗糙乱线和模板式居中构图。

prompts.text: Hyper-realistic indoor full-body mirror selfie photography, vertical ratio approximately 4:5, a young adult East Asian female standing in front of a large floor-to-ceiling mirror in a minimalist modern interior for a selfie. The image captures the person completely from head to feet, with the person positioned center-left in the frame, occupying about 80–85% of the frame height, leaving a narrow mirror edge on the right side. The background is almost entirely a whole wall of light beige-grey blank space. Use approximately 28–35mm equivalent mobile phone lens, the person is about 1.5–2 meters away from the mirror, the camera position is close to chest-abdomen height, maintaining realistic mobile phone mirror selfie perspective, no fisheye, no obvious background blur. The person has a very prominent but real and natural curvaceous hourglass adult female figure: medium-to-small bone structure, moderate-to-narrow shoulders, upper body is clearly full, chest volume is large but maintains a natural sense of gravity; quickly tapers below the chest into a clearly slender waistline, waist and abdomen are flat and soft; pelvis is wide, hips are rounded and spread to both sides, buttocks and hips are full, base of thighs is thick, legs are overall long and slender. Core proportions are full upper body + narrow waist + wide hips + full thighs + relatively slender calves, no slender model type, no narrow hips and thin legs, no athletic muscular type, and no extreme wasp waist or exaggerated distorted proportions. The person adopts a clear S-shaped standing posture: the right leg serves as the main supporting leg, basically straight and standing vertically; the left leg extends diagonally towards the front left of the person, knee slightly bent, toes pointing outward, making the legs form a natural asymmetrical posture. The pelvis is clearly pushed out towards the person's right, the waist is tightened in the opposite direction, and the upper body is tilted slightly towards the person's left, forming a strong but natural waist-hip curve. Shoulders are relaxed, do not stand stiffly facing the front. The right hand is raised in front of the face, vertically holding a light grey-silver triple-camera smartphone for a selfie, the phone is located on the right side of the person's face and covers a small part of the face. The person lowers their head slightly to look at the phone screen, eyes half-closed or slightly squinted, lips naturally closed, expression calm and relaxed, no toothy smile. The left arm hangs naturally at the left side of the body, the left hand holds a soft white coat/sweatshirt, the garment is loosely draped over the left forearm and palm, the fabric hangs down to near the middle of the thigh, forming a large number of natural folds. Do not wear the white coat on the body. The person has a raven black short Bob hairstyle, length approximately between the chin and neck, the ends of the hair slightly curve inward, and the top of the head is naturally fluffy. The forehead has thin air bangs, the length of the bangs is close to the eyebrows, the center is slightly sparse, and the broken hair on both sides naturally stays close to the cheeks. No long hair, no curly hair, no thick straight bangs. The face shape is small and somewhat oval, the skin tone is fair and slightly warm, and the makeup is very natural. Eyes are dark brown, eyeliner is thin, eyelashes are clear but not excessively thick; eyebrows are naturally flat and straight, the bridge of the nose is small, and lips are nude pink. The skin retains slight real texture and natural luster, no excessive skin smoothing. The upper body wears a pure white tight-fitting short-sleeved sports Crop Top, low square neck/deep rounded square neck design, the neckline is wide and low, fully exposing the collarbone and upper chest area. The shoulders have very short tight sleeves, the fabric is soft and high-elastic, with slightly fine ribbing or athletic knit texture. The clothing is very tight-fitting, naturally tightening along the full upper body and slender waistline, the hem ends below the ribs and above the navel, fully exposing a section of slender waist and abdomen. There is a very small black 'alo' style simple logo in the very center of the chest, the size is very small, do not enlarge it into a big Logo. The lower body wears pure black high-waisted tight sports shorts, the waistline is near the navel or slightly lower, the waistband is tight against the slender waist, and the cut naturally fits along the wide hips and full buttocks. The leg length reaches the upper part of the thigh, belonging to short fitness hot pants, but not ultra-short underwear; the fabric is matte high-elastic sports fabric, overall pure black, no patterns, no pockets, no complex decorations. The leg openings fit the thighs, no loose sweatpants. The legs wear pure white knee-high sports socks, the sock height reaches about 2–4cm below the knee, the thickness is medium, and the ribbed cuffs are clear. The socks are overall pure white or slightly creamy white, no silk stockings, over-the-knee socks, or short socks. The feet wear a pair of white + light grey vintage chunky-soled running shoes/dad sneakers, the soles are thick, the upper is composed of white mesh, light grey synthetic leather, and silver-grey details, and the laces are white. The shoe shape has a strong sense of volume but maintains realistic sneaker proportions, the sole has clear layers and cushioning structure. No high heels, canvas shoes, or pure white flat shoes. The background must be extremely simple: a whole wall of low-saturation light grey-beige occupies the vast majority of the frame, with no furniture, hanging pictures, decorations, or text. There are a few slight scuffs and stains near the bottom of the wall, increasing the lived-in feel of a mirror in a real public space/gym locker area. On the far right side of the frame, a very narrow mirror frame or another mirror joint can be seen. The floor is covered with large-sized dark grey-brown square tiles, the grout lines are clear, and the floor tiles have a slight matte reflection. The person's feet are fully stepped on the tiled floor, the contact between the feet and the ground is real, not floating. The lighting is dim, soft indoor ceiling lights + ambient light in front of the mirror, no strong flash. The overall exposure of the person is slightly dark, the skin tone is naturally warm, the white top and long socks become the brightest areas of the frame, and the black shorts and black hair retain shadow details. The background wall appears grey-beige, and the frame has obvious mobile phone high ISO grain and a slight grey fog feel. The overall must present a real low-light mobile phone mirror selfie texture: slight digital noise, limited dynamic range, soft grey shadows, natural mobile phone sharpening, no commercial studio feel, no high-end fashion blockbuster quality. The background is basically clear, do not use portrait mode creamy blur. Key focus: Minimalist light grey empty wall + full-body floor-to-ceiling mirror selfie + short black Bob with air bangs + right hand holding light grey triple-camera phone + left hand carrying white coat + prominent hourglass figure with full upper body, very thin waist, wide hips and full thighs + S-shaped standing posture with pelvis pushed to the right + white low square-neck short-sleeved sports Crop Top + extremely small black alo-style logo on chest + black high-waisted tight sports shorts + white knee-high socks + white and grey chunky-soled vintage running shoes + dark grey-brown floor tiles + dim indoor light + obvious mobile phone noise. Avoid: Long hair, big waves, thick straight bangs, person standing stiffly facing forward, legs parallel, pelvis not shifted sideways, ordinary slender figure, narrow hips, thin thighs, athletic muscular type, extreme wasp waist, ordinary loose white T-shirt, high-neck sports top, long pants, yoga leggings, pleated skirt, black silk stockings, short socks, high heels, pure white flat shoes, wearing the white coat on the body, complex gym equipment, bedroom background, furniture, strong flash, bright studio light, heavy background blur, fisheye, ultra-wide angle distortion, excessive skin smoothing, plastic skin, CG feel, anime face, extra limbs, incorrect fingers.

prompts.text:
超写实室内全身镜自拍摄影，竖版约 4:5，一名年轻成年东亚女性站在极简现代室内的大型落地镜前自拍。画面从头顶完整拍到双脚，人物位于画面中央偏左，占画面高度约 80–85%，右侧保留一条窄窄的镜面边缘，背景几乎完全是一整面浅米灰色空白墙。采用约 28–35mm 等效手机镜头，人物距离镜面约 1.5–2 米，机位接近胸腹高度，保持真实手机镜面自拍透视，不使用鱼眼，不做明显背景虚化。

人物拥有非常明显但真实自然的丰满沙漏型成年女性身材：骨架中等偏小，肩部适中偏窄，上半身明显丰满，胸部体积较大但保持自然重力感；胸下迅速进入明显纤细腰线，腰腹平坦柔和；骨盆较宽，髋部圆润向两侧展开，臀胯丰满，大腿根部厚实，双腿整体修长。核心比例为丰满上身＋窄腰＋宽胯＋丰满大腿＋相对纤细小腿，不要纤细模特型、窄胯细腿、健美肌肉型，也不要极端蜂腰或夸张失真比例。

人物采用明显的 S 型站姿：右腿作为主要支撑腿，基本伸直并垂直站立；左腿向人物左前方斜伸，膝盖轻微弯曲，脚尖朝外，使双腿形成自然不对称姿势。骨盆明显向人物右侧推出，腰部向相反方向收紧，上半身轻微向人物左侧倾斜，形成很强但自然的腰臀曲线。肩膀放松，不要正面僵直站立。

右手抬至脸部前方，竖直握一部浅灰银色三摄智能手机自拍，手机位于人物脸部右侧并遮住一小部分脸。人物低头微微看向手机屏幕，眼睛半闭或轻轻眯起，嘴唇自然闭合，表情平静、放松，不露齿笑。

左臂自然垂在身体左侧，左手握住一件柔软的白色外套/卫衣，衣服松散地搭在左前臂和手掌上，布料向下垂至大腿中部附近，形成大量自然褶皱。不要把白色外套穿在身上。

人物留乌黑色短 Bob 发型，长度约到下巴和颈部之间，发尾轻微向内收，头顶自然蓬松。额前为轻薄空气刘海，刘海长度接近眉毛，中央略稀疏，两侧碎发自然贴近脸颊。不要长发、卷发、厚重齐刘海。

脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，肤色白皙偏暖，妆容非常自然。眼睛深棕色，眼线细，睫毛清楚但不过分浓密；眉毛自然偏平直，鼻梁小巧，嘴唇裸粉色。皮肤保留轻微真实纹理和自然光泽，不要过度磨皮。

上身穿一件纯白色贴身短袖运动 Crop Top，低方领/深圆角方领设计，领口宽而低，完整露出锁骨和上胸区域。肩部为很短的贴身袖子，面料是柔软高弹、略带细密罗纹或运动针织纹理。衣服非常贴身，顺着丰满上身和纤细腰线自然收紧，衣摆结束在肋骨下方、肚脐上方，完整露出一段纤细腰腹。胸前正中央有一个非常小的黑色“alo”风格简洁标识，尺寸很小，不要放大成大 Logo。

下身穿纯黑色高腰紧身运动短裤，腰线位于肚脐附近或略低，裤腰紧贴纤细腰部，裤型顺着宽胯和丰满臀部自然贴合。裤腿长度到大腿上部，属于短款健身热裤，但不是超短内裤；面料为哑光高弹运动布料，整体纯黑，无图案、无口袋、无复杂装饰。裤脚贴合大腿，不要宽松运动裤。

双腿穿纯白色及膝运动长袜，袜筒高度达到膝盖下方约 2–4cm，厚度中等，罗纹袜口清楚。袜子整体纯白或略微偏奶白，不要丝袜、过膝袜或短袜。

prompts.text:
Theme:
Hydration time on the green field

Subject:
In the center of the frame, a green outdoor court, a woman in white sportswear is kneeling on both knees, holding a transparent water bottle in her left hand. White sneakers, gold wire mesh, and blurred trees show rest after exercise.

Character · Expression:
The woman's face is slightly tilted to the left of the frame, looking at the camera with a soft smile. Slightly long oval face and small chin, horizontally long eyes, thin and soft eyebrows, thin straight bridge of the nose, glossy peach lips. Long tea-colored hair parted in the middle, with thin front bangs and hair bundles by the cheeks, loose waves falling below the chest. Pale pink eye shadow and blush.

Clothing · Pose:
White thin shoulder strap ribbed sports top, with a horizontally long hollow-out design in the center below the chest. White short shorts tied with thin strings at both waists and with white piping. White socks and platform sneakers. Sitting with both knees on the court, left hand supporting the water bottle, right hand lightly touching the right shoe.

Background · Lighting:
Green turf covers from the foreground to the background, a gold wire mesh is placed diagonally on the right side of the frame, and thick green trees are blurred in the distance on the left. Soft sunlight from above evenly illuminates the face and white clothing.

Composition · Lens:
2:3 vertical composition, camera angle slightly higher than horizontal, capturing the full body from head to toe. The character is centered and enlarged, the water bottle is placed in the lower left, focus is on the character, softly blurring the background.

Texture · Style:
White ribbed fabric, transparent bottle, artificial turf, naturally presented bright realistic photo. Mainly white and green tones, refreshing and simple.

Negative Prompts:
Do not omit the water bottle; do not change the kneeling posture on both knees to a standing posture.

prompts.text: Ultra-realistic nighttime portrait photography inside a public transit carriage, vertical composition at approximately 3:4. A young adult East Asian woman sits alone on red-and-black plaid seats in a vintage public transit carriage. She is centered in the frame, photographed from the front at a slightly high, close-range angle. The framing extends from just above her head to near the soles of her boots, fully retaining the seats, both legs, and the window environment. Use an approximately 28–35mm full-frame-equivalent smartphone lens, with the camera positioned about 1.5–2 meters from the subject. Preserve the natural perspective of a casual smartphone snapshot. No fisheye distortion and no obvious background blur. The woman has a naturally full, distinctly curvy adult figure, with moderately broad shoulders, a full upper body, a clearly defined waist, wide hips and pelvis, and very full thighs, creating a natural hourglass silhouette. Emphasize realistic gravity and soft-tissue deformation in the seated position: her hips sink into the seat, and her thighs naturally spread, compress, and appear fuller due to crossing and weight-bearing, while her waist and abdomen retain a natural inward definition. Do not depict her as a slender fashion model or use extreme, anatomically implausible proportions. She lounges lazily against the center of the seat, her back resting against the seatback and her pelvis shifted slightly forward. Her upper body tilts subtly toward her right. Her legs are crossed in a wide, pronounced pose, with one leg laid horizontally over the other. The upper thigh extends almost across the center foreground, creating strong depth. The thigh closest to the camera is visibly enlarged by perspective and occupies a substantial portion of the lower-middle frame, while the other leg extends downward. The knees, hip joints, and leg connections must remain anatomically correct for a real seated pose. Her left arm is raised high, with the elbow bent toward the upper-left corner of the frame. Her left hand naturally holds a red beverage can above and beside her head. She wears a metal chain bracelet and rings on that wrist. The can should have realistic metallic reflections and red-and-white printed packaging, but no garbled or illegible brand text. Her right arm extends toward the right side of the frame, with the elbow resting naturally on the neighboring armrest or the edge of the seatback. Her forearm is raised, her wrist relaxed, and her fingers slightly curled, creating a casual, languid pose. A dark gray jacket has slipped extensively from both shoulders and hangs only from her arms and along the sides of her body, fully exposing her shoulders, neck, and white camisole. She has short black hair reaching between the chin and the neck, styled as a subtly layered short bob. The ends bend inward and outward in an irregular, natural way. The crown has soft volume, while the front features longer, slightly messy wispy bangs, with several strands falling around her eyebrows and eyes. No long hair, heavy blunt bangs, or exaggerated curls. Her face is small and softly oval, with a gentle jawline and naturally warm-toned skin. Her eyes are dark brown, narrow and slightly upturned, looking directly into the camera with a calm, mildly tired, nonchalant expression. She has naturally fine eyebrows, a small nose bridge, full lips with nude-pink lipstick, and a naturally closed mouth. Her makeup is extremely light, with slightly emphasized eyeliner and eyelashes and a faint natural flush on the cheeks. Her skin should show real pores, subtle variations in tone, and slightly dewy highlights created by the smartphone flash. Avoid porcelain-like airbrushing or overly smooth skin. She wears a fitted white ribbed spaghetti-strap tank top with a low scoop neckline. The material is soft, stretchy cotton with clearly visible fine vertical ribbing. It fits closely to the body and forms natural tension lines and folds around the waist and abdomen. Black underlayer straps and a small amount of black neckline trim are naturally visible inside the white straps. Around her neck is a very fine short gold necklace with a small gold pendant. Her outer layer is an oversized dark charcoal-gray knitted or heavy cotton zip-up jacket. It is completely open and has slipped off her shoulders. On the left side, the sleeve gathers around her forearm as her arm is raised. The right side also hangs loosely from her arm, creating abundant soft, natural folds. She wears extremely short, fitted, low-rise white shorts or under-shorts. Most of them are concealed by the crossed thighs and the hem of the white top, with only narrow white edges visible at the sides of the waist and hips. Her legs are bare and retain a natural skin texture. On her feet is a striking pair of vintage brown leather knee-high boots. The shafts rise close to the knees. The leather is distressed dark brown, with natural creasing, wear, uneven tones, and a vintage waxed texture. Wide leather straps with metal square buckles wrap around the tops of the boots. Additional straps, large metal ring buckles, and metal eyelets decorate the ankle area. The soles are thick, dark, and low-heeled. The boot closest to the camera creates strong foreground perspective in the lower-right corner, with crisp, visible details. The scene takes place inside a moving public transit carriage at night. The woman sits between two adjacent seats upholstered in a fine red, black, and white plaid pattern. The fabric features a rich vintage-red tartan design, with clearly visible gray plastic armrests and seat frames and realistic woven texture. A small black leather handbag rests on the empty seat to her left. The bag is soft and slightly worn, with short handles, clearly visible gold-colored hardware, and a zipper. Directly behind her is a large black window. Outside is completely dark. The glass shows dust, water stains, and subtle reflections. Because of the interior lighting and camera flash, the window clearly reflects the backs of passengers in the rear rows, the silhouettes of seats, and a small bright spot near the photographer, creating the authentic feeling of a nighttime public transit snapshot. Preserve the white-gray metal carriage structure, black window frame, and a few yellow handrails above the window. A small blue-green exit sign may appear in the upper-left corner, but avoid large areas of readable text. The lighting combines close-range direct smartphone flash with dim carriage ceiling lights. The flash comes directly from the camera’s direction, brightly illuminating the woman’s face, shoulders, neck, arms, thighs, and white tank top. Her skin displays delicate but pronounced highlights. The crossed foreground thigh is one of the brightest areas in the image. The dark gray jacket and background quickly fall into shadow. The red plaid seats remain saturated without becoming overexposed. The window is almost completely black, reflecting the flash point and silhouettes of people and objects inside the carriage. The overall image should feel like an authentic casual social-media snapshot taken during nighttime public transit travel, with a subtle early-2000s direct-flash digital-camera aesthetic: light high-ISO grain, limited dynamic range, localized sharpening, and slightly hard flash shadows. The woman remains sharp while the background is still recognizable. Avoid the polished appearance of commercial studio photography and do not apply cinematic color grading. Key elements to preserve: red-and-black plaid public transit seats, a black reflective nighttime window, the woman centered and lounging against the seat, a naturally full hourglass figure, one full thigh crossing horizontally through the foreground, her left hand raising a red beverage can, her right arm resting toward the adjacent armrest, short tousled black bobbed hair, a white ribbed spaghetti-strap tank top, an oversized dark gray jacket slipped off the shoulders, narrow edges of white shorts, distressed vintage brown knee-high buckle boots, a black handbag on the left seat, direct frontal smartphone flash, and an authentic nighttime atmosphere.

prompts.text:
A striking Chinese woman with a polished, confident demeanor sits gracefully on a smooth, weathered piece of driftwood near the water's edge, embodying a relaxed yet chic summer aesthetic. Her posture is elegant and grounded, with one leg bent and the other extended slightly, creating a strong, natural silhouette that balances the softness of the environment with her poised presence. She wears a distinctive minimalist white denim apron featuring an overall-inspired construction that serves as her primary garment. The design includes a low-set bib front with a wide open neckline, allowing the fabric to drape naturally against her torso, while two sturdy white denim shoulder straps extend upward, secured with visible metal adjusters that catch the light with subtle metallic glints. The apron features open sides with ties secured neatly around her waist, and a clearly defined separate front panel that ends at the upper thighs, showcasing the authentic white denim weave, precise stitching, and realistic fabric folds that respond to her movement and the gentle sea breeze.

Her expression is restrained and serene, capturing a moment of quiet contemplation as she gazes softly toward the horizon, her bare shoulders and arms exposed to the warm coastal air. The environment is a pristine, expansive beach with fine, pale sand stretching out to meet a calm, turquoise ocean under a clear sky. The natural tension and draping of the apron fabric are highlighted by the soft, directional sunlight of late afternoon, which casts gentle, realistic shadows that define the contours of her figure and the texture of the denim. This lighting offers a natural white balance that enhances the crisp whiteness of the apron against the warm tones of her skin and the cool blues of the sea, creating a harmonious color palette typical of high-end contemporary summer photography.

The image is captured with the clarity of naturalistic digital photography, exhibiting believable autofocus and clean dynamic range, avoiding any artificial CGI polish or excessive noise. The composition utilizes a medium-full shot from a slightly elevated angle, placing the subject in the lower third of the frame to emphasize the vastness of the beach and sky behind her. The depth of field is shallow enough to keep her sharply in focus while softly blurring the distant waves and horizon, ensuring that the intricate details of the denim texture and her poised gesture remain the central visual interest. The aspect ratio is 4:5, framing the scene with a balanced vertical orientation that highlights her elegant stance and the serene coastal atmosphere.

70–85mm 人像镜头，电影级柔和侧逆光，暖金轮廓光勾勒花冠、发丝、肩颈、珠宝与披帛边缘，面部自然补光，双眼精准对焦。高清 8K 细节，真实皮肤、丝绸、薄纱、刺绣、宝石与金属质感，自然浅景深，轻微电影柔光与细腻胶片质感。整体低饱和浅青绿、象牙白、淡粉、赭红与柔金色调，清雅、庄重、华丽、空灵而具有东方神性美感。

prompts.text:
**Photorealistic vertical 1990s Hong Kong nighttime snapshot.**

A clearly adult **20-year-old Hong Kong female influencer** wearing a historically inspired **1990s Royal Hong Kong Policewoman cosplay uniform**. Large expressive eyes, realistic doll-like facial features, subtle makeup, natural skin texture, feminine hourglass figure, believable anatomy.

She wears a fitted **muted olive/khaki-green short-sleeved police shirt** with pointed collar, two chest pockets, shoulder epaulettes, dark buttons, black whistle lanyard and simple black leather duty belt, paired with a **matching short above-knee tailored uniform skirt** inspired by late-1980s to mid-1990s Royal Hong Kong Police female uniforms.

She wears a **dark navy female bowler-style police hat** with compact rounded crown, short black visor and centered silver British-era police badge. A compact period-style radio is clipped near her chest. No modern tactical gear.

She stands tensely on a **Hong Kong street at night**, her body slightly angled sideways to the camera. She holds a **Smith & Wesson Model 10 short-barrel revolver with both hands**, both arms **fully extended forward in a ready-to-fire pose**.

Her shoulders and posture show controlled tension. She has a **serious, focused expression** and is **not looking at the camera**; her eyes are fixed intensely toward something outside the frame in the direction of the revolver, as if responding to an uncertain situation during nighttime patrol.

The scene should feel like a candid moment caught just before action rather than a glamour pose.

Behind her are a **period-appropriate 1990s Hong Kong police patrol car and a Hong Kong police motorcycle**, both partly visible. The patrol car headlights are on and **red-and-blue roof lights are flashing**, casting irregular colored reflections across her face, uniform, revolver and the wet-looking asphalt.

Dark Hong Kong roadway, roadside barriers, sodium-vapor streetlights, faint period road signs and distant apartment blocks.

**Vertical cowboy shot, mid-thigh to just above the hat, subject filling about 75–80% of frame. Slight low angle, close 28–35mm point-and-shoot perspective, imperfect handheld framing and slightly tilted horizon.**

**Authentic late-1990s to early-2000s lo-fi consumer 35mm snapshot photography.** Cheap compact point-and-shoot camera, soft imperfect focus, slightly missed autofocus, subtle handheld shake, mild motion softness and weak micro-detail.

**Heavy coarse irregular 35mm grain**, uneven exposure, washed or blown highlights, murky faded shadows and hazy midtones. Muted aged colors, imperfect white balance, green-cyan shadows, warm yellowish streetlight highlights, subdued saturation and slight analog color bleeding.

Red-and-blue police lights softly bloom and bleed across her hat, face, arms and uniform. Headlights become partially blown glowing patches. Soft faded contrast, faint halation, slight haze, minor chromatic aberration and cheap-lens softness.

Looks like an **old drugstore-developed 35mm print poorly scanned at low resolution**: faded texture, dust, tiny scratches, scan noise and compression softness.

**Almost a failed photograph — tense, blurry, grainy, unevenly exposed and poorly scanned, yet believable and nostalgic.**

**Avoid:** looking at camera, smiling, glamour posing, finger-gun gestures, oversized handgun, semi-automatic pistol, long-barrel revolver, modern tactical gear, body armor, modern light-blue Hong Kong Police uniforms, crisp digital sharpness, HDR, polished cinematic grading, studio lighting, perfect autofocus, excessive bokeh, pristine film scan, plastic skin, CGI cleanliness or obvious AI aesthetics.

prompts.text:
写实主义垂直90年代香港夜间快照。

一位显而易见的成年20岁香港女性网红，穿着受历史启发、具有1990年代风格的皇家香港女警角色扮演制服。大而富有表现力的眼睛，写实的玩偶般面部特征，细微的妆容，自然的皮肤纹理，柔美的沙漏型身材，可信的人体解剖结构。

她穿着一件合身的、色调柔和的橄榄色/卡其绿色短袖警察衬衫，带有尖领、两个胸前口袋、肩章、深色纽扣、黑色哨绳和简单的黑色皮革勤务腰带，搭配一条配套的膝盖以上短款裁剪制服裙，其灵感源自1980年代后期至1990年代中期的皇家香港警察女性制服。

她戴着一顶深蓝色女性圆顶帽风格的警帽，帽顶紧凑圆润，配有短黑帽檐和居中的银色英殖时期警察徽章。一个紧凑的年代感无线电对讲机夹在她的胸前附近。没有现代战术装备。

她紧张地站在夜晚的香港街道上，身体微微侧向镜头。她双手持有一把史密斯威森10型短枪管左轮手枪，双臂完全向前伸出，呈现预备射击姿态。

她的肩膀和姿态展现出受控的紧张感。她表情严肃、专注，没有注视镜头；她的眼睛紧盯着框架外沿着左轮手枪方向的某个地方，仿佛正在应对夜间巡逻中的不确定情况。

场景感觉应该像是一个在行动前被捕捉到的瞬间，而不是一张魅力摆拍。

她身后有一辆符合年代感的1990年代香港警察巡巡逻车和一辆香港警察摩托车，均部分可见。巡逻车的车灯亮着，红蓝车顶灯正在闪烁，在她的脸部、制服、左轮手枪和看起来湿漉漉的柏油路上投射下不规则的彩色反光。

黑暗的香港车道、路边护栏、高压钠路灯、模糊的年代感路标和远处的公寓大楼。

垂直牛仔镜头，从大腿中部到帽子上方，主体占据画面约75–80%。轻微低角度，接近28–35mm傻瓜相机透视，不完美的手持构图和略微倾斜的地平线。

真实的1990年代后期至2000年代初期低保真消费级35mm快照摄影。廉价紧凑型傻瓜相机，柔和且不完美的焦距，轻微的自动对焦失误，微妙的手持抖动，轻微的运动模糊和微弱的细节。

沉重粗糙且不规则的35mm颗粒，不均匀的曝光，褪色或过曝的高光，阴暗褪色的阴影和朦胧的中间调。柔和的老化色彩，不完美的白平衡，青绿色的阴影，暖黄色的路灯高光，低饱和度和轻微的模拟色彩溢出。

红蓝警灯在她的帽子、脸部、手臂和制服上柔和地晕染和溢出。大灯变成部分过曝的发光斑块。柔和褪色的对比度，微弱的光晕，轻微的薄雾，轻微的色差和廉价镜头的柔和感。

看起来像是在药店冲洗的老旧35mm照片被低分辨率糟糕扫描后的样子：褪色的质感、灰尘、微小的划痕、扫描噪点和压缩模糊。

几乎是一张失败的照片——紧张、模糊、多颗粒、曝光不均且扫描粗糙，但却真实且令人怀旧。

避免：注视镜头、微笑、魅力摆拍、指枪手势、过大的手枪、半自动手枪、长管左轮手枪、现代战术装备、防弹衣、现代浅蓝色香港警察制服、锐利的数字清晰度、HDR、抛光的电影级调色、摄影棚灯光、完美的自动对焦、过度的焦外虚化、原始的胶片扫描、塑料皮肤、CGI般的整洁感或明显的AI美学。

prompts.text:
Create a premium vertical 4:5 stylized travel poster for [COUNTRY], designed as an imaginative handcrafted illustration rather than a realistic depiction.

Create ONE continuous flowing hand-drawn ink illustration where the country’s architecture, landscapes, culture, food, transportation, nature and everyday details merge naturally into one playful artistic scene.

The artwork should feel clearly illustrated and intentionally non-realistic — use simplified shapes, expressive line work, slightly exaggerated proportions, whimsical perspective and charming artistic imperfections. Do not make the buildings, people, objects or landscapes look like real photographs.

Include:

• One dominant iconic landmark as the main visual focus
• A second architectural landmark subtly woven into the composition
• A recognizable natural landscape in the background
• Local transportation represented in a simplified illustrated style
• Traditional clothing or a cultural detail
• A recognizable local food or drink
• Small fictionalized street-life moments
• Birds, clouds, plants and decorative details integrated throughout
• Handwritten illustrated labels pointing toward selected elements

Use bold black ink outlines, delicate cross-hatching, loose sketch marks, imperfect hand-drawn contours and subtle screen-print texture.

Keep the illustration mostly flat and graphic, with minimal shading and no realistic lighting. Use a warm off-white paper background with generous clean negative space.

Use only 2–3 muted accent colors inspired by [COUNTRY]. Keep colors slightly imperfect like traditional screen printing.

At the top, add a large playful hand-lettered title:

“[COUNTRY]”

Below it, add a tiny elegant subtitle:

“A little world to discover”

The overall composition should feel whimsical, editorial, nostalgic, artistic and handcrafted, like a page from an imaginary vintage travel sketchbook.

Avoid:
photorealism, realistic photography, cinematic realism, hyperrealistic people, realistic textures, 3D rendering, glossy surfaces, gradients, dramatic lighting, realistic faces, overly accurate architectural rendering, excessive colors, digital-perfect geometry, generic tourist-poster layouts.

The final image must look unmistakably like a premium illustrated travel journal poster, not a photograph or AI-generated realistic scene.

prompts.text:
为[国家]创作一张高品质的纵向 4:5 风格化旅行海报，设计为极具想象力的手工艺插画，而非写实描绘。

创作一张连续流动的、手绘墨水插画，将该国家的建筑、景观、文化、美食、交通、自然和日常生活细节自然地融合成一个充满趣味的艺术场景。

艺术作品应具有明显的插画感，且刻意追求非写实——使用简化的形状、富有表现力的线条、略显夸张的比例、奇思妙想的透视和迷人的艺术瑕疵。不要让建筑、人物、物体或风景看起来像真实的摄影照片。

包含：

• 一个占主导地位的标志性地标作为视觉中心
• 第二个建筑地标巧妙地编织在构图中
• 背景中可辨识的自然景观
• 以简化的插画风格呈现的当地交通工具
• 传统服饰或文化细节
• 一种可辨识的当地美食或饮品
• 小型的虚构化街头生活瞬间
• 贯穿其中的鸟类、云朵、植物和装饰性细节
• 指向选定元素的手写插图标签

使用大胆的黑色墨水轮廓、精致的交叉排线、松散的草图痕迹、不完美的手绘轮廓和细微的丝网印刷纹理。

保持插画大部分为扁平和图形化，阴影极少，没有写实光影。使用温暖的米白色纸张背景，并留出大量洁净的负空间。

仅使用 2–3 种灵感来自[国家]的柔和点缀色。保持颜色略微不完美，如同传统的丝网印刷。

在顶部，添加一个巨大的趣味性手写标题：

“[国家]”

在其下方，添加一个小而优雅的副标题：

“A little world to discover”（一个小世界，等你发现）

整体构图应具有奇幻、编辑感、怀旧感、艺术感和手工艺感，就像一本想象中的复古旅行素描本中的一页。

避免：
照相写实主义、写实摄影、电影感写实主义、超写实人物、写实纹理、3D 渲染、光滑表面、渐变、戏剧性光影、写实脸部、过于精确的建筑渲染、过多的颜色、数字化的完美几何图形、平庸的旅游海报布局。

最终图像必须看起来完全像是高品质的插图旅行日记海报，而不是照片或 AI 生成的写实场景。

prompts.text:
Create a flagship commercial advertising poster for an original chewy fruit-candy brand named "CITRUS POP", combining Orbit energy with Port symbol power. Use ultra-realistic product photography with premium FMCG compositing, not illustration, not 3D cartoon render. Keep the same core structural logic: a vivid orange full-frame poster, one joyful young woman in the left-center immersed in a burst of fruity freshness, one hero candy roll held forward in her hand as the absolute product focus, giant oversized background typography, explosive juice motion around the frame, sliced oranges and glossy candy pieces suspended in motion, and a clean minimal benefit strip along the bottom. The candy roll must remain the absolute product hero at all times.

Style lock: high-energy FMCG candy advertising, ultra-clean commercial realism, crisp pack-shot quality, premium fruit-fresh concept, product-first hierarchy, saturated citrus-orange palette, polished studio portrait integration, globally launch-ready campaign visual.

Core composition: one realistic young woman positioned left-center in three-quarter view, head tilted slightly back, eyes gently closed, expression refreshed and euphoric. Her near hand extends the candy roll toward camera in the lower-left foreground, and the pack must be the sharpest, clearest, and most readable object in the entire image. Behind her, a giant oversized freshness word occupies the upper background as an architectural graphic layer. Around the woman and product, build one strong circular citrus eruption that wraps the scene and visually returns to the candy roll.

Port logic: turn the combination of the candy roll and the orange burst ring into the brand’s super-symbol. The product should feel like the core source of the citrus explosion, while the surrounding circular juice-and-fruit arc becomes its signature energy halo. The viewer should remember the image as "the candy roll inside the orange burst." The symbol must feel ownable, immediate, and iconic.

Orbit logic: shape the splash, fruit slices, floating dragees, droplets, and flowing hair into one coherent circular motion path. The eye should begin at the hero pack, rise through the woman’s face, sweep into the giant headline, circle through the orange burst ring, and resolve back at the product. The motion must feel juicy, explosive, and controlled, never chaotic.

Product concept: redesign the product as "CITRUS POP Orange Chews", a chewy fruity fresh candy roll with bright citrus energy. The pack should be premium, playful, and globally shelf-ready, with a white-and-cobalt master wordmark, glossy orange wrapper ends, fresh citrus cues, and compact claims such as "juicy chew" and "bursting orange". All text must be original.

Female character: one realistic young adult woman with natural anatomy, correct hand structure, five fingers only, realistic skin texture, soft pores, natural lips, believable eyelids, and dynamic flowing hair. She wears a fresh orange-toned jacket or hoodie. Her pose must feel natural and open, with one hand presenting the pack and the body visually connected to the citrus burst.

Lighting: bright warm commercial lighting with a soft frontal key light on the face and product pack, plus glowing citrus backlight through the splash ring. Use crisp highlights on the candy roll, glossy droplets, orange pulp, and wet surfaces. Keep shadows soft and controlled. No muddy oranges, no dead black zones.

Materials and realism: realistic candy roll wrapper print, crisp foil-and-paper texture, believable hand grip, natural skin rendering, semi-translucent juice splash, juicy orange flesh texture, glossy candy dragees, sparkling droplets, and energetic yet physically coherent fluid motion. Every element must obey premium advertising lighting logic.

Typography and layout: use original English text only, never copy any existing wording. Place one giant top background word such as "BURST" or "FRESH" in oversized bold lettering. Add a central slogan such as "CHEW THE SUN." or "UNWRAP THE BURST." Add one compact circular seal with short copy such as "bursting with orange". Along the bottom, place a minimal benefit strip with concise labels such as "fruity fresh", "juicy chew", "long-lasting", and "shareable joy". Typography must be bold, architectural, and secondary to the candy roll.

Color strategy: dominant electric orange, citrus gold, warm tangerine, white highlights, cobalt brand lettering, and tiny green leaf accents. Keep the palette saturated, joyful, premium, and tightly controlled.

Quality and physical rules: extremely sharp hero pack, readable label, correct hand anatomy, believable splash flow, clean edge separation, premium citrus detail, no clutter, no warped pack, no deformed face, no extra fingers, no muddy gradients, no low-resolution fluid effects. The candy roll and its orange burst ring must remain the strongest visual sales trigger at all times.

Negative prompt: copied branding, copied slogan, weak product hierarchy, blurry pack, unreadable label, distorted hand, extra fingers, fused fingers, plastic skin, deformed face, muddy orange background, chaotic splash effects, excessive fantasy clutter, cheap retail flyer aesthetic, cartoon rendering, CGI toy look, low-resolution pack detail, product losing dominance.

prompts.text:
为名为“CITRUS POP”的原创嚼劲水果糖品牌创作一张旗舰商业广告海报，结合 Orbit 能量与 Port 符号力量。使用超写实产品摄影与高端快消品（FMCG）合成技术，而非插图，也不是 3D 卡通渲染。保持相同的核心结构逻辑：一张生动的全画幅橙色海报，左中位置有一名沉浸在水果新鲜爆发中的愉悦年轻女性，手中向前握着一卷作为绝对产品核心的主视觉糖果卷，背景有巨大的超大号版式，画框周围有爆发性的果汁动态，悬浮着切开的橙子和光泽的糖果块，底部有一条简洁精干的效益条。糖果卷在任何时候都必须保持为绝对的产品主角。

风格锁定：高能量快消品糖果广告，超洁净商业现实主义，清晰的包装拍摄质量，高端水果新鲜概念，产品优先层级，饱和的柑橘橙色调，精致的摄影棚人像结合，全球发布的活动视觉。

核心构图：一名真实的年轻女性位于左中位置，呈现四分之三侧面观，头微后仰，双眼微闭，表情清新愉悦。她靠近的这只手向镜头伸出糖果卷，位于左下方前景，包装必须是整个图像中最锐利、最清晰、最易读的物体。在她身后，一个巨大的超大号新鲜单词作为建筑图形层占据上方背景。环绕着女性和产品，构建一个强大的圆形柑橘喷发，包裹整个场景并视觉上回归到糖果卷。

Port 逻辑：将糖果卷与橙色喷发环的组合转化为品牌的超级符号。产品应该感觉像是柑橘爆炸的核心源头，而周围的圆形果汁和水果弧线则成为其标志性的能量光环。观众应该将该图像记忆为“橙色喷发中的糖果卷”。该符号必须具有归属感、即时感且具象化。

Orbit 逻辑：将喷溅、水果片、漂浮的糖粒、水滴和飘动的头发塑造成一条连贯的圆周运动路径。视线应从主角包装开始，穿过女性的面部上升，扫入巨大的标题，绕过橙色喷发环，并重新回到产品上。动态必须感觉多汁、爆发且受控，绝不混乱。

产品概念：将产品重新设计为“CITRUS POP Orange Chews”，一种带有明亮柑橘能量的嚼劲水果新鲜糖果卷。包装应该是高端、俏皮且全球上架可用的，带有白蓝相间的主字标、光泽的橙色包装边缘、新鲜的柑橘暗示，以及如“juicy chew”和“bursting orange”等简短声明。所有文字必须是原创的。

女性角色：一名真实的年轻女性，具有自然的解剖结构，正确的手部结构，仅五根手指，真实的皮肤纹理，细腻的毛孔，自然的嘴唇，可信的眼睑，以及动态飘动的头发。她穿着一件新鲜橙色调的外套或连帽衫。她的姿势必须感觉自然大方，一只手展示包装，身体在视觉上与柑橘喷发相连。

灯光：明亮的暖色商业灯光，面部和产品包装上有柔和的前部主灯，加上穿过喷溅环的柔和柑橘背光。在糖果卷、光泽的水滴、橙子果肉和湿润表面上使用清晰的高光。保持阴影柔和受控。没有浑浊的橙色，没有死黑区域。

材质与写实感：真实的糖果卷包装印刷，清晰的箔纸与纸张纹理，可信的手部握持，自然的皮肤渲染，半透明的果汁喷溅，多汁的橙子果肉纹理，光泽的糖果颗粒，晶莹的水滴，以及充满能量但物理连贯的流体运动。每个元素都必须遵循高端广告灯光逻辑。

版式与布局：仅使用原创英文文本，绝不复制任何现有措辞。在上方背景放置一个巨大的单词，如“BURST”或“FRESH”，采用超大号粗体字。添加一个中央口号，如“CHEW THE SUN.”或“UNWRAP THE BURST.”。添加一个紧凑的圆形印章，带有如“bursting with orange”等简短文案。沿底部放置一个极简的效益条，带有如“fruity fresh”、“juicy chew”、“long-lasting”和“shareable joy”等简洁标签。版式必须大胆、具有建筑感，且次于糖果卷。

色彩策略：主导性的电光橙、柑橘金、暖橘红、白色高光、钴蓝色品牌字标和微小的绿叶装饰。保持色调饱和、愉悦、高端且受到严格控制。

质量与物理规则：极其锐利的主角包装，可读的标签，正确的手部解剖，可信的喷溅流向，清晰的边缘分离，高端的柑橘细节，不杂乱，包装不变形，面部不畸形，没有多余手指，没有浑浊渐变，没有低分辨率流体效果。糖果卷及其橙色喷发环在任何时候都必须保持最强的视觉销售触发力。

负面提示：复制的品牌，复制的口号，薄弱的产品层级，模糊的包装，不可读的标签，扭曲的手部，多余的手指，融合的手指，塑料皮肤，畸形的面部，浑浊的橙色背景，混乱的喷溅效果，过度的幻想杂物，廉价的零售传单美学，卡通渲染，CGI 玩具感，低分辨率包装细节，产品失去主导地位。

prompts.text:
864×1536px, 9:16. Ultra-realistic private smartphone selfie. An adult Japanese woman in her early 20s, sitting on the edge of a bed in a hotel-style room with calm tones, taking a selfie with the front camera just after touching her loosely tied back hair with her fingers. Arms are not fully extended, the distance is quite close. The entire face is the main subject, a close-up from the head to the neck and near the collarbone. The frame is slightly tilted, with the face positioned slightly to the left of the center. Not a symmetrical frontal shot like an ID photo.

Large, deep natural brown eyes, slightly upturned eyes with naturally drooping corners, and plump, thick tear bags on the lower eyelids. The tear bags are not artificially emphasized white lines, but naturally present three-dimensionality through soft protrusion, blood color, indoor light reflections, and faint shadows on the underside. Round and gentle eyes, a slender and clean bridge of the nose, small and soft lips, and a slightly long oval facial contour. The front camera lens naturally meets the eyes, with a subtle smile as if just about to take a photo.

The hair is long dark brown hair loosely tied into a bun at the back of the head, keeping thin bangs and wisps of hair around the face. Thin strands of hair fall at the temples and cheeks, and the tied hair has a slightly messy feel. Translucent pink-beige makeup. Pale mauve-brown eyelids, thin eyeliner, distinct natural lashes, extremely faint light and shadow on the tear bags, thin pink cheeks, and natural glossy pink-beige lipstick.

Light gray soft knit top. The background includes beige walls, a slightly messy bed, indirect lighting by the bedside, half-closed curtains, a small bag and a plastic bottle placed by the bed. In the warm indirect lighting at night, extremely weak bluish outdoor light from the window is mixed in. There is soft contrast between light and dark on the cheeks, tear bags, bridge of the nose, and lips, and subtle light enters the wisps of hair.

Retains the slight wide-angle feel characteristic of the front camera, the intimacy of close range, slight frame tilt, and soft focus, but facial features and expressions are clearly visible. The skin retains natural texture with non-exaggerated pores, blood color, and subtle color differences, not homogenized like an applied beauty filter. Not like cutting out the person alone, but integrated with the same lighting, color temperature, and resolution as the background. Avoid AI-style smooth skin, plastic texture, excessive beauty processing, overly neat image quality like advertising photos, mass-produced face shapes, and unnatural fixed poses.

items.title: 智能自适应艺术排版视觉语言提示词

prompts.text:
For the lower half, use the uploaded reference image as the basis for a new visual language and presentation logic. The reconstruction should feel highly intelligent, adaptive, and conceptually strong rather than following a fixed template. Interpret the original photograph first, then spontaneously generate a small set of simplified visual symbols, abstract shapes, poetic fragments, and graphic relationships that are genuinely connected to its subject, mood, action, or hidden meaning.

The layout should feel intuitive, improvised, and almost casually assembled, yet remain visually sophisticated and perfectly responsive to the theme. Avoid rigid grids or overly calculated symmetry. Allow elements to float, shift, overlap, separate, or form unexpected relationships across generous negative space, as if they were fragments of visual thought placed naturally on a page. Each photograph should generate its own unique composition rather than repeating the same arrangement.

Use a tactile, handmade editorial language inspired by the reference image: simple cut-paper-like shapes, softly imperfect silhouettes, hand-drawn marks, loose geometric forms, subtle grain, paper texture, lightly printed or stamped surfaces, naïve symbolic imagery, and occasional handwritten text. Forms may be extremely simple—even childlike at first glance—but their selection and placement should reveal an intelligent interpretation of the photograph.

Instead of literally reconstructing the photographed scene, translate its essential meaning into a small visual vocabulary. A person, object, gesture, landscape, architectural detail, weather condition, or spatial relationship may become an unexpected symbol, metaphor, diagram, or poetic association. Different visual fragments may communicate different layers of the same idea, creating a loose visual conversation rather than a single literal illustration.

Typography should also feel spontaneous and context-sensitive. Use only a few meaningful words, short phrases, poetic observations, or conceptual notes generated specifically from the image. Text may appear handwritten, lightly typeset, tilted, offset, or placed in seemingly accidental locations, but its position should always strengthen the visual rhythm and thematic meaning. It should feel like a private annotation, fleeting thought, visual diary entry, or poetic observation rather than conventional poster information.

The final result should combine the freedom of an artist’s sketchbook, the intelligence of editorial art direction, the intimacy of a visual diary, and the restraint of an independent art publication. It should feel playful, poetic, slightly naïve, tactile, and spontaneous, while still being highly intentional, refined, and conceptually precise.

prompts.text:
对于下半部分，使用上传的参考图像作为新视觉语言和表现逻辑的基础。重建应该感觉高度智能、具有自适应性且概念性强，而不是遵循固定模板。首先解读原始照片，然后自发地生成一小组简化的视觉符号、抽象形状、诗意碎片和图形关系，这些元素应与照片的主题、情感、动作或隐含意义真正相连。

布局应感觉直观、即兴且几乎是随性组装的，但仍保持视觉上的精致，并与主题完美契合。避免僵硬的网格或过度计算的对称。允许元素在广阔的负空间中漂浮、移动、重叠、分离或形成意想不到的关系，仿佛它们是自然放置在页面上的视觉思维碎片。每张照片都应生成其独特的构图，而不是重复相同的排列。

使用受参考图像启发的触感、手工社论语言：简单的剪纸状形状、柔和的不完美轮廓、手绘标记、松散的几何形式、微细的颗粒感、纸张纹理、轻微印刷或盖印的表面、天真的符号意象以及偶尔出现的手写文字。形式可能非常简单——初看之下甚至是稚气的——但它们的选择和布局应揭示出对照片的智能解读。

不要字面上重建拍摄的场景，而是将其本质含义转化为一小组视觉词汇。人、物体、手势、景观、建筑细节、天气状况或空间关系可能变成意想不到的符号、隐喻、图表或诗意联想。不同的视觉碎片可能传达同一想法的不同层面，创造一种松散的视觉对话，而不是单一的字面插图。

排版也应感觉自发且对上下文敏感。仅使用从图像中专门生成的几个有意义的单词、短语、诗意观察或概念笔记。文字可能以手写、轻微排版、倾斜、偏移或出现在看似偶然的位置，但其位置应始终加强视觉节奏和主题意义。它应该感觉像私人注释、转瞬即逝的想法、视觉日记条目或诗意观察，而不是常规的海报信息。

最终结果应结合艺术家素描本的自由、社论艺术指导的智能、视觉日记的亲密以及独立艺术出版物的克制。它应该感觉有趣、充满诗意、略显天真、具有触感且自发，同时仍然保持高度的意图性、精致感和概念上的精确。

prompts.text:
Subject:
Dinner with Rabbit and Lights

Main Subject:
In the center of the frame, on a dining table in a nighttime restaurant, a woman wearing a white dress holds a round white rabbit plush toy against the side of her face. The dishes on the white plate in front, wine glasses, and candles create a dinner atmosphere.

Character/Expression:
The woman turns her face slightly to the right side of the frame, looking directly into the camera with a calm expressionless face. Rounded oval face and small chin, large and horizontally long eyes, thin and loose eyebrows, small and rounded nose tip, thin upper lip and thick lower lip with reddish lip color. Bright skin tone, light pink eyeshadow and blush. Bright chestnut shoulder-length bob hair, a parting biased towards the center, thin bangs and hair tips turning inwards and outwards.

Clothing/Pose:
Ivory white thin-strap dress, low neckline decorated with fine ruffles, soft seams and ruffles below the waistline. Both elbows placed on the table, both hands supporting the round rabbit plush toy on the left side of the face. Wearing a thin necklace and bracelet.

Background/Light:
White plates and silver cutlery in the foreground, wine glasses and small flowers on the left side of the frame, background is a mirrored shop interior, bottles, and hanging lighting. The candle on the left side of the frame and the warm light source above softly illuminate the face and the white tablecloth.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 vertical composition, framing the seated figure from the waist up with a horizontal lens perspective. The rabbit is located on the left side of the face, and the food plate is in the foreground on the lower left, focusing on the person and the plush toy, rendering the background lighting as bokeh.

Texture/Style:
Warm amber-colored realistic photo. Delicately depicting the soft plush toy, the satin texture of the clothing, and the luster of the glass and food.

Negative:
Do not turn the white rabbit plush toy into another animal.

prompts.text: Ultra-realistic indoor bedroom close-up portrait photography, vertical orientation approximately 4:5. A young adult East Asian female is lying prone on a white bed, with the lens almost close to the bed surface, shot at a close distance from a position slightly to the right of the front of the subject. Using an approximately 28–35mm equivalent mobile phone/compact camera lens, about 45–70cm from the face, the camera position is slightly lower than the subject's face, creating a very distinct but natural depth perspective: the face and upper body are in the front right of the frame, closest to the lens; the waist and hips extend towards the back left of the frame; the legs are bent at the knees and raised upwards, with both feet located in the far upper left of the frame. The frame extends completely from the toes to the character's forearms, the character almost fills the entire frame, no fisheye used, no strong background blur. The character must maintain a very obvious naturally plump hourglass adult female figure: medium-to-small frame, moderate shoulders, significantly plump upper body, large and natural breast volume with a sense of real weight; the ribcage itself is not wide, the waist is clearly constricted, the pelvis and hips are wide, the buttocks are very plump, rounded, and thick, and the base of the thighs is full. In the prone position, the chest and torso receive natural support and slight compression from the bed surface, and the hips and pelvis form a clear rounded contour as the body extends backward. Do not generate a common slender model physique, do not have narrow hips, flat buttocks, or thin thighs, and do not have extreme athletic muscular types or distorted wasp waists. The character adopts a low-lying prone position: the abdomen and pelvis are close to the bed surface, the upper body is propped up by both forearms, the elbows are in front of the lens, and the shoulders are slightly pulled forward. The character's right forearm extends horizontally to the bottom of the frame, and the other arm is partially obscured by the body and composition. The chest and neck/shoulders are clearly close to the lens, but not completely upright, instead lying relaxed on the bed. The lower body extends towards the back left of the frame, the pelvis is slightly tilted towards the character's left, making the buttock contour form a clear arc in the middle-left of the frame. Both knees are simultaneously bent at about 90°, the lower legs are raised from the bed surface, the two lower legs are close together but do not completely overlap; both feet are raised high behind the character and tilted towards the upper left of the frame, the soles of the feet face the front side of the lens, forming a clear silhouette of the soles. The legs must have correct knee joint connections, no intersecting, merging, or extra legs. The character's head is located in the upper right center of the frame, the face is very close to the lens. The head is tilted slightly to the character's left, the chin is slightly raised, and both eyes look directly at the lens. The lips are slightly pouted/pursed, showing a natural slight pout expression, no teeth showing. The overall expression is quiet, slightly lazy, and has an intimate mobile phone close-up feel. The character has jet-black ultra-long straight hair, at least to the chest or even lower, thick and smooth hair volume. The top of the head is a natural middle part with a slight side part, there is a layer of thin and neat long air bangs on the forehead, the length is close to the eyebrows, and a few stray hairs naturally fall near the forehead and eyes. A large amount of long hair on the character's right side follows the shoulder down onto the bed surface and in front of the chest, forming a large deep black hair area; the hair on the left side partially extends to the back. No short hair, curly hair, or voluminous big waves. The face shape is small and oval, the jawline is soft, and the skin tone is fair and warm. The eyes are deep brown, large almond eyes, natural double eyelids, the eyeliner is thin and slightly extended outward; eyelashes are obvious and distinct, especially the upper lashes. Eyebrows are naturally flat and straight. The bridge of the nose is small and straight, and the tip of the nose is exquisite. The lips are naturally full, nude pink rose color, with a faint moist luster on the surface. The cheeks have a clear but soft pink blush, and the tip of the nose and under the eyes have a slightly pinkish tone. The skin retains real pores and minor skin tone variations, but the overall look is clean and bright, no excessive skin smoothing. The upper body wears a dark gray loose suit jacket, a boyfriend-style oversized blazer, the fabric is a medium-thickness gray suit wool with a clear twill/fine hair fabric texture. The collar of the jacket is completely open, the large peak lapels/notch lapels naturally flip to both sides; the shoulders are slightly wide, and the sleeves are long and form natural stacking at the forearms. The front of the jacket slides to both sides due to the prone position, revealing the internal black low-neck inner wear. The inner layer wears a black minimalist low-neck close-fitting inner wear/bustier-style top, pure black color, matte fabric, without complex lace or patterns. Only the chest and a small area below the chest are exposed, mostly covered by the gray suit jacket. Do not generate white inner wear, high-neck tops, or sports tank tops. The lower body wears black ultra-short tight-fitting bottoms/high-cut shorts, mainly located in the hip and pelvic area, mostly obscured by the body posture and gray jacket, only revealing the edges of the black fabric near the buttocks and hips. Maintain normal clothing coverage, do not generate skirts, jeans, or long pants. The legs wear white translucent thin silk stockings/pantyhose, continuously covering from the thighs to the toes. The material is very thin, about 10–20D, with an overall milky white translucent effect, which can reveal the natural skin tone and the silhouette of the toes. The stockings have fine fiber textures on the calves, ankles, and soles, appearing with soft silk-like reflections under close-up direct flash. The sole area is slightly more transparent due to the stretching of the stocking material, the outline of the soles, heels, and toes are naturally visible, but still clearly covered by the white thin silk stockings. Do not generate thick white cotton socks, over-the-knee socks, bare feet, or shoes. The bedding is simple white/warm white sheets and duvets, the character's forearms and torso are pressed on the soft bed surface, the sheets form a large number of natural indentations and wrinkles. Soft white fabric is visible on the left side of the frame and under the character's body, do not have exquisite hotel-style bed-making, maintain a real sense of home use. The background is very simple and dark: the back is a light gray-white wall, in the upper left/back left there is a dark doorway or corridor entrance, which is entirely cast in shadow; the wall in the back right is basically blank, without complex furniture, decorative paintings, bedside tables, or lamps. There is very little background information, the character becomes the absolute subject. The photographic lighting uses obvious close-up smartphone/portable digital camera front direct flash. The flash directly illuminates the character's face, chest, shoulders, arms, and the foreground sheets from the lens direction, making the skin appear fair and bright, producing clear but not overexposed highlights on the bridge of the nose, cheeks, lips, and collarbones; the room behind the character darkens rapidly, forming a strong light fall-off of 'bright subject + gray-black background.' Black hair still needs to retain hair strand details, not pure black. The overall image has a real social media selfie/friend close-up snapshot texture: slight high ISO noise, natural digital sharpening, limited dynamic range, slight hard shadows caused by direct flash, no cinematic color grading, no professional studio soft light. The face and foreground upper body are the clearest, the feet and distant background can have a very slight natural softening, but do not have significant blurring.

prompts.text:
超写实室内卧室近距离人像摄影，竖版约 4:5，一名年轻成年东亚女性趴伏在白色床铺上，镜头几乎贴近床面，从人物正前方略偏右的位置近距离拍摄。采用约 28–35mm 等效手机/便携相机镜头，距离脸部约 45–70cm，机位略低于人物脸部，形成非常明显但自然的纵深透视：脸部和上半身位于画面右前方、距离镜头最近；腰臀向画面左后方延伸；双腿屈膝向上抬起，两只脚位于画面左上远处。画面从脚尖完整延伸到人物前臂，人物几乎填满整个画面，不使用鱼眼，不做强烈背景虚化。

人物必须保持非常明显的自然丰满沙漏型成年女性身材：骨架中等偏小，肩部适中，上半身明显丰满，胸部体积大而自然，具有真实重量感；胸廓本身不宽，腰部明显收束，骨盆和髋部较宽，臀部非常丰满、圆润、厚实，大腿根部饱满。趴姿状态下，胸部和躯干受到床面的自然承托与轻微压缩，臀胯因身体向后延伸而形成明显圆润轮廓。不要生成普通纤细模特体型，不要窄胯、扁臀、细大腿，也不要极端健美肌肉型或失真的蜂腰。

人物采用低位趴卧姿势：腹部和骨盆贴近床面，上半身依靠双前臂撑起，双肘位于镜头前方，肩部略微向前收。人物右侧前臂横向延伸到画面底部，另一只手臂部分被身体和构图遮挡。胸口和肩颈明显向镜头靠近，但不是完全挺起，而是松弛地趴在床上。

下半身向画面左后方延伸，骨盆略微偏向人物左侧，使臀部轮廓在画面左中部形成明显弧线。双膝同时弯曲约 90°，小腿从床面向上抬起，两条小腿靠得较近但并不完全重合；两只脚在人物身后高高翘起并向画面左上方倾斜，脚掌朝向镜头侧前方，形成清楚的脚底轮廓。双腿必须有正确膝关节连接，不要穿插、融合或出现额外腿。

人物头部位于画面右上偏中央，脸距离镜头非常近。头略微向人物左侧倾斜，下巴微微抬起，双眼直接注视镜头。嘴唇轻轻嘟起/收拢，呈自然轻微 pout 表情，不露齿笑。整体神态安静、略带慵懒和亲密的手机近拍感。

人物留乌黑色超长直发，长度至少到胸部甚至更下方，发量浓密顺滑。头顶为自然中分偏轻微侧分，额前有一层轻薄而整齐的长空气刘海，长度接近眉毛，几缕碎发自然落在额头和眼睛附近。人物右侧大量长发顺着肩膀向下铺在床面和胸前，形成深黑色大面积发丝区域；左侧头发部分向背后延伸。不要短发、卷发或蓬松大波浪。

脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，下颌柔和，肤色白皙偏暖。眼睛为深棕色偏大杏仁眼，双眼皮自然，眼线纤细并向外轻微延长；睫毛明显、根根分明，尤其上睫毛清楚。眉毛自然偏平直。鼻梁小巧顺直，鼻尖精致。嘴唇自然丰满，裸粉玫瑰色，表面有微弱水润光泽。脸颊带明显但柔和的粉色腮红，鼻尖与眼下略带粉嫩色调。皮肤保留真实毛孔和细小肤色变化，但整体干净明亮，不要过度磨皮。

上身穿一件深灰色宽松西装外套，偏男友风 oversized blazer，面料为中厚度灰色西装呢，具有清晰斜纹/细毛织物纹理。外套领口完全敞开，宽大的枪驳领/平驳领自然向两侧翻开；肩部略宽，袖子长并在前臂处形成自然堆叠。外套前襟由于趴姿向两侧滑开，露出内部黑色低领内搭。

内层穿黑色极简低领贴身内搭/胸衣式上衣，颜色纯黑，面料哑光，没有复杂蕾丝和图案。只露出胸前和少量胸下区域，整体被灰色西装外套大部分遮挡。不要生成白色内搭、高领上衣或运动背心。

下身穿黑色极短贴身下装/高叉短裤，主要位于臀胯区域，大部分被身体姿势和灰色外套遮挡，只在臀部与髋部附近露出黑色布料边缘。保持正常服装覆盖，不要生成裙子、牛仔裤或长裤。

双腿穿白色半透明薄丝袜/连裤袜，从大腿一直连续覆盖到脚趾。材质非常轻薄、约 10–20D，整体呈乳白色半透明效果，能够透出自然肤色和脚趾轮廓。丝袜在小腿、脚踝和脚底处具有轻微细密纤维纹理，在近距离直闪下出现柔和丝光反射。脚底区域因为袜料拉伸而略微更透明，脚掌轮廓、脚跟和脚趾自然可见，但仍明确是被白色薄丝袜包覆。不要生成厚白棉袜、过膝袜、裸脚或鞋子。

床铺为简单的白色/暖白色床单和被褥，人物前臂和躯干压在柔软床面上，床单形成大量自然压痕与褶皱。画面左侧和人物身体下方可见柔软白色织物，不要精致酒店式铺床，保持真实居家使用感。

背景非常简洁且偏暗：后方为浅灰白色墙面，左上/左后方有一处深色门洞或走廊入口，整体陷入阴影；右后方墙面基本空白，没有复杂家具、装饰画、床头柜或灯具。背景信息很少，人物成为绝对主体。

摄影光线采用明显的近距离手机/便携数码相机正面直闪。闪光灯从镜头方向直接照亮人物脸部、胸肩、手臂和前景床单，使皮肤显得白皙明亮，鼻梁、双颊、嘴唇和锁骨产生清楚但不过曝的高光；人物身后的房间迅速变暗，形成“明亮主体＋灰黑背景”的强烈光衰减。黑发仍需保留发丝细节，不能死黑。

画面整体具有真实社交媒体自拍/朋友近距离抓拍质感：轻微高 ISO 噪点、自然数码锐化、有限动态范围、直闪造成的轻微硬阴影，没有电影感调色，没有专业棚拍柔光。脸部和前景上半身最清晰，脚部和远处背景可有极轻微自然柔化，但不要大幅虚化。
