prompts.text:
Direction: 9:16 longitudinal smartphone SNS snapshot. Quiet outdoor roadside, fictional adult female in her 20s, a close-up photo capturing only the center of the torso from below the shoulders to the upper thighs. The face or head is intentionally placed outside the upper edge of the frame, not for the purpose of identifying the person, but with the layering of white, skin tone, white, and sabbia and natural body twisting as the main subject. Like a casual shot of a friend suddenly holding up a phone while walking, capturing the moment she is about to arrange her hair. Not an advertising shoot or studio shoot, but a frame with a sense of reality naturally captured from an SNS video. 
Mood: Roadside in the late afternoon, slightly warm and dry air. Not an intentional fashion shoot, but a light daily feeling of staying for only a few seconds while moving. Retain the sense of incompleteness before the pose is finished, creating a natural and defenseless snapshot atmosphere. 
Model: Fictional adult female in her early to mid-20s. Does not imitate real people, artists, or influencers. The character's face or personality hardly appears, and it is treated as an adult daily fashion snapshot. 
Face: The face is almost completely out of the frame. Does not actively show the chin or the corners of the mouth, boldly cutting off the head at the upper edge of the frame. Does not attempt to complete the face display, but makes "facelessness" itself the composition. 
Hair: Dark brown to black-brown long hair. Mainly straight hair with extremely natural waves, flowing from the back side to near the right shoulder. The ends or a few strands of hair are slightly messy due to wind and body movements, not perfectly neat like just finished in a salon. 
Body: Depicts a slender to standard adult body type in natural proportions. The torso is not facing the camera directly, the left shoulder is slightly extended forward, and the pelvis is slightly rotated in the opposite direction. There is a natural twist of a few degrees between the orientation of the upper body and the waist. The center of gravity is slightly biased to one side, not completely symmetrical. Does not exaggerate body proportions, only lets the waistline appear naturally through the drape of clothes and the pose. 
Skin: Natural beige skin tone bathed in warm-colored natural light in the afternoon. Do not apply too much skin beautification, retain subtle skin texture, slight color differences, and natural shadows. Highlights are towards gold but without too much orange tone. Do not make it look like plastic-like uniform skin. 
Outfit: White thin-strap cropped camisole. Thin texture that fits the body, with low-key fine lace on the upper edge, a small white ribbon and slight pleats in the center of the chest. Two thin white drawstrings hang down from the center, falling towards the abdomen due to natural gravity, slightly shifting left and right due to body movement. Sufficient bare skin of the abdomen is exposed below the camisole. Below that, the upper part of plain white sporty underwear is visible, and further down, extremely loose cargo pants in sabbia to khaki beige are worn at a low waist position. The pants are cotton twill material with a slightly dry texture after washing, belt loops, buttons, front fly, and stitching are naturally visible. The upper part of the pants is not close to the body, and the left and right heights are slightly different, showing a loose and drooping way of wearing. Never include brand names, logos, English letters, or graphics. 
Accessories: A delicate and slender silver bracelet on the left wrist. The nails of the right hand are short to medium length in white to extremely pale blue-gray monochrome. Accessories should not be excessive. 
Scene_objects: The background is gray asphalt road, slightly worn white lane lines, low curb stones, dry grass and soil, dull brown and green ground. Only retain a sense of real roadside life that does not grab attention. Do not place flashy signs or tourist elements. 
Pose: Left arm bent at the elbow upwards towards the face and hair, the hand itself is almost out of the frame. Like a natural movement in the middle of arranging hair, tucking it behind the ear, or moving the hand to the face. The right arm is slightly bent, and the right hand is hovering in the air at the side of the waist. Not a gripping action to emphasize clothes or the body, but an idle natural gesture when transitioning to the next action. Shoulder, waist, and hand positions are not completely symmetrical. 
Lighting: Natural light from late afternoon to before evening. The main light source is warm diagonal light entering from the top left to the front left of the frame. Creates soft golden highlights on the left arm, white top, and left side of the torso, while maintaining thin natural shadows on the opposite side. Do not use strong HDR or studio rim lighting. White clothes are slightly brightened within the range of retaining details, not completely overexposed. 
Effect: Texture of a still image taken by a smartphone, or a frame captured from an SNS video. With a slight JPEG compression feeling, extremely subtle edge softening, dynamic feeling of slight camera shake at the edges of hair or fingertips, and slight phone noise in the dark parts. Avoid excessive cinematic color grading or 8K-like ultra-fine feeling. 
Camera: 9:16 vertical. Standard to slightly wide angle of a smartphone, equivalent to a natural perspective of 24–28mm. The sense of distance from the character is a close distance of about 50–90cm. The camera height is near the abdomen to below the chest. Not shot from the front, but from a slightly tilted position. Do not use extreme perspective like 0.5x ultra-wide angle. The background retains smartphone-like shapes and road information to a recognizable degree, without extreme shallow depth of field. 
Imperfections: The frame is tilted only a few degrees, and the character is not completely centered. The drawstrings of the top do not fall in the same position on the left and right, and the hair flows irregularly in parts. There are also left and right differences at the top of the pants, with small wrinkles or traces of use on the fabric. Skin is uneven, and the white fabric also has subtle folds or shadows. The background asphalt road or curb has slight stains or wear. Do not perfectly retouch the entire photo, but retain the randomness of a friend's snapshot. 
Background: Quiet roadside near suburbs or residential areas. Not set as an urban bustling street, seaside, studio, or main park area. Roads, white lines, curbs, dry grass and soil naturally connect in the depth of the screen, and the shape of the location is identifiable. Do not make it a heavy blur background like a DSLR portrait, just slightly softer than the subject. 
Atmosphere: Natural color design centered on white, warm skin tone, and sabbia, with low saturation. Background is dark gray, dry brown, and dull green. Warm evening light softly wraps the whole thing, but does not make it a single yellow like a filter. One can feel the dry roadside air and the atmosphere of a moment while moving. 
Composition: The top priority is an ultra-close torso crop that discards the face. The top of the frame cuts off the head and face, starting from near the shoulders, and the bottom extends to the upper part of the pants to near the upper thighs. Vertically composed of white top, bare abdomen, white underwear top, and sabbia loose pants; these four color blocks are clearly continuous. The character enters the frame slightly diagonally, creating movement in the upper left through the raised left arm, and using the drooping white drawstrings as slender vertical lines near the center of the frame. 
Negative: Faces similar to real people or celebrities, people who look like minors, full-body composition, composition showing the face completely, stiff standing posture from the front, frozen poses like model shoots, extreme body proportions, excessive skin retouching, doll-like faces, plastic-like skin, extreme HDR, too strong DSLR blur, studio backgrounds, overly cinematic lighting, excessive ultra-high definition, brand logos, text, English letter prints, watermarks, app UI, back arrows, screen icons, rounded corner frames derived from apps.

"face": "脸部几乎完全在画面外。不主动展示下巴或嘴角，大胆地在框架上端截断头部。不试图补全脸部展示，而是将‘无脸’本身作为构图成立。",
"hair": "深棕至黑褐色的长发。以直发为主，带有极自然的波浪，从背部侧流向右肩附近。发梢或几缕头发因风和肢体动作略显凌乱，不像沙龙刚做完般完美整齐。",
"body": "以自然比例描绘纤瘦至标准的成年体型。躯干不正对镜头，左肩略微前伸，骨盆向相反方向稍稍旋转。上半身与腰部的朝向有几度偏差的自然扭转。重心略偏向一侧，不完全左右对称。不夸张身体比例，仅通过衣服垂落和姿势让腰线自然显现。",
"skin": "沐浴午后暖色自然光的自然米色系肤色。不施加过多美肌处理，保留细微肌理、轻微色差和自然的阴影。高光偏金色但不过多橙调。不做成塑料般的均匀肌肤。",
"outfit": "白色细肩带短款吊带背心。贴合身体的薄质地，上端有低调的细蕾丝，胸口中央有小巧的白色缎带和轻微褶皱。从中央垂下两条细白色系带，受自然重力向腹部方向下坠，因身体动作略微左右偏移。背心下方露出足够的腹部裸肤。其下可见素面白色的运动型内裤上部，进一步下方以低腰位置搭配沙贝色至卡其米色的极宽松工装裤。裤子为棉斜纹布材质，带有洗水后的略干爽质感，腰带环、纽扣、前开襟、缝线自然可见。裤子上部不紧贴身体，左右高度略有差异，呈现宽松垂落的穿搭方式。绝不加入品牌名、标志、英文字母、图形。",
"accessories": "左手腕上戴一条细致纤细的银色系手链。右手指甲为短至中长度的白色至极淡蓝灰色单色。饰品不宜过多。",
"scene_objects": "背景为灰色柏油路，略微磨损的白色车道线，低矮路缘石，干燥的草地与泥土，暗淡的棕色与绿色地面。仅保留不抢镜程度的真实路边生活感。不放置花哨的标牌或观光地元素。",
"pose": "左臂弯曲肘部向上朝脸·头发方向，手本身几乎在框架外。像是整理头发、拨到耳后、将手移向脸部途中的自然动作。右臂轻微弯曲，右手在腰侧悬浮于空中。不是为了强调衣服或身体而抓握的动作，而是过渡到下一个动作时无所事事的自然手势。肩部、腰部、手的位置不完全左右对称。",
"lighting": "午后稍晚至傍晚前的自然光。主光源从画面左上至左前方进入的暖色斜光。在左臂、白色上衣、躯干左侧营造柔和的金色高光，对侧保留薄薄的自然阴影。不使用强烈的HDR或工作室轮廓光。白色衣物在保留细节的范围内略微提亮，不完全过曝。",
"effect": "智能手机拍摄的静止图像，或从SNS视频中截取的一帧质感。带有轻微JPEG压缩感、极细微的轮廓柔和、头发或手尖有轻微手抖边缘的动态感、暗部有轻微手机噪点。避免过度的电影调色分级或8K般的超精细感。",
"camera": "纵向9:16。智能手机的标准至稍广角，相当于24～28mm的自然视角。与人物的距离感约为50～90cm的近距离。相机高度在腹部至胸下附近。不是正面对拍，而是稍斜位置拍摄。不使用0.5倍超广角般的极端透视。背景保留智能手机般的形状和道路信息可辨程度，不做极端浅景深。",
"imperfections": "框架仅倾斜几度，人物不完全居中。上衣系带不落在左右相同位置，头发部分不规则流动。裤子上端也有左右差异，布料上有细小褶皱或使用痕迹。肌肤不均匀，白色布料也有细微折痕或阴影。背景柏油路或路缘石有轻微污渍或磨损。不将整张照片完美修饰，保留朋友瞬间抓拍的偶然性。",
"background": "郊外或住宅区附近的安静路边。不设为都市繁华街、海边、工作室、公园主区域。道路、白线、路缘石、干燥草地·泥土在画面深处自然连接，地点形状可辨识。不做成单眼人像的大虚化背景，仅比主体稍柔和。",
"atmosphere": "以白、温暖肤色、沙贝色为中心，低饱和度的自然色彩设计。背景为深灰、干燥棕色、暗淡绿色。傍晚暖色轻柔包裹整体，但不做成滤镜般的单一黄色。能感受到干燥路边空气和移动中一瞬的氛围。",
"composition": "最优先是舍弃脸部的超近距离躯干裁剪。画面上端截断头部和脸部，从肩部附近开始，下端至裤子上部～大腿上部附近。纵向构成白色上衣 → 裸露腹部 → 白色内裤上部 → 沙贝色宽松裤子，这四个色块明确连续。人物稍斜入画，通过抬起的左臂在左上制造动感，将垂下的白色系带作为画面中央附近的细长竖线使用。",
"negative": "类似现实人物或名人的脸、看似未成年的人物、全身构图、完全展示脸部的构图、正面的僵硬站姿、模特拍摄式的定格姿势、极端身体比例、过度的肌肤修饰、人偶般的脸、塑料般的肌肤、极端HDR、过强的单眼虚化、工作室背景、过于电影化的照明、过剩的高精细化、品牌标志、文字、英文字母印花、浮水印、应用UI、返回箭头、画面图标、应用衍生的圆角框架"
}

items.title: 雨中森林的年轻韩国女性银发丝绸裙

prompts.text:
A young Korean woman in her twenties stands in a secluded forest clearing, immersed in a gentle, steady rain. Her pale silver hair is slicked back, clinging to her forehead and neck in wet, defined strands that catch the ambient light. She is the sole focus, captured in a moment of quiet introspection, with her eyes slightly downcast and a serene, contemplative expression. The rain beads on her skin, highlighting the smooth texture of her complexion and the delicate curve of her jawline, creating a tactile sense of moisture and coolness.

She wears a sleeveless mini dress made of translucent white silk-chiffon, which has become heavy and clingy with water. The fabric drapes naturally over her shoulders and hips, conforming to her silhouette while remaining lightweight. The dress is simple and unadorned, allowing the interplay of light, water, and fabric to define its form. The hemline rests mid-thigh, fluttering slightly with the subtle shift of her weight and the movement of the rain.

The setting is a lush, green forest with large ferns and moss-covered stones surrounding her. The ground is a mix of wet earth and fallen leaves, creating a rich, textured foreground that contrasts with the softness of her figure. Behind her, the forest fades into a soft, misty backdrop, with tall trees rising vertically to frame the scene. The composition places her slightly off-center, allowing the natural elements to balance the frame and create a sense of depth.

The lighting is diffused and soft, filtering through the canopy above in gentle beams that catch the falling raindrops. The color palette is restrained, dominated by cool grays, deep greens, and the stark brightness of her wet dress and hair, creating a poetic, dreamlike atmosphere. The image has a realistic, photographic quality, with every droplet of water and fold of fabric rendered with delicate tonal separation.

The camera is positioned at a low angle, looking slightly up at her, which emphasizes her presence against the towering trees and the falling rain. This viewpoint adds a sense of scale and reverence to the scene, while a shallow depth of field keeps her sharply in focus while softly blurring the background foliage. The image is presented in a 2:3 vertical composition, enhancing the verticality of the rain and the trees, and framing her within the natural environment.

prompts.text:
一位二十多岁的年轻韩国女性站在僻静的森林空地中，沉浸在温柔而持续的雨水中。她淡银色的头发向后梳理，湿透的发丝紧贴在额头和脖子上，捕捉着周围的光线。她是唯一的焦点，被捕捉在安静内省的时刻，双眼略微低垂，表情宁静而沉思。雨滴在她的皮肤上凝结，突显出她肤质的平滑和下颚线的精致轮廓，营造出一种触感上的湿润和凉爽感。

她穿着一件由半透明白色丝绸雪纺制成的无袖连衣裙，裙子因水分而变得沉重且贴身。面料自然地垂落在她的肩膀和臀部，顺着她的轮廓，同时保持轻盈。裙子简单且没有装饰，让光线、水和织物的相互作用来定义其形态。裙摆落在腿部中段，随着她重心的微妙转移和雨水的律动轻微飘动。

背景是一片郁郁葱葱的绿色森林，周围环绕着巨大的蕨类植物和覆盖着青苔的石头。地面是湿润的泥土和落叶的混合体，创造了丰富、有质感的前景，与她身形的柔和形成对比。在她身后，森林逐渐隐入柔和朦胧的背景中，高大的树木纵向矗立，构成了场景的框架。构图将她置于略微偏离中心的位置，让自然元素平衡画面并营造出深度感。

光线弥漫且柔和，通过上方的树冠过滤成柔和的光束，捕捉着落下的雨滴。色调克制，以冷灰色、深绿色以及她湿透的裙子和头发的鲜明亮度为主，营造出一种诗意、梦幻般的氛围。图像具有真实的摄影质感，每一滴水珠和织物的褶皱都以细腻的色调分离呈现。

摄像机位于低角度，略微仰视她，这强调了她在高大树木和落下的雨水背景下的存在感。这种视角为场景增添了一种比例感和崇敬感，同时浅景深使她保持清晰的焦点，同时柔化了背景的植被。图像以 2:3 的垂直构图呈现，增强了雨水和树木的垂直感，并将她置于自然环境中。

Authentic late-1990s to early-2000s consumer 35mm snapshot, compact 28–35mm point-and-shoot, Kodak Ultramax 400-like color-negative character. Punchy imperfect analog contrast, uneven exposure, washed highlights, faded shadows, hazy midtones, subtle warm yellow-magenta cast, imperfect reds, muted cooler tones and irregular white balance. Organic grain, mild softness, slightly imperfect focus, motion softness only with movement, faint halation and minor lens distortion.

items.title: 稚拙油画棒旅行线描对照构图

prompts.text:
Please convert each travel photo I upload into an independent 「NAIVE OIL-PASTEL TRAVEL LINE｜稚拙油画棒旅行线描」.

Output each photo separately, without multi-image stitching. The overall layout uses a 3:4 vertical top-and-bottom comparison composition.

The upper part occupies about 48%–50% of the frame, retaining the clear original photo with substantial area; the lower part occupies about 50%–52%, refining the same scene into a minimalist, naive yet aesthetically controlled oil-pastel travel line drawing.

Use clear, straight horizontal boundaries between the upper and lower areas; do not use gradients, feathering, or mutual penetration.

The upper part must faithfully retain the original photo.

Accurately maintain the subject identity, number of subjects, orientation, posture, action, key architectural structures, vehicle proportions, boat direction, ridge morphology, spatial relationship between figures and environment, natural textures, real light and shadow, and original color atmosphere.

Apply only slight color grading for travel magazines, independent publications, or photography exhibitions, and add an extremely thin film grain.

Do not redraw the photo, do not stretch, mirror, move, replace, or add subjects; do not change vehicle direction, figure posture, building outlines, mountain peak morphology, or number of boats. The upper part must still clearly be a real photographic work.

The lower part should not redraw the complete composition of the photo.

First understand the photo, then select the most memorable subject from it, for example:

- A single boat
- A lighthouse or tower
- A pavilion, hut, or independent building
- A roadside vehicle
- An isolated mountain peak
- One to two figures
- An animal or travel object with a clear outline

Keep only the minimum visual facts that make the subject instantly recognizable:

- Number of subjects
- Overall outer silhouette
- Orientation or direction of travel
- Posture
- Most important proportional relationships
- One to three key structures
- One clue explaining the environment

For boats, keep the bow, stern, hull curve, cabin, or motor; for vehicles, keep the wheel distance, body direction, seats, and front structure; for buildings, keep the roofline, main entrance, and support relationships; for mountain peaks, keep the unique ridge and one necessary horizon line; for figures, keep the number, posture, orientation, hairstyle, or main clothing color, without depicting facial features, clothing folds, or fine human structures.

Delete dense vegetation, repeated window panes, tourist shadows, advertising signs, complex water ripples, cloud details, rock textures, and photographic-level light and shadow.

The background should retain at most one to three broken path lines, shorelines, water surface lines, horizons, ridges, or ground hints. Do not form a complete background, and do not shrink the entire original scene to fit it all onto the paper.

The lower part uses warm off-white or light ivory matte drawing paper; the paper surface has natural fibers, small particles, and obvious paper texture resistance.

The subject usually occupies only 22%–42% of the width and 20%–38% of the height of the conversion area, placed in the lower-middle, left-leaning, or right-leaning, following the direction of the subject in the original photo.

Retain at least 65%–80% of completely unpainted continuous paper white. The paper must become the largest color block in the lower half.

Use childlike, direct, but aesthetically maturely controlled oil pastels, thick crayons, or waxy chalk lines to redraw the subject.

Lines must show:

- Obvious thickness
- Uneven pressure
- Waxy particles
- Paper texture resistance
- Natural breaks
- Partial white gaps
- Occasional buildup
- Hesitation and back-folding
- Slight double lines
- Partial misalignment
- Unclosed outlines
- Active stopping at secondary structures

Do not use a uniform black outer outline.

Extract 3–6 colors from the original photo, using mutually separate colored lines to distinguish structures.

For example:

- The subject's signature color for the main outer outline
- Gray-blue or charcoal gray for tires, shadows, or ridges
- Ocher, sienna, or taupe for buildings and ground
- Gray-green or olive green for a small number of plant hints
- Light blue or gray-blue for one or two water surface or sky direction lines

Almost no full coloring.

Only add a small amount of loose, transparent short cross-hatching, thick scratches, or waxy color blocks at the most critical positions of the subject. Allow colors to be slightly darker where crayons overlap, but do not create realistic volume.

Do not draw complete shadows, do not use smooth gradients, and do not pursue correct and smooth perspective. It should be like an experienced illustrator deliberately retaining a somewhat clumsy hand-feel.

The lower half adds a small amount of small text by default.

Small text includes:

1. A small title of 1–3 English words;
2. A very short observation of 5–10 English words.

Before generating, please clearly replace:

TITLE: “[English Title]”
OBSERVATION: “[Short sentence based on the real content of the photo]”

Observation sentences should not introduce scenic knowledge or write vague travel quotes. It should describe actions, colors, positions, or feelings truly visible in the photo, such as:

- “yellow waits where the alley cools”
- “the boat rests below the pale cliff”
- “one figure stands beneath the peaks”
- “a small door beneath stacked stone”

Text should be placed in the continuous paper white away from the subject, and the total area must not exceed 3%–5% of the lower area.

Text should use:

- Slightly slanted blunt pencil handwriting
- Small oil pastel signatures
- Simple handwritten sans-serif with slight breaks
- Typefaces with paper teeth, white gaps, and waxy particles

Text color is extracted from the subject's outline color, gray-blue, taupe, or ocher. Do not use smooth, neat, floating digital fonts.

Do not add author names, accounts, signatures, brands, logos, QR codes, URLs, fictional locations, fictional dates, fake Chinese, or garbled text.

The overall style should be: simple, quiet, relaxed, slightly clumsy, like a small sketch casually drawn in a paper notebook during a trip. It can be naive but not childish; simple but not sloppy; inaccurate, but the subject's identity, direction, and posture must be accurate.

Avoid: children’s classroom drawing, kindergarten cartoon, cute sticker aesthetics, flower-vase template, colored-pencil detailed rendering, adult coloring book, uniform black outline, automatic edge tracing, clean vector icon, smooth pen line, full oil-pastel filling, heavy oil painting, realistic crayon portrait, complete background, individual leaves, repeated water waves, photographic lighting, gradient shadows, full-page illustration, decorative typography, fake text, author signature, logo, watermark, blurry split boundary.

The most important rule: First strip the photo down to just a few of the most recognizable lines of the subject, then let the crayon particles, breaks, hesitant outlines, and small text signatures work together with the large areas of untouched paper to complete the memory.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的
「NAIVE OIL-PASTEL TRAVEL LINE｜稚拙油画棒旅行线描」。

每张照片单独输出，不进行多图拼接。
整体采用3:4竖版上下对照构图。

上方约占画面48%–50%，保留清楚、具有实质面积的原始照片；
下方约占50%–52%，将同一场景提炼成一幅极简、
稚拙而具有成熟审美控制的油画棒旅行线描。

上下区域使用清晰、平直的水平边界，
不得渐变、羽化或相互渗透。

上半部分必须忠实保留原始照片。

准确保持主体身份、主体数量、朝向、姿态、动作、
关键建筑结构、车辆比例、船只方向、山脊形态、
人物与环境的空间关系、自然材质、真实光影和原有色彩氛围。

仅进行轻微的旅行杂志、独立出版物或摄影展调色，
并加入极薄的胶片颗粒。

不得重绘照片，不得拉伸、镜像、移动、替换或增加主体，
不得改变车辆方向、人物姿势、建筑轮廓、山峰形态或船只数量。
上半部分仍须明确是一张真实摄影作品。

下半部分不要按照照片的完整构图重新画一遍。

先理解照片，从中选择一个最值得记住的主体，例如：

- 单一船只
- 灯塔或塔楼
- 亭子、小屋或独立建筑
- 路边车辆
- 孤立山峰
- 一至两个人物
- 动物或轮廓清楚的旅行物件

只保留让主体一眼可辨的最少视觉事实：

- 主体数量
- 整体外轮廓
- 朝向或行进方向
- 姿态
- 最重要的比例关系
- 一至三处关键结构
- 一条解释环境的线索

船只保留船头、船尾、船舷弧线、船舱或马达；
车辆保留车轮距离、车身方向、座椅和车头结构；
建筑保留屋顶走势、主要入口和支撑关系；
山峰保留独特山脊与一条必要的地平线；
人物保留数量、姿态、朝向、发型或服装主色，
不描绘五官、衣褶和精细人体结构。

删除密集植被、重复窗格、游客杂影、广告招牌、
复杂水纹、云层细节、岩石肌理和摄影级明暗。

背景最多只保留一至三条断开的路径线、岸线、
水面线、地平线、山脊或地面提示。
不得形成完整背景，也不得把原始场景缩小后全部塞进纸面。

下半部分使用温暖米白或浅象牙色哑光画纸，
纸面具有天然纤维、细小颗粒和明显的纸纹阻力。

主体通常只占转绘区域宽度的22%–42%、
高度的20%–38%，放置在中下部、偏左或偏右，
并顺应原照片主体的方向。

至少保留65%–80%完全未经绘制的连续纸白。
纸张必须成为下半部分最大的色块。

使用儿童般直接、但经过成熟审美控制的油画棒、
粗蜡笔或蜡质粉笔线条重新描绘主体。

线条必须呈现：

- 明显偏粗
- 压力不均
- 蜡质颗粒
- 纸纹阻力
- 自然断裂
- 局部漏白
- 偶尔堆积
- 迟疑与回折
- 轻微双线
- 局部错位
- 未闭合轮廓
- 次要结构主动停笔

不要使用统一的黑色外轮廓。

从原照片中提取3–6种颜色，
使用彼此分离的彩色线条区分结构。

例如：

- 主体标志色负责主要外轮廓
- 灰蓝或炭灰负责轮胎、阴影或山脊
- 土黄、赭石或灰褐负责建筑与地面
- 灰绿或橄榄绿负责少量植物提示
- 浅蓝或灰蓝负责一两条水面或天空方向线

几乎不要完整填色。

只在主体最关键的位置加入少量松散、透底的短排线、
粗擦痕或蜡质色块。
允许蜡笔重叠处颜色略深，但不能塑造写实体积。

不要绘制完整阴影，不要使用平滑渐变，
不要追求正确而圆滑的透视。
它应像一位经验丰富的插画者，
刻意保留有点笨拙的手感。

下半部分默认加入少量小字。

小字包括：

1. 一个1–3个英文单词的小标题；
2. 一句5–10个英文单词的极短观察。

生成前请明确替换：

TITLE: “[英文标题]”
OBSERVATION: “[根据照片真实内容写成的短句]”

观察句不要介绍景点知识，
也不要写空泛的旅行鸡汤。

它应描述照片中真实可见的动作、颜色、位置或感受，例如：

- “yellow waits where the alley cools”
- “the boat rests below the pale cliff”
- “one figure stands beneath the peaks”
- “a small door beneath stacked stone”

文字放在远离主体的连续纸白中，
总面积不得超过下半区域的3%–5%。

文字使用：

- 略歪的钝铅笔手写体
- 细小的油画棒题签
- 轻微断裂的朴素手写无衬线
- 带纸齿、漏白与蜡质颗粒的字形

文字颜色从主体轮廓色、灰蓝、灰褐或赭石中提取。
不得使用光滑、工整、悬浮的数字字体。

不要添加作者名、账号、签名、品牌、Logo、
二维码、网址、虚构地点、虚构日期、假中文或乱码。

整体应具有：

简单、安静、松弛、略带笨拙，
像旅行途中翻开纸本随手画下的小稿。

它可以稚拙，但不能幼稚；
可以简单，但不能潦草；
可以不准确，但主体身份、方向与姿态必须准确。

Avoid: children’s classroom drawing, kindergarten cartoon,
cute sticker aesthetics, flower-vase template,
colored-pencil detailed rendering, adult coloring book,
uniform black outline, automatic edge tracing,
clean vector icon, smooth pen line, full oil-pastel filling,
heavy oil painting, realistic crayon portrait,
complete background, individual leaves, repeated water waves,
photographic lighting, gradient shadows, full-page illustration,
decorative typography, fake text, author signature,
logo, watermark, blurry split boundary.

最重要的规则：

先把照片删到只剩主体最有辨识度的几根线，
再让蜡笔的颗粒、断口、迟疑轮廓、小字题签
与大片没有触碰过的纸面共同完成记忆。

items.title: CRISPORA高端帕帕德零食商业海报

prompts.text:
Create a flagship commercial advertising poster for an original papad snack brand named "CRISPORA", combining Orbit energy with Port symbol power. Use ultra-realistic lifestyle product photography. Keep the same core structural logic: a dramatic top-down supermarket aisle perspective, one young woman reaching upward from a shopping cart to grab a large papad bag from the shelf, long symmetrical grocery shelves on both sides creating a strong tunnel effect, and one clean headline block floating in the upper-right area. The papad package must remain the absolute visual hero, larger, sharper, and more readable than every other element.

Style lock: high-end FMCG retail advertising, premium supermarket realism, product-first hierarchy, clean cinematic lifestyle photography, strong aisle-depth perspective, polished global campaign finish.

Core composition: tall vertical frame, camera looking down from above the aisle. The woman stands in the lower-middle area, body angled slightly forward, one arm fully extended upward holding the hero pack. The shopping cart sits subtly beneath or just behind her. The two shelf walls must form a strong symmetrical corridor that visually funnels attention toward the raised package. The hero bag should sit closest to the viewer in visual importance, reading as the clear destination of the composition.

Port logic: turn the raised papad bag into the brand’s super-symbol. The product should feel like "the one bag worth reaching for" at first glance. The gesture of reaching upward and securing the pack must become the memorable brand code, so the viewer remembers the image as the snack that stands above the shelf.

Orbit logic: use the converging shelf lines, aisle perspective, arm extension, cart placement, and subtle gaze direction to create one clean visual sweep from the far depth of the supermarket tunnel into the woman’s hand and the hero package. The motion must feel focused, desirable, and purchase-driven, never cluttered.

Product concept: redesign the product as an original premium roasted papad brand called "CRISPORA". The pack should feel shelf-ready, modern, and globally marketable, using a warm golden-beige and deep brown identity with subtle spice cues. Add original text only, such as "roasted papad crisps", "lightly spiced", and "crispy lentil wafers". Do not copy any existing branding or wording.

Female character: one realistic young adult woman with natural anatomy, correct shoulders, neck, arms, and hands, five fingers only, realistic skin texture, natural facial proportions, and believable hair strands. Her expression should feel focused and slightly delighted, as if she has found exactly the snack she came for. Clothing should be simple, modern, and secondary to the product.

Lighting: bright supermarket ambient lighting with soft overhead highlights, clean aisle illumination, realistic shelf reflections, and a slightly enhanced commercial key light on the hero pack and the woman’s face. Keep the scene bright, premium, and natural, with no muddy shadows or dead black patches.

Materials and realism: realistic printed snack bag with crisp folds, subtle matte-gloss reflections, believable package inflation, sharp label print, and appetizing papad imagery. Shelf products should be softly blurred and subordinate. The cart, floor tiles, and aisle shelves must obey real-world scale and perspective.

Typography and layout: use original English text only, never copy any existing wording. Place a clean upper-right headline such as "REACH THE CRUNCH." or "TAKE THE TOP PICK." with a short support line like "worth the stretch." Keep typography bold, modern, and clearly secondary to the product.

Color strategy: warm golden-beige hero pack, clean neutral supermarket tones, softened shelf color variety, and restrained warm-brown branding accents. Keep the palette bright, realistic, and premium.

Quality and physical rules: extremely sharp hero pack, readable label, correct hand anatomy, believable supermarket perspective, clean shelf depth, no clutter overload, no warped package, no deformed face, no extra fingers, no muddy lighting. The product bag must remain the strongest visual sales trigger and the clearest symbolic focal point.

Negative prompt: copied branding, copied slogan, weak product hierarchy, blurry pack, unreadable label, distorted hands, extra fingers, fused fingers, plastic skin, deformed face, warped aisle perspective, cluttered shelves, muddy supermarket lighting, cheap retail flyer aesthetic, cartoon rendering, CGI toy look, low-resolution packaging, product losing dominance.

prompts.text:
为名为“CRISPORA”的原创帕帕德（papad）零食品牌创建一张旗舰商业广告海报，结合 Orbit 能量与 Port 符号力量。使用超写实的生活方式产品摄影。保持相同的核心结构逻辑：一个戏剧性的自上而下的超市走道透视，一名年轻女性从购物车中向上伸手，从货架上抓取一大袋帕帕德，两侧长长的对称杂货货架营造出强烈的隧道效果，右上角区域漂浮着一个干净的标题块。帕帕德包装必须保持绝对的视觉主角地位，比其他所有元素都更大、更清晰、更具可读性。

风格锁定：高端快速消费品零售广告、优质超市现实主义、产品优先等级、干净的电影化写实生活摄影、强烈的走道深度透视、精湛的全球营销完成度。

核心构图：高大的垂直框架，摄像机从走道上方向下看。女性站在中下方区域，身体略微前倾，一只手臂完全向上伸展，握着主角包装袋。购物车巧妙地位于她下方或紧随其后。两面货架墙必须形成一个强烈的对称走廊，在视觉上将注意力集中在举起的包装上。主角袋在视觉重要性上应离观众最近，被视为构图的明确目标。

Port 逻辑：将举起的帕帕德袋变成品牌的超级符号。产品应该在第一眼就被感觉是“值得伸手去拿的那一袋”。向上伸手并拿稳包装袋的姿势必须成为令人难忘的品牌代码，让观众记住这张图像是矗立在货架之上的零食。

Orbit 逻辑：利用汇聚的货架线条、走道透视、手臂伸展、购物车摆放和微妙的注视方向，创造一个从超市隧道深处汇聚到女性手中和主角包装的干净视觉流向。动作必须感觉专注、令人向往且由购买驱动，绝不凌乱。

产品概念：将产品重新设计为名为“CRISPORA”的原创高端烘焙帕帕德品牌。包装应具有随时可上架感、现代感且具有全球市场竞争力，使用温暖的金米色和深褐色标识，并带有微妙的香料暗示。仅添加原创文本，例如“roasted papad crisps”（烘焙帕帕德脆片）、“lightly spiced”（轻微调味）和“crispy lentil wafers”（酥脆扁豆片）。不要复制任何现有的品牌或措辞。

女性角色：一名写实的成年女性，具有自然的解剖结构、正确的肩膀、颈部、手臂和手部，只有五个手指，真实的皮肤纹理，自然的面部比例和可信的发丝。她的表情应该显得专注并略带喜悦，仿佛她找到了正是她要找的零食。服装应简洁、现代，且从属于产品。

灯光：明亮的超市环境照明，带有柔和的顶置高光，干净的走道照明，真实的货架反射，以及在主角包装和女性面部上稍作增强的商业主光。保持场景明亮、高端且自然，没有浑浊的阴影或死黑斑块。

材料与现实主义：写实的印刷零食袋，带有清晰的褶皱、微妙的哑光-光泽反射、可信的包装膨胀感、清晰的标签印刷和诱人的帕帕德图像。货架产品应软化模糊并处于次要地位。购物车、地板砖和走道货架必须服从现实世界的比例和透视。

排版与布局：仅使用原创英文文本，绝不复制任何现有措辞。在右上角放置一个干净的标题，例如“REACH THE CRUNCH.”（触及嘎吱脆）或“TAKE THE TOP PICK.”（拿走顶级选择），并配有一行简短的辅助文案，如“worth the stretch.”（值得一伸）。保持排版大胆、现代，且明确次于产品。

色彩策略：温暖的金米色主角包装，干净的中性超市色调，柔和的货架颜色多样性，以及克制的暖褐色品牌点缀。保持色调明亮、写实且高端。

质量与物理规则：极度清晰的主角包装，可读的标签，正确的手部解剖结构，可信的超市透视，干净的货架深度，无杂乱过载，无扭曲的包装，无变形的面部，无多余的手指，无浑浊的灯光。产品袋必须保持最强的视觉销售诱因和最清晰的象征性焦点。

负向提示词：复制的品牌、复制的标语、薄弱的产品等级、模糊的包装、不可读的标签、扭曲的手、多余的手指、融合的手指、塑料皮肤、变形的面部、扭曲的走道透视、凌乱的货架、浑浊的超市灯光、廉价零售传单美学、卡通渲染、CGI 玩具感、低分辨率包装、产品失去主导地位。

items.title: 大尺寸文字互动时尚社论海报

prompts.text:
Subject = [person / artist / dancer / musician / fashion model]
Action = [running / playing an instrument / dancing / posing / interacting with an object]
Headline = [a short meaningful word or phrase]
Accent color = [cobalt blue / coral red / amber / burgundy / custom color]
Type interaction = [body through letters / object through negative space / motion across type / color field cutting through type]

Create a 9:16 editorial poster built around the physical relationship between the subject and oversized typography.

Start with a strong, realistic photograph. The person should have a clear identity, expressive body language and an action that naturally connects to the theme. Keep skin, hair, clothing and props realistic and detailed.

Treat the headline as part of the composition rather than text added afterward. Make the letters extremely large, crop them at the edges and let the subject move in front of some parts and behind others. Use letter openings, strokes and negative space to frame the body, limbs or objects.

Choose one dominant interaction for each poster. A runner can break through oversized letters, a musician and instrument can occupy the negative space of the type, a dancer can extend limbs through letterforms, or a fashion subject can cross between contrasting color fields while the typography changes with the background.

Use one strong accent color against a mostly neutral palette. Geometric elements such as a circle, arc, bar or large color field can help anchor the subject, but they should support the main interaction rather than decorate the page.

Keep supporting text minimal. One short line or small editorial label is enough. Every word should relate to the subject or concept instead of acting as filler.

The final image should feel like a finished fashion or culture poster with strong scale, depth, movement and graphic tension — not a portrait with text placed around it.

items.title: 火山之吻高端辣酱超写实商业海报

prompts.text:
Create a flagship commercial advertising poster for an original hot sauce brand named "VOLCANO BITE", merging Orbit energy with Transit restraint. Use ultra-realistic product photography, not illustration, not 3D render. Keep the same structural logic: a blazing orange-red background with subtle heat-wave patterning, one giant centered squeeze bottle of tropical chili sauce as the absolute visual hero, bold headline blocks on the upper left and upper right, and a clean lower three-panel serving section showing three food-pairing dishes in equal-width compartments. The bottle must dominate the composition and overlap slightly into the lower band.

Style lock: premium FMCG condiment advertising, ultra-real packaging realism, strong product-first hierarchy, bold graphic poster design, tropical heat mood, clean campaign layout, high-end supermarket hero visual.

Core composition: one large front-facing squeeze bottle placed exactly at the center, vertically extending from the upper-middle into the lower-middle. Keep the bottle taller, sharper, and visually heavier than every other element. Place one condensed bold text block on the upper-left and one on the upper-right, balanced around the bottle shoulders. Use only a restrained number of floating accents around the bottle. The lower section must be divided into three equal compartments with identical visual width and clean alignment, each showing one smaller usage dish. Preserve strong negative space around the bottle so the poster feels premium and architectural.

Transit logic: reduce all non-essential clutter, shorten top copy, simplify the lower panel copy, and keep the background clean enough that scale, contrast, and the central bottle create the impact. Avoid a busy retail-flyer feeling. The bottle, the orange field, and the grid should do most of the work.

Orbit logic: arrange the background accents into a clear upward swirling motion around the bottle, guiding the eye from the lower food panels into the center bottle and then up toward the nozzle cap. Use a few controlled chili slices, fruit pieces, petals, and tiny sauce droplets in elegant rising arcs. The movement must feel concentrated and heat-driven, not messy.

Product concept: redesign the hero product as an original tropical chili sauce with a sharp green nozzle cap, a translucent bottle body filled with vivid red-orange sauce, and a bold label system reading "VOLCANO BITE" with a descriptor such as "tropical fire chili sauce". The label should feel premium, shelf-ready, and globally launchable, with strong vertical emphasis and a compact iconic heat mark. All label text must be original.

Lighting: bright studio key light from front-upper center with warm side shaping to emphasize bottle volume, cap texture, sauce translucency, and glossy reflections. Add gentle rim highlights around the bottle edges and soft grounded shadows under the lower dishes. Keep the background glowing and graphic, without muddy contrast or dead black zones.

Materials and realism: realistic semi-transparent plastic squeeze bottle with visible thickness, glossy sauce body with suspended chili flecks, crisp cap ridges, premium printed label with subtle sheen, believable liquid meniscus, and clean reflections. Lower food pairings should be highly realistic and appetizing: one sliced chicken platter, one fried savory snack plate, and one crispy spring-roll platter with dipping sauce. Keep all three plates aligned cleanly, sized consistently, and clearly secondary to the bottle.

Typography and layout: use original English text only, never copy existing wording. Place a bold upper-left headline such as "TROPIC HEAT" and an upper-right headline such as "SHARP FINISH". Keep the copy shorter, stacked, and poster-ready. In the lower panels, use only minimal micro-copy such as "dip", "drizzle", and "crave". The bottle label and top headlines must carry the branding.

Color strategy: dominant hot orange and saturated chili red, supported by green cap accents, off-white typography, pale fruit highlights, and natural food tones in the lower dishes. Keep the palette bold, tropical, hot, and tightly controlled.

Quality and physical rules: extremely sharp hero bottle, readable label, correct bottle symmetry, realistic sauce translucency, clean lower grid alignment, equal lower panel widths, consistent plate sizing, believable garnish scale, no warped bottle, no distorted food, no excessive props, no clutter, no cheap flyer feel. The bottle must remain the absolute visual hero at all times.

Negative prompt: copied branding, copied slogan, weak product hierarchy, blurry bottle, unreadable label, fake plastic reflections, warped cap, distorted bottle shape, muddy orange background, dead black patches, cluttered layout, too many floating ingredients, oversized lower dishes, inconsistent plate sizes, cheap retail flyer aesthetic, cartoon rendering, CGI look, illustration style, low-resolution food detail, product losing dominance.

核心构图：一个垂直延伸从上中到下中的大型正向挤压瓶放置在正中心。使瓶子比其他所有元素更高、更清晰、视觉分量更重。在左上角和右上角各放置一个紧凑的加粗文本块，围绕瓶肩平衡。瓶子周围仅使用有限数量的漂浮装饰。下部必须分为三个等宽、对齐整洁的区域，每个区域展示一道较小的食用菜肴。在瓶子周围保留强大的负空间，使海报具有高端感和建筑感。

过境逻辑：减少所有非必要的杂乱，缩短顶部文案，简化底部面板文案，并保持背景足够整洁，使比例、对比度和中心瓶子产生冲击力。避免忙碌的零售传单感。瓶子、橙色区域和网格应承担大部分视觉工作。

轨道逻辑：将背景装饰排列成围绕瓶子的清晰向上螺旋运动，引导视线从底部的食物面板进入中心瓶子，然后向上移向瓶盖。使用少量受控的辣椒片、水果碎块、花瓣和微小的酱汁液滴，呈优雅的上升弧线。运动必须感觉集中且由热力驱动，而不是混乱。

产品概念：将核心产品重新设计为带有锋利绿色瓶盖的原创热带辣椒酱，半透明瓶身装满鲜艳的红橙色酱汁，以及印有“VOLCANO BITE”和“tropical fire chili sauce”等描述语的大胆标签系统。标签应具有高端感、上架即售感并可全球发布，具有强大的垂直强调感和紧凑的标志性热度标记。所有标签文本必须是原创的。

光照：来自前上方中心的明亮影棚主灯，带有温暖的侧面造型光，以强调瓶子的体积、瓶盖的纹理、酱汁的半透明感和光泽反射。在瓶子边缘添加柔和的轮廓高光，并在下方菜肴下添加柔和的地面阴影。保持背景发光且具平面感，没有浑浊的对比度或死黑区域。

材质与写实：真实的半透明塑料挤压瓶，带有可见的厚度，带有悬浮辣椒碎的光泽酱体，清晰的瓶盖棱线，带有微妙光泽的高级印刷标签，可信的液体弯月面和干净的反射。底部的食物搭配应高度写实且令人垂涎：一盘切片鸡肉、一盘炸咸味小吃和一盘带蘸酱的酥脆春卷。保持三盘整齐排列，尺寸一致，且明显次于瓶子。

排版与布局：仅使用原创英文文本，严禁复制现有措辞。在左上角放置大胆标题，如“TROPIC HEAT”，右上角放置标题如“SHARP FINISH”。保持文案简短、堆叠并符合海报要求。在下方板块中，仅使用极简的微型文案，如“dip”、“drizzle”和“crave”。瓶身标签和顶部标题必须承载品牌形象。

色彩策略：主导色为火热的橙色和饱和的辣椒红，辅以绿色瓶盖点缀、米白色字体、淡色水果亮色以及底部菜肴中的自然食物色调。保持色调大胆、热带感、火热且严格受控。

质量与物理规则：极其清晰的核心瓶子，可读的标签，正确的瓶子对称，真实的酱汁半透明度，整洁的底部网格对齐，相等的底部面板宽度，一致的盘子尺寸，可信的装饰比例，瓶子无变形，食物无扭曲，无多余道具，不杂乱，没有廉价传单感。瓶子在任何时候都必须是绝对的视觉中心。

负面提示词：复制的品牌，复制的口号，弱产品层级，模糊的瓶子，无法阅读的标签，虚假的塑料反射，扭曲的瓶盖，变形的瓶形状，浑浊的橙色背景，死黑板块，杂乱的布局，过多的漂浮成分，过大的底部菜肴，不一致的盘子尺寸，廉价的零售传单美学，卡通渲染，CGI感，插画风格，低分辨率食物细节，产品失去主导地位。

items.title: 高级像素游戏旅行海报

prompts.text:
Please turn every travel photo I upload into an independent high-end pixel game travel poster. No multi-photo stitching, one photo corresponds to one complete finished product.

The overall composition adopts a strict 3:4 vertical layout. The screen is divided into two nearly 1:1 areas at the top and bottom, using a straight, clear, and clean horizontal boundary in the middle. Only output the front of the poster, do not generate photo frames, walls, handheld displays, or Mockups.

### Top Half: High-Fidelity Original Photography

The upper half must faithfully preserve the original photo.

Accurately maintain the subject identity and quantity in the photo, person or animal poses, vehicle and boat directions, architectural structures, topographic relationships, observation angles, spatial perspective, front-and-back occlusion, real materials, natural light and shadow, and the original color atmosphere.

Only perform slight, restrained travel magazine, art publication, or photography exhibition level color grading, and add very thin film grain. The upper half must still clearly be a real photo.

不得将照片插画化，不得移动、替换、增删或放大主体，不得重塑建筑、镜像场景、改变人物动作或使用模糊照片填充画幅。

### Bottom Half: Subject Extraction-Style Pixel Game Redrawing

Do not fully pixelate the entire photo.

First, understand the single visual subject in the photo most worth the viewer getting closer to, operating, entering, or continuing to explore, for example:

- A landmark building with a clear outline
- A ship, vehicle, or other travel transportation tool
- A character or a group of characters with clear movement relationships
- A door, a stall, a bridge, or an independent travel object
- A section of road, steps, or navigation path that can represent the photo's story

Choose only one main visual anchor.

Retain the subject's most recognizable outline, posture, orientation, key structure, and iconic colors, and reconstruct it into an aesthetically mature independent travel game character, location, or interactive object.

The subject usually occupies about 35%–60% of the width and about 25%–45% of the height of the bottom area, placed in the lower center or naturally offset according to the direction of the original scene.

Do not redraw according to the original photo's full framing, original proportions, and original background density.

### Environmental Reduction

Keep only one to three environmental clues that can explain the location, direction, and action relationships, such as:

- A short section of road, track, steps, or track
- Two or three building facades or mountain fragments
- A small amount of trees, street lamps, guardrails, or shorelines
- Several sets of water ripples, reflections, or ground color blocks
- A very small distant figure, vehicle, or ship as a scale prompt

Delete other tourists, repeated window panes, dense vegetation, billboards, cluttered traffic, complex skies, irrelevant buildings, and photography noise.

The bottom half retains at least about 50%–65% of continuous warm off-white paper surface. Allow blank space to directly represent sky, air, water surface, distance, streets, or game areas that have not yet been explored.

### Pixel Medium

Rebuild the subject using square or near-square pixel blocks with clear edges.

- Use smaller, denser pixel blocks at key points of subject recognition.
- Use medium-sized pixel blocks for the main volume of the subject.
- Gradually reduce pixel density for roads, water ripples, vegetation, reflections, and distant views.
- The interior of the subject is relatively complete, and the exterior breaks apart, misaligns, scatters, and disappears into the paper white frame by frame along the real outline, road direction, water flow, mountain trend, or movement direction.
- Outlines must have clear stepped hard edges.
- There can be a small amount of paper gaps between pixel blocks.

This is not a photo mosaic filter, not an overall reduction in photo resolution, nor a blurred pixelated, cyber glitch, or data corruption effect.

The overall should be like an independent travel game with mature art design: a real location compressed into a small level that can be approached, entered, and continued to be explored.

### Game Text Information

Text is not tiny editorial notes, but part of the game scene information.

Based on the location, subject, and action that can be confirmed in the photo, extract and keep only three layers of English information:

1. Main Title: Location, landmark or scene name, 1–3 English words.
2. Area Subtitle: Route, area or scene type, 1–3 English words.
3. Status Information: Real action or state happening in the photo, 2–4 English words.

If the specific location cannot be confirmed, do not invent place names, coordinates, or dates; use the subject and scene names.

The main title is the second visual center of the bottom half:

- Use 8-bit or 16-bit pixel display fonts truly built on a grid.
- All uppercase, thick glyphs, square ends, no anti-aliasing.
- Width usually occupies about 35%–55% of the bottom area.
- Must be clearly readable when viewed normally, cannot be shrunk into technical side notes.
- Can use dark character faces extracted from photos, and add a one-grid light-colored or characteristic-colored hard-edged pixel drop shadow.
- Long titles are allowed to be compactly divided into two lines.

Area subtitles are about 35%–45% of the main title font size, like map area categories.

Status information can be smaller, but must still be readable when viewed normally, and naturally arranged along the subject baseline, road, track, or water ripple.

The text must use the same pixel grid, limited color palette, and hard-edge mechanism as the image, looking as if it naturally grew out of the game scene rather than a common monospaced font pasted later.

Do not generate other text, numbers, author names, signatures, accounts, brands, logos, QR codes, or URLs.

### Color

The color scheme is extracted entirely from the current photo and compressed into about 6–12 main color levels.

Retain the most recognizable colors of the subject and use adjacent light and dark colors to establish volume. One highly saturated color that truly exists in the photo can be retained as a visual jump point.

Off-white paper must be the largest color block in the bottom half.

Do not fixedly use neon blue-purple, cyber color schemes, game console high-saturation colors, or sunset orange unrelated to the original photo.

### Overall Vibe

Authentic, quiet, with a sense of life, while also having a desire for game exploration.

Like an ordinary moment during a trip, suddenly saved as an area unlock screen, location map, or action save in an independent game.

Gamification comes from subject extraction, pixel structure, level-style space, and text information hierarchy, rather than stacking HUDs and game icons.

### Mandatory Avoidance

Avoid: full-scene pixel redraw, same-crop same-scale redraw, complete pixel background, photo mosaic filter, overall low resolution, blurry pixelation, smooth vector illustration, generic pixel landscape, generic landmark icon, giant HUD, health bars, buttons, dialogue boxes, inventory panels, commercial game logo, voxel 3D, Minecraft blocks, cyber glitch, data corruption, neon palette, invented landmark, invented people, altered architecture, excessive text, tiny unreadable title, ordinary typewriter font, author name, signature, watermark, pixels crossing the horizontal divider.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张旅行照片分别制作成一张独立的高级像素游戏旅行海报。不要多图拼接，一张照片对应一张完整成品。

整体采用严格的 3:4 竖版构图。画面上下分为两个接近 1:1 的区域，中间使用笔直、清楚、干净的水平边界。只输出海报正面，不生成相框、墙面、手持展示或 Mockup。

### 上半部分：高保真原始摄影

上半部分必须忠实保留原始照片。

准确保持照片中的主体身份与数量、人物或动物姿态、车辆和船只方向、建筑结构、地形关系、观察角度、空间透视、前后遮挡、真实材质、自然光影和原有色彩氛围。

只进行轻微、克制的旅行杂志、艺术出版物或摄影展级调色，并加入极薄胶片颗粒。上半部分仍然必须明确是一张真实照片。

不得将照片插画化，不得移动、替换、增删或放大主体，不得重塑建筑、镜像场景、改变人物动作或使用模糊照片填充画幅。

### 下半部分：主体提炼式像素游戏转绘

不要将整张照片完整像素化。

首先理解照片中最值得观者靠近、操作、进入或继续探索的单一视觉主体，例如：

- 一座具有明确轮廓的地标建筑
- 一艘船、车辆或其他旅行交通工具
- 一个人物或一组动作关系清楚的人物
- 一扇门、一个摊位、一座桥或一个独立旅行物件
- 一段能够代表照片故事的道路、台阶或航行路径

只选择一个主要视觉锚点。

保留主体最具识别度的轮廓、姿态、朝向、关键结构和标志性色彩，将它重新构建成审美成熟的独立旅行游戏角色、地点或可交互物件。

主体通常占下半区域宽度约 35%–60%、高度约 25%–45%，放置在中央偏下或依据原场景方向自然偏移。

不要按照原照片的完整取景、原比例和原背景密度重新绘制。

### 环境删减

只保留一至三条能够解释地点、方向和行动关系的环境线索，例如：

- 一小段道路、铁轨、台阶或航迹
- 两三块建筑立面或山体碎片
- 少量树木、街灯、护栏或岸线
- 几组水纹、倒影或地面色块
- 一个很小的远处人物、车辆或船只作为尺度提示

删除其他游客、重复窗格、密集植被、广告牌、杂乱交通、复杂天空、无关建筑和摄影噪声。

下半部分至少保留约 50%–65% 连续的温暖米白纸面。允许空白直接代表天空、空气、水面、距离、街道或尚未探索的游戏区域。

### 像素媒介

使用边缘清楚的正方形或近似正方形像素块重新搭建主体。

- 主体识别关键处使用较小、较密的像素块。
- 主体主要体量使用中等尺寸像素块。
- 道路、水纹、植被、倒影和远景逐渐降低像素密度。
- 主体内部相对完整，外围沿真实轮廓、道路方向、水流、山势或运动方向逐格断开、错位、散落并消失到纸白。
- 轮廓必须具有明确的台阶状硬边。
- 像素块之间可以有少量纸面缺口。

这不是照片马赛克滤镜，不是将照片整体降低分辨率，也不是模糊像素化、赛博故障或数据损坏效果。

整体应像一款具有成熟美术设计的独立旅行游戏：真实地点被压缩成一个可以靠近、进入和继续探索的小型关卡。

### 游戏文字信息

文字不是微小的编辑注释，而是游戏场景信息的一部分。

根据照片中能够确认的地点、主体和动作，提炼且只保留三层英文信息：

1. 主标题：地点、地标或场景名称，1–3 个英文单词。
2. 区域副标题：路线、区域或场景类型，1–3 个英文单词。
3. 状态信息：照片中正在发生的真实动作或状态，2–4 个英文单词。

如果无法确认具体地点，不得虚构地名、坐标或日期，应使用主体和场景名称。

主标题是下半部分的第二视觉中心：

- 使用真正建立在方格网格上的 8-bit 或 16-bit 像素显示字体。
- 全部大写，字形厚实、端点方正、无抗锯齿。
- 宽度通常占下半区域约 35%–55%。
- 正常查看时必须清楚可读，不能缩成技术边注。
- 可使用从照片提取的深色字面，并加入一格浅色或特征色硬边像素投影。
- 长标题允许紧凑地分成两行。

区域副标题约为主标题字号的 35%–45%，像地图区域分类。

状态信息可以更小，但正常查看仍须可读，并沿主体基线、道路、航迹或水纹自然排列。

文字必须与画面使用相同的像素网格、限色色盘和硬边机制，像从游戏场景中自然长出来，而不是后期贴上的普通等宽字体。

不得生成其他文字、数字、作者名、签名、账号、品牌、Logo、二维码或网址。

### 色彩

配色完全从当前照片提取并压缩为约 6–12 个主色阶。

保留主体最具识别度的颜色，并使用相邻深浅色建立体积。可保留一处照片中真实存在的高饱和颜色作为视觉跳点。

米白纸面必须是下半部分的最大色块。

不要固定使用霓虹蓝紫、赛博配色、游戏机高饱和色或与原照片无关的夕阳橙。

### 整体气质

真实、安静、有生活感，同时带有游戏探索欲。

像旅行途中一个普通瞬间，突然被保存成独立游戏中的区域解锁画面、地点地图或行动存档。

游戏化来自主体提炼、像素结构、关卡式空间与文字信息层级，而不是堆叠 HUD 和游戏图标。

### 强制避免

Avoid: full-scene pixel redraw, same-crop same-scale redraw, complete pixel background, photo mosaic filter, overall low resolution, blurry pixelation, smooth vector illustration, generic pixel landscape, generic landmark icon, giant HUD, health bars, buttons, dialogue boxes, inventory panels, commercial game logo, voxel 3D, Minecraft blocks, cyber glitch, data corruption, neon palette, invented landmark, invented people, altered architecture, excessive text, tiny unreadable title, ordinary typewriter font, author name, signature, watermark, pixels crossing the horizontal divider.

items.title: 大胆排版商业海报视觉设计

prompts.text:
Create a bold editorial campaign poster where oversized typography actively shapes the visual concept instead of simply sitting in the background.

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product / Campaign: [PRODUCT OR CAMPAIGN]
Main Word: [SHORT WORD]
Subject / Product: [PERSON / PRODUCT / BOTH]
Typography Function: [SHADOW / FRAME / LIGHT / ROUTE / OTHER]
Main Color: [COLOR]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Campaign Details: [SLOGAN / SPECS / DATE / OTHER]
Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Use contemporary editorial design, realistic commercial photography, bold oversized typography, and a strong high-contrast color system.

Make the main word extremely large, filling roughly 50–75% of the composition. Allow letters to extend beyond the canvas, be cropped, overlap the subject, or use their negative space as part of the layout.

Most importantly, give the typography a clear visual function. For example, let the letters cast shadows across the subject, frame a product, shape the lighting, create a movement path, or organize the scene in another meaningful way.

The subject or product should interact naturally with this typography system so the text, photography, and graphic elements feel designed as one composition.

prompts.text:
Better logic for processing the following text:
Please turn each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, each photo output separately. The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout, continuing the top-bottom dual-layer logic: the upper part is real photography, and the lower part is an artistic reconstruction based on subtext and allegory;

The upper part retains the original photo, keeping the subject's identity, structure, posture, real texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end photographic color grading to give it the texture of an art magazine, independent publication, and exhibition photography. To adapt to the frame, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The lower part extracts the most recognizable **subject, outline, posture, narrative relationship, and emotional metaphor** from the photo, not only reproducing "what is seen," but more importantly understanding "what the original image implies, symbolizes, and reminds people of," then reconstructing it into a **geometrically minimalist, poetically romantic, but structurally rigorous** graphic scene. Do not fully depict the original scene, nor copy realistic details, but only retain the core theme and visual logic that most validates the spirit of the original image, translating complex information into a few clear and meaningful forms, paths, landforms, architectural feelings, spatial layers, or symbolic objects, making people feel at a glance that it shares the same source as the original image, while feeling an elevated sense of allegory and poetry.

The composition should be built on **geometric order and rational structure**, with a Da Vinci-like sense of rigor: emphasizing proportion, axis, perspective, primary and secondary order, block-surface relationships, path guidance, and spatial balance. The subject can be transformed into simplified mountains, buildings, vessels, human figures, roads, platforms, domes, arches, discs, tree-like forms, or other symbolic geometric shapes, building a quiet and romantic "conceptual landscape" through a few key elements. The lower part should have a large amount of light-colored negative space and breathing room, with complex backgrounds actively deleted, leaving only the necessary field to support the theme and allegory, allowing the blank space, distance, and order itself to participate in the narrative.

Visual language adopts **geometric flat graphics + soft manual texture**: clear and generalized forms, restrained edges, simplified details, allowing a slight paper, powdery, or print-like feel, but avoiding a sticker, 3D, realistic, and over-decorated feel. The overall image has both the simplicity of modern graphic design and the poetic nature of romantic narrative illustration, like a dream map, memory landscape, or allegorical illustration constrained by rational structure.

Color palette continues the current logic: overall adoption of **soft, transparent, slightly desaturated high-end color systems**, with an extremely light, clean, near-white pale background as a large-area breathing field. Use **pale pink-blue, mist blue, sky blue, airy cold-toned blue** to create the main atmosphere, then use **ivory white, cream white, light beige, soft gray-green, architectural neutral colors** to maintain balance; a small amount of **blush pink, soft peach, dusty rose, or muted blush** can be added as local highlights to make the image more healing, poetic, and exquisitely layered. Avoid dirty gray, excessive contrast, high-saturation clashing colors, and cheap vintage feels.

The text does not preset fixed titles, numbers, locations, or languages, nor does it provide menu-style information. It should freely generate a very small number of truly meaningful characters, words, short sentences, or fragments based on the theme, emotion, allegory, memory, or cultural context of the photo, and naturally enter the blank area through high-end editorial layout. The text should be small, light, restrained, and exquisite, and can be arranged along axes, edges, paths, or around the subject, like notes, labels, or observational phrases in an independent publication, forming a quiet and clever relationship with the geometric composition.

Overall temperament should be like an independently published art travel journal or visual allegory manual: **minimalist, poetic, romantic, rational, restrained, with geometric order and conceptual beauty.** Avoid complete realistic landscapes, information stacking, complex decorations, overcrowded subjects, overly solid backgrounds, template-like poster feels, e-commerce illustration feels, cartoon feels, and cheap collage feels.

prompts.text:
更好的逻辑处理如下文本：
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，延续上下双层逻辑：上半部分为真实摄影，下半部分为基于潜台词与寓意的艺术化重构；

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览摄影质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的**主体、轮廓、姿态、叙事关系与情绪隐喻**，不仅重现“看见了什么”，更要理解原图“在暗示什么、象征什么、让人联想到什么”，再将其重构为一种**几何极简、诗意浪漫、但结构严谨**的图形化场景。不要完整描摹原场景，也不要照搬现实细节，而是只保留最能成立原图精神的核心主题与视觉逻辑，把复杂信息转译成少量清晰而有意味的形体、路径、地貌、建筑感、空间层次或象征性对象，让人一眼感到与原图同源，同时感受到被提升后的寓言感与诗意。

构图应建立在**几何秩序与理性结构**之上，具有类似达·芬奇式的严谨感：重视比例、轴线、透视、主次秩序、块面关系、路径引导与空间平衡。主体可被转化为简化的山体、建筑体、器物体、人物体、道路、平台、穹顶、拱形、圆盘、树状体或其他象征性几何形体，通过少量关键元素搭建一个安静而浪漫的“观念景观”。下半部分应有大量淡色留白与呼吸空间，复杂背景主动删减，只留下支撑主题与寓意的必要场域，让空白、距离和秩序本身参与叙事。

视觉语言采用**几何化平面图形 + 柔和手工质感**：形体清晰概括，边缘克制，细节简化，允许轻微纸感、粉感或版画感，但避免贴纸感、3D感、写实感和过度装饰。画面整体既有现代图形设计的简洁，也有浪漫叙事插画的诗性，像一幅被理性结构约束过的梦境地图、记忆风景或寓意图解。

配色延续当前逻辑：整体采用**柔和、通透、略微去饱和的高级色系**，并以极浅、干净、接近白色的淡色背景作为大面积呼吸场。以**浅粉蓝、雾蓝、天空蓝、空气感冷调蓝**营造主氛围，再以**象牙白、奶油白、浅米色、柔和灰绿、建筑中性色**保持平衡；可加入少量 **blush pink、soft peach、dusty rose 或 muted blush** 作为局部点睛，使画面更具治愈感、诗意与精致层次。避免脏灰、过强反差、高饱和撞色和廉价复古感。

文字不预设固定标题、编号、地点或语种，也不做菜单式信息。应根据照片的主题、情绪、寓意、记忆或文化语境，自由生成极少量真正有意义的字、词、短句或片段，并通过高级编辑排版自然进入留白区域。文字应小、轻、克制、精致，可沿轴线、边缘、路径或主体周围排布，像独立出版物中的注记、题签或观察性短语，与几何构图形成安静而聪明的关系。

整体气质应像一本独立出版的艺术旅行刊物或视觉寓言手册：**极简、诗意、浪漫、理性、克制、带有几何秩序与观念美感。** 避免完整写实风景、信息堆积、复杂装饰、主体过满、背景过实、模板化海报感、电商插画感、卡通感和廉价拼贴感。

The fabric should look like silk or satin, decorated with very low-contrast gray-pink floral or ink-wash botanical motifs. The bodice fits the chest and waist naturally without looking excessively tight. The chest remains fully covered and only shows a restrained natural contour through the fitted satin fabric.  The qipao has high side slits. In the low seated pose, substantial portions of both thighs become visible through the slits, while the center skirt panel drops naturally between the legs in irregular, gravity-driven satin folds. Avoid perfect symmetry in the drape.  She is sitting on a very low stone seat or ledge, hips close to the ground, torso facing directly toward the camera and remaining relatively upright while the shoulders stay relaxed. Both knees open widely toward the sides, creating the distinctive broad triangular lower-body composition from the reference. Because the thighs and knees are closer to the lens, allow a believable amount of 24–28mm smartphone wide-angle perspective, making the knees slightly more prominent without stretching the legs into impossible proportions.  One arm is raised with the elbow bent, the fingers loosely holding a thin white cigarette-like stick, with no prominent smoke. The opposite arm hangs naturally beside the other knee and lower leg. Keep slight differences in shoulder level, wrist rotation, elbow position and knee height instead of creating perfectly mirrored anatomy.  She wears pale nude-pink or light beige delicate square-toe strappy heels with thin ankle straps. Add only a small dark brown-black beaded bracelet on the wrist at frame right and a very thin minimalist ring on one finger of the lowered hand. No additional jewelry and no visible phone.  Accurately preserve the visible skin regions. Visible skin includes the entire face and neck, both shoulders, both arms and hands, large portions of both thighs through the high side slits, the knees, lower legs, ankles, tops of the feet and toes. The chest, abdomen, waist, back and buttocks remain covered by the qipao.  Her skin is fair with a neutral-to-slightly-cool pink undertone. It may show mild smartphone beauty retouching, but it should still feel tactile and human: the upper arms and thighs look softly matte, smooth and supple, while the knees, knuckles and ankles retain faint natural texture, joints and subtle anatomical changes. Do not create poreless plastic skin. Weak frontal fill keeps the face, shoulders, arms and legs relatively even in brightness, with very soft highlights rather than oily shine.  The setting is a shaded outdoor garden pavilion surrounded by dense greenery. A gray-brown wooden bench or railing runs horizontally behind her. A black garden lamp post rises vertically from directly behind the center of her head, with part of its round white lamp globe visible near the upper frame. Preserve this accidental overlap rather than correcting it into a cleaner professional composition.  Surround the pavilion with dense dark green broadleaf plants and tree branches. The foreground consists of rough gray stone tiles with cracks, stains, irregular patterns and natural tonal variation.  Use physically believable daytime lighting beneath a dense tree canopy. The sky behind the subject is extremely bright and locally blown out to white, while the foliage underneath falls into deep green shadow. The subject receives soft skylight and possibly a very weak frontal phone flash or localized exposure lift, causing her face, shoulders and limbs to remain brighter and more evenly exposed than the darker vegetation. Facial shadows remain shallow. Do not introduce dramatic side lighting, a studio three-point setup, strong artificial rim lighting or warm golden-hour sunset tones.  Shoot with the visual behavior of a 24–28mm full-frame-equivalent smartphone main camera, approximately 1.5–2 meters from the subject. Position the camera around the seated subject's upper-abdomen to waist height, slightly below her eye line, giving an extremely subtle low-angle perspective. Frame her completely from the top of the head to the shoes.  Use moderate-to-deep depth of field: the woman is sharp, while the wooden railing, nearby foliage and stone-floor texture remain clearly readable, with only mild softening in more distant greenery. Avoid an 85mm f/1.4 creamy-bokeh look.  The final image should feel like a genuine casual phone photograph that received only mild social-media beauty processing, not a flawless commercial fashion campaign. Preserve small imperfections: mild skin smoothing mixed with digital sharpening, slight exposure inconsistency, clipped sky highlights, leaves partially obstructing the background, the lamp post awkwardly intersecting the head, messy stone-floor texture, minor body asymmetry, subtle digital noise and light compression artifacts.  The emotional identity is a quiet, restrained, slightly distant modern-qipao moment in summer garden shade. She had already become still, yet the photograph feels as though this particular moment is about to disappear.  Negative prompt: minor, mirror selfie, phone covering face, standing pose, extreme hourglass body, impossible long legs, exaggerated lips, heavy Western glam, plastic skin, wax face, excessive skin smoothing, extra fingers, malformed hands, malformed knees, perfect mechanical symmetry, extreme 85mm bokeh, creamy background blur, studio rim light, golden sunset, overprocessed HDR, synthetic AI skin, sterile cleaned background, heavy smoke.

prompts.text: 创建一张3:4纵横比的全身环境肖像，具有真实智能手机照片的视觉特征，紧密保留参考的构图和氛围。一名视觉年龄在22-28岁左右的年轻成年女性，极低地坐在户外花园凉亭的中心。她身材苗条纤长，肩膀窄小，天生细腰，长直的深黑棕色头发垂至胸部以下，呈整洁的中分或近乎中分的发型。保留参考的面部比例：窄椭圆脸，精致的下颚线，相对较大的眼睛，苗条笔直的鼻子和柔软的小嘴唇。不要将面部重新设计成夸张的西方高骨骼结构魅力感或极端的网红V脸。她直视镜头，眼神平静，略微放大但具有可信度，外眼角微微上扬。她的嘴唇轻轻闭合，几乎保持中性。没有微笑。她的表情显得安静、柔和且略显疏离，仿佛她刚刚在花园的阴凉处坐定；前一秒的情绪依然萦绕，而这一刻仿佛随时可能再次打破。使用符合现代旗袍造型的当代东亚社交媒体柔美妆容语言：白皙的中性至冷色调粉色底妆，柔和的半哑光皮肤，略微向外延伸的纤细黑色眼线，淡粉棕色眼影，细致的自然眉毛，非常克制的腮红以及低饱和度的干枯玫瑰色或裸粉色嘴唇。保持精致但不具戏剧性，不使用浓重的修容或过度的人工感。让她穿着一件柔和的粉色/灰粉色无袖高领旗袍，配有立领、斜襟和精致的传统粉色盘扣细节。面料看起来应该是丝绸或缎面，装饰有对比度非常低的灰粉色花卉或水墨植物图案。上衣自然贴合胸部和腰部，看起来不会过分紧身。胸部完全覆盖，仅通过贴身的缎面面料显示出克制的自然轮廓。旗袍有高侧叉。在低坐姿下，大腿的大部分通过开衩可见，而裙摆中心部分则自然地垂落在双腿之间，形成受重力驱动的不规则缎面褶皱。避免垂坠感的完美对称。她坐在一个非常低的石座或边缘，臀部靠近地面，躯干直接面对镜头并保持相对挺直，而肩膀保持放松。双膝向两侧大开，营造出参考图中独特的宽三角形下半身构图。由于大腿和膝盖离镜头更近，允许一定程度的可信的24-28mm手机广角透视，使膝盖略显突出，但不会将腿部拉伸成不可能的比例。一只手臂抬起，肘部弯曲，手指松松地拿着一根细长的白色类香烟棒，没有明显的烟雾。另一只手臂自然垂在另一侧膝盖和小腿旁。在肩膀高度、手腕转动、肘部位置和膝盖高度上保持细微差异，而不是创造完美的镜像解剖结构。她穿着浅裸粉色或浅米色的精致方头系带高跟鞋，配有细踝带。仅在画面右侧的手腕上添加一串深棕黑色小圆珠手链，并在下垂手的一根手指上戴一枚极细的极简主义戒指。没有额外的珠宝，也没有可见的手机。准确保留可见的皮肤区域。可见皮肤包括整个面部和颈部、双肩、双臂和双手、通过高侧叉露出的大腿大部分区域、膝盖、小腿、脚踝、脚背和脚趾。胸部、腹部、腰部、背部和臀部保持被旗袍覆盖。她的皮肤白皙，带有中性至略微偏冷的粉色底调。它可能表现出轻微的智能手机美容修图感，但仍应感觉具有触感和人性：上臂和大腿看起来柔和哑光、光滑且富有弹性，而膝盖、指关节和脚踝则保留微弱的自然纹理、关节和细微的解剖变化。不要创造无毛孔的塑料皮肤。弱正面补光使面部、肩膀、手臂和腿部的亮度相对均匀，带有非常柔和的高光，而不是油腻的光泽。环境是一个阴凉的户外花园凉亭，被茂密的绿色植物包围。一个灰褐色的木凳或栏杆横向贯穿她的身后。一根黑色的花园灯杆从她头部的正后方垂直升起，部分圆形白色灯球在画面上方可见。保留这种偶然的重叠，而不是将其修正为更整洁的专业构图。凉亭周围环绕着茂密的深绿色阔叶植物和树枝。前景由粗糙的灰色石砖组成，带有裂缝、污点、不规则图案和自然的色调变化。在茂密的树荫下使用物理上可信的白天光线。被摄对象身后的天空极其明亮，局部过曝为白色，而下方的叶子则处于深绿色的阴影中。被摄对象接收到柔和的天光，可能还有非常弱的正面手机闪光灯或局部曝光提升，导致她的面部、肩膀和四肢保持比阴暗植被更明亮、更均匀的曝光。面部阴影保持浅淡。不要引入戏剧性的侧光、摄影棚三点布光、强烈的专业轮廓光或温暖的金光时刻日落色调。以24-28mm全画幅等效智能手机主摄像头的视觉行为进行拍摄，距离被摄对象约1.5-2米。将相机置于坐着的被摄对象上腹部到腰部的高度，略低于她的视线高度，提供一个极其微妙的低角度视角。构图完整，从头顶到鞋子。使用中等至深景深：女性是清晰的，而木栏杆、附近的树叶和石地板纹理保持清晰可辨，只有在更远的绿植中才有轻微的软化。避免85mm f/1.4的奶油色虚化效果。最终图像应该感觉像一张真实的、随意的手机照片，仅经过轻微的社交媒体美容处理，而不是完美无瑕的商业时尚大片。保留微小的瑕疵：轻微的皮肤磨皮与数字锐化相结合、轻微的曝光不一致、被剪裁的天空高光、部分遮挡背景的叶子、灯杆尴尬地与头部交叉、杂乱的石地板纹理、轻微的身材不对称、细微的数字噪点和轻微的压缩伪影。情感身份是夏季花园阴影下平静、克制、略显疏离的现代旗袍时刻。她已经安静下来，然而照片感觉这一特定时刻即将消失。负向提示词：轻微，镜中自拍，手机遮脸，站姿，极端沙漏型身材，不可能的长腿，夸张的嘴唇，浓重的西方魅力妆容，塑料皮肤，蜡像脸，过度皮肤磨皮，多余的手指，畸形的手，畸形的膝盖，完美的机械对称，极端的85mm虚化，奶油色背景模糊，影棚轮廓光，金色日落，过度处理的HDR，合成AI皮肤，无菌清理过的背景，浓烟。

prompts.text: Please turn each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-photo stitching, each photo output separately. Overall adopts a 3:4 vertical composition. The screen is strictly divided from top to bottom into four horizontal areas, the height of each area must precisely account for 25% of the overall screen, the ratio of the four layers is strictly 1:1:1:1, no ratio deviation allowed. Seamless transition between areas, no dividers, no white space gaps. The 'no white space gaps' here only means that the seams between layers cannot have gaps; the interior of each layer can still retain negative space, paper, or solid color backgrounds according to the corresponding style. All four layers are based solely on the same uploaded photo, presenting the same subject, the same moment, and the same spatial relationship. Strictly maintain consistency in subject identity, quantity, key structure, proportions, posture, movement direction, line of sight, observation perspective, perspective, occlusion, left-right position, front-back relationship, and core narrative. The four layers are not four unrelated new compositions, but a continuous style translation of the same image. Since each layer is an extremely flat banner of about 3:1, the subject should be organized horizontally, and appropriate breathing space should be reserved on the left and right; natural horizontal extension or slight cropping of the background is allowed, but the subject must not be stretched vertically, key parts must not be cropped, character relationships must not be changed, or scenes unrelated to the original image must not be created. The visual center of gravity, subject proportion, and contour landing points of the four layers should be aligned vertically as much as possible, forming a coherent evolution from real photography to the target style. Each layer must completely fill its own 25% area. Do not add layer numbers, dividers, borders, collage gaps, watermarks, or logos. Unless a layer style description explicitly requires small amounts of editorial text, bill marks, or handwritten notes, do not generate extra text; even if text is needed, it must be small, restrained, not block the subject, and avoid gibberish as much as possible. Layer 1 | Original Photography: Directly retain the real photography state of the uploaded photo as the visual benchmark for the style translation of the subsequent three layers. Maintain the original person or subject identity, quantity, facial features, hairstyle, clothing, structure, proportions, posture, movements, line of sight, interactive relationships, observation perspective, perspective, occlusion, environmental direction, natural light and shadow, and core colors, without performing illustration, texture transformation, geometrization, or 3D reconstruction. To adapt to the extremely flat banner of about 3:1, only natural extension of the left and right sides of the background that conforms to the original scene logic is allowed, or slight cropping that does not damage the subject; the subject's proportions must not be changed, people or buildings must not be stretched, and the head, hands, feet, key objects, or important narrative relationships must not be cropped. The screen remains natural, real, and clear, avoiding excessive skin smoothing, exaggerated color grading, fictional scenery, and decorations unrelated to the original image. Layer 2 | Black and White Thick Crayon Silhouette: In the roughly 3:1 flat horizontal banner area of this layer, translate the real subject of the first layer into a 'black and white thick crayon silhouette' style. Maintain consistency with the first layer's subject identity, quantity, key structure, posture, left-right position, perspective, spatial relationship, and core narrative, and then fully implement the following visual requirements: Extract the most recognizable subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, and reconstruct it as a minimalist thick black dry medium silhouette illustration. Do not mechanically trace photo details, but compress the subject into a rounded, thick, slightly naive generalized form; the head, main outline, or most memorable parts can be appropriately enlarged so that it can still be identified at a glance with minimal information. If the photo contains multiple subjects, retain the most important interactive relationship and treat them as a single visual unit rather than spreading focus evenly. This layer only uses nearly pure white paper base + thick black crayon, charcoal, or dry erase marks, no colors, no grayscale gradients. The black form is not a smooth solid vector block, but is formed by repeated smearing of short, forceful crayons, retaining paper grain, broken strokes, indentations, rough edges, uneven thickness, and local white exposure. The outline is slightly shaky, incomplete, and imprecise, giving the screen a real handmade feel. The most critical identification features of the subject can be strengthened through 'white feature areas suddenly cut out from the black silhouette,' such as the face, around the eyes, window holes, vessel openings, animal faces, key structures of objects, or the most identifiable parts; then use minimal black dots, short lines, or symbols to complete expressions and details. Do not pursue realistic facial features and precise structures, but let a direct, interesting, and strong identification relationship form between black and white. Composition maintains large areas of pure negative space + one main visual relationship. The subject can be centered and suspended, or slightly offset, partially cropped, or close to the bottom of the screen, using only a rough ground friction line, a few short lines, or minimal environmental symbols to suggest space. Grass, rain, smoke, table, shadow, road, wind, or other environmental information should be compressed into minimal crayon marks, keeping the background quiet and empty. Overall does not pursue complex scenes, but lets a posture, action, distance, or relationship bear the main narrative. Text retains a system of small characters where a sense of high-end editorial and children's book coexist. Do not just write the name of the place or object, but extract a short English title from the emotions, actions, relationships, time, or tiny stories in the photo, and then pair it with a number, a matching gold sentence, a chapter number, or a very short, implicit piece of copy. The text can be restrained small printed characters, or a very small amount of clumsy handwriting, crayon characters, or incomplete regular font shapes can be added, making it look as if it originally belonged to this illustration. Text needs to have a clever relationship with the graphics: it can be arranged along the ground line, extended along the direction of the subject's movement, hidden in large areas of negative space, slightly blocked by the outline, stuck in the negative space between two subjects, or use a thin line to connect the number to the subject. Maintain 'one short title + 1–2 groups of tiny auxiliary text' to let the text become part of the composition's rhythm, rather than a common poster title. Overall presents visual characteristics of thick black, clean white, simple shape, and rough texture, maintaining a subtle balance between childishness, gentleness, quietness, humor, and loneliness, like an old black-and-white children's book re-edited by a high-end design studio. Avoid smooth digital strokes, precise line drawings, realistic light and shadow, impasto, 3D effects, color, large-area gray rendering, cartoon sticker feel, and templated commercial illustration. Layer 3 | Geometric Order Linear Experiment: In the roughly 3:1 flat horizontal banner area of this layer, translate the real subject of the first layer into a 'geometric order linear experiment' style. Maintain consistency with the first layer's subject identity, quantity, key structure, posture, left-right position, perspective, spatial relationship, and core narrative, and then fully implement the following visual requirements: Extract the most recognizable subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, and reconstruct it as a linear experimental poster with geometric order. The subject is manifested by high-density repeating lines, misplaced outlines, short loops, and slight jitter trajectories, retaining clear identification edges while maintaining instability and flow internally; the periphery uses lines of the same origin but thinner, sparser, and lighter to spread outward, and establishes a rational structure with horizontal, vertical, diagonal, arc, tangent, or implicit grids, forming visual tension with high density in the center and low density on the periphery, where geometric order and free linearity coexist. Color extraction: from the uploaded original photo, extract the color that is most vital, most recognizable, and best represents the spirit of the subject as the main line color; do not take the average color by area, and do not deliberately age or gray it; it can be appropriately purified, brightened, and corrected to make the color cleaner, more vivid, and more modern. Overall adopts a clean light-colored background, a single main line color, and black-gray micro-typography, forming layers through line density, thickness, and overlapping, avoiding dirty colors, grayness, fixed blue tones, multi-color mixing, and digital gradients. Text intervenes cleverly as part of the composition, extracting a very short English title from the emotion, action, time, state, or metaphor of the photo, and pairing it with a small amount of numbers, matching philosophical gold sentences, state words, scales, or micro-annotations. Text can be arranged along geometric axes, subject outlines, or line field boundaries, arranged horizontally, vertically, rotated, interspersed, or misplaced, forming a sense of high-end editing through tiny font size, thin font weight, wide letter spacing, and precise alignment, so that rational typesetting suppresses the restlessness of free lines. Overall maintains large areas of negative space, a single visual focus, and clear geometric order, presenting a clean, restrained, sharp, experimental, artistic, and vital visual temperament. Avoid random graffiti, directionless yarn balls, dirty old vintage, cyber-tech feel, commercial promotion feel, cartoon feel, and template feel. Layer 4 | Dynamic Magnetic Field Grain Print: In the roughly 3:1 flat horizontal banner area of this layer, translate the real subject of the first layer into a 'dynamic magnetic field grain print' style. Maintain consistency with the first layer's subject identity, quantity, key structure, posture, left-right position, perspective, spatial relationship, and core narrative, and then fully implement the following visual requirements: Extract the most recognizable subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, and reconstruct it as a surreal minimalist print visual. Compress the subject into a clear and restrained visual anchor, usually placed in a large area of negative space on a small scale, retaining only the most critical outline and posture; do not replicate complex details, but let the actions, directions, light and shadow, or spatial relationships in the original image transform into a dynamic field expanding around the subject. The dynamic field naturally chooses a main movement logic according to the subject's own characteristics: prioritized to flow horizontally or diagonally, spread from the core to both sides, or form irregular ripples and echoes; only when the original action itself is clear, retain short-distance falling or rising. Use a large number of thin lines, broken trajectories, coarse dots, and changes in grain density to express movement, denser and stronger near the core, gradually thinning, breaking, and disappearing into negative space towards the edges. Avoid stacking multiple special effects at the same time, let one subject, one movement, and one huge spatial relationship become the core of the screen. Color extraction: from the uploaded original photo, extract the most recognizable and spirited primary color, and form a strict 2–3 color system with warm white, ivory white, or natural paper color and a small amount of black. The primary color can be appropriately purified and strengthened, making it vivid and powerful but not overly digital; form depth through dot density, ink layering, and paper negative space, rather than common gradients. Retain silk screen printing, Risograph, coarse grain, paper fiber, uneven ink coverage, and slight overprint deviation, avoiding computer rendering, 3D, real light effects, and smooth digital illustration feel. Text establishes a restrained experimental art book micro-typography system. Extract a very short English title from the action, distance, state, emotion, or metaphor of the photo, and pair it with 2–4 groups of micro-text, which can be freely combined from short phrases, state words, place or object information, serial numbers, coordinate-style numbers, direction words, archive labels, or observation notes. Text can be arranged along the horizon, dynamic trajectory, subject axis, or negative space edge, or it can be arranged vertically, rotated, with widened letter spacing, embedded in the grain field, or slightly passed through by lines, so that the typesetting itself participates in space and movement, rather than being independently pasted on the screen. Overall pursues tiny subjects, huge negative space, strong scale contrast, a single dynamic field, and coarse printing texture, presenting a quiet, lonely, mysterious, poetic, and slightly surreal experimental editorial visual. Whether the subject is a person, animal, plant, building, utensil, vehicle, or natural landscape, it should maintain a clear identity echo between the original image and the abstract field, avoiding complex scenes, multiple focuses, decorative stacking, common gradients, commercial poster feel, and template feel.
