prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。

整体采用 3:4竖版构图。画面从上到下严格四等分为四个横向区域，每个区域高度必须精确占整体画面的25%，四层比例严格为1:1:1:1，不允许出现比例偏差。区域之间无缝衔接，无分隔线、无留白间隙。这里的“无留白间隙”仅指层与层的接缝不能出现空隙；每层内部仍可按照对应风格保留负空间、纸面或纯色背景。

四层全部以同一张上传照片为唯一依据，呈现同一主体、同一瞬间和同一空间关系。严格保持主体身份、数量、关键结构、比例、姿态、动作方向、视线、观察视角、透视、遮挡、左右位置、前后关系与核心叙事一致。四层不是四张互不相关的新构图，而是同一画面的连续风格转译。由于每层均为约3:1的极扁横幅，主体应横向组织，并保留适量左右呼吸空间；允许对背景进行自然横向延展或轻微裁切，但不得纵向拉伸主体、裁掉关键部位、改变人物关系，或另造与原图无关的场景。

四层的视觉重心、主体占比和轮廓落点尽量上下对齐，形成从真实摄影逐步过渡到目标风格的连贯演化。每层都必须完整填满自身25%的区域。不要添加层号、分隔线、边框、拼贴缝隙、水印或Logo。除非某层风格说明明确要求少量编辑文字、票据标记或手写注释，否则不要额外生成文字；即使需要文字，也必须少量、克制、不遮挡主体，并尽量避免乱码。

第一层｜原始摄影

直接保留上传照片的真实摄影状态，作为后三层风格转译的视觉基准。保持原始人物或主体的身份、数量、面部特征、发型、服装、结构、比例、姿态、动作、视线、互动关系、观察视角、透视、遮挡、环境方向、自然光影与核心色彩，不进行插画化、材质化、几何化或三维重建。

为了适配约3:1的极扁横幅，只允许对背景左右两侧进行符合原场景逻辑的自然延展，或进行不损伤主体的轻微裁切；不得改变主体比例，不得拉伸人物或建筑，不得裁掉头部、手脚、关键物件或重要叙事关系。画面保持自然、真实、清晰，避免过度磨皮、夸张调色、虚构景物和与原图无关的装饰。

第二层｜黑白粗蜡笔剪影

在本层约3:1的扁横幅区域中，将第一层的真实主体转译为“黑白粗蜡笔剪影”风格。保持与第一层一致的主体身份、数量、关键结构、姿态、左右位置、视角、空间关系与核心叙事，再完整执行以下视觉要求：

从照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为极简粗黑干媒介剪影插画。不要机械描摹照片细节，而是将主体压缩成圆润、敦厚、略带稚拙感的概括形体，可适度放大头部、主要轮廓或最有记忆点的局部，使其在极少信息下仍能一眼识别原物。若照片包含多个主体，则保留最重要的互动关系，将它们视为一个整体视觉单元，而不是平均分散焦点。

本层画面只使用近乎纯白的纸面底 + 浓黑蜡笔、炭笔或干擦痕迹，不使用彩色，不使用灰阶渐变。黑色形体不是光滑实心矢量块，而是由短促、有力度的蜡笔反复涂抹形成，保留纸张颗粒、断笔、压痕、边缘毛糙、浓淡不均和局部露白。轮廓略微摇晃、不完整、不精确，让画面保持真实手作感。

主体最关键的识别特征可通过“黑色剪影中突然切出的白色特征区”强化，例如脸部、眼睛周围、窗洞、器皿开口、动物面部、物件核心结构或最具有辨识度的局部；再以极少黑点、短线或符号完成表情与细节。不要追求写实五官和精密结构，而是让黑、白之间形成直接、有趣而强烈的辨识关系。

构图保持大面积纯净留白 + 一个主要视觉关系。主体可居中悬浮，也可轻微偏置、局部裁切或靠近画面下方，仅用一条粗糙地面摩擦线、几根短线或极少环境符号提示空间。草叶、雨丝、烟气、桌面、影子、道路、风或其他环境信息都应被压缩成极少的蜡笔记号，让背景保持安静空旷。整体不追求复杂场景，而让一个姿态、动作、距离或关系承担主要叙事。

文字保留少量高级编辑感与童书感并存的小字系统。不要只写地点或物体名称，而从照片中的情绪、动作、关系、时间或微小故事提炼一个简短英文标题，再搭配编号、适配的金句、章节号或一句极短的含蓄小文案。文字可以是克制的印刷小字，也可以加入极少量笨拙手写、蜡笔字或不完全规整的字形，使其像原本就属于这幅插画。

文字需要与图形发生巧妙关系：可以贴着地面线排列、沿主体动作方向延伸、躲在大片留白中、与轮廓产生轻微遮挡、卡在两个主体之间的负形里，或用一条细线把编号与主体连接起来。保持“一个短标题 + 1–2组极小辅助文字”即可，让文字成为构图节奏的一部分，而不是普通海报标题。

整体呈现黑要粗、白要净、形要简、质要糙的视觉特征，在童稚、温软、安静、幽默与孤独之间保持微妙平衡，像一本由高级设计工作室重新编辑的旧黑白童书。避免光滑数字描边、精密线稿、写实光影、厚涂、三维效果、彩色、大面积灰色渲染、卡通贴纸感和模板化商业插画。

第三层｜几何秩序线性实验

在本层约3:1的扁横幅区域中，将第一层的真实主体转译为“几何秩序线性实验”风格。保持与第一层一致的主体身份、数量、关键结构、姿态、左右位置、视角、空间关系与核心叙事，再完整执行以下视觉要求：

从照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为具有几何秩序的线性实验海报。主体由高密度重复线条、错位描线、短促回环和轻微抖动轨迹聚合显形，保留清晰识别边缘，内部保持不稳定与流动感；外围使用同源但更细、更疏、更轻的线条向外扩散，并以水平、垂直、斜线、圆弧、切线或隐性网格建立理性结构，形成中心高密度、外围低密度，几何秩序与自由线性并存的视觉张力。

配色从上传的原图中提取最有生命力、最有辨识度、最能代表主体精气神的颜色作为主线色，不按面积平均取色，也不刻意做旧降灰；可适度提纯、提亮和校正，使颜色更干净、鲜明、现代。整体采用清洁浅色背景、单一主线色和黑灰微排版，通过线条密度、粗细和叠压形成层次，避免脏色、灰蒙、固定蓝调、多色混杂和数字渐变。

文字作为构图的一部分巧妙介入，从照片的情绪、动作、时间、状态或隐喻中提炼极短英文标题，并搭配少量编号、适配的哲理金句、状态词、标尺或微型注释。文字可沿几何轴线、主体轮廓或线场边界排列，横排、竖排、旋转、穿插或错位，通过极小字号、细字重、宽字距和精确对齐形成高级编辑感，使理性排版压住自由线条的躁动。

整体保持大面积留白、唯一视觉焦点和清晰几何秩序，呈现干净、克制、锐利、实验、艺术化且富有生命力的视觉气质。避免随机涂鸦、无方向线团、脏旧复古、赛博科技感、商业宣传感、卡通感和模板感。

第四层｜动态磁场颗粒版画

在本层约3:1的扁横幅区域中，将第一层的真实主体转译为“动态磁场颗粒版画”风格。保持与第一层一致的主体身份、数量、关键结构、姿态、左右位置、视角、空间关系与核心叙事，再完整执行以下视觉要求：

从照片中提取最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为超现实极简版画视觉。将主体压缩成一个清晰而克制的视觉锚点，通常以较小尺度置于大片留白中，仅保留最关键的轮廓与姿态；不要复刻复杂细节，而是让原图中的动作、方向、光影或空间关系转化为围绕主体展开的动态场域。

动态场根据主体自身特征自然选择一种主要运动逻辑：优先沿横向或斜向流动、由核心向两侧扩散，或形成不规则波纹与回响；仅当原图动作本身明确时，才保留短距离的上下坠落或上升。使用大量细线、断裂轨迹、粗粝网点和颗粒密度变化表现运动，核心附近更密、更强，向边缘逐渐稀疏、破碎并消失于留白。避免同时堆叠多种特效，让一个主体、一种运动、一个巨大空间关系成为画面的核心。

配色从上传的原图中提炼最有辨识度、最有精气神的一个主色，与暖白、象牙白或自然纸色及少量黑色组成严格的2–3色体系。主色可适度提纯和强化，使其鲜明、有力量但不过度数字化；通过网点密度、油墨叠压与纸面留白形成深浅，而不是普通渐变。保留丝网印刷、孔版印刷（Risograph）、粗颗粒、纸张纤维、油墨覆盖不均和轻微套印偏差，避免电脑渲染、三维、真实光效和光滑数字插画感。

文字建立克制的实验艺术书微排版系统。从照片的动作、距离、状态、情绪或隐喻中提炼一个极短英文标题，并搭配2–4组微型文字，可由短句、状态词、地点或对象信息、序列号、坐标式数字、方向词、档案标签或观察注释自由组合。文字可沿地平线、动态轨迹、主体轴线或留白边缘排列，也可纵排、旋转、拉开字距、嵌入颗粒场或被线条轻微穿过，使排版本身参与空间与运动，而不是独立贴在画面上。

整体追求极小主体、极大留白、强烈尺度反差、单一动态场与粗粝印刷质感，呈现安静、孤独、神秘、诗意又带有轻微超现实感的实验编辑视觉。无论主体是人物、动物、植物、建筑、器物、交通工具或自然景观，都应保持原始影像与抽象场域之间清晰的身份呼应，避免复杂场景、多重焦点、装饰堆积、普通渐变、商业海报感和模板感。

items.title: 俯视室内闭眼日本女性奶油上衣碎花布肖像

prompts.text:
Subject:
A fictional adult Japanese woman indoors with her head down and eyes closed, an intimate portrait taken from directly above. Showing a high bun and a cream-colored top, as well as a screen full of floral fabric.

Location·Time·Background:
A quiet indoor space with restrained background information. Place light-colored bedding or clothing fabrics around the person, retaining only the sense of proximity of a living space.

Clothing·Small Items:
A cream-colored top with fine ribbing and small buttons, and lace trim at the chest. Light-colored fabric scattered with small red, blue, and green flowers is layered from the waist down, showing no accessories.

Pose·Fingers·Contact:
The head is tilted forward, bringing the chin close to the chest, and the shoulders are relaxed and curled inward. Arms and hands are not the main subjects, gathered near the body, forming a natural resting pose.

Expression·Gaze:
A quiet expression with eyes closed and lips slightly relaxed. Expressing a sense of defenselessness at the moment of falling asleep or taking a deep breath.

Face·Makeup:
Detailed depiction of the forehead visible from above, closed eyelids, natural eyebrows, a thin straight nose bridge, and light pink lips. The makeup is thin, preserving the subtle unevenness of the skin and the warmth of the cheeks.

Hair:
Gather dark brown hair into a large, rough bun near the top of the head. Show the small loose ends and short bangs falling from the hairline to the forehead.

Light Source:
Project strong and hard light from near the camera, illuminating the face, chest, and floral fabric, creating sharp shadows at the edges. Use weak ambient light in the room only to prevent black blocks from forming.

Color·Tone:
Cream, warm skin tones, and dark brown are the main tones, with small reds and blues of floral patterns as accent colors. Maintain a tone that falls rapidly from the bright center to the dark periphery.

Material·Fine Texture:
Highly detailed depiction of skin texture, eyelashes, eyebrows, rib knit, fine lace edges, buttons, folds of floral cloth, and messy hair strands of the bun.

Composition·Camera:
An extreme top-down portrait with an aspect ratio of 9:16. Place the top of the head at approximately 50% of the screen width and 8% from the top; the center of the face at approximately 49% horizontal and 32% from the top. The visual center of the figure is placed at approximately 50% horizontal, the chest at approximately 58% of the screen height, and the floral cloth spreads across the lower half of the screen. Use a perspective similar to a close-up shot taken from almost directly above with a smartphone.

Image Processing·Completion:
Finished with a direct texture close to an everyday flash snapshot, clearly preserving the details of the face and fabric. Color correction is restrained, utilizing the raw feel of hard light.

Crash Avoidance·Prohibition:
Fixed to the same woman, closed eyes, high bun, cream ribbed top, lace and buttons at the chest, floral cloth, close-up from directly above. Do not add other people, minors, expressions with open eyes, multiple figures, other clothing, accessories, text, logos, or watermarks. Do not destroy the face, eyelashes, hair, lace, buttons, or flowers.

prompts.text:
被摄主体：
在室内低头、闭眼的虚构成年日本女性一人，从正上方拍摄的亲密肖像。展示高盘发和奶油色上衣，以及满屏的花卉布料。

地点·时间·背景：
背景信息克制的安静室内。在人物周围放置淡色的寝具或衣物面料，仅保留生活空间的近距离感。

服装·小物：
带有细密罗纹和小纽扣、胸口蕾丝边的奶油色上衣。从腰部以下叠加散布着红、蓝、绿小花的浅色布料，不展示饰品。

姿势·手指·接触：
头部向前倾斜，将下巴靠近胸口，肩膀向内侧松弛地蜷缩。手臂和手不作为主角，收拢在身体附近，形成自然的休息姿势。

表情·视线：
双目闭合，嘴唇微微放松的安静表情。表现即将入睡或深呼吸瞬间的无防备感。

脸部·妆容：
从上方可见的额头、闭合的眼睑、自然的眉毛、细直的鼻梁、淡粉色的嘴唇，细致描绘。妆容淡薄，保留肌肤的细微凹凸和脸颊的温暖感。

头发：
将深棕色头发在头顶附近拢成一个大而粗糙的盘发。展示散出的细小发梢，以及从发际线落到额头的短刘海。

光源：
从相机附近投射较强且硬质的光线，照射脸部、胸口和花卉布料，在边缘制造急剧的阴影。用室内的弱环境光仅防止黑块形成。

颜色·色调：
以奶油色、温暖的肤色、深棕色为主调，将花卉图案的小红和小蓝作为点缀色。保持从明亮的中心部向黑暗外围快速落下的色调。

材质·细微质感：
高精致描绘肌肤的纹理、睫毛、眉毛、罗纹编织、蕾丝的细边、纽扣、花卉布的褶皱、盘发的凌乱发束。

构图·相机：
纵横9:16的极端俯瞰肖像。将头顶置于画面宽度的约50%、上端约8%、脸部中心置于横约49%、上端约32%。人物的视觉中心置于横约50%，胸口置于画面高的约58%，花卉布向画面下半部分展开。采用智能手机几乎从正上方近距离拍摄的透视感。

图像处理·完成：
以接近日常闪光快照的直接质感完成，清晰保留脸部和布料的细节。色彩校正保持克制，活用硬光线的生生感。

崩溃回避·禁止：
固定为同一女性、闭合的眼睛、高盘发、奶油色的罗纹上衣、胸口的蕾丝和纽扣、花卉布、正上方的近距离。不添加其他人、未成年人、睁眼的的表情、多个人物、其他服装、配饰、文字、标志、水印。不破坏脸部、睫毛、头发、蕾丝、纽扣、花卉。

items.title: 夏日清晨海滩一字马日系写真

prompts.text:
Subject: Vertical 3:4, a quiet beach on a summer morning, a character completing a lateral split on smooth and clean light-golden fine sand, legs stretching left and right along the bottom of the frame, hands lightly touching the sand surface in front for stability, the body is centered and fully in frame. She has just finished a set of seaside stretches, leaving a shallow sand mark lightly pressed by her fingertips nearby, with distant wave lines forming soft horizontal layers.

Character・Expression: A stunningly beautiful 23-year-old East Asian beauty, with a stylish, confident, and gentle temperament; symmetrical and voluptuous figure, naturally full breasts (about D to E cup visual effect), slim waist, coordinated hip-to-leg ratio, soft and natural curves; ivory skin with a light pink flush, retaining detailed pores, and natural highlights on the shoulders, neck, and legs. Bright milk tea gray-brown medium-length hair with a moist bundled texture blown by the sea breeze, thin air bangs slightly parted, and wisps of hair near the sides of the face. Makeup consists of light rose blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, slender eyelashes, natural tear bags, and translucent pink-beige lips. Her jaw is slightly tucked, corners of the lips carry a restrained slight smile, eyes looking calmly directly at the lens, with small catchlights retained in the pupils.

Clothing・Pose: Wearing an ivory fine-knit halter triangle bikini, the top straps are naturally tied behind the neck, and the bottom is a snug and stable mid-waist side-tie style, with knots and fabric generating realistic slight tension with movement. Pelvis facing the camera and kept level, legs spreading from the hips to the left and right into a standard lateral split near 180 degrees, knees straight, toes naturally pointed and aligned with the leg axis. The upper body is straight and slightly leaning forward, the spine maintains natural extension, shoulders down; arms falling forward from both sides of the body, heel of the palm and five fingers lightly touching the sand surface to bear weight, fingers pressing out small sand grain indentations. The edges of the bikini fit the body, not floating or distorted, and the force direction of the side ties is consistent with the hip movement.

Background・Light: The foreground is slightly blurred fine sand grains and scattered shell fragments, the midground is the character and shallow sand marks, the background only retains the calm deep blue sea surface, a white wave line, and pure light blue sky. Low-angle warm sun from the upper right serves as the sole main light, illuminating hair strands, the right side of the face, shoulder lines, and the upper edges of the stretched legs, with soft shadows falling towards the back left; the sea surface provides an extremely faint cold blue reflection, gently brightening the backlit side of the body without overpowering the warm sun layers.

Composition・Camera: Equivalent 50mm lens, camera position near the character's chest height with a slight high-angle shot, fully retaining the top of the head, both hands, hips, and left and right toes, the focal plane covers the eyes and the center of hip movement, using medium depth of field to keep legs clear and soften the distant sea. The legs form a stable horizontal baseline, the upper body forms a centered vertical triangular structure, leaving a small amount of sky white space at the top of the head, and breathing space between the left and right toes and the frame edges.

Texture・Style: Japanese summer seaside fashion editorial photography, low contrast, restrained saturation, soft warm-blue tones with subtle film grain. Emphasis on presenting real skin texture, moist hair bundles, fine knit of the bikini, tie tension, and dry sand particles pressed by palms.

Negative: Underage or mature middle-aged feel, drifting facial features, incorrect split angle or overlapping legs, pelvis and hip joint distortion, extra limbs or finger joint errors, hands floating without touching sand, bikini clipping or incorrect tie tension, plastic-looking skin, watermarks

prompts.text:
主体：
竖3:4，夏日清晨的安静海滩，人物在平整干净的浅金色细沙上完成横向一字马，双腿沿画面下方左右舒展，双手轻触身前沙面保持稳定，身体居中并完整入镜。她刚结束一组海边拉伸，近处留有一道被指尖轻压出的浅浅沙痕，远处浪线形成柔和横向层次。

人物・表情：
绝美23岁东亚美女，气质时尚、自信、温柔；
身材匀称丰满，胸部自然丰满（约D至E杯视觉效果），腰部纤细，臀腿比例协调，曲线柔和自然；
象牙白肌肤带淡粉血色，保留细致毛孔、肩颈与腿部自然高光。明亮奶茶灰棕中长发带海风吹出的湿润束感，薄空气刘海微微分开，脸周碎发贴近颊侧。妆容为淡玫瑰腮红、香槟米色与粉棕眼影、细长睫毛、自然泪袋和透感粉米色唇。她下颌微收，唇角带克制浅笑，双眼平静直视镜头，瞳孔中保留细小眼神光。

服装・姿势：
穿象牙色细织纹挂脖三角比基尼，上身肩带在颈后自然系结，下身为贴合稳固的中腰侧系带款，结扣与面料随动作产生真实轻微张力。骨盆正对镜头并保持水平，双腿从髋部向左右展开成接近180度的标准横向一字马，膝盖伸直，脚尖自然绷直并与腿部轴线一致。上身挺直略向前倾，脊柱保持自然延展，双肩下沉；两臂从身体两侧向前落下，掌根与五指轻触沙面承重，手指压出细小沙粒凹痕。比基尼边缘贴合身体，不漂浮、不扭曲，侧系带受力方向与髋部动作一致。

背景・光：
前景是轻微虚化的细沙颗粒与零星贝壳碎片，中景为人物和浅浅沙痕，背景仅保留平静深蓝海面、一道白色浪线与纯净淡蓝天空。右上方低角度暖阳作为唯一主光，照亮发丝、脸部右侧、肩线与伸展双腿的上缘，阴影柔和地落向左后方；海面提供极淡的冷蓝反射，轻轻提亮身体背光侧，不抢夺暖阳层次。

构图・相机：
等效50mm镜头，机位接近人物胸口高度并轻微俯拍，完整保留头顶、双手、髋部和左右脚尖，焦点平面覆盖双眼与髋部动作中心，使用中等景深使腿部保持清晰、远海柔化。双腿形成稳定的横向基线，上身构成居中的竖向三角结构，头顶保留少量天空留白，左右脚尖与画框边缘留出呼吸空间。

质感・风格：
日系夏日海边时尚编辑写真，低对比、克制饱和、柔和暖蓝调与细微胶片颗粒。重点呈现真实皮肤纹理、湿润发束、比基尼细织纹、系带张力和被手掌压动的干燥沙粒。

负面：
未成年或成熟中年感、人物面部特征漂移、一字马角度错误或双腿交叠、骨盆与髋关节畸变、额外肢体或手指关节错误、手掌悬浮未接触沙面、比基尼穿模或系带受力错误、塑料感皮肤、水印

prompts.text:
Ultra-realistic outdoor forest valley portrait photography, vertical orientation about 9:16, a young adult East Asian female kneeling in the center of a narrow cement bridge/walkway in the middle of a forest trail. The person is located slightly to the left of the center, occupying about 70% of the screen height. The background completely preserves the deep green trees, stream, metal guardrails, and the trail extending into the distance. Using approximately 35–50mm equivalent lens, camera position slightly higher than the person's chest with a slight downward angle, shooting distance about 1.5–2 meters, maintaining natural portrait perspective, no fisheye, no exaggerated background blur.

The person has a naturally plump, distinctly hourglass-shaped adult female figure: moderate shoulders, full upper body, a clearly slender and tapered waist, wide pelvis and hips, and full, soft thighs. In the kneeling position, the thighs produce natural compression and realistic soft tissue shapes due to bending the knees, while the waist and abdomen remain flat and soft. The overall focus is on maintaining a natural proportion of "full upper body + thin waist + wide hips + full thighs," avoiding thin paper-like, narrow-hipped, athletic muscular, or extremely distorted bodies.

The person adopts a low kneeling position: both knees bent on the rough cement bridge surface, both calves folded backward and downward toward the body, buttocks slightly sitting toward the heels but not completely seated; the pelvis remains upright, and the upper body tilts slightly toward the person's left. The person's left leg is in front of the frame, with the knee closer to the lens, and the right leg is slightly behind, forming a natural front-to-back layer. Both hands are placed lightly on top of the left and right thighs/knees respectively, fingers naturally spread, wrists relaxed, no exaggerated gestures. Shoulders rotated slightly toward the person's left, creating a soft S-curve in the body.

Head tilted slightly toward the person's right, face turned toward the camera, eyes looking directly at the camera, expression quiet and soft, with a slight, subtle smile. The overall feel is like a natural travel photo taken while stopping on a small bridge in the forest during a hike, rather than a professional model studio shot.

The person has black medium-long hair, tied in a low loose bun/low ponytail, with the back of the head hair volume naturally fluffy. In front of the forehead are thin long wispy bangs, with longer face-framing strands left on both sides, naturally close to the cheeks and jaw, some stray hairs blown by the forest breeze. No shoulder-length long curly hair, no thick straight bangs.

The face shape is small and oval-leaning, skin tone fair with a neutral cool-warm balance, soft and delicate features. Deep brown almond eyes, natural double eyelids, slender eyeliner slightly upturned, eyelashes clear but not too thick; eyebrows naturally thin, nose bridge small and straight, lips naturally full, soft nude pink lip makeup. Cheeks have a slight natural pinkish glow, skin retains fine texture and soft highlights, no plastic airbrushing.

Upper body wearing a pure white form-fitting sleeveless cropped tank top, wide straps or medium-width straps, the neckline is a distinct low U-shape/deep round neck, the fabric is soft elastic cotton or fine knit material. The tank top closely follows the contours of the chest and waist, armholes are slightly low on the sides, the hem stops near the navel, revealing a small section of slender waist and abdomen. The fabric is overall matte, no patterns, no logos, no lace or complex decorations.

Lower body wearing light blue ultra-short denim hot pants, low to mid-rise design, pant legs are extremely short but maintain normal denim short structure, leg openings have natural fraying and slight raw edges. The denim has clear light blue washed texture, stitching, waistband, and pocket structures, fitting tightly against the hips and buttocks, revealing most of the full thighs. Do not generate long jeans, loose shorts, or skirts.

Feet wearing light beige/nude low-heeled sandals, thin strap structure, insteps and toes naturally exposed, soles are thin. Due to the kneeling posture, the shoes are mostly located behind the body, only part of the instep, straps, and toes are visible at the bottom of the frame, do not include sneakers or high heels.

The scene is a dense, damp forest valley trail. The person is kneeling on a narrow gray cement bridge/walking walkway, the bridge surface has slight moss, damp spots, fallen leaves, and natural wear. Old galvanized metal pipe guardrails are installed on both left and right sides, the guardrails have obvious oxidation, rust, connection clamps, and bottom metal fixing plates. The right guardrail extends from the foreground along the trail to the upper right distance of the frame, forming a clear perspective guide line; the left guardrail extends diagonally from behind the person toward the left of the frame.

Shallow streams and rocks can be seen below and to the back left of the bridge, the water flowing through deep green forest shadow areas, with partial white splashes. The surrounding is filled with dense ferns, shrubs, large broad-leaved plants, and tall trees, trunks extending upwards from the left and right of the frame, the top canopy forming a dense green shelter. The background forest has clear depth, the further away the darker the color, leaning more towards cold green, but still maintaining details, not blurred into solid color blocks.

The light is soft natural daylight in a summer forest, sunlight passing through gaps in the canopy, forming scattered dappled light spots and soft volumetric light. The person's face, neck, chest, and thighs are illuminated by brighter soft diffused light, making the skin tone clear and natural; the background forest is overall darker, forming a natural separation of the subject. Some sunlight falls on the walkway, guardrails, and the person's shoulders, creating slight light and shadow changes, but no strong harsh direct sunlight.

The overall color tone is dominated by fresh forest deep green, gray cement, silver-gray metal, white top, and light blue denim, with the person's skin tone becoming the brightest warm color area of the frame. Colors are natural and fresh, with a slight softness of Japanese/Korean travel photography, but must maintain real photo texture, no cinematic color grading or dream filters.

High-quality full-frame or high-end mobile phone portrait photography texture, ISO 100–400, shutter stable enough, person's face, hair strands, skin, white tank top, denim texture, guardrail rust, bridge surface particles, leaves and stream details are clear. Depth of field is medium to deep, the person is clear, the background has slight natural layering but not large-aperture creamy blur.

Key Focuses: vertical forest travel portrait + narrow cement bridge/walkway + left and right old metal guardrails + dense deep green forest and stream + person in low kneeling position + bent knees, hands placed lightly on thighs + black low-tie hair and long wispy bangs + white low U-neck form-fitting sleeveless cropped tank top + light blue ultra-short denim hot pants + natural full hourglass figure + thin waist wide hips full thighs + soft forest diffused light + real clear travel photography texture.

Avoid: standing, squatting, sitting on a chair, person too close, cropping out knees/legs, long curly hair, blonde hair, thick straight bangs, ordinary loose T-shirts, long pants, skirts, sneakers, city parks, wooden suspension bridges, artificial gardens, waterfall as the main subject, strong direct sunlight, flash, night scenes, thick fog, heavily blurred background, fisheye, extreme wide angle, plastic skin, excessive skin smoothing, CG feeling, anime face, limb deformities, extra fingers, watermarks, and garbled text.

prompts.text:
超写实户外森林溪谷人像摄影，竖版约 9:16，一名年轻成年东亚女性跪坐在森林步道中央的狭窄水泥桥/栈道上拍照，人物位于画面中央偏左，占画面高度约 70%，背景完整保留深绿色树林、溪流、金属护栏和延伸到远处的步道。采用约 35–50mm 等效镜头，机位略高于人物胸口并轻微俯拍，拍摄距离约 1.5–2 米，保持自然人像透视，不使用鱼眼，不做夸张背景虚化。

人物拥有自然丰满、明显沙漏型的成年女性身材：肩部适中，上半身丰满，腰部明显纤细收束，骨盆和髋部较宽，大腿丰满柔软。跪坐姿势下，大腿因屈膝产生自然压缩和真实软组织形态，腰腹保持平坦柔和。整体重点保持“丰满上身＋细腰＋宽胯＋丰满大腿”的自然比例，不要生成纤细纸片型、窄胯、健美肌肉型或极端失真人体。

人物采用低位跪坐姿势：双膝弯曲跪在粗糙水泥桥面上，两条小腿向身体后下方折叠，臀部略微坐向脚跟但没有完全坐下；骨盆保持直立，上半身微微向人物左侧倾斜。人物左腿位于画面前方，膝盖更靠近镜头，右腿略靠后，形成自然前后层次。双手分别轻放在左右大腿/膝盖上方，手指自然展开，手腕放松，不做夸张手势。肩膀略微向人物左侧旋转，使身体形成柔和 S 型曲线。

头部轻轻向人物右侧倾斜，脸转向镜头，双眼直接看向镜头，神情安静、柔和，带轻微若有若无的微笑。整体像徒步途中在林间小桥上停下来拍摄的一张自然旅行照片，而不是专业模特棚拍。

人物留黑色中长发，整体扎成低位松散发髻/低马尾，后脑勺发量自然蓬松。额前为轻薄长碎刘海，两侧留有较长的脸侧发丝，自然贴近脸颊和下颌，部分碎发被森林微风吹动。不要披肩长卷发，不要厚重齐刘海。

脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，肤色白皙偏冷暖中性，五官柔和精致。深棕色杏仁眼，双眼皮自然，细长眼线轻微上扬，睫毛清晰但不过浓；眉毛自然纤细，鼻梁小巧顺直，嘴唇自然丰满，柔和裸粉色唇妆。脸颊带轻微自然粉润感，皮肤保留细小纹理和柔和高光，不要塑料磨皮。

上身穿纯白色贴身无袖短款背心，宽肩带或中等宽度肩带，领口为明显低 U 型/深圆领，面料为柔软弹力棉质或细针织材质。背心紧贴胸腰轮廓，侧边袖窿略低，衣摆停在肚脐附近，露出一小段纤细腰腹。面料整体哑光、无图案、无 Logo，不要蕾丝或复杂装饰。

下身穿浅蓝色超短牛仔热裤，低至中腰设计，裤腿极短但保持正常牛仔短裤结构，裤脚带自然磨边和轻微毛边。牛仔布具有清晰浅蓝水洗纹理、缝线、腰头和口袋结构，紧贴髋部和臀胯，露出大部分丰满大腿。不要生成长牛仔裤、宽松短裤或裙子。

脚穿浅米色/裸色低跟凉鞋，细带结构，脚背和脚趾自然露出，鞋底较薄。由于跪姿，鞋子大部分位于身体后侧，只在画面下方可见部分脚背、鞋带和脚趾，不要加入运动鞋或高跟鞋。

场景为茂密潮湿的森林溪谷步道。人物跪坐在一座狭窄的灰色水泥桥/步行栈道上，桥面有轻微青苔、潮湿斑点、落叶和自然磨损。左右两侧安装老旧镀锌金属管护栏，护栏具有明显氧化、锈迹、连接卡箍和底部金属固定板。右侧护栏从前景沿步道一直延伸到画面右上远处，形成清晰透视引导线；左侧护栏从人物身后斜向画面左侧延伸。

桥下和左后方可以看到浅浅溪流与岩石，水流经过深绿色森林阴影区域，局部有白色水花。周围布满浓密蕨类、灌木、大型阔叶植物和高大树木，树干从画面左右向上延伸，顶部树冠形成浓密绿色遮蔽。背景树林具有明显纵深，越远颜色越深、更偏冷绿，但仍保持细节，不要糊成纯色块。

光线为夏季森林中的柔和自然日光，阳光从树冠缝隙穿过，形成零散斑驳光点和柔和体积光。人物脸部、肩颈、胸前和大腿受到较明亮的柔和散射光照射，肤色清透自然；背景树林整体偏暗，形成自然主体分离。部分阳光落在步道、护栏和人物肩膀上，产生轻微明暗变化，但不要强烈硬直射光。

整体色调以清新的森林深绿、灰色水泥、银灰金属、白色上衣和浅蓝牛仔为主，人物肤色成为画面最明亮的暖色区域。色彩自然清新，略带日系/韩系旅行摄影的柔和感，但必须保持真实照片质感，不要做成电影调色或梦幻滤镜。

采用高质量全画幅或高端手机人像摄影质感，ISO 100–400，快门足够稳定，人物脸部、发丝、皮肤、白色背心、牛仔纹理、护栏锈迹、桥面颗粒、树叶与溪水细节清晰。景深中等偏深，人物清晰，背景有轻微自然层次但不是大光圈奶油虚化。

重点锁定：竖版森林旅行人像＋狭窄水泥桥/栈道＋左右老旧金属护栏＋茂密深绿色树林和溪流＋人物低位跪坐＋双膝弯曲、双手轻放大腿＋黑色低位扎发与长碎刘海＋白色低 U 领贴身无袖短款背心＋浅蓝超短牛仔热裤＋自然丰满沙漏体型＋细腰宽胯丰满大腿＋柔和林间散射光＋真实清晰旅行摄影质感。

避免：站姿、蹲姿、坐在椅子上、人物过近、裁掉膝腿、长卷发、金发、厚齐刘海、普通宽松 T 恤、长裤、裙子、运动鞋、城市公园、木质吊桥、人工花园、瀑布主体、强烈阳光直射、闪光灯、夜景、浓雾、背景严重虚化、鱼眼、极端广角、塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、CG 感、动漫脸、肢体畸形、多余手指、水印和乱码文字。

items.title: 布鲁克林大桥活力少女街拍影像

prompts.text:
A vibrant candid street-style photograph of a young woman sitting playfully on the Brooklyn Bridge pedestrian walkway during golden hour. She is smiling brightly toward the camera, wearing a red-and-white patterned sleeveless top, red ribbed leg warmers, and oversized chunky white sneakers.

She holds both hands close to the camera, creating a playful framing gesture with her fingers. Her hands appear dramatically larger due to an extreme wide-angle perspective, creating a fun, dynamic composition. Her hair is loosely tied up with a few strands blowing naturally around her face, and she wears a delicate silver chain necklace.

The Brooklyn Bridge stone towers, suspension cables, metal framework, and Manhattan skyline are visible in the background. Warm sunlight shines from behind her, producing beautiful rim lighting, subtle lens flare, and long shadows across the brick walkway. Low-angle camera perspective, exaggerated foreground depth, ultra-wide 14mm lens effect, energetic Gen-Z street photography aesthetic, natural skin texture, realistic details, warm cinematic color grading, sharp focus, photorealistic, vertical 4:5 composition.

prompts.text: 一张充满活力的自然街拍风格照片，拍摄的是一名年轻女性在黄金时段俏皮地坐在布鲁克林大桥的人行道上。她对着镜头灿烂地微笑，穿着红白花纹的无袖上衣、红色罗纹护腿和超大号的厚底白色运动鞋。她双手紧贴镜头，用手指做出了一个俏皮的构图手势。由于极宽的广角透视，她的手显得戏剧性地大，营造出一种有趣、动态的构图。她的头发松散地扎起，几缕发丝在脸庞周围自然飘动，她戴着一条精致的银链项链。背景中可以看到布鲁克林大桥的石塔、悬索、金属框架和曼哈顿天际线。温暖的阳光从她身后照进来，产生美丽的轮廓光、微妙的镜头光晕以及穿过砖砌人行道的长长阴影。低角度相机透视，夸张的前景深度，超宽14mm镜头效果，充满活力的Gen-Z街拍美学，皮肤纹理自然，细节写实，温暖的电影感调色，对焦清晰，照片级真实，垂直4:5构图。

items.title: 赛博更新风格银发日系女性写真

prompts.text:
Use the uploaded reference image as the STRICT PRIMARY reference for the clearly ADULT woman’s face, hairstyle, hair color/length, body proportions, swimsuit, pose, framing and setting. If anything conflicts, ALWAYS follow the reference image.

Ultra-photorealistic LIVE-ACTION iPhone 17 Pro vertical 4:5 photo of the same clearly ADULT Japanese woman in her 20s sitting casually on a beige sofa in a bright modern apartment.

Long silky platinum-silver hair, wispy bangs, pale-blue ribbon bows, natural pink-beige makeup. White competitive one-piece swimsuit. Relaxed seated pose, one hand gently touching her cheek, direct eye contact. Woman fills 85–90% of frame, slightly high-angle 24–28mm, NOT a selfie.

Futuristic translucent cyan-white HUD: “UPDATING…”, glowing progress bar at 58%, “58%”, small “5G” + signal bars on ONE cheek only, and “OS UPDATE MODE” projected on one shoulder.

Natural window daylight, city skyline, realistic skin and hair, Smart HDR, subtle depth of field, clean AR glow. No anime, CGI, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, duplicated HUD, unreadable text or watermark.

未来感半透明青白色 HUD：“UPDATING...”，进度条发光显示 58%，“58%”，仅在半边脸颊上有微小的“5G”+信号条，一个肩膀上投影有“OS UPDATE MODE”。

自然窗外阳光，城市天际线，真实皮肤和头发，智能 HDR，细微的景深，干净的 AR 光辉。无动漫、无 CGI、无解剖结构扭曲、无多余手指、无重复 HUD、无模糊文字或水印。

prompts.text:
{
任务：图像生成，
"aspect_ratio": "9:16",

“风格”： {
“摄影”: “自然的 iPhone 照片”
"camera_shake": "存在相机抖动",
“写实主义”：“日常的、自然的快照，看起来就像是在真正的居酒屋（日本酒吧）房间里拍摄的一样。”
"snapshot_feel": "这不是一张摆拍的纪念照，而是一张自然的第一人称快照，在你参加大型饮酒聚会时，你碰巧转过头，两个醉酒的女人走过来和你说话，你随手拍下的那一刻。"
“skin_rendering”：避免过度修饰皮肤，保留自然的皮肤纹理、脸颊泛红和轻微的肤色瑕疵。
},

“场景”： {
“地点”：“居酒屋（日式酒吧）里的榻榻米房间”，
“环境”：典型的日式居酒屋，榻榻米包间。铺着榻榻米或类似榻榻米的地面，摆放着矮木桌和坐垫，入座前需脱鞋。桌上随意散落着吃剩的食物、小碟子、筷子、酒杯、啤酒杯、手机、小碗和湿毛巾等。室内灯光温暖，周围还有其他人在喝酒，气氛略显热闹。这里不像高级旅馆那样一丝不苟，而是更像一个适合多人聚会喝酒的自然榻榻米包间。
“瞬间”：在一场大型酒会上，摄影师侧身望去，看到隔壁房间里并排坐着两个女人。下面的女人坐在垫子上，另一个女人跪在她腿上。下面的女人双臂环抱着上面的女人的腰和肚子。两人都喝得酩酊大醉，脸颊和鼻子通红，眼神迷离。当她们注意到摄影师时，都转过头看向他，身体仍然侧着身子，醉醺醺的，两人同时说了些什么。
},

“作品”： {
“camera_position”: “摄影师本人坐在房间里，以第一人称视角自然地拍摄。他正从侧面看着站在他旁边的两位女士。”

"strict_side_view_rule": "构图严格固定为侧视图。摄像机明显位于两位女性身体的侧面，而不是她们的前面。两位女性的躯干、臀部、骨盆和大腿都以侧面朝向镜头。"

“camera_axis_rule”：两名女性的身体前后方向与摄像机的视线大致垂直。拍摄角度并非正面，而是大约90度的侧面角度。

“相机安装规则”：相机应手持，高度自然，从摄影师的脸部到胸部附近。这个高度很自然，就像轻轻地用智能手机对准身边的两个人一样。

“seating_layout”: “两位女士坐在榻榻米房间的同一侧，离摄影师很近。摄影师和两位女士之间没有矮桌、垫子、食物、行李或隔断。”

"no_table_between_rule": "榻榻米房间里的矮桌摆放在两位女士的身体前面。请勿在摄影师和两位女士之间放置桌子。"

“no_object_between_women_rule”：两名女性之间不得放置任何物品，例如桌子、行李、靠垫、食物、盘子或杯子。她们的身体必须直接接触。

"lap_sitting_rule": "上面的女人实际上是坐在下面的女人的膝盖和大腿上。不仅仅是她们互相倚靠；从侧面看，你可以看到上面的女人是坐在下面的女人的膝盖上。"

"lower_woman_seating_rule": "下位女性自然地坐在垫子上或房间的地板上，用膝盖和大腿支撑上位女性。"

“upper_woman_seating_rule”： “上方女性侧身坐在下方女性的膝盖和大腿上。她的身体没有正对镜头，她的躯干和臀部保持侧向。”

“身体朝向规则”：“两人的肩膀、肋骨、躯干、臀部、骨盆和大腿都应朝向侧面。不要让整个身体正对摄影师。”

"side_profile_body_rule": "屏幕主要显示两个人的侧面轮廓。这不是正面肖像，而是侧面轮廓，显示从肩膀到腰部和大腿的线条。"

“仅转头规则”：与摄影师交谈时，双方都不应将整个身体转向摄影师，而只需将头部和脸部转向摄影师即可。肩膀、胸腔和腰部应保持侧向。

items.title: PHO REPUBLIC 越南粉 2x2 旗舰平面广告系列

prompts.text:
Create a flagship 2x2 campaign poster series for an original Vietnamese noodle brand named "PHO REPUBLIC", merging Orbit energy with Transit restraint. Use ultra-realistic commercial food photography, not illustration, not 3D render. The final artwork must present four coordinated square posters arranged in a strict 2x2 grid, each panel built from the same structural system with disciplined variation. The pho bowl must remain the absolute visual hero in every panel.

Style lock: high-end graphic food advertising, bold editorial poster layout, product-first hierarchy, clean color-block backgrounds, oversized kinetic typography, youthful premium Asian street-dining branding, Cannes-level print campaign execution.

Core campaign structure: four square panels with alternating deep navy blue and warm mustard yellow backgrounds. Each panel contains one large white pho bowl shown from the exact same slightly top-down camera angle. Bowl size, bowl height, bowl perspective, rim thickness, bowl diameter, and visual weight must be perfectly consistent across all four posters. The container must sit at an equal visual scale in every panel, acting as the fixed campaign anchor. Variation is allowed only in typography rhythm, circular text paths, callout placement, and directional movement around the bowl.

Transit logic: simplify every panel so the layout feels flagship and globally polished. Reduce small labels, reduce decorative callouts, shorten copy, preserve more clean negative space, and let the bowl, background block, and primary typography do most of the work. Avoid flyer-like density. Each square should feel graphic, premium, and instantly readable.

Orbit logic: create a coordinated movement system across the full 2x2 set. Panel one uses a strong descending diagonal text flow, panel two uses a mirrored inward-driving diagonal, panel three uses a controlled circular orbit around the bowl, and panel four uses a tighter circular return path that visually resolves the campaign. The four panels should feel like one connected visual sequence: launch, counter, orbit, resolve. Motion must feel crisp and graphic, not noisy.

Food design: create a premium beef pho hero dish with richly detailed ingredients: glowing amber broth, thin rice noodles, sliced beef, beef balls, tendon or tripe accents, basil leaves, scallions, red chili slices, onion, fresh herbs, and subtle broth sheen. Ingredient styling may shift slightly between panels, but the bowl size and bowl dominance must never change. The dish must feel abundant, fragrant, hot, and highly craveable.

Panel logic:
1. Top-left panel: deep navy background, oversized stacked headline moving diagonally from upper-left toward center, bowl anchored in the lower-middle zone, a few restrained callout markers near the rim.
2. Top-right panel: mustard background, mirrored bold typography driving inward from upper-right toward center seam, bowl anchored at the same scale and height as panel one, minimal graphic accents only.
3. Bottom-left panel: mustard background, centered bowl with a clean circular text orbit around it, fewer callouts than the top row, stronger negative space.
4. Bottom-right panel: deep navy background, centered bowl matching panel three exactly in scale and placement, tighter orbit text and a compact brand footer block to conclude the campaign.

Typography and branding: use original English text only, never copy any existing wording. Use a bold master phrase such as "TALK THE PHO" as the campaign anchor across the series, varied in scale and rhythm but always consistent in brand voice. Add only a few short descriptors such as "fresh", "slow broth", "street soul", "herbal", and "comfort". Include a compact brand block reading "PHO REPUBLIC" with a subtitle such as "modern Vietnamese kitchen". Typography should feel oversized, architectural, witty, and kinetic, but always secondary to the bowls.

Lighting: bright controlled studio food lighting with soft frontal illumination and subtle side shaping. The broth must glow warmly, herbs must feel crisp and fresh, meat textures must remain moist and realistic, and the white ceramic bowls must look clean, glossy, and dimensional. Keep shadows soft and controlled, with no muddy contrast.

Materials and realism: realistic white ceramic bowls with identical shape and scale across all four posters, hot glossy broth, tender beef textures, springy noodles, fresh basil, crisp chili slices, subtle oil shimmer, clean matte background fields, premium print-ready sharpness, and integrated graphic elements that feel designed rather than pasted.

Color system: strict alternating navy blue and mustard yellow fields, with restrained accents of red, white, black, and herb green. Keep the palette disciplined, high-contrast, and premium. Food colors must remain natural and appetizing.

Quality and physical rules: all four panels must feel like one unified flagship campaign. Equal bowl size across every panel is mandatory. Equal bowl camera angle, equal bowl scale, equal bowl visual weight, and equal product dominance must be preserved. Keep the campaign clean, graphic, premium, and highly legible. No clutter, no warped rims, no type collisions, no weak food detail, no dead black patches, no oversaturated broth.

Negative prompt: copied branding, copied text, inconsistent bowl sizes, inconsistent bowl height, inconsistent bowl perspective, different container scale between panels, warped bowl rims, blurry food, fake broth texture, messy layout, chaotic typography, cheap flyer look, low-resolution print feel, oversaturated food colors, excessive labels, cluttered callouts, cartoon rendering, CGI look, illustration style, product losing dominance, muddy shadows, dirty background.

prompts.text:
为名为“PHO REPUBLIC”的原创越南河粉品牌创作一系列 2x2 旗舰活动海报，融合 Orbit 的能量与 Transit 的克制。使用超写实商业美食摄影，非插画，非 3D 渲染。最终的作品必须呈现四个协调的正方形海报，排列在严格的 2x2 网格中，每个面板都由相同的结构系统构建，并具有克制的变量。在每个面板中，河粉碗必须保持绝对的视觉主角地位。

风格锁定：高端平面美食广告，大胆的社论海报布局，产品优先的层级结构，干净的色块背景，超大动态排版，年轻的高端亚洲街头餐饮品牌，戛纳级别的平面广告执行。

核心活动结构：四个正方形面板，交替使用深海军蓝和温暖的芥末黄背景。每个面板包含一个大型白色河粉碗，以完全相同的略微俯视的相机角度展示。碗的大小、高度、透视、边缘厚度、直径和视觉重量在所有四张海报中必须完全一致。容器在每个面板中必须处于相等的视觉比例，作为固定的广告支柱。仅允许在排版节奏、圆形文字路径、标注放置和围绕碗的定向运动方面进行变化。

Transit 逻辑：简化每个面板，使布局具有旗舰感和全球化的精致感。减少小标签，减少装饰性标注，缩短文案，保留更多干净的负空间，让碗、背景色块和主要排版完成大部分工作。避免传单式的密度。每个方格都应该具有图形感、高端感并易于即时阅读。

Orbit 逻辑：在整个 2x2 组合中创建一个协调的运动系统。第一面板使用强烈的下降对角线文字流，第二面板使用镜像的向内驱动对角线，第三面板使用受控的围绕碗的圆形轨道，第四面板使用更紧凑的圆形返回路径，在视觉上解决整个活动。这四个面板应该感觉像一个连贯的视觉序列：启动、对抗、轨道、解决。动作必须感觉干脆利落且具图形感，而不是嘈杂。

食物设计：制作一道具有丰富细节配料的高端牛肉河粉主角菜肴：晶莹剔透的琥珀色肉汤、细米粉、牛肉片、牛肉丸、牛筋或牛肚点缀、罗勒叶、葱花、红辣椒片、洋葱、新鲜香草和微妙的肉汤光泽。面板之间的配料造型可能会略有变化，但碗的大小和碗的主导地位绝不能改变。菜肴必须让人感觉丰盛、芬芳、热气腾腾且极具诱惑力。

面板逻辑：
1. 左上角面板：深海军蓝背景，超大的堆叠标题从左上角向中心对角移动，碗固定在下部中间区域，靠近边缘处有少量克制的标注标记。
2. 右上角面板：芥末黄背景，镜像的大胆排版从右上角向中心接缝向内驱动，碗固定在与第一面板相同比例和高度的位置，仅有极简的图形装饰。
3. 左下角面板：芥末黄背景，居中的碗，周围有干净的圆形文字轨道，标注比顶行少，负空间更强。
4. 右下角面板：深海军蓝背景，居中的碗在比例和放置上与第三面板完全一致，更紧凑的轨道文字和紧凑的品牌页脚块，以此结束活动。

排版与品牌：仅使用原始英文文本，切勿复制任何现有字词。使用一个大胆的主导短语，如“TALK THE PHO”，作为整个系列中的活动支柱，在规模和节奏上有所变化，但在品牌基调上始终保持一致。仅添加少量简短的描述词，如“fresh”、“slow broth”、“street soul”、“herbal”和“comfort”。包含一个简洁的品牌块，写着“PHO REPUBLIC”，并带有副标题，如“modern Vietnamese kitchen”。排版应该是超大的、建筑感的、风趣的和动态的，但始终次于碗。

光照：明亮且受控的影棚美食照明，具有柔和的前部照明和微妙的侧面塑形。肉汤必须散发出温暖的光芒，香草必须感觉清爽新鲜，肉的质地必须保持湿润写实，白色陶瓷碗必须看起来干净、光滑且具有立体感。保持阴影柔和受控，没有模糊的对比。

材料与写实：写实的白色陶瓷碗，在所有四张海报中具有相同的形状和比例，滚烫光滑的肉汤，鲜嫩的牛肉质地，劲道的面条，新鲜的罗勒，清脆的辣椒片，微妙的油脂闪烁，干净的哑光背景场，高端的印刷级清晰度，以及感觉是设计出来的而非粘贴上去的集成图形元素。

颜色系统：严格交替的海军蓝和芥末黄场，辅以红色、白色、黑色和草绿色的克制点缀。保持色调严谨、高对比度且高端。食物颜色必须保持自然诱人。

质量与物理规则：所有四个面板必须感觉像一个统一的旗舰活动。每个面板中碗的大小相等是强制性的。必须保持相等的碗相机角度、相等的碗比例、相等的碗视觉重量和相等的产品主导地位。保持活动简洁、具图形感、高端且极易辨识。没有混乱，没有变形的碗边，没有排版冲突，没有单薄的食物细节，没有死黑区域，没有过饱和的肉汤。

负向提示：抄袭的品牌，抄袭的文本，不一致的碗大小，不一致的碗高度，不一致的碗透视，面板之间不同的容器比例，变形的碗边，模糊的食物，假的肉汤质地，凌乱的布局，混乱的排版，廉价的传单感，低分辨率的印刷感，过饱和的食物颜色，过多的标签，拥挤的标注，卡通渲染，CGI 感，插画风格，产品失去主导地位，模糊的阴影，肮脏的背景。

prompts.text:
[Visual Overview] An original adult East Asian female walking and taking a selfie at night in Chongqing's Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street, behind her are high-rise neon signs, snack stall steam, and reflections on wet stone pavement. She wears a non-cosplay silver-white and gold-black contrast urban formal dress, making a night market street snap look like a luxury brand advertisement.
[Character] She is in her early twenties, with a delicate and natural face. Long silver-white hair is tied into a low bun with a few smooth strands hanging down. Amber contact lenses bring a cold but realistic makeup feel. She smiles slightly at the phone camera, gaze direct and composed, skin looking clean and transparent under warm sign lights.
[Action/Pose] One hand holds the phone at a slightly high selfie angle in front of her chest, her body is slightly turned toward the camera, and the other hand lightly touches the dangling hair accessory by her ear. Her steps stop mid-stride, shoulder line relaxed, with the skirt hem and hair strands gently lifted by the night wind of the street.
[Clothing] She wears a silver-white satin asymmetrical camisole short dress. The chest is wrapped with diagonal folds, and the waist is tightened with black and gold thin string drawstrings. One side of the skirt has a high slit but maintains an elegant street-snap scale. She wears an ultra-short black sheer shawl on top, with fine gold thread cloud patterns embroidered on the edges, paired with a thin gold necklace, black-gold tassel earrings, and transparent black stockings. The stockings reflect streetlights on the calves and knees, enhancing the long leg lines and the sexy tension of the urban night.
[Camera & Composition] Selfie perspective, vertical half-body to mid-thigh medium shot, the lens is slightly higher than the eyes, with a wide angle bringing out the close-up figure and the perspective of the street scene behind. The character occupies the left-center of the frame, with the phone edge and her hand as the foreground; background high-rise signs extend toward the back right.
[Scene] Location is Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street at night, the sidewalk is wet, snack stall steam rises from the back right, and glass windows, mall signs, and pedestrian light spots form real urban layers. Environmental details remain recognizable but not overpowering.
[Lighting & Color] Warm yellow stall lights illuminate the face and neck, cold white mall lights outline the silver hair edges, and red signs leave local reflections on the black gauze and stockings. Overall color is balanced between gold, black, silver-white, and night market neon.
[Overall Atmosphere & Texture] The image has a high-quality digital human street-snap feel with a real photographic sense, combining the intimacy of a natural selfie with the refined control of a high-end fashion ad; skin, satin, tulle, stockings, and wet ground reflections are all detailed and believable.

prompts.text:
【画面概览】一位原创成年东亚女性在夜晚的重庆解放碑步行街边走边自拍，身后是高楼灯牌、小吃摊热气和潮湿石板路反光。她穿一套非角色复刻的银白与金黑撞色都市礼服，像把夜市街拍拍成了奢侈品广告。
【人物】她二十多岁，面容精致自然，长银白发被盘成低位发髻并垂下几缕柔顺长发，琥珀色美瞳带来冷艳但真实的妆感。她对手机镜头微微笑，视线直接、从容，皮肤在暖色招牌光下显得干净通透。
【动作姿势】她一手举手机在胸前偏上的自拍角度，身体略向镜头侧转，另一只手轻扶耳边垂坠发饰。步伐停在半步之间，肩线放松，裙摆与发丝被街道夜风轻轻带起。
【服装】她穿银白缎面不对称吊带短礼服，胸口以斜向折片形成精致包裹，腰侧用黑金细绳抽褶收紧，裙身一侧有高开衩但保持优雅街拍尺度。外搭极短黑色薄纱披肩，边缘绣有细金线云纹，搭配金色细项链、黑金流苏耳饰和透明黑色丝袜，丝袜在小腿和膝侧反射街灯，强化修长腿线与都市夜色的性感张力。
【镜头与构图】自拍视角竖版半身到大腿中景，镜头略高于眼睛，广角带出近处人物和后方街景透视。人物占据画面左侧偏中，手机边缘和她的手作为近景，背景高楼灯牌向右后方延伸。
【场景】地点是解放碑步行街夜间，人行道湿润，小吃摊蒸汽从右后方升起，玻璃橱窗、商场招牌和行人光斑形成真实城市层次。环境细节保持可识别但不喧宾夺主。
【灯光与色彩】暖黄色摊位灯照亮脸部和肩颈，冷白商场灯勾出银发边缘，红色招牌在黑纱和丝袜上留下局部反光。整体色彩在金、黑、银白与夜市霓虹之间平衡。

prompts.text:
Create a bold editorial campaign poster where oversized typography reacts to a physical force created by the subject or product.

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product / Campaign: [PRODUCT OR CAMPAIGN]
Main Word: [SHORT WORD]
Subject: [PERSON / PRODUCT / BOTH]
Action: [STEP / JUMP / PULL / SKATE / ETC.]
Force: [PRESS / PUSH / WRAP / SLIDE / OTHER]
Force Direction: [DOWN / UP / ROTATE / DIAGONAL / OTHER]
Main Color: [COLOR]
Accent Color: [COLOR]
Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Use realistic commercial photography, oversized typography, high-contrast colors, and contemporary editorial design.

Make the main word extremely large, filling roughly 50–75% of the frame. The typography should visibly respond to the chosen force instead of remaining static.

For example:

 PRESS: compress, bend, or shift the letters at the point of impact.
 PUSH: stretch the typography along an upward or forward direction.
 WRAP: let large letterforms pass behind and in front of the subject to create an enclosing motion.
 SLIDE: offset and shift the letters along one strong directional axis.

The deformation must follow the subject’s actual movement and force direction. Keep the typography graphic and readable — avoid turning it into soft 3D, liquid, or cartoon lettering.

Create clear foreground–subject–background interaction so the person or product feels physically connected to the type.

Use one dominant high-impact color with black, white, and a contrasting accent color. Add only a few meaningful campaign details such as the brand name, product name, slogan, specifications, labels, or small editorial text.

Keep people and products realistic, with believable proportions, materials, lighting, shadows, and dynamic movement.

The final image should feel like a finished campaign key visual where force, subject, typography, and composition all move together.

There is almost no furniture or decoration in the background, emphasizing a spacious, clean feel slightly reminiscent of a studio or dance practice space.

The mirror itself does not need an obvious frame; the image looks as if taken directly through a large floor-to-ceiling mirror. There are very slight reflection layers between the floor and the mirror, but do not create a second person or incorrectly duplicated limbs. The edges of the frame allow for natural cropping of parts of the legs and feet, maintaining a realistic mobile phone selfie composition rather than deliberately showing the full body completely.

The lighting is a mix of bright, even indoor natural scattered light and cool white ambient light, mainly shining from above and in front. The subject's face, arms, and thighs are brightly and softly exposed, without strong hard shadows; the black clothing maintains sufficient shadow detail. The overall white balance is slightly cool, with the grey space having a slight bluish-grey tone, while the skin remains naturally warm, forming a soft cold-warm contrast with the background.

The overall texture is that of a real social media mobile phone selfie, high-definition but not overly commercialized, with slight mobile HDR, natural sharpening, and a small amount of compression. The focus is not on studio-shot refinement, but on a casual moment where the subject, after seeing something interesting, sits in front of a mirror and holds up a phone to take a photo.

Focus on maintaining: Spacious cool-grey minimalist interior + large floor-to-ceiling mirror selfie + subject sitting low on the floor + obvious high-angle wide-angle composition + both legs lifted and knees significantly bent and crossed + knees and calves occupying the right foreground + both hands holding the phone vertically + fingers clicking the screen + wide eyes looking at the phone + surprised smile with teeth showing + straight black hair with air bangs + black tight sleeveless bodysuit + black over-the-knee socks/leg warmers + bare feet + naturally plump body type + realistic mobile phone snapshot texture.

Avoid: Standing, kneeling, normal cross-legged sitting, eye-level lens, long skirts, high heels, stockings with heels, slender straight body type, extreme body proportions, merged legs, wrong knee joints, extra legs, extra arms, wrong fingers and toes, duplicate figures in mirror, fisheye distortion, strong background blur, hard studio lighting, over-smoothed skin, plastic skin, anime face, gibberish text, watermarks.

上身穿纯黑色紧身无袖连体衣/短袖式运动连体服，上半部分为高圆领、贴身剪裁，袖口刚好覆盖肩部外缘，面料为哑光高弹力运动布料。衣服紧贴胸腰曲线，在腰部和髋部随坐姿产生轻微自然拉伸，不要出现夸张褶皱、亮面乳胶或皮革质感。

腿部穿黑色过膝长袜或腿套，从膝盖附近一直延伸至脚踝区域，面料厚实、哑光、有弹性。由于双膝弯曲，袜口在膝部附近形成自然卷边和压痕，小腿处布料保持贴合。双脚部分裸露，脚趾自然可见；其中一只脚靠近画面右下角，因广角透视略微放大，另一只脚位于画面最右侧并被边缘部分裁切。脚趾、脚掌与脚踝结构保持真实，不出现额外脚趾或扭曲。

场景是极简、空旷的现代室内空间，整体呈冷灰白色调。地面为大面积浅灰色光滑水泥或微水泥材质，具有轻微反射和不规则施工纹理；人物后方和上方是大面积浅灰白色墙体或可移动隔断板，隔断底部安装多个小型金属脚轮，距离地面留有一条狭长亮光。背景几乎没有家具和装饰，强调宽阔、干净、略带摄影棚或舞蹈练习空间的感觉。

镜面本身不需要明显边框，画面像直接通过大型落地镜拍摄。地面和镜面之间产生非常轻微的反射层次，但不要制造第二个人物或错误重复肢体。画面边缘允许自然裁切部分腿部和脚部，保持真实手机自拍构图，而不是刻意完整展示全身。

光线为明亮均匀的室内自然散射光与冷白环境灯混合，主要从画面上方和前方照射。人物脸部、双臂和大腿曝光明亮柔和，没有强烈硬阴影；黑色服装保持足够暗部细节。整体白平衡略偏冷，灰色空间带轻微青灰色调，皮肤仍保持自然偏暖，与背景形成柔和冷暖对比。

整体呈真实社交媒体手机自拍照片质感，高清但不过度商业化，轻微手机 HDR、自然锐化和少量压缩感。重点不是棚拍精致感，而是人物突然看到有趣内容后坐在镜前举手机拍摄的随意瞬间。

重点保持：空旷冷灰色极简室内＋大型落地镜自拍＋人物低位坐在地面＋明显俯视广角构图＋双腿同时抬起并大幅屈膝交错＋膝盖和小腿占据右侧前景＋双手竖握手机＋手指点击屏幕＋睁大眼睛看手机＋张嘴露齿的惊喜笑容＋黑色长直发与空气刘海＋黑色紧身无袖连体服＋黑色过膝长袜/腿套＋裸露脚部＋自然丰满体型＋真实手机随手拍质感。

避免：站姿、跪姿、普通盘腿坐姿、镜头平视、长裙、高跟鞋、丝袜高跟造型、纤细直筒体型、极端人体比例、腿部粘连、错误膝关节、额外腿、额外手臂、错误手指和脚趾、镜中重复人物、鱼眼畸变、强背景虚化、摄影棚硬光、过度磨皮、塑料皮肤、动漫脸、乱码文字、水印。

prompts.text:
Subject:
One fictional adult Japanese woman leaning her body toward the lens on a green urban sidewalk. Wearing a white top and a light blue lace skirt, capturing the moment she speaks to the other person during a street walk.

Location, Time, Background:
A sunny daytime city with dense street trees and low-lying plants along the way. Pedestrians, cafe or shop entrances, and roadside buildings are softly superimposed in the distance, retaining a lively daily atmosphere.

Clothing and Small Items:
A white short-sleeved wrap top overlapping at the chest, and a light blue lace long skirt with a sense of transparency. The right hand holds the fine chain of a light-colored small shoulder bag.

Pose, Fingers, Contact:
Leaning forward from above the waist, the left shoulder sinking slightly, bringing the face closer to the lens. The right arm hangs in front of the body, with the fingertips lightly coiling the chain on the bag.

Expression and Gaze:
A soft smile with slightly narrowed but not excessive eyes, looking straight ahead, with lips slightly parted. Creating an intimate and natural sense of distance, as if encountering an acquaintance and adjusting one's pace.

Face and Makeup:
Smooth oval contour, neat and thick eyebrows, dark brown pupils, small nose, and pale pink lips. Add moderate complexion and sunlight luster to the cheeks, using clean natural makeup.

Hair:
Near-black dark brown long wavy hair. Parted from the middle, naturally superimposing thick hair bundles flowing from the cheeks to the chest and fine stray hairs at the back.

Light Source:
Diffused sunlight filtering through street trees shines on the front of the face and white clothing, creating slender highlights on the hair outline. The background retains a soft sense of light and shadow with dappled tree shadows.

Colors and Tones:
A refreshing color scheme with white, aqua blue, dark green, and warm skin tones as the main characters. Do not overexpose the tone of the white clothing, and slightly soften the blue of the lace and the green of the background.

Materials and Fine Textures:
The soft fabric of the wrap top, the pattern of the lace and the transparency of the skirt hem, the metal chain, the fine strands of hair, the leaves of the street trees, and the graininess of the sidewalk must all be specifically depicted.

Composition and Lens:
A vertical 9:16 close-up portrait. The center of the face is placed at approximately 50% of the screen width and 24% from the top edge, with the character's visual center aligned at approximately 49% horizontally. Leave about 4% white space above the head, the waist position is at about 76% of the screen height, and the bag chain leads to the bottom right. Use a slight wide-angle smartphone-like perspective.

Image Processing and Finish:
As a natural smartphone photo of a street walk, keep the face and clothing clear while slightly blurring the background. Avoid excessive skin beautification and preserve fine skin and hair details.

Crash Avoidance and Prohibitions:
Fixed to the same woman, white wrap top, aqua blue lace skirt, leaning forward pose, right-hand bag, tree-lined sidewalk. Do not add other people, minors, multiple people, other clothing, hats, glasses, text, logos, watermarks, or split screens. Do not break the straight lines of fingers, chains, lace, face, or background.

prompts.text: Create a **2:3 vertical, full-body environmental portrait in natural window light**. A young adult woman in her 20s is seated sideways on an antique dark-brown carved wooden chair with a woven cane back. Her body faces frame-right while her torso twists gently back toward the camera. It should feel as though the photographer had just called to her from behind and she turned during the final fraction of the previous moment. Her eyes meet the lens softly and directly, with a hint of hesitation and emotional distance. Her lips are naturally slightly parted, with no obvious smile and no deliberately performed fashion expression.  Preserve a soft oval facial structure, natural jawline and believable facial proportions. Do not enlarge the eyes, sharpen the chin excessively or turn her into the likeness of a specific celebrity. Use an extremely light East Asian editorial beauty makeup direction: sheer natural foundation, soft diffused brows, an almost invisible brown-black eyeliner, restrained lashes, muted apricot-pink blush and soft nude-pink lips. Makeup should remain barely noticeable, with real skin texture visible.  Her hair is deep brown-black, medium-long to long, with loose natural waves, an informal center-ish part and a few strands falling around the forehead and cheeks. Do not make the hair perfectly salon-styled. Preserve mild frizz, flyaways and uneven curls. Where strong window light passes through individual strands, allow the edges to become faintly translucent warm brown.  Her frame is slender and elongated, with a light shoulder-neck line and naturally long limbs rather than a muscular or gym-defined physique. She is loosely wrapped in a **cream-ivory, heavily crinkled gauze-like robe or oversized draped garment**. The fabric has slipped naturally from both shoulders, exposing the shoulders, collarbone region, much of the upper back and a restrained portion of the side torso. One hand instinctively gathers the garment across the chest, keeping the central chest naturally covered; do not emphasize breast volume or cleavage. The sleeves are wide and soft, while large amounts of the same crumpled fabric fall around her body, over the chair and down to the floor. The textile should resemble washed cotton gauze or softly rumpled linen, with tangible irregular folds rather than commercially pressed clothing.  The legs are a major compositional element. One leg crosses naturally over the other, creating a long diagonal from the chair toward the lower-right of the frame. The thighs, knees, calves, ankles and bare feet remain visible. One foot sits closer to the floor while the other extends slightly outward and remains lightly suspended. The pose must not feel mathematically arranged like professional fashion posing. Preserve subtle imbalance, uneven shoulder height, relaxed joints, slipping fabric and the small accidental tensions produced by a real seated body.  Her skin is very fair neutral-to-cool ivory, becoming slightly rosy-white in the strong window illumination while shaded areas retain faint pink-gray blood tone and natural color variation. Visible skin includes the face, neck, shoulders, upper back, portions of the arms and hands, along with broad areas of both legs. Texture should remain fine but human. Visually, the skin should suggest that it would feel **soft, slightly cool, clean and faintly velvety with very fine body hair**, never waxy, ceramic or synthetic. Preserve subtle tonal changes around knees, knuckles, ankles, toes and joints.  Set the portrait inside a bright, pale European-classical sculpture studio, art apartment or antique-filled interior. A large tall window occupies most of the background, covered by translucent white sheers and thin taupe-gray curtains. In the left foreground, place a large white classical female plaster bust on an ornate pedestal, partly cropped by the edge of the frame. Near the window on the right, include a white classical male sculpted head, with part of another carved white stone pedestal cropped into the right foreground. Use a pale stone or softly veined marble floor. Near the chair legs, allow a few dried warm-brown flower stems or scattered botanical fragments to remain, giving the room the feeling of an actually inhabited artistic space rather than a perfectly dressed set.  The dominant light source is a very large window behind and to the rear-right of the subject. The translucent white curtain acts as a huge diffuser, with the taupe-gray sheer reducing illumination in selected areas. Pale walls, plaster sculptures, stone flooring and the windowsill bounce substantial light back onto the subject. This produces broad, extremely soft luminous planes across her shoulders, back, arms and legs with almost no hard-edged shadows. Expose primarily for the skin, allowing the window itself to wash toward white and partially clip into overexposure. Do not introduce a clean commercial rim light, obvious flash, hard directional fill or golden-orange sunset lighting.  Place the camera front-left of the subject at approximately seated chest-to-shoulder height, essentially level with only a very subtle low-angle impression. Use the visual language of a full-frame or APS-C mirrorless camera with approximately a **50–70mm full-frame-equivalent lens**, avoiding obvious wide-angle stretching of the legs or room. Depth of field should be moderately shallow, around the visual impression of f/2.8–f/4: the face, body and nearby cane-chair texture remain readable while the foreground sculptures and curtains soften gently. Do not erase the environment with extreme creamy bokeh.  Keep the photograph high-key and low-contrast, with a neutral-to-slightly-cool white balance. A  young woman with slightly tousled shoulder-length hair, cigarette in mouth, viewed from BELOW through flames. Shoulder-length hair with natural slight waves, a little tousled but not wild — effortlessly messy, lived-in texture. Looking down toward camera through the fire, half-lidded distant gaze. Cold, detached, nonchalant expression with cigarette dangling from lips. Holding burning newspaper, only lower face visible — chin, lips, cigarette, and jaw seen through flames.

Black blazer, dark formal wear. The New York Times newspaper held in front, bottom edge of newspaper and flames are in EXTREME FOREGROUND, burning with flames rising UP toward camera.

FOREGROUND ELEMENT — camera shoots THROUGH the flames, fire partially obscures and frames the view of subject's lower face. Fire between camera and subject's face, flames rising in front of lens. Warm orange and golden yellow flames, slightly out of focus in foreground. Fire creates natural vignette/frame, viewer looks THROUGH flames to see chin, lips, and cigarette. Cigarette dangling from lips, lit, visible through the fire, smoke mixing with fire glow.

Close-up of lower face THROUGH foreground flames, 35mm f/1.8. LOW ANGLE from below newspaper level, shooting UP through fire toward chin/mouth. Camera placed as if BEHIND the burning newspaper edge, shooting through flames. FG: out-of-focus fire and newspaper edge filling bottom/sides of frame; MG: sharp focus on chin, lips, cigarette; BG: dark face fading into black. Shallow depth of field — foreground flames slightly blurred, focus on lips/chin area.

SINGLE LIGHT SOURCE — fire only. NO other light sources, NO fill light, NO ambient light. ONLY the burning newspaper flames illuminate the scene. Fire below face, casting warm uplight on chin, underlip, and nose from below. Dark, dramatic, firelit chiaroscuro. PURE BLACK surroundings, face emerges from complete darkness, lit only by fire glow from below.

Fujifilm ETERNA style, extremely dark and underexposed, fire is the ONLY color/light in the frame. Pure black background, warm orange fire glow on skin, deep shadows everywhere else. Very dark overall exposure with crushed blacks.

黑色西装外套，深色正装。手里拿着《纽约时报》，报纸的底边和火焰处于极前景，火焰正朝着相机向上升起。

前景元素——相机穿过火焰拍摄，火焰部分遮挡并构图了主体下半张脸的视野。火位于相机和主体面部之间，火焰在镜头前升起。温暖的橙色和金黄色火焰，在前景中略微失焦。火焰创造了自然的暗角/边框，观众穿过火焰看到下巴、嘴唇和香烟。香烟叼在唇间，已点燃，透过火光可见，烟雾与火光交融。

透过前景火焰拍摄下半张脸的特写，35mm f/1.8。从报纸水平线以下的低角度仰拍，穿过火焰拍向底部的下巴/嘴部。相机放置位置如同在燃烧的报纸边缘后方，穿过火焰拍摄。前景（FG）：失焦的火焰和报纸边缘填充了画面的底部/侧面；中景（MG）：焦点清晰地落在下巴、嘴唇、香烟上；背景（BG）：黑暗的面部没入黑色。浅景深——前景火焰略微模糊，焦点在嘴唇/下巴区域。

单一光源——只有火。没有其他光源，没有补光，没有环境光。只有燃烧的报纸火焰照亮场景。火在脸部下方，从下方在下巴、下唇和鼻子处投射出温暖的仰光。黑暗、戏剧化、火光照明的明暗对比法。纯黑的环境，脸部从完全的黑暗中显现，仅由下方的火光照亮。

富士 Fujifilm ETERNA 风格，极暗且曝光不足，火是画面中唯一的颜色/光线。纯黑背景，皮肤上有温暖的橙色火光，其他地方皆为深邃阴影。整体曝光非常暗，带有压碎的黑色效果。

items.title: 超写实夜间室内生活随拍东亚女性视角

prompts.text:
Hyper-realistic nighttime indoor lifestyle snapshot photography, vertical aspect ratio approximately 9:16, a young adult East Asian female sitting on a dark grey floor, body leaning against the black leather sofa on the right side of the frame. The camera is almost touching the ground, located directly in front of the subject and slightly to the left, approximately 24–28mm equivalent mobile phone wide-angle, using a very pronounced low-angle close-up perspective: the feet and calves are closest to the lens, occupying the lower half of the frame and creating a natural near-large far-small effect, while the subject's face is located in the upper right area of the frame. Retaining a large amount of floor and dim indoor environment, presenting a feeling of being captured up close while casually sitting on the floor, no fisheye used.

The subject has a slender and well-proportioned figure, elegant shoulders and neck, a thin waist, and long legs. She is sitting on the floor with knees bent, both legs extending forward towards the camera, one knee raised higher and close to her chest, the other knee slightly lower, the two legs naturally overlapping, forming a layered curled sitting posture. Because the camera is extremely close to the feet, the front sole is significantly enlarged, then gradually shrinks towards the subject's body along the ankles, calves, knees, and thighs, strengthening the depth perspective while maintaining realistic human proportions.

The subject's arms are wrapped around the top of the raised knee, two forearms overlapping horizontally, one hand naturally resting near the other knee with relaxed fingers; the body leans slightly towards the sofa on the right. The head tilts gently to the right and close to her forearm, chin slightly tucked, eyes looking directly at the lens, corners of the mouth with a very slight, restrained smile, quiet and soft expression, with a clear nighttime home snapshot feel.

The subject has dark brown-black short hair, length about between the jaw and neck, a side-parted short bob, naturally fluffy roots, hair ends slightly curved inwards, with several loose strands of hair on both sides of the cheeks. Small oval face, exquisite and natural features, soft eyebrow shape, dark eyes, light eyeliner and eyelashes, thin bridge of the nose, lips in a natural rose pink color. The skin is fair, with obvious bright highlights on the face after being illuminated by a close-range flash, while retaining real skin texture.

Wears a pure black slim-fit long-sleeve top on the upper body, soft elastic fabric, simple round neck/low round neck design, tight against the upper body but without patterns or decorations. Wears a very short dark brown, taupe, and beige plaid pleated mini skirt on the lower body, the hem naturally stacks on the hips and sides of the thighs in a sitting position, with clear plaid and pleat structures visible.

Wearing black ultra-thin transparent pantyhose on the legs, approximately 10–15D light and thin nylon texture, continuously covering from thighs to toes, overall highly skin-permeable, able to clearly see natural skin tone, knee outlines, instep, and toe structures; the surface of the pantyhose has very fine and uniform faint mercerized reflections, forming soft highlights along the shins, knees, and insteps under the flash. No shoes on the feet, the pantyhose completely wrap both feet, one foot in front is closest to the lens, the sole and toes are significantly enlarged, the other foot is slightly behind and partially overlapping; the toe shapes are natural, and dark toenails are faintly visible through the pantyhose. The pantyhose must remain continuous and complete, without breaks, damage, wrong seams, or waistbands.

The scene is a dim living room/study area of a minimalist modern apartment, the floor is paved with dark grey large-size tiles or matte flooring. Immediately to the right of the subject is a black glossy leather sofa, with soft leather wrinkles and highlights from the flash visible. Behind the subject is a set of black open high bookshelves, with a few books and items scattered; to the left is a large area of grey-white wall and door frame, other areas of the room basically fall into shadow, no complex decorations.

Adopting a typical nighttime mobile phone/portable digital camera direct flash effect: the environment itself is very dim, the close-range on-camera flash shines directly at the subject, the face, arms, pantyhose legs, and foreground feet are strongly illuminated, producing sharp and hard highlights and shadows cast backward; the background rapidly decays into dark grey-black. The foreground feet have slight out-of-focus and motion softening due to being too close to the lens, while the knees, upper body, and face are relatively clear, presenting real small digital camera autofocus characteristics.

The overall quality maintains the texture of a 2000s portable digital camera/mobile phone nighttime snapshot, with limited dynamic range, slight high ISO noise, a small amount of flash overexposure, and natural sharpening, not doing commercial studio shots or cinematic color grading. The subject's face, short hair, clothes, plaid skirt, and pantyhose textures are clear, with strong but natural foreground perspective. Avoid fisheye, extreme body stretching, plastic skin, excessive skin smoothing, CG feel, anime feel, wrong leg overlapping, extra limbs, deformed soles, extra toes, extra fingers, broken pantyhose, wrong foot structure, watermarks, and garbled text.

真人摄影风格，高级日系潮流杂志 Editorial 写真，海边黄金时刻日落场景。一位 20–23 岁、明确成年的漂亮日本女性 坐在海岸边粗粝的天然礁石上，身后是辽阔海面、延伸至远方的礁石群与正在缓缓落向海平面的夕阳。天空呈现金黄、橙红、蜜桃粉与淡紫色自然渐变，海面被夕阳染成大片闪烁的金色波光，整体具有浪漫、温暖而高级的电影氛围。

人物身材丰盈但比例健康协调，拥有自然优越的模特比例，腰身纤细，双腿修长，胸部视觉约为自然 D 罩杯大小，丰满圆润但不过度夸张。肌肤非常白皙细腻，呈通透冷白色调，在暖金色夕阳照射下形成自然的冷暖肤色层次，同时保留真实毛孔、细微肌理与淡淡血色。

人物拥有精致典型的日系美人五官，头部偏小、脸型小巧，流畅清晰的下颌线与微尖下巴，五官集中协调。乌黑柔顺的长发自然披散，海边晚风持续吹动长发，部分发丝凌乱飘向侧后方，并被夕阳勾勒出通透的金色发丝轮廓光。妆容清透精致，以自然眼线、细腻睫毛、蜜桃色腮红与水润裸粉唇为主。

身穿白色修身短款深 V 领上衣，采用明显的低位深 V 剪裁，领口自然向下延伸，露出大半上胸、肩颈与清晰锁骨线条，自然突出丰满但协调的胸部曲线；短款设计露出纤细腰部。下身搭配低腰修身超短牛仔裙，裙长明显偏短但保持完整、自然的服装结构，充分展现修长的大腿与腿部比例。棉质与牛仔面料具有清晰真实的织物纹理，并受到海风影响产生轻微自然褶皱。

不穿鞋、不穿袜，全程赤脚。 人物自然坐在靠近海水的礁石上，身体略微向后倾斜，双手轻松支撑在身体两侧的岩石表面。双腿自然错落舒展，一条腿轻微弯曲，另一条腿向前自然延伸，脚踝、脚背与脚趾保持放松，姿态大方、自信、慵懒而自然。

采用海边低机位轻微仰拍，中景至三分之二身构图，人物作为画面主要视觉中心，同时完整保留身后的海平线与落日。摄影机方向让低垂夕阳出现在人物侧后方或远处海平线附近，避免太阳被人物完全遮挡。利用前景礁石、中景人物、远景海面与夕阳形成明显空间纵深。

夕阳处于接近海平面的低角度位置，暖金色侧逆光穿过人物发丝，在头发、肩膀、手臂、腰部与双腿边缘形成清晰但柔和的金色轮廓光；人物正面由天空与海面反射形成自然柔和补光，使五官和冷白肌肤保持明亮清晰。海面具有明显但不过曝的金色反射光带，湿润礁石表面出现细碎夕阳反光。

天空保留丰富晚霞层次与自然云层纹理，远处海浪轻柔翻涌，浪花在逆光下形成细腻高光，少量海风带来的薄雾增加空气透视感。黄金时刻、日落夕阳、海面金色波光、晚霞渐变、逆光发丝、柔和 Lens Flare、电影级动态范围、浅景深、轻微胶片颗粒、真实皮肤与织物纹理、高级时尚杂志摄影质感。

整体呈现浪漫海边日落 × 日系时尚 Editorial × 自然性感 × 慵懒自由感，色彩以夕阳金橙色、蜜桃粉天空、深蓝海水、白色上衣与冷白肌肤形成高级冷暖对比。

避免：正午阳光，阴天天空，没有夕阳，夕阳位置错误，太阳过曝成纯白色，天空过度饱和，假晚霞，人物脸部过暗，严重逆光黑脸，大头，大脸，身体比例失衡，胸部过度夸张，腿部过短，严重广角变形，手脚畸形，多余肢体，多余手指脚趾，衣物穿模，塑料皮肤，过度磨皮，背景杂乱，AI伪影，文字，Logo，水印。

items.title: 临海机甲整备舱内的银白装甲少女

prompts.text:
Subject:
Vertical 3:4, inside a seaside mecha maintenance bay, she stands in front of a semi-open humanoid mecha cockpit, her right palm pressed against the transparent visor of a silver-white mecha helmet floating beside her, as if initiating biometric identification before departure. The character is located slightly to the right of the center of the frame, with the framing from the top of the head to the middle of the thighs; the bottom left foreground is slightly obstructed by a maintenance mechanical arm, and the unfolded armor skeleton behind her creates a sense of depth and protection.

Character・Expression:
A stunning 23-year-old East Asian beauty, with a stylish, confident, and gentle temperament; a well-proportioned and voluptuous figure, naturally full breasts (approximate visual effect of D to E cups), a slender waist, and coordinated hip-to-leg proportions, with soft and natural curves; ivory white skin with a faint pinkish glow, retaining realistic pores, collarbones, and subtle highlights on the shoulders and arms. Bright milk-tea grey-brown medium-long hair falls naturally over the shoulders, thin air bangs are gently blown apart by the breeze inside the cabin, with fine hair strands around the face and the ends slightly curled inward. The face shape is delicate and soft, with clear apricot eyes containing tiny catchlights, a natural bridge of the nose, and full yet restrained lip shape; champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, slender eyelashes, light rose blush, and translucent pink-beige lips. Her chin is slightly tucked, her gaze looks past the helmet towards the sea and sky outside the cabin door, her expression calm with a hint of anticipation before departure.

Clothing・Pose:
A pearl-white textured triangle bikini with narrow silver-grey piping and crisscross shoulder straps, the form-fitting fabric retains fine textures and natural tension; the bikini bottom is a low-waist side-tie structure, with the ties naturally under tension along the hip line. Streamlined silver-white light mecha armor covers the shoulders, forearms, and outer thighs, composed of segmented ceramic armor plates, matte titanium alloy joints, and a few ice-blue status lights, with clear soft black padding between the armor plates and the skin, not obscuring the main body of the bikini. The center of gravity falls on the slightly bent left leg, with the right leg half a step back; the right arm is naturally raised, the palm and five fingers are completely flush against the helmet visor, and a faint ice-blue identification light rings the contact point, while the left hand hangs relaxed at the side of the hip.

Background・Light:
The foreground is a blurred black maintenance mechanical arm, the mid-ground shows the helmet and the semi-unfolded humanoid mecha cockpit, and outside the cabin door in the background is only the deep blue sea surface and morning mist blurred by shallow depth of field. Cold morning light enters from the upper right cabin door, diagonally illuminating her face, shoulders, collarbones, and the edges of the silver-white armor plates, with soft shadows falling towards the bottom left; the sea surface provides only a layer of restrained pale blue reflection, creating clear warm and cold layers between the skin and the metal. Indicator lights inside the cabin remain sparse, with no readable text.

Composition・Camera:
Equivalent 50mm lens, slightly low angle shot at chest height, focus on the near pupil and the palm pressed against the visor, shallow depth of field softens the mecha structure behind. The character occupies about 68% of the frame, with the armor on both sides of the mecha cockpit forming an inward-closing geometric frame; the mechanical arm in the lower left forms a foreground obstruction, and the upper left area in the direction of the gaze preserves white space in the sea mist.

Texture・Style:
Japanese futurism beauty magazine photography and restrained hard sci-fi fashion editorial, low contrast, cold silver-blue main tone, skin tone remains warm, with subtle soft film grain. Focus on representing real skin, textured swimwear, matte ceramic armor plates, brushed titanium, and faint fingerprint reflections on the transparent visor.

Negative:
Underage or mature middle-aged feel, drifting facial features, bikini and mecha structure sticking or clipping, palm not flush with the visor or incorrect number of fingers, misaligned armor joints, plastic skin, excessive nudity, readable garbled text or watermarks.

prompts.text:
主体：
竖3:4，临海机甲整备舱内，她站在半开启的人形机甲胸舱前，右手掌贴住悬浮于身侧的银白机甲头盔透明面罩，像在启动出航前的生物识别。人物位于画面中央略偏右，取景从头顶至大腿中段；左下前景被检修机械臂轻微遮挡，身后展开的装甲骨架形成纵深与守护感。

人物・表情：
绝美23岁东亚美女，气质时尚、自信、温柔；
身材匀称丰满，胸部自然丰满（约D至E杯视觉效果），腰部纤细，臀腿比例协调，曲线柔和自然；
象牙白肌肤带淡粉血色，保留真实毛孔、锁骨与肩臂的细微高光。明亮奶茶灰棕中长发自然过肩，薄空气刘海被舱内微风轻轻吹开，脸周发束细碎，发尾微微内扣。脸型精致柔和，清亮杏眼内含细小眼神光，鼻梁自然，唇形饱满克制；香槟米色与粉棕眼影、细长睫毛、淡玫瑰腮红、透感粉米色唇。她下颌微收，目光越过头盔望向舱门外的海天，神情冷静而带一丝出航前的期待。

服装・姿势：
珍珠白织纹三角比基尼采用细窄银灰包边与交叉肩带，贴身面料保留细密织纹和自然张力；比基尼下装为低腰侧绑结构，结带顺着髋线自然受力。肩部、前臂与大腿外侧覆盖流线型银白轻装机甲，装甲以分段陶瓷甲片、雾面钛合金关节和少量冰蓝状态灯构成，甲片与皮肤之间留有清晰柔软黑色衬垫，不遮挡比基尼主体。重心落在微屈的左腿，右腿向后半步；右臂自然抬起，掌心与五指完整贴合头盔面罩，接触处亮起一圈微弱冰蓝识别光，左手放松垂在髋侧。

背景・光：
前景是虚化的黑色检修机械臂，中景可见头盔与半展开的人形机甲胸舱，背景舱门之外只有被浅景深化开的深蓝海面与晨雾。右上方舱门射入清冷晨光，斜向照亮她的脸、肩、锁骨及银白甲片边缘，阴影柔和落向左下；海面仅提供一层克制的淡蓝反射，使皮肤与金属之间产生清晰冷暖层次。舱内指示灯保持稀疏，不出现可读文字。

构图・相机：
等效50mm镜头，胸口高度略低机位轻微仰拍，焦点落在近侧瞳孔与贴住面罩的手掌，浅景深柔化后方机甲结构。人物约占画面68%，机甲胸舱两侧装甲构成向内收束的几何框景；左下机械臂形成前景遮挡，视线方向的左上区域保留海雾留白。

质感・风格：
日系未来主义美容杂志写真与克制的硬科幻时尚编辑，低对比、冷银蓝主调、肤色保持温润，带轻微柔和胶片颗粒。重点表现真实皮肤、织纹泳装、雾面陶瓷甲片、拉丝钛合金与透明面罩上的微弱指纹反光。

负面：
未成年或成熟中年感、人物面部特征漂移、比基尼与机甲结构粘连或穿模、手掌未贴合面罩或手指数量错误、装甲关节错位、塑料感皮肤、过度裸露、可读乱码文字或水印

items.title: 高级极简旅行海报摄影插画分屏设计

prompts.text: Please turn each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, output each photo separately. Use an overall 3:4 vertical composition, with the heights of the upper and lower areas strictly 1:1, each occupying 50% of the screen. The upper half preserves the original photo, maintaining the identity, structure, posture, realistic texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere of the subject, with only slight high-end photographic color grading to give it the quality of art magazines, independent publications, and exhibition photography. To adapt to the frame, the sky, ground, or environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed. The lower half extracts the most recognizable **subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship** from the photo, reconstructing it into a premium minimalist flat-vector travel poster style situational illustration. Do not mechanically trace the photo; instead, based on the visual personality of the original image, extract the most representative main visual focus and supplement it with 2–4 auxiliary elements that best illustrate the environmental temperament, daily lifestyle, sense of place, or state of life. Whether the original image is a city, building, person, animal, plant, object, vehicle, or natural landscape, the lower half should be like a high-end travel visual poster customized for it, rather than applying a fixed template. The composition should be reorganized according to the temperament of the subject itself, rather than repeating the same layout. Use a clear focal point, distinct foreground and background layers, moderate white space, and a quiet, orderly visual rhythm to establish the image; it can be naturally transformed into streets, squares, shores, courtyards, passages, platforms, plant scenes, indoor corners, open landscapes, or environmental fragments with life clues based on the original image. The subject is always the primary visual center, and other elements are only used to strengthen the uniqueness of 'this is this place / this object / this situation,' avoiding collage-style landmark stacking, postcard-style listing, and excessive narration. If figures are needed in the image, keep only 3–6 small-scale figures and let them naturally blend into the environment without a single protagonist. The overall style adopts **premium minimalist flat vector illustration**: Japanese stationery feel, boutique sticker illustration, modern editorial travel branding temperament, using simple geometric shapes, soft outlines, uniform line weights, flat color blocks, and restrained details, with a fresh, quiet, exquisite, and contemporary image. Avoid realism, heavy shadows, watercolor textures, paper textures, complex brushstrokes, gradients, crowded backgrounds, and excessive details. The color palette is based on soft, transparent, slightly desaturated high-end color systems, which can be extracted from the comprehensive color temperature of the original image for adjustment, but overall remains light and unified. Use **pale pink-blue, mist blue, sky blue, airy cool-toned blue** to create the main atmosphere, then use **ivory white, cream white, light beige, soft gray-green, architectural neutrals** to maintain balance; only allow a small amount of dusty rose or muted blush as tiny accents for flowers, clothing, small logos, awnings, or local decorations, making the image both breathable and layered with exquisite depth. The text logic should also be transformed into a part of this style. Do not directly apply city name templates; instead, extract a short title from the original image's **location, object name, keywords, state, or atmosphere**, place it in the upper left or a position with ample white space, and pair it with a short, restrained, and atmospheric tagline. The typography should maintain an understated, editorial, spacious, premium temperament, not overpowering the image; when necessary, a small amount of small-print information, coordinate-style annotations, or micro-descriptions can be added to make the text naturally integrate into the composition like a visual identifier in a high-end travel brand or boutique postcard, rather than a title bar pasted on later. The overall presentation should be like a **high-end travel poster / boutique lifestyle postcard** specially designed for the subject: fresh, elegant, quiet, modern, and exquisite, with sufficient white space and a relaxed sense of presence. Each lower half must have an independent visual identity and cannot just replace the name while using the same composition, the same foreground, and the same arrangement of objects. Avoid a sense of templates, a sense of copying, general travel poster formulas, and repetitive compositions.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览摄影质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展天空、地面或环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的**主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系**，重构为一张 premium minimalist flat-vector travel poster 风格的场景化插画。不要机械描摹照片，而是根据原图的视觉个性，提炼一个最具代表性的主视觉焦点，并围绕它补充 2–4 个最能说明环境气质、日常方式、地方感或生活状态的辅助元素。无论原图是城市、建筑、人物、动物、植物、器物、交通工具或自然景观，下半部分都应像为它量身定制的一张高级旅行视觉海报，而不是套用固定模板。

构图应根据主体本身的气质重新组织，而不是重复同一种版式。利用一个明确焦点、清晰前后层次、适度留白和安静有序的视觉节奏建立画面；可根据原图自然转化为街道、广场、岸边、庭院、通道、平台、植物场景、室内角落、开放景观或带有生活线索的环境片段。主体始终是第一视觉中心，其余元素仅用于强化“这是这个地方 / 这个对象 / 这种情境”的独特性，避免拼贴式地标堆积、明信片式罗列和过度叙事。若画面需要人物，仅保留 3–6 个小尺度人物，并让其自然融入环境，不设单一主角。

整体风格采用**高级极简扁平矢量插画**：日系文具感、精品贴纸插画、现代 editorial travel branding 气质，使用简洁几何形、柔和轮廓、统一线重、平涂色块和克制细节，画面清新、安静、精致、当代。避免写实、厚重阴影、水彩肌理、纸张纹理、复杂笔触、渐变、拥挤背景和过多细节。

配色以柔和、通透、略微去饱和的高级色系为基础，可从原图中提炼综合色温进行调整，但整体保持轻盈统一。以**浅粉蓝、雾蓝、天空蓝、空气感冷调蓝**营造主氛围，再以**象牙白、奶油白、浅米色、柔和灰绿、建筑中性色**保持平衡；仅允许少量 dusty rose 或 muted blush 作为微小点缀，用于花、服饰、小标识、遮阳篷或局部装饰，使画面既有呼吸感又不失精致层次。

文字逻辑也要转化为这种风格的一部分。不要直接套城市名模板，而是从原图的**地点、对象名称、主题词、状态或氛围**中提炼一个简短标题，置于左上或留白充足的位置，并搭配一句简短、克制、具有气质的 tagline。文字应保持 understated、editorial、spacious、premium 的排版气质，不压过画面；必要时可加入少量小字信息、坐标式注释或微型说明，使文字像高级旅行品牌或精品明信片中的视觉标识，自然融入构图，而不是后期贴上的标题栏。

整体呈现应像一张为该主体专门设计的**高级旅行海报 / 精品生活方式明信片**：清新、优雅、安静、现代、精致，具有充足留白和松弛的在场感。每一张下半部分都必须拥有独立的视觉身份，不能只替换名称而沿用同一套构图、同一套前景和同一套物件摆法。避免模板感、复制感、通用旅游海报公式和重复性构图。

Theme:
Double V-signs on the rooftop

Subject:
On the rooftop terrace in the center of the frame, a woman makes V-sign gestures with both hands, with one foot kicked back. A light blue cropped top paired with a plaid pleated skirt, smiling with teeth showing.

Character · Expression:
The face is tilted slightly from the front toward the left side of the frame, looking at the camera with a bright toothy smile. A round small face with a slender chin, horizontally long eyes and eyeline, thin eyebrows, a short and rounded nose tip, coral-colored lips, and peach-colored cheeks. Dark brown shoulder-length wavy hairstyle with thin front bangs, half tied up, with a white flower accessory pinned to the back right.

Clothing · Pose:
A light water-blue ribbed camisole top, paired with a water-blue, grey, and beige plaid pattern pleated mini skirt. The top has thin shoulder straps, a deep round neck, small white buttons in front, and a cropped hem. Wearing white socks and platform sneakers, both hands are raised to the sides of the face making V-signs, and the character's own left knee is bent backward revealing the sole of the shoe.

Background · Lighting:
The foreground consists of a wooden deck and plants, the background on the left is a blurred cityscape, and on the top and right are a wooden pergola, string lights, tables, and chairs. Harsh direct sunlight is projected from the top left of the frame, casting sharp shadows on the person and the ground while keeping the blue sky bright.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 3:4, camera looking straight at a level slightly lower than the waist, almost a full-body portrait. The character occupies a large space in the center, the raised shoe appears large in the lower right foreground, and the supporting foot is cut off at the bottom edge. Focus is on the face and body, with the cityscape blurred with a shallow depth of field.

Texture · Style:
Bright and photorealistic outdoor live-action photo. Ribbed fabric, pleats, white shoes, wood, leaves, and a metal clock are vividly depicted under the summer sun.

Negative Prompt:
Deformed fingers in the double V-signs; reversed left and right of the backward-bent leg
