items.title: 东方诗意留白艺术海报提示词

prompts.text:
【Original Poetry Sentence】: Fill in a line of ancient poetry with clear emotion and a sense of imagery.
【Two-character Theme】: Extract 2 core characters from the poem.
【Core Emotion】: Endless flowing / Indistinguishable / Unforgettable / Unstoppable / Waiting / Longing, etc.
【Emotional Action】: Flowing away / Entwining / Lingering / Disappearing / Fading / Drifting away, etc.
【Small Subject】: Water traces / Silk threads / Old windows / Petals / Lanterns / Boats / Stationery, etc.
【Main Color】: Fill in 1–3 main colors.
【Light Embossing】: Old riverbeds / Thread marks / Human figures / Flower shadows / Water ripples / Moon halos, etc.
【Location and Date】: Fill in.

Generate a 9:16 vertical Oriental poetic minimalist art poster, transforming the 【Core Emotion】 in the 【Original Poetry Sentence】 into a visible 【Emotional Action】.

Use pure white or slightly cool-toned premium handmade art paper as the background, retaining real paper fibers, pulp particles, and natural indentations. Maintain about 65%–70% effective whitespace in the image; do not fill the screen with giant subjects.

Place only one 【Small Subject】 occupying about 15%–25% of the frame, then add a tiny figure or a minimal amount of narrative elements. The point is not to directly explain the poem, but to let the emotion happen in the space through the 【Emotional Action】.

Background includes low-contrast shallow relief 【Light Embossing】 related to the theme. The embossing must have meaning, such as the path where water once flowed, a human figure that has disappeared, thread marks that were straightened and then entwined, faded flower shadows, or the position left by an old object. Keep it clean from a distance, and only discover these "remnants" upon close inspection.

Use 【Main Color】 for colors; they can be beautiful, clear, and emotional, but do not make everything black, white, and gray just for the sake of sadness. Let colors gradually fade, wash away, or merge into the paper with distance and time.

Lines, water edges, and flower fall trajectories must be continuous, soft, and natural, avoiding a large number of break points, broken lines, and cluttered AI textures.

Use the 【Two-character Theme】 for the main Chinese title, employing modern Songti or Mingti typefaces. Design sense can be added through letter spacing, slight misalignment, thin lines, or partial extensions, but the Chinese characters must be complete, accurate, and clear.

Also include small-sized original poem lines, location, date, and a short English title. The overall effect should be a combination of ancient poetry emotion, material experimentation, paper embossing, and high-end editorial poster design.

Avoid: Ordinary ancient-style illustrations, traditional landscape paintings, travel posters, giant subjects, people crying, dark clouds and heavy rain, over-literal emotional expressions, beige or old backgrounds, broken lines, meaningless embossing, dull gray colors, dense text, and cheap 3D.

prompts.text:

【核心情绪】：流不尽 / 理不清 / 忘不掉 / 留不住 / 等待 / 思念等
【情绪动作】：流走 / 缠绕 / 残留 / 消失 / 褪色 / 漂离等

【主色】：填写 1–3 种主要颜色
【浅压纹】：旧河道 / 线痕 / 人影 / 花影 / 水纹 / 月晕等
【地点与日期】：填写

生成一张 9:16 竖版东方诗意留白艺术海报，将【诗词原句】里的【核心情绪】转化为一种可见的【情绪动作】。

使用纯白或轻微冷调的高级手工艺术纸作为背景，保留真实纸纤维、纸浆颗粒和自然压痕。画面保持约 65%–70% 的有效留白，不使用巨大主体压满画面。

只放置一个占画面约 15%–25% 的【小主体】，再加入极小人物或极少量叙事元素。重点不是直接解释诗句，而是通过【情绪动作】让情绪发生在空间里。

背景加入与主题有关的低对比浅浮雕【浅压纹】，压纹必须有含义，例如曾经流过的路径、已经消失的人影、被拉直又缠绕的线痕、褪色花影或旧物留下的位置。远看保持干净，近看才发现这些“残留”。

颜色使用【主色】，可以漂亮、清透、有情绪，但不要为了悲伤全部做成黑白灰。让颜色随着距离和时间逐渐变淡、褪去或进入纸面。

线条、水边、花落轨迹等必须连续、柔和、自然，避免大量断点、碎线和凌乱的 AI 纹理。

中文主标题使用【两字主题】，采用现代宋体或明朝体，可通过字距、轻微错位、细线或局部延伸增加设计感，但必须保证汉字完整、准确、清晰。

同时加入小字号原诗句、地点、日期和简短英文标题。整体效果像古诗情绪、材料实验、纸张压纹与高级编辑海报的结合。

避免：普通古风插画、传统山水画、旅游海报、巨大主体、人物哭泣、乌云暴雨、情绪表达过度直白、背景米黄发旧、线条断裂、压纹没有含义、颜色灰闷、密集文字和廉价 3D。

prompts.text:
Create a bold editorial campaign poster where oversized typography becomes part of the composition, not just background text.

Brand: [BRAND NAME]
Product / Campaign: [PRODUCT OR CAMPAIGN]
Main Word: [SHORT WORD]
Subject: [PERSON / PRODUCT / BOTH]
Action: [RUNNING / DANCING / RIDING / ETC.]
Main Color: [COLOR]
Type Interaction: [CUT THROUGH / STAND ON / FRAME / SURROUND / OTHER]
Aspect Ratio: [9:16]

Use contemporary editorial design, realistic commercial photography, bold typography, and strong graphic composition.

Make the main word extremely large, filling roughly 50–75% of the frame. Let parts of the letters extend beyond the canvas, overlap the subject, or shift in perspective.

The subject should actively interact with the typography rather than simply stand in front of it. Create clear foreground–subject–background layering, with some letterforms behind the subject and others crossing in front.

Build the whole composition around one clear visual direction. The subject pose, typography, perspective, and graphic elements should work together.

Use one dominant color with black, white, and only a small amount of accent color.

Add a few meaningful campaign details such as the brand name, product name, slogan, date, specs, labels, crop marks, or small editorial text. Keep the information organized and avoid random filler words.

Keep the subject realistic, with natural proportions, believable lighting, authentic skin and material textures, and dynamic body language.

The final image should feel like a finished brand campaign key visual — bold, layered, energetic, and visually complete.

Avoid generic “person + big title” layouts, meaningless text, excessive UI graphics, too many colors, heavy 3D typography, stiff poses, and cluttered composition.

最终图像应感觉像是一个完成的品牌活动主视觉——大胆、分层、充满活力且视觉完整。

items.title: 真实摄影与治愈积木解构高级海报设计

prompts.text:
Please make each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, each photo output individually. The overall composition adopts a 3:4 vertical layout, with the upper and lower two areas strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the screen.

The upper part preserves the original photo, maintaining the main structure, spatial relationships, real materials, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, only performing slight high-end photographic color grading to give it the texture of an art magazine, independent publication, and exhibition photography. To adapt to the frame, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The lower part extracts the most recognizable **subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship** from the photo, following the logic of "deconstruction—screening—refining—reconstruction," and transforms it into a **healing block sculpture with a 3D / isometric sense of space**. Focus on preserving the subject's most unique volume proportions, axes, curves, interspersions, layering, occlusion, and negative space, re-organized with rounded, simple, tactile modular blocks; do not fully replicate details, but it must be immediately felt as corresponding to the original image above.

The composition is adaptively designed according to the subject's own visual center of gravity, posture direction, and spatial relationships, establishing rhythm through large and small blocks, high and low staggered layers, front and back interspersing, local suspension, density changes, and large areas of white space. Blocks can be spliced, stacked, nested, crossed, or naturally misplaced, so that the subject retains its identity while having the sculptural sense and relaxed imagination of contemporary art toys, avoiding mechanical disassembly and simple pixelation.

**Color schemes must be generated by analyzing the original image above.** First identify the most vital and recognizable main color relationships in the photo, as well as the comprehensive color temperature, brightness levels, cold-warm echoes, and key point colors, then re-modulate these colors into a softer, clearer, brighter, and more airy healing color system. Preserve the hue identity and emotional memory of the original image, but moderately increase brightness, reduce harsh contrasts, and purify grayish or dirty colors, making the colors present a gentle, childlike, light, and high-end feel. Different photos should naturally result in different color schemes; do not use any fixed preset color cards, and do not forcibly add colors that do not exist in the original image for the sake of a "healing feeling."

Color establishes rhythm through **main color area, auxiliary color layers, homologous light and dark, and a very small amount of vivid point colors**, making the subject look rich but not cluttered, cute but not cloying, soft but spirited. The block material uses a fine matte, soft diffuse reflection texture, with a slight touch like pulp, wood, pastel, or flexible materials, with rounded corners and soft shadows, avoiding plastic highlights, metallic feel, heavy CG, and cheap toy textures.

The text establishes a light, high-end editorial-style micro-typography system, extracting a 2–5 word title from the photo's light and shadow, action, space, emotion, or symbolic meaning, and matching it with a small number of status words, locations, numbers, direction words, or micro-annotations, without using years. Text can be arranged along block edges, module gaps, visual axes, or negative spaces, and can also form interspersing, occlusion, and alignment with the blocks, making the text naturally part of the block composition.

Overall presentation is a visual temperament of **real photography × healing blocks × isometric space × original color translation × high-end editorial design**, gentle, light, childlike, quiet, exquisite, imaginative but not naive. Whether the subject is a person, animal, plant, building, object, food, vehicle, or natural landscape, it should develop a unique block combination and color scheme from the original image's own structure and colors, avoiding fixed color cards, Lego-style copying, children's cartoons, e-commerce toy display feel, and template feel.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体结构、空间关系、真实材质、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览摄影质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的**主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系**，按照“解构—筛选—提炼—重构”的逻辑，转化为具有 **3D / isometric 空间感的治愈系积木雕塑**。重点保留主体最独特的体量比例、轴线、曲线、穿插、层叠、遮挡与负空间，以圆润、简洁、具有触感的模块化体块重新组织；不完整复刻细节，但必须一眼感受到与上方原图的对应。

构图根据主体自身的视觉重心、姿态方向和空间关系自适应设计，通过大小体块、高低错层、前后穿插、局部悬浮、疏密变化与大面积留白建立节奏。积木可以拼接、叠放、嵌套、穿越或自然错位，使主体既保留身份，又具有当代艺术玩具般的雕塑感和轻松想象力，避免机械拆件和简单像素化。

**配色必须从上方原图本身分析产生。** 先识别照片中最有生命力、最有辨识度的主色关系，以及综合色温、明度层级、冷暖呼应和关键点色，再将这些颜色重新调制为更柔和、清澈、明亮、有空气感的治愈色彩体系。保留原图的色相身份与情绪记忆，但适度提高明度、降低刺眼对比、净化灰脏杂色，使颜色呈现温柔、童趣、轻盈而高级的感觉。不同照片应自然得到不同配色，不固定使用任何预设色卡，也不要为了“治愈感”强行加入原图不存在的颜色。

色彩通过**主色面积、辅助色层次、同源深浅与极少量鲜活点色**建立节奏，让主体看起来丰富但不杂乱、可爱但不甜腻、柔和但有精气神。积木材质采用细腻哑光、柔和漫反射的质感，带轻微纸浆、木质、粉蜡或柔性材料般的触感，边角圆润、阴影轻柔，避免塑料高光、金属感、厚重CG和廉价玩具质感。

文字建立轻盈的高级编辑式微排版系统，从照片的光影、动作、空间、情绪或象征意义中提炼一个2–5词的标题，并搭配少量状态词、地点、编号、方向词或微型注释，不使用年份。文字可沿积木边缘、模块缝隙、视觉轴线或负空间排列，也可与体块形成穿插、遮挡与对齐，让文字自然成为积木构图的一部分。

整体呈现 **真实摄影 × 治愈积木 × isometric空间 × 原图色彩转译 × 高级编辑设计** 的视觉气质，温柔、轻盈、童趣、安静、精致、有想象力但不幼稚。无论主体是人物、动物、植物、建筑、器物、食物、交通工具或自然景观，都应从原图自身的结构与色彩中发展出独特的积木组合和配色方式，避免固定色卡、乐高式复制、儿童卡通、电商玩具展示感和模板感。

items.title: 实景背景可爱手绘涂鸦人物转换

prompts.text:
Transform ONLY the people in the uploaded photo into adorable hand-drawn doodle characters while keeping the original photographic background unchanged.

CORE RULE:
Background = original realistic photo.
People = cute hand-drawn doodle characters.

PRESERVE THE BACKGROUND:
Keep the original sky, landscape, buildings, water, furniture, ground, plants, railings, objects, lighting, colors, perspective, camera angle, framing, and textures as close to the original photo as possible.

Do NOT redraw, simplify, illustrate, or apply doodle/crayon/pencil effects to the background or environmental objects.

TRANSFORM ONLY PEOPLE:
Replace each person with a charming, naive doodle version while preserving:
- exact number of people
- original position and relative scale
- front/back/side/three-quarter orientation
- head and body direction
- pose and gesture
- arm and leg positions
- interactions with people or objects
- hairstyle, clothing colors, and major accessories

IMPORTANT:
If someone faces away, keep them back-facing.
If sideways, keep them sideways.
If facing forward, keep them forward.
Never rotate a person toward the viewer or invent a face that is not visible.

CUTE DOODLE STYLE:
Freely reinterpret realistic anatomy into an adorable, imperfect character:
- oversized round head
- tiny compact body
- short simplified arms and legs
- tiny hands and feet
- cute awkward proportions
- loose scribbled hair
- tiny dot eyes and simple facial features when visible
- rosy scribbled cheeks when appropriate

Keep the original pose recognizable, but simplify and slightly exaggerate it for cuteness.

DRAWING STYLE:
Loose naive hand-drawn doodle, like a quick children's sketch.
Use thin shaky black outlines, imperfect shapes, overlapping sketch lines, scribbled colored-pencil or crayon fills, uneven coloring, white gaps, and slightly messy edges.

The character should look intentionally roughly drawn but extremely cute.

OBJECTS:
Objects, furniture, scenery, and items around the people should remain photographic whenever possible. A doodle character may naturally touch or hold a real photographic object.

INTEGRATION:
Keep correct scale, ground contact, depth, and occlusion so the doodle characters naturally occupy the same locations as the original people.

FINAL LOOK:
It should feel like the real people were removed from the original photograph and replaced with adorable little hand-drawn doodle versions of themselves, while the real-world background remained untouched.

Prioritize:
1. Original photographic background
2. Person position and scale
3. Exact body orientation
4. Pose and gesture
5. Cute exaggerated doodle character design

Avoid full-image illustration, background doodling, realistic anatomy, anime, manga, 3D cartoon, polished digital art, vector lines, changed poses, changed orientation, added people, or invented faces.

prompts.text:
仅将上传照片中的人物转换为可爱的可爱手绘涂鸦角色，同时保持原始摄影背景不变。

核心规则：
背景 = 原始写实照片。
人物 = 可爱的手绘涂鸦角色。

保留背景：
尽可能保持原始天空、景观、建筑、水、家具、地面、植物、栏杆、物体、照明、颜色、透视、相机角度、构图和纹理与原始照片一致。

请勿对背景或环境物体进行重新绘制、简化、插图化或应用涂鸦/蜡笔/铅笔效果。

仅转换人物：
将每个人替换为迷人的、天真的涂鸦版本，同时保留：
- 确切的人数
- 原始位置和相对比例
- 正面/背面/侧面/四分之三侧面朝向
- 头部和身体方向
- 姿势和手势
- 手臂和腿部位置
- 与人或物体的互动
- 发型、服装颜色和主要配件

重要提示：
如果有人背对，请保持背对。
如果是侧向，请保持侧向。
如果是面向前方，请保持面向前方。
切勿将人转向观众或捏造不可见的脸。

可爱涂鸦风格：
自由地将写实解剖结构重新诠释为可爱的、不完美的角色：
- 超大的圆头
- 娇小紧凑的身体
- 短小简化的手臂和腿
- 细小的手和脚
- 可爱笨拙的比例
- 随意涂鸦的头发
- 可见时使用细小的点状眼睛和简单的面部特征
- 适当处使用涂鸦般的红润脸颊

保持原始姿势可辨认，但为了可爱而简化并略微夸张。

绘图风格：
随意天真的手绘涂鸦，就像儿童的快速素描。
使用细而不稳的黑色轮廓、不完美的形状、重叠的素描线条、乱涂的彩色铅笔或蜡笔填充、不均匀的着色、白色的缝隙以及略显凌乱的边缘。

角色看起来应该是故意画得粗糙但极其可爱。

物体：
人物周围的物体、家具、风景和物品应尽可能保持摄影效果。涂鸦角色可以自然地触摸或握住真实的摄影物体。

融合：
保持正确的比例、地面接触、深度和遮挡，使涂鸦角色自然地占据与原始人物相同的位置。

最终外观：
感觉就像原始照片中的真人被移除，并替换为他们自己的可爱手绘涂鸦版本，而现实世界的背景保持不变。

优先顺序：
1. 原始摄影背景
2. 人物位置和比例
3. 准确的身体朝向
4. 姿势和手势
5. 可爱夸张的涂鸦角色设计

避免：全图插画、背景涂鸦、写实解剖、动漫、漫画、3D卡通、精致的数字艺术、矢量线条、改变姿势、改变朝向、增加人数或捏造面孔。

items.title: 高层窗边黑与白泳装女性肖像

prompts.text:
Theme:
By the window of a high-rise, black and white

Subject:
A woman sitting sideways on a bed by the window in the center of the frame, gazing at the city streetscape on the left side of the frame. Wearing a black one-piece swimsuit, with a white see-through shawl draped over her.

Character/Expression:
The face is turned two-thirds to the left of the frame, quietly staring out the window, with lips slightly parted. A slightly elongated oval face with a slender chin, long narrow eyes with long eyelashes, thin straight eyebrows, a straight bridge of the nose, a small nose tip, and lustrous light coral lips. The hairstyle is a center-parted line, long see-through bangs, and dark brown long curly hair reaching below the chest.

Clothing/Pose:
A black one-piece swimsuit paired with a white chiffon long-sleeved shawl. The swimsuit features thin straps, a deep V-neckline, small ruffles at the edges, a black ribbon at the center of the chest, gathers at the side of the waist, and long adjustment ties. The shawl is an open-front design, with the cuffs flaring out in two tiers. Sitting with legs bent to the side, the left hand is supporting on the bed, and the right hand is placed on the right thigh.

Background/Lighting:
The left side of the frame features a large black-framed window and a blurred high-rise city/mountain view, the right side features white tulle curtains, and the bottom features light gray bedding and pillows. Soft diffused light filters in from the window and curtain side on the right of the frame, illuminating the skin and white fabric, creating a strong contrast of light and dark with the black swimsuit.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical 3:4 ratio, an upper thigh portrait shot from a horizontal camera angle at the same height as the bed. The character occupies most of the space from the center to the right, the bent legs are cut off at the bottom, and the scenery outside the window becomes the negative space on the left. Focus is concentrated on the character's face and clothing, while the streetscape is smoothly blurred with a shallow depth of field.

Texture/Style:

上身穿黑色极简挂脖连体衣，柔软哑光弹力面料，颈部两侧宽肩带向后绕颈，前胸采用非常深的窄 V 形领口，从颈部一路向下延伸至腹部上方，左右衣片形成简洁锐利的黑色轮廓；连体衣紧贴腰腹与胯部，强调纤细腰线和自然身体曲线。下身搭配黑色半透明细网格丝袜，从胯部连续覆盖整个双腿和双脚，丝袜具有均匀细密的菱形/交叉网格纹理，透出自然肤色；纹理必须连续贴合腿部三维曲面，在膝盖、大腿和脚部自然发生透视变化，不出现断裂、漂浮或错误图案。

场景是一条光线较暗的现代公寓更衣区/衣帽间走廊，地面为深棕近黑色的大尺寸木纹地板。人物身后与右侧排列黑色金属框架的大面积深色玻璃衣柜门，玻璃表面具有真实反射，可隐约映出人物背影、走廊结构和室内物品，但反射不要生成额外人物。左侧为浅米灰色墙面和深色柜体边缘。人物下方铺着不规则灰白、棕灰相间的柔软长毛皮草地毯，毛绒质感明显，与深色地面形成反差。走廊深处可见少量杂乱的浅色织物或家居物品，使空间保持真实居住感。

整体采用夜间室内手机直闪摄影效果：环境曝光偏暗，近距离闪光灯直接照亮人物面部、胸肩、手臂和双腿，在白皙皮肤上形成明亮而略硬的高光，同时背景迅速落入深色阴影。玻璃柜门产生微弱闪光反射，地板保留暗部细节。整体色调以黑色、深棕、暖肤色和灰白色为主，具有轻微高 ISO 数码噪点和真实手机照片质感，不使用电影级布光。

高清照片级细节，人物五官、发丝、皮肤、黑色面料、丝袜细网格以及皮毛地毯纹理清晰可辨；保持真实抓拍感，不要影棚写真感、CG感、动漫感、过度磨皮、夸张锐化、鱼眼畸变、极端腿长、错误透视、多余人物、错误镜像、重复肢体、畸形手脚、多余手指、丝袜纹理断裂、水印或乱码文字。

items.title: 影像衍生品牌包装视觉识别海报

prompts.text: Please turn each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-photo stitching, each photo output individually. The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout, with the upper and lower areas strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the frame. The upper half preserves the original photo, maintaining the subject identity, structure, posture, realistic texture, natural lighting, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end photographic color grading to give it the texture of art magazines, independent publications, and exhibition photography. To adapt to the frame, the sky, ground, or environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed. The lower half extracts the most recognizable subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, transforming it into a complete brand packaging and material visual system. Do not simply copy the photo; instead, refine the subject's characteristics into reusable core graphics, illustration symbols, patterns, color blocks, or identification elements, and then apply them to packaging carriers of different sizes and purposes, making all materials instantly belong to the same visual family. Automatically select the most suitable 5–8 carriers based on the original image's theme, such as paper bags, packaging boxes, gift sets, labels, tags, tickets, cards, stickers, sleeves, cup packaging, key pendants, wrapping paper, or other related materials, without forcing the use of fixed categories. Use 1–2 main packages as the visual focus, with the remaining materials forming modular combinations based on size, horizontal/vertical ratios, and function; use a clear grid, edge alignment, scale contrast, spacing rhythm, and large areas of white space to organize the frame, like a professional brand design studio's packaging identity presentation board, rather than product displays or messy mockup collages. The color palette remains soft, transparent, and slightly desaturated in high-end tones, mainly light pink-blue, mist blue, sky blue, and airy cool-toned blue, paired with ivory white, cream white, light beige, soft gray-green, and architectural neutral colors, using only a small amount of dusty rose or muted blush as visual accents. Different packaging can change the color area and combination method, but must maintain the same color system to form a rich yet unified sense of series. The material emphasizes realistic and exquisite paper and packaging craftsmanship, showing matte paper, fine-grained paper, thick cardstock, translucent paper, embossing, die-cutting, folding, stickers, partial printing, and slight layering relationships; lighting is soft and natural, only used to express paper thickness, creases, and material differences, avoiding plastic feel, strong reflections, exaggerated 3D, and cheap product rendering. Text is also designed uniformly as part of the entire packaging system. Extract a short English main title from the subject's name, theme, mood, function, or symbolic meaning of the original image, and extend a very small amount of sub-titles, short sentences, numbers, category names, or micro-descriptions. Text can change naturally according to different carriers: vertically arranged on tags, extending along packaging edges, surrounding circular labels, crossing box surfaces, hidden between graphics, or becoming part of the packaging closure structure, so that fonts, graphics, and materials together form a complete brand language, rather than repeating the same title on every item. The overall presentation is a high-end brand packaging system / visual identity proposal board: rich but not crowded, lively but orderly, showing both the complete series and the design logic between graphics, text, materials, and different carriers. Whether the original image is a person, animal, plant, architecture, object, food, vehicle, or natural landscape, a unique packaging language should be established from the original image itself, avoiding fixed product combinations, repetitive templates, e-commerce display feel, and ordinary brand mockup templates.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体身份、结构、姿态、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览摄影质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展天空、地面或环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，将其转化为一套完整的品牌包装与物料视觉系统。不要简单复制照片，而是把主体特征提炼成可重复使用的核心图形、插画符号、纹样、色块或识别元素，再分别应用到不同尺寸和用途的包装载体中，使所有物料一眼属于同一个视觉家族。

根据原图主题自动选择最合适的 5–8 种载体，例如纸袋、包装盒、套盒、标签、吊牌、票券、卡片、贴纸、封套、杯具包装、钥匙挂件、包装纸或其他相关物料，不强行使用固定品类。以 1–2 个主包装作为视觉重心，其余物料按大小、横竖比例和功能形成模块化组合；使用清晰网格、边缘对齐、尺度反差、间距节奏和大面积留白组织画面，像专业品牌设计工作室的 packaging identity presentation board，而不是商品陈列或杂乱 mockup 拼贴。

配色保持柔和、通透、略微去饱和的高级色系，以浅粉蓝、雾蓝、天空蓝、空气感冷调蓝为主，搭配象牙白、奶油白、浅米色、柔和灰绿和建筑中性色，仅用少量 dusty rose 或 muted blush 作为视觉跳点。不同包装可以改变颜色面积和组合方式，但必须保持同一套色彩系统，形成丰富而统一的系列感。

材质强调真实而精致的纸张与包装工艺，可表现哑光纸、细纹纸、厚卡、半透明纸、压纹、模切、折叠、贴纸、局部印刷与轻微层叠关系；光线柔和自然，只用于表现纸张厚度、折痕和材质差异，避免塑料感、强反光、夸张3D和廉价商品渲染。

文字也作为整个包装系统的一部分统一设计。从原图的主体名称、主题、情绪、功能或象征意义中提炼一个简短英文主标题，并延展出极少量副标题、短句、编号、品类名称或微型说明。文字可以根据不同载体自然变化：竖排于吊牌、沿包装边缘延伸、环绕圆形标签、跨越盒面、隐藏在图形之间或成为包装封口结构的一部分，使字体、图形和材质共同形成完整品牌语言，而不是每件物料重复贴上同一个标题。

整体呈现为一张高级品牌包装系统 / 视觉识别提案板：丰富但不拥挤，活泼但有秩序，既展示完整系列，也能看到图形、文字、材质与不同载体之间的设计逻辑。无论原图是人物、动物、植物、建筑、器物、食物、交通工具或自然景观，都应从原图本身建立独特的包装语言，避免固定产品组合、重复模板、电商展示感和普通品牌 mockup 套版。

items.title: 南国度假村泳池畔日系女性人像摄影

prompts.text:
Subject:
In a southern resort by the pool, a fictional adult Japanese woman is sitting alone on a white lounge chair. She leans her upper body toward the close-up camera, smiling slightly. Long dark brown hair, wearing a white open-work knit cover-up, and a light green floral pattern swimsuit. Against the background of bright water and deck, created as a 9:16 vertical composition intimacy resort portrait. Condensing the face, the tie on the chest, the bent knee, and the blue of the pool into one moment.

Location, Time, Background:
A clear day, an outdoor pool along a wooden deck. Behind the character to the right are vibrant light blue water, white railings, thick green plants, palm leaves, and light beige buildings softly visible. On the left is the back of a white lounge chair, and warm wood grain extends at the bottom of the frame. Ripples on the water surface and dappled tree shadows show a peaceful afternoon at the resort.

Clothing and Accessories:
A spaghetti strap light green floral bikini, and a white embroidery lace or crochet style long-sleeved cover-up. The front-opening white fabric is tied tightly at the chest with a thin string, featuring detailed open-work patterns, embroidered edges, and a loose drape on the sleeves. The small leaf floral pattern of the swimsuit is faintly visible through the white fabric, clearly showing the ties, fabric thickness, and shadows falling on the skin. No accessories are highlighted.

Pose, Fingers, Contact:
Sitting on a lounge chair, the upper body leans diagonally toward the camera, with one knee significantly bent and placed at the bottom right of the frame. Shoulders and face tilt in the same direction, one arm placed inside the body, and the other arm naturally touching the seat surface or thigh. The white fabric on the chest creates folds and openings due to the forward lean, and hair touches the shoulders, arms, and fabric, casting thin shadows. Naturally maintain the continuity of legs, waist, ribcage, and neck.

Expression and Gaze:
Pupils looking directly at the camera, greeting gently with a slight smile with closed lips. The head is slightly tilted, cheeks and corners of the mouth are softly raised, creating an intimacy as if sharing a secret with the other person by the pool. Do not squint excessively, do not laugh loudly or fake smile, maintain a calm direct gaze even in bright sunlight.

Face and Makeup:
Refreshing oval face, natural brown eyebrows, dark brown pupils, thin straight nose bridge, pale pink lips. Apply thin beige and short eyeliner to the upper eyelids, lashes are delicate bundles, and cheeks are dotted with transparent rose tones. Create soft luster on the forehead, nose, cheekbones, and lower lip, retaining pores, fine peach fuzz, and small shadows around the eyes to complete a natural skin texture.

Hair:
Long dark brown hair reaching below the chest. Thin bangs fall diagonally across the forehead, left hair flows behind the shoulder, and right hair flows like waves toward the chest and arm. The surface reflects subtle reddish-brown due to sunlight, and the inner side is deep caramel to create thickness. Hair ends do not appear too wet, softly gathered by wind and shoulder contact.

Light Source:
Using bright natural light from the upper right of the frame as the main light source, highlights are placed on the hair surface, forehead, nose, shoulders, white lace, and knees. The pool water and white lounge chair reflect bluish-white light, illuminating the area under the chin and the skin on the shadow side; soft shadows are retained inside the hair, on the chest, and where fabric overlaps. Create small catchlights of the sky and water reflections in the pupils.

Color and Tone:
Combining white, water blue, pale green, woody brown, dark green of plants, and bright beige of skin. The water surface gradients from turquoise to cyan, white fabric from pure white to light gray, hair smoothly transitions from blackish-brown to reddish-brown. Maintain high brightness at noon while ensuring highlights on skin and white fabric are not overexposed, and do not process the pool's blue into a fluorescent color.

Material and Fine Texture:
Depicting the holes of the white open-work knit, embroidery threads, ties, the elasticity of the swimsuit fabric, skin pores and luster, overlapping hair bundles, the matte fabric of the lounge chair, wood grain of the deck, and ripples on the water surface. Lips retain fine vertical lines, pupils show the iris and tear film, and knees retain natural skin light and shade. The transparency of the fabric changes according to overlapping and light direction.

Composition and Lens:
A 9:16 vertical composition sitting close-up resort portrait. The center of the face is placed at approximately 49% of the frame width and 25% from the top, with the line connecting the eyes at approximately 20% from the top. Margin above the head is about 2%, face width is about 52% of the frame width, the visual center of the figure is horizontally about 48%, and the bent knee is at approximately 69% of the frame width and 78% from the top. The lens approaches from slightly above eye level, focusing on the face and chest, using a wide-angle slightly close-up shot. Focus is on pupils, lips, hair, and white ties, with the pool and plants gradually blurring.

Image Processing and Finish:
Possessing brightness suitable for resort advertisements, while retaining natural tones and a small amount of noise from a smartphone shot. Add moderate sharpness to the contours of the face, pupils, hair, lace, ties, and knees, with the background water surface softly glowing. Keep the balance of white and blue neutral, do not over-bleach the skin, and do not create an unnatural cutout feel of the outlines.

Breakdown Avoidance and Prohibitions:
Fixed as the same adult woman, long brown hair, frontal quiet smile, white lace cover-up, light floral swimsuit, leaning forward sitting posture, bottom-right bent knee, white lounge chair, blue pool, wooden deck, southern plants, daylight. Do not add other people, children, or swimmers; do not use clothing more revealing than the original, excessively exaggerated body types, text, logos, watermarks, sunglasses, hats, collages, or CG-ification. Do not change the number of fingers or legs, do not fuse knees and arms, do not break clothing ties, do not collapse lace holes, no abnormal eyeballs or teeth, do not dissolve hair and shoulders, do not distort water lines or railings. Do not create hands or feet outside the frame or invisible swimsuit parts.

prompts.text:
被摄主体：
南国度假村泳池旁，白色的躺椅上坐着一位虚构的成年日本女性，独自一人。她将上身靠近近距离镜头，微微笑着。长长的深棕色头发，穿着白色镂空编织罩衫，淡绿色花卉图案泳衣。以明亮的水面和甲板为背景，制作成9:16竖构图的亲密度假肖像。将脸部、胸前的系带、弯曲的膝盖、泳池的蓝色浓缩在一个瞬间。

地点・时间・背景：
晴朗的白天，沿着木质甲板的室外泳池。人物右侧后方是鲜艳的浅蓝色水面、白色栏杆、浓绿色的植栽、棕榈树叶、浅米色的建筑物柔和可见。左侧有白色躺椅的椅背，画面下方延伸着温暖的木纹。水面的涟漪和树影斑驳，展现出度假村宁静的午后。

服装・配饰：
细肩带浅绿色系花卉比基尼，以及白色刺绣蕾丝或钩针风格的长袖罩衫。前开式的白色布料在胸前用细绳系紧，具有细致的镂空图案、刺绣边饰、袖子的松弛垂感。泳衣的小叶状花纹从白色布料间隐约可见，明确展现系带、布料厚度、落在肌肤上的阴影。不突出任何配饰。

姿势・手指・接触：
坐在躺椅上，上身斜向镜头倾斜，一侧膝盖大幅弯曲置于画面右下方。肩膀和脸朝同一方向倾斜，一侧手臂置于身体内侧，另一侧手臂自然触及坐面或大腿。胸前的白色布料因前倾而产生褶皱和开口，头发触碰肩膀、手臂、布料，投下薄薄的阴影。自然保持腿部、腰部、胸廓、脖子的连贯性。

表情・视线：
瞳孔直视镜头，以闭合嘴唇的浅浅微笑温柔迎接。头部微微倾斜，脸颊和嘴角柔和上扬，营造出像在泳池边与对方分享秘密般的亲近感。不眯眼过度，不大笑或假笑，即使在明亮的日光下也保持平静的直视。

脸部・妆容：
清爽的椭圆形脸、自然棕色眉毛、深棕色瞳孔、细直鼻梁、淡粉色嘴唇。上眼睑施以薄薄的米色和短眼线，睫毛为细腻的束状，脸颊点缀透明的玫瑰色调。在额头、鼻子、颧骨、下唇创造柔和的光泽，保留毛孔、细微汗毛、眼周的小阴影，完成自然的肌肤质感。

头发：
及胸下方的深棕色长发。薄薄的刘海斜向额头落下，左侧头发流向肩后，右侧头发波浪般流向胸前和手臂。表面因阳光反射出细微的红棕色，内侧为深焦糖色营造厚度。发梢不显过湿，受风和肩部接触而柔和收拢。

光源：
以画面右上方明亮的自然光为主光源，在头发表面、额头、鼻子、肩膀、白色蕾丝、膝盖置入高光。泳池水面和白色躺椅反射出青白色的光，照亮下巴下方和阴影侧的肌肤；在头发内侧、胸前、布料重叠处保留柔和阴影。在瞳孔中营造天空和水面反射的小型捕捉光。

颜色・色调：
结合白色、水蓝色、淡绿色、木质棕色、植栽深绿、肌肤明亮米色。水面从绿松石渐变至青色，白色布料从纯白至浅灰，头发从黑褐色平滑过渡至红棕色。保持中午的高亮度，同时不让肌肤和白色布料的高光过曝，不将泳池的蓝色处理成荧光色。

材质・细微质感：
描绘白色镂空编织的孔洞、刺绣线、系带、泳衣布料的弹性、肌肤的毛孔与光泽、头发束的重叠、躺椅的哑光布料、甲板的木纹、水面的波纹。嘴唇保留细微竖纹，瞳孔展现虹膜和泪膜，膝盖保留自然的皮肤明暗。布料的透视感根据重叠和光线方向而变化。

构图・镜头：
9:16竖构图的坐姿近距离度假肖像。脸部中心置于画面宽度的约49%、上端约25%、双眼连线置于上端约20%。头部上方余白约2%，脸宽约画面宽度的52%，人物视觉中心横向约48%，弯曲膝盖置于画面宽度的约69%、上端约78%。镜头从眼睛高度稍上方靠近，以脸部和胸前为中心，使用广角偏近摄取。焦点对准瞳孔、嘴唇、头发、白色系带，泳池和植栽逐步虚化。

图像处理・完成：
具备可用于度假广告的明亮度，同时保留智能手机拍摄的自然色调和少量噪点。对脸部、瞳孔、头发、蕾丝、系带、膝盖轮廓添加适度锐度，背景水面柔和发光。保持白色和蓝色的平衡中立，不过度美白肌肤，不产生轮廓的不自然抠图感。

崩溃回避・禁止：

prompts.text:
Subject:
On outdoor grey stairs, photographing a fictional adult Japanese woman, she leans down, looking down below—in this subject image, the finished frame is vertical 9:16, using a single independent photo; only one protagonist, no left-right flipping of the person, replacement with others, clothing changes, or background reorganization; preserve natural resolution like smartphone shooting, slight close-up perspective difference, and incompleteness of instantaneous composition; do not replace the ethnic appearance of the person with other characteristics, but present with an identifiable natural styling of a Japanese woman. A young adult over 20 years old, a natural moment of adjusting posture supported by hands during movement. Visible from the top of the head to the upper part of the shorts, both arms, and parts of the hands. The area below the stairs, toes, building use, surrounding people, etc., are all generated outside the frame.

Location, Time, Background:
Composed of grey outdoor stairs, horizontal lines of steps, and a bright wall or handrail surface on the right—in the depth of this scene, the time period is limited to the range interpreted from the frame's light, without adding new objects determined to be morning, noon, or night; maintain the overlapping of foreground, midground, and background, ensuring the background does not unnaturally bend along the person's silhouette; background information is more low-key than the person but is not replaced by monochrome blur; do not generate unconfirmable windows, doors, signs, furniture, pedestrians, vehicles, scenery, or reflections within the frame. Sunlight enters from above, with light and shadow on the edges of the steps and the wall. The perspective of the stairs and the number of steps are kept only within the visible range of the frame and are not replaced with other locations.

Clothing and Accessories:
A light beige to grey-beige sleeveless rib-knit top and light blue denim shorts—in this outfit reproduction, align fabric seams, openings, shoulder or chest boundaries, overlaps, and stretching directions with the pose; do not make changes that increase exposure or emphasize sexiness. The top fits the body, preserving vertical ribs and shoulder edges. Do not add accessories, bags, or hats; fix the clothing type, color, and length. Shorts only show the waist and hem parts, without forcibly adding pockets or metal parts.

Pose, Fingers, Contact:
The upper body leans forward, both arms extend downward, hands supported near the stairs or knees—in the continuity of this action, the thickness of the arms and the positions of the joints are consistent on the left and right, without adding extra elbows or wrists. Shoulder height and elbow angles differ slightly on the left and right, with the center of gravity at the front of the body. The neck and back are connected with natural curves, without changing the depth of the crouch, and without modifying it to a standing or sitting posture.

Expression and Gaze:
The face is slightly downward, and the gaze also falls toward the feet or hands—in this sense of distance and emotion, integrate the pupil direction, upper eyelid, lower eyelid, eyebrows, cheeks, and mouth as one emotional whole; do not add emotions or stories to the expression that cannot be confirmed by the image. The mouth is relaxed, not a smile, but does not show fatigue or displeasure. Preserve the weight of the eyelids, the quiet shadows on the cheeks, and the moment just before looking up. Do not change to looking at the camera, blinking, a toothy smile, a crying face, or a provocative expression.

Face and Makeup:
A small oval face, gentle forehead and cheeks, slender jawline. Skin is a bright neutral beige, with elegant warm tones under the sunlight on the right. Eyebrows are a natural dark brown shape, pupils are downward, preserving the part covered by the upper eyelid. The bridge of the nose is thin and straight, lips are pale rose-beige, lightly closed. The front face remains unchanged, do not widen the eyes, avoid heavy makeup or porcelain-like skin.

Hair:
Thick deep dark brown hair tied low behind the head, preserving sparse bangs and sideburns—in this reproduction of hair flow, hair strands are not filled with single-line depictions but are overlaid with hair bundles of different thicknesses, a sense of wholeness, shadows, and a small amount of flying strands; the boundary with the scalp is natural, and bangs do not invade the eyebrows or pupils; the boundary with the background does not produce cut-out white edges or fusion, and only restrained light transmission and luster are placed on the light source side. When leaning forward, thin hair bundles fall near the cheeks, and the silhouette under the sunlight presents a soft luster. The hair tie and hair length are limited to the visible range, and long hair is not added to the back.

Light Source:
Natural sunlight from the upper right of the frame is the main light source—in this lighting design, the direction of light falling on the skin, hair, fabric, and background is all consistent; place natural shadows on the opposite side of the main light source under the nose, under the chin, inside the hair, and at clothing overlaps, ensuring shadow tones are not muddy. The hair silhouette, right cheek, right shoulder, arm, and stair edges are bright, while the left face and body retain soft shadows. The stairs and walls reflect faint light but do not flatly lift the dark areas. Do not change to front flash, sunset, neon, or studio multi-light lighting.

Color and Tone:
A low-saturation color scheme consisting of grey-beige, light denim blue, concrete grey, natural warm skin tones, and thick tea-colored hair—in this color scheme and tone, preserve the gradients of highlights, midtones, and shadows to prevent skin overexposure, hair clogging, and loss of clothing texture; the white balance matches the main light source, without destroying the color relationship between the skin, white-colored fabrics, and grey background; do not overall increase saturation or sharpness, creating the tone of a natural smartphone photo. Highlights are warm, shadows are slightly cool. The top does not lean toward pure white or yellow, and the denim is not changed to a vivid blue.

Material and Subtle Texture:
Skin pores, fine vellus hair, subtle shadows on arms, and lip lines are preserved—in this texture design, do not attach uniform particles to the skin, but change pore visibility based on bright parts and shadows; avoid extreme JPEG compression distortion, while not pursuing commercial CG-like perfection, but rather preserving the subtle graininess of a natural shoot. Hair shows both back hair and bundles. Vertical grooves of the rib knit, weave and stitching of the denim, powdery unevenness of the concrete, and wear on the steps are distinguished. Details in the sunlight parts are not overexposed, and shadow noise is not completely eliminated.

Composition and Camera:
Finished frame is vertical 9:16—in this frame configuration, calculated as 100% width and 100% height, fix the center of the face at 49-51% horizontal, the line connecting the eyes at 27-32% of the upper end, head-top margin at 3-7%, and the overall visual center of the person at 45-55% horizontal; the head and hair are at least 4% from the left and right edges, the face height accounts for about 18-25% of the frame height, and from the top of the head to the lowest visible part of the lower body is contained within 88-96% of the frame height; the depth of field is such that the face and main clothing are clear, and the background is gently softened. Captured vertically with a smartphone from a position higher than the woman's head, tilted diagonally downward. Naturally present the depth extending from the face, shoulders, arms, top, and shorts. The main focus is placed on the face and upper body, with the stairs slightly softened. Preserve the slight parallax of close-up shooting but avoid fisheye distortion where the head or hands bulge.

Image Processing and Completion:
The atmosphere of the scene where the woman in a light-colored top on the outdoor stairs is supporting herself with her hands and looking down is not damaged, so first adjust the low-frequency large blocks of light and dark, then adjust the medium shapes of the face, clothing, and background, and finally fine-tune subtle elements such as hair strands or cloth patterns—in this photo-like completion, the completion level is a real-shot smartphone photo; suppress chromatic aberration, false colors, halos, and double outlines, preserving natural lens softness; the tone curve is rich in midtones, not clipping black or white ends; unify the light, color, texture, and graininess of the entire frame.

Collapse Avoidance and Prohibitions:
Fix the same adult woman, same tied hair, downward gaze expression, leaning forward pose, arm positions, beige top, light denim, stair configuration, upper right light, color, and texture—to protect this finished image, do not generate extra faces, eyes, ears, arms, hands, fingers, legs, shadows, or reflected images; absolutely do not add text, numbers, subtitles, logos, brands, watermarks, signatures, or border lines; do not change the same woman, face shape, age sense, hairstyle, clothing, pose, contact, background configuration, camera position, light source, color, material, or completion; do not flip the body or clothing left and right. Do not turn the face to the front, do not damage fingers, elbows, shoulders, clothing edges, or stair perspective. Do not add extra people, hands, fingers, bags, text, logos, or watermarks. Do not create legs, shoes, or surrounding landscapes outside the frame.

prompts.text:
被摄主体：
在室外的灰色楼梯上，拍摄一位虚构的成年日本女性，她弯下身子，低头看着下方——在这个被摄主体形象中，完成画面为纵向9:16，采用单张独立照片；主角仅一人，不进行人物左右翻转、替换成他人、服装变更、背景重组；保留如同智能手机拍摄般的自然分辨率、近距离的轻微远近差、瞬间构图的不完整性；不将人物的民族外貌替换为其他特征，而是以日本人女性可辨识的自然造型呈现。20岁以上的年轻成人，在移动途中用手支撑调整姿势的自然瞬间。从头顶到短裤上部、双臂和部分手部可见。楼梯下方、脚尖、建筑物用途、周围人等均置于画面外生成。

地点・时间・背景：
灰色的室外楼梯、台阶的水平线、右侧的明亮墙壁或扶手面构成——在这个场景的深度中，时间段仅限于从画面光线解读的范围，不添加断定为早晨、中午、夜晚的新景物；维持前景・中景・背景的重叠，确保背景不沿人物轮廓不自然弯曲；背景信息比人物更低调，但不替换为单色模糊；画面内不生成无法确认的窗户、门、标牌、家具、行人、车辆、景色、反射。上方阳光照入，台阶边缘和墙面有明暗。楼梯的透视和台阶数仅保留画面可见范围，不替换为其他地点。

服装・小物：
明亮的米色至灰米色的无袖罗纹针织上衣，以及浅蓝色的牛仔短裤——在这个装束再现中，将布料的缝合线、开口部、肩部或胸口的边界、重叠、拉伸方向与姿势一致；不进行增加暴露或性感强调的变更。上衣贴合身体，保留纵向罗纹和肩周边缘。不添加配饰、包、帽子，固定服装种类、颜色、长度。短裤仅显示腰部和下摆部分，不强行添加口袋或金属部件。

姿势・手指・接触：
上身向前倾倒，双臂向下伸展，手撑在楼梯或膝盖附近——在这个动作的连贯性中，可见手臂的粗细和关节位置左右一致，不额外增加肘部或手腕。肩部高度和肘部角度左右略有差异，重心位于身体前方。颈部和背部以自然曲线连接，不改变蹲伏深度，不修改为直立或坐姿。

表情・视线：
脸部略微向下，视线也落在脚下或手部方向——在这个距离感和情感中，将瞳孔方向、上眼睑、下眼睑、眉毛、脸颊、嘴部作为一个情感整合；不向表情添加图像无法确认的情感或故事。嘴部放松，不是笑容，但不表现出疲劳或不悦。保留眼睑的重量感、脸颊的静谧阴影，以及下一刻即将抬头的一瞬。不改为注视镜头、眨眼、露齿笑容、哭脸、挑逗表情。

脸部・妆容：
小巧的卵形脸、平缓的额头和脸颊、细长的下巴线。皮肤为明亮的 neutral 米色，右侧阳光下带有淡雅的暖色调。眉毛为深褐色的自然形状，瞳孔向下，保留上眼睑遮盖的部分。鼻梁细直，嘴唇为淡玫瑰米色，轻闭。正面脸不变，不睁大眼睛，避免浓妆或瓷器般的肌肤。

头发：
浓深暗褐色的头发在脑后低低扎起，保留稀疏的刘海和鬓角后发——在这个发丝流动再现中，发丝不以单根描绘填充，而是叠加粗细不同的发束、整体感、阴影、少量飞散发丝；与头皮的边界自然，刘海不侵入眉毛或瞳孔；与背景的边界不产生抠图白边或融合，光源侧仅放置克制的透光和光泽。前倾时细发束落在脸颊附近，阳光下的轮廓呈现柔和光泽。发结和头发长度仅限于可见范围，不添加长发至背部。

光源：
画面右上方自然阳光为主光源——在这个照明设计中，皮肤、头发、布料、背景落光方向全部一致；鼻下、下巴下、头发内侧、衣物重叠处放置主光源反侧的自然阴影，确保阴影色调不浑浊。头发轮廓、右脸颊、右肩、臂部、楼梯边缘明亮，左侧脸部和身体保留柔和阴影。楼梯和墙壁反射微弱光线，但不平坦提升暗部。不改为正面闪光、日落、霓虹、摄影棚多灯照明。

颜色・色调：
灰米色、淡牛仔蓝、混凝土灰、皮肤自然暖色、头发浓茶构成的低饱和度配色——在这个配色和色调中，保留明部、中间调、暗部的渐层，防止皮肤过曝、头发堵塞、衣物质感消失；白平衡匹配主光源，不破坏皮肤、白系布料、灰色背景的色关系；不整体提升饱和度或清晰度，营造自然智能手机照片的色调。明部温暖，阴影略带冷调。上衣不偏向纯白或黄色，牛仔不改为鲜艳蓝色。

材质・细微质感：
皮肤毛孔、细绒毛、臂部细微阴影、嘴唇细线保留——在这个质感设计中，不向皮肤贴附均匀颗粒，根据明亮部分和阴影改变毛孔可见度；避免JPEG极端压缩失真，同时不追求商业CG般的完美无缺，而是保留自然拍摄的细微颗粒感。头发同时显示后发和发束。罗纹针织的纵向凹槽、牛仔的织纹和缝合、混凝土的粉状不均、台阶的磨损加以区分。阳光部分的细节不致过曝，阴影噪点不完全消除。

构图・相机：
完成画面为纵向9:16——在这个画面配置中，以画面宽度100%、高度100%计，将脸部中心固定在横向49〜51%、连接双眼的线在上端27〜32%、头顶余白3〜7%、人物整体视觉中心横向45〜55%；头部和头发至少距左右端4%，脸部高度约占画面高度18〜25%、从头顶到可见下半身最下端收纳在画面高度88〜96%；景深程度为脸部和主要衣物清晰，背景温和柔化。以智能手机从女性头部更高位置靠近，斜向下方的纵向拍摄。自然呈现脸部、肩部、臂部、上衣、短裤延伸的深度。主要焦点置于脸部和上半身，楼梯略微柔化。保留近摄的轻微远近差，但避免头部或手部膨胀的鱼眼失真。

图像处理・完成：

prompts.text:
Task: Image Generation
Aspect Ratio: 9:16

Style:
Photography: Natural iPhone photo
Camera Shake: Slight camera shake
Realism: Everyday and natural snapshot photo
Snapshot Feel: Not a posed photo, but a natural first-person snapshot captured in the middle of interaction during a large group gathering, as if accidentally captured

Scene:
Location: Izakaya table seat
Environment: Ordinary wood-grain izakaya table. Half-eaten food, sharing plates, beer mugs, glasses, chopsticks, mobile phones, small dishes, etc., are naturally scattered. Warm-toned interior lighting, with participants of the same gathering around, slightly lively. Not a one-on-one date, but a natural atmosphere in a corner of a large group gathering
Moment: During a large group gathering, the photographer picks up a bite of food with chopsticks and is about to put it in their own mouth to eat. A woman sitting in the seat directly across the table, with a playful "give me a bite" mood, suddenly stretches her body and neck forward, naturally leaning her upper body toward the table. Bringing her mouth directly close to the food at the tip of the photographer's chopsticks, she takes a bite of the food just like that. The woman herself is not holding chopsticks and eats the food directly from the photographer's chopsticks

Composition:
Camera Position: Natural first-person POV perspective of the photographer sitting at the table seat
Camera Mount Rule: The moment the photographer is holding a smartphone in one hand and chopsticks in the other about to eat food. The smartphone is at a height near the photographer's face or chest, naturally aimed at the woman opposite
Camera Angle: A natural POV composition looking from the photographer's side toward the front of the table. Not an extreme high or low angle, but at the eye level of people sitting
Height Rule: The camera is above the table surface, at a height near the chest to face when the photographer is sitting in a chair. The movement of the woman opposite leaning in is naturally visible
Framing: The foreground of the screen has the photographer's hand and chopsticks, with the chopsticks extending from the center of the screen into the depth. There is a bite-sized piece of food at the tip of the chopsticks, and the woman opposite is putting that bite of food into her mouth to eat. The upper body and face of the woman leaning over the table are shown in large size from the center to the top of the screen
Table Between Rule: An izakaya table must exist between the photographer and the woman. The woman was originally sitting in the seat across the table, not in the seat on the same side as the photographer
Leaning Rule: The woman lifts her waist from the opposite seat or leans her upper body significantly forward while sitting, naturally stretching her body and neck across the table. Her chest to shoulders, neck, and face move closer to the photographer's side
Table Lean Rule: Part of the woman's forearms or hands are resting on the table, a posture of naturally climbing onto the table while supporting her body. Not completely lying on the table, but a natural movement of suddenly leaning in to get a bite of food
Chopsticks Rule: The person holding the chopsticks is the photographer. Only the tip of a pair of chopsticks extending from the photographer's hand holds the food, and the woman eats that food directly
Food Interaction: The moment the photographer is about to eat the food brought to their mouth, but it is bitten off first by the woman opposite. The woman's lips or front teeth touch near the food, and part of the food has already entered her mouth
Mouth Chopstick Relation: The woman does not bite hard on the chopsticks themselves, but naturally takes the food held by the chopsticks into her mouth to eat. The tip of the chopsticks comes just before the woman's mouth, and the food is taken from the chopsticks
Viewer Hand Rule: The photographer's hand holding the chopsticks naturally enters from the foreground of the screen, making it clear who is holding the food. A consistent natural shape from wrist to fingers to chopsticks
Distance Rule: The woman's face is much closer than the usual distance across the table because she is leaning in towards the photographer's chopsticks and smartphone. However, it is not an extreme close-up, but a distance where the table and posture can be understood
Gaze: While putting the food into her mouth, the woman 1 only looks slightly upward at the photographer with her eyes. A natural upturned gaze, with slightly drunken moist eyes and a playful look
Expression Timing: The moment she has just taken the food into her mouth or eaten it in one bite. The mouth is naturally open due to eating the food, but a playful smile of "having stolen it" remains in the eyes and cheeks
Depth Rule: The foremost foreground is the photographer's hand and chopsticks, the middle ground is the food or beer mug on the table, the depth is the woman's face and upper body leaning significantly forward, and in the further background, the izakaya background and other participants are visible
Focus Rule: The main subjects are the woman's face, mouth, and the food at the tip of the chopsticks. The participants in the background and the interior of the store are naturally slightly blurred, only conveying the atmosphere of the gathering
Snapshot Rule: Because the woman suddenly grabs the food, the photographer has no time to perfectly adjust the composition, resulting in a slightly imperfect framing. The chopsticks or hand enter slightly diagonally, and the woman is not perfectly centered horizontally, a natural snapshot

Subjects:
Count: 1
Woman 1: 
- Position: Directly opposite seat across the table from the photographer's POV
- Age: Adult woman in her 20s
- Nationality: Japanese
- Body Type: Standard build
- Skin Tone: Pale skin
- Facial Realism: Asymmetrical, realistic natural face shape
- Skin Details: Very faint freckles on the skin, no excessive skin beautification
- Hair: Natural medium-length hair
- Face Type: Slightly fox-faced
- Clothing: Tank top with a light jacket, natural casual clothes suitable for an izakaya gathering
- Bust Size: D cup
- Drunk Features: Cheeks and tip of the nose slightly flushed due to alcohol, eyes slightly moist, eyelids appearing slightly heavy, a natural drunken expression
- Starting Position: Originally sitting in the seat across the table
- Pose: Leaning the body significantly forward from the opposite seat toward the photographer's side, shoulders and neck stretched forward, leaning across the table. One hand or part of both hands resting on the table to naturally support the body while bringing the face close to the photographer's chopsticks
- Neck Pose: Naturally stretching the neck forward to reach the food, chin slightly lifted. Not just stretching the neck forcedly, but a natural posture linked with the overall forward tilt of the upper body
- Mouth Action: Bringing the mouth close to the bite-sized food on the photographer's chopsticks and biting it off directly from the chopsticks
- Eye Direction: Face moving close to the food, while pupils only look at the photographer in a natural upturned gaze
- Expression: Slightly drunk with flushed cheeks, enjoying the playful expression of stealing food. Eyes are smiling, and the mouth also has a slight smile while eating. Not a "give me" spoiled look, but a playful sense of "stealing" a bite for herself
- Interaction Intent: Taking a bite of the food the photographer was about to eat in a half-joking way, a natural prank between close gathering partners

Details:
POV Feeling: A strong first-person sense of presence where you are about to eat food with chopsticks and the woman directly opposite suddenly stretches over and grabs that bite to eat
Relationship Feeling: A lighthearted playfulness with a close sense of distance that only works because they are close. The woman is not being polite but slightly playful, naturally wanting a bite in the momentum of drunkenness
Group Drinking Context: Not a one-on-one date, but a corner of the same table at a large group gathering. Other participants' bodies, hands, drinks, etc., are partially visible in the surroundings, with a lively atmosphere of conversation and laughter
Mood: Intimate, slightly comedic, drunken playfulness, mischievousness, sudden close distance
Food Detail: Bite-sized izakaya food that can be naturally held with chopsticks. A small piece of fried chicken, tamagoyaki, grilled food, small piece of meat dish, etc., a natural size to eat in one bite directly from chopsticks
Tabletop Details: Half-eaten food, sharing plates, beer mugs, glasses, small dishes, chopstick sleeves, mobile phones, etc., are naturally scattered on the table, slightly messy like in the middle of an actual gathering
Background People: Adult participants of the same gathering are shown in the background or edge of the screen. Not the main characters, only naturally visible to the extent of shoulders, arms, hands holding glasses, etc
Lighting: Warm-toned ordinary izakaya lighting. Skin and wood grain naturally appear warm, no perfect lighting like in advertising photos
Motion: The moment the woman suddenly leans forward, there is a very subtle sense of motion in the tips of her hair, the photographer's chopsticks, the woman's shoulders, etc
Camera Imperfection: Due to the sudden shooting with a smartphone, there is slight camera shake, subtle horizontal deviation, and imperfect framing

Negative Constraints:
- Do not let the woman hold her own chopsticks
- Do not make a composition where the woman eats food with other chopsticks
- Do not remove the photographer's chopsticks from the screen
- Do not completely move the photographer's hand holding the chopsticks out of the frame
- Do not blur the positional relationship between the chopsticks, food, and the woman's mouth
- Do not make a composition where the woman only bites the chopsticks themselves
- Do not let the woman bite the chopsticks without food
- Do not make a composition where the woman eats food from her own plate
- Do not make a composition where the woman sits on the same side as the photographer
- Do not remove the table from between the photographer and the woman
- Do not place the woman right next to the photographer from the beginning
- Do not make a composition where the woman sits normally in a chair and eats from a distance
- Do not weaken the woman's movement of stretching her body forward
- Do not unnaturally stretch only the neck
- Do not let the woman lie completely on the table
- Do not let the woman's whole body get on top of the table
- Do not make a composition where the woman stands up and faces forward
- Do not make a front pose like a commemorative photo
- Do not use an extreme high-angle composition
- Do not use an extreme low angle
- Do not make the woman's face far and small
- Do not make an extreme close-up of the woman's face
- Do not make the upturned gaze into extreme white eyes or unnatural eyeball positions
- Do not let the woman have an expressionless face
- Do not make an angry or unpleasant expression
- Do not make a dead-drunk expression
- Do not eliminate the atmosphere of a large group gathering
- Do not use an empty izakaya background
- Do not make it a one-on-one date photo
- Do not over-beautify the skin
- Do not make the face completely symmetrical
- Do not make it too perfect like a studio shoot or advertising photo
- Do not generate more than 2 pairs of chopsticks
- Do not change the chopsticks to forks or spoons
- Do not add more fingers to the photographer's hand
- Do not add more hands or fingers to the woman
- Do not let the connection of arms, hands, and chopsticks break
- Do not let the food become unnaturally huge
- Do not let the shapes of the mouth, teeth, and chopsticks break

items.title: 极简扁平矢量城市旅行海报设计

prompts.text:
Premium minimalist flat-vector travel poster for [CITY_NAME], 3:4 vertical format.

Design an original, sophisticated travel poster that captures the authentic visual personality of [CITY_NAME]. The composition must feel purpose-built for this city rather than following a reusable template.

CITY IDENTITY

First interpret the unique visual character of [CITY_NAME] and build the scene around these five elements:

1. A recognizable landmark, architectural feature, or skyline element.
2. A distinctive local way of moving through the city.
3. One subtle everyday lifestyle moment.
4. A native plant, landscape, or environmental characteristic.
5. A composition and viewpoint that naturally belongs to the city.

The overall scene structure must change from city to city. Do not repeatedly use the same object positions or visual formula.

Possible compositions include:
harbor viewpoint, narrow historic lane, riverside garden, coastal path, elevated city overlook, lively market passage, tram avenue, ferry terminal, botanical setting, heritage square, beach promenade, cultural plaza, or skyline terrace.

Choose whichever composition best represents [CITY_NAME].

TYPOGRAPHY

Place “[CITY_NAME]” in the upper-left area with generous clean negative space.

Add one short, sophisticated English tagline inspired by the atmosphere of the city.

Typography should feel understated, editorial, spacious, and premium. Never allow text to dominate the artwork.

VISUAL HIERARCHY

Use one iconic landmark or architectural feature as the main focal point.

Support it with only 2–4 carefully selected local elements. Every added detail should strengthen the sense of place.

Avoid landmark collections or postcard-style collages. Keep the scene visually quiet and intentional.

PEOPLE

Include only 3–6 small-scale figures.

Give each person a believable activity connected to local life, such as:
walking through a historic lane, cycling, waiting for public transport, sketching architecture, boarding a ferry, reading outdoors, taking a quiet photograph, carrying beach equipment, browsing a market, or jogging beside the water.

Avoid crowds and avoid making any single person the main character. Figures should integrate naturally into the environment.

LOCAL CHARACTER

Use city-specific elements only when they genuinely fit [CITY_NAME]:

- local transportation
- architecture
- street furniture
- vegetation
- small signs or wayfinding
- local food references
- recreational activities
- pavement markings
- cultural details

Transport and signage should remain subtle. Instead of always using a large signboard, incorporate details naturally through a small transit marker, station clock, ferry information panel, bike symbol, painted road marking, beach flag, or understated metro icon.

ART DIRECTION

Japanese stationery-inspired aesthetic,
luxury sticker illustration,
premium commercial vector artwork,
modern editorial travel branding,
clean delicate outlines,
uniform line weight,
simple geometric forms,
flat-color illustration,
soft shapes,
balanced visual rhythm,
high-end minimalist postcard design.

COLOR SYSTEM

Build the atmosphere primarily with:
pale powder blue, soft sky blue, mist blue, and cool airy blues.

Balance these with:
warm ivory, cream, soft beige, muted sage, gray-green, and understated architectural neutrals.

Use dusty rose or muted blush only for tiny visual accents such as flowers, clothing details, small signs, awnings, or decorative objects.

Colors should remain soft, sophisticated, slightly desaturated, and cohesive.

MOOD

Fresh, airy, peaceful, refined, contemporary, elegant.

The final artwork should feel like a premium boutique travel postcard or luxury lifestyle brand illustration, with generous breathing room and a relaxed sense of place.

IMPORTANT QUALITY RULES

Every city must have its own visual identity.
Change the camera angle, scene structure, landmark placement, foreground treatment, and supporting details according to the city's character.

Do not simply replace [CITY_NAME] inside an existing composition.

NEGATIVE PROMPT

No photorealism.
No realism.
No watercolor.
No painterly brushwork.
No gradients.
No heavy shadows.
No dramatic cinematic lighting.
No paper texture.
No excessive detail.
No cluttered background.
No landmark collage.
No crowded streets.
No oversized characters.
No dominant hero character.
No repetitive café composition.
No fixed signboard position.
No identical foreground treatment.
No generic tourist-poster formula.
No copied layout from another city.
No unnecessary decorative elements.

prompts.text:
为 [CITY_NAME] 创作的高级极简扁平矢量旅行海报，3:4 纵向比例。

设计一张原创且精致的旅行海报，捕捉 [CITY_NAME] 真实的视觉个性。构图必须是为该城市量身定制的，而不是遵循可重复使用的模板。

城市特征

首先解读 [CITY_NAME] 独特的视觉特征，并围绕这五个元素构建场景：

1. 一个可识别的地标、建筑特色或天际线元素。
2. 一种独特的当地城市移动方式。
3. 一个微妙的日常生活瞬间。
4. 一种本土植物、景观或环境特征。
5. 一个自然属于该城市的构图和视角。

整体场景结构必须因城市而异。不要重复使用相同的物体位置或视觉公式。

可能的构图包括：
港口视角、狭窄的历史小巷、河畔花园、海岸小径、高架城市俯瞰、热闹的市场通道、有轨电车大道、渡轮码头、植物园设置、遗产广场、海滩长廊、文化广场或天际线露台。

选择最能代表 [CITY_NAME] 的构图。

排版

将“[CITY_NAME]”放置在左上角区域，留出充足且干净的负空间。

添加一条受城市氛围启发的简短、精致的英文口号。

排版应显得低调、编辑风格、宽敞且高端。绝不要让文字主导艺术作品。

视觉层级

使用一个标志性地标或建筑特色作为主要焦点。

仅使用 2–4 个精心挑选的当地元素作为辅助。每一个增加的细节都应增强地域感。

避免地标集合或明信片式的拼贴。保持场景视觉上的安静和有意图。

人物

仅包含 3–6 个小比例的人物。

赋予每个人一个与当地生活相关的可信活动，例如：
穿行在历史小巷、骑自行车、等待公共交通、写生建筑、登上渡轮、在户外阅读、安静地拍照、携带海滩设备、浏览市场，或在水边慢跑。

避免拥挤，并避免让任何单个人成为主角。人物应自然地融入环境。

当地特色

仅在真正符合 [CITY_NAME] 时使用城市特定元素：

- 当地交通
- 建筑
- 街道家具
- 植被
- 小型标识或导向系统
- 当地食物参考
- 康乐活动
- 路面标记
- 文化细节

交通和标识应保持微妙。与其总是使用大型广告牌，不如通过小型交通标记、车站时钟、渡轮信息板、自行车符号、喷漆路标、海滩旗帜或低调的地铁图标自然地融入细节。

艺术指导

日式文具启发的美学，
豪华贴纸插画，
优质商业矢量艺术品，
现代编辑风格旅行品牌视觉，
干净精致的轮廓，
统一的线宽，
简单的几何形状，
平涂色彩插图，
柔和的形状，
平衡的视觉节奏，
高端极简明信片设计。

色彩系统

主要使用以下色彩构建氛围：
淡粉蓝、柔和的天蓝色、雾蓝色和清凉轻盈的蓝色。

用以下颜色进行平衡：
温暖的象牙色、奶油色、柔和的米色、暗淡的鼠尾草绿、灰绿色和低调的建筑中性色。

仅在微小的视觉亮点（如花朵、服装细节、小型标志、遮阳篷或装饰物）上使用灰粉色或暗粉红色。

色彩应保持柔和、精致、略微去饱和且协调。

氛围

清新、空灵、平和、精致、现代、优雅。

最终的艺术作品应感觉像一张高端精品旅行明信片或奢侈生活方式品牌插画，具有充足的呼吸空间和轻松的地域感。

重要质量规则

每个城市必须有其独特的视觉身份。
根据城市的特征改变摄像机角度、场景结构、地标位置、前景处理和辅助细节。

不要只是简单地在现有构图中替换 [CITY_NAME]。

负面提示词

无照相写实主义。
无现实主义。
无水彩。
无绘画笔触。
无渐变。
无厚重阴影。
无戏剧性的电影照明。
无纸张纹理。
无过多细节。
无杂乱背景。
无地标拼贴。
无拥挤街道。
无超大人物。
无占主导地位的主角。
无重复的咖啡馆构图。
无固定的广告牌位置。
无相同的前景处理。
无通用的旅游海报公式。
无从其他城市复制的布局。
无不必要的装饰元素。

prompts.text:

The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout, with the screen divided into two clear contrast areas, upper and lower, with a ratio of approximately 1:1. Only perform slight travel magazine and art publication color grading, and add an extremely thin film grain. To adapt to the frame, the sky, ground, or environment can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, mirrored, copied, moved, or changed.

The lower part uses a medium-dark color extracted from the dark parts of the original photo as a matte paper background, and retains a large area of solid color empty space. prompts.text:
Subject: [adult male / female portrait]
Interference: [color split / narrow light beam / horizontal cut / motion veil]
Title: [TITLE]
Palette: [main neutral tones + one accent color]
Mood: [sharp / cinematic / restrained / experimental]

Create a 9:16 experimental editorial portrait poster where the photography is interrupted by one strong visual intervention.

Start with a striking close or waist-up portrait. Keep the subject large in frame, with clear facial emotion, natural skin texture, realistic hair and a strong silhouette. The portrait should already work as a fashion photograph before any graphic elements are added.

Choose only one main interference method.

For a color split, use uneven translucent bands that pass through the face and body, selectively revealing or shifting color rather than simply covering the portrait.

For a light intervention, keep most of the scene cool and restrained, then let one narrow beam of light cut across the eyes, nose or cheek and continue naturally through the surrounding space.

For a horizontal cut, divide selected parts of the face or body with bold graphic bands and oversized typography, using the cuts to reorganize the portrait rather than making a simple collage.

For a motion veil, keep the main portrait sharp while selected areas such as the eyes, mouth or shoulders stretch into soft horizontal motion trails. It should feel like photographic displacement, not a digital glitch.

Typography should be part of the composition. Use one strong headline, allow letters to crop off the canvas, overlap the subject, disappear behind the body or change as they pass through the interference area.

Keep supporting text minimal — one series label and one short phrase are enough.

Use a controlled palette with mostly black, white, grey or deep neutral tones, plus one accent color. Keep skin tones natural and avoid overly warm or yellow grading.

Add only a few fine lines, circles or open corner marks if needed. The final image should feel like a fashion editorial, contemporary poster or art-direction experiment rather than a template.

Avoid multiple competing effects, dense micro-text, obvious UI graphics, heavy glitch effects, random collage, numbering, Vol./Issue labels, four-point sparkle symbols, logos or watermarks.

The color palette should be based on a **soft, airy, slightly desaturated premium palette**, which may be adjusted by extracting and harmonizing the overall color temperature from the original image, while keeping the final result light and cohesive. Use **light pink-blue, misty blue, sky blue, and airy cool blues** to build the main atmosphere; balance them with **ivory white, creamy white, light beige, soft gray-green, and architectural neutrals**. Only allow a small amount of **dusty rose or muted blush** as subtle accents—for flowers, clothing, small signs, awnings, or local decorative details—so the image feels breathable yet still refined and layered.

The **text logic** should also become part of this style. Do not simply apply a city-name template. Instead, extract a **short title** from the original image’s **location, object name, theme, condition, or atmosphere**, and place it in the **upper left corner** or another area with generous negative space. Pair it with a **brief, restrained, tasteful tagline**. Typography should remain **understated, editorial, spacious, and premium**, never overpowering the visual. If necessary, add a small amount of secondary text, coordinate-style annotations, or tiny descriptive notes, so the text feels like a natural visual identity element from a **high-end travel brand or boutique postcard**, rather than a title bar added afterward.

The overall result should feel like a **high-end travel poster / boutique lifestyle postcard** designed specifically for the subject: **fresh, elegant, quiet, modern, and refined**, with generous negative space and a relaxed sense of presence. The **lower half of every poster must have its own independent visual identity**—you must not simply change the name while reusing the same composition, the same foreground, or the same arrangement of objects. Avoid anything that feels templated, repetitive, generic, or formulaic like a standard tourism poster.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每张照片转换为一个单独的、独立设计的高级海报。不要制作拼贴画或合并多张图像——每张照片都应单独处理和输出。使用整体的 3:4 纵向构图，画布分为上下两个相等的部分，采用严格的 1:1 高度比例，各占图像的 50%。

上半部分应保留原始照片，保持主体的身份、结构、姿势、真实的纹理、自然的光线和原始的色彩氛围。仅应用细微、精致的摄影调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物或展览摄影的感觉。为了适应格式，如果需要，可以自然延伸天空、地面或环境背景，但主体不得被拉伸、扭曲或改变。

下半部分应从照片中提取最具辨识度的主体、轮廓、姿势和叙事关系，并将它们重构为一个高级简约扁平矢量旅行海报风格的插画场景。不要机械地描摹照片。相反，根据原始图像的视觉个性，提炼出最具代表性的主要视觉焦点，并围绕它构建 2–4 个辅助元素，以最好地表达环境的氛围、日常生活方式、地方感或生活状态。无论原始图像包含城市、建筑、人物、动物、植物、物体、车辆还是自然风光，下半部分都应感觉像是专门为该主体定制设计的高级旅行视觉海报，而不是套用在所有事物上的固定模板。

构图应根据主体自身的性格重新组织，而不是重复相同的布局。使用一个明确的焦点、清晰的前景-背景层次、适当的留白和冷静、有序的视觉节奏来构建图像。根据原始图像，场景可能会自然地转化为街道、广场、水边、庭院、通道、平台、植物环境、室内角落、开阔景观或带有日常生活痕迹的环境片段。主体必须始终保持为主要的视觉中心；所有其他元素应仅加强“这个地方 / 这个物体 / 这种情境”的独特性。避免拼贴式的地标堆砌、明信片式的罗列或过于叙事性的安排。如果场景中需要人物，仅包含 3–6 个小比例人物，自然地融入环境中，没有单一的主角。

整体风格应为高级简约扁平矢量插画：灵感来自日本文具美学、精品贴纸插画和现代编辑类旅行品牌设计。使用干净的几何形状、柔和的轮廓、一致的线宽、扁平色块和克制的细节。整体感觉应是清新、宁静、细腻且具有现代感。避免写实主义、厚重的阴影、水彩纹理、纸张纹理、复杂的笔触、渐变、拥挤的背景和过多的细节。

色调应基于柔和、轻盈、略显低饱和度的高级色板，可以通过提取并协调原始图像的整体色温进行调整，同时保持最终结果轻盈且凝聚。使用浅粉蓝、雾霾蓝、天蓝和轻盈的冷蓝色来构建主要氛围；用象牙白、奶白色、浅米色、柔和的灰绿色和建筑中性色来平衡它们。仅允许少量的灰粉色或柔和的浅粉色作为微妙的点缀——用于花朵、服装、小招牌、遮阳篷或局部装饰细节——使图像感觉透气但仍精致且富有层次感。

文字逻辑也应成为这种风格的一部分。不要简单地套用城市名称模板。相反，从原始图像的地点、物体名称、主题、状况或氛围中提取一个简短的标题，并将其放置在左上角或其他有大量留白的区域。为其配上一个简短、克制、有品位的标语。排版应保持低调、编辑风格、空间感和高级感，永远不要压过视觉效果。如有必要，添加少量的辅助文字、坐标式注释或微小的描述性说明，使文字感觉像是来自高级旅行品牌或精品明信片的自然视觉识别元素，而不是事后添加的标题栏。

整体效果应感觉像是专门为该主体设计的高级旅行海报 / 精品生活方式明信片：清新、优雅、宁静、现代且精致，具有大量的留白和轻松的临场感。每张海报的下半部分必须具有其独立的视觉身份——你绝不能在重复使用相同构图、相同前景或相同物体排列的同时仅仅更改名称。避免任何感觉像模板化、重复、通用或公式化的东西，如标准的旅游海报。

prompts.text:
Create a premium same-source wash-and-restore recreation using the image as the only visual reference. Strictly preserve the exact original style, subject type, composition, camera angle, pose, perspective, color hierarchy, lighting atmosphere, material behavior, and visual mood. Style must remain stylized fantasy 3D render with flagship AAA game-cover quality, smooth sculpted anatomy, cinematic forest haze, premium fur rendering, and collectible key-art finish. Do not redesign, do not reinterpret, do not switch styles, do not add unrelated elements, and do not change the heroine, the roaring snow-leopard-like beast, the rune sword, the forest setting, or their spatial relationship. Only enhance clarity, silhouette power, anatomy precision, material fidelity, edge cleanliness, depth separation, and heroic cover impact. Remove watermark and all unnecessary text.

Style lock:
stylized fantasy 3D render, flagship game-cover key art, premium fantasy hunter poster, smooth sculpted forms, cinematic teal forest atmosphere, premium creature fur rendering, controlled orange rune glow, not photoreal live action, not anime cel shading, not thick-paint illustration.

Core composition:
Use the same tall vertical composition with one adult female fantasy huntress standing in the upper middle and one giant roaring snow-leopard-like beast dominating the lower foreground. Preserve the exact arrangement: the huntress stands behind and above the beast, torso turned slightly left, chin lifted in a proud upward angle, one hand resting firmly on the beast’s head, while a huge upright fantasy sword rises vertically behind her on the right side. The beast’s open mouth must fill the lower center as the strongest foreground shape. Preserve the exact hierarchy but sharpen it into a flagship cover read: huntress first, beast second, sword third, teal forest atmosphere last. The image must instantly read as one iconic super-symbol: a lone huntress mastering a monstrous apex predator.

Orbit motion logic:
Strengthen the unified heroic flow without changing the original pose. Let the heroine’s windswept hair sweep leftward and backward, the sword act as a strong vertical anchor, the beast’s roaring mouth thrust powerfully forward, and the fur, whiskers, mist, and subtle grass edges support one continuous circulation of force. The eye path should move cleanly through the heroine’s face, along the lifted jawline and hair, down through the planted hand, into the beast’s huge open jaws and fangs, then back upward along the glowing sword. The whole frame should feel like a frozen finishing-moment cover image with maximum heroic tension and clarity.

Main heroine:
Depict one adult female fantasy warrior with stylized but coherent anatomy, strong shoulders, natural breast placement, narrow but believable waist, toned abdomen, realistic pelvis, strong hips, and properly formed hands with five fingers. Preserve the exact attitude: calm, dominant, fearless, and slightly aloof, with a confident upward gaze and relaxed control over the beast beneath her. She must feel mature, agile, and dangerous, never childish. She is the emotional and symbolic face of the image.

Face and hair:
Preserve the exact identity: short dark charcoal hair with magenta-pink ends, swept dynamically to the left, sharp brows, golden-amber eyes, softly parted lips, and a cool warrior confidence. Refine silhouette clarity so the face and hair read more strongly from a distance, but do not change hairstyle shape, facial proportions, or expression. The face must remain elegant, fierce, and instantly recognizable.

Costume and accessories:
Preserve the exact costume structure: torn mustard-yellow cropped top with rough frayed hem, dark underlayer beneath, fitted brown leather belt and waist harness details, wrapped forearm bandages, engraved metal arm cuff, and large gold hoop earrings. Keep the same exposed midriff, same rugged huntress styling, and same balance between cloth, leather, and metal. Do not redesign into heavy armor and do not add unrelated accessories.

Sword:
Preserve the exact sword placement and silhouette: a huge upright fantasy blade behind the heroine on the right side, broad metallic body with circular and crescent cutout-like forms near the top and glowing orange rune-like insets along the blade. The sword must read more clearly as a cover icon, with stronger silhouette clarity, cleaner glow control, and more premium metal definition, while remaining secondary to the heroine and beast. Keep the exact angle, scale, and visual role.

Beast:
Preserve the exact foreground creature as a giant snow-leopard-like predator with pale gray fur, dark spots, huge open jaws, long fangs, wet gums, visible tongue, moist nose, and an intense roaring expression. The beast must dominate the lower half and feel extremely close to camera, creating a powerful scale contrast beneath the huntress. Its head should read as the second major symbol of the cover: primal, violent, and fully controlled by the heroine’s presence. Fur must feel dense and premium, with strong shape readability and clean depth separation.

Environment:
Keep the exact misty forest setting with soft teal-blue atmospheric haze, blurred vertical tree forms, faint foliage depth, and minimal environmental clutter. The forest must remain secondary and supportive, functioning as a clean cinematic backdrop for the huntress-beast iconography. No added architecture, no extra creatures, no new props.

Lighting:
Preserve the original lighting logic exactly: cool teal ambient forest light, soft frontal illumination on the heroine and beast, and warm orange accents from the rune sword and selective skin and fur highlights. Refine the lighting into a more flagship cover hierarchy: the heroine’s face, hair edges, upper torso, resting hand, beast fangs, and beast mouth receive the clearest readability; the sword glow remains controlled and elegant; the background haze stays clean and atmospheric. Do not introduce new dramatic light sources or alter the established warm-cool balance.

Materials:
Skin: smooth stylized 3D skin shading with subtle warmth, mild blush, and clean hero-character finish.
Hair: layered semi-gloss strands with strong silhouette breakup and pink accent tips.
Cloth top: matte worn fabric with frayed edges, slight tension, and natural fold logic.
Leather harness: rugged brown leather with stitching, creases, and travel-worn texture.
Metal cuff and sword: engraved steel with scratches, subtle wear, cool reflections, and restrained orange emissive insets.
Beast fur: dense spotted snow-leopard fur, soft clumping, strong whiskers, clear muzzle texture.
Mouth interior: wet gums, tongue texture, fang translucency near tips, saliva sheen kept controlled.
Forest air: teal volumetric haze, soft depth bloom, clean atmospheric separation.

Color palette:
Strictly preserve the original palette: teal-blue forest haze, mustard-yellow top, brown leather, dark steel sword, orange rune glow, pale warm skin, charcoal hair with magenta accents, gray-white spotted beast fur, and warm pink-red mouth interior. Keep the palette bold but disciplined, with the heroine, the beast mouth, and the glowing sword acting as the three strongest chromatic anchors.

Rendering and finish:
Maintain the exact original visual language: polished stylized fantasy 3D render, premium flagship game-cover finish, cinematic hunter-versus-beast composition, smooth sculpted anatomy, high-end fur rendering, collectible fantasy key art. This is not a redesign and not a style conversion. It is a faithful same-source restoration and elevation into a stronger cover image.

Image quality and cleanup:
Enhance facial clarity, eye sharpness, hand anatomy, abdomen definition, cloth edge precision, earring detail, cuff engraving, sword silhouette, rune glow cleanliness, beast fur separation, fang realism, mouth texture, whisker sharpness, and forest depth. Remove watermark, signature, copied text, noise, muddy shadows, overblown highlights, and compression artifacts. Keep the final image high-resolution, clean, sharp, commercially polished, and fully faithful to the original composition, style, and mood.

Negative prompt:
watermark, signature, readable text, logo, changed pose, changed composition, changed sword design, changed beast species, changed costume, added armor, added scenery, extra creatures, photoreal live action, anime cel shading, thick-paint illustration, malformed hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, distorted torso, warped beast jaw, unrealistic fur, fake mouth anatomy, oversaturated glow, muddy teal fog, dead black patches, blurry edges, low-resolution detail, style drift, redesigned character

prompts.text:
使用图像作为唯一的视觉参考，创建一个优质的同源清洗与修复重制版。严格保留原有的风格、主体类型、构图、摄像机角度、姿势、透视、颜色层级、光影氛围、材质表现和视觉情绪。风格必须保持为具有旗舰级AAA游戏封面品质的程式化奇幻3D渲染，拥有平滑的雕刻解剖结构、电影感的森林薄雾、优质的皮毛渲染以及收藏级的关键艺术完成度。不要重新设计，不要重新解释，不要切换风格，不要添加无关元素，也不要改变女主角、咆哮的类雪豹巨兽、符文剑、森林设置或它们的空间关系。仅增强清晰度、轮廓力量、解剖精度、材质忠实度、边缘整洁度、深度分离和英雄封面冲击力。移除水印和所有不必要的文字。

风格锁定：
程式化奇幻3D渲染，旗舰级游戏封面关键艺术，优质奇幻猎人海报，平滑的雕刻形态，电影感的青色森林氛围，优质生物皮毛渲染，受控的橙色符文光芒，非写实真人版，非动漫赛璐璐着色，非厚涂插画。

核心构图：
使用相同的竖向长构图，一名成年女性奇幻女猎手站在中上部，一只巨大的咆哮类雪豹巨兽占据下部前景。保留确切的排列：女猎手站在巨兽后上方，躯干略微向左转，下巴以骄傲的向上角度抬起，一只手牢牢地放在巨兽头上，而一把巨大的竖直奇幻剑在右侧身后升起。巨兽张开的嘴必须充满底部中央，作为最强的前景形状。保留确切的层级，但将其强化为旗舰封面读感：女猎手第一，巨兽第二，剑第三，青色森林氛围最后。图像必须立即被解读为一个标志性的超级符号：一位独自征服了残暴顶级掠食者的女猎手。

轨道运动逻辑：
在不改变原始姿势的情况下加强统一的英雄流向。让女主角被风吹动的头发向左后方飘动，剑作为强有力的垂直锚点，巨兽咆哮的嘴有力地向前冲，皮毛、胡须、薄雾和细微的草缘支撑着一个连续的力量循环。视线路径应清晰地穿过女主角的面部，沿着抬起的下颌线和头发，向下穿过按下的手，进入巨兽巨大的张开的颚部和尖牙，然后沿着发光的剑向上返回。整个画面应感觉像是一张凝固的终结时刻封面图，具有最大的英雄张力和清晰度。

主要女主角：
描绘一名具有程式化但连贯的解剖结构、强壮的肩膀、自然的胸部位置、纤细但可信的腰部、紧致的腹部、写实的骨盆、强壮的臀部以及形态正确、有五个手指的手的成年女性奇幻战士。保留确切的态度：冷静、统治、无畏且略显冷漠，目光自信地向上看，从容地控制着下方的巨兽。她必须显得成熟、敏捷且危险，绝非孩子气。她是图像的情感和象征核心。

面部和头发：
保留确切的身份：短炭黑色头发，发梢为洋红色，动态向左扫过，眉毛锐利，金色琥珀色眼睛，嘴唇微微张开，展现出冷酷的战士自信。精炼轮廓清晰度，使面部和头发在远处更易识别，但不要改变发型形状、面部比例或表情。面部必须保持优雅、凶猛且一眼就能认出。

服装与配饰：
保留确切的服装结构：撕裂的芥末黄短款上衣，边缘粗糙磨损，下方有深色内层，修身的棕色皮革腰带和腰部背带细节，缠绕的前臂绷带，刻有图案的金属护臂，以及大的金耳环。保持相同的露脐设计，相同的粗犷女猎手造型，以及布料、皮革和金属之间的相同平衡。不要重新设计成重型盔甲，也不要添加无关的配饰。

剑：
保留确切的剑位置和轮廓：在女主角右侧身后的一把巨大的竖直奇幻大剑，宽阔的金属剑身，顶部附近有圆形和新月形的镂空形状，沿着剑身有发光的橙色符文状镶嵌。剑必须更清晰地作为封面图标，具有更强的轮廓清晰度、更干净的发光控制和更优质的金属质感，同时保持作为女主角和巨兽的次要地位。保持确切的角度、比例和视觉角色。

巨兽：
保留确切的前景生物，作为一只巨大的类雪豹掠食者，具有浅灰色的皮毛、黑色的斑点、巨大的张开的颚部、长长的尖牙、湿润的牙龈、可见的舌头、湿润的鼻子和强烈的咆哮表情。巨兽必须占据下半部分，并感觉非常接近相机，在女猎手下方创造出强大的比例对比。它的头部应被视为封面的第二个主要符号：原始、暴力，且完全受控于女猎手的存在。皮毛必须感觉浓密且优质，具有强大的形状可读性和清晰度。

环境：
保持确切的迷雾森林设置，带有柔软的青蓝色大气层薄雾、模糊的垂直树木形状、微弱的植被深度和最少的环境杂乱。森林必须保持次要和支持地位，作为女猎手与巨兽图腾的干净电影背景。没有添加的建筑，没有额外的生物，没有新的道具。

 lighting：
精确保留原始灯光逻辑：冷青色的环境森林光，女主角和巨兽身上柔和的前方照明，以及来自符文剑和选择性的皮肤及皮毛高光的温暖橙色点缀。将灯光提炼为更具旗舰封面感的层级：女主角的面部、头发边缘、上身、按下的手、巨兽的尖牙和巨兽的嘴部获得最清晰的可读性；剑的发光保持受控且优雅；背景薄雾保持干净且有氛围感。不要引入新的戏剧性光源或改变既定的冷暖平衡。

材质：
皮肤：光滑的程式化3D皮肤着色，带有细微的暖意、轻微的红晕和干净的主角级完成度。
头发：分层的半光泽发丝，具有强大的轮廓分解感和粉色发梢。
布料上衣：哑光磨损织物，边缘磨损，有轻微的张力和自然的褶皱逻辑。
皮革背带：粗犷的棕色皮革，带有缝线、褶皱和旅途磨损的纹理。
金属护臂和剑：刻有图案的钢材，带有划痕、细微的磨损、冷色反射和克制的橙色自发光镶嵌。
巨兽皮毛：浓密的斑点雪豹皮毛，柔软的成簇感，强壮的胡须，清晰的吻部纹理。
口腔内部：湿润的牙龈，舌头纹理，尖牙顶端的半透明感，唾液光泽保持受控。
森林空气：青色体积雾，柔软的深度光晕，干净的大气分离。

调色板：
严格保留原始调色板：青蓝色森林薄雾、芥末黄上衣、棕色皮革、深色钢剑、橙色符文光芒、浅暖色皮肤、带洋红色点缀的炭黑色头发、灰白色斑点巨兽皮毛以及暖粉红色的口腔内部。保持色调大胆但有节制，女主角、巨兽的嘴和发光的剑作为三个最强的色彩锚点。

渲染与完成度：
