The environment is slightly messy but realistic, do not change to a luxury bedroom or photography studio.

Adopts a close-range mobile phone direct flash photography effect, the flash shines directly on the subject from the camera direction, making the face, chest, forearms, backs of the hands, and legs significantly bright, with delicate highlights on the bridge of the nose and cheeks, while the room behind the subject quickly fades into a darker area. The overall color temperature is warm, skin tone is natural, background is low-saturation tones of brown, gray, and black. Retain slight high ISO grain from mobile photos, local sharpening, and limited dynamic range; the subject's face and foreground hands are clear, the background only naturally reduces detail without strong portrait mode blurring.

High-definition photo-level details, focusing on the moist reflection in the eyes, natural skin texture, highlights on the bridge of the nose, scattered hair strands, knit fabric texture, finger joints, fingernails, floor mat fibers, and wooden floor texture. Maintain a realistic ordinary mobile phone close-range snapshot quality, avoid commercial studio feel, plastic skin, excessive beautification, CG feel, anime feel, fisheye distortion, extreme body proportions, incorrect kneeling posture, limb intersection, extra arms, extra fingers, fused palms, deformed joints, overly tidy background, watermarks, or garbled text.

prompts.text:
超写实室内近距离人像摄影，竖版约 3:4，一名年轻成年东亚女性在铺着浅棕色榻榻米/编织地垫的房间里跪姿俯身面对镜头。镜头位于人物正前方偏低的位置，约 24–28mm 等效手机广角镜头，距离非常近，机位约在地面上方 30–50cm，形成明显但自然的近大远小透视。人物从头顶一直拍到前景双手，脸部和上半身占据画面中央，双手位于最靠近镜头的画面底部，背景保留真实凌乱的居家环境，整体像朋友蹲在她面前用手机随手拍摄，不使用鱼眼。

人物为自然丰满的女性体型，肩部较窄，胸腰曲线明显，大腿丰满。她双膝跪在地垫上，两膝分开约与髋同宽，小腿向身体后方折叠，脚背自然贴地。身体从髋部明显向前倾，腰背形成轻微弧度，双臂从肩部向前下方伸出，两只手分别撑在镜头前方的木地板边缘，手掌完全展开、五指自然分开。由于镜头距离很近，双手和前臂在前景被轻微放大，随后是跪姿双腿与身体，上半身继续向镜头靠近。

头部轻轻向人物右侧倾斜，下巴略微抬起，脸距离镜头较近，双眼直接注视镜头，神情安静、自然，嘴唇微微分开，没有夸张笑容。姿态带有明显生活化抓拍感，而不是标准棚拍摆姿。

人物留深棕黑色中长层次卷发，长度约至肩膀下方，发量丰富蓬松，带自然凌乱的空气感。发尾形成松散的大弧度外翻和内卷，脸颊两侧有明显的羽毛层次；额前为较长的轻薄八字碎刘海，多缕发丝自然垂落到眉毛、眼睛和鼻梁附近。头顶略微蓬松，保留细碎飞发。

脸型为柔和的小鹅蛋脸，五官自然精致，棕色大眼睛，双眼皮清晰，眉毛纤细自然，睫毛轻微强调；鼻梁纤细，鼻尖圆润；嘴唇丰满但自然，为裸粉色。皮肤白皙偏暖，面颊有淡淡粉红色血色感，鼻梁、鼻尖和双颊在近距离闪光下带明显自然油润高光。保留毛孔、细小雀斑/皮肤纹理和轻微肤色变化，不要过度磨皮。

上身穿深炭灰色/黑灰色贴身罗纹针织长袖上衣，低圆领设计，领口贴合胸部曲线。衣服面料具有清晰细密的竖向针织纹理，袖子在手臂上略微堆叠形成自然褶皱，袖口位于前臂中下段。下身基本被跪姿、上衣和构图遮挡，不添加复杂服饰或配饰。

场景为普通住宅内部的日式或简约小房间。人物跪在浅棕色细密编织纹理地垫上，画面最下方露出一条浅木色地板和地垫收边。背景左侧可见木门、黑色摄影灯架/三脚架以及靠墙摆放的开放式白色置物架，架子上有书籍、纸张和零散生活用品；右后方是通往较暗空间的门洞或走廊，可见少量堆放物品。环境略显凌乱但真实，不要改成豪华卧室或摄影棚。

采用近距离手机直闪摄影效果，闪光灯从镜头方向直接照射人物，使脸部、胸口、前臂、手背和双腿明显明亮，鼻梁和双颊产生细腻高光，同时人物身后的房间快速衰减为较暗区域。整体色温偏暖，肤色自然，背景为棕色、灰色和黑色低饱和色调。保留手机照片轻微高 ISO 颗粒、局部锐化和有限动态范围，人物脸部与前景双手清晰，背景仅自然降低细节，不做强烈人像模式虚化。

高清照片级细节，重点表现眼睛湿润反光、自然皮肤纹理、鼻梁高光、零散发丝、针织面料纹路、手指关节、指甲、地垫纤维和木地板纹理。保持真实普通手机近距离抓拍质感，避免商业棚拍感、塑料皮肤、过度美颜、CG感、动漫感、鱼眼畸变、极端身体比例、错误跪姿、肢体穿插、多余手臂、多余手指、融合手掌、畸形关节、背景过度整洁、水印或乱码文字。

prompts.text: Create a surreal, ultra-realistic low-angle fisheye photograph of a young man walking directly over the camera in the center of a grand European city square. The camera is placed almost flat against the cobblestone pavement, creating an extreme forced-perspective effect. One leg is lifted high toward the lens, with the sneaker sole dominating the foreground and appearing dramatically oversized, showing detailed rubber tread and realistic texture. His other foot remains planted on the ground. He reaches one hand directly toward the camera with an open palm and naturally spread fingers, creating strong depth and interaction with the viewer. He wears a blue denim jacket over a clean white T-shirt, relaxed blue jeans, and classic black-and-white canvas sneakers. He has short slightly tousled dark hair and subtle round glasses, with a calm, confident expression as he looks down toward the camera. Surround him with elegant historic European architecture curving dramatically around the frame because of the extreme 8mm fisheye lens. Bright blue summer sky with soft white clouds, strong sunlight and subtle lens flare, realistic shadows across the cobblestones, distant pedestrians and city details around the square. Extreme barrel distortion, circular architectural framing, dynamic perspective, crisp facial detail, realistic skin, denim and shoe textures, cinematic street photography, natural colors, high dynamic range, immersive depth, photorealistic, 8K detail. Vertical 4:5 composition, subject centered, no text, no logos, no watermark.

items.title: 复古CCD风格黑暗仙女公主肖像

prompts.text:
An ultra-realistic fine art portrait of an ethereal young woman styled as a dark fairy princess, photographed against a plain neutral gray background with a vintage direct-camera flash.

She has porcelain skin with visible natural texture, tiny freckles scattered across the nose and cheeks, soft pink blush, slightly flushed nose, glossy skin highlights, and deep wine-red velvet lips with subtle gradient edges.

Her eyes are unusually large, watery and luminous with muted gray-violet irises, soft catchlights from the flash, delicate lashes, slightly sleepy eyelids and an almost melancholic expression. A tiny faded cross symbol is delicately drawn between her eyebrows, adding a mystical medieval atmosphere.

Her dark brown hair is long, naturally wavy, center-parted with loose wispy curls framing her face. The hairstyle feels romantic, slightly messy and effortless rather than perfectly styled.

She wears an extravagant royal blue jeweled tiara inspired by Dolce & Gabbana Alta Moda, decorated with oversized sapphire gemstones, antique silver settings, diamonds and intricate vintage craftsmanship. Matching oversized chandelier earrings feature blue crystals, emerald accents, antique silver filigree and dangling gemstones that sparkle dramatically under the flash.

Around her neck are multiple luxurious gemstone necklaces layered together, including sapphire, amethyst, emerald and crystal pieces. Large sculptural floral jewelry made from translucent gemstones blooms across her chest like wearable fantasy art, resembling enchanted flowers carved from precious stones.

The jewelry catches the direct flash, producing authentic starburst reflections, tiny diffraction spikes, brilliant gemstone sparkle and realistic specular highlights.

Photographed using a Canon PowerShot G7 or early CCD compact camera with a built-in direct flash. Strong frontal flash illuminates the face and jewelry while leaving subtle shadows around the edges. The background remains flat and slightly gray with no dramatic lighting.

Authentic early-2000s CCD digital photography aesthetic mixed with luxury editorial styling. Fine CCD sensor grain. Slight digital noise in darker areas. Soft lens rendering. Low dynamic range. Tiny JPEG artifacts. Slight chromatic aberration. Natural skin texture. No beauty filter. No HDR. No AI oversharpening.

Color grading emphasizes muted gray background, porcelain skin, deep burgundy lips, sapphire blue gemstones, emerald green details and antique silver metals. Warm flash highlights create glowing reflections on the jewelry while preserving realistic skin tones.

The overall mood feels mysterious, aristocratic, gothic romantic and dreamlike, inspired by Alexander McQueen couture, Dolce & Gabbana Alta Moda jewelry, Renaissance princess portraits, medieval fantasy illustrations, Tim Walker editorials, dark fairy tales, vintage Vogue beauty photography and museum-quality fashion portraiture.

The image should resemble an authentic high-fashion beauty portrait discovered in an early-2000s couture editorial rather than an AI-generated fantasy illustration.

prompts.text:
Theme:
Dark green bikini in a rainy garden

Subject:
A woman in her 20s standing in the courtyard of an old wooden house in the rain. The frame largely features the subject down to the upper thighs, depicting a dark gray-green triangle bikini, wet hair, and blue jeans pulled down to the thighs.

Character/Expression:
A slightly elongated oval face with a small chin, horizontally long dark brown pupils, thin eyebrows, a clean nose bridge, and slightly parted pale peach lips. Chin raised, face facing forward, with a quiet and firm expression as if looking down at the camera. Shoulder-length black wet hair, a center-parted hairline, and thin strands of hair clinging to the forehead, cheeks, and neck. Pale coral eye makeup and naturally moist skin.

Clothing/Pose:
A dark gray-green triangle bikini. Clearly depicted thin neck and back straps, small brown bead decorations on the edges, and brown tie strings on both sides of the waist. Blue jeans pulled from the waist down to the thighs. Standing on both legs, arms slightly bent forward, hands floating at both sides of the abdomen.

Background/Lighting:
The background consists of black wooden pillars, a gray tiled roof, shoji-style windows, a wet stone garden, and low green shrubs and rocks on the left and right. Fine raindrops are shown throughout the frame. Soft diffused light from an overcast sky is projected from the front above, creating restrained white reflections on the wet skin, hair, and stone path.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. An upper-thigh portrait taken from a front shot slightly below eye level. The character is placed largely in the center, cropped at the roof at the top and at the jeans on the thighs at the bottom. Focused on the face and bikini, with the wooden house blurred to a recognizable degree with a medium depth of field.

Texture/Style:
A photorealistic live-action photo like those taken under natural light on a rainy day. High-definition depiction of wet hair, skin with water droplets, fine unevenness of fabric, and the luster of wet wood and stone, using calm tones of gray-green and blue-gray.

Negative:
Significant changes to wet hair and facial features; omission of jeans pulled down to the thighs.

items.title: 极简奢华VELORE覆盆子慕斯海报

prompts.text:
Create a premium minimalist dessert campaign poster for a fictional haute patisserie brand called VELORÉ, combining Transit-style restraint with Orbit-style poetic motion in a further purified composition. The image must feel ultra-clean, gallery-like, elegant, and commercially luxurious, with the dessert as the absolute and solitary visual hero. No copied text, no watermark, no clutter, no unnecessary props.

Main composition:
A single round raspberry mousse cheesecake sits perfectly centered on a matte white ceramic plate in the lower-middle of the frame. The cake is the only substantial object in the composition. Preserve a strict three-layer structure: a dark cocoa crumb base, a thick ivory mousse body with fine natural aeration, and a flawless glossy raspberry-red mirror glaze on top. The garnish is reduced to the minimum iconic expression: two fresh raspberries, one blackberry, one small whipped cream accent, and one extremely delicate blossom sprig rising upward in a graceful curved arc. The blossom line should create a subtle orbital motion that guides the eye upward and back toward the cake, while remaining almost weightless.

Transit restraint:
Use a large field of warm off-white negative space. Typography must be reduced to a highly disciplined editorial minimum: one small brand line, one product name, one short descriptor. Remove all extra annotation blocks and nonessential copy. The image should read instantly as a flagship luxury dessert poster.

Orbit motion:
The only motion cue comes from the elegant upward arc of the blossom sprig and the gentle clustered rhythm of the berries on top, creating a refined sense of lift and circulation above the cake. The motion must feel quiet, premium, and intentional, never decorative or busy.

Typography and layout:
Place a very small refined brand line at the upper center: “VELORÉ PATISSERIE”. Beneath it, set the product name in elegant editorial type: “Raspberry Cloud”. Add one restrained subline: “Silken mousse with vivid fruit glaze.” All typography should be dark charcoal, airy, centered, and clearly secondary to the cake.

Lighting:
Soft diffused studio light from the upper left-front, with subtle fill from the right and a very gentle shadow beneath the plate. Keep the light bright, soft, and sculptural, with a controlled highlight across the red glaze and delicate volume on the mousse body. No hard shadows, no muddy contrast, no overexposed whites.

Material rendering:
The raspberry mirror glaze must look ultra-smooth, glassy, and slightly viscous. The mousse layer should feel chilled, creamy, and naturally aerated with microscopic pores. The cocoa base should be compact, crisp, and finely granular. The berries must show realistic drupelet texture, subtle bloom, natural moisture, and fresh color depth. The whipped cream accent should feel dense, soft, and freshly piped. The blossom sprig must be fine, botanical, and fragile with tiny pink florets.

Color system:

主要构图：
一个圆形的覆盆子慕斯芝士蛋糕完美地置于画框中下部的一个哑光白色陶瓷盘中央。蛋糕是构图中唯一的实质性物体。保持严格的三层结构：深色可可碎基底、带有细微自然气孔的厚象牙色慕斯主体，以及顶部完美的亮面覆盆子红镜面淋面。装饰被简化为最小的标志性表达：两个新鲜覆盆子、一个黑莓、一个小的鲜奶油点缀，以及一根极细致的花枝以优雅的弧形向上升起。花枝线条应创造一种微妙的轨道运动，引导视线向上并回到蛋糕，同时保持近乎无重力感。

Transit 克制：
使用大面积的暖白色负空间。排版必须减少到高度自律的社论式最小值：一行小品牌文字、一个产品名称、一个简短描述。移除所有额外的注释块和非必要的文案。图像应能瞬间被识别为旗舰级奢华甜品海报。

Orbit 运动：
唯一的运动提示来自于花枝优雅的向上弧线和顶部浆果柔和的簇状节奏，在蛋糕上方创造出一种精致的提升和循环感。运动必须感觉安静、高级且有目的性，绝非装饰性或忙乱。

排版与布局：
在上方中央放置一行极小的精致品牌文字：“VELORÉ PATISSERIE”。在其下方，以优雅的社论字体设置产品名称：“Raspberry Cloud”。添加一行克制的副标题：“Silken mousse with vivid fruit glaze.” 所有排版应为深炭灰色、通透、居中，且明显次于蛋糕。

灯光：
左前上方发出的柔和扩散摄影灯光，右侧有微妙的补光，盘子下方有非常柔和的阴影。保持光线明亮、柔和且具有雕塑感，红色淋面上带受控的高光，慕斯主体上有细腻的体积感。无硬影，无浑浊对比，无过曝的白色。

材质渲染：
覆盆子镜面淋面必须看起来超平滑、如玻璃般且略显粘稠。慕斯层应感觉冰凉、奶油般，并带有微孔自然透气。可可基底应紧凑、松脆且呈细颗粒状。浆果必须展示真实的核果纹理、微妙的白霜、自然的水分和新鲜的色彩深度。鲜奶油点缀应感觉浓郁、柔软且新鲜裱花。花枝必须精细、具有植物学美感且脆弱，带有微小的粉色小花。

色彩系统：
暖白色、象牙奶油色、深覆盆子红、深可可棕、黑莓黑紫色，以及一点点柔和的植物粉色作为点缀。保持色调高度克制，以红色淋面和浆果作为唯一的强色彩焦点。

风格：
奢华社论甜品摄影，极简主义甜品品牌设计，旗舰级商业食物海报，戛纳级别的奢华克制，洁净、触感、精致且令人难忘。

图像质量与物理约束：
超细节，高分辨率，边缘清晰，正确的圆形几何形状，洁净的盘子轮廓，真实的淋面反射，可信的装饰平衡，一尘不染的背景，无多余碎屑，无随机道具，无畸变，无廉价的面包店造型。

负向提示词：
廉价面包店传单，复制的原始文本，杂乱的布局，过多的浆果，过度的装饰，随机道具，卡通甜品，虚假 CGI 食物，塑料质感淋面，蜡质奶油，扭曲的蛋糕形状，脏盘子，硬影，平淡光线，浑浊的白色，过饱和的红色，嘈杂背景，不可读的排版，水印

Generate an illustration of an Oriental deity riding a mythical beast, overall integrating the visual language of traditional Chinese deity paintings, Gongbi heavy color, white-line drawing (Bai Miao), folk woodblock prints, and ancient scripture holy icon scrolls.

The screen uses "Deity + Spirit Beast" as the dual subject. The deity serves as the core visual subject, while the spirit beast has a large enough volume and presence. A clear movement relationship is formed between the two, which can be riding, guarding, fighting side-by-side, or surrounding and protecting, rather than a simple collage.

The character's face is majestic, divine, and possesses a sense of oppression, avoiding modern idol faces and excessive demonization. The clothing adopts high-completion traditional divine general armor or dharma robes, incorporating precise decorations such as cloud patterns, thunder patterns, beast face patterns, scale armor patterns, and acanthus patterns. The details are rich, but the character's overall silhouette must be clear.

The spirit beast has the temperament of a divine beast, spiritual beast, or evil-suppressing mount, with a robust physique and powerful posture. Hair, scales, turtle shells, etc., are shaped through a large number of fine and directional lines, emphasizing the ancient Gongbi texture of "shaping through lines," rather than photographic hair or 3D CG texture.

Weapons / Dharma vessels must participate in the composition, forming clear diagonal lines, vertical lines, or main action axes. The character's posture avoids stiff standing; movements such as twisting the body, pressing shoulders, leaning forward, holding weapons, performing mudras, patrolling, or attacking can be added, giving the entire image a clear "momentum."

Add an appropriate amount of silk ribbons, clothing hems, crown tassels, hair/beard, clouds, smoke, or water mist, which together with the character's movements form S-shaped, C-shaped, or swirling streamlines. Flowing elements should serve the theme and not be piled up just for richness.

The background maintains ancient Xuan paper white space, using rice white, ivory white, or old paper color as the base, adding only a small amount of inscriptions, red seals, cloud patterns, or smoke, creating a sense of an ancient scripture holy icon scroll. Avoid complex palaces, battlefields, and complete landscape backgrounds.

The colors use a low-saturation mineral color system, centered on the [Main Color Palette], and can be matched with ink black, dark blue, mineral blue, mineral green, bronze gold, old gold, cinnabar, ochre red, grayish white, and other colors. The overall effect is ancient, elegant, and restrained, with a small amount of high-saturation colors to lift the spirit.

The final image should simultaneously possess: the solemnity of Oriental deities, the sense of oppression from spirit beasts, the complexity of Gongbi line drawing, the tranquility of ancient Xuan paper, and a clear and powerful compositional momentum.

Avoid: modern Guochao neon, cyber style, 3D game concept art feel, plastic CG feel, overly full background, stiff characters, ordinary spirit beasts, loose lines, and excessive garbled text.

prompts.text:
Please turn each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, each photo output individually. The overall composition adopts a 3:4 vertical layout, with the upper and lower areas strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the screen.

The upper part preserves the original photo, maintaining the subject structure, real texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end photographic color grading to give it the exquisite texture of high-end brand advertising, art magazines, and exhibition visuals. To fit the frame, the sky, ground, or environmental background can be naturally extended, while the subject itself remains unchanged.

The lower part extracts the most recognizable subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, reconstructing it into a minimalist visual poster with high-end commercial aesthetics. The core language is "real objects passing through geometric emotional windows": a narrow, restrained, low-saturation geometric color block is set in the image as a visual anchor and spatial container. The direction of the color block is not fixed and can be horizontal, vertical, or diagonal, naturally determined by the subject's center of gravity, movement direction, outline trend, and layout rhythm. The subject enters the color block in a realistic photographic sense or exquisite realistic manner, and partially crosses boundaries, breaks the frame, extends out, or passes through borders, forming a sense of natural growth, spatial penetration, and white space breathing.

The composition remains minimalist, clear, and balanced, establishing order through geometric color blocks, subject boundary-crossing relationships, and large areas of white space. prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium architectural sales poster for a fictional real-estate brand called AERLITH HABITAT, combining more refined Transit polish with stronger Orbit generation flow. Vertical format, soft taupe-beige studio background, elegant diagonal sunlight from the upper-right, and one central tabletop concept presentation where an architectural maquette and white technical overlays become one unified product story. The image must feel like a flagship launch visual for a boutique residential project: calm, luxurious, intelligent, and globally editorial.

Main composition:
Keep a strict vertical hierarchy. In the lower-middle, place one exquisitely crafted physical house maquette on a square site plinth, with warm timber construction, pitched roof, fine glazing, and clean miniature landscape integration. In the upper half, float a sparse architectural drawing system: one floor plan, one small elevation or axonometric study, and a few elegant annotation clusters. Strengthen the Orbit direction by making the relationship between upper diagrams and lower model feel more actively connected, as if the concept above is descending and materializing into the maquette below. Use delicate white strategy lines, arrows, and environmental curves to visually bridge upper and lower zones with a more continuous generative flow.

Architecture:
Design a compact high-end retreat house or boutique nature residence with a steep double-pitched roof, warm timber structure, floor-to-ceiling glazing, and one cleanly articulated entry volume. The model must feel fully buildable and coherent. Around the lower model, include a few translucent abstract trees, tiny white scale figures, airflow and sunlight path arrows, and subtle topographic or water-path lines, all highly restrained and elegant.

Transit direction:
Make everything cleaner, lighter, and more internationally premium. Reduce annotation density, increase breathing room, soften any unnecessary visual noise, and keep typography and graphics more editorial than explanatory. The image should feel closer to a luxury architecture monograph cover or global real-estate launch poster than a technical board. The technical overlays must remain precise but visually airy.

Lighting:
Use soft natural directional light from the upper-right, with visible but restrained sunlight beams crossing the upper and middle area. Let the light create long elegant shadows over the table, subtle glow on the roof edges, and a precious warmth across the wooden model. Keep contrast sculptural but clean. The light should also reinforce the Orbit feeling, guiding the eye diagonally from the upper diagrams down into the physical model.

Material realism:
Render the maquette with exceptionally refined tactile detail: warm basswood or pale oak surfaces, crisp cut-card edges, thin acrylic glazing, subtle paper textures, matte site base, miniature landscaping, and a neat stack of wood or material samples at the lower-right edge of the table. The white overlay drawings must feel like fine architectural drafting, crisp and precise against the warm background.

Typography and branding:
Add one small original English project title in the upper-left, such as “SOLEN HAVEN,” with a tiny supporting subtitle and a few lines of refined architectural copy, all fully original. Keep all typography white, elegant, sparse, and secondary. Small original diagram labels may appear near the plan and environmental arrows, but they must remain minimal.

Graphic system:
Only white technical overlays: floor plan, tiny elevation/axon sketch, solar path icons, airflow arrows, circles, contour lines, and micro-annotations. Strengthen the sense that these graphics are not just hovering, but actively shaping and explaining the lower model. Keep them beautifully spaced and never cluttered.

Color system:
Warm taupe-beige background, honey wood tones, white drafting lines, pale translucent trees, soft gray shadows, and a subtle golden sunlight wash. Keep everything restrained, premium, and coherent.

Negative prompt:
no copied project title, no existing architect names, no Chinese title, no cluttered diagrams, no fantasy architecture, no distorted roof geometry, no messy material samples, no muddy shadows, no black blotches, no watermark, no existing logos, no noisy background, no random furniture clutter.

prompts.text:
创建一个名为 AERLITH HABITAT 的虚构房地产品牌的超高级建筑销售海报，将更精致的 Transit 磨光效果与更强的 Orbit 生成流相结合。竖版格式，柔和的灰褐色工作室背景，来自右上方的优雅对角阳光，以及一个中央桌面概念展示，其中建筑模型和白色技术覆盖图融为一体，形成统一的产品故事。图像必须感觉像是一个精品住宅项目的旗舰发布视觉：宁静、奢华、智能且具有全球编辑感。

主要构图：
保持严格的垂直层级。在中下方，在一个方形场地底座上放置一个制作精美的实体房屋模型，采用温暖的木结构、坡屋顶、精美的玻璃窗和干净的小型景观融合。在上半部分，漂浮一个稀疏的建筑图纸系统：一个平面图，一个小型立面或轴测研究，以及一些优雅的注释簇。通过增强 Orbit 方向，让上方图表与下方模型之间的关系感觉更加活跃地连接，仿佛上方的概念正在下降并具象化为下方的模型。使用精致的白色策略线、箭头和环境曲线，以更连续的生成流在视觉上桥接上下区域。

建筑：
设计一个紧凑的高端避世住宅或精品自然住宅，拥有陡峭的双坡屋顶、温暖的木结构、落地玻璃窗和一个清晰表达的入口体量。模型必须感觉完全可建造且连贯。在下方模型周围，包括一些半透明的抽象树木、微小的白色比例人偶、气流和阳光路径箭头，以及微妙的地形或水路引导线，所有这些都高度克制且优雅。

Transit 方向：
让一切变得更干净、更轻盈、更具国际化高级感。减少注释密度，增加呼吸空间，弱化任何不必要的视觉噪音，让排版和图形更具编辑感而非解释性。图像感觉应该更接近豪华建筑专著封面或全球房地产发布海报，而不是技术板。技术覆盖层必须保持精确，但在视觉上显得轻盈。

光影：
使用来自右上方的柔和自然定向光，在上方和中部区域有可见但克制的阳光束穿过。让光线在桌面上创造出长而优雅的阴影，在屋顶边缘产生微妙的光泽，并在木制模型上散发出珍贵的温暖。保持对比的雕塑感但干净。光线还应强化 Orbit 感觉，引导视线从上方的图表对角线下移到实体模型。

材质真实感：
以极其精致的触感细节渲染模型：温暖的椴木或浅色橡木表面、干脆的切卡边缘、薄压克力玻璃、微妙的纸质纹理、哑光场地基座、微型景观，以及桌子右下角整齐堆放的木材或材料样本。白色覆盖图必须感觉像精美的建筑绘图，在温暖的背景下清晰而精准。

排版与品牌：
在左上方添加一个小的原创英文项目标题，例如“SOLEN HAVEN”，并配有微小的辅助副标题和几行精致的建筑文案，全部为原创。保持所有排版为白色、优雅、稀疏且处于次要地位。平面图和环境箭头附近可能会出现小的原创图表标签，但必须保持极简。

图形系统：
仅限白色技术覆盖图：平面图、微型立面/轴测草图、太阳路径图标、气流箭头、圆圈、等高线和微型注释。加强这些图形不仅是在悬浮，而且是在积极塑造和解释下方模型的感觉。保持它们间距美观，绝不拥挤。

色彩系统：
温暖的灰褐色背景、蜂蜜木色调、白色绘图线、浅色半透明树木、柔和的灰色阴影和微妙的金黄色阳光洗礼。保持一切克制、高级且连贯。

负面提示词：
无复制的项目标题，无现有建筑师名字，无中文标题，无杂乱图表，无幻想建筑，无扭曲的屋顶几何形状，无杂乱的材料样本，无模糊的阴影，无黑色污渍，无水印，无现有徽标，无嘈杂背景，无随机家具杂乱。

Strict face identity lock — do not redesign, beautify, stylize, age, de-age, or replace her face.

The girl stands alone in the center of the composition in a graceful, natural editorial pose. She is facing the camera with a relaxed confident expression and a subtle natural smile. Her body is slightly angled, creating a candid fashion-editorial feeling. She holds a beautiful small mixed bouquet of flowers naturally with both hands in front of her. One leg is slightly crossed in front of the other for an elegant relaxed pose.

Outfit

- elegant ivory/cream long-sleeve button-up blouse
- high-waisted wide-leg beige trousers

prompts.text: Create a 3:4 vertical, high-key lifestyle fashion portrait against an almost pure seamless white background. A young adult woman wears a casual baseball-inspired outfit and is photographed from a rear three-quarter angle, with her body positioned toward the left side of the frame and a generous field of clean white negative space on the right. Her hips remain turned away from the camera while her waist, ribcage and head twist naturally toward frame right. She looks sideways past her shoulder rather than into the lens, her lips slightly parted and her expression quiet, relaxed and subtly aloof, as though she has just heard someone call her from behind.  She wears a bright cobalt or royal-blue baseball cap with a broad brim and only a very small orange-red embroidered detail. The brim creates a soft, physically believable shadow near her eyes. Her hair is deep black to black-brown, tied into a low ponytail, with a few loose face-framing strands. The long ponytail ends fall into broad, relaxed curves and flick slightly outward, retaining natural weight, movement and a few imperfect flyaways rather than looking perfectly styled.  Preserve a slim, soft facial structure, delicate jawline, natural side-profile nose and small relaxed lips. Makeup is extremely light and translucent, inspired by clean East Asian fashion-editorial beauty: sheer foundation with faint natural texture still visible, soft apricot-peach blush, very subtle eyeliner, light lashes, nearly invisible eyeshadow, and muted nude-pink or pale coral lips. No heavy contouring and no exaggerated influencer-style facial redesign.  She wears a white short-sleeve baseball jersey with thin blue vertical pinstripes, slightly loose through the upper torso and gathered, rolled or lightly tied around the waist to create a cropped effect. Add a small red-and-blue baseball-inspired letter patch on the chest without reproducing legible brand typography. The pinstripes must bend realistically around the torso twist, and the fabric should bunch and wrinkle naturally around the waist.  Pair it with deep indigo frayed denim cut-off shorts, featuring golden-brown stitching, curved rear-pocket seams, distressed rolled edges and irregular loose fibers. The denim should feel thick and real, lightly creased and naturally shaped around the hips without looking vacuum-tight.  Visible skin includes the face, ear, side of the neck, forearms, hands, a narrow strip of side and lower-back skin, and most of the thighs below the shorts. The shoulders, chest and most of the back remain covered, and the buttocks remain covered by denim, with only the upper-thigh edges visible near the frayed hems. Use a bright warm-ivory skin tone with subtle peach and natural circulation. The skin should look fine and soft yet retain faint real texture and tonal variation; visually it should suggest skin that would feel warm, clean and lightly supple to the touch rather than smooth plastic.  The pose should feel caught during a real movement. Most of the body weight rests on one straighter leg while the other leg extends diagonally toward the lower right of the frame, producing a relaxed S-shaped flow through the waist, hips and legs. One hand hangs loosely beside the outer thigh with naturally separated fingers. The other arm reaches toward frame right while lightly holding a white takeaway drink cup with a thin black straw. Tiny minimalist markings may appear on the cup, but they should remain indistinct rather than turning into obvious AI-generated text.  Photograph from slightly behind and to the subject's left, with the camera around chest-to-waist height and only a very mild upward angle. Use the visual character of a full-frame 50-70mm equivalent lens at approximately f/3.5-f/5.6. Frame from the complete top of the cap down to around the mid-to-lower thighs, keeping the extended hand and drink entirely within the composition. Keep the framing slightly off-center and imperfect rather than mathematically balanced.  Use an extremely large diffused white key light positioned roughly 30-45 degrees in front of the subject toward frame right. The seamless white studio and large white bounce surfaces should strongly fill the shadows, pushing the backdrop close to pure white with occasional slight overexposure. Broad, milky, diffused highlights should appear across the cheek, forearms, hand, waist and thighs. Keep only a faint realistic shadow beneath the cap brim. No hard light, no strong rim light, no colored lighting and no dramatic cinematic backlight.  The image should be high resolution without aggressive sharpening or HDR. Retain extremely fine digital softness or subtle grain, natural flyaway hairs, garment bunching, irregular denim frays, imperfect finger alignment and slight shifts in body weight. The overall aesthetic is 90s/00s baseball-inspired casual fashion blended with clean East Asian editorial styling: bright, summery, sporty and effortless, with a slight emotional distance from the camera.  She had just turned around; the drink is still moving slightly in her hand. Right now her body is suspended in that brief turning moment, and in the next second she seems ready to keep walking. items.title: AURELIA LAND云曜天际房产海报设计

prompts.text:
Create a premium vertical flagship real-estate advertising poster for a fictional luxury property developer brand called AURELIA LAND, promoting its iconic serviced-residence tower project “云曜天际” with the English subtitle “The Address Above”. The image must merge Orbit-style upward momentum with Transit-style editorial restraint, while making the brand memory unmistakably strong through a singular architectural identity, a disciplined logo system, and a high-recognition visual symbol. The building must remain the absolute visual hero.

Core concept:
A refined luxury high-rise tower rises from a razor-thin dark premium platform resting on a realistic adult human hand in the lower foreground. The hand symbolizes ownership, elevation, and control, but remains secondary. The main brand memory device is the tower itself: it must have a distinctive signature silhouette with elegant stepped balcony bands and a recognizable crown profile, so the architecture becomes an instantly identifiable brand icon. The entire poster should feel like one unforgettable commercial symbol: a branded tower held above the city.

Composition:
Vertical poster, highly centralized composition, strong symmetry with subtle premium asymmetry in light and skyline depth. The tower stands at exact center, occupying the visual core and extending upward into generous negative space. The platform is thin, dark, glossy, and engineered, acting like a luxury pedestal-device hybrid. A realistic hand supports the platform from below, emerging from the lower edge with correct anatomy and understated presence. The upper half contains a tightly controlled premium typography system with clear brand hierarchy. The lower section contains only a reduced, elegant information structure. No clutter.

Orbit direction:
Strengthen the feeling of ascent and elevation. The tower should feel as if it is being presented upward toward the sky, with balcony lines, facade rhythm, lighting gradation, and podium geometry all guiding the eye vertically. The silhouette should become slimmer and more luminous toward the upper levels. Palm trees, podium lighting, and platform perspective should subtly reinforce an upward lift. The visual energy is not chaotic; it is a calm, prestigious rise.

Transit restraint:
Keep the layout extremely clean and premium. Remove all unnecessary decorative elements, excessive text blocks, or busy urban distractions. The skyline in the background is soft, blurred, and minimal. The poster should read in one second: brand, tower, aspiration. Typography must be sparse, measured, and elegant. Every element should feel expensive, intentional, and globally marketable.

Architecture:
An internationally upscale 14-to-16-story luxury serviced-residence tower with a highly memorable form: sculpted stepped terraces, continuous wraparound balconies, warm interior light, floor-to-ceiling low-iron glass, champagne-bronze frame accents, pale limestone or travertine surfaces, transparent corner glazing, and a refined hospitality-style podium with double-height lobby glass. The crown should have a distinctive final-tier expression, elegant but instantly recognizable. The tower must look architecturally credible, developer-grade, investment-worthy, and beautifully buildable.

Brand identity emphasis:
Create a strong, cohesive visual branding system. At the very top, place a minimal geometric logo mark derived from the tower’s silhouette, paired with the brand name AURELIA LAND in a refined luxury wordmark. Introduce one restrained signature brand accent color, muted champagne gold, repeated only in the logo mark, one key headline word, and a thin divider line, so the identity becomes memorable without becoming noisy. The tower silhouette, logo form, and balcony rhythm should feel like one unified brand language. The image must not feel like a generic property ad; it must feel like a proprietary flagship campaign.

Typography and layout:
Use original, premium, restrained text only. Top: the AURELIA LAND logo system. Below: project name “云曜天际”. Main Chinese headline: “一座被记住的天际资产”. Smaller English line: “A landmark shaped for prestige, return, and recognition.” Add one ultra-minimal descriptor line beneath: “Serviced residences | Elevated lifestyle | Prime long-term value”. At the bottom, reduce to three concise icon-led selling points such as “Iconic Skyline Presence”, “Private Hospitality Living”, “Prime Urban Growth”, followed by a clean, narrow contact strip. Typography should be spacious, balanced, high-end, and clearly subordinate to the architecture.

Lighting:
Golden sunset transitioning into early dusk, with soft radiant sky light, warm architectural interior glow, controlled highlights on metal trims and balcony slabs, and subtle rim light around the tower silhouette. The light should help the tower separate cleanly from the background and amplify its brand-icon status. Strong but elegant tonal hierarchy, no muddy shadows, no blown sky, no dead-black blocks.

Material rendering:
Ultra-real architectural detail: low-iron glass with soft realistic reflections, champagne-bronze brushed metal edges, matte pale stone facade surfaces, warm glowing lobby interiors, refined balcony undersides, polished dark platform edge, realistic tropical greenery, and a photoreal hand with fine pores, natural skin folds, realistic tendons, subtle joint definition, correct finger anatomy, and believable sunset reflection. The building must never feel toy-like or miniature; it must feel like a real luxury tower presented through a surreal but premium advertising gesture.

Environment:
A calm high-end metropolitan skyline at sunset, softly blurred and low-contrast, with a few elegant tower silhouettes in the far distance. Minimal palm trees and restrained podium landscaping around the building base. No cars, no crowds, no unnecessary props, no excessive city detail. The environment exists only to elevate the branded tower symbol.

Color system:
Warm ivory, pale sunset gold, champagne metallic accents, limestone beige, charcoal-black platform tones, warm amber interior lights, muted palm green, and faint blue-grey city haze. Saturation is controlled and premium. The gold accent should feel proprietary and memorable, not loud.

Style:
Cannes-level luxury real-estate campaign, flagship developer launch visual, ultra-clean international branding, iconic architecture-as-brand-symbol thinking, hyper-real architectural visualization fused with premium advertising photography, elegant, aspirational, memorable, investment-oriented.

Image quality and physical rules:
Ultra-detailed, sharp tower edges, coherent perspective, realistic structural depth, believable hand-to-platform scale, accurate lighting direction, clean skyline falloff, realistic glass behavior, no floating geometry, no warped balconies, no broken fingers, no cheap brochure styling, no text overload.

Negative prompt:
generic developer branding, copied original slogan, copied original logo, weak brand identity, cheap brochure layout, cluttered typography, toy-like miniature tower, warped architecture, fake CGI materials, plastic facade, overdecorated luxury style, dead black shadows, muddy sunset, oversaturated gold, noisy skyline, extra hands, deformed fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, broken anatomy, floating building, unreadable icons, messy information bar, random city clutter, watermark, real person names

items.title: 盛夏海港风吹碎发写真

prompts.text: Usage: photorealistic-natural, continuing the "Midsummer Harbor After-school Wandering" portrait photography scheme. Image 1 is the main photography reference for this shot, responsible for the horizontal facial close-up in the strong harbor wind, messy hair crossing facial features, greenish sky and water surface, natural skin, and low-commercial-polish old digital texture; it does not bear character identity. Image 2 is the auxiliary photography reference for the same strong daylight harbor sub-scheme, only supplementing the environmental relationship of port bicycles, fishing boats, and wind-blown ties; it does not change the close-up lighting and focus fall-off of Image 1, nor does it bear character identity. This shot re-generates an adult original female of the "clear and agile, recognizable beauty with a sea breeze feel" type, do not inherit the face of the person in the portrait reference images. She has a soft narrow oval face, light and natural jawline, relaxed eyes and brows, bright and clear black eyes, an elegant nose bridge, and a soft lip shape; her facial features are natural and memorable, not a templated influencer face; "plain water" makeup, natural semi-matte skin, the large area of the forehead and cheeks maintain soft diffuse reflection, with narrow highlights only on the nose bridge and the cupid's bow; black high ponytail, short straight bangs, and messy hair blown by the wind. She wears a slightly wrinkled white shirt and a loosened dark blue striped tie, with white wired earphones worn on only one side. Generate a brand new horizontal 3:2 shoulder-to-face close-up portrait. The camera is nearly at eye level with the character, shot close from the front-side of the railing; the character's body and head-shoulders face the front-left of the frame, the face occupies about one-third of the right side of the frame, and the left side retains a large area of low-detail cyan-blue sky, harbor water surface, and blurred boats. A ship whistle suddenly sounds from afar, she has just taken the other earphone from her ear, fingers holding the earbud near her collar, eyes lifted toward the source of the sound, the tip of her brow slightly raised, lips slightly parted; a strand of hair blown by the wind crosses her eyes and nose bridge, her expression is like a real reaction, not a posed smile. Background bicycles and boats serve only as low-sharpness color blocks, without making every part clear. The midsummer noon sun in world space is fixed at the front-left-above of the character; hard light falls on the light-facing eye, the narrow zone of the nose bridge, the cupid's bow, the white shirt collar, and the fingertips holding the earbud, while the other side of the face is provided with very weak cold cyan fill-in from the sea surface. Wind-blown hair strands cast fine, directional short shadows on the face, and the black hair shows only scattered cold highlights, not forming a continuous warm outline. Skin tone is natural and light, sky and seawater are greenish, black levels are slightly lifted, highlights overflow softly, edges are slightly soft, fine grain, low micro-contrast, and light old digital compression; focus prioritized on the light-facing eye and the hair strand flying across the nose bridge, with the ear and rear ponytail naturally falling off. Do not have a full-face oily shine, commercial skin smoothing, warm backlighting, creamy bokeh, HDR, or excessive digital sharpening. Eyes, nose, lips, fingers, earbuds, earphone wires, and shoulder-neck structures are natural, with only one person. Add artistic handwritten text "nuyoah" in the bottom right corner of the image as a signature, and no other text or extra watermarks besides that. items.title: 极简多风格四层竖版艺术拼接海报

prompts.text:
Please turn the photo I uploaded into a vertical collage poster with an overall 3:4 vertical composition. The image is strictly divided into four horizontal areas from top to bottom, and the height of each area must be precisely controlled at 25% of the overall image height (the four-layer ratio is strictly 1:1:1:1, no ratio deviation allowed), with seamless connection between areas, no dividers or gaps. The order is: Original Image -> Style 1 -> Style 2 -> Style 3. Since each layer has an extremely flat and wide aspect ratio of approximately 3:1, it is suggested to arrange the subjects of each layer centered horizontally, emphasizing open white space and a sense of breathability on the left and right, avoiding longitudinal stretching, deformation, or crowded edges. The four layers maintain continuity and resonance in terms of character positioning, scene structure, and eye direction, presenting an overall sense of one image with four translations. The style layers (second to fourth layers) must follow minimalist principles: the number of visual elements in each layer is compressed to the minimum, retaining only one core subject symbol, while other secondary decorations, background details, and foil elements are all omitted, with the white space proportion no less than 60%.

The first layer retains the original photo's main structure, real character interactions and poses, real textures, natural light and shadow, and the original color atmosphere, with only slight professional photography color grading to present a magazine photography texture, without changing the character relationships or composition logic. The sky, ground, or environmental background can be naturally extended without changing character relationships or composition logic to make the overall look more spacious and narrative.

The second layer is in Blue and White Porcelain style: borrowing from blue and white porcelain painting techniques, using cobalt blue lines and smudging on a cream-white base to represent characters and scenes, presenting the sparse and elegant feel of porcelain patterns. Colors are monochromatic, mainly cobalt blue and cream-white. Avoid too many levels of blue intensity that look messy, and avoid piling up patterned decorations.

The third layer is in Dunhuang Mural style: borrowing the mineral heavy-color texture of Dunhuang murals to express a primitive and mottled beauty, lines and color blocks need to be simplified. The background is an earth yellow or ochre base color with a mottled mural texture. Colors are mainly ochre, azurite, cinnabar, and earth yellow. Avoid piling up too many crack textures and avoid complex pattern decorations.

The fourth layer is in Embroidery Brocade style: using embroidery stitch textures to represent characters and scene outlines, presenting silk luster and needlework texture, the patterns must be minimally summarized. The background is a cream-white or light gray satin base color. Colors consist of 2 to 3 soft colors paired with gold thread accents. Avoid overly dense stitches that look complicated, and avoid too many gold threads that look flashy.

Each layer must uniformly convert the subject and scene into the corresponding style, with overall expression being extremely restrained and simplified, keeping only the most core subject symbol and its basic outline relationship, deleting all non-essential background elements, decorative details, and foils; key positional relationships, interaction directions, and postural characteristics between characters must be retained but should be abstracted into recognizable outline relationships, achieving 'fewer elements, clearer relationships'. Colors are all extracted and summarized from the original image, with each layer strictly controlled within 2-4 main colors. The height ratio of the four areas must be strictly maintained at 1:1:1:1 (25% each), with no splicing misalignment or ratio deviation. Avoid cyberpunk/cyberpunk styles, forced superposition of realistic photo textures, cartoon styles, 3D rendering feel, commercial poster feel, complex background stacking, excessive elements or crowded screens, similar styles between adjacent layers, and any text, logos, watermarks, or titles.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的照片制作成一张竖版拼图海报，整体采用 3:4 竖版构图。画面从上到下严格四等分为四个横向区域，每个区域的高度必须精确控制为整体画面高度的25%（四层比例严格为1:1:1:1，不允许出现比例偏差），区域之间无缝衔接，不设分隔线、不留间隙，顺序为：原图→风格1→风格2→风格3。由于每层为约3:1的极扁宽幅比例，各层主体建议横向居中排布，强调左右开阔留白与呼吸感，避免元素纵向拉伸变形或贴边拥挤。四层在人物站位、场景结构、视线方向上保持连贯呼应，呈现同一画面、四种转译的整体感。风格层（第二至四层）须遵循极简原则：每层视觉元素数量压缩至最低限度，只保留1个最核心的主体符号，其余次要装饰、背景细节与陪衬元素一律省略，画面留白占比不低于60%。

第一层保留原始照片的主体结构、人物真实互动关系与姿态、真实质感、自然光影与原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，呈现杂志摄影质感，不改变人物关系与构图逻辑，并可在不改变人物关系与构图逻辑的前提下自然扩展天空、地面或环境背景，使整体更具空间感与叙事感。

第二层为青花瓷绘风格：借鉴青花瓷绘画技法，以钴蓝色线条与晕染在米白底上表现人物与场景，呈现瓷器纹样的疏朗雅致感。色彩以钴蓝与米白为主的单色系。避免蓝色浓淡层次过多显杂，避免图案化装饰堆砌。

第三层为敦煌壁画风格：借鉴敦煌壁画矿物重彩质感，表现古朴斑驳的美感，需简化线条与色块。背景为土黄或赭石底色，带斑驳壁画肌理感。色彩以赭石、石青、朱砂、土黄为主。避免裂纹肌理过多堆砌，避免复杂纹样装饰。

第四层为刺绣锦缎风格：以刺绣针脚肌理表现人物与场景轮廓，呈现丝缎光泽与针线纹理感，图案需极简概括。背景为米白或浅灰缎面底色。色彩以2至3种柔和色搭配金线点缀。避免针脚过密显繁琐，避免金线过多显浮夸。

每一层需将主体与场景统一转换为对应风格，整体表达极度克制与简化，只保留最核心的一个主体符号及其基本轮廓关系，删除一切非必要的背景元素、装饰细节与陪衬物；人物之间的关键位置关系、互动方向与姿态特征需保留，但应抽象为可识别的轮廓关系，做到“元素越少、关系越清晰”。色彩均从原图中提取归纳，每层严格控制在2-4种主色以内。四个区域的高度比例须严格保持1:1:1:1（各占25%），不可出现拼接错位或比例偏差。整体避免朋克/赛博朋克风格、写实照片质感强行叠加、卡通风格、3D渲染感、商业海报感、复杂背景堆砌、元素过多或画面拥挤、相邻两层风格雷同，以及任何文字、Logo、水印或标题。

prompts.text:
Subject:
Blue Mosaic in a Hot Spring

Main Body:
Soaking in an outdoor shallow hot spring surrounded by trees and rocks, a woman in her 20s brings her upper body close to the camera. The part above the thighs is placed largely in the center of the frame, wearing a blue mosaic pattern bikini swimsuit, wet short hair, depicting water droplets on the skin.

Person/Expression:
Round oval face and a small, not overly sharp chin, large amber pupils, slender and soft eyebrows, a small nose, and glossy pale peach lips. Tilting the face slightly to the left side of the frame, looking straight at the camera with a quiet smiling expression. Light brown wet hair below the chin, thin clumped bangs, hair tips along the cheeks. Pale peach blush and understated eye makeup.

Clothing/Pose:
A triangle bikini swimsuit scattered with blue, light blue, peach, and white small mosaic patterns. Clearly depict the dark blue neck strap, gold rings, fine lace edges and small bows on the chest, and the ties and tassels on both sides of the waist. Leaning the upper body forward, placing her own left hand lightly on the hair by her left ear. The right arm hangs down in front of the body.

Background/Light:
The foreground and right side are transparent shallow hot spring water, the left side features gray rocks and a wooden lantern, the distance shows a bamboo fence and thick green trees, and the far right shows a small stream of water. Soft direct sunlight through the leaves from the upper right of the frame illuminates the water droplets on the hair, cheeks, shoulders, and chest, and creates circular bokeh in the background.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 2:3. A portrait from above the thighs taken from a close-range shot slightly higher than the water surface. Placing the face and upper body large in the upper center, with the waist ties placed at the bottom left and right, and rocks and lanterns in the left background. The thighs are cut off at the bottom edge. Both eyes are in sharp focus, the background is softly blurred, using a shallow depth of field.

Texture/Style:
A photorealistic real-life photo taken with warm natural light. High-definition depiction of skin texture and water droplets, wet hair, mosaic pattern fabric, lace, rocks, and water surface reflections.

Negative:
Major changes to facial features and wet short hair; monochrome conversion of the blue mosaic pattern.

prompts.text:
Subject:
Only reproduce a fictional adult Japanese woman as an urban fashion portrait wearing a white long-sleeved ribbed knit sweater and a gray pleated skirt, on a modern indoor staircase. The person tilts her body slightly to one side halfway up the stairs, smiling brightly at the camera positioned above. In a vertical 9:16 frame, the center of the face is located at about 27% from the top and 50% horizontally, and the line connecting the eyes is at about 25% from the top. The top of the head is about 5% from the top edge, the head width including hair is about 29% of the frame width, the shoulder width is about 50%, and the upper body and upper part of the skirt occupy about 78% of the frame height. A slender tan bag strap is visible near the left shoulder. Hands and stair handrails are almost outside the frame in this crop, so do not add them forcibly. Maintain a mature, steady facial expression and natural body proportions; do not change to a juvenile face or excessive thinness.

Face/Makeup:
The face shape is a smooth oval, with natural roundness in the cheeks and a gentle delicacy at the tip of the chin. Eyebrows are dark brown with medium thickness, in a relaxed arch, retaining the flow of hair. Eyes are slender almond-shaped, with a gaze slightly upward but directed at the camera, keeping both pupils aligned. Upper eyelid lines and eyelashes remain low-key; do not add heavy eyeliner or gaudy eyeshadow. The bridge of the nose is naturally slender, retaining the shape of the tip and nostrils. The mouth is a bright smile showing teeth, with both corners of the mouth turned up, and the lip color is a low-saturation rose beige. Skin is a bright natural tone, with a faint flush on the cheeks, thin shadows around the eyes, and slightly visible pores. Avoid strong highlights, contour-reducing processing, over-whitening, or corrections that make teeth look like a single plate. Maintain an adult freshness, and do not turn the face into a completely symmetrical CG.

Hair:
Hair is near-black dark brown straight long hair, flowing to both sides from a slightly off-center parting, falling over the shoulders and in front/behind the chest. Thick and thin strands form on both sides of the face, with one side naturally falling in front of the shoulder and the other side leaning toward the back. Extremely subtle flow due to the air on the stairs or body orientation is allowed, but do not blow excessively. Subtle gloss is shown on the top of the head and the outer side receiving window light, retaining recognizable layers of hair strands even in dark areas. Hair ends extend into the lower crop area of the frame; do not invent invisible lengths or the shape of the back of the head. Do not add wet hair, strong curls, short bangs, flashy colors, hats, or hair accessories. Hair should not penetrate shoulder straps, necklaces, or clothing, overlapping naturally in the foreground or background.

Expression/Gaze:
At the moment the face turns slightly upward to look at the camera, create a friendly and open smile showing teeth. The gaze is fixed on the lens at the top of the frame; do not change to a squint, look down, or look into the distance. The smile raises the cheeks, slightly narrows the lower eyelids, and links the corners of the mouth with the eyes. Do not change to a face with wide-eyed surprise, protruding lips, a provocative half-open gaze, or an excessively wide laugh. Teeth maintain natural size and shadows, avoiding extra teeth, melting boundaries, or excessive whiteness. Create a natural emotion like turning back halfway up the stairs to give a light greeting to an acquaintance. Do not add unnecessary tension between the eyebrows or on the forehead; retain small left-right differences in the face.

Pose/Hands/Contact:
The body is placed diagonally relative to the direction of the stairs, with one shoulder slightly forward and the neck elongated with the face upward. The upper body is nearly vertical, but creates a slight center of gravity difference as if walking or stopping. Do not shrug the shoulders; white long-sleeved arms extend naturally along the sides of the body. In the original vertical crop, contact with hands or handrails is insufficient to appear, so do not add hands near the face or force a grip on the handrail. If parts of the arms are visible at the edges of the frame, do not newly expose fingers or wrists; maintain the existing cropping method. The bag strap extends diagonally downward from the left shoulder, but do not invent the bag itself outside the frame. Do not complete invisible legs, feet, stair contact surfaces, or the back of the clothing; only naturalize the person's center of gravity.

Clothing/Accessories:
The top is a white to ivory long-sleeved ribbed knit sweater, with a V-neck that is not too deep or wide to reveal the area around the collarbones. The whole piece has slender vertical ribs, sleeves extend toward the wrists, and the body fits moderately but not vacuum-tight. Small wrinkles follow the pose at the chest, underarms, and waist; do not lose the knit texture due to overexposure. The bottom is a medium-gray pleated skirt, with vertical pleats appearing at uneven, natural intervals. A thin gold chain and a small pendant are placed on the neck, and only one tan or camel-colored thin bag strap is placed on the left shoulder. The bag body, shoes, watches, and rings are not visible, so do not add them. Logos, text, patterns, flashy decorations, see-through effects, or excessive chest exposure are prohibited.

Location/Time/Background:
The background is an indoor transparent staircase reminiscent of a high-rise building or modern commercial facility, with gray, beige, and white as the main tones. Diagonally placed stairs, horizontal or diagonal handrails, walls, and depth extending to upper floors are blurred behind the person. Do not add building names, shop names, logos, text, signs, or other people. Lighting is natural light entering from large windows above or from the side at midday; the background is bright but do not show night scenes or outdoor landscapes. When positioning, ensure stair lines do not unnaturally protrude from the person's neck or head, using the background's geometric shapes as a frame surrounding the person. Do not determine the specific location or purpose of the place; do not assume invisible settings such as stations, hotels, or offices. The background is softer and more blurred than the person, retaining only an urban sense of space.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 9:16, using a composition centered on the upper body, placing the person in the middle from the chest up to the upper part of the skirt. The center of the face is 49-51% horizontally and about 27% from the top; the pendant is placed near 50% horizontally and about 50% from the top; the shoulder width is fixed at about 50% of the frame width. There is about 5% margin above the top of the head, and more than 9% on each side outside the hair or shoulders, with the bottom cropped mid-skirt. The person's visual center is maintained at 47-53% horizontally, with diagonal stair lines escaping to the left and right background. The camera is aimed at the vicinity of the gaze from a position slightly higher than the person, creating the feeling of the woman looking up, but avoiding extreme high-angle shots or shortened body proportions. Use a standard smartphone field of view, with clear focus on the face, hair, white knit, and pendant, and medium blurring of the stairs. Avoid fisheye, ultra-wide-angle edge distortion, telephoto flattening, or tilted vertical lines. Do not place hands or feet in unnatural positions.

Light Source:
The main light source is soft daylight entering from above or the side of the transparent stairs, illuminating from the front diagonal above the face, the shoulders of the white knit, and the outer edges of the hair. The opposite side is slightly lifted by weak reflections from walls or floors, ensuring half of the face does not turn black. Small natural catchlights are placed in both eyes; do not add hard flash spots or multi-colored light. The bright areas of the white knit are bright but do not lose the ribbing and collarline contours. Soft shadows form under the chin, on the neck, inside the hair, and in the skirt pleats, unifying the light direction. The background has slightly dark mid-tones and some bright surfaces, ensuring the face receives eye-catching exposure first. Avoid strong rim light, neon, sunset orange, or skin-only glow processing.

Color/Gradation:
Composed of a white knit, gray pleated skirt, thin tan strap, small gold pendant, dark brown hair, natural skin tone, and gray to beige architectural background. Saturation is low to medium, maintaining a neutral urban fashion atmosphere. The white clothing does not blend with the background white, creating a brightness difference for visible contours and ribbing. The gray skirt does not have strong color casts of blue or purple, with only the pendant and strap remaining as small areas of warm color. The person's skin and the white knit are not placed at the same brightness; the skin is assigned a very thin warm color, and the knit is assigned a neutral white. Faint layers are retained even in the dark areas deep in the stairs; do not turn the background into a single flat gray board. Skin does not lean toward yellow-orange; cheeks and lips retain a faint flush. Highlights, mid-tones, and shadows are smoothly connected, avoiding strong HDR, blue-green-orange, sepia tones, or crushed blacks/blown-out whites. Finished with simple colors and fresh gradations like a smartphone photo. The white and beige of the architectural background maintain a contrast one level lower than the person's clothing, ensuring the gaze does not move away from the face.

Material/Subtle Texture:
Skin retains pores on the cheeks, forehead, and around the nose, and fine lines around the eyes caused by the smile, showing them discreetly; do not plasticize. Hair has strands of different thicknesses, fine flyaways, and small glints of natural light; do not make it uniform, plate-like, or wire-like. The white ribbed knit expresses vertical knit patterns, soft thickness, and wrinkles at the shoulders and chest, avoiding satin-like strong gloss. The gray pleated skirt has light and dark between pleats and fabric drape; do not make it look like stiff paper or metal. The bag strap is a thin strap of matte leather or synthetic leather, and the pendant is only a small metallic reflection. The background walls and handrails have lower resolution than the person, guarding the depth of field of a real shot. Do not add excessive contour emphasis, fake textures, or repeating AI textures.

Image Processing/Finish:
Finish as a fashion snapshot that looks like it was taken with a smartphone in a modern indoor staircase. Lightly adjust the overall exposure, white balance, and shadows; do not brighten only the face as if it were a separate layer. Local skin correction is limited to evening out small spots; do not deform contours, eyes, nose, mouth, or dentition. Mild sharpness is applied to the pupils, corners of the mouth, front edge of the hair, knit ribbing, and pendant, with the background smoothly blurred. Slightly correct architectural line distortion, but retain the natural perspective of the camera position. Do not create cutout halos around the hair, making the background blur boundaries continuous. Do not add text, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders, collages, dividers, or multiple scenes; finish with only one adult woman and one staircase space.

Collapse Avoidance/Prohibitions:
Fix the same adult woman, dark long hair, upward smile, white ribbed knit, gray pleated skirt, small gold pendant, tan shoulder strap, indoor stairs, and soft daylight. Do not change to other clothing, characters, backgrounds, or strong colors. Prohibit eye deviation, extra teeth, melting ears, neck distortion, split shoulder straps, pendant multiplication, or hair merging with clothing. Do not speculate on showing hands, bag bodies, legs, shoes, or stair contact points outside the frame. Do not unnaturally grip the handrail, and ensure background lines do not penetrate the head or neck. Avoid see-through clothing, excessive chest emphasis, or juvenile faces. Generate only a natural vertical photo of an adult woman; no multiple people, mirroring, text, logos, collages, grids, illustrations, or 3D.

prompts.text:
被摄主体：
仅将一名虚构的成年日本女性，作为穿着白色长袖罗纹针织衫和灰色百褶裙的都市时尚肖像，在现代室内楼梯中再现。人物在楼梯中途将身体微微斜向一边，脸朝上方相机明亮微笑。纵向9:16画面中，脸中心位于上端约27%、横向50%，双眼连线位于上端约25%。头顶至上端约5%，包含头发在内的头部宽度约为画面宽度的29%，肩宽约为50%，上半身和裙子上部占据画面高的约78%。在左肩附近显示细长的棕褐色包肩带。手和楼梯扶手在此裁剪中几乎位于画面外，因此不要强行添加。保持成人的沉稳面容和自然的体型比例，不要改为幼态脸庞或过度纤细。

脸部·妆容：
脸型为光滑的椭圆形，脸颊带有自然的圆润，下巴尖端保持温和的细腻。眉毛为深棕色的中等粗细，呈松弛的拱形，保留毛流向。眼睛为细长的杏仁形，视线略微上扬但对准相机，左右瞳孔方向保持一致。上眼睑线条和睫毛保持低调，不要添加浓重的眼线或艳丽的眼影。鼻梁自然纤细，保留鼻尖和小鼻的形状。嘴巴为露出牙齿的明亮笑容，嘴角两侧均上扬，唇色为低饱和度的玫瑰米色。皮肤为明亮的自然肤色，脸颊保留淡淡的血色，眼周保留薄薄的阴影，毛孔略微可见。避免强烈的亮点、削减轮廓的加工、过度白皙化、牙齿板状化的修正。保持成人的清爽感，不要将脸部完全对称化为CG。

头发：
头发为接近黑色的深棕色直长发，从略微偏离中心的发缝向两侧流动，垂落在肩部和胸前身后。脸部两侧形成粗细不同的发束，一侧自然落在肩前，另一侧偏向背部。允许因楼梯空气或身体朝向而产生的极微弱流动，但不要大幅飘扬。头顶和受窗光的外侧显示细微的光泽，即使在暗部也保留可辨识发束方向的层次。发梢延伸至画面下部裁剪范围，不要虚构不可见的长度或后脑勺形状。不要添加湿发、强烈卷发、短刘海、艳丽颜色、帽子、发饰。头发不要穿透肩带、项链或服装，自然地重叠于前景或背景。

表情·视线：
脸部略微上扬注视相机的瞬间，营造亲切而开放的露出牙齿笑容。视线对准画面上方的镜头，不要改为斜视、下视或远眺。笑容使脸颊上提，下眼睑略微变窄，嘴角与眼周联动。不要改为惊讶睁大眼睛的脸庞、嘴唇前突的表情、挑逗性的半睁眼、过度张嘴的笑声。牙齿保持自然的大小和阴影，避免多余牙齿、融化般的边界、过度白皙。营造在楼梯中途回头、向熟人轻声打招呼般的自然情感。不要在眉间或额头添加不必要的紧张，保留脸部的微小左右差异。

姿势·手指·接触：
身体相对于楼梯方向呈斜向放置，一侧肩膀略微前伸，脖子伸长脸部向上。上半身接近垂直，但营造行走或停步瞬间的轻微重心差异。不要耸肩，白色长袖手臂自然沿身体侧面延伸。原纵向裁剪中双手或扶手接触不足以显现，因此不要在脸部附近添加手，或强迫握紧扶手。若画面边缘可见手臂部分，也不要新暴露手指或手腕，保持既有的裁剪方式。包肩带从左肩斜向下延伸，但不要虚构画面外的包本体。不要补全不可见的腿部、脚部、楼梯接触面、服装背面，仅自然化人物的重心。

服装·配饰：
上衣为从白色至象牙白的长袖罗纹针织衫，V领不宜过深或领口较宽以显露锁骨周边。整体带有细长的纵向罗纹，袖子延伸至手腕方向，身体部分适度贴合但不真空紧贴。在胸口、腋下、腰部形成随姿势的小皱褶，不要因过曝而丢失编织纹理。下装为中灰色的百褶裙，纵向褶皱以不均匀的自然间距显现。颈部放置一条细金色链子和一个小吊坠，左肩仅放置一条棕褐色或骆驼色的细包肩带。不可见包本体、鞋子、手表、戒指因此不要添加。禁止logo、文字、图案、艳丽装饰、透视、过度胸口暴露。

场所·时间·背景：
背景为让人联想到高层建筑或现代商业设施的室内通透楼梯，以灰色、米色、白色为主调。人物后方模糊配置斜向楼梯、水平或斜向扶手、墙面、上层延伸的纵深。不要添加建筑名称、店铺名称、logo、文字、指示牌、其他人物。光线为从中午时分上方或侧方大窗进入的自然光，背景部分明亮但不要显示夜景或室外景观。配置时确保楼梯线条不从人物颈部或头部不自然伸出，背景的几何形状作为包围人物的框架。不要确定场所的具体位置或用途，如车站、酒店、办公室等不可见设定不要断定。背景比人物更柔和模糊，仅保留都市空间感。

构图·相机：
纵向9:16，采用以上半身为中心，从胸上至裙子上部将人物置于中央的构图。脸中心横向49〜51%、上端约27%，吊坠置于横向50%附近、上端约50%，肩宽固定为画面宽度的约50%。头顶上方余白约5%，左右各留发或肩外9%以上，下端在裙子中途裁剪。人物视觉中心保持横向47〜53%，楼梯斜线向左右背景逸出。相机从略高于人物的位置对准视线附近，营造女性抬头观看的感觉，但避免极端俯视或身材比例缩短。采用智能手机标准画角，对脸部、头发、白色针织衫、吊坠明确对焦，楼梯中等程度模糊。避免鱼眼、超广角边缘扭曲、长焦平坦化、倾斜垂直线。不要将手或脚置于不自然位置。

光源：
主光源为从楼梯通透上方或侧方进入的柔和日光，从脸部正面斜上方、白色针织衫肩部、头发外缘照亮。反侧由墙壁或地面弱反射抬高，确保脸部一半不发黑。双眼置入小型自然光捕捉光，不要添加闪光硬点或多色光。白色针织衫明部明亮，但不丢失罗纹和领口轮廓。在下巴下方、颈部、头发内侧、裙子褶皱形成柔和阴影，统一光向。背景略暗的中调和部分明亮面，确保脸部首先入眼曝光。避免强烈轮廓光、霓虹、夕阳橙色、仅皮肤发光处理。

色彩·层次：
由白色针织衫、灰色百褶裙、棕褐色细肩带、金色小吊坠、深棕色头发、自然肤色、灰至米色的建筑背景构成。饱和度从低至中程度，维持中性都市时尚氛围。白色服装与背景白色不融合，制造可见轮廓和罗纹的明度差。灰色裙子不添加蓝色或紫色的强烈色偏，仅吊坠和肩带作为小面积暖色保留。人物皮肤与白色针织衫不置于相同亮度，皮肤分配极薄暖色，针织衫分配中性白。楼梯深处的暗部也保留微弱层次，不要将背景变为单一片灰板。皮肤不偏向黄橙色，脸颊和嘴唇保留淡淡血色。平滑连接高光、中间调、阴影，避免强烈HDR、蓝绿橙色、棕褐调、黑压白飞。以智能手机照片般的朴实色彩和清爽层次完成。

建筑背景的白色和米色保持比人物服装低一级的对比，确保视线不从脸部移开。

材质·细微质感：
皮肤保留脸颊、额头、鼻周的毛孔、笑容带来的眼周细纹，低调显现，不要塑胶化。头发带有粗细不同的发束、细碎后发、自然光的小光泽，不要均一板状或金属丝状。白色罗纹针织衫表现纵向编织纹、柔和厚度、肩部和胸口皱褶，避免缎面般的强烈光泽。灰色百褶裙带有褶皱间的明暗和布料垂坠感，不要硬纸或金属质。包肩带为哑光皮革或人造革的细带，吊坠仅为小金属反射。背景墙壁和扶手比人物降低分辨率，守护实拍景深。不要添加过度轮廓强调、伪造织纹、重复AI纹理。

图像处理·完成：
完成成一张看起来像在现代室内楼梯用智能手机拍摄的时尚快照。整体轻微调整曝光、白平衡、阴影，不要仅脸部如单独图层般变亮。皮肤局部修正仅限于调匀小色斑，不要变形轮廓、眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、牙列。锐度温和施加于瞳孔、嘴角、头发前缘、针织罗纹、吊坠，背景平滑模糊。轻微修正建筑线条扭曲，但保留相机位置的自然远近感。不要在头发周围制造抠图光晕，使背景虚化边界连续。不要添加文字、logo、签名、浮水印、边框、拼贴、分隔、多场景，仅以一名成年女性和一个楼梯空间完结。

崩溃回避·禁止：
固定同一成年女性、深色长发、上扬笑容、白色罗纹针织衫、灰色百褶裙、金色小吊坠、棕褐色肩带、室内楼梯、柔和日光。不要更改为其他服装、人物、背景、强烈颜色。禁止眼球偏移、多余牙齿、融化耳朵、脖子扭曲、肩带分叉、吊坠增殖、头发与服装融合。不要推测显示画面外的双手、包本体、腿部、鞋子、楼梯接触。不要不自然握紧扶手，确保背景线条不穿透头部或脖子。避免服装透视、过度胸部强调、幼态脸庞。仅生成自然成年女性的纵向照片，不要多人物、镜像、文字、logo、拼贴、网格、插图、3D。

prompts.text:
9:16 vertical full-body fantasy character illustration, dark samurai gothic aesthetic, high-fashion warrior design, painterly concept art with expressive ink-brush energy.

A beautiful young East Asian female warrior standing in a powerful three-quarter pose against a minimal warm pale beige-gray background. She has delicate refined facial features, porcelain-pale realistic skin, narrow dark eyes, subtle muted-red eye makeup, soft natural lips, and thin understated eyeglasses. Her expression is calm, cold, detached and quietly dangerous.

Her extremely long black hair explodes upward and outward in the wind, individual strands dissolving into loose ink-like strokes. A striking silver-white streak of hair sweeps horizontally across her face, partially crossing one eye, creating strong directional movement.

She wears elaborate black-and-antique-silver samurai-inspired gothic armor, combining Japanese armor construction with dark fantasy haute couture. Huge sharply raised black shoulder plates, sculptural high collar, layered lacquer-black arm guards, engraved silver fittings, ornate skull-like metallic motifs, fitted black armored corset, asymmetrical hip armor, black thigh-high armored boots and intricate silver knee guards.

The armor is glossy but weathered, with subtle scratches, tarnished silver edges, engraved ornamental metalwork and restrained reflections. Beneath the armor are torn charcoal-gray fabric layers and long sweeping black-gray skirt panels.

Several pieces of vivid saturated crimson-red cords, knots and torn tassels hang from her waist and thigh armor. The red is exceptionally intense and clean — almost cinnabar / blood-crimson — becoming the strongest chromatic accent in an otherwise nearly monochromatic image. Small restrained crimson accents also appear around the eyes and armor details.

She holds a long slender black katana downward in one hand while the other hand grips the dark wrapped hilt of another sword at her hip. The weapons are elegant, extremely elongated and understated rather than oversized.

Her enormous black-gray cloak and skirt dissolve outward into broad, energetic dry-brush ink strokes, sweeping dramatically around the lower half of the composition. Fabric edges partially disappear into abstract painterly gestures, creating the feeling that the warrior herself is emerging from a traditional ink painting.

Strong visual contrast between highly resolved face and armor details and deliberately unresolved expressive brushwork around the silhouette. Sophisticated controlled chaos, localized areas approaching visual abstraction while the character remains perfectly legible.

Minimal background, generous negative space, no scenery, no typography, no symbols, no logo, no watermark, no star icon.

Palette dominated by lacquer black, charcoal gray, gunmetal, antique silver and warm pale gray, punctuated exclusively by brilliant deep crimson-red accents.

Japanese dark-fantasy concept art, contemporary Asian fashion illustration, sumi-e inspired gestural brushwork, elegant gothic samurai aesthetic, extremely intricate armor craftsmanship, realistic metallic reflections, delicate skin rendering, dynamic wind movement, sophisticated composition, cinematic character design, painterly realism, information-dense but visually controlled, masterpiece character concept art.

Aspect ratio 9:16.

prompts.text:
9:16 纵向全身奇幻角色插画，暗黑武士哥特美学，高级时装战士设计，具有表现力水墨笔触能量的绘画风格概念艺术。

一位美丽的年轻东亚女战士，以强有力的四分之三姿态站在极简的温暖浅米灰色背景前。她拥有精致优雅的面部特征，瓷白写实的皮肤，狭长的黑眼睛，微妙的暗红色眼妆，柔软自然的嘴唇，以及细致简约的眼镜。她的表情冷静、冷酷、超然且透着危险。

她极长的黑发在风中向上向外爆发，发丝溶解成松散的墨迹笔触。一缕醒目的银白色头发横向扫过她的脸部，部分穿过一只眼睛，创造出强烈的方向感。

她穿着精致的黑色与仿古银色武士启发哥特盔甲，结合了日本盔甲结构与暗黑奇幻高级定制时装。巨大的尖锐升起黑色肩甲，雕塑感的高领，分层的漆黑色护臂，雕刻的银色配件，华丽的类骷髅金属图案，贴身的黑色铠甲束身衣，不对称的髋部盔甲，黑色过膝装甲靴和复杂的银色护膝。

盔甲光泽但有磨损感，带有细微划痕、晦暗的银色边缘、雕刻装饰金属制品和克制的反射。盔甲之下是撕裂的炭灰色织物层和长长的飘逸黑灰色裙摆。

几根鲜艳饱和的深红色绳索、结和撕裂的流苏挂在她的腰部和大腿装甲上。红色异常强烈且纯净——几乎是朱砂/血红色——成为在原本几近单色的图像中最强的色彩重点。眼睛周围和盔甲细节处也出现了少量的克制红色点缀。

她一只手向下握着一把细长的黑色武士刀，另一只手紧握腰间另一把剑的黑色缠绕剑柄。武器优雅、极其修长且简约，而非夸张巨大。

她巨大的黑灰色斗篷和裙子向外溶解成宽阔、充满活力的干笔水墨笔触，在构图的下半部分剧烈扫动。织物边缘部分消失在抽象的绘画手势中，营造出战士本人仿佛正从传统水墨画中走出的感觉。

高度精细的面部和盔甲细节与轮廓周围刻意未完成的表现主义笔触之间形成强烈的视觉对比。精致且受控的混沌，局部区域接近视觉抽象，而角色保持完美清晰。

极简背景，大量的负空间，无风景，无排版，无符号，无标志，无水印，无星星图标。

调色板以漆黑、炭灰、炮铜色、仿古银色和温暖的浅灰色为主，仅由亮丽的深红色调点缀。

日本暗黑奇幻概念艺术，当代亚洲时尚插画，水墨启发的手势笔触，优雅哥特武士美学，极度复杂的盔甲工艺，写实的金属反射，细腻的皮肤渲染，动态的风力运动，精致的构图，电影感角色设计，绘画写实主义，信息密集但视觉受控，杰作级角色概念艺术。

纵横比 9:16。

run cross_section_page:

inference_cascade := derive the real layer stack (3–7) → each layer's actual thickness
   → its material and job → the one layer that is the selling point → whether the
   category cuts clean (blade) or tears (foam, bread)
hero_dna       := one unit sliced on a single flat plane, cut face square to camera,
                  intact exterior still visible at the edge so you read object then interior
strata_law     := layer thickness in the render is proportional to the real spec — a 2mm
                  layer cannot look the same as a 40mm layer. order is fixed and matches
                  the labels. every cut face shows interior structure different from that
                  material's exterior (open cells, crumb, weave, grain).
cut_honesty    := the cut behaves like the material — foam compresses at the blade, bread
                  tears, metal shows a burr, chocolate fractures. a laser-clean cut through
                  a soft material is a failure.
label_geometry := leader lines land on the exact layer named, no crossings, all labels on
                  one side, thickness in real units beside each
depth_cue      := the cut plane is lit slightly brighter than the receding interior
color_discipline := neutral ground + one signal color reserved for the hero layer and cta
imperfection   := one layer slightly compressed or displaced where the blade passed
frame          := 16:10; commerce chrome present — nav, price, add to cart
mood           := "so that's what's inside"

render: one screen where the interior sells harder than the exterior ever could.

forbidden — objects: invented layers, decorative gradient bands standing in for material
forbidden — look: uniform layer thicknesses, labels pointing between layers, identical
texture on cut face and outer surface, multiple contradictory cut planes, a soft material
cut like glass

prompts.text:
Create a premium vertical real-estate sales poster for a fictional boutique developer brand called AUREN CASA, refined with stronger Orbit reveal energy and more polished Transit luxury. Preserve the original structural logic exactly: a soft warm beige luxury interior background in shallow depth of field, a large central modern villa maquette floating between two realistic human hands, the upper hand lifting a thin roof slab upward, the lower hand supporting the architectural model from beneath, a clean logo-and-headline zone at the top, and a compact branded contact-information strip at the bottom. The whole image must feel like a flagship property-launch visual: elegant, emotionally warm, and internationally premium.

Main visual:
At the center, place one ultra-refined two-story modern villa maquette with fully visible cutaway interiors. Strengthen the Orbit direction by making the lifted roof plane and the supported house body feel more dynamically related, as if the act of opening the roof is actively releasing the living experience inside. The gap between roof slab and model should feel deliberate and slightly more dramatic, while remaining realistic and controlled. The house model must feel handcrafted, valuable, and architecturally believable: slim dark metal frame, floor-to-ceiling glass, warm walnut or oak surfaces, recessed lighting, elegant living room, dining zone, upper private suite, indoor greenery, and clean layered floor plates.

Architecture and interiors:
The villa must read as a premium product, not a conceptual toy. Lower floor: open-plan living and dining with refined furniture, warm shelves, art piece, and subtle residential luxury. Upper floor: softer intimate bedroom or lounge suite. Materials must be rendered with great care: timber, glass, matte slabs, metal framing, upholstery texture, ambient light glow, and miniature lifestyle elegance. The interior should feel warm, inviting, and globally premium.

Hands and realism:
Both hands must be realistic, elegant, and anatomically correct, with natural finger spacing, believable grip pressure, fine skin texture, and beauty-commercial lighting. The upper hand should feel graceful and intentional, delicately lifting the roof slab. The lower hand should feel stable and supportive, reinforcing craftsmanship and care. No hand distortion, no extra fingers, no awkward pose.

Transit direction:
Refine the whole page toward a more international, more editorial, and more luxurious launch-poster standard. Reduce graphic noise, keep the top branding cleaner, make the contact strip more understated, soften any excessive contrast in the background blur, and allow the central model to carry more of the emotional and commercial weight. The image should feel like a flagship collaboration between a top-tier developer and a premium interior design house.

Lighting and mood:
Use soft warm daylight with subtle architectural interior glow. Let the model receive elegant directional light from upper-right or upper-front, with delicate highlights on the roof slab, glass edges, timber interiors, and the hands. Strengthen light-shadow relationships enough to give the model genuine volume and make the lifted-roof action feel more dramatic. The background should remain creamy, blurred, and luxurious, with no distraction.

Typography and branding:
Top zone: one original minimal logo mark, one original developer name, and one short English headline such as “OPEN TO ELEVATED LIVING” or “WHERE SPACE BECOMES HOME,” fully original and not copied. Add one small supporting line beneath.  
Bottom strip: one elegant branded contact bar with original fictional phone number, city text, and website, cleaner and more restrained than a brochure banner.  
All typography must be original, modern, premium, and secondary to the architectural model.

Style:
Luxury real-estate launch poster, premium architecture-and-interior branding, boutique residential campaign, design-build property marketing, hyper-real commercial rendering with emotional warmth, Cannes-level developer advertising polish.

Color system:
Warm beige, soft taupe, cream, walnut brown, muted charcoal frame lines, amber interior glow, restrained dark text, and one subtle brand accent if needed. Keep everything calm, polished, and globally premium.

Negative prompt:
no copied brand names, no copied slogans, no cluttered background, no toy-house feel, no distorted roof geometry, no warped hands, no extra fingers, no malformed anatomy, no muddy shadows, no black blotches, no watermark, no existing logos, no noisy layout, no cheap brochure feel.

prompts.text:
为一个名为 AUREN CASA 的虚拟精品开发商品牌制作一张高级垂直房地产销售海报，并以更强的 Orbit 揭示能量和更精美的 Transit 奢华感进行完善。精确保留原始结构逻辑：背景为浅景深的柔和暖米色奢华室内，一个大型中央现代别墅模型悬浮在两只真实的人手之间，上方的手向上提起薄薄的屋顶板，下方的手从下方托住建筑模型，顶部是干净的标志和标题区域，底部是紧凑的品牌联系信息条。整个图像必须感觉像是一个旗舰物业发布视觉效果：优雅、情感温暖且具有国际高端感。

主视觉：
在中心放置一个极其精美的两层现代别墅模型，内部剖面完全可见。通过使升起的屋顶平面和被支撑的房屋主体之间的联系更具动态感，增强 Orbit 方向，仿佛打开屋顶的动作正在积极释放内部的居住体验。屋顶板与模型之间的间隙应该是刻意的，且稍微更具戏剧性，同时保持真实和可控。房屋模型必须感觉是手工制作的、有价值的且在建筑上令人信服：纤细的深色金属框架、落地玻璃、温暖的核桃木或橡木表面、嵌入式照明、优雅的客厅、用餐区、上层私人套房、室内绿植和干净的分层楼板。

建筑与室内：
别墅必须被视为高端产品，而不是概念玩具。底层：开放式起居和用餐区，配备精美的家具、温暖的架子、艺术品和微妙的住宅奢华感。上层：更柔和亲密的卧室或休息套房。材料的渲染必须非常用心：木材、玻璃、哑光板、金属框架、室内装潢纹理、环境光光泽和微型生活方式的优雅感。室内应感觉温暖、诱人且具有全球高端感。

手部与写实：
两只手都必须真实、优雅且解剖结构正确，具有自然的指缝、可信的握持压力、细腻的皮肤纹理和美容广告级的照明。上方的手应感觉优雅且有目的性，精致地提起屋顶板。下方的手应感觉稳定且具有支撑力，强化工艺和关怀。没有手部畸形，没有多余的手指，没有尴尬的姿势。

Transit 方向：
将整个页面向更国际化、更具编辑感和更奢华的发布海报标准精炼。减少图形噪音，保持顶部品牌更简洁，使联系条更含蓄，软化背景模糊中任何过度的对比，并让中央模型承担更多的情感和商业分量。图像应该感觉像是顶级开发商与高端室内设计事务所之间的旗舰合作。

灯光与氛围：
使用柔和的温暖日光和微妙的建筑室内光泽。让模型接受来自右上方或正前方的优雅定向光，在屋顶板、玻璃边缘、木质室内和手上产生精致的高光。加强光影关系，足以给模型真实的体积感，并让提起屋顶的动作感觉更具戏剧性。背景应保持奶油色、模糊且奢华，没有干扰。

排版与品牌：
顶部区域：一个原始简约的标志符号，一个原始开发商名称，以及一个简短的英文标题，如“OPEN TO ELEVATED LIVING”或“WHERE SPACE BECOMES HOME”，完全原创且非复制。在下方添加一行小的辅助线。
底部条带：一个优雅的品牌联系栏，带有原始虚构的电话号码、城市文字和网站，比手册横幅更简洁、更克制。

prompts.text:
Use the single uploaded photo as the only visual reference. Transform the person into an adorable hand-drawn 2D children’s storybook character, while keeping their identity immediately recognizable.

Preserve exactly from the photo:
- Facial features and skin tone
- Real hairstyle, length, texture, and color
- Exact clothing, colors, patterns, and layering
- Glasses, jewelry, headwear, bags, and all visible accessories

Do not invent or copy hairstyles, outfits, accessories, braids, pigtails, bows, bonnets, or headscarves from any reference artwork.

### Character
Use an oversized rounded head, tiny compact body, short arms, narrow shoulders, soft rounded silhouette, and cute childlike proportions. Keep the head visually dominant. Avoid realistic anatomy.

### Face
Simplify into tiny dot/oval eyes, minimal nose, tiny smiling mouth, rounded cheeks, and soft peach/pink blush. Keep recognizable facial characteristics. No realistic eyes, detailed lips, anime features, glossy 3D rendering, or heavy shading.

### Hair & Clothing
Recreate the exact hairstyle and outfit from the uploaded photo, simplified into chunky hand-drawn shapes. Preserve important colors, patterns, jewelry, glasses, and other recognizable details.

### Style
Handmade 2D picture-book aesthetic using soft gouache, wax crayon, colored pencil, and dry pastel. Use slightly irregular dark-brown linework, subtle paper grain, uneven pigment, soft brush marks, and imperfect painted edges. Avoid clean vector art, CGI, anime, or photorealism.

### Composition
Square 1:1 portrait, chest/waist-up, centered and facing mostly forward, with balanced negative space. Use a relaxed, charming pose.

### Background
Simple warm mustard, butter yellow, ochre, or cream background with subtle paper texture. No scenery, objects, text, borders, or distractions.

Final feeling: the same person lovingly redrawn as an extremely cute, warm, wholesome, nostalgic, handcrafted children’s-book character—same identity, same hair, same clothes, same accessories, completely simplified and adorable.

### 角色
使用超大的圆头、极小的紧凑身材、短手臂、窄肩膀、柔和圆润的轮廓以及可爱的童稚比例。保持头部在视觉上占据主导地位。避免写实的人体解剖。

简化为微小的点状/椭圆眼睛、极简的鼻子、微小的微笑嘴巴、圆润的双颊以及柔和的桃红色/粉色腮红。保留可识别的面部特征。不要使用写实的眼睛、细节丰富的嘴唇、动漫特征、光滑的3D渲染或厚重的阴影。

从上传的照片中重现确切的发型和装束，并将其简化为块状的手绘形状。保留重要的颜色、图案、首饰、眼镜和其他可识别的细节。

方形1:1肖像，胸部/腰部以上，居中且主要面向前方，具有平衡的负空间。使用轻松、迷人的姿势。

简单的暖芥末色、奶油黄、赭色或奶油色背景，带有细微的纸张纹理。无风景、物体、文字、边框或干扰项。
