prompts.text:
Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio, in a cream-white bedroom in the early morning, the character has just woken up from sleepiness, sitting halfway on the edge of the bed near the window, her right fingertips gently pinching the edge of the gauze curtain and pulling open a narrow slit, letting the first beam of sunlight enter the room. The framing is from the top of the head to the middle of the thigh, with the character located in the center-left of the frame; the foreground is a naturally raised, edge-blurred thin quilt, with the curtains and warm light forming the main narrative clues.

Stunning 23-year-old East Asian beauty, with a fashionable, confident, and gentle temperament;

Bright milk tea grey-brown medium-long hair with a slightly fluffy bundled feel from just waking up, thin air bangs lightly scattered on the forehead, layers around the face close to the cheeks, with a few stray strands of hair illuminated by the window light. Exquisite and natural oval face, eyes half-open, long eyelashes, with tiny warm-colored catchlights in the pupils; champagne beige and light pink-brown eyeshadow, natural tear bags, light rose blush, and translucent pink-beige lips kept thin. The corners of the mouth are relaxed, the chin is slightly tucked, and the gaze falls past the fingertips toward the morning light in the curtain slit, presenting a quiet expression with sleepiness not yet fully faded.

Clothing/Posture:
Wearing an ivory fine-ribbed deep U-neck tight-fitting camisole top, the soft fabric naturally fits along the chest and waist; the bottom is matching ivory low-waist ruffled home ultra-shorts, the waistband forming slight horizontal folds in a sitting posture. The body's center of gravity falls on the left hip, the left palm resting on the mattress behind, fingers naturally spread due to weight-bearing; the upper body leans slightly toward the window, the right shoulder is slightly raised, and the right thumb and index finger pinch the edge of the gauze curtain with slight force, without penetrating the fabric. The right knee is naturally bent and partially covered by the thin quilt, the left leg hangs relaxedly toward the side of the bed, the straps and hem maintain realistic tension, not deliberately posed.

Background/Light:
The foreground thin quilt shows soft cotton-linen folds, the mid-ground is the character and translucent cream-white gauze curtains, the background only retains a light wood bedside table and a textless frosted glass water cup. Low-angle warm golden morning light from outside the window at the top right shines obliquely through the narrow curtain slit, sequentially illuminating the right-side hair, eyelashes, bridge of the nose, neck and collarbone, leaving a soft diagonal band of light on the bedsheet; shadows extend toward the back left, keeping a transparent light gray soft shadow on the left side of the face. The cream-white wall provides extremely weak natural bounce-fill, so that the dark parts still retain skin tones and fabric layers.

Composition/Camera:
Equivalent 50mm lens, camera position near mattress height, shooting from a slight front-side eye-level angle; the focal plane falls on the pupil on the window side and the fingertips pinching the gauze curtain, shallow depth of field softens the bedside table and the distant wall. The character occupies about 65% of the frame, the blurred thin quilt forms the lower foreground obstruction, the curtain forms a vertical framing along the right side of the image, an appropriate amount of bright white space is reserved in the direction of the character's gaze, and the edges of the frame naturally crop the edge of the bed and the lower segment of the left leg.

Underage or mature middle-aged feel, drifting facial features, pinching curtain fingers floating or penetrating the fabric, incorrect fingers and weight-bearing joints, messy strap or thin quilt structure, plastic-looking skin, broken window frame perspective, readable text or watermarks.

象牙白肌肤带淡粉血色，晨光下保留细小毛孔、鼻尖与颧骨的微润高光。明亮奶茶灰棕中长发略带刚睡醒的蓬松束感，薄空气刘海轻散在额前，脸周层次贴近面颊，几缕细碎飞发被窗光照亮。精致自然的鹅蛋脸，眼睛半睁、睫毛细长，瞳孔里有微小暖色眼神光；香槟米色与淡粉棕眼影、自然泪袋、淡玫瑰腮红和透感粉米色唇保持轻薄。唇角放松，下颌微收，视线越过指尖落向帘缝中的晨光，呈现睡意尚未完全褪去的安静神情。

服装・姿势：
穿象牙色细罗纹深U领贴身吊带短上衣，柔软面料沿胸腰自然贴合；下身为同色低腰荷叶边居家超短裤，裤腰在坐姿下形成轻微横向褶皱。身体重心落在左侧臀部，左手掌撑在身后床垫上，手指因承重自然张开；上身微向窗边倾斜，右肩略抬，右手拇指与食指以轻微力道夹住纱帘边缘，不穿透布料。右膝自然屈起并被薄被遮住一部分，左腿松弛垂向床侧，吊带与衣摆保持真实受力，不刻意摆拍。

背景・光：
前景薄被呈柔软棉麻褶皱，中景为人物与半透明米白纱帘，背景只保留浅木床头柜和一只无文字的磨砂玻璃水杯。右上方窗外的低角度暖金色晨光从窄帘缝斜射进入，依次照亮右侧发丝、睫毛、鼻梁、肩颈与锁骨，在床单上留下柔软的斜向光带；阴影向左后方延伸，面部左侧保持通透的浅灰柔影。米白墙面提供极弱的自然回填，使暗部仍保留肤色与织物层次。

构图・相机：
等效50mm镜头，机位接近床垫高度，以轻微侧前方平视角度拍摄；焦点平面落在靠窗侧瞳孔与捏住纱帘的指尖，浅景深柔化床头柜和远处墙面。人物约占画面65%，虚化薄被形成下方前景遮挡，窗帘沿画面右侧构成竖向框景，人物视线方向保留适量亮部留白，画面边缘自然裁切床沿与左腿下段。

质感・风格：
日系美容杂志与室内生活方式写真，低对比、克制暖米色调、柔和高光与轻微胶片颗粒。重点表现真实肤质、逆光发丝、半透明纱帘、细罗纹上衣与棉麻床品的触感差异，整体清醒而朦胧，具有晨间空气感。

负面：
未成年或成熟中年感、人物面部特征漂移、捏帘手指悬空或穿透布料、手指与承重关节错误、吊带或薄被结构混乱、塑料感皮肤、窗框透视崩坏、可读文字或水印

prompts.text:
9:16 vertical version, modern Oriental female dreamland 3D papercut art, modern oriental papercut art, layered paper cut illustration, dimensional paper sculpture, intricate paper carving, paper diorama, layered shadow box, epic oriental papercraft fantasy, contemporary oriental art poster.

The theme of the work is "She walks towards the river surface from the lights of Hongyadong."

The core narrative of the scene is: a young Oriental female slowly walks from layers of paper-carved mountain city and corridors of lights towards the steps by the river, with the river water, night wind, distant bridge, and moonlight in front of her. She walks out from the depths of prosperous and noisy lights to the wider and more open edge of the river, as if finally seeing the distance she truly wants to go after the bustle.

The main character is an adult Oriental female with a visual age of about 25, clear-headed and independent, mysterious and elegant, with a sense of calmness after passing through prosperity. The character has a delicate oval face, slender almond eyes slightly raised, and a restrained and focused expression. The character does not look at the camera, using a back view or side-back narrative posture as the emotional core.

Character's hairstyle and headwear: Black long hair tied low, with slender flowing paper art ribbons extending from the ends, wearing pale gold light patterns and small flower branch hair accessories. The headwear is light and exquisite, not complex or high-lofted.

Character's clothing: Layered paper art long dress in deep vermilion, warm gold, and ivory white, with extremely fine hollow structures of pavilions, lights, railings, waves, and city patterns on the hem and silk scarf. The outer silk scarf is long and light, spreading extensively towards the back and side-rear. The clothing must have a clear paper thickness, fine cut edges, fiber texture, slight creases, and a high-completion museum-grade paper carving craftsmanship feel. The silk scarf and hem are like a whole piece of complex hollow paper carving long scroll.

The dream carrier is: mountain city paper art pavilion clusters and riverside corridors.

Dream imagery includes: stilt houses (Diaojiaolou), lights, long steps, river surface, distant bridge, flying birds, full moon, and distant city sea of lights. All buildings, characters, river water, sky, bridges, lanterns, railings, and plants must be unified into a high-completion 3D paper carving language, not realistic photography, not ordinary CG night scenes.

The overall papercut structure adopts: a multi-layered stage style.

Composition and character actions: The main body on the left and upper part of the image is a whole surface of huge paper-carved mountain city growing vertically along the cliff. Layers of stilt houses, pavilions, corridors, terraces, railings, lanterns, and small bridges overlap each other, extending from the foreground to the background, forming an extremely complex and orderly vertical space. On the right is the open river surface, distant bridge, city skyline, and full moon night sky, forming a clear opening and closing relationship. The character is located on the riverside steps below and slightly to the middle-left of the frame, body facing the river and the distance, walking down slowly or stopping quietly, becoming the narrative focus connecting the "prosperous mountain city" and the "vast river surface."

The mountain city architecture must clearly refer to Hongyadong-style mountain stilt house clusters, but entirely processed with paper carving: multi-layered wooden pavilions, dense window lattices, layers of corridors, cantilevered platforms, bending stairs, overhanging eaves, red lanterns, and warm-light window scenes intersect with each other, forming an overwhelming sense of vertical growth and strong depth. The building density is very high, but the order is clear. Foreground buildings can be cropped by the frame to enhance the sense of spatial pressure and presence.

The foreground and midground can feature continuous paper art railings, paper lamps, stone steps, platforms, and a few paper-carved plant silhouettes, serving as a frame for the viewer to enter the interior of the mountain city. The river surface on the right is open, with detailed paper-carved ripples and moonlight reflections on the water. A bridge spans the river in the distance with its lights lit, and the distant city sea of lights forms dense points of light. A full moon and scattered flying birds are visible in the night sky. The moonlight is cool, forming a cold-warm contrast with the warm lights of the mountain city.

Overall color scheme: Mainly vermilion, warm gold, deep cyan-blue, and ivory white, with a small amount of ink black for balance. Vermilion is used for the main pavilions, character's main dress, railings, and lantern structures; warm gold is used for lights, window lattices, outlines, and local highlights; deep cyan-blue is used for the night sky, river water, and background shadows; ivory white is used for the hollow silk scarf, architectural highlights, moonlight, and some decorative paper layers. The overall colors are gorgeous and transparent, with obvious cold-warm contrast, but must not be dirty or muddy, and do not blacken the entire image.

Light and paper texture: Warm gold lights shine from inside the pavilions, intertwining with the cool blue night and moonlight. The architectural paper layers glow locally, and the river surface reflects the lights and moonlight. Paper thickness, cutting patterns, hollow railings, window lattices, lantern edges, and character clothing details must be extremely rich and clear. Strengthen the real paper fiber, slight creases, inter-layer shadows, edge light transmission, and multi-layered paper carving structure, making the entire image like a high-completion large-scale Oriental paper carving art installation.

The image overall has a sense of Oriental dream mountain city, papercut night tour, riverside moonlight, female growth narrative, and high-end art poster. The focus is not just "Hongyadong night scene," but the emotional transition of "walking from prosperous lights to the vast river." The mountain city must be prosperous, complex, and growing upwards in layers; the river surface must be open, cool, and leave room to breathe; the character must become the emotional anchor from bustle to silence.

Supplementary requirements: Strengthen the vertical space and prosperity of the lights in the mountain city. The character is in the foreground or mid-foreground but must not destroy the overall architectural pressure and depth. The entire scene must be unified as paper carving; it cannot just be the character in paper art and the background realistic.

prompts.text:
9:16竖版，现代东方女性梦境立体剪纸艺术，modern oriental papercut art，layered paper cut illustration，dimensional paper sculpture，intricate paper carving，paper diorama，layered shadow box，epic oriental papercraft fantasy，contemporary oriental art poster。

作品主题为“她从洪崖洞的灯火里走向江面”。

画面核心叙事为：一位年轻东方女性从层层叠叠的纸雕山城与灯火回廊中缓缓走向临江阶梯，面前是江水、夜风、远桥与月色。她从繁盛喧闹的灯火深处走出，来到更辽阔开阔的江面边缘，像终于在热闹之后看见自己真正要去的远方。

主体人物为视觉年龄约25岁的东方成年女性，清醒独立、神秘优雅，带一点穿越繁华后的冷静感。人物拥有清秀鹅蛋脸，细长杏眼微微抬起，神情克制而专注。人物不看镜头，采用背影或侧背影叙事姿态，作为情绪核心。

人物发型与头饰为：黑色长发低挽，发尾延展出细长流动的纸艺丝带，佩戴浅金灯饰纹样与小型花枝发饰。头饰轻盈精致，不复杂不高耸。

人物服装为：深朱红、暖金与象牙白层叠纸艺长裙，裙摆与披帛带有极为精细的楼阁、灯火、栏杆、波浪与城市纹样镂空结构，外层披帛修长轻盈，大面积向身后与侧后方展开。服装必须具有清晰纸张厚度、细密裁切边缘、纤维纹理、轻微折痕和高完成度的博物馆级纸雕工艺感，披帛与裙摆像一整片繁复的镂空纸雕长卷。

梦境载体为：山城纸艺楼阁群与临江回廊。

梦境意象包括：吊脚楼、灯火、长阶、江面、远桥、飞鸟、满月、远处城市灯海。所有建筑、人物、江水、天空、桥梁、灯笼、栏杆和植物都必须统一为高完成度的立体纸雕语言，不要写实摄影，不要普通CG夜景。

整体剪纸结构采用：多层舞台式。

构图与人物动作为：画面左侧与上方主体是一整面沿崖壁垂直生长的巨大纸雕山城，层层吊脚楼、楼阁、回廊、露台、栏杆、灯笼与小桥彼此交叠，从前景一直延伸到远景，形成极其复杂而有秩序的垂直空间。右侧是开阔江面、远桥、城市天际线与满月夜空，形成明晰的开合关系。人物位于画面下方偏中左的临江台阶之上，身体朝向江面与远方，缓步向下或安静停驻，成为连接“繁华山城”与“辽阔江面”的叙事焦点。

山城建筑必须明显参考洪崖洞式山地吊脚楼群，但全部纸雕化处理：多层木构楼阁、密集窗格、层层回廊、悬挑平台、弯折楼梯、挑檐、红灯笼、暖光窗景彼此交错，形成压倒性的垂直生长感和强烈纵深。建筑密度很高，但秩序清晰，近景建筑可以被画框裁切，增强空间压迫感与现场感。

前景与中景可以出现连续的纸艺栏杆、纸灯、石阶、平台与少量纸雕植物剪影，作为观者进入山城内部的框景。右侧江面开阔，水面有细致的纸雕波纹与月光倒影，远处一座桥梁横跨江面，桥身灯光点亮，远方城市灯海形成细密光点。夜空中可见一轮明月与零散飞鸟，月色清冷，和山城暖灯形成冷暖对比。

整体色彩方案为：朱红、暖金、深青蓝、象牙白为主，少量墨黑平衡。朱红用于楼阁主体、人物主裙、栏杆与灯笼结构；暖金用于灯火、窗格、描边与局部高光；深青蓝用于夜空、江水与远景阴影；象牙白用于镂空披帛、建筑高光、月光与部分装饰性纸层。整体色彩华丽而通透，冷暖对比明显，但不能脏浊，不要整体压黑。

光线与纸张质感为：暖金灯火从楼阁内部透出，与冷蓝夜色和月光交织，建筑纸层局部发光，江面反射灯火与月光。纸张厚度、裁切纹样、镂空栏杆、窗格、灯笼边缘和人物服装细节都必须极其丰富清晰。强化真实纸张纤维、轻微折痕、层间投影、边缘透光感和多层纸雕结构，使整张画面像一件高完成度的大型东方纸雕艺术装置。

画面整体具有东方梦境山城、纸雕夜游、江边月色、女性成长叙事和高级艺术海报感。重点不只是“洪崖洞夜景”，而是“从繁华灯火里走向辽阔江面”的情绪转折。山城必须繁盛、复杂、层层向上生长；江面必须开阔、清冷、留出呼吸空间；人物必须成为由繁入静的情绪锚点。

补充要求：强化山城垂直空间与灯火繁盛感，人物位于前景或中前景，但不能破坏整体建筑压迫感与纵深感；整个场景必须统一纸雕化，不能只是人物纸艺、背景写实。

prompts.text:
Please make each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-photo stitching, each photo output individually. The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout, with the upper and lower regions strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the screen.

The upper part retains the original photo, maintaining the main structure, realistic texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end photography color grading to give it an art magazine, independent publication, and exhibition photography texture. To fit the frame, the sky, ground, or environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The lower part extracts the most recognizable subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, reconstructing it into a minimalist Gestalt positive and negative space screen print. Retain the most recognizable outer contour of the subject, while extracting an environment, structure, object, or symbolic image most closely related to it from the original photo, allowing the two to merge into a complete graphic through contour interlocking, negative space hollowing, boundary sharing, and figure-ground reversal: seeing the subject first from a distance, and discovering another layer of scene or image hidden within upon closer inspection. Do not simply stack two objects; let the edge of one shape naturally become the boundary of another.

The composition maintains a single visual anchor, clear silhouette, and large areas of white space, with positioning determined by the subject's own posture, orientation, center of gravity, and contour trend, using eccentricity, partial cropping, upper and lower nesting, or edge alignment to create a clever visual transition between positive and negative shapes. Auxiliary elements must be minimal, letting visual interest mainly come from the momentary switch between 'seeing what' and 'seeing what again,' rather than complex decoration.

The color scheme uses a healing, soft, and high-end Morandi pastel system, referring to the low-saturation color logic in dreamlike architectural spaces: misty pink, soft apricot, grey-green, sage, light terracotta, cream yellow, misty blue, grey-purple, etc., coordinating with each other, with a light-colored paper surface as the base, selecting the most spirited color relationships from the original photo for softening and recombination. Control the overall to 2–4 colors, establishing layers through a combination of color temperature, brightness difference, and area ratio. Colors are clean, soft, and airy, avoiding dirty grey, heavy aging, neon colors, and high-contrast commercial color schemes.

Retain slight paper fibers, screen printing particles, ink coverage, and registration deviations, giving the graphics a real printmaking touch, but keeping edges sharp and color blocks flat, without using gradients, 3D volume, realistic shadows, or smooth CG textures.

Text also participates in the positive and negative space composition. Extract a short English title from the photo's identity, location, action, emotion, state, or symbolic meaning, paired with a very small amount of location, number, status words, or micro-annotations. Text can be arranged along the subject's contour, negative space boundary, horizontal baseline, or white space axis, or partially embedded in graphics, cut by contours, or blocked by color blocks, making the text like a part of the print structure rather than a title pasted on later. The overall look remains small, restrained, clever, and with a high-end editorial feel.

The overall presentation combines minimalist geometry, Gestalt optical illusion, soft Morandi colors, screen printing, and poetic narrative visual temperament. Whether the subject is a person, animal, plant, building, object, vehicle, or natural landscape, it should maintain the dual reading experience of 'recognizing the subject at first glance and discovering the hidden image at second glance,' avoiding multiple parallel focal points, direct collage, complex illustrations, cartoonish feel, commercial promotional feel, and template feel.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体结构、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物和展览摄影质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展天空、地面或环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的**主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系**，重构为极简的格式塔正负形丝网版画。保留主体最具有辨识度的外轮廓，同时从原图中提炼一个与其关系最紧密的环境、结构、物件或象征性意象，让二者通过**轮廓咬合、负形镂空、边界共用和图底反转**融为一个完整图形：远看首先识别主体，近看才发现另一层场景或意象隐藏其中。不要把两个对象简单叠放，而要让一个形状的边缘自然成为另一个形状的边界。

构图保持**单一视觉锚点、清晰剪影和大面积留白**，根据主体自身姿态、朝向、重心和轮廓走势决定位置，可采用偏心、局部裁切、上下嵌套或边缘对齐，使正形与负形之间形成巧妙视觉转换。辅助元素必须极少，让视觉趣味主要来自“看见什么”与“再次看见什么”的瞬间切换，而不是复杂装饰。

配色采用治愈、柔和而高级的**莫兰迪粉彩体系**，参考梦境般建筑空间中的低饱和配色逻辑：雾粉、柔杏、灰绿、鼠尾草、淡陶土、奶油黄、雾蓝、灰紫等相互协调，以浅色纸面为底，从原照片中选择最有精神的色彩关系进行柔化与重组。整体控制在2–4种颜色，通过综合色温、明度差和面积比例建立层次，颜色干净、柔和、有空气感，避免脏灰、沉重做旧、荧光色和高反差商业配色。

保留轻微纸张纤维、丝网印刷颗粒、油墨覆盖与套色偏差，使图形具有真实版画触感，但保持边缘清晰、色块平整，不使用渐变、3D体积、写实阴影或光滑CG质感。

文字同样参与正负形构图。从照片的**身份、地点、动作、情绪、状态或象征意义**中提炼一个简短英文标题，并搭配极少量地点、编号、状态词或微型注释。文字可沿主体轮廓、负形边界、水平基线或留白轴线排布，也可局部嵌入图形、被轮廓切断或与色块形成遮挡，使文字像版画结构的一部分，而不是后期贴上的标题。整体保持细小、克制、聪明而具有高级编辑感。

整体呈现**极简几何、格式塔错视、柔和莫兰迪色、丝网版画与诗意叙事**结合的视觉气质。无论主体是人物、动物、植物、建筑、器物、交通工具或自然景观，都应保持“一眼识别主体，第二眼发现隐藏意象”的双重阅读体验，避免多个并列焦点、直接拼贴、复杂插画、卡通感、商业宣传感和模板感。

Vertical 3:4. A wide-angle shot taken from near the adjacent window toward the front, placing the majority of the character's body from the head to the waist on the left. Travel snapshot style under a clear sky, realistic photography. The hair fluttering in the wind, the thin white shirt, the metal window frame and train body, the camera glass, the sea surface, and the crushed stones are depicted with high-definition detail.

prompts.text:
create temp view franchise_dna as
select
infer_iconic_character_profile(:franchise) as profile_mask,
infer_flat_environment(:franchise) as foreground,
infer_light_color(:franchise) as light_ink,
infer_dark_color(:franchise) as dark_ink;

create temp view poster_layers as
select
layer1 = render_background(light_ink, texture='archival_paper'),
layer2 = render_foreground(foreground, dark_ink, mask=profile_mask)

items.title: 窗边自拍的日本女性写实人像

prompts.text:
Subject:
Represented as a selfie-style intimate smartphone portrait of only one fictional adult Japanese female, wearing a white ribbed tank top by a bright window, leaning her cheek on her left hand. The upper body is facing forward, with the face tilted slightly to the right, and the left cheek lightly resting on the left fist or bent fingers of the left hand. The center of the face is positioned at approximately 30% from the top and 49-51% horizontally on a vertical 9:16 frame, with the eye line at approximately 27% from the top. The top of the head is about 3% from the upper edge, the head width including hair is about 48% of the frame width, the shoulder width is about 67%, and the distance from the face to the upper chest is about 69% of the frame height. The right arm, right hand, waist, legs, and the smartphone itself are outside the frame and are therefore not added. Maintain a calm adult facial expression and natural body proportions, without changing to oversized eyes or an overly rounded contour to appear younger.

Face/Makeup:
The contour is an oval shape that retains the soft roundness of the cheeks, and the tip of the chin is not overly slender. Eyebrows are a natural thickness in dark brown, with a relaxed arc, not perfectly symmetrical, retaining the direction of hair growth. Eyes are slender almond shapes, with black pupils facing the lens, and the eyelid lines and eyelashes are visible to a delicate degree. Do not make the whites of the eyes bluish-white; the catchlights in both eyes correspond to the direction of the window. The bridge of the nose is soft, retaining the realism of the tip and small nostrils. Lips are a closed, elegant smile in a low-saturation pink-beige, with the corners of the mouth slightly upturned. Skin is a bright natural skin tone, retaining pores on the cheeks and around the nose, thin shadows around the eyes, and slight cheek deformation caused by contact with the left hand. Avoid strong blush, heavy eyeliner, glitter, contour-shaving processing, and porcelain-like overall smoothing.

Hair:
The hair is dark brown long hair close to black, mixing loose straight lines and faint waves, falling toward the shoulders and chest. The parting is slightly off-center to the left or right, revealing part of the forehead and forming thick bundles beside the left and right cheeks. Hair bundles facing the window retain slender bright edges, while the indoor side retains calm dark areas; do not paint the entire hair in uniform black. Near the left cheek and left hand, the hair naturally overlaps the fingers or wrist but does not embed into the skin or merge to hide fingers. Hair ends extend to the range where they are cut off at the bottom of the frame; do not create invisible lengths or back shapes. Do not use wind to blow it over a wide range; do not add wet hair, strong curls, straight bangs, exaggerated hair color gradients, or hair accessories. Retain a small amount of fine stray hairs to maintain a daily feel that is not overly tidy.

Expression/Gaze:
The gaze is quietly aimed at the lens, with a slight hint of coquettishness as if waiting for the other party's reply, creating a calm and intimate closed-lip smile. Do not open the eyes wide; naturally lower the upper eyelids so that the direction of both pupils is consistent. Because the cheek is leaning on the hand, the left cheek is slightly raised, and there is a subtle left-right difference in the corners of the mouth. Do not change to a wide laugh showing teeth, a surprised open-mouthed face, pouting lips, head down, looking sideways, or provocative half-open eyes. Do not apply force between the eyebrows or on the forehead; the corners of the eyes only bring out a very weak sense of softness. Do not completely correct the face for symmetry; retain the natural asymmetry consistent with hand contact and neck tilt. The emotion is not loneliness or sadness, but a calm atmosphere of speaking to a close-range object by a bright window.

Pose/Fingers/Contact:
The left elbow is outside the frame or at the bottom, the left forearm is bent upward, and the fingers of the left hand are slightly curled to support the left cheek. Do not clench into a fist; the contours of the thumb, index finger, and middle finger connect naturally, and only the part in contact with the cheek is slightly compressed. Correctly present the number of five fingers and joints; extra fingers, fusion, nail overgrowth, hands piercing through the cheek, and unnatural wrist twists are prohibited. Shoulders are relaxed, and the head is tilted slightly toward the hand, but do not extremely bend the neck. The right shoulder droops naturally within the visible range, and the right hand remains outside the frame. Since the smartphone holding posture is not visible in the image, it is not added. Prioritize the contact relationship between the hair, cheeks, left hand, and clothing; do not create invisible elbow positions, chairs, tables, or the lower body.

Clothing/Accessories:
The clothing is a ribbed knit tank top in a light ivory color from off-white, reproducing thin left and right shoulder straps and a shallow round chest within the visible range. Vertical fine ribs extend from the chest to the bottom edge of the frame, and the fabric is a medium-thickness matte cotton blend. The straps rest naturally on the skin, do not disappear or double mid-way, and do not pull the chest down excessively. The side illuminated by window light is bright, but do not lose the ribs due to overexposure; light gray shadows form under the armpits or under the hair. Do not add logos, text, patterns, lace, ruffles, buttons, or see-through effects. Since no clear accessories are confirmed on the neck, ears, or hands, do not create necklaces, earrings, rings, watches, or nail decorations. Bottoms or shoes outside the frame are also not shown.

Place/Time/Background:
The place suggests an interior of a daytime home or living space, but without determining the specific location or room use. There are strong bright white curtains and window light on the left side or behind the subject, and elements that look like a dark rectangular TV or monitor, light walls, and furniture parts are blurred in the background on the opposite side. The curtains are white to ivory with soft vertical folds; since specific scenery outside the window is overexposed and invisible, it is not created. Dark rectangles do not display images, text, or reflections of people. The background is more blurred than the person, retaining a sense of life while not adding cluttered items, brands, posters, plants, or others. The time period is considered soft natural light from morning to noon; do not change to sunset, night scenes, or colored lighting. Fix the front-to-back relationship between the window, the person, and the indoor background.

Composition/Camera:
A 9:16 vertical selfie-style close-up composition, including the top of the head, face, left hand, shoulders, and upper chest in one frame. The center of the face is fixed at 50% horizontally and approximately 30% from the top, and the contact point between the left hand and the cheek is placed at 35-42% horizontally and 48-55% from the top. The margin above the head is about 3%, the margins from the outside of the hair to the left and right ends are each 3-8%, and the bottom is cut off in the middle of the upper chest. The visual center of the person is maintained at 48-52% horizontally; do not squeeze the face or hair to the left or right ends. The camera is close to eye height, with a sense of distance like a smartphone standard wide-angle with an arm stretched, but without showing the actual arm or device. Avoid ultra-wide angles that distort the center of the face, flattening from long telephoto, fisheye, strong high-angle views, or tilted horizons. Focus is on the eyes, lips, and the left hand contact area, smoothly blurring the background curtains and TV.

Light Source:
The main light source is soft daylight entering from a large window on the back left or side of the frame, gently illuminating the outer edges of the hair, forehead, cheeks, nose bridge, and shoulders. Due to the backlight component, the background curtains are quite bright, but the face is adjusted to appropriate exposure using reflected light from indoor walls or the window side. Small and soft catchlights reflecting the shape of the window are placed in both eyes; do not add point-like strong flashes. The window side of the face is slightly brighter, while the opposite cheek, neck, and inner side of the hair retain soft shadows. Do not let the highlights of the white clothing and curtains overexpose; retain the gradation of visible ribs and fabric folds. Do not add warm lamps, neon, strong rim light, or multi-directional hard shadows. Unify the light direction of the hair and skin, avoiding processing where only the face glows from a separate light source.

Color/Tones:
The overall composition consists of white curtains, ivory clothing, natural bright skin, dark brown hair, an interior from light beige to gray, and a near-black TV, forming a low-saturation neutral color scheme. The white balance is slightly warm daylight, but do not excessively turn the skin yellow-orange, retaining the subtle differences in the white of the clothing and curtains. The midtones of the face are rich, smoothly connecting from the window highlights to the dark parts of the hair. The ivory of the clothing is slightly warmer than the curtains, and the dark side of the TV is kept neutral rather than bluish-black, also showing the distance between the person and the living space through color. Avoid over-brightened matte tones, blue shadows, teal and orange, strong sepia, or excessive HDR. Only naturally retain the faint blood color of the lips and cheeks, without adding primary color accents to the background. Maintain the realism of the window being slightly bright under smartphone auto-exposure, while adjusting within a range where the face does not wash out or crush to black.

Texture/Fine Details:
The skin retains small pores on the cheeks, nose, and forehead, thin shadows around the eyes, and minute longitudinal lines on the lips to a moderate degree. The contact point between the left cheek and the hand forms shape changes and small shadows under soft pressure, so the hand does not appear to be floating. The hair has strands of different thicknesses, fine waves, fine window light reflections, and a small amount of stray hairs; do not artificially sharpen individual strands. The ribbed tank top has a vertical knit pattern, soft thickness, and matte fabric with small folds at the chest and armpits. Although the curtains are more blurred than the person, vertical fabric folds are recognizable, and the TV is a dark surface with suppressed gloss. Finger skin, nails, and joints are natural; do not add overly long nails or exaggerated nail art. The overall resolution is like a smartphone photo, avoiding excessive micro-contrast or pseudo-high-frequency patterns.

Image Processing/Finish:
Completed as a natural selfie photo taken with a smartphone by an indoor window. Exposure correction only slightly suppresses the window brightness and restores the gradation of the face and white clothing. Gently adjust skin color differences, but do not eliminate pores, under-eye shadows, or cheek-hand contact. Sharpness is applied slightly to the pupils, lips, leading edge of the hair, and fingers, without adding strong outlines to the background and skin. Noise removal only suppresses the graininess around dark hair or the TV, retaining the texture of hair and ribs. The background blur is optically continuous, without creating cutout halos around the hair. Do not use beauty correction to deform the face shape, eye size, nose, mouth, or hands. Do not add text, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders, collages, dividers, or multi-cuts; complete with only one adult female and one indoor scene.

Collapse Avoidance/Prohibitions:
Fix the same adult female, dark long hair, ivory ribbed tank top, pose leaning left cheek on left hand, frontal gaze, closed smile, white curtains and dark TV, soft window light. Prohibit the increase or decrease of left hand fingers, fusion, piercing through the cheek, wrist reversal, or extra arms. Inconsistent eye directions, dual irises, melting ears or neck, disappearing shoulder straps, and hair merging with fingers are prohibited. Do not generate a smartphone, right hand, elbow position, waist, legs, or scenery outside the window based on speculation. Do not make clothing see-through, do not exaggerate the chest, and do not change to a young face. Others, mirror images, people inside the TV, text, and brands are not added to the background. Do not generate illustrations, animations, 3D, collages, grids, or comparison images; generate only a natural vertical photo of one adult female.

prompts.text:
被摄体：
仅以一名虚构的成年日本女性为对象，在明亮的窗边穿着白色罗纹吊带背心，将脸颊倚靠在左手上的自拍式亲密智能手机肖像来再现。人物上半身正面朝向，脸部微微向右倾斜，将左脸颊轻轻搁置在左拳或弯曲的左手手指上。脸部中心置于纵向9:16画面上端约30%、横向49〜51%的位置，双眼神线置于上端约27%。头顶至上端约3%，包含头发在内的头部宽度约占画面宽度的48%，肩宽约67%，从脸部至胸上部约占画面高的69%。右臂、右手、腰部、腿部、智能手机本体位于画面外，因此不添加。保持成人的沉稳面容和自然的体型比例，不改变为显得幼小的过大眼睛或过于圆润的轮廓。

脸部・妆容：
轮廓为保留脸颊柔和圆润的卵形，下巴尖端不过分纤细。眉毛为深棕色的自然粗细，呈松弛的弧形，不完全对称，保留毛流向。眼睛为细长的杏仁形，黑瞳朝向镜头，眼睑线和睫毛呈现纤细可见的程度。不将眼白弄得青白，双目的捕捉光根据窗户方向对应。鼻梁柔和，保留鼻尖和小鼻孔的真实感。嘴唇为闭合的淡雅微笑，低饱和度的粉米色，嘴角微微上扬。皮肤为明亮的自然肤色，保留脸颊和鼻周的毛孔、眼周的薄影，以及与左手接触引起的轻微脸颊变形。避免强烈的腮红、浓重的眼线、闪粉、削减轮廓的加工，以及瓷器般的全面平滑化。

头发：
头发为接近黑色的深棕色长发，混合松散的直线和微弱的波浪，向肩部和胸部垂落。分线略微偏离中心向左或右，露出部分额头，在左右脸颊旁形成粗束。面向窗户的发束保留细长的亮边，室内侧保留沉稳的暗部，不将整体头发涂成统一的黑色。在左脸颊和左手附近，头发自然叠加于手指或手腕，但不嵌入皮肤或隐藏手指融合。发梢延伸至画面下部截断的范围，不创作不可见的长度或背面形状。不用风吹大范围飘动，不添加湿发、强烈卷曲、齐刘海、头发颜色的夸张渐变、发饰品。保留少量细碎后发丝，维持不过分整齐的日常感。

表情・视线：
视线静静对准镜头，像是等待对方回复般略带一丝撒娇，营造平静而亲密的闭唇微笑。不睁大眼睛，自然垂下上眼睑，使左右瞳孔方向一致。因脸颊倚靠手部，左侧脸颊微微上抬，嘴角也产生细微的左右差异。不改变为露出牙齿的大笑、惊讶张嘴脸、撅唇表情、低头、侧目、挑逗性的半睁眼。眉间或额头不施加力量，眼尾仅带出极弱的柔和感。不将脸部完全对称校正，保留与手部接触和颈部倾斜相符的自然不对称。情感不是孤独或悲伤，而是明亮窗边对近距离对象平静诉说的氛围。

姿势・手指・接触：
左肘位于画面外或下部，左前臂向上弯曲，左手手指轻微蜷曲支撑左脸颊。不紧握成拳，拇指、食指、中指的轮廓自然连接，仅接触脸颊的部分略微压缩。正确呈现五指数量和关节，禁止多余手指、融合、指甲增生、贯穿脸颊的手、不自然的腕部扭曲。肩膀放松，头部略微向手倾斜，但不极端折曲颈部。右肩在可见范围内自然下垂，右手保持在画面外。因智能手机持姿在图像中不可见，因此不添加。优先处理头发、脸颊、左手、服装的接触关系，不创作不可见的肘部位置、椅子、桌子、下半身。

服装・小物：
服装为从米白的浅象牙色罗纹编织吊带背心，在可见范围内再现左右细肩带和浅圆胸口。纵向细密罗纹从胸口延伸至画面下端，面料为中等厚度和哑光棉混材质。肩带自然搭于皮肤，不在中途消失或加倍，不过度拉低胸口。受窗光照射的面亮堂，但不因过曝丢失罗纹，在腋下或头发下方形成淡灰色阴影。不添加标志、文字、图案、蕾丝、褶边、纽扣、透视效果。因颈部、耳朵、手部无明确饰品确认，因此不创作项链、耳环、戒指、手表、美甲装饰。画面外的下装或鞋子也不展示。

场所・时间・背景：
场所暗示日间家居或生活空间的室内，但不断定具体位置或房间用途。画面左侧或背后有强烈明亮的白色窗帘和窗光，对侧背景有看似暗色矩形电视或显示器的元素、淡壁、家具部分模糊存在。窗帘为白色至象牙色，带有纵向柔和褶皱，因窗外具体景色白曝不可见，因此不创作。暗色矩形不显示影像、文字、反射人物。背景比人物更大程度模糊，保留生活感的同时，不添加散乱物、品牌、海报、植物、他者。时间带视为从早到午的柔和自然光，不改变为日落、夜景、彩色照明。固定窗户与人物、室内背景的前后关系。

构图・相机：
纵向9:16的自拍式近接构图，将头顶、脸部、左手、双肩、胸上部纳入一帧。脸部中心固定于横向50%、上端约30%，左手与脸颊接点置于横向35〜42%、上端约48〜55%。头顶上方余白约3%，头发外侧至左右端余白各3〜8%，下端在胸上部中途截断。人物视觉中心维持于横向48〜52%，不将脸或头发挤向左右端。相机接近眼睛高度，以智能手机标准广角拉伸手臂程度的距离感，但不显示实际手臂或设备。避免扭曲脸部中央的超广角、长望远的扁平化、鱼眼、强烈俯视、倾斜的水平线。焦点对准双目和嘴唇、左手接触部，将背景窗帘和电视平滑虚化。

光源：
主光源为画面左后方或侧方的巨大窗户射入的柔和日光，温柔照亮头发外缘、额头、脸颊、鼻梁、肩膀。因有逆光成分，背景窗帘相当明亮，但脸部以室内墙壁或窗边反射光调整至适当曝光。双目置入反映窗户形状的小而柔和捕捉光，不添加点状强闪光。脸部窗侧略亮，对侧脸颊、颈部、头发内侧保留柔和阴影。不让白色服装和窗帘的高光过曝，保留可见罗纹和布褶的阶调。不添加暖色灯、霓虹、强边缘光、多方向硬阴影。将头发和皮肤的光向统一，避免仅脸部以单独光源发光的加工。

颜色・阶调：
整体由白色窗帘、象牙色服装、自然明亮皮肤、深褐色头发、从淡米色到灰色的室内、接近黑色的电视构成低饱和度的中性配色。白平衡为略带暖意的日光，但不过分黄橙化皮肤，保留服装和窗帘白色的细微差异。脸部中间调丰富，平滑连接从窗户高光至头发暗部。服装的象牙色比窗帘略暖，电视暗面不弄成青黑而保持中性，通过颜色也显示人物与生活空间的距离。避免过分提亮的哑光调、蓝色阴影、蓝绿色与橙色、强棕褐、过度HDR。仅自然保留嘴唇和脸颊的淡血色，不向背景添加原色点缀。维持智能手机自动曝光下窗户略亮的真实感，同时调整至脸部不白曝或黑崩的范围。

材质・细微质感：
皮肤保留脸颊、鼻子、额头的细小毛孔、眼周的薄阴影、嘴唇的微细纵纹，程度适中。左脸颊与手接点形成柔和压力下的形状变化和小阴影，使手不显得浮起。头发带有粗细不同的束、细微波浪、窗光细反射、少量后发丝，不人工锐化单根发丝。罗纹吊带背心具有纵向编织纹、柔和厚度、胸口和腋下小褶皱的哑光布料。窗帘虽比人物更模糊，但可辨识纵向布褶，电视为抑制光泽的暗面。手指皮肤、指甲、关节自然，不添加过长指甲或夸张美甲。整体分辨率如智能手机照片般，避开过度微对比或伪高频图案。

图像处理・完成：
完成成室内窗边用智能手机拍摄的自然自拍照片。曝光校正仅略微抑制窗户亮度，恢复脸部和白色服装的阶调。温和调整皮肤色差，但不消除毛孔、眼下阴影、脸颊与手接触。锐度轻微施加于瞳孔、嘴唇、头发前缘、手指，不在背景和皮肤添加强轮廓线。噪点去除仅抑制暗色头发或电视周边的粗糙度，保留头发和罗纹质感。背景虚化光学连续，不在头发周遭制造抠图光晕。不以美容校正变形脸形、眼睛大小、鼻子、嘴、手。不添加文字、标志、签名、水印、边框、拼贴、分隔、多切图，仅以一名成年女性和一个室内场景完成。

崩溃回避・禁止：
固定同一成年女性、暗色长发、象牙色罗纹吊带背心、左脸颊倚靠左手姿势、正面视线、闭合微笑、白色窗帘和暗色电视、柔和窗光。禁止左手手指增减、融合、贯穿脸颊、手腕反转、多余手臂。眼球方向不一致、双重虹膜、耳朵或颈部溶解、肩带消失、头发与手指融合。不以推测生成画面外的智能手机、右手、肘部位置、腰部、腿部、窗外风景。不使服装透视，不夸张胸口，不改变为幼颜。他者、镜像、电视内人物、文字、品牌不添加至背景。不生成插图、动画、3D、拼贴、网格、比较图像，仅生成一名成年女性的自然纵向照片。

prompts.text:
[Subject] Image 1 [Signature] There is a small Meta-operated Threads logo in the bottom right corner, with "CHAse" written in small white handwritten letters, looking like a signature.  
[Subject's Pose and Expression]  
Pose and Composition: Holding a blue vinyl LP cover with both hands above the head, a front-center medium shot (Medium Shot) capturing a lighthearted moment.  
Pose: Arms raised high in a triangular shape, slightly holding the LP cover upside down, upper body leaning cheerfully to the left side. The free-spirited upper body lines and the aesthetic beauty of the arm shapes create a lightheartedness like that of an independent artist.  
Expression: Not looking directly at the camera, but looking curiously and playfully askew toward the top right. The slightly parted lips and the transparent mask reveal the witty and sentimental atmosphere unique to Y2K indie pop.  
[Subject's Clothing and Props]  
Clothing:  
Top: A deep blue sleeveless cropped top with a vivid three-dimensional longitudinal ribbed (Ribbed) texture.  
Bottom: A minimalist light sky blue linen/denim textured long skirt with natural folds at the waistline, creating a sentimental tone-on-tone blue look.  
Props:  
LP Cover (CHASE - Love Wins All): Holding a bright cyan-blue LP paper cover above the head, creating a retro rock-style visual focus.  
Nails: Neatly manicured pure white (Pure White) nail art, forming a sharp color contrast with the blue-toned clothing and LP prop.  
[Subject's Hair and Makeup Details]  
Hairstyle: Voluminous jet black (Jet Black) long natural straight hair falling neatly over shoulders, chest, and back. The dark cuticle texture unique to the hair strands creates a prominent contrast with the blue clothing and skin tone.  
Makeup: Clear and three-dimensional porcelain-like skin base under direct flash. The eyes are modified with soft brown eyeshadow, and the lips are freshly finished with moist, hydrated pinkish-coral lip gloss.  
[Lighting and Light Direction]  
Light Source: Strong direct studio camera flash light (Direct Flash Light) from the front of the subject.  
Effect: The flash shines on the background wall, forming a clear and heavy drop shadow (Drop Shadow) following the character's outline, creating the intuitive and analog light-dark contrast unique to 90s retro pop magazine lifestyle photos.  
[Texture and Tonal Atmosphere (Core Texture Details)]  
Color: A harmonious and unified cool and fresh "Cool Retro Indie Pop" color atmosphere of deep blue (Deep Blue) on the top, sky blue (Sky Blue) on the skirt, and cyan blue (Cyan Blue) on the LP prop.  
Texture Details (Special Analysis):  
Paper LP cover texture: The unique matte and hard paper texture of the LP jacket and the fine texture of the printed surface.  
Fabric texture: The tight longitudinal ribbed texture of the sleeveless top and the light linen/cotton blend fine fold texture of the skirt fabric.  
Skin and shadow texture: Glowing skin texture under direct flash highlights and the hard shadow edge texture falling on the ivory wall behind.  
[Film and Camera Lens Depth of Field, Angle]  
Composition and Angle: A horizontal front composition aligned with the subject's eye-level (Eye-level).  
Features: Applying deep depth of field (Deep DoF) and high-definition sharp focus (Sharp Focus), not only the model's features but also the album typography of the LP cover, the longitudinal ribbed texture, and the white nail details are clearly presented without distortion.  
[Background and Studio Layout Elements]  
Space: A clean and concise light cold grey/ivory studio horizontal wall.  
Details: The area behind the character is simply arranged with only the right-leaning diagonal outline shadow formed by the flash, ensuring that the gaze is fully concentrated on the subject's witty pose and props.

prompts.text:
[人物] 图像 1 [签名] 右下角有一个小型的 Meta 运营的 Threads 标志，上面用白色手写体小字写着“CHAse”，像签名一样。  
[人物的姿势及表情]  
姿势及构图：双手举起蓝色乙烯基 LP 封面置于头顶上方，捕捉轻快瞬间的正面中心中景（Medium Shot）构图。  
姿势：双臂呈三角形高高举起，略微倒握 LP 封面，上身愉快地向左侧倾斜。自由奔放的上身线条与手臂的造型美感营造出独立艺术家般的轻快感。  
表情：没有直视镜头，而是好奇而调皮地斜眼看向右上方。微微张开的嘴唇和透明口罩中透出 Y2K 独立流行音乐特有的机智而感性的氛围。  
[人物服装及道具]  
服装：  
上衣：立体纵向罗纹（Ribbed）纹理活现的深蓝色无袖裁剪露脐上装。  
下装：腰线处带有自然褶皱的浅天空蓝调简约亚麻/牛仔质感长裙，搭配出感性的同色调（Tone-on-tone）蓝色造型。  
道具：  
LP 封面（CHASE - Love Wins All）：举起亮青蓝色 LP 纸质封面置于头顶上方，营造复古摇滚风格的视觉焦点。  
指甲：整齐修剪的纯白色（Pure White）指甲艺术，与蓝色调服装及 LP 道具形成鲜明色彩对比。  
[人物发型及化妆细节]  
发型：整齐地垂落在肩部、胸部及后背的丰盈纯黑（Jet Black）长自然直发造型。发丝特有的深色毛鳞纹理与蓝色服装及肤色形成突出的对比。  
化妆：直射闪光灯下清澈而立体的瓷器般皮肤底妆。眼部以柔和的棕色眼影修饰，嘴唇以含水润泽的粉嫩珊瑚色唇彩清新收尾。  
[照明及光线方向]  
光源：从主体正面强烈直射的摄影棚相机直闪光（Direct Flash Light）。  
效果：闪光照射在背景墙面上，形成跟随人物轮廓的清晰而浓重的投影（Drop Shadow），营造出 90 年代复古流行杂志生活照特有的直观而模拟的明暗对比。  
[质感与色调氛围（核心质感细节）]  
色彩：上衣的深蓝（Deep Blue）、裙子的天空蓝（Sky Blue）、LP 道具的青蓝（Cyan Blue）和谐统一的冷冽而清新的“酷复古独立流行（Cool Retro Indie Pop）”色彩氛围。  
质感细节（特殊分析）：  
纸质 LP 封面质感：LP 外套特有的哑光而坚硬的纸张质感及印刷面的细微纹理。  
织物质感：上衣无袖的紧密纵向罗纹纹理与裙子面料的轻盈亚麻/棉混纺细小褶皱纹理。  
皮肤及阴影质感：直射闪光高光下泛着光泽的皮肤纹理及后方象牙色墙面落下的坚硬阴影边缘纹理。  
[胶片及相机镜头景深、角度]  
构图及角度：与主体的眼平线（Eye-level）对齐的水平正面构图。  
特点：应用深景深（Deep DoF）和高清晰度的锐利对焦（Sharp Focus），不仅模型的五官，连 LP 封面的专辑排版、纵向罗纹纹理、白色指甲细节都无失真地清晰呈现。  
[背景及摄影棚布局元素]  
空间：简洁无赘余的浅冷灰/象牙色摄影棚水平墙面。  
细节：人物后方仅以闪光形成的右侧斜线轮廓阴影简单布置，确保视线完全集中在主体的机智姿势和道具上。

items.title: 真实摄影与稚拙扁平插画设计海报

prompts.text:
Please turn every photo I upload into an individual high-end design poster, not a multi-image collage; each photo should be output separately. The overall composition adopts a 3:4 vertical format, with the top and bottom sections strictly 1:1 in height, each taking up 50% of the frame.

The upper half preserves the original photo, maintaining the subject structure, realistic texture, natural light and shadow, and the original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end photographic color grading to give it the texture of an art magazine, independent publication, or exhibition photography. To fit the aspect ratio, the environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The lower half extracts the most recognizable subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, reconstructing it into a relaxed, naive Korean-style flat editorial illustration. Retain the general layout, object relationships, and core actions of the original image, but remove realistic light and shadow, perspective, and material details. Generalize the subject into rounded, simple, slightly exaggerated geometric shapes, using rough, shaky, partially broken black hand-drawn outlines paired with flat solid color fills, so the image remains instantly recognizable but not overly realistic.

The composition maintains one clear visual center, with other objects as foils, establishing a light rhythm through size differences, misalignment, occlusion, slight cropping, and incomplete symmetry. The background uses large areas of bright solid colors and white space to support the subject, retaining left/right or partial complete color blocks as breathing space; do not pile up complex scenes, making the image look like a carefully designed children's picture book or an independent editorial illustration, rather than a cartoonized photo.

The color scheme extracts the most vital and recognizable colors from the photo above and transforms them into high-brightness, high-purity, limited-quantity flat color blocks; bright blue, red, yellow, green, white, and other color relationships with childlike tension can be used, but do not mechanically apply fixed color palettes. The background and the subject form a sharp contrast in area, avoiding gradients, shadows, gray/dirty colors, complex color mixing, and a plastic feel.

The text also adopts a naive yet design-oriented editorial logic. Extract a short English title from the subject, action, mood, or story of the photo, and pair it with a small number of extremely small short sentences, object words, location words, numbers, or playful annotations. The main title can use a font that feels slightly handwritten, uneven in thickness, or slightly tilted, while the small text remains clear and restrained; the text can be arranged along the subject's outline, color block edges, white space areas, or the image axis, and can also feature slight rotation, misalignment, splitting, and interlacing, making the text feel like a part of the illustration itself rather than typography pasted on later.

The overall presentation is a visual temperament of real photography × naive flat illustration × relaxed editorial design, which is bright, childlike, intimate, playful, relaxed, and design-oriented. Whether the subject is a person, animal, plant, building, object, vehicle, food, or natural scene, a clear visual echo should be maintained between the original photo's identity and the illustration below, avoiding cheap cartoons, complex depictions, 3D textures, a commercial sticker feel, and templated children's illustrations.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体结构、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，使其具有艺术杂志、独立出版物与展览摄影质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为轻松、稚拙的韩式扁平编辑插画。保留原图的大致布局、物体关系和核心动作，但去除写实光影、透视和材质细节，将主体概括成圆润、简单、略带夸张的几何形状，以粗糙抖动、局部断开的黑色手绘轮廓搭配纯色平涂，让画面保持一眼可辨又不过度写实。

构图保持一个明确视觉中心，其余物体作为陪衬，通过大小差、错位、遮挡、轻微裁切和不完全对称建立轻快节奏。背景使用大面积明亮纯色与留白承托主体，可保留左右或局部完整色块作为呼吸空间，不堆积复杂场景，让画面像经过精心设计的儿童绘本或独立编辑插画，而不是照片卡通化。

配色从上方照片中提取最有生命力和辨识度的颜色，再转化为高明度、高纯度、数量有限的扁平色块；可使用亮蓝、红、黄、绿、白等具有童趣张力的色彩关系，但不机械套用固定色卡。背景与主体形成鲜明面积对比，避免渐变、阴影、灰脏色、复杂混色和塑料感。

文字同样采用稚拙而有设计感的编辑逻辑。从照片的主体、动作、情绪或故事中提炼一个简短英文标题，并搭配少量极小短句、对象词、地点词、编号或俏皮注释。主标题可使用略带手写感、粗细不均或轻微歪斜的字体，小字则保持清晰克制；文字可以沿主体轮廓、色块边缘、留白区域或画面轴线排列，也可出现轻微旋转、错位、拆分和穿插，使文字像插画本身的一部分，而不是后期贴上的排版。

整体呈现真实摄影 × 稚拙扁平插画 × 轻松编辑设计的视觉气质，明快、童趣、亲切、俏皮、松弛又有设计感。无论主体是人物、动物、植物、建筑、器物、交通工具、食物或自然场景，都应保持原图身份与下方插画之间清晰的视觉呼应，避免廉价卡通、复杂描绘、3D质感、商业贴纸感和模板化儿童插画。

items.title: ROSÉVA高端法式覆盆子甜点商业摄影海报

prompts.text:
Create a premium vertical dessert campaign poster for a fictional haute patisserie brand called ROSÉVA, combining Transit-style restraint with Orbit-style airy motion. The image must feel ultra-clean, elegant, soft, editorial, and commercially luxurious, while keeping the mini cake as the absolute visual hero. No copied text, no watermark, no clutter.

Main composition:
A single signature raspberry mini cake floats at the center-lower portion of the frame against a seamless dusty-rose studio background. The cake has a clean cylindrical mousse body, a thin golden biscuit base, faint raspberry compote seams near the lower edge, and a delicate pale-pink berry glaze gently dripping with realistic gravity. On top sits a sculptural swirl of whipped vanilla cream, crowned with several fresh raspberries and a few deep berry accents arranged in a refined clustered composition. Around the cake, place only a minimal orbit of oversized raspberries at different depths, with two or three softly blurred foreground/background berries and one or two sharper mid-depth berries, creating a graceful circular flow around the hero product without crowding it.

Transit restraint:
Keep the layout highly disciplined and premium. Preserve large negative space in the upper half for typography. Reduce all secondary fruit and decorative elements to the minimum necessary. The composition should read instantly: headline, hero cake, soft berry orbit, brand mark. No extra props, no crumbs scatter, no busy garnish.

Orbit motion:
The surrounding raspberries should feel like they are gently revolving around the cake in a soft suspended arc, creating elegant movement and flavor aura. Their placement must guide the eye in a subtle circular path toward the whipped topping and back down to the mousse body. Motion should feel light, poetic, and controlled, never chaotic.

Typography and branding:
At the upper center, place an elegant English script headline: “Softness in Bloom”. Beneath it, add a refined uppercase serif line: “RASPBERRY PETIT GATEAU”. Add a faint oversized translucent background word layer as a subtle graphic accent, softly integrated and partially cropped. At the lower center, place a very small luxury ROSÉVA logo mark. Typography must feel editorial, feminine, premium, and internationally commercial.

Lighting:
Soft diffused studio lighting from the upper front-left, with gentle right-side fill and a subtle overhead highlight on the whipped cream and raspberry surfaces. Shadows should be short, soft, and low-contrast, lightly anchoring the cake while preserving an airy bright atmosphere. Increase sculptural separation slightly so the mousse body, frosting ridges, and berry forms feel dimensional and premium.

Material rendering:
The mousse body must appear chilled, creamy, and ultra-realistic, with fine aerated microtexture and subtle natural porosity. The whipped topping should feel dense, smooth, and freshly piped, with refined ridges and a soft semi-matte sheen. Raspberries must show realistic drupelet structure, velvety bloom, seed detail, delicate translucency, and fresh natural irregularity. The pink glaze should appear lightly viscous, glossy, and physically believable. The biscuit base should show crisp fine crumb structure and warm toasted color.

Color system:
Dusty rose pink, whipped-cream ivory, raspberry crimson, pale blush, soft biscuit beige, and a few deep berry-red accents. The palette must stay restrained, elegant, and softly appetizing, with the red fruit acting as the controlled focal contrast.

Style:
Luxury patisserie advertising, minimalist editorial food photography, flagship dessert poster, Cannes-level commercial food image, ultra-realistic, feminine, tactile, premium, and globally marketable.

Image quality and physical constraints:
Ultra-detailed, high-resolution, crisp frosting edges, realistic berry skin texture, correct shallow depth-of-field falloff, clean background, believable floating physics, natural glaze gravity, no distorted cake geometry, no plastic food look, no dirty shadows, no dead-black areas, no random clutter.

Negative prompt:
cheap bakery flyer, copied original slogan, copied original brand text, cartoon dessert, plastic mousse, fake CGI frosting, oversaturated pink, messy composition, too many raspberries, cluttered background, distorted cake shape, broken floating physics, melting structure, artificial berry texture, harsh shadows, flat lighting, unreadable typography, watermark, random labels, low-end packaging style

prompts.text:
为虚构的高端法式甜品品牌 ROSÉVA 创作一张高端竖版甜点活动海报，结合 Transit 式的克制与 Orbit 式的灵动。图像必须呈现出极致的简洁、优雅、柔和、社论感和商业奢华感，同时保持迷你蛋糕为绝对的视觉核心。无复制文本，无水印，无杂乱。

主要构图：
一个标志性的覆盆子迷你蛋糕悬浮在画面中下方，背景是无缝的灰粉色影棚背景。蛋糕具有整洁的圆柱形慕斯主体、薄薄的金色饼干底座、靠近下边缘的隐约覆盆子果酱接缝，以及受真实重力影响轻轻滴落的精致淡粉色浆果淋面。顶部装饰着雕塑般的香草打发奶油旋涡，并冠以数颗新鲜覆盆子和一些深色浆果点缀，排列成精致的簇状结构。在蛋糕周围，仅放置一个由超大覆盆子组成的极简轨道，分布在不同深度，其中两三颗覆盆子位于前景/背景并柔和模糊，一两颗位于中景且较为清晰，为核心产品营造出优雅的环形流动感，且不显拥挤。

Transit 式克制：
保持布局高度自律且高端。上半部分保留大量留白用于排版。将所有次要水果和装饰元素减少到最低限度。构图应一目了然：标题、核心蛋糕、柔和的浆果轨道、品牌标识。无额外道具，无碎屑散落，无繁杂装饰。

Orbit 式灵动：
周围的覆盆子应感觉像是在围绕蛋糕以柔和的悬浮弧线轻轻旋转，营造出优雅的动态和风味氛围。它们的摆放必须引导视线以微妙的圆形路径移向顶部的奶油装饰，并回到下方的慕斯主体。动态应感觉轻盈、富有诗意且受控，绝不混乱。

排版与品牌：
在上方中央位置，放置一个优雅的英文手写体标题：“Softness in Bloom”。在其下方，添加一行精美的全大写衬线字体文字：“RASPBERRY PETIT GATEAU”。添加一层浅淡的超大半透明背景单词层作为微妙的图形点缀，柔和融合且部分被裁剪。在下方中央位置，放置一个非常小的奢华 ROSÉVA 标志。排版必须具有社论感、女性化、高端感和国际化商业属性。

灯光：

prompts.text: Create an approximately 2:3 vertical, authentic low-light smartphone mirror selfie. Avoid aggressive contouring, an exaggerated V-line jaw or oversized eyes.  Her hair is natural black to deep black-brown, long and highly voluminous, with a center or near-center part and long face-framing bangs. Most of the hair falls heavily toward frame left. The lower lengths form loose, imperfect waves rather than polished salon curls. Allow overlapping strands, mild frizz, irregular wave ends and some loss of micro-detail in the darkest areas from smartphone noise reduction.  She wears a warm-white off-shoulder Bardot-style ruched blouse with puffed sleeves. Both shoulders and the collarbone region remain visible, with elasticized gathered sleeve openings resting on the upper arms. The neckline is low and the center of the garment contains naturally gathered, overlapping and compressed white fabric. Preserve the garment's actual coverage rather than artificially altering the body's proportions. The material is lightweight, soft and opaque, turning slightly creamy under warm light. Keep the folds irregular and physically believable instead of smoothing the blouse into a pristine formal gown.  Visible skin includes the face, neck, collarbones, shoulders, upper chest and the portion of chest visible within the neckline, upper arms, forearm, phone-holding hand and fingers, plus part of a bent knee or leg in the lower foreground. The abdomen, back and hips are not clearly shown and should not be invented.  Use a light warm-ivory to pale beige-apricot complexion. The skin should look fine, soft and gently creamy while retaining natural depth and subtle tonal variation. Its visual texture should suggest skin that would feel warm, soft and lightly supple to the touch rather than plastic or poreless.  Translate the mood into physical lighting rather than vague atmospheric light. Use mixed-temperature practical indoor illumination: a warm approximately 3000–3400K lamp or tungsten-like source comes from the front and slightly toward frame right, possibly a little below eye level, creating amber-golden diffuse reflections across the phone-holding hand, forearm, shoulders and upper chest. A weaker cooler source from frame left—such as window light, a pale wall or ambient daylight—gently lifts the shadows. Allow warm orange and more neutral gray-cool regions to coexist across the skin and white fabric. Retain real shadows beside the nose, beneath the hair and around the phone; do not add studio rim lighting.  Add a very delicate silver necklace with a small abstract loop, droplet or curved-metal pendant. Thin silver rings appear on the phone-holding fingers. The nails are moderately long and naturally pink or nude-pink, with believable finger spacing and wrist tension.  The phone is a silver or pale-gray older-generation smartphone with vertically stacked dual rear cameras, inside a clear or pale-gray case. Preserve a rectangular sticker and a slim gray phone-grip accessory on the back. Any sticker lettering should remain mirrored, blurry or unreadable instead of becoming crisp AI-generated forward-facing text.  Allow a bent knee or leg to enter the lower foreground, appearing slightly enlarged because it is closer to the mirror/camera. This foreground obstruction is important to the spontaneous seated-selfie feeling and should not be cleaned out for the sake of perfect composition.  Keep the domestic environment recognizable. Frame right contains large areas of honey-brown or amber-brown wood paneling or cabinet doors. Frame left has a cooler pale-gray or creamy wall. A dark carved wooden mirror frame intrudes naturally along the upper and upper-left edges. Behind the subject hangs a framed decorative artwork containing only soft pink, muted blue and floral-like shapes. The phone, hair and body should obscure parts of the room.  Simulate an older smartphone rear main camera photographing through a mirror, roughly resembling a 26–30mm full-frame-equivalent phone lens, with the mirror distance reducing the harshness of the wide-angle perspective. Keep the subject, phone and nearby room broadly recognizable rather than using professional shallow-focus bokeh. Include mild JPEG compression, low-light noise reduction, slightly smeared dark hair detail, minor color shifts, uneven exposure and fine digital grain. Allow a slight tilt, off-center crop and imperfect framing. Avoid HDR, aggressive sharpening and commercial skin retouching.  The final image should feel like a romantic low-light mirror selfie in a warm wood interior, with soft East Asian social-media portrait styling and subtle 2000s/2010s nostalgia—something that had quietly lived in a phone photo album for years rather than a modern studio image recreated to look nostalgic.  She had just raised the phone in the warm room. The light has already been resting across her shoulders and hand for a while; now she is still looking near the screen, and in the next moment she may lower the phone and return to whatever had been interrupted. Theme:
Afternoon of raising white heels

Subject:
A woman in her 20s sitting on the floor by a light beige wall, extending one leg high towards the top right. The upper body is shown in the lower left of the frame, and long legs are placed diagonally in the top right, depicting white shirt-style clothing and white lace-up high heels.

Slender oval face and small chin, horizontally long dark brown eyes, detailed natural eyebrows, a small nose, and pale coral lips. The face turns from the shoulder toward the camera with a calm expression gazing straight ahead. Waist-length dark brown long hair, thin bangs, loose waves flowing toward the back, and a large white bow on the back of the head.

White thin long-sleeved shirt-style mini dress. Dropped shoulders with a wide collar, loose sleeves, and thin ties at the waist sides should be clearly depicted. White square-toe instep lace-up high heels with low block heels. Placing both hands on the floor to support the body, the character's own right leg is bent on the floor, and the left leg is stretched straight diagonally toward the top right.

Background・Lighting:
The background consists of a pale grey-beige wall with decorative moldings and a wooden floor with clear light and shadow. Warm direct sunlight is introduced from the left side of the frame, creating soft rim light on the hair, shoulders, and left leg, and casting window-frame-like light shadows on the floor.

Composition・Lens:
Vertical 3:4. Capture the whole body from a slightly front shot at the same height as the floor. Place the character's face and upper body in the left half, and the extended left leg and shoe largely in the wide negative space at the top right, with the bent right leg in the bottom right. Include both hands and both shoes in the frame, focusing on the face and nearby body with a medium depth of field.

Texture・Style:
Photorealistic photo with soft indoor natural light. Finely depict the texture of the skin, the luster of long hair, the thinness and folds of the white cloth, the reflections of the patent leather shoes, and the details of the wooden floor.

Negative:
Changing the pose of the left leg extending toward the top right; significantly changing the facial features.

prompts.text:
Create a premium vertical beverage advertising poster for a fictional tropical cafe brand called SOLARA SIP, featuring a signature drink called “Golden Pine Cream”. Preserve the core visual logic of a bold modern product poster: a single hero drink centered in the frame, a fully saturated monochrome background, oversized headline typography integrated behind and above the glass, one vertical side label, and one short bottom descriptor line. The drink must remain the absolute visual hero. Do not copy any original wording.

Main composition:
A short clear rocks glass sits slightly below center on a seamless vivid mango-yellow background and matching surface, creating an immersive monochrome field. The glass contains a chilled pineapple-latte fusion drink with a rich golden-yellow body, subtle gradient density, faint condensation, and a smooth creamy foam cap. A fresh triangular pineapple wedge floats on the foam surface as the top focal garnish, angled slightly toward camera. The glass casts a clean, sharply defined warm shadow diagonally to the lower right, adding graphic strength and midday sunlight realism. Keep the composition ultra-minimal, centered, and iconic.

Typography and layout:
Place a large bold uppercase English headline behind and above the drink in clean white sans-serif type: “GOLDEN / TROPIC” or “SUNLIT / BLEND”, stacked in two lines, tightly composed but not obscuring the product. Add one slim vertical side label on the left side in uppercase: “PINEAPPLE LATTE”. At the bottom center, place one short premium descriptor line in small uppercase white text, such as: “VELVETY PINEAPPLE, SILK FOAM, BRIGHT ISLAND ENERGY.” Add a tiny minimal brand mark near the top or lower area, very restrained and editorial.

Product design:
The drink should feel like a luxurious tropical latte or fruit-cream coffee hybrid: bright pineapple-gold liquid, subtly opaque, lightly aerated near the upper layer, smooth creamy foam on top, and one clean pineapple wedge with juicy fibrous translucency and natural rind detail. The glass must be thick-bottomed, premium, and crystal clear, with realistic refraction, soft internal reflections, and visible chilled density.

Lighting:
Strong clean directional sunlight from upper left, creating bright highlights on the glass rim, creamy foam, pineapple flesh, and upper liquid surface. The shadow should be crisp-edged but elegant, with high contrast and strong poster-like impact. Maintain bright luminous color without clipping highlights. No muddy darks, no dirty gradients, no dead black.

Material rendering:
Ultra-real beverage photography. The foam must look dense, silky, micro-bubbled, and softly glossy. The pineapple slice must show juicy flesh fibers, slight translucency, fresh moisture, and realistic yellow color variation. The glass must show accurate thickness, weight, polished edge highlights, realistic base refraction, and condensation haze near the cold liquid zone. The liquid should show believable opacity, suspended fruit-creamy density, and subtle tonal variation from top to bottom.

Color system:
Dominant palette of saturated tropical yellow, mango gold, pineapple yellow, creamy ivory foam, transparent glass neutrals, and crisp white typography. The entire image should feel bright, optimistic, refreshing, and design-led, with extremely controlled color harmony.

Style:
Cannes-level beverage advertising, luxury pop-minimal commercial poster, highly graphic modernist composition fused with ultra-real product photography, fresh, youthful, iconic, globally campaign-ready, and instantly memorable.

Image quality and physical constraints:
Ultra-detailed, high resolution, razor-sharp glass edges, clean centered geometry, realistic foam texture, correct pineapple anatomy, accurate glass refraction, believable sunlight shadow direction, no extra props, no fruit clutter, no messy splashes, no plastic drink texture, no low-end cafe menu feel.

Negative prompt:
copied original headline, copied original text, generic cafe poster, cheap juice ad, cluttered layout, extra fruits, splash explosion, plastic liquid, fake CGI glass, warped glass cylinder, muddy yellow, dirty background, flat lighting, weak shadow, unreadable typography, watermark, random labels, low-end menu design

一个矮身透明古典杯（rocks glass）位于画面中心略下方，置于无缝的亮丽芒果黄背景和配套平面上，营造沉浸式单色场。杯中装有冷藏的菠萝拿铁融合饮品，具有浓郁的金黄色泽、微妙的梯度密度、微弱的水汽凝结和顺滑的奶油奶泡层。一片新鲜的三角形菠萝块漂浮在奶泡表面，作为顶部视觉焦点装饰，并向相机方向微微倾斜。玻璃杯向右下方投射出干净、清晰且锐利的温暖阴影，增加图形强度和正午阳光的真实感。保持构图极简、居中且具标志性。

排版与布局：
在饮品后方和上方放置醒目的大号粗体英文标题，使用干净的白色无衬线字体：“GOLDEN / TROPIC”或“SUNLIT / BLEND”，分两行排列，构图紧凑但不遮挡产品。左侧添加一个大写的纤细垂直侧标签：“PINEAPPLE LATTE”。在底部中心，放置一行简短的高端描述语，使用白色大写小字，例如：“VELVETY PINEAPPLE, SILK FOAM, BRIGHT ISLAND ENERGY.” 在顶部或下方区域添加一个极小的极简品牌标志，非常克制且具社论风格。

产品设计：
饮品应给人一种奢华的热带拿铁或果油咖啡混合感：明亮的菠萝金色液体，微不透明，上层轻微充气，顶部有顺滑的奶油奶泡，以及一片展现出多汁纤维半透明感和自然果皮细节的干净菠萝块。玻璃杯必须是厚底、高端且晶莹剔透的，具有真实的折射、柔和的内部反射和可见的冷藏密度。

光效：
来自左上方的强烈清晰定向阳光，在杯缘、奶油奶泡、菠萝果肉和液体上表面产生明亮的高光。阴影应边缘清晰但优雅，具有高对比度和强大的海报冲击力。保持明亮发光的色彩，且高光不溢出。无沉闷暗部，无脏乱渐变，无死黑。

材质渲染：
超真实的饮料摄影。奶泡必须看起来绵密、丝滑、有微小气泡且带有柔和光泽。菠萝片必须展现多汁的果肉纤维、轻微的半透明感、新鲜的水分和真实的黄色色泽变化。玻璃杯必须展现准确的厚度、重量感、抛光边缘的高光、真实的杯底折射，以及冷液体区域附近的水汽凝结。液体应显示出可信的不透明度、悬浮的果油密度以及从上到下的微妙色调变化。

色彩系统：
以饱和的热带黄、芒果金、菠萝黄、奶油色象牙奶泡、透明玻璃中性色和利落的白色排版为主的主色调。整个图像应感到明亮、乐观、清爽且由设计主导，具有极佳受控的色彩和谐感。

风格：
戛纳广告奖级别的饮料广告，奢华波普极简商业海报，高度图形化的现代主义构图与超真实产品摄影相结合，清新、年轻、标志性，具备全球活动水准且令人过目难忘。

图像质量与物理约束：
超精细、高分辨率、极其锋利的玻璃边缘、干净的居中几何构图、真实的奶泡纹理、正确的菠萝结构、准确的玻璃折射、可信的阳光阴影方向，无额外道具，无水果杂乱，无凌乱溅射，无塑料质感饮品，无低端咖啡馆菜单感。

负面提示：
复制的原始标题，复制的原始文本，平庸的咖啡馆海报，廉价果汁广告，凌乱的布局，多余的水果，喷溅爆炸，塑料液体，假 CGI 玻璃杯，变形的圆柱玻璃杯，沉闷的黄色，脏乱背景，平淡光效，微弱阴影，无法阅读的排版，水印，随机标签，低端菜单设计。

items.title: 极简人文抽象艺术海报设计

prompts.text: Please turn each photo I upload into an independent high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, each photo output individually. The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical format, with the top and bottom areas strictly 1:1 in height, each occupying 50% of the screen. The upper half retains the original photo, maintaining the subject structure, real texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, with only slight high-end photographic color grading to give it a magazine photography and art exhibition quality. To adapt to the frame, the sky, ground, or environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed. The lower half extracts the most recognizable subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, reconstructing them into a minimalist abstract geometric visual expression. Use simple geometric shapes, flat color blocks, fine lines, structural lines, and negative space to re-summarize the subject. Do not make realistic illustrations or pile up complex details, but clear features must be retained so that the original object can be recognized at a glance. A small number of horizontal lines, outlines, spatial division lines, or abstract environmental elements can be added based on the original image's relationships, allowing the image to maintain order and a sense of breath within restraint. The composition emphasizes balance, rhythm, and humanistic temperament. With the subject in the lower half as the sole visual core, the overall layout is centered but not stiffly symmetrical, establishing a quiet and professional layout order through proportion control, positive and negative space relationships, density changes, slight layer shifts, and large areas of white space. The image should be concise, stable, and restrained, while carrying a bit of gentle spatial undulation and a shallow embossed feel, making the geometric shapes appear as if slightly imprinted or subtly raised from the paper surface, forming a delicate and subtle three-dimensional layering rather than an obvious 3D effect. The color scheme is extracted from the photo above, but not mechanically copied; instead, it is transformed into a softer color palette with more humanistic temperament. Use low-stimulation, warm, and restrained colors such as off-white, warm white, light gray, sand, dusty pink, light ochre, misty blue, and sage green as the base. Retain the most atmospheric primary and secondary colors from the original image to form a harmonious, quiet, and enduring relationship through a limited palette. The overall colors should be gentle, clear, and full of cultural and life sense, avoiding cheap high saturation, dirty gray distortion, cold high-tech feel, and common commercial color schemes. Keep the text minimal and high-end, not just place names, but concise English titles extracted from the photo's theme, identity, emotion, action, time, or metaphor, accompanied by a small number of numbers, status words, or tiny annotations. The text can be naturally arranged along the subject's outline, structural lines, edges of white space, or the image axis, composing with the graphics in a restrained high-end editorial manner to form a low-key but designed layout relationship. Overall refer to international design studios, architectural posters, art exhibition posters, and high-end brand visual systems, presenting a high-end, modern, quiet, humanistic, artistic, restrained, and gentle visual temperament. Avoid common filters, cheap vector feel, excessive 3D, cartoonish feel, e-commerce feel, and template feel.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体结构、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，使其具有杂志摄影和艺术展览质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展天空、地面或环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的**主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系**，重构为极简抽象的几何视觉表达。使用简洁几何形状、扁平色块、细线条、结构线与留白重新概括主体，不做写实插画，不堆砌复杂细节，但必须保留清晰特征，使人能够一眼识别原物。可根据原图关系加入少量水平线、轮廓线、空间分割线或抽象环境元素，让画面在克制中保有秩序与呼吸感。

构图强调**平衡、节奏与人文气质**。以下半部分主体为唯一视觉核心，整体偏居中但不僵硬对称，通过比例控制、正负形关系、疏密变化、轻微层次错动和大面积留白建立安静而专业的版面秩序。画面应简洁、稳定、克制，同时带有一点温和的空间起伏与浅浅的浮雕感，让几何形体仿佛轻微压印或微微隆起于纸面之上，形成细腻、含蓄的立体层次，而不是明显3D效果。

配色从上方照片中提取，但不机械照搬，而是转化为更具**人文主义气质**的柔和色组。以米白、暖白、浅灰、沙色、灰粉、浅赭、雾蓝、鼠尾草绿等低刺激、温润、克制的颜色为基调，从原图中保留最有气质的主色与辅助色，通过有限色盘形成和谐、安静、耐看的关系。整体色彩应温和、清透、富有文化感与生活感，避免廉价高饱和、脏灰失真、冰冷科技感和普通商业配色。

文字保持少量且高级，不只是地点名，而应从照片的**主题、身份、情绪、动作、时间或隐喻**中提炼简洁英文标题，并搭配少量编号、状态词或微型注释。文字可沿主体轮廓、结构线、留白边缘或画面轴线自然排布，以克制的高级编辑方式与图形共同构图，形成低调但有设计感的版式关系。

整体参考国际设计工作室、建筑海报、艺术展览海报与高级品牌视觉系统，呈现**高级、现代、安静、人文、艺术化、克制而温柔**的视觉气质。避免普通滤镜、廉价矢量感、过强3D、卡通感、电商感和模板感。

items.title: 博物馆大理石阳台女性摄影写实肖像

prompts.text: Create a realistic vertical 9:16 photographed portrait. Subject and action: One woman standing at the upper-level railing, leaning into the writing surface and looking down at the page. Hair and styling: Render an adult woman's hair as a chin-length center-part bob with natural root volume, in deep chocolate brown, only within jaw-to-collarbone bob, lob, or compact-tie geometry. Composition: Vertical three-quarter-to-nearly-full-body environmental portrait, subject placed right of center on an upper-level marble balcony; head in the upper-middle of frame, body extending beyond the bottom edge with feet cropped out; broad view of the museum atrium, arches. Camera: Eye-level camera from slightly behind and to her left, showing a clear left-facing three-quarter profile; natural 35–50mm lens feel at conversational distance, mild background falloff, no exaggerated perspective. Color and depth relationships: Near-black outfit and dark hair mass set against cool ivory-grey marble and muted blue-grey architecture, with chandelier bulbs and skin providing the only restrained warm notes. Pose: Standing close to the balcony rail with torso angled left and leaning forward from the hips. Wardrobe: Fitted black long-sleeve turtleneck tucked into high-waisted loose black tailored trousers, with natural sleeve compression and small wrinkles at the bent elbows and waist; small plain gold hoop earrings; No shoes visible because the frame crops above the feet. Setting: Grand historic museum or gallery atrium viewed from an upper-floor marble balcony, with carved stone balusters, veined marble columns, repeated rounded arches, two tall glowing. Lighting: Soft cool daylight enters from the tall windows behind and to the left, mixed with dim warm chandelier light; the face receives gentle side illumination while the outfit remains very dark, and the windows are bright but softly rolled off. Finish: Muted film-like editorial photograph with cool grey-green ambient color, restrained saturation, moderate-low contrast, softly lifted shadow detail in the architecture, deep but not featureless blacks in the outfit, gentle highlight roll-off around the windows and chandeliers, faint fine grain, slight optical softness. Skin and material texture: unretouched photographed skin with visible pores, vellus hair, under-eye/lip texture, tonal variation, and faint grain on face, neck, ears, and hands, including flash, monochrome, and low light; global grain or noise alone does not satisfy this constraint. Rendering constraints: keep the exact crop, body-to-camera relationship, hand task, gaze direction, light direction, foreground obstruction, and background placement; preserve believable anatomy and natural hands; avoid beauty-filter skin, studio-clean restaging, generic fashion posing, text, logos, borders, and watermarks.

prompts.text: 创建一张写实的 9:16 纵向摄影肖像。主体与动作：一名女性站在上层栏杆处，靠在书写面上并向下凝视页面。发型与造型：将成年女性的发型呈现为下巴长度的中分波波头，带有自然的根部蓬松感，颜色为深巧克力棕色，仅限在下颚至锁骨的波波头、长波波头（lob）或紧凑扎起的几何形状内。构图：纵向四分之三至接近全身的环境人像，主体置于上层大理石阳台中心偏右的位置；头部位于画面中上部，身体延伸超出底部边缘，切掉双脚；博物馆中庭、拱门的宽广视野。相机：与眼平齐的相机，位于其斜后方左侧，展示清晰的左向四分之三侧面；自然的 35–50mm 镜头感，处于谈话距离，背景有轻微的虚化，无夸张透视。色彩与深度关系：近乎黑色的套装和深色发团与冷色调的象牙灰大理石及柔和的蓝灰色建筑形成对比，吊灯灯泡和皮肤提供仅有的克制的暖色调。姿势：紧靠阳台栏杆站立，躯干向左倾斜并从臀部向前弯曲。衣着：修身的黑色长袖高领衫塞进高腰宽松黑色西装裤中，手肘弯曲处和腰部有自然的袖子压缩和细小褶皱；精致的纯金圆环耳环；因为构图裁剪在脚部以上，所以看不见鞋子。场景：从高层大理石阳台俯瞰宏伟的历史博物馆或画廊中庭，带有雕刻的石制栏杆、有纹理的大理石柱、重复的圆拱门、两个高大的发光物。光照：柔和的冷色日光从后方和左侧的高窗射入，与昏暗的暖色吊灯光线混合；面部接受柔和的侧向照明，而套装保持非常暗的色调，窗户明亮但光影柔和。后期效果：柔和的电影感社论照片，具有冷灰绿色环境色，克制的饱和度，中低对比度，建筑中柔和提升的阴影细节，套装中深邃但并非毫无细节的黑色，窗户和吊灯周围柔和的高光溢出，微细的颗粒，轻微的光学柔和感。皮肤与材质纹理：未经修饰的摄影皮肤，具有清晰可见的毛孔、汗毛、眼下/嘴唇纹理、色调变化，以及面部、颈部、耳朵和手部的微细颗粒，包括闪光灯、单色和低光效果；仅靠全局颗粒或噪点不足以满足此约束。渲染约束：保持准确的裁剪、身体与相机的关系、手部任务、注视方向、光照方向、前景遮挡和背景放置；保留可信的人体解剖结构和自然的手部；避免美颜滤镜皮肤、影棚级的洁净重构、通用的时尚摆拍、文字、标志、边框和水印。

prompts.text:
Please turn my uploaded photo into a vertical collage poster with an overall 3:4 vertical composition. The image is strictly divided into four horizontal areas from top to bottom, and the height of each area must be precisely controlled at 25% of the overall image height (the ratio of the four layers is strictly 1:1:1:1, no ratio deviation allowed). The areas are connected seamlessly without dividing lines or gaps. The order is: original image → Style 1 → Style 2 → Style 3. Since each layer has an extremely wide ratio of approximately 3:1, it is suggested that the main subject of each layer be arranged horizontally centered, emphasizing open white space and a sense of breathing on the left and right, avoiding vertical stretching deformation or crowded edges. The four layers maintain continuity and resonance in character positioning, scene structure, and line of sight, presenting an overall sense of the same scene through four translations. The style layers (layers 2 to 4) must follow the principle of minimalism: the number of visual elements in each layer is compressed to the minimum, retaining only 1 most core main symbol, and all other secondary decorations, background details, and foil elements are omitted. The white space ratio is no less than 60%.

The first layer retains the main structure, real character interaction relationships and poses, real texture, natural light and shadow, and the original color atmosphere of the original photo. Only slight high-end photographic color grading is performed to present a magazine photography texture, without changing the character relationships and composition logic. The sky, ground, or environmental background can be naturally expanded without changing character relationships and composition logic to make the whole more spatial and narrative.

The second layer is in woodcut style: high-contrast black and white woodcut knife marks express scene textures and character silhouettes, supplemented by one or two limited color accents. The background is cream or light gray paper, and the knife mark lines are bold and powerful but not messy. Colors are mainly black and cream, paired with one accent color. Avoid overly dense knife marks and avoid too many grayscale levels that make the image look gray.

The third layer is in torn paper collage style: torn edge paper color blocks are used to represent characters and the environment, and the layered edges retain natural tear textures. The background is a cream kraft paper base color. The main elements are composed of several torn edge colored papers stacked together, with no more than three layers. Colors are controlled within 2 to 4 natural color systems. Avoid clutter caused by too many paper pieces and avoid overly fine cut edges.

The fourth layer is in cyanotype style: using cyanotype photography (blueprinting) style, with single Prussian blue and white representing character and environment silhouettes, creating an old craft texture. The background is cream or light bluish-white, and there may be a slight graininess from development. The color is a monochromatic system of Prussian blue and white. Avoid adding other miscellaneous colors and avoid overly heavy graininess that looks dirty.

Each layer needs to uniformly convert the subject and scene into the corresponding style. The overall expression is extremely restrained and simplified, retaining only the most core main symbol and its basic outline relationship, deleting all non-essential background elements, decorative details, and foil items; the key positional relationships, interaction directions, and pose characteristics between characters must be retained but should be abstracted into recognizable outline relationships, achieving "fewer elements, clearer relationships." Colors are all extracted and summarized from the original image, with each layer strictly controlled within 2-4 main colors. The height ratio of the four areas must be strictly maintained at 1:1:1:1 (25% each), and no splicing misalignment or ratio deviation should occur. Overall, avoid punk/cyberpunk styles, forced overlay of realistic photo textures, cartoon styles, 3D rendering feel, commercial poster feel, complex background stacking, too many elements or crowded images, similar styles in adjacent layers, and any text, logos, watermarks, or titles.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的照片制作成一张竖版拼图海报，整体采用 3:4 竖版构图。画面从上到下严格四等分为四个横向区域，每个区域的高度必须精确控制为整体画面高度的25%（四层比例严格为1:1:1:1，不允许出现比例偏差），区域之间无缝衔接，不设分隔线、不留间隙，顺序为：原图→风格1→风格2→风格3。由于每层为约3:1的极扁宽幅比例，各层主体建议横向居中排布，强调左右开阔留白与呼吸感，避免元素纵向拉伸变形或贴边拥挤。四层在人物站位、场景结构、视线方向上保持连贯呼应，呈现同一画面、四种转译的整体感。风格层（第二至四层）须遵循极简原则：每层视觉元素数量压缩至最低限度，只保留1个最核心的主体符号，其余次要装饰、背景细节与陪衬元素一律省略，画面留白占比不低于60%。

第一层保留原始照片的主体结构、人物真实互动关系与姿态、真实质感、自然光影与原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，呈现杂志摄影质感，不改变人物关系与构图逻辑，并可在不改变人物关系与构图逻辑的前提下自然扩展天空、地面或环境背景，使整体更具空间感与叙事感。

第二层为木刻版画风格：以高对比黑白木刻刀痕表现场景肌理与人物剪影，辅以一至两处限定色点缀。背景为米白或浅灰纸底，刀痕线条粗犷有力但不杂乱。色彩以黑、米白为主，搭配一处点缀色。避免刀痕过密，避免灰阶层次过多导致画面发灰。

第三层为撕纸拼贴风格：以撕边纸张色块拼贴表现人物与环境，层叠边缘保留自然撕痕肌理。背景为米白牛皮纸底色。主体元素由数张撕边色纸叠放构成，层次不超过三层。色彩控制在2至4种自然色系以内。避免纸片过多导致画面凌乱，避免裁剪边缘过于精细。

第四层为蓝晒氰版风格：采用氰版摄影（蓝晒）风格，以单一普鲁士蓝与白表现人物与环境剪影，营造老工艺质感。背景为米白或浅蓝白底，可有轻微显影颗粒感。色彩为普鲁士蓝与白的单色系。避免加入其他杂色，避免颗粒感过重显脏。

每一层需将主体与场景统一转换为对应风格，整体表达极度克制与简化，只保留最核心的一个主体符号及其基本轮廓关系，删除一切非必要的背景元素、装饰细节与陪衬物；人物之间的关键位置关系、互动方向与姿态特征需保留，但应抽象为可识别的轮廓关系，做到“元素越少、关系越清晰”。色彩均从原图中提取归纳，每层严格控制在2-4种主色以内。四个区域的高度比例须严格保持1:1:1:1（各占25%），不可出现拼接错位或比例偏差。整体避免朋克/赛博朋克风格、写实照片质感强行叠加、卡通风格、3D渲染感、商业海报感、复杂背景堆砌、元素过多或画面拥挤、相邻两层风格雷同，以及任何文字、Logo、水印或标题。

prompts.text:
Use the uploaded product image as the single source of truth.

Create one premium 16:9 campaign image where the product appears inside a physical ad surface such as a poster, framed print, billboard, lightbox, screen, or magazine page, and one meaningful part of the same product breaks beyond that boundary into real space.

The boundary break must prove the product’s real benefit. The product stays fully accurate and unchanged. There is only one product, and the inside/outside portions must connect perfectly.

Create a clean, high-end editorial composition with bold framing, refined negative space, cinematic lighting, accurate perspective, realistic contact shadows, tactile materials, and strong depth.

prompts.text:
2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 texas or other state specific famous dinners: INPUT = [DISH / SEASON_OR_OCCASION / FLAVOR_PROFILE / INGREDIENT_MODE / AUDIENCE] 

Run INDULGENT_RECIPE_PROMO_EXTRACTION:

DISH_DNA := infer category, texture, serving vessel, portion style, visual structure, flavor cues, and emotional appeal

OCCASION_DNA := infer holiday, party, weekday meal, family dinner, luxury dessert, picnic, brunch, sports night, date night, wellness routine, or cultural context

HERO_FOOD := infer best appetizing presentation:
scoop lift, slice pull, pour, steam, drizzle, fork bite, spoonful, cross-section, stacked layers, melting, crunch break, garnish fall, or glass pour

TITLE_SYSTEM := infer bold headline, descriptive modifier, flavor-forward name, and short craveable subtitle

INGREDIENT_SYSTEM := infer core ingredients, packaging vs fresh items, plus signs, labels, preparation notes, and substitutions if useful

CALLOUTS := infer badge claims:
easy, make-ahead, crowd-pleaser, no-bake, high-protein, cozy, spicy, crunchy, creamy, refreshing, budget-friendly, kid-friendly, etc.

MOOD_PROPS := infer contextual props from occasion:
seasonal produce, utensils, napkins, candles, table surface, cultural objects, party decor, kitchen tools, or none

ICON_STRIP := infer 3–5 benefits or use cases with simple icons

RENDER_STYLE := infer commercial food photography, editorial recipe card, social ad, cookbook spread, or packaging-inspired promo

A delicious promotional recipe graphic where the food, ingredients, copy, and props all come from the input dish.
