prompts.text:
Please turn each uploaded photo into a separate premium design poster. Do not combine multiple images. Each photo should be output as an individual poster. Use a 3:4 vertical composition, divided strictly into two equal sections, with the upper and lower halves each occupying 50% of the canvas.

The upper half should preserve the original photograph, including the subject structure, authentic texture, natural lighting, and original atmosphere. Apply only subtle high-end editorial color grading to give it the quality of magazine photography and art exhibition imagery. To fit the composition, the sky, ground, or surrounding environment may be naturally extended, but the main subject must not be stretched, distorted, or altered.

The lower half should extract the most recognizable subject, silhouette, posture, structural features, and narrative relationship from the photograph, then reinterpret them as a minimalist surreal 3D space with a Monument Valley-inspired visual language. Do not mechanically reproduce the original image. Translate its key characteristics into platforms, stairways, arches, passages, bridges, suspended structures, and impossible architecture, using height differences, pathways, connections, occlusion, isolation, and repetition to express the mood and story of the photograph. Use an orthographic isometric perspective. The geometry should feel clean, poetic, quiet, and surreal, while remaining clearly connected to the subject in the upper image.

The lower half should not directly inherit the overall colors of the original photograph. Instead, use a distinctive Monument Valley-inspired pastel color system: cream white, pale sandstone, misty pink, coral, soft lavender, sky blue, aqua, mint green, and similar luminous tones. Each poster should automatically select 2–4 dominant colors, combining analogous hues with subtle warm–cool contrast. Add only one small high-purity accent color—such as coral red, vivid pink, turquoise, or soft yellow—on a doorway, turning point, figure, or key architectural detail. Emphasize large clean color fields, clear planar separation, and tonal variations within the same hue family. The overall palette should feel bright, airy, translucent, and dreamlike. Avoid muddy colors, yellowish casts, low-value palettes, large areas of brown or black, and generic muted “Morandi” palettes.

The 3D materials must be extremely clean, smooth, matte, and solid-colored, with soft even lighting and very subtle ambient shadows. The image should feel crisp, polished, and digitally pristine. No grain, film noise, paper texture, roughness, dust, distressed printing, speckled surfaces, heavy PBR materials, or glossy reflections.

Typography should appear only as small editorial annotations, never as a large headline. Based on the emotion, relationship, or story within the photo, generate one short poetic Chinese line or aphorism with subtle meaning and emotional resonance. Use thin, restrained, geometric typography that matches the Monument Valley-inspired visual system. Keep the text small, with generous letter spacing and ample negative space. Place it quietly along an edge, corner, architectural void, or empty area, allowing subtle alignment, overlap, or interaction with the geometry. A much smaller English translation may be added beneath it. Do not use years, dates, serial numbers, “vol.” labels, oversized typography, bold poster slogans, or dominant text.

The final result should create a dual narrative: the upper half represents the real world, while the lower half becomes its poetic spatial interpretation. Photography carries reality and memory; geometry carries emotion and metaphor; the small text leaves a quiet afterthought. The overall image should feel bright, clean, dreamy, restrained, intelligent, and unmistakably Monument Valley-inspired, while remaining adaptable to people, architecture, animals, still life, landscapes, and interior scenes.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体结构、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，使其具有杂志摄影与艺术展览质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展天空、地面或环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为「纪念碑谷气质」的极简超现实主义3D空间。不要机械复制原图，而是将核心特征转译为平台、台阶、门洞、拱桥、通道、悬浮结构与不可能空间，通过高低差、路径、连接、遮挡、孤立和重复关系表达照片的情绪与故事。采用正交等距视角，几何结构简洁、诗意、安静，同时保持与上方主体清晰可辨的对应关系。

下半部分不要直接提取上方照片的综合色彩，而是使用鲜明的纪念碑谷式动态粉彩系统：以奶油白、浅砂岩、雾粉、珊瑚粉、柔紫、天空蓝、湖水青、薄荷绿等清透色彩进行组合，每张作品根据主题自动选择2—4个主色，通过相邻色与冷暖对比形成完整色组，并在门洞、转折、人物或局部结构加入1处较高纯度的橙红、玫红、蓝绿或明黄作为视觉跳点。强调大面积纯净色块、清晰色面分区和同色系明度层级，整体明亮、柔和、通透、有空气感，避免灰脏、发黄、低明度、大面积棕色、黑色以及普通莫兰迪配色。

3D材质保持极其干净、平滑、哑光、纯色，使用柔和均匀的光线和轻微环境阴影塑造空间。画面必须清澈细腻，禁止颗粒、噪点、纸张纹理、胶片感、磨砂纹理、旧印刷效果、脏污、复杂PBR材质和强烈反光。

文字只作为小尺寸编辑注释存在，不做大标题，不抢主体。根据照片中的情绪、关系或故事提炼一句简短、有余韵的中文金句或诗性短句，使用纤细、简洁、几何化的纪念碑谷式排版语言，字号较小、字距舒展、留白充足，可安静地放置在画面边缘、角落、建筑留白或下方空白处，并与几何结构形成对齐、遮挡或微妙穿插。可附一行更小的英文意译。不要出现年份、日期、编号、vol.，不要巨大文字、粗体标题或海报式口号。

整体呈现「上方真实世界，下方诗意空间」的双重叙事：摄影负责真实与记忆，几何空间负责情绪与隐喻，小字金句负责留下余韵。最终效果明亮、纯净、梦幻、克制、聪明，具有鲜明的纪念碑谷式空间语言与粉彩配色，同时适配人物、建筑、动物、静物、自然景观和室内空间等不同题材。
```

prompts.text:
Create a premium editorial juice-campaign poster for a fictional wellness beverage brand called AURORA PRESS, refined in a more international, cleaner, and more luxurious Transit direction. The whole image must feel like a flagship health-drink editorial page from a top-tier global lifestyle magazine.

Main composition:
Place one clear glass bottle filled with vivid fresh orange juice in the lower-center as the visual anchor. Around it, arrange a highly disciplined ingredient constellation: a halved apple near the upper-right center, one large orange slice near the upper-left center, a piece of fresh ginger near the upper-middle, a few carrot coin slices placed with editorial precision, one lemon wedge near the upper-right, and one small ginger slice below. Keep the ingredient spacing more refined and intentional, with increased breathing room and less visual noise. The bottle must remain the unquestioned hero.

Product realism:
The bottle must be rendered with premium realism: transparent glass, vivid orange liquid, subtle pulp density, soft reflective highlights, natural meniscus, light refraction, and a clean white cap. Ingredients must look fresh and elevated: juicy orange pulp, moist apple flesh with visible seed cavity, realistic ginger fiber texture, crisp carrot cross-sections, glossy lemon flesh, and subtle organic imperfections. All materials should feel more polished and editorial than a casual recipe page.

Graphic design layer:
Use a restrained hand-drawn black doodle system with cleaner hierarchy and fewer marks: a few sketched fruit outlines, minimal arrows, and elegant accent lines only where they help the composition. Add original ingredient labels in a mix of hand-drawn and editorial type, all fully original. Place one large expressive orange headline across the middle such as “Fresh Lift” or “Bright Fuel,” fully original, but keep it cleaner and more internationally art-directed than a playful craft page. Below or left of the bottle, include a compact ingredients list and short preparation guide in refined editorial microcopy. Near the upper-left, place one kraft-paper tip tag with string and original tiny note text, but keep it smaller, neater, and more premium.

Style:
Luxury wellness editorial, premium juice recipe campaign, global health-magazine commercial page, clean real-fruit photography fused with restrained hand-drawn annotation, sophisticated and highly shoppable. The whole page must feel like a polished brand-sponsored editorial feature.

Lighting and mood:
Soft natural daylight from upper-left or upper-front, with delicate object shadows, clean bottle highlights, and gentle separation from the white background. Keep the image bright, airy, and health-oriented, but more refined and internationally premium. Avoid overly playful contrast; use subtle tonal discipline.

Color system:
Bright white background, vivid juice orange, carrot orange, citrus yellow, soft apple cream and red, ginger beige, restrained black doodle lines, muted kraft-paper beige, and subtle dark gray editorial text. Keep the palette clean, optimistic, and globally premium.

Negative prompt:
no copied text, no existing magazine layout, no cluttered ingredient arrangement, no dirty background, no warped fruit shapes, no low-detail bottle, no muddy orange liquid, no black blotches, no messy doodles, no watermark, no existing logos, no chaotic typography.

items.title: 高级杂志感手写观察图谱海报

prompts.text:
Please turn every photo I upload into an individual high-end design poster, no multi-image stitching, output each photo separately. The overall composition uses a 3:4 vertical layout, with the top and bottom two areas strictly at a 1:1 height, each occupying 50% of the frame.

The upper part preserves the original photo, maintaining the main structure, real texture, natural light and shadow, and original color atmosphere, only performing slight high-end photographic color grading to give it the texture of magazine photography and art publications. To adapt to the frame, the sky, ground, or environmental background can be naturally extended, but the subject must not be stretched, distorted, or changed.

The lower part extracts the most recognizable subject, outline, posture, and narrative relationship from the photo, reconstructing it into a relaxed, intimate, and refreshing handwritten observation map. With a large area of clean white paper as the main space, the theme is broken down into several small block-like physical graphics, partial close-ups, cross-section small images, repeated small items, or detail fragments, loosely distributed in the upper-middle and middle sections of the frame, without a rigid table, but using staggered white space, a rhythm akin to horizontal reading, and handwritten phrases to naturally connect them, forming a casual observation record like taste, touch, sound, action, or memory. Small graphics should retain the material feel, color, and identification characteristics of the subject itself, presenting small scales, rounded outlines, slight perspective, and hand-painted coloring marks, with local parts carrying particles, charred edges, debris, textures, or cross-section details; do not unify them into standard icons, but rather a physical note feeling between picture book illustrations and journal stickers.

Text is the important skeleton of the lower part. Use thin black, slightly childlike or handwritten short words, short sentences, onomatopoeia, and annotations, interspersed around the graphics, some close to the edges of the graphics, some floating in the blank space, with relaxed character spacing and slightly jumping baselines, forming an intimate reading rhythm of 'reading while looking'; a smaller signature-style explanation, number, date, title, or thematic short sentence can be added at the bottom, making the text naturally integrate into the picture rather than a post-pasted layout label.

The overall color scheme is extracted from the upper photo, with white paper white space occupying the largest area, thin black characters carrying information, and the main color being warm, clean, and slightly high in brightness; a small amount of high-saturation warm colors, dark colors, or thematic auxiliary colors are only used for focus, shadows, textures, and rhythmic embellishments. Retain the slight softening, natural compression, uneven edges, and pigment absorption effects of scanned paper, without adding heavy shadows, decorative borders, or a strong sense of modern layout. The overall style references handwritten observation pages, picture book information pages, art publications, and relaxed editorial design, presenting a refreshing, gentle, naive, agile, readable, and life-like visual temperament, avoiding a template feel, cartoonization, cheapness, and over-design.

prompts.text:
请将我上传的每一张照片分别制作成一张独立的高级设计海报，不多图拼接，每张照片单独输出。整体采用3:4竖版构图，上下两个区域高度严格1:1，各占画面50%。

上半部分保留原始照片，保持主体结构、真实质感、自然光影和原有色彩氛围，仅进行轻微高级摄影调色，使其具有杂志摄影与艺术出版物质感。为适配画幅，可自然扩展天空、地面或环境背景，但不得拉伸、扭曲或改变主体。

下半部分提取照片中最具识别性的主体、轮廓、姿态与叙事关系，重构为轻松、亲切、清爽的手写观察图谱。以大面积洁白纸面作为主要空间，将主题拆解为若干小块实物状图形、局部特写、剖面小图、重复小件或细节片段，松散分布于画面中上部与中段，不做严整表格，而以错位留白、近似横向阅读的节奏和手写短语自然串联，形成像对味觉、触感、声音、动作或记忆的随手观察记录。小图形应保留主题自身的材料感、颜色与识别特征，呈现小尺幅、圆钝轮廓、轻微透视和手绘上色痕迹，局部带有颗粒、焦边、碎屑、纹理或剖面细节，不要统一成标准图标，而要像绘本插图与手账贴纸之间的实物笔记感。

文字是下半部分的重要骨架。使用细黑色、略带童稚感或手写感的短词、短句、拟声词和注释，围绕图形左右穿插，部分贴近图形边缘，部分漂浮在空白中，字距松弛，基线轻微跳动，形成“边看边读”的亲密阅读节奏；底部可加入一行较小的署名式说明、编号、日期、标题或主题短句，使文字自然融入画面，而不是后期贴上的排版标签。

整体配色从上方照片中提取，白纸留白占最大面积，黑色细字承担信息，主体色温暖、清洁、略高明度；少量高饱和暖色、深色或主题辅色仅用于焦点、阴影、纹理和节奏点缀。保留扫描纸张的轻微柔化、自然压缩感、边缘不齐和颜料吸收效果，不加厚重阴影、装饰边框或强烈现代排版感。整体参考手写观察页、绘本信息页、艺术出版物与轻松编辑设计，呈现清爽、温柔、稚拙、灵动、可读、富有生活感的视觉气质，避免模板感、卡通化、廉价感和过度设计感。

items.title: 戛纳级别VELOCENE高端运动鞋广告海报

prompts.text:
Create a Cannes-level premium running shoe campaign poster for a fictional brand called VELOCENE, designed as a world-class fusion of hyper-real product photography and bold designer-led vector illustration. Square format, deep midnight-navy base, one oversized hero performance running shoe floating diagonally across the center as the absolute visual focus, surrounded by a cleaner, more internationally refined illustrated motion world. The image must merge Orbit energy with Transit sophistication: stronger directional thrust, sharper motion architecture, cleaner graphic reduction, and a more premium athletic-brand finish.

Main product:
One ultra-real performance running shoe in vivid orange with black and white engineered sole structure, shown in a dramatic three-quarter underside angle, enlarged and suspended in midair. Increase the Orbit feeling by tilting the shoe slightly more aggressively upward-forward so the toe projects into space and the whole silhouette feels like it is accelerating out of the frame. The shoe must feel lightweight, breathable, and technically advanced: dense knit mesh upper, perforation zones, sculpted heel pull tab, layered support cage, precise lace system, responsive foam midsole, black traction outsole, realistic stitching, subtle matte-sheen overlays, and highly believable sports-footwear construction. Lighting on the shoe must be premium, dimensional, and crisp, clearly separating it from the illustrated background.

Background concept:
Build a stylized running-life universe around the shoe using a reduced but highly intentional vector language. Keep the playful spirit, but make it more curated and globally premium: simplified sunshine icon, a few energetic runners, abstract urban blocks, flowers, clouds, curved roads, leaves, and one or two lifestyle accents only. Remove decorative excess and keep the background cleaner than a typical cartoon poster. Every illustrated element must support the shoe’s forward motion and comfort story. The environment should feel like a branded motion landscape, not a busy cartoon scene.

Typography and layout:
Integrate oversized dynamic slogan blocks into the illustrated composition, using original English only, such as “RUN LIGHT. GO LONG.” and “AIR IN EVERY MILE.” The typography should be bold, angled, condensed, and architectural, helping create forward thrust around the shoe. Strengthen the Orbit direction by making the large type panels slant and push in the same movement axis as the shoe. Strengthen the Transit direction by keeping type spacing cleaner, hierarchy sharper, and the number of text elements more restrained. Add one small original brand wordmark near the top with a minimal running descriptor.

Style:
Hyper-real product hero plus designer vector world, premium global sports campaign, youthful but not childish, playful but not noisy, graphic but commercially luxurious. The final image must feel like a top-tier international running brand seasonal key visual with award-level clarity and momentum.

Lighting and atmosphere:
The shoe receives premium studio lighting with controlled highlights, elegant shadow falloff, and subtle warm bounce from surrounding orange-yellow graphic elements. The vector background remains mostly flat but can include minimal tonal layering for depth. Keep contrast strong, composition clean, and motion unmistakable. Use angled type, directional clouds, and selective flying leaves to amplify movement without clutter.

Color system:
Deep midnight navy background, vivid orange hero shoe, yellow and cream typography highlights, restrained violet or purple support blocks, touches of lime green and coral, crisp black-and-white outsole contrast. Keep the palette energetic but controlled, with a more international flagship polish.

Negative prompt:
no copied brand names, no copied slogans, no messy background, no low-detail shoe, no deformed footwear, no broken sole structure, no muddy colors, no black blotches, no cheap cartoon look, no childish illustration, no weak hierarchy, no photoreal background, no cluttered typography, no watermark, no existing logo.

prompts.text:
为虚构品牌 VELOCENE 创建一张戛纳级别的高级跑鞋运动广告海报，设计为超写实产品摄影与大胆的设计师主导矢量插图的世界级融合。正方形格式，深午夜蓝底色，一只巨大的主角性能跑鞋呈对角线漂浮在中心，作为绝对的视觉焦点，周围是一个更简洁、更具国际精细感的插图动态世界。图像必须融合 Orbit（轨道）能量与 Transit（转换）的精致感：更强的定向推力，更锐利的运动架构，更简洁的图形简化，以及更高级的运动品牌质感。

主产品：
一只亮橙色的超写实性能跑鞋，配有黑白工程鞋底结构，以戏剧性的四分之三底部视角展示，放大并悬浮在半空中。通过将鞋子稍微更激进地向上向前倾斜来增加 Orbit 感觉，使鞋尖投射到空间中，整个轮廓感觉像是正在加速冲出画框。鞋子必须感觉轻便、透气且技术先进：致密的针织网眼鞋面、穿孔区、雕刻鞋跟拉环、分层支撑架、精密系带系统、响应式泡沫中底、黑色抓地外底、逼真的缝线、微妙的哑光光泽覆盖层以及高度可信的运动鞋结构。鞋子上的照明必须是高级、立体且清晰的，将其与插图背景明确区分开。

背景概念：
使用简化但极具意图的矢量语言围绕鞋子构建一个风格化的跑步生活宇宙。保留趣味精神，但使其更具策展感和全球高级感：简化的阳光图标、几个充满活力的跑者、抽象的城市街区、花朵、云朵、弯曲的道路、叶子以及仅一两个生活方式点缀。移除装饰性多余部分，保持背景比典型的卡通海报更简洁。每个插图元素都必须支持鞋子的前向运动和舒适故事。环境应该感觉像是一个品牌动态景观，而不是拥挤的卡通场景。

排版和布局：
将超大的动态标语块融入插图组合中，仅使用原始英文，例如 “RUN LIGHT. GO LONG.” 和 “AIR IN EVERY MILE.”。字体应大胆、有角度、紧凑且具建筑感，有助于在鞋子周围创造前向推力。通过使大字体面板倾斜并推向与鞋子相同的运动轴来加强 Orbit 方向。通过保持字体间距更整洁、层级更清晰以及文字元素数量更克制来加强 Transit 方向。在顶部附近添加一个带有极简跑步描述符的小型原始品牌字标。

风格：
超写实产品主角加设计师矢量世界，高级全球运动广告，年轻但不幼稚，有趣但不嘈杂，图形化但具备商业奢华感。最终图像必须感觉像是顶级国际跑鞋品牌具有奖项级清晰度和动能的季节性主视觉。

照明和氛围：
鞋子接受带有受控高光、优雅阴影衰减以及来自周围橙黄色图形元素的微妙温暖反弹的高级摄影棚照明。矢量背景保持大部分平整，但可以包含极小的色调分层以增加深度。保持对比度强，构图整洁，运动感明确。使用有角度的字体、定向云朵和选择性的飞叶来放大运动感而又不显杂乱。

色彩系统：
深午夜蓝背景，亮橙色主角鞋，黄色和奶油色排版高光，克制的紫罗兰色或紫色支撑块，点缀石灰绿和珊瑚色，清脆的黑白外底对比。保持色调充满活力但受控，具有更具国际旗舰感的抛光度。

负面提示：
无抄袭品牌名称，无抄袭标语，无凌乱背景，无低细节鞋子，无变形鞋类，无断裂鞋底结构，无浑浊色彩，无黑色污渍，无廉价卡通外观，无幼稚插图，无虚弱层级，无照片写实背景，无杂乱排版，无水印，无现有徽标。

prompts.text: 3:4, environment underexposed by two stops + soft flash bloom, night indoor satin long dress photoshoot, quiet and high-end, soft and ambiguous atmosphere. Adult Korean young female, clear variant of New Chinese Magnolia makeup, real skin texture, semi-matte base makeup, soft eye corners, light red blush in the middle of the face, satin lips, low bun with a strand of loose hair, thin silver ear thread. Champagne-colored satin slip long dress, with a thin gauze long shawl over it, reclining on a dark hotel sofa, one hand supporting the head, calmly looking directly at the camera, lips slightly parted, legs naturally stretched forward. The background consists of a floor-to-ceiling window night view, a long table lamp, champagne glasses and wine bottles as blurred embellishments, eye-level half-body to medium shot, soft flash shining from the camera direction and side front towards the subject, falling on the cheeks, hair strands, collarbone, satin dress fabric and thin gauze, forming obvious bloom and local highlight spots. Lightweight negative: no plastic skin, excessive skin smoothing, oily film feeling, background too bright, facial feature deformation, finger deformity.

prompts.text: 3:4，环境压暗两档 + 柔化闪光 bloom，夜间室内缎面长裙写真，静谧高级，柔和暧昧氛围。成年韩系年轻女性，新中式玉兰妆清透变体，真实皮肤纹理，半哑光底妆，柔和眼尾，面中浅红晕，缎光唇，低盘发带一缕碎发，细银耳线。香槟色缎面吊带长裙，外搭薄纱长披肩，斜倚在暗色酒店沙发上，一手扶头，平静直视镜头，唇微张，腿部自然前伸。背景为落地窗夜景、长桌灯、香槟杯与酒瓶虚化点缀，平视半身到中景，柔化闪光从镜头方向与侧前方照向人物，落在脸颊、发丝、锁骨、缎面裙料和薄纱上，形成明显 bloom 与局部高光光斑。 轻量负面：不要塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、油膜感、背景太亮、五官变形、手指畸形。

Theme:
Summer hair bun tied with white sand

A young adult woman sitting sideways on a white sand tropical beach with her back to the clear azure sea. Position the subject, facing away from the camera, in the center of the frame, emphasizing her from head to toe, her white ruffled swimsuit, raised arms, and ponytail as the protagonists.

Person · Expression:
Bright, smooth skin, small oval face, neat bridge of the nose, pale pink lips. A refined profile with the face turned toward the left side of the frame, eyes closed, showing a peaceful expression as if feeling the summer breeze. Hair is light brown, with thin bangs and slender back strands, tied in a high long ponytail. The hair bundle sways toward the bottom right of the frame with the wind, with fine strands catching the sunlight.

Clothing · Pose:
Pale ivory halter-neck swimsuit with translucent thin gauze ruffles encircling the underbust and waist, with thin strings tied at the neck, back, and left and right waist. Sitting sideways on the sand with knees bent to the left and right, spine straight, and a slight twist at the waist. Both arms are bent and raised above the head, with the right hand holding the base of the ponytail and the left hand layered over it from above. Small grains of sand cling to the soles of the feet and toes.

Background · Lighting:
From the left to the center of the frame is shallow turquoise seawater and the edge of slender waves, with a vibrant blue sky above, and white sand and a lush green coastal forest in the back right. Bleached thick driftwood and branches are scattered in the foreground and background. Strong direct midday sunlight from slightly above the left side of the frame illuminates the shoulders, back, waist, and thighs, casting clear-contoured short shadows on the sand. Reflected light from the sea surface softly fills in the shadow side.

Composition · Lens:
3:4 vertical. A full-body portrait captured from a position slightly above the sand surface with a natural line of sight from the back toward the diagonal right. Raised arms placed in the upper part, back and waist in the center, and bent legs and toes in the lower part and enlarged, with a little blue sky empty space left above the head. Precise focus on the person, with the beach and driftwood softly blurred, using a shallow to medium depth of field.

Texture · Style:
High-definition realistic photography taken under strong summer sunlight. Truly depicts the natural texture of the skin, fine hair bundles with backlighting, the translucency and ruffles of the gauze, thin strings, sand grains, wet wave edges, and the dry texture of driftwood. Bright tropical colors of white, turquoise, and blue sky, avoiding excessive skin smoothing or illustration styles.

Negative:
Sitting sideways posture · Placement of arms and hair · White swimsuit · Modification of the profile

prompts.text:
Create a premium 4:5 vertical artistic travel poster for [CITY], [COUNTRY], based on the concept “City as a Neon Ribbon.”

Use a deep matte-black background with dramatic empty negative space. Build the entire composition from expressive hand-painted neon strokes, ink splashes, dry-brush textures, and energetic gestural lines.

Integrate the city name “[CITY]” in huge custom hand-painted lettering, but make the letters interact with the ribbon rather than simply sitting on top of the artwork. Some letters can stretch, break apart, overlap, or dissolve into colorful paint trails.

Add one small handwritten phrase such as “CITY NIGHTS”, “WHERE THE CITY GLOWS”, or “FEEL THE CITY” in a delicate contrasting script.

Composition should feel bold, sophisticated, youthful, collectible, and editorial — like a limited-edition contemporary travel poster rather than a generic tourist illustration.

No photorealism, no ordinary skyline collage, no generic clip-art, no excessive details. Keep the artwork graphic, dramatic, recognizable, and highly stylized.

prompts.text:

PRINT. Warm cream fiber paper (#F1E7D6), visible paper tooth and one subtle fold crease. Paper is the lightest value; no white ink. Use three plates only: black, pale sea teal, and coral. Plate overlaps create the only additional hues. Keep black coverage under 35%.

TYPE. FIGURE. Young adult woman, early twenties, wind-lifted hair, standing in the defining pedestrian/public area of the destination. EYE BAND. Flat semi-opaque coral rectangle across her eyes, slightly wider than her face. Eyes remain visible underneath as dark halftone. Edges should be slightly imperfect and physically printed.

BACKGROUND. One instantly recognizable architectural or structural landmark placed left of centre. Signature lines, cables, streets, coastlines, or structural elements fan outward toward both edges as thin black lines. The destination's recognizable background environment appears far behind in flat teal halftone. Foreground surfaces, paths, streets, steps, or architectural lines converge naturally across the bottom.

ACCENTS. Add a coral drybrush band low on the horizon and a teal diagonal band in the upper-left area. Include small destination-specific environmental silhouettes in the upper-right and lower-left corners. Mid-right on the coral band, place two lines of small lowercase marker handwriting: "[SHORT TRAVEL NOTE LINE 1] / [SHORT TRAVEL NOTE LINE 2]".

SURFACE. Ink visibly sinking into paper fibre, authentic plate misregistration, physically cut paper edges, faint scan noise, matte printed finish, subtle handmade imperfections. Maintain an even 8% margin on all four sides.

AVOID. Photorealistic skin, glossy or vector-smooth finish, 3D shading, painterly rendering, neon glow, gradients. No signature, watermark, or edition number. No extra people, signage, logos, or doodle lines. The main title and handwritten note are the only text elements.

眼部横条。横跨她双眼的扁平半透明珊瑚色矩形，略宽于她的脸。下方的眼睛作为深色半色调依然可见。边缘应略微不完美且具有物理印刷感。

点缀。在近地平线处添加一条珊瑚色干刷色带，在左上角添加一条青色对角色带。在右上角和左下角添加特定目的地的环境剪影小图标。在珊瑚色带的中右侧，放置两行小写手写马克笔文字："[短旅行笔记第 1 行] / [短旅行笔记第 2 行]"。

表面。墨水明显渗入纸张纤维，真实的印版套印不准，物理切割的纸边缘，微弱的扫描噪点，哑光印刷饰面，细微的手工瑕疵。四周保持均匀的 8% 边距。

prompts.text:
Theme:
A Look Back in Colorful Ruffles

Subject:
On a large stage shining with purple and pink lights, a female performer in her 20s stands with her back to the audience, looking back over her shoulder. Her slender full body is placed largely in the center of the frame, with her left hand holding a pink microphone and her thin, colorful, shining ruffled costume as the protagonists.

Character · Expression:
Slender oval face, slender deep brown eyes, thin and neat eyebrows, a small nose, and lustrous coral pink lips. Turning her face over her left shoulder towards the camera, looking straight ahead, she shows a confident expression with only a soft smile at the corners of her mouth. Deep dark brown long hair reaching below the chest, thin bundle-like bangs on the forehead, and loose wavy hair strands. Stage wind gently blows the ends of her hair towards the right side of the frame.

Costume · Pose:
An idol-style two-piece outfit layering light aqua blue, pink, lavender, and yellow. A crop top with spaghetti straps decorated with jewel-like ornaments, gold trim, and light blue ruffles attached under the chest. On the waist are glossy light blue shorts and asymmetrical multi-layered transparent organza ruffles, with long tail-like fabric hanging down towards the right side of the frame. The body faces the back-side at an angle, with the waist twisted towards the left side of the frame and weight placed on the left leg. The left arm extends diagonally back and down holding a pink microphone, and the right arm extends towards the right side of the frame with a lightly clenched fist.

Background · Lighting:
A large LED screen on the left side of the frame reflects abstract patterns of pink, light blue, and yellow. White, purple, and pink circular stage lights are scattered on the right side and top/bottom of the frame, with the background graduating from deep indigo to black. Strong direct purple and pink light is projected from the back right and top of the frame, forming sharp magenta rim lighting on the hair, shoulders, and costume silhouette. The front is illuminated with soft white fill light on the face and skin.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 6:11. Using a slightly low-angle telephoto lens, looking up from the audience's perspective, capturing vertically from the top of the head to near below the knees, with the portion above the knees visible. The figure is placed largely in the center of the frame, with the face positioned towards the top and the multi-layered ruffles at the waist in the center, and hands extending left and right positioned near the edges of the frame. The left microphone is completely included, and the legs are cropped at the bottom. Sharp focus on the face and costume, with the LED and lighting forming large circular bokeh, using a shallow depth of field.

Texture · Style:
A photorealistic live-action photo of a live performance taken with a telephoto lens. High-definition depiction of natural skin texture, subtle reflections on long hair, transparency and layering of organza, sequins, beads, jewel-like decorations, and a metal mesh microphone. Keep the purple, pink, and light blue vibrant; even under strong stage light, do not let the details of the face and costume become overexposed.

Negative:
Omission of the back-facing look back and microphone, change to monochromatic costume.

质感·风格：

Paris summer draped in paper pieces

She stands slightly angled, body facing the mirror, head turned a bit to her right with soft pouty lips and a playful, confident expression. Her right hand gently rests against her right cheek, fingers lightly touching her face. Her left hand holds an orange iPhone up to capture the reflection.
She has long, straight dark brown hair cascading over her shoulders with soft natural volume. Fair, luminous skin with visible natural texture, pores, and subtle imperfections. Soft glam makeup — defined arched brows, subtle winged eyeliner, long lashes, soft pink-nude lips in a pout.
She wears a deep burgundy/maroon satin off-the-shoulder dress with a sweetheart neckline that creates deep cleavage, structured cups, and delicate off-shoulder sleeves resting on her upper arms. The fabric has a luxurious silk-satin sheen with soft folds and gathering at the waist. A dramatic high thigh slit on her left leg reveals her upper thigh and leg. A small black leather crossbody bag with a gold chain strap hangs from her right shoulder.
Accessories: gold watch on her left wrist, delicate thin gold bracelet on her right wrist, multiple thin gold rings on her fingers.
Setting: elegant bathroom with beige marble-look tiles on the walls, a white panel radiator under a tall arched window with dark wood frame, white sheer curtains with subtle floral embroidery letting in soft natural daylight. Large mirror reflection captures the scene. Soft, flattering natural window light with gentle highlights on the satin fabric and skin, creamy shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, fabric sheen, and fine details.
Shot on Sony A7R V, 85mm f/1.4 lens, 8K RAW, ultra-photorealistic, hyper-detailed, natural skin texture, visible pores, cinematic lighting, high dynamic range, film grain.
Negative prompt: deformed face, extra limbs, plastic skin, over-smoothed skin, cartoon, anime, low resolution, blurry, bad anatomy, watermark, text.

items.title: 极简主义城市地标拼贴垂直海报

prompts.text:
CITY: [TOKYO / NEW YORK / PARIS / DUBAI / YOUR CITY]
MAIN LANDMARK: [most iconic landmark]
OTHER LANDMARKS: [4–5 recognizable landmarks]
TYPE COLOR: [accent color]
FOREGROUND DETAIL: [cherry blossoms / taxi / leaves / palm leaves]
COUNTRY: [country name]

Create a 9:16 vertical city poster using iconic landmarks from the same city.

Treat each landmark as an independent architectural collage element rather than a realistic street scene. Place the landmarks around the edges of the frame using an extreme worm’s-eye perspective, with their forms rising and converging toward the center of the sky.

Use the MAIN LANDMARK as the central vertical anchor. Keep it the most complete and recognizable structure in the composition.

Arrange the other landmarks from the upper-left, upper-right, lower-left and lower-right edges. Make them large near the frame edges and gradually narrower toward the center, creating a strong radial, upward-moving composition.

Do not follow real geographic positions. The goal is to reconstruct the visual identity of the city through its landmarks.

Behind the architecture, place the city name in huge ultra-tall condensed sans-serif typography. The letters should occupy around 45–60% of the image, partially hidden behind the landmarks while remaining clearly readable.

Keep the city-name typography clean, solid and sharp. No distressed texture, cracks or worn lettering.

Use a limited three-color system: warm off-white paper background, charcoal / grayscale architecture, one strong accent color for the city name.

Render the landmarks with realistic architectural photography, then add subtle vintage editorial print texture, fine grain, halftone and paper texture.

Add a small blurred foreground detail connected to the city, occupying only around 5–10% of the lower edge, to create depth and local atmosphere.

Core visual formula:
iconic landmarks + extreme low-angle perspective + radial convergence + giant city typography + limited colors + subtle foreground depth.

prompts.text:
城市：[东京 / 纽约 / 巴黎 / 迪拜 / 你的城市]

前景细节：[樱花 / 出租车 / 落叶 / 棕榈叶]
国家：[国家名称]

创作一张 9:16 的垂直城市海报，使用来自同一城市的标志性地标。

将每个地标视为独立的建筑拼贴元素，而不是真实的街道场景。使用极端的虫眼视角将地标放置在框架边缘，它们的形态向天空中心升起并汇聚。

以“主要地标”作为中心垂直锚点。使其成为构图中完整且最具辨识度的结构。

将其他地标布置在左上、右上、左下和右下边缘。使它们在靠近框架边缘处变大，并向中心逐渐变窄，创造出强烈的放射状向上移动的构图。

不要遵循真实的地理位置。目标是通过地标重建城市的视觉身份。

在建筑背后，以巨大的超高、压缩的无衬线字体放置城市名称。字母应占据图像的 45–60% 左右，部分隐藏在地标背后，同时保持清晰可读。

保持城市名称字体的整洁、稳实和锋利。不要有磨损纹理、裂纹或破旧字体。

使用受限的三色系统：暖米白色纸张背景、木炭色/灰色调建筑、城市名称使用一种强烈的强调色。

使用真实的建筑摄影效果渲染地标，然后添加微妙的复古社论印刷纹理、细颗粒、半色调和纸张纹理。

添加与城市相关的细小模糊前景细节，仅占据底边的 5–10% 左右，以营造深度感和当地氛围。

核心视觉公式：
标志性地标 + 极端低角度视角 + 放射状汇聚 + 巨大城市字体 + 有限颜色 + 微妙前景深度。

prompts.text:
Generate an extremely narrow and long vertical editorial visual around a specific theme, creating three clear planar spaces consisting of an outer large color field, a central warm white paper page, and an indented theme window within the page. First, derive two structural colors from the thematic state contrast and emotional temperature, covering the majority of the image with a hard horizontal boundary; repeat this division in the embedded window with the same direction and similar proportions; the outer field is brighter and emptier, while the window is deeper and denser, with the paper white acting as the highest brightness interlayer of the entire painting. The weight of the image is concentrated in the middle, leaving a wide title area at the top and a relaxed emotional landing point at the bottom; the edges of the paper are straight, without heavy floating shadows, and a wide annotation strip is reserved below the window.

Extract a continuous and identifiable core form from the theme's direction, process, structural connections, and temporal changes, organizing it into a single diagonal axis running through the middle, making it cross at least two boundaries from inside the window, pressing over the window frame, entering the paper white space, and extending to the outer color field. The cross-boundary form remains complete and continuous, with the endpoints crossing the edges retaining the clearest recognition outlines, while internal details are moderately compressed; local forms go from dense to sparse along the diagonal axis, and other auxiliary objects are reduced to quiet small geometric focal points, stably remaining inside the window and near the color field boundary. Maintain a strict orthogonal order for the horizontal color boundary, vertical frame, rectangular paper, and inner window; only the core theme has the right to break the rules, establishing space through accurate occlusion relationships rather than relying on perspective or dramatic shadows.

Place a few homologous echoes on one side of the theme's momentum: enlarge, crop, and reduce the transparency and contrast of the core form, blurring it strongly until only soft color blocks remain, partially extending out of the canvas; the central subject remains clear, while the other side remains clean, giving the planar color field a sense of shallow air and memory. The colors maintain a clear area order, with the two structural colors together occupying about 80% of the image; the thematic intermediate color spans the two fields and stitches together cold and warm or state differences, while a small-area accent color appears twice at a long distance only at the visual focus within the window and the text gesture outside the paper. The specific hues change with the theme, but the brightness relationship—where paper white is the highest, a few deep outlines press the structure, and the accent color wins by saturation rather than area—remains stable.

The text system continues the order and boundary-crossing relationship of the image. The main title uses an elongated, sharp editorial serif skeleton with obvious stroke contrast and exquisite endpoints; the Chinese characters use a slender font with a bookish temperament and relaxed letter spacing. Transform a keyword into a continuous freehand thin line, lightly passing through or adjacent to the printed title, forming a private handwriting that echoes the theme's diagonal axis. Explanatory information is indented at the bottom of the paper, divided into two groups of medium-thin small characters and date-style micro-text; the area outside the bottom of the paper can use a group of handwritten text with long closing strokes to carry the second accent color, with only minimal metadata at the very bottom. Let the title, image, annotations, and footer decrease in density in sequence, ensuring the text does not suppress the core identifiable edges.

Treat objects with directionless soft daylight and low shadows, allowing the theme to retain limited realistic textures while still submitting to planar color blocks. The entire image is covered with extremely light art paper fibers, fine printing dots, and low-contrast scanning grain; textures in the paper and window are slightly more obvious, while the outer solid color field is more restrained; object edges allow for slight printing softening and color bleeding, while key outlines and glyphs remain clean. The final image first presents a white paper window in a two-color long format and a theme form growing continuously from inside the window to the outside, followed by the revelation of out-of-focus side shadows, exquisite headers, handwritten interventions, and micro-annotations, forming a modern paper-print visual where strict editorial order and a vivid sense of time coexist.

prompts.text:

items.title: 现代极简黑白室内人像摄影

prompts.text:
[Character] Image 1 [Signature] The Threads logo operated by Meta is placed in a small scale in the lower right corner, with "CHAse" written in small white handwriting above it, just like a signature.

[Person's Pose and Expression]
Pose and Composition: Capturing a full-body silhouette of a person straddling the top back axis of a heavy black leather sofa, presented in a front-centered medium-range full-length shot (Full-length Shot) composition.

Pose: The left leg is draped over the right leg, the foot is placed on the sofa armrest, the left leg hangs naturally, while one hand moves to the mouth, gently covering the lips with fingers, presenting a pensive posture. A loosely taken-off white jacket naturally reveals a single shoulder line.

Expression: Not looking directly at the camera, but casting a hazy and serene gaze toward the left side of the frame, with eyes calm and deep. No exaggeratedly groomed face, creating a modern and stylish emotional atmosphere.

[Clothing and Props]
Clothing: Paired with a pure white short-sleeved buttoned knit top that finely integrates vertical rib patterns, and a loosely draped loose-fit white denim jacket. The bottoms are lightweight black and white striped shorts.

Props:

White cotton socks: Shoes removed, wearing only simple pure white cotton mid-calf socks (Socks) extending up to the ankles, emphasizing a natural and private loungewear sensibility.

Black leather sofa: A full-cushioned leather sofa that the person straddles, playing the role of a heavy and modern minimalist object in the space.

[Hair and Makeup Details]
Hairstyle: 5:5 parting, calm ink-black / dark brown toned straight long hair falling neatly on the shoulders and back. No stray hairs, clean and sharp hair lines add to the minimalist aesthetic.

Makeup: A clean, transparent cold-toned skin base with perfectly modified imperfections, paired with brown gradient eyeshadow that softly emphasizes the eyes. The lips are neatly finished with a calm nude coral pink lip makeup that retains natural blood color.

[Lighting and Light Direction]
Light Source: Soft and warm natural diffused window light seeping in from the left side of the frame, along with cold-toned studio environment lighting (Soft Diffused Daylight).

Effect: Calm highlights are formed on the person's skin texture, the texture of the white knit, and the soft glossy surface of the black leather sofa, creating a modern and neat light and shadow contrast.

[Texture and Color Atmosphere (Core Texture Details)]
Color: The clean snow white (White) of the clothes and socks, the absolute jet black (Jet Black) of the sofa, and the soft off-white of the wall constitute a calm "Modern Minimal Monochrome" color atmosphere.

Texture Details (Special Analysis):

Leather texture: The smooth surface of the leather sofa with subtle wrinkle textures showing signs of use, and the matte-glossy texture that glimmers when receiving light.

Knit and cotton texture: The tight vertical rib (Ribbed) texture of the knit top, and the woven texture of the soft and fluffy cotton socks wrapping around the ankles.

Wall texture: The characteristic coarse graininess of the plaster/stucco wall behind the person, and the texture of the softly diffused light.

[Film and Camera Lens Depth of Field, Angle]
Composition and Angle: A horizontal frontal composition aligned with the eye-level of the seated subject, providing a stable and clean portrait perspective.

Features: Through a sharp focus (Sharp Focus) of a standard portrait perspective, it vividly captures the model's features, the knit rib texture, the woven touch of the socks, and the texture of the leather sofa, while the background wall is neat and orderly, maximizing immersion in the subject.

[Background and Studio Layout Elements]
Space: Minimalist white studio interior without redundancy.

Details: The clean white plaster wall behind the person and the herringbone wood flooring material slightly exposed in the lower left corner help create a sense of cleanliness in the space.

prompts.text:
[人物] 图像 1 [签名] 右下角有 Meta 运营的 Threads 标志小幅放置在其上方，以白色手写体小字写着“CHAse”，如同签名一样。  

[人物的姿势及表情]  
姿势及构图：捕捉人物跨坐在厚重黑色皮革沙发顶部靠背轴上的全身剪影，以正面居中的中景全身镜头（Full-length Shot）构图呈现。  

姿势：左腿搭在右腿上，脚搁置在沙发扶手上，左腿自然下垂，同时一只手移到嘴边，用手指轻轻遮住嘴唇，呈现出陷入沉思的姿势。松垮脱下的白色夹克自然露出单侧肩线。  

表情：不直视镜头，而是向画面左侧投以朦胧而宁静的目光，眼神平静而深邃。没有夸张的整洁面容，营造出现代而时髦的感性氛围。  

[人物服装及道具]  
服装：搭配了精细融入竖向罗纹图案的纯白短袖纽扣针织上衣，以及随意披上的宽松版型白色牛仔夹克。下装是轻盈的黑色与白色条纹短裤。  

道具：  

白色棉袜：脱掉鞋子，仅穿着向上延伸至脚踝的简约纯白棉质中筒袜（Socks），强调自然而私密的家居服感性。  

黑色皮革沙发：人物跨坐其上的饱满缓冲皮革沙发，扮演空间中厚重而现代的极简物件角色。  

[人物发型及妆容细节]  
发型：5:5 分缝，整齐地垂落在肩部和背部的平静墨黑色 / 深棕色调的直长发型。没有碎发，干净利落的发丝线条增添极简美学。  

妆容：以完美修饰瑕疵的干净透明冷调肤色基础，搭配轻柔强调眼部的棕色渐层眼影妆容。唇部以保留自然血色的平静裸色珊瑚粉唇妆整齐收尾。  

[照明及光线方向]  
光源：画面左侧柔和而温暖渗入的窗边自然漫射光，以及工作室冷调环境照明（Soft Diffused Daylight）。  

效果：在人物的皮肤纹理、白色针织的质感，以及黑色皮革沙发的柔和光泽面上形成平静的高光，营造出现代而整洁的光影对比。  

[质感与色调氛围（核心质感细节）]  
色彩：服装和袜子的干净雪白（White）、沙发的绝对墨黑（Jet Black），以及墙面的柔和灰白色，构成平静的“现代极简单色调（Modern Minimal Monochrome）”色彩氛围。  

质感细节（特殊分析）：  

皮革质感：皮革沙发表面的光滑却带有使用痕迹的细微褶皱纹理，以及受光时闪烁的哑光-光泽质感。  

针织及棉质质感：针织上衣的紧密竖向罗纹（Ribbed）纹理，以及包裹脚踝的柔软蓬松棉袜的编织质感。  

墙面质感：人物后方石膏/灰泥墙面特有的粗糙颗粒感，以及柔和扩散的光线质感。  

[胶片及相机镜头景深、角度]  
构图及角度：与坐姿主体的眼平高度（Eye-level）对齐的水平正面构图，提供稳定而整洁的人像视角。  

特点：通过标准人像视角的清晰焦点（Sharp Focus），鲜明捕捉模特的五官、针织罗纹纹理、袜子的编织触感，以及皮革沙发的质感，而背景墙面则整齐有序，最大化对主体的沉浸感。  

[背景及工作室布局元素]  
空间：简约无赘余的白色工作室内部。  

细节：人物后方的干净白色灰泥墙面，以及下方左侧角落微微露出的鱼骨纹木质地板材料，辅助营造空间的整洁感。

items.title: 实验性角色海报半色调扫描效果

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 experimental character poster using a close or waist-up portrait with expressive body language.

Keep most of the portrait in high-contrast black and white, then add a clear halftone screen-print effect. Use finer dots on the face and denser dots in the hair, clothing and shadows, so it feels like a printed zine rather than simple photo grain.

Add one color scan window through an important part of the portrait. It can run vertically across the eye, face and hand, horizontally through the eyes and gesture, or extend from the face down into the collar and body.

Inside this window, return to clean high-resolution photography with realistic cool-neutral skin, blue-grey shadows and natural lip tones. Keep it crisp and free of halftone texture so the contrast between “printed portrait” and “real detail” feels obvious.

Use oversized condensed typography as part of the composition rather than placing a title in empty space. Let the letters crop off the canvas, overlap the body, pass behind the subject or cut across the scan window.

Keep the palette restrained: black, white and cool grey as the base, then one cool blue and one muted red / burgundy as accents.

Only add a few small identity-style labels such as “IDENTITY TRACE”, “SUBJECT ACTIVE”, “GESTURE READ” or “FEATURE ACTIVE”. A few thin lines, circles and open corner marks are enough.

The final image should feel like a mix of youth-culture poster, printed zine, character dossier and experimental magazine editorial.

Avoid warm yellow grading, multiple random scan windows, floating facial features, heavy glitch effects, dense UI graphics, long paragraphs, numbering, Vol./Issue labels, sparkle symbols, logos or watermarks.

prompts.text:
创建一个 9:16 的实验性角色海报，使用具有表现力肢体语言的特写或半身肖像。

保持肖像的大部分为高对比度黑白，然后添加明显的半色调丝网印刷效果。在面部使用更精细的点，在头发、衣物和阴影中使用更密集的点，使其感觉像印刷的杂志而不是简单的照片颗粒。

通过肖像的重要部分添加一个彩色扫描窗口。它可以垂直穿过眼睛、脸部和手部，水平穿过眼睛和手势，或从脸部向下延伸到衣领和身体。

在这个窗口内部，恢复为清晰的高分辨率摄影，具有逼真的冷中性皮肤、蓝灰色阴影和自然的唇色。保持其清晰且没有半色调纹理，使“印刷肖像”与“真实细节”之间的对比感觉显而易见。

使用超大压缩排版作为构图的一部分，而不是在空白处放置标题。让字母裁剪出画布、重叠身体、从主体后方经过或穿过扫描窗口。

保持色调克制：以黑色、白色和冷灰色为基调，然后以一种冷蓝色和一种柔和的红色/酒红色作为点缀。

仅添加少量身份风格的标签，如“IDENTITY TRACE”、“SUBJECT ACTIVE”、“GESTURE READ”或“FEATURE ACTIVE”。少量细线、圆圈和开放式边角标记就足够了。

最终图像应感觉像是青少年文化海报、印刷杂志、角色档案和实验性杂志社论的混合体。

避免暖黄色调、多个随机扫描窗口、漂浮的面部特征、沉重的故障效果、密集的 UI 图形、长段落、编号、卷/辑标签、闪烁符号、徽标或水印。

items.title: 荧光手撕纸拼贴风格城市文化海报

prompts.text: At first glance, a group of irregularly layered fluorescent hand-torn paper title blocks forms a strong visual anchor: the main title is huge, centered, and staggered in lines, with a typeface formed by thick brushes and paper-cutting, heavy strokes, rough and broken edges, exaggerated corners, varying internal white spaces, and slight local misalignments, making the text look like hand-printed graphics rather than neat typography. A circular, loose but clear reading path activity information system is established around the title, with several hand-drawn sticker badges with blue and white outlines distributed around it; each badge is connected to a theme-related small illustration, location marker, or symbol with a white label, varying in size and direction, as if casually pasted on the paper surface; the main body and labels share a striking blue outer contour and yellow fill, forming a unified brushstroke across elements. The background uses warm fibrous paper and old poster textures, with a large area of umber base color, retaining paper grains, indentations, slight color differences, and printing bleeds; organize the blank space with dark brown hand-drawn dashed lines, arcs, arrows, and a small amount of English geometric lettering, without being overbearing. The primary colors are locked to ochre brown, bright yellow, vivid blue, and off-white, using flat coating and limited overlapping colors, without using modern gradients, glass textures, or excessively smooth digital shadows. All graphics, text, stickers, and backgrounds share slightly unstable hand-drawn outlines, overprint offsets, thickness variations, and local wear, retaining imperfect production marks; the information hierarchy is clear, the central title is the heaviest, and the surrounding modules create rhythm and breathing space, and the overall piece looks like an urban cultural event poster completed by collage, hand-drawing, screen printing, and old paper.

prompts.text:
Theme:
Selfie in a modern Japanese-style guest room

Subject:
In a spacious modern Japanese-style hotel guest room with tatami flooring, a young adult woman sits on the floor by the bed, taking a selfie through a mirror. The figure is placed largely from the center to the bottom of the frame, with a yellow smartphone, a white see-through top, black denim shorts, and forward-spread legs as the main subjects.

Character/Expression:
Small rounded oval face, bright smooth skin, large dark brown eyes, detailed natural eyebrows, small nose, light pink lips. Face directly towards the mirror and camera, casting a gaze from the side of the smartphone, with a soft closed-mouth smile. Long eyelashes, detailed eyeliner, elegant cheek blush. Waist-length light brown loose large wavy hair, thin bangs, short hair strands around the face, hair flowing voluminously toward the left shoulder in the frame.

Clothing/Pose:
White checkered knit and see-through cropped long-sleeve top, deep V-neck lace trim, only one small white button fastened in the front center, ruffled cuffs. Dark gray distressed denim shorts, brown thin strings crossing on the left and right waist. Sitting on the tatami, extending the left leg toward the bottom left of the frame, with the right knee raised and the right foot placed in the bottom center. Holding a yellow triple-camera smartphone vertically with the right hand in front of the right side of the face, left hand lightly placed on the waist of the shorts.

Background/Lighting:
On the left side of the frame is a large bed with white sheets; in the center depth is warm indirect lighting illuminating black shelves and ornaments, abstract black and white wall art; in the right depth is a large TV and low black storage stand, and a bright large window at the right end. Beige tatami and black furniture continue throughout. Bright daytime diffused light enters through the window on the right side of the frame, softly illuminating the face, white top, and legs, with warm auxiliary light in the depths of the room. Shadows are shallow and natural.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. Through the perspective of a smartphone facing a mirror near the floor, employing a wide-angle relatively close full-body selfie composition. The head is placed in the center of the upper half, the torso in the center, and the open legs occupy a large portion of the lower half, with the left leg and right foot naturally cut off at the edges of the frame. The bed and window of the guest room are shown broadly to the left and right. Focus on the face, smartphone, and upper body, with the background also presented in a deeper depth of field so that the shape of the guest room is recognizable.

Texture/Style:
A high-definition realistic photograph with a natural wide-angle feel as if taken with a smartphone. Realistic depiction of skin, long curly hair, see-through white fabric and lace, denim wear and tear, yellow phone case, tatami, white bedding, and reflections on black furniture. Based on clean white and beige tones, avoiding excessive skin smoothing treatments or illustration styles.

Negative Prompt:
Alterations to facial features, long curly hair, sitting posture, or the position of the phone in the mirror.

主角是在宁静的和风餐饮店座位上，用筷子夹起一片烤肉即将送入口边的、可爱自然的虚构成年日本女性一人。从头顶至盖饭上缘纳入画面，穿着黑色长袖罗纹上衣。人数固定为一人，以20岁以上的虚构成人表现，而非现实人物。只再现画面中确认可见的年龄印象、体型、可见部位、服装、动作，不赋予国籍、职业、家庭关系等视觉无法确定的属性。不将人物替换为其他脸型、其他体型、其他年龄层，即使背景可见其他人物也不将其提升为主角。保持主角轮廓与背景的自然边界。  
脸・妆容：  
脸部及画面内脸部元素为小卵形、薄刘海部分遮盖眉毛、闭合双眼、自然鼻梁、牙齿略微可见的大笑容。抬起脸颊，传达即将进食前的愉悦，但不不自然张大嘴巴。基础妆容不厚涂，保留肌肤色的小波动、脸颊・鼻・嘴周的立体感、自然毛孔。左右眼睛、眉毛、鼻孔、嘴角、可见牙齿的排列作为人体自然对齐，不将虹膜或捕捉光复制般统一化。妆容仅限于图像可辨识的淡色，不添加浓重眼影、粗眼线、人工假睫毛、强烈轮廓修饰、过度美白、塑料感肌肤。  
头发：  
头发为接近黑色的深棕色半长发，后方扎起，保留薄刘海及脸颊侧的长刘海。头顶自然分缝及室内光的小光泽。不将每根头发统一为线条，混合粗束、中等束、细刘海，从发根至发梢连续流动。不破坏发际线、分缝、耳周、颈部或肩部的重叠。仅反映画面可见的风、湿气、重力、接触，不改为其他发型、过度卷发、统一光泽的头盔状表现。  
表情・视线：  
表情与视线为闭合双眼、脸部略微向下、开口大笑。视线不可见，传达对料理的期待自然喜悦。不显示已含入口中食物状态、夸张咀嚼、露出舌头。将左右瞳孔方向与焦点距离一致，避免斜视、单眼焦点不同、不自然白眼。将脸颊、眼尾、鼻翼、嘴角的动作联动至同一情感，不将仅嘴部贴附式笑容。图像中无泪水、强烈惊讶、愤怒、睡意、挑逗、恋爱断定，不添加此类元素。  
姿势・手指・接触：  
姿势、手指、接触为上身略微前倾向桌面。画面左侧进入的单手持木筷，尖端水平附近夹住一小片肉。相反的手在画面外。正确保箸、指、肉的接触与重力。肩部、锁骨、颈部、上臂、肘、前臂、手腕在画面内连接的部分以骨骼自然角度呈现。可见手时，不混淆左右，一手五指、关节数、指甲方向、指长自然，物体持握接触点与压力、重力一致。不从背景生出不可见手指或身体部位，避免手臂融合、肩部双重化、颈部伸长、关节反曲。将身体方向与脸部方向的扭转变换固定在原图范围内。  
服装・小物：  
服装与小物为纯色黑色长袖罗纹针织。圆领、贴合身体的细纵纹、肩部与袖子的自然皱褶。细银链与小圆吊坠。无其他装饰、标志。不改变颜色、领口、袖口、肩带、结扣、缝合、五金件、装饰的有无。布料不贴附如涂装，依伸缩、垂感、厚度、重力、接触产生小皱褶。可见小物保持相同形状、位置、持握方式、材质，不添加品牌文字或虚构标志。不推测补全画面外服装整体或未确认配饰。  
场所・时间・背景：  
场所与背景为温暖照明和风餐饮店。背景为浅米色涂墙与齐腰木板，右下角黑色椅子或隔板。近景为白底青花大盖饭，上方绿刻葱与肉料理部分。时间帯固定为画面内光线可读的亮度，不替换为夜景、日落、摄影棚背景等其他时间・场所。守护前景、中景、远景顺序与重叠，水平线、墙、窗、地板、家具、植物等可见结构的朝向自然化。桌面整体、相反的手、腰部以下、盖饭内全部、店内客人均在画面外。不创作不明料理名、店名、菜单、额外餐具、蒸汽、标志。背景不简化为空白，同时不以原图无信息填充。  
构图・相机：  
构图与相机为从同席者视线略高位置的纵向抓拍。35～50mm等效，脸、筷尖、盖饭呈三角配置。对脸与肉合焦，盖饭足够可读但远方墙柔和虚化。固定纵向裁剪、拍摄距离、相机高度、俯仰角、与被摄主体的正对・斜向。保持智能手机般的自然分辨率，避免广角桶形扭曲、脸中央膨胀、仅腿或臂伸长。焦平面匹配主角脸或图像主题，背景虚化量与轮廓相当于原图。不制造轮廓抠图般的非自然均匀虚化、二重轮廓、生成虚化的涡流。  
光源：  
光源以天花板温暖漫射照明为主光源，脸正面与头发柔和琥珀色光。从画面左前方弱辅助光照入筷子与肉、指，使其可读，不将阴影黑化压扁。主光源、辅助反射、阴影方向保持一致，对脸、头发、服装、小物、背景施加相同照明条件。捕捉光或材质反射与光源位置对应，不添加多个矛盾太阳、无关聚光灯、轮廓全周人工发光。高光保留细微阶调，不同时白飞肌肤、白布、空、云、窗。阴影也保留色信息与反射光。  
颜色・阶调：  
颜色与阶调将黑色服装、浓茶发、米色墙、木色、白青盖饭、绿葱、赤褐肉以暖色系统合。抑制室内黄色被覆，肌肤保持自然暖色。白平衡匹配场景光线，抑制肌肤、白、黑、背景色的相互污染。从明部至中间调、暗部平滑连接，避免HDR风局部对比、荧光色、过度青橙分离、黑压扁、轮廓周边光晕。饱和度维持图像内主色与点缀色的关系，不将服装或背景色相改为其他色。  
材质・细微质感：  
材质与细微质感描绘黑色针织的纹路、头发束、木筷光滑面、烤肉表面、刻葱、陶器盖饭釉药与青花图案、木墙、肌肤毛孔与牙齿自然质感。肌肤非均匀噪点面，根据部位变化毛孔大小、薄绒毛、血色、干湿差、光泽差自然化。头发、布、木、陶器、沙、水、金属、塑料等不统一光泽，个别描绘表面粗糙度、透明度、反射范围、边缘厚度。高精细化不制造伪文字、规则重复图案、过度锐化、格子状噪点。放大显示时，不仅轮廓，连接触面的微小阴影、半透明边缘、表面凹凸、纤维或颗粒方向均可确认密度。一方面，不夸张肉眼不可见毛孔或纤维转为粗糙质感，守护与拍摄距离相称的信息量。  
图像处理・完成：  
图像处理作为实拍智能手机照片或自然肖像照片完成。曝光、色温、对比、清晰度、饱和度、噪点降低适度，维持原图亮度与空气感。不将肌肤单独如其他图层般平滑化，避免仅瞳孔、牙齿、嘴唇过度强调。保留轻微传感器颗粒感与自然阶调，不偏向插图、3DCG、蜡像、广告用过度合成照片。轮廓局部校正时，不将头发细线、睫毛、指尖、服装边缘、小物边缘溶入背景，反之也不制造白色镶边。噪点降低后，不统一肌肤、布、头发、背景的颗粒感，各自保留深度与材质差。色调曲线不过度压缩明部，以中间调的脸与服装为主角，不过度提升暗部信息致平板化。不后附色差、过度周边减光、人工光泄漏、镜头眩光。最终输出不插入文字、字幕、边框、浮水印、签名、UI、样机，仅输出9:16单张照片。  
崩坏回避・禁止：

Both hands are positioned directly above the raised sneaker, actively tying the white shoelaces.

Her long hair falls naturally forward around both sides of her face because of the bending posture. 
The pose should feel completely candid, as if the photographer noticed the moment her shoelace came undone and casually took a photo.

Vertical 9:16 composition. 
Full-body to three-quarter environmental portrait. 
Camera positioned approximately at waist height in front of the subject. 
Slightly low frontal perspective. 
Subject centered prominently in the frame. 
Raised sneaker and hands clearly visible in the lower-middle portion of the image. 
35mm-equivalent wide-angle smartphone lens. 
Moderate background separation while keeping the park recognizable.

Bright natural daylight filtered through green tree leaves. 
Soft diffused sunlight. 
Gentle highlights on the hair, shoulders, and skin.

No harsh studio lighting.

No CGI.

items.title: 书店女大学生写实摄影人像

prompts.text:
TITLE:
Bookstore College Student Portrait

IDENTITY LOCK:
None.

STYLE:
Ultra-realistic photorealism.
Authentic handheld iPhone 16 Pro photography.
Casual Instagram-style lifestyle photo.
Natural HDR with minimal retouching.
Authentic skin texture.

SUBJECT:
Beautiful Japanese female college student in her early 20s.
Long dark brown hair with soft see-through bangs and loose natural waves.
Large dark brown eyes.
Natural makeup.
Healthy fair skin.

BODY:
Pronounced feminine hourglass figure.
Natural feminine curves.
Realistic anatomy.
Naturally full bust.
Slim waist.
Softly rounded hips.

OUTFIT:
Clean and casual college-student outfit.
White short-sleeve knit top.
Gray pleated mini skirt.
White ankle socks.
Black leather loafers.
Simple black shoulder bag worn over one shoulder.

SCENE / ENVIRONMENT:
Inside a modern Japanese bookstore.
Standing directly beside a tall dark-wood bookshelf filled with neatly arranged books.
Colorful Japanese book spines covering the shelves from floor level to above her head.
Warm wooden flooring.
Natural everyday bookstore atmosphere.
Additional bookshelves visible across the aisle and in the background.

POSE / EXPRESSION:
Standing very close to the bookshelf with her lower body facing it.
Reaching one arm high above her head toward a book on an upper shelf.
Her body stretches naturally upward while her torso gently twists back toward the camera.
Suddenly turning her head over her shoulder after noticing the camera.
Looking directly at the camera with a genuinely surprised expression, as if she was unexpectedly photographed.
Eyes slightly widened and eyebrows naturally raised.
Lips slightly parted in spontaneous surprise.
Natural candid reaction rather than a deliberate pose or smile.

CAMERA:
Handheld iPhone perspective.
Vertical 3:4 composition.
Tight full-body framing from head to shoes.
Camera distance approximately 1–1.5 meters.
Camera positioned behind and slightly to the left of the subject.
Camera height approximately 0–15 cm above the floor.
Camera tilted upward for a rear three-quarter low-angle view.
Natural 24–28mm full-frame equivalent smartphone perspective.
Moderate depth of field with distant shelves softly blurred.

LIGHTING:
Warm soft indoor bookstore lighting.
Natural overhead ceiling lights.
Soft illumination on the face and hair.
Realistic highlights and gentle shadows.
Balanced exposure.

DETAILS:
Realistic fabric texture.
Natural individual hair strands.
Detailed wooden shelves and varied book spines.
Subtle imperfections typical of a real bookstore.

NEGATIVE / CONSTRAINTS:
No CGI.
No illustration.
No anime.
No plastic skin.
No text or watermark.
No malformed anatomy or extra limbs.
No distorted hands.
No unnatural body proportions.

prompts.text:
标题：
书店大学生肖像

身份锁定：
无。

风格：
超写实摄影。真实的 iPhone 16 Pro 手持摄影。休闲 Instagram 风格生活照。极简修饰的自然 HDR。真实的皮肤纹理。

主体：
20 岁出头的美丽日本女大学生。深棕色长发，配有柔和的空气刘海和自然的波浪卷。大大的深棕色眼睛。淡妆。健康白皙的皮肤。

身体：
明显的女性沙漏型身材。自然的女性曲线。真实的解剖结构。自然丰满的胸部。纤细的腰部。圆润的臀部。

穿搭：
干净简约的大学生穿搭。白色短袖针织上衣。灰色百褶短裙。白色短袜。黑色皮质乐福鞋。单肩背着简单的黑色挎包。

场景 / 环境：
在一家现代日本书店内部。紧靠着一个摆满整齐书籍的高大深色木制书架站立。彩色日本书籍书脊覆盖了从地面到头顶以上的书架。温暖的木地板。自然的日常书店氛围。过道对面和背景中可见额外的书架。

姿势 / 表情：
紧靠书架站立，下半身面向书架。一只手臂高高举过头顶，伸向高层书架上的书。她的身体自然向上延伸，而躯干轻轻向相机方向扭回。在注意到相机后，突然转头回望。直视镜头，表情真实惊讶，仿佛是意外被拍到的。眼睛略微睁大，眉毛自然抬起。嘴唇微张，露出自然的惊喜。自然的抓拍反应，而非刻意的姿势或微笑。

相机：
手持 iPhone 视角。垂直 3:4 构图。紧凑的全身构图，从头到脚。相机距离约 1–1.5 米。相机位于拍摄对象后方偏左位置。相机高度距地面约 0–15 厘米。相机向上倾斜，形成背后的四分之三低角度视图。自然的 24–28mm 全画幅等效智能手机视角。中等景深，远处书架略微模糊。

光照：
温暖柔和的书店室内照明。自然的头顶吸顶灯。脸部和头发上的柔和光线。写实的亮点和柔和的阴影。曝光平衡。

细节：
真实的织物纹理。自然的单根发丝。细致的木制书架和多样的书脊。真实书店中特有的细微瑕疵。

负面 / 约束：
无 CGI。无插图。无动漫。无塑料感皮肤。无文字或水印。无解剖畸形或多余肢体。无畸形手部。无不自然的身体比例。

prompts.text:
Subject: The completed image is fixed as a 9:16 vertical single-person photo. Face center placed at 51% horizontal, 31% vertical; pupils at 27% vertical; cup center at approximately 22% horizontal, 44% vertical. The character's bounding area is 0-100% horizontal, 5-100% vertical, with about 4% white space at the top. The left hand and cup are on the left, long hair and shoulder straps on the right. This ratio, character bounding area, position of face, eyes, hands, and small objects, and white space at top, sides, and bottom are fixed anchors; do not re-center or adjust, nor equalize background white space during each generation. Parts continuing outside the frame stay truncated; do not complete via canvas expansion. Maintain the same woman, same facial features, same hairstyle, same clothing, same pose and contact, same background layout, same lighting, color, material, and treatment. No horizontal flipping, vertical flipping, field of view changes, camera distance changes, face-only enlargement, or character-only reduction. The overlapping order of character and background, the position where the outline reaches the edge of the frame, and the size relationship between foreground and background are fixed. Tolerance for each anchor under normalized coordinates is generally controlled within ±2%; correction that only aligns the face center while shifting hands or objects is prohibited. During final confirmation, use both overall display and enlarged display to check if the same information as the original image is located in the same position. 
Protagonist: A cute and elegant fictional adult Japanese woman, alone at a window seat in a coffee shop, holding a clear plastic cup of iced latte near her cheek, taking a selfie with a smartphone. Captured from the top of the head to below the chest, wearing a top with a light blue small floral pattern on a white base fabric. The number of people is fixed at one, represented as a fictional adult over 20 years old, not a real person. Reproduce only the age impression, body type, visible parts, clothing, and movements confirmable on the screen; do not assign visually undeterminable attributes such as nationality, occupation, or family relationships. Do not replace the character with other face shapes, other body types, or other age groups; even if other characters are visible in the background, do not promote them to the protagonist. Maintain a natural boundary between the protagonist's outline and the background.
Face/Makeup: Face and facial elements in the frame are a small oval shape, thin parallel eyebrows, large dark brownish-black pupils, a thin straight bridge of the nose, and light coral pink lips. The eye area features detailed eyelashes and extremely thin brown eyeliner, with a natural flush on the cheeks. Base makeup is not thick, retaining small fluctuations in skin tone, three-dimensionality of cheeks, nose, and mouth area, and natural pores. Left and right eyes, eyebrows, nostrils, corners of the mouth, and visible teeth alignment are naturally aligned for a human; do not replicate irises or catchlights identically. Makeup is limited to light colors recognizable in the image; do not add heavy eyeshadow, thick eyeliner, artificial fake eyelashes, strong contour correction, excessive whitening, or plastic-like skin.
Hair: Hair is dark brown long straight hair approaching black. Thin bangs, inner-curling strands around the face, and long, lustrous strands flowing from the right shoulder to below the chest. No excessive uniform gloss. Each hair is not unified into the same line; a mix of thick strands, medium strands, and fine flyaways is maintained with continuous flow from root to tip. Hairline, parting, area around the ears, and overlap at the neck or shoulders do not break down. Reflect only wind, humidity, gravity, and contact visible on screen; do not change to other hairstyles, excessive curls, or helmet-like expressions with uniform gloss.
Expression/Gaze: Expression and gaze look directly at the camera with a slight smile and closed mouth. Looking towards the near object while showing the cup, with an intimate feeling of a selfie. Avoid enlarged eyes or juvenile expressions. Direction and focal length of left and right pupils remain consistent; avoid strabismus, different focal points for each eye, or unnatural eye whites. Movement of cheeks, corners of eyes, wings of the nose, and corners of the mouth are linked to the same emotion; do not do fake smiles with only the mouth attached. No tears, strong surprise, anger, sleepiness, flirtatiousness, or romantic assertions in the image; do not add such elements.
Pose/Fingers/Contact: Pose, fingers, and contact are from the perspective of one arm extended toward the smartphone, but the device and the holding hand are outside the frame. The hand on the left side of the frame supports the lower part of the cup, naturally showing five fingers and light pink nails. The edge of the cup is near the cheek but not touching. Shoulders, collarbones, neck, upper arms, elbows, forearms, and wrists in the parts connected within the frame are presented at natural skeletal angles. When hands are visible, do not confuse left and right; five fingers on one hand, number of joints, nail direction, and finger length are natural; contact points for holding objects, pressure, and gravity are consistent. Do not sprout invisible fingers or body parts from the background; avoid arm fusion, double shoulders, elongated necks, or hyperextended joints. The twist of the body orientation relative to the face orientation is fixed within the range of the original image.
Clothing/Accessories: Clothing and accessories are a summer top with small light blue and gray floral patterns on a white base fabric, a small knot at the center of the chest, and thin straps. A beige bag strap is on the right shoulder. A thin silver chain and a small heart pendant. Do not change colors, necklines, sleeves, straps, knots, stitching, hardware, or the presence of decorations. The fabric does not cling like paint; small wrinkles are generated based on stretch, drape, thickness, gravity, and contact. Visible accessories maintain the same shape, position, holding style, and material; do not add brand text or fictional logos. Do not complete by speculating on the overall clothing outside the frame or unconfirmed accessories.
Location/Time/Background: Location and background are a bright coffee shop or a window seat near a station. Background consists of white tile-like grids and soft blurred window reflections; furniture or other people are not prominent. A small blue bottle-shaped mark is visible on the cup, but no text or real brand. Time period is fixed to the brightness readable from the light in the frame; do not replace with night views, sunsets, studio backgrounds, or other times/locations. Maintain the order and overlap of foreground, midground, and background; orientation of visible structures such as horizons, walls, windows, floors, furniture, and plants is natural. The smartphone, the other hand taking the photo, everything below the waist, and the full view of the coffee shop are outside the frame. Do not create invisible drink names, shop names, menus, food on the table, or extra characters. The background is not simplified to white space, nor is it filled with information not present in the original image.
Composition/Camera: Composition and camera are a vertical smartphone selfie with an extended arm, equivalent to 28-35mm. The face is placed near the center while including the cup in the same frame, suppressing facial distortion. Focus on the pupils and face; the cup and hand have sufficient readable resolution; background is slightly blurred. Fixed vertical cropping, shooting distance, camera height, pitch angle, and front-facing/diagonal orientation relative to the subject. Maintain the natural resolution of a smartphone; avoid wide-angle barrel distortion, central facial swelling, or elongation of only legs or arms. Focal plane matches the protagonist's face or the image theme; background blur amount and outlines are equivalent to the original image. No unnatural uniform blur like cutout outlines, double outlines, or generated blur swirls.
Light Source: Light source is bright diffused daylight coming through the window, entering from the front left, forming a large catchlight in the pupils and producing soft reflections on the bridge of the nose, cheeks, fingertips, and cup edge. Indoor white walls serve as fill light, preventing the chin from becoming dark. Direction of main light source, auxiliary reflections, and shadows remain consistent; apply the same lighting conditions to the face, hair, clothing, accessories, and background. Catchlights and material reflections correspond to the light source position; do not add multiple contradictory suns, unrelated spotlights, or artificial all-around rim lighting. Highlights retain subtle gradations, while preventing skin, white cloth, sky, clouds, or windows from blowing out to pure white. Shadows also retain color information and reflected light.
Color/Tone: Colors and tones center on white, light blue, beige, milk coffee color, and dark brown, maintaining a clean low-to-mid saturation. Skin is neutral, with only the blue of the pattern and the cup mark as small accent colors. White balance matches the scene lighting, suppressing mutual contamination of skin, white, black, and background colors. Smooth connection from highlights to midtones to shadows; avoid HDR-style local contrast, fluorescent colors, excessive blue-orange separation, crushed blacks, or vignetting around outlines. Saturation maintains the relationship between main and accent colors in the image; do not change clothing or background hues to other colors.
Materials/Fine Textures: Materials and fine textures distinguish between the edge and lid of the transparent cup, the black straw, the opaque milky white of the iced latte, nails, the thin weave of patterned cloth, the matte faux leather of the bag, hair strands, and skin pores. Skin is not unified as a noise surface; naturally vary pore size, fine fuzz, blood color, dry/wet differences, and gloss differences according to the area. Hair, cloth, wood, ceramics, sand, water, metal, and plastic are not unified in gloss; individually depict surface roughness, transparency, reflection range, and edge thickness. High-definition enhancement does not create fake text, regular repetitive patterns, excessive sharpness, or grid-like noise. When enlarging, confirm not only the outlines but also tiny shadows at contact surfaces, translucent edges, surface irregularities, and density of fiber or grain directions. On the other hand, do not exaggerate pores or fibers invisible to the naked eye into a rough texture, guarding the information amount appropriate for the shooting distance.
Image Processing/Finishing: Image processing is finished as a real smartphone photo or natural portrait photo. Exposure, color temperature, contrast, sharpness, saturation, and noise reduction are performed moderately, maintaining the brightness and atmosphere of the original image. Do not smooth the skin separately as if it were a different layer; pupils, teeth, and lips are not overemphasized. Retain slight sensor grain and natural gradations; do not lean toward illustrations, 3DCG, wax figures, or over-composited photos for advertising. During local outline correction, do not let fine hair lines, eyelashes, fingertips, clothing edges, or accessory edges melt into the background, nor create white borders. After noise reduction, do not unify the grain of skin, cloth, hair, and background; each maintains depth and material differences. Tone curves do not excessively compress highlights; focus on the face and clothing in the midtones, and do not overly lift shadow information to flatten the image. Do not post-add chromatic aberration, excessive vignetting, artificial light leaks, or lens flares. Final output does not insert text, subtitles, borders, watermarks, signatures, UI, or models; output only one 9:16 photo.
Deformation Avoidance/Prohibitions: Highest priority condition for avoiding collapse; prohibited to resemble real people, de-age/miniaturize, replace with others, multiply people, facial left-right asymmetry, inconsistent pupil shapes, fused teeth, overlapping nostrils, deformed ears, or poor neck-shoulder connection. When hands are present, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, reversed palms, abnormally long nails, or fingers penetrating objects are prohibited. Clothing prohibits disappearing straps or sleeves, fusion with the body, interrupted patterns, or extra perspective. Background prohibits curved horizon or wall lines, dissolving furniture or vessels, giant distant figures, or unreadable text that looks readable. Regarding invisible elements, the smartphone, the other hand taking the photo, everything below the waist, and the full view of the coffee shop are outside the frame. Guard the boundary of not creating invisible drink names, shop names, menus, food on the table, or extra characters; do not generate parts outside the frame or unknown parts. Beauty filters, excessive face slimming, eyeball enlargement, extreme breast/waist emphasis, overt sexual performance, low angles just to incite body parts, other clothing, other backgrounds, other light sources, other seasons, logos, brands, or watermarks are not added.

prompts.text:
被摄主体：  
完成图像固定为纵9:16的单人照片。脸部中心置于横51%、纵31%，瞳孔置于纵27%，杯子中心置于横22%、纵44%附近。人物外接区域为横0～100%、纵5～100%，头顶留白约4%，左手和杯子置于左侧，长发和肩带置于右侧。此比率、人物外接区域、脸・眼・手・小物的位置、头顶・左右・下方留白作为固定锚点，每次生成时不重新居中调整，也不均等化背景留白。画面外延续的部位保持在那里截断的状态，不通过画布扩展来补全。保持相同的女性、相同的脸部特征、相同的发型、相同的服装、相同的姿势和接触、相同的背景布局、相同的光线、颜色、材质、处理方式。不进行左右翻转、上下翻转、画角变更、相机距离变更、仅脸部放大、仅人物缩小。人物与背景的重叠顺序、轮廓到达画面边缘的位置、前景与背景的大小关系固定。正规化坐标下各锚点的容差原则上控制在±2%以内，禁止仅对脸部中心对齐而偏移手或小物的校正。最终确认时，通过整体显示和放大显示两种方式，核对是否与原图像相同的信息位于相同的位置。  
主角是一位可爱而优雅的虚构成年日本女性，独自在咖啡店的窗边座位，手持透明塑料杯的冰拿铁举到脸颊附近，用智能手机自拍。从头顶到胸部下方入镜，穿着白色底布上印有淡青色小花图案的上衣。人数固定为一人，以20岁以上的虚构成人表现，而非真实人物。只再现屏幕上可确认的年龄印象、体型、可见部位、服装、动作，不赋予国籍、职业、家庭关系等视觉上无法确定的属性。不将人物替换为其他脸型、其他体型、其他年龄层，即使背景可见其他人物也不将其提升为主角。保持主角轮廓与背景的边界自然。  
脸・妆容：  
脸部和画面内的脸部元素为小卵形、细平行眉、大而接近黑色的焦茶色瞳孔、细直鼻梁、淡珊瑚粉色的嘴唇。眼部为细致的睫毛和极薄的棕色眼线，脸颊带有自然的血色。基础妆容不厚涂，保留肌肤色的小波动、脸颊・鼻子・嘴周的立体感、自然毛孔。左右眼睛、眉毛、鼻孔、嘴角、可见牙齿的排列作为人体自然对齐，不将虹膜或捕捉光完全相同化复制。妆容仅限于图像可辨识的淡色，不添加浓重眼影、粗眼线、人工假睫毛、强烈轮廓修正、过度美白、塑料感肌肤。  
头发：  
头发为接近黑色的深棕色长直发。薄刘海、脸周内卷的发束、从右肩流至胸部下方的长而有光泽的发束。不做过度均匀光泽。每根头发不统一为相同线条，混合粗发束、中等发束、细碎后发，从发根到发梢保持连续流动。发际线、分线、耳周、颈部或肩部的重叠不崩坏。只反映画面可见的风、湿气、重力、接触，不改为其他发型、过度卷发、均匀光泽的头盔状表现。  
表情・视线：  
表情和视线直视镜头，闭嘴微微微笑。一边展示杯子一边将视线转向近处的对象，带有自拍的亲密感。避免眼睛放大或幼态表情。左右瞳孔的方向和焦距保持一致，避免斜视、单眼焦点不同、不自然的眼白。脸颊、眼尾、鼻翼、嘴角的动作联动相同情感，不做仅嘴部贴上的假笑。图像中无泪水、强烈惊讶、愤怒、睡意、挑逗、恋爱断定等，不添加此类元素。  
姿势・手指・接触：  
姿势、手指、接触为单臂伸向智能手机方向的视角，但终端和握持手在画面外。画面左侧的手支撑杯子下部，自然显示五指和淡粉色指甲。杯子边缘靠近脸颊但不接触。肩部、锁骨、颈部、上臂、肘部、前臂、手腕在画面内连接的部分以骨骼自然角度呈现。可见手部时不混淆左右，一只手上五指、关节数、指甲方向、指长自然，物体握持接触点、压力、重力一致。不从背景生出不可见的手指或身体部位，避免手臂融合、肩部双重、颈部伸长、关节反曲。身体朝向与脸部朝向的扭曲固定在原图像范围内。  
服装・小物：  
服装和小物为白色底布上印有小淡蓝色和灰色花纹、胸口中央小结、细肩带的夏季上衣。右肩有米色包带。细银链和小爱心吊坠。不改变颜色、领口、袖子、肩带、结、缝合、金具、装饰的有无。布料不贴身如涂漆，依伸缩、垂感、厚度、重力、接触产生小皱褶。可见小物保持相同形状、位置、握持方式、材质，不添加品牌文字或虚构标志。不推测画面外服装整体或未确认配饰来补全。  
地点・时间・背景：  
地点和背景为明亮咖啡店或车站附近的窗边座位。背景为白色瓷砖状网格和窗户反射柔和模糊，家具或其他人不突出。杯子上可见小蓝色瓶状标记，但不做文字或真实品牌。时间带固定为画面内光线可读的明亮度，不替换为夜景、日落、摄影棚背景等其他时间・地点。保持前景、中景、远景的顺序和重叠，水平线、墙、窗、地板、家具、植物等可见结构的朝向自然。智能手机、拍摄中的另一手、腰部以下、咖啡店全景在画面外。不创作不可见的饮料名、店名、菜单、桌上料理、额外人物。背景不简化为空白，同时不以原图像中无的信息填满。  
构图・相机：  
构图和相机为伸臂纵向智能手机自拍，相当于28～35mm。脸部置于中央附近，同时将杯子纳入同一画面，抑制脸部扭曲。对瞳孔和脸部对焦，杯子和手有足够可读分辨率，背景轻微模糊。固定纵向裁剪、拍摄距离、相机高度、俯仰角、与被摄体的正对・斜向。保持智能手机自然的解像感，避免广角桶形扭曲、脸部中央膨胀、仅腿或臂伸长。焦平面匹配主角脸部或图像主题，背景虚化量和轮廓相当于原图像。不做轮廓抠图般的非自然均匀虚化、二重轮廓、生成虚化的漩涡。  
光源：  
光源为窗户传入的明亮漫射日光，从正面左侧进入，在瞳孔形成大捕捉光，在鼻梁、脸颊、指尖、杯子边缘产生柔和反射。以室内白色墙壁为辅助光，不使下巴变暗。主光源、辅助反射、阴影方向保持一致，对脸部、头发、服装、小物、背景应用相同照明条件。捕捉光和材质反射与光源位置对应，不添加多个矛盾太阳、无关聚光灯、轮廓全周人工发光。高光保留细微阶调，同时不使肌肤、白布、空、云、窗户白飞。阴影也保留色信息和反射光。  
颜色・阶调：  
颜色和阶调以白、淡蓝、米色、奶咖啡色、深棕色为中心，保持清洁的低～中饱和度。肌肤为中性，仅花纹的蓝和杯子标记作为小点缀色。白平衡匹配场景光线，抑制肌肤、白、黑、背景色的相互污染。从明部到中间调、暗部平滑连接，避免HDR风局部对比、荧光色、过度青橙分离、黑压、轮廓周围晕影。饱和度维持图像内主色与点缀色的关系，不将服装或背景色相改为其他色。  
材质・细微质感：  
材质和细微质感区分透明杯子的边缘和盖子、黑色吸管、冰拿铁的不透明奶白色、指甲、花纹布的薄织、包的哑光人造革、发束、肌肤毛孔。肌肤不统一为噪声面，根据部位自然变化毛孔大小、薄绒毛、血色、干湿差、光泽差。头发、布、木、陶器、沙、水、金属、塑料等不统一光泽，个别描绘表面粗糙度、透明度、反射范围、边缘厚度。高精细化不制造假文字、规则重复图案、过度锐利度、格子状噪声。放大显示时，不仅轮廓，还确认接触面的微小阴影、半透明边缘、表面凹凸、纤维或颗粒方向的密度。一方面，不夸张肉眼不可见的毛孔或纤维而转为粗糙质感，守护与拍摄距离相称的信息量。  
图像处理・完成：  
图像处理作为实拍智能手机照片或自然肖像照片完成。曝光、色温、对比度、清晰度、饱和度、降噪适度进行，维持原图像的亮度和空气感。不将肌肤单独如其他图层般平滑，瞳孔、牙齿、嘴唇也不过度强调。保留轻微传感器颗粒感和自然阶调，不偏向插图、3DCG、蜡像、广告用过度合成照片。轮廓局部修正时，不让头发细线、睫毛、指尖、服装边缘、小物边缘溶入背景，反之也不制造白色镶边。降噪后也不统一肌肤、布、头发、背景的颗粒感，各自保持深度和材质差异。色调曲线不过度压缩明部，以中间调的脸部和服装为主角，不过度提升暗部信息而平板化。不后加色差、过度周边减光、人工光泄漏、镜头光晕。最终输出不插入文字、字幕、边框、透水印、签名、UI、模型，仅输出一张9:16照片。  
崩坏回避・禁止：  
崩坏回避的最高优先条件，禁止与真实人物相似、未成年化、替换为他人、多人化、脸部左右不对称崩坏、瞳孔形状不一致、牙齿融合、鼻孔重叠、耳朵变形、颈肩连接不良。手部存在时，禁止多余手指、缺失手指、融合手指、反转手掌、异常长指甲、贯穿物体的手指。服装禁止肩带或袖子消失、与身体融合、图案中断、额外透视。背景禁止水平线或墙线弯曲、家具或器物溶解、远景人物巨大化、看似可读却不可读的文字。不可见元素方面，智能手机、拍摄中的另一手、腰部以下、咖啡店全景在画面外。守护不可见饮料名、店名、菜单、桌上料理、额外人物不创作的边界，不生成画面外・不明部分。美肌滤镜、过度小脸化、眼球放大、极端胸腰强调、露骨性感演出、仅煽动身体部位的低角度、其他服装、其他背景、其他光源、其他季节、标志、品牌、透水印不添加。

与参考图像中完全相同的女性超写实全身肖像，保持面部 100% 一致——相同的面部结构、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇，具有可见毛孔和自然瑕疵的皮肤纹理，完全相同的深棕色长直发，从中缝分开并垂在肩膀上。

她站在一个温暖、优雅的餐厅走廊里，有着浓郁的深色木板装饰，越过左肩回头看向相机，带着灿烂、真诚、略显俏皮的微笑。柔和的自然妆容，水亮的嘴唇，清晰的眉毛。

装扮：修身的黑色缎面/丝绸无袖挂脖上衣，带有环绕颈部的高领口，深露背，正面有重度褶皱，形成柔软的垂直褶皱，以及一件采用相同丝滑黑色面料的短款喇叭迷你裙。面料具有细微的光泽和逼真的垂感。

配饰：手指上戴着多个精致的金戒指，左手腕上戴着一条细金链手链，左手通过短手柄拎着一个小巧的有结构感的黑色手提包。

姿势：身体略微偏离相机，重心落在一条腿上，躯干扭转回望，双手放松在臀部附近拿着包。通过修身的轮廓可以看到柔美的女性曲线。

环境：高档餐厅走廊，铺着抛光木地板，深色木墙板，右侧墙上有一幅带框的黑白艺术品，柔和的暖色壁灯和嵌入式照明营造出柔和的高光和阴影，背景走廊中隐约可见铺着白色桌布的餐桌，走廊更深处有一个小的“WC”标志和出口标志。

相机与技术：使用 Sony A7R V 拍摄，搭配 85mm f/1.4 镜头，浅景深，背景有奶油般的虚化效果，自然的皮肤纹理，逼真的织物光泽和褶皱，高动态范围，电影感的暖色调调色，8K 超细节，写实，社论时尚摄影风格。

光照：柔和温暖的餐厅环境光与来自左侧的柔和主光相结合，头发和肩膀上有微妙的轮廓光，自然的皮肤光泽，无生硬阴影。

负面提示词：变形的面部，不同的面部，改变的面部特征，塑料感皮肤，过度平滑的皮肤，多余的肢体，解剖学错误，模糊，低分辨率，卡通，动漫，过度饱和，浓妆，不同的服装颜色

prompts.text:
任务：创建一张写实、自然的竖屏手机抓拍，展现第一人称视角的同学聚会瞬间。

主体：
数量：3人。
共同属性：日本国籍，20多岁年轻女性，自然苗条至平均成年人身材，写实的未修饰皮肤且带有可见的自然纹理，面部特征自然不完美且带有细微的不对称感，适合晚间同学聚会的自然精致妆容。身份规则：这三名女性必须拥有截然不同的脸型、发型、面部结构和整体视觉身份。不要让她们看起来像姐妹、克隆体或同一名女性的变体。

左侧女性：位于前景三人组左侧，24岁，略显犀利的狐狸系日本面部特征，细长的鹅蛋脸且下颚线略窄，略微上挑的杏仁形深褐色眼睛，自然且带轻微角度的眉毛，中小尺寸的直鼻，纤细的自然唇形，浅色肤色。皮肤细节：非常细微的雀斑和自然不均匀的皮肤纹理。发型：中长发，带有轻微自然波浪的柔和长发，自然黑褐色，空气感碎刘海。性格印象：略显自信、爱开玩笑、好胜且带有轻微醋意。表情：可爱的闷闷不乐表情，眼神微眯并带着小小的嘟嘴，同时向上看向观察者。服装：优雅的成年女性吊带晚间协调套装，适合时髦的同学聚会。饰品：精美的小耳环和简约首饰。

中间女性：位于前景三人组中心，23岁，柔和的狸猫系日本面部特征，圆润的鹅蛋脸且双颊略显丰满，大而柔和的圆形深褐色眼睛，眼睑形状自然不均匀，柔和的自然直眉，圆润的小鼻子，中等厚度的柔和嘴唇且唇形自然生动，白皙肤色。皮肤细节：自然毛孔、浅色雀斑和肤色的轻微真实变化。发型：短波波头，自然及颈长度，发梢细微内扣并有几缕碎发，深棕黑色，自然柔和的刘海。性格印象：友好可爱但目前正处于可爱的嫉妒中并渴望关注。表情：脸颊微鼓，带着小小的嘟嘴，同时直接向上盯着观察者。服装：优雅的成年女性吊带晚间协调套装，适合时髦的同学聚会。饰品：精致的项链和低调的耳环。

右侧女性：位于前景三人组右侧，25岁，干净、精致、优雅的日本面部特征，均衡的柔和鹅蛋脸且颧骨宽度适中，沉稳的杏仁形深褐色眼睛，自然直挺至微弯的眉毛，中等大小且均衡的鼻子，均衡的自然唇形，浅色肤色。皮肤细节：真实的健康皮肤，带有细微毛孔和自然的不对称感。发型：扎成松散的低马尾，脸部周围有柔和的碎发，自然黑色，侧分的柔和刘海。性格印象：通常沉稳优雅，但对观察者表现出含蓄的嫉妒。表情：克制的可爱嘟嘴，眼神微眯并向上投以静静要求关注的目光。服装：优雅的成年女性吊带晚间协调套装，适合时髦的同学聚会。饰品：适合晚间聚会的含蓄成熟首饰。

身份区分规则：在整张图像中保持左、中、右女性的视觉区分。左侧身份：犀利狐狸脸、微卷中长发；中间身份：柔和狸猫脸、短波波头；右侧身份：精致优雅脸、低马尾。避免：同一张脸重复三次、几乎相同的眼型、相同的发型、相同的面部比例、姐妹般的相似感、三人之间的面部混合。

场景：
地点：一个热闹的同学会场或酒店宴会厅，处于 20 多岁年轻前同学参加的室内晚间活动中。
瞬间：三名 20 多岁的年轻女性紧贴在相机下方，俏皮但带有占有欲地抓着并拽着观察者的领带。
情感背景：女性们以一种俏皮的“我们三个中你选谁？”的劲头面对观察者。
距离：亲密的近距离。
瞬间风格：在聚会中意外捕捉到的非摆拍日常瞬间。

相机与构图：
视角：被拽领带的人的第一人称视角。
观察者高度：观察者明显比三名女性高。
相机位置：观察者从高于女性的高位拿着手机。
相机角度：清晰的俯拍透视，向下俯视女性。
主体位置：三名女性都紧贴着靠向相机下方。
左右中规则：狐狸系长发女性必须保持在左侧，狸猫系波波头女性必须保持在中间，优雅马尾女性必须保持在右侧。
眼神线：每位女性在继续拽领带的同时都向上看向观察者，营造出亲密的低到高视线互动。
构图：不完美的手机手持竖屏构图，同时也透露出足够的周围聚会人群以建立情境。
镜头：28mm 广角手机相机。
宽高比：3:4

互动：
领带：属于第一人称观察者的单条领带向下延伸至前景场景中。
动作：三名女性都在与同一条领带互动，抓着或轻轻地向自己方向拉领带的不同部分。
手部行为：手和手指必须符合解剖学自然，具有可信的抓握姿势，没有融合或重复的手指。
物理关系：女性们紧密站立在观察者周围，且彼此之间没有不自然的重叠。
观察者存在感：观察者本人大部分在画框外；他的领带和第一人称的高机位相机建立了他的存在。

表情：
整体表情：可爱的闷闷不乐表情，感觉俏皮、富有情感表现力且带有轻微醋意，而非严厉。
表情细节：轻微嘟嘴、可爱的烦恼、轻微的嫉妒、细微鼓起的脸颊、小小的噘嘴、开玩笑的生气样子、微眯的双眼、可爱地要求关注的向上凝视。
变化规则：不要给三名女性完全相同的表情。左侧女性应看起来略带挑战和调侃，中间女性应更公开地表现出可爱和撒娇，右侧女性应更克制且优雅地吃醋。

服装与造型：
前景女性服装：前景中的三名女性必须穿着适合时髦晚间同学聚会的优雅成年吊带套装。
前景服装差异：为每位女性提供不同但协调的吊带套装设计和低调优雅的颜色，以免她们看起来像制服团体。
前景服装优先级：不要将前景三人组改为带袖连衣裙。保持三名主要女性穿着吊带协调套装。
头发：保持每位女性明确定义的发型和发长。
饰品：适合同学聚会派对的含蓄饰品。

背景：
场地：具有强烈且能立即识别出的同学会氛围的怀旧聚会大厅或酒店宴会场地。
