Wardrobe assembly rule:
Each FINAL WORN STATE overrides conflicting wearing-state wording only for the item descriptions it explicitly scopes or names, and only for wearing role or use, count, position, side, orientation, routing, fastening, layering, folds, tucking, and draping. Preserve those descriptions for identity, design, material, color, pattern, construction, and proportions.

Top: One black-and-warm-ivory lace corset camisole top with a fitted cropped silhouette and structured underwired cups. Two narrow black satin shoulder straps include small silver-tone rectangular sliders and connect separately to the upper cup corners and straight rear edge. Each black satin bust cup is densely gathered along its curved lower seam and trimmed across the upper edge with narrow warm-ivory scalloped floral lace. A small black satin bow centers above a triangular warm-ivory lace bridge between the cups. The torso combines a densely ruched vertical black satin center panel, two long warm-ivory floral-lace side-front panels that taper toward the lower edge, and translucent black mesh side panels. Black satin binding outlines the complete upper and lower edges, while short warm-ivory scalloped lace sections project beneath the outer lower corners. Finish with vertical internal boning channels, a concealed rear hook-and-eye closure, tonal black stitching, and no text, hardware ornaments, or additional graphics.

Bottom: One solid black low-rise wrap maxi skirt made from medium-weight cotton twill with a washed matte surface and soft structured drape. A broad asymmetric upper edge closes through two long integral black self-fabric ties anchored at separated front-waist stations; equal usable lengths form one compact center-front knot with two balanced loops and two long tapered tails. The skirt body overlaps into a full A-line silhouette with one broad outer front panel crossing diagonally over a continuous inner panel. Along the lower product-left front, a narrow vertical extension carries four evenly spaced matte-black round buttons and ends in a squared free edge. Near the lower product-right front, add one small silver-white embroidered botanical composition consisting of a compact berry-and-leaf sprig connected to a long fine looping stem that forms one large upper arc and one smaller lower curl. Each boot has a sharply tapered closed toe, a close straight shaft with a subtly lowered rear topline, a fitted heel counter, a narrow high stiletto heel, and a thin black outsole. A concealed full-length zipper follows the inner shaft beneath a narrow leather guard, while fine tonal seams shape the vamp, ankle, and vertical shaft. Preserve identical shaft height, pointed forepart geometry, polished finish, heel profile, and construction across the pair except for anatomical mirroring, with no buckles, laces, graphics, or decorative hardware.

Bag:

One compact black crescent shoulder bag made from glossy crinkled synthetic leather with a softly structured body, reinforced applied panels, black edge paint, and silver-toned hardware. The broad curved top edge contains one full-width zipper opening with exposed silver teeth, while the lower body expands into a rounded shallow crescent with gathered central volume and a level reinforced base. The visible broad face is organized by a curved top yoke, angular layered corner panels, round metal studs, one short functional buckle tab, and a small shaped flap secured by a round stud; each applied region retains its own stitched perimeter and thickness step. A wide adjustable belt-style strap attaches through metal rings, carries a sequence of large silver eyelets, round studs, and a rectangular buckle, and includes a padded section edged by black braided trim. One slim rectangular auxiliary zip pouch is secured to the lower strap hardware through a short metal ring connector; the pouch has a vertical silver zipper, two round studs, and one raised oval face panel. Each earring forms a slender circular open hoop from uniform round-section metal, with one straight post at the upper terminal and a compact hinged latch at the opposing terminal. prompts.text:
衣橱组装规则：
每个最终穿着状态仅针对其明确界定或命名的物品描述，覆盖与之冲突的穿着状态措辞，且仅限于穿着角色或用途、数量、位置、侧边、方向、路径、紧固、分层、折叠、塞入和垂坠。保留那些关于身份、设计、材质、颜色、图案、结构和比例的描述。

上装：一件黑色与暖象牙色蕾丝束胸背心上衣，具有贴身的短款轮廓和结构化的带钢圈罩杯。两条窄黑色缎面肩带包含小型银色矩形调节扣，分别连接到罩杯上角和直平的后缘。每个黑色缎面胸罩罩杯沿其弯曲的下缝线密集褶皱，并沿上边缘装饰有窄窄的暖象牙色扇形花卉蕾丝。一个小的黑色缎面蝴蝶结位于罩杯之间三角形暖象牙色蕾丝桥的中心上方。躯干结合了一个密集收褶的垂直黑色缎面中心面板、两个向边缘缩小的长款暖象牙色花卉蕾丝侧前后面板，以及半透明的黑色网眼侧面板。黑色缎面滚边勾勒出完整的上下边缘，而短促的暖象牙色扇形蕾丝部分从外部下角下方突出。最后以垂直内部鱼骨槽、隐藏式后部钩扣、同色系黑色缝线完成，且无文字、硬件装饰或额外图形。

下装：一条纯黑色低腰围裹式长裙，由中等重量、具有水洗哑光表面和柔和结构感垂坠的棉斜纹布制成。宽大的不对称上边缘通过两个锚定在分离的前腰位置的长款一体式黑色同质面料系带闭合；相等的可用长度形成一个带两个平衡环和两个长锥形尾部的紧凑中心前结。裙身重叠形成完整的 A 字廓形，一个宽大的外前片对角穿过连续的内片。沿着产品左下方的前部，一个窄的垂直延伸部分带有四个均匀间隔的哑光黑圆形纽扣，并以方形自由边缘结束。在产品右下方前部附近，增加一个小的银白色绣花植物构图，由一个紧凑的浆果和叶子小枝连接到一个形成一个大上圆弧和一个较小下卷曲的长精细循环茎。保留单侧纽扣面板、局部刺绣、干净水平的长裙摆、加固的系带锚点、同色系缝线，且无额外图形或硬件。

鞋履：一双匹配的镜像黑色及膝尖头靴，由光滑打磨的皮革制成，具有纤细的结构化靴筒和柔和起皱的脚踝过渡。每只靴子都有一个锐利缩小的封闭脚尖、一个带有微妙降低的后顶线的贴合直筒、一个贴合的跟杯、一个纤细的高细跟和一个薄黑色外底。拉链隐藏在内侧轴线下方的窄皮革护边内，而精细的同色系接缝塑造了鞋面、脚踝和垂直靴筒。保留相同的靴筒高度、尖头前部几何形状、抛光饰面、鞋跟轮廓和整对的结构（解剖学镜像除外），无搭扣、系带、图形或装饰性硬件。

包袋：

一款紧凑的黑色新月形单肩包，由具有柔和结构感、加固贴合面板、黑色油边和银色硬件的亮面皱褶合成皮革制成。宽阔的弧形顶边缘包含一个带有外露银齿的全宽拉链开口，而下部包身扩展成圆润的浅新月形，具有聚集的中心容量和水平加固底部。可见的宽阔面由弧形顶过肩、棱角分明的层叠角面板、圆形金属铆钉、一个短的功能性搭扣条和一个由圆形铆钉固定的定型小翻盖组成；每个贴合区域都保留其自身的缝线周长和厚度阶梯。宽大的可调节腰带式背带通过金属环连接，带有一系列大型银色孔眼、圆形铆钉和一个矩形搭扣，并包括一个由黑色编织饰边包围的衬垫部分。一个纤细的矩形辅助拉链袋通过短金属环连接器固定在下部背带硬件上；该小袋有一个垂直银色拉链、两个圆形铆钉和一个凸起的椭圆面板。保留紧凑的新月比例、亮面皱褶面、清晰的层叠面板几何形状、功能性拉链路径和密集的协调银色硬件。

最终穿着状态：
- 包袋携带：视角：前方/近前方支撑 图像右侧；后方/近后方支撑 图像左侧；侧面遵循佩戴者左侧。登记的短背带承担来自该肩膀的重量；包顶直接位于同一腋下紧靠侧躯干。双手保持离开状态；支撑点永远不会移动到前臂、肘部、手腕或手部。
- 完成 — 自然：将登记的短背带保持在佩戴者左肩，包身顶部直接位于左腋下；仅调整紧贴身体的接触和包的角度，绝不调整支撑点。保持选定的支撑点准确，同时允许有限的自然接触变化和一个小的重力引导角度。

项链：

一条精致的短款银色珠宝链，由一根连续的细链条组成，具有紧密排列的微型链节和断断续续的微小细长珠站。保持链条轻盈、均匀且从微妙的中心站开始双侧平衡，无吊坠或超大焦点组件。以紧凑的龙虾扣和短款匹配的调节尾部完成。保持均匀的链节节距、流畅的衔接、牢固的珠子到链条连接、克制的抛光反射和精致的低调饰面。

一条中等长度的复古银色吊坠项链，构造为一个完整的柔性闭合回路。带有紧密椭圆链节的精细氧化圆弧链通过一个小龙虾扣和短延长链闭合。中心为一个雕塑感的眼形吊坠，由一个窄尖椭圆外框、一个凸起的抛光上睑、一个深色凹陷的杏仁形中心和一个微小的银珠瞳孔组成，通过一个紧凑的一体式挂环连接。保留水平吊坠方向、深色与亮色金属对比、精致的链条比例，且无宝石、文字或额外装饰。

耳饰：一对匹配的大号抛光暖金色圆环耳耳环，作为两个完整的相同产品展示。每只耳环由均匀的圆截面金属形成细长的圆形开口环，在上端有一个直柱，在相对端有一个紧凑的铰链闩锁。保留宽大的洁净圆环、轻巧的截面、镜面抛光暖金色饰面、相同的直径，且无宝石、纹理、文字或垂坠组件。

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-realistic editorial portrait using the uploaded photo as the exact reference for the person. Preserve the person’s facial identity, facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, body proportions, clothing, accessories, and pose accurately.

Create a creative split-style composition where the real person is naturally positioned beside a highly detailed hand-drawn pencil sketch of the exact same person. The sketch must precisely replicate the person’s pose, hairstyle, sunglasses, outfit, shoes, bag, coffee cup, magazine, and body proportions.

The real person should look completely photorealistic with natural skin texture, realistic hair strands, authentic fabric details, soft natural lighting, subtle shadows, and cinematic depth. The sketch should be monochrome graphite/ink with fine pencil strokes, cross-hatching, realistic line variation, hand-drawn imperfections, and artistic shading.

Place the real person against a clean warm beige/cream wall in a minimalist fashion-editorial setting. Make the sketch appear as if it has been hand-drawn directly onto the wall beside the real person, perfectly aligned with the real pose.

items.title: 盛夏海边浅滩双人手机超广角自拍

prompts.text:
Direction: 2 fictional adult Japanese women over 21 years old, at the moment of entering the shallow water area of a summer beach, a vertical selfie casually taken by the woman on the left using a smartphone's 0.5x ultra-wide-angle camera. Not beautifying the characters into portraits, but conveying the shooting reason of 'entering the sea with a friend, playing around and stretching out an arm to take a shot, which accidentally left a very summery photo,' a daily SNS snapshot. Avoid perfected poses or advertisement-like staging, emphasize the closeness of the shooting distance, the enlarged foreground arm, hair messed up by the sea breeze, moments where faces cannot be seen clearly, with the backlit sparkling water surface as the protagonist. 
Mood: The openness of a midsummer noon, casual and relaxed between friends, slightly random and accidental mobile phone photo. Not the glamour of a travel brochure, but an ordinary summer vacation record kept in a personal phone album. Neither poses with a perfect smile for the camera, prioritizing capturing the atmosphere of the moment. 
Model Left: Fictional adult Japanese woman over 21 years old. Healthy and naturally curved figure. There is a full natural volume at the chest area through the clothes, but no single part of the body is taken as the protagonist of the photo. Naturally presented as a friend entering the sea. 
Model Right: Fictional adult Japanese woman over 21 years old. Friend of the woman on the left. Healthy adult female physique, same height, body type, and pose as the woman on the left are avoided to give natural individual differences. Does not imitate real people, celebrities, or influencers. 
Face: Neither shows the face clearly. The woman on the left tilts her head to the right, with one hand and the black hair blown by the sea breeze overlapping part of the cheek to the eyes, making the expression almost unrecognizable. The woman on the right is in a back-to-oblique-back view facing the sea side, with her face almost invisible. Not a front-facing portrait for facial recognition, but an amount of information that stands as an accidental selfie between friends. 
Hair: Both have black long hair. Not perfect straight hair like a beauty advertisement; the sea breeze separates the hair strands, with a few fine hairs scattering horizontally, strands falling over the face, and uneven hair ends. The backlit part has only subtle rim light, and the black hair on the shadow side is slightly crushed due to smartphone exposure. 
Body: Realistic bone structure and center of gravity of adult women. Standing asymmetrically, with weight slightly shifted to one leg on the unstable sand of the shallows. The woman on the left twists her upper body slightly to take the selfie, while the woman on the right moves forward toward the deeper part of the sea, stepping forward with one leg. Body proportions are not exaggerated, only the perspective of the ultra-wide angle is boldly preserved. 
Skin: Natural skin exposed to strong summer sunlight. Preserves subtle skin texture, slight color variations, gloss on arms or shoulders, and fine moisture brought by seawater. No uniform smoothness like a beauty filter; highlights in the backlit parts are slightly overexposed, and shadow sides lack gradation like a smartphone. 
Outfit Left: Dark blue form-fitting short-sleeved ribbed top. Lower body is extremely low-waist casual pants, waistline low near the hip bone, but naturally fixed as clothing, ensuring necessary coverage. Does not reveal underwear or skin in an unnatural way, nor adopts a coordinate-style symmetrical wear, adding natural folds and drapes to the extent of being slightly shifted during play by the sea. 
Outfit Right: White-colored loose short-sleeved T-shirt and light blue low-waist denim shorts. The waist position is slightly higher than the woman on the left so that the two do not appear to have the same clothing structure. One arm casually holds a thin black coat or lightweight bag brought to the beach. 
Accessories: Visible accessories are minimized. No large jewelry used while playing by the sea. The smartphone body used by the woman on the left for shooting is close to the outside of the frame; if necessary, only a small part of the case edge or the holding part should be naturally revealed. 
Scene Objects: A thin black coat or lightweight bag casually held by one arm of the woman on the right. The sea surface has small ripples and slender white reflections. Avoid artificial props, reflectors, lighting equipment, or decorations for resort advertisements. 
Pose Left: From the bottom left to near the center of the screen. The body still faces the sea side, only the upper body is slightly turned toward the camera. One arm is greatly extended holding the smartphone for a selfie, thus the forearm appears huge with extreme perspective from the bottom center toward the left shoulder. The other hand is lightly raised to the face, blocking part of the face along with the hair blown by the sea breeze. No smile, presenting a subtle expression as if in the middle of shooting. 
Pose Right: Center to the right side of the screen. Oblique back view facing the bay side. Left leg steps slightly forward walking in the shallows, one arm extends high diagonally upward toward the horizon, with the index and middle fingers naturally making a V-sign. The wrist is slightly tilted back, not making a perfectly symmetrical pose. 
Water: Shallow and highly transparent seawater. Water depth is about 10-30cm depending on the position, with both immersed to near the ankles or calves. Yellow-brown sand ripples show through the bottom; the color of the sea is not a single vivid turquoise, but a mixture of grayish-blue, slight green, warm colors of the seabed, and white reflections of the sun. Small waves overlap multiple times almost parallel to the horizon. 
Lighting: High sun from mid-morning to early afternoon. The sun is located from the front right to nearly the front of the screen, with the characters partially backlit. Small ripples on the water surface produce many white specular highlights, some of which are blown out like a smartphone. Hair shadows are slightly crushed, and bright spots on the skin are strongly irradiated. Do not use HDR to completely equalize the characters and the sea, preserving the exposure difference of natural light. 
Effect: Sea breeze makes the hair flutter, shallow water sways slightly around the legs. Arms or hair can have small movements at the edge from hand tremors. Water surface highlights have slight clipping characteristic of smartphones, and there is slight stretching and lens distortion like an ultra-wide angle around the periphery of the screen. Not cinematic color grading, but color processing close to a standard smartphone camera. 
Camera: Assuming an ultra-wide-angle shot equivalent to 0.5x of a recent smartphone's rear or front camera, field of view 13-16mm equivalent. 9:16 vertical position. The woman on the left fully extends her arm, holding the phone at a position slightly higher than her head, tilting slightly downward toward the two. Due to the close distance of the subject, the foreground arm is extremely enlarged, and the distance between the characters and the sea feels wider than reality. Portrait mode is not used; a smartphone-style depiction with a relatively wide focus from the background to the characters. Exposure is slightly affected by the strong reflection of the water surface, making character shadows slightly dark. 
Imperfections: Shot with one hand extending the phone, so the horizon is slightly tilted by a few degrees, and the center composition is also slightly offset. There is subtle motion blur in the hair part, light noise in dark areas, and slight highlight blowouts on the water surface. Clothes have small folds from the sea breeze and body movements. Shoulder heights, leg angles, hair volume, and clothing positions are not perfectly unified. There is an extremely light texture like JPEG preservation or SNS compression, but no intentional low-quality processing is done. 
Background: Top part of the screen about 40% is the summer sky. Not just blue sky; there is a slightly dark large cumulus cloud above the center, mixed with bright white clouds and blue sky around it. The horizon is placed above the center of the screen, and more than the bottom half is occupied by the shallow sea surface. No large resort facilities or gaudy tropical signs are placed in the distance, establishing it as an ordinary beach. 
Atmosphere: Midsummer air where strong sunlight, moist sea breeze, and the smell of the tide can be imagined. Not a model shoot, but a sudden moment when two friends raise their phones while entering the shallows. Even if the water surface is too bright, the face is covered by hair, or the arm is hugely distorted, there is no reshoot, posting this imperfection as-is to SNS. 
Composition: 9:16 portrait. The horizon is near the top 35-40%. The forearm of the woman on the left appearing huge enters from the bottom center diagonally to the upper left, followed by the left shoulder and head. The woman on the right is in the middle-right, slightly further than the left. The V-sign held high by the woman on the right extends toward the sky and horizon. The faces of the characters are not placed in the center; the screen is composed of the sea, the arm, and the actions of the two. Do not correct the unruly perspective characteristic of ultra-wide angles. 
Photo Quality: Not high-end camera work, but the level of a direct SNS post from a recent smartphone. No background blur, no overly shallow depth of field. Sea, clouds, characters, and distance retain information within the necessary range, coexisting with slight smartphone HDR, highlight blowouts, dark noise, ultra-wide-angle distortion, and a slight sense of compression. 
Negative: Imitation of real people or celebrities' faces, characters who look underage, excessive skin retouching, doll-like faces, plastic-like skin, unrealistic bone structure, extremely exaggerated body proportions, composition with specific body parts as protagonists, perfect posing like advertisement shoots, studio lighting, excessive background blur, excessive HDR, overly vivid turquoise sea like tropical resort advertisements, perfectly tidy hair, symmetrical arrangement of characters, composition shot from a distance by a third party, UI, back icon, search icon, SNS buttons, screenshot frame, text, existing logos, existing watermarks. 
Watermark Direction: Integrate the string '@Live_life_style' as a very low-key signature that exists accidentally in the beach environment from the time of shooting, rather than a logo pasted on later. 
Integration Method: Slender sun reflections and small ripples formed on the shallow water at the bottom of the screen naturally form a shape that can be read as '@Live_life_style' upon close inspection. Not ordinary printed characters or digital subtitles, but a combination of the brightness and darkness of the water surface, fine white reflections, and sand ripples on the seabed forming a character-like shape. 
Subtle Visibility: The watermark is not noticed when first looking at the photo, and only readable upon searching for it. Do not use pure white text brighter than the sea surface, but a contrast equivalent to the surrounding reflections. 
Placement: Toward the bottom right of the screen, but not close to the edge, and not overlaid on the characters' bodies. Placed on the shallow water part sufficiently far from the legs of the woman on the right, not imitating the position of an SNS UI. 
Material Behavior: The character shapes are not complete font outlines; wave fluctuations make line widths slightly uneven, with some parts interrupted or distorted. Appearing through the perspective of seabed sand ripples and water surface reflections. 
Lighting Interaction: Becomes bright as a water surface reflection consistent with the sun's backlight direction, slightly breaking up in the same direction as the surrounding small waves. Do not make flattened text that deviates from shadows or highlights. 
Avoid: Post-pasted white text, thick logos, black outlines, drop shadows, stickers, SNS UI-style display, text directly on the characters' bodies, abnormally legible typography, lighting unrelated to the surroundings.

A charming candid outdoor street-style portrait of a young woman standing outside a cozy café or boutique. She is wearing an oversized red-and-white gingham checkered dress with long puff sleeves, a gathered waist, white decorative trim around the neckline, and small floral embellishments. She stands playfully with one arm extended outward and the other resting near her waist, creating a carefree, joyful pose. Behind her is a rustic storefront with dark gray stone walls, large wooden-framed glass doors, a leafy potted tree, and stone pavement. Soft natural daylight, warm realistic colors, subtle shadows, candid smartphone photography, gentle background blur, cozy Korean street-fashion aesthetic, natural skin texture, slightly dreamy film look, high detail, vertical portrait, 4:5 aspect ratio.

items.title: 现代东方器物编辑风海报提示词

prompts.text:
【Subject】：____
【Core Artifact】：____
【Main Title】：____
【Subtitle】：____
【Main Color】：____
【Continuous Linear Element】：Branches / Water ripples / Slanted lines / Free curves / ____
【Small Area Accent Color】：____

Design a 2:3 vertical Oriental artifact Editorial poster. Use warm ivory white paper, slight fiber and printing grain as the base, combining real artifact photography, Chinese fonts, small English text, line drawings, and a small amount of Oriental graphics.

Maintain medium-to-high information density in the image, but avoid cluttering. Organize the layout with 2–3 main visual blocks and design a "visual thread" running through the frame, connecting the title, artifacts, and auxiliary graphics, allowing elements to interweave: text can be partially obscured by artifacts, lines wrap around the subject, patterns can extend from artifacts to the layout, and light-colored large characters are hidden in the background.

Typography establishes a clear four-level scale: giant visual characters / medium Chinese titles / small English / tiny information text, combined in horizontal, vertical, and staggered arrangements, partially overstepping boundaries but overall controlled by an invisible grid, creating a "disorderly yet orderly" editorial feel.

Artifacts avoid simple centered display; use multi-layer presentation such as complete subject + partial cropping + faint line drawings. Add low-contrast large characters, plant line drawings, artifact outlines, or textures to the background blank areas, so the white space has content but does not overpower the main subject.

The overall style uses low-saturation main colors, adding only one small area of high-recognition accent color for labels, thin lines, or local graphics. The image should be elegant, restrained, and have a sense of modern Oriental cultural design.

Avoid: PPT-style partitioning, elements scattered individually, large areas of empty space without content, simple "artifact + title" placement, template-like logos, numbering, four-pointed stars, excessive "Guochao" decorations.

prompts.text:
【主题】：____
【核心器物】：____
【主标题】：____
【副标题】：____
【主色】：____
【贯穿线性元素】：枝条 / 水纹 / 斜线 / 自由曲线 / ____
【小面积点缀色】：____

设计一张 2:3 竖版东方器物 Editorial 海报。以暖象牙白纸本、轻微纤维与印刷颗粒为底，结合真实器物摄影、中文字体、英文小字、线稿与少量东方图形。

画面保持中高信息密度，但避免堆砌。用 2–3 个主要视觉团块组织版面，并设计一条贯穿画面的“视觉脉络”，连接标题、器物和辅助图形，让元素彼此穿插：文字可被器物局部遮挡，线条绕过主体，纹样可从器物延伸到版面，浅色大字藏在背景中。

Typography 建立明显的四级尺度：巨型视觉字 / 中型中文标题 / 小型英文 / 极小信息文字，横排、竖排和错位组合，局部越界但整体受隐形网格控制，形成“乱中有序”的编辑感。

器物避免简单居中陈列，可使用完整主体 + 局部裁切 + 淡线稿等多层呈现。背景留白区域也加入低对比度的大字、植物线描、器物轮廓或纹理，让留白有内容但不喧宾夺主。

整体采用低饱和主色，只加入一次小面积高识别度点缀色，用于标签、细线或局部图形。画面要优雅、克制、有现代东方文化设计感。

避免：PPT 式分区、元素各自散开、大面积无内容空白、单纯“器物 + 标题”摆放、模板感 Logo、编号、四角星芒、过度国潮装饰。

prompts.text: Create a realistic vertical 9:16 photographed portrait. Subject and action: A single woman seated close to the backdrop, leaning toward the camera while turning toward something off-frame right; her face remains clearly readable at medium portrait scale; Preserve the candid forward hunch, uneven shoulder height, and the abrupt crop through her hands and lower legs. Hair and styling: Render an adult woman's hair as a chin-length rounded bob with a brow-clear side fringe, in natural soft black, only within jaw-to-collarbone bob, lob, or compact-tie geometry. Composition: vertical seated portrait cropped from just above the knees, subject centered slightly low with generous empty headroom; both forearms descend out of the bottom edge. Camera: eye-level camera at conversation distance, natural 50mm portrait-lens feel, straight-on viewpoint. Color and depth relationships: strict monochrome: near-black outfit and deep shadowed torso against a smooth mid-grey background, with pale skin highlights forming the only bright values. Pose: seated with torso leaning forward, shoulders slightly rounded and asymmetrical, upper arms held close to the ribs, elbows bent and forearms angled downward together between the knees beyond the crop; caught mid-laugh with mouth open, upper and lower teeth visible, cheeks raised, and eyes lightly narrowed. Wardrobe: Oversized black tailored blazer with broad lapels, a deep open V neckline, long sleeves, and one dark front button visible; the fabric falls in heavy gravity folds and creases where the arms press toward the torso; Small slim hoop earrings; No shoes, bag, hosiery, or other garments are visible. Setting: plain seamless grey studio backdrop with no props or visible corners. Lighting: single large soft source from upper camera-right, producing gentle cheek and neck modeling, a brighter right side of the backdrop, soft shadow gradients, and no hard-edged cast shadows. Finish: Black-and-white editorial studio photograph with muted mid-grey tones, moderately deep near-black shadows, restrained contrast, soft highlight roll-off, fine film-like grain visible across the backdrop and skin, visible natural pores and faint cheek and under-eye unevenness, mild optical softness with restrained. 色彩：背景沉稳的尘蓝（Dusty Blue）窗帘与墙面的古白（Antique White）、婚纱的纯白象牙白（Ivory），以及新娘明亮的暖粉调皮肤调和的高级经典新娘柔和色盘。

纹理：蕾丝刺绣面料的颗粒立体感、面纱薄纱的细密网状纹理、天鹅绒/亚麻窗帘的丰满织物质感、锁骨和肩膀皮肤的光滑触感，以及高级肖像胶片特有的致密有机细微胶片颗粒（Film Grain）纹理层层生动。

6. [胶片及相机镜头景深、角度]
相机设置：35mm 全画幅肖像相机，85mm f/2.0 人物定焦镜头。

角度及景深：与人物视线高度平行的稳定眼平（Eye-level）特写角度。施以浅景深，将新娘的五官、清澈瞳孔、脸颊光泽和婚纱上部的蕾丝刺绣锐利（Sharp）对焦，微微动作的手部细微动态感和背后室内背景以柔和光学虚化（Bokeh）处理，赋予主体完美的视觉焦点。

7. [背景及布局元素]
背景空间：凸显欧洲风经典室内的高级新娘套房/工作室室内背景。

道具及结构：人物左侧后方有沉重褶皱垂直长长垂下的尘蓝灰（Dusty Sky Blue）色调的丰满窗帘，右侧后方配置细致雕刻和垂直沟槽（Fluted）造型的古白护墙板墙面，完成整洁浪漫的室内氛围。

prompts.text:
Let the future theme first be carried by a low-saturation, nearly grayscale narrative image as the main subject: consisting of fine and slightly dry line drawings, light ink blocks, and restrained paper negative space, forming a scene with a sense of history but without beautification. At first glance, it must be oversized black text overlapping, cropping, and interspersing with the image: the title is not just information, but a structural black block that weighs down the screen; some characters are cropped out of the frame, and some are vertically or horizontally misaligned, forming strong reading tension and an asymmetrical axis. Let the text and image share similar printing blackness and slight edge unevenness, making the two systems invade each other as if on the same piece of paper; the typeface adopts a modern sans-serif geometric skeleton, with clear contrast in stroke thickness, clean corners, large and stable inner space, straight endpoints, letter spacing pulled apart and locally compressed, and intersecting horizontal and vertical reading directions while still retaining a clear rhythm of recognition. The main image subject is placed in the middle and background, repeatedly divided by giant characters, fine lines, and local circular markers; circles, numbered small text, narrow column descriptions, and edge annotations serve only as sparse cues of order, not spread evenly. The screen retains large areas of blank space, a light gray background, and black anchors, with minimal use of cold gray or faded hues locally, avoiding vivid colors, gradients, gloss, and commercial retouching. Let the composition look like it has undergone rigorous editing yet retains the tiny misalignments of manual layout, paper ink absorption, and slight overprinting differences; details are clear but not smooth, and line drawings, text, and background colors all obey the same set of restrained physical printing relationships.

——————

Create a theme poster for an urban memory archive exhibition for a public cultural space: using cold ink blue-gray as the only faded hue, with giant black characters and light gray paper forming a cold contrast; let a set of fine block line drawings travel from the bottom left to the top right of the frame, with a large area of quiet white space reserved on the right, and circular markers appearing sparsely along the visual path. The main title is placed in the upper middle of the right side, using vertical oversized characters that are cropped out of the frame; narrow column date and location information is close to the bottom edge but kept restrained; the aspect ratio is vertical 3:4

prompts.text:
让未来主题先由一幅低饱和、近乎灰白的叙事性图像承担主体：以细密而略带干涩的线描、淡墨块面和克制的纸面留白，构成具有历史感但不被美化的场景。第一眼必须是超大号黑色文字与图像发生遮挡、切边和穿插：标题不只是信息，而是压过画面的结构性黑块，部分字被裁出画外，部分字竖直或横向错位，形成强烈的阅读张力与不对称轴线。让文字和图像共享近似的印刷黑度与轻微边缘不匀，使两套系统像在同一张纸上互相侵入；字形采用现代无衬线的几何骨架，笔画粗细对比明确，转角干净，内空间大而稳定，端点平直，字距被拉开又被局部压缩，横竖阅读方向交错但仍保留清晰的识别节奏。图像主体置于中后景，被巨字、细线和局部圆形标记反复切分；圆环、编号感小字、窄栏说明和边缘注释只作为稀疏的秩序线索，不要平均铺满。画面保留大块空白、浅灰背景与黑色锚点，局部使用极少的冷灰或褪色色相，避免鲜艳配色、渐变、光泽和商业化润饰。让构图像经过严谨编辑却保留手工排版的微小错位、纸张吸墨和套印轻差；细节清楚但不光滑，线描、文字和底色都服从同一套克制的物理印刷关系。


——————
为城市记忆档案展制作一张面向公共文化空间的主题海报：以冷墨蓝灰为唯一褪色色相，黑色巨字与浅灰纸面形成冷峻对照；让一组细密街区线描从画面左下向右上穿行，右侧保留大块安静留白，圆环标记沿视觉路径稀疏出现。主标题置于右侧中上部，采用竖排超大字并切出画框，窄栏日期与地点信息贴近下缘但保持克制；画幅为竖版 3:4

prompts.text:

Palette: [background / type / outfit]

Create a high-fashion editorial poster where oversized typography becomes part of the physical composition, not just text placed behind the model.

Make the figure and type share the same space through clear front/back occlusion: let parts of the letter sit behind the body, other parts cross in front, and let the figure or fabric break through the type.

Use one dominant letter or word occupying roughly 50–75% of the frame. Keep the model realistic, with natural skin texture, refined couture styling, strong silhouette, and expressive fabric movement.

Keep the palette restrained to 2–4 main colors. Add only a few small editorial text elements for hierarchy and atmosphere.

The key is: type should act as space — a portal, layer, frame, or motion structure — rather than a background graphic.

Minimal layout, strong negative space, premium fashion photography, realistic fabric and lighting, no logos, no numbering, no decorative sparkles.

prompts.text: Create a realistic vertical 9:16 photographed portrait. Subject and action: an adult woman poses alone close to the camera in the booth, leaning diagonally with one arm bent above her head, meeting the lens through her sunglasses with pursed lips. Hair and styling: Render an adult woman's hair as a shoulder-length lob worn straight with the face open, in cool dark brown, only within jaw-to-collarbone bob, lob, or compact-tie geometry. Composition: Tight vertical chest-up nightclub snapshot, an adult woman filling the right and center of the frame with her near shoulder and lower torso cropped by the bottom edge; head close to the upper-right edge, slightly crooked framing, close phone-camera distance with mild wide-angle. Camera: Eye-level handheld phone shot at intimate arm's-length distance, deep focus, rough early-camera-phone rendering. Pose: Upper body angled diagonally toward the camera with one shoulder closest to the lens; torso leaning slightly left into the frame; One arm is lifted overhead with the elbow bent and the hand resting loosely on the crown, while the other arm stays below the crop; Looking directly through oversized sunglasses toward the camera; lips pushed forward into a small kiss shape, cheeks relaxed. Wardrobe: Courreges black knit mini dress with a close sleeveless silhouette; the shoulder line sits slightly unevenly from the raised arm, the knit pulls gently across the torso, and the hem remains outside the tight crop; Courreges black knit mini dress, white low sneakers. Setting: Dark nightclub booth or lounge corner with deep burgundy-red padded wall panels and narrow vertical warm-orange reflections behind her; background mostly falls into black. Lighting: Harsh direct on-camera flash lights the face and near shoulder unevenly while the room remains underexposed; dim red-orange ambient light leaks around the edges, with clipped facial highlights and crushed background shadows. Finish: Low-resolution mid-2000s phone-club snapshot with a greenish-yellow cast in the flash-lit skin, dirty burgundy-red ambient contamination, coarse chroma noise, visible grain sitting on the skin, slight oil shine and visible pores on the cheeks and nose, oversharpened edges, smeared shadow detail, clipped flash. Rendering constraints: keep the exact crop, body-to-camera relationship, hand task, gaze direction, light direction, foreground obstruction, and background placement; preserve believable anatomy and natural hands; avoid beauty-filter skin, studio-clean restaging, generic fashion posing, text, logos, borders, and watermarks.

prompts.text: 创建一个真实的垂直 9:16 摄影肖像。主体与动作：一位成年女性在展位里靠近摄像机独自摆姿势，斜向倚靠，一只手臂弯曲在头顶上方，透过太阳镜噘起嘴唇注视镜头。发型与造型：将成年女性的头发渲染为齐肩长的 lob 头，直发，露出面部，冷深褐色，仅限于下巴到锁骨的 bob、lob 或紧凑扎发的几何形状。构图：紧凑的垂直胸部以上夜店快照，一位成年女性占据画面的右侧和中心，近处的肩膀和下躯干被底部边缘裁剪；头部靠近右上边缘，构图略微歪斜，近距离手机摄像头距离，带有轻微广角。相机：眼平手持手机拍摄，亲密的臂长距离，深焦，粗糙的早期手机摄像头渲染。姿势：上身斜对相机，一个肩膀最靠近镜头；躯干向左轻微倾斜进入画面；一只手臂举过头顶，肘部弯曲，手松散地落在头顶，另一只手臂保持在裁剪范围下方；直接透过大号太阳镜注视相机；嘴唇向前推成一个小吻的形状，脸颊放松。衣着：Courreges 黑色针织迷你裙，紧身无袖廓形；肩线因举起的手臂而略显不平，针织面料在躯干上轻轻拉紧，裙摆留在紧凑裁剪范围外；Courreges 黑色针织迷你裙，白色低帮运动鞋。场景：黑暗的夜店展位或酒廊角落，带有深酒红色的衬垫墙板，身后有狭窄的垂直暖橙色反射；背景大部分没入黑色。光影：强烈的直接机载闪光灯不均匀地照亮面部和近处肩膀，而房间保持曝光不足；昏暗的红橙色环境光在边缘泄漏，面部高光溢出，背景阴影深黑。修饰：低分辨率的 2000 年代中期手机夜店快照，闪光灯照射下的皮肤带有绿黄色调，脏兮兮的酒红色环境污染，粗糙的色度噪声，皮肤上可见颗粒，脸颊和鼻子上可见油光和毛孔，边缘过度锐化，阴影细节模糊，闪光灯溢出。渲染约束：保持确切的裁剪、身体与相机的关系、手部动作、注视方向、光线方向、前景遮挡和背景放置；保留可信的解剖结构和自然的手部；避免美颜滤镜皮肤、工作室洁净重置、通用的时尚摆拍、文字、标志、边框和水印。

items.title: 操作系统式作品集编辑海报设计

prompts.text: Design a 3:4 vertical "OS-style portfolio" editorial poster for [Personal Portfolio / Design Agency / Brand Project / Creative Team]. Use a deep graphite black background overall to establish a professional workstation-like interface order, but do not copy any specific brand's OS interface. Set a very narrow status bar at the top, sequentially placing: Brand Name / Current City / Date / Time / Online Status. Set a project directory area on the left, occupying about 30%—35% of the frame, with 6—8 project names listed consecutively. Each project includes: a short title and a one-sentence achievement description of no more than 12 words. Present the only activated core project on the right, occupying about 50%—55% of the frame. Use a single high-impact full visual image as the main visual, which can be a person, product, space, brand result, or key project visual. Do not split it into a thumbnail grid. The currently activated project should be highlighted in the left directory using reverse color, underline, or a single accent color, and establish a clear correspondence with the right main visual through a thin path, fine line, or positioning relationship. Add third-level auxiliary information at the bottom: Project Year, Service Type, File Status. Typography system: Use compact geometric sans-serif for main titles; neutral sans-serif for directory descriptions; monospaced fonts for time, numbers, and status. Color palette limited to: Charcoal Black, Warm White, Cold Gray, and one project accent color [Signal Orange / Cobalt Blue / Acid Green / Cold Purple]. The accent color area should not exceed 6%. Overall vibe like: Creative studio backend, digital archive, cultural magazine cover, mature proposal system. Avoid: Mimicking computer screenshots, stacked windows, complex icons, neon code rain, uniform card arrays, multiple images of equal size, cheap tech aesthetics.

items.title: 超高级混合旅游时尚插画海报

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium hybrid travel-fashion campaign poster that merges Orbit-style interaction enhancement with Transit-style international editorial polish, centered around one unforgettable three-part super-symbol: the same hand-drawn girl, four real scenic destinations, and four distinctly playful pose-actions. The composition must be a clean 2x2 four-panel grid. In every panel, the girl is fully illustrated by hand in the exact same character design and fashion identity, while everything else is completely real and photographic. The final artwork must feel like a Cannes-level global travel editorial campaign: stylish, witty, vibrant, highly shareable, and flawlessly integrated. Do not copy any existing title, slogan, or text.

Core super-symbol composition:
Build the entire image around one instantly readable visual equation:
1. one identical illustrated travel girl,
2. four different real-world scenic environments,
3. four clearly different fun travel poses.
Use a strict 2x2 grid with clean borders and strong panel balance. Each panel must feel distinct in location and action, but the whole poster must remain unified through the same illustrated character, the same drawing language, and a consistent premium travel-fashion tone. The viewer should understand the concept immediately at a glance.

Character consistency:
Use one iconic hand-drawn girl repeated across all four panels with exactly the same face logic, hair color, illustration style, body proportions, outline treatment, and fashion identity. She should feel youthful-adult, stylish, playful, and highly brandable, with bold colored hair, oversized fashion accessories or expressive stylized eyes, graphic clothing, and chunky fashion shoes. She must never drift into four different character designs. She is one same visual mascot traveling through four real destinations.

Real-vs-illustrated rule:
The girl is the only illustrated element. Everything else must be real photography: streets, buildings, beaches, railings, terraces, trees, mountains, paving, sea, sky, cafes, sunlight, shadows, textures, reflections, and environment details. The contrast must be crisp and intentional: one drawn girl inside four completely real locations.

Orbit enhancement:
Push the physical interaction much harder. The illustrated girl must feel truly grounded and physically present in each real location. Her feet must align perfectly with real pavement, sand, stairs, wood decks, or stone floors. Her body tilt, arm direction, and stride must react to the real perspective and gravity of each location. Add stronger contact logic: foot planting, edge overlap, partial occlusion, perspective scaling, and scene-matched cast shadows. She must look like she is genuinely walking, leaning, sitting, posing, or balancing inside the real scene, not pasted on top.

Transit enhancement:
Refine the whole image into an international top-tier travel editorial language. Unify the four locations with polished global color grading, cleaner air, brighter but controlled highlights, and premium retouching. The real scenes should feel luminous, cinematic, and magazine-ready. The illustrated girl’s palette should be vivid but sophisticated, harmonized with the real environments. The final image should feel like a luxury fashion-travel collaboration, not a casual social collage.

Four-scene narrative:
Panel 1: a real sunlit residential or city street with trees and long afternoon shadows; the illustrated girl strides confidently forward holding a drink, as if on a stylish daily walk.
Panel 2: a real seaside boardwalk, promenade, or beach overlook; the illustrated girl leans into the coastal breeze with playful vacation energy, one leg lifted or body tilted in a fun pose.
Panel 3: a real scenic terrace, mountain overlook, rooftop viewpoint, or historic street; the illustrated girl pauses in a curious sightseeing pose, looking outward or gesturing toward the landscape.
Panel 4: a real colorful travel spot such as a cafe frontage, tropical walkway, urban plaza, or landmark corner; the illustrated girl performs the most playful pose of the set, such as a hop, twirl, sit-pose, or exaggerated fashion stance.
All four actions must be clearly different and instantly legible.

Illustration style:
Use premium hand-drawn fashion-cartoon illustration with bold black outlines, high-quality flat color blocks, controlled retro-pop charm, and slight editorial exaggeration. The girl should feel polished, fashionable, and premium. You may add only a very small amount of hand-drawn accent marks such as stars, sparkles, motion marks, or doodle waves around her, but keep them restrained so the core symbol remains: drawn girl inside real places.

Lighting integration:
The illustrated girl must adapt perfectly to the real lighting in each panel. If the scene has golden side light, cool ocean reflection, soft mountain haze, or urban shadow, the drawing must reflect the same light direction, shadow edge, and color temperature. This is essential. Her highlights and shadows must match each real location so the integration feels seamless and luxury-grade.

Color system:
Use a polished travel-editorial palette built from real environmental tones plus the girl’s iconic fashion colors. Her outfit may combine sunshine yellow, turquoise, coral, pink, fresh green, cobalt, or sky blue, but the tones must be refined and internationally stylish. The four real locations should each retain their own atmosphere while still belonging to one unified campaign color world.

Typography and layout:
If title-like graphic elements are used, keep them minimal, original, hand-drawn, and integrated across the four-panel poster as premium editorial decoration only. Do not copy any wording from the reference. Preserve enough negative space so the grid stays elegant and readable.

Image finish:
The final artwork must feel like a world-class hybrid travel-fashion campaign: iconic, crisp, witty, internationally polished, and highly memorable. Preserve photoreal clarity in the four real scenic locations, perfect character consistency in the illustrated girl, and impeccable integration across all four panels. 8k, flagship advertising quality.

Mood:
playful, stylish, travel-loving, iconic, editorial, vibrant, premium, globally polished, witty, fashionable, highly shareable

Rendering style:
ultra-premium hybrid travel-fashion campaign, Orbit-style scene interaction enhancement, Transit-style global editorial polish, same illustrated girl across four real scenic locations, four distinct playful poses, flawless illustration-to-reality integration, world-class advertising art direction, 8k

Negative prompt:
realistic human character, inconsistent illustrated girl design, different face in each panel, fake background, pasted sticker effect, floating feet, wrong perspective, weak shadows, copied text, brand logos, messy grid, childish clip-art style, low-detail illustration, dirty image, black blotches, low-resolution environment

prompts.text:
创建一个超高级的混合旅游时尚活动海报，将 Orbit 风格的交互增强与 Transit 风格的国际社论修饰相结合，围绕一个令人难忘的三部分超级符号展开：同一个手绘女孩、四个真实的风景目的地和四个截然不同的俏皮姿势动作。构图必须是一个干净的 2x2 四格网格。在每个面板中，女孩完全由手工绘制，具有完全相同的角色设计和时尚身份，而其他一切都是完全真实的摄影。最终的艺术作品必须感觉像是一场戛纳级别的全球旅游社论活动：时尚、风趣、充满活力、极具分享性且完美融合。不要复制任何现有的标题、标语或文本。

核心超级符号构图：
围绕一个一眼就能看懂的视觉等式构建整个图像：
1. 一个完全相同的插画旅游女孩，
2. 四个不同的现实世界风景环境，
3. 四个明显不同的有趣旅游姿势。
使用带有干净边界和强大面板平衡的严格 2x2 网格。每个面板在位置和动作上必须感觉截然不同，但整个海报必须通过相同的插画角色、相同的绘画语言和一致的高级旅游时尚基调保持统一。观众应该一眼就能立即理解这个概念。

角色一致性：
使用一个标志性的手绘女孩，在所有四个面板中重复，具有完全相同的面部逻辑、发色、插画风格、身体比例、轮廓处理和时尚身份。她应该感觉年轻、时尚、俏皮且极具品牌感，拥有大胆的有色头发、夸张的时尚配饰或表现力强的程式化眼睛、图形化的服装和笨重的时尚鞋子。她绝对不能漂移成四种不同的角色设计。她是同一个在四个真实目的地旅行的视觉吉祥物。

真实与插画规则：
女孩是唯一的插画元素。其他一切都必须是真实的摄影：街道、建筑、海滩、栏杆、露台、树木、山脉、铺路、大海、天空、咖啡馆、阳光、阴影、纹理、反射和环境细节。对比必须清晰且有目的：四个完全真实的地点中的一个绘画女孩。

Orbit 增强：
更用力地推动物理交互。插画女孩在每个真实地点必须感觉真实落地且具有物理存在感。她的脚必须与真实的铺路、沙子、楼梯、木甲板或石地板完美对齐。她的身体倾斜、手臂方向和步幅必须对每个位置的真实透视和重力做出反应。增加更强的接触逻辑：脚部着地、边缘重叠、部分遮挡、透视缩放和与场景匹配的投射阴影。她必须看起来像是在真实场景中真实地行走、斜靠、坐着、摆姿势或平衡，而不是粘贴在上面。

Transit 增强：
将整个图像细化为国际顶级的旅游社论语言。通过精致的全球分级调色、更干净的空气、明亮但受控的高光和高级修图来统一四个位置。真实场景应该感觉明亮、电影化且具备杂志品质。插画女孩的色调应该是生动但成熟的，并与真实环境和谐统一。最终图像应该感觉像是一次奢侈时尚与旅游的合作，而不是随意的社交媒体拼贴。

四场景叙事：
面板 1：一条真实的阳光明媚的住宅或城市街道，有树木和漫长的午后阴影；插画女孩拿着饮料自信地向前迈进，仿佛在进行一次时尚的日常漫步。
面板 2：一个真实的海滨木板路、长廊或海滩观景台；插画女孩带着俏皮的度假活力斜靠在海风中，一条腿抬起或身体倾斜，摆出一个有趣的姿势。
面板 3：一个真实的风景露台、山顶俯瞰、屋顶观景点或历史街道；插画女孩以好奇的观光姿势停下来，向外看或向风景做手势。
面板 4：一个真实的彩色旅游点，如咖啡馆门面、热带步道、城市广场或地标角落；插画女孩进行这组动作中最俏皮的姿势，例如跳跃、旋转、坐姿或夸张的时尚站姿。
所有四个动作必须明显不同且瞬间可辨。

插画风格：
使用高级手绘时尚卡通插画，带有粗黑轮廓、高质量平涂色块、受控的复古流行魅力和轻微的社论夸张感。女孩应该感觉精致、时尚且高级。你可以在她周围只添加极少量的手绘点缀标记，如星星、闪烁、运动标记或涂鸦波浪，但要保持克制，以便核心符号保持不变：真实场景中的绘画女孩。

光影融合：
插画女孩必须完美适应每个面板中的真实光照。如果场景有金色侧光、冷色海洋反射、柔和的山雾或城市阴影，绘画必须反映相同的光线方向、阴影边缘和色温。这是必不可少的。她的高光和阴影必须与每个真实地点匹配，以便融合感觉天衣无缝且达到奢侈品级别。

色彩系统：
使用基于真实环境色调加上女孩标志性时尚色彩的精致旅游社论调色板。她的服装可以结合阳光黄、青绿色、珊瑚色、粉红色、清新绿、钴蓝色或天蓝色，但色调必须精致且具有国际时尚感。四个真实地点应各自保留自己的氛围，同时仍属于一个统一的活动色彩世界。

排版与布局：
如果使用了类似标题的图形元素，请保持它们极简、原创、手绘，并作为高级社论装饰整合在四格海报中。不要复制参考资料中的任何措辞。保留足够的负空间，使网格保持优雅和易读。

图像完成度：
最终艺术作品必须感觉像是一场世界级的混合旅游时尚活动：标志性、清晰、机智、国际精炼且令人难忘。在四个真实风景位置保持照片般的真实感，在插画女孩中保持完美的人物一致性，并在所有四个面板中实现无可挑剔的融合。8k，旗舰广告品质。

情绪：
俏皮，时尚，热爱旅游，标志性，社论感，充满活力，高级，全球精炼，机智，时髦，极具分享性

渲染风格：
超高级混合旅游时尚竞选，Orbit 风格场景交互增强，Transit 风格全球社论修饰，四个真实风景位置中同一个插画女孩，四个截然不同的俏皮姿势，完美的插画与现实融合，世界级广告美术指导，8k

负面提示词：
写实人类角色，不一致的插画女孩设计，每个面板不同的脸，假背景，贴纸效果，悬浮的脚，错误的透视，微弱的阴影，复制的文本，品牌徽标，混乱的网格，幼稚的剪贴画风格，低细节插画，肮脏的图像，黑色污迹，低分辨率环境

Theme: [your own theme]
Main title: [TITLE]
Subject: [young adult woman / character description]

Pose & props: [pose + 2–3 themed props]
Main color: [color]
Accent color: [color]
Cover lines: [2–4 short editorial lines]

Create a 9:16 cute youth magazine cover with a clean white or soft cream graphic background.

Use one young adult character as the main photographic subject, framed in a 3/4 body composition with natural skin texture, expressive eyes, relaxed body language, and a lively candid feel.

Place an oversized glossy bubble title across the upper 30–38% of the poster. The letters should feel soft, inflated and playful, with bold outlines, subtle offset shadows, curved white highlights, and slight hand-drawn irregularity. Let the character naturally overlap part of the title.

Behind the character, add one large organic graphic shape in the secondary color to build depth without creating a realistic environment.

Keep the editorial information clear and moderate: use only 3–4 small text areas, with strong contrast between the huge display title and tiny supporting typography.

Add 6–10 lightweight graphic accents such as dots, curves, open frames, checker patterns, brush marks, brackets or simple hand-drawn icons. Keep them playful but visually controlled.

Use only 2–3 real props related to the theme. Let props communicate the story instead of building a full realistic scene.

Overall look: sweet, youthful, playful, polished, graphic editorial, visually rich but never cluttered.

在海报上方 30–38% 的位置放置一个超大的光泽气泡标题。字体应感觉柔软、膨胀且俏皮，具有粗轮廓、细微的偏移阴影、弯曲的白色高光和轻微的手绘不规则感。让角色自然地遮挡部分标题。

在角色身后，添加一个辅助色的巨大有机图形形状，以增加深度，但不创建写实环境。

保持编辑信息清晰且适度：仅使用 3–4 个小文本区域，巨大的显示标题与微小的辅助版式之间形成强烈对比。

添加 6–10 个轻量级图形装饰，如点、曲线、开口框架、棋盘格图案、笔触、括号或简单的手绘图标。保持它们的俏皮感，但在视觉上加以控制。

仅使用 2–3 个与主题相关的真实道具。让道具传达故事，而不是构建一个完整的写实场景。

古建筑木梁、立柱和墙壁隐没于阴影中，背景浅景深虚化，仅保留窗棂几何纹样。

prompts.text:
Subject:
Orchid and Mirror Flower Gallery

Main Subject:
A young adult woman standing in a mirrored greenhouse corridor, with countless orchids and greenery hanging from above. Place the figure's full body slightly to the left of the center of the frame, presenting the repeatedly reflected flowers, leaves, and the reflections of the long legs on the surrounding surfaces and ground as broad main protagonists.

Person · Expression:
Small oval face, bright and smooth skin, deep brown pupils, detailed natural eyebrows, small nose bridge, light coral lips. Face directly to the camera, mouth closed in a soft smile. Fresh makeup with thin eyeliner, long eyelashes, and light pink blush. Loose wavy dark brown long hair reaching below the chest, front bangs neatly stopping above the eyebrows, long hair bundles naturally falling to both shoulders.

Clothing · Pose:
A white thin-strap top with a heart-shaped neckline and diagonal overlapping pleats, a light beige form-fitting mini skirt with small overlaps on the right hem. Thin-strap light beige high-heeled sandals, a small light beige handbag hanging on the left shoulder. Standing with legs almost together, right hand pulling the handbag strap to the chest, left arm hanging naturally. One foot slightly forward.

Background · Lighting:
The entire frame is covered with dense green orchid leaves and aerial roots, as well as small white, light peach, purple, and yellow flowers. The left and right walls and floor are mirrors with visible seams, with layered reflections continuing deep in the center, and a silver slender handrail extending to the back right. The glass ceiling above and scattered white light sources cast bright diffused light, evenly illuminating the person and the leaves. Mirrored reflected light makes shadows extremely soft.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 3:4. A slightly distant full-body portrait captured from a horizontal lens slightly below the chest. The upper body of the person is placed in the upper-center position, and the lower body includes the inverted legs and flower reflections extending on the mirrored floor starting from the feet, occupying a large space. Leave enough space for dense flowers above the head and on the left and right. Focus on the character, while the mirror gallery and flowers also maintain a deep depth of field to show details.

Texture · Style:
A high-definition realistic photograph taken under bright greenhouse light. Realistic depiction of skin, hair strands, white top pleats, smooth skirt hem, leather handbag, leaf luster, petals, mirror seams, and clear reflections. White and pastel flower colors are scattered in deep green, avoiding mirror flaws or illustration styles.

Negative Prompt:
Modifications to person, clothing, full-body reflection on the mirrored floor, and flower density.

items.title: 顶级旗舰甜品KV奶油旋涡动感视觉海报

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium global flagship dessert KV that preserves the reference image's slightly top-down commercial perspective while merging Port-style iconic product totem clarity with Orbit-style structural drama: one original branded dessert cup placed in the lower center of a tall vertical frame, viewed from a slightly elevated overhead angle, with a powerful sculptural vortex of silky vanilla cream erupting upward from the cup in one continuous central-axis motion and expanding into a bold premium cream crown in the upper half of the composition. Around this central cream structure, suspend glossy caramel rings, chocolate-coated wafer bites, crisp biscuit fragments, and fine crumb particles in a controlled orbital rhythm. The final image must feel like an international flagship dessert campaign: iconic, highly legible, premium, globally marketable, physically believable, and irresistibly edible. Do not copy any real brand name, logo, slogan, or packaging text.

Core composition:
Use a strict centered vertical composition with the cup as the absolute brand anchor and hero object. The camera must look slightly downward from above, clearly revealing the opening of the cup and the top surface of the dessert inside, matching the spatial logic of the reference. From this cup opening, build a tall cream vortex rising directly along the center axis. The structure must feel clean, iconic, and immediately readable from a distance, like a flagship billboard visual. The upper cream formation should bloom outward with controlled asymmetry into a crown-like splash, creating monumentality without losing elegance.

Port enhancement:
Treat the cup as a brand totem. Its silhouette must be clean, strong, and instantly recognizable, with bold original red-and-ivory graphic blocking, simple abstract insignia placement, and a polished premium fast-dessert identity. The cup should feel more iconic than decorative, more global than playful, and more flagship than casual. Keep all branding fictional, minimal, and non-readable. The cup-to-vortex relationship must feel like a complete visual logo system.

Orbit enhancement:
Increase the structural tension and upward lift of the dessert spiral. The cream column should feel more dynamic, tensile, and sculptural, with stronger vertical acceleration and a more dramatic expansion near the top. Caramel ribbons should wrap around the cream in elegant elliptical orbits with clear spatial layering. Wafer bites and crumbs should follow a deliberate rising trajectory, as if drawn into a refined dessert cyclone. The result should feel explosive in shape design but still controlled, luxurious, and commercially disciplined.

Natural silky texture:
This is essential. The cream must look naturally silky, dense, whipped, and aerated, with realistic extrusion ridges, soft folds, rounded peaks, and convincing gravity. No hard splash simulation, no synthetic foam, no plastic CGI edges. The caramel must feel smooth, glossy, elastic, and luxurious, with believable viscosity and subtle thickness variation. The chocolate coating must feel rich and premium with a satin gloss, never waxy or fake. Every edible surface must feel touchable, fresh, and physically correct.

Lighting and flagship gloss:
Use sophisticated high-end studio lighting with a warm top-front key light, soft lateral fill, and refined specular accents. The highlights must feel clean, international, and premium-retouched, especially on the caramel rings, chocolate shells, and selected cream ridges. The gloss treatment should elevate the image into a flagship global advertising language: polished, controlled, appetizing, and luxurious, never greasy, never cheap, never over-rendered.

Material rendering:
Render the cream with ultra-detailed whipped texture and subtle micro-air structure. Render caramel as translucent amber-gold with elegant reflections and believable drag. Render chocolate-coated wafer bars with realistic milk-chocolate shells, crisp wafer layering, and creamy filling. Crumbs should vary naturally in size and position, showing toasted biscuit realism. The cup should have matte-coated printed paper texture with slight premium finish and clean edge definition.

Color system:
Use an internationally appealing premium dessert palette: vanilla ivory, soft cream white, caramel amber, toasted biscuit gold, milk-chocolate brown, copper warmth, and a refined mocha-caramel gradient background. The red-and-ivory cup graphics should add strong commercial identity, but remain fully original and non-readable. The overall palette should feel warm, indulgent, premium, modern, and globally marketable.

Background and cleanliness:
Use a smooth warm caramel-to-mocha studio backdrop with a subtle center glow behind the vortex. Keep the environment immaculate and minimal. Only a light field of micro-crumbs and tiny suspended particles should remain to support depth and appetite appeal. No clutter, no spoon, no table, no extra packaging, no redundant props.

Camera and framing:
Maintain the slightly top-down perspective throughout. The cup opening must be visible, the first folds of cream must read clearly, and the vortex must remain fully legible from cup to crown. Use a premium poster-ready framing with strong negative space, clean silhouette separation, and immediate product recognition.

iconic, flagship, silky, sculptural, craveable, polished, indulgent, globally premium, youthful, luxurious, high-end commercial

Rendering style:

prompts.text:
创建一个超高端全球旗舰甜品KV，保留参考图的微俯视商业视角，同时融合Port风格的标志性产品图腾清晰度与Orbit风格的结构戏剧感：一个原创品牌甜品杯放置在长方形构图的下中心，从略微抬高的俯视角度观看，一股强大的丝滑香草奶油雕塑感旋涡从杯中沿单一连续中轴运动向上喷发，并在构图的上半部分扩展成大胆的高级奶油冠冕。在这个中心奶油结构周围，以受控的轨道律动悬浮着光泽焦糖环、巧克力涂层威化块、酥脆饼干碎和精细的碎屑颗粒。最终图像必须感觉像是国际旗舰甜品广告：标志性、高度清晰、高端、具有全球市场活力、物理真实且令人无法抗拒地垂涎。不要复制任何真实的品牌名称、标志、标语或包装文本。

核心构图：
使用严格的居中垂直构图，以杯子作为绝对的品牌锚点和英雄物体。相机必须从上方略微向下看，清晰地展示杯口和内部甜品的顶面，符合参考图的空间逻辑。从这个杯口开始，沿着中心轴直接建立一个高耸的奶油旋涡。结构必须感觉整洁、具有标志性，并且在远处立即可读，就像旗舰看板视觉效果。上部的奶油形态应以受控的不对称性向外绽放成冠状喷溅，在不失优雅的情况下营造出宏伟感。

Port增强：
将杯子视为品牌图腾。其轮廓必须整洁、强有力且能立即识别，具有大胆的原创红象牙白图形块、简单的抽象徽章位置和精致的高级快消甜品身份。杯子应该感觉比装饰性更具标志性，比俏皮更具全球化，比旗舰感更强。保持所有品牌均为虚构、简约且不可读。杯子与旋涡的关系必须感觉像一个完整的视觉标志系统。

Orbit增强：
增加甜品螺旋的结构张力和向上提升感。奶油柱应该感觉更具动感、韧性和雕塑感，具有更强的垂直加速度和顶部更戏剧性的扩张。焦糖丝带应以优雅的椭圆轨道包裹奶油，具有清晰的空间层次感。威化块和碎屑应遵循刻意上升的轨迹，仿佛被吸入一个精致的甜品气旋中。结果应在形状设计上感觉具有爆发力，但仍受控、豪华且具有商业纪律。

自然丝滑质感：
这是必不可少的。奶油必须看起来自然丝滑、浓郁、打发过且充气，具有真实的挤压棱角、柔和的褶皱、圆润的尖端和令人信服的重力感。没有硬喷溅模拟，没有合成泡沫，没有塑料CGI边缘。焦糖必须感觉光滑、有光泽、有弹性且豪华，具有可信的黏度和微妙的厚度变化。巧克力涂层必须感觉浓郁且高端，带有缎面光泽，绝不显蜡质或虚假。每个食用表面都必须感觉可触及、新鲜且物理正确。

灯光与旗舰光泽：
使用精致的高端影棚灯光，配备温暖的顶前主光、柔和的侧向补光和精细的镜面高光。高光必须感觉整洁、国际化且经过高级修饰，特别是在焦糖环、巧克力壳和选定的奶油棱角上。光泽处理应将图像提升到旗舰全球广告语言：精致、受控、诱人且豪华，绝不油腻，绝不廉价，绝不渲染过度。

材质渲染：
将奶油渲染出超详细的打发纹理和微妙的微气孔结构。将焦糖渲染为半透明的琥珀金，具有优雅的反射和可信的拖拽感。将巧克力涂层威化棒渲染为真实的牛奶巧克力外壳、酥脆的威化分层和奶油内芯。碎屑的大小和位置应自然变化，展现烘烤饼干的现实感。杯子应具有哑光涂层印刷纸纹理，具有轻微的高级质感和整洁的边缘定义。

色彩系统：
使用具有国际吸引力的高级甜品色调：香草象牙色、柔和的奶油白、焦糖琥珀色、烤饼干金色、牛奶巧克力棕、铜色温暖，以及精致的摩卡焦糖渐变背景。红象牙白杯子图形应增加强烈的商业身份，但保持完全原创且不可读。整体色调应感觉温暖、放纵、高端、现代且具有全球市场价值。

背景与整洁度：
使用光滑温暖的焦糖到摩卡影棚背景，旋涡后方有微妙的中心发光。保持环境洁净且简约。应只保留一片轻微的微碎屑和微小悬浮颗粒场，以支持深度和食欲吸引力。没有杂乱，没有勺子，没有桌子，没有额外的包装，没有冗余的道具。

相机与构图：
始终保持微俯视视角。杯口必须可见，奶油的第一道褶皱必须读得清楚，旋涡从杯子到冠冕必须保持完全清晰。使用适合海报的高级构图，具有强烈的负空间、整洁的轮廓分离和即时的产品识别度。

氛围：
标志性的，旗舰的，丝滑的，雕塑感的，令人垂涎的，精致的，放纵的，全球高端的，年轻的，豪华的，高端商业的

渲染风格：
超高端甜品广告摄影，全球旗舰快消甜品KV，微俯视英雄镜头，标志性杯子图腾，雕塑感奶油旋涡，自然丝滑流动，优雅的焦糖轨道环，高级巧克力威化碎片，精细的国际光泽，世界级修饰，8k

负面提示词：
平视镜头，低角度镜头，真实品牌名称，复制的标志，可读的标语，杂乱的喷溅，虚假的CGI奶油，塑料感巧克力，油腻的高光，混乱的碎屑，杯子存在感弱，杂乱的背景，细节低下的威化，肮脏的阴影，廉价的快餐感，扭曲的透视，过度饱和的色彩

items.title: 当代艺术出版物视觉文化展览海报设计

prompts.text:
Design a 9:16 vertical cultural exhibition poster with an overall contemporary Editorial Graphic Design / art publication visual.

【Theme】: ____
【Chinese Title】: ____
【English Title】: ____
【Key Visual】: ____
【Auxiliary Pattern】: ____
【Primary Color】: ____
【Secondary Color】: ____
【Date / Institution】: ____

Corely use "diagonal potential energy" composition, but do not directly draw obvious diagonal lines.

First determine a hidden diagonal visual axis, letting the visual weight of the key visual, Chinese title, patterns, date information, and white space progress step by step along the same direction.

The key visual bears the main weight; large Chinese titles must participate in the layout, and can be misaligned, vertically arranged, partially cropped, or slightly interspersed with the main subject; English titles, dates, and institution information are scaled down and concentrated in 2–3 areas, forming a clear font size hierarchy.

Each piece uses only one set of auxiliary pattern language and makes it relate to the theme itself, such as sound waves, map folds, artifact rubbings, or plant rubbings. Do not add multiple sets of decorative elements at the same time just for the sake of richness.

The background also needs to participate in the design: use art paper textures, extremely faint pattern afterimages, drawings, specimen information, or material textures, giving the white space layers while remaining clear from a distance.

Overall information volume is medium to high, but there must be a hierarchy:
First glance sees the composition and main subject;
Second glance sees the Chinese title and patterns;
Third glance reads the English, dates, and auxiliary information.

Color is controlled to 3–4 primary colors, creating tension through scale, cropping, overlapping, density, and white space.

Overall effect: cultural exhibition poster, editorial design, mature print publication feel, rich but not messy, diagonal potential energy exists naturally, do not deliberately arrange elements just to be "diagonal."

4 cases for replacement:

prompts.text:
设计一张 9:16 竖版文化展览海报，整体为当代 Editorial Graphic Design / 艺术出版物视觉。

【主题】：____
【中文标题】：____
【英文标题】：____
【主视觉】：____
【辅助纹样】：____
【主色】：____
【辅助色】：____
【日期 / 机构】：____

核心使用「斜向势能」构图，但不要直接画明显斜线。

先确定一条隐藏的对角视觉主轴，让主视觉、中文标题、纹样、日期信息和留白的视觉重量沿同一方向逐步递进。

主视觉承担主要重量；大型中文标题必须参与版式，可错位、纵排、局部裁切或与主体轻微穿插；英文标题、日期和机构信息缩小并集中在 2–3 个区域，形成明显字号层级。

每张只使用一套辅助纹样语言，并让它与主题本身产生关系，例如声纹、地图折页、器物拓印、植物拓印。不要为了丰富而同时加入多套装饰元素。

背景也需要参与设计：使用艺术纸纹理、极淡图案残影、图纸、标本信息或材料纹理，让留白有层次，但远看仍保持清楚。

整体信息量中高，但必须有主次：
第一眼看到构图与主体；
第二眼看到中文标题和纹样；
第三眼再阅读英文、日期和辅助信息。

色彩控制在 3–4 个主要颜色，通过尺度、裁切、叠压、疏密和留白制造张力。

整体效果：文化展览海报、编辑设计、成熟印刷出版物感，丰富但不乱，斜向势能自然存在，不要为了“斜”而刻意排列元素。

4 个案例可替换：

1. 潮痕回声
主视觉：黑白有机潮汐 / 矿物形态
纹样：靛蓝 Moiré 同心声纹

2. 城中折景
主视觉：城市钢笔速写组成的折叠观察册
纹样：芥末黄地图折页 + 极淡城市路网

3. 东方器韵
主视觉：大型青铜器
纹样：从器物表面延展出的饕餮纹、云雷纹与铭文拓印

4. 枝间夜航
主视觉：老树枝 + 黑色乌鸫
纹样：淡赭色大型植物叶片拓印

prompts.text:
Subject:
White morning time by the window

Main Subject:
In a bright living room, sunlight filters through white curtains as a young adult woman reaches out her arm for a selfie. The person occupies most of the space from the center to the right of the frame, with the main focus from the face to the waist and upper part of the shorts, showcasing a sofa and foliage plants on the left.

Person · Expression:
A rounded small oval face, smooth and bright skin, large grayish-brown eyes, neat thin eyebrows, a small nose, and pale rose-pink lips. The face is slightly tilted toward the left of the frame, looking into the lens with a friendly closed-mouth smile. Long eyelashes, thin light brown eyeliner, pale peach blush, and a natural lip gloss shine. Dark brown straight hair reaching the chest, with thin bangs on the forehead finely gathered above the eyes, and long side hair and ends flowing loosely inward and outward.

Clothing · Pose:
An ivory-white sleeveless cropped knit top with fine vertical stripes and a sheer feel, a deep round neck, a small white button at the front center, and a hem slightly flared to the sides. Light gray soft shorts, a white belt, a thin black wristband on the left wrist, and a small circular silver pendant around the neck. The right hand reaches toward the lens for a selfie, the upper body leans back slightly, moving the waist toward the left of the frame, and the left arm hangs naturally.

Background · Lighting:
A beige fabric sofa and ivory-white throw pillows, a tall foliage plant in a rattan basket in the deep left, and a wooden side table with green plants in a glass vase filled with water in the front left. Strong morning light filters through the floor-to-ceiling window and white lace curtains at the back right, softly illuminating the edges of the hair, face, shoulders, and chest. It creates elegant daylight on the floor and furniture, with shallow and natural shadows.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 3:4. Positioning the extended right-hand camera slightly higher than the face, adopting a close-range slight high-angle selfie perspective, capturing a portrait from the head to the waist. The face is in the upper half biased toward the right, the torso is centered, the waist and shorts are cut off at the bottom, and the upper right arm naturally extends to the right side of the frame. The person is placed in the foreground and enlarged, while the furniture in the deep left is reduced and included. Precise focus on the eyes, face, and white top, with the background maintaining a recognizable medium depth of field.

Texture · Style:
High-definition realistic live-action photo taken with bright natural light. Delicate skin texture and soft luster, fine hair strands, the weave and transparency of the white knit, the fabric of the shorts, the texture of the silver pendant, and the tactile feel of wood grain, glass, water, and leaves are all realistically represented. Dominated by white and beige tones, accented with fresh green, avoiding excessive skin smoothing or illustration styles.

Negative Prompt:
Modifications to the face, hairstyle, white top, and high-angle selfie composition

构图・镜头：
纵向3:4。将伸出的右手相机置于脸部稍高的位置，采用近距离轻微俯视的自拍视角，捕捉从头部到腰部的肖像。脸部在上半部分偏右，躯干居中，腰部和短裤在下端截断，右上臂自然延伸至画面右侧。将人物置于前景并放大，左侧深处的家具则缩小纳入。精准对焦于眼睛、脸部和白色上衣，背景保持室内可辨识的中等景深。

质感・风格：
以明亮自然光拍摄的高精细写实真人照片。细腻的皮肤纹理和柔和光泽，细发束，白针织的编织与透视感，短裤的面料，银色吊坠的质地，木纹、玻璃、水和叶子的触感皆为写实表现。以白色和米色为主调，点缀清新的绿色，避免过度美肌处理或插图风格。

prompts.text:
Oriental ancient style female warrior, young adult female, delicate and natural facial features with a slight mixed-race feel, long black hair in a high bun + partially loose hair, red hairpins/hairbands/ribbons, silver tassel earrings.

Temperament: Cold and elegant, sharp, heroic, murderous but not stiff, eyes sharp with a sense of oppression (different gazes in different scenes).

Clothing: Bright red ancient style female warrior long dress + tube top overlapping top + translucent red gauze wide sleeves + black dark-patterned waist seal (waist-cinching) + multi-layered red gauze long skirt (high slit) + red, black, blue, and purple ribbons.

Accessories: Black and red scabbard + red sword tassel, high-heeled lace-up shoes.

Weapon: Oriental ancient sword (silver-white blade + dark patterns + metal carved handguard + exquisite hilt), no Western swords.

Style: Oriental martial arts movie poster + ink-wash rice paper background + high-end fashion magazine layout + realistic photography fused with ink-wash illustration + large white space + black wild cursive calligraphy + red and black contrast + ink dots/petals/dust particles.

2. Four Storyboard Scenes

1 | Desert Lonely Sword (Static Long Shot)
Ultra-wide shot, small full-body proportion (bottom 1/3 of the frame), desert + large area of sky white space.
Standing holding a sword, sword tip touching the ground or pointing diagonally at the ground, another sword stabbed into the sandy ground behind.
Expression calm and indifferent, eyes looking into the distance, not looking directly at the camera.
White space at the top of the frame + vertical poems + red stamps.

2 | Drawing Sword and Slashing Diagonally (Dynamic Mid-Close Shot)
Character occupies 70%, side-view drawing the sword.
Action: Draw sword → Turn waist → Drop shoulders → Slash diagonally (top right → bottom left).
The sword forms a strong diagonal composition.
Expression: Pressed eyebrows, murderous intent, locking onto the target.
Ribbons + sleeves + hair are strongly driven by movement.
Wild cursive large characters on the left: Red Robe Slashes the Heart.
Vertical short sentences on the right (optional).

3 | Horizontal Sword Swing (Close-up Perspective)
Half-body to thighs, character on the right, white space + ink writing on the left.
Horizontal-diagonal sword swing (top right → bottom left), the sword is very close to the lens forming perspective.
Not looking at the camera, side-glance at the target, calm and dangerous.
Red gauze rolling like smoke, ribbons surrounding.
Wild cursive title on top left: Red Sleeve Slashes the Swan Shadow.

4 | Close-range Thrust (Oppressive)
Low-angle close-up, character pressing towards the camera.
Action: Hidden sword → Step forward → Turn waist → Flip wrist → Straight thrust at the camera (diagonal line).
Sword tip is extremely close to the lens, strong perspective.
Expression focused and cold, murderous but not exaggerated.
Red gauze exploding + skirt hem like waves.
Wild cursive on the left: Red Sleeve Startles the Swan.

3. Universal Visual Keywords
Ink-wash rice paper background | Large white space | Black wild cursive calligraphy | Vermilion seal | Ink splashes | Red petals | Dust particles | Cinematic realistic photography | Oriental martial arts poster | Modern graphic design | calligraphy typography | cinematic wuxia style

4. Sword Qi (Simplified)
Thin white air-cutting tracks + a small amount of dark red flowing light + particle ink dots.
Extends along the direction of the sword, does not block the character and weapon.

Actions not conforming to human mechanics | Wrong sword grip | Finger deformity | Extra hands and arms | Floating weapons | Deformed sword | Stiff expression | Uncanny valley face | Looking directly at the camera (unless specified) | Plastic skin | Cyber neon | Laser special effects | Western armor | Japanese katana | Modern clothing | Watermark logo gibberish

配饰：黑红剑鞘+红色剑穗流苏，高跟绑带鞋。

武器：东方古剑（银白剑身+暗纹+金属雕花护手+精致剑柄），不要西方剑。

风格：东方武侠电影海报 + 水墨宣纸背景 + 高级时尚杂志排版 + 写实摄影融合水墨插画 + 大留白 + 黑色狂草书法 + 红黑对比 + 墨点/花瓣/尘粒。

二、四张分镜

1｜荒漠孤剑（静态远景）

超远景，全身小比例（画面下方1/3），沙漠+大面积天空留白。

站立持剑，剑尖垂地或斜指地面，另一把剑插在身后沙地。

表情冷静淡漠，眼神看远方，不直视镜头。

画面上方留白+竖排诗词+红印章。

2｜拔剑斜斩（动态中近景）

人物占70%，侧身拔剑。

动作：拔剑→转腰→沉肩→斜向斩出（右上→左下）。

剑形成强烈斜线构图。

表情：压眉、杀气、锁定目标。

飘带+袖子+头发强烈被带动。

左侧狂草大字：红衣斩心

右侧竖排短句（可选）。

3｜横向挥剑（近景透视）

半身到大腿，人物在右侧，左侧留白+墨书。

横斜挥剑（右上→左下），剑非常靠近镜头形成透视。

不看镜头，侧视目标，冷静危险。

红纱像烟雾翻卷，飘带环绕。

左上狂草标题：红袖斩鸿影

4｜近距离刺击（压迫感）

低机位近景，人物压向镜头。

动作：藏剑→跨步→转腰→翻腕→直刺镜头（斜线）。

剑尖极近镜头，强透视。

表情专注冷酷，有杀气但不夸张。

红纱炸开+裙摆如浪。

左侧狂草：红袖惊鸿

三、通用视觉关键词

水墨宣纸背景｜大留白｜黑色狂草书法｜朱红印章｜墨点飞溅｜红色花瓣｜尘粒｜电影级写实摄影｜东方武侠海报｜现代平面设计｜calligraphy typography｜cinematic wuxia style

四、剑气（简化）

细白色空气切割轨迹 + 少量暗红流光 + 粒子墨点
沿剑方向延伸，不遮挡人物与武器。

五、负面提示词

动作不符合人体力学｜错误握剑｜手指畸形｜多手多臂｜武器漂浮｜剑变形｜僵硬表情｜恐怖谷脸｜直视镜头（除非指定）｜塑料皮肤｜赛博霓虹｜激光特效｜西方铠甲｜日式武士刀｜现代服装｜水印logo乱码
