prompts.text: 2x2 grid, 1:1 do this for 4 famous books<transformation> - Preserve the subject’s recognizable structure, but reinterpret it as a stylized editorial composition where drawing and miniature object-world logic coexist. - Convert some forms into sparse grainy line illustration while converting other forms into soft pastel miniatures or still-life objects. - Reinterpret texture-rich or detailed areas as small clusters of plants, props, vessels, terrain fragments, or decorative micro-world motifs. - Convert smooth surfaces into matte pastel color fields, while using graphic linework to describe edges, volume, and texture selectively. - Reduce complexity into a limited color system with one dominant graphic ink tone and a few quiet pastel support colors. - Replace deep realism with poster-like clarity, paper-print tactility, and curated tabletop arrangement. - Allow the subject to feel partially drawn and partially physically staged, creating a deliberate ambiguity between illustration and object. - Use negative space and sparse composition to keep the image clean, modern, and highly readable. </transformation> <shape_language> - Favor simple containers, rounded objects, leaves, stems, pebbles, tabletop silhouettes, miniature clusters, and clean abstract forms. - Use a mix of flat contour areas and soft low-relief sculptural accents. - Keep repetition rhythmic and decorative. - Let small details feel intentional and editorial rather than busy. </shape_language> <rendering_rules> - Use visibly grainy printed or crayon-like marks for lines and texture accents. - Keep volumetric forms soft, simplified, and pastel. - Limit the palette aggressively for a designed, print-friendly look. - Use shallow spatial depth with subtle diorama hints. - Make the final result feel like an art print, a magazine illustration, and a miniature set all at once. </rendering_rules> <finish> - Graphic limited-palette editorial hybrid. - Printmaking texture fused with soft pastel mini-world staging. - Smart, modern, collectible, and quietly distinctive. </finish> <avoid> - Avoid photoreal rendering. - Avoid deep cinematic perspective or strong realism. - Avoid overstuffing with too many tiny details. - Avoid using too many colors; keep it controlled and designed. </avoid>

prompts.text: 2x2 网格，1:1 比例，为 4 本名著创作 <transformation> - 保留主体的可辨识结构，但将其重新诠释为一种风格化的编辑构图，使绘画与微型物体世界的逻辑并存。 - 将某些形式转换为稀疏的颗粒感线条插画，同时将其他形式转换为柔和的柔和色调微缩模型或静物对象。 - 将纹理丰富或细节较多的区域重新诠释为小型的植物群、道具、容器、地形碎片或装饰性的微型世界图案。 - 将平滑表面转换为哑光柔和色块，同时有选择地使用图形线条来描绘边缘、体积和纹理。 - 将复杂性简化为有限的色彩系统，包含一种主导性的图形墨色和几种沉静的柔和辅助色。 - 以海报般的清晰度、纸张印刷的触感和精心策划的桌面布置取代深度现实主义。 - 让主体感觉像是部分绘制的，部分是实体布置的，在插画和物体之间创造一种刻意的模糊感。 - 使用负空间和稀疏的构图，使图像保持干净、现代且高度易读。 </transformation> <shape_language> - 偏好简单的容器、圆润的物体、叶子、茎、鹅卵石、桌面剪影、微缩集群和干净的抽象形式。 - 结合平面的轮廓区域和柔和的低浮雕雕塑感点缀。 - 保持重复具有韵律感和装饰性。 - 让微小的细节显得具有意图感和编辑感，而不是杂乱。 </shape_language> <rendering_rules> - 使用明显的颗粒状印刷或蜡笔般的痕迹作为线条和纹理重点。 - 保持体积形式柔和、简化且呈柔和色调。 - 极力限制调色板，以获得一种经过设计的、适合印刷的外观。 - 使用浅空间深度并带有细微的西洋镜暗示。 - 让最终结果同时具有艺术印刷品、杂志插画和微缩场景的感觉。 </rendering_rules> <finish> - 图形化有限色调的编辑混合体。 - 版画纹理与柔和色调微型世界布置相结合。 - 灵动、现代、具有收藏价值且低调独特。 </finish> <avoid> - 避免写实渲染。 - 避免深邃的电影透视或强烈的现实主义。 - 避免塞入过多的微小细节。 - 避免使用过多颜色；保持受控且经过设计。 </avoid>

The theme of the work is "She walked through the Bund to see the light on the other side of the Huangpu River."

The core narrative of the scene is: a young Oriental woman stands on a paper-sculpted riverside promenade, the Huangpu River where night and dawn meet slowly unfolds before her. The Bund buildings and the Lujiazui skyline on the opposite bank are lit up layer by layer in the glimmer, the city like a waking river of stars. She quietly gazes at the opposite bank, as if finally deciding to walk from the familiar shore toward a more vast distance.

The main character is an Oriental adult female with a visual age of approximately 25, clear-headed and independent, bright and firm, with a sense of calmness after urban growth. The character has a delicate oval face, bright almond eyes, and a calm and focused expression, as if seeing the outline of the future. The character uses exquisite Oriental paper art illustration-style modeling, not a real-life photographic texture, and is not overly cartoonish.

The character's hairstyle and hair accessories are: long black hair naturally flowing, with the ends extending into streamlined paper ribbons blown backward by the river wind, wearing light gold geometric leaves and small star-point hair accessories; the headwear is exquisite and light, not complex or towering.

The character's clothing is: a deep ultramarine and silver-white layered paper art long dress, with the interior of the skirt hem engraved with patterns of the city skyline, water waves, star points, and buildings; the outer silk sash is light and long, with fine hollow patterns and a sense of paper art cutting on the edges. The skirt hem and silk sash extend significantly backward in the wind, forming elegant flowing lines; the clothing presents clear paper thickness, fiber texture, slight creases, and high-quality hand-cut edges.

The dream carrier is: a paper art riverside promenade.

Dream imagery includes: Bund buildings, Huangpu River, city skyline, promenade, bridges, glimmering star points. All buildings, the river surface, railings, clouds, characters, and decorations must be unified into a high-completion three-dimensional paper carving language.

The overall papercut structure adopts: a paper-page road style.

The composition and character movements are: a paper art promenade extending along the river curves from the foreground into the distance; the character is located in the middle-lower left part of the screen, with her back or half-back to the camera, standing quietly by the railing, facing the skyline on the opposite bank. The character is not posing for a normal photo but is as if gazing at the light on the other side. The long hair, skirt hem, and silk sash unfold backward in the river wind, forming a flow direction consistent with the riverside promenade. The promenade railings, street lamps, ground patterns, and riverside curves together lead the eye toward the direction of Lujiazui in the distance, forming a clear depth of space of "riverbank - river surface - opposite skyline."

The foreground consists of exquisite paper art riverside railings, flower branch decorations, lamp posts, and pavement patterns; the midground is the curved and extending riverside promenade and the character; the background is the Huangpu River surface, ships on the river, Bund buildings, and urban high-rises on the opposite bank. The Bund buildings must be paper-sculpted into Western-style facades, domes, clock towers, arched windows, and continuous riverside building clusters with a distinct historical style; the Lujiazui skyline on the opposite side of the Huangpu River must also be paper-sculpted, with clearly visible iconic outlines such as the Oriental Pearl, Shanghai Tower, and Shanghai World Financial Center, unfolding in layers of paper-carved buildings of varying heights. There can be several paper-carved cruise ships on the river as scale and momentum accents.

The overall color scheme is: mainly deep ultramarine, silver-white, and champagne gold, with small amounts of coral red as accents. Deep ultramarine is used for the night sky, the character's main dress, the river surface, and some building shadows; silver-white is used for paper-carved railings, building highlights, silk sashes, clouds, and bright parts of the pavement; champagne gold is used for lighting, window light in buildings, local outlines, and highlight details; a small amount of coral red is used only as local city lights or sky glimmer accents. The overall color needs to be high-end, bright, and clear, presenting a dreamy urban atmosphere of night and dawn merging, not gray, not dirty, and not overall yellowish.

Lighting and paper texture: A combination of clear night light and soft horizon dawn light, with urban buildings and the riverside promenade lit by delicate lights, the edges of buildings slightly translucent, and the paper-carved texture of the river surface and the cut edges of the buildings clearly visible. There is soft and bright sky light in the direction of the distant skyline, forming a cold and warm intertwined light and shadow layer between the Bund and Lujiazui. Emphasize real paper fibers, hand-cut marks, paper layer thickness, layered shadows, and the translucency of hollowed-out edges, making the entire image like a museum-grade large-scale paper-carved urban art installation.

The overall picture has the feel of a modern Oriental female art poster, a paper-carved urban dreamscape, an urban star river, and a high-completion art installation display. The character is the emotional core, but the urban space must be vast enough; the Bund and the opposite skyline must have clear recognizability; the entire picture should be like a paper art dream of the "other shore" unfolding from a real city, rather than a common urban night scene poster.

Supplementary requirements: The urban space should be large, the character should not be too large relative to the scene, and the depth relationship of "riverbank - opposite shore - skyline" should be strengthened; both the Bund buildings and the Lujiazui skyline must be clearly paper-sculpted; the overall look should be clear, gorgeous, bright, and dreamy, and should not be made into a common travel promotion illustration.

Negative prompts: Minors, juvenile faces, real-life photography, common anime, plastic 3D, resin material, clay, felt, children's handicrafts, common urban night scene posters, too strong a sense of reality photography, disconnected material between character and background, no paper layers, no hollow structures, messy paper layers, weak building recognizability, Bund and Lujiazui not obvious, insufficient riverbank depth, character close-up too large, gray picture, dead black shadows, overall yellowish, overall bluish clump, messy accumulation of elements, text, logo, watermark.

prompts.text:
9:16竖版，现代东方女性梦境立体剪纸艺术，modern oriental papercut art，layered paper cut illustration，dimensional paper sculpture，intricate paper carving，paper diorama，layered shadow box，poetic female dreamscape，contemporary oriental art poster。

作品主题为“她走过外滩，去看浦江另一边的光”。

画面核心叙事为：一位年轻东方女性站在纸雕化的滨江长廊上，夜色与晨光交汇的浦江在她面前缓缓展开。外滩建筑与浦江对岸的陆家嘴天际线在微光中层层点亮，城市像一条正在苏醒的星河。她静静望向彼岸，像终于决定从熟悉的此岸走向更辽阔的远方。

主体人物为视觉年龄约25岁的东方成年女性，清醒独立、明亮坚定，带一点都市成长后的冷静感。人物拥有清秀鹅蛋脸，明亮杏眼，神情平静而专注，像正在看见未来的轮廓。人物采用精致东方纸艺插画式塑形，不是真人摄影质感，不过度卡通化。

人物发型与头饰为：黑色长发自然披散，发尾延展成流线状纸带，被江风吹向身后，佩戴浅金几何叶片与小型星点发饰，头饰精致轻盈，不复杂不高耸。

人物服装为：深群青与银白层叠纸艺长裙，裙摆内部镂刻城市天际线、水波、星点与楼宇纹样，外层披帛轻薄修长，边缘具有细密镂空花纹与纸艺裁切感。裙摆与披帛在风中向后大幅延展，形成优雅的流动线条，服装呈现清晰的纸张厚度、纤维纹理、轻微折痕与高完成度手工裁切边缘。

梦境载体为：纸艺滨江长廊。

梦境意象包括：外滩建筑、浦江、城市天际线、长廊、桥梁、微光星点。所有建筑、江面、栏杆、云层、人物与装饰都必须统一为高完成度立体纸雕语言。

整体剪纸结构采用：纸页道路式。

构图与人物动作为：一条沿江延展的纸艺长廊从前景向远方弯曲延伸，人物位于画面中下部偏左位置，背对或半侧背对镜头，静静站在栏杆边，面向对岸天际线。人物不是普通摆拍，而是像正在凝望彼岸的光。长发、裙摆和披帛在江风中向后展开，形成与江岸长廊一致的流动方向。长廊栏杆、路灯、地面纹样和滨江弧线共同把视线引向远处陆家嘴方向，形成明显的“江岸—江面—对岸天际线”的纵深空间。

近景是精致的纸艺滨江栏杆、花枝装饰、灯柱与路面纹样；中景是弯曲延展的江岸长廊与人物；远景是浦江水面、江上船只、外滩建筑与对岸城市高楼。外滩建筑必须纸雕化为具有明显历史风貌的西式立面、穹顶、钟楼、拱窗和连续沿江建筑群；浦江对岸的陆家嘴天际线也必须纸雕化，清晰可见东方明珠、上海中心、上海环球金融中心等标志性轮廓，以高低错落的纸雕楼群层层展开。江面上可有几艘纸雕游船，作为尺度和动势点缀。

整体色彩方案为：深群青、银白、香槟金为主，少量珊瑚红点缀。深群青用于夜空、人物主裙、江面与部分建筑阴影；银白用于纸雕栏杆、建筑高光、披帛、云层和路面亮部；香槟金用于灯光、楼体窗光、局部描边和高光细节；少量珊瑚红仅作为建筑局部灯火或天空微光点缀。整体色彩需高级、明亮、清透，呈现夜色与晨光交融的梦幻城市气息，不灰蒙、不脏、不整体偏黄。

光线与纸张质感为：清透夜光与柔和天际晨光结合，城市楼宇与滨江长廊被细腻灯光点亮，建筑边缘轻微透光，江面纸雕纹理与楼体裁切边缘清晰可见。远方天际线方向有柔和明亮的天光，外滩与陆家嘴之间形成冷暖交织的光影层次。强调真实纸张纤维、手工裁切痕迹、纸层厚度、层叠投影与镂空边缘透光感，使整幅画面像博物馆级大型纸雕城市艺术装置。

画面整体具有现代东方女性艺术海报、纸雕城市梦境、都会星河与高完成度艺术装置展示感。人物是情绪核心，但城市空间必须足够辽阔；外滩与对岸天际线必须有明确辨识度；整幅画面要像从现实城市中展开的一场纸艺彼岸之梦，而不是普通城市夜景海报。

补充要求：城市空间要大，人物相对场景不要过大，强化“江岸—对岸—天际线”的纵深关系；外滩建筑与陆家嘴天际线都要明显纸雕化；整体清透华丽、明亮梦幻，不要做成普通旅游宣传插画。

负面提示词：未成年人，幼态脸，真人摄影，普通动漫，塑料3D，树脂材质，黏土，毛毡，儿童手工，普通城市夜景海报，现实摄影感过强，人物与背景材质割裂，没有纸张层次，没有镂空结构，纸层混乱，建筑辨识度太弱，外滩和陆家嘴不明显，江岸纵深不足，人物特写过大，画面灰蒙，暗部死黑，整体偏黄，整体偏蓝成一团，元素杂乱堆积，文字，Logo，水印。

prompts.text:
【Variables】
Woman: [adult East Asian woman, hairstyle, overall vibe]
Top: [burgundy / ivory / olive / charcoal fitted top]
Bottom: black high-waisted mini skirt
Tights: [sheer black tights + vertical lines / elongated diamonds / flowing contour lines / diagonal pinstripes]
Pose: [hand on cheek / adjusting hair / touching ankle / relaxed crouch]
Expression: [calm gaze / side glance / subtle smirk / soft smile]
Location: [convenience store / parking area / old street / alley entrance]

Create a 9:16 ultra-realistic nighttime street-fashion portrait of an adult woman crouching close to the ground.

Shoot from a very low, close camera position with a 28–35mm perspective. Let the bent legs occupy a large part of the foreground while keeping the face naturally proportioned.

Use direct on-camera flash: bright skin highlights, darker ambient background, slight hard shadows, subtle high-ISO grain, and an early-2000s compact digital camera feel.

The tights should stay sheer and naturally reveal skin tone. Keep the pattern clean, continuous, and clearly part of the hosiery itself. All lines must follow the 3D curvature of the thighs, knees, calves, and ankles without floating, breaking, crossing randomly, or looking painted onto the skin.

Keep the pose relaxed and asymmetrical. Hands and fingers should feel natural, with clear separation between arms, knees, legs, and shoes.

Use an ordinary lived-in nighttime city environment with parked cars, storefronts, concrete, streetlights, or slightly worn architecture. Avoid luxury locations or polished studio lighting.

9:16 vertical version, high-precision ancient style Xianxia soft and dreamy photography style, the scene is an ancient wooden corridor space, surrounded by thick dark brown wooden pillars, wooden railings, and wooden steps, the background retains traditional architectural texture. The overall color tone is soft warm wood, forming a contrast with the character's light-colored clothing.

The main subject of the picture is a 24–28-year-old young adult Oriental female, with a clear adult temperament and natural and clear Oriental female characteristics. She adopts a kneeling or semi-kneeling posture, located in the center of the frame, body leaning slightly forward, head slightly turned toward the camera, eyes soft and quiet, and the expression carries a bit of shyness, quietness, and a sense of dreaminess.

The character has a very obvious exaggerated hourglass-shaped upper body ratio—the chest volume is extremely plump, round and full, both horizontal and vertical volumes are very prominent, significantly larger than the shoulder width and waist width; the waist is extremely thin and strongly constricted, forming a strong contrast of "ultra-plump chest + extremely narrow waist." In the kneeling forward-leaning posture, the chest naturally hangs down due to gravity forming a full curve, the waist narrows smoothly in the forward tilt, and the overall curves are looming under the light gauze fabric.

She has long black hair with soft air bangs, wearing pink-white flower hair accessories and small pearl hairpins on the side of her hair, adding a classical, soft, and ethereal atmosphere. The makeup is exquisite and sweet ancient style makeup—the skin tone is fair and transparent, the eye makeup is soft with light pink pearlescent, the lip color is a natural pinkish hydrated feel, and there may be a very faint pink floral mark on the forehead. The overall facial features are delicately handled, retaining real skin texture, not plastic or internet celebrity-like.

The clothing is a light white/ivory white ancient style Xianxia gauze dress style. The upper body is a bandeau-style inner layer or corset-style top, with a thin semi-transparent white gauze garment draped over the outer layer, the gauze naturally slipping off the shoulders, creating a soft and elegant visual effect. There is a light blue ribbon decoration on the chest, adorned with pale gold embroidery, beadwork, and patterns. The sleeves are wide, thin, and flowing, an ancient style long-sleeve design. The lower body is a matching white light gauze layered long skirt, with the hem spreading on the wooden floor, the material is light and semi-transparent, with layered tulle and exquisite embroidery details. The overall clothing style is ethereal and soft, ancient style photography, cosplay costume texture, with the completion of exquisite photography outfits. A very thin silver clavicle chain is worn on the chest, forming small highlights under the light.

Soft side-backlighting enters from the side of the corridor, illuminating the side of the character's face, hair strands, gauze edges, and hair accessory highlights. It forms soft curved highlights on the illuminated surface of the plump chest contour and natural shadow transitions at the narrowing of the waistline. The background wooden pillars and steps maintain a shallow depth-of-field blur, the overall atmosphere is soft, quiet, and beautiful.

The whole adopts an ancient style Xianxia dreamy refined filter—the colors are bright and transparent, with warm wood tones and ivory white as the main key, highlights are soft, dark parts are clean, skin tone is natural and delicate, and the textures of the gauze, embroidery, and hair accessory details are clear. Avoid cheap cosplay, studio ancient costumes, modern dress feel, immature face, internet celebrity face, plastic skin, excessive skin smoothing, chaotic clothing structure, and stacked hair accessories. 9:16.

prompts.text:
9:16竖版，高精度古风仙侠柔美梦幻写真风格，画面为古风木质回廊空间，周围有粗大的深棕色木柱、木栏杆和木台阶，背景保留传统建筑质感。整体色调偏柔和暖木色，与人物浅色服饰形成对比。

画面主体是一位24–28岁年轻成年东方女性，成年气质明确，具有自然明确的东方女性特征。她采用跪坐或半跪坐姿势，位于画面中央，身体微微前倾，头部略微侧向镜头，眼神柔和安静，表情带有一点羞怯、安静和梦幻感。

人物拥有非常明显的夸张沙漏型上半身比例——胸部体积极其丰满、圆润饱满，横向与纵向体量都非常突出，明显大于肩宽与腰宽；腰部则极细、强烈内收，形成"超丰满胸部＋极窄腰身"的强烈反差。在跪坐前倾姿态中，胸部因重力自然垂落形成饱满弧线，腰身在俯倾中收窄流畅，整体曲线在轻纱面料下若隐若现。

她留着乌黑长发，带有轻柔空气刘海，发侧佩戴粉白色花朵发饰与细小珍珠发簪，增添了古典柔美仙气氛围。妆容为精致甜美古风妆——肤色白皙通透，眼妆柔和带淡粉珠光，唇色为自然偏粉水润感，额间可有极淡的粉色花钿。整体五官处理细腻，保留真实皮肤质感，不塑料不网红。

服饰为浅白色/象牙白色古风仙侠纱裙造型。上身为抹胸式内搭或束胸式上衣，外层披着轻薄半透明的白色纱衣，纱衣在肩部自然滑落，形成柔软飘逸的视觉效果。胸前有浅蓝色系带装饰，并带有淡金色刺绣、珠饰与花纹点缀。袖子宽大轻薄飘逸，为古风长袖设计。下身是同色系白色轻纱层叠长裙，裙摆铺散在木地面上，材质轻盈半透明，有层叠薄纱与精致刺绣细节。整体服饰风格偏仙气柔美、古风写真、角色扮演服装质感，带有精致的摄影服完成度。胸前佩戴一条极细的银色锁骨链，在光线下形成细小高光。

prompts.text:
Theme:
White rock and water-colored bikini

Subject:
In a transparent shallow surrounded by white rock walls, a woman in her 20s stands submerged in water above her knees. Place the figure in the center of the frame and zoom in, highlighting the wet long hair, light water-colored string swimsuit, hands raised to the sides of the face, and water-droplet-covered skin as the main focus.

Character/Expression:
A slightly long oval face with soft cheeks and a small rounded chin. Long horizontal almond-shaped eyes, dark brown pupils with slightly upturned corners, thin and gentle arched eyebrows, a thin straight nose bridge with a small tip, and glossy coral pink lips with a thinner upper lip and thicker lower lip. Face directed forward, chin slightly raised, casting a calm gaze at the camera, lips slightly parted. Thin eyeliner, long eyelashes, light red blending around the eyes and cheeks. Wet dark brown straight hair reaching below the chest, with fine bangs and long strands of hair clinging to the cheeks and neck.

Clothing/Pose:
Light sky-colored triangle bikini swimsuit, thin strings extending to the neck, one string below the chest, and small bottoms with long ribbons tied at both sides of the waist. A thin silver chain and a small blue star pendant around the neck. Standing frontally, waist slightly shifted to the left of the frame, both elbows extended to the left and right. Fingertips of both hands lightly touching from below the ears to the wet hair, revealing shoulders and neck.

Background/Lighting:
The overall background of the frame is bright white-gray rock walls with unevenness and vertical cracks. The lower part is a transparent turquoise shallow with fine ripples, and a very fine sandy area deep in the center. Strong direct noon sunlight enters from the upper slightly left side of the frame, forming sharp white highlights on the face, shoulders, chest, abdomen, and thighs. Diffuse reflection from the rocks makes the shadows bright, and the light from the water surface shimmers on the skin.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical 3:4. Capture a knee-up portrait from a horizontal shot slightly above the water surface. The face is placed in the center of the upper half, arms spread to the left and right, and the torso and swimsuit are largely contained from the center to the lower half. Cut below the knees by the water surface and the bottom edge, with white rock walls remaining evenly around the figure. Precise focus on the face and body, with a deeper depth of field where the rock walls also have discernible texture.

Texture/Style:
High-definition realistic live-action photo taken under strong natural light. Realistically depict water droplets and gloss on wet skin, fine wet hair, swimsuit fabric and strings, transparent water, and the rough surface of white rocks. Bright summer colors of white, light blue, and skin tones.

Negative:
Significantly change the facial contour and the contour of the wet hair

prompts.text:
Subject: An adult oriental female with slender and natural adult proportions, a soft oval face, pinkish-white delicate porcelain skin, and exquisite, elegant features. Thick black long hair styled into a voluminous classical high bun and rounded side buns, with extremely long straight black hair hanging naturally at the back; the bun is decorated with ice-blue translucent butterflies, light blue flower ornaments, silver-white bead flowers, and long tassel hairpins, with a few blue butterflies dotting the sides of the forehead and hairline. The makeup uses a clear classical dewy water-light look, with slender natural eyebrows, light peach pink eyeshadow, thin eyeliner, soft long eyelashes, light pink blush, and soft moist bean-paste red lips, with a gentle, quiet, and slightly shy expression.

Wardrobe: Wearing low-saturation lake blue, azure, and ice blue classical Hanfu styling, with light translucent gauze ribbons and wide-sleeved outer layers on the upper body, the collar naturally sliding down to near the shoulders, forming a soft off-the-shoulder silhouette; the chest and cuffs are decorated with silver-white, ice blue, and light pink 3D flower embroidery, beadwork, and fine patterns; the lower body is matched with a soft light pink long skirt and multiple layers of thin gauze, with the blue outer robe naturally spread across the bench and the side of the legs. The fabric is light, with clear transparent layers and fine embroidery. A low-profile VOXCAT woven label or small tag is added to the clothing.

Composition: 9:16 vertical full-body to upper-half-body composition, the character is sitting on a black wooden bench in a Chinese garden corridor, with the body located slightly to the right of the center of the frame. The camera is slightly higher than the knees with a slight high-angle shot, the character's upper body leans forward, the face is facing down, forming a natural diagonal line extending from the head, shoulder line, arms, down to the legs and shoes. The legs are crossed, with one leg raised and extended towards the lower left of the frame, becoming a prominent foreground; the long skirt and blue thin gauze fall in a large area from the waist towards the lower right, forming a soft S-shaped fabric curve. The frame completely retains the head ornaments, face, legs, and white high-heeled shoes.

Action: The character's sitting posture is elegant but with a sense of a candid moment from life, looking down intently while putting on shoes or adjusting the heel for herself. One leg is naturally crossed and raised, with the toes pointing forward, already wearing one white pointed-toe stiletto; the other hand lightly supports the heel or the opening of the shoe, fingers naturally close to the ankle and the upper; the other leg is naturally bent near the bench, and the other identical white high-heeled shoe can be worn on the foot or naturally located nearby. Shoulders are slightly pulled in, head is bowed, eyes fall on the shoes, not looking at the camera. The action is like a behind-the-scenes moment of an ancient-style styling captured by chance.

Location: A traditional Chinese garden corridor, with red wooden pillars, gray tile roofs, dark gray brick walls, black wooden railings, and benches forming the background, with green trees, lotus leaves, or courtyard plants behind. The background has realistic garden layers but maintains a light blur and low visual weight; the red pillars, gray tiles, and green plants only serve as classical spatial anchors, making the character's blue clothing the brightest color subject of the frame.

Camera & Lighting: A portrait snapshot texture of mobile phone photography or a lightweight digital camera, approximately 28–50mm equivalent perspective, a slight wide-angle environmental feel, close-range vertical shooting. Natural cloudy day or bright scattered sunlight under tree shade, softly lighting the character from the top front, skin is highlighted and transparent but shadows are very shallow; the blue gauze clothing has a soft light-transmitting effect, the white legs and shoe surfaces remain bright and clean, and the black hair retains satin-like highlights. The overall exposure is slightly bright, high clarity, with the authentic mobile phone imaging feel of a short video ancient-style styling record.

Style: Real-life ancient-style styling photography, modern Hanfu portrait, garden life-like snapshot, the juxtaposition of classical ladies and modern fashion, clear high-purity digital portrait, ice blue ethereal color scheme, light thin gauze, exquisite embroidery, natural sunlight, social media short video cover feel. The atmosphere of the image is soft, cool, precious, and life-like, the focus is not on a grand xianxia scene, but on the "real rest moment after the styling is completed."

Color Palette: Lake blue #38B9D7, Ice cyan #89DCE7, Light sky blue #A7DFE5, Light pink skirt #E8CFD5, Pinkish-white skin tone #F1D7CF, Jet black hair color #111214, Vermilion corridor pillars #9B493D, Courtyard plant green #4E7547. The overall palette uses blue-cyan as the absolute main subject, pink is responsible for softening, and black hair and vermilion buildings are responsible for visual weighting.

Typography / Branding: The frame is mainly pure character photography, a simple small graphic logo combined with a stylized "V" and cat elements is added to the upper left corner; a low-profile handwritten artist signature voxCAT is added to the lower right corner, maintaining the sense of a photography work signature, not blocking the character, shoes, or skirt hem.

Constraints: The character is clearly an adult, with naturally slender body proportions; the relationship between the sitting posture, pelvis, shoulders and neck, knees, ankles, and leg crossing is accurate, the leg-raising and shoe-putting action conforms to real human movement logic; the length of the legs, the position of the knees, the ankle structure, and the foot proportions are stable; the structure of the white pointed-toe high heels is accurate, the shoe tips, openings, heels, and feet fit naturally; the hand structure is natural and accurate, the number of fingers is correct, the proportions are normal, the joints are clear, and the contact relationship between the fingers and the heel is reasonable; the structure of the classical hair bun is complete and stable, blue butterflies, bead flowers, and tassels have clear fixed positions and gravity directions; the gauze clothing maintains real transparent layers, the embroidery is attached to the fabric surface, and the clothing folds follow the sitting posture and gravity; the frame is clean and clear, reducing unnecessary noise and graininess, particle special effects are restrained, avoiding large areas of floating particles, scattered light, and impurities, overall details are stable, reducing the sense of messiness.

Output Specs: 9:16 vertical, high-resolution real-life ancient-style photography, focuses on ensuring the accuracy of the classical high bun, ice-blue butterfly hair accessories, looking-down expression, blue embroidered thin gauze, crossed long legs, hand shoe-putting action, and white pointed-toe stilettos.

Core Compression Formula: Adult classical lady + ice blue voluminous classical high bun + blue butterfly bead flower tassels + lake blue translucent embroidered Hanfu + light pink long skirt + garden corridor bench + looking down putting on white pointed-toe stilettos + crossed legs extended forward + natural scattered sunlight + mobile phone ancient-style styling snapshot.

prompts.text:
Subject： 一名明确为成年人的东方女性，纤细修长的自然成年比例，柔和鹅蛋脸，粉白细腻瓷肌，五官精致清秀。乌黑浓密长发塑造成大体积古典高髻与左右圆润侧髻，后方保留极长顺直黑发自然垂落；发髻上装饰冰蓝色半透明蝴蝶、浅蓝花饰、银白珠花与细长流苏步摇，少量蓝色蝴蝶点缀在额侧与发际附近。妆容采用清透古典水光妆，细长自然眉，淡桃粉眼影，纤细眼线，柔长睫毛，淡粉腮红与柔润豆沙红唇，神态温柔、安静、略带羞涩。

Wardrobe： 身穿低饱和湖蓝、天青与冰蓝色古典汉服妆造，上身为轻薄半透明纱质披帛与宽袖外层，领口自然滑落至肩部附近，形成柔和露肩轮廓；胸前与袖口装饰银白、冰蓝、浅粉立体花卉刺绣、珠饰与细密纹样；下身搭配柔软浅粉色长裙与多层薄纱，蓝色外袍自然铺落在长椅与腿侧。面料轻盈、透明层次清楚、刺绣精细。服装加入低调 VOXCAT 织标或小型吊牌。

Composition： 9:16 竖幅全身至大半身构图，人物坐在中式园林回廊的黑色木质长椅上，身体位于画面中央略偏右。镜头略高于膝盖并轻微俯拍，人物上身向前倾，脸部朝下，形成从头部、肩线、手臂一路延伸至腿部和鞋子的自然斜线。双腿交叠，一条腿抬起并向画面左下方伸出，成为明显前景；长裙和蓝色薄纱从腰部向右下方大面积垂落，形成柔软的S形布料曲线。画面完整保留头饰、脸部、双腿和白色高跟鞋。

Action： 人物坐姿优雅但带生活化瞬间感，低头专注地为自己穿鞋或调整鞋跟。一条腿自然交叠抬起，脚尖伸向前方，已经穿上一只白色尖头细高跟鞋；另一只手轻扶鞋跟或鞋口，手指自然靠近脚踝与鞋面；另一条腿自然弯曲靠近长椅，另一只同款白色高跟鞋可穿在脚上或自然位于附近。肩部微收，头部低垂，视线落在鞋子上，不看镜头。动作像被偶然捕捉到的古风妆造幕后瞬间。

Location： 中国传统园林回廊，红色木柱、灰色瓦顶、深灰砖墙、黑色木制栏杆与长椅组成背景，后方有绿色树木、荷叶或庭院植物。背景具有真实园林层次，但保持轻度虚化与低视觉权重；红柱、灰瓦、绿植只作为古典空间锚点，使蓝色人物服装成为画面最亮的色彩主体。

Camera & Lighting： 手机摄影或轻量数码相机的人像随拍质感，约 28–50mm 等效视角，轻微广角环境感，近距离竖幅拍摄。自然阴天或树荫下明亮散射日光，从正前方偏上柔和照亮人物，皮肤高亮通透但阴影很浅；蓝色纱衣具有柔和透光效果，白色腿部与鞋面保持明亮洁净，黑发保留丝缎高光。整体曝光略偏明亮，清晰度高，带短视频古风妆造记录的真实手机成像感。

Style： 真人古风妆造摄影、现代汉服写真、园林生活感随拍、古典仕女与现代时尚错位、清透高净度数字人像、冰蓝仙气配色、轻盈薄纱、精致刺绣、自然日光、社交媒体短视频封面感。画面气质柔美、清凉、娇贵、生活化，重点不是宏大仙侠场景，而是“妆造完成后的真实休息瞬间”。

Color Palette： 湖蓝 #38B9D7、冰青 #89DCE7、浅天蓝 #A7DFE5、淡粉裙 #E8CFD5、粉白肤色 #F1D7CF、乌黑发色 #111214、朱红廊柱 #9B493D、庭院植绿 #4E7547。整体以蓝青色为绝对主体，粉色负责柔化，黑发和朱红建筑负责视觉压重。

Typography / Branding： 画面以纯人物摄影为主，左上角加入由 stylized “V” 与猫元素结合的简洁小型图形 logo；右下角加入低调手写艺术家签名 voxCAT，保持摄影作品署名感，不遮挡人物、鞋子与裙摆。

Constraints： 人物明确为成年人，身体比例自然修长；坐姿、骨盆、肩颈、膝盖、脚踝与腿部交叠关系准确，抬腿穿鞋动作符合真实人体运动逻辑；双腿长度、膝盖位置、脚踝结构与足部比例稳定；白色尖头高跟鞋结构准确，鞋尖、鞋口、鞋跟和脚部贴合自然；手部结构自然准确，手指数量正确、比例正常、关节清晰，手指与鞋跟接触关系合理；古典发髻结构完整稳定，蓝色蝴蝶、珠花与流苏有明确固定位置和重力方向；纱衣保持真实透明层次、刺绣附着于布料表面，衣褶遵循坐姿与重力；画面干净清晰，减少无必要噪点与颗粒感，粒子特效克制，避免大面积漂浮颗粒、碎光和杂质感，整体细节稳定、减少脏乱感。

Output Specs： 9:16 竖幅，高分辨率真人古风摄影，重点保证古典高髻、冰蓝蝴蝶发饰、低头表情、蓝色刺绣薄纱、交叠长腿、手部穿鞋动作和白色尖头细高跟鞋的准确度。

核心压缩公式：

成年古典仕女 + 冰蓝大体积古典高髻 + 蓝蝶珠花流苏 + 湖蓝半透明刺绣汉服 + 浅粉长裙 + 园林回廊长椅 + 低头穿白色尖头细高跟鞋 + 双腿交叠前伸 + 自然散射日光 + 手机古风妆造随拍

items.title: 章节式影像档案编辑海报

prompts.text:
Design a 3:4 vertical "Chapter-style Image Archive" editorial poster for [Character Story / Travel Record / Brand Project / Film Archive / Architectural Project].

The overall design uses a warm off-white background and restrained vertical grids. The image is quiet, clear, and has the texture of a photography book and archival publication.

[Main Image]

Place a core photographic work in the center of the frame, occupying about 50%—65% of the total area.

The main image must carry the primary emotion of this chapter and can use a full horizontal or vertical photography composition.

Retain the real environment, natural light, real character states, and slight film grain. Do not use complex cutouts or add decorative special effects.

The main image highlights only one core scene, such as:
Character working state
A certain moment during travel
The final outcome of a brand project
Behind-the-scenes film set
Actual usage state in an architectural space

[Chapter Index]

Set a narrow vertical "Chapter Index" on the left side of the frame.

Use unified numbering rules, for example:

1.1 First Encounter
1.2 Departure
1.3 Turning Point
1.4 Accumulation

Current chapter uses darker text or a low-saturation accent color to stand out, while other chapters have reduced contrast.

Chapter numbers must maintain consistent font, position, and spacing so that the audience can clearly feel the reading order.

[Auxiliary Image]

Allow the addition of 1 partial detail image, slightly overlapping the edge of the main image.

The auxiliary image can only supplement details not seen in the main image, such as:
Hand movements
Object close-ups
Tickets
Manuscripts
Building materials
Product packaging
Behind-the-scenes records

The auxiliary image must not be the same size as the main image; do not create an ordinary collage.

[Next Chapter Hint]

Reveal approximately 5%—10% of the next chapter's image edge at the bottom right of the frame.

Display only a very small part, such as:
The color of the next photo
The edge of a building
Character outlines
Natural landscapes
A small segment of a night scene

Create a visual hint that "the page is continuing."

[Information System]

Retain only four core pieces of information below the main image:

Project Name
Location
Year
Medium

Keep the text brief; do not write long explanations.

[Typography]

Titles use a restrained neutral sans-serif font.

Project name is slightly larger.

Location, year, number, and medium use small monospaced fonts or narrow sans-serif fonts.

The overall layout has a combined sense of museum gallery labels, photography books, and film slate archives.

[Color Palette]

Mainly warm off-white, charcoal black, warm gray, and the natural colors of the photo itself.

Allow the addition of only one low-saturation accent color, such as:
Dark red
Moss green
Gray-blue

The accent color is only used for the current chapter number or a minimal amount of positioning information.

[Overall Requirements]

The image has:
A sense of continuity
A sense of time
A sense of archive
A sense of publication
A sense of photographic narrative

prompts.text:
为【人物故事 / 旅行记录 / 品牌项目 / 电影档案 / 建筑项目】设计一张3:4竖版“章节式影像档案”编辑海报。

整体采用暖米白背景与克制的纵向网格，画面安静、清晰、具有摄影画册和档案出版物的质感。

【主影像】

画面中央放置一张占整体约50%—65%的核心摄影作品。

主影像必须承担这一章节的主要情绪，可以采用完整横向或竖向摄影构图。

保留真实环境、自然光线、真实人物状态和轻微胶片颗粒，不做复杂抠图，不添加装饰性特效。

主影像只突出一个核心场景，例如：
人物工作状态
旅行途中某个瞬间
品牌项目最终成果
电影幕后现场
建筑空间中的真实使用状态

【章节索引】

在画面左侧设置一条窄幅纵向“章节索引”。

使用统一编号规则，例如：

1.1 初识
1.2 启程
1.3 转折
1.4 沉淀

当前章节使用较深文字或一种低饱和强调色突出，其余章节降低对比度。

章节编号必须保持统一字体、位置和间距，让观众能够清楚感受到阅读顺序。

【辅助影像】

允许加入1张局部细节图片，轻微叠压主影像边缘。

辅助图片只能补充主影像中没有被看见的细节，例如：
手部动作
物件特写
车票
手稿
建筑材料
产品包装
幕后记录

辅助图片不得与主影像同等大小，不要形成普通拼贴画。

【下一章节提示】

在画面右下方露出下一章节约5%—10%的图像边缘。

只展示极小的一部分，例如：
下一张照片的颜色
建筑边缘
人物轮廓
自然景观
一小段夜景

形成“页面正在继续”的视觉暗示。

【信息系统】

主影像下方只保留四项核心信息：

项目名称
地点
年份
媒介

文字保持简短，不写长段说明。

【字体】

标题使用克制的中性无衬线字体。

项目名称稍大。

地点、年份、编号和媒介使用小号等宽字体或窄体无衬线字体。

整体排版具有美术馆展签、摄影画册和电影场记档案的结合感。

【配色】

以暖米白、炭黑、暖灰和照片自身自然色彩为主。

只允许加入一种低饱和强调色，例如：
暗红
苔藓绿
灰蓝

强调色只用于当前章节编号或极少量定位信息。

【整体要求】

画面具有：
连续感
时间感
档案感
出版物感
摄影叙事感

Theme:
Mountain scenery after soaking in a hot spring

Subject:
In a Japanese-style open-air hot spring in the mountains, an adult woman is alone, covered longitudinally from her chest to the front of her thighs with a white bath towel. A portrait of her upper body and thighs, positioned center-right, leaning against wet rocks and the hot spring pool, with her upper body slightly leaning forward toward the camera.

Person · Expression:
Small oval face, rounded chin, brown large almond-shaped eyes, slender natural eyebrows, small nose, light coral lips. Looking directly at the camera, showing teeth slightly in a soft smile. Dark brown hair tied casually in a small bun near the top of the head, with thin bangs and long strands on the left and right falling from the cheeks to the neck. Natural light makeup, bright and smooth skin.

Clothing · Pose:
Not showing clothes or swimwear, only firmly covered from the chest and front of the body with a single thick white towel-textured bath towel. The person's own right hand is pressed against the chest to fix the upper end of the bath towel, and the left arm extends downward to hold the lower end of the bath towel. The waist is moved toward the right side of the frame, while both shoulders and the head are tilted toward the left side of the frame, leaning the body forward.

Background · Lighting:
To the rear left is a serene grey-blue hot spring pool and steam, surrounded by wet, glowing black natural stones. The middle ground is enclosed by a horizontally long green bamboo fence, with a dark wooden azumaya roof and beams at the top. The far background on the left consists of faintly misty mountains and deciduous trees. The low morning sun at the rear right of the frame serves as the main light source, creating a soft backlighting silhouette on the hair and shoulders, and casting a gentle diffused light on the face.

Composition · Lens:
Horizontal 4:3. A natural horizontal perspective taken from an angle slightly lower than the character's eye level. The character is placed center-right in a large proportion, with the frame containing from the head to the mid-thigh. The left half retains the depth of the hot spring pool and mountains, with the azumaya roof diagonally enclosing the top edge. Focus on the face and body, with the mountains and trees in the far background softly blurred with a shallow depth of field.

Texture · Style:
High-precision photorealistic hot spring photograph. Naturally depicts the fine towel texture of the white bath towel, reflections on wet rocks, fine ripples on the water surface, and the textures of bamboo and wood. Based on calm grey-green and wood-brown tones, layered with the warm tones of the morning sun to create a clean and serene atmosphere.

Negative:
Do not change the towel position to avoid exposing the chest; do not change the open-air hot spring to an indoor bathhouse.

不改变浴巾位置以避免露出胸口；不将露天温泉改为室内浴场

prompts.text: 9:16 vertical version, modern oriental papercut art, modern oriental papercut art, layered paper cut illustration, dimensional paper sculpture, intricate paper carving, paper diorama, layered shadow box, epic oriental papercraft fantasy, contemporary oriental art poster. The theme of the work is "She sees the royal city rising behind the gates." The core narrative of the scene is: a young oriental woman passes through layers of nested giant paper art arches and sees a long-sleeping paper-carved royal city rising from the sea of clouds at the end of the gates. She stands before the long stairs leading to the royal city, realizing she has finally reached the threshold where fate truly begins. The entire picture emphasizes the grand sense of order of "doors within doors," the shock of the royal city slowly appearing from the depths of the sea of clouds, and the epic entrance quality leading to a higher world. The main character is an oriental adult female with a visual age of about 24, clear-headed and independent, mysterious and elegant, with a sense of calmness when facing fate. The character has a delicate oval face, slender almond eyes slightly raised, a quiet and focused gaze, and an expression of restraint with a slight shock. The character uses oriental paper art illustration-style modeling, not real photo texture, nor over-cartoonized. The character's hairstyle and headwear are: long black hair half-draped and half-tied, hair strands extending into flowing hollow paper ribbons, wearing small light-gold flower branches and crescent moon hair ornaments. The headwear is exquisite and light, not complex or tall. The long hair and silk drape extend backward in the high-altitude breeze, creating a sense of flow. The character's clothing is: an ivory white and deep fog blue paper art long dress, with the hem edge featuring arch, ripple, and star-point hollow structures, the outer silk drape is light and slender, with local light gold paper foil details. The clothing must have a clear multi-layer paper structure, fine-cut edges, hollow patterns, paper thickness, fiber texture, and slight creases, overall gorgeous, clear, and light. The dream carrier is: a group of nested giant paper art arches. Dream imagery includes: arches, royal city, sea of clouds, flying birds, long stairs, distant mountains. All door frames, long stairs, clouds, royal cities, mountains, flying birds, and decorative elements are unified into a highly completed three-dimensional paper carving language. The overall papercut structure adopts: a multi-layer stage style. Composition and lens requirements: From foreground to background, multiple giant arches progress layer by layer, forming a very strong oppressive perspective space and rhythmic order. The center of the screen is a long staircase and longitudinal passage leading to the distant royal city, with multiple giant arches continuously nested, forming a mythological entrance of "doors within doors." The character is located in a relatively small position in the lower center of the screen, with her back or semi-side back to the camera, standing in front of or walking towards the long stairs, serving as an emotional anchor in the vast space. High in the distance, the royal city rises from the sea of clouds, located after multiple arches overlap, becoming the final visual focus. The arches must be very huge, and the foreground door frames can even exceed the edges of the screen. Door frames, lintels, pillars, inner arches, and outer arches all bear high-precision paper carving hollow patterns, including cloud patterns, spiral patterns, star points, flying birds, waves, and oriental geometric patterns. The scale of each weight of the door decreases clearly, the repetitive rhythm is strong, forming an epic mythological entrance feeling. The distant royal city must be huge, gorgeous, and sacred, floating as a whole in the depths of the sea of clouds, composed of multiple layers of palaces, pavilions, towers, arches, and the main hall. The royal city is not an ordinary group of buildings, but like a sky royal city awakening from sleep, with the central main hall illuminated by bright sky light and the surrounding palaces unfolding layer by layer. The edge of the royal city is slightly translucent, and the sea of clouds surges below it, making the royal city look as if it has just risen from the sea of clouds. The character must be clearly small and cannot become a close-up. She is just a small figure in the huge paper art space, used to set off the hugeness of the arches and the distance of the royal city. The character can stand at the starting point of the long stairs, her body facing the distant royal city, her long hair and silk drape extending backward, forming a forward and upward momentum. The overall color scheme is: ivory white, deep fog blue, and light gold as the main colors, with a small amount of cool gray for balance. On this basis, the colors should be slightly more saturated than the basic version, but still remain high-end, transparent, and clear, not dirty, not gray, and not vulgar. Ivory white is used for door frames, long stairs, cloud highlights, and the main body of the royal city; deep fog blue is used for the inner walls of doors, distant mountains, shadow layers, and the inner layers of character clothing; light gold is used for outlines, hollow details, star points, and highlight decorations; a small amount of cool gray is only used for the deepest space balance. The overall screen requires clear, bright, airy sense and high-end completeness like a paper art display cabinet. Lighting and paper texture are: bright sky light from the direction of the distant royal city enters through layers of arches, the shadow of the door frame paper layers is clear, the edge of the royal city is slightly translucent, and the paper thickness, cut edges, and textures are finely visible. The overall picture adopts bright and transparent high-altitude sky light, with moderate fusion of cold and warm, not darkened or blacked out. Strengthen the following paper art details: clear paper fibers, manual cutting marks, paper layer thickness, layered shadows, edge translucency, and fine hollow patterns of door frames and clouds. The overall effect should present a more exquisite, clearer, and more high-end paper carving poster feeling. The overall picture has the sense of modern oriental paper carving art, giant paper art mythological scenes, sky royal cities, epic dream entrances, and high-end art posters. Emphasize the "epic mythological entrance" atmosphere: characters are extremely small, arches are huge and rhythmic, the distant royal city rises shockingly, the spatial layers are extremely deep, the picture is bright and transparent, the colors are slightly more saturated, and the overall look is clear and not gray. Supplementary requirements: The character must be small, the arch must be huge and have a clear repetitive rhythm, strengthening the sense of "epic mythological entrance"; the color is slightly more saturated, the overall feeling is clearer and brighter, avoiding grayness and dullness. Negative Prompt: Minors, childish face, real photo photography, ordinary anime, plastic 3D, resin material, clay, felt, children's handmade, ordinary ancient style door opening, modern arch, royal city too small, character too large, character close-up, crowded scene, too few door frames, no repetitive rhythm, no depth, no sea of clouds, royal city not obvious, gray picture, dead black shadows, overall yellowish, overall blue in a mess, chaotic paper layers, blurry paper edges, fragmented materials, hand deformity, extra characters, text, Logo, watermark.

prompts.text:
9:16竖版，现代东方女性梦境立体剪纸艺术，modern oriental papercut art，layered paper cut illustration，dimensional paper sculpture，intricate paper carving，paper diorama，layered shadow box，epic oriental papercraft fantasy，contemporary oriental art poster。

作品主题为“她在群门之后看见王城升起”。

画面核心叙事为：一位年轻东方女性穿过层层相套的巨大纸艺拱门，在群门尽头看见一座沉睡已久的纸雕王城从云海中升起。她站在通往王城的长阶之前，意识到自己终于走到了命运真正开始的门槛上。整个画面强调“门中有门”的宏大秩序感、王城从云海深处缓缓显现的震撼感，以及通往更高世界的史诗式入口气质。

主体人物为视觉年龄约24岁的东方成年女性，清醒独立、神秘优雅，带有面对命运时的冷静感。人物拥有清秀鹅蛋脸，细长杏眼微微抬起，目光安静而专注，神情克制中带有轻微震撼。人物采用东方纸艺插画式塑形，不是真人摄影质感，也不过度卡通化。

人物发型与头饰为：黑色长发半披半挽，发丝延展成流动镂空纸带，佩戴浅金小型花枝与月牙发饰。头饰精致轻盈，不复杂、不高耸。长发和披帛在高处微风中向后延展，形成流动感。

人物服装为：象牙白与深雾蓝纸艺长裙，裙摆边缘带有拱门、波纹与星点镂空结构，外层披帛轻盈修长，局部带浅金纸箔细节。服装必须具有清晰的多层纸片结构、精细裁切边缘、镂空纹样、纸张厚度、纤维纹理与轻微折痕，整体华丽、明净、轻盈。

梦境载体为：层层相套的巨型纸艺拱门群。

梦境意象包括：拱门、王城、云海、飞鸟、长阶、远山。所有门框、长阶、云层、王城、山脉、飞鸟与装饰元素均统一为高完成度立体纸雕语言。

整体剪纸结构采用：多层舞台式。

构图与镜头要求：从前景到远景由多重巨型拱门层层递进，形成极强的压迫性透视空间与秩序节奏。画面中心是一条通向远方王城的长阶和纵向通道，多个巨大拱门不断嵌套，形成“门中有门”的神话入口。人物位于画面下方中央偏小位置，背对或半侧背对镜头，站在长阶前方或正走向长阶，作为巨大空间中的情绪锚点。远方高处，王城从云海中升起，位于多个拱门套叠之后，成为最终视觉焦点。

拱门必须非常巨大，前景门框甚至可以超出画面边缘。门框、门楣、柱体、内拱和外拱都带有高精度纸雕镂空纹样，包括云纹、旋纹、星点、飞鸟、波浪和东方几何花纹。每一重门的尺度递减清晰，重复节奏强烈，形成史诗神话入口感。

远方王城必须巨大、华丽、神圣，整体漂浮在云海深处，由多层宫阙、殿阁、塔楼、拱门与主殿共同组成。王城不是普通建筑群，而像一座从沉睡中苏醒的天空王城，中心主殿被明亮天光照亮，周围群殿层层展开。王城边缘轻微透光，云海在其下方翻涌，使王城仿佛刚刚从云海中升起。

人物必须明显偏小，不能成为大特写。她只是庞大纸艺空间中的一点身影，用来衬托拱门的巨大与王城的遥远。人物可站在长阶起点，身体朝向远方王城，长发与披帛向后延展，形成向前与向上的动势。

整体色彩方案为：象牙白、深雾蓝、浅金为主，少量冷灰平衡。在此基础上，颜色要比基础版稍微更饱和一些，但仍保持高级、通透、清澈，不脏、不灰、不俗艳。象牙白用于门框、长阶、云层高光与王城主体；深雾蓝用于门内壁、远山、阴影层和人物服装内层；浅金用于描边、镂空细节、星点与高光装饰；少量冷灰只用于最深层空间平衡。整体画面要求清透、明亮、有空气感和纸艺展柜般的高级完成度。

光线与纸张质感为：远处王城方向的明亮天光穿过层层拱门照入，门框纸层投影清晰，王城边缘轻微透光，纸张厚度、裁切边缘和纹理精细可见。画面整体采用明亮通透的高空天光，冷暖适度融合，不压暗、不压黑。强化以下纸艺细节：清晰纸张纤维、手工裁切痕迹、纸层厚度、层叠投影、边缘透光感、门框和云层的细密镂空纹样。整体要呈现更精致、更清透、更有高级纸雕海报感的效果。

画面整体具有现代东方纸雕艺术、巨型纸艺神话场景、天空王城、史诗级梦境入口和高级艺术海报感。强调“史诗神话入口”氛围：人物极小，拱门巨大且节奏强烈，远方王城震撼升起，空间层次极深，画面明亮通透，色彩稍微更饱和，整体清透而不灰蒙。

补充要求：人物必须小，拱门必须巨大且有明显重复节奏，强化“史诗神话入口”感；色彩稍微更饱和一些，整体感觉更清透、更明亮，避免灰蒙和闷暗。

负面提示词：未成年人，幼态脸，真人摄影，普通动漫，塑料3D，树脂材质，黏土，毛毡，儿童手工，普通古风门洞，现代拱门，王城过小，人物过大，人物特写，场景拥挤，门框太少，没有重复节奏，没有纵深，没有云海，王城不明显，画面灰蒙，暗部死黑，整体偏黄，整体偏蓝成一团，纸层混乱，纸张边缘模糊，材质割裂，手部畸形，多余人物，文字，Logo，水印。

prompts.text:
Theme:
Gazing at the flower garden from the window

Subject:
An adult woman wearing light water-blue loungewear stands alone by an open white wooden frame window. Both hands rest on the windowsill as she gazes at the courtyard, turning back toward the camera from the center of the frame, a portrait from the head to the thighs.

Person and Expression:
Small oval face and rounded chin, dark brown almond-shaped eyes, detailed natural eyebrows, small nose, pale pink lips. The face turns from the person's own right shoulder toward the upper right of the frame, eyes cast toward the upper part of the courtyard, a serene profile with lips slightly parted. Dark brown chin-length bob, slightly center-parted, thin bangs, fine strands of hair along the cheeks, ends slightly flipped outward. Light eye makeup and faint blush, soft skin under warm natural light.

Clothing and Pose:
A thin-strap cropped camisole top made of light greyish-blue fine rib material, and matching fitted shorts. Trimmings and straps are white. Standing indoors, leaning deeply toward the window from above the waist, arms straightened with hands placed on the wooden windowsill. Back to the camera, waist positioned toward the left of the frame, with only the face turned back to the right.

Background and Lighting:
To the left of the frame is a white wall, translucent beige lace curtains, a small wooden dressing table, and a white flower vase. To the lower right is a potted plant in a wicker basket, with beige bedding at the bottom edge. Outside the open window is a courtyard with densely arranged purple, white, and pale pink flowers and green potted plants, a white lounger, and a large beige parasol. Warm and soft direct sunlight enters from the top right of the frame, outlining the hair, shoulders, back, and waist, casting shadows of leaves on the windowsill and interior.

Composition and Camera:
Vertical 3:4. Photographed from a position slightly lower than the waist, with a back-diagonal near-level perspective. The subject is placed in a large position left of center, including from the head to the mid-thigh, with the thighs cropped at the bottom edge. The window frame is used as a vertical frame to surround the person and the courtyard, with the curtains on the left and the potted plant on the lower right creating a sense of depth. Focus on the face and back, with the depth of the courtyard softly blurred with medium depth of field.

Texture and Style:
High-precision photorealistic photo. Softly depicts fine rib fabric, short hair, wooden frames, thin curtains, flowers, and leaves in natural morning light. A bright and peaceful country cottage style color palette dominated by light water-blue, beige, and green.

Negative Prompt:
Avoid front-facing or upright standing poses; do not omit the courtyard and the open wooden frame window.

prompts.text: [人物] 图像 1 [签名] 右下角有 Meta 运营的 Threads 标志小巧地放置着，其上方以白色手写体小字写着“CHAse”，如同签名一般。  [人物的姿势及表情]  姿势及构图：人物的脸部右侧（画面基准左侧）以斜线方式充满整个画面的极端宏观极限特写（Extreme Close-up）几何肖像构图。  姿势：与相机镜头近在咫尺，前额覆盖的碎发间清晰露出单侧瞳孔。  表情：以神秘而阴冷的眼神牢牢凝视相机。微微张开的嘴唇和僵硬的五官营造出类似神秘惊悚电影中一幕的诡异而令人毛骨悚然的深层叙事。  [人物服装及道具]  服装：由于特写特性，服装元素被排除，视线100%集中在人物的皮肤和五官本身。  道具（身体艺术细节）：脸部手写汉字（축경），深黑色的墨水汉字（축문/축경）字句被抄写在脸颊、鼻梁、颌线上方，赋予强烈的诡异咒术般的焦点。  珠宝：耳垂末端微微露出闪烁着微光的迷你银质耳钉。  [人物发型及化妆细节]  发型：不规则遮盖眉毛和眼周的蓬乱细长深黑碎发（Messy dark bangs）风格。发丝凌乱地垂落额前，加倍营造出令人毛骨悚然的迷人光环。  化妆：基于调低色调的冷峻无血色苍白（Pale）皮肤底妆，运用清晰的眼线和阴影眼影表现深邃的眼部轮廓。嘴唇以调低色调的裸色玫瑰粉光泽唇结束，带有湿润的水感和纵向唇纹细节。  [照明及光线方向]  光源：从被摄体左侧正面渗入的低矮昏暗低照度工作室阴影照明（Low-key directional light）。  效果：光线清晰突出接触到的皮肤部位和汉字字句，同时右侧发丝及周边沉入深邃的黑暗（Chiaroscuro），营造出诡异而宏大的神秘电影特有的悬念。  [质感与色调氛围（核心质感细节）]  色彩：皮肤的冷峻毛毡灰·米色、汉字与发丝的绝对墨黑（Jet Black），以及唇部的细微勃艮第粉色，以沉降的色调和谐融合成“神秘黑暗电影风（Occult Dark Cinematic）”色彩氛围。  质感细节（特殊分析）：  粗糙胶片颗粒质感：整个画面被非常密集而粗糙的 35mm 模拟高-ISO 胶片噪点（Coarse ISO Grain）颗粒覆盖，形成刺痛般的质感，完成电影预告海报的经典感。  墨水/身体彩绘质感：如渗入皮肤凹凸和毛孔般绘制的黑色毛笔墨水的哑光平滑吸收质感。  嘴唇水分质感：在粗糙胶片噪点中唯独有机闪烁的光泽唇的顺滑湿润感和纵向唇皱纹细节。  [胶片及相机镜头景深、角度]  构图及角度：从人物眼高贴近到可见毛孔和瞳孔纹理的宏观肖像角度。  特征：施加极度浅的景深（Ultra-shallow DoF），如刀刃般（Sharp Focus）对焦于人物的瞳孔和脸颊上的汉字“司”、“我”，而眼前垂落的刘海和背景黑暗则与胶片噪点一同柔和地虚焦处理。  [背景及工作室布局元素]  空间：只有漆黑般的黑暗和阴影存在的冷峻而隐秘的电影般背景。  排版及杂志/海报布局：  上方：以细长的白色衬线字体叠加演出语句“*THE BLACK FILM”。  中央：人物五官中央整齐排列的演员姓名“CHASE”、副标题“Interstellar Traveler”，以及下方字间距拉宽的宏大白色主标题“H U S H”叠加。  下方：下方中央整洁摆放的白色无衬线开映语句“ONLY IN THREADS”排版。

Hair styling by the green window

By a window where bright green is visible, an adult woman wearing a white bandeau-style triangle bikini top is alone. Arms are raised, she is fixing her hair, a portrait from the chest up occupying a large space in the center of the frame.

Character・Expression:
Slightly slender oval face and small chin, large dark brown almond-shaped eyes, slender and soft eyebrows, straight and small nose, lustrous pale pink lips. Gaze looking directly at the camera, a calm expression with lips slightly closed. Dark brown hair, nearly black, casually tied into a bun towards the back of the crown, with a centered parting, long thin bangs reaching the eyes, and fine loose strands hanging from the left and right cheeks to the neck. Refined eyeliner, elegant blush, bright and natural skin tone.

Clothing・Pose:
White fine ribbed fabric bandeau-style triangle swimwear top. Small gold rings at the base of the thin neck straps, styled with a simple thin horizontal band tied under the chest. Both arms raised above the head, left hand placed behind the neck, right hand lightly touching the bun on the crown, a natural pose in the middle of fixing hair.

Background・Lighting:
Large windows or openings fill the background, with vibrant green leaves and white light outside presented in a large bokeh effect. Slender indoor plant leaves on the left side of the frame, and a thin wooden frame on the right side. Soft backlighting and diffused light from the window serve as the main light, brightly outlining the hair, raised arms, and shoulders, while the face is illuminated with uniform and soft fill light.

Composition・Lens:
Vertical 3:4. A close-up portrait shot horizontally from the front with the camera at the same height as the subject's gaze. The bun and right hand are placed near the upper edge, with the left and right elbows and forearms naturally cropped at the edges of the frame, and below the chest cropped at the bottom edge. The face is positioned slightly above the center of the frame and is large, with the arms forming a triangle encircling the face. Focused on both eyes, the background is strongly blurred with an extremely shallow depth of field.

Texture・Style:
High-key, high-precision photorealistic realistic photo. Natural depiction of thin swimwear fabric, skin, eyelashes, and soft hair without a wet feel. A clean and refreshing summer light dominated by white, skin tones, and bright green.

Do not let hair hang loose; do not let arms hang down or the face be turned sideways

prompts.text: Create a **9:16 vertical, clean photographic image with absolutely no interface or text overlays**. An adult woman in her 20s is seated on a pale floor at the base of a rough gray-white plaster wall. Her torso leans slightly backward toward the wall, with one hand planted on the floor just behind and beside her body for support. She has natural black medium-long to long hair, loosely side-parted and disturbed by a light breeze; some strands touch the wall while others lift irregularly around her head. Keep small flyaway hairs, slight frizz and believable disorder instead of polished commercial hair styling.  She wears a fitted black lace spaghetti-strap camisole or lingerie-inspired top with a subtle scalloped lace edge. An oversized black shirt or lightweight jacket is loosely draped around her, slipping off the shoulders and naturally pooling around her arms and sides. Pair it with black fitted bottoms, deep-red semi-sheer thigh-high stockings with a darker red upper welt, and vivid red patent pointed or narrow-toed stiletto heels. The hosiery must remain genuinely semi-transparent so the warm skin tone is still visible underneath the red material; do not turn the stockings into opaque leggings.  Keep the pose noticeably asymmetrical and slightly accidental. One leg is bent upward with the knee extremely close to the camera, occupying a large central-lower portion of the foreground and appearing larger because of wide-angle perspective. The other leg bends and then extends diagonally toward the lower-right edge, naturally approaching or even slightly leaving the frame. Do not square the torso or shoulders perfectly. Preserve a mild body twist, realistic weight distribution and believable muscular tension, as though she had been adjusting her posture a second ago and has only now briefly become still.  Place her face in the upper half of the composition. Her eyes are slightly heavy-lidded and directed toward the low-positioned camera, carrying a calm, cool and faintly tired expression. Her lips remain naturally closed or softly relaxed, with no deliberate smile. Preserve natural facial proportions and subtle asymmetry. Use a restrained East Asian fashion-editorial makeup direction: clean semi-matte complexion, naturally elongated brows, thin dark brown-black eyeliner extending slightly outward, separated lashes without oversized falsies, subtle under-eye definition, and muted rose-brown or dusty red lips. Avoid heavy Western-style contouring.  Visible skin includes the face, neck, shoulders, collarbones and upper-chest edge, both arms and hands, and a narrow area of upper thigh/hip above the stocking welt. Use a light to light-medium warm complexion with gentle peach-beige undertones. Skin should look refined but genuinely human rather than airbrushed: visually warm, soft and slightly velvety to the touch, with subtle pores, natural color variation around joints and realistic surface contours.  Photograph the scene as though a friend captured a spontaneous smartphone frame from close range, not as a professional studio campaign. Use approximately a **24–28mm full-frame-equivalent wide-angle perspective**. Position the camera close to seated leg height, clearly below her eyes, and angle it slightly upward. This should exaggerate the raised knee and foreground legs through perspective while allowing the face to appear comparatively smaller. Use moderate smartphone-style depth of field: the face, torso and much of the foreground legs remain readable, while the rough wall texture is still clearly visible. Avoid exaggerated creamy bokeh.  Illuminate the subject mainly with a single warm directional source entering from frame-right or front-right, resembling late-afternoon window light or warm ambient side light. Let it strike the right side of her cheek, shoulder, upper-chest edge and legs, producing soft highlights that gradually fall into shadow. The side close to the wall, the black outer garment and the opposite side of the body remain naturally darker. Let the right half of the wall become slightly brighter so its uneven plaster creates many tiny highlight-and-shadow variations. Do not add ring-light catchlights, obvious rim lighting, perfect fill light or a conventional three-point studio setup.  Maintain a strong red, black and pale-gray color relationship. The overall mood is cool, languid and quiet, carrying the remaining warmth of a moment just before night. It should feel like a real frame pulled from a casual smartphone video: the hair is still moving, the composition is slightly offset, legs and shoes approach the edges, the wall and floor can contain small authentic marks or scuffs, and the image retains subtle smartphone noise, compression character and mild computational sharpening. Avoid polished commercial perfection.  **Remove every element belonging to the original social-media screenshot.** No top status bar, clock, battery icon, 5G or Wi-Fi indicator, menu, search icon, like/comment/favorite/share buttons, profile avatar, follow button, username, captions, hashtags, music bar, bottom navigation, platform watermark, logo, text overlay or any other app-interface component. The final image must read purely as a clean photograph, never as a screenshot.  Negative prompt: UI, app interface, status bar, icons, text overlay, subtitle, username, watermark, logo, like button, comment button, share button, navigation bar, phone in hand, mirror selfie, ring light, commercial studio glamour, plastic skin, over-retouched skin, extreme body proportions, extra limbs, deformed hands, opaque red leggings, heavy bokeh, perfect symmetry.

prompts.text:
Create a vertical 9:16 premium travel poster for {DESTINATION / CITY}, designed as a minimal handcrafted layered paper-cut collage.

Use a warm off-white background with subtle matte cardstock texture, visible fine paper fibers, crisp cut edges, soft dimensional relief, and delicate contact shadows.

Reserve the upper 22–25% as open negative space. Center the title “{DESTINATION / CITY}” at the top in dark navy uppercase geometric sans-serif lettering with wide tracking. No other text.

Below the title, include only two or three small minimal white paper clouds. Do not include any sun, circle, red dot, decorative disk, or similar graphic element.

Feature {PRIMARY LANDMARK / ICONIC ARCHITECTURE} as the single dominant centerpiece. Keep it simplified, iconic, and immediately recognizable, preserving only its most defining architectural forms and proportions. Avoid intricate sculptural detail. Reduce the landmark to clear layered paper shapes with elegant symmetry and strong silhouette.

Introduce {SECONDARY STRUCTURAL ELEMENT / ROAD / BRIDGE / LANDSCAPE FEATURE} as one smooth, simple paper form across the lower-middle composition. Behind the main landmark, place only a few simplified {CITY / DESTINATION} silhouettes as flat supporting layers, with {DISTANT LANDMARK} subtly hinted in the background if appropriate.

In the foreground, add a very minimal streetscape or environmental layer: a few soft sage paper tree shapes, one or two pale paving or ground layers, and exactly one small {SIGNATURE CITY ELEMENT / VEHICLE / OBJECT} as the single characteristic detail.

Keep the composition sparse, calm, balanced, and highly legible. Use only a small number of clean paper layers across foreground, middle ground, and background. Favor bold silhouettes over detail.

Limited palette: warm ivory, deep navy blue, muted blue-gray, sage green, plus one restrained accent color appropriate to the destination. Keep saturation sophisticated and subdued.

Use soft studio light from the upper left, casting subtle shadows toward the lower right. The overall effect should feel like a refined editorial paper collage: minimal, elegant, tactile, handcrafted, and premium.

No people, photorealism, painterly effects, neon colors, dense detail, complex windows, heavy gradients, thick outlines, clutter, logos, watermark, border, extra text, duplicate landmarks, or unnecessary decorative elements.

prompts.text:
为{目的地/城市}创建一张 9:16 的纵向高级旅游海报，设计风格为极简手工叠层剪纸拼贴。

使用暖白色背景，带有细微的哑光卡纸纹理、可见的细微纸张纤维、利落的剪切边缘、柔和的立体浮雕效果以及细腻的接触阴影。

保留顶部 22–25% 的空间作为开放负空间。在顶部中心放置大写的深蓝色几何无衬线字体标题“{DESTINATION / CITY}”，并使用宽间距。不添加其他文字。

标题下方仅包含两到三朵极简的白色纸云。不要包含太阳、圆圈、红点、装饰性圆盘或类似的图形元素。

以{主要地标/标志性建筑}作为唯一的视觉中心。保持其简化、标志性且易于辨认，仅保留其最定义的建筑形态和比例。避免复杂的雕塑细节。将地标简化为具有优雅对称性和强剪影效果的清晰叠层纸张形状。

在构图的中下部引入{次要结构元素/道路/桥梁/景观特征}作为一种平滑、简单的纸张形式。在主地标后面，仅放置几个简化的{城市/目的地}轮廓作为扁平的支撑层，如果合适，在背景中隐约暗示{远景地标}。

在前景中，添加一个非常简约的街景或环境层：几个柔和的鼠尾草绿纸质树木形状，一两个浅色铺面或地面层，以及正好一个小型{特征城市元素/车辆/物体}作为唯一的特色细节。

保持构图稀疏、平静、平衡且高度易读。在前景、中景和背景中仅使用少量的整洁纸层。比起细节，更倾向于大胆的剪影。

限制色调：暖象牙色、深海军蓝、柔和的蓝灰色、鼠尾草绿，外加一种适合目的地的内敛点缀色。保持饱和度高雅且柔和。

使用来自左上角的柔和摄影棚光线，向右下方投射微妙的阴影。整体效果应该感觉像精致的社论纸质拼贴：极简、优雅、有触感、手工制作且高端。

不包含人物、写实主义、绘画效果、霓虹色、密集细节、复杂窗户、重度渐变、粗轮廓、杂乱、标志、水印、边框、额外文字、重复地标或不必要的装饰元素。

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 high-fashion editorial poster built around the interaction between portrait photography, typography, structure, and physical space.

Subject: [male / female fashion model]
Outfit: [minimal tailoring / black fashion / white suit / structured styling]
Palette: [black + acid lime / ivory + burgundy / black + teal / custom palette]
Title: [TITLE]
Design direction: [oversized type / acrylic frame / vertical slicing / structural layout]

Start with a strong fashion photograph: realistic skin, refined facial features, expressive pose, detailed fabric, controlled studio lighting, and premium magazine quality.

Then make the graphic design physically interact with the subject instead of simply placing text around the portrait.

Directions:

• Oversized type × figure
Use extremely large typography that extends beyond the canvas. Let the subject pass in front of some letters and behind others, creating foreground/background depth.

• Acrylic form × spatial layering
Introduce a transparent glass or acrylic frame with visible thickness, reflections, edge highlights and subtle refraction. Let the subject touch, enter or intersect the structure.

• Vertical slices × portrait
Reconstruct one portrait through 4–5 unequal vertical image sections with visible gaps and subtle positional shifts. Keep the main facial features readable and attractive.

• Fashion × structural layout
Use a strong fashion pose, geometric color fields, oversized typography and architectural framing. Let the body, furniture, color blocks and type form one unified composition.

Keep typography bold but controlled: one dominant title, one short supporting phrase and minimal micro-text.

Use asymmetrical composition, strong scale contrast, intentional negative space, layering, cropping and selective color accents.

The final image should feel like a premium fashion campaign, experimental magazine cover or contemporary exhibition key visual.

prompts.text:
创建一个 9:16 的高端时尚社论海报，核心围绕人像摄影、排版、结构和物理空间之间的相互作用。

主体：[男性 / 女性 时尚模特]
服装：[极简裁剪 / 黑色时尚 / 白色西装 / 结构化造型]
色调：[黑色 + 荧光青 / 象牙白 + 酒红 / 黑色 + 蓝绿 / 自定义色调]
标题：[标题]
设计方向：[超大字体 / 亚克力框架 / 垂直切片 / 结构化布局]

从一张强大的时尚照片开始：真实的皮肤、精致的面部特征、富有表现力的姿势、细致的面料、可控的摄影棚灯光以及优质的杂志质量。

然后让平面设计与主体产生物理上的互动，而不仅仅是在肖像周围放置文本。

方向：

• 超大字体 × 人物
使用超出画布的极大排版。让主体穿过某些字母的前面并位于其他字母的后面，创造出前景/背景的深度。

• 亚克力形态 × 空间分层
引入具有可见厚度、反射、边缘高光和微妙折射的透明玻璃或亚克力框架。让主体接触、进入或与结构相交。

• 垂直切片 × 肖像
通过 4–5 个不等宽且具有可见间隙和微妙位置偏移的垂直图像部分重新构建一个肖像。保持主要面部特征的可读性和吸引力。

• 时尚 × 结构化布局
使用强大的时尚姿势、几何色域、超大排版和建筑构图。让身体、家具、色块和字体形成一个统一的构图。

保持排版大胆但受控：一个主标题，一个简短的辅助短语和极少的微缩文字。

使用不对称构图、强烈的比例对比、刻意的负空间、分层、裁剪和选择性颜色重点。

最终图像应该感觉像是一个高端时尚广告活动、实验性杂志封面或当代展览的主视觉图。

Her makeup is elegant and feminine: thin winged eyeliner, softly separated eyelashes, champagne-toned eyeshadow, subtle peach blush and glossy coral-pink lipstick. She looks directly into the camera with a warm, poised and approachable expression, wearing a small relaxed smile with her lips slightly parted.

Her glossy dark-brown hair is styled in an elaborate 1930s–1940s Shanghai-inspired coiffure. The front is center-parted and shaped into two large sculpted victory rolls with smooth rounded volume above the temples. The sides curl backward into symmetrical low rolled buns around the ears and nape. Decorate both sides with small pearl hair clips and compact arrangements of pale lilac, powder-blue and ivory flowers. Keep the hairstyle polished but realistically textured with visible individual strands.

She wears an elegant sleeveless gray-green silk qipao with a high mandarin collar, fitted bodice and asymmetrical front closure. The fabric is printed with large painterly peonies and hydrangeas in dusty pink, cream, muted blue, lavender and sage green. Add fine dark piping around the collar and front opening, plus delicate frog closures near the throat. The qipao follows her naturally curvy feminine figure with a full bust, narrow waist and balanced proportions while remaining refined and believable.

Accessorize her with large pearl drop earrings, two long layered strands of small white pearls draped over her chest and a smooth pale-jade bangle on one wrist.

Reproduce the gesture precisely: one arm remains extended forward and slightly downward outside the lower-left frame as if she is holding the phone for a selfie. Her opposite elbow is bent and raised in front of her upper chest. The raised hand is open and relaxed, with the palm angled diagonally toward the camera, positioned between her chin and collarbone. All five fingers are visible, long and naturally separated but not widely spread. The fingertips point upward toward the left side of her face.

Capture the raised hand during a small, gentle side-to-side greeting wave. The hand and fingertips show soft directional motion blur, while her eyes, face, hair and qipao remain clearly focused. The hand must not cover her eyes, nose or mouth. Her shoulders stay relaxed and her torso turns only slightly three-quarter toward the camera.

Use a close handheld front-facing smartphone camera at eye level, positioned approximately an arm’s length away. Apply mild phone-camera wide-angle perspective without distorting her face. The composition should resemble a candid paused frame from a social-media video rather than a formal studio portrait.

Behind her is a nostalgic Chinese cabaret or vintage theater lobby with rich crimson velvet stage curtains, warm cream walls and oversized star-shaped marquee signs outlined with round glowing tungsten bulbs. Include small gold starburst decorations and hints of lacquered dark-wood flooring. Any decorative characters or signage should remain abstract and unreadable.

Warm amber marquee lights illuminate the edges of her curled hair and create a soft golden glow across the red curtains. Gentle frontal phone light keeps her face bright and flattering, with pearly highlights on her cheeks, eyes, earrings, necklace and silk dress. Use shallow depth of field, slightly soft smartphone sharpness, restrained skin smoothing, subtle digital noise and light compression texture.

Authentic retro Shanghai glamour mixed with contemporary smartphone-video realism, warm festive backstage atmosphere, realistic skin texture, individual hair strands, detailed silk fabric and believable jewelry. No subtitles, no captions, no readable text, no interface icons, no watermark, no plastic skin, no doll-like face, no exaggerated eyes, no deformed hands and no extra fingers.

prompts.text: Establish a quiet solar term narrative around any specific theme content, letting the theme itself determine the main imagery, symbols, environmental clues, materials, and hue sources, and refine the form that best represents the theme into a rounded glowing focal point with a complete outline and concentrated volume; at first glance, read the isolated circular bright part in a large area of calm twilight sky, then fall along the central axis to the restrained title, supporting platform, and tiny narrative characters, forming a gentle contrast of grand scale and intimate scale juxtaposition. The composition locks onto a large area of white space in the sky, with a stable central axis as the skeleton but allowing the focal point to shift high or low on the axis: the focal point can be suspended in the air or pressed onto a low base, with its size controlled to vary between small and bright to huge and quiet; the lower edge is formed by close-up railings, tabletops, or supporting structures derived from the theme to create a dark horizontal frame, while silhouettes of mountains, buildings, or the thematic environment that are atomized and lowered are preserved in the distance, making the foreground clear, the middle ground sparse, and the background blue-grayed, never letting the background steal the circular focal point. Small characters or symbols derived from the theme appear only in two or three simple outlines, close to the focal point or juxtaposed on the foreground supporting surface, establishing a relationship of watching and companionship with a minimal scale; extract a low-saturation warm-colored small object or point of light from the thematic semantics as a rhythmic marker, creating a cold-warm contrast with a vast difference in area compared to the large area of cold, low-saturation twilight. The light is in blue twilight, the circular focal point emits a soft creamy self-luminescence, the edges are slightly blurred but the outline is still clear, light only touches adjacent surfaces, and the distant lights are fragmented and restrained; the overall look maintains a clean digital composite and soft depth of field, without adding grain, paper texture, or dramatic glare. The title system is coaxial with the scene: the main title uses a narrow and upright high-contrast serif structure in the target writing system, obvious contrast in thickness, and tight letter spacing to form a quiet line of dark characters, placed in the main white space area and can slightly overlap the circular bright part; the subtitle follows with another layer of local text or more compact typeface, with a slightly heavier weight and tight line spacing, and then uses tiny fine characters and dates to pull apart the hierarchy along the axis. Preserve the causal relationship between broad white space, circular focal point, low support, tiny characters, distant fog layer, and slender titles; if the image becomes an ordinary night scene, full of decorations, text detached from the environment, or the focal point loses its sense of isolation, it is considered a deviation. The theme of the work is "She looks up under the crown of the World Tree."

The core narrative of the scene is: a young Oriental woman comes between the roots and a high platform of a giant paper-art divine tree, looking up to see the canopy unfolding upwards layer by layer like an entire sky palace, with flowers, light, and birds pouring down from the top of the tree. She finally sees the truly magnificent appearance of life and realizes for the first time that she is standing beneath some kind of sacred and great center.

The main character is an Oriental adult female with a visual age of about 25 years old, soft and poetic, gentle and firm, with a sense of shock and softness when facing great life. The character has a soft oval face, bright almond eyes looking up slightly, and a quiet, relieved expression with a slight hint of wonder. The character uses exquisite Oriental paper art illustration-style shaping, not real photography, and not over-cartoonized.

The character's hairstyle and headwear are: black long hair naturally flowing, the ends of the hair naturally connected with paper-cut flower vines, wearing light gold leaves and small paper flower hair accessories. The headwear is light and exquisite, not overly complex. The long hair naturally extends backward in the breeze at high altitudes, forming soft flowing paper ribbon lines.

The character's clothing is: a cyan-green and milky-white paper art long dress, the hem of the skirt growing layer by layer like leaves, petals, and long branches, with light gold hollow patterns added locally. The clothing is composed of multiple layers of paper-cut garment pieces, flower-and-leaf-shaped paper pieces, slender draped silks, precision hollowed edges, and real paper thickness, where paper fibers, slight creases, hand-cut edges, and layering relationships can be clearly seen. The hem and draped silks have a light sense of growth, but the character must be significantly small in the frame.

The dream carrier is: a giant paper art divine tree and a high platform.

Dream imagery includes: divine tree, flowers, flower vines, flying birds, clouds, long steps. All tree trunks, branches and leaves, flowers, clouds, birds, steps, and characters must be unified into a high-completion 3D paper sculpture language, no realistic tree texture can appear, nor can it look like a regular garden illustration.

The overall paper-cut structure adopts: a surrounding dreamscape style.

The main subject of the picture is a giant paper art divine tree with a true sense of epic scale. The divine tree must rise from the bottom of the frame, with a trunk extremely thick and towering, far larger than the characters and the high platform. The interior of the tree body is filled with complex hollow patterns, entwined branch structures, corridors, lattice windows, small pavilions, and palace-like paper sculpture levels. The trunk is not an ordinary trunk, but like a giant tower of life woven together by countless paper sculpture vines, branch veins, arches, and palace structures.

The crown of the divine tree must be extremely huge, like an entire celestial palace propping up the sky. The crown unfolds layer by layer from a high place in all directions, occupying a large area in the upper part of the frame, creating a sense of a crown that obscures the sun and the sky. Inside the crown, dense paper art branches and leaves, hollow patterns, paper sculpture flowers, hanging vines, glowing flower hearts, circular canopy layers, and layer-by-layer structures like sky palaces are visible. Visually, it must clearly make people feel that: the scale of the crown far exceeds that of the character and the trunk, like an entire world suspended above.

The composition adopts a low-angle upward view or a strong upward-looking perspective, emphasizing the overwhelming sense of scale that "the tree is much larger than the person." The character is located near the bottom center of the screen or near the high platform, occupying only a small proportion, standing on the edge of tree roots, platforms, or long steps, with the body slightly lifted upwards, looking up at the high canopy. The character is only an emotional anchor in the huge space, must not be too large, and must not steal the visual focus. The real protagonist is the divine tree itself.

The divine tree is surrounded by layers of flower vines, paper sculpture flower clusters, circling vines, and surrounding long steps forming a huge space. Long steps and small platforms meander upwards or outwards from the roots as a scale reference. A small number of paper art flying birds travel between the tree body and the canopy, further strengthening the huge divine scale of the tree. The background clouds support the divine tree from both sides of the screen and in the distance, forming a high-altitude, god-realm-like negative space and sacred atmosphere.

The overall color scheme is: primarily cyan-green, milky-white, and warm gold, with a small amount of light pink as accents. The overall color must be bright, holy, transparent, and gorgeous, not gray, not darkened, not dirty or muddy.

Lighting and paper texture: Warm white skylight from above spills down between the canopy, forming strong but soft sacred light beams, illuminating the middle of the trunk, the character, flower vines, and the high platform. The center of the canopy should have a clear sense of luminescence, like skylight pouring from the depths of life. The edges of flower vines and leaves are slightly translucent, the tree trunk, branches and leaves, and high platform paper layers are clearly layered, and the fibers and cut edges are clearly visible. Strengthen the real paper thickness, hand-cut marks, fine hollow patterns, interlaminar shadows, and edge light transmission, making the entire picture look like a museum-grade large-scale paper sculpture art installation.

The overall image should have a sense of modern Oriental paper sculpture art, World Tree, sky palace, life mythology, epic dream space, and high-end art poster. Key highlights: The divine tree must be visually overwhelmingly huge, the canopy must have an epic sense of "propping up the sky," the character is clearly small, it cannot be made into a regular garden scene, nor can the tree just look like a decorative tree. Let the viewer feel at a glance that this is a World Tree like the center of a divine realm.

Supplementary requirements: The character must be small, the divine tree must be huge, the canopy must unfold layer by layer like a sky palace, strengthening the overwhelming sense and epic life sense that "the tree is much larger than the person," no ordinary garden feel, don't let the tree look not big enough.

Negative prompts: minors, youthful face, real photography, ordinary anime, plastic 3D, resin material, clay, felt, children's handicraft, ordinary garden trees, ordinary forest, bonsai sense, small tree, oversized character, half-body character close-up, small canopy, thin trunk, no depth, no high-altitude sense, no paper layering, no hollow structure, messy paper layers, blurred paper edges, heavy shadows, dead black dark parts, gray screen, overall dirty yellow, extra characters, text, Logo, watermark.
