prompts.text:
9:16竖版，现代东方女性梦境立体剪纸艺术，modern oriental papercut art，layered paper cut illustration，dimensional paper sculpture，intricate paper carving，paper diorama，layered shadow box，epic oriental papercraft fantasy，poetic female dreamscape，contemporary oriental art poster。

作品主题为“她在世界之树的冠冕下抬头”。

画面核心叙事为：一位年轻东方女性来到一棵巨大纸艺神树的根部与高台之间，抬头看见树冠像一整座天空宫殿般向上层层展开，花朵、光与飞鸟从树顶倾泻而下。她终于看见生命真正恢弘的样子，也第一次意识到自己正站在某种神圣而伟大的中心之下。

主体人物为视觉年龄约25岁的东方成年女性，柔美诗意、温柔坚定，带有面对伟大生命时的震撼与柔和感。人物拥有柔和鹅蛋脸，明亮杏眼微微仰望，神情安静、释然，带一点轻微惊叹。人物采用精致东方纸艺插画式塑形，不是真人摄影，也不过度卡通化。

人物发型与头饰为：黑色长发自然披散，发尾与花藤剪纸自然连接，佩戴浅金叶片与小型纸花发饰。头饰轻盈精致，不过度复杂。长发在高处微风中自然向后延展，形成柔和流动的纸带线条。

人物服装为：青绿色与奶白色纸艺长裙，裙摆像叶片、花瓣和长枝层层生长，局部加入浅金镂空纹样。服装由多层剪纸衣片、花叶形纸片、细长披帛、精密镂空边缘和真实纸张厚度组成，能够明显看见纸张纤维、轻微折痕、手工裁切边缘与层叠关系。裙摆与披帛具有轻盈生长感，但人物在画面中必须明显偏小。

梦境载体为：巨型纸艺神树与高台。

梦境意象包括：神树、花朵、花藤、飞鸟、云层、长阶。所有树干、枝叶、花朵、云层、飞鸟、台阶和人物都必须统一为高完成度立体纸雕语言，不能出现写实树木质感，也不能像普通花园插画。

整体剪纸结构采用：环绕梦境式。

画面主体是一棵真正具有史诗尺度感的巨型纸艺神树。神树必须从画面下方拔地而起，树干极其粗壮高耸，远大于人物与高台，树身内部布满复杂的镂空纹样、枝蔓缠绕结构、回廊、花窗、小型亭台和宫殿般的纸雕层级。树干不是普通树干，而像由无数纸雕藤蔓、枝脉、拱门与宫阙结构共同编织出的生命巨塔。

神树树冠必须极其巨大，像撑起天空的一整座天穹宫殿。树冠从高处向四周层层展开，占据画面上部大面积空间，形成遮天蔽日般的冠冕感。树冠内部可见密集的纸艺枝叶、镂空花纹、纸雕花朵、悬垂藤蔓、发光花心、环形冠层以及像天空宫阙一样的层层结构。视觉上要明确让人感受到：树冠远远超出人物与树干的尺度，像一整个世界悬浮在上方。

构图采用低角度仰视或强烈向上观看的视角，强调“树比人巨大得多”的压倒性尺度感。人物位于画面下方偏中央或高台附近，只占很小比例，站在树根、平台或长阶边缘，身体微微向上抬起，仰望高处树冠。人物只是巨大空间中的情绪锚点，不可过大，不可抢走视觉重心。真正的主角是神树本身。

神树周围由层层花藤、纸雕花丛、盘旋枝蔓和环绕长阶构成巨大空间。长阶与小型平台从树根向上或向四周蜿蜒，作为尺度参照。少量纸艺飞鸟从树身与树冠之间穿行，进一步强化树的巨大神性尺度。背景云层从画面两侧和远处托起神树，形成高空、神域般的留白和神圣氛围。

整体色彩方案为：青绿、奶白、暖金为主，少量浅粉点缀。青绿色用于枝叶、远处云层阴影和人物服装内层；奶白用于树干主体、花朵、高台、云层亮部和人物服装外层；暖金用于高光、树冠中心、花心、局部描边和纸箔装饰；少量浅粉仅用于花朵局部点睛。整体色彩必须明亮、圣洁、通透、华丽，不灰蒙，不压暗，不脏浊。

光线与纸张质感为：高处暖白天光从树冠间洒下，形成强烈但柔和的神圣光束，照亮树干中段、人物、花藤与高台。树冠中心应有明显的发光感，像天光从生命深处倾泻。花藤与叶片边缘轻微透光，树干、枝叶和高台纸层层次分明，纤维与裁切边缘清晰可见。强化真实纸张厚度、手工裁切痕迹、细密镂空纹样、层间投影和边缘透光感，使整幅画面看起来像博物馆级大型纸雕艺术装置。

画面整体要具有现代东方纸雕艺术、世界之树、天空宫殿、生命神话、史诗级梦境空间和高级艺术海报感。重点突出：神树必须在视觉上压倒性巨大，树冠要有“撑起天空”的史诗感，人物明显偏小，不能做成普通花园场景，也不能让树只像一棵装饰树。要让观者一眼感受到这是一棵如同神域中心般的世界之树。

补充要求：人物必须小，神树必须巨大，树冠必须像天空宫殿一样向上层层展开，强化“树比人巨大得多”的压迫感与史诗生命感，不要普通花园感，不要树看起来不够大。

负面提示词：未成年人，幼态脸，真人摄影，普通动漫，塑料3D，树脂材质，黏土，毛毡，儿童手工，普通花园树木，普通森林，盆景感，小树，人物过大，半身人物特写，树冠过小，树干过细，没有纵深，没有高空感，没有纸张层次，没有镂空结构，纸层混乱，纸张边缘模糊，阴影过重，暗部死黑，画面灰蒙，整体脏黄，多余人物，文字，Logo，水印。

items.title: 东方暗黑档案实验博物馆海报设计

prompts.text:
【Theme】: Fill in the exhibition theme
【Chinese Main Title】: Fill in 2–6 Chinese characters
【English Title】: Fill in the English title
【Subtitle】: Fill in the exhibition description
【Core Image】: Mythical beast / Nuo mask / Armor / Star chart / Other ancient images
【Black Composition】: Diagonal cut / Arc / Vertical fault / Night negative space / Others
【Thematic Phrase】: Fill in a short copy sentence
【Time and Location】: Fill in the exhibition information
【Aspect Ratio】: 9:16

Design an "Oriental Dark Archives" experimental museum poster.

Use yellowed old paper, rice paper fiber, scanning grains, ink bleeding, and natural print wear as the background texture, with large areas of ink-black flat structures to create a strong positive-negative shape relationship. Black must participate in the composition, using forms like diagonal cuts, giant arcs, vertical faults, night negative space, etc. Each theme uses a different structure to avoid simple templating.

Process the 【Core Image】 into a fragmented ancient map or cultural relic archive slice, showing only the most recognizable parts, such as eyes, half of a mask, armor and weapons, astrolabe and star charts, etc. Retain cracks, faded pigments, rust, wood grain, rubbings, or age-related wear, making the image look like a rediscovered ancient visual archive rather than an ordinary Chinese-style illustration.

The Chinese main title uses huge, coarse calligraphy, stele inscriptions, or rubbing-style fonts; the English title uses extra-large, high-contrast serif fonts, which can be cropped, cross borders, or be obscured by black structures. Subtitles, thematic phrases, TIME, and ADDRESS are concentrated in quiet areas with clear hierarchy, and a tiny cinnabar red seal is added.

Overall low saturation, mainly based on ink black, old paper beige, ochre, dark gold, and gray-green. The image maintains a mysterious, ancient, restrained, museum experimental poster and cultural archive feel.

Avoid: Ordinary Chinese-style templates, full main character illustrations, material piling, fantasy game feel, tourism promotion feel, high-saturation colors, glowing effects, dense small text, garbled characters, Logos, watermarks, image numbers.

prompts.text:
【主题】：填写展览主题
【中文主标题】：填写 2–6 个汉字
【英文标题】：填写英文标题
【副标题】：填写展览说明
【核心图像】：异兽 / 傩面 / 甲胄 / 星图 / 其他古代图像
【黑色构图】：斜切 / 圆弧 / 纵向断层 / 夜幕负空间 / 其他
【主题短句】：填写一句简短文案
【时间地点】：填写展览信息
【画面比例】：9:16

设计一张「东方暗黑档案」实验博物馆海报。

使用泛黄旧纸、宣纸纤维、扫描颗粒、墨迹渗透和自然印刷磨损作为背景质感，以大面积墨黑平面结构制造强烈正负形关系。黑色必须参与构图，可使用斜切、巨大圆弧、纵向断层、夜幕负空间等形式，每个主题使用不同结构，避免简单套版。

将【核心图像】处理成残缺古图或文物档案切片，只展示最有辨识度的局部，例如眼睛、面具半脸、甲胄与兵刃、星盘与星图等。保留裂纹、褪色颜料、锈蚀、木纹、拓印或年代磨损，让画面像重新发现的古代视觉档案，而不是普通国风插画。

中文主标题使用巨大粗粝书法、碑刻或拓印感字体；英文标题使用超大高对比衬线字体，可裁切、越界、被黑色结构遮挡。副标题、主题短句、TIME、ADDRESS 集中在安静区域，层级清楚，并加入一枚极小朱砂红印章。

整体低饱和，以墨黑、旧纸米黄、赭石、暗金、灰绿为主。画面保持神秘、古老、克制、具有博物馆实验海报与文化档案感。

避免：普通国风模板、完整主体立绘、素材堆砌、玄幻游戏感、旅游宣传感、高饱和色彩、发光特效、密集小字、乱码、Logo、水印、图片编号。

items.title: 傍晚都市商场扶梯上行回眸的美女

prompts.text:
Theme: Looking back while ascending.
Subject: Vertical 3:4 aspect ratio, inside an urban department store at dusk, a woman slowly ascends on an escalator, turning her shoulder to look back at the camera before about to leave the field of vision. She is located slightly to the right of the center of the frame, her left palm naturally resting on the moving black rubber handrail, framing from the top of her head to the mid-thigh; the receding metal steps below and the glass railing beside her together form an upward line of depth.
Person/Expression: Stunningly beautiful 23-year-old East Asian beauty, stylish, confident, and gentle temperament; well-proportioned and full figure, naturally full chest (visual effect of about D to E cup), slender waist, coordinated hip-to-leg ratio, soft and natural curves; exquisite and natural oval face with soft cartilage structure, ivory white skin showing a faint pink blood color, retaining small pores and restrained real highlights on the bridge of the nose and cheekbones. Bright milk tea grey-brown medium-long hair hangs over the shoulders, thin air bangs lightly cover the forehead, the layers around the face rise slightly with the turning movement, and the inner-buckled ends and fine flyaway hairs bring a sense of dynamics. Champagne beige overlaid with pink-brown eyeshadow, slender eyelashes, natural tear bags, and small but clear pupil glints; light rose blush with translucent pink-beige lips. Head turned over the right shoulder looking back, gaze accurately falling on the camera, corners of the lips slightly raised almost imperceptibly, expression as if suddenly recognizing a familiar person in a crowd.
Clothing/Pose: Wearing a deep charcoal grey fine-ribbed natural V-neck fitted short tank top, the neckline and shoulder straps are simple and neat; the bottom is low-waist deep indigo raw-edge denim ultra-short shorts, the waistband fits the hips, with a few real horizontal folds generated at the turn. The body faces upward along the escalator, center of gravity stable on the front step, both feet fully stepping within the yellow safety lines of adjacent steps; hips remain facing forward, upper body naturally rotates from the waist and back toward the back right, avoiding exaggerated body twisting. Left arm stretched backward, left palm resting on the black handrail with gentle force and moving upward with it, fingers naturally separated and not gripping; right hand hangs by the side, lightly pinching the short handle of a small black soft leather handbag, the bag body close to the right leg and not floating.
Background/Light: The foreground lower left is cut in by a blurred silver escalator side panel, the middle ground retains transparent glass railings, metal steps, and softly bright safety edges, the background is layers of receding mall floors and out-of-focus crowd outlines, any shop text is blurred and unrecognizable. Warm natural light from the dusk enters from a high window in the upper right of the mall, obliquely lighting her looking-back face, right shoulder, and the outer edges of her hair, while the left cheek and side of the waist fall into soft shadows; the glass railing provides only a restrained cold grey reflection, strengthening the transparency of the urban space.
Composition/Camera: Equivalent 50mm lens, the camera is located at chest height on the next adjacent escalator, following the character's upward direction from a slightly low angle, the focal plane is locked on the looking-back eyes and the left hand resting on the handrail. Medium-shallow depth of field makes the character, hand contact, and the step they are on clear, while distant floors and crowds are softened; the diagonal lines on both sides of the escalator converge toward the upper right, leaving an appropriate amount of space to the left of the character's looking direction, and the edge of the foreground side panel is cropped to create a sense of chance encounter like real street photography.
Texture/Style: Japanese urban beauty magazine photo and restrained cinematic street photography temperament, low contrast, low saturation warm grey and deep indigo tones, fine and soft film grain. Emphasis on expressing real skin texture, backlighting of milk tea grey-brown hair strands, fine-ribbed fabric, denim raw edges, soft leather handbag, and the brushed metal texture of the escalator.
Negative: Underage or mature middle-aged feel, drifting facial features, wrong looking-back direction or excessive twisting of neck and waist, left hand not resting on the handrail or fingers penetrating the handrail, feet floating or crossing step boundaries, collapsed perspective of escalator steps and glass railings, obvious finger joint errors, readable garbled text or watermarks.

prompts.text:
主题： 上行时的回眸
主体： 竖3:4画幅，傍晚的都市百货商场内，一位女性乘自动扶梯缓缓上行，在即将离开视线前转过肩头回望镜头。她位于画面中央略偏右，左手掌自然贴着同步移动的黑色橡胶扶手，取景从头顶至大腿中段；下方渐远的金属梯级与身侧玻璃护栏共同形成向上的纵深线。
人物・表情： 绝美23岁东亚美女，气质时尚、自信、温柔； 身材匀称丰满，胸部自然丰满（约D至E杯视觉效果），腰部纤细，臀腿比例协调，曲线柔和自然； 精致自然的鹅蛋脸与柔和软骨相，象牙白肌肤透出淡粉血色，保留细小毛孔和鼻梁、颧骨处克制的真实高光。明亮奶茶灰棕中长发垂过肩部，薄空气刘海轻覆额前，脸周层次随回身动作微微扬起，内扣发尾与细碎飞发带出动态。香槟米色叠加粉棕眼影，细长睫毛、自然泪袋与小而清晰的瞳孔眼神光；淡玫瑰腮红配透感粉米色唇。头部越过右肩回望，眼神准确落向镜头，唇角若有若无地轻扬，神情像在人群中忽然认出熟悉的人。
服装・姿势： 穿深炭灰色细罗纹自然V领贴身短背心，领口和肩带简洁利落；下装为低腰深靛蓝毛边牛仔超短裤，裤腰贴合髋部，回身处产生少量真实横向褶皱。身体顺扶梯朝上，重心稳定落在前方梯级，双脚各自完整踩在相邻梯级的黄色安全线内；髋部保持前向，上半身从腰背自然向右后方旋转，避免夸张拧身。左臂向后舒展，左手掌以轻柔力道贴合黑色扶手并随之上行，手指自然分开不抓紧；右手垂在身侧，轻捏一只小型黑色软皮手袋的短柄，袋身贴近右腿不悬浮。
背景・光： 前景左下由一段虚化的银色扶梯侧板切入，中景保留透明玻璃护栏、金属梯级与柔亮的安全边线，背景是层层退远的商场楼面和失焦的人群轮廓，任何店铺文字均模糊不可辨。右上方商场挑高窗透入傍晚偏暖的自然光，斜照她回望的脸、右肩和发丝外缘，左侧脸颊与腰侧落入柔和阴影；玻璃护栏仅提供一道克制的冷灰反射，强化都市空间的通透感。
构图・相机： 等效50mm镜头，摄影机位于下一段相邻扶梯的胸口高度，略低角度追随人物上行方向，焦点平面锁定回望的双眼与贴在扶手上的左手。中浅景深令人物、手部接触和所在梯级清晰，远处楼层与人群柔化；扶梯两侧斜线汇向右上方，人物回望方向的左侧保留适量空间，前景侧板边缘裁切制造真实街拍般的偶遇感。
质感・风格： 日系都市美容杂志写真与克制的电影街拍气质，低对比、低饱和的暖灰与深靛色调，细腻柔和胶片颗粒。重点表现真实肤质、奶茶灰棕发丝逆光、细罗纹织物、牛仔毛边、软皮手袋与扶梯金属拉丝纹理。
负面： 未成年或成熟中年感、人物面部特征漂移、回眸方向错误或颈腰过度扭曲、左手未贴合扶手或手指穿入扶手、双脚悬空或跨越梯级边界、扶梯梯级与玻璃护栏透视崩坏、明显手指关节错误、可读乱码文字或水印

items.title: 复古氛围深海军蓝发色果冻少女画报

prompts.text:
[Character] Reference Image 1, Image 2 [Signature] In the lower right corner, the Threads logo operated by Meta is placed slightly above it, with "CHAse" written in small white handwritten letters, looking like a signature. 

1. [Character's Pose and Expression] 
Composition and Pose: A medium-wide shot composition of sitting on a chair, holding a glass cup containing colorful jelly in one hand and lifting a piece of jelly with the other, upper body slightly twisted, sitting lazily. 

Expression and Atmosphere: Head tilted slightly, with a dreamy and blurry frontal gaze, creating a trendy retro atmosphere. 

2. [Character Clothing] 
Top, Bottoms and Details: Wearing a white high-neck long-sleeved henley top with one button undone, paired with vintage-cut black denim shorts with a studded belt. 

Accessories: A thin silver necklace, opal blue finger nail art, and thorn line tattoo details on the left thigh, adding trendy highlights. 

3. [Character Hairstyle and Makeup Details] 
Hairstyle: Voluminous deep navy blue long wavy hair with bangs hanging down. 

Makeup: Emphasizing eye contours with brown gradient eye makeup, paired with moist peach-brown lip makeup, completing subtle and mysterious facial features. 

4. [Lighting and Light Direction] 
Light Source and Effects: Strong indoor spotlight lighting shining obliquely from the side above.

让未来主题先生成一个极短的核心词和一段克制的提示语，画面第一眼必须是暖橙色超粗字形形成巨大实体墙，灰阶摄影剪影般的主题主体从前景切入并与字形发生真实遮挡、穿插、托举或牵引关系，使文字像可触摸的空间构件而不是平面标题。背景使用旧奶油纸底，留出大片安静空白，只保留轻微印刷磨损、擦痕和低对比纸纤维，禁止干净渐变和过度装饰。核心词采用极重黑体/无衬线构造，笔画厚、字腔被压紧、端部果断、字距紧密，局部被主体遮住但仍保持正字法可识别；上方提示语用小号大间距字符分行垂直堆叠，像铅字逐行钉在空白中，形成从细小理性文字到巨大情绪文字再到具身动作的阅读路径。主体保持黑白或低饱和灰阶，边缘有轻微剪贴感和网印颗粒，阴影极少，靠明度差与字形产生跨系统统一；色彩只让暖橙承担冲击，黑灰承载叙事，纸白承载呼吸。不要使用源图具体人物、原文、品牌或符号，不要把粗糙修成高级海报质感，不要增加复杂场景，主题语义必须通过巨字、身体动作、遮挡层级和旧印刷触感共同重建。

items.title: 清晨寒潭石桥古风仙侠女子写真海报

prompts.text:
9:16 vertical format, high-precision ancient style Xianxia character poster portrait, realistic Oriental fantasy portrait photography texture, early morning cold pool, mist bridge, and mountain gate scenes, the picture is elegant, aloof, quiet, firm, and ethereal, with a slight sense of destiny and landscape narrative. The overall tone is cold but not grey, light but not thin, and the character is always the absolute visual subject.
The main subject is a young adult Oriental female, visual age about 20–28 years old, with natural and clear Oriental female characteristics. Exquisite Oriental light-featured face, soft and smooth small oval face, clear facial bone structure, clean contours, a combination of long eyes and apricot eyes, clear and quiet eyes, slightly lowered gaze, with a sense of thoughtful restraint; eyebrows are stretched and natural, the bridge of the nose is delicate, the tip of the nose is exquisite, and the lip shape is soft and clear. The overall temperament is aloof, elegant, and quiet, but should not be sickly, overly melancholy, or spiritless.
The skin is fair and transparent, retaining delicate and natural skin texture, with a moist texture reflected by the morning mist.
The makeup is a transparent immortal makeup, with a light concentration. The base makeup is light, delicate, and moist, avoiding a heavy powdery feel; eye makeup is delicately blended with light grey-pink, soft brown, low-saturation cold pink, and a small amount of light jade pearlescent highlights, focusing on enhancing the charm of the long eye shape and the end of the eyes; the eyeliner is thin and natural, the eyelashes are naturally long, and the aegyo-sal (lower eyelid) is only slightly highlighted; the blush is extremely light, only retaining natural complexion; the lip makeup uses low-saturation light rose, cold bean paste, or soft petal pink, the lip surface is delicate and moist but not excessively glassy. The overall makeup is clear, moist, high-end, and quiet, coordinated with the jade green clothing, not sweet-girl style, and not modern internet celebrity style.
The hairstyle is black smooth long hair, half down and half pinned up, with abundant volume, smooth and natural hair strands, the long hair at the back gently rises with the morning breeze, and a few strands of fine hair on the side of the face brush across the cheeks, adding slight movement and immortal air.
The headwear level is magnificent, consisting of a delicate flower branch hair crown and hanging bead chains made of light gold, cold silver, white jade, light green jade, pearls, and transparent crystal. The hair accessories extend horizontally along the hair bun, not forming a high crown; on both sides, thin long bead chains, jade pendants, and tassels hang down naturally. The earrings are exquisite long pendant styles composed of white jade, pearls, and thin light gold chains, overall magnificent but elegant, not piled up.
The clothing is a layered gauze skirt like an ancient idol drama heroine, of medium-high magnificence, using a jade green, white, and gold color system. The primary colors are transparent jade green, light green jade, and soft water green; the auxiliary colors are pearl white, moon white, and milky white, with touches of light gold, white jade, pearls, and a very small amount of silver.
The upper part of the clothing adopts a soft overlapping structure and Xianxia fantasy-style tailoring, the shoulder and neck lines are naturally stretched, and the outer layer uses semi-transparent tulle, light gauze capes, and draped gauze sleeves; the inner layer is delicate silk-feel and embroidered fabric. The garment body features light gold floral patterns, flowing cloud patterns, thin vine patterns, jade leaf patterns, and small Baoxiang patterns embroidery, with pearls, thin gold chains, and small jade pendants added to the shoulders, sleeve edges, and waist. The waist uses an exquisite cinched structure and hanging ornaments; the overall look is light, magnificent, and elegant, not having the feel of a heavy court gown.
Jade green is only used for the main body of the character's clothing; the environment must not be overall greenish. The cold pool maintains a natural cold bluish-grey water color, while the mountains, stone bridge, and mountain gate maintain tones of grey-white, lime, dark wood, and natural landscape colors.
The character is located on an ancient stone bridge crossing the cold pool, near a carved stone railing. She is positioned two-thirds sideways to the camera, lightly leaning against the stone bridge railing, with both arms or one hand naturally resting on the stone railing, in a relaxed but dignified posture. Her head is slightly turned and her gaze is lowered, looking at the surface of the cold pool water under the bridge, with a quiet and thoughtful expression. The other hand can naturally rest on the stone railing, sleeve edge, or near the body, without exaggerated posing.
The camera shoots from a close distance at a slight diagonal in front of the character, with an upper-body to most-body composition, about 70–100mm portrait lens feel, slight spatial compression, and the background still retains enough structure of the cold pool, distant bridge, and mountain gate. The character occupies the main visual area of the frame, with facial features, makeup, hair accessories, clothing materials, and hands remaining clear.
The scene is cold pool stone bridge / misty water surface / mountain gate ancient bridge. The foreground shows a grey-white stone railing and carved pillar head with a sense of age but intact structure; the middle ground is a clear cold pool, with the water surface having soft highlights and slight ripples; thin and transparent morning mist floats on the water, the mist only serves as a spatial layer and does not obscure the character.
In the distance, a second arched stone bridge, the bridge deck leading to the mountain gate, layered mountains, and a towering Oriental classical mountain gate can be seen. The mountain gate has flying eaves, a gate tower, a stone base, and a high gate opening, shrouded in light morning mist and backlighting, serving as the distant landscape narrative anchor of the image. Further away, mountain silhouettes, pine tree silhouettes, and mountain trends in the mist can be seen, forming a deep and distant space.
The light is morning mist light + soft backlight + water surface reflection fill light. The sun is located behind the character to the side or near the distant mountain gate, the morning light passes through the mist to form a soft, high-brightness background. Backlighting gently highlights the edges of the character's hair, headwear, shoulder tulle, and bead chains; the water surface reflection provides natural cold white fill light for the face, jaw, and clothing, making the character's face transparent and spirited.
The background generally maintains high brightness and low to medium contrast, but the character's facial features must not be consumed by the mist. The cold feeling of the picture comes from the air, cold pool, and morning mist, rather than a general blue-green filter.
The photography texture is biased towards high-quality real-person ancient style portrait + Oriental fantasy movie-style character poster, real skin texture, real black hair strands, real silk and semi-transparent tulle materials, fine embroidery and jade jewelry reflections, natural water surface highlights, and realistic stone bridge textures. High precision, high completion, bright and clear, shallow depth of field but retaining environmental narrative.
Overall visual keywords:
Cold pool, stone bridge, morning mist, mountain gate, jade green immortal dress, transparent makeup, contemplating by the water, cold and aloof heroine, sense of landscape destiny, Oriental Xianxia character poster.

prompts.text:
9:16 竖版，高精度古风仙侠角色海报写真，偏写实东方幻想人像摄影质感，清晨寒潭、雾桥、山门场景，画面清雅、孤高、安静、坚定、空灵，带轻微宿命感与山水叙事感。整体冷而不灰、淡而不寡，人物始终是绝对视觉主体。
画面主体是一位年轻成年东方女性，视觉年龄约 20–28 岁，具有自然明确的东方女性特征。精致东方淡颜，柔和流畅的小鹅蛋脸，面部骨相清秀，轮廓干净，长眼型与杏眼结合，眼神清亮安静，略微低垂视线，带若有所思的克制感；眉形舒展自然，鼻梁秀气，鼻尖精致，唇形柔软清晰。整体气质孤高、清雅、安静，但不能病弱、忧郁过度或无神。
肌肤白皙通透，保留细腻自然肌肤纹理，具有清晨雾光映照出的柔润质感。
妆容为清透仙气妆，妆容浓度清透。底妆轻薄、细腻、柔润，避免厚重粉感；眼妆以浅灰粉、柔棕、低饱和冷粉与少量淡玉色珠光细腻晕染，重点增强长眼型与眼尾神韵；眼线纤细自然，睫毛自然纤长，卧蚕仅轻微提亮；腮红极淡，只保留自然气色；唇妆采用低饱和浅玫瑰、冷豆沙或柔润花瓣粉，唇面细腻水润但不过分玻璃感。整体妆面清润、高级、安静，与玉绿色服装协调，不甜妹化、不现代网红化。
发型为黑色柔顺长发半披半挽，发量丰盈，发丝顺滑自然，后部长发随清晨微风轻轻扬起，脸侧有几缕纤细碎发拂过面颊，增加轻微动态与仙气。
头饰等级为华丽，以浅金、冷银、白玉、浅青玉、珍珠、透明水晶组合成精致花枝发冠与垂坠珠链。发饰沿发髻横向延展，不做过高头冠；两侧有细长珠链、玉坠和流苏自然垂落。耳饰为白玉、珍珠与浅金细链组成的精致长坠款，整体华丽但清雅，不堆砌。
服装为古偶女主式层叠纱裙，中高华丽度，采用玉绿白金系。主色为清透玉绿、浅青玉、柔和水绿色，辅色为珍珠白、月白、乳白，点缀使用浅金、白玉、珍珠与极少量银色。
服装上身采用轻柔交叠结构与仙侠幻想式剪裁，肩颈线条自然舒展，外层使用半透明薄纱、轻纱披层和垂坠纱袖；内层为细腻绢感与刺绣面料。衣身带有浅金花卉纹、流云纹、细藤蔓纹、玉叶纹与小型宝相纹刺绣，肩部、袖缘和腰侧辅以珍珠、细金链与玉石小坠。腰间采用精致收束结构与垂坠饰件，整体轻盈、华丽、清雅，不做厚重宫廷礼服感。
玉绿色仅用于人物服装主体，环境不得整体泛青。寒潭保持自然偏冷的青灰蓝水色，山体、石桥与山门保持灰白、石灰、深木和自然山水色调。
人物位于一座横跨寒潭的古老石桥上，靠近雕刻石栏。她身体三分之二侧向镜头，轻轻倚在石桥栏杆边，双臂或一只手自然搭在石栏上，姿态松弛但端雅。头部微微侧转并低垂视线，看向桥下寒潭水面，神情安静若有所思。另一只手可自然搭在石栏、衣袖边或靠近身体，不做夸张摆拍。
镜头从人物斜前方近距离拍摄，上半身至大半身构图，约 70–100mm 人像镜头感，轻微空间压缩，背景仍保留足够的寒潭、远桥与山门结构。人物占据画面主要视觉区域，五官、妆容、发饰、衣料和手部保持清晰。
场景为寒潭石桥 / 悬雾水面 / 山门古桥。近景可见带岁月质感但结构完整的灰白石栏与雕花柱头；中景为清澈寒潭，水面带柔和高光与轻微波纹；水面上漂浮薄而通透的晨雾，雾气只作为空间层次，不遮蔽人物。
远处可见第二座拱形石桥、通往山门的桥面、层叠山体，以及高耸的东方古典山门。山门具有飞檐、门楼、石质基座与高大门洞，笼罩在淡淡晨雾与逆光中，作为画面的远景叙事锚点。更远处可见山体轮廓、松树剪影与雾中山势，形成深远空间。
光线为清晨雾光 + 柔和逆光 + 水面反射补光。太阳位于人物侧后方或远景山门附近，晨光穿过雾气形成柔和高明度背景。逆光轻轻勾亮人物发丝、头饰、肩部薄纱和珠链边缘；水面反射为脸部、下颌与服装提供自然冷白补光，使人物面部通透有神。
背景总体保持高明度、低至中等对比，但人物五官不能被雾气吃掉。画面冷感来自空气、寒潭与晨雾，而不是整体套青蓝滤镜。
摄影质感偏高质量真人古风写真 + 东方幻想电影感角色海报，真实皮肤纹理，真实黑色发丝，真实丝绸与半透明薄纱材质，精细刺绣与玉石珠宝反射，水面高光自然，石桥纹理真实。高精度、高完成度、明亮清透、浅景深但保留环境叙事。
整体视觉关键词：
寒潭、石桥、晨雾、山门、玉绿仙裙、清透妆容、临水沉思、清冷女主、山水宿命感、东方仙侠角色海报。

items.title: 街头抓拍超写实东亚女性夜景人像

prompts.text:
[Location]: subway exit / vending machine / bus stop / convenience store
[Outfit]: jacket + fitted top + mini skirt/shorts + knee-high socks + sneakers
[Action]: crouching, sitting low, bending down, fixing hair/shoes, caught mid-motion

Create a 9:16 ultra-realistic night portrait of an adult East Asian woman in her early 20s. Use a close 28–35mm perspective with a slightly low camera angle, letting one knee or leg enter the foreground for stronger depth.

The body should stay in an unfinished everyday action rather than a perfect model pose — low center of gravity, natural hip/waist twist, loose shoulders, hair slightly messy from movement, then suddenly looking directly into the camera.

Use harsh on-camera direct flash as the main light. Keep the subject much brighter than the dark environment, with realistic highlights on skin, hair and fabric, subtle high-ISO grain, imperfect nighttime exposure, and natural background lights.

Prioritize real skin texture, visible pores, natural flyaway hair, believable clothing folds and anatomy. Avoid plastic skin, beauty filters, studio lighting, CGI look, stiff posing, extreme wide-angle distortion, or overly cinematic grading.

prompts.text:
[场景]：地铁出口 / 自动贩卖机 / 公交车站 / 便利店
[穿搭]：夹克 + 修身上衣 + 迷你裙/短裤 + 及膝袜 + 运动鞋
[动作]：蹲下，低坐，弯腰，整理头发/鞋子，抓拍动态瞬间

创建一个 9:16 的超写实夜景肖像，主角是一位 20 出头的成年东亚女性。使用 28–35mm 的近距离视角和略低的相机角度，让一只膝盖或腿进入前景以增强深度感。

身体应保持在未完成的日常动作中，而非完美的模特姿势——重心降低，自然的臀部/腰部扭转，放松的双肩，因运动而略显凌乱的发丝，然后突然直视镜头。

使用强烈的机载直射闪光灯作为主光源。保持主体比黑暗环境明亮得多，皮肤、头发和织物上有真实的写实高光，带有细微的高 ISO 颗粒感、不完美的夜间曝光和自然的背景灯光。

优先考虑真实的皮肤纹理、可见的毛孔、自然的碎发、可信的衣物褶皱和解剖结构。避免塑料感的皮肤、美颜滤镜、影棚灯光、CGI 效果、僵硬的姿势、极端的广角畸变或过度电影化的调色。

items.title: 葡萄色泳衣女性床边回首全身特写

prompts.text:
Theme:
Grape-colored Looking Back

Subject:
A vertical full-body close-up photograph of a woman sitting sideways on a bed in a warm old room, looking back over her shoulder from the center of the frame. A deep grape-colored backless one-piece swimsuit and white bedding are the main elements.

Character · Expression:
The torso faces the right side of the frame, only the face turns from behind the left shoulder towards the camera, gazing quietly with grayish-brown slender eyes, and pale beige-pink lips lightly closed. A slightly elongated oval face shape and a small rounded chin, horizontally narrow almond-shaped eyes, natural and soft eyebrows, a thin straight bridge of the nose, and a small tip of the nose. Light eyeliner and a thin layer of blush, bright semi-matte skin. Near-black chin-length ear-level bob hair parted to the right, retaining sparse bangs and fine wisps of hair on the cheeks.

Clothing · Pose:
A deep burgundy one-piece swimsuit. Thin halter-style neck straps extend, with a deep V-neck in the front, and the back is wide open from the shoulder blades to the waist, with a deep V-drop at the waist. Sitting sideways on the bed with knees folded toward the person's own left side, the right hand reaches toward the bedding on the right side of the frame for palm support, and the left arm is partially hidden behind the torso.

Background · Lighting:
On the left side of the frame is a bright wood-framed window, the background consists of beige mottled walls and dark wood wainscoting, and at the bottom of the frame is wrinkled off-white bedding. Soft warm main light filters in from the left window, illuminating the left side of the face, shoulder, back, waist, and thigh, creating a gradient shadow on the right side.

Composition · Lens:
3:4 vertical composition, a full-body close-up portrait from the top of the head to the toes at a low horizontal perspective nearly level with the bed. The character occupies most of the center, with the curve of the back centered and the bent legs overlapping in the lower half. The focus is placed on the face and shoulders, with the window and walls softly blurred with a shallow depth of field.

Texture · Style:
A photorealistic realistic photo under natural light. High-definition depiction of smooth swimsuit fabric, skin, short hair, wrinkled bedding, and wood, with a quiet contrast between burgundy and warm beige.

Negative Prompt:
Do not change the look back over the shoulder to a front-facing sitting position; do not close the deep slit on the back.

prompts.text:
主题：
葡萄色的回首

主体：
温暖的古老房间的床上，画面中央一名女性侧坐，背对镜头从肩后回望的纵向全身特写照片。深葡萄色的背部大开叉连体泳衣和白色寝具是主要元素。

人物·表情：
躯干面向画面右侧，仅脸部从左肩后转向镜头，以灰褐色的细长眼睛静静凝视，淡米粉色的嘴唇轻轻闭合。略显长形的椭圆脸型和小巧圆润的下巴，横宽收窄的杏仁形眼睛，自然柔和的眉毛，细直的鼻梁和小巧的鼻尖。淡妆的眼线和薄薄的腮红，明亮的半哑光肌肤。接近黑色的下巴齐耳鲍勃短发向右侧分线，保留稀疏的前发和脸颊细碎的后发。

服装·姿势：
深酒红色的连体泳衣。细细的吊带颈式肩带延伸，胸前是深V领，背部从肩胛骨到腰际大面积敞开，腰部深V下坠。在床上双膝向人物自身左侧折叠侧坐，右手伸向画面右侧的寝具以手掌支撑，左臂在躯干后方部分隐没。

背景·光线：
画面左侧是木框明亮窗户，背景为米色斑纹墙壁和深色木质腰墙，画面下方是皱褶的生成り白色寝具。左侧窗户透入柔和的暖色主光，照亮脸部左侧、肩膀、背部、腰部和大腿，在右侧形成渐变的阴影。

构图·镜头：
3:4的纵长构图，以与床铺几乎相同的低水平视角，从头顶到足尖部分的全身特写肖像。人物占据中央大部，背部曲线居中，弯曲的双腿重叠于下半部。焦点置于脸部和肩膀，窗户与墙壁以浅景深柔和虚化。

质感·风格：
自然光下的照片级真实写实照片。高清描绘光滑的泳衣面料、肌肤、短发、皱褶寝具和木材，以酒红色与温暖米色静静对比。

负面提示：
不将肩后回首改为正面坐姿；不闭合背部的深开叉

items.title: 东亚女性复古室内直闪近景人像

prompts.text:

prompts.text: Direction: 3:4 vertical composition realistic SNS post style smartphone photo. On a clear daytime outdoor sports field, a fictional adult Japanese female in her early to mid-20s, captured naturally by a friend with a smartphone at the moment of stretching before or after exercise. The core of the reproduction is the stretching pose with arms crossed over the head, a slender S-shaped silhouette with the body flowing to the side, light hair color, healthily tanned skin, white x pink sportswear, and a sports field composed of green, blue, and red. Established not as a cosplay shoot or advertisement shoot, but as a daily snapshot accidentally taken during actual exercise. Mood: Bright, refreshing, and healthy daytime atmosphere. The naturalness of being photographed by a friend while stretching during a break from exercise. Not a forced smile, but a friendly expression looking back at the camera for a moment. No excessively flashy, provocative, or advertisement-style treatment. Model: Fictional adult Japanese female in her early to mid-20s. Does not imitate celebrities, influencers, or real people. Natural bone structure and face shape as a Japanese person. Healthy and curvy adult female body type, no extreme anime body types or unnatural thinness. A flexible body that looks like it has an exercise habit. Face: Natural small oval face as a Japanese female. The jaw should not be too thin, and the cheeks have soft roundness. The bridge of the nose is natural and not overly prominent. Lips slightly closed, a quiet smile with only the corners of the mouth slightly raised. A natural face shape that is not perfectly symmetrical. Looking directly at the camera, but not a posing face for a shoot, but the look of suddenly turning her eyes when called out during stretching. Eyes: Natural almond-shaped eyes. Irises are dark brown to slightly bright brown. Sclera retains natural shadows. Eye makeup is elegant, with thin brown-toned lines centered on the upper eyelid and slender natural eyelashes. No flashy colored contacts, glowing pupils, or anime-style huge eyes. Hair: Long hair dyed in a light beige gold to milk tea gold. A dyed hair color that looks realistic for a Japanese female, not white like platinum, with a bit of yellowish tint. Length is slightly below the chest. Not completely straight, naturally falling in the middle with soft curls at the ends. Long bangs flow diagonally to one side, with a few strands falling by the temples and cheeks. Under the influence of the outdoor breeze and stretching movement, a few fine hairs float irregularly. Skin: Healthy Japanese female wheat skin tone as if bathed in sunlight during outdoor sports. Warm-toned golden beige, with slight color differences remaining on the face, neck, shoulders, and arms. No uniform bronze processing, retaining pores, fine hairs, thin spots, shadows around joints, etc., for a realistic photo-like subtle skin texture. No excessive beauty filters or plastic-like textures. Body: An adult female body type with a very full bust equivalent to a J-cup. However, instead of unrealistically enlarging the chest alone, the connection of shoulder width, ribcage, waist, pelvis, and thighs is established as a realistic natural human proportion. Retaining natural positions according to gravity and extremely slight left-right differences, the ribcage naturally lifts when raising the arms. A relatively slender waist, rounded pelvis, and healthy, firm legs. The protagonist of the body is not the chest, but the slender S-shaped silhouette extending from the arms to the head, ribcage, waist, and pelvis. Outfit: A regular-length white short-sleeved sports T-shirt. The crew neck and cuffs are trimmed only with light pink ribbing. No logos, text, school names, brand names, or numbers. Soft sports jersey fabric, fitting the body moderately but not completely tight. The full chest equivalent to a J-cup makes the fabric naturally pull forward, with fine pull-wrinkles extending from the side of the ribcage to the flank. When raising both arms, the fabric pulls toward the shoulders and armpits, and the regular-length hem naturally lifts slightly, with a bit of the area around the navel exposed. It is not made as a crop top from the beginning. Bottoms are light cherry blossom pink sports shorts. Soft jersey fabric, elastic waist, two thin white lines on the left and right. The length is natural, not excessively short or high-cut, naturally established as realistic sportswear. Accessories: A bright pink fabric scrunchie worn near one wrist. Not satin, but a slightly wrinkled cotton-like material. No large jewelry, flashy accessories, necklaces, or brand items. Scene_objects: Yellow-green grass field, red to dark pink running track, blue low fences or sports field equipment, followed by dark green trees. In the distance, white lines, small sports equipment, benches, sports bags, etc., can exist extremely sparingly. No huge stadiums crowded with spectators. Retain color spots on the grass, wear on the track, slight fading of the fence, etc., as small imperfections of an actually used location. Pose: Most important. The arm on the right side of the screen is stretched almost vertically upward from the shoulder, the elbow is not completely locked but slightly relaxed. The opposite arm is bent, the forearm spans behind the head, and the hand lightly touches the area from the elbow to the upper arm of the stretched arm. A natural stretching pose with both arms crossed overhead. The ribcage is slightly tilted toward the left side of the screen, and the pelvis naturally slides toward the right side of the screen. The center of gravity is slightly biased toward one leg, and the heights of the left and right shoulders and waist are not perfectly aligned. Instead of making the ribcage and pelvis face the same direction, the whole body forms a soft inverted S-shape. Not a model pose, but a natural body line formed as a result of normal stretching of the shoulders and flanks. Gravity_and_cloth: Chest, T-shirt, hair, and shorts all reflect natural gravity. The full chest equivalent to a J-cup also does not have an unnatural upward fixed shape, retaining a natural weight sensation as a human body. When raising arms, the T-shirt fabric pulls toward the shoulders, armpits, and ribcage, the chest is stretched forward, there are diagonal wrinkles on the flanks, and there is uneven lifting near the hem. The shorts also produce small fabric ripples due to the shift in gravity. Hair hangs down according to gravity, while a light breeze makes a few strands sway gently. Lighting: Clear sky to bright lightly clouded daylight. Main light is soft natural light entering from the front top-left of the screen. Natural highlights on the forehead, bridge of nose, cheeks, shoulders, upper arms, top of the T-shirt, and thighs. Natural shadows under the chin, neck, inner arms, armpits, and clothing folds. Instead of using only direct sunlight to make shadows pitch black, the blue ambient light of the sky and reflected light from the grass or ground surround weakly. For the white T-shirt part, there can be very slight overexposure as a smartphone shot. Effect: Not an advertisement photo, but a real SNS snapshot taken with a smartphone. A slight sense of JPEG compression, subtle luminance noise, and some edge processing characteristic of smartphones. There can be extremely weak motion traces just before hand shake at hair tips or fingertips. No excessive HDR, retaining slight incomplete gradations in highlights and shadows. Saturation is natural, avoiding cinematic orange-teal or strong color grading. Camera: A friend shooting with a smartphone's standard to 2x equivalent camera from a distance of about 1.8 to 2.3 meters. Natural perspective of about 50-60mm in full-frame equivalent. Camera height is at the chest to sternum level, shooting slightly upward from a position slightly lower than the subject. Not an extreme low angle. As a smartphone, no excessive shallow depth of field, the person is clear, and the background also retains information recognizable as a sports field. No artificial strong blur of portrait mode. The neckline and sleeves of the T-shirt are not perfectly symmetrical. No completely melting blur, retaining information to see it's an outdoor sports field. Atmosphere: Before starting light training or during a break from exercise. A scene of suddenly turning her face toward the camera without breaking the stretching pose when called by a friend while relaxing the body. Not standing perfectly from the beginning for the shoot, but a contingency captured following the flow of the scene. A daily atmosphere where the bright air of summer to early autumn, the smell of grass, or slightly dry field air can be felt. Composition: 3:4 vertical composition. A wide range from the upward-stretched arm to the upper thigh area is included. The person occupies about 75-85% of the frame. The head is near the center, the ribcage is slightly left of center, the waist is almost central, and the pelvis moves toward the right of the frame. The person's center line continues from the arms, head, ribcage, waist, and pelvis into a soft inverted S-shape. The upward-stretched arm is quite close to the top of the frame, and a part of it may be near. The left and right margins are not perfectly equal, and the right margin is slightly tighter due to the pelvis flowing to the right. Instead of just cropping or making the chest the protagonist, it's a continuous overall silhouette from the overhead arm to the thighs. Realism_priority: Top priority is that the fictional adult female as a Japanese person looks like a real photo. Instead of just emphasizing the J-cup body type specification, the bone structure, gravity, clothing tension, posture, and balance of shoulders and back are all realistic. Priority is given to posture, color composition, physical behavior of fabric, natural light, background information, and imperfections characteristic of smartphone shooting over replication of anime body proportions. "effect": "不是广告照片，而是智能手机拍摄的真实SNS快照。轻微JPEG压缩感、细微亮度噪点、些许智能手机特有的边缘处理。发梢或指尖可有手抖寸前的极弱运动痕迹。不过度HDR，保留高光和暗部的些微不完整阶调。饱和度自然，避免电影式的橙-青调或强烈的颜色分级。",

"camera": "朋友从约1.8～2.3米的距离用智能手机的标准到2倍等效相机拍摄。全画幅换算约50～60mm程度的自然远近感。相机高度在胸到胸骨程度，比被摄体稍低的位置微微仰拍。不是极端低角度。作为智能手机，不做过度浅景深，人物清晰，背景也保留能辨识为运动场地的信息量。不用人像模式的 artificial 强虚化。",

prompts.text:
Create a premium handcrafted 3D paper-craft travel diorama centered around a little girl and her beloved doll on a magical journey.

adorable young girl doll character sitting on the upper edge of the diorama with her favorite small doll companion beside her. She wears a charming vintage travel outfit — a soft knitted cardigan, pleated skirt, little boots, cute hat, and a tiny backpack. She holds a miniature travel journal or map, while her doll is dressed in a matching outfit and carries a tiny suitcase.

The main scene inside the dimensional frame should represent [DESTINATION] as a magical miniature world. Include its most recognizable architecture and landscapes, but reinterpret everything as handcrafted toys and paper sculptures: tiny buildings, colorful streets, flowers, trees, bridges, cafés, lanterns, local decorations, and a small pathway leading into the scene.

Add charming storytelling details:

The girl’s doll sitting beside her as her travel companion
Tiny suitcase covered with travel stickers
Miniature teddy bear peeking from the backpack
A tiny camera hanging around the girl’s neck
Small postcards and stamps scattered around the frame
A miniature paper airplane flying through the scene
A tiny map with a dotted route
Handcrafted flowers and plants around the foreground

Use a soft pastel vintage palette of dusty pink, warm cream, terracotta, muted teal, sage green, peach, and warm brown.

The entire artwork should feel like a luxury handcrafted children’s storybook mixed with a vintage travel scrapbook, using layered cardstock, paper quilling, embossed paper, miniature clay details, fabric textures, stitched leather accents, and delicate hand-painted surfaces.

Make the girl and her doll especially charming and expressive, with a cute collectible-doll aesthetic, oversized curious eyes, soft handcrafted facial details, and a warm adventurous personality.

Add a large raised plaque at the bottom reading:

[DESTINATION]
[COUNTRY]

Surround the composition with subtle travel elements such as a compass, postage stamps, luggage tags, leaves, postcards, and a dotted travel route.

Soft warm studio lighting, realistic miniature shadows, tactile paper fibers, shallow depth of field, premium product photography, highly detailed handcrafted textures, whimsical cinematic atmosphere, elegant composition, cozy nostalgic feeling, museum-quality miniature diorama, 8K.

Avoid: photorealistic humans, plastic-looking 3D characters, excessive text, clutter, harsh colors, modern objects, generic fantasy scenery.

可爱的年轻女孩玩偶角色坐在立体模型的上边缘，身边带着她最喜欢的小玩偶同伴。她穿着迷人的复古旅行装——柔软的针织开衫、百褶裙、小靴子、可爱的帽子和一个小背包。她手里拿着一本微型旅行日记或地图，而她的玩偶穿着配套的服装并拎着一个小提箱。

从小背包里探头的小泰迪熊
挂在女孩脖子上的微型相机
散落在框架周围的小明信片和邮票

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium food advertising poster that preserves the core visual logic of a hand-held illustrated tasting card photographed in a warm casual dining environment, while refining it into a more cohesive Transit-version commercial visual centered on one tightly curated product family. Design an original Japanese-inspired street-gourmet brand called KITSUNE TABLE. Show one realistic human hand holding a vertical off-white tasting card in the foreground, slightly tilted, centered in the frame, photographed above a softly blurred restaurant table scene. The card must be the absolute visual hero. It should feature a curated collection of 10 signature ramen-and-side-dish items rendered as charming hand-drawn premium food illustrations with elegant editorial spacing, stylish English-first labels, small prices, and tiny handwritten annotation marks. No copied text from the source image. All wording must be newly invented, beautiful, sparse, and brand-consistent.

Core composition:
Use a strict vertical composition with the tasting card occupying most of the frame, held naturally by one hand from the lower left corner. The card floats above a softly blurred tabletop with subtle chopsticks, napkin folds, ceramic reflections, and warm restaurant ambience, but the background remains secondary. The card should be slightly angled from lower left to upper right, creating a candid handheld snapshot feeling. Keep the design dense but breathable: small illustrated dishes distributed across the page in a balanced scattered layout, with enough white space to feel premium and collectible. The overall image must read instantly as a stylish ramen discovery card, a souvenir-like tasting guide, and a campaign poster at the same time.

Brand and title logic:
At the top of the card, place a compact brand mark “KITSUNE TABLE” and below it a bold elegant handwritten title such as “RAMEN & BITES GUIDE” in expressive English lettering. Add one small secondary location-style label such as “MIDNIGHT DISTRICT” or “ALLEY EDITION” in a neat typographic block if needed. Typography must feel hand-crafted, editorial, playful, and precise, not generic, not childish, not corporate.

Unified product system:
Include exactly 10 signature items built around a coherent ramen-and-side-dish universe:
1. Yuzu Shoyu Ramen
2. Black Garlic Tonkotsu
3. Spicy Miso Corn Ramen
4. Sake Clam Udon
5. Crispy Gyoza
6. Tamago Sando Bites
7. Wagyu Negi Skewer
8. Ebi Tempura Roll
9. Plum Soda
10. Hojicha Milk Tea
The card must feel like one curated late-night Japanese comfort-food system rather than a random assortment. Every illustration should support the same brand world: warm broths, glossy noodles, golden fried textures, grilled char marks, soft bread crumb, translucent drinks, precise garnishes, and compact editorial appetizing detail.

Food illustration realism:
Render every item as an ultra-appetizing miniature hero illustration with real product logic: broth surface shimmer, oil droplets, noodle sheen, egg yolk texture, sliced chashu marbling, seaweed softness, gyoza blistering, tempura crumb structure, skewer glaze, drink condensation, ice refraction, foam highlights, and garnish freshness. The look should feel like a hybrid of editorial food sketching and luxury product visualization. Every item must be delicious, clean, and physically believable.

Typography and annotation:
Use elegant handwritten English for item names, tiny refined descriptors below selected dishes, and restrained clean price numerals. Add thin doodled arrows, small ingredient notes, and minimal recommendation cues to connect text and dish illustrations. Keep the layout lively but controlled. No dense paragraphs, no copied foreign text, no chaotic note clutter.

Card material and print finish:
The tasting card should feel like thick premium matte paper with a soft warm ivory tone, crisp edges, subtle natural tooth, and fine print fidelity. Printed linework should use warm dark-brown or espresso ink rather than harsh black, giving the piece a softer gourmet identity. The illustrations must feel sharp, boutique-designed, and professionally printed.

Hand and realism:
Show one realistic hand holding the card from the lower left with believable anatomy, correct finger count, natural skin texture, soft knuckle folds, clean nails, and relaxed grip pressure. The hand should feel candid and unforced, supporting the authenticity of a real dining moment. No deformed fingers, no awkward grip.

Lighting:
Use warm ambient restaurant lighting with a soft key light from upper right-front, creating flattering highlights on the paper, subtle shadow beneath the fingers, and gentle glow on the tabletop behind. Add cozy golden-brown bokeh and low-contrast depth in the background. The lighting must feel intimate, appetizing, and commercial, with soft shadow transitions and no muddy black areas.

Color system:
Base palette: warm ivory, toasted cream, walnut brown, dark espresso ink, caramel beige, muted charcoal. Accent palette from the food: ramen amber, miso orange, yuzu yellow, corn gold, chashu pink-brown, seaweed green, tempura gold, plum red, hojicha brown. Keep the card restrained so the dishes provide the chromatic highlights. The overall mood must feel warm, urban, flavorful, artisanal, and premium.

Background and environment:
Set the scene in a cozy Japanese-inspired bistro or ramen bar environment, softly out of focus. Suggest a dark tabletop, a folded napkin, a pair of chopsticks, a faint glass reflection, and dim seating beyond, but keep everything blurred and clean. No messy leftovers, no distracting people, no clutter. The card remains the dominant product.

Commercial finish:
The final image must feel like a Cannes-level boutique restaurant campaign visual: hand-held authenticity, collectible tasting-card design, beautiful typography hierarchy, mouthwatering real-product illustration, elegant brand identity, and extremely clean editorial composition. Crisp focus on the card, text, printed dishes, and hand; soft atmospheric blur everywhere else. No dirt, no stains, no bad perspective, no cheap menu design.

Negative prompt:
copied source text, generic menu typography, cluttered layout, unreadable labels, messy arrows, excessive paragraphs, low-resolution food drawings, plastic-looking food, bad anatomy, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, warped hand, muddy shadows, black blotches, oversaturated colors, chaotic background, distracting people, cheap branding, duplicate dishes, flat lighting, blurry card edges, bad print texture, watermark, logo clutter

prompts.text:
创建一张超高端美食广告海报，保留在一个温馨休闲餐饮环境中拍摄的手持插画品鉴卡的核心视觉逻辑，同时将其提炼为更具凝聚力的、以一个精心策划的产品系列为中心的 Transit 版本商业视觉。设计一个名为 KITSUNE TABLE 的原创日式灵感街头美食品牌。展示一只真实的人手在前景中握着一张垂直的米白色品鉴卡，略微倾斜，居中构图，在柔焦的餐厅桌面场景上方拍摄。卡片必须是绝对的视觉主角。它应包含一组精心挑选的 10 款招牌拉面和配菜，以迷人的手绘高端美食插画形式呈现，具有优雅的编辑间距、时尚的英文优先标签、小额价格和微小的手写注释标记。不要复制源图像中的文字。所有文字必须是新发明的、美观的、稀疏的且符合品牌调性。

核心构图：
采用严格的垂直构图，品鉴卡占据画面大部分，由一只手从左下角自然握住。卡片漂浮在柔焦的桌面上方，背景有细微的筷子、餐巾褶皱、陶瓷反光和温馨的餐厅氛围，但背景保持次要。卡片应从左下向右上稍微倾斜，营造出一种随意的抓拍感。保持设计密集但有呼吸感：小插图菜肴平衡地分布在页面上，采用分散式布局，并留有足够的留白，使其感觉高端且具有收藏价值。整体图像必须能让人立即读出既是时尚的拉面探索卡，又是纪念品般的品鉴指南，同时也是竞选海报。

品牌和标题逻辑：
在卡片顶部，放置一个紧凑的品牌标识“KITSUNE TABLE”，下方是一个醒目优雅的手写标题，如富有表现力的英文刻字“RAMEN & BITES GUIDE”。如果需要，可以在整齐的排版块中添加一个小的二级位置标签，如“MIDNIGHT DISTRICT”或“ALLEY EDITION”。排版必须感觉是手工打造的、编辑风格的、俏皮且精确的，而不是通用的、幼稚的或企业化的。

统一的产品系统：
包含正好 10 个围绕连贯的拉面和配菜宇宙构建的招牌项目：
1. Yuzu Shoyu Ramen (柚子酱油拉面)
2. Black Garlic Tonkotsu (黑蒜豚骨拉面)
3. Spicy Miso Corn Ramen (辣味噌玉米拉面)
4. Sake Clam Udon (清酒蛤蜊乌冬面)
5. Crispy Gyoza (酥脆饺子)
6. Tamago Sando Bites (玉子烧三明治)
7. Wagyu Negi Skewer (和牛大葱串)
8. Ebi Tempura Roll (海老天妇罗卷)
9. Plum Soda (苏打梅酒)
10. Hojicha Milk Tea (焙茶奶茶)
这张卡片必须感觉像是一个精心策划的深夜日式治愈美食系统，而不是随机组合。每张插图都应支持同一个品牌世界：温暖的汤头、有光泽的面条、金黄的油炸质感、烤焦的痕迹、柔软的面包屑、半透明的饮料、精确的装饰和紧凑的编辑风格诱人细节。

美食插画现实主义：
将每个项目渲染为具有真实产品逻辑的超诱人微型主角插图：汤面闪烁、油脂滴、面条光泽、蛋黄质感、叉烧肉片大理石纹、海苔柔软度、饺子皮起泡、天妇罗碎屑结构、串烧釉面、饮料冷凝水、冰块折射、泡沫高光和配菜新鲜度。外观应感觉像是编辑美食素描和奢侈产品可视化的结合体。每件物品都必须美味、干净且物理上可信。

排版和注释：
使用优雅的手写英文标注项目名称，在选定菜肴下方使用微小精致的描述词，以及克制干净的价格数字。添加细线涂鸦箭头、小型成分注释和极简的推荐提示，以连接文本和菜肴插图。保持布局活泼但受控。没有密集的段落，没有复制的外文文本，没有混乱的笔记堆砌。

卡片材质和印刷工艺：
品鉴卡应感觉像厚实的高端哑光纸，具有柔和的暖象牙色调、锋利的边缘、微妙的自然纹理和精细的印刷保真度。印刷线条应使用温暖的深褐色或浓缩咖啡色墨水，而不是生硬的黑色，赋予作品更柔和的美食身份。插图必须感觉清晰、精品设计且印刷专业。

手部和真实感：
展示一只真实的手从左下角握住卡片，具有可信的解剖结构、正确的手指数量、自然的皮肤纹理、柔软的关节褶皱、干净的指甲和放松的握持压力。手的感觉应该是随意的、不强求的，支持真实用餐瞬间的真实性。没有畸形的手指，没有尴尬的握姿。

光照：
使用温馨的餐厅环境光，右前方上方有柔和的主光，在纸张上产生悦目的高光，在手指下方产生微妙的阴影，并在后面的桌面上产生柔和的光晕。背景添加舒适的金褐色焦外成像和低对比度深度。灯光必须感觉亲密、诱人且具有商业感，阴影过渡柔和，没有浑浊的黑色区域。

色彩系统：
基础调色板：暖象牙色、烤奶油色、胡桃褐、深浓缩咖啡墨水、焦糖米色、柔和炭色。来自食物的点缀色：拉面琥珀色、味噌橙色、柚子黄、玉米金、叉烧粉褐色、海苔绿、天妇罗金、梅子红、焙茶棕。保持卡片色彩克制，以便菜肴提供色彩亮点。整体基调必须感觉温暖、都市、富有风味、手工且高端。

背景和环境：
场景设定在一个温馨的日式风格小酒馆或拉面吧环境中，柔焦处理。暗示一个深色桌面、一个折叠的餐巾、一双筷子、一个模糊的玻璃杯反光和远处的昏暗座位，但保持一切模糊和干净。没有凌乱的剩菜，没有分散注意力的行人，没有杂物。卡片仍然是主导产品。

商业成品感：
最终图像必须感觉像是戛纳级别的精品餐厅活动视觉效果：手持的真实感、可收藏的品鉴卡设计、精美的排版层级、令人垂涎的真实产品插图、优雅的品牌标识和极其干净的编辑构图。核心聚焦在卡片、文字、印刷菜肴和手部；其他地方都是柔和的大气模糊。没有污垢，没有污渍，没有错误的透视，没有廉价的菜单设计。

负面提示词：
复制的源文本、通用的菜单排版、拥挤的布局、无法辨认的标签、混乱的箭头、过多的段落、低分辨率的美食图画、塑料感的食物、糟糕的解剖、多余的手指、缺失的手指、融合的手指、扭曲的手、浑浊的阴影、黑色斑块、过饱和的颜色、混乱的背景、分散注意力的行人、廉价的品牌、重复的菜肴、平淡的光线、模糊的卡片边缘、糟糕的印刷质感、水印、徽标堆砌

prompts.text:
Create a premium 4:5 vertical retro screen-print poster illustration centered on [SUBJECT / LANDMARK / CITY / ERA]. The composition should feel like a refined vintage travel or cultural print, while remaining adaptable to any location, historical period, landmark, or subject.

TYPOGRAPHY: Place the primary title "[MAIN TITLE]" in a bold, condensed uppercase sans-serif, positioned within a balanced area of negative space. Add a smaller supporting line "[SECONDARY HEADLINE / LOCATION / DATE]" beneath it. Maintain strong typographic hierarchy, restrained spacing, and an authentic archival-poster character.

MAIN SUBJECT: Feature [PRIMARY SUBJECT] as the dominant visual element, positioned within the lower or side third of the composition. Use a distinctive pose, silhouette, or profile that communicates the character of the subject. Include carefully rendered defining details, natural contours, expressive features, clothing or architectural details, and subtle highlights without making the artwork photorealistic.

GEOMETRIC ANCHOR: Introduce one bold, simple geometric shape behind or around the main subject to create visual separation and establish a strong graphic focal point.

BACKGROUND: Construct the environment as several flat, layered graphic planes rather than a conventional realistic scene. Use recognizable elements associated with [LOCATION / SUBJECT] — distant silhouettes, architectural forms, structural details, vegetation, terrain, atmospheric elements, or cultural motifs. Avoid a strong vanishing point. Build depth through overlapping shapes, scale, linework, and tonal density. 身材高挑纤细，约170～175cm，腿部修长，头身比例优美，腰部纤细，肩颈线条修长，身体曲线自然。

人物处于严格的右侧侧面视角。

头部微微抬起，下巴略微向前，鼻梁、嘴唇、下颌线形成清晰优雅的侧脸剪影。

神情平静、疏离、克制，不笑，不看镜头，视线自然望向右前方。

皮肤为自然偏暖的浅肤色，由于低照度逆光，大部分身体处于柔和暗部，只在脸部轮廓、肩膀、手臂、腿部边缘形成微弱暖色高光。

真实皮肤纹理，保留自然毛孔与细微明暗过渡，不要塑料皮肤，不要强烈磨皮。

## 发型

乌黑或深黑色超长直发，头发长度接近腰部。

前额及脸侧保留几缕自然垂落的黑色碎发，一缕发丝沿脸颊侧面垂下。

头发采用半盘发、半披发造型，上半部分在后脑轻轻挽起，下半部分长发自然垂落。

后脑位置固定一朵较大的米白色、奶油色绢花或柔软布艺花饰，类似东方复古发饰。

花饰不能过大，不能现代蝴蝶结感过强。

发丝真实细腻，具有自然散落感与轻微光泽。

## 饰品

佩戴细长垂坠式耳环，银色或浅金色，小巧精致。

双手腕部佩戴极细的金属手镯或手链。

首饰低调，不能喧宾夺主。

## 服装

穿一件极具东方复古气质的黑色贴身长裙，融合现代旗袍与晚礼服设计。

整体以深黑色为底色。

面料为略带丝绸光泽的柔软高级布料。

裙身从胸部到臀部贴合身体自然曲线。

上身为无袖、抹胸或极细肩带式设计，肩膀与手臂裸露，后背具有一定露肤面积。

裙身表面带有大面积低调的金色、暗金色东方牡丹花纹或古典花卉纹样，纹样集中于胸腰、臀部以及大腿区域。

花纹不是刺眼亮金，而是被暖光压暗后的复古暗金色。

裙子为长款设计，裙摆接近脚踝。

靠镜头一侧具有极高的侧开衩，从大腿上部自然打开，使前后腿在侧面站姿中清晰可见。

开衩边缘垂下一片狭长黑色裙摆，在腿部之间形成明显的垂直黑色线条。

服装必须高级、克制、复古，不要廉价性感写真感。

## 鞋子

穿裸色、米金色或浅香槟色细带高跟凉鞋。

极细高跟，约10～12cm。

脚踝位置有纤细绕带。

鞋面由几根极细金属色或裸色带子组成。

真实脚部结构，脚趾数量正确，高跟鞋结构合理。

## 姿势

这是画面最重要的部分。

人物站在画面左侧至中央位置，完整全身入镜。

身体完全侧向右侧。

双腿前后自然错开，形成明显的修长站姿：

左侧后腿向画面左下方伸展，脚掌落地；

右侧前腿位于身体下方略向前，膝盖基本伸直。

由于裙子的高开衩，两条腿都能看到。

臀部略微向画面左侧后方突出。

腰部形成自然轻微反弓。

上半身从腰部开始向画面右侧明显前倾，上半身和下半身几乎呈90度状态，腰部几乎水平，整个身体形成一条优美夸张的S曲线。

胸腔向前延伸。

双肩放松。

两只手臂同时向前伸出。

双肘微微弯曲。

双手自然撑在画面右侧一件复古家具的顶部边缘。

手指修长、放松、自然分开。

人物不是夸张摆拍，而像在安静地俯身触碰家具或观察面前的雾气。

整个人体侧面轮廓形成明显的“S形”视觉曲线。

## 右侧家具

画面右侧放置一件复古奶油色或米黄色金属家具。

造型类似20世纪中期复古美容院设备、老式旅行箱柜、复古蒸汽护理台或金属推车。

家具主体为圆角长方体。

顶部呈圆润弧形。

外壳为奶油米黄色。

四周具有深色或金属色包边。

正面有少量复古铰链、锁扣、小型黑色金属配件。

底部可以有细长金属支架。

家具约到人物髋部或腰部高度。

人物双手正撑在它的顶部。

不要出现现代桌子、现代电器或复杂机械结构。

## 蒸汽与光源

家具顶部靠右位置有一个小型暖白色光源，类似小夜灯、香薰灯或蒸汽设备的发光口。

灯体本身非常小，只呈现一个柔和明亮的乳白色椭圆形高光。

灯光附近升起明显但柔软的白色水蒸气。

蒸汽从右下方缓缓向左上方扩散。

雾气半透明、自然翻滚，边缘柔软。

暖色光线穿过蒸汽后产生轻微体积光效果。

蒸汽不能变成浓烟，不能像火灾烟雾。

## 场景

极简复古室内。

背景几乎没有装饰。

后方是一整面暖米黄色、焦糖黄色墙壁。

墙面存在极少量竖直拼接线。

画面左侧有一个巨大的墙体转角或立柱。

左侧区域明显更暗，形成大面积深棕色阴影。

右侧墙面受到暖光照射，比左侧明亮。

地面同样为深暖棕色或暗黄色。

背景干净，没有窗户，没有床，没有植物，没有复杂家具，没有文字。

整体空间产生一种高级酒店、私人会所、复古美容室或电影布景般的神秘感。

## 构图

竖版 9:16。

全身侧面人物摄影。

人物从头顶到高跟鞋全部完整入镜。

头顶上方保留较大的负空间。

人物头部位于画面高度约25%～30%的位置。

人物主体位于中央偏左。

右侧家具占据画面右下约25%～30%。

人物头部与上半身不要居中，应保留明显环境空间。

人物身体与家具形成横向连接关系。

左侧约20%～25%的画面被深色墙体或阴影占据。

背景右上方保留大面积暖色负空间。

构图极简、克制、具有高级时尚摄影的留白感。

## 摄影机

真实全画幅相机拍摄。

约50mm～70mm人像镜头。

摄影机高度大约位于人物腰部至胸部之间。

基本平视，轻微低机位，但不要明显仰拍。

摄影机距离人物约4～6米。

无广角畸变。

人物完整全身进入画面。

f/2.8～f/4。

ISO 800～1600。

1/80s～1/125s。

轻微浅景深，但人物身体、裙子、双腿和家具主体仍然保持足够清晰。

## 灯光

整个画面采用极低调的电影级暖色布光。

主色温约2200K～3000K。

只使用暖琥珀色、焦糖色、暗金色、深棕色与黑色。

主要光源来自画面右侧及右前方。

人物左侧身体大部分陷入阴影。

面部不需要完全照亮，以侧脸轮廓为主。

肩膀、上臂、前臂、腰部、大腿和小腿边缘受到微弱暖色轮廓光。

黑色裙装与暗色背景局部融为一体，只留下金色花纹和人体边缘。

高光不过曝。

暗部保留层次。

具有真实摄影中的宽容度，而不是纯黑剪影。

右下方蒸汽附近的小灯形成画面最亮区域。

整体曝光明显偏暗约0.7～1.5档。

## 色彩

极其统一的暖色单色调。

amber lighting,
warm sepia,
caramel brown,
dark gold,
warm tungsten light,
low-key photography.

肤色、墙壁、地面全部受到钨丝灯暖色影响。

黑色裙子保持真正的深黑色。

金色花卉仅呈暗金色反光。

避免橙色过饱和。

避免黄得像滤镜。

画面应该像真实摄影经过克制电影调色后的效果。

## 质感

超写实真人摄影。

真实电影剧照。

真实女性身体结构。

真实皮肤。

真实发丝。

真实丝绸与织物纹理。

真实高跟鞋。

真实蒸汽。

自然阴影。

轻微高感噪点。

非常轻微的电影胶片颗粒。

暗部存在少量真实数码噪声。

不过度锐化。

不要AI塑料感。

不要HDR过度。

不要商业棚拍的均匀补光。

整体具有安静、暧昧、神秘、复古、高级、克制的东方电影气质。

A beautiful adult Korean woman in her early 20s with warm fair porcelain skin, a delicate oval face, expressive almond-shaped dark brown eyes, an elegant straight nose, naturally full glossy lips, subtle Korean makeup with soft pink blush and natural eyeliner, and a sleek chin-length black bob with silky texture, soft inward curves, a subtle side part, and wispy face-framing bangs gently moved by the breeze.

prompts.text: Build a modern flat graphic around any chosen subject object, with a huge Chinese theme character, geometric color blocks, and a single-line organic contour interlacing through one another. Keep an overall bright, clean background field, letting approximately two-thirds or more of the space remain empty, and concentrate the main weight in an off-center cluster: a saturated rectangular block in the theme's primary color first establishes a stable plane; a deeper, low-lightness, cool-toned circle overlaps from beneath it and extends beyond the boundary; the core Chinese theme character advances vertically in oversized, heavy, geometric black strokes across the white background, rectangle, and circle, with partial occlusion and cropping creating a strong scale jump; on the left, the date and a bilingual subtitle form a compact numeric column, while on the right, short vertical sentences set in two stroke-weight tiers balance the weight; a few miniature captions, short dashes, and linear symbols scatter along the edges, creating a three-level reading rhythm from main character to side notes to details. Abstract the dynamic relationship derived from the theme into one continuous organic contour, drawn as a broad sweeping loop with a clear, near-black single line that enters from the large empty field, passes through the color blocks, and crosses the edge; the curve intersects itself several times while remaining legible as a single path; keep most of its interior as the underlying background color, adding only localized, transparent, fading fills in the theme's primary color at the tips and extended sections, so the light line creates tension with the heavy giant character. Adapt the color scheme to the theme: let a clean, high-lightness neutral background carry the largest area; keep the theme's primary color vivid and highly saturated, using it for the rectangle and the localized transparent gradient; use a deep cool support color for the circle, separated in hue from the primary color and blending softly into the primary color at its end; use near-black for text and the contour, with a very small amount of light text reversed onto the primary color block; fix unequal areas, lightness hierarchy, and saturation differences, but do not fix specific color names. Render all elements as flat surfaces like matte digital printing, with sharp contour edges and gradients only as two localized, slowly feathered transitions; do not add dimensional shadows, paper grain, or global lighting effects. Keep typography in a low-contrast, broad, thick, near-geometric black sans-serif skeleton; allow the main character's parts to be elongated, offset, cut out, and switched between color-block backgrounds; give numbers a rounded futuristic structure and compress small text with narrow letterforms and loose tracking. Replace brand names, advertising copy, and concrete dates with new theme information. Preserve in the final result the extreme whitespace, the geometric cluster positioned lower-center, the opposing pull between horizontal and vertical text, and the moment an organic line crosses rigid geometric shapes, while avoiding evenly filling every part or reducing the contour to an isolated decoration.

prompts.text:
16:9 horizontal cinematic frame, oriental divine realm super-scale royal architectural photography, 1980s Hong Kong fantasy wuxia cinematic language + modern photorealistic cinematic VFX. The camera stands in the liminal space between the interior of a super-giant main divine hall and a cloud-adjacent platform, human eye height about 1.4 meters, 32mm lens, level gaze into the distance, no aerial photography.

The foreground is the abnormally massive interior structure of the main hall, with a giant viewing opening, deep vermilion palace lacquer pillars, oily deep wood beams, black-blue multi-layered eaves, cyan-green dougong, and a few ancient gold door decorations; the tops of the pillars, eaves, and beam structures are cropped by the frame, clearly expressing the oppression of the foreground mega-structure. White jade platforms, railings, column bases, and partial wall surfaces are warm and highly polished, with exquisite dragon patterns, cloud patterns, and lotus pattern reliefs, overall royal luxury, clean and magnificent.

The midground is an extremely wide white jade platform adjacent to clouds, where 3 adult oriental female immortals wear pale cyan, moon white, and light apricot long dresses, standing by the edge of the platform talking in low voices and viewing the scenery; the figures are small, serving only as a scale reference.

Beyond the platform is a vast and pure white sea of clouds, the air is extremely clear, with giant stereoscopic cumulus clouds in the distance. At the very far end, a central main god palace must stand at the edge of the sea of clouds, kilometers away but still abnormally massive, horizontally extremely wide, with a heavy foundation and obvious extended wings; the main body is medium-deep blue-grey palace structure, dark blue and black-blue multi-layered eaves, dark vermilion column rows, deep wood beams, and a warm white jade base; slightly washed out by atmospheric perspective, but must maintain a medium-deep color quality, significantly darker than the sea of clouds, cannot be whitened, cannot be shrunk, and cannot become a light, ethereal background.

The overall luminosity structure is: dark foreground frame → bright white jade platform and sea of clouds → medium-deep distant main palace → clear blue sky. The lighting is high-altitude clear daytime strong side-backlight, cloud edges are glowing, shadows are cool and clear, highlights are bright but not overexposed. Overall requirements: clear, luxurious, sacred, solemn, strong royal sense, distant main palace is huge and heavy, the composition is concise with a sense of pressure.

**Forbidden:** Aerial photography, bird's-eye view, ordinary small palaces, shrinking distance, whitened distance, gray fog, full-screen volumetric fog, oversized characters, plants stealing the spotlight, rough textures, ordinary temple feeling, tourist-spot style, plastic white jade, excessive gold, cluttered palace clusters.

prompts.text:
16:9 横向电影画幅，东方神界超尺度皇家建筑摄影，1980s Hong Kong fantasy wuxia cinematic language + modern photorealistic cinematic VFX。摄影机站在一座超巨型神界主殿内部与临云平台交界的阈限空间，人眼高度约 1.4 米，32mm 镜头，平视远方，不航拍。

近景是异常巨大的主殿内部结构，巨型观景开口、深朱宫廷漆柱、油润深木梁架、墨青重檐、青绿斗拱、少量古金门饰，柱顶、檐口、梁架都被画面裁切，明确表现近景巨构压迫。白玉平台、栏杆、柱础与局部墙面温润高抛光，带精致龙纹、云纹、莲纹浮雕，整体皇家奢华、洁净华贵。

中景是一片极宽阔的白玉临云平台，3 位成年东方女仙穿淡青、月白、浅杏长裙，站在平台边低声交谈并观景，人物较小，仅作尺度参照。

Beyond the mirrored pond is a vast white sea of clouds; the foreground air is extremely clear, with a few giant three-dimensional cumulus clouds in the distance. prompts.text:
16:9 horizontal cinematic aspect ratio, Eastern divine realm super-scale royal capital photography, 1980s Hong Kong fantasy wuxia cinematic language + modern photorealistic cinematic VFX. The camera stands between the railing of a suspended palace terrace and the main hall, at an eye level of approximately 1.4 meters, 40mm–50mm with a slight telephoto compression, looking straight ahead at the distance, no aerial photography.

The right side and top of the foreground are pressed into by a part of an exceptionally massive royal main hall: deep vermilion lacquered giant columns, oily deep wood beam structures, dark blue-green double eaves, blue and green dougong, antique gold edges, and high-polished white jade walls and railings; the structure can only be seen in part and is cropped by the frame, the foreground building itself possesses a strong sense of megastructure oppression.

The midground consists of multi-layered white jade palace terraces, long steps, and corridors continuously extending along a huge cliff, the platforms are wide and clean. 3–4 adult Eastern female immortals wear light cyan, moon white, apricot pink, and light jade green long dresses, sitting or standing by the railing to view the scenery, the characters are relatively small. Local wisteria and ancient pines of the divine realm on far cliffs only serve as natural form-breakers.

The left side of the frame opens up to a large area of bright blue sky and pure white cloud sea. The core divine temple of the main city at the extreme far end of the high sky must be exceptionally massive; despite being several kilometers away, it still possesses absolute visual weight, horizontally wide like a mountain range, the hall body is high, wide, thick, and deep, its volume clearly overpowering all surrounding secondary buildings. The main palace uses a mid-to-deep blue-gray body, dark blue double eaves, dark vermilion structures, warm white jade bases, and restrained gold leaf; after far-distance atmospheric perspective, it is slightly bluish-gray, but still significantly darker than the cloud sea and must not be whitened out.

The composition adopts an asymmetric cinematic composition of right-side foreground megastructure framing + left-side massive cloud sea negative space + extreme distant dark main city core. Afternoon clear warm golden side light enters from the left, white jade, gold leaf, and lacquered surfaces are bright but not overexposed, shadows maintain cool blue layers. The overall feel is magnificent, refreshing, and open, yet with the oppression of extreme distant gigantic objects.

**Forbidden:** Distant main city too small, a large number of equal-sized palaces filling the screen, pale white distant palaces, gray fog, aerial city map feel, characters too large, ordinary mountain scenery, ordinary gardens, unrefined materials.

items.title: AURELLE奢华护肤广告海报设计

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium beauty advertising poster for an original luxury skincare brand called AURELLE, designed as a Cannes-level campaign visual that preserves the exact structural logic, camera impact, and emotional minimalism of the image, while strengthening the core concept that both the woman and her reaching hand are actively emerging out of the smartphone screen into real space. The final artwork must feature a warm monochrome beige studio, one oversized upright smartphone in the mid-background, one sophisticated adult woman partially stepping out from inside the screen, and one hyper-real luxury hand cream tube in the lower-right foreground as the absolute commercial hero. The image must feel modern, elegant, tactile, intimate, and conceptually sharp, with a stronger sense that digital beauty care is physically crossing into reality.

Core composition:
Use a tall vertical composition with a clean warm-beige studio environment and a strong editorial luxury mood. Place one large smartphone upright in the center-left background, perfectly frontal, with a crisp black frame and a softly lit interior scene visible inside the display. The woman must no longer feel only framed inside the phone; instead, her upper body and reaching arm should visibly project beyond the screen boundary into the viewer’s space. Her hand must extend dramatically toward the lower-right foreground with convincing perspective, scale enlargement, and spatial separation, as if it has broken through the screen plane. The product tube sits exactly in the physical space she is reaching toward, creating a strong real-world contact tension. The viewer must instantly understand: care is leaving the screen and entering life.

Concept enhancement:
Strengthen the “emerging from the screen” illusion. The phone should function as a portal, not just a frame. Part of the woman’s torso, arm, and hand should feel visually outside the screen boundary, with the screen edge acting like a threshold between digital intimacy and physical beauty ritual. The reaching gesture should be more assertive and closer to the product, creating a near-touch moment with strong emotional and visual pull. The concept must feel luxurious and seamless, never gimmicky.

Hero product:
Design the hero item as a premium hand cream from AURELLE, globally market-ready, elegant, and collectible. Use a refined ivory tube with a satin finish, warm champagne-gold typography, subtle metallic cap detailing, and a minimal French-luxury layout. Add original English branding such as:
AURELLE
VELVET HAND RITUAL
ROSE SILK REPAIR
The tube must feel expensive, clean, feminine, and highly tactile, with beautiful material rendering, crisp print clarity, elegant proportions, and soft realistic shadowing on the studio floor. It must remain the clearest and strongest product focal point in the image.

Character styling:
The woman must be an adult fashion-forward beauty figure with calm confidence and understated luxury. She wears dark refined sunglasses, a cream silk blouse, tailored deep-brown trousers, and elegant neutral heels. Her hair is smooth, shoulder-length, softly styled, and natural. Her expression is composed, modern, and quietly powerful. Her body posture should clearly suggest that she is leaning out from the phone into real space, while one leg and part of her body still remain inside the screen world. She must feel like a luxury editorial model, never casual, never influencer-like.

Transit visual system:
Unify the entire poster into a mature luxury skincare campaign language. The smartphone interior, model styling, hand cream tube, serif headline, support line, floor tone, shadow density, and beige-brown-gold palette must all belong to one disciplined beauty system. Keep the color world tightly controlled: warm beige background, ivory product body, champagne-gold labeling, espresso-brown tailoring, soft black accessories, and creamy interior neutrals. Typography weight, spacing, and layout must feel precise, fashion-beauty, and globally premium.

Screen world:
Inside the phone display, show a softly blurred warm interior suggesting a refined private beauty environment: neutral seating, creamy textiles, muted furniture shapes, and quiet domestic softness. Keep this world secondary and understated, serving only as the intimate origin point from which the woman emerges. The screen must clearly read as a transition threshold between private ritual and tangible product access.

Typography and layout:
Add original English-only headline typography near the upper center in a refined high-fashion serif, such as:
“Care Steps Closer.”
or
“Reach the Ritual.”
Add a smaller elegant support line near the lower area if needed, such as:
“Luxury hand care, crossing from screen to skin.”
Typography must be minimal, spacious, premium, and editorial, with no copied wording and no generic layout.

Lighting:
Use soft high-end beauty lighting with warm neutral tones. The overall light should be delicate, diffused, and luxurious, with gentle sculpting on the woman’s blouse, face, trousers, and especially the extended hand. The hand cream tube must receive the cleanest and most refined highlight structure, with subtle reflective accents on the cap and smooth tonal transitions across the tube body. The smartphone frame should remain crisp and slightly darker, grounding the composition and emphasizing the portal effect.

Color direction:
Use a disciplined palette of warm beige, ivory, cream, espresso brown, soft black, and champagne gold. Keep the whole image elegant, minimal, and cohesive, allowing the reaching gesture and the product to dominate. The scene must feel calm, elevated, tactile, and expensive.

Material realism:
Render every surface with exceptional realism: satin skincare tube finish, metallic cap reflections, realistic smartphone glass and frame, silk blouse sheen, tailored fabric drape, natural skin texture, manicured nails, and soft studio floor reflections. The perspective of the emerging hand and partially projected upper body must feel especially convincing and cinematic.

Creative direction:
The final image must feel like a world-class luxury beauty campaign that transforms digital proximity into physical intimacy. The strongest memory point is the moment a woman literally reaches out of the phone toward the product, making the brand promise tangible. The poster should balance editorial restraint, commercial clarity, and conceptual sharpness in one unforgettable modern beauty key visual.

Mood:
elegant, intimate, modern, tactile, luxurious, reachable, editorial, calm, premium, feminine, minimal, emotionally precise

Rendering style:
ultra-premium beauty advertising poster, luxury hand cream hero product, woman partially emerging from smartphone screen, strong reaching-hand perspective, enhanced portal illusion, warm beige editorial studio, minimal serif typography, fashion-beauty campaign aesthetic, 8k, world-class image quality

Negative prompt:
copied luxury skincare branding, copied slogans, cluttered set, cheap influencer aesthetic, generic phone ad, weak product visibility, plastic-looking tube, harsh shadows, messy typography, exaggerated expression, low-resolution skin, overdecorated background, random props

prompts.text:
为名为 AURELLE 的原创奢华护肤品牌创作一张超高端美容广告海报，设计为戛纳级别的竞选视觉效果，保留图像的精确结构逻辑、镜头冲击力和情感极简主义，同时加强核心概念，即女性及其伸出的手都在积极地从智能手机屏幕中浮现到现实空间。最终作品必须包含一个温暖的单色米色摄影棚，中背景有一个超大的立式智能手机，一名成熟洗练的女性从屏幕内部部分跨出，右下角前景中有一个超真实的奢华护手霜软管作为绝对的商业主角。图像必须具有现代感、优雅感、触感、亲密感且概念锐利，并带有更强的数字美容护理物理跨入现实的感觉。

核心构图：
采用高垂直构图，具有干净的暖米色摄影棚环境和强烈的社论奢华氛围。在左中背景垂直放置一部大型智能手机，完全正面，带有清晰的黑色边框，显示屏内可见光线柔和的室内场景。女性不能再感觉只是被框在手机里；相反，她的上半身和伸出的手臂应该明显地投影到屏幕边界之外，进入观众的空间。她的手必须以令人信服的透视、比例放大和空间分离感戏剧性地向右下角前景伸出，仿佛它已经突破了屏幕平面。产品软管正位于她伸向的物理空间中，创造出强烈的现实世界接触张力。观众必须立刻明白：护理正在离开屏幕并进入生活。

概念强化：
加强“从屏幕中浮现”的错觉。手机应该作为一个门户，而不仅仅是一个框架。女性躯干、手臂和手的一部分应该在视觉上感觉位于屏幕边界之外，屏幕边缘就像数字亲密度与物理美容仪式之间的阈值。伸出的姿势应该更加坚定且更接近产品，创造出具有强烈情感和视觉吸引力的近乎触碰的时刻。这个概念必须感觉奢华且无缝，绝不能华而不实。

主角产品：
将主角单品设计为来自 AURELLE 的高端护手霜，具备全球市场就绪、优雅且具有收藏价值的特点。使用带有缎面质感的精致象牙色软管，搭配温暖的香槟金排版、微妙的金属盖细节和极简的法国奢华布局。添加原始英文品牌标识，如：
AURELLE
VELVET HAND RITUAL
ROSE SILK REPAIR

Behind the moon window, another world is slowly unfolding, like mountains and rivers, stars and celestial light turning over the back of the world before her eyes. She stands at a high place, quietly looking up, seeing for the first time that there is a wider world beyond the moonlight. Main character: An oriental adult female, visual age about 24, cold and ethereal, quiet and sober, with a sense of strength like waking up again. She has a delicate narrow oval face, slender apricot eyes slightly raised, and her expression is quiet with a slight relief after being startled awake. The face uses exquisite oriental paper art illustration-style modeling, with clear features, not a real photography texture, and not overly cartoonish. Hairstyle and headwear: Black long hair half-draped and half-tied, hair strands extending backward into flowing paper ribbons, wearing light gold crescent moon and star-piece head ornaments. The headwear is light and exquisite, not complex or tall. Long hair and silk scarves gently flutter backward in the breeze at the high altitude. The clothing is composed of multi-layer paper structures, fine hollow patterns, clear cut edges, slight creases, real paper thickness and fiber texture, with a small amount of light gold paper foil details in parts; the overall effect is exquisite and magnificent but still maintains a cold divinity. All moon window, corridor, mountain, cloud, flying bird, and sky elements must uniformly adopt high-completion 3D paper carving language. The top of the corridor, arch frames, door lintels, and pillars have a large number of high-precision hollow patterns, including crescent moons, cloud patterns, stars, and oriental decorative geometric patterns. At the end of the corridor is a giant, complete, and very oppressive circular paper-carved moon window. Through the moon window, one can see a dream world illuminated by moonlight and the star river: layered distant mountains, winding rivers, seas of clouds, distant paper art palaces, flying birds, and star river tracks together constitute another unfolding world, as if the world has turned over its other side behind the moon window. 作品主题为：她在月神回廊尽头看见世界翻面。

画面核心叙事为：
一位年轻东方女性走到巨型纸雕月神回廊的尽头，在一轮巨大圆形月窗之前停下。月窗之后，另一个世界正在缓缓展开，像山河、星河与天光在她眼前翻开了世界的背面。她站在高处，安静仰望，第一次看见月色之外仍有更辽阔的天地。
主体人物为：
 视觉年龄约24岁的东方成年女性，清冷空灵、安静清醒，带一点重新苏醒的力量感。
人物拥有清秀窄鹅蛋脸，细长杏眼微微抬起，神情安静中带有轻微惊醒后的释然。面部采用精致的东方纸艺插画式塑形，五官清晰，不是真人摄影质感，不过度卡通化。

人物发型与头饰为：
 黑色长发半披半挽，发丝向后延展成流动纸带，佩戴浅金月牙与星片发饰。
头饰轻盈、精致，不复杂、不高耸。长发与披帛在高处微风中轻轻向后飘动。
人物服装为：
 群青蓝与月白层叠纸艺长裙，裙摆镂刻月亮、云层、星点纹样，外层披帛轻薄飘动。
服装由多层纸片结构、细密镂空纹样、清晰裁切边缘、轻微折痕、真实纸张厚度和纤维纹理组成，局部带有少量浅金纸箔细节，整体精致华丽但仍保持清冷神性。
梦境载体为：
 巨型圆形纸雕月窗与月神回廊。

梦境意象包括：
 月亮、月窗、回廊、星河、飞鸟、远山。
所有月窗、回廊、山脉、云气、飞鸟和天空元素都必须统一采用高完成度的立体纸雕语言。
整体剪纸结构采用：
 圆窗窥梦式。
画面主体是一条极长的月神回廊。
回廊由大量连续排列的高耸纸柱、拱框、镂空梁架、月纹装饰和云纹纸雕结构组成，从近景一直向远方月窗延伸，形成非常强烈的纵深透视和“圣廊”般的仪式感。
回廊顶部、拱框、门楣和立柱之间带有大量高精度镂空纹样，包括月牙、云纹、星点和东方装饰性几何图案。

回廊尽头是一轮巨大、完整、极具压迫感的圆形纸雕月窗。
月窗远大于人物，几乎占据画面上部核心区域。
月窗不是普通装饰，而像是另一个世界的入口。
透过月窗，可以看见一片被月光与星河照亮的梦境世界：
层叠远山、蜿蜒河流、云海、远处的纸艺宫阁、飞鸟与星河轨迹共同构成另一个展开中的天地，仿佛世界在月窗背后翻开了另一面。

人物站在高处，背对或半侧对镜头，身体朝向巨型月窗，头部微微仰起，目光望向月窗之后展开的世界。
人物只占整体画面很小比例，重点突出“巨大月窗 + 超长回廊”的神性尺度感。
构图必须强调：

回廊从近景向远方月窗延伸的强烈透视

prompts.text:

Core composition:
Use a strong centered composition. Place one realistic beverage bottle in the lower-center foreground, upright and slightly monumental, occupying the lower third of the poster. From the bottle opening, a compact creamy-citrus liquid burst rises directly upward and transitions into a large layered splash universe filling the upper two-thirds of the frame. Fruit and garnish elements:

Background:
Use a rich saturated orange background with subtle material texture, like luxury matte paper or premium embossed poster stock. 瓶子后面的爆发必须由柠檬黄、芒果黄、金橙色和浅米色的分层立体飞溅剪影构成。这些形状看起来应该像雕刻的剪纸液体云或高级模压图形飞溅形状，而不是杂乱无章的喷溅。飞溅群必须从瓶口处开始收紧，并随着向上升起而变得更宽、更具戏剧性。保持边缘圆润、干净、立体且高级。整体爆发必须感觉充满趣味且充满力量，就像柑橘风味在空间中物理绽放。

水果和装饰元素：
在飞溅构图中点缀经过艺术指导的柑橘瓣、小圆片和新鲜绿叶。使用橙子片、柠檬瓣、柑橘环和一些小的圆形水滴。这些元素必须感觉是经过精心布置的，设计感强于混乱感，有节奏、平衡地环绕在中心飞溅周围。水果块应该看起来高端、略带风格化且立体，与精心制作的海报世界相匹配，同时保持可信的柑橘纹理。绿叶应增加对比度和清新感，但保持整洁稀疏，以保持视觉上的高级感。

背景：
使用具有微妙材质纹理的浓郁饱和橙色背景，如豪华哑光纸或高级压纹海报纸。背景必须包含柔和的分层色调变化和少量凹陷的飞溅剪影，使整个画面感觉沉浸且经过设计，但并不杂乱。保持氛围明亮、温暖、阳光且清爽。

items.title: 高端时尚编辑海报设计指南

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 high-fashion editorial poster.

Subject: [male / female / fashion model / artist]
Outfit: [fashion styling]
Palette: [red / black / white / custom palette]
Main title: [TITLE]
Design direction: [perspective × typography / blur × sharp detail / profile × oversized type / gesture × editorial layout]
Supporting text: [short phrase]

Build the poster around one strong photographic subject and one dominant graphic idea.

Use oversized typography as part of the composition rather than simple text placed around the image. Let letters interact with the subject through cropping, overlap, foreground/background layering, or scale contrast.

Depending on the selected direction:

• Perspective × typography — use a strong foreground gesture or body movement toward the camera, with dramatic near-far perspective and large type framing the action.

• Blur × sharp detail — keep parts of the portrait softly blurred while one narrow facial region remains extremely sharp, creating controlled focus contrast.

• Profile × oversized type — use a sculptural side-profile portrait against a bold flat-color background, with large serif typography partially hidden behind or crossing the silhouette.

• Gesture × editorial layout — combine an expressive fashion pose, subtle motion echo or secondary silhouette, and integrated magazine-style typography.

Keep the layout clean and visually bold. Use one dominant color, one neutral base, and limited accent colors. Typography should include one large headline, one short supporting line, and only a few small editorial labels.

Maintain realistic skin texture, natural facial anatomy, refined fashion styling, crisp fabric details, controlled studio lighting, strong negative space, and premium magazine-cover quality.

将超大排版作为构图的一部分，而不仅仅是放置在图像周围的简单文本。让字母通过裁剪、重叠、前景/背景分层或比例对比与主体进行交互。

根据所选方向：

• 透视 × 排版 —— 使用朝向镜头的强烈前景姿态或肢体动作，具有戏剧性的远近透视和大字体框架动作。

• 模糊 × 锐利细节 —— 保持肖像部分柔和模糊，同时一个狭窄的面部区域保持极其锐利，创造受控的焦点对比。

• 侧面肖像 × 超大字体 —— 在大胆的纯色背景下使用雕塑般的侧面肖像，大号衬线字体部分隐藏在轮廓后或跨越轮廓。

• 姿势 × 编辑布局 —— 结合表现力强的时尚姿势、微妙的动作回声或次要剪影，以及集成的杂志风格排版。

保持布局简洁且视觉大胆。使用一种主导颜色、一种中性基色和有限的强调色。排版应包括一个大标题、一行短辅助线，以及仅有的几个小型编辑标签。
