prompts.text:
use the attached image as the main facial reference with high precision while preserving exact facial structure, natural proportions, authentic facial asymmetry, and natural facial character.

SCENE:
A candid daytime outdoor snapshot beside a glossy black SUV parked outside a modern residence. The subject stands casually near the rear side of the vehicle holding a clear plastic iced drink with a green straw. The atmosphere feels spontaneous and summery like a real early-2000s roadside or driveway digicam photo taken during a casual day out.

POSE / EXPRESSION:
Body turned three-quarters away from the camera with one hip resting lightly toward the SUV. One knee bends slightly while the opposite leg carries more weight. One hand loosely holds the iced drink near the waist while the other rests naturally against the upper thigh. Shoulders remain uneven and relaxed. Head tilts downward and to one side while the face turns softly toward the ground rather than directly into the lens. Expression feels calm, feminine, and slightly shy with relaxed lips and lowered gaze. Preserve exactly two anatomically connected arms and two hands with believable finger placement around the cup.

CAMERA / CCD LOGIC:
Shot on an old early-2000s CCD digital compact camera with bright natural daylight and subtle direct built-in flash fill. Authentic outdoor digicam rendering with crisp face, hair, cup, nails, clothing texture, vehicle edges, and foreground skin detail. Visible CCD grain and light digital sensor noise remain present in darker car reflections, wheel wells, foliage, and frame corners. Slight JPEG compression artifacts, limited dynamic range, mild highlight clipping on skin, cup lid, car paint, and bright white top. Flattened shadows and slightly washed highlight behavior typical of compact digital cameras. Cool-neutral automatic white balance while preserving healthy warm skin tones and visible makeup.

SKIN / MAKEUP:
Healthy warm natural skin with visible pores, realistic hydrated texture, and soft rosy-peach warmth through cheeks, shoulders, arms, thighs, and knees. Keep complexion lively and dimensional—never pale, gray, washed out, or orange. Visible natural-soft glam makeup with defined brows, light liner, soft lashes, gentle rosy cheeks, subtle contour, and glossy pink-peach lips.

HAIR:
Dark hair gathered into a loose high messy bun with natural flyaways and face-framing strands. Preserve visible strand separation, slight frizz, realistic motion, and imperfect bun shape.

OUTFIT / ACCESSORIES:
White off-shoulder cropped top with soft lettuce-edge trim. Dark loose sporty pants with a high side opening revealing the upper thigh. Large gold hoop earrings, rings, and light blue manicure. Clear iced drink cup with domed lid and green straw.

BACKGROUND / ENVIRONMENT:
Glossy black SUV with realistic reflections of sky, trees, and nearby architecture. Modern gray exterior wall and pale windows behind. Ground surface slightly textured and sunlit. Keep car reflections realistic and not mirror-perfect.

COMPOSITION:
Dynamic handheld compact-camera portrait from a slightly low three-quarter angle near hip level, looking gently upward toward the subject. Camera positioned off to one side so the SUV creates a strong diagonal depth line behind her. Add a subtle right Dutch tilt for imperfect real-world framing. Subject stands slightly left of center with the vehicle dominating the background. Approximately 15% headroom above the bun. Allow one thigh and part of the vehicle edge to approach the frame boundaries naturally. The drink sits slightly forward in the composition, creating mild foreground depth and authentic compact-camera perspective.

LIGHTING:
Bright outdoor daylight mixed with subtle compact-camera flash fill. Flash gently lifts facial and body shadows without overpowering ambient light. Mild highlight bloom appears on cheekbones, shoulders, cup lid, nails, jewelry, and glossy black car paint. Dark vehicle reflections and wheel areas retain visible CCD grain and natural compact-camera contrast.

prompts.text:
使用附带的图像作为主要面部参考，以高精度保留确切的面部结构、自然比例、真实的面部不对称性和自然的面部特征。

场景：
一张在现代住宅外的亮黑色SUV旁的随性日间户外快照。主体随意地站在车辆后侧，拿着一个带有绿色吸管的透明塑料冰饮。氛围感觉自发且具有夏日感，就像在休闲的一天中拍摄的真实的2000年代初路边或车道数码相机照片。

姿势 / 表情：
身体与相机呈四分之三角度，一侧臀部轻轻靠向SUV。一个膝盖微屈，另一条腿承重较多。一只手松松地拿着腰部的冰饮，另一只手自然地靠在大腿上部。肩膀保持不平衡且放松。头部向下并向一侧倾斜，面部柔和地转向地面而非直视镜头。表情感觉冷静、女性化且略显害羞，嘴唇放松，目光低垂。精确保留两条解剖结构连接的手臂和两只手，杯子周围的指尖位置可信。

相机 / CCD 逻辑：
使用旧的2000年代初CCD数码紧凑型相机拍摄，光线为明亮的自然日光并带有微妙的直射内置闪光灯补光。真实的户外数码相机渲染，具有清晰的脸部、头发、杯子、指甲、服装纹理、车辆边缘和前景皮肤细节。在较暗的汽车反射、轮毂井、树叶和画面角落中存在可见的CCD颗粒和轻微的数字传感器噪点。轻微的JPEG压缩伪影、有限的动态范围、皮肤、杯盖、车漆和亮白色上衣上的轻微高光溢出。紧凑型数码相机典型的扁平阴影和略显冲淡的高光表现。冷中性自动白平衡，同时保留健康的暖肤色和可见的妆容。

皮肤 / 妆容：
健康的暖色自然皮肤，可见毛孔，真实的滋润纹理，以及脸颊、肩膀、手臂、大腿和膝盖的柔和粉红桃色暖感。保持肤色生动且立体——绝不苍白、灰色、被冲淡或橙色。可见的自然柔和精致妆容，带有清晰的眉毛、淡眼线、柔软的睫毛、温柔的玫瑰色脸颊、细致的修容和光泽的粉红桃色嘴唇。

头发：
黑发扎成高高的凌乱丸子头，带有自然的碎发和修饰脸型的发丝。保留可见的发丝分离、轻微的毛躁、真实的动态和不完美的丸子头形状。

服装 / 配饰：
白色露肩短款上衣，带有柔软的木耳边修饰。深色宽松运动裤，侧面高开口露出大腿上部。大金圆环耳环、戒指和淡蓝色美甲。带圆顶盖和绿色吸管的透明冰饮杯。

背景 / 环境：
亮黑色SUV，带有天空、树木和附近建筑的真实反射。后面是现代灰色外墙和浅色窗户。地面纹理略显且受阳光照射。保持汽车反射真实，而非完美的镜像。

构图：
从靠近臀部高度的稍低四分之三角度拍摄的动态手持紧凑型相机肖像，轻轻向上看向主体。相机位于一侧，使SUV在身后创造出强烈的对角线深度感。加入微妙的右侧荷兰式倾斜，以实现不完美的现实世界取景。主体位于中心稍偏左的位置，车辆占据背景主导地位。丸子头上方留有约15%的头部空间。允许一条大腿和部分车辆边缘自然地靠近画面边界。饮料在构图中位置稍靠前，创造出轻微的前景深度和真实的紧凑型相机透视。

照明：
明亮的户外日光混合着微妙的紧凑型相机闪光灯补光。闪光灯轻轻提升脸部和身体阴影，而不压倒环境光。颧骨、肩膀、杯盖、指甲、首饰和亮黑色车漆上出现轻微的高光晕染。深色车辆反射和车轮区域保留可见的CCD颗粒和自然的紧凑型相机对比度。

prompts.text:
Subject:
Running on the pasture

Main body:
In a vast pasture ground, a woman runs from the bottom-left of the frame towards the camera, a dynamic longitudinal full-body photo of a black cow chasing from the back-right of the frame. In the distance are several black cows, green hills, and cumulus clouds.

Figures/Expressions:
Face slightly downward, drooping eyes and slightly parted lips revealing a serious expression of tension and focus. Rounded oval face shape and small chin, slender eyes, natural eyebrows, thin straight nose bridge, slightly reddish lips. Bright skin tone, light makeup. Near-black long brown hair parted in the middle, fluttering significantly to the left of the frame in the wind.

Clothing/Pose:
Vibrant red spaghetti strap cropped corset top. Ruffles at the chest and hem, red lace-up tie in the front. White long-sleeved shirt open at the front, draped as if sliding off the shoulders, raw-edge white denim shorts, brown belt, knee-high brown western boots. Arms bent and spread to the left and right, right leg forward, left leg kicking back while running.

Background/Lighting:
Lower half of the frame is bright green grass swaying in the wind, with a fence and multiple grazing cattle in the distant center, a running black cow on the right, and green hills and mountains in the distance. The upper half is deep blue sky and horizontally stretching white cumulus clouds. The sun above casts hard direct light, throwing short shadows on the grass and the figure.

Composition/Lens:
3:4 vertical composition, low-angle horizontal perspective, capturing the full-body action photo from head to boots. The woman occupies most of the left side of the frame, the chasing cow is placed slightly in the middle ground on the right, and the upper third leaves a wide space of open sky. Focus on the woman, using a deep depth of field so that the cows and hills are also identifiable.

Texture/Style:
Clear photorealistic realistic photo. High-definition depiction of wind-blown hair and shirt, grass, denim, leather, cow hair, utilizing strong summer colors of red, green, and blue.

Negative prompt:
Do not omit the chasing black cow; do not break the front-back pose of the running legs

prompts.text:
Vertical 3:4 realistic "fashion editorial outfit breakdown board", editorial collage style: asymmetric layout, white space, torn paper edges, tape stickers, image borders slightly misaligned and overlapping; overall light and bright, young, sunny, energetic, with a bit of sexiness but not vulgar. Add "Fashion Notes" text elements across the page: short Chinese labels, short sentences, numbers, arrow doodles, circles and dots, handwritten strokes, highlighter underlines, heart/star small doodles, but no large blocks of long text. 

Top left main title in Chinese: "元气街头搭配" (fixed position). Title should not be formal print or regular bold; change to handwritten fun font/graffiti font: thick marker handwriting, uneven stroke thickness, slightly slanted, irregular letter spacing, with a sense of speed from cursive strokes; overall title rotated 2–5 degrees, like a sticker applied; add highlighter background smudge (lemon yellow/electric blue) + white stroke + slight shadow, presenting a "casual but high-end" look. Next to the title, place a small sticker label "2026 Summer / LOOK 01 / Trend Notes" (small handwritten style).

Model: Asian female (Chinese/Korean vibe), 20 years old, 166cm, well-proportioned curves (waist-hip curve, long leg ratio), honey-toned wheat skin; low side ponytail, rose gold hair color, dynamic hair strands; energetic sunny makeup look, sweet big smile; facial features should have weakened recognizability but maintain real proportions and real skin details, reject influencer face and excessive contouring.

Photography: Shot by professional visual special feature photographer, daytime natural light, shallow depth of field, creamy blur, moderate film grain, real skin texture, Kodachrome style; summer 28°C city street, background city street scene blurred, sun highlights and slight lens flare visible; subject is sharp, fabric texture is clear, real wrinkles and stitching.

Outfit theme: Energetic Street × Y2K × Sporty Sexy × Vitality × Sunny. Main colors bright white + electric blue, accents of lemon yellow + silver. Materials: cotton, stretch nylon, mesh, denim. Central main image occupies about 75%~85% of the frame, full body from head to toe in shot: electric blue cropped baseball jacket (can have sleeve patches/letter patches but no brand) + bright white midriff-baring short sports bra + high-waisted loose denim short skirt + lemon yellow platform canvas shoes + silver chain small shoulder bag; accessories large silver hoop earrings, colorful anklet, baseball cap. Action: energetic turn, blowing a kiss (skirt hem and side ponytail swing with movement, posture shows more femininity and dynamism).

Column content (medium information density, relaxed and stylish):
- Top right "Item Breakdown": ghost mannequin hanging display of jacket/sports bra/denim skirt/platform canvas shoes/silver chain small shoulder bag/large hoop earrings/anklet/baseball cap, numbered + short Chinese labels + arrow doodles (short words only).
- "Detail Close-up" film strip: 2–4 macro shots, focus: jacket sleeve patch, bra edge and mesh texture, skirt hem denim texture, shoelaces and platform details.
- "Bag Essentials/EDC Flat Lay": small and exquisite corner flat lay (do not occupy large area), items: smartphone, keys, card holder, wireless earphones, lip oil, sunscreen, perfume, small mirror, hair clip, bracelet; numbered + short labels.
- Right down "More Angles": 2–4 larger small images (half-body sweet smile, hand blowing kiss action, shoe/bag detail, back view), allowed misaligned stacking and tape fixing effect.
Whole page avoids brands and logos, maintaining realistic photography texture and high-end magazine layout.

Negative prompt: Anime/illustration style, influencer face, over-smoothed plastic skin, exaggerated beauty filter big eyes and sharp chin, heavy makeup, low resolution, blurry subject, deformed limbs/incorrect fingers, extra limbs, broken perspective, layout too regular like a table manual, title using standard print fonts/regular bold/default computer fonts, dense long readable text, watermarks, logo/brand marks, overexposure, pornographic, vulgar suggestive poses, underage feeling, dirty feeling, excessive grain/noise covering details.

左上角主标题为中文：**“元气街头搭配”**（固定位置）。标题不要正规印刷体、不要规整黑体；改为**手写趣体/涂鸦字**：粗马克笔手写，笔画粗细不均、略歪、字距不齐、带连笔速度感；标题整体轻微旋转 2–5 度，像贴纸贴上去；加荧光笔底色涂抹（柠檬黄/电光蓝）+ 白色描边 + 轻微投影，呈现“随意但高级”。标题旁边放小贴纸标签“2026 Summer / LOOK 01 / Trend Notes”（小字手写风）。

分栏内容（中等信息密度、松弛时髦）：

- “细节特写”胶片条：2–4 张微距，重点：夹克袖标、bra 边缘与网眼质感、裙摆牛仔纹理、鞋带与厚底细节。

全页避免品牌与商标，保持真实摄影质感与高级杂志排版。

**Negative prompt**  
动漫插画风，网红脸，过度磨皮塑料皮，夸张美颜大眼尖下巴，妆容过重，低清晰度，主体模糊，肢体畸形手指错误，多余肢体，透视崩坏，排版过于规整像表格说明书，标题使用标准印刷字体/规整黑体/默认电脑字体，密密麻麻大段可读长文，水印，logo/品牌标识，过度暴露、色情、低俗挑逗姿势，未成年感，脏污感，过度颗粒/噪点遮住细节。

prompts.text:
Create a premium 4:5 vertical graphic poster in the Swiss International Typographic Style, combining an ultra-photorealistic portrait of a fictional top-tier Korean female K-pop idol with enormous geometric typography featuring [CITY NAME].

CORE COMPOSITION

Make the city name a major architectural element occupying most of the frame. The portrait, typography, authentic cityscape, geometric graphics, and grid must feel like one unified design system.

Show a waist-up, strictly frontal portrait of an elegant, charismatic Korean female idol with refined natural features, realistic skin texture, expressive eyes, and direct eye contact. Her face must remain sharp, fully recognizable, unobstructed, and visually dominant even while integrated into the typography.

Do not imitate any specific real celebrity; create an original fictional idol with a premium global K-pop editorial presence.

CITY — [CITY NAME]

Use an authentic, recognizable cityscape belonging specifically to [CITY NAME], with appropriate architecture, skyline elements, landmarks, and urban depth.

For NEW YORK, use believable Manhattan skyscrapers, Midtown architecture, bridge elements, and layered urban structures. When replacing the city, automatically replace all architecture and visual references accordingly.

Allow selected parts of the cityscape to appear inside and through the oversized letters.

TYPOGRAPHY

Render [CITY NAME] in enormous geometric sans-serif lettering inspired by Swiss International Graphic Design.

The letters should:

occupy most of the frame

follow a strict modular grid

function as architectural structures

create strong visual rhythm

interact naturally with the portrait

reveal portions of the cityscape

Keep the city name perfectly spelled, clearly legible, and structurally clean. Never allow distorted or nonsensical letterforms.

GRAPHIC SYSTEM

Use:

strict modular grid

asymmetric but balanced composition

precise alignment

strong hierarchy

generous negative space

circles, squares, rectangles

thin rules and diagonal lines

geometric framing elements

Add restrained editorial micro-details such as small captions, numerical codes, coordinate-style numbers, minimalist pictograms, and technical labels.

Keep these elements subtle and secondary.

FASHION

Dress the idol in sophisticated contemporary urban fashion inspired by [CITY NAME]: structured jacket, minimalist top, tailored outerwear, or elevated streetwear.

The styling should feel luxury editorial rather than casual, with no visible brand logos.

CAMERA & LIGHTING

85mm portrait-lens aesthetic, frontal camera angle, waist-up framing, natural portrait compression, realistic facial proportions.

Use soft cinematic daylight with controlled directional contrast, realistic shadows, natural highlight roll-off, and accurate skin rendering. Preserve genuine skin texture without plastic-looking retouching.

COLOR PALETTE

Primary:
Black · White · Warm Gray

Accents:
International Red · Deep Royal Blue · Mustard Yellow

Use accent colors sparingly to maintain the disciplined Swiss aesthetic.

PRINT FINISH

Add a subtle premium print character:

fine Portra-inspired film grain

matte paper texture

extremely subtle dust and micro-scratches

refined editorial print finish

Keep texture understated and sophisticated.

FINAL AESTHETIC

Ultra-photorealistic 8K-quality fashion photography fused with museum-level Swiss graphic design, creating a clean, modern, luxurious, conceptual, architectural, and highly curated poster.

The portrait, typography, cityscape, grid, geometry, color, and texture must feel organically designed together.

AVOID: Blur, low quality, bad anatomy, extra fingers, duplicate faces, distorted features, plastic skin, broken/misspelled text, generic cityscapes, clutter, oversaturation, noise, watermarks, logos, celebrity imitation, cartoon/anime style, AI artifacts.

调色板

印刷成品

最终美学

prompts.text: Build a restrained, solemn paper-based informational design with human warmth around any chosen thematic subject: let large areas of bright white space first establish quiet order, then let a striking headline, line-drawn narrative, and bottom numerals carry the reading onward in sequence. Organize clearly differentiated modules along a single main reading axis: near the top, place one extremely small, thin, widely letterspaced auxiliary text or numbering group on each side, separated by remote spacing to create slight asymmetry; beneath them, set an oversized, high-contrast Latin serif headline extending horizontally, with strong contrast between fine hairlines and thick stems, elongated letterforms, sharp terminals, and the same accent ink as the core illustration; then add a centered group of short Chinese phrases on the theme, built on a slender Songti skeleton with generous line spacing and breathing room between characters, so the dark text block both carries the headline and builds momentum toward the illustration. Distill the thematic subject's core image and its relationship to the environment into a monochrome printmaking-style line drawing rather than reproducing fixed objects: build outward spatial movement from the center with clear outer contours, continuous arcs, layered paths, and a few flat fills; keep foreground lines longer and more open, make the middle forms the heaviest, and finish the distance with fine short strokes; alternate dense detail with large expanses of empty paper, keep the contours legible, allow slight hand-drawn variation in line weight, and preserve the soft, blunted edges created by ink absorption at corners of a printed mark, so the image has a monumental stability without feeling heavy. Place the most important short notice phrase below the illustration, then anchor the bottom visual weight with a group of oversized, high-contrast numerals or equally scaled key information, spreading the left and right information apart and connecting the center with an ultra-fine horizontal line and small text, so the extreme scale differences create the ceremony of a formal announcement; finish with a hairline rule running across the bottom edge, lifted at its center by a small symmetrical emblem derived from the theme, and set a micro Latin wordmark beneath it with extremely wide letterspacing for a quiet, precise ending. Derive the color adaptively from the theme: the theme's meaning decides the specific hue and warm/cool character of the accent, which should stay medium-high in saturation, clean, and slightly pigment-like, occupying roughly one-tenth to two-tenths of the image and concentrated in the large headline, core line drawing, and bottom fine lines; give the background a near-white, low-saturation paper color that harmonizes with the accent, lets it dominate the composition, and keeps it high in lightness; use a near-black with the same warm/cool tendency for body text and numerals, limiting it to the typographic skeleton and local contrast. Keep an asymmetric area contrast rather than an even color balance: the more vivid the accent color, the more restrained the paper and the fewer, more precise the dark areas. Render the surface as fine uncoated paper fiber with slight uniform grain and a soft scanned feel; keep the texture mainly on the blank paper and visible through thin layers of ink, allow only tiny tonal variation in solid areas, and avoid heavy stains, strong creases, gloss, dimensional shadows, or decorative gradients; the whole design should remain bright, airy, and slightly edged by the paper's ink absorption, preserving the order among white space, line drawing, typographic scale jumps, and bottom closure, while preventing the illustration from expanding and squeezing the information or the text from averaging out and losing rhythm.

prompts.text: 围绕任何选定的主题，构建一个带有温度的、克制且庄重的纸质信息设计：让大面积的明亮留白首先建立起安静的秩序，然后让醒目的标题、线描叙事和底部的数字按顺序引导阅读。沿单一主阅读轴组织区分明确的模块：在顶部附近，两侧各放置一组极小、纤细、字间距宽阔的辅助文字或编号，以遥远的间距分隔，营造出轻微的不对称感；在它们下方，设置一个超大、高对比度的拉丁衬线体标题，水平延伸，在极细的线条和粗壮的笔画、拉长的字母形态、锐利的末端之间形成强烈对比，并使用与核心插图相同的强调色油墨；然后添加一组以该主题为中心的短中文词组，构建在纤细的宋体骨架上，具有慷慨的行距和字符间的呼吸空间，使深色文本块既承载了标题，又为插图积蓄了势能。将主题的核心图像及其与环境的关系提炼成单色版画风格的线描，而不是复制固定的物体：从中心向外构建空间运动，具有清晰的外轮廓、连续的弧线、分层的路径和少量的平涂填充；保持前景线条更长且更开阔，使中间形态最重，并用精细的短笔触完成远景；将密集的细节与大面积的留白纸面交替排列，保持轮廓清晰，允许线条粗细有轻微的手绘变化，并保留印刷标记角落因油墨吸收而产生的柔软、钝化的边缘，使图像具有纪念碑般的稳重感而又不显沉重。在插图下方放置最重要的简短提示短语，然后用一组超大、高对比度的数字或同等比例的关键信息锚定底部视觉重量，将左右信息分散，并用一条极细的水平线和微型文字连接中心，使极端的比例差异营造出正式公告的仪式感；最后以横跨底部边缘的细线收尾，中心由源自该主题的小型对称徽标提拉，并在其下方设置一个间距极宽的微型拉丁文字标，作为安静、精准的结束。根据主题自适应地推导颜色：主题的含义决定了强调色的具体色调和冷暖特性，该颜色应保持中高饱和度、干净且略带颜料感，约占图像的十分之一至十分之二，并集中在大标题、核心线描和底部细线上；给背景一种近乎白色、低饱和度的纸张颜色，与强调色相协调，使其主导构图并保持高亮度；在正文和数字中使用具有相同冷暖倾向的近黑色，将其限制在排版骨架和局部对比中。保持不对称的面积对比，而不是均衡的色彩平衡：强调色越鲜艳，纸张就越克制，深色区域就越少、越精准。将表面渲染为带有轻微均匀纹理和柔软扫描感的精细无涂层纸张纤维；纹理主要保留在空白纸张上，并通过薄薄的墨层可见，仅允许在实色区域有微小的色调变化，避免沉重的污渍、强烈的折痕、光泽、立体阴影或装饰性渐变；整个设计应保持明亮、通透，并带有纸张吸墨产生的轻微边缘感，保留留白、线描、排版比例跳跃和底部收尾之间的秩序，同时防止插图膨胀挤压信息，或文字因趋于平均而失去节奏。

"direction": "让人联想到2000年代前半时尚杂志上刊登的工作室快照，由虚构的成年女性模特拍摄的逼真人物照片。在白色无缝工作室中，模特穿着鲜艳的绿色极简泳装，采取片膝着地的低不对称姿势。最重要的是，不是泳装本身，而是通过肩部、腰部、膝盖和肘部形成的巨大对角线和S形身体结构。不是完成后的广告照片，而是拍摄会话中杂志用的一瞬间，保留那种自然感。",
"mood": "平静的酷感，略带慵懒的Y2K时尚杂志氛围。不做笑容，而是像在摄影师指示下调整姿势途中的安静紧张感。不过度华丽、高级或挑逗，而是作为时尚拍摄的自然存在感。",
"model": "虚构的20多岁成年女性模特。不模仿真实存在的艺人、模特、影响者或特定个人。以成人般的自然骨骼和脸部特征，避免夸张的身体比例。",
"face": "脸部相对于身体的大倾斜保持相对正直，几乎正对镜头。下巴微微抬起，视线在镜头附近。嘴巴轻轻闭合的中性表情。不是完全左右对称，一侧眉毛或嘴角有极小的差异。眼线稍注重横向，唇色是米色到玫瑰系的低调色调，没有强烈的腮红。",
"hair": "从黑色到深棕色的短鲍勃头。长度到下巴到脖子程度，前刘海稀疏，额头微微透出。发梢不整齐统一，在脖子和脸颊侧有几缕自然向外散开。不是为拍摄完美固定的现代光泽发型，而是90年代末到2000年代前半杂志拍摄中常见的那种略显粗糙的完成度。",
"body": "自然的成年女性体型。腰部向画面右侧送出，肩部和上半身大幅向画面左侧回转，从而在腹部到腰部形成明确的S形。骨盆不是完全正面，而是略微斜向正面。不是为了让身体看起来瘦而做的不自然变形，而是从片膝姿势和重心移动中产生的现实扭转。",
"skin": "像真人一样的肌肤。保留轻微毛孔、细微色差、关节附近的自然阴影。用柔和的工作室光线看起来均匀，但腹部、锁骨、手臂、膝盖有微弱的立体感。避免瓷器般的美肌加工、塑料感、强烈的HDR处理。",
"outfit": "从鲜艳的祖母绿到凯莉绿的简单两件式泳装。上装是细肩带简洁的胸罩型，不过度强调三角形，也不是运动胸罩那样面积宽大。面料有极微弱的光泽。下装同色，腰位稍高，侧边不做极端细的设计，极简风格。作为时尚杂志的造型自然，不做过度强调身体的设计。",
"accessories": "脖子上叠戴2~3条不同长度的银色链条，混入小吊坠。腰部前侧有几条细银色链条或绳状配饰松散叠加。左手戴小戒指。不是镜面加工的高级珠宝广告，而是2000年代风格的轻叠戴。",
"scene_objects": "不放置家具、小道具、椅子、植物、拍摄器材。只有人物、白地板、白背景。有意减少背景的信息量，让姿势的轮廓本身成为主角。",
"pose": "低不对称跪姿。画面左侧的膝盖着地，左腿深弯曲。左手轻放在左大腿到膝盖附近，手指不着力，自然张开。画面右侧的腿向身体右侧下方展开，膝盖弯曲状态下部分延伸到画面外。两膝不朝同一方向对齐。腰部大幅向画面右侧送出，上半身向相反的画面左侧倾斜。从右肩到右臂向画面右上方伸展，肘部大约弯成直角，前臂向脸部方向回转。用右手指尖轻捏右侧肩带，微微向上提起，像在整理服装途中的自然动作。不做手贴到头部的姿势。明确肩部、右肘、腰部、左膝四点形成的强烈斜向结构。",
"pose_physics": "重心由左膝和左侧腿支撑着地板，同时只让骨盆向右侧逃脱。左臂触碰大腿形成轻微稳定，右臂抬起导致右肩自然上抬。腹部产生无负担的扭转和左右不对称的褶皱・阴影。手脚不浮起，腰部也不会不自然地折断。",
"lighting": "白色背景的工作室，大型柔和光源配置在相机正面稍偏左侧的感觉光线。右侧有白墙或弱填充光的反射光。鼻子和下巴的阴影很淡，手臂、腹部、腰部、腿部保留极柔和的阴影。背景接近白的高亮度，但不完全飞掉到人物轮廓消失。不是现代美容环形灯那样的无影照明。",
"effect": "像2000年代时尚杂志后来扫描的那种质感。极细微的颗粒感、略微柔和的分辨感、弱纸面扫描风的颜色整体感。白色保留一丝温暖，只有绿色印象性地鲜艳。避免强烈的数字HDR、过度的微对比、现代超高精细广告完成度。",
"camera": "纵构图，接近4:5的比例。人物占画面约85%。相机在模特胸部到脸部高度，几乎水平。全画幅换算约60~75mm的标准到中望远偏向的自然压缩感。不用超广角，抑制脸、手、膝的远近夸张。景深不浅，人物整体足够可读。头顶和右肘周围保留少量白色余白，右腿和膝盖部分在画面下端自然切断。",
"imperfections": "右肩和左肩高度保留自然的差异。发梢有几缕凌乱。泳装面料有轻微张力或小褶皱，链条位置也不完全左右对称。不把手指为姿势过度均匀张开，捏肩带的指尖有微弱的力差。不把肌肤均匀打磨，保留微弱颗粒和扫描来源的柔和感。",
"background": "地板和墙壁边界几乎分不清的白色无缝背景。纯白，但人物脚下附近保留极薄的接地影，让人感受到地板的存在。不放入家具、窗户、窗帘、海、泳池、文字、拍摄器材、UI元素。",
"atmosphere": "与其说是时尚杂志的正式镜头，不如说是拍摄途中造型师说稍微调整肩带，然后就这样按下快门的一瞬间。姿势有设计性，但通过表情和手部保留一丝途中感，让它作为人类实际在工作室拍摄的照片成立。",
"composition": "脸在画面上部中央稍偏左。肩部在中央附近，细腰在中央稍下，腰在右下方向，左膝在下中央偏左，右腿从右下到画面外。不是直立的纵轴，而是从左上到右下流动的巨大对角线配置人物整体。让能读出脸→上半身→腰→右腰→大腿连续的S形轮廓。",
"negative": "直立姿势、左右对称的姿态、两膝同方向、普通的正坐、右手只放在头上的姿势、过度的身体比例、极端的低角度、超广角扭曲、长发、满面笑容、背景的家具或小道具、太强的虚化、环形灯风的无影光、过度的美肌修正、人偶般的脸、塑料般的肌肤、现代的高级广告修图、类似真实人物或名人的脸、画面UI、返回图标、截屏来源的文字"

prompts.text:
use the attached image as the main facial reference with high precision. Preserve recognizable identity, exact facial proportions, natural asymmetry, and authentic facial character. Adult woman.

SCENE / COMPOSITION:
Bright indoor fashion portrait inside a clean white loft with paneled walls, exposed ceiling pipes, and a sculptural cream sofa. Frame vertically from head to lower legs, photographed from a slightly low eye-level perspective. She sits sideways on the rounded sofa edge, positioned slightly camera-right with generous pale negative space around her.

POSE / EXPRESSION:
Her hips stay anchored on the sofa while the torso leans back into one supporting arm, creating a soft elongated S-curve through the waist rather than a rigid seated posture. One shoulder lifts subtly toward the cheek while the opposite shoulder drops and opens the neckline. Legs extend diagonally toward camera-left with one knee gently overlapping the other, both relaxed rather than posed symmetrically. Head visibly tilted about 18° toward camera-right with the chin slightly lowered, never upright. She glances sideways toward camera-left with softly lowered lids, relaxed brows, and a calm sultry expression.

Exactly two arms and two hands: the camera-right hand rests naturally on the sofa beside the hip supporting part of her weight; the opposite arm stays relaxed close to the torso.

HAIR:
Hair long, ombre ash-chocolate, styled in thick voluminous waves with a deep side part with strong lifted root volume and a dramatic heavy sweep covering most of the camera-right side, sweeping naturally across one side of the face and shoulder. Preserve glossy strand separation, soft movement, and a few loose face-framing pieces.

MAKEUP / SKIN:
Fair/light peach-beige skin with visible pores, realistic texture, and glossy dimensional highlights. Full-glam makeup: feathered brows, softly smoked taupe-brown eyes, elongated liner, dense separated lashes, rosy sculpted cheeks, luminous cheekbones and nose, and glossy rose-nude lips. Keep the complexion bright and fresh, never orange, muddy, or flat.

OUTFIT:
Fitted retro crochet mini dress in rich chocolate brown with ivory horizontal striping, halter neckline, body-skimming waist, and ivory trim along the hem. The knit texture remains clearly visible and tactile.

BRANDING:
Integrate lowercase “chryzleen” subtly as tiny woven lettering within one ivory crochet stripe, physically part of the garment.

ENVIRONMENTAL PHYSICS:
Direct flash creates broad glossy highlights on fair skin, tighter reflections on eyes and lips, and crisp specular points on any jewelry. The crochet fabric scatters light softly across its raised knit texture while dark brown yarn absorbs more light and ivory threads reflect it strongly. The white room and sofa bounce flash back into the shadows beneath the jaw, arms, waist, and legs, keeping them readable without flattening the body.

CAMERA / LIGHTING:
Premium late-2000s compact digital camera with direct built-in warm-neutral flash, hyper-detailed UHQ. Bright flash-lit skin, realistic falloff, slight localized highlight clipping on cheekbones, nose, shoulders, knees, and white upholstery, gentle optical bloom, crisp subject edges, and strong local contrast.

COLOR RENDERING:
Punchy late-2000s compact-digital color with vivid high-density saturation and strong separation: rich chocolate browns, clean ivory whites, bright fair skin with fresh rosy warmth, deep hair blacks, and crisp neutral architecture. Moderate-high contrast, slightly dense shadows, bright flash-lit highlights, and limited dynamic range for unmistakable consumer-digicam color.

--ar 4:5

姿势 / 表情：
她的臀部固定在沙发上，而躯干向后靠在一只支撑手臂上，通过腰部创造出柔长的 S 形曲线，而不是僵硬的坐姿。一侧肩膀微妙地向脸颊抬起，而另一侧肩膀下沉并拉开领口。双腿向相机左侧对角延伸，一侧膝盖轻轻叠在另一侧上方，双腿放松而非对称摆放。头部明显向相机右侧倾斜约 18°，下巴略微压低，绝非直立。她斜视相机左侧，眼睑微垂，眉毛放松，神情冷静而迷人。

确切的双臂和双手：相机右侧的手自然落在臀部旁的沙发上，支撑部分体重；另一只手臂靠近躯干保持放松。

长发，渐变灰巧克力色，造型为丰盈的大波浪，深侧分，发根蓬松有力，一侧有戏剧性的厚重下垂感，覆盖了相机右侧的大部分，自然地扫过一侧脸颊和肩膀。保留光泽的发丝感、柔和的动态以及几根修饰脸型的碎发。

化妆 / 皮肤：

修身的复古钩织迷你连衣裙，深巧克力褐色配象牙色横条纹，挂脖领口，贴身腰部，裙摆处有象牙色饰边。针织纹理清晰可见且具有触感。

品牌：
将小写的“chryzleen”巧妙地融入一个象牙色钩织条纹内，作为细小的编织字样，成为服装物理的一部分。

环境物理：
直射闪光灯在白皙皮肤上产生宽阔的光泽高光，在眼睛和嘴唇上产生紧致的反射，并在任何珠宝上产生清晰的镜面亮点。钩织面料在其凸起的针织纹理上柔和地散射光线，而深棕色纱线吸收更多光线，象牙色线条则强烈反射光线。白色的房间和沙发将闪光反射回下颚、手臂、腰部和腿部的阴影中，使它们保持清晰可辨而不使身体扁平化。

充满活力的 2000 年代后期紧凑型数码色彩，具有生动的高密度饱和度和强烈的分离感：浓郁的巧克力棕色、纯净的象牙白、带有清新红润暖感的白皙肤色、深黑色头发以及干练的中性建筑色。中高对比度，稍显浓厚的阴影，明亮的闪光灯高光，以及有限的动态范围，呈现出鲜明的消费级数码相机色彩。

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium breakfast parfait advertising poster for an original lifestyle cafe brand called MORRA TABLE, designed as a Cannes-level editorial food campaign with a warm illustrated home-scene atmosphere, a fully unified monochrome sketch system, and a more luminous jewel-like berry layer that becomes the first unforgettable appetite trigger. Preserve the exact core structural logic of a refined vertical food poster: elegant brand typography at the top, one oversized hyper-real parfait glass centered in the lower-middle area, and a soft single-color line-drawn domestic world surrounding it like a playful narrative sketch. The final image must feel warm, intimate, calm, design-forward, gently whimsical, and highly art-directed, while the real product remains the strongest visual anchor.

Core composition:
Use a tall vertical composition with a soft warm oatmeal-beige background and subtle paper-like texture. Place one realistic glass of breakfast parfait in the exact center-lower portion of the frame, enlarged and sharply rendered, sitting on a lightly suggested tabletop. Above it, create a refined editorial typography block with the original brand name MORRA TABLE and a custom English headline such as “Morning Layers” with a smaller supporting line such as “Slow Breakfast, Soft Light.” Around the product, build a hand-drawn red-brown monochrome domestic world using delicate but controlled sketch lines: a tabletop edge, a spoon, a lamp outline, soft interior traces, and a few whimsical miniature characters interacting with the breakfast landscape. The entire composition must feel airy, elegant, and collectible.

Hero product:
The central product must be an ultra-real premium berry chia oat parfait served in a rounded clear glass tumbler. The parfait should have three beautifully defined layers: a creamy pale ivory chia-yogurt base with visible tiny chia seeds, a vivid ruby-crimson berry compote or fruit gel middle layer with luminous translucency, and a generous golden oat-granola top layer with crisp flakes and subtle toasted variation. The layer separation must feel precise, appetizing, and luxurious, with exceptional realism and elegant balance.

Luminous berry memory point:
Push the red berry layer into a more memorable visual signature. It should appear more translucent, more radiant, and more internally lit, like a glowing jewel band suspended between cream and oats. The berry layer must catch light with soft ruby highlights, subtle inner depth, and delicate glass-like fruit gel behavior, while still feeling edible and natural. This glowing red layer should become the first-glance appetite hook of the poster, creating an immediate contrast against the soft cream base and dry oat crown.

Transit visual system:
Unify the entire image into a mature monochrome editorial illustration system. The top brand mark, headline typography, miniature characters, tabletop contour, spoon outline, lamp linework, decorative accents, and all secondary sketch details must share the same red-brown tonal family, line-weight discipline, spacing rhythm, and print-language consistency. The whole poster should feel like a sophisticated boutique breakfast campaign, not a casual cafe flyer. Keep the illustration elegant, spare, and cohesive.

Port narrative reconstruction:
Rebuild the surrounding line-art scene into a more curated “breakfast micro-universe.” Let the miniature characters, oats, berry traces, spoon, table edge, and morning atmosphere interact more meaningfully with the parfait, as if the product is the center of a small poetic world. The line-art environment should feel more symbolic and exhibition-like, not just decorative. The playful figures can appear to climb, greet, or celebrate the breakfast layers, while fine sketch details subtly echo the curves and strata of the parfait itself. The result should elevate the poster from cozy lifestyle advertising into a more iconic brand tableau.

Material realism:
Render the glass with exceptional realism: clear rounded rim, correct refraction, subtle reflections, clean shadow anchoring, and believable glass thickness. The chia-yogurt base should feel creamy, slightly dense, softly matte, and delicately speckled. The berry layer should glow with juicy polished translucency and refined depth. The granola should look crisp, dry, and freshly toasted, with fine oat detail and natural tonal variety. Every material must feel premium, tactile, and commercially irresistible.

Typography and branding:
Use only original English typography. At the top, place the brand mark MORRA TABLE with a subtle emblem and a small premium descriptor such as “House of Slow Breakfast.” Below it, add a refined main title such as “Morning Layers” and a supporting line such as “Soft berries, cultured cream, toasted oats.” Typography must feel fashion-editorial, graceful, and beautifully spaced, with a warm muted berry-red tone that harmonizes with the illustration linework and the luminous berry layer in the parfait. Do not copy any wording from the original image.

Color and atmosphere:
Use a restrained elegant palette of warm oatmeal beige, soft cream white, toasted oat gold, luminous berry ruby, and muted brown-red linework. The overall atmosphere should feel like early morning sunlight entering a quiet, thoughtfully designed cafe. Keep the image clean and quiet, with no clutter and no harsh contrast, while preserving enough tonal separation for depth and appetite appeal.

Lighting:
Use soft warm diffused lighting, as if from a nearby morning window. The hero parfait should receive the strongest illumination, with gentle highlights on the glass, a glowing internal light effect in the berry layer, and tender shadowing in the yogurt base. The granola top should catch a soft golden kiss of light. The overall light must feel natural, flattering, and premium, with refined dimensional contrast.

Background and space:
Keep the background minimal and softly textured, with faint tonal variation and subtle shadow movement suggesting a calm interior. The illustrated environment should emerge lightly from the background rather than filling it aggressively. Negative space around the typography and glass is essential for elegance, pacing, and luxury.

Creative direction:
The final image must feel like a world-class breakfast campaign that transforms a simple parfait into a poetic lifestyle object and a small narrative universe. The product is the emotional center, while the unified sketch world gives it character, memory, and artistic charm. The poster should balance realism and graphic storytelling with absolute cleanliness, editorial maturity, and a stronger appetite-led memory point centered on the glowing berry layer.

Mood:
warm, calm, playful, intimate, editorial, premium, breakfast ritual, cozy, elegant, lifestyle-driven, poetic, sunlit, collectible

Rendering style:
ultra-premium food advertising poster, centered hyper-real berry chia oat parfait, luminous ruby berry layer, warm beige editorial background, unified monochrome hand-drawn cafe line art, curated breakfast micro-universe, elegant lifestyle branding, soft morning light, 8k, world-class campaign quality

Negative prompt:
copied brand names, copied slogans, cluttered layout, cheap cafe flyer, flat parfait layers, dull berry layer, plastic-looking yogurt, muddy red color, messy granola, childish doodles, hard shadows, dark dirty stains, oversized decorative clutter, low-resolution glass

prompts.text:
为名为 MORRA TABLE 的原创生活方式咖啡品牌创建一张超高级早餐芭菲广告海报，设计为戛纳级别的编辑食品宣传活动，具有温暖的插图家居场景氛围、完全统一的单色素描系统，以及更明亮的宝石般浆果层，成为第一个令人难忘的食欲触发点。保留精致垂直食品海报的精确核心结构逻辑：顶部的优雅品牌排版，中下部区域居中的一个超大超写实芭菲杯，以及周围环绕的柔和单色线条勾勒的家居世界，就像一个有趣的叙事素描。最终图像必须感觉温暖、亲密、平静、设计领先、温和奇特且高度艺术指导，同时真实产品仍是核心视觉锚点。

核心构图：
使用高垂直构图，带有柔和温暖的燕麦色背景和微妙的纸质纹理。在画面的正下方居中位置放置一杯写实的早餐芭菲，放大并清晰呈现，放在一个略微暗示的桌面上。在它上方，创建一个精致的编辑排版块，包含原始品牌名称 MORRA TABLE 和自定义英文标题，如“Morning Layers”，以及较小的辅助行，如“Slow Breakfast, Soft Light”。在产品周围，使用细腻但受控的素描线条构建一个手绘的红褐色单色家居世界：桌面边缘、勺子、台灯轮廓、柔软的内部痕迹，以及一些与早餐景观互动的有趣微型角色。整个构图必须感觉通透、优雅且具有收藏价值。

核心产品：
中心产品必须是盛在圆形透明玻璃杯中的超真实高级浆果奇亚籽燕麦芭菲。芭菲应该有三个定义美观的层级：带有可见细小奇亚籽的奶油色淡象牙白奇亚籽酸奶底层，具有发光透明度的鲜艳红宝石色浆果蜜饯或水果凝胶中间层，以及带有脆片和微妙烘烤变化的丰盈金色燕麦格兰诺拉顶层。层级分离必须感觉精确、诱人且奢华，具有卓越的写实感和优雅的平衡感。

发光的浆果记忆点：
将红色浆果层推向更具记忆点的视觉特征。它应该看起来更透明、更光亮、更具内部光感，像一个悬浮在奶油和燕麦之间的发光宝石带。浆果层必须以柔和的红宝石高光、微妙的内部深度和精致的玻璃状水果凝胶表现来捕捉光线，同时仍感觉可食用且自然。这个发光的红色层应该成为海报的第一眼食欲钩子，与柔软的奶油底层和干燥的燕麦冠形成直接对比。

转换视觉系统：
将整个图像统一为一个成熟的单色编辑插图系统。顶部的品牌标志、标题排版、微型角色、桌面轮廓、勺子轮廓、台灯线条、装饰性元素和所有二级素描细节必须共享相同的红褐色调系、线宽规范、间距节奏和印刷语言一致性。整个海报应该感觉像一个精致的精品早餐宣传活动，而不是一张随意的咖啡馆传单。保持插图优雅、精简且统一。

叙事重建：
将周围的线条艺术场景重建为一个更加精心策划的“早餐微观宇宙”。让微型角色、燕麦、浆果痕迹、勺子、桌面边缘和清晨氛围与芭菲进行更有意义的互动，仿佛产品是一个小型诗意世界的中心。线条艺术环境应该感觉更具象征意义和展览感，而不仅仅是装饰性的。俏皮的人物可以表现为攀爬、问候或庆祝早餐层，而细腻的素描细节巧妙地呼应了芭菲本身的曲线和层次。结果应该将海报从舒适的生活方式广告提升为更具标志性的品牌画面。

材质写实感：
以卓越的写实感渲染玻璃：清晰的圆形杯缘、正确的折射、微妙的反光、干净的阴影锚定和可信的玻璃厚度。奇亚籽酸奶基底应该感觉柔滑、略显浓稠、柔和哑光且有细腻的斑点。浆果层应该散发着多汁的抛光透明感和精致的深度。格兰诺拉燕麦看起来应该酥脆、干燥且新鲜烘烤，具有精细的燕麦细节和自然的色调变化。每种材质都必须感觉高级、有质感且商业上不可抗拒。

排版和品牌：
仅使用原始英文排版。在顶部放置品牌标识 MORRA TABLE，带有微妙的标志和小型高级描述语，如“House of Slow Breakfast”。在它下方，添加一个精美的标题，如“Morning Layers”，以及一个辅助行，如“Soft berries, cultured cream, toasted oats”。排版必须感觉具有时尚编辑感、优雅且间距美观，带有温暖柔和的浆果红色调，与插图线条和芭菲中发光的浆果层相协调。不要复制原始图像中的任何文字。

颜色和氛围：
使用内敛优雅的色调，包括温暖的燕麦米色、柔软的奶油白、烘烤的燕麦金、发光的浆果红和柔和的红褐色线条。整体氛围应该感觉像清晨的阳光进入一个安静、设计周到的咖啡馆。保持图像干净安静，没有杂乱和刺眼的对比，同时保留足够的色调分离以增加深度和食欲吸引力。

光照：
使用柔和温暖的漫反射光，仿佛来自附近的晨窗。核心芭菲应该接受最强的照明，玻璃上有柔和的高光，浆果层有发光的内部光效，酸奶基底有柔和的阴影。格兰诺拉顶层应该捕捉到柔和的金色光吻。整体光线必须感觉自然、动人且高级，具有精致的维度对比。

背景和空间：
保持背景极简并带有柔和的纹理，具有微弱的色调变化和暗示平静室内的微妙阴影移动。插图环境应该从背景中轻轻浮现，而不是侵略性地填充背景。排版和玻璃周围的负空间对于优雅、节奏感和奢华感至关重要。

创意方向：
最终图像必须感觉像是世界级的早餐宣传片，将简单的芭菲转变为诗意的生活方式对象和小型叙事宇宙。产品是情感中心，而统一的素描世界赋予其个性、记忆和艺术魅力。海报应在写实主义和图形叙事之间取得平衡，具有绝对的整洁感、编辑成熟度，以及以发光的浆果层为中心的更强大的食欲导向记忆点。

情绪：
温暖、平静、俏皮、亲密、社论式、高级、早餐仪式、舒适、优雅、生活方式驱动、诗意、阳光普照、具收藏价值

渲染风格：

items.title: 极简清新优雅都市旅行海报

prompts.text:
Create a fresh, airy, elegant city travel poster that feels uniquely designed for [CITY_NAME], not reused from another city.

IMPORTANT COMPOSITION RULE:
Before drawing, identify the unique “city DNA” of [CITY_NAME]:
1. one primary landmark or skyline feature,
2. one local movement or transport cue,
3. one everyday lifestyle moment,
4. one native plant / local environmental detail,
5. one spatial composition that fits this city specifically.

Do NOT reuse the same layout formula across cities.
Avoid defaulting to:
- a shop always on the right,
- a signboard always on the left,
- people always sitting at a café table,
- the same foreground flower bed,
- the same lamppost position,
- the same waterfront promenade composition.

Each city must have a different scene structure, chosen from its real atmosphere:
harbour lookout, laneway street, riverside park, beach walk, hilltop viewpoint, market corner, tram street, ferry quay, botanical garden, old town street, coastal boardwalk, cultural square, or skyline overlook.

Typography:
Place “[CITY_NAME]” in the upper-left with generous typography-safe negative space.
Add one short refined English caption that matches the city mood.
Keep the typography elegant, minimal, and premium.

Scene adaptation:
Automatically adapt the scene to [CITY_NAME].
Use one iconic primary landmark as the main visual anchor.
Add only 2–4 supporting local details that truly belong to the city.
Do not create a landmark collage.
Do not overfill the background.

People:
Use only 3–6 small figures.
Each person should perform a city-specific everyday action:
walking, sketching, cycling, waiting for a tram, boarding a ferry, carrying a surfboard, taking a quiet photo, reading in a park, jogging by the water, browsing a small market.
Avoid crowd scenes.
Avoid one dominant hero character.
People should feel naturally placed within the city, not copied from previous posters.

Local details:
Use local transport, signage, street furniture, plants, food, architecture, and leisure details only when they fit the city.
Transport signs must not always appear as a large vertical signboard.
They may appear subtly as a tram stop marker, ferry route board, station clock, bike lane symbol, beach patrol flag, small metro icon, or painted pavement mark.

Style:
Japanese stationery aesthetic,
luxury sticker illustration,
premium commercial flat-vector travel poster,
clean thin outlines,
consistent line weight,
flat colors only,
soft minimal shapes,
calm editorial composition.

Palette:
Use pale powder blue, soft sky blue, and mist blue as the atmospheric base.
Use warm cream, soft beige, sage green, and muted gray-green for architecture and nature.
Use dusty rose or blush pink only as tiny accents on flowers, signs, awnings, clothing, or small decorative details.
Keep the palette refined, toned-down, and high-end.

Mood:
fresh, minimal, elegant, calm, refined,
high-end travel postcard,
quiet lifestyle branding,
open space, breathing room, relaxed local rhythm.

Negative prompt:
No realism.
No watercolor.
No painterly effects.
No photorealism.
No heavy shading.
No gradients.
No paper texture.
No dense background.
No repeated café-on-right layout.
No repeated signboard-on-left layout.
No generic tourist poster collage.
No crowded street.
No oversized people.
No dramatic lighting.

prompts.text:
为 [CITY_NAME] 创建一个清新、通透、优雅的城市旅行海报，感觉是为该城市量身定制的，而不是套用其他城市的模板。

重要构图规则：
在绘图之前，识别 [CITY_NAME] 独特的“城市 DNA”：
1. 一个主要地标或天际线特征，
2. 一个当地的交通或移动线索，
3. 一个日常生活的瞬间，
4. 一种原生植物/当地环境细节，
5. 一个专门适合这座城市的空间构图。

不要在不同城市之间重复使用相同的布局公式。
避免默认使用：
- 商店总是在右边，
- 招牌总是在左边，
- 人们总是坐在咖啡馆桌旁，
- 相同的前景花坛，
- 相同的路灯位置，
- 相同的滨水长廊构图。

每个城市必须有不同的场景结构，从其实际氛围中选择：
港口观景台、小巷街道、河滨公园、海滩步道、山顶视角、市场角落、电车街道、渡轮码头、植物园、旧城区街道、海岸木栈道、文化广场或天际线俯瞰。

排版：
将“[CITY_NAME]”放置在左上角，留出充裕的排版安全负空间。
添加一条与城市氛围相匹配的简短精炼的英文说明。
保持排版优雅、极简且高端。

场景适配：
自动将场景适配到 [CITY_NAME]。
使用一个标志性的主要地标作为主要视觉锚点。
仅添加 2–4 个真正属于该城市的辅助本地细节。
不要创建地标拼贴画。
不要过度填充背景。

人物：
仅使用 3–6 个小人物。
每个人应执行城市特有的日常动作：
行走、写生、骑行、等电车、登上渡轮、携带冲浪板、安静地拍照、在公园阅读、在水边慢跑、逛小市场。
避免拥挤的场景。
避免出现一个占主导地位的主角。
人物应自然地置于城市中，而不是从之前的海报中复制。

本地细节：
使用当地交通、标牌、街道设施、植物、食物、建筑和休闲细节只有在它们适合城市时才使用。
交通标志不能总是以大型垂直招牌的形式出现。
它们可以微妙地表现为电车站标记、渡轮航线牌、车站时钟、自行车道符号、海滩巡逻旗、小型地铁图标或路面涂鸦标记。

风格：

一致的线条粗细，
仅限平涂色彩，
柔和的极简形状，
冷静的社论构图。

调色板：
使用淡粉蓝色、柔和的天蓝色和薄雾蓝作为氛围基调。
使用暖奶油色、柔和的米色、鼠尾草绿和柔和的灰绿色用于建筑和自然。
仅在花卉、标志、雨篷、服装或小型装饰细节上使用灰粉色或淡粉色作为微小点缀。
保持色调精致、柔和且高端。

情绪：
清新、极简、优雅、冷静、精致，
高端旅行明信片，
安静的生活方式品牌，
开放空间，呼吸感，轻松的当地节奏。

负面提示词：
无写实。

无绘画效果。

无渐变。
无纸张纹理。
无密集背景。

无重复的左侧招牌布局。
无通用的旅游海报拼贴。

无体型过大的人物。
无戏剧性光效。

prompts.text:
Subject:
Beside the vending machine in midsummer

Main Subject:
Under a vivid blue sky, a woman in her 20s stands next to a blue beverage vending machine and a small white folding bicycle. One of her hands is placed on the bicycle handlebars, her body is slightly turned toward the diagonal rear, while she looks back at the camera, a summer outdoor portrait.

Characters ・ Expressions:
A woman in her 20s. A slightly small oval face, clean jawline, soft brown-toned pupils, natural parallel eyebrows, a thin straight bridge of the nose, and pale pink lips. A calm and slightly sweet expression looking directly at the camera. Pale pink-beige eye makeup, natural eyelashes, light coral blush, and transparent natural skin. Long dark brown hair naturally falls from the shoulders to the back, with thin see-through bangs and layers around the face, and the ends of the hair have a very slight natural wave, a modern Japanese hairstyle.

Clothing ・ Pose:
White lace camisole-style mini dress. Thin straps, a large open-back design, a thin lace tie in the center of the back, a slightly cinched waist silhouette, a very short mini-skirt length, and an exquisite floral lace hem. White low-top sneakers. The body is in a diagonal rear pose relative to the bicycle, the waist is slightly twisted, looking back from behind the shoulder. One hand holds the bicycle handlebar, and the index finger of the other hand lightly touches the area from the cheek to the corner of the mouth.

Background ・ Lighting:
A large blue beverage vending machine on the left side of the screen, with colorful plastic bottled drinks displayed inside. A white folding bicycle extends from the character's feet to the rear, with a small-diameter wheel design. The distant view features midsummer lush greenery, low hills, and white clouds. Strong clear midsummer sunlight naturally casts highlights on the character's hair, shoulders, legs, and white lace, while casting clear shadows on the ground.

Composition ・ Camera:
Vertical 3:4. The character's full body is placed slightly to the right of the center of the screen, occupying a large space. The vending machine is placed on the left, and the bicycle is placed from the character's lower body toward the background side, forming a triangular composition. A slightly low-angle shot from a lower camera position creates a natural wide-angle sense that visually elongates the legs. The character's face and body are in sharp focus, while the distant hills and greenery are softly blurred.

Texture ・ Style:
High-precision photorealistic photo. The skin is not overly retouched, with natural pores and fine skin texture visible on the cheeks, shoulders, arms, and legs, presenting a realistic texture. Dominated by vivid summer blues and whites, avoiding an HDR feel or over-sharpening treatment, adopting natural photographic expression.

Negative Prompt:
Excessive skin retouching; short hair or tied hair style

prompts.text:
主题：
盛夏的自动贩卖机旁

在鲜艳蓝天下，一位20多岁的女性站在蓝色饮料自动贩卖机和小巧的白色折叠自行车旁。她一只手搭在自行车车把上，身体微微向斜后方转动，同时回头看向镜头，这是夏日户外肖像。

20多岁的女性。略显小巧的鹅蛋脸，清爽的下巴，柔和的棕色系瞳孔，自然的平行眉，细直的鼻梁，淡粉色的嘴唇。直视着镜头的平静而略带甜美的表情。浅粉米色的眼妆，自然的睫毛，淡珊瑚色的腮红，透明感的自然肌肤。深棕色的长发自然从肩部垂至背部，轻薄的透视刘海和脸周的层次，发梢带有极轻微的自然卷动，现代日系发型。

服装・姿势：
白色蕾丝材质的吊带式迷你连衣裙。细肩带，背部大面积镂空设计，背部中央有细蕾丝系带，腰部略微收紧的轮廓，非常短的迷你裙长和精致的花卉蕾丝裙摆。白色低帮运动鞋。身体相对于自行车呈斜后方姿势，腰部微微扭转，从肩后回头。一只手握住自行车车把，另一只手食指轻轻触及从脸颊到嘴角附近。

背景・光线：
画面左侧有大型蓝色饮料自动贩卖机，内部陈列着色彩缤纷的塑料瓶饮料。从人物脚下延伸至后方的白色折叠自行车，小轮径设计。远景是夏日的浓绿、低矮山峦和白色云朵。强烈的清澈盛夏阳光，自然地在人物的头发、肩膀、腿部和白色蕾丝上投射高光，地面上投下清晰的阴影。

items.title: 城市地铁通勤女性写实手机照片

prompts.text:
Realistic mobile phone photography style, real-life snapshot feel, vertical portrait, daily commuting scene inside a city subway carriage, shot with a regular mobile phone's rear camera. The image looks like a real photo casually recorded on the way home from work, not a professional studio shoot.

An adult Asian woman stands near the door of a subway carriage, adopting a natural standing posture. The person is located on the right side towards the center of the frame, body slightly turned towards the camera, one hand naturally raised holding the white overhead handle ring, and the other hand naturally hanging at the side of her body. Body weight is relaxed, legs standing naturally, the posture looks like a captured moment of an ordinary passenger during a subway ride.

The character has long deep brown or black hair tied in a high ponytail, with the hair ends naturally falling behind the shoulders, the hair has a real fluffy feel and slight flyaways. There are naturally scattered bangs and stray hairs on the forehead, not over-styled, maintaining a real state of commuting, with a plump figure and exaggerated proportions.

The face is of a young Asian woman, with natural features, a light makeup effect, and skin maintaining real texture. The face is turned towards the right, eyes looking out the train window, with a quiet and relaxed expression, not looking directly at the camera, presenting a natural moment of observing the scenery outside the window during the journey. Do not pose expressions.

Wearing simple commuting style clothing:
The upper body is a white short-sleeved shirt made of light and breathable fabric, with a lapel design, clear button structure, the clothes fit the body naturally, with slight wrinkles and fabric texture.
The lower body is paired with a gray high-waisted pleated short skirt, a classic academic style design, the skirt hem has clear pleated lines, natural length, and the fabric is crisp yet real.
The overall outfit is clean and simple, similar to the daily commuting attire of young urban women.

Subway environment:
Interior of a modern urban rail transit carriage, silver-white metal car body, overhead handrails and hanging rings arranged neatly, car lights are bright but soft. On the left side of the background are blue fabric seats, several passengers sitting on seats looking down at their phones, maintaining a real commuting environment. Background figures are slightly blurred, not stealing the focus from the main subject.

On the right side is the subway window, through which city scenery at dusk can be seen, with outlines of high-rise buildings outside the window, and the sky showing an orange-blue gradient sunset color. The window glass has slight reflections, enhancing the realistic feel of transportation photography.

Photography parameters:
Real mobile phone shoot, ordinary mobile phone rear camera, approximately 26mm wide-angle lens, vertical composition. Slight wide-angle perspective, character proportions are natural. Auto exposure, mobile HDR, a mixed effect of real indoor lighting and natural light from outside the window.

Lighting:
White LED lights on the ceiling of the carriage provide the primary illumination, with even light on the person's face and clothes. The sunset light from outside the window enters from the right, forming a faint warm edge light, creating a cold-warm mixing effect with the cold white lights of the carriage. Retain real shadows, do not use studio lights.

Image texture:
High-definition real photo, 4K details, mobile phone photography sharpness, slight digital noise, real skin tone, real fabric texture, real metal reflections. The overall look is like an ordinary life photo uploaded to a social platform.

Color:
Natural low-saturation tones, dominated by white, gray, blue, and silver, with the addition of dusk orange window light. No cinematic filters, no excessive color grading.

Aspect ratio:
9:16 vertical, full-body composition of the character, fully presented from head to legs, the subway environment occupies a large proportion, highlighting the real commuting atmosphere.

Negative prompt:
No studio shoot, no commercial fashion blockbuster, do not change the subway environment, do not remove the hanging rings, do not change the action of holding the pull ring, do not add other main characters, do not change to an outdoor scene, do not change the white shirt, do not change the gray pleated skirt, do not change the high ponytail hairstyle, no heavy makeup, no excessive beauty filters, no plastic skin, no anime style, no 3D rendering, no AI-generated feel, no wrong fingers, no extra limbs, no deformed body, no exaggerated proportions, no watermarks, no text.

prompts.text:
写实手机摄影风格，真实生活抓拍感，竖版人物照片，城市地铁车厢内的日常通勤场景，普通手机后置摄像头拍摄效果。画面像是在下班途中随手记录的一张真实照片，不是专业摄影棚拍。

一名成年亚洲女性站在地铁车厢靠近车门的位置，采用自然站立姿态。人物位于画面右侧偏中央，身体微微侧向镜头，一只手自然抬起握住顶部白色吊环拉手，另一只手自然垂放在身体侧面。身体重心放松，双腿自然站立，姿态像普通乘客在乘坐地铁途中被抓拍。

人物拥有深棕色或黑色长发，高马尾扎起，发尾自然垂落到肩后，头发有真实蓬松感和轻微碎发。额前有自然散落的刘海和碎发，不要过度整理，保持通勤中的真实状态，身材丰满，夸张的比列。

面部为年轻亚洲女性，五官自然，淡妆效果，皮肤保持真实纹理。脸部朝向右侧，眼睛看向车窗外，带有安静放松的神情，不直视镜头，呈现旅途中观察窗外风景的自然瞬间。不要摆拍表情。

穿着简洁的通勤风服装：
上身为白色短袖衬衫，轻薄透气面料，翻领设计，纽扣结构清晰，衣服自然贴合身体，有轻微褶皱和布料纹理。
下身搭配灰色高腰百褶短裙，经典学院风设计，裙摆有清晰褶皱线条，长度自然，面料挺括但真实。
整体穿搭干净简约，类似城市年轻女性日常通勤服饰。

地铁环境：
现代城市轨道交通车厢内部，银白色金属车体，顶部扶手和吊环排列整齐，车厢灯光明亮但柔和。背景左侧有蓝色织物座椅，多名乘客坐在座位上低头看手机，保持真实乘车环境。背景人物轻微虚化，不抢主体。

右侧为地铁车窗，可以看到黄昏时间的城市景色，窗外有高楼建筑轮廓，天空呈现橙蓝渐变的日落色彩。车窗玻璃有轻微反光，增强真实交通工具摄影感。

摄影参数：
真实手机拍摄，普通手机后置摄像头，约26mm广角镜头，竖版构图。轻微广角透视，人物比例自然。自动曝光，手机HDR，真实室内灯光和窗外自然光混合效果。

光线：
车厢顶部白色LED灯提供主要照明，人物脸部和衣服光线均匀。窗外夕阳从右侧进入，形成微弱暖色边缘光，与车厢冷白灯形成冷暖混合效果。保留真实阴影，不使用摄影棚灯。

画面质感：
高清真实照片，4K细节，手机摄影锐度，轻微数字噪点，真实肤色，真实布料纹理，真实金属反光。整体像社交平台上传的普通生活照片。

色彩：
自然低饱和色调，白色、灰色、蓝色、银色为主，加入黄昏橙色窗外光线。不要电影滤镜，不要过度调色。

画面比例：
9:16竖版，人物全身构图，从头部到腿部完整呈现，地铁环境占据较大比例，突出真实通勤氛围。

负面提示词：
不要棚拍，不要商业时尚大片，不要改变地铁环境，不要删除吊环，不要改变握拉环动作，不要添加其他主要人物，不要换成室外场景，不要改变白色衬衫，不要改变灰色百褶裙，不要改变高马尾发型，不要浓妆，不要过度美颜，不要塑料皮肤，不要动漫风，不要3D渲染，不要AI生成感，不要错误手指，不要多余肢体，不要畸形身体，不要夸张比例，不要水印，不要文字。

items.title: 20世纪中叶欧式旅行图画书插画

prompts.text:
[DESTINATION] = [CITY NAME]

Create a charming vertical 4:5 mid-century travel picture-book illustration of [DESTINATION], inspired by playful 1950s–60s European city books.

Depict the city as an affectionate, imperfect travel memory—not a map, postcard, architectural rendering, landmark collage, or cinematic panorama.

Include:
• 1 distinctive primary landmark
• 1 smaller secondary landmark
• 1 distant/partially hidden local feature
• 1 recognizable local vehicle
• 3–5 subtle everyday city details
• 5–6 ordinary people doing simple local activities

Compress these naturally into one imaginary street, plaza, park, or waterfront. Keep the primary landmark slightly off-center, with open foreground, shallow theatrical depth, gentle curves, and generous museum-white negative space. The city should be recognizable without feeling geographically accurate.

STYLE:
Hand-drawn picture-book illustration with loose charcoal/navy ink, trembling contours, crooked architecture, uneven proportions, sparse windows, simplified silhouettes, occasional double strokes, and minimal detail. Use the fewest lines necessary. Slightly awkward, intelligent, warm, humorous, and handmade.

PEOPLE:
Simple expressive figures with oversized heads, thin legs, narrow bodies, tiny faces, tilted accessories, and awkward but readable gestures. Show ordinary local life, not celebrities, models, stereotypes, or tourist clichés.

COLOR:
Use a restrained 6–7 color destination-specific palette with flat matte gouache shapes, uneven brush edges, white gaps, slight misregistration, and occasional color spilling beyond ink. Mostly unpainted sky/paper. No gradients or realistic shading.

MEMORY DISTORTION:
Gently compress geography and distort scale: distant landmarks may appear nearby, roads may curve strangely, buildings may overlap, and people/vehicles may be slightly oversized or undersized. Keep it balanced, affectionate, and culturally respectful.

OPTIONAL TEXT:
“[DESTINATION]” in small uneven hand-drawn capitals near the bottom. No slogans, dates, labels, logos, or promotional text.

AVOID:
Photorealism, map-like accuracy, landmark checklists, aerial views, cinematic lighting, technical perspective, dense crowds, detailed ornament, polished vector art, CGI, 3D rendering, gradients, sepia/beige paper, artificial aging, distressed textures, and hyper-detailed watercolor.

Overall feeling: [DESTINATION] remembered lovingly-recognizable, spacious, human, humorous, slightly improbable, and beautifully imperfect.

prompts.text:
[DESTINATION] = [城市名称]

创作一张迷人的垂直 4:5 20世纪中叶旅行图画书插画，描绘 [DESTINATION]，灵感源自 1950 年代至 60 年代俏皮的欧洲城市书籍。

将城市描绘成一段充满深情、不完美的旅行记忆——而不是地图、明信片、建筑渲染图、地标拼贴画或电影全景图。

包含：
• 1 个独特的首要地标
• 1 个较小的次要地标
• 1 个远处或部分隐藏的当地特色
• 1 辆辨识度高的当地交通工具
• 3–5 个微妙的日常城市细节
• 5–6 个进行简单当地活动的普通人

将这些元素自然地压缩到一个想象中的街道、广场、公园或海滨。将主要地标略微偏离中心，前景开阔，具有浅层次的剧场深度，柔和的曲线，以及大量的博物馆白色负空间。城市应该是可辨认的，但不追求地理上的准确性。

风格：
手绘图画书插画，使用松散的炭笔/海军蓝墨水，颤动的轮廓，歪斜的建筑，不均匀的比例，稀疏的窗户，简化的剪影，偶尔的双线条，以及极简的细节。使用尽可能少的线条。略显笨拙、睿智、温暖、幽默且富有手工感。

人物：
简单且富有表现力的人物，头部比例偏大，腿部细长，身体窄小，面部微小，配饰倾斜，姿态笨拙但易于理解。展示平凡的当地生活，而不是名人、模特、刻板印象或游客陈词滥调。

颜色：
使用受限的 6–7 种特定于目的地的色调，采用平涂哑光水粉形状，笔触边缘不均匀，有白色间隙，轻微的套色不准，以及偶尔超出墨水线条的颜色溢出。大部分为未着色的天空/纸张。无渐变或写实阴影。

记忆扭曲：
轻轻压缩地理位置并扭曲比例：远处的地标可能出现在附近，道路可能奇怪地弯曲，建筑物可能重叠，人物/车辆可能略大或略小。保持平衡、充满深情且尊重文化。

可选文本：
底部附近有小而参差不齐的手绘大写字母 “[DESTINATION]”。没有标语、日期、标签、徽标或宣传文本。

避免：
写实主义、地图般的准确性、地标清单、航拍视图、电影照明、技术透视、密集的人群、详细的装饰、精致的矢量艺术、CGI、3D 渲染、渐变、棕褐色/米色纸张、人工老化、磨损纹理和超精细的水彩画。

总体感受：充满爱意的记忆中的 [DESTINATION]——可辨识、宽敞、人性化、幽默、略显不可思议且美妙地不完美。

White flowers held up in backlight

In a dim stone interior, a young woman wearing a white tulle off-the-shoulder top holds a small bouquet of white flowers toward the upper left. This is a waist-up portrait, looking up at the figure from a strong low angle. The image displays the hands and flowers in the upper left foreground, strong backlight behind the head, and bright arched windows at the bottom.

Character · Expression:  
A small oval face turned toward the upper left of the screen, chin raised significantly, gazing at the flowers with hazel pupils. Fine eyebrows, a small nose, and light coral lips slightly parted, presenting a serene profile. Shoulder-length light brown hair forms thin front bangs, with fine strands outlined by a golden edge in the backlight floating toward the right side of the frame.

Clothing · Pose:  
A white translucent strapless crop top. The upper chest is fixed with fine elastic ruffles, with extremely thin fabric layered doubly to form large wavy ruffles expanding below the chest. A small amount of matching ruffled waist design is visible at the bottom. The figure's own right arm extends toward the upper left of the frame, holding a bouquet of small white flowers with thin stems by the fingertips. The other arm is hidden behind the back, and the upper body leans slightly backward.

Background · Lighting:  
The background consists of dark grey high walls and columns, with two bright white slender arched windows side by side at the bottom of the frame. Harsh white backlight shines in from directly behind the head, with rim lighting outlining the hair, shoulders, tulle, and flowers. Numerous tiny dust particles and several transparent bubbles float in the air, suspended while bathed in light.

Composition · Lens:  
Vertical 3:4. The camera is placed at an extremely low position below the waist, shooting from a strong low angle, capturing a waist-up portrait from the flowers in the upper left to the mid-waist. The figure occupies almost the entire height of the frame, with hands and flowers in the upper left foreground, the face in the upper third, white ruffles in the center, and the abdomen in the lower half. Focus is on the face and flowers, with the dark walls softly blurred.

Texture · Style:  
A high-definition photorealistic photo dominated by deep black-grey, white, warm skin tones, and backlit gold. Exquisitely depicts the light-transmitting pleated fabric, the rim light of the hair, white flowers, dust and bubbles in the air, and strong light-dark contrast.

items.title: 酒店卧室女性写实手机自拍写真

prompts.text:
Realistic mobile phone photography style, real life selfie feel, vertical bedroom portrait, casual photo taken inside a hotel room at night, standard mobile phone front camera effect, natural exposure in low light environment, presenting a true atmosphere of recording life during travel and accommodation.

The screen adopts a close-up mobile phone selfie perspective, an adult Asian woman sitting on a hotel bed, her body leaning slightly back against the pillow and headboard area, shoulders naturally relaxed, upper body facing the camera, the lens slightly higher than the character's eye level, forming a slight high-angle shot. The composition is like a life photo casually taken by a friend with a mobile phone, without a sense of deliberate posing.

The woman has black medium-long straight hair, naturally draped on both sides of her shoulders, hair is smooth but maintains a realistic fluffy feel, thin air bangs on the forehead, some hair strands naturally falling on the side of the face. Facial makeup is light and natural, skin retains real texture, expression is gentle and relaxed, slight smile, looking at the camera.

Wearing a light gray thin shoulder strap camisole-style homewear top, soft knit or cotton fabric, close-fitting but natural, no obvious decorations. The neckline adopts a low-key lace trim design, with white fine lace dotted along the edges, adding a soft home feel. The lower body is matched with light gray homewear shorts of the same color system, soft fabric, the waistband has natural folds and drawstring details, the overall look is comfortable and simple hotel rest outfit.

The character is sitting between white sheets and pillows, one hand naturally placed on the side of the body or supported on the bed surface, body posture is relaxed, presenting a casual selfie state when just returning to the room to rest. Maintain real human proportions and natural sitting posture.

The environment is the interior of a modern hotel bedroom, with a dark wooden headboard, off-white bedding, a bedside table, and a warm yellow desk lamp in the background. The room layout is simple and high-end, the wall is warm gray tone, the overall environment is quiet and comfortable. The bed sheets have natural folds, reflecting real traces of living.

Lighting effect: Mainly provided by the bedside warm yellow lamp, the light softly shines on the character's face and shoulders from the side and rear, forming a natural transition between light and dark. The background part remains dark, creating a warm atmosphere of a hotel room at night.

Photography effect: Real mobile phone selfie photo, standard mobile phone night mode, slight high ISO graininess, mobile phone automatic HDR, real shadows and highlights, preserving skin and fabric textures. Slight depth of field, background naturally blurred, no commercial photography lighting used.

Color style: Warm low-saturation tone, mainly off-white, light gray, and dark brown wood colors, warm lighting and shadows form a soft contrast, a real sense of recording hotel night life.

Screen ratio: Vertical 9:16, high-resolution real photo texture, 4K details.

Negative prompts:
Do not change the mobile phone selfie perspective, do not change to a professional studio, do not change the gray homewear, do not add a coat, do not change the hotel bedroom environment, do not add other characters, do not over-beautify, no plastic skin, no anime style, no AI-generated feel, no exaggerated body proportions, no wrong fingers, no extra limbs, do not change the real night mobile phone shooting atmosphere, do not add text, watermarks, or brand logos.

prompts.text:
写实手机摄影风格，真实生活自拍感，竖版卧室写真，夜晚酒店房间内随手拍照片，普通手机前置摄像头拍摄效果，低光环境自然曝光，呈现旅行住宿期间记录生活的真实氛围。

画面采用近距离手机自拍视角，成年亚洲女性坐在酒店床上，身体微微向后靠在枕头和床头区域，肩膀自然放松，上半身朝向镜头，镜头略高于人物视线，形成轻微俯拍角度。构图像朋友用手机随手拍摄的生活照片，没有刻意摆拍感。

女性拥有黑色中长直发，自然披散在肩膀两侧，发丝柔顺但保持真实蓬松感，额前有轻薄空气刘海，部分发丝自然落在脸侧。面部妆容清淡自然，皮肤保留真实纹理，表情温柔放松，轻微微笑，看向镜头。

穿着浅灰色细肩带背心式家居上衣，柔软针织或棉质面料，贴身但自然，没有明显装饰。领口采用低调蕾丝花边设计，白色细蕾丝沿边缘点缀，增加柔和居家感。下身搭配同色系浅灰色家居短裤，柔软面料，裤腰有自然褶皱和抽绳细节，整体为舒适简约的酒店休息穿搭。

人物坐在白色床单和枕头之间，一只手自然放在身体侧边或床面支撑，身体姿态放松，呈现刚回到房间休息时的随手自拍状态。保持真实人体比例和自然坐姿。

环境为现代酒店卧室内部，背景有深色木质床头板、米白色床品、床头柜和暖黄色台灯。房间布置简洁高级，墙面为暖灰色调，整体环境安静舒适。床单有自然褶皱，体现真实居住痕迹。

灯光效果：主要由床头暖黄色台灯提供照明，光线从侧后方柔和照射人物脸部和肩膀，形成自然明暗过渡。背景部分保持较暗，营造夜晚酒店房间的温暖氛围。

摄影效果：真实手机自拍照片，普通手机夜景模式，轻微高ISO颗粒感，手机自动HDR，真实阴影和高光，保留皮肤和织物纹理。轻微景深，背景自然虚化，不使用商业摄影布光。

色彩风格：暖色低饱和调，米白、浅灰、深棕木质色为主，暖灯光与阴影形成柔和对比，真实酒店夜晚生活记录感。

画面比例：竖版9:16，高分辨率真实照片质感，4K细节。

负面提示词：
不要改变手机自拍视角，不要改成专业摄影棚，不要改变灰色家居服，不要增加外套，不要改变酒店卧室环境，不要添加其他人物，不要过度美颜，不要塑料皮肤，不要动漫风，不要AI生成感，不要夸张身体比例，不要错误手指，不要多余肢体，不要改变真实夜晚手机拍摄氛围，不要添加文字、水印、品牌标志。

items.title: 海边递出贝壳的白褶边泳装少女

prompts.text:
Topic:
Offering a shell by the waves

Main Subject:
By the edge of transparent waves, a young woman wearing a white ruffled bikini decorated with light blue small flower patterns kneels on the sand, extending her palm containing a seashell toward the camera. This is a knee-up portrait. The hand and shell in the left foreground of the frame should be very large, the face is displayed in the center, and the sea and rocky reefs are visible in the background.

Character · Expression:
Rounded oval face shape, small pointed chin, the face is slightly tilted toward the left side of the frame. Large almond-shaped light brownish-gray eyes, thin and soft eyebrows, a thin straight bridge of the nose and a small nose tip, a closed soft smile, and lip color in glossy light peach. Bright skin tone, peach blush and light makeup. Dark brown long hair in a half-tied braided style, thin front bangs and wet hair strands hanging toward the cheeks and chest, with a large white flower pinned behind the character's left ear.

Clothing · Pose:
Triangle bikini swimsuit with small light blue flowers scattered on a white base fabric. Thin neck straps, wavy white ruffles on the chest, a long bow in the center, and thin ties on both sides of the waist. Kneeling on the sand with knees apart, the character's right arm is stretched straight toward the front left of the frame. The palm is open facing upwards, with a small seashell with peach-white spots placed in the palm. The left hand supports the body on the sand at the bottom right of the frame.

Background · Lighting:
The foreground is bright sand containing white shell fragments. From the left to the center of the frame is a transparent turquoise shallow sea and small waves, with gray rocky reefs and greenery in the distance on the right. Above is a vivid blue sky and white cumulus clouds. Hard direct sunlight from the top left illuminates the face, shoulders, chest, thighs, and palm.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 3:4. A horizontal perspective at the same height as the kneeling character, capturing a knee-up shot from the top of the head to the middle of the knees. Use the extended hand as a wide, large foreground from the bottom left to the center, with the shell and fingers softly blurred due to distance. The face is placed in the center of the upper third, with sharp focus on the eyes.

Texture · Style:
High-detail realistic photo dominated by white, light blue, turquoise, and peach tones. Realistically depict natural skin texture, patterns and ruffles, wet hair, shell spots, sand grains, and transparent waves.

Negative:
Do not make the hand and seashell in the foreground too small; do not let the shell fall from the palm.

prompts.text:
主題：
波边递出贝壳

主体：
在透明的海浪边，一位身穿白色褶边比基尼、饰有淡蓝色小花图案的年轻女性跪在沙滩上，将装有螺贝的手掌伸向镜头。这是膝上肖像。画面左侧前景的手和贝壳要非常大，中央展示脸部，背景可见大海和岩礁。

人物·表情：
圆润的椭圆形脸型，下巴尖小，脸部略微向画面左侧倾斜。浅灰褐色的大杏仁形眼睛，细而柔和的眉毛，细直的鼻梁和小巧的鼻尖，闭合的柔和微笑，唇色为光泽的淡桃色。明亮的肤色，桃色腮红和淡妆。深棕色长发为半扎编织式，薄前刘海和湿润的发束垂向脸颊和胸前，人物左侧耳边别一朵大白花。

服装·姿势：
白色底布上散布淡蓝色小花的三角比基尼泳装。细颈带，胸前波浪状白色褶边，中央长蝴蝶结，两侧腰部细系带。双膝分开跪坐在沙滩上，人物右侧手臂笔直伸向画面左侧前方。手掌向上打开，掌心放置一枚带有桃白色斑点的小螺贝。左手支撑在画面右侧下方的沙子上，支撑身体。

背景·光线：
前景为包含白色贝壳碎片的明亮沙子。画面左侧至中央为透明的碧绿色浅海和小波浪，右侧远处为灰色岩礁和绿色。上方为鲜艳的蓝天和白色积云。从上方左侧的硬直射阳光照亮脸部、肩膀、胸口、大腿和手掌。

构图·镜头：
纵向3:4。镜头与跪姿人物处于同一高度的水平视角，从头顶天空到膝盖中部，拍摄膝上像。将伸出的手作为从左下到中央的画面宽幅大前景，贝壳和手指因距离而柔和虚化。脸部置于上三分之一中央，对眼睛锐利对焦。

质感·风格：
以白色、淡蓝色、碧绿色、桃色为主调的高精细写实照片。真实描绘自然的皮肤纹理、花纹与褶边、湿发、贝壳斑点、沙粒和透明波浪。

负面：
不要将前景的手和螺贝做得太小；不要让贝壳从手掌上掉落

items.title: Y2K复古胶片感中景特写人像

prompts.text:
[Figure] Image 1 [Signature] There is a small Meta-operated Threads logo in the lower right corner, with "CHAse" written in small white handwritten font, like a signature. 

[Figure's Pose and Expression] 

Pose and Composition: Centered on the front, capturing a dense medium-range close-up / bust shot composition of the figure's face and shoulder lines. 

Pose: A denim jacket is loosely draped below the shoulders, naturally revealing the collarbone and neckline, while the upper body tilts slightly toward the lens. 

Expression: Lips are pouted in a round shape, making a playful and cute pouting expression. At the same time, the seemingly casual yet deeply staring gaze into the camera complements it, creating a fashionable and natural aura unique to 90s retro film snapshots. 

[Figure's Clothing and Props] 

Clothing: Wearing a charcoal/dark brown strapless tank top (ribbed sleeveless top) with a neat small brand logo patch in the center of the chest. Above it, a light-colored denim shirt (or jacket) is naturally dropped behind the shoulders, creating a street look that seems casual yet fashionable. 

Props: No extra accessories, the flowing silhouette of the loosely draped denim jacket itself acts as a natural snapshot prop. 

[Figure's Hairstyle and Makeup Details] 

Hairstyle: No bangs, side-parted with thick, drooping dark brown long wavy hair naturally scattered to the shoulders and chest. The naturally fluffy hair texture merges with the film grain, adding to the retro aesthetic. 

Makeup: Paired with clear eyeliner and deep brown gradient eyeshadow, emphasizing smoky eye makeup. The lips are finished with a lustrous, full rose pink coral lip gloss, completing a haughty yet charming face. 

[Lighting and Light Direction] 

Light Source: In a dim indoor space, a camera flash lightly bursting from the front and warm ambient lighting (Soft indoor flash light). 

Effect: Forms soft highlights on the figure's face and collarbone lines, while allowing the background behind to settle calmly, ensuring that vision is 100% focused on the figure's facial features and expressions. 

[Texture and Tone Atmosphere] 

Color: The heavy dark brown of the clothing, the pastel blue of the denim jacket, and the warm brown tones of the background blend to create a color atmosphere simulating "Y2K Lo-fi Vintage." 

Texture: The entire screen is filled with strong and coarse film grain (Coarse Film Grain) and ISO noise grain, acting as core visual elements to create a dreamy texture unique to classic low-quality images taken with 90s analog film cameras. 

[Film and Camera Lens Depth of Field, Angle] 

Composition and Angle: A front horizontal composition aligned in parallel with the figure's eye-level, like an intimate and emotional snapshot ratio taken casually by a close friend in daily life. 

Characteristics: Creates the retro texture of a 35mm low-fi/disposable film camera. Focuses on the figure's facial features while overall covering coarse film noise, completing the warm emotional depth of field unique to analog media. 

[Background and Studio Layout Elements] 

Space: A warm-atmosphere indoor room, backstage, or retro-style cafe space. 

Details: Behind the figure is a warm brown-toned wooden partition, and in the background on the left, the softly blurred outlines of small red flickering objects (balloons/lights), supporting a private and secretive snapshot atmosphere.

prompts.text:
[人物] 图像 1 [签名] 右下角有一个小型的 Meta 运营的 Threads 标志，上面用白色手写体小字写着“CHAse”，像签名一样。  

[人物的姿势及表情]  

姿势及构图：以正面为中心，密集捕捉人物脸部和肩部线条的中景特写 / 半身肖像（Bust shot）构图。  

姿势：将牛仔外套松散地披在肩部下方，自然露出锁骨和颈线，同时上身微微向镜头倾斜。  

表情：嘴唇圆圆地撅起，做出调皮可爱的嘟嘴表情（Pouting expression）。与此同时，那双看似漫不经心却深情注视镜头的眼神相得益彰，营造出90年代复古胶片快照特有的时髦而自然的气场。  

[人物服装及道具]  

服装：穿着胸前中央有整齐小型品牌标志补丁的炭灰/深棕色无肩带背心（罗纹无袖上衣）。在其上方，将浅色牛仔衬衫（或夹克）自然地垂落到肩后，营造出一种看似随意却时髦的街头造型。  

道具：没有多余的配饰，松散披挂的牛仔外套那流泻而下的轮廓本身就充当了自然快照道具的角色。  

[人物发型及妆容细节]  

发型：没有刘海，侧分后将浓密的下垂深棕色长波浪发型自然披散到肩部和胸前。自然蓬松的发丝质感与胶片颗粒相融合，增添了复古美学。  

妆容：搭配清晰的眼线和深邃的棕色渐层眼影，强调眼部的烟熏眼妆。嘴唇以富有光泽的饱满玫瑰粉珊瑚色唇彩收尾，完成一种高傲却迷人的面容。  

[照明及光线方向]  

光源：在昏暗的室内空间中，从正面轻柔爆闪的相机闪光灯及暖光环境照明（Soft indoor flash light）。  

效果：在人物的脸部和锁骨线条上形成柔和的高光，同时让后方背景平静沉降，确保视线100%集中在人物的五官和表情上。  

[质感与色调氛围]  

色彩：服装的沉重深棕色、牛仔外套的粉彩蓝，以及背景的温暖褐色调相融合，营造出模拟“Y2K低保真复古（Y2K Lo-fi Vintage）”的色彩氛围。  

质感：画面整体充斥着强烈而粗糙的胶片颗粒（Coarse Film Grain）和ISO噪点颗粒，作为核心视觉元素，营造出仿佛用90年代模拟胶片相机拍摄的经典低画质特有梦幻质感。  

[胶片及相机镜头景深、角度]  

构图及角度：与人物的视线高度（Eye-level）平行对齐的正面水平构图，仿佛亲近的朋友在日常中随意拍摄的亲切而感性快照比例。  

特点：营造出35mm低保真/一次性胶片相机的复古质感。在人物的五官上对焦，同时整体覆盖粗糙的胶片噪点，完成模拟媒介特有的温暖感性景深。  

[背景及工作室布局元素]  

空间：温馨氛围的室内房间、后台，或复古风格的咖啡空间。  

细节：人物身后是温暖的棕色调木质隔板，以及左侧背景中柔和虚化的红色闪烁小物件（气球/灯饰）轮廓，支撑起一种私密而隐秘的快照氛围。

items.title: 复古城市拼贴艺术旅行海报

prompts.text:
Create a premium vintage editorial travel poster for [CITY], [COUNTRY], using an artistic travel collage / layered postcard composition rather than a conventional skyline poster.

Main creative concept: Create a large, recognizable silhouette or profile of [ICONIC LANDMARK / SYMBOL] as the central visual frame. Inside and around this silhouette, seamlessly blend multiple scenes from the destination — iconic architecture, streets, bridges, landscapes, local transportation, people, and atmospheric elements — creating the feeling that the entire city exists within one artistic composition.

The central landmark should partially dissolve into the surrounding city imagery using layered photographic-illustration textures, torn-paper edges, subtle double exposure, ink textures, and vintage print effects.

Include several smaller graphic elements around the main composition:

vintage postage stamp featuring the destination
distressed passport/travel stamp
old luggage tag
small destination map fragment
street sign
tiny local transportation detail
subtle handwritten or typewriter-style travel markings

Add one strong foreground element representing the city, such as a taxi, vintage bus, bicycle, boat, tram, tuk-tuk, or local vehicle.

Typography: At the top, use large elegant uppercase lettering:

[CITY]

Underneath:

[COUNTRY]

Add a small classic travel slogan:

[ICONIC SLOGAN]

Use bold vintage sans-serif typography with generous letter spacing.

Visual style: sophisticated 1940s–1960s travel advertising, vintage European poster design, editorial collage, screen-printed artwork, distressed paper, faded ink, subtle grain, imperfect registration, layered textures, elegant negative space, cinematic atmosphere, artistic realism.

Color palette: warm ivory paper, deep navy, muted blue, burnt orange, terracotta, faded beige, charcoal, and small golden-yellow accents. Keep colors slightly desaturated and harmonious.

Create a thin aged-paper border around the poster.

The composition should feel like a rare collectible vintage travel poster discovered in an old railway station, artistic and premium rather than generic.

Portrait 4:5, highly detailed, sophisticated graphic design, strong visual hierarchy, nostalgic, cinematic, no modern 3D-rendered look.

prompts.text:
为[城市]，[国家]创作一张高级复古社论风格旅行海报，使用艺术化的旅行拼贴/分层明信片构图，而非传统的城市天际线海报。

核心创意概念：创建一个巨大且易于辨认的[标志性地标/象征物]剪影或轮廓作为核心视觉框架。在此剪影内部及其周围，无缝融合来自该目的地的多种场景——标志性建筑、街道、桥梁、景观、当地交通、人物和氛围元素——营造出整座城市都存在于一个艺术构图中的感觉。

中央地标应使用分层摄影插图纹理、撕裂纸张边缘、细微的双重曝光、水墨纹理和复古印刷效果，部分溶解在周围的城市意象中。

在主构图周围加入几个较小的图形元素：

带有目的地特色的复古邮票
做旧的护照/旅行印章
旧行李标签
小型目的地地图碎片
街道标志

items.title: 纪念仪式感几何建筑海报设计

prompts.text: Create a geometric poster with a sense of memorial ceremony around any specific thematic content: organize the reading with a strong central axis, keeping about half of the frame as bright, relaxed light-colored white space with the thematic title suspended within it; enlarge the most recognizable short symbol of the theme into an overwhelming geometric bold visual anchor, making it step down from the white space into a perspective memorial platform built of multiple horizontal color blocks. The memorial platform expands step by step from a narrow top near the visual center downwards and extends beyond the boundaries, forming an upward-looking scale, stable center of gravity, and a top-to-bottom ritualistic reading path. The giant symbol and the platform share colors and vertical axes, appearing both as text and architecture, inseparable; the platform is layered with wide strip modules of adjacent light and dark, with clear edges for each layer, and soft dark bands partially pressing the seams to maintain the simplicity of flat vectors while creating a restrained step depth. The title uses upright, low-stroke-contrast Chinese sans-serif characters with medium-to-thick weight and relaxed letter spacing; the subtitle is thinner, smaller, with significantly widened letter spacing and centered line breaks; the giant symbol uses a heavy geometric skeleton, square ends, and compact internal space, becoming the first read from a distance. A minimalist light-colored silhouette emblem refined from the theme is embedded in the middle section of the platform, with slender dates or numbers arranged below it, followed by two lines of sparsely spaced short sentences to form a rhythmic pause; only low-contrast small signature information is kept at the corners and bottom edges, making peripheral information subordinate to the central memorial structure. All specific hues are determined by the theme's semantics, with no fixed color names preset: the brightest, lowest-saturation theme light color covers a large area of the background, while a deeper and high-saturation theme core color carries the giant symbol and the memorial platform. The core color progresses in homochromatic levels between the dark top, stable mid-tones, and brighter foreground; text uses a dark version of the core color or white-out from the background light color, with small-area high-brightness similar-color circles hanging on the edge of the platform, and another larger, paler circular light spot cropped from the edge of the white space to balance the hard geometry with a soft warm difference of no more than a small amount of area. The background presents high-brightness diffused light and fine paper fiber texture, with uniform particles spread over the light-colored areas, and thin spray-dot mist superimposed at the white space edges and color block boundaries; printed color blocks retain slight ink absorption and transparent overlapping colors, with outlines remaining flat and clear, without forming stains or strong damage. The foreground can have a simplified emblem derived from the theme sink into the platform in a low-transparency, large-scale, partially cropped manner, faintly appearing as if through a colored thin layer, enhancing depth without competing with the giant symbol. Ultimately maintain an area order of approximately half for the light-colored white space, nearly half for the giant symbol and perspective platform, and very few accents, making the overall effect bright, gentle yet solemn; if the giant symbol and the platform are separated, the peripheral information becomes heavy, the texture covers the outline, or decorations increase, this monumental cohesion will be destroyed.

prompts.text: 围绕任意具体主题内容建立具有纪念仪式感的几何海报：以强中轴组织阅读，让画面约一半保持明亮、松弛的浅色留白，主题标题悬置其间；将主题最具识别度的简短符号放大为压倒性的几何粗体视觉锚点，使它从留白区向下跨入一座由多个水平色块搭成的透视纪念台，纪念台由靠近视觉中心的窄顶向下逐级扩展并延伸出边界，形成仰望式尺度、稳定重心与由上至下的仪式性阅读路径。巨大符号与台体共享色彩和垂直轴线，既像文字又像建筑，二者不可分离；台体用明暗相邻的宽条模块分层，每层边缘清晰，局部以柔和暗带压住接缝，保持平面矢量的简练，同时产生克制的台阶深度。标题采用端正、低笔画反差的中文无衬线字，字重中等偏粗、字距舒展；副标题更细、更小、明显加宽字距并分行居中；巨大符号使用厚重几何骨架、方整端部与紧凑内部空间，成为远距离第一读。台体中段嵌入由主题提炼的极简浅色剪影徽记，其下排列纤细日期或编号，再以两行疏朗短句形成节奏停顿；角落与底缘只保留低对比的小型署名信息，使外围信息服从中央纪念结构。由主题语义决定全部具体色相，不预设固定色名：最亮、最低饱和的主题浅色承担大面积背景，较深且高饱和的主题核心色承担巨大符号与纪念台，核心色在暗顶、稳定中间调和更明亮前景之间作同色系层级递进；文字使用核心色的深色版本或背景浅色反白，小面积高明度近似色圆形点缀悬于台体边缘，另一枚更大、更淡的圆形光斑从留白边缘被裁切，以不超过少量面积的柔和暖差平衡硬朗几何。背景呈高明度漫射光与细密纸纤维触感，浅色区域铺均匀微粒，在留白边缘和色块交界叠加轻薄喷点云雾；印刷色块保留轻微吸墨与透明叠色，轮廓仍平整清楚，不形成污渍或强烈破损。前景可让主题派生的简化徽记以低透明度、大尺度、局部裁切的方式沉入台体，像透过彩色薄层隐约显现，增强纵深却不争夺巨大符号。最终保持浅色留白、巨大符号、透视台体约为半数、近半数与极少点缀的面积秩序，整体明亮温和而庄重；若巨大符号与台体分家、外围信息变重、纹理覆盖轮廓或装饰增多，都会破坏这份纪念碑式凝聚力。
