items.title: AURELIS顶级豪宅室内设计展示海报

prompts.text:
Create a world-class multi-page real estate interior sales presentation poster for a self-created premium property design brand called "AURELIS LIVING STUDIO", designed as a flagship editorial overview board that merges Orbit-level page alignment precision, Transit-level developer system standardization, and Port-level proposal-book completeness. The image must fully preserve the exact structural logic, modular 3x3 page rhythm, white-margin brochure layout, and mixed-content hierarchy of a luxury interior presentation board: a 3x3 grid of nine vertically oriented page-like panels, each functioning as one page from a high-end developer’s official interior sales booklet, combining photoreal room renders, concept pages, floor-plan graphics, inspiration boards, furniture specification layouts, and material palette pages. The final board must feel like an international real estate company’s official multi-page interior proposal system, highly architectural, editorial, globally polished, and commercially premium.

Core composition:
Use a tall vertical presentation composed of nine evenly spaced brochure-style pages arranged in a strict 3x3 grid. Each page must feel like an individual spread from the same official developer design package, but all nine pages must share one fully unified brand system: identical margins, page proportions, typography hierarchy, white-space logic, caption style, and color palette. Preserve the exact visual logic of alternating page types: strategy page, hero render, technical plan page, styling page, inspiration collage, lighting detail page, furniture selection sheet, second hero render, and material board. The board must read as a complete developer brochure overview wall rather than a random collage.

Orbit-level precision:
Push the page-to-page consistency to an extremely high standard. Make all outer margins, inter-page spacing, page-number positions, headline baselines, image crop ratios, and internal white borders feel nearly publication-perfect. The second and eighth pages, as the major hero interior visuals, should carry stronger impact while still remaining proportionally aligned with the rest of the system. The board must feel art-directed at a luxury editorial level, with exact spacing and disciplined visual rhythm.

Transit-level system standardization:
Transform the multi-page set into a believable mature developer sales system. Standardize internal metadata and page-language fields using elegant English labels such as:
Project Name
Space Type
Design Package
Ref Code
Page No.
These should appear consistently where appropriate across concept, furniture, material, and technical pages. Typography hierarchy, caption system, page numbering, module naming, and page layout logic must all feel globally professional and developer-grade.

Port-level proposal-book completeness:
Elevate the board into a true overview of an international developer’s interior manual. Add a more complete naming structure across the nine pages, as if each page belongs to a coherent proposal book:
- Client Vision
- Signature Lounge
- Concept Plan
- Styling Language
- Inspiration Board
- Lighting Details
- Furniture Selection
- Living Atmosphere
- Material Board
The whole poster should feel like the opening visual summary of a full interior proposal package for a premium real estate project.

Page system:
Page 1:
CLIENT VISION page with small subheads, structured briefing text, and one refined preview image.
Page 2:
SIGNATURE LOUNGE hero page with a premium armchair, fireplace or feature wall, vertical wood slats, marble, and warm daylight.
Page 3:
CONCEPT PLAN page with a clean floor plan in the upper area and elegant explanatory copy below.
Page 4:
STYLING LANGUAGE page featuring sculptural decor, a console, vase, wood slats, and one editorial quote.
Page 5:
INSPIRATION BOARD page with a clean collage of multiple small interior images.
Page 6:
LIGHTING DETAILS page with cabinetry close-up, integrated light glow, fixture references, and supporting copy.
Page 7:
FURNITURE SELECTION page with product silhouettes, coded items, and a room-based selection list.
Page 8:
LIVING ATMOSPHERE hero page with a premium soft-seating living room scene and one quote-based title treatment.
Page 9:
MATERIAL BOARD page with neatly labeled swatches for wood, stone, textile, and surface finishes.

Interior language:
All room imagery must feature globally premium warm-minimal interiors: soft ivory and greige walls, warm walnut or smoked oak paneling, pale marble, refined upholstery, sculptural lounge seating, elegant tables, restrained styling objects, concealed lighting, and quiet editorial composition. The spaces should feel highly realistic, luxurious, calm, and show-unit ready.

Photoreal realism:
Render all interior images with master-level realism: matte plaster walls, realistic wood grain, subtle stone veining, tactile fabric texture, clean joinery, soft daylight dust, refined reflections, premium contact shadows, and de-AI surface control. The brochure pages must feel printed, believable, and architecturally serious.

Graphic and editorial system:
Use only English text. Typography must feel architectural, editorial, restrained, and globally premium. Use clean modern sans-serif for informational content and, where helpful, a refined serif or elegant display treatment for quotes and hero emphasis. Add consistent page numbering such as 1/9, 2/9, 3/9, etc. Include standardized metadata lines such as:
Project Name: Aurelis Residence Collection
Space Type: Living Room / Bedroom / Main Bathroom
Design Package: Interior Signature Series
Ref Code: ALS-INT-09
All page headers and metadata must feel clean, mature, and highly consistent.

Technical and specification pages:
The floor-plan page must use crisp thin-line architectural drafting. The furniture selection page must use organized icons or miniature visuals with concise labels. The material board must use disciplined swatch alignment and finish naming. These technical pages must feel like real developer presentation sheets, not decorative inserts.

Brand presentation:
Integrate a minimal official logo for AURELIS LIVING STUDIO and subtle system language across the set. The poster must feel like a branded developer proposal overview, not a generic design magazine. Add restrained collection naming and page metadata so the entire board feels authentic and complete.

Lighting:
Use extremely soft architectural daylight with warm neutral tonality, subtle ambient glow, refined cove lighting, and gentle shadow falloff. Every page image must feel luminous, calm, and premium. Avoid harsh contrast, muddy shadows, and visual noise.

Color direction:
Use a cohesive palette of warm white, ivory, soft greige, taupe, walnut brown, pale marble gray, muted sand, and soft charcoal accents. Keep the entire multi-page system tightly unified and sophisticated.

Commercial goal:
The final artwork must feel like an award-level international real estate interior multi-page sales presentation: editorial, highly architectural, globally polished, system-complete, materially rich, and commercially persuasive. Preserve the exact multi-page grid brochure logic while elevating it into a more precise, more standardized, and more complete official developer interior proposal overview.

Negative prompt:
messy brochure layout, inconsistent page sizes, random typography, cheap catalog look, cluttered furniture, harsh shadows, dark muddy interiors, low-resolution pages, generic stock interiors, noisy image, plastic materials, distorted perspective, overcrowded text, bad margins, chaotic mood board, cheap rendering

prompts.text:
为名为 "AURELIS LIVING STUDIO" 的自创高级物业设计品牌创建一个世界级的多页房地产室内销售演示海报，设计为旗舰级的编辑总览板，融合了 Orbit 级的页面对齐精度、Transit 级的开发商系统标准化以及 Port 级的方案书完整性。图像必须完全保留豪华室内演示板的精确结构逻辑、模块化的 3x3 页面节奏、白边手册布局和混合内容的层次结构：一个由九块垂直定向的类页面面板组成的 3x3 网格，每一块都作为高端开发商官方室内销售手册中的一页，结合了逼真的房间渲染图、概念页、平面图、灵感板、家具规格布局和材质调色板页面。最终的展板必须感觉像是国际房地产公司的官方多页室内方案系统，具有高度的建筑感、编辑感、全球化磨合感和商业高级感。

核心构图：
使用高大的垂直演示，由九个均匀间隔的手册式页面组成，排列在严格的 3x3 网格中。每一页都必须感觉像是来自同一个官方开发商设计包的单独跨页，但所有九页必须共享一个完全统一的品牌系统：相同的边距、页面比例、排版层级、留白逻辑、标题风格和色调。保留交替页面类型的确切视觉逻辑：策略页、主渲染图、技术平面图页、造型页、灵感拼贴、照明细节页、家具选择表、第二张主渲染图和材质板。展板读起来必须是一个完整的开发商手册总览墙，而不是随机的拼贴。

Orbit 级的精度：
将页面间的连贯性推向极高标准。使所有外边距、页间距、页码位置、标题基线、图像裁剪比例和内部白边感觉几乎达到出版级的完美。作为主要的核心室内视觉效果，第二页和第八页应具有更强的冲击力，同时仍与系统的其余部分保持比例对齐。展板必须在豪华编辑水平上进行艺术指导，具有精确的间距和严谨的视觉节奏。

Transit 级的系统标准化：
将多页集合转变为可信的成熟开发商销售系统。使用优雅的英文标签标准化内部元数据和页面语言字段，例如：
Project Name
Space Type
Design Package
Ref Code
Page No.
这些应在概念、家具、材质和技术页面中适当且一致地出现。排版层级、标题系统、页码、模块命名和页面布局逻辑必须都感觉具有全球专业水平和开发商级别。

Port 级的方案书完整性：
将展板提升为国际开发商室内手册的真实总览。在九个页面中添加更完整的命名结构，仿佛每一页都属于一本连贯的方案书：
- Client Vision
- Signature Lounge
- Concept Plan
- Styling Language
- Inspiration Board
- Lighting Details
- Furniture Selection
- Living Atmosphere
- Material Board
整个海报应感觉像是高级房地产项目完整室内方案包的开篇视觉摘要。

页面系统：
第 1 页：
CLIENT VISION（客户愿景）页，带有小副标题、结构化的简报文本和一张精选的预览图。
第 2 页：
SIGNATURE LOUNGE（标志性休息室）主页，配有高级扶手椅、壁炉或特色墙、垂直木条、大理石和温暖的日光。
第 3 页：
CONCEPT PLAN（概念平面图）页，上方为整洁的平面图，下方为优雅的说明文字。
第 4 页：
STYLING LANGUAGE（造型语言）页，包含雕塑感装饰、玄关柜、花瓶、木条和一段编辑语录。
第 5 页：
INSPIRATION BOARD（灵感板）页，由多张室内小图组成的整洁拼贴。
第 6 页：
LIGHTING DETAILS（照明细节）页，包含橱柜特写、集成灯光效果、灯具参考和支持性文字。
第 7 页：
FURNITURE SELECTION（家具选择）页，带有产品轮廓、编号单品和基于房间的选择列表。
第 8 页：
LIVING ATMOSPHERE（生活氛围）主页，带有高级软座起居室场景和基于语录的标题处理。
第 9 页：
MATERIAL BOARD（材质板）页，带有整齐标注的木材、石材、纺织品和表面处理样板。

室内语言：
所有房间图像必须采用全球领先的高级温暖极简主义室内设计：柔软的象牙色和灰褐色墙壁、温暖的胡桃木或熏橡木镶板、浅色大理石、精制的内饰、雕塑感休息区座椅、优雅的桌子、克制的装饰物、隐藏式照明和安静的编辑构图。空间应感觉高度写实、豪华、沉静且具备样板间水准。

逼真的写实主义：
以大师级的写实度渲染所有室内图像：哑光石灰墙、真实的木纹、细微的石材纹理、触感织物纹理、整洁的木作、柔和的日光尘埃、精制的反射、高级的接触阴影和去 AI 化的表面控制。手册页面必须感觉是印刷出来的、可信的且具有严谨的建筑感。

平面与编辑系统：
仅使用英文文本。排版必须感觉具有建筑感、编辑感、克制感且具有全球高级感。对信息内容使用整洁的现代无衬线字体，并在有帮助的地方，对语录和核心强调使用精制的衬线体或优雅的展示性处理。添加一致的页码，如 1/9、2/9、3/9 等。包含标准化的元数据行，如：
Project Name: Aurelis Residence Collection
Space Type: Living Room / Bedroom / Main Bathroom
Design Package: Interior Signature Series
Ref Code: ALS-INT-09
所有页眉和元数据必须感觉整洁、成熟且高度一致。

技术与规格页：
平面图页必须使用清晰的细线建筑绘图。家具选择页必须使用有条理的图标或缩微视觉效果，并配有简洁的标签。材质板必须使用规范的样板排列和饰面命名。这些技术页面必须感觉像真实的开发商演示表，而不是装饰性的嵌入物。

品牌展示：
整合 AURELIS LIVING STUDIO 的极简官方标志，并在整套设计中融入细微的系统语言。海报必须感觉像是有品牌的开发商方案总览，而不是通用的设计杂志。添加克制的系列命名和页面元数据，使整个展板感觉真实且完整。

光照：
使用极柔和的建筑日光，具有温暖的中性色调、细微的环境辉光、精制的灯槽照明和柔和的阴影衰减。每个页面的图像必须感觉明亮、宁静且高级。避免强烈的对比、混浊的阴影和视觉噪点。

色彩方向：
使用由暖白色、象牙色、柔软的灰褐色、灰褐色、胡桃棕色、浅大理石灰色、柔和的沙色和柔软的炭黑点缀组成的统一调色板。保持整个多页系统高度统一且考究。

商业目标：
最终艺术品必须感觉像是获奖级的国际房地产室内多页销售演示：编辑感、高度建筑感、全球化磨合、系统完整、材质丰富且具有商业说服力。保留精确的多页网格手册逻辑，同时将其提升为更精确、更标准化、更完整的官方开发商室内方案总览。

负面提示词：
杂乱的手册布局、不一致的页面大小、随机的排版、廉价的目录感、拥挤的家具、生硬的阴影、昏暗混浊的室内、低分辨率页面、通用的素材库室内、有噪点的图像、塑料材质、扭曲的透视、过于拥挤的文本、糟糕的边距、混乱的情绪板、廉价的渲染。

prompts.text:
9:16 vertical version, modern oriental female dreamscape 3D papercut art, modern oriental papercut art, layered paper cut illustration, dimensional paper sculpture, intricate paper carving, paper diorama, layered shadow box, poetic female dreamscape, contemporary oriental art poster.

The theme of the work is "She re-embraces her childhood self." The core narrative of the scene is: a woman in a dreamscape paper art garden sees a tiny paper light and shadow symbolizing childhood memories; she opens her arms to catch that part of her forgotten self and begins to truly heal her heart.

The main subject is an Oriental adult female with a visual age of approximately 25 years old, quiet and healing, gentle and firm, with the softness of maturity. The character has a beautiful round oval face, clear almond eyes with a slight glimmer of tears, a relieved and gentle expression, and a very slight sense of comfort at the corners of the mouth. The face adopts exquisite Oriental paper art illustration-style modeling, with clear and soft features, not real photography texture, not excessively cartoonish, and no plastic 3D feeling.

The character's hairstyle and headwear are: long black hair tied low, interspersed with pearl-white small flowers and tiny star fragments, with soft paper ribbon curves extending from the ends of the hair. The headwear is exquisite and light, not complex or heavy, not like a palace drama crown. The hair is composed of soft paper ribbons, fine hollowed-out hair strands, and light paper curves, unified with the overall paper art world.

The clothing design is: cream-white and light peach-pink paper art long dress, the skirt hem adopts layers of petals and arc-shaped paper pieces, and the cuffs have fine flower branch hollow patterns. The clothing is composed of multiple layers of paper-cut pieces, petal-shaped paper pieces, arc-shaped paper sculpture structures, and light paper layers, where clear layered hemlines, paper creases, cut edges, paper thickness, fiber texture, and extremely detailed hollow patterns can be seen, overall presenting a high-completion handcrafted paper sculpture formal dress effect.

The dreamscape unfolds through paper art screens. Gardens, flower vines, stars, clouds, glowing seeds, and paper boats appear in the scene. All flowers, plants, clouds, paper boats, and decorative elements adopt a unified paper-cut and 3D paper sculpture language, not realistic plants, nor ordinary flat illustration decorations, but uniformly existing in the same exquisite paper art world.

The overall paper-cut structure adopts a multi-layered stage style. The character is located in the center-bottom, bending slightly in front of the unfolded paper art screen, arms gently opened forward, with a warm glowing paper shadow floating in front. This glowing paper shadow is expressed as a tiny paper art light and shadow outline symbolizing childhood memories, not a physical child, not a second character, but a gentle, light, translucent tiny dream image composed of light and paper. The character's gaze is lowered, looking gently at this glowing paper shadow, with a soft and natural body posture, expressing the emotion of re-embracing oneself, comforting oneself, and catching the past. Surrounding flower vines and paper boats circle to create a sense of envelopment. The image has a clear foreground paper layer, subject character paper layer, middle-ground screen paper layer, and background dreamscape paper layer, with clear foreground-background relationships and complete spatial hierarchy.

The overall color scheme is: peach pink, warm white, champagne gold as main colors, with a small amount of turquoise accents. Warm white and cream white are used as the base colors, peach pink is used for the character's skirt, flowers, and dreamscape atmosphere, champagne gold is used for light, partial patterns, and detail accents, and turquoise only appears in leaves, water surfaces, or small areas of plant decoration. Different paper layers retain their own clear and pure colors, the colors are warm, clear, bright, and dreamy, not grayish, not dirty yellow, not overall orange-leaning, and no unified filter coverage.

prompts.text:
Theme:
A smile given to the water splashes

Subject:
A full-body portrait of a young woman in cyan-white swimwear splashing water forward with both hands in the shallow area of a sunny beach. Place the figure in the center of the frame, overlaying large water droplets and curved splashes in the foreground, with waves in the background.

Character · Expression:
A small oval face facing directly forward, with slender brown eyes and gaze directed at the camera. Thin eyebrows, a small nose, and rounded coral lips wide open, showing white teeth in a smile. Bright, moist skin with extremely light makeup. A short dark brown bob along the jawline with thin bangs, and wet hair tips splashing to the left and right.

Clothing · Pose:
A spaghetti strap triangle bikini with a light blue floral pattern on a white base fabric. A pair of matching translucent short ruffled shorts is layered at the waist, tied with thin cord bows on the left and right sides. Both arms are stretched forward at chest height, with both palms placed side-by-side facing upward, scooping up splashes and throwing them toward the camera.

Background · Light:
In the center background are the blue ocean and white breaking waves, with a light blue sky above, and highly transparent shallow seawater distributed in the lower half. Bright direct sunlight shining from above illuminates the moist skin, swimwear, and water droplets, forming sharp white reflections on the splashing water.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 2:3. The lens uses a horizontal perspective near the character's waist height, capturing a medium-full shot from the top of the head to the mid-thigh. The face is placed in the center of the upper half, the extended arms are in the large foreground of the frame, and the water arc unfolds overall from the top-left. Focus on the face and arms, with only a slight blurring of the waves.

Texture · Style:
High-definition realistic photography with a fresh emphasis on cyan and white. Realistically depicts natural moist skin, short hair bundles, thin swimwear fabric, transparent water droplets and their refraction, and foaming waves.

Negative Prompt:
Significantly changing facial features; do not omit foreground splashes.

prompts.text: 2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 unusual classic cars that were real: INPUT ::= [PRODUCT]  STEP_1 :: infer the components - every part or ingredient, separated and identified - the assembly order — components arrayed the way they combine - what is structural, what is active, what is the secret inside - the single element that reveals how it works  STEP_2 :: infer the suspension - each component floating in its own plane, held in zero gravity - the constellation logic: exploded along one clean axis, or orbiting a centre - spacing that reads as deliberate, never scattered - the hero element largest and forward, the rest receding  STEP_3 :: infer the reveal story - what's inside / how it's made / what it's made of - the cutaway or cross-sectioned component that proves the claim - raw ingredients rendered as beautifully as the finished product  STEP_4 :: infer ground and air - seamless background, one hue, the components as the only subjects - soft directional light unifying every floating element - each piece casting an honest soft shadow despite hanging in air  STEP_5 :: render spec - focus-stacked so every suspended element is sharp - studio product lighting, controlled reflections on each part - forbidden: visible wires, inconsistent scale, parts lit differently - material honesty on every component, raw and finished alike

prompts.text: 2x2网格，16:9，为4辆真实的非同寻常的经典车执行此操作：输入 ::= [产品] 步骤_1 :: 推断组件 - 每一个分离并识别的零件或成分 - 组装顺序 — 组件按照它们结合的方式排列 - 什么是结构的，什么是活跃的，什么是内部的秘密 - 揭示其工作原理的单一元素 步骤_2 :: 推断悬浮 - 每个组件漂浮在自己的平面上，保持在零重力状态 - 星座逻辑：沿一个干净的轴线爆炸，或围绕中心旋转 - 读起来是刻意而非散乱的间距 - 核心元素最大且位于前方，其余部分后退 步骤_3 :: 推断揭晓故事 - 内部是什么 / 它是如何制造的 / 它是由什么制成的 - 证明这一主张的切面或横截面组件 - 原材料的渲染与成品一样精美 步骤_4 :: 推断地面和空气 - 无缝背景，单一色调，组件作为唯一的主体 - 柔和的定向光统一每个悬浮元素 - 尽管悬浮在空中，每件物品都投射出真实的柔和阴影 步骤_5 :: 渲染规格 - 景深合成，使每个悬浮元素都清晰锐利 - 影棚产品照明，每个部分都有受控的反光 - 禁用：可见的电线、比例不一致、光照不同的零件 - 每个组件的材质真实感，无论是原材料还是成品都一视同仁

[Character's Pose and Expression] 

Pose and Composition: A knee-up (Knee shot) composition capturing a coexistence of a sense of movement and a lazy atmosphere.

Right hand placed under the chin, fingers lightly biting the lip, head slightly tilted, gazing straight at the camera. Left hand hanging naturally, wearing white over-the-knee socks below the knees. Toes pointed to emphasize leg lines. The character is sitting completely sideways. 

Expression: A provocative yet lazy mysterious gaze staring at the camera. Lips slightly parted, and the posture of fingers lightly biting is both charming and evokes a deep sense of narrative. 

[Character Clothing and Props] 

Clothing: A sporty set pairing a black crop top (black base with white trim) and high-waisted shorts (black base with white trim). Wearing white long socks, with a fine chain bracelet on the right wrist. 

Props: Various props arranged in the surrounding environment to maximize the vintage atmosphere. 

On the storage cabinet: A transparent glass jar filled with cookies, liquor bottles, a green bottle, black props, etc., are placed. 

Wall: Several vintage posters and prints like The Clash are arranged in a seemingly messy way. 

Under the storage cabinet: A guitar head and neck, and a green plastic box are placed there. 

Top right: Brown wooden shutters serve as the background. 

[Character Hairstyle and Makeup Details] 

Hairstyle: Deep black long hair. Naturally messy and voluminous wave styling, giving a feeling of being blown by the wind. Strands of hair surround the face. 

Makeup: A smoky yet natural beauty look. Characterized by brown-smudged gradient eye makeup and clear eyeliner. Peach blush lightly applied to the cheeks. Lips finished with a nude pink tone matte finish. 

[Lighting and Light Direction] 

Light Source: Soft indoor diffused lighting shining from the front and left side of the character. 

Effect: Forms natural shadows to three-dimensionally express the character's facial features and figure. Light seeping through the gaps of the wooden shutters on the wall creates a warm vintage atmosphere. The overall tone is calm and warm. 

[Texture and Tone Atmosphere] 

Color: A warm and dark tone atmosphere blending the deep brown of the storage cabinet, wooden shutters, and the faded tones of vintage posters. The black and white contrast of the clothing forms a sharp contrast with the white long socks. 

Texture: The wooden texture of the storage cabinet, the wood and metal texture of the guitar, the smooth texture of glass bottles, the fabric texture of clothing, and the faded paper texture of vintage posters are layered to create a deep vintage atmosphere. Fine film grain is added to give a cinematic feel. 

[Film and Camera Lens Depth of Field, Angle] 

Composition and Angle: A front horizontal composition parallel to the character's eye level. Due to the knee shot composition, the character's pose and surrounding props are harmoniously arranged. 

Features: Utilizing the shallow depth of field of a 35mm film camera. The character and adjacent props (glass jar, liquor bottle) are in sharp focus, while the vintage posters and wooden shutters in the back are softly blurred to concentrate the gaze on the character. 

[Background and Studio Layout Elements] 

Space: A vintage indoor studio background that excludes unnecessary interior design, ensuring the gaze is 100% immersed in the character's unique prop styling and vintage atmosphere. 

Details: Behind the character is a low-key deep brown/tan toned semi-plastered stone texture wall with traces of age, merging with vintage posters to support a warm sense of depth.

prompts.text:
A photorealistic natural photo of a completely fictional 20-year-old adult Japanese woman, clearly adult, in a tasteful clean gravure style with an elegant subtle sensual mood.

She is standing close to a wooden pillar inside a bright airy room filled with natural daylight. One side of her body leans lightly against the wooden pillar in a relaxed natural posture. Both arms are raised above and slightly behind her head, elbows naturally bent, opening the shoulders and elongating the upper body. Her torso is turned gently in a three-quarter angle, creating a graceful body line through the waist, chest, neck, and face. She looks directly toward the camera with a warm bright smile, relaxed approachable expression, and natural candid off-shot mood.

She has a Japanese idol-like cute face with a soft oval face shape, a gentle jawline, natural facial asymmetry, medium-sized dark-brown almond-shaped eyes, soft straight brows, a slim delicate nose, natural pink lips, and a healthy soft blush. Her short dark-brown bob haircut has slightly tousled ends, with thin airy bangs falling lightly over the forehead. Her appearance is fresh, feminine, realistic, and not overly perfect. Preserve realistic skin texture, visible pores, slight imperfections, subtle unevenness, and natural skin tone variation. No plastic skin.

She is wearing a refined light-blue bikini top with a delicate small floral print or a soft watercolor flower motif, clearly non-striped, elegant, feminine, clean, and tasteful. The bikini top has thin shoulder straps, realistic fabric texture, subtle wrinkles, and natural fabric tension. Her body has a healthy natural shape, a smooth natural waistline, and a naturally full soft bust expressed through believable weight, natural gravity, natural roundness, and smooth anatomical transitions into the torso, without exaggerated cleavage or artificial lift.

EXTREME LOW-ANGLE CAMERA COMPOSITION:
Use a very strong, dramatic, but tasteful low-angle perspective. The smartphone camera is positioned extremely low, almost at the level of her upper hips or slightly below, around 15–25 cm above the floor, and very close to the subject. The lens is aimed steeply upward toward her torso, chest, shoulders, neck, face, raised arms, and the bright ceiling area.

Vertical 9:16 composition. Use a natural smartphone wide-angle lens, approximately 22–24 mm equivalent. Create strong but believable foreshortening and an extreme foreground-to-background scale difference. The lower torso and upper waist should appear slightly larger in the foreground, while the bikini top, chest, collarbones, neck, face, and raised arms rise dramatically upward through the frame. Her face should appear in the upper third of the image, clearly looking downward toward the low camera position.

The viewer’s eye should travel naturally from:
foreground waist and lower torso → bikini top and chest → collarbones and shoulders → neck and jawline → smiling face → raised arms → wooden pillar, bright windows, and ceiling lines above.

The camera must feel much lower than usual, as if a friend is holding a smartphone from near floor level and pointing it upward from close range. The perspective should feel bold, immersive, and visually striking, but still elegant and non-voyeuristic.

FRAMING:
Tight upper-body vertical composition from just below the upper waist to slightly above the head. Do not show the full body. Keep the framing intimate and upper-body dominant. The torso should fill much of the lower half of the image, while the face and raised arms occupy the upper half. Allow the arms to create a strong framing shape around the face.

BACKGROUND:
A bright airy indoor natural-light setting with large windows in the background, softly blurred window frames, faint greenery visible outside, and the wooden pillar clearly visible beside her. Because of the strong low angle, show more of the upward architectural lines, including the vertical pillar and upper window structure, to emphasize the dramatic perspective. The background should remain softly out of focus.

LIGHTING:
Soft daylight streaming in from large windows, creating bright but gentle illumination. Use natural, flattering light with restrained highlights on the cheeks, nose bridge, collarbones, shoulders, upper chest, and arms. Preserve soft shadows beneath the arms, around the torso, and along the side of the body. Keep the skin naturally matte with a faint healthy glow.

STYLE / IMAGE QUALITY:
Photorealistic natural photography, high-end editorial gravure feeling, elegant and clean, natural candid off-shot style, shallow depth of field, soft background blur, realistic fabric texture, realistic pores, subtle handheld realism, slight HDR, authentic indoor daylight, classy understated sexiness.

Avoid: eye-level angle, flat composition, full-body framing, distant shot, exaggerated anatomy, extreme cleavage, transparent fabric, vulgar posing, plastic skin, over-retouching, artificial symmetry, CGI appearance, anime style, fisheye distortion, deformed hands, giant arms, giant chest, watermark, logo, readable text.

prompts.text:
一张完全虚构的20岁成年日本女性的写实自然照片，显然是成年人，具有大方干净的写真风格，带有优雅微妙的感官氛围。

她站在一个充满自然日光的明亮通风的房间里的木柱旁。她身体的一侧轻微地倚靠在木柱上，姿势自然放松。双臂抬起并略微置于脑后，肘部自然弯曲，打开肩膀并拉长上身。她的躯干轻轻转动，呈四分之三角度，通过腰部、胸部、颈部和面部勾勒出优美的身体线条。她带着温暖灿烂的微笑直视镜头，表情轻松可亲，具有自然的抓拍氛围。

她有一张像日本偶像一样可爱的脸，柔和的鹅蛋脸型，柔和的下颌线，自然的面部不对称，中等大小的深褐色杏仁眼，柔软的直眉，纤细精致的鼻子，自然的粉色嘴唇和健康的红晕。她的深褐色短波波头修剪得稍显蓬松，轻薄的空气刘海垂在额头。她的外表清新、柔美、真实，并非过于完美。保留真实的皮肤纹理、可见的毛孔、细微的瑕疵、微妙的不均匀和自然的肤色变化。没有塑料感的皮肤。

她穿着一件精致的浅蓝色比基尼上衣，带有精致的小碎花图案或柔和的水彩花卉图案，明确为非条纹，优雅、柔美、干净且大方。比基尼上衣有细肩带，真实的织物纹理，细微的褶皱和自然的织物张力。她的身体具有健康的自然形态，平滑的自然腰线，以及通过可信的重量、自然重力、自然圆润度以及与躯干的平滑解剖学过渡表现出的自然丰满柔软的胸部，没有夸张的乳沟或人造的提升感。

极低角度镜头构图：
使用非常强烈、戏剧化但大方的低角度透视。智能手机镜头的位置极低，几乎与她的上臀部齐平或略低，距地面约 15–25 厘米，且非常靠近拍摄对象。镜头陡峭地向上对准她的躯干、胸部、肩膀、颈部、脸部、抬起的双臂和明亮的天花板区域。

纵向 9:16 构图。使用自然的智能手机广角镜头，约 22–24 毫米等效焦距。创造强烈但可信的透视缩短和极端的远近比例差异。下躯干和上腰部在前景中应显得略大，而比基尼上衣、胸部、锁骨、颈部、面部和抬起的双臂则在画框中剧烈向上延伸。她的脸应出现在图像的上三分之一处，清楚地向下注视着较低的摄像机位置。

观众的视线应自然地从以下路径移动：
前景腰部和下躯干 → 比基尼上衣和胸部 → 锁骨和肩膀 → 颈部和下颌线 → 微笑的面孔 → 抬起的双臂 → 上方的木柱、明亮的窗户和天花板线条。

相机必须感觉比平时低得多，就像朋友在靠近地面的地方拿着智能手机并从近距离向上指着一样。透视感应大胆、沉浸且视觉冲击力强，但依然优雅且非窥视感。

取景：
从上腰部下方到头顶上方的紧凑上身垂直构图。不要显示全身。保持取景亲密且以上半身为中心。躯干应占据图像下半部分的大部分，而脸部和抬起的双臂占据上半部分。让手臂在脸部周围形成强烈的框架形状。

背景：
明亮通风的室内自然光环境，背景有大窗户，窗框柔和模糊，室外隐约可见绿植，身旁的木柱清晰可见。由于强烈的低角度，显示更多向上的建筑线条，包括垂直的柱子和上方的窗户结构，以强调戏剧性的透视感。背景应保持柔和的焦外效果。

光照：
从大窗户射入的柔和日光，创造出明亮而温和的照明。使用自然、讨人喜欢的光线，在脸颊、鼻梁、锁骨、肩膀、上胸部和手臂上保留克制的高光。在手臂下方、躯干周围和身体侧面保留柔和的阴影。保持皮肤自然哑光，带有淡淡的健康光泽。

风格 / 图像质量：
写实自然摄影，高端编辑写真感，优雅干净，自然抓拍风格，浅景深，柔和的背景虚化，真实的织物纹理，真实的毛孔，微妙的手持真实感，轻微的 HDR，真实的室内日光，高雅含蓄的性感。

避免：眼平角度，平坦的构图，全身取景，远摄，夸张的解剖结构，极端的乳沟，透明织物，粗俗的姿势，塑料皮肤，过度修饰，人造的对称，CGI 外观，动漫风格，鱼眼畸变，畸形的手，巨大的手臂，巨大的胸部，水印，标志，可读文本。

items.title: 黑色网眼猫咪Y2K另类街头时尚

prompts.text:
Black-based Y2K alternative street fashion merging cute and cool. Primarily black, with low-key silver hardware. Not heavy punk clothing or cosplay, but endowed with a sense of lightness and transparency that works on the street. Not lingerie style or underwear style.

【Top】
Using delicate and thin black fashion mesh fabric to make a compact bandeau-style top. No shoulder straps, backless strings, or straps. Covering the chest with a nearly horizontal line, not a simple tube, but a three-dimensional structure that naturally fits the body. Do not use thick leather, latex, PVC, or vinyl materials. A small silver ring is placed in the center, with a thin and light material, slightly larger black decorative ribbon attached below it. No fabric added below the ribbon. No longitudinal fabric, triangular cloth, front piece, hanging cloth, or additional panels covering the abdomen. No corsets, bustiers, bodysuits, or long tops. Instead of layering garters as separate pieces, thin black faux-leather-style details are used as the top edge, bottom edge, and left and right outer piping of the bandeau top, integrated together. No straps extending to the upper chest or shoulders. Small silver rings, buckles, rivets, etc., are kept to a minimum.

【Cat Theme】
On the inside of the chest part of the top, place one black cat-face shaped silhouette independently on the left and right. Not connected in the center, do not place one large cat. Only a textureless black outline of a rounded cat face with two short triangular ears. No cat body, neck, limbs, tail, eyes, nose, mouth, or whiskers. Size is small to medium, leaving mesh space around it. Not patches on the surface of the mesh, but thin and non-transparent panels sewn tightly to the inside. No thick appliques or 3D decorations.

【Outerwear】
Black or dark charcoal gray, transparent organza or chiffon ultra-short top. An open-front short bolero or short shrug that only lightly covers the shoulders and upper chest. Does not block the cat silhouettes, central ring, and decorative ribbon of the top. The sleeves are transparent long puff sleeves that swell moderately from the shoulder to the upper arm. Naturally tapering from below the elbow to the wrist, with thin cuffs. No giant balloon sleeves, excessive ruffles, or princess style.

【Bottoms】
Black low-waist asymmetrical wrap mini skirt. No culottes, skorts, or integrated shorts. A clear one-piece wrap skirt with fabric overlapping diagonally from one side to the opposite side. The embedding of the inner fabric is kept short, creating a slit-like opening on one side, allowing the structure to naturally reveal the thigh slightly when walking. No crotch piece, pant-type seams, or short hems. The hem is asymmetrical, slightly shorter on one side. Material is matte soft black fabric. A thin black belt, small silver rings, short chains, thin hanging straps, and small cat-shaped charms are discreetly added to the waist.

【Legs/Shoes】
Thin and naturally transparent black ultra-high-thigh tight stockings. Covering continuously from the toes to the mid-thigh on the left and right respectively. The upper end is not a loose garter, but a thin and flat black belt-style piping. No lace, embroidery, ruffles, or large ribbons. Feet are black slim-fit platform mid-calf boots. Square-ish toe, low-key silver hardware. Neck is paired with a thin black rivet-style choker.

【Overall Effect】
Combining the black mesh strapless bandeau top, left and right cat face silhouettes, central ring and decorative ribbon, integrated piping garters, transparent puff sleeve top, one-side slit low-waist wrap mini skirt, and ultra-high-thigh stockings. Dominated by black and silver, blending cute, cool, and Y2K-style lightness and transparency.

prompts.text:
以黑色为主调，融合可爱与酷感的Y2K另类街头时尚。
以黑色为主，金具使用低调的银色。不做沉重的朋克服装或cosplay，而是赋予能在街头成立的轻盈感和透明感。不做内衣风或内衣风格。

【上衣】
使用细腻轻薄的黑色时尚网眼面料，制作紧凑的班杜式上衣。
不加肩带、露背绳或肩带。
以接近水平的线条覆盖胸部，不是简单的筒状，而是自然贴合身体的立体结构。
不使用厚实的皮革、乳胶、PVC或乙烯基材质。

中央放置一个小型银环，其下方附上薄而轻的材质、稍大一些的黑色装饰缎带。
缎带下方不添加面料。不做纵长布料、三角布、前片、垂布或覆盖腹部的附加面板。
不做紧身胸衣、紧身背心、紧身连体衣或长上衣。

不将束带作为独立件叠加，而是将细黑色的仿皮革风细节作为班杜上衣的上缘、下缘及左右外侧的镶边，一体化处理。
不做延伸到胸上或肩部的肩带。
小型银环、扣环、铆钉等保持最小化。

【猫咪主题】
在上衣胸部内侧，左右独立放置一个黑色猫脸形状的轮廓各一个。
不连接中央，不放置一个大猫。
仅为圆润猫脸加上两个短三角耳的无纹理黑色轮廓。
不加猫的身体、脖子、四肢、尾巴、眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、胡须。
大小从小到中等，周围绕留网眼空白。
不是网眼表面的贴片，而是密着内侧缝制的薄而非透明面板。不做厚实的贴花或立体装饰。

【外套】
黑色或深烟灰色的、透明的欧根纱或雪纺制超短上衣。
仅轻覆肩部和胸上部的开襟短款波莱罗，或短款耸肩。
不遮挡上衣的猫轮廓、中央环和装饰缎带。

袖子是从肩部到上臂适度鼓起的透明感长袖泡泡袖。
从肘下到手腕自然收细，袖口做成细袖口。
不做巨大的气球袖、过度褶边或公主风。

【下装】
黑色的低腰不对称裹式迷你裙。
不做裙裤、裤裙或一体式短裤。
从一侧斜向对侧叠布的、明确的一片裹裙。
内侧面料的嵌入保持较短，在一侧制造类似开衩的开口，让走动时大腿自然稍露结构。
不做裆布、裤型接缝或短裤下摆。
下摆为一侧稍短的不对称。材质为哑光柔软的黑色布料。
腰部低调添加细黑腰带、小型银环、短链条、细垂带和小猫形吊饰。

【腿部·鞋子】
薄而自然透感的黑色超高筒紧身袜。
从脚尖到大腿中段，左右分别连续覆盖。
上端不是宽松的袜带，而是细而平坦的黑色腰带式镶边。
不加蕾丝、刺绣、褶边或大缎带。

脚部是黑色细身厚底中筒靴。鞋头偏方形，银色金具低调。
颈部配细黑铆钉式颈圈。

【整体效果】
组合黑色网眼无肩带班杜上衣、左右猫脸轮廓、中央环与装饰缎带、镶边一体式束带、透明泡泡袖上衣、一侧开衩低腰裹式迷你裙、超高筒紧身袜。
以黑银色为主，融合可爱、酷感，以及Y2K式的轻盈与透明感。

items.title: 马士基全球高端物流品牌视觉海报

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium Instagram social media campaign poster for Maersk that looks like an official global brand campaign designed by Pentagram, AKQA, or DesignStudio for Behance and Cannes Lions.

Aspect ratio 4:5 vertical, 8K ultra-high resolution, hyper-realistic commercial advertising, premium editorial composition, Scandinavian minimalist design language, bold corporate branding, clean visual hierarchy, generous negative space.

Scene: A massive modern Maersk logistics hub at sunrise. In the foreground, a pristine Maersk-blue electric container truck drives confidently toward the camera from a premium logistics terminal. The truck is loaded with an official Maersk shipping container featuring the authentic Maersk star logo and corporate blue livery. The vehicle is positioned in a dramatic front three-quarter perspective, becoming the visual hero of the composition.

Behind it, a state-of-the-art container terminal is alive with activity. Giant ship-to-shore cranes lift containers with precision, automated guided vehicles move seamlessly through the yard, and neatly stacked Maersk containers create a strong geometric rhythm. In the distance, an enormous Maersk container vessel is docked at the terminal with hundreds of containers onboard. Above the horizon, a modern cargo aircraft climbs into the sky, completing the end-to-end logistics story from sea to air.

Human presence adds life to the campaign: logistics managers in safety helmets reviewing operations on digital tablets, crane operators coordinating container movement, forklift operators transporting cargo, dock workers inspecting containers, all captured naturally without looking at the camera. Every action feels authentic, creating a living industrial ecosystem rather than a staged corporate photo.

The environment is clean, engineered and premium, inspired by Scandinavian industrial architecture with polished concrete, glass control towers, organized container stacks, calm ocean water, crisp blue skies and subtle atmospheric haze. The entire logistics hub feels efficient, sustainable and technologically advanced.

The composition is bold and highly graphic. Oversized white negative space balances the industrial scene. Massive editorial typography reading “MOVE THE WORLD.” integrates into the architecture, partially overlapping containers without hiding important subjects. Thin technical grid lines, subtle route graphics, coordinate markers and minimal logistics-inspired design elements reinforce Maersk's engineering precision. Large Maersk-blue geometric panels anchor the composition, creating a modern corporate visual system without clutter.

Colour palette: authentic Maersk Blue (#42B0D5), pure white, soft concrete grey, steel grey, deep ocean blue with restrained safety yellow accents. Scandinavian minimalism, clean contrast, premium corporate aesthetic.

Lighting: bright natural morning daylight, soft diffused sunlight, realistic reflections on painted metal, shipping containers, truck bodywork and glass architecture, crisp atmospheric depth, premium commercial automotive and industrial photography.

Captured on a Phase One XF IQ4 150MP medium-format camera with a Schneider Kreuznach 55mm lens, ultra-high dynamic range, razor-sharp details, realistic container textures, steel surfaces, tyre rubber, glass reflections, painted metal, subtle wear, authentic industrial materials, natural human skin texture and premium color science.

The final image should feel like the hero cover of a Behance case study for Maersk's global integrated logistics campaign—modern, bold, clean, highly designed, unmistakably premium, and instantly recognizable as an official Maersk social media advertisement.

prompts.text:
为马士基创作一张超高端的 Instagram 社交媒体活动海报，看起来就像是由 Pentagram、AKQA 或 DesignStudio 为 Behance 和戛纳狮子奖设计的官方全球品牌活动。

纵横比 4:5 垂直，8K 超高分辨率，超写实商业广告，高级编辑构图，斯堪的纳维亚极简主义设计语言，大胆的企业品牌推广，清晰的视觉层级，大量的留白。

场景：日出时分的一个巨大的现代马士基物流枢纽。在前景中，一辆崭新的马士基蓝色电动集装箱卡车从高级物流终端自信地驶向镜头。卡车装载着一个官方马士基海运集装箱，上面印有真实的马士基星星标志和企业蓝色涂装。车辆处于极具张力的前侧三四分透视位置，成为构图中的视觉主角。

在它身后，一个最先进的集装箱码头正繁忙运作。巨大的岸桥起重机精准地吊起集装箱，自动导引车在场站内无缝移动，整齐堆放的马士基集装箱营造出强烈的几何律动感。远处的码头停泊着一艘巨大的马士基集装箱船，船上装载着数百个集装箱。在地平线上方，一架现代货机冲向云霄，完成了从海洋到航空的端到端物流叙事。

人的存在为活动增添了生命力：戴着安全帽的物流经理在数字平板电脑上审查运营情况，起重机操作员协调集装箱移动，叉车驾驶员运输货物，码头工人检查集装箱，所有这些都是自然捕捉的，没有直视镜头。每个动作都显得真实，创造出一个生动的工业生态系统，而非摆拍的企业照片。

环境干净、工程化且高端，灵感来自斯堪的纳维亚工业建筑，拥有抛光混凝土、玻璃控制塔、有序的集装箱堆栈、平静的海水、清爽的蓝天和细微的大气雾霾。整个物流枢纽给人以高效、可持续和技术先进的感觉。

构图大胆且极具图形感。巨大的白色留白平衡了工业场景。印有“MOVE THE WORLD.”的大型编辑排版字体融入建筑之中，部分重叠在集装箱上，但没有遮挡重要主体。细致的技术网格线、微妙的路线图形、坐标标记和受物流启发的极简设计元素强化了马士基的工程精度。巨大的马士基蓝色几何面板固定了构图，创造出一种现代的企业视觉系统，且毫不杂乱。

调色板：真实的马士基蓝 (#42B0D5)、纯白、柔和的混凝土灰、钢灰、深海蓝以及克制的安全黄点缀。斯堪的纳维亚极简主义，清晰的对比，高端企业审美。

光照：明亮的自然晨光，柔和的漫射阳光，油漆金属、海运集装箱、卡车车身和玻璃建筑上的真实反射，清晰的大气深度，高端商业汽车和工业摄影。

由 Phase One XF IQ4 150MP 中画幅相机拍摄，搭配 Schneider Kreuznach 55mm 镜头，超高动态范围，锐利的细节，真实的集装箱纹理、钢铁表面、轮胎橡胶、玻璃反射、油漆金属、细微磨损、真实的工业材料、自然的皮肤纹理以及高端的色彩科学。

最终图像感觉应该像马士基全球综合物流活动在 Behance 上的案例研究主封面——现代、大胆、干净、设计精良、绝对高端，并且一眼就能认出是马士基官方社交媒体广告。

prompts.text:
[Cultivation Motto]: [Fill in a classic short sentence]
[Two-character Theme]: [Extracted from the short sentence]
[Core Meaning]: [Waiting / Self-reflection / Preserving Sincerity / Returning to the Origin, etc.]
[Main Material]: [Black metal / Cinnabar lacquer mirror / Blue and white porcelain / Raw wood / Glazed glass, etc.]
[Main Color System]: [Fill in 2–4 clear colors]
[Visual Metaphor]: [Opening / Contrast / Retention / Stripping / Return, etc.]
[Background Embossing]: [Internal structure / Reflection outline / Vessel shape lines / Annual rings, etc.]
[Location and Date]: [Fill in]

Generate a 9:16 vertical Oriental minimalist art poster, transforming the [Cultivation Motto] into a visual metaphor with a contemporary installation feel.

Use high-end handmade art paper with real fibers, indentations, and pulp particles as the background, maintaining large areas of white space, and add low-contrast bas-relief [Background Embossing] related to the theme. The embossing must participate in expressing meaning, looking restrained from afar and revealing details only upon close inspection.

The image features a [Main Material] with a clear outline, real volume, and material texture, expressing the [Core Meaning] through a [Visual Metaphor]. Add a tiny figure occupying about 1%–2% of the screen to establish a scale relationship between the giant object and the person.

Colors use the [Main Color System], which can be bold and vivid, but maintain a clear primary and secondary hierarchy. Let the color enter the space through glaze, cracks, reflections, flowing light, lacquer surfaces, or the interior of the material; do not be limited to black, white, and gray, and do not use cheap neon effects.

The main Chinese title uses the [Two-character Theme] in a modern Songti, Mincho, or sculpted serif font. Design sense can be added through letter spacing, displacement, curves, or short lines, but the Chinese characters must be complete, accurate, and clear.

Simultaneously include small-sized [Cultivation Motto], location, date, and a short English title. The overall presentation is a combination of Oriental cultivation, material art, contemporary installation, and high-end editorial posters.

items.title: 斯堪的纳维亚极简风格纪念邮票版张设计

prompts.text:
[DESTINATION] = [Destination]

Create a premium commemorative postage-stamp collection inspired by [DESTINATION], presented as a beautifully designed A4 vertical stamp sheet.

Create 7–9 individual stamps featuring a thoughtful mix of iconic landmarks, architecture, local food, transportation, nature, cultural objects, and small everyday symbols that uniquely evoke [DESTINATION].

All stamps must keep the same elegant 3:4 portrait proportion, but vary noticeably in physical size. Arrange them freely across the sheet with gentle asymmetry, visual rhythm, and comfortable white space — NOT a rigid grid.

STYLE

Premium Scandinavian minimalism with sophisticated contemporary postal design.

Simplify each subject into elegant geometric forms, clean silhouettes, restrained details, subtle graphic abstraction, and refined editorial composition.

Use a fresh but limited color palette inspired naturally by [DESTINATION].

Keep the background clean warm-white or pure white.

Avoid vintage sepia, excessive decoration, cartoonish illustration, photorealism, or generic tourist-poster aesthetics.

STAMPS

Every stamp must feel like a real collectible postage stamp:

• crisp perforated edges
• beautifully printed paper texture
• country or destination name
• authentic local currency symbol and realistic current postage denomination
• subtle, elegant typography
• one distinctive subject per stamp

Research and use plausible current local postage values and currency conventions for [DESTINATION].

Make every stamp visually different while maintaining one coherent art direction.

Mix bold architectural compositions, close-up objects, landscapes, food, transportation, flora, and charming local details.

PRESENTATION

Show the complete A4 vertical commemorative stamp sheet straight-on, like a premium limited-edition postal release photographed or scanned for a design archive.

The final result should feel exceptionally collectible, tactile, sophisticated, and physically believable — something so beautifully designed that the viewer would genuinely want to tear off and keep each stamp.

No rigid grid. No identical stamp sizes. No excessive empty space. No mockup frame. No hands. No envelopes. A4 vertical ratio.

prompts.text:
[DESTINATION] = [目的地]

所有邮票必须保持相同的优雅 3:4 纵向比例，但在物理尺寸上要有明显变化。在版面中自由排列，带有柔和的不对称感、视觉韵律和舒适的留白——而不是呆板的网格。

带有高级当代邮政设计的优质斯堪的纳维亚极简主义。

使用受 [DESTINATION] 自然启发的清新但有限的调色板。

避免复古棕褐色、过度的装饰、卡通插图、写实主义或平庸的旅游海报美学。

邮票

每枚邮票必须感觉像真实的收藏级邮票：

• 清晰的齿孔边缘
• 精美的纸张印刷质感

• 微妙、优雅的排版

研究并使用 [DESTINATION] 合理的当前本地邮资数值和货币惯例。

让每枚邮票在视觉上各不相同，同时保持统一的艺术方向。

混合大胆的建筑构图、特写物品、风景、食物、交通工具、植物和迷人的当地细节。

呈现

像为设计档案拍摄或扫描的高级限量版邮政发行物一样，正对着展示完整的 A4 纵向纪念邮票版张。

无呆板网格。无相同的邮票尺寸。无过多的空白空间。无样机框架。无手。无信封。A4 纵向比例。

items.title: 留有天空的海滩比基尼人像

prompts.text:
Theme:
Beach with Sky Space

Subject:
Against a cloudless blue sky and a calm sea, a young woman dressed in an off-white bikini top and a waist wrap stands on a beach. Position the character in the lower half of the frame, leaving a vast sky space above the head that exceeds the character's height. A wooden boardwalk extending from the bottom left corner crosses the horizon at a low level.

Character · Expression:
A slightly oval face tilted towards the right side of the frame, with large brown almond-shaped eyes looking directly ahead. Thin eyebrows gently curved into an arch, a small straight bridge of the nose, and well-defined rose pink lips with a reserved smile. Bright skin tone, faint eyeliner, and a soft blush on the cheeks. Chest-length brown hair with sparse wispy bangs and long strands around the face, soft waves spreading outwards in the sea breeze.

Clothing · Pose:
An off-white triangle bikini top with thin straps, small frills around the cups, and a long tie at the center of the chest. A thin fabric of the same color is wrapped diagonally around the waist, secured through a wooden ring at the waist on the right side of the frame, from which a deep-slit skirt extends downwards, revealing the legs in front. The upper body is slightly twisted towards the right side of the frame, the arm on the left side hangs naturally, and the hand on the right side is lightly placed near the knot of the waist wrap.

Background · Lighting:
The foreground is a yellowish-brown beach with lingering footprints and subtle irregularities, with a bamboo-green plank boardwalk extending diagonally from the bottom left corner. In the middle ground, the blue ocean is dotted with small swimmers and a green buoy on the left bank, with a low island silhouette at the right end of the horizon. The majority of the upper part is a bright blue sky with a uniform tone. Intense summer sunlight pouring from above brightly illuminates the skin and white cloth, casting short, soft shadows on the sand.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 3:4. The lens is aimed almost horizontally from a height slightly lower than the character's chest, capturing a large area of white space above the head and a mid-range full view from the top of the head to the mid-thigh. The character is located in the lower center, the face is near the center of the frame, the horizon is slightly above the shoulder level, and the sky occupies the vast majority of the upper half of the frame. The character's face and upper body are in focus, while the sea surface and islands retain their outlines and are slightly blurred.

Texture · Style:
A high-definition realistic photograph with clear separation between the blue sky, sea water, beach, and off-white. Realistically depicts natural skin texture, small frills and thin waist wrap, footprints on the sand, the wooden boardwalk, fine reflections on the sea surface, and hair strands spreading in the wind.

Negative Prompt:
Do not fill the vast sky space in the upper half; do not significantly change facial features

prompts.text:

背对无云的蓝天与平静的大海，一位身着生成り白的比基尼上装和腰巾的年轻女性站在沙滩上。将人物置于画面中央的下半部分，头顶上方保留超过人物高度的广阔天空留白。从左下角延伸入画的木质步道，低低地横跨水平线。

将蓝天、海水、沙滩和生成り白清晰分隔的高精细写实照片。真实描绘自然的肌理、细小的褶边和薄腰巾、沙上的足迹、木质步道、海面的细碎反射，以及风中散开的发丝。

prompts.text:
9:16 portrait orientation, high-precision ancient style xianxia boudoir beauty portrait, Tang style fantasy aesthetic, the overall atmosphere is noble, gentle, quiet, delicately raised, and subtle, with the feel of a refined poster of a female lead in front of a boudoir window. The main subject is a young adult Oriental female, visual age about 20–28 years old, possessing natural and clear Oriental female characteristics, not Westernized, not child-like, and not a 'social media influencer face'. She has a small oval face, clean and soft facial lines, soft almond eyes, a gentle, quiet, subtle, and composed gaze, a delicate and natural nose shape, and soft, clear lip lines, overall presenting the temperament of a noble boudoir female lead. The skin is fair and delicate, translucent and lustrous, with a delicate and bright water-light glow.

The makeup is peach-pink water-light makeup, with an exquisite concentration, emphasizing blush, water-light base makeup, and aegyosal (under-eye) highlighting. The base makeup is light, thin, delicate, fair, and translucent, presenting a soft creamy water-light feel; the eye makeup is delicately blended with peach pink, soft pink-brown, and light warm brown to enhance the warm moisture of the soft almond eyes; eyelashes are naturally slender, and the aegyosal is softly highlighted; the blush is peach pink, honey peach pink, or light rouge pink, mainly distributed under the eyes and in the middle of the face, distinct but sophisticated; the lip makeup is soft and moist light peach pink, petal pink, or low-saturation rose pink, with a moist and full texture but not excessively influencer-like; facial highlights slightly brighten the tip of the nose, the center of the face, under the eyes, and the cupid's bow. The overall makeup is delicately raised and exquisite, but not 'sweet girl'-like and not modern influencer-like.

The hairstyle is long straight black hair, half-draped and half-pinned, with moderately fluffy hair on top, smooth and delicate hair strands, and a small amount of natural broken hair framing the face. The accessory level is ornate, wearing light gold hair ornaments, pearl tassels, white jade flower ornaments, a small amount of green jade embellishments, and delicate buyao (step-shakes), paired with pearl, white jade, and light gold thin chain long pendant earrings, overall ornate and light, without overwhelming the face. The clothing consists of a light gauze outer robe + an embroidered inner layer + a pearl waist chain, belonging to a medium-to-high ornateness ancient style boudoir female lead outfit, using an aqua, white, and gold color scheme, dominated by aqua, light green jade, and soft light cyan-green, with white, milk white, and moon white as auxiliary colors, and light gold, pearls, white jade, and a small amount of light green jade-like ornaments as accents. The inner long dress features detailed embroidery of floral patterns, vine patterns, jade leaf patterns, or flowing cloud patterns, while the outer light gauze robe is semi-transparent, soft, and draping, with a detailed pearl waist chain worn at the waist, composed of thin light gold chains, pearls, small white jade pendants, and a small amount of jade ornaments. The upper body contour is soft, elegant, and dignified, with a full and natural chest, overall dignified and restrained.

The character is leaning and sitting by the side of an ancient-style soft couch, body slightly turned, one hand gently lifting a white gauze curtain, looking out the window, the camera shot is a half-body close-up. The scene is in front of a magnolia window, with white gauze curtains and an ancient-style soft couch environment, the background features blurred magnolia flower shadows, window lattices, white gauze curtains, and soft couch details, with hazy magnolia shadows, soft light from the window, and layers of the indoor boudoir visible. The lighting is soft daylight by the window, with the gauze curtains providing diffuse reflection making the face delicate and bright, and soft luster on the side of the face, hair tips, earrings, and edges of the light gauze. The character is the absolute visual center, the overall image is high-precision and high-completion, the makeup is distinct, hair strands are delicate, clothing layers are clear, and the background does not overpower the subject, possessing the completion level of an ancient style xianxia noble boudoir female lead character poster.

prompts.text:
9:16 竖版，高精度古风仙侠闺阁美人写真，唐风幻想审美，整体画面清贵、温柔、安静、娇养、含蓄，具有闺阁窗前女主的精修海报感。画面主体是一位年轻成年东方女性，视觉年龄约 20–28 岁，具有自然明确的东方女性特征，不欧美化，不幼态化，不网红脸。她拥有小巧鹅蛋脸，面部线条干净柔和，柔和杏眼，眼神温柔安静、含蓄从容，鼻型秀气自然，唇形柔软清晰，整体呈现清贵闺阁女主气质。肌肤白皙细腻、通透莹润，带细腻明亮的水光感。

妆容为桃粉水光妆，妆容浓度精致，重点强化腮红、水光底妆与卧蚕提亮。底妆轻薄细腻、白皙通透，呈现柔和奶油水光感；眼妆以桃粉、柔粉棕、浅暖棕细腻晕染，增强柔和杏眼的温润感；睫毛自然纤长，卧蚕轻柔提亮；腮红为桃粉、蜜桃粉或浅胭脂粉，重点分布在眼下和面中，明显但高级；唇妆为柔润浅桃粉、花瓣粉或低饱和玫瑰粉，质感水润饱满但不过分网红化；面部高光轻微提亮鼻尖、面中、眼下与唇峰。整体妆容娇养精致，但不甜妹化，不现代网红化。

发型为黑长直半披半挽，发顶蓬松适度，发丝顺滑细腻，少量碎发自然修饰脸型。头饰等级为华丽，佩戴浅金发饰、珍珠流苏、白玉花饰、少量青玉点缀与细巧步摇，搭配珍珠、白玉、浅金细链长坠耳饰，整体华丽轻盈，不压脸。服装为轻纱外袍 + 刺绣内层 + 珍珠腰链，属于中高华丽度古风闺阁女主妆造，采用水青白金系配色，以水青、青玉浅色、柔和浅青绿为主色，白色、乳白、月白为辅色，浅金、珍珠、白玉与少量浅青玉石感饰件为点缀。内层长裙带有细致花卉纹、藤蔓纹、玉叶纹或流云纹刺绣，外层轻纱外袍半透明柔软垂坠，腰间佩戴细致珍珠腰链，由浅金细链、珍珠、白玉小坠与少量玉饰组成。上半身轮廓柔美端雅，胸部饱满自然，整体端庄克制。

人物倚坐在古风软榻边，身体轻侧，一只手轻轻掀起白纱帘，看向窗外，镜头为半身近景。场景为玉兰窗前、白纱帘、古风软榻环境，背景虚化玉兰花影、窗棂、白纱帘与软榻细节，可见朦胧玉兰影、柔和窗边光与室内闺阁层次。光线为白天窗边柔光，纱帘漫反射使面部细腻明亮，脸侧、发梢、耳饰与轻纱边缘带柔和光泽。人物是绝对视觉中心，整体画面高精度、高完成度、妆面显妆、发丝细腻、服装层次清晰、背景不喧宾夺主，具有古风仙侠、清贵闺阁女主与角色海报级完成度。

prompts.text:
Character: [adult woman, appearance, hairstyle]

Create a photorealistic 9:16 nighttime portrait. Use a close, low-angle camera near the ground. The woman sits in a curled pose with one knee raised close to the lens, the other leg folded inward, and both arms resting loosely across the knee.

Her shoulders turn slightly inward, her head tilts gently, her chin stays lowered, and her eyes look up directly into the camera. Keep the expression restrained, emotional, and quietly captivating—no smile.

Use direct flash to keep the subject crisp while the background remains darker and atmospheric. Preserve realistic skin texture, natural hair, accurate hands and legs, believable fabric, and a candid late-night photography feel.

prompts.text:
3:4 vertical retro preppy style indoor lifestyle portrait, soft warm sunlight shining into an exquisite living room. In the foreground on the carpet are a wooden chessboard, scattered pieces, an open magazine, a small white cup and saucer, and two red cherries, with a light orange-pink cushion in the lower left. A burgundy vintage corded telephone is placed on the sofa seat, with the phone cord hanging down naturally and connecting to the handset in the character's hand.

There is only one adult East Asian woman in the frame, sitting on the light-colored carpet in front of the sofa, located center-right of the frame. Her legs are folded to the right side, her sitting posture is natural and stable, one hand lightly holding the red phone handset by her leg, the other hand resting on the edge of the pink sofa seat, her head turned slightly to the left, gaze looking out of the frame, expression quiet, restrained, with a slight sense of waiting. She has long dark hair, hair strands falling naturally, wearing a white collared shirt, a black tweed sleeveless dress or pinafore dress, a black bow tied at the neckline, white tights on the lower body, and black low-heel Mary Janes or black low-heel shoes; the overall style is sweet-cool retro preppy.

Light enters from the front right, forming warm, soft, slightly geometric-edged sun spots, mainly falling on the carpet, magazine pages, sofa edges, and near the character's legs; the character's face remains soft and readable, not overexposed. The overall colors are mainly off-white, coral gray-pink, warm beige, black-gray, and burgundy; the frame is clean, restrained, exquisite, with a slight retro film warmth and fine grain, but the character's face, clothing texture, telephone, chessboard, and sofa suede must be clear.

Forcefully incorporate a clear and natural Soran three-layer natural watermark system. Layer 1 readable watermark: clearly add "Soran" brand embroidery under the black bow near the face or on the black tweed chest woven label, or a readable Soran can appear on the small nameplate at the top of the burgundy telephone. Layer 2 hidden watermark: integrate Soran into the silver tweed yarn, pink sofa suede texture, red phone cord spiral structure, chessboard wood grain, and magazine printing texture. Layer 3 microscopic watermark: form microscopic Soran through the scratches on the chess piece bases, telephone cord loops, cup and saucer glaze fine lines, cherry arrangement, clothing stitching nodes, and sofa button pile direction. All markings must change naturally with material, perspective, lighting, and occlusion, being obvious, readable, and tasteful, and must not be externally pasted.

items.title: 欧洲古典画室中的静谧少女

prompts.text:
In the quiet halls of a forgotten European atelier somewhere between the soft mornings of 19th-century Florence and the still light of a Parisian studio, a young woman stands as if she has just stepped out of an old master’s sketchbook. The air carries the faint scent of aged paper and linen, and the pale morning light filters through high windows, catching every fold of fabric as though time itself has paused to study her. items.title: 实景微缩模型产品摄影生成指令

prompts.text:
2x2 grid, 16:9, do this for 4 popular snacks around the world: INPUT ::= [PRODUCT] + [ONE_BENEFIT]

STEP_1 :: infer the benefit-as-landscape
- make the single benefit physically literal as a small world
- cooling → an arctic set carved from the product's own foam
- protection → a fortress; speed → a racetrack of the material itself
- the product is the monument, sun, or hero at the centre of this world

STEP_2 :: infer the build
- practical miniature set, forced perspective, product at hero scale
- craft materials that fake the world: paper, foam, fabric, sugar, real water
- the handmade tell that makes it delightful rather than sterile CGI
- one inhabitant or figure giving the tiny world life and scale

STEP_3 :: infer the narrative moment
- the world paused mid-story, something just happening within it
- the product's role in the scene made unmistakable
- a second reading rewarding the viewer who looks closely

STEP_4 :: infer world light
- lit like a landscape, not a product: a sun, a horizon, weather
- practical atmosphere inside the set: mist, dust, real smoke
- colour palette carrying the benefit's temperature

STEP_5 :: render spec
- macro depth holding the whole set, f/16 territory
- lights rigged inside the miniature, spilling naturally
- true miniature falloff — forbidden: fake tilt-shift, obvious compositing
- dust motes in the light beams, one honest seam of the build showing

EXAMPLE_INPUT :: [a deodorant] + [24-hour freshness]
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
2x2 网格，16:9，为全球 4 种流行零食执行此操作：输入 ::= [产品] + [一个益处]

步骤_1 :: 推导益处即景观
- 将单一益处在物理上字面化为一个微缩世界
- 清凉 → 从产品自身泡沫中雕刻出的北极场景
- 保护 → 一座堡垒；速度 → 由材料本身构成的赛道
- 产品是这个世界中心的纪念碑、太阳或主角

步骤_2 :: 推导构建方式
- 实景微缩布景，强制透视，产品处于英雄比例
- 伪造世界的工艺材料：纸张、泡沫、织物、糖、真实的水
- 这种手工痕迹使其显得生动有趣，而非生硬的 CGI
- 一个居民或人物，为微小世界赋予生命和比例感

步骤_3 :: 推导叙事瞬间
- 世界在故事中途暂停，其中正有事发生
- 产品在场景中的角色清晰无误
- 二次解读，回馈仔细观察的观众

步骤_4 :: 推导世界光影
- 像景观一样布光，而非像产品：太阳、地平线、天气
- 布景内的实际氛围：薄雾、灰尘、真实的烟雾
- 承载益处温度的色调

步骤_5 :: 渲染规格
- 涵盖整个场景的宏观深度，f/16 领域
- 安装在微缩模型内部的灯光，自然溢出
- 真实的微缩衰减 —— 禁用：虚假移轴、明显的合成
- 光束中的尘埃微粒，展示布景的一处真实接缝

示例输入 :: [一款除臭剂] + [24 小时清新]

items.title: 夏日蓝天低机位清透人像摄影写真

prompts.text:
With [Character Name] as the main subject, create a summer blue sky photo shoot × low-angle clear portrait photography. The person sits on wide dark gray outdoor steps, the body slightly turned and leaning back, one hand supporting the side for balance, the other hand's fingertips lightly touching the lips; the head is tilted upwards, chin slightly raised, eyes lightly closed, as if feeling the sunlight and breeze, with a lazy, sweet, and relaxed expression. 

One leg is bent and crossed in front of the other, knees extending towards the camera, forming a clear front-to-back perspective; feet land naturally on steps of different heights, toes slightly turned inward. Hair is gently blown by the wind. 

Adopting a 2:3 vertical full-body composition, ultra-low angle slightly looking up, close-range wide-angle perspective, legs located in the foreground and moderately enlarged, the upper body of the person located in the upper center of the frame. The background is a bright light blue sky with large soft clouds, a small amount of white industrial pipes and metal railings exposed in the upper right corner, three pure white balloons scattered beside the steps, adding a light, dreamy summer atmosphere to the scene. 

Use natural light from a sunny afternoon, sunlight illuminating the face, arms, and clothing from the side-front, the edges of hair strands with soft golden-brown rim light; overall adoption of low contrast, high brightness, slight soft focus, and shallow depth of field, presenting a clear Japanese-style photo shoot, youthful fashion pictorial, and airy digital photography texture. The character proportions are natural, hand and foot structures are accurate, and the textures of the skirt hem, stockings, shoe surfaces, and hair strands are clear.

prompts.text:
以【角色名称】为主体，创作一张夏日蓝天写真 × 低机位清透人像摄影。人物坐在宽阔的深灰色户外台阶上，身体微微侧转并向后倚靠，一只手撑在身侧保持平衡，另一只手指尖轻触嘴唇；头部向上仰起，下巴微抬，双眼轻闭，像在感受阳光与微风，神态慵懒、甜美而放松。      

人物一条腿屈起并从另一条腿前方交叠，双膝朝镜头方向延伸，形成明显的前后透视；双脚自然落在不同高度的台阶上，脚尖略微内收。头发被风轻轻吹动 

采用 2:3 竖版全身构图，超低机位轻微仰拍，近距离广角视角，腿部位于前景并被适度放大，人物上半身位于画面中央偏上。背景是明亮的浅蓝天空与大片柔软云层，右上角露出少量白色工业管道和金属栏杆，台阶旁散落三只纯白气球，为画面增加轻盈、梦幻的夏日气息。

使用晴日下午自然光，阳光从侧前方照亮面部、手臂与衣料，发丝边缘带柔和金棕色轮廓光；整体采用，低对比、高明度、轻微柔焦与浅景深，呈现清透日系写真、青春时尚画报与空气感数码摄影质感。人物比例自然，手脚结构准确，裙摆、丝袜、鞋面和发丝材质清晰。

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 high-fashion editorial poster where one person physically interacts with a monumental 3D letter.

The letter must function like a real sculptural structure—not flat typography. Show believable weight, contact, shadows, depth, and clear front-to-back layering. The subject should grip an edge, step on a stroke, pass a limb through a counter, sit inside the letter, or emerge through an opening.

Subject: [Asian / Western / male / female]
Letter: [A / B / G / R]
Interaction: [climb / hold / sit inside / break through]
Title: [custom title]
Series: TYPE CONTACT
Year: 2026

4 directions:

1. BREAK THE TYPE — a stylish male figure emerging through the two openings of a translucent cobalt-blue “B,” with his head and arms crossing from behind the letter to the foreground.

2. GRIP THE FORM — an athletic woman climbing a monumental stone “R,” gripping its top edge, stepping on its strokes, and threading one leg through the inner opening.

3. HOLD THE LINE — a contemporary male dancer supported by a massive matte-black “A,” with hands gripping both sides, one foot resting on the crossbar, and the body stretching through the triangular space.

4. FORM — an elegant woman seated inside the cavity of a dark green “G,” leaning against the inner curve while one leg remains inside and the other extends beyond the letter.

Use realistic anatomy, natural skin and fabric, controlled studio lighting, refined material textures, strong negative space, and a distinct color palette for each poster.

Keep the typography minimal: one main title, one short supporting line, “TYPE CONTACT,” and “2026.” Let part of the title pass behind the subject or sculpture, but keep it readable.

prompts.text:
创建一个 9:16 的高端时尚社论海报，其中一个人与一个巨大的 3D 字母进行肢体互动。

该字母必须像真实的雕塑结构一样运作——而不是扁平的排版。展示可信的重量感、接触感、阴影、深度以及清晰的前后分层。主体应该抓握边缘、踏在笔画上、肢体穿过孔隙、坐在字母内部或从开口中浮现。

主体：[亚洲人 / 西方人 / 男性 / 女性]
字母：[A / B / G / R]
互动：[攀爬 / 抓握 / 坐在内部 / 突破]
标题：[自定义标题]
系列：TYPE CONTACT
年份：2026

4 个方向：

1. 突破字形 —— 一位时尚的男性形象从一个半透明钴蓝色“B”的两个开口中浮现，他的头部和双臂从字母后方穿过到前景。

2. 抓握形式 —— 一位运动型女性攀爬一个巨大的石质“R”，抓握其顶端边缘，踏在其笔画上，并将一条腿穿过内部开口。

3. 坚守线条 —— 一位当代男舞者由一个巨大的哑光黑色“A”支撑，双手抓握两侧，一只脚踩在横梁上，身体在三角形空间中伸展。

4. 形式 —— 一位优雅的女性坐在深绿色“G”的腔体内部，倚靠着内侧曲线，一只腿留在内部，另一只腿伸出字母之外。

使用真实的解剖结构、自然的皮肤和织物、受控的摄影棚灯光、精致的材质纹理、强大的负空间，并为每张海报设定独特的色调。

保持排版极简：一个主标题，一行简短的辅助文字，“TYPE CONTACT”和“2026”。让标题的一部分经过主体或雕塑后方，但保持其可读性。

Vivid lawn in the foreground, large areas of broadleaf trees arranged from the middle ground to the background, an open park view. A slender walkway extends from the back right of the frame, with the distant view softly blurred. Vertical composition 2:3. The character's full body is placed in the center of the frame, with appropriate blank space left above the head and below the shoes. prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium ice cream brand e-commerce detail-page sales poster that merges Cream Halo Transit flagship brand precision with Milk Cloud Orbit tactile frozen-dessert realism, while strictly preserving the exact original single-page vertical homepage-detail structure. Brand identity:
Create a self-invented premium ice cream company such as “VELORA GELATO”, “AUREL FRUIT CREAM”, or “MOSA FROST HOUSE”. The brand must feel modern, colorful, youthful, luxurious, and commercially elite. Use a minimal official logo mark, elegant English main titles with smaller Chinese subtitle support, and a fully unified flagship visual language.

Strict original structure:
This is critical. Preserve exactly:
1. Bright top hero section with left-side headline/copy/CTA and right-side circular frozen dessert hero.
2. Row of circular flavor / category cards below.
3. Centered middle feature zone with two side-by-side fruit product blocks and UI-like pricing/sale elements.
4. Lower wave-shaped color-band hero section with one dominant fruit ice drink / frozen cream beverage.
5. Decorative floating fruit slices, leaves, and small accents throughout.
Do not redesign into a grid, a different landing page, or an alternative card system.

Collector-grade sales visual upgrade:
This is critical. Make the page feel like a collectible flagship sales visual by:
- reducing visual noise
- enlarging negative space inside all modules
- making each fruit and frozen object more sculptural
- refining CTA, pricing, and micro UI handling
- strengthening the rhythm between the big modules
- letting color blocks, frozen texture, and fruit realism carry more emotional impact
It should still be clearly commercial, but far rarer and more display-worthy.

Cream Halo Transit flagship precision:
Unify the entire page into a stronger international brand system. Hero headline, Chinese subtitle, circular flavor-card text, middle deals-title, pricing logic, CTA buttons, small labels, and bottom stat blocks must all share one disciplined visual language with better spacing, calmer hierarchy, and more premium alignment. The page must feel like one official flagship campaign rather than stacked content sections.

Milk Cloud Orbit frozen realism:
Push tactile realism to the highest level:
- gelato / frozen cream swirl definition
- frost particles and cold condensation
- fruit flesh translucency and juice sheen
- creamy thickness and soft scoop edge logic
- splash realism and frozen-liquid transition
- cup reflections and lid clarity
- fruit peel pores and cut-surface wetness

Everything must feel touchable, de-AI, collectible, and materially expensive.

Top hero section:
Keep the original left-right structure. On the left, place one bold English title such as “ICE CREAM YELLOW CHERRY” or “FRUIT GELATO SPLIT”, one smaller Chinese subtitle, and one refined CTA. On the right, keep one large circular frozen dessert composition resembling a fruit-topped ice cream tart or gelato wheel, divided into colorful premium fruit sections. Make it more sculptural, cleaner, and more collectible.

Flavor-card row:
Preserve the circular flavor-card logic but make it more luxurious. Use several distinct same-series flavors such as raspberry cream, pineapple sorbet, matcha coconut gelato, strawberry fruit blend, and dark berry frozen cream. Keep the cards aligned, bright, and highly controlled, with stronger contrast but less visual clutter.

Middle feature zone:
Keep the original central “deals” logic with two side-by-side fruit-centered product stories such as ripe bananas and red watermelon. Refine the UI elements, sale tags, and price blocks so they feel premium rather than promotional-heavy. Let the fruit and frozen product visuals dominate.

Bottom hero section:
Preserve the wavy saturated lower section with one dominant fruit ice beverage / frozen cream hero. Make the drink more collectible and materially rich: deeper frozen texture, more elegant splash, finer condensation, and more refined ingredient side visuals. Keep the lower stats and info blocks but unify them into a more premium flagship rhythm.

Color direction:
Use a refined but lively palette of saturated yellow, cherry red, watermelon pink, citrus orange, kiwi green, cream white, blueberry violet, and mint leaf green. Keep the color blocks bold but more mature, more controlled, and more expensive.

Lighting:

prompts.text:
Character: [Luffy / Nami / Zoro / Robin]
Title: [two-word English title]
Main typography: [IMPACT / STORM / BLADE / BLOOM]

Scene: [ship deck / harbor / ocean ruins / island coast]
Color palette: [bright custom palette]
Series label: GRAND LINE FRAGMENTS

Create a bright, high-impact 9:16 anime editorial poster featuring one One Piece character using their signature ability.

Use clean 2D shonen anime illustration, bold ink outlines, vivid cel shading, expressive facial features, exaggerated but coherent perspective, and colors that remain clear and saturated. Keep the background white or cool off-white; avoid yellowed paper, brown shadows, dark vintage filters, and muted colors.

Build the composition around one oversized English word. The letters should occupy most of the frame, extend beyond the canvas, and function as part of the environment. Place the sky, ocean, sails, harbor, ruins, clouds, or architecture inside the letterforms.

Connect the typography naturally to the physical scene:
- let the lower letterforms meet the deck, stone steps, or ruins;
- extend ground perspective lines into the letters;
- cast consistent shadows across both typography and scenery;
- allow ropes, masts, weapons, hair, clothing, and effects to pass through the negative spaces.

The character must occupy the middle layer, while one signature element breaks strongly into the foreground. Keep the anatomy, hands, weapons, and mechanical details clear.

Four directions:

1. RUBBER IMPACT — Luffy lunges from a sunny ship deck, one stretched fist enlarged toward the camera. Bright ocean, sails, clouds, and islands fill the giant IMPACT letters.

2. STORM CALL — Nami rotates across the deck while pointing the Clima-Tact toward the viewer. A localized blue-white storm forms inside the STORM letters, with warm sunlight and cool lightning illuminating the same scene.

3. THREE BLADE — Zoro performs a low three-sword strike in a bright harbor. One blade dominates the foreground, while the other two create middle and rear spatial layers through the BLADE typography.

4. FLOWER TRACE — Robin stands calmly among sunlit coastal ruins. Use only one enlarged foreground hand and two separated secondary ability arms. Let them emerge from different parts of the BLOOM letters without creating a dense wall of hands.

1. RUBBER IMPACT — 路飞从阳光明媚的船甲板上向前冲，一只拉伸的拳头朝向镜头放大。明亮的海洋、船帆、云朵和岛屿填充在巨大的 IMPACT 字母中。

2. STORM CALL — 娜美在甲板上旋转，同时将天候棒指向观众。STORM 字母内部形成了一场局部的蓝白色风暴，温暖的阳光和冷冽的闪电同时照亮了同一个场景。

3. THREE BLADE — 索隆在明亮的港口进行低位三刀流攻击。一把刀占据前景，而另外两把刀通过 BLADE 排版创造出中间和后部的空间层次。

4. FLOWER TRACE — 罗宾静静地站在阳光照射的沿海遗迹中。仅使用一只放大的前景手和两条分离的副能力手臂。让它们从 BLOOM 字母的不同部分显现，而不要制造出一堵密集的手墙。

items.title: 现代国际主义版式风格PPT设计系统

prompts.text: Establish a modern PPT system collaborating dark field high contrast, bold titles, and rectangular photographic slices: take International Typographic Style theory as the main axis, using modular grids, unified margins, and baseline rhythm to stabilize information; use the functional asymmetry of New Typography to create spanning columns, misalignments, and scale transitions; use Gestalt laws of proximity and common region to cluster titles, descriptions, data, and images into clear modules; use Itten's light-dark and area contrast to let small-area high-purity symbols form instantaneous focus against large-area low-chroma backgrounds. Borrow Josef Müller-Brockmann's mathematical grids and objective hierarchy to coordinate the entire series, absorb Jan Tschichold's dynamic white space and unequal blocks to guide the line of sight, use Paul Rand's conceptualized geometric symbols to provide light recognition, and then use Alexey Brodovitch's bold cropping and text-image dialogue to change page density, with each dividing labor without replicating individual works. The color scheme adopts four types of replaceable roles: deep low-brightness low-chroma background accounts for 65%—80%, high-brightness information color accounts for 15%—25%, thematic photos retain medium-high brightness and medium chroma accounting for 15%—35%, and high-purity cool and warm localized accent colors total no more than 8%; emphasis is only placed adjacent to title endpoints, key numbers, and directional nodes, enhancing brightness through simultaneous contrast, any theme or brand colors must be mapped once according to roles, maintaining area, brightness order, chroma difference, cool-warm tension, and projection readability unchanged. The composition uses a 4—8 column elastic modular grid, with titles read first, focal images second, and descriptions and data last; covers allow oversized titles to span columns, content pages rotate between left-right splitting, up-down staggered levels, and large blocks of white space, rectangular images serve as unequal visual mass to dynamically balance with text areas, allowing only one symbol to cross column lines for controlled breaking of the grid. The background uses a uniform matte plane as the base, with extremely fine low-contrast squares overlaid on the cover, while content pages remain pure; photography adopts natural diffused light, realistic tones, close-up cropping, and hard-edged rectangular masks without decorative filters; radial petals, sharp-angled intersections, and folded-angle linear shapes are produced as stroke-less vector flat fills, with sharp edges, partial edge-pressing or semi-bleeding, undertaking the rhythm of chapters, directions, and pauses. Titles and body text use a rounded geometric sans-serif family with consistent skeletons: titles are extra bold, tight letter spacing, tight line spacing and broken into short lines, body text is regular weight, small font size, loose line spacing; Chinese and Western characters are corrected according to visual face, counter density, and baseline, not strictly aligned by nominal font size, title symbols only fit endpoints or negative spaces, not eroding readability. The overall feeling is bright, direct, young, agile, clear, and credible. Topic: Why do some people habitually lie? Rich in knowledge points. Each layout varies to avoid repetition. A total of 10 pages.
