items.title: 高端果汁品牌电商详情页海报设计

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium e-commerce detail-page sales poster for a self-invented juice beverage brand, strictly preserving the exact original asymmetrical packaging-led layout logic, while pushing the image in the Milk Cloud Orbit direction and upgrading the whole page into a more collectible flagship sales visual. Do not change the original composition structure. Keep the same central hero packaging block, the same surrounding ingredient-image modules, the same alternating rounded-corner visual cards, the same left-right text explanation rhythm, and the same lower serving-scene storytelling flow. The final artwork must feel like a collector-edition commercial print for a luxury juice brand: hyper-real, clean, luminous, materially rich, elegantly quiet, and visually rare, with the entire page reading more like a design-award-winning brand object than an ordinary product detail page.

Brand identity:
Create a self-invented premium juice beverage brand such as “VELORA JUICE LAB”, “AUREL FRESH PRESS”, or “EMBER FRUIT RESERVE”. The hero product should be a premium bottled or boxed cold-pressed juice series that naturally fits the original central-pack composition. The brand must feel fresh, modern, organic, giftable, and internationally premium. Use a minimal official logo mark, elegant English main titles, and smaller refined Chinese subtitle lines.

Strict original structure:
This is critical. Preserve exactly:
- one strong central hero package vertically anchoring the page
- surrounding asymmetrical ingredient and texture image modules
- inserted left-right text explanation zones between image blocks
- rounded rectangular image cards in the same visual rhythm
- lower continuation of serving and ingredient storytelling
- overall reading order as one premium detail-page poster
Do not convert it into a homepage, grid collage, or alternative composition.

Central hero product block:
Place one dominant premium juice package in the center, acting as the spine of the page. It may be a luxury carton, glass bottle, or slim clear bottle with an exceptionally refined label. The packaging must feel materially expensive: crisp print detail, subtle matte or satin finish, elegant emboss feel, clean structural edges, premium cap or seal reflections, and beautiful liquid visibility if transparent. The hero pack should feel like a collectible object, almost worthy of display.

Milk Cloud Orbit material realism:
This is the main focus. Push tactile realism to the highest possible level:
- fruit flesh fibers and juicy translucency
- cut-edge wetness and fresh pulp tension
- peel pores and natural skin sheen
- liquid depth, meniscus, and inner glow inside bottle or glass
- condensation beads with believable edge tension
- packaging print sharpness, paper grain, film sheen, and embossed details
- glass reflections, wall thickness, and clean highlights
- puree, syrup, or cold-pressed liquid texture with natural viscosity
Everything must feel touchable, de-AI, and collector-grade.

Surrounding ingredient modules:
Around the central package, keep the original surrounding module logic but elevate every image into a premium material study:
- sliced citrus, berries, peach, kiwi, mango, apple, grape, or pomegranate
- bowls of puree or pressed fruit texture
- macro fruit segments, seeds, peel textures, and juice droplets
- elegant top-down ingredient arrangements on refined neutral surfaces
Every surrounding block must feel quieter, more sculptural, and more luxurious, like product-ingredient still lifes in a gallery.

Text explanation zones:
Preserve the original placement of text modules between image blocks. Use elegant English main titles such as:
- “Pure Fruit Structure”
- “Cold-Pressed Clarity”
- “Natural Ingredients”
- “Freshness in Layers”
with smaller Chinese subtitle support. Keep body copy short, refined, and airy. The text must feel beautifully typeset and secondary to the material photography.

Lower serving and usage blocks:
In the lower page area, continue the same original modular storytelling logic with serving-scene images and product usage visuals. Show the juice poured into elegant glassware, paired with sliced fruit, breakfast accents, or a chilled tabletop ritual. Keep the scenes highly controlled, premium, and product-led. These lower modules must feel like the continuation of one collectible editorial narrative.

More collectible flagship feeling:
This is critical. Make the whole detail page feel more like a collectible sales visual by:
- reducing unnecessary text density
- increasing negative space within each module
- using fewer but more precise props
- making each ingredient image feel like a luxury material study
- giving the central product stronger object-like status
- letting the page breathe like a premium poster rather than a standard e-commerce sheet
The result should feel suitable for both luxury online sales and printed brand showcase display.

Color direction:
Use a refined bright-organic palette of warm ivory, pale cream, citrus yellow, grapefruit coral, mango gold, kiwi green, berry red, and gentle leaf green accents. Preserve contrast between modules, but unify them into one mature premium brand family.

Lighting:
Use soft premium commercial lighting with bright daylight-like highlights, elegant shadow falloff, refined reflections on packaging and glass, and beautiful fruit realism. The page must feel luminous, fresh, and materially expensive without becoming noisy.

Typography and layout system:
Use minimal English main titles with smaller Chinese subtitle support. Unify all headings, body text, labels, and small callouts into one advanced flagship system with better spacing, calmer hierarchy, and more collectible editorial balance. The page must feel like a luxury brand artifact.

Rendering style:
ultra-premium juice beverage e-commerce detail page, strict original asymmetrical packaging-led layout, Milk Cloud Orbit tactile realism, collectible flagship sales visual, central hero juice package with surrounding ingredient modules, elegant English main titles with smaller Chinese subtitles, hyper-real fruit and liquid photography, award-winning editorial-commerce design, 8k, masterpiece quality

Negative prompt:
changed page structure, homepage layout, random collage composition, cheap juice ad, fake fruit texture, plastic-looking liquid, cluttered page, messy typography, generic template, low-end packaging, cartoon graphics, oversaturated colors, harsh flash lighting, noisy props

prompts.text:
为一家自创的果汁饮料品牌创作一张超高端电商详情页销售海报，严格保留原有的非对称包装主导布局逻辑，同时将图像推向“奶云轨道”（Milk Cloud Orbit）方向，并将整个页面升级为更具收藏价值的旗舰级销售视觉效果。不要改变原始的构图结构。保持相同的中心英雄产品包装块、相同的周围成分图像模块、相同的交替圆角视觉卡片、相同的左右文字解释节奏，以及相同的下方饮用场景叙事流。最终的作品必须感觉像是一个奢侈果汁品牌的收藏版商业印刷品：超真实、干净、透亮、材质丰富、优雅安静且视觉罕见，整个页面的阅读体验更像是一个获得设计奖的品牌艺术品，而非普通的商品详情页。

品牌标识：
创建一个自创的高端果汁饮料品牌，如“VELORA JUICE LAB”、“AUREL FRESH PRESS”或“EMBER FRUIT RESERVE”。核心产品应为高端瓶装或盒装冷压果汁系列，自然契合原始的中心包装构图。品牌必须感觉新鲜、现代、有机、适合作为礼物，并具有国际高端感。使用极简的官方标志、优雅的英文主标题和较小的精致中文副标题行。

严格的原始结构：
这是至关重要的。准确保留：
- 一个强有力的中心英雄包装，垂直锚定页面
- 周围非对称的成分和纹理图像模块
- 在图像块之间插入的左右文字解释区
- 具有相同视觉节奏的圆角矩形图像卡片
- 下方延续的饮用和成分叙事
- 整体阅读顺序为一个高端详情页海报
不要将其转化为首页、网格拼贴或替代构图。

中心英雄产品块：
在中心放置一个占主导地位的高端果汁包装，作为页面的脊梁。它可以是奢侈纸盒、玻璃瓶或带有极其精致标签的细长透明瓶。包装必须在材质上感觉昂贵：清晰的印刷细节、微妙的哑光或缎面触感、优雅的浮雕感、干净的结构边缘、高端瓶盖或封口反射，如果是透明的，则应有美丽的液体可见度。英雄包装应该感觉像是一个收藏品，几乎值得展示。

奶云轨道材质写实：
这是主要焦点。将触感写实推向最高水平：
- 果肉纤维和多汁的透明感
- 切边的湿润感和新鲜果肉的张力
- 果皮孔隙和自然的表皮光泽
- 瓶内或玻璃杯内液体的深度、弯月面和内部光泽
- 具有可信边缘张力的冷凝水珠
- 包装印刷的锐度、纸张纹理、薄膜光泽和浮雕细节
- 玻璃反射、壁厚和干净的高光
- 具有自然粘性的果泥、糖浆或冷压液体质感
一切都必须感觉触手可及、去AI化且达到收藏级。

周围成分模块：
在中心包装周围，保留原有的周围模块逻辑，但将每张图像提升为高端材质研究：
- 切开的柑橘、浆果、桃子、猕猴桃、芒果、苹果、葡萄或石榴
- 盛放果泥或压榨水果纹理的碗
- 宏观水果切片、种子、果皮纹理和果汁滴
- 在精致的中性表面上优雅的自上而下的成分排列
每个周围区块必须感觉更安静、更具雕塑感且更奢华，就像画廊中的产品成分静物画。

文字解释区：
保留图像块之间文字模块的原始位置。使用优雅的英文主标题，例如：
- “Pure Fruit Structure”
- “Cold-Pressed Clarity”
- “Natural Ingredients”
- “Freshness in Layers”
并配有较小的中文副标题支持。保持正文简短、精致且通透。文字必须排版精美，且次于材质摄影。

下方饮用及使用板块：
在页面下方区域，延续相同的原始模块化叙事逻辑，使用饮用场景图像和产品使用视觉效果。展示果汁倒入优雅的玻璃器皿中，搭配切片水果、早餐点缀或冰镇桌面仪式。保持场景高度受控、高端且以产品为主导。这些下方模块必须感觉像是一个可收藏的编辑叙事的延续。

更具收藏价值的旗舰感：
这是至关重要的。通过以下方式让整个详情页感觉更像是一件收藏级的销售视觉作品：
- 减少不必要的文字密度
- 增加每个模块内的负空间
- 使用更少但更精确的道具
- 让每张成分图感觉像是一场奢侈材质研究
- 赋予中心产品更强的物体感地位
- 让页面像高端海报一样呼吸，而不是标准的电商页面
结果应适用于奢侈品在线销售和印刷品牌展示。

色彩方向：
使用精致、明亮且有机的色调，包括暖象牙色、淡奶油色、柑橘黄、葡萄柚珊瑚色、芒果金、猕猴桃绿和柔和的叶绿点缀。保留模块之间的对比，但将它们统一为一个成熟的高端品牌家族。

光影：
使用柔和的高端商业照明，具有明亮的日光般高光、优雅的阴影衰减、包装和玻璃上的精致反射，以及美丽的写实水果。页面必须感觉亮丽、清新且材质昂贵，且不显杂乱。

排版和布局系统：
使用极简的英文主标题，并辅以较小的中文副标题支持。将所有标题、正文、标签和细小的标注统一为一个具有更好间距、更冷静层级和更具收藏价值编辑平衡感的高级旗舰系统。页面必须感觉像是一个奢侈品牌的手工艺品。

渲染风格：
超高端果汁饮料电商详情页，严格的原始非对称包装主导布局，奶云轨道触感写实，收藏级旗舰销售视觉，中心英雄果汁包装配周围成分模块，优雅英文主标题配较小中文副标题，超真实水果和液体摄影，屡获殊荣的商业编辑设计，8k，杰作质量

负向提示词：
改变的页面结构，首页布局，随机拼贴构图，廉价果汁广告，虚假的水果纹理，塑料感的液体，杂乱的页面，凌乱的排版，通用模板，低端包装，卡通图形，过饱和的色彩，刺眼的闪光灯照明，嘈杂的道具

prompts.text:
Create a photorealistic 3:4 full-body smartphone portrait of an exceptionally beautiful and subtly sexy adult East Asian woman posing inside a modest apartment entryway. She has a slim yet naturally curvy hourglass figure, a full bust, narrow waist, softly rounded hips and long slender legs. Her face is exceptionally attractive and refined, with luminous fair skin, a delicate V-shaped face, large dark almond-shaped eyes, softly arched eyebrows, a small high nose bridge, glossy rose-pink lips and elegant symmetrical features. She wears flattering soft-glam makeup with fine black eyeliner, long eyelashes, subtle rosy blush and naturally smooth skin. Her long, thick black hair is styled half-up with soft volume and loose waves falling behind her shoulders. A playful black cat-ear headband with small white fluffy feather decorations sits on top of her head, and she wears medium-sized silver hoop earrings.

She wears a fitted black sleeveless camisole with a plunging V-neckline edged in delicate floral lace, subtly emphasizing her feminine curves, paired with an elegant high-waisted black satin midi skirt with a semi-sheer black lace hem. A small structured tan canvas shoulder bag hangs naturally from her left shoulder at hip level. She also wears a pale-green jade bangle on one wrist and a delicate gold bracelet on the other.

Reproduce the pose precisely: she stands directly in front of the door with her torso facing the camera, shoulders relaxed and waist gently curved. Both arms extend outward symmetrically at approximately waist height, elbows softly bent, palms facing upward and fingers naturally separated, creating a playful “What can I say?” shrugging gesture. One leg supports her weight while the opposite knee bends backward, lifting her foot behind her and causing the satin skirt to sway slightly. She looks directly into the camera with softly parted lips, relaxed eyes and a calm, confident, subtly alluring expression.

Behind her is a reddish-brown wooden apartment door with a silver handle and lock. A dark-gray over-door hook rack runs across the upper section of the door, with a few empty hooks visible behind her head. Plain off-white walls surround the doorway, with only a small amount of ordinary household clutter appearing near the far-left edge. Preserve the intimate, slightly imperfect feeling of a real residential entryway rather than a designed studio set.

Use strong direct smartphone lighting from slightly right of the camera, illuminating her face, neckline and black outfit clearly while casting recognizable shadows of her arms and hands onto the white wall. Eye-level handheld camera, straightforward frontal composition, authentic Chinese social-media video still, subtle beauty-filter softness, mild digital compression, slightly imperfect focus and faint motion softness in the moving skirt. Keep the woman’s face clear, beautiful and sharply recognizable while preserving realistic skin, lace, satin, hair and fabric details. Accurate anatomy, two arms, two hands, five natural fingers on each hand, correctly oriented palms, realistic wrists, natural leg proportions, structurally correct shoulder bag and straps. No extra limbs, no fused or distorted fingers, no deformed face, no exaggerated plastic skin, no anime style, no luxury interior, no professional studio lighting, no cinematic color grading, no text, no logo, no watermark.

prompts.text:

items.title: 高级茶饮品牌三栏式详情页视觉海报

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium e-commerce detail-page sales poster for a self-invented tea beverage brand, strictly preserving the exact original three-column long-form vertical layout logic, while merging Cream Halo Transit luxury brand precision with Milk Cloud Orbit tactile realism to make the entire detail page feel rarer, more expensive, and more flagship-level. Do not change the original structural composition. Keep the same three tall narrow columns side by side, the same top-to-bottom modular reading rhythm, the same infographic-detail-page hierarchy, and the same product-explanation sequence. The final artwork must feel like a design-award-level premium tea brand detail page: hyper-real, clean, elegant, materially rich, highly unified, and visually expensive, with minimal English main titles and smaller Chinese subtitle support.

Brand and product:
Create a self-invented premium tea beverage company such as “AUREL TEA LAB”, “VELORA TEA WELL”, or “EMBER TEA RESERVE”. The hero product should remain a premium powdered tea latte or grain-tea shake style tea drink, perfectly suited to the original page logic. The packaging must feel luxury-grade, modern, healthy, and giftable, with refined cylindrical canister design, elegant label hierarchy, premium matte paper texture, subtle embossing, and precise print clarity.

Strict original page structure:
Preserve the original logic exactly:
Left column:
- top brand / badge / intro block
- middle hero product with one standing canister and one finished creamy tea drink
- lower nutrition or key-value strip
- bottom icon-based feature section

Center column:
- top quote-style brand statement block
- middle powder / tea blend macro block with percentage logic
- lower nutrient or function-circle cluster
- bottom product spill / powder reveal image

Right column:
- top ingredient-value / spoon-comparison block
- middle flavor and taste explanation block with finished drink visual
- bottom raw ingredient ratio / source comparison section

Do not change this structure into a homepage, collage, or different module order. It must remain a strict three-column product detail page.

Make the detail page feel more expensive:
This is critical. Upgrade the entire page into a higher luxury tier through:
- more refined negative space inside each module
- thinner, more elegant typography hierarchy
- more premium material rendering on product, powder, spoons, packaging, and ingredients
- calmer and more controlled section rhythm
- more precise alignment of numbers, icons, headings, and explanatory blocks
- less cheap “health product” feeling, more flagship brand editorial-commerce feeling
The page should feel like a collector-grade commercial detail page, not a generic marketplace layout.

Left column hero:

A stylish portrait of a woman bathing in the sea breeze with one hand resting against a utility pole on a clear, cloudless seaside road. Her hair and the thin shirt tied around her waist flutter in the wind, capturing a refreshing summer moment against the backdrop of the blue sky and the sea.

One hand touches the utility pole at head height, the upper body is arched backward, and the face is lifted upward. The other arm hangs naturally relaxed, and the legs are slightly crossed, forming a slender and elegant silhouette.

A coastal road with a continuous white guardrail, a calm blue sea, and a lush coastline and small town in the distance. The upper part of the frame is mostly occupied by a deep, clear blue sky, with thin layers of clouds spreading at a low altitude. Strong summer sunlight shines on the subject from diagonally above, creating bright highlights on the skin, hair, and white clothing. Clear-contoured natural shadows are cast at the feet.

Composition · Lens:

A thick utility pole is placed vertically at the right edge, echoing the subject's upward-reaching pose. A slight wide-angle feel looking up from the feet, extending the leg lines while emphasizing the negative space of the vast blue sky. The subject is in sharp focus, with the distant view slightly softened and blurred.

Texture · Style:
Realistic style summer fashion photography. Finely depicted natural skin texture and moderate gloss, wind-blown hair, thin fabric, ribbed material, metal utility pole, and asphalt texture. A palette of blue, white, and light aqua blue with a sense of transparency, avoiding excessive HDR or strong beauty filters.

prompts.text: A young East Asian woman in her 20s standing in front of a light gray-white seamless studio background, framed from the top of the head to below the hips. The subject is positioned slightly right of center, body in a two-thirds side-back view facing the left of the frame, back naturally straight, shoulders relaxed, waist slightly turned toward the camera. She looks down toward the bottom right of the frame, eyes not looking at the camera, lips naturally parted slightly, expression quiet, restrained, slightly melancholic and detached. The left arm near the camera hangs naturally, the other hand is placed gently across the waist and abdomen, fingers softly conforming to the fabric. She has a delicate, slightly elongated oval face, soft and clear jawline, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, a slender bridge of the nose, and low-saturation nude pink lips. Makeup is extremely light, with only thin base makeup, natural eyelashes, thin eyeliner, light gray-brown eyeshadow, and pale coral blush. Skin tone is fair with a neutral-warm undertone, retaining real pores, fine vellus hair, slight skin tone variations, and soft sebum highlights, no plastic airbrushing allowed. Deep brown-black hair styled in a loose, messy mid-low bun, with natural voluminous volume at the back of the head, thin wispy bangs at the forehead, a few long, slightly curly strands falling by the sides of the face, and natural flyaway hairs kept on the top of the head and around the edges of the bun. She wears a black sleeveless long dress with wide shoulder straps, a deep V front neckline and a large area low-back structure, with narrow elastic gathering at the waist, and the skirt naturally flaring out from the waist. The fabric is similar to lightweight taffeta, crinkled nylon, or semi-matte organza, with subtle transparent layers and irregular pleats, but key parts are fully covered by a matching color lining. The overall cut is minimalist, light, and restrained, with no patterns or brand logos. The background is a pure light cool gray to off-white gradient, without any props. A large softbox shines from the upper front-left of the frame, with a soft reflector used for fill light on the right, creating delicate highlights on the face, neck, shoulders, back, and arms, while the black fabric retains texture and layers. The overall tone is high-key, low-saturation, low-contrast, dominated by cool gray-white, black, and natural skin tones. Photography style: 85mm or 105mm portrait lens, f/2.8, eye-level slightly high camera angle, medium-shallow depth of field, focus on eyes, lips, hands, and shoulder-neck, real skin, hair, and wrinkled fabric texture, slight ISO200 film grain, Black Pro-Mist 1/8 softening, Japanese minimalist fashion editorial, quiet cinematic portrait, photorealistic. 她拥有精致偏长的鹅蛋脸、柔和清晰的下颌线、杏仁形深棕眼睛、自然细眉、纤细鼻梁和低饱和裸粉色嘴唇。妆容极淡，仅有轻薄底妆、自然睫毛、细眼线、浅灰棕眼影和淡珊瑚腮红。肤色白皙偏中性暖调，保留真实毛孔、细小绒毛、轻微肤色变化和柔和皮脂高光，禁止塑料磨皮。

The eyelids have low-saturation peach-pink and warm-brown residual makeup, the ends of the eyes are slightly smudged, eyes are downcast, not looking at the camera. The skin is cold-white and translucent but realistic, retaining pores, vellus hair, slight fatigue under the eyes, natural flush, and small skin tone differences; the luster on the forehead, cheeks, and neck is restrained, with no plastic-like continuous highlights.

Her black long hair is piled into a magnificent high bun, but the structure is already loose, with several slender hair strands scattered on the sides of her face and chest. She wears a large gold-plated phoenix crown, the crown body is located towards the back of the top of the head, the phoenix wings extend to the upper left and right, equipped with flower branches, pearls, small gold bells, and dense hanging chains. Several gold hairpins are inserted horizontally on the right side, one of which is lightly supported by her fingers; pearl tassels fall naturally behind the ears and the side of the neck.

She wears a low-saturation lotus-pink Tang-style tube top dress, with a transparent pink gauze large-sleeved robe draped over it, featuring very delicate gold thread floral embroidery on the chest, placket, and cuffs. The fabric is soft and thin, the sleeves naturally pile up on the edge of the dressing table, showing real gauze texture and small folds.

The foreground dressing table is a dark wood or leather-edged tabletop. At the bottom left is a short, thick candle that has clearly melted and is about to burn out; in the center are two stacked circular rouge boxes, one open to reveal dark red rouge; on the right lies a long gold hairpin that has already been removed and a few small gold ornaments. A blurred black-gold mirror stand or incense burner appears in the bottom right corner as a foreground obstruction.

Cold dawn light enters from between the curtains and lattice windows on the upper left, forming a distinct but soft cold blue-gray light band, illuminating the character's left forehead, bridge of the nose, cheeks, shoulders, and hair outlines. The residual candle at the bottom left provides warm gold fill light, illuminating the inner arm, the gold threads of the sleeves, the rouge box, and some gold ornaments. Cold light dominates, candle light only serves as small warm color accents, creating a sense of time as the night is about to end.

85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, face, fingers behind the ear, and the main body of the phoenix crown are clear, items on the table are slightly blurred, and background curtains and court space are completely soft focus. The screen colors are mainly low-saturation lotus pink, old gold, cold blue-gray, and dark brown, slight film grain, soft high dynamic range, details in the shadows, highlights not overexposed. Overall atmosphere is quiet, cold, restrained, fragile, and noble, the visual focus is the huge phoenix crown and loose hair strands in the cold morning light.

Avoid minors or juvenile characters, cheap ancient costume photo studio feel, modern accessories, modern makeup, internet celebrity plastic surgery faces, anime eyes, plastic skin, excessive exposure, wrong hands, abnormal number of fingers, hairpins penetrating the head, jewelry sticking together, floating phoenix crown, extra limbs, extra characters, multiple faces in the mirror, cluttered background, overexposure, over-saturation, text, logos, and watermarks.

她穿低饱和藕粉色唐风抹胸长裙，外披透明粉纱大袖衫，胸前、衣襟和袖口带有非常细腻的金线花卉刺绣。衣料柔软、轻薄，袖子自然堆叠在梳妆台边缘，展现真实纱织纹理与细小褶皱。

The hairstyle is black smooth long hair half-draped and half-tied, the hair strands are smooth and delicate, the top of the hair is moderately fluffy, part of the long hair falls naturally on the side of the shoulders and behind the back, and thin silver chains are interspersed between the hair, forming a light drooping feeling like star ornaments. The headwear grade is gorgeous, wearing a silver jewelry hair crown, thin chain step-shakes (Buyao), light purple gems, pearl tassels, small white jade ornaments, and star-patterned structural parts. The earrings are cold silver, pearl, and light purple gem long pendant styles. The overall look is gorgeous and exquisite but does not overwhelm the face. The clothing is a light gauze Xianxia layered dress, paired with a bead chain cover layer, belonging to the high-gorgeousness ancient style Xianxia female lead makeup and costume, using a light purple and silver-white color scheme, with misty purple, light purple, and extremely light soft misty purple as the main colors, and silver-white, moon-white, and pearl-white as auxiliary colors, with cold silver, pearls, light purple gems, and white jade cold light as embellishments. The shoulders, neck, chest, upper arms, or waist sides are covered with bead chain cover layers. The body of the garment has star patterns, flowing cloud patterns, star orbit patterns, small flower patterns, or Baoxiang flower pattern embroidery. The overall look is light, spiritual, gorgeous, and rich in the sense of a star-observing character.

The character is located at a high platform for star observation, with ancient style star map instruments and observatory structures beside her. The star map only serves as an atmosphere and plot prop and does not compete for the visual center of the character's face. The background is a blurred galaxy, clouds, observatory stone pillars, and star map light spots, with a deep blue-black night sky, silver-white starlight, soft cold light cloud layers, and background stone pillar outlines visible. The lighting is cold light from the star map combined with soft face light, with obvious highlights on fingers, jawline, clothing bead chains, silver ornaments, and thin chains. Special attention should be paid to the fact that light purple is only used for clothing and eye makeup echoes, and the background night sky must not be largely purple. The overall requirements are high precision, high completion, ethereal makeup, delicate hair strands, clear bead chain highlights, exquisite star map texture, the character as the absolute subject, with ancient style Xianxia, star-observing high platform, galaxy female lead, and character poster-level completion.

Overall composition:

2. Top-right panel: side-profile contour mapping portrait

9:16 vertical version, high-precision ancient style Xianxia lotus lamp female lead portrait, Tang style fantasy aesthetic, gorgeous refined character poster feel, the overall screen is gentle, sacred, noble, subtle, with a sense of compassion, featuring a prayer female lead atmosphere in a water palace lotus pond. The main subject is a young adult Oriental female, visual age about 20–28 years old, with natural and clear Oriental female characteristics, not Westernized, not child-like, not an internet celebrity face. She has a classical oval face, facial contours are soft and smooth, soft almond eyes, eyes are calm and gentle, stable and restrained, with a slight sense of compassion and holiness, the nose shape is elegant and natural, the lip shape is soft and clear, the overall presentation is a noble, elegant, and sacred ancient style Xianxia female lead temperament. Skin is fair and delicate, transparent and translucent, with a soft glow.

Makeup is apricot pink gentle makeup, makeup concentration is on the noble side, key emphasis on blush, lip makeup, and facial highlights. Base makeup is delicate and transparent, soft and smooth, with a slight cream luster; eye makeup is delicately blended with light apricot pink, soft warm brown, rice apricot, and extremely light pearlescent colors, strengthening the noble sense of soft almond eyes; eyeliner is meticulous and natural, eyelashes are long and distinct; blush is apricot pink, light peach pink, or warm apricot pink, distributed in the center of the face and cheeks, complexion is obvious but high-end; lip makeup is milky apricot pink, peach pink, light rose apricot pink, or soft bean paste pink, texture is full and hydrated, elegant and subtle; facial highlights brighten the bridge of the nose, tip of the nose, center of the face, under the eyes, and Cupid's bow, allowing the warm light of the lotus lamp and the reflection of the water surface to naturally reflect on the face. Expression is gentle and restrained, no sweet smile, not excessively cute.

Hairstyle is long black hair tied low, hair strands are smooth, the top of the head is naturally fluffy, part of the long hair falls softly on the side of the shoulders and back. Headwear level is heavy-duty, wearing a champagne gold hair crown, white jade lotus hair ornaments, pearl tassels, warm gold chain ornaments, detailed step-shakes, and warm jade ornaments, paired with pearls, white jade, and warm gold long pendant earrings, the overall is gorgeous and heavy-duty but not cluttered, with a sense of sacred ritual. Clothing is a palace-style ancient dress gown, belonging to a high-gorgeousness ancient style female lead makeup and costume, using an apricot white champagne gold color scheme, with apricot white, milky apricot white, and warm white as the main colors, soft rice white, light milk tea apricot, and pearl white as auxiliary colors, champagne gold, pearls, white jade, and a small amount of warm gold luster as embellishments. The dress structure is solemn and exquisite, the upper body is elegant, the chest line is naturally full, the outer layer has a translucent dress gauze layer, soft draped silk, and a ritualistic drooping structure, the clothing body has lotus patterns, flowing cloud patterns, baoxiang patterns, water ripple patterns, or soft vine pattern embroidery, the waist is equipped with champagne gold metal waist ornaments, soft pearl chains, white jade pendants, and pearl drooping structures, the overall is noble, holy, and soft.

The character is kneeling by the jade steps, hands gently holding up a lotus lamp, bust to three-quarter body close-up composition. The lotus lamp is located in front of the chest or slightly lower, emitting a soft warm light, the character's posture is dignified, subtle, and elegant. The scene is a water palace lotus pond, floating lotus lamps, beside the jade steps, the background is a blurred lotus pond, shadows of water palace pillars, floating lotus lamps, visible soft water ripples, jade white steps, distant pillar shadows, and large patches of lotus lamp bokeh. The lighting atmosphere is the warm light of the lotus lamp coordinated with the soft light on the face, the water surface reflection increases the dreamlike feeling, the character's face is clear and transparent, jewelry and fabric details have fine highlights. The overall picture must be bright, soft, and transparent, not dark, not dirty or gray. The character is the absolute visual center, the background is only responsible for creating a sacred and dreamlike atmosphere. Overall requirements are high precision, high completion, makeup showing clearly, clothing layers clear, headwear heavy-duty and exquisite, lotus lamp and water surface reflection natural, featuring ancient style Xianxia, water palace lotus pond, prayer female lead, and character poster level completion.

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium real estate architectural sales poster for a self-created international luxury property developer, merging a pristine architectural presentation drawing with a hyper-real built waterfront residence in one seamless vertical composition. The final image must feel quieter, more spacious, more collectible, and more luxurious, like a world-class campaign poster created jointly by a top architecture studio and an elite real estate brand. The built architecture must remain the absolute visual hero, while the upper drawing, labels, and typography reinforce precision, design authority, and premium lifestyle aspiration.

Brand identity:
Use a self-created international luxury real estate brand:
NORHAVEN ESTATE
Project name:
NORHAVEN LAKE PAVILION
Main headline:
LIVING IN PURE HORIZON
Supporting line:
Waterfront Residence Collection
All typography must be elegant English only, ultra-minimal, perfectly spaced, and integrated like part of a premium architectural board. No Chinese main title. No crude bold fonts. No cheap brochure styling.

Core composition:
Use a tall vertical poster with an extremely disciplined split hierarchy.
The upper half must contain a larger and cleaner field of pale mist-gray, soft mineral white, and warm silver-beige negative space, creating a rare sense of calm and architectural confidence.
Across this upper zone, place a highly refined architectural elevation or section drawing of the same residence, stretched horizontally and centered with elegant breathing room.
The drawing must use ultra-thin graphite-gray linework, subtle measurement marks, minimal technical notes, restrained callouts, and immaculate drafting rhythm.
The lower half must reveal the finished real architecture in hyper-real cinematic form, larger and more visually commanding than before, placed in a serene lakeside landscape.
The transition between upper concept and lower reality must feel seamless and intelligent.

Orbit + Transit enhancement:
Increase the amount of clean negative space in the upper composition and reduce annotation density further.
Make the technical drawing lighter, finer, more exact, and more expensive in feeling.
At the same time, upgrade the material language of the real residence toward a softer luxury palette: pale travertine or light mineral stone, subtle champagne-toned metal detailing, ultra-clear glazing, warm natural timber ceilings, refined concrete surfaces, and slim dark structural lines.
The overall result must feel like a collector-grade luxury real estate launch image with stronger breathing room, calmer prestige, and more international high-end residential character.

Architectural subject:
Design a world-class luxury waterfront residence or flagship sales pavilion for an elite property developer.
The architecture must feel believable, buildable, internationally premium, and deeply serene.
Use a long elegant roofline, ultra-thin slab geometry, floor-to-ceiling glass walls, pale stone or travertine surfaces, warm timber soffits, champagne metal trim, slender dark steel columns, and a minimal fireplace chimney element.
The building should feel light, disciplined, and rooted in the landscape without heaviness.
Its silhouette must be simple, iconic, and highly desirable.

Design representation:
The upper architectural drawing must feel exceptionally precise and beautiful.
Show a refined elevation or section view with measured proportions, interior hints, facade rhythm, structural thickness, glazing zones, and subtle dimensional annotation logic.
Use only minimal English labels and small technical note fragments.
The drawing must feel premium, airy, and museum-like, never crowded and never academic in a cheap way.

Real built architecture:
The lower architecture must translate the drawing into a flawless finished building.
Show the residence resting at the edge of a calm lake or quiet coastal inlet with a broad timber terrace extending toward the horizon.
The building should feel more monumental and slightly closer in scale, with warm interior glow visible through ultra-clear glass and elegant furniture silhouetted inside.
The terrace, roof edges, glass, and structure must all feel razor-clean and architecturally exact.

Environment:
Place the project in a pristine rocky waterfront setting with highly controlled natural beauty.
Include weathered shoreline stone, refined decking, soft grasses, subtle low vegetation, still water, distant misty tree silhouettes, and a pale atmospheric horizon.
Shift the environment toward a softer luxury morning mood with faint lake mist and luminous air.
Everything must remain minimal, premium, and visually clean.
No excessive props, no messy landscape, no visual distraction.

Lighting:
Use extremely soft misty morning light with a refined palette of pale gray, silver-white, soft ivory, and warm mineral beige.
Natural light must be diffused and gentle, softly revealing travertine texture, champagne metal sheen, timber warmth, and glass clarity.
Interior lighting should glow subtly and warmly, creating a calm aspirational atmosphere without overpowering the natural scene.
The full image must feel luminous, delicate, and expensive.

Material realism:
Render all materials with exceptional realism and restraint.
Travertine or pale stone must feel dense, smooth, and luxurious.
Champagne metal must feel satin-finished and refined.
Glass must feel ultra-clear, lightly reflective, and architecturally correct.
Timber ceilings and decking must feel warm, natural, and premium.
Rocks, shoreline textures, mist, water, and distant trees must all feel physically believable and immaculate.
The whole image must remain free of cheap rendering artifacts.

Typography and layout:
Integrate the text with perfect spacing discipline in the upper composition.
Include:
NORHAVEN ESTATE
NORHAVEN LAKE PAVILION
LIVING IN PURE HORIZON
Waterfront Residence Collection
Add only a few tiny English architectural notes and specification fragments around the drawing.
Typography must feel like part of the architecture system, not pasted over the image.

Visual hierarchy:
The composition must read in two refined layers:
1. upper technical drawing and brand system
2. lower hyper-real finished waterfront residence
The lower building must carry the emotional and commercial weight.
The upper drawing must add design intelligence, credibility, and luxury restraint.

prompts.text:
为一个自主创建的国际奢侈地产开发商创作一张超高端房地产建筑销售海报，将原始的建筑表现图与高度真实的建成滨水住宅融合在一个无缝的垂直构图中。最终图像必须感觉更安静、更宽敞、更具收藏价值且更奢华，就像是由顶尖建筑事务所和精英地产品牌联合创作的世界级竞选海报。建成建筑必须保持绝对的视觉主角地位，而上方的图纸、标注和排版则强化了精确度、设计权威和高端生活方式的追求。

品牌身份：
使用一个自主创建的国际奢侈房地产品牌：
NORHAVEN ESTATE
项目名称：
NORHAVEN LAKE PAVILION
主标题：
LIVING IN PURE HORIZON
辅助语：
Waterfront Residence Collection
所有排版必须仅使用优雅的英语，极简主义，间距完美，并像高端建筑展示板的一部分一样融合在一起。不要中文主标题。不要粗糙的加粗字体。不要廉价的画册风格。

核心构图：
使用具有极其严格分割层级的长竖版海报。
上半部分必须包含更大且更干净的浅雾灰色、柔和矿物白和暖银米色负空间区域，营造出一种罕见的冷静感和建筑自信。
横跨这个上部区域，放置同一住宅的高度精炼的建筑立面或剖面图，水平延伸并居中，留有优雅的呼吸空间。
图纸必须使用超细的石墨灰色线条、微妙的测量标记、极简的技术注释、克制的引出标注和完美的绘图节奏。
下半部分必须以超真实的电影感形式展现建成的真实建筑，比之前更大且更具视觉冲击力，放置在宁静的湖畔景观中。
上半部分概念与下半部分现实之间的过渡必须感觉无缝且智能。

Orbit + Transit 增强：
增加上部构图中干净负空间的数量，并进一步降低标注密度。
使技术图纸更轻、更精细、更准确，且在感官上更昂贵。
同时，将真实住宅的材料语言升级为更柔和的奢侈色调：浅色洞石或轻质矿物石、微妙的香槟色金属细节、超清晰玻璃、温暖的天然木质天花板、精炼的混凝土表面和纤细的深色结构线条。
整体结果必须感觉像是一张收藏级别的奢华房地产发布图像，具有更强的呼吸感、更冷静的声望和更多的国际高端住宅特色。

建筑主体：
为精英地产开发商设计一个世界级的奢华滨水住宅或旗舰销售展厅。
建筑必须感觉可信、可建造、国际高端且深邃宁静。
使用长而优雅的屋顶线、超薄板片几何形状、从地板到天花板的玻璃墙、浅色石材或洞石表面、温暖的木质檐口、香槟色金属装饰、纤细的深色钢柱和极简的壁炉烟囱元素。
建筑物应该感觉轻盈、克制，并植根于景观之中而不显得厚重。
其轮廓必须简单、标志性且极具吸引力。

设计表现：
上方的建筑图纸必须感觉异常精确和美观。
展示具有测量比例、内部暗示、立面节奏、结构厚度、玻璃区域和微妙尺寸标注逻辑的精炼立面或剖面视图。
仅使用极简的英文标签和少量的技术说明碎片。
图纸必须感觉高端、通透且像博物馆一样，绝不拥挤，也绝不以廉价的方式呈现学术感。

真实的建成建筑：
下方的建筑必须将图纸转化为完美的成品建筑。
展示住宅坐落在平静的湖边或宁静的海岸湾口边缘，宽阔的木质露台向地平线延伸。
建筑物应该感觉更加雄伟，尺度略微拉近，通过超清晰的玻璃可以看到内部散发出的柔和暖光，内部家具呈现出优雅的剪影。
露台、屋顶边缘、玻璃和结构都必须感觉极其干净且建筑学上精确。

环境：
将项目放置在具有高度受控自然美的纯净岩石滨水环境中。
包括风化的岸边石头、精制铺装、柔软的草丛、微妙的低矮植被、静水、远处模糊的树木剪影和浅色的带大气感的地平线。
将环境转向更柔和的奢侈清晨氛围，带有淡淡的湖雾和明亮的空气。
一切都必须保持极简、高端且视觉上整洁。
没有多余的道具，没有杂乱的景观，没有视觉干扰。

光影：
使用极度柔和的薄雾晨光，搭配浅灰色、银白色、柔和象牙色和暖矿物米色的精炼色调。
自然光必须是弥散且温和的，柔和地展现出洞石纹理、香槟色金属光泽、木材温暖感和玻璃透明度。
室内照明应微妙而温暖地闪烁，营造出冷静的向往氛围，而不会掩盖自然场景。
整张图像必须感觉明亮、细腻且昂贵。

材料真实感：
 render 所有材料与卓越的真实感和克制力。洞石或浅色石材必须感觉致密、平滑且奢华。香槟色金属必须感觉具有缎面效果且精制。玻璃必须感觉超清晰、轻微反射且在建筑学上正确。木质天花板和铺装必须感觉温暖、自然且高端。岩石、岸边纹理、雾气、水和远处的树木都必须感觉物理上可信且完美无瑕。整个图像必须没有任何廉价的渲染瑕疵。

排版与布局：
将文本以完美的间距准则整合在上部构图中。
包括：
NORHAVEN ESTATE
NORHAVEN LAKE PAVILION
LIVING IN PURE HORIZON
Waterfront Residence Collection
在图纸周围仅添加少量微小的英文建筑说明和规范片段。排版必须感觉像是建筑系统的一部分，而不是粘贴在图像上。

视觉层级：
构图必须以两个精炼的层级呈现：
1. 上部的技术图纸和品牌系统
2. 下部的高度真实的建成滨水住宅
下方的建筑必须承载情感和商业重量。上方的图纸必须增加设计智能、可信度和奢华的克制感。

氛围：
建筑的、极简的、奢华的、宽敞的、冷静的、智能的、具收藏价值的、滨水的、精炼的、宁静的、高端的、设计主导的、国际化的、柔和电影感的、永恒的

渲染风格：
超高端房地产销售海报，建筑立面与建成建筑的融合，收藏级滨水住宅竞选，巨大负空间，优雅的英文排版，超细技术图纸，浅色洞石和香槟色金属材料，薄雾清晨湖畔氛围，温暖室内光泽，世界级建筑品牌图像，8k，博物馆级真实感

他们看起来过热但又感到解脱，仿佛风扇将他们从夏日的酷暑中拯救出来。

氛围应该是可爱的、舒适的、温暖的、清爽的、俏皮的，并且适合社交媒体。

最重要的情绪：

这不是一张冷静的肖像。

这是一个可爱的“太热了，终于在风扇前凉快下来”的时刻。

图像应清楚地显示夏日的炎热、轻微的汗水、来自风扇的风以及清爽的反应。

身体比例方向：

- 让写实的人物看起来娇小、紧凑、可爱、骨架小
- 避免模特般的高大比例
- 避免长腿或拉长的身体比例
- 不要让真人看起来高大或像时装模特
- 保持坐姿紧凑且可爱
- 使用低矮舒适的地板坐姿构图，而不是站立的时装肖像
- 真人应该感觉明显是成年人，但可爱、平易近人且骨架小

真人：

- 写实人物摄影
- 与上传的参考图具有相同的可识别身份
- 保留参考图中的相同发型、发色、可见配饰、服装和整体造型方向
- 自然地坐在地板、编织垫或低矮舒适的室内场所
- 紧挨着或稍微在毛绒玩偶后面坐着
- 面向电风扇
- 嘴巴微张，仿佛在说“啊，好凉快”
- 表情应该是可爱的、解脱的、清爽的，并且因炎热而略显疲惫
- 使用明亮的眼睛、柔和的腮红、细微可见的汗水、放松的脸颊和可爱的张嘴清爽表情
- 脸部应该感觉像是：“天太热了，但这风扇感觉太棒了。”
- 不要让脸部空白、僵硬、毫无表情、冷漠或严肃
- 额头、脸颊或脖子上有轻微的汗水
- 因受热而产生的微妙红晕
- 头发和衣服被风扇轻轻吹动
- 自然的皮肤纹理
- 清晰的写实感，而非卡通感

毛绒玩偶版本：

- 上传人物的可爱毛绒玩偶版本
- 毛绒玩偶必须明显地像真人
- 相似性应源自发型形状、发色、面部氛围、可见配饰线索、服装颜色暗示以及整体角色印象
- 柔软圆润的毛绒身体
- 柔软的织物纹理
- 刺绣或简化的可爱眼睛和嘴巴
- 脸颊上有柔和的腮红
- 微小的毛绒手脚
- 圆润的可拥抱比例
- 手工制作毛绒玩具的收藏感
- 可爱、天真、迷人且略带幽默
- 它应该清楚地感觉像是“毛绒版的我”
- 毛绒玩偶应该看起来稍微有生命力，仿佛它也在对风扇做出反应
- 毛绒玩偶面向风扇，带着小小的张嘴清爽表情
- 玩偶的小胳膊可能会稍微抬起或可爱地垂放，正享受着微风

items.title: 顶级国际豪宅建筑销售海报设计

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium real estate architectural sales poster for a self-created international luxury property developer, combining the clean authority of an elite architectural presentation board with the emotional refinement of a world-class luxury residence campaign. The composition must preserve a strong vertical hierarchy with vast atmospheric negative space, a floating exploded architectural line diagram in the upper sky, and a hyper-real built landmark anchored below. The final image must feel calmer, more collectible, more spacious, and more luxurious, with the architecture remaining the absolute visual hero.

Brand identity:
Use a self-created international luxury real estate brand:
LUMERA LAND
Project name:
LUMERA HORIZON PAVILION
Main headline:
DESIGNED FOR THE FUTURE OF LIVING
Supporting line:
Flagship Sales Gallery and Residence Vision
All typography must be elegant English only, highly restrained, beautifully spaced, and integrated like a premium architectural identity system. No Chinese headline. No crude bold fonts. No noisy brochure styling.

Core composition:
Use a tall vertical poster with an extremely disciplined top-heavy structure.
The upper two-thirds of the image must be dominated by a vast sky field with expanded negative space, creating a strong sense of calm, rarity, and architectural confidence.
Use a soft pale silver-blue, misty pearl, and cool warm-gray atmospheric gradient, cleaner and more luminous than before.
At the upper center, place a floating exploded architectural diagram rendered in ultra-thin white linework, with several separated building layers suspended in precise vertical alignment.
The line drawing must feel lighter, finer, more elegant, and more technically beautiful, with increased spacing between layers and more air around the diagram.
At the top center, integrate the brand and headline in a refined premium layout with strong breathing room.
The lower third must reveal the completed architecture in hyper-real cinematic form, monumental yet calm, grounded in a pristine urban frontage.

Architectural subject:
Design a flagship luxury sales pavilion and branded residential showcase building for a premium real estate developer.
The building must feel internationally high-end, buildable, iconic, and highly desirable.
Use a sculptural contemporary form with softened corners, disciplined massing, elegant vertical facade fins, pale mineral stone, champagne-toned metal detailing, ultra-clear glass, and warm interior architectural glow.
The building should feel more residential-luxury and hospitality-grade, less commercial and less generic.
Its silhouette must remain simple, confident, and memorable.

Transit + Orbit enhancement:
Push the image toward a more spacious collector-grade presentation.
Increase the clean sky area and reduce visual noise even further.
Make the exploded line diagram more delicate, more sparse, and more precise, with thinner drafting lines, cleaner layer separation, and subtler construction guides.
At the same time, shift the material language of the real building into a warmer, more refined luxury palette: pale stone, soft champagne metal, warm timber undertones, and crystal-clear glazing.
The result must feel like a top-tier global luxury real estate launch image, where technical design intelligence and emotional premium atmosphere are perfectly balanced.

Design representation:
The floating exploded architectural diagram must clearly correspond to the building below.
Show multiple horizontal layers separated elegantly in space, as if the project is being revealed through a refined architectural thinking process.
The linework must be extremely accurate, graceful, and minimal.
Include only subtle technical trace lines, tiny specification accents, and refined drafting logic.
The diagram should feel almost weightless in the sky, like a museum-grade architectural sketch.

Environment:
Place the built architecture in a pristine urban frontage with a broad open street and a lightly reflective ground plane.
The environment should feel freshly washed, calm, and expensive, with very controlled reflections and minimal clutter.
Include only a few understated pedestrians and a small number of refined vehicles for scale.
Add very limited edge landscaping or distant urban context, keeping the building visually dominant.
Everything must feel clean, organized, and premium.

Lighting:
Use extremely soft post-rain morning light or refined bright overcast luxury daylight.
The sky must feel luminous and airy, with very delicate diffusion and no harsh sun.
The architecture should receive soft, even natural light with subtle highlights along the champagne metal details, stone planes, and glass edges.
Interior light should glow gently, hinting at warmth and prestige.
The lighting must feel polished, realistic, calm, and expensive, never harsh, never artificial.

Material realism:
Render every material with exceptional realism and precision.
Pale stone must feel dense, smooth, and luxurious.
Champagne metal must feel refined, satin-finished, and premium.
Glass must feel ultra-clear, lightly reflective, and architecturally accurate.
The vertical fins must have razor-clean rhythm and believable depth.
Wet pavement, road markings, curb lines, and distant urban edges must all feel physically real and impeccably controlled.
The image must remain immaculate and free of cheap rendering artifacts.

Visual hierarchy:
The poster must read in three elegant layers:
1. refined title typography at the top
2. floating exploded architectural line diagram in the vast sky field
3. hyper-real flagship architecture anchored below
This hierarchy must feel balanced, airy, intelligent, and powerful.
The architecture must remain the anchor, while the diagram adds design authority and aspirational value.

Typography and layout:
Integrate the following text at the top center in elegant English typography:
LUMERA LAND
LUMERA HORIZON PAVILION
DESIGNED FOR THE FUTURE OF LIVING
Flagship Sales Gallery and Residence Vision
Add only a few tiny English specification notes if needed.
Typography must feel premium, sparse, architectural, and inseparable from the composition.

Mood:
architectural, luxurious, refined, spacious, intelligent, calm, premium, international, collectible, aspirational, elegant, design-led, landmark-driven, softly cinematic, hospitality-grade

Rendering style:
ultra-premium real estate launch poster, vast atmospheric negative space, floating exploded architectural diagram, ultra-thin white drafting lines, hyper-real luxury sales pavilion, pale stone and champagne metal materials, reflective wet street, elegant English typography, calm luminous daylight, world-class architectural branding image, 8k, museum-grade realism

Negative prompt:
cheap brochure design, ugly bold fonts, generic mall advertisement, cluttered infographic layout, fantasy architecture, dirty city background, excessive people, cheap commercial look, low-detail facade, weak line drawing, inaccurate exploded diagram, oversaturated sky, HDR glare, cartoon rendering, plastic materials, chaotic composition, noisy reflections

prompts.text:
为一个自主创办的国际奢侈房地产开发商创建一个超高级的房地产建筑销售海报，结合了精英建筑展示板的干练权威感与世界级奢侈住宅营销的情感精致感。构图必须保持强大的纵向层级感，拥有广阔的大气留白，上方天空中漂浮着建筑分解线框图，下方锚定一个超写实的建成地标。最终的图像必须感觉更平静、更具收藏价值、更宽敞且更奢华，建筑保持绝对的视觉主角。

品牌标识：
使用一个自主创办的国际奢侈房地产品牌：
LUMERA LAND
项目名称：
LUMERA HORIZON PAVILION
主标题：
DESIGNED FOR THE FUTURE OF LIVING
副标题：
Flagship Sales Gallery and Residence Vision
所有排版必须仅采用优雅的英语，高度克制，间距优美，并像高级建筑标识系统一样融合。不要中文标题。不要粗糙的粗体字。不要嘈杂的宣传册样式。

核心构图：
使用具有极度自律的“头重脚轻”结构的纵向长海报。
图像的上三分之二必须由广阔的天空区域主导，并扩大留白空间，营造出一种强烈的冷静感、稀缺感和建筑自信感。
使用柔和的浅银蓝色、雾珍珠色和冷暖灰色大气渐变，比以前更干净、更明亮。
在上方中心位置，放置一个由超细白色线条渲染的漂浮建筑分解图，几个分离的建筑层精确地垂直排列悬浮。
线条图必须感觉更轻盈、更精细、更优雅、更具技术美感，层与层之间的间距增大，图表周围有更多空气感。
在顶部中心，将品牌和标题整合到精致的高级布局中，并留有强大的呼吸空间。
下三分之一必须以超写实的电影化形式展示落成的建筑，宏伟而平静，扎根于纯净的城市临街面。

建筑主体：
为一家高级房地产开发商设计一座旗舰级奢侈销售展馆和品牌住宅展示建筑。
建筑必须感觉国际化高端、可建造、具有标志性且极具吸引力。
采用带有柔化边角的雕塑感现代形式，克制的体量感，优雅的垂直立面格栅，浅色矿物石材，香槟色金属细节，超白玻璃以及温暖的室内建筑光泽。
建筑应更具住宅奢侈感和酒店级品质，减少商业感和通用感。
其轮廓必须保持简洁、自信且令人难忘。

转换 + 轨道增强：
将图像推向更宽敞的收藏级呈现。
增加洁净的天空区域，并进一步减少视觉噪点。
让分解线条图更细腻、更稀疏、更精确，使用更细的绘图线、更干净的层级分离和更微妙的辅助线。
同时，将真实建筑的材料语言转向更温暖、更精致的奢侈色调：浅色石材、柔和的香槟金金属、温暖的木纹底色和水晶般清澈的玻璃。
结果必须感觉像顶级的全球奢侈房地产发布图像，技术设计智慧与情感高端氛围完美平衡。

设计表现：
漂浮的建筑分解图必须与下方的建筑清晰对应。
展示在空间中优雅分离的多个水平层，仿佛项目正在通过精致的建筑思考过程被揭示。
线条必须极其精确、优雅且极简。
仅包含微妙的技术追踪线、微小的规格标注和精致的绘图逻辑。
图表在天空中应感觉几乎没有重量，像博物馆级的建筑草图。

环境：
将落成的建筑置于一个纯净的城市临街面，拥有宽阔开放的街道和轻微反射的地面。
环境应感觉像是刚洗刷过一样，平静且昂贵，具有非常有节制的反射和极少的杂乱。
仅包含少数低调的行人和少量精致的车辆以体现比例感。
添加非常有限的边缘景观或遥远的城市背景，保持建筑在视觉上的主导地位。
一切都必须感觉干净、有序且高端。

光照：
使用极度柔和的雨后清晨光线或精致明亮的阴天奢侈日光。
天空必须感觉明亮且通风，散发出非常微妙的漫反射，没有刺眼的阳光。
建筑应接收柔和均匀的自然光，沿香槟色金属细节、石材平面和玻璃边缘有微妙的高光。
室内灯光应轻轻闪烁，暗示温暖与尊贵。
光照必须感觉抛光、逼真、平静且昂贵，绝不刺眼，绝不人造。

材料真实感：
以非凡的真实感和精度渲染每种材料。
浅色石材必须感觉致密、平滑且奢华。
香槟色金属必须感觉精致、缎面处理且高级。
玻璃必须感觉超清晰、轻微反射且符合建筑精度。
垂直格栅必须具有如剃刀般干净的节奏感和可信的深度。
湿润的路面、道路标记、路缘线和远处的城市边缘都必须感觉物理真实且控制得无可挑剔。
图像必须保持完美，没有廉价的渲染瑕疵。

视觉层级：
海报必须分为三个优雅的层级进行阅读：
1. 顶部精致的标题排版
2. 广阔天空区域中漂浮的建筑分解线框图
3. 下方锚定的超写实旗舰建筑
这种层级感必须感觉平衡、空灵、智慧且强大。
建筑必须保持锚定地位，而图表则增加了设计权威感和愿景价值。

排版与布局：
在顶部中心整合以下优雅英语排版的文本：
LUMERA LAND
LUMERA HORIZON PAVILION
DESIGNED FOR THE FUTURE OF LIVING
Flagship Sales Gallery and Residence Vision
如果需要，仅添加少量微小的英语规格说明。
排版必须感觉高端、稀疏、具有建筑感，并且与构图融为一体。

氛围：
建筑感、奢华、精致、宽敞、智慧、冷静、高端、国际化、收藏级、令人向往、优雅、设计主导、地标驱动、柔和电影感、酒店级

渲染风格：
超高级房地产发布海报，广阔的大气留白空间，漂浮的建筑分解图，超细白色绘图线条，超写实奢侈销售展馆，浅色石材和香槟色金属材料，反射性湿润街道，优雅的英语排版，冷静明亮的日光，世界级建筑品牌图像，8k，博物馆级真实感

负面提示词：
廉价宣传册设计，丑陋的粗体字，普通的商场广告，杂乱的信息图布局，幻想建筑，肮脏的城市背景，过多的人物，廉价的商业外观，低细节立面，虚弱的线条画，不准确的分解图，过饱和的天空，HDR 强光，卡通渲染，塑料材料，混乱的构图，嘈杂的反射

Build a report-type PPT that juxtaposes large-scale documentary photography with clear information architecture, with the internationalist layout system as the main axis: use modular grids and baseline grids to lock column widths, margins, title and body rhythms; use Gestalt law of proximity and common areas to cluster content into scannable blocks; use editorial rhythm to create tension and relaxation between main visual pages, white-space information pages, and multi-column data pages. Borrow Josef Müller-Brockmann's asymmetric mathematical grid to govern alignment, Alexey Brodovitch's radical cropping, image scale, and white space to create narrative pauses, Massimo Vignelli's limited fonts and unified components to maintain consistency throughout the set, and Josef Albers' adjacent color field relationships to calibrate the recognition of chapter color tabs and information cards, with each method managing one domain without mechanical imitation. Establish replaceable color roles: main visual field accounts for 55%—70%, medium-dark values, medium-high saturation, and retaining natural light and dark levels; paper background accounts for 20%—35%, high brightness, low saturation; structural text accounts for 8%—15%, ensuring clear projection with extreme light-dark contrast; chapter coding and key prompts together account for 3%—8%, using multiple groups of equally-weighted high-purity colors to produce temperature and saturation jumps between adjacent modules. Future themes or brand colors are mapped item by item according to main visual, background, text, coding, and prompts, replaced once while maintaining area proportions, brightness sequences, chromaticity differences, adjacency relationships, and contrast intensity. Pages run on asymmetric multi-column grids: theme pages let high-angle top-down documentary photography become the main quality, placed within large rounded corner boundaries, forming three-stage reading with small logos, theme titles, and oversized time information; content pages combine column text, equal-height cards, and edge-aligned narrow chapter color tabs in wide outer margins, allowing a single title or photograph to break across columns; the bottom edge of the information card is gathered with a single-pointing folded corner, the first reading is the title or focal image, the second reading is the summary, and the third reading is the details. Photography uses real ambient light, subtle grains, and brightness compression from near to far, performing natural tone correction first, then cropping with rounded corner masks, retaining edge details and local highlights; information pages use textureless matte backgrounds, overlaying low-transparency outline numbers, single-line geometric icons, and thin color bars, synthesized in the order of background, image or card, structural lines, text, and coding. Adopt coordinated pairings of same-skeleton geometric sans-serifs: display characters are oversized, bold-narrow, tightly tracked, and can cross columns, partially turning into hollow outlines, forming character-image overlapping with photography; the body text uses regular weight and higher line spacing, and the caption text is smaller but with wider letter spacing. Chinese and English font sizes are aligned by optical blackness rather than nominal size, correcting optical margins for numbers, full-width punctuation, and rounded boundaries, and the body text avoids complex images. The overall presentation is credible, clear, pragmatic, open, organic, and action-oriented.

items.title: 现代东方女性梦境立体剪纸艺术海报

prompts.text:
9:16 vertical version, modern Eastern woman dream 3D paper cut art, modern Eastern paper cut art, layered paper cut illustration, 3D paper sculpture, exquisite paper carving, paper carving landscape, poetic female dream, contemporary Eastern art poster.

The theme of the work is "Wind turns the next page for her." A young woman has already stepped onto a path of paper pages leading to the distance. Before continuing forward, she briefly looks back at the old chapters behind her. This backward glance is not hesitation, but a quiet farewell; in the next moment, she will still turn and walk toward the new world.

The main character is an Eastern adult female with a visual age of about 24, clear-headed and independent, bright and brave, with a sense of lightness and freedom. Classical oval face, clear almond eyes, relaxed brows, the body is already facing the distance, but the face looks back toward the camera direction, the gaze is calm and clear, and the corners of the mouth have a very slight sense of relief.

Long black hair tied low, long hair and a few strands of hair are blown horizontally to the left side of the frame by the wind, wearing simple light gold leaf hair accessories. The character wears a moon white and cyan-green layered paper art long dress, the skirt is composed of a large number of hollowed-out paper pieces and soft paper ribbons, with warm gold patterns partially embellished, and the tail of the skirt is blown to the side and back by the wind to form a wide arc expansion.

The overall structure adopts a paper page path style. The character stands on the paper page stairs in the lower middle of the frame, with her body facing away from the camera and slightly turned, one foot on a higher step, forming a pause in the process of moving forward. The waist and shoulders face the road ahead, and the head turns back to look behind, forming a clear backward-glancing posture. One hand gently lifts the skirt or paper art shawl, and the other hand naturally expands toward the side and back, echoing the floating paper pages.

A canyon formed by huge folded book pages expands upward from both sides of the character, the edges of the pages are significantly turned up, curled and flying, forming a strong dynamic of being flipped by the wind. The foreground pages behind the character are denser, symbolizing the old chapters that have already been turned; the paper page path in front of the character is brighter and more open, winding all the way up along the valley to high places.

Floating book pages, flying birds, distant mountains, cloud layers, a paper page path leading to the distance and a small amount of starlight appear in the frame. All scenery uses a unified language of paper cutting, paper sculpture and paper layering.

The overall colors are mainly moon white, cyan-green and warm gold, with a small amount of coral pink scattered in the foreground paper pages and plant silhouettes as visual finishing touches. Keep colors clear and separated, not overall yellowish, and do not use a unified warm color filter.

Golden morning light shines in from the upper left, forming soft golden edges on the character's face profile, hair, shoulders and flying skirt. Large areas of paper pages show warm white light, and clear fibers, thickness, cutting textures, hollowed-out plant patterns and natural bends are visible on the paper surface. Different layers produce delicate spatial shadows.

Strengthen the narrative of "looking back at the past, but continuing forward." The character's face must be clear, the angle of the backward glance natural and elegant, the paper page path must clearly lead to the distance, and the overall look should remain bright, high-end, ethereal and have a strong poster feel, without text.

prompts.text:
9:16竖版，现代东方女性梦境立体剪纸艺术，现代东方剪纸艺术，层叠剪纸插图，立体纸雕，精致纸雕刻，纸雕景观，诗意女性梦境，当代东方艺术海报。

作品主题为“风替她翻开下一页”。一位年轻女性已经踏上通往远方的纸页道路，在继续前行前，她短暂回头看向身后的旧篇章。这个回眸不是犹豫，而是一场安静的告别，下一刻她仍会转身走向新的世界。

主体人物为视觉年龄约24岁的东方成年女性，清醒独立、明亮勇敢，带一点轻盈自由感。古典鹅蛋脸，清亮杏眼，眉眼舒展，身体已经朝向远方，面部却回望镜头方向，眼神平静清醒，嘴角带极浅的释然感。

黑色长发低挽，长发和几缕发丝被风横向吹向画面左侧，佩戴简洁浅金叶片发饰。人物穿月白与青绿色层叠纸艺长裙，裙摆由大量镂空纸片和柔软纸带组成，局部点缀暖金纹样，裙尾被风吹向侧后方形成宽大的弧形展开。

整体采用纸页道路式结构。人物站在画面中下部的纸页阶梯上，身体背向镜头并略微侧转，一只脚位于较高一级阶梯，形成正在前进过程中的停顿。腰身和肩膀朝向道路前方，头部回转看向身后，形成清晰的回眸姿态。一只手轻轻提住裙摆或纸艺披帛，另一只手自然向侧后方展开，与漂浮纸页形成呼应。

由巨大折叠书页形成的峡谷从人物两侧向上展开，纸页边缘大幅翘起、卷曲和翻飞，形成被风翻动的强烈动态。人物身后的近景纸页较密，象征已经翻过的旧篇章；人物前方的纸页道路则更加明亮、开阔，并沿着山谷一路向高处蜿蜒延伸。

画面中出现漂浮书页、飞鸟、远山、云层、通往远方的纸页道路与少量星点。所有景物使用统一的剪纸、纸雕和纸张层叠语言。

整体色彩为月白、青绿、暖金为主，少量珊瑚粉散落在前景纸页与植物剪影中作为视觉点睛。保持颜色清透分离，不整体偏黄，不使用统一暖色滤镜。

清晨金色光线从左上方照入，在人物面部侧缘、头发、肩部和飞扬裙摆上形成柔和金边。大片纸页透出暖白光，纸张表面可见清晰纤维、厚度、裁切纹理、镂空植物纹样以及自然弯折。不同层次产生细腻的空间投影。

强化“回望过去，但继续向前”的叙事。人物面部必须清晰，回眸角度自然优雅，纸页道路必须明显通向远方，整体保持明亮、高级、空灵且具有强烈海报感，不出现文字。

Wall finish and cleanliness:

- one accents and decor block

warm greige, taupe, mineral beige, soft walnut, parchment cream, muted sand, smoked bronze, and shadowed brown.

Lighting realism:

No dirty gray-black buildup, no artificial vignette, no over-sharpened edges, no harsh hotspot lighting.

Styling realism:

The rug, pouf, ceramics, framed art, and small decor objects must feel minimal and intentional.

Typography and layout:

Visual hierarchy:

prompts.text:
为一家自创的国际奢华地产开发商创建一张超高端房地产室内销售海报，设计为精致的编辑风格卧室展示板，将占主导地位的超真实主卧场景与优雅的规划图表、材料调色板、家具产品展示和微妙的价格信息相结合。将整体图像推向更冷静、更成熟、更具国际奢华感的住宅身份，同时在整个卧室场景中加入更柔和、更细腻、更高级的光影氛围。最终的艺术作品必须让人感到宁静、昂贵、具有建筑感且值得收藏，就像世界级奢华住宅系列的旗舰主卧发布海报。

品牌标识：
使用一个自创的国际奢华室内品牌：
VELORA PRIVATE INTERIORS
项目名称：
VELORA MASTER SUITE
主标题：
QUIETLY COMPOSED.
副标题：
A Private Bedroom Collection for Elevated Living.
所有排版必须仅使用优雅的英文，经过艺术指导，间距美观，并作为高端室内品牌系统的一部分进行整合。不含中文标题。不含粗俗的粗体。不含廉价的目录风格。

核心构图：
使用长垂直海报，采用高度严谨的编辑拆分布局。
左侧必须由一张放大的英雄卧室图像占据大部分构图。
右侧必须是一个干净的高端信息列，包含简约的房间平面图、色彩调色板、材料和纹理、墙面艺术参考以及装饰点缀。
底部增加一个精致的产品带，单独展示关键卧室单品，并配有微小的优雅标签和低调的极简价格备注。
整张海报必须感觉比零售家具单页更冷静、更宽敞、更高端，更像国际奢华卧室发布封面。

轨道增强：
放大英雄卧室场景，使其在视觉上更具统领力。
减少次要噪音，保持每个支持信息块更清晰、更安静、更精炼。
增加排版、色块、产品项目和引导线之间的呼吸空间。
构图必须具有更强的层次感和更多的奢侈克制感，仿佛是为全球高端住宅发布活动而创作。

国际主卧方向：
将风格转向更稳定、更成熟、全球精炼的奢华卧室氛围。
使用由暖灰褐色、矿物米色、石头灰褐色、柔和胡桃木色、软燕麦色、烟熏青铜色、羊皮纸奶油色和阴影摩卡色组成的复杂调色板。
避免过度甜腻、装饰性或随意的卧室风格。
最终的空间必须感觉像是超高端示范住宅中的主卧套房：安静、定制、具有建筑感且情感价值昂贵。

英雄卧室场景：
展示一个超真实的奢华主卧，软垫床位于精致的柔和石膏墙中央。
使用雕刻感的软垫床头板，分层的高端床上用品（灰褐色、暖灰色、摩卡色、羊皮纸色和暖象牙色），优雅的胡桃木床头柜，编织长凳或坐垫，床头上方微妙的艺术品，以及一盏具有手工纹理的精致吊灯或吸顶灯。
加入柔软的窗帘、中性色地毯、克制的陶瓷和精致的植物枝条。
房间必须感觉真实、国际精英化且深沉宁静。
灯光和造型必须强调静谧的奢华、高端的舒适和建筑的和谐。

奶油色高级光影过渡：
使用极度柔和的漫反射日光，带有丝滑的奶油色调过渡。
自然光应穿过薄纱窗帘，以平滑、天鹅绒般连续的方式散布在床上用品、墙壁、木材表面、地毯和装饰品上。
床上用品必须展现出柔软的奶油色高光衰减，没有强烈的对比，也没有暗淡的灰色扁平感。
窗帘必须发出柔和的光芒，具有半透明的柔软感和优雅的分层深度。
石膏墙必须感觉明亮、干净且如黄油般顺滑，带有微妙的矿物质纹理，但没有污点、没有脏痕、没有突然的阴影带。
胡桃木或暖色木质表面必须接收到细腻的反射光，展示出柔和的纹理、缎面深度和静谧的奢华，而没有刺眼的眩光。
所有高光到阴影的过渡必须感觉像奶油般细腻、渐进且高端，如同高端住宅品牌的顶级室内摄影。
没有压碎的黑色，没有泥泞的暗区，没有斑驳的墙面阴影，没有突然的光线断裂。

墙面处理和整洁度：
墙面和所有大型背景表面必须完美干净、精炼且高端。
去除所有深色污点、烟熏痕迹、不均匀的染色、黑色斑块、灰色污染和脏污的低光伪影。
仅保留极度微妙、优雅的石膏纹理，具有平滑的色调连续性。

设计表达：
右侧信息列必须包括：
- 极简卧室平面图
- 精炼的色彩调色板带
- 材料和纹理部分
- 一个墙面艺术参考块
- 一个点缀和装饰块
所有图表和标签必须感觉极其干净、标准且美观。
加入超微妙的设计细节元素，如淡淡的布局引导线、微小的饰面代码和细分隔线。
一切都必须保持稀疏、优雅和高端。

家具和产品行：
在底部，在干净的背景上展示来自同一卧室构图的隔离关键单品：
- 软垫床
- 床头柜
- 床头柜
- 编织坐垫或长凳
- 吊灯
- 装饰花瓶或落地灯
每个项目应具有：
- 优雅的英文产品名称
- 微小的单行规格说明
- 极其微妙的极简价格备注
价格备注必须感觉像奢侈品目录的微缩文案，绝不具促销感，绝不吵闹。

材料和颜色方向：
使用成熟的全球奢华卧室调色板：
暖灰褐色、灰褐色、矿物米色、柔软胡桃木色、羊皮纸奶油色、柔和沙色、烟熏青铜色和阴影褐色。
织物必须感觉致密、柔软且高端。
木材必须感觉温暖且静谧昂贵。
石膏必须感觉如天鹅绒般且具有建筑感。
金属装饰必须感觉是缎面处理且克制的。
整个色调必须传达稳定性、舒适性、持久性和国际化的精致。

灯光真实感：
保持整个图像足够明亮，以保留光影中的材料细节。
暗区必须保持可见性、柔软度、纹理和色调丰富度。
没有脏污的灰黑色堆积，没有人造暗角，没有过度锐化的边缘，没有生硬的热点照明。
卧室必须感觉柔和明亮、自然通透且极度宁静。

造型真实感：
以卓越的真实感渲染每个细节。
床上用品必须感觉有层次感、有分量、柔软且触手及及。
窗帘必须感觉轻盈且流线。
木质家具必须感觉工艺精湛。
地毯、坐垫、陶瓷、裱框艺术品和小型装饰物品必须感觉极简且有意为之。
不凌乱，没有廉价酒店造型，没有过度的装饰。

排版和布局：
整合：
VELORA PRIVATE INTERIORS
VELORA MASTER SUITE
QUIETLY COMPOSED.
A Private Bedroom Collection for Elevated Living.
使用优雅的纯英文排版，具有强大的编辑间距和精炼的全球奢华美学。
所有微缩文案、产品标签和价格备注必须感觉是统一高端品牌系统的一部分。

视觉层级：
观看者必须首先阅读放大的英雄卧室场景。
其次是右侧的规划和调色板列。
第三是底部的家具产品带。
第四是微妙的价格和饰面细节系统。
海报必须始终感觉像是以空间宁静、收藏级家具和国际住宅品味为中心的奢华地产卧室销售视觉效果。

氛围：
卧室、奢华、成熟、国际化、宁静、定制、触感、建筑感、高端、冷静、优雅、奶油色光影、收藏级、向往感、高端住宅

超高端卧室销售海报、旗舰编辑风格主卧套房板、放大的英雄卧室图像、干净的右侧材料和规划列、底部家具产品带、暖灰褐色和胡桃木色调、奶油色漫反射日光、丝滑阴影过渡、无瑕石膏墙、优雅英文排版、微妙奢华价格显示、世界级室内品牌形象、8k、博物馆级真实感

prompts.text:

Her upper body leans subtly toward the lens. Her head is turned to the side and slightly upward, as if looking off into the distance beyond the camera. Her neck and collarbones are visible, and her posture creates a graceful elegant silhouette. Her free arm rests naturally along her body or lightly near her waist.

Emphasize strong low-angle perspective and believable foreshortening:

The figure's own right forearm is placed along the inside of the right thigh, the left forearm is placed diagonally above the left thigh, arms hanging naturally without overlapping low between the knees. The upper body leans slightly forward, shoulders slightly tucked, face tilted slightly to the figure's own left, while looking directly at the camera.

Character · Expression:
Small oval face, bright ivory skin, slender light brown eyebrows, large hazel pupils, long eyelashes with detailed eyeliner, pale rose pink blush, glossy coral-beige lips. Lips slightly parted, casting a calm and straight gaze at the camera. Hair is bright ash brown below chest length, with thin bangs and long strands at the temples, braided from the top towards the sides and tied into a high ponytail at the back of the head. A long hair strand flows from the figure's own left shoulder to the back. Dazzling pearl earrings on the ears, a thin silver chain with a small single pendant around the neck. Soft sunlight through the trees sprinkles on the top of the head, cheeks, shoulders, and arms.

Clothing · Pose:
Off-white (Kinari) ribbed knit halter top. Wide fabric connected to the back of the neck, deep V-neckline, decorated with fine lace trim on both sides, crossed with multiple thin strings at the front center, fitting tightly to the body up to above the waist. The bottom is a white asymmetrical mini skirt, with multiple metal snaps and thin belts at the waist, a large fabric knot and stepped ruffles on the figure's own left waist, and a long white strap with a silver square buckle hanging from the right waist. White ribbed loose socks are worn loosely from the ankles to the lower calves on both legs. Shoes are black leather lace-up platform shoes, round-toe design, black laces, metal eyelets, extremely thick stepped soles and chunky heels. Slender fingers with light-colored nails, precise depiction of knees, ankles, and shoe soles touching the ground in a squatting pose is required.

Background · Lighting:
The foreground is a grayish-brown park path mixed with small stones and dry soil, showing subtle unevenness, fallen leaves, and tree shadows. A very thick dark brown tree trunk is placed in the upper right of the frame, with vibrant green leaves and branches arranged throughout the upper part. The left side of the background is a round-trimmed dark green hedge, the far center is a bright lawn and thin tree trunks, and the far right is a winding path and low shrubs, heavily blurred. Soft natural light pouring from the upper left of the frame passes through the leaves, casting bright spots of various sizes on the hair, face, shoulders, white clothing, arms, thighs, and shoes. Tight shadows form under the black shoes and behind the figure, and many yellow-green circular bokeh spots float in the upper part of the background.

Composition · Lens:
Close to a 2:3 vertical aspect ratio, a full-body fashion portrait taken from an angle slightly lower than the chest of the squatting figure. Place the face in the upper center, arms and hands in the center, left and right knees in the lower center, and both feet in platform shoes in the lower center, creating a strong contrast between the white clothing and black shoes. The figure occupies about 80% of the frame height, with empty space for leaves above the head and soil including shadows below the feet. Include both shoes entirely in the frame, and the long strap hanging on the right side is not cropped. The pupils and face are the clearest, while hands, belt, loose socks, shoelaces, and soles maintain high resolution. The background is softly blurred with a short-focus portrait lens.

Texture · Style:
High-resolution realistic summer street fashion photography. Main color palette of off-white and white, warm skin tones, black leather, yellow-green leaves, and grayish-brown soil. Natural skin texture and elegant complexion, subtle reflections on hair and braids, ribbing and lace of the top, fabric of the skirt, metal buckles and snaps, thick knit of the socks, matte luster of the black leather, steps of the platform soles, and soil and small stones need precise depiction. Do not overexpose the highlights of the white clothing, while balancing the light and shadow of the sunlight through the trees and the weight of the black shoes.

Negative Prompt:
Avoid distorted faces or gazes, extra fingers, hands merging with knees, deformed arms or wrists, merging legs in a squatting pose, backward-bent knees or ankles, poor contact between soles and ground, contradiction between center of gravity and gravity, excessively flipped skirts, flaws in belts or straps, asymmetrical platform shoes, unnatural repetitive sunlight through trees, horizontal flip, text, logo, watermark, excessive skin smoothing treatment.

prompts.text:
主题：
树荫下的白与黑

主体：
在洒满明亮树间阳光的公园土路小径上，以纵向全身视角捕捉一位二十多岁的女性深蹲的姿态。女性占据画面中央，头部位于上部中央，上身和双臂居中，腰部和大腿弯曲的膝盖位于中央下方，黑色厚底鞋排列至下端。双脚略微分开超过肩宽，脚底平贴地面，将腰部降至靠近脚跟的位置。人物自身的右前臂沿右大腿内侧放置，左前臂斜置于左大腿上方，双臂自然下垂而不低叠于膝间。上身略微前倾，肩膀微收，脸庞微微向人物自身的左侧倾斜，同时直视正面的镜头。

人物·表情：
小巧的卵形脸庞，明亮的象牙色肌肤，细长的浅棕色眉毛，大大的榛色瞳孔，长长的睫毛与细致的眼线，淡玫瑰粉色的腮红，富有光泽的珊瑚米色唇瓣。唇瓣微微张开，向镜头投以平静而笔直的目光。头发为及胸下方的明亮灰棕色，留有薄薄的刘海和鬓角的长发丝，从头顶向两侧编入辫子，并在后脑勺高位束成马尾。长长的发束从人物自身的左肩流向背部。耳朵上佩戴摇曳的珍珠耳环，颈部戴着细银链和小巧的单颗吊坠。将柔和的树间阳光洒在头顶、脸颊、肩膀和手臂上。

服装·姿势：
生成り色的罗纹编织露背吊带上衣。宽阔的布料连接至颈后，深V字领口，两侧饰以细蕾丝边，前中央交叉系以多条细绳，紧贴身体直至腰部以上。下装为白色不对称迷你裙，腰间配有多处金属按扣和细腰带，人物自身的左腰处饰以大块布结和阶梯状褶边，右腰垂下长长的白色肩带与银色方形扣环。双腿上从脚踝至小腿下方的白色罗纹宽松袜松垮地穿着。鞋子为黑色皮革系带厚底鞋，圆头设计，黑色鞋带，金属眼孔，极厚的阶梯状鞋底与粗跟。双手纤细的手指与淡色指甲，蹲姿下的膝盖、脚踝、鞋底的接地需精确描绘。

背景·光线：
前景为混杂小石与干土的灰褐色公园小径，展现细微凹凸、落叶与树影。画面右上方置入极粗的深褐色树干，上部整体布置鲜艳的绿色叶片与枝条。背景左侧为圆形修剪的深绿色树篱，中央远处为明亮的草坪与细树干，右远处为蜿蜒小径与低矮灌木，大幅虚化。画面左上方倾泻的柔和自然光透过叶片，在头发、脸庞、肩膀、白色衣物、手臂、大腿、鞋子上洒下大小明亮的斑点。黑色鞋子下方与人物背后形成紧实的阴影，背景上部浮动众多黄绿色的圆形虚化光斑。

构图·镜头：
接近纵向2:3的画面比例，从略低于蹲姿人物胸部的角度拍摄全身时尚肖像。将脸庞置于上部中央，双臂和双手居中，左右膝盖位于中央下方，双脚厚底鞋置于下部中央，营造白色服饰与黑色鞋子的强烈上下对比。人物占据画面高度约八成，头部上方留有叶片的空白余地，脚下包含阴影的土壤余白。将双鞋完全纳入画面，右侧垂下的长肩带亦不裁切。以瞳孔和脸庞最为清晰，双手、腰带、宽松袜、鞋子的系带与鞋底保持高分辨率。背景以短焦肖像镜头柔和虚化。

质感·风格：
高分辨率的现实主义夏季街头时尚照片。以生成り色与白色、温暖肤色、黑色皮革、叶子的黄绿色、土壤的灰褐色为主调。自然肌理与淡雅血色，头发与辫子的细微反光，上衣的罗纹与蕾丝，裙子的布料，金属扣环与按扣，袜子的厚实编织，黑色皮革的哑光泽，厚底鞋底的阶梯，土壤与小石需精密描绘。不让白色服饰的高光过曝，同时兼顾树间阳光的明暗与黑色鞋子的重量感。

负面提示：
避免脸部或视线崩坏、多余手指、双手与膝盖融合、手臂或手腕变形、蹲姿双腿融合、膝盖与脚踝反折、鞋底接地不良、重心与重力矛盾、裙子过度翻卷、腰带或肩带破绽、厚底鞋左右不对称、树间阳光不自然重复、左右翻转、文字、logo、透かし、过度美肌处理。

prompts.text: Vertical 3:4, single realistic mobile phone lifestyle snapshot photo, no collages, no four-grid layouts, no text, no watermarks. Only refer to the young adult Asian female's facial features, face shape, long straight black hair, natural skin texture, and overall temperament from the uploaded images, maintaining consistent female appearance. Reconstruct a dessert shop interaction scene for two people, do not copy the single-person pose from the original photo. A pair of young adult Asian male and female sitting in a quiet and warm dessert shop window seat, both clearly appearing in the frame. The female sits on a light brown sofa chair by the window, wearing a light grayish-brown sleeveless knitted long dress, with long straight black hair naturally draped over her shoulders, body slightly facing the male, expression happy and slightly shy. The male sits next to or diagonally opposite the female, wearing a simple and clean light-colored short-sleeved shirt or white T-shirt, short black hair, natural and refreshing appearance, not a celebrity face, do not overshadow the female as the main subject. The male holds a dessert cup in one hand and a small spoon in the other, naturally handing a small bite of light green ice cream to the female's mouth. The female leans forward slightly, gently opening her mouth to eat the ice cream from the spoon, eyes looking at the male with a smile, or briefly looking at the camera, presenting a natural moment suddenly captured by a friend. The male turns his head to look at the female, expression gentle and relaxed, with a natural smile on the corners of his mouth. The actions of the two must have a real interactive relationship, a natural distance, and no stiff posing. On the table, there can be tissues, another dessert cup, and a mobile phone, retaining real dessert shop lifestyle details. The background consists of a wooden tabletop, light-colored walls, frosted glass windows, and warm brown seats, with soft natural light coming through the window, a mix of indoor warm light and daylight. Shot close-up using a mobile phone, with a slightly casual snapshot composition, lens height close to the characters' eye level. The female is the main visual focus, the male's face and upper body are fully visible, and the relationship between the two's hands, the spoon, and the dessert cup is clear and accurate. Real skin texture, slight pores, natural stray hairs, and real clothing wrinkles, no excessive skin smoothing. The overall atmosphere is relaxed, sweet, and lifestyle-oriented, like a moment unintentionally captured by a friend during a couple's date, but without a wedding photo or commercial advertisement feel. ## Negative Prompts: Do not have only the male's hand in the frame, do not crop out the male's face, no third person, the female should not hold the spoon herself, no floating spoon, no spoon passing through the mouth, no finger deformities, no extra arms, no sharing one hand, no facial feature distortion, no excessive mouth opening, no exaggerated intimate actions, no kissing, no studio posing feel, no fake smiles, no plastic skin, no excessive skin smoothing, no anime feel, no cluttered background, no garbled text on dessert cups.

prompts.text:
竖版 3:4，单张真实手机生活抓拍照片，不要拼贴，不要四宫格，不要文字，不要水印。

仅参考上传图片中年轻成年亚洲女性的五官、脸型、黑色长直发、自然肤质和整体气质，保持女性外貌一致。重新构建甜品店双人互动场景，不照搬原图的单人姿势。

一对年轻成年亚洲男女坐在安静温馨的甜品店靠窗座位，两个人都清晰出现在画面中。女生坐在靠窗的浅棕色沙发椅上，穿浅灰棕色无袖针织长裙，黑色长直发自然披肩，身体微微面向男生，表情开心又略带害羞。

男生坐在女生旁边或斜对面，穿简洁干净的浅色短袖衬衫或白色T恤，黑色短发，外形自然清爽，不要明星脸，不要抢夺女生主体位置。男生一只手拿着甜品杯，另一只手拿着小勺，正自然地把一小口浅绿色冰淇淋递到女生嘴边。

女生微微前倾，轻轻张嘴准备吃下勺子里的冰淇淋，眼睛带笑地看向男生，或短暂看向镜头，呈现被朋友突然抓拍到的自然瞬间。男生侧头看着女生，表情温柔轻松，嘴角带自然笑意。两人的动作要有真实的互动关系，距离自然，不要僵硬摆拍。

桌面上可以放纸巾、另一杯甜品和一部手机，保留真实甜品店生活细节。背景是木质桌面、浅色墙壁、磨砂玻璃窗和暖棕色座椅，窗外透进柔和自然光，室内暖光与日光混合。

使用手机近距离拍摄，略带随手抓拍的构图，镜头与人物视线高度接近。女生为主要视觉焦点，男生完整露出脸部和上半身，两个人的手部、勺子和甜品杯关系清晰准确。真实皮肤纹理，轻微毛孔、自然碎发和真实衣服褶皱，不要过度磨皮。整体氛围轻松、甜蜜、生活化，像情侣约会时被朋友无意间拍下的一瞬间，但不要婚纱照或商业广告感。

## 负面提示词

不要只有男生的手入镜，不要男生被裁掉脸，不要第三个人，不要女生自己拿勺子，不要勺子悬空，不要勺子穿过嘴巴，不要手指畸形，不要多余手臂，不要共用一只手，不要五官变形，不要过度张嘴，不要夸张亲密动作，不要接吻，不要影楼摆拍感，不要假笑，不要塑料皮肤，不要过度磨皮，不要动漫感，不要背景杂乱，不要甜品杯文字乱码。

prompts.text:
9:16 vertical version, modern oriental female dreamscape 3D papercut art, modern oriental papercut art, layered paper cut illustration, dimensional paper sculpture, intricate paper carving, paper diorama, poetic female dreamscape, contemporary oriental art poster.

The theme of the work is "Dreams grow from within the flower". The core narrative of the scene is: a woman wakes up from a giant blooming paper flower that unfolds layer by layer; the flower is like the spring regrowing within her heart, and she has finally learned to embrace her own softness and vitality.

The main subject is an Oriental adult female with a visual age of approximately 25 years old, soft and poetic, quiet and healing, with a sense of gentle yet firm growth. The character has a soft oval face, bright almond eyes, a gentle gaze, and a faint smile on her lips, as if she has just seen the light. The face is shaped using exquisite Oriental paper art illustration style, with clear and natural features, not a real-life photographic texture, nor overly cartoonish.

The character's hairstyle and headwear are: long black hair naturally draped, with hair strands naturally connecting to the papercut petals, wearing pearl-white paper flowers and small pale gold branch and leaf hair ornaments. The hair is composed of flowing paper ribbons, dense hollowed-out hair strands, and light paper curves, keeping the headwear exquisite and light.

The character's clothing design is: an apricot-pink and cream-white multi-layered paper art formal gown, the skirt hem spreads outward in petal-shaped paper pieces, with dense flower branch hollowed-out patterns on the chest and cuffs. The clothing is composed of multi-layered paper-cut garment pieces, hollowed-out patterns, paper-sculpted petals, and lightweight paper art structures, with clearly visible layered skirts, paper creases, cut edges, and delicate paper textures.

The dreamscape unfolds through a giant blooming paper flower. The scene features flowers, flower vines, butterflies, clouds, glowing seeds, and distant mountains; all flowers, plants, clouds, and decorative elements adopt a unified paper-cut and 3D paper sculpture language.

The overall paper-cut structure adopts a flower-blooming style. The character and scene composition are represented as: the character is located in the center, standing up from the layers of the giant flower core that is opening up, hands gently holding the outer petals, the skirt and petals unfolding downward together, and butterflies flying upward from her side. The image has a clear front-to-back paper layer relationship, with the character in the main visual layer, dream imagery distributed in the foreground, middle ground, and background, without obstructing the character's face or body outline.

The overall color scheme is: apricot pink, cream white, champagne gold as the main colors, with a small amount of misty purple as accents. Different paper layers maintain their own clear and pure colors, colors are coordinated but do not use a single filter overlay; the image is not gray, not dirty yellow, and does not have an overall color cast.

The lighting and paper texture are: soft warm white light falling from above, paper-sculpted petal edges slightly glowing, paper layer shadows are soft, the paper has delicate fibers and slight creases, with transparent layers. Natural and soft shadows are formed between different paper layers, hollowed edges have slight light transmission, and real paper fibers, slight creases, hand-cut edges, and fine hollowed patterns can be seen.

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 editorial portrait poster built around light, motion blur, and selective focus.

Subject: [Asian / Western / male / female]
Title: [custom title]
Blur method: [horizontal motion trail / blurred foreground / translucent filter / soft light haze]
Color palette: [custom colors]
Series: LIGHT RESIDUE
Year: 2026

Keep one facial detail clearly recognizable—such as one eye, the glasses, or the nose bridge—while the rest of the portrait gradually shifts through blur, reflection, colored light, or motion. The blur must have a clear direction and visual cause, not look randomly out of focus.

4 directions:

1. SIGNAL CUT — a sharp eye crossed by a vivid light beam, while the hair and face stretch into horizontal motion trails.

2. FILTER STATE — a fashion portrait seen through translucent colored acrylic panels, with the glasses and eyes remaining crisp.

3. PASSING FRAME — a clear subject standing still while blurred figures move through the foreground and a soft reflection appears behind.

4. MINT STATIC — a quiet portrait dissolving into mint-colored haze, with one eye still visible inside the soft motion blur.

Use realistic skin, natural hair, believable fabric, cinematic lighting, subtle grain, strong negative space, and a restrained editorial layout.

Keep the typography minimal: one large title, “LIGHT RESIDUE,” one short supporting line, and “2026.” Let the title interact slightly with the light or blur, but keep it readable.
