prompts.text:
Theme:
Stone path and white summer

Subject:
On the approach path within a Japanese shrine surrounded by continuous green tree shade, a vertical shot of a woman in her 20s wearing a white swimsuit and a thin haori, taken from head to below the knees. The woman occupies most of the space slightly to the left of the center of the frame, with her head at the top center, chest and abdomen in the center, waist in the lower center, and joined legs extending to the bottom edge. Her body faces forward, with her waist slightly shifted to her own right, and knees standing close together. Her own right hand pinches the swimsuit string and the edge of the haori on the right side of her waist, and her left hand lightly pulls the string on the left side of her waist. Shoulders are slightly pulled inward, face tilted to her own right, while smiling warmly at the camera.

Character · Expression:
Small oval face, bright ivory skin, slender dark brown eyebrows, large brown pupils, exquisite eyeliner and long eyelashes, pale pink cheeks, lustrous coral pink lips. Looking directly at the camera with a slight upturn at the corners of the mouth, showing a friendly smile. Hair is dark brown reaching below the chest, keeping thin bangs and long trailing hair along the cheeks, loosely tied into a ponytail at a high position on the back of the head. A long strand of hair flows from her own right shoulder to the side of her chest, with fine leaf-dappled light scattered on the top of her head, bangs, and shoulders. Small metal earrings are worn on the ears, and a thin silver chain with a transparent single-stone pendant is worn on the neck.

Clothing · Pose:
Pure white patternless triangle bikini. The top has thin shoulder straps and back straps, left and right triangle cups, and a thin horizontal band tied under the chest, with fabric edges decorated with fine ruffles. The bottom is a white low-waist triangle, with thin strings and long ribbons tied on both sides of the waist, showing the hanging strings on the left and right. Over the upper body is a very thin, light yellow transparent shirt or robe, naturally slipping off the shoulders, wide sleeve design, fine weave texture, creating soft folds. The haori wraps around the arms and the outside of the waist, open at the front. The thumbs and fingers of both hands lightly pinch near the swimsuit waist strings, with moderate tension, creating natural fabric tension. The center of gravity of the pelvis, knees, and legs in the standing posture remains natural.

Background · Lighting:
On the left side of the frame is an old dark brown wooden building, configured with thick pillars, glass sliding doors, a low veranda, and wooden boxes. A white cloth curtain hangs diagonally under the eaves of the building, painted with two huge dark blue chrysanthemum-like circular patterns. On the upper part of the pillar hangs a longitudinal wooden plaque, with rows of small black brush-written characters, but the content is not identifiable. The right side of the frame extends deep into a grey stone-paved approach, with low stone pillars, stone lanterns, a torii-like horizontal structure, and small wooden buildings arranged with a shallow depth of field. The upper part of the frame is entirely covered by vibrant green branches and leaves, scattering fine leaf-dappled light onto the approach and the building. The main light source comes from the bright natural light at the upper right of the frame, illuminating the face, shoulders, chest, abdomen, legs, and white fabric, while deep brown shadows are retained on the building side.

Composition · Camera:
Vertical composition 3:4, a full-body close-up fashion portrait shot from a camera position slightly looking down from near the standing figure's chest height. The face is placed at the top center, hands and waist strings in the lower center, and joined legs at the bottom center. The figure occupies about ninety percent of the frame height, with blank space of curtains and leaves left above the head, and a sense of depth from the building and approach retained on the left and right, with the legs cut at the bottom edge below the knees. The wooden building on the left serves as a vertical foreground line, and the stone path on the right serves as a leading line towards the vanishing point. The pupils and face are presented most clearly, while the hands, swimsuit strings, haori weave, and abdomen maintain high resolution. Background lanterns and trees are softly blurred using a short-focus portrait lens.

Texture · Style:
High-resolution realistic summer fashion photography. Main color palette consists of white, pale yellow, warm skin tones, dark wood brown, stone grey-blue, and vibrant leaf green. Precisely depicts natural skin texture and light elegant complexion, fine hair strands, smooth weave and ruffles of swimsuit fabric, translucency and folds of haori, wood grain, glass reflections, stone roughness, and leaf luster. Maintains the light and dark contrast of leaf-dappled light without overexposing the white fabric and skin highlights, achieving a balance between background circular bokeh and clear foreground resolution.

Negative Prompt:
Avoid facial or smile distortion, left-right gaze deviation, extra fingers, hands merging with waist strings, wrist or arm deformation, legs merging, knee or pelvis distortion, collapse of standing posture center of gravity, uncoordinated swimsuit strings or knots, haori embedding, overexposure, perspective distortion of buildings and stone slabs, unnaturally repeating patterns, identifiable extra text, logos, watermarks, horizontal flipping, excessive skin beautification.

prompts.text:
主题：
石板路与白色的夏

主体：
在绿树荫影连绵的日式神社境内参道上，从头到膝下纵向拍摄一位身穿白色泳衣和薄羽织的20多岁女性。女性占据画面中央稍左的大部分空间，头部位于上部中央，胸部和腹部位于中央，腰部位于中央下方，并拢的双腿延伸至下端。身体面向正面，腰部微微向人物自身右侧偏移，双膝靠近站立。人物自身右手捏住右侧腰部的泳衣细绳和羽织边缘，左手轻轻拉住左侧腰部的细绳。肩膀微微内收，脸庞向人物自身右侧倾斜，同时对着镜头温和微笑。

人物·表情：
小巧的椭圆形脸庞，明亮的象牙色肌肤，细长的深棕色眉毛，大大的棕色瞳孔，精致的眼线和长睫毛，淡粉色的脸颊，富有光泽的珊瑚粉色嘴唇。直视正面的镜头，嘴角微微上扬，露出亲切的笑容。头发是及胸下部的深棕色，保留薄薄的刘海和沿脸颊的长后发，在后脑勺较高位置松松地扎成马尾。长长的发束从人物自身右肩流向胸部侧边，头顶、刘海和肩膀上洒落细碎的树叶光斑。耳朵上戴着小巧的金属耳环，脖子上佩戴细银链和透明的单颗吊坠。

服装·姿势：
纯白无图案的三角比基尼。上装有细肩带和背带、左右三角罩杯，以及胸下系着的细水平带，布料边缘饰以细密褶边。下装是白色低腰三角形，两侧腰部以细绳和长丝带打结，展示左右垂下的细绳。从上身披上一件极薄的浅黄色透明衬衫或长袍，肩部自然滑落，宽袖设计，细密织纹，营造柔和褶皱。羽织包裹双臂和腰部外侧，前方敞开。双手的拇指和手指轻轻捏住泳衣腰绳附近，拉扯适度，营造自然的布料张力。站姿的骨盆、膝盖和腿部重心保持自然。

背景·光线：
画面左侧有一座古老的深褐色木造建筑，配置粗壮的柱子、玻璃拉门、低矮的缘台和木箱。建筑屋檐下斜挂白色布幔，绘有两个深蓝色的巨大菊花状圆形纹样。柱子上部挂有纵长的木牌，排列着细小的黑色毛笔文字，但内容不予辨识。画面右侧向深处延伸灰色石板参道，以浅景深配置低矮石柱、石灯笼、类似鸟居的水平结构，以及小型木造建筑。画面上部整体覆盖鲜艳的绿色枝叶，向参道和建筑洒落细碎的树叶光斑。主光源来自画面右上方的明亮自然光，照亮脸庞、肩膀、胸部、腹部、腿部和白色布料，而建筑侧保留深褐色的阴影。

构图·相机：
纵向构图3:4，从接近站立人物胸部高度的相机位置略微俯拍的全身特写时尚肖像。脸部置于上部中央，双手和腰绳置于中央下方，并拢的双腿置于下部中央。人物占据画面高度约九成，头部上方留有布幔和树叶的空白空间，左右保留建筑和参道的纵深感，双腿在膝下截于画面下端。左侧木造建筑作为前景垂直线，右侧石板路作为通向消失点的引导线。最清晰呈现瞳孔和脸部，双手、泳衣细绳、羽织织纹直至腹部保持高分辨率。背景灯笼和树木以短焦人像镜头柔和虚化。

质感·风格：
高分辨率的现实主义夏季时尚摄影。以白色、浅黄色、温暖肤色、古木焦褐、石板青灰、树叶鲜绿为主色调。精密描绘自然的皮肤纹理和淡雅血色、头发的细发束、泳衣布料的光滑织纹与褶边、羽织的透光与褶皱、木材纹理、玻璃反射、石材粗糙、树叶光泽。保留树叶光斑的明暗对比，同时不让白色布料和皮肤高光过曝，实现背景圆形虚化和前景清晰分辨率的平衡。

负面提示：
避免脸部或微笑变形、左右视线偏移、多余手指、双手与腰绳融合、手腕或手臂变形、腿部融合、膝盖或骨盆扭曲、站姿重心崩坏、泳衣细绳或结扣不协调、羽织嵌入、过度暴露、建筑与石板透视扭曲、纹样不自然重复、可辨识的额外文字、logo、水印、左右翻转、过度美肌处理。

prompts.text: Establish a bright, modular modern PPT visual system, with the International Typographic Style and modular grids as the main axis: use repeating units and stable baselines to unify the entire set of pages; use Gestalt's law of proximity and common regions to house similar information within rounded color blocks; use dynamic equilibrium to let large-area color fields, photos, and white space act as counterweights to each other in asymmetry; use editorial rhythm to form chapter breathing through changes in image scale, density, and white space. Draw on Josef Müller-Brockmann's precise column grids and objective hierarchy for alignment, Massimo Vignelli's use of limited typefaces and spread rules to maintain system consistency, Josef Albers' use of adjacent color fields to calibrate color perception, and Alexey Brodovitch's use of cropping, scale contrast, and white space to drive the dialogue between images and text; methods are synergistic but not mechanically replicated. Default to warm white #F7F7F3 as background at approx 45%, fluorescent yellow-green #E5EA45 as primary emphasis at approx 22%, light lavender purple #C5ADD7 as support at approx 18%, near black #1D1D1D for structure and body text at approx 12%, fog blue #AFC8EC for small amounts of information coding at approx 3%; control high-saturation colors to occupy only key areas based on Itten's light-dark and area contrast and Albers' adjacency effect. When users specify colors later, those shall prevail while retaining role hierarchy, area proportions, lightness differences, and projection readability. Adopt multi-column modular grids and ample margins, with titles, focal visuals, information cards, and annotations forming a clear first to third reading order; regular elements are strictly aligned, allowing only one rounded color field or focal visual to break the grid across columns, ensuring thumbnails are still recognizable at a glance. Background remains flat matte white, a mix of photography and geometric vectors: natural soft-light photos first undergo restrained color temperature unification, then are cropped with rounded hard-edge masks, overlaid with semi-transparent low-saturation color blocks, with a low-contrast isometric vertical line texture added at the bottom-most layer as a rhythmic band, avoiding meaningless shadows and decorative noise. Typefaces use consistent pairings of sans-serifs with the same skeleton, titles use medium-bold weights and tight line spacing to form large-scale jumps, and body text uses regular weights, wider line spacing, and short line lengths to ensure long-distance readability; Chinese and Western text are aligned by visual grayness rather than mechanical font size, unifying baselines, optically correcting kerning, and letting text edges share alignment lines with image masks. prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium commercial dessert poster for a fictional tiramisu brand called VELORA DOLCE, combining the tactile richness of Milk Cloud Orbit with the brand-system refinement of Cream Halo Transit, while enlarging the negative space, strengthening the sculptural flow of the poured liquid, and deepening the luxurious gloss of the dessert against a richer dark background. The final image must feel like a world-class flagship dessert campaign: highly polished, hyper-realistic, seductive, and collector-grade, with one elegant tiramisu serving as the absolute hero and a thick chocolate milkshake-like pour descending from above in a refined cinematic motion. Use English-first branding only.

Core composition:
Use a tall vertical poster composition with one premium tiramisu serving positioned exactly in the lower-middle center as the absolute hero. The dessert may be presented on an elegant plate or refined serving base, but it must remain the clear focal point. Above it, a graceful hand and vessel enter from the upper edge, pouring a dense glossy chocolate milkshake-like liquid in one continuous stream directly over the tiramisu. Expand the breathing room around the dessert and the liquid stream so the composition feels more iconic, more premium, and more brand-led. The negative space must feel intentional and luxurious.

Milk Cloud Orbit enhancement:
Push tactile richness much further. The mascarpone layers must feel silkier and more nuanced, the espresso-soaked sponge more moist and tender, the cocoa dust finer and more velvety, and the chocolate liquid thicker, glossier, and more physically weighted. The hand skin texture, porcelain surface, tiramisu edge detail, and liquid cling must all feel more collector-grade. Every surface should look touchable and indulgent.

Cream Halo Transit refinement:
Strengthen the premium dessert brand system. The title hierarchy, logo lockup, vessel design, plate spacing, and supporting typography must feel more disciplined, intentional, and rollout-ready. The poster should look like part of a mature luxury dessert campaign rather than a one-off food image.

Liquid sculpture:
This is critical. The pouring liquid must feel more sculptural and art-directed. The stream should descend in a graceful, uninterrupted line and wrap across the top edge of the tiramisu with elegant folds, premium drips, and controlled pooling behavior. The flow must feel like a designed visual signature, not a casual pour. It should read as a luxurious ribbon of chocolate indulgence.

Negative space:
Expand the empty surrounding space significantly so the dessert and the pour feel more isolated, more iconic, and more premium. Do not crowd the frame with unnecessary elements. The space around the tiramisu must feel expensive and cinematic, letting the product breathe like a hero in a luxury poster.

Dark background dessert glow:
Push the background into a deeper, richer, more luxurious darkness such as espresso-black, cocoa-charcoal, or dark warm brown. The tiramisu, porcelain, and pouring liquid must glow more beautifully against this deep background. The contrast between the dark space and the glossy dessert surfaces should feel stronger and more seductive.

Hero dessert logic:
The tiramisu must feel refined, rich, and intensely appetizing. Build it with clear mascarpone cream layering, espresso-soaked sponge or cake structure, cocoa-dusted surface, and luxurious inner softness. The dessert must feel premium and polished, with a beautiful cut edge and strong material contrast between cream, soaked sponge, cocoa top, and glossy poured liquid.

Hand and vessel logic:
The hand must feel clean, elegant, and natural, with believable anatomy, refined skin texture, and a comfortable pouring grip. The vessel should feel premium and simple, such as smooth porcelain or a refined dessert sauce cup. The hand and vessel must support the dessert story, not overpower it.

Typography and branding:
Use a premium English-first brand identity:
Brand: VELORA DOLCE
Headline: POUR THE DESIRE
or
DROWN IN TIRAMISU
Typography must feel bold yet elegant, art-directed, and beautifully integrated into the poster. Keep the text compact and secondary to the dessert, but strong enough to signal a real luxury dessert campaign.

Lighting:
Use extremely delicate high-end commercial lighting with soft cinematic shaping. Let the light reveal mascarpone layers, cocoa texture, glossy sauce stream, porcelain vessel, hand skin texture, and plate edges with graceful highlight rolloff. The dessert must glow with rich dimensionality and luxurious softness against the dark background.

Material realism:
Push realism to the maximum. The tiramisu layers must feel creamy, moist, and physically believable. The cocoa top must show ultra-fine powder texture. The sponge must feel espresso-soaked and tender. The poured chocolate liquid must feel thick, silky, and weighted. The serving base and vessel must feel tactile and real. Keep crumbs and traces highly restrained and premium.

Color direction:
Use a refined dessert palette of deep cocoa brown, espresso black-brown, mascarpone cream, soft ivory, and restrained caramel highlights. Keep the image rich, elegant, warm, and appetite-driven, with stronger dessert gloss against the dark premium field.

prompts.text:
为一家名为 VELORA DOLCE 的虚构提拉米苏品牌创建一张超高级商业甜点海报，结合 Milk Cloud Orbit 的触感丰富度和 Cream Halo Transit 的品牌系统精炼感，同时扩大留白空间，加强倾倒液体的雕塑般流动感，并加深甜点在更浓郁深色背景下的奢华光泽。最终图像必须感觉像是世界级的旗舰甜点宣传活动：高度抛光、超现实、诱人且收藏级，以一份优雅的提拉米苏作为绝对主角，一股浓稠的巧克力奶昔状液体以精炼的电影感动作从上方降下。仅使用英语优先的品牌标识。

核心构图：
使用高大的垂直海报构图，一份高级提拉米苏正好位于中下方中心作为绝对主角。甜点可以盛放在优雅的盘子或精制的底座上，但它必须始终是清晰的焦点。在它上方，一只优雅的手和容器从上边缘进入，将一股浓稠、闪亮的巧克力奶昔状液体以连续的流线直接浇在提拉米苏上。扩大甜点和液体流周围的呼吸空间，使构图感觉更具标志性、更高级、更具品牌导向。留白空间必须让人感到是有意为之且奢华的。

Milk Cloud Orbit 增强：
进一步推高触感丰富度。马斯卡彭层必须感觉更丝滑、更有层次感，浸过浓缩咖啡的海绵蛋糕要更湿润嫩滑，可可粉要更细腻如天鹅绒，巧克力液体要更浓稠、更闪亮、物理质感更重。手的皮肤纹理、瓷器表面、提拉米苏边缘细节和液体的附着感都必须感觉更具收藏价值。每个表面都应该看起来触手可及且令人沉溺。

Cream Halo Transit 精炼：
加强高级甜点品牌系统。标题层级、Logo 组合、容器设计、盘子间距和辅助排版必须感觉更加严谨、有目的地且具备推广可行性。这张海报看起来应该像是成熟奢侈甜点宣传活动的一部分，而不是一张随手的食物图片。

液体雕塑：
这是至关重要的。倾倒的液体必须感觉更具雕塑感和艺术指导感。流线应以优雅、不间断的线条降下，并以优雅的褶皱、高级的滴落和受控的汇聚行为包裹在提拉米苏的顶缘。流动感必须感觉像是一种精心设计的视觉签名，而不是随意的倾倒。它应该被解读为一条奢华的巧克力诱惑丝带。

留白空间：
显著扩大周围的空白空间，使甜点和倾倒流感觉更孤立、更具标志性、更高级。不要用不必要的元素挤满画面。提拉米苏周围的空间必须感觉昂贵且具有电影感，让产品像奢侈海报中的英雄一样自由呼吸。

深色背景甜点光泽：
将背景推向更深、更丰富、更奢华的黑暗，如浓缩咖啡黑、可可炭黑或深暖褐色。提拉米苏、瓷器和倾倒的液体在深色背景下必须焕发出更美的光泽。黑暗空间与闪亮甜点表面之间的对比应该感觉更强烈、更诱人。

手和容器逻辑：

将真实感推向极致。提拉米苏层必须感觉乳脂状、湿润且在物理上可信。可可顶部必须显示超细粉末纹理。海绵必须感觉浸透了浓缩咖啡且嫩滑。倾倒的巧克力液体必须感觉浓稠、丝滑且有重量感。底座和容器必须感觉具有触感且真实。保持碎屑和痕迹高度克制且高级。

使用精炼的甜点色调：深可可棕、浓缩咖啡黑褐色、马斯卡彭奶油色、柔和的象牙白和克制的焦糖高光。保持图像丰富、优雅、温暖且由食欲驱动，在深色高级背景下具有更强的甜点光泽。

prompts.text: A young East Asian woman in her 20s is squatting on the muddy soil of a rural vegetable garden. The shot is taken from the top of her straw hat down to her feet, with the subject centered and slightly to the left. She is in a deep squat with her knees bent, body leaning forward naturally, arms reaching toward the ground. She wears off-white cotton gardening gloves stained with damp soil, her hands supporting a small herb or vegetable seedling as she buries the roots in a newly dug small hole. Her gaze is lowered, focused on the plant, with her lips slightly parted; her expression is quiet, serious, and natural, like a moment captured by chance during labor. She has a soft oval face, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, natural eyebrow shape, a slender nose bridge, and light nude pink lips. Her makeup is extremely light, with a natural warm-white skin tone, retaining real pores, freckles, slight sunburn marks, fine vellus hair, and sweat, without skin smoothing. Her dark brownish-black hair is loosely tied up, with several strands of moist stray hair sticking to her forehead, cheeks, and sides of her ears. She wears a wide-brimmed natural raffia woven hat with rough, irregular, and slightly frayed brim edges. She wears a light oatmeal gray linen camisole dress with thin shoulder straps, ruffles and a drawstring tie at the chest, a loose and wrinkled bodice, and a hem hanging near the knees; on her feet are simple dark gray rubber slippers. The clothing has natural wrinkles, dust, and slight traces of labor. The vegetable garden features soft, dark damp soil, seedlings, weeds, and large green leafy vegetables. In the upper left foreground, there are out-of-focus green leaves obscuring the view; to the right rear are an old wooden house, wooden windows, flower pots, and a translucent simple greenhouse, with a softly blurred background. Diffused natural light from an overcast sky enters from the front left. The overall color palette is low-saturation and low-contrast, dominated by earthy browns, gray-beige, forest green, and natural skin tones. Photography style: 35mm or 50mm lens, f/2.8, slightly high-angle close-up snapshot, medium-shallow depth of field. The gloves, soil, seedlings, and face are sharp. Realistic textures of skin, linen, straw weaving, soil, and plants. Fine ISO 400 film grain. Japanese rural documentary photography, capturing a gardening lifestyle, photorealistic. Avoid: Posed fashion photos, clean gloves, clean clothes, plastic skin, exaggerated makeup, incorrect squatting posture, deformed fingers, fused arms, repetitive plants, fake straw hats, oversaturated greens, strong HDR, over-sharpening, modern urban backgrounds, CG, anime, text, watermarks, logos.

prompts.text:
Theme:
Sunlight and Photography Collection

Subject:
A realistic style portrait in a vertical composition of a woman in her 20s sitting on a beige long-pile carpet in a living room with warm sunlight streaming in, leaning her upper body against an ivory fabric sofa on the left side of the frame. The woman is positioned diagonally from the upper left to the lower right of the frame, with her head and shoulders in the upper left, chest in the center-left, waist in the center-right, and legs bent and stacked, extending significantly toward the lower right in the lower half. Her own right elbow is placed on the sofa seat, and her right hand gently supports the back of her head. Her own left arm extends along the side of her body to the waist, but below the elbow is hidden between her body and the outside of the frame. The upper body leans toward her own right, the waist is slightly twisted, knees are deeply bent, and the legs are stacked front to back.

Character/Expression:
Slightly elongated face shape, small face, bright beige-toned skin, meticulously trimmed brown eyebrows, large dark brown pupils, exquisite eyeliner and long eyelashes, light coral pink blush, natural pink-beige lips. The face is tilted slightly toward her own right while staring directly at the camera lens with lips slightly parted, presenting a calm expression. The hair is medium-length, below the shoulders, in a light brown with reddish tones, with thin bangs hanging finely over the forehead, layered around the face, and hair ends softly curling inward and outward in waves. The light from the upper right of the frame forms fine golden highlights on the top of the head, bangs, cheeks, bridge of the nose, and collarbone, and casts a faint shadow of the window side on the cheeks. Each ear wears a small single stud earring.

Clothing/Pose:
A pale salmon pink thin-strap ribbed knit camisole. The chest features a deep-opening Henley collar design, with small matching-colored buttons arranged vertically on the short central placket, and the entire garment is covered with fine vertical ribbing. The hem flares slightly above the abdomen in a cropped design, revealing the waist and navel. The bottoms are soft white shorts. The waist features a wide elastic band with fine pleats at the waistline, and the leg openings and sides are decorated with double-layer ruffle trim; the thin fabric naturally forms wrinkles at the waist twist. The fingers of the right hand touch the hair and the back of the head, connecting naturally from the shoulder to the elbow and wrist. The front thigh and knee are prominently displayed, the back leg is bent below, and the tips of both feet are cut off at the lower right edge.

Background/Lighting:
A large photography collection is spread out in the lower left foreground, with multiple female portraits arranged on the double pages. Behind the woman's waist in the lower right of the frame, a thin photography collection with a white cover and visible portrait photos is also placed diagonally. In the left middle ground is a thick ivory sofa, with a natural cream-colored woven pattern blanket and cushions on the backrest. In the center rear is a tall foliage plant with slender leaves spreading upward. To the right rear is a honey-colored wooden low cabinet-cum-bookshelf, with books of various colors arranged vertically in the upper right partition, a small white bowl and a green plant in the center, and books stacked horizontally in the lower right. On the right edge, the legs and part of the tabletop of a low wooden table are visible, with a bright window and blurred greenery above. The main light source is warm natural light streaming from the window in the upper right of the frame, illuminating the hair, face, shoulders, chest, abdomen, thighs, and carpet, rendering the area under the sofa and deep within the furniture in soft brown shadows.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical composition 3:4, capturing an indoor lifestyle portrait from a low-angle position close to the floor, looking slightly upward. The face is placed at the upper left third, the chest is in the center, the white shorts are in the center-right, and the bright front thigh and stacked knees occupy a large area of the lower half. The figure occupies about three-quarters of the frame, with parts of the right arm, the tips of both feet, and the foreground photography collection naturally cut off at the edges of the frame. The pupils and face serve as the sharpest focus, while maintaining details of the hair, clothing, front leg, and the open photography collection. The rear foliage plant, bookshelf, and window are smoothly blurred with a shallow depth of field. A standard focal length lens feel is used, giving the front leg a natural sense of perspective to avoid extreme wide-angle distortion.

Texture/Style:
High-resolution realistic digital photograph. Dominated by warm tones of cream, beige, pale pink, white, and woody brown, with the green of the foliage plant as a small accent color. Skin is not overly homogenized, retaining a faint flush on the cheeks, a soft glow on the shoulders or legs, and smooth gradients between sunlit and shaded areas. Clearly depicts the subtle reflections of each strand of hair, the dense vertical ribbing of the camisole, the thin fabric and ruffles of the shorts, the weave of the sofa, the long pile of the carpet, the glossy paper of the photography collection, and the wood grain of the wooden furniture. Balances soft blurring of the background with resolution in the foreground, creating a clean yet natural sense of daily life.

Negative:
Avoid facial deformation, misaligned left and right gaze, unnatural fingers or wrists, increased or decreased fingers, fusion of arms and hair, deformation of shoulders or ribcage, leg overlap glitches, hyper-extended joints, poor contact with the carpet, clothing indentation marks, strong wide-angle distortion, perspective glitches in background furniture, unnatural shadows, identifiable text in the photography collection, logos, watermarks, excessive skin smoothing treatment.

prompts.text:
主題：

主体：
温暖的阳光洒入客厅的米色长毛地毯上，坐着一位20多岁的女性，上半身倚靠在画面左侧的象牙色布艺沙发上，以纵向构图拍摄的写实风格肖像。女性以从画面左上到右下的对角线姿势放置身体，头部和肩膀在左上，胸口在中央左侧，腰部在中央右侧，双腿弯曲叠放在下半部分向右下大幅延伸。人物自身的右肘置于沙发坐面上，右手轻轻支撑后脑勺。人物自身的左臂沿身体侧边延伸至腰部，但肘部以下隐藏在身体与画面外。上身向人物自身的右侧倾斜，腰部微微扭转，双膝深弯，将双腿前后叠放。

人物·表情：
略显长形的脸型，小巧的脸庞，明亮的米色调肌肤，细致修剪的棕色眉毛，大大的深棕色瞳孔，精致的眼线和长睫毛，淡珊瑚粉色的腮红，自然的粉米色嘴唇。脸部微微向人物自身的右侧倾斜，同时凝视正面的镜头，嘴唇微张，呈现平静的表情。头发是及肩以下的中长发，带有红调的浅棕色，薄薄的刘海细细垂在额前，脸部周围有层次，毛梢柔和地向内外波浪状卷曲。画面右上方的光线在头顶、刘海、脸颊、鼻梁、锁骨上形成细细的金色高光，脸颊上淡淡地投下窗边的阴影。双耳各戴一颗小巧的单颗耳钉。

服装·姿势：
淡鲑鱼粉色的细肩带罗纹针织吊带背心。胸口采用深开的亨利领设计，中央短款前襟上纵向排列着小巧的同色纽扣，全身布满细密的竖向罗纹。衣摆在腹部上方略微展开，为短款设计，露出腰部和肚脐。下装是柔软的白色短裤。腰部采用较宽的松紧腰，腰围处有细密的褶皱，裤腿口和侧边饰有双层荷叶边镶边，薄薄的布料在腰部扭转处自然形成褶皱。右手手指触及头发和后脑勺，从肩膀到肘部、手腕自然连接。前侧的大腿和膝盖突出显示，后侧的腿在下方弯曲，双脚尖在右下端部分截断。

背景·光线：
前景左下方摊开一本大摄影集，双页上配置多张女性肖像照片。画面右下方的女性腰部后方，也斜置一本白色封面并可见人物照片的薄摄影集。中景左侧是厚实的象牙色沙发，靠背上铺有生成り色编织图案的毛毯和靠枕。中央后方有一株高大的观叶植物，叶片细长向上展开。右后方是蜂蜜色的木制矮柜兼书架，右上分区纵向排列颜色各异的书籍，中央放置白色小碗和绿色植物，右下方横叠着书籍。右端可见低矮木制桌子的桌腿和部分桌面，上方是明亮的窗户和模糊的绿色。主光源是从画面右上方的窗户射入的温暖自然光，照亮头发、脸部、肩膀、胸口、腹部、大腿和地毯，将沙发下方和家具深处渲染成柔和的棕色阴影。

构图·镜头：
纵向构图3:4，从靠近地板的低角度位置略微仰视拍摄室内生活方式肖像。脸部置于左上三分之一处，胸口在中央，白色短裤在右中央，前侧明亮的大腿和叠放的膝盖占据下半部分的较大面积。人物占据画面约四分之三，右臂部分、双脚尖、前景的摄影集在画面边缘自然截断。瞳孔和脸部作为最清晰的焦点，保留头发、服装、前侧腿部和摊开摄影集的细节。后方的观叶植物、书架、窗户以浅景深平滑虚化。采用标准焦段的镜头感，为前侧腿部赋予自然的透视感，避免极端广角畸变。

质感·风格：
高分辨率的写实数字照片。以温暖的奶油色、米色、淡粉色、白色和木质棕色为主调，将观叶植物的绿色作为小巧的点缀色。肌肤不过度均匀化，保留脸颊的薄薄血色、肩膀或腿部的柔和光泽、日向与阴面的平滑渐变。清晰描绘每根头发的细微反射、吊带背心的密致竖罗纹、短裤的薄布和荷叶边、沙发的织纹、地毯的长毛、摄影集的光面纸张、木制家具的木纹。兼顾背景的柔和虚化和前景的分辨感，营造出干净而自然的生活感。

负面：

items.title: 少数民族方言早安诗性视觉排版指南

prompts.text: Construct a light and translucent PPT visual system narrated by giant text and soft-focus imagery: with editorial rhythm as the main axis, using scale transitions of titles, focal imagery, descriptions, and data to form 'impact—pause—close reading'; with dynamic balance letting the top-left text center of gravity, biased visual subjects, and peripheral information bands counterbalance across space; using Gestalt principles of continuity and proximity, connecting scattered information with thin line tracks and grouping related content; using the Munsell value-chroma system to maintain projection readability of high-value backgrounds and local deep-value anchor points. Drawing from Alexey Brodovitch to establish editorial breathing with radical font sizes, cropping, and large white space; Muriel Cooper for thin spatial construction with translucent layers, light-color penetration, and front-middle-back ground; Herb Lubalin’s ligatures, shared strokes, and long-tail extensions for display characters only, making text directional graphics; Emil Ruder for body text rhythm, baseline order, and multi-level clarity, with the four collaborating in distinct domains without replicating individual works. Color schemes adopt a replaceable five-role syntax: background field accounts for 55%—65%, highest value, low chroma, and allowing slow warm-cold drift; focal visuals account for 20%—25%, medium-high value and medium chroma; informational text accounts for 10%—15%, establishing main contrast with deepest values; translucent support layers account for 5%—10%, low chroma and adjacent to the background to produce soft simultaneous contrast; high chroma highlights no more than 3%, falling only on key nodes. Future themes or brand color schemes must be mapped one-by-one by role, retaining area ratios, value order, chroma gradients, temperature relationships, and adjacent contrasts, without needing to change layout or fonts. Layout employs multi-column editorial grids and baseline grids: the first reading point is a column-crossing giant title, the second is a boundary-crossing focal visual, the third is data and descriptions; wide negative space is reserved around the edges, slender sidebars carry secondary information, breaking order with one column-cross or boundary-cross, controlling information density per page and ensuring thumbnail legibility. Backgrounds are composed of high-key photographic synthesis, first laying a vertically softened translucent base, then layering low-contrast environmental imagery and local out-of-focus foreground occlusion, finally adding a small amount of free-form halos; using diffused ambient light, low-density atomization, soft color spills without hard edges, and slight fabric-like vertical textures, with focal layer edges going from blurred to sharp, avoiding uniform full-page blurring. Typography uses a contrast pairing of high-stroke-contrast display serifs and a restrained body text system; display characters are oversized, compact, and allow for ligatures with shared strokes and terminal strokes extending in the reading direction, creating occlusion or guiding relationships with image contours; Chinese characters echo the vertical tension of Latin characters with sharp terminal strokes and balanced center-mass, while body text is graded by weight, width, spacing, and optical grayscale, with Chinese, English, and numbers aligned by visual weight rather than nominal font size. Clear, poetic, breathable, soft, agile, bright. Theme: 10 Ethnic Minorities, how to say Good Morning in dialects. A total of 10 images, each being a name theme. Different layouts. Each image should have 3-5 knowledge points, different information presentation methods. Professional collection-level typography and fonts. Aspect ratio 3:4. No serial number logic.

prompts.text:
"Direction": "This is a realistic fashion mobile snapshot taken with a 9:16 aspect ratio at dusk near Shibuya Crossing. A stunning Korean adult female in her 20s or 30s (tall hourglass figure) begins to cross the pedestrian crossing, and her companion takes this photo from behind. The subject does not turn around, and the focus is on the amber color of the setting sun, a single thin black vertical strap on her back, and the asymmetrical silhouette of her back as she walks."
"Format": "Full photo, straight corners, 9:16 aspect ratio, recommended size 1080x1920 pixels, vertical smartphone photo, directly posted to social media."
"Atmosphere": "The fleeting intersection of urban sculptural resort style and the evening bustle of Shibuya. This is not a high-end advertising shoot, but a natural fashion snapshot casually captured by a companion while walking, with a hint of raw beauty."
"Model": "A fictional Japanese adult female, aged between late 20s and 30s. Not based on any real person, celebrity, or influencer. Slim but not fragile, with moderate muscle definition in the shoulders, back, and arms."
"Face Close-up": "She does not turn to face the camera. She bows her head slightly, facing left, with only the profile of a straight nose bridge, left cheek, and ear visible (sculptural facial profile). She makes no eye contact with the camera and has no forced smile; her attention is focused on her feet and the bustling crowd."
"Hair": "Dark brown, almost black. No bangs, combed back into a low bun that fans out slightly on both sides just above the nape. There is a thin layer of hair on top that glows like the setting sun, with a few natural wisps at the ends of the bun."
"Body": "Upper body leaning slightly forward, with the center of gravity shifted more toward the leg on the right of the screen. Asymmetrical weight distribution, with the right shoulder slightly higher and hips slightly to the right. The curves of the shoulder blades, the spine, and the arc of the rounded glutes are naturally highlighted under the harsh oblique light."
"Skin Tone": "Deep, bronzed, wheat-colored skin tone with a slight reddish tint. Natural variations in skin tone on the shoulders, back, and arms, preserving pores, fine textures, peach fuzz, and color differences around joints. Avoid excessive skin smoothing or creating an even, paint-like skin tone."
"Clothing": "The original clothing structure will remain unchanged. A matte black long evening gown, or a sculptural haute couture piece with a bodysuit structure. The back is wide open from the neck to below the waist, extending to the upper part of the glutes, maintaining the original deep V backless/exposed glute look and the area of exposed skin. A very thin black shoulder strap starts from the back of the neck, extends vertically down between the shoulder blades, and connects to a dark silver ring on the upper part of the glutes. Matte black fabric wraps around the upper glutes and lower body from both sides of the ring, and the fabric falling to the sides will show different swings and folds as she walks. The clothing will not be changed to a regular halter-neck, a back-covering dress, long-sleeved dress, jacket, coat, or multiple crossed straps."
"Clothing Preservation": "The main structure must be preserved—the position and area of the back opening, the single vertical strap, the silver ring in the gluteal cleft area, and the black fabric wrapping the upper glutes from both sides. Significantly increase the area of exposed skin and do not narrow it to cover more. The garment should appear as a stylish and sexy long evening gown."
"Accessories": "A thin large silver earring and a milky white teardrop pendant on the left ear. A spiral silver arm ring and a small turquoise ornament on the left upper arm. A thin double-line arm ring on the right upper arm. Stacked silver bracelets and bangles of different thicknesses and shapes on both wrists, avoiding symmetrical styles on both sides."
"Tattoo": "A short and thin letter-like tattoo near the base of the neck. A vertical tattoo on the spine, composed of an intermittent pattern of thin lines, short symbols, and abstract text. It is not composed of clearly recognizable words or brand names, but is dark brown ink that blends perfectly with the skin."
"Pose": "Just stepping onto the Shibuya crosswalk. Her right elbow is slightly bent, and her right hand is lightly resting on the black fabric at her waist, adjusting the position of the clothes as she walks. Her left arm is extended diagonally backward and downward, with the elbow slightly bent and fingers naturally spread. The movements of the arms are different; this is not a complete hands-on-hips pose."
"scene_objects": "The white crosswalk at Shibuya Crossing, slightly worn asphalt road, traffic lights, guardrails, streetlights, surrounded by medium-to-high-rise buildings, large video screens in the distance, urban signs, a few taxis and private cars, and pedestrians starting to walk as the traffic light changes. Existing brand logos and company names are not precisely replicated but are presented generally as a typical Shibuya cityscape."
"Background People": "Naturally arrange adults returning from work, people carrying shopping bags, friends walking together, etc. Everyone moves at a different pace and direction and does not notice the presence of the camera. Position them so they do not block the subject's back or shoulder strap."
"Lighting": "On the eve of sunset, the low sun shines directly from the right of the screen. This is not soft advertising-style backlighting, but harsh sunlight shining through the gaps between buildings. It dyes the skin deep amber, copper-red, and burnt orange-brown, casting deep shadows under the shoulder blades, in the spinal groove, waist dimples, and at the boundary with the black fabric. Faint, pale reflections from large screens and store lighting are mixed in, but the main light source remains the setting sun."
"Color": "Primary colors are bronzed skin, deep amber sunset, matte black dress, dull silver accessories, warm-toned gray asphalt, and slightly dull white crosswalk. The red, blue, and yellow of background signs serve only as small accents."
"Camera": "Located approximately 1.2 to 1.8 meters behind the subject, slightly above shoulder height and tilted slightly downward. Natural smartphone perspective equivalent to 35-50mm focal length. 0.5x ultra-wide angle was not used. The subject fills the frame from the head to near the knees, occupying about 94-96% of the image height and 78-82% of the width."
"Composition": "The person's torso is almost in the center of the frame, with the head slightly to the left. The left arm extends to the lower left of the frame, while the right arm is close to the body. A black shoulder strap is clearly visible vertically across the back, guiding the viewer's gaze in this vertical composition. The white lines of the crosswalk in the background extend diagonally, creating a sense of urban depth. There is about 4-5% headroom at the top of the frame."
"Focus": "The primary focus is on the hair, the thin strap in the center of the back, the silver ring, the tattoo, and the edges of the black fabric. The zebra crossing, traffic lights, and pedestrian flow in the background are also clearly captured, enough to identify it as Shibuya. Avoid excessive blurring; the depth of field is not as shallow as is common for smartphones."
"Effect": "Warm color grading, bright signs and crosswalks slightly saturated due to smartphone auto-exposure, subtle noise in the dark areas of the black clothes, and a slight sense of JPEG compression. Unlike high-end advertisements with uniform adjustments in all areas, this photo looks more like a travel or outing photo posted directly to social media."
"Flaws": "As the person walks, the black fabric on the left and right sides swings in different directions. There is slight motion blur on the left fingertips, fine hair strands, and background pedestrians. There is subtle overlap between accessories, slight misalignment at the edges of the fabric, wear marks on the crosswalk, and repair marks on the asphalt. The skin, shoulders, waist, and arms are not perfectly symmetrical."
"Background": "Shibuya Crossing before sunset. White zebra crossings, traffic lights, city buildings, large screens, and bustling crowds appear in the frame. This is not a wide-angle panorama from a tourism poster, but a close-up street snapshot taken by a companion one step behind."
"Atmosphere": "Shibuya in the evening; you can feel the flickering of traffic lights, the footsteps of pedestrians, the sound of cars passing by, and the heat lingering on the asphalt from the day. The woman is walking one step ahead of the photographer, on her way to dinner or an event, and the sunset glow perfectly reflects the silhouette of her clothing from behind; her companion reflexively holds up their phone to take a photo."
"Negative": "Clothing design changes, back-covering fabric, high neck, long sleeves, jacket, coat, plain black dress, reduced back opening, overexposure, lingerie-style clothing, multiple branching straps, crossed ropes, complex lacing, missing silver ring, looking back at the camera, front view, forced smile, symmetrical pose, hands on hips, face looking like a real person or celebrity, juvenile appearance, huge tattoos, clear text, excessive retouching, baby face, plastic skin, unrealistic skeletal structure, extremely low angle, fisheye lens, 0.5x ultra-wide angle, excessive background blur, uniform HDR, studio lighting, clear existing company logos, social media interface UI, extra limbs or fingers"

prompts.text:
A young adult East Asian female in her 20s stands in the outdoor stone shower area of a seaside resort, framed from the head to the upper thighs. The figure is positioned slightly to the right of the center, with her body in profile facing the right side of the frame, her back naturally straight, arms raised above her head, and hands gently joined under the stream of water, fingers natural and clear. Shoulders are relaxed, and the waist forms a soft curve. She turns her head over her left shoulder to look at the camera, showing a natural and bright smile, her eyes relaxed, friendly, and filled with a sense of vacation pleasure.

She has a delicate and soft oval face, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, a slender bridge of the nose, and moist light pink lips. The makeup is fresh and natural, with soft pink blush, fine eyeliner, and natural eyelashes. The skin tone is fair and warm-toned, with real tiny water droplets covering the face, shoulders, back, arms, and sides of the waist, preserving pores, vellus hair, natural skin tone variations, and moist highlights, without plastic skin smoothing.

The dark brown long hair is completely wet, falling loosely back to below the shoulder blades, with thin wet bangs on the forehead and a few strands of wet hair clinging to the sides of the face and neck, the ends naturally clumping. She wears a light pink and cream white cloud or marble pattern triangle bikini; the top has thin halter straps and a tie-back structure; the bottom consists of low-rise side-tie swim trunks in the same pattern, with a clear and natural bow on the right side. The fabric is matte and completely opaque, with no brand logos.

In the upper right of the frame, dense shower water lines can be seen falling from the showerhead, with water droplets clearly suspended in the backlight; on the left is a light beige rough natural stone pillar. The background is a tropical beach resort with blurred turquoise sea water, light-colored sand, palm trees, and wooden lounge chairs. Bright afternoon sunlight shines from the front right of the frame, creating clear side lighting and a slight backlight, highlighting the wet hair, water droplets, shoulders, and the edges of the arms. The overall tone is fresh, low saturation, and soft warm-toned.

Photography style: 85mm lens, f/2.8, eye-level slightly low angle, medium-shallow depth of field, clear textures on the face, water droplets, hands, and swimwear, creamy background bokeh, 1/1000 second to freeze water droplets, ISO 200, realistic skin subsurface scattering, fine film grain, luxury tropical resort swimwear editorial, photorealistic.

Avoid: underage features, nudity, exposed nipples, transparent swimwear, exaggerated body proportions, pornographic poses, incorrect fingers, fused arms, deformed shoulders or neck, static fake water droplets, dry hair, plastic skin, excessive skin smoothing, strong HDR, over-sharpening, cluttered tourists, CG, anime, text, watermarks, logos.

prompts.text: Design a vertical Chinese-English bilingual English reading textbook infographic with the theme "[Theme]". The overall design adopts the editorial style of classic English textbooks and extracurricular reading materials, referencing the professional layout of 20th-century publications. The layout is formal, clear, and durable, providing a traditional paper textbook reading experience. Maintain a fixed textbook layout structure that does not change its layout logic with the theme; visual styles, illustration styles, and cultural elements can be freely adjusted according to the article content. Set concise course columns, chapter labels, or reading level information at the top of the page; place a prominent English main title "[English Title]" in the center, with a smaller Chinese title "[Chinese Title]" below it. The main text area centers on an English reading article, divided into 3 to 5 short paragraphs, with natural and concise language suitable for primary and secondary school English learners. A small amount of emphasis colors can be used in the body to highlight key vocabulary or grammar points, but the overall feeling remains restrained and professional like a printed textbook. Adopt a modular editorial layout of classic English reading textbooks: the English reading text is on the left or upper part, and a main theme illustration is arranged on the right; the bottom of the page is fixed with a learning auxiliary area, such as "Chinese Translation", "Key Words", "Did You Know?", "Think and Answer" and other modules. The boundaries between the text area, illustration area, and exercise area are clear, the reading path is natural, and it is suitable for classroom teaching and printing. The content of the main illustration changes according to the theme, such as character stories, natural sciences, historical events, urban life, traditional culture, technological exploration, animal world, travel scenes, etc.; meanwhile, 1 to 2 auxiliary narrative small illustrations can be added to supplement background information or show key plots. Illustrations use a classic publication hand-drawn style, choosing an appropriate visual language based on the theme, which can be expressed as watercolor, light color, pen line drawing, vintage picture book, natural history illustration, or realistic textbook illustration style. The structures of people, animals, objects, and environments are accurate, the modeling is natural, not exaggerated, not childish, and avoids modern 3D cartoon effects. Overall colors are adjusted according to the theme but maintain a low-saturation, soft, and printed texture textbook style. Off-white, light gray, or old paper colors can be used as the base background, paired with auxiliary colors like deep blue, dark green, brownish red, terracotta, or gray-black; avoid high-saturation clashing colors. Very light textures, environmental elements, or theme-related decorations can be added to the background, but they must not affect text clarity. Fonts and layout remain classic, rational, and professional: English titles use bold and clear serif fonts or classic textbook title fonts, and the main text uses legible printed fonts; Chinese titles and auxiliary text remain concise and standard. Avoid fancy artistic fonts, modern commercial poster styles, or excessive decoration. Overall requirements: Fixed English textbook infographic layout + content and illustration styles that change according to the theme. Maintain rich information levels without being overcrowded, with reasonable white space, neat margins, a balanced text-to-image ratio, and a professional publication texture, suitable as a single page of an English reading textbook, classroom handout, or cultural science reading page. prompts.text:
Theme:
Tree shade in the wind

Main Subject:
In a sunny early summer tree-shaded park, a woman in her 20s stands in front of a dark wooden bench, squinting into the wind, captured in a close-up vertical fashion portrait. The figure occupies the center of the frame, a large area from the top of the head to the upper thighs, with the upper body slightly twisted toward the figure's own left, and the figure's own right hand placed on the backrest of the bench at the right edge of the frame. Short dark brown hair blows powerfully toward the left side of the frame, while an ivory white lace camisole and lightweight layered shorts emerge brightly amidst the green tree shade. The background features a sandy garden path stretching straight into the depths, continuous large trees on the left and right, a green lawn, and soft dappled light from tree shadows, condensing the summer wind, light, and the natural movements of the person into a complete photograph.

Person · Expression:
A woman in her 20s, with a bright complexion and a healthy glow, a slender and naturally curved figure. Jaw-length, wet-look dark brown bob with a sense of strands, thin bangs scattered on the forehead, and the left hair tips blown by the wind into a nearly horizontal state. The face is slightly upturned, eyes squinted as if closed very slightly, natural eyebrows, a sunlit bridge of the nose, pale peach cheeks, and slightly parted moist coral pink lips, presenting a peaceful and liberated expression savoring the warm breeze. Natural luster from sweat or fine moisture is placed on the cheeks, tip of the nose, chin, neck, collarbone, and shoulders. The face is not overly youthful, retaining photo-like texture, fine hairs, and neck shadows.

Clothing · Pose:
Wearing an ivory white thin-strap ribbed camisole. The chest has a deep V-shape, the triangular edges are decorated with exquisite patterned lace, there is a small tie in the center, fine lace ribbons at the lower edge, and the hem fits the waist. The bottom is light ivory lightweight shorts with an elastic waistband and drawstring, the surface has small botanical patterns of the same color, two layers of ruffles at the top and bottom, and a see-through lace hem. The figure's own right arm extends diagonally downward, with the right hand placed on the right edge of the bench backrest in the frame. The left arm is hidden behind the body, the chest is slightly open, and the waist leans against the bench. The upper body's left shoulder is slightly forward, and the right shoulder is pulled back, expressing natural center-of-gravity movement in response to the wind. Fingers, shoulders, clothing boundaries, and the connection between the waist and legs are anatomically precise.

Background · Lighting:
Thick-trunked deciduous trees are arranged regularly on the left and right of the frame, with the upper part covered in yellow-green to deep green leaves. Behind the figure, a sandy straight garden path disappears into the center depth, with lawns on the left and right, and small signs and continuous trees placed in the distance. From the figure's waist to the bottom right of the frame, a low-gloss dark brown wooden bench is placed diagonally, showing the horizontal planks' wood grain, wear, and metal fasteners. The warm near-noon sun shines diagonally from the top left of the frame, forming bright highlights on the hair silhouette, cheeks, shoulders, chest, arms, and thighs. Leaf shadows fall on the collarbone and clothing in the form of small spots, and the background melts into golden-green circular magnolia bokeh. The bright parts of the face are not blown out white, balancing the deep green of the tree shade with the warm tones of the skin.

Composition · Camera:
Vertical 3:4, camera at a low position looking slightly up from the figure's chest to the face, taken at close range. The figure's head is placed in the upper center of the frame, the face in the upper third, the waist in the lower center, the shorts and thighs at the bottom, and the figure's own right arm extends toward the bottom right of the frame connecting to the bench. Hair blowing to the left fills the blank space on the left side of the frame, balancing with the thick tree trunk on the right. 50mm equivalent, around F2.0, focus on both eyes, face, and chest lace, with the garden path, trees, and signs behind blurred with a smooth shallow depth of field. Maintain natural body proportions, without using wide-angle to distort the face, chest, arms, or thighs. Only the hair tips moving in the wind retain a very slight sense of motion.

Texture · Style:
High-precision live-action fashion photography, a style halfway between Japanese summer magazine editorials and natural light portraits. Hair in wet-like fine strands, minute skin texture and luster, vertical knitting of the rib knit, exquisite yarn of the lace, thin fabric and folds of the shorts, scratches on the wooden bench, and color layers of leaves and grass are depicted photo-realistically. The color tone centers on ivory white, skin-warm beige, vibrant yellow-green, deep forest color, and rich brown, expressing the contrast between strong summer sunlight and cool tree shade. High-transparency highlights, deep but detail-retaining shadows, refined fine grain, natural lens blur, and a sense of life without over-processing.

Negative:
Characters who look underage, childish physique, unnatural shoulders, missing bench, too many background characters, anime style, illustration style, 3DCG feel, excessive HDR, plastic skin, watermarks, text.

主体：
在晴朗初夏的林荫公园中，20多岁的女性站在深色木制长椅前，迎着风眯起眼睛的瞬间，以近距离捕捉的纵向时尚肖像。人物占据画面中央，从头顶到大腿上部的大片区域，上半身微微向人物自身左侧扭转，人物自身右手置于画面右侧边缘的长椅靠背上。短款深棕色头发向画面左侧有力飘扬，象牙白蕾丝吊带背心和轻盈的分层短裤在绿色树荫中明亮浮现。背景配置为向深处笔直延伸的沙色园径、左右连绵的大树、绿色草坪，以及柔和的树影斑驳光线，将夏风、光线和人物自然的动作浓缩在一张完整的照片中。

人物·表情：
20多岁的女性，明亮的肤色带着健康的润泽，纤细而自然曲线的身材。下巴长度、湿润般的束感深棕色波波头，薄薄的前发散落在额头，左侧发梢被风吹散至近水平状态。脸庞微微上扬，双目极细微地闭合般眯起，自然的眉毛、日光照耀的鼻梁、淡桃色的脸颊、微微张开的润泽珊瑚粉色嘴唇，呈现出品味温暖微风的宁静而解放的表情。脸颊、鼻尖、下巴、颈部、锁骨、肩膀上放置汗水或细微水分的自然光泽。面容不过度稚嫩，保留照片般的肌理、细毛、颈部阴影。

服装·姿势：
穿着象牙白细肩带罗纹吊带背心。胸口为深V字，三角形边缘饰以精致花纹蕾丝，中央有小系带，下缘也有细蕾丝带，衣摆贴合腰部。下装为浅象牙白的轻盈短裤，腰部为松紧带和细绳，表面有同色细小植物图案，上、下两层褶边及透视感的蕾丝下摆。人物自身右臂斜向下伸展，右手置于长椅靠背的画面右侧边缘。左臂藏于身体后侧，胸部微微打开，腰部倚靠长椅。上半身左肩稍向前，右肩向后拉，表现风中反应的自然重心移动。手指、肩膀、衣物边界、腰部与腿部的连接解剖学上精确。

背景·光线：
画面左右规则排列粗壮树干的落叶树，上部覆盖黄绿色至深绿色的叶片。人物背后，沙色笔直园径向中央深处消失，左右为草坪，远处放置小标识和树木连续。人物腰部至画面右下方，斜置光泽抑制的深褐色木制长椅，展示横板的木纹、磨损、金属固定件。近正午的温暖太阳从画面左上方斜射，在头发轮廓、脸颊、肩膀、胸口、臂部、大腿上形成明亮高光。叶影以细小斑点形式落在锁骨和衣物上，背景融化为金绿色圆形玉兰晕。脸部明部不白飞，兼顾树荫的深绿与肌肤暖色。

构图·相机：
纵向3:4，相机从人物胸部至脸部微微仰视的低位，近距离拍摄。人物头部置于画面上部中央，脸部在上三分之一，腰部在中央下，短裤和大腿在下部，人物自身右臂向画面右下方延伸连接长椅。向左飘扬的头发填充画面左侧空白，与右侧粗壮树干平衡。50mm等效，F2.0前后，对双目、脸部、胸口蕾丝对焦，背后园径、树木、标识以平滑浅景深模糊。保持自然身体比例，不用广角扭曲脸部、胸部、臂部、大腿。只在风中移动的发梢保留极轻微的动感。

质感·风格：
高精度的实拍时尚摄影，日本夏季杂志编辑与自然光肖像的中间风格。头发湿润般的细束、肌肤微细纹理与光泽、罗纹针织的纵向编织、蕾丝的精致纱线、短裤的薄布与褶皱、木制长椅的划痕、叶与草的色彩层次，以照片般描绘。色调以象牙白、肌肤温暖的米色、鲜艳黄绿、深邃森林色、浓褐色为中心，表现强烈夏日阳光与凉爽树荫的对比。透明感高光、深邃但保留阶调的阴影、上品微细颗粒、自然镜头晕染、不过度加工的生命感完成。

负面：
看起来未成年的人物、幼稚体格、不自然的肩膀、长椅缺失、过多背景人物、动画风格、插图风格、3DCG感、过度HDR、塑料肌肤、水印、文字。

items.title: 河边树荫下夏日野餐少女写真

prompts.text:
Theme:
Summer picnic by the river

Subject:
A vertical portrait featuring a woman in her 20s sitting on a reddish-brown and ecru checkered picnic mat under the shade of a tree by the river in midsummer. The figure occupies a large space in the center-right of the frame, with knees raised near the chest, legs crossed diagonally, and hands holding a silver potato chip bag in front of the knees. The bag occupies a large area in the lower left of the frame, made of silver glossy material, with bold black "Calbee" and "ポテトチップス" (Potato Chips), white text "コンソメパンチ" (Consomme Punch), a small "Vegetable of 5 types of vegetables" in the upper left corner, and "55g" at the bottom clearly visible from the front. In the lower right of the frame is a light rattan woven basket containing a plastic bottle of transparent sugar-free black tea, a silver-black small film camera, bluish-white fabric, and yellow-green grapes. Including the person, snack bag, drink, basket, and small items, it is depicted as a complete scene of a peaceful summer picnic.

Person · Expression:
A woman in her 20s with fair, smooth skin and a slim, healthy figure. Soft taupe long hair reaching the chest with a fine-stranded, loose wave, thin bangs on the forehead falling naturally, with delicate outlines of sunlight through leaves on the top of the head and the ends of the hair. Her face is slightly tilted towards her own right side while looking directly at the camera in front, with rounded dark brown pupils, natural parallel eyebrows, pale coral pink cheeks, and slightly parted moist pink-beige lips, presenting a soft expression that speaks quietly. The right ear wears a small silver hoop and white four-flower dangling earrings, a thin silver chain with a white four-flower pendant around the neck, and a slender bracelet adorned with the same flowers on the figure's own left wrist. The skin is not overly highlighted, and natural blood color and subtle texture are retained on the cheeks, shoulders, arms, and legs.

Clothing · Posture:
Wearing an ivory white ribbed knit camisole with thin shoulder straps close to ecru color and matching short hot pants. The camisole has a deep round neck design that fits the body naturally, and the hot pants are made of soft fabric, with fine frills at the leg openings and a drawstring visible on the figure's own left side underarm. On the mat, the upper body is almost facing the front, the figure's own left knee is raised high in the center of the frame, and the right leg is folded in front, making the legs tightly tucked. Both arms naturally stretch toward the front knees, and both hands lightly hold the lower left and right ends of the bag. Clearly depict slender fingers and pale pink nails, with accurate joints and number of fingers. The exposed parts are natural for summer casual wear, and the posture, clothing boundaries, and leg overlap are anatomically harmonious.

Background · Lighting:
The background is a bright green lawn, in front of which is a calm blue river surface, a low concrete bridge, and further away are grayish-blue city buildings. A thick tree trunk and branches extend into the upper right of the frame, with green leaves spreading at the top, creating cool shade around the figure. On a clear afternoon, strong natural light from the upper left of the frame illuminates the background lawn and water surface, and sunlight through the leaf gaps forms small and soft spots on the hair, shoulders, arms, knees, and mat. The figure's face is presented evenly under the diffused light of the shade, while retaining highlights in the pupils, bridge of the nose, lips, and fine highlights in the hair. Subtle shimmering reflections are added to the background river surface, with levels from yellow-green to dark green on the lawn, and cool cyan-green tones are incorporated into the shade.

Composition · Lens:

items.title: 夏空下的西瓜劈

prompts.text:
Subject: Watermelon splitting under the summer sky

Main Subject: On a midsummer beach, a woman in her 20s is kneeling on the sand, leaning her upper body far forward, gripping a wooden stick with both hands, pressing down toward a large watermelon that has already been split open. In the foreground of the image, a large split watermelon and splashing water droplets are placed; the center features the hands gripping the stick, and in the distance, the face of the woman laughing brilliantly is arranged, forming a natural and continuous depth of composition from the foreground to the character. The bright blue sky, azure sea, long silver-white hair fluttering in the wind, green sunglasses, and purple floral pattern chiffon dress serve as visual centers.

Character/Expression: A young woman with bright ivory skin. Soft oval face shape, with a small and rounded chin. The cheeks, bridge of the nose, shoulders, collarbones, and arms have the natural luster of midsummer sunlight, with small water droplets and realistic textures remaining on the skin. Eyebrows are slender taupe, in a gentle arch. The eye area uses light beige and moss green eyeshadow, thin eyeliner, and naturally separated eyelashes. Light rose-pink blush is applied to the cheeks, and the lips are coated with transparent coral pink lip gloss. Mouth open in a happy, loud laugh, white teeth naturally visible. Gaze directed toward the camera. Wearing large, rounded green translucent sunglasses with a thin silver metal frame and a double bridge design. Hair extends to near the waist, bright platinum blonde. Sparse, uneven bangs and long layered hair around the face, with most of the hair flowing heavily toward the left side of the frame under the sea breeze. Fine flyaway hairs crossing in front of the cheeks and lips are also naturally preserved.

Clothing/Pose: A thin chiffon camisole mini dress featuring lavender, lilac, white, and green small flower patterns. Thin shoulder straps, soft near-V neckline, a small knot at the center under the chest with hanging ribbons. The skirt slightly flares from the waist with multiple layers of thin ruffles and wavy edges. The sea breeze blows the skirt on the right side of the frame outward, making the translucent chiffon layers and patterns visible. A short silver bead chain necklace, a small round pendant, and a transparent water-drop-shaped pendant hanging to the chest are layered on the neck. Small swaying silver earrings are worn on the ears, and a thin bracelet on the wrist. Nails are light lavender. The woman is kneeling on the beach with her waist held back and upper body leaning deeply forward. Arms extend diagonally downward from both shoulders, with both hands overlapping and firmly gripping the wooden stick at the bottom center of the frame. Elbows are almost straight, fingers naturally wrapped around the stick. The stick extends diagonally from the hands toward the large watermelon in the bottom left foreground; perspective makes the near end appear thicker.

Background/Lighting: A large watermelon with light and dark green stripes is placed in the bottom left foreground. The watermelon is split vertically near the center, with vibrant red flesh visible in the gap. There are strong white reflections on the wet surface, and large and small transparent water droplets splashing upward around the crack and the stick. In the bottom right foreground is a blue and white thick-striped leisure mat. Behind it is the bright beige sand, with the turquoise sea and horizon appearing faintly in the middle ground. People or parasols on the beach are small and softly blurred. Most of the background is a bright blue sky with few clouds. White seagulls fly in the upper left and right, slightly blurred due to depth of field. Strong direct noon sunlight enters from the upper left of the frame, forming bright highlights on the hair silhouette, cheeks, bridge of the nose, shoulders, collarbones, arms, watermelon, and water droplets. There are natural and slightly clear shadows under the chin, chest, inner arms, and skirt folds. Reflected light from the blue of the sky and sea is slightly added to the shadow side, creating a refreshing and bright summer color tone.

Composition/Lens: Vertical 2:3. Close-up shot of the character from a low camera position near the beach, slightly looking up. The character is placed largely in the center-right of the frame, captured from the top of the head to near the knees. The face is located near the center of the upper half, hands at the bottom center of the frame, and the watermelon largely occupies the bottom left foreground. The leisure mat is partially included in the bottom right, with the skirt and legs naturally cropped at the edges of the frame. Wide-angle-style perspective is used to make the foreground watermelon and stick appear larger than the character, with the watermelon, stick, hands, and face forming a diagonal continuous composition. The horizon is located low at the bottom of the frame, almost horizontal. The character's face, hands, stick, and the watermelon crack are clearly depicted, while distant swimmers, the sea, and seagulls are softly blurred. High-speed shutter captures the frozen moments of water droplets and fine hair fluttering in the wind.

Texture/Style: Photorealistic photograph. A bright and refreshing summer fashion portrait. Precise depiction of the skin's natural moisture, wet watermelon skin, transparent water droplets, light chiffon fabric, fine hair, and reflections of metal jewelry. The blue sky and sea are vivid, with the purple of the floral pattern, the green of the sunglasses, and the red of the watermelon serving as bright color accents. The character and foreground are sharp, while the background has natural optical blur. Avoid excessive skin smoothing or artificial CG expression, maintaining realistic photographic lighting, skin, and material textures.

Negative: Short hair, dark hair, opaque black sunglasses, swimwear or plain clothing, intact/unbroken watermelon, holding the stick with one hand, stick not in contact with hands, extra limbs or fingers, loose grip, unnatural face or teeth, excessive body emphasis, fisheye distortion, dim twilight scenes, illustration style, text, logo, watermark.

prompts.text:
主题：

主体：  
在盛夏的海滩上，20多岁的女性双膝跪在沙滩上，上身大幅前倾，用双手紧握一根木棒，向已劈开的大西瓜压去。画面前景处放置大幅劈开的大西瓜和飞溅的水滴，中央是握棒的双手，远处配置着灿烂大笑的女性面容，形成从前景到人物的视线自然连贯的纵深构图。鲜艳的蓝天、蔚蓝的大海、随风飘扬的长银白色头发、绿色的太阳镜、紫色系花卉图案雪纺连衣裙成为视觉中心。

人物·表情：  
拥有明亮象牙色肌肤的年轻女性。脸型柔和的卵形，下巴尖小而圆润。脸颊、鼻梁、肩膀、锁骨、手臂上带有盛夏阳光的自然光泽，肌肤上残留着细小的水滴和逼真的质感。眉毛是细长的灰褐色，呈缓和的拱形。眼部使用淡米色和苔绿色的眼影、细眼线、自然分离的睫毛。脸颊上施以淡玫瑰粉色的腮红，嘴唇涂抹透明感的珊瑚粉色唇彩。张开嘴愉快大笑，白牙自然显现。视线朝向镜头。  
佩戴大而圆润的绿色半透明太阳镜，细银色金属框架，双桥设计。头发延伸至腰部附近，是明亮的铂金金色。稀疏不齐的刘海和脸周的长层发，海风吹拂下大部分头发大幅向画面左侧流动。脸颊和嘴唇前方横过的细碎后发也自然保留。

服装·姿势：  
采用薰衣草色、淡紫、白、绿色小花图案的薄款雪纺吊带迷你连衣裙。细肩带、柔和近V字领口、胸下中央的小结和垂下的缎带。裙摆从腰部轻微展开，多层薄褶边和波浪状边缘。海风吹动画面右侧裙摆向外摇曳，半透明雪纺层与花纹重叠可见。  
颈部叠戴短银色珠链项链、小圆形吊坠，以及垂至胸口的透明水滴形吊坠。耳朵上戴小巧摇曳的银耳环，手腕上细手链。指甲为淡薰衣草色。  
女性双膝跪于沙滩，腰部向后保持，上身向前深倾。从双肩延伸手臂斜向下，在画面中央下方双手叠握木棒用力紧握。肘部几乎伸直，手指自然缠绕棒身。棒从双手向前景左下方的大西瓜斜伸，远近感使近端显得较粗。

背景·光线：  
前景左下方放置带有浓淡绿色条纹的大西瓜。西瓜从中央附近纵向裂开，缝隙中可见鲜艳的红色果肉。湿润表面有强烈的白色反光，裂缝和棒周围有大小透明水滴向上飞溅。  
前景右下方是蓝白粗条纹的休闲垫。其后是明亮的米色沙滩，中景处青绿色大海和地平线细细显现。海滩上的人物或阳伞小而柔和地虚化。背景大部分是少云的鲜艳蓝天。上空左右有白色海鸥飞翔，因景深而略微模糊。  
从画面左上方射入强烈的正午直射阳光，在头发轮廓、脸颊、鼻梁、肩膀、锁骨、手臂、西瓜、水滴上形成明亮高光。下巴下方、胸口、手臂内侧、裙褶处有自然且稍清晰的阴影。从天空和大海的蓝色反射光稍加于阴影侧，营造清爽明亮的夏日色调。

构图·镜头：  
纵向2:3。从靠近沙滩的低相机位置，略微仰拍人物的近距离拍摄。人物大幅置于画面中央偏右，从头顶至膝部附近纳入。脸位于上半部中央附近，双手在画面中央下方，西瓜大幅占据左下前景。右下方部分纳入休闲垫，裙摆和腿部在画面边缘自然裁切。  
使用广角式的远近感，使前景的西瓜和棒比人物显得更大，西瓜、棒、双手、脸形成一条对角线连贯的构图。地平线位于画面下方偏低处，几乎水平。人物的脸、双手、棒、西瓜裂缝清晰描绘，远处海水浴客、大海、海鸥柔和虚化。以高速快门捕捉水滴和随风飘扬的细发静止瞬间。

质感·风格：  
照片级真实写实照片。明亮清爽的夏日时尚肖像。精密描绘肌肤的自然水润感、湿润西瓜皮、透明水滴、轻盈雪纺面料、细发、金属饰品的反射。蓝天和大海鲜艳，花纹的紫色、太阳镜的绿色、西瓜的红色作为鲜明色彩点缀。人物和前景锐利，背景自然光学虚化。避免过度美肌修饰或人工CG表现，保持现实照片的光线、肌肤、材质感。

负面：  
短发、暗色头发、不透明黑色太阳镜、泳装或素色服装、完整无损的西瓜、单手持棒、棒与手非接触、多余手脚或手指、松散握姿、不自然的脸或牙齿、过度身体强调、鱼眼变形、昏暗黄昏场景、插图风格、文字、标志、水印。

prompts.text: Generate a minimalist product instructional visual around any theme object: leave a large area of blank space at the top, set two lines of restrained and powerful Chinese titles in the upper left, black thin sans-serif font, natural character spacing, loose line spacing, like a rational statement rather than an emotional slogan; below the title, use thin lines to form a horizontal table column, several phrases separated by vertical lines, a small circular symbol before each item, gray crosses and warm gold checkmarks forming a slight information rhythm, text size significantly smaller than the title, the whole thing like a verifiable quality checklist. In the center of the image, let the theme object appear in a "sliced open" manner: the bottom is a steady semicircular or block-like support, the surface displays real textures, veins, fibers, particles or layers derived from the theme; the top separates into round slices, long strips, and small squares, floating upward along a slightly tilted vertical axis, maintaining clear spacing from each other, the cut surfaces facing the viewer, outer skin, internal tissue and moist edges forming touchable material evidence. A slender metal tool is inserted diagonally from the right into the bottom support, the tip becoming a structural fulcrum, the cold gray highlights forming a clean contrast with the warm or thematic colors of the theme object. The background must be close to pure white or very light neutral colors, retaining about more than half of the blank area; theme colors are derived from content semantics, but follow the role relationship of "light background as the main, subject medium-to-high saturation, text pure black, symbols highlighted in warm gold, metal in cold gray auxiliary," with refreshing brightness and saturation concentrated on the object itself, not covering the whole picture. The light is high-key hard photographic light, illuminating from the upper left, with clear highlights and small moist reflections on the edges, and short, clear shadows cast to the right at the bottom, all materials real, clean, without yellowing or aging. Press the layout with a thin horizontal line at the bottom, then place a line of tiny gray footnotes, forming a calm reading path from the title, certification column, floating slices to the footnotes; if the subject is not sliced and floating, the tool does not participate in support, the text column becomes ordinary decoration, or the background becomes heavy and muddy upon failure, it will lose this rational laboratory-like food advertisement temperament. —————— Theme: Fresh-cut citrus pulp new product poster, highlighting the refreshing texture of the peel and internal tissue. Light supplement: Add a clear new product selling point, retain a small amount of promotional text. Aspect ratio: Vertical 9:10.

围绕任意主题对象生成极简产品说明式视觉：上方保留大面积空白，左上设置两行克制有力的中文标题，黑色细瘦无衬线字形，字距自然、行距宽松，像理性声明而非情绪口号；标题下方用细线构成横向表格栏，若干短语被竖线分隔，每项前有小圆形符号，灰色叉号与暖金色勾号形成轻微信息节奏，文字尺寸明显小于标题，整体像可核验的品质清单。画面中部让主题对象以可被“整颗切开”的方式出现：底部是稳重的半圆或块状承托体，表面显示主题派生的真实纹理、脉络、纤维、颗粒或层理；上方分离出圆片、长条切面和小方块，沿一条轻微倾斜的垂直轴向上悬浮，彼此保持清晰间距，切面朝向观者，外皮、内部组织和湿润边缘形成可触摸的材质证据。一件细长金属工具从右侧斜插入底部承托体，尖端成为结构支点，冷灰高光与主题对象的暖色或主题色形成干净对照。背景必须接近纯白或极浅中性色，保留约大半空白面积；主题颜色由内容语义派生，但遵守“浅背景为主、主体中高饱和、文字纯黑、符号暖金点亮、金属冷灰辅助”的角色关系，明度清爽、饱和集中在物体本身，不铺满全图。光线为高调硬净摄影光，从左上方照亮，边缘有明确高光与细小湿润反射，底部向右投下短而清晰的阴影，所有材质真实、洁净、无泛黄旧化。底部以一条细横线压住版面，再放一行极小灰色脚注，形成从标题、认证栏、悬浮切面到脚注的冷静阅读路径；失败时若主体不被切分悬浮、工具不参与支撑、文字栏变成普通装饰或背景变得厚重浑浊，就会失去这种理性实验室般的食物广告气质。


——————

轻补充：加入一个清晰新品卖点，保留少量促销文字

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium commercial poster for DANISA Butter Cookies, pushing the Milk Cloud Orbit direction to the extreme while further enlarging the negative space, intensifying the royal-blue and champagne-gold luxury atmosphere, and amplifying the central fracture tension. The image must center on one authentic Danisa butter cookie being cleanly snapped open by two elegant fingertips, frozen at the exact peak instant of breakage, with a narrow high-tension gap between the halves and a luxurious cascade of buttery crumbs and fine biscuit dust falling through the center. The final artwork must feel collector-grade, jewel-box elegant, hyper-realistic, and globally premium, like a world-class Danish butter-cookie brand campaign. Use English-first branding only, with minimal official Danisa logo presence and extremely restrained premium typography.

Core composition:
Use a tall vertical composition with the hero butter cookie exactly centered in the frame, held delicately by two fingertips entering from the left and right edges. The cookie must be split into two balanced halves with a dramatic suspended break aligned to the center axis. Expand the surrounding clean space significantly so the product occupies a tighter central zone and the rest of the frame breathes with expensive restraint. The composition must feel iconic, elevated, and fully focused on the snap moment.

Central fracture tension:
This is critical. The break must feel sharper, tighter, and more dramatic, as if the cookie has just reached the most beautiful millisecond of snapping apart. The two halves should feel visually loaded with tension, with crisp fracture lines, suspended crumb particles, delicate butter-sand debris, and a controlled vertical fall of crumbs through the center gap. The middle break must become the absolute emotional and visual core of the poster.

Milk Cloud Orbit enhancement:
Push tactile realism much further. The broken interior must feel more buttery, more sandy, more delicate, and more touchable. Enhance the fine crumb granules, dry-butter richness, ridge texture, edge sharpness, falling crumb layers, fingertip skin realism, and warm illuminated particle dust so every surface feels collector-grade. The cookie should look rich, dense, fragile, and freshly broken.

Hero product logic:
The product must read instantly as authentic Danisa Danish butter cookies. Show the classic rich butter-cookie texture, elegant ridged surface logic, delicate baked golden edges, and dense yet crumbly premium biscuit character. The broken interior must feel buttery, layered, sandy, and exquisitely fragile, with visible crumb granules and refined fracture detail. The cookie must feel thick, premium, and heritage-rich, never industrial or fake.

Finger styling:
The fingertips must feel clean, elegant, natural, and premium. Skin texture should be soft and realistic, with refined pose logic and no distraction. Their only role is to support the snap moment, emphasize texture scale, and frame the central fracture beautifully.

Crumb cascade and base:
Let fine cookie dust and larger broken particles fall from the center gap into a refined pile of buttery crumbs and a few broken cookie chunks below. The lower crumb bed must feel fresh, tactile, and luxurious, with clear variation from powder to chunk. Keep the fall controlled, sculptural, and appetizing.

Negative space:
This is critical. Further enlarge the empty surrounding space so the hero cookie and its fracture feel more elevated, more cinematic, and more premium. The unused space must feel intentional, expensive, and brand-led, making the central snap moment read like a jewel object inside a luxury poster. Do not clutter this space with props or oversized text.

Blue-and-gold atmosphere:
Push the royal-blue and champagne-gold identity much harder. Let the background, light accents, and overall poster mood shift into a cooler, nobler, more jewel-like luxury system. The contrast between deep royal blue shadow fields and warm butter-gold highlights must feel richer and more prestigious, while the cookie itself remains warm, buttery, and realistic. The image should feel like a premium tin-box heritage campaign elevated into a modern brand masterpiece.

Background and environment:
Use a minimal smooth background with deep royal blue, warm ivory, and restrained champagne-gold tonal transitions. Keep it clean, elegant, and softly atmospheric, with no clutter and no extra scenery. The background should function like a luxury stage for the cookie and falling crumbs.

Typography and branding:
Use English-first typography with a very short refined line such as “Butter Crafted Elegance” or “The Taste of Danish Tradition”. Keep the typography compact, elegant, and secondary to the image. Add only a discreet official Danisa logo presence. The poster must remain image-led rather than text-led.

Lighting:
Use extremely delicate high-end commercial lighting with warm cinematic shaping. Let the light reveal cookie grain, fracture edges, crumb dust, fingertip detail, and falling particles with graceful premium highlight rolloff. The scene must glow with buttery warmth while maintaining soft shadow depth and blue-gold luxury contrast.

Material realism:
Push realism to the maximum. The butter cookie must feel dense, sandy, crisp, and fragile. The break edge must show believable crumb structure. The falling particles must feel weighty and natural. Larger crumb chunks must feel crisp and freshly broken. Skin, crumbs, and cookie surfaces must all feel collector-grade and touchable.

Color direction:
Use a refined luxury palette of butter gold, baked biscuit beige, royal blue, warm ivory, and restrained champagne-gold highlights. Keep the image luxurious, appetite-driven, and distinctly Danisa in mood, with stronger blue-gold prestige than before.

Mood:
Danish butter-cookie luxury, jewel-box heritage elegance, central snap tension, premium biscuit realism, collector-grade confectionery campaign, refined indulgence, blue-gold prestige

Rendering style:
ultra-premium biscuit advertising poster, Milk Cloud Orbit enhancement, centered broken Danisa butter cookie held by fingertips, enlarged negative space, intensified central fracture tension, suspended crumb cascade, stronger royal-blue and champagne-gold atmosphere, minimal heritage branding, soft cinematic lighting, extreme fracture realism, editorial confectionery campaign aesthetic, 8k

Negative prompt:
cheap supermarket flyer style, oversized text, messy hands, fake cookie texture, plastic-looking crumbs, weak fracture detail, cluttered background, cartoon styling, greasy look, low-resolution texture, chaotic props, distorted branding, weak product focus, insufficient negative space

prompts.text:
为皇冠丹麦曲奇（DANISA Butter Cookies）制作一张超高端商业海报，将“牛奶云轨道”方向推向极致，同时进一步扩大留白，强化皇室蓝与香槟金的奢华氛围，并放大中央断裂的张力。画面必须以一块真实的皇冠丹麦曲奇为中心，它被两个优雅的指尖干净利落地掰开，冻结在破碎的最巅峰瞬间，两半之间留有一条窄窄的高张力缝隙，奢华的黄油碎屑和精细的饼干粉末从中心倾泻而下。最终的作品必须具有收藏级质感、珠宝盒般的优雅、超写实且具备全球顶尖品质，就像一场世界级的丹麦曲奇品牌活动。仅使用英语优先的品牌设计，带有极简的皇冠官方标志，以及极其克制的高级排版。

核心构图：
采用高耸的垂直构图，主角曲奇准确位于画面中央，由从左右边缘伸入的两个指尖细腻地捏住。曲奇必须分成平衡的两半，并在中轴线上呈现充满戏剧性的悬浮断裂。大幅扩展周围的干净空间，使产品占据更紧凑的中心区域，而画面的其余部分则散发着昂贵的克制感。构图必须具有标志性、高级感，并完全聚焦于折断的瞬间。

中央断裂张力：
这是至关重要的。断裂感必须更锋利、更紧凑、更有戏剧性，仿佛曲奇刚刚达到掰开时最美的毫秒瞬间。两半曲奇在视觉上应充满张力，拥有清晰的断裂纹路、悬浮的碎屑颗粒、细腻的黄油沙质残渣，以及碎屑穿过中心缝隙受控的垂直落下。中间的断裂必须成为海报绝对的情感和视觉核心。

牛奶云轨道增强：
进一步提升触觉写实感。破碎的内部必须感觉更有黄油感、更具沙质、更细腻、更真实可感。增强细小的碎屑颗粒、干黄油的丰盈度、纹路质感、边缘锐度、掉落的碎屑层、指尖皮肤的写实感以及温暖的照明微尘，使每个表面都达到收藏级水平。曲奇看起来应该浓郁、致密、脆弱且新鲜折断。

主角产品逻辑：
产品必须能让人立刻认出是正宗的皇冠丹麦曲奇。展示经典的浓郁黄油曲奇质感、优雅的棱纹表面逻辑、细腻的烘烤金色边缘，以及致密而酥脆的高级饼干特性。破碎的内部必须感觉充满黄油、层次分明、呈沙状且精致脆弱，带有可见的碎屑颗粒和精细的断裂细节。曲奇必须感觉厚实、高端且富有传承感，绝非工业化或虚假的产品。

手指造型：
指尖必须感觉干净、优雅、自然且高端。皮肤纹理应柔软写实，具有精细的姿势逻辑且不产生干扰。它们的唯一作用是支撑折断瞬间，强调质感比例，并精美地框住中央断裂处。

碎屑倾泻与基底：
让细小的饼干粉尘和较大的破碎颗粒从中心缝隙掉落，落入下方由黄油碎屑和几块破碎曲奇块组成的精制堆簇中。底部的碎屑层必须感觉新鲜、真实且奢华，从粉末到碎块有明显的视觉变化。保持掉落过程受控、具有雕塑感且令人垂涎。

留白：
这是至关重要的。进一步扩大周围的空白区域，使主角曲奇及其断裂感显得更高级、更具电影感且更高端。未使用的空间必须感觉是有意为之的、昂贵的且由品牌主导的，使中央的折断瞬间读起来就像奢华海报中的珠宝首饰。不要用道具或过大的文字塞满这个空间。

蓝金氛围：
更强力地推行皇室蓝与香槟金的身份识别。让背景、光影细节和整体海报氛围转向更冷色调、更显赫、更像珠宝般的奢华体系。深邃的皇室蓝阴影区域与温暖的黄油金色高光之间的对比必须感觉更丰富、更威严，而曲奇本身则保持温暖、黄油感和写实感。图像应感觉像是一场提升为现代品牌杰作的高端铁盒传承活动。

背景与环境：
使用极简的光滑背景，带有深皇室蓝、暖象牙色和克制的香槟金影调过渡。保持干净、优雅且柔和的氛围，没有杂乱，没有额外场景。背景应像一个为曲奇和掉落碎屑准备的奢华舞台。

排版与品牌：
使用英语优先的排版，搭配非常简洁精炼的短句，如“Butter Crafted Elegance”或“The Taste of Danish Tradition”。保持排版紧凑、优雅，并次于图像。仅添加低调的皇冠官方标志。海报必须保持图像主导，而非文字主导。

灯光：
使用极其细腻的高端商业照明，带有温暖的电影感塑造。让光线展现曲奇纹理、断裂边缘、碎屑粉尘、指尖细节和掉落颗粒，并带有优雅的高级高光衰减。场景必须焕发出黄油般的温暖，同时保持柔和的阴影深度和蓝金奢华对比。

材质写实感：
将写实感推向极致。黄油曲奇必须感觉致密、沙质、酥脆且脆弱。断裂边缘必须展示可信的碎屑结构。掉落的颗粒必须感觉有重量感且自然。较大的碎屑块必须感觉酥脆且新鲜折断。皮肤、碎屑和曲奇表面都必须感觉是收藏级的且真实可感。

色彩方向：
使用由黄油金、烘烤饼干米色、皇室蓝、暖象牙色和克制的香槟金高光组成的精制奢华调色板。保持图像奢华、激发食欲，并具有明显的皇冠品牌氛围，具有比以前更强的蓝金威望感。

情绪：
丹麦黄油曲奇奢华感，珠宝盒传承优雅，中央折断张力，高端饼干写实感，收藏级糖果活动，精致的享受，蓝金威望感

渲染风格：
超高端饼干广告海报，牛奶云轨道增强，指尖捏住的居中断裂皇冠丹麦曲奇，扩大的留白空间，强化的中央断裂张力，悬浮的碎屑倾泻，更强的皇室蓝与香槟金氛围，极简传承品牌，柔和的电影感灯光，极致的断裂写实感，社论糖果活动美学，8k

负面提示词：
廉价超市传单风格，过大的文字，凌乱的手，虚假的曲奇质感，塑料感的碎屑，微弱的断裂细节，杂乱的背景，卡通造型，油腻感，低分辨率纹理，混乱的道具，扭曲的品牌设计，弱化的产品焦点，留白不足
