items.title: 俯拍竹筏古风女子青绿意境人像

prompts.text:
2:3 vertical single outdoor ancient-style environment portrait, shot from above through emerald green leaves and hanging branches near the lens in the upper right of the frame, foreground leaves forming an irregular top framing, covering part of the water surface and the space above the character's head, but must not block the character's face. High camera position shot downwards from the shore or a bridge, a bamboo raft made of old and new green bamboo tied side-by-side runs diagonally from the upper left to the lower right of the frame, bamboo nodes, horizontal fixed wooden strips, and rope knot structures are continuous and believable.

A young adult East Asian female sits in the center-right of the bamboo raft, upper body slightly towards the left of the frame, head lifted looking at the camera at a high position, eyes naturally open, brow relaxed, lips slightly parted, expression quiet, soft, and slightly curious. Hips in clear contact with the bamboo raft, one leg bent and retracted on the raft surface, the other leg naturally hanging from the edge of the raft, bare feet gently exploring the water, small ripples and realistic water surface disturbance forming at the feet.

Deep black long hair styled in a traditional low bun, adorned with light-colored jade hairpins, metal leaf hair accessories, and a small amount of thin long hanging ornaments, two strands of long straight hair falling from the shoulders to below the waist. Wearing multi-layered ancient-style clothing composed of cyan-green, peacock blue, grayish-blue, and light gray, light-colored close-fitting inner layer, deep cyan-green high-waisted loose long skirt, outer layer is semi-transparent gradient wide sleeves and pibao (silk drape), cyan, blue, and grayish-purple gauze layered over each other, able to reveal the inner fabric and the color of the bamboo raft. The pibao falls naturally from the shoulders and arms to both sides, the skirt hem forms large-area folds on the surface of the bamboo raft influenced by sitting posture, gravity, and bamboo node support, not floating.

One hand naturally placed at the side of the knee or the edge of the bamboo raft, the other hand partially covered by the wide sleeve, shoulder line relaxed, neck slightly extended due to the raised head. Clothing features low-saturation bamboo leaf patterns, plant patterns, or water ripple patterns, patterns naturally deforming along the fabric folds. Inner fabric is soft, matte, and has draping weight, deep cyan long skirt retains extremely weak silk reflection, outer gauze is light and semi-transparent, no plastic feeling.

The background is a garden pond, slow-moving river channel, or forest stream pool surrounded by trees, the water surface is deep green and grayish-green, retaining natural ripples, tree shadow reflections, and local cold blue reflections. The water surface below the bamboo raft and around the character is clearly discernible, the distant environment is moderately softened. Soft overcast scattered light or natural light filtered through the canopy enters from the front-above, evenly illuminating the character's face, neck, back of hands, and light-colored clothing layers, no hard shadows.

Deep green and grayish-green water surface accounts for about 40%, cyan-yellow bamboo raft and earth-brown bamboo nodes about 25%, cyan-green and grayish-blue clothing about 20%, deep black hair and clothing shadows about 10%, light warm ivory skin and grayish-white highlights about 5%. Real ancient-style environment photography, medium depth of field, character clarity slightly higher than water surface and leaves, low-saturation cyan-green tone, quiet, serene, with landscape poetic imagery. Core relationship is high-angle top-down shot, foreground leaf framing, diagonal bamboo raft, character sitting by water, bare feet in water, and cyan-green multi-layered ancient clothing.

Negative Prompt

Low camera angle, eye-level composition, bamboo raft placed horizontally, foreground leaves missing, leaves covering the character's whole face, character floating, hips not touching the bamboo raft, sitting posture force error, abnormal number of knees, confused leg positions, deformed toes, extra toes, feet passing through water surface, no ripples at the entry point, water surface like solid, bamboo raft bamboo tubes broken, bamboo nodes misaligned, confused number of bamboo tubes, bamboo raft perspective error, rope knots floating, crossbeams cannot connect, extra fingers, missing fingers, hand deformity, fingers passing through clothing, long hair and pibao stuck together, hair ornaments floating, bun structure confused, outer robe fused into a single green cloth ball, gauze completely opaque, shiny plastic gauze, hard organza, cheap stage satin, zero-gravity streamers, flat sticker patterns, modern raincoat texture, single green filter for the whole image, skin obviously turning green, excessive skin smoothing, plastic skin, heavy makeup, exaggerated expressions, modern clothing, modern architecture, tourists, boats, text, watermark, brand logo, HDR, over-sharpening, strong flash, strong portrait mode blur, commercial studio ancient costume feel.

prompts.text:
2:3 竖幅单人户外古风环境人像，隔着画面右上方靠近镜头的翠绿色树叶与垂落枝条俯拍，前景叶片形成不规则顶部框景，遮住部分水面和人物头顶空间，但不得遮挡人物面部。高机位从岸边或桥上向下拍摄，一张由新旧青竹并排捆扎而成的竹筏沿画面左上至右下斜向贯穿，竹节、横向固定木条与绳结结构连续可信。

一位年轻成年东亚女性坐在竹筏中央偏右，上身略朝画面左侧，头部抬起看向高处镜头，眼睛自然睁开，眉间舒展，嘴唇轻轻分开，神态清静、柔和、略带好奇。臀部与竹筏明确接触，一条腿屈曲收在筏面，另一条腿从竹筏边缘自然垂落，赤足轻轻探入水中，脚边形成细小涟漪和真实水面扰动。

深黑色长发梳成传统低位盘发，配浅色玉簪、金属叶片发饰和少量细长垂坠饰件，两缕长直发从肩部垂落至腰部以下。穿青绿、孔雀蓝、灰蓝和浅灰色组成的多层古风衣装，浅色贴身内搭，深青绿色高腰宽松长裙，外层为半透明渐变宽袖和披帛，青、蓝、灰紫色薄纱互相叠加，能够透出内层衣料与竹筏颜色。披帛从肩臂向两侧自然垂落，裙摆在竹筏表面形成受坐姿、重力和竹节支撑影响的大面积褶皱，不悬浮。

人物一只手自然放在膝侧或竹筏边缘，另一只手被宽袖部分遮挡，肩线放松，颈部因抬头而轻微延伸。服装带有低饱和竹叶纹、植物纹或水波纹，纹样顺着布料褶皱自然变形。内层衣料柔软哑光并具有垂坠重量，深青长裙保留极弱丝质反射，外层薄纱轻盈半透明，没有塑料感。

背景为树木包围的园林池塘、缓慢河道或林间溪潭，水面呈深绿与灰绿色，保留自然波纹、树影反射和局部冷蓝反光。竹筏下方与人物周围水面清楚可辨，远处环境适度柔化。柔和阴天散射光或树冠过滤后的自然光从前上方进入，均匀照亮人物面部、颈部、手背和浅色衣层，没有硬阴影。

深绿与灰绿水面约占四成，青黄竹筏与土棕竹节约占两成半，青绿与灰蓝衣装约占两成，深黑头发和衣物暗部约占一成，浅暖象牙肤色与灰白高光约占半成。真实古风环境摄影，中等景深，人物清晰度略高于水面与树叶，低饱和青绿色调，安静、清幽、具有山水诗意。核心关系为高位俯拍、前景树叶框景、斜向竹筏、人物临水坐姿、赤足入水和青绿多层古风衣装。

负向提示词

prompts.text:
A young adult East Asian woman stands in front of a pure warm white studio background, with the shot taken from the top of her head to near her waist. The subject is positioned slightly to the right of center, her body facing slightly towards the right of the frame, her head turned towards the left of the frame at a roughly two-thirds profile angle, chin slightly pressed down, eyes naturally closed, with a quiet, restrained, and soft expression, and lips gently closed, presenting a pure and high-end beauty and lingerie editorial portrait texture.

She has a delicate oval face, a smooth jawline, natural thin eyebrows, a slender and straight bridge of the nose, and pale nude-pink lips. The makeup is extremely light, featuring only a thin base, natural eyelashes, soft beige-brown eyeshadow, and a slight blush. Her skin tone is fair with neutral-warm undertones, retaining realistic pores, fine vellus hair, natural skin tone variations, and soft sebum highlights; plastic skin smoothing is prohibited.

Her deep black long hair is neatly parted in the middle, smoothly conforming to the shape of her head, and tied into a low double-layered bun or petal-shaped low bun at the back of the head, with a very small amount of stray hair near the ears. On her right ear, she wears an earring combining a silver leaf shape with a rounded pearl, featuring delicate metal reflections.

She is wearing a white translucent floral embroidery tulle bra with thin shoulder straps, underwired structure, and fine lace edges, which completely covers key areas; she is layered with an off-white lightweight chiffon or silk cover-up with loose long sleeves, naturally open and draped over her shoulders and arms. Both hands are gently arranging or holding the ties of the cover-up in front of her waist, with fingers appearing natural and clear.

The background is a seamless cream-white to light gray-white gradient, without furniture or decorations. A large softbox shines from the front-left above the frame, with a white reflector used for fill light from the front; shadows are extremely shallow, and the overall look is high-key, low saturation, and low contrast, with clear white layers.

Photography style: 85mm or 105mm portrait lens, f/2.8, eye-level camera position, medium-shallow depth of field, clear details on the side profile, earrings, and lace textures, realistic skin, hair, pearls, tulle, and chiffon fibers, slight ISO 100 film grain, soft fine-art beauty editorial, photorealistic.

Avoid: open eyes, looking directly at the camera, exaggerated expressions, heavy makeup, messy hairstyles, transparent exposure, nudity, incorrect bra structure, incorrect fingers, fused arms, plastic skin, excessive skin smoothing, strong HDR, over-sharpening, CG, anime, text, watermarks, Logos.

prompts.text:

TEXT:

SCENE:
Depict a storytelling scene on a quiet riverside promenade overlooking the Sumida River. A couple stands near the riverside railing in the lower third, one lightly leaning toward the other. Tokyo Skytree appears in the mid-distance as the main landmark, with a simple bridge hint crossing the river, a few minimal water lines, and a faint city skyline suggestion stretching behind.

COMPOSITION:
Use the riverside railing as a simple foreground anchor, the couple as the emotional focal point, and Tokyo Skytree as the central location cue. Keep the river and sky minimal with generous blank paper around them.

BACKGROUND SIMPLIFICATION:
Include only 4 key cues: riverside railing, Tokyo Skytree, river suggestion, and a faint skyline silhouette. Avoid crowds, vehicles, boats, dense buildings, and cluttered city details.

FINISH:
The couple and railing should be moderately resolved. The Skytree and skyline should remain simplified, partially colored, and lightly outlined.

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 high-fashion editorial poster built around a single person and a layered visual identity.

Subject: [Asian / Western / male / female]
Title: [custom title]
Layering method: [giant portrait / textured glass / motion-blurred foreground / split mirrors]
Color palette: [custom colors]
Series label: LAYERED PRESENCE
Year: 2026

Keep one version of the subject clear and recognizable, while a second visual layer changes how the same person is perceived through scale, refraction, movement, or reflection.

4 directions:

1. INNER SCALE — a smaller foreground figure placed against an enlarged background portrait, with different expressions and opposing gaze directions.

2. PRISM CONTACT — part of the face remains clear while textured glass stretches and refracts the other side, including the hand touching the surface.

3. PASSING FRAME — a sharp subject surrounded by blurred foreground figures or motion trails, creating depth and the feeling that the world is moving around them.

4. TWIN FREQUENCY — the same person appears across several narrow mirrors, with each reflection showing a slightly different pose or emotion.

Use realistic fashion photography, natural skin texture, believable hair and fabric, cinematic lighting, subtle grain, restrained graphic accents, and strong foreground-background separation.

竖版 3:4，单张创意人像图片，真实摄影质感与超现实动画元素结合，不要拼贴，不要四宫格，不要信息图，不要文字。

一位年轻亚洲女性站在傍晚的城市街头，背对镜头后微微回头，身形修长，气质安静高级。她穿一条黑色优雅长裙，裙摆被双手自然轻轻提起展开。人物本身保持真实人像摄影质感，皮肤细腻自然，头发盘起或低扎，整体高级简洁。

最核心的创意是：裙摆内部不是普通布料，而是一整座发光的微缩城市。在黑色裙摆之中，清晰可见夜晚城市的街道、车流、楼宇、窗户灯光、十字路口和高楼之间的纵深感，仿佛一座繁华城市被装进了她的裙子里。裙摆边缘仍然保留真实布料的垂坠感，但内部世界像一个独立的夜景宇宙，灯光温暖、细节丰富、层次分明。

背景是真实但略微虚化的都市街道，冷色傍晚环境，远处有路灯和散景光斑，营造电影感。整体画面要兼具时尚大片气质与超现实想象力，构图干净，人物居中偏下，裙摆成为视觉焦点。风格高级、梦幻、具有故事感。

负面提示词：
不要卡通脸，不要低幼插画感，不要廉价特效，不要畸形手，不要多余人物，不要文字水印，不要夸张科幻机甲感，不要婚纱感，不要杂乱背景。

items.title: 超写实东方古典女性肖像摄影写真

prompts.text:
3:4 vertical composition, ultra-realistic Oriental classical female portrait photography, cinematic Oriental aesthetics photo shoot, high-end Editorial art photography style, real photography texture, not an illustration, not anime.

The main subject is an original adult Oriental female character over 22 years old. The character's overall image is designed with reference to high-end classical figures, possessing a gentle and elegant Oriental temperament. The face is natural and exquisite, the features are soft and pleasing, the facial contours are smooth, the gaze is quiet and subtle, and the skin has a natural and delicate texture, retaining real skin grain, slight pore details, and natural luster, without using plastic skin or excessive skin smoothing.

Character Styling:

The character wears a light blue Oriental classical long dress. The clothing is designed by combining Song dynasty aesthetics with modern high-end period photography. The overall color palette is light mist blue and moon white. The outer layer is covered with a light, translucent long gauze shawl. The fabric has the texture of delicate silk and soft gauze. The cuffs are wide and hang naturally. The skirt uses a multi-layered stacked gauze structure, and the surface is decorated with low-key and exquisite white floral embroidery. The embroidery is concentrated on the edges of the sleeves, the chest, and the hem area. The patterns are delicate, not exaggerated, and not cheap. The overall presentation is a cold, pure, and soft Oriental celestial and elegant temperament.

Hairstyle Design:

Adopts a traditional Oriental high bun, with long black hair gathered up. The bun is full and rounded with an exquisite structure. A light-colored pearl flower hairpin is added to the top of the head. The hairpin is composed of white flowers, tiny pearls, and hanging tassels. A few natural loose hairs are kept on the sides, with a few strands gently blown by the breeze, forming a soft hair outline light under backlighting.

Posture Design:

The character is in a two-thirds side-view standing posture, with the body turned towards the side-rear of the camera. The shoulders maintain a natural rotation, and the upper body is not facing the camera directly. One shoulder is slightly raised, forming an elegant and subtle shoulder line. The head looks back along the direction of the shoulder, and the face maintains a side-turned angle. The character is not in a posed front-facing shot but looks as if the photographer captured the moment of turning, with a natural and relaxed body posture.

Round Fan Action:

The character holds an Oriental round fan. The fan has a traditional circular shape, and the fan surface is a complete circular structure. The fan ribs are made of light-colored bamboo and wood. The fan surface uses a dense silk material with transparency reduced by about 20%, remaining semi-transparent but with a clear blocking effect. Faintly elegant Oriental flower and bird patterns can be seen on the fan surface. The character holds the round fan in front of the face, with the fan covering about 40% of the face, hiding the area near one eye and part of the cheek. The other eye is revealed from the edge of the fan. The character gazes quietly at the camera through the edge of the fan, with fingers naturally gripping the fan handle in a gentle and restrained movement, creating a feeling of a classical woman observing the camera subtly.

Expression:

The revealed gaze is calm and soft, with no obvious smile. The corners of the mouth are naturally relaxed, with a slight sense of tranquility. The overall mood is like the moment after a character in an ancient painting wakes up.

Photography Environment:

An indoor Oriental space with a minimalist background, featuring light-colored walls, wooden structures, and soft window light. The space is kept clean, and the background is highly blurred to avoid complex decorations from stealing the focus from the main character.

Light and Shadow:

Adopts strong side-backlighting photography. The light source comes from behind the character. Sunlight enters the space through window gauze, forming a soft white halo. Natural light mist appears at the edges of the lens. Obvious rim lighting is generated on the character's shoulders, hair accessories, and the edge of the round fan. The face maintains soft shadows, and highlights overflow naturally, simulating the optical effects produced by a real cinematic lens facing strong light.

Photography Parameters:

Leica SL3 full-frame photography, APO-Summicron-SL 90mm F2 ASPH lens, F2 large aperture, shallow depth of field, real lens bokeh, RAW photography, slight film grain, low-saturation Oriental cinematic colors, high-end classical magazine photography texture.

Prohibited:

Anime, 2D, CG characters, game characters, plastic skin, AI face, exaggerated beauty enhancement, influencer face, modern clothing, cheongsam, overly transparent clothing, completely transparent round fan, fan covering the entire face, watermarks, text, logo, hand errors, extra or missing fingers.

prompts.text:
3:4竖构图，超写实东方古典女性肖像摄影，电影级东方美学写真，高级Editorial艺术摄影风格，真实摄影质感，非插画，非动漫。

画面主体为一位22岁以上原创成年东方女性角色，人物整体参考高级古典人物形象设计，拥有温柔清雅的东方气质，面容自然精致，五官柔和耐看，脸部轮廓流畅，眼神安静含蓄，皮肤呈自然细腻质感，保留真实皮肤纹理、轻微毛孔细节与自然光泽，不使用塑料皮肤，不过度磨皮。

人物造型：

人物穿着淡蓝色东方古典长裙，服装采用宋制美学与现代高级古装摄影结合设计，整体色调为浅雾蓝、月白色，外层覆盖轻盈半透明长纱披帛，衣料具有细腻丝绸与柔纱质感，袖口宽大自然垂落，裙身采用多层叠纱结构，表面装饰低调精致的白色花卉刺绣，刺绣集中于衣袖边缘、胸前以及裙摆区域，纹样细腻，不夸张，不廉价，整体呈现清冷、纯净、柔和的东方仙雅气质。

发型设计：

采用传统东方高盘发，黑色长发整体盘起，发髻饱满圆润，结构精致，头顶加入浅色珍珠花簪，簪饰由白色花朵、细小珍珠以及垂落流苏组成，侧边保留少量自然碎发，几缕发丝被微风轻轻吹动，逆光下形成柔和发丝轮廓光。

姿态设计：

人物整体呈三分之二侧身站姿，身体朝镜头侧后方转动，肩膀保持自然旋转，上半身并非正面对镜头，一侧肩膀轻微抬起，形成优雅含蓄的肩部线条，头部沿肩膀方向回望，脸部保持侧转角度，人物不是摆拍式正脸，而像摄影师捕捉到转身瞬间，身体姿态舒展自然。

团扇动作：

人物手持一把东方圆形团扇，团扇为传统圆盘造型，扇面呈完整圆形结构，扇骨采用浅色竹木材质，扇面使用细密丝绢材质，透明度降低约20%，保持半透明但具有明确遮挡效果，扇面可以隐约看到淡雅东方花鸟纹样，人物将团扇举在脸部前方，团扇遮挡脸部约40%左右，遮住一侧眼睛附近以及部分面颊，另一侧眼睛从扇缘露出，人物通过扇子边缘安静望向镜头，手指自然握住扇柄，动作轻柔克制，营造古典女性含蓄观察镜头的感觉。

表情：

露出的眼神平静柔和，没有明显微笑，嘴角自然放松，带有轻微沉静感，整体情绪像古画人物苏醒后的瞬间。

摄影环境：

室内东方空间，背景极简，采用浅色墙面、木质结构、柔和窗光，空间保持干净，背景高度虚化，避免复杂装饰抢夺人物主体。

光影：

采用强烈侧逆光摄影，光源来自人物后方，阳光穿过窗纱进入空间，形成柔白色光晕，镜头边缘出现自然光雾，人物肩部、发饰、团扇边缘产生明显轮廓光，脸部保持柔和阴影，高光自然溢出，模拟真实电影镜头面对强光产生的光学效果。

摄影参数：

Leica SL3全画幅摄影，APO-Summicron-SL 90mm F2 ASPH镜头，F2大光圈，浅景深，真实镜头虚化，RAW摄影，轻微胶片颗粒，低饱和东方电影色彩，高级古典杂志摄影质感。

禁止：

动漫、二次元、CG人物、游戏角色、塑料皮肤、AI脸、夸张美颜、网红脸、现代服装、旗袍、过度透明服饰、团扇完全透明、扇子遮挡整张脸、水印、文字、Logo、手部错误、多指少指。

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium 4-panel product poster for the Dilmah Tea series, merging extreme beverage realism with stronger flavor-based visual differentiation, while reducing all supporting elements to an even purer minimum. Fully preserve the exact visual logic and elegant minimal layout of a luxury beverage editorial campaign: a strict 2x2 grid, each panel featuring one real Dilmah tea product presented in a clean, isolated, highly refined still-life composition. The final artwork must feel like a world-class premium tea campaign: hyper-realistic, pure, elegant, visually quiet, and extremely polished, with the products remaining the absolute heroes.

Core structure:
Use a strict 2x2 four-panel layout with equal panel proportions and perfect spacing. Each panel must function like its own luxury still-life poster while remaining part of one unified Dilmah series. The overall composition must feel balanced, airy, minimal, and premium, with strong visual consistency across all four quadrants.

Product system:
Feature four real Dilmah Tea series products, each one clearly different in flavor identity, liquid color, glass styling mood, and visual personality while still belonging to the same elegant family. Suggested lineup:
1. floral tea
2. classic black tea
3. fruit tea
4. green tea or matcha-inspired tea variation

Each panel must show the real Dilmah product in a beautifully styled glass or tea-serving presentation. Packaging may be subtly implied or very lightly integrated only if needed, but the drink itself must remain the main visual focus. The products must feel real, premium, and instantly desirable.

Composition within each panel:
In each quadrant, place one drink centered or slightly off-center on a small elevated stone, plaster, or matte pedestal block. Reduce supporting elements to the bare minimum. Use at most one tiny accent per panel, such as a single citrus wedge, one dried fruit slice, one flower sprig, one minimal herb accent, or one tiny tea powder trace. Some panels may have no extra accent at all if the composition feels stronger without it. The supporting elements must remain secondary and almost invisible in hierarchy. Each panel must feel pure, controlled, and editorial.

4-panel color variation:
Keep the overall system luxurious and unified, but introduce stronger panel-to-panel color variation so each tea feels like its own quiet world. The background in each panel should remain soft and premium, but shift subtly in hue according to the drink identity:
- floral tea panel: pale cream-beige with warm ivory undertone
- black tea panel: deeper oat-beige or soft caramel-beige
- fruit tea panel: blush sand or warm peach-beige
- green/matcha panel: pale stone-beige with faint cool green undertone

The color shifts must stay sophisticated and restrained, not loud. The four panels should feel harmonized but clearly differentiated.

Background:
Use warm soft neutral backgrounds with gentle tonal variation across the four panels. The surfaces should feel smooth, clean, luminous, and premium, with no heavy texture or visual noise. Each panel’s background should subtly echo its flavor family while preserving the overall calm luxury mood.

Drink styling:
Each drink must be styled with exceptional realism and refined individuality:
- one pale translucent floral tea with quiet floral elegance
- one darker layered black tea with rich depth and amber-brown density
- one glowing fruit tea with warm brightness and juicy clarity
- one soft green tea or matcha-based drink with creamy purity

The glasses must feel premium, sculptural, and beautifully proportioned. Liquids must show real transparency, density, condensation, layering, foam or crema if needed, soft meniscus detail, and subtle internal light behavior. Every beverage must feel physically believable and luxurious.

Typography and branding:
Use minimal premium English typography only. Include:
DILMAH TEA SERIES

You may add one small refined line of supporting copy such as:
Crafted in Purity
or
A Collection of Quiet Elegance

Typography must feel highly restrained, modern, and editorial. Add a small subtle official-style Dilmah logo placement with elegance. Do not overcrowd the layout. The text must remain secondary to the product.

Lighting:
Use extremely delicate, soft, high-end studio lighting. Let each product catch elegant highlights along the glass rim, liquid surface, garnish texture if present, and pedestal edge. Shadows must be soft, short, and clean. The lighting must feel natural, quiet, and luxurious, with fine tonal falloff and no harsh glare.

Material realism:
Push realism to the highest level. Glass must feel crisp, smooth, and premium. Tea liquids must show subtle transparency, rich gradients, realistic ice or foam if present, and accurate reflections. Garnishes such as citrus, dried fruit, herbs, or blossoms must feel fresh and tactile if included. Add only a minimal amount of condensation, fine water droplets, or powder trace where appropriate. The image must feel pristine, not wet or chaotic.

Visual mood:
The poster must communicate purity, refinement, stillness, and product confidence. It should feel like a luxury tea editorial shoot with strong series discipline, elegant restraint, and quiet visual impact. The four panels should feel more differentiated in mood while remaining unmistakably one family.

Color direction:
Use a controlled premium palette of ivory, cream, warm beige, pale stone, oat, caramel-beige, blush sand, soft peach, herbal green, amber tea brown, citrus gold, and muted shadow taupe. The overall image must feel harmonious, elegant, soft, and quietly varied across the four panels.

Rendering style:
ultra-premium photorealistic beverage still-life poster, Dilmah Tea series, 4-panel luxury editorial layout, clean pedestal compositions, reduced supporting elements, subtle background color variation across panels, elegant English typography, soft cinematic studio light, hyper-detailed glass and liquid realism, minimalist premium brand aesthetics, 8k, masterpiece quality

Negative prompt:
cheap cafe poster, cluttered props, cartoon drinks, low-detail glass, bad liquid transparency, messy garnish, oversaturated colors, noisy background, generic packaging ad, flat lighting, low-resolution textures, too much text, supermarket drink styling

prompts.text:
为迪尔玛（Dilmah）茶系列制作一张超高端的四格产品海报，将极端的饮品写实主义与更强的基于口味的视觉差异化相结合，同时将所有辅助元素减少到更纯粹的最低限度。充分保留豪华饮品社论广告的确切视觉逻辑和优雅简约布局：严格的 2x2 网格，每个面板包含一个以干净、孤立、高度精致的静物构图呈现的真实迪尔玛茶产品。最终的艺术作品必须感觉像世界级的优质茶品牌宣传：超写实、纯净、优雅、视觉安静且极其精致，产品是绝对的主角。

核心结构：
使用比例相等且间距完美的严格 2x2 四格布局。每个面板必须像其自身的豪华静物海报一样运作，同时保持作为统一的迪尔玛系列的一部分。整体构图必须感觉平衡、通透、简约和高端，在所有四个象限中具有强大的视觉一致性。

产品系统：
展示四款真实的迪尔玛茶系列产品，每款产品在口味标识、液体颜色、玻璃造型氛围和视觉个性上都明显不同，但仍属于同一个优雅的家族。建议阵容：
1. 花茶
2. 经典红茶
3. 果茶
4. 绿茶或抹茶灵感茶品种

每个面板必须在造型美观的玻璃杯或茶具中展示真实的迪尔玛产品。包装可以巧妙地暗示或仅在需要时非常轻微地整合，但饮品本身必须保持主要的视觉焦点。产品必须让人感到真实、优质且瞬间产生渴望感。

每个面板内的构图：
在每个象限中，将一杯饮品置于中心或稍微偏离中心地放置在小的抬高的石头、石膏或哑光底座块上。将辅助元素减少到最低限度。每个面板最多使用一个小点缀，例如一片柑橘、一片干果、一枝花、一个极简草本点缀或一小抹茶粉痕迹。如果构图在没有额外点缀的情况下感觉更强，某些面板可能完全没有额外点缀。辅助元素必须保持次要地位，在层级上几乎不可见。每个面板必须感觉纯粹、受控且具有社论感。

四格色彩变化：
保持整体系统的奢华和统一，但引入更强的面板间色彩变化，使每种茶都感觉像其自身安静的世界。每个面板的背景应保持柔和高端，但根据饮品身份在色调上发生微妙变化：
- 花茶面板：带有温暖象牙色底色的淡奶油米色
- 红茶面板：更深的燕麦米色或柔和的焦糖米色
- 果茶面板：胭脂沙色或温暖的桃米色
- 绿茶/抹茶面板：带有淡淡冷绿色底色的淡石米色

颜色偏移必须保持精致和克制，不要大张旗鼓。四个面板应该感到和谐但差异明显。

背景：
使用温暖柔和的中性背景，四个面板具有温和的色调变化。表面应感觉光滑、干净、明亮且高端，没有沉重的纹理或视觉噪音。每个面板的背景应微妙地呼应其口味系列，同时保留整体冷静奢华的氛围。

饮品造型：
每种饮品都必须以卓越的写实感和精致的个性进行造型：
- 一种带有安静花卉优雅的淡透明花茶
- 一种具有丰富深度和琥珀褐色密度的深色分层红茶
- 一种具有温暖亮度和多汁清晰度的发光果茶
- 一种具有奶油般纯净感的柔和绿茶或抹茶饮品

玻璃杯必须感觉高端、具有雕塑感且比例优美。液体必须显示真实的透明度、密度、冷凝、分层、泡沫或克丽玛（如果需要）、柔和的液面边缘细节和微妙的内部光线行为。每种饮料必须在物理上令人信服且奢华。

排版和品牌：
仅使用极简的高端英文排版。包括：
DILMAH TEA SERIES

您可以添加一行简短精致的辅助文案，例如：
Crafted in Purity
或
A Collection of Quiet Elegance

排版必须感觉高度克制、现代且具有社论感。优雅地添加一个微小微妙的官方风格迪尔玛标志位置。不要让布局过度拥挤。文本必须次于产品。

光照：
使用极其细腻、柔和的高端摄影棚光照。让每件产品在玻璃杯边缘、液体表面、装饰物纹理（如果存在）和底座边缘捕捉到优雅的高光。阴影必须柔和、短且干净。光照必须感觉自然、安静且奢华，具有细腻的色调衰减，没有刺眼的眩光。

材质写实：
将写实主义推向最高水平。玻璃必须感觉脆爽、光滑且高端。茶液必须显示微妙的透明度、丰富的渐变、真实的冰块或泡沫（如果存在）以及准确的反射。装饰物如柑橘、干果、草本或花朵如果包含在内，必须感觉新鲜且具有触感。仅在适当的地方添加极少量的冷凝、精细的水滴或粉末痕迹。图像必须感觉纯净，而不是潮湿或混乱。

视觉氛围：
海报必须传达纯净、精致、宁静和产品自信。它应该感觉像是具有强大系列纪律、优雅克制和安静视觉冲击力的奢华茶类社论拍摄。四个面板在氛围上应感到更具差异化，同时保持明显的一致性。

色彩方向：
使用象牙色、奶油色、暖米色、淡石色、燕麦色、焦糖米色、胭脂沙色、柔和桃色、草本绿、琥珀茶褐、柑橘金和柔和阴影灰褐色的受控高端调色板。整体图像必须感觉和谐、优雅、柔和，且在四个面板上略有变化。

渲染风格：

创作一张深夜在黑暗的河岸或湖边石阶旁拍摄的自然户外 iPhone 17 Pro 肖像。智能手机握持得异常高，位于拍摄对象上方约 55–65 度，并以陡峭的角度向下倾斜，带有约 7 度的细微手持荷兰式倾斜。构图从头顶到鞋子，保留完整的坐姿、长发发型、彩色单肩包、石阶、开花植物、狭窄的小径和几近漆黑的水面。将拍摄对象置于中心略下方偏左位置，而粗糙的石径则向右侧对角线延伸。在水面和左上方框架保留大面积的深色负空间。构图应感觉像是偶然的、冒险的，且具有真实的智能手机拍摄感，而非专业的摆拍。

身体力学

大部分坐姿重量落在骨盆后右侧，身体自然地安放在狭窄的石阶上。

左臀承受的压力稍小，形成细微的骨盆倾斜，而非完美的水平坐姿。

骨盆保持向远离相机的深色水面旋转约 35 度，而肋骨独立地向左旋转约 40 度，并向上朝向手机。肩部平面比肋骨旋转得稍远，使面部和上胸部在陡峭的高空角度下仍可辨识。

支撑右臀上方的腰部轻轻压缩，而另一侧拉长，创造出可信的女性轮廓且不夸张。

脊柱遵循自然的解剖学 S 曲线，而非保持垂直挺直。上身在躯干上方微微前倾，而头部和上胸部向上转向手机，创造出可见的深度，而非平面的自上而下的身体形状。

左大腿向左对角线倾斜，左膝舒适弯曲。左小腿延伸至石阶下方朝向左下区域，脚稳固地踩在较低的石头表面而非悬空。

右膝弯曲得更紧且更靠近身体。右小腿在石阶旁向下倾斜，保持与左腿的真实分离和物理上可信的支撑。

 neck 独立于肩膀向上朝手机旋转约 45 度。下巴微微抬起并保持拉伸感。她的目光穿过散乱的发丝直接注视着抬高的相机，眼神柔和，眉毛放松，嘴唇自然放松且有光泽。

双前臂保持在腿部附近。

左前臂轻轻搭在大腿上，肘部柔和弯曲。左手在左膝附近保持放松，部分被宽松的袖子和身体角度遮挡。

右肘在躯干旁自然弯曲，而右手低垂在右大腿或包带附近，大部分被头发和衣服遮挡。不要在其他地方创造另一只可见的右手。

保持正好两只手臂和两只手：
• 左手低垂在左膝附近。
• 右手低垂在右大腿或包带附近，大部分被遮挡。
没有额外的隐藏手、重复的手臂、悬浮的手或次要的手部放置。

双肩保持低垂和放松，呈现明显的不对称性。避免僵硬的姿势、完美的水平肩膀、平行的身体平面或像人体模型一样的对齐。

长而深的浓缩咖啡黑色头发，带有柔和的中分，松散的自然波浪，头顶微蓬松，真实的丝丝分明，以及细微的碎发。头发沉沉地垂在双肩和背后，几缕被风吹乱的部分横跨额头、脸颊和一只眼睛，但没有完全遮挡可辨识的面部结构。保留深夜微风带来的自然动感。

宽松的白色长袖上衣，采用柔软轻盈的面料，袖子略显宽大，肘部和腰部有真实的褶皱，上肩部有深红色的点缀带或拼块。搭配一条休闲的中洗蓝色牛仔裤，具有真实的褪色、坐姿臀部和膝盖周围的自然面料压缩、大腿和小腿处的真实褶皱，以及略显宽松的裤腿。

一个彩色的手工钩针单肩包斜跨在背部和外侧肩膀上，具有鲜艳的红色、橙色、钴蓝色、绿松石色、黄色和白色的粗水平条纹和点状针织图案。包应具有可见的手工纱线纤维、真实的钩针针脚清晰度、因内容物而产生的自然下垂，以及正确遵循肩膀和肋骨的背带。包括一个放在腿部附近的小橄榄绿布袋或折叠配件。

搭配简单的白色运动鞋、小银耳环、精致的吊坠项链、细戒指和精致的手镯。

柔和的玫瑰灰褐色眼影，细长的棕色眼线，自然根根分明的睫毛，羽毛般的眉毛，带有粉色光泽的韩国水光肌，集中在脸颊和鼻子的微妙桃粉色腮红，微妙高光的鼻亮和颧骨，光泽的柔和玫瑰粉色嘴唇，真实的眼下纹理，自然的皮肤纹理和可见的细微毛孔。

iPhone 直接闪光灯从抬高的相机位置照亮拍摄对象，产生清晰的闪光灯照明面部、明亮可读的眼睛，以及额头、脸颊、嘴唇、头发、肩膀、钩针纱线、牛仔布和白色运动鞋上的物理高光。保留在小腿和周围石头上真实的自上而下的闪光衰减。

旁边的花朵、草地和石阶边缘捕捉到零星的闪光高光，而水面保持几近漆黑，仅有微弱克制的倒影。仅在最亮的面部和白色织物区域保留轻微的高光裁剪，而不丢失面部结构。

深夜河边或湖边环境，设有狭窄的风化石阶、粗糙不平的小径、占据左侧的深色静止水面、一丛丛粉白色野花、沿裂缝和边缘生长的低矮绿色植物、细微的苔藓和深邃的自然阴影。路径应向右上角背景对角线延续，营造强烈的环境深度。保留足够的周围细节，使其感觉像真实的户外地点，而非空洞的黑色背景。无人像模式模糊、DSLR 焦外、奶油般的背景分离或电影化处理。

RAW iPhone 17 Pro 后置摄像头，真实的智能手机拍摄，1× 镜头，直接内置闪光灯，自然智能手机 HDR，真实的 iPhone 计算摄影，拍摄对象和附近石径的深焦，真实的边缘锐化，真实色彩，细微的暖中性夜间白平衡，自然的微对比度，明显的俯视广角透视，真实的头身透视缩减，细微的手持畸变，轻微的低光数字噪点，真实的 JPEG 处理，无电影调色。主要焦点是眼睛、可辨识的面部结构、随风飘动的头发、彩色的钩针包、坐姿剪影、牛仔布纹理、野花和陡峭的俯视构图。呈现超洁净的精细细节，具有独立分辨的发丝、真实的皮肤微纹理、清晰的钩针纤维、可读的石头纹理、优质图像质量，且无人工过度锐化。

保持物理上正确的解剖结构、真实的肩膀连接、解剖学正确的肋骨与骨盆的反向旋转、正确的坐姿骨盆力学、可信的重量分布、真实的脊柱弯曲、准确的肘部方向、中性的手腕对齐、正确的手指数量、真实的俯视透视缩减、稳定的双脚放置、身体与狭窄石阶之间的真实交互、可信的牛仔裤压缩以及整个动作中物理上准确的包带张力。

--ar 4:5

负面提示：平坦的自上而下身体、笔直僵硬的坐姿、居中的人偶姿势、对称的肩膀、平行的肩部和臀部平面、AI 僵硬姿势、破碎的解剖结构、脱臼的关节、扭曲的手腕、折断的肘部、不可能的坐姿平衡、悬浮在石阶上方的身体、无支撑的双脚、悬浮的鞋子、额外的手臂、额外的手、重复的肢体、可见的第二只右手、脸部附近的第二只左手、融合的手指、缺失的手指、扭曲的骨盆、不真实的腰部、变形的俯视比例、过度放大的头部、微小的躯干、改变身份、美颜滤镜、蜡质皮肤、塑料皮肤、过度平滑的面部、模糊的眼睛、完全遮挡面部的头发、完全过曝的皮肤、空洞的黑色背景、缺失的石径、看不见的花朵、变形的水边、扭曲的钩针图案、重复的包带、DSLR 焦外、人像模式模糊、电影调色、虚假 HDR、时间戳、日期戳、文本、水印、应用程序 UI。

items.title: 资深品牌设计师四图视觉识别提案

prompts.text:
You are a senior brand designer, logo designer, visual art director, and editorial layout designer.

Please design and generate a set of [Four-Image Brand Visual Identity Proposal] directly for the same brand according to the brand information I fill in. Do not output image prompts first, and do not just provide plans or page outlines; generate 4 independent images directly.

[Brand Information]

Chinese Brand Name: [Fill in]
English Brand Name: [Fill in]
Brand Industry: [Fill in]
Main Products or Services: [Fill in]
Brand Positioning and Target Audience: [Fill in]
Brand Core Concept: [Fill in]
Brand Personality Keywords: [Fill in 3–5]
Brand Slogan: [Fill in, or re-refine based on concept]

Logo Inspiration Source: [Fill in]
Logo Type: [Abstract Symbol / Chinese Character Integration / Letter Graphic / Geometric Symbol / Emblem, etc.]
Meaning the Logo is expected to express: [Fill in]
Elements to avoid: [Fill in]

Overall Visual Style: [Fill in]
Main Color Tone: [Fill in]
Secondary and Accent Colors: [Fill in]
Main Materials: [Fill in 3–5 types]
Photography or Spatial Atmosphere: [Fill in]
Main Products, Packaging, and Application Scenarios: [Fill in]

Image Aspect Ratio: [Default 4:5 vertical]
Text Language: [Mainly Chinese / Mainly English / Combination of Chinese and English]
Supplementary Requirements: [Fill in]

If some information is not filled in, please automatically supplement a reasonable plan based on the brand industry, positioning, and concept. Do not stop because non-critical fields are empty.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【Design Task】
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

First, unify the design and lock the brand system, including:

- An original, clear, independently usable logo pattern
- Chinese and English brand wordmarks
- Main, secondary, and accent colors
- Typography, materials, and photographic language
- Secondary graphics and patterns extended from the logo
- Product, packaging, material, and spatial application methods

The logo cannot be text-only. It must include a design-heavy independent Symbol related to the brand concept, with clear outlines, negative space, or geometric structures, recognizable even when scaled down, and suitable for embossing, gold stamping, embroidery, engraving, and spatial signage.

Avoid directly using common industry icons, such as incense burners, tea leaves, female profiles, houses, common leaves, lotuses, auspicious clouds, Taiji, or traditional seals. They need to be abstracted, simplified, and reconstructed to form original brand symbols.

Once the logo is determined, the core outline, internal structure, wordmark, and combination method in the four images must remain consistent and cannot be redesigned for each image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【Content of the Four Images】
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Image 1 | Brand Worldview and Concept Cover

Use a large brand key visual to establish the brand mood and worldview, while clearly displaying the complete logo, Chinese name, English name, conceptual main title, brand manifesto, 3–5 mood or material images, and a small amount of handwritten conceptual notes.

Adopt a structure of "Main Title + Large Key Visual + Complete Logo + Irregular Mood Collage." The logo must be clearly visible but should not overpower the main title and brand atmosphere.

Image 2 | Logo Concept and Symbol Generation Logic

With the oversized Logo Symbol as the visual center, display the complete logo, Chinese and English wordmarks, horizontal and vertical combinations, simplified versions, conceptual source sketches, negative space, and structural relationships.

Add a small amount of hand-drawn outlines, arrows, circles, and designer's handwritten notes to let the audience understand why the logo was designed this way. The page should have a sense of research but should not be made into a complex engineering drawing or a traditional VI table.

Image 3 | Brand Visual Language and Design System

Display brand main colors, secondary colors, fonts, materials, photographic language, logo partial crops, and secondary patterns.

Colors need to establish a connection with real materials, such as stone, paper, metal, glass, plants, or fabrics. Secondary graphics must be extracted from the logo outline, internal curves, negative space, or strokes, and no irrelevant decorations should be added.

The layout uses a combination of regular grids and free collage, adding large typography, vertical text, thin lines, and a small amount of handwritten markings.

Image 4 | Brand Application and Experience Scenarios

Show how the brand enters real products, packaging, paper goods, fabrics, and spaces. Select 5–7 reasonable touchpoints based on the industry, such as the main product, gift box, tote bag, card, label, uniform, towel, metal signage, storefront, reception desk, or spatial wayfinding.

Adopt a structure of "One large product or spatial key visual + 4–6 application details." The complete logo, independent Symbol, and secondary patterns need to be used in layers; do not have every product repeatedly print the full brand name.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【Overall Visual Requirements】
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The entire set of images adopts a design language that combines high-end brand proposals, Editorial magazine design, art direction boards, and modern visual identity cases.

Each image must have:

- A striking large main title
- A short subtitle
- A core description
- 2–4 keywords or information tags
- 2–4 meaningful handwritten notes
- A clear visual center
- Approximately 25%–35% white space

The main title should participate in the composition; it can be enlarged, cropped, displaced, arranged vertically, or interspersed with images and logos, rather than being a plain header.

Handwritten markings can use short sentences, arrows, circles, underlines, or simple sketches to explain the logo, fonts, colors, materials, and processes. Handwritten content must be short, clear, and meaningful, avoiding meaningless garbled text and full-screen graffiti.

The four images use a unified brand name, logo, font, color scheme, material, photographic atmosphere, margins, and guide lines, but the layout cannot be identical:

- Image 1: Large key visual and mood collage
- Image 2: Oversized logo and structural research
- Image 3: Color, font, and material system
- Image 4: Product space and application implementation

Avoid common PPTs, simple Moodboards, traditional VI tables, material website mockup collections, neatly repeated grids, large blocks of body text, information crowding, low-quality 3D materials, cheap gold, color drift, and changes in logo structure.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【Output Requirements】
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Please directly generate 4 independent 4:5 vertical images. Do not merge the four contents into one collage, and do not output image generation prompts first.

Generate in the following order:

1. Brand Worldview and Concept Cover
2. Logo Concept and Symbol Generation Logic
3. Brand Visual Language and Design System
4. Brand Application and Experience Scenarios

If currently only one image can be generated at a time, please start directly from Image 1 and continue generating Image 2, Image 3, and Image 4 according to the same locked logo and visual system, without re-planning or changing the design direction.

prompts.text:
你是一名资深品牌设计师、Logo设计师、视觉艺术指导与Editorial版式设计师。

请根据我填写的品牌信息，为同一个品牌直接设计并生成一套【四图品牌视觉识别提案】。不要先输出图片提示词，也不要只给方案或页面大纲，直接生成4张独立图片。

【品牌信息】

中文品牌名：【填写】
英文品牌名：【填写】
品牌行业：【填写】
主要产品或服务：【填写】
品牌定位与目标人群：【填写】
品牌核心理念：【填写】
品牌性格关键词：【填写3—5个】
品牌标语：【填写，或根据理念重新提炼】

Logo灵感来源：【填写】
Logo类型：【抽象符号 / 汉字融合 / 字母图形 / 几何符号 / 徽章等】
希望Logo表达的含义：【填写】
不希望出现的元素：【填写】

整体视觉风格：【填写】
主色调：【填写】
辅助色与点缀色：【填写】
主要材质：【填写3—5种】
摄影或空间氛围：【填写】
主要产品、包装与应用场景：【填写】

画面比例：【默认4:5竖版】
文字语言：【中文为主 / 英文为主 / 中英结合】
补充要求：【填写】

如果部分信息没有填写，请结合品牌行业、定位和理念自动补充合理方案，不要因为非关键字段为空而停止。

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【设计任务】
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

先统一设计并锁定品牌系统，包括：

- 一个原创、清晰、可独立使用的Logo图案
- 中文与英文品牌字标
- 主色、辅助色与点缀色
- 字体、材质和摄影语言
- 从Logo中延展出的辅助图形与纹样
- 产品、包装、物料和空间应用方式

Logo不能只有纯文字。必须包含一个具有设计感的独立Symbol，与品牌理念相关，具备清晰轮廓、负空间或几何结构，缩小后仍可识别，并适合压印、烫金、刺绣、雕刻和空间标识。

避免直接使用普通行业图标，例如香炉、茶叶、女性侧脸、房屋、普通树叶、莲花、祥云、太极或传统印章。需要经过抽象、简化和重新构成，形成原创品牌符号。

Logo一旦确定，四张图中的核心轮廓、内部结构、字标和组合方式必须保持一致，不能每张图重新设计。

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
【四张图片内容】
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

图1｜品牌世界观与概念封面

用一张大型品牌主视觉建立品牌情绪和世界观，同时清晰展示完整Logo、中文名、英文名、概念主标题、品牌宣言、3—5张情绪或材质图片，以及少量手写概念注释。

采用“大标题＋大型主视觉＋完整Logo＋非规则情绪拼贴”的结构。Logo必须明显可见，但不能压过主标题和品牌氛围。

图2｜Logo概念与符号生成逻辑

以超大的Logo Symbol作为视觉中心，展示完整Logo、中英文字标、横版与竖版组合、简化版本、概念来源草图、负空间与结构关系。

加入少量手绘轮廓、箭头、圈选和设计师手写注释，让观众理解Logo为什么这样设计。页面要有研究感，但不能做成复杂工程图或传统VI表格。

图3｜品牌视觉语言与设计系统

展示品牌主色、辅助色、字体、材质、摄影语言、Logo局部裁切和辅助纹样。

颜色需要与真实材质建立联系，例如石材、纸张、金属、玻璃、植物或织物。辅助图形必须从Logo轮廓、内部曲线、负空间或笔画中提取，不能添加无关装饰。

版式采用规整网格与自由拼贴结合，加入大型字体、纵向文字、细线和少量手写标记。

图4｜品牌应用与体验场景

展示品牌如何进入真实产品、包装、纸品、织物和空间。根据行业选择5—7个合理触点，例如主产品、礼盒、手提袋、卡片、标签、制服、毛巾、金属标牌、门头、前台或空间导视。

采用“一张大型产品或空间主视觉＋4—6张应用细节”的结构。完整Logo、独立Symbol和辅助纹样需要分层使用，不要让每件产品都重复印完整品牌名称。

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium 4-panel promotional poster for a fictional refined Western dining brand, designed as a luxury restaurant social-media key visual campaign. Use a strict 2x2 grid, with each panel functioning like a polished high-end dining promo card while remaining part of one unified boutique restaurant series. The final artwork must feel like a world-class fine-dining social campaign: hyper-realistic, luxurious, appetizing, modern, editorial, clean, and visually elevated, with strong food focus, restrained English typography, subtle promotional pricing, and a premium restaurant-art-direction mood.

Core structure:
Use a strict 2x2 four-grid layout with equal panel proportions and elegant spacing. Each panel must present one different refined Western dish, styled as an individual social-media hero visual while still belonging to one coherent restaurant identity. The full composition must feel like a curated premium dining feed or launch campaign rather than a casual menu board.

Plate consistency:
This is essential: all four plates or bowls must appear in exactly the same scale, position, and framing logic across the four panels. The dish vessel in every panel must be fully visible, never cropped by the image edge, never cut off, and never shifted randomly. Keep the plate centered or locked into the exact same compositional anchor point in each grid cell so the whole 4-panel layout feels clean, aligned, elegant, and highly collectible. The visual rhythm should feel like a luxury restaurant presentation system.

Brand identity:
Create a fictional upscale Western dining brand:
VELORA TABLE

Use elegant English-only branding with a refined, understated logo treatment. The brand must feel boutique, contemporary, polished, and expensive.

Product hierarchy:
Design four refined Western dishes with a stronger tasting-menu rhythm and high-end restaurant character:
1. Herb Butter Ribeye Steak
2. Creamy Truffle Mushroom Pasta
3. Garlic Prawn Risotto
4. Citrus Glazed Salmon

The four dishes must feel like a curated upscale dining journey, not random menu items. The first panel should feel bold and signature-led, the second rich and indulgent, the third textural and composed, and the fourth lighter, cleaner, and more elegant.

Panel design logic:
Each panel should include:
- one dominant plated hero dish
- one elegant English dish title
- one very short supporting line
- one subtle but readable promotional price
- minimal handwritten or sketch accents only if helpful
- a small refined brand mark

The food must remain the strongest visual element. Typography and pricing should feel more restrained than fast-promo design, with a luxury social-media key visual tone.

Typography and text style:
Use refined editorial English typography, cleaner and more premium than ordinary promotional layouts. Example text:
HERB BUTTER RIBEYE
TRUFFLE MUSHROOM PASTA
GARLIC PRAWN RISOTTO
CITRUS GLAZED SALMON

Short supporting lines may read:
Finished with aromatic herb butter.
Creamy truffle depth in every bite.
Slow-stirred with delicate prawn sweetness.
Bright citrus glaze over flame-seared salmon.

Add subtle social-campaign pricing such as:
$28
$22
$24
$26

Prices must be visible but elegant, integrated like premium restaurant social content rather than loud discount advertising.

Visual background system:
Use a dark premium restaurant mood with soft warm highlights, subtle bokeh, and controlled shadow depth. Each panel may vary slightly in warmth according to the dish:
- steak panel: deeper, darker, richer
- pasta panel: warm and creamy
- risotto panel: composed neutral warmth
- salmon panel: slightly brighter and cleaner

All four must belong to the same luxurious restaurant atmosphere. The panels should feel like elevated social content art direction, not busy menu graphics.

Food realism:
Push the realism to the absolute highest level. Steak must feel deeply seared, juicy, and richly textured. Butter glaze must feel warm and luminous. Pasta must show creamy coating, truffle richness, and refined movement. Risotto must feel luscious, delicately grained, and glossy with seafood depth. Salmon must feel moist, delicately grilled, and lightly glazed with a refined citrus sheen. Garnishes such as herbs, parmesan shavings, citrus slices, mushrooms, prawns, greens, and buttery reflections must feel fresh and premium. Add subtle steam, oil sheen, sauce drips, crumbs, and fine seasoning particles where appropriate. Everything must feel intensely edible, extremely clean, and collector-grade.

Plating:
Use elegant dark ceramic or refined modern plates and bowls. The plating should feel upscale, controlled, and restaurant-grade. Each dish should feel intentionally composed for high-end visual appeal without becoming overdecorated. Every dish vessel must be fully contained within its panel, perfectly complete, and visually aligned with the same vessel scale and placement logic across all four grids. No cut plate edges. No floating offset compositions. No inconsistent crop sizes.

Lighting:
Use extremely delicate, soft, high-end commercial food lighting. Let each dish catch beautiful highlights on sauces, seared protein, glossed vegetables, pasta texture, grains, and plate edges. Shadows must be rich, soft, and cinematic. The lighting should make the dishes feel warm, fresh, elevated, and expensive.

Handwritten accent logic:
If used, keep handwritten accents extremely minimal: one or two soft strokes, subtle guide marks, or tiny premium flourish lines near price or title. No messy doodles. The result should feel like luxury restaurant social art direction.

Visual mood:
The full 4-panel poster must communicate boutique dining confidence, elegant indulgence, curated appetite, and high-end restaurant social-media sophistication. It should feel like a premium launch campaign for an upscale dining brand, with stronger editorial beauty and less discount-poster energy. The consistent plate scale and position must enhance the sense of order, precision, and luxury.

核心结构：
使用比例相等且间距优雅的严格 2x2 四格布局。每个面板必须展示一种不同的精致西式菜肴，作为独立的社交媒体英雄视觉效果呈现，同时仍属于一个连贯的餐厅身份。整个构图必须感觉像是一个精心策划的高级餐饮流或发布活动，而不是随意的菜单板。

盘子一致性：
这一点至关重要：所有四个盘子或碗在四个面板中必须以完全相同的比例、位置和取景逻辑出现。每个面板中的菜肴容器必须完全可见，绝不能被图像边缘裁剪，绝不能被切断，也绝不能随机移动。将盘子居中或锁定在每个网格单元中完全相同的构图锚点上，使整个 4 格布局感觉整洁、对齐、优雅且极具收藏价值。视觉节奏应感觉像豪华餐厅的展示系统。

品牌身份：
创建一个虚构的高档西式餐饮品牌：
VELORA TABLE

使用优雅的纯英文品牌，配合精致、低调的标志处理。品牌必须感觉精致、当代、讲究且昂贵。

产品层级：
设计四款具有更强品鉴菜单节奏和高端餐厅特性的精致西式菜肴：
1. 香草黄油肋眼牛排
2. 奶油松露蘑菇面
3. 蒜香虾仁烩饭
4. 柑橘釉面三文鱼

这四道菜必须感觉像是一场精心策划的高档餐饮之旅，而不是随机的菜单项目。第一个面板应该感觉大胆且由招牌引领，第二个面板浓郁而放纵，第三个面板富有质感且构图考究，第四个面板则更轻盈、更洁净、更优雅。

面板设计逻辑：
每个面板应包含：
- 一个占主导地位的摆盘英雄菜肴
- 一个优雅的英文菜名
- 一行非常简短的辅助文字
- 一个微妙但清晰可读的促销价格
- 仅在有帮助时添加极简的手写或草图点缀
- 一个精致的小品牌标志

食物必须保持最强的视觉元素。排版和定价应该比快速促销设计更克制，具有豪华社交媒体关键视觉的基调。

排版和文字风格：
使用精致的社论英文排版，比普通的促销布局更整洁、更高级。示例文字：
HERB BUTTER RIBEYE
TRUFFLE MUSHROOM PASTA
GARLIC PRAWN RISOTTO
CITRUS GLAZED SALMON

简短的辅助文字可能为：
Finished with aromatic herb butter.
Creamy truffle depth in every bite.
Slow-stirred with delicate prawn sweetness.
Bright citrus glaze over flame-seared salmon.

添加微妙的社交活动定价，例如：

$22
$24
$26

价格必须可见但优雅，像高级餐厅社交内容一样融合，而不是响亮的折扣广告。

视觉背景系统：
使用带有柔和暖色高光、微妙焦外成像和受控阴影深度的深色高级餐厅氛围。每个面板的色温可以根据菜肴略有不同：
- 牛排面板：更深、更暗、更浓郁
- 意面面板：温暖且乳白
- 烩饭面板：考究的中性暖感
- 三文鱼面板：略微更明亮、更洁净

所有四个面板必须属于相同的豪华餐厅氛围。面板应该感觉像提升了的社交内容美术指导，而不是忙乱的菜单图形。

食物真实感：
将真实感推向绝对最高水平。牛排必须感觉深度煎制、多汁且质感丰富。黄油涂层必须感觉温暖且发光。意面必须展示奶油涂层、松露的浓郁和精致的流动感。烩饭必须感觉美味、颗粒细腻且带有海鲜深度的光泽。三文鱼必须感觉滋润、精细烧烤且涂有精致的柑橘光泽。装饰物如草本植物、帕尔马干酪碎、柑橘片、蘑菇、虾仁、绿叶和黄油反光必须感觉新鲜且优质。在适当的地方添加微妙的蒸汽、油光、酱汁滴落、碎屑和精细的调味颗粒。一切都必须感觉极度诱人、极其干净且具有收藏级别。

摆盘：

照明：
使用极其细腻、柔和的高端商业食物照明。让每道菜在酱汁、煎制的蛋白质、上光的 vegetables、面条质地、颗粒和盘缘上捕捉到美丽的亮点。阴影必须浓郁、柔和且具有电影感。灯光应使菜肴感觉温暖、新鲜、高级且昂贵。

手写点缀逻辑：
如果使用，请保持手写点缀极简：在一两处柔和的笔触、微妙的引导标记或价格和标题附近微小的溢价装饰线。没有凌乱的涂鸦。结果应感觉像豪华餐厅社交美术指导。

视觉氛围：

渲染风格：

prompts.text: Theme: Tree shadows on the Engawa. Subject: On an old wooden Engawa facing a neatly trimmed Japanese garden, a woman in her 20s is depicted in a vertical full-body perspective, with her hands and knees on the floor. The woman occupies most of the space from the center to the right side of the frame, with her head and shoulders towards the upper left, chest and arms in the center left, waist in the center right, and bent legs extending towards the bottom half of the frame. Her upper body leans forward, keeping her waist raised, placing her right hand at the bottom left of the frame and her left hand with fingers spread on the floor at the bottom center. Her left knee is supported at the bottom center in the front, and her right knee is at the center in the background, extending her right toes toward the bottom right. Her face is slightly tilted towards her right side while looking directly at the camera. Character/Expression: Small oval face, bright ivory skin, slender dark brown eyebrows, large blue-greyish eyes, long eyelashes and delicate eyeliner, light pink cheeks, glossy coral beige lips. Lips slightly parted, casting a calm and firm gaze towards the front camera. Hair is a dark brown straight bob from chin to shoulder, heavy bangs reaching the eyebrows, thin strands of hair by the cheeks, and the ends flick slightly outward. Backlighting from the top left of the frame outlines the outer edge of the hair, top of the head, her right shoulder, arms, and back with a thin golden edge. Wearing small thin metal teardrop earrings on the ears, and a slender silver chain with a single-bead pendant around the neck. Clothing/Pose: Light beige spaghetti strap mini dress. The deep V-neckline is trimmed with delicate beige lace, and the front center is tied with a thin light beige satin ribbon. The dress features a corset-style cut that fits the body and slender vertical pleats, overall dotted with light water-blue fine flowers and sprig patterns. From the waist to the hem is a short flared skirt, layered with double-layered ruffles of transparent tulle and lace, gently spreading backwards from her right waist. Wearing white thin-strap flat sandals on the feet, with multiple thin straps across the top of the foot and ankle straps visible on her right foot. Fingers and light-colored nail polish on both hands, and a thin ring on the left hand are clearly visible; the connections of wrists, elbows, shoulders, knees, ankles, and contact with the floor are natural and smooth. Background/Lighting: Foreground is a wide wooden Engawa in bright brownish tones showing the passage of time, showing the floor's wood grain, joints, knots, and subtle wear across the bottom of the frame. The left and center background is a Japanese garden consisting of moss, low grass, round garden stones, and neatly trimmed low shrubs. The distance is heavily blurred with deep green trees and stone arrangements. The right side of the frame is the boundary between wooden pillars and open indoor space, with a white paper shoji door in a wooden frame placed at the top right, and a dark threshold separating the Engawa from the interior. Strong natural light enters from the upper left rear of the frame, warmly illuminating the hair, shoulders, back, waist, thighs, arms, and floor. Round tree shadows and soft shadows cast through the leaves fall on the skin, dress, and floor, while the depths of the garden and the indoor side are shrouded in soft shadows of deep green and dark brown. Composition/Lens: Vertical composition 3:4, a full-body fashion portrait of the woman's face and body captured from a low camera position near the Engawa floor with a slightly upward-looking perspective. Placing the face at the top-left third, hands at the bottom left and bottom center, waist at the right center, left knee at the bottom center, and right foot and white sandals at the bottom right, emphasizing the diagonal line of the body. The character occupies about three-quarters of the frame, placing the right elbow, waist, and legs near the right edge, while including the head, hands, knees, and right toes in the frame. The eyes and face are the clearest, with hands, lace, floor, and right foot maintaining high resolution. The garden uses a short focal length portrait lens to create soft circular bokeh. Texture/Style: High-resolution realistic outdoor fashion photography. Combining light beige, light water-blue, warm skin tones, ancient wood brown, and the deep green of moss and leaves. Skin retains natural texture and color, with a soft glow of sunlight depicted on the shoulders, arms, thighs, and knees. Subtle reflections of short hair, threads of lace, transparent tulle, fine flower patterns, ruffles, thin leather straps of sandals, wood grain of the floor, and the moist texture of moss and stones are clear and distinct. While maintaining high contrast of the tree shadows, avoid overexposure of the white clothing's gradients, naturally blending the tranquil Japanese garden with the modern portrait. prompts.text:
主题：
缘侧的树影

主体：
在一个面向修剪整齐的和风庭院的老旧木制缘侧上，以纵向全身视角描绘一位二十多岁的女性，她双手双膝撑在地板上。女性占据画面中央至右侧的大部分空间，头部和肩膀偏左上方，胸口和双臂位于中央左侧，腰部在中央右侧，弯曲的双腿向画面下半部分展开。上身向前倾斜，保持腰部高抬，将人物自身的右手置于画面左下方，左手张开手指置于中央下方的地板上。人物自身的左膝撑在前方的中央下方，右膝撑在奥方的中央，将右脚脚尖伸向右下方。脸部微微向人物自身的右侧倾斜，同时直视镜头。

人物·表情：
小巧的卵形脸庞，明亮的象牙色肌肤，细长的深棕色眉毛，大而带青灰色的眼睛，长长的睫毛和细致的眼线，淡粉色的脸颊，富有光泽的珊瑚米色嘴唇。嘴唇微微张开，向正面的镜头投以平静而坚定的目光。头发是及下巴至肩上的深棕色直发鲍勃头，重刘海及至眉毛，脸颊旁有细细的发束，发梢向外轻微翘起。从画面左上方照来的逆光在头发外缘、头顶、人物自身的右肩、手臂和背部勾勒出金色的细边。耳朵上戴着细金属小滴状耳坠，脖子上佩戴纤细的银色链子和一颗单粒吊坠。

服装·姿势：
浅米色的细肩带迷你连衣裙。深V字领口以精致的米色蕾丝镶边，前中央以细细的浅米色缎带系住。裙身采用贴合身体的紧身胸衣式剪裁和细长的纵向褶皱，整体点缀着淡水蓝色的细花和小枝图案。从腰部到裙摆为短款喇叭裙，叠加透明薄纱和蕾丝的双层褶边，从人物自身的右腰向后方轻轻展开。脚上穿着白色细带平底凉鞋，在人物自身的右脚上可见横跨脚面的多条细带和脚踝带。双手的手指和浅色指甲油、左手上的细戒指清晰可见，手腕、肘部、肩膀、膝盖、脚踝的连接以及与地板的接触自然流畅。

背景·光线：
前景是散发岁月气息的明亮茶色宽阔木制缘侧，在画面下方整体展现地板的木纹、接缝、节疤和细微磨损。背景左侧和中央由苔藓、低矮草丛、圆形庭院石和修剪整齐的低矮灌木构成的日本庭园。远处以深绿色树木和石组大面积虚化。画面右侧是木柱与敞开室内空间的边界，将木框的白纸拉门置于右上方，深色的门槛将缘侧与室内分隔开来。强烈的自然光从画面左上方后方射入，温暖地照亮头发、肩膀、背部、腰部、大腿、手臂和地板。通过树叶洒下的圆形树影和柔和阴影落在肌肤、裙子和地板上，庭院深处和室内一侧则笼罩在深绿与焦茶色的柔和阴影中。

构图·镜头：

items.title: 高端商业产品杂志风拼贴海报

prompts.text:
Vertical 2:3 premium commercial product collage poster, clean modern magazine advertising layout, vibrant fresh tone automatically adapted from the uploaded product packaging color palette. No fixed forced green or yellow background.

Strict high-end layout structure, do not generate any numbering, do not generate any photo frame numbers, do not add circled numbers, stamps, badges, or ugly advertisement labels. The overall layout should feel intentional, balanced, and premium, not crowded or randomly scattered.

Composition rules:
1. Center hero product: The exact uploaded product is placed in the middle-lower center as the largest visual focus, slightly tilted for dynamism, hyper-realistic commercial product photography, realistic packaging texture, condensation droplets, liquid splash or ingredient splash around the opening, strong highlight, sharp detail, 8K ultra clear.

2. Top headline area: Large premium 3D headline made from the product’s core ingredient shape, with soft rounded edges, clean glossy texture, and a smaller handwritten-style subhead below it. The headline should not look cheap or over-decorated.

3. Small photo frames: Use maximum 6 to 7 small rectangular lifestyle photos arranged around the central product, not 8 or more. Each small photo has a very thin clean white border, soft shadow, and slightly rounded corner card style. Do not use thick polaroid borders, messy cutouts, or uneven frame sizes.

4. Frame positions:
- Top left: Small lifestyle photo of people holding the product
- Top right: Small lifestyle photo of a model holding the product
- Left middle: Small lifestyle photo of a person enjoying the product
- Right middle: Small product scene photo with raw materials
- Bottom left: Small lifestyle photo of a person walking or posing with the product
- Bottom right: Small product still life photo with ingredients

All frames must be evenly spaced, aligned with invisible columns, and never overlap, never tilt randomly, never create a messy scrapbook effect.

5. Background: Clean gradient background based on the product’s main color, with subtle soft texture, small floating ingredient particles, ice cubes, fruit pieces, petals, or bubbles that match the product formula. Only use relevant raw material elements, not random decorations.

6. Typography:
- Main headline: Large 3D ingredient-shaped text at the top
- Subhead: Short selling point text below the headline
- Bottom corners: Two short decorative slogans, clean handwritten style
- All text must be well aligned, readable, and not cluttered. Do not generate extra text, fake website links, brand logos, or watermarks.

Style requirements:
Premium beverage commercial poster, modern editorial magazine layout, clean and fresh aesthetic, balanced negative space, high contrast but not harsh lighting, realistic iPhone lifestyle photos mixed with high-end product photography, cinematic color grading, refined graphic design feeling, not cheap advertising flyer style.

Negative prompt:
numbering, circled numbers, photo frame numbers, badges, stamps, ugly advertisement labels, messy layout, random scattered frames, overlapping frames, too many small photos, scrapbook style, cheap flyer design, deformed product, distorted human faces, blurry photos, watermark, logo, extra text, fake website links, cluttered background, over-decorated text, thick borders, polaroid borders, inconsistent frame sizes, misaligned frames, low resolution, dull colors

prompts.text:
垂直 2:3 高端商业产品拼贴海报，洁净现代的杂志广告布局，充满活力的清新色调，根据上传的产品包装色板自动适配。没有固定的强制绿色或黄色背景。

严格的高端布局结构，不要生成任何编号，不要生成任何照片框编号，不要添加圆圈数字、印章、徽章或丑陋的广告标签。整体布局应感觉是有意为之、平衡且高端的，而不是拥挤或随机散乱。

构图规则：
1. 中心核心产品：将上传的准确产品放置在中下部中心作为最大的视觉焦点，略微倾斜以增加动感，超写实商业产品摄影，真实的包装质感，冷凝水滴，开口周围有液体飞溅或成分飞溅，强高光，锐利细节，8K超清。

2. 顶部标题区域：由产品核心成分形状制成的大型高端 3D 标题，具有柔软的圆角、洁净的光泽质感，下方有一个较小的手写体副标题。标题不应显得廉价或过度装饰。

3. 小照片框：在中心产品周围排列最多 6 到 7 张小型长方形生活方式照片，不要 8 张或更多。每张小照片都有非常细的洁净白色边框、柔和阴影和圆角卡片风格。不要使用厚宝丽来边框、凌乱的裁剪或不均匀的框架尺寸。

4. 框架位置：
- 左上：人们手持产品的缩小生活方式照片
- 右上：模特手持产品的缩小生活方式照片
- 左中：一个人享受产品的缩小生活方式照片
- 右中：带有原材料的小型产品场景照
- 左下：一个人带着产品行走或摆姿势的缩小生活方式照片
- 右下：带有成分的小型产品静物照

所有框架必须间距均匀，与隐形列对齐，且绝不重叠，绝不随机倾斜，绝不产生凌乱的剪贴簿效果。

5. 背景：基于产品主色的洁净渐变背景，带有微妙的柔和纹理，漂浮着与产品配方相匹配的小成分颗粒、冰块、水果片、花瓣或气泡。仅使用相关的原材料元素，而非随机装饰。

6. 排版：
- 主标题：顶部大型 3D 成分形状文本
- 副标题：标题下方短促的卖点文本
- 底部角落：两个简短的装饰性标语，洁净的手写风格
- 所有文本必须对齐良好、清晰易读且不杂乱。不要生成额外的文字、虚假网站链接、品牌标志或水印。

风格要求：
高端饮料商业海报，现代社论杂志布局，洁净清新的审美，平衡的负空间，高对比度但非刺眼的照明，真实的 iPhone 生活方式照片与高端产品摄影相结合，电影级调色，精细的平面设计感，而非廉价的广告传单风格。

负面提示词：
编号，圆圈数字，照片框编号，徽章，印章，丑陋的广告标签，凌乱的布局，随机散乱的框架，重叠的框架，过多的小照片，剪贴簿风格，廉价传单设计，变形的产品，扭曲的人脸，模糊的照片，水印，标志，额外文本，虚假网站链接，杂乱的背景，过度装饰的文本，厚边框，宝丽来边框，不一致的框架尺寸，错位的框架，低分辨率，沉闷的色彩。

4. Fried Chicken
5. Combo Meal
6. Limited Special

Each item must look real, premium, and highly craveable. Products should vary clearly in silhouette, ingredients, and appetite mood, so the six panels feel diverse, fast-moving, and commercial, while still belonging to one campaign family.

Panel design logic:
Each panel should include:
- one dominant real food hero
- one bold title block
- one clearly visible promotional price tag
- one short supporting line in English
- one or two minimal handwritten or drawn accents if useful
- strong negative space around the product so the composition remains clean and impactful

The product must remain the main visual focus. Typography and price blocks should support it, not overpower it. Each panel should feel like a fast-selling menu card with its own role inside the larger brand system.

Typography and text style:
Use bold premium English typography inspired by modern fast-food campaign design. Titles should be large, stacked, graphic, and highly legible. Example text system:
BRISK BITE
SIGNATURE BURGER
CRISPY WRAP
LOADED FRIES
FRIED CHICKEN
COMBO DEAL
LIMITED DROP

Use short supporting promotional lines such as:
Hot. Fresh. Fast.
Made for Cravings.
Today’s Best Combo.
Big Flavor, Quick Fix.
Weekend Favorite.

Add clear promo price tags in a strong quick-service layout style, for example:
$8.90
$11.50
$6.90
$9.90
$13.90
$10.90

Prices must be readable, bold, and naturally integrated like real fast-food advertising.

Color system:
Use a strong fast-food campaign palette with high contrast and promotional energy. Build the six panels from a unified set of premium commercial colors such as:
bright orange
warm yellow
cream beige
deep brown
red accent blocks
soft off-white

Vary the panel backgrounds and graphic blocks so each product tier feels distinct, but keep the brand system consistent and intentional. The overall feel must be bold and appetizing, not chaotic.

Food realism:
Push the food realism to the absolute highest level. Buns must feel soft and glossy. Fried chicken coating must feel crisp and textured. Melted cheese must feel hot and elastic. Fries must feel golden and salted. Wrap bread must feel toasted and slightly blistered. Sauces must feel rich, thick, and glossy. Lettuce, tomato, pickles, onions, and herbs must feel fresh, hydrated, and vivid. Add subtle crumbs, sauce drips, tiny seasoning particles, and minimal steam or warmth cues where appropriate. Everything must feel hyper-real, clean, and commercial.

Lighting:
Use extremely delicate, soft, high-end commercial food lighting. Let each product catch beautiful highlights on bread, cheese, meat, sauces, fried crust, and vegetables. Shadows must remain short, soft, and controlled. The image should feel bright, juicy, appetizing, and polished, with no harsh glare.

Handwritten accent logic:
Add only minimal handwritten-style promotional accents or sketch lines: a few arrows, little emphasis marks, tiny note-like circles, or small energetic strokes around price tags or food edges. These accents must feel playful and commercial, not messy. Keep them sparse and well designed.

Visual mood:
The full 6-panel poster must communicate instant craving, strong product confidence, speed, accessibility, and modern fast-food culture. It should feel like a premium restaurant launch campaign or digital menu-promo series with clean commercial sharpness and youthful impact. The hierarchy between burger, wrap, fries, fried chicken, combo, and limited special should be immediately felt.

Rendering style:
ultra-premium photorealistic fast-food advertising poster, 6-panel grid campaign, fictional Western fast-food brand BRISK BITE, product-tier structure with burger wrap fries fried chicken combo and limited special, bold English typography, strong promo price tags, minimal handwritten accents, soft cinematic commercial lighting, hyper-detailed food textures, world-class quick-service campaign aesthetics, 8k, masterpiece quality

Negative prompt:

prompts.text:
* 一个食物主角 + 一个堆叠标题 + 一个价格标签
在每个网格中仅保留一个主要食物项、一个大标题和一个价格锚点；信息层级是固定的，因此用户不必寻找重点。

* 严格的 2x3 网格，产品层级活动节奏
统一的六格布局，但产品使用汉堡、卷饼、小吃、套餐和限量版物品进行分层；整个图像既充当菜单又充当促销活动。

* 高对比度快餐配色方案，极简手写点缀
橙色、黄色、红色和乳白色营造出高对比度、刺激食欲的配色方案；手写箭头仅放置在价格或卖点附近，以保持促销感而不会使设计显得杂乱。

GPT-图像 2 提示词
为虚构的名为 BRISK BITE 的西方快餐品牌创建一个超高端 6 面快餐促销海报，将极端的食物写实主义与更强的产品层级活动节奏相结合。完全保留大胆的基于网格的活动布局的精确结构逻辑和视觉能量：六个正方形面板排列成严格的 2x3 构图，每个面板的功能就像一个独立的高冲击力促销卡，同时仍然是统一品牌世界的一部分。最终作品必须感觉像是世界级的快速服务餐厅活动：超写实、明亮、图形化、面向年轻人、干净、美味且高度商业化，带有醒目的价格标签、优雅的英文排版、极简的手写点缀，并且食物始终是视觉主角。

核心结构：
使用比例相等且间距一致性强的严格 2x3 六格布局。每个面板必须感觉像是一个独立的快餐促销视觉效果，但所有六个面板结合在一起必须读作一个连贯的品牌活动。保持结构大胆、瞬间可读，并针对促销影响进行优化。通过将六个面板划分为不同的快餐产品层，同时在所有卡片中保持一个视觉系统，来建立更强的菜单层级感。

品牌身份：
创建一个虚构的高端快餐品牌：
BRISK BITE

使用带有干净、大胆、都市友好标志风格的现代纯英文品牌。品牌必须感觉具有当代感、易于接近、充满活力和商业化，但仍然精致且高端。始终包含一个小的官方风格标志。

产品阵容层级：
将六个面板设计为结构更清晰的快餐系列：
1. 招牌汉堡
2. 脆皮卷饼
3. 丰富配料薯条
4. 炸鸡
5. 组合套餐
6. 限量特供

每件物品都必须看起来真实、高端且非常诱人。产品的轮廓、成分和食欲氛围应有明显变化，使六个面板感觉多样、快速移动且商业化，同时仍属于一个活动家族。

面板设计逻辑：
每个面板应包括：
- 一个占主导地位的真实食物主角
- 一个大胆的标题块
- 一个清晰可见的促销价格标签
- 一行简短的英文辅助说明
- 一两个极简的手写或绘制点缀（如果有用）
- 产品周围有强烈的负空间，以便构图保持干净且有冲击力

产品必须保持主要的视觉中心。排版和价格块应支持它，而不是压倒它。每个面板应感觉像是一张在更大的品牌系统内有自己角色的热销菜单卡。

排版和文本样式：
使用受现代快餐活动设计启发的粗体高端英文排版。标题应大、堆叠、具有图形感且高度易读。示例文本系统：
BRISK BITE
SIGNATURE BURGER
CRISPY WRAP
LOADED FRIES
FRIED CHICKEN
COMBO DEAL
LIMITED DROP

使用简短的辅助促销语，例如：
Hot. Fresh. Fast.
Made for Cravings.
Today’s Best Combo.
Big Flavor, Quick Fix.
Weekend Favorite.

以强烈的快速服务布局风格添加清晰的促销价格标签，例如：
$8.90
$11.50
$6.90
$9.90
$13.90
$10.90

价格必须可读、加粗，并像真实的快餐广告一样自然融合。

色彩系统：
使用具有高对比度和促销能量的强大快餐活动调色板。由一组统一的高端商业色彩构建六个面板，例如：
亮橙色
暖黄色
乳米色
深棕色
红色点缀块
柔和的米白色

Vary the panel backgrounds and graphic blocks so each product tier feels distinct, but keep the brand system consistent and intentional. The overall feel must be bold and appetizing, not chaotic. 
改变面板背景和图形块，使每个产品层级感觉不同，但保持品牌系统一致且有目的。整体感觉必须大胆且诱人，而不是混乱。

食物写实主义：
将食物写实主义推向最高水平。汉堡面包必须感觉柔软且有光泽。炸鸡涂层必须感觉酥脆且有质感。融化的奶酪必须感觉热且有弹性。薯条必须感觉金黄且有盐。卷饼面包必须感觉经过烘烤且有轻微的起泡。酱汁必须感觉浓郁、粘稠且有光泽。生菜、西红柿、泡菜、洋葱和香草必须感觉新鲜、水润且鲜艳。在适当的地方添加微妙的碎屑、酱汁滴、微小的调味颗粒以及微小的蒸汽或温暖提示。一切都必须感觉超现实、干净且商业化。

灯光：
使用极其细腻、柔和、高端的商业食物灯光。让每种产品在面包、奶酪、肉类、酱汁、油炸脆皮和蔬菜上捕捉到美丽的亮部。阴影必须保持短促、柔和且受控。图像应感觉明亮、多汁、诱人且精致，没有刺眼的眩光。

手写点缀逻辑：
仅添加极简的手写风格促销点缀或素描线条：一些箭头、小的强调标记、微小的笔记状圆圈，或价格标签或食物边缘周围的小的活力线条。这些点缀必须感觉俏皮且具有商业感，而不是凌乱。保持它们稀疏且设计良好。

视觉氛围：
完整的 6 面海报必须传达即时的渴望、强大的产品信心、速度、易接近性和现代快餐文化。它应该感觉像是一个高端餐厅发布活动或具有干净商业锐度和年轻冲击力的数字菜单促销系列。汉堡、卷饼、薯条、炸鸡、套餐和限量特供之间的层级感应该被立即感受到。

渲染风格：
超高端写实快餐广告海报，6 面网格活动，虚构的西方快餐品牌 BRISK BITE，具有汉堡、卷饼、薯条、炸鸡、套餐和限量特供的产品层级结构，粗体英文排版，醒目的促销价格标签，极简手写点缀，柔和的电影级商业灯光，超精细的食物质感，世界级快餐活动美学，8k，杰作质量

负面提示词：
廉价外卖传单，凌乱的构图，卡通食物，产品重点不突出，细节不足的汉堡，假奶酪，塑料成分，凌乱的排版，无法辨认的价格，通用的超市风格，平淡的灯光，过度饱和的混乱，低分辨率纹理

prompts.text:
9:16 vertical composition, ultra-realistic Oriental classical female cinematic portrait photography (Oriental Cinematic Historical Portrait), Chinese historical film still style, high-end Editorial art portrait photography, shot with real cinematic camera texture, real photography, not illustration, not anime, not CG rendering.

The main subject is an original Oriental adult female character over 22 years old.

The character as a whole presents a cold, quiet, restrained, and elegant Oriental classical female temperament, not a sweet young girl, not an internet celebrity ancient style photo, not a commercial historical costume model pose. She is like a character existing in a real ancient movie, with a calm, aloof, and introverted sense of cinematic narrative.

Character Face:
Natural Oriental female face shape, facial contours are soft and smooth, with real Oriental bone structure, delicate features but maintaining natural proportions. The face retains real skin texture, visible fine pores, real skin quality, imperfect details, no plastic skin, no AI skin smoothing, no excessive beautification. A natural small mole is kept near the corner of the eye as a character identification detail. Lips are natural light pink, lips gently closed, expression is calm and restrained, eyes have a slight sense of thinking, no smiling, no exaggerated emotions.

Head and Eyes:
The overall face is facing the camera, the head remains basically forward-facing, do not turn the head significantly, the body turns sideways to form a spatial difference with the face. The head is slightly tilted down by about 5°–10°, the chin is slightly tucked in, do not raise the head, do not look up, do not look down at the ground. Both eyes are fully visible, the eyeballs naturally shift to the right side of the frame, the gaze is directed towards the far right, forming a cinematic still moment: body sideways → face towards camera → head slightly lowered → gaze looking into the distance. The overall demeanor is quiet, restrained, and has a sense of story.

Body Posture:
The overall body is rotated about 45 degrees to the left side of the frame, the 45 degrees comes from body rotation, not head rotation. The chest, shoulders, and waist maintain a consistent orientation towards the left side of the frame, the left shoulder is slightly closer to the camera, and the right shoulder is naturally back, forming a natural sideways spatial relationship. Shoulders are relaxed, the body is upright but not stiff, no front-facing standing posture, no body facing right, no sense of posing.

Hands and Sleeves:
Hands are naturally positioned in front of the body, wide Hanfu sleeves naturally cover the arms, the foreground sleeve is close to the camera, forming a soft foreground shallow depth of field blur. Sleeves hang down naturally, do not pose deliberately.

Hairstyle and Hair Accessories:
Black long hair is tied into an Oriental classical high bun, the bun is dignified and elegant, the hair strands are real and natural, retaining a small amount of stray hair on the sides of the face. Wearing white pearls, light blue jade, golden filigree hairpins, white jade flower ornaments, and slender tassels. Hair accessories are exquisite but not overly gorgeous, integrated with the character's temperament, with real metal texture and real pearl and jade reflections.

Clothing:
Wearing moon white and light ice blue classical Hanfu. The inner layer is a light ice blue cross-collar long skirt, and the outer layer is a white semi-transparent sheer wide-sleeved long coat. The clothing has a real high-end silk texture, and the shoulders, cuffs, and chest are covered with exquisite three-dimensional floral embroidery. The embroidery has a real fiber structure, and the white patterns present subtle relief layers. The sheer fabric is realistically transparent, the cloth has natural wrinkles, and the sleeves are light and soft. Under the main light on the left side, the sheer fabric shows a slight light-transmitting effect.

Background Space:
Dark Oriental fantasy cinematic space, remove obvious architectural backgrounds, no clear ancient buildings, no identifiable environmental elements. The overall background is dark gray-black, and the character is placed in a large amount of cold white cinematic smoke. The fog spreads slowly from behind the character, forming a continuous large-area atomized space. No obvious smoke texture, no lumps of smoke, no clear smoke edges. The background fog needs to be highly blurred, like the atmospheric fog in a real movie studio, forming: slight foreground atomization → clear character → background cold fog softening and disappearing.

Cinematic Lighting:
Cinematic low-key lighting (Low Key Cinematic Lighting). The main light source clearly comes from the left side of the frame, located about 45° in front and to the left of the character, slightly higher than the character's eyes, using soft white cinematic soft light. The main light on the left directly illuminates the forehead, bridge of the nose, cheeks, chin, neck, shoulders, Hanfu on the chest, and foreground sleeves. A clear white highlight is formed on the left side of the character, a soft brightness appears on the chest embroidery, the sheer fabric becomes slightly translucent in the light, and the character looks as if wrapped in white cinematic light. Not backlight, not a backlit subject, not primarily rim light. The background remains low brightness, retaining only a very slight cold-colored rim light to outline the hair strands, and the fog is illuminated by the main light on the left, forming soft light and fog layers. Overall effect: dark background + left white cinematic main light + cold soft fog + highlighted main subject character.

Camera Parameters:
ARRI ALEXA 65 cinematic camera texture, 85mm cinematic portrait lens, F1.4 large aperture, shallow depth of field, precise focus on the character's eyes, natural background blur, real cinematic exposure, Kodak Vision3 cinematic film color, natural film grain, high dynamic range, real commercial cinematic photography, high-end Editorial photography style.

Final Effect:
Chinese historical film still, Oriental classical female character portrait, cold cinematic aesthetics, character wrapped in white cinematic light, dark space, continuous blurred cold fog, body sideways 45 degrees, face towards camera, head slightly lowered, gaze towards the far right, real skin, real hair strands, real silk, real embroidery, real cinematic photography, no AI plastic feeling.

Negative Prompt:
Head turned sharply to the right, 90-degree profile, looking down, looking up, looking upwards, chin raised, head tilted upwards, only backlight, only back lighting, face too dark, face not receiving light, body facing right, body standing facing forward, looking directly at the camera. Clear architectural background, clear ancient buildings, temple background, complex architectural details. Smoke texture too clear, smoke distributed in clumps, smoke edges too sharp, smoke competing with the subject, background too clear. Anime style, illustration style, 2D, CG, 3D rendering, game modeling style. Plastic skin, AI face, excessive skin smoothing, beauty filters, skin too smooth, HDR halo, over-saturated colors. Cheap historical costume photo, studio style, sense of posing, modern photo style. Wrong hands, extra fingers, deformed limbs, wrong human structure. Low quality, blurry, out of focus, low resolution.

prompts.text:
9:16竖构图，超写实东方古典女性电影肖像摄影（Oriental Cinematic Historical Portrait），中国古装电影剧照风格，高级Editorial艺术人像摄影，真实电影摄影机拍摄质感，真实摄影，不是插画，不是动漫，不是CG渲染。

画面主体为一位22岁以上原创东方成年女性角色。

人物整体呈现清冷、安静、克制、优雅的东方古典女性气质，不是甜美少女，不是网红古风写真，不是商业古装模特摆拍。她像真实存在于古代电影中的角色，具有沉静、疏离、内敛的电影叙事感。

人物面容：
自然东方女性脸型，脸部轮廓柔和流畅，具有真实东方骨相，五官精致但保持自然比例。面部保留真实皮肤纹理，可见细微毛孔、真实肤质、不完美细节，不要塑料皮肤，不要AI磨皮，不要过度美颜。眼角附近保留一颗自然细小的痣，作为人物辨识度细节。嘴唇自然淡粉色，嘴唇轻轻闭合，表情平静克制，眼神带有轻微思考感，不要微笑，不要夸张情绪。

头部与眼神：
脸部整体朝向镜头，头部保持基本正向，不要明显转头，身体侧向与脸部形成空间差。头部轻微向下压低约5°–10°，下巴轻微内收，不要抬头，不要昂首，不要低头看地面。双眼完整可见，眼球自然向画面右侧偏移，眼神望向右侧远方，形成电影静止瞬间：身体侧向 → 脸朝镜头 → 头微低 → 眼神看向远方。整体神态安静、克制、具有故事感。

身体姿态：
身体整体向画面左侧旋转约45度，45度来自身体旋转，而不是头部旋转。胸腔、肩膀、腰部保持一致朝向画面左侧，左肩略靠近镜头，右肩自然向后，形成自然侧身空间关系。双肩放松，身体挺拔但不僵硬，不要正面站姿，不要身体朝右，不要摆拍感。

双手与衣袖：
双手自然位于身体前方，宽大的汉服衣袖自然覆盖手臂，前景衣袖靠近镜头，形成柔和前景浅景深虚化。衣袖自然垂落，不要刻意摆姿势。

发型与发饰：
乌黑长发盘成东方古典高髻，发髻端庄、高雅，发丝真实自然，保留少量脸侧碎发。佩戴白色珍珠、淡蓝色玉石、金色花丝发簪、白玉花饰、细长流苏。发饰精致但不过度华丽，与人物气质融为一体，具有真实金属质感与真实珠玉反光。

服饰：
身穿月白色与浅冰蓝色古典汉服。内层为浅冰蓝色交领长裙，外层为白色半透明薄纱广袖长衫。服装具有真实高级丝绸质感，肩部、袖口、胸前布满精细立体花卉刺绣，刺绣具有真实纤维结构，白色花纹呈现微妙浮雕层次。薄纱真实透明，布料存在自然褶皱，衣袖轻盈柔软，在左侧主光照射下，薄纱出现轻微透光效果。

背景空间：
深色东方幻想电影空间，取消明显建筑背景，不要清晰古建筑，不要可识别环境元素。背景整体为深灰黑色，人物置于大量冷白色电影烟雾之中。雾气从人物背后缓慢扩散，形成连续的大面积雾化空间。不要明显烟雾纹理，不要一团一团的烟，不要清晰烟雾边缘。背景雾气需要高度虚化，像真实电影摄影棚中的氛围雾，形成：前景轻微雾化 → 人物清晰 → 背景冷雾柔化消失。

电影灯光：

prompts.text:
Create a realistic “weightless youth” portrait in a 9:16 vertical frame. Show a 20-year-old East Asian young woman with a college-girl / school-uniform vibe, photographed outdoors under a wide blue summer sky. Use an extremely low-angle camera from the front-side, close to the ground, looking upward. Place her on a clearly sloped surface such as a rooftop edge, concrete seawall, bleachers, or a parking ramp.

The key is not normal walking and not a dramatic jump, but the subtle split second of weightlessness — the moment when her body seems to briefly lose gravity. One or both feet should be just leaving the ground or just about to touch down, with a natural shift of balance, slight suspension, and believable motion. The pose should feel real and candid, like a moment caught in between steps.

Keep a clear side profile or three-quarter profile visible. Her face should be easy to see, with eyes, nose, lips, and jawline unobstructed. Hair should flow naturally backward in the wind with a few loose strands, but must not cover the face. Her skirt, shirt hem, and bag can move slightly with inertia to enhance the feeling of motion.

Let the sky fill around 60–75% of the frame. Use strong diagonal ground lines to create tension and instability. Keep the lighting like real summer daylight, with natural skin texture, realistic clothing folds, and a youthful cinematic mood. The image should feel candid, airy, and emotionally suspended.

prompts.text:
在 9:16 的垂直画幅中创作一张真实的“轻盈青春”肖像。展示一名 20 岁的东亚年轻女性，带有女大学生/校服风格，在户外宽广的蓝色夏日天空下拍摄。使用极低的前侧相机角度，贴近地面向上看。将她置于明显的坡面上，如屋顶边缘、混凝土海堤、看台或停车场坡道。

关键点在于不是普通的行走，也不是剧烈的跳跃，而是那种微妙的失重瞬间——她的身体似乎短暂失去重力的那一刻。一只脚或双脚应刚刚离开地面或正要着地，伴随着自然的重心转移、轻微的悬浮感和可信的动作。姿势应感觉真实且自然，就像两步之间捕捉到的瞬间。

保持清晰的侧面轮廓或四分之三侧面可见。她的脸应该清晰可见，眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇和下颚线没有遮挡。头发应随风自然向后飘动，有几根松散的发丝，但绝不能遮住脸。她的裙子、衬衫摆和包可以随惯性轻微移动，以增强运动感。

让天空占据画面约 60–75% 的空间。使用强烈的对角线地面线条来营造张力和不稳定性。灯光保持真实的夏日日光感，具有自然的皮肤纹理、逼真的衣物褶皱和充满青春感的电影氛围。图像应给人以自然、轻盈和情感悬浮的感觉。

prompts.text: 9:16 vertical version, new Chinese-style Oriental aesthetic minimalist illustration, fusion of Dunhuang murals and modern Guochao visuals, Oriental classical Silk Road artistic mood poster. The image is dominated by high-saturation cinnabar red and crimson gradient backgrounds, the upper part and the left side retain a large area of pure white space, below is an open ground of warm white and ivory white, in the distance there are only faint, looming light gray ink wash hills and light mist, the space is quiet and vast. A group of huge, light, and elegant transparent silks and gauzes hang down from the upper right of the image, ribbons extend down from the top of the image, forming elegant S-shaped curves and multi-layered overlapping rotating structures in the air. The gauze material is crystal clear and translucent, having a translucent texture like glazed glass, organza, and pearlescent film, with soft glowing edges, fine refractions of pale pink, moon white, light gold, turquoise, and iridescent colors appear on the surface, with transparent highlights and rich layers, like the ribbons of a heavenly maiden blown by the wind. Some ribbons are internally embedded with exquisite Dunhuang patterns and traditional brocade patterns, including turquoise intertwined floral patterns, Baoxiang flowers, auspicious clouds, lotus flowers, cinnabar red peonies, gilded outlines, and vintage mineral color decorations. The patterns are dominated by azurite blue, malachite green, cinnabar, gilding, and beige, interweaving with the transparent gauze, possessing both the decorativeness of classical murals and a modern high-end fashion texture. Several black-blue swallows weave and fly up and down around the ribbons, the swallows use simple and delicate Gongbi illustration styles, with deep indigo feathers, white bellies, and cinnabar red beaks, long tails stretched, their flight dynamics are all different, some rising against the wind, some diving downwards, some circling along the ribbons, forming a rhythmic visual guide. In the lower-left corner of the image near the horizon, a very small-scale ancient traveler in white clothes is arranged riding a white horse slowly forward. The figure wears a simple ancient crown and a moon-white or light beige robe, the white horse is equipped with a small amount of cinnabar and turquoise blue saddlery, the figures and horse shapes are simple and exquisite, with a feeling of combining traditional Gongbi painting and modern flat illustration. Below the horse, there is a soft and slender gray shadow, emphasizing the silent journey and vast space. The overall composition is heavy at the top and light at the bottom, dense on the right and sparse on the left, the huge ribbons and the tiny traveler form a strong scale contrast, large areas of negative space, the image has a poetic narrative of 'wind coming from beyond the heavens, a lonely journey into mountains and rivers'. High saturation but not dazzling, clear colors, with red, turquoise, moon white, and gilding forming sharp contrasts. Exquisite Oriental decorative painting, Guofeng art poster, Dunhuang Flying Apsaras elements, Silk Road fantasy, Gongbi line drawing, mineral pigment texture, slight rock color particles, soft halo, delicate gold outlining, high-end graphic design, clean background, no text in the image, no borders, high level of completion.
