items.title: 极简公寓透明椅坐姿东亚美女时尚写真

prompts.text:
Create a photorealistic 3:4 full-body smartphone fashion portrait of an exceptionally beautiful adult East Asian woman in her mid-20s, sitting sideways on a transparent acrylic chair inside a minimalist gray apartment.

She has a delicate oval face, very fair natural skin, large dark-brown almond-shaped eyes, long eyelashes, a small straight nose and softly full muted-pink lips. She wears thin round silver eyeglasses. Her expression is quiet, slightly aloof and thoughtful, with relaxed lips and a steady gaze directed toward the camera.

Her very long glossy black hair has a center part and falls in large soft waves past her waist, flowing behind her shoulder and along the chair. She has a naturally voluptuous hourglass figure with a full bust, narrow waist, broad rounded hips and thick shapely thighs.

She wears a fitted white ribbed long-sleeve top with a softly curved neckline and slightly flared hem, paired with very short fitted black lounge shorts. Around both thighs are delicate white-and-pale-pink floral lace garter bands with thin straps following the outer thighs. Subtle pink ornamental tattoos curve along one thigh and lower leg.

Recreate the seated pose: her body turns sideways on the chair, hips resting near the right edge of the seat. One leg bends upward with the knee raised prominently in the foreground, while the other leg crosses underneath and extends toward the lower-left edge of the frame. One elbow rests lightly on the raised knee, with her fingers curled near her lips and chin. Her other arm remains relaxed close to her body.

Use a slightly low, close camera position from the front-left side, creating strong perspective that emphasizes the bent legs while keeping her face, torso and complete seated posture visible. Background: dark-gray built-in wardrobe panels with black grid frames, cool-gray tiled walls, a narrow black shelving unit and a simple modern interior.

Bright diffused frontal phone lighting, cool neutral color palette, realistic pale skin texture, soft shadows, detailed hair strands, natural fabric tension and subtle smartphone wide-angle perspective. No anime, no childish appearance, no transparent top, no nudity, no distorted legs, no malformed hands, no extra limbs, no text, logo, watermark or rounded image corners.

prompts.text:
创建一个写实的 3:4 全身智能手机时尚人像，主角是一位 20 多岁、美貌出众的成年东亚女性，她侧坐在一间极简灰色公寓内的透明亚克力椅子上。

她有一张精致的鹅蛋脸，非常白皙自然的皮肤，大大的深褐色杏仁状眼睛，长长的睫毛，小巧挺直的鼻子和柔软丰满的淡粉色嘴唇。她戴着细圆银色眼镜。她的表情安静、略显冷淡且深思，嘴唇放松，目光平稳地注视着相机。

她极长的亮丽黑发中分，呈大波浪状垂过腰部，流淌在肩膀后侧和椅子上。她拥有自然的玲珑曼妙的沙漏型身材，胸部丰满，腰部纤细，臀部宽大圆润，大腿丰满且线条优美。

items.title: 商业晚会私密仪式感邀请海报

prompts.text: Around any subject, develop an invitation poster with a sense of private ritual. Use a large area of near-black, low-brightness background to support a subject visual carrier that is close to the lens and edge-cropped, allowing it to expand from the middle toward the right and bottom, occupying slightly more than half of the frame; the left side retains a deep dark breathing zone, with information arranged hierarchically from top to bottom along a single left-aligned axis. Set an oversized English serif title across the upper edge, slightly contacting the visual carrier on the right; the glyphs are tall and slender, stretching vertically, with strong contrast between main and thin strokes, tight letter spacing, and parts approaching the boundaries, forming a gorgeous yet restrained first read. Below it, use a larger Chinese Ming-style font title to establish the second level, then use very small English fine text, short paragraphs of Chinese body text, honorifics, time, and location to form an alternating rhythm of density and sparseness; each level of text maintains significant scale jumps, and a line of slender cursive English signature is added at the bottom, with strokes stretching horizontally like silk threads. On the left, use a four-pointed star and extremely thin vertical lines to string together a few tiny diamond dots, forming a quiet ritual mark, remaining isolated and restrained, not expanding into a complex border. The theme provides the core carrier and its local textures, magnifying the most recognizable part into a close-up photographic form, creating inward-converging soft depth through layered, curled, or undulating surfaces; the outline partially disappears into the dark background, letting only the illuminated edges, folds, and grains appear layer by layer, allowing the black negative space and the luminous structure to jointly complete the subject. Colors do not lock into specific hues, but are derived from the thematic semantics into three roles: dark background, luminous main color, and light-colored information: the near-black background accounts for about 50% to 60%, the main color of the theme accounts for about 30% to 40%, concentrated in high saturation and medium-high brightness on the visual carrier and the top title, the body text uses low-saturation light colors, and a very small amount of bright colors only falls on the star points and local highlights; maintain low illumination, strong light-dark span and mysterious romantic emotions, while keeping the bright colors clear and fresh, not gray or muddy. Use close-up photography and low-illumination imaging texture, with soft sidelight grazing across the surface undulations, the highlights are fine and diffused, and the dark parts slowly sink into pure black; add uniform and fine color photographic grain and slight softening to the image layer, making the luminous area appear as if developed from particles, the grain is concentrated in the transition between the carrier and the dark part, and the text edges, thin lines and main negative space remain clean and sharp. The final visual must retain the tension between the huge close-up on the right and the narrow text area on the left, the sense of scale of the oversized serif title pressing the upper edge, and the core effect of soft bright particles emerging from the darkness. Theme: Invitations for various commercial galas. 10 images in total, each with different color schemes, theme images, and copywriting logic. Aspect ratio 16:9.

items.title: 海蓝之谜超高端四宫格奇幻自然护肤海报

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium 2x2 four-panel skincare campaign poster for La Mer, with absolute brand consistency but four completely different fantasy natural environments. Each quadrant must feel like a distinct magical world with its own ecological identity, color atmosphere, and cinematic mood, yet all four must still clearly belong to one unified La Mer visual universe. The product must remain the absolute protagonist in every panel, fully integrated into nature as if it naturally belongs there. The final artwork must feel like a world-class luxury skincare series and like award-winning cinematography frozen into four still frames: hyper-real product photography, exquisite environmental storytelling, elegant natural interaction, subtle fantasy atmosphere, and collector-grade visual refinement. Use refined English title typography, subtle official-feeling branding, and minimal support text in a premium editorial layout.

Core layout:
Use a strict 2x2 four-panel composition with balanced spacing and unified design discipline. Each panel must contain one hero La Mer product, placed in a visually dominant but environmentally integrated way. The product must never feel pasted into the scene; it must feel fully immersed in each natural world through lighting, moisture, reflections, material contact, and compositional interaction. Every panel must clearly express a different environmental identity, while maintaining the same luxury tone, product scale logic, and brand coherence.

Milk Cloud Orbit + Cream Halo Transit direction:
Push the strongest established qualities further: strengthen the contrast between the four different natural worlds, refine the marine-botanical fantasy details, and elevate the entire visual language toward cinematic still-photography excellence. Keep the same four-environment skeleton, but make each panel feel more like a perfectly paused moment from an award-winning fantasy film: quieter, more spacious, more atmospheric, and more emotionally resonant. Replace any generic decorative fantasy feel with stronger cinematic environmental storytelling, better depth layering, more natural light falloff, and more controlled visual silence around the product.

Series concept:
The four panels should represent four completely different enchanted nature worlds, each with strong visual contrast and its own ecological character, yet all must still feel luxurious, calming, magical, and unmistakably La Mer. Each environment must independently tell the story of one natural state:
1. humid tropical forest sanctuary,
2. cool marine cliff or tidepool world,
3. misty moonlit moss forest,
4. crystalline sea-mineral botanical world.
These four worlds must feel distinct in color, light, texture, and atmosphere, but all should still speak the same skincare language of hydration, renewal, purity, and luxury.

Panel 1, tropical forest sanctuary:
Place the La Mer product on a mossy stone or natural pedestal inside a warm, humid rainforest clearing. Surround it with elegant tropical leaves, filtered sunbeams, soft mist, dew, and lush green depth. The environment should feel fresh, moist, and sunlit, with premium natural richness. The product should interact with the environment through soft moisture sheen, leaf framing, and golden-green reflected light. This panel should feel like a quiet sacred moment in a living rainforest film still.

Panel 2, marine cliff or tidepool world:
Place the La Mer product in a cool oceanic environment inspired by tidepools, sea cliffs, mineral rocks, and marine mist. The product can rest on a wet sea rock or elevated stone surrounded by gentle tidewater, sea haze, sea-glass fragments, mineral moisture, and cool blue-green reflections. This panel should feel more aquatic, airy, windswept, and cinematic, like a frame captured on a remote cliff at dawn.

Panel 3, moonlit moss forest:
Place the La Mer product in a darker, more mysterious enchanted moss forest at twilight or moonlit dusk. Use deep green-black moss, wet bark, soft glowing fungus-like accents, faint floating particles, silver-blue haze, and quiet shadow depth. The product should glow softly against the darker environment, creating a feeling of nocturnal renewal and secret botanical alchemy. This panel should feel like a hidden ritual scene from a fantasy feature film.

Panel 4, crystalline sea-mineral botanical world:
Place the La Mer product in a refined fantasy environment where marine botanicals, translucent crystals, sea-mineral formations, wet petals, and pale luminous natural elements create a more ethereal and precious setting. The product should feel as if it has emerged from a sacred oceanic-botanical altar. This panel may be the most elevated and magical of the four, with subtle pearl, jade, and seafoam tonal accents, but it must still feel elegant and cinematic rather than decorative.

Product realism:
Render the La Mer product with obsessive realism and luxury material fidelity. Show correct jar or bottle proportions, refined glass or cream-jar surfaces, polished cap, premium label sharpness, clean reflections, and elegant tonal depth. The product must feel pristine, expensive, and unmistakably La Mer in every panel. It must remain the chromatic and compositional center of each frame.

Nature-product interaction:
In every panel, the product and environment must actively respond to each other. Use moisture on stone, reflected light from leaves, sea mist catching on glass, moss touching the base, droplets on surrounding petals, soft haze, and subtle natural framing. The product must feel fully harmonized with the natural world around it. This relationship must feel cinematic and organic, never decorative or artificial.

Water, mist, and particle realism:
Render water, humidity, droplets, mist, and micro-particles with extreme realism and elegance. Every panel should contain some form of atmospheric moisture or natural particle life, but adapted to its own ecology: rainforest humidity, sea spray, moonlit forest vapor, mineral mist, or luminous moisture dust. The effects must feel clean, premium, and physically believable. Keep them more restrained and cinematic, as if suspended in quiet air before motion resumes.

Lighting:
Use extremely delicate soft cinematic lighting in all four panels, but vary the light character to match the environment:
1. warm filtered rainforest light,
2. cool marine daylight haze,
3. dim moonlit forest glow,
4. pale sacred mineral illumination.
All lighting must remain luxurious, gentle, and highly controlled. The product must always be lit with premium clarity while the environment supports its mood. Each panel should feel like expertly composed natural-cinematic lighting rather than studio fantasy glow.

Cinematic depth and atmosphere:
Make every panel feel like a still frame from an award-winning fantasy nature film. Use stronger foreground-midground-background separation, more natural lens depth, controlled haze, atmospheric silence, and carefully framed empty areas. Avoid filling every corner. Let the world breathe. The sense of space, pause, and emotional stillness is essential.

Color direction:
Create four distinct but harmonious fantasy-natural color systems:
1. warm lush green and gold,
2. cool aqua, seafoam, and silver-blue,
3. deep moss black-green with muted moonlit silver,
4. pearl jade, soft aqua, pale mineral violet, and sea-glass light.
The four panels must feel varied and contrasting, but still part of one luxury La Mer universe.

Typography and branding:
Add a refined English main title such as “LA MER” and a short support line in a premium editorial layout. Include subtle official-feeling brand logic, but keep all text sparse, elegant, and spatially integrated. Typography must remain luxurious and controlled, never bulky or noisy.

Mood:
luxurious, ethereal, hydrating, botanical, oceanic, mystical, luminous, sacred, elegant, collectible, cinematic, still, atmospheric

Rendering style:
ultra-premium La Mer skincare campaign, 2x2 four-panel fantasy nature series, hyper-real luxury product photography, four distinct enchanted environments, cinematic still-frame composition, refined water and mist realism, subtle official branding, high-fashion skincare advertising aesthetic, award-winning cinematography mood, 8k, collector-grade image quality

Negative prompt:
cheap beauty ad, repetitive same forest background, weak product focus, cartoon plants, noisy fantasy effects, plastic packaging, oversaturated colors, artificial lighting, generic skincare ad style, cluttered composition, childish fairy aesthetic, low-detail droplets, overdecorated fantasy background

prompts.text:
为海蓝之谜（La Mer）制作一张超高端的2x2四格护肤营销海报，保持绝对的品牌一致性，但包含四个完全不同的奇幻自然环境。每个象限必须感觉像是一个独特的魔法世界，拥有各自的生态特征、色彩氛围和电影感心境，但所有四个象限仍必须清晰地属于一个统一的海蓝之谜视觉宇宙。在每一格中，产品必须保持绝对的主角地位，完全融入自然，仿佛它天生就属于那里。最终的艺术作品必须感觉像是一个世界级的奢侈护肤系列，以及定格为四个静止画面的获奖电影摄影：超写实的产品摄影、精致的环境叙事、优雅的自然互动、微妙的奇幻氛围以及收藏级的视觉精炼。使用精炼的英文标题排版、微妙的官方品牌标识，并在高端社论式布局中采用极少的辅助文字。

核心布局：
使用严格的2x2四格构图，具有均衡的间距和统一的设计规范。每个画格必须包含一个核心海蓝之谜产品，以视觉主导但环境融合的方式放置。产品绝不能感觉像是被粘贴进场景的；它必须通过光影、水分、反射、材质接触和构图互动，感觉完全沉浸在每个自然世界中。每个画格必须清晰地表达不同的环境特征，同时保持相同的奢华基调、产品比例逻辑和品牌连贯性。

Milk Cloud Orbit + Cream Halo Transit方向：
进一步强化已确立的最强特质：加强四个不同自然世界之间的对比，精炼海洋植物奇幻细节，并将整个视觉语言提升至电影静态摄影的卓越水平。保留相同的四环境骨架，但让每个画格感觉更像是获奖奇幻电影中一个完美暂停的瞬间：更安静、更宽敞、更具氛围感，且更具情感共鸣。用更强的电影环境叙事、更好的深度分层、更自然的光影衰减以及产品周围更受控的视觉留白，取代任何通用的装饰性奇幻感。

系列概念：
四个画格应代表四个完全不同的魔幻自然世界，每个都具有强烈的视觉对比和各自的生态特征，但所有画格仍必须感觉奢华、平静、神奇，且带有鲜明的海蓝之谜风格。每个环境必须独立讲述一个自然状态的故事：
1. 潮湿的热带森林圣地，
2. 凉爽的海洋悬崖或潮池世界，
3. 薄雾笼罩的月光苔藓森林，
4. 结晶的海洋矿物植物世界。
这四个世界在色彩、光线、纹理和氛围上必须感觉截然不同，但都应讲述关于补水、修复、纯净和奢华的同一种护肤语言。

画格1，热带森林圣地：
将海蓝之谜产品放置在温暖潮湿的雨林林间空地中的苔藓石头或自然基座上。周围环绕着优雅的热带叶子、过滤后的阳光、柔和的雾气、露水和郁郁葱葱的绿色深度。环境应感觉清新、湿润且阳光明媚，具有高端的自然丰饶感。产品应通过柔和的水分光泽、叶片构图和金绿色的反射光与环境互动。这个画格应感觉像是充满生机的雨林电影剧照中一个安静神圣的瞬间。

画格2，海洋悬崖或潮池世界：
将海蓝之谜产品放置在受潮池、海边悬崖、矿物岩石和海雾启发的凉爽海洋环境中。产品可以放置在潮湿的海岩或升高的石头上，周围环绕着柔和的潮水、海雾、海玻璃碎片、矿物水分和冷色调的蓝绿色反射。这个画格应感觉更具水感、通透、海风吹拂且具电影感，就像黎明时分在偏远悬崖上捕捉到的画面。

画格3，月光苔藓森林：
将海蓝之谜产品放置在黄昏或月光下的深色、更神秘的魔幻苔藓森林中。使用深绿黑色的苔藓、湿润的树皮、柔和发光的真菌状装饰、微弱的漂浮颗粒、银蓝色薄雾和安静的阴影深度。产品应在较暗的环境中发出柔和的光芒，营造出一种夜间修复和秘密植物炼金术的感觉。这个画格应感觉像是奇幻故事片中一个隐藏的仪式场景。

画格4，结晶海洋矿物植物世界：

Please first understand the novel content above, then design an original novel cover for it.

Do not randomly generate an image based only on the book title. Please first extract from the story:
1. The most core emotion
2. The most representative scene
3. Character relationships or key objects that best imply the plot
4. Main colors and auxiliary colors suitable for the novel's temperament
5. Fonts and typography language corresponding to the genre

Use a visual approach that combines a sense of real photography, literary feeling, and cinematic feeling. Use the key scene from the novel as the full-frame background. The image should have clear foreground, midground, and background, and add restrained but perceptible narrative clues through character silhouettes, glass reflections, rain, lighting, buildings, vehicles, or key objects.

The cover cannot just be a beautiful landscape, nor should it directly state the entire plot. The image should make the reader feel that the story is happening and generate curiosity about character relationships or conflicts.

Arrange the position of the book title according to the screen structure; do not fix the text on the same side for every cover. The Chinese book title is the main visual, and handwritten, Songti, sans-serif, or other fonts matching the theme can be used; the English subtitle, author name, and slogan serve as secondary information. The text should naturally integrate with architectural perspective, roads, characters, light, or negative space areas, rather than simply being overlaid on the image.

Retain appropriate publishing design layers:
- Chinese book title
- English subtitle or Pinyin, optional
- Author name
- One cover slogan
- A small amount of novel genre or publishing information

The overall result needs to have the completeness, visual layering, and publishing sense of a real novel cover. It should not be overly minimalist, nor should it look like a common photography poster. Different novels should naturally generate different scenes, compositions, color schemes, fonts, and emotions based on the story content, rather than applying the same fixed template.

Finally, generate only one single, complete novel cover. Do not generate collages, nine-square grids, book mockups, or display scenes.

不要只根据书名随机生成一张图片。请先从故事中提炼：
1. 最核心的情绪
2. 最有代表性的场景
3. 最能暗示剧情的人物关系或关键物件
4. 适合小说气质的主色与辅助色
5. 对应题材的字体与排版语言

使用真实摄影感、文学感和电影感结合的视觉方式。以小说中的关键场景作为全幅背景，画面应具备明确的前景、中景和远景，并通过人物背影、玻璃倒影、雨水、灯光、建筑、交通工具或关键物件，加入克制但可感知的叙事线索。

封面不能只是漂亮风景，也不要把剧情全部直接讲明。画面应让读者感受到故事正在发生，并对人物关系或冲突产生好奇。

根据画面结构安排书名位置，不要每张封面都把文字固定放在同一侧。中文书名是主要视觉，可使用手写体、宋体、无衬线体或其他与题材匹配的字体；英文副标题、作者名和宣传语作为次级信息。文字应与建筑透视、道路、人物、光线或留白区域自然结合，而不是简单覆盖在图片上。

保留适当的出版设计层次：
- 中文书名
- 英文副标题或拼音，可选
- 作者名
- 一句封面宣传语
- 少量小说类型或出版信息

整体需要有真实小说封面的完整度、视觉层次和出版感，不能过度极简，也不能像普通摄影海报。不同小说应根据故事内容自然生成不同的场景、构图、配色、字体和情绪，而不是套用同一个固定模板。

最终只生成一张独立完整的小说封面，不要生成拼图、九宫格、书籍样机或展示场景。

prompts.text:

Profile face wrapped in tide

Depict a woman in her 20s standing on a seaside with rocky reefs, a vertical 3:4 realistic portrait. The upper body occupies about 70% of the frame, with the arm and deep blue sea retained on the left, and a blurred rocky area at the bottom right.

Bright ivory-beige skin with a natural pale pink flush. Add subtle gloss to cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbone, retaining the realistic texture of pores and fine skin grain. Pale rose blush, champagne-beige and pink-brown eye makeup, slender eyelashes, natural tear bags, soft bright brown eyebrows, and glossy pink-beige lipstick. A well-defined profile with the face turned to the right side of the frame, chin slightly retracted, and gaze cast diagonally downward. Lips lightly closed, showing a peaceful and steady expression.

Clothing · Pose:
An ivory-colored delicately knitted triangle bikini. Thin shoulder straps and side straps fit the skin naturally, with slight tension and small wrinkles added to the fabric. The body is twisted about 30 degrees to the right side of the frame, with the left shoulder slightly forward. The character's own left arm hangs down to near the waist, with the elbow relaxed and bent. The abdomen is naturally stretched, and the center of gravity of the shoulders, rib cage, and waist is smooth and continuous.

Background · Lighting:
A sunny seashore. The foreground is the portrait, the middle ground is the deep blue sea surface, and the background consists of out-of-focus rocky reefs and a low coastline. Strong warm sunlight falls from the upper left, illuminating the forehead, bridge of the nose, shoulders, chest, and the left side of the abdomen. Pale blue reflected light from the sky and sea is added to the opposite side, shadows are not too harsh, maintaining a sense of three-dimensionality. Tiny water droplets are scattered on the skin and hair strands.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 3:4, a medium close-up from the waist up. A level perspective lens close to chest height, with a slight telephoto feel. Narrow headroom at the top, ensuring empty space for the blue sky in front of the character's profile. Focus on the pupils and profile, with the coastline softly blurred by a shallow depth of field.

Texture · Style:
High-precision summer fashion photography. Bright milk-tea grey-brown medium-length hair, thin transparent bangs, layers around the face, and loose inner curls at the ends. A natural wet clumping look under the sea breeze, with individual visible hair strands flowing, slender highlights, soft luster, and a few stray hairs falling on the cheeks. Dominated by vibrant blue and ivory tones, with natural contrast and moderate graininess.

Negative:
Expressions that look like a minor, unnatural facial features, unnatural gaze, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, extra fingers, missing fingers, flaws in arms or joints, asymmetry of left and right shoulders, poor contact between clothing and body, unnatural gravity, shadows with contradictory light sources, text, logos, watermarks.

prompts.text:

prompts.text: Generate an image with the temperament of a literary magazine cover around any subject: The image first establishes the primary visual weight with very large black or theme-derived dark text, with thick glyphs and strokes that have a calligraphic sense of pressure, occupying the high-position white space on one side, accompanied by a small amount of thin lines, publication-style small font information, italic English or vertical short sentences to form a quiet reading rhythm; the subject object should not be presented realistically, but translated into a naive crayon-drawn symbolic main form, placed in a lower position on the other side, forming obvious tension with large areas of blank space, with edges retaining hand-drawn roughness, breakage, smudging, and a sense of partial overstepping boundaries. Around the main subject, there can be theme-derived arcs, starlike dots, fireworks, small marks, or attachments, using slightly out-of-control hand-drawn trajectories to create a sense of adventure and childhood imagination, but the information area must be restrained, neat, and leave room to breathe. Colors are extracted from the theme's own materials, emotions, and narratives: large areas of the background maintain a bright, clear, clean high-brightness base, text uses clear dark colors to bear the structure, the subject uses medium-to-high saturation theme color blocks, and accent colors appear only as small area dots or lines, maintaining a light, innocent, and airy mood; the paper surface can have subtle printing grains and crayon powdery textures, but it cannot become dirty, gray, or aged. The overall look is like a carefully typeset independent publication meeting a child's hand-drawn dream, where rational textual order and free graffiti constrain each other, possessing both an editorial feel and an unpolished spirit of adventure.

prompts.text:
Create a highly realistic vertical smartphone portrait of a fictional adult East Asian woman in her mid-20s, photographed indoors beside a large bright window during daytime.

Use an extremely close, slightly wide-angle perspective, approximately equivalent to a 26–30mm full-frame lens. The camera is positioned around shoulder-to-face height, less than one meter from her face, creating strong foreground perspective distortion.

The woman fills almost the entire frame from the upper torso to the top of her head. Her face is positioned in the upper-left quadrant rather than centered. Her torso turns approximately 55 degrees sideways, while her head rotates gently back toward the camera. She is caught in the middle of raising one arm above or behind her head, as though adjusting her windblown hair.

Her raised upper arm must dominate the right side of the frame, occupying approximately 25–30 percent of the image. The arm is extremely close to the camera lens, partially cropped by the top and right edges, with the elbow and hand completely outside the frame. It must appear as a large, soft, heavily defocused foreground shape. Do not focus on the arm. The arm should create natural optical foreground blur, not directional motion blur.

Her face remains the primary focus, especially the eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, and several strands of hair crossing the face. The neck, clothing, lower torso, opposite arm, and background gradually become softer.

She has a softly elongated oval face, natural almond-shaped dark brown eyes, subtle straight eyebrows, a small refined nose, softly rounded cheeks, and natural adult facial proportions. She looks toward a point just beside the camera lens with a relaxed, slightly distant expression. Her eyelids are gently lowered, her lips are slightly parted, and she is not smiling. Avoid a glamorous or heavily posed facial expression.

Her hair is a short, slightly uneven dark brown bob ending between the jawline and upper neck. The hair has soft natural volume and imperfect ends. A gentle sideways breeze pushes multiple thin strands of hair irregularly across her forehead, eyebrows, eyes, nose, cheeks, lips, and chin. Use many delicate individual strands rather than one thick lock of hair. Several loose ends should lift outward around the sides of her head and neck.

She wears a fitted sleeveless ribbed bodysuit or one-piece top in a muted greige, dusty taupe, or pale pink-beige color. The fabric has fine vertical ribbing and a soft matte texture. The neckline is relatively high and simple, while the side opening is cut very deeply beneath the raised arm, exposing the side of the torso. No logos, prints, metal details, jewelry, or decorative elements.

Her body has natural adult proportions, a softly curved upper torso, realistic skin compression, and believable anatomy. The visual shape should come primarily from the sideways body angle, raised arm, deep side cut, and close wide-angle perspective rather than exaggerated anatomy.

Lighting is very bright, soft, and high-key. A large window behind and slightly to the left of the woman creates strong diffused daylight and an almost overexposed pale background. The window light should wrap gently around the hair, cheek, shoulder, and raised arm. Use weak frontal fill from white walls or natural reflected light so the face remains evenly illuminated without dark shadows.

The background is an abstract, heavily blurred modern interior in pale blue-white and light gray tones. Include only vague shapes of a large window, white window frames, soft exterior building shapes, and a light horizontal surface near the bottom. Do not include detailed furniture, plants, curtains, lamps, or decorative objects.

Use shallow depth of field similar to a smartphone portrait mode effect, but keep the optical transitions natural. The face and a few strands of hair are sharp. The raised arm is strongly defocused in the extreme foreground. The distant window and room are also heavily blurred.

Color grading is soft, low-contrast, and slightly cool. Use pale blue-white highlights, lifted shadows, muted blacks, low saturation, soft pink-beige skin tones, dark brown hair, muted rose lips, and a dusty greige outfit. Preserve faint natural skin texture around the lips, nose, eyes, and hairline while smoothing the overall complexion subtly.

The final image should feel like an intimate, accidental smartphone snapshot captured while she was adjusting her hair, positioned between a private candid photo and a minimal beauty editorial. It must not look like a formal studio portrait, fashion campaign, selfie with a visible phone, or polished glamour pose.

Vertical composition, approximately 3:5 aspect ratio, close crop, face in the upper-left area, torso flowing diagonally toward the lower-left, oversized blurred upper arm on the right, bright overexposed window background, soft windblown hair crossing the face, realistic photography, natural anatomy, subtle smartphone image processing.

prompts.text:
创建一个高度写实的虚构20多岁成年东亚女性的垂直智能手机肖像，白天在室内的大明窗旁拍摄。

使用极近的、略微广角的透视，大约相当于26–30mm全画幅镜头。摄像机放置在肩部到面部的高度，距离她的脸不到一米，产生强烈的前景透视失真。

女人几乎填满了从上躯干到头顶的整个画面。她的脸位于左上象限而不是正中。她的躯干侧转约55度，而她的头轻轻地转回镜头。她正处于将一只手臂举过头顶或脑后的动作中，仿佛在整理被风吹乱的头发。

她举起的上臂必须占据画面的右侧，约占图像的25–30%。手臂离摄像机镜头极近，被顶部和右边缘部分裁剪，肘部和手完全在画面之外。它必须呈现为一个巨大的、柔软的、严重失焦的前景形状。不要聚焦在手臂上。手臂应产生自然的视觉前景模糊，而不是定向运动模糊。

她的脸仍然是主要焦点，尤其是眼睛、眉毛、鼻子、嘴唇和横跨面部的几缕头发。脖子、衣服、下躯干、另一只手臂和背景逐渐变得柔和。

光线非常明亮、柔和且高调。女人身后略偏左的大窗户营造出强烈的扩散日光和近乎过曝的浅色背景。窗光应轻轻包裹住头发、脸颊、肩膀和抬起的手臂。利用来自白墙的微弱正面填充光或自然反射光，使面部保持均匀照亮，没有深色阴影。

背景是一个抽象的、严重模糊的现代室内装饰，采用淡蓝白色和浅灰色调。仅包含大窗户、白色窗框、柔和的室外建筑形状和底部附近的浅色水平面的模糊形状。不要包括详细的家具、植物、窗帘、灯具或装饰物。

使用类似于智能手机人像模式效果的浅景深，但保持光学过渡自然。面部和几缕头发是清晰的。抬起的手臂在极端前景中被强烈去焦。远处的窗户和房间也严重模糊。

最终图像应该感觉像是一张她在整理头发时抓拍的私密的、偶然的智能手机快照，定位在私人偷拍照片和极简美容社论之间。它绝不能看起来像正式的摄影棚肖像、时尚大片、露出手机的自拍或精致的妩媚姿势。

prompts.text:
Hyper-realistic real-life photography, cinematic ancient style portrait, shoulder-up face close-up (Close-up Portrait), character occupies about 85% to 90% of the frame, 9:16 vertical composition, cinematic still texture, shallow depth of field, large aperture bokeh, medium format photography, real skin texture, combination of soft natural light and cold-colored rim light, background is an ancient style courtyard at night, distant lanterns, cornices, and hazy tree shadows are blurred, not distracting from the subject, the overall atmosphere is oppressive, somber, and restrained.

Character setting: An Oriental classical girl about 20 years old, oval face, exquisite and soft features, fair and delicate skin, real pores and fine fuzz clearly visible, black long hair tied in a classical bun, wearing white jade and pearl hairpins, light blue embroidered wide-sleeved Hanfu, with a cold and dignified temperament.

Emotional theme: "Hatred".

The character is not in a rage, nor is there any exaggerated roaring, but rather suppresses a wave of hatred beneath a calm exterior. The eyebrows remain naturally relaxed, no frowning, no glaring, the eyes are calm yet sharp, as if after experiencing betrayal, life-and-death separation, or deep-seated hatred, all emotions have settled into a cold decisiveness.

The head is slightly lowered, the chin naturally tucked in by about 5° to 10°, the overall face remains almost directly facing the camera, with only a slight turn of about 8° to 12° toward the character's left, forming a nearly front-facing three-quarter view. The eyes do not look directly at the camera but steadily gaze at a position outside the lens about 15° to 20° to the character's right, with the line of sight slightly downward by about 3° to 5°, the pupils focused firmly and with restraint, as if always locked onto someone unforgettable to her. The upper eyelids are naturally slightly pressed, the lower eyelids are slightly tightened, the eyebrows are only very slightly gathered toward the middle, no frowning, no glaring, no raising of eyebrows, the lips are naturally closed, there is no smile at the corners of the mouth, nor any obvious downward pull, only a very slight sense of tension is maintained.

The eye sockets are noticeably red, the whites of the eyes are covered with fine bloodshot veins, the corners of the eyes are moist, there is a glimmer of tears deep in the pupils, the tears have not fallen yet, just continuously accumulating in the eye sockets, forming crystal-clear specular reflections. The lower eyelids are slightly moist, the tip of the nose is slightly red, the breathing seems to be forcibly suppressed, the entire face remains restrained and quiet, yet allows people to clearly feel the hatred deep into the marrow.

The overall emotional expression emphasizes "eye lethality" rather than exaggerated facial movements, the image is quiet, oppressive, and full of tension, as if the final decision will be made in the next second. The emotion comes from the direction of the gaze, the focus of the pupils, the subtle changes of the eyelids, and the suppressed body language, rather than exaggerated facial feature movements, making the character present a cinematic-level restrained performance and strong dramatic tension.

The background remains in soft focus and blurred, serving only as an ancient-style environmental atmosphere foil, without interfering with the character's face.

prompts.text:

prompts.text:
3:4 vertical minimalist watercolor and ink urban sketch on cold-press handmade paper. Loose studio sketch, not a finished illustration.

FINISH GRADIENT (priority): the couple is the only fully resolved area. Nearby architecture ~60% painted, with clear patches of bare paper and contour line breaking through. Distant buildings and frame edges dissolve into loose graphite and untouched paper before the border. ~20% of the page stays unpainted, mostly upper area and edges. Background is bare paper, not a painted sky. Unfinished edges are intentional.

SCENE: Top of the Rock observation deck, Midtown Manhattan, clear afternoon. Two lovers at the stone parapet seen from behind, shoulders touching, one leaning in and pointing toward the Empire State Building. Wind in hair and a light cardigan. Quiet, unposed.

COMPOSITION: High vantage point. Couple small and back-turned in the lower third. Empire State Building off-center mid-distance. High horizon, deep space, generous open paper above.

WASH: Wet-on-wet bleeding with blooms and backruns. Washes deliberately offset from the ink lines, spilling past contours and stopping short of others. Strong dilution variation within one facade — saturated, ghost-pale, and bare paper in turn. Visible granulation in the paper tooth. Hard wet-on-dry edges beside soft blooms. Reserved white paper as highlights, never white paint.

LINE: Fast searching graphite and fine ink, construction marks left uncorrected. Scribble loops for railings and distant windows instead of literal detail. Weight varies hairline to bold. Faces suggested in a few marks.

VALUE: High-key and airy, with exactly one deep dark note — the shaded face of the nearest rooftop tower in ink navy.

COLOR: Cool blue-dominant. 55% slate blue, dusty cerulean, powder blue, pale blue-gray. 20% bare warm off-white paper. 15% warm stone gray and limestone as mid-tone relief against flat monochrome blue. 10% taxi yellow on sunlit edges. Muted, low saturation.

TYPOGRAPHY: Upper right, italic "New York" with one short poetic English line below in muted slate navy, absorbed into the paper.

NEGATIVE: flat monochrome blue, painted sky, uniform flat coverage, no white space, over-detailed architecture, smooth gradients, digital airbrush, color perfectly inside the lines, photorealistic, 3D render, heavy black outlines, harsh shadows, muddy gray-blue, oversaturated, cluttered, realistic faces, stiff pose, single person, misspelled text, logo, watermark, border, frame.

完成度渐变（优先级）：这对情侣是唯一完全处理好的区域。附近的建筑约 60% 已绘制，带有明显的空白纸张斑块和轮廓线穿插其中。远处的建筑和画面边缘在边界前溶解为松散的石墨和未触及的纸张。约 20% 的页面保持未涂色，主要是上方区域和边缘。背景是白纸，而非涂抹的天空。未完成的边缘是刻意为之。

场景：巨石之巅观景台，曼哈顿中城，晴朗的下午。石质女儿墙边的两位恋人的背影，肩膀相触，一人倾身指向帝国大厦。头发和轻薄开衫随风飘动。安静，自然。

构图：高视角。情侣在下三分之一处显得渺小且背对观众。帝国大厦位于中景偏离中心位置。高地平线，深远空间，上方留出大量空白。

渲染：湿画法渗色，带有水渍和回流。色块刻意偏离墨水线条，溢出轮廓或止于轮廓前。同一立面内的稀释变化强烈——饱和、幽灵般的苍白以及留白纸张交替出现。纸张纹理中可见明显的颗粒感。软水渍旁有坚硬的干画法边缘。留白纸张作为高光，绝不使用白色颜料。

线条：快速探索性的石墨和细墨水线条，保留未修正的结构标记。用草稿圆圈表示栏杆和远处的窗户，而非写实细节。线条粗细从发丝细到粗壮不等。脸部仅用几处痕迹暗示。

明度：高调且轻快，恰有一个深色调——墨蓝色阴影下的最近屋顶塔楼面。

色彩：冷蓝色调为主。55% 石板蓝、粉尘蔚蓝、粉蓝色、淡蓝灰色。20% 温暖的米白色原纸。15% 暖石灰色和石灰石色作为中性色，对比平坦的单色蓝。10% 出租车黄位于受光边缘。色调柔和，低饱和度。

排版：右上角，斜体“New York”，下方有一行简短诗意的英文，采用柔和的石板蓝，渗入纸张。

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium fantasy skincare advertising poster for La Mer, built around one hyper-real hero product floating in the center of a magical natural world, with a soft blurred female figure appearing far in the background as a very distant atmospheric presence. The image must feel luxurious, ethereal, oceanic, botanical, and cinematic, like a world-class high-fashion skincare campaign. The product must remain the absolute visual protagonist. Surround it with a suspended cradle of water, mist, petals, translucent fragments, and luminous natural particles, creating a sense of elegant levitation and sacred support. The final image must feel dreamlike, clean, and emotionally powerful, while preserving premium realism and delicate fantasy atmosphere.

Core composition:
Use a tall vertical composition with the La Mer product floating at the exact visual center or slightly above center, clearly dominant and sharply focused. The product should appear suspended in mid-air, gently held by a sculptural natural support system made of flowing cream-like ribbons, water vapor, delicate petals, droplets, and soft organic motion. Behind the product, place a healthy athletic Western female model in very soft, distant blur, positioned farther back in the upper-left or center-left depth of field so she feels like a faint environmental spirit rather than a second subject. She must feel remote, quiet, and secondary. The entire composition must feel centered, sacred, and visually balanced.

Milk Cloud Orbit + Cream Halo Transit direction:
Push the strongest established qualities further: intensify the sacred levitation of the product, refine the natural support structure into a more elegant marine-botanical ritual, and reduce the visual weight of the background human presence. Keep the exact same core skeleton, but make the woman farther away, more dissolved into haze, and less descriptive, so the product and its surrounding aura become more iconic and self-sufficient. At the same time, replace some decorative floral logic with more elevated marine-mineral cues such as sea mist, sea-glass translucency, tide-borne crystalline fragments, and oceanic botanical textures. The result should feel quieter, rarer, and more aligned with La Mer’s ocean-born luxury mythology.

Product choice and realism:
Use an iconic La Mer hero skincare product, such as a premium cream jar or serum bottle, rendered with obsessive realism and luxury material fidelity. Show correct packaging proportions, refined glass or jar material, polished cap, subtle reflections, premium label sharpness, and elegant tonal depth. The product must feel pristine, expensive, and unmistakably La Mer. It should glow softly as the central object of desire, with clean edges, tactile realism, and a noble luxury presence.

Floating support logic:
The product must not simply hover randomly. It should feel naturally and magically supported by the environment through a sculptural floating relationship. Use elegant suspended forms such as silk-like cream ribbons, water arcs, mist layers, petals, and translucent sea-glass or crystal-like fragments, all arranged around the product in a balanced and controlled way. The product should appear gently uplifted by nature and light, as if held in a ritual of renewal. The support structure must remain airy and beautiful, never heavy or cluttered.

Fantasy natural environment:
Build a luxurious enchanted natural environment that combines marine and botanical fantasy. Use luminous wet flowers only in restrained amounts, moss, sea-breeze moisture, fine stems, dew, soft petals, blurred floral depth, and stronger hints of magical coastal vegetation and mineral presence. The world should feel like a meeting point between ocean and forest: elegant, dreamy, fresh, and sacred. Keep the environment premium and controlled, never childish, never noisy. The foreground and midground should contain beautifully lit natural elements, while the deep background fades into soft atmospheric blur and darkness.

Blurred female presence:
The female figure in the background must be heavily softened by shallow depth of field and positioned farther away than before. She should feel like a distant muse or memory of femininity inside the environment, almost dissolving into mist and light. Her face and body should remain soft, elegant, and unreadable in detail. She must never become sharper or more visually dominant than the product. Her presence is emotional, not narrative.

Water, mist, and particle realism:
Render water, mist, droplets, and micro-particles with extreme realism and elegance. Use tiny floating droplets, gentle atmospheric moisture, soft glimmering particles, and fine mist to create a magical skincare world. The water behavior must feel clean, premium, and physically believable. The particles should feel suspended and luminous, enhancing the sensation of softness and hydration without becoming noisy.

Lighting:
Use extremely delicate soft cinematic lighting. The main light should create a luminous premium halo around the product, with gentle cool-to-soft-warm transitions and elegant highlights on the packaging, suspended droplets, petals, and surrounding natural elements. The woman in the background should remain in diffused, distant, almost disappearing light. The lighting must feel ethereal, luxurious, and controlled, never harsh and never synthetic.

Color direction:
Use a refined fantasy-luxury palette inspired by La Mer’s premium identity: seafoam green, pale aqua, misty silver, pearl white, soft jade, subtle botanical blue-green, and very restrained mineral-violet or blush accents if needed. Keep the palette cool, clean, radiant, and elevated. The product should remain the center of chromatic focus.

Typography and branding:
Add a refined English main title such as “LA MER” in a premium editorial beauty layout, with minimal support text if needed. Include subtle official-feeling brand logic, but keep all typography sparse, elegant, and spatially integrated. The text must feel luxurious and restrained, never loud or bulky.

Mood:
luxurious, ethereal, hydrating, botanical, oceanic, feminine, luminous, sacred, elegant, collectible, cinematic, distant

Rendering style:

Negative prompt:

prompts.text:
为海蓝之谜（La Mer）创作一张超高端的奇幻护肤广告海报，围绕一个漂浮在神奇自然世界中心的超写实英雄产品构建，背景中有一个柔和模糊的女性形象，作为非常遥远的氛围存在。图像必须具有奢华感、空灵感、海洋感、植物感和电影感，就像世界级的顶级时尚护肤大片。产品必须保持绝对的视觉主角。用悬浮的水、雾、花瓣、半透明碎片和发光的自然微粒构成的摇篮围绕着它，营造出一种优雅的悬浮感和神圣的支撑感。最终图像必须具有梦幻感、洁净感和强大的情感冲击力，同时保留高端的写实主义和精致的奇幻氛围。

核心构图：
使用长竖构图，海蓝之谜产品漂浮在视觉中心正中或略高于中心的位置，占据主导地位且对焦清晰。产品应呈现悬浮在半空中的状态，由流动的奶油色缎带、水汽、精致花瓣、水滴和柔和的有机运动构成的雕塑感自然支撑系统轻轻托起。在产品后方，放置一位健康的运动型西方女性模特，处于非常柔和、遥远的模糊状态，位于景深左上方或左中方的较远位置，使其感觉像是一个隐约的环境精灵而非第二个主体。她必须感觉遥远、安静且处于次要地位。整个构图必须感觉居中、神圣且视觉平衡。

牛奶云轨道 + 奶油光环转移方向：
进一步加强已确立的特质：增强产品的神圣悬浮感，将自然支撑结构细化为更优雅的海洋植物仪式，并减轻背景人物存在的视觉权重。保持完全相同的核心骨架，但让女性更远，更多地消融在薄雾中，减少写实描述，使产品及其周围的光环变得更具标志性和自给自足。同时，将部分装饰性的花卉逻辑替换为更高端的海洋矿物元素，如海雾、海玻璃半透明感、潮汐带来的晶体碎片和海洋植物纹理。结果应该感觉更安静、更稀有，且更符合海蓝之谜源自海洋的奢华神话。

产品选择与写实度：
使用一款标志性的海蓝之谜英雄护肤产品，如高端面霜罐或精华瓶，以极其执着的写实主义和奢华材质保真度进行渲染。展示正确的包装比例、精致的玻璃或罐体材质、抛光的盖子、细微的反光、高端标签的清晰度以及优雅的色调深度。产品必须感觉洁净、昂贵且带有明显的海蓝之谜风格。它应该作为中心渴望之物散发柔光，具有洁净的边缘、触觉真实感和高贵的奢华存在感。

悬浮支撑逻辑：
产品不能只是随机悬浮。它应该通过雕塑感的悬浮关系，感受到被环境自然而神奇地支撑。使用优雅的悬浮形式，如丝绸般的奶油缎带、水弧、雾层、花瓣以及半透明的海玻璃或类水晶碎片，所有这些都以平衡且受控的方式排列在产品周围。产品应看起来被自然和光线轻轻抬起，仿佛置身于一场焕新仪式中。支撑结构必须保持轻盈美观，绝不能沉重或杂乱。

奇幻自然环境：
构建一个结合了海洋和植物奇幻色彩的奢华迷人自然环境。仅在克制的情况下使用发光的湿润花朵、苔藓、海风湿气、纤细的茎、露水、柔和的花瓣、模糊的花卉深度，以及更强烈的神奇海岸植被和矿物存在的暗示。这个世界应该感觉像海洋与森林的交汇点：优雅、梦幻、清新且神圣。保持环境的高端和受控，绝不幼稚，绝不嘈杂。前景和中景应包含光线优美的自然元素，而深层背景则淡入柔和的氛围模糊和黑暗中。

模糊的女性存在：
背景中的女性形象必须因浅景深而大幅柔化，且位置比之前更远。她应该感觉像是环境内部的一个遥远缪斯或女性记忆，几乎消融在雾气和光影中。她的脸部和身体应保持柔和、优雅且细节模糊。她绝不能比产品更清晰或在视觉上更占主导地位。她的存在是情感层面的，而非叙事层面的。

水、雾和微粒写实度：
以极端的写实和优雅渲染水、雾、水滴和微粒。使用细小的漂浮水滴、轻柔的氛围水分、柔和闪烁的微粒和细雾来营造一个神奇的护肤世界。水的行为必须感觉洁净、高端且物理上可信。微粒应呈现悬浮和发光的状态，在不产生噪点的情况下增强柔和感和滋润感。

灯光：
使用极其细腻的柔和电影照明。主光应在产品周围营造出一种发光的高端光环，带有轻柔的冷色到柔和暖色的过渡，并在包装、悬浮水滴、花瓣和周围自然元素上产生优雅的高光。背景中的女性应处于弥散的、遥远的、几乎消失的光影中。灯光必须感觉空灵、奢华且受控，绝不刺眼，绝不人造。

色彩方向：
使用灵感来自海蓝之谜高端身份的精致奇幻奢华色调：海沫绿、淡水蓝、雾银、珍珠白、柔和翠玉、细微的植物蓝绿，以及根据需要加入非常克制的矿物紫或红晕点缀。保持色调冷峻、洁净、灿烂且高级。产品应保持色彩关注的中心。

排版与品牌：
在高端社论美容布局中加入精致的英文主标题，如“LA MER”，根据需要添加极简的辅助文本。包含细微的官方品牌逻辑，但保持所有排版稀疏、优雅且与空间整合。文本必须感觉奢华且克制，绝不响亮或笨重。

情绪：
奢华、空灵、补水、植物、海洋、柔美、发光、神圣、优雅、收藏级、电影感、遥远

渲染风格：
超高端海蓝之谜护肤大片，居中悬浮英雄产品，神奇海洋植物支撑结构，背景中极远模糊的女性形象，迷人的海洋自然环境，水雾水滴和半透明矿物点缀，柔和电影奢华灯光，高时尚护肤广告美学，8k，收藏级图像质量

Create an original English novel cover based on the story above.

First understand the novel, then extract its emotional core, character relationships, key scene, visual symbol, and overall identity. Do not generate a random attractive image based only on the title.

Use the most meaningful scene, object, location, or relationship from the story as the main visual concept. Build clear foreground, middle ground, and background depth, with subtle narrative clues that make the viewer curious without explaining the entire plot.

Choose the visual language according to the genre. It may use cinematic photography, architectural composition, vintage paperback design, editorial illustration, collage, or another suitable publishing style. Different stories should naturally produce different compositions, typography, colors, and atmospheres.

Include:
- Novel title
- Author name
- One short tagline
- Optional small genre or publishing text

Typography must feel integrated into the scene and follow the image structure. Do not always place all text on the same side. Use serif, sans-serif, condensed, handwritten, or display typography according to the story.

The final image should feel like a complete, professionally published novel cover with visual depth and strong storytelling—not a movie poster, generic photo poster, tourism ad, or book mockup.

Avoid excessive minimalism, overcrowded text, meaningless decorative copy, Vol.01, issue numbers, page numbers, repetitive layouts, generic AI aesthetics, and unrelated visual elements.

Generate one standalone cover only. Do not create a grid, collage of multiple covers, or physical book mockup.

prompts.text: Maintain the original facial features exactly as they are, preserving the natural 100% facial identity and perfectly balanced proportions. The subject is centred in the composition, filling most of the frame while taking a selfie with her head noticeably tilted toward the right side of the image (left from the subject’s perspective), looking directly into the camera with a confident, captivating gaze. She wears a white collared shirt with the top buttons left open, revealing the neck, collarbones, and upper chest. Natural sunlight streams through the front of the car, creating strong, direct hard lighting that highlights the glow of the face, eyes, and hair, with the light likely reflected by the hand or smartphone holding the camera. prompts.text:
Theme:
The Other Side of the Page

Subject:
3:4 vertical composition. A woman in her 20s lies on a quilted bed with white plant embroidery, with her head toward the top left of the frame and her waist to legs toward the bottom right. The figure occupies about 75% of the frame, with an open Western book placed diagonally from her waist to the top of her thighs, naturally obscuring her lower body.

Character · Expression:
A natural and realistic elegant woman. Long dark brown hair fans out on the pillow, with thin bangs hanging over her forehead. Soft brown eyes stare quietly at the camera, and her lips are slightly parted, presenting a calm expression. Transparent natural makeup, light pink-beige lipstick, preserving natural skin texture and moderate color.

Clothing · Pose:
Summer-style thin ivory camisole. Thin shoulder straps, soft cotton rib fabric, simple silhouette naturally fitting the body. The subject's own left hand is bent and placed near her mouth. The five fingers are naturally spread, not touching the lips, only lightly close. The subject's own right hand reaches toward her waist and is placed on the open book page. The five fingers of the right hand are also clearly defined, with the fingertips lightly touching the page. Nails are short and olive green.

Background · Lighting:
The white quilted bedspread is decorated with detailed green and beige plant embroidery. The overall frame has a gentle sense of daily life, without adding extra furniture or decorations. Warm natural light pours in from a window in the top left, casting slender bands of light on the face, shoulders, left arm, and abdomen. Shadows extend softly toward the bottom right, creating delicate light and dark on the quilted textures and embroidery. The background is dominated by bright ivory tones, with green retained as small accent areas.

Composition · Lens:
3:4 vertical position, a slight high-angle shot from nearly directly above. Focusing on the upper body, while including everything from the head to the waist and the open book. The face is placed at the top-left third point of the frame, and the book is placed at the bottom right. A wide area of quilted empty space is left at the bottom of the frame to create a quiet vertical flow. Equivalent to 50mm, natural perspective. The face and both hands are the focus, with the deeper parts of the quilting slightly softened and blurred.

Texture · Style:
Elegant Japanese lifestyle photography. Slightly warm low saturation, gentle contrast, subtle film grain. Skin is not excessively smoothed, naturally retaining pores and small shadows. The texture of the fabric, the thickness of the paper, every strand of hair, and the texture of the quilting floating in light and shadow are all depicted with delicate techniques.

The layout adopts small Western text or symbols arranged horizontally at the top with sparse letter spacing, a striking short title in the upper-middle part, and thin vertical lines, small side-arranged numbers, dates, or magazine-style marks on the left and right edges; all small text must be restrained and leave white space, like soft annotations on a magazine cover. The strongest visual action is placed at the bottom: a set of oversized white handwritten strokes spans the boundary between the inner window content and the dark frame, with jumping stroke thickness, flying white endings, and local boundary crossing, and a thinner bright English handwritten line can be layered below, forming a moment where the image is pressed down by an emotional signature. Two or three short sentences can also be added inside the window, arranged along movement arcs, with the small text slightly tilted, as if carried by the wind, and must not overpower the handwritten text at the bottom. Retain the slight blur of real photos, the grain of vegetation or background textures, edge vignetting, and print noise; failure states are when the outer frame becomes a common photo frame, the handwriting is too neat, the colors are too bright or clean, or the small text is evenly spread, leading to the loss of the sense of freedom.

prompts.text: A young adult East Asian woman walking in a quiet Chinese ancient town's stone alley, the composition is from upper body to near full body. The character is located slightly to the right of the center, with her body turned about two-thirds away from the camera, walking forward while naturally looking back over her left shoulder at the camera, showing a gentle and bright smile with teeth slightly visible, her expression is relaxed, kind, and fresh. She has a soft and delicate oval face, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, natural thin eyebrows, a slender bridge of the nose, and light coral pink lips. Her makeup is very light. Her skin tone is fair and warm, retaining real pores, subtle texture, and natural highlights, without plastic skin smoothing. Her hair is long deep black hair, naturally loose, voluminous, smooth and slightly wavy, falling to her back, with a few light stray hairs. She is wearing an off-white or light cream-colored slim-fit long-sleeved top with thin, form-fitting fabric; light blue high-waisted straight-leg jeans on the bottom; carrying a simple white shoulder bag with the strap hanging from her right shoulder. The background is an ancient town alley, with old-style wooden structure houses, gray-white walls, porches, and potted plants on both sides, several red lanterns hanging, the ground is a stone road, and the distant background is softly blurred. The light is soft natural daylight, with slight side-backlighting or warm evening light, with delicate rim lighting on the edges of the character's hair and face. Overall low saturation, low contrast, transparent airy feel, real lifestyle photography. Photography style: 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, eyes and face are sharp, background is naturally blurred, slight film grain, photorealistic. items.title: 晴朗都市屋顶白衣成熟女性肖像

prompts.text:
Theme:
Wearing the sky's white

Subject:
A calm adult woman standing on a sunny urban rooftop. The character is positioned slightly to the right of the center of the frame, capturing a broad range from the top of the head to the thighs. The body occupies about 70% of the frame, quietly looking down from a low-angle camera.

Person/Expression:
Bright skin with natural flush, elegant facial features with neat contours. Pink-beige lipstick, pale rose blush, detailed brown eyeliner, and eyelashes that do not overemphasize length, creating a sophisticated Japanese-style makeup look. Dark brown shoulder-length bob hairstyle with thin bangs and layering around the face, with the ends and back strands swaying gently in the wind. The chin is slightly tucked in, looking into the lens with a calm and mature gaze, lips naturally slightly parted.

Clothing/Pose:
Thin, sheer ivory chiffon shirt. The V-neck is not too deep, soft and comfortable, with loose long sleeves and delicate cufflinks at the cuffs. A beige simple camisole that matches the skin tone is worn underneath, creating an elegant transparency where the chest and body contours are visible. The bottom is a light cream-colored high-waisted pleated mini skirt. The upper body is leaning slightly forward, shoulders relaxed, and arms hanging naturally at the sides. Blown by the wind, the chiffon of the shirt and the hem of the skirt sway gently, naturally forming folds and shadows at the waist.

Background/Lighting:
Located on the rooftop of an urban apartment. Waist-high metal fence, low-rise residential buildings and apartment complexes discreetly arranged in the distance, without any text or logos added. Most of the background is a vivid blue sky and three-dimensional white cumulus clouds. Warm backlight spills from a low sun in the lower left of the frame, lining the edges of the hair, cheeks, neck, and the chiffon of the shirt with a golden halo. The front of the face blends with the soft light reflected from the sky and the rooftop floor, avoiding being too dark. Only a small circular lens flare remains near the waist.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4. A bold low-angle shot looking up from near the ground, leaving about 20% of the blue sky as negative space above the character's head. The left side of the frame is a bright space with clouds and the sun, while the character's arms and shoulders are placed on the right, forming an asymmetrical yet stable composition. Equivalent to a 28-35mm wide-angle feel, with precise focus on the face and upper body, and shallow depth-of-field blur on the background buildings. Does not unnaturally stretch the body or legs, naturally expressing the tension unique to low angles.

Texture/Style:
Realistic portrait. Retains skin texture and fine vellus hair, avoiding excessive skin smoothing. Detailed depiction of the chiffon fabric's fibers, tiny folds, transmitted light, and overlapping pleats. Contrasts the refreshing cool tones of the blue sky with the golden warm tones of the sun, creating a sense of cleanliness and a mature atmosphere like a summer fashion magazine.

Negative Prompt:
Childish face, unnatural features, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands and feet, broken joints, disproportionate body, extreme distorted wide-angle expression, unnatural contact between fabric and body, excessive transparency, shadows contradicting the light source, blown-out whites, too many lens flares, plastic-like skin, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

prompts.text:
主题：
身披天空的白色

主体：
一位站在晴朗都市屋顶上的沉稳成年女性。人物配置在画面中央稍偏右的位置，拍摄从头顶到大腿的广阔范围。身体占据画面约七成，从低角度的相机静静俯视。

人物・表情：
保留自然血色的明亮肌肤，轮廓整齐的高雅面容。粉米色的唇膏，淡玫瑰色的腮红，细致的棕色眼线，以及不过分强调长度的睫毛，营造出精致的日系妆容。深棕色的及肩鲍勃发型，配以薄薄的刘海和脸部周围的层次感，发梢和后发丝在风中左右轻轻摇曳。下巴微微收回，以平静而成熟的目光注视镜头，嘴唇自然微张。

服装・姿势：
轻薄透视的象牙白雪纺衬衫。V领不过分深邃，柔和舒适，长袖宽松，袖口饰以细致的袖扣。内搭肤色相宜的米色简约吊带背心，营造出胸口和身体轮廓优雅可见的透明感。下装为浅奶油色的腰部高腰褶皱迷你裙。上身微微前倾，肩膀放松，双臂自然垂于身体两侧。受风吹拂，衬衫的薄纱和裙摆轻轻摇动，腰部自然形成褶皱和阴影。

背景・光线：
位于都市公寓的屋顶。腰部高度的金属围栏，远处低调配置低层住宅和集合住宅，不添加文字或标志。背景大部分为鲜艳的蓝天和立体感的白色积云。从画面左下方的低位太阳洒下温暖的逆光，将发丝边缘、脸颊、颈部和衬衫的薄纱镶嵌上金色光晕。脸部正面融入天空和屋顶地面反射的柔和光线，避免过暗。仅在腰部附近保留一个小圆形镜头光晕。

构图・相机：
纵向3:4。从地面附近仰视的大胆低角度拍摄，为人物头部上方保留约二成的蓝天留白。画面左侧为云朵和太阳的明亮空间，右侧放置人物的手臂和肩膀，形成不对称却稳定的构图。相当于28〜35mm的广角感，精准对焦脸部和上半身，背景建筑浅景深虚化。不自然拉伸身体或腿部，仅自然表现低角度特有的张力。

质感・风格：
实写肖像。保留皮肤纹理和细微汗毛，避免过度美肌修饰。细致描绘雪纺面料的纤维、细小褶皱、透射光线以及褶皱的重叠。以蓝天的清爽冷色调与太阳的金色暖色调形成对比，营造出如夏季时尚杂志般的洁净感和成熟氛围。

负面提示：
显得幼稚的面容、不自然的五官、不自然的视线、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手脚融合、关节崩坏、身体比例失调、极端扭曲的广角表现、布料与身体的不自然接触、过度透视、与光源矛盾的阴影、白飞、过多镜头光晕、塑料般的肌肤、文字乱码、标志、水印。

Generate a bright and clean activity visual around any theme object: the screen uses a large area of pure white space as an airy background, making geometric symbols derived from the theme the first subjects to be seen, using multiple flat triangles, corners, or peaked surfaces staggered and interspersed with each other to form a sense of layered progression like mountains; the main surfaces occupy the center and edges of the screen, allowing some forms to be cropped by the screen, while other smaller forms hang above or at the bottom to form an echo, maintaining a strong diagonal reading path. The theme text uses large-scale mixed Chinese and English arrangement, Chinese strokes are thick, square, with a small number of rounded corners or cutouts, English uses wide and flat geometric sans-serif glyphs, text can be cropped by the edges or obscured by graphics, so that characters and graphics compete for space with each other without being completely separated. Colors are derived by theme but maintain three types of roles: large areas of high-brightness pure white background, the main body uses medium-saturation, relatively calm natural colors or the theme's main color, text and fine lines use low-brightness warm gold, earth gold or warm support colors within the theme, and a very small amount of cold-colored fine diagonal lines are used as speed and direction cues; overall brightness is high, saturation is restrained, boundaries are clean, no dirty or old grain. Graphics have a vector poster texture, flat surfaces, very fine strokes or same-colored outlines on the outer edges, a small number of wireframe triangles and slender diagonal lines can be added inside, so that white spaces also have slight movement. prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium fragrance advertising poster for Terre d'Hermès, built around one hyper-real perfume bottle as the absolute hero product, emerging from a sculptural desert-earth environment with an explosive upward arc of sand, dust, and dry soil particles behind and around it. The image must feel refined, elemental, masculine, geological, and mythic, like a world-class luxury fragrance campaign. The product must remain the central visual protagonist. Surround it with an exquisitely controlled environment of sand grains, dry earth, fractured soil, weathered root-like dead wood, and only the faintest residual traces of withered botanical matter, all composed with high-end restraint. The scene must feel both realistic and monumental, as if the perfume has been born from the dry memory of the earth itself. Use elegant English title typography, subtle official-feeling brand logic, minimal support text, and an overall composition with strong impact yet extreme control.

Core composition:
Use a tall vertical composition with the Terre d'Hermès bottle positioned near the lower middle or slightly off-center, partially embedded in the sandy terrain and tilted subtly for dramatic tension. Behind and around the bottle, create a powerful upward sand burst or swirling sand plume, sculpted like a clean natural force frozen in time. The bottle must remain clearly readable and visually dominant, while the sand and dust form a dynamic halo of movement. In the foreground and side areas, place weathered root-like dry wood fragments, dark mineral-rich soil, broken earth, and only the most restrained withered organic traces. The composition must feel elemental, elegant, and intensely premium.

Milk Cloud Orbit + Cream Halo Transit direction:
Push the strongest established qualities further: intensify the hero-bottle dominance, make the sand plume more sculptural and layered, and refine the environmental storytelling so it feels more primal and more geological. Keep the same core bottle-and-sand skeleton, but replace any decorative dryness with more convincing wind-eroded root forms, exposed earth structure, and cleaner material relationships. The sand must feel like the scent itself rising from the land. The result should feel richer, more ancient, and more iconic, while staying controlled and product-led.

Background and spatial scale:
Pull the background further open and make the horizon line much lower, so the bottle and sand burst stand against a larger, emptier, more majestic desert atmosphere. Increase the sense of spatial silence and distance. Let the upper half of the frame breathe with more open sky glow, dry haze, and vast empty air, while the distant landforms remain low, soft, and understated. The expanded negative space must make the fragrance feel more monumental and sacred, like a solitary object in an immense elemental world.

Product realism:
Render the Terre d'Hermès bottle with obsessive realism and luxury material fidelity. Show the iconic bottle shape with crystal-clear glass, warm amber-orange fragrance liquid, precision edges, realistic reflections, subtle dust contact, premium cap finish, and immaculate branding. The bottle should feel heavy, expensive, and tactile, with elegant transparency and warm inner glow. It must remain pristine and heroically presented even while interacting with sand and dust.

Sand and dust behavior:
The sand and dust are major protagonists. Render them with world-class physical realism: fine sand grains, heavier soil particles, airy dust, tiny debris, and soft dry-earth fragments all moving in a beautiful controlled arc around the bottle. The motion should feel sculptural, clean, and luxurious, never chaotic. The sand plume should rise behind the bottle with strong vertical energy, as if desert wind and buried memory are erupting upward. Show different particle scales, subtle depth, realistic gravity behavior, and exquisite sharpness in the most important grains and clumps. The overall feeling must be dry, warm, and elemental.

Environment:
Build an extreme geographic environment with a refined desert-earth identity. Use dry sand, textured soil, scorched mineral ground, broken earth, and elegant weathered dead wood or exposed root-like structures as the core environmental language. Add only the faintest traces of withered flowers or dried plant remains if they help the scent narrative, but keep them nearly fossil-like and extremely sparse. The scene should feel like an abstracted desert landscape reduced to its most poetic materials. No clutter, no extra props, no generic perfume set dressing.

Dry wood and root logic:
Use highly realistic dead wood fragments or weathered root-like pieces around the bottle, as if ancient roots have been exposed by erosion and heat. The forms must feel tactile, cracked, sun-dried, and elegant, not messy. They should add geological age and memory to the scene rather than rustic decoration. Everything should feel restrained, elemental, and intentional.

Lighting:
Use extremely delicate, soft, cinematic desert light. The lighting should feel warm, low-angle, and premium, like late golden-hour sun filtered through dry atmosphere. It must sculpt the bottle edges, inner fragrance liquid, sand grains, dust particles, and root surfaces with exquisite precision. Use warm amber highlights, deep but soft shadow transitions, and subtle haze in the background. The lighting must feel luxurious, natural, and emotionally powerful, never harsh or artificial.

Background:
Keep the background minimal, atmospheric, and geographically suggestive. Use distant blurred desert tones, very low horizon landforms, soft warm sky glow, and controlled haze. The background must support the elemental theme without distracting from the bottle. No busy landscape detail. The feeling should be expansive, minimal, and almost sacred.

Typography and branding:
Add a refined English main title such as “TERRE D’HERMÈS” in a premium editorial fragrance layout, with a very restrained support line beneath if needed. Include subtle official-feeling Hermès branding logic, but keep all text minimal, elegant, and spatially integrated. Typography must feel luxurious, quiet, and perfectly art-directed. No bulky fragrance-ad styling. The text should support the environment and product rather than dominate them.

Mood:
elemental, dry, luxurious, masculine, geological, mythic, warm, sculptural, premium, poetic, collectible, restrained, vast

prompts.text:
为 Terre d'Hermès 创作一张超高级香水广告海报，以一瓶超写实的香水瓶作为绝对的主角产品，它从雕塑般的沙漠土地环境中浮现，背后和周围环绕着向上爆发的沙子、尘土和干燥土壤颗粒。图像必须具有精致、自然、男性化、地质和神话感，如同世界级的奢华香水大片。产品必须保持视觉核心地位。周围环绕着极其精控的沙粒、干土、破碎土壤、风化的根状枯木，以及极其微量的枯萎植物残留痕迹，所有元素都以高端克制的方式构成。场景必须既写实又宏大，仿佛香水诞生于大地自身的干燥记忆。使用优雅的英文标题排版，微妙的官方品牌逻辑，最少的辅助文字，整体构图具有强烈冲击力且极度受控。

核心构图：
采用高竖向构图，Terre d'Hermès 香水瓶位于中下方或略偏离中心，部分嵌入沙地中并略微倾斜以产生戏剧张力。在瓶子背后和周围，创造一个强大的向上沙爆或旋转的沙柱，雕刻得像是一个冻结在时间中的纯净自然力量。瓶子必须保持清晰可辨且在视觉上占主导地位，而沙尘则形成一个动感十足的运动光晕。在前台和侧面区域，放置风化的根状枯木碎片、富含矿物质的深色土壤、碎裂的土地，以及最克制的枯萎有机痕迹。构图必须具备自然元素感、优雅且极度高级。

Milk Cloud Orbit + Cream Halo Transit 方向：
进一步强化已建立的最强特质：加强主角瓶子的主导地位，使沙柱更具雕塑感和层次感，并提炼环境叙事，使其感觉更原始、更具地质感。保持相同的瓶子和沙子核心骨架，但将任何装饰性的干燥替换为更有说服力的风蚀根部形状、裸露的土地结构和更干净的材料关系。沙子必须让人感觉到就像是大地中升起的香气本身。结果应该感觉更丰富、更古老、更具标志性，同时保持受控且以产品为导向。

背景与空间尺度：
进一步拉开背景，将地平线降得更低，使瓶子和沙爆映衬在更大、更空旷、更宏伟的沙漠氛围中。增加空间寂静感和距离感。让画面的上半部分有更多的天空辉光、干燥薄雾和广阔的空灵感，而遥远的地貌保持低平、柔和且含蓄。扩展的负空间必须让香水感觉更宏伟、更神圣，像是一个巨大自然世界中的孤独物体。

产品写实度：
以偏执的写实主义和奢华材质保真度渲染 Terre d'Hermès 瓶子。展示标志性的瓶身形状，晶莹剔透的玻璃，温暖的琥珀橙色香水液体，精准的边缘，真实的反射，微妙的尘埃接触感，高级的瓶盖饰面和完美无瑕的品牌标识。瓶子应该感觉沉重、昂贵且有触感，具有优雅的透明度和温暖的内在光泽。即使在与沙尘互动时，它也必须保持原始状态并以主角姿态呈现。

沙尘行为：
沙子和尘土是主要角色。以世界级的物理真实感渲染它们：细沙粒、较重的土壤颗粒、轻盈的尘土、细小的碎屑和柔软的干土碎片，所有这些都围绕瓶子以优美的受控弧线运动。动作应具有雕塑感、干净且奢华，绝不混乱。沙柱应在瓶子后方以强烈的垂直能量升起，仿佛沙漠的风和埋藏的记忆正在向上喷发。展示不同的粒子比例、微妙的深度、真实的重力行为，以及最重要的颗粒和结块中精致的锐度。整体感觉必须是干燥、温暖和自然元素的。

环境：
构建一个具有精致沙漠土地特征的极端地理环境。使用干沙、有纹理的土壤、烧焦的矿物地面、破碎的土地，以及优雅的风化枯木或裸露的根状结构作为核心环境语言。如果对气味叙事有帮助，可以添加极少量的枯萎花朵或干枯植物遗骸，但要让它们近乎化石化且极其稀疏。场景应该感觉像是一个抽象的沙漠景观，简化为其最富诗意的材料。没有杂乱，没有额外道具，没有平庸的香水布置。

枯木与根部逻辑：
在瓶子周围使用高度写实的枯木碎片或风化的根状碎片，仿佛古老的根部因侵蚀和高温而裸露。形态必须具有触感、开裂、晒干且优雅，不杂乱。它们应该为场景增添地质年代感和记忆感，而不是乡村装饰。一切都应感到克制、原始且有意为之。

光影：
使用极其细腻、柔和、电影感的沙漠光。灯光应感觉温暖、低角度且高级，像经过干燥大气过滤的傍晚黄金时段阳光。它必须以极高的精度塑造瓶子边缘、内部香液、沙粒、尘埃颗粒和根部表面。使用温暖的琥珀色高光，深沉但柔和的阴影过渡，以及背景中的微妙薄雾。灯光必须感觉奢华、自然且富有情感张力，绝不生硬或人造。

背景：
保持背景极简、有氛围感且具地理暗示性。使用遥远的模糊沙漠色调、非常低的地平线地貌、柔和温暖的天空光辉和受控的薄雾。背景必须支持自然元素主题，且不分散对瓶子的注意力。没有繁忙的景观细节。感觉应该是广阔的、极简的，且近乎神圣。

排版与品牌：
添加精美的英文主标题，如“TERRE D’HERMÈS”，采用高级社论香水排版，如果需要，下方配以非常克制的辅助行。加入微妙的、具有官方感的爱马仕品牌逻辑，但保持所有文字极简、优雅且在空间上融合。排版必须感觉奢华、安静且经过完美的艺术指导。不要使用笨重的香水广告样式。文字应支持环境和产品，而不是主导它们。

氛围：
自然元素，干燥，奢华，男性化，地质感，神话感，温暖，雕塑感，高级，诗意，收藏级，克制，广阔

渲染风格：

Below the title, arrange a line of extremely small light gray English or Latin subtitles with significantly widened letter spacing, serving as a quiet horizontal beat. In the middle section of the layout, arrange a horizontal image module band consisting of theme-related detail images, partial scenes, or symbolic visuals, using a contact-sheet-like sequence of narrow rectangles of unequal heights and larger vertical rectangles interleaved, separated by thin white gaps, retaining one double-layered frame with a top-bottom split, making the image band the only relatively dense dark weight of the entire layout; when theme content enters these grids, it must share the same narrative thread and create rhythm through cropping, partial enlargement, and different light and dark fragments, rather than neat stock library thumbnails. prompts.text:

2. a black hand-drawn doodle-shadow version of the same character/person on the wall beside them

Core concept:
The real person and their doodle-shadow are doing a playful mischievous pose together.
The real person performs a cute realistic version of the pose, while the doodle-shadow performs a much more exaggerated, chaotic, cartoonish version of the same pose idea.

Real person:

The real person and the doodle-shadow should share the same general pose idea, but they do not need to match perfectly.
The real person performs a cute realistic version.
The doodle-shadow performs a much more exaggerated, chaotic, cartoonish version.

Do not repeatedly use pointing poses.

The final pose should feel fresh, cute, mischievous, and slightly chaotic.

Background Setting
Classical Chinese garden, evening Golden Hour, pavilions, bridges and flowing water, hazy lake surface, distant mountains, water pavilions, weeping willows, flying eaves and brackets appearing faintly, large area of shallow depth of field, background completely blurred, only soft Bokeh remains, environment quiet and ethereal, strong cinematic atmosphere.

Lighting Setting
The sun is located about 45° behind the character, soft Rim Light wraps around the hair and shoulders, natural golden highlights form at the edges of the hair, soft diffuse fill light is used on the face, no HDR, no overexposure, skin tone is natural and transparent, there is a slight mist in the air, Volumetric Light enhances spatial layers.

Photography Language
Leica SL3, APO-Summicron-SL 90mm F2 ASPH, f/2.0, telephoto compression, ultra-shallow depth of field, real lens breathing sensation, natural background blur, high-end cinematic colors, real skin texture, retaining pores, fine vellus hair, natural skin reflections, no plastic skin, no AI feeling.

Color Style
Traditional elegant Chinese tones, soft low saturation, high-end cinematic color grading, interwoven cyan-gray, light blue, off-white, and warm golden light, the image is clean and pure, full of poetry and a sense of breathing.

Image Quality
Ultra Photorealistic, Cinematic Portrait, Editorial Photography, 8K, HDR, Ultra Detailed, Masterpiece, Professional Color Grading, Natural Skin Texture, Soft Rim Light, Atmospheric Perspective.

prompts.text:
超写实古风人像摄影，电影级视觉，近景特写（Close-up Portrait），人物占据画面约70%～85%，肩部以上构图，轻微侧身，头部自然回望镜头，眼神温柔平静，神情含蓄自然，具有东方古典美感。

古典中式园林，傍晚黄金时刻（Golden Hour），亭台楼阁、小桥流水、朦胧湖面、远山、水榭、垂柳、飞檐斗拱若隐若现，大面积浅景深，背景完全虚化，仅保留柔和光斑（Bokeh），环境安静空灵，电影氛围浓厚。

Delicate features, almond eyes, soft eyebrow shape, slender bridge of the nose, natural coral pink lips, light makeup. items.title: 极致奢华COSTA咖啡九宫格中轴构图海报

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium top-down commercial poster for the COSTA series, built around a perfectly overhead composition featuring nine different coffee states arranged in a compact central-axis clustered formation rather than a standard 3x3 grid. The entire artwork must feel like a world-class international coffee campaign: minimal, luxurious, appetizing, iconic, and extremely art-directed. The composition must be viewed from a perfect bird’s-eye perspective, with all coffee cups and product elements seen directly from above. The background must be extremely minimal, dark, spacious, and velvety, built from deep black, charcoal, and subtle espresso-toned gradients with large areas of elegant negative space. The main visual impact comes from the refined arrangement of nine COSTA coffee states, each with a different latte-art or coffee-surface expression, gathered into a tighter sculptural composition with a strong centerline and premium visual rhythm. Carefully placed roasted coffee beans and restrained product-related brand presence should support the arrangement without clutter. The overall image must feel calmer, more elevated, more collectible, and more design-driven.

Core composition:
Use a strict top-down flat-lay composition with nine circular coffee presentations arranged in a compact central-axis clustered system. Avoid a literal square 3x3 layout. Instead, create a more elegant editorial arrangement where the cups gather around a strong vertical center structure, with subtle asymmetrical balancing on the left and right sides. The cluster should feel intentional, sculptural, and highly designed, like a luxury brand diagram or design annual cover image. Keep the grouping tight enough to feel unified, but leave enough breathing room between cups for each coffee state to remain distinct. Surround the central cluster with generous dark negative space so the arrangement feels premium and not crowded.

Milk Cloud Orbit + Cream Halo Transit direction:
Push the strongest qualities of the concept further: stronger latte-art individuality, stronger sculptural composition, more refined coffee realism, and a more elevated relationship between product, coffee beans, and negative space. Keep the nine-state overhead system intact, but refine the visual language so not every cup relies on the same white-latte-art formula. Replace part of the repetition with more nuanced coffee-surface states: a few cups should feature exquisite latte art, while others show luxurious crema patterns, milk-cloud bloom transitions, or subtle semi-fluid coffee states. The result should feel richer, more intelligent, and more premium. The composition should feel like one brand universe with varied internal moods rather than nine similar cups repeated.

Nine coffee states:
Show nine different COSTA coffee expressions, all viewed directly from above. The states should include a refined mix such as:
1. perfect heart latte art,
2. layered tulip latte art,
3. fine rosetta feather,
4. swan-like or leaf-halo pour,
5. bold central leaf,
6. dense espresso crema surface with subtle tonal pattern,
7. milk-cloud bloom state with soft diffusion,
8. partially disrupted latte art with elegant fluid transition,
9. dark coffee surface with minimal crema glow.
Each coffee state must be individually beautiful, highly legible, and physically believable. The milk foam, crema, and coffee tones must all differ enough to create luxury variety while remaining unmistakably part of one cohesive COSTA series.

Cup and product presence:
The COSTA series must remain product-led even in an overhead composition. The cups should feel like official COSTA vessels with premium material realism, elegant brand-correct color logic, refined rim detail, subtle surface texture, and restrained visibility of the brand identity. Allow minimal but clear COSTA product presence through cup design, selective exterior glimpses, or subtle integrated packaging logic near the cluster if needed. The products must feel premium, real, and unmistakably part of the COSTA series, but never overcrowd the composition.

Coffee bean logic:
Use fewer coffee beans, but place them with far greater precision. The beans should no longer act as filler or blanket decoration. Instead, they should function like deliberate visual punctuation marks that guide the eye through the clustered composition. Place a few small bean clusters at key junctions between cups, near transitions in the central axis, or in selected gaps where extra tactile richness is needed. Every bean must feel glossy, rich, sharp, and photography-grade, with visible cracks, natural oil sheen, and varied roast tones. The beans should enhance rhythm, tension, and elegance, not density.

Background and negative space:
Make the background more open, more minimal, and more luxurious. The dark background should feel deep, velvety, and spacious, with subtle premium gradient falloff and almost no distractions. Increase the amount of empty space around the clustered cups so the central formation feels iconic and gallery-like. The surrounding darkness should behave like silence in a luxury campaign, giving the coffee tones, latte art, and bean accents more authority. No table clutter, no unnecessary props, no excessive decorative elements.

Coffee and latte realism:
Render the coffee, crema, milk foam, and latte-art structures with obsessive realism. Every cup must show extremely clean fluid behavior, refined foam texture, realistic surface tension, subtle bubble detail, smooth tonal transitions, and perfect latte-art line precision. The milk shapes should feel hand-poured yet idealized, elegant but believable, with clean edges and natural feathering. The espresso and crema states should look warm, dense, silky, and physically correct. The milk-cloud and semi-fluid states should feel especially premium, soft, and controlled, never messy.

Lighting:
Use extremely delicate, soft, luxurious commercial lighting from above, with subtle highlight control and premium shadow falloff. The light should reveal the cup rims, the crema silkiness, the milk foam softness, and the gloss of the few carefully placed coffee beans. The lighting must feel calm, expensive, and refined, never harsh, never overexposed. The overall illumination should support the central cluster while preserving the richness of the dark negative space.

Typography and layout:
Add elegant English-only typography in a restrained premium editorial-commercial layout. Include a refined English main title related to COSTA, a small tasteful support line, and minimal official-feeling logo placement. The typography should be integrated into the empty surrounding background space, never competing with the coffee arrangement. Keep it sparse, modern, and luxurious.

Color direction:
Use a sophisticated palette of deep black, charcoal, espresso brown, roasted coffee brown, crema gold, warm milk white, soft caramel, and subtle burgundy accents consistent with COSTA brand identity. Keep the image rich but controlled, warm but elevated, and visually luxurious without becoming noisy or overcrowded.

luxurious, appetizing, iconic, precise, premium, editorial, tactile, calm, coffee-driven, modern, elegant, sculptural, high-end, collectible
