prompts.text:
为 COSTA 系列创作一张超高端自上而下的商业海报，围绕完美的俯视构图构建，其特点是九种不同的咖啡状态以紧凑的中轴集群形式排列，而不是标准的 3x3 网格。整个艺术作品必须感觉像是一场世界级的国际咖啡宣传活动：极简、奢华、诱人、标志性且极具艺术指导力。构图必须从完美的鸟瞰视角观察，所有咖啡杯和产品元素都直接从上方看到。背景必须极其简约、深色、宽敞且具有天鹅绒感，由深黑色、木炭色和微妙的浓缩咖啡色调渐变构成，并带有大面积优雅的负空间。主要的视觉冲击力来自九种 COSTA 咖啡状态的精致排列，每种都有不同的拉花艺术或咖啡表面表现，聚集在具有强大中心线和高端视觉节奏的紧凑雕塑式构图中。精心放置的烘焙咖啡豆和克制的产品相关品牌存在感应在不造成混乱的情况下支持这种安排。整体形象必须感觉更沉静、更高级、更具收藏价值且更具设计驱动力。

核心构图：
使用严格的自上而下的平铺构图，九种圆形的咖啡呈现方式排列在一个紧凑的中轴集群系统中。避免使用刻板的正方形 3x3 布局。相反，创造一种更优雅的编辑式安排，杯子围绕一个强大的垂直中心结构聚集，并在左右两侧进行微妙的不对称平衡。集群应具有意图感、雕塑感和高度的设计感，就像奢侈品牌的图表或设计年鉴封面图片。保持分组足够紧凑以感到统一，但在杯子之间留出足够的呼吸空间，让每种咖啡状态保持清晰。在中央集群周围环绕大量的深色负空间，使布局显得高端而不拥挤。

奶云轨道 + 奶油晕转变方向：
进一步推动概念的最强特质：更强的拉花艺术个性、更强的雕塑化构图、更精细的咖啡写实度，以及产品、咖啡豆和负空间之间更高级的关系。保持九态俯视系统完整，但细化视觉语言，使并非每个杯子都依赖相同的白色拉花公式。用更细微的咖啡表面状态取代部分重复：一些杯子应具有精美的拉花艺术，而另一些则展示奢华的油脂图案、奶云绽放过渡或微妙的半流体咖啡状态。结果应该感觉更丰富、更智能、更高端。构图应该感觉像一个具有多样内部情绪的品牌宇宙，而不是九个重复的相似杯子。

九种咖啡状态：
展示九种不同的 COSTA 咖啡表达，全部直接从上方观察。这些状态应包括精致的组合，例如：
1. 完美的心形拉花，
2. 分层的郁金香拉花，
3. 精细的罗塞塔羽毛，
4. 天鹅状或叶晕倾倒，
5. 粗犷的中央叶片，
6. 具有微妙色调图案的浓密浓缩咖啡油脂表面，
7. 具有柔和扩散效果的奶云绽放状态，
8. 具有优雅流体过渡的部分破碎拉花艺术，
9. 具有极小油脂光泽的深色咖啡表面。
每种咖啡状态都必须单独美观、高度清晰且物理上可信。奶泡、油脂和咖啡色调必须有足够的差异以创造奢侈的多样性，同时保持作为统一 COSTA 系列一部分的明确特征。

杯子和产品存在感：
即使在俯视构图中，COSTA 系列也必须保持以产品为主导。杯子应感觉像官方的 COSTA 容器，具有高端材料真实感、优雅且品牌正确的色彩逻辑、精致的杯缘细节、微妙的表面纹理以及克制的品牌标识可见度。如果需要，可以通过杯子设计、选择性的外部一瞥或集群附近微妙的集成包装逻辑，允许微小但清晰的 COSTA 产品存在。产品必须感觉高端、真实且明确属于 COSTA 系列，但绝不能使构图过于拥挤。

咖啡豆逻辑：
使用更少的咖啡豆，但放置得更加精准。咖啡豆不再起填充物或地毯式装饰的作用。相反，它们的功能应该像精心设计的视觉标点符号，引导视线穿过集群构图。在杯子之间的关键交汇处、中轴线的过渡处或选定的需要额外触感丰富的间隙处放置一些小的咖啡豆簇。每颗咖啡豆都必须感觉亮泽、浓郁、锐利且达到摄影级水平，具有可见的裂纹、天然油光和多样的烘焙色调。咖啡豆应增强节奏感、张力和优雅感，而不是密度感。

背景 and 负空间：
让背景更加开放、简约和奢华。深色背景应感觉深邃、如天鹅绒般且宽敞，具有微妙的高端渐变衰减，几乎没有干扰。增加集群杯子周围的空白空间，使中央结构感觉具有标志性和画廊感。周围的黑暗应表现得像奢华宣传活动中的沉默，赋予咖啡色调、拉花艺术和咖啡豆点缀更多权威感。没有杂乱的桌面，没有不必要的道具，没有过度的装饰元素。

咖啡和拉花真实感：
以痴迷般的真实感渲染咖啡、油脂、奶泡和拉花结构。每个杯子都必须展示极其干净的流体行为、精细的泡沫纹理、真实的表面张力、微妙的气泡细节、平滑的色调过渡和完美的拉花线条精度。牛奶形状应感觉像是手工倾倒但又理想化了的，优雅但可信，具有干净的边缘和自然的羽化感。浓缩咖啡和油脂状态应看起来温暖、浓密、丝滑且物理正确。奶云和半流体状态应感觉特别高端、柔软且受控，绝不凌乱。

照明：
使用极其细腻、柔和、奢华的商业上方照明，具有微妙的高光控制和高端阴影衰减。光线应展现杯缘、油脂的丝滑感、奶泡的柔软感以及几颗精心放置的咖啡豆的光泽。灯光必须感觉沉静、昂贵且精致，绝不刺眼，绝不过曝。整体照明应支持中央集群，同时保持深色负空间的丰富感。

排版和布局：
在克制的高端编辑商业布局中添加优雅的纯英文排版。包括一个与 COSTA 相关的精致英文主标题、一小行高雅的辅助文字以及极简的官方感 logo 放置。排版应融入周围空白的背景空间中，绝不与咖啡布置竞争。保持稀疏、现代且奢华。

色彩方向：
使用由深黑色、木炭色、浓缩咖啡棕、烘焙咖啡棕、油脂金、暖奶白、柔和焦糖色以及与 COSTA 品牌标识一致的微妙勃艮第红组成的精致调色板。保持图像丰富但受控，温暖但高级，视觉上奢华而不显得嘈杂或拥挤。

氛围：
奢华、诱人、标志性、精确、高端、编辑感、触感、沉静、咖啡驱动、现代、优雅、雕塑感、高档、收藏级

渲染风格：
超高端 COSTA 咖啡宣传活动、完美的自上而下平铺构图、九种不同的咖啡状态、紧凑的中轴集群排列、简约的深色奢华背景、更少但高度精准的咖啡豆点缀、超写实拉花艺术和油脂细节、微妙的官方品牌、精致的英文排版、柔和的电影级商业照明、世界级食品广告美学、8k、收藏级图像质量

负向提示：
标准的 3x3 网格、凌乱的平铺、随机的杯子放置、杂乱的桌面道具、太多的咖啡豆、低细节拉花艺术、浑浊的泡沫、通用的咖啡杯、看起来像塑料的材料、廉价的排版、嘈杂的背景、过饱和的颜色、散落的填充豆、溢出的液体杂乱、品牌感弱、低分辨率表面、业余咖啡馆海报风格

prompts.text:
Use the uploaded character reference image as the strict identity and outfit reference.

Preserve the reference character’s:
- face identity
- facial proportions
- eye shape
- nose
- lips
- skin tone
- hairstyle
- hair color
- visible hair accessories
- overall recognizable vibe
- outfit and styling shown in the reference image

Do not hardcode any specific character traits that are not present in the uploaded reference.
All identity, hairstyle, accessories, and clothing details must be inferred directly from the uploaded reference image.

Create a high-quality mixed-style vertical portrait showing:
1. a realistic full-body version of the uploaded character/person
2. a black hand-drawn doodle-shadow version of the same character/person on the wall beside them

Core concept:
The real person and their doodle-shadow are doing a playful mischievous pose together.
The real person performs a cute realistic version of the pose, while the doodle-shadow performs a much more exaggerated, chaotic, cartoonish version of the same pose idea.
The mood should feel cute, playful, mischievous, stylish, funny, and social-media-friendly.

Real person:
- Must remain realistic and photogenic
- Must wear the same outfit style and key visible details from the uploaded reference image
- Do not replace the reference styling with unrelated fashion
- Expression should be cute, slightly confused, mildly embarrassed, playful, as if thinking: “Why am I doing this with my shadow?”
- The real person should not stand stiffly
- The real person should actively participate in the pose, but in a natural realistic way

Doodle-shadow:
- Must be a black hand-drawn sketch version of the same person, drawn directly on the wall
- Not a realistic second person
- Not a normal physical shadow
- Not a full-color anime character
- Black sketch line-art only
- Should resemble the person through hairstyle silhouette, accessories, outfit silhouette, and pose structure
- The doodle-shadow should look more energetic, sillier, and more chaotic than the real person
- Add manga-like motion lines, hearts, stars, sparkles, and comic marks around the doodle if helpful

Random mischievous pose rule:
The pose must NOT be fixed.

For each generation, invent a new playful mischievous pose for both the real person and the doodle-shadow.
The real person and the doodle-shadow should share the same general pose idea, but they do not need to match perfectly.
The real person performs a cute realistic version.
The doodle-shadow performs a much more exaggerated, chaotic, cartoonish version.

Do not repeatedly use pointing poses.
Do not repeatedly use finger-gun poses.
Do not repeatedly use the same standing pose.
Do not always make both figures simply point at each other.

Create a different mischievous pose each time.

Possible pose directions are loose inspiration only, not a fixed menu:
- playful idol pose
- silly dance pose
- leaning sideways with one arm curved overhead
- making a big heart pose
- cheeky wink pose
- hands near cheeks in a cute teasing pose
- exaggerated “ta-da!” pose
- mock surprise pose
- playful running-in-place pose
- mischievous tiptoe pose
- arms stretched in opposite directions
- pretending to sneak away
- cute troublemaker pose
- dramatic overreaction pose
- goofy victory pose
- playful balance pose
- playful peekaboo pose
- shy but mischievous pose
- cute overconfident pose

The final pose should feel fresh, cute, mischievous, and slightly chaotic.
The real person should look like they are reluctantly playing along.
The doodle-shadow should look like it is having way too much fun.

Composition:
- vertical 4:5 or 9:16
- show the real person in full-body or nearly full-body framing
- place the real person on one side of the frame
- place the black doodle-shadow on a clean wall beside them
- the doodle-shadow should be roughly the same height or slightly taller
- keep enough space around both figures so the full pose is visible

prompts.text:
使用上传的角色参考图作为严格的身份和服装参考。

保留参考角色的：
- 面部身份
- 面部比例
- 眼睛形状
- 鼻子
- 嘴唇
- 肤色
- 发型
- 发色
- 可见的发饰
- 整体可辨识的氛围
- 参考图中显示的服装和造型

不要硬编码上传的参考图中不存在的任何特定角色特征。所有身份、发型、配饰和服装细节必须直接从上传的参考图中推断。

创建一个高质量的混合风格垂直肖像，显示：
1. 上传角色/人物的真实全身版本
2. 同一个角色/人物在旁边墙上的黑色手绘涂鸦阴影版本

核心概念：
真人及其涂鸦阴影一起做一个顽皮搞怪的姿势。真人表演该姿势的可爱写实版本，而涂鸦阴影则表演同一个姿势构思的更加夸张、混乱、卡通的版本。情绪应该是可爱、俏皮、顽皮、时尚、有趣且适合社交媒体的。

真人：
- 必须保持写实且上镜
- 必须穿着与上传的参考图相同的服装风格和关键可见细节
- 不要用无关的时尚取代参考造型
- 表情应该是可爱的、略显困惑的、轻微尴尬的、俏皮的，仿佛在想：“为什么我要和我的影子做这个？”
- 真人不应僵硬地站着
- 真人应积极参与姿势，但以一种自然写实的方式

涂鸦阴影：
- 必须是同一个人的黑色手绘草图版本，直接画在墙上
- 不是真实的第二个人
- 不是正常的物理阴影
- 不是全彩动漫角色
- 仅限黑色素描线条艺术
- 应通过发型轮廓、配饰、服装轮廓和姿势结构与该人物相似
- 涂鸦阴影应比真人看起来更有活力、更愚蠢、更混乱
- 如果有帮助，可以在涂鸦周围添加漫画风格的动态线、心形、星星、闪烁和漫画标记

随机顽皮姿势规则：
姿势不得固定。每次生成时，为真人和涂鸦阴影发明一个新的顽皮搞怪姿势。真人和涂鸦阴影应共享相同的总体姿势构思，但不需要完美匹配。真人表演可爱写实版本。涂鸦阴影表演更加夸张、混乱、卡通的版本。

不要重复使用指向姿势。不要重复使用手指枪姿势。不要重复使用相同的站立姿势。不要总是让两个形象只是互相指着。每次都创建一个不同的顽皮姿势。

可能的姿势方向仅作为宽松的灵感，而非固定菜单：
- 俏皮的偶像姿势
- 愚蠢的舞蹈姿势
- 身体侧歪，一只手臂弯曲在头顶
- 做一个大大的爱心姿势
- 调皮的眨眼姿势
- 双手放在脸颊旁做可爱的嘲弄姿势
- 夸张的“哒哒！”姿势
- 模拟惊讶的姿势
- 俏皮的原地奔跑姿势
- 顽皮的踮脚姿势
- 双臂向相反方向拉伸
- 假装溜走
- 可爱的小捣蛋鬼姿势
- 戏剧性的过度反应姿势
- 笨拙的胜利姿势
- 俏皮的平衡姿势
- 俏皮的躲猫猫姿势
- 害羞但顽皮的姿势
- 可爱的过度自信姿势

最终的姿势应该感觉新鲜、可爱、顽皮且略显混乱。真人应该看起来像是勉强配合。涂鸦阴影应该看起来像是玩得太开心了。

构图：
- 垂直 4:5 或 9:16
- 以全身或近全身画幅展示真人
- 将真人放置在画面的一侧
- 将黑色涂鸦阴影放置在他们旁边的干净墙壁上
- 涂鸦阴影应与真人高度大致相同或略高
- 在两个形象周围留出足够的空间，以便看到完整的姿势

items.title: 旅途窗口叙事海报设计指南

prompts.text:
Please generate a "Journey Window Narrative Poster".

【Replaceable Content】
Transportation: 【Airplane / Train / Car / Ferry / Bus】
Window Scene: 【Sea of clouds sunrise / Desert canyon / Rainy night city / Midnight port】
Theme/Emotion: 【Departure / Exploration / Night return / Farewell】
Main Title: 【Fill in English title】
Supporting Phrase: 【Fill in a short copywriting sentence】
Main Color Tone: 【Cool gray-blue / Warm golden-orange / Rainy night blue-red / Deep sea blue-gold】
Aspect Ratio: 9:16

Adopt a real passenger perspective, looking diagonally out the window from the side of the seat; the window should not face the camera directly, nor should it be perfectly centered. Window frames, seats, armrests, or table corners naturally enter the frame, forming realistic spatial occlusion and a sense of subjective observation.

The interior of the vehicle remains dim, while the scenery outside the window is bright, creating a clear contrast between the dark interior and the bright exterior. The glass features slight reflections, water vapor, raindrops, scratches, or carriage light reflections, making the image look like a moment accidentally captured during a journey.

Strengthen the state of movement: Trees, shrubs, utility poles, road signs, lights, or water surfaces near the window show obvious directional motion blur, while distant mountains, cities, clouds, or lighthouses are relatively clear, forming a layer of "speed in the foreground, story in the background".

Overall use cinematic travel photography, retro magazine editorial style, natural film grain, realistic depth of field, and slight vignetting. The image should have emotion, speed, and a sense of journey; do not make it look like a static landscape photo or a neat travel advertisement template.

Text must become part of the image:
- Choose high-contrast serif, narrow-long, or handwritten fonts based on the theme
- The main title can partially enter window frames, shadows, raindrops, or glass reflections
- Allow slight ghosting, atomization, reflection, wear, or water surface extension effects for the text
- Text should have a sense of design but remain restrained, avoiding exaggerated 3D, metallic, or flashy special effects
- Small text uniformly uses simple narrow sans-serif fonts
- Retain a small amount of editorial elements, such as ROUTE JOURNAL, ISSUE numbers, coordinates, thin lines, or location tags

The image composition does not need to be absolutely neat; allow natural tilting, partial cropping, and asymmetrical white space. Realistic photography texture, high-end, immersive, with a sense of cinematic narrative; avoid frontal windows, complete symmetrical window frames, static scenery, over-sharpening, over-saturation, templated layout, and text stacking.

prompts.text:
请生成一张「旅途窗口叙事海报」。

【可替换内容】
交通工具：【飞机 / 火车 / 汽车 / 轮渡 / 巴士】
窗外场景：【云海日出 / 荒漠峡谷 / 雨夜城市 / 午夜港口】
主题情绪：【启程 / 探索 / 夜归 / 告别】
主标题：【填写英文标题】
辅助短句：【填写一句简短文案】
主色调：【冷灰蓝 / 暖金橙 / 雨夜蓝红 / 深海蓝金】
画面比例：9:16

采用真实乘客视角，从座位一侧斜着看向窗外，窗口不要正对镜头，也不要完整居中。窗框、座椅、扶手或桌角自然进入画面，形成真实的空间遮挡和主观观察感。

交通工具内部保持昏暗，窗外景色明亮，形成明显的内暗外亮关系。玻璃带有轻微反光、水汽、雨滴、划痕或车厢灯光倒影，让画面像旅途中偶然看到的一瞬间。

强化移动状态：靠近窗口的树木、灌木、电线杆、路牌、灯光或水面出现明显的方向性动态模糊，远处山体、城市、云层或灯塔相对清晰，形成“近景有速度、远景有故事”的层次。

整体使用电影感旅行摄影、复古杂志编辑风、自然胶片颗粒、真实景深和轻微暗角。画面具有情绪、速度和旅途感，不要像静态风景照，也不要像规整的旅游广告模板。

文字必须成为画面的一部分：
- 根据主题选择高对比衬线体、窄长字体或手写字体
- 主标题可以局部进入窗框、阴影、雨滴或玻璃反射
- 允许轻微拖影、雾化、反光、磨损或水面延伸字效
- 文字要有设计感，但保持克制，不使用夸张3D、金属或炫技特效
- 小字统一使用简洁窄体无衬线字体
- 保留少量编辑元素，如 ROUTE JOURNAL、ISSUE 编号、坐标、细线或地点标签

画面构图不必绝对工整，允许自然倾斜、局部裁切和不对称留白。真实摄影质感，高级、沉浸、有电影叙事感，避免正面窗口、完整对称窗框、静止景色、过度锐化、过饱和、模板化排版和文字堆积。

prompts.text: Generate a clear, solar-term-style poster screen based on any theme object. Transform the most recognizable textures, facets, or symbolic contours of the theme into a group of foreground peaks and distant minor peaks, like edible or touchable mountains rising from the frosted mist below. The largest peak in the foreground is close to the bottom with its roots obscured by soft mist; several peaks in the middle ground are staggered in height; the distant peaks shrink and their edges are diluted by air, forming a quiet reading path from the bottom upwards and then returning to the central text. The upper half retains a large area of clean white space, and the background is a high-brightness, low-saturation warm color field derived from the theme, with a very light cool-colored water vapor transition. The overall look is bright, clean, with few shadows. Color roles are re-mapped according to the theme: the background occupies the largest area, while the theme peaks use fuller main colors and moist grainy textures. A small amount of dark details serve only as focal embellishments to avoid darkening the screen. The surface of the peaks retains tiny textures of real materials, translucent moisture, soft facets, and local highlights. The bottom blends with milk-white mist and shallow cool-colored water surfaces, without hard-cut boundaries. One or two translucent white smoke ribbons wrap around the peaks and the text axis, with lines showing slight glowing, thickness variations, and dissipation breakpoints, turning the physical mountain scenery into a dreamland like heat, water vapor, or fragrance. The text system is center-aligned and floating: the top features a small date or serial number placed in a thin rounded-corner capsule; the middle is the large Chinese theme name, with characters having a slender vertical posture, slight Song-style turns, and soft pinkish ink feel; below is loose-tracked small-sized Pinyin or English. Then, place a column of extremely fine vertical short sentences slightly below the center axis of the screen, with a color derived from the title but lighter. Tiny silhouettes of theme-related traffic, people, or objects can be added at the bottom edge as scale anchors; they must be light, distant, and low-contrast, so as not to grab the dominant relationship of the peaks and white space. Aspect ratio 3:4. A photo of a woman sitting on a black leather chair in a bright interior, taken from above. An adult woman with calm allure and inner resilience. Bright ivory-beige natural skin, with moderate flush and highlights added to the cheeks and tip of the nose. A small amount of blank space is left near the top of the head, and the curves of the chair surround the figure on the left and right. Knees bent, flowing the legs from the back to the foreground, with one leg lightly overlapping the other. The waist remains sideways, the upper body is slightly raised, and the character supports her weight with her right hand on the towel. The left arm is close to the side of the body. The contact and center of gravity of the fingertips, elbows, knees, and ankles are natural and smooth, with subtle wrinkles on the towel formed by the pressure of the hands and feet.

Background · Lighting:
The foreground features bare feet with sand grains and a finely woven towel. The middle ground is a bright sandy beach with white waves, and the background is transparent azure sea water, with a lush small cape and white-walled buildings in the back left of the frame. The sky is a clear water blue with few clouds. Warm morning sunlight shines diagonally from the upper right of the frame, with soft highlights on the contours of the shoulders, arms, waist, and legs. Shadows fall toward the bottom left, and the sand and towel reflect dim light, supplementing the skin's shadow image. Fine light reflections are scattered on the sea surface.

Composition · Lens:
9:16 vertical composition. A close-up low-angle shot capturing the full body of the character. The lens is shot from a low position near the edge of the towel, the feet in front are slightly larger, and the face is placed in the upper third of the frame. The character occupies about two-thirds of the frame, with a wide blue sky blank space at the top. Natural compression similar to an 85mm portrait lens. Focus on the pupils and face, with the coastline and cape softly blurred.

Texture · Style:
High-precision photographic expression. Skin is not excessively homogenized, retaining subtle skin texture, sand grains, fine hairs, and natural luster. Hair strands are clear one by one, dry and un-wetted hair bundles, towel fibers, sand grains, and wave reflections are all meticulously depicted. Contrast warm skin tones with the vivid blue sea to create a bright and transparent resort portrait. Natural tones, shallow depth of field, moderate film grain.

Negative Prompt:
Underage-looking characters, unnatural facial features, unnatural gaze, excessive body distortion, extra limbs, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, confused left and right legs, floating body, poor contact with the towel, wrong perspective, shadows inconsistent with the light source, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, text, logos, watermarks.

prompts.text:
主题：
沙滩上缓缓流淌的时间

主体：
在晴朗海滨沙滩上铺开的淡象牙白毛巾上，一位女性弯曲双腿侧身而坐。人物占据画面中央偏右的大片区域，从脚部延伸至面部的纵向构图富有纵深感。身体面向海侧，仅上半身和脸部回望镜头。

人物·表情：
带有自然血色的明亮米色肌肤。长长的深棕色头发保留了薄薄的刘海和脸部周边的碎发，海风轻拂发梢微微摇曳。眼部化淡雅棕色妆容，脸颊带浅珊瑚粉，唇色为透亮粉米色。下巴微微收回，以平静而沉稳的目光注视镜头，嘴唇轻启，呈现自然的表情。

服装·姿势：
光泽低调的沙米色简约比基尼。细肩带和腰间的小结以自然方式呈现。双膝弯曲，将双腿从后方流向画面前景，一腿轻叠于另一腿上。腰部保持侧向，上半身略微抬起，人物以右手撑于毛巾支撑体重。左臂贴近身体侧边。指尖、肘部、膝盖、脚踝的接触与重心自然流畅，毛巾上带有手脚压力形成的细微褶皱。

背景·光线：
前景为沾有沙粒的素足与织纹细致的毛巾。中景为明亮的沙滩与白色浪花，后景为透明的湛蓝海水，画面左后方有树木茂密的小海角与白墙建筑。天空是少云的澄澈水蓝。温暖的午前阳光从画面右上方斜射，肩部、手臂、腰部、腿部的轮廓带有柔和的高光。阴影向左下方落下，沙子和毛巾反射出淡光，补充肌肤的阴影像。海面散布细碎的光反射。

构图·镜头：
9:16的纵向构图。收录人物全身的近距离低角度摄影。镜头从靠近毛巾边缘的低位拍摄，前方的脚部略显较大，脸部置于画面上部三分之一处。人物占据画面的约三分之二，上部留有广阔的蓝天空白。接近85mm人像镜头的自然压缩感。对焦于瞳孔和脸部，海岸线与海角柔和虚化。

质感·风格：
高精度的摄影表现。肌肤不过度均匀化，保留细微的皮肤纹理、沙粒、汗毛、自然光泽。发丝一根根清晰，干燥未湿的发束，毛巾纤维、沙粒、浪花反射皆细致描绘。以温暖肤色与鲜艳蓝海对比，营造明亮透明的度假人像。自然色调、浅景深、适度胶片颗粒。

Only reference the character's appearance, do not inherit the dessert shop background, yellow chair, ice cream, clothing, action and composition from the uploaded image, completely reconstruct an ordinary family living room. A young adult Asian woman, slim and natural figure, wearing a light beige sleeveless knitted home maxi dress, sitting comfortably sideways on an ordinary fabric sofa, with a thin blanket casually covering her legs. She is holding potato chips in one hand, with the other hand next to the remote control, originally watching TV. A friend suddenly calls her from the other end of the sofa, she turns her head toward the camera, her expression first a bit stunned, with food still in her mouth, then showing a very light, natural smile. The living room is ordinary and slightly cluttered, not a luxury showroom. There are throw pillows and a thin blanket on the sofa, and snack bags, a water cup, tissues, charging cables and a remote control on the coffee table. The TV is on in the background, but the screen content is blurry and unrecognizable. The cool light from the TV illuminates the character's face and shoulders, with only a dim warm floor lamp nearby, forming a realistic uneven cool and warm mixed light. Obvious mobile phone noise is retained in the dark parts of the room. Using an ordinary mobile phone rear lens, 26mm wide angle, shot from a lower position on the other side of the sofa, medium shot. The composition is slightly tilted, the character's posture is relaxed and natural, without intentionally showing off the figure. Retain real skin texture, slight pores, a few blemishes, natural oiliness and messy stray hairs, unedited, like a life photo taken casually by a friend at night. prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 editorial typography poster built around one human-centered moment.

Use oversized, cropped letters as the main composition structure. Embed the environment inside the letterforms, while the person, body movement, or a foreground object breaks through the letters with strong perspective. The typography should shape the image, not simply sit on top of it.

Scene: [roller skating / swimming / cycling / coffee break]
Subject: [young Asian woman / Western man / Asian man / Western woman]
Title: [custom two-word title]
Series: HUMAN FRAGMENTS
Year: 2026

4 directions:

1. ROLL SIGNAL — a roller skater gliding past the camera, one skate enlarged in the foreground, body and urban scene passing through giant letters.

2. BLUE CURRENT — a swimmer moving through turquoise water, one arm reaching toward the camera, water and splashes filling and breaking beyond the typography.

3. CITY LOOP — a cyclist turning through a city street, the front wheel enlarged by perspective and visually connected with circular letterforms.

4. BREW PAUSE — a quiet café moment, with the hand and coffee cup closer to the camera while the person and window scene are woven into oversized type.

Use realistic photography, natural skin and fabric, believable water and motion, subtle paper grain, strong negative space, and a restrained color palette.

prompts.text:
Subject:
Pale pink of lotus shadow

Main Subject:
In a serene lotus pond surrounded by wooden platforms, a woman dressed in pale pink clothing kneels in shallow water, looking up at the camera. The figure occupies the center-left to the lower half of the frame, surrounded by huge lotus leaves and multiple peach-colored flowers.

Person · Expression:
An adult woman with a calm sense of maturity and natural curves. Wet black hair is loosely tied up, retaining thin forehead bangs and hair strands fitting the cheeks, with a small peach-colored floral ornament on one side. The head is tilted slightly to the right, the face is raised upwards, while casting a serene gaze toward the camera. Lips are slightly parted, presenting natural luster of light rose makeup and wet skin.

Clothing · Pose:
A wet draped dress layered with pale cherry blossom tulle. The chest and waist are lined with undergarments of the same color system, elegantly covering while maintaining a sense of transparency. An off-the-shoulder style with the right shoulder naturally drooping, the figure's right hand lightly pinches the fabric in front of the chest, and the left arm is placed on the wooden frame at the left end of the frame. The waist is twisted towards the back right, both knees touch the bottom of the water, and the right leg extends diagonally towards the bottom right of the frame. Wet fabric clings to the body and legs, forming subtle folds and water droplets.

Background · Lighting:
The foreground features huge wet lotus leaves and blooming peach-colored lotuses, the mid-ground contains the person and the water surface, and the background is configured with dark brown wooden platforms and pillars. Reflections of lotus leaves, buds, flowers, and the sky float on the water surface, with faint ripples spreading out. Soft natural light seeps in from the upper left of the frame, forming elegant highlights on the face, shoulders, collarbones, and wet fabric. Shadows fall towards the bottom right, and the water surface reflects cold green light, gently illuminating the underside of the skin.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 3:4 ratio, a mid-full shot looking down from a slightly high position. A diagonal composition with the character's face towards the upper left and the waist and legs flowing towards the lower right. Negative space of the wooden platform is reserved on the upper right, and lotus leaves are extensively placed at the bottom and sides to create a sense of depth. Equivalent to a 50mm focal length, the focus is concentrated on the face and upper body, with the background water surface and platform slightly blurred.

Texture · Style:
Realistic fashion photography. Meticulously depicts natural skin texture, the clumped feeling of wet hair strands, the transparency and luster of tulle, and the delicate reflections of water droplets. A calm color scheme dominated by cherry pink, deep green, and ink black. Avoid excessive skin retouching, presenting a refined texture like a magazine photo taken in a quiet garden.

Negative Prompt:
Characters that look like minors, unnatural facial features, asymmetrical eyes, extra fingers, missing fingers, fusion of hands and feet, broken joints, poor fabric contact, floating, unnatural water level, shadows inconsistent with light source, collapsed lotus leaf shapes, text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin.

9:16 竖版，写实自然生活摄影，真实户外人像摄影，手机原相机与自然人像镜头结合的真实质感，清晨河边步道，阳光明亮但不过曝，画面自然、清透、松弛，有轻微生活抓拍感。

一位 22–26 岁的年轻成年东方女性，明确成年，原创人物，拥有柔和古典鹅蛋脸，面部轮廓流畅自然，骨相精致但不过度锐利，五官比例协调，温柔杏眼，眼神清澈有真实聚焦感，视线轻微偏向镜头旁边，嘴角带放松克制的浅笑，整体气质安静、温柔、松弛，同时具有自然健康的生命力。

人物轻微侧身站在河边步道旁，肩部自然转向一侧，头部轻轻转回，脸部完整清晰入镜。长黑发自然披散，被河边微风轻轻吹动，少量发丝掠过额头、脸颊与肩颈，但不遮挡眼睛与主要五官。肩颈自然舒展，锁骨清晰但不过度突出，下颌、脖颈、肩部与锁骨连接真实自然。

人物穿简洁的浅米白色细肩带针织上衣，服装贴合但自然，质感轻薄清爽，符合夏日河边散步的生活场景，不过度华丽，不抢人物五官。

皮肤为中度真实质感，保留脸颊和鼻翼附近细微毛孔、少量细小绒毛、局部肤色变化、轻微自然泛红、鼻尖与脸颊真实皮脂高光、眼下轻微纹理、唇部自然唇纹。皮肤整体健康细腻，但不是磨皮后的陶瓷肌，面部与脖颈存在轻微自然色差。眼睛具有真实湿润感，虹膜纹理自然可见，眼神光来自清晨侧前方阳光，反光方向与环境光一致，不是发光瞳孔。

清晨斜侧光从人物侧前方照射，阳光自然落在额头、鼻梁、脸颊、嘴唇、下颌、肩颈与锁骨上，形成柔和真实的明暗层次。发丝边缘带轻微暖金色轮廓光，皮肤高光克制，不出现油腻反光。背景为安静的河面、沿河护栏、树木与延伸向远处的步道，河面位于画面一侧，林荫步道位于另一侧，背景适度虚化但保留真实环境信息。

真实头肩近景，人物占据画面主要区域，但保留部分肩部、锁骨和河边环境。摄影透视自然，避免广角怼脸，人物脸部完整，双眼清晰，鼻子比例自然，背景形成纵深，引导视线向远处延伸。整体呈现舒服、清新、有生命力的夏日户外人像，适合作为可灵视频首帧，后续可以自然延展为风吹发丝、缓慢转头、轻微眨眼、由安静浅笑逐渐笑开的连续动作。

【负面约束】

未成年感，幼态儿童脸，网红脸，医美模板脸，AI流水线美女脸，完全对称脸，锥子脸，过尖下巴，夸张大眼，发光瞳孔，玻璃珠眼睛，空洞眼神，眼白过亮，五官模糊，五官变形，鼻子放大，广角畸变，半边脸，极端侧脸，头发遮挡双眼，脸部裁切错误，塑料皮肤，陶瓷肌，蜡像皮肤，过度磨皮，过度锐化，全脸统一毛孔，砂纸皮肤，瑕疵过多，脏乱肤质，油光过重，浓妆，厚重底妆，假睫毛过重，锁骨雕刻感，圆柱形脖子，肩颈僵硬，姿态扭曲，服装变形，背景过度虚化，背景抢主体，强烈暖黄偏色，绿色反光污染面部，过曝高光，HDR过强，影楼写真感，商业棚拍感，字幕，水印，logo。

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium vertical advertising poster for Starbucks Cold Brew, preserving the same minimalist editorial skeleton while pushing the image into a more flagship, more sculptural, and more internationally fashion-magazine-level direction. Keep the composition built from a large field of clean negative space in the upper half and an extreme macro close-up of the cup rim, cold brew surface, and ice structure dominating the lower half. The final result should feel like a hybrid of a world-class Starbucks campaign, a luxury beverage poster, and a collectible international magazine cover: light, cold, precise, modern, and visually unforgettable.

The hero product is Starbucks Cold Brew shown in an extreme macro close-up focused on the very top rim of the cup. The lower half of the poster must be dominated by the cup edge, the liquid meniscus, and a dense frozen landscape of crystal-clear ice rising above the rim. The cup should emerge from the bottom edge of the frame so only the upper portion is visible, making the viewer feel intimately close to the drink. The rim must be hyper-realistic: thin transparent edge, subtle glass thickness, wet reflections, elegant refraction, tiny cold condensation beads, meltwater traces, and perfect surface tension. The cold brew inside must feel dark, deep, and luxurious, with black-brown density, amber undertones, chilled transparency, and beautiful depth beneath the ice.

Push the cold-drink identity to an even more extreme level. The interaction between coffee and ice should be astonishingly rich in detail: large angular ice cubes, fractured transparent planes, trapped air bubbles, melting edges, floating smaller ice fragments, cold condensation droplets clinging to the cup, micro-beads of water, faint cooling haze, and sharp liquid transitions where dark coffee meets thinner translucent zones. The lower macro area should feel like an icy coffee world or a cold-brew geological cutaway, highly tactile and physically believable.

Preserve the same poster logic, but boldly reconstruct the lower beverage zone into a more sculptural and iconic frozen landscape. Let the ice cluster at the rim feel less like ordinary drink styling and more like a monumental cold-brew horizon: cracked clear ice peaks, wet reflective ridges, dark liquid depth below, subtle meltwater channels, and refined tonal separation between transparent ice, amber light, and dense coffee shadow. The drink should feel monumental while remaining product-true and hyper-real.

Refine the upper text system completely so it feels lighter, colder, and more like the cover language of an international design or lifestyle magazine. Use a clean, airy, editorial English title such as "Cold Brew" or "COLD / BREW" with elegant spacing, taller vertical rhythm, and restrained sophistication. Pair it with a short handwritten-style line that feels cool, intelligent, and fresh, such as "deep chill", "slow and cold", "stay crisp", or "cool begins here". Add a very subtle Starbucks siren mark or official brand signature, plus a few tiny editorial fragments or fine-line supporting copy arranged with the intelligence of a collectible magazine cover. Typography must feel black or deep charcoal, crisp, modern, slightly fashion-oriented, and premium, with only the most restrained use of Starbucks green if needed.

The text composition must no longer feel warm or cafe-like. It should feel colder, more airy, more modern, and more internationally editorial. Let the title float with elegant asymmetry, the handwritten note arc gently or lean lightly through the negative space, and small copy fragments behave like magazine-cover coverlines without clutter. The typography should echo the line of the rim and the geometry of the ice below, creating a strong dialogue between graphic design and product form. The upper half should feel spacious, calm, and expensive.

Lighting must be extremely soft, crisp, and premium, with more coolness and brightness than a standard coffee ad. Use delicate highlights on ice edges, refined reflections on the cup rim, wet sparkle on condensation droplets, soft luminous gradients inside the coffee, and impeccable tonal control from deep cold-brew brown to translucent amber to icy clear highlights. Every ice fracture, droplet, and liquid shift must feel macro-photography-grade, razor-sharp yet elegant. The realism must be extreme, but the mood remains clean, quiet, cold, and premium.

Keep the palette tightly controlled: pale cool beige or soft stone background above, deep cold-brew brown, near-black coffee depth, translucent amber light, clear ice highlights, soft silver-gray chill reflections, and only minimal restrained Starbucks green for tiny brand cues. The final image should feel like a world-class Starbucks flagship cold-drink poster and a collectible magazine-cover object at the same time: hyper-real cold brew, monumental ice detail, refined cold editorial typography, minimal official branding, luxury cooling atmosphere, premium print texture, and ultra-sharp detail.

Avoid cluttered layout, avoid too many props, avoid full-cup dominance, avoid muddy liquid, avoid weak ice detail, avoid warm cozy coffee-shop typography, avoid excessive green, avoid cheap poster design, avoid cartoon illustration style, avoid chaotic composition, avoid low-detail condensation.

prompts.text:
为星巴克冷萃咖啡（Starbucks Cold Brew）创作一张超高级的竖版广告海报，保留同样的极简主义编辑骨架，同时将图像推向更具旗舰感、更具雕塑感以及更具国际时尚杂志水平的方向。保持构图由上半部分的大面积干净负空间和下半部分占据主导地位的杯缘、冷萃液面及冰块结构的极端宏观特写组成。最终结果应该感觉像是世界级星巴克活动、奢侈饮品海报和收藏级国际杂志封面的混合体：轻盈、寒冷、精确、现代，且视觉上令人难忘。

核心产品是星巴克冷萃咖啡，以极端宏观特写展现，聚焦于杯子的最顶端边缘。海报的下半部分必须由杯缘、液体弯月面以及升起在杯缘之上的致密冷冻晶莹剔透冰块景观所主导。杯子应从画面的底部边缘浮现，以便仅看到上半部分，让观众感到与饮品亲密接触。杯缘必须是超写实的：薄而透明的边缘、细微的玻璃厚度、湿润的反光、优雅的折射、微小的冷凝水珠、融水痕迹以及完美的表面张力。内部的冷萃咖啡必须感觉黑暗、深邃且奢华，具有黑褐色浓度、琥珀色底色、冰冷的透明度以及冰块下美丽的深度。

将冷饮身份推向更极端的水平。咖啡与冰块之间的互动应在细节上惊人地丰富：巨大的棱角冰块、破碎的透明平面、困住的气泡、融化的边缘、漂浮的小冰碎片、附着在杯子上的冷凝水滴、微小的水珠、淡淡的冷却薄雾，以及深色咖啡与较薄半透明区域相遇的锋利液体过渡。下方的宏观区域应感觉像是一个冰冷的咖啡世界或冷萃地质剖面，极具触感且物理上真实可信。

保留相同的海报逻辑，但大胆地将下方的饮品区域重构成更具雕塑感和标志性的冰冻景观。让杯缘处的冰块簇感觉不像普通的饮品造型，而更像是一个宏伟的冷萃地平线：破碎的透明冰峰、湿润的反光脊线、下方的深色液体深度、细微的融水通道，以及透明冰块、琥珀光线和浓密咖啡阴影之间精致的色调分离。饮品应感觉宏伟，同时保持产品真实感和超写实感。

彻底完善上方的文字系统，使其感觉更轻盈、更寒冷，更像国际设计或生活方式杂志的封面语言。使用干净、空灵的编辑风格英文标题，如“Cold Brew”或“COLD / BREW”，具有优雅的间距、较高的垂直节奏和克制的精致感。搭配一行感觉酷炫、聪明且新鲜的手写风格文字，如“deep chill”、“slow and cold”、“stay crisp”或“cool begins here”。添加一个非常细微的星巴克海妖标志或官方品牌签名，再加上一些以收藏级杂志封面的智慧排列的微小编辑片段或细线辅助文案。排版必须感觉是黑色或深炭灰色，清晰、现代、略带时尚导向且高端，仅在需要时最克制地使用星巴克绿。

文字构图绝不能再有温暖或咖啡馆的感觉。它应该感觉更寒冷、更空灵、更现代、更具国际编辑风格。让标题以优雅的不对称感漂浮，手写笔记轻轻地呈弧形或倾斜穿过负空间，小的文案片段表现得像杂志封面导读词而不显得杂乱。排版应呼应杯缘的线条和下方冰块的几何形状，在平面设计和产品形态之间建立强有力的对话。上半部分应感觉宽敞、平静且昂贵。

灯光必须极其柔和、清脆且高端，比标准的咖啡广告更冷、更亮。在冰块边缘使用精致的高光，在杯缘上使用精细的反光，在冷凝水滴上使用湿润的闪光，在咖啡内部使用柔和的发光梯度，以及从深色冷萃咖啡棕到半透明琥珀色再到冰冷的透明高光的完美色调控制。每一个冰块裂缝、水滴和液体位移都必须达到宏观摄影级，锐利而优雅。写实感必须达到极致，但氛围保持干净、安静、寒冷和高端。

严格控制调色板：上方为淡冷米色或柔和的石材背景，深色冷萃咖啡棕、近乎黑色的咖啡深度、半透明的琥珀色光、清晰的冰块高光、柔和的银灰色冷反光，以及仅用于微小品牌提示的最少量克制的星巴克绿。最终图像应同时感觉像是世界级星巴克旗舰冷饮海报和收藏级杂志封面对象：超写实冷萃咖啡、宏伟的冰块细节、精致的冷色调编辑排版、极简的官方品牌、奢侈的冷却氛围、高端的印刷质感和超锐利的细节。

避免凌乱的布局，避免过多的道具，避免全杯占据主导，避免浑浊的液体，避免微弱的冰块细节，避免温暖舒适的咖啡馆排版，避免过多的绿色，避免廉价的海报设计，避免卡通插画风格，避免混乱的构图，避免细节模糊的冷凝。

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 editorial typography poster built around one human-centered moment.

Use oversized, cropped letters as the main composition structure. Embed the environment inside the letterforms, while the person, body movement, or a foreground object breaks through the letters with strong perspective. The typography should shape the image, not simply sit on top of it.

Scene: [roller skating / swimming / cycling / coffee break]
Subject: [young Asian woman / Western man / Asian man / Western woman]
Title: [custom two-word title]
Series: HUMAN FRAGMENTS
Year: 2026

4 directions:

1. ROLL SIGNAL — a roller skater gliding past the camera, one skate enlarged in the foreground, body and urban scene passing through giant letters.

2. BLUE CURRENT — a swimmer moving through turquoise water, one arm reaching toward the camera, water and splashes filling and breaking beyond the typography.

3. CITY LOOP — a cyclist turning through a city street, the front wheel enlarged by perspective and visually connected with circular letterforms.

4. BREW PAUSE — a quiet café moment, with the hand and coffee cup closer to the camera while the person and window scene are woven into oversized type.

Use realistic photography, natural skin and fabric, believable water and motion, subtle paper grain, strong negative space, and a restrained color palette.

prompts.text:
创建一个 9:16 的社论排版海报，围绕一个以人为本的瞬间构建。

使用超大、裁剪的字母作为主要的构图结构。将环境嵌入到字母形状中，同时人物、肢体动作或前景物体以强烈的透视感冲破字母。排版应该塑造图像，而不是简单地叠放在图像之上。

场景：[轮滑 / 游泳 / 骑行 / 咖啡间歇]
主体：[年轻亚洲女性 / 西方男性 / 亚洲男性 / 西方女性]
标题：[自定义双词标题]
系列：HUMAN FRAGMENTS
年份：2026

4 个方向：

1. ROLL SIGNAL —— 一名轮滑者滑过摄像机，一只滑轮在前景中放大，身体和城市场景穿过巨大的字母。

2. BLUE CURRENT —— 一名游泳者在青绿色的水中移动，一只手臂向摄像机伸出，水和水花填充并冲破排版的界限。

3. CITY LOOP —— 一名骑行者在城市街道转弯，前轮由于透视感而被放大，并与圆形字母形状在视觉上相连。

4. BREW PAUSE —— 一个安静的咖啡馆时刻，手和咖啡杯更靠近摄像机，而人物和窗外场景则交织在超大字体中。

使用写实摄影、自然的皮肤和织物、真实的水和动态、细微的纸张纹理、强烈的负空间以及克制的配色方案。

prompts.text:
Create a trendy 3:2 square promotional poster for “[PRODUCT NAME]” using the uploaded product image or generate a premium realistic version of [PRODUCT NAME]. Automatically adapt all ingredients, textures, colors, toppings, decorative graphics, and visual mood according to the product type or uploaded image. Focus on a youthful modern café branding style with oversized typography and playful graphic energy.

Canvas Size:
1:1 Square Format — 1080x1080 px, optimized for Instagram posts and modern café social media marketing.

Setting & Background:
Use a vibrant minimal background with bold monochrome or dual-tone color palettes inspired by the product flavor. Include playful doodles, abstract shapes, outlined circles, hand-drawn arrows, retro symbols, spark icons, curved typography paths, sticker-style cutout borders, and trendy Asian-inspired pop design elements. Keep the composition energetic and visually balanced.

Lighting:
Bright soft commercial lighting with glossy drink reflections, realistic ice textures, creamy highlights, soft shadows, vibrant café atmosphere, and appetizing product enhancement.

Style:
Modern café advertising aesthetic, Korean/Japanese-inspired graphic poster design, trendy Gen Z social media branding, playful typography composition, sticker-cutout product style, premium minimal poster design, ultra-realistic drink rendering.

Typography Style:
Use oversized bold typography with playful layout placement.
Mix curved text, handwritten doodles, rounded bold fonts, and modern condensed typography.
Keep text large, youthful, and visually dynamic.

Color Direction:
Automatically adapt colors according to [PRODUCT NAME]:

Iced Coffee → cobalt blue + white + beige

Matcha Latte → green + cream + white

Strawberry Milk → pink + red + cream

Chocolate Shake → brown + beige + caramel

Use high-contrast trendy colors with a clean modern vibe.

Camera:
Centered hero product composition, close-up commercial drink photography, shallow depth of field, cinematic café lighting, ultra-sharp texture details, premium advertising quality, 4K social media render.

Text Elements:
Include stylish marketing text such as:
“Fresh Brew”
“Ice Coffee”
“Limited Time”
“Now Serving”
“Daily Fresh”
“Cold & Refreshing”

Important:

Keep the composition playful and typography-driven

Maintain sticker-style outlined product cutout

Automatically adapt colors and decorative graphics to [PRODUCT NAME]

Use clean trendy café branding style

Avoid cluttered layouts

Design should resemble modern Asian café promotional posters

prompts.text:
为“[产品名称]”创建一个时尚的3:2方形宣传海报，使用上传的产品图片或生成一个[产品名称]的高级写实版本。根据产品类型或上传的图片自动调整所有成分、纹理、颜色、配料、装饰图形和视觉氛围。专注于具有超大排版和趣味图形活力的年轻现代咖啡馆品牌风格。

画布尺寸：
1:1方形格式 — 1080x1080 px，针对Instagram帖子和现代咖啡馆社交媒体营销进行了优化。

环境与背景：
使用充满活力的极简背景，具有受产品口味启发的醒目单色或双色调配色方案。包括趣味涂鸦、抽象形状、轮廓圆圈、手绘箭头、复古符号、火花图标、弯曲的排版路径、贴纸风格的切口边缘以及流行的受亚洲启发的波普设计元素。保持构图充满活力且视觉平衡。

灯光：
明亮柔和的商业照明，带有光亮的饮料反射、真实的冰块纹理、奶油般的高光、柔和的阴影、充满活力的咖啡馆氛围以及令人食指大动的产品增强。

风格：
现代咖啡馆广告美学、受韩系/日系启发的平面海报设计、潮流Gen Z社交媒体品牌设计、趣味排版布局、贴纸剪纸产品风格、高级极简海报设计、超写实饮料渲染。

排版风格：
使用具有趣味布局位置的超大粗体排版。
混合弯曲文本、手写涂鸦、圆润粗体字体和现代紧凑排版。
保持文本巨大、年轻且视觉动态。

色彩方向：
根据[产品名称]自动调整颜色：

冰咖啡 → 钴蓝色 + 白色 + 米色

抹茶拿铁 → 绿色 + 奶油色 + 白色

草莓牛奶 → 粉红色 + 红色 + 奶油色

巧克力奶昔 → 棕色 + 米色 + 焦糖色

使用具有干净现代氛围的高对比度潮流色彩。

相机：
居中的英雄产品构图、特写商业饮料摄影、浅景深、电影感咖啡馆灯光、超清晰纹理细节、高级广告质量、4K社交媒体渲染。

文本元素：

Hair is deep dark brown. Thin see-through bangs, with the back of the head softly tied into a bun at a low position. On the feet are geta with black soles and elegant patterned straps. Squatting deeply with knees bent by the water tank, with the spine slightly straightened. The figure's right hand holds the small circular net to the chest, and the left hand extends the small white bowl over the water tank. A Japanese summer festival night. A metal-framed water tank is set up on the right, with transparent pink, blue, green, yellow, and orange water balloons floating densely. The background features wooden boxes of stalls, dim pillars, and blurred signs. The foreground is dark flagstone, the middle ground consists of the person and the water tank, and the background features softly blurred stall lights. The main light source is warm-colored stall lighting from the upper right of the frame. Soft highlights are added to the right cheek, bridge of the nose, shoulder, and back of the hand, with weak blue reflected light added to the left. Focus is concentrated on the face and both hands, with the stalls in the rear showing smooth blur.

Character · Expression:
An adult woman with a calm, charming, and mature presence. A healthy and naturally rounded adult physique. Long dark brown hair slightly disheveled, with thin bangs and hair strands around the face falling on the cheeks. The head is slightly tilted, looking at the camera with a calm and direct gaze. Lips are gently closed, showing an unadorned and gentle expression. The skin retains natural color and subtle texture.

Clothing · Pose:
A white spaghetti-strap camisole made of ribbed material. A clear V-neck decorated with lace trim at the chest, of moderate length and naturally fitting the body. Bottoms are made of dark red satin material with fine pleats at the edges. Kneeling on the bed with both knees, stretching the left leg forward and folding the right leg back. The upper body is almost facing the front, with only a slight twist at the waist. The right hand lightly touches the edge of the red satin with fingertips, and the left hand is naturally placed near the opposite edge. No forceful pulling of the fabric, realistically expressing the contact between fingers and clothing.

Background · Lighting:
A bedroom with messy white bed sheets and pillows, creating a lived-in atmosphere. The walls are irregularly covered with items like magazine covers, interior photos, street scenes, flowers, and strips of paper; the text retains a Japanese atmosphere but is blurred enough to be unreadable. An open photo book is placed in the foreground, the character and a black camera in the middle ground, and a collage on the wall in the background. Warm sunlight pours in from a low angle at the top left of the frame, illuminating the left side of the face, shoulders, chest, and thighs. Clear-contoured shadows are cast on the right side of the character and the wall, while the white bed sheets reflect a soft glow.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 2:3, the character accounts for about 70% of the whole frame. The face is placed in the upper third, the waist is centered, and the knees and magazines are in the lower part. The lens position is at a slight low angle level with the bed, with a natural perspective of about 50mm. Focus on the character's eyes and face, with the background paper slightly softened and blurred. Moderate negative space is maintained on the left and right walls and the lower part of the bed, with scattered magazines guiding the gaze toward the character.

Texture · Style:
A warm-toned magazine-pictorial style realistic photo. Fine film grain, soft highlights, shallow shadows, with a calm beige and white tone as the base, using only the red satin as a strong color accent. The skin retains pores and subtle shadows, avoiding excessive skin-smoothing retouching. Clearly distinguish the different textures of hair, ribbed fabric, lace, satin, bed sheets, and paper.

prompts.text:
Using the uploaded image as the only facial reference, preserve 100% of the man's facial identity, hairstyle, beard, eye color, skin tone, facial structure, expression style, and recognizable features in every scene. Keep the character perfectly consistent across all six panels.

Create a 3×2 vertical collage of six ultra-realistic cinematic miniature scenes featuring the same 10 cm tall tiny man trapped in hilarious oversized everyday situations inside a warm, modern kitchen. The tiny man sprints across a polished wooden kitchen floor in absolute panic while an enormous fluffy tabby cat playfully hunts him with one giant raised paw. Flying dust particles, motion blur, dramatic low-angle perspective, warm morning sunlight through the window, cinematic depth of field.

items.title: 雨中倒影情感关系四阶段视觉故事

prompts.text:
Create a 4-image visual story series. Each image must be generated separately, not combined into one collage. All images should be vertical 9:16, cinematic, realistic, atmospheric, and based on rainy puddle reflections on the ground.

Core visual language:
The main subject in each image is the reflection in a puddle on a rainy street. The real people may appear only partially at the edge of the frame, such as shoes, legs, or a bit of clothing. The reflection should feel natural and imperfect, with ripples, raindrops, wet asphalt texture, water stains, and slight distortion. Do not make the puddle look like a perfect mirror. The real-world pose and direction must match the reflected pose and direction. Strong mood, soft cinematic lighting, believable urban environment, subtle storytelling, no text.

The 4 images should show 4 stages of a relationship:

1. Passion
A young couple walking very close together under one transparent umbrella on a rainy summer afternoon street. Their reflections are near each other, intimate, warm, and youthful. The water is relatively calm.

2. Love
The couple embracing quietly in the rain on an older street at dusk, with soft warm light reflected in the puddle. Their reflections almost merge into one shape. Emotional, tender, and calm.

3. Conflict
The couple after an argument on a colder rainy city street at night. They are no longer close. One stands under the umbrella, the other stands in the rain. Their reflections are separated, with more visible ripples and a colder tone.

4. Separation
A breakup scene at a rainy night street or station. One person stays still under an umbrella, while the other turns away and walks off. Their reflections are farther apart, partially broken by rain, with a strong sense of distance and emotional loss.

Make the 4 images feel like one coherent series with the same visual method, but each scene should happen in a different time and place, so it feels like a real progression rather than four moments from the same minute.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
创建一个包含 4 张图片的视觉故事系列。每张图片必须单独生成，而不是组合成一张拼贴图。所有图片应为垂直 9:16、电影感、写实、有氛围，并以地面雨水坑的倒影为基础。

核心视觉语言：
每张图片的主体是雨天街道水坑里的倒影。真实的人物可能只出现在画面的边缘，例如鞋子、腿或一点衣服。倒影应该是自然且不完美的，带有波纹、雨滴、潮湿的沥青纹理、水渍和轻微的变形。不要让水坑看起来像一面完美的镜子。现实世界的姿势和方向必须与倒影的姿势和方向相匹配。强烈的情绪、柔和的电影级光效、可信的城市环境、微妙的叙事感、无文字。

这 4 张图片应展示一段关系的 4 个阶段：

1. 激情
在一个夏日雨后的下午街道上，一对年轻情侣共用一把透明伞，走得很近。他们的倒影靠在一起，亲密、温暖且充满青春气息。水面相对平静。

2. 爱情
黄昏时分在一条老旧的街道上，这对情侣在雨中静静拥抱，柔和的暖光映在水坑里。他们的倒影几乎融为一体。富有情感、温柔且平静。

3. 冲突
夜晚一条较冷的雨中城市街道上，争吵过后的情侣。他们不再亲密。一个站在伞下，另一个站在雨中。他们的倒影是分开的，有更明显的波纹和更冷的色调。

4. 分离
在雨夜的街道或车站的分手场景。一个人撑着伞静止不动，而另一个人转身走开。他们的倒影相距更远，部分被雨水打断，带有强烈的距离感和情感缺失感。

使这 4 张图片感觉像是一个连贯的系列，采用相同的视觉方法，但每个场景应发生在不同的时间和地点，因此感觉像是真实的进展，而不是同一分钟内的四个瞬间。

Clothing·Pose:

Bottoms are ecru thin shorts and white loose socks. The upper body has a straight spine, with the center of gravity tilted slightly toward the right side of the waist. Knees are spread wide in a cross-legged position, right foot in front, left foot slightly behind. Fingers of both hands naturally hold the sides and bottom of the player, and the headphone cord hangs loosely from the chest to between the knees.

Background·Lighting:
A Japanese retro private room configured with wooden-framed sliding doors, beige plastered walls, low wooden shelves, vinyl records, cassettes, vintage radio-cassette players, Polaroid photos, pocketbooks, small flower vases, and a cloth-covered lamp. In the foreground are an open notebook, a pink pen, stickers, and scattered photos. Handwritten text on paper or notebooks in the background is only blurry and unidentifiable. Warm desk lamp light is cast from a low position on the right side of the frame, and soft natural light filters through the sliding doors from the upper left. Add warm highlights on the right cheek, collarbone, and upper thighs, with shadows extending softly toward the lower left.

Composition·Lens:
Low-angle camera position close to the floor height, almost at eye level. Natural perspective equivalent to 35mm. Leave about 8% empty space above the person's head and about 20% space for the feet and foreground small objects. Use the desk lamp on the right and the radio-cassette player on the left to support the frame, with the person's face and the cassette player as the primary focus. The background is slightly blurred, but with a medium depth of field where the shapes of the washitsu wood and small objects are still recognizable.

Texture·Style:
Japanese magazine interior portrait style. Delicately depict natural skin texture, the feel of hair strands, the touch of knitwear and wood, and the aged feel of the cassette's metal and plastic. Dominated by light beige, matte pink, and brown tones, incorporating fine grain of film photography and restrained contrast. Avoid excessive gloss or CG feel, creating a quiet and lived-in texture.

Negative Prompt:
Young face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands and feet, broken joints, poor contact of the player, floating cables, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, garbled text, readable text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin smoothing, plastic-like skin.

prompts.text:
主题：
回溯的时间

在现代风格的和室里布置得宁静的房间中，一位散发成熟气息的女性盘腿坐在地毯上，双手握着一个小型便携式卡带播放器。人物位于画面中央稍偏右，全身占据画面约七成。

人物·表情：
自然且富有真实感的女性。柔和的卵形轮廓，沉稳的大人气质眼眸，高雅而温和的表情。脸部朝画面右侧约30度倾斜，视线追逐着窗边光线般斜向右上方。头发是深棕色长层剪，薄薄的透视刘海，脸周留有细碎的飞絮发丝，发梢呈松散波浪。妆容包括粉米色腮红、棕色系眼影、细线眼线、自然泪袋，以及抑制光泽的玫瑰米色唇彩。

象牙白小花卉吊带背心，搭配薄款镂空针织开衫。开衫从肩部自然垂落，在手臂周围形成柔软的布料褶皱。下装是生成色轻薄短裤，白色宽松短袜。上半身挺直脊背，腰部稍稍向右侧倾斜重心。双膝大大张开成盘腿姿势，右脚在前，左脚稍稍靠后。双手手指自然握住播放器的侧面和底部，耳机线从胸前松散垂落到膝盖间。

配置木框拉门、米色抹墙、低矮木制置物架、黑胶唱片、卡带、老式收录机、宝丽来照片、文库本、小花瓶、布罩灯的日式复古私人房间。前景有打开的笔记本、粉色笔、贴纸、散落的照片。背景的纸张或笔记本上仅模糊不清的手写文字，无法辨识。从画面右侧低位投射暖色台灯光，从画面左上方拉门透入淡雅自然光。在右脸颊、锁骨、大腿上表面添加温暖高光，阴影柔和地向左下方延伸。

构图·镜头：
接近地板高度的低角度镜头位置，几乎平视。相当于35mm的自然透视感。人物头部上方留约8%的空白空间，脚部和前景小物件留约20%的空间。以右侧台灯和左侧收录机支撑画面，将人物脸部和卡带播放器作为主要焦点。背景略微虚化，但和室的木材和小物件形状仍可辨识的中等景深。

日系杂志的室内肖像风格。细腻描绘自然的肌理、头发束感、针织与木材的触感、卡带金属与塑料的陈旧感。以淡米色、哑光粉、棕色为主调，融入胶片照片的细微颗粒与克制对比。避免过度光泽或CG感，营造安静而富有生活气息的质感。

负面提示：
幼态脸庞、不自然视线、多余手指、缺失手指、手脚融合、关节崩坏、播放器接触不良、悬浮线缆、错误透视法、与光源矛盾的阴影、文字乱码、可读文字、标志、水印、过度美肌修饰、塑料般的肌肤。

prompts.text:
Generate a 3:4 vertical high-end Chinese visual poster with the theme [Subject]. The overall style is Oriental Fantasy + Paper Carving / Papercraft layering style, featuring obvious three-dimensional paper-cut edges, embossed paper texture, delicate relief shadows, and a high-completion art poster temperament. The image is not a common illustration, but a complete Chinese poster design.

[Overall Composition]
Set a large-area paper title zone at the top of the poster, like a torn paper scroll, paper label, or floating cardboard, creating a strong visual anchor. Set a huge circular visual focal point in the center, which can be a full moon, moon gate, sun wheel, energy ring, circular light on the sea, or a holy gate. A long street, steps, bridge, or ritual passage with a strong sense of depth is formed from the bottom to the middle of the picture, with crowds, lanterns, buildings, and scenery converging toward the center along the central axis.

[Scene and Subject]
The subject is an Oriental fantasy city / architectural complex / scene system developed around [Subject]. Buildings should have layers of pavilions, towers, covered bridges, arches, steps, city gates, mountains, lanterns, banners, cloud patterns, flower trees, ripples, or other Oriental decorative elements. The overall is not a realistic city, but a "Fantasy City" with imagination and world-view settings.

[Style and Material]
The overall expression uses paper carving, layered paper cutting, three-dimensional paper art, paper embossing, and fine decorative patterns. There are clear foreground and background layers between each building and landscape layer, like a handmade paper art model. The texture is exquisite, the outlines are clear, the shadows are soft, and it has the quality of an exhibition poster and collector-grade illustration.

[Color]
Based on deep blue, warm gold, cream white, and cinnabar red. A small amount of auxiliary colors can be added according to [Subject], but the overall must be restrained, high-end, and unified. Night scenes can lean toward deep blue and gold, spring scenes can add pink, snow scenes can add cold white and foggy blue, and a sense of the future can add a small amount of silver-blue light.

[Typography]
The following Chinese text must appear clearly in the poster:
- Chinese Main Title: "[Main Title]"
- Chinese Subtitle: "[Subtitle]"
- Column Text: "[Column Text]"
- Date: "20260722"

The title must be large, clear, and complete, with a calligraphic sense or high-end Chinese display font effect; the subtitle and column text are smaller, with neat typesetting and clear hierarchy. The date must be clearly legible.

[Aura]
The overall is high-end, poetic, mysterious, oriental, dreamy, and solemn, like an art concept poster, exhibition poster, or high-end visual poster, rather than an e-commerce poster.

[Negative Items]
No logos, watermarks, or QR codes;
No garbled Chinese characters;
No cheap cartoon feel;
No modern e-commerce promotional feel;
No ordinary flat illustration feel;
No loose composition;
No titles that are too small;
No low-quality AI feel.

prompts.text:
生成一张3:4竖版的高级中文视觉海报，主题为【主题】。整体风格为东方幻想 + 纸雕 / 纸艺层叠风格，具有明显的立体切纸边缘、压纹纸张质感、细腻浮雕阴影和高完成度艺术海报气质。画面不是普通插画，而是完整中文海报设计。

【整体构图】
海报顶部设置大面积纸质标题区，像破纸卷轴、纸质题签或悬浮纸板，形成强烈视觉锚点。中部设置一个巨大的圆形视觉焦点，可为圆月、月门、日轮、能量环、海上圆光或圣门。画面下方到中部形成一条具有强纵深感的长街、台阶、桥道或仪式性通道，人群、灯笼、建筑和景物沿中轴线向中心汇聚。

【场景与主体】
主体为围绕【主题】展开的东方幻想城市 / 建筑群 / 场景系统。建筑应具有层层叠叠的楼阁、塔楼、廊桥、牌坊、台阶、城门、山体、灯笼、旗幡、云纹、花树、波纹或其他东方装饰元素。整体不是写实城市，而是具有想象力和世界观设定的“幻想之城”。

【风格与材质】
整体使用纸雕、层叠剪纸、立体纸艺、纸张压纹、细密装饰纹样的表现方式。每个建筑和景观层之间有明确前后层次，像手工纸艺模型。质感精致，轮廓清晰，阴影柔和，具有展览海报和收藏级插画质感。

【色彩】
以深蓝、暖金、米白、朱砂红为基础色系，可根据【主题】加入少量辅助色，但整体必须克制、高级、统一。夜景可偏深蓝金色，春景可加入粉色，雪景可加入冷白和雾蓝，未来感可加入少量银蓝光。

【文字排版】
海报中必须清晰出现以下中文文字：
- 中文主标题：“【主标题】”
- 中文副标题：“【副标题】”
- 小栏目文字：“【栏目文字】”
- 日期：“20260722”

标题必须大、清晰、完整，具有书法感或高级中文展示字体效果；副标题和栏目文字较小，排版整齐、层级分明。日期必须清晰可读。

【画面气质】
整体高级、诗意、神秘、东方、梦幻、庄重，像艺术概念海报、展览海报或高级视觉海报，而不是电商海报。

【禁止项】
不要Logo、水印、二维码；
不要中文乱码；
不要廉价卡通感；
不要现代电商宣传感；
不要普通平面插画感；
不要构图松散；
不要标题过小；
不要低质AI感。

prompts.text:
Form a dark-field viewpoint cover around specific thematic content, where a thematic speaker or core object occupies the center of the frame, presented frontally at close range, with restrained empty space left at the head or top, and the lower half of the body or subject gradually darkened by deep colors, allowing the gaze to first read the stable, calm face or core outline, and then fall on the viewpoint text covering the area below. The background uses a low-brightness color field derived from the theme, keeping it near black but not dead black, with a very weak diffuse brightness in the center to set off the edges of the subject, naturally tapering off at the edges, overall clean, low saturation, and low noise, like a combination of a studio portrait and a serious media cover. The material of the subject is generated according to the theme, but must have real lighting; soft frontal main light shapes skin tones, surfaces, or material details, with layers preserved in the dark parts, and clothing or supports sinking into the background as much as possible, leaving only hands, edges, or local highlights slightly exposed. A left-aligned editorial title area is established below, first using an eye-catching small red rectangular label to carry short category words, with a slender red vertical line next to or below it as a visual anchor; the main title uses heavy sans-serif white characters with tight leading and sufficient weight, pressed over the dark part of the subject but remaining clear; auxiliary explanatory text is thinner and smaller, forming two levels of reading. An exaggerated white quotation mark or theme-derived symbol is set on the left as a viewpoint entrance. Colors are derived from the theme, with the dark background responsible for steady distance, the subject retaining natural and credible mid-tones, white text providing the highest brightness contrast, and red used only as a small amount of warning and column emphasis. Avoid fancy decorations, complex scenes, and overly bright backgrounds; all elements serve the first-impression effect of 'a credible voice from a person or core object, with the title pressed into the frame like an editorial judgment.'

——————

Supplement: 3 related information points appear, retaining a small amount of column text
Aspect Ratio: Vertical 9:16

items.title: 辉柏嘉铅笔高端极简四格活动展示板

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium vertical 4-panel campaign board for Faber-Castell pencils, designed as a refined 2x2 grid of four collectible minimalist advertising posters unified into one luxury presentation sheet. Preserve the same core concept of four different pencil-based miracle images, but push the campaign into a more expensive, more restrained, more gallery-grade direction: stronger color contrast between the four panels, more breathing room, more negative space, less text, and a more sophisticated international design-book feeling.

Each of the four panels must feature a real Faber-Castell pencil as the absolute hero product, transformed into a different highly creative object-fusion concept with seamless realism and zero visual awkwardness. Every panel must feel like a premium stand-alone print ad, but together they should read like an elite brand proposal board. The product itself must always remain hyper-realistic and recognizable: authentic Faber-Castell proportions, real lacquered body, sharpened wood grain, graphite tip texture, premium printed branding detail, and impeccable material fidelity.

Push the visual luxury much further by making the four panels cleaner and more spacious. Give each panel more empty background, more formal restraint, and more elegant placement of the hero object. Avoid filling the frame too much. Let the miracle object sit in a more powerful field of negative space, so each concept feels more iconic and expensive. Typography must be more reduced than before: only a concise English headline, a tiny supporting line, a subtle official Faber-Castell brand mark, and if desired one restrained handwritten-style accent phrase. The text must feel lighter, quieter, and more confident, never loud or busy.

Make the four color systems clearly distinct and more luxurious in contrast with each other:

Panel 1: a futuristic pencil-rocket concept in a pale cool grey or off-white space, with the pencil transformed into a sleek launch vehicle. Use a cold premium palette of emerald green, metallic silver, graphite black, and faint launch-fire amber. The object should feel engineered, aerodynamic, and visually sharp, surrounded by clean negative space and a subtle sense of lift-off.

Panel 2: a pencil-high-speed-train concept, with the sharpened graphite tip forming the aerodynamic nose and the body extending into a streamlined rail machine. Use a completely different palette, such as warm stone beige, charcoal, muted olive, and brushed steel. The scene should feel fast yet calm, elegant yet precise, with even more minimal background and refined motion cues.

Panel 3: a pencil-architecture concept, where pencils form a grand cultural monument or library with one dominant upright pencil as the central spire. Use a richer but disciplined palette such as soft limestone, ivory, deep forest green, and antique bronze. The composition should be frontal, poised, and monumental, with strong vertical dignity and generous negative space around the structure.

Panel 4: a pencil-object metaphor concept with even greater minimalist intelligence, such as the pencil transformed into a lighthouse, a bridge, a conductor’s baton, or an ascent tool. The concept must feel poetic, master-level, and visually pure. Use a bold contrasting palette that is entirely different from the other three, such as deep midnight blue, warm ivory, and a single saturated accent, or rich burgundy with pale blush and matte black. Keep it the most restrained and artful of all four panels.

The four panels must not feel repetitive. Each should use a different compositional rhythm, scale, perspective logic, and emotional tone, but all should share the same premium realism and minimalist intelligence. The color contrast between the four posters should be clear at first glance, yet each palette must remain elegant and controlled rather than noisy. The whole sheet should feel like a brand campaign selected for an international design annual.

Typography across all four posters should be official, premium, and highly restrained. Use concise English titles only, with minimal supporting copy and very subtle logo identification. The handwritten phrase, if included, should be tiny, elegant, and secondary. Text should never compete with the product. It should function more like editorial whisper than advertising shout. Allow the negative space and the product idea to carry the luxury.

Lighting must be exceptionally soft, precise, and commercial-premium across all four panels. Use clean directional highlights, crisp edge definition, refined shadow control, subtle reflective behavior, and tactile material realism. Add only minimal atmospheric cues where appropriate, such as refined motion blur, soft air particles, or delicate launch glow, but keep everything controlled. Finish the entire 4-panel board with subtle heavy print grain and razor-sharp detail, like a luxury print portfolio object.

Avoid childish illustration style, avoid cluttered props, avoid repeated colors, avoid repeated compositions, avoid noisy text, avoid generic school-product advertising, avoid flat lighting, avoid cheap surrealism, avoid awkward product distortion, avoid overfilled layouts, avoid excessive graphic decoration.

prompts.text:
为辉柏嘉铅笔创作一个超高端的垂直四格活动展示板，设计成一个由四张具有收藏价值的极简主义广告海报组成的精致2x2网格，统一在一个奢华的展示页面中。保留四个不同的基于铅笔的神奇图像的核心概念，但将活动推向更昂贵、更克制、更画廊级的方向：四个板块之间有更强的色彩对比，更多的负空间，更少的文字，以及更精致的国际设计书感。

四个板块中的每一个都必须以一支真实的辉柏嘉铅笔作为绝对的主角产品，通过无缝的现实主义和零视觉尴尬感，转化为不同的极具创意的物体融合概念。每个板块都必须感觉像是一个高端的独立平面广告，但组合在一起时，它们应该读起来像是一个精英品牌提案板。产品本身必须始终保持超现实且可识别：真实的辉柏嘉比例、真实的漆面笔身、削尖的木纹、石墨笔尖纹理、高端印刷的品牌细节以及无懈可击的材料保真度。

通过让四个板块更整洁、更宽敞，进一步提升视觉奢华感。给每个板块更多的空白背景、更多的形式克制和更优雅的主角物体摆放。避免画面过于拥挤。让神奇物体处于一个更强大的负空间场中，使每个概念都感到更加标志性和昂贵。排版必须比以前更加简化：只有一个简明扼要的英文标题，一行微小的辅助文字，一个微妙的官方辉柏嘉品牌标志，如果需要，还可以有一个克制的手写风格点缀短语。文字必须感觉更轻盈、更安静、更自信，绝不喧闹或杂乱。

让四个色彩系统清晰区分，并在相互对比中显得更奢华：

板块 1：浅冷灰色或米白色空间中的未来主义铅笔火箭概念，铅笔被转化为流线型的运载火箭。使用由祖母绿、金属银、石墨黑和微弱的发射火焰琥珀色组成的冷色调高端调色板。物体应具有工程感、空气动力学感和视觉锐度，周围环绕着干净的负空间和微妙的升空感。

板块 2：铅笔高铁概念，削尖的石墨笔尖形成空气动力学鼻锥，笔身延伸为流线型铁路机器。使用完全不同的调色板，例如暖石色、木炭色、柔和的橄榄色和拉丝钢色。场景应感觉快速而平静，优雅而精确，背景更加极简，动态暗示更加精致。

板块 3：铅笔建筑概念，铅笔构成宏伟的文化纪念碑或图书馆，一支占主导地位的直立铅笔作为中心尖塔。使用更丰富但有节制的调色板，如软石灰石色、象牙色、深森林绿和古董青铜色。构图应是正面的、沉稳的、宏伟的，具有强烈的垂直尊严，建筑周围有大量的负空间。

板块 4：具有更高极简智慧的铅笔物体隐喻概念，例如将铅笔转化为灯塔、桥梁、指挥棒或登山工具。这个概念必须具有诗意、大师级水平且视觉纯净。使用与其他三个完全不同的鲜明对比色调，例如深夜蓝、暖象牙色和单一饱和的点缀色，或深勃艮第红搭配淡粉色和哑光黑。保持它是四个板块中最克制、艺术感最强的一个。

四个板块不得感到重复。每个板块应使用不同的构图节奏、比例、透视逻辑和情感基调，但都应具备相同的高端写实感和极简智慧。四张海报之间的色彩对比应一眼可见，但每个调色板必须保持优雅受控，而非嘈杂。整个页面应感觉像是入选国际设计年鉴的品牌活动。

四张海报的排版应是官方的、高端的且高度克制的。仅使用简短的英文标题，配以极少的辅助文案和非常微妙的标志标识。如果包含手写短语，它应该是微小的、优雅的且次要的。文字绝不能与产品竞争。它的作用应该更像编辑式的低语，而不是广告式的呐喊。让负空间和产品创意来承载奢华感。

光照必须格外柔和、精准且具备商业高端感。使用干净的方向性高光、清晰的轮廓定义、精致的阴影控制、微妙的反射行为和触觉材料写实感。仅在适当的地方添加极少的环境提示，如精致的动态模糊、柔软的空气颗粒或细腻的发射光芒，但保持一切受控。以微妙的重型印刷颗粒和锐利的细节完成整个四格展示板，就像一个奢侈印刷作品集。

prompts.text:
Create a photorealistic 9:16 full-body fashion portrait of an exceptionally beautiful adult East Asian woman in her mid-20s, posing inside a modern luxury apartment at night. She has a refined oval face, large almond-shaped brown eyes, sharp eyeliner, a delicate straight nose, softly full nude-pink lips and a calm, cool expression. Her auburn-brown hair is styled in a clean low updo with a center part and two loose strands framing her cheeks.

She has a slim yet curvy hourglass figure with a full bust, narrow waist, rounded hips and long shapely legs. She wears an elegant dark-purple floral lace corset mini dress with black structured panels, thin shoulder straps and an opaque fitted bodice. Add sheer black back-seam stockings and black open-toe high heels with delicate ankle straps. Her hands are completely bare, with long pale manicured nails. Her neck and shoulders are fully uncovered: no scarf, no lace collar, no cape and no choker. She has no horns or head accessories.

Recreate the crouching pose precisely: she balances on her high heels with both knees raised close to her chest, thighs held together and angled toward the camera. One bare hand rests lightly on the polished floor for balance, while the other bare hand bends beside her face with relaxed fingers. She looks directly into the camera with a composed, slightly mysterious expression.

Use an extremely low front-facing camera placed near floor level, creating strong perspective with the legs prominent in the foreground while keeping her face and complete body visible. Background: glossy cream marble floor, white marble TV cabinet, large black television, dark floor-to-ceiling curtains and warm recessed ceiling lights. Realistic indoor smartphone photography, warm ambient lighting, natural skin texture, subtle fabric and stocking details, slight wide-angle perspective, no anime, no plastic skin, no distorted limbs, no extra fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

items.title: 都市浴室镜前准备的成熟女性

prompts.text:
Theme:
Preparation through the mirror

Subject:
In an urban bathroom unified by dark gray tiles, a fictional adult woman faces a mirror holding a smartphone. The frame is vertical 3:4, with the figure positioned slightly left of center, captured from the top of the head to the mid-thigh. The hand holding the smartphone is placed at the top right, and the hand resting on the sink is placed at the bottom left, centering the curve of the leaning body and the gaze through the mirror.

Character·Expression:
A woman with a calm sense of maturity and a healthy silhouette. Long deep brown straight hair falls naturally to her chest, with a thin center part allowing fine strands to lightly touch her cheeks. Adopts natural Japanese-style makeup, soft parallel eyebrows, delicate eyelashes, pale beige-brown eyeshadow, thin rose-colored blush, and moist pink-beige lipstick. Her face is turned slightly toward the right side of the frame, with eyelids lowered gazing at the smartphone screen. Her mouth is relaxed, presenting a quiet and natural expression.

Clothing·Pose:
A gray cropped sports tank top. Thin shoulder straps, form-fitting elastic ribbed material, and a compact cut that ends near the bottom of the chest. The bottoms are ivory high-waisted sports shorts made of soft stretch fabric, expressing natural fabric tension and subtle folds accompanying the movement of the waist and legs.
The upper body leans forward close to the mirror, and the waist gently shifts toward the right side of the frame. The figure's right arm is bent, holding the smartphone vertically next to her face, with the index and middle fingers naturally resting on the back. The left arm extends diagonally downward, with the left hand supporting the sink in the bottom left of the frame. Shoulder heights differ slightly, with the center of gravity and the body's twist naturally connecting into one.

Background·Light:
Located in a compact and sophisticated bathroom of a Japanese urban-style apartment. The walls are large matte charcoal gray tiles, and the floor is laid with fine-grained gray tiles. A small white square trash bin is placed in the back right, creating a clean space with restrained decoration. Very thin water droplet traces and wiping marks remain on the mirror surface, but the character's face and clothing are clearly visible.
Warm white light spills in from the top left of the frame, creating slender highlights on the hair outline, cheeks, collarbone, shoulders, arms, and abdomen. Faint gray reflected light from the tiles is added on the opposite side, casting a soft shadow of the figure on the left wall. The background is slightly darker than the figure, using a light and dark design to let the skin and gray clothing naturally emerge.

Composition·Lens:
Vertical 3:4, a close-up fashion snapshot through a mirror. Camera position is at an eye-level view close to chest height, with a slight sense of wide-angle. The figure's face is placed in the top left, the waist in the bottom center, and the smartphone in the top right, forming a triangular visual guide. The head clearance is narrow, leaving only a small amount of the left and right tile walls, with the thighs naturally cropped at the bottom of the frame. Focus is on the face, upper body, and smartphone, while the depth of the bathroom is slightly blurred.

Texture·Style:
Like a real indoor photo taken with a smartphone. Detailed depiction of natural skin texture, fine vellus hair, every strand of hair, and the difference between ribbed fabric and stretch material. The main tones are calm gray, black hair, and ivory, retaining only the warmth of the skin with moderate restraint. Avoids excessive HDR or skin smoothing, creating a quiet and sophisticated texture like a magazine's behind-the-scenes shot.

Negative Prompt:
Childish face, unnatural gaze, confusion of left and right hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, distorted smartphone, mirror contradictions, flaws in arms or joints, unnatural fabric marks, floating, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting light source, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

prompts.text:
主题：
透过镜子的准备

主体：
在以深灰色瓷砖统一而成的都市浴室中，一位虚构的成年女性面对镜子拿着智能手机。画面为纵向 3:4，人物占据中央稍偏左的位置，拍摄从头顶到大腿中部。右上方放置拿着智能手机的手，左下方放置搭在洗手台上的手，将前倾身体的曲线和透过镜子的视线置于画面中心。

人物·表情：
一位拥有沉稳的成熟感和健康轮廓的女性。长长的深棕色直发自然垂至胸口，薄薄的中间分缝让细碎的发丝轻轻贴在脸颊上。采用日式自然妆容，柔和的平行眉、细腻的睫毛、淡米色棕眼的眼影、薄薄的玫瑰色腮红、水润般的粉米色唇膏。脸微微转向画面右侧，低垂着眼帘注视着智能手机的屏幕。嘴角放松，呈现出安静而自然的的表情。

服装·姿势：
灰色的短款运动背心。细肩带、贴合身体的弹性罗纹材质、长度在胸下附近结束的紧凑剪裁。下装为象牙白的高腰运动短裤，采用柔软的拉伸面料，表现自然的面料张力和腰部与腿部动作相伴的细微褶皱。
上半身向前倾斜靠近镜子，腰部缓缓向画面右侧偏移。人物的右臂弯曲，在脸侧竖直握住智能手机，食指和中指自然贴在背面。左臂斜向下伸展，左手支撑画面左下方的洗手台。双肩高度略有差异，重心与身体的扭转自然连接成一体。

背景·光线：
位于日本都市型公寓的紧凑而精致浴室。墙壁为哑光炭灰色的大型瓷砖，地板为细粒灰色瓷砖铺设。右后方放置一个白色方形的小垃圾箱，营造出装饰克制的洁净空间。镜子表面残留极薄的水滴痕迹和擦拭痕迹，但人物的脸部和服装清晰可见。
从画面左上方洒入温暖的白光，在头发轮廓、脸颊、锁骨、肩膀、手臂、腹部创造细长的亮点。相对侧加入来自瓷砖的微弱灰色反射光，在左墙投下人物柔和的影子。背景比人物稍暗，采用明暗设计，让肌肤和灰色服装自然浮现。

构图·镜头：
纵向 3:4，透过镜子的近距离时尚快照。相机位置接近胸部高度的平视视角，略带广角感。将人物的脸置于左上方、腰部置于中央下方、智能手机置于右上方，形成三角形的视线引导。头顶余白狭窄，左右瓷砖墙仅留少量，大腿在画面下端自然裁切。对脸部、上半身和智能手机对焦，浴室深处略微模糊。

质感·风格：
如同用智能手机拍摄的真实室内照片。细致描绘自然的肌理、细小的汗毛、每一根头发、罗纹面料与拉伸材质的差异。以沉稳的灰色、黑发、象牙白为主调，仅保留肌肤的温暖感，适度克制。避免过度 HDR 或美肌修饰，营造出杂志幕后花絮般的安静而精致质感。

负面提示：
幼稚的脸部、不自然的视线、左右手的混淆、多余的手指、缺失的手指、融合的手指、扭曲的智能手机、镜像矛盾、手臂或关节的破绽、不自然的布料勒痕、漂浮、错误的透视法、与光源矛盾的影子、过度美肌修饰、塑料般的肌肤、文字乱码、标志、水印。

items.title: AI全自动超长信息图生成器

prompts.text:
Please automatically create an ultra-long infographic based on the topic input by the user.

This is not an ordinary image generation task. Please treat this task as a complete long infographic production project, automatically completed in this round of tasks: data understanding / web verification when necessary / information architecture planning / master canvas design / segmented continuous generation / seamless stitching / error checking / final export.

Do not simply compress extreme ratios into ordinary vertical images, and do not just generate a single short image pretending to be a long image. Do not show intermediate processes, drafts, segmented images, or analysis processes; only return the final complete product.

【User Input Variables】
Topic: {topic}
Final Width: {width}
Final Height: {height}
Final Aspect Ratio: {aspect_ratio}
Visual Style: {style}
Information Density: {density}
Output Language: {language}
Web Access: {web_mode}
Text Generation Mode: {text_mode}
Color Palette: {palette}
Main Visual Anchor: {visual_anchor}
Output Format: {format}

【Automatic Processing Rules】
1. Automatically determine the category the topic belongs to, such as: History / Technology / Business / Geography / Tutorial / Figure / Culture / Product / Industry Analysis / Trend Summary.
2. Automatically design the most suitable information structure according to the topic type, without using rigid templates.
3. If the topic depends on real facts, timelines, data, development history, phase divisions, representative figures, real cases, or the latest information, automatically verify on the web and extract key information.
4. If the topic is conceptual, aesthetic, knowledge organization, or non-time-sensitive content, the structural design can be completed directly based on existing knowledge.
5. Automatically generate a main visual anchor matching the topic, such as: rivers, paths, timelines, energy lines, knowledge trees, map veins, city roads, star maps, process flows, product chains, etc., and make it run through the entire long infographic.

【Content Structure Requirements】
Automatically generate a reasonable information structure based on the topic. Include at least:
- Main Title
- Subtitle / Introduction
- 4 to 10 main sections
- Key points under each section
- Representative visual elements
- Bottom summary / Enlightenment / Conclusion / Method checklist

If the topic is History, it should prioritizedly include:
Origins, stage evolution, key events, representative figures, systems / civilizations / cultures, impacts and summaries.

If the topic is Technology, it should prioritizedly include:
Definition, core principles, development stages, key technologies, representative companies / products, application scenarios, trends and challenges.

If the topic is Business / Brand, it should prioritizedly include:
Origins, development nodes, product / service systems, business models, user personas, competitive landscape, key data, trend summaries.

If the topic is Tutorial / Methodology, it should prioritizedly include:
Conceptual definition, steps/processes, core methods, precautions, common mistakes, tool checklists, case descriptions, summary suggestions.

【Text Strategy】
All titles, section names, body descriptions, labels, years, numbers, quotes, and summary texts should prioritizedly be generated directly by the image model and integrated into the overall image to form an AI-native integrated infographic effect.
Text must be real and readable, and must not use garbled characters, fake Chinese characters, or meaningless placeholders.
When there are obvious typos, incorrect orders, factual errors, year errors, duplicate paragraphs, or layout breakdowns, partial corrections of the problem areas are allowed, but the final style must remain unified, without a post-pasted disjointed feel.

【Visual Style Requirements】
The entire image must maintain a unified:
- Color system
- Paper / Background / Texture logic
- Margin system
- Title font temperament
- Body font size sense
- Icon system
- Illustration language
- Layout density
- Information hierarchy

The default style is high-density, clear structure, visual unity, and detail-rich AI-native infographic.
Avoid ordinary PPT feel, template collage feel, cheap marketing poster feel, messy layout, and obvious paragraph fragmentation.

【Long Infographic Production Rules】
1. First establish the final master canvas, with dimensions of {width} × {height}.
2. Automatically split continuous segments according to the final height; it is recommended that each segment's effective generation height is about 1000–1400 pixels.
3. The number of segments is automatically calculated, which can be estimated by ceil({height} / 1100).
4. Adjacent segments retain 15%–20% content overlap.
5. Each segment must inherit the visual anchor, margins, hue, texture, text temperament, structural density, and composition logic of the end of the previous segment.
6. It is not allowed to restart design for each segment; it must extend naturally like the same long infographic.
7. If content duplication, connection breakage, text distortion, or image breakdown occurs in the first generation of a certain segment, it will be automatically corrected before being included in the final stitching.

【Seamless Stitching Rules】
1. Automatically identify overlapping areas.
2. Automatically crop duplicate content.
3. Automatically perform vertical position alignment.
4. Automatically match paper texture, ink color, brightness, contrast, color temperature, and border style.
5. Use edge feathering, local repair, structural continuation, etc., to eliminate stitching marks.
6. Ensure that the main visual anchor, timeline, path, mountains, city skyline, flow line, or decorative patterns remain continuous.

【Final Check】
Automatically check and correct the following issues:
- Typos, garbled characters, fake characters
- Data errors or logical errors
- Chronological order errors
- Confusing title hierarchy
- Module duplication
- Obvious seams
- Main visual anchor breakage
- Style inconsistency between upper and lower segments
- Bottom content truncated
- Imbalance of white space
- Missing signature

【Final Output】
Only return 1 final complete long infographic.
Format: {format}
Dimensions: {width} × {height}
Ratio: {aspect_ratio}
Add an unobtrusive artistic signature "nuyoah" in the bottom right corner.
Do not return intermediate segments, do not return process descriptions, do not use short images to pretend to be long images.

prompts.text:
请根据用户输入的主题，自动制作一张超长信息图。

这不是一次普通生图任务。请将本任务视为一个完整的长图制作工程，在本轮任务中自动完成：
资料理解 / 必要时联网核验 / 信息架构规划 / 母版画布设计 / 分段连续生成 / 无缝拼接 / 错误检查 / 最终导出。

不要将极端比例简单压缩成普通竖图，也不要只生成单张短图冒充长图。不要展示中间过程、草稿、分段图或分析过程，只返回最终完整成品。

【用户输入变量】
主题：{topic}
最终宽度：{width}
最终高度：{height}
最终比例：{aspect_ratio}
视觉风格：{style}
信息密度：{density}
输出语言：{language}
是否联网：{web_mode}
文字生成方式：{text_mode}
配色倾向：{palette}
主视觉锚点：{visual_anchor}
输出格式：{format}

【自动处理规则】
1. 自动判断该主题所属类型，例如：历史 / 科技 / 商业 / 地理 / 教程 / 人物 / 文化 / 产品 / 行业分析 / 趋势总结。
2. 根据主题类型自动设计最适合的信息结构，不使用固定死板模板。
3. 如果该主题依赖真实事实、时间线、数据、发展历程、阶段划分、代表人物、真实案例或最新信息，则自动联网核验并提炼关键信息。
4. 如果主题偏概念、审美、知识整理或非时效性内容，则可直接基于已有知识完成结构设计。
5. 自动生成与主题匹配的主视觉锚点，例如：河流、路径、时间线、能量线、知识树、地图脉络、城市道路、星图结构、工艺流程、产品链路等，并使其贯穿整张长图。

【内容结构要求】
自动根据主题生成合理的信息结构。至少包含：
- 总标题
- 副标题 / 导语
- 4至10个主要章节
- 每章节下的关键要点
- 代表性视觉元素
- 底部总结 / 启示 / 结论 / 方法清单

如果主题是历史类，应优先包含：
起源、阶段演进、关键事件、代表人物、制度 / 文明 / 文化、影响与总结。

如果主题是科技类，应优先包含：
定义、核心原理、发展阶段、关键技术、代表企业 / 产品、应用场景、趋势与挑战。

如果主题是商业 / 品牌类，应优先包含：
起源、发展节点、产品 / 服务体系、商业模式、用户画像、竞争格局、关键数据、趋势总结。

如果主题是教程 / 方法论类，应优先包含：
概念定义、步骤流程、核心方法、注意事项、常见误区、工具清单、案例说明、总结建议。

【文字策略】
所有标题、章节名、正文说明、标签、年代、数字、引语、总结文字，优先由图像模型直接生成，并融入整体画面，形成AI原生一体化信息图效果。
文字必须真实可读，不得使用乱码、伪汉字或无意义占位符。
当存在明显错字、错序、事实错误、年份错误、重复段落或排版崩坏时，允许对问题区域进行局部修正，但最终风格必须保持统一，不能出现后贴式割裂感。

【视觉风格要求】
整张图必须保持统一的：
- 配色体系
- 纸张 / 背景 / 纹理逻辑
- 边距系统
- 标题字气质
- 正文字号感
- 图标系统
- 插画语言
- 版式密度
- 信息层级

默认风格为高密度、结构清晰、视觉统一、细节丰富的AI原生信息图。
避免普通PPT感、模板拼贴感、廉价营销海报感、凌乱排版和明显段落割裂。

【长图生产规则】
1. 先建立最终母版画布，尺寸为 {width} × {height}。
2. 根据最终高度自动拆分连续区段，建议每段有效生成高度约 1000–1400 像素。
3. 区段数自动计算，可按 ceil({height} / 1100) 估算。
4. 相邻区段保留 15%–20% 的内容重叠。
5. 每一段必须继承上一段结尾的视觉锚点、边距、色调、纹理、文字气质、结构密度和构图逻辑。
6. 不允许每段重新开始设计，必须像同一张长图自然延展。
7. 若某段首次生成出现内容重复、接续断裂、文字失真、图像崩坏，则自动修正后再纳入最终拼接。

【无缝拼接规则】
1. 自动识别重叠区域。
2. 自动裁切重复内容。
3. 自动进行纵向位置对齐。
4. 自动匹配纸张纹理、墨色、亮度、对比度、色温和边框风格。
5. 使用边缘羽化、局部修补、结构延续等方式消除拼接痕迹。
6. 确保主视觉锚点、时间线、路径、山脉、城市天际线、流程线或装饰纹样保持连续。

【最终检查】
自动检查并修正以下问题：
- 错字、乱码、伪字
- 数据错误或逻辑错误
- 年代顺序错误
- 标题层级混乱
- 模块重复
- 接缝明显
- 主视觉锚点断裂
- 上下段风格不一致
- 底部内容被截断
- 留白失衡
- 签名缺失

【最终输出】
只返回 1 张最终完整长图。
格式：{format}
尺寸：{width} × {height}
比例：{aspect_ratio}
右下角加入不起眼的艺术签名“nuyoah”。
不要返回中间分段，不要返回过程说明，不要用短图冒充长图。

Theme:
