Develop a minimalist advertising-style visual around any subject object, the screen uses a large area of pure white space as breathing room, the strongest subject is not a complete object, but a huge translucent circular arc color plane pressed in from the outer upper edge, the edges are cropped by the screen, only revealing a full arc and a single droplet falling downwards, forming a first-glance tension of "weight suspended above blank space." The subject content is transformed into clear and moist color blocks, dots, droplets, and local textures, gradually becoming smaller along a vertical path slightly off the central axis, passing through the subject glyphs or symbols in the middle; the glyphs use heavy black display fonts, some strokes are embedded, obscured, or replaced by subject-colored circles, making the text look as if it were perforated by liquid, pulp, minerals, or subject materials, rather than being typeset separately. Keep slender vertical main copy on the right, form small-scale explanatory text, subject carriers or information thumbnails, and price-style information groups at the bottom left, all information blocks are pressed very lightly, relying on extremely wide white space and the giant color plane above to form an asymmetrical balance. Colors are derived from the subject's semantics, the main color occupies the largest visual area, it must be high brightness, medium-high saturation, clean and transparent, white as the absolutely dominant background space, black only bears the text skeleton and a small amount of bottom information, auxiliary colors float inside the color plane with lighter, more transparent tones of the same or neighboring brightness. The main color plane should have a material feel of jelly, clear juice, glazed surface, or light colors on wet paper, with soft cloud-like precipitates, shallow scratches, transparent overlapping colors, and irregular bright spots appearing inside, the edges are clean but locally have rounded closures of falling liquid; the whole maintains a bright, restrained, natural feel without filter-like heaviness. The text system is mainly based on a vertical reading rhythm, the body text is thin, narrow, and sparse, the title or subject characters are thick, black, and low-decoration, with a clear size difference; it is forbidden to let decorations fill the blank space, the failure state is the color blocks becoming a normal background, the droplets losing vertical rhythm, the text and circles no longer interlocking, or the subject object stealing the clarity and quietness brought by the white space.

items.title: 品牌全案中文视觉提案板生成指令

prompts.text:
【Store Type】: 【Fill in, e.g., Offline Retail / Catering / Service Store】
【Brand Name】: 【Fill in】
【Store Scale and Location】: 【Fill in】
【Brand Temperament】: 【Fill in 3–5 words】
【Main Color】: 【Fill in】
【Accent Color】: 【Fill in】
【Core Graphic Language】: 【Fill in, e.g., botanical line art / geometric facets / hand-drawn maps】
【Main Materials】: 【Fill in 4–6 real materials】
【Store Core Product or Service】: 【Fill in】
【Main Title】: 【Fill in】
【Subtitle】: 【Fill in】
【Chinese Text Allowed per Image】: 【List per image, the fewer the better】

Use official ChatGPT-Image2 to generate a set of 4 independently outputted 3:4 vertical Chinese brand proposal boards. The four must belong to the same brand system but undertake different business tasks respectively; each image should be a separate output, not a 4-in-1, not a nine-square grid, and do not just change items while repeating the same composition.

First, establish a unified system: use [Main Color], [Accent Color], [Core Graphic Language], and [Main Materials] throughout the four images; use clear modern Chinese fonts for titles; all Chinese characters are natively generated by the model within the bitmap, with few and large characters, each being correct. Unify the light source, material precision, rounded corners, line thickness, and rhythm of white space, while giving each image a different visual focus and reading path.

1st Image | Space Entrance
Show a realistic and feasible store exterior, storefront, window display, or reception entrance, and supplement with 2–3 close-up key details. The main space occupies more than half of the frame; use brand graphics or a continuous visual line to connect details, do not cut the page into regular small grids. Focus on verifying brand identification, business information, product display, and street visibility.

2nd Image | Products and Packaging
Show core products or service carriers, as well as packaging, tote bags, stickers, cards, protective sleeves, and other supporting materials. Use packaging unfoldings, structural breakdowns, or continuous material bands to form the composition; clearly represent real textures such as paper, fabric, glass, metal, wood, and plastic. Do not make ordinary e-commerce white background images.

3rd Image | Circulation and Wayfinding
Use 3D axonometric, top-down space, or clear scene perspective to show the process of customers entering, selecting, being served, and leaving. Supplement with classification signs, process cards, number plates, price tags, or functional wayfinding. Circulation must be reasonable and cannot go through walls; furniture and pedestrian scales must be feasible; do not generate Dashboards or fake UIs.

4th Image | Opening Communication
Show a main poster and extend it to window stickers, invitation cards, door stickers, and social media vertical images. Offline and online materials must come from the same visual system, but do not include phone frames, platform UIs, like counts, QR codes, discount prices, or fictional URLs. Use paper ribbons, graphics, materials, or light and shadow to connect various materials into a continuous picture.

Composition and Quality Requirements:
- Each image should only keep 1 main visual, 2–4 auxiliary modules, and enough white space.
- Text and objects should blend naturally, do not awkwardly paste text, and do not use dense descriptions.
- Light source and shadow directions must be unified; architectural proportions, packaging structures, perspectives, and item scales must be realistic.
- Chinese text on packaging, storefronts, labels, and posters must be clearly readable, without generating extra paragraphs or gibberish.
- The four images should use four types of information architecture: space, structure, process, and communication, respectively; do not copy the same layout.
- The overall quality should reach the level of a professional brand design company's proposal, showing style as well as how it can be implemented.

Avoid:
Replicating the theme, industry, items, title rhythm, and iconic composition of the reference images; overhead shots of light gray concrete equipment, huge English serif titles, handwritten ornate initials, stacked ID cards and receipts; nine-square grids, fake UIs, strong e-commerce feel, cheap promotional feel, children's illustration feel, over-saturation, incorrect Chinese, misspelled brand names, deformed objects, repetitive elements, unnatural shadows, and spaces that cannot be constructed.

【主标题】：【填写】
【副标题】：【填写】
【每张图允许出现的中文】：【逐张列出，越少越好】

使用官方 ChatGPT-Image2 生成一套 4 张独立输出的 3:4 竖版中文品牌提案板。四张必须属于同一品牌系统，但分别承担不同商业任务；每张单独成图，不要四合一，不要九宫格，不要只换物品重复同一构图。

先建立统一系统：使用【主色】、【点缀色】、【核心图形语言】和【主要材质】贯穿四张；标题统一使用清晰的现代中文字体；所有中文由模型原生生成在位图中，文字少而大、逐字正确。统一光源、材质精度、圆角、线条粗细和留白节奏，同时让每张拥有不同的视觉重心与阅读路径。

第 1 张｜空间入口
展示真实可落地的门店外观、门头、橱窗或接待入口，并补充 2–3 个关键细节近景。主体空间占画面一半以上；用品牌图形或一条连续视觉线连接细节，不要把页面切成规则小格。重点验证品牌识别、营业信息、商品陈列和街道可见性。

第 2 张｜商品与包装
展示核心商品或服务载体，以及包装、手提袋、贴纸、卡片、保护套等配套物料。用包装展开、结构拆解或连续材料带形成构图；清楚表现纸张、织物、玻璃、金属、木材、塑料等真实质感。不要做普通电商白底图。

第 3 张｜动线与导视
使用 3D 轴测、俯视空间或清楚的场景透视展示顾客从进入、选择、服务到离开的流程。补充分类牌、流程卡、号码牌、价签或功能导视。动线必须合理、不能穿墙，家具与人行尺度可落地；不要生成 Dashboard 或假 UI。

第 4 张｜开业传播
展示一张主海报，并延展到橱窗贴、邀请卡、门贴和社交竖图。线下与线上物料必须来自同一视觉系统，但不要出现手机框、平台 UI、点赞数、二维码、折扣价格或虚构网址。用纸带、图形、材质或光影把各物料连成连续画面。

构图与质量要求：
- 每张只保留 1 个主视觉、2–4 个辅助模块和足够留白。
- 文字与物件自然融合，不要生硬贴字，不要密集说明。
- 光源和阴影方向统一，建筑比例、包装结构、透视和物品尺度真实。
- 中文包装、门头、标签和海报文字必须清晰可读，不生成额外段落或乱码。
- 四张分别使用空间、结构、流程、传播四种信息架构，不能复制同一个版式。
- 整体达到专业品牌设计公司提案级，能看出风格，也能看出如何落地。

避免：
复刻参考图的主题、行业、物品、标题节奏和标志性构图；浅灰水泥装备俯拍、巨大英文衬线标题、手写花体首字母、工牌票据堆叠；九宫格、假 UI、强电商感、廉价促销感、儿童插画感、过饱和、错误中文、品牌拼错、物品变形、重复元素、不自然阴影和无法施工的空间。

items.title: 夜间都市工业风时尚大片肖像

prompts.text: Create a realistic, avant-garde night urban fashion editorial portrait, the subject is an East Asian adult female over 21 years old, standing on a dim industrial rooftop or open-air parking lot. She is located slightly left of the center of the frame, full body from boots to head, leaning against a towering, weather-beaten concrete steel pillar. This steel pillar has peeling paint, a rough surface, and is covered with bolts, stains, and worn metal edges. The camera angle is low, slightly upward, creating a strong cinematic feel and elongating her figure. Her pose is bold and confident: one arm raised high above her head, palm resting on the pillar; the other arm hanging naturally, close to her thigh. She leans against the pillar in a steady three-quarter stance, one leg straight, the other slightly bent, hips naturally tilted, shoulders relaxed yet powerful. She looks down slightly at the camera with a calm and confident expression, lips slightly parted, light smoky eyeliner, long eyelashes, translucent skin, well-defined contours, and a soft rosy nude lip color. She has long dark brownish-black hair, falling naturally and slightly messy, with a few strands gently draping on both sides of her cheeks. The hair shines under soft rim lighting, blending naturally with the deep background. She is wearing a blue cropped denim jacket with rugged street-style designs such as distressed stitching, rolled cuffs, and metal buttons. Underneath is a black slim-fit tube-style crop top. For the bottom, she wears black denim mini shorts, a wide dark leather belt decorated with metal buckles, and a pair of black high-top leather boots, with a distressed surface, buckles, folds, and a pointed toe design. The overall look should combine rebelliousness, cinematic feel, urbanity, and high-fashion sense, while remaining tasteful and stylish. The scene is set in a dim industrial building at night, with exposed beams, concrete pillars, wet reflective ground, deep shadows, and distant city skyline lights faintly visible through the open sides. A strong cool white slanted beam of light enters from the top right background, piercing through the mist, illuminating floating dust, and creating a dramatic atmosphere. The distant cityscape should have soft blue-amber bokeh, there should be subtle reflections on the ground, and deep shadow spaces should be left around the figure. The lighting should adopt a low-key and cinematic style; a cool-toned spotlight on the right should illuminate the figure's face, collarbone, torso, denim jacket, legs, boots, and the texture of the pillar, creating bright highlights. Add soft rim light around her hair, raised arm, jacket edges, and boot silhouettes. Use high contrast, deep blacks, a smoky atmosphere, realistic skin textures, clear denim and leather details, smooth ground reflections, and exquisite post-processing effects. Style: Realistic avant-garde urban fashion photography, adult model, low angle power pose, open denim jacket, black crop top, black denim shorts, black high leather boots, industrial rooftop at night, rough concrete pillar, dramatic spotlight beam, wet reflective floor, distant city lights, cinematic shadows, high contrast, shallow depth of field, vertical aspect ratio, high detail, no text, no watermark, no logo, no other people, no distorted anatomy, no cartoon style, no overexposure, no clutter, no explicit nudity.

prompts.text:
创作一幅写实、风格前卫的夜间都市时尚大片肖像，拍摄对象是一位21岁以上的东亚成年女性，她站在昏暗的工业屋顶或露天停车场中。她位于画面中心偏左的位置，从靴子到头部，全身入镜，倚靠在一根高耸的、饱经风霜的混凝土钢柱上。这根钢柱油漆剥落，表面粗糙，布满螺栓、污渍和磨损的金属边缘。相机角度较低，略微向上，营造出强烈的电影感，并拉长了她的身形。

她的姿势大胆自信：一只手臂高举过头，手掌倚靠在柱子上；另一只手臂自然垂落，靠近大腿。她以稳健的四分之三站姿倚靠在柱子上，一条腿伸直，另一条腿微微弯曲，臀部自然倾斜，肩膀放松却不失气场。她微微低头看向镜头，神态沉稳而自信，双唇微启，眼线淡淡烟熏，睫毛纤长，肌肤透亮，轮廓分明，唇色是柔和的玫瑰裸色。

她拥有一头深棕黑色的长发，自然垂落，略带凌乱，几缕发丝轻柔地垂在脸颊两侧。头发在柔和的轮廓光下熠熠生辉，与深沉的背景自然融合。

她身穿一件蓝色牛仔短款夹克，夹克采用做旧缝线、卷边袖口、金属纽扣等粗犷的街头风格设计。内搭一件黑色修身抹胸式露脐上衣。下身搭配黑色超短牛仔短裤、一条饰有金属扣的宽版深色皮带，以及一双黑色高筒皮靴，靴子表面做旧处理，带有搭扣、褶皱和尖头设计。整体造型应兼具叛逆、电影感、都市感和高级时尚感，同时又不失品味和时尚感。

场景设定为夜晚的昏暗工业建筑，裸露的横梁、混凝土柱、湿润反光的地面、深邃的阴影，以及透过敞开的侧面隐约可见的远处城市天际线灯光。一束强烈的冷白色斜光束从右上角背景射入，穿透薄雾，照亮了漂浮的尘埃，营造出戏剧性的氛围。远处城市景观应呈现柔和的蓝琥珀色散景，地面上应有微妙的反射，人物周围则应留出深邃的阴影空间。

灯光应采用低调而富有电影感的风格，右侧的一束冷色调聚光灯应照亮人物的脸部、锁骨、躯干、牛仔外套、腿部、靴子以及柱子的纹理，营造出明亮的高光。在她的头发、抬起的手臂、外套边缘和靴子轮廓周围添加柔和的轮廓光。运用高对比度、深邃的黑色、烟雾缭绕的氛围、逼真的皮肤纹理、清晰的牛仔和皮革细节、光滑的地面反射，以及精致的后期处理效果。

风格：写实前卫都市时尚摄影，成人模特，低角度摆出力量姿势，敞开的牛仔夹克，黑色露脐上衣，黑色牛仔短裤，黑色高筒皮靴，夜晚的工业屋顶，粗糙的混凝土柱，戏剧性的聚光灯光束，湿润的反光地板，远处的城市灯光，电影般的阴影，高对比度，浅景深，竖幅比例，高细节，无文字，无水印，无标志，无其他人，无扭曲的解剖结构，无卡通风格，无过度曝光，无杂物，无露骨的裸露。

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 high-end spatial portrait editorial poster.

Theme: [custom original title]
Subject: [male / female / Asian / Western fashion figure]
Color palette: [deep navy + silver / violet dusk / charcoal + orange / teal gray + burnt orange]
Visual structure: [oversized typography / foreground blur / portrait fragments / motion trails]
Supporting text: [2–4 short original phrases]
Year: 2026

Build the composition around one strong spatial relationship between the portrait and the graphic system. Typography, foreground figures, blur, repeated portrait fragments, and depth should feel integrated into the image rather than simply layered on top.

4 directions:

1. BETWEEN LINES
A full-body fashion figure standing inside monumental oversized typography. Let the letters sit behind and around the body, with parts extending toward the floor to create architectural depth and perspective.

2. VELVET HOUR
A sharply focused subject in the midground, while another person passes very close to the camera as a soft blurred foreground silhouette. Use dusk light, atmospheric depth, and subtle visual tension to create a cinematic story between the two figures.

3. SPLIT PRESENCE
One clear central portrait surrounded by uneven vertical slices of the same face. Mix sharp, softly blurred, enlarged, and partially hidden fragments over a dark atmospheric background, with one strong accent-color strip as a visual anchor.

4. PASSING LIGHT
A quiet subject standing in the midground while a blurred moving figure or light trail crosses the foreground. Combine muted cool tones with warm burnt-orange light and oversized background typography to suggest passing time and memory.

Use realistic skin texture, natural hair, cinematic lighting, subtle grain, strong negative space, and refined editorial typography.

Keep each poster focused on one main visual mechanism.

构图：
采用纵向海报布局，具有强烈的中心或略微偏离中心的构图。放置一位健康的运动型西方女性徒步者，站在或行走在荒漠小径、峡谷边缘、干燥的脊线路径或开阔的沙路上，营造出强烈的距离感和探索感。她的姿势应该显得自然、沉着且安静坚定，仿佛在漫长的旅程中停下来扫描地平线。
New Balance 2002R 必须在她的脚上清晰可见，以强大的产品现实主义呈现，并有足够的临场感以保持其视觉锚点地位。在场景周围，在天空、侧边栏和开阔地面区域布置干净的白色或褪色粉笔感手绘日志图形：路线箭头、里程计数、海拔笔记、微型地图碎片、沙漠符号、营地图标、天气标记、手写观察、坐标和轨迹标记。构图应显得丰富且身临其境，但仍保持高端且美观受控。

产品现实主义：
以绝对的真实感和精确的品牌忠实度渲染 New Balance 2002R：
高端麂皮覆盖层、
技术网眼底层、
分层的复古跑步结构、
标志性的大号 N 字 Logo、
精确的鞋跟支撑几何形状、
精致的缝线、
分段式缓震语言、
真实的实地外底深度、
以及真实的 New Balance 2002R 比例。
鞋子必须感觉有触感、昂贵且物理真实，具有可信的麂皮绒面、透气的网眼纹理、微妙的沙漠尘土痕迹和自然的色调分离。它必须是确凿无疑的 New Balance 2002R，绝不是普通的徒步鞋类。

徒步者方向：
使用一位健康的运动型西方女性模特，具有自然的社论美感、强大的姿态和非网红脸。她应该显得有能力、独立，并以一种精致的方式呈现出饱经风霜的状态。为她搭配高端轻便的旅行装备：技术背包、修身的性能层、透气的徒步裤或短裤、极简的多功能夹克或衬衫，以及干净的功能性配饰。
她的表情应该显得深思、冷静且由好奇心驱动。她应该看起来像一个真实的远距离旅行者，被提升为高端广告图像。

手绘记录语言：
整合富有表现力、干净、自发的手绘实地日志图形，仿佛实时记录穿越荒漠的旅程。包括：
里程计数、
路线图、
微型地图、
海拔笔记、
太阳图标、
风力符号、
帐篷草图、
距离标记、
手写观察、
坐标符号、
以及方向箭头。
线条感应显得快速、智能、自然且高端，就像旅行笔记本混合了设计草稿。保持标记干净且时尚，绝不幼稚或混乱。

环境：
将场景设定在真实的荒漠小径环境中，拥有开阔的天空、风化的岩石、干燥的脊线、沙调的土地、峡谷边缘、布满灰尘的小径和远方分层的地貌。环境应显得辽阔、电影感。

prompts.text:
Theme:
A night melting in the lights

Subject:
In an apartment living room at night, a woman in her 20s leans leisurely on a deep gray sofa. The character enters the frame significantly from the center-right, including everything from the upper body to the bare feet. Emphasize the legs stretched forward, with a black smartphone placed on the bottom left of the sofa.

Character/Expression:
Natural and friendly female style, slightly rounded oval contour. Small chin, soft cheeks, subtle bridge of the nose. Bright ivory beige skin with residual pale pink flush, showing realistic texture of pores and fine skin grain. Rose pink blush, pink-brown eye makeup, slender eyelashes, natural tear bags, translucent pink-beige lip gloss. Gaze directed towards the bottom left of the frame, a faint smile appearing at the corners of the mouth. Hair is milk tea gray-brown medium-length hair. Thin see-through bangs and layers around the face, natural back hair strands and delicate hair flow.

Clothing/Pose:
Ribbed material V-neck camisole from white to light ivory. The neckline is decorated with fine lace, the fabric is soft and naturally fits the body. The bottom is light gray short lounge shorts with a white drawstring tied in the center of the waist. The right arm is on the sofa backrest, and the right hand lightly touches the hair. The left hand hangs relaxedly at the side of the chest, fingers naturally curled. The left leg is bent and raised, and the right leg is extended toward the camera. Precisely represent the stretching of the clothes, the waist folds, and the weight of the body sinking into the sofa.

Background/Lighting:
A quiet interior at night. The window at the back left of the frame lets in bluish-white city lights, which are significantly blurred. At the back right, there is small indirect lighting and foliage plants, as well as a shelf with a restrained sense of daily life. The main light source is warm indoor light entering from the top right of the frame, softly illuminating the cheeks, shoulders, collarbones, and the upper side of the thighs. Faint blue reflected light from the window is added to the left side of the frame, forming a natural contrast between warm and cold colors. Shadows fall gently on the bottom left of the sofa.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical 2:3. A close-up shot of the sofa seat and the character, a relaxed portrait. The shot is taken from a position slightly lower than the waist using a lens equivalent to 35mm. The raised legs are placed in the foreground for emphasis, with the face in precise focus. The background is naturally blurred with a shallow depth of field. Do not crop the top of the head, hands, or toes, leaving moderate blank space at the right cushion and the left night view.

Texture/Style:
A natural indoor photograph taken with a high-sensitivity full-frame camera. Delicately depict fine irregularities of the skin, fine hairs, every strand of hair, ribbed fabric, lace, and fibers of the sofa fabric. Avoid excessive HDR or skin smoothing, preserving a bit of high-sensitivity noise and gentle contrast. Warm and quiet night color tones, realistic photographic expression.

Negative Prompt:
Anime style, illustration style, CG feel, excessive skin smoothing, plastic-like skin, unnatural facial features, unnatural gaze, asymmetrical eyes, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands and feet, broken joints, unnatural leg length, clothing marks, floating, wrong perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

服装·姿势：
从白色到浅象牙白的罗纹材质V领吊带背心。领口饰以细致蕾丝，布料柔软自然贴合身体。下装是浅灰色的短款居家短裤，腰部中央系有白色抽绳。右臂搭在沙发靠背上，右手轻触头发。左手放松垂在胸口侧边，手指自然弯曲。左腿屈膝抬起，右腿向镜头方向伸展。精确表现衣物的拉伸、腰部褶皱，以及身体沉入沙发的重量感。

背景·光线：
夜晚宁静的室内。画面左后方的窗户透入青白色的城市灯光，大幅虚化。右后方有小型间接照明和观叶植物，以及克制生活感的架子。主光源从画面右上方进入的暖色室内灯，柔和照亮脸颊、肩膀、锁骨和大腿上侧。画面左侧添加窗户传来的微弱蓝色反射光，形成暖色与冷色的自然对比。阴影温和地落在沙发左下方。

构图·镜头：
纵向2:3。沙发坐面和人物的近距离拍摄，放松的肖像照。镜头从腰部稍低的位置，使用相当于35mm的镜头拍摄。将抬起双腿置于前景突出，脸部精准对焦。背景以浅景深自然虚化。不裁剪头顶、手部和脚尖，在右侧靠垫和左侧夜景处留出适度空白。

质感·风格：
使用高感度全画幅相机拍摄的自然室内照片。细腻描绘肌肤的微小凹凸、汗毛、每一根发丝、罗纹布料、蕾丝、沙发织物的纤维。避免过度HDR或美肌修饰，保留些许高感度噪点和温和对比度。温暖宁静的夜晚色调，现实的摄影表现。

围绕任意主题对象生成具有倒置观影感的海报式画面：上方以主题派生的深暗环境或剪影形成沉重遮蔽，边缘保持不规则、湿润、被光吞没的轮廓，中上部留出一个小而孤立的倒悬符号或主题化身，使它像从黑暗边界垂入下方明亮空间；下方展开大块清透发光的冷色场，颜色由主题推导，但必须保持深暗低明度占据上端、明亮洁净的水光色成为主场、少量偏暖高饱和细线作为情绪注脚的关系。主要文字采用巨幅手写式飞白笔触横贯画面中段，笔画粗细跳跃、拖尾很长、局部断裂和晕散，像白色光痕写在潮湿水面上，字势略倾斜并跨越空旷背景，成为第一眼的视觉冲击；可加入一行更细的主题短句，以荧光般的暖色手写线压低在大字下方，保持随手写下的轻微失衡。上下边缘的小号信息字使用冷白窄体大写感排布，字距拉开、行距克制、居中成组，只用于建立电影字幕般的秩序，不抢过手写光字。整体质感保持低照度、清洁水汽、轻微颗粒和柔软压暗，亮处有水面扩散的雾化边，暗处不可变成均匀黑块；失败时若大字像普通书法标题、背景像平面渐变、剪影不再倒悬压迫，画面就会失去这种夜色水光中的悬置感。


——————
片名方向: 雨夜告别+倒悬街巷轮廓+湿地反光+手写片名
院线用途: 文艺剧情片宣传海报+影展报名主视觉
暖色调配色: 暖橙灯光+奶白雾面+深棕黑影+低饱和柔暗
画面焦点: 斜向街灯倒影+边缘压暗建筑剪影+人物只作远处小焦点，竖版 3:4

prompts.text:
A three-panel character reference sheet, the composition is a horizontal image, equally divided into three side-by-side vertical panels (three-panel character reference sheet), with clean and thin dividing lines between the panels, the same character and the same outfit are presented completely identically across the three panels.

A young woman, slender and well-proportioned body, sweet and pure temperament. Pink-purple (dusty rose pink-purple) long wavy hair, straight bangs, large waves reaching the waist, hair is smooth and lustrous, a black satin bow hair clip decorated with pearl strings on the left side of the hair. Soft and rounded face shape, full cheeks, slender jawline; almond eyes, dark brown pupils, gaze is clear and gentle; soft curved eyebrows, a small bridge of the nose, full petal lips. Skin is fair, translucent, and hydrated, light pink blush on the cheeks, natural makeup look, nude pink glossy lips. A pair of small pearl earrings on the ears, a thin silver chain pendant on the neck. (This identity description applies to all three panels)

Wearing a black velvet camisole short dress, V-shaped neckline trimmed with white lace, thin shoulder straps, slim-fit cut fits the slender curves, the hem falls at the mid-thigh; lower body wears black semi-transparent stockings, and black high heels on the feet. (This styling description applies to all three panels)

Left panel —— Frontal full body, headless. The character's body faces the camera directly, from below the shoulders down to the shoes, arms hanging naturally at the sides, hands relaxed and open, weight distributed evenly on both feet. No head, no hair—nothing rises above the shoulder line, no hair hanging down in front of the chest or on the shoulders. The neck rises briefly upward from the shoulders, terminating at the base of the throat with a clean, flat, clearly defined horizontal cut, like a headless mannequin model—neat sculptural cut edge, edges are clearly visible, not blurred, not out of focus, not dissipated, no smoke, no afterimages, no transparency, no blood, no anatomical details. Above the cut is only the blank medium gray background. This panel retains complete top-of-the-head space—sufficient blank space is left above the shoulder line so that the character's proportion and position in the frame are consistent with a normal full-body portrait.

Middle panel —— Back full body, with head. The same character filmed from directly behind, standing posture is straight, the pink-purple long wavy hair naturally falls to the waist from the back, the back construction of the black velvet camisole dress, the crossing of the thin shoulder straps, and the hem are clearly visible, arms hanging naturally at the sides, hands relaxed, completely in frame from the top of the head to the black high heels, black stockings wrap the long legs.

Right panel —— Chest-up extreme close-up, identity lock. A tight composition from slightly above the top of the head to the collarbone, only showing the uppermost edge of the dress, the face occupies most of the frame, a true close-up. Body faces the camera, head looking straight, eyes looking directly at the camera, lips closed and relaxed, a neutral and restrained gentle expression, an extremely shallow closed-lip smile. The pink-purple straight bangs, soft curved eyebrows, long eyelashes, the lip texture of the full petal lips, the black bow pearl hair clip, and the silver chain pendant are all clearly discernible at close range.

Unified background for the three panels: A flat and even 18% medium gray seamless background, single color value, no gradient, no attenuation (flat 18% gray seamless). Directionless and shadowless frontal illumination, fill light is uniform and consistent all around, no key light side, no shadow side, no rim light, no glow, no edge light (shadowless frontal illumination), no projection on the background, no contact shadow under the feet (zero cast shadow), the lighting in the three panels is completely consistent.

Photorealistic quality (photorealistic), skin shows fine and even pores and subsurface scattering (subsurface scattering), hair strands are distinct (strand-level hair), the fabric textures of velvet, lace, and stockings are clear (fabric weave), slight film grain (theatrical grain). Real human, shot with a real camera, absolutely not plastic-feeling, absolutely not a render, absolutely not CGI, no AI skin smoothing, no over-smoothing.

prompts.text:
一张三格人物设定参考图，构图为一个横向画面，等分为三个并排的竖直分格 (three-panel character reference sheet)，格与格之间是干净纤细的分隔线，同一位人物、同一套造型在三格中完全一致地呈现。

一位青年女性，纤细匀称身形，甜美清纯气质。粉紫色（灰调玫瑰粉紫）长卷发，齐刘海，大波浪卷发长及腰际，发丝柔顺有光泽，左侧头发处一枚黑色缎面蝴蝶结发夹点缀珍珠串。柔和圆润脸型，饱满脸颊，纤细下颌线；杏眼，深棕色瞳孔，眼神清澈温柔；柔和弯眉，小巧鼻梁，饱满花瓣唇。皮肤白皙透亮水润，脸颊淡淡粉色腮红，妆感自然，裸粉润唇。耳部一对小巧珍珠耳饰，颈部一条纤细银链吊坠。（此段身份描述适用于全部三格）

身穿一件黑色天鹅绒吊带短裙，V 字领口缀白色蕾丝花边，细肩带，收身剪裁贴合纤细曲线，裙摆落在大腿中段；下身黑色半透明丝袜，脚踩黑色高跟鞋。（此段造型描述适用于全部三格）

左格 —— 正面全身，无头。人物身体正对镜头，从肩部以下直到鞋子，双臂自然垂放身侧，双手放松张开，重心均匀落在双脚。没有头部、没有头发——没有任何东西高出肩线，胸前与肩上没有头发垂落。颈部从肩膀向上短短升起，在喉咙根部以一条干净、平整、边缘清晰的水平切口收束，如同无头人台模特——利落的雕塑感切边，边缘清晰可见，不模糊、不虚化、不消散、无烟雾、无残影、无透明、无血迹、无解剖细节。切口之上只有空白的中灰背景。此格保留完整头顶空间——肩线上方留有充足的空白，使人物在画面中的比例与位置与正常全身像一致。

中格 —— 背面全身，带头。同一人物从正后方拍摄，站姿笔直，粉紫色长卷发从背后自然垂落及腰，黑色天鹅绒吊带裙的裙背构造、细肩带交叉、裙摆清晰可见，双臂自然垂放身侧，双手放松，重心均匀落在双脚，从头顶到黑色高跟鞋完整入镜，黑色丝袜包裹修长双腿。

右格 —— 齐胸大特写，身份锁定。同一人物从头顶略上方到锁骨、仅露出裙子最上缘的紧凑构图，脸部占据画面大部分，真正的近景特写。身体正对镜头，头部平视，双眼直视镜头，双唇闭合放松，中性克制的温柔神情，极浅的闭唇微笑。粉紫齐刘海、柔和弯眉、纤长睫毛、饱满花瓣唇的唇部质感、黑蝴蝶结珍珠发夹、银链吊坠，在近距离下全部清晰可辨。

三格统一背景：平坦均匀的 18% 中灰无缝背景，单一色值，无渐变无衰减 (flat 18% gray seamless)。无方向无阴影的正面照明，四周补光均匀一致，无主光侧、无阴影侧、无轮廓光、无发光、无边缘光 (shadowless frontal illumination)，背景无任何投影，脚下无接触阴影 (zero cast shadow)，三格光照完全一致。

真实照片级质感 (photorealistic)，皮肤可见细腻均匀毛孔与次表面散射 (subsurface scattering)，发丝根根分明 (strand-level hair)，天鹅绒、蕾丝、丝袜织物纹理清晰 (fabric weave)，轻微胶片颗粒 (theatrical grain)。真实人类，真实相机拍摄，绝非塑料感、绝非渲染、绝非 CGI、无 AI 磨皮、无过度平滑。

items.title: 桥本有菜春日樱花Codex皮肤概念图

prompts.text:
A high-end Codex desktop application skin concept map with Arina Hashimoto as the character theme, fully displaying the Windows desktop software interface, front eye-level screenshot composition, no perspective tilt. The overall integration of fresh Japanese-style photography, spring cherry blossoms, light luxury fashion magazines, and modern digital creative spaces presents a gentle, bright, exquisite, and romantic but not overly sweet visual temperament; this is an unofficial tribute-style concept design, and official authorization logos do not appear.

The overall color scheme uses cherry blossom pink, cream white, champagne gold, light gray purple, and soft rose brown. Interface materials combine delicate washi paper, translucent tulle, mother-of-pearl, frosted acrylic, and light-colored metal. The background uses soft-focus cherry blossom branches, light pink watercolor smudges, light petals, small starlight, and elegant curves as decorations, paired with the soft natural light of a spring afternoon. All floral elements remain sparse and restrained, highlighting the characters and interface information, without forming a wedding poster or cheap pink sticker style.

A gradient navigation bar of cream white and very light cherry blossom pink is set on the left, with the concise word "Codex" and an abstract icon composed of cherry blossom petals and code brackets displayed at the top. The navigation items are "New Inspiration", "Schedule", "Creation Plugins", "Photo Archives", "Version Records", and "Collaboration Space" in order. The project list below includes "Spring Photos", "Styling Inspiration", "Lens Notes", "Color Collection", and "Travel Snippets", and the task list includes "Organize Photos", "Select Styling", "Record Inspiration", and "Complete Layout". Icons uniformly adopt slender rose gold lines, including cameras, petals, hangers, picture frames, starlight, and folders.

The top of the main content area displays "Arina Hashimoto's Exclusive Creative Space", with "Unofficial Concept Skin" marked in small text next to it. A large horizontal main visual welcome area is set in the center, using soft rounded corners, with the background naturally transitioning from cream white, light pink, and light gray purple, adding tulle light and shadow, bokeh spots, and a small amount of falling petals. The left side retains the title and functional information, and the right side displays a high-quality realistic character portrait of Arina Hashimoto.

The character presents the image of an adult East Asian woman, with recognizable exquisite facial features, black or dark brown long hair, soft bangs, clear natural makeup, and a gentle and confident expression. Wearing a dignified and elegant light pink tulle dress or champagne-colored fashion dress, the neckline and skirt design are appropriate, not exposing, not transparent, paired with small pearl earrings. The character's body is slightly turned toward the camera, hands naturally folded near the chin or lightly supporting the side of the face, the posture is elegant and relaxed, gazing at the camera. Using high-end Japanese fashion magazine photography, soft window light, natural skin texture, delicate hair strands, and shallow depth of field, the character naturally integrates with the interface background.

The left side of the main visual welcome area displays a striking Chinese title "What do you want to create today?", and the subtitle "Collect inspiration, let every moment glow gently". Elegant abstract English handwritten lines are added above the title as decoration, but do not copy real signatures or proprietary wordmarks. The text uses deep rose brown to ensure clear contrast with the light background.

Four cream-white rounded functional cards are arranged horizontally at the bottom of the main visual welcome area, using rose gold fine outlines, light pink icons, and soft shadows. The first card uses a camera icon with the text "Organize Images"; the second uses a picture frame icon with the text "Collect Inspiration"; the third uses a palette icon with the text "Explore Color Matching"; the fourth uses starlight and tool icons with the text "Perfect Works". The cards are uniform in size and evenly spaced, with only a small number of petals and tiny starlight added at the corners, not obscuring the text and icons.

Directly below the main visual welcome area, an independent large horizontal rounded creative panel is set, strictly aligned with the left and right edges of the main content area, close to the full width of the content area, with a height of about one-fourth of the main content area. It must rest stably at the bottom of the page and be a complete, clear, and operable input panel, not a floating chat bubble, narrow search bar, capsule input box, terminal, or independent pop-up window.

The outer background of the creative panel is designed as a gradient from cream white to very light cherry blossom pink according to the character theme, with very subtle washi fibers, pearl soft light, and tulle textures. The edges use slender rose gold outlines and soft light brown pink shadows. The overall color is quieter and less decorated than the main visual welcome area, which is consistent with the Japanese photography and spring cherry blossom themes while keeping the input area clear and legible.

A small folder icon and the partition text "Images" are set in the upper left corner of the outer panel. A wide rounded input area is embedded inside the panel, with clear, slender light rose gold outlines all around, and the internal background is a clean warm cream white, retaining ample white space for writing. The placeholder text is located in the upper left of the input area, content is "Write down an inspiration, a scene, or a moment you want to record...". Only a very light petal watermark and a slender curve are kept in the background of the input area, and decorations cannot enter the main text area.

In the same input panel, a complete bottom control bar is set: on the far left is a circular plus button with a rose gold fine border; next to it are "Full Access" mode controls and a favorite icon; on the right are the model status "5.6 Sol Mid", a down arrow, and a microphone icon; on the far right is a solid circular send button, using a soft rose pink to coral pink gradient, with a clear cream white upward arrow inside. The corners of the panel are only decorated with a small sprig of light pink cherry blossoms, two or three petals, and a small amount of pearl starlight, not obscuring the placeholder text, model selector, or send button.

A slightly tilted vintage Polaroid photo can be stacked in the lower right corner, showing a half-length photo of the character in soft window light, fixed with a short piece of light pink ribbon tape; the photo cannot obscure the important controls of the input panel.

The interface must maintain a real, complete, and operable desktop application structure, rather than a character promotional poster. The character occupies about one-third of the right side of the main visual welcome area, and the left title, four functional cards, and the bottom input panel are clear and complete. Using high-end commercial UI/UX design, precise grids, clear visual hierarchy, loose white space, uniform rounded corners, delicate outlines, restrained shadows, real materials, and Japanese magazine-level color grading. All specified Chinese text is clearly discernible and presents short texts such as "New Inspiration", "Schedule", "Photo Archives", "What do you want to create today?", "Organize Images", "Collect Inspiration", "Explore Color Matching", "Perfect Works", and "Images" as accurately as possible. Ultra-high detail, 4K product display quality, complete window borders, without cropping any important components.

Aspect ratio 16:10

Negative constraints: low resolution, blurred, pixelated, over-sharpened, overexposed, over-saturated colors, cheap pink filters, gaudy studio style, wedding poster style, cartoon idol style, excessive roses, heart stickers, piled up petals, cluttered background, messy interface hierarchy, misaligned components, cropped window, severe perspective distortion, repeated cards, repeated characters, overlapping text, garbled Chinese, random English letters, wrong menu text, bottom input box size too small, input box becomes narrow search bar, capsule-shaped input box, floating chat bubble, input panel detached from the page, input panel becomes terminal or pop-up, missing outer large panel, missing inner input outline, missing bottom control bar, missing circular plus or send button, input area filled with floral decorations, input box uses pure black smoked glass, sexual hints, nude clothing, transparent clothing, lingerie styling, suggestive poses, character face drift, wrong hairstyle, wrong age performance, exaggerated expressions, waxy feeling, plastic skin, wrong body proportions, hand deformities, extra fingers, extra arms, fused fingers, hard edges between character and background, copying real signatures, forging official logos, presenting as official cooperation or officially authorized product, watermark.

prompts.text:
一张以桥本有菜为人物主题的高端 Codex 桌面应用皮肤概念图，完整展示 Windows 桌面软件界面，正面平视截图构图，无透视倾斜。整体融合清新日系写真、春日樱花、轻奢时尚杂志与现代数字创作空间，呈现温柔、明亮、精致、浪漫但不过度甜腻的视觉气质；这是非官方致敬型概念设计，不出现官方授权标识。

整体采用樱花粉、奶油白、香槟金、浅灰紫和柔和玫瑰棕配色。界面材质结合细腻和纸、半透明薄纱、珍珠母贝、磨砂亚克力与浅色金属。背景使用柔焦樱花枝、淡粉水彩晕染、轻盈花瓣、细小星光和优雅曲线作为装饰，搭配春日下午的柔和自然光。所有花卉元素保持疏朗克制，重点突出人物和界面信息，不形成婚礼海报或廉价粉色贴纸风格。

左侧设置奶油白与极浅樱花粉渐变导航栏，顶部显示简洁的“Codex”字样以及由樱花花瓣和代码括号组成的抽象图标。导航项目依次为“新建灵感”“日程安排”“创作插件”“写真档案”“版本记录”“协作空间”。下方项目列表包括“春日写真”“造型灵感”“镜头笔记”“色彩收藏”“旅行片段”，任务列表包括“整理照片”“选择造型”“记录灵感”“完成排版”。图标统一采用纤细玫瑰金线条，包含相机、花瓣、衣架、画框、星光和文件夹。

主内容区顶部显示“桥本有菜专属创作空间”，旁边以小号文字标注“非官方概念皮肤”。中央设置大型横向主视觉欢迎区域，使用柔和圆角，背景由奶油白、浅粉和淡灰紫自然过渡，加入薄纱光影、散景光斑与少量飘落花瓣。左侧保留标题和功能信息，右侧展示桥本有菜的高品质写实人物肖像。

人物呈现成年东亚女性形象，具有可识别的精致面部特征、黑色或深棕色长发、柔和刘海、清透自然妆容和温柔自信的神情。身穿端庄优雅的浅粉色薄纱礼服或香槟色时尚连衣裙，领口与裙身设计得体，不暴露、不透明，搭配小巧珍珠耳饰。人物身体微微侧向镜头，双手自然交叠靠近下颌或轻扶脸侧，姿态优雅放松，凝视镜头。采用高端日系时尚杂志摄影、柔和窗边光、自然皮肤纹理、细腻发丝和浅景深，人物与界面背景自然融合。

主视觉欢迎区域左侧显示醒目中文标题“今天想创造什么？”，副标题“收藏灵感，让每个瞬间温柔发光”。标题上方加入优雅的抽象英文手写线条作为装饰，但不复制真实签名或专有字标。文字使用深玫瑰棕色，保证与浅色背景之间具有清晰对比。

主视觉欢迎区域下部横向排列四张奶油白圆角功能卡片，使用玫瑰金细描边、浅粉图标和柔和阴影。第一张使用相机图标，文字“整理影像”；第二张使用画框图标，文字“收藏灵感”；第三张使用调色盘图标，文字“探索配色”；第四张使用星光与工具图标，文字“完善作品”。卡片尺寸统一、间距均匀，仅在边角加入少量花瓣和细小星光，不遮挡文字与图标。

主视觉欢迎区域正下方设置一个独立的大型横向圆角创作面板，与主内容区左右边缘严格对齐，接近内容区全宽，高度约占主内容区域的四分之一。它必须稳定落在页面底部，是完整、清晰、可操作的输入面板，不是悬浮聊天气泡、狭窄搜索栏、胶囊输入框、终端或独立弹窗。

prompts.text: Create a photorealistic 2×2 character-editorial collage in an approximately 3:4 vertical format. Every panel must feature the same clearly adult woman, visually around 22 to 28 years old, with consistent facial structure, makeup, hair color, maid costume and headwear. Do not merge the four images into one continuous scene.  She has a compact oval face, a narrow jaw and prominently doll-like eye proportions. Her makeup combines Japanese gothic-lolita portraiture, doll-inspired editorials and Korean social-media beauty styling: a pale semi-matte base, fine natural brows, gray-green or cool-gray enlarging contacts, elongated black eyeliner, clearly separated upper and lower lashes, soft pink shading beneath the eyes, a few tiny freckle-like or beauty-mark dots, a gentle nose-tip highlight and muted gray-pink nude lips. Her lips remain slightly parted without a smile. In the upper-left close-up, she opens her eyes wide and looks directly into the lens. In the other panels, her eyelids are more relaxed or her gaze shifts slightly sideways. The overall expression should feel quiet, detached and self-possessed, like an ornate doll that has developed a will of its own.  Her hair is deep chestnut brown, reflecting warm chocolate-brown satin highlights under direct flash. It is long enough to reach the chest or waist and paired with a neat, softly airy blunt fringe. Preserve two curved face-framing sections, slightly inward-bending ends and loose natural arcs. Include a few flyaway hairs, the natural spread of hair in the reclining panel and small variations in fringe placement between photographs. Avoid a rigid wig texture or perfectly uniform styling.  She wears a vintage Japanese-inspired maid dress in deep navy and creamy white. The bodice has a square neckline, a white apron panel, short navy puff sleeves, white eyelet-lace cuffs and dark satin bow details. The skirt is short and flared, with a layered white ruffled apron and lace petticoat. The lace appears light, thin and mildly translucent, with fine visible texture. The navy fabric is thicker and holds a structured bell-shaped silhouette. Add smoky-black sheer thigh-high stockings and glossy black platform Mary Jane heels. Her wide black-and-white maid headband is built from sculptural creamy ruffles, dark satin ribbons and large black bows on both sides.  Visible skin includes the full face, neck, a small amount of collarbone, upper arms, forearms, hands and small areas of upper-thigh skin between the skirt and stockings. Her complexion is light neutral ivory with a subtle cool-pink undertone. Hard flash makes the skin appear creamy and bright, while shadowed areas shift toward soft gray-beige. The surface looks carefully made-up but still visually suggests a soft, fine, slightly cool and faintly powdery touch. Preserve natural joint color variation, subtle pores and small creases around the fingers, knees and arms. Avoid plastic or silicone-like skin.  The upper-left panel is a close bust portrait photographed near eye level. She looks directly into the camera and lightly touches the area beneath one eye or the cheek with a finger. Part of a black handgun-shaped theatrical prop enters from the side of the frame. The composition is tight, with the maid headpiece and hair filling the upper section and the square neckline and apron panel visible below.  The upper-right panel is a full-body pose seated in an ornate classical armchair. Her legs bend and overlap across the seat and foreground, clearly showing the sheer black stockings and platform heels. Both arms rise above her head, with a black handgun-shaped character prop in each hand. The arms form an imperfect triangular frame. The navy skirt and white lace spread outward, revealing rich layers of ruffles.  The lower-left panel is photographed directly from above. She lies on a brown floor with her head near the bottom edge of the panel. Her long hair spreads naturally like a fan. Do not rotate or correct this composition. Both hands hold a black handgun-shaped prop near the chest. The navy skirt and white lace gather above the body, while one bent leg enters the frame. Preserve a slight imbalance and spontaneous snapshot feeling.  The lower-right panel uses a three-quarter side view. She leans forward over a dark upright piano. One hand braces near the piano keys or casing, while the other lowers a black prop toward the floor. Her head turns back toward the camera. Long hair falls beside the face and along the back. The navy skirt forms a bell-shaped silhouette behind her, with the white lace hem remaining clearly visible.  All handgun-shaped objects must read as non-functional theatrical or cosplay props used only for fashion and suspense storytelling. Do not show real model markings, internal mechanics, firing procedures, muzzle flashes, shell casings, blood or injury. Do not point the props toward the viewer.  The setting is a dim and elaborate vintage music room, Victorian-inspired parlor or gothic private salon. Include a dark upright piano with visible keys, a carved wooden armchair with pale gray patterned upholstery, a vintage lamp with fringe or beaded trim, layered gray-brown and bronze satin drapes, a round carved side table, glasses, small bottles, a gold tray and a framed vintage butterfly-specimen display. The room should resemble a time-frozen antique dollhouse: refined, enclosed, quiet and faintly uncanny.  Photograph the collage like an early-2000s compact digital camera or early social-media character editorial. Use hard direct flash close to the lens axis. The face, white apron and lace become bright, while concentrated highlights appear across the nose bridge, under-eye area, backs of the hands, arms and thighs. Short, clearly edged shadows form beneath the fringe, chin, lace trim and skirt layers. The light falls off rapidly, pushing the piano, curtains, dark wood furniture and corners of the room into deep brown or black underexposure. Retain only weak warm tungsten light and bronze-gold environmental reflections. Do not add blue rim lighting, large softboxes or evenly balanced commercial fill.  Preserve slight highlight bloom, dark-area noise, JPEG compression, uneven local sharpness, exposure variation and small white-balance differences between panels. The poses, stacked skirt layers, flyaway hairs and cropping do not need to be perfectly polished. She had already changed into the maid costume and entered the dim old music room. She now touches her cheek, raises both hands, lies beneath the camera and finally leans toward the piano. The next panel feels as though it might reveal the story hidden beneath the sweet styling. Blend Japanese gothic maid fashion, dark lolita, doll-like makeup, Victorian interiors and early digital direct-flash photography.  Negative prompt: underage appearance, single image, incorrect collage, mirror selfie, phone covering face, extra person, inconsistent face across panels, changing hair color, changing costume, extra arms, extra fingers, deformed hands, broken joints, limb intersection, prop intersection, prop aimed at camera, firing action, muzzle flash, shell casings, blood, injury, explicit nudity, wardrobe malfunction, exaggerated bust, extreme tiny waist, plastic skin, waxy face, modern white studio, evenly diffused light, blue rim light, heavy HDR, oversharpening, noise-free commercial editorial, anime, obvious 3D render.

prompts.text: She is wearing a green chiffon strapless flowing floor-length dress. The fabric is slightly translucent, and the dress is a single complete continuous one-piece design. Starting from the strapless neckline at the chest, the fabric drapes naturally all the way to the feet without interruption, completely covering the body. There are no elastic bands, no drawstrings, no ruching, no cinching, no belts, no waistline stitching, no layered seams, and no closing structures at the chest, waist, or body of the dress. The entire dress features a loose, straight, and highly fluid natural drape cut, with the fabric forming soft vertical folds based on its own weight without intentionally cinching the waist. The dress is paired inside with a pale yellow strapless tube-top style lining and a pale yellow short inner skirt; the lining fits naturally but is not exposed, and no outline of safety pants appears. The outer chiffon has a slightly transparent texture, but the overall look maintains elegance, full coverage, and a daily fashion sense. items.title: 校园跃动日本高中生清新夏日写真

prompts.text:
[Scene]: campus skybridge / rooftop walkway / seaside school route  
[Uniform colors]: white and navy / light blue and grey  
[Hair]: high ponytail / twin ponytails  
[Mood]: bright, youthful, free  
[Aspect ratio]: 9:16

Create a realistic full-body photo of an 18-year-old adult high school senior in a light summer Japanese school uniform: short-sleeve sailor-style shirt, short pleated skirt, mid-calf socks, sneakers, and a simple school backpack.

Capture her in mid-air during a graceful, energetic leap. Her upper body leans slightly forward, one leg bends upward while the other extends naturally, and both arms open for balance. The pose should feel flexible, coordinated, light, and physically believable rather than stiff or weightless.

She has a youthful, natural face, fair realistic skin, balanced body proportions, and a lively expression. Her ponytail, skirt, ribbon, and backpack straps move naturally with the jump.

Use a bright summer campus setting with blue sky, modern school buildings, glass railings, trees, and strong perspective lines. Shoot from a slightly low angle with a fast shutter speed, keeping the face and body sharp while preserving subtle motion in the hair and clothing.

Natural daylight, clean blue-and-white color palette, realistic skin texture, shallow depth of field, and the feeling of a frame from a Japanese youth film.

prompts.text:
A high-end Codex desktop application skin concept map with Jay Chou as the character theme, fully displaying the Windows desktop software interface, front-view screenshot composition, no perspective tilt. The overall integration of Chinese pop music, classical piano, retro film, recording studio and modern digital creation studio temperament, presenting a steady, mysterious, romantic and narrative visual style; this is an unofficial tribute concept design, without official authorized logos.

The overall color scheme uses piano black, dark walnut brown, parchment off-white, vintage brass gold and dark burgundy, with low-saturation sapphire blue highlights added locally. The interface materials combine black piano lacquer, dark wood, brass metal, vinyl record textures and fine film grain. Background decorations use restrained musical staves, piano keys, vinyl records, magnetic tapes, film strips and golden sound wave curves; using warm recording studio side light and stage contour light to create a quiet, nostalgic, slightly dreamlike atmosphere.

A narrow dark navigation bar is set on the left, with the simple text 'Codex Studio' and an abstract icon composed of musical notes and code brackets displayed at the top. Navigation items are sequentially 'New Inspiration', 'Creation Schedule', 'Music Plugins', 'Work Library', 'Version Records', and 'Collaboration Space'. The project list below includes 'Melody Drafts', 'Piano Snippets', 'Lyric Archives', 'Arrangement Experiments', 'Film Inspiration', and the task list includes 'Complete Chorus', 'Organize Samples', 'Adjust Chords', and 'Record Inspiration'. Icons uniformly adopt slender brass gold lines, including piano keys, musical notes, vinyl records, microphones, film strips and quills.

The top of the main content area displays 'Music Creation Exclusive Workbench', with small text next to it labeling 'Unofficial Concept Skin'. In the center is a large horizontal rounded hero card, with the title and description reserved on the left and a realistic portrait of Jay Chou on the right. The character has recognizable East Asian male facial features, black short hair, a calm and confident expression, wearing a black layered jacket or retro dark stage suit, paired with low-profile silver accessories; the body is slightly turned toward the camera, one hand naturally close to the piano keys, in a relaxed and restrained posture. Behind the character, a grand piano, recording studio microphone, film strips and warm golden stage lights vaguely appear, using cinematic soft light, natural skin textures and fine hair strands, the character naturally blends with the interface background.

The left side of the hero card displays a prominent Chinese title 'Write inspiration into melody', and a subtitle 'Where code, music and imagination meet here'. Abstract handwritten lines are used as decoration above the title, but do not copy real signatures or proprietary wordmarks. The background overlaps looming musical staves, piano key shadows and golden sound waves, ensuring sufficient white space and clear text in the title area.

Four rounded function cards are arranged horizontally at the bottom of the hero card, using off-white, dark brown and brass gold color schemes. The first uses a piano key icon with the text 'Record Melody'; the second uses a quill and musical note icon with the text 'Polish Lyrics'; the third uses a multi-track sound wave icon with the text 'Build Arrangement'; the fourth uses a film strip and play button icon with the text 'Organize Footage'. The cards adopt a unified size, fine brass strokes, soft shadows and even spacing, and the icons have slight golden highlights.

A large independent horizontal rounded creation panel is set directly below the hero card, aligned with the left and right edges of the main content area, close to the full width of the content area, with a height of about one-fourth of the main content area. It must be a complete panel that lands stably at the bottom of the page, not a floating chat bubble, search bar, capsule input box, terminal or independent pop-up window.

The outer background of the creation panel adopts a themed light walnut beige and low-saturation parchment gradient, with very light wood grain, vinyl concentric lines and film grain; the outline uses a narrow brass stroke and soft brown shadows. The overall color is lighter and quieter than the hero area, maintaining clear usability, while consistent with the piano, recording studio and retro film themes, not using common pure white or smoke black glass.

A small folder icon and the section text 'Creation' are set in the upper left corner of the outer panel. A wide rounded input area is embedded inside the panel, with clear and slender brass-brown strokes around it, and the internal background is a clean warm off-white, reserving sufficient and neat blank writing space. The placeholder text is located at the top left of the input area, with the content 'Write down a melody, lyrics or a sudden inspiration...'. The input area background only keeps a very light musical staff watermark, not letting any texture or decoration interfere with the text.

A complete bottom control bar is set inside the same input panel: on the far left is a circular plus button with a thin border; next to it are the 'Full Access' mode control and the favorites icon; on the right are the model status '5.6 Sol Mid', a drop-down arrow and a microphone icon; at the far right is a solid circular send button, using a dark burgundy and brass gold gradient, with a clear upward arrow inside. The bottom edge of the panel is only decorated with a small number of golden musical notes, tiny piano keys and a short section of sound wave lines, the decoration is concentrated in the corners and does not enter the main writing area.

A slightly tilted vintage Polaroid photo can be stacked in the lower right corner, showing a silhouette of the character sitting at the piano, fixed with a small piece of film-style tape; the Polaroid cannot block the send button, model selector or input text.

The interface must maintain a real, complete, and operable desktop application structure rather than a character promotional poster. The character occupies about the right third of the hero card, with the title and function cards on the left clear and complete. Adopting high-end commercial UI/UX design, precise grids, clear visual hierarchy, generous white space, unified rounded corners, fine strokes, restrained shadows, real materials and cinematic color grading. All specified Chinese is clearly identifiable and presents short texts such as 'New Inspiration', 'Creation Schedule', 'Work Library', 'Write inspiration into melody', 'Record Melody', 'Polish Lyrics', 'Build Arrangement', 'Organize Footage', and 'Creation' as accurately as possible. Ultra-high detail, 4K product display quality, full window boundaries, without cropping any important components.

Aspect Ratio: 16:10

Negative Constraints: low resolution, blurry, pixelated, over-sharpened, overexposed, oversaturated colors, cheap neon effects, pink girly style, roses, heart stickers, cartoon idol art style, cluttered background, pile of decorations, chaotic interface hierarchy, misplaced components, cropped windows, severe perspective distortion, repetitive cards, repetitive characters, overlapping text, gibberish Chinese, random English letters, wrong menu text, bottom input box size too small, input box becoming a narrow search bar, capsule-shaped input box, floating chat bubbles, input panel detached from the page, input panel becoming a terminal or pop-up, missing outer large panel, missing inner input stroke, missing bottom control bar, missing circular plus or send button, input area filled with decorations, input box using irrelevant pink floral backgrounds, input box using pure black smoke glass, character face drifting, wrong hairstyle, wrong age performance, props inconsistent with musician identity, exaggerated expressions, wax-like feeling, plastic skin, wrong body proportions, hand deformities, extra fingers, extra arms, fused fingers, harsh edges between character and background, copying real signatures, forging official Logos, presented as official cooperation or official authorized products, watermarks.

prompts.text:
一张以周杰伦为人物主题的高端 Codex 桌面应用皮肤概念图，完整展示 Windows 桌面软件界面，正面平视截图构图，无透视倾斜。整体融合华语流行音乐、古典钢琴、复古电影、录音棚与现代数字创作工作室气质，呈现沉稳、神秘、浪漫而富有叙事感的视觉风格；这是非官方致敬型概念设计，不出现官方授权标识。

整体配色采用钢琴黑、深胡桃木棕、羊皮纸米白、复古黄铜金与暗酒红，局部加入低饱和宝石蓝高光。界面材质结合黑色钢琴烤漆、深色木材、黄铜金属、黑胶唱片纹理和细腻电影颗粒。背景装饰使用克制的五线谱、钢琴键、黑胶唱片、磁带、电影胶片和金色声波曲线；使用温暖录音棚侧光与舞台轮廓光，营造安静、怀旧、略带梦境感的氛围。

左侧设置窄幅深色导航栏，顶部显示简洁的“Codex Studio”文字与音符、代码括号组成的抽象图标。导航项目依次为“新建灵感”“创作日程”“音乐插件”“作品库”“版本记录”“协作空间”。下方项目列表包括“旋律草稿”“钢琴片段”“歌词档案”“编曲实验”“电影灵感”，任务列表包括“完成副歌”“整理采样”“调整和弦”“记录灵感”。图标统一采用纤细黄铜金线条，包含钢琴键、音符、黑胶唱片、麦克风、胶片和羽毛笔。

主内容区顶部显示“音乐创作专属工作台”，旁边使用小号文字标注“非官方概念皮肤”。中央是一张大型横向圆角英雄卡片，左侧保留标题与说明，右侧展示周杰伦的写实人物肖像。人物具有可识别的东亚男性面部特征、黑色短发、沉静自信的神情，身穿黑色层次感夹克或复古深色舞台西装，搭配低调银色配饰；身体微微侧向镜头，一只手自然靠近钢琴琴键，姿态松弛克制。人物身后隐约出现三角钢琴、录音棚麦克风、电影胶片和暖金色舞台灯，采用电影级柔光、自然皮肤纹理和细腻发丝，人物与界面背景自然融合。

英雄卡片左侧显示醒目中文标题“把灵感写成旋律”，副标题“让代码、音乐与想象在这里相遇”。标题上方使用抽象手写线条作为装饰，但不复制真实签名或专有字标。背景叠加若隐若现的五线谱、钢琴键阴影和金色声波，保证标题区域留白充足、文字清晰。

英雄卡片下部横向排列四张圆角功能卡片，使用米白、深棕和黄铜金配色。第一张使用钢琴键图标，文字“记录旋律”；第二张使用羽毛笔与音符图标，文字“打磨歌词”；第三张使用多轨声波图标，文字“构建编曲”；第四张使用电影胶片和播放键图标，文字“整理影像”。卡片采用统一尺寸、精细黄铜描边、柔和投影和均匀间距，图标具有轻微金色高光。

英雄卡片正下方设置一个独立的大型横向圆角创作面板，与主内容区左右边缘对齐，接近内容区全宽，高度约占主内容区域的四分之一。它必须是稳定落在页面底部的完整面板，不是悬浮聊天气泡、搜索栏、胶囊输入框、终端或独立弹窗。

创作面板外层背景采用主题化的浅胡桃木米色与低饱和羊皮纸色渐变，带极淡的木纹、黑胶同心纹和电影颗粒；轮廓使用细窄黄铜描边与柔和棕色阴影。整体颜色比英雄区域更浅、更安静，保持清晰可用，同时与钢琴、录音棚和复古电影主题一致，不使用普通纯白或烟黑玻璃。

外层面板左上角设置小型文件夹图标和分区文字“创作”。面板内部嵌入一个宽大的圆角输入区域，四周具有清晰而纤细的黄铜棕色描边，内部背景为干净的暖米白色，保留充足、整洁的空白书写空间。占位文字位于输入区域左上方，内容为“写下一段旋律、歌词或突然出现的灵感……”。输入区域背景只保留极淡的五线谱水印，不让任何纹理或装饰干扰文字。

在同一输入面板内部设置完整的底部控制栏：最左侧是带细边框的圆形加号按钮；旁边依次是“完全访问”模式控制和收藏图标；右侧依次放置模型状态“5.6 Sol 中”、下拉箭头和麦克风图标；最右端设置一个实心圆形发送按钮，使用暗酒红与黄铜金渐变，内部为清晰的向上箭头。面板下边缘仅点缀少量金色音符、细小钢琴键和一段短促声波线条，装饰集中在边角，不进入主要书写区域。

右下角可以叠放一张略微倾斜的复古拍立得照片，照片内容为人物坐在钢琴前的侧影，使用一小段电影胶片式胶带固定；拍立得不能遮挡发送按钮、模型选择器或输入文字。

界面必须保持真实、完整、可操作的桌面应用结构，而不是人物宣传海报。人物约占英雄卡片右侧三分之一，左侧标题和功能卡片清晰完整。采用高级商业UI/UX设计、精确网格、明确视觉层级、宽松留白、统一圆角、细腻描边、克制阴影、真实材质和电影级色彩分级。所有指定中文清晰可辨，并尽可能准确呈现“新建灵感”“创作日程”“作品库”“把灵感写成旋律”“记录旋律”“打磨歌词”“构建编曲”“整理影像”“创作”等短文本。超高细节，4K产品展示品质，完整窗口边界，不裁切任何重要组件。

宽高比：16:10

负面约束：低清晰度，模糊，像素化，过度锐化，过度曝光，颜色过饱和，廉价霓虹效果，粉色少女风，玫瑰，爱心贴纸，卡通偶像画风，杂乱背景，装饰堆砌，界面层级混乱，组件错位，窗口被裁切，严重透视畸变，重复卡片，重复人物，文字重叠，乱码中文，随机英文字母，错误菜单文字，底部输入框尺寸过小，输入框变成狭窄搜索栏，胶囊形输入框，悬浮聊天气泡，输入面板脱离页面，输入面板变成终端或弹窗，缺少外层大面板，缺少内层输入描边，缺少底部控制栏，缺少圆形加号或发送按钮，输入区域被装饰占满，输入框使用无关的粉色花卉背景，输入框使用纯黑烟雾玻璃，人物脸部漂移，错误发型，错误年龄表现，不符合音乐人身份的道具，夸张表情，蜡像感，塑料皮肤，身体比例错误，手部畸形，多余手指，多余手臂，手指融合，人物与背景边缘生硬，复制真实签名，伪造官方Logo，呈现为官方合作或官方授权产品，水印。

画面主体是一位明确成年的年轻东方女性，视觉年龄约 22–28 岁，富家千金、闺阁贵女、高门贵女，娇养感强，气质温柔、清贵、精致、柔美、富养。人物五官精致美观，柔和小鹅蛋脸，面部骨相干净流畅，面中饱满，下颌线纤细清晰，清亮杏眼，眼尾轻微上扬，鼻梁秀气挺直，鼻尖小巧，唇形柔软饱满，五官比例自然协调，具有东方古典美感，不欧美化，不幼态化，不网红整容脸。

人物妆容为明显精致的桃粉玫瑰水润显妆。底妆瓷白通透，肌肤细腻柔润，面中带有自然奶油光泽，保留轻微真实皮肤纹理，水润但不过度油亮。眼妆采用桃粉、杏粉与玫瑰棕渐层，眼窝柔和桃粉铺色，眼尾玫瑰棕明显加深，眼中带少量细腻珠光，眼线纤细干净，睫毛纤长卷翘、根根分明。眼下与面中带有清晰可见的桃粉玫瑰腮红，鼻梁与鼻尖带有细腻明亮高光，鼻尖反光清晰但不塑料。唇妆为蜜桃玫瑰色玻璃唇釉，嘴唇水润饱满，唇面具有清晰柔亮的玻璃反光。

人物黑色长发高挽成华丽古典发髻，发量丰盈，发型立体精致，额前与脸侧保留少量柔软碎发。头饰由白玉花簪、珍珠流苏、浅金花枝发钗、细金链条、小颗玉石与珍珠组成，层次丰富，材质高级，左右略微不对称，搭配珍珠玉石长耳坠，头饰华丽但不压脸，不遮挡五官。

人物穿着清贵精致的古风齐胸襦裙，胸部饱满圆润，胸腰比例自然柔和，服装完整包裹胸部，仅通过齐胸衣料的起伏、贴合结构与自然阴影表现珠圆玉润的曲线，不暴露敏感皮肤，不使用夸张挤压效果。上身为珍珠白、杏白与浅水青配色的齐胸襦裙，胸前采用贴合但不过度紧绷的绢罗结构，表面带浅金刺绣、淡粉小花与水青缠枝纹，胸线圆润自然。腰间使用水青色高腰腰封，勾勒清晰纤细腰线，搭配浅金镂空腰饰、珍珠腰链与小型玉石垂饰，形成柔和的胸腰比例。

外层披着珍珠白半透明轻纱大袖衫，衣袖宽大柔软，带细密浅金刺绣、淡粉花卉与少量水青纹样，面料轻盈通透，具有真实绢纱光泽。水青色披帛从肩颈两侧自然垂落，与腰封形成纵向线条，帮助强调肩颈、锁骨、饱满胸部与纤细腰线。整体服装清贵华丽、柔软垂坠、层次丰富，但不过度宫廷化，不是仙侠战袍。

场景位于春日中式庭院回廊，人物站在木质栏杆旁，背景包含深棕色木格花窗、暖木色廊柱、远处水面、庭院绿植与大量盛开的粉色海棠花。海棠花枝从画面上方和右侧自然探入，花朵清晰鲜润，背景保留自然绿色、水面灰绿色和暖木色，不将整张画面统一染成粉色。前景与背景花枝形成自然框景，人物面部始终是第一视觉中心。

使用春日暖白自然光与柔和侧前光，阳光从画面右上方照入，照亮人物脸部、锁骨、肩颈和服装刺绣，在鼻尖、唇面、胸前绢罗与发饰珍珠上形成细腻高光。人物脸部亮度高于背景，眼中保留细小自然眼神光，背景采用浅景深柔和虚化，海棠花、水面与庭院形成清透明亮的自然散景。

整体配色采用桃粉玫瑰妆容、珍珠白与杏白服装、水青披帛与腰封、浅金刺绣和白玉珍珠头饰，背景保留海棠粉、自然绿意、灰绿水面与暖木色。色彩和谐但明确解耦，不要整张图统一偏粉，不要粉色滤镜覆盖肤色。高精度写实古风人像，东方美妆广告级面部细节，细腻自然皮肤纹理，真实绢罗刺绣材质，柔和浅景深，春日空气感，画面高级、明亮、通透、精修但不失真实。

items.title: 安化黑茶采茶园双段叙事排版摄影

prompts.text: Around any specific theme content, establish first-sight memory with a two-part continuous photographic narrative: the same theme content and the same environment appear repeatedly in two full-frame scenes, top and bottom. The upper segment lets multiple states disperse, rotate, and face different directions, forming an outward and brisk rhythm, while the lower segment turns into a quiet state of approaching each other, stopping, or establishing relationships, causing the emotion to gradually converge from movement. Paths, structures, or theme-derived spaces in the environment run through the foreground and background, leading the gaze from the near distance to the bright and slightly misty distance. The two scenes are connected by a clear horizontal seam; the seam both switches time and emotion and becomes a stage for the title. The theme's main title adopts a pure light-colored high-contrast Song or Ming style skeleton, with thin horizontal and thick vertical strokes, sharp wedge-shaped endings, and slender character faces; several oversized characters stretch horizontally and press down on the seam, partially crossing the upper and lower images, using loose letter-spacing to counter dense environmental textures and create a striking pause. A line of small-sized, wide-spaced Latin serif subtitle is interspersed within the title, like a thin bridge connecting the large characters. The center of the lower segment features several rows of sparsely spaced small vertical theme copy, with extremely thin vertical annotations and small marks retained on the left and right edges; the bottom carries practical information needed for the activity in three groups of aligned text, with font sizes decreasing progressively but remaining clear. Colors are derived from the theme's semantics: let analogous colors that best represent the theme's environment and vitality occupy the vast majority of the area; focal content uses deeper, calmer, and slightly more restrained adjacent colors to form stable outlines; text and distant highlights use a small amount of high-brightness, low-saturation light colors; minimal warm colors only bear local emotional temperature and small reminders. Maintain large areas of vivid and clean colors, dark parts are rich but not dirty, bright parts are transparent but not deathly white; the distant view reduces contrast and saturation with aerial perspective, making the overall feel fresh, poetic, slightly nostalgic of an era but not yellowed. Light adopts overcast diffused light or ambient filtered wrap-around light, focal edges are soft, space surface details are clear, and dark areas still retain layers. The whole combines real photography with restrained graphic layout; the image has only slight fine grain and natural lens softening, font edges remain sharp and clean, with no heavy filters, embossing, neon, or decorative borders added. Must maintain the narrative echo of the dual scenes, the oversized light-colored title spanning the seam, the central vertical copy, and the three groups of information at the bottom linked together, avoiding degradation into a single photo with a common title. Theme: Anhua Black Tea Picking Garden. Ratio 16:9.

prompts.text:
围绕任意具体主题内容，以两段连续摄影叙事建立第一眼记忆：同一主题内容与同一环境在上下两幅满幅场景中重复出现，上段让多个状态分散、旋转、朝向各异，形成外放而轻快的节奏，下段转为彼此靠近、停驻或建立关系的安静状态，使情绪由跃动逐渐收束；环境中的路径、结构或主题派生空间贯穿前后景，把视线从近处引向明亮而略带雾气的远处。两幅场景用清晰的水平接缝相连，接缝既切换时间与情绪，也成为标题舞台；主题主标题采用纯净浅色的高对比宋明体骨架，细横粗竖、锐利楔形收笔、字面修长，数个超大字符横向舒展并压住接缝，局部跨越上下影像，以宽松字距对抗密集的环境纹理，制造醒目的停顿。标题内部穿插一行小号、宽字距的拉丁衬线副题，像细桥连接大字；下段中央设置数列间距疏朗的小型竖排主题文案，左右边缘保留极细竖排注释与小型标记，底部以三组对齐文字承载活动所需的实用信息，字号逐级减小但保持清楚。色彩从主题语义推导：让最能代表主题环境与生命力的同类色占据绝大面积，焦点内容使用更深、更冷静且饱和度略收敛的近邻色形成稳定轮廓，文字与远景高光使用少量高明度、低彩度浅色，极少暖色只承担局部情感温度和微小提醒；保持大面积色彩鲜明而洁净，暗部浓郁不脏，亮部通透不惨白，远景随空气透视降低对比与饱和度，使整体清新、诗意、略带年代回望而不泛黄。光线采用阴天漫射或环境过滤后的包围光，焦点边缘柔和，空间表面细节清晰，深色区域仍保留层次；整体结合真实摄影与克制平面排版，影像仅有轻微细颗粒和自然镜头柔化，字体边缘保持锐利干净，不添加厚重滤镜、浮雕、霓虹或装饰边框。必须保持双场景的叙事回声、超大浅色标题横跨接缝、中央竖排文案与底部三组信息彼此联动，避免退化成单幅照片配普通标题。

items.title: 草坪上舒展裙摆的优雅日本女性肖像

prompts.text:
Theme:
Skirt spreading on the lawn

Subject:
A portrait-oriented photo. A woman is sitting on a lush park lawn, positioned slightly to the right of the center of the frame. The subject is in full view, occupying about 70% of the frame. Her left leg is stretched forward long, her right knee is raised high, her arms are folded on her knees, and her head rests gently on her arms. Her right hand extends behind her body, supporting her weight on the lawn on the right side of the frame. The spread-out skirt flows toward the bottom right of the frame, forming a soft arc on the lawn.

Character · Expression:
A natural and realistic Japanese woman. She exudes a calm, mature temperament and an elegant, delicate atmosphere. Her hair is a lustrous dark brown. It is tied into a low-key, slightly messy bun-style updo at the back of her head, retaining thin, see-through bangs and fine strands of hair falling along her cheeks. Her face is slightly downward, and her gaze falls near her raised knee. Her eyes, eyebrows, and corners of her mouth are relaxed, showing a serene expression. Her makeup is mainly pink-beige, with natural tear bags, slender eyelashes, pale rose blush, and coral pink lips with a sense of translucency.

Clothing · Pose:
An ivory-based sleeveless long dress with tiny light blue-gray floral patterns, resembling a Japanese brand style. The neckline is a small stand collar with fine ruffles and a low-key vertical slit on the chest. The shoulders are decorated with double-layered mini ruffles, and the waist uses a wide smocked design, cinching into a slender silhouette. The skirt integrates fine pleats and diagonal drapes starting from the waist, with the hem slightly flaring out downward, forming an asymmetrical design. Thin and light chiffon fabric, yet not excessively transparent, with the lining naturally visible. She wears white thin-strap block-heel sandals on her feet. Her right leg is raised near the center of her body, and her extended left leg flows diagonally toward the bottom left of the frame. The contact between knees, hands, ankles, and shoes is natural and smooth, with clothing folds following the weight of the sitting posture and the bending of the legs.

Background · Lighting:
A quiet urban park on a summer afternoon. The foreground consists of fine-textured grass and a few fallen leaves. On the left side of the mid-ground are tall, thin-leafed green plants, and on the right is a gentle grassy slope. The background features blurred large trees and a low fence with white decorative panels. The sky is only partially visible in blue. Strong sunlight pours in from the upper left of the frame, casting bright highlights and shadows on the forehead, bridge of the nose, shoulders, arms, knees, and calves. Soft dappled patterns formed by tree shadows are scattered on the lawn and background, and the subject's shadow extends toward the bottom right of the frame. Pale green light reflected from the lawn is added to the skin, and weak cool reflections from the blue sky are integrated into the white dress.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 4:5 ratio. Taken from a slightly higher position than the subject's sitting posture, at a slight downward angle. Approximately 85mm medium telephoto lens. Moderate blank space is reserved above the subject's head, showing trees and the blue sky, with the extended leg and plants placed on the left, and the spread-out skirt on the right. Focus is on the face and the nearby knee, with a smooth background blur. The subject's head, raised knee, extended leg, and spread-out skirt form a stable triangular composition. Toes are not cut off by the frame, and both left and right sandals are naturally included.

Texture · Style:
Elegant Japanese fashion portrait. Capturing the transparent air of midsummer and photographic expressions of varying natural light intensity. Skin is bright and smooth, yet retains pores and subtle shadows. The three-dimensional feel of the dress's thin chiffon, fine ruffles, smocking, and pleats is meticulously depicted. The deep green of the background separates from the bright ivory-white of the person and clothing. High contrast, moderate saturation. Sharp depiction with plenty of transparency, supplemented by very light film grain.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands and feet, broken joints, deformed knees or ankles, confused left and right legs, poor contact between shoes and feet, floating body, unnatural sense of weight, broken clothing folds, excessive transparency, shadows contradicting the light source, incorrect perspective, garbled text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin.

prompts.text:
主题：
在草坪上舒展的裙摆

主体：
纵向构图的照片。一位女性坐在郁郁葱葱的公园草坪上，位置在画面中央略偏右。人物全身入镜，占据画面约七成。左腿向前长长伸展，右膝高高抬起，双臂叠放在膝上，头部轻轻靠在手臂上。右手向身体后方伸展，支撑在画面右侧的草坪上承受体重。展开的裙摆向画面右下方流动，在草坪上形成柔和的圆弧。

人物·表情：
自然而富有现实感的日本女性。散发着沉稳的成熟气质，以及优雅而细腻的氛围。头发是光泽的深棕色。后脑勺低调地盘成略显凌乱的发髻式高髻，保留了薄薄透出的刘海，以及沿脸颊垂落的细碎发丝。脸庞微微向下，视线落在抬起膝盖附近。眉眼和嘴角放松，呈现出宁静的表情。妆容以粉米色为主，自然的泪袋、细长的睫毛、淡玫瑰色的腮红，以及透出感的珊瑚粉唇。

服装·姿势：
以象牙白为主调，点缀着极淡的蓝灰色小花图案，宛如日系品牌风格的无袖长连衣裙。领口是小立领搭配细密褶边，胸前有低调的竖向开衩。肩部饰以双层迷你荷叶边，腰部采用宽幅抽褶设计，收紧成纤细轮廓。裙身从腰部开始融入细密褶皱和斜向垂褶，向下裙摆微微展开，形成不对称设计。薄而轻盈的雪纺面料，却不过度透明，内衬自然可见。脚上穿着白色细带粗跟凉鞋。抬起右腿靠近身体中心，伸展的左腿向画面左下方斜向流动。膝盖、手部、脚踝和鞋子的接触自然流畅，衣物褶皱顺应坐姿的重量和腿部弯曲。

背景·光线：
夏日午后的宁静都市公园。近景是细碎的草坪和少许落叶。中景左侧是高挑细叶的绿色植物，右侧是缓和的草坪斜坡。远景模糊处理大树和带有白色装饰面板的低矮围栏。天空仅部分显露蓝色。强烈的日光从画面左上方洒入，在脸部额头、鼻梁、肩部、手臂、膝盖和小腿上投下明亮光影。树荫形成的柔和斑驳图案洒落在草坪和背景上，人物的影子向画面右下方延伸。肌肤上添加草坪反射的淡绿色光线，白色连衣裙上融入蓝天微弱的冷色反射。

构图·镜头：
纵向4:5比例。镜头从人物坐姿位置略高处，以轻微俯视角度拍摄。约85mm的中远摄镜头。人物头顶保留适度空白，可见树木和蓝天，左侧配置伸展的腿部和植物，右侧配置展开的裙摆。以脸部和近处的膝盖为焦点，背景平滑虚化。人物头部、抬起膝盖、伸展腿部和展开裙摆形成稳定的三角形构图。脚尖不被画面裁切，左右凉鞋自然纳入。

质感·风格：

prompts.text: A photorealistic 3:4 vertical seated portrait photographed indoors in low light with direct on-camera flash. An adult woman, approximately 24 to 32 years old, sits diagonally on a carved black wooden chair. Her body turns toward the right side of the frame while her face rotates back toward the camera. Both arms rise high and fold behind her head, with the elbows pointing separately toward the upper-left and upper-right corners, creating a wide, imperfect triangular frame. Her spine extends slightly, the chest lifts and the head tilts backward with the chin elevated. Despite the backward tilt, her slightly lowered eyelids look toward the camera positioned below her face. Her lips remain gently parted. The expression is calm, languid and self-assured, suspended between a deliberate pose and an incidental nighttime snapshot.  Preserve her elongated facial proportions, subtly lifted eye shape and clearly defined lips. Use a makeup direction combining vintage Shanghai-inspired cinema, contemporary evening beauty and East Asian fashion portrait styling: a softly matte complexion, refined brows, elongated upward black eyeliner, muted gray-brown eyeshadow, restrained contouring and low-saturation rose-bean or brick-rose lipstick. Avoid severe Western-style contouring, oversized false lashes and highly reflective glass lips.  Her hair is natural black or extremely deep cool brown-black. It is brushed away from the face and remains relatively smooth at the crown, then falls heavily from the back of the head and shoulders along the left side of the chair. The long hair should feel sleek and weighty, absorbing most of the surrounding light like black satin. Only narrow highlights appear where the flash strikes. Keep slight natural curvature at the ends and avoid large, voluminous curls.  The figure is long, supple and naturally slim, with an elongated neck and shoulder line, slender but believable arms and a gently defined waist. One leg bends horizontally across the front of the chair, exposing a long lower leg, ankle and silver strappy heel. The other leg bends toward the right side of the frame, revealing the knee and part of the thigh. Preserve believable leg overlap and perspective compression. Most of the weight rests on one hip and the upholstered cushion. The raised arms must show realistic shoulder tension, joint angles and muscle stretch. Do not add extra arms, hands or fingers.  She wears a fitted sleeveless top in champagne gray, gray-pink beige or pale cool mauve. Fine silver metallic fibers are woven through the knit or mesh, while small irregular sequins or metallic points are scattered across the chest. Direct flash breaks these embellishments into fragmented gold-and-silver reflections. The remaining fabric combines a delicate matte surface with restrained shimmer. The top fully covers the chest, with relatively deep armholes and only a faint translucent impression around the fabric edges. Do not introduce a plunging neckline, exaggerated cleavage or a wardrobe malfunction.  The skirt is a high-waisted satin midi skirt in dusty blush, muted gray rose or champagne pink. It fits smoothly around the waist and hips, then gathers into rich, irregular folds across the thighs, knees and chair. Loose front draping and hanging fabric should fall below the seat. The satin should visually suggest a cool, smooth and finely woven touch. Raised folds reflect silver-pink highlights, while recessed creases shift into muted gray-violet shadow.  Visible skin includes the full face and ears, neck, collarbones, a small area of the upper chest, shoulders, both underarm areas, inner upper arms, forearms, one knee, part of a thigh, a lower leg, ankle and top of the foot. The complexion is light and fair with neutral beige and subtle peach-pink undertones. Under direct flash, the skin appears creamy and bright, while shadowed areas shift toward warm gray. The surface should look fine and clean, visually suggesting a soft, slightly cool and naturally elastic touch. Preserve faint pores, natural joint color variation and believable contours around the shoulders, arms and knees. Avoid a completely textureless porcelain or wax surface.  Add long, fine silver or crystal drop earrings and an extremely delicate metallic necklace with a tiny pendant. She wears silver strappy high-heeled sandals with narrow ankle straps and reflective metal heels. The seat is a heavy carved black wooden chair or bench with a dark floral textile cushion.  The background is a dim, enclosed private dining room, vintage lounge or restaurant chamber using East Asian-inspired decorative language. Behind the subject is an aged parchment-brown mural or textile screen depicting white cranes, bamboo branches or reeds. Heavy glossy black wooden borders and dark wall panels surround it. A deep vermilion or wine-red wall section appears on the right, along with the partial curved outline of dark furniture. The room should feel like the remains of an old nighttime banquet: quiet, glamorous, faintly mysterious and slightly dangerous.  Photograph the scene like an early-2000s compact digital camera nightlife image, using an approximately 28–40mm equivalent focal length and an aperture impression around f/2.8 to f/4. Position the camera slightly below the subject’s face, roughly around chest or waist height. The mild low angle emphasizes the raised arms, long neck and backward head tilt. Use a vertical seated three-quarter-to-full-body composition, including everything from the lifted elbows to the silver heels. Let the subject fill almost the entire vertical frame, with the right knee approaching the edge and the crop retaining a slightly hurried, imperfect offset.  The main physical light source is a hard direct flash positioned close to the lens axis and slightly left. The light falls off rapidly, making the face, shoulders, arms, shimmering top and satin skirt visibly bright while the mural, black wooden structures and distant room become underexposed. The raised arms cast relatively hard-edged shadows around the face, neck and wall. Deep occlusion appears beneath the arms, beside the waist and where the body meets the chair. Preserve only a weak warm-red ambient glow on the right. Do not add softboxes, even fill light, blue rim light or bright daylight windows.  Retain low-light digital grain, mild JPEG compression, background noise, uneven local sharpness, slightly bright flash-rendered skin and an imperfect nightlife crop. Do not polish the image into a noise-free, evenly lit, ultra-clean commercial studio editorial.  She had just turned and settled into the dim room, and the satin skirt had already gathered between her knees. She now lifts both hands behind her head and looks beyond the flash toward the lens. A moment later, she may lower her arms and disappear back into the unfinished night. The image should blend vintage Shanghai-inspired diva energy, East Asian decorative art, old-film banquet atmosphere and early-2000s direct-flash fashion photography. Mature, cool and languid, with authenticity taking priority over perfection.  Negative prompt: underage appearance, phone selfie, mirror reflection, extra arms, extra fingers, deformed hands, broken joints, arm intersection, hair intersection, exaggerated bust, extreme tiny waist, explicit exposure, wardrobe malfunction, miniskirt, plastic skin, waxy face, bright white studio, even soft lighting, blue rim light, heavy HDR, oversharpening, noise-free commercial editorial, anime, obvious 3D render.

prompts.text: prompts.text: Generate a clear film-style wedding invitation visual centered around any subject: the frame first establishes a quiet sense of breathing with a large area of bright sky, the main content occupies only a lower position, keeping a clean, light, slightly airy background above, allowing the text to float gently in the blank space. The core structure uses a mirrored relationship with a horizontal boundary, where the real subject appears close to the boundary line, and an inverted image continues its outline and emotion below, the reflection area is darker, deeper, and more like glass or a reflective surface, creating a visual surprise through the contrast between top and bottom; the boundary line remains sharp but not stiff, it can include narrow railings, window frames, tabletops, or structural edges derived from the theme, making the real layer and the reflection layer join naturally. A restrained distance is maintained between the subjects with echoing gazes, postures, or directions, the emotion is intimate but not overly performed, details are concentrated on the face, hands, bouquets, ornaments, or thematic symbols near the boundary line, while other parts are swallowed by the dark reflection surface. The typography system uses a central axis, with a large white custom font or main title at the top, wide letter spacing, simplified strokes, and edges with a soft film exposure feel; tiny white English text or auxiliary information is scattered in the middle and lower parts, with wide spacing, low density, and so light it almost blends into the background, serving only as rhythm points without overshadowing the subject. Colors are derived from the thematic content, but maintain the same role distribution: high-area low-saturation light-bright cool tones as the air background, mid-to-low-area dark reflection surfaces weighting the lower half, and characters or subject objects using natural warm skin, soft white fabrics, and a few vivid accent colors as emotional focuses; overall brightness is high, saturation is restrained, and cleanliness is strong, allowing film grain, slight exposure bleaching, soft vignetting, and fine scan textures to exist, but without adding dirt or aging effects. Light works like sunny day diffusion combined with glass reflections, highlights are transparent, shadows are soft, and edges have slight whitening and grain jitter; maintain a stable relationship between white space, mirroring, thin fonts, and clear film texture, avoiding turning the visual into a crowded collage, heavy poster, or ordinary portrait photography.
