items.title: 海风中舒展的写实时尚人像

prompts.text:
Subject:
Stretching in the sea breeze

Main Body:
A vertical 3:4 realistic fashion photograph. An adult female leaning her upper body out of the open window of a deep blue car, positioned slightly to the right of the center of the frame. Captured from the waist to the head, with the person occupying about 60% of the frame. Both hands are placed on the window frame at the moment she looks up at the bright sky while bathed in the sea breeze.

Character/Expression:
A young and natural woman. A bright and friendly face, clear eyes, soft eyebrows, and light coral pink lips. Her chin is slightly raised, but she maintains an angle where the eyes, nose, and mouth are fully visible, with her gaze directed toward the sky in the upper left of the frame. A natural and refreshing smile is on the corners of her mouth. Deep brown medium-length hair with light layers and thin bangs, the ends of which flutter backward with the wind.

Clothing/Pose:
An ecru-colored exquisite crochet knit top. Elegant deep V-neck with a thin ribbon tied in the center, long bell sleeves, and a shorter hem. Clearly reveals the white glossy neck and collarbones, and a slender waistline. A curvy body typical of a mature woman, along with naturally three-dimensional breast curves. The bottom is ivory high-waist pants paired with a thin brown belt. Both arms are extended diagonally downward, with the left and right palms gently supporting the window frame. Fingers are naturally spread, with no unnecessary force applied to the shoulders and wrists.

Background/Lighting:
A driveway on a high plateau by the seaside in summer. The mid-ground features a deep blue sea, a green cape, and a wooden guardrail. The background consists of elegant mountains and the horizon. The upper part of the frame widely includes a vast blue sky and slender flowing white clouds. Intense and clear midday sunlight pours down from the upper right, creating highly transparent highlights on the forehead, cheeks, bridge of the nose, neck, collarbones, shoulders, and chest. The skin is fair and bright but avoids overexposure, preserving delicate skin texture and a natural moist feel. Soft shadows are cast under the chin and in the hollows of the collarbones, and the car body reflects the blue light of the sky and sea.

Composition/Lens:
A medium shot from the waist up. Taken from a slightly low position, the person's face is near the center of the frame, with a wide sky space left above the head. The upper edge of the car door serves as a horizontal line at the bottom of the frame, utilizing the coastline extending into the distance. Equivalent to a 35mm focal length, focusing on the face and upper body, with the background slightly blurred. The head is not tilted back excessively, maintaining an angle where both the facial profile and collarbones can be presented beautifully.

Texture/Style:
A bright and fresh live-action photograph like a summer fashion magazine. Delicately depicts natural skin luster, soft shadows around the collarbones, fine hair strands, the three-dimensional feel of the crochet knit, and the gloss of the deep blue car body. A refreshing color palette based on blue sky, sea, ecru, and deep blue. Avoids excessive skin beautification while balancing transparency and realistic skin texture.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features, unnatural gaze, unnatural body shape, extra fingers, missing fingers, flaws in wrists or joints, poor contact with the window frame, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, overexposure, plastic-like skin, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

prompts.text:
主题：
在海风中舒展

主体：
纵向3:4的写实时尚照片。将一位从深蓝色的车打开的窗户探出上半身的成年女性，放置在画面中央稍偏右的位置。从腰部到头部入镜，人物占据画面的约6成。双手置于窗框上，全身沐浴海风的同时抬头仰望明亮的天空那一刻。

人物・表情：
年轻而自然的女性。明亮亲切的面容，清澈的眼眸，柔和的眉毛，淡珊瑚粉色的嘴唇。微微抬起下巴，但保持眼睛、鼻子和嘴部充分可见的角度，视线投向画面左上方的天空。嘴角带着自然清爽的微笑。深棕色的半长发加入轻盈的层次感和薄薄的刘海，发梢随风向后飘扬。

服装・姿势：
生成り色的精致钩针编织上衣。优雅深度的V领，中央系着细丝带，长款喇叭袖，较短的下摆。清晰展现白色光泽的颈部和锁骨，纤细的腰线。成熟女性般的曲线分明的体型，以及自然立体的胸部曲线。下装为象牙白的 high-waist 裤子搭配细棕色腰带。双臂斜向下伸展，左右手掌轻轻支撑窗框。手指自然张开，肩膀和手腕不施加多余的力道。

背景・光线：
夏季海边高台上的驾驶道。中景为蔚蓝的大海、绿色的岬角、木质护栏。远景为淡雅的山峦与地平线。画面上部广泛纳入广阔的蓝天和细长流动的白云。从右上方倾泻而下强烈而清澈的午间阳光，在额头、脸颊、鼻梁、颈部、锁骨、肩膀和胸口营造出透明感十足的高光。肌肤白皙明亮但避免过曝，保留细腻的皮肤纹理和自然的湿润感。下巴下方和锁骨凹陷处投下柔和的阴影，车身反射出天空和大海的蓝色光芒。

构图・镜头：
腰部以上的中景镜头。从稍低的位置拍摄，人物的脸部位于画面中央附近，头部上方留出广阔的天空空白。将车门上端作为画面下部的水平线，利用海岸线向深处延伸。相当于35mm焦段，对脸部和上半身对焦，背景轻微虚化。头部不过度后仰，保持脸部轮廓和锁骨都能美丽呈现的角度。

质感・风格：
如同夏季时尚杂志般明亮而清新的实拍照片。细腻描绘自然的肌肤光泽、锁骨周边的柔和阴影、头发细密的发束、钩针编织的立体感，以及深蓝色车身的光泽。以蓝天、大海、生成り色、深蓝为基调的清爽色调。避免过度美肌处理，同时兼顾透明感和现实的皮肤质感。

负面提示：
不自然的五官、不自然的视线、不自然的体型、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手腕或关节的破绽、与窗框接触不良、错误的透视法、与光源矛盾的阴影、过曝、塑料般的肌肤、文字乱码、标志、水印。

items.title: 指尖残留的夜晚立体停车场时尚人像

prompts.text:
Subject:
The night remaining at the fingertips

Main Subject:
A vertical 4:5 photograph. A nighttime multi-story parking lot, a young woman sitting on a yellow and black striped guardrail on the right side of the frame. The subject is a full-body size, occupying a position slightly to the right of the center of the frame, with dim parking spaces and a wide empty space on the left.

Character · Expression:
Fair skin with bright ivory beige tones, slightly flushed with rosy color. Smooth skin that retains its natural texture. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long and thick eyelashes, natural aegyo-sal, soft brown eyebrows, transparent pink-beige lipstick. Small and clear catchlights in the pupils. The face is turned slightly to the left of the frame, but the gaze returns to the lens, showing a serene and steady expression.

Clothing · Pose:
A pale ivory pink tulle material shirt. Featuring fine vertical lines and a soft luster, adorned with a small black bow at the neckline. Charcoal gray high-waisted shorts, bare feet, black patent leather platform high heels. Legs stretch diagonally down to the bottom left of the frame, naturally bringing the ankles close together. The arm on the right side of the frame hangs down naturally from the side of the body towards the back, with the elbow slightly bent. The base of the palm is placed on top of the yellow horizontal pipe, palm facing down. The four fingers are grouped together, following the arc of the pipe, with fingertips gently curved to touch the surface. The thumb wraps around to the opposite side of the pipe, not gripping tightly, only lightly supporting the body's weight. The other hand is hidden behind the body and is not visible.

Background · Lighting:
Nighttime multi-story parking lot. The foreground consists of black asphalt and white parking lines, the midground is a yellow and black striped guardrail, and the right end has a concrete pillar with warning-colored diagonal lines. The background includes beams and pillars, vacant parking areas, blurred streetlights, and city lights. Warm lighting is projected from the top left of the frame, gently illuminating the contours of the face, hair, shoulders, arms, and legs. Pale cold external light is added from the far right to create a sense of depth in the background. Shadows are softly cast to the lower left of the figure.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 4:5. Full-body portrait. The subject's head is located at the top center-left of the frame, and the tips of the shoes are near the bottom left. The pillar on the right end is used as a vertical frame, and the curve of the guardrail guides the line of sight toward the subject's waist and hands. The lens position is slightly lower than the waist, almost at eye level. Equivalent to an 85mm focal length, shallow depth of field. Precisely focus on the face and hands, with the background softly blurred.

Texture · Style:
Elegant Japanese fashion portrait. Detailed depiction of natural skin, slender strands of hair, the transparency of the shirt, the gloss of the high heels, the scratches and painted texture of the metal pipes, etc. The primary tones are warm colors and charcoal gray, creating a steady color palette. Fine film grain, low saturation, soft contrast.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural hands, unnatural fingers, extra fingers, missing fingers, damaged wrists, tightly gripped hands, poor contact between hands and guardrails, fused hands and feet, unnatural legs, broken joints, floating, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, garbled text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin.

prompts.text:
主题：
指尖残留的夜晚

主体：
纵向4:5的照片。夜晚的立体停车场，一位年轻女性坐在画面右侧的黄黑相间的护栏上。人物为全身入镜的尺寸，占据画面中央稍偏右的位置，左侧留有昏暗的停车位和宽阔的空白空间。

人物·表情：
明亮的象牙米色调的白皙肌肤，微微泛着玫瑰色的血色。保留自然肌理的光滑皮肤。淡玫瑰粉色的腮红、香槟米色与粉棕色的眼影、细长浓密的睫毛、自然的泪袋、柔和的棕色眉毛、透感十足的粉米色唇膏。瞳孔中带有细小而清澈的捕捉光。脸庞微微转向画面左侧，但视线转回镜头，展现出宁静而沉稳的表情。

服装·姿势：
淡象牙粉色的薄纱材质衬衫。带有细致的纵向线条和柔和的光泽，领口处点缀着一个小巧的黑色蝴蝶结。炭灰色的的高腰短裤、光脚、黑色漆皮的厚底高跟鞋。双腿向画面左下方斜长伸展，自然地将脚踝靠近。画面右侧的手臂从身体侧面自然向后垂下，肘部微微弯曲。手掌根部置于黄色的横管上方，手掌向下。四根手指并拢，沿着管子的圆弧贴合，指尖轻轻弯曲触碰表面。拇指绕到管子的对侧，不用力握紧，仅轻轻支撑身体的重量。另一只手隐藏在身体后方，看不见。

背景·光线：
夜晚的立体停车场。近景为黑色柏油路和白色停车线，中景为黄黑相间的护栏，右端有带有警告色斜线的混凝土柱子。远景包括梁柱、空置的停车区、模糊的路灯和城市灯光。从画面左上方投射下暖色照明，温柔地照亮脸庞、头发、肩膀、手臂和双腿的轮廓。右远方加入淡冷的外部光线，为背景营造纵深感。阴影柔和地投射到人物的左下方。

构图·镜头：
纵向4:5。全身肖像。人物头部位于画面上部中央偏左的位置，鞋尖靠近左下方。利用右端的柱子作为纵向框架，护栏的曲线引导视线流向人物的腰部和手部。镜头位置略低于腰部，几乎平视。相当于85mm焦段，浅景深。精确对焦脸部和手部，背景柔和虚化。

质感·风格：
优雅的日系时尚肖像。细致描绘自然肌肤、纤细的发丝、衬衫的透视感、高跟鞋的光泽、金属管的划痕和涂装质感等。基调为暖色与炭灰色，营造沉稳的色调。细腻的胶片颗粒、低饱和度、柔和的对比度。

负面提示：
不自然的手、不自然的指头、多余的指头、缺失的指头、手腕的破损、用力紧握的手、手与护栏的接触不良、手脚融合、不自然的腿、关节破损、漂浮、错误的透视法、与光源矛盾的阴影、文字乱码、标志、水印、过度美肌修饰、塑料般的皮肤。

items.title: 红色气球与夏日河川敷的优雅女性

prompts.text:
Theme:
Whereabouts of the Red Balloon

Main Subject:
Vertical composition. A woman sits on low stone steps next to a summer riverbank walkway. The figure is positioned on the right side of the screen, occupying about 75% of the frame. A large red balloon floats in the upper left, connected to the figure's right hand by a thin white line. The blue sky and the balloon create a wide negative space, evoking a sense of summer-like openness.

Character·Expression:
An adult woman with natural Japanese beauty. Longish dark brown hair flutters in the wind, showing light movement. Elegant Japanese makeup with a high sense of transparency. Soft ivory-toned pale skin, delicate eyelashes, and cheeks and lips with a slight flush. Her gaze is directed toward the red balloon in the upper left, with a quiet expression and a slightly open mouth. Natural light and shadow from the neck to the collarbone create a mature and steady atmosphere.

Clothing·Pose:
A model-like physique showing beautiful body lines. Long straight legs, a tightened waist, and a naturally voluminous silhouette. Wearing an ivory ribbed material V-neck top with understated button details at the chest. A light mini skirt with a delicate floral pattern sways slightly in the wind. The right hand holds the balloon string, while the left hand is placed behind to support her on the stone steps. The right leg is naturally extended, and the left leg is slightly bent, forming a three-dimensional pose. Wearing thin strap sandals on her feet.

Background·Light:
A summer Japanese riverbank walkway. On the left is a calm river surface, with a bridge and a distant city skyline faintly visible behind it. On the right, a large tree-lined path extends, with dappled tree shadows scattered on the ground. Huge cumulonimbus clouds unique to summer float in the sky. Sunlight enters obliquely from the upper left of the screen, forming soft highlights on the figure's cheeks, shoulders, and legs. Light reflected from the trees softens the shadows, expressing a refreshing summer air.

Composition·Lens:
A low-angle wide-angle shot. A composition that emphasizes the figure's legs in the foreground with the gaze extending into the distance. The red balloon is placed in the upper left of the screen, forming a diagonal composition with the figure. The background uses a shallow depth of field for soft blurring, highlighting the figure and the balloon as the main subjects. An exquisite balance like a magazine photoshoot.

Texture·Style:
A realistic photographic style like an outdoor location shoot for a high-end fashion magazine. Skin retains a natural texture while being given a sense of transparency. Every strand of hair, clothing fibers, the rough surface of the stone steps, and the light passing through the leaves are all meticulously depicted. Slightly high saturation, but maintains soft tones like a film photograph. The color contrast between the summer blue sky and the red balloon is impressive.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands and feet, deformed joints, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, garbled text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin.

prompts.text:
主题：
红色气球的去向

主体：
纵向构图。夏日的河川敷游步道旁，低矮的石阶上，一位女性坐着。人物配置在画面右侧偏位，全身占据画面约75%。左上方飘着一个大大的红色气球，细细的白线连接到人物的右手。蓝天与气球营造出宽广的留白，演出夏日般的开阔感。

人物·表情：
拥有自然日系美感的成年女性。稍长的深棕色头发随风飘动，展现轻盈的动态。透明感十足的优雅日系妆容。柔和的象牙色偏白的肌肤，纤细的睫毛，微微透出血色的脸颊与嘴唇。视线投向左上方的红色气球，微微张口的宁静表情。从颈部到锁骨处自然的光影，营造出成熟而沉稳的氛围。

服装·姿势：
体型如模特般展现优美的身体线条。修长笔直的双腿，收紧的腰部，自然丰盈的轮廓感。身着象牙色的罗纹材质V领上衣，胸口处点缀着低调的纽扣细节。淡雅花卉图案的轻盈迷你裙随风微微摇曳。右手握着气球的线，左手置于身后支撑石阶。右腿自然伸展，左腿微微弯曲，形成富有立体感的姿势。脚上穿着细肩带凉鞋。

背景·光线：
夏日日本的河川敷游步道。左侧是平静的河面，其后方隐约可见桥梁与远景的城市轮廓。右侧延伸着巨大的林荫道，树影斑驳洒落在地面。天空飘浮着夏日特有的巨大积雨云。阳光从画面左上方斜射而入，在人物的脸颊、肩膀和双腿上形成柔和的高光。树木反射的光线缓和了阴影，表现出现爽快的夏日空气感。

构图·镜头：
较低的低角度广角拍摄。将人物的双腿置于前景突出，视线向深处延伸的构图。将红色气球置于画面左上方，形成与人物的对角线构图。背景采用较浅的景深柔和虚化，将人物与气球作为主角突出。宛如杂志写真般的精致平衡。

质感·风格：
如同高级时尚杂志的外景拍摄般的真实摄影风格。肌肤保留自然质感的同时赋予透明感。发丝一根根、衣物纤维、石阶粗糙表面、叶片透光等皆细致描绘。饱和度稍高，却保有胶片照片般的柔和色调。夏日蓝天与红色气球的色彩对比，令人印象深刻。

负面提示：
不自然的五官、不自然的视线、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手脚融合、关节变形、不自然的引力、错误的透视法、与光源矛盾的阴影、文字乱码、标志、水印、过度美肌修饰、塑料般的肌肤。

items.title: 虎牌啤酒温馨海港模块化海报

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium editorial advertising poster for Tiger Beer, designed as a warm and heartwarming harbor-world system board while preserving a strong modular archive composition. The layout must keep one dominant central hero product panel surrounded by smaller supporting panels, but the overall emotional direction should shift into a cozy, healing, cinematic animated-feature atmosphere. The final image should feel like a collectible Tiger Beer campaign poster where the product becomes the glowing lighthouse-heart of a tiny harbor world filled with warmth, gentle wonder, and premium storytelling.

Core concept:
The hero product is a hyper-real Tiger Beer bottle or can presented as the radiant centerpiece of a cozy miniature harbor universe. The product should feel like a golden harbor beacon or treasured dockside light source. Around it, smaller modular panels reveal a loving world of warm piers, tiny boats, glowing warehouse interiors, barley gardens, hop storage houses, soft foam-cloud stations, and amber liquid studies. The image must feel emotionally welcoming, magical, and refined, while always keeping Tiger Beer as the dominant focus.

Composition:
Use a vertical premium poster layout divided into elegant modular panels. The central panel must dominate and contain the main Tiger Beer product as the hero object, presented prominently and with strong visual gravity. Around it, build secondary panels showing different harbor-world modules:
a dockside amber glow panel,
a foam-cloud texture panel,
a condensation sparkle panel,
a hops-and-barley garden panel,
a warm warehouse materials panel,
a tiny supply boat scene,
and a clean bottle silhouette or product structure panel.
The overall layout must feel highly organized, balanced, and architectural, while emotionally soft and inviting.

Product realism:
Render Tiger Beer with absolute realism and premium fidelity:
crisp bottle glass or metallic can structure,
clearly visible Tiger Beer branding,
rich golden amber beer tone,
cold condensation droplets,
lively foam texture,
clean highlights,
premium label details,
and tactile packaging realism.
The hero product must remain the sharpest, coldest, and most desirable element in the entire poster, even within the whimsical harbor setting.

Cozy harbor world:
Transform the supporting system into a miniature warm harbor environment. Use tiny dock platforms, soft-lit piers, glowing storage huts, elegant cargo ropes, floating supply boats, hop gardens, barley drying racks, little lanterns, and foam-like cloud stations. Everything should feel handcrafted, cozy, and story-rich, as if the Tiger Beer product powers a charming living port. The harbor should feel intimate and warm rather than busy or cartoonish.

Supporting detail panels:
Design each surrounding module as a premium harbor-themed study related to the product:
a close-up of glowing amber liquid like harbor sunset water,
a foam texture panel interpreted like soft cloud surf,
a condensation droplet panel with sparkling freshness,
a barley and hops ingredient dock-garden,
a small warm warehouse materials panel,
a floating supply-boat panel carrying ingredients,
and a minimal structural panel showing the product form like a port beacon schematic.
All panels must feel directly connected to Tiger Beer and the harbor-world concept.

Color direction:
Use a warm premium palette of honey gold, amber, soft cream, weathered wood brown, toasted brass, warm ivory, muted sea teal, dusk blue, and gentle lantern orange. Keep the colors rich and cozy with soft cinematic gradients, avoiding harsh darkness or loud cartoon saturation.

Typography:
Use a minimal elegant English-led typography system with warm editorial spacing.
Suggested text direction:
Main title:
“TIGER BEER”
Secondary title:
“COZY HARBOR SYSTEM”
Supporting English microcopy:
“GLOW / GATHER / POUR”
“HARBOR 03 / AMBER LIGHT”
“BREWED FOR WARM NIGHTS”
If Chinese support text is included, keep it very restrained, small, and design-led. Typography should feel warm, premium, and beautifully integrated into the panel structure.

Brand coding:
Preserve Tiger Beer identity through:
clear product visibility,
golden beer tonality,
premium packaging fidelity,
and an elevated social warmth.
Preserve the modular system-board structure through:
central hero panel,
surrounding supportive modules,
clear hierarchy,
and elegant visual organization.

核心概念：
英雄产品是一个超真实的虎牌啤酒瓶或罐，作为温馨微型海港宇宙的辐射中心。产品应该感觉像是一个金色的海港信标或珍贵的码头光源。在它周围，较小的模块化面板展示了一个充满爱意的世界，包括温暖的码头、小船、发光的仓库内部、大麦花园、啤酒花储存屋、柔软的泡沫云站和琥珀色液体研究。图像必须在情感上令人感到受欢迎、神奇且精致，同时始终保持虎牌啤酒作为主导焦点。

构图：
使用垂直的高级海报布局，分为优雅的模块化面板。中央面板必须占据主导地位，并包含作为英雄物体的虎牌啤酒主要产品，突出显示并具有强大的视觉引力。在它周围，构建显示不同海港世界模块的次要面板：
一个码头琥珀色光芒面板，
一个泡沫云纹理面板，
一个冷凝水闪烁面板，
一个啤酒花和大麦花园面板，

整体布局必须感觉高度有序、平衡且具有建筑感，同时在情感上柔软且诱人。

产品真实感：

清晰的玻璃瓶或金属罐结构，
清晰可见的虎牌啤酒品牌标识，
浓郁的金琥珀色啤酒色调，
冷凝水滴，
活泼的泡沫纹理，
干净的高光，
高级标签细节，
以及触感真实的包装真实感。
即使在奇幻的海港设置中，英雄产品也必须保持是整张海报中最清晰、最冰冷、最令人向往的元素。

温馨海港世界：
将支持系统转化为一个微型的温暖海港环境。使用微型码头平台、柔光码头、发光的储存小屋、优雅的货物绳索、漂浮的补给船、啤酒花花园、大麦烘干架、小灯笼和泡沫状的云站。一切都应该感觉是手工制作的、温馨的且故事丰富的，仿佛虎牌啤酒产品为一个迷人的生活港口提供动力。海港应该感觉亲密而温暖，而不是繁忙或卡通化。

支持细节面板：
将每个周围的模块设计为与产品相关的超高级海港主题研究：
像海港落日余晖般的发光琥珀色液体的特写，
像柔软云浪般解读的泡沫纹理面板，
带有闪烁新鲜感的冷凝水滴面板，
大麦和啤酒花原料码头花园，

所有面板必须感觉与虎牌啤酒和海港世界概念直接相关。

排版：

水环的对面

主体：
纵向 4:5。盛夏海边高台上的无边泳池，一位散发成熟氛围的成年女性正大幅向后甩起湿润的长黑发的那一刻。人物配置在画面中央稍偏右下方，从头部到腰部占据画面约一半。头发和水花划出巨大的弧线，向着蓝天扩散，画面上部布满透明的水滴。

人物·表情：

接近白色的象牙色简约露背比基尼。摒弃多余装饰的优雅设计，以细肩带在背部和腰间系结。膝盖浸在浅水中，腰部向后拉伸，上半身优美后仰。从胸口到腰部、臀部的自然流畅轮廓。双臂自然垂于身前，指尖即将触及水面。因甩发而生的冲力，在头顶向左侧绘出巨大的水之拱门。

构图·镜头：
纵构 4:5，中长镜头。镜头从水面稍高位置的平视视角。人物置于下半部，头发与水花占据上半部大部分。左上方留出广阔天空的空白，右侧建筑收紧整体画面。焦点落在脸庞、湿发、水滴上。背景海滨街景略微虚化，突出人物与水环。相当于 35mm 的自然透视感，以 1/2000 秒高速快门将水滴清晰定格。

宛如杂志度假特辑的真实时尚摄影。高清描绘透明的碧蓝色池水、细密水滴、湿发束感、自然肌肤阴影。以白、蓝、深绿为主调的清爽洁净色彩设计。虽对比度略高，却不损肌肤柔软与水之透明的上乘质感。夏日阳光的热烈与海风的舒适同时传达的摄影表达。

prompts.text:

Contemporary traveler, not costume caricature.
Landscape (secondary focal point): One single most-iconic [LOCATION] papercraft view — 2–3 elements max, torn/cut paper terrain, paper architecture and vegetation, visible fiber texture, layered shadow. (Single-landmark simplicity has outperformed busier multi-landmark composites.)

prompts.text:
Theme:
A cat walking under the summer sky

Main Subject:
A vertical 4:5 photographic work. Set against a quiet Japanese slope leading to the sea, a woman stands slightly to the right of the center of the frame, with a huge white cumulonimbus cloud forming the shape of a cat in the sky above. The woman occupies about 40% of the lower half of the frame, and the cat in the clouds covers a wide area of the sky, presenting an overwhelming size. Emphasizing the scale difference between humans and clouds, a summer scene where reality and fantasy naturally blend.

Character · Expression:
A natural and realistic adult woman. Tall with long limbs, a well-proportioned figure like a sophisticated fashion model. Long dark brown hair with slight waves, gently blowing backward in the summer breeze. High-end Japanese-style makeup, translucent skin, soft eyebrows, and clear eyes. Her face is turned to the upper left, gazing up at the giant cat cloud. Her lips are slightly parted, with an expression mixed with surprise and quiet longing.

Clothing · Pose:
A summer maxi dress primarily in light ivory tones. Thin spaghetti straps, a not-too-deep clear V-neck, and a three-dimensional tailored fit from the chest to the waist. Detailed blue-gray botanical patterns, with a thin tie made of the same fabric at the waist. The hem is made of lightweight fabric with a discreet slit on one side, and the corners of the skirt sway slightly in the wind. A small rattan bag hangs from her right hand, while her left arm hangs naturally at her side. Her weight is placed on one leg, with the other knee slightly relaxed, presenting a composed model standing pose.

Background · Lighting:
A Japanese seaside residential area. Stone walls, low fences, old wooden houses with tiled roofs, slender utility poles and wires, and hydrangeas beside the slope. The deep blue sea and a distant peninsula are visible at the end of the slope. The sky is a rich summer blue. The giant cloud takes the form of a long-haired cat stretching its front paws, with the ears, nose, cheeks, chest, and rounded front paws naturally forming the lumps of the cumulus cloud. The cloud surface has subtle bulges and soft shadows, emphasizing its texture as a cloud rather than animal fur. Intense daytime sunlight pours down from the upper left. Bright highlights are cast on the character's shoulders, cheeks, collarbones, and the edges of her hair strands. Shadows extend toward the bottom right of the frame, with the sea surface and white walls reflecting a delicate bluish-white light.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical 4:5, a medium-full shot from a slightly low angle. The woman is presented in a large proportion from above the knees to the head, while retaining enough of the slope and seaside background. The character is located slightly to the right of the center of the frame, the cat cloud's face is in the upper left, and its stretched front paws point toward the upper right. About half of the upper part is used for the blue sky and clouds, with the character's line of sight and the cat cloud's face connected on a diagonal line. Equivalent to the natural compression of an 85mm lens, the character is in sharp focus, and the background is slightly blurred, but the street scene and seaside are still recognizable.

Texture · Style:
High-precision realistic photographic expression. Clear midsummer air, bright blue and white contrast, soft skin texture, natural hair strands, the translucent feel of thin fabric, and the dense texture of the rattan weave are all carefully depicted. A steady color tone like an outdoor shoot for a fashion magazine. Avoid excessive HDR or artificial skin retouching, add a small amount of film grain and natural light bloom.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features, unnatural gaze, over-emphasized chest, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands and feet, deformed joints, poor contact with the rattan bag, unnatural marks from fabric, unnatural sense of weight, cloud expression that looks like a plush toy, expression where the cat's outline is too hard, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, garbled text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin.

纵向4:5，稍低视角的中全景镜头。女性从膝上至头部大比例呈现，同时保留足够的坡道与海景背景。人物位于画面中央稍偏右，猫云的脸部在左上方，伸展的前爪指向右上方。上半部约一半用于蓝天与云朵，人物视线与猫云脸部在对角线上连接。相当于85mm的自然压缩感，人物清晰对焦，背景轻微虚化，但街景与海景仍可辨识。

items.title: 极简工作室暗黑忍者持剑侧影

prompts.text:
[Character] Reference image 1 [Signature] There is a small Meta-operated Threads logo in the bottom right corner, with "CHAse" written in small white handwritten font, like a signature.

[Character Pose and Expression]
A dynamic and charming side-profile full-body pose kneeling on one knee on a minimalist studio floor, holding a long sword (katana) vertically. One hand holds the upper end of the hilt, and the other hand tightly grips near the handguard, gazing directly into the camera with intense tension. Like the portrayal of an assassin character in a game, the cold and indifferent eyes and tightly closed lips exude a quiet charisma.

[Character Clothing]
Overall unified in black, a modern reinterpretation of a dark ninja concept outfit. The arms and upper chest wear a sophisticated and vintage black tight bodysuit woven with vine and floral patterns, with a see-through design for the sleeve lines. The lower body is paired with a minimalist black short skirt that exposes the hip and leg lines and spreads softly to the floor, with bare feet adding a sense of narrative.

[Character Hairstyle and Makeup Details]
A waist-length, extremely long, straight dark grey-brown natural straight hairstyle, parted in the middle and falling calmly towards the back and shoulders. The makeup emphasizes the character's sharp and clear features, based on a clean matte skin expression, with delicate gradient eyeshadow and detailed cat eyeliner, and the lips are paired with a calm dried rose (MLBB) tone to complete a cold and glamorous mask.

[Lighting and Light Direction]
Soft silver studio diffused light (scattered light) seeps in from the front right side of the character (left side of the frame) as the main light source. It simultaneously three-dimensionally illuminates the character's highlighted skin surface and the yarn-woven texture of the lace fabric, while the opposite side casts soft, non-intense shadows, profoundly emphasizing the aesthetic curves of the human body and the depth of the sharp long sword's silhouette.

[Texture and Tonal Atmosphere]
The cold metallic texture of the black clothing and long sword, and the flat light grey tone of the background, blend in a minimalist way with a monochrome-centered high fashion editorial vibe. The decorative texture of the lace fabric and the perfect harmony of soft skin texture add elegance, like a page from a modern martial arts poster or art book, creating a sophisticated and restrained atmosphere.

[Film and Camera Lens Depth of Field, Angle]
Shot using an f/3.2 aperture, 1/250 second shutter speed, ISO 100, and a 50mm standard prime lens. To clearly capture the overall beauty of the seated pose on the floor and the long silhouette of the katana without distortion, it is shot as a medium-range shot from an angle slightly lower than eye-level. Maximum detail is achieved with needle-sharp focus on the subject's entire body and props.

[Background Elements (Optional)]
A minimalist matte light grey studio wall and floor without any artificial structures serve as the background. The blank space at the top right of the frame is decorated with a deep navy blue, heavy and strong oriental-style California font "katarina" title logo, below which the English typography "BLANC" and a small placeholder text are neatly overlaid, showing a level of completion like a design nameplate or a fashion magazine cover.

prompts.text:
[人物] 参考图像 1 [签名] 右下角位置有一个小型的由 Meta 运营的 Threads 标志，上面以白色手写体小字写着“CHAse”，如同签名般。  

[人物的姿势及表情]  
在极简工作室地板上单膝跪坐，将长剑（武士刀）垂直直立握住的动态而迷人的侧面全身姿势。一只手握住剑柄（hilt）上端，另一只手紧握护手附近，目光直视前方镜头，充满强烈张力。仿佛游戏中暗杀者角色的演绎，冷峻而无动于衷的眼神与紧闭的嘴唇散发着静谧的领袖魅力。  

[人物服装]  
整体以黑色统一，现代重新诠释的黑暗忍者概念服装。双臂和胸部上半部分穿着精致而复古的藤蔓及花卉图案编织的黑色紧身连体服，袖线采用透视设计。下身为暴露髋部和腿部线条、柔和褶皱散开至地面的极简黑色短裙搭配，赤足增添叙事感。  

[人物发型及妆容细节]  
以中分梳理，向后背及肩侧平静垂落的及腰极长笔直深灰棕色自然直发造型。妆容为强调人物锐利清晰五官，在干净哑光肌肤表现基础上，绘制精致渐层眼影和细致猫眼眼线，唇部搭配沉稳的干玫瑰（MLBB）色调，完成冷艳面具。  

[照明及光线方向]  
人物右侧正面（画面基准左侧）渗入柔和的银色工作室漫射光（分散光）作为主光源。同时立体照亮人物高光肌肤表面与蕾丝面料的纱线编织纹理，反向侧则投下不强烈的柔和阴影，深刻强调人体造型曲线美与锐利长剑的剪影深度感。  

[质感与色调氛围]  
黑色服装与长剑的冷峻金属质感，以及背景的扁平浅灰色调，以极简方式融合的单色调中心高时尚编辑氛围。蕾丝面料的装饰性纹理与柔和肌肤质感的完美和谐增添优雅，仿佛现代武侠海报或艺术书的一页，营造精致而克制的氛围。  

[胶片及相机镜头景深、角度]  
使用光圈 f/3.2、快门速度 1/250 秒、ISO 100、焦距 50mm 标准定焦镜头拍摄。为了清晰捕捉无失真地呈现坐于地面的整体造型美与武士刀的长剪影，以略低于眼平线（Eye-level）的角度拍摄中景。对被摄体全身与道具以刀刃般锐利清晰的焦点最大化细节。  

[背景元素（可选）]  
无任何人工结构物的极简哑光浅灰（Light Grey）调工作室墙壁与地板作为背景。画面右侧上方空白空间配以深海军蓝厚重而强烈的东方风加利福尼亚字体“katarina”标题标志，其下方以英文排版“BLANC”及小型占位符文本整齐叠加，展现如设计铭牌或时尚杂志封面般的完成度。

prompts.text: Create a vertical 9:16 modern-office group portrait containing exactly seven clearly adult women, approximately 23 to 30 years old. Two women stand in the back row and lean subtly toward the center, while five women sit closely together on pale office chairs or a bench in the foreground. Every subject looks naturally toward a camera positioned low and directly in front of them. Preserve seven distinct faces with believable facial variation, slight asymmetry, subtly different smiles and individual head angles. Do not create repeated faces or a single cloned beauty template.  Their outfits are coordinated without being perfectly identical: warm-white, ivory or neutral-white collared button-up shirts, fitted but not tight, tucked into charcoal, dark-gray or black high-waisted short pencil skirts. Some sleeves are rolled to the forearms, collars open naturally by one or two buttons, and the shirts remain fully opaque with realistic folds around the shoulders, elbows and waist. Every leg is fully covered by thin smoke-black sheer tights. Believable knee, thigh and calf contours remain visible beneath the hosiery, but the legs must never become bare, thigh-high stockings or over-the-knee socks. Add pointed patent-leather stiletto pumps, mostly glossy black, with two or three vivid red patent heels or red soles creating a restrained red-and-black visual rhythm across the lower frame.  The five seated women form the dominant foreground with crossed, parallel or diagonally extended legs. The central woman sits most upright with her hands resting naturally together near her lap. A woman with airy straight bangs rests one cheek on her hand. A long-haired woman on the right lightly supports her chin. The far-right subject leans inward with one or both hands close to her chin. The back-left woman has long deep-chestnut waves and raises one hand toward her hair. Preserve uneven seat heights, slightly offset shoulder lines, natural body occlusion, overlapping legs and partial cropping of the edge subjects. Every arm, hand, finger, knee, leg and shoe must remain clearly connected and anatomically plausible.  Hair colors include natural black, black-brown and deep chestnut. Use varied hairstyles such as side-parted waves, long center-parted straight hair, shoulder-length straight hair, neat airy bangs, long middle-parted S-waves and a loose half-up hairstyle with face-framing strands. Hair should feel smooth yet weighted, with visible part lines, fine flyaways and slightly separated ends. Avoid identical plastic gloss. Makeup follows contemporary East Asian urban-office and soft Korean beauty styling: lightweight semi-matte foundation, gently straight brows, thin brown-black eyeliner, clean separated lashes, muted peach or rose blush, and coral, dusty-rose or soft-pink lips. Avoid oversized eyes, heavy contouring and dramatic glam makeup.  Clearly visible skin is limited to faces, ears, necks, small areas of collarbone and upper chest inside the shirt collars, wrists, forearms and hands. Chests, waists, hips, buttocks and legs remain covered by clothing or tights. Use naturally varied fair-to-light warm skin tones with neutral, peach or faint rosy undertones. The skin should appear and feel soft, fine-grained, clean and semi-matte, like lightly moisturized skin beneath a thin foundation layer. Retain faint pores, subtle under-eye texture and hand-joint detail rather than waxy or plastic skin.  Place the camera near floor or lower-shin height and tilt it upward by approximately 5 to 10 degrees from directly in front. Use a close shooting distance and a 20 to 26 mm full-frame equivalent wide-angle lens, making the foreground legs and shoes visibly larger than the upper bodies while avoiding fisheye distortion or severe stretching at the edges. The image should resemble a rear-smartphone-camera group photo with mild computational HDR and restrained beauty processing, or a full-frame wide-angle photograph with similar rendering. Keep the image clean and sharp while retaining extremely fine sensor grain, uneven highlights, fabric creases and small human imperfections. Use moderately deep focus so all seven faces, the tights-covered legs and the foreground shoes remain substantially sharp, with focus biased slightly toward the central woman and no heavy background blur.  Set the scene in a bright, orderly modern office lounge or meeting area. Include a white suspended ceiling with several circular recessed downlights, pale cabinetry or office partitions on the left, a bright window or glass opening on the right, light-beige chairs, and a polished dark floor with pale abstract stone or marble-like patterns. Broad white ceiling illumination combines with slightly cooler daylight entering from the right, producing a mixed color temperature around 4300 to 5000K. Create gentle physical highlights on foreheads, noses, cheeks and forearms, with shallow gray shadows beneath jaws and around eye sockets. Sheer tights and patent shoes should carry controlled linear and point-like reflections without clipping, while soft shadows and blurred reflections appear under the chairs and across the polished floor.  The scene should feel like seven familiar coworkers who had just gathered for an impromptu office portrait. The shutter has already been pressed, yet they are still holding their chin-resting gestures, crossed legs and subtle inward leans. In the next moment, their hands may lower and the overlapping legs may shift. prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium editorial advertising poster for Dulux, centered on one oversized hyper-real paintbrush as the absolute hero object, combined with a real animal interacting playfully and naturally with the brush. The image must feel minimalist, witty, visually striking, and highly premium, with a pure-color background, refined typography, and strong product-led composition. The final result should look like a world-class Dulux campaign poster where the animal and paint become one elegant visual idea.

Core concept:
The hero composition features a giant realistic paintbrush standing vertically in the center of the frame. A hyper-real chameleon clings naturally around the brush handle and bristle area, using its body to create the central visual metaphor of color transformation. The animal must feel completely real and tactile, while its body color transitions smoothly from its natural vivid green tones near the top into rich Dulux blue tones near the lower body and tail, as if the paint has transformed or inspired its coloration. The image should feel intelligent, playful, clean, and premium.

Composition:
Use a vertical luxury poster layout with a pure light neutral background. Place one oversized paintbrush centrally with strong clean negative space around it. The chameleon should wrap itself around the brush in a graceful, believable pose, with its claws gripping the handle and ferrule, and its tail curling elegantly around the lower section. The lower bristles should be dipped into glossy rich paint, with a few perfectly controlled drips falling downward. The overall composition must be calm, graphic, iconic, and immediately readable.

Product realism:
Render the paintbrush with absolute realism:
natural wood handle,
premium metallic ferrule,
fine realistic bristle texture,
glossy wet paint coating,
clean paint weight and viscosity,
and believable paint drips.
The brush must feel like a premium painter’s tool, tactile and physically grounded.

Animal realism:
Render the chameleon with extreme realism and fine biological detail:
sharp textured scales,
subtle skin translucency,
clear eye structure,
natural grip tension in the claws,
realistic musculature,
and elegant tail curvature.
The animal must feel alive and captivating, not cartoonish. Its pose should be calm and confident, as if it belongs on the brush.

Color transformation logic:
The color change across the animal must be the key visual story. Preserve realistic chameleon patterning while allowing a graceful transition from natural greens and warm accents into Dulux-inspired blue paint tones. The transition should feel smooth and intelligent, not artificial. The lower body and tail may reflect stronger paint influence, visually tying the animal to the dipped brush and the paint below.

Paint treatment:
Use extremely clean, premium paint behavior. The paint should be rich, glossy, and thick, coating the lower bristles with luxurious realism. Add only a few perfectly shaped drips to keep the composition elegant. The paint must connect visually with the animal’s color transformation, suggesting creativity, reinvention, and joy in color.

Background:
Use a clean pure-color or soft warm-neutral background with no clutter. The background should feel premium and spacious, allowing the brush, animal, and paint to dominate fully. Keep the field minimal and smooth, with subtle tonal refinement only.

Typography:

“COLOR, NATURALLY.”
Chinese subtitle:
“色彩，自然发生”

premium paint-tool realism,
confident use of color,
clean global advertising polish,
minimal composition,
and a clear branded product packshot in the lower corner.
Include a hyper-real Dulux paint can or bucket in a restrained lower corner placement, with clean logo visibility and balanced scale.

Lighting:
Use soft studio-quality lighting with refined highlights on the chameleon scales, brush ferrule, paint gloss, and wood texture. The lighting must feel clean, controlled, and luxurious, with no harsh shadows and no visual mess.

prompts.text:
Create a 9:16 vertical editorial collage poster.

Theme: [THEME]
Series title: [TITLE]

Use a warm off-white paper background with generous negative space. Place one realistic full-body subject as the main visual anchor, occupying around 60–70% of the poster height. The subject should feel natural and alive, with realistic skin, hair, clothing texture, body proportions, and a relaxed everyday action rather than a stiff fashion pose.

Build the composition with layered torn-paper photography, grayscale environment fragments, receipts, tickets, handwritten notes, small labels, stamps, paper tape, and 1–2 bold geometric color blocks. Keep all supporting elements secondary to the main subject.

Use a balanced mix of large editorial typography, small typewriter-style labels, and a few handwritten lines. The text should feel original and connected to the theme, not copied from any reference image.

The overall look should feel like an independent magazine page, visual diary, travel journal, or lifestyle moodboard: nostalgic, clean, tactile, slightly imperfect, and carefully composed.

Keep the visual hierarchy clear:
1. Main title
2. Full-body subject
3. Large color shape

She had originally picked up the phone to check a notification. After seeing herself in the front camera, she impulsively opens Instagram and takes one photo. prompts.text: Generate a set of bright and clean commercial new product visuals around any theme. The core is not a single subject close-up, but dismantling the theme into a main form, small same-series forms in the distance, foreground cross-sections or sample blocks, distinct embellishments on the right, and multiple sets of vertical information labels, making the picture like a carefully arranged seasonal limited poster. The main form occupies the visual center slightly to the right, has the largest volume, and possesses edible textures with soft stacking, curling, layering, or fine granular sprinkling; secondary forms are reduced and receded in the top left, forming a call-and-response within the same series; flat supporting surfaces and cut-away cross-sections are placed low in the foreground, revealing internal layers derived from the theme, causing the reader to follow a curved reading path along the left vertical column, top small labels, central main object, foreground samples, and bottom-right description. The background uses clean color-blocked geometric floors and walls, with the primary color derived from the theme as the largest area of refreshing base color, supplemented by high-brightness warm or cold color support blocks; a small amount of high-saturation complementary colors is used only for embellishments and key text; the overall maintain a high brightness, medium-high saturation, soft diffused light, shallow shadows, and a clean studio-shot advertising feel without any dirt. The text system is mainly vertical, with a narrow color ribbon on the left carrying the largest title, featuring loose character spacing, clear strokes, and ample white space; other information is compressed into small vertical seal-like marks, short column descriptions, and local red highlights, with text positioned around the main body like layout structural components without blocking key forms. Materials must have fine powder, cream, jelly, cross-sections, translucent layers, or discernible granules and soft-hard contrasts of theme-equivalent materials, with clear edges but not over-sharpened, and colors derived from the theme semantics maintaining the relationship of "large area of fresh primary color, medium area of bright supporting color, small area of vivid accent color." Avoid making the picture into a single product photo or a crowded infographic; it must retain the light-hearted new product poster temperament composed of multi-product family display, vertical labels, color-blocked backgrounds, foreground cross-sections, and a high-brightness clean advertising feel. Theme: Frappuccino New Product Poster.

items.title: 晨光余白日系室内少女写真

prompts.text:
Theme:
Morning Light Margin

Main Subject:
A vertical 9:16 indoor portrait. A natural and realistic woman in her 20s is shown large in the center of the screen, with a composition looking up from a low position from the upper body to the upper thighs. The figure occupies about 80% of the screen, with a large window on the left and a bed and small wall decorations in the back right. A piece with a soft morning atmosphere based on white and ivory.

Person/Expression:
Woman in her 20s. Bright ivory-beige white skin with a smooth skin texture containing a slight pink complexion. Soft highlights are on the cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbones, leaving a natural texture rather than excessive skin correction. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink brown eyeshadow, thin and long eyelashes, natural tear bags, soft bright brown eyebrows, and translucent pink-beige gloss lips. A small, clear catchlight in the eyes. The gaze is directed outside the window at the upper right of the screen, the lips are slightly open, and a quiet expression as if sleepiness remains. Hair is bright milk tea ash brown. Thin see-through bangs, a layered cut along the face, and medium-long to below the shoulders. The ends of the hair are loosely curled inward, with a fluffy airy feel and a natural bundle feel. Fine highlights, soft luster, and a small amount of natural loose hair are carefully depicted.

Clothing/Pose:
Ivory rib material cropped camisole. There are small buttons and modest lace edges on the chest, and the soft fabric creates natural roundness and three-dimensionality along the body. The hem stops around under the bust, and the collarbone, shoulders, upper abdomen, and waistline look smooth in the morning light. Below are matching color loungewear shorts. The waist is elasticated with a thin string ribbon tie in the center. There are small ruffles at the hem, and the fabric has fine irregularities and soft wrinkles. Accessories are not conspicuous, and the overall style is a clean Japanese-style roomwear style.
The left arm is stretched overhead, and the elbow enters the upper right of the screen large. The right arm is also raised and turned near the back of the head, creating a gentle S-line from the neck to the shoulders, armpits, and waist. The waist is slightly arched to the left of the screen, and the upper body is twisted toward the window. The abdomen is naturally tightened, not excessive muscle expression but a soft and healthy physique.

Background/Light:
Bright morning bedroom. There is a large white wooden frame window and thin sheer curtains on the left of the screen, and the blue sky is faintly visible outside the window. In the background, a white wall, a small wooden shelf, a foliage plant, blurred postcards, stuffed animals, and bed linens are arranged. The text is blurred to the point where it cannot be read. The main light source is warm natural light coming from the window at the top left. Bright highlights are on the person's left shoulder, hair, cheeks, chest, abdomen, and the string of the shorts, and soft shadows fall to the right. Diffuse light through the curtains and direct light are mixed, and faint reflected light travels around the white cloth and skin.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical composition, natural close-up feeling like a smartphone photo. The camera looks up slightly from a position lower than the waist. The person's face is in the upper right of the screen, and the waist and shorts are in the lower center of the screen. Depth is created vertically with the window on the left, and the wall decorations and bed in the back right are softly blurred with a shallow depth of field. The focus naturally fits the face, hair, clothing fabric on the chest, skin texture of the abdomen, and the ribbon of the pants. The background melts brightly, and only the person stands out three-dimensionally.

Texture/Style:
Realistic photographic expression. Japanese portrait, morning natural light, soft contrast, transparent skin, ribbed feel of fabric, fine hair flow, faint film-like grain. The color tone is centered on ivory, cream, pale beige, milk tea brown, and the thin blue of the window. Not excessively flashy processing, but a calm finish like a morning time special feature in a magazine.

Negative:
Persons who look underage, unnatural faces, unnatural gazes, excessive sexual expression, explicit nudity, expressions with only underwear, extra fingers, missing fingers, fusion of limbs, breakdown of joints, unnatural deformation of armpits or neck, poor contact between clothing and body, floating cloth, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, garbled characters, logos, watermarks, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin.

prompts.text:
主題：
朝光の余白

主体：
縦長9:16の室内ポートレート。画面中央に20代の自然で現実感のある女性が大きく写り、上半身から太もも上までを低い位置から見上げる構図。人物は画面の約8割を占め、左側に大きな窓、右奥にベッドと小さな壁飾りが入る。白とアイボリーを基調にした、やわらかな朝の空気が漂う一枚。

人物・表情：
20代女性。明るいアイボリーベージュ寄りの白肌で、ほんのりピンクの血色を含んだなめらかな肌質。頬、鼻先、肩、鎖骨に柔らかなハイライトが入り、過度な美肌補正ではなく自然な肌理を残す。淡いローズピンクのチーク、シャンパンベージュとピンクブラウンのアイシャドウ、細く長いまつ毛、自然な涙袋、明るめブラウンの柔らかい眉、透け感のあるピンクベージュのグロスリップ。瞳に小さく澄んだキャッチライト。視線は画面右上の窓外へ向け、唇は少しだけ開き、眠気が残るような静かな表情。髪は明るいミルクティーアッシュブラウン。薄めのシースルーバング、顔まわりに沿うレイヤーカット、肩下までのミディアムロング。毛先は内側にゆるくカールし、ふんわりした空気感と自然な束感がある。細いハイライト、柔らかなツヤ、少量の自然な後れ毛を丁寧に描写する。

服装・ポーズ：
アイボリーのリブ素材クロップドキャミソール。胸元に小さなボタンと控えめなレース縁があり、柔らかい布地が身体に沿って自然な丸みと立体感を作る。裾はバスト下あたりで止まり、鎖骨、肩、上腹部、ウエストラインが朝光でなめらかに見える。下は同系色の居家用ショートパンツ。ウエストはゴム仕様で、中央に細い紐のリボン結び。裾に小さなフリルがあり、布地には細かな凹凸と柔らかなシワがある。アクセサリーは目立たせず、全体を清潔で日系の部屋着スタイルにまとめる。
左腕は頭上へ伸ばし、肘が画面右上に大きく入る。右腕も上げて後頭部付近に回し、首から肩、脇、腰にかけてゆるやかなS字のラインを作る。腰はわずかに画面左へ反らせ、上半身は窓側へひねる。腹部は自然に引き締まり、過度な筋肉表現ではなく柔らかく健康的な体型。

背景・光：
明るい朝の寝室。画面左に白い木枠の大きな窓と薄いシアーカーテンがあり、窓外には青空が淡く見える。後景には白い壁、木製の小さな棚、観葉植物、ぼかされたポストカード、ぬいぐるみ、ベッドリネンが配置される。文字は読めない程度にぼかす。主光源は左上の窓から入る暖かい自然光。人物の左肩、髪、頬、胸元、腹部、ショートパンツの紐に明るいハイライトが入り、右側へ柔らかな影が落ちる。カーテン越しの拡散光と直射光が混ざり、白い布や肌に淡い反射光が回る。

構図・カメラ：
縦構図、スマートフォン写真のような自然な近距離感。カメラは腰より少し低い位置から軽く見上げる。人物の顔は画面上部右寄り、ウエストとショートパンツは画面下部中央。左側の窓で縦の奥行きを作り、右奥の壁飾りとベッドは浅い被写界深度で柔らかくぼかす。焦点は顔、髪、胸元の服地、腹部の肌質、パンツのリボンに自然に合う。背景は明るく溶け、人物だけが立体的に浮かぶ。

質感・スタイル：
リアルな写真表現。日系ポートレート、朝の自然光、柔らかいコントラスト、透明感のある肌、布地のリブ感、細かな髪の流れ、淡いフィルムライクな粒子。色調はアイボリー、クリーム、淡いベージュ、ミルクティーブラウン、窓の薄いブルーを中心にまとめる。過度に派手な加工ではなく、雑誌の朝時間特集のような落ち着いた仕上がり。

ネガティブ：
未成年に見える人物、不自然な顔、不自然な視線、過度な性的表現、露骨な裸、下着だけの表現、余分な指、欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、脇や首の不自然な変形、衣服と身体の接触不良、布の浮遊、不自然な重力、誤った遠近法、光源と矛盾する影、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌。

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic lifestyle portrait of a stunning young woman with naturally voluminous dark brown curly hair and expressive hazel eyes, seated comfortably on a plush cream-colored sofa in a luxurious, modern living room during golden hour. Warm late-afternoon sunlight streams through large floor-to-ceiling windows, casting beautiful natural highlights across her face and hair while creating soft, realistic shadows. The rich texture of her curls glows with warm amber reflections, emphasizing depth and volume.
The background features a minimalist luxury interior with beige stone walls, light wooden architectural details, sheer white curtains, a marble coffee table, and a vase of fresh white lilies. The background is softly blurred with creamy bokeh, keeping full attention on the subject while enhancing the premium editorial aesthetic.
Captured with a full-frame mirrorless camera using an 85mm portrait lens at f/1.8, producing shallow depth of field, razor-sharp eyes, smooth skin texture with visible natural pores, realistic hair strands, subtle makeup, glossy lips, and lifelike lighting. items.title: 明亮简约包装感甜甜圈产品海报

prompts.text: Generate a visual system centered around any subject that is bright, restrained, and has a sense of packaged advertising: the subject content is first distilled into a giant, soft, and approachable central main form, placed close to the center of the frame and clearly overlapping a thin-line frame behind it, drawing the eye into an internal cavity or core white space through radial organization; the cavity maintains the same color scheme or similar brightness as the background, forming a clear figure-ground relationship and Gestalt closure, allowing the viewer to first read a complete, full symbol with a pause before reading the specific subject. The background uses a high-key warm bright color or clean light color derived from the subject's semantics as a large-area single color field; the subject's color is slightly thicker than the background, with subtle grain and soft edges; the light is diffused high-key light, and shadows only lightly press out layers at contact points, keeping the whole clean, transparent, and free of gray or dirty tones. The frame uses dark thin lines, a small amount of vertical or horizontal short copy, and a small circular seal-like information point to establish a traditional packaging order; the main title can use high-contrast Songti or an equivalent stable display font, with a certain glyph or mark echoing the circular structure, but the text must be subordinate to the central main form. Retain the relationship of "giant subject form obstructing the frame, sparse surrounding information enclosure, and bright color field lifting the product mood," avoiding turning elements into scattered collages, thick retro styles, or low-saturation dark posters. This theme: Donut product poster. Aspect ratio 16:9. Note that the above is the content of the first image. Follow the same logic to expand to other color systems and images of other products for this store. A total of 10 products.

prompts.text:
The final output is a 9:16 vertical Japanese fashion photo magazine page (Portrait 9:16). 

Using a Japanese Fashion Editorial Layout, the entire page consists of three different photography works, separated horizontally by two extremely thin black lines.

Important:
Not one photo with three black lines drawn on it.
Not crops of the same photo.
Not repetition of the same pose.
Not Split Screen.
Not Storyboard.

Must first generate three completely independent photography works, then automatically layout and combine them into one 9:16 magazine page (Composite Editorial Layout).

The three photos belong to:
The same girl
The same outfit
The same shooting space
The same set of lighting
But camera angles, poses, expressions, and compositions are all different, forming a continuous cinematic reading rhythm.

【First Photo (Top)】
Portrait Close-up (Chest-up close-up)
The girl leans forward slightly, twin tails falling naturally, eyes looking directly at the camera, smiling gently, her gaze carrying a bit of girlishness and a sense of communication.
Camera distance approximately 70cm
85mm portrait lens
The background retains the laundromat environment but is significantly blurred
The character takes up about 70% of the first frame

【Second Photo (Middle)】
Hero Shot (Visual center of the entire set)
24mm cinematic wide-angle lens
Slightly low camera angle
The girl supports herself on a transparent acrylic tabletop with both hands, leaning naturally toward the camera, creating strong spatial perspective
The character takes up about 80% of the second frame
The most abundant action, the strongest visual impact
This one must become the visual focus of the entire set

【Third Photo (Bottom)】
Cinematic Ending Shot (Movie ending shot)
The girl turns her body slightly, looks down and smiles, or looks away from the frame
Relaxed and natural body posture
The frame is quieter
Forming a story ending shot
The character takes up about 60% of the third frame

The entire set of work adopts a Tokyo girl idol photo style (Japanese Idol Editorial), merging high-end Instagram lifestyle photography, Japanese magazine covers, Korean commercial photography, and movie still aesthetics.

The subject is a 20-25 year old adult East Asian girl.
Tall and slender figure, long proportions.
Fair and delicate skin, real skin texture, with a slight natural dewy glow.
Small and soft face shape, clear and bright eyes, pupils full of spirit.
Naturally three-dimensional bridge of the nose.
Soft and full lips, bean paste pink nude lip makeup, corners of the mouth slightly raised, naturally sweet.
Hairstyle adopts high twin tails.
Air bangs.
Black long hair is smooth and thick, with weight and natural luster.
A small amount of hair strands fluttering gently.
Clothing adopts modern Japanese idol stage outfits.
Pearly light purple silk satin halter-neck cropped top, fabric has soft pearl luster and silk satin reflection.
Exquisite bows, crystal charms, and thin silver chain decorations added to the chest.
Lower body paired with a pure white high-waisted pleated miniskirt.
Skirt layers are rich, crisp and light.
Wearing silver necklaces, small earrings.
Double arms wearing translucent light purple tulle long sleeves.
Wearing white mid-calf slouch socks and white sneakers.

Scene is set in a Tokyo neon laundromat.
Rows of light blue drum washing machines.
Transparent acrylic chairs.
Transparent storage baskets.
Acrylic tabletop.
Transparent heart-shaped ornaments.
Transparent bead strings.
Transparent crystal hanging decorations.
A large amount of transparent materials together create a dreamy space.

The foreground of the image includes many out-of-focus crystal bead curtains, transparent acrylic, crystal pendants, and heart-shaped transparent decorations, forming rich Foreground Framing (secondary composition).
Utilizing real lens blurring to produce colored bokeh, refracted highlights, and dreamy light spots.
Background includes slight volumetric light (Volumetric Light), forming soft atmospheric perspective.
Overall color tone is dominated by pink-purple, light blue, cyan-blue, and candy pink.
Lighting is soft, high-end cinematic lighting.
Real lens out-of-focus.
Real photography.
Layer Composition.
Z-axis Depth.

Cinematic color.
Ultra-high definition.
8K.

items.title: 美诺Triflex吸尘器高端红色视觉广告

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium editorial campaign board for Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 in a “Miele Red Signature” direction, designed as a luxury four-panel horizontal home-lifestyle poster system. The image must feel hyper-real, architectural, refined, and unmistakably premium, combining four distinct domestic cleaning scenarios into one cohesive branded campaign layout. The final result should look like a world-class Miele advertising master visual, not a generic appliance catalog or e-commerce collage.

Core concept:
The hero is the Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 cordless vacuum system, presented across four different real home environments and usage situations, with the iconic Miele red acting as the subtle visual signature unifying the entire campaign. Each panel should communicate a different cleaning function, lifestyle need, and product benefit, while the product remains the dominant visual focus. The overall board should express German precision, quiet luxury, modular intelligence, and beautifully controlled modern living.

Composition:
Use a premium four-panel campaign board made of four stacked horizontal scenes. Each panel must feel clearly different in environment, action, and function, yet all four should belong to one consistent luxury design language. Use elegant spacing, clean negative space, disciplined typography placement, and strong product hierarchy.
The four panels should be:
1. extreme close-up floor pickup action,
2. refined real living-room lifestyle scene,
3. premium modular product display still life,
4. close-up handheld or detail-cleaning function scene.
Across all four panels, integrate restrained red accents that echo Miele’s identity, such as a red chair, a red throw, a red book spine, a fine red line graphic, a red object in the background, or a controlled red surface detail. These red elements must feel deliberate, sparse, and luxurious.

Panel 1 – Fine Dust Precision:
Show a hyper-real close-up of the Miele Triflex floorhead vacuuming fine dust, crumbs, and powder across a dark premium hard floor. The suction path should feel crisp and highly believable, with elegant debris flow and exceptional floorhead detail. Use a dramatic close angle and subtle directional light to emphasize engineering precision.
Introduce one restrained Miele red accent in the environment or in a precision graphic line, keeping the product as the main focus.

Panel 2 – Real Living Space:
Show a luxurious modern living room with a healthy athletic Western female model using the Miele Triflex in a believable premium lifestyle moment. The room should feel warm, calm, and architecturally clean, with refined furniture, soft textiles, and spacious composition. The vacuum should be actively used on a rug or floor area, with realistic posture and natural movement.
Integrate a Miele red signature through one elegant object such as a cushion, chair detail, throw blanket, or art accent. The red must act as a visual anchor, not a distraction.

Panel 3 – Modular Design Display:
Create a sculptural product-led still-life panel that showcases the Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 system, attachments, and modular flexibility in a luxury interior setting. The arrangement should feel like a premium industrial design presentation: clean, balanced, and highly intentional. Emphasize form, engineering, and component elegance.
Use a very controlled red signature element, such as a red platform edge, red spine book, red accessory cue, or minimal red graphic line to reinforce brand recall.

Panel 4 – Handheld Precision Detail:
Show a close-up functional use scene in handheld mode cleaning upholstery, sofa creases, stairs, or tight interior corners. Focus on tactile realism: fabric texture, dust pickup, transparent dust canister detail, and the refined ergonomics of the product in use. The framing should feel intimate, precise, and elegant.
Place one small but sharp Miele red detail in the scene, such as a nearby design object or a clean linear graphic marker.

Product realism:
Render the Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 with absolute realism and exact premium-brand fidelity:
accurate cordless vacuum proportions,
refined body geometry,
authentic floorhead engineering,
true dust canister transparency,
premium matte and satin surface transitions,
accurate handle and wand construction,
realistic attachments,
subtle metallic detailing,
and unmistakable Miele design language.
The product must feel engineered, luxurious, durable, and physically real, with perfect industrial-design clarity.

Environment styling:
Use four different but visually related premium home environments:
dark charcoal flooring,
warm taupe walls,
soft stone-grey textiles,
modern architectural furniture,
clean shelving,
minimal clutter,
and sophisticated spatial composition.
All interiors should feel global, high-end, and calm. Every scene must be elegant enough to support the product and brand without becoming sterile.

People direction:
If people appear, use healthy athletic Western adult models with natural editorial beauty, non-influencer faces, and believable body language. Their role is to support the product story, not overpower it. Styling should be luxurious minimal homewear: knitwear, lounge tailoring, soft contemporary basics, neutral tones, and refined domestic elegance.

Typography:
Use only elegant English typography with strong premium campaign hierarchy.
Possible title directions:
“MIELE TRIFLEX HX1 / HX2”
“THE RED SIGNATURE OF PRECISION”
“ONE SYSTEM. FOUR MOMENTS.”
“CLEANING, REFINED.”
“ENGINEERED FOR EVERYDAY LUXURY”
Use one strong clean master title and then smaller feature labels across the four panels, such as:
“Fine Dust Pickup”
“Living Room Reach”
“Modular Freedom”
“Handheld Precision”
Typography should be modern, minimal, and beautifully spaced, with subtle red graphic punctuation lines or dividers to strengthen the brand system.

Graphic accents:
Add extremely restrained premium graphic marks only where useful:
fine red divider lines,
small callout marks,
minimal arrows,
subtle feature indicators,
clean modular labels.
These accents must feel intelligent and technical, never noisy or gimmicky.

Brand coding:
Preserve Miele identity through:
German precision,
quiet luxury,
timeless engineering,
high-performance domestic care,
modular intelligence,
and refined premium living.
The campaign should communicate that Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 is a beautifully engineered design object integrated into elevated modern life.

Lighting:
Use exquisitely soft high-end interior lighting with delicate shadow transitions and controlled highlights. Each panel should have slightly different lighting behavior according to the environment, but all must feel unified by premium realism and tactile calm. The vacuum body, floor textures, rug fibers, upholstery, and dust details should all be rendered with exceptional softness and clarity.

Color direction:
Use a restrained Miele luxury palette built around:
graphite black,
deep charcoal,
warm greige,
soft taupe,
stone grey,
clean ivory,
and precisely controlled Miele red accents.
The red should never dominate the full scene; it should function as a premium signature cue that creates brand memory and visual rhythm across the board.

Mood:
premium, precise, architectural, intelligent, hyper-real, calm, luxurious, product-led, tactile, modern, editorial, refined, distinctly branded.

Rendering style:
hyper-real Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 luxury campaign board, four stacked horizontal home-environment panels, refined modern interiors, real product usage, modular product display, elegant English typography, restrained Miele red signature accents, soft premium interior lighting, world-class appliance advertising realism, 8k.

Negative prompt:
generic appliance catalog, cheap retail flyer, cluttered home scene, wrong vacuum proportions, plastic-looking materials, exaggerated mess, cartoon dust, low-detail floorhead, weak product focus, messy typography, influencer lifestyle aesthetic, bad anatomy, bright cheap red overload, overdecorated layout, low-end e-commerce collage

prompts.text:
为 Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 创建一个超高端的编辑级活动看板，采用“Miele Red Signature（美诺红签名）”方向，设计为豪华的四面板横向家居生活方式海报系统。图像必须具有超写实感、建筑感、精致且无可置疑的高端感，将四个不同的家庭清洁场景组合成一个统一的品牌活动布局。最终结果应该看起来像世界一流的美诺广告主视觉，而不是普通的家电目录或电子商务拼贴。

核心概念：
主角是 Miele Triflex HX1 / HX2 无绳吸尘器系统，展示在四种不同的真实家庭环境和使用情况下，标志性的美诺红作为细微的视觉签名统一整个活动。每个面板应传达不同的清洁功能、生活方式需求和产品优势，同时产品保持核心视觉焦点。整个看板应表达德国精密、静谧奢华、模块化智能和优美受控的现代生活。

构图：
使用由四个堆叠的横向场景组成的优质四面板活动看板。每个面板的环境、动作和功能必须明显不同，但四个面板都应属于一种一致的奢华设计语言。使用优雅的间距、干净的负空间、严谨的排版布局和强大的产品层次结构。
四个面板应为：
1. 极端特写的地面吸尘动作，
2. 精致的真实客厅生活场景，
3. 高端模块化产品展示静物，
4. 手持或细节清洁功能的特写场景。

items.title: 电影感黑灰调低照度东方女性人像摄影

prompts.text:
9:16 vertical version, a realistic low-key cinematic female portrait photography work. The main subject is a clearly adult young Eastern female, visual age about 24–28 years old, sitting alone on the edge of a dark black-gray leather sofa. Her body is slightly leaning forward and turned to one side, waist naturally tucked, one leg curved and draped to the other side, legs forming a soft overlapping diagonal composition; one hand is propped on the sofa cushion at her side, the other hand naturally rests lightly on her knee. Her head is slightly turned toward the side of the frame, her gaze looking into the distance rather than at the camera, her expression quiet, calm, and slightly pensive, her movements relaxed and natural, like a moment accidentally captured in a movie plot.

The person has an exquisite and long-lasting Eastern beautiful face, a narrow oval face, naturally full forehead, slightly full mid-face, low and soft cheekbones, a clean but not overly sharp jawline, and a small, natural chin. Clear and slightly long almond eyes, the corners naturally and slightly narrowed, the gaze quiet and full of vitality; the bridge of the nose is elegant and smooth, the tip of the nose exquisite and natural; the lip shape is soft and full, with a low-saturation nude pink lip color. The facial proportions are harmonious, the bone structure is exquisite, realistic and long-lasting, not internet-celebrity style, not juvenile, and not Westernized.

Black long hair is styled in a loose low ponytail, with some strands naturally falling in front of one shoulder, and a small amount of fine stray hairs kept at the side of the face; the hairstyle has a slight everyday messy feel and is not overly styled. The figure is balanced and slender but with obvious curves, a natural shoulder and neck line, clear collarbones, a full and natural bust, a clearly tucked waistline, a smooth waist-to-hip transition, soft and slender thigh lines, and realistic body proportions.

The person wears a dark gray slim-fit long-sleeved knit top with a low round neck or soft deep V-neck cut and a fine vertical knit texture; the fabric is soft and fits the body, naturally presenting the relationship between the chest and waist. The bottom is a black high-waisted slim-fit hip-hugging mini skirt; the skirt is simple without decoration, with a very small slit on the side, naturally revealing the waist-hip and thigh lines through tailoring and sitting posture. The overall clothing is mature, restrained, and simple, without the use of sequins, high-reflective leather, or complex decorations.

Adopting a medium-shot composition from the upper body to the thighs, the character is located center-left of the frame, and the lens is slightly higher than the sofa cushion but maintains a nearly eye-level view, using a 50mm to 85mm portrait lens feel. The frame retains the subject's upper body, waist/hips, and overlapping legs, avoiding wide-angle perspective and exaggerated body proportions. The dark sofa forms a stable horizontal composition, and the subject's body forms a soft diagonal line, giving the image a natural cinematic storyboard feel.

The scene is located in a low-light modern living room, with a dark gray-black wall and minimalist furnishings in the background. A small warm-toned wall lamp or floor lamp is set at the back right or back left, forming only a small, restrained amber halo; the lamp itself is not overly bright. Most of the background area sinks into delicate shadows, retaining the faint texture of the wall, the leather texture of the sofa, and realistic spatial depth, without cluttered furniture or bright home displays.

Using a realistic low-key cinematic lighting system. The main light comes from a beam of soft, directionally clear cool neutral weak light from the front-side or top-side of the frame, focusing on illuminating the subject's face, collarbones, chest-waist silhouette, hands, and the front of the thighs; the rear-side warm lamp only serves as ambient light and background layering, not directly illuminating the whole body. The side of the character closer to the main light has soft highlights, while the other side naturally enters deep gray shadows, forming a clear but not harsh chiaroscuro relationship.

In the overall low-light environment, extremely weak and restrained facial reflection fill light is added to keep the eyes, bridge of the nose, mid-face, lips, and jawline contour clear. The eyes retain tiny natural catchlights but do not use large-area circular catchlights typical of commercial studio photography. The facial brightness is slightly higher than the clothes and background; there is no dead black under the eyes, the mid-face does not appear gray, and the features are not swallowed by shadows.

The overall grading uses a low-saturation cinematic style with dark gray tones and subtle cool-warm contrast. The character and the sofa are dominated by cool gray, charcoal black, and dark gray; the background lighting retains a small amount of low-saturation amber warmth, forming a restrained cool-warm relationship, but the whole image cannot be overall yellow. The skin tone is naturally neutral, retaining realistic blood color, not pale, not orange-yellow, and not oily.

Realistic photography lens rendering, natural depth of field, the focus falls on the character's face and upper body; the hands and thighs remain sufficiently clear, and the background lamps and walls are slightly softened but still recognizable. The bokeh is natural, the edges have slight optical fall-off and restrained vignetting, and excessive creamy blur is not used.

The character's skin retains natural pores, subtle skin undulations, slight lip lines, realistic eye area textures, and soft skin highlights. The arms, knees, and thighs retain realistic joint structures and natural skin textures; there is no plasticized skin smoothing or wax figure feel. The knit fabric needs to present fine fibers and natural wrinkles, and the sofa retains the leather texture and slight wear feel under low light.

Adding delicate film grain, natural photographic noise, soft micro-contrast, slight color shift, deep but layered shadows, and real optical texture. The overall atmosphere is quiet, mature, restrained, private, and high-end, with a slight sense of loneliness and narrative blank space, like an indoor still frame from an independent movie or an urban emotional film, rather than a commercial portrait studio shot, fashion e-commerce image, or a deliberately sexy photoshoot.

prompts.text:
9:16 竖版，一张写实低调电影感女性人像摄影作品。画面主体是一位明确成年的年轻东方女性，视觉年龄约24–28岁，独自坐在深色黑灰皮质沙发的边缘位置。她的身体轻微前倾并向一侧转动，腰部自然收束，一条腿弯曲搭向另一侧，双腿形成柔和交叠的斜线构图；一只手撑在身侧的沙发坐垫上，另一只手自然轻放在膝盖上。头部微微转向画面侧方，视线看向远处而不是镜头，神情安静、冷静、略带思绪感，动作松弛自然，像电影剧情中被偶然捕捉的一个瞬间。

黑色长发采用松散低扎发，部分发丝自然垂落在一侧肩前，脸侧保留少量细碎发丝，发型略带生活中的轻微凌乱感，不做过度精致造型。人物身形匀称纤细但曲线明显，肩颈线自然，锁骨清晰，上围饱满自然，腰线收束明确，腰臀过渡流畅，大腿线条柔和修长，身体比例真实。

人物穿深灰色修身长袖针织上衣，低圆领或柔和深V领剪裁，细密竖向针织纹理，面料柔软贴合身体，自然呈现胸腰关系；下身穿黑色高腰修身包臀短裙，裙身简洁无装饰，侧面带有极小开衩，通过剪裁和坐姿自然展现腰臀与大腿线条。服装整体成熟、克制、简洁，不使用亮片、皮革高反光或复杂装饰。

采用大半身到大腿中景构图，人物位于画面中央偏左，镜头略高于沙发坐垫但保持接近平视，使用50mm至85mm人像镜头感。画面保留人物上半身、腰臀和交叠腿部，避免广角透视和身体比例夸张。深色沙发形成稳定的横向构图，人物身体形成柔和对角线，使画面具有自然的电影分镜感。

场景位于低照度现代客厅，背景为深灰黑墙面与极简陈设。画面右后方或左后方设置一盏小型暖色壁灯或落地灯，只形成一小片克制的琥珀色光晕，灯具本身不过度明亮。背景大部分区域沉入细腻阴影，保留墙面微弱纹理、沙发皮革质感和真实空间纵深，不出现杂乱家具，不做明亮家居展示。

使用真实低调电影光影系统。主光来自画面侧前方或侧上方的一束柔和、方向明确的冷中性弱光，重点照亮人物面部、锁骨、胸腰轮廓、手部和大腿前侧；侧后方暖灯只作为环境光与背景层次，不直接照亮全身。人物靠近主光的一侧具有柔和高光，另一侧自然进入深灰阴影，形成明显但不过硬的 chiaroscuro 明暗关系。

在整体低照度环境中加入极弱、克制的面部反射补光，使双眼、鼻梁、面中、唇部和下颌轮廓保持清晰。双眼保留细小自然眼神光，但不使用商业棚拍式大面积圆形眼神光。面部亮度略高于衣服和背景，眼下不死黑，面中不发灰，五官不被阴影吞没。

整体采用灰黑暗调与冷暖微对比的低饱和电影分级。人物与沙发以冷灰、炭黑、深灰为主，背景灯光保留少量低饱和琥珀暖色，形成克制的冷暖关系，但不能全图偏黄。肤色自然偏中性，保留真实血色，不苍白，不橙黄，不油亮。

真实摄影镜头渲染，自然景深，焦点落在人物面部与上半身，手部和大腿保持足够清晰，背景灯具与墙面轻微柔化但仍可辨认。焦外自然，边缘带轻微光学衰减与克制暗角，不使用过度奶油虚化。

人物皮肤保留自然毛孔、细微皮肤起伏、轻微唇纹、真实眼周纹理和柔和皮肤高光。手臂、膝盖和大腿保留真实关节结构与自然肤质，不做塑料化磨皮，不产生蜡像感。针织面料需要呈现细密纤维和自然褶皱，沙发保留低光下的皮革纹理与轻微磨损感。

prompts.text: Create a realistic late-night social-media portrait of an adult woman seated on a low, soft, deep-charcoal velvet sofa. Her body faces mostly forward, her upper torso remains upright without becoming rigid, her shoulders are relaxed, and her head is gently tilted to one side. She looks directly into the lens with bright, calm, steady eyes. Her lips remain naturally closed with only the faintest upward curve, as though she had just relaxed a moment before the shutter was pressed.  Preserve a soft oval face, a narrow refined jawline, large clear eyes, a small delicate nose, and naturally full lips. Use Korean idol-inspired evening glamour only as a makeup and styling language, not as a claim of identity: fine dark brows, softly blended taupe-brown eyeshadow, delicate lifted eyeliner, long separated lashes, subtle under-eye brightness, and pink-peach blush extending across the cheeks and slightly beneath the eyes. Add controlled highlights to the nose bridge, nose tip, cheekbones, and cupid's bow. Use glossy rose-nude lips. The complexion should be bright and softly luminous with a mild beauty-filter effect, but retain faint pores, real tonal variation, and the warmth of living skin rather than a waxy or porcelain finish.  Give her extremely long, dense natural-black hair with cool blue-black reflections under the flash. The hair is center-parted or slightly off-center, naturally lifted at the crown, and shaped into loose broad waves through the lengths. The heaviest section of hair falls on the left side of the frame, covering part of the shoulder and chest. Preserve a few stray strands touching the arms and dress instead of arranging every hair perfectly. Place one clearly visible oversized gold quatrefoil-shaped drop earring on the right side of the frame, finished with a thin hanging chain. Add several slim silver rings, a delicate crystal bracelet on one wrist, and a fine metal chain bracelet on the other. Do not add a necklace, headwear, handbag, drink, or an invented fully visible second earring.  Dress her in a deep forest-green or muted dark-emerald asymmetric halter bodycon mini dress. The dress has a high halter neckline, a diagonal front panel, a clearly defined geometric central cutout, two narrow crossed straps beneath the bust, and smaller side-waist openings. Preserve the exact neckline height, panel placement, cutout geometry, crossed straps, and original garment coverage without increasing exposure. The material should look like soft low-sheen stretch jersey or matte elastic fabric, never latex. Show natural tension across the torso, slight pulling around the bust and waist, and small wrinkles or gathered areas where the seated body compresses the fabric. The fitted hem sits high on the thighs and gathers slightly around the hips and sofa cushion.  Her adult figure combines slender shoulders, a defined waist, and naturally fuller curves. One thigh and knee extend toward the camera, occupying the lower-right foreground and appearing larger because of close-range perspective. The other leg folds back or overlaps behind it. Her hands rest naturally near the hem, thigh, and knee; one forearm crosses diagonally toward the knee while the other hand stays near the skirt. Retain believable body weight, small asymmetries, subtle abdominal compression, fabric pressure marks, and the natural settling of the hips into the cushion. Do not reshape the body into an extreme or anatomically implausible hourglass.  Visible skin includes the face, neck, shoulders, collarbones, upper chest, the chest area framed by the dress opening, central upper abdomen, small side-waist sections, both arms, hands, fingers, and a large area of the forward thigh and knee. Use a fair neutral-to-cool complexion that appears ivory with pale peach undertones under flash, with stronger pink coloration on the cheeks. The skin should look as though it would feel soft, warm, lightly hydrated, and satin-smooth rather than plastic. Preserve faint tonal differences across the arms and thighs, subtle joint texture, tiny natural irregularities, and extremely light marks on the thigh.  Photograph the scene with a small, hard frontal flash positioned close to the lens axis, recreating the look of a smartphone rear camera, compact digital camera, or small mirrorless camera with direct on-camera flash. Use an estimated 28–35mm full-frame-equivalent perspective. Position the camera near eye level or slightly above it, almost straight-on with a very mild downward angle. The close shooting distance must naturally enlarge the foreground knee. The flash should create concentrated highlights on the forehead, nose bridge, nose tip, cheekbones, lips, collarbones, upper chest, forearms, and thigh, with short defined shadows beneath the chin, between overlapping arms, along the dress edges, and under the knee. Allow the light to fall off rapidly behind the subject so that she remains bright while the room becomes dark. Do not use a studio softbox, balanced fill light, sunset illumination, or strong rim lighting.  Use a 3:4 vertical composition framed from the top of the head to the knees and a small section of the lower legs. Keep the subject broadly centered, but allow the heavy hair on the left and enlarged knee on the lower right to create slight natural imbalance. Use moderate-to-deep depth of field so the face, torso, and foreground knee remain readable. The sofa and curtains may soften slightly, but avoid exaggerated creamy bokeh.  Set the scene in a quiet, enclosed, subtly luxurious nightclub lounge, private hotel seating area, or after-hours room. Behind her are a deep-charcoal velvet banquette, heavy dark cushions with visible directional velvet texture, casually arranged pillows, and floor-to-ceiling dark curtains with pronounced vertical folds. Keep the environment underexposed, preserving only a faint cool blue-violet glow at the far-right edge and small flash reflections on the velvet. Retain slight digital noise, compression texture, and minor color blocking in the shadows.  The final mood is quiet, intimate, soft, and self-assured. The party had just become quieter; she is already settled into the dark sofa and is still holding the camera's gaze. The shutter captures this brief pause, while the rest of the night is about to continue. Preserve direct-flash highlights, mild beauty filtering, foreground-knee perspective, flyaway hair, fabric wrinkles, shadow noise, and slightly imperfect framing so the photograph feels like a spontaneous image taken by someone seated across from her, not an overly polished commercial advertisement.

Subject:
