items.title: 午后红影室内轻熟女性人像

prompts.text:
Theme:
Afternoon Red Afterglow

Subject:
A vertical indoor portrait featuring an adult woman sitting on a dark wood grain floor. The subject is positioned largely in the center-left of the frame, capturing from the upper body to the legs at a close distance. Wooden shutters are placed on the right, and a low shelf and houseplants are placed in the back-left, with the background moderately blurred.

Person · Expression:
A natural and realistic adult woman. Deep brown long hair is slightly messy, with fine strands of hair falling around the face. The head is slightly tilted to the left, the chin is slightly raised, quietly gazing at the camera. The expression is not deliberately sculpted; half-open lips and calm eyes create a lazy and elegant atmosphere. The body type gives a mature impression, not appearing slender, with natural roundness and a beauty of posture.

Clothing · Pose:
Wears a dark red ribbed knit material set. The top is a shorter cardigan-style top, with a natural three-dimensional effect at the chest, showing a part that is elegant and restrained. Ribbon knots and strings on the sides add a light embellishment to the clothing. The bottom is a tight miniskirt of the same color. The left leg is significantly bent with the knee raised, and the other leg is folded on the floor. The person's right hand is near the back of the body, supporting on the floor with weight on the fingertips. The left arm hangs naturally near the leg. Wearing black loafer-style high heels, exuding a steady adult temperament down to the feet.

Background · Lighting:
Warm afternoon interior. Sunlight from the low-lying sun filters through wooden shutters in the back right, casting long thin strips of light and shadow on the floor and walls. Light enters from the upper right of the frame, forming soft highlights on hair outlines, shoulders, and the front of the legs. Light reflected from the floor slightly illuminates the skin, with the background side slightly dim to create a sense of depth. Wooden shelves, stacked books, trays, and houseplants are placed in the back left, with a breath of life but not overly prominent.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical composition, 3:4 ratio. The lens starts from a low position near the floor, not a slightly downward angle, but from a natural eye-level height pointing from the character's chest to the face. Equivalent to a 35mm–50mm natural angle of view. Focus is on the character's face, with the background and deep floor softly blurred with a shallow depth of field. The large triangle formed by the knee, the hand propped on the floor, and the diagonally entering shutter light create a sense of rhythm in the frame. The character, clothing details, accurate pose, and arrangement of background small objects in the reference image are not directly copied, but redesigned while maintaining the same atmosphere.

Texture · Style:
Realistic photo expression. Skin is not over-edited, retaining natural texture and soft highlights. The fine texture of red ribbed knit, the luster of the wooden floor, the small bundles of hair strands, and the shadows of the shutters are all carefully depicted. Warm-toned film-like tones, slightly lower contrast, with a steady completion like a magazine photo.

Negative:
Unnatural facial features, unnatural gaze, excessive exposure, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, extra fingers, missing fingers, fusion of hands and feet, damaged clothing, deformed shoes, floating, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

prompts.text:
主题：
午后的红色余韵

主体：
以坐在深色木纹地板上的成年女性为主角的纵向室内肖像。人物较大地配置在画面中央稍偏左的位置，以较近的距离感拍摄上半身至双腿。右侧放置木质百叶窗，左后方放置低矮的架子和观叶植物，背景适度模糊。

人物·表情：
自然且具现实感的大人女性。深棕色的长发略显凌乱，细碎的发丝垂落在脸庞周围。头部微微向左倾斜，下巴稍稍抬起，静静凝视镜头。表情不刻意雕琢，半开的嘴唇和沉静的眼眸营造出慵懒而优雅的氛围。体型给人成熟的印象，不显纤细，带有自然的圆润感和姿态的美感。

服装·姿势：
采用深红色罗纹针织材质的套装。上身为较短的开衫式上衣，胸口自然呈现立体感，露出部分优雅而克制。侧面的缎带结和细绳为服装增添轻盈的点缀。下身为同色系的紧身迷你裙。左侧的腿大幅弯曲抬起膝盖，另一侧腿折叠置于地板上。人物自身的右手靠近身体后方支撑在地板上，用指尖承重。左臂自然垂放在腿部附近。穿着黑色的乐福鞋风格高跟鞋，直至足部都散发着沉稳的大人气质。

背景·光线：
温暖的午后室内。右侧后方的木质百叶窗透入低矮的阳光，在地板和墙壁上投下细长的条状光影。光线从画面右上方进入，在发丝轮廓、肩膀和腿部前侧形成柔和的高光。地板反射的光线微微照亮肌肤，背景侧稍显昏暗以营造深度感。左后方放置木制架子、叠放的书籍、浅盘和观叶植物，带有生活气息但不过分突出。

构图·镜头：
纵向构图，3:4比例。镜头从靠近地板的较低位置出发，不是稍稍俯视的角度，而是以自然视线高度从人物胸口指向脸部。相当于35mm〜50mm的自然画角。将焦点对准人物的脸部，背景和地板深处以浅景深柔和模糊。膝盖形成的巨大三角形、撑在地板上的手、斜入的百叶窗光线为画面营造节奏感。参考图中的人物、服装细节、准确姿势、背景小物件的配置不直接复制，仅保留相同氛围感进行重新设计。

质感·风格：
真实的照片表现。肌肤不过度修饰，保留自然的质感和柔和的高光。红色罗纹针织的细密纹理、木地板的光泽、发丝的细小束、百叶窗的阴影均仔细描绘。偏暖色的胶片般色调、稍低的对比度，如杂志照片般沉稳的完成度。

负面：
不自然的五官、不自然的视线、过度的露出、过度的美肌修饰、塑料般的肌肤、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手脚融合、服装破损、鞋子变形、漂浮、不自然的引力、错误的透视法、与光源矛盾的阴影、文字乱码、标志、水印。

items.title: 高端奢侈街头服饰购物袋视角海报

prompts.text:
Create a premium luxury streetwear editorial advertising poster in a vertical 9:16 format.
A stylish young female model leans over an enormous shopping bag, looking directly down toward the viewer with a confident, irresistible expression. The scene is captured from an extreme point-of-view camera positioned inside the shopping bag, creating a dramatic upward perspective as if the viewer is the item about to be picked.

The model naturally leans over the bag’s opening, with one hand reaching inside while maintaining intense direct eye contact. He wears an oversized vibrant red hoodie, black cargo pants, and clean white sneakers, embodying a bold contemporary luxury streetwear aesthetic.

The opening of the shopping bag forms a powerful foreground frame, surrounding the model and enhancing the immersive perspective. The interior walls of the bag become part of the graphic design, featuring oversized premium typography wrapping around the paper surface with the statement:

“TAKE WHAT’S YOURS”

Integrate sophisticated editorial graphic elements throughout the composition, including authentic receipt graphics, barcode strips, shipping labels, premium stickers, paper folds, subtle print imperfections, registration marks, and luxury magazine-inspired layout details.

Composition emphasizes an unforgettable forced-perspective viewpoint with strong foreground framing, dramatic depth, and a highly shareable luxury fashion campaign aesthetic suitable for premium social media advertising.

Lighting is inspired by high-end fashion campaigns, with brilliant natural light pouring in from above the bag, creating luminous highlights, soft shadows, realistic paper reflections, and cinematic contrast.

Color Palette: Rich crimson red, deep black, crisp white, and warm cream paper tones.

Style: Ultra-premium luxury streetwear campaign, contemporary editorial design, cinematic fashion photography, magazine cover quality, bold graphic composition, hyper-realistic textures, impeccable typography integration, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, 8K masterpiece, award-winning commercial advertising, premium branding aesthetic.

prompts.text:
创建一个垂直 9:16 格式的高端奢侈街头服饰社论广告海报。
一位时尚的年轻女性模特俯身于一个巨大的购物袋上，以自信且不可抗拒的表情直接向下注视着观众。场景是从放置在购物袋内部的极端视点相机拍摄的，营造出一种戏剧性的向上视角，仿佛观众就是那个即将被捡起的物品。

模特自然地俯在购物袋开口处，一只手伸进袋内，同时保持着强烈且直接的眼神交流。她穿着一件超大号的亮红色连帽衫、黑色工装裤和干净的白色运动鞋，体现出一种大胆的现代奢侈街头服饰美学。

购物袋的开口形成了一个强有力的前景框架，包围着模特并增强了沉浸式的透视感。购物袋的内壁成为了平面设计的一部分，其特征是环绕在纸张表面的超大高端排版，印有声明：

“TAKE WHAT’S YOURS”

在整个构图中融入复杂的社论平面元素，包括真实的收据图形、条形码条、运输标签、优质贴纸、纸张折痕、细微的印刷缺陷、对位标记以及受奢侈杂志启发的布局细节。

构图强调了令人难忘的强迫透视视角，具有强有力的前景框架、戏剧性的深度，以及适合高端社交媒体广告的高分享度奢侈时尚活动美学。

光效灵感来自高端时尚活动，灿烂的自然光从袋子上方倾泻而下，营造出明亮的高光、柔和的阴影、真实的纸张反射和电影般的对比度。

调色板：浓郁的深红色、深黑色、清爽的白色和温暖的奶油色纸张色调。

风格：超高端奢侈街头服饰活动、现代社论设计、电影时尚摄影、杂志封面品质、大胆的图形构图、超逼真的纹理、完美的排版融合、超细致、照片级真实、8K 杰作、获奖商业广告、优质品牌美学。

items.title: 超写实俯视草地情侣浪漫人像摄影

prompts.text:
Ultra-realistic lifestyle couple portrait captured from a perfectly vertical top-down overhead perspective. A handsome young man (Face given in refrance image 1) and a beautiful young woman (FACE GIVEN IN REFRANCE IMAGE 2 ) are lying closely together on lush, vibrant green grass in a peaceful garden during a warm summer afternoon. Their heads gently touch while they hold hands naturally with intertwined fingers, creating an intimate and romantic moment.

The woman has soft medium-length wavy chestnut-brown hair spread naturally on the grass, flawless fair skin, delicate facial features, warm brown eyes, a genuine bright smile, elegant gold drop earrings, wearing a fitted deep red sleeveless camisole and dark denim jeans. One hand rests naturally on her waist while the other holds her partner's hand.

The man has thick textured black hair with natural volume, light stubble, sharp masculine facial features, expressive brown eyes, and a subtle relaxed smile. He wears a fitted black crew-neck t-shirt and lies upside down relative to the camera, with one arm extended above his head and the other reaching toward the woman while holding her hand.

Soft natural sunlight filters through nearby tree branches, creating beautiful dappled leaf shadows across their faces, clothing, and the surrounding grass. Out-of-focus flowers, leaves, and branches frame the foreground, producing dreamy depth and a cinematic composition. Rich green grass texture, realistic skin pores, natural hair strands, subtle fabric folds, authentic lighting, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, peaceful romantic atmosphere, editorial lifestyle photography, premium fashion campaign aesthetic.

items.title: 娜美现代高级时装角色设定海报

prompts.text:
Create a 2:3 vertical modern high-end character fashion design poster, with an overall temperament that is a combination of a fashion magazine editorial page, a brand lookbook, and a character clothing development board. The picture presents a clean, restrained, realistic, soft, and sophisticated modern fashion vision, with the texture of a luxury brand collaboration blockbuster and high-end clothing design archive pages.

The main subject is a high-fashion reimagined version of Nami from "One Piece" in live-action cosplay. The character is an East Asian adult woman in her 20s, with exquisite and bright facial features, carrying a high-end Japanese and Korean cosplay photo feel, blending the vitality and freshness of Japanese character photo albums with the slender proportions of Korean fashion blockbusters. She is wearing a full set of clothing redesigned based on Nami's complete character styling: retaining orange long hair, navigator identity, blue and orange color scheme, fresh tops, slim-fit bottoms, shell or ocean symbols, Log Pose, nautical charts, Clima-Tact, and a smart and agile character temperament.

The clothing design focuses on orange, navy blue, white, pale gold, and a small amount of denim blue. The upper body adopts a high-end resort-style short top or slim-fit vest structure, incorporating exquisite edge lines, marine patterns, and metal buckle decorations. The bottom combines high-waisted short skirts, culottes, lightweight slit long skirts, or high-end denim structures, paired with thin-strap shoes or fashion boots. The overall character temperament is smart, free, bright, and sexy but not frivolous through clean tailoring, cinched waistline, light layers, leg lines, marine patterns, and nautical accessories.

The character is the main visual core of the entire picture, with a full-body shot from hair to toes clearly visible, the character's height accounting for about 92% to 96% of the frame. The standing posture is a natural high-fashion blockbuster standing pose, with weight on one leg, a slight turn of the body, a natural shoulder-hip relationship, smooth body lines, and a confident and agile expression with a bit of playfulness and control, like a brand's main visual model.

The background is a real modern high-end fashion display space, close to a minimalist brand runway, a fashion showroom, or a modern exhibition-style showroom. The space is bright, clean, and soft, with light-colored walls, curved architectural outlines, delicate ground reflections, slight depth of field, and real spatial depth. The lighting is modern commercial fashion photography lighting, with soft main light illuminating the character's face, orange hair strands, clothing layers, and shoes, and slight rim light separating the body edges, presenting a real brand blockbuster texture.

The layout adopts "full-width character main visual + magazine-style surrounding blocks." The line drawing modules are distributed around the character in the frame, with the number controlled at 6 to 7 blocks, staggered in size and balanced in arrangement. The line drawing blocks adopt a high-end clothing design draft style, mainly featuring fine black and gray line drawings, light gray sketch cross-hatching, local extremely light color blocks, paper textures, and a small amount of handwritten-feel annotations. The base color of the blocks is mainly high-end off-white and warm white paper colors, with local additions of light navy blue, light orange, soft white, and pale gold, forming a bright and unified color rhythm.

The content of the blocks includes: main clothing structure design drafts, top and waistline design drafts, skirt or high-waisted bottom structure drafts, shoe structure drafts, Log Pose and nautical accessory sketches, Clima-Tact or ocean symbol design drafts, and partial drafts of denim, satin, or tulle materials. Small color palettes or color swatches are added locally to make the page look more like a real fashion development page.

Brand collaboration lettering and title typography are added in the top left area:
“ONE PIECE”
“X”
“NAMI”
The title “NAMI” uses a large, elegant serif font, presenting the texture of a fashion brand poster. Adding a small text watermark “0xkyne”. The subtitle can use:
“Navigator in Blue”

The entire picture emphasizes the unified effect of “real fashion shot + high-end design draft surround + brand special layout.” The character remains the strongest visual focus, and the line drawing modules serve as a fashionable, designed, and editorial information auxiliary layer.

prompts.text:
制作一张 2:3 竖版现代高级角色时装设定海报，整体气质为时装杂志编辑页、品牌 lookbook、角色服装开发板的结合体。画面呈现干净、克制、真实、柔和、精致的现代时尚视觉，具有奢侈品牌联名大片与高级服装设计档案页的质感。

主体为《海贼王》里的娜美真人 cosplay 高级时装重释版本。人物是一位 20 多岁的东亚成年女性，五官精致明亮，带有日韩高级 cosplay 写真感，融合日式角色写真集的活力清爽与韩式时尚大片的修长比例。她穿着基于娜美完整角色造型重新设计的全套服装：保留橙色长发、航海士身份、蓝橙配色、清爽上装、修身下装、贝壳或海洋符号、记录指针、航海图、天候棒与聪明灵动的角色气质。

服装设计以橙色、海蓝、白色、浅金与少量牛仔蓝为主。上身采用高级度假风短上装或修身背心结构，加入精致边线、海洋纹样和金属扣饰。下装结合高腰短裙、裙裤、轻盈开衩长裙或高级牛仔结构，搭配细带鞋履或时装靴。整体通过清爽剪裁、收束腰线、轻盈层次、腿部线条、海洋纹样和航海配饰，呈现聪明、自由、明亮、性感但不轻浮的角色气质。

人物为整张画面的主视觉核心，完整全身入镜，从头发到鞋尖清晰可见，人物高度占画面约 92% 到 96%。站姿为高级时装大片式自然站姿，单腿承重，轻微侧身，肩胯关系自然，身体线条流畅，神态自信灵动，带一点俏皮和掌控感，像品牌主视觉模特。

背景为真实现代高端时装展示空间，接近极简品牌秀场、时装陈列厅或现代展览式 showroom。空间明亮、干净、柔和，有浅色墙面、弧形建筑轮廓、细腻地面反射、轻微景深与真实空间纵深。光线为现代商业时装摄影灯光，柔和主光照亮人物面部、橙色发丝、服装层次和鞋履，轻微轮廓光分离身体边缘，整体呈现真实品牌大片质感。

版式采用“整幅人物主视觉 + 杂志编辑式环绕分块”。线稿模块围绕人物分布在画面四周，数量控制在 6 到 7 块，大小错落，排布均衡。线稿分块采用高级服装设计稿风格，以精细黑灰线稿、淡灰素描排线、局部极淡色块、纸面纹理、少量手写感注释为主。分块底色以高级米白、暖白纸色为主，局部加入浅海蓝、浅橙、柔白、淡金色，形成明亮统一的色彩节奏。

分块内容包括：主服装结构设计稿、上装与腰线设计稿、裙装或高腰下装结构稿、鞋履结构稿、记录指针与航海配饰草图、天候棒或海洋符号设计稿、牛仔、缎面或薄纱材质局部稿。局部加入极小号色板或配色小样，使页面更像真正的时装开发页。

左上区域加入品牌联名字样与标题排版：
“ONE PIECE”
“X”
“NAMI”
标题“NAMI”使用大号优雅衬线体，呈现时装品牌海报质感。加入小号文字水印“0xkyne”。副标题可使用：
“Navigator in Blue”

整张画面强调“真实时装成片 + 高级设计稿环绕 + 品牌专题排版”的统一效果。人物保持最强视觉焦点，线稿模块作为时尚化、设计化、编辑化的信息辅助层。

items.title: 超现实产品摄影与黑色手绘涂鸦创意广告

prompts.text:
Use the uploaded product image as the primary reference.

Preserve the original product exactly as shown, including its packaging design, logo placement, typography, branding elements, colors, proportions, materials, textures, reflections, shadows, product shape, food appearance, beverage appearance, ingredients, label details, and overall brand identity.

DO NOT redesign, simplify, reinterpret, replace, crop, distort, recolor, or modify any packaging, logos, branding, structural details, or label elements. The product must remain 100% photorealistic and completely unchanged.

Transform the product into the hero of a premium commercial advertising campaign while keeping the product itself entirely realistic.

Before generating the scene, intelligently analyze the product's category, purpose, flavor, ingredients, packaging style, brand personality, color palette, and emotional appeal.

Based on that analysis, automatically develop a fun, playful, visually engaging concept that feels naturally connected to the product.

Choose an activity that authentically reinforces the product's identity, usage occasion, lifestyle, season, flavor, or personality—never something random or disconnected.

Automatically generate matching doodle props that support the chosen activity and strengthen the visual storytelling.

Select a clean pastel studio background inspired by the dominant colors of the product packaging and branding, ensuring strong visual harmony while maintaining enough contrast for the product to remain the clear focal point.

Position the product in a dynamic tilted pose that conveys movement, energy, and personality.

Surround the product with playful hand-drawn doodle illustrations created using loose black marker lines.

Illustrate ONLY the following as doodles:
- Arms
- Hands
- Legs
- Shoes
- Facial expression (only if appropriate)
- Activity props
- Motion lines
- Speed lines
- Swirls
- Impact effects
- Decorative doodles

Keep the product itself completely photorealistic.

All doodles must share the same hand-drawn black marker style with consistent line weight, slightly imperfect strokes, expressive energy, and a fun mascot-like personality.

Generate additional decorative doodles that naturally complement the chosen concept, such as leaves, stars, bubbles, sparkles, confetti, splashes, crumbs, petals, clouds, geometric shapes, or other relevant elements.

Add realistic, soft floating shadows beneath the product to create convincing depth.

Use premium commercial product photography lighting with soft diffused studio illumination, realistic reflections, subtle shadows, shallow depth of field, premium retouching, and luxury advertising quality.

Leave generous negative space suitable for marketing headlines, branding, or promotional copy.

The final artwork should feel like a world-class advertising campaign that seamlessly combines ultra-realistic commercial product photography with playful hand-drawn doodle illustrations, contemporary graphic design, dynamic storytelling, premium branding, minimalist composition, and mascot-style personality.

Quality: Ultra-realistic, premium commercial photography, playful doodle illustration, modern advertising campaign, editorial quality, clean composition, crisp details, highly detailed, 8K.

Creative Direction:

Do NOT choose the first obvious idea.

Instead, approach the image as an award-winning commercial art director creating a premium social media campaign for the product.

Invent a unique, memorable, emotionally engaging concept that feels fresh and distinctive.

The activity, doodle props, and decorative elements should be clever, unexpected, and perfectly aligned with the product's branding, personality, and intended audience.

Every generated image should be visually unique while remaining fully consistent with the product's identity.

Avoid repeating the same poses, activities, props, layouts, or compositions across different products

完全按照原样保留原始产品，包括其包装设计、徽标位置、排版、品牌元素、颜色、比例、材料、纹理、反射、阴影、产品形状、食物外观、饮料外观、成分、标签细节和整体品牌标识。

请勿重新设计、简化、重新解释、替换、裁剪、变形、重新着色或修改任何包装、徽标、品牌、结构细节或标签元素。产品必须保持100%写实且完全不变。

将产品转化为高端商业广告活动的中心，同时保持产品本身完全真实。

在生成场景之前，智能分析产品的类别、用途、风味、成分、包装风格、品牌个性、调色板和情感吸引力。

基于该分析，自动开发一个有趣、俏皮、具有视觉吸引力且感觉与产品自然连接的概念。

选择一种能真实强化产品身份、使用场合、生活方式、季节、风味或个性的活动——绝不是随机或脱节的内容。

自动生成与所选活动匹配的涂鸦道具，以支持视觉叙事。

选择灵感源自产品包装和品牌主色的干净柔和色调影棚背景，确保强烈的视觉和谐，同时保持足够的对比度以使产品保持为清晰的焦点。

将产品置于传达运动、能量和个性的动态倾斜姿态中。

使用松散的黑色马克笔线条创作的俏皮手绘涂鸦插画包围产品。

仅将以下内容插画为涂鸦：
- 手臂
- 手
- 腿
- 鞋子
- 面部表情（仅在适当时）
- 活动道具
- 运动线
- 速度线
- 漩涡
- 冲击效果
- 装饰性涂鸦

保持产品本身完全写实。

所有涂鸦必须共享相同的手绘黑色马克笔风格，具有一致的线条粗细、略微不完美的笔触、富有表现力的活力和有趣的吉祥物般个性。

生成额外的装饰性涂鸦，自然地补充所选概念，例如叶子、星星、气泡、闪光、彩纸、溅沫、碎屑、花瓣、云朵、几何形状或其他相关元素。

在产品下方添加真实的软漂浮阴影，以创造令人信服的深度。

使用高端商业产品摄影照明，具有柔和的扩散影棚光照、真实的反射、细微的阴影、浅景深、高级修图和奢侈广告质量。

留出足够的负空间，适用于营销标题、品牌宣传或促销文案。

最终作品应感觉像是一个世界级的广告活动，将超写实的商业产品摄影与俏皮的手绘涂鸦插画、当代平面设计、动态叙事、高端品牌、极简构图和吉祥物风格个性无缝结合。

不要选择第一个明显的想法。

相反，以获奖商业艺术总监的角度为该产品创作一个高端社交媒体活动。

创造一个独特、难忘、具有情感吸引力且感觉新颖独特的情境。

活动、涂鸦道具和装饰元素应该是聪明、意想不到的，并与产品的品牌、个性和目标受众完美契合。

prompts.text:
Create the fourth image of the unified brand visual system for “OZOUO” fruit drinks, keeping exactly the same brand identity, mascot illustration style, typography system, 225ml can proportion, lychee flavor hero design, and overall color DNA as the established OZOUO visual system. This image must serve a new responsibility: a retail touchpoint and brand-extension application board, not a packaging sheet, not a flavor lineup poster, and not a broad campaign collage.

Core role:
This image should show how the OZOUO brand system extends into real consumer touchpoints, including point-of-sale materials, retail-ready packaging extensions, fridge display, branded lifestyle accessories, and human interaction moments. It should feel like a polished brand application board for a modern beverage launch.

Overall composition:
Use a clean multi-panel layout on a soft warm beige or creamy neutral background, with 5 or 6 sections arranged in a tidy brand-presentation collage. Each panel should feel visually distinct but clearly belong to the same OZOUO world. The whole image must remain calm, premium, playful, and highly coherent.

Brand consistency:
Keep exactly the same OZOUO identity system:
same “OZOUO” wordmark,
same lychee hero flavor,
same adult-oriented cartoon lychee mascot,
same 225ml compact can design,
same creamy base + lychee pink + deep brown typography,
same “PEEL THE MOOD” tone of voice,
same balance between cute and grown-up.
Everything must clearly feel like one brand.

Suggested panel structure:

Panel 1:
Branded print materials such as postcards, flyers, mini posters, or brand cards laid flat in a neat presentation. Use the same OZOUO logo, lychee mascot, and creamy-pink color system. The style should feel simple, graphic, and collectible.

Panel 2:
A compact retail multipack or gift carton designed for the OZOUO 225ml cans. Show a realistic branded paper carrier or small boxed set using the same mascot and typography system. It should feel commercially believable and shelf-ready.

Panel 3:
A refrigerated retail shelf display with multiple OZOUO lychee cans lined up neatly inside a cooler. The cans should look cold, fresh, slightly condensed, and highly recognizable. This panel demonstrates shelf impact and retail visibility.

Panel 4:
A stylish young adult holding or presenting an OZOUO can in a natural lifestyle moment. Keep the person fashionable, modern, and brand-appropriate, with the can clearly visible. The mood should feel social, confident, and urban, not like a generic stock photo.

Panel 5:
A branded tote bag, shopping bag, or soft lifestyle accessory using the OZOUO visual system. The bag should feel trendy, useful, and premium, extending the brand into daily life. Use the logo and mascot in a more graphic, simplified way.

Optional Panel 6:
A small point-of-sale or countertop display, sticker sheet, shelf wobblers, or branded cooler decal system, proving the OZOUO design language works across retail details.

Visual tone:
The board should feel more practical and retail-facing than the previous campaign image. It must communicate how OZOUO appears in real purchase environments and branded consumer touchpoints. Each panel should be simple, strong, and brand-consistent.

Typography:
Typography should stay concise and highly recognizable, using the same OZOUO system:
“OZOUO”
“LYCHEE JUICE DRINK”
“PEEL THE MOOD”
“轻启一罐，荔刻上头”
“成人向果味灵感”
Use text sparingly and strategically. Avoid cluttered copy.

Color palette:
Use the established OZOUO lychee palette:
creamy warm beige,
soft blush pink,
lychee rose,
berry-pink accents,
deep espresso-brown typography,
small fresh green leaf accents.
All applications should clearly feel part of the same family.

Styling:
Adult playful, stylish, retail-ready, social-media friendly, clean, modern, premium FMCG branding, cute but not childish, polished and commercially believable.

Rendering:
hyper-detailed 225ml can mockups, realistic packaging materials, premium print finishes, clean collage composition, realistic fridge display, lifestyle application realism, soft studio shadows, 8k, brand presentation quality.

Negative prompt:
repeated technical packaging board, barcode-heavy design, random flavor changes, inconsistent mascot style, childish kids drink branding, messy collage, unrelated products, weak retail realism, low detail, inconsistent can proportions, generic supermarket branding, cluttered layout

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium advertising poster for Yellow Tail Merlot red wine, built around a strong contrast between one highly realistic wine bottle and a surrounding world of lively hand-drawn exploration-route line art. The image should feel clean, adventurous, graphic, playful, premium, and highly brand-specific, like a collectible illustrated wine poster on textured paper.

Main composition:
Place one realistic bottle of Yellow Tail Merlot exactly at the center as the absolute hero object. The bottle must be highly realistic and unmistakably Yellow Tail: deep merlot-red wine glow, crisp label, iconic yellow kangaroo mark clearly visible, elegant foil capsule, glossy glass reflections, realistic shadow, and premium wine-bottle rendering. The bottle must be the only fully realistic object in the image.

Background:
Use a very clean warm ivory or pale cream textured paper background with generous negative space. The paper should feel premium and lightly tactile, like an artist’s poster sheet. Keep the background open and uncluttered.

Core visual system:
Around the bottle, create a hand-drawn black-ink exploration route that wraps and travels around the bottle like a map-based adventure path. The line art should not behave like a decorative frame or random doodles. It must feel like a drawn route map unfolding around the bottle, with winding paths, directional arrows, signposts, handwritten labels, route marks, tiny icons, and small illustrated discoveries placed along the journey.

Exploration-route storytelling:
Make the bottle feel like the key landmark in the middle of an Australian wine adventure map. Along the route, integrate small hand-drawn symbols and discoveries related to Yellow Tail and Australian Merlot identity:
leaping kangaroo icon,
vineyard hills,
grape clusters,
eucalyptus sprigs,
sun symbols,
wine barrels,
harvest crate,
country road marks,
southern stars,
tiny birds,
wine glass icon,
open plains,
small cellar sketch,
route arrows,
distance marks,
handwritten place notes,
little exploration badges,
“stop here” or “discover this” style sign graphics.
The drawings should feel lively, curious, slightly playful, and full of discovery.

Layout behavior:
The route should move around the bottle in a dynamic way, as if circling and guiding the eye across the page. Some parts can curve behind the bottle, some can run beside it, some can create mini stops around top left, right side, lower side, and bottom areas. The composition should feel like a hand-drawn travel/adventure map centered on the bottle. Do not make the line art symmetrical or evenly distributed. Let it feel exploratory and organic.

Style:
The line art should be crisp black ink with a premium hand-drawn identity feel, combining route-map graphics, handwritten signage, and light illustrative storytelling. Add a subtle Art Nouveau influence only in the flowing vine curves and rhythmic line movement, but keep the overall feeling modern, clean, and brand-driven.

Color system:
warm ivory paper background,
deep merlot red bottle,
black ink route illustration,
small Yellow Tail signature yellow accents,
tiny touches of vineyard green only if necessary.
Keep the palette highly restrained so the bottle remains the most saturated and realistic focal point.

Typography:
Integrate typography into the route-map world rather than using a standard ad layout. Use small elegant hand-drawn or poster-style phrases woven into the exploration route, such as:
“YELLOW TAIL”
“MERLOT”
“LEAP INTO RED”
“EXPLORE THE TASTE”
“AUSTRALIA IN A BOTTLE”
These text fragments should feel like route labels, signposts, or little discovery notes around the bottle.

Optional subtle Chinese text can be integrated in a similarly restrained way:
“黄尾袋鼠 梅洛干红”
“澳洲风味探索”
“沿着果香一路前行”
Keep Chinese minimal, refined, and secondary.

Mood:
clean, graphic, adventurous, Australian, lively, route-based, exploratory, premium, collectible, high-contrast, hand-drawn, fresh, intelligent, brand-driven.

Rendering:

Add a mirrored floor or dark reflection strip below, where reflections are elongated, darkened, and slightly blurred, giving the image a ritualized stage depth; the outer layer can have a restrained dark information box or boundary line, with a small amount of short labels in the top right corner, miniature descriptions on the side, and local name-style information layers inside, text using white or theme-derived light colors as high-readability information colors, and a small amount of emotional color used only for small-area emphasis. Colors are extracted from the theme's own material, emotion, or brand semantics, retaining a relationship of large-area clear dark backgrounds, clear high-saturation glowing primary colors, minimal light-colored text, and clean dark-to-light steps, forming a calm, sharp, and dramatic tech stage mood; primary colors are responsible for emotion and backlighting, dark colors for structure and negative space, and light colors only for reading, without using muddy gray-brown, distressed stains, or cluttered gradients. The overall texture has slight film grain, shadow noise, and sharp edges, with the composition leaving wide dark areas for the information layer to breathe, avoiding filling the compartments with details, the final effect should be like a precisely choreographed backlit launch event, with the theme disassembled into a rhythmic silhouette matrix and strong information hierarchy.

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium advertising poster for Guerlain perfume, in the visual spirit of the Aqua Allegoria line, using a minimalist ingredient-board composition on a clean pale ivory-warm-gray background. The image should feel fresh, refined, precise, airy, and extremely luxurious, like an international fragrance campaign with highly controlled composition and couture-level still-life photography.

Main composition:
Place one realistic Guerlain Aqua Allegoria perfume bottle exactly at the center as the absolute hero object. The bottle must be unmistakably Guerlain: elegant transparent glass bottle, luminous pale golden perfume liquid, refined honeycomb texture, iconic rounded gold cap, crisp luxurious label, crystal-clear reflections, and exquisite premium detail. The bottle should be the brightest, clearest, and most luminous object in the image.

Composition structure:
Arrange the fragrance-note ingredients in a restrained, spread-out, flat-lay-inspired composition around the bottle, not as a wreath, not as a bouquet, and not as a dense decorative frame. The note elements should feel gently laid out on the same surface behind and around the bottle, with open spacing, calm visual balance, and strong editorial restraint. The bottle remains dominant while the ingredients act as a refined composition board.

Fragrance-note layout:
Create four carefully art-directed note clusters around the central Guerlain bottle:
top left: fresh mandarin and bergamot slices, glossy citrus peel, a few dew droplets
top right: delicate white floral cluster such as orange blossom and neroli petals, with elegant green leaves
bottom left: a fresh basil or green aromatic herb cluster, clean, sculptural, vibrant, premium
bottom right: soft white musk-inspired element interpreted as smooth pale material, translucent petals, or clean airy white botanical texture, with a few crystal-clear droplets

Visual language:
The surrounding ingredients should be slightly deeper, richer, and more saturated than the perfume bottle itself, so the transparent bottle stands out clearly. The ingredient clusters must feel premium, hyper-real, fresh, tactile, and materially rich, like botanical specimens in a luxury fragrance editorial. Keep them restrained, crisp, and sculptural, never messy.

Background:
Use a very clean pale ivory-gray or warm light stone background with no environmental clutter. The surface should feel softly matte, smooth, and expensive. Add only subtle natural shadows beneath each element to create depth while preserving the flat, controlled, and elevated luxury-ad look.

Typography:
Typography must be extremely minimal, elegant, and editorial. Do not place any scattered small black text in the upper-left corner. Keep the layout elevated and quiet. Place a clean centered title at the top:
“GUERLAIN”
“AQUA ALLEGORIA”

Under the bottle, place a restrained supporting line:
“mandarin, bergamot, neroli, basil, white musk”
or
“fresh clarity in botanical couture”

Optional refined Chinese support in very small tasteful typography:
“娇兰香水”
“极简清爽”
“精致到每一寸细节”

Add tiny elegant labels near the ingredient clusters if needed:
“MANDARIN”
“NEROLI”
“BASIL”
“WHITE MUSK”
or bilingual minimalist labels:
“柑橘”
“橙花”
“罗勒”
“白麝香”

The labels should be very subtle, airy, and integrated into the composition.

Color palette:
pale ivory background,
transparent golden perfume tone,
fresh citrus yellow,
leaf green,
soft white petals,
warm gold accents,
clear dew highlights.
The overall palette should feel clean, refreshing, luminous, and expensive.

Mood:
clean, fresh, luminous, precise, restrained, botanical, couture, luxurious, airy, highly detailed, editorial, calm, elegant, unforgettable.

Rendering:
hyper-detailed luxury perfume photography, pristine glass reflections, realistic citrus texture, crisp leaf detail, delicate white petals, subtle water droplets, elegant soft shadows, 8k, international fragrance campaign quality, minimal but powerful, extremely refined.

Negative prompt:
crowded composition, wreath arrangement, bouquet styling, messy props, dark dramatic background, weak Guerlain identity, blurry bottle, cheap cosmetic ad, too much text, upper-left scattered black text, plain black font, low detail, random filler objects, overdecorated scene, childish layout

生活方式产品

将上传的产品转化为适用于以下场景的高级快消品英雄广告：

• 产品目录
• 亚马逊列表

原始产品细节

items.title: 强信息图形海报规则场域俯视视角

prompts.text: Generate a strong information graphic poster around any subject object. Abstract the space, rules, or system belonging to the subject into a top-down white thin-line frame, with lines spreading close to the boundaries to form a clear structural field; the main body of the image does not rely on real-scene narration, but on huge, high-density, and thick Chinese title blocks pressed into the main visual area, with font shapes showing slight wear, breakage, and printing grains, creating a warm, direct, and tournament-like impact. The title overlaps with the structural line frame, and small information text is embedded around the title in neat short lines, establishing a reading hierarchy like event times, stages, and rule descriptions, with the font remaining clean sans-serif and having clear thickness contrast. Add a dynamic small object or symbol derived from the theme as a focal breakthrough point, which flies out or swipes across from between the text and the line frame, coordinated with two or three clean arc trajectories to create a sense of speed, making the static layout appear in momentary motion. The background uses the main color extracted from the subject's own material, emotion, or cultural semantics as a large-area structural base color, maintaining high saturation but clean brightness; the text and line frames use high-brightness light colors to bear information and order, and a small amount of theme-derived emphasis colors are only used for key symbols, small icons, or brand-level details. The overall color should be bright, clean, and full of energy, retaining large areas of pure base color, clear color gradients, strong text contrast, and small-area dynamic emphasis relationships, not copying fixed color numbers, nor doing gray-dirty vintage processing. The texture is a combination of slight paper grain and printing wear, with clear edges and dense but not chaotic information, the final effect being like a theme quiz or activity visual driven by a rule field, huge text, precise line drawing, and instantaneous momentum. —————— Horizontal requirement: Horizontal 16:9, use pre-match information of the World Cup opening game as a large-screen warm-up video cover, top-down view of stadium white lines covering the boundaries, huge title says 'Opening Night'. Information to be exposed: June 14 20:00, National Stadium, Group A first round, Live reservation opened, made into short-line descriptions around the title. Dynamic focal point: A football brushes past the center line from the bottom right of the title and flies out, with two arc trajectories, and the small-area emphasis color comes from the home team jersey.

prompts.text:
围绕任意主题对象生成一张强信息图形海报，把主题所属的空间、规则或系统抽象成俯视式白色细线框，线条贴近边界铺开，形成清晰的结构场域；画面主体不是靠真实场景叙事，而是靠巨大、高密度、粗重的中文标题块压入主要视觉区，字形有轻微磨损、断裂和印刷颗粒，形成热烈、直接、带赛事感的冲击力。标题与结构线框发生叠压关系，信息小字以整齐短行嵌入标题周围，像活动时间、阶段、规则说明一样建立阅读层级，字体保持干净无衬线，粗细对比明确。加入一个主题派生的动态小物或符号作为焦点突破点，它从文字与线框之间飞出或划过，配合两三条干净弧线轨迹制造速度感，让静态排版出现瞬间运动。背景使用主题自身材质、情绪或文化语义中提取的主色作为大面积结构底色，保持高饱和但明度干净；文字与线框使用高明度浅色承担信息和秩序，少量主题派生强调色只用于关键符号、小图标或品牌级细节。整体色彩应明亮、洁净、充满能量，保留大面积纯净底色、清晰色阶、强文字反差和小面积动感强调的关系，不照搬固定色号，也不做灰脏复古处理。质感为轻微纸面颗粒与印刷磨损结合，边缘清楚，信息密集但不混乱，最终效果像一张以规则场域、巨大文字、精确线描和瞬间动势共同驱动的主题竞猜或活动视觉。


——————
横版需求: 横版 16:9，用世界杯揭幕战赛前信息做大屏预热视频封面，俯视球场白线铺满边界，巨大标题写“开幕之夜”。
需要露出的信息: 6月14日 20:00、国家体育场、A组首轮、直播预约已开启，做成标题周围的短行说明。
动势焦点: 一颗足球从标题右下方擦过中线飞出，带两条弧线轨迹，小面积强调色来自主队球衣。

items.title: 网球主题强冲击视觉广告海报

prompts.text:
Generate a high-impact advertising visual around any subject theme: the screen is clearly divided into two functional areas, the top is a clean theme scene window, establishing spatial order with concise lines or structural boundaries; the bottom is a whole field of high-saturation, bright, and clean emotional color, carrying huge theme symbols and short, powerful main slogans. The theme object appears as a real shot or highly realistic main form, stuck at the junction of the two areas, maintaining a momentary posture of diagonal stretching, leaping out of boundaries, and pulling the line of sight upwards, making the main form belong to both the scene and the information area at the same time, forming a strong sense of graphic crossing; clear shadows fall on the color field below, increasing speed, weight, and presence. Colors are extracted from the theme's own material, emotion, and cultural signals: the largest color surface uses a bright and pure emotional background color, the upper scene uses structural colors that form a cold-warm or brightness contrast with the theme, the main form uses a high-visibility theme emphasis color, and text and symbols use clean light or dark colors to establish tough hierarchies; overall maintain high brightness, strong saturation, sharp boundaries, bright and brisk, without dirty, old, or greyed treatments. Typography is as direct as a sports advertisement, the bottom main slogan has thick weight, tight tracking, and stable position, small vertical information can be added to the side as a rhythm line, but text only serves hierarchy and impact, not overshadowing the main subject. The final output needs to have compressed space like bird's-eye photography, hard light shadows, slight print texture, distinct borders, and a call to action that can be understood at a glance, avoiding ordinary illustration style, loose collage feeling, and weightless decorative layout.

——————
Want to replace with: Tennis racket and tennis shoes crossing the top and bottom divisions, with a strong action traction like a training advertisement.
Store use: Tennis course registration page header or offline event poster, suitable for placing short promotional titles.
Retained information: Bottom main slogan reads "READY TO SERVE", the screen is clean and bright without a complex background.
Output specification: Landscape 16:9

items.title: 夜巷街头成熟日系女性人像

prompts.text:
Subject: Night Alley

Character / Expression:
A woman in her 20s. A natural and mature atmosphere without childishness. Dark brown medium-length hair tied up loosely, with thin bangs and loose strands around the face. Clear Japanese-style photo makeup, natural skin texture. Lips have a moderate flush of color. Face slightly tilted, with a calm expression looking directly at the camera.

Clothing / Pose:
Wearing a white to ivory fine-ribbed knit cardigan, slightly open at the front. Underneath is a black simple camisole, and the bottom is gray high-waisted loose trousers. A small light gray shoulder bag is carried on one shoulder. The body is slightly tilted towards the left of the frame, with the back leaning gently against a dark stone wall. The character's own left hand is placed lightly on the back of the head, and the right hand is tucked into the trouser pocket. Fingertips are naturally curved, creating a relaxed difference in center of gravity between the shoulders and waist. An elegant and restrained adult street portrait.

Background / Lighting:
A backstreet in Tokyo at night. Dim building walls, narrow sidewalks, blurred taillights in the distance, sign lights, and circular halos from street lamps. Background text is blurred to the point of being unrecognizable. The road surface is slightly wet, with the reflection of streetlights extending long and thin. A faint white light similar to a flash shines from the front slightly above the left, highlighting the face, white cardigan, and shoulders. The background falls deep and dark, with only the distant halos appearing as warm-colored bokeh.

Composition / Lens:
Vertical composition 4:5. A medium shot from above the waist to above the thighs. The character is placed off-center to the right of the frame, with the left side reserved for the depth of the night road and dark negative space. The camera position is slightly higher than the chest, almost at eye level. The distance between the character and the camera is close, with shallow depth of field in the background. A natural sense of distance like a snapshot. Focus is concentrated on the pupils and around the face.

Texture / Style:
High-quality Japanese photo. Night flash photography style, with a slightly grainy film-like texture. Skin is not overly smoothed, naturally retaining pores and luster. A calm color palette dominated by black, ivory, gray, and warm bokeh. Avoid excessive HDR or advertising photo styles, with a slightly moist urban night atmosphere.

Negative Prompt:
Minors, young faces, overexposure, see-through clothing, nudity, vulgar poses, exaggerated bodies, clones of the same face, unnatural eye contact, extra or missing fingers, merged hands and feet, deformed joints, poor contact of bags or clothing, unnatural gravity, recognizable background text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, excessive HDR, overly strong AI feel.

prompts.text:
主题：夜巷

人物・表情：
20多岁的女性。没有稚气的自然而成熟氛围。黑褐色的中长发松散地扎起，保留稀疏的刘海和脸部周围的散落发丝。清透的日系照片妆容，自然的肌肤质感。嘴唇带有适度的血色。脸部微微倾斜，平静的表情直视镜头。

服装・姿势：
穿着白色至象牙色的细肋针织开衫，前开稍敞。内搭黑色简约的吊带背心，下身是灰色高腰宽松长裤。单肩挎着一个小巧的浅灰色肩背包。身体略微向画面左侧倾斜，背部轻轻靠在暗色的石墙上。人物自己的左手轻放在后脑勺，右手插进裤袋。指尖自然弯曲，在肩部和腰部制造松弛的重心差异。高雅而克制的成人街头肖像。

背景・光线：
东京夜晚的后街。昏暗的建筑物墙壁，狭窄的人行道，远处模糊的车尾灯、招牌灯和街灯的圆形光晕。背景文字模糊到无法辨识的程度。路面略微湿润，街灯的反射细长地延伸。人物正面稍偏左上方照来微弱的类似闪光灯的白色光线，将脸部、白色开衫和肩部衬托出来。背景深沉下坠，只有远处的光晕呈暖色虚化。

构图・镜头：
纵向构图 4:5。从腰部上方至大腿上方纳入的中景镜头。人物配置在画面右侧偏位，左侧保留夜路的纵深和黑暗的留白。镜头位置略高于胸口，几乎平视。人物与镜头的距离较近，背景浅景虚化。宛如抓拍照片般的自然距离感。焦点集中在瞳孔和脸部周围。

质感・风格：
高质量的日系照片。夜间闪光拍摄风格，略带颗粒感的胶片般质感。肌肤不过度平滑，自然保留毛孔和光泽。以上以黑、象牙白、灰色和暖色虚化为主的沉稳色调。避免过度HDR或广告照片风格，带有些许湿润的都市夜晚氛围。

负面提示：
未成年人、幼态脸庞、过度暴露、透视服装、裸露、低俗姿势、夸张的身体、相同脸部的复制、不自然的视线、多余或缺失的手指、手脚融合、关节变形、包袋或服装的接触不良、不自然的引力、背景文字可辨识、标志、水印、过度美肌修饰、塑料般的肌肤、过度HDR、过强的AI感。

items.title: OZOUO品牌视觉规范系统海报

prompts.text:
Create the fifth image of the unified visual system图1 for the fruit drink brand “OZOUO”, designed as a polished brand identity system board / visual guideline poster. Keep exactly the same brand DNA as the established OZOUO lychee drink system: same OZOUO wordmark style, same 225ml compact can proportion, same adult-oriented lychee mascot, same creamy neutral base, same lychee pink and berry-red accent palette, same deep espresso-brown typography, same slogan tone such as “PEEL THE MOOD”, and the same balance between playful and grown-up.

This image must serve a different role from the previous packaging sheet, flavor family poster, campaign collage, and retail touchpoint board. Its responsibility is to summarize the OZOUO brand world as a complete identity system, like a modern FMCG brand guideline board.

Overall composition:
Use a clean modular collage layout on a soft warm beige or creamy background, inspired by a premium brand guideline presentation board. The layout should feel structured, balanced, and highly designed, with multiple rectangular content zones arranged in a neat grid. The whole image should feel like a professional visual identity overview for a real beverage brand.

Core sections to include:
1. Brand logo block
A large OZOUO logo in the upper area as the main anchor. Show the logo clearly on a clean background, with strong breathing room. Add a short concise brand descriptor such as:
“OZOUO”
“LYCHEE JUICE DRINK”
“成人向果味灵感”
“PEEL THE MOOD”

2. Hero can photography
Show one or two hero OZOUO 225ml lychee cans in a premium studio product shot with condensation and realistic aluminum finish. The can should be unmistakably the same as the established OZOUO packaging design.

3. Color palette block
Present the brand color system in a clean palette section. Use OZOUO’s established tones:
cream beige,
lychee blush pink,
berry rose,
soft coral,
deep espresso brown,
fresh leaf green accent.
Display them as simple color swatches with a premium guideline feel.

4. Typography block
Show the OZOUO typography system with large sample letters and clean hierarchy. Present the logotype style and supporting typography as if this were a real brand manual. The type should feel stylish, rounded, adult-friendly, and shelf-ready.

5. Mascot and icon system block
Show the adult-oriented lychee mascot in a clean character presentation area, with one or two supporting graphic icons such as fruit droplets, leaves, bubbles, or tiny expression marks, all in the same OZOUO illustration language.

6. Pattern or graphic motif block
Show repeating OZOUO brand motifs such as floating lychee fruits, bubbles, leaf shapes, or simplified mascot repeats, arranged as a clean pattern sample. It should feel graphic and usable across packaging and merch.

7. Product lineup strip
Show a row of coordinated OZOUO 225ml cans, preferably lychee plus 2 additional flavor variants in the same brand system, to demonstrate scalability while keeping lychee as the hero flavor.

8. Brand extension / merch block
Show one or two brand-extension objects such as a branded carton multipack, tote bag, mini cooler bag, T-shirt, sticker sheet, or display cube, all using the same OZOUO visual system. Keep the application clean and believable.

9. Lifestyle or poster application block
Include one small campaign-style visual or lifestyle application image that shows how the OZOUO identity looks in the real world, but keep it secondary to the system layout.

Visual tone:
The entire board should feel playful, modern, FMCG-ready, graphic, clean, slightly cheeky, and premium. It should look like a true brand identity system board for a youthful fruit drink startup with strong shelf appeal. It must not feel childish, messy, or generic.

Flavor continuity:
Keep lychee as the lead identity anchor. The mascot, can, fruit elements, and pink accent system should remain clearly rooted in the lychee flavor world established in the existing OZOUO packaging design.

Typography suggestions:
Use concise text only, such as:
“OZOUO”
“LYCHEE JUICE DRINK”
“PEEL THE MOOD”
“轻启一罐，荔刻上头”
“成人向果味灵感”
“BRAND IDENTITY SYSTEM”
“COLOR PALETTE”
“TYPOGRAPHY”
“ICONOGRAPHY”
“PATTERN”
“PRODUCT FAMILY”
“BRAND ESSENCE”

Mood:
clean, brand-cohesive, graphic, youthful, adult playful, structured, premium, modern, FMCG, design-forward, presentation-ready, visually memorable.

Rendering:
hyper-detailed 225ml can mockups, premium print finishes, crisp mascot illustration, clean grid layout, polished studio lighting, realistic merch mockups, brand-guideline aesthetic, 8k, commercially believable.

Negative prompt:
technical packaging board only, barcode-heavy layout, inconsistent mascot style, random unrelated flavors, childish kids drink branding, messy collage, weak typography system, low detail, mismatched can proportions, generic supermarket branding, cluttered arrangement, inconsistent color palette

Create an ultra-high-definition 9:16 low-angle ultra-wide campus portrait.

The subject is an adult East Asian young woman with an authentic university student vibe, naturally beautiful facial features, realistic skin texture, bright expressive eyes, and long black hair gently flowing in the summer breeze.

The scene takes place on the wide steps outside a modern university building. The background includes a bright blue sky, lush green trees, a campus bulletin board, parked bicycles, contemporary academic buildings, and students walking in the distance, creating a lively and authentic university atmosphere.

She is wearing a light yellow sleeveless knitted top, white pleated skort, white athletic sneakers, white mid-calf socks, and carrying a light-colored canvas shoulder bag.

The camera is placed almost on the ground, shooting from directly in front of her feet with an ultra-wide-angle lens. One white sneaker is extremely close to the camera, creating a dramatic foreground perspective with sharp details of the toe box, laces, and sole texture. She is crouching naturally while tying her shoelaces, then looking up toward the camera with a warm, genuine smile, creating the feeling of a candid photo taken by a close friend.

Emphasize the oversized sneaker foreground, dramatic stair perspective, flowing hair in the breeze, bright summer sunshine, natural documentary-style campus photography, cinematic realism, HDR lighting, ultra-detailed textures, and a youthful university atmosphere.

Avoid: inappropriate or suggestive camera angles, distorted body proportions, plastic-looking AI skin, cartoon or illustration style, deformed shoes, incorrect hands or fingers, warped background, overexposure, low quality, or unrealistic anatomy.

The image should combine one realistic product with an explosive hand-drawn illustrated background, creating a youthful, saturated, energetic, and extremely lively candy campaign poster.

Main composition:
Place one realistic mini M&M’s tube package exactly at the center of the image. The package should be a slim portable candy tube, compact and upright, with a rounded cap and a clean cylindrical body, clearly designed as a mini snack tube for M&M’s. It must feel highly realistic, glossy, tactile, and instantly recognizable, with vivid M&M’s logo, colorful branding, premium printed label wrap, sharp reflections, and strong commercial product rendering. The mini tube should be the only fully realistic object in the composition and must dominate the center.

Packaging direction:
The tube should feel playful, portable, collectible, and snackable, like a convenient mini candy tube sold at retail checkout counters. The cap can be bold red, yellow, blue, or white. The body should clearly show M&M’s identity and may include a transparent section revealing colorful candies inside, or a bright fully printed wrapper with bold brand graphics. The tube should feel modern, cute, and highly display-friendly.

Background concept:
Behind the mini tube, create an explosive illustrated universe that radiates outward like a burst of candy energy. The background should not be realistic. Instead, it should be a dense, dynamic, hand-drawn graphic world made of bold black outlines, candy splashes, bounce arcs, swirls, pop-art shapes, looping doodles, comic impact bursts, and rhythmic motion graphics. The illustration should erupt from behind the tube and wrap around it in a circular energetic explosion.

Illustrated elements:

candy trails,

The illustrations should feel premium, bold, rhythmic, and highly art-directed, not messy childish scribbles.

Style contrast:
The mini tube must feel solid, glossy, realistic, and sharply rendered, while the illustrated universe behind it feels wild, colorful, playful, and explosive. This contrast between realism and hand-drawn candy chaos is the key visual hook. The product remains the visual anchor at all times.

Color palette:
Use a highly saturated M&M’s palette:
bright candy red,
electric blue,
sunny yellow,
vivid green,
orange,
chocolate brown,
clean white highlights,
and bold black line work.
Choose one strong dominant background field color such as vivid sky blue, rich yellow, or bright red, then let the multicolor candy illustration explode around the central mini tube.

Motion and energy:
The poster must feel like candy energy is bursting outward from the mini tube with bounce, swirl, pop, splash, spin, and playful impact. The overall mood should be dynamic, joyful, fast, pop, and impossible to ignore.

Typography:
Keep typography concise and energetic, placed cleanly without cluttering the composition. Use playful premium lettering, rounded and graphic, not ugly heavy black fonts.

“MINI TUBE, MAX FUN”

Keep text short, bold, youthful, and balanced with the central tube and illustrated explosion.

prompts.text:
Afternoon Selfie

Subject:
Centered on an adult woman holding a smartphone taking a selfie in a bright bedroom, using a vertical realistic photo style portrait.

Person · Expression:
A natural and realistic adult woman. Slightly long black hair with a bit of a wet clumped feel, bangs gently resting on her forehead. Her face is slightly tilted toward the camera, and her pupils are looking this way through the phone. There is a sense of calmness between her brows and eyes, and her lips are relaxed into a natural posture. The skin is not over-retouched, with the cheeks and the area around her collarbones bathed in soft indoor light.

Clothing · Pose:
Wearing a white ribbed material cropped camisole, the silhouette naturally fits the body. The chest is not intentionally emphasized, maintaining a mature adult balance. The bottoms are deep indigo denim shorts, with a low-waist design resting at the hip position. The person holds the phone with her right hand, her fingertips naturally fitting the side of the device. Her left hand is placed on a wooden desk at the bottom left of the frame, and her upper body leans slightly forward. Her waist is slightly tilted to one side, with the center of gravity shifted toward one leg.

Background · Light:
A small bedroom with white and beige as the main tones. On the right side of the frame are white curtains and a bed; on the left are a wooden desk and storage shelves, potted plants, a desk lamp, candles, and a blurred seaside photo frame. The main light source comes from the window on the right side of the frame, with soft daylight naturally falling on the right side of her face, her shoulders, and her white top. The desk lamp on the left provides warm auxiliary light, adding a hint of orange temperature to the background. Shadows are soft, naturally extending into the depths of the bed and storage shelves.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical composition. A close-range indoor selfie from above the chest to above the thighs. The person is located slightly to the right of the center of the frame, with the phone close to her face. A small amount of negative space is left above the head, and the waist is naturally included in the frame. The camera position is slightly higher than eye level, looking down slightly. The background uses a shallow depth of field for soft blurring, with the focus concentrated on the person's face, hair, phone, and upper body.

Texture · Style:
Realistic photographic expression. Skin retains natural pores and soft texture, and hair incorporates fine clumped details and luster. The white ribbed fabric, the thickness of the denim, the wooden desk, and the softness of the bed sheets are each clearly distinguishable. The color tone blends warm indoor light with elegant daylight, creating a natural atmosphere. Avoid excessive skin-beautifying retouching or a CG feel, retaining the intimacy and daily life atmosphere of a smartphone photo.

Negative Prompt:
Faces that look like minors, overexposure, overly sexy expressions, unnatural breast shapes, unnatural facial features, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands and feet, deformed joints, poor contact with the phone, sense of floating, unnatural gravity, incorrect perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, garbled text, logos, watermarks, excessive skin-beautifying retouching, plastic-like skin.

prompts.text:
午后自拍

主体：
以一位在明亮卧室中手持智能手机自拍的成年女性为中心，采用纵向的真实照片风格肖像。

人物·表情：
自然且富有现实感的大人女性。稍长的黑发带着些许湿润的束状感，刘海轻轻搭在额前。脸庞略微向镜头倾斜，瞳孔透过手机看向这边。眉眼间透着平静，嘴唇放松成自然的姿态。肌肤不过度修饰，脸颊和锁骨周围沐浴在柔和的室内光线中。

服装·姿势：
身穿白色罗纹材质的裁剪吊带背心，轮廓自然贴合身体。胸口不刻意强调，保持成熟大人的平衡感。下装是深靛蓝牛仔短裤，低腰设计停在臀部位置。人物用自己的右手握住手机，指尖自然贴合设备侧边。左手置于画面左下方的木质书桌上，上半身微微前倾。腰部略微斜向一侧，重心偏向单腿。

背景·光线：
以白色和米色为主调的小型卧室。画面右侧有白色窗帘和床铺，左侧有木质书桌和置物架、盆栽植物、台灯、蜡烛，以及一幅模糊的海边照片相框。主光源来自画面右侧的窗户，柔和的日光自然洒在脸庞右侧、肩膀和白色上衣上。画面左侧的台灯提供温暖的辅助光线，为背景增添一丝橙色温度。阴影柔和，向床铺和置物架深处自然延伸。

构图·镜头：
纵向构图。从胸部上方至大腿上方纳入的近距离室内自拍。人物位于画面中央略偏右，手机靠近脸庞。头顶上方留出少许余白，腰部自然纳入框架。镜头位置略高于视线，轻微俯视。背景采用浅景深柔和虚化，焦点集中在人物的脸庞、头发、手机和上半身上。

质感·风格：
真实的照片表现。肌肤保留自然的毛孔和柔软质感，头发融入细致的束状感和光泽。白色罗纹面料、牛仔布的厚度、木质书桌、床单的柔软感各自鲜明可辨。色调融合温暖的室内光与淡雅的日光，营造自然氛围。避免过度美肌修饰或CG感，保留手机拍摄般的亲近感和生活气息。

负面提示：
看起来像未成年人的面容、过度暴露、过于性感的表现、不自然的胸部形状、不自然的五官、不自然的视线、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手脚融合、关节变形、与手机接触不良、漂浮感、不自然的引力、错误的透视法、与光源矛盾的阴影、文字乱码、标志、水印、过度美肌修饰、塑料般的肌肤。

The main figure is pressed to one side of the screen with a clean cutout or refined photographic texture, with clear edges and a stable expression or posture, forming a trustworthy public expression. The background uses a large area of clear color fields derived from the theme, retaining bright and clean high-brightness layers and slight gradients, letting the main color bear the order and emotion; the dark parts are only used to support the subject and the bottom information, keeping it optically clean, without old, ashy, or dirty treatment. Enlarge the most important keywords, commemorative numbers, or core concepts in the theme into semi-transparent giant word shadows, sinking into the background and partially blocked by the main figure. The font is heavy, the edges are hard, and the transparency is restrained, creating a sense of pressure and memory points where "text becomes a space wall." The information layout adopts a corporate annual report style order: small letter spacing or subtitles at the top to leave room for breathing, the largest title placed in the upper middle, a name/identity/description text group set next to the main figure with a narrow emphasis line as a visual anchor, and a longer statement text at the bottom with loose line spacing, distinct font weights, and mainly left-aligned. Colors are extracted from the material, industry attributes, and emotions of the theme itself, mapped into large areas of clear main colors, low-proportion dark structural layers, bright light-colored text, and a small amount of high-saturation emphasis lines, maintaining a calm, precise, clean, and solemn emotion; the overall texture is like high-end corporate commemorative communication, with fine grain and soft halos in the background, a real and sharp subject, and clear text hierarchy, avoiding cluttered decoration and excessive dramatization.

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium commercial poster for Oreo, with a composition closely matching a classic central trophy-advertising layout. The image must be built around one dominant hero object: a modern FIFA World Cup trophy silhouette reimagined in Oreo material language. The overall poster should feel saturated, clean, explosive, luxurious, and immediately readable at first glance.

Main composition:
Use a strict vertical hero composition.
Top center: Oreo logo, small but clear.
Center: one large trophy occupying most of the poster height, clearly the absolute focal point.
Bottom center: one strong campaign slogan in bold clean typography.
The entire design must feel symmetrical, stable, and iconic, with the trophy as the visual core and all secondary elements orbiting around it.

Trophy scale and proportion:
The trophy must be tall, elegant, and dominant, taking about 60 to 70 percent of the full composition height. Its silhouette must follow the exact modern FIFA World Cup trophy form:
rounded globe top,
two upward flowing support forms,
narrow tapering lower body,
circular pedestal base.
The trophy silhouette must read instantly and cleanly from a distance.

Material logic:
The trophy is formed primarily from silky white Oreo cream fluid, wrapped tightly around the exact World Cup trophy form. The cream should feel smooth, glossy, thick, and luxurious, with high-end fluid tension and sculptural wrapping motion.
Oreo cookies appear as embedded accents and supportive fragments, not as the main body material.
Use:
whole Oreo cookies,
partial Oreo halves,
dark cocoa crumbs,
tiny cream bursts.
The cream is the main sculptural mass; the cookies are the identity accents.

Cookie size balance:
The Oreo cookies around the trophy must be carefully scaled and balanced.
Do not make the floating cookies too large.
Do not let foreground cookies overpower the trophy.
Use only a few medium and small Oreo cookies orbiting around the trophy, with restrained variation in size.
The largest cookie accent may appear near the base, but it must still remain secondary to the trophy.
The trophy should always feel visually larger, heavier, and more important than any cookie element.

Explosion logic:
The energy should erupt outward from the trophy itself, like a championship moment frozen in time.
Use a controlled burst of silky cream splashes, crumbs, and Oreo fragments around the center.
The splash must support the trophy silhouette, not destroy it.
The composition should feel explosive but still clean and highly readable.

Base:
The pedestal should be clean, centered, and premium, with Oreo blue, dark cocoa, and white cream details. It should anchor the trophy visually and strengthen the championship feeling without becoming overly complex.

Background:
Use a rich high-saturation Oreo championship blue background, clean and slightly luminous, with a subtle arena-light atmosphere if needed. Keep the background simple enough so the center trophy remains dominant. No cluttered stadium scene.

Lighting:
Use glossy premium commercial lighting.
Strong highlights on the cream,
rich shadows in the Oreo cookie texture,
clear rim light around the trophy silhouette,
clean separation from the blue background.
The fluid should look ultra-real, silky, and sculptural.

Typography:
Keep typography centered and clean.
Top:
“OREO”
Bottom:
“DUNK YOUR WAY TO GLORY”
Optional Chinese:
“奥利奥”
“冠军级夹心爆发”
Typography must feel bold, premium, and campaign-ready, without too much copy.

Mood:
iconic, victorious, saturated, clean, premium, balanced, explosive, luxurious, globally commercial, unforgettable.

Rendering:
hyper-detailed silky cream fluid simulation, exact modern FIFA World Cup trophy silhouette, realistic Oreo cookie texture, premium Oreo-blue background, balanced cookie scale, strong centered composition, luxury commercial lighting, 8k, world-class advertising quality.

Negative prompt:
oversized floating cookies, weak trophy dominance, messy composition, broken trophy readability, too many cookie fragments, off-center layout, thin watery cream, wrong trophy silhouette, Jules Rimet cup shape, cluttered stadium background, cartoon style, low realism, excessive props

Figure/Expression:
A natural and realistic adult female. Hair in a low, casual bun with a few stray strands falling by the neck and ears. The face is hardly shown, retaining only a hint of the profile silhouette turned slightly to the right. Her gaze is directed towards the bright courtyard through the open glass door. Clothing/Pose:
Wearing a pale ivory maxi dress with a sheer, lightweight gauzy shawl over the shoulders. The back design is wide open but with a natural skin-toned lining inside, creating an elegant and lifestyle visual effect. Thin straps meet loosely in the middle of the back, and the shawl cuffs are fluffy and spread out. The right hand is placed lightly on the open wooden frame, fingertips slightly curved. The left arm hangs naturally at her side, slightly pulling the thin fabric close. Weight is on the right foot, with the left foot half a step back, causing the body to turn slightly. Background/Lighting:
A tranquil interior of an antique-style Japanese residence. Wooden floors, slim wood-framed glass doors, thin white curtains on the right, with a small courtyard, low walls, potted plants, and light green garden trees visible deep in the scene. The light is soft morning sunlight seeping in from the outdoors at the top left of the frame. It illuminates the back, shoulders, and the edges of the shawl, revealing the delicate texture of the fabric fibers. Shadows of the wooden frame and curtains fall obliquely on the floor, with faint reflections remaining on the glass.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical composition. The figure stands slightly to the right of the center, captured from head to hem. The horizontal and vertical lines of the glass door naturally divide the frame, guiding the eye to the back of the figure and the open doorway. 主题：
晨光之白

主体：
以一位成年女性背对镜头，在木框大玻璃门前，沐浴庭院洒入的晨光，凝视外界的宁静纵向肖像。

自然而富有真实感的成年女性。发型为低位的随意发髻，颈侧与耳边垂落几缕细碎发丝。脸部几乎不露，仅保留一丝向右侧微转的侧脸轮廓。视线投向敞开玻璃门外、庭院的明亮处。肩头放松，仿佛正于吸入晨间空气前一刻的静默姿态。

服饰·姿势：
身着淡象牙白的及长连衣裙，外披透视感轻薄纱质披肩。背部设计大开，但内搭接近肤色的自然内里，营造优雅且生活化的视觉效果。细肩带在背中松散交汇，披肩袖口蓬松舒展。人物右手轻置于敞开的木框上，指尖微微弯曲。左臂自然垂于身侧，略微拉近薄布。重心置于右足，左足半步后撤，令身体稍稍斜转。裙摆在木质地板上柔和铺展，晨风拂动布边微微摇曳。

背景·光线：
仿古日式住宅的宁静室内。木质地板、细木框玻璃门、右侧薄白窗帘，画面深处可见小庭院、低矮围墙、盆栽及浅绿庭木。光线为画面左上方户外渗入的柔和晨曦。照亮背部、肩头与披肩边缘，透出布料纤维的细腻纹理。室内略显昏暗，外侧庭院明亮却不过曝。地板上斜落木框与窗帘的影子，玻璃上残留极淡反射。

构图·镜头：
纵向构图。人物站于中央稍偏右位，自头部至裙摆全身入镜。玻璃门的纵横线条自然分割画面，引导视线汇聚于人物背影与敞开门扉。镜头自腰部稍高位置近乎平视拍摄。焦点置于人物上半身与透光布料，庭院树木与围墙柔和虚化。活用室内昏暗与户外晨光的对比，保留宁静的逆光氛围。

质感·风格：
摄影风格。肌肤呈自然质感，避免过度美肤修饰。细腻描绘薄纱纤维、木地板微光、窗帘柔影、玻璃的雾感和反射。以象牙白、浅米色、木质棕与庭院柔绿为主色调。整体营造沉静的晨间气息，如杂志摄影般留白十足。

The interior walls are cream to ivory tones, decorated with exquisite decorative moldings, creating a high-end sense of space. Warm afternoon natural light spills diagonally from a window in the upper left of the frame, casting bright highlights on the top of her hair, forehead, cheeks, chest, thighs, and the sofa fur. 女性给人一种沉稳而成熟的印象。及肩的深棕色松散波浪发，前额轻柔地垂着薄薄的刘海。脸庞略微正面对准镜头，目光直视镜头的中央。眉眼柔和，嘴角微微张开，营造出宁静而亲密的氛围。肌肤光滑却不过分修饰，脸颊和唇部保留自然的红润血色。

服装·姿势：

背景·光线：

bottom section: bold outdoor campaign or oversized billboard / street poster application

This section should show the brand’s public presence and visual impact.

“PEEL THE MOOD”

or

The whole board should feel like a polished launch campaign presentation for a modern fruit drink startup:
clean,
graphic,
adult playful,
social-media ready,
retail-ready,
brand-cohesive,
stylish,
fresh,
premium,
commercially believable.
It should not feel like four unrelated images. All scenes must be tied together by the same color system, can design, typography, mascot style, and tone of voice.

Color palette:

creamy warm beige,
soft blush pink,
lychee rose,
berry-pink accents,
deep espresso-brown typography,
small fresh green leaf accents.
The campaign board should feel consistent and recognizable as the same brand family.

Negative prompt:

A cinematic, low-angle urban portrait taken with a cheap 2004 pocket digital camera, forced flash off. A young Japanese woman stands on a paved sidewalk next to a road. The other hand holds the handle of a small black bag. She wears a crisp white short-sleeved button-up shirt with a small black graphic on the chest, a brown and black plaid mini skirt, black crew socks, and black chunky loafers. Tattoos are visible on her right arm. The camera angle is very low, looking up at her from the ground, making her figure appear tall and commanding. Behind her is a low concrete wall with a metal frame window structure, a long black asphalt road with white lane markings, and a tall metal communication tower in the background. The sky is dramatic and moody, filled with textured, swirling clouds in shades of deep teal, steel grey, and faded blue. A bright, distinct white contrail cuts diagonally across the sky. The color palette is desaturated and cinematic, dominated by cool teal, muted grey, stark white, and deep black. Soft, diffused overcast lighting. Realistic skin texture, visible pores, a faint natural shine on her forehead, no beauty filter. Heavy grain, slight chromatic aberration, sickly greenish-yellow tint. A stray cat tail peeks from behind the concrete wall at the bottom left corner.

prompts.text:
UNIVERSAL FMCG HERO AD PROMPT™ V2.0

Act as a world-class Creative Director, Luxury Product Photographer, Apple-level Design Director, Brand Strategist, Swiss Typography Expert, Unreal Engine 5 & V-Ray Rendering Artist.

INPUT
Upload one product image only. Automatically detect any product category (electronics, FMCG, cosmetics, food, furniture, appliances, fashion, household items, etc.). No questions or manual settings.

OBJECTIVE
Transform the uploaded product into a premium hero advertisement suitable for Amazon, catalogs, websites, social media, packaging, print, billboards, and product launches.

Preserve 100% of the original product:
- Shape
- Packaging
- Branding
- Logo
- Colors
- Labels
- Materials
- Texture
- Proportions

The product must remain the main hero.

BRANDING
Extract the original logo from the product packaging and recreate it cleanly at the top-left. Never replace or redesign the brand.

COLOR
Automatically derive the background, gradients, accents, and lighting from the product's brand colors for a cohesive premium look.

TEXT
Generate:
• Premium headline
• Short supporting sentence (max 2 lines)
• Four text-only product features placed on the left (no icons).

PRODUCT DISPLAY
Large hero product occupying about 70% of the layout with realistic shadows, subtle floor reflection, luxury perspective, and balanced composition.

BOTTOM GALLERY
Include 4–5 clean product angles (Front, 45°, Side, Back, Top/Close-up) with identical lighting.

BACKGROUND
Apple-inspired minimal luxury studio with soft gradients, natural window shadows, editorial daylight, elegant negative space, subtle reflections, and no clutter, props, patterns, or decorative graphics.

STYLE
Swiss typography (Helvetica Neue, SF Pro, Inter style), clean Apple-inspired layout, premium editorial spacing.

CAMERA & LIGHTING
ARRI Alexa Mini LF, 85mm hero shot, 35mm gallery shots, commercial studio lighting, HDR, ray tracing, global illumination, soft reflections.

QUALITY
Ultra-photorealistic 8K, V-Ray/Octane/Corona/UE5 quality, magazine-ready, catalog-ready, billboard-ready, luxury commercial product photography.

STRICT RULES
Never redesign or modify the product, packaging, branding, logo, labels, or colors. No humans, icons, unnecessary graphics, or fake environments. Keep the product as the absolute hero. Place the original logo at top-left, headline and four features on the left, gallery at the bottom. Use a 4:5 portrait composition with Apple-level minimalism.

担任世界级创意总监、奢侈品产品摄影师、苹果级设计总监、品牌战略师、瑞士排版专家、Unreal Engine 5 和 V-Ray 渲染艺术家。

Each of the four panels should show a different playful interaction between the real Lay’s bag / chips and the black doodle world:

Panel 1:
The Lay’s chip bag acts as a hot air balloon basket, floating upward. Hand-drawn doodle balloon canopy above, clouds, tiny birds, airflow lines, cheerful adventure icons. Golden potato chips fly around like wind-blown leaves.

Panel 2:
The Lay’s bag becomes a skateboard or surf ramp. Black line doodle characters slide across curved chips as if they are skate ramps or waves. Motion lines, stars, mini flags, playful action symbols. Strong sense of movement and energy.

Panel 3:
The Lay’s bag works as a music speaker or party amplifier. Doodle sound waves, dancing lines, tiny music notes, happy mini figures, chips bouncing outward like rhythm beats. The composition feels lively and punchy but still visually clean.

Panel 4:
The Lay’s bag becomes a doorway or portal into a doodle snack universe. Hand-drawn swirls, stars, floating chips, tiny ladders, adventurous mini people, playful arrows, and whimsical snack symbols emerging from the bag opening. The scene should feel imaginative and delightful.

Art direction:
The hand-drawn doodles must be elegant, controlled, witty, and compositionally smart, not childish scribbles. Use clean black ink lines, refined cartoon minimalism, soft humor, and subtle visual storytelling. The real product should interact directly with the doodles so the scene feels cleverly integrated, not pasted on top. Every panel should have one clear visual joke or interaction.

Chips:
Golden Lay’s potato chips should appear in all four panels as supporting heroes, realistic, crisp, lightly salted, appetizing, floating or interacting with the doodle world. Some chips can act like suns, wheels, stepping stones, surfboards, or flying objects, but all ideas must remain clean and readable.

Typography:
Add minimal but artistic campaign typography, clean and modern, integrated into the overall layout, not large messy headlines. Use a stylish mix of English and Chinese, with refined spacing and ad-design elegance. Suggested text:
“Lay’s”
“Crunch Into Fun”
“One Bag, Four Adventures”
Chinese text:
“乐事薯片”
“一口开启趣味”
“四格同频快乐”
“脆趣正在发生”
Typography should feel editorial, light, premium, and balanced with the visuals. Avoid crude heavy fonts.

Overall feel:
clean commercial illustration poster, conceptual packaging ad, modern minimal layout, clever visual interaction, witty and bright, premium campaign board, playful but sophisticated, high-end brand presentation, warm paper background, realistic product photography mixed with black ink doodle art, strong negative space, strong composition, 8k, hyper-detailed, unique, memorable.

Negative prompt:
messy layout, cluttered background, low detail, childish doodles, cheap design, distorted packaging, blurry logo, too many objects, overdecorated poster, dark background, random colors, weak interaction, flat composition, generic snack ad, unreadable text, extra products, low-end illustration

items.title: 四川火锅店玩手机的中国年轻女子

prompts.text: A candid phone photo of a young Chinese woman in her mid-20s sitting in a dimly lit upscale Sichuan hotpot restaurant, absorbed in her phone. She has long, dark brown hair falling loosely past her shoulders, fair skin, delicate features with soft makeup and red-tinted lips, her face gently lit by the cool glow of her phone screen. She leans back relaxed in her seat against a dark wall, holding her phone up in her right hand, eyes down on the screen, her left hand resting gently on her stomach. A thin silver bracelet on her wrist. She has a full, curvy figure — she wears a tight cream-white short-sleeve top, the thin stretchy fabric clinging snugly to her full bust and soft rounded belly, paired with grey shorts, her bare legs crossed under the table. To her left, a large mirrored black wall panel reflects her seated figure and the warm restaurant lights. The table in front of her is loaded with hotpot dishes filling the foreground — a large metal pot of bright red spicy mala broth with a ladle, a plate of thinly sliced raw beef rolls arranged in neat rows on a white tray with a small broccoli garnish, a black bowl of dipping sauce with scallions and chili, a small dish of minced garlic, a metal cup, chopsticks resting on a bowl, and a dark wooden tissue box. The restaurant interior is moody and dark — black marble table, dark walls with subtle gold Chinese artwork and warm accent lighting, a coat rack in the corner. Warm amber ambient light mixed with the cool phone glow on her face. Shot on a phone from across the table at seated eye level, slightly tilted candid framing, natural noise and soft focus in the shadows — the authentic feeling of a casual dinner photo taken by a friend.

prompts.text:
Theme: Sea Breeze Slope

Person/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. A natural and mature atmosphere, with a healthy expression devoid of childishness. Dark brown medium-length hair is loosely curled, with the ends gently fluttering in the sea breeze. Transparent Japanese photobook makeup, thin base makeup, natural flush, and realistic skin texture. Looking back toward the camera from over her shoulder with a bright and cheerful smile.

Clothing/Pose:
Keep the person, expression, background, and composition from the generated photo, and only adjust the clothing to match the atmosphere of the reference image. An ivory-white lightweight sleeveless dress with thin straps, a simple open-back design, elegantly covered chest, and a naturally cinched waist. The skirt is short, made of a fluffy pleated fabric, with the hem drawing an arc as it spins with the wind. The right hand lightly pinches a corner of the skirt hem, and the left arm naturally extends backward. The body moves toward the depths of the slope while half-rotating, with weight resting on one foot. Elegant exposure, avoiding transparency or overly sexy expressions.

Background/Light:
A slope where the sea can be seen. In the distance is the blue sea, with white residences, palm trees, and low walls on the left and right, and a blurred city streetscape in the far distance. A sunny summer afternoon, the sky is a clear pale blue. The main light source comes from strong sunlight in the upper right of the frame, illuminating the silhouette of the hair and shoulders. Soft reflected light comes from buildings and the road on the left. Shadows extend from the feet toward the bottom left of the frame, with palm leaf shadows faintly cast on the road surface.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical composition. A full-body close-up portrait from above the knees to the top of the head. The person is located slightly to the right of the center of the frame, with the body occupying about 65% of the frame. Use the road lines of the slope and the residences on both sides to create a sense of depth, maintaining the extension that guides the eye toward the sea. The camera is at chest height, a slightly close-up eye-level perspective. Shallow depth of field with background blur, focusing on the face and the hem of the dress. With a natural and slight telephoto compression.

Texture/Style:
High-quality Japanese photobook style. Summer sunlight, subtle wrinkles in white fabric, shadows of thin cotton material, fine strands of hair, and the natural pore texture of the skin are all meticulously depicted. A bright high-key style, but without excessive blown-out whites; the blue sky and ivory clothing are refreshing and harmonious. Avoid excessive HDR or an overly artificial AI feel, pursuing a natural photo expression with a sense of daily life.

Negative Prompt:
Expressions that look like minors, infantilization, excessive exposure, see-through clothing, nudity, unnatural faces or gazes, duplicate identical faces, extra or missing fingers, fused hands or feet, broken joints, fabric movement that defies gravity, unnatural shadows, excessive skin smoothing, plastic-looking skin, text, logos, watermarks, background signage text, excessive HDR.
