items.title: 同一人物角色设定图生成指令

prompts.text:
Please use the person/character in the attached image as the most important reference to create a character setting sheet that looks like the same person/character.

If the attached image is in a photorealistic style, maintain the photorealistic style; if it is in an illustration/anime/manga/3D/deformed style, maintain its art style, lines, coloring, texture, and degree of deformation.
Please do not convert to photorealism, illustration, or other art styles without authorization.

The purpose is not a personal profile introduction, but visual material for character production, AI image generation, and model fixation.
No personal profile elements such as name, age, personality, hobbies, or explanatory text are needed.
Text in the image is limited to labeling each panel with short Japanese tags; do not use English labels.

Image format:
16:9 horizontal single image. White to light gray background. High resolution. Organized with thin lines or boxes in an easy-to-read character setting sheet style layout.

Most important condition:
Please faithfully reproduce the face, eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, contour, hairstyle, hair color, skin or coloring texture, body type, atmosphere, and impression of the clothing from the original image.
Please do not become another person/character.
Excessive beautification, simplification, body type changes, and facial remakes are prohibited.
Disposable small objects, food, backgrounds, poses, or handheld items appearing in the original image should be excluded unless necessary for the character setting.

Clothing:
If the clothing in the original image is clear, please maintain it.
If the full body cannot be seen, supplement with natural clothing that matches the atmosphere of the original image.
Front, side, and back must use the same clothing, same hairstyle, and same body type.
Please avoid excessive exposure, underwear, swimwear, or sexy clothing.

Content to be included:
【Full body】 Front, side, back
【Facial close-up】 Front, profile, 45-degree angle
【Expressions】 Normal, smiling face, smile, serious, surprised, shy, thinking, troubled face
【Facial parts】 Eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, ears, contour, skin, texture
【Hair details】 Bangs, side hair, back hair, hair flow
【Other angles】 Diagonal left, diagonal right, from above, from below, back of the head

Layout:
Must be easy to read as reference material, leave neat white space, and organize contents with boxes.
Please do not make it magazine profile style, resume style, or poster style.
Please do not add long explanations, use only short Japanese tags.

Negative prompts:
Other person, other character, face change, art style change, unauthorized photorealism, unauthorized animation, hairstyle change, hair color change, inconsistent clothing, body type change, excessive beautification, excessive simplification, profile text, name, age, personality, hobbies, English labels, long explanations, garbled text, illegible text, rough layout, low resolution, facial distortion, strange eyes, broken hands, broken fingers, duplicate faces, sexy clothing, underwear, swimwear, unnecessary small objects, holding food in mouth, random objects, cluttered background

prompts.text: A candid photo-dump collage designed to feel like [HUMAN]'s phone gallery from one rainy afternoon running errands downtown. The mechanic is a six-panel grid stitched together like an iPhone camera roll, each photo slightly water-speckled on the lens with soft flash hotspots bouncing off wet pavement. Panels: a blurry mirror shot in a shop's rain-fogged window, an overhead shot of shoes splashing through a puddle at a crosswalk, a low-angle shot from a bus shelter bench looking up mid-laugh, a fisheye selfie under an umbrella inches from the lens, a candid shot reflected in a coffee cup lid on a café table, and a motion-blurred shot taken mid-stride on an escalator. Expressions shift from a squinting laugh in the rain to a skeptical side-eye at a shop window to a quiet, unposed half-smile on the bus. Cohesive charcoal grey, cream, faded black and wet-pavement silver palette. Premium candid lifestyle photography, visible grain and uneven exposure, no glossy textures, aspect ratio 4:5.

items.title: 高级时装大片禅意环境人像静禅

prompts.text:
Positive prompt:
High fashion editorial Zen environment portrait, adult East Asian beautiful female, theme "Quiet · Zen". Real photographic subject + minimalist Zen interior space + large area of negative space (white space). The image does not rely on exaggerated expressions, but carries emotions of calm, letting go, introspection, and dwelling through quiet interior space, natural light, tea sets, window courtyards, and restrained white space. Overall presents a museum-grade fine art editorial photography texture, no text, no title, no logo, no watermark.

【Core Scene】
A minimalist Zen interior space. Wooden structure, plain gray-beige walls, low wooden tea table, tatami or natural floor material, open floor-to-ceiling windows or large window views. Outside the window is a quiet courtyard landscape: trees, light-colored walls, stones, a small amount of natural plants, overall minimalist, empty, clean, and peaceful. The scenery outside the window must quietly recede, not overwhelming the subject, only serving as an extension of "breath."

【Subject】
An adult East Asian female, 24–30 years old, quiet, restrained, gentle, and introverted. Possessing real and natural bone structure, elegant but mature, not juvenile, rejecting Internet celebrity faces, rejecting anime faces. Showing real skin texture, subtle pores, facial fuzz, natural skin tone, and the natural translucency of subcutaneous fat, retaining real facial volume and optical texture. Expression is calm and relaxed, eyes slightly lowered, breathing long, lips naturally closed, not sad, not cold, not fawning.

【Action】
The person is sitting quietly by the tea set, posture steady, center of gravity stable, movements extremely gentle and slow, quietly lifting a cup to taste tea. Not a performative tea art display, but a natural, relaxed, daily Zen moment of dwelling in the present. Movement is restrained, pace is slow, as if time is paused at this moment.

【Clothing and Styling】
Wearing plain off-white, oatmeal, or light gray-beige cotton/linen texture loose robes, belonging to modern minimalist Zen clothing. Fabric is natural and soft, with real fabric texture. Hairstyle is clean and quiet, a low bun or naturally tied hair, with a small amount of natural stray hairs but overall smooth and restrained. Makeup is extremely light, presenting a clean, pure natural original beauty.

【Space Props】
Only minimalist tea sets are placed on the low wooden tea table: a small teapot and a teacup, the quantity is extremely restrained. A bonsai is placed on one side of the room as one of the only Zen objects with a strong presence in the picture. The shape of the objects is minimalist, clean, and quiet, not piled up, not complex. The entire space only retains a few necessary elements, never cluttered.

【Light and Atmosphere】
Soft diffused natural light, a single natural light source softly entering from the side of a large window. Overall low contrast, bright areas are soft and transparent, dark parts are very light, shadow edges are softly feathered, and slight tree shadows can be vaguely seen projected on the wall. With a very slight environmental micro-mist feel, subtle edge highlight blooming, and organic film grain, the air is clean and transparent, with the atmosphere of quiet morning light. Never use strong dramatic lighting, never high contrast.

【Composition Aesthetics】
16:9 ultra-wide environmental editorial composition. The lens retreats significantly, the camera position maintains a respectful observation distance. The subject is located at the bottom right of the frame, the person occupies only about 15% to 20% of the area, and the environment and negative space dominate the entire frame. The left side is a large area of window scenery and negative space, the right side is the person and the bonsai, forming an asymmetrical but visually balanced Zen composition. The environment is much larger than the person, and the person only serves as an anchor for the emotional scale. Never shoot close-ups, never shoot half-body close-ups, never use tight cropping.

【Atmosphere】
Anxiety-free, empty, relieved, introspective, morning-like calm. The space and the person together constitute a quiet Zen home life philosophy: the interior is minimalist, there are trees, stones, and natural quiet scenes outside the window, the atmosphere inside and outside are connected, and the overall is like a livable Zen life picture. This is not a commercial home advertisement, nor a common posed photo shoot, but a high-end, quiet high fashion editorial Zen portrait.

【Image Quality and Texture】
High-resolution original editorial photography, with real perspective depth and natural optical lens rendering, showing a real sense of lens space. Face, eyes, tea sets, and bonsai are clear and real, the distant background and large areas of negative space are soft and clean, not broken, not messy, not fake. With slight film grain, restrained details, the overall presents a high-end, quiet, and transparent texture.

【Negative Constraints】
Reject computer graphics (CG), reject 3D rendering, reject Unreal Engine texture, reject anime faces, reject plastic-feeling skin, reject wax-like skin smoothing, reject over-sharpening, reject cluttered decorations, reject redundant props, reject crowded tea sets, reject exaggerated poses, reject dramatic expressions, reject strong contrast, reject messy backgrounds, no text, no watermark.

prompts.text:
正向提示词：
高级时装大片禅意环境人像，东亚成年美丽女性，主题「静·禅」。真实摄影主体 + 极简禅意室内空间 + 大面积负空间（留白）。画面不依靠夸张的表情，而是通过安静的室内空间、自然光线、茶席、窗外庭院与克制留白，来承载平静、放下、内观、安住的情绪。整体呈现美术馆级的精细艺术大片摄影质感，无文字，无标题，无标志，无水印。

【核心场景】
一间极简的禅意室内空间。木质结构、素色灰米色墙面、低矮的木质茶桌、榻榻米或自然地面材质、开阔的落地窗或大开口窗景。窗外是安静的庭院景观：树木、浅色围墙、石头、少量自然植物，整体极简、空寂、干净、平和。窗外景色必须安静地向后退去，不喧宾夺主，只作为“气息”的延伸。

【主体】
一位成年东亚女性，24–30 岁，安静、克制、温柔、内敛。拥有真实自然的骨相，清秀但成熟，不幼态，拒绝网红脸，拒绝动漫脸。展现真实的皮肤纹理、细微毛孔、面部绒毛、自然肤色，以及皮下脂肪的自然透光感，保留真实的面部体量与光学质感。神情平静放松，轻微垂眸，呼吸绵长，双唇自然微合，不悲伤、不冷漠、不谄媚。

【动作】
人物静坐于茶席旁，姿态沉稳、重心稳定，动作极其轻柔缓慢，正在安静地举杯品茶。并非带有表演感的茶艺展示，而是自然、放松、安住于当下的日常禅意瞬间。动势克制，节奏缓慢，仿佛时间在此刻暂停。

【服装与造型】
身着素色米白、燕麦色或浅灰米色的棉麻/亚麻质感宽松衣袍，属于现代极简禅意服饰。布料天然、柔软，具有真实的织物纹理。发型干净安静，低挽的发髻或自然束发，有少量自然碎发但整体柔顺克制。妆容极淡，呈现干净的纯天然原生美感。

【空间道具】
低矮的木质茶桌上仅摆放极简茶具：一只小茶壶与一只茶杯，数量极度克制。室内一侧放置一盆盆景，作为画面中唯一具有强存在感的禅意器物之一。器物造型极简、干净、安静，不堆砌，不繁复。整个空间只保留少量必要元素，绝不杂乱。

【光线氛围】
柔和漫反射自然光，单一自然光源从大窗侧面柔和地照入。整体呈现低对比度，明亮区域柔和而通透，暗部极淡，阴影边缘羽化柔和，墙面上隐约可见轻微的树影投射。带有非常轻微的环境微雾感、微妙的边缘高光晕染以及有机的胶片颗粒感，空气干净通透，具有清晨宁静光线的氛围感。绝不使用强烈的戏剧化光线，绝不高反差。

【构图美学】
16:9 超宽幅环境大片构图。镜头大幅度后退，机位保持带有敬意的观察距离。主体位于画面右侧偏下方，人物仅占画面约 15% 至 20% 的面积，环境与留白主导整个画面。左侧为大面积的窗景与留白空间，右侧为人物与盆景，形成不对称但视觉平衡的禅意构图。环境远大于人物，人物仅作为情绪尺度的锚点。绝不拍摄近景，绝不拍摄半身特写，绝不进行紧凑裁切。

【氛围】
安宁、空寂、释然、内观、清晨般的平静。空间与人共同构成一种安静的禅意居家生活哲学：室内极简，窗外有树、有石、有自然静景，室内外的气息相互连通，整体宛如一幅可居住的禅意生活画面。这不是商业家居广告，也不是普通的摆拍写真，而是高级、安静的时装大片禅意人像。

【画质与质感】
高分辨率原片大片摄影，具备真实的透视纵深感与自然的光学镜头渲染，展现真实的镜头空间感。脸部、眼睛、茶具与盆景清晰真实，远处的背景与大面积留白区域柔和干净，不破碎、不脏乱、不虚假。带有轻微的胶片颗粒，细节克制，整体呈现高级、安静、通透的质感。

【负面约束】
拒绝计算机图形（CG），拒绝3D渲染，拒绝虚幻引擎质感，拒绝动漫脸，拒绝塑料感皮肤，拒绝蜡感磨皮，拒绝过度锐化，拒绝杂乱的装饰，拒绝多余的道具，拒绝拥挤的茶具，拒绝夸张的姿势，拒绝戏剧化的表情，拒绝强烈的对比度，拒绝杂乱的背景，无文字，无水印。

items.title: 电影级高端产品爆炸瞬间海报

prompts.text:
Create a premium cinematic product poster for [BRAND / PRODUCT].

Place the real product at the center of an explosive frozen-impact moment, as if its core energy, ingredient, texture, material, or sensory identity is bursting outward in mid-air.

The burst must visually match the product:

perfume → icy glass, water shards, cold mist
tea → green liquid, leaves, droplets, botanical energy
camera → dust, rocks, light streaks, adventure particles
chocolate → melted chocolate, cocoa shards, glossy splashes

Use ultra-detailed commercial realism, dramatic high-contrast lighting, sharp product focus, premium advertising composition, fast-motion particles frozen in time, glossy highlights, deep shadows, cinematic depth of field, scroll-stopping energy.

Keep the product recognizable, accurate, premium, and centered.
No extra text unless requested.
Aspect ratio: [4:5 / 1:1 / 16:9].
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
为 [品牌 / 产品] 创作一张高端电影级的商业产品海报。

将真实的产品放置在爆炸性的冰冻瞬间中心，仿佛它的核心能量、成分、纹理、材料或感官特性正在半空中向外爆发。

爆发的视觉效果必须与产品匹配：

香水 → 冰冷的玻璃、水碎片、冷雾
茶叶 → 绿色液体、茶叶、水滴、植物能量
相机 → 尘土、岩石、光束、冒险粒子

[Texture and Tone Atmosphere]
A minimalist and pure color atmosphere dominated by pure white (White), the person's black hair (Black), and the soft pink (Pink) tones of the shy cheeks. The delicate and hollow see-through texture of the lace fabric, pearl luster, moist hair texture, and soft skin texture intertwine to evoke the sensibility of an extremely refined artistic fashion editorial.

[Film and Camera Lens Depth of Field, Angle]
Photographed using an aperture of f/2.0, shutter speed 1/200 sec, ISO 100, and an 85mm telephoto prime lens. A white studio space with blurred and transparent boundaries. prompts.text:

在纯白的先锋新娘氛围中，微微低头、正面强烈凝视镜头的上半身半身像（Bust shot）姿势。仿佛能洞穿灵魂的清澈而深邃的眼神，以及无法解读情感的静止表情，散发着高级定制时装模特特有的神秘而朦胧的气场。

[人物服装]
身着经典却又充满魅惑魅力的白色蕾丝材质无肩带紧身胸衣（bustier）连衣裙。精致而立体的花卉刺绣蕾丝图案与透视轮廓重叠，展现出现代却又奢华的艺术服装造型美。

如风中飘散般柔和触碰额头和脸颊的慵懒质感黑发短发波浪（湿润刘海风格）发型。头顶随意戴着与连衣裙相配的半透明白色蕾丝面纱（婚纱头纱），以最大化神秘感。妆容是在透明瓷器般的肌肤上，将双颊和鼻梁用粉色腮红大面积晕染的梦幻“宿醉妆”（이가리妆容）风格。湿润裸粉渐层唇妆与耳边的细小珍珠耳环相得益彰。左手戴着长款白色蕾丝歌剧手套（长手套），手腕上叠戴大胆的珍珠手链（手镯），增添华丽的亮点。

[质感与色调氛围]
纯白的白色（White）和人物的黑发（Black），以及脸颊羞涩的柔和粉色（Pink）调为主导的极简而纯净的色彩氛围。蕾丝面料的细腻且镂空的透视质感、珍珠光泽、湿润的发丝质地，以及柔软的皮肤纹理交织融合，唤起极度精炼的艺术时尚画报般的感性。

边界模糊且透明的白色工作室空间。除了人物身后柔和飘散的面纱轮廓外，完全排除所有人工元素，使视线完全沉浸于模特的迷人视觉和白色的造型美之中。

prompts.text:
Subject:
Seaside Dusk

Character · Expression:
A female in her 20s. Bright ivory beige-toned fair skin, with a slight pinkish flush, and a smooth, delicate skin texture. Soft highlights on the cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbones, not excessive skin beautification, but retaining natural skin grain and texture. High-end doll-style Japanese makeup, pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, slender and dense eyelashes, natural tear bags, bright brown eyebrows, and translucent pink-beige lip gloss. Small, clear catchlights in the pupils. Smiling gently, looking directly into the camera.

Clothing · Pose:
Elegant cream beige off-the-shoulder set. The top has sheer tulle sleeves, with understated woven ties and fine ruffles at the chest, a design where the fabric naturally fits the body. The bottom is a matching wrap-style mini skirt with a soft ribbon knot tied at the waist. The right hand gently touches the hair by the ear, and the left hand is naturally placed on the edge of a wooden table. The body is turned slightly to the left of the frame, with the upper body twisted slightly towards the camera. One leg is extended forward, with a sitting posture that has a natural sense of weight and contact.

Background · Lighting:
A wooden terrace of a Japanese seaside cafe reminiscent of the Enoshima area. To the back left is the sunset and reflections on the sea surface, with a small lighthouse and coastal streetscape in the distance. To the back right is the exterior of a wooden cafe, warm-colored lanterns, foliage plants, and a blackboard menu. On the table is a clear plastic cup of iced black tea, a black straw, and a circular cafe logo, with reflections from ice cubes and lemon. The sunset shines diagonally from a low angle on the back left of the frame, illuminating the silhouette of the hair, shoulders, cheeks, collarbones, and water droplets on the glass, dyeing them golden. Shadows stretch towards the bottom right of the frame, and the soft reflected light from the sea slightly lifts the shadows on the skin and clothing.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical composition, a mid-distance portrait from the upper body to the thighs. The person is located slightly to the right of the center of the frame, with the face placed near the upper third line. The table and hands are placed in the bottom left of the frame, with the background widely retaining the sea and sunset. The camera position is slightly lower than eye level, captured naturally, equivalent to a 35mm slight wide-angle. The person's face and upper body are in focus, with the background slightly blurred, but retaining enough clarity to recognize the Enoshima cafe atmosphere.

Texture · Style:
Realistic Japanese photo style. The skin is smooth but retains pores and subtle shadows, avoiding a plastic feel. The hair is bright milk tea ash brown, with thin see-through bangs, layered cut around the face, and shoulder-length medium hair. The ends of the hair are loosely curled inward, with a natural sense of bundles, fine highlights, and soft luster, meticulously depicting a small amount of stray hairs. Warm tones, soft contrast, and fine graininess like an evening film photograph.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features or gaze, excessive skin beautification, damaged clothing, extra or missing fingers, fused hands or feet, deformed joints, distortion of drinks or straws, garbled text, blurry logos, unnatural perspective, shadows contradicting the light source, excessively distorted background, extra people, watermarks.

prompts.text:
主题：
海边的黄昏

人物·表情：
20多岁的女性。明亮的象牙米色调的白皙肌肤，带着微微粉红的血色，肌质光滑细腻。脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀、锁骨处带有柔和的高光，不是过度美肌修饰，而是保留自然的肌理纹理。上品的人偶风日系妆容，淡玫瑰粉色的腮红、香槟米色与粉棕色的眼影、细长浓密的睫毛、自然的泪袋、明亮的棕色眉毛、透亮感的粉米色唇彩。瞳孔中有细小清澈的捕捉光。温和地微笑，直视镜头。

服装·姿势：
淡雅的奶油米色露肩套装。上衣是透视感的薄纱袖子，胸口处有低调的编织系带和细碎褶边，布料自然贴合身体的设计。下装是同色系的裹式迷你裙，腰间系着柔软的缎带结。右手轻轻触碰耳边的发丝，左手自然置于木质桌子的边缘。身体微微转向画面左侧，上半身稍稍扭向镜头侧。单腿向前伸展，坐姿带有自然的重量感和接触感。

背景·光线：
让人联想到江之岛周边的日本海滨咖啡馆木质露台。左后方是夕阳与海面的反射，远景中有小型灯塔和沿海街景。右后方是木造咖啡馆外观、暖色灯笼、观叶植物、黑板菜单。桌上放置透明塑料杯的冰红茶、黑色吸管、圆形咖啡馆标志，加入冰块和柠檬的反射。夕阳从画面左后方低角度斜射，照亮头发的轮廓、肩膀、脸颊、锁骨、玻璃杯上的水珠，染成金色。阴影向画面右下方拉长，海面柔和的反射光微微抬升肌肤和衣物的阴影。

构图·镜头：
纵向构图，从上半身到大腿的中距离肖像。人物位于画面中央稍偏右，脸部置于上三分之一线附近。桌子和手部置于画面左下方，背景广泛保留海与夕阳。镜头位置略低于视线高度，自然拍摄，相当于35mm的轻微广角。人物的脸部和上半身对焦，背景轻微虚化，但保留足以辨识江之岛咖啡馆氛围的清晰度。

质感·风格：
逼真的日本照片风格。肌肤光滑但保留毛孔和细微阴影，避免塑料感。头发是明亮的奶茶灰棕色，薄薄的透视刘海，脸部周围的层次剪裁，及肩的中长发。发梢向内松散卷曲，带有自然的束感、细高光、柔和光泽，细致描绘少量散乱发丝。宛如傍晚胶片照片的温暖色调、柔和对比、细腻颗粒感。

负面提示：
不自然的五官或视线、过度美肌修饰、服装破损、多余或缺失的手指、手脚融合、关节变形、饮料或吸管的扭曲、文字乱码、标志模糊、不自然的透视法、与光源矛盾的阴影、背景过度扭曲、多余人物、水印。

prompts.text:
Create a high-end type couture editorial poster where typography becomes part of the fashion composition.

Theme: [fashion campaign / couture poster / lookbook / designer editorial / luxury visual]
Direction: [circular window luxury editorial / stacked type seated poster / transparent typography garment / diagonal motion fashion editorial]
Brand name: [original fictional brand name]
Main title: [original title]
Subtitle: [short original subtitle]
Subject: [adult fashion model / coat look / seated menswear look / experimental garment / walking couture look]
Mood: [luxury / minimal / experimental / elegant / structured / editorial]
Color palette: [cream-white-black / soft grey / black-white / warm neutral]
Aspect ratio: [9:16]

The poster should feel like a premium fashion campaign, designer lookbook page or couture editorial.

Use oversized typography as part of the visual structure, not just as a title.
Make the words interact with the model, garment or space through overlap, masking, cropping, transparency, diagonal slicing, circular framing or spatial layering.

Choose one direction:

1. Circular window luxury editorial
   Use a clean white background, a large circular image window, a full-body fashion model in a luxury coat, and refined serif typography. Let the model stand in front of the circular scene.

2. Stacked type seated poster
   Use huge black block letters as a background structure. Place a seated fashion model in front of the letters, with the chair and body partially overlapping the type.

3. Transparent typography garment
   Use a walking fashion model wearing a transparent outer layer covered with original letterforms, thin lines and abstract typography, as if text becomes fabric.

4. Diagonal motion fashion editorial
   Use a walking couture model with flowing white fabric. Add large diagonal typography bands cutting across the composition, matching the motion of the garment.

Keep all text original.
Do not use real brand names, real magazine names, issue numbers, dates, barcodes, URLs, watermarks, copyright marks or reference-image wording.

Keep it refined, original, editorial and visually designed.

Avoid cheap templates, cluttered layouts, random small text, fake logos, messy typography, distorted anatomy, broken hands, plastic skin and low-end fashion ad style.

Generate one finished poster only.

items.title: 夏日窗边日系生活感写真

prompts.text:
Theme: Summer by the window

Character・Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Natural and mature atmosphere, a calm face without childishness. Dark brown medium-length hair with airy bangs and slightly messy strands. Transparent Japanese-style photo makeup, natural skin texture, elegant blush, subtle eyelashes, pink-beige lips. Face slightly downward, eyes lowered, an expression like quietly exhaling a breath.

Clothing・Pose:
White to ivory thin cotton loose V-neck summer top. Wide neckline with natural space around shoulders and collarbone. The front fabric drapes softly, and the hem is slightly raised to reveal the waist. Bottoms are light blue denim shorts. The front button is undone, waist slightly loosened, creating a relaxed wearing feel. No emphasis on underwear, a high-class and lived-in expression.
The character sits diagonally on a sofa bench by the window, one hand resting on a back cushion, the other arm naturally extending toward the front of the frame. Upper body slightly twisted, head slightly tilted. Legs naturally apart but not excessively, weight resting on the seat surface. Realistically depict clothing folds, the unbuttoned part of the jeans, and the grounded feel of the hand touching the seat.

Background・Lighting:
A Japanese summer apartment living room. Right side has a large window and white lace curtains, with greenery faintly visible outside. The floor is bright wood grain, with small potted plants, low wooden furniture, and beige carpet in the distance. The background is tidy and full of life, with few items.
Morning natural light enters from the upper right of the frame, illuminating hair, cheeks, collarbones, arms, and the texture of the white top fabric. Shadows fall softly toward the lower left, with square reflections of summer sunlight on the floor and seat. Natural highlights on the white fabric and natural reflected light on the skin.

Composition・Lens:
Vertical 2:3. Slightly high-angle overhead close-up photo-style composition. Medium close-up including from the head to the upper thighs. The character is largely positioned in the center-right of the frame, using the negative space of the window side and wooden floor to show the summer air. Lens feel like a natural distance shot slightly from above with a smartphone. Composition where the gaze flows to the face, chest, waist, and unbuttoned denim part. Background slightly blurred, texture of characters and clothing naturally sharp.

Texture・Style:
High-quality Japanese photography expression. Not excessive photorealism, but a lifestyle portrait taken in a summer room. Fine expression of natural skin texture, thinness and folds of fabric, hard texture of denim, reflections on wooden floors, and soft light through curtains. Colors unified in white, light wood, light blue denim, and soft skin tones. Slight film feel, clean and transparent finish.

Negative Prompt:
Minor, childish face, excessive exposure, nipples, overly transparent clothes, underwear emphasis, vulgar poses, excessive sexual expression, unnatural breasts, body distortion, broken fingers, extra fingers, unnatural joints, poor contact between clothes and body, broken denim structure, floating fabric, shadows inconsistent with light source, plastic skin, excessive skin retouching, excessive HDR, logos, text, watermarks, obvious AI feel.

prompts.text:
主题：夏天的窗边

人物・表情：
20多岁的女性。自然而成熟的氛围，没有稚气的沉稳面容。黑褐色中长发，带有空气感的刘海和略显凌乱的发束。清透的日系写真妆容，自然的肌理、淡雅的血色、含蓄的睫毛、粉米色的唇部。脸微微向下，视线略微低垂，像是静静吐出一口气的表情。

服装・姿势：
白色至象牙白的薄棉质宽松 V 领夏装上衣。领口较宽，肩部和锁骨周围带有自然的空感。前身布料柔和地垂褶，下摆微微上翘露出腰部。下身是浅蓝色的牛仔短裤。前面的扣子解开，腰部略微松开，营造轻松的穿着感。不强调内衣，上品且富有生活气息的表现。
人物斜坐在窗边的沙发长凳上，一只手撑在后面的靠枕上，另一只手臂自然伸向画面前方。上身微微扭转，头部轻垂。双腿自然分开但不过分，重心落在坐面上。服饰的褶皱、牛仔裤敞开的扣子部分、手触碰坐面的接地感，要真实描绘。

背景・光线：
日本夏天的公寓客厅。右侧是大窗户和白色蕾丝窗帘，外面隐约可见绿色。地板是明亮的木纹，远处有小型盆栽、低矮的木制家具、米色的地毯。背景整洁且富有生活感，物品较少。
上午的自然光从画面右上方进入，照亮头发、脸颊、锁骨、手臂、白色上衣布料的凹凸。阴影柔和地落在画面左下方，地板和坐面上映入夏日阳光的方形反射。白色布料上有不过分的亮点，肌肤上有自然的反射光。

构图・镜头：
纵向 2:3。略微从高处俯拍的近距离照片式构图。从头部到大腿上部纳入的中间特写。人物较大地配置在画面中央偏右位置，利用窗边和木地板的留白展现夏天的空气感。镜头像是用智能手机从上方稍拍的自然距离感。视线流向脸部、胸口、腰部、敞开的牛仔扣子部分的构图。背景轻微虚化，人物和服饰的质感自然锐利。

质感・风格：

items.title: 纽约字母填充创意极简旅行海报

prompts.text:
Clean, modern typographic travel poster in a 3:2 landscape format. The words "NEW YORK" — seven large, bold, uppercase geometric sans-serif letters set on a single line (or "NEW" stacked above "YORK" if better balanced) — span the full width and ARE the entire composition. Every illustrated element lives strictly INSIDE the letterforms, as if each letter is a window cut out of white paper revealing a scene; nothing spills outside the letter silhouettes. Outside the letters: pure, empty, flat white background — no objects, no cast shadows, no decoration.

— WHAT FILLS EACH LETTER (NYC-accurate, clipped to the letter shape) —
N : the Statue of Liberty — standing torch raised, following one vertical of the N.
E : stacked Manhattan brownstone facades with fire escapes nested in the three horizontal bars.
W : the Brooklyn Bridge — its two Gothic stone arches and suspension cables spanning the W's zig-zag, a small boat on the East River below.
Y : the Empire State Building — the Art-Deco spire cradled in the fork of the Y.
O : the ring frames Times Square — glowing billboards, a yellow taxi cab, a scramble of tiny pedestrians.
R : the Flatiron Building's distinctive triangular wedge silhouette inside the R.
K : Central Park greenery and the One World Trade Center spire slicing along the K's diagonals; a subway car along the base.

Small city details (a yellow cab, a hot-dog cart with faint steam, a pigeon, a subway roundel, drifting clouds) appear ONLY where they fit within a letter's interior. Keep full legibility of "NEW YORK".

— STYLE —
Elegant flat vector illustration, crisp geometric shapes, minimal detail, clean outlines, subtle shadows contained inside the letters only. Limited palette: deep navy, warm cream, muted red, soft gray-blue — a restrained warm-yellow accent used ONLY on the taxis / Times Square glow. Optional minimal tagline beneath in wide-spaced small capitals: "THE CITY THAT NEVER SLEEPS", thin and understated. Perfectly balanced centered composition.

premium flat vector, minimalist travel poster, geometric illustration, editorial tourism branding, clean typography, high contrast, ultra-sharp lines, museum-quality print, scalable SVG aesthetic, 8K.

prompts.text:
干净、现代的排版旅行海报，3:2 横向格式。“NEW YORK”字样——七个大而粗体、大写的几何无衬线字母设置在单行上（或者如果平衡更好，则“NEW”堆叠在“YORK”上方）——跨越整个宽度，且它们本身就是整个构图。每个插图元素都严格存在于字母形状内部，仿佛每个字母都是从白纸上剪下的窗口，露出一个场景；没有任何东西溢出字母轮廓。字母外部：纯净、空白、平坦的白色背景——没有物体，没有投射阴影，没有装饰。

— 每个字母填充的内容（准确的纽约市景观，剪裁至字母形状） —
N：自由女神像——火炬高举，沿着 N 的一条垂直线。
E：堆叠的曼哈顿棕色石屋立面，防火梯嵌套在三个水平栏中。

items.title: 狂野图形化漫画风格视觉导向

prompts.text:
You are a visual director for graphic feral manga stylization.

Apply this style to any subject the user provides. The subject may be a person, animal, object, plant, building, room, garment, creature, sculpture, machine, or abstract form. Do not reduce the style to generic anime, cute chibi design, or decorative manga imitation. Translate the deeper visual logic of the style into the subject: compressed proportions, dominant graphic shapes, confrontational framing, sharp ink control, selective texture, bold flat color, and a tense balance between cuteness, severity, and animal alertness.

The central idea is the transformation of a subject into a compact, high-impact manga image built from graphic contrast, oversized focal features, and compressed emotional force. The subject should feel immediate, iconic, mischievous, and physically present, as if it is pressing into the picture plane. The image should feel designed like a powerful illustration panel or cover image rather than a naturalistic scene.

The image should not feel soft, painterly, atmospheric, or ornamental. It should feel deliberate, sharp, compressed, and graphic. Every line, contour, shadow shape, hatch, texture cluster, and patch of color must serve form, attitude, and visual punch. Avoid excess rendering. Avoid decoration that does not strengthen silhouette, expression, or tactile emphasis.

Use a restricted, high-clarity palette. Favor deep black, off-white, pale skin tones, vivid cyan or turquoise, sharp red accents, warm amber or yellow accents, muted cream, and occasional cool grey. Most color should appear in bold flat zones. Black should function as a structural force, not just a shadow color. Small accent colors should strike hard against the black and white field. Keep the palette limited and intentional.

Treat the subject as a graphic object with tactile zones. Surfaces should be differentiated clearly through line behavior and texture strategy. Hair may appear as a glossy black mass cut by highlight bands and dense vertical ink marks. Fur may appear fluffy and sharp through clustered tuft lines. Fabric may appear soft, thick, and slightly bulky through contour rhythm and selective fold indication. Skin may remain relatively clean and pale, with minimal blush or fine line detail where needed. Do not over-model the form.

Linework is essential. Use clean, confident contour lines, fine interior marks, controlled thickness variation, sparse cross-contour hatching, and selective texture buildup. Do not use loose sketchiness. Do not use soft painterly blending. Do not use overly mechanical vector smoothness. The line should feel hand-drawn, precise, lively, and intentional. It should carry personality through pressure, taper, spacing, and rhythm.

Shading should be graphic and economical. Prefer flat shadow masses, selective hatching, and carefully placed tonal accents over smooth rendering. Use shadow to carve form, compress space, and strengthen impact. Preserve broad areas of open flat color and exposed paper-like brightness. The image should feel ink-driven first, color-supported second.

Framing should be intimate, aggressive, and compressed. Use close crops. Push important forms toward the viewer. Favor frontal confrontation, low spatial depth, and poses that thrust hands, paws, sleeves, faces, or other expressive forms into the foreground. Foreshortening may be exaggerated, but it must remain readable and forceful. The frame should feel like the subject is crowding the image.

Proportion should be stylized with care. Heads may be large relative to the body. Eyes may dominate the face. Hands, sleeves, ears, or key accessories may be enlarged by perspective. However, do not let the style become generic baby proportion, mascot design, or soft plush illustration. The distortion should produce impact, stubbornness, attitude, and graphic concentration.

Expression should be restrained but potent. Favor sullen stares, narrowed focus, stubborn challenge, quiet irritation, impish confidence, animal alertness, or deadpan intensity. The subject should not grin broadly or perform exaggerated cartoon comedy unless explicitly requested. The emotional effect should come from compression, gaze, pose, and line tension rather than theatrical acting.

Eyes are a primary anchor. They may be very large, very clear, and very graphic. Irises may use a vivid contrasting color. Lids, lashes, and line weight around the eye should intensify the stare. The eyes should feel watchful, confrontational, or emotionally sealed rather than soft, dreamy, or romantic.

Hair should be treated as a major graphic mass. Use blunt silhouette control, heavy dark fill, crisp strands at the fringe, and selective highlight bands. Avoid airy salon styling, excessive shine effects, rainbow color, or decorative hair rendering. Hair should strengthen the overall black shape design.

If animal traits or costume traits are present, integrate them structurally rather than decoratively. Ears, tails, collars, fur trims, claws, whiskers, or textured garments should contribute to silhouette, pose, and tactile contrast. They should not read as random cosplay decoration. The style works best when such features intensify the subject’s feral compactness and visual identity.

For clothing, prefer clear shapes and tactile simplicity. Thick knits, padded trims, plush textures, simple buttons, sleeves, cuffs, scarves, collars, and compact layered garments work well when rendered with clarity and graphic purpose. Avoid busy patterns, fashion clutter, ornamental jewelry overload, or highly realistic fabric rendering.

For non-human subjects, preserve the same grammar. Do not force human face conventions where they do not belong. Translate the style through graphic compression, dominant focal features, close confrontation, bold silhouette, selective line texture, and limited color impact. A plant, object, building, or machine should still feel iconically flattened, tightly framed, and structurally sharpened.

Backgrounds should be minimal or nearly absent unless the subject truly requires context. Favor solid black, stark empty space, or very limited graphic framing support. Negative space is important. It allows the subject to strike harder. If background information appears, it should remain subordinate and highly reduced.

Composition should feel poster-like, iconic, and immediate. Use asymmetry when useful, but preserve strong balance through shape placement and gaze direction. The strongest visual event is usually the interaction between oversized focal features, black mass, bright accent color, and a form thrust toward the viewer.

Do not make the image soft, pastel, dreamy, cinematic, painterly, glossy, ornamental, over-rendered, sentimental, or generically cute. Do not add decorative sparkles, trendy anime clichés, speed lines, random symbols, patterned backgrounds, excessive blush, glamour lighting, fantasy aura effects, or extra detail that weakens graphic force.

Do not use generic quality language. Do not use phrases such as masterpiece, best quality, ultra detailed, stunning, trending, 8k, perfect, cinematic, or beautiful. Describe only concrete visual decisions.

Always preserve the essence: a compact confrontational manga image built from oversized focal features, dominant black shape design, sharp controlled linework, selective texture, bold flat color, tight close framing, strong foreshortening, and feral deadpan intensity.

prompts.text:
你是一位图形化狂野漫画风格化（graphic feral manga stylization）的视觉导演。 

将此风格应用于用户提供的任何主体。主体可以是人、动物、物体、植物、建筑、房间、服装、生物、雕塑、机器或抽象形式。不要将风格简化为通用的动漫、可爱的 Q 版设计或装饰性的漫画模仿。将该风格深层的视觉逻辑转化为待表现的主体：压缩的比例、主导性的图形形状、对抗性的构图、锐利的墨迹控制、选择性的纹理、大胆的平涂色彩，以及在可爱、严峻和动物性警觉之间的紧张平衡。

核心理念是将主体转变为一张紧凑、高冲击力的漫画图像，这种图像由图形对比、夸大的焦点特征和压缩的情感力量构建而成。主体应该给人以即时感、标志性、淘气感和物理存在感，仿佛它正挤入画面平面。图像的感觉应该像是一个设计精良的强力插画版面或封面图像，而不是一个自然主义的场景。

图像不应感到柔软、有绘画感、有氛围感或装饰性。它应该感到刻意、锐利、压缩且具有图形感。每一根线条、轮廓、阴影形状、排线、纹理簇和色块都必须为形式、态度和视觉冲击力服务。避免过度渲染。避免不能强化剪影、表情或触觉重点的装饰。

使用受限的、高清晰度的色调。偏好深黑色、米白色、浅肤色、鲜艳的青色或绿松石色、锐利的红色点缀、温暖的琥珀色或黄色点缀、柔和的乳白色以及偶尔使用的冷灰色。大多数颜色应以大胆的平涂区域出现。黑色应作为一种结构性力量发挥作用，而不不仅仅是阴影颜色。小的点缀色应在黑白场中产生强烈的视觉撞击。保持色调受限且有目的性。

将主体视为具有触觉区域的图形对象。表面应通过线条表现和纹理策略进行清晰区分。头发可能表现为被高光带和密集的垂直墨迹切开的亮黑色块。皮毛可能通过成簇的簇状线条表现得蓬松而锐利。织物可能通过轮廓节奏和选择性的褶皱指示表现得柔软、厚实且略显臃肿。皮肤可能保持相对干净和苍白，在需要的地方辅以极少的红晕或细线细节。不要对形式进行过度建模。

线条工作至关重要。使用干净、自信的轮廓线，精细的内部标记，受控的粗细变化，稀疏的跨轮廓排线，以及选择性的纹理堆积。不要使用松散的草图感。不要使用柔软的绘画式混合。不要使用过度机械的矢量平滑感。线条应该感到是手绘的、精确的、活泼的且刻意的。它应通过压力、锥度、间距和节奏承载个性。

阴影应该是图形化且节省的。相比平滑渲染，更倾向于平涂的阴影块、选择性的排线和精心布置的色调重音。使用阴影来刻画形式、压缩空间并加强冲击力。保留大面积的开放式平涂颜色和暴露的类纸亮度。图像应感觉首先由墨迹驱动，其次由颜色支持。

构图应是亲密的、侵略性的且压缩的。使用特写裁剪。将重要的形式推向观众。偏好正面交锋、低空间深度，以及将手、爪、袖子、脸部或其他有表现力的形式推向前景的姿态。缩短透视法可以夸张，但必须保持可读性和力量感。画面框应该让人感觉到主体正挤满整个图像。

比例应经过精心风格化。头相对于身体可能很大。眼睛可能占据脸部主导地位。手、袖子、耳朵或关键配件可能因透视而放大。然而，不要让风格变成通用的婴儿比例、吉祥物设计或柔软的毛绒插画。这种畸变应该产生冲击力、顽固感、态度和图形集中感。

表情应克制但有力。偏好阴沉的凝视、缩小的焦点、顽固的挑战、安静的激怒、顽皮的自信、动物性的警觉或冷面强度。除非明确要求，否则主体不应大口而笑或表演夸张的卡通喜剧。情感效果应源于压缩感、眼神、姿态和线条张力，而非戏剧化的表演。

眼睛是主要的锚点。它们可能非常大、非常清晰且非常图形化。虹膜可能使用鲜艳的对比色。眼睑、睫毛和眼周的线重应增强凝视感。眼睛应感到是警觉的、对抗性的或情感封闭的，而不是柔软、梦幻或浪漫的。

头发应被视为主要的图形块。使用钝感的剪影控制、沉重的深色填充、边缘处清脆的发丝以及选择性的高光带。避免空灵的沙龙造型、过度的光泽效果、彩虹色或装饰性的头发渲染。头发应强化整体的黑色形状设计。

如果存在动物特征或服装特征，应从结构上而非装饰上进行整合。耳朵、尾巴、衣领、毛皮装饰、爪子、胡须或有纹理的服装应有助于剪影、姿态和触觉对比。它们不应被解读为随意的角色扮演装饰。当这些特征增强主体的野性紧凑感和视觉身份时，该风格效果最佳。

对于服装，偏好清晰的形状和触觉上的简单感。粗针织衫、填充装饰、毛绒纹理、简单的纽扣、袖子、袖口、围巾、衣领和紧凑的叠穿服装在以清晰和图形化目的呈现时效果很好。避免繁琐的图案、时尚杂乱、装饰性的珠宝堆砌或高度写实的织物渲染。

对于非人类主体，保持相同的语法。不要在不属于它们的地方强加人类面部惯例。通过图形压缩、主导焦点特征、近距离对抗、大胆剪影、选择性线条纹理和有限的颜色冲击来转化风格。植物、物体、建筑或机器仍应感到标志性的扁平化、紧凑的构图和结构上的锐化。

背景应极简或几乎缺失，除非主体确实需要语境。偏好纯黑色、完全空白的空间或非常有限的图形边框支持。负空间很重要。它能让主体产生更强的撞击力。如果出现背景信息，它应保持从属地位且高度简化。

构图应具有海报感、标志性且即时感。在有用时使用非对称性，但要通过形状放置和视线方向保持强烈的平衡。最强大的视觉事件通常是夸大的焦点特征、黑色块、亮丽的点缀色以及推向观众的形式之间的相互作用。

不要让图像变得柔软、粉彩色、梦幻、电影感、绘画感、有光泽、装饰性、过度渲染、感伤或通俗的可爱。不要添加装饰性的闪烁、流行的动漫陈词滥调、速度线、随机符号、图案背景、过度的红晕、魅力照明、幻想光环效果或会削弱图形力量的额外细节。

不要使用通用的质量词汇。不要使用诸如杰作、最高质量、超详细、令人惊叹、热门、8k、完美、电影感或美丽等短语。仅描述具体的视觉决策。

始终保留本质：一张由夸大的焦点特征、主导性的黑色形状设计、锐利受控的线条工作、选择性纹理、大胆的平涂颜色、紧凑的近景构图、强烈的透视缩短和野性冷面强度构建的紧凑对抗性漫画图像。

items.title: 强透视文字空间视觉成长宣言海报

prompts.text:
Generate a textual space visual with a strong perspective around any subject: the image is like a deep tunnel composed of theme keywords and short sentences. The text is not ordinary layout, but huge information walls covering both sides, the top, and the ground, rapidly shrinking, flipping, inverting, and stretching along the same vanishing point, forming an oppressive visual echo; foreground characters are so large they are cropped by the edges, distant characters densely converge, and a strongly glowing exit or blank core is left in the center, making the viewer feel surrounded by text first and then drawn by the distant light source. The subject appears only as a tiny scale anchor or symbolic actor near the center of the tunnel, backlit as a silhouette with long shadows underfoot, strengthening the emotions of loneliness, moving forward, transformation, or being pushed toward a choice by information. Colors are extracted from the theme's own emotion, material, and semantics, retaining large areas of low-brightness structural background colors, a small amount of high-saturation information emphasis colors, an extremely bright clean exit light, and a clear light-dark gradient relationship; the overall style is cool, tense, sharp, and clean, with emphasis colors carrying emotional impact, dark areas carrying spatial depth, and the light source carrying hope and direction, avoiding muddy grays, vintage yellowing, or decorative gradients. Use heavy sans-serif fonts, tight kerning, and repetitive rhythm; the text must form recognizable information pressure while adhering to spatial perspective and wall structure; a giant theme verb or core manifesto can be placed at the bottom or foreground, forming a dual-layer reading experience of foreground oppression and background calling.

——————
Growth Manifesto: Self-breakthrough + Action Keywords + White Exit + Silhouette of a person moving forward
Mobile Poster Use: Personal growth course cover + Community check-in splash screen
Cool Color Palette: Deep Sea Blue + Silver Gray White + Electric Cyan + Dark High Contrast
Main Visual Focus: Single person's back centered + Strong light portal at the end + Giant verb cropped in the foreground
Aspect Ratio: 16:9

prompts.text:
Generate a vertical 3:4 finished Chinese poster with the theme "Breathing Flowers".

The overall style is: Digital art exhibition poster, light mist plants, smoky flowers, transparent petals, fluorescent plant veins, dark background, dreamy energy flow, contemporary Chinese typography, high-end exhibition visuals.

The main subject is [Flower Subject], for example: transparent lilies, blue-purple irises, fluorescent wildflowers, glowing orchids, cold flame garden, glass-like petals, smoky bouquets, flowing flower branches, dreamscape plants.

The flowers are not ordinary realistic flowers, but life forms generated together by smoke, light, energy lines, transparent gauze, and plant veins. The petals should be light, translucent, and glowing, with blue-purple light mist on the edges, and the stems and branches extend like fluorescent green energy lines. Flowing smoke, particle light spots, stardust, transparent ribbons, vortex airflows, soft halos, and dreamlike plant structures can appear in the scene.

Visual requirements:
1. The background is mainly deep black, deep blue, dark green, dark purple, or foggy white.
2. The main flower must have a strong visual center and not be cluttered.
3. The light mist should have a flowing direction, as if the plant is breathing, growing, and stretching.
4. The colors are mainly blue, purple, cyan, fluorescent green, pale gold, and cool white.
5. The overall feel should be high-end, dreamy, ethereal, with a digital art exhibition sense.
6. No ordinary florist posters, no cheap fluorescence, no cartoon feel, no e-commerce feel.

Typography requirements:
Write "呼吸的花" for the main Chinese title.
Write "Breathing Flowers" for the small English text.

The text must be clear and accurate, no garbled code, no typos. Chinese is the main language, and English can only be used as auxiliary small text. The layout should be like a real art exhibition poster with a complete information hierarchy.

Composition options:
1. Vertical title on the left, light mist bouquet on the right.
2. Huge glowing flower in the center, title at the bottom.

上半身仅着卡其米色的细肋针织吊带背心。下半身是黑色高腰包臀迷你裙、黑色薄丝袜、黑色短靴。小巧的耳钉和细链项链。右肩和背部轻轻倚靠画面右侧的洗衣机，腰部微微斜向一侧。人物右手捏着洗衣卡，自然垂放在裙子侧边。人物左手放松垂在 thigh 旁。双腿轻微交叉，重心放在画面右侧的腿上。服饰的褶皱、肩带、手指、脚部的着地要自然描绘。

背景·光线：
自助洗衣店的夜晚。画面右侧纵向排列的滚筒式洗衣机，远处有洗涤剂贩卖机和老旧的指示牌，地板上有洗衣篮。前景左右大幅虚化黑色门框或墙壁，营造出从缝隙窥视的空间感。天花板的荧光灯从左上方斜射，柔和照亮脸部、锁骨、肩膀、吊带背心的凹凸。阴影向右下方和远处延伸。洗衣机的金属表面有微弱反射光，远处的贩卖机发出青白色的微光。背景的日文文字作为环境文字自然融入，细节不宜过于清晰可读。

构图·镜头：
纵向3:4。全身肖像。人物位于画面中央稍偏右，全身占据画面约70%。前景的黑色纵向框架大胆遮挡左右，中央形成细长的视线通道。镜头位置略低于胸部高度，轻微平视。中远摄般的压缩感，背景浅景深虚化。焦点在瞳孔，脚部和远处的洗衣机稍作柔化。

质感·风格：
逼真的照片风格。夜晚低光快门快照，类似35mm胶片颗粒，略带暖色的荧光灯，暗部深邃，肌肤不过度修饰，保留自然质感。色调统一于米色、黑色、暗绿色、青白色的机械光泽。非杂志摄影，而是偶然捕捉的安静纪录片感。

负面提示：
不自然的五官或视线、过大的眼睛、过于尖锐的下巴、多余或缺失的手指、手足融合、腿部扭曲、关节崩坏、卡片接触不良、悬空的脚、不自然的重量感、洗衣机圆形门的扭曲、错误的透视、光源矛盾的阴影、过度的美肌修饰、塑料般的肌肤、过曝、无关人物、可读的品牌标志、文字乱码、水印、过度的AI痕迹。

prompts.text:
Create a highly realistic 8K professional black-and-white fashion editorial portrait of a Korean East Asian female model in her late 20s to early 30s. The model should have a serene, contemplative, and confident expression, captured in a sharp left-facing profile view while gazing off-camera. Her jaw should be relaxed, lips closed, and overall presence calm, mature, and sophisticated.

The model has fair skin with neutral undertones, a smooth satin-like texture, and a natural healthy glow. Use soft studio highlights to define the bridge of the nose, cheekbones, and chin, with gentle shadows sculpting the jawline and neck. Her facial structure should feature an elegant oval face shape, refined proportions, a sharp graceful jawline, and a delicate straight nose profile.

Apply a minimalist “no-makeup” makeup look emphasizing natural elegance. Use a light-to-medium coverage satin foundation, subtle upper lash-line definition, very natural mascara, softly groomed brows with a gentle arch, barely noticeable cheek contouring, and natural-toned soft matte lips.

Dress the model in a high-fashion monochrome black outfit: a tailored oversized black blazer paired with a matching long flowing black skirt featuring a high thigh slit. The blazer should have structured padded shoulders, classic lapels, a deep V-neckline worn without an undershirt, single-breasted button closure, and flap pockets. The blazer fabric should appear matte and wool-blend, while the skirt should have a heavy, elegant drape. No accessories. The styling should combine masculine tailoring with feminine elegance, creating a powerful modern silhouette.

Pose the model seated on a simple industrial metal folding chair, angled in a three-quarter profile toward the left. Her head remains level and fully turned into a clean left profile. Her left hand rests elegantly on the chair’s backrest while her right arm stays relaxed. Her left shoulder is slightly raised and pushed back. Her legs are crossed at the knees, creating long elegant lines, paired with sleek black high-heeled pumps. The overall body language should feel powerful, poised, statuesque, and refined.

Place the subject in a minimalist professional photo studio with a seamless monochromatic gray background transitioning from medium gray to light gray. Keep the composition clean and uncluttered, allowing the strong silhouette of the model and chair to stand out. Use deep depth of field so both the model and chair remain sharply detailed.

Capture the image as a full-body portrait from an eye-level camera angle, slightly positioned to the side to emphasize the profile view and leg line. Use the visual feel of an 85mm portrait lens with minimal distortion.

Lighting should resemble professional studio softbox illumination, with a key light coming from the front-left. Create smooth gradients across the body and soft shadows falling toward the right side. Maintain diffused, flattering light that highlights the clothing textures, facial contours, and elegant pose.

Overall style: fine-art luxury fashion editorial photography with a timeless black-and-white aesthetic. Use high contrast with rich tonal gradations, crisp whites, deep blacks, and refined gray tones. The final image should feel sophisticated, quiet, powerful, minimalist, and visually striking.

Aspect ratio: 3:4
Quality: 8K, ultra-realistic, professional black-and-white portrait photography, clean studio lighting, ultra-detailed natural skin texture.

prompts.text:
Subject:
Afternoon by the poolside

Person/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Bright ivory-beige toned fair skin with a faint pink rosy glow, smooth and delicate skin texture. Soft highlights on cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbones. Exquisite and elegant doll-style Japanese makeup. Small, clear catchlights in the pupils. Gazing at the camera with a reserved and soft smile.

White simple triangle bikini. Sitting on a wooden platform by a resort pool. The leg toward the left side of the frame extends into the pool, lightly kicking the water surface with the toes, creating small splashes. The other knee is naturally bent, with an elbow resting on the knee and a hand supporting the cheek. The other hand is naturally placed on the side of the body on the platform, with fingertips completely relaxed. A relaxed and comfortable posture, an elegant and fresh summer portrait.

Background/Lighting:
Bright outdoor resort pool. Foreground features highly transparent blue pool water and subtle reflections, with small splashes near the character's feet. Middle ground includes a wooden platform, white parasols, white sofas, and potted tropical greenery. The background consists of white pergolas and slightly blurred resort architecture. Strong summer sunlight spills from the top left, casting bright highlights on cheeks, shoulders, collarbones, legs, and the water surface. Shadows extend toward the bottom right. The blue light reflected from the water surface faintly illuminates the legs and the underside of the platform.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical composition, 2:3. Full-view poolside portrait. The character is placed largely in the center, slightly to the right, using the leg lines and the pool surface to create a sense of depth. The camera uses a slightly low angle with a natural sense of distance. The background is softly blurred with a shallow depth of field, with the focus concentrated on the character's pupils and around the face. Retaining summer-like bright white space in the sky and one side of the background.

Generate a picture with a strong sense of field immersion based on any theme: Let the repeating layered elements derived from the theme fill the visual space, with foreground elements significantly enlarged and softened to form an accessible blocking layer; the midground reveals only a few key subjects, expressions, symbols, or objects, making it appear as if suddenly emerging from a dense environment, allowing the eye to first read the large area of flowing field and then discover the surrounded core moment. The space should have a shallow depth of field and a sense of compression, with the foreground blurred and the background light, using local clear points to control the line of sight. The background should not be blank decoration but rather continue to extend with the same thematic elements into a rhythm like a continuous sea. Colors are extracted from the theme's own materials, seasons, emotions, and narratives, preserving large areas of high-brightness, transparent, and clean main color fields, supplemented by deeper structural colors to establish layers, with a small amount of bright emphasis colors falling only on focal points and information nodes; the overall feeling remains bright and brisk, airy, with clear color gradations and soft natural light, avoiding gray, dirty, old, or dull tones. A small amount of textual information can be added to the image, and the text must participate in the composition like graphics: use large words with a coarse handwritten texture at the bottom or main visual center of gravity, with brush marks and irregular grains on the edges, forming a heavy memory point; auxiliary text is smaller and more restrained, echoing the focal point but not stealing the breath of the field. The overall texture should be a fusion of real photography and poster design, retaining natural grain, a slight film feel, moist and bright air, and intimate life emotions, avoiding isolating the subject into a common illustration or treating the background as a flat pattern.

This theme: Say Good Morning to people of various provinces, similar to: Good Morning, Shanghai
Today's date: 2026-07-03
A total of 10 cities

——————

Continuously generate 10 images, each with different city themes, illustration logic, golden phrase logic, as well as color and layout logic.
Each one possesses collector-level value.
Similar to a PPT, generate 10 images, ensuring layout differences between each other.
Ratio 16:9

prompts.text:
Generate a vertical 3:4 Chinese fruit-themed finished poster, the theme is [Fruit Name].

The overall style is: Oriental minimalist fruit poster, white background with negative space, soft natural light, watercolor texture, slight paper grain, clean Chinese typography, quiet and high-end, Oriental aesthetics, magazine cover feel.

The main subject is [Fruit Name], the fruit must be realistic and recognizable, but do not have too strong a realistic photography feel, nor be cartoonized. Fruit texture should be soft, clean, moist, with delicate skin, faint highlights, natural shadows, and slight grain. Can appear as complete fruit, partial enlargement, multiple fruits staggered and stacked, cropped composition, translucent overlays, or soft ghosting.

Background is clean white or slightly warm off-white, large area of negative space. No complex scenes, no desktop clutter, no e-commerce staging. Overall looks like a finished Oriental aesthetic fruit poster.

Typography requirements:
1. Chinese main title write "[Fruit Name]"
2. Main title can be vertical or horizontal, font must be clear, restrained, with Oriental temperament.
3. Add a small red square seal, inside the seal write "美".
4. Bottom can add small text "AIGC".
5. Can add a small line of English text: Look for peaceful Oriental artistic conception aesthetics
6. Signature write "杨哥视觉研究"
7. Chinese must be clear and accurate, no garbled code, no typos.
8. Not too much text, maintain high-end negative space.

Composition can vary:
1. Vertical title on the left, large fruit on the right
2. Single fruit super large crop, occupying more than half of the picture
3. Three fruits staggered and stacked, forming a rhythm
4. One large fruit plus one small fruit in the distance, forming spatial levels
5. Fruit partial close-up, title placed at the bottom
6. Fruit enters from the edge of the picture, retaining a lot of blank space
7. Fruit superimposed with light-colored circular shadows
8. Title and fruit form a diagonal relationship
9. Minimalist center composition, only retaining one subject and small amount of text

Color requirements:
Overall low saturation, clear, soft. Adjust main color according to the fruit's own color, but no high saturation, no cheap vividness. Picture should be clean, light, with paper breathing feel.

Do not:
No watermarks, no real brand logos, no QR codes, no e-commerce promotion feel, no price tags, no complex backgrounds, no messy English, no low-quality typography.

prompts.text:
生成一张竖版 3:4 的中文水果主题成品海报，主题为【水果名称】。

整体风格为：东方极简水果海报、白底留白、柔和自然光、水彩质感、轻微纸张颗粒、干净中文排版、安静高级、东方审美、杂志封面感。

画面主体是【水果名称】，水果要真实可识别，但不要写实摄影感过强，也不要卡通化。水果质感要柔和、干净、水润，有细腻表皮、微弱高光、自然阴影和轻微颗粒。可以出现完整水果、局部放大、多个水果错位叠放、裁切构图、半透明叠影或柔和重影。

背景为干净白色或微暖米白色，大面积留白。画面不要复杂场景，不要桌面杂物，不要电商摆拍。整体像一张已经完成排版的东方美学水果海报。

排版要求：
1. 中文主标题写「【水果名称】」
2. 主标题可以竖排，也可以横排，字体要清晰、克制、有东方气质。
3. 加入一枚小红色方形印章，印章内写「美」。
4. 底部可加入小字「AIGC」。
5. 可加入一句英文小字：Look for peaceful Oriental artistic conception aesthetics
6. 署名写「杨哥视觉研究」
7. 中文必须清晰准确，不要乱码，不要错字。
8. 文字不要太多，保持高级留白。

构图可以变化：
1. 左侧竖排标题，右侧大水果
2. 单个水果超大裁切，占据画面一半以上
3. 三个水果错位叠放，形成节奏
4. 一个大水果加一个远处小水果，形成空间层次
5. 水果局部特写，标题放在底部
6. 水果从画面边缘进入，保留大量空白
7. 水果与淡色圆形阴影叠加
8. 标题与水果形成对角线关系
9. 极简中心构图，只保留一个主体和少量文字

色彩要求：
整体低饱和、清透、柔和。根据水果本身颜色调整主色，但不要高饱和，不要廉价鲜艳。画面要干净、轻盈、有纸张呼吸感。

不要：
不要水印，不要真实品牌 Logo，不要二维码，不要电商促销感，不要价格标签，不要复杂背景，不要杂乱英文，不要低质排版。

prompts.text:
Theme:
Morning's hurried footsteps

Character/Expression:
A female in her 20s. Fair skin with bright ivory beige tones and a faint pinkish healthy texture. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long and thick eyelashes, natural aegyo-sal (tear bags), sheer pink-beige lipstick. Small catchlights in the pupils. Holding toast in her mouth, with a slightly panicked yet bright expression, running down the stairs.

Clothing/Pose:
White short-sleeved sailor-style shirt with an elegant navy blue collar and cuff lines, and a large, beautifully shaped navy blue ribbon. High-waisted neat navy blue pleated skirt, white socks, and black loafers. The character's right foot steps onto the step below, while the left foot bounces lightly backward. The character's left hand holds the bag strap, and the right hand is slightly raised near the hair. The skirt and hair sway naturally with the momentum of running.

Background/Lighting:
Stairs of a pedestrian bridge in front of a station. Metal railings, a covered walkway, blurred station signs and street signs in the distance. Strong morning sunlight enters from the top right of the frame, illuminating the face, shirt, legs, and the edges of the stairs. The shadows of the railings on the stairs fall diagonally, sharply highlighting the contrast between bright and shadowed areas. Add a slight white bloom effect to the air.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical 2:3 ratio, full body included in the composition. Place the character slightly to the right of the center, using the lines of the stairs and railings to create a sense of depth. The lens is slightly low, looking up slightly from the front. Focus on the character, with the background naturally blurred. A frozen snapshot capturing the moment of running.

Texture/Style:
Realistic Japanese street photography. Bright summer morning, soft highlights, natural skin texture, detailed depiction where every strand of hair's movement can be seen. Hair is bright milk tea ash brown, with thin see-through bangs, layered cut around the face, and medium-length hair reaching below the shoulders. The ends of the hair are loosely curled inward, fluffing out with the running motion. The bag is a dark brown Japanese-style school bag, hung with multiple accessories such as a teddy bear, a small white plush toy, ribbons, a fluffy keychain, and beaded charms.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features or gaze, extra or missing fingers, fused hands and feet, deformed joints, floating feet, hair or skirt that does not conform to gravity, corrupted bag accessories, poor contact with props, shadows inconsistent with the light source, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, garbled text, logos, watermarks, unnecessary people.

位于车站前的步行桥楼梯。金属扶手，有顶棚的通道，远处模糊的车站指示牌和街头招牌。早晨的强烈阳光从画面右上方射入，照亮脸庞、衬衫、双腿和楼梯边缘。楼梯上扶手的影子斜向落下，鲜明地突出明亮部分与阴影部分的对比。在空气中稍稍加入白色光晕的晕染。

构图・镜头：
纵向2:3，全身纳入构图。将人物置于中央稍偏右的位置，用楼梯和扶手的线条营造纵深感。镜头稍低，从正面略微仰视的角度。焦点对准人物，背景自然模糊。捕捉奔跑瞬间的定格快照照片。

质感・风格：
真实的日系街头摄影。明亮的夏日早晨，柔和的高光，自然的肌肤质感，能看到每一根头发的流动的细腻描绘。头发是明亮的奶茶灰棕色，薄薄的透视刘海，围绕脸庞的层次剪裁，及肩下的中长发。发梢向内松散卷曲，随着奔跑动作蓬松展开。包是深棕色的日式校服包，挂着泰迪熊、小小的白色毛绒玩具、丝带、毛茸茸的钥匙扣、串珠挂饰等多个饰品。

负面提示：
不自然的五官或视线，多余或缺失的手指，手脚融合，关节变形，悬空的脚，不符合重力的头发或裙子，包饰品的崩坏，与道具接触不良，与光源矛盾的影子，过度美肌修饰，塑料般的肌肤，文字乱码，标志，水印，不必要的人物。

items.title: 嗦粉局螺蛳粉品牌视觉系统全套提案

prompts.text: Please create a set of highly finished '4 brand visual proposals' with a unified visual system based on the following brand information. Note: This is not a four-grid puzzle, nor is it a master image combining 4 contents in the same frame, but a set of 4 independent images that need to be 'generated separately in sequence'. Please complete the generation of these 4 images consecutively under the same brand visual system. The 4 images must clearly belong to the same brand, but each image carries different responsibilities and cannot just be 4 repeated variants. [Brand Information] Brand Name: 嗦粉局 (Suo Fen Ju) English Name: SLURP CLUB Brand Concept: Midnight Obsession Project Brand Type: Youthful new-style snail noodle brand / night snack brand Slogan: Tonight, slurp first. One-sentence Positioning: Turning a bowl of smelly, spicy, and obsessive snail noodles into a night snack brand that young people are more willing to buy, photograph, and share. Core Keywords: Snail noodles, night snack, obsessive, red oil, sour bamboo shoots, fried egg, yuba, heavy flavor, smoky atmosphere, youthful trend, midnight life-saver, appetite impact, takeout-friendly, packaging feel, brand proposal feel. Target Audience: Young people aged 18–35, night snack consumers, heavy flavor lovers, people who like to take photos and check-in, browse takeout apps, and pursue stimulating tastes and highly memorable food. [Overall Visual Direction] Do not make it look like traditional local specialty packaging, nor like cheap internet-famous snack posters. The overall look should be like a youthful, design-oriented, textured, and commercially viable night catering brand proposal. Visual Keywords: Warm light night snack, red oil appetite, natural ingredient colors, metal texture, cream-white cards, smoky atmosphere, youthful brand, proposal feel, high-end feel. Color Palette Direction: Do not use excessive black-red hard-clashing colors, do not have black backgrounds with red text for the whole image, and do not cover the whole screen with red. Please use a more layered color system: Main Background Color: Warm charcoal grey, deep smoke grey, deep taupe, black matte texture. Main Accent Color: Chili oil orange-red, red oil red, brick red, instead of piercing bright red. Information Carrier Color: Bone soup cream white, warm cream white, light cream grey, used for menu cards, receipts, SKU cards, label cards, and instruction modules. Auxiliary Ingredient Colors: Sour bamboo shoot yellow, yuba gold, fried egg golden yellow, braised egg brown. Small Area Accents: Scallion green, stainless steel grey, a small amount of warm orange light. Material Language: Stainless steel trays, metal plates, warm light boxes, matte packaging bags, paper menus, receipt paper, seal stickers, plastic film reflection, steam, red oil highlights. Auxiliary Graphics: Red oil ripples, noodle trajectory lines, bowl mouth circles, receipt torn edges, chopstick diagonal lines, chili icon, sour bamboo shoot icon, yuba icon, wood ear icon, peanut icon, fried egg icon, label stickers, receipt numbering system. Label Copy can use: Obsession Warning, Night Snack Recommendation, Extra Spicy Must-Order, Extra Fried Egg, Soul of Sour Bamboo Shoots, Midnight Life-Saver, Slurp Once Obsessed, Slurp First Tonight, Heavy Flavor Lovers. Core Products: 1. Signature Classic Snail Noodles 2. Super Spicy Red Oil Snail Noodles 3. Fried Egg Snail Noodles 4. Pork Intestine Snail Noodles 5. Double Yuba Snail Noodles 6. Deluxe Double-Mix Snail Noodles [Unified Requirements] 1. The four images must belong to the same brand system, keeping brand name, font temperament, color scheme, auxiliary graphics, label system, and product logic unified. 2. All images use vertical 4:5 ratio, suitable for social media display and brand proposal presentation. 3. Each image is generated independently, no four-grids, no merging into one master image. 4. The overall result must have high finish, sufficient information, strong design feel, and strong brand proposal feel; do not be too simple or too empty. 5. The visuals must have appetite impact but not be overly dark, and no red-black overload. 6. Highlight warm light, natural ingredient colors, metal texture, cream-white information cards, and red oil layering. 7. Products must be real and tempting, with clear layers of red oil, sour bamboo shoots, yuba, fried eggs, peanuts, wood ear, green vegetables, and rice noodles. 8. Chinese titles should be clear, English text as auxiliary, and the overall layout should have a commercial proposal feel. [Image 1] IMAGE 1 | DARK RED OIL HERO BOARD Task: Generate the brand visual cover image for the entire proposal. At first glance, make people feel: night snack, hot and spicy, obsessive, snail noodles, youthful trend, appetite impact, and brand texture. Composition: Top displays brand name '嗦粉局', English name 'SLURP CLUB', slogan 'Tonight, slurp first.', and information like 'Midnight Obsession Project'. Center features a bowl of 'Fried Egg Snail Noodles' as the absolute visual center. Use black ceramic bowls, dark tableware, or stainless steel trays. The bowl must clearly show red oil soup base, rice noodles, fried egg, sour bamboo shoots, yuba, wood ear, peanuts, green vegetables, and scallions; a small amount of braised egg or meat slices can be added. Food should have steam, oil glisten, and real ingredient layers. Surroundings can include chili, sour bamboo shoot side dishes, chopsticks, receipts, seasoning bowls, and other details. Background uses warm charcoal grey, deep smoke grey, metallic grey; no pure dead black. Titles and key labels use chili oil orange-red, info cards use bone soup cream white to improve layering and readability. Bottom displays 4 main product small cards: 1. Signature Classic Snail Noodles 2. Super Spicy Red Oil Snail Noodles 3. Fried Egg Snail Noodles 4. Pork Intestine Snail Noodles. Add selling point labels: Hardcore Red Oil / Soulful Sour Bamboo Shoots / Midnight Life-Saver / Slurp Once Obsessed. Requirements: Do not make it like a common catering poster; make it like a high-finish, youthful, textured brand visual cover. The visual should be impactful but not a blurred mess of black and red. [Image 2] IMAGE 2 | MIDNIGHT VISUAL SYSTEM BOARD Task: Generate a brand identification system image, showing the visual system composition of 'Suo Fen Ju'. It is not a common VI manual, but should look like a high-end proposal board of 'Midnight Menu Archive + Brand ID System + Receipt Label System'. Composition: Top displays brand name '嗦粉局', English name 'SLURP CLUB', slogan 'Tonight, slurp first.', can include a small snail noodle main bowl image as a visual anchor. Middle modularly displays the following content: 1) Brand Identity System: Chinese logotype '嗦粉局', English logotype 'SLURP CLUB', seal version, horizontal version, vertical version, simplified identity. 2) Color System: Chili oil orange-red, warm charcoal grey, bone soup cream white, sour bamboo shoot yellow, yuba gold, stainless steel grey, scallion green. Color blocks should have names and hierarchy, do not use all black and red. 3) Typography System: Chinese main title font, Chinese auxiliary font, English auxiliary font, label font. Example words can include: 嗦粉局, Tonight slurp first, Obsession warning, Night snack recommendation. 4) Icon System: Chili, sour bamboo shoot, yuba, wood ear, peanut, braised egg, fried egg, chopsticks, rice noodles, red oil. 5) Label Sticker System: Obsession warning, Extra spicy must-order, Extra fried egg, Night snack recommendation, Soul of sour bamboo shoots, Midnight life-saver, Heavy flavor lovers, The more you slurp the more obsessed you get. These labels can be made into receipt strips, stickers, seals, menu labels. 6) Auxiliary Graphic System: Red oil ripples, noodle trajectory lines, receipt torn edges, bowl mouth circles, chopstick diagonal lines, steam lines. 7) SKU Coding System: 01 Signature Classic, 02 Super Spicy Red Oil, 03 Fried Egg, 04 Pork Intestine, 05 Double Yuba, 06 Deluxe Double-Mix. Bottom displays 6 SKU product cards, each with a small image, number, name, and spiciness or selling point labels. Requirements: The overall look must have design and system feel, using bone soup cream white cards to carry information, avoiding excessive black and red throughout the image. It should look like a high-end brand archive board, not a promotional flyer or an e-sports style control panel. [Image 3] IMAGE 3 | PRODUCT & PACKAGING BOARD Task: Generate product and packaging application images, showing how 'Suo Fen Ju' is implemented as a sellable product system. Make people feel at a glance that this brand can be dine-in, takeout, retail, and sold on shelves. Composition: Top displays 4 key finished products: 1. Signature Classic Snail Noodles 2. Super Spicy Red Oil Snail Noodles 3. Fried Egg Snail Noodles 4. Pork Intestine Snail Noodles. Finished products should be presented using high-end food photography, with red oil, rice noodles, fried egg, sour bamboo shoots, yuba, peanuts, wood ear, and green vegetables clearly visible. The food area should be bright, with steam, oil glisten, and layers. Middle displays the complete packaging system: Bagged home-version snail noodles, Tubed/Cup-packed instant version, Takeout bowls, Tote bags, Takeout bags, Seals, Chopstick sleeves, Menu cards, Brand stickers, Receipts, Ingredient pack breakdown: red oil pack, sour bamboo shoot pack, yuba pack, peanut pack, vinegar pack, soup base pack. Packaging style uses warm charcoal grey, bone soup cream white, chili oil orange-red, sour bamboo shoot yellow, yuba gold; do not make it look like traditional local specialty packaging. It should have modernity, youthfulness, texture, and SKU differentiation. Bottom displays 6 complete SKU product cards: 1. Signature Classic Snail Noodles 2. Super Spicy Red Oil Snail Noodles 3. Fried Egg Snail Noodles 4. Pork Intestine Snail Noodles 5. Double Yuba Snail Noodles 6. Deluxe Double-Mix Snail Noodles. Each product card includes a product image, name, number, and highlight labels. Selling points can be added: Hardcore Red Oil / Soulful Sour Bamboo Shoots / Fried Egg Must-Order / Midnight Life-Saver / Extra Spicy Warning. If space allows, add topping recommendations: Extra sour bamboo shoots / One more fried egg / Extra pork intestine / Double yuba. Requirements: Must have a 'truly sellable' feel. Not just a pile of products, but reflecting the product system, packaging system, takeout system, and retail system. The overall look should be like a high-end food retail brand proposal. [Image 4] IMAGE 4 | CAMPAIGN & SPACE BOARD Task: Generate communication and scene application images, showing the effect of 'Suo Fen Ju' in the real world. Focus on presenting a complete brand landing of 'Late-night Store + Night Snack Stall + Takeout Communication + Social Media Communication'. Composition: Large main scene on the left: Display a textured late-night store, street-side shop, or night snack stall. The storefront clearly says '嗦粉局', can carry the English 'SLURP CLUB', and displays the slogan 'Tonight, slurp first.' The scene should have warm light, smoky atmosphere, pickup window, counter, finished noodle display, ingredient area, takeout pickup area, a few young customers or staff. The overall atmosphere is midnight, warm, appetizing, making people want to go in and slurp a bowl; do not make it overly dark. Top right module: Display a small night snack pop-up stall or brand event stand, including light boxes, menu boards, product displays, packing bags, brand posters, etc. Middle right module: Display two brand promotion posters: One featuring Fried Egg Snail Noodles, One featuring Super Spicy Red Oil Snail Noodles. Poster copy can use: Tonight, slurp first. Slurp once obsessed, don't sleep tonight. Midnight life-saver, come for a hardcore bowl. Extra spicy warning. Bottom left module: Simulate 3–4 mobile vertical social media content cards: New product recommendations, Fried egg must-order, Extra spicy warning, Night snack recommendation. Each social media card maintains a unified brand style, but not all black/red; food images should stand out. Bottom right module: Display brand touchpoints: Takeout bags, receipts, chopstick sleeves, stickers, napkins, packaging seals, takeout packaging, brand small cards. Bottom info area: Display scene labels: Midnight Store / Night Snack Stall / Takeout Recommendation / Street Smoke & Fire / Youth Community. An emotional slogan can be added: It's late, time for a hardcore bowl. Requirements: This image should have more sense of scene, communication, and storytelling than Image 3. Not a common snack shop or a rustic night market stall, but a youthful, design-oriented night snack brand space with warm light texture. [Execution Method] Please strictly follow the process below: 1. Unify the brand visual DNA internally first. 2. Generate Image 1: Dark Red Oil Hero Board. 3. Under the same brand system, continue to generate Image 2: Midnight Visual System Board. 4. Under the same brand system, continue to generate Image 3: Product & Packaging Board. 5. Under the same brand system, continue to generate Image 4: Campaign & Space Board. 6. Do not merge the 4 images into one, do not make a four-grid, do not repeat the content of the 4 images. 7. Each image is an independent vertical 4:5 brand proposal image. [Final Goal] Output a set of 4 independent but highly unified '嗦粉局 SLURP CLUB' brand visual proposal images: Image 1 sets the tone. Image 2 explains the system. Image 3 handles product and packaging implementation. Image 4 handles communication and scene implementation. The entire result should possess: Unified brand visual DNA, clear page division, high-finish aesthetics, appetite impact, commercial proposal feel, packaging system feel, scene landing feel, and portfolio quality directly usable for brand concept presentation.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
请根据以下品牌信息，创作一套高完成度、具有统一视觉系统的「4张品牌视觉提案」。

注意：
这不是一张四宫格拼图，也不是把4张内容合并在同一个画面里的总图，而是一套需要“依次分别生成”的4张独立图片。请在同一个品牌视觉系统下，连续完成这4张图的生成。4张图必须明显属于同一个品牌，但每一张图承担不同职责，不能只是4张重复变体。

【品牌信息】

品牌名：嗦粉局
英文名：SLURP CLUB
品牌概念：深夜上头计划
品牌类型：年轻化新派螺蛳粉品牌 / 夜宵品牌
Slogan：今晚，先嗦为敬。

一句话定位：
把一碗够臭、够辣、够上头的螺蛳粉，做成年轻人更愿意买、更愿意拍、更愿意分享的夜宵品牌。

核心关键词：
螺蛳粉、夜宵、上头、红油、酸笋、炸蛋、腐竹、重口、烟火气、年轻潮流、深夜续命、食欲冲击、外卖友好、包装感、品牌提案感。

目标人群：
18–35岁年轻人，夜宵消费人群，重口味爱好者，喜欢拍照打卡、刷外卖、追求刺激口味和强记忆点美食的人群。

【整体视觉方向】

不要做成传统地方特产包装，也不要做成廉价网红小吃海报。
整体要像一个年轻化、有设计感、有质感、有商业落地感的夜宵餐饮品牌提案。

视觉关键词：
暖光夜宵、红油食欲、食材本色、金属质感、米白卡片、烟火气、年轻品牌、提案感、高级感。

配色方向：
不要使用过度黑红硬撞的配色，不要整张图黑底红字，也不要红色铺满全画面。

请使用更有层次的配色系统：

主背景色：
暖炭灰、深烟灰、深灰褐、黑色磨砂质感。

主强调色：
辣油橘红、红油红、砖红，而不是刺眼正红。

信息承载色：
骨汤米白、暖米白、浅米灰，用于菜单卡、小票、SKU卡、标签卡、说明模块。

辅助食材色：
酸笋黄、腐竹金、炸蛋金黄、卤蛋棕。

小面积点缀：
葱花绿、不锈钢灰、少量暖光橙。

材质语言：
不锈钢托盘、金属餐盘、暖光灯箱、哑光包装袋、纸质菜单、小票纸、封签贴纸、塑封膜反光、热气、红油高光。

辅助图形：
红油波纹、面条轨迹线、碗口圆形、小票撕边、筷子斜切线、辣椒icon、酸笋icon、腐竹icon、木耳icon、花生icon、炸蛋icon、标签贴纸、小票编号系统。

标签文案可使用：
上头警告、夜宵推荐、加辣必点、炸蛋加满、酸笋灵魂、深夜续命、一嗦上头、今晚先嗦、重口爱好者。

核心产品：

1. 招牌经典螺蛳粉
2. 爆辣红油螺蛳粉
3. 炸蛋螺蛳粉
4. 肥肠螺蛳粉
5. 腐竹双倍螺蛳粉
6. 豪华双拼螺蛳粉

【统一要求】

1. 四张图必须属于同一个品牌系统，品牌名、字体气质、配色、辅助图形、标签系统、产品逻辑保持统一。
2. 所有图片统一使用竖版4:5，适合社交媒体展示和品牌提案展示。
3. 每张图独立生成，不要四宫格，不要拼成一张总图。
4. 整体要高完成度、信息量足够、设计感强、品牌提案感强，不要太简陋，不要太空。
5. 画面要有食欲冲击，但不要过度暗黑，不要红黑过载。
6. 要突出暖光、食材本色、金属质感、米白信息卡和红油层次。
7. 产品必须真实诱人，红油、酸笋、腐竹、炸蛋、花生、木耳、青菜、米粉层次清晰。
8. 中文标题要清晰，英文字样作为辅助，整体排版要有商业提案感。

【第1张图】

IMAGE 1｜DARK RED OIL HERO BOARD / 暗夜红油主视觉

任务：
生成整套提案的品牌主视觉封面图。第一眼就让人感受到：夜宵、热辣、上头、螺蛳粉、年轻潮流、食欲冲击和品牌质感。

画面结构：
顶部展示品牌名“嗦粉局”、英文名“SLURP CLUB”、slogan“今晚，先嗦为敬。”，以及“深夜上头计划”等信息。

中部以一碗“炸蛋螺蛳粉”为绝对主视觉中心。
使用黑色陶瓷碗、深色餐具或不锈钢托盘，碗中必须清晰看到红油汤底、米粉、炸蛋、酸笋、腐竹、木耳、花生、青菜、葱花，可少量加入卤蛋或肉片。食物要有热气、油光和真实食材层次。

周围可摆放辣椒、酸笋小料碟、筷子、小票、调料碗等细节。
背景使用暖炭灰、深烟灰、金属灰，不要纯黑死黑。
标题和重点标签使用辣油橘红，信息卡片使用骨汤米白，提升层次和可读性。

底部展示4个主打产品小卡片：

1. 招牌经典螺蛳粉
2. 爆辣红油螺蛳粉
3. 炸蛋螺蛳粉
4. 肥肠螺蛳粉

加入卖点标签：
红油够狠 / 酸笋够灵魂 / 深夜续命 / 一嗦上头

要求：
不要做成普通餐饮海报，要像高完成度、年轻化、有质感的品牌主视觉封面。画面要冲击强，但不能黑红糊成一片。

【第2张图】

IMAGE 2｜MIDNIGHT VISUAL SYSTEM BOARD / 夜宵视觉系统档案

任务：
生成品牌识别系统图，展示《嗦粉局》的视觉系统构成。它不是普通VI手册，而要像“夜宵菜单档案板 + 品牌识别系统 + 小票标签体系”的高级提案板。

画面结构：
顶部展示品牌名“嗦粉局”、英文名“SLURP CLUB”、slogan“今晚，先嗦为敬。”，可加入一张小型螺蛳粉主碗图作为视觉锚点。

中部模块化展示以下内容：

1）品牌标识系统
中文字标“嗦粉局”、英文字标“SLURP CLUB”、印章版、横版、竖版、简化标识。

2）色彩系统
辣油橘红、暖炭灰、骨汤米白、酸笋黄、腐竹金、不锈钢灰、葱花绿。
色块要有命名和层次，不要全部使用黑红。

3）字体系统
中文主标题字体、中文辅助字体、英文辅助字体、标签字体。
示例词可包括：嗦粉局、今晚先嗦为敬、上头警告、夜宵推荐。

4）图标系统
辣椒、酸笋、腐竹、木耳、花生、卤蛋、炸蛋、筷子、米粉、红油。

5）标签贴纸系统
上头警告、加辣必点、炸蛋加满、夜宵推荐、酸笋灵魂、深夜续命、重口爱好者、越嗦越上头。
这些标签可以做成小票签条、贴纸、印章、菜单标签。

整体要有设计感和系统感，使用骨汤米白卡片承载信息，避免整张图过度黑红。要像高级品牌档案板，不像促销单，也不像电竞风控制面板。

【第3张图】

IMAGE 3｜PRODUCT & PACKAGING BOARD / 夜宵产品矩阵与包装系统

任务：
生成产品与包装应用图，展示《嗦粉局》如何落地为可售卖的产品系统。让人一眼觉得这个品牌可以堂食、外卖、零售、上架售卖。

顶部展示4款重点成品：

【第4张图】

IMAGE 4｜CAMPAIGN & SPACE BOARD / 深夜门店与传播场景

任务：
生成传播与场景应用图，展示《嗦粉局》进入真实世界后的效果。重点呈现“深夜门店 + 夜宵档口 + 外卖传播 + 社媒传播”的完整品牌落地。

画面结构：
左侧大主场景：
展示一个有质感的深夜门店、街边小店或夜宵档口。
门头清晰写着“嗦粉局”，可带英文“SLURP CLUB”，展示slogan“今晚，先嗦为敬。”
场景要有暖光、烟火气、取餐口、柜台、成品粉展示、小料区、外卖取餐区、少量年轻顾客或店员。

今晚，先嗦为敬。
一嗦上头，今夜别睡。
深夜续命，来碗狠的。
加辣警告。

左下模块：
模拟3–4张手机竖图式社媒内容：

右下模块：
展示品牌触点：
外卖袋、小票、筷套、贴纸、纸巾、打包封签、外卖包装、品牌小卡。

底部信息区：
展示场景标签：
深夜门店 / 夜宵档口 / 外卖推荐 / 街边烟火 / 年轻社群

可加入一句情绪化标语：
夜深了，该来一碗狠的。

要求：
这张要比第3张更有场景感、传播感和故事感。
不是普通小吃店，也不是土味夜宵摊，而是年轻化、有设计感、有暖光质感的夜宵品牌空间。

【执行方式】

请严格按照以下流程执行：

1. 先内部统一品牌视觉DNA。
2. 生成第1张图：暗夜红油主视觉。
3. 在同一品牌系统下，继续生成第2张图：夜宵视觉系统档案。
4. 在同一品牌系统下，继续生成第3张图：夜宵产品矩阵与包装系统。
5. 在同一品牌系统下，继续生成第4张图：深夜门店与传播场景。
6. 不要把4张图合并成一张，不要做四宫格，不要让4张图内容重复。
7. 每张图都是独立的竖版4:5品牌提案图。

【最终目标】

输出一套4张独立但高度统一的《嗦粉局 SLURP CLUB》品牌视觉提案图：

第1张负责定调
第2张负责解释系统
第3张负责产品和包装落地
第4张负责传播和场景落地

整套结果应具备：
统一的品牌视觉DNA、清晰的页面分工、高完成度审美、食欲冲击、商业提案感、包装系统感、场景落地感，以及可直接用于品牌概念展示的作品集质量。

The background maintains a large area of bright, clear, and clean high-brightness base, colors are extracted from the material, emotion, and context of the theme itself: the base color is responsible for a light and airy feel, dark colors are responsible for the skeleton and tension, medium-saturated theme colors are responsible for emotion, a very small number of dots or short lines serve as beats and visual pauses; the overall effect maintains a bright, refreshing, restrained but vital color relationship, avoiding turbidity, staleness, and gloom. The information hierarchy should be as clear as an exhibition visual system, the main title is the largest and most orderly, and secondary information such as dates, descriptions, and signatures are narrowed into vertical edge arrangements or small font modules, forming a rhythm where images and text restrain each other; the final effect should be like a modern art promotional visual organized by silhouettes, paper scraps, rubbing textures, and geometric white space, having both handmade traces and maintaining cleanliness, clarity, and readability.

items.title: 原宿白昼午后少女风日系街头写真

prompts.text:
Subject:
Harajuku daylight afternoon

Character/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Bright ivory beige whitish skin tone with a faint pinkish natural texture. Soft highlights on the cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbones. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long and thick eyelashes, natural aegyo-sal (tear bags), light brown eyebrows, translucent pink-beige lip gloss. Small clear catchlights in the pupils. Looking at the camera with a soft smile.

Clothing/Pose:
White to ivory girly Japanese streetwear. Ruffled sleeve shirt, large satin ribbon tie, high-waist pleated mini skirt, lace hem, thin chain and small ribbon decorations. White ruffled socks, platform white lace-up shoes. The right arm is stretched out significantly toward the camera, making the palm and fingers appear large in the foreground. The left hand is slightly open near the cheek. Standing on one leg with the other leg bent backward. The thickness of the legs and thighs is natural, balanced on both sides.

Background/Lighting:
A bright alley in Harajuku, Tokyo. Cafe signs, white building walls, street trees, store signs and pedestrians stretching into the distance. Text is within a natural range blending into the Japanese street scene, with blurry and illegible parts. Midday natural light spills in from the upper right, illuminating the face, hair, and ruffles of the white clothes. Soft shadows at the feet. The background is slightly bright and transparent, with a clean and light atmosphere.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical 4:5. Full-body portrait. The person is located slightly to the left of the center, with the entire body included. Shot in a low-angle wide-angle lens style, enlarging the outstretched hand and placing the face and body behind to emphasize the sense of depth. The background has a natural shallow depth of field rather than excessive blurring. A composition where the depth of the alley and white lines guide the eye toward the person.

Texture/Style:
Realistic photo-style AI image. A bright and highly transparent Japanese-style portrait. Dominated by white and ivory tones, with hair in a bright milk tea ash brown. Thin see-through bangs, layers around the face, shoulder-length medium hair. The hair ends are loosely curled inward, showing a natural sense of bundles, fine highlights, soft luster, and a few stray hairs. Skin is not over-retouched; the lace of the fabric, the platform of the shoes, and the texture of the road surface should be presented in detail.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features or gaze, extra or missing fingers, hand merging, joint deformation, asymmetrical thighs, unnatural differences in leg thickness, distorted knees or ankles, floating shoes, unnatural weight sensation, damaged clothing, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, garbled text, logos, watermarks, unnecessary passersby entering the frame.
