prompts.text:
Create a premium advertising poster for [BRAND] featuring [PRODUCT].

Build the image around an AURA FIELD concept.

The product must be the clear hero, placed in a premium commercial composition with sharp detail, realistic materials, cinematic lighting, and strong visual hierarchy.

Around the product, create visible aura fields that express what the product makes people feel, taste, hear, smell, wear, or experience.

The aura should not look like random magic. It must be designed as a refined visual language based on the product category and brand DNA.

Adapt the aura to the product:
- food products create flavor waves, crumbs, cream, chocolate, steam, crunch particles, or appetite energy
- fragrance and beauty products create scent trails, mist, petals, skin glow, botanical particles, or soft liquid air
- tech products create clean data fields, light grids, interface particles, signal waves, or intelligent glow
- fashion and eyewear products create motion trails, attitude lines, reflections, street energy, or editorial light
- home products create calm atmosphere, warmth, texture, comfort waves, soft shadows, or ritual energy
- performance products create speed fields, impact rings, air pressure, focus lines, or kinetic energy

The aura must wrap around the product, interact with its shape, and make the product feel powerful, desirable, and iconic.

Keep the composition premium, minimal where needed, and highly polished. Use refined typography inspired by the brand’s visual language with a short 3-word slogan.

Do not use miniature people, micro worlds, shadow storytelling, negative-space frames, exploded-view composition, product monuments, or split reality.

Avoid copying any existing real campaign. Create a fresh original ad concept.

Brand: [BRAND]
Product: [PRODUCT]
Aura type: [SENSORY / EMOTIONAL / FUNCTIONAL AURA]
Aspect ratio: [RATIO]

光场不应看起来像随意的魔法。它必须根据产品类别和品牌基因设计成一种精致的视觉语言。

使光场适应产品：
- 食品类产品产生风味波浪、碎屑、奶油、巧克力、蒸汽、酥脆颗粒或食欲能量

- 性能类产品产生速度场、冲击环、气压、聚焦线或动能

光场必须环绕产品，与其形状互动，使产品显得强大、诱人且具标志性。

一次意外捕捉到的奢华生活时刻，就像真实的旅行记忆而非摆拍。使用 iPhone 17 Pro Max 拍摄的超写实智能手机摄影。自然的瑕疵、真实的非对称、真实的姿势、可见的皮肤纹理、毛孔、皮肤上微妙的光泽、水光唇、狐系睫毛，以及原始未经编辑的照片美学。没有人工修图，没有影棚级的完美。

一位美丽年轻女性坐在热带海岸线上一处巨大岩石悬崖上的写实旅行时尚肖像。垂直画幅，智能手机视角，中长景构图。她舒适地坐在风景优美的观景点边缘的一块粗糙石头表面上。一条腿弯曲并搁在岩石高处，另一条腿自然下垂。一只手随意拿着一副放在膝盖上的黑色设计师墨镜，另一只手伸向头发，仿佛在拨开挡在脸上的发丝。

她的头转离相机面向海岸线，眺望远方而非看着观众。表情沉着、若有所思且自然自信，营造出一种真实的旅行时刻感。

她留着及腰的长直黑发，在海风中自由飘动。几缕散发自然地拂过她的脸庞。妆容精致且简约：透亮的皮肤、柔和勾勒的眉毛、长睫毛、微妙的轮廓阴影和亮泽的裸粉色嘴唇。

她穿着一件鲜艳黄色带绿色包边的大廓形巴西国家足球队球衣，风格更偏向时尚旅行街头服饰而非运动装。球衣有真实的织物褶皱、刺绣细节和自然宽松的剪裁。她搭配了一条大廓形白色降落伞工装裤，带有长抽绳和束脚设计。白色运动袜和厚实的灰色 Balenciaga 3XL 运动鞋完成了整套穿搭。一条精致的银链项链和细手链增添了微妙的奢华细节。

地点：一个俯瞰着清澈透明的青绿色海湾、令人叹为观止的热带山顶观景点。前景是崎岖的风化岩石、干草和海岸植被。背景展现出郁郁葱葱的绿色山坡、蜿蜒的沿海公路、零星的奢华别墅、停泊在海湾的小船、热带海滩和地平线上升起的远方岛屿。高处观景点营造出一种强烈的自由、冒险和奢华旅行感。

明亮的自然中午阳光从上方并略微侧方照亮场景，在她的头发、皮肤、球衣、岩石和海面上创造出真实的亮部。阴影保持清晰且自然。海洋反射出灿烂的青绿色和深蓝色调，并带有闪烁的银色高光。

调色板：巴西黄和绿、青绿色海洋、翡翠绿山丘、米色石崖、温暖自然的肤色以及生动的蓝天。

构图为垂直画幅，女性位于全景景观的中心位置。前景岩石创造了深度，而开阔的海岸线和热带海湾填满了整个背景。自然的智能手机镜头透视、真实的景深、精细的头发丝、可见的皮肤毛孔、真实的织物纹理、微妙的胶片颗粒、写实旅行摄影、奢华生活美学、运动时尚风、真实的社交媒体旅行照、高细节、对焦于女性、热带风景背景、沙漏型身材。

Layout Structure:

Square and vertical versions adopt top text and bottom image:

A simple action

items.title: 清晨裹着浴巾向镜头伸手的温柔女性

prompts.text:
Theme:
The calling hand of early morning

Characters・Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Bright ivory beige whitish skin with a faint pinkish healthy glow, smooth and natural skin texture. Soft highlights on cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbone, not excessive skin retouching, but retaining natural skin texture. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eyeshadow, long and thick eyelashes, natural tear bags, light brown soft eyebrows, transparent pink-beige lip gloss. Pupils are a steady brown with small clear catchlights. Wearing a gentle smile, looking directly at the camera.

Clothing・Pose:
A thick white bath towel is tightly wrapped from the chest to the waist and upper thighs. The towel is a clean terry cloth material, with natural fabric thickness and folds at the chest and waist. Lying on the bed, upper body slightly raised, moving closer to the camera. Both arms extended towards the camera, palms open, posing as if gently calling out. Fingers naturally spread, without excessive force. The body type is natural mature female curves, an elegant and healthy impression.

Background・Lighting:
A bright bedroom consisting only of white sheets and white pillows. The foreground is the outstretched hands, the middle ground is the face and upper body, and the background is soft messy bedding. Natural morning light pours in from the upper right of the frame, forming soft white highlights on the hair, cheeks, shoulders, collarbone, and towel folds. Shadows fall elegantly towards the lower left of the frame, and the reflected light from the white sheets envelops the skin brightly.

Composition・Lens:
Vertical 9:16. A close-up high-angle composition looking down from the bed. The face is located in the upper center of the frame, and the outstretched hands occupy the left and right foreground, slightly emphasizing the sense of perspective. From the chest to the upper thighs are included in the frame, with white bedding creating negative space. Sight and focus are on the pupils, with hands slightly blurred in the foreground. Wide-angle but natural portrait expression without facial distortion.

Texture・Style:
Realistic photo-style AI image. Bright and clean Japanese portrait. Skin is full of transparency while retaining natural pores and blood color. Hair is light milk tea ash-brown medium-length hair, with thin see-through bangs, face-framing layers, and loosely curled ends on the inside. Detailed depiction of every strand of hair flow, delicate highlights, soft luster, and a few stray hairs. The white bath towel shows the bumps and soft thickness of the terry cloth material.

Negative Prompt:
Expressions that look like minors, overly childish face, excessive sexual emphasis, exposure, see-through towel, slipping towel, unnatural chest, vulgar poses, unnatural complexion or gaze, extra or missing fingers, hand deformation, arm fusion, joint collapse, poor contact between towel and body, floating feeling, unnatural gravity, shadows with contradictory light sources, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, text, logos, watermarks.

白色厚实的浴巾从胸口紧紧裹到腰部和大腿上部。浴巾是干净的绒圈材质，胸口和腰部有自然的布料厚度与褶皱。身体仰躺在床上，上半身微微抬起，向镜头靠近。双臂向镜头伸出，手掌张开，摆出温柔召唤般的姿势。手指自然分开，不用力过度。体型是自然成熟的女性曲线，优雅而健康的印象。

仅由白色床单和白色枕头构成的明亮卧室。前景是伸出的双手，中景是脸部和上半身，背景是柔和凌乱的寝具。从画面右上方洒入清晨的自然光线，在头发、脸颊、肩膀、锁骨、浴巾褶皱处形成白色柔和的高光。阴影淡雅地落在画面左下方，白色床单的反射光让整体肌肤明亮包裹。

逼真的照片风格AI图像。明亮干净的日系人像。肌肤透明感十足，同时保留自然的毛孔和血色。头发是浅奶茶灰棕色的中长发，薄透刘海、脸周层叠、内侧松散卷曲的发梢。细致描绘每一根头发的流动、细腻高光、柔和光泽，以及少量散乱发丝。白色浴巾展现绒圈材质的凹凸与柔软厚度。

prompts.text: Create a work of **Oriental Literati Aesthetic Calligram**. The main subject uses minimalist brush line drafts to outline the silhouette, completing the shape with only a few ink lines rich in calligraphic brushwork. The interior of the main subject is not ordinary filling, but is naturally composed of a large number of vertically arranged traditional brush calligraphy characters. The calligraphic characters are naturally arranged along the object's structure, the direction of gravity, or the direction of flow, making the text both the content and the shape itself, forming a complete visual structure. The density of the characters changes naturally, with varying sizes, possessing a sense of writing rhythm, irregular but overall coordinated, as if completed by real handwriting. The whole follows the aesthetics of traditional Chinese literati painting: Large area of white space; Sparse enough to gallop a horse, dense enough to block the wind; Quiet composition; Strong sense of breathing; Minimalist; Restrained; Elegant; Full of Zen. Background uses: Old Xuan paper, off-white paper, natural fiber texture, slightly yellowed aging, extremely light ink wash bleeding, extremely light paper wrinkles, natural paper texture. Colors use only: Inky black, light ink gray, a small amount of cinnabar seals. The image is dotted with several traditional Chinese carved seals, placed naturally and not intentionally. Overall resembles: Ancient literati manuscripts, museum collections, Oriental modern art, Chinese calligraphy installation art, minimalist posters. The image is quiet, restrained, and rich in negative space. No modern fonts. No computer typesetting. No high-saturation colors. No complex backgrounds. No realistic photography. No illustration feel. No decorative patterns. No extra elements. Subject: Lotus

items.title: 仪式感书籍分享沙龙海报生成提示词

prompts.text:
Generate an image with a heavy sense of ritual around any subject object: the screen first lets a large area of monochromatic background carry the emotion, the main form is shifted to the left to form a steady sense of physical oppression, with fine tactile textures and weak shadows on the surface; the subject content is abstracted in front of the main form into a set of stepping structures decreasing from bottom to top, the left half uses clear light-colored blocks to present the thickness of the object, and the right half switches to extremely fine line-drawn outlines, like a skeleton of knowledge, path, or time revealed after being cut open from the entity, forming a visual moment where thick matter and light line drafts are juxtaposed. The upper and middle parts retain a large amount of quiet white space, with a few light line small symbols as breathing and scale hints, all decorations are close to the thematic semantics. Text is part of the structure, the main title is arranged vertically along one side, with wide letter spacing and slow rhythm, using high-contrast, slender, inscribed-style Chinese fonts; auxiliary information is in lighter fine characters close to the main form and bottom wireframe, forming a reading path from markers to themes and then to action information. Colors are extracted from the theme's own materials, emotions, or cultural signals, maintaining a role relationship where a large area of pure base color carries emotion, a light-colored main body establishes brightness contrast, and dark fine lines and a small amount of small-area accent colors calibrate the rhythm; the overall should present a warm and solemn, clean and restrained, saturated but not dirty feeling, textures only add tactile sensation and do not create aged gray mist. The key is the precise half-and-half conversion between physical material and translucent line drawing within the same subject structure, making the weight, path, and thickness of time visible at a glance.

——————
Sharing session direction: Travel reading + book list + speaker portrait + route symbols
Publication use: Reading salon preview poster + activity registration page header image
Cool colors: Indigo + Silver Gray + Fog White + low saturation cold
Screen composition: Diagonal book page path + bottom info box + top white space focus, horizontal 16:9

items.title: 怀旧咖啡馆复古数码相机人像

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-realistic nostalgic café portrait captured on a premium early-2000s compact digital camera, blending direct flash with soft afternoon daylight. The image has a dreamy, imperfect snapshot quality with gentle motion softness caused by natural handheld camera movement, subtle subject motion, and shifting strands of hair. The atmosphere feels candid, intimate, and effortlessly authentic.
A young woman sits alone at a cozy café table beside a large sunlit window. Instead of facing outward, she is turned slightly toward the camera while lowering her gaze with a quiet, thoughtful expression. One hand loosely holds a ceramic coffee cup near her lips while the other rests against the edge of the table. Her posture is relaxed and natural, conveying a calm afternoon moment rather than a posed portrait.
She wears an oversized cream-colored knit cardigan layered over a soft sage-green top, loose charcoal trousers, a slim vintage wristwatch, and understated jewelry. On the table are a cappuccino with delicate foam art, a small notebook, and a bundle of pale peach roses wrapped in kraft paper. Warm wooden furniture, softly blurred indoor plants, scattered reflections, and muted café décor create a peaceful everyday setting.
Shot through thick vintage optics with pronounced spherical aberration, reduced edge sharpness, soft focus drift, blooming highlights, subtle lens haze, gentle veiling flare, lifted blacks, low micro-contrast, and characteristic CCD digital-camera color rendering. Fine JPEG softness and natural optical imperfections contribute to the nostalgic aesthetic.
Small naturally clipped highlights appear on hair strands, glossy lips, watch crystal, coffee cup edges, flower petals, table surfaces, window reflections, and bright outdoor areas beyond the glass. Light softly blooms into surrounding tones without artificial sparkle effects or exaggerated glow.
Skin appears naturally healthy and luminous with realistic texture and faintly visible pores beneath the dreamy softness. Gentle warmth is concentrated in the cheeks and lips, while the complexion retains realistic tonal variation and depth.
Makeup features refined glass-skin beauty styling: softly lifted brows, subtle grey-blue eyes, delicately separated lashes, muted taupe eyeshadow, and luminous reflective highlighter on the cheekbones, nose bridge, inner eye corners, cupid’s bow, and chin. The highlights remain bright and elegant while preserving believable skin texture.
Colors remain rich and distinct despite the soft contrast: cream knitwear, sage-green fabric, warm wood tones, peach roses, coffee browns, indoor greenery, and natural skin tones maintain depth, vibrancy, and separation without oversaturation.
Lighting combines soft window daylight with gentle flash fill. Daylight creates a subtle rim light around the hair and shoulders, while flash softly illuminates facial features. Hair carries elongated reflections, lips show natural moisture, ceramic surfaces catch diffuse highlights, flowers reveal delicate satin reflections, and knit fabrics retain tactile detail.
Natural handheld vertical framing, slight tilt, imperfect composition, candid crop, and a premium vintage digicam feel. The overall mood is quiet, warm, reflective, and reminiscent of a treasured café snapshot discovered years later.
Aspect Ratio: 4:5
Negative Prompt: beauty filter, airbrushed skin, plastic texture, waxy complexion, over-sharpening, HDR processing, excessive clarity, harsh contrast, oversaturated colors, artificial glow effects, unrealistic reflections, perfect symmetry, CGI appearance, digital painting look, heavy skin smoothing.

items.title: 品牌产品分裂现实高级创意广告海报

prompts.text:
Create a premium advertising poster for [BRAND] featuring [PRODUCT].

Build the composition around a clear SPLIT REALITY concept.

The poster should be divided into two visually contrasting worlds that show the transformation, contrast, or duality created by the product.

The product must sit at the center of the split as the visual bridge between both realities.

One side should represent the “before” state, problem, raw material, ordinary world, chaos, friction, noise, dullness, or limitation.

The other side should represent the “after” state, solution, refined experience, elevated world, clarity, control, beauty, energy, taste, performance, or desire.

The split should feel intentional and cinematic, not like a simple before/after collage.

Make the product accurate, recognizable, sharp, premium, and visually dominant.

Adapt the split logic to the brand DNA:
- tech products show chaos vs control, analog vs intelligent, limitation vs possibility
- food products show raw ingredient vs irresistible final experience
- beauty products show dullness vs glow, routine vs ritual, raw nature vs refined care
- fashion products show ordinary presence vs elevated identity
- luxury products show raw craft vs timeless refinement
- home products show everyday mess vs designed atmosphere

Use premium commercial photography, cinematic lighting, strong contrast between both worlds, refined typography, sharp product detail, realistic materials, elegant composition, polished shadows, and world-class campaign finishing.

Add tasteful poster typography inspired by the brand with a short 3-word slogan.

Do not use miniature people, micro worlds, product monuments, shadow storytelling, exploded-view composition, or negative-space frames.

Avoid copying any existing campaign. Create a fresh original split-reality advertisement.

prompts.text: create a highly detailed cinematic storyboard poster in a 4:5 vertical ratio, designed like a premium editorial character sheet and film planning board. Use a clean beige paper background with thin black grid lines, black title bars, and a vintage magazine-meets-movie-production aesthetic. The composition must follow this layout: a large vertical character profile panel on the left, a multi-panel storyboard sequence on the right, and a bottom information strip spanning the full width. Keep the design polished, balanced, and highly readable, with strong hierarchy, realistic lighting, and consistent character design across all panels. Left panel: show the main character in a hero pose with a large stylized title at the top, a short tagline beneath it, then a structured profile section with labels such as name, age, hometown, profession, style, quote, about, and lifestyle. Add a full-body or near full-body hero image of the character, with one prop that defines their identity. The typography should feel hand-drawn, bold, and cinematic. Right side: create 6 to 7 storyboard frames arranged in a clean grid. Each frame should have a black header bar with numbered shot titles. Every frame must show the same character in a different action beat, with clear camera energy and scene progression. Under each frame, include three small text boxes labeled camera / movement, music, and sound. The shots should feel like a real production storyboard: dynamic, expressive, and visually coherent from scene to scene.  Bottom strip: add three labeled sections across the width: wardrobe and gear, personality and skills, and locations and conditions. Use small thumbnail-style images, icons, or product-style cutouts for the wardrobe area. Keep the personality area as a bullet list with short traits. Keep the locations area as mini landscape thumbnails with concise labels and environment notes. Style direction: cinematic commercial, premium storyboard board, urban editorial design, natural skin texture, realistic proportions, dramatic but clean lighting, cohesive color palette, high detail, sharp composition, professional print-ready finish. Make it look like a storyboard used for a film, music video, or high-end brand campaign. Important layout rules: preserve the same overall structure, visual balance, and ratio discipline as the reference. Use one dominant left panel, one storyboard grid on the right, and one footer band at the bottom. Make the whole design feel like a single unified art board, not separate random panels. items.title: 偷色壁画少女惊愕瞬间

prompts.text:
Theme:
Color-stealing mural

Characters・Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Black hair in a half-up bun, soft loose hair, natural makeup. Looking back at the wall on the left, with wide eyes and an open mouth in a strong expression of surprise. Expressing the moment of anxiety and confusion that "my skirt color is being stolen."

Clothing・Pose:
Lavender short-sleeved top, white sneakers. A colorful tulle long skirt mixed with pink, blue, and yellow. The color on the left half of the skirt is sucked away, turning into translucent white tulle. The right half still retains its original colorful appearance. Legs and white panties are naturally visible through the transparent part, in an elegant and non-sexy way of expression. Both hands are frantically grabbing the skirt, the body is slightly backing away while turning the head to the left.

Background・Lighting:
A narrow alley. On the left is a cream-colored long wall. The wall features mostly flat 2D mural art that stays close to the wall surface. A cat artist character with thick outlines is pointing a transparent straw at the skirt. Pink, blue, and yellow pigments sucked from the skirt are flowing inside the tube. The other end of the tube is connected to a huge roller in the hands of another small artist character in the mural, using those colors to paint colorful splashes on the wall. Stars, hearts, flowers, swirls, and abstract strokes are added to create a design-heavy pop mural. Bright natural light, with soft shadows at the feet.

Composition・Lens:
Vertical 4:5. The character is on the right side of the frame, and the mural is on the left side. A full-body street snap style. The visual flow moves from "colorful skirt → faded translucent part → transparent tube → roller → mural splash." A slightly low eye-level angle, not too wide a frame. The background depth is slightly blurred to ensure the main character's mechanism is clear at a glance.

Texture・Style:
Characters and the alley use realistic photographic expression. Only the mural is a flat and pop 2D illustration. Detailed depiction of the rough texture of the wall, the transparency of the tulle, the boundary of the color loss on the half side, and the pigment flowing inside the transparent tube. Cute, surprised.

Negative Prompt:
Do not make mural characters 3D, do not let them jump out of the wall, do not erase the overall color of the skirt, do not reverse the color flow, do not let the color inside the tube become empty, no poor roller connection, no unnatural face or gaze, no flaws in fingers or legs, overexposure, vulgar expression, unnecessary characters, text, logos, watermarks, shadows contradicting the light source.

prompts.text:
2x2网格，16:9，针对历史上4个令人困惑的日子：风格 = {
  <柔和粉彩公益动漫电影>
  媒介：柔和的社论信息图插画，融合了风格化的动漫电影场景设计。
  表面：哑光纸张纹理，柔和的颗粒感，轻微点缀的海报饰面，带有干净简化渲染的柔和数字绘画。
  形式：可爱的风格化人物和易读的象征性物体，放置在清晰的海报式构图中。
  颜色：公益事业粉彩色调，包含天蓝色、医疗蓝、薄荷绿、腮红粉、奶油色、浅珊瑚色和柔和米色，辅以少量深蓝色作为视觉锚点。
  光影：整体为明亮的柔和环境光，伴有选择性的戏剧性光束，中心主体周围带有轻微的电影感光辉。
  构图：清晰的海报层级，具有强烈的中心焦点主体，简化的周围人物，易读的辅助图标以及宽阔的背景形状。
  情绪：充满希望、具有公民意识、情感上令人振奋，但带有严肃感和英雄紧迫感的底色。
  </柔和粉彩公益动漫电影>

  <转换>
  - 将主体转换为一个受动漫启发的风格化人物或物体，并放置在干净的公共信息海报布局中。
  - 将周围元素重新解释为简化的象征性辅助图形、公民图标、教育主题或叙事辅助人物。
  - 将写实风格转化为柔和的圆形、亲切的卡通比例，以及情感上易读的面部或焦点表情。
  - 平衡柔和的信息图清晰度与微妙的电影场面调度及英雄色彩的强调。
  - 将复杂的环境重建为简化的场景背景，具有宽阔易读的形式、柔和的气氛并减少杂乱。
  - 将激烈的动作、紧张或冲突转化为柔化的海报戏剧感：易读、充满情感且具有象征意义，而非粗糙或写实的。
  - 在相关时使用象征性物体、徽章、盾牌、图表、地球仪或机构图案来辅助构图。
  - 保留主体身份，但使其感觉像是一个带有动漫电影魅力的崇高公众意识运动的核心部分。
  </转换>

  <形状语言>
  - 倾向于圆润的轮廓、干净的线条、柔和的几何形状和亲切的人物设计。
  - 保持次要人物简单且易读。
  - 使用图标式的道具、大型象征性形式和适合海报的空间布局。
  - 让情感叙事通过姿势、间距和构图来表现，而非密集的细节。
  </形状语言>

  <渲染规则>
  - 保持表面柔和且哑光。
  - 使用细腻的纸张颗粒和粉彩色块。
  - 避免生硬的写实主义；保持面部和人物设计风格化且可爱。
  - 让构图在远处看就像教育海报一样清晰。
  - 添加恰到好处的电影氛围以创造情感升华。
  </渲染规则>

  <收尾>
  - 粉彩公益动漫海报美学。
  - 柔和、充满希望、具有象征意义且干净。
  - 教育性的社论清晰度与以人物为中心的电影情感相融合。
  </收尾>

  <避免>
  - 避免粗糙的血腥、写实或严酷的战术细节。
  - 避免密集的背景杂乱。
  - 避免过于阴暗的调色板或激烈的对比。
  </避免>
}

items.title: 当代中文水果视觉海报设计

prompts.text:
Generate a vertical 3:4 Chinese fruit-themed finished poster, a single complete poster, no nine-grid, no collage, no collection.

The theme of the image is [Fruit Theme]. The fruit must be clear and realistic, with a fresh and moist texture, and can include whole fruits, cross-sections, pulp, skin, water droplets, bubbles, juice, pits, seeds, partial close-ups, and floating slices.

The overall style is not ordinary fruit photography or e-commerce fruit advertising, but contemporary Chinese visual poster design. Please reorganize the fruit images into a poster with a clear layout, a Chinese title, a visual center, and design completion.

The image must form different visual directions based on different fruits; do not make all images look the same. One of the following layouts can be adopted:
1. High-saturation blue background + transparent glass frame + floating fruit slices
2. Creamy white background + large area of white space + partial fruit close-up
3. Purple night scene + circular partitions + star map orbit layout
4. Pink mirror + symmetrical composition + sticky notes
5. Infographic structure + multiple cross-section annotations + specimen research feel
6. High-contrast graphics + bold Chinese title + collage blocks
7. Channel broadcast feel + labels, icons, signal lines, sticker-style layout
8. Minimalist white space + transparent material square boxes + light botanical feel
9. Cosmic orbit + starlight, rings, pulp floating structure

The poster must have a Chinese main title:
「【Main Title】」

Add a Chinese subtitle:
「【Subtitle】」

Add a Chinese short phrase:
「【Short Phrase】」

Add a signature:
「Signature」

Text requirements:
Chinese must be clear and accurate, no garbled characters, no typos.
Chinese is the main focus, a small amount of English text can be used as an auxiliary, but English should not dominate.
The title should have a sense of design, using large characters, vertical layout, horizontal layout, misplaced layout, mirror composition, border layout, label layout, and infographic layout.

Image texture:
High-end poster design, fresh fruit, strong visual impact, clean typography, magazine cover feel, visual experimental feel, modern Chinese typography, refreshing but not cheap.

No watermarks, no real brand logos, no QR codes, no e-commerce promotion feel, no product detail pages.

prompts.text:
生成一张竖版 3:4 的中文水果主题成品海报，单张完整海报，不要九宫格，不要拼图，不要合集。

画面主题为【水果主题】，水果必须清晰真实，有新鲜水润的质感，可以包含完整果实、切面、果肉、果皮、水滴、气泡、果汁、果核、果籽、局部特写和漂浮切片。

整体不是普通水果摄影，也不是电商水果广告，而是当代中文视觉海报设计。请把水果图像重新组织成一张有明确版式、有中文标题、有视觉中心、有设计完成度的海报。

画面必须根据不同水果形成不同视觉方向，不要所有图都长得一样。可以采用以下版式之一：
1. 高饱和蓝底 + 透明玻璃框 + 漂浮水果切片
2. 奶油白底 + 大面积留白 + 水果局部特写
3. 紫色夜景 + 圆形分区 + 星图轨道排版
4. 粉色镜像 + 对称构图 + 便签贴纸
5. 信息图结构 + 多个切面标注 + 标本研究感
6. 高对比图形 + 粗体中文标题 + 拼贴块面
7. 频道广播感 + 标签、图标、信号线、贴纸式排版
8. 极简留白 + 透明材质方框 + 轻盈植物感
9. 宇宙轨道 + 星点、圆环、果肉漂浮结构

海报必须有中文主标题：
「【主标题】」

加入中文副标题：
「【副标题】」

加入一句中文短句：
「【短句】」

加入署名：
「署名」

文字要求：
中文必须清晰准确，不要乱码，不要错字。
中文为主，可以有少量英文小字作为辅助，但不能英文主导。
标题要有设计感，可以使用大字、竖排、横排、错位排版、镜像构图、边框排版、标签排版、信息图排版。

画面质感：
高级海报设计、鲜活水果、强视觉冲击、干净排版、杂志封面感、视觉实验感、现代中文排版、清爽但不廉价。

不要水印，不要真实品牌 Logo，不要二维码，不要电商促销感，不要商品详情页。

items.title: 午后的光与优雅日系少女肖像

prompts.text:
Subject:
Afternoon Light

Character · Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Bright ivory beige-toned fair skin with a faint pink healthy glow, skin is smooth and delicate. Soft highlights on cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbone, without excessive skin retouching, retaining natural skin texture and presenting an exquisite quality. Elegant and soft face shape, leaning towards a Japanese beauty style, oval contour, small and clear nose bridge, slightly large but not unnatural brown pupils. Exquisite and elegant makeup, like a sophisticated Japanese doll makeup. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eye shadow, long and thick eyelashes, natural tear bags, bright soft brown eyebrows, pink-beige lip gloss with transparency. Small and clear catchlights in the pupils. Expression is serene and soft, corners of the mouth slightly closed, looking directly at the camera.

Clothing · Pose:
Summer lightweight ivory white tulle material dress-style top. Deep V-neck design, making the chest area appear mature and elegant. A matching color sophisticated lace inner layer is faintly visible inside. Sleeves are sheer long sleeves with natural folds at the wrists. Overall with slight wrinkles and a soft drape. Body slightly tilted, upper body facing forward. Gently lifting her own left hand to the side of her face, fingertips naturally curved. Shoulders relaxed, creating a calm and mature atmosphere. Hair is bright milk tea ash brown. Thin see-through bangs, layered cut around the face, medium-length hair below the shoulders. Hair ends loosely curled inward, with a fluffy airy feel and natural bundling. Carefully depict the flow of every hair strand, slender luster, soft brightness, and a small amount of naturally stray hair.

Background · Lighting:
Simple interior walls from white to gray-beige. The background is a tidy minimalist space with restrained decoration. Afternoon natural light spills in from the window at the front left of the frame. In addition to the soft main light source, slender beams of light through curtains or window frames fall on the face, forming impressive light traces on the forehead, brow, nose bridge, and upper left cheek. Shoulders and collarbone are also bathed in warm light, while the opposite side creates a three-dimensional effect with light shadows. Thin window shadows are also cast on the background wall, enhancing the photo-like airiness. Light color temperature leans towards warm cream beige, creating a gentle afternoon atmosphere.

Composition · Lens:
Vertical composition upper body portrait. The subject is located slightly to the right of the center of the frame. Close-up framing from the top of the head to below the chest, naturally including the left hand in the frame. Lens position is slightly higher than eye level, maintaining a natural sense of distance. Equivalent to an 85mm medium telephoto portrait feel. Precisely focus on the face and pupils, background softly blurred. Ensure that the hair bundling, skin texture, fabric layering at the chest, and the light beams on the face are all clearly conveyed.

Texture · Style:
Realistic photo-style AI portrait. An elegant finish between Japanese magazine photography and natural portraiture. Skin is smooth but not plastic-like, retaining detailed hair flow and texture. Hair represents transparent brown tones and delicate luster. Clothing needs to depict the difference between tulle and lace. Color palette centered on ivory white, milk tea brown, pink-beige, and gray-beige. Avoid overly strong contrast, letting only the light traces become the visual focus, creating a photo-like expression. Slightly film-like airiness.

Negative Prompt:
Unnatural facial features, unnaturally large eyes, asymmetrical face shape, overly sharp chin, excessive skin retouching, plastic-like skin, extra fingers, missing fingers, deformed joints, unnatural hand positions, hair in blocks, heavy bangs, unnatural chest shape, deformed fabric, overexposure, vulgar clothing, shadows contradicting the light source, shadows obscuring the face, unnecessary small objects, text, logos, watermarks.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
主题：
午后的光

人物·表情：
20多岁的女性。明亮的象牙米色调的白皙肌肤，带着淡淡粉红血色的光泽，肌肤平滑细腻。脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀、锁骨处有柔和的高光，不进行过度美肌修饰，保留自然的肌理，呈现精致的质感。脸型优雅柔美，偏向日系美女风格，椭圆形轮廓，小巧而清晰的鼻梁，略大的但不过分自然的棕色瞳孔。妆容精致优雅，宛如精巧的日系娃娃妆。淡玫瑰粉色的腮红，香槟米色与粉棕色的眼影，细长浓密的睫毛，自然的泪袋，明亮的柔软棕色眉毛，带有透明感的粉米色唇彩。瞳孔中加入小而清澈的捕捉光。表情宁静柔和，嘴角微微闭合，直视着镜头。

服装·姿势：
夏日轻盈的象牙白薄纱材质连衣裙式上衣。深V领设计，让胸口显得成熟而优雅。内侧隐约可见同色系的精致蕾丝内搭。袖子为薄透的长袖，手腕处有自然的褶皱。整体带有轻微褶皱和柔软垂坠感。身体略微侧倾，上半身朝向正面。将自己的左手轻轻举到脸庞侧边，指尖自然弯曲。肩膀放松，营造出沉稳的成熟氛围。头发是明亮的奶茶灰棕色。薄薄的透视刘海，脸部周围的层次剪裁，及肩下方的中长发。发梢向内松散卷曲，带有蓬松的空气感和自然的束感。仔细描绘每一根头发的流动、细长的光泽、柔和的亮度，以及少量自然的散乱发丝。

背景·光线：
简约室内从白色到灰米色的墙壁。背景是整理整齐的极简空间，装饰克制。从画面左前方窗户洒入午后的自然光。除柔和的主光源外，透过窗帘或窗框的细长光束落在脸上，在前额、额头、鼻梁、左脸颊上方形成印象深刻的光痕。肩膀和锁骨也沐浴在温暖的光线中，对侧则以淡影营造立体感。背景墙上也投下薄薄的窗影，增强照片般的空气感。光线色温偏向温暖的奶油米色，营造温柔的午后氛围。

构图·镜头：
纵向构图的上半身肖像。人物位于画面中央略偏右的位置。从头顶到胸部下方的近距离取景，自然地将左手纳入画面。镜头位置略高于视线的高度，保持自然的距离感。相当于85mm的中远摄肖像感。将焦点精准对准脸部和瞳孔，背景柔和虚化。确保发丝的束感、肌肤的质感、胸口的布料重叠，以及脸上的光束都能清晰传达。

质感·风格：
逼真的照片风格AI肖像。介于日本杂志写真与自然肖像之间的优雅完成度。肌肤平滑但不似塑料，保留细致的毛流和肌理。头发表现透明感的棕色调与细腻光泽。服装需描绘出薄纱与蕾丝的差异。以象牙白、奶茶棕、粉米色、灰米色为中心调色。避免过强对比，仅让光痕成为视觉焦点，营造照片般的表现。略带胶片感的空气感。

负面提示：

prompts.text:
Generate a restrained, calm, exhibition-like visual work around any theme: the upper part of the image consists of slender structural components, suspended fragments, or modular strokes derived from the theme as the main form, suspended in an empty field by thin lines, transparent supports, or extremely light spatial relationships. The real form occupies only a small visual area, but casts an enlarged shadow of thematic text, symbols, or core imagery on the lower plane through light, allowing the viewer to read the huge image on the ground at first glance and only discover that the image comes from the scattered physical structures above at second glance. The space remains clean with white space, the background resembles a quiet exhibition hall, model room, or seamless installation space, with walls and floors establishing depth through soft junctions. The main body is suspended in the upper-middle area, and the shadow spreads forward with perspective distortion, edge hardness/softness changes, and slight blurring, forming a figure-ground reversal where 'the entity is light, the shadow is heavy.' If text is needed in the image, it should participate in the composition as an information layer along with the shadow layer: titles or theme words can be transformed into huge projections, and explanatory text is arranged in small font size, wide spacing, and low density at the bottom or edges, maintaining a precise, quiet, and highly ceremonial commercial visual order. Colors are extracted from the material, brand temperament, and emotions of the theme itself, retaining a large area of high-brightness clean base color, a small amount of neutral structural colors, clear light-to-dark hierarchies, and low-saturation information colors; the overall effect should be clear, quiet, calm, and precise, with bright but not glaring light, and the shadow carrying the main emotional weight, avoiding dirty gray, smoky, retro yellowing, or heavy stains. Material surfaces are delicate, edges are sharp, and hanging lines and structural components should have realistic scale and slight industrial precision. items.title: 睡前蓝色房间的优雅女性人像

prompts.text:
Theme:
Blue room before bed

Person/Expression:
An adult woman who looks like she is in her late 20s. Mature and steady physique, exuding an elegant atmosphere without childishness. Skin is bright ivory beige-toned fair skin with a faint pink flush, smooth and delicate texture. No excessive highlights or whiteness; soft highlights on the cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, and collarbone, with moderate pore texture that doesn't look unnaturally plastic. Faint rose pink blush on the cheeks, champagne beige and pink brown gradient makeup on the eyes. Long and natural eyelashes, natural eye bags, bright brown soft arched eyebrows. Lips have translucent pink beige lip gloss, naturally shining in the center. The overall facial makeup is an elegant and clean precision doll-style Japanese makeup. Hair is deep brown almost black long hair, keeping thin bangs and stray strands around the face. The head is tilted slightly to the lower left, gaze falling slightly in front of the hands. Expression is serene and peaceful, with a soft lingering afterglow of before falling asleep.

Clothing/Pose:
Summer night ivory-colored cool-feeling loungewear. The top is a short camisole-style top with thin straps and delicate lace edges; the top few front buttons are undone, forming a deep V-neckline. The fabric opens naturally and softly, but the exposed parts are elegant and restrained. The bottom consists of matching shorts with ruffles and a thin ribbon tied at the waist. Sitting on the bed in a side-sitting posture close to the original image. The leg on the left side of the screen is bent and extended forward, while the leg on the right side of the screen is deeply bent and folded to the side. The upper body leans slightly forward with shoulders pulled inward. Both arms hang naturally in front of the body, hands gently stacked on the bed surface between the knees. Five fingers on each hand are naturally visible, fingertips relaxed and aligned. Natural indentations and contact shadows are added where the skin, clothing, and bed meet.

Background/Lighting:
A night apartment bedroom. To the left of the screen is a large window and thin curtains; outside is a deep blue night scene, with distant streetlights forming small blurred points of light. To the back right of the screen is a warm-toned bedside lamp and a small potted plant. The bed is covered with light gray sheets and white pillows; the whole room is clean and quiet. Cold blue night light casts in from the window side, outlining the hair and shoulders, while the lamp in the back right casts warm light, softly illuminating the cheeks, collarbone, arms, and clothing fabric. Shadows fall elegantly in front of the bed and at the bottom left of the screen, with the blue and orange light blending naturally.

Composition/Lens:
Vertical 4:5. Close-up indoor portrait from the head to the thighs and tips of the knees. The person is located slightly to the right of the center of the screen, focusing on the hands and upper body. The camera is slightly higher than the bed for a slight high-angle shot, with the line of sight almost level with the eyes. Natural compression feeling close to a medium-long focal length, focusing on the texture of the face, collarbone, hands, and loungewear. The background window, curtains, and lamps are softly blurred, preserving the sense of depth of the night.

Texture/Style:
Realistic photo-style AI image. Night indoor portrait, with a steady texture like a Japanese lifestyle photo. Skin is smooth but not over-retouched, retaining natural texture and color. Detailed depiction of the texture of thin cotton ribbing, lace, ruffles, and ribbons of the clothing. Color tones are mainly ivory, light beige, deep navy blue, and warm lamp colors. Low to medium contrast, soft grain, creating a clean and intimate night atmosphere.

Negative Prompt:
Underage characters, excessive emphasis on sexiness, vulgar exposure, exaggerated breasts, unnatural face or gaze, plastic-like skin, excessive skin retouching, hands not appearing to have five fingers, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused fingers, overly long fingers, deformed joints, twisted wrists, unnatural connection of legs, body floating, insufficient contact shadows with the bed, shadows contradictory to light sources, broken buttons or seams on clothing, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

prompts.text:
主题：
睡前蓝色的房间

人物・表情：
看起来像20多岁后半的成年女性。成熟而沉稳的体型，散发着没有稚气的优雅氛围。皮肤是明亮的象牙米色调的白皙肌肤，带着淡淡的粉色血色，质感光滑细腻。没有过度高光泛白，脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀、锁骨处有柔和的高光，毛孔感适度但不显得像塑料般不自然。脸颊上淡淡的玫瑰粉腮红，眼部是香槟米色与粉棕色的渐层妆效。细长而自然的睫毛，自然的泪袋，明亮的棕色柔和拱形眉毛。嘴唇涂有透亮感的粉米色唇彩，中央自然闪耀。整体脸部妆容是优雅而洁净的精密娃娃风日系妆容。头发是接近黑色的深棕色长发，保留薄薄的刘海和脸部周围的散落发丝。头部微微向左下方倾斜，视线落在手边稍前方。表情宁静而平和，带着入睡前的柔和余韵。

服装・姿势：
夏夜穿着的象牙色系清凉感居家服。上身为短款吊带背心式上衣，细肩带、精致的蕾丝边，前扣上部解开几颗，形成深V领口。布料柔软自然敞开，但露出部分优雅克制。下身为同色系带褶边的短裤，腰部系细丝带。在床上以接近原图的侧坐姿势。画面左侧的腿膝盖弯曲向前伸展，画面右侧的腿膝盖大幅弯曲向侧方折叠。上半身微微前倾，肩膀向内收拢。双臂自然垂于身前，双手在膝盖间的床面上轻轻叠放。双手各有五指自然可见，指尖放松并齐整。皮肤、衣物与床铺的接触处添加自然的凹陷和接触阴影。

背景・光线：
夜晚的公寓卧室。画面左侧是大窗户和薄薄的窗帘，外头是深蓝色的夜景，远处的路灯形成小小的虚化光点。画面右后方有暖色调的床头灯和小盆栽。床铺铺着浅灰色床单和白色枕头，整个房间干净而宁静。窗户侧投射进冷冽的蓝色夜光，勾勒出头发和肩膀的轮廓，右后方的灯投射出温暖的光线，柔和地照亮脸颊、锁骨、手臂和衣物布料。阴影淡雅地落在床前和画面左下方，蓝色与橙色的光线自然融合。

构图・镜头：
纵向4:5。从头部到大腿、膝尖的近距离室内肖像。人物位于画面中央稍偏右，以手部和上半身为焦点。镜头从床铺稍高位置轻微俯拍，视线几乎与眼睛齐平。接近中长焦的自然压缩感，对焦于脸部、锁骨、手部和居家服的质感。背景的窗户、窗帘、灯具柔和虚化，保留夜晚的纵深感。

质感・风格：
逼真的照片风AI图像。夜晚室内肖像，宛如日系生活照般的沉稳质感。皮肤光滑但不过度修饰，保留自然的肌理和血色。衣物的薄棉质罗纹、蕾丝、褶边、丝带的质感细致描绘。色调以象牙色、浅米色、深海军蓝、温暖的灯光色为主。低至中对比度，柔和的颗粒感，营造洁净而亲密的夜晚氛围。

负面提示：
看起来像未成年的人物、过度的性感强调、下流的露出、过分的胸部夸张、不自然的臉部或视线、像塑料般的皮肤、过度的美肌修饰、双手不像有五指、额外的指头、缺失的指头、融合的指头、过长的指头、关节变形、手腕扭曲、腿部不自然的连接、身体浮空、与床铺接触阴影不足、与光源矛盾的阴影、衣物纽扣或缝合线破损、文字乱码、标志、水印。

prompts.text:
Create a premium advertising poster for [BRAND] featuring [PRODUCT].

Use the brand’s logo, icon, letterform, label shape, packaging frame, or signature silhouette as a true negative-space frame.

Build a cinematic visual world inside that negative-space shape that expresses the product’s story, emotion, origin, texture, function, craft, flavor, scent, sound, or brand promise.

The outside canvas must stay clean, minimal, elegant, and controlled.

The inside of the shape must feel rich, atmospheric, detailed, and visually immersive.

The hero product must not be trapped inside the frame.

Make the product break out of the negative-space boundary in a premium, intentional way:
part of the product stays inside the visual world, while part of it extends beyond the frame into the clean outer space.

This frame-breaking moment should create depth, tension, hierarchy, and a strong campaign-level visual hook.

The negative space must feel literal and professional — not just a simple image mask. The silhouette should clearly shape the composition, while the product interacts with it naturally and powerfully.

Adapt the execution to the brand DNA:
- tech should feel clean, precise, futuristic, and intelligent
- fragrance and beauty should feel elegant, sensual, refined, and atmospheric
- food should feel rich, appetizing, textured, and indulgent
- fashion should feel editorial, stylish, cultural, and dynamic
- audio should feel immersive, energetic, tactile, and cinematic
- luxury should feel restrained, polished, timeless, and expensive

Use premium commercial photography, cinematic lighting, refined typography, strong contrast, polished shadows, realistic materials, sharp product detail, high-end composition, and world-class ad finishing.

Add tasteful poster typography inspired by the brand’s visual language with a short 3-word slogan.

Do not use miniature people, tiny worlds, micro cities, product monuments, or exploded-view composition.

Avoid copying any existing real campaign. Create a fresh original negative-space advertisement.

prompts.text:
You are an image generation director.

Style name:
Civic Wax Realism

Style definition:
Create one photorealistic image of an original adult woman who looks like a real person, a wax figure, and a public statue at the same time. The subject belongs to an ordinary civic environment: city hall, registry office, permit counter, public clinic, court corridor, tax office, transport bureau, municipal waiting room, public archive, passport office, or government service desk.

Core visual law:
The woman appears alive, but too still.
Her skin appears human, but sealed.
Her clothing appears normal, but institutional.
The location appears public, functional, and indifferent.
The photograph appears factual, not dramatic.

The image must feel like a municipal record, an identification photo taken outside its proper system, or a public archive snapshot of someone who should not move.

Subject:
The subject is an adult woman aged 30 or older.
She must look like a specific individual, not a model and not a fantasy character.
She may be a clerk, applicant, witness, inspector, archivist, nurse, registrar, translator, civil servant, court employee, records worker, public health officer, or silent visitor.

Face design:
The face is the main design element.
Use a controlled, fixed expression.
Use still eyes, heavy eyelids, flat affect, compressed facial planes, stiff cheeks, sealed skin, faint pores under waxy shine, powdery makeup, old lipstick, uneven foundation, facial asymmetry, small cracks in texture, age marks, under eye fatigue, rigid mouth, or statue like calm.

The face should not look dead.
The face should not look animated.
It should occupy the narrow space between living person, wax figure, and civic monument.

The face must remain photorealistic.
Avoid cartoon exaggeration.
Avoid horror monster features.
Avoid gore.
Avoid glamour beauty.
Avoid influencer features.
Avoid polished fashion skin.

Body:
Use an adult female body with ordinary physical weight.
The posture should be upright, seated, waiting, standing in line, holding documents, leaning near a counter, sitting beneath fluorescent light, or facing the camera with bureaucratic stillness.
The body should feel constrained by the setting.
No fashion posing.
No heroic posing.
No sexualized posing.
No theatrical gesture.

Wardrobe:
Clothing must feel ordinary, official, or civic.
Use plain blouses, cardigans, office jackets, municipal uniforms, pencil skirts, slacks, low heels, practical shoes, ID lanyards, name badges, cheap jewelry, tired formalwear, public service vests, hospital cardigans, file clerk clothing, or weathered coats.

Fabric should look real:
creased, stiff, polyester, faded, slightly shiny, poorly fitted, overwashed, worn at cuffs, buttoned too tightly, or practical without style.

Photography:
Photorealistic only.
Use direct on camera flash or hard institutional flash.
Use flat frontal light.
Use fluorescent spill from the room.
Use dull color.
Use mild lens distortion.
Use visible skin shine.
Use underexposed corners.
Use hard shadows behind the subject.
Use imperfect framing.
Use documentarian stillness.
Use the visual character of old compact cameras, public record photography, office snapshots, or local newspaper archive photos.

Do not use cinematic lighting.
Do not use dramatic horror lighting.
Do not use fashion editorial lighting.
Do not use soft beauty lighting.
Do not use painterly effects.
Do not use anime.
Do not use illustration.
Do not use CGI.
Do not use luxury portrait style.

Environment:
The location must be ordinary, public, and administrative.
It should look used, cheap, and functional.

Suitable details:
plastic chairs, ticket number machines, service counters, old computers, laminated notices, public forms, clipboards, file boxes, fluorescent ceiling panels, worn linoleum, beige walls, faded posters, metal cabinets, document trays, queue barriers, wall clocks, public health signs, stamped papers, blue pens on chains, glass partitions, waiting area plants, security cameras, old elevators, scratched counters, and institutional signage.

Composition:
The woman is the main figure.
The camera should be close enough to read the face, but not intimate.
The frame should feel like a record, not a portrait session.
The background should remain ordinary and unstyled.
The subject should appear as if she was found inside the institution rather than arranged for the image.

Mood:
Bureaucratic.
Still.
Public.
Artificial.
Human.
Uncomfortable.
Dry.
Matter of fact.

Final formula:
An original adult woman with a wax sealed civic face, ordinary institutional clothing, and rigid public stillness, photographed with hard flash inside a mundane government or public service environment.

prompts.text:
你是一位图像生成导演。

风格名称：
市政蜡像现实主义 (Civic Wax Realism)

风格定义：
创作一张原创成年女性的写实图像，她看起来既像真人，又像蜡像，同时还像公共雕像。主体属于普通的市政环境：市政厅、登记处、许可证窗口、公立诊所、法院走廊、税务局、交通局、市政候车室、公共档案馆、护照办公室或政府服务台。

核心视觉规律：
女人看起来是活着的，但过于静止。
她的皮肤看起来像人类，但被密封了。
她的衣服看起来很普通，但是制度化的。
地点看起来是公共的、功能性的且冷漠的。
照片看起来是事实性的，而不是戏剧性的。

图像必须感觉像是一份市政记录，一张在其正规系统之外拍摄的身份照片，或者是一张不应移动的人的公共档案快照。

主体：
主体是一名 30 岁或以上的成年女性。
她必须看起来像一个具体的个人，而不是模特，也不是幻想角色。
她可能是一名办事员、申请人、证人、检查员、档案管理员、护士、登记员、翻译、公务员、法院员工、记录工作人员、公共卫生官员或沉默的访客。

面部设计：
面部是主要的设计元素。
使用受控的、固定的表情。
使用静止的眼睛、沉重的眼睑、平淡的情感、压缩的面部平面、僵硬的双颊、密封的皮肤、蜡质光泽下的细微毛孔、粉状妆容、旧口红、不均匀的底妆、面部不对称、纹理中的微小裂缝、年龄标记、眼下疲劳、僵硬的嘴部或雕像般的冷静。

面部不应看起来像死人。
面部不应看起来有动画感。
它应该占据活人、蜡像和市政纪念碑之间的狭窄空间。

面部必须保持照相写实主义。
避免卡通夸张。
避免恐怖怪物特征。
避免血腥。
避免魅力之美。
避免网红特征。
避免抛光的时尚皮肤。

身体：
使用具有普通体重的成年女性身体。
姿势应为笔直、坐着、等待、排队、拿着文件、靠在柜台附近、坐在荧光灯下或以官僚式的静止面对镜头。
身体应该感到受环境限制。
没有时尚摆拍。
没有英雄式摆拍。
没有性化摆拍。
没有剧场式动作。

衣橱：
服装必须感觉普通、正式或市政化。
使用素色衬衫、开衫、办公室夹克、市政制服、铅笔裙、休闲裤、低跟鞋、实用鞋、身份证挂绳、名牌、廉价珠宝、疲惫的正装、公共服务背心、医院开衫、文件员服装或风化的外套。

织物看起来应该真实：
有褶皱、僵硬、涤纶、褪色、略带光泽、不合身、洗涤过度、袖口磨损、扣子扣得太紧或没有风格的实用性。

摄影：
仅限照相写实主义。
使用直接的机载闪光灯或硬质的机构闪光灯。
使用平面的正面光。
使用来自房间的荧光灯溢出。
使用暗淡的色彩。
使用轻微的镜头畸变。
使用可见的皮肤油光。
使用曝光不足的角落。
在主体后面使用硬阴影。
使用不完美的构图。
使用纪录片式的静止感。
使用旧便携式相机、公共记录摄影、办公室快照或当地报纸档案照片的视觉特征。

不要使用电影照明。
不要使用戏剧性的恐怖照明。
不要使用时尚社论照明。
不要使用柔和的美颜照明。
不要使用绘画效果。
不要使用动漫。
不要使用插画。
不要使用 CGI。
不要使用奢侈肖像风格。

环境：
地点必须是普通的、公共的和行政的。
它应该看起来是用过的、廉价的且功能性的。

合适的细节：
塑料椅、排号机、服务台、旧电脑、塑封通知、公共表格、写字板、文件箱、荧光天花板板块、磨损的亚麻油地毡、米色墙壁、褪色的海报、金属柜、公文盘、排队护栏、挂钟、公共卫生标志、盖章文件、链条上的蓝笔、玻璃隔断、休息区植物、监控摄像头、旧电梯、划伤的柜台和机构标牌。

构图：
女性是主要人物。
摄像机应该足够近以看清面部，但不具亲密感。
画面应该感觉像是一份记录，而不是一场人像拍摄。
背景应保持普通且未经过风格化处理。
主体应该看起来像是被发现存在于机构内部，而不是为了图像而特意安排的。

Mood：
官僚的。
静止的。
公共的。
人造的。
人类的。
不舒服的。
干燥的。
实事求是的。

最终公式：
一名拥有蜡封市政面部、普通机构服装和僵硬公共静止感的原创成年女性，在平庸的政府或公共服务环境中使用硬闪光拍摄。

items.title: 韩系时尚杂志风粉色短发女性肖像

prompts.text:
9:16 vertical composition, high-end Korean fashion magazine studio portrait, CCD soft-focus texture, dreamy haze, strong highlight bloom, halo glow, fine film grain, slightly overexposed highlights, creamy warm tones, shallow depth of field.

Minimalist private studio setup with an ivory / off-white seamless backdrop. Soft draped fabric in the background. Diffused studio lighting with a soft side key light and subtle backlight outlining the hair strands. Skin appears luminous and glowing. Overall mood is quiet, expensive, intimate, restrained, and slightly ambiguous.

A young adult Taiwanese woman with a short pastel pink bob, airy and slightly messy, with an idol-like presence.

Her aura is cold, confident, “bad girl / cool boss girl,” with strong control but a subtle emotional crack. Chin slightly lifted, eyes looking directly into the camera but slightly out of focus. Expression restrained, cold, slightly tired, and faintly dangerous. Lips slightly parted, as if she just took a deep breath.

Pose: close-up / chest-up framing. No “shh” gesture. She is slightly side-seated or gently leaning back, body subtly leaning forward. One hand softly touches the neck or collarbone. The other hand hangs naturally or lightly holds fabric slipping off the shoulder. Head slightly tilted, asymmetrical shoulder line, creating an elegant loosened tension—like the final 0.5 second before a composed persona breaks.

Makeup: Korean glass skin makeup with dewy base, soft peach-pink blush, clean straight brows, fine brown eyeliner, separated lashes, subtle aegyo-sal highlight, soft nose highlight. Lips are the focal point: Korean gradient bitten lip, glossy wet finish, slightly blurred lip edges suggesting emotional instability.

Outfit: high-end studio lingerie / sleepwear-inspired styling, ivory silk camisole or soft silky robe slipping off one shoulder, thin straps, smooth reflective fabric. Sensual but tasteful, editorial fashion aesthetic, not explicit.

Lens language: 85mm portrait look, sharp focus on eyes and lips, blurred background, realistic skin detail, magazine cover style.

Mood keywords: cold breakdown, fragile control, quiet danger, emotional fracture, luxury intimacy, cinematic, Korean editorial fashion.

prompts.text:
9:16 垂直构图，高端韩国时尚杂志影棚肖像，CCD 柔焦质感，梦幻薄雾，强烈的亮部晕染，光晕，细腻的胶片颗粒，略微过曝的高光，奶油色暖色调，浅景深。

极简私人影棚布置，配有象牙色/奶白色无缝背景。背景中有柔软的褶皱织物。漫反射影棚照明，带有柔软的侧面主光和勾勒发丝的微妙背光。皮肤看起来通透发光。整体氛围安静、昂贵、亲密、克制且略显模糊。

一位年轻的台湾女性，留着浅粉色短波波头，蓬松且略显凌乱，具有偶像般的存在感。

她的气场冷酷、自信，“坏女孩/酷飒女老板”，控制力强但带有微妙的情绪裂痕。下巴微扬，眼睛直视镜头，但略微失焦。表情克制、冷淡、略显疲惫，且透着淡淡的危险感。嘴唇微张，仿佛刚刚深呼吸。

姿势：特写/胸部以上构图。没有“嘘”的手势。她微侧坐或轻轻向后靠，身体微妙地前倾。一只手轻轻触摸脖子或锁骨。另一只手自然下垂或轻抓从肩膀滑落的织物。头微偏，不对称的肩线，营造出一种优雅的松弛感——就像冷静面具破碎前的最后 0.5 秒。

妆容：韩系水光肌妆容，底妆清透，柔和的蜜桃粉色腮红，干净的平眉，细长的棕色眼线，根根分明的睫毛，微妙的卧蚕高光，柔和的鼻梁高光。嘴唇是焦点：韩系渐变咬唇妆，水光湿润质感，略微模糊的唇缘暗示情绪的不稳定。

服装：高端影棚内衣/睡衣灵感造型，象牙色丝绸吊带裙或从一侧肩膀滑落的柔软丝绸长袍，细吊带，平滑反光的面料。感性但高级，编辑时尚美学，非露骨。

镜头语言：85mm 肖像感，眼睛和嘴唇对焦清晰，背景模糊，真实的皮肤细节，杂志封面风格。

氛围关键词：冰冷崩溃，脆弱的控制，安静的危险，情绪裂痕，奢华亲密感，电影感，韩国编辑时尚。

prompts.text: A surreal doll-like young woman with waist-length flowing hair, captured in a realistic candid portrait with a soft everyday charm. She appears shy yet connected with the camera, gently feeling the breeze as strands of hair move naturally around her face. Ethereal beauty with porcelain-cool skin, a delicate oval face, pointed chin, and fair complexion. Shot in a spontaneous snapshot style with a slightly tilted frame, low-angle perspective, and ultra-wide lens for a dynamic composition. Soft white pastel tones mixed with subtle silver hues, cinematic side lighting outlining her silhouette, translucent light leaks, and dreamy overlays create a nostalgic atmosphere. Inspired by Japanese summer aesthetics, featuring dappled tree shadows, gentle motion blur, soft grain, faded contrast, cool indigo undertones, expired film colors, low saturation, natural makeup, delicate clothing textures, and an artistic, cinematic film look with a dreamy and expressive mood.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text: 一个超现实的人偶般的年轻女子，留着及腰的飘逸长发，以写实、抓拍的肖像风格捕捉，散发着柔和的日常魅力。她显得羞涩却又与镜头有交流，轻轻感受着微风，发丝在脸庞周围自然飘动。空灵之美，拥有如瓷器般冰冷的肌肤，精致的鹅蛋脸，尖下巴，肤色白皙。采用自发的快照风格拍摄，构图略微倾斜，低角度透视，并使用超广角镜头营造动态构图。柔和的白色调与微妙的银色调混合，电影感的侧面光勾勒出她的轮廓，半透明的漏光和梦幻的叠加营造出怀旧的氛围。灵感源自日本夏季美学，具有斑驳的树影、柔和的运动模糊、细微的颗粒、褪色的对比度、冷靛蓝底色、过期胶卷色彩、低饱和度、自然妆容、精致的衣物纹理，以及带有梦幻和表现力情绪的艺术化电影胶片感。

items.title: 力量之道顶级摩托车工业美学视觉大片

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-premium global motorcycle campaign titled:

THE WAY OF POWER

This is not a conventional motorcycle advertisement.

It should feel like a collector's edition fashion editorial, luxury automotive campaign, Japanese design exhibition, and modern samurai manifesto merged into one iconic image. Every detail should communicate timeless craftsmanship, restraint, precision, and engineering obsession.

---

SCENE

The composition is set during golden hour beneath the massive freeway overpasses of downtown Los Angeles.

The sun sits low on the horizon, flooding the concrete architecture with rich amber light. Long shadows stretch across rain-soaked asphalt while the last puddles from a recent shower reflect the motorcycle like polished bronze mirrors.

The concrete bridges glow with warm sunlight while distant glass skyscrapers shimmer softly against a clear sky.

The atmosphere feels calm after movement—not busy, but alive.

Small pockets of steam rise from drainage grates.

The wet pavement reflects warm sunlight, freeway columns, and the motorcycle with museum-quality realism.

---

THE MOTORCYCLE

At the center stands an original Japanese-inspired superbike—not a replica of any existing manufacturer.

It should embody the philosophy of Japanese engineering:

razor-sharp aerodynamic bodywork

exposed titanium hardware

forged aluminum frame

visible carbon fiber weave

CNC-machined rearsets

sculpted swingarm

premium Öhlins-style suspension

precision brake calipers

titanium exhaust

subtle aerodynamic winglets

intricate radiator fins

perfectly tensioned chain

realistic bolts, welds, fasteners and mechanical components

Every surface should contain tiny rain droplets illuminated by the warm sunset.

The motorcycle is angled slightly toward the viewer in a heroic three-quarter perspective.

The LED headlights remain on, creating a cool white contrast against the warm environment.

It should feel less like transportation and more like industrial sculpture.

---

THE RIDER

Standing beside the motorcycle is a confident rider wearing:

matte black premium riding suit

minimalist tailoring

subtle Japanese fashion influence

no oversized racing branding

premium leather gloves

modern riding boots

The rider removes one glove while the opposite hand gently rests on the fuel tank.

Expression:

calm

focused

disciplined

earned confidence

No aggressive stance.

No exaggerated posing.

The motorcycle should appear to be an extension of the rider rather than something they own.

---

ENVIRONMENT

Blend Los Angeles infrastructure with subtle Japanese philosophy.

Include:

towering freeway pillars

industrial steel

graffiti walls

weathered concrete

reflective puddles

golden sunlight

soft atmospheric haze

distant downtown skyline

Warm sunbeams pass between the overpasses creating cinematic shafts of light.

Japanese philosophy quietly emerges through graphic design.

Subtle sumi ink textures dissolve into drifting mist.

Engineering sketches fade into the air.

Brush calligraphy appears naturally integrated into walls and atmosphere.

Nothing should feel pasted on.

Everything should feel physically present.

---

TYPOGRAPHY

Typography is an architectural element.

Not an overlay.

Massive distressed condensed typography is integrated behind the motorcycle, partially hidden by architecture, reflections and light.

Hero headline:

MADE TO OUTLAST THE ROAD.

Secondary typography:

DISCIPLINE.

PRECISION.

NO COMPROMISE.

CRAFTED FOR THOSE WHO NEVER SETTLE.

ENGINEERED IN JAPAN.

CONQUERING AMERICA.

Typography materials:

weathered paint

aged steel

distressed ink

industrial wear

subtle embossing

soft transparency

sun-faded textures

warm metallic reflections

Letters interact naturally with sunlight, architecture and reflections.
prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
创建一场名为：

力量之道 (THE WAY OF POWER)

的全球超顶级摩托车广告活动。

这不只是一则常规的摩托车广告。

它应该感觉像是收藏版时尚社论、豪华汽车广告、日本设计展和现代武士宣言的合而为一，形成一个标志性的图像。每一个细节都应传达永恒的工艺、克制、精准和对工程的痴迷。

---

场景

构图设定在洛杉矶市中心宏伟的高速公路立交桥下的黄金时段。

太阳低挂在水平线上，浓郁的琥珀色光芒洒在混凝土建筑上。长长的影子延伸在被雨水浸湿的沥青路面上，而最近一场阵雨留下的最后几处积水像抛光的青铜镜一样反射着摩托车。

混凝土桥梁在温暖的阳光下闪耀，远处玻璃幕墙的摩天大楼在晴朗的天空下柔和地闪烁。

大气层感觉像是在运动后的宁静——并不繁忙，但充满生机。

排水格栅升起一缕缕细小的蒸汽。

湿滑的路面以博物馆级的写实感反射着温暖的阳光、高速公路立柱和摩托车。

---

摩托车

中心位置停放着一辆原创的日系风格超级跑车——并非任何现有制造商的复制品。

它应体现日本工程哲学：

锋利的空气动力学车身

外露的钛合金硬件

锻造铝合金车架

可见的碳纤维编织

CNC加工的后脚踏

雕刻感的摇臂

高级 Öhlins 风格悬挂

精密刹车卡钳

钛合金排气管

微妙的空气动力学小翼

复杂的散热片

张紧完美的链条

真实的螺栓、焊缝、紧固件和机械部件

每一个表面都应包含被温暖落日照亮的细小雨滴。

摩托车稍微朝向观众，呈英雄式的四分之三透视角度。

LED 大灯保持开启，在温暖的环境中创造出冷白色的对比。

它应该感觉不像交通工具，而更像工业雕塑。

---

骑手

站在摩托车旁的是一位自信的骑手，穿着：

哑光黑色高级骑行服

极简剪裁

微妙的日本时尚影响

没有夸张的赛车品牌标志

高级皮革手套

现代骑行靴

骑手摘下一只手套，另一只手轻轻搭在油箱上。

表情：

冷静

专注

自律

赢得的自信

没有挑衅姿态。

没有夸张的造型。

prompts.text:
Create a vertical 3:4 Korean-style minimalist collage photo poster on a light paper-textured background. The overall aesthetic should feel like a trendy Instagram lifestyle magazine page with clean composition, soft lighting, plenty of negative space, and a subtle Korean editorial mood.

Use the reference person as the main subject. Place one large selfie facing the camera as the centerpiece and largest image in the composition. The expression should be playful, relaxed, and natural, with a Japanese/Korean magazine-inspired vibe.

Surround the main image with exactly 8 smaller photos of the same person, all clearly smaller than the main image. Each photo should show a different pose and perspective:

* Hand reaching toward the camera
* Wink close-up
* Side profile portrait
* Overhead bird’s-eye-view shot
* Face-cupping headshot
* Natural standing pose
* Candid walking shot
* Looking back with a side glance

All photos must preserve the same facial identity and appearance as the reference image. Every image should have a unique pose, framing, gaze direction, and expression. The mood should feel candid, relaxed, innocent, playful, and naturally expressive, with a mix of soft smiles and quiet moments.

Arrange the smaller photos with slight rotations, overlapping layers, offset positioning, thin white borders, and subtle shadows. The layout should feel like organized chaos; fashionable, casual, asymmetrical, and journal-like while remaining balanced and breathable.

Outfit throughout all photos: simple white top and blue jeans, no accessories.

Color grading should use a soft light-blue palette with low saturation, gentle contrast, and a subtle Korean-film filter look.

Add sparse hand-drawn doodle elements around the collage, including wavy lines, circles, arrows, small stars, and tiny hearts. Decorations should feel natural and minimal, never cluttered.

Maintain perfect anatomy and body proportions in every image. Hands, fingers, limbs, and facial features must appear realistic and undistorted.

Negative requirements:

* Exactly 8 small photos only
* Main image must remain the largest element
* No symmetrical layout
* No duplicated poses or expressions
* No distorted anatomy
* No extra, missing, or deformed fingers
* No missing body parts
* No stiff or unnatural poses
* No cluttered decorations
* No text, letters, words, logos, captions, or numbers anywhere in the image.

prompts.text:
[Character] Image 1 [Signature] A small Meta-operated Threads logo is placed in the bottom right corner, with the signature-like "CHAse" written in small white handwritten script above it. 

[Character's Pose and Expression] Propped up on the edge of a cool emerald pool with both hands, as if hesitating to emerge from the water, pushing the pool bottom with palms, with thighs exposed above the water surface, staring at the camera in a seductive pose. The head is tilted slightly back, elegantly displaying the jawline and neck curves, with half-open lips and a haughty yet charming gaze, exuding the overwhelming charm characteristic of high-end fashion magazine covers. The character's upper body is oriented 90 degrees toward the left side of the frame.

[Character's Clothing] Wearing a classic yet bold charcoal black high-end dress with a deep V-neck slit. The upper part is decorated with exquisite three-dimensional silver bead embroidery details, finely crafted, while the skirt part consists of voluminous and heavy black feather decorations that appear slightly wet, perfectly interpreting a luxurious summer glamour look.

[Character's Hair and Makeup Details] Smooth wet hair combed straight back as if just coming out of the pool (wet hair styling). Makeup is based on brown smoky eye makeup that emphasizes deep and soft eyes, paired with a calm matte nude-beige lipstick. Adorned with ornate long silver drop earrings reminiscent of lizards or chains, and a chunky chain silver necklace around the neck, adding sparkling highlights.

[Lighting and Light Direction] Artificial soft lighting like a professional pictorial shoot, with light gently falling on the left cheek and a relatively strong shadow forming on the right cheek. The shimmer of the pool water surface and sunlight create smooth highlights on the character's right shoulder, collarbone, and cheeks, clearly highlighting a healthy and elastic skin texture.

[Texture and Tone Atmosphere] The cool turquoise blue of the pool water, the heavy dark tones of the dress, and the strong red of the magazine title form a perfect visual contrast. The metallic texture of the sparkling bead embroidery, the soft texture of the feathers, and the transparent quality of the water rippling in the sunlight blend together to create a sophisticated high-end resort pictorial atmosphere.

[Film and Lens Depth of Field, Angle] Shot using an aperture of f/2.8, shutter speed of 1/1000 second, ISO 100, and a 50mm standard prime lens. To capture the most attractive silhouette of the character sitting on the pool deck, a medium shot composition from eye-level height at a slight side angle. The character's face and the front of the clothing are in razor-sharp focus, while the rippling water surface in the background is softly blurred, giving the character a sense of complete immersion.

[Background Elements (Optional)] The background consists of a grey stone pool deck with a delicate textured surface and an emerald pool water surface shimmering bright white in the sunlight. To match the magazine layout, a large red bold "BLANC" logo is placed at the top without obscuring the character's face, layered behind the face. Sophisticated white and red fashion typography combining Greek and English such as "CHASE", "WHAT'S SEXY NOW" are sensually overlaid in the left and right spaces.

prompts.text:
[人物] 图像 1 [签名] 右下角有 Meta 运营的 Threads 标志小巧地放置着，其上方以白色手写体小字写着像签名一样的“CHAse”。  

[人物的姿势及表情]  
在清凉的翡翠色泳池边缘双手撑着，仿佛要从水中浮起又犹豫不决，用手掌推着池底，大腿直到水面外露的状态，凝视着镜头的妖娆姿势。高头微微后仰，优雅地展现出下巴线条和颈部曲线，半张开的嘴唇以及高傲却又迷人的眼神，散发着高级时尚杂志封面特有的压倒性魅力。人物的上半身朝框架左侧90度方向。  

[人物服装]  
穿着经典却大胆的胸前深V开叉的炭黑色高级感礼服。上身饰有精致立体的银色珠绣细节，精细绣制而成，裙部则由略微湿润般丰盈厚重的黑色羽毛装饰构成，完美诠释奢华的夏日魅力造型。  

[人物发型及妆容细节]  
仿佛刚从泳池中出来般，水湿后整齐向后梳拢的顺滑湿发（湿发造型）。妆容以强调眼部深邃柔和的棕色烟熏眼妆为基础，嘴唇搭配沉稳哑光的裸色米色调唇膏。耳朵上戴着令人联想到蜥蜴或链条的华丽长款银色水滴耳坠，脖子上佩戴粗犷链式银色项链，增添闪耀的亮点。  

[照明及光线方向]  
如同专业画报拍摄般的人工柔和光线，人物左侧脸颊微微洒落光线，而右侧脸颊则相对形成强烈的阴影。泳池水面反射的粼光和阳光在人物右侧肩膀、锁骨以及脸颊上营造出平滑的高光，清晰凸显健康富有弹性的肌肤质感。  

[质感与色调氛围]  
泳池水色的清凉青绿色（Turquoise Blue）与礼服的厚重深色调，以及杂志标题的强烈红色（Red），在视觉上形成完美的对比。闪耀珠绣的金属质感、羽毛的柔软纹理，以及阳光下荡漾的水的透明质感交织融合，营造出精致高端的度假画报氛围。  

[胶片及镜头景深、角度]  
使用光圈 f/2.8、快门速度 1/1000 秒、ISO 100、焦距 50mm 标准定焦镜头拍摄。人物坐在泳池平台（Deck）上最具魅力的造型轮廓，为了最吸引人地捕捉，从眼平高度略微侧面拍摄的中景构图。人物的面部和服装正面锐利如刀刃般清晰对焦，而后方荡漾的水面涟漪则柔和地虚化处理，赋予人物完整的沉浸感。  

[背景元素（可选）]  
背景由带有细腻凹凸质感的灰色石质泳池平台，以及阳光下白亮闪烁的翡翠色泳池水面构成。为匹配杂志布局，上方以大型红色粗体字体放置“BLANC”标志，且不遮挡人物脸部，在脸部后方分层布置。左右侧空间感性地叠加了“CHASE”、“WHAT'S SEXY NOW”等希腊语与英文结合的精致白色及红色时尚排版文字。

冲绳明亮的白沙海滩。人物漂浮在离海稍远的沙滩一侧。远处是透明度极高的碧青色海洋、白色的浪花边缘、岩石区、南国浓郁的绿色、低矮的度假建筑，以及远方的海岸线。背景中自然配置海边漫步的游客、游泳的人、遮阳伞、救生员台等元素，以不干扰主角为度进行轻微模糊。正午强烈的阳光从画面左上方斜射，照亮肩膀、腹部和腿部上侧。影子从人物正下方略向左下方投落，沿沙子的凹凸形成浓淡有致的真实感影子。海面反射光线使肌肤的阴影不过于生硬，沙子的白皙将整体笼罩在明亮中。

构图・镜头：
纵向构图。人物大体置于画面下半部至中央右侧，全身可见的中宽幅镜头。镜头从靠近沙滩的低位拍摄，以略微俯视的自然角度。人物的漂浮感和影子距离清晰传达，身体与沙子之间留出空间。背景海岸线进入上半部，形成有深度的海滩照片。焦点在人物的脸部至上半身，背景轻微虚化，但保留冲绳特色的海洋色彩和游客的存在感。

质感・风格：
逼真的照片风格。细致描绘夏日强烈的日照、白沙的细小颗粒、肌肤的自然光泽、比基尼布料的张力、头发的束感，以及落于沙上的影子。色彩采用明亮透明的南国调性。碧蓝海洋、白沙、浅粉色泳装清爽协调。不施加过度美肌修饰或AI式的均匀肌肤，保留自然的油光和柔和阴影。

负面提示：
不自然的五官或视线、多余或缺失的手指、手指融合、手腕或肘部的破损、身体过度扭曲、漂浮感不足、看起来像接触沙子的身体、无影子、影子方向与光源矛盾、腰间的丝巾或纱笼、多余布料、过度性感的姿势、不自然夸张的体型、塑料般的肌肤、过度过曝的肌肤、文字乱码、标志、水印。

items.title: 高级中文人物拼贴艺术海报

prompts.text: Generate a vertical 3:4 Chinese character collage concept poster, which must be a finished poster with completed Chinese typography. The overall style is: high-end character poster, paper collage, emotional reorganization, editorial design, Chinese typography, art poster, soft realistic portrait, material collage, quiet but with visual tension. The main subject of the image is a half-body portrait of a young woman with clear facial features and emotional eyes, avoiding a common photoshoot or influencer look. The portrait needs to be deconstructed and collaged: parts of the face, hair, shoulders, neck, or body covered, displaced, obscured, and overlapped by fragments of different materials, then reorganized into a complete but slightly fragmented portrait. Collage materials can include: torn paper, old photos, film negatives, transparent glass pieces, handwritten notes, letter paper, stamps, pressed flower specimens, botanical pressings, broken mirrors, blueprint paper, data glitch blocks, pages in the wind, old newspapers, tape, clips, needles and pins. The image is not a messy collage but has a clear design order: the main subject is centered or slightly off-center; the main Chinese title is clear and eye-catching; auxiliary text is restrained and distributed; paper and text naturally blend into the character's structure; the background is simple with white space; overall it looks like a high-end magazine cover or an art exhibition poster. Chinese typography requirements: Main title says "【主标题】"; Subtitle says "【副标题】"; Include 2-4 short Chinese copy sentences, which can look like handwritten notes, corner annotations, vertical small text, or poster descriptions. The text must be clear, no gibberish, no typos. If dates are involved, use "当日" or "【当日日期】", do not write old years. Atmosphere: fragmented, reorganized, quiet, emotional, memory, time, farewell, self-healing, soft but powerful. Do not: no cheap collage templates, no e-commerce posters, no excessive cyber elements, no exaggerated special effects, no watermarks, no real brand logos, no gibberish, no old dates.

画面主体是一位年轻女性半身肖像，人物五官清晰，眼神有情绪，不要普通写真感，不要网红感。人物肖像需要被重新解构和拼贴：脸部、头发、肩颈或身体局部被不同材质的碎片覆盖、错位、遮挡、重叠，再重新组合成一个完整但略带破碎感的人像。

拼贴材质可以是：
撕裂纸片、旧照片、胶片底片、透明玻璃片、手写便签、信纸、邮票、花瓣标本、植物压花、破碎镜面、蓝图纸、数据故障块、风中纸页、旧报纸、胶带、夹子、针钉。

如果涉及日期，使用「当日」或「【当日日期】」，不要写旧年份。

画面气质：
破碎、重组、安静、情绪、记忆、时间、告别、自我修复、柔软但有力量。

不要：

items.title: 简约黑色笔触手绘旅游插画提示词

prompts.text: Create a charming editorial travel illustration of {DESTINATION} in a simple hand-drawn doodled style, as if sketched by hand with a black felt-tip marker in a travel notebook. The illustration should feel personal, spontaneous, and imperfect rather than digitally designed. Think of the kind of drawing someone might casually create while sitting at a café after exploring the destination.** ## COLOR PALETTE Keep the illustration almost entirely black and white. Use **only one accent color: {ONE POINT COLOR}** ## STYLE Draw entirely with black felt-tip pen lines. Use slightly wobbly hand-drawn contours, natural line variation, loose marker strokes, sketch-like confidence, subtle imperfections, slightly open line endings, uneven hand pressure, and occasional overlapping strokes. Every line should clearly look handmade. Avoid perfectly smooth curves, mechanically precise outlines, polished vector graphics, or overly crisp digital rendering. ## SUBJECT Illustrate the unique atmosphere and instantly recognizable identity of **{DESTINATION}** rather than producing a realistic cityscape. Select the destination's most iconic landmarks, characteristic architecture, local transportation, famous scenery, native plants, local animals, regional food, and cultural objects. Focus on the spirit of the destination instead of literal accuracy. ## COMPOSITION Arrange the selected elements into a balanced editorial composition with generous white space. The layout should feel open, light, and effortless, similar to a designer's travel sketchbook. Allow objects to overlap naturally without becoming crowded. Every element should have room to breathe. Keep the composition visually relaxed and uncluttered. Apply the blue sparingly to selected details such as water, sky, windows, signs, clothing accents, decorative highlights, or small architectural features. Never introduce any additional colors. ## DRAWING STYLE Keep every object simple and intentionally simplified. Use flat shapes with minimal interior detail. Avoid realistic textures, gradients, shadows, painterly brushwork, glossy surfaces, or complex rendering. The illustration should remain clean, airy, understated, and highly graphic. ## LINE QUALITY The black marker lines are the main visual feature. Lines should feel confident, casual, lively, expressive, and naturally imperfect. Slightly uneven contours, open edges, variable line thickness, and small drawing inaccuracies are encouraged because they enhance the authentic hand-drawn feeling. ## MOOD Warm. Friendly. Relaxed. Playful. Minimal. Editorial. Contemporary. Elegant through simplicity. The finished artwork should resemble a beautifully designed travel notebook, boutique travel guide, editorial magazine illustration, or lifestyle sketchbook rather than a polished digital illustration. ## IMPORTANT No photorealism. No 3D rendering. No painterly effects. No gradients. No heavy shadows. No glossy lighting. No vector-clean artwork. No excessive detail. No busy composition. Preserve generous white space. Maintain a flat editorial doodle aesthetic with a distinctly handmade character. The final image should instantly evoke **{DESTINATION}** through simple, expressive black felt-tip sketches with subtle sky-blue accents.

prompts.text: 为{DESTINATION}创作一个迷人的编辑风格旅游插画，采用简约的手绘涂鸦风格，就像是在旅行笔记本中用黑色毡尖笔手绘而成的。插画应该感觉非常私人、自发且不完美，而不是数字设计的。想象一下，有人在游览完目的地后坐在咖啡馆里随手创作的那种绘画。## 色彩组合 保持插画几乎完全是黑白的。仅使用一种强调色：{ONE POINT COLOR} ## 风格 完全使用黑色毡尖笔线条绘制。使用略微摇晃的手绘轮廓、自然的线条变化、松散的马克笔笔触、素描般的自信、微妙的不完美、稍微开口的线条末端、不均匀的手部压力以及偶尔重叠的笔触。每一根线条都应该清晰地看起来是手工制作的。避免完美的平滑曲线、机械精确的轮廓、精致的矢量图形或过于清晰的数字渲染。 ## 主题 描绘{DESTINATION}独特的氛围和极具辨识度的身份，而不是制作逼真的城市景观。选择该目的地最具标志性的地标、特色建筑、当地交通、著名风景、原生植物、当地动物、地区美食和文化物品。专注于目的地的精神，而不是字面上的准确性。 ## 构图 将选定的元素排列成一个平衡的编辑构图，并留出大量的空白。布局应该感觉开放、轻盈且毫不费力，类似于设计师的旅行写生本。允许物体自然重叠而不会变得拥挤。每个元素都应该有呼吸的空间。保持构图在视觉上放松且不凌乱。将蓝色少量地应用于选定的细节，如水、天空、窗户、标志、服装点缀、装饰亮点或小型建筑特征。绝不要引入任何其他颜色。 ## 绘画风格 保持每个物体简单且刻意简化。使用内部细节极少的扁平形状。避免逼真的纹理、渐变、阴影、绘画般的画笔技巧、光泽表面或复杂的渲染。插画应保持干净、大气、低调且具有高度的平面感。 ## 线条质量 黑色马克笔线条是主要的视觉特征。线条应该感觉自信、随性、活泼、富有表现力且自然地不完美。鼓励略微不均匀的轮廓、开口的边缘、变化的线条厚度和微小的绘画误差，因为它们增强了真实的手绘感。 ## 氛围 温暖。友好。放松。俏皮。极简。编辑风格。当代感。通过简约体现优雅。成品艺术品应类似于设计精美的旅行笔记本、精品旅行指南、编辑杂志插画或生活方式速写本，而不是精致的数字插图。 ## 重要事项 不要摄影写实。不要3D渲染。不要绘画效果。不要渐变。不要重阴影。不要光泽照明。不要矢量般整洁的艺术品。不要过多的细节。不要拥挤的构图。保留大量的空白。保持具有明显手工特性的扁平编辑涂鸦美学。最终图像应通过简单、富有表现力的黑色毡尖笔草图和微妙的天蓝色点缀，瞬间唤起对{DESTINATION}的记忆。

prompts.text:
Create a cheerful, creative composition that blends a realistic subject with playful hand-drawn doodles and a subtle micro-story.

Subject:
[insert object / person / product — keep simple and recognizable]

Layout:
- Invisible clean grid system underneath
- Balanced, airy spacing (avoid clutter)
- Clear hierarchy: subject first, doodles second, micro details third

Doodles (IMPORTANT):
- Playful, expressive, slightly exaggerated
- Include: smiley faces, stars, sparkles, arrows, motion lines, cute icons

Micro Story:
- Add a tiny, fun narrative (e.g., doodle characters using the object, reacting to it)
- Keep it subtle and discoverable on second glance

Typography:
- Friendly sans-serif + handwritten notes
- Casual tone (not serious, not corporate)
- Include small fun labels or thoughts

Color:
- Base: white / soft cream
- Ink: soft black / dark grey
- Accents: 2–3 cheerful colors (yellow, sky blue, soft red, mint, etc.)

Lighting:

items.title: Y2K原宿风品牌徽章矢量插画设计

prompts.text:
[BRAND NAME]

You are a senior vector designer specializing in Y2K Harajuku badge art. Your world: Tokyo bootleg culture, early 2000s Japanese brand remixes, retro-futuristic sticker aesthetics. Every output should look like a clean Illustrator vector file, flat and sticker-ready. The badge structure must be invented fresh for each brand, not templated.

BRAND ANALYSIS

Before designing, resolve all of the following: (1) PRIMARY COLOR — brand's main color softened into a pastel Y2K version, still recognizable but lighter and more kawaii; (2) ACCENT COLOR — brand's secondary color pushed to warm saturation for energetic pop; (3) DARK COLOR — deep brand palette (navy, dark brown, near-black) used for outlines and extrusions; (4) LETTER CONTENT — brand name in bold lowercase or most iconic abbreviation; (5) KATAKANA — correct Japanese transliteration as a secondary text element; (6) ORIGIN FLAG — brand's country of origin flag as a small flat element; (7) SHAPE LANGUAGE — iconic geometric forms from the brand's visual identity used as orbital and background elements, never generic ovals; (8) CULTURAL SYMBOLS — 1-2 small iconic objects from the brand's universe rendered as tiny flat illustrations; (9) COMPOSITION LOGIC — design the badge layout using everything above so it feels invented specifically for this brand.

CANVAS

1:1 square. Flat off-white or warm light grey background. Completely empty, no texture, no gradient.

BADGE STRUCTURE

Using the resolved shape language and composition logic, build the full badge. Fixed rules: central lettering element, surrounding brand-specific shapes with z-layer stacking, at least one element passing both behind and in front of the letters for depth, and a unified badge or patch silhouette. The shapes must feel inevitable, as if they could only belong to this brand. Everything else is determined by the brand's own visual DNA.

LETTERING

Brand name in large bold lowercase with a wide rounded display typeface. Flat PRIMARY COLOR fill. Thick DARK COLOR extrusion offset down-right at 8-12% of letter height. Bold DARK COLOR outline. No gradients, no rendering.

Y2K SIGNATURE ELEMENTS

Every badge must include: SPEED LINES or motion texture in ACCENT COLOR inside background shapes. SHARP 4-POINT STAR as a decorative accent near the lettering in DARK COLOR. KATAKANA transliteration tucked naturally into the composition. ORIGIN FLAG as a small accurate flat element. BRAND CULTURAL SYMBOL rendered as a tiny flat illustration integrated into the badge.

TECH SPECS

Flat vector only. Zero gradients, effects, blur, or rendering. Clean crisp edges throughout. Maximum 4 colors: PRIMARY pastel, ACCENT warm saturated, DARK outline, off-white. Must feel like a collectible sticker or embroidered patch. Every brand produces a structurally different badge because every brand has different shape language. The Y2K Japanese aesthetic is the constant, the structure is the variable.

prompts.text:
[品牌名称]

你是一位资深矢量设计师，擅长 Y2K 原宿徽章艺术。你的世界：东京靴子（bootleg）文化、21 世纪初日本品牌重混、复古未来主义贴纸美学。每一个输出都应该看起来像一个干净的 Illustrator 矢量文件，扁平且可直接作为贴纸使用。徽章结构必须为每个品牌重新发明，而不是使用模板。

品牌分析

在设计之前，解决以下所有问题：(1) 主色 —— 品牌的主色调软化为粉彩 Y2K 版本，保持识别度但更轻盈、更可爱；(2) 强调色 —— 品牌的次要颜色推向暖色饱和度，以获得充满活力的流行感；(3) 深色 —— 品牌深色调（海军蓝、深棕色、近黑色），用于轮廓和挤压效果；(4) 字母内容 —— 粗体小写字母或最具标志性的缩写形式的品牌名称；(5) 片假名 —— 正确的日语译音，作为次要文本元素；(6) 产地旗帜 —— 品牌原产国国旗，作为一个小的扁平元素；(7) 形状语言 —— 来自品牌视觉身份的标志性几何形状，用作轨道和背景元素，绝非通用的椭圆形；(8) 文化符号 —— 1-2 个来自品牌领域的标志性小物体，渲染为微小的扁平插画；(9) 构图逻辑 —— 使用上述所有元素设计徽章布局，使其感觉是专门为该品牌发明的。

画布

1:1 正方形。扁平的米白色或暖浅灰色背景。完全空白，无纹理，无渐变。

徽章结构

利用解析出的形状语言和构图逻辑，构建完整的徽章。固定规则：中央字母元素，周围环绕品牌特定形状并带有 z 轴图层堆叠，至少有一个元素穿过字母的后方和前方以增加深度，以及统一的徽章或补丁轮廓。这些形状必须感觉是必然的，仿佛它们只能属于这个品牌。其他一切都由品牌自身的视觉 DNA 决定。

字体设计

品牌名称采用大号粗体小写字母，使用宽大的圆角显示字体。扁平的主色填充。粗壮的深色挤压效果，在字母高度的 8-12% 处向右下方偏移。粗体深色轮廓。无渐变，无渲染。

Y2K 签名元素

每个徽章必须包含：背景形状内部的强调色速度线或运动纹理。字母附近的深色尖锐四角星作为装饰。自然融入构图的片假名译音。作为小型准确扁平元素的产地旗帜。品牌文化符号，渲染为集成到徽章中的微型扁平插画。

技术规格

仅限扁平矢量。零渐变、特效、模糊或渲染。全程保持干净利落的边缘。最多 4 种颜色：粉彩主色、暖饱和强调色、深色轮廓、米白色。必须感觉像是一张收藏级贴纸或刺绣补丁。每个品牌都会产生结构不同的徽章，因为每个品牌都有不同的形状语言。Y2K 日本美学是常量，结构是变量。

prompts.text:
为[BRAND]品牌的产品[PRODUCT]制作一张高级广告海报。

将海报构建为电影感的爆炸视图构图，产品悬浮在空间中，被分解为基本层级、材料、成分、组件、纹理或感官元素。

目的不是技术说明。目的是视觉叙事。

每一个悬浮层都应揭示出关于产品的有意义的信息：
- 科技产品揭示精密性、镜头、芯片、屏幕、光线、信号、玻璃、金属和智能
- 食品揭示风味、纹理、成分、碎屑、奶油、蒸汽、酱汁、脆度或新鲜度
- 饮料产品揭示液体能量、气泡、冰、水果、冷凝、运动和清爽感
- 时尚产品揭示面料、缝线、鞋底结构、皮革、网眼、运动、身份和生活方式
- 美容产品揭示香气、植物成分、液体、玻璃、皮肤光泽、薄雾、仪式和精致感
- 奢侈品揭示工艺、传承、材料、抛光、阴影和永恒的设计

保持产品准确、可辨认、锐利且在视觉上占主导地位。

以高级艺术指导、电影感灯光、清晰的深度、抛光的反射、强烈的负空间、戏剧性的阴影和清晰的视觉层级来排列爆炸元素。

图像应感觉像是世界级的活动海报：标志性的、昂贵的、令人驻足观看的，并且是专门为该品牌和产品设计的。

不要使用微缩人物、微小世界、产品纪念碑或城市规模的场景。

添加受品牌视觉语言启发的高级海报排版，并配上简短的3个单词的标语。

避免模仿任何现有的活动。创建一个新鲜的原创视觉系统。

纵横比：[RATIO]
