prompts.text:
请生成一张【超宽横版游戏关卡设定图】，单张完整图片，不要拼图，不要多宫格，不要分栏。

尺寸：横版 3:1。

【关卡主题】：赛博都市 / 奇幻森林 / 废土地铁站 / 东方古城 / 你自己的主题
【场景风格】：科幻 / 奇幻 / 废土 / 古风 / 蒸汽朋克 / 城市冒险
【玩法类型】：跑酷 / 平台跳跃 / 动作冒险 / 解谜探索 / 横版卷轴闯关
【主要场景元素】：填写平台、建筑、机关、道具、障碍、背景元素
【色调氛围】：填写主色调和整体氛围
【补充要求】：填写你想强调的玩法或视觉重点

整体画面必须是一张完整的横版卷轴游戏关卡长图，采用横向展开的游戏关卡视角，不是俯视图，不是普通海报，也不是单纯风景插画。重点是表现一个真正“可玩”的横版关卡场景：从左到右连续展开，能够清晰看出推进路线、平台结构、高低差、跳跃点、障碍区、机关区、道具点和视觉节奏。

画面中要有清晰的关卡逻辑：
可以包含不同高度的平台、桥梁、楼顶、树根、遗迹、车厢、城墙、屋檐、绳索、升降平台、断裂区域、危险地带、可收集道具、隐藏区域、敌人活动区、机关装置等。
这些元素要形成自然的推进关系，而不是随意堆砌。

视觉层次要清晰：
前景是可玩的平台和机关结构，
中景是主要场景建筑与路线，
背景是用来增强世界观和氛围的远景环境。
整张图要像高质量游戏概念设定图、横版平台关卡地图、2.5D 游戏场景展示图。

如果是赛博都市主题，可以加入高楼屋顶、霓虹灯牌、空调外机、金属平台、无人机、激光障碍、能量道具。
如果是奇幻森林主题，可以加入巨树、树根平台、蘑菇跳台、藤蔓桥、发光水晶、遗迹和陷阱。
如果是废土地铁主题，可以加入废弃月台、破损列车、轨道断裂、维修通道、漏电水坑、补给箱和坍塌区域。
如果是东方古城主题，可以加入青瓦屋顶、飞檐、城墙、牌楼、灯笼、桥梁、绳索点、卷轴宝箱和机关陷阱。

整体效果要突出一个核心：
超宽横图特别适合承载完整的横版关卡结构，一张图就能把路径、玩法、场景和世界观同时讲清楚。

避免：俯视图、海报拼贴感、多宫格、无路线逻辑、普通风景插画感、纯壁纸感、元素堆砌混乱、平台关系不清、过多无关文字、低清晰度。

prompts.text:
Premium minimal flat-vector travel poster for [CITY_NAME], 3:4 vertical.

Top-left typography:
[CITY_NAME]
[Short elegant English caption matching the city mood]

Create a soft premium stationery-style city travel poster with a clean, airy, high-end postcard mood.

BACKGROUND RULE:
Use a clean white or near-white background.
Keep the upper-left typography area mostly pure white and spacious.
Do not use peach, beige, cream, warm tinted background wash, or paper-like background color.
Warm tones may appear only in architecture, flowers, clothing, café details, and small objects.

CITY ADAPTATION:
Automatically adapt the scene to [CITY_NAME].
Use one iconic primary landmark as the main visual anchor in the middle or background.
Add local architecture, a small café or street-side shop, a local transport sign, a slim street lamp, trees, flower pots, and a few refined city-specific details.
Optional secondary landmark may appear very small and subtle in the far background, but it must not compete with the primary landmark.
Avoid landmark collage or overly dense city elements.

PEOPLE:
Use only 3–5 people.
Show small natural daily-life moments:
two people talking at a café table,
one person walking quietly,
one person taking a photo,
and optionally one person sketching or jogging.
Avoid crowds.
Avoid a single hero character.

COMPOSITION:
Keep large clean white negative space in the upper-left.
Place the main landmark clearly in the middle-to-background.
Place the café or local shop on one side.
Keep the scene simple, balanced, spacious, and uncluttered.
Avoid filling the top area with too many branches, clouds, birds, flowers, or decorative elements.

STYLE:
Soft stationery illustration aesthetic,
premium sticker illustration,
minimal flat-vector poster,
clean thin outlines,
consistent line weight,
flat colors only,
rounded forms,
tiny dot eyes,
simple facial features,
elegant graphic balance.

COLOR PALETTE:
blush pink,
dusty rose,
sage green,
warm cream,
soft beige,
muted gray-green.

Use these colors softly on objects only.
Do not use them as a full background wash.

MOOD:
minimal,
elegant,
calm,
refined,
romantic,
clean,
premium travel postcard,
greeting card,
wall art,
book-cover,
lifestyle branding.

CAPTION RULE:
Generate one short English caption, 3–7 words.
It should feel elegant, poetic, simple, and city-specific.
Avoid clichés, exclamation marks, and tourist brochure language.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
No realism.
No photorealism.
No watercolor.
No painterly effects.
No gradients.
No shading.
No texture.
No peach background.
No beige background wash.
No dense background.
No crowded streets.
No excessive landmark collage.
No overly detailed architecture.

prompts.text:

左上角排版：
[CITY_NAME]
[匹配城市氛围的简短优雅英文标题]

创作一张具有干净、通透、高端明信片氛围的柔和高端文具风格城市旅行海报。

背景规则：
使用干净的白色或近乎白色的背景。
保持左上角的排版区域大部分为纯白色且宽敞。
请勿使用桃红色、米色、奶油色、暖色调背景晕染或类纸质背景色。
暖色调仅可出现在建筑、花卉、服装、咖啡馆细节和小型物品中。

城市适配：
自动将场景适配至 [CITY_NAME]。
使用一个标志性的主要地标作为中部或背景的主要视觉锚点。
加入当地建筑、一家小咖啡馆或路边小店、一个当地交通标志、一盏纤细的路灯、树木、花盆以及一些精致的特定城市细节。
可选的次要地标可以非常微小且微妙地出现在远景中，但绝不能与主要地标竞争。
避免地标堆砌或过于密集的城市元素。

人物：
仅使用 3–5 人。
展示自然的小型日常生活瞬间：
两人在咖啡馆桌旁交谈，
一人静静地行走，
一人正在拍照，
以及可选的一人正在写生或慢跑。
避免拥挤的人群。
避免出现单一的主角人物。

构图：
在左上角保留大量干净的白色留白空间。
将主要地标清晰地放置在中景到背景位置。
将咖啡馆或当地商店放置在侧面。
保持场景简洁、平衡、宽敞且整齐。
避免在顶部区域填充过多的树枝、云朵、鸟类、花卉或装饰元素。

风格：
柔和的文具插画美学，
高端贴纸插画，
极简扁平矢量海报，
干净的细轮廓，
一致的线条粗细，
仅限扁平色，
圆润的形状，
微小的圆点眼睛，
简单的面部特征，
优雅的图形平衡。

配色方案：
腮红粉，
灰粉色，
鼠尾草绿，
暖奶油色，
柔和米色，
柔和的灰绿色。
仅在物体上柔和地使用这些颜色。
请勿将其用作整体背景晕染。

氛围：
极简、优雅、冷静、精致、浪漫、干净、高端旅行明信片、贺卡、墙面艺术、书籍封面、生活方式品牌。

标题规则：
生成一个短小的英文标题，3-7 个单词。
它应该感觉优雅、富有诗意、简洁且具有城市特色。
避免陈词滥调、感叹号和旅游手册用语。

负面提示词：
无写实。无照片写实。无水彩。无绘画效果。无渐变。无阴影。无纹理。无桃红色背景。无米色背景晕染。无密集背景。无拥挤街道。无过度的地标堆砌。无过于复杂的建筑。

She has a black bob haircut, her head is slightly tilted toward her right shoulder, her eyes are closed, and her expression is calm and natural, without any sense of deliberate performance. She is wearing a light blue-gray off-the-shoulder knitted top and an off-white short skirt. Her arms are naturally crossed in front of her, and her legs are naturally together and slightly slanted. Her overall posture is relaxed, as if she has inadvertently fallen asleep due to exhaustion during the train journey. The character's state should be real and restrained, with skin retaining natural texture and real quality, without excessive beautification or skin smoothing, presenting the sense of life of an ordinary mobile phone snapshot. [Second Character and Background Characters] In the middle ground on the left side of the frame, another adult East Asian woman in a window seat is also in a state of sleep. She has long black hair, her head is tilted against the window, her eyes are closed, and she is wearing a white shirt and a dark gray short skirt, sitting quietly in a blue window seat. A black bag is placed beside her as an everyday travel item to enhance realism. An empty seat is kept between the two people, allowing the blue seats to form a clear depth-of-field relationship. A few ordinary passengers are scattered in the back row of the carriage, some partially blocked by seats, existing only as background elements, not overshadowing the main visual center. [Appearance and Outfit] The foreground subject is an adult East Asian woman with an ordinary and real temperament, with a natural appearance, without exaggerated influencer-style modification. Her cold brown bob hairstyle has a slightly natural fluffy feel of daily life. The outfit is simple and daily, a light blue-gray off-the-shoulder knitted top paired with an off-white short skirt, the overall atmosphere is a relaxed, daily, and real travel outfit. The woman in the left middle ground has long black hair, wearing a white shirt and a dark gray short skirt, also maintaining the natural image of an ordinary passenger, without deliberate sexualized presentation. Both characters should reflect the state of tired rest of real East Asian women during a journey, rather than a sense of a posing model. [Environment] The scene is set inside a Chinese high-speed rail second-class carriage. The interior features typical blue fabric seats, each equipped with a white headrest cloth, and real and reasonable seat number text is visible on the wall above. The overall space should be clean, bright, and tidy, with the structure and atmosphere of a real high-speed rail carriage. A blurred platform and urban tracks are visible outside the window as external hints of the high-speed train environment, but they should not be too clear or eye-catching. The entire environment should convey the sense of order and life of a real public transportation space, and no wrong carriage structures or chaotic backgrounds should appear. [Composition Requirements] Adopt a vertical composition, 3:4 ratio, the overall look is like a mobile phone lifestyle photo captured unintentionally during a journey. The sleeping woman in the right foreground is the main visual focus, and the sleeping woman by the window in the left middle ground forms a resonance. The empty seat in the middle and the rows of blue seats together constitute a clear spatial depth, allowing the internal structure of the high-speed rail carriage to unfold naturally. The texture of the blue seats, white headrest cloths, windows, seat numbers, characters' sleeping postures, and scattered passengers in the back row should be naturally presented in the frame. The composition can have a slight sense of snapshot and slight imperfection, without being too neat, to strengthen the documentary atmosphere of "unintentionally captured during a real journey." The visual focus is suggested to fall in order: the sleeping woman in the right foreground -> the sleeping woman by the window in the left middle ground -> the depth formed by the blue seats and empty seats -> the white headrest cloths and seat numbers -> the blurry window exterior and back row passengers. [Camera/Technical Parameters] The overall look should present a hyper-realistic mobile phone photography quality, as if naturally taken with an ordinary mobile phone, rather than a professional studio shoot. Use a slight wide-angle perspective to retain the sense of carriage space and the longitudinal extension of the seats. The optical performance should be close to daily mobile phone imaging: the subject is clear, the background and the window exterior can have a slight natural blur, with a bit of slight noise and the sense of daily image compression. The frame retains real skin details, clothing folds, seat fabric texture, headrest cloth texture, and carriage structure details, avoiding over-sharpening, over-smoothing, or a fake high-definition feel. [Atmosphere/Light] Adopt real natural indoor light, mainly the ambient light inside the high-speed rail carriage, without using cinematic lighting or studio-style light effects. The overall light should be naturally soft, bright, and restrained, like the real light sense formed by the outside of the window and the carriage lighting when the train is moving or stopped during the day. The area outside the window can be slightly brighter but not overexposed; the characters' faces and clothing should be naturally lit, retaining a quiet, tired, and life-like atmosphere. The overall color tone should be realistically neutral, without strong filter processing, to strengthen the "unintentional snapshot during a quiet journey" temperament. [Style] The overall style is realistic documentary photography, mobile phone snapshot, and lifestyle snapshot style. Emphasize the sense of real moments in public transportation scenes, rather than fashion photography, posed blockbusters, or movie stills. The image should have a clear realistic photography tendency, retaining the simplicity, restraint, and daily sense of ordinary mobile phone photos, avoiding a heavy sense of AI generation. The final effect should make people feel that this is a lifestyle photo accidentally taken during a real high-speed rail journey. [Detail Emphasis] Focus on the following details: The real spatial sense and structure of a Chinese high-speed rail second-class carriage; The material details of blue fabric seats and white headrest cloths; Reasonable and real seat number text on the wall overhead; Blurred platform and urban tracks outside the train window; The tired sleeping posture of the woman in the right foreground with her head slightly tilted, eyes closed, arms naturally crossed, and legs naturally together and slanted; The posture of the woman in the left middle ground sleeping by the window and the black bag beside her; The presence of passengers in the back row as background elements should be low, used only to enhance the real atmosphere of the carriage; The overall performance should be a quiet, tired, restrained, and natural state of life during a journey; The photo must look like a real capture, not a deliberately designed, over-modified, or image with obvious AI traces. [Avoid] Low quality, poor clarity, blurry face, deformed face, deformed hands, deformed legs, extra fingers, missing fingers, hand errors, body proportion errors, facial distortion, eyes open, fake skin, plastic texture, over-smoothing, over-beautification, influencer photo sense, deliberate posing sense, studio sense, movie lighting, strong filters, over-sharpening, over-saturation, sexualization, nudity, minors, school uniforms, suggestive poses, provocative expressions, exaggerated body figures, low-cut emphasis, anime style, illustration style, CG feel, 3D rendering, oil painting style, garbled text, wrong seat numbers, wrong carriage structure, duplicate characters, multiple heads, multiple legs, multiple hands, chaotic background.

prompts.text:
【主体与状态】
一张超写实手机随手拍照片，呈现旅途中安静、疲惫、自然的瞬间。画面前景右侧，一名成年东亚女性坐在中国高铁二等座靠走道的蓝色座椅上睡着。她留黑色波波头短发，头部微微低垂向自己的右肩，闭眼，神情平静自然，没有刻意表演感。她穿着浅蓝灰色一字肩针织上衣与米白色短裙，双臂自然交叉放在身前，双腿自然并拢并略微斜放，整体姿态放松，像是在列车行途中因疲惫而不经意睡着。人物状态应真实克制，皮肤保留自然纹理与真实质感，不过度美化，不磨皮，呈现普通手机抓拍的生活感。

【第二人物与背景人物】
画面左侧中景，靠窗座位上还有一名成年东亚女性同样处于睡眠状态。她有长黑色头发，头低垂靠着窗户，闭着眼睛，穿着白色衬衫与深灰色短裙，安静地坐在靠窗的蓝色座椅上。她身旁放有一个黑色包，作为日常出行物件增强真实感。两人之间保留一个空座位，使蓝色座椅形成清晰的纵深关系。车厢后排零散坐着几名普通乘客，部分被座椅遮挡，仅作为背景元素存在，不喧宾夺主，不抢占主体视觉中心。

【外貌与穿搭】
前景主体为普通真实气质的成年东亚女性，外貌自然，不做网红式夸张修饰。她的冷棕色波波头发型略带生活中的自然蓬松感。穿搭简洁日常，为浅蓝灰色一字肩针织上衣搭配米白色短裙，整体有轻松、日常、真实的旅行穿着氛围。左侧中景女性则为长黑发，穿白色衬衫和深灰色短裙，同样保持普通旅客的自然形象，不做刻意性感化呈现。两位人物都应体现真实东亚女性旅途中疲惫休息的状态，而非摆拍模特感。

【环境】
场景设定为中国高铁二等座车厢内部。车厢内为典型的蓝色织物座椅，每个座椅配有白色头枕布，头顶墙面可见真实合理的座位编号文字。整体空间应当干净、明亮、整洁，具有真实高铁车厢的结构与氛围。车窗外可见模糊的站台和城市轨道，作为高速列车环境的外部提示，但不应过于清晰抢眼。整个环境要传达真实公共交通空间的秩序感与生活感，不能出现错误的车厢结构或混乱背景。

【构图要求】
采用竖构图，3:4比例，整体像旅途中无意拍到的一张手机生活照。前景右侧的睡着女性为主要视觉焦点，左侧中景的靠窗睡着女性形成呼应。中间空座位与一排排蓝色座椅共同构成清晰的空间纵深，让高铁车厢的内部结构自然展开。画面中应自然呈现蓝色座椅纹理、白色头枕布、窗户、座位编号、人物睡姿以及后排零散乘客。构图可以略带抓拍感与轻微不完美，不必过于工整，以强化“真实旅途中随手拍到”的生活纪实氛围。视觉重点建议依次落在：前景右侧睡着的女性 → 左侧中景靠窗睡着的女性 → 蓝色座椅与空座形成的纵深 → 白色头枕布与座位编号 → 模糊窗外与后排乘客。

【相机/技术参数】
整体应呈现超写实手机摄影质感，像用普通手机自然拍摄所得，而非专业棚拍。使用轻微广角透视，保留车厢空间感与座椅的纵深延伸。光学表现应接近日常手机成像：主体清晰，背景和窗外可有轻微自然虚化，带一点轻微噪点和日常影像压缩感。画面保留真实皮肤细节、衣物褶皱、座椅织物纹理、头枕布质感与车厢结构细节，避免过度锐化、过度平滑或假高清感。

【氛围/光线】
采用真实自然室内光，以高铁车厢内的环境光为主，不使用电影化布光或棚拍式光效。光线整体应自然柔和、明亮克制，像白天列车行驶或停靠时由窗外与车厢照明共同形成的真实光感。窗外区域可以稍亮，但不能过曝；人物面部和衣着应自然受光，保留安静、疲惫、生活化的氛围。整体色调应偏真实中性，不做强烈滤镜处理，强化“安静旅途中的无意抓拍”气质。

【风格】
整体风格为真实纪实摄影、手机随手拍、生活化抓拍风格。强调公共交通场景中的真实瞬间感，而不是时尚写真、摆拍大片或电影剧照。画面应具有明显的现实主义摄影倾向，保留普通手机照片的质朴、克制与日常感，避免AI生成感过重。最终效果应让人感觉这是一张在真实高铁旅途中偶然拍下的生活照片。

【细节强调】
重点强调以下细节：

* 中国高铁二等座车厢的真实空间感与结构
* 蓝色织物座椅与白色头枕布的材质细节
* 头顶墙面上合理真实的座位编号文字
* 车窗外模糊的站台与城市轨道
* 前景右侧女性头微垂、闭眼、双臂自然交叉、双腿自然并拢斜放的疲惫睡姿
* 左侧中景女性靠窗睡着的姿态与身旁的黑色包
* 后排乘客作为背景元素的存在感应低，仅用于增强车厢真实氛围
* 整体应表现旅途中安静、疲惫、克制、自然的生活状态
* 照片必须像真实拍摄，而不是刻意设计、过度修饰或带明显AI痕迹的图像。

【避免】
低质量，清晰度差，脸部模糊，畸形脸，畸形手，畸形腿，多余手指，缺失手指，手部错误，身体比例错误，脸部扭曲，眼睛睁开，假皮肤，塑料质感，过度磨皮，过度美颜，网红写真感，刻意摆拍感，棚拍感，电影灯光，强烈滤镜，过度锐化，过度饱和，色情化，裸露，未成年人，学生制服，暴露姿势，挑逗表情，夸张身材，低胸强调，动漫风，插画风，CG感，3D渲染，油画风，文字乱码，错误座位编号，车厢结构错误，重复人物，多头，多腿，多手，背景混乱。

主体是一件馆藏级 hero object，造型优美、纹样丰富、材质精致、有艺术收藏价值。采用局部裁切、右下角巨大切入、圆形画窗或半露出画面的方式呈现，不要完整商品摆拍。

prompts.text:
Create a high-end type-framed poster where oversized typography becomes the main visual structure.

Theme: [urban culture / public event / nature film / travel / outdoor / lifestyle project]
Direction: [urban crossing poster / freedom signal poster / nature film poster / travel typography poster]
Project name: [name]
Main title: [short word or title]
Subtitle: [short subtitle]
Subject: [person / bird / landscape / city / object]
Mood: [cinematic / calm / public / natural / modern / adventurous / editorial]
Color palette: [black-white-blue / dark green / deep navy / grey-blue / warm paper tone]
Aspect ratio: [9:16]

The poster should feel like a premium design poster, film poster, event visual, travel campaign or cultural project poster.

The key idea: typography should frame the image, not just overlay it.
Use huge cropped letters, vertical type frames, word-shaped windows, strong negative space, realistic photography, paper grain, clean information hierarchy and a clear relationship between the subject and the type.

Choose one direction:

1. Urban crossing poster
   Use a single person walking through a city passage, street crossing, tunnel or architectural space. Oversized letters should frame the person and create a strong city-grid structure.

2. Freedom signal poster
   Use one person in a modern public space with a white dove or symbolic detail. Keep the design clean. Use large blue / black / white typography to frame the figure and the symbol.

3. Nature film poster
   Use a person in a natural landscape, wetland, field or mountain setting. Let a huge vertical title frame the person and scenery like tall pillars or windows.

4. Travel typography poster
   Use a huge word as an image container. Fill the letters with mountains, forests, sky or landscape photography, with a small traveler for scale.

Keep it clean, structured, editorial and visually designed.

Avoid messy collage, too many elements, random stickers, weak typography, flat text overlay, generic template design, bad text rendering, distorted people, fake scenery, cartoon style and real copyrighted brand logos.

Generate one finished poster only.

prompts.text:
创建一个高端的文字框架海报，其中超大排版成为主要的视觉结构。

主题：[城市文化 / 公共活动 / 自然电影 / 旅行 / 户外 / 生活方式项目]
方向：[城市交叉口海报 / 自由信号海报 / 自然电影海报 / 旅行排版海报]
项目名称：[名称]
主标题：[短词或标题]
副标题：[短副标题]
主体：[人 / 鸟 / 风景 / 城市 / 物体]
情绪：[电影感 / 平静 / 公共 / 自然 / 现代 / 冒险 / 编辑风格]
配色方案：[黑-白-蓝 / 深绿 / 深海军蓝 / 灰蓝 / 暖纸色调]
宽高比：[9:16]

海报应具有高端设计海报、电影海报、活动视觉、旅行活动或文化项目海报的质感。

核心理念：排版应该框住图像，而不仅仅是覆盖它。
使用巨大的裁剪字母、垂直类型框架、单词形状的窗口、强烈的负空间、写实摄影、纸张纹理、清晰的信息层级以及主体与排版之间的清晰关系。

选择一个方向：

1. 城市交叉口海报
   使用一个人走过城市通道、街道交叉口、隧道或建筑空间。超大字母应框住人物并创造出强烈的城市网格结构。

2. 自由信号海报
   在带有白鸽或象征性细节的现代公共空间中使用一个人。保持设计简洁。使用蓝色 / 黑色 / 白色的巨大排版来框住人物和符号。

3. 自然电影海报
   在自然风景、湿地、田野或山脉设置中使用一个人。让巨大的垂直标题像高柱或窗户一样框住人物和风景。

4. 旅行排版海报
   使用一个巨大的单词作为图像容器。在字母中填充山脉、森林、天空或风景摄影，并加入一个微小的旅行者以体现比例感。

保持简洁、结构化、编辑风格和视觉设计感。

避免杂乱的拼贴、过多的元素、随机贴纸、虚弱的排版、扁平的文字叠加、通用的模板设计、糟糕的文字渲染、扭曲的人物、虚假场景、卡通风格以及真实的受版权保护的品牌标志。

仅生成一张成品海报。

prompts.text:
Transform the uploaded sketch, rough logo idea, drawing, or reference image into a professional logo exploration board.

Use the provided image ONLY as the core creative concept and visual foundation.

• unique recognizable elements

Do NOT copy the sketch literally.
Refine, redesign, and evolve the idea into professional logo systems.

Create a grid of 16–20 unique minimalist logo concepts based on the original idea.

Each logo must reinterpret the same concept using different professional branding approaches:

1. Geometric logo mark

DESIGN RULES:
• Preserve the original idea identity and concept
• Keep the main subject recognizable
• Simplify complex details into strong visual symbols
• Use professional logo design principles
• Focus on timeless branding, not illustration
• Avoid unnecessary decoration
• Avoid generic icons
• Avoid AI-looking symbols

STYLE:
• Clean vector logo aesthetics
• Premium branding studio presentation
• Modern international identity design

prompts.text:
Generate a vertical 3:4 high-end spring plant-themed graphic poster, which must be a finished poster with completed text layout.

The main subject is an abstract rubbing pattern of spring branches and buds, looking like plant branches pressed onto a paper surface and then screen-printed in cyan-blue. The background is a cream-white handmade paper texture, partially overlaid with light yellow rectangular base blocks, pink-orange translucent circles, and small dot decorations, forming a spring retro magazine layout.

At the top of the composition, place a large Chinese main title "绿意回返", with a tall serif or modern Songti font in a warm orange-red color, spanning horizontally across the top of the frame. Below the title, add a line of small English text "GREEN RETURNS", followed by a very small Chinese sub-sentence "听见新芽醒来，春天正在回到枝头". The image must have clear poster information layers: the top main title, the sub-sentence below the title, the label box on the right, the vertical text on the left, the bottom handwritten text, and the date information must all be directly generated in the image. The overall information density is medium-high, but the layout must be orderly and cannot just be a plant background.

Colors are mainly cream-white, cyan-blue, light yellow, pink-orange, and orange-red, low saturation, bright, and artistic.

prompts.text:
Ultra-wide side-scrolling game level concept art prompt:

Please generate one [Ultra-wide side-scrolling game level concept art], a single complete image, no collages, no multi-grids, no columns.

Size: Landscape 3:1.

[Level Theme]: Cyber City / Fantasy Forest / Wasteland Subway Station / Oriental Ancient City / Your own theme
[Scene Style]: Sci-fi / Fantasy / Wasteland / Ancient Style / Steampunk / Urban Adventure
[Gameplay Type]: Parkour / Platformer / Action-Adventure / Puzzle Exploration / Side-scrolling level
[Main Scene Elements]: Fill in platforms, buildings, mechanisms, props, obstacles, background elements
[Tonal Atmosphere]: Fill in the main color tone and overall atmosphere
[Additional Requirements]: Fill in the gameplay or visual focus you want to emphasize

The overall image must be a single complete horizontal side-scrolling game level long image, using a horizontally unfolding game level perspective, not a top-down view, not a regular poster, and not just a simple landscape illustration. The focus is to present a truly "playable" side-scrolling level scene: unfolding continuously from left to right, clearly showing the progression route, platform structure, height differences, jumping points, obstacle areas, mechanism areas, prop points, and visual rhythm.

There must be clear level logic in the image:
It can include platforms of different heights, bridges, rooftops, tree roots, ruins, train carriages, city walls, eaves, ropes, lifting platforms, fractured areas, dangerous zones, collectable items, hidden areas, enemy activity zones, mechanical devices, etc.
These elements should form a natural progression relationship, rather than being randomly piled up.

The visual hierarchy must be clear:
Foreground is the playable platform and mechanism structure,
Midground is the main scene buildings and routes,
Background is the distant environment used to enhance the world view and atmosphere.
The entire image should look like high-quality game concept design art, a side-scrolling platform level map, or a 2.5D game scene display image.

If it is a Cyber City theme, you can add high-rise rooftops, neon signs, air conditioning units, metal platforms, drones, laser obstacles, energy items.
If it is a Fantasy Forest theme, you can add giant trees, tree root platforms, mushroom jumping platforms, vine bridges, glowing crystals, ruins, and traps.
If it is a Wasteland Subway theme, you can add abandoned platforms, damaged trains, broken tracks, maintenance tunnels, electrified puddles, supply boxes, and collapsed areas.
If it is an Oriental Ancient City theme, you can add blue tile roofs, flying eaves, city walls, arches, lanterns, bridges, rope points, scroll treasure chests, and mechanism traps.

The overall effect should highlight one core:
The ultra-wide horizontal image is particularly suitable for carrying a complete side-scrolling level structure, explaining the path, gameplay, scene, and world view simultaneously in one image.

Avoid: Top-down views, poster collage feel, multi-grids, lack of route logic, simple landscape illustration feel, pure wallpaper feel, messy element piling, unclear platform relationships, too much irrelevant text, low resolution.

prompts.text:
超宽横版游戏关卡设定图 提示词：

请生成一张【超宽横版游戏关卡设定图】，单张完整图片，不要拼图，不要多宫格，不要分栏。

尺寸：横版 3:1。

【关卡主题】：赛博都市 / 奇幻森林 / 废土地铁站 / 东方古城 / 你自己的主题
【场景风格】：科幻 / 奇幻 / 废土 / 古风 / 蒸汽朋克 / 城市冒险
【玩法类型】：跑酷 / 平台跳跃 / 动作冒险 / 解谜探索 / 横版卷轴闯关
【主要场景元素】：填写平台、建筑、机关、道具、障碍、背景元素
【色调氛围】：填写主色调和整体氛围
【补充要求】：填写你想强调的玩法或视觉重点

整体画面必须是一张完整的横版卷轴游戏关卡长图，采用横向展开的游戏关卡视角，不是俯视图，不是普通海报，也不是单纯风景插画。重点是表现一个真正“可玩”的横版关卡场景：从左到右连续展开，能够清晰看出推进路线、平台结构、高低差、跳跃点、障碍区、机关区、道具点和视觉节奏。

画面中要有清晰的关卡逻辑：
可以包含不同高度的平台、桥梁、楼顶、树根、遗迹、车厢、城墙、屋檐、绳索、升降平台、断裂区域、危险地带、可收集道具、隐藏区域、敌人活动区、机关装置等。
这些元素要形成自然的推进关系，而不是随意堆砌。

视觉层次要清晰：
前景是可玩的平台和机关结构，
中景是主要场景建筑与路线，
背景是用来增强世界观和氛围的远景环境。
整张图要像高质量游戏概念设定图、横版平台关卡地图、2.5D 游戏场景展示图。

如果是赛博都市主题，可以加入高楼屋顶、霓虹灯牌、空调外机、金属平台、无人机、激光障碍、能量道具。
如果是奇幻森林主题，可以加入巨树、树根平台、蘑菇跳台、藤蔓桥、发光水晶、遗迹和陷阱。
如果是废土地铁主题，可以加入废弃月台、破损列车、轨道断裂、维修通道、漏电水坑、补给箱和坍塌区域。
如果是东方古城主题，可以加入青瓦屋顶、飞檐、城墙、牌楼、灯笼、桥梁、绳索点、卷轴宝箱和机关陷阱。

整体效果要突出一个核心：
超宽横图特别适合承载完整的横版关卡结构，一张图就能把路径、玩法、场景和世界观同时讲清楚。

避免：俯视图、海报拼贴感、多宫格、无路线逻辑、普通风景插画感、纯壁纸感、元素堆砌混乱、平台关系不清、过多无关文字、低清晰度。

TITLE:
ULTRA-PREMIUM REFRESHING BEVERAGE SPLASH POSTER TEMPLATE

CORE CONCEPT:
Create a premium beverage advertising poster built around the idea of “freshness in motion”.

The main idea is:
one refreshing drink becomes the center of a dynamic splash moment,
surrounded by ice cubes, fruit slices, liquid motion, bold oversized typography, and clean commercial UI details.

The poster should communicate:

freshness,
energy,
cool taste,
summer mood,
premium refreshment,
bold flavor,
social-media appetite appeal,
modern drink branding.

Do NOT copy any reference image literally.
Use only the concept of:
large drink glass,
frozen splash motion,
floating ice,
fruit garnish,
bold oversized typography,
warm energetic background,
premium beverage campaign layout.

TOPIC:
[BEVERAGE POSTER / COLD DRINK AD / ICED TEA CAMPAIGN / MOCKTAIL POSTER / SUMMER DRINK BRANDING / JUICE AD / SODA CAMPAIGN / CAFE MENU POSTER / REFRESHING DRINK TEMPLATE / PREMIUM FOOD AND DRINK ADVERTISING]

STYLE & ART DIRECTION:

Premium beverage advertising.

High-energy summer drink campaign.

Clean commercial poster composition.

Bold editorial typography.

Fresh fruit-driven visual identity.

Modern cafe and restaurant branding.

Dynamic liquid photography style.

Social-media-ready drink layout.

High-end refreshment campaign.

Marketplace-ready beverage poster template.

MAIN SUBJECT:

ONE hero drink displayed prominently.

The drink may be:

iced tea,
soda,
cola,
lemonade,
fruit juice,
mocktail,
cold brew,
sparkling drink,
summer refresher,
cafe signature drink,
restaurant beverage.

The glass should look:

cold,
fresh,
glossy,
realistic,
transparent,
premium,
high-detail,
commercial-quality.

Include visible drink details such as:

ice cubes,
bubbles,
condensation,
fruit slices,
garnish,
liquid highlights,
glass reflections,
fresh splash movement.

VISUAL METAPHOR:

Create a “freshness explosion” around the drink.

Use:

liquid splash arc,
floating ice cubes,
fruit slices,
bubbles,
condensation droplets,
cold mist,
citrus garnish,
dynamic diagonal motion.

The splash should feel frozen in time.

The drink should look like it is moving through the poster with energy and taste.

LAYOUT & COMPOSITION:

Horizontal or vertical premium beverage-poster composition.

The design should include:

brand logo in the top corner,

large oversized typography across the middle,

hero drink overlapping or cutting through the typography,

fruit slices floating around the glass,

liquid splash above or behind the drink,

small price or menu detail,

small origin / flavor / location text block,

minimal CTA button,

subtle dotted texture or graphic detail,

clean negative space,

strong brand-color background,

premium commercial hierarchy.

The typography should feel integrated into the drink motion, not separated from it.

The product should remain the strongest visual focus.

TYPOGRAPHY:

Use:

extra-bold condensed sans-serif typography,

large uppercase display words,

wide letter spacing,

clean menu-style microcopy,

modern beverage-brand hierarchy,

minimal UI-style labels,

high-impact social media readability.

TEXT STRUCTURE:

Brand Name:
[BEVERAGE BRAND NAME]

Main Campaign Word:
[OVERSIZED DRINK NAME / FLAVOR / LOCATION WORD]

Supporting Line:
[SHORT REFRESHING MESSAGE]

Flavor / Origin Text:
[FROM / FLAVOR / INGREDIENT / LOCATION]

Price or Menu Detail:
[PRICE / MENU NOTE / LIMITED OFFER]

CTA:
[OPEN MENU / ORDER NOW / TRY TODAY / REFRESH NOW]

Bottom Info:
[WEBSITE / SOCIAL HANDLE / CAFE LOCATION]

HEADLINE EXAMPLES:

ICE COLD

FRESH SIP

CITRUS RUSH

SUMMER POUR

COOL WAVE

LONG REFRESH

TASTE THE CHILL

SPLASH SEASON

BIG FLAVOR

POUR THE MOMENT

SUPPORTING LINE EXAMPLES:

Freshness served cold.

A bold sip of summer.

Made for sunny moments.

Cool taste, big energy.

Your daily refreshment escape.

Bright flavor in every sip.

A splash of pure refreshment.

VISUAL SYSTEM:

Build the poster around a “drink in motion” visual system.

Use:

hero glass perspective,

diagonal drink movement,

oversized typography behind the glass,

liquid splash crown,

floating ice cubes,

fresh fruit garnish,

soft bubbles,

subtle halftone dots,

minimal UI arrows,

clean menu button,

premium light reflections.

The design should feel modern, energetic, and highly appetizing.

BACKGROUND SYSTEM:

Use a single bold beverage background color.

Recommended color directions:

orange citrus gradient,

lime green summer background,

deep cola brown,

lemon yellow,

berry red,

ice blue,

mint green,

peach sunset,

tropical teal.

Add subtle lighting gradients and soft bokeh only if needed.

Avoid clutter.

Avoid busy patterns.

Keep the drink, splash, and typography as the main focus.

COLOR PALETTE:

PRIMARY COLOR:
[BRAND BACKGROUND COLOR]

SECONDARY COLOR:
[DRINK / GLASS HIGHLIGHT COLOR]

ACCENT COLOR:
[FRUIT / CTA / GRAPHIC DETAIL COLOR]

TEXT COLOR:
[WHITE / CREAM / HIGH-CONTRAST COLOR]

Use the color system consistently across:

background,

typography,

fruit garnish,

drink highlights,

CTA,

brand logo,

menu details,

graphic accents.

EXTRA DESIGN DETAILS:

Frozen liquid splash.

Floating ice cubes.

Fresh citrus slices.

Cold condensation.

Large cropped typography.

Minimal price label.

Menu CTA button.

Small origin text.

UI arrow details.

Soft bokeh circles.

Subtle dotted texture.

Premium glass reflections.

Clean beverage-brand spacing.

MARKETPLACE TEMPLATE REQUIREMENTS:

The template must be reusable for:

iced tea brands,

juice bars,

mocktail menus,

soda campaigns,

cafe drinks,

summer beverages,

lemonade brands,

cold brew products,

restaurant drink menus,

smoothie campaigns,

energy drinks,

sparkling water,

fruit refreshers,

social media drink ads.

The buyer should be able to replace:

brand name,

drink type,

glass image,

fruit garnish,

headline,

background color,

price,

CTA,

location text,

flavor name,

logo,

website,

social handle,

menu details.

QUALITY:

Ultra-realistic beverage photography.

Premium commercial drink advertising.

High-end cafe campaign design.

Behance-quality composition.

Pinterest-worthy beverage poster.

Magazine-quality refreshment ad.

Clean social-media-ready layout.

8K ultra-high-resolution rendering.

QUALITY CONTROLS:

Do NOT copy the reference image exactly.

Do NOT use the same brand name.

Do NOT use the same drink name.

Do NOT repeat the exact glass angle.

Do NOT repeat the exact typography placement.

Do NOT overcrowd the layout.

Do NOT make the drink look artificial.

Do NOT make the text unreadable.

Do NOT limit the concept to one beverage only.

Do NOT create a one-time dead idea.

Preserve only the core idea:

refreshing hero drink,

dynamic liquid splash,

floating ice and fruit,

oversized integrated typography,

bold single-color background,

menu-style UI details,

premium beverage advertising mood,

marketplace-ready editable structure.

The final result should feel like a fresh premium drink advertising template that can be sold as part of a reusable beverage and cafe campaign system.

标题：
超高级清凉饮品溅射海报模板

核心概念：
围绕“动态中的新鲜感”这一理念，创作一张高级饮品广告海报。

主要想法是：
一款清爽的饮品成为动态溅射瞬间的中心，
周围环绕着冰块、水果片、液体律动、大胆的超大排版以及简洁的商业UI细节。

海报应传达：
新鲜感、
活力、
酷爽口感、
夏季心情、
高级清凉、
浓郁风味、
社交媒体上的食欲吸引力、
现代饮品品牌塑造。

不要字面复制任何参考图像。
仅使用以下概念：
大号饮料杯、
冻结的溅射动态、
漂浮的冰块、
水果装饰、
大胆的超大排版、
温暖而充满活力的背景、
高级饮品宣传布局。

主题：
[饮品海报 / 冷饮广告 / 冰茶活动 / 无酒精鸡尾酒海报 / 夏季饮品品牌设计 / 果汁广告 / 苏打水活动 / 咖啡馆菜单海报 / 清爽饮品模板 / 高级食品和饮品广告]

风格与艺术指导：
高级饮品广告。
高能量夏季饮品活动。
简洁的商业海报构图。
大胆的社论排版。
新鲜水果驱动的视觉识别。
现代咖啡馆和餐厅品牌设计。
动态液体摄影风格。
适合社交媒体的饮品布局。
高端清凉系列活动。
面向市场的饮品海报模板。

主要主体：
突出展示一个核心饮品。
该饮品可以是：
冰茶、
苏打水、
可乐、
柠檬水、
果汁、
无酒精鸡尾酒、
冷萃、
气泡饮、
夏季清凉剂、
咖啡馆招牌饮品、
餐厅饮料。

杯子看起来应该是：
冰冷的、
新鲜的、
光滑的、
写实的、
透明的、
高级的、
高细节的、
商业品质的。

包括可见的饮品细节，如：
冰块、
气泡、
冷凝水珠、
水果片、
装饰物、
液体高光、
玻璃反射、
新鲜的溅射动作。

视觉隐喻：
在饮品周围创造一种“新鲜感爆炸”。
使用：
液体溅射弧线、
漂浮的冰块、
水果片、
气泡、
冷凝滴、
冷雾、
柑橘装饰、
动态的对角线运动。
溅射应该感觉被冻结在时间中。
饮品看起来应该像是带着能量和美味在海报中移动。

布局与构图：
水平或垂直的高级饮品海报构图。
设计应包括：
顶角的品牌徽标、
横跨中间的大胆超大排版、
核心饮品与排版重叠或穿过排版、
玻璃杯周围漂浮的水果片、
饮品上方或后方的液体溅射、
小字的价格或菜单细节、
小字的产地 / 风味 / 地点文本块、
极简的行动呼吁（CTA）按钮、
微妙的点状纹理或图形细节、
简洁的负空间、
强烈的品牌色彩背景、
高级商业层级。
排版应感觉与饮品运动融为一体，而不是与其分离。
产品应保持最强的视觉焦点。

排版：
使用：
特粗压缩无衬线排版、
大号大写展示词汇、
宽字母间距、
简洁的菜单式微型文案、
现代饮品品牌层级、
现代UI风格标签、
高影响力的社交媒体可读性。

文本结构：
品牌名称：
[饮品品牌名称]
主宣传词：
[超大号饮品名称 / 风味 / 地点词汇]
支持行：
[简短的清爽信息]
风味/产地文本：
[来自 / 风味 / 成分 / 地点]

标题示例：
冰冷 (ICE COLD)

夏季倾倒 (SUMMER POUR)

支持行示例：
冷萃新鲜感。
大胆的夏季啜饮。
为阳光时刻而作。
酷爽口感，强大能量。
你日常的清凉逃离。
每一口都有明亮风味。
一抹纯净的清爽。

视觉系统：
围绕“运动中的饮品”视觉系统构建海报。
使用：
核心玻璃杯透视、
对角线饮品运动、
玻璃杯后的超大排版、
液体溅射冠冕、
漂浮的冰块、
新鲜水果装饰、
柔和气泡、
微妙的半色调点、
极简UI箭头、
简洁菜单按钮、
高级光影反射。
设计应感觉现代、充满活力且极具诱惑力。

背景系统：
使用单一的大胆饮品背景色。
推荐的颜色方向：
橙色柑橘渐变、
酸橙绿夏季背景、
深可乐棕、
柠檬黄、
浆果红、
冰蓝色、
薄荷绿、
桃色夕阳、
热带青色。
仅在需要时添加微妙的光影渐变和柔和焦外成像。
避免杂乱。
避免繁忙的图案。
保持饮品、溅射和排版作为主要焦点。

调色板：
主色：
[品牌背景色]
辅助色：
[饮品 / 玻璃杯高光颜色]
强调色：
[水果 / CTA / 图形细节颜色]
文本颜色：
[白色 / 奶油色 / 高对比度颜色]
在背景、排版、水果装饰、饮品高光、CTA、品牌徽标、菜单细节、图形元素中一致地使用色彩系统。

额外设计细节：
冻结的液体溅射。
漂浮的冰块。
新鲜柑橘片。
冰冷冷凝水。
大号裁剪排版。
极简价格标签。
菜单CTA按钮。
小字产地文本。
UI箭头细节。
柔和的焦外圆点。
微妙的点状纹理。
高级玻璃反射。
简洁的饮品品牌间距。

市场模板要求：
该模板必须可重用于：
冰茶品牌、
果汁店、
无酒精鸡尾酒菜单、
苏打水宣传、
咖啡馆饮品、
夏季饮料、
柠檬水品牌、
冷萃产品、
餐厅饮品菜单、
奶昔宣传、
能量饮料、
气泡水、
水果清新剂、
社交媒体饮品广告。
买家应能够更换：
品牌名称、
饮品类型、
玻璃杯图像、
水果装饰、
标题、
背景颜色、
价格、
行动呼吁（CTA）、
位置文本、
风味名称、
徽标、
网站、
社交账号、
菜单细节。

质量：
超写实饮品摄影。
高级商业饮品广告。
高端咖啡馆宣传设计。
Behance级别的构图。
Pinterest风格的饮品海报。
杂志品质的清凉广告。
简洁且适配社交媒体的布局。
8K超高清渲染。

质量控制：
不要完全复制参考图像。
不要使用相同的品牌名称。
不要使用相同的饮品名称。
不要重复相同的玻璃杯角度。
不要重复相同的排版摆放。
不要让布局过于拥挤。
不要让饮品看起来不自然。
不要让文本难以阅读。
不要将概念仅局限于一种饮料。
不要创建一个一次性的死点子。
仅保留核心理念：
清爽的核心饮品、
动态液体溅射、
漂浮的冰块和水果、
超大号集成排版、
大胆的单色背景、
菜单式UI细节、
高级饮品广告氛围、
面向市场的可编辑结构。
最终结果应感觉像是一个新鲜的高级饮品广告模板，可以作为可重用的饮品和咖啡馆宣传系统的一部分进行销售。

prompts.text:
Generate a clear, bright, design-oriented image centered around any subject: the scene uses a large area of clean, light-colored, airy background to support the subject, the subject does not appear in a complete realistic form, but is translated into several huge halftone dot outlines, parts enter from the edges and are cropped, forming light overlapping, displacement, and tension from negative space; a finer linear structure passes through the main body from below or the side, like the skeleton, path, or growth line of the subject, carrying direction and order; then add a small-scale derived symbol of the subject as a visual pause, creating breath between the large shapes and small dots. prompts.text:
Generate a [Maximalist Vector Art Magazine Cover Poster], with an aspect ratio of [Vertical 3:4 / 9:16 / Horizontal 16:9].

The theme is [Fill in theme, e.g.: Chinese Mythology Future Chronicles / Shanhaijing Urban Legends / Oriental Myth Fashion Week / Cyber Wonderland].

The image fuses [Chinese mythological elements] with [modern visual language]. The main subject can include elements such as [mythical beasts, flying apsaras, dragons, phoenixes, kirins, immortal mountains, palaces, auspicious clouds, stars, moon phases, wave patterns, flame patterns, ribbons, talismans, ancient artifacts], while incorporating [modern magazine layout, trendy posters, technical graphics, grid lines, numbering, borders, info tags, halftone dots, print grain].

The style is maximalist vector illustration: complex lines, layered overlapping, dense details, rich colors, strong decorativeness, overall like a completed high-end art magazine cover. The composition is full but has a clear visual center, with the main visual prominent and a large number of auxiliary graphics and details added around it.

The color direction is [Fill in colors, e.g.: Black Gold Vermilion Cyan / Cream White Gilded Royal Blue / Fluorescent Purple Electric Blue / Vintage Beige Cinnabar Red]. The overall look should be high-end, fashionable, and modern; do not use cheap Guochao style, avoid ordinary illustration feel, and avoid low-quality cartoon textures.

Include complete text typography:
Clear big title at the top:
"[Fill in English main title at the top]"

Chinese main title in the middle or bottom:
"[Fill in Chinese theme title]"

Auxiliary small text can include:
"[Fill in subtitle / date / number / theme short phrase]"

Text style requirements: The top title can use hazy letters, edge halftone gradients, print grain, and large magazine cover typography; the Chinese title should be clear and readable, with a sense of calligraphy or modern fonts. Add a small number of IDs, dates, column names, vertical small text, borders, and information blocks to form a complete magazine layout.

Prohibited: No real brand logos, no watermarks, no QR codes, no gibberish, no random English characters, no blank themes, no simple tiling of elements.

prompts.text:

A stylized, low-angle portrait of a young person looking upward with a serene expression. He/She is wearing large over-ear headphones and a textured red beanie. The composition is a close-up, focusing on the profile and neck, shot with a cinematic perspective.

A blend of modern pop art and digital vector illustration. The image uses bold, high-contrast shadows and clean linework.

Color Palette:
A striking limited color scheme featuring deep blacks, muted greys, vibrant red, and a specific teal/mint green accent. The background is a flat, neutral off-white with subtle, thin geometric sketch lines.

The woman's jacket and beanie feature expressive, painterly strokes of red and teal. The headphones have a glossy, metallic finish with realistic reflections. Her skin is rendered in shades of grey and teal highlights to emphasize the dramatic lighting coming from above.

Urban, artistic, and melancholic, reminiscent of high-end graphic novel cover art or a modern street-art mural.

prompts.text:
[Subject and State]
Adult East Asian woman, early twenties, natural and elegant temperament, with the maturity of high-end fashion editorial portraits. She stands in a bright indoor space by the window, looking down at the camera with calm, soft eyes and a slightly restrained sense of allure. The pose is relaxed and decent, with both hands gently lifting and spreading the hem of the white silk shirt, letting the fabric form a naturally flowing arc in front of her body. The overall presentation is an intimate, quiet, fashionable but not explicit photography atmosphere.

[Appearance and Outfit]
Naturally exquisite face, soft and clear skin, retaining real skin texture and delicate quality. Makeup is light and natural, with clean and soft facial features. Long dark brown hair is slightly fluffy, showing delicate hair layers and bright rim light in the backlight. Wearing a loose white silk shirt instead of a knit top; the shirt fabric is light, soft, with high-end luster, showing a soft translucency, fine folds, and flowing texture when sunlight penetrates. The lower body is paired with loose white drawstring loungewear pants, the overall look is clean, comfortable, and restrained.

[Environment]
Minimalist bright modern interior space by the window, light-colored walls, clean and transparent, simple furnishings. Morning or afternoon natural sunlight fills the room, the spatial atmosphere is peaceful, warm, and serene. The background is not overly complex, highlighting the subject, silk fabric, and sunlight texture.

[Composition Requirements]
Vertical 9:16 composition, very low-angle shot from below, camera position at about waist height, shooting upwards at her face and torso. The subject's face is located near the top of the frame, and the torso and white silk shirt occupy the main foreground. The abdomen is faintly visible, and the fabric is slightly stretched between both hands, forming a flowing and natural arc. The image has a sense of low-angle perspective, intimacy, and fashion editorial composition tension.

[Camera/Technical Parameters]
Ultra-realistic photography quality, 4K high resolution, true color calibration, clear natural skin texture, accurate expression of hair details, silk luster, soft fine folds, and translucent materials. The lens has a low-angle perspective effect, the subject is clear, and the background is slightly softly blurred. The overall image is exquisite, transparent, and real, and should not present a noticeable AI feel.

[Atmosphere/Lighting]
Intense natural sunlight pours in from the window behind and above her, forming bright backlighting and dazzling light beams. Light creates mottled light and shadows on the skin, white silk shirt, and interior space. The edges of the hair have a halo-like rim light, warm-toned highlights are soft and bright, and shadows are light and delicate. The overall atmosphere is transparent, warm, and quiet, with a cinematic sunlight quality.

[Style]
Ultra-realistic fashion photography, high-end editorial aesthetics, cinematic natural light portraits. Overall elegant, sensual, restrained but not explicit, emphasizing real texture, soft light and shadow, natural poses, and luxurious silk fabric performance.

[Detail Emphasis]
Emphasize the white silk shirt instead of a knit top; the fabric should be loose, light, glossy, with soft fine folds, a flowing feel, and a translucent texture under sunlight. Emphasize the low-angle perspective, both hands gently lifting the shirt hem, the fabric forming a flowing arc, abdomen faintly visible, bright backlighting, hair rim light, minimalist window-side interior, and warm peaceful atmosphere. The subject must be clearly an adult woman.

[Avoid]
Underage feel, knit tops, heavy fabrics, cheap fabric texture, excessive exposure, sexualization, stiff poses, exaggerated expressions, low resolution, facial distortion, abnormal fingers, extra limbs, excessive skin smoothing, plastic skin, blown-out whites, high-contrast shadows, cluttered background, overly studio-shot feel, obvious AI feel, cartoon style, oil painting style, fake textures, overcrowded composition.

prompts.text:
【主体与状态】  
成年东亚裔女性，二十岁出头，气质自然优雅，带有高端时尚编辑类人像的成熟感。她站在窗边明亮室内，低头望向镜头，眼神平静、柔和，略带克制的魅惑感。姿态放松而得体，双手轻轻提起并展开白色真丝衬衫的下摆，让布料在身前形成自然流动的弧线。整体呈现私密、安静、时尚但不露骨的摄影氛围。

【外貌与穿搭】  
面容自然精致，肌肤柔软清透，保留真实皮肤纹理与细腻质感。妆容清淡自然，五官干净柔和。深棕色长发略带蓬松感，在逆光中呈现细腻发丝层次与柔亮轮廓光。穿着宽松的白色真丝衬衫，而不是针织上衣；衬衫面料轻盈、柔软、带有高级光泽，阳光穿透时呈现柔和半透明感、细褶与飘逸质感。下身搭配宽松的白色抽绳家居长裤，整体干净、舒适、克制。

【环境】  
窗边的极简明亮现代室内空间，浅色墙面，干净通透，陈设简约。早晨或午后的自然阳光洒满房间，空间氛围宁静、温暖、安详。背景不过度复杂，突出人物、真丝面料与阳光质感。

【构图要求】  
竖屏9:16构图，极低角度仰拍视角，机位约在腰部高度，镜头向上拍摄她的面部与躯干。人物面部位于画面上方附近，躯干与白色真丝衬衫占据前景主体。腹部隐约可见，布料在双手之间被轻微拉展，形成流动而自然的弧线。画面具有低角度透视感、私密感与时尚编辑类构图张力。

【相机/技术参数】  
超写实摄影质感，4K高分辨率，真实色彩调校，自然肌肤纹理清晰，发丝细节、真丝光泽、柔软细褶与半透明材质表现准确。镜头具有低角度透视效果，主体清晰，背景略带柔和虚化。整体画面精致、通透、真实，不应呈现明显 AI 感。

【氛围/光线】  
强烈自然阳光从她身后上方的窗户倾泻而入，形成明亮逆光与耀眼光束。光线在肌肤、白色真丝衬衫和室内空间中产生斑驳光影。发丝边缘带有辉光般的轮廓光，暖调高光柔和明亮，阴影轻盈细腻。整体氛围通透、温暖、安静，带有电影级阳光质感。

【风格】  
超写实时尚摄影，高端编辑类美学，电影化自然光人像。整体优雅、感性、克制而不露骨，强调真实质感、柔和光影、自然姿态与奢华真丝面料表现。

【细节强调】  
强调白色真丝衬衫而非针织上衣；面料应宽松、轻盈、带光泽，具有柔软细褶、飘逸感与阳光下的半透明质感。强调低角度仰拍透视、双手轻轻提起衬衫下摆、布料形成流动弧线、腹部隐约可见、明亮逆光、发丝轮廓光、极简窗边室内与温暖宁静氛围。主体必须明确为成年女性。

【避免】  
未成年感，针织上衣，厚重面料，廉价布料质感，过度暴露，色情化，姿势僵硬，夸张表情，低清晰度，脸部变形，手指异常，多余肢体，过度磨皮，塑料皮肤，过曝死白，高反差阴影，背景杂乱，棚拍感过强，AI感明显，卡通风格，油画风格，虚假材质，构图过满。

items.title: 复古梳妆台深夜慵懒少女

prompts.text:
Create image: use the attached image.

A spontaneous late-night bedroom moment caught while getting ready at an antique wooden vanity. The subject crouches beside the dressing table, lazily holding a big makeup brush up to her mouth, lost somewhere between touching up her look and zoning out. Her face looks distant, drowsy, faintly sad, completely oblivious to the camera. A short dark bob frames her face loosely with natural movement and messy strands.

She's dressed in a black sequined open-back bodysuit, small earrings, barely any accessories. The vibe is intimate, raw, and a little messy rather than polished.

The space looks worn and lived in. An old wooden vanity with curved mirrors is set against decorative wallpaper. Lipsticks, perfume bottles, clips, loose makeup, glossy magazines, and assorted clutter are spread across the surface. Shadowy corners, scuffed furniture, and everyday items fill the background.

The person taking this photo wasn't aiming for beauty. The shot looks unintentional, poorly framed, snapped without any setup. The shutter went off during a quiet, unguarded second. The composition is sloppy and slightly off, like a photo you stumble across on an old memory card.

The subject fills around 70-80% of the frame but is clearly off-center. Empty space shows mostly on one side through the vanity mirrors, the wallpaper, and the surrounding room. Headroom is roughly 15-20%. Parts of the vanity, mirror edge, outfit, knees, and clutter on the table are awkwardly cut off by the frame.

Taken on a cheap early-2000s low-res toy digital camera. Heavy motion blur, slight hand shake, tilted framing, unplanned composition, harsh built-in flash leaving blown-out hotspots and patchy exposure, dark muddy shadows, low-saturation washed-out colors, strong digital noise, coarse sensor grain, chromatic aberration, soft plastic-lens distortion, missed focus, JPEG compression artifacts, motion smear, and 0.3-megapixel output quality.

A strong warm light leak bleeds naturally across one side of the frame. Bright zones overexpose and bloom. The toy sensor can't hold detail. Facial features are still readable but softened by blur, compression, bad focus, and tiny sensor limits. Hair strands clump together. 信任

稳定
渴望
信心

- 渴望
- 安全
- 乐观
- 信心
- 进步

A. 现代城市公寓
B. 高端城市生活场景

Instagram / LinkedIn SMM

1080 x 1350

1. HDFC 红蓝品牌色块

细微的高端亮点

Recreate this exact photo style: A candid travel photo taken at the Leaning Tower of Pisa in Pisa, Italy, shot from a low ground-level angle pointing upward, creating a forced-perspective optical illusion.
Subject: A young woman with long straight brown hair with light blonde balayage highlights, parted in the middle, hair falling past her shoulders and slightly windblown. She has a delicate layered necklace and stacked bracelets on both wrists.

She is laughing/smiling directly at the camera, head tilted slightly.
Background: The Leaning Tower of Pisa dominates the left-center of the frame, photographed at a low upward angle that exaggerates its tilt, showing its full height with all 8 levels of Romanesque white marble arched colonnades clearly visible, topped with a small red flag. Around the base, scattered tourists in casual summer clothing walk and gather on the grass. A row of metal pedestrian barriers runs along the foreground, with a round stone bollard visible near the woman's standing foot. Manicured green lawn, tall cypress and hedge trees line the right side, and a reddish stone building edge is visible in the far right background.
Lighting & color: Bright, harsh midday sunlight, hard shadows, vivid saturated deep-blue cloudless sky, warm golden-white tones on the marble tower, high contrast.

prompts.text:
SYSTEM ROLE

Your expertise includes:

Think like a fusion of:

Parle creative team
Ogilvy India

Classic Indian advertising legends

Never create generic biscuit ads, luxury-food styling, or AI-slop visuals.

TASK

Create a world-class premium social media marketing campaign poster for Parle-G.

This is not just a biscuit ad.

This is emotional storytelling rooted in Indian memory.

The design must feel warm, nostalgic, relatable, and instantly recognizable.

PRODUCT DNA

Product:
Parle-G glucose biscuit.

Parle-G is not just a biscuit.

Parle-G is a memory.

Core emotional triggers:

Chai
Childhood
Comfort
Home
Rain
Family
Everyday warmth

Brand personality:

Simple
Trustworthy
Warm
Familiar
Authentic
Timeless

Core truth:

Parle-G has been present in everyday Indian life for generations.

CONSUMER EMOTION

Trigger:

nostalgia
comfort
warmth
childhood memory
belonging
simple joy

Viewer reaction:

“This reminds me of home.”

ENVIRONMENTAL STORYTELLING

Create a realistic Indian monsoon chai environment.

Scene:

warm indoor setting
rain visible through nearby window
soft natural daylight
steam rising from hot chai
Parle-G packet on wooden table
few biscuits on steel plate
natural crumbs
slightly wet atmosphere from monsoon air

slight chai splash
biscuit about to dunk
steam visible

SOCIAL MEDIA CAMPAIGN DESIGN

heritage-inspired graphic framing

mobile readability

Indian advertising sensibility

crisp edges

chai steam

warm ambient bounce

gentle shadows
cinematic warmth

brand-safe placement

prompts.text:
系统角色

担任世界级的快速消费品品牌艺术总监、食品广告创意总监、社论平面设计师和文化叙事专家，在顶级全球代理机构运作。

Parle 创意团队
奥美印度
Pentagram

绝不要创作平庸的饼干广告、豪华食品造型或人工智能粗制滥造的视觉效果。

Parle-G 是一种记忆。

印度奶茶 (Chai)

慰藉
家
雨
家庭
日常的温暖

简单
值得信赖
温暖
亲切
真实
永恒

Parle-G 已存在于印度几代人的日常生活中。

消费者情感

触发点：

怀旧
慰藉
温暖
童年记忆
归属感
简单的快乐

这应该感觉像是一个真实的印度饮茶时刻。

英雄产品时刻

捕捉情感消费时刻。

Parle-G 饼干悬停在奶茶杯上方
轻微的奶茶溅起
饼干正要浸泡
可见蒸汽
包装袋近景
次要饼干自然排列

items.title: 夸张大头鱼眼足球涂鸦海报

prompts.text:
Create an ultra-detailed collectible football graffiti poster featuring [PLAYER NAME] wearing the official [COUNTRY] national team jersey with number [JERSEY NUMBER].

CAMERA & COMPOSITION:
Use an EXTREME 10mm ultra-wide fisheye lens from a very high bird's-eye perspective looking straight down. The player stands perfectly centered with the entire body visible from head to boots. Apply exaggerated caricature proportions with a gigantic head and slightly smaller body while maintaining recognizable facial identity and realistic anatomy. Strong perspective distortion is essential.

FACIAL EXPRESSION:
Huge expressive eyes, raised eyebrows, slightly open mouth, surprised and energetic expression. Cute and iconic. No serious expression, no smiling portrait pose, no side profile.

POSE:
Standing naturally with arms relaxed at the sides and feet fully visible. Front-facing.

BACKGROUND:
Fill every inch of the composition with chaotic football graffiti and street-art elements. No empty spaces. Create a dense layered collage with overlapping illustrations, paint splashes, doodles, sketches, tactical diagrams, symbols and typography.

INCLUDE:
• [PLAYER NAME] spray-painted in huge graffiti lettering.
• Giant [JERSEY NUMBER] integrated into the background.
• [COUNTRY] written in street-art typography.
• Country flag colors and textures.
• National team crest.
• Football tactical arrows, Xs and Os.
• Hand-drawn stars, crowns, circles, crosses and scribbles.
• Football sketches, boots and ball illustrations.
• Paint splatters, dripping ink and grunge textures.
• Stadium floodlights and cheering crowd silhouettes.
• Signature and handwritten notes.
• Small action silhouette of the player celebrating or scoring.
• Country-specific landmarks, monuments, animals, mythology, maps and cultural symbols unique to [COUNTRY].
• Multiple layers of sketches and chalk markings.
• Dynamic motion lines and graphic elements.

ART STYLE:
Premium football sticker collection, street-art mural, graffiti wall, comic book cover and collectible trading card aesthetic.

LIGHTING:
Bright stadium floodlights, cinematic HDR, rim lighting, volumetric glow, high contrast.

COLOR PALETTE:
Dominated by the colors of the national flag with vibrant reds, blues, whites, greens, yellows or blacks depending on [COUNTRY].

QUALITY:
Hyper-realistic, 8K, ultra-sharp focus, rich textures, ray tracing, global illumination, depth of field, masterpiece quality.

CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Extreme fisheye distortion.

Massive head and smaller body caricature proportions.

Wide-open eyes and shocked expression.

Full body visible.

Player perfectly centered.

Dense graffiti filling the entire frame.

No empty areas.

Fun collectible poster look.

Similar to premium football street-art trading cards.

Highly detailed and visually overwhelming.

Iconic and energetic.

Aspect Ratio 9:16 Inspired by exaggerated fisheye caricature posters, collectible football sticker art, graffiti murals, and pop-surreal sports illustrations, with a giant head, tiny body, and dense wall-to-wall doodle composition.

prompts.text:

面部表情：
巨大的表现力眼睛，挑起的眉毛，微张的嘴巴，惊讶且充满活力的表情。可爱且具有标志性。不要严肃表情，不要微笑的人像姿势，不要侧脸。

姿势：

Please generate a professional short drama / web series casting call long image. The overall look should be like a real film and television project casting call, a short drama project introduction long image, or a series visual proposal, rather than a common poster.

Image Structure Requirements:

The top is the series main visual cover area, which must have a strong film and television atmosphere, a large drama title, and characters or scene main visuals. The cover area must be attractive and have movie-poster-level visual impact. The drama title should have a clear sense of design, using styles like calligraphy, plaque characters, gold outlines, seals, vertical subtitles, and genre tags to enhance recognition.

The middle is the project information area, designed as neat, exquisite, and layered information card modules. It can include: project information, work introduction, genre, number of episodes, episode duration, start date, filming location, production company, co-producer, production firm, executive production team, etc. The information should be like a real casting call case—specific, complete, and professional—without vague placeholders.

The middle section should include a creative team area, which can include: Publisher, Chief Producer, Producer, Director, Writer, Director of Photography, Art Director, Visual Director, etc. If specific names are not provided, please automatically generate a set of realistic Chinese names to make the image look like a complete case.

The lower part is the character bio area, designing 4-6 character card modules based on the uploaded character bios. Each character card includes the character's name, gender/age, personality keywords, and a brief character introduction, paired with small character silhouettes, avatar-style illustrations, scroll cards, borders, tags, or decorative graphics. Character information must be specific; do not use "Character A", "Character B", or "XXX".

The bottom adds the casting team, contact information, data submission email, contact phone number, Staff, and other modules, making the whole image a complete loop, like a real short drama casting call long image that can be sent to actor groups, industry groups, and WeChat Moments.

【题材类型】：古装甜宠 / 仙侠虐恋 / 志怪悬疑 / 宫廷权谋 / 民国情感 / 都市短剧 / 悬疑刑侦
【整体风格】：填写风格，例如：古风水墨、黑金权谋、朱砂志怪、米白甜宠、清冷仙侠、民国复古、都市电影感
【主色调】：填写主色调，例如：墨绿朱砂、黑金暗红、米白橘红、青灰银白、复古棕金、都市冷灰
【顶部主视觉】：填写主视觉方向，例如：男女主对望、女主独立宫阙前、古镇灯会、雪山仙门、民国街巷、都市夜景
【画幅比例】：超长竖版 1:3
【信息完整度】：如果我没有提供完整项目信息，请自动补全一套真实感案例信息，不要出现“XXX”“待定”“某某”等空泛占位。
【开机时间】：默认设置为 2026 年下半年的某个具体日期，例如 2026年8月、9月、10月或11月。
【清晰度要求】：整张图必须高清、清晰、锐利，文字区域和图形边缘不能糊，不能低清晰度。

请生成一张专业的短剧 / 网剧组讯长图，整体像真实影视项目选角组讯、短剧项目介绍长图、剧集视觉提案，而不是普通海报。

画面结构要求：

顶部是剧集主视觉封面区，要有强烈的影视剧氛围、剧名大标题、人物或场景主视觉。封面区必须吸引人，有剧集海报级视觉冲击力。剧名标题要有明显设计感，可以使用书法字、牌匾字、金色描边、印章、竖排副标题、类型标签等方式增强辨识度。

中间是项目信息区，设计成规整、精致、有层级的资料卡模块。可以包含：项目信息、作品简介、题材类型、集数、单集时长、开机时间、拍摄地点、出品公司、联合出品、制作公司、承制团队等内容。信息要像真实组讯案例，具体、完整、有项目感，不要出现空泛占位。

中段加入主创团队区，可以包含：出品人、总制片人、制片人、导演、编剧、摄影指导、美术指导、视觉总监等信息。如果没有提供具体名字，请自动生成一套真实感中文姓名，让画面更像完整案例。

下方是人物小传区，根据上传的人物小传设计 4-6 个角色卡片模块。每个角色卡包含角色名、性别年龄、人设关键词、简短人物介绍，并搭配小型人物剪影、头像感插图、卷轴卡片、边框、标签或装饰图形。角色信息要具体，不要使用“角色A”“角色B”“XXX”。

底部加入选角团队、联系方式、资料投递邮箱、联系电话、Staff 等模块，让整张图形成完整闭环，像可以发到演员群、行业群、朋友圈的真实短剧组讯长图。

视觉质感要求：

整体要高级、丰富、精致、图文并茂、有氛围感、有视觉冲击力。根据题材匹配合适的视觉元素，例如：宣纸纹理、水墨晕染、金色线框、朱砂印章、卷轴卡片、宫殿、山水、灯笼、云雾、花枝、雪山、月光、民国街巷、都市灯光等。配色要统一，标题要漂亮，信息板块要清晰，图形装饰要精细。

文字要求：

允许生成清晰中文标题、短句和重点信息，让画面看起来像完整案例。但不要生成满屏密密麻麻的小字，不要乱码中文，不要错误重复文字，不要让文字压住主视觉。如果信息较多，可以把内容拆成两张 1:3 长图拼接，类似电商详情页的处理方法。

最终效果：

一张 1:3 超长竖版短剧 / 网剧组讯长图，顶部有强封面，中间有项目信息和主创团队，下方有人物小传和联系方式。整体清晰、高级、专业、丰富、精致，像真实可用的影视项目组讯案例。

纯果乐传递的是瓶装的新鲜。

心理定位：

晨间活力。

受众

目标受众：

- 家庭
- 专业人士
- 注重健康的消费者
- 年轻人
- 大众高端市场

受众动机：

- 健康选择
- 新鲜感
- 更美好的早晨
- 天然营养

情感驱动力：

能量
新鲜
乐观
健康

情感框架

触发因素：

- 新鲜
- 活力
- 食欲
- 积极
- 自然能量

期望的观众反应：

“这看起来很新鲜，让人无法抗拒。”

环境

创建一个高端的阳光充足的早餐环境。

场景包括：

明亮的厨房台面
柔和的清晨阳光
干净的大理石表面
自然的深度
微妙的背景虚化

环境保持次要地位。

视觉构图

平台：
Instagram SMM

纵横比：
4:5 纵向

分辨率：
1080 x 1350

构图层级：

顶部 25%
活动标题

中心 55%
主角瓶身/纸盒 + 水果飞溅

底部 20%
品牌块 + 行动呼吁 (CTA)

构图比例：

35% 产品主体
35% 水果架构
30% 平面设计

使用强有力的焦距层级。

品牌资产

强制性资产：

1. 纯果乐 Logo
2. 叶子图案
3. 橙色水果几何图形
4. 包装轮廓

在构图中使用圆形水果形状。

色彩系统

主色：

纯果乐橙 (Tropicana Orange)
叶绿色 (Leaf Green)

辅助色：

白色
黄色高光

色彩规则：

橙色占主导。
绿色支撑新鲜感。
白色增加清晰度。

排版系统

排版起到视觉支撑作用。

使用：

- 粗体简洁的无衬线体
- 高端的可读性
- 强大的层级结构
- 整洁的间距

标题示例：

SIP
SUNSHINE

或

FRESH
START

排版应感觉明亮且现代。

平面设计系统

使用高端 SMM 叠加层。

包括：

- 圆形水果框
- 整洁的社论标签
- 受叶子启发的曲线
- 分层渐变
- 微妙的几何框架

设计语言必须感觉：

新鲜
高端
简洁
充满活力

灯光

使用奢华的商业产品灯光。

灯光设置：

明亮的晨曦
柔和的补光
干净的高光
多汁的反光

灯光必须塑造出新鲜感。

微观细节

包括：

冷凝水滴
果汁飞溅弧线
橙肉质感
水果纤维
玻璃反光
高端阴影

每个细节都必须是刻意为之的。

行动呼吁 (CTA)

示例：

Sip Sunshine
Start Fresh
Taste the Morning

CTA must feel optimistic.

硬约束

严格拒绝：

- 平庸的果汁广告
- 人造 CGI 水果
- 过度饱和的颜色
- 凌乱的飞溅
- 无力的排版
- 拥挤的布局
- AI 瑕疵

自我评估循环

评估：

品牌契合度 /10
新鲜感 /10
食欲吸引力 /10
布局质量 /10
SMM 视觉冲击力 /10
独创性 /10

如果任何得分 < 9：
优化输出。

最终质量标准

最终结果必须感觉像是由顶级创意代理机构打造的高端全球纯果乐营销活动。

prompts.text:
Generate a hyper-realistic commercial food photography piece, the theme is [Product Name], and the style is a modern high-end food brand advertisement.

Composition:
Use a minimalist commercial advertisement composition, with the subject located in the middle or slightly to one side, leaving clean negative space around for brand titles and short phrases. The frame should be balanced and restrained, without being crowded with decorations.

Background:
The background is soft beige, creamy white, light apricot, or a low-saturation warm color. Natural sunlight shines in from the upper side, forming slight leaf or window shadows on the background. A small amount of soft-focus greenery, glass reflections, or table edges can be added to the foreground to create a shallow depth of field and a sense of airiness.

Typography:
Add a small amount of modern Chinese brand typography to the frame; the text should be concise, clean, and like a high-end food advertisement. It is suggested to include a Chinese main title [Chinese Main Title] and a short slogan [Chinese Short Slogan]. The font style is modern sans-serif or elegant light Songti, with restrained layout and font sizes that do not overpower the product. If Chinese text is unstable, leave clean blank spaces for later addition.

Lighting:
Soft natural daylight, warm highlights, shallow depth of field, slight rim light on the edges of the subject, soft shadows, overall bright but not washed out.

Color:
Low-saturation premium tones, with the product's own color as the visual focus, paired with beige, cream, light brown, and natural green. The overall feel is fresh, clean, modern, and approachable yet premium.

Quality:
Hyper-realistic high-end commercial food photography, high-definition details, real textures, professional advertising photography, exquisite composition, shallow depth of field, 4:5 or 1:1 ratio.

→ 连接
→ 转型
→ 影响

观众反应：

“Wipro 让智能动起来。”

环境叙述

将构图置于高端的现实环境设计中。

选择其一：

- 全球创新实验室
- 智慧城市金融区
- 协作式玻璃办公空间
- 先进运营中心

环境规则：

真实的建筑  
微妙的人物存在  
电影般的气氛  
高端材料  
柔和的深度  
奢华写实主义  

技术必须感觉嵌入在环境中。

使用灵感来自 Wipro 品牌标识的微妙数据路径和流动的连接线。

不要虚假的全息图。

环境应该感到充满活力和积极。

布局系统

宽高比：
4:5 纵向
1080×1350

构图：
35% 排版
50% 环境
15% 编辑信息

网格：
严格的模块化编辑系统

层级：

第 1 层 — 主体环境
第 2 层 — 巨型排版
第 3 层 — 微观编辑细节
第 4 层 — 徽标 + 行动呼吁 (CTA)

排版与环境互动。

排版

排版是表现性的建筑。

风格：
大胆的现代无衬线体
大写字母
高端编辑间距
强烈的视觉节奏

标题示例：

CONNECTING
WHAT’S
NEXT

排版应感到自信且前行。

调色板

主色：
深 Wipro 紫
宝蓝色

辅助色：
石墨色
柔白色

强调色：
标志性的 Wipro 光谱强调色：
黄色
青色
粉色
绿色
橙色

颜色使用规则：

90% 克制的色调
10% 受控的光谱强调色

使用彩虹色仅作为战略亮点。

绝不能盖过构图。

核心视觉效果

创建一个高端的环境主体视觉效果。

可能的处理方式：

- 带有流动数据路径的创新实验室
- 带有连接网络节点的城市基础设施
- 带有抽象能量轨迹的协作办公空间
- 由智能系统链接的建筑结构

视觉质量：

超写实
高端商业摄影
高端反射
体积光
高端电影阴影

 lighting：
蓝调时刻
柔和的环境辉光
受控的高光

设计语言

融合：

Wipro 品牌 DNA
+
Apple 的克制
+
Wired 的编辑活力
+
Murphy / Diplomeme 的构图

美学：
动感的奢华企业沟通

微观细节

包括：

- 编辑标签
- 微观排版
- 微妙的指标
- 细连接线
- 高端深度层
- 柔和辉光
- 精确的间距
- 光学对齐

每个细节都必须是深思熟虑的。

prompts.text:

The core subject stands in the visual center and crosses the text layer, partially obscuring the giant characters, forming a clear hierarchy of 'the background is cut open by text, the subject walks out of the text.' At the top, keep sparse, restrained, and wide-spaced small information text. At the bottom, set a heavier main title and a small amount of auxiliary information. Colors are extracted from the theme's own material, environment, and mood: large areas of high-brightness clean base colors provide breathing space and structural white space; theme environmental colors serve as medium-area vivid support; the main subject color remains clearly identifiable; a small amount of high-saturation accent colors are used only for emotional focuses and information nodes; dark colors mainly serve text readability and visual weight. Edge treatment should be sharp, giant character cuts clean and powerful, with internal images and external white space forming clear graphic tension. prompts.text:
Please create a set of 9 'high-budget realistic underwater wedding photos' based on the clear two-person portrait reference photo I uploaded, all in 3:4 vertical composition, as independent images, no collages.

Strictly preserve the real face shapes, facial proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, sense of age, hairstyle characteristics, and overall identity of the bride and groom from the reference. No face-swapping, do not turn them into strangers, no 'internet celebrity' faces, no anime style, no plastic fake faces. Both must be adults with a real couple/newlywed aura.

The overall style is: high-budget real underwater photography, cinematic wedding masterpiece, underwater ballet, romantic yet powerful, strong sense of movement, strong vitality, elegant body lines, and real emotions. The images should look like they were taken by a real photography team in a deep water pool or underwater studio, not an AI-synthesized feel, not ordinary studio wedding photos.

The scene is unified as a deep water pool or underwater studio, the water is a high-end blue-green, the images have real underwater refraction, floating particles, bubbles, pool bottom ripple light, and water ripple light and shadow on the skin. Light comes from above the water, forming natural backlighting, rim lighting, and soft shadows. The images can have slight film grain and cinematic color grading.

Clothing settings:
The bride wears a white underwater wedding dress, which can be a light tulle skirt, a satin slip wedding dress, a boned corset wedding dress, a long-tail gown, a translucent veil, or a long gauze sash. The wedding dress must float, unfold, and entwine naturally in the water, creating a misty and flowing feel, but must not cover the face too much.
The groom wears a white wet shirt or an open white shirt and black trousers, or can be partially shirtless with black trousers, overall clean, high-end, restrained, like an underwater movie male lead. The fabric should have a realistic skin-clinging texture and floating folds after being completely soaked.

Action requirements:
Each image must have different poses, different distances, different angles, and different relational tensions. Including horizontal floating, inverted approach, lifting, hand-held sinking, embracing and rotating, offset kissing, arched back, skirt unfolding, and bubble bursts. Human body proportions must be real and natural, with correct structure of fingers, toes, and limbs, no limb deformation.

Emotional requirements:
Do not use ordinary sweet poses; it should be like an underwater love movie. It can include proximity, salvation, falling, suspension, indulgence, tugging, reunion, and a sense of oath. Realistic eyes with a sense of breath and tension, no hollow eyes.

Quality requirements:
Shot with a real professional camera, high-end underwater photography, clear skin texture, real water flow, real bubbles, real fabric movement, cinematic light and shadow, soft but with contrast. No excessive skin smoothing, no cheap blue light, no plastic skin, no fake underwater effects, no studio backgrounds, no cartoons, no collages, no text, no watermarks.

01｜Underwater Vow: Horizontal floating kiss
No. 1: Underwater vow. The groom and bride float horizontally in deep blue-green water, bodies almost parallel, leaning in for a gentle kiss. The bride wears a white tulle wedding dress, the skirt and veil unfolding like clouds behind her; the groom wears a soaked white shirt and black trousers, one hand supporting the bride's lower back, the other gently holding her shoulder. Fine bubbles surround them, backlight shines from above the water, and real water ripple light is on the edges of their faces, necks, collarbones, and arms. The composition is romantic but not cheesy, like a high-budget underwater movie poster.
02｜Bubble Burst: Bride leaning back
No. 2: The moment of a bubble burst. The bride leans back in the water, her reddish-brown or black wet hair spread out, the white wedding dress clinging to her body while floating at the waist, and the veil surging upwards. The groom approaches from the side-rear of the frame, one hand steadily supporting her back, the other holding her wrist. A large volume of bubbles rises between the two, obscuring part of the background but not the outlines of the subjects. The image has a strong sense of movement, breath, and vitality, like a real underwater photography snapshot, not a pose.
03｜Inverted Proximity: Underwater weightlessness
No. 3: Inverted proximity. The groom's body is inverted, floating downwards from the top of the frame, the bride floats face-up below, their faces close but not yet kissing, separated by a layer of fine bubbles. The groom's white shirt spreads in the water like translucent white gauze; the bride's wedding dress skirt is spread over the light and shadow on the pool floor, her hair floating naturally. The image focuses on the sense of weightlessness, body tension, top-down composition, and underwater light and shadow, like a frame from a romantic fantasy movie.
04｜Underwater Lift: Powerful wedding photo
No. 4: Underwater lift. The groom kneels on the pool floor or is semi-suspended, lifting the bride's waist and back with both hands. The bride's body stretches upwards, one hand reaching towards the water surface, the other lightly resting on the groom's shoulder. The white wedding dress long skirt blooms upwards in the water like a giant white flower. The groom wears a white shirt and black trousers, his posture stable and powerful. There are obvious ripple lights on the pool floor, small bubbles around the characters, and the image has both the softness of the wedding dress and the strength of a dance lift.
05｜牽手下沉：Escape movie feel
No. 5: Hand-in-hand sinking. The groom and bride slowly sink deeper into the water together, the bodies forming a diagonal composition. The bride wears a light white trailing wedding dress, the long veil pulling out a long streamline behind her; the groom wears an open white shirt and black trousers, looking back to hold the bride's hand. The two are not looking at the camera, but at each other or deep underwater. The image has a cinematic feel of escaping reality and falling into a blue dream together, dynamic, free, and full of life.
06｜White Veil Storm: Wedding dress as the subject
No. 6: White veil storm. The frame focuses on the bride's ultra-long white veil and wedding dress skirt unfolding extensively in the water, surrounding the two like clouds, waves, or smoke. The bride is close to the camera in a half-body shot, her face clear and real, her gaze calm and firm; the groom holds her from the side behind her, his face lit by soft light. The white veil must not completely cover the face but should form a richly layered translucent foreground. A large amount of underwater particles, bubbles, and backlighting from above make the image look like a high-end fashion magazine cover.
07｜Pool Floor Reunion: Low-angle intimacy
No. 7: Pool floor reunion. The bride lies on her side or half-kneels on the pool floor, the white wedding dress spread out, wet hair close to her neck; the groom kneels on one knee in front of her, gently kissing the back of her hand or moving close to her forehead. Their posture is like an underwater wedding vow, but not a typical proposal pose, more cinematic and restrained. Shot from a low angle, the pool floor ripple light is clear, the background is deep blue water, and bubbles slowly rise from behind them. The image is quiet, sacred, and romantic, with a real sense of underwater weight.
08｜Rotating Embrace: Underwater double dance
No. 8: Rotating embrace. The groom and bride embrace and rotate in the water, their bodies forming an elegant arc composition. The groom supports the bride's waist and back with one hand and holds her hand with the other; the bride has one leg naturally bent and the other extended backwards, the white wedding dress skirt carrying a flowing arc from the rotation. The hair, clothes, and bubbles of both people show water flow movement in the same direction. The image is like underwater ballet and also like the climax of a wedding movie, with elegance, power, and romance existing simultaneously.
09｜Surface Backlight: The final kiss
No. 9: Surface backlight final kiss. The two are close to the water surface, the bride's white veil floats to the surface, and the water surface reflection is like a silver mirror. The groom lightly supports the bride from below, their foreheads touching or about to kiss. Sunlight penetrates down from the water surface, forming bright rim light on their faces, necks, shoulders, and the edges of the wedding dress. The background is simple deep blue, with only a few bubbles and water ripples. The image is like a movie ending, quiet, pure, and affectionate, but still has the dynamic feel of real underwater photography.

prompts.text:
请基于我上传的清晰双人人像参考图，创作一组 9 张「高预算真实水下婚纱照」，全部为 3:4 竖构图，分别独立成片，不要拼图。

必须严格保留参考中新郎和新娘本人的真实脸型、五官比例、眼睛、鼻子、嘴唇、肤色、年龄感、发型特征和整体辨识度。不能换脸，不能变成陌生人，不能网红脸，不能动漫化，不能塑料假脸。两个人都必须是成年人，真实情侣/新人气质。

整体风格为：超高预算真实水下摄影、电影感婚纱大片、水下芭蕾、浪漫但有力量、动态感强、生命力强、身体线条优雅、情绪真实。画面像真实摄影团队在深水泳池或水下摄影棚拍摄，不是 AI 合成感，不是普通影楼婚纱照。

场景统一为深水泳池或水下摄影棚，水体呈高级蓝绿色，画面有真实水下折射、漂浮微粒、气泡、池底波纹光、皮肤上的水纹光影。光线来自水面上方，形成自然逆光、轮廓光和柔和阴影。画面可以有轻微胶片颗粒和电影调色。

服装设定：
新娘穿白色水下婚纱，可以是轻盈薄纱裙、缎面吊带婚纱、鱼骨胸衣婚纱、长拖尾纱裙、半透明头纱或长纱披帛。婚纱必须在水中自然漂浮、展开、缠绕，形成云雾感和流动感，但不能遮住脸太多。
新郎穿白色湿衬衫或敞开的白衬衫、黑色西裤，也可以部分赤裸上身搭配黑色长裤，整体干净、高级、克制、像水下电影男主。衣料要有真实湿透后的贴肤质感和漂浮褶皱。

动作要求：
每一张都要有不同姿态、不同距离、不同角度和不同关系张力。包括横向漂浮、倒置靠近、托举、牵手下沉、拥抱旋转、错位亲吻、背部弓起、裙摆展开、气泡爆发。人物身体比例真实自然，手指、脚趾、四肢结构正确，不能肢体变形。

情绪要求：
不要普通甜蜜摆拍，要像一场水下爱情电影。可以有靠近、救赎、坠落、悬浮、沉溺、拉扯、重逢、誓言感。眼神真实，有呼吸感和张力，不要眼神空洞。

画质要求：
真实专业相机拍摄，高级水下摄影，清晰皮肤质感，真实水流、真实气泡、真实布料运动，电影级光影，柔和但有对比。不要过度磨皮，不要廉价蓝光，不要塑料皮肤，不要假水下效果，不要影楼背景，不要卡通，不要拼图，不要文字，不要水印。

01｜水下誓吻：横向漂浮亲吻
第 1 张：水下誓吻。新郎和新娘在深蓝绿色水中横向漂浮，身体几乎平行，彼此靠近轻轻亲吻。新娘穿白色薄纱婚纱，裙摆和头纱在身后像云一样展开；新郎穿湿透的白衬衫和黑色西裤，一只手托住新娘腰背，另一只手轻扶她肩膀。两人周围有细密气泡，水面上方逆光照下，脸部边缘、肩颈、锁骨和手臂有真实水纹光。构图浪漫但不俗气，像高预算水下电影海报。
02｜气泡爆发：新娘后仰
第 2 张：气泡爆发瞬间。新娘在水中后仰，红棕色或黑色湿发散开，白色婚纱贴合身体又在腰侧漂浮，头纱向上翻涌。新郎从画面侧后方靠近，一只手稳稳托住她的背，另一只手牵住她的手腕。大量气泡从两人中间升起，遮住部分背景但不遮住主体轮廓。画面有强烈动态感、呼吸感和生命力，像真实水下摄影抓拍，不是摆拍。
03｜倒置靠近：水下失重感
第 3 张：倒置靠近。新郎身体倒置，从画面上方向下漂浮，新娘在下方仰面漂浮，两人脸部接近但尚未亲吻，中间隔着一层细密气泡。新郎白衬衫在水中散开，像半透明白纱；新娘的婚纱裙摆铺在池底光影上，头发自然漂浮。画面重点表现失重感、身体张力、上下构图和水下光影，像一帧浪漫奇幻电影。
04｜水下托举：力量感婚纱照
第 4 张：水下托举。新郎跪在池底或半悬浮，用双手托起新娘腰部和背部。新娘身体向上舒展，一只手伸向水面，另一只手轻搭新郎肩膀，白色婚纱长裙在水中向上盛放，像一朵巨大的白色花。新郎穿白衬衫黑西裤，姿态稳定有力量。池底有明显波纹光，人物周围有细小气泡，画面既有婚纱的柔美，也有舞蹈托举的力量感。
05｜牵手下沉：逃婚电影感
第 5 张：牵手下沉。新郎和新娘在水中一起向深处缓慢下沉，身体呈对角线构图。新娘穿轻盈白色拖尾婚纱，长头纱在身后拉出很长的流线；新郎穿敞开的白衬衫和黑色西裤，回头牵住新娘的手。两人不是看镜头，而是看向彼此或水下深处。画面有逃离现实、一起坠入蓝色梦境的电影感，动态、自由、有生命力。
06｜白纱风暴：婚纱成为主体
第 6 张：白纱风暴。画面重点表现新娘的超长白色头纱和婚纱裙摆在水中大面积展开，像云、浪、烟雾一样围绕两人。新娘半身靠近镜头，脸部清晰真实，眼神平静坚定；新郎在她身后侧方抱住她，脸部被柔光照亮。白纱不能完全遮住脸，要形成层次丰富的半透明前景。大量水下微粒、气泡和上方逆光，让画面像高级时尚杂志封面。
07｜池底重逢：低机位亲密感
第 7 张：池底重逢。新娘侧躺或半跪在池底，白色婚纱铺开，湿发贴近肩颈；新郎在她面前单膝跪地，轻轻吻她的手背或靠近她额头。两人姿态像水下婚礼誓言，但不要普通求婚摆拍，要更电影、更克制。低机位拍摄，池底波纹光清晰，背景是深蓝水体，气泡从两人身后缓慢上升。画面安静、神圣、浪漫，有真实水下重量感。
08｜旋转拥抱：水下双人舞
第 8 张：旋转拥抱。新郎和新娘在水中旋转拥抱，身体形成优雅的圆弧构图。新郎一只手托住新娘腰背，另一只手牵住她的手；新娘一条腿自然弯曲，另一条腿向后延展，白色婚纱裙摆被旋转带出流动弧线。两人的头发、衣服、气泡都呈现同一方向的水流运动。画面像水下芭蕾，也像婚礼电影高潮片段，优雅、力量、浪漫同时存在。
09｜水面逆光：最后一吻
第 9 张：水面逆光最后一吻。两人靠近水面下方，新娘的白色头纱漂浮到水面，水面反光像银色镜面。新郎从下方轻托新娘，两人额头相抵或即将亲吻。阳光从水面穿透下来，在他们的脸、脖颈、肩膀和婚纱边缘形成明亮轮廓光。背景简洁深蓝，只有少量气泡和水纹。画面像电影结尾，安静、纯净、深情，但仍然有真实水下摄影的动态感。

prompts.text:
Please generate an [Ultra-wide Science Popularization Long Scroll], a single complete image, no collage, no multi-grid, no columns.

Dimensions: Horizontal 3:1, suitable for science posters, exhibition board visuals, knowledge visualization long images, and content creation references.

[Theme Type]: Solar system planets / Evolution of life on Earth / Evolution of human civilization / Evolution of science
[Main Title]: Fill in the title of this long scroll
[Expansion Logic]: Expand horizontally in sequence / Expand by timeline / Expand by evolution chain / Expand by progressive knowledge structure
[Main Content]: Fill in the core stages, objects, or knowledge points to be displayed in this image
[Style Direction]: High-end science exhibition board / Museum long scroll / Science museum infographic / Knowledge visualization poster
[Color Tone]: Fill in according to the theme, such as deep space blue, natural earth colors, museum neutrals, tech blue-gray, etc.
[Supplementary Requirements]: Fill in content to be emphasized

The overall image must be a single complete ultra-wide horizontal long scroll, adopting a left-to-right reading logic. The key is not ordinary illustration, nor simple collage, but clearly visualizing continuous knowledge structures, time progression, evolutionary relationships, or scale changes in one long image.

The image should have a strong sense of structure, a strong sense of information, and high collection value. Small titles, labels, time nodes, name descriptions, small notes, arrows, orbital lines, structural lines, or stage separation prompts can be added, but the layout must be neat and restrained, cannot be too full of text, and cannot be like a densely packed textbook page. The overall style is more like a high-end museum board, science museum long scroll, or knowledge visualization poster.

The image should highlight a core advantage:
The ultra-wide horizontal format is particularly suitable for clearly explaining complex content that "unfolds continuously from left to right," accommodating a large amount of knowledge structures and visual information at once, an effect that is difficult for ordinary aspect ratios to achieve.

Overall style requirements: Clear, rational, professional, possessing visual tension and reading rhythm, with both ornamental value and a sense of science popularization. Backgrounds and color schemes can change according to the theme, but the overall must be unified, coherent, and readable.

Avoid: Collage feel, multi-grids, columns, children's cartoon feel, pure wallpaper feel, messy information, overcrowded text, element piling, unclear structure, chaotic stage order, low resolution, irrelevant decorative text.

prompts.text:
请生成一张【超宽科学科普长卷】，单张完整图片，不要拼图，不要多宫格，不要分栏。

尺寸：横版 3:1，适合做科普海报、展板视觉、知识可视化长图、内容创作参考。

【主题类型】：太阳系行星 / 地球生命演进 / 人类文明演进 / 科学演进
【主标题】：填写本张长卷的标题
【展开逻辑】：按顺序横向展开 / 按时间线展开 / 按演化链展开 / 按知识结构递进展开
【主要内容】：填写本张图要展示的核心阶段、对象或知识点
【风格方向】：高级科普展板 / 博物馆长卷 / 科学馆信息图 / 知识可视化海报
【色调】：根据主题填写，例如深空蓝、自然土色、博物馆中性色、科技蓝灰等
【补充要求】：填写想强调的内容

整体画面必须是一张完整的超宽横向长卷，采用从左到右的阅读逻辑。重点不是普通插画，也不是简单拼贴，而是把连续的知识结构、时间推进、演化关系或尺度变化，清晰地可视化在一张长图里。

画面应具有强结构感、强信息感和较高的收藏价值。可以加入少量标题、标签、时间节点、名称说明、小型注释、箭头、轨道线、结构线或阶段分隔提示，但排版必须整洁克制，不能文字过满，不能像密密麻麻的教材页。整体更像高级博物馆展板、科学馆长卷、知识可视化海报。

画面要突出一个核心优势：
超宽横图特别适合讲清楚“从左到右连续展开”的复杂内容，能一次性容纳大量知识结构和视觉信息，普通画幅很难做到这种完整展开效果。

整体风格要求：清晰、理性、专业、具有视觉张力和阅读节奏，既有观赏性，也有科普感。可以根据主题变化背景和配色，但整体必须统一、连贯、易读。

避免：拼图感、多宫格、分栏、儿童卡通感、纯壁纸感、信息杂乱、文字过满、元素堆砌、结构不清、阶段顺序混乱、低清晰度、无关装饰文字。

The overall style is [Oriental New Luxury / Minimalist High-end / Natural Organic / Young National Trend / New Chinese Elegant / Vintage Collectible / Holiday Gift / Light Luxury Souvenir / French Dessert Style / Japanese Minimalist Style / Regional Cultural Style]. The back design needs to include the product name, ingredients list, allergen warnings, nutrition facts table, production information, storage methods, consumption suggestions, executive standards, production license number, manufacturer information, barcode, QR code, environmental protection labels, and production batch number reservation area. Overall image requirements: award-winning pastry packaging design, premium bakery packaging, high-end confectionery packaging, luxury e-commerce dessert gift box, production-ready packaging blueprint, manufacturer-ready dieline layout, structural packaging engineering drawing, realistic paper texture, refined typography, premium brand identity system, elegant food packaging design, photorealistic 3D packaging mockup, detailed printing process annotations, CMYK print-ready layout, Pantone color system, gold foil stamping, embossed logo, debossed texture, spot UV details, food-grade PET window, inner tray structure, sustainable food packaging, premium gift box design, clean white studio background, soft natural lighting, ultra detailed, high resolution, commercial product design board

prompts.text:
为【品牌名】设计一套可量产的高端电商糕点包装设计方案。产品名称为【产品名】，产品类型为【糕点类型】，品牌定位为【品牌定位】，目标人群为【目标用户】。包装类型为【天地盖礼盒 / 抽屉盒 / 开窗彩盒 / 手提礼盒 / 磁吸礼盒 / 彩盒 / 纸筒 / 软袋 / 电商运输礼盒】，成品尺寸为【长 × 宽 × 高 mm】，内装规格为【数量】枚或【组合装】，单枚规格为【单枚重量或尺寸】。    

请设计一张专业级高端电商糕点包装设计提案板。整体需达到国际包装设计奖项级水准，兼具品牌识别度、电商主图吸引力、货架陈列效果、送礼价值感、结构合理性、印刷可行性、运输保护性和厂家量产落地性。

整体风格为【东方新奢 / 极简高级 / 自然有机 / 年轻国潮 / 新中式雅致 / 复古收藏 / 节日礼赠 / 轻奢伴手礼 / 法式甜点风 / 日式简约风 / 地域文化风】。视觉气质应高级、精致、干净、有食欲、有品牌记忆点，避免廉价感、杂乱感和模板感。色彩方案以【主色】为主，搭配【辅助色】和【点缀色】，整体色彩应符合产品口味、品牌定位和送礼场景。

画面为横版专业包装设计提案板，清晰分区，排版高级，留白合理，信息完整，包含：主视觉 3D 包装效果图、包装正面 Front、背面 Back、左侧 Left、右侧 Right、顶部 Top、底部 Bottom、开盒内部结构、糕点内托展示、完整展开刀模图、尺寸标注、线型图例、材料说明、印刷工艺说明、局部工艺放大图、色彩方案、字体方案和厂家生产说明。

主视觉 3D 包装效果图需展示包装盒 45° 立体视角，包装材质真实，纸张纹理细腻，盒体厚度清晰，结构合理，光影柔和高级。周围可搭配真实糕点、原料、茶具、餐盘、木托盘、丝带、花材、谷物、坚果、水果、奶油、芝麻、蛋黄、红豆、可可、蜂蜜、麦穗、节日元素或地域文化元素，营造高级电商主图氛围。糕点颜色和形态需符合具体产品类型，不限定为绿色。

正面设计需包含品牌名、产品名、英文辅助名、核心卖点、净含量、规格信息、品牌符号和主视觉图案。主视觉可以使用糕点实拍、插画、纹样、开窗结构、东方图形、地域文化符号、原料图形、抽象品牌符号或节日图案。构图需有强烈记忆点，适合电商缩略图点击。

背面设计需包含产品名称、配料表、过敏原提示、营养成分表、生产信息、储存方式、食用建议、执行标准、生产许可证编号、厂家信息、条形码、二维码、环保标识和生产批号预留区。信息层级清晰，排版真实可信。左右侧面需包含品牌口号、产品系列名、口味标识、开盒方向、装饰纹样或品牌辅助图形。顶部展示品牌符号、礼盒开启方式、封口结构或主视觉延展图案。底部展示折叠结构、生产批号位置、环保标识或简化信息区。

内部结构展示需包含食品级 PET 内托、环保纸浆内托、纸卡隔断、独立小盒、独立包装袋或防油纸内衬。每枚糕点独立放置，体现防震、防压、防串味、防油污和电商运输安全。糕点造型真实、有食欲，色彩自然高级。

展开刀模图需展示完整包装展开结构，包含正面、背面、左右侧面、顶部、底部、插舌、锁扣、粘胶位、开窗区域、内托示意、条码二维码位置、尺寸标注和工艺版位。刀模图必须像真实包装工程图，比例准确，线型清晰，适合厂家打样参考。

刀模图必须清晰、专业、可量产，所有单位为 mm。线型图例必须标注：红色实线 = 裁切线 / 刀线；蓝色虚线 = 压痕线 / 折线；绿色线 = 出血线；紫色线 = 安全线；灰色线 = 参考线，不印刷；黄色区域 = 粘胶位；半透明浅蓝区域 = 食品级 PET 开窗区域；金色区域 = 烫金版；亮白区域 = 局部 UV 版；浮雕阴影区域 = 击凸 / 击凹区域。

尺寸标准：出血每边 3 mm；安全边距 5 mm；尺寸公差 ±1 mm；模切公差 ±0.5 mm；印刷套位公差 ±0.3 mm；条码区域需预留清晰白底；二维码需保留扫描安全区；食品标签信息区需清晰可读；所有折线、插舌、粘胶位和开窗区域需标注明确。

材料建议：【350g 食品级白卡纸 / 400g 食品级白卡纸 / 特种纸 / 灰板裱纸 / 牛皮纸 / 环保纸浆 / 可降解纸托 / 食品级 PET / 食品级防油纸 / 铝箔内袋 / 独立小包装】。食品接触部分需使用食品级材料，电商运输需考虑防压、防震、防潮、防油污和防串味。

印刷方式：CMYK 四色印刷，可加入 Pantone 专色、金属专色和专版工艺。表面工艺：【哑膜 / 亮膜 / 触感膜 / 局部 UV / 烫金 / 烫银 / 烫玫瑰金 / 击凸 / 击凹 / 压纹 / 珠光油墨 / 专色印刷 / 食品级环保油墨】。

prompts.text:
生成一张【超宽连续背景场景长图】，单张完整图片，不要拼图，不要多宫格，不要分栏，横版 3:1。

prompts.text:

Use the uploaded image as the reference subject. Analyze its design, personality, silhouette, costume, colors, facial expression, powers, weapons, props, symbols, allies, enemies, and world.
