prompts.text: Generate a vertical visual poster based on specific theme content, the overall appearance is like a paper-cut layered scene permeated by mist. Core content does not appear as complete realistic materials, but is first compressed into translucent light-colored silhouettes, a few recognizable outlines, clear negative shapes, and thin light-weight blocks, then embedded into a large-area low-noise light-colored background field. The image must have a near-blank dominant path running through the top and bottom; the path can come from the theme's own space, time, flow, or information relationships, being wide, soft-edged, with sufficient internal white space, and edges revealed by light-colored transparent overprinting, serving the function of a reading route and a spatial cut. The background is not a decorative base color but a paper surface, a mist field, and a memory container, actively swallowing the lower edges and distant ends of objects, letting the focal points gently emerge from the blank space. The composition maintains a long-scroll hierarchy: the information entry is left in sufficient blank space, main symbols are distributed along the sides and turns of the path, the background is lighter, and the foreground is slightly heavier; all objects are assigned clarity according to information importance, with titles and key edges being the clearest, while secondary layer scenes gradually merge into the mist white. Colors maintain high brightness, low saturation, and transparent overprinting, with a near-white base color as the largest area, structural colors organizing the path and distant/near space, emotional colors appearing only lightly at the edges of subjects, layer boundaries, and local blocks, and minimal emphasis colors used for titles, fine lines, badges, or information nodes. Object processing insists on outline priority and detail compression, with no stacked textures inside, using blank cuts, holes, edge transitions, and top lines to complete recognition; different theme elements must be like the same set of paper pieces being stacked, faded, and misted. When text exists, it is like an exquisite data column and marginalia system; the main title uses a high-contrast, slender, and open elegant typeface, small text is restrained with sufficient white space, and can be accompanied by extremely fine horizontal lines, small badges, and low-density explanations; text serves the layout order without covering the subject. The final surface maintains a clean light-print texture, with soft edges, light mist, transparent overprinting, low grain, and no heavy projections, making the image present a quiet, clear, and readable paper-fog layered scene. This theme: One Hundred Years of Solitude Night Reading Sharing Session Podcast Promotion Poster. Ratio: 16:9 landscape.

prompts.text:
围绕具体主题内容生成一张竖向视觉海报，整体像被雾气浸润的纸切层景，核心内容不以完整写实素材出现，而先被压缩成半透明浅色剪影、少数可识别轮廓、清澈负形和轻薄质量块，再嵌入大面积低噪声浅色背景场。画面必须有一条接近空白的主导路径贯穿上下，路径可以来自主题自身的空间、时间、流动或信息关系，宽阔、柔边、内部留白充足，边缘以浅色透明叠印显形，承担阅读路线和空间切口的功能。背景不是装饰底色，而是纸面、雾场和记忆容器，主动吞没对象下缘与远端，让重点从空白中轻轻显影。构图保持长卷式层次：信息入口留在充足空白中，主要符号沿路径两侧和转折处分布，远景更淡，近景略重，所有对象都按信息重要性分配清晰度，标题与关键边缘最清楚，次要层景逐渐融入雾白。色彩保持高明度、低饱和和透明叠印，以近白底色为最大面积，结构色组织路径和远近空间，情绪色只在主体边缘、层景交界和局部块面轻轻出现，强调色极少，用于标题、细线、徽章或信息节点。对象处理坚持轮廓优先和细节压缩，内部不堆纹理，用空白切口、洞形、边缘转折和顶线完成识别；不同主题元素都要像同一套纸片被叠放、印淡、雾化。文字存在时像精致资料栏和边注系统，主标题使用高反差、纤细、开阔的优雅字形，小字克制、留白充足，可配极细横线、小徽章和低密度说明，文字服务版面秩序而不覆盖主体。最终表面保持干净轻印刷质感，柔边、浅雾、透明套色、低颗粒、无厚重投影，让画面呈现安静、清澈、可阅读的纸雾层景。

主体是一位时尚的年轻男子，留着卷曲的黑发，戴着眼镜，拥有富有表现力的眼睛和温暖且富有魅力的微笑。在保持面部结构可辨认的同时，通过真实的漫画风格渲染重新诠释，使用手绘墨水排线、交叉排线、铅笔结构线、粗糙的草图笔触、不均匀的墨水密度、编辑标记、手写日语制作笔记、漫画布局注释和不完美的草稿线稿。

构图应类似于一张真实的漫画角色设计草稿表，在主肖像周围设有多个小型漫画分镜。包括眼睛、侧面轮廓、时尚细节和富有表现力的随性时刻的次要特写草图。在整个页面中加入手写日语笔记、页面标记、编辑圈号、框架指南、裁切标记和复古漫画制作符号。

主体的姿势和表情必须与参考照片完全不同。创造一个放松的电影化随性姿势，他稍稍转离镜头，同时自然地微笑，仿佛在交谈中被捕捉到。肢体语言应显得活泼、时尚、自信且富有情感表现力。

为主体穿上现代叠穿的日式街头服饰，而不是原始的毛衣。包括叠穿在质感工装夹克下的超大连帽衫，具有宽松的当代廓形、细微的配饰、项链细节、真实的织物褶皱，以及符合怀旧漫画美学的视觉有趣的服装纹理。

在整个作品中使用沉重的墨水排线、粗糙的铅笔底稿、表现力的阴影、有机的草图能量和可见的手工瑕疵。最终结果看起来应该像是一张从1990年代日本漫画工作室档案中扫描出来的未完成漫画概念插图——平衡了写实感、表现力草图美学、电影化构图、复古漫画能量和手工瑕疵。

prompts.text:
Please generate a high-texture vertical female emotional portrait.

【Core Theme】
The "beautiful back" is the main visual core, using backlighting, side backlighting, and soft light to highlight the shoulder and neck lines, shoulder blades, spinal line, and back curves. The focus of the image is the back, not the front face.

【Character Setting】
Adult female, temperament options: gentle / cold / lazy / mature / artistic / high-end. The characters should be real and natural, no plastic feel, no exaggerated makeup.

【Clothing Setting】
Clothing can be replaced freely, but it must serve the "backless structure" and "sense of emotion," such as: backless dresses, suspender dresses, tulle, knitwear, slipping shirts, silk long skirts, etc. Materials should be soft, layered, and able to participate in the composition.

【Posture Requirements】
Back to the camera, looking back, side profile, head down, raising hand to tidy hair, leaning, semi-reclining, etc. The posture should be natural, with the focus on displaying the back lines and body curves.

【Scene Setting】
Optional: window side, bedroom, bedside, chair side, homestay, hotel, minimalist room, city night view, etc. The background should be simple and not overshadow the subject.

【Lighting Requirements】
Focus on backlighting, side backlighting, and window light, emphasizing back contours, highlight edges, and light and shadow layers, making the overall sense more cinematic and breathable.

【Composition Requirements】
Vertical composition, the character is the absolute protagonist, the visual center of gravity is placed on the back and body curves, the composition is restrained, clean, and high-end.

【Image Style】
Realistic photography feel, cinematic feel, soft mist feel, delicate skin texture, shallow depth of field, naturally high-end, quiet and private.

【Restrictions】
No text, no watermarks, no logos, no e-commerce feel, no AI plastic feel, no limb deformities, no vulgarization.

【Final Effect】
A high-completion female portrait with "beautiful back + backlighting + emotion + clothing changes" as the core.

White angel long dress + giant white wings + silver jewelry headpiece + pearl chains + long straight black hair + European castle indoor scene.

White slim-fit long dress or satin-feel long dress, can have lace or jewelry decoration on the chest; paired with oversized white wings; wearing silver or crystal-feel headpieces, forehead ornaments, pearl chains, cross necklaces, bracelets, and other accessories. prompts.text:
Style: Organic UGC meets luxury fashion editorial. Tone: Aspirational, real, confident — not corporate. Feel: A real woman showing off a phone she genuinely loves, shot like a cinematic short film.

**Product:** Vivo V70 Pro — Silver-Violet colorway. Ultra-slim titanium frame, frosted matte glass back, ZEISS triple-camera module with floating ring light, minimal bezels, in-display fingerprint sensor.

**Talent:** Elegant young woman, mid-20s, effortlessly stylish. She's not posing for the camera — she's living her life and the phone is part of it. Soft confidence. Natural expressions. Designer-casual outfit in neutral or deep tones that contrast the phone's silver-violet finish.

**Environment:** Luxury penthouse apartment at night. Floor-to-ceiling glass windows. Neon-lit city below. Glossy dark floors reflecting ambient light. Minimal editorial interior. Soft volumetric fog, cool-toned ambient glow.

**Scene 1 — Establishing:** Wide shot. She stands at the window, phone in hand, city glowing behind her. Cinematic rack focus from city lights to her profile. Quiet luxury mood.

**Scene 2 — The Walk:** Slow handheld tracking shot. She moves through the penthouse, phone held naturally at her side. Outfit flows. Lens flare catches the ZEISS module. Effortless power mood.

**Scene 3 — Camera Close-Up:** Extreme macro of the ZEISS triple-camera module slowly rotating. Lens catches light. Holographic spec text fades in softly: 200MP · 50MP · 64MP Periscope. Precision craftsmanship mood.

**Scene 4 — The Selfie Moment:** She raises the phone, glances at the screen, almost smiles. Not staged — a genuine selfie moment. Skin texture is real, warm, beautiful under soft rim light. Intimate mood.

**Scene 5 — Specs Reveal:** Phone floats in frame with clean holographic callouts: 16GB RAM · 512GB · 120W Flash Charge · Dimensity 9400 · 120Hz AMOLED · 200MP ZEISS. Subtle depth of field. Each spec appears, breathes, fades. Premium mood.

**Scene 6 — Gaming / Performance:** She leans back gaming on the phone. Subtle processor-energy aura around the device. Eyes focused. Completely absorbed. Power under the surface mood.

**Scene 7 — Hero Close:** She turns, looks directly into camera, phone held naturally toward viewer. City glows behind her. Slow push-in. She doesn't smile — she knows. This is the one mood.

**Text Overlays:** Vivo V70 Pro — Elegance Meets Power — Capture Beyond Imagination — Flagship Performance. Redefined. Clean white or silver serif font, bottom-third placement.

**Lighting:** Soft purple-blue neon bleed from city windows. Warm rim light on skin. Lens flare off ZEISS module. Glossy floor reflections, subtle volumetric rays. Teal-orange cinema base with violet lift in shadows.

**Technical:** 9:16 vertical aspect ratio. Simulated Sony Venice camera, 85mm lens, f/1.4 aperture. Anamorphic, shallow depth of field, cinematic motion blur. 4K minimum, 8K preferred. HDR, Rec.2020 color space. Platforms: Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Digital OOH.

**UGC Authenticity Notes:** No stiff product poses — every shot feels caught, not staged. She interacts with the phone naturally, not demonstratively. Specs are ambient, not shouted. Lighting is cinematic but believable for a real space. Emotion is subtle — confidence, not performance.

场景 6 — 游戏 / 性能：她靠在椅背上玩手机游戏。设备周围有微妙的处理器能量光环。目光专注。完全投入。内在力量氛围。

场景 7 — 主体收尾：她转身，直视镜头，手机自然地朝向观众。身后城市闪烁。缓慢推近。她没有微笑——她心领神会。这就是唯一之选的氛围。

文字叠加：Vivo V70 Pro —— 优雅遇见力量 —— 超越想象的捕捉 —— 旗舰性能。重新定义。纯白或银色衬线字体，底部三分之一放置。

灯光：来自城市窗户的柔和紫蓝色霓虹光漫射。皮肤上的暖色轮廓光。蔡司模块产生的镜头光晕。亮面地板反射，微妙的体积光线。青橙色电影基调，阴影部分带有紫色提升。

技术参数：9:16 垂直纵横比。模拟索尼 Venice 摄影机，85mm 镜头，f/1.4 光圈。变形镜头，浅景深，电影级运动模糊。最低 4K，首选 8K。HDR，Rec.2020 色彩空间。平台：Instagram Reels、TikTok、YouTube Shorts、数字户外广告。

UGC 真实性说明：无僵硬的产品摆拍——每一组镜头都感觉是捕捉到的，而非编排的。她与手机的互动很自然，而不是演示性的。规格参数是环境化的，不是叫嚣式的。灯光是电影化的，但在真实空间中是可信的。情感是微妙的——自信，而非表演。

prompts.text:
Create a hyper-realistic luxury FMCG advertisement titled:

“THE WORLD’S MOST BEAUTIFUL STRAWBERRY MILK.”

The image should feel:
bright,
instantly understandable,
premium,
saveable and aggressively scroll-stopping.

IMPORTANT:
This should NOT feel like a normal product shot.

It should feel like:
a billion-dollar global campaign designed specifically to dominate social media feeds.

SCENE:

A gigantic transparent glass bottle of premium strawberry milk stands in the middle of a dreamy sunlit strawberry field during golden-hour sunset.

The bottle should be enormous —
larger than a small house —
like a real-world landmark.

Inside the glass bottle:
perfect creamy pink strawberry milk swirls realistically with soft condensation and flowing liquid movement.

The bottle itself should look:
obsessively tactile and luxurious:

- cold condensation droplets,
- glossy glass reflections,
- creamy liquid texture,
- embossed logo,
- realistic strawberry illustrations,
- tiny imperfections in glass,
- sunlight refracting through the liquid.

AROUND THE BOTTLE:

People naturally interact with it as though it has always existed there.

- children running through giant strawberries,
- friends sitting beneath the shadow of the bottle,
- someone climbing a ladder attached to the bottle cap,
- a girl photographing reflections in the glass,
- strawberries rolling through grass in cinematic slow motion,
- milk splashes forming organically around the environment.

The atmosphere should feel:
joyful,
warm,
dreamlike and visually addictive.

IMPORTANT:

The image should contain:
MASSIVE oversized strawberries scattered across the landscape like natural objects.

Some sliced open.
Some reflecting sunlight.
Some partially dipped in milk.

The strawberries should feel:
hyper-realistic,
fresh,
glossy and almost edible through the screen.

TYPOGRAPHY:

Minimal clean luxury typography floating softly in the sky:

“DRINK SUMMER.”

Small subtext beneath:
“Sweetness, bottled.”

Typography should feel:
Apple-level minimal and globally iconic.

LIGHTING:

Warm golden-hour sunset lighting with:

- glowing milk reflections,
- cinematic lens flare,
- soft atmospheric haze,
- warm grass highlights,
- dreamy backlighting,
- realistic shadow falloff,
- reflective liquid highlights.

CAMERA STYLE:

Blend:

- luxury beverage commercials,
- FMCG photography,
- dreamlike environmental realism,
- and tactile food cinematography.

Use:

- medium-format realism,
- cinematic depth of field,
- realistic skin texture,
- subtle motion blur,
- premium lens behavior,
- aerial drone composition,
- and practical reflections.

COLOR PALETTE:

creamy pink,
warm strawberry red,
golden sunlight,
fresh green grass,
soft white highlights and sunset orange tones.

The final image should feel:
so visually satisfying and commercially polished that people immediately stop scrolling and think:

“how is this not a real campaign?”

这不应该像普通的草莓产品拍摄。

专为统治社交媒体动态而设计的价值十亿美元的全球营销活动。

一个巨大的透明玻璃瓶高端草莓牛奶矗立在金色黄昏时刻梦幻般的阳光草莓田中。

瓶子应该是巨大的——

完美的奶油粉色草莓牛奶真实地旋转，带有柔和的冷凝水和流动的液体运动。

极具触感且奢华：

- 冷凝水滴，

- 奶油般的液体质感，
- 浮雕 Logo，
- 写实的草莓插图，
- 玻璃中的细微瑕疵，
- 阳光穿过液体折射。

瓶子周围：

人们自然地与其互动，仿佛它一直存在于那里。

示例：

- 孩子们在巨大的草莓中奔跑，
- 朋友们坐在瓶子的阴影下，
- 有人爬上连接在瓶盖上的梯子，

愉悦、
温暖、
梦幻且视觉上令人上瘾。

重要提示：

图像应包含：
像自然物体一样散落在景观中的巨型超大草莓。

有些切开了。
有些反射着阳光。
有些部分浸泡在牛奶中。

草莓感觉应：
超写实、
新鲜、
有光泽，并且隔着屏幕几乎可以食用。

排版：

极简、干净、奢华的排版轻轻漂浮在天空中：

“DRINK SUMMER。”

下方的小副标题：
“Sweetness, bottled。”

排版感觉应：
苹果级别的极简且具有全球标志性。

灯光：

带有以下效果的温暖黄金时段日落灯光：

- 闪烁的牛奶反射，
- 电影感的镜头光晕，
- 柔和的大气薄雾，
- 温暖的草地高光，
- 梦幻般的逆光，
- 真实的阴影衰减，
- 反光的液体高光。

相机风格：

融合：

- 奢华饮料广告，
- 快消品摄影，
- 梦幻的环境写实主义，
- 以及触感极佳的食物电影摄影。

使用：

- 中画幅写实，
- 电影感的景深，
- 真实的皮肤纹理，
- 细微的运动模糊，
- 高端镜头表现，
- 无人机航拍构图，
- 以及真实的反射。

配色方案：

奶油粉、
温暖的草莓红、
金色的阳光、
新鲜的绿草、
柔和的白色高光和日落橙色调。

最终图像的感觉应：
视觉上非常舒适且具有商业磨光感，以至于人们会立即停止滑动并思考：

“这怎么可能不是一个真实的活动？”

prompts.text:
Please create a high-end wall clock with great texture based on the viral illustration. This wall clock needs to reinterpret the artistic atmosphere, character design, emotional tone, color scheme, symbolic elements, architectural style, clothing, lighting, fantasy or sci-fi elements, and world-building of the illustration into a highly original cuckoo clock-style wall clock design. Do not design it as a regular antique clock. The overall silhouette, carvings, decorations, moving parts, pendulum, decorative windows, roof structure, numbers, hands, textures, and materials must all present a sense of naturalness as if they originated from that illustration's world.

Fantasy miko themes can incorporate lacquered wood, spiritual power sigils, torii-style frames, glowing charms, hanging bells, cherry blossom carvings, layered shrine architecture, elegant red and black lacquer textures, and softly glowing paper windows. Futuristic or android themes can adopt holographic clock faces, segmented mechanical armor panels, glowing circuits, transparent crystal casings, floating rings, neon edge lighting, dynamic digital pendulums, and smooth asymmetrical structures. Cute macaron-colored worlds can inspire rounded and soft silhouettes, candy-like decorations, transparent ornaments, heart elements, glossy enamel surfaces, plush textures, and dreamy fairy-tale styles.

The cuckoo clock-style window opening should contain a small dynamic character, spiritual entity, mechanical bird, miniature mascot, or symbolic object derived from the illustration. The pendulum and moving decorations should visually align with the world-building and emotional tone of the illustration. The clock hands and numbers must be uniquely designed to suit the illustration, rather than using standard styles.

If the illustration includes a character, please place the character naturally below or to the side of the wall clock, looking up at the wall clock with an expression of curiosity or appreciation, while retaining the character's original facial features, hairstyle, proportions, color scheme, clothing style, and personality. Requirements include bright cinematic lighting, extreme detailed craftsmanship, realistic materials, high-end fantasy indoor photography texture, elegant shadows, and high-precision reflection effects, presenting a masterwork level.

prompts.text:
请根据爆款的插画，创作一款极具质感的高端挂钟。该挂钟需将插画的艺术氛围、角色设计、情感基调、配色方案、符号元素、建筑风格、服饰、光影、奇幻或科幻元素以及世界观，重新诠释为极具原创性的布谷鸟钟式挂钟设计。请勿设计成普通的古董钟。整体轮廓、雕刻、装饰、活动部件、钟摆、装饰窗、屋顶结构、数字、指针、纹理和材质，都必须呈现出仿佛源自该插画世界的自然感。

奇幻巫女主题可融入漆木、灵力纹章、鸟居风格框架、发光符咒、悬挂铃铛、樱花雕刻、层叠的神社建筑、优雅的红黑漆器纹理以及柔和发光的纸窗。未来主义或仿生人主题可采用全息钟面、分段式机械装甲面板、发光电路、透明水晶外壳、悬浮环、霓虹边缘灯光、动态数字钟摆以及流畅的非对称结构。可爱的马卡龙色系世界则可启发圆润柔和的轮廓、糖果般的装饰、透明饰品、爱心元素、光泽感珐琅表面、毛绒质感以及梦幻的童话风格。

布谷鸟钟式的开窗处应包含一个源自插画的小型动态角色、灵体、机械鸟、微型吉祥物或象征性物体。钟摆和活动装饰应在视觉上与插画的世界观及情感基调相契合。钟表指针和数字必须进行独特设计以适配插画，而非使用标准样式。

如果是插画中包含角色，请将该角色自然地放置在挂钟下方或侧面，使其带着好奇或赞赏的神情仰望挂钟，同时保留角色原有的面部特征、发型、比例、配色、服装风格和个性。要求明亮的电影级光影、极致的细节工艺、逼真的材质、高端奇幻室内摄影质感、优雅的阴影、高精度的反射效果，呈现大师级作品水准。

• 1:1 square composition

• Refined editorial typography hierarchy with natural-history aesthetics
• Rounded modular information cards with clean spacing
• Gentle realistic shadows and premium museum-style dividers
• Minimal scientific wildlife iconography
• Extremely detailed central camel render viewed in dramatic three-quarter perspective in a realistic desert environment during golden-hour lighting

• Clean, organized “knowledge-first” layout with high information density but breathable spacing

Main Subject Presentation:

A stunning ultra-detailed realistic render of a camel placed at the center, featuring realistic fur textures, desert lighting, anatomical accuracy, expressive eyes, weathered skin detail, muscular legs, detailed hump structure, and premium wildlife-documentary realism.

Surround the camel with scientific callouts and magnified detail circles explaining:

• water-conservation adaptations
• broad desert feet structure
• long eyelashes and sand protection
• nostril-closing mechanism
• heat-resistance biology
• digestive system adaptations

prompts.text:
Please generate a set of 9 individual portrait photos based on the clear photo of the user uploaded, all in 3:4 vertical composition, no collages, no nine-grid patterns.

The character must strictly maintain the user's real appearance and recognizability, including face shape, facial feature proportions, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone, sense of age, hairstyle base, and overall temperament. All 9 photos must clearly be the same real girl, must not become a stranger, must not be Westernized, must not be overly "Internet celebrity" style, and must not become an AI fake face.

Theme: Sweet and Spicy Landlady style portrait.

Overall Style: Retro home glam, sweet and spicy, flamboyant, lazy, confident, knows how to handle the camera, like a beautiful landlady living in an old apartment, just woke up with hair rolled, doing makeup, and taking a set of very photogenic fashion portraits in between. The image should have a strong sense of life, a slight sense of clutter, a retro direct flash shot feel, with a fashion atmosphere mixed with Y2K, Hong Kong style, leopard print, and pink socialite elements.

Character Styling:
- Obvious pink hair rollers on the head
- Long curly hair or big wavy hairstyle
- Exquisite and heavy makeup, obvious eyelashes, refined eyeliner, blush and lips have a strong presence
- Temperament is sweet and spicy, lazy, confident, with a bit of arrogance and playfulness
- Allow for a slight exaggerated "drama queen" and "hostess" feel

Clothing and Accessories:
- Leopard print camisole nightgown / Leopard print tight mini skirt / Leopard print bathrobe
- Pink feather shawl / Pink sweet and spicy home items can be used for some styling variations
- Pearl necklaces, exaggerated earrings, rings, bracelets
- Props can include: makeup brushes, powder compacts, small mirrors, lipsticks, cigarette props, pink mobile phones, small dolls, wine bottles
- The overall look should be like a "finely dressed home landlady," sweet, spicy, and fashionable, with a bit of kitschy luxury

Scene:
Retro small apartment, kitchen, bedside, sofa side, dressing corner, leopard print blankets, jars and bottles, poster wall, cosmetics, wine bottles, small ornaments, mirrors, hair curlers, pet dogs can all appear. The overall should have a sense of life and slight clutter, but still look good, well-photographed, and atmospheric, not dirty or messy.

Lighting and Image Quality:
Direct flash shooting, slight film grain, retro CCD / snapshot texture, natural warm skin tone, slightly strong contrast, like the popular retro home fashion portraits on Xiaohongshu. Must have a candid feel but also maintain a high-end fashion sense.

Please generate the following 9 different shots, each with different movements, angles, and compositions:

1. Sitting on a leopard print blanket, wearing a leopard print camisole dress, pink hair rollers on the head, winking or smirking at the camera, main visual cover feel
2. Sitting in the kitchen or by the bed, several hands helping her touch up makeup, brush on blush, hold powder compacts and makeup brushes at the same time, the scene is lively and fun
3. Half-body close-up, hair rollers very obvious, holding a cigarette prop or lipstick, looking directly at the camera, very strong sweet and spicy feel
4. Touching up makeup or looking in the mirror, holding a small mirror or powder compact, expression is narcissistic and cute
5. Sitting on the bed or sofa, wrapped in a pink feather shawl, holding a pink mobile phone or small doll, looking like taking a selfie
6. Lying on a leopard print blanket, hair spread out, hair rollers still there, composition more lazy, with a bit of pretentious sexiness
7. Standing full-body shot, wearing a leopard print skirt or pink sweet and spicy outfit, looking back at the camera, like the hostess of the apartment
8. In the same frame as a pet dog, sitting in the kitchen or by the bed,姿态放松, the image has more life feel
9. Super close-up face shot, focusing on the face, hair rollers, eyelashes, blush, lips, and hand movements, as the closing shot of the set

Final Requirements:
- All 9 are individual photos
- All 9 must clearly be the same person from the uploaded photo
- The overall image is unified in "Sweet and Spicy Landlady" style
- Do not repeat movements and compositions
- Have both a sense of life and a sense of fashion photography
- No collages, no watermarks, no text, no screenshot borders
- No face distortion, no weird fingers, no distorted proportions, no cheap photo studio feel

items.title: 概念叙事极简标志设计提示词

prompts.text:
Please create a high-quality “Conceptual Narrative Minimal Logo” based on the following user inputs:

[Brand Name / Project Name]
[Subtitle / Product Name]
[Industry / Category]
[Brand Positioning]
[Core Concept]
[Metaphorical Motif]
[Emotional Tone]
[Primary Color]
[Accent Color]
[Aspect Ratio]

【User Input】
Brand Name / Project Name: [__________]
Subtitle / Product Name: [__________]
Industry / Category: [creative studio / visual lab / editorial project / independent fashion label / art space / publishing / architecture / music label / cultural brand / experimental project / etc.]
Brand Positioning: [__________]
Core Concept: [dream / control / distance / isolation / orbit / freedom / structure / memory / narrative / imagination / tension / future / etc.]
Metaphorical Motif: [astronaut / orbit / rabbit ears / silhouette / marionette / box / thread / moon / hand / geometric structure / void / object / etc.]
Emotional Tone: [quiet / restrained / poetic / cold / experimental / mysterious / intelligent / futuristic / minimal / conceptual / etc.]
Primary Color: [black / white / gray / dark brown / charcoal / etc.]
Accent Color: [small amount of red / muted red / subtle highlight / none]
Aspect Ratio: [1:1 / 4:3 / 3:2]

【Creative Goal】
Design a “Conceptual Narrative Minimal Logo”.
This is not a conventional commercial logo, not a decorative badge, and not a generic geometric icon.
The goal is to create a logo that feels like a small visual idea: minimal, quiet, and concept-driven.

The result should express the idea of “less is more”:
less decoration, more meaning;
less noise, more concept;
less visual clutter, more narrative tension.

【Core Definition】
This type of logo should use:
- a very small number of visual elements,
- a strong sense of negative space,
- a clear symbolic or metaphorical relationship,
- restrained typography,
- and a subtle narrative or conceptual layer.

It should feel like a logo that belongs to an independent creative studio, an art-directed brand, an experimental project, or a design-led identity system.

【Essential Principles】
1. The logo must be minimal, but not empty.
2. The graphic must be simple, but not generic.
3. The symbol should carry metaphor, implication, or conceptual meaning.
4. The composition should use a lot of breathing room and negative space.
5. The logo should feel quiet, intentional, and art-directed.
6. Typography should be restrained, intelligent, and carefully placed.
7. The overall design should feel like a small visual statement, not a loud advertisement.
8. Avoid unnecessary decoration.

【Graphic Direction】
Create a minimal symbolic graphic, or a small narrative visual scene, based on the [Core Concept] and [Metaphorical Motif].

The graphic may include:
- a simplified human silhouette,
- a symbolic object,
- a surreal relationship between a figure and a structure,
- a small orbit or trajectory,
- an abstract device-like form,
- a geometric scene with narrative implication,
- a metaphorical composition that suggests an idea rather than directly illustrating it.

The graphic should:
1. be simple and highly distilled;
2. avoid excessive detail;
3. carry symbolic or poetic meaning;
4. suggest a story, relation, or emotional state;
5. feel conceptual rather than merely decorative.

【Typography Direction】
Typography must be minimal and controlled.
Requirements:
1. The brand name should be clear and readable.
2. Typography should feel calm, modern, and deliberate.
3. It can be uppercase, small caps, narrow sans serif, or another restrained modern style.
4. Text should support the symbol, not overpower it.
5. The relationship between text and graphic should feel intentional and curated.
6. Subtitle / secondary text may be added in a very small amount if needed.
7. Avoid overly expressive, playful, or loud type.

【Composition Direction】
The overall composition should emphasize stillness and space.
Requirements:
1. Use a lot of empty space.
2. Keep the main logo relatively small within the frame.
3. The symbol can sit left, center, or right, but the overall balance must feel refined.
4. The composition should feel like an identity presentation or a gallery-like display.
5. Small annotations, thin lines, or subtle structural alignments may be used if helpful.
6. Avoid making it feel like a poster, sticker sheet, or advertisement.

【Color Direction】
Keep the palette restrained.
Recommended approach:
- black, white, gray, charcoal, or deep neutral tones as the main palette;
- optionally add a very small amount of red, muted red, or another subtle accent color;
- the accent color should function as a point of tension, cut, orbit, line, or signal;
- never let the accent color dominate the design;
- avoid rich gradients and high-saturation color schemes.

【Mood & Aesthetic】
The final logo should feel:
- minimal
- conceptual
- narrative
- poetic
- restrained
- intelligent
- art-directed
- independent
- experimental
- less-is-more

【What to Avoid】
Please strictly avoid:
1. generic corporate logos;
2. decorative badge logos;
3. cute mascot logos;
4. overly geometric abstract marks with no meaning;
5. heavy ornament;
6. crowded compositions;
7. poster-like layouts;
8. colorful or noisy designs;
9. anything that feels generic, loud, or commercially over-explained.

【Output Requirement】
Generate one high-quality “Conceptual Narrative Minimal Logo” that communicates a clear idea through minimal form, strong negative space, and a quiet but meaningful symbolic gesture.

The final result should feel like:
a logo with a story,
a symbol with tension,
and a visual identity built on the principle that less is more.

prompts.text:
请基于以下用户输入创建一个高质量的“概念叙事极简标志”：

[品牌名称 / 项目名称]
[副标题 / 产品名称]
[行业 / 类别]
[品牌定位]
[核心概念]
[隐喻基调]
[情感基调]
[主色调]
[强调色]
[宽高比]

【用户输入】
品牌名称 / 项目名称：[__________]
副标题 / 产品名称：[__________]
行业 / 类别：[创意工作室 / 视觉实验室 / 编辑项目 / 独立时尚品牌 / 艺术空间 / 出版 / 建筑 / 音乐厂牌 / 文化品牌 / 实验项目 / 等]
品牌定位：[__________]
核心概念：[梦境 / 控制 / 距离 / 孤立 / 轨道 / 自由 / 结构 / 记忆 / 叙事 / 想象力 / 张力 / 未来 / 等]
隐喻基调：[宇航员 / 轨道 / 兔耳 / 剪影 / 木偶 / 盒子 / 线条 / 月亮 / 手 / 几何结构 / 虚空 / 物体 / 等]
情感基调：[安静 / 克制 / 诗意 / 冷峻 / 实验性 / 神秘 / 智慧 / 未来感 / 极简 / 概念性 / 等]
主色调：[黑色 / 白色 / 灰色 / 深褐色 / 炭灰色 / 等]
强调色：[少量红色 / 柔和的红色 / 微妙的高光 / 无]
宽高比：[1:1 / 4:3 / 3:2]

【创意目标】
设计一个“概念叙事极简标志”。
这不是一个传统的商业标志，不是装饰性徽章，也不是通用的几何图标。
目标是创建一个感觉像是一个微小视觉创意的标志：极简、安静且由概念驱动。

结果应表达“少即是多”的理念：
更少的装饰，更多的意义；
更少的噪音，更多的概念；
更少的视觉杂乱，更多的叙事张力。

【核心定义】
这类标志应使用：
- 极少数的视觉元素，
- 强烈的负空间感，
- 清晰的象征或隐喻关系，
- 克制的排版，
- 以及微妙的叙事或概念层。

它应该给人一种属于独立创意工作室、艺术指导品牌、实验项目或设计驱动的识别系统的标志感。

【基本原则】
1. 标志必须极简，但不能空洞。
2. 图形必须简单，但不能通用。
3. 符号应承载隐喻、暗示或概念意义。
4. 构图应使用大量的留白和负空间。
5. 标志应感觉安静、有意为之且经过艺术指导。
6. 排版应克制、智慧且经过精心布置。
7. 整体设计应感觉像是一个微小的视觉陈述，而不是大声的广告。
8. 避免不必要的装饰。

【图形方向】
基于 [核心概念] 和 [隐喻基调] 创建一个极简的象征性图形或一个微小的叙事视觉场景。

图形可能包括：
- 简化的剪影，
- 一个象征性的物体，
- 人物与结构之间超现实的关系，
- 微小的轨道或轨迹，
- 抽象的类似装置的形式，
- 具有叙事暗示的几何场景，
- 暗示一个想法而非直接描绘它的隐喻构图。

图形应当：
1. 简单且高度凝练；
2. 避免过多的细节；
3. 承载象征或诗意意义；
4. 暗示故事、关系或情感状态；
5. 感觉是概念性的而非仅仅是装饰性的。

【排版方向】
排版必须极简且受控。
要求：
1. 品牌名称应清晰易读。
2. 排版应感觉冷静、现代且深思熟虑。
3. 可以是大写、小型大写字母、窄无衬线体或其他克制的现代风格。
4. 文字应支撑符号，而不是压倒它。
5. 文字与图形之间的关系应感觉是有意且经过策划的。
6. 如果需要，可以添加极少量的副标题 / 次要文本。
7. 避免过于表现化、俏皮或响亮的字体。

【构图方向】
整体构图应强调静止与空间。
要求：
1. 使用大量的空白空间。
2. 保持主标志在画框内相对较小。
3. 符号可以位于左侧、中心或右侧，但整体平衡必须感觉精致。
4. 构图应感觉像是一个身份展示或画廊般的陈列。
5. 如果有帮助，可以使用小的注释、细线或微妙的结构对齐。
6. 避免使其感觉像海报、贴纸页 or 广告。

【颜色方向】
保持色调克制。
推荐方法：
- 黑色、白色、灰色、炭灰色或深中性色作为主调；
- 可选择性地添加极少量的红色、柔和的红色或其他微妙的强调色；
- 强调色应作为张力点、切割线、轨道、线条或信号起作用；
- 绝不要让强调色主导设计；
- 避免丰富的渐变和高饱和度的配色方案。

【氛围与美学】
最终标志应感觉：
- 极简
- 概念性
- 叙事性
- 诗意
- 克制
- 智慧
- 艺术指导感
- 独立
- 实验性
- 少即是多

【应避免的内容】
请严格避免：
1. 通用的公司标志；
2. 装饰性的徽章标志；
3. 可爱的吉祥物标志；
4. 没有意义的过度几何化的抽象标记；
5. 沉重的装饰；
6. 拥挤的构图；
7. 类似海报的布局；
8. 彩色或嘈杂的设计；
9. 任何感觉通用、大声或商业上过度解释的东西。

【输出要求】
生成一个高质量的“概念叙事极简标志”，通过极简的形式、强烈的负空间和安静但有意义的象征性姿态来传达清晰的想法。

最终结果应感觉像：
一个有故事的标志，
一个带有张力的符号，
以及一个建立在“少即是多”原则上的视觉识别系统。

prompts.text:
Based on 1-3 clear photos of the person uploaded by the user, generate 9 different individual refined portrait photos at once, unified in a 3:4 vertical composition.

Theme:
"Japanese Washitsu Natural Light Kimono Portrait"

Overall style reference:
High-end portrait commercial photography + Japanese Washitsu aesthetics + warm golden natural light + crimson kimono + cinematic still frames + relaxed and restrained character emotions.

This set of images is not ordinary tourist check-in kimono photos, not cherry blossom festival posing, and not low-cost ancient style studio photography. Key points are:
Premium, quiet, transparent, ambiguous, exquisite, cinematic.
The whole set should look like a group of Japanese-style portrait blockbusters shot by a high-budget fashion photography studio, with clear commercial shooting quality and aesthetic control.

I. Character Consistency
Please strictly preserve the user's true identity characteristics, including but not limited to:
- Face shape
- Facial feature proportions
- Eye shape
- Nose shape
- Lip shape
- Skin tone
- Sense of age
- Hairline
- Facial bone structure
- Body foundation
- Overall temperament

In all 9 photos, it must clearly look like the same real woman. Do not become a stranger, do not Westernize, do not become an internet celebrity style, do not over-smooth the skin, and do not use AI fake faces. High-end commercial retouching is allowed, but real recognizability and delicate skin texture must be preserved.

II. Overall Temperament
The overall temperament is: Japanese style, quiet, soft, restrained, slightly sensual, cinematic, magazine-like.
Keywords:
- Japanese style editorial portrait
- warm natural light
- tatami room photography
- cinematic still frame
- elegant and quiet
- refined commercial portrait
- soft sensuality
- airy golden atmosphere
- delicate emotional portrait
- premium portrait campaign

The character's emotions should not be exaggerated, no big laughs, no "sweet girl" cuteness. It should be closer to:
- Quiet
- Thoughtful
- Slightly detached
- Implicitly soft and beautiful
- Breathable
- Like a fragment from a movie

III. Clothing and Styling
The clothing for the whole set is unified as: Crimson / Vermilion / Orange-red kimono styling, paired with a white inner lining and a golden brocade obi.
Clothing requirements:
- The main body is a red or vermilion kimono
- The white cross-collar inner lining is clearly visible
- The waist seal is a golden or gold-brocade pattern obi
- The fabric has a sense of drape and high-end texture
- No cheap cosplay feel
- No stage costume feel
- No exaggerated gaudy prints

Some shots are allowed to have the following treatment:
- The kimono slides down slightly, revealing the neck and collarbone
- The neckline is more relaxed, creating more atmosphere
- The fabric spreads out naturally during local lying poses to reflect natural body beauty
- However, the overall look should remain restrained, elegant, and not vulgar

IV. Accessory Requirements
Accessories should be few and accurate, unified with Japanese temperament:
- Red or pink flower hairpin
- A small amount of pearls or small flowers for hair ornaments
- Japanese folding fan
- Red wagasa / paper umbrella
- A small amount of red maple leaves or flowers can appear as foreground props
Requirements:
- Props should be few but exquisite
- Do not pile up small Japanese items
- No tourist photo feel
- The overall look should be like selected styling props in a commercial shoot

V. Hair and Makeup
Hair:
The hairstyle is unified as: Loose bun / Low bun / Japanese-style twist hair
Requirements:
- Hair is tied up or half-tied
- Natural loose hairs on both sides
- Hair strands can have a slight wet feel
- Local hair strands fall to the side of the face, ears, and neck
- Overall relaxed but exquisite
- No neat and stiff studio-style buns

Makeup:
- Natural and exquisite makeup
- Light and transparent base makeup
- Delicate skin texture with a slight hydrated feel
- Gentle and clean eye makeup
- Natural and exquisite eyelashes
- Lip makeup is watery nude red, bean paste red, or warm-toned red-brown
- Overall look is premium, quiet, and breathable

VI. Scene and Setting
The scene is unified as: Japanese Washitsu space + Tatami + Shoji doors + wooden frames + warm sunlight.
Core scene elements:
- Tatami floor
- Shoji doors / Japanese sliding doors
- Wooden door frames
- Japanese indoor white space
- Partial view of a courtyard or blurred greenery
- Wooden lounge chair / bamboo and wood leisure chair
- Red maple foreground blur
- Paper umbrella / folding fan as auxiliary props
Requirements:
- Minimalist scene
- Clean and transparent
- No complex Japanese Izakaya settings
- No background full of cherry blossoms
- No cheap ancient-style studio background cloth
- It must look like a real Japanese indoor space or a high-quality commercial set

VII. Lighting Requirements
Lighting is one of the most critical parts of the whole set of photos.
Please use unified: Evening warm golden natural light + soft backlighting + indoor diffuse reflection + airy highlights.
Specific requirements:
- The overall picture is warm gold-toned
- Like afternoon or evening sunlight shining into the Washitsu
- Rim light on hair and neck when backlit
- Skin glows slightly
- Shadows are soft, not dirty or gray
- Partial soft focus flare is allowed
- The indoor air feels heated by the sun, full of a soft and quiet atmosphere
Do not use:
- Cold white studio light
- Harsh flash
- Nightclub colorful lights
- Overexposure
- Yellowish or dirty skin tone
- Overly heavy filters

VIII. Skin and Texture Requirements
The skin texture in this set is very important, it should have: a slight watery feel, real pore texture, small water droplet feel, and luster on the neck and collarbone.
In local close-ups, you can add:
- Small water droplets on the neck and shoulders
- Slightly wet texture on the collarbone and back
- Hair strands sticking to the skin
- Natural skin reflection
Requirements:
- It's the "moist air feel" in high-end commercial portraits
- Not a bathing portrait
- Not excessive wetness
- Not vulgar
- The focus is the interaction between skin and light

IX. Body and Posture Requirements
The focus of the character's posture is: extended neck and shoulders, clear collarbones, soft movements, and natural, relaxed poses.
Requirements:
- Natural hand movements
- Slender neck
- Relaxed shoulders
- Soft back lines
- Lying and sitting poses must be natural
- No forced posing
- No strange broken-bone-like movements
- No vulgar suggestive feel

X. 9-Shot Breakdown Requirements
Please generate 9 different individual final photos, each belonging to the same set of kimono commercial portraits, but with clearly different camera languages.

Shot 1: Half-body portrait in front of a Shoji door. The person stands in front of the Shoji door, warm sun shines on the face and neck, wearing a red kimono, white collar sliding down slightly to reveal the collarbone. Hair strands fall naturally, wearing a small flower hairpin. Emotion is quiet, head slightly lowered or looking to the side. The image is one of the main visuals of the set.

Shot 2: Lying on the side on Tatami. The person lies on her side on the Tatami, body wrapped in a red kimono, one hand lightly placed on the chest or lapel. Face is close to the ground, eyes looking at the camera. A red flower can be nearby as a close-up. The image is soft, lazy, and highly cinematic.

Shot 3: Close-up of the face. The person lies on the Tatami or slightly tilts her head back, camera captures a close-up of the face. Focus on showing the eyes, lips, loose hairs by the face, and flower ornaments by the ear. Skin is delicate, light is warm. This shot is more like a commercial beauty-style close-up.

Shot 4: Leaning against a Shoji door holding a folding fan. The person leans halfway against the Shoji door, holding a red and black Japanese folding fan. The kimono is loosely draped over the shoulders, and the obi is visible. The gaze is to the side, and the person looks like a quiet scene from a movie. The image has both a sense of styling and white space.

Shot 5: Full-body vertical shot holding a wagasa. The person stands in the center of the Washitsu, holding a red paper umbrella. The composition is more complete, showing the red kimono, golden obi, and Shoji door background. A small amount of red maple foreground blur is allowed. The image looks like a brand promotional blockbuster.

Shot 6: Lazy sitting posture on a wooden lounge chair. The person sits back on a wooden lounge chair, holding a folding fan, with the red kimono spread naturally. Red maple can be used in the foreground to blur part of the image. Eyes look at the camera, emotion is restrained yet tense. The image leans towards a fashion commercial editorial page.

Shot 7: Quiet sitting pose on a wooden chair. The person sits on a wooden chair, looking down at the fan or lowering her eyes slightly. Sunlight illuminates the kimono and neck, wind blows the loose hair. The image is quieter, more like a gap in a story.

Shot 8: Close-up of collarbone and neck moisture. A close-up of the character's neck, collarbone, and shoulders. The red kimono and white lining slide down slightly, with small water droplets on the neck and shoulders, and a small red flower can be used as an accent nearby. The focus is on skin texture, lines, and light. No excessive exposure, maintain a premium feel.

Shot 9: Back close-up finale. The person faces away from the camera, revealing her back and back of the neck, with small water droplets on the skin and hair strands falling naturally. The kimono is loosely draped below the shoulders, the background is still warm light and Shoji doors. Like the closing shot of the whole set, it is quiet, restrained, and has a strong aftertaste.

XI. Photography and Final Style
Overall photography style reference:
- high-end kimono editorial portrait
- Japanese room natural light photography
- cinematic warm portrait
- premium commercial beauty portrait
- tatami room fashion shoot
- quiet sensuality
- red kimono campaign photography
- refined Asian portrait editorial
- soft golden light portrait
- luxury portrait retouching
Final Requirements:
- High-definition realistic photography
- High-end commercial retouching
- Clean composition
- Delicate skin
- Clear texture of kimono fabric and obi
- Real hair strands
- Warm and transparent image
- Like a brand-level commercial portrait shot by a high-end photography studio

XII. Negative Requirements
Please avoid the following problems:
- No tourist check-in feel
- No cheap Japanese studio feel
- No 2D cosplay feel
- No overly thick filters
- No plastic skin
- No wrong fingers
- No strange limbs
- No facial feature distortion
- No proportion distortion
- No excessive skin smoothing
- No excessive exposure / nudity
- No vulgar sexiness
- No cluttered background
- No modern home furniture intrusion
- No cherry blossom festival commercial street atmosphere

XIII. Final Effect Summary
The final image should make people feel: This is a set of high-completion, high-aesthetic-control kimono premium portrait commercial photography. The red kimono, Shoji doors, Tatami, warm sun, flower hairpins, folding fans, wagasa, and wooden furniture together constitute a quiet, soft, and cinematic Japanese-style space. The key is not just "wearing a kimono," but using light, skin, posture, and scenes to shoot the character into a truly high-end commercial portrait work.

prompts.text:
请基于用户上传的 1-3 张清晰本人照片，一次性生成 **9 张不同的单独精修写真照片**，统一为 **3:4 竖构图**。

主题为：

**「日式和室自然光和服写真」**

整体风格参考：

**高级人像商拍 + 日式和室美学 + 暖金自然光 + 赤色和服 + 电影感静帧 + 松弛克制的人物情绪。**

这组图不是普通游客打卡和服照，不是樱花祭摆拍，也不是低成本古风棚拍。  
重点是：

**高级、安静、通透、暧昧、精致、电影感。**

整组应像一组高预算时尚摄影工作室拍摄的和风人像大片，画面有明确的商业拍摄质感与审美控制力。

---

## 一、人物一致性

请严格保留用户本人真实身份特征，包括但不限于：

- 脸型
- 五官比例
- 眼睛形状
- 鼻子形状
- 嘴唇形状
- 肤色
- 年龄感
- 发际线
- 面部骨相
- 身材基础
- 整体气质

9 张照片里都必须清楚看起来是同一个真实女性。  
不要变成陌生人，不要欧美化，不要网红化，不要过度磨皮，不要 AI 假脸。  
允许高级商业精修，但必须保留真实辨识度和细腻皮肤质感。

---

## 二、整体气质

整体气质为：

**和风、静谧、柔美、克制、微性感、电影感、杂志感。**

关键词：

- Japanese style editorial portrait
- warm natural light
- tatami room photography
- cinematic still frame
- elegant and quiet
- refined commercial portrait
- soft sensuality
- airy golden atmosphere
- delicate emotional portrait
- premium portrait campaign

人物情绪不要夸张，不要大笑，不要甜妹感卖萌。  
更接近：

- 安静
- 若有所思
- 微微疏离
- 含蓄柔美
- 有呼吸感
- 像电影里的一个片段

---

## 三、服装造型

整组服装统一为：

**赤色 / 朱红色 / 橘红色和服造型，搭配白色内衬与金色织锦腰封。**

服装要求：

- 主体为红色或朱红色和服
- 白色交领内衬明显可见
- 腰封为金色或金锦图案 obi
- 面料有垂坠感和高级质感
- 不要廉价 cosplay 感
- 不要舞台戏服感
- 不要夸张花哨印花

可以允许部分镜头做以下处理：

- 和服微微下滑，露出肩颈和锁骨
- 领口更松弛，更有氛围感
- 局部躺姿时衣料自然散开，体现自然身体美
- 但整体仍要克制、优雅，不低俗

---

## 四、配饰要求

配饰应少而准，统一日式和风气质：

- 红色或粉红色花簪
- 少量珍珠或细小花朵点缀发饰
- 日式折扇
- 红色和伞 / 纸伞
- 可出现少量红枫叶或花朵做前景道具

要求：

- 道具少而精
- 不要堆砌日式小物
- 不要旅游写真感
- 整体要像商业拍摄中经过挑选的造型道具

---

## 五、发型与妆容

### 发型

发型统一为：

**松散盘发 / 低盘发 / 日式挽发**

要求：

- 头发盘起或半挽起
- 两侧有自然碎发
- 发丝可略带微湿感
- 局部发丝垂落到脸侧、耳边、肩颈
- 整体松弛但精致
- 不要整齐僵硬影楼盘发

### 妆容

- 自然精致妆容
- 底妆轻薄通透
- 肤质细腻，有轻微水润感
- 眼妆温柔干净
- 睫毛自然精致
- 唇妆偏水光裸红、豆沙红、暖调红棕
- 整体显得高级、安静、有呼吸感

---

## 六、场景与布景

场景统一为：

**日式和室空间 + 榻榻米 + 障子门 + 木质框架 + 暖阳照射。**

核心场景元素：

- 榻榻米地面
- 障子门 / 和室推拉门
- 木质门框
- 日式室内留白
- 局部可见庭院或模糊绿色
- 木质躺椅 / 竹木休闲椅
- 红枫前景虚化
- 纸伞 / 折扇作为辅助道具

要求：

- 场景极简
- 干净通透
- 不要复杂日式居酒屋布景
- 不要樱花堆满背景
- 不要廉价古风影楼背景布
- 要像真正的日式室内空间或高质量商业搭景

---

## 七、光线要求

光线是整组照片最关键的部分之一。

请统一使用：

**傍晚暖金色自然光 + 柔和逆光 + 室内漫反射 + 空气感高光。**

具体要求：

- 画面整体为暖金调
- 像下午或傍晚阳光照进和室
- 逆光时发丝和肩颈有边缘光
- 皮肤轻微发光
- 阴影柔和，不脏不灰
- 局部可有柔焦 flare
- 室内空气像被阳光晒热，充满柔和安静的氛围

不要：

- 冷白影棚光
- 强硬闪光灯
- 夜店彩灯
- 过曝
- 肤色偏黄发脏
- 过重滤镜

---

## 八、皮肤与质感要求

这组图的皮肤质感很重要，要有：

**轻微水润感、真实毛孔感、细小水珠感、肩颈与锁骨的光泽。**

可在局部特写中加入：

- 肩颈处细小水珠
- 锁骨和背部微湿质感
- 发丝贴肤
- 皮肤自然反光

要求：

- 是高级商业写真里的“湿润空气感”
- 不是洗澡写真
- 不是过度湿身
- 不低俗
- 重点是皮肤与光线的互动

---

## 九、身材与体态要求

人物体态重点为：

**肩颈舒展、锁骨清晰、动作柔和、姿态自然松弛。**

要求：

- 手部动作自然
- 脖颈修长
- 肩膀放松
- 背部线条柔和
- 躺姿和坐姿都要自然
- 不要硬拗姿势
- 不要奇怪骨折动作
- 不要低俗挑逗感

---

## 十、9张分镜要求

请生成 9 张不同的单独成片照片，每张都属于同一组和服商拍写真，但镜头语言明显不同。

### 第 1 张：障子门前半身肖像
人物站在障子门前，暖阳照在脸部与肩颈，身穿红色和服，白色领口微微下滑，露出锁骨。  
发丝自然垂落，头戴小型花簪。  
情绪安静、微低头或看向一侧。  
画面是整组的主视觉之一。

### 第 2 张：榻榻米侧躺照
人物侧躺在榻榻米上，身体包裹在红色和服中，一只手轻放在胸前或衣襟处。  
脸部贴近地面，目光看向镜头。  
旁边可有一朵红花作近景。  
画面柔软、慵懒、电影感强。

### 第 3 张：面部近景特写
人物躺在榻榻米上或微仰头，镜头拍摄面部特写。  
重点展现眼神、唇部、脸侧碎发、耳边花饰。  
皮肤细腻，光线温暖。  
这张更像商业美妆感特写。

### 第 4 张：倚靠障子门持折扇
人物半倚在障子门旁，手持一把红黑色日式折扇。  
和服松弛披在肩上，腰封可见。  
视线侧看，整个人像电影里一帧安静场景。  
画面兼具造型感与留白感。

### 第 5 张：持和伞全身竖幅照
人物站在和室中央，手持红色和伞。  
构图更完整，能看见红色和服、金色腰封和障子门背景。  
可有少量红枫前景虚化。  
画面像品牌宣传大片。

### 第 6 张：木质躺椅慵懒坐姿
人物靠坐在木质躺椅上，手持折扇，红色和服自然铺开。  
前景可用红枫虚化遮挡部分画面。  
目光看向镜头，情绪克制而有张力。  
画面偏时尚商业内页。

### 第 7 张：木椅正坐安静照
人物坐在木质椅上，低头看扇子或微微垂眸。  
阳光照亮和服与肩颈，风吹动碎发。  
画面更静，更像故事里的间隙。

### 第 8 张：锁骨与颈部湿润特写
拍摄人物颈部、锁骨、肩部的近景特写。  
红色和服与白色内衬微微下滑，肩颈带有细小水珠，旁边可点缀一朵小红花。  
重点是皮肤质感、线条和光线。  
不要过度裸露，保持高级感。

### 第 9 张：背部特写终章
人物背对镜头，露出背部与后颈，皮肤上有细小水珠，发丝自然垂落。  
和服松弛搭在肩下，背景仍是暖光和障子门。  
像整组照片的收尾镜头，安静、克制、余韵很强。

---

## 十一、摄影与成片风格

整体摄影风格参考：

- high-end kimono editorial portrait
- Japanese room natural light photography
- cinematic warm portrait
- premium commercial beauty portrait
- tatami room fashion shoot
- quiet sensuality
- red kimono campaign photography
- refined Asian portrait editorial
- soft golden light portrait
- luxury portrait retouching

成片要求：

- 高清写实摄影
- 高级商业精修
- 构图干净
- 皮肤细腻
- 和服面料与腰封纹理清晰
- 发丝真实
- 画面温暖通透
- 像高端摄影工作室拍摄的品牌级人像商片

---

## 十二、负面要求

请避免以下问题：
- 不要旅游打卡感
- 不要廉价和风影楼感
- 不要二次元 cosplay 感
- 不要过浓滤镜
- 不要塑料皮肤
- 不要错误手指
- 不要奇怪肢体
- 不要五官失真
- 不要比例失真
- 不要过度磨皮
- 不要过度裸露
- 不要低俗性感
- 不要背景杂乱
- 不要现代家居乱入
- 不要樱花祭商业街氛围

---

## 十三、最终效果总结

最终画面应让人感受到：

这是一组高完成度、高审美控制力的和服高级人像商拍。  
红色和服、障子门、榻榻米、暖阳、花簪、折扇、和伞与木质家具，共同构成一种静谧、柔软、电影化的和风空间。  
重点不只是“穿和服”，而是用光线、肌肤、姿态和场景，把人物拍成一组真正高级的商业人像作品。

items.title: 观念叙事型极简品牌标志设计

prompts.label: 英文提示词

prompts.text:
请根据用户输入的信息设计一个高完成度的「观念叙事型极简 Logo」。

【用户输入】
品牌名 / 项目名：【品牌名 / 项目名】
副标题 / 产品名：【副标题 / 产品名】
类型 / 行业：【设计工作室 / 影像工作室 / 创意厂牌 / 艺术展览 / 独立服饰 / 音乐品牌 / 建筑空间 / 创意出版 / 文化项目 / 小众品牌等】
品牌定位：【品牌定位】
核心概念：【梦境 / 控制 / 距离 / 孤独 / 探索 / 未来 / 想象 / 对话 / 结构 / 自由 / 叙事 / 精神性等】
隐喻意象：【宇航员 / 兔耳朵 / 剪影 / 木偶 / 手 / 盒子 / 星球 / 门 / 眼睛 / 绳线 / 月亮 / 装置 / 几何结构 / 人物与空间关系等】
情绪气质：【克制、冷静、先锋、神秘、实验、疏离、艺术感、诗性、理性、未来感等】
主色调：【黑 / 白 / 灰 / 深褐 / 墨黑等】
辅助色：【少量红色 / 暗红 / 极少量强调色】
画幅比例：【1:1】

【核心目标】
这次要设计的不是普通企业 Logo，也不是单纯图形标，而是一个具有“观念表达、叙事张力和极简气质”的品牌标志。它需要通过极少的元素，传达一个概念、一种情绪、一段隐喻关系，形成一个像“小型视觉作品”一样的 Logo。

最终效果应当具备：
1. 极简但不空洞；
2. 留白很多但不单薄；
3. 图形很少但有意味；
4. 文字克制但有设计感；
5. 整体像独立设计师品牌、创意工作室或艺术项目的识别符号。

【设计本质】
这类 Logo 的核心不是直接“说明品牌做什么”，而是通过图形隐喻、场景关系和视觉诗意，去间接表达品牌的精神气质。
请优先考虑：
- 一个图形是否有观念；
- 图形与文字之间是否形成一种叙事关系；
- 留白是否增强了作品感；
- 整体是否像一件小型艺术化识别装置。

【最重要的原则】
1. 图形必须简洁，但不能普通；
2. 图形必须带有隐喻、象征或观念性；
3. 不要把画面塞满，必须保持大量留白；
4. Logo 主体可以偏小，像被放置在安静空间中的一个小型符号；
5. 文字必须克制、简洁、有排版意识；
6. 不要做成传统厚重商业徽章；
7. 不要做成热闹卡通 Logo；
8. 不要做成普通几何极简标；
9. 整体要有实验感、先锋感、艺术感和独立品牌气质。

【图形设计要求】
请围绕【核心概念】和【隐喻意象】，设计一个“具有叙事意味的小型主图形 / 小场景 / 小装置”。

图形要求：
1. 不能只是普通插画；
2. 不能只是常规图标；
3. 需要有隐喻感；
4. 需要有轻微叙事性；
5. 可以有黑白剪影、细线结构、几何框架、少量红线、局部留白等形式；
6. 图形整体应简洁，不宜太复杂；
7. 图形要有“被观看”的价值，而不是仅仅功能化。

【文字设计要求】
文字部分应极其克制，但不能敷衍。
要求：
1. 品牌名 / 项目名清晰可读；
2. 英文可偏简洁、细线、全大写、现代感；
3. 中文可偏理性、冷静、少量使用；
4. 文字可作为图形的注释、对位、分列、标题或支撑结构；
5. 允许中英混排，但整体必须克制；
6. 不要使用过于花哨的字体；
7. 不要让文字成为主视觉堆积；
8. 文字与图形之间要形成冷静的设计关系，而不是随便摆放。

【排版与构图要求】
整体构图应偏“展览感 / 提案感 / 作品集感”：
1. 大量留白；
2. 主体较小；
3. 可以偏居中，也可以偏左 / 偏右，但要有设计平衡；
4. 图与字的关系可分列、对置、上下悬置或横向对位；
5. 可加入极细线、极少量小标记、小编号、小副标题；
6. 画面不能像海报，也不能像包装正稿，而应像一个独立展示的品牌识别方案。

【色彩要求】
色彩要克制。
推荐方案：
- 黑白灰为主体；
- 辅助以少量红色、暗红色、深褐色或一点点冷灰蓝；
- 红色可以作为：切线、轨迹、连接线、警示点、局部结构线、强调关系；
- 不要使用高饱和多彩配色；
- 不要大面积渐变；
- 不要热闹。

【适用气质】
整体应呈现：
- 先锋
- 冷静
- 神秘
- 诗性
- 概念性
- 设计师感
- 小众品牌感
- 独立工作室感

【风格关键词】
观念叙事型极简 Logo、Conceptual Narrative Minimal Logo、experimental logo、symbolic minimal logo、narrative mark、art-directed logo、independent studio branding、editorial-style brand mark、concept-driven brand identity、poetic visual metaphor。

【验收标准】
请确保最终结果满足：
1. 图形很少但有意味；
2. 画面很空但不单薄；
3. 有一个清晰的观念或隐喻；
4. 品牌名字体克制但有设计感；
5. 整体像一件小型品牌视觉作品；
6. 带有独立、先锋、设计师气质；
7. 与传统商业 Logo 有明显区别；
8. 适合创意、艺术、实验性品牌场景使用。

【输出要求】
请最终输出一个高完成度的「观念叙事型极简 Logo」，强调隐喻、叙事、小场景、极简构图、大留白、冷静文字与小众先锋气质。

prompts.text:
Design a visual poster with Oriental ink wash animation temperament for the theme [Straw Boats Borrowing Arrows]. The overall visual logic follows 'heavy ink to establish the bones, light colors to create the atmosphere, negative space for narration, and breathing edges.' The background is a warm Xuan paper texture with natural smudging of off-white, light blue-grey, and light watery tones, featuring slight paper grain, watermarks, and ink diffusion.

The core text in the image is not fixed in one position but is intelligently laid out according to the main subject's movement, line of sight, negative space, and visual center of gravity. The title can appear on the left, right, top, bottom, diagonally, partially exposed at the edges, or scattered around the main subject. The text position should look like a naturally grown part of the image, rather than post-production typography pasted on.

The main title serves as a heavy ink visual anchor participating in the composition, playing the role of grounding the image, supporting the main subject, guiding the line of sight, or creating rhythm. The title font is hand-written heavy ink calligraphy, with strokes that are thick, wet, naive, and irregular, featuring 'flying white', broken strokes, ink clumps, seepage, and rough edges. Character sizes are varied, with a slightly swaying center of gravity, possessing the handcrafted feel of children's picture books and Chinese ink wash animation opening titles. The title does not use regular commercial fonts but should be like a set of black graphic symbols, echoing the main subject, edge elements, and negative space.

The center of the image maintains moderate negative space, letting the main characters or core objects rest lightly in the air of the paper. Add light-colored edge elements based on the theme (e.g., [straw boats, arrows in the fog]), which extend in from the outside of the frame, showing only parts and not fully displayed. Edge elements use ink wash light colors, transparent smudging, and local blurring to create off-screen space and a sense of breathing. Color mainly appears at the edges and four corners, while the center area remains restrained and clean.

The overall temperament is poetic, childlike, Oriental, warm, and has a hand-drawn feel, like a breathing frame of a Chinese ink wash animation poster. The image should have a high-end design sense of 'heavy ink text as the skeleton, light color edges as the atmosphere, and negative space to tell the story.'

Theme: Straw Boats Borrowing Arrows
Ratio: 9:16

prompts.text:
为【主题】设计一张具有东方水墨动画气质的视觉海报。整体采用“重墨立骨、淡彩造境、留白叙事、边缘呼吸”的视觉逻辑。背景为温润宣纸质感，米白、浅青灰、淡水色自然晕染，带轻微纸纹、水痕和墨色扩散。

画面中的核心文字不固定在某一个位置，而是根据主体动作、视线方向、画面留白和视觉重心智能布局。标题可以出现在左侧、右侧、上方、下方、斜向、边缘半露，或围绕主体错落排布。文字位置要像画面自然生长出来的一部分，而不是后期贴上去的排版。

主标题作为浓墨视觉锚点参与构图，具有压住画面、托住主体、引导视线或制造节奏的作用。标题字体为手写重墨书法，笔画厚重、湿润、稚拙、不规则，带飞白、断笔、墨团、渗化和毛糙边缘。字形大小错落，重心略微摇晃，有儿童绘本与中国水墨动画片头的手工感。标题不使用规整商业字体，而要像一组黑色图形符号，与主体、边缘元素、留白空间产生呼应。

画面中心保持适度留白，让主要角色或核心物象轻轻落在纸面空气中。四周加入根据主题变化的淡彩边缘元素，例如【边缘元素】，这些元素从画面外部伸入，只露局部，不完整展示。边缘元素使用水墨淡彩、透明晕染、局部虚化处理，制造画外空间和呼吸感。彩色主要出现在边缘和四角，中心区域保持克制干净。

整体气质诗意、童趣、东方、温润、有手绘感，像一帧会呼吸的中国水墨动画海报。画面要有“重墨文字做骨架，淡彩边缘做气氛，留白区域讲故事”的高级设计感。

prompts.text:
Please generate 8 independent display images for individual items based on the same "Black Stockings / Garter Belt Guide" series style.

【Series Requirements】
- These images must belong to the same series as the completed overview guide.
- Overall layout, font, color tone, background, texture, and typesetting logic must remain consistent.
- All are vertical, high completion, warm white / light grey-white background, luxury feminine fashion guide style.
- Each one looks like an extension page under the same brand or the same visual system.

【Common Structure for Each Single Image】
1. Top Title Area
- English series title: BLACK GARTER GUIDE
- Chinese main title: 黑色丝袜 / 吊带袜单款展示
- Current style name: __________
- One short subtitle: Highlighting the core characteristics of the style

2. Middle Main Area
- Mainly features 1 adult female model wearing and displaying.
- Focus on displaying key details of the corresponding style:
  - Classic Lace: Lace at the top, elegant atmosphere.
  - Fine Fishnet: Mesh texture, light and transparent.
  - Dot Sheer: Polka dot pattern, retro and playful.
  - Back Seam: Seam on the back, sense of lines.
  - Stripe Sheer: Vertical stripes, leg-shaping.
  - Cross Strap: Strap structure, sense of design.
  - Minimal Sheer: Transparency, basic and versatile.
  - Floral Lace: Patterned decoration, romantic atmosphere.
- The model's appearance, hairstyle, pose, and camera angle should be different for each image, but all must remain high-end, realistic, sexy, and lifelike.
- Standing, sitting, crossed legs, leaning, looking back, and other different poses are allowed.
- The image should have a sense of three-dimensionality, shadow layers, and high-end editorial feel.

3. Annotation Area
- Each image must retain 3 to 5 hand-drawn style annotations.
- Arrows, short lines, circles, and handwritten style labels can be used.
- Annotation content should revolve around the most critical details of the style, such as:
  - Top opening structure
  - Pattern texture
  - Transparency
  - Seam position
  - Strapping method
  - Leg line effect
- Annotation text should be concise, clear, and in a unified style.

4. Bottom Information Area
- Add a short "Style Notes / 风格速记"
- Use 1 to 2 sentences to explain the suitable scene and atmosphere for the style.
- Keep it concise, do not overpower the main subject.

【Unified Visual Requirements】
- Maintain an overall visual system completely unified with the overview guide.
- Background unified as warm white, light grey-white, or milk white.
- Style unified as high-end, clean, fashion guide feel, luxury feminine visuals.
- Models must be real, three-dimensional, realistic, with natural skin texture.
- Each image must highlight the product, do not be vulgar, do not over-eroticize.
- Each image should look like a different chapter in the same series, not different works.

【Style List】
1. Classic Lace
2. Fine Fishnet
3. Dot Sheer
4. Back Seam
5. Stripe Sheer
6. Cross Strap
7. Minimal Sheer
8. Floral Lace

【Output Goal】
Generate 8 independent display images according to the above 8 styles. Require each one to maintain a unified series feel, while the character's styling, hairstyle, pose, and camera language are significantly different, ensuring the whole set looks complete, professional, and collectible.

items.title: 月光雾境空灵现代舞16宫格分镜故事板

prompts.text:
Please generate a high-completion, ultra-high-definition, clear and transparent '16-grid storyboard' image, with the theme 'Ethereal Modern Dance in Moonlight Mist'.

【Overall Positioning】
This is not an ordinary poster, nor a single dance portrait, but a complete 16-grid storyboard. The image should look like a professional choreography storyboard reference, with each grid showing different continuous movements of the same female dancer in the same scene. The overall sense of camera work, movement design, and storyboard feel should be very strong, suitable for subsequent video generation reference.

【Screen Layout】
- 4×4 layout, 16 grids in total
- Each grid must have a clear number: 1-16
- Each grid must have a Chinese title
- Each grid can be accompanied by 1-3 concise Chinese movement descriptions
- Each grid must clearly show the dancer's full body or most of the body to ensure movements are recognizable
- Overall like a professional dance storyboard / storyboard, do not make it into a messy poster

【Scene Setting】
- Shallow water mirror stage under the moonlight
- Thin mist, cold white moonlight, slight Tyndall light beams in the environment
- The ground has shallow water reflections that can reflect the character's movements
- The background is ethereal and minimalist, with hazy mountain shadows or blurred spatial layers in the distance
- The overall color palette is moonlight white, mist blue, silver-gray, and cold white
- The atmosphere is ethereal, dreamlike, pure, and high-end; not dark, not muddy, no color spots

【Character Setting】
- The same young adult female modern dancer
- Ethereal, clean, flowing, and somewhat celestial temperament
- Clothing is white / moonlight white / mist blue gauze modern dance long dress
- Barefoot
- The skirt is light and flowing, with obvious dynamics
- Must maintain high consistency in the character's face, hairstyle, and clothing across the 16 grids; do not make her look like a different person in each grid
- No ancient costumes, no ethnic costumes, no girl group vibe

【Style Requirements】
- Cinematic, realistic, elegant, artistic short film temperament
- Not a cartoon, not an illustration, not a rough sketch
- Should be like a 'high-quality dance movement storyboard'
- The movement in each grid should be significantly different, not just posing from different angles
- Highlight body lines, gauze dynamics, reflections, and spatial atmosphere

【16 Grids Movement Content】
1. Appearance under the Moon
The dancer stands in the center of the shallow water mirror, body slightly turned, one hand naturally垂落 (hanging down), one hand lightly raised, skirt touching the ground, reflection clear.

2. Raising Arms to Start the Dance
Arms slowly open upwards, chest slightly lifted, body as if awakened by moonlight.

3. Lateral Extension
Body elongated to the side, one arm up, one arm down, waist and spine forming a beautiful curve.

4. Probing Forward and Brushing Water
Body leans forward, one hand close to the water surface, the other hand extended backward, the skirt pulled into a streamline.

5. Low-level Contraction
The dancer drops to a low position, knees bent, body slightly gathered, arms hugging towards the body, as if gathering strength.

6. Rising and Releasing
Suddenly opening from the low position, chest up, arms widely extended, gauze and skirt being carried up.

7. Backbend
The dancer performs a large backbend, the spine curve is obvious, arms spread backward, body curve is graceful.

8. Spin and Turn
Returning to the center from the backbend, completing a smooth turn, the skirt and gauze flying around the body.

9. Leaping into the Air
The dancer completes a grand jump or leap, legs and arms forming extended lines, skirt billowing backward.

10. Turning in the Air and Landing
Continuing from the previous grid, performing a slight aerial turn or leap turn, then landing elegantly, movements continuous and smooth.

11. Sliding on the Ground
Sliding into ground movements after landing, one leg extended, one leg bent, arms trailing a long line.

12. Flipping Up from the Ground

prompts.text:

【整体定位】
这不是普通海报，也不是单张舞蹈写真，而是一张完整的16宫格分镜故事板。画面要像专业编舞分镜参考图，每一格都展示同一位女舞者在同一个场景中的不同连续动作，整体具有很强的镜头感、动作设计感和故事板感，适合后续作为视频生成参考。

【画面布局】
- 4×4排版，共16格
- 每格都要有清晰编号：1-16
- 每格都要有中文标题
- 每格可附1-3条简洁中文动作说明

- 整体像专业舞蹈分镜板 / 故事板，不要做成杂乱海报

【场景设定】
- 月光下的浅水镜面舞台
- 环境中有薄雾、冷白月光、轻微丁达尔光束
- 地面带浅水倒影，能反射人物动作
- 背景空灵极简，可有远处朦胧山影或虚化空间层次

【人物设定】
- 同一位年轻成年女性现代舞者
- 气质空灵、干净、飘逸、偏仙气
- 服装为白色 / 月白 / 雾蓝色轻纱现代舞长裙
- 赤脚
- 裙摆轻盈飘逸，有明显动态
- 必须保持16格人物脸部、发型、服装高度统一，不要每格像不同的人
- 不要古装，不要民族服饰，不要女团感

【风格要求】
- 偏电影感、写实、优雅、艺术短片气质
- 不是卡通，不是插画，不是粗糙草图
- 要像“高质量舞蹈动作分镜板”
- 每格动作要明显不同，不能只是换角度摆拍
- 要突出身体线条、轻纱动态、倒影和空间氛围

【16格动作内容】
1. 月下亮相
舞者站在浅水镜面中央，身体微侧，一只手自然垂落，一只手轻轻抬起，裙摆垂地，倒影清晰。

2. 抬臂启舞
双臂缓缓向上打开，胸腔微微上提，身体像被月光唤醒。

3. 侧身延展
身体向侧面拉长，一臂向上，一臂向下，腰腹与脊柱形成优美弧线。

4. 前探拂水
身体向前探出，一只手接近水面，另一只手向后延展，裙摆被拉出流线。

5. 低位收缩
舞者落入低位，膝盖弯曲，身体微微收拢，手臂抱向身体，像在蓄力。

6. 起身释放
从低位猛然打开，胸腔上扬，双臂大幅舒展，轻纱和裙摆被带起。

7. 后仰下腰
舞者做一个大幅后仰下腰动作，脊柱弯曲明显，双臂向后展开，身体曲线曼妙。

8. 回旋转体
从后仰中回到中心，完成一次顺滑转体，裙摆与轻纱绕身体飞起。

9. 腾空跃起
舞者完成一个大跳或腾空跃步，双腿与手臂形成舒展线条，裙摆向后扬起。

10. 空中转身落地
接上一格，做一个轻微空中转体或跃转，然后优雅落地，动作连贯流畅。

11. 地面滑落
落地后顺势滑入地面动作，一腿伸展，一腿弯曲，手臂拖出一条很长的线。

12. 地面翻起
从地面姿态快速翻起或卷身起立，头发、裙摆、轻纱一起带动。

13. 腾身侧弯
舞者起身后做一个大幅侧弯延展，一只腿支撑，一只腿向侧后延伸，手臂长线条打开。

14. 大旋展开
舞者完成一轮完整大旋转，身体完全打开，裙摆和轻纱形成饱满圆形动势。

15. 腾空拱背
全片最大高光。舞者做一个强烈腾空动作，跃起时上身后仰、脊柱拱起、双臂拉开，形成“腾空下腰”的视觉感，但必须保持真实可演。

16. 月下定格
最后收在一个极美的长线条定格，一臂高举，一臂舒展，身体微微后仰或侧立，裙摆缓缓落下，倒影安静。

prompts.text:
Design a high-end conceptual poster for "[Subject]". The core of the image is not a direct depiction of the subject itself, but transforms the subject into an "Internal System Map" with a sense of life. Use a large organic circular structure as the main visual, with a form similar to tree rings, water ripples, fingerprint textures, topographic contour lines, energy vortexes, or slices of life; there is a clear core point in the center, diffusing outward with multiple layers of irregular ring textures, representing the growth, accumulation, evolution, expansion, and internal order of the theme.

Set several small black nodes and extremely fine guide lines within the circular system, using "[Keyword 1], [Keyword 2], [Keyword 3], [Keyword 4], [Keyword 5]" as spiritual coordinates in the system, rather than an ordinary text list. Text annotations should be naturally distributed like scientific maps, star charts, anatomical diagrams, or research manuscripts, forming a contrast between rational annotations and emotional textures.

The overall style is minimalist high-end poster, art school graduation exhibition, conceptual visual design, information map, natural texture experiment, abstract brand visual. The background uses a large amount of clean white space with a slight paper texture, without using complex scenes. The main visual occupies the upper or center-upper position of the frame, leaving quiet space below for titles, short copy, or brand information. A miniature version of the small circular system can be added as a "partial enlargement / soul slice / second perspective" to enhance the contrast between macro and micro.

Colors use "[Main Color]" as a large-area organic base color, overlaying a small amount of "[Secondary Color]" as texture veins, and using black as anchors for text, nodes, and thin lines. Colors should be transparent, blooming, grainy, with a handmade watercolor or printmaking texture, and edges should be naturally broken with a strong sense of breathing. Overall, avoid a commercial template feel, avoid excessive decoration, avoid mechanical geometry, and pursue a balance of emotion, rationality, vitality, and spirituality.

prompts.text:
Please generate a high-completion mobile vertical 9:16 Eastern fantasy narrative portrait poster, with the series title "Beauty in the Painting · Breaking out of the Scroll."

【Theme Setting】
Subject Character: [Fill in, e.g.: ancient style beauty / Flower Goddess / Fairy under the moon / Cold Moon Goddess / Red-clothed swordswoman / Crane Shadow Immortal Lady]
Character Temperament: [Fill in, e.g.: pitiable and lovely / gentle and elegant / cold and aloof / bright and sharp / enchanting and mysterious / solemn and sacred]
Expression and Emotion: [Fill in, e.g.: eyes moist and moving / gentle smile / cold restraint / sharp and firm / sorrowful and hesitating to speak]
Action Setting: [Fill in, e.g.: reaching forward / stepping half a step out of the scroll / leaning forward out / flying out of the scroll / holding sleeves and looking back]
Clothing Direction: [Fill in, e.g.: white and green light gauze Hanfu / pink and gold gentle long dress / ice blue moonlight immortal skirt / red and gold magnificent ancient style robes]
Main Color Tone: [Fill in, e.g.: white + light green + light gold / off-white + soft pink + apricot gold / bluish-white + ice blue + silver grey / crimson + gold + milky white]
Floral Elements: [Fill in, e.g.: white plum / magnolia / crabapple / peony / camellia / cherry blossom]
Auxiliary Elements: [Fill in, e.g.: red-crowned crane / birds / floating gauze / flower petals / reflection in water / mist / golden particles / moon / pavilions]

【Core Visual Skeleton】
The center of the screen must have a very obvious vertical long scroll / hanging scroll as the core structure of the entire image. The character is not standing in front of the scroll, but must present a clear visual effect of "emerging from / walking out of / flying out of / breaking out of the scroll."

The following structural logic must be met simultaneously:
1. Most of the character's body has left the scroll, with the overall trend clearly facing toward the camera, creating a strong sense of breaking boundaries and forward momentum.
2. A part of the body, hem of the skirt, hem of the clothes, footsteps, or strands of hair must remain inside the scroll, forming a clear "fusion of inside and outside the painting."
3. The part of the character inside the scroll can be slightly soft, hazy, and painterly; the face, hands, and upper body protruding outside the scroll should be more realistic, clear, and delicate.
4. The character must have an overlapping relationship with the scroll, flower branches, birds, and floating gauze, rather than a flat studio pose.

【Scroll Content】
The scroll must be long enough and slightly wider than ordinary scrolls, overall stretched, grand, and complete. The inside of the scroll can present an Eastern painting realm matching the theme, such as:
- Landscape clouds and mist
- Flower trees and flower realms
- Moonlit night pavilions
- Ink wash pavilions and terraces
- Abstract Eastern secret realms
- Crane shadows on a cold river
- Flower Goddess scroll realm

【Character Performance】
The character must be a high-beauty, exquisite, realistic Eastern character image, with a cinematic realistic portrait texture. The character's expression must have emotional resonance, not stiff, not scary, and not ghost-like. The overall feeling should be beautiful, heart-stirring, and have a sense of story, like the stunning moment when "the person in the painting comes to reality."

【Foreground and Spatial Layers】
The image must have obvious but not overwhelming foreground elements used to create real spatial depth, for example:
- Foreground flower branches / flowers
- A small number of cranes or birds
- Floating light gauze
- Falling flower petals
- Water reflections
- Soft mist
- Golden particles / light spots

Note:
1. Foreground elements should appear to truly exist in physical space, rather than just being stuck on the background.
2. Cranes / birds can only serve as foil decorations and cannot be more eye-catching than the character.
3. Foreground elements should help establish "real space," thereby strengthening the feeling that the character has already broken out of the scroll.

【Background Requirements】
The background should not be pure black, nor should it be a complex realistic large scene. Please use a low-information dark atmospheric background, such as:
- Deep blue-grey misty realm
- Moonlit night soft mist flower realm
- Ink wash cloud and smoke background
- Warm gold dark mist background

The background needs a sense of layering, airiness, slight halo, and mist, but the overall style should still be restrained and not overwhelming. The goal is to create a dreamlike stage atmosphere where "the world in the painting slightly overlaps with real space."

【Composition and Camera Feel】
The overall composition is a 9:16 vertical poster-style composition, with the central axis long scroll as the stable core, and the character's face and extended hands as the visual focus. The upper part retains appropriate breathing space and atmospheric elements, the middle part strengthens the character's expression and action, and the lower part completes the landing and closure through the hem of the clothes, water surface, and flower branches. There should be a clear reading path: see the face first, then the hands, then understand the narrative relationship of breaking out of the scroll.

【Overall Style Requirements】
The overall style is:
Eastern fantasy aesthetics, ancient style cinematic feel, realistic beautiful portrait, installation-style flower realm, narrative poster, dreamlike but clear, exquisite high completion.

Emphasis:
- The image should be clear, do not over-blur
- The parts protruding outside the scroll are more realistic
- The composition has strong depth and camera feel
- High-end texture, do not have a low-quality illustration feel, do not have a common ancient style photo template feel, do not have a game character art feel
- The final effect should be like a high-end Eastern fantasy visual poster

【If the user uploads a character reference image】
If there is a reference character image, please use Image A as the character identity reference, retaining their facial feature recognition, face shape, makeup direction, and overall temperament, and complete the "Beauty in the Painting · Breaking out of the Scroll" stylized creation on this basis, do not change to a strange face.

Please output a final finished image with rich details, a beautiful atmosphere, and a strong visual impact of "breaking out of the scroll."

prompts.text:
请生成一张高完成度的手机竖版 9:16 东方奇幻叙事人像海报，系列名称为「画中美人 · 破卷而出」。

【主题设定】
主题人物：【填写，如：古风美人 / 花神 / 月下仙子 / 冷月神女 / 红衣剑姬 / 鹤影仙姬】
人物气质：【填写，如：楚楚可怜 / 温柔大方 / 清冷疏离 / 明艳凌厉 / 妖冶神秘 / 庄重神圣】
表情情绪：【填写，如：眼神湿润、楚楚动人 / 温柔含笑 / 冷淡克制 / 锐利坚定 / 哀伤欲言又止】
动作设定：【填写，如：向前伸手 / 半步迈出画卷 / 身体前倾探出 / 飞身破卷而出 / 扶袖回眸】
服装方向：【填写，如：白青轻纱汉服 / 粉金温柔长裙 / 冰蓝月色仙裙 / 红金华丽古风衣袍】
主色调：【填写，如：白+淡青+浅金 / 米白+柔粉+杏金 / 青白+冰蓝+银灰 / 赤红+金+奶白】
花材元素：【填写，如：白梅 / 玉兰 / 海棠 / 牡丹 / 山茶 / 樱花】
辅助元素：【填写，如：仙鹤 / 飞鸟 / 飘纱 / 花瓣 / 水面倒影 / 雾气 / 金色微粒 / 月亮 / 楼阁】

【核心视觉骨架】
画面中心必须有一幅非常明显的纵向长画卷 / 挂轴，作为整个画面的核心结构。人物不是站在画卷前，而是必须呈现出明显的“从画卷中探出来 / 走出来 / 飞出来 / 破卷而出”的视觉效果。

必须同时满足以下结构逻辑：
1. 人物的大半个身体已经离开画卷，整体趋势明显朝向镜头前方，有很强的破界感和前冲感。
2. 必须保留一部分身体、裙摆、衣摆、脚步或发丝仍然留在画卷内部，形成清晰的“画里画外融合”。
3. 画卷内部的人物部分可略带柔和、朦胧、绘画感；探出画外的脸部、手部、上半身则要更加写实、清晰、细腻。
4. 人物与画卷、花枝、飞鸟、飘纱要形成穿插关系，而不是平面摆拍。

【画卷内容】
画卷必须足够长，也比普通卷轴略宽，整体舒展、大气、完整。画卷内部可呈现与主题匹配的东方画境，如：
- 山水云雾
- 花树花境
- 月夜楼阁
- 水墨亭台
- 抽象东方秘境
- 鹤影寒江
- 花神卷境

【人物表现】
人物必须是高颜值、精致、写实的东方人物形象，具有电影级写实人像质感。人物表情要有情绪感染力，不能呆板，不能恐怖，不能女鬼化。整体感觉应唯美、心动、有故事感，像“画中人来到现实”的惊艳瞬间。

【前景与空间层次】
画面必须有明显但不喧宾夺主的前景元素，用于制造真实空间纵深，例如：
- 前景花枝 / 花朵
- 少量仙鹤或飞鸟
- 飘动轻纱
- 飘落花瓣
- 水面倒影
- 柔和雾气
- 金色微粒 / 光点

注意：
1. 前景元素要像真实存在于物理空间中，而不是只贴在背景上。
2. 仙鹤 / 飞鸟只能作为陪衬点缀，不能比人物更抢眼。
3. 前景元素要帮助建立“现实空间”，从而强化人物已经破卷而出的感觉。

【背景要求】
背景不要纯黑，也不要复杂写实大场景。请使用低信息量暗色氛围背景，如：
- 深青灰雾境
- 月夜柔雾花境
- 水墨云烟背景
- 暖金暗雾背景

背景需要有层次感、空气感、轻微光晕与雾感，但整体仍应克制，不能喧宾夺主。目的是营造“画中世界与现实空间轻度重叠”的梦幻舞台氛围。

【构图与镜头感】
整体构图为 9:16 竖版海报式构图，以中轴长画卷为稳定核心，以人物面部和伸出的手部为视觉焦点。上部保留适当呼吸空间和氛围元素，中部强化人物表情与动作，下部通过衣摆、水面、花枝完成落地与收束。整体要有明确阅读路径：先看脸，再看手，再理解破卷而出的叙事关系。

【整体风格要求】
整体风格为：
东方幻想美学、古风电影感、写实唯美人像、装置式花境、叙事型海报、梦幻但清晰、精致高完成度。

强调：
- 画面清晰，不要过度模糊
- 探出画外的部分更写实
- 构图有强烈纵深和镜头感
- 质感高级，不要低质插画感，不要普通古风写真模板感，不要游戏立绘感
- 最终效果要像一张高级东方幻想视觉海报

【如果用户上传人物参考图】
如果有参考人物图，请以 Image A 作为人物身份参考，保留其五官辨识度、脸型、妆感方向和整体气质，在此基础上完成「画中美人 · 破卷而出」风格化创作，不要换成陌生脸。

请输出一张细节丰富、氛围唯美、具有明显“从画卷中破卷而出”视觉冲击力的最终成品图。

prompts.text: Image Concept: A mixed-media, anime-style fashion design and concept art sketch sheet, centered around a character with vibrant, wavy red hair and an edgy style, similar to the vibe of the original image, but with distinct changes. ​Core Elements to Include: ​Style: A combination of detailed character illustrations, close-up details (like eyes and hands), and simplified, super-deformed (SD) "chibi" sketches, all done in a hand-drawn colored pencil and ink art style on a textured paper background. ​Main Character Illustration: Feature a prominent full-body sketch of a character in a dynamic pose (e.g., confidently standing with hands on hips). ​Outfit: A dark red, off-the-shoulder top with intricate black lacing, a short, dark grey pleated skirt with an attached red and black plaid asymmetric overlay, black fishnet stockings, and chunky black combat boots. ​Details: Add a lot of accessories: a wide black leather belt with silver skull buckles and hanging chains, multiple silver-toned necklaces (like cross pendants), a black choker, and rings with dark gemstones. ​Expression & Mood: The character has a confident, slightly mysterious expression with dark eyeliner and perhaps a small septum piercing. ​Detail Close-ups (Instead of the eyes): ​Hands: A detailed drawing of hands with long, dark nail art (perhaps black and silver abstract designs), adorned with gothic rings. ​Hairstyle: A close-up showing the texture of the deep red, wavy hair with perhaps a small red bow or skull pin. ​Chibi Characters: Scatter smaller, cute chibi versions of the character around the page, showcasing different emotions (e.g., one happy chibi with tiny hearts, one looking determined, etc.). ​Text & Doodles: Add the phrase "DESIGNED BY RUZAINA" prominently. Include handwritten-style notes and doodles like "GOTHIC CHIC," "RED VELVET DREAMING," small stars, hearts, crescent moons, and maybe a small bat icon. ​Layout: A slightly less crowded but still dynamic collage-style layout on an off-white, textured paper background, giving it the feel of an artist's genuine sketchbook page.

prompts.text: 图像概念：一个混合媒介、动漫风格的时尚设计和概念艺术素描图页，围绕一个拥有充满活力的波浪红发和前卫风格的角色展开，与原图的氛围相似，但有明显的改动。要包含的核心元素：风格：详细的角色插图、特写细节（如眼睛和手）以及简化的超变形（SD）“Q版”素描的结合，全部采用纹理纸背景上的手绘彩色铅笔和墨水艺术风格。主角插图：以一个处于动态姿势（例如自信地叉腰站立）的显著全身素描角色为特色。服装：一件带有复杂黑色系带的深红色露肩上衣，一条带有红黑格子不对称覆盖层的深灰色短百褶裙，黑色渔网袜和厚底黑色战斗靴。细节：添加大量配饰：带有银色骷髅扣和挂链的宽黑色皮革腰带，多条银色调项链（如十字架吊坠），一个黑色颈圈，以及镶有深色宝石的戒指。表情与情绪：角色具有自信且略带神秘的表情，画着深色眼线，可能还有一个小的鼻中隔穿孔。细节特写（代替眼睛）：手部：带长长的深色美甲（可能是黑色和银色的抽象设计）的手部详细画作，装饰着哥特式戒指。发型：显示深红色波浪发纹理的特写，可能带有一个红色小蝴蝶结或骷髅发夹。Q版角色：在页面周围散布较小的、可爱的Q版角色版本，展示不同的情绪（例如，一个带着小爱心的快乐Q版，一个看起来意志坚定的Q版等）。文字与涂鸦：显著地添加短语“DESIGNED BY RUZAINA”。包括手写风格的笔记和涂鸦，如“GOTHIC CHIC”、“RED VELVET DREAMING”、小星星、爱心、新月，可能还有一个小蝙蝠图标。布局：在米白色纹理纸背景上采用稍微不那么拥挤但仍具动态感的拼贴风格布局，赋予其艺术家真实素描本页面的感觉。

prompts.text:
Design a high-end Oriental editorial poster / cultural visual poster / solar term poster / literary cover-style poster for [Theme]. The overall style should not be a common clean illustration, but rather a "visual afterimage left behind by time, paper, air, and old printing."

The core highlight of the visual is: use large silhouettes of symbolic objects related to [Theme], such as [Theme Symbolic Objects], and let these silhouettes cut into the frame significantly from the top, bottom, or edges. Do not display the objects in full; instead, show only fragments, edges, contours, and truncated forms, letting the graphics naturally invade from outside the frame, creating a high-end, restrained compositional tension rich in white space.

These silhouettes cannot be clean vector graphics or ordinary illustrations. They must be processed with halftone dots, screen printing grain, old newspaper textures, Risograph retro printing textures, damaged ink, ink leakage, misaligned color registration, paper fiber erosion, rough edges, partial fading, and partial fracture effects. The graphics should look like afterimages left on old paper after many years, rather than patterns just drawn.

The composition adopts an "upper and lower climate layering" method. The upper part of the image uses warm-toned graphic processing, such as rust red, ochre, withered leaf orange, old cinnabar, caramel brown, and dark orange, to express external emotions, heat, memory, vitality, maturity, or a sense of history in [Theme]. The lower part uses cool-toned graphic processing, such as light cyan, mist blue, grayish green, cool bluish-gray, pale water blue, and diluted blue, to express internal emotions, air, water vapor, distance, silence, dreams, echoes, or spirituality in [Theme].

The background cannot be pure white. The background must be a warm old paper texture, using cream, ivory white, light beige, linen white, or old book page colors as the base, with subtle paper grain, horizontal fibers, slight stains, faded particles, printing indentations, and a sense of old poster wear. All colors should look as if they have been absorbed by the paper, low-saturation, soft, dry, and slightly faded, not bright or glowing, and without modern digital gradients.

Keep a large area of "breathing" white space at the center or visual center of gravity for placing the [Theme] main title. The main title should become the spiritual anchor of the visual. The font can be selected based on the theme: Songti, stela-style fonts, calligraphic fonts, or modern Chinese magazine title fonts for Oriental themes; restrained serif fonts, editorial magazine fonts, or minimalist title fonts for modern themes. The text color should not be pure black; use dark green, grayish green, dark tea color, old ink color, or faded brown to make the text also look printed on paper.

The typography should have an editorial design feel: the main title large yet restrained, the subtitle small and exquisite. English translations, dates, short sentence descriptions, vertical text, sidebar information, numbers, footnote-style explanations, and catalog-style small text can be added. Small text should not overpower the main subject; it should be like the explanatory text on old book pages, botanical archives, poetry collection covers, or exhibition posters. A breathing relationship must be formed between the text and graphics, avoiding crowding.

The visual needs a sense of "climate on paper": the graphics are not decorations but the deposition of air, temperature, time, memory, and emotion on paper. The warm parts are like sunlight, flames, autumn leaves, history, and the residual warmth of life; the cool parts are like dew, mist, rivers, night, silence, and inner echoes. There is no need for a hard division between the upper and lower colors; instead, they transition naturally through white space, paper grain, halftone dot density, and color dilution.

Overall style references: East Asian solar term posters, retro screen printing, Risograph posters, old book covers, botanical archival maps, poetry book binding, folk art printing, old newspaper halftone dots, Japanese seasonal posters, modern Oriental editorial design. The visual should have a high-end sense of design, collectability, cultural depth, paper texture, a sense of time, and restrained poetry.

Avoid: Do not make common commercial illustrations, no clean vector graphics, no excessive realism, no plastic texture, no neon colors, no high-saturation gradients, no cartoon styles, no overly complex backgrounds, do not place the main subject completely centered, and do not make the text look like it was pasted on later.

Final visual should be like a theme printed matter preserved by time: huge cropped symbolic objects forming warm-cool contrast at top and bottom edges, white space in the middle supporting the title, and paper grain, dots, ink leakage, and fading giving the entire image a high-end texture of old paper, climate, memory, and poetic afterimages.

——————
